/-! ## 0. Small algebra helpers -/

/
def lineAt (p u : Point) (t : ℚ) : Point
proof: := fun k => p k + t * u k

name: lineAt_zero
statement: theorem lineAt_zero (p u : Point) : lineAt p u 0 = p
proof:
:= by
  funext k; simp [lineAt]

name: dotQ_eq_sum
statement: theorem dotQ_eq_sum (n x : Point) : dotQ n x = ∑ i, n i * x i
proof:
:= by
  rw [Fin.sum_univ_three]; rfl

name: ne_zero_of_dotQ
statement: theorem ne_zero_of_dotQ {n u : Point} (h : dotQ n u ≠ 0) : n ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  rintro rfl
  exact h (by simp [dotQ])

name: dotQ_self_pos
statement: theorem dotQ_self_pos {n : Point} (h : n ≠ 0) : 0 < dotQ n n
proof:
:= by
  have hk : n 0 ≠ 0 ∨ n 1 ≠ 0 ∨ n 2 ≠ 0 := by
    by_contra hc
    push_neg at hc
    refine h (funext fun k => ?_)
    fin_cases k <;> simp [hc.1, hc.2.1, hc.2.2]
  have heq : dotQ n n = n 0 * n 0 + n 1 * n 1 + n 2 * n 2 := rfl
  rw [heq]
  rcases hk with h0 | h1 | h2
  · linarith [mul_self_pos.mpr h0, mul_self_nonneg (n 1), mul_self_nonneg (n 2)]
  · linarith [mul_self_pos.mpr h1, mul_self_nonneg (n 0), mul_self_nonneg (n 2)]
  · linarith [mul_self_pos.mpr h2, mul_self_nonneg (n 0), mul_self_nonneg (n 1)]

name: dotQ_comm
statement: theorem dotQ_comm (u v : Point) : dotQ u v = dotQ v u
proof:
:= by
  simp only [dotQ]; ring

name: dotQ_smul_left
statement: theorem dotQ_smul_left (κ : ℚ) (u v : Point) : dotQ (κ • u) v = κ * dotQ u v
proof:
:= by
  simp only [dotQ, Pi.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul]; ring

name: dotQ_smul_right
statement: theorem dotQ_smul_right (κ : ℚ) (u v : Point) : dotQ u (κ • v) = κ * dotQ u v
proof:
:= by
  simp only [dotQ, Pi.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul]; ring

name: dotQ_zero_right
statement: theorem dotQ_zero_right (u : Point) : dotQ u 0 = 0

statement: theorem dotQ_crossQ_self_left (a b : Point) : dotQ (crossQ a b) a = 0
proof:

name: dotQ_crossQ_self_right
statement: theorem dotQ_crossQ_self_right (a b : Point) : dotQ (crossQ a b) b = 0
proof:

name: dotQ_double_cross
statement:
theorem dotQ_double_cross (a b n w : Point) :
    dotQ (crossQ (crossQ a b) n) w
      = dotQ a n * dotQ b w - dotQ b n * dotQ a w
proof:
:= by
  simp only [dotQ, crossQ, mkPoint_zero, mkPoint_one, mkPoint_two]; ring

name: det3_crossQ_self
statement:
theorem det3_crossQ_self (a b : Point) :
    det3 a b (crossQ a b) = dotQ (crossQ a b) (crossQ a b)
proof:
:= by
  simp only [det3, dotQ, crossQ, mkPoint_zero, mkPoint_one, mkPoint_two]; ring

name: cramer_kernel
statement:
theorem cramer_kernel {a b u w : Point} (hdet : det3 a b u ≠ 0)
    (ha : dotQ a w = 0) (hb : dotQ b w = 0) (hu : dotQ u w = 0) : w = 0
proof:
:= by
  have hcof : ∀ (ca cb cu : ℚ),
      ca * dotQ a w + cb * dotQ b w + cu * dotQ u w = 0 := by
    intro ca cb cu; rw [ha, hb, hu]; ring
  funext k
  rw [Pi.zero_apply]
  fin_cases k
  · have key : w 0 * det3 a b u = 0 := by
      have := hcof (b 1 * u 2 - b 2 * u 1) (-(a 1 * u 2 - a 2 * u 1))
        (a 1 * b 2 - a 2 * b 1)
      simp only [det3, dotQ, crossQ, mkPoint_zero, mkPoint_one, mkPoint_two] at this ⊢
      linear_combination this
    exact (mul_eq_zero.mp key).resolve_right hdet
  · have key : w 1 * det3 a b u = 0 := by
      have := hcof (-(b 0 * u 2 - b 2 * u 0)) (a 0 * u 2 - a 2 * u 0)
        (-(a 0 * b 2 - a 2 * b 0))
      simp only [det3, dotQ, crossQ, mkPoint_zero, mkPoint_one, mkPoint_two] at this ⊢
      linear_combination this
    exact (mul_eq_zero.mp key).resolve_right hdet
  · have key : w 2 * det3 a b u = 0 := by
      have := hcof (b 0 * u 1 - b 1 * u 0) (-(a 0 * u 1 - a 1 * u 0))
        (a 0 * b 1 - a 1 * b 0)
      simp only [det3, dotQ, crossQ, mkPoint_zero, mkPoint_one, mkPoint_two] at this ⊢
      linear_combination this
    exact (mul_eq_zero.mp key).resolve_right hdet

name: eval_lineAt
statement:

statement:

name: foldr_min_le
statement:
theorem foldr_min_le {l : List ℚ} {a : ℚ} (h : a ∈ l) (b : ℚ) :
    l.foldr min b ≤ a
proof:
:= by
  induction l with
  | nil => cases h
  | cons x xs ih =>
    rcases List.mem_cons.mp h with rfl | h'
    · exact min_le_left _ _
    · exact le_trans (min_le_right _ _) (ih h')

name: foldr_min_pos
statement:
theorem foldr_min_pos {l : List ℚ} (hl : ∀ a ∈ l, 0 < a) {b : ℚ} (hb : 0 < b) :
    0 < l.foldr min b
proof:
:= by
  induction l with
  | nil => exact hb
  | cons x xs ih =>
    exact lt_min (hl x (List.mem_cons_self _ _))
      (ih (fun a ha => hl a (List.mem_cons_of_mem _ ha)))

name: exists_pos_lt_avoiding
statement:
theorem exists_pos_lt_avoiding {m : ℚ} (hm : 0 < m) (L : List ℚ) :
    ∃ δ : ℚ, 0 < δ ∧ δ < m ∧ ∀ r ∈ L, δ ≠ r
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨δ, hδ⟩ := ((Set.Ioo_infinite hm).diff L.finite_toSet).nonempty
  exact ⟨δ, hδ.1.1, hδ.1.2, fun r hr hc => hδ.2 (by rw [hc]; exact hr)⟩

name: exists_between_avoiding
statement:
theorem exists_between_avoiding {lo hi : ℚ} (h : lo < hi) (L : List ℚ) :
    ∃ σ : ℚ, lo < σ ∧ σ < hi ∧ ∀ r ∈ L, σ ≠ r
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨σ, hσ⟩ := ((Set.Ioo_infinite h).diff L.finite_toSet).nonempty
  exact ⟨σ, hσ.1.1, hσ.1.2, fun r hr hc => hσ.2 (by rw [hc]; exact hr)⟩

name: exists_avoiding
statement: theorem exists_avoiding (L : List ℚ) : ∃ ε : ℚ, ε ∉ L ∧ ε ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  have hfin : (insert (0 : ℚ) {x | x ∈ L}).Finite :=
    (L.finite_toSet.insert 0)
  obtain ⟨ε, hε⟩ := hfin.infinite_compl.nonempty
  rw [Set.mem_compl_iff, Set.mem_insert_iff] at hε
  push_neg at hε
  exact ⟨ε, hε.2, hε.1⟩

name: facet_n_ne_zero
statement:
theorem facet_n_ne_zero {t : Triangle} (hdet : detOrigin t ≠ 0) :
    ∀ g ∈ tetraHalves t, g.n ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  intro g hg
  rw [mem_tetraHalves_iff] at hg
  obtain ⟨k, rfl⟩ := hg
  have hneg : ∀ (n : Point) (c : ℚ) (u : Point), dotQ n u ≠ 0 →
      (Half.neg ⟨n, c⟩).n ≠ 0 := by
    intro n c u hu
    apply ne_zero_of_dotQ (u := u)
    show dotQ (psub (mkPoint 0 0 0) n) u ≠ 0
    rw [dotQ_neg_normal]
    exact neg_ne_zero.mpr hu
  fin_cases k
  · have h : slot t 0 = (if 0 ≤ dotQ (crossQ t.v₁ t.v₂) t.v₀
        then (⟨crossQ t.v₁ t.v₂, 0⟩ : Half) else Half.neg ⟨crossQ t.v₁ t.v₂, 0⟩) := rfl
    have hd : dotQ (crossQ t.v₁ t.v₂) t.v₀ ≠ 0 := by rw [dotQ_cross12_v0]; exact hdet
    show (slot t 0).n ≠ 0
    rw [h]; split_ifs
    · exact ne_zero_of_dotQ hd
    · exact hneg _ _ _ hd
  · have h : slot t 1 = (if 0 ≤ dotQ (crossQ t.v₀ t.v₂) t.v₁
        then (⟨crossQ t.v₀ t.v₂, 0⟩ : Half) else Half.neg ⟨crossQ t.v₀ t.v₂, 0⟩) := rfl
    have hd : dotQ (crossQ t.v₀ t.v₂) t.v₁ ≠ 0 := by
      rw [dotQ_cross02_v1]; exact neg_ne_zero.mpr hdet
    show (slot t 1).n ≠ 0
    rw [h]; split_ifs
    · exact ne_zero_of_dotQ hd
    · exact hneg _ _ _ hd
  · have h : slot t 2 = (if 0 ≤ dotQ (crossQ t.v₀ t.v₁) t.v₂
        then (⟨crossQ t.v₀ t.v₁, 0⟩ : Half) else Half.neg ⟨crossQ t.v₀ t.v₁, 0⟩) := rfl
    have hd : dotQ (crossQ t.v₀ t.v₁) t.v₂ ≠ 0 := by rw [dotQ_cross01_v2]; exact hdet
    show (slot t 2).n ≠ 0
    rw [h]; split_ifs
    · exact ne_zero_of_dotQ hd
    · exact hneg _ _ _ hd
  · have hd : dotQ (Proof.MeshIntersectJump.faceNormal t) t.v₀ ≠ 0 := by rw [faceNormal_offset]; exact hdet
    have h : slot t 3 = (if dotQ (crossQ (psub t.v₁ t.v₀) (psub t.v₂ t.v₀)) t.v₀ ≤ 0
        then (⟨crossQ (psub t.v₁ t.v₀) (psub t.v₂ t.v₀),
              dotQ (crossQ (psub t.v₁ t.v₀) (psub t.v₂ t.v₀)) t.v₀⟩ : Half)
         else Half.neg ⟨crossQ (psub t.v₁ t.v₀) (psub t.v₂ t.v₀),
              dotQ (crossQ (psub t.v₁ t.v₀) (psub t.v₂ t.v₀)) t.v₀⟩) := rfl
    show (slot t 3).n ≠ 0
    rw [h]; split_ifs
    · exact ne_zero_of_dotQ (show dotQ (Proof.MeshIntersectJump.faceNormal t) t.v₀ ≠ 0 from hd)
    · exact hneg _ _ t.v₀ (show dotQ (Proof.MeshIntersectJump.faceNormal t) t.v₀ ≠ 0 from hd)

name: slot3_eval
statement:
theorem slot3_eval {t : Triangle} (hdet : detOrigin t ≠ 0) (x : Point) :
    (slot t 3).eval x
      = -(orientSign t : ℚ) * (dotQ (Proof.MeshIntersectJump.faceNormal t) x - detOrigin t)
proof:
:= by
  have hb : dotQ (crossQ (psub t.v₁ t.v₀) (psub t.v₂ t.v₀)) t.v₀ = detOrigin t :=
    faceNormal_offset t
  have h : slot t 3 = (if dotQ (crossQ (psub t.v₁ t.v₀) (psub t.v₂ t.v₀)) t.v₀ ≤ 0
      then (⟨crossQ (psub t.v₁ t.v₀) (psub t.v₂ t.v₀),
            dotQ (crossQ (psub t.v₁ t.v₀) (psub t.v₂ t.v₀)) t.v₀⟩ : Half)
       else Half.neg ⟨crossQ (psub t.v₁ t.v₀) (psub t.v₂ t.v₀),
            dotQ (crossQ (psub t.v₁ t.v₀) (psub t.v₂ t.v₀)) t.v₀⟩) := rfl
  unfold orientSign
  rcases hdet.lt_or_lt with hlt | hgt
  · rw [h, if_pos (by rw [hb]; linarith), if_neg (by linarith), if_pos hlt]
    show dotQ (crossQ (psub t.v₁ t.v₀) (psub t.v₂ t.v₀)) x
        - dotQ (crossQ (psub t.v₁ t.v₀) (psub t.v₂ t.v₀)) t.v₀ = _
    rw [hb]
    show dotQ (Proof.MeshIntersectJump.faceNormal t) x - detOrigin t = _
    push_cast; ring
  · rw [h, if_neg (by rw [hb]; linarith), if_pos hgt]
    show dotQ (psub (mkPoint 0 0 0) (crossQ (psub t.v₁ t.v₀) (psub t.v₂ t.v₀))) x
        - -dotQ (crossQ (psub t.v₁ t.v₀) (psub t.v₂ t.v₀)) t.v₀ = _
    rw [dotQ_neg_normal, hb]
    show -dotQ (Proof.MeshIntersectJump.faceNormal t) x - -detOrigin t = _
    push_cast; ring

name: slot_lat_c
statement:
theorem slot_lat_c (t : Triangle) :
    (slot t 0).c = 0 ∧ (slot t 1).c = 0 ∧ (slot t 2).c = 0
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · have h : slot t 0 = (if 0 ≤ dotQ (crossQ t.v₁ t.v₂) t.v₀
        then (⟨crossQ t.v₁ t.v₂, 0⟩ : Half) else Half.neg ⟨crossQ t.v₁ t.v₂, 0⟩) := rfl
    rw [h]; split_ifs <;> simp [Half.neg]
  · have h : slot t 1 = (if 0 ≤ dotQ (crossQ t.v₀ t.v₂) t.v₁
        then (⟨crossQ t.v₀ t.v₂, 0⟩ : Half) else Half.neg ⟨crossQ t.v₀ t.v₂, 0⟩) := rfl
    rw [h]; split_ifs <;> simp [Half.neg]
  · have h : slot t 2 = (if 0 ≤ dotQ (crossQ t.v₀ t.v₁) t.v₂
        then (⟨crossQ t.v₀ t.v₁, 0⟩ : Half) else Half.neg ⟨crossQ t.v₀ t.v₁, 0⟩) := rfl
    rw [h]; split_ifs <;> simp [Half.neg]

statement:

name: orientSign_ne_zero
statement:
theorem orientSign_ne_zero {t : Triangle} (hdet : detOrigin t ≠ 0) :
    (orientSign t : ℚ) ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  rcases orientSign_cases hdet with h | h <;> rw [h] <;> norm_num

name: slot_eval_vanish
statement:
theorem slot_eval_vanish {t : Triangle} (hdet : detOrigin t ≠ 0)
    {k m : Fin 4} (hm : m ≠ slotIdx k) : (slot t k).eval (tetraVert t m) = 0
proof:
:= by
  have hv0 : tetraVert t 0 = 0 := rfl
  have hv1 : tetraVert t 1 = t.v₀ := rfl
  have hv2 : tetraVert t 2 = t.v₁ := rfl
  have hv3 : tetraVert t 3 = t.v₂ := rfl
  obtain ⟨w0, w1, w2⟩ := faceNormal_vertex t
  have h4 : ∀ j : Fin 4, j = 0 ∨ j = 1 ∨ j = 2 ∨ j = 3 := by decide
  rcases h4 k with rfl | rfl | rfl | rfl <;> rcases h4 m with rfl | rfl | rfl | rfl
  
  · rw [slot0_eval hdet, hv0, dotQ_zero_right, mul_zero]
  · exact absurd rfl hm
  · rw [slot0_eval hdet, hv2, dotQ_crossQ_self_left, mul_zero]
  · rw [slot0_eval hdet, hv3, dotQ_crossQ_self_right, mul_zero]
  
  · rw [slot1_eval hdet, hv0, dotQ_zero_right, mul_zero]
  · rw [slot1_eval hdet, hv1, dotQ_crossQ_self_right, mul_zero]
  · exact absurd rfl hm
  · rw [slot1_eval hdet, hv3, dotQ_crossQ_self_left, mul_zero]
  
  · rw [slot2_eval hdet, hv0, dotQ_zero_right, mul_zero]
  · rw [slot2_eval hdet, hv1, dotQ_crossQ_self_left, mul_zero]
  · rw [slot2_eval hdet, hv2, dotQ_crossQ_self_right, mul_zero]
  · exact absurd rfl hm
  
  · exact absurd rfl hm
  · rw [slot3_eval hdet, hv1, w0]; ring
  · rw [slot3_eval hdet, hv2, w1]; ring
  · rw [slot3_eval hdet, hv3, w2]; ring

name: slot_eval_omitted_ne
statement:
theorem slot_eval_omitted_ne {t : Triangle} (hdet : detOrigin t ≠ 0)
    (k : Fin 4) : (slot t k).eval (tetraVert t (slotIdx k)) ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  have hos : (orientSign t : ℚ) ≠ 0 := orientSign_ne_zero hdet
  fin_cases k
  · show (slot t 0).eval (tetraVert t (slotIdx 0)) ≠ 0
    rw [show tetraVert t (slotIdx 0) = t.v₀ from rfl, slot0_eval hdet,
      dotQ_cross12_v0]
    exact mul_ne_zero hos hdet
  · show (slot t 1).eval (tetraVert t (slotIdx 1)) ≠ 0
    have hd : dotQ (crossQ t.v₂ t.v₀) t.v₁ = detOrigin t := by
      rw [dotQ_crossQ_swap, dotQ_cross02_v1]; ring
    rw [show tetraVert t (slotIdx 1) = t.v₁ from rfl, slot1_eval hdet, hd]
    exact mul_ne_zero hos hdet
  · show (slot t 2).eval (tetraVert t (slotIdx 2)) ≠ 0
    rw [show tetraVert t (slotIdx 2) = t.v₂ from rfl, slot2_eval hdet,
      dotQ_cross01_v2]
    exact mul_ne_zero hos hdet
  · show (slot t 3).eval (tetraVert t (slotIdx 3)) ≠ 0
    rw [show tetraVert t (slotIdx 3) = (0 : Point) from rfl, slot3_eval hdet,
      dotQ_zero_right, show -(orientSign t : ℚ) * (0 - detOrigin t)
        = (orientSign t : ℚ) * detOrigin t from by ring]
    exact mul_ne_zero hos hdet

name: slot_ne_of_idx_ne
statement:
theorem slot_ne_of_idx_ne {t : Triangle} (hdet : detOrigin t ≠ 0)
    {k k' : Fin 4} (hkk : k ≠ k') : slot t k ≠ slot t k'
proof:
:= by
  intro heq
  apply slot_eval_omitted_ne hdet k'
  rw [← heq]
  exact slot_eval_vanish hdet (fun h => hkk (slotIdx_injective h).symm)

name: tetraHalves_not_proportional
statement:
theorem tetraHalves_not_proportional {t : Triangle} (hdet : detOrigin t ≠ 0)
    {g g' : Half} (hg : g ∈ tetraHalves t) (hg' : g' ∈ tetraHalves t)
    (hne : g ≠ g') (κ : ℚ) (hκ : ∀ z, g'.eval z = κ * g.eval z) : False
proof:
:= by
  rw [mem_tetraHalves_iff] at hg hg'
  obtain ⟨k, rfl⟩ := hg
  obtain ⟨k', rfl⟩ := hg'
  have hkk : slotIdx k' ≠ slotIdx k := fun h => hne (by rw [slotIdx_injective h])
  have hker := hκ (tetraVert t (slotIdx k'))
  rw [slot_eval_vanish hdet hkk, mul_zero] at hker
  exact slot_eval_omitted_ne hdet k' hker

name: perp_normal_nondegen
proof:
:= by
  by_contra hc
  push_neg at hc

  have hd : det3 (psub t.v₁ t.v₀) (psub t.v₂ t.v₀) (Proof.MeshIntersectJump.faceNormal t) ≠ 0 := by

name: clean_off_carrier

name: clean_off_surface
statement:
theorem clean_off_surface {M : Mesh} (hnpo : NoPlaneThroughOrigin M) {x : Point}
    (hx : G1Clean M x) (i : Fin M.size) : x ∉ triangleSet M[i]
proof:

name: qsign_ne_zero
statement: theorem qsign_ne_zero {q : ℚ} (h : q ≠ 0) : qsign q = 1 ∨ qsign q = -1
proof:
:= by
  rcases h.lt_or_lt with hlt | hgt
  · right; exact qsign_of_neg hlt

name: admPair_sides
statement:
theorem admPair_sides {M : Mesh} {i : Fin M.size} {x y : Point} {τc : ℚ}
    (hnpo : NoPlaneThroughOrigin M) (hp : AdmPair M i x y τc) :
    dotQ (Proof.MeshIntersectJump.faceNormal M[i]) x - detOrigin M[i] ≠ 0 ∧
    dotQ (Proof.MeshIntersectJump.faceNormal M[i]) y - detOrigin M[i] ≠ 0 ∧
    sideOf M[i] x = -sideOf M[i] y ∧
    (sideOf M[i] x = 1 ∨ sideOf M[i] x = -1)
proof:
:= by
  set t := M[i] with ht
  set D : ℚ := dotQ (Proof.MeshIntersectJump.faceNormal t) (psub y x) with hD
  
  have htrace : ∀ τ : ℚ, dotQ (Proof.MeshIntersectJump.faceNormal t) (seg x y τ) - detOrigin t
      = (dotQ (Proof.MeshIntersectJump.faceNormal t) x - detOrigin t) + τ * D := by
    intro τ
    have := eval_seg ⟨Proof.MeshIntersectJump.faceNormal t, detOrigin t⟩ x y τ
    simpa [Half.eval] using this
  have hx : dotQ (Proof.MeshIntersectJump.faceNormal t) x - detOrigin t ≠ 0 :=
    clean_off_carrier hnpo hp.g1x i
  have hy : dotQ (Proof.MeshIntersectJump.faceNormal t) y - detOrigin t ≠ 0 :=
    clean_off_carrier hnpo hp.g1y i
  have hfoot : dotQ (Proof.MeshIntersectJump.faceNormal t) (seg x y τc) - detOrigin t = 0 := by
    rw [triangleSet_on_carrier hp.footMem]; ring
  have hx_eq : dotQ (Proof.MeshIntersectJump.faceNormal t) x - detOrigin t = -τc * D := by
    have := htrace τc; rw [hfoot] at this; linarith
  have hy_eq : dotQ (Proof.MeshIntersectJump.faceNormal t) y - detOrigin t = (1 - τc) * D := by
    have h1 := htrace 1
    have hseg1 : seg x y 1 = y := seg_one x y
    rw [hseg1] at h1
    rw [h1, hx_eq]; ring
  have hDne : D ≠ 0 := by
    intro hc; rw [hc, mul_zero] at hx_eq; exact hx hx_eq
  have hside : sideOf t x = -sideOf t y := by
    unfold sideOf
    rw [hx_eq, hy_eq]
    rcases hDne.lt_or_lt with hneg | hpos
    · rw [qsign_of_pos (by nlinarith [hp.lt0]), qsign_of_neg (by nlinarith [hp.lt1])]
      ring
    · rw [qsign_of_neg (by nlinarith [hp.lt0]), qsign_of_pos (by nlinarith [hp.lt1])]
  exact ⟨hx, hy, hside, qsign_ne_zero hx⟩

name: admPt_side
statement:
theorem admPt_side {M : Mesh} {i : Fin M.size} {s : ℤ} {x : Point}
    (hnpo : NoPlaneThroughOrigin M) (hx : AdmPt M i s x) : s = 1 ∨ s = -1
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨y, τc, hp, hs⟩ := hx
  rw [← hs]
  exact (admPair_sides hnpo hp).2.2.2

name: thresh_one_var
statement:
theorem thresh_one_var (K : List (ℚ × ℚ))
    (h0 : ∀ b : ℚ, b ≤ 0 → ¬ ∀ k ∈ K, k.1 * b ≤ k.2) :
    ∃ ε : ℚ, 0 < ε ∧ ∀ b : ℚ, b ≤ ε → ¬ ∀ k ∈ K, k.1 * b ≤ k.2
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hS : ∃ b : ℚ, ∀ k ∈ K, k.1 * b ≤ k.2
  · obtain ⟨b₀, hb₀⟩ := hS
    have hb₀pos : 0 < b₀ := by
      by_contra hc; push_neg at hc; exact h0 b₀ hc hb₀
    
    have hKneg : K.filter (fun k => k.1 < 0) ≠ [] := by
      intro hnil
      refine h0 0 le_rfl (fun k hk => ?_)
      have hk1 : ¬ k.1 < 0 := by
        intro hneg
        have hmem : k ∈ K.filter (fun k => k.1 < 0) := by
          rw [List.mem_filter]; exact ⟨hk, by simpa using hneg⟩
        rw [hnil] at hmem
        simp at hmem
      push_neg at hk1
      have := hb₀ k hk
      nlinarith
    set ratios := (K.filter (fun k => k.1 < 0)).map (fun k => k.2 / k.1) with hratios
    have hrlen : 0 < ratios.length := by
      rw [hratios, List.length_map]
      exact List.length_pos_of_ne_nil hKneg
    set a := ratios.maximum_of_length_pos hrlen with ha
    
    have hlower : ∀ b : ℚ, (∀ k ∈ K, k.1 * b ≤ k.2) → a ≤ b := by
      intro b hb
      have hmem := List.maximum_of_length_pos_mem hrlen
      rw [← ha] at hmem
      rw [hratios, List.mem_map] at hmem
      obtain ⟨k, hkmem, hkval⟩ := hmem
      rw [List.mem_filter] at hkmem
      have hk1 : k.1 < 0 := by simpa using hkmem.2
      have hineq := hb k hkmem.1
      rw [← hkval]
      rw [div_le_iff_of_neg hk1]
      linarith [hineq]
    
    have hasol : ∀ k ∈ K, k.1 * a ≤ k.2 := by
      intro k hk
      rcases lt_trichotomy k.1 0 with hneg | hzero | hpos
      · have hmem : k.2 / k.1 ∈ ratios := by
          rw [hratios, List.mem_map]
          exact ⟨k, by rw [List.mem_filter]; exact ⟨hk, by simpa using hneg⟩, rfl⟩
        have hle : k.2 / k.1 ≤ a := List.le_maximum_of_length_pos_of_mem hmem hrlen
        calc k.1 * a ≤ k.1 * (k.2 / k.1) := by
              apply mul_le_mul_of_nonpos_left hle (le_of_lt hneg)
          _ = k.2 := by
              rw [mul_comm]
              exact div_mul_cancel₀ k.2 (ne_of_lt hneg)
      · have := hb₀ k hk
        rw [hzero, zero_mul] at this ⊢
        exact this
      · have hab₀ : a ≤ b₀ := hlower b₀ hb₀
        calc k.1 * a ≤ k.1 * b₀ := by nlinarith
          _ ≤ k.2 := hb₀ k hk
    have hapos : 0 < a := by
      by_contra hc; push_neg at hc; exact h0 a hc hasol
    refine ⟨a / 2, by linarith, fun b hb hsol => ?_⟩
    have := hlower b hsol
    linarith
  · exact ⟨1, one_pos, fun b _ hsol => hS ⟨b, hsol⟩⟩

name: fm_step
statement:
theorem fm_step (K : List (ℚ × ℚ × ℚ)) (b : ℚ) :
    fmElim K b ↔ ∃ a : ℚ, ∀ k ∈ K, k.1 * a + k.2.1 * b ≤ k.2.2
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨hzero, hpair⟩
    by_cases hL : K.filter (fun k => k.1 < 0) ≠ []
    · 
      set lows := (K.filter (fun k => k.1 < 0)).map (fun k => (k.2.2 - k.2.1 * b) / k.1)
        with hlows
      have hllen : 0 < lows.length := by
        rw [hlows, List.length_map]; exact List.length_pos_of_ne_nil hL
      set a := lows.maximum_of_length_pos hllen with ha
      
      have hmem := List.maximum_of_length_pos_mem hllen
      rw [← ha, hlows, List.mem_map] at hmem
      obtain ⟨l, hlf, hval⟩ := hmem
      rw [List.mem_filter] at hlf
      have hl1 : l.1 < 0 := by simpa using hlf.2
      refine ⟨a, fun k hk => ?_⟩
      rcases lt_trichotomy k.1 0 with hneg | hz | hpos
      · have hmemk : (k.2.2 - k.2.1 * b) / k.1 ∈ lows := by
          rw [hlows]
          exact List.mem_map.mpr ⟨k, List.mem_filter.mpr ⟨hk, by simpa using hneg⟩, rfl⟩
        have hle := List.le_maximum_of_length_pos_of_mem hmemk hllen
        rw [← ha] at hle
        have hmul := mul_le_mul_of_nonpos_left hle (le_of_lt hneg)
        rw [← mul_div_assoc, mul_comm k.1 (k.2.2 - k.2.1 * b),
          mul_div_assoc, div_self (ne_of_lt hneg), mul_one] at hmul
        linarith
      · rw [hz, zero_mul, zero_add]
        exact hzero k hk hz
      · have hcomb := hpair k hk l hlf.1 hpos hl1
        have hkey : k.1 * ((l.2.2 - l.2.1 * b) / l.1) ≤ k.2.2 - k.2.1 * b := by
          rw [← mul_div_assoc, div_le_iff_of_neg hl1]
          nlinarith [hcomb]
        rw [← hval]
        linarith
    · push_neg at hL
      by_cases hU : K.filter (fun k => 0 < k.1) ≠ []
      · 
        set ups := (K.filter (fun k => 0 < k.1)).map (fun k => (k.2.2 - k.2.1 * b) / k.1)
          with hups
        have hulen : 0 < ups.length := by
          rw [hups, List.length_map]; exact List.length_pos_of_ne_nil hU
        set a := ups.minimum_of_length_pos hulen with ha
        refine ⟨a, fun k hk => ?_⟩
        rcases lt_trichotomy k.1 0 with hneg | hz | hpos
        · exfalso
          have : k ∈ K.filter (fun k => k.1 < 0) :=
            List.mem_filter.mpr ⟨hk, by simpa using hneg⟩
          rw [hL] at this
          simp at this
        · rw [hz, zero_mul, zero_add]
          exact hzero k hk hz
        · have hmemk : (k.2.2 - k.2.1 * b) / k.1 ∈ ups := by
            rw [hups]
            exact List.mem_map.mpr ⟨k, List.mem_filter.mpr ⟨hk, by simpa using hpos⟩, rfl⟩
          have hle := List.minimum_of_length_pos_le_of_mem hmemk hulen
          rw [← ha] at hle
          have hmul := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hle (le_of_lt hpos)
          rw [← mul_div_assoc, mul_comm k.1 (k.2.2 - k.2.1 * b),
            mul_div_assoc, div_self (ne_of_gt hpos), mul_one] at hmul
          linarith
      · push_neg at hU
        refine ⟨0, fun k hk => ?_⟩
        have hz : k.1 = 0 := by
          rcases lt_trichotomy k.1 0 with hneg | hz | hpos
          · exfalso
            have : k ∈ K.filter (fun k => k.1 < 0) :=
              List.mem_filter.mpr ⟨hk, by simpa using hneg⟩
            rw [hL] at this; simp at this
          · exact hz
          · exfalso
            have : k ∈ K.filter (fun k => 0 < k.1) :=
              List.mem_filter.mpr ⟨hk, by simpa using hpos⟩
            rw [hU] at this; simp at this
        rw [hz, zero_mul, zero_add]
        exact hzero k hk hz
  · rintro ⟨a, ha⟩
    constructor
    · intro k hk hz
      have := ha k hk
      rw [hz, zero_mul, zero_add] at this
      exact this
    · intro k hk l hl hkpos hlneg
      have h1 := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (ha k hk) (by linarith : (0:ℚ) ≤ -l.1)
      have h2 := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (ha l hl) (le_of_lt hkpos)
      nlinarith [h1, h2]

name: elimList_iff
statement:
theorem elimList_iff (K : List (ℚ × ℚ × ℚ)) (b : ℚ) :
    (∀ p ∈ elimList K, p.1 * b ≤ p.2) ↔ fmElim K b
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro hall
    constructor
    · intro k hk hz
      exact hall (k.2.1, k.2.2) (List.mem_append_left _
        (List.mem_map.mpr ⟨k, List.mem_filter.mpr ⟨hk, by simpa using hz⟩, rfl⟩))
    · intro k hk l hl hkpos hlneg
      exact hall (k.1 * l.2.1 - l.1 * k.2.1, k.1 * l.2.2 - l.1 * k.2.2)
        (List.mem_append_right _ (by
          rw [List.mem_flatMap]
          exact ⟨k, hk, List.mem_map.mpr ⟨l, List.mem_filter.mpr ⟨hl,
            by simpa using ⟨hkpos, hlneg⟩⟩, rfl⟩⟩))
  · rintro ⟨hzero, hpair⟩ p hp
    rcases List.mem_append.mp hp with hp | hp
    · rw [List.mem_map] at hp
      obtain ⟨k, hkf, rfl⟩ := hp
      rw [List.mem_filter] at hkf
      exact hzero k hkf.1 (by simpa using hkf.2)
    · rw [List.mem_flatMap] at hp
      obtain ⟨k, hk, hp⟩ := hp
      rw [List.mem_map] at hp
      obtain ⟨l, hlf, rfl⟩ := hp
      rw [List.mem_filter] at hlf
      have hcond : 0 < k.1 ∧ l.1 < 0 := by simpa using hlf.2
      exact hpair k hk l hlf.1 hcond.1 hcond.2

name: thresh_strip
statement:
theorem thresh_strip (K : List (ℚ × ℚ × ℚ))
    (hnonneg : ∀ a b : ℚ, (∀ k ∈ K, k.1 * a + k.2.1 * b ≤ k.2.2) → 0 ≤ b)
    (h0 : ∀ a : ℚ, ¬ ∀ k ∈ K, k.1 * a + k.2.1 * 0 ≤ k.2.2) :
    ∃ ε : ℚ, 0 < ε ∧ ∀ a b : ℚ, b ≤ ε →
      ¬ ∀ k ∈ K, k.1 * a + k.2.1 * b ≤ k.2.2
proof:
:= by
  have key : ∀ b : ℚ, (∀ p ∈ elimList K, p.1 * b ≤ p.2)
      ↔ ∃ a, ∀ k ∈ K, k.1 * a + k.2.1 * b ≤ k.2.2 :=
    fun b => (elimList_iff K b).trans (fm_step K b)
  have hempty : ∀ b : ℚ, b ≤ 0 → ¬ ∀ p ∈ elimList K, p.1 * b ≤ p.2 := by
    intro b hb hsolE
    obtain ⟨a, ha⟩ := (key b).mp hsolE
    rcases lt_or_eq_of_le hb with hlt | hzero
    · exact absurd (hnonneg a b ha) (not_le.mpr hlt)
    · subst hzero
      exact h0 a ha
  obtain ⟨ε, hε, hthresh⟩ := thresh_one_var (elimList K) hempty
  exact ⟨ε, hε, fun a b hb hsol => hthresh b hb ((key b).mpr ⟨a, hsol⟩)⟩

name: quad_roots_finite
statement:
theorem quad_roots_finite {a b c : ℚ} (h : ¬ (a = 0 ∧ b = 0 ∧ c = 0)) :
    {τ : ℚ | a + b * τ + c * τ ^ 2 = 0}.Finite
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hsub : {τ : ℚ | a + b * τ + c * τ ^ 2 = 0}.Subsingleton
  · exact hsub.finite
  · rw [Set.not_subsingleton_iff] at hsub
    obtain ⟨x, hx, y, hy, hxy⟩ := hsub
    apply Set.Finite.subset ((Set.finite_singleton y).insert x)
    intro z hz
    rw [Set.mem_setOf_eq] at hx hy hz
    by_contra hzm
    simp only [Set.mem_insert_iff, Set.mem_singleton_iff] at hzm
    push_neg at hzm
    obtain ⟨hzx, hzy⟩ := hzm
    
    have e1 : (x - y) * (b + c * (x + y)) = 0 := by linear_combination hx - hy
    have e2 : (x - z) * (b + c * (x + z)) = 0 := by linear_combination hx - hz
    have f1 : b + c * (x + y) = 0 :=
      (mul_eq_zero.mp e1).resolve_left (sub_ne_zero.mpr hxy)
    have f2 : b + c * (x + z) = 0 :=
      (mul_eq_zero.mp e2).resolve_left (sub_ne_zero.mpr (fun hc => hzx hc.symm))
    have hcz : c * (y - z) = 0 := by linarith
    have hc : c = 0 :=
      (mul_eq_zero.mp hcz).resolve_right (sub_ne_zero.mpr (fun hc => hzy hc.symm))
    have hb : b = 0 := by rw [hc] at f1; linarith
    have ha : a = 0 := by
      rw [hb, hc] at hx
      nlinarith [hx]
    exact h ⟨ha, hb, hc⟩

name: combo_zero_of_det
statement:
theorem combo_zero_of_det {t : Triangle} (hdet : detOrigin t ≠ 0)
    {c₀ c₁ c₂ : ℚ} (h : c₀ • t.v₀ + c₁ • t.v₁ + c₂ • t.v₂ = 0) :
    c₀ = 0 ∧ c₁ = 0 ∧ c₂ = 0
proof:
:= by
  have h0 := congrFun h 0
  have h1 := congrFun h 1
  have h2 := congrFun h 2
  simp only [Pi.add_apply, Pi.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul, Pi.zero_apply] at h0 h1 h2
  refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · have hkey : c₀ * detOrigin t = 0 := by
      simp only [detOrigin]
      linear_combination (t.v₁ 1 * t.v₂ 2 - t.v₁ 2 * t.v₂ 1) * h0
        + (t.v₁ 2 * t.v₂ 0 - t.v₁ 0 * t.v₂ 2) * h1
        + (t.v₁ 0 * t.v₂ 1 - t.v₁ 1 * t.v₂ 0) * h2
    exact (mul_eq_zero.mp hkey).resolve_right hdet
  · have hkey : c₁ * detOrigin t = 0 := by
      simp only [detOrigin]
      linear_combination (t.v₂ 1 * t.v₀ 2 - t.v₂ 2 * t.v₀ 1) * h0
        + (t.v₂ 2 * t.v₀ 0 - t.v₂ 0 * t.v₀ 2) * h1
        + (t.v₂ 0 * t.v₀ 1 - t.v₂ 1 * t.v₀ 0) * h2
    exact (mul_eq_zero.mp hkey).resolve_right hdet
  · have hkey : c₂ * detOrigin t = 0 := by
      simp only [detOrigin]
      linear_combination (t.v₀ 1 * t.v₁ 2 - t.v₀ 2 * t.v₁ 1) * h0
        + (t.v₀ 2 * t.v₁ 0 - t.v₀ 0 * t.v₁ 2) * h1
        + (t.v₀ 0 * t.v₁ 1 - t.v₀ 1 * t.v₁ 0) * h2
    exact (mul_eq_zero.mp hkey).resolve_right hdet

name: eq_smul_of_crossQ_zero
statement:
theorem eq_smul_of_crossQ_zero {u z : Point} (hu : u ≠ 0) (h : crossQ u z = 0) :
    z = (dotQ u z / dotQ u u) • u
proof:
:= by
  have huu : dotQ u u ≠ 0 := ne_of_gt (dotQ_self_pos hu)
  have hc0 : u 1 * z 2 - u 2 * z 1 = 0 := congrFun h 0
  have hc1 : u 2 * z 0 - u 0 * z 2 = 0 := congrFun h 1
  have hc2 : u 0 * z 1 - u 1 * z 0 = 0 := congrFun h 2
  funext k
  rw [Pi.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul, div_mul_eq_mul_div, eq_div_iff huu]
  fin_cases k
  · show z 0 * dotQ u u = dotQ u z * u 0
    simp only [dotQ]
    linear_combination (-(u 1)) * hc2 + u 2 * hc1
  · show z 1 * dotQ u u = dotQ u z * u 1
    simp only [dotQ]
    linear_combination u 0 * hc2 + (-(u 2)) * hc0
  · show z 2 * dotQ u u = dotQ u z * u 2
    simp only [dotQ]
    linear_combination (-(u 0)) * hc1 + u 1 * hc0

name: curveAt_apply
statement:
theorem curveAt_apply (t : Triangle) (τ : ℚ) (k : Fin 3) :
    curveAt t τ k = (1/3 - τ - τ^2) * t.v₀ k + (1/3 + τ) * t.v₁ k
      + (1/3 + τ^2) * t.v₂ k
proof:
:= by
  simp [curveAt]

name: dot_curve_quad
statement:
theorem dot_curve_quad (t : Triangle) (p w : Point) (τ : ℚ) :
    dotQ w (psub (curveAt t τ) p)
      = dotQ w (psub (curveAt t 0) p) + τ * dotQ w (psub t.v₁ t.v₀)
        + τ ^ 2 * dotQ w (psub t.v₂ t.v₀)
proof:
:= by
  simp only [dotQ, psub, curveAt_apply]
  ring

name: dot_curveAt_quad
statement:
theorem dot_curveAt_quad (t : Triangle) (w : Point) (τ : ℚ) :
    dotQ w (curveAt t τ) = dotQ w (curveAt t 0) + τ * dotQ w (psub t.v₁ t.v₀)
      + τ ^ 2 * dotQ w (psub t.v₂ t.v₀)
proof:
:= by
  simp only [dotQ, psub, curveAt_apply]
  ring

name: dot_cross_curve_quad
statement:
theorem dot_cross_curve_quad (t : Triangle) (p u w : Point) (τ : ℚ) :
    dotQ w (crossQ u (psub (curveAt t τ) p))
      = dotQ w (crossQ u (psub (curveAt t 0) p))
        + τ * dotQ w (crossQ u (psub t.v₁ t.v₀))
        + τ ^ 2 * dotQ w (crossQ u (psub t.v₂ t.v₀))
proof:
:= by
  simp only [dotQ, crossQ, psub, curveAt_apply, mkPoint_zero, mkPoint_one, mkPoint_two]
  ring

name: relint_pick
statement:
theorem relint_pick (M : Mesh) (hnpo : NoPlaneThroughOrigin M) (i : Fin M.size)
    (Ls : List (Point × Point)) (Ps : List Point) (Hs : List (Point × ℚ))
    (hHs : ∀ h ∈ Hs, dotQ h.1 (psub M[i].v₁ M[i].v₀) ≠ 0 ∨
      dotQ h.1 (psub M[i].v₂ M[i].v₀) ≠ 0 ∨ dotQ h.1 (curveAt M[i] 0) ≠ h.2) :
    ∃ c : Point, c ∈ triangleSet M[i] ∧ c ∉ edgeSet M[i] ∧
      (∀ L ∈ Ls, ∀ t : ℚ, c ≠ lineAt L.1 L.2 t) ∧ (∀ p ∈ Ps, c ≠ p) ∧
      (∀ h ∈ Hs, dotQ h.1 c ≠ h.2)
proof:
:= by
  set t : Triangle := M[i] with ht
  have hdet : detOrigin t ≠ 0 := hnpo i
  
  have hn : Proof.MeshIntersectJump.faceNormal t ≠ 0 :=
    ne_zero_of_dotQ (u := t.v₀) (by rw [faceNormal_offset]; exact hdet)
  have he₁ : psub t.v₁ t.v₀ ≠ 0 := by
    intro hz
    have hcombo : (-1 : ℚ) • t.v₀ + (1 : ℚ) • t.v₁ + (0 : ℚ) • t.v₂ = 0 := by
      funext k
      have := congrFun hz k
      simp only [psub, Pi.zero_apply] at this
      simp only [Pi.add_apply, Pi.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul, Pi.zero_apply]
      linarith
    exact one_ne_zero (combo_zero_of_det hdet hcombo).2.1
  have hB₁ : dotQ (psub t.v₁ t.v₀) (psub t.v₁ t.v₀) ≠ 0 :=
    ne_of_gt (dotQ_self_pos he₁)
  
  have hbadP : ∀ p : Point, {τ : ℚ | curveAt t τ = p}.Finite := by
    intro p
    apply Set.Finite.subset (quad_roots_finite
      (a := dotQ (psub t.v₁ t.v₀) (psub (curveAt t 0) p))
      (b := dotQ (psub t.v₁ t.v₀) (psub t.v₁ t.v₀))
      (c := dotQ (psub t.v₁ t.v₀) (psub t.v₂ t.v₀))
      (fun hc => hB₁ hc.2.1))
    intro τ hτ
    rw [Set.mem_setOf_eq] at hτ ⊢
    have hq := dot_curve_quad t p (psub t.v₁ t.v₀) τ
    rw [hτ] at hq
    have hzero : dotQ (psub t.v₁ t.v₀) (psub p p) = 0 := by
      simp only [dotQ, psub]; ring
    rw [hzero] at hq
    linarith [hq]
  
  have hbadL : ∀ u p : Point, {τ : ℚ | ∃ s, curveAt t τ = lineAt p u s}.Finite := by
    intro u p
    by_cases hu : u = 0
    · 
      apply Set.Finite.subset (hbadP p)
      intro τ hτ
      obtain ⟨s, hs⟩ := hτ
      rw [Set.mem_setOf_eq, hs, hu]
      funext k
      simp [lineAt]
    · 
      have hcc : ¬ (crossQ u (psub t.v₁ t.v₀) = 0 ∧ crossQ u (psub t.v₂ t.v₀) = 0) := by
        rintro ⟨hcu1, hcu2⟩
        set r₁ := dotQ u (psub t.v₁ t.v₀) / dotQ u u with hr₁
        set r₂ := dotQ u (psub t.v₂ t.v₀) / dotQ u u with hr₂
        have he1 : psub t.v₁ t.v₀ = r₁ • u := eq_smul_of_crossQ_zero hu hcu1
        have he2 : psub t.v₂ t.v₀ = r₂ • u := eq_smul_of_crossQ_zero hu hcu2
        
        have hcombo : (r₁ - r₂) • t.v₀ + r₂ • t.v₁ + (-r₁) • t.v₂ = 0 := by
          funext k
          have h1 := congrFun he1 k
          have h2 := congrFun he2 k
          simp only [psub, Pi.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul] at h1 h2
          simp only [Pi.add_apply, Pi.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul, Pi.zero_apply]
          linear_combination r₂ * h1 - r₁ * h2
        have hr₁0 : r₁ = 0 := neg_eq_zero.mp (combo_zero_of_det hdet hcombo).2.2
        apply he₁
        rw [he1, hr₁0, zero_smul]
      
      rcases not_and_or.mp hcc with hw | hw
      · apply Set.Finite.subset (quad_roots_finite
          (a := dotQ (crossQ u (psub t.v₁ t.v₀)) (crossQ u (psub (curveAt t 0) p)))
          (b := dotQ (crossQ u (psub t.v₁ t.v₀)) (crossQ u (psub t.v₁ t.v₀)))
          (c := dotQ (crossQ u (psub t.v₁ t.v₀)) (crossQ u (psub t.v₂ t.v₀)))
          (fun hc => (ne_of_gt (dotQ_self_pos hw)) hc.2.1))
        intro τ hτ
        obtain ⟨s, hs⟩ := hτ
        rw [Set.mem_setOf_eq]
        have hq := dot_cross_curve_quad t p u (crossQ u (psub t.v₁ t.v₀)) τ
        rw [hs] at hq
        have hzero : dotQ (crossQ u (psub t.v₁ t.v₀))
            (crossQ u (psub (lineAt p u s) p)) = 0 := by
          simp only [dotQ, crossQ, psub, lineAt, mkPoint_zero, mkPoint_one, mkPoint_two]
          ring
        rw [hzero] at hq
        linarith [hq]
      · apply Set.Finite.subset (quad_roots_finite
          (a := dotQ (crossQ u (psub t.v₂ t.v₀)) (crossQ u (psub (curveAt t 0) p)))
          (b := dotQ (crossQ u (psub t.v₂ t.v₀)) (crossQ u (psub t.v₁ t.v₀)))
          (c := dotQ (crossQ u (psub t.v₂ t.v₀)) (crossQ u (psub t.v₂ t.v₀)))
          (fun hc => (ne_of_gt (dotQ_self_pos hw)) hc.2.2))
        intro τ hτ
        obtain ⟨s, hs⟩ := hτ
        rw [Set.mem_setOf_eq]
        have hq := dot_cross_curve_quad t p u (crossQ u (psub t.v₂ t.v₀)) τ
        rw [hs] at hq
        have hzero : dotQ (crossQ u (psub t.v₂ t.v₀))
            (crossQ u (psub (lineAt p u s) p)) = 0 := by
          simp only [dotQ, crossQ, psub, lineAt, mkPoint_zero, mkPoint_one, mkPoint_two]
          ring
        rw [hzero] at hq
        linarith [hq]
  
  have hbadH : ∀ h ∈ Hs, {τ : ℚ | dotQ h.1 (curveAt t τ) = h.2}.Finite := by
    intro h hmem
    apply Set.Finite.subset (quad_roots_finite
      (a := dotQ h.1 (curveAt t 0) - h.2)
      (b := dotQ h.1 (psub t.v₁ t.v₀))
      (c := dotQ h.1 (psub t.v₂ t.v₀))
      (fun hc => by
        rcases hHs h hmem with hne | hne | hne
        · exact hne hc.2.1
        · exact hne hc.2.2
        · exact hne (by linarith [hc.1])))
    intro τ hτ
    rw [Set.mem_setOf_eq] at hτ ⊢
    have hq := dot_curveAt_quad t h.1 τ
    rw [hτ] at hq
    linarith [hq]
  
  have hbad : (((⋃ L ∈ Ls, {τ : ℚ | ∃ s, curveAt t τ = lineAt L.1 L.2 s}) ∪
      ⋃ p ∈ Ps, {τ : ℚ | curveAt t τ = p}) ∪
      ⋃ h ∈ Hs, {τ : ℚ | dotQ h.1 (curveAt t τ) = h.2}).Finite := by
    apply Set.Finite.union
    · apply Set.Finite.union
      · exact Set.Finite.biUnion Ls.finite_toSet (fun L _ => hbadL L.2 L.1)
      · exact Set.Finite.biUnion Ps.finite_toSet (fun p _ => hbadP p)
    · exact Set.Finite.biUnion Hs.finite_toSet hbadH
  have hIoo : (Set.Ioo (0 : ℚ) (1/4)).Infinite := Set.Ioo_infinite (by norm_num)
  obtain ⟨τ, hτmem⟩ := (hIoo.diff hbad).nonempty
  obtain ⟨⟨hτ0, hτ1⟩, hτbad⟩ := hτmem
  refine ⟨curveAt t τ, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · 
    exact mem_triangleSet_of_coords (by nlinarith) (by nlinarith) (by nlinarith)
      (by ring) rfl
  · 
    intro hedge
    rcases hedge with (hseg | hseg) | hseg
    · obtain ⟨a, b, _, _, hab, hz⟩ := hseg
      have hcombo : (a - (1/3 - τ - τ^2)) • t.v₀ + (b - (1/3 + τ)) • t.v₁
          + (-(1/3 + τ^2)) • t.v₂ = 0 := by
        funext k
        have hk := congrFun hz k
        simp only [Pi.add_apply, Pi.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul, curveAt_apply] at hk
        simp only [Pi.add_apply, Pi.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul, Pi.zero_apply]
        linarith
      have := (combo_zero_of_det hdet hcombo).2.2
      nlinarith [this]
    · obtain ⟨a, b, _, _, hab, hz⟩ := hseg
      have hcombo : (-(1/3 - τ - τ^2)) • t.v₀ + (a - (1/3 + τ)) • t.v₁
          + (b - (1/3 + τ^2)) • t.v₂ = 0 := by
        funext k
        have hk := congrFun hz k
        simp only [Pi.add_apply, Pi.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul, curveAt_apply] at hk
        simp only [Pi.add_apply, Pi.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul, Pi.zero_apply]
        linarith
      have := (combo_zero_of_det hdet hcombo).1
      nlinarith [this]
    · obtain ⟨a, b, _, _, hab, hz⟩ := hseg
      have hcombo : (b - (1/3 - τ - τ^2)) • t.v₀ + (-(1/3 + τ)) • t.v₁
          + (a - (1/3 + τ^2)) • t.v₂ = 0 := by
        funext k
        have hk := congrFun hz k
        simp only [Pi.add_apply, Pi.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul, curveAt_apply] at hk
        simp only [Pi.add_apply, Pi.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul, Pi.zero_apply]
        linarith
      have := (combo_zero_of_det hdet hcombo).2.1
      nlinarith [this]
  · 
    intro L hL s hc
    exact hτbad (Set.mem_union_left _ (Set.mem_union_left _
      (Set.mem_biUnion hL ⟨s, hc⟩)))
  · 
    intro p hp hc
    exact hτbad (Set.mem_union_left _ (Set.mem_union_right _
      (Set.mem_biUnion hp hc)))
  · 
    intro h hh hc
    exact hτbad (Set.mem_union_right _ (Set.mem_biUnion hh hc))

name: generic_direction
statement:
theorem generic_direction (Ψ : List Point) (hΨ : ∀ ψ ∈ Ψ, ψ ≠ 0) :
    ∃ d : Point, ∀ ψ ∈ Ψ, dotQ ψ d ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  induction Ψ with
  | nil => exact ⟨fun _ => 1, fun ψ h => absurd h (by simp)⟩
  | cons ψ₀ Ψ ih =>
    obtain ⟨d, hd⟩ := ih (fun ψ h => hΨ ψ (List.mem_cons_of_mem _ h))
    have hψ₀ : ψ₀ ≠ 0 := hΨ ψ₀ (by simp)
    
    set bad : List ℚ := Ψ.map (fun φ =>
      if dotQ φ ψ₀ = 0 then 1 else -dotQ φ d / dotQ φ ψ₀) with hbad
    obtain ⟨ε, hεmem, hεne⟩ := exists_avoiding (-dotQ ψ₀ d / dotQ ψ₀ ψ₀ :: bad)
    refine ⟨lineAt d ψ₀ ε, fun φ hφ => ?_⟩
    rcases List.mem_cons.mp hφ with rfl | hφΨ
    · 
      rw [dotQ_lineAt]
      intro hc
      have hself : dotQ φ φ ≠ 0 := ne_of_gt (dotQ_self_pos hψ₀)
      have hroot : ε = -dotQ φ d / dotQ φ φ := by
        rw [eq_div_iff hself]
        linarith
      apply hεmem
      rw [hroot]
      exact List.mem_cons_self _ _
    · rw [dotQ_lineAt]
      intro hc
      by_cases hφψ : dotQ φ ψ₀ = 0
      · rw [hφψ, mul_zero, add_zero] at hc
        exact hd φ hφΨ hc
      · apply hεmem
        apply List.mem_cons_of_mem
        rw [hbad]
        refine List.mem_map.mpr ⟨φ, hφΨ, ?_⟩
        rw [if_neg hφψ, div_eq_iff hφψ]
        linarith

name: relint_clear_of_nsi
statement:
theorem relint_clear_of_nsi {M : Mesh} (hns : NoFaceInteriorContact M)
    {i u : Fin M.size} (hne : u ≠ i) {p : Point}
    (hu : p ∈ triangleSet M[u]) (hmem : p ∈ triangleSet M[i])
    (hoff : p ∉ edgeSet M[i]) : False
proof:
:=
  hoff (hns i u (fun hc => hne hc.symm) ⟨hmem, hu⟩)

name: seg_subseg
statement:
theorem seg_subseg (x y : Point) (τ₀ τ₁ τ : ℚ) :
    seg (seg x y τ₀) (seg x y τ₁) τ = seg x y (τ₀ + τ * (τ₁ - τ₀))
proof:
:= by
  funext k; simp only [seg]; ring

name: vertBound_le
statement:
theorem vertBound_le {t : Triangle} (k : Fin 3) :
    |t.v₀ k| ≤ vertBound t ∧ |t.v₁ k| ≤ vertBound t ∧ |t.v₂ k| ≤ vertBound t
proof:
:= by
  have hterm : ∀ j : Fin 3, (0:ℚ) ≤ |t.v₀ j| + |t.v₁ j| + |t.v₂ j| := by
    intro j; positivity
  have hsingle : |t.v₀ k| + |t.v₁ k| + |t.v₂ k| ≤ vertBound t :=
    Finset.single_le_sum (fun j _ => hterm j) (Finset.mem_univ k)
  refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_⟩ <;> [skip; skip; skip] <;>
    linarith [abs_nonneg (t.v₀ k), abs_nonneg (t.v₁ k), abs_nonneg (t.v₂ k)]

name: foldr_max_nonneg
statement: private theorem foldr_max_nonneg (l : List ℚ) : 0 ≤ l.foldr max 0
proof:
:= by
  induction l with
  | nil => exact le_rfl
  | cons a l ih => exact le_max_of_le_right ih

name: le_foldr_max
statement: private theorem le_foldr_max {l : List ℚ} {a : ℚ} (h : a ∈ l) : a ≤ l.foldr max 0
proof:
:= by
  induction l with
  | nil => simp at h
  | cons b l ih =>
    rcases List.mem_cons.mp h with rfl | h
    · exact le_max_left _ _
    · exact le_max_of_le_right (ih h)

name: boxBound_nonneg
statement: theorem boxBound_nonneg (M : Mesh) : 0 ≤ boxBound M
proof: := foldr_max_nonneg _

name: vertBound_le_boxBound
statement:
theorem vertBound_le_boxBound {M : Mesh} {t : Triangle} (ht : t ∈ M.toList) :
    vertBound t ≤ boxBound M
proof:
:=
  le_foldr_max (List.mem_map.mpr ⟨t, ht, rfl⟩)

name: simplex_subset_box
statement:
theorem simplex_subset_box (M : Mesh) {t : Triangle} (ht : t ∈ M.toList) :
    simplex t ⊆ {x | inBox M x}
proof:
:= by
  have hVB := vertBound_le_boxBound ht
  apply convexHull_min
  · rintro v hv k
    rcases hv with rfl | rfl | rfl | rfl
    · simpa using boxBound_nonneg M
    · exact le_trans (vertBound_le k).1 hVB
    · exact le_trans (vertBound_le k).2.1 hVB
    · simp only [Set.mem_singleton_iff] at *
      exact le_trans (vertBound_le k).2.2 hVB
  · intro x hx y hy a b ha hb hab k
    have hxk := hx k
    have hyk := hy k
    have happ : (a • x + b • y) k = a * x k + b * y k := rfl
    rw [happ]
    calc |a * x k + b * y k| ≤ |a * x k| + |b * y k| := abs_add _ _
      _ = a * |x k| + b * |y k| := by
          rw [abs_mul, abs_mul, abs_of_nonneg ha, abs_of_nonneg hb]
      _ ≤ a * boxBound M + b * boxBound M := by
          have := boxBound_nonneg M
          gcongr
      _ = boxBound M := by rw [← add_mul, hab, one_mul]

name: winding_zero_outside_box
statement:
theorem winding_zero_outside_box (M : Mesh) {Q : Point} (hQ : ¬ inBox M Q) :
    winding (meshChain M) Q = 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [winding]
  apply List.sum_eq_zero
  intro z hz
  rw [List.mem_map] at hz
  obtain ⟨e, he, rfl⟩ := hz
  rw [meshChain, Array.toList_map, List.mem_map] at he
  obtain ⟨t, ht, rfl⟩ := he
  simp only
  rw [if_neg]
  intro hmem
  exact hQ (simplex_subset_box M ht hmem)

name: ray_escapes_box
statement:
theorem ray_escapes_box (M : Mesh) (Q d : Point) (hd : d ≠ 0) :
    ∃ T₀ : ℚ, 0 < T₀ ∧ ∀ T : ℚ, T₀ ≤ T → ¬ inBox M (lineAt Q d T)
proof:
:= by
  have hk : ∃ k, d k ≠ 0 := by
    by_contra hc; push_neg at hc
    exact hd (funext fun k => hc k)
  obtain ⟨k, hk⟩ := hk
  have hdk : 0 < |d k| := abs_pos.mpr hk
  refine ⟨(boxBound M + |Q k| + 1) / |d k|, ?_, ?_⟩
  · apply div_pos ?_ hdk
    have := boxBound_nonneg M
    have := abs_nonneg (Q k)
    linarith
  · intro T hT hbox
    have h1 := hbox k
    have hTpos : 0 < T := lt_of_lt_of_le (by
      apply div_pos ?_ hdk
      have := boxBound_nonneg M
      have := abs_nonneg (Q k)
      linarith) hT
    have h2 : boxBound M + |Q k| + 1 ≤ T * |d k| := by
      rw [div_le_iff₀ hdk] at hT
      linarith
    have h3 : |T * d k| = T * |d k| := by
      rw [abs_mul, abs_of_pos hTpos]
    have h4 : |T * d k| ≤ |Q k + T * d k| + |Q k| := by
      have := abs_sub (Q k + T * d k) (Q k)
      calc |T * d k| = |(Q k + T * d k) - Q k| := by ring_nf
        _ ≤ |Q k + T * d k| + |Q k| := abs_sub _ _
    have h5 : |Q k + T * d k| ≤ boxBound M := h1
    rw [h3] at h4
    linarith

name: boxAt_map_lt
statement:
theorem boxAt_map_lt (f : Box → Box) (input : Array Box) (k : Nat) (hk : k < input.size) :
    boxAt (input.map f) k = f (boxAt input k)
proof:
:= by
  have hk' : k < (input.map f).size := by simpa using hk
  simp only [boxAt, Array.getD_eq_get?, Array.get?_eq_getElem?, Array.getElem?_map,
    Array.getElem?_eq_getElem hk, Array.getElem?_eq_getElem hk', Option.map_some,
    Option.getD_some, Array.getElem_map]

name: foldl_shift
statement:
theorem foldl_shift {α : Type*} (g : α → α) (F F' : α → Nat → α) (l : List Nat)
    (hstep : ∀ (a : α) (k : Nat), k ∈ l → F' (g a) k = g (F a k)) :
    ∀ a : α, l.foldl F' (g a) = g (l.foldl F a)
proof:
:= by
  induction l with
  | nil => intro a; rfl
  | cons k ks ih =>
    intro a
    simp only [List.foldl_cons]
    rw [hstep a k (by simp)]
    exact ih (fun a' k' hk' => hstep a' k' (List.mem_cons_of_mem k hk')) (F a k)

name: ediv_congr
statement:
theorem ediv_congr {n d n' d' : ℤ} (hd : 0 < d) (hd' : 0 < d')
    (hv : (n : ℚ) / (d : ℚ) = (n' : ℚ) / (d' : ℚ)) : n / d = n' / d'
proof:
:= by
  have hf : Int.fdiv n d = Int.fdiv n' d' := by
    have h := Proof.BVH.dyFloor_congr 0 hd hd' hv
    simpa only [Impl.BVH.dyFloor, if_pos (le_refl (0:ℤ)), Int.toNat_zero, pow_zero,
      mul_one] using h
  rwa [Int.fdiv_eq_ediv _ hd.le, Int.fdiv_eq_ediv _ hd'.le] at hf

name: center2N_val
statement:
private theorem center2N_val (lo hi : ℚ) :
    (0 : ℤ) < ((lo.den * hi.den : ℕ) : ℤ) ∧
    ((lo.num * (hi.den : ℤ) + hi.num * (lo.den : ℤ) : ℤ) : ℚ)
      / (((lo.den * hi.den : ℕ) : ℤ) : ℚ) = lo + hi
proof:
:= by
  have hl : (0 : ℚ) < (lo.den : ℚ) := by exact_mod_cast lo.pos
  have hh : (0 : ℚ) < (hi.den : ℚ) := by exact_mod_cast hi.pos
  refine ⟨by exact_mod_cast Nat.mul_pos lo.pos hi.pos, ?_⟩
  have hl' : (lo.num : ℚ) = lo * (lo.den : ℚ) := (div_eq_iff (ne_of_gt hl)).mp (Rat.num_div_den lo)
  have hh' : (hi.num : ℚ) = hi * (hi.den : ℚ) := (div_eq_iff (ne_of_gt hh)).mp (Rat.num_div_den hi)
  push_cast
  field_simp
  rw [hl', hh']
  ring

name: fracSh_pair
statement:
private theorem fracSh_pair (lo hi k : ℚ) :
    FracSh (2 * k)
      (lo.num * (hi.den : ℤ) + hi.num * (lo.den : ℤ), ((lo.den * hi.den : ℕ) : ℤ))
      ((lo - k).num * ((hi - k).den : ℤ) + (hi - k).num * ((lo - k).den : ℤ),
        (((lo - k).den * (hi - k).den : ℕ) : ℤ))
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨hp, hv⟩ := center2N_val lo hi
  obtain ⟨hp', hv'⟩ := center2N_val (lo - k) (hi - k)
  exact ⟨hp, hp', by rw [hv', hv]; ring⟩

name: center2N_sh0
statement:
theorem center2N_sh0 (ox oy oz : Rat) (b : Box) :
    FracSh (2 * ox) (center2N b 0) (center2N (shBox ox oy oz b) 0)
proof:
:=
  fracSh_pair b.lox b.hix ox

name: center2N_sh1
statement:
theorem center2N_sh1 (ox oy oz : Rat) (b : Box) :
    FracSh (2 * oy) (center2N b 1) (center2N (shBox ox oy oz b) 1)
proof:
:=
  fracSh_pair b.loy b.hiy oy

name: center2N_sh2
statement:
theorem center2N_sh2 (ox oy oz : Rat) (b : Box) :
    FracSh (2 * oz) (center2N b 2) (center2N (shBox ox oy oz b) 2)
proof:
:=
  fracSh_pair b.loz b.hiz oz

name: fracLtN_iff
statement:
private theorem fracLtN_iff {u v : Int × Int} (hu : 0 < u.2) (hv : 0 < v.2) :
    fracLtN u v = true ↔ (u.1 : ℚ) / (u.2 : ℚ) < (v.1 : ℚ) / (v.2 : ℚ)
proof:
:= by
  have hu' : (0 : ℚ) < (u.2 : ℚ) := by exact_mod_cast hu
  have hv' : (0 : ℚ) < (v.2 : ℚ) := by exact_mod_cast hv
  rw [fracLtN, decide_eq_true_eq, div_lt_div_iff₀ hu' hv']
  constructor
  · intro h; exact_mod_cast h
  · intro h; exact_mod_cast h

name: leN_iff
statement:
private theorem leN_iff {u v : Int × Int} (hu : 0 < u.2) (hv : 0 < v.2) :
    v.1 * u.2 ≤ u.1 * v.2 ↔ (v.1 : ℚ) / (v.2 : ℚ) ≤ (u.1 : ℚ) / (u.2 : ℚ)
proof:
:= by
  have hu' : (0 : ℚ) < (u.2 : ℚ) := by exact_mod_cast hu
  have hv' : (0 : ℚ) < (v.2 : ℚ) := by exact_mod_cast hv
  rw [div_le_div_iff₀ hv' hu']
  constructor
  · intro h; exact_mod_cast h
  · intro h; exact_mod_cast h

name: fracLtN_sh
statement:
theorem fracLtN_sh {t : ℚ} {a a' c c' : Int × Int} (ha : FracSh t a a') (hc : FracSh t c c') :
    fracLtN a' c' = fracLtN a c
proof:
:= by
  rw [Bool.eq_iff_iff, fracLtN_iff ha.2.1 hc.2.1, fracLtN_iff ha.1 hc.1, ha.2.2, hc.2.2]
  constructor <;> intro h <;> linarith

name: fracSh_min
proof:
:= by
  rw [fracLtN_sh hu hv]
  split <;> assumption

name: fracSh_max
proof:
:= by
  rw [fracLtN_sh hu hv]
  split <;> assumption

name: quantN_val
proof:
:= by
  have hc' : (0 : ℚ) < (c.2 : ℚ) := by exact_mod_cast hc
  have hg' : (0 : ℚ) < (g.2 : ℚ) := by exact_mod_cast hg
  have hm' : (0 : ℚ) < (m.2 : ℚ) := by exact_mod_cast hm
  have hd : (0 : ℚ) < (m.1 : ℚ) * (g.2 : ℚ) - (g.1 : ℚ) * (m.2 : ℚ) := by
    have h : ((g.1 * m.2 : ℤ) : ℚ) < ((m.1 * g.2 : ℤ) : ℚ) := by exact_mod_cast hgm
    push_cast at h
    linarith
  have hcne : (c.2 : ℚ) ≠ 0 := ne_of_gt hc'
  have hgne : (g.2 : ℚ) ≠ 0 := ne_of_gt hg'
  have hmne : (m.2 : ℚ) ≠ 0 := ne_of_gt hm'
  have hdne : (m.1 : ℚ) * (g.2 : ℚ) - (g.1 : ℚ) * (m.2 : ℚ) ≠ 0 := ne_of_gt hd
  have hsubM : (m.1 : ℚ) / (m.2 : ℚ) - (g.1 : ℚ) / (g.2 : ℚ)
      = ((m.1 : ℚ) * (g.2 : ℚ) - (g.1 : ℚ) * (m.2 : ℚ)) / ((m.2 : ℚ) * (g.2 : ℚ)) := by
    field_simp
    ring
  have hsubC : (c.1 : ℚ) / (c.2 : ℚ) - (g.1 : ℚ) / (g.2 : ℚ)
      = ((c.1 : ℚ) * (g.2 : ℚ) - (g.1 : ℚ) * (c.2 : ℚ)) / ((c.2 : ℚ) * (g.2 : ℚ)) := by
    field_simp
    ring
  rw [hsubM, hsubC]
  push_cast
  field_simp
  ring

name: quantN_sh
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨hc2, hc2', hcv⟩ := hc
  obtain ⟨hg2, hg2', hgv⟩ := hg
  obtain ⟨hm2, hm2', hmv⟩ := hm
  have hbranch : (m'.1 * g'.2 ≤ g'.1 * m'.2) = (m.1 * g.2 ≤ g.1 * m.2) := by
    rw [eq_iff_iff, leN_iff hg2' hm2', leN_iff hg2 hm2, hgv, hmv]
    constructor <;> intro h <;> linarith
  simp only [quantN]
  by_cases hb : m.1 * g.2 ≤ g.1 * m.2
  · have hb' : m'.1 * g'.2 ≤ g'.1 * m'.2 := by rw [hbranch]; exact hb
    rw [if_pos hb, if_pos hb']
  · have hb' : ¬ (m'.1 * g'.2 ≤ g'.1 * m'.2) := by rw [hbranch]; exact hb
    rw [if_neg hb, if_neg hb']
    have hgm : g.1 * m.2 < m.1 * g.2 := by omega
    have hgm' : g'.1 * m'.2 < m'.1 * g'.2 := by
      by_contra hcon
      push_neg at hcon
      exact hb (by rwa [← eq_iff_iff.mp hbranch])
    set K : ℤ := ((((2 : Nat) ^ mortonBits) - 1 : Nat) : ℤ) with hK
    have hden : (0 : ℤ) < c.2 * (m.1 * g.2 - g.1 * m.2) := by
      apply mul_pos hc2; omega
    have hden' : (0 : ℤ) < c'.2 * (m'.1 * g'.2 - g'.1 * m'.2) := by
      apply mul_pos hc2'; omega
    have hval : (((c'.1 * g'.2 - g'.1 * c'.2) * K * m'.2 : ℤ) : ℚ)
          / ((c'.2 * (m'.1 * g'.2 - g'.1 * m'.2) : ℤ) : ℚ)
        = (((c.1 * g.2 - g.1 * c.2) * K * m.2 : ℤ) : ℚ)
          / ((c.2 * (m.1 * g.2 - g.1 * m.2) : ℤ) : ℚ) := by
      rw [quantN_val hc2' hg2' hm2' hgm' K, quantN_val hc2 hg2 hm2 hgm K, hcv, hgv, hmv,
        show (c.1 : ℚ) / (c.2 : ℚ) - t - ((g.1 : ℚ) / (g.2 : ℚ) - t)
            = (c.1 : ℚ) / (c.2 : ℚ) - (g.1 : ℚ) / (g.2 : ℚ) by ring,
        show (m.1 : ℚ) / (m.2 : ℚ) - t - ((g.1 : ℚ) / (g.2 : ℚ) - t)
            = (m.1 : ℚ) / (m.2 : ℚ) - (g.1 : ℚ) / (g.2 : ℚ) by ring]
    rw [ediv_congr hden' hden hval]

name: mortonKeyN_sh
statement:
theorem mortonKeyN_sh (input : Array Box) (ox oy oz : Rat)
    {gx mx gy my gz mz gx' mx' gy' my' gz' mz' : Int × Int}
    (hgx : FracSh (2 * ox) gx gx') (hmx : FracSh (2 * ox) mx mx')
    (hgy : FracSh (2 * oy) gy gy') (hmy : FracSh (2 * oy) my my')
    (hgz : FracSh (2 * oz) gz gz') (hmz : FracSh (2 * oz) mz mz')
    (k : Nat) (hk : k < input.size) :
    mortonKeyN (input.map (shBox ox oy oz)) gx' mx' gy' my' gz' mz' k
      = mortonKeyN input gx mx gy my gz mz k
proof:
:= by
  simp only [mortonKeyN, boxAt_map_lt _ _ _ hk]
  rw [quantN_sh (center2N_sh0 ox oy oz (boxAt input k)) hgx hmx,
    quantN_sh (center2N_sh1 ox oy oz (boxAt input k)) hgy hmy,
    quantN_sh (center2N_sh2 ox oy oz (boxAt input k)) hgz hmz]

name: foldl_rel
statement:
theorem foldl_rel {α β : Type*} (R : α → β → Prop) (F : α → Nat → α) (F' : β → Nat → β)
    (l : List Nat) (hstep : ∀ a b k, k ∈ l → R a b → R (F a k) (F' b k)) :
    ∀ a b, R a b → R (l.foldl F a) (l.foldl F' b)
proof:
:= by
  induction l with
  | nil => intro a b h; exact h
  | cons k ks ih =>
    intro a b h
    simp only [List.foldl_cons]
    exact ih (fun x y j hj hxy => hstep x y j (List.mem_cons_of_mem k hj) hxy) _ _
      (hstep a b k (List.mem_cons_self _ _) h)

name: bndsN_sh
statement:
theorem bndsN_sh (input : Array Box) (ox oy oz : Rat) (hpos : 0 < input.size) :
    RBnds ox oy oz (bndsN input) (bndsN (input.map (shBox ox oy oz)))
proof:
:= by
  have hsize : (input.map (shBox ox oy oz)).size = input.size := Array.size_map _ _
  unfold bndsN
  rw [hsize]
  refine foldl_rel (RBnds ox oy oz) _ _ (List.range input.size) ?_ _ _ ?_
  · intro a b k hk hab
    have hk' : k < input.size := List.mem_range.mp hk
    have hb : boxAt (input.map (shBox ox oy oz)) k = shBox ox oy oz (boxAt input k) :=
      boxAt_map_lt _ _ _ hk'
    obtain ⟨h1, h2, h3, h4, h5, h6⟩ := hab
    rw [hb]
    exact ⟨fracSh_min (center2N_sh0 ox oy oz (boxAt input k)) h1,
      fracSh_max h2 (center2N_sh0 ox oy oz (boxAt input k)),
      fracSh_min (center2N_sh1 ox oy oz (boxAt input k)) h3,
      fracSh_max h4 (center2N_sh1 ox oy oz (boxAt input k)),
      fracSh_min (center2N_sh2 ox oy oz (boxAt input k)) h5,
      fracSh_max h6 (center2N_sh2 ox oy oz (boxAt input k))⟩
  · have hb : boxAt (input.map (shBox ox oy oz)) 0 = shBox ox oy oz (boxAt input 0) :=
      boxAt_map_lt _ _ _ hpos
    rw [hb]
    exact ⟨center2N_sh0 ox oy oz (boxAt input 0), center2N_sh0 ox oy oz (boxAt input 0),
      center2N_sh1 ox oy oz (boxAt input 0), center2N_sh1 ox oy oz (boxAt input 0),
      center2N_sh2 ox oy oz (boxAt input 0), center2N_sh2 ox oy oz (boxAt input 0)⟩

name: mortonOrderN_eq
statement:
theorem mortonOrderN_eq (input : Array Box) :
    mortonOrderN input = (List.range input.size).mergeSort
      (fun a b =>
        let ka := (keysN input).getD a 0
        let kb := (keysN input).getD b 0
        ka < kb || (ka == kb && a ≤ b))
proof: := rfl

name: mortonOrderN_sh
statement:
theorem mortonOrderN_sh (input : Array Box) (ox oy oz : Rat) (hpos : 0 < input.size) :
    mortonOrderN (input.map (shBox ox oy oz)) = mortonOrderN input
proof:
:= by
  have hsize : (input.map (shBox ox oy oz)).size = input.size := Array.size_map _ _
  have hkeys : keysN (input.map (shBox ox oy oz)) = keysN input := by
    obtain ⟨h1, h2, h3, h4, h5, h6⟩ := bndsN_sh input ox oy oz hpos
    unfold keysN
    rw [hsize]
    congr 1
    refine List.map_congr_left ?_
    intro k hk
    exact mortonKeyN_sh input ox oy oz h1 h2 h3 h4 h5 h6 k (List.mem_range.mp hk)
  rw [mortonOrderN_eq, mortonOrderN_eq, hsize, hkeys]

name: array_map_append

name: buildTreeMorton_sh
statement:
theorem buildTreeMorton_sh (input : Array Box) (ox oy oz : Rat) :
    ∀ (fuel : Nat) (l : List Nat), l ≠ [] → (∀ k ∈ l, k < input.size) →
      buildTreeMorton (input.map (shBox ox oy oz)) fuel l
      = shTree ox oy oz (buildTreeMorton input fuel l)
proof:
:= by
  intro fuel
  induction fuel with
  | zero =>
    intro l hne hlt
    match l with
    | [] => exact absurd rfl hne
    | [k] => simp only [buildTreeMorton, boxAt_map_lt _ _ _ (hlt k (by simp)), shTree]
    | k0 :: k1 :: rest =>
      simp only [buildTreeMorton, boxAt_map_lt _ _ _ (hlt k0 (by simp)), shTree]
  | succ fuel ih =>
    intro l hne hlt
    match l with
    | [] => exact absurd rfl hne
    | [k] => simp only [buildTreeMorton, boxAt_map_lt _ _ _ (hlt k (by simp)), shTree]
    | k0 :: k1 :: rest =>
      set L := k0 :: k1 :: rest with hL
      have hlen : 2 ≤ L.length := by simp [hL]
      set mid := L.length / 2 with hmid
      have hmidpos : 0 < mid := by omega
      have hmidlt : mid < L.length := by omega
      have htne : L.take mid ≠ [] := by
        have : 0 < (L.take mid).length := by rw [List.length_take]; omega
        exact List.ne_nil_of_length_pos this
      have hdne : L.drop mid ≠ [] := by
        have : 0 < (L.drop mid).length := by rw [List.length_drop]; omega
        exact List.ne_nil_of_length_pos this
      have htlt : ∀ k ∈ L.take mid, k < input.size := fun k hk =>
        hlt k (List.mem_of_mem_take hk)
      have hdlt : ∀ k ∈ L.drop mid, k < input.size := fun k hk =>
        hlt k (List.mem_of_mem_drop hk)
      have eL : buildTreeMorton (input.map (shBox ox oy oz)) (fuel + 1) L
        = .node (hull (buildTreeMorton (input.map (shBox ox oy oz)) fuel (L.take mid)).box
                      (buildTreeMorton (input.map (shBox ox oy oz)) fuel (L.drop mid)).box)
               (buildTreeMorton (input.map (shBox ox oy oz)) fuel (L.take mid))
               (buildTreeMorton (input.map (shBox ox oy oz)) fuel (L.drop mid)) := rfl
      have eR : buildTreeMorton input (fuel + 1) L
        = .node (hull (buildTreeMorton input fuel (L.take mid)).box
                      (buildTreeMorton input fuel (L.drop mid)).box)
               (buildTreeMorton input fuel (L.take mid))
               (buildTreeMorton input fuel (L.drop mid)) := rfl
      rw [eL, eR, ih (L.take mid) htne htlt, ih (L.drop mid) hdne hdlt]
      simp only [shTree, shTree_box, hull_sh]

name: mtreeQuery_shTree

theorem mtreeQuery_shTree (mbs : Array MBox) (P : MBox → Bool) (ox oy oz : Rat) (t : Tree) :

name: mtreeQuery_sh
statement:
theorem mtreeQuery_sh (input : Array Box) (ox oy oz ax ay az : Rat) (e : ℤ)
    (fuel : Nat) (idxs : List Nat) (hne : idxs ≠ []) (hlt : ∀ k ∈ idxs, k < input.size)
    (P : MBox → Bool) :
    Proof.BVH.mtreeQuery
        ((input.map (shBox ox oy oz)).map (mboxOfBox (ax - ox) (ay - oy) (az - oz) e))
        P (buildTreeMorton (input.map (shBox ox oy oz)) fuel idxs) #[]

    = signI (iFacePlaneP a₀ b₀ c₀) v.h
proof:

name: cutVtx_t_val
statement:
theorem cutVtx_t_val (n : P3) (c : Rat) (P Q : Vtx)
    (hP : P.h = toH4 P.p) (hQ : Q.h = toH4 Q.p) :
    (((evalI (clearPlane n c) P.h * Q.h.w : Int) : ℚ))
      / (((evalI (clearPlane n c) P.h * Q.h.w
           - evalI (clearPlane n c) Q.h * P.h.w : Int) : ℚ))
    = (dotS n P.p - c) / ((dotS n P.p - c) - (dotS n Q.p - c))
proof:
:= by
  set κ : ℚ := (clearPlaneW n c : ℚ) with hκ
  set wP : ℚ := (toH4W P.p : ℚ) with hwP
  set wQ : ℚ := (toH4W Q.p : ℚ) with hwQ
  set DP : ℚ := dotS n P.p - c with hDP
  set DQ : ℚ := dotS n Q.p - c with hDQ
  
  have hep : ((evalI (clearPlane n c) P.h : Int) : ℚ) = wP * (κ * DP) := by
    rw [hP, evalI_decode, gAff_clearPlane]
  have heq : ((evalI (clearPlane n c) Q.h : Int) : ℚ) = wQ * (κ * DQ) := by
    rw [hQ, evalI_decode, gAff_clearPlane]
  have hPw : ((P.h.w : Int) : ℚ) = wP := by rw [hP, toH4_w]
  have hQw : ((Q.h.w : Int) : ℚ) = wQ := by rw [hQ, toH4_w]
  
  have hk : (0 : ℚ) < wP * wQ * κ :=
    mul_pos (mul_pos (by rw [hwP]; exact_mod_cast toH4W_pos _)
                     (by rw [hwQ]; exact_mod_cast toH4W_pos _))
            (by rw [hκ]; exact_mod_cast clearPlaneW_pos _ _)
  have hnum : (((evalI (clearPlane n c) P.h * Q.h.w : Int) : ℚ)) = (wP * wQ * κ) * DP := by
    push_cast; rw [hep, hQw]; ring
  have hden : (((evalI (clearPlane n c) P.h * Q.h.w
                - evalI (clearPlane n c) Q.h * P.h.w : Int) : ℚ)) = (wP * wQ * κ) * (DP - DQ) := by
    push_cast; rw [hep, heq, hPw, hQw]; ring
  rw [hnum, hden, mul_div_mul_left _ _ (ne_of_gt hk)]

name: trVtx_mkVtx

name: lerp_psubS
statement:
theorem lerp_psubS (o A B : P3) (t : Rat) :
    (⟨(psubS A o).x + t * ((psubS B o).x - (psubS A o).x),
       (psubS A o).y + t * ((psubS B o).y - (psubS A o).y),
       (psubS A o).z + t * ((psubS B o).z - (psubS A o).z)⟩ : P3)
    = psubS ⟨A.x + t * (B.x - A.x), A.y + t * (B.y - A.y), A.z + t * (B.z - A.z)⟩ o
proof:
:= by
  simp only [psubS, P3.mk.injEq]; refine ⟨by ring, by ring, by ring⟩

name: cutVtx_tr
statement:
theorem cutVtx_tr (o a₀ b₀ c₀ : P3) (A B : Vtx)
    (hA : A.h = toH4 A.p) (hB : B.h = toH4 B.p) :
    cutVtx (iFacePlaneP (psubS a₀ o) (psubS b₀ o) (psubS c₀ o)) (trVtx o A) (trVtx o B)
    = trVtx o (cutVtx (iFacePlaneP a₀ b₀ c₀) A B)
proof:
:= by
  rw [cutVtx_posMul (posMul_iFacePlaneP _ _ _), cutVtx_posMul (posMul_iFacePlaneP _ _ _)]
  set n : P3 := crossS (psubS b₀ a₀) (psubS c₀ a₀) with hn
  have hnorm : crossS (psubS (psubS b₀ o) (psubS a₀ o)) (psubS (psubS c₀ o) (psubS a₀ o)) = n :=
    crossNormal_translate a₀ b₀ c₀ o
  have hg : iFacePlane a₀ b₀ c₀ = clearPlane n (dotS n a₀) := rfl
  have hg' : iFacePlane (psubS a₀ o) (psubS b₀ o) (psubS c₀ o)
           = clearPlane n (dotS n (psubS a₀ o)) := by simp only [iFacePlane, hnorm]
  
  have hA' : (trVtx o A).h = toH4 (trVtx o A).p := rfl
  have hB' : (trVtx o B).h = toH4 (trVtx o B).p := rfl
  
  have htU := cutVtx_t_val n (dotS n a₀) A B hA hB
  have htT := cutVtx_t_val n (dotS n (psubS a₀ o)) (trVtx o A) (trVtx o B) hA' hB'
  
  have hcollapse : ∀ p : P3, dotS n (psubS p o) - dotS n (psubS a₀ o) = dotS n p - dotS n a₀ := by
    intro p; rw [dotS_psubS, dotS_psubS]; ring
  have hpA : (trVtx o A).p = psubS A.p o := rfl
  have hpB : (trVtx o B).p = psubS B.p o := rfl
  rw [hpA, hpB, hcollapse, hcollapse] at htT
  
  have hteq :
      (((evalI (clearPlane n (dotS n (psubS a₀ o))) (trVtx o A).h * (trVtx o B).h.w : Int) : ℚ))
        / (((evalI (clearPlane n (dotS n (psubS a₀ o))) (trVtx o A).h * (trVtx o B).h.w
             - evalI (clearPlane n (dotS n (psubS a₀ o))) (trVtx o B).h * (trVtx o A).h.w : Int) : ℚ))
      = (((evalI (clearPlane n (dotS n a₀)) A.h * B.h.w : Int) : ℚ))
        / (((evalI (clearPlane n (dotS n a₀)) A.h * B.h.w
             - evalI (clearPlane n (dotS n a₀)) B.h * A.h.w : Int) : ℚ)) := by
    rw [htT, htU]
  
  simp only [cutVtx, hg, hg', hpA, hpB]
  rw [hteq, trVtx_mkVtx, lerp_psubS]

name: vtx_mem_triangleSet
statement:
theorem vtx_mem_triangleSet (t : Triangle) :

name: seg_mem_triangleSet
statement:
theorem seg_mem_triangleSet {t : Triangle} {a b : Point} (ha : a ∈ triangleSet t)
    (hb : b ∈ triangleSet t) {τ : ℚ} (h0 : 0 ≤ τ) (h1 : τ ≤ 1) :
    (fun k => a k + τ * (b k - a k)) ∈ triangleSet t
proof:
:= by
  have h : (fun k => a k + τ * (b k - a k)) = (1 - τ) • a + τ • b := by
    funext k; simp only [Pi.add_apply, Pi.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul]; ring
  rw [h, triangleSet]
  exact (convex_convexHull ℚ _) ha hb (by linarith) h0 (by ring)

name: baryPt_mem_triangleSet
statement: theorem baryPt_mem_triangleSet (t : Triangle) : baryPt t ∈ triangleSet t
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨h0, h1, h2⟩ := vtx_mem_triangleSet t
  have hm : (fun k => t.v₁ k + (1/2 : ℚ) * (t.v₂ k - t.v₁ k)) ∈ triangleSet t :=
    seg_mem_triangleSet h1 h2 (by norm_num) (by norm_num)
  have hmem := seg_mem_triangleSet h0 hm (τ := 2/3) (by norm_num) (by norm_num)
  have heq : baryPt t = (fun k => t.v₀ k + (2/3 : ℚ) *
      ((fun k => t.v₁ k + (1/2 : ℚ) * (t.v₂ k - t.v₁ k)) k - t.v₀ k)) := by
    funext k; simp only [baryPt]; ring
  rw [heq]; exact hmem

name: h4Repr_toH4
statement: theorem h4Repr_toH4 (p : P3) : H4Repr (toH4 p) p
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨hw, hQ⟩ := CSG.Proof.MeshIntersectBridge.toH4_repr p
  have hwq : ((toH4 p).w : ℚ) ≠ 0 := by exact_mod_cast hw.ne'
  refine ⟨hw, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · have h := congrFun hQ 0
    simp only [P3.toPoint, CSG.Proof.SimImplCover.mkPoint_zero] at h
    rw [h]; field_simp
  · have h := congrFun hQ 1
    simp only [P3.toPoint, CSG.Proof.SimImplCover.mkPoint_one] at h
    rw [h]; field_simp
  · have h := congrFun hQ 2
    simp only [P3.toPoint, CSG.Proof.SimImplCover.mkPoint_two] at h
    rw [h]; field_simp

name: edge_endpoints_mem
statement:
theorem edge_endpoints_mem {t : Triangle} {e : P3 × P3}
    (he : e ∈ (faceEdgesC (faceSOf t)).toList) :
    (∃ v : Point, v ∈ triangleSet t ∧ e.1 = ofPoint v) ∧
      (∃ v : Point, v ∈ triangleSet t ∧ e.2 = ofPoint v)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨h0, h1, h2⟩ := vtx_mem_triangleSet t
  have h3 : e = (ofPoint t.v₀, ofPoint t.v₁) ∨ e = (ofPoint t.v₁, ofPoint t.v₂)
      ∨ e = (ofPoint t.v₂, ofPoint t.v₀) := by
    simpa [faceEdgesC, faceSOf, mkVtx] using he
  rcases h3 with rfl | rfl | rfl
  · exact ⟨⟨t.v₀, h0, rfl⟩, ⟨t.v₁, h1, rfl⟩⟩
  · exact ⟨⟨t.v₁, h1, rfl⟩, ⟨t.v₂, h2, rfl⟩⟩
  · exact ⟨⟨t.v₂, h2, rfl⟩, ⟨t.v₀, h0, rfl⟩⟩

name: baryOf_eq
statement: theorem baryOf_eq {M : Mesh} {i : ℕ} (hi : i < M.size) : baryOf M i = baryPt (M[i]'hi)
proof:
:= by
  rw [baryOf, arr_getD _ _ _ hi]

name: wa_eq_leg
statement:
theorem wa_eq_leg {M₁ M₂ : Mesh} (hcyc : IsClosedOrientedSurface M₂)
    (hnpo : NoPlaneThroughOrigin M₂) (hns : NoFaceInteriorContact M₂)
    {Wa : Point → ℤ} (hclean : CleanDirs M₂ Wa)
    {free : Array Bool} (hbf : BoxFree M₁ M₂ free)
    {i : ℕ} (hi : i < M₁.size) (hfi : free.getD i false = true)
    {a b : Point} (ha : a ∈ triangleSet (M₁[i]'hi)) (hb : b ∈ triangleSet (M₁[i]'hi)) :
    Wa a = Wa b
proof:
:= by
  refine wa_eq_of_fat_segment hcyc hnpo hns hclean
    (ρ := sepRadius (bboxOfFace ((materialize M₁).getD i default)) (materialize M₂))
    (sepRadius_pos (hbf i hi hfi)) ?_
  intro τ h0 h1 z hz u
  exact off_triangleSet_of_close hi (hbf i hi hfi) (seg_mem_triangleSet ha hb h0 h1) hz u

name: wa_adj
statement:
theorem wa_adj {M₁ M₂ : Mesh} (hcyc : IsClosedOrientedSurface M₂)
    (hnpo : NoPlaneThroughOrigin M₂) (hns : NoFaceInteriorContact M₂)
    {Wa : Point → ℤ} (hclean : CleanDirs M₂ Wa)
    {free : Array Bool} (hbf : BoxFree M₁ M₂ free)
    {i j : ℕ} (hadj : AdjC (materialize M₁) free i j) :
    Wa (baryOf M₁ i) = Wa (baryOf M₁ j)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨hilt, hjlt, hfi, hfj, e, he, e', he', hkey⟩ := hadj
  have hi : i < M₁.size := by rwa [size_materialize] at hilt
  have hj : j < M₁.size := by rwa [size_materialize] at hjlt
  rw [materialize_getD hi] at he
  rw [materialize_getD hj] at he'
  obtain ⟨-, v, hv, hev⟩ := edge_endpoints_mem he
  obtain ⟨⟨w, hw, hew⟩, -⟩ := edge_endpoints_mem he'
  
  have hvw : v = w := ofPoint_inj (by rw [← hev, ← hew]; exact (edgeKeyC_fst hkey).symm)
  subst hvw
  rw [baryOf_eq hi, baryOf_eq hj]
  exact (wa_eq_leg hcyc hnpo hns hclean hbf hi hfi (baryPt_mem_triangleSet _) hv).trans
    (wa_eq_leg hcyc hnpo hns hclean hbf hj hfj hw (baryPt_mem_triangleSet _))

name: wa_chain
statement:
theorem wa_chain {M₁ M₂ : Mesh} (hcyc : IsClosedOrientedSurface M₂)
    (hnpo : NoPlaneThroughOrigin M₂) (hns : NoFaceInteriorContact M₂)
    {Wa : Point → ℤ} (hclean : CleanDirs M₂ Wa)
    {free : Array Bool} (hbf : BoxFree M₁ M₂ free)
    {r i : ℕ} (hch : ChainC (materialize M₁) free r i) :
    Wa (baryOf M₁ r) = Wa (baryOf M₁ i)
proof:
:= by
  induction hch with
  | refl => rfl
  | step _ hadj ih => exact ih.trans (wa_adj hcyc hnpo hns hclean hbf hadj)

name: keepFragB_bary
statement:
theorem keepFragB_bary (M₁ M₂ : Mesh) (bvh : Impl.BVH.BVH) {i : ℕ} (hi : i < M₁.size) :
    keepFragB bvh (prepare (materialize M₂)) (fragOfFace ((materialize M₁).getD i default))
      = (waOf bvh (prepare (materialize M₂)) (baryOf M₁ i) == 1)
proof:
:= by
  rw [materialize_getD hi,
    keepFragB_eq _ _ (materialize_wedgeOK M₂) (by simp [fragOfFace])
      (fragMirrors_fragOfFace _),
    fragCentroid_fragOfFace, baryOf_eq hi]
  rfl

name: hkeep_prepOf
statement:
theorem hkeep_prepOf (M₁ M₂ : Mesh) (hcyc : IsClosedOrientedSurface M₂)
    (hnpo : NoPlaneThroughOrigin M₂) (hns : NoFaceInteriorContact M₂)
    (hclean : CleanDirs M₂ (waOf (prepOf M₂).bvh (prepare (materialize M₂)))) :
    ∀ i, i < (materialize M₁).size →
      (freeOf (candOf (materialize M₁) (materialize M₂) (prepOf M₂).bvh)).getD i false = true →
      (keepRootOf (materialize M₁)
          (freeOf (candOf (materialize M₁) (materialize M₂) (prepOf M₂).bvh))
          (clusterFree (materialize M₁)
            (freeOf (candOf (materialize M₁) (materialize M₂) (prepOf M₂).bvh)))
          (prepOf M₂).bvh (prepare (materialize M₂))).getD
          ((clusterFree (materialize M₁)
            (freeOf (candOf (materialize M₁) (materialize M₂) (prepOf M₂).bvh))).getD i i) false
        = keepFragB (prepOf M₂).bvh (prepare (materialize M₂))
            (fragOfFace ((materialize M₁).getD i default))
proof:
:= by
  intro i hi hfi
  set A := materialize M₁ with hA
  set B := materialize M₂ with hB
  set free := freeOf (candOf A B (prepOf M₂).bvh) with hfree
  have hbvh : (prepOf M₂).bvh
      = Impl.BVH.buildBVHM (B.map (fun f => boxToBVH (bboxOfFace f))) := prepOf_bvh M₂
  have hAsz : A.size = M₁.size := size_materialize M₁
  
  have hbf : BoxFree M₁ M₂ free := by
    intro i' hi'' hfi' j hj
    exact (freeOf_getD_iff (A := A) (B := B) _ hbvh (by rw [hAsz]; exact hi'')).mp hfi' j hj
  
  have hsz : free.size = A.size := by
    rw [hfree, freeOf, Array.size_map, candOf, Array.size_map]
  obtain ⟨hrlt, hrfree, hroot, hch⟩ := clusterFree_spec A free hsz hfi
  
  rw [keepRootOf_getD A free (clusterFree A free) (prepOf M₂).bvh (prepare B) hrlt hrfree hroot,
    keepFragB_bary M₁ M₂ _ (by rwa [hAsz] at hrlt),
    keepFragB_bary M₁ M₂ _ (by rwa [hAsz] at hi),
    wa_chain hcyc hnpo hns hclean hbf hch]

name: meshIntersectPre_eq_ref_prepOf
statement:
theorem meshIntersectPre_eq_ref_prepOf (M₁ M₂ : Mesh)
    (hcyc₁ : IsClosedOrientedSurface M₁) (hnpo₁ : NoPlaneThroughOrigin M₁)
    (hns₁ : NoFaceInteriorContact M₁)
    (hcyc₂ : IsClosedOrientedSurface M₂) (hnpo₂ : NoPlaneThroughOrigin M₂)
    (hns₂ : NoFaceInteriorContact M₂)
    (hcleanA : CleanDirs M₂ (waOf (prepOf M₂).bvh (prepare (materialize M₂))))
    (hcleanB : CleanDirs M₁ (waOf (prepOf M₁).bvh (prepare (materialize M₁)))) :
    meshIntersectPre (prepOf M₁) (prepOf M₂) = meshIntersectRef (prepOf M₁) (prepOf M₂)
proof:
:=
  meshIntersectPre_eq_ref _ _
    (hkeep_prepOf M₁ M₂ hcyc₂ hnpo₂ hns₂ hcleanA)
    (hkeep_prepOf M₂ M₁ hcyc₁ hnpo₁ hns₁ hcleanB)

name: mapPair_empty
statement:
@[simp] theorem mapPair_empty (h : Frag → Frag) :
    mapPair h (#[], #[]) = (#[], #[])
proof: := by simp [mapPair]

name: clipBySide_eq
statement:
theorem clipBySide_eq (g : IPlane) (f : Frag) :
    clipBySide g f = (clipFrag g f).foldl (partStep (sideOf g)) (#[], #[])
proof: := rfl

name: partStep_map
statement:
theorem partStep_map (h : Frag → Frag) (test test' : Frag → Bool)
    (acc : Array Frag × Array Frag) (piece : Frag) (htest : test' (h piece) = test piece) :
    partStep test' (mapPair h acc) (h piece) = mapPair h (partStep test acc piece)
proof:
:= by
  simp only [partStep, mapPair, htest]
  split <;> simp [Array.map_push]

name: foldl_partStep_mem
statement:
theorem foldl_partStep_mem (h : Frag → Frag) (test test' : Frag → Bool) :
    ∀ (l : List Frag), (∀ piece ∈ l, test' (h piece) = test piece) →
    ∀ (init : Array Frag × Array Frag),
      (l.map h).foldl (partStep test') (mapPair h init) = mapPair h (l.foldl (partStep test) init)
  | [], _, init => rfl
  | piece :: l, hl, init => by
      simp only [List.map_cons, List.foldl_cons]
      rw [partStep_map h test test' init piece (hl piece (List.mem_cons_self _ _))]
      exact foldl_partStep_mem h test test' l
        (fun p hp => hl p (List.mem_cons_of_mem _ hp)) (partStep test init piece)

/-! ## 1. `clipBySide` commutes with `trFrag` (abstract sign/cut invariance) -/

/

name: clipBySide_ss
statement:
theorem clipBySide_ss (o : P3) (g g' : IPlane) (f : Frag) (hf : FragFaithful f)
    (hsign : ∀ v : Vtx, VtxFaithful v → signI g' (trVtx o v).h = signI g v.h)
    (hcut : ∀ A B : Vtx, VtxFaithful A → VtxFaithful B →
      cutVtx g' (trVtx o A) (trVtx o B) = trVtx o (cutVtx g A B)) :
    clipBySide g' (trFrag o f) = mapPair (trFrag o) (clipBySide g f)
proof:
:= by
  rw [clipBySide_eq, clipBySide_eq, clipFrag_ss o g g' f hf hsign hcut,
      ← Array.foldl_toList, ← Array.foldl_toList, Array.toList_map]
  have hl : ∀ piece ∈ (clipFrag g f).toList, sideOf g' (trFrag o piece) = sideOf g piece := by
    intro piece hp
    exact sideOf_ss o g g' piece
      (clipFrag_faithful g f hf piece (Array.mem_toList.mp hp)) hsign
  have key := foldl_partStep_mem (trFrag o) (sideOf g) (sideOf g') (clipFrag g f).toList hl (#[], #[])
  simpa using key

name: ismul_a
statement: @[simp] theorem ismul_a (k : Int) (g : IPlane) : (ismul k g).a = k * g.a
proof: := rfl

name: ismul_b
statement: @[simp] theorem ismul_b (k : Int) (g : IPlane) : (ismul k g).b = k * g.b
proof: := rfl

name: ismul_c
statement: @[simp] theorem ismul_c (k : Int) (g : IPlane) : (ismul k g).c = k * g.c
proof: := rfl

name: ismul_d
statement: @[simp] theorem ismul_d (k : Int) (g : IPlane) : (ismul k g).d = k * g.d
proof: := rfl

name: gamma_ismul
statement: theorem gamma_ismul (k : Int) (g : IPlane) : gamma (ismul k g) = k.natAbs * gamma g
proof:
:= by
  unfold gamma
  simp only [ismul_a, ismul_b, ismul_c, ismul_d]
  rw [Int.gcd_mul_left, Int.gcd_mul_left]
  push_cast
  rw [Int.gcd_mul_left, Int.natAbs_abs]

name: gamma_dvd_a
statement: theorem gamma_dvd_a (g : IPlane) : (gamma g : Int) ∣ g.a
proof:
:=
  dvd_trans Int.gcd_dvd_left Int.gcd_dvd_left

name: gamma_dvd_b
statement: theorem gamma_dvd_b (g : IPlane) : (gamma g : Int) ∣ g.b
proof:
:=
  dvd_trans Int.gcd_dvd_left Int.gcd_dvd_right

name: gamma_dvd_c
statement: theorem gamma_dvd_c (g : IPlane) : (gamma g : Int) ∣ g.c
proof:
:=
  dvd_trans Int.gcd_dvd_right Int.gcd_dvd_left

name: gamma_dvd_d
statement: theorem gamma_dvd_d (g : IPlane) : (gamma g : Int) ∣ g.d
proof:
:=
  dvd_trans Int.gcd_dvd_right Int.gcd_dvd_right

name: gamma_eq_zero_iff
statement:
theorem gamma_eq_zero_iff (g : IPlane) :
    gamma g = 0 ↔ g.a = 0 ∧ g.b = 0 ∧ g.c = 0 ∧ g.d = 0
proof:
:= by
  unfold gamma
  rw [Int.gcd_eq_zero_iff]
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨h1, h2⟩
    have h1' : Int.gcd g.a g.b = 0 := by exact_mod_cast h1
    have h2' : Int.gcd g.c g.d = 0 := by exact_mod_cast h2
    rw [Int.gcd_eq_zero_iff] at h1' h2'
    exact ⟨h1'.1, h1'.2, h2'.1, h2'.2⟩
  · rintro ⟨ha, hb, hc, hd⟩
    refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩ <;> simp [Int.gcd_eq_zero_iff, ha, hb, hc, hd]

name: entry_ediv_ismul
statement:
theorem entry_ediv_ismul {k x : Int} {g : IPlane} (hk : k ≠ 0) (hγ : gamma g ≠ 0)
    (hdvd : (gamma g : Int) ∣ x) :
    (k * x) / ((k.natAbs * gamma g : Nat) : Int) = Int.sign k * (x / (gamma g : Int))
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨q, hq⟩ := hdvd
  have hγ' : (gamma g : Int) ≠ 0 := by exact_mod_cast hγ
  have hka : (k.natAbs : Int) ≠ 0 := by
    simpa [Int.natAbs_eq_zero] using hk
  have hx : x / (gamma g : Int) = q := by
    rw [hq, mul_comm, Int.mul_ediv_cancel _ hγ']
  rw [hx, hq]
  push_cast
  rw [Int.abs_eq_natAbs]
  
  have hnum : k * ((gamma g : Int) * q)
      = (Int.sign k * q) * ((k.natAbs : Int) * (gamma g : Int)) := by
    conv_lhs => rw [← Int.sign_mul_natAbs k]
    ring
  rw [hnum, Int.mul_ediv_cancel _ (mul_ne_zero hka hγ')]

name: primDir_ismul
statement:
theorem primDir_ismul {k : Int} (g : IPlane) (hk : k ≠ 0) :
    IPlane.primDir (ismul k g) = ismul (Int.sign k) (IPlane.primDir g)
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hγ : gamma g = 0
  · 
    obtain ⟨ha, hb, hc, hd⟩ := (gamma_eq_zero_iff g).mp hγ
    have hg : g = ⟨0, 0, 0, 0⟩ := by
      cases g; simp_all
    subst hg
    have hz : IPlane.primDir (⟨0, 0, 0, 0⟩ : IPlane) = ⟨0, 0, 0, 0⟩ := rfl
    simp only [ismul, mul_zero, hz]
  · 
    have hγk : gamma (ismul k g) ≠ 0 := by
      rw [gamma_ismul]
      simpa [Int.natAbs_eq_zero, hk] using hγ
    have hγ' : (gamma g : Int) ≠ 0 := by exact_mod_cast hγ
    have hγk' : (gamma (ismul k g) : Int) ≠ 0 := by exact_mod_cast hγk
    have key : ∀ x : Int, (gamma g : Int) ∣ x →
        (k * x) / (gamma (ismul k g) : Int) = Int.sign k * (x / (gamma g : Int)) := by
      intro x hx
      rw [show (gamma (ismul k g) : Int) = ((k.natAbs * gamma g : Nat) : Int) by rw [gamma_ismul]]
      exact entry_ediv_ismul hk hγ hx
    unfold IPlane.primDir
    rw [if_neg (by simpa using hγk'), if_neg (by simpa using hγ')]
    simp only [ismul, IPlane.mk.injEq]
    exact ⟨key g.a (gamma_dvd_a g), key g.b (gamma_dvd_b g),
           key g.c (gamma_dvd_c g), key g.d (gamma_dvd_d g)⟩

name: firstNonZeroSign_ismul
statement:
theorem firstNonZeroSign_ismul {s : Int} (hs : s = 1 ∨ s = -1) (d : IPlane) :
    firstNonZeroSign (ismul s d) = s * firstNonZeroSign d
proof:
:= by
  have hsne : s ≠ 0 := by rcases hs with h | h <;> simp [h]
  have hsign : ∀ x : Int, Int.sign (s * x) = s * Int.sign x := by
    intro x
    rw [Int.sign_mul]
    rcases hs with h | h <;> simp [h]
  have hne : ∀ x : Int, (s * x ≠ 0) ↔ (x ≠ 0) := by
    intro x; constructor
    · intro h hx; exact h (by rw [hx, mul_zero])
    · intro h; exact mul_ne_zero hsne h
  unfold firstNonZeroSign
  simp only [ismul_a, ismul_b, ismul_c, ismul_d, bne_iff_ne]
  by_cases ha : d.a = 0
  · simp only [ha, mul_zero, ne_eq, not_true_eq_false, if_false, hsign]
    by_cases hb : d.b = 0
    · simp only [hb, mul_zero, ne_eq, not_true_eq_false, if_false, hsign]
      by_cases hc : d.c = 0
      · simp only [hc, mul_zero, ne_eq, not_true_eq_false, if_false, hsign]
      · simp only [mul_ne_zero hsne hc, hc, ne_eq, not_false_eq_true, if_true, hsign]
    · simp only [mul_ne_zero hsne hb, hb, ne_eq, not_false_eq_true, if_true, hsign]
  · simp only [mul_ne_zero hsne ha, ha, ne_eq, not_false_eq_true, if_true, hsign]

name: int_sign_mem
statement: theorem int_sign_mem (x : Int) : Int.sign x = -1 ∨ Int.sign x = 0 ∨ Int.sign x = 1
proof:
:= by
  rcases lt_trichotomy x 0 with h | h | h
  · exact Or.inl (Int.sign_eq_neg_one_of_neg h)
  · subst h; right; left; rfl
  · exact Or.inr (Or.inr (Int.sign_eq_one_of_pos h))

name: firstNonZeroSign_mem
statement:
theorem firstNonZeroSign_mem (g : IPlane) :
    firstNonZeroSign g = -1 ∨ firstNonZeroSign g = 0 ∨ firstNonZeroSign g = 1
proof:
:= by
  unfold firstNonZeroSign
  split <;> [skip; split] <;> [skip; skip; split] <;> exact int_sign_mem _

name: firstNonZeroSign_eq_zero
statement:
theorem firstNonZeroSign_eq_zero {g : IPlane} (h : firstNonZeroSign g = 0) :
    g.a = 0 ∧ g.b = 0 ∧ g.c = 0 ∧ g.d = 0
proof:
:= by
  unfold firstNonZeroSign at h
  by_cases ha : g.a = 0 <;> by_cases hb : g.b = 0 <;> by_cases hc : g.c = 0 <;>
    by_cases hd : g.d = 0 <;>
    simp_all [Int.sign_eq_zero_iff_zero]

name: prim_ismul
statement:
theorem prim_ismul {k : Int} (g : IPlane) (hk : k ≠ 0) :
    IPlane.prim (ismul k g) = IPlane.prim g
proof:
:= by
  have hsk : Int.sign k = 1 ∨ Int.sign k = -1 := by
    rcases lt_trichotomy k 0 with h | h | h
    · right; exact Int.sign_eq_neg_one_of_neg h
    · exact absurd h hk
    · left; exact Int.sign_eq_one_of_pos h
  have hf := firstNonZeroSign_mem (IPlane.primDir g)
  simp only [IPlane.prim, primDir_ismul g hk, firstNonZeroSign_ismul hsk,
    ismul_a, ismul_b, ismul_c, ismul_d, IPlane.mk.injEq]
  rcases hf with hf1 | hf1 | hf1
  · 
    have hscalar : (if 0 ≤ Int.sign k * firstNonZeroSign (IPlane.primDir g) then (1 : Int) else -1)
          * Int.sign k = (if 0 ≤ firstNonZeroSign (IPlane.primDir g) then (1 : Int) else -1) := by
      rcases hsk with hk1 | hk1 <;> simp [hk1, hf1]
    refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩ <;> rw [← mul_assoc, hscalar]
  · 
    obtain ⟨ha, hb, hc, hd⟩ := firstNonZeroSign_eq_zero hf1
    rw [ha, hb, hc, hd]; simp
  · 
    have hscalar : (if 0 ≤ Int.sign k * firstNonZeroSign (IPlane.primDir g) then (1 : Int) else -1)
          * Int.sign k = (if 0 ≤ firstNonZeroSign (IPlane.primDir g) then (1 : Int) else -1) := by
      rcases hsk with hk1 | hk1 <;> simp [hk1, hf1]
    refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩ <;> rw [← mul_assoc, hscalar]

name: ismul_den_num_eq
statement:
theorem ismul_den_num_eq {g h : IPlane} {ρ : ℚ}
    (ha : (h.a : ℚ) = ρ * g.a) (hb : (h.b : ℚ) = ρ * g.b)
    (hc : (h.c : ℚ) = ρ * g.c) (hd : (h.d : ℚ) = ρ * g.d) :
    ismul (ρ.den : Int) h = ismul ρ.num g
proof:
:= by
  have hqρ : (((ρ.den : Int) : ℚ)) * ρ = ((ρ.num : Int) : ℚ) := by
    exact_mod_cast Rat.den_mul_eq_num ρ
  have eqa : (ρ.den : Int) * h.a = ρ.num * g.a := by
    have : (((ρ.den : Int) : ℚ)) * (h.a : ℚ) = (((ρ.num : Int) : ℚ)) * (g.a : ℚ) := by
      rw [ha, ← mul_assoc, hqρ]
    exact_mod_cast this
  have eqb : (ρ.den : Int) * h.b = ρ.num * g.b := by
    have : (((ρ.den : Int) : ℚ)) * (h.b : ℚ) = (((ρ.num : Int) : ℚ)) * (g.b : ℚ) := by
      rw [hb, ← mul_assoc, hqρ]
    exact_mod_cast this
  have eqc : (ρ.den : Int) * h.c = ρ.num * g.c := by
    have : (((ρ.den : Int) : ℚ)) * (h.c : ℚ) = (((ρ.num : Int) : ℚ)) * (g.c : ℚ) := by
      rw [hc, ← mul_assoc, hqρ]
    exact_mod_cast this
  have eqd : (ρ.den : Int) * h.d = ρ.num * g.d := by
    have : (((ρ.den : Int) : ℚ)) * (h.d : ℚ) = (((ρ.num : Int) : ℚ)) * (g.d : ℚ) := by
      rw [hd, ← mul_assoc, hqρ]
    exact_mod_cast this
  unfold ismul; rw [IPlane.mk.injEq]; exact ⟨eqa, eqb, eqc, eqd⟩

name: prim_eq_of_ratMul
statement:
theorem prim_eq_of_ratMul {g h : IPlane} (hp : RatProp g h) :
    IPlane.prim g = IPlane.prim h
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨ρ, hρ, ha, hb, hc, hd⟩ := hp
  have hqpos : (0 : Int) < (ρ.den : Int) := by exact_mod_cast ρ.pos
  have hpne : ρ.num ≠ 0 := Rat.num_ne_zero.mpr hρ
  have heq : ismul (ρ.den : Int) h = ismul ρ.num g := ismul_den_num_eq ha hb hc hd
  
  have hthis := prim_ismul (k := (ρ.den : Int)) h (ne_of_gt hqpos)
  rw [heq, prim_ismul (k := ρ.num) g hpne] at hthis
  exact hthis

name: primDir_entry_a
statement:
theorem primDir_entry_a {g : IPlane} (hγ : gamma g ≠ 0) :
    g.a = (gamma g : Int) * (IPlane.primDir g).a
proof:
:= by
  have hγ' : (gamma g : Int) ≠ 0 := by exact_mod_cast hγ
  unfold IPlane.primDir
  rw [if_neg (by simpa using hγ')]
  exact (Int.mul_ediv_cancel' (gamma_dvd_a g)).symm

name: primDir_entry_b
statement:
theorem primDir_entry_b {g : IPlane} (hγ : gamma g ≠ 0) :
    g.b = (gamma g : Int) * (IPlane.primDir g).b
proof:
:= by
  have hγ' : (gamma g : Int) ≠ 0 := by exact_mod_cast hγ
  unfold IPlane.primDir
  rw [if_neg (by simpa using hγ')]
  exact (Int.mul_ediv_cancel' (gamma_dvd_b g)).symm

name: primDir_entry_c
statement:
theorem primDir_entry_c {g : IPlane} (hγ : gamma g ≠ 0) :

proof:

  unfold IPlane.primDir
  rw [if_neg (by simpa using hγ')]

name: primDir_entry_d
statement:
theorem primDir_entry_d {g : IPlane} (hγ : gamma g ≠ 0) :

proof:
