name: prim_eq_sign_smul
statement:
theorem prim_eq_sign_smul (g : IPlane) :
    ∃ s : Int, (s = 1 ∨ s = -1) ∧
      (IPlane.prim g).a = s * (IPlane.primDir g).a ∧
      (IPlane.prim g).b = s * (IPlane.primDir g).b ∧
      (IPlane.prim g).c = s * (IPlane.primDir g).c ∧
      (IPlane.prim g).d = s * (IPlane.primDir g).d
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨if 0 ≤ firstNonZeroSign (IPlane.primDir g) then 1 else -1, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · split <;> [left; right] <;> rfl
  all_goals (unfold IPlane.prim; rfl)

name: exists_intMul_prim
statement:
theorem exists_intMul_prim {g : IPlane} (hγ : gamma g ≠ 0) :
    ∃ k : Int, k ≠ 0 ∧
      (g.a = k * (IPlane.prim g).a ∧ g.b = k * (IPlane.prim g).b ∧
       g.c = k * (IPlane.prim g).c ∧ g.d = k * (IPlane.prim g).d)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨s, hs, pa, pb, pc, pd⟩ := prim_eq_sign_smul g
  have hsne : s ≠ 0 := by rcases hs with h | h <;> simp [h]
  have hss : s ^ 2 = 1 := by rcases hs with h | h <;> simp [h]
  have hγ' : (gamma g : Int) ≠ 0 := by exact_mod_cast hγ
  refine ⟨(gamma g : Int) * s, mul_ne_zero hγ' hsne, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · rw [primDir_entry_a hγ, pa]; ring_nf; rw [hss]; ring
  · rw [primDir_entry_b hγ, pb]; ring_nf; rw [hss]; ring
  · rw [primDir_entry_c hγ, pc]; ring_nf; rw [hss]; ring
  · rw [primDir_entry_d hγ, pd]; ring_nf; rw [hss]; ring

name: ratMul_of_prim_eq
statement:
theorem ratMul_of_prim_eq {g h : IPlane} (hγg : gamma g ≠ 0) (hγh : gamma h ≠ 0)
    (heq : IPlane.prim g = IPlane.prim h) :
    RatProp g h
proof:
:= by
  
  obtain ⟨kg, hkg, hg⟩ := exists_intMul_prim hγg
  obtain ⟨kh, hkh, hh⟩ := exists_intMul_prim hγh
  rw [heq] at hg
  
  refine ⟨(kh : ℚ) / (kg : ℚ), by
    apply div_ne_zero <;> exact_mod_cast (by assumption), ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩ <;>
  · 
    first
      | (rw [hh.1, hg.1]) | (rw [hh.2.1, hg.2.1]) | (rw [hh.2.2.1, hg.2.2.1])
      | (rw [hh.2.2.2, hg.2.2.2])
    push_cast
    field_simp
    ring

name: beqIPlane_eq_true_iff
statement: theorem beqIPlane_eq_true_iff {g h : IPlane} : beqIPlane g h = true ↔ g = h
proof:
:= by
  unfold beqIPlane
  simp only [Bool.and_eq_true, beq_iff_eq]
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨⟨⟨ha, hb⟩, hc⟩, hd⟩
    cases g; cases h; simp_all
  · rintro rfl; exact ⟨⟨⟨rfl, rfl⟩, rfl⟩, rfl⟩

name: coplanarPlane_eq_true_iff
statement:
theorem coplanarPlane_eq_true_iff {g h : IPlane} :
    coplanarPlane g h = true ↔ IPlane.prim g = IPlane.prim h
proof:
:= by
  unfold coplanarPlane
  exact beqIPlane_eq_true_iff

name: coplanarPlane_iff_ratMul
statement:
theorem coplanarPlane_iff_ratMul {g h : IPlane} (hγg : gamma g ≠ 0) (hγh : gamma h ≠ 0) :
    coplanarPlane g h = true ↔ RatProp g h
proof:
:= by
  rw [coplanarPlane_eq_true_iff]
  constructor
  · exact ratMul_of_prim_eq hγg hγh
  · exact prim_eq_of_ratMul

name: not_ratProp_of_coplanarPlane_false
statement:
theorem not_ratProp_of_coplanarPlane_false {g h : IPlane}
    (hcop : coplanarPlane g h = false) : ¬ RatProp g h
proof:
:= by
  intro hp
  have : IPlane.prim g = IPlane.prim h := prim_eq_of_ratMul hp
  rw [← coplanarPlane_eq_true_iff] at this
  rw [this] at hcop
  exact Bool.noConfusion hcop

name: den_eq_one_of_dvd
statement:
theorem den_eq_one_of_dvd {m : Int} {q : Rat} (h : (q.den : Int) ∣ m) :
    ((m : ℚ) * q).den = 1
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨j, hj⟩ := h
  have h2 : (m : ℚ) * q = ((j * q.num : Int) : ℚ) := by
    rw [hj]; push_cast
    have hk := Rat.den_mul_eq_num q
    calc (q.den : ℚ) * j * q = j * ((q.den : ℚ) * q) := by ring
      _ = j * q.num := by rw [hk]
  rw [h2]; exact Rat.den_intCast _

name: cast_num_mul
statement:
theorem cast_num_mul {m : Int} {q : Rat} (h : (q.den : Int) ∣ m) :
    (((m : ℚ) * q).num : ℚ) = (m : ℚ) * q
proof:
:=
  Rat.coe_int_num_of_den_eq_one (den_eq_one_of_dvd h)

name: clearMul_pos
statement: theorem clearMul_pos (n : P3) (c : Rat) : 0 < clearMul n c
proof:
:= by
  unfold clearMul
  have hne : ((n.x.den.lcm n.y.den).lcm n.z.den).lcm c.den ≠ 0 :=
    Nat.lcm_ne_zero (Nat.lcm_ne_zero (Nat.lcm_ne_zero n.x.den_nz n.y.den_nz) n.z.den_nz) c.den_nz
  exact Int.ofNat_pos.mpr (Nat.pos_of_ne_zero hne)

name: clearPlane_eq_smul
statement:
theorem clearPlane_eq_smul (n : P3) (c : Rat) :
    0 < clearMul n c ∧
    ((clearPlane n c).a : ℚ) = (clearMul n c : ℚ) * n.x ∧
    ((clearPlane n c).b : ℚ) = (clearMul n c : ℚ) * n.y ∧
    ((clearPlane n c).c : ℚ) = (clearMul n c : ℚ) * n.z ∧
    ((clearPlane n c).d : ℚ) = (clearMul n c : ℚ) * c
proof:
:= by
  
  have dxn : n.x.den ∣ ((n.x.den.lcm n.y.den).lcm n.z.den).lcm c.den :=
    dvd_trans (dvd_trans (Nat.dvd_lcm_left _ _) (Nat.dvd_lcm_left _ _)) (Nat.dvd_lcm_left _ _)
  have dyn : n.y.den ∣ ((n.x.den.lcm n.y.den).lcm n.z.den).lcm c.den :=
    dvd_trans (dvd_trans (Nat.dvd_lcm_right _ _) (Nat.dvd_lcm_left _ _)) (Nat.dvd_lcm_left _ _)
  have dzn : n.z.den ∣ ((n.x.den.lcm n.y.den).lcm n.z.den).lcm c.den :=
    dvd_trans (Nat.dvd_lcm_right _ _) (Nat.dvd_lcm_left _ _)
  have dcn : c.den ∣ ((n.x.den.lcm n.y.den).lcm n.z.den).lcm c.den := Nat.dvd_lcm_right _ _
  have dx : (n.x.den : Int) ∣ clearMul n c := by
    unfold clearMul; rw [Int.ofNat_eq_natCast]; exact Int.natCast_dvd_natCast.mpr dxn
  have dy : (n.y.den : Int) ∣ clearMul n c := by
    unfold clearMul; rw [Int.ofNat_eq_natCast]; exact Int.natCast_dvd_natCast.mpr dyn
  have dz : (n.z.den : Int) ∣ clearMul n c := by
    unfold clearMul; rw [Int.ofNat_eq_natCast]; exact Int.natCast_dvd_natCast.mpr dzn
  have dc : (c.den : Int) ∣ clearMul n c := by
    unfold clearMul; rw [Int.ofNat_eq_natCast]; exact Int.natCast_dvd_natCast.mpr dcn
  refine ⟨clearMul_pos n c, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩ <;>
    · unfold clearPlane
      simp only
      rw [show (Int.ofNat (((n.x.den.lcm n.y.den).lcm n.z.den).lcm c.den)) = clearMul n c from rfl]
      first
        | exact cast_num_mul dx | exact cast_num_mul dy
        | exact cast_num_mul dz | exact cast_num_mul dc

name: ratPropCarrier_of_tie_eq_zero
statement:
theorem ratPropCarrier_of_tie_eq_zero {n n' : Point} {c c' : ℚ}
    (hc : c ≠ 0) (hc' : c' ≠ 0)
    (htie : c' • n - c • n' = 0) :
    RatPropCarrier n c n' c'
proof:
:= by
  have h : c' • n = c • n' := sub_eq_zero.mp htie
  refine ⟨c' / c, div_ne_zero hc' hc, ?_, by field_simp⟩
  
  have hn' : n' = (c⁻¹) • (c • n') := by rw [smul_smul, inv_mul_cancel₀ hc, one_smul]
  rw [hn', ← h, smul_smul]
  congr 1
  field_simp

name: ratPropCarrier_iff_ratProp4
statement:
theorem ratPropCarrier_iff_ratProp4 (n n' : Point) (c c' : ℚ) :
    RatPropCarrier n c n' c' ↔ RatProp4 (n 0) (n 1) (n 2) c (n' 0) (n' 1) (n' 2) c'
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨ρ, hρ, hn, hc⟩
    refine ⟨ρ, hρ, ?_, ?_, ?_, hc⟩ <;>
      · rw [hn]; simp [Pi.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul]
  · rintro ⟨ρ, hρ, h0, h1, h2, hc⟩
    refine ⟨ρ, hρ, ?_, hc⟩
    funext i
    fin_cases i <;> simp [Pi.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul] <;> assumption

name: ratProp_iff_ratProp4_of_decomp
statement:
theorem ratProp_iff_ratProp4_of_decomp {P Q : IPlane} {a b c d a' b' c' d' mP mQ : ℚ}
    (hmP : mP ≠ 0) (hmQ : mQ ≠ 0)
    (hPa : (P.a : ℚ) = mP * a) (hPb : (P.b : ℚ) = mP * b)
    (hPc : (P.c : ℚ) = mP * c) (hPd : (P.d : ℚ) = mP * d)
    (hQa : (Q.a : ℚ) = mQ * a') (hQb : (Q.b : ℚ) = mQ * b')
    (hQc : (Q.c : ℚ) = mQ * c') (hQd : (Q.d : ℚ) = mQ * d') :
    RatProp P Q ↔ RatProp4 a b c d a' b' c' d'
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨ρ, hρ, ea, eb, ec, ed⟩
    refine ⟨ρ * mP / mQ, div_ne_zero (mul_ne_zero hρ hmP) hmQ, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
    · have : mQ * a' = ρ * (mP * a) := by rw [← hQa, ea, hPa]
      field_simp at this ⊢; linarith [this]
    · have : mQ * b' = ρ * (mP * b) := by rw [← hQb, eb, hPb]
      field_simp at this ⊢; linarith [this]
    · have : mQ * c' = ρ * (mP * c) := by rw [← hQc, ec, hPc]
      field_simp at this ⊢; linarith [this]
    · have : mQ * d' = ρ * (mP * d) := by rw [← hQd, ed, hPd]
      field_simp at this ⊢; linarith [this]
  · rintro ⟨σ, hσ, ea, eb, ec, ed⟩
    refine ⟨mQ * σ / mP, div_ne_zero (mul_ne_zero hmQ hσ) hmP, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
    · rw [ea] at hQa; rw [hQa, hPa]; field_simp; ring
    · rw [eb] at hQb; rw [hQb, hPb]; field_simp; ring
    · rw [ec] at hQc; rw [hQc, hPc]; field_simp; ring
    · rw [ed] at hQd; rw [hQd, hPd]; field_simp; ring

name: not_ratProp4_of_coplanarPlane_false
statement:
theorem not_ratProp4_of_coplanarPlane_false {P Q : IPlane} {a b c d a' b' c' d' mP mQ : ℚ}
    (hcop : coplanarPlane P Q = false) (hmP : mP ≠ 0) (hmQ : mQ ≠ 0)
    (hPa : (P.a : ℚ) = mP * a) (hPb : (P.b : ℚ) = mP * b)
    (hPc : (P.c : ℚ) = mP * c) (hPd : (P.d : ℚ) = mP * d)
    (hQa : (Q.a : ℚ) = mQ * a') (hQb : (Q.b : ℚ) = mQ * b')
    (hQc : (Q.c : ℚ) = mQ * c') (hQd : (Q.d : ℚ) = mQ * d') :
    ¬ RatProp4 a b c d a' b' c' d'
proof:
:= by
  rw [← ratProp_iff_ratProp4_of_decomp hmP hmQ hPa hPb hPc hPd hQa hQb hQc hQd]
  exact not_ratProp_of_coplanarPlane_false hcop

name: tie_of_transverse
statement:
theorem tie_of_transverse {t u : Triangle}
    (hdt : detOrigin t ≠ 0) (hdu : detOrigin u ≠ 0)
    (hnp : ¬ RatPropCarrier (carrierNormal t) (detOrigin t)
              (carrierNormal u) (detOrigin u)) :
    detOrigin u • carrierNormal t - detOrigin t • carrierNormal u ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  intro htie
  exact hnp (ratPropCarrier_of_tie_eq_zero hdt hdu htie)

name: cutVtx_faithful
statement: theorem cutVtx_faithful (g : IPlane) (A B : Vtx) : VtxFaithful (cutVtx g A B)
proof: := rfl

name: foldl_inv
statement:
theorem foldl_inv {α β} (P : β → Prop) (F : β → α → β) :
    ∀ (l : List α) (init : β), P init →
      (∀ b, P b → ∀ a ∈ l, P (F b a)) → P (l.foldl F init)
  | [], init, h0, _ => h0
  | a :: l, init, h0, hstep => by
      rw [List.foldl_cons]
      refine foldl_inv P F l (F init a) (hstep init h0 a (List.mem_cons_self a l)) ?_
      intro b hb x hx
      exact hstep b hb x (List.mem_cons_of_mem a hx)

/-! ## 2. `clipFrag` preserves faithfulness -/

/
predicate on the splitter's 2-tuple fold state. -/
def FaithSt (st : Array Vtx × Array Vtx) : Prop
proof:
:=
  (∀ v ∈ st.1, VtxFaithful v) ∧ (∀ v ∈ st.2, VtxFaithful v)

name: clipFrag_faithful
statement:
theorem clipFrag_faithful (g : IPlane) (f : Frag) (hf : FragFaithful f) :
    ∀ f' ∈ clipFrag g f, FragFaithful f'
proof:
:= by
  intro f' hf'
  simp only [clipFrag] at hf'
  split_ifs at hf' with hcond
  · 
    rw [Array.mem_singleton] at hf'
    subst hf'; exact hf
  · 
    
    have hfold : FaithSt
        ((Array.range f.poly.size).foldl (init := (#[], #[]))
          (fun st i =>
            let a := f.poly.getD i default
            let sa := (f.poly.map (fun v => signI g v.h)).getD i 0
            let sb := (f.poly.map (fun v => signI g v.h)).getD ((i + 1) % f.poly.size) 0
            if 0 ≤ sa then
              if sb < 0 then
                if 0 < sa then
                  let b := f.poly.getD ((i + 1) % f.poly.size) default
                  let X := cutVtx g a b
                  (st.1.push a |>.push X, st.2.push X)
                else
                  (st.1.push a, st.2.push a)
              else
                if sa == 0 then
                  (st.1.push a, st.2.push a)
                else
                  (st.1.push a, st.2)
            else
              if 0 < sb then
                let b := f.poly.getD ((i + 1) % f.poly.size) default
                let X := cutVtx g a b
                (st.1.push X, st.2.push a |>.push X)
              else
                (st.1, st.2.push a))) := by
      rw [← Array.foldl_toList]
      refine foldl_inv FaithSt _ _ _ (by simp [FaithSt]) ?_
      intro b hb i hi
      rw [Array.toList_range, List.mem_range] at hi
      have ha : VtxFaithful (f.poly.getD i default) := hf _ (getD_mem f.poly i hi default)
      have hX : VtxFaithful (cutVtx g (f.poly.getD i default)
          (f.poly.getD ((i + 1) % f.poly.size) default)) := cutVtx_faithful ..
      obtain ⟨pV, nV⟩ := b
      simp only [FaithSt] at hb ⊢
      obtain ⟨hbP, hbN⟩ := hb
      split_ifs <;> refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩ <;> intro v hv <;>
        (try simp only [Array.mem_push] at hv) <;>
        (try casesm* _ ∨ _) <;>
        first
        | exact hbP v (by assumption)
        | exact hbN v (by assumption)
        | (subst_vars; first
            | exact hf _ (getD_mem f.poly i hi default)
            | exact hf _ (Array.getElem_mem hi)
            | exact cutVtx_faithful ..)
    
    rw [Array.mem_def] at hf'
    fin_cases hf'
    · exact hfold.1
    · exact hfold.2

name: toList_flatMap
statement:
theorem toList_flatMap {α β : Type*} (as : Array α) (F : α → Array β) :
    (as.flatMap F).toList = as.toList.flatMap (fun a => (F a).toList)
proof:
:= by
  show (as.foldl (fun bs a => bs ++ F a) #[]).toList = _
  rw [← Array.foldl_toList]
  suffices h : ∀ (l : List α) (init : Array β),
      (l.foldl (fun bs a => bs ++ F a) init).toList
        = init.toList ++ l.flatMap (fun a => (F a).toList) by
    simpa using h as.toList #[]
  intro l
  induction l with
  | nil => intro init; simp
  | cons a l ih =>
    intro init
    rw [List.foldl_cons, ih, List.flatMap_cons, Array.toList_append, List.append_assoc]

name: mem_flatMap_arr
statement:
theorem mem_flatMap_arr {α β : Type*} {b : β} {as : Array α} {F : α → Array β} :
    b ∈ as.flatMap F ↔ ∃ a ∈ as, b ∈ F a
proof:
:= by
  rw [Array.mem_def, toList_flatMap, List.mem_flatMap]
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨a, ha, hb⟩; exact ⟨a, Array.mem_def.mpr ha, Array.mem_def.mpr hb⟩
  · rintro ⟨a, ha, hb⟩; exact ⟨a, Array.mem_def.mp ha, Array.mem_def.mp hb⟩

name: arr_flatMap_map
statement:
theorem arr_flatMap_map {α β γ} (as : Array α) (g : α → β) (h : β → Array γ) :
    (as.map g).flatMap h = as.flatMap (fun a => h (g a))
proof:
:= by
  apply Array.ext'
  simp only [toList_flatMap, Array.toList_map, List.flatMap_map, Function.comp]

name: arr_map_flatMap
statement:
theorem arr_map_flatMap {α β γ} (as : Array α) (f : α → Array β) (g : β → γ) :
    (as.flatMap f).map g = as.flatMap (fun a => (f a).map g)
proof:
:= by
  apply Array.ext'
  simp only [Array.toList_map, toList_flatMap, List.map_flatMap]

name: arr_flatMap_congr
statement:
theorem arr_flatMap_congr {α β} (as : Array α) (F G : α → Array β)
    (h : ∀ a ∈ as, F a = G a) : as.flatMap F = as.flatMap G
proof:
:= by
  apply Array.ext'
  rw [toList_flatMap, toList_flatMap]
  apply List.flatMap_congr
  intro a ha
  rw [h a (Array.mem_toList.mp ha)]

name: meshIntersect_normal
statement:
theorem meshIntersect_normal (M₁ M₂ : Mesh)
    (h₁ : Legacy.WellFormedMesh M₁) (h₂ : Legacy.WellFormedMesh M₂) :
    Legacy.Normal (meshChain (Impl.MeshIntersect.meshIntersect M₁ M₂))
proof:
:= by
  classical
  obtain ⟨N₁, hN₁neg, hN₁⟩ := h₁.2.1
  obtain ⟨N₂, hN₂neg, hN₂⟩ := h₂.2.1
  obtain ⟨Nm, hNmneg, hNm⟩ := master_gen M₁ M₂ h₁ h₂
  refine ⟨N₁ ∪ N₂ ∪ Nm,
    negligible_union (negligible_union hN₁neg hN₂neg) hNmneg, ?_⟩
  intro Q hQ
  have hQ1 : Q ∉ N₁ := fun h => hQ (Or.inl (Or.inl h))
  have hQ2 : Q ∉ N₂ := fun h => hQ (Or.inl (Or.inr h))
  have hQm : Q ∉ Nm := fun h => hQ (Or.inr h)
  rw [hNm Q hQm]
  rcases hN₁ Q hQ1 with ha | ha <;> rcases hN₂ Q hQ2 with hb | hb <;>
    rw [ha, hb] <;> simp

name: atomize_saturated_gen
statement:
theorem atomize_saturated_gen {M₁ M₂ : Mesh}
    (h₁ : NoPlaneThroughOrigin M₁) (h₂ : NoPlaneThroughOrigin M₂)
    {f : Frag} (hf : f ∈ keptGen M₁ M₂)
    [hzm : NeZero (atomizeFrag (vsGen M₁ M₂) f).poly.size]
    {z : Point} (hz : ∃ u ∈ (vsGen M₁ M₂).toList, P3.toPoint u.p = z)
    (k : Fin (atomizeFrag (vsGen M₁ M₂) f).poly.size) :
    z ∉ openSegment ℚ (fragCycle (atomizeFrag (vsGen M₁ M₂) f) k)
      (fragCycle (atomizeFrag (vsGen M₁ M₂) f) (k + 1))
proof:
:= by
  classical
  
  
  obtain ⟨_M, _i, _hi, -, _hdet, hinv₀⟩ := kept_fragInv h₁ h₂ hf
  haveI hzr : NeZero f.poly.size := hinv₀.neZero
  obtain ⟨M, i₀, hi₀, hdet, hinv, hm, hshape⟩ := keptGen_refShape h₁ h₂ hf
  have hr : 3 ≤ f.poly.size := hinv.size3
  have hs := hshape
  obtain ⟨d, hper, hdisj, -⟩ := hs.chart
  intro hmem
  obtain ⟨hk0, hk1, hk2, hk3, hk4⟩ := hper k
  set w := fragCycle f with hw
  set i : Fin f.poly.size := (d k).1 with hi
  set lo : ℚ := (d k).2.1 with hlo
  set hi' : ℚ := (d k).2.2 with hhi
  obtain ⟨θ₁, θ₂, hθ₁, hθ₂, hsum, hcomb⟩ := hmem
  have hθ₂' : θ₂ = 1 - θ₁ := by linarith
  subst hθ₂'
  set τ : ℚ := θ₁ * lo + (1 - θ₁) * hi' with hτ
  have hzrep : z = w i + τ • (w (i + 1) - w i) := by
    rw [← hcomb, hk3, hk4, hτ]
    module
  have hθ₁1 : θ₁ < 1 := by linarith
  have hlt1 : lo < τ := by
    rw [hτ]
    nlinarith [mul_pos (show (0:ℚ) < 1 - θ₁ by linarith) (show (0:ℚ) < hi' - lo by linarith)]
  have hlt2 : τ < hi' := by
    rw [hτ]
    nlinarith [mul_pos hθ₁ (show (0:ℚ) < hi' - lo by linarith)]
  have hτ0 : 0 < τ := lt_of_le_of_lt hk0 hlt1
  have hτ1 : τ < 1 := lt_of_lt_of_le hlt2 hk2
  obtain ⟨u, humem, hueq⟩ := hz
  have hfacts := vsGen_facts h₁ h₂
  have hgda : f.poly.getD i.val default = f.poly[i] := poly_getD f i
  have hgdb : f.poly.getD ((i.val + 1) % f.poly.size) default
      = f.poly[i + 1] := poly_getD_succ hr i
  have ha' : repr4 ((f.poly.getD i.val default).h)
      (P3.toPoint (f.poly.getD i.val default).p) := by
    rw [hgda]
    exact hinv.vrepr i
  have hb' : repr4 ((f.poly.getD ((i.val + 1) % f.poly.size) default).h)
      (P3.toPoint (f.poly.getD ((i.val + 1) % f.poly.size) default).p) := by
    rw [hgdb]
    exact hinv.vrepr (i + 1)
  have hab : P3.toPoint (f.poly.getD i.val default).p
      ≠ P3.toPoint (f.poly.getD ((i.val + 1) % f.poly.size) default).p := by
    rw [hgda, hgdb]
    exact Proof.MeshIntersectClip.consec_ne hr hinv.strictConv i
  have hrep : P3.toPoint u.p
      = P3.toPoint (f.poly.getD i.val default).p
        + τ • (P3.toPoint (f.poly.getD ((i.val + 1) % f.poly.size) default).p
          - P3.toPoint (f.poly.getD i.val default).p) := by
    rw [hgda, hgdb, hueq, hzrep]
    rfl
  have hhit : u ∈ (hitsOn (vsGen M₁ M₂) (f.poly.getD i.val default)
      (f.poly.getD ((i.val + 1) % f.poly.size) default)).toList :=
    hitsOn_complete (vsGen M₁ M₂) ha' hb' (hfacts.1 u humem)
      (vertexUniverse_xmono (keptGen M₁ M₂)) hab humem hτ0 hτ1 hrep
  have humem' : u ∈ (atomizeFrag (vsGen M₁ M₂) f).poly.toList := by
    rw [atomizeFrag_poly, List.mem_flatMap]
    exact ⟨i.val, List.mem_range.mpr i.isLt, List.mem_cons_of_mem _ hhit⟩
  obtain ⟨j', hj', hju⟩ := List.mem_iff_getElem.mp humem'
  have hj'' : j' < (atomizeFrag (vsGen M₁ M₂) f).poly.size := by
    simpa using hj'
  
  
  have hpj : (atomizeFrag (vsGen M₁ M₂) f).poly[j']'hj'' = u := by
    rw [← hju]
    exact (Array.getElem_toList hj'').symm
  have huj : fragCycle (atomizeFrag (vsGen M₁ M₂) f) ⟨j', hj''⟩ = z := by
    rw [← hueq]
    show P3.toPoint ((atomizeFrag (vsGen M₁ M₂) f).poly[j']'hj'').p = P3.toPoint u.p
    rw [hpj]
  set j : Fin (atomizeFrag (vsGen M₁ M₂) f).poly.size := ⟨j', hj''⟩
  obtain ⟨hj0, hj1, hj2, hj3, -⟩ := hper j
  have hpin := chart_inj hr hinv.strictConv hj0 (lt_of_lt_of_le hj1 hj2)
    hτ0.le hτ1 (by rw [← hj3, huj, hzrep])
  obtain ⟨hdj, hloj⟩ := hpin
  have hjk : j ≠ k := by
    intro hc
    rw [hc] at hloj
    exact absurd hloj (ne_of_lt hlt1)
  have hdval : (((d j).1.val : ℚ)) = (((d k).1.val : ℚ)) := by rw [hdj, hi]
  rcases hdisj j k hjk with h | h
  · have e1 : lo = (d k).2.1 := hlo
    linarith [h, hj1, hloj, hlt1, hdval, e1]
  · have e2 : hi' = (d k).2.2 := hhi
    linarith [h, hloj, hlt2, hdval, e2]

name: sat_field_gen
statement:
theorem sat_field_gen {M₁ M₂ : Mesh}
    (h₁ : NoPlaneThroughOrigin M₁) (h₂ : NoPlaneThroughOrigin M₂)
    {f : Frag} (hf : f ∈ keptGen M₁ M₂)
    [NeZero (atomizeFrag (vsGen M₁ M₂) f).poly.size]
    (k j : Fin (atomizeFrag (vsGen M₁ M₂) f).poly.size) :
    fragCycle (atomizeFrag (vsGen M₁ M₂) f) j
      ∉ openSegment ℚ (fragCycle (atomizeFrag (vsGen M₁ M₂) f) k)
        (fragCycle (atomizeFrag (vsGen M₁ M₂) f) (k + 1))
proof:
:= by
  refine atomize_saturated_gen h₁ h₂ hf ?_ k
  have hall := atomize_vertex_mem (vsGen M₁ M₂) f (fun v hv =>
    vertexUniverse_complete (keptGen M₁ M₂) hf (Array.mem_def.mpr hv))
  
  
  have hmem : (atomizeFrag (vsGen M₁ M₂) f).poly[j.val]'j.isLt
      ∈ (atomizeFrag (vsGen M₁ M₂) f).poly.toList := by
    rw [← Array.getElem_toList j.isLt]
    exact List.getElem_mem _
  obtain ⟨u', hu', hup⟩ := hall _ hmem
  exact ⟨u', hu', congrArg P3.toPoint hup⟩

name: keptGen_emitPackage
statement:
theorem keptGen_emitPackage {M₁ M₂ : Mesh} (h₁ : NoPlaneThroughOrigin M₁)
    (h₂ : NoPlaneThroughOrigin M₂) {f : Frag} (hf : f ∈ keptGen M₁ M₂) :
    (emitFrag (atomizeFrag (vsGen M₁ M₂) f)).toList.Pairwise TriRel
    ∧ ∀ t ∈ (emitFrag (atomizeFrag (vsGen M₁ M₂) f)).toList,
        triangleSet t ⊆ vpoly (fragCycle f)
        ∧ ∀ S : Set Point, vrelint (fragCycle f) ∩ S = ∅ →
            triangleSet t ∩ S ⊆ edgeSet t
proof:
:= by
  
  
  obtain ⟨_M, _i, _hi, -, _hdet, hinv₀⟩ := kept_fragInv h₁ h₂ hf
  haveI hzr : NeZero f.poly.size := hinv₀.neZero
  haveI hzm : NeZero (atomizeFrag (vsGen M₁ M₂) f).poly.size :=
    ⟨by have := keptGen_atomize_size3 h₁ h₂ hf; omega⟩
  obtain ⟨M, i, hi, hdet, hinv, hm, hshape⟩ := keptGen_refShape h₁ h₂ hf
  exact emit_package_core hinv hm hshape (sat_field_gen h₁ h₂ hf)

name: clipFrag_plane
statement:
theorem clipFrag_plane (g : IPlane) (f : Frag) {f' : Frag}
    (hf' : f' ∈ clipFrag g f) : f'.plane = f.plane
proof:
:= by
  rw [clipFrag_eq] at hf'
  split at hf'
  · rw [Array.mem_def] at hf'; simp at hf'; subst hf'; rfl
  · rw [Array.mem_def] at hf'
    simp only [Array.toList_toArray, List.mem_cons, List.mem_singleton, List.not_mem_nil,
      or_false] at hf'
    rcases hf' with h | h <;> (subst h; rfl)

name: clipFaceScoped_plane
statement:
theorem clipFaceScoped_plane (f₀ : Frag) (L : Array (IPlane × Box3)) {f' : Frag}
    (hf' : f' ∈ clipFaceScoped f₀ L) : f'.plane = f₀.plane
proof:
:= by
  rw [clipFaceScoped_eq_sclipFold] at hf'
  have hbase : ∀ g ∈ (#[f₀] : Array Frag), g.plane = f₀.plane := by
    intro g hg; rw [Array.mem_def] at hg; simp at hg; subst hg; rfl
  suffices h : ∀ (Ls : List (IPlane × Box3)) (fs : Array Frag),
      (∀ g ∈ fs, g.plane = f₀.plane) → ∀ g ∈ sclipFold fs Ls, g.plane = f₀.plane by
    exact h L.toList #[f₀] hbase f' hf'
  intro Ls
  induction Ls with
  | nil => intro fs hfs g hg; exact hfs g hg
  | cons t Ls ih =>
    intro fs hfs g hg
    rw [sclipFold_cons] at hg
    refine ih _ ?_ g hg
    intro gm hgm
    rw [mem_flatMap_arr] at hgm
    obtain ⟨r, hr, hrm⟩ := hgm
    simp only [clipFragS] at hrm
    split at hrm
    · rw [clipFrag_plane _ _ hrm]; exact hfs r hr
    · have hgr : gm = r := by simpa using hrm
      rw [hgr]; exact hfs r hr

name: not_ratPropCarrier_of_coplanarPlane_false
proof:
:= by
  rw [ratPropCarrier_iff_ratProp4]
  obtain ⟨mP, hmP, hPa, hPb, hPc, hPd⟩ := isMulOf_faceSOf_plane t
  obtain ⟨mQ, hmQ, hQa, hQb, hQc, hQd⟩ := isMulOf_faceSOf_plane u
  exact not_ratProp4_of_coplanarPlane_false hcop (ne_of_gt hmP) (ne_of_gt hmQ)
    hPa hPb hPc hPd hQa hQb hQc hQd

name: base_vertex_off_level
statement:
theorem base_vertex_off_level {t : Triangle} {nu : Point} {cu : ℚ}
    (hdet : detOrigin t ≠ 0) (hcu : cu ≠ 0)
    (hnp : ¬ RatPropCarrier (carrierNormal t) (detOrigin t) nu cu)
    (_meshId _parent : Nat) :
    ∃ k : Fin (fragOfFace (faceSOf t)).poly.size,
      dotQ nu (fragCycle (fragOfFace (faceSOf t)) k) ≠ cu
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have hb := fragInv_base hdet
  haveI := hb.neZero
  by_contra hcon
  push_neg at hcon
  
  set base := fragOfFace (faceSOf t) with hbase
  
  have hsub : ∀ x, dotQ (carrierNormal t) x = detOrigin t → dotQ nu x = cu :=
    fun x hx => carrier_subset_of_cycle_on_plane hb.size3 hb.onPlane hb.strictConv
      (m := nu) (d := cu) hcon hx
  
  have hna : carrierNormal t ≠ 0 := carrierNormal_ne_zero hdet
  have hnn : 0 < dotQ (carrierNormal t) (carrierNormal t) := dotQ_self_pos hna
  set y0 : Point := (detOrigin t / dotQ (carrierNormal t) (carrierNormal t))
    • carrierNormal t with hy0
  have hy0c : dotQ (carrierNormal t) y0 = detOrigin t := by
    rw [hy0, Proof.SimImplCover.dotQ_smul_right, div_mul_cancel₀ _ (ne_of_gt hnn)]
  
  have hker : ∀ v : Point, dotQ (carrierNormal t) v = 0 → dotQ nu v = 0 := by
    intro v hv
    have hin : dotQ (carrierNormal t) (y0 + v) = detOrigin t := by
      rw [dotQ_add_right, hy0c, hv, add_zero]
    have e1 := hsub y0 hy0c
    have e2 := hsub (y0 + v) hin
    rw [dotQ_add_right] at e2
    linarith
  
  obtain hsm := smul_of_ann_ker hna hker
  set ρ : ℚ := dotQ nu (carrierNormal t) / dotQ (carrierNormal t) (carrierNormal t)
    with hρdef
  have hcuρ : cu = ρ * detOrigin t := by
    have := hsub y0 hy0c
    rw [hsm, Proof.SimImplCover.dotQ_smul_left, hy0c] at this
    linarith
  have hρ0 : ρ ≠ 0 := by
    intro h0
    rw [h0, zero_mul] at hcuρ
    exact hcu hcuρ
  exact hnp ⟨ρ, hρ0, hsm, hcuρ⟩

name: cs_off_side_gen
statement:
theorem cs_off_side_gen {MA MB : Mesh} (meshId : Nat) {i : ℕ} (hi : i < MA.size)
    (hdetA : detOrigin (MA[i]'hi) ≠ 0)
    {f : Frag}
    (hmem : f ∈ clipFaceScoped (fragOfFace ((materialize MA).getD i default))
      (planesForScoped ((materialize MA).getD i default).plane (materialize MB)
        ((candP MA MB).getD i #[])))
    {j : ℕ} (hj : j < MB.size) (hdetB : detOrigin (MB[j]'hj) ≠ 0)
    (hcop : coplanarPlane (faceSOf (MA[i]'hi)).plane (faceSOf (MB[j]'hj)).plane = false) :
    vrelint (fragCycle f) ∩ triangleSet (MB[j]'hj) = ∅
proof:
:= by
  have hiA : i < (materialize MA).size := by simpa [materialize] using hi
  rw [arr_getD _ _ _ hiA, materialize_getElem MA i hi] at hmem
  have hf₀ := fragInv_base hdetA
  haveI := hf₀.neZero
  refine clipFaceScoped_vrelint_off_triangle hf₀ hmem
    (dotQ_carrierNormal_v₀ _) (dotQ_carrierNormal_v₁ _)
    (dotQ_carrierNormal_v₂ _) ?_ ?_
  · 
    by_cases hmeet : (triangleSet (MA[i]'hi) ∩ triangleSet (MB[j]'hj)).Nonempty
    · left
      obtain ⟨pg, hpg, hmul, hbox⟩ := Proof.MeshIntersectPrep.planesForScoped_of_meet_P hi hj hmeet
      rw [arr_getD _ _ _ hiA, materialize_getElem MA i hi] at hpg
      exact ⟨pg, hpg, hmul, hbox⟩
    · right
      rw [vpoly_fragOfFace]
      rw [Set.not_nonempty_iff_eq_empty] at hmeet
      exact hmeet
  · 
    have hnp := not_ratPropCarrier_of_coplanarPlane_false hcop
    exact base_vertex_off_level hdetA hdetB hnp meshId i

name: ncBucket_transverse
statement:
theorem ncBucket_transverse {MA MB : Mesh} {f : Frag} {i : ℕ} (hi : i < MA.size)
    (hpl : f.plane = (faceSOf (MA[i]'hi)).plane)
    (hnc : isCoplanarWith f (materialize MB) = false)
    {j : ℕ} (hj : j < MB.size) :
    coplanarPlane (faceSOf (MA[i]'hi)).plane (faceSOf (MB[j]'hj)).plane = false
proof:
:= by
  rw [← hpl]
  rw [Proof.MeshIntersectCoplanarKey.isCoplanarWith_eq_any, ← Bool.not_eq_true,
    Array.any_eq_true] at hnc
  push_neg at hnc
  have hjM : j < (materialize MB).size := by simpa [materialize] using hj
  have hthis := hnc ⟨j, hjM⟩
  simp only [Fin.getElem_fin] at hthis
  rw [materialize_getElem MB j hj] at hthis
  exact Bool.eq_false_iff.mpr hthis

name: crossStage_half_gen
statement:
theorem crossStage_half_gen {MA MB : Mesh} (meshId : Nat)
    (hA : NoPlaneThroughOrigin MA) (hB : NoPlaneThroughOrigin MB)
    {i j : ℕ} (hi : i < MA.size) (hj : j < MB.size) {f₁ f₂ : Frag}
    (hm₁ : f₁ ∈ clipFaceScoped
      (fragOfFace ((materialize MA).getD i default))
      (planesForScoped ((materialize MA).getD i default).plane (materialize MB)
        ((candP MA MB).getD i #[])))
    {L₂ : Array (IPlane × Box3)}
    (hm₂ : f₂ ∈ clipFaceScoped
      (fragOfFace ((materialize MB).getD j default)) L₂)
    (hcop : coplanarPlane (faceSOf (MA[i]'hi)).plane (faceSOf (MB[j]'hj)).plane = false) :
    vrelint (fragCycle f₁) ∩ vpoly (fragCycle f₂) = ∅
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have hdetB : detOrigin (MB[j]'hj) ≠ 0 := hB ⟨j, hj⟩
  have hoff := cs_off_side_gen meshId hi (hA ⟨i, hi⟩) hm₁ hj hdetB hcop
  
  have hjM : j < (materialize MB).size := by rwa [materialize_size]
  rw [arr_getD _ _ _ hjM, materialize_getElem MB j hj] at hm₂
  have hb₂ := fragInv_base hdetB
  have step2 : vpoly (fragCycle f₂) ⊆ triangleSet (MB[j]'hj) := by
    refine (clipFaceScoped_vpoly_subset hb₂ L₂ hm₂).trans ?_
    rw [vpoly_fragOfFace]
  rw [Set.eq_empty_iff_forall_not_mem]
  rintro x ⟨hx1, hx2⟩
  rw [Set.eq_empty_iff_forall_not_mem] at hoff
  exact hoff x ⟨hx1, step2 hx2⟩

name: fragsAOf_pairwise
statement:
theorem fragsAOf_pairwise {M₁ M₂ : Mesh} (h₁ : NoPlaneThroughOrigin M₁)

proof:
:= by

statement:
theorem fragsBOf_pairwise {M₁ M₂ : Mesh} (h₂ : NoPlaneThroughOrigin M₂)

name: keptNcA_provenance
statement:
theorem keptNcA_provenance {M₁ M₂ : Mesh} {f : Frag}
    (hf : f ∈ classify (splitCoplanar (fragsAOf M₁ M₂) (materialize M₂)).2
      (prepare (materialize M₂))) :
    ∃ i : ℕ, ∃ hi : i < M₁.size,
      f ∈ clipFaceScoped (fragOfFace ((materialize M₁).getD i default))
        (planesForScoped ((materialize M₁).getD i default).plane (materialize M₂)
          ((candP M₁ M₂).getD i #[]))
      ∧ f.plane = (faceSOf (M₁[i]'hi)).plane
      ∧ isCoplanarWith f (materialize M₂) = false
proof:
:= by
  rw [mem_classify] at hf
  obtain ⟨hmem, -⟩ := hf
  rw [splitCoplanar] at hmem
  simp only at hmem
  obtain ⟨hmemF, hnc⟩ := Array.mem_filter.mp hmem
  rw [fragsAOf] at hmemF
  obtain ⟨i, hi, hfi⟩ := mem_flatMap_arr.mp hmemF
  rw [Array.mem_def, Array.toList_range, List.mem_range] at hi
  have hiM : i < M₁.size := by rwa [materialize_size] at hi
  refine ⟨i, hiM, hfi, ?_, by simpa using hnc⟩
  rw [clipFaceScoped_plane _ _ hfi]
  have hiMz : i < (materialize M₁).size := by rwa [materialize_size]
  rw [arr_getD _ _ _ hiMz, materialize_getElem M₁ i hiM]
  rfl

name: keptNcB_provenance
statement:
theorem keptNcB_provenance {M₁ M₂ : Mesh} {f : Frag}
    (hf : f ∈ classify (splitCoplanar (fragsBOf M₁ M₂) (materialize M₁)).2
      (prepare (materialize M₁))) :
    ∃ j : ℕ, ∃ hj : j < M₂.size,
      f ∈ clipFaceScoped (fragOfFace ((materialize M₂).getD j default))
        (planesForScoped ((materialize M₂).getD j default).plane (materialize M₁)
          ((candP M₂ M₁).getD j #[]))
      ∧ f.plane = (faceSOf (M₂[j]'hj)).plane
      ∧ isCoplanarWith f (materialize M₁) = false
proof:
:= by
  rw [mem_classify] at hf
  obtain ⟨hmem, -⟩ := hf
  rw [splitCoplanar] at hmem
  simp only at hmem
  obtain ⟨hmemF, hnc⟩ := Array.mem_filter.mp hmem
  rw [fragsBOf] at hmemF
  obtain ⟨j, hj, hfj⟩ := mem_flatMap_arr.mp hmemF
  rw [Array.mem_def, Array.toList_range, List.mem_range] at hj
  have hjM : j < M₂.size := by rwa [materialize_size] at hj
  refine ⟨j, hjM, hfj, ?_, by simpa using hnc⟩
  rw [clipFaceScoped_plane _ _ hfj]
  have hjMz : j < (materialize M₂).size := by rwa [materialize_size]
  rw [arr_getD _ _ _ hjMz, materialize_getElem M₂ j hjM]
  rfl

name: copA_provenance
statement:
theorem copA_provenance {M₁ M₂ : Mesh} {fa : Frag}
    (hfa : fa ∈ (splitCoplanar (fragsAOf M₁ M₂) (materialize M₂)).1) :
    ∃ i : ℕ, ∃ hi : i < M₁.size,
      fa ∈ clipFaceScoped (fragOfFace ((materialize M₁).getD i default))
        (planesForScoped ((materialize M₁).getD i default).plane (materialize M₂)
          ((candP M₁ M₂).getD i #[]))
      ∧ fa.plane = (faceSOf (M₁[i]'hi)).plane
      ∧ isCoplanarWith fa (materialize M₂) = true
proof:
:= by
  rw [splitCoplanar] at hfa
  simp only at hfa
  obtain ⟨hmemF, hcop⟩ := Array.mem_filter.mp hfa
  rw [fragsAOf] at hmemF
  obtain ⟨i, hi, hfi⟩ := mem_flatMap_arr.mp hmemF
  rw [Array.mem_def, Array.toList_range, List.mem_range] at hi
  have hiM : i < M₁.size := by rwa [materialize_size] at hi
  refine ⟨i, hiM, hfi, ?_, by simpa using hcop⟩
  rw [clipFaceScoped_plane _ _ hfi]
  have hiMz : i < (materialize M₁).size := by rwa [materialize_size]
  rw [arr_getD _ _ _ hiMz, materialize_getElem M₁ i hiM]
  rfl

name: copB_provenance
statement:
theorem copB_provenance {M₁ M₂ : Mesh} {fb : Frag}
    (hfb : fb ∈ (splitCoplanar (fragsBOf M₁ M₂) (materialize M₁)).1) :
    ∃ j : ℕ, ∃ hj : j < M₂.size,
      fb ∈ clipFaceScoped (fragOfFace ((materialize M₂).getD j default))
        (planesForScoped ((materialize M₂).getD j default).plane (materialize M₁)
          ((candP M₂ M₁).getD j #[]))
      ∧ fb.plane = (faceSOf (M₂[j]'hj)).plane
      ∧ isCoplanarWith fb (materialize M₁) = true
proof:
:= by
  rw [splitCoplanar] at hfb
  simp only at hfb
  obtain ⟨hmemF, hcop⟩ := Array.mem_filter.mp hfb
  rw [fragsBOf] at hmemF
  obtain ⟨j, hj, hfj⟩ := mem_flatMap_arr.mp hmemF
  rw [Array.mem_def, Array.toList_range, List.mem_range] at hj
  have hjM : j < M₂.size := by rwa [materialize_size] at hj
  refine ⟨j, hjM, hfj, ?_, by simpa using hcop⟩
  rw [clipFaceScoped_plane _ _ hfj]
  have hjMz : j < (materialize M₂).size := by rwa [materialize_size]
  rw [arr_getD _ _ _ hjMz, materialize_getElem M₂ j hjM]
  rfl

name: vrelint_descent_of_vpoly_subset
statement:
theorem vrelint_descent_of_vpoly_subset {nt : Point} {ct : ℚ} {g b : Frag}
    (hg : FragInv nt ct g) (hb : FragInv nt ct b)
    (hsub : vpoly (fragCycle b) ⊆ vpoly (fragCycle g)) :
    vrelint (fragCycle b) ⊆ vrelint (fragCycle g)
proof:
:= by
  haveI := hg.neZero
  haveI := hb.neZero
  refine vrelint_mono hb.size3 hg.size3 hb.onPlane hb.strictConv
    hg.onPlane hg.strictConv (fun j => ?_)
  exact hsub (subset_convexHull ℚ _ (Set.mem_range_self j))

name: crossSep_descent
statement:
theorem crossSep_descent {g₁ g₂ b₁ b₂ : Frag} (hg : CrossSep g₁ g₂)
    (hr₁ : vrelint (fragCycle b₁) ⊆ vrelint (fragCycle g₁))
    (hv₁ : vpoly (fragCycle b₁) ⊆ vpoly (fragCycle g₁))
    (hr₂ : vrelint (fragCycle b₂) ⊆ vrelint (fragCycle g₂))
    (hv₂ : vpoly (fragCycle b₂) ⊆ vpoly (fragCycle g₂)) :
    CrossSep b₁ b₂
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨h1, h2⟩ := hg
  constructor
  · rw [Set.eq_empty_iff_forall_not_mem]
    rintro x ⟨hx1, hx2⟩
    rw [Set.eq_empty_iff_forall_not_mem] at h1
    exact h1 x ⟨hr₁ hx1, hv₂ hx2⟩
  · rw [Set.eq_empty_iff_forall_not_mem]
    rintro x ⟨hx1, hx2⟩
    rw [Set.eq_empty_iff_forall_not_mem] at h2
    exact h2 x ⟨hr₂ hx1, hv₁ hx2⟩

name: keptCop_provenance
statement:
theorem keptCop_provenance {M₁ M₂ : Mesh} (h₁ : NoPlaneThroughOrigin M₁)
    (h₂ : NoPlaneThroughOrigin M₂) {b : Frag}
    (hb : b ∈ resolveCoplanar (faceBVH (prepare (materialize M₂)))
      (faceBVH (prepare (materialize M₁)))
      (splitCoplanar (fragsAOf M₁ M₂) (materialize M₂)).1
      (splitCoplanar (fragsBOf M₁ M₂) (materialize M₁)).1
      (prepare (materialize M₂)) (prepare (materialize M₁))) :
    ∃ (M : Mesh) (k : ℕ) (hk : k < M.size) (g : Frag),
      ((M = M₁ ∧ isCoplanarWith g (materialize M₂) = true
          ∧ g ∈ clipFaceScoped (fragOfFace ((materialize M₁).getD k default))
              (planesForScoped ((materialize M₁).getD k default).plane (materialize M₂)
                ((candP M₁ M₂).getD k #[])))
        ∨ (M = M₂ ∧ isCoplanarWith g (materialize M₁) = true
          ∧ g ∈ clipFaceScoped (fragOfFace ((materialize M₂).getD k default))
              (planesForScoped ((materialize M₂).getD k default).plane (materialize M₁)
                ((candP M₂ M₁).getD k #[]))))
      ∧ detOrigin (M[k]'hk) ≠ 0
      ∧ FragInv (carrierNormal (M[k]'hk)) (detOrigin (M[k]'hk)) b
      ∧ vpoly (fragCycle b) ⊆ triangleSet (M[k]'hk)
      ∧ vpoly (fragCycle b) ⊆ vpoly (fragCycle g)
      ∧ vrelint (fragCycle b) ⊆ vrelint (fragCycle g)
      ∧ g.plane = (faceSOf (M[k]'hk)).plane
proof:
:= by
  classical
  rcases mem_resolveCoplanar _ _ _ _ _ _ hb with ⟨fa, hfa, hpiece⟩ | ⟨fb, hfb, hpiece⟩
  · 
    unfold resolveFragNear at hpiece
    obtain ⟨i, hi, hfaclip, hfapl, hfacop⟩ := copA_provenance hfa
    have hdet : detOrigin (M₁[i]'hi) ≠ 0 := h₁ ⟨i, hi⟩
    
    have hiMz : i < (materialize M₁).size := by rwa [materialize_size]
    have hfaInv : FragInv (carrierNormal (M₁[i]'hi)) (detOrigin (M₁[i]'hi)) fa := by
      have hbase := fragInv_base hdet
      rw [arr_getD _ _ _ hiMz, materialize_getElem M₁ i hi] at hfaclip
      exact fragInv_clipFaceScoped hbase _ hfaclip
    
    have hbInv : FragInv (carrierNormal (M₁[i]'hi)) (detOrigin (M₁[i]'hi)) b :=
      resolveFrag_kept_fromFa _ _ _ hfaInv hpiece
    
    have hvsub : vpoly (fragCycle b) ⊆ vpoly (fragCycle fa) :=
      resolveFrag_kept_vpoly_subset_fa _ _ _ hfaInv hpiece
    have hfaT : vpoly (fragCycle fa) ⊆ triangleSet (M₁[i]'hi) := by
      have hbase := fragInv_base hdet
      rw [arr_getD _ _ _ hiMz, materialize_getElem M₁ i hi] at hfaclip
      refine (clipFaceScoped_vpoly_subset hbase _ hfaclip).trans ?_
      rw [vpoly_fragOfFace]
    
    have hrsub : vrelint (fragCycle b) ⊆ vrelint (fragCycle fa) :=
      vrelint_descent_of_vpoly_subset hfaInv hbInv hvsub
    exact ⟨M₁, i, hi, fa, Or.inl ⟨rfl, hfacop, hfaclip⟩, hdet, hbInv, hvsub.trans hfaT,
      hvsub, hrsub, hfapl⟩
  · 
    unfold resolveCoplanar.resolveFragBNear at hpiece
    obtain ⟨j, hj, hfbclip, hfbpl, hfbcop⟩ := copB_provenance hfb
    have hdet : detOrigin (M₂[j]'hj) ≠ 0 := h₂ ⟨j, hj⟩
    have hjMz : j < (materialize M₂).size := by rwa [materialize_size]
    have hfbInv : FragInv (carrierNormal (M₂[j]'hj)) (detOrigin (M₂[j]'hj)) fb := by
      have hbase := fragInv_base hdet
      rw [arr_getD _ _ _ hjMz, materialize_getElem M₂ j hj] at hfbclip
      exact fragInv_clipFaceScoped hbase _ hfbclip
    have hbInv : FragInv (carrierNormal (M₂[j]'hj)) (detOrigin (M₂[j]'hj)) b :=
      resolveFragB_kept_fromFb _ _ _ hfbInv hpiece
    have hvsub : vpoly (fragCycle b) ⊆ vpoly (fragCycle fb) :=
      resolveFragB_kept_vpoly_subset_fb _ _ _ hfbInv hpiece
    have hfbT : vpoly (fragCycle fb) ⊆ triangleSet (M₂[j]'hj) := by
      have hbase := fragInv_base hdet
      rw [arr_getD _ _ _ hjMz, materialize_getElem M₂ j hj] at hfbclip
      refine (clipFaceScoped_vpoly_subset hbase _ hfbclip).trans ?_
      rw [vpoly_fragOfFace]
    have hrsub : vrelint (fragCycle b) ⊆ vrelint (fragCycle fb) :=
      vrelint_descent_of_vpoly_subset hfbInv hbInv hvsub
    exact ⟨M₂, j, hj, fb, Or.inr ⟨rfl, hfbcop, hfbclip⟩, hdet, hbInv, hvsub.trans hfbT,
      hvsub, hrsub, hfbpl⟩

name: crossSep_ncA_ncB
statement:
theorem crossSep_ncA_ncB {M₁ M₂ : Mesh} (h₁ : NoPlaneThroughOrigin M₁)
    (h₂ : NoPlaneThroughOrigin M₂) {f₁ f₂ : Frag}
    (hf₁ : f₁ ∈ classify (splitCoplanar (fragsAOf M₁ M₂) (materialize M₂)).2
      (prepare (materialize M₂)))
    (hf₂ : f₂ ∈ classify (splitCoplanar (fragsBOf M₁ M₂) (materialize M₁)).2
      (prepare (materialize M₁))) :
    CrossSep f₁ f₂
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨i, hi, hm₁, hpl₁, hnc₁⟩ := keptNcA_provenance hf₁
  obtain ⟨j, hj, hm₂, hpl₂, hnc₂⟩ := keptNcB_provenance hf₂
  
  have hcopAB : coplanarPlane (faceSOf (M₁[i]'hi)).plane (faceSOf (M₂[j]'hj)).plane
      = false := ncBucket_transverse hi hpl₁ hnc₁ hj
  have hcopBA : coplanarPlane (faceSOf (M₂[j]'hj)).plane (faceSOf (M₁[i]'hi)).plane
      = false := ncBucket_transverse hj hpl₂ hnc₂ hi
  exact ⟨crossStage_half_gen 1 h₁ h₂ hi hj hm₁ hm₂ hcopAB,
    crossStage_half_gen 2 h₂ h₁ hj hi hm₂ hm₁ hcopBA⟩

name: coplanarPlane_symm
statement:
theorem coplanarPlane_symm (g h : IPlane) :
    coplanarPlane g h = coplanarPlane h g
proof:
:= by
  rw [Bool.eq_iff_iff, Proof.MeshIntersectPrim.coplanarPlane_eq_true_iff,
    Proof.MeshIntersectPrim.coplanarPlane_eq_true_iff, eq_comm]

name: isCoplanarWith_congr_plane
statement:
theorem isCoplanarWith_congr_plane {f f' : Frag} (h : f.plane = f'.plane)
    (B : Array FaceS) : isCoplanarWith f B = isCoplanarWith f' B
proof:
:= by
  unfold isCoplanarWith; rw [h]

name: crossHalf_nc_g_diff
statement:
theorem crossHalf_nc_g_diff {MA MB : Mesh} (meshIdA : Nat)
    (hA : NoPlaneThroughOrigin MA) (hB : NoPlaneThroughOrigin MB)
    {ia : ℕ} (hia : ia < MA.size) {a : Frag}
    (hma : a ∈ clipFaceScoped (fragOfFace ((materialize MA).getD ia default))
      (planesForScoped ((materialize MA).getD ia default).plane (materialize MB)
        ((candP MA MB).getD ia #[])))
    (hapl : a.plane = (faceSOf (MA[ia]'hia)).plane)
    (hanc : isCoplanarWith a (materialize MB) = false)
    {k : ℕ} (hk : k < MB.size) {g : Frag} {L : Array (IPlane × Box3)}
    (hmg : g ∈ clipFaceScoped (fragOfFace ((materialize MB).getD k default)) L) :
    vrelint (fragCycle a) ∩ vpoly (fragCycle g) = ∅
proof:
:= by
  have hcop : coplanarPlane (faceSOf (MA[ia]'hia)).plane (faceSOf (MB[k]'hk)).plane
      = false := ncBucket_transverse hia hapl hanc hk
  exact crossStage_half_gen meshIdA hA hB hia hk hma hmg hcop

name: crossSep_ncA_cop
statement:
theorem crossSep_ncA_cop {M₁ M₂ : Mesh} (h₁ : NoPlaneThroughOrigin M₁)
    (h₂ : NoPlaneThroughOrigin M₂) (hns₁ : NoFaceInteriorContact M₁) {a b : Frag}
    (ha : a ∈ classify (splitCoplanar (fragsAOf M₁ M₂) (materialize M₂)).2
      (prepare (materialize M₂)))
    (hb : b ∈ resolveCoplanar (faceBVH (prepare (materialize M₂)))
      (faceBVH (prepare (materialize M₁)))
      (splitCoplanar (fragsAOf M₁ M₂) (materialize M₂)).1
      (splitCoplanar (fragsBOf M₁ M₂) (materialize M₁)).1
      (prepare (materialize M₂)) (prepare (materialize M₁))) :
    CrossSep a b
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨ia, hia, hma, hapl, hanc⟩ := keptNcA_provenance ha
  obtain ⟨M, k, hk, g, hbucket, hdet, hbInv, hbT, hbvg, hbrg, hgpl⟩ :=
    keptCop_provenance h₁ h₂ hb
  rcases hbucket with ⟨rfl, hgcop, hgclip⟩ | ⟨rfl, hgcop, hgclip⟩
  · 
    have hne : ia ≠ k := by
      intro hik; subst hik
      
      have hga : g.plane = a.plane := by rw [hgpl, hapl]
      rw [isCoplanarWith_congr_plane hga] at hgcop
      rw [hgcop] at hanc; exact absurd hanc (by simp)
    constructor
    · 
      rw [Set.eq_empty_iff_forall_not_mem]
      rintro x ⟨hx1, hx2⟩
      have hsg := sameStage_half 1 h₁ hns₁ hia hk hne hma hgclip
      rw [Set.eq_empty_iff_forall_not_mem] at hsg
      exact hsg x ⟨hx1, hbvg hx2⟩
    · 
      rw [Set.eq_empty_iff_forall_not_mem]
      rintro x ⟨hx1, hx2⟩
      have hsg := sameStage_half 1 h₁ hns₁ hk hia hne.symm hgclip hma
      rw [Set.eq_empty_iff_forall_not_mem] at hsg
      exact hsg x ⟨hbrg hx1, hx2⟩
  · 
    constructor
    · 
      rw [Set.eq_empty_iff_forall_not_mem]
      rintro x ⟨hx1, hx2⟩
      have hoff := crossHalf_nc_g_diff 1 h₁ h₂ hia hma hapl hanc hk hgclip
      rw [Set.eq_empty_iff_forall_not_mem] at hoff
      exact hoff x ⟨hx1, hbvg hx2⟩
    · 
      rw [Set.eq_empty_iff_forall_not_mem]
      rintro x ⟨hx1, hx2⟩
      have hcop : coplanarPlane (faceSOf (M[k]'hk)).plane (faceSOf (M₁[ia]'hia)).plane
          = false := by
        rw [coplanarPlane_symm]
        exact ncBucket_transverse hia hapl hanc hk
      have hoff := crossStage_half_gen 2 h₂ h₁ hk hia hgclip hma hcop
      rw [Set.eq_empty_iff_forall_not_mem] at hoff
      exact hoff x ⟨hbrg hx1, hx2⟩

name: crossSep_ncB_cop
statement:
theorem crossSep_ncB_cop {M₁ M₂ : Mesh} (h₁ : NoPlaneThroughOrigin M₁)
    (h₂ : NoPlaneThroughOrigin M₂) (hns₂ : NoFaceInteriorContact M₂) {a b : Frag}
    (ha : a ∈ classify (splitCoplanar (fragsBOf M₁ M₂) (materialize M₁)).2
      (prepare (materialize M₁)))
    (hb : b ∈ resolveCoplanar (faceBVH (prepare (materialize M₂)))
      (faceBVH (prepare (materialize M₁)))
      (splitCoplanar (fragsAOf M₁ M₂) (materialize M₂)).1
      (splitCoplanar (fragsBOf M₁ M₂) (materialize M₁)).1
      (prepare (materialize M₂)) (prepare (materialize M₁))) :
    CrossSep a b
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨ia, hia, hma, hapl, hanc⟩ := keptNcB_provenance ha
  obtain ⟨M, k, hk, g, hbucket, hdet, hbInv, hbT, hbvg, hbrg, hgpl⟩ :=
    keptCop_provenance h₁ h₂ hb
  rcases hbucket with ⟨rfl, hgcop, hgclip⟩ | ⟨rfl, hgcop, hgclip⟩
  · 
    constructor
    · 
      rw [Set.eq_empty_iff_forall_not_mem]
      rintro x ⟨hx1, hx2⟩
      have hoff := crossHalf_nc_g_diff 2 h₂ h₁ hia hma hapl hanc hk hgclip
      rw [Set.eq_empty_iff_forall_not_mem] at hoff
      exact hoff x ⟨hx1, hbvg hx2⟩
    · 
      rw [Set.eq_empty_iff_forall_not_mem]
      rintro x ⟨hx1, hx2⟩
      have hcop : coplanarPlane (faceSOf (M[k]'hk)).plane (faceSOf (M₂[ia]'hia)).plane
          = false := by
        rw [coplanarPlane_symm]
        exact ncBucket_transverse hia hapl hanc hk
      have hoff := crossStage_half_gen 1 h₁ h₂ hk hia hgclip hma hcop
      rw [Set.eq_empty_iff_forall_not_mem] at hoff
      exact hoff x ⟨hbrg hx1, hx2⟩
  · 
    have hne : ia ≠ k := by
      intro hik; subst hik
      have hga : g.plane = a.plane := by rw [hgpl, hapl]
      rw [isCoplanarWith_congr_plane hga] at hgcop
      rw [hgcop] at hanc; exact absurd hanc (by simp)
    constructor
    · 
      rw [Set.eq_empty_iff_forall_not_mem]
      rintro x ⟨hx1, hx2⟩
      have hsg := sameStage_half 2 h₂ hns₂ hia hk hne hma hgclip
      rw [Set.eq_empty_iff_forall_not_mem] at hsg
      exact hsg x ⟨hx1, hbvg hx2⟩
    · 
      rw [Set.eq_empty_iff_forall_not_mem]
      rintro x ⟨hx1, hx2⟩
      have hsg := sameStage_half 2 h₂ hns₂ hk hia hne.symm hgclip hma
      rw [Set.eq_empty_iff_forall_not_mem] at hsg
      exact hsg x ⟨hbrg hx1, hx2⟩

name: keptGen_eq_buckets
statement:
theorem keptGen_eq_buckets (M₁ M₂ : Mesh) :
    keptGen M₁ M₂
      = (classify (splitCoplanar (fragsAOf M₁ M₂) (materialize M₂)).2
            (prepare (materialize M₂))
          ++ classify (splitCoplanar (fragsBOf M₁ M₂) (materialize M₁)).2

        ++ resolveCoplanar (faceBVH (prepare (materialize M₂)))
            (faceBVH (prepare (materialize M₁)))

            (splitCoplanar (fragsBOf M₁ M₂) (materialize M₁)).1
            (prepare (materialize M₂)) (prepare (materialize M₁))

  rfl

name: keptNcA_sublist
statement:
theorem keptNcA_sublist (M₁ M₂ : Mesh) :
    (classify (splitCoplanar (fragsAOf M₁ M₂) (materialize M₂)).2
      (prepare (materialize M₂))).toList.Sublist (fragsAOf M₁ M₂).toList
proof:
:= by
  have h1 : (classify (splitCoplanar (fragsAOf M₁ M₂) (materialize M₂)).2
        (prepare (materialize M₂))).toList.Sublist
      (splitCoplanar (fragsAOf M₁ M₂) (materialize M₂)).2.toList := by
    rw [classify, Array.toList_filter]; exact List.filter_sublist _
  have h2 : (splitCoplanar (fragsAOf M₁ M₂) (materialize M₂)).2.toList.Sublist
      (fragsAOf M₁ M₂).toList := by
    rw [splitCoplanar]; simp only; rw [Array.toList_filter]; exact List.filter_sublist _

statement:

proof:

        (prepare (materialize M₁))).toList.Sublist
      (splitCoplanar (fragsBOf M₁ M₂) (materialize M₁)).2.toList := by

name: copA_carrier
statement:
theorem copA_carrier {M₁ M₂ : Mesh} (h₁ : NoPlaneThroughOrigin M₁)
    {fa : Frag} (hfa : fa ∈ (splitCoplanar (fragsAOf M₁ M₂) (materialize M₂)).1) :
    ∃ (i : ℕ) (hi : i < M₁.size),
      FragInv (carrierNormal (M₁[i]'hi)) (detOrigin (M₁[i]'hi)) fa
      ∧ detOrigin (M₁[i]'hi) ≠ 0 ∧ fa.plane = (faceSOf (M₁[i]'hi)).plane
      ∧ fa ∈ clipFaceScoped (fragOfFace ((materialize M₁).getD i default))
          (planesForScoped ((materialize M₁).getD i default).plane (materialize M₂)
            ((candP M₁ M₂).getD i #[]))
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨i, hi, hfaclip, hfapl, -⟩ := copA_provenance hfa
  have hdet : detOrigin (M₁[i]'hi) ≠ 0 := h₁ ⟨i, hi⟩
  have hiMz : i < (materialize M₁).size := by rwa [materialize_size]
  have hfaInv : FragInv (carrierNormal (M₁[i]'hi)) (detOrigin (M₁[i]'hi)) fa := by
    have hbase := fragInv_base hdet
    rw [arr_getD _ _ _ hiMz, materialize_getElem M₁ i hi] at hfaclip
    exact fragInv_clipFaceScoped hbase _ hfaclip
  exact ⟨i, hi, hfaInv, hdet, hfapl, hfaclip⟩

name: copB_carrier
statement:
theorem copB_carrier {M₁ M₂ : Mesh} (h₂ : NoPlaneThroughOrigin M₂)
    {fb : Frag} (hfb : fb ∈ (splitCoplanar (fragsBOf M₁ M₂) (materialize M₁)).1) :
    ∃ (j : ℕ) (hj : j < M₂.size),
      FragInv (carrierNormal (M₂[j]'hj)) (detOrigin (M₂[j]'hj)) fb
      ∧ detOrigin (M₂[j]'hj) ≠ 0 ∧ fb.plane = (faceSOf (M₂[j]'hj)).plane
      ∧ fb ∈ clipFaceScoped (fragOfFace ((materialize M₂).getD j default))
          (planesForScoped ((materialize M₂).getD j default).plane (materialize M₁)
            ((candP M₂ M₁).getD j #[]))
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨j, hj, hfbclip, hfbpl, -⟩ := copB_provenance hfb
  have hdet : detOrigin (M₂[j]'hj) ≠ 0 := h₂ ⟨j, hj⟩
  have hjMz : j < (materialize M₂).size := by rwa [materialize_size]
  have hfbInv : FragInv (carrierNormal (M₂[j]'hj)) (detOrigin (M₂[j]'hj)) fb := by
    have hbase := fragInv_base hdet
    rw [arr_getD _ _ _ hjMz, materialize_getElem M₂ j hj] at hfbclip
    exact fragInv_clipFaceScoped hbase _ hfbclip
  exact ⟨j, hj, hfbInv, hdet, hfbpl, hfbclip⟩

name: resolveFrag_within_crossSep
statement:
private theorem resolveFrag_within_crossSep {nt : Point} {ct : ℚ} (bvh : Impl.BVH.BVH)
    (copB : Array Frag)
    (WB : Array PFace) {fa : Frag} (hfaInv : FragInv nt ct fa) :
    (resolveFrag bvh fa copB WB).toList.Pairwise CrossSep
proof:
:= by
  refine (resolveFrag_kept_pairwise bvh copB WB hfaInv).imp_of_mem ?_
  intro p p' hp hp' hd
  exact crossSep_of_relDisj (resolveFrag_kept_fromFa bvh copB WB hfaInv (Array.mem_def.mpr hp))
    (resolveFrag_kept_fromFa bvh copB WB hfaInv (Array.mem_def.mpr hp')) hd

name: resolveFragB_within_crossSep
statement:
private theorem resolveFragB_within_crossSep {nt : Point} {ct : ℚ} (bvh : Impl.BVH.BVH)
    (copA : Array Frag)
    (WA : Array PFace) {fb : Frag} (hfbInv : FragInv nt ct fb) :
    (resolveCoplanar.resolveFragB bvh fb copA WA).toList.Pairwise CrossSep
proof:
:= by
  refine (resolveFragB_kept_pairwise bvh copA WA hfbInv).imp_of_mem ?_
  intro p p' hp hp' hd
  exact crossSep_of_relDisj (resolveFragB_kept_fromFb bvh copA WA hfbInv (Array.mem_def.mpr hp))
    (resolveFragB_kept_fromFb bvh copA WA hfbInv (Array.mem_def.mpr hp')) hd

name: coplanar_carrier_prop
statement:
theorem coplanar_carrier_prop {u v : Triangle}
    (hdu : detOrigin u ≠ 0) (hdv : detOrigin v ≠ 0)
    (hcop : coplanarPlane (faceSOf u).plane (faceSOf v).plane = true) :
    ∃ ρ : ℚ, ρ ≠ 0 ∧ carrierNormal v = ρ • carrierNormal u ∧ detOrigin v = ρ * detOrigin u
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨mP, hmP, hPa, hPb, hPc, hPd⟩ := isMulOf_faceSOf_plane u
  obtain ⟨mQ, hmQ, hQa, hQb, hQc, hQd⟩ := isMulOf_faceSOf_plane v
  
  have hγu : Proof.MeshIntersectPrim.gamma (faceSOf u).plane ≠ 0 := by
    intro hz
    rw [Proof.MeshIntersectPrim.gamma_eq_zero_iff] at hz
    have h0 : ((faceSOf u).plane.d : ℚ) = 0 := by exact_mod_cast hz.2.2.2
    rw [hPd] at h0
    exact (mul_ne_zero (ne_of_gt hmP) hdu) h0
  have hγv : Proof.MeshIntersectPrim.gamma (faceSOf v).plane ≠ 0 := by
    intro hz
    rw [Proof.MeshIntersectPrim.gamma_eq_zero_iff] at hz
    have h0 : ((faceSOf v).plane.d : ℚ) = 0 := by exact_mod_cast hz.2.2.2
    rw [hQd] at h0
    exact (mul_ne_zero (ne_of_gt hmQ) hdv) h0
  rw [Proof.MeshIntersectPrim.coplanarPlane_iff_ratMul hγu hγv] at hcop
  have h4 := (Proof.MeshIntersectPrim.ratProp_iff_ratProp4_of_decomp
    (ne_of_gt hmP) (ne_of_gt hmQ) hPa hPb hPc hPd hQa hQb hQc hQd).mp hcop
  exact (Proof.MeshIntersectPrim.ratPropCarrier_iff_ratProp4
    (carrierNormal u) (carrierNormal v) (detOrigin u) (detOrigin v)).mpr h4

name: copA_sublist
proof:
:= by

name: keptCop_pairwise_crossSep
statement:
theorem keptCop_pairwise_crossSep {M₁ M₂ : Mesh} (h₁ : NoPlaneThroughOrigin M₁)
    (h₂ : NoPlaneThroughOrigin M₂) (hns₁ : NoFaceInteriorContact M₁)
    (hns₂ : NoFaceInteriorContact M₂) :
    (resolveCoplanar (faceBVH (prepare (materialize M₂)))
      (faceBVH (prepare (materialize M₁)))
      (splitCoplanar (fragsAOf M₁ M₂) (materialize M₂)).1
      (splitCoplanar (fragsBOf M₁ M₂) (materialize M₁)).1
      (prepare (materialize M₂)) (prepare (materialize M₁))).toList.Pairwise CrossSep
proof:
:= by
  classical
  set copA := (splitCoplanar (fragsAOf M₁ M₂) (materialize M₂)).1 with hcopA
  set copB := (splitCoplanar (fragsBOf M₁ M₂) (materialize M₁)).1 with hcopB
  set WB := prepare (materialize M₂) with hWB
  set WA := prepare (materialize M₁) with hWA
  
  rw [show resolveCoplanar (faceBVH WB) (faceBVH WA) copA copB WB WA
      = copA.flatMap (fun fa => resolveFragNear (copBVH copB) (faceBVH WB) copB fa WB)
        ++ copB.flatMap (fun fb =>
            resolveCoplanar.resolveFragBNear (copBVH copA) (faceBVH WA) copA fb WA) from rfl]
  rw [Array.toList_append, List.pairwise_append]
  refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · 
    rw [toList_flatMap_arr, List.pairwise_flatMap]
    refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
    · 
      intro fa hfa
      obtain ⟨i, hi, hfaInv, -, -, -⟩ := copA_carrier h₁ (Array.mem_def.mpr hfa)
      unfold resolveFragNear
      exact resolveFrag_within_crossSep (faceBVH WB) _ WB hfaInv
    · 
      refine ((fragsAOf_pairwise h₁ hns₁).sublist (copA_sublist M₁ M₂)).imp_of_mem ?_
      intro fa fa' hfa hfa' hcs p hp p' hp'
      obtain ⟨i, hi, hfaInv, -, -, -⟩ := copA_carrier h₁ (Array.mem_def.mpr hfa)
      obtain ⟨i', hi', hfa'Inv, -, -, -⟩ := copA_carrier h₁ (Array.mem_def.mpr hfa')
      unfold resolveFragNear at hp hp'
      refine crossSep_descent hcs ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_
      · exact vrelint_descent_of_vpoly_subset hfaInv
          (resolveFrag_kept_fromFa _ _ WB hfaInv (Array.mem_def.mpr hp))
          (resolveFrag_kept_vpoly_subset_fa _ _ WB hfaInv (Array.mem_def.mpr hp))
      · exact resolveFrag_kept_vpoly_subset_fa _ _ WB hfaInv (Array.mem_def.mpr hp)
      · exact vrelint_descent_of_vpoly_subset hfa'Inv
          (resolveFrag_kept_fromFa _ _ WB hfa'Inv (Array.mem_def.mpr hp'))
          (resolveFrag_kept_vpoly_subset_fa _ _ WB hfa'Inv (Array.mem_def.mpr hp'))
      · exact resolveFrag_kept_vpoly_subset_fa _ _ WB hfa'Inv (Array.mem_def.mpr hp')
  · 
    rw [toList_flatMap_arr, List.pairwise_flatMap]
    refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
    · intro fb hfb
      obtain ⟨j, hj, hfbInv, -, -, -⟩ := copB_carrier h₂ (Array.mem_def.mpr hfb)
      unfold resolveCoplanar.resolveFragBNear
      exact resolveFragB_within_crossSep (faceBVH WA) _ WA hfbInv
    · refine ((fragsBOf_pairwise h₂ hns₂).sublist (copB_sublist M₁ M₂)).imp_of_mem ?_
      intro fb fb' hfb hfb' hcs p hp p' hp'
      obtain ⟨j, hj, hfbInv, -, -, -⟩ := copB_carrier h₂ (Array.mem_def.mpr hfb)
      obtain ⟨j', hj', hfb'Inv, -, -, -⟩ := copB_carrier h₂ (Array.mem_def.mpr hfb')
      unfold resolveCoplanar.resolveFragBNear at hp hp'
      refine crossSep_descent hcs ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_
      · exact vrelint_descent_of_vpoly_subset hfbInv
          (resolveFragB_kept_fromFb _ _ WA hfbInv (Array.mem_def.mpr hp))
          (resolveFragB_kept_vpoly_subset_fb _ _ WA hfbInv (Array.mem_def.mpr hp))
      · exact resolveFragB_kept_vpoly_subset_fb _ _ WA hfbInv (Array.mem_def.mpr hp)
      · exact vrelint_descent_of_vpoly_subset hfb'Inv
          (resolveFragB_kept_fromFb _ _ WA hfb'Inv (Array.mem_def.mpr hp'))
          (resolveFragB_kept_vpoly_subset_fb _ _ WA hfb'Inv (Array.mem_def.mpr hp'))
      · exact resolveFragB_kept_vpoly_subset_fb _ _ WA hfb'Inv (Array.mem_def.mpr hp')
  · 
    intro a ha b hb
    rw [Array.mem_toList, mem_flatMap_arr] at ha hb
    obtain ⟨fa, hfaA, hpa⟩ := ha
    obtain ⟨fb, hfbB, hpb⟩ := hb
    unfold resolveFragNear at hpa
    obtain ⟨i, hi, hfaInv, hdetA, hfapl, hfaclip⟩ := copA_carrier h₁ hfaA
    obtain ⟨j, hj, hfbInv, hdetB, hfbpl, hfbclip⟩ := copB_carrier h₂ hfbB
    
    
    
    
    have hoppCarrier : Proof.MeshIntersectResolveNear.OppCarrier
        (carrierNormal (M₂[j]'hj)) (detOrigin (M₂[j]'hj)) fb.plane copA := by
      intro fa' hfa'
      obtain ⟨i', hi', hfa'Inv, hdetA', hfa'pl, -⟩ := copA_carrier h₁ hfa'
      refine ⟨carrierNormal (M₁[i']'hi'), detOrigin (M₁[i']'hi'), hfa'Inv, fun hcop' => ?_⟩
      rw [hfbpl, hfa'pl] at hcop'
      obtain ⟨τ, hτ, hnτ, hcτ⟩ := coplanar_carrier_prop hdetB hdetA' hcop'
      exact ⟨τ, hτ, hnτ, hcτ⟩
    rw [Proof.MeshIntersectResolveNear.resolveFragBNear_eq _ _ _ _ hfbInv hoppCarrier] at hpb
    
    have haInv : FragInv (carrierNormal (M₁[i]'hi)) (detOrigin (M₁[i]'hi)) a :=
      resolveFrag_kept_fromFa _ _ WB hfaInv hpa
    have hbInv : FragInv (carrierNormal (M₂[j]'hj)) (detOrigin (M₂[j]'hj)) b :=
      resolveFragB_kept_fromFb _ _ WA hfbInv hpb
    have havp : vpoly (fragCycle a) ⊆ vpoly (fragCycle fa) :=
      resolveFrag_kept_vpoly_subset_fa _ _ WB hfaInv hpa
    have havr : vrelint (fragCycle a) ⊆ vrelint (fragCycle fa) :=
      vrelint_descent_of_vpoly_subset hfaInv haInv havp
    have hbvp : vpoly (fragCycle b) ⊆ vpoly (fragCycle fb) :=
      resolveFragB_kept_vpoly_subset_fb _ _ WA hfbInv hpb
    have hbvr : vrelint (fragCycle b) ⊆ vrelint (fragCycle fb) :=
      vrelint_descent_of_vpoly_subset hfbInv hbInv hbvp
    by_cases hcop : coplanarPlane (faceSOf (M₁[i]'hi)).plane (faceSOf (M₂[j]'hj)).plane = true
    · 
      
      obtain ⟨ρ, hρ, hnρ, hcρ⟩ := coplanar_carrier_prop hdetA hdetB hcop
      
      have hcopfb : coplanarPlane fb.plane fa.plane = true := by
        rw [hfbpl, hfapl, coplanarPlane_symm]; exact hcop
      have hoppInv : ∀ fa' ∈ copA, ∃ n' c', FragInv n' c' fa'
          ∧ (coplanarPlane fb.plane fa'.plane = true →
              ∃ σ : ℚ, σ ≠ 0 ∧ n' = σ • carrierNormal (M₂[j]'hj)
                ∧ c' = σ * detOrigin (M₂[j]'hj)) := by
        intro fa' hfa'
        obtain ⟨i', hi', hfa'Inv, hdetA', hfa'pl, -⟩ := copA_carrier h₁ hfa'
        refine ⟨carrierNormal (M₁[i']'hi'), detOrigin (M₁[i']'hi'), hfa'Inv, fun hcop' => ?_⟩
        
        have hcop'' : coplanarPlane (faceSOf (M₂[j]'hj)).plane (faceSOf (M₁[i']'hi')).plane
            = true := by rw [← hfbpl, ← hfa'pl]; exact hcop'
        obtain ⟨τ, hτ, hnτ, hcτ⟩ := coplanar_carrier_prop hdetB hdetA' hcop''
        exact ⟨τ, hτ, hnτ, hcτ⟩
      have hbfa : vrelint (fragCycle b) ∩ vrelint (fragCycle fa) = ∅ :=
        resolveFragB_kept_avoids _ copA WA hfbInv hoppInv hpb hfaA hcopfb
      
      have hd : RelDisj a b := by
        rw [RelDisj, Set.eq_empty_iff_forall_not_mem]
        rintro x ⟨hx1, hx2⟩
        rw [Set.eq_empty_iff_forall_not_mem] at hbfa
        exact hbfa x ⟨hx2, havr hx1⟩
      
      have hpl12 : OnPlane (carrierNormal (M₁[i]'hi)) (detOrigin (M₁[i]'hi)) (fragCycle b) := by
        intro k
        have := hbInv.onPlane k
        rw [hnρ, hcρ] at this
        rw [dotQ_smul_left] at this
        exact mul_left_cancel₀ hρ this
      have hpl21 : OnPlane (carrierNormal (M₂[j]'hj)) (detOrigin (M₂[j]'hj)) (fragCycle a) := by
        intro k
        rw [hnρ, hcρ, dotQ_smul_left, haInv.onPlane k]
      exact crossSep_of_relDisj_free haInv hbInv hpl12 hpl21 hd
    · 
      rw [Bool.not_eq_true] at hcop
      constructor
      · 
        rw [Set.eq_empty_iff_forall_not_mem]
        rintro x ⟨hx1, hx2⟩
        have hoff := crossStage_half_gen 1 h₁ h₂ hi hj hfaclip hfbclip hcop
        rw [Set.eq_empty_iff_forall_not_mem] at hoff
        exact hoff x ⟨havr hx1, hbvp hx2⟩
      · 
        rw [Set.eq_empty_iff_forall_not_mem]
        rintro x ⟨hx1, hx2⟩
        have hcop' : coplanarPlane (faceSOf (M₂[j]'hj)).plane (faceSOf (M₁[i]'hi)).plane
            = false := by rw [coplanarPlane_symm]; exact hcop
        have hoff := crossStage_half_gen 2 h₂ h₁ hj hi hfbclip hfaclip hcop'
        rw [Set.eq_empty_iff_forall_not_mem] at hoff
        exact hoff x ⟨hbvr hx1, havp hx2⟩

name: kept_pairwise_crossSep
statement:
theorem kept_pairwise_crossSep {M₁ M₂ : Mesh} (h₁ : NoPlaneThroughOrigin M₁)
    (h₂ : NoPlaneThroughOrigin M₂) (hns₁ : NoFaceInteriorContact M₁)
    (hns₂ : NoFaceInteriorContact M₂) :
    (keptGen M₁ M₂).toList.Pairwise CrossSep
proof:
:= by
  rw [keptGen_eq_buckets, Array.toList_append, List.pairwise_append]
  refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · 
    rw [Array.toList_append, List.pairwise_append]
    refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_⟩
    · 
      exact (fragsAOf_pairwise h₁ hns₁).sublist (keptNcA_sublist M₁ M₂)
    · 
      exact (fragsBOf_pairwise h₂ hns₂).sublist (keptNcB_sublist M₁ M₂)
    · 
      intro a ha b hb
      exact crossSep_ncA_ncB h₁ h₂ (Array.mem_def.mpr ha) (Array.mem_def.mpr hb)
  · 
    exact keptCop_pairwise_crossSep h₁ h₂ hns₁ hns₂
  · 
    intro a ha b hb
    rw [Array.toList_append, List.mem_append] at ha
    have hb' : b ∈ resolveCoplanar (faceBVH (prepare (materialize M₂)))
        (faceBVH (prepare (materialize M₁)))
        (splitCoplanar (fragsAOf M₁ M₂) (materialize M₂)).1
        (splitCoplanar (fragsBOf M₁ M₂) (materialize M₁)).1
        (prepare (materialize M₂)) (prepare (materialize M₁)) := Array.mem_def.mpr hb
    rcases ha with ha | ha
    · exact crossSep_ncA_cop h₁ h₂ hns₁ (Array.mem_def.mpr ha) hb'
    · exact crossSep_ncB_cop h₁ h₂ hns₂ (Array.mem_def.mpr ha) hb'

name: out_pairwise_gen
statement:
theorem out_pairwise_gen {M₁ M₂ : Mesh} (h₁ : NoPlaneThroughOrigin M₁)
    (h₂ : NoPlaneThroughOrigin M₂) (hns₁ : NoFaceInteriorContact M₁)
    (hns₂ : NoFaceInteriorContact M₂)
    (hg₁ : Proof.MeshIntersectNpo.GenWF M₁) (hg₂ : Proof.MeshIntersectNpo.GenWF M₂) :
    (meshIntersect M₁ M₂).toList.Pairwise TriRel
proof:
:= by
  classical
  rw [meshIntersect_eq M₁ M₂ hg₁ hg₂, toList_flatMap_arr, Array.toList_map]
  rw [show (((keptGen M₁ M₂).toList.map (atomizeFrag (vsGen M₁ M₂))).flatMap
        (fun g => (emitFrag g).toList))
      = (((keptGen M₁ M₂).toList.map (atomizeFrag (vsGen M₁ M₂))).map
        (fun g => (emitFrag g).toList)).flatten from rfl]
  rw [List.map_map, List.pairwise_flatten]
  constructor
  · 
    intro l hl
    rw [List.mem_map] at hl
    obtain ⟨f, hf, rfl⟩ := hl
    exact (keptGen_emitPackage h₁ h₂ (Array.mem_def.mpr hf)).1
  · 
    rw [List.pairwise_map]
    refine (kept_pairwise_crossSep h₁ h₂ hns₁ hns₂).imp_of_mem ?_
    intro f₁ f₂ hf₁ hf₂ hcs t₁ ht₁ t₂ ht₂
    obtain ⟨-, hpkg₁⟩ := keptGen_emitPackage h₁ h₂ (Array.mem_def.mpr hf₁)
    obtain ⟨-, hpkg₂⟩ := keptGen_emitPackage h₁ h₂ (Array.mem_def.mpr hf₂)
    obtain ⟨hsub₁, hsep₁⟩ := hpkg₁ t₁ ht₁
    obtain ⟨hsub₂, hsep₂⟩ := hpkg₂ t₂ ht₂
    have hS₁ : vrelint (fragCycle f₁) ∩ triangleSet t₂ = ∅ := by
      rw [Set.eq_empty_iff_forall_not_mem]
      rintro x ⟨hx1, hx2⟩
      exact (Set.eq_empty_iff_forall_not_mem.mp hcs.1) x ⟨hx1, hsub₂ hx2⟩
    have hS₂ : vrelint (fragCycle f₂) ∩ triangleSet t₁ = ∅ := by
      rw [Set.eq_empty_iff_forall_not_mem]
      rintro x ⟨hx1, hx2⟩
      exact (Set.eq_empty_iff_forall_not_mem.mp hcs.2) x ⟨hx1, hsub₁ hx2⟩
    exact fun x hx =>
      ⟨hsep₁ _ hS₁ hx, hsep₂ _ hS₂ ⟨hx.2, hx.1⟩⟩

name: meshIntersect_noSelfIntersection
statement:
theorem meshIntersect_noSelfIntersection (M₁ M₂ : Mesh)
    (h₁ : Legacy.WellFormedMesh M₁) (h₂ : Legacy.WellFormedMesh M₂) :

proof:

  noSelf_of_pairwise_triRel
    (out_pairwise_gen h₁.2.2.2 h₂.2.2.2 h₁.2.2.1 h₂.2.2.1
      (Proof.MeshIntersectNpo.GenWF.of_legacy h₁) (Proof.MeshIntersectNpo.GenWF.of_legacy h₂))

name: one_smul_pt
statement: private theorem one_smul_pt (Q : Point) : (1 : ℚ) • Q = Q
proof: := one_smul ℚ Q

name: winding_eq_stepSum_one
statement:
theorem winding_eq_stepSum_one (M : Mesh) (hM : NoPlaneThroughOrigin M)
    {Q : Point} (hQ : ∀ j : Fin M.size, dotQ (carrierNormal M[j]) Q ≠ 0) :
    winding (meshChain M) Q = stepSum (meshSteps M Q) 1
proof:
:= by
  have h := winding_radial_step M hM hQ (μ := 1) (by norm_num)
  rwa [one_smul_pt] at h

name: emit_face_spec_gen_prov
statement:
theorem emit_face_spec_gen_prov (M₁ M₂ : Mesh)
    (h₁ : NoPlaneThroughOrigin M₁) (h₂ : NoPlaneThroughOrigin M₂)
    (hg₁ : Proof.MeshIntersectNpo.GenWF M₁) (hg₂ : Proof.MeshIntersectNpo.GenWF M₂)
    {τ : Triangle} (hτ : τ ∈ meshIntersect M₁ M₂) :
    ∃ (M : Mesh) (i : ℕ) (hi : i < M.size),
      (M = M₁ ∨ M = M₂)
      ∧ detOrigin (M[i]'hi) ≠ 0
      ∧ dotQ (carrierNormal (M[i]'hi)) τ.v₀ = detOrigin (M[i]'hi)
      ∧ dotQ (carrierNormal (M[i]'hi)) τ.v₁ = detOrigin (M[i]'hi)
      ∧ dotQ (carrierNormal (M[i]'hi)) τ.v₂ = detOrigin (M[i]'hi)
      ∧ 0 < dotQ (carrierNormal (M[i]'hi))
          (crossQ (τ.v₁ - τ.v₀) (τ.v₂ - τ.v₀))
proof:
:= by
  rw [Proof.MeshIntersectNpo.meshIntersect_eq M₁ M₂ hg₁ hg₂] at hτ
  obtain ⟨g, hg, hτg⟩ := mem_flatMap_arr.mp hτ
  rw [Array.mem_map] at hg
  obtain ⟨f, hfk, rfl⟩ := hg
  obtain ⟨M, i, hi, hMmem, hdet, hinv⟩ :=
    Proof.MeshIntersectNpo.kept_fragInv h₁ h₂ hfk
  obtain ⟨hvs, hnd⟩ := Proof.MeshIntersectNpo.vsGen_facts h₁ h₂
  obtain ⟨hm, hshape⟩ :=
    atomize_refShape hinv (Proof.MeshIntersectNpo.vsGen M₁ M₂) hvs hnd
  haveI instr : NeZero f.poly.size := hinv.neZero
  haveI instm : NeZero (atomizeFrag (Proof.MeshIntersectNpo.vsGen M₁ M₂) f).poly.size :=
    ⟨by have := hm; omega⟩
  exact ⟨M, i, hi, hMmem, hdet,
    Proof.MeshIntersectNpo.emit_facts_gen hinv.size3 hm hinv.onPlane hinv.strictConv
      hshape.toRefShape hτg⟩

name: out_carrier_ne_of_mem
statement:
theorem out_carrier_ne_of_mem (M₁ M₂ : Mesh)
    (h₁ : NoPlaneThroughOrigin M₁) (h₂ : NoPlaneThroughOrigin M₂)
    (hg₁ : Proof.MeshIntersectNpo.GenWF M₁) (hg₂ : Proof.MeshIntersectNpo.GenWF M₂)
    {Q : Point} (hG : Gen M₁ M₂ Q)
    {τ : Triangle} (hτ : τ ∈ meshIntersect M₁ M₂) :
    dotQ (carrierNormal τ) Q ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  classical
  obtain ⟨M, i, hi, hMmem, hdet, hp, hq, hr, hA⟩ :=
    emit_face_spec_gen_prov M₁ M₂ h₁ h₂ hg₁ hg₂ hτ
  
  set n := carrierNormal (M[i]'hi) with hn
  have hcarτ : crossQ (τ.v₁ - τ.v₀) (τ.v₂ - τ.v₀) = carrierNormal τ := rfl
  have hpar : dotQ n n • carrierNormal τ = dotQ n (carrierNormal τ) • n := by
    have h := cross_parallel_normal (n := n) (p := τ.v₀) (q := τ.v₁) (r := τ.v₂) hp hq hr
    rwa [hcarτ] at h
  
  have hAτ : 0 < dotQ n (carrierNormal τ) := by rw [← hcarτ]; exact hA
  have hnn : 0 < dotQ n n := dotQ_self_pos (carrierNormal_ne_zero hdet)
  
  have hnQ : dotQ n Q ≠ 0 := by
    rcases hMmem with rfl | rfl
    · exact hG.1 ⟨i, hi⟩
    · exact hG.2.1 ⟨i, hi⟩
  
  have hsl : ∀ (a : ℚ) (u : Point), dotQ (a • u) Q = a * dotQ u Q := by
    intro a u; rw [dotQ_comm, dotQ_smul_right, dotQ_comm]
  have hkey : dotQ n n * dotQ (carrierNormal τ) Q = dotQ n (carrierNormal τ) * dotQ n Q := by
    have hc := congrArg (fun w => dotQ w Q) hpar
    simp only [hsl] at hc
    exact hc
  intro h0
  rw [h0, mul_zero] at hkey
  exact (mul_ne_zero (ne_of_gt hAτ) hnQ) hkey.symm

name: winding_gen_eq_bucket
statement:
theorem winding_gen_eq_bucket (M₁ M₂ : Mesh) (hg₁ : Proof.MeshIntersectNpo.GenWF M₁) (hg₂ : Proof.MeshIntersectNpo.GenWF M₂) (Q : Point) :
    winding (meshChain (meshIntersect M₁ M₂)) Q
      = bucketWinding M₁ M₂ (Proof.MeshIntersectNpo.keptGen M₁ M₂) Q
proof:
:= by
  rw [Proof.MeshIntersectNpo.meshIntersect_eq M₁ M₂ hg₁ hg₂, winding_meshChain_flatMap,
    Array.toList_map, List.map_map]
  rfl

name: bucketWinding_append
statement:
theorem bucketWinding_append (M₁ M₂ : Mesh) (K L : Array Frag) (Q : Point) :
    bucketWinding M₁ M₂ (K ++ L) Q
      = bucketWinding M₁ M₂ K Q + bucketWinding M₁ M₂ L Q
proof:
:= by

name: keptGen_eq_buckets
statement:
theorem keptGen_eq_buckets (M₁ M₂ : Mesh) :

      = (keptNcA M₁ M₂ ++ keptNcB M₁ M₂) ++ keptCop M₁ M₂
proof: := rfl

name: winding_gen_split
statement:
theorem winding_gen_split (M₁ M₂ : Mesh) (hg₁ : Proof.MeshIntersectNpo.GenWF M₁) (hg₂ : Proof.MeshIntersectNpo.GenWF M₂) (Q : Point) :
    winding (meshChain (meshIntersect M₁ M₂)) Q
      = (bucketWinding M₁ M₂ (keptNcA M₁ M₂) Q
          + bucketWinding M₁ M₂ (keptNcB M₁ M₂) Q)
        + bucketWinding M₁ M₂ (keptCop M₁ M₂) Q
proof:
:= by
  rw [winding_gen_eq_bucket M₁ M₂ hg₁ hg₂, keptGen_eq_buckets, bucketWinding_append,
    bucketWinding_append]

name: bucketWinding_keptCop_eq
statement:
theorem bucketWinding_keptCop_eq (M₁ M₂ : Mesh) (Q : Point) :
    bucketWinding M₁ M₂ (keptCop M₁ M₂) Q = winding (meshChain (outCop M₁ M₂)) Q

name: Tncop_eq_outNc
statement:
theorem Tncop_eq_outNc (M₁ M₂ : Mesh) (Q : Point) :

name: outCop_mem_meshIntersect
statement:
theorem outCop_mem_meshIntersect (M₁ M₂ : Mesh) (hg₁ : Proof.MeshIntersectNpo.GenWF M₁) (hg₂ : Proof.MeshIntersectNpo.GenWF M₂)
    {τ : Triangle} (hτ : τ ∈ outCop M₁ M₂) : τ ∈ meshIntersect M₁ M₂
proof:
:= by
  rw [outCop] at hτ
  rw [mem_flatMap_arr] at hτ
  obtain ⟨g, hg, hτg⟩ := hτ
  rw [Array.mem_map] at hg
  obtain ⟨f, hfk, rfl⟩ := hg
  rw [Proof.MeshIntersectNpo.meshIntersect_eq M₁ M₂ hg₁ hg₂, mem_flatMap_arr]
  refine ⟨atomizeFrag (Proof.MeshIntersectNpo.vsGen M₁ M₂) f, ?_, hτg⟩
  rw [Array.mem_map]
  refine ⟨f, ?_, rfl⟩
  rw [keptGen_eq_buckets, Array.mem_append]
  exact Or.inr hfk

name: outNc_mem_meshIntersect
statement:
theorem outNc_mem_meshIntersect (M₁ M₂ : Mesh) (hg₁ : Proof.MeshIntersectNpo.GenWF M₁) (hg₂ : Proof.MeshIntersectNpo.GenWF M₂)
    {τ : Triangle} (hτ : τ ∈ outNc M₁ M₂) : τ ∈ meshIntersect M₁ M₂
proof:
:= by
  rw [outNc] at hτ
  rw [mem_flatMap_arr] at hτ
  obtain ⟨g, hg, hτg⟩ := hτ
  rw [Array.mem_map] at hg
  obtain ⟨f, hfk, rfl⟩ := hg
  rw [Proof.MeshIntersectNpo.meshIntersect_eq M₁ M₂ hg₁ hg₂, mem_flatMap_arr]
  refine ⟨atomizeFrag (Proof.MeshIntersectNpo.vsGen M₁ M₂) f, ?_, hτg⟩
  rw [Array.mem_map]
  refine ⟨f, ?_, rfl⟩
  rw [keptGen_eq_buckets, Array.mem_append]
  exact Or.inl hfk

name: noPlaneThroughOrigin_of_mem
proof:
:= by

name: carrier_ne_of_mem
statement:
theorem carrier_ne_of_mem (M₁ M₂ : Mesh)
    (h₁ : Legacy.WellFormedMesh M₁) (h₂ : Legacy.WellFormedMesh M₂)
    {Q : Point} (hG : Gen M₁ M₂ Q) {M : Mesh}
    (hsub : ∀ τ ∈ M, τ ∈ meshIntersect M₁ M₂) :
    ∀ j : Fin M.size, dotQ (carrierNormal M[j]) Q ≠ 0
proof:

    (Proof.MeshIntersectNpo.GenWF.of_legacy h₁) (Proof.MeshIntersectNpo.GenWF.of_legacy h₂) hG

name: winding_eq_stepSum_one_of_sub
statement:
theorem winding_eq_stepSum_one_of_sub (M₁ M₂ : Mesh)
    (h₁ : Legacy.WellFormedMesh M₁) (h₂ : Legacy.WellFormedMesh M₂)
    {Q : Point} (hG : Gen M₁ M₂ Q) {M : Mesh}
    (hsub : ∀ τ ∈ M, τ ∈ meshIntersect M₁ M₂) :
    winding (meshChain M) Q = stepSum (meshSteps M Q) 1
proof:
:=
  winding_eq_stepSum_one M
    (noPlaneThroughOrigin_of_mem
      (Proof.MeshIntersectNpo.meshIntersect_noPlaneThroughOrigin M₁ M₂ h₁ h₂) hsub)

name: cop_bucket_radial_step
statement:
theorem cop_bucket_radial_step (M₁ M₂ : Mesh)
    (h₁ : Legacy.WellFormedMesh M₁) (h₂ : Legacy.WellFormedMesh M₂)
    {Q : Point} (hG : Gen M₁ M₂ Q) :
    bucketWinding M₁ M₂ (keptCop M₁ M₂) Q = stepSum (meshSteps (outCop M₁ M₂) Q) 1
proof:
:= by
  rw [bucketWinding_keptCop_eq]
  exact winding_eq_stepSum_one_of_sub M₁ M₂ h₁ h₂ hG
    (fun _ hτ => outCop_mem_meshIntersect M₁ M₂ (Proof.MeshIntersectNpo.GenWF.of_legacy h₁)

name: Tncop_radial_step
statement:
theorem Tncop_radial_step (M₁ M₂ : Mesh)
    (h₁ : Legacy.WellFormedMesh M₁) (h₂ : Legacy.WellFormedMesh M₂)
    {Q : Point} (hG : Gen M₁ M₂ Q) :
    Tncop M₁ M₂ Q = stepSum (meshSteps (outNc M₁ M₂) Q) 1
proof:

  exact winding_eq_stepSum_one_of_sub M₁ M₂ h₁ h₂ hG
    (fun _ hτ => outNc_mem_meshIntersect M₁ M₂ (Proof.MeshIntersectNpo.GenWF.of_legacy h₁)
      (Proof.MeshIntersectNpo.GenWF.of_legacy h₂) hτ)

name: gamma_faceSOf_ne
statement:
theorem gamma_faceSOf_ne {t : Triangle} (hdet : detOrigin t ≠ 0) :
    gamma (faceSOf t).plane ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  intro hγ
  obtain ⟨ha, hb, hc, hd⟩ := (gamma_eq_zero_iff (faceSOf t).plane).mp hγ
  obtain ⟨m, hm, _, _, _, hdm⟩ := Proof.MeshIntersectKeep.isMulOf_faceSOf_plane t
  rw [hd] at hdm
  have : (0 : ℚ) = m * detOrigin t := by exact_mod_cast hdm
  exact hdet (by
    rcases mul_eq_zero.mp this.symm with h | h
    · exact absurd h (ne_of_gt hm)
    · exact h)

name: primDir_eq_d_ratio
statement:
theorem primDir_eq_d_ratio {g h : IPlane} (hγg : gamma g ≠ 0) (hγh : gamma h ≠ 0)
    (heq : IPlane.primDir g = IPlane.primDir h) :
    (h.d : ℚ) = ((gamma h : ℚ) / (gamma g : ℚ)) * (g.d : ℚ)
proof:
:= by
  have hgd := primDir_entry_d hγg
  have hhd := primDir_entry_d hγh
  rw [heq] at hgd
  have hγg0 : (gamma g : ℚ) ≠ 0 := by exact_mod_cast hγg
  have hgdQ : (g.d : ℚ) = (gamma g : ℚ) * ((IPlane.primDir h).d : ℚ) := by exact_mod_cast hgd
  have hhdQ : (h.d : ℚ) = (gamma h : ℚ) * ((IPlane.primDir h).d : ℚ) := by exact_mod_cast hhd
  rw [hhdQ, hgdQ]
  field_simp
  ring

name: orientSign_eq_of_sameOrient
statement:
theorem orientSign_eq_of_sameOrient {t u : Triangle}
    (hdt : detOrigin t ≠ 0) (hdu : detOrigin u ≠ 0)
    (hso : sameOrient (faceSOf t).plane (faceSOf u).plane = true) :
    orientSign t = orientSign u
proof:
:= by
  have hpeq : IPlane.primDir (faceSOf t).plane = IPlane.primDir (faceSOf u).plane := by
    have := hso
    unfold sameOrient at this
    exact beqIPlane_eq_true_iff.mp this
  have hγt := gamma_faceSOf_ne hdt
  have hγu := gamma_faceSOf_ne hdu
  have hd := primDir_eq_d_ratio hγt hγu hpeq
  obtain ⟨mt, hmt, _, _, _, hdt'⟩ := Proof.MeshIntersectKeep.isMulOf_faceSOf_plane t
  obtain ⟨mu, hmu, _, _, _, hdu'⟩ := Proof.MeshIntersectKeep.isMulOf_faceSOf_plane u
  have hρpos : 0 < (gamma (faceSOf u).plane : ℚ) / (gamma (faceSOf t).plane : ℚ) :=
    div_pos (by exact_mod_cast Nat.pos_of_ne_zero hγu)
      (by exact_mod_cast Nat.pos_of_ne_zero hγt)
  have hkey : mu * detOrigin u
      = ((gamma (faceSOf u).plane : ℚ) / (gamma (faceSOf t).plane : ℚ)) * (mt * detOrigin t) := by
    rw [← hdu', ← hdt', hd]
  have hdetu : detOrigin u
      = (((gamma (faceSOf u).plane : ℚ) / (gamma (faceSOf t).plane : ℚ)) * mt / mu) * detOrigin t := by
    field_simp at hkey ⊢
    linarith [hkey]
  have hfacpos : 0 < ((gamma (faceSOf u).plane : ℚ) / (gamma (faceSOf t).plane : ℚ)) * mt / mu :=
    div_pos (mul_pos hρpos hmt) hmu
  unfold orientSign
  rcases lt_trichotomy (detOrigin t) 0 with ht | ht | ht
  · have : detOrigin u < 0 := by rw [hdetu]; exact mul_neg_of_pos_of_neg hfacpos ht
    simp [not_lt.mpr (le_of_lt ht), ht, not_lt.mpr (le_of_lt this), this]
  · exact absurd ht hdt
  · have : 0 < detOrigin u := by rw [hdetu]; exact mul_pos hfacpos ht
    simp [ht, this]

name: keepFragB_iff_winding
statement:
theorem keepFragB_iff_winding {MB : Mesh} {W : Array PFace} {f : Frag}
    {r : ℕ} [NeZero r] {w : Fin r → Point} {fc n : Point} {c : ℚ}
    (hwf : Legacy.WellFormedMesh MB)
    (hW : W = prepare (materialize MB))
    (hr : 3 ≤ r)
    (hpl : OnPlane n c w)
    (hs : StrictConv n w)
    (hfc_pt : fragCentroid f = ofPoint fc)
    (hne : f.poly.size ≠ 0)
    (hmir : FragMirrors f)
    (hfc_bary : fc = ∑ i, (r : ℚ)⁻¹ • w i)
    (hoff_surf : ∀ (u : Fin MB.size), ∀ x ∈ vrelint w, x ∉ triangleSet MB[u])
    (hfacet_feas : ∀ (j : Fin MB.size) (g : Half), g ∈ tetraHalves MB[j] →
      ∃ y, dotQ n y = c ∧ g.eval y ≠ 0)
    (hmoment : ∀ (u : Fin MB.size) (k : Fin 3),
      ∃ m : Point, dotQ m (psub (edgeHead MB[u] k) (edgeTail MB[u] k)) = 0 ∧
        ∃ y, dotQ n y = c ∧ dotQ m (psub y (edgeTail MB[u] k)) ≠ 0) :
    ∃ P : Point,
      G1Clean MB P ∧
      P ∈ vrelint w ∧
      keepFragB (faceBVH W) W f = decide (winding (meshChain MB) P = 1)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have hnpo : NoPlaneThroughOrigin MB := hwf.2.2.2
  
  obtain ⟨d_fc, hd_fc_ne, hd_fc_clean, hWA⟩ := windingAt_clean_dir hnpo fc
  
  obtain ⟨P, d', hPmem, hPclean, hd'ne, hoffc, hdN, hdA, hG2line, hnoedge,
      hoffSeg, hedgeSeg, hdθ, hedgeArc⟩ :=
    gen_dense_codir hnpo hr hpl hs hfc_bary hoff_surf hd_fc_ne hd_fc_clean hfacet_feas hmoment
  
  have hL : RayCount MB fc d_fc = RayCount MB P d_fc :=
    rayCount_local_const hnpo hoffSeg hedgeSeg
  
  have hD : RayCount MB P d_fc = RayCount MB P d' :=
    rayCount_local_const_dir hnpo hoffc hdθ hedgeArc
  
  have hW5 : winding (meshChain MB) P = RayCount MB P d' :=
    raycount_eq_winding hwf.1 hnpo hwf.2.2.1 hPclean hd'ne hdN hdA hG2line hnoedge
  
  have hbridge : windingAt (faceBVH (prepare (materialize MB))) (prepare (materialize MB))
      (ofPoint fc) = winding (meshChain MB) P :=
    hWA.trans (hL.trans (hD.trans hW5.symm))
  
  refine ⟨P, hPclean, hPmem, ?_⟩
  subst hW
  rw [keepFragB_eq _ _ (materialize_wedgeOK MB) hne hmir, hfc_pt, hbridge]
  exact Bool.beq_eq_decide_eq _ _

name: overlap_mono_right

theorem overlap_mono_right (q b b' : Box) (hsub : Subbox b b') :
