name: axisSlab_mono
statement:
theorem axisSlab_mono (dα xα loα hiα loα' hiα' : Rat)
    (hlo : loα' ≤ loα) (hhi : hiα ≤ hiα') :
    (axisSlab dα xα loα hiα).den = (axisSlab dα xα loα' hiα').den ∧
    (axisSlab dα xα loα hiα).bdd = (axisSlab dα xα loα' hiα').bdd ∧
    ((axisSlab dα xα loα hiα).ok = true →
      (axisSlab dα xα loα' hiα').ok = true ∧
      (axisSlab dα xα loα' hiα').loN ≤ (axisSlab dα xα loα hiα).loN ∧
      (axisSlab dα xα loα hiα).hiN ≤ (axisSlab dα xα loα' hiα').hiN)
proof:
:= by
  unfold axisSlab
  by_cases hd : dα = 0
  · simp only [hd, if_pos rfl, if_true]
    refine ⟨trivial, trivial, ?_⟩
    intro hok
    simp only [Bool.and_eq_true, decide_eq_true_eq] at hok ⊢
    exact ⟨⟨hlo.trans hok.1, hok.2.trans hhi⟩, le_refl _, le_refl _⟩
  · simp only [if_neg hd]
    refine ⟨trivial, trivial, ?_⟩
    intro hok
    simp only [decide_eq_true_eq] at hok ⊢
    have hval' : loα' ≤ hiα' := (hlo.trans hok).trans hhi
    refine ⟨hval', ?_, ?_⟩
    · 
      by_cases hpos : 0 < dα
      · simp only [if_pos hpos, one_mul]
        rw [rmin_eq_left (by linarith : loα - xα ≤ hiα - xα)]
        exact (rmin_le_left _ _).trans (by linarith)
      · simp only [if_neg hpos]
        rw [rmin_eq_right (by nlinarith : (-1 : Rat) * (hiα - xα) ≤ (-1) * (loα - xα))]
        exact (rmin_le_right _ _).trans (by nlinarith)
    · 
      by_cases hpos : 0 < dα
      · simp only [if_pos hpos, one_mul]
        rw [rmax_eq_right (by linarith : loα - xα ≤ hiα - xα)]
        exact (by linarith : hiα - xα ≤ hiα' - xα).trans (le_rmax_right _ _)
      · simp only [if_neg hpos]
        rw [rmax_eq_left (by nlinarith : (-1 : Rat) * (hiα - xα) ≤ (-1) * (loα - xα))]
        exact (by nlinarith : (-1 : Rat) * (loα - xα) ≤ (-1) * (loα' - xα)).trans (le_rmax_left _ _)

name: slabLeHi_mono
statement:
theorem slabLeHi_mono (s t s' t' : AxisSlab)
    (hsden : s.den = s'.den) (htden : t.den = t'.den)
    (hsbdd : s.bdd = s'.bdd) (htbdd : t.bdd = t'.bdd)
    (hslo : s'.loN ≤ s.loN) (thhi : t.hiN ≤ t'.hiN)
    (hsdpos : 0 < s.den) (htdpos : 0 < t.den) :
    slabLeHi s t = true → slabLeHi s' t' = true
proof:
:= by
  unfold slabLeHi
  by_cases hb : s.bdd && t.bdd
  · have hb' : s'.bdd && t'.bdd := by rw [← hsbdd, ← htbdd]; exact hb
    rw [if_pos hb, if_pos hb']
    simp only [decide_eq_true_eq]
    intro h
    
    rw [← hsden, ← htden]
    have h1 : s'.loN * t.den ≤ s.loN * t.den := by
      apply mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hslo (le_of_lt htdpos)
    have h2 : t.hiN * s.den ≤ t'.hiN * s.den := by
      apply mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right thhi (le_of_lt hsdpos)
    exact h1.trans (h.trans h2)
  · have hb' : ¬ (s'.bdd && t'.bdd) := by rw [← hsbdd, ← htbdd]; exact hb
    rw [if_neg hb']
    intro _; rfl

name: axisSlab_den_pos
statement: theorem axisSlab_den_pos (dα xα loα hiα : Rat) : 0 < (axisSlab dα xα loα hiα).den
proof:
:= by
  unfold axisSlab
  by_cases hd : dα = 0
  · simp [hd]
  · simp only [if_neg hd]
    by_cases hpos : 0 < dα
    · simp [if_pos hpos, hpos]
    · rw [if_neg (by simp [hpos])]
      have : dα < 0 := lt_of_le_of_ne (not_lt.mp hpos) hd
      nlinarith

name: rayLineMeetsBox_mono
statement:
theorem rayLineMeetsBox_mono (x d : Pt) (b b' : Box) (hsub : Subbox b b') :
    rayLineMeetsBox x d b = true → rayLineMeetsBox x d b' = true
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨h1, h2, h3, h4, h5, h6⟩ := hsub
  intro hmeet
  
  have mx := axisSlab_mono d.x x.x b.lox b.hix b'.lox b'.hix h1 h4
  have my := axisSlab_mono d.y x.y b.loy b.hiy b'.loy b'.hiy h2 h5
  have mz := axisSlab_mono d.z x.z b.loz b.hiz b'.loz b'.hiz h3 h6
  set sx := axisSlab d.x x.x b.lox b.hix with hsx
  set sy := axisSlab d.y x.y b.loy b.hiy with hsy
  set sz := axisSlab d.z x.z b.loz b.hiz with hsz
  set sx' := axisSlab d.x x.x b'.lox b'.hix with hsx'
  set sy' := axisSlab d.y x.y b'.loy b'.hiy with hsy'
  set sz' := axisSlab d.z x.z b'.loz b'.hiz with hsz'
  
  have dpx : 0 < sx.den := axisSlab_den_pos _ _ _ _
  have dpy : 0 < sy.den := axisSlab_den_pos _ _ _ _
  have dpz : 0 < sz.den := axisSlab_den_pos _ _ _ _
  
  obtain ⟨hdx, hbx, hokx'⟩ := mx
  obtain ⟨hdy, hby, hoky'⟩ := my
  obtain ⟨hdz, hbz, hokz'⟩ := mz
  
  
  rw [rayLineMeetsBox] at hmeet
  simp only [← hsx, ← hsy, ← hsz, Bool.and_eq_true] at hmeet
  obtain ⟨⟨⟨⟨⟨⟨⟨⟨hokX, hokY⟩, hokZ⟩, hXY⟩, hXZ⟩, hYX⟩, hYZ⟩, hZX⟩, hZY⟩ := hmeet
  
  obtain ⟨hokx2, hxlo, hxhi⟩ := hokx' hokX
  obtain ⟨hoky2, hylo, hyhi⟩ := hoky' hokY
  obtain ⟨hokz2, hzlo, hzhi⟩ := hokz' hokZ
  
  have dpx' : 0 < sx'.den := by rw [← hdx]; exact dpx
  have dpy' : 0 < sy'.den := by rw [← hdy]; exact dpy
  have dpz' : 0 < sz'.den := by rw [← hdz]; exact dpz
  
  rw [rayLineMeetsBox]
  simp only [← hsx', ← hsy', ← hsz', Bool.and_eq_true]
  refine ⟨⟨⟨⟨⟨⟨⟨⟨hokx2, hoky2⟩, hokz2⟩, ?_⟩, ?_⟩, ?_⟩, ?_⟩, ?_⟩, ?_⟩
  · exact slabLeHi_mono sx sy sx' sy' hdx hdy hbx hby hxlo hyhi dpx dpy hXY
  · exact slabLeHi_mono sx sz sx' sz' hdx hdz hbx hbz hxlo hzhi dpx dpz hXZ
  · exact slabLeHi_mono sy sx sy' sx' hdy hdx hby hbx hylo hxhi dpy dpx hYX
  · exact slabLeHi_mono sy sz sy' sz' hdy hdz hby hbz hylo hzhi dpy dpz hYZ
  · exact slabLeHi_mono sz sx sz' sx' hdz hdx hbz hbx hzlo hxhi dpz dpx hZX
  · exact slabLeHi_mono sz sy sz' sy' hdz hdy hbz hby hzlo hyhi dpz dpy hZY

name: slabNonneg_mono
statement:
theorem slabNonneg_mono (s s' : AxisSlab)
    (hbdd : s.bdd = s'.bdd) (hhi : s.hiN ≤ s'.hiN) :
    slabNonneg s = true → slabNonneg s' = true
proof:
:= by
  unfold slabNonneg
  rw [← hbdd]
  by_cases hb : s.bdd = true
  · rw [if_pos hb, if_pos hb]
    simp only [decide_eq_true_eq]
    exact fun h => le_trans h hhi
  · simp only [Bool.not_eq_true] at hb
    rw [hb]; simp

name: rayLineMeetsBoxFwd_mono
statement:
theorem rayLineMeetsBoxFwd_mono (x d : Pt) (b b' : Box) (hsub : Subbox b b') :
    rayLineMeetsBoxFwd x d b = true → rayLineMeetsBoxFwd x d b' = true
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨h1, h2, h3, h4, h5, h6⟩ := hsub
  intro hmeet
  have mx := axisSlab_mono d.x x.x b.lox b.hix b'.lox b'.hix h1 h4
  have my := axisSlab_mono d.y x.y b.loy b.hiy b'.loy b'.hiy h2 h5
  have mz := axisSlab_mono d.z x.z b.loz b.hiz b'.loz b'.hiz h3 h6
  set sx := axisSlab d.x x.x b.lox b.hix with hsx
  set sy := axisSlab d.y x.y b.loy b.hiy with hsy
  set sz := axisSlab d.z x.z b.loz b.hiz with hsz
  set sx' := axisSlab d.x x.x b'.lox b'.hix with hsx'
  set sy' := axisSlab d.y x.y b'.loy b'.hiy with hsy'
  set sz' := axisSlab d.z x.z b'.loz b'.hiz with hsz'
  have dpx : 0 < sx.den := axisSlab_den_pos _ _ _ _
  have dpy : 0 < sy.den := axisSlab_den_pos _ _ _ _
  have dpz : 0 < sz.den := axisSlab_den_pos _ _ _ _
  obtain ⟨hdx, hbx, hokx'⟩ := mx
  obtain ⟨hdy, hby, hoky'⟩ := my
  obtain ⟨hdz, hbz, hokz'⟩ := mz
  rw [rayLineMeetsBoxFwd] at hmeet
  simp only [← hsx, ← hsy, ← hsz, Bool.and_eq_true] at hmeet
  obtain ⟨⟨⟨⟨⟨⟨⟨⟨⟨⟨⟨hokX, hokY⟩, hokZ⟩, hXY⟩, hXZ⟩, hYX⟩, hYZ⟩, hZX⟩, hZY⟩, hNX⟩, hNY⟩, hNZ⟩ := hmeet
  obtain ⟨hokx2, hxlo, hxhi⟩ := hokx' hokX
  obtain ⟨hoky2, hylo, hyhi⟩ := hoky' hokY
  obtain ⟨hokz2, hzlo, hzhi⟩ := hokz' hokZ
  rw [rayLineMeetsBoxFwd]
  simp only [← hsx', ← hsy', ← hsz', Bool.and_eq_true]
  refine ⟨⟨⟨⟨⟨⟨⟨⟨⟨⟨⟨hokx2, hoky2⟩, hokz2⟩, ?_⟩, ?_⟩, ?_⟩, ?_⟩, ?_⟩, ?_⟩, ?_⟩, ?_⟩, ?_⟩
  · exact slabLeHi_mono sx sy sx' sy' hdx hdy hbx hby hxlo hyhi dpx dpy hXY
  · exact slabLeHi_mono sx sz sx' sz' hdx hdz hbx hbz hxlo hzhi dpx dpz hXZ
  · exact slabLeHi_mono sy sx sy' sx' hdy hdx hby hbx hylo hxhi dpy dpx hYX
  · exact slabLeHi_mono sy sz sy' sz' hdy hdz hby hbz hylo hzhi dpy dpz hYZ
  · exact slabLeHi_mono sz sx sz' sx' hdz hdx hbz hbx hzlo hxhi dpz dpx hZX
  · exact slabLeHi_mono sz sy sz' sy' hdz hdy hbz hby hzlo hyhi dpz dpy hZY
  · exact slabNonneg_mono sx sx' hbx hxhi hNX
  · exact slabNonneg_mono sy sy' hby hyhi hNY
  · exact slabNonneg_mono sz sz' hbz hzhi hNZ

name: qle_div_iff
statement:
theorem qle_div_iff (c : ℚ) (m D : ℤ) (hD : 0 < D) :
    c ≤ (m : ℚ) / (D : ℚ) ↔ c.num * D ≤ m * c.den
proof:
:= by
  have hDQ : (0:ℚ) < (D:ℚ) := by exact_mod_cast hD
  have hcd : (0:ℚ) < (c.den:ℚ) := by exact_mod_cast c.pos
  have hnd : (c.num:ℚ) = c * (c.den:ℚ) := (div_eq_iff (ne_of_gt hcd)).mp (Rat.num_div_den c)
  rw [le_div_iff₀ hDQ]
  rw [show (c.num * D ≤ m * c.den) ↔ ((c.num:ℚ) * (D:ℚ) ≤ (m:ℚ) * (c.den:ℚ)) from by
        constructor <;> intro h <;> exact_mod_cast h]
  rw [hnd]
  constructor
  · intro h; nlinarith [h, hcd]
  · intro h; nlinarith [h, hcd]

name: div_le_q_iff
statement:
theorem div_le_q_iff (c : ℚ) (m D : ℤ) (hD : 0 < D) :
    (m : ℚ) / (D : ℚ) ≤ c ↔ m * c.den ≤ c.num * D
proof:
:= by
  have hDQ : (0:ℚ) < (D:ℚ) := by exact_mod_cast hD
  have hcd : (0:ℚ) < (c.den:ℚ) := by exact_mod_cast c.pos
  have hnd : (c.num:ℚ) = c * (c.den:ℚ) := (div_eq_iff (ne_of_gt hcd)).mp (Rat.num_div_den c)
  rw [div_le_iff₀ hDQ]
  rw [show (m * c.den ≤ c.num * D) ↔ ((m:ℚ) * (c.den:ℚ) ≤ (c.num:ℚ) * (D:ℚ)) from by
        constructor <;> intro h <;> exact_mod_cast h]
  rw [hnd]
  constructor
  · intro h; nlinarith [h, hcd]
  · intro h; nlinarith [h, hcd]

name: commonDen_pos
statement: theorem commonDen_pos (b : Box) : 0 < commonDen b
proof:
:= by
  unfold commonDen
  refine Int.natCast_pos.mpr (Nat.pos_of_ne_zero ?_)
  refine Nat.lcm_ne_zero (Nat.lcm_ne_zero (Nat.lcm_ne_zero ?_ ?_) (Nat.lcm_ne_zero ?_ ?_))
    (Nat.lcm_ne_zero ?_ ?_) <;> exact (Rat.den_pos _).ne'

name: numOver_div
statement:
theorem numOver_div (D : ℤ) (c : ℚ) (hD : 0 < D) (hdvd : (c.den:ℤ) ∣ D) :
    ((numOver D c : ℤ) : ℚ) / (D:ℚ) = c
proof:
:= by
  have hDne : (D:ℚ) ≠ 0 := by exact_mod_cast hD.ne'
  have hcast : ((numOver D c : ℤ):ℚ) = c * (D:ℚ) := by
    unfold numOver
    push_cast [Int.cast_div_charZero hdvd]
    rw [show (c.num:ℚ) * ((D:ℚ)/(c.den:ℚ)) = ((c.num:ℚ)/(c.den:ℚ)) * (D:ℚ) from by ring,
        Rat.num_div_den]
  rw [hcast, mul_div_assoc, div_self hDne, mul_one]

name: ratBox_iboxOfBox
statement: theorem ratBox_iboxOfBox (b : Box) : ratBox (iboxOfBox b) = b
proof:
:= by
  have hpos := commonDen_pos b
  
  have dvd_lox : ((b.lox.den:ℤ)) ∣ commonDen b := by
    unfold commonDen; exact_mod_cast
      (Nat.dvd_lcm_left _ _).trans ((Nat.dvd_lcm_left _ _).trans (Nat.dvd_lcm_left _ _))
  have dvd_loy : ((b.loy.den:ℤ)) ∣ commonDen b := by
    unfold commonDen; exact_mod_cast
      (Nat.dvd_lcm_right _ _).trans ((Nat.dvd_lcm_left _ _).trans (Nat.dvd_lcm_left _ _))
  have dvd_loz : ((b.loz.den:ℤ)) ∣ commonDen b := by
    unfold commonDen; exact_mod_cast
      (Nat.dvd_lcm_left _ _).trans ((Nat.dvd_lcm_right _ _).trans (Nat.dvd_lcm_left _ _))
  have dvd_hix : ((b.hix.den:ℤ)) ∣ commonDen b := by
    unfold commonDen; exact_mod_cast
      (Nat.dvd_lcm_right _ _).trans ((Nat.dvd_lcm_right _ _).trans (Nat.dvd_lcm_left _ _))
  have dvd_hiy : ((b.hiy.den:ℤ)) ∣ commonDen b := by
    unfold commonDen; exact_mod_cast
      (Nat.dvd_lcm_left _ _).trans (Nat.dvd_lcm_right _ _)
  have dvd_hiz : ((b.hiz.den:ℤ)) ∣ commonDen b := by
    unfold commonDen; exact_mod_cast
      (Nat.dvd_lcm_right _ _).trans (Nat.dvd_lcm_right _ _)
  simp only [ratBox, iboxOfBox,
    numOver_div _ _ hpos dvd_lox, numOver_div _ _ hpos dvd_loy, numOver_div _ _ hpos dvd_loz,
    numOver_div _ _ hpos dvd_hix, numOver_div _ _ hpos dvd_hiy, numOver_div _ _ hpos dvd_hiz]

name: iboxOfBox_d
statement: theorem iboxOfBox_d (b : Box) : (iboxOfBox b).d = commonDen b
proof: := rfl

name: ioverlap_eq
statement:
theorem ioverlap_eq (q : Box) (v : IBox) (hd : 0 < v.d) :
    ioverlap (iboxQ q) v = overlap q (ratBox v)
proof:
:= by
  have e1 : decide (q.lox.num * v.d ≤ v.hix * (q.lox.den:ℤ)) = decide (q.lox ≤ (v.hix:ℚ)/(v.d:ℚ)) :=
    decide_eq_decide.mpr (qle_div_iff q.lox v.hix v.d hd).symm
  have e2 : decide (v.lox * (q.hix.den:ℤ) ≤ q.hix.num * v.d) = decide ((v.lox:ℚ)/(v.d:ℚ) ≤ q.hix) :=
    decide_eq_decide.mpr (div_le_q_iff q.hix v.lox v.d hd).symm
  have e3 : decide (q.loy.num * v.d ≤ v.hiy * (q.loy.den:ℤ)) = decide (q.loy ≤ (v.hiy:ℚ)/(v.d:ℚ)) :=
    decide_eq_decide.mpr (qle_div_iff q.loy v.hiy v.d hd).symm
  have e4 : decide (v.loy * (q.hiy.den:ℤ) ≤ q.hiy.num * v.d) = decide ((v.loy:ℚ)/(v.d:ℚ) ≤ q.hiy) :=
    decide_eq_decide.mpr (div_le_q_iff q.hiy v.loy v.d hd).symm
  have e5 : decide (q.loz.num * v.d ≤ v.hiz * (q.loz.den:ℤ)) = decide (q.loz ≤ (v.hiz:ℚ)/(v.d:ℚ)) :=
    decide_eq_decide.mpr (qle_div_iff q.loz v.hiz v.d hd).symm
  have e6 : decide (v.loz * (q.hiz.den:ℤ) ≤ q.hiz.num * v.d) = decide ((v.loz:ℚ)/(v.d:ℚ) ≤ q.hiz) :=
    decide_eq_decide.mpr (div_le_q_iff q.hiz v.loz v.d hd).symm
  simp only [ioverlap, iboxQ, overlap, ratBox, e1, e2, e3, e4, e5, e6]

name: ioverlap_iboxOfBox
statement:
theorem ioverlap_iboxOfBox (q b : Box) :
    ioverlap (iboxQ q) (iboxOfBox b) = overlap q b
proof:
:= by
  rw [ioverlap_eq q (iboxOfBox b) (by rw [iboxOfBox_d]; exact commonDen_pos b), ratBox_iboxOfBox]

name: rmin_div
statement: theorem rmin_div (a b c : ℚ) (hc : 0 < c) : rmin a b / c = rmin (a/c) (b/c)
proof:
:= by
  unfold rmin
  by_cases h : a ≤ b
  · rw [if_pos h, if_pos ((div_le_div_iff_of_pos_right hc).mpr h)]
  · rw [if_neg h, if_neg (fun h' => h ((div_le_div_iff_of_pos_right hc).mp h'))]

name: rmax_div
statement: theorem rmax_div (a b c : ℚ) (hc : 0 < c) : rmax a b / c = rmax (a/c) (b/c)
proof:
:= by
  unfold rmax
  by_cases h : a ≤ b
  · rw [if_pos h, if_pos ((div_le_div_iff_of_pos_right hc).mpr h)]
  · rw [if_neg h, if_neg (fun h' => h ((div_le_div_iff_of_pos_right hc).mp h'))]

name: imin_div
statement:
theorem imin_div (na nb : ℤ) (c : ℚ) (hc : 0 < c) :
    ((if na ≤ nb then na else nb : ℤ):ℚ)/c = rmin ((na:ℚ)/c) ((nb:ℚ)/c)
proof:
:= by
  unfold rmin
  by_cases h : na ≤ nb
  · rw [if_pos h, if_pos ((div_le_div_iff_of_pos_right hc).mpr (by exact_mod_cast h : (na:ℚ) ≤ nb))]
  · rw [if_neg h, if_neg (fun h' => h (by exact_mod_cast (div_le_div_iff_of_pos_right hc).mp h'))]

name: imax_div
statement:
theorem imax_div (na nb : ℤ) (c : ℚ) (hc : 0 < c) :
    ((if na ≤ nb then nb else na : ℤ):ℚ)/c = rmax ((na:ℚ)/c) ((nb:ℚ)/c)
proof:
:= by
  unfold rmax
  by_cases h : na ≤ nb
  · rw [if_pos h, if_pos ((div_le_div_iff_of_pos_right hc).mpr (by exact_mod_cast h : (na:ℚ) ≤ nb))]
  · rw [if_neg h, if_neg (fun h' => h (by exact_mod_cast (div_le_div_iff_of_pos_right hc).mp h'))]

name: axisSlab_lo_div
statement:
theorem axisSlab_lo_div (dα xα loα hiα : ℚ) (hd : dα ≠ 0) :
    (axisSlab dα xα loα hiα).loN / (axisSlab dα xα loα hiα).den
      = rmin ((loα - xα)/dα) ((hiα - xα)/dα)
proof:
:= by
  have hden : 0 < (axisSlab dα xα loα hiα).den := axisSlab_den_pos _ _ _ _
  have hsgn : (if decide (0 < dα) then (1:ℚ) else -1) ≠ 0 := by split <;> norm_num
  simp only [axisSlab, if_neg hd] at hden ⊢
  rw [rmin_div _ _ _ hden, mul_div_mul_left _ _ hsgn, mul_div_mul_left _ _ hsgn]

name: axisSlab_hi_div
statement:
theorem axisSlab_hi_div (dα xα loα hiα : ℚ) (hd : dα ≠ 0) :
    (axisSlab dα xα loα hiα).hiN / (axisSlab dα xα loα hiα).den
      = rmax ((loα - xα)/dα) ((hiα - xα)/dα)
proof:
:= by
  have hden : 0 < (axisSlab dα xα loα hiα).den := axisSlab_den_pos _ _ _ _
  have hsgn : (if decide (0 < dα) then (1:ℚ) else -1) ≠ 0 := by split <;> norm_num
  simp only [axisSlab, if_neg hd] at hden ⊢
  rw [rmax_div _ _ _ hden, mul_div_mul_left _ _ hsgn, mul_div_mul_left _ _ hsgn]

name: islab_den_pos
statement:
theorem islab_den_pos (dα xα : ℚ) (D nlo nhi : ℤ) (hd : dα ≠ 0) (hD : 0 < D) :
    0 < (islab (iaxisParam dα xα) D nlo nhi).den
proof:
:= by
  have hdn : dα.num ≠ 0 := Rat.num_ne_zero.mpr hd
  have hxdp : (0:ℤ) < (xα.den:ℤ) := by exact_mod_cast xα.pos
  rcases lt_trichotomy dα.num 0 with hlt | heq | hgt
  · have h1 : ¬ (0 < dα.num) := by omega
    simp only [islab, iaxisParam, if_neg hdn, if_neg h1, if_pos hlt]
    exact mul_pos (mul_pos (by omega) hD) hxdp
  · exact absurd heq hdn
  · have h2 : ¬ (dα.num < 0) := by omega
    simp only [islab, iaxisParam, if_neg hdn, if_pos hgt, if_neg h2]
    exact mul_pos (mul_pos hgt hD) hxdp

name: islab_na_div
statement:
theorem islab_na_div (dα xα : ℚ) (D n : ℤ) (hd : dα ≠ 0) (hD : 0 < D) :
    (((iaxisParam dα xα).sgnDd * (n * (iaxisParam dα xα).xd - (iaxisParam dα xα).xn * D) : ℤ) : ℚ)
      / (((iaxisParam dα xα).absDn * D * (iaxisParam dα xα).xd : ℤ) : ℚ)
      = ((n:ℚ)/(D:ℚ) - xα)/dα
proof:
:= by
  have hdn : dα.num ≠ 0 := Rat.num_ne_zero.mpr hd
  have hddQ : (0:ℚ) < (dα.den:ℚ) := by exact_mod_cast dα.pos
  have hxd : (0:ℚ) < (xα.den:ℚ) := by exact_mod_cast xα.pos
  have hDQ : (0:ℚ) < (D:ℚ) := by exact_mod_cast hD
  have hxαQ : (xα.num:ℚ) = xα * (xα.den:ℚ) := (div_eq_iff (ne_of_gt hxd)).mp (Rat.num_div_den xα)
  have hdαQ : (dα.num:ℚ) = dα * (dα.den:ℚ) := (div_eq_iff (ne_of_gt hddQ)).mp (Rat.num_div_den dα)
  have hdd0 : (dα.den:ℚ) ≠ 0 := ne_of_gt hddQ
  have hxd0 : (xα.den:ℚ) ≠ 0 := ne_of_gt hxd
  have hD0 : (D:ℚ) ≠ 0 := ne_of_gt hDQ
  rcases lt_trichotomy dα.num 0 with hlt | heq | hgt
  · have h1 : ¬ (0 < dα.num) := by omega
    simp only [iaxisParam, if_neg hdn, if_neg h1, if_pos hlt]
    push_cast
    field_simp
    rw [hxαQ, hdαQ]
    ring
  · exact absurd heq hdn
  · have h2 : ¬ (dα.num < 0) := by omega
    simp only [iaxisParam, if_neg hdn, if_pos hgt, if_neg h2]
    push_cast
    field_simp
    rw [hxαQ, hdαQ]
    ring

name: islab_lo_div
statement:
theorem islab_lo_div (dα xα : ℚ) (D nlo nhi : ℤ) (hd : dα ≠ 0) (hD : 0 < D) :
    ((islab (iaxisParam dα xα) D nlo nhi).loN : ℚ) / ((islab (iaxisParam dα xα) D nlo nhi).den : ℚ)
      = rmin (((nlo:ℚ)/(D:ℚ) - xα)/dα) (((nhi:ℚ)/(D:ℚ) - xα)/dα)
proof:
:= by
  have hdn : dα.num ≠ 0 := Rat.num_ne_zero.mpr hd
  have hz : (iaxisParam dα xα).zero = false := by simp [iaxisParam, hdn]
  have hden_pos : (0:ℚ) < (((iaxisParam dα xα).absDn * D * (iaxisParam dα xα).xd : ℤ) : ℚ) := by
    have h := islab_den_pos dα xα D nlo nhi hd hD
    simp only [islab, hz, if_false, Bool.false_eq_true] at h
    exact_mod_cast h
  simp only [islab, hz, if_false, Bool.false_eq_true]
  rw [imin_div _ _ _ hden_pos, islab_na_div dα xα D nlo hd hD, islab_na_div dα xα D nhi hd hD]

name: islab_hi_div
statement:
theorem islab_hi_div (dα xα : ℚ) (D nlo nhi : ℤ) (hd : dα ≠ 0) (hD : 0 < D) :
    ((islab (iaxisParam dα xα) D nlo nhi).hiN : ℚ) / ((islab (iaxisParam dα xα) D nlo nhi).den : ℚ)
      = rmax (((nlo:ℚ)/(D:ℚ) - xα)/dα) (((nhi:ℚ)/(D:ℚ) - xα)/dα)
proof:
:= by
  have hdn : dα.num ≠ 0 := Rat.num_ne_zero.mpr hd
  have hz : (iaxisParam dα xα).zero = false := by simp [iaxisParam, hdn]
  have hden_pos : (0:ℚ) < (((iaxisParam dα xα).absDn * D * (iaxisParam dα xα).xd : ℤ) : ℚ) := by
    have h := islab_den_pos dα xα D nlo nhi hd hD
    simp only [islab, hz, if_false, Bool.false_eq_true] at h
    exact_mod_cast h
  simp only [islab, hz, if_false, Bool.false_eq_true]
  rw [imax_div _ _ _ hden_pos, islab_na_div dα xα D nlo hd hD, islab_na_div dα xα D nhi hd hD]

name: cross_le
statement:
theorem cross_le {a c : ℚ} (b d : ℚ) (hb : 0 < b) (hd : 0 < d) :
    a / b ≤ c / d ↔ a * d ≤ c * b
proof:
:= by
  rw [div_le_iff₀ hb, div_mul_eq_mul_div, le_div_iff₀ hd]

name: islab_corr
statement:
theorem islab_corr (dα xα : ℚ) (D nlo nhi : ℤ) (hD : 0 < D) :
    SlabCorr (axisSlab dα xα ((nlo:ℚ)/(D:ℚ)) ((nhi:ℚ)/(D:ℚ)))
             (islab (iaxisParam dα xα) D nlo nhi)
proof:
:= by
  have hDQ : (0:ℚ) < (D:ℚ) := by exact_mod_cast hD
  by_cases hd0 : dα = 0
  · 
    have hdn0 : dα.num = 0 := Rat.num_eq_zero.mpr hd0
    refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
    · simp only [axisSlab, islab, iaxisParam, hd0, hdn0, if_true, eq_self_iff_true, ite_true]
      congr 1
      · exact decide_eq_decide.mpr (div_le_q_iff xα nlo D hD)
      · exact decide_eq_decide.mpr (qle_div_iff xα nhi D hD)
    · simp [axisSlab, islab, iaxisParam, hd0, hdn0]
    · simp [axisSlab, hd0]
    · simp [islab, iaxisParam, hdn0]
    · intro hbdd; simp [axisSlab, hd0] at hbdd
  · 
    have hdn : dα.num ≠ 0 := Rat.num_ne_zero.mpr hd0
    refine ⟨?_, ?_, axisSlab_den_pos _ _ _ _, islab_den_pos dα xα D nlo nhi hd0 hD, ?_⟩
    · simp only [axisSlab, islab, iaxisParam, if_neg hd0, hdn, if_false, Bool.false_eq_true]
      exact decide_eq_decide.mpr ((div_le_div_iff_of_pos_right hDQ).trans Int.cast_le)
    · simp only [axisSlab, islab, iaxisParam, if_neg hd0, hdn, if_false, Bool.false_eq_true]
    · intro _
      refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
      · rw [axisSlab_lo_div dα xα _ _ hd0, islab_lo_div dα xα D nlo nhi hd0 hD]
      · rw [axisSlab_hi_div dα xα _ _ hd0, islab_hi_div dα xα D nlo nhi hd0 hD]

name: islabLeHi_eq
statement:
theorem islabLeHi_eq (s t : AxisSlab) (si ti : IAxisSlab)
    (hs : SlabCorr s si) (ht : SlabCorr t ti) :
    islabLeHi si ti = slabLeHi s t
proof:
:= by
  unfold islabLeHi slabLeHi
  rw [hs.ebdd, ht.ebdd]
  by_cases hb : si.bdd && ti.bdd
  · rw [if_pos hb, if_pos hb]
    rw [Bool.and_eq_true] at hb
    obtain ⟨hsb, htb⟩ := hb
    have hsbt : s.bdd = true := by rw [hs.ebdd]; exact hsb
    have htbt : t.bdd = true := by rw [ht.ebdd]; exact htb
    obtain ⟨hslo, _⟩ := hs.eval hsbt
    obtain ⟨_, hthi⟩ := ht.eval htbt
    apply decide_eq_decide.mpr
    constructor
    · intro h
      have h1 : (si.loN:ℚ) * (ti.den:ℚ) ≤ (ti.hiN:ℚ) * (si.den:ℚ) := by exact_mod_cast h
      have h2 : (si.loN:ℚ)/(si.den:ℚ) ≤ (ti.hiN:ℚ)/(ti.den:ℚ) :=
        (cross_le (si.den:ℚ) (ti.den:ℚ) (by exact_mod_cast hs.siden)
          (by exact_mod_cast ht.siden)).mpr h1
      rw [← hslo, ← hthi] at h2
      exact (cross_le s.den t.den hs.sden ht.sden).mp h2
    · intro h
      have h2 : s.loN/s.den ≤ t.hiN/t.den := (cross_le s.den t.den hs.sden ht.sden).mpr h
      rw [hslo, hthi] at h2
      have h1 : (si.loN:ℚ)*(ti.den:ℚ) ≤ (ti.hiN:ℚ)*(si.den:ℚ) :=
        (cross_le (si.den:ℚ) (ti.den:ℚ) (by exact_mod_cast hs.siden)
          (by exact_mod_cast ht.siden)).mp h2
      exact_mod_cast h1
  · rw [if_neg hb, if_neg hb]

name: islabNonneg_eq
statement:
theorem islabNonneg_eq (s : AxisSlab) (si : IAxisSlab) (h : SlabCorr s si) :
    islabNonneg si = slabNonneg s
proof:
:= by
  unfold islabNonneg slabNonneg
  rw [h.ebdd]
  by_cases hb : si.bdd = true
  · rw [if_pos hb, if_pos hb]
    have hsbt : s.bdd = true := by rw [h.ebdd]; exact hb
    obtain ⟨_, hhi⟩ := h.eval hsbt
    apply decide_eq_decide.mpr
    constructor
    · intro hpos
      have h2 : (0:ℚ) ≤ (si.hiN:ℚ)/(si.den:ℚ) :=
        div_nonneg (by exact_mod_cast hpos) (le_of_lt (by exact_mod_cast h.siden))
      rw [← hhi] at h2
      have h3 : (0:ℚ) ≤ s.hiN := by
        by_contra hc
        push_neg at hc
        have : s.hiN / s.den < 0 := div_neg_of_neg_of_pos hc h.sden
        linarith
      exact_mod_cast h3
    · intro hpos
      have h2 : (0:ℚ) ≤ s.hiN/s.den :=
        div_nonneg (by exact_mod_cast hpos) (le_of_lt h.sden)
      rw [hhi] at h2
      have h3 : (0:ℚ) ≤ (si.hiN:ℚ) := by
        by_contra hc
        push_neg at hc
        have : (si.hiN:ℚ) / (si.den:ℚ) < 0 :=
          div_neg_of_neg_of_pos hc (by exact_mod_cast h.siden)
        linarith
      exact_mod_cast h3
  · simp only [Bool.not_eq_true] at hb
    rw [hb]; simp

name: irayLineMeetsBox_eq
statement:
theorem irayLineMeetsBox_eq (x d : Pt) (v : IBox) (hd : 0 < v.d) :
    irayLineMeetsBox (iaxisParam d.x x.x) (iaxisParam d.y x.y) (iaxisParam d.z x.z) v
      = rayLineMeetsBox x d (ratBox v)
proof:
:= by
  have cx := islab_corr d.x x.x v.d v.lox v.hix hd
  have cy := islab_corr d.y x.y v.d v.loy v.hiy hd
  have cz := islab_corr d.z x.z v.d v.loz v.hiz hd
  unfold irayLineMeetsBox rayLineMeetsBox
  simp only [ratBox]
  rw [cx.eok, cy.eok, cz.eok,
    ← islabLeHi_eq _ _ _ _ cx cy, ← islabLeHi_eq _ _ _ _ cx cz,
    ← islabLeHi_eq _ _ _ _ cy cx, ← islabLeHi_eq _ _ _ _ cy cz,
    ← islabLeHi_eq _ _ _ _ cz cx, ← islabLeHi_eq _ _ _ _ cz cy]

name: irayLineMeetsBox_iboxOfBox
statement:
theorem irayLineMeetsBox_iboxOfBox (x d : Pt) (b : Box) :
    irayLineMeetsBox (iaxisParam d.x x.x) (iaxisParam d.y x.y) (iaxisParam d.z x.z) (iboxOfBox b)
      = rayLineMeetsBox x d b
proof:
:= by
  rw [irayLineMeetsBox_eq x d (iboxOfBox b) (by rw [iboxOfBox_d]; exact commonDen_pos b),
    ratBox_iboxOfBox]

name: irayLineMeetsBoxFwd_eq
statement:
theorem irayLineMeetsBoxFwd_eq (x d : Pt) (v : IBox) (hd : 0 < v.d) :
    irayLineMeetsBoxFwd (iaxisParam d.x x.x) (iaxisParam d.y x.y) (iaxisParam d.z x.z) v
      = rayLineMeetsBoxFwd x d (ratBox v)
proof:
:= by
  have cx := islab_corr d.x x.x v.d v.lox v.hix hd
  have cy := islab_corr d.y x.y v.d v.loy v.hiy hd
  have cz := islab_corr d.z x.z v.d v.loz v.hiz hd
  unfold irayLineMeetsBoxFwd rayLineMeetsBoxFwd
  simp only [ratBox]
  rw [cx.eok, cy.eok, cz.eok,
    ← islabLeHi_eq _ _ _ _ cx cy, ← islabLeHi_eq _ _ _ _ cx cz,
    ← islabLeHi_eq _ _ _ _ cy cx, ← islabLeHi_eq _ _ _ _ cy cz,
    ← islabLeHi_eq _ _ _ _ cz cx, ← islabLeHi_eq _ _ _ _ cz cy,
    ← islabNonneg_eq _ _ cx, ← islabNonneg_eq _ _ cy, ← islabNonneg_eq _ _ cz]

name: irayLineMeetsBoxFwd_iboxOfBox
statement:
theorem irayLineMeetsBoxFwd_iboxOfBox (x d : Pt) (b : Box) :
    irayLineMeetsBoxFwd (iaxisParam d.x x.x) (iaxisParam d.y x.y) (iaxisParam d.z x.z) (iboxOfBox b)
      = rayLineMeetsBoxFwd x d b
proof:
:= by
  rw [irayLineMeetsBoxFwd_eq x d (iboxOfBox b) (by rw [iboxOfBox_d]; exact commonDen_pos b),
    ratBox_iboxOfBox]

name: singleAxisOf_spec
statement:
theorem singleAxisOf_spec (d : Pt) (axis : Nat) (pos : Bool)
    (h : singleAxisOf d = some (axis, pos)) :
    (axis = 0 ∧ d.y = 0 ∧ d.z = 0 ∧ d.x ≠ 0 ∧ pos = decide (0 < d.x)) ∨
    (axis = 1 ∧ d.x = 0 ∧ d.z = 0 ∧ d.y ≠ 0 ∧ pos = decide (0 < d.y)) ∨
    (axis = 2 ∧ d.x = 0 ∧ d.y = 0 ∧ d.z ≠ 0 ∧ pos = decide (0 < d.z))
proof:
:= by
  unfold singleAxisOf at h
  split at h
  · rename_i hc
    simp only [Bool.and_eq_true, beq_iff_eq, Bool.not_eq_true', beq_eq_false_iff_ne] at hc
    simp only [Option.some.injEq, Prod.mk.injEq] at h
    exact Or.inl ⟨h.1.symm, hc.1.1, hc.1.2, hc.2, h.2.symm⟩
  · split at h
    · rename_i hc
      simp only [Bool.and_eq_true, beq_iff_eq, Bool.not_eq_true', beq_eq_false_iff_ne] at hc
      simp only [Option.some.injEq, Prod.mk.injEq] at h
      exact Or.inr (Or.inl ⟨h.1.symm, hc.1.1, hc.1.2, hc.2, h.2.symm⟩)
    · split at h
      · rename_i hc
        simp only [Bool.and_eq_true, beq_iff_eq, Bool.not_eq_true', beq_eq_false_iff_ne] at hc
        simp only [Option.some.injEq, Prod.mk.injEq] at h
        exact Or.inr (Or.inr ⟨h.1.symm, hc.1.1, hc.1.2, hc.2, h.2.symm⟩)
      · exact absurd h (by simp)

name: ilineMeetsBoxAx_eq
statement:
theorem ilineMeetsBoxAx_eq (x d : Pt) (axis : Nat) (pos : Bool)
    (h : singleAxisOf d = some (axis, pos)) (v : IBox) :
    ilineMeetsBoxAx (iaxisParam d.x x.x) (iaxisParam d.y x.y) (iaxisParam d.z x.z) axis v
      = irayLineMeetsBox (iaxisParam d.x x.x) (iaxisParam d.y x.y) (iaxisParam d.z x.z) v
proof:
:= by
  rcases singleAxisOf_spec d axis pos h with ⟨ha, hy, hz, hd, _⟩ | ⟨ha, hx, hz, hd, _⟩ | ⟨ha, hx, hy, hd, _⟩
  · subst ha
    have hpx : (iaxisParam d.x x.x).zero = false := by simp [iaxisParam, Rat.num_ne_zero.mpr hd]
    have hpy : (iaxisParam d.y x.y).zero = true := by simp [iaxisParam, Rat.num_eq_zero.mpr hy]
    have hpz : (iaxisParam d.z x.z).zero = true := by simp [iaxisParam, Rat.num_eq_zero.mpr hz]
    simp [ilineMeetsBoxAx, irayLineMeetsBox, islab, islabLeHi, iaxLo, iaxHi, hpx, hpy, hpz,
      Bool.and_assoc, Bool.and_comm, Bool.and_left_comm]
  · subst ha
    have hpx : (iaxisParam d.x x.x).zero = true := by simp [iaxisParam, Rat.num_eq_zero.mpr hx]
    have hpy : (iaxisParam d.y x.y).zero = false := by simp [iaxisParam, Rat.num_ne_zero.mpr hd]
    have hpz : (iaxisParam d.z x.z).zero = true := by simp [iaxisParam, Rat.num_eq_zero.mpr hz]
    simp [ilineMeetsBoxAx, irayLineMeetsBox, islab, islabLeHi, iaxLo, iaxHi, hpx, hpy, hpz,
      Bool.and_assoc, Bool.and_comm, Bool.and_left_comm]
  · subst ha
    have hpx : (iaxisParam d.x x.x).zero = true := by simp [iaxisParam, Rat.num_eq_zero.mpr hx]
    have hpy : (iaxisParam d.y x.y).zero = true := by simp [iaxisParam, Rat.num_eq_zero.mpr hy]
    have hpz : (iaxisParam d.z x.z).zero = false := by simp [iaxisParam, Rat.num_ne_zero.mpr hd]
    simp [ilineMeetsBoxAx, irayLineMeetsBox, islab, islabLeHi, iaxLo, iaxHi, hpx, hpy, hpz,
      Bool.and_assoc, Bool.and_comm, Bool.and_left_comm]

name: islabNonneg_islab_ax
statement:
theorem islabNonneg_islab_ax (dα xα : ℚ) (pos : Bool) (D nlo nhi : ℤ)
    (hd : dα ≠ 0) (hpos : pos = decide (0 < dα)) (hle : nlo ≤ nhi) :
    islabNonneg (islab (iaxisParam dα xα) D nlo nhi)
      = (if pos then decide ((iaxisParam dα xα).xn * D ≤ nhi * (iaxisParam dα xα).xd)
         else decide (nlo * (iaxisParam dα xα).xd ≤ (iaxisParam dα xα).xn * D))
proof:
:= by
  have hdn : dα.num ≠ 0 := Rat.num_ne_zero.mpr hd
  have hxdp : (0:ℤ) < (xα.den:ℤ) := by exact_mod_cast xα.pos
  have hddp : (0:ℤ) < (dα.den:ℤ) := by exact_mod_cast dα.pos
  have hz : (iaxisParam dα xα).zero = false := by simp [iaxisParam, hdn]
  have hxn : (iaxisParam dα xα).xn = xα.num := by simp [iaxisParam, hdn]
  have hxd : (iaxisParam dα xα).xd = (xα.den:ℤ) := by simp [iaxisParam, hdn]
  set xn := xα.num with hxnv
  set xd : ℤ := (xα.den:ℤ) with hxdv
  have hAB : nlo * xd - xn * D ≤ nhi * xd - xn * D := by
    have : nlo * xd ≤ nhi * xd := by
      apply mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hle (le_of_lt hxdp)
    omega
  unfold islabNonneg islab
  simp only [hz, Bool.false_eq_true, if_false, hxn, hxd]
  by_cases hp : 0 < dα
  · have hnp : 0 < dα.num := Rat.num_pos.mpr hp
    have hsgn : (iaxisParam dα xα).sgnDd = (dα.den:ℤ) := by
      simp [iaxisParam, hdn, hnp, le_of_lt hnp, not_lt.mpr (le_of_lt hnp)]
    rw [hpos]; simp only [hp, decide_true, if_true]
    rw [hsgn]
    
    have hnanb : (dα.den:ℤ) * (nlo * xd - xn * D) ≤ (dα.den:ℤ) * (nhi * xd - xn * D) :=
      mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hAB (le_of_lt hddp)
    rw [if_pos hnanb]
    apply decide_eq_decide.mpr
    constructor
    · intro h
      have : 0 ≤ nhi * xd - xn * D := le_of_mul_le_mul_left (by simpa using h) hddp
      omega
    · intro h
      have : 0 ≤ nhi * xd - xn * D := by omega
      exact mul_nonneg (le_of_lt hddp) this
  · have hlt : dα < 0 := lt_of_le_of_ne (not_lt.mp hp) hd
    have hnn : dα.num < 0 := Rat.num_neg.mpr hlt
    have hsgn : (iaxisParam dα xα).sgnDd = -(dα.den:ℤ) := by
      simp [iaxisParam, hdn, hnn, not_lt.mpr (le_of_lt hnn), asymm hnn]
    rw [hpos]; simp only [hp, decide_false, if_false]
    rw [hsgn]
    have hnbna : -(dα.den:ℤ) * (nhi * xd - xn * D) ≤ -(dα.den:ℤ) * (nlo * xd - xn * D) :=
      mul_le_mul_of_nonpos_left hAB (by omega)
    have hval : (if -(dα.den:ℤ) * (nlo * xd - xn * D) ≤ -(dα.den:ℤ) * (nhi * xd - xn * D)
        then -(dα.den:ℤ) * (nhi * xd - xn * D) else -(dα.den:ℤ) * (nlo * xd - xn * D))
        = -(dα.den:ℤ) * (nlo * xd - xn * D) := by
      split
      · rename_i hh; omega
      · rfl
    rw [hval]
    apply decide_eq_decide.mpr
    constructor
    · intro h
      have h2 : (dα.den:ℤ) * (nlo * xd - xn * D) ≤ 0 := by nlinarith [h]
      have hA : nlo * xd - xn * D ≤ 0 := by
        have hmul : (dα.den:ℤ) * (nlo * xd - xn * D) ≤ (dα.den:ℤ) * 0 := by rw [mul_zero]; exact h2
        exact le_of_mul_le_mul_left hmul hddp
      omega
    · intro h
      have hA : nlo * xd - xn * D ≤ 0 := by omega
      nlinarith [hA, hddp]

name: irayLineMeetsBoxFwd_split
statement:
theorem irayLineMeetsBoxFwd_split (px py pz : IAxisParam) (v : IBox) :
    irayLineMeetsBoxFwd px py pz v
      = (irayLineMeetsBox px py pz v
          && islabNonneg (islab px v.d v.lox v.hix)
          && islabNonneg (islab py v.d v.loy v.hiy)
          && islabNonneg (islab pz v.d v.loz v.hiz))
proof: := rfl

name: irayMeetsBoxFwdAx_eq
statement:
theorem irayMeetsBoxFwdAx_eq (x d : Pt) (axis : Nat) (pos : Bool)
    (h : singleAxisOf d = some (axis, pos)) (v : IBox) :
    irayMeetsBoxFwdAx (iaxisParam d.x x.x) (iaxisParam d.y x.y) (iaxisParam d.z x.z) axis pos v
      = irayLineMeetsBoxFwd (iaxisParam d.x x.x) (iaxisParam d.y x.y) (iaxisParam d.z x.z) v
proof:
:= by
  set px := iaxisParam d.x x.x with hpxdef
  set py := iaxisParam d.y x.y with hpydef
  set pz := iaxisParam d.z x.z with hpzdef
  rw [irayLineMeetsBoxFwd_split, ← ilineMeetsBoxAx_eq x d axis pos h v]
  rcases singleAxisOf_spec d axis pos h with
      ⟨ha, hy, hz, hdd, hpe⟩ | ⟨ha, hx, hz, hdd, hpe⟩ | ⟨ha, hx, hy, hdd, hpe⟩
  · subst ha
    have hpyz : py.zero = true := by simp [hpydef, iaxisParam, Rat.num_eq_zero.mpr hy]
    have hpzz : pz.zero = true := by simp [hpzdef, iaxisParam, Rat.num_eq_zero.mpr hz]
    have hny : islabNonneg (islab py v.d v.loy v.hiy) = true := by
      simp [islabNonneg, islab, hpyz]
    have hnz : islabNonneg (islab pz v.d v.loz v.hiz) = true := by
      simp [islabNonneg, islab, hpzz]
    rw [hny, hnz, Bool.and_true, Bool.and_true]
    by_cases hline : ilineMeetsBoxAx px py pz 0 v = true
    · rw [hline, Bool.true_and]
      have hle : v.lox ≤ v.hix := by
        rw [ilineMeetsBoxAx] at hline
        simp only [iaxLo, iaxHi, Bool.and_eq_true, decide_eq_true_eq] at hline
        exact hline.1.1.1
      rw [irayMeetsBoxFwdAx, hline, Bool.true_and]
      simp only [iaxLo, iaxHi, if_pos (rfl : (0:Nat) = 0), beq_self_eq_true]
      have := islabNonneg_islab_ax d.x x.x pos v.d v.lox v.hix hdd hpe hle
      simpa [hpxdef] using this.symm
    · simp only [Bool.not_eq_true] at hline
      rw [hline, Bool.false_and]
      rw [irayMeetsBoxFwdAx, hline, Bool.false_and]
  · subst ha
    have hpxz : px.zero = true := by simp [hpxdef, iaxisParam, Rat.num_eq_zero.mpr hx]
    have hpzz : pz.zero = true := by simp [hpzdef, iaxisParam, Rat.num_eq_zero.mpr hz]
    have hnx : islabNonneg (islab px v.d v.lox v.hix) = true := by
      simp [islabNonneg, islab, hpxz]
    have hnz : islabNonneg (islab pz v.d v.loz v.hiz) = true := by
      simp [islabNonneg, islab, hpzz]
    by_cases hline : ilineMeetsBoxAx px py pz 1 v = true
    · rw [hline, Bool.true_and, hnx, hnz]
      simp only [Bool.true_and, Bool.and_true]
      have hle : v.loy ≤ v.hiy := by
        rw [ilineMeetsBoxAx] at hline
        simp only [iaxLo, iaxHi, Bool.and_eq_true, decide_eq_true_eq] at hline
        exact hline.1.1.1
      rw [irayMeetsBoxFwdAx, hline, Bool.true_and]
      simp only [iaxLo, iaxHi]
      have := islabNonneg_islab_ax d.y x.y pos v.d v.loy v.hiy hdd hpe hle
      simpa [hpydef] using this.symm
    · simp only [Bool.not_eq_true] at hline
      rw [hline, Bool.false_and, Bool.false_and, Bool.false_and]
      rw [irayMeetsBoxFwdAx, hline, Bool.false_and]
  · subst ha
    have hpxz : px.zero = true := by simp [hpxdef, iaxisParam, Rat.num_eq_zero.mpr hx]
    have hpyz : py.zero = true := by simp [hpydef, iaxisParam, Rat.num_eq_zero.mpr hy]
    have hnx : islabNonneg (islab px v.d v.lox v.hix) = true := by
      simp [islabNonneg, islab, hpxz]
    have hny : islabNonneg (islab py v.d v.loy v.hiy) = true := by
      simp [islabNonneg, islab, hpyz]
    by_cases hline : ilineMeetsBoxAx px py pz 2 v = true
    · rw [hline, Bool.true_and, hnx, hny]
      simp only [Bool.true_and, Bool.and_true]
      have hle : v.loz ≤ v.hiz := by
        rw [ilineMeetsBoxAx] at hline
        simp only [iaxLo, iaxHi, Bool.and_eq_true, decide_eq_true_eq] at hline
        exact hline.1.1.1
      rw [irayMeetsBoxFwdAx, hline, Bool.true_and]
      simp only [iaxLo, iaxHi]
      have := islabNonneg_islab_ax d.z x.z pos v.d v.loz v.hiz hdd hpe hle
      simpa [hpzdef] using this.symm
    · simp only [Bool.not_eq_true] at hline
      rw [hline, Bool.false_and, Bool.false_and, Bool.false_and]
      rw [irayMeetsBoxFwdAx, hline, Bool.false_and]

name: arr_getD
statement:
private theorem arr_getD {α : Type} (a : Array α) (i : ℕ) (d : α) (hi : i < a.size) :
    a.getD i d = a[i]
proof:
:= by
  rw [Array.getD]; simp [hi]

name: fdiv_eq_floor
statement: theorem fdiv_eq_floor (n D : ℤ) (h : 0 < D) : Int.fdiv n D = ⌊(n : ℚ)/(D : ℚ)⌋
proof:
:= by
  have h1 := Int.fdiv_add_fmod n D
  have h2 : 0 ≤ Int.fmod n D := Int.fmod_nonneg' n (by omega)
  have h3 : Int.fmod n D < D := Int.fmod_lt_of_pos n h
  symm
  rw [Int.floor_eq_iff]
  refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
  · rw [le_div_iff₀ (by exact_mod_cast h)]
    have : ((Int.fdiv n D) * D : ℤ) ≤ n := by nlinarith
    exact_mod_cast this
  · rw [div_lt_iff₀ (by exact_mod_cast h)]
    have hlt : n < ((Int.fdiv n D + 1) * D : ℤ) := by nlinarith
    have h4 := (by exact_mod_cast hlt : (n:ℚ) < ((Int.fdiv n D + 1 : ℤ) : ℚ) * (D:ℚ))
    push_cast at h4 ⊢
    linarith

name: two_zpow_pos
statement: theorem two_zpow_pos (e : ℤ) : (0:ℚ) < (2:ℚ)^e
proof: := by positivity

name: gcoord_mono
statement: theorem gcoord_mono (a : ℚ) (e : ℤ) {v w : ℚ} (h : v ≤ w) : gcoord a e v ≤ gcoord a e w
proof:
:= by
  unfold gcoord
  exact (div_le_div_iff_of_pos_right (two_zpow_pos e)).mpr (by linarith)

name: gcoord_sub
statement:
theorem gcoord_sub (a : ℚ) (e : ℤ) (v w : ℚ) :
    gcoord a e v - gcoord a e w = (2:ℚ)^(-e) * (v - w)
proof:
:= by
  unfold gcoord
  rw [zpow_neg]
  field_simp

name: dyFloor_eq_floor
statement:
theorem dyFloor_eq_floor (n d e : ℤ) (hd : 0 < d) :
    dyFloor n d e = ⌊((n : ℚ)/(d : ℚ)) / (2:ℚ)^e⌋
proof:
:= by
  have hdQ : (0:ℚ) < (d:ℚ) := by exact_mod_cast hd
  unfold dyFloor
  split
  · rename_i he
    rw [fdiv_eq_floor _ _ (by positivity)]
    congr 1
    push_cast
    rw [show ((2:ℚ))^(e.toNat) = (2:ℚ)^e by
      rw [← zpow_natCast (2:ℚ) e.toNat, Int.toNat_of_nonneg he]]
    field_simp
  · rename_i he
    push_neg at he
    have hk : (((-e).toNat : ℕ) : ℤ) = -e := Int.toNat_of_nonneg (by omega)
    rw [fdiv_eq_floor _ _ hd]
    congr 1
    push_cast
    rw [show ((2:ℚ))^((-e).toNat) = (2:ℚ)^(-e) by
      rw [← zpow_natCast (2:ℚ) ((-e).toNat), hk]]
    rw [zpow_neg]
    field_simp
    left; ring

name: dyCeil_eq_ceil
statement:
theorem dyCeil_eq_ceil (n d e : ℤ) (hd : 0 < d) :
    dyCeil n d e = ⌈((n : ℚ)/(d : ℚ)) / (2:ℚ)^e⌉
proof:
:= by
  unfold dyCeil
  rw [dyFloor_eq_floor _ _ _ hd]
  rw [show (((-n : ℤ)):ℚ)/(d:ℚ)/(2:ℚ)^e = -(((n:ℤ):ℚ)/(d:ℚ)/(2:ℚ)^e) by push_cast; ring]
  rw [Int.floor_neg, neg_neg]

name: dyFloor_congr
statement:
theorem dyFloor_congr {n d n' d' : ℤ} (e : ℤ) (hd : 0 < d) (hd' : 0 < d')
    (hv : (n:ℚ)/(d:ℚ) = (n':ℚ)/(d':ℚ)) : dyFloor n d e = dyFloor n' d' e
proof:
:= by
  rw [dyFloor_eq_floor _ _ _ hd, dyFloor_eq_floor _ _ _ hd', hv]

name: dyCeil_congr
statement:
theorem dyCeil_congr {n d n' d' : ℤ} (e : ℤ) (hd : 0 < d) (hd' : 0 < d')
    (hv : (n:ℚ)/(d:ℚ) = (n':ℚ)/(d':ℚ)) : dyCeil n d e = dyCeil n' d' e
proof:
:= by
  rw [dyCeil_eq_ceil _ _ _ hd, dyCeil_eq_ceil _ _ _ hd', hv]

name: mant_frac
statement:
theorem mant_frac (v a : ℚ) :
    (0:ℤ) < (v.den : ℤ) * (a.den : ℤ) ∧
    ((v.num * (a.den : ℤ) - a.num * (v.den : ℤ) : ℤ) : ℚ) / (((v.den : ℤ) * (a.den : ℤ) : ℤ) : ℚ)
      = v - a
proof:
:= by
  have hv : (0:ℚ) < (v.den:ℚ) := by exact_mod_cast v.pos
  have ha : (0:ℚ) < (a.den:ℚ) := by exact_mod_cast a.pos
  refine ⟨by positivity, ?_⟩
  have hv' : (v.num:ℚ) = v * (v.den:ℚ) := (div_eq_iff (ne_of_gt hv)).mp (Rat.num_div_den v)
  have ha' : (a.num:ℚ) = a * (a.den:ℚ) := (div_eq_iff (ne_of_gt ha)).mp (Rat.num_div_den a)
  push_cast
  field_simp
  rw [hv', ha']
  ring

name: mantFloor_eq
statement: theorem mantFloor_eq (v a : ℚ) (e : ℤ) : mantFloor v a e = ⌊gcoord a e v⌋
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨hpos, hval⟩ := mant_frac v a
  unfold mantFloor gcoord
  rw [dyFloor_eq_floor _ _ _ hpos, hval]

name: mantCeil_eq
statement: theorem mantCeil_eq (v a : ℚ) (e : ℤ) : mantCeil v a e = ⌈gcoord a e v⌉
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨hpos, hval⟩ := mant_frac v a
  unfold mantCeil gcoord
  rw [dyCeil_eq_ceil _ _ _ hpos, hval]

name: mantFloor_le
statement: theorem mantFloor_le (v a : ℚ) (e : ℤ) : ((mantFloor v a e : ℤ) : ℚ) ≤ gcoord a e v
proof:
:= by
  rw [mantFloor_eq]; exact Int.floor_le _

name: le_mantCeil
statement: theorem le_mantCeil (v a : ℚ) (e : ℤ) : gcoord a e v ≤ ((mantCeil v a e : ℤ) : ℚ)
proof:
:= by
  rw [mantCeil_eq]; exact Int.le_ceil _

name: mantFloor_le_mantCeil_of_le
statement:
theorem mantFloor_le_mantCeil_of_le {v w : ℚ} (a : ℚ) (e : ℤ) (h : v ≤ w) :
    mantFloor v a e ≤ mantCeil w a e
proof:
:= by
  rw [mantFloor_eq, mantCeil_eq]
  exact le_trans (Int.floor_le_floor (gcoord_mono a e h)) (Int.floor_le_ceil _)

name: msubbox_refl
statement: theorem msubbox_refl (m : MBox) : MSubbox m m
proof:
:=
  ⟨le_refl _, le_refl _, le_refl _, le_refl _, le_refl _, le_refl _⟩

name: msubbox_trans
statement: theorem msubbox_trans {a b c : MBox} (h1 : MSubbox a b) (h2 : MSubbox b c) : MSubbox a c
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨a1,a2,a3,a4,a5,a6⟩ := h1
  obtain ⟨b1,b2,b3,b4,b5,b6⟩ := h2
  exact ⟨b1.trans a1, b2.trans a2, b3.trans a3, a4.trans b4, a5.trans b5, a6.trans b6⟩

name: munion_left
statement: theorem munion_left (u v : MBox) : MSubbox u (munion u v)
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩ <;> simp only [munion] <;> split <;> omega

name: munion_right
statement: theorem munion_right (u v : MBox) : MSubbox v (munion u v)
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩ <;> simp only [munion] <;> split <;> omega

name: mboxOfBox_lox
statement:
theorem mboxOfBox_lox (ax ay az : ℚ) (e : ℤ) (b : Box) :
    (mboxOfBox ax ay az e b).lox = mantFloor b.lox ax e
proof: := rfl

name: mboxOfBox_loy
statement:
theorem mboxOfBox_loy (ax ay az : ℚ) (e : ℤ) (b : Box) :
    (mboxOfBox ax ay az e b).loy = mantFloor b.loy ay e
proof: := rfl

name: mboxOfBox_loz
statement:
theorem mboxOfBox_loz (ax ay az : ℚ) (e : ℤ) (b : Box) :
    (mboxOfBox ax ay az e b).loz = mantFloor b.loz az e
proof: := rfl

name: mboxOfBox_hix
statement:
theorem mboxOfBox_hix (ax ay az : ℚ) (e : ℤ) (b : Box) :
    (mboxOfBox ax ay az e b).hix = mantCeil b.hix ax e
proof: := rfl

name: mboxOfBox_hiy
statement:
theorem mboxOfBox_hiy (ax ay az : ℚ) (e : ℤ) (b : Box) :
    (mboxOfBox ax ay az e b).hiy = mantCeil b.hiy ay e
proof: := rfl

name: mboxOfBox_hiz
statement:
theorem mboxOfBox_hiz (ax ay az : ℚ) (e : ℤ) (b : Box) :
    (mboxOfBox ax ay az e b).hiz = mantCeil b.hiz az e
proof: := rfl

name: mboxOfTree_leaf_msubbox
statement:
theorem mboxOfTree_leaf_msubbox (mbs : Array MBox) :
    ∀ (t : Impl.BVH.Tree) (k : ℕ), k ∈ t.leaves →
      MSubbox (mbs.getD k default) (mboxOfTree mbs t)
proof:
:= by
  intro t
  induction t with
  | leaf j b =>
    intro k hk
    simp only [Impl.BVH.Tree.leaves, List.mem_singleton] at hk
    subst hk
    exact msubbox_refl _
  | node b l r ihl ihr =>
    intro k hk
    simp only [Impl.BVH.Tree.leaves, List.mem_append] at hk
    simp only [mboxOfTree]
    rcases hk with h | h
    · exact msubbox_trans (ihl k h) (munion_left _ _)
    · exact msubbox_trans (ihr k h) (munion_right _ _)

name: mbs_getD_eq
statement:
theorem mbs_getD_eq (boxes : Array Box) (ax ay az : ℚ) (e : ℤ) (k : ℕ) (hk : k < boxes.size) :
    (boxes.map (mboxOfBox ax ay az e)).getD k default = mboxOfBox ax ay az e (boxAt boxes k)
proof:
:= by
  have hk' : k < (boxes.map (mboxOfBox ax ay az e)).size := by rwa [Array.size_map]
  rw [arr_getD _ _ _ hk', Array.getElem_map, boxAt, arr_getD _ _ _ hk]

name: moverlap_of_overlap
statement:
theorem moverlap_of_overlap (h : BVH) (q b : Box) (hov : overlap q b = true) :
    moverlap (mboxQ h q) (mboxOfBox h.ax h.ay h.az h.ce b) = true
proof:
:= by
  simp only [overlap, Bool.and_eq_true, decide_eq_true_eq] at hov
  obtain ⟨⟨⟨⟨⟨h1, h2⟩, h3⟩, h4⟩, h5⟩, h6⟩ := hov
  simp only [moverlap, mboxQ, mboxOfBox_lox, mboxOfBox_loy, mboxOfBox_loz,
    mboxOfBox_hix, mboxOfBox_hiy, mboxOfBox_hiz, Bool.and_eq_true, decide_eq_true_eq]
  exact ⟨⟨⟨⟨⟨mantFloor_le_mantCeil_of_le _ _ h1, mantFloor_le_mantCeil_of_le _ _ h2⟩,
    mantFloor_le_mantCeil_of_le _ _ h3⟩, mantFloor_le_mantCeil_of_le _ _ h4⟩,
    mantFloor_le_mantCeil_of_le _ _ h5⟩, mantFloor_le_mantCeil_of_le _ _ h6⟩

name: moverlap_mono_right
statement:
theorem moverlap_mono_right (qq : MBox) {m m' : MBox} (hsub : MSubbox m m')
    (hov : moverlap qq m = true) : moverlap qq m' = true
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨s1, s2, s3, s4, s5, s6⟩ := hsub
  simp only [moverlap, Bool.and_eq_true, decide_eq_true_eq] at hov ⊢
  obtain ⟨⟨⟨⟨⟨h1, h2⟩, h3⟩, h4⟩, h5⟩, h6⟩ := hov
  exact ⟨⟨⟨⟨⟨h1.trans s4, s1.trans h2⟩, h3.trans s5⟩, s2.trans h4⟩, h5.trans s6⟩, s3.trans h6⟩

name: axisSlab_ok_le
statement:
theorem axisSlab_ok_le (dα xα loα hiα : ℚ) (h : (axisSlab dα xα loα hiα).ok = true) :
    loα ≤ hiα
proof:
:= by
  unfold axisSlab at h
  split at h
  · simp only [Bool.and_eq_true, decide_eq_true_eq] at h
    exact le_trans h.1 h.2
  · simpa using h

name: daxisParam_zero_false
statement:
theorem daxisParam_zero_false (dα xα a : ℚ) (e : ℤ) (hd : dα ≠ 0) :
    (daxisParam dα xα a e).zero = false
proof:
:= by
  simp [daxisParam, Rat.num_ne_zero.mpr hd]

name: daxisParam_absDn_pos
statement:
theorem daxisParam_absDn_pos (dα xα a : ℚ) (e : ℤ) (hd : dα ≠ 0) :
    0 < (daxisParam dα xα a e).absDn
proof:
:= by
  have hdn : dα.num ≠ 0 := Rat.num_ne_zero.mpr hd
  simp only [daxisParam, if_neg hdn]
  split <;> omega

name: daxisParam_xlo
statement:
theorem daxisParam_xlo (dα xα a : ℚ) (e : ℤ) :
    (daxisParam dα xα a e).xlo = ⌊gcoord a e xα⌋
proof:
:= by
  have hv : (0:ℚ) < (xα.den:ℚ) := by exact_mod_cast xα.pos
  have ha : (0:ℚ) < (a.den:ℚ) := by exact_mod_cast a.pos
  have hpos : (0:ℤ) < (a.den : ℤ) * (xα.den : ℤ) := by positivity
  have hval : ((xα.num * (a.den : ℤ) - a.num * (xα.den : ℤ) : ℤ) : ℚ)
      / (((a.den : ℤ) * (xα.den : ℤ) : ℤ) : ℚ) = xα - a := by
    have hv' : (xα.num:ℚ) = xα * (xα.den:ℚ) := (div_eq_iff (ne_of_gt hv)).mp (Rat.num_div_den xα)
    have ha' : (a.num:ℚ) = a * (a.den:ℚ) := (div_eq_iff (ne_of_gt ha)).mp (Rat.num_div_den a)
    push_cast
    field_simp
    rw [hv', ha']
    ring
  have : (daxisParam dα xα a e).xlo
      = dyFloor (xα.num * (a.den : ℤ) - a.num * (xα.den : ℤ)) ((a.den : ℤ) * (xα.den : ℤ)) e := by
    unfold daxisParam; dsimp only; split <;> rfl
  rw [this, dyFloor_eq_floor _ _ _ hpos, hval]
  rfl

name: daxisParam_xhi
statement:
theorem daxisParam_xhi (dα xα a : ℚ) (e : ℤ) :
    (daxisParam dα xα a e).xhi = ⌈gcoord a e xα⌉
proof:
:= by
  have hv : (0:ℚ) < (xα.den:ℚ) := by exact_mod_cast xα.pos
  have ha : (0:ℚ) < (a.den:ℚ) := by exact_mod_cast a.pos
  have hpos : (0:ℤ) < (a.den : ℤ) * (xα.den : ℤ) := by positivity
  have hval : ((xα.num * (a.den : ℤ) - a.num * (xα.den : ℤ) : ℤ) : ℚ)
      / (((a.den : ℤ) * (xα.den : ℤ) : ℤ) : ℚ) = xα - a := by
    have hv' : (xα.num:ℚ) = xα * (xα.den:ℚ) := (div_eq_iff (ne_of_gt hv)).mp (Rat.num_div_den xα)
    have ha' : (a.num:ℚ) = a * (a.den:ℚ) := (div_eq_iff (ne_of_gt ha)).mp (Rat.num_div_den a)
    push_cast
    field_simp
    rw [hv', ha']
    ring
  have : (daxisParam dα xα a e).xhi
      = dyCeil (xα.num * (a.den : ℤ) - a.num * (xα.den : ℤ)) ((a.den : ℤ) * (xα.den : ℤ)) e := by
    unfold daxisParam; dsimp only; split <;> rfl
  rw [this, dyCeil_eq_ceil _ _ _ hpos, hval]
  rfl

name: daxisParam_xlo_le
statement:
theorem daxisParam_xlo_le (dα xα a : ℚ) (e : ℤ) :
    (((daxisParam dα xα a e).xlo : ℤ) : ℚ) ≤ gcoord a e xα
proof:
:= by
  rw [daxisParam_xlo]; exact Int.floor_le _

name: le_daxisParam_xhi
statement:
theorem le_daxisParam_xhi (dα xα a : ℚ) (e : ℤ) :
    gcoord a e xα ≤ (((daxisParam dα xα a e).xhi : ℤ) : ℚ)
proof:
:= by
  rw [daxisParam_xhi]; exact Int.le_ceil _

name: daxisParam_ok
statement: theorem daxisParam_ok (dα xα a : ℚ) (e : ℤ) : DParamOK (daxisParam dα xα a e)
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
  · rw [daxisParam_xlo, daxisParam_xhi]; exact Int.floor_le_ceil _
  · intro hz
    by_cases hd : dα = 0
    · rw [daxisParam, if_pos (Rat.num_eq_zero.mpr hd)] at hz; simp at hz
    · exact daxisParam_absDn_pos dα xα a e hd

name: rmin_mul_pos
statement: theorem rmin_mul_pos {c a b : ℚ} (hc : 0 < c) : c * rmin a b = rmin (c*a) (c*b)
proof:
:= by
  unfold rmin
  by_cases h : a ≤ b
  · rw [if_pos h, if_pos (by nlinarith : c*a ≤ c*b)]
  · rw [if_neg h, if_neg (fun h' => h (by nlinarith : a ≤ b))]

name: rmax_mul_pos
statement: theorem rmax_mul_pos {c a b : ℚ} (hc : 0 < c) : c * rmax a b = rmax (c*a) (c*b)
proof:
:= by
  unfold rmax
  by_cases h : a ≤ b
  · rw [if_pos h, if_pos (by nlinarith : c*a ≤ c*b)]
  · rw [if_neg h, if_neg (fun h' => h (by nlinarith : a ≤ b))]

name: div_le_div_of_le_neg
statement: private theorem div_le_div_of_le_neg {u u' c : ℚ} (hc : c < 0) (h : u ≤ u') : u'/c ≤ u/c
proof:
:= by
  rw [div_eq_mul_inv, div_eq_mul_inv]
  have hci : c⁻¹ < 0 := inv_neg''.mpr hc
  nlinarith [h, hci]

name: rmin_div_mono4
statement:
theorem rmin_div_mono4 {u u' v' v c : ℚ} (hc : c ≠ 0)
    (h1 : u ≤ u') (h2 : u' ≤ v') (h3 : v' ≤ v) :
    rmin (u/c) (v/c) ≤ rmin (u'/c) (v'/c)
proof:
:= by
  rcases lt_trichotomy c 0 with hneg | hzero | hpos
  · have e1 : v/c ≤ v'/c := div_le_div_of_le_neg hneg h3
    have e2 : v'/c ≤ u'/c := div_le_div_of_le_neg hneg h2
    have e3 : u'/c ≤ u/c := div_le_div_of_le_neg hneg h1
    rw [rmin_eq_right (le_trans (le_trans e1 e2) e3), rmin_eq_right e2]
    exact e1
  · exact absurd hzero hc
  · have e1 : u/c ≤ u'/c := (div_le_div_iff_of_pos_right hpos).mpr h1
    have e2 : u'/c ≤ v'/c := (div_le_div_iff_of_pos_right hpos).mpr h2
    have e3 : v'/c ≤ v/c := (div_le_div_iff_of_pos_right hpos).mpr h3
    rw [rmin_eq_left (le_trans (le_trans e1 e2) e3), rmin_eq_left e2]
    exact e1

name: rmax_div_mono4
statement:
theorem rmax_div_mono4 {u u' v' v c : ℚ} (hc : c ≠ 0)
    (h1 : u ≤ u') (h2 : u' ≤ v') (h3 : v' ≤ v) :
    rmax (u'/c) (v'/c) ≤ rmax (u/c) (v/c)
proof:
:= by
  rcases lt_trichotomy c 0 with hneg | hzero | hpos
  · have e1 : v/c ≤ v'/c := div_le_div_of_le_neg hneg h3
    have e2 : v'/c ≤ u'/c := div_le_div_of_le_neg hneg h2
    have e3 : u'/c ≤ u/c := div_le_div_of_le_neg hneg h1
    rw [rmax_eq_left (le_trans (le_trans e1 e2) e3), rmax_eq_left e2]
    exact e3
  · exact absurd hzero hc
  · have e1 : u/c ≤ u'/c := (div_le_div_iff_of_pos_right hpos).mpr h1
    have e2 : u'/c ≤ v'/c := (div_le_div_iff_of_pos_right hpos).mpr h2
    have e3 : v'/c ≤ v/c := (div_le_div_iff_of_pos_right hpos).mpr h3
    rw [rmax_eq_right (le_trans (le_trans e1 e2) e3), rmax_eq_right e2]
    exact e3

name: dslab_endpoint_div
statement:
theorem dslab_endpoint_div (dα xα a : ℚ) (e : ℤ) (hd : dα ≠ 0) (m x : ℤ) :
    (((daxisParam dα xα a e).sgnDd * (m - x) : ℤ) : ℚ)
        / (((daxisParam dα xα a e).absDn : ℤ) : ℚ)
      = ((m : ℚ) - (x : ℚ)) / dα
proof:
:= by
  have hdn : dα.num ≠ 0 := Rat.num_ne_zero.mpr hd
  have hddQ : (0:ℚ) < (dα.den:ℚ) := by exact_mod_cast dα.pos
  have hdαQ : (dα.num:ℚ) = dα * (dα.den:ℚ) := (div_eq_iff (ne_of_gt hddQ)).mp (Rat.num_div_den dα)
  rcases lt_trichotomy dα.num 0 with hlt | heq | hgt
  · have h1 : ¬ (0 < dα.num) := by omega
    simp only [daxisParam, if_neg hdn, if_neg h1, if_pos hlt]
    push_cast
    field_simp
    rw [hdαQ]
    ring
  · exact absurd heq hdn
  · have h2 : ¬ (dα.num < 0) := by omega
    simp only [daxisParam, if_neg hdn, if_pos hgt, if_neg h2]
    push_cast
    field_simp
    rw [hdαQ]
    ring

name: dslab_zero_eq
proof:
:= by
  simp [dslab, h]

name: dslab_nz_eq
statement:
theorem dslab_nz_eq (ap : DAxisParam) (mlo mhi : ℤ) (h : ap.zero = false) :
    dslab ap mlo mhi =
      { ok := decide (mlo ≤ mhi),
        loN := (if ap.sgnDd * (mlo - ap.xhi) ≤ ap.sgnDd * (mhi - ap.xlo)
                then ap.sgnDd * (mlo - ap.xhi) else ap.sgnDd * (mhi - ap.xlo)),
        hiN := (if ap.sgnDd * (mlo - ap.xhi) ≤ ap.sgnDd * (mhi - ap.xlo)
                then ap.sgnDd * (mhi - ap.xlo) else ap.sgnDd * (mlo - ap.xhi)),
        den := ap.absDn, bdd := true }
proof:
:= by
  simp [dslab, h]

name: dslab_den_pos
statement:
theorem dslab_den_pos {ap : DAxisParam} (hok : DParamOK ap) (mlo mhi : ℤ) :
    0 < (dslab ap mlo mhi).den
proof:
:= by
  by_cases h : ap.zero = true
  · rw [dslab_zero_eq ap mlo mhi h]; norm_num
  · simp only [Bool.not_eq_true] at h
    rw [dslab_nz_eq ap mlo mhi h]; exact hok.2 h

name: dslab_lo_div
statement:
theorem dslab_lo_div (dα xα a : ℚ) (e : ℤ) (hd : dα ≠ 0) (mlo mhi : ℤ) :
    (((dslab (daxisParam dα xα a e) mlo mhi).loN : ℤ) : ℚ)
        / (((dslab (daxisParam dα xα a e) mlo mhi).den : ℤ) : ℚ)
      = rmin (((mlo:ℚ) - ((daxisParam dα xα a e).xhi : ℤ))/dα)
             (((mhi:ℚ) - ((daxisParam dα xα a e).xlo : ℤ))/dα)
proof:
:= by
  set ap := daxisParam dα xα a e with hap
  have hz : ap.zero = false := by rw [hap]; exact daxisParam_zero_false dα xα a e hd
  have hpos : (0:ℚ) < ((ap.absDn : ℤ) : ℚ) := by
    have := daxisParam_absDn_pos dα xα a e hd
    rw [← hap] at this
    exact_mod_cast this
  rw [dslab_nz_eq ap mlo mhi hz]
  simp only []
  rw [imin_div _ _ _ hpos, hap, dslab_endpoint_div dα xα a e hd mlo _,
    dslab_endpoint_div dα xα a e hd mhi _]

name: dslab_hi_div
statement:
theorem dslab_hi_div (dα xα a : ℚ) (e : ℤ) (hd : dα ≠ 0) (mlo mhi : ℤ) :
    (((dslab (daxisParam dα xα a e) mlo mhi).hiN : ℤ) : ℚ)
        / (((dslab (daxisParam dα xα a e) mlo mhi).den : ℤ) : ℚ)
      = rmax (((mlo:ℚ) - ((daxisParam dα xα a e).xhi : ℤ))/dα)
             (((mhi:ℚ) - ((daxisParam dα xα a e).xlo : ℤ))/dα)
proof:
:= by
  set ap := daxisParam dα xα a e with hap
  have hz : ap.zero = false := by rw [hap]; exact daxisParam_zero_false dα xα a e hd
  have hpos : (0:ℚ) < ((ap.absDn : ℤ) : ℚ) := by
    have := daxisParam_absDn_pos dα xα a e hd
    rw [← hap] at this
    exact_mod_cast this
  rw [dslab_nz_eq ap mlo mhi hz]
  simp only []
  rw [imax_div _ _ _ hpos, hap, dslab_endpoint_div dα xα a e hd mlo _,
    dslab_endpoint_div dα xα a e hd mhi _]

name: dslab_dom
statement:
theorem dslab_dom (dα xα a : ℚ) (e : ℤ) (loα hiα : ℚ) (mlo mhi : ℤ)
    (hval : loα ≤ hiα)
    (hlo : ((mlo : ℤ) : ℚ) ≤ gcoord a e loα) (hhi : gcoord a e hiα ≤ ((mhi : ℤ) : ℚ)) :
    SlabDom ((2:ℚ)^(-e)) (axisSlab dα xα loα hiα) (dslab (daxisParam dα xα a e) mlo mhi)
proof:
:= by
  set ap := daxisParam dα xα a e with hap
  have hxlo : ((ap.xlo : ℤ) : ℚ) ≤ gcoord a e xα := by rw [hap]; exact daxisParam_xlo_le _ _ _ _
  have hxhi : gcoord a e xα ≤ ((ap.xhi : ℤ) : ℚ) := by rw [hap]; exact le_daxisParam_xhi _ _ _ _
  have hmlomhi : mlo ≤ mhi := by
    have : ((mlo:ℤ):ℚ) ≤ ((mhi:ℤ):ℚ) :=
      le_trans hlo (le_trans (gcoord_mono a e hval) hhi)
    exact_mod_cast this
  by_cases hd : dα = 0
  · 
    have hz : ap.zero = true := by
      rw [hap]; simp [daxisParam, Rat.num_eq_zero.mpr hd]
    refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
    · intro hok
      simp only [axisSlab, if_pos hd, Bool.and_eq_true, decide_eq_true_eq] at hok
      rw [dslab_zero_eq ap mlo mhi hz]
      simp only [Bool.and_eq_true, decide_eq_true_eq]
      constructor
      · have : ((mlo:ℤ):ℚ) ≤ ((ap.xhi:ℤ):ℚ) :=
          le_trans hlo (le_trans (gcoord_mono a e hok.1) hxhi)
        exact_mod_cast this
      · have : ((ap.xlo:ℤ):ℚ) ≤ ((mhi:ℤ):ℚ) :=
          le_trans hxlo (le_trans (gcoord_mono a e hok.2) hhi)
        exact_mod_cast this
    · rw [dslab_zero_eq ap mlo mhi hz]; simp [axisSlab, hd]
    · simp [axisSlab, hd]
    · rw [dslab_zero_eq ap mlo mhi hz]; norm_num
    · intro hbdd; simp [axisSlab, hd] at hbdd
    · intro hbdd; simp [axisSlab, hd] at hbdd
  · 
    have hz : ap.zero = false := by rw [hap]; exact daxisParam_zero_false dα xα a e hd
    have hden : (0:ℚ) < (2:ℚ)^(-e) := two_zpow_pos _
    
    have hu : ((mlo:ℤ):ℚ) - ((ap.xhi:ℤ):ℚ) ≤ gcoord a e loα - gcoord a e xα := by linarith
    have huv : gcoord a e loα - gcoord a e xα ≤ gcoord a e hiα - gcoord a e xα := by
      have := gcoord_mono a e hval; linarith
    have hv : gcoord a e hiα - gcoord a e xα ≤ ((mhi:ℤ):ℚ) - ((ap.xlo:ℤ):ℚ) := by linarith
    have hgl : gcoord a e loα - gcoord a e xα = (2:ℚ)^(-e) * (loα - xα) := gcoord_sub a e loα xα
    have hgh : gcoord a e hiα - gcoord a e xα = (2:ℚ)^(-e) * (hiα - xα) := gcoord_sub a e hiα xα
    refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
    · intro _
      rw [dslab_nz_eq ap mlo mhi hz]
      simpa using hmlomhi
    · rw [dslab_nz_eq ap mlo mhi hz]; simp [axisSlab, hd]
    · exact axisSlab_den_pos _ _ _ _
    · rw [dslab_nz_eq ap mlo mhi hz]
      exact_mod_cast (by rw [hap]; exact daxisParam_absDn_pos dα xα a e hd :
        0 < ap.absDn)
    · intro _
      rw [hap, dslab_lo_div dα xα a e hd mlo mhi, ← hap]
      rw [axisSlab_lo_div dα xα loα hiα hd]
      rw [rmin_mul_pos hden]
      rw [show (2:ℚ)^(-e) * ((loα - xα)/dα) = ((2:ℚ)^(-e) * (loα - xα))/dα by ring,
          show (2:ℚ)^(-e) * ((hiα - xα)/dα) = ((2:ℚ)^(-e) * (hiα - xα))/dα by ring,
          ← hgl, ← hgh]
      exact rmin_div_mono4 hd hu huv hv
    · intro _
      rw [hap, dslab_hi_div dα xα a e hd mlo mhi, ← hap]
      rw [axisSlab_hi_div dα xα loα hiα hd]
      rw [rmax_mul_pos hden]
      rw [show (2:ℚ)^(-e) * ((loα - xα)/dα) = ((2:ℚ)^(-e) * (loα - xα))/dα by ring,
          show (2:ℚ)^(-e) * ((hiα - xα)/dα) = ((2:ℚ)^(-e) * (hiα - xα))/dα by ring,
          ← hgl, ← hgh]
      exact rmax_div_mono4 hd hu huv hv

name: islabLeHi_of_slabLeHi
proof:
:= by
  unfold islabLeHi
  by_cases hb : si.bdd && ti.bdd
  · rw [if_pos hb]
    rw [Bool.and_eq_true] at hb
    obtain ⟨hsb, htb⟩ := hb
    have hsbt : s.bdd = true := by rw [hs.ebdd]; exact hsb
    have htbt : t.bdd = true := by rw [ht.ebdd]; exact htb
    unfold slabLeHi at h
    rw [if_pos (by rw [hsbt, htbt]; rfl)] at h
    simp only [decide_eq_true_eq] at h ⊢
    have hq : s.loN/s.den ≤ t.hiN/t.den := (cross_le s.den t.den hs.sden ht.sden).mpr h
    have step : ((si.loN : ℤ):ℚ)/((si.den : ℤ):ℚ) ≤ ((ti.hiN : ℤ):ℚ)/((ti.den : ℤ):ℚ) :=
      le_trans (hs.elo hsbt) (le_trans (by nlinarith [hq, hσ]) (ht.ehi htbt))
    have hsd : (0:ℚ) < ((si.den : ℤ):ℚ) := by exact_mod_cast hs.siden
    have htd : (0:ℚ) < ((ti.den : ℤ):ℚ) := by exact_mod_cast ht.siden
    have := (cross_le ((si.den : ℤ):ℚ) ((ti.den : ℤ):ℚ) hsd htd).mp step
    exact_mod_cast this
  · rw [if_neg hb]

name: islabNonneg_of_slabNonneg
statement:
theorem islabNonneg_of_slabNonneg {σ : ℚ} (hσ : 0 < σ) {s : AxisSlab} {si : IAxisSlab}
    (hs : SlabDom σ s si) (h : slabNonneg s = true) : islabNonneg si = true
proof:
:= by
  unfold islabNonneg
  by_cases hb : si.bdd = true
  · rw [if_pos hb]
    have hsbt : s.bdd = true := by rw [hs.ebdd]; exact hb
    unfold slabNonneg at h
    rw [if_pos hsbt] at h
    simp only [decide_eq_true_eq] at h ⊢
    have h0 : (0:ℚ) ≤ s.hiN / s.den := div_nonneg (by exact_mod_cast h) (le_of_lt hs.sden)
    have h1 : (0:ℚ) ≤ ((si.hiN : ℤ):ℚ)/((si.den : ℤ):ℚ) :=
      le_trans (by nlinarith [h0, hσ]) (hs.ehi hsbt)
    have hsd : (0:ℚ) < ((si.den : ℤ):ℚ) := by exact_mod_cast hs.siden
    by_contra hc
    push_neg at hc
    have : ((si.hiN : ℤ):ℚ)/((si.den : ℤ):ℚ) < 0 :=
      div_neg_of_neg_of_pos (by exact_mod_cast hc) hsd
    linarith
  · simp only [Bool.not_eq_true] at hb
    rw [hb]; simp

name: slabDoms_of
statement:
private theorem slabDoms_of (ax ay az : ℚ) (e : ℤ) (x d : Pt) (b : Box)
    (hx : b.lox ≤ b.hix) (hy : b.loy ≤ b.hiy) (hz : b.loz ≤ b.hiz) :
    SlabDom ((2:ℚ)^(-e)) (axisSlab d.x x.x b.lox b.hix)
      (dslab (daxisParam d.x x.x ax e) (mboxOfBox ax ay az e b).lox
        (mboxOfBox ax ay az e b).hix) ∧
    SlabDom ((2:ℚ)^(-e)) (axisSlab d.y x.y b.loy b.hiy)
      (dslab (daxisParam d.y x.y ay e) (mboxOfBox ax ay az e b).loy
        (mboxOfBox ax ay az e b).hiy) ∧
    SlabDom ((2:ℚ)^(-e)) (axisSlab d.z x.z b.loz b.hiz)
      (dslab (daxisParam d.z x.z az e) (mboxOfBox ax ay az e b).loz
        (mboxOfBox ax ay az e b).hiz)
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · rw [mboxOfBox_lox, mboxOfBox_hix]
    exact dslab_dom d.x x.x ax e b.lox b.hix _ _ hx
      (by rw [mantFloor_eq]; exact Int.floor_le _) (by rw [mantCeil_eq]; exact Int.le_ceil _)
  · rw [mboxOfBox_loy, mboxOfBox_hiy]
    exact dslab_dom d.y x.y ay e b.loy b.hiy _ _ hy
      (by rw [mantFloor_eq]; exact Int.floor_le _) (by rw [mantCeil_eq]; exact Int.le_ceil _)
  · rw [mboxOfBox_loz, mboxOfBox_hiz]
    exact dslab_dom d.z x.z az e b.loz b.hiz _ _ hz
      (by rw [mantFloor_eq]; exact Int.floor_le _) (by rw [mantCeil_eq]; exact Int.le_ceil _)

name: mrayLineMeetsBox_of_exact
statement:
theorem mrayLineMeetsBox_of_exact (ax ay az : ℚ) (e : ℤ) (x d : Pt) (b : Box)
    (hm : rayLineMeetsBox x d b = true) :
    mrayLineMeetsBox (daxisParam d.x x.x ax e) (daxisParam d.y x.y ay e)
      (daxisParam d.z x.z az e) (mboxOfBox ax ay az e b) = true
proof:
:= by
  have hσ : (0:ℚ) < (2:ℚ)^(-e) := two_zpow_pos _
  rw [rayLineMeetsBox] at hm
  simp only [Bool.and_eq_true] at hm
  obtain ⟨⟨⟨⟨⟨⟨⟨⟨hokX, hokY⟩, hokZ⟩, hXY⟩, hXZ⟩, hYX⟩, hYZ⟩, hZX⟩, hZY⟩ := hm
  obtain ⟨cx, cy, cz⟩ := slabDoms_of ax ay az e x d b
    (axisSlab_ok_le _ _ _ _ hokX) (axisSlab_ok_le _ _ _ _ hokY) (axisSlab_ok_le _ _ _ _ hokZ)
  rw [mrayLineMeetsBox]
  simp only [Bool.and_eq_true]
  exact ⟨⟨⟨⟨⟨⟨⟨⟨cx.eok hokX, cy.eok hokY⟩, cz.eok hokZ⟩,
    islabLeHi_of_slabLeHi hσ cx cy hXY⟩, islabLeHi_of_slabLeHi hσ cx cz hXZ⟩,
    islabLeHi_of_slabLeHi hσ cy cx hYX⟩, islabLeHi_of_slabLeHi hσ cy cz hYZ⟩,
    islabLeHi_of_slabLeHi hσ cz cx hZX⟩, islabLeHi_of_slabLeHi hσ cz cy hZY⟩

name: mrayLineMeetsBoxFwd_of_exact
statement:
theorem mrayLineMeetsBoxFwd_of_exact (ax ay az : ℚ) (e : ℤ) (x d : Pt) (b : Box)
    (hm : rayLineMeetsBoxFwd x d b = true) :
    mrayLineMeetsBoxFwd (daxisParam d.x x.x ax e) (daxisParam d.y x.y ay e)
      (daxisParam d.z x.z az e) (mboxOfBox ax ay az e b) = true
proof:
:= by
  have hσ : (0:ℚ) < (2:ℚ)^(-e) := two_zpow_pos _
  rw [rayLineMeetsBoxFwd] at hm
  simp only [Bool.and_eq_true] at hm
  obtain ⟨⟨⟨⟨⟨⟨⟨⟨⟨⟨⟨hokX, hokY⟩, hokZ⟩, hXY⟩, hXZ⟩, hYX⟩, hYZ⟩, hZX⟩, hZY⟩, hNX⟩, hNY⟩, hNZ⟩ := hm
  obtain ⟨cx, cy, cz⟩ := slabDoms_of ax ay az e x d b
    (axisSlab_ok_le _ _ _ _ hokX) (axisSlab_ok_le _ _ _ _ hokY) (axisSlab_ok_le _ _ _ _ hokZ)
  rw [mrayLineMeetsBoxFwd]
  simp only [Bool.and_eq_true]
  exact ⟨⟨⟨⟨⟨⟨⟨⟨⟨⟨⟨cx.eok hokX, cy.eok hokY⟩, cz.eok hokZ⟩,
    islabLeHi_of_slabLeHi hσ cx cy hXY⟩, islabLeHi_of_slabLeHi hσ cx cz hXZ⟩,
    islabLeHi_of_slabLeHi hσ cy cx hYX⟩, islabLeHi_of_slabLeHi hσ cy cz hYZ⟩,
    islabLeHi_of_slabLeHi hσ cz cx hZX⟩, islabLeHi_of_slabLeHi hσ cz cy hZY⟩,
    islabNonneg_of_slabNonneg hσ cx hNX⟩, islabNonneg_of_slabNonneg hσ cy hNY⟩,
    islabNonneg_of_slabNonneg hσ cz hNZ⟩

name: ite_eq_min
statement: private theorem ite_eq_min (na nb : ℤ) : (if na ≤ nb then na else nb) = min na nb
proof:
:= by
  split <;> omega

name: ite_eq_max
statement: private theorem ite_eq_max (na nb : ℤ) : (if na ≤ nb then nb else na) = max na nb
proof:
:= by
  split <;> omega

name: dslab_mono
statement:
theorem dslab_mono {ap : DAxisParam} (hx : ap.xlo ≤ ap.xhi) {mlo mhi mlo' mhi' : ℤ}
    (hlo : mlo' ≤ mlo) (hhi : mhi ≤ mhi') :
    (dslab ap mlo mhi).den = (dslab ap mlo' mhi').den ∧
    (dslab ap mlo mhi).bdd = (dslab ap mlo' mhi').bdd ∧
    ((dslab ap mlo mhi).ok = true →
      (dslab ap mlo' mhi').ok = true ∧
      (dslab ap mlo' mhi').loN ≤ (dslab ap mlo mhi).loN ∧
      (dslab ap mlo mhi).hiN ≤ (dslab ap mlo' mhi').hiN)
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hz : ap.zero = true
  · rw [dslab_zero_eq ap mlo mhi hz, dslab_zero_eq ap mlo' mhi' hz]
    refine ⟨rfl, rfl, ?_⟩
    intro hok
    simp only [Bool.and_eq_true, decide_eq_true_eq] at hok ⊢
    exact ⟨⟨le_trans hlo hok.1, le_trans hok.2 hhi⟩, le_refl _, le_refl _⟩
  · simp only [Bool.not_eq_true] at hz
    rw [dslab_nz_eq ap mlo mhi hz, dslab_nz_eq ap mlo' mhi' hz]
    refine ⟨rfl, rfl, ?_⟩
    intro hok
    simp only [decide_eq_true_eq] at hok ⊢
    have hok' : mlo' ≤ mhi' := by omega
    rcases lt_trichotomy ap.sgnDd 0 with hs | hs | hs
    · 
      have hab : ap.sgnDd * (mhi - ap.xlo) ≤ ap.sgnDd * (mlo - ap.xhi) := by nlinarith
      have hab' : ap.sgnDd * (mhi' - ap.xlo) ≤ ap.sgnDd * (mlo' - ap.xhi) := by nlinarith
      have hna : ap.sgnDd * (mlo - ap.xhi) ≤ ap.sgnDd * (mlo' - ap.xhi) := by nlinarith
      have hnb : ap.sgnDd * (mhi' - ap.xlo) ≤ ap.sgnDd * (mhi - ap.xlo) := by nlinarith
      refine ⟨hok', ?_, ?_⟩
      · rw [ite_eq_min, ite_eq_min]; omega
      · rw [ite_eq_max, ite_eq_max]; omega
    · 
      have h0 : ∀ u v : ℤ, ap.sgnDd * (u - v) = 0 := by intro u v; rw [hs]; ring
      refine ⟨hok', ?_, ?_⟩ <;> simp [h0]
    · 
      have hab : ap.sgnDd * (mlo - ap.xhi) ≤ ap.sgnDd * (mhi - ap.xlo) := by nlinarith
      have hab' : ap.sgnDd * (mlo' - ap.xhi) ≤ ap.sgnDd * (mhi' - ap.xlo) := by nlinarith
      have hna : ap.sgnDd * (mlo' - ap.xhi) ≤ ap.sgnDd * (mlo - ap.xhi) := by nlinarith
      have hnb : ap.sgnDd * (mhi - ap.xlo) ≤ ap.sgnDd * (mhi' - ap.xlo) := by nlinarith
      refine ⟨hok', ?_, ?_⟩
      · rw [ite_eq_min, ite_eq_min]; omega
      · rw [ite_eq_max, ite_eq_max]; omega

name: islabLeHi_mono
statement:
theorem islabLeHi_mono (s t s' t' : IAxisSlab)
    (hsden : s.den = s'.den) (htden : t.den = t'.den)
    (hsbdd : s.bdd = s'.bdd) (htbdd : t.bdd = t'.bdd)
    (hslo : s'.loN ≤ s.loN) (thhi : t.hiN ≤ t'.hiN)
    (hsdpos : 0 < s.den) (htdpos : 0 < t.den) :
    islabLeHi s t = true → islabLeHi s' t' = true
proof:
:= by
  unfold islabLeHi
  by_cases hb : s.bdd && t.bdd
  · have hb' : s'.bdd && t'.bdd := by rw [← hsbdd, ← htbdd]; exact hb
    rw [if_pos hb, if_pos hb']
    simp only [decide_eq_true_eq]
    intro h
    rw [← hsden, ← htden]
    have h1 : s'.loN * t.den ≤ s.loN * t.den :=
      mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hslo (le_of_lt htdpos)
    have h2 : t.hiN * s.den ≤ t'.hiN * s.den :=
      mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right thhi (le_of_lt hsdpos)
    exact h1.trans (h.trans h2)
  · have hb' : ¬ (s'.bdd && t'.bdd) := by rw [← hsbdd, ← htbdd]; exact hb
    rw [if_neg hb']
    intro _; rfl

name: islabNonneg_mono_int
statement:
theorem islabNonneg_mono_int (s s' : IAxisSlab)
    (hbdd : s.bdd = s'.bdd) (hhi : s.hiN ≤ s'.hiN) :
    islabNonneg s = true → islabNonneg s' = true
proof:
:= by
  unfold islabNonneg
  rw [← hbdd]
  by_cases hb : s.bdd = true
  · rw [if_pos hb, if_pos hb]
    simp only [decide_eq_true_eq]
    exact fun h => le_trans h hhi
  · simp only [Bool.not_eq_true] at hb
    rw [hb]; simp

name: mrayLineMeetsBox_mono
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨s1, s2, s3, s4, s5, s6⟩ := hsub
  obtain ⟨hdx, hbx, hokx'⟩ := dslab_mono hpx.1 s1 s4
  obtain ⟨hdy, hby, hoky'⟩ := dslab_mono hpy.1 s2 s5
  obtain ⟨hdz, hbz, hokz'⟩ := dslab_mono hpz.1 s3 s6
  have dpx := dslab_den_pos hpx m.lox m.hix
  have dpy := dslab_den_pos hpy m.loy m.hiy
  have dpz := dslab_den_pos hpz m.loz m.hiz
  rw [mrayLineMeetsBox] at hm
  simp only [Bool.and_eq_true] at hm
  obtain ⟨⟨⟨⟨⟨⟨⟨⟨hokX, hokY⟩, hokZ⟩, hXY⟩, hXZ⟩, hYX⟩, hYZ⟩, hZX⟩, hZY⟩ := hm
  obtain ⟨hokx2, hxlo, hxhi⟩ := hokx' hokX
  obtain ⟨hoky2, hylo, hyhi⟩ := hoky' hokY
  obtain ⟨hokz2, hzlo, hzhi⟩ := hokz' hokZ
  rw [mrayLineMeetsBox]
  simp only [Bool.and_eq_true]
  refine ⟨⟨⟨⟨⟨⟨⟨⟨hokx2, hoky2⟩, hokz2⟩, ?_⟩, ?_⟩, ?_⟩, ?_⟩, ?_⟩, ?_⟩
  · exact islabLeHi_mono _ _ _ _ hdx hdy hbx hby hxlo hyhi dpx dpy hXY
  · exact islabLeHi_mono _ _ _ _ hdx hdz hbx hbz hxlo hzhi dpx dpz hXZ
  · exact islabLeHi_mono _ _ _ _ hdy hdx hby hbx hylo hxhi dpy dpx hYX
  · exact islabLeHi_mono _ _ _ _ hdy hdz hby hbz hylo hzhi dpy dpz hYZ
  · exact islabLeHi_mono _ _ _ _ hdz hdx hbz hbx hzlo hxhi dpz dpx hZX
  · exact islabLeHi_mono _ _ _ _ hdz hdy hbz hby hzlo hyhi dpz dpy hZY

name: mrayLineMeetsBoxFwd_mono
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨s1, s2, s3, s4, s5, s6⟩ := hsub
  obtain ⟨hdx, hbx, hokx'⟩ := dslab_mono hpx.1 s1 s4
  obtain ⟨hdy, hby, hoky'⟩ := dslab_mono hpy.1 s2 s5
  obtain ⟨hdz, hbz, hokz'⟩ := dslab_mono hpz.1 s3 s6
  have dpx := dslab_den_pos hpx m.lox m.hix
  have dpy := dslab_den_pos hpy m.loy m.hiy
  have dpz := dslab_den_pos hpz m.loz m.hiz
  rw [mrayLineMeetsBoxFwd] at hm
  simp only [Bool.and_eq_true] at hm
  obtain ⟨⟨⟨⟨⟨⟨⟨⟨⟨⟨⟨hokX, hokY⟩, hokZ⟩, hXY⟩, hXZ⟩, hYX⟩, hYZ⟩, hZX⟩, hZY⟩, hNX⟩, hNY⟩, hNZ⟩ := hm
  obtain ⟨hokx2, hxlo, hxhi⟩ := hokx' hokX
  obtain ⟨hoky2, hylo, hyhi⟩ := hoky' hokY
  obtain ⟨hokz2, hzlo, hzhi⟩ := hokz' hokZ
  rw [mrayLineMeetsBoxFwd]
  simp only [Bool.and_eq_true]
  refine ⟨⟨⟨⟨⟨⟨⟨⟨⟨⟨⟨hokx2, hoky2⟩, hokz2⟩, ?_⟩, ?_⟩, ?_⟩, ?_⟩, ?_⟩, ?_⟩, ?_⟩, ?_⟩, ?_⟩
  · exact islabLeHi_mono _ _ _ _ hdx hdy hbx hby hxlo hyhi dpx dpy hXY
  · exact islabLeHi_mono _ _ _ _ hdx hdz hbx hbz hxlo hzhi dpx dpz hXZ
  · exact islabLeHi_mono _ _ _ _ hdy hdx hby hbx hylo hxhi dpy dpx hYX
  · exact islabLeHi_mono _ _ _ _ hdy hdz hby hbz hylo hzhi dpy dpz hYZ
  · exact islabLeHi_mono _ _ _ _ hdz hdx hbz hbx hzlo hxhi dpz dpx hZX
  · exact islabLeHi_mono _ _ _ _ hdz hdy hbz hby hzlo hyhi dpz dpy hZY
  · exact islabNonneg_mono_int _ _ hbx hxhi hNX
  · exact islabNonneg_mono_int _ _ hby hyhi hNY
  · exact islabNonneg_mono_int _ _ hbz hzhi hNZ

name: daxisParam_sgnDd_pos
statement:
theorem daxisParam_sgnDd_pos (dα xα a : ℚ) (e : ℤ) (hp : 0 < dα) :
    (daxisParam dα xα a e).sgnDd = (dα.den : ℤ)
proof:
:= by
  have hdn : dα.num ≠ 0 := Rat.num_ne_zero.mpr (ne_of_gt hp)
  have hnp : 0 < dα.num := Rat.num_pos.mpr hp
  simp [daxisParam, hdn, hnp]

name: daxisParam_sgnDd_neg
statement:
theorem daxisParam_sgnDd_neg (dα xα a : ℚ) (e : ℤ) (hn : dα < 0) :
    (daxisParam dα xα a e).sgnDd = -(dα.den : ℤ)
proof:
:= by
  have hdn : dα.num ≠ 0 := Rat.num_ne_zero.mpr (ne_of_lt hn)
  have hnn : dα.num < 0 := Rat.num_neg.mpr hn
  simp [daxisParam, hdn, hnn, asymm hnn]

name: mslabNonneg_dslab_ax
statement:
theorem mslabNonneg_dslab_ax (dα xα a : ℚ) (e : ℤ) (pos : Bool) (mlo mhi : ℤ)
    (hd : dα ≠ 0) (hpos : pos = decide (0 < dα)) (hle : mlo ≤ mhi) :
    islabNonneg (dslab (daxisParam dα xα a e) mlo mhi)
      = (if pos then decide ((daxisParam dα xα a e).xlo ≤ mhi)
         else decide (mlo ≤ (daxisParam dα xα a e).xhi))
proof:
:= by
  set ap := daxisParam dα xα a e with hap
  have hz : ap.zero = false := by rw [hap]; exact daxisParam_zero_false dα xα a e hd
  have hx : ap.xlo ≤ ap.xhi := by rw [hap]; exact (daxisParam_ok dα xα a e).1
  have hddp : (0:ℤ) < (dα.den : ℤ) := by exact_mod_cast dα.pos
  rw [dslab_nz_eq ap mlo mhi hz]
  unfold islabNonneg
  simp only [if_pos rfl]
  by_cases hp : 0 < dα
  · have hs : ap.sgnDd = (dα.den : ℤ) := by rw [hap]; exact daxisParam_sgnDd_pos dα xα a e hp
    rw [hpos]; simp only [hp, decide_true, if_true]
    rw [hs, ite_eq_max]
    apply decide_eq_decide.mpr
    have hmax : max ((dα.den:ℤ) * (mlo - ap.xhi)) ((dα.den:ℤ) * (mhi - ap.xlo))
        = (dα.den:ℤ) * (mhi - ap.xlo) := by
      have : (dα.den:ℤ) * (mlo - ap.xhi) ≤ (dα.den:ℤ) * (mhi - ap.xlo) := by nlinarith
      omega
    rw [hmax]
    constructor
    · intro h; nlinarith
    · intro h; nlinarith
  · have hlt : dα < 0 := lt_of_le_of_ne (not_lt.mp hp) hd
    have hs : ap.sgnDd = -(dα.den : ℤ) := by rw [hap]; exact daxisParam_sgnDd_neg dα xα a e hlt
    rw [hpos]; simp only [hp, decide_false, if_false]
    rw [hs, ite_eq_max]
    apply decide_eq_decide.mpr
    have hmax : max (-(dα.den:ℤ) * (mlo - ap.xhi)) (-(dα.den:ℤ) * (mhi - ap.xlo))
        = -(dα.den:ℤ) * (mlo - ap.xhi) := by
      have : -(dα.den:ℤ) * (mhi - ap.xlo) ≤ -(dα.den:ℤ) * (mlo - ap.xhi) := by nlinarith
      omega
    rw [hmax]
    constructor
    · intro h; nlinarith
    · intro h; nlinarith

name: mlineMeetsBoxAx_eq
statement:
theorem mlineMeetsBoxAx_eq (x d : Pt) (ax ay az : ℚ) (e : ℤ) (axis : ℕ) (pos : Bool)
    (h : singleAxisOf d = some (axis, pos)) (v : MBox) :
    mlineMeetsBoxAx (daxisParam d.x x.x ax e) (daxisParam d.y x.y ay e)
        (daxisParam d.z x.z az e) axis v
      = mrayLineMeetsBox (daxisParam d.x x.x ax e) (daxisParam d.y x.y ay e)
        (daxisParam d.z x.z az e) v
proof:
:= by
  rcases singleAxisOf_spec d axis pos h with
      ⟨ha, hy, hz, hdd, _⟩ | ⟨ha, hx, hz, hdd, _⟩ | ⟨ha, hx, hy, hdd, _⟩
  · subst ha
    have hpx : (daxisParam d.x x.x ax e).zero = false := daxisParam_zero_false _ _ _ _ hdd
    have hpy : (daxisParam d.y x.y ay e).zero = true := by
      simp [daxisParam, Rat.num_eq_zero.mpr hy]
    have hpz : (daxisParam d.z x.z az e).zero = true := by
      simp [daxisParam, Rat.num_eq_zero.mpr hz]
    simp [mlineMeetsBoxAx, mrayLineMeetsBox, dslab, islabLeHi, maxLo, maxHi, hpx, hpy, hpz,
      Bool.and_assoc, Bool.and_comm, Bool.and_left_comm]
  · subst ha
    have hpx : (daxisParam d.x x.x ax e).zero = true := by
      simp [daxisParam, Rat.num_eq_zero.mpr hx]
    have hpy : (daxisParam d.y x.y ay e).zero = false := daxisParam_zero_false _ _ _ _ hdd
    have hpz : (daxisParam d.z x.z az e).zero = true := by
      simp [daxisParam, Rat.num_eq_zero.mpr hz]
    simp [mlineMeetsBoxAx, mrayLineMeetsBox, dslab, islabLeHi, maxLo, maxHi, hpx, hpy, hpz,
      Bool.and_assoc, Bool.and_comm, Bool.and_left_comm]
  · subst ha
    have hpx : (daxisParam d.x x.x ax e).zero = true := by
      simp [daxisParam, Rat.num_eq_zero.mpr hx]
    have hpy : (daxisParam d.y x.y ay e).zero = true := by
      simp [daxisParam, Rat.num_eq_zero.mpr hy]
    have hpz : (daxisParam d.z x.z az e).zero = false := daxisParam_zero_false _ _ _ _ hdd
    simp [mlineMeetsBoxAx, mrayLineMeetsBox, dslab, islabLeHi, maxLo, maxHi, hpx, hpy, hpz,
      Bool.and_assoc, Bool.and_comm, Bool.and_left_comm]

name: mrayLineMeetsBoxFwd_split
statement:
theorem mrayLineMeetsBoxFwd_split (px py pz : DAxisParam) (v : MBox) :
    mrayLineMeetsBoxFwd px py pz v
      = (mrayLineMeetsBox px py pz v
          && islabNonneg (dslab px v.lox v.hix)
          && islabNonneg (dslab py v.loy v.hiy)
          && islabNonneg (dslab pz v.loz v.hiz))
proof: := rfl

name: mrayMeetsBoxFwdAx_eq
statement:
theorem mrayMeetsBoxFwdAx_eq (x d : Pt) (ax ay az : ℚ) (e : ℤ) (axis : ℕ) (pos : Bool)
    (h : singleAxisOf d = some (axis, pos)) (v : MBox) :
    mrayMeetsBoxFwdAx (daxisParam d.x x.x ax e) (daxisParam d.y x.y ay e)
        (daxisParam d.z x.z az e) axis pos v
      = mrayLineMeetsBoxFwd (daxisParam d.x x.x ax e) (daxisParam d.y x.y ay e)
        (daxisParam d.z x.z az e) v
proof:
:= by
  set px := daxisParam d.x x.x ax e with hpxdef
  set py := daxisParam d.y x.y ay e with hpydef
  set pz := daxisParam d.z x.z az e with hpzdef
  rw [mrayLineMeetsBoxFwd_split, ← mlineMeetsBoxAx_eq x d ax ay az e axis pos h v]
  rcases singleAxisOf_spec d axis pos h with
      ⟨ha, hy, hz, hdd, hpe⟩ | ⟨ha, hx, hz, hdd, hpe⟩ | ⟨ha, hx, hy, hdd, hpe⟩
  · subst ha
    have hpyz : py.zero = true := by rw [hpydef]; simp [daxisParam, Rat.num_eq_zero.mpr hy]
    have hpzz : pz.zero = true := by rw [hpzdef]; simp [daxisParam, Rat.num_eq_zero.mpr hz]
    have hny : islabNonneg (dslab py v.loy v.hiy) = true := by
      rw [dslab_zero_eq py _ _ hpyz]; simp [islabNonneg]
    have hnz : islabNonneg (dslab pz v.loz v.hiz) = true := by
      rw [dslab_zero_eq pz _ _ hpzz]; simp [islabNonneg]
    rw [hny, hnz, Bool.and_true, Bool.and_true]
    by_cases hline : mlineMeetsBoxAx px py pz 0 v = true
    · rw [hline, Bool.true_and]
      have hle : v.lox ≤ v.hix := by
        rw [mlineMeetsBoxAx] at hline
        simp only [maxLo, maxHi, Bool.and_eq_true, decide_eq_true_eq] at hline
        exact hline.1.1.1
      rw [mrayMeetsBoxFwdAx, hline, Bool.true_and]
      simp only [maxLo, maxHi, beq_self_eq_true, if_pos, cond_true]
      have := mslabNonneg_dslab_ax d.x x.x ax e pos v.lox v.hix hdd hpe hle
      rw [← hpxdef] at this
      simpa using this.symm
    · simp only [Bool.not_eq_true] at hline
      rw [hline, Bool.false_and]
      rw [mrayMeetsBoxFwdAx, hline, Bool.false_and]
  · subst ha
    have hpxz : px.zero = true := by rw [hpxdef]; simp [daxisParam, Rat.num_eq_zero.mpr hx]
    have hpzz : pz.zero = true := by rw [hpzdef]; simp [daxisParam, Rat.num_eq_zero.mpr hz]
    have hnx : islabNonneg (dslab px v.lox v.hix) = true := by
      rw [dslab_zero_eq px _ _ hpxz]; simp [islabNonneg]
    have hnz : islabNonneg (dslab pz v.loz v.hiz) = true := by
      rw [dslab_zero_eq pz _ _ hpzz]; simp [islabNonneg]
    by_cases hline : mlineMeetsBoxAx px py pz 1 v = true
    · rw [hline, Bool.true_and, hnx, hnz]
      simp only [Bool.true_and, Bool.and_true]
      have hle : v.loy ≤ v.hiy := by
        rw [mlineMeetsBoxAx] at hline
        simp only [maxLo, maxHi, Bool.and_eq_true, decide_eq_true_eq] at hline
        exact hline.1.1.1
      rw [mrayMeetsBoxFwdAx, hline, Bool.true_and]
      simp only [maxLo, maxHi]
      have := mslabNonneg_dslab_ax d.y x.y ay e pos v.loy v.hiy hdd hpe hle
      rw [← hpydef] at this
      simpa using this.symm
    · simp only [Bool.not_eq_true] at hline
      rw [hline, Bool.false_and, Bool.false_and, Bool.false_and]
      rw [mrayMeetsBoxFwdAx, hline, Bool.false_and]
  · subst ha
    have hpxz : px.zero = true := by rw [hpxdef]; simp [daxisParam, Rat.num_eq_zero.mpr hx]
    have hpyz : py.zero = true := by rw [hpydef]; simp [daxisParam, Rat.num_eq_zero.mpr hy]
    have hnx : islabNonneg (dslab px v.lox v.hix) = true := by
      rw [dslab_zero_eq px _ _ hpxz]; simp [islabNonneg]
    have hny : islabNonneg (dslab py v.loy v.hiy) = true := by
      rw [dslab_zero_eq py _ _ hpyz]; simp [islabNonneg]
    by_cases hline : mlineMeetsBoxAx px py pz 2 v = true
    · rw [hline, Bool.true_and, hnx, hny]
      simp only [Bool.true_and, Bool.and_true]
      have hle : v.loz ≤ v.hiz := by
        rw [mlineMeetsBoxAx] at hline
        simp only [maxLo, maxHi, Bool.and_eq_true, decide_eq_true_eq] at hline
        exact hline.1.1.1
      rw [mrayMeetsBoxFwdAx, hline, Bool.true_and]
      simp only [maxLo, maxHi]
      have := mslabNonneg_dslab_ax d.z x.z az e pos v.loz v.hiz hdd hpe hle
      rw [← hpzdef] at this
      simpa using this.symm
    · simp only [Bool.not_eq_true] at hline
      rw [hline, Bool.false_and, Bool.false_and, Bool.false_and]
      rw [mrayMeetsBoxFwdAx, hline, Bool.false_and]

name: subbox_hull_left
statement: theorem subbox_hull_left (u v : Box) : Subbox u (hull u v)
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩ <;> simp only [hull]
  · exact rmin_le_left _ _
  · exact rmin_le_left _ _
  · exact rmin_le_left _ _
  · exact le_rmax_left _ _
  · exact le_rmax_left _ _
  · exact le_rmax_left _ _

name: subbox_hull_right

proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩ <;> simp only [hull]
  · exact rmin_le_right _ _
  · exact rmin_le_right _ _
  · exact rmin_le_right _ _
  · exact le_rmax_right _ _
  · exact le_rmax_right _ _
  · exact le_rmax_right _ _

name: subbox_refl
statement: theorem subbox_refl (b : Box) : Subbox b b
