:=
  ⟨le_refl _, le_refl _, le_refl _, le_refl _, le_refl _, le_refl _⟩

name: subbox_trans
statement: theorem subbox_trans {a b c : Box} (h1 : Subbox a b) (h2 : Subbox b c) : Subbox a c
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨a1,a2,a3,a4,a5,a6⟩ := h1
  obtain ⟨b1,b2,b3,b4,b5,b6⟩ := h2
  exact ⟨b1.trans a1, b2.trans a2, b3.trans a3, a4.trans b4, a5.trans b5, a6.trans b6⟩

name: buildTreeMorton_cover
statement:
theorem buildTreeMorton_cover (boxes : Array Box) :
    ∀ (fuel : ℕ) (idxs : List ℕ), idxs ≠ [] →
      HCover boxes (buildTreeMorton boxes fuel idxs)
proof:
:= by
  intro fuel
  induction fuel with
  | zero =>
    intro idxs hne
    cases idxs with
    | nil => exact absurd rfl hne
    | cons k0 rest =>
      cases rest with
      | nil => simp only [buildTreeMorton, HCover]
      | cons k1 rest' => simp only [buildTreeMorton, HCover]
  | succ fuel' ih =>
    intro idxs hne
    cases idxs with
    | nil => exact absurd rfl hne
    | cons k0 rest =>
      cases rest with
      | nil => simp only [buildTreeMorton, HCover]
      | cons k1 rest' =>
        have hleftne : (k0 :: k1 :: rest').take ((k0 :: k1 :: rest').length / 2) ≠ [] := by
          intro hc
          have hd : ((k0 :: k1 :: rest').take ((k0 :: k1 :: rest').length / 2)).length = 0 := by
            rw [hc]; rfl
          rw [List.length_take] at hd
          simp only [List.length_cons] at hd
          omega
        have hrightne : (k0 :: k1 :: rest').drop ((k0 :: k1 :: rest').length / 2) ≠ [] := by
          intro hc
          have hd : ((k0 :: k1 :: rest').drop ((k0 :: k1 :: rest').length / 2)).length = 0 := by
            rw [hc]; rfl
          rw [List.length_drop] at hd
          simp only [List.length_cons] at hd
          omega
        simp only [buildTreeMorton, HCover]
        refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
        · simp only [Impl.BVH.Tree.box]; exact subbox_hull_left _ _
        · simp only [Impl.BVH.Tree.box]; exact subbox_hull_right _ _
        · exact ih _ hleftne
        · exact ih _ hrightne

name: hcover_leaf
statement:
theorem hcover_leaf (boxes : Array Box) :
    ∀ (t : Impl.BVH.Tree) (k : ℕ), HCover boxes t → k ∈ t.leaves →
      Subbox (boxAt boxes k) t.box
proof:
:= by
  intro t
  induction t with
  | leaf j b =>
    intro k hcov hk
    simp only [Impl.BVH.Tree.leaves, List.mem_singleton] at hk
    subst hk
    simp only [HCover] at hcov
    simp only [Impl.BVH.Tree.box]; rw [hcov]; exact subbox_refl _
  | node b l r ihl ihr =>
    intro k hcov hk
    obtain ⟨hl, hr, hcl, hcr⟩ := hcov
    simp only [Impl.BVH.Tree.leaves, List.mem_append] at hk
    simp only [Impl.BVH.Tree.box]
    rcases hk with hkl | hkr
    · exact subbox_trans (ihl k hcl hkl) hl
    · exact subbox_trans (ihr k hcr hkr) hr

name: buildTreeMorton_leaves_perm
statement:
theorem buildTreeMorton_leaves_perm (boxes : Array Box) :
    ∀ (fuel : ℕ) (idxs : List ℕ), idxs ≠ [] → idxs.length ≤ fuel →
      (buildTreeMorton boxes fuel idxs).leaves.Perm idxs
proof:
:= by
  intro fuel
  induction fuel with
  | zero =>
    intro idxs hne hfuel
    have h0 : idxs.length = 0 := Nat.le_zero.mp hfuel
    exact absurd (List.eq_nil_of_length_eq_zero h0) hne
  | succ fuel' ih =>
    intro idxs hne hfuel
    cases idxs with
    | nil => exact absurd rfl hne
    | cons k0 rest =>
      cases rest with
      | nil => simp only [buildTreeMorton, Impl.BVH.Tree.leaves]; exact List.Perm.refl _
      | cons k1 rest' =>
        have hflen : (k0 :: k1 :: rest').length ≤ fuel' + 1 := hfuel
        simp only [List.length_cons] at hflen
        have hsplit : (k0 :: k1 :: rest').take ((k0 :: k1 :: rest').length / 2)
            ++ (k0 :: k1 :: rest').drop ((k0 :: k1 :: rest').length / 2) = (k0 :: k1 :: rest') :=
          List.take_append_drop _ _
        have hleftne : (k0 :: k1 :: rest').take ((k0 :: k1 :: rest').length / 2) ≠ [] := by
          intro hc
          have hd : ((k0 :: k1 :: rest').take ((k0 :: k1 :: rest').length / 2)).length = 0 := by
            rw [hc]; rfl
          rw [List.length_take] at hd; simp only [List.length_cons] at hd; omega
        have hrightne : (k0 :: k1 :: rest').drop ((k0 :: k1 :: rest').length / 2) ≠ [] := by
          intro hc
          have hd : ((k0 :: k1 :: rest').drop ((k0 :: k1 :: rest').length / 2)).length = 0 := by
            rw [hc]; rfl
          rw [List.length_drop] at hd; simp only [List.length_cons] at hd; omega
        have hlenL : ((k0 :: k1 :: rest').take ((k0 :: k1 :: rest').length / 2)).length ≤ fuel' := by
          rw [List.length_take]; simp only [List.length_cons] at hflen ⊢; omega
        have hlenR : ((k0 :: k1 :: rest').drop ((k0 :: k1 :: rest').length / 2)).length ≤ fuel' := by
          rw [List.length_drop]; simp only [List.length_cons] at hflen ⊢; omega
        simp only [buildTreeMorton, Impl.BVH.Tree.leaves]
        have pl := ih _ hleftne hlenL
        have pr := ih _ hrightne hlenR
        refine (List.Perm.append pl pr).trans ?_
        rw [hsplit]

name: rootNodeM_mbox
statement:
theorem rootNodeM_mbox (mbs : Array MBox) (base : ℕ) (t : Impl.BVH.Tree) :
    (rootNodeM mbs base t).mbox = mboxOfTree mbs t
proof: := by cases t <;> rfl

name: flattenM_size
statement:
theorem flattenM_size (mbs : Array MBox) (base : ℕ) (t : Impl.BVH.Tree) :
    (flattenM mbs base t).size = t.size
proof:
:= by
  induction t generalizing base with
  | leaf k b => simp [flattenM, Impl.BVH.Tree.size]
  | node b l r ihl ihr => simp [flattenM, Impl.BVH.Tree.size, ihl, ihr]; ring

name: flattenM_get_zero
statement:
theorem flattenM_get_zero (mbs : Array MBox) (base : ℕ) (t : Impl.BVH.Tree) :
    (flattenM mbs base t)[0]? = some (rootNodeM mbs base t)
proof:
:= by
  induction t generalizing base with
  | leaf k b => simp [flattenM, rootNodeM]
  | node b l r ihl ihr =>
    have hl : (flattenM mbs (base+1) l).getD 0 default = rootNodeM mbs (base+1) l := by
      rw [Array.getD_eq_get?, ihl]; rfl
    have hr : (flattenM mbs (base+1+l.size) r).getD 0 default
        = rootNodeM mbs (base+1+l.size) r := by
      rw [Array.getD_eq_get?, ihr]; rfl
    simp only [flattenM, Array.append_assoc, hl, hr, rootNodeM_mbox]
    rw [Array.getElem?_append_left (by simp)]
    rfl

name: flattenM_getD_zero
statement:
theorem flattenM_getD_zero (mbs : Array MBox) (base : ℕ) (t : Impl.BVH.Tree) :
    (flattenM mbs base t).getD 0 default = rootNodeM mbs base t
proof:
:= by
  rw [Array.getD_eq_get?, flattenM_get_zero]; rfl

name: flattenM_node
statement:
theorem flattenM_node (mbs : Array MBox) (base : ℕ) (b : Box) (l r : Impl.BVH.Tree) :
    flattenM mbs base (.node b l r)
      = #[rootNodeM mbs base (.node b l r)]
        ++ (flattenM mbs (base+1) l ++ flattenM mbs (base+1+l.size) r)
proof:
:= by
  simp only [flattenM, Array.append_assoc, flattenM_getD_zero, rootNodeM_mbox]
  rfl

name: agrees_self
statement: theorem agrees_self (mbs : Array MBox) (t : Impl.BVH.Tree) : Agrees (flattenM mbs 0 t) mbs 0 t
proof:
:= by
  intro i _; simp

name: agrees_root
statement:
theorem agrees_root {nodes : Array Node} {mbs : Array MBox} {base : ℕ} {t : Impl.BVH.Tree}
    (h : Agrees nodes mbs base t) : nodes[base]? = some (rootNodeM mbs base t)
proof:
:= by
  have := h 0 (by cases t <;> simp [Impl.BVH.Tree.size])
  simp only [Nat.add_zero] at this
  rw [this, flattenM_get_zero]

name: agrees_left
proof:
:= by
  intro i hi
  have hlt : (1 + i) < (Impl.BVH.Tree.node b l r).size := by
    simp only [Impl.BVH.Tree.size]; omega
  have hx := h (1 + i) hlt
  rw [show base + (1 + i) = (base + 1) + i by ring] at hx
  rw [hx, flattenM_node]
  rw [Array.getElem?_append_right (by simp)]
  rw [Array.getElem?_append_left (by rw [flattenM_size]; simp; omega)]
  congr 1
  simp

name: agrees_right
proof:
:= by
  intro i hi
  have hlt : (1 + l.size + i) < (Impl.BVH.Tree.node b l r).size := by
    simp only [Impl.BVH.Tree.size]; omega
  have hx := h (1 + l.size + i) hlt
  rw [show base + (1 + l.size + i) = (base + 1 + l.size) + i by ring] at hx
  rw [hx, flattenM_node]
  rw [Array.getElem?_append_right (by simp; omega)]
  rw [Array.getElem?_append_right (by rw [flattenM_size]; simp; omega)]
  congr 1
  rw [flattenM_size]
  simp only [show (#[rootNodeM mbs base (Impl.BVH.Tree.node b l r)] : Array Node).size = 1 from rfl]
  omega

name: boxQuery_go_eq
statement:
theorem boxQuery_go_eq (h : BVH) (mbs : Array MBox) (qq : MBox) :
    ∀ (t : Impl.BVH.Tree) (base fuel : ℕ) (acc : Array ℕ),
      Agrees h.nodes mbs base t → t.size ≤ fuel →
      boxQuery.go h qq base fuel acc = mtreeQuery mbs (moverlap qq) t acc
proof:
:= by
  intro t
  induction t with
  | leaf k b =>
    intro base fuel acc hag hfuel
    cases fuel with
    | zero => simp [Impl.BVH.Tree.size] at hfuel
    | succ fuel' =>
      rw [boxQuery.go, agrees_root hag]
      simp only [mtreeQuery, rootNodeM]
      cases hov : moverlap qq (mbs.getD k default) <;> simp
  | node b l r ihl ihr =>
    intro base fuel acc hag hfuel
    cases fuel with
    | zero => simp only [Impl.BVH.Tree.size] at hfuel; omega
    | succ fuel' =>
      rw [boxQuery.go, agrees_root hag]
      simp only [mtreeQuery, rootNodeM, mboxOfTree]
      have hsl : l.size ≤ fuel' := by simp only [Impl.BVH.Tree.size] at hfuel; omega
      have hsr : r.size ≤ fuel' := by simp only [Impl.BVH.Tree.size] at hfuel; omega
      by_cases hov : moverlap qq (munion (mboxOfTree mbs l) (mboxOfTree mbs r)) = true
      · simp only [hov, Bool.not_true, Bool.false_eq_true, if_false, if_true]
        rw [ihl (base+1) fuel' acc (agrees_left hag) hsl]
        rw [ihr (base+1+l.size) fuel' _ (agrees_right hag) hsr]
      · simp only [Bool.not_eq_true] at hov; simp [hov]

name: rayQuery_go_eq
statement:
theorem rayQuery_go_eq (h : BVH) (mbs : Array MBox) (px py pz : DAxisParam) :
    ∀ (t : Impl.BVH.Tree) (base fuel : ℕ) (acc : Array ℕ),
      Agrees h.nodes mbs base t → t.size ≤ fuel →
      rayQuery.go h px py pz base fuel acc
        = mtreeQuery mbs (mrayLineMeetsBox px py pz) t acc
proof:
:= by
  intro t
  induction t with
  | leaf k b =>
    intro base fuel acc hag hfuel
    cases fuel with
    | zero => simp [Impl.BVH.Tree.size] at hfuel
    | succ fuel' =>
      rw [rayQuery.go, agrees_root hag]
      simp only [mtreeQuery, rootNodeM]
      cases hov : mrayLineMeetsBox px py pz (mbs.getD k default) <;> simp
  | node b l r ihl ihr =>
    intro base fuel acc hag hfuel
    cases fuel with
    | zero => simp only [Impl.BVH.Tree.size] at hfuel; omega
    | succ fuel' =>
      rw [rayQuery.go, agrees_root hag]
      simp only [mtreeQuery, rootNodeM, mboxOfTree]
      have hsl : l.size ≤ fuel' := by simp only [Impl.BVH.Tree.size] at hfuel; omega
      have hsr : r.size ≤ fuel' := by simp only [Impl.BVH.Tree.size] at hfuel; omega
      by_cases hov : mrayLineMeetsBox px py pz (munion (mboxOfTree mbs l) (mboxOfTree mbs r)) = true
      · simp only [hov, Bool.not_true, Bool.false_eq_true, if_false, if_true]
        rw [ihl (base+1) fuel' acc (agrees_left hag) hsl]
        rw [ihr (base+1+l.size) fuel' _ (agrees_right hag) hsr]
      · simp only [Bool.not_eq_true] at hov; simp [hov]

name: rayQueryFwd_go_eq
statement:
theorem rayQueryFwd_go_eq (h : BVH) (mbs : Array MBox) (px py pz : DAxisParam) :
    ∀ (t : Impl.BVH.Tree) (base fuel : ℕ) (acc : Array ℕ),
      Agrees h.nodes mbs base t → t.size ≤ fuel →
      rayQueryFwdGo h px py pz base fuel acc
        = mtreeQuery mbs (mrayLineMeetsBoxFwd px py pz) t acc
proof:
:= by
  intro t
  induction t with
  | leaf k b =>
    intro base fuel acc hag hfuel
    cases fuel with
    | zero => simp [Impl.BVH.Tree.size] at hfuel
    | succ fuel' =>
      rw [rayQueryFwdGo, agrees_root hag]
      simp only [mtreeQuery, rootNodeM]
      cases hov : mrayLineMeetsBoxFwd px py pz (mbs.getD k default) <;> simp
  | node b l r ihl ihr =>
    intro base fuel acc hag hfuel
    cases fuel with
    | zero => simp only [Impl.BVH.Tree.size] at hfuel; omega
    | succ fuel' =>
      rw [rayQueryFwdGo, agrees_root hag]
      simp only [mtreeQuery, rootNodeM, mboxOfTree]
      have hsl : l.size ≤ fuel' := by simp only [Impl.BVH.Tree.size] at hfuel; omega
      have hsr : r.size ≤ fuel' := by simp only [Impl.BVH.Tree.size] at hfuel; omega
      by_cases hov :
          mrayLineMeetsBoxFwd px py pz (munion (mboxOfTree mbs l) (mboxOfTree mbs r)) = true
      · simp only [hov, Bool.not_true, Bool.false_eq_true, if_false, if_true]
        rw [ihl (base+1) fuel' acc (agrees_left hag) hsl]
        rw [ihr (base+1+l.size) fuel' _ (agrees_right hag) hsr]
      · simp only [Bool.not_eq_true] at hov; simp [hov]

name: rayQuery_goAx_eq_go
statement:
theorem rayQuery_goAx_eq_go (h : BVH) (px py pz : DAxisParam) (axis : ℕ)
    (Hpt : ∀ v, mlineMeetsBoxAx px py pz axis v = mrayLineMeetsBox px py pz v) :
    ∀ (cur fuel : ℕ) (acc : Array ℕ),
      rayQuery.goAx h px py pz axis cur fuel acc = rayQuery.go h px py pz cur fuel acc
proof:
:= by
  intro cur fuel
  induction fuel generalizing cur with
  | zero => intro acc; rfl
  | succ fuel ih =>
    intro acc
    cases e : h.nodes[cur]? with
    | none => simp only [rayQuery.goAx, rayQuery.go, e]
    | some nd =>
      simp only [rayQuery.goAx, rayQuery.go, e, Hpt nd.mbox]
      by_cases hov : (!mrayLineMeetsBox px py pz nd.mbox) = true
      · rw [if_pos hov, if_pos hov]
      · rw [if_neg hov, if_neg hov]
        by_cases hl : nd.isLeaf = true
        · rw [if_pos hl, if_pos hl]
        · rw [if_neg hl, if_neg hl, ih nd.left, ih nd.right]

name: rayQueryFwd_goAx_eq_go
statement:
theorem rayQueryFwd_goAx_eq_go (h : BVH) (px py pz : DAxisParam) (axis : ℕ) (pos : Bool)
    (Hpt : ∀ v, mrayMeetsBoxFwdAx px py pz axis pos v = mrayLineMeetsBoxFwd px py pz v) :
    ∀ (cur fuel : ℕ) (acc : Array ℕ),
      rayQueryFwdGoAx h px py pz axis pos cur fuel acc
        = rayQueryFwdGo h px py pz cur fuel acc
proof:
:= by
  intro cur fuel
  induction fuel generalizing cur with
  | zero => intro acc; rfl
  | succ fuel ih =>
    intro acc
    cases e : h.nodes[cur]? with
    | none => simp only [rayQueryFwdGoAx, rayQueryFwdGo, e]
    | some nd =>
      simp only [rayQueryFwdGoAx, rayQueryFwdGo, e, Hpt nd.mbox]
      by_cases hov : (!mrayLineMeetsBoxFwd px py pz nd.mbox) = true
      · rw [if_pos hov, if_pos hov]
      · rw [if_neg hov, if_neg hov]
        by_cases hl : nd.isLeaf = true
        · rw [if_pos hl, if_pos hl]
        · rw [if_neg hl, if_neg hl, ih nd.left, ih nd.right]

name: rayQuery_eq_go
statement:
theorem rayQuery_eq_go (h : BVH) (x d : Pt) :
    rayQuery h x d
      = rayQuery.go h (daxisParam d.x x.x h.ax h.ce) (daxisParam d.y x.y h.ay h.ce)
          (daxisParam d.z x.z h.az h.ce) 0 h.nodes.size #[]
proof:
:= by
  unfold rayQuery
  cases hsa : singleAxisOf d with
  | none => rfl
  | some p =>
    obtain ⟨axis, pos⟩ := p
    exact rayQuery_goAx_eq_go h _ _ _ axis
      (fun v => mlineMeetsBoxAx_eq x d h.ax h.ay h.az h.ce axis pos hsa v) 0 h.nodes.size #[]

name: rayQueryFwd_eq_go
statement:
theorem rayQueryFwd_eq_go (h : BVH) (x d : Pt) :
    rayQueryFwd h x d
      = rayQueryFwdGo h (daxisParam d.x x.x h.ax h.ce) (daxisParam d.y x.y h.ay h.ce)
          (daxisParam d.z x.z h.az h.ce) 0 h.nodes.size #[]
proof:
:= by
  unfold rayQueryFwd
  cases hsa : singleAxisOf d with
  | none => rfl
  | some p =>
    obtain ⟨axis, pos⟩ := p
    exact rayQueryFwd_goAx_eq_go h _ _ _ axis pos
      (fun v => mrayMeetsBoxFwdAx_eq x d h.ax h.ay h.az h.ce axis pos hsa v) 0 h.nodes.size #[]

name: mtreeQuery_mem_mono
statement:
theorem mtreeQuery_mem_mono (mbs : Array MBox) (P : MBox → Bool) :
    ∀ (t : Impl.BVH.Tree) (acc : Array ℕ) (m : ℕ), m ∈ acc → m ∈ mtreeQuery mbs P t acc
proof:
:= by
  intro t
  induction t with
  | leaf k b =>
    intro acc m hm
    simp only [mtreeQuery]
    split
    · exact Array.mem_push.mpr (Or.inl hm)
    · exact hm
  | node b l r ihl ihr =>
    intro acc m hm
    simp only [mtreeQuery]
    split
    · exact ihr _ _ (ihl _ _ hm)
    · exact hm

name: mtreeQuery_mem_leaves
statement:
theorem mtreeQuery_mem_leaves (mbs : Array MBox) (P : MBox → Bool) :
    ∀ (t : Impl.BVH.Tree) (acc : Array ℕ) (m : ℕ),
      m ∈ mtreeQuery mbs P t acc → m ∈ acc ∨ m ∈ t.leaves
proof:
:= by
  intro t
  induction t with
  | leaf k b =>
    intro acc m hm
    simp only [mtreeQuery] at hm
    split at hm
    · rcases Array.mem_push.mp hm with h | h
      · exact Or.inl h
      · exact Or.inr (by simp [Impl.BVH.Tree.leaves, h])
    · exact Or.inl hm
  | node b l r ihl ihr =>
    intro acc m hm
    simp only [mtreeQuery] at hm
    split at hm
    · rcases ihr _ m hm with h | h
      · rcases ihl _ m h with h' | h'
        · exact Or.inl h'
        · exact Or.inr (by simp [Impl.BVH.Tree.leaves, h'])
      · exact Or.inr (by simp [Impl.BVH.Tree.leaves, h])
    · exact Or.inl hm

name: mtreeQuery_nodup
statement:
theorem mtreeQuery_nodup (mbs : Array MBox) (P : MBox → Bool) :
    ∀ (t : Impl.BVH.Tree) (acc : Array ℕ),
      t.leaves.Nodup → acc.toList.Nodup → (∀ m ∈ acc, m ∉ t.leaves) →
      (mtreeQuery mbs P t acc).toList.Nodup
proof:
:= by
  intro t
  induction t with
  | leaf k b =>
    intro acc _ hacc hdisj
    simp only [mtreeQuery]
    split
    · rw [Array.push_toList, List.nodup_append]
      refine ⟨hacc, by simp, ?_⟩
      intro a ha hb
      simp only [List.mem_singleton] at hb
      subst hb
      exact hdisj a (Array.mem_toList.mp ha) (by simp [Impl.BVH.Tree.leaves])
    · exact hacc
  | node b l r ihl ihr =>
    intro acc hlv hacc hdisj
    simp only [mtreeQuery]
    split
    · simp only [Impl.BVH.Tree.leaves, List.nodup_append] at hlv
      obtain ⟨hlnd, hrnd, hlr⟩ := hlv
      have haccl : (mtreeQuery mbs P l acc).toList.Nodup :=
        ihl acc hlnd hacc (fun m hm hml => hdisj m hm (by simp [Impl.BVH.Tree.leaves, hml]))
      have hdisjr : ∀ m ∈ mtreeQuery mbs P l acc, m ∉ r.leaves := by
        intro m hm hmr
        rcases mtreeQuery_mem_leaves mbs P l acc m hm with h | h
        · exact hdisj m h (by simp [Impl.BVH.Tree.leaves, hmr])
        · exact (List.disjoint_left.mp hlr h) hmr
      exact ihr _ hrnd haccl hdisjr
    · exact hacc

name: mtreeQuery_append_sublist
statement:
theorem mtreeQuery_append_sublist (mbs : Array MBox) (P : MBox → Bool) :
    ∀ (t : Impl.BVH.Tree) (acc : Array ℕ),
      ∃ sub : List ℕ, (mtreeQuery mbs P t acc).toList = acc.toList ++ sub ∧
        sub.Sublist t.leaves
proof:
:= by
  intro t
  induction t with
  | leaf k b =>
    intro acc
    simp only [mtreeQuery]
    split
    · exact ⟨[k], by simp, by simp [Impl.BVH.Tree.leaves]⟩
    · exact ⟨[], by simp, by simp⟩
  | node b l r ihl ihr =>
    intro acc
    simp only [mtreeQuery]
    split
    · obtain ⟨subl, hsubl, hsl⟩ := ihl acc
      obtain ⟨subr, hsubr, hsr⟩ := ihr (mtreeQuery mbs P l acc)
      refine ⟨subl ++ subr, ?_, ?_⟩
      · rw [hsubr, hsubl, List.append_assoc]
      · simp only [Impl.BVH.Tree.leaves]; exact List.Sublist.append hsl hsr
    · exact ⟨[], by simp, by simp⟩

name: mtreeQuery_sound
statement:
theorem mtreeQuery_sound (mbs : Array MBox) (P : MBox → Bool)
    (hmono : ∀ m m', MSubbox m m' → P m = true → P m' = true) :
    ∀ (t : Impl.BVH.Tree) (acc : Array ℕ) (k : ℕ),
      k ∈ t.leaves → P (mbs.getD k default) = true → k ∈ mtreeQuery mbs P t acc
proof:
:= by
  intro t
  induction t with
  | leaf j b =>
    intro acc k hk hP
    simp only [Impl.BVH.Tree.leaves, List.mem_singleton] at hk
    subst hk
    simp only [mtreeQuery, hP, if_true]
    exact Array.mem_push.mpr (Or.inr rfl)
  | node b l r ihl ihr =>
    intro acc k hk hP
    have hsub : MSubbox (mbs.getD k default) (mboxOfTree mbs (.node b l r)) :=
      mboxOfTree_leaf_msubbox mbs (.node b l r) k hk
    have hPb : P (munion (mboxOfTree mbs l) (mboxOfTree mbs r)) = true := hmono _ _ hsub hP
    simp only [mtreeQuery, hPb, if_true]
    simp only [Impl.BVH.Tree.leaves, List.mem_append] at hk
    rcases hk with hkl | hkr
    · exact mtreeQuery_mem_mono mbs P r _ k (ihl _ k hkl hP)
    · exact ihr _ k hkr hP

name: mortonOrderN_perm
statement:
theorem mortonOrderN_perm (input : Array Box) :
    (mortonOrderN input).Perm (List.range input.size)
proof:
:= by
  unfold mortonOrderN
  exact List.mergeSort_perm _ _

name: mortonOrderN_length
statement:
theorem mortonOrderN_length (input : Array Box) :
    (mortonOrderN input).length = input.size
proof:
:= by
  rw [(mortonOrderN_perm input).length_eq, List.length_range]

name: mortonOrderM_perm
statement:
theorem mortonOrderM_perm (mbs : Array MBox) :
    (mortonOrderM mbs).Perm (List.range mbs.size)
proof:
:= by
  unfold mortonOrderM
  exact List.mergeSort_perm _ _

name: agrees
statement:
theorem agrees (hb : Built h boxes t) :
    Agrees h.nodes (boxes.map (mboxOfBox h.ax h.ay h.az h.ce)) 0 t
proof:
:= by
  rw [hb.hnodes]; exact agrees_self _ _

name: fuel
statement: theorem fuel (hb : Built h boxes t) : t.size ≤ h.nodes.size
proof:
:= by
  rw [hb.hnodes, flattenM_size]

name: boxQuery_eq
statement:
theorem boxQuery_eq (hb : Built h boxes t) (q : Box) :
    boxQuery h q
      = mtreeQuery (boxes.map (mboxOfBox h.ax h.ay h.az h.ce)) (moverlap (mboxQ h q)) t #[]
proof:
:= by
  show boxQuery.go h (mboxQ h q) 0 h.nodes.size #[] = _
  exact boxQuery_go_eq h _ _ t 0 _ #[] hb.agrees hb.fuel

name: rayQuery_eq
statement:
theorem rayQuery_eq (hb : Built h boxes t) (x d : Pt) :
    rayQuery h x d
      = mtreeQuery (boxes.map (mboxOfBox h.ax h.ay h.az h.ce))
          (mrayLineMeetsBox (daxisParam d.x x.x h.ax h.ce) (daxisParam d.y x.y h.ay h.ce)
            (daxisParam d.z x.z h.az h.ce)) t #[]
proof:
:= by
  rw [rayQuery_eq_go]
  exact rayQuery_go_eq h _ _ _ _ t 0 _ #[] hb.agrees hb.fuel

name: rayQueryFwd_eq
statement:
theorem rayQueryFwd_eq (hb : Built h boxes t) (x d : Pt) :
    rayQueryFwd h x d
      = mtreeQuery (boxes.map (mboxOfBox h.ax h.ay h.az h.ce))
          (mrayLineMeetsBoxFwd (daxisParam d.x x.x h.ax h.ce) (daxisParam d.y x.y h.ay h.ce)
            (daxisParam d.z x.z h.az h.ce)) t #[]
proof:
:= by
  rw [rayQueryFwd_eq_go]
  exact rayQueryFwd_go_eq h _ _ _ _ t 0 _ #[] hb.agrees hb.fuel

name: query_mem_lt
statement:
theorem query_mem_lt (hb : Built h boxes t) {mbs : Array MBox} {P : MBox → Bool} {m : ℕ}
    (hm : m ∈ mtreeQuery mbs P t #[]) : m < boxes.size
proof:
:= by
  rcases mtreeQuery_mem_leaves mbs P t #[] m hm with h' | h'
  · simp at h'
  · exact List.mem_range.mp (hb.hperm.mem_iff.mp h')

name: query_nodup
statement:
theorem query_nodup (hb : Built h boxes t) {mbs : Array MBox} {P : MBox → Bool} :
    (mtreeQuery mbs P t #[]).toList.Nodup
proof:
:=
  mtreeQuery_nodup mbs P t #[] (hb.hperm.nodup_iff.mpr (List.nodup_range _)) (by simp) (by simp)

name: boxQuery_sound
statement:
theorem boxQuery_sound (hb : Built h boxes t) (q : Box) (j : ℕ) (hj : j < boxes.size)
    (hov : overlap q (boxes.getD j default) = true) : j ∈ boxQuery h q
proof:
:= by
  rw [hb.boxQuery_eq q]
  have hmem : j ∈ t.leaves := hb.hperm.mem_iff.mpr (List.mem_range.mpr hj)
  have hP : moverlap (mboxQ h q)
      ((boxes.map (mboxOfBox h.ax h.ay h.az h.ce)).getD j default) = true := by
    rw [mbs_getD_eq boxes _ _ _ _ j hj]
    exact moverlap_of_overlap h q (boxAt boxes j) (by rw [boxAt]; exact hov)
  exact mtreeQuery_sound _ _ (fun m m' hs hp => moverlap_mono_right _ hs hp) t #[] j hmem hP

name: rayQuery_sound
statement:
theorem rayQuery_sound (hb : Built h boxes t) (x d : Pt) (j : ℕ) (hj : j < boxes.size)
    (hhit : rayLineMeetsBox x d (boxes.getD j default) = true) : j ∈ rayQuery h x d
proof:
:= by
  rw [hb.rayQuery_eq x d]
  have hmem : j ∈ t.leaves := hb.hperm.mem_iff.mpr (List.mem_range.mpr hj)
  have hP : mrayLineMeetsBox (daxisParam d.x x.x h.ax h.ce) (daxisParam d.y x.y h.ay h.ce)
      (daxisParam d.z x.z h.az h.ce)
      ((boxes.map (mboxOfBox h.ax h.ay h.az h.ce)).getD j default) = true := by
    rw [mbs_getD_eq boxes _ _ _ _ j hj]
    exact mrayLineMeetsBox_of_exact h.ax h.ay h.az h.ce x d (boxAt boxes j)
      (by rw [boxAt]; exact hhit)
  refine mtreeQuery_sound _ _ (fun m m' hs hp =>
    mrayLineMeetsBox_mono (daxisParam_ok _ _ _ _) (daxisParam_ok _ _ _ _) (daxisParam_ok _ _ _ _)
      hs hp) t #[] j hmem hP

name: rayQueryFwd_sound
statement:
theorem rayQueryFwd_sound (hb : Built h boxes t) (x d : Pt) (j : ℕ) (hj : j < boxes.size)
    (hhit : rayLineMeetsBoxFwd x d (boxes.getD j default) = true) : j ∈ rayQueryFwd h x d
proof:
:= by
  rw [hb.rayQueryFwd_eq x d]
  have hmem : j ∈ t.leaves := hb.hperm.mem_iff.mpr (List.mem_range.mpr hj)
  have hP : mrayLineMeetsBoxFwd (daxisParam d.x x.x h.ax h.ce) (daxisParam d.y x.y h.ay h.ce)
      (daxisParam d.z x.z h.az h.ce)
      ((boxes.map (mboxOfBox h.ax h.ay h.az h.ce)).getD j default) = true := by
    rw [mbs_getD_eq boxes _ _ _ _ j hj]
    exact mrayLineMeetsBoxFwd_of_exact h.ax h.ay h.az h.ce x d (boxAt boxes j)
      (by rw [boxAt]; exact hhit)
  refine mtreeQuery_sound _ _ (fun m m' hs hp =>
    mrayLineMeetsBoxFwd_mono (daxisParam_ok _ _ _ _) (daxisParam_ok _ _ _ _)
      (daxisParam_ok _ _ _ _) hs hp) t #[] j hmem hP

name: sentinel_size
statement: private theorem sentinel_size (h : BVH) (hn : h.nodes = sentinelNodes) : h.nodes.size = 1
proof:
:= by
  rw [hn]; rfl

name: sentinel_get
proof:
:= by
  rw [hn]; rfl

name: boxQuery_of_sentinel
statement:
theorem boxQuery_of_sentinel (h : BVH) (hn : h.nodes = sentinelNodes) (q : Box) :
    boxQuery h q = #[]
proof:
:= by
  have hgo1 : ∀ acc : Array ℕ, boxQuery.go h (mboxQ h q) 1 0 acc = acc := by
    intro acc; rw [boxQuery.go]
  show boxQuery.go h (mboxQ h q) 0 h.nodes.size #[] = #[]
  rw [sentinel_size h hn, boxQuery.go, sentinel_get h hn]
  simp only []
  by_cases hov : moverlap (mboxQ h q) (default : MBox) = true
  · simp only [hov, Bool.not_true, Bool.false_eq_true, if_false]
    rw [hgo1, hgo1]
  · simp only [Bool.not_eq_true] at hov
    simp only [hov, Bool.not_false, if_true]

    intro acc; rw [rayQuery.go]

  by_cases hov : mrayLineMeetsBox (daxisParam d.x x.x h.ax h.ce) (daxisParam d.y x.y h.ay h.ce)

name: anchor_frac_val
statement:
private theorem anchor_frac_val (n d : ℤ) (a : ℚ) (hd : 0 < d) :
    ((n * (a.den:ℤ) - a.num * d : ℤ):ℚ) / (((a.den:ℤ) * d : ℤ):ℚ) = (n:ℚ)/(d:ℚ) - a
proof:
:= by
  have hdQ : (0:ℚ) < (d:ℚ) := by exact_mod_cast hd
  have haQ : (0:ℚ) < (a.den:ℚ) := by exact_mod_cast a.pos
  have ha' : (a.num:ℚ) = a * (a.den:ℚ) := (div_eq_iff (ne_of_gt haQ)).mp (Rat.num_div_den a)
  push_cast
  field_simp
  rw [ha']
  ring

name: daxisParamND_eq
statement:
theorem daxisParamND_eq (dα : ℚ) (xn xd : ℤ) (a : ℚ) (e : ℤ) (hxd : 0 < xd) :
    daxisParamND dα xn xd a e = daxisParam dα ((xn:ℚ)/(xd:ℚ)) a e
proof:
:= by
  set xα : ℚ := (xn:ℚ)/(xd:ℚ) with hxα
  have hap : (0:ℤ) < (a.den : ℤ) := by exact_mod_cast a.pos
  have hxαd : (0:ℤ) < (xα.den : ℤ) := by exact_mod_cast xα.pos
  have hd1 : (0:ℤ) < (a.den:ℤ) * xd := by positivity
  have hd2 : (0:ℤ) < (a.den:ℤ) * (xα.den:ℤ) := by positivity
  have hval : ((xn * (a.den:ℤ) - a.num * xd : ℤ):ℚ) / (((a.den:ℤ) * xd : ℤ):ℚ)
      = ((xα.num * (a.den:ℤ) - a.num * (xα.den:ℤ) : ℤ):ℚ) / (((a.den:ℤ) * (xα.den:ℤ) : ℤ):ℚ) := by
    rw [anchor_frac_val xn xd a hxd, anchor_frac_val xα.num (xα.den:ℤ) a hxαd]
    have hnd : ((xα.num : ℤ):ℚ)/(((xα.den:ℕ):ℤ):ℚ) = xα := by push_cast; exact Rat.num_div_den xα
    rw [hnd]
  have hlo : dyFloor (xn * (a.den:ℤ) - a.num * xd) ((a.den:ℤ) * xd) e
      = dyFloor (xα.num * (a.den:ℤ) - a.num * (xα.den:ℤ)) ((a.den:ℤ) * (xα.den:ℤ)) e :=
    dyFloor_congr e hd1 hd2 hval
  have hhi : dyCeil (xn * (a.den:ℤ) - a.num * xd) ((a.den:ℤ) * xd) e
      = dyCeil (xα.num * (a.den:ℤ) - a.num * (xα.den:ℤ)) ((a.den:ℤ) * (xα.den:ℤ)) e :=
    dyCeil_congr e hd1 hd2 hval
  unfold daxisParamND daxisParam
  dsimp only
  split <;> simp only [hlo, hhi]

    rw [dotProduct]; exact Finset.sum_nonneg (fun i _ => mul_self_nonneg _)

  · exact hlt
  · exact absurd (dotProduct_self_eq_zero.mp heq.symm) h

name: linearIndependent_of_orthogonal
proof:
:= by
  rw [LinearIndependent.pair_iff' h1]
  intro a ha
  have hdot : e1 ⬝ᵥ (a • e1) = e1 ⬝ᵥ e2 := by rw [ha]
  rw [dotProduct_smul, smul_eq_mul, horth] at hdot
  have he11 : 0 < e1 ⬝ᵥ e1 := dotProduct_self_pos h1
  have ha0 : a = 0 := by
    rcases mul_eq_zero.mp hdot with h | h
    · exact h
    · exact absurd h (ne_of_gt he11)
  rw [ha0, zero_smul] at ha
  exact h2 ha.symm
