name: frame_e1_ne_zero
statement:
theorem frame_e1_ne_zero {N : Point} (hN : N ≠ 0) :
    crossProduct N (frameAux N) ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  have hcomp : N 0 ≠ 0 ∨ N 1 ≠ 0 ∨ N 2 ≠ 0 := by
    by_contra h; push_neg at h
    exact hN (by funext i; fin_cases i <;> simp [h.1, h.2.1, h.2.2])
  unfold frameAux
  split
  · rename_i h
    intro hzero
    rcases h with h0 | h1
    · exact h0 (by have := congrFun hzero 1; simpa [cross_apply, mkPoint] using this)
    · exact h1 (by have := congrFun hzero 0; simpa [cross_apply, mkPoint] using this)
  · rename_i h
    push_neg at h
    have hN2 : N 2 ≠ 0 := by
      rcases hcomp with h0 | h1 | h2
      · exact (h0 h.1).elim
      · exact (h1 h.2).elim
      · exact h2
    intro hzero
    exact hN2 (by have := congrFun hzero 1; simpa [cross_apply, mkPoint] using this)

name: frame_e2_ne_zero
statement:
theorem frame_e2_ne_zero {N : Point} (hN : N ≠ 0) :
    crossProduct N (crossProduct N (frameAux N)) ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  set e1 := crossProduct N (frameAux N) with he1
  have he1ne : e1 ≠ 0 := frame_e1_ne_zero hN
  have hperp : N ⬝ᵥ e1 = 0 := by rw [he1]; exact dot_self_cross N (frameAux N)
  rw [crossProduct_ne_zero_iff_linearIndependent, LinearIndependent.pair_iff' hN]
  intro a ha
  rw [← ha, dotProduct_smul, smul_eq_mul] at hperp
  have hNN : 0 < N ⬝ᵥ N := dotProduct_self_pos hN
  have ha0 : a = 0 := by
    rcases mul_eq_zero.mp hperp with h | h
    · exact h
    · exact absurd h (ne_of_gt hNN)
  rw [ha0, zero_smul] at ha
  exact he1ne ha.symm

name: frame_e1_e2_orth
statement:
theorem frame_e1_e2_orth (N : Point) :
    (crossProduct N (frameAux N)) ⬝ᵥ (crossProduct N (crossProduct N (frameAux N))) = 0
proof:
:=
  dot_cross_self N (crossProduct N (frameAux N))

name: Lframe_apply
statement:
@[simp] theorem Lframe_apply (e1 e2 : Point) (y : Plane2) :
    Lframe e1 e2 y = y 0 • e1 + y 1 • e2
proof:
:= by
  simp [Lframe, LinearMap.smulRight]

name: Lframe_injective
statement:
theorem Lframe_injective {e1 e2 : Point} (hindep : LinearIndependent ℚ ![e1, e2]) :
    Function.Injective (Lframe e1 e2)
proof:
:= by
  rw [← LinearMap.ker_eq_bot, LinearMap.ker_eq_bot']
  intro y hy
  rw [Lframe_apply] at hy
  rw [LinearIndependent.pair_iff] at hindep
  obtain ⟨h0, h1⟩ := hindep (y 0) (y 1) hy
  funext i; fin_cases i <;> simpa

name: coordFun_apply
statement: theorem coordFun_apply (e x : Point) : coordFun e x = (e ⬝ᵥ x)/(e⬝ᵥe)
proof:
:= by
  simp [coordFun]; ring

name: Mframe_Lframe
statement:
theorem Mframe_Lframe {e1 e2 : Point} (h1 : e1 ≠ 0) (h2 : e2 ≠ 0)
    (horth : e1 ⬝ᵥ e2 = 0) (y : Plane2) : Mframe e1 e2 (Lframe e1 e2 y) = y
proof:
:= by
  have he11 : (e1 ⬝ᵥ e1) ≠ 0 := ne_of_gt (dotProduct_self_pos h1)
  have he22 : (e2 ⬝ᵥ e2) ≠ 0 := ne_of_gt (dotProduct_self_pos h2)
  have horth' : e2 ⬝ᵥ e1 = 0 := by rw [dotProduct_comm]; exact horth
  have h0 : Mframe e1 e2 (Lframe e1 e2 y) 0 = y 0 := by
    rw [show Mframe e1 e2 (Lframe e1 e2 y) 0 = coordFun e1 (Lframe e1 e2 y) from rfl,
       coordFun_apply, Lframe_apply, dotProduct_add, dotProduct_smul, dotProduct_smul,
       smul_eq_mul, smul_eq_mul, horth, mul_zero, add_zero, mul_div_assoc, div_self he11, mul_one]
  have h1 : Mframe e1 e2 (Lframe e1 e2 y) 1 = y 1 := by
    rw [show Mframe e1 e2 (Lframe e1 e2 y) 1 = coordFun e2 (Lframe e1 e2 y) from rfl,
       coordFun_apply, Lframe_apply, dotProduct_add, dotProduct_smul, dotProduct_smul,
       smul_eq_mul, smul_eq_mul, horth', mul_zero, zero_add, mul_div_assoc, div_self he22, mul_one]
  funext i; fin_cases i
  · exact h0
  · exact h1

name: iotaAff_apply
statement:
theorem iotaAff_apply (N o : Point) (y : Plane2) :
    iotaAff N o y = Lframe (planeFrame N).1 (planeFrame N).2 y +ᵥ o
proof: := rfl

name: iotaAff_linear
statement:
theorem iotaAff_linear (N o : Point) :
    (iotaAff N o).linear = Lframe (planeFrame N).1 (planeFrame N).2
proof:
:=
  AffineMap.mk'_linear _ _ _ _

name: frame_independent
statement:
theorem frame_independent {N : Point} (hN : N ≠ 0) :
    LinearIndependent ℚ ![(planeFrame N).1, (planeFrame N).2]
proof:
:= by
  rw [frame_c_fst, frame_c_snd]
  refine linearIndependent_of_orthogonal (frame_e1_ne_zero hN) (frame_e2_ne_zero hN) ?_
  exact frame_e1_e2_orth N

name: iotaAff_linear_injective
statement:
theorem iotaAff_linear_injective {N : Point} (hN : N ≠ 0) (o : Point) :
    Function.Injective (iotaAff N o).linear
proof:
:= by
  rw [iotaAff_linear]; exact Lframe_injective (frame_independent hN)

name: iotaInvAff_iotaAff
statement:
theorem iotaInvAff_iotaAff {N : Point} (hN : N ≠ 0) (o : Point) (y : Plane2) :
    iotaInvAff N o (iotaAff N o y) = y
proof:
:= by
  have he1 : (planeFrame N).1 ≠ 0 := by rw [frame_c_fst]; exact frame_e1_ne_zero hN
  have he2 : (planeFrame N).2 ≠ 0 := by rw [frame_c_snd]; exact frame_e2_ne_zero hN
  have horth : (planeFrame N).1 ⬝ᵥ (planeFrame N).2 = 0 := by
    rw [frame_c_fst, frame_c_snd]; exact frame_e1_e2_orth N
  show Mframe (planeFrame N).1 (planeFrame N).2 (iotaAff N o y -ᵥ o) = y
  rw [iotaAff_apply, vadd_vsub]
  exact Mframe_Lframe he1 he2 horth y

name: finrank_range_Lframe
statement:
theorem finrank_range_Lframe {N : Point} (hN : N ≠ 0) :
    Module.finrank ℚ (LinearMap.range (Lframe (planeFrame N).1 (planeFrame N).2)) = 2
proof:
:= by
  rw [LinearMap.finrank_range_of_inj (Lframe_injective (frame_independent hN))]
  simp [Module.finrank_pi]

name: finrank_ker_linOf
statement:
theorem finrank_ker_linOf {N : Point} (hN : N ≠ 0) :
    Module.finrank ℚ (LinearMap.ker (linOf N)) = 2
proof:
:= by
  have hNlin : linOf N ≠ 0 := (linOf_eq_zero_iff N).not.mpr hN
  have hsur : Module.finrank ℚ (LinearMap.range (linOf N)) = 1 := by
    have hrt : LinearMap.range (linOf N) = ⊤ := by
      rw [LinearMap.range_eq_top]
      intro c
      obtain ⟨x, hx⟩ : ∃ x, linOf N x ≠ 0 := by
        by_contra hcon; push_neg at hcon
        exact hNlin (by apply DFunLike.ext; intro x; exact hcon x)
      exact ⟨(c / linOf N x) • x, by rw [map_smul, smul_eq_mul, div_mul_cancel₀ _ hx]⟩
    rw [hrt, finrank_top, Module.finrank_self]
  have htot := LinearMap.finrank_range_add_finrank_ker (linOf N)
  rw [hsur] at htot
  have h3 : Module.finrank ℚ Point = 3 := by simp [Point, Module.finrank_pi]
  rw [h3] at htot; omega

name: range_Lframe_le_ker
statement:
theorem range_Lframe_le_ker (N : Point) :
    LinearMap.range (Lframe (planeFrame N).1 (planeFrame N).2) ≤ LinearMap.ker (linOf N)
proof:
:= by
  rw [LinearMap.range_le_ker_iff]
  apply LinearMap.ext; intro y
  have h1 : linOf N (planeFrame N).1 = 0 := by
    rw [frame_c_fst, linOf_apply, ← dotProduct]; exact dot_self_cross N (frameAux N)
  have h2 : linOf N (planeFrame N).2 = 0 := by
    rw [frame_c_snd, linOf_apply, ← dotProduct]; exact dot_self_cross N _
  simp only [LinearMap.comp_apply, Lframe_apply, map_add, map_smul, h1, h2,
    smul_eq_mul, mul_zero, add_zero, LinearMap.zero_apply]

name: range_Lframe_eq_ker
statement:
theorem range_Lframe_eq_ker {N : Point} (hN : N ≠ 0) :
    LinearMap.range (Lframe (planeFrame N).1 (planeFrame N).2) = LinearMap.ker (linOf N)
proof:
:=
  Submodule.eq_of_le_of_finrank_eq (range_Lframe_le_ker N)
    (by rw [finrank_range_Lframe hN, finrank_ker_linOf hN])

name: vectorSpan_le_ker_linOf
proof:
:= by
  rw [vectorSpan_def, Submodule.span_le]
  rintro x ⟨p, hp, q, hq, rfl⟩
  rw [SetLike.mem_coe, LinearMap.mem_ker]
  show (linOf N) (p - q) = 0
  exact hPplane p hp q hq

name: vectorSpan_eq_ker_linOf
statement:
theorem vectorSpan_eq_ker_linOf {N : Point} (hN : N ≠ 0) {P : Set Point}
    (hPplane : ∀ p ∈ P, ∀ q ∈ P, linOf N (p - q) = 0)
    (hdim : Module.finrank ℚ (vectorSpan ℚ P) = 2) :
    vectorSpan ℚ P = LinearMap.ker (linOf N)
proof:
:=
  Submodule.eq_of_le_of_finrank_eq (vectorSpan_le_ker_linOf hPplane)
    (by rw [hdim, finrank_ker_linOf hN])

name: iotaAff_plane_iso
statement:
theorem iotaAff_plane_iso
    {m : ℕ} (g : Fin m → (Point →ᵃ[ℚ] ℚ)) (P : Set Point) (N o : Point)
    (hP : P = ⋂ i, {x | 0 ≤ g i x}) (hoP : o ∈ P) (hN : N ≠ 0)
    (hPplane : ∀ p ∈ P, ∀ q ∈ P, linOf N (p - q) = 0)
    (hdim : Module.finrank ℚ (vectorSpan ℚ P) = 2) :
    ∃ (g' : Fin m → (Plane2 →ᵃ[ℚ] ℚ)) (Pq : Set Plane2),
      Function.Injective (iotaAff N o).linear
      ∧ Set.range (iotaAff N o) = (affineSpan ℚ P : Set Point)
      ∧ (∀ y : Plane2, iotaInvAff N o (iotaAff N o y) = y)
      ∧ Pq = ⋂ i, {y | 0 ≤ g' i y}
      ∧ (∀ i, g' i = (g i).comp (iotaAff N o))
      ∧ iotaAff N o '' Pq = P
      ∧ Module.finrank ℚ (vectorSpan ℚ Pq) = 2
proof:
:= by
  set iota := iotaAff N o with hiotadef
  have hiotalin : (iota).linear = Lframe (planeFrame N).1 (planeFrame N).2 := iotaAff_linear N o
  have hinj : Function.Injective iota.linear := iotaAff_linear_injective hN o
  have hiota0 : iota 0 = o := by rw [hiotadef, iotaAff_apply]; simp
  
  have hLrange : LinearMap.range iota.linear = vectorSpan ℚ P := by
    rw [hiotalin, range_Lframe_eq_ker hN, vectorSpan_eq_ker_linOf hN hPplane hdim]
  
  have hrange : Set.range iota = (affineSpan ℚ P : Set Point) := by
    have hcoe : Set.range iota = (↑(AffineSubspace.map iota ⊤) : Set Point) := by
      rw [AffineSubspace.coe_map, AffineSubspace.top_coe, Set.image_univ]
    rw [hcoe]
    apply congrArg (SetLike.coe)
    have hmemP : o ∈ affineSpan ℚ P := subset_affineSpan ℚ P hoP
    have hmemMap : o ∈ AffineSubspace.map iota ⊤ := by
      rw [AffineSubspace.mem_map]; exact ⟨0, AffineSubspace.mem_top _ _ _, hiota0⟩
    rw [AffineSubspace.eq_iff_direction_eq_of_mem hmemMap hmemP,
        AffineSubspace.map_direction, AffineSubspace.direction_top,
        direction_affineSpan, Submodule.map_top, hLrange]
  
  have hinv : ∀ y : Plane2, iotaInvAff N o (iota y) = y := iotaInvAff_iotaAff hN o
  
  set g' : Fin m → (Plane2 →ᵃ[ℚ] ℚ) := fun i => (g i).comp iota with hg'def
  set Pq : Set Plane2 := ⋂ i, {y | 0 ≤ g' i y} with hPqdef
  have hg' : ∀ i, g' i = (g i).comp iota := fun _ => rfl
  
  have hmemequiv : ∀ y : Plane2, (iota y ∈ P ↔ y ∈ Pq) := by
    intro y
    rw [hP, hPqdef]
    simp only [Set.mem_iInter, Set.mem_setOf_eq]
    constructor
    · intro h i; show 0 ≤ g' i y; simpa [g', AffineMap.comp_apply] using h i
    · intro h i; have := h i; simpa [g', AffineMap.comp_apply] using this
  have hPsub : P ⊆ Set.range iota := by rw [hrange]; exact subset_affineSpan ℚ P
  have hiotaPq : iota '' Pq = P := by
    ext x
    constructor
    · rintro ⟨y, hy, rfl⟩; exact (hmemequiv y).mpr hy
    · intro hx; obtain ⟨y, rfl⟩ := hPsub hx; exact ⟨y, (hmemequiv y).mp hx, rfl⟩
  have hdim' : Module.finrank ℚ (vectorSpan ℚ Pq) = 2 := by
    have hfr := Proof.PlaneIso.finrank_vectorSpan_image iota hinj Pq
    rw [hiotaPq] at hfr; rw [← hfr, hdim]
  exact ⟨g', Pq, hinj, hrange, hinv, hPqdef, hg', hiotaPq, hdim'⟩

name: det3_ne_zero_iff_linearIndependent
statement:
theorem det3_ne_zero_iff_linearIndependent (a b c : Point) :
    det3 a b c ≠ 0 ↔ LinearIndependent ℚ ![a, b, c]
proof:
:= by
  rw [det3_eq]
  set M : Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℚ := ![a, b, c] with hM
  have hdet : a ⬝ᵥ crossProduct b c = Matrix.det M := by
    rw [hM, Matrix.det_fin_three]; simp [cross_apply, dotProduct, Fin.sum_univ_three]; ring
  rw [hdet]
  rw [show LinearIndependent ℚ (![a, b, c] : Fin 3 → Point) ↔ LinearIndependent ℚ (fun i => M i)
        from Iff.rfl,
     Matrix.linearIndependent_rows_iff_isUnit, Matrix.isUnit_iff_isUnit_det, isUnit_iff_ne_zero]

name: psub_eq_sub
statement: theorem psub_eq_sub (u v : Point) : psub u v = u - v
proof: := by funext i; rfl

name: affineIndependent_of_edges_independent
statement:
theorem affineIndependent_of_edges_independent {a b c : Point}
    (h : LinearIndependent ℚ ![b - a, c - a]) : AffineIndependent ℚ ![a, b, c]
proof:
:= by
  rw [affineIndependent_iff]
  intro s w hw hcomb
  rw [LinearIndependent.pair_iff] at h
  classical
  set W : Fin 3 → ℚ := fun i => if i ∈ s then w i else 0 with hW
  have hWsum : ∑ i, W i = 0 := by
    rw [← hw, ← Finset.sum_filter_add_sum_filter_not Finset.univ (· ∈ s) W]
    have h1 : ∑ i ∈ Finset.univ.filter (· ∈ s), W i = ∑ i ∈ s, w i := by
      rw [Finset.filter_mem_eq_inter, Finset.univ_inter]
      apply Finset.sum_congr rfl; intro i hi; simp [hW, hi]
    have h2 : ∑ i ∈ Finset.univ.filter (¬ · ∈ s), W i = 0 := by
      apply Finset.sum_eq_zero; intro i hi; rw [Finset.mem_filter] at hi; simp [hW, hi.2]
    rw [h1, h2, add_zero]
  have hWcomb : ∑ i, W i • (![a, b, c] : Fin 3 → Point) i = 0 := by
    rw [← hcomb, ← Finset.sum_filter_add_sum_filter_not Finset.univ (· ∈ s) (fun i => W i • _)]
    have h1 : ∑ i ∈ Finset.univ.filter (· ∈ s), W i • (![a, b, c] : Fin 3 → Point) i
        = ∑ i ∈ s, w i • (![a, b, c] : Fin 3 → Point) i := by
      rw [Finset.filter_mem_eq_inter, Finset.univ_inter]
      apply Finset.sum_congr rfl; intro i hi; simp [hW, hi]
    have h2 : ∑ i ∈ Finset.univ.filter (¬ · ∈ s), W i • (![a, b, c] : Fin 3 → Point) i = 0 := by
      apply Finset.sum_eq_zero; intro i hi; rw [Finset.mem_filter] at hi; simp [hW, hi.2]
    rw [h1, h2, add_zero]
  rw [Fin.sum_univ_three] at hWsum hWcomb
  simp only [Matrix.cons_val_zero, Matrix.cons_val_one, Matrix.head_cons, Matrix.cons_val_two,
    Matrix.tail_cons] at hWcomb
  have hW0 : W 0 = -(W 1 + W 2) := by linarith [hWsum]
  have hpair : W 1 • (b - a) + W 2 • (c - a) = 0 := by
    have hcc : W 0 • a + W 1 • b + W 2 • c = 0 := hWcomb
    rw [hW0] at hcc
    rw [smul_sub, smul_sub]
    have hexp : W 1 • b - W 1 • a + (W 2 • c - W 2 • a)
        = -(W 1 + W 2) • a + W 1 • b + W 2 • c := by module
    rw [hexp]; exact hcc
  obtain ⟨hw1, hw2⟩ := h (W 1) (W 2) hpair
  have hw0 : W 0 = 0 := by rw [hW0, hw1, hw2]; ring
  intro i hi
  have hWi : W i = 0 := by fin_cases i; exacts [hw0, hw1, hw2]
  have : W i = w i := by simp [hW, hi]
  rw [this] at hWi; exact hWi

name: affineIndependent_of_crossQ_ne_zero
statement:
theorem affineIndependent_of_crossQ_ne_zero {a b c : Point}
    (h : crossQ (psub b a) (psub c a) ≠ 0) : AffineIndependent ℚ ![a, b, c]
proof:
:= by
  rw [crossQ_eq_crossProduct, psub_eq_sub, psub_eq_sub,
     crossProduct_ne_zero_iff_linearIndependent] at h
  exact affineIndependent_of_edges_independent h

name: linOfMap_apply
statement: @[simp] theorem linOfMap_apply (n : Point) : linOfMap n = linOf n
proof: := rfl

name: linOfMap_injective
statement: theorem linOfMap_injective : Function.Injective linOfMap
proof:
:= by
  rw [← LinearMap.ker_eq_bot, LinearMap.ker_eq_bot']
  intro n hn
  funext i
  have : linOf n (Pi.single i 1) = 0 := by rw [show linOf n = linOfMap n from rfl, hn]; rfl
  simpa [linOf_apply, Finset.sum_eq_single i, Pi.single_apply] using this

name: covec_linearIndependent_iff
statement:
theorem covec_linearIndependent_iff (a b c : Point) :
    LinearIndependent ℚ ![linOf a, linOf b, linOf c] ↔ det3 a b c ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [det3_ne_zero_iff_linearIndependent]
  rw [show (![linOf a, linOf b, linOf c] : Fin 3 → (Point →ₗ[ℚ] ℚ)) = linOfMap ∘ ![a, b, c] by
        funext i; fin_cases i <;> rfl]
  exact LinearMap.linearIndependent_iff linOfMap (LinearMap.ker_eq_bot.mpr linOfMap_injective)

name: lift_vertex_triple
statement:
theorem lift_vertex_triple {N : Point} (hN : N ≠ 0) (o : Point) (na nb : Point)
    (hindep : LinearIndependent ℚ
      ![(linOf na).comp (iotaAff N o).linear, (linOf nb).comp (iotaAff N o).linear]) :
    det3 na nb N ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [← covec_linearIndependent_iff]
  rw [LinearIndependent.pair_iff] at hindep
  
  rw [Fintype.linearIndependent_iff]
  intro w hw
  
  
  set s := w 0; set t := w 1; set u := w 2
  have hcomb : s • linOf na + t • linOf nb + u • linOf N = 0 := by
    have := hw
    rw [Fin.sum_univ_three] at this
    simpa [Matrix.cons_val_zero, Matrix.cons_val_one, Matrix.head_cons, Matrix.cons_val_two,
      Matrix.tail_cons] using this
  
  
  have hrange : LinearMap.range (iotaAff N o).linear = LinearMap.ker (linOf N) := by
    rw [iotaAff_linear, range_Lframe_eq_ker hN]
  have hpull : s • (linOf na).comp (iotaAff N o).linear
      + t • (linOf nb).comp (iotaAff N o).linear = 0 := by
    apply LinearMap.ext; intro y
    have hy : (iotaAff N o).linear y ∈ LinearMap.ker (linOf N) := by
      rw [← hrange]; exact ⟨y, rfl⟩
    rw [LinearMap.mem_ker] at hy
    have happ : (s • linOf na + t • linOf nb + u • linOf N) ((iotaAff N o).linear y) = 0 := by
      rw [hcomb]; rfl
    simp only [LinearMap.add_apply, LinearMap.smul_apply, hy, smul_eq_mul, mul_zero,
      add_zero] at happ
    simp only [LinearMap.add_apply, LinearMap.smul_apply, LinearMap.comp_apply, smul_eq_mul,
      LinearMap.zero_apply]
    linarith [happ]
  obtain ⟨hs, ht⟩ := hindep s t hpull
  
  have hu : u • linOf N = 0 := by
    have := hcomb; rw [hs, ht, zero_smul, zero_smul, zero_add, zero_add] at this; exact this
  have hNlin : linOf N ≠ 0 := (linOf_eq_zero_iff N).not.mpr hN
  have hu0 : u = 0 := by
    by_contra hu0
    apply hNlin
    have hkey : (u⁻¹ * u) • linOf N = u⁻¹ • (u • linOf N) := by rw [mul_smul]
    rw [hu, smul_zero, inv_mul_cancel₀ hu0, one_smul] at hkey
    exact hkey
  intro i; fin_cases i
  · exact hs
  · exact ht
  · exact hu0

name: factor_covec
statement:
theorem factor_covec {V : Type*} [AddCommGroup V] [Module ℚ V]
    (f g : V →ₗ[ℚ] ℚ) (hg : Function.Surjective g) (h : LinearMap.ker g ≤ LinearMap.ker f) :
    ∃ c : ℚ, f = c • g
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨v0, hv0⟩ := hg 1
  refine ⟨f v0, ?_⟩
  apply LinearMap.ext; intro x
  have hker : x - (g x) • v0 ∈ LinearMap.ker g := by
    rw [LinearMap.mem_ker]; simp [hv0, mul_comm]
  have hf0 : f (x - (g x) • v0) = 0 := h hker
  rw [map_sub, map_smul, smul_eq_mul, sub_eq_zero] at hf0
  simp only [LinearMap.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul]
  rw [hf0]; ring

name: linOf_surjective
statement: theorem linOf_surjective {N : Point} (hN : N ≠ 0) : Function.Surjective (linOf N)
proof:
:= by
  have hNlin : linOf N ≠ 0 := (linOf_eq_zero_iff N).not.mpr hN
  obtain ⟨x, hx⟩ : ∃ x, linOf N x ≠ 0 := by
    by_contra hcon; push_neg at hcon
    exact hNlin (by apply DFunLike.ext; intro x; exact hcon x)
  intro c
  exact ⟨(c / linOf N x) • x, by rw [map_smul, smul_eq_mul, div_mul_cancel₀ _ hx]⟩

name: active_pullback_pair
statement:
theorem active_pullback_pair {N : Point} (hN : N ≠ 0) (o : Point) (na nb : Point)
    (hdet : det3 na nb N ≠ 0) :
    LinearIndependent ℚ
      ![(linOf na).comp (iotaAff N o).linear, (linOf nb).comp (iotaAff N o).linear]
proof:
:= by
  have htriple : LinearIndependent ℚ ![linOf na, linOf nb, linOf N] :=
    (covec_linearIndependent_iff na nb N).mpr hdet
  have hrange : LinearMap.range (iotaAff N o).linear = LinearMap.ker (linOf N) := by
    rw [iotaAff_linear, range_Lframe_eq_ker hN]
  rw [LinearIndependent.pair_iff]
  intro s t hst
  
  set φ : Point →ₗ[ℚ] ℚ := s • linOf na + t • linOf nb with hφ
  have hφker : LinearMap.ker (linOf N) ≤ LinearMap.ker φ := by
    intro x hx
    rw [LinearMap.mem_ker] at hx ⊢
    have hxr : x ∈ LinearMap.range (iotaAff N o).linear := by rw [hrange]; rwa [LinearMap.mem_ker]
    obtain ⟨y, rfl⟩ := hxr
    have : (s • (linOf na).comp (iotaAff N o).linear
        + t • (linOf nb).comp (iotaAff N o).linear) y = 0 := by rw [hst]; rfl
    simpa [hφ, LinearMap.add_apply, LinearMap.smul_apply, LinearMap.comp_apply] using this
  
  obtain ⟨c, hc⟩ := factor_covec φ (linOf N) (linOf_surjective hN) hφker
  
  rw [Fintype.linearIndependent_iff] at htriple
  have hφeq : s • linOf na + t • linOf nb = c • linOf N := by rw [← hφ]; exact hc
  have hcomb : ∑ i, (![s, t, -c] : Fin 3 → ℚ) i • ![linOf na, linOf nb, linOf N] i = 0 := by
    rw [Fin.sum_univ_three]
    simp only [Matrix.cons_val_zero, Matrix.cons_val_one, Matrix.head_cons, Matrix.cons_val_two,
      Matrix.tail_cons, neg_smul]
    rw [hφeq]; abel
  have hz := htriple ![s, t, -c] hcomb
  refine ⟨hz 0, hz 1⟩

name: mkPoint_zero
statement: theorem mkPoint_zero (a b c : ℚ) : (mkPoint a b c) 0 = a
proof: := rfl

name: mkPoint_one
statement: theorem mkPoint_one (a b c : ℚ) : (mkPoint a b c) 1 = b
proof: := rfl

name: mkPoint_two
statement: theorem mkPoint_two (a b c : ℚ) : (mkPoint a b c) 2 = c
proof: := rfl

name: det3_expand
statement:
theorem det3_expand (a b c : Point) :
    det3 a b c = a 0 * (b 1 * c 2 - b 2 * c 1) - a 1 * (b 0 * c 2 - b 2 * c 0)
                 + a 2 * (b 0 * c 1 - b 1 * c 0)
proof:
:= by
  rw [det3, dotQ,
     show (crossQ b c) 0 = b 1 * c 2 - b 2 * c 1 from rfl,
     show (crossQ b c) 1 = b 2 * c 0 - b 0 * c 2 from rfl,
     show (crossQ b c) 2 = b 0 * c 1 - b 1 * c 0 from rfl]
  ring

name: cramer3_dotQ_zero
statement:
theorem cramer3_dotQ_zero {r0 r1 r2 rhs : Point} (hd : det3 r0 r1 r2 ≠ 0) :
    dotQ r0 (cramer3 r0 r1 r2 rhs) = rhs 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [det3_expand] at hd
  rw [dotQ]
  show r0 0 * (cramer3 r0 r1 r2 rhs) 0 + r0 1 * (cramer3 r0 r1 r2 rhs) 1
       + r0 2 * (cramer3 r0 r1 r2 rhs) 2 = rhs 0
  rw [cramer3]
  simp only [mkPoint_zero, mkPoint_one, mkPoint_two]
  rw [det3_expand, det3_expand, det3_expand, det3_expand]
  simp only [mkPoint_zero, mkPoint_one, mkPoint_two]
  field_simp
  ring

name: cramer3_dotQ_one
statement:
theorem cramer3_dotQ_one {r0 r1 r2 rhs : Point} (hd : det3 r0 r1 r2 ≠ 0) :
    dotQ r1 (cramer3 r0 r1 r2 rhs) = rhs 1
proof:
:= by
  rw [det3_expand] at hd
  rw [dotQ]
  show r1 0 * (cramer3 r0 r1 r2 rhs) 0 + r1 1 * (cramer3 r0 r1 r2 rhs) 1
       + r1 2 * (cramer3 r0 r1 r2 rhs) 2 = rhs 1
  rw [cramer3]
  simp only [mkPoint_zero, mkPoint_one, mkPoint_two]
  rw [det3_expand, det3_expand, det3_expand, det3_expand]
  simp only [mkPoint_zero, mkPoint_one, mkPoint_two]
  field_simp
  ring

name: cramer3_dotQ_two
statement:
theorem cramer3_dotQ_two {r0 r1 r2 rhs : Point} (hd : det3 r0 r1 r2 ≠ 0) :
    dotQ r2 (cramer3 r0 r1 r2 rhs) = rhs 2
proof:
:= by
  rw [det3_expand] at hd
  rw [dotQ]
  show r2 0 * (cramer3 r0 r1 r2 rhs) 0 + r2 1 * (cramer3 r0 r1 r2 rhs) 1
       + r2 2 * (cramer3 r0 r1 r2 rhs) 2 = rhs 2
  rw [cramer3]
  simp only [mkPoint_zero, mkPoint_one, mkPoint_two]
  rw [det3_expand, det3_expand, det3_expand, det3_expand]
  simp only [mkPoint_zero, mkPoint_one, mkPoint_two]
  field_simp
  ring

name: cramer3_unique
statement:
theorem cramer3_unique {r0 r1 r2 rhs : Point} (hd : det3 r0 r1 r2 ≠ 0)
    {x : Point} (h0 : dotQ r0 x = rhs 0) (h1 : dotQ r1 x = rhs 1) (h2 : dotQ r2 x = rhs 2) :
    x = cramer3 r0 r1 r2 rhs
proof:
:= by
  set y := cramer3 r0 r1 r2 rhs with hy
  have hy0 : dotQ r0 y = rhs 0 := cramer3_dotQ_zero hd
  have hy1 : dotQ r1 y = rhs 1 := cramer3_dotQ_one hd
  have hy2 : dotQ r2 y = rhs 2 := cramer3_dotQ_two hd
  
  have hli : LinearIndependent ℚ ![r0, r1, r2] := (det3_ne_zero_iff_linearIndependent r0 r1 r2).mp hd
  have hlin : ∀ (r : Point), linOf r (x - y) = dotQ r x - dotQ r y := by
    intro r; rw [map_sub, dotQ_eq_sum, dotQ_eq_sum]; rfl
  have hd0 : linOf r0 (x - y) = 0 := by rw [hlin, h0, hy0, sub_self]
  have hd1 : linOf r1 (x - y) = 0 := by rw [hlin, h1, hy1, sub_self]
  have hd2 : linOf r2 (x - y) = 0 := by rw [hlin, h2, hy2, sub_self]
  
  have htriple : LinearIndependent ℚ ![linOf r0, linOf r1, linOf r2] :=
    (covec_linearIndependent_iff r0 r1 r2).mpr hd
  
  have hzero : x - y = 0 := by
    by_contra hne
    
    set ev : (Point →ₗ[ℚ] ℚ) →ₗ[ℚ] ℚ :=
      { toFun := fun f => f (x - y), map_add' := by intro f g; simp, map_smul' := by intro c f; simp }
      with hev
    have hev_ne : ev ≠ 0 := by
      rw [DFunLike.ne_iff]
      obtain ⟨i, hi⟩ : ∃ i, (x - y) i ≠ 0 := by
        by_contra h; push_neg at h; exact hne (funext h)
      refine ⟨linOf (Pi.single i 1), ?_⟩
      show linOf (Pi.single i 1) (x - y) ≠ (0 : (Point →ₗ[ℚ] ℚ) →ₗ[ℚ] ℚ) (linOf (Pi.single i 1))
      rw [LinearMap.zero_apply, linOf_apply, Finset.sum_eq_single i]
      · simpa using hi
      · intro j _ hj; simp [Pi.single_apply, Ne.symm hj]
      · intro h; exact absurd (Finset.mem_univ i) h
    
    have hdual : Module.finrank ℚ (Point →ₗ[ℚ] ℚ) = 3 := by
      rw [Module.finrank_linearMap]; simp [Module.finrank_pi]
    have hspan3 : Module.finrank ℚ (Submodule.span ℚ (Set.range ![linOf r0, linOf r1, linOf r2])) = 3 := by
      rw [finrank_span_eq_card htriple]; simp
    have hspan_top : Submodule.span ℚ (Set.range ![linOf r0, linOf r1, linOf r2]) = ⊤ := by
      apply Submodule.eq_top_of_finrank_eq; rw [hspan3, hdual]
    have hkertop : LinearMap.ker ev = ⊤ := by
      rw [eq_top_iff, ← hspan_top, Submodule.span_le]
      rintro f hf
      simp only [Set.mem_range] at hf
      obtain ⟨i, rfl⟩ := hf
      rw [SetLike.mem_coe, LinearMap.mem_ker]
      fin_cases i
      · exact hd0
      · exact hd1
      · exact hd2
    apply hev_ne
    apply LinearMap.ext; intro f
    have : f ∈ LinearMap.ker ev := hkertop ▸ Submodule.mem_top
    simpa [LinearMap.mem_ker] using this
  rw [sub_eq_zero] at hzero; exact hzero

name: pointBEq_iff
statement: theorem pointBEq_iff (p q : Point) : pointBEq p q = true ↔ p = q
proof:
:= by
  rw [pointBEq]
  simp only [Bool.and_eq_true, beq_iff_eq]
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨⟨h0, h1⟩, h2⟩; funext i; fin_cases i <;> assumption
  · intro h; subst h; exact ⟨⟨rfl, rfl⟩, rfl⟩

name: feasible_iff
statement:
theorem feasible_iff (G : Array Half) (x : Point) :
    feasible G x = true ↔ ∀ g ∈ G, 0 ≤ gOf g x
proof:
:= by
  rw [feasible, Array.all_eq_true]
  constructor
  · intro h g hg
    obtain ⟨i, hi, rfl⟩ := Array.mem_iff_getElem.mp hg
    have := h ⟨i, hi⟩
    simpa [gOf_apply] using (decide_eq_true_iff).mp this
  · intro h i
    have : 0 ≤ gOf (G[i.1]) x := h G[i.1] (Array.getElem_mem i.2)
    simpa [gOf_apply, decide_eq_true_iff] using this

name: gOf_linear_ne_zero_iff
statement: theorem gOf_linear_ne_zero_iff (g : Half) : (gOf g).linear ≠ 0 ↔ g.n ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [gOf_linear]; exact (linOf_eq_zero_iff g.n).not

name: affineMap_eq_of_basis
statement:
theorem affineMap_eq_of_basis {b : AffineBasis (Fin 4) ℚ (Fin 3 → ℚ)}
    {f g : Point →ᵃ[ℚ] ℚ} (h : ∀ i, f (b i) = g (b i)) : f = g
proof:
:= by
  apply AffineMap.ext
  intro x
  have hx := b.affineCombination_coord_eq_self x
  conv_lhs => rw [← hx]
  conv_rhs => rw [← hx]
  rw [Finset.map_affineCombination _ _ _ (b.sum_coord_apply_eq_one x),
      Finset.map_affineCombination _ _ _ (b.sum_coord_apply_eq_one x)]
  have hfg : (⇑f ∘ ⇑b) = (⇑g ∘ ⇑b) := by funext i; exact h i
  rw [hfg]

name: gOf_eq_smul_coord
statement:
theorem gOf_eq_smul_coord {b : AffineBasis (Fin 4) ℚ (Fin 3 → ℚ)}
    (f : Point →ᵃ[ℚ] ℚ) (j : Fin 4) (lam : ℚ)
    (hj : f (b j) = lam) (hother : ∀ i, i ≠ j → f (b i) = 0) :
    f = lam • (b.coord j)
proof:
:= by
  apply affineMap_eq_of_basis (b := b)
  intro i
  by_cases hij : i = j
  · subst hij
    show f (b i) = (lam • (b.coord i)) (b i)
    rw [hj]
    show lam = lam • (b.coord i) (b i)
    rw [b.coord_apply_eq]; simp
  · show f (b i) = (lam • (b.coord j)) (b i)
    rw [hother i hij]
    show (0 : ℚ) = lam • (b.coord j) (b i)
    rw [b.coord_apply_ne (Ne.symm hij)]; simp

name: halfspace_eq_of_pos_smul
proof:
:= by
  ext x
  simp only [Set.mem_setOf_eq, hfg]
  show 0 ≤ lam • g x ↔ 0 ≤ g x
  rw [smul_eq_mul]
  rw [mul_nonneg_iff_of_pos_left hlam]

name: dotQ_crossQ_left
statement: theorem dotQ_crossQ_left (v1 v2 : Point) : dotQ (crossQ v1 v2) v1 = 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [dotQ_eq_sum, crossQ_eq_crossProduct,
     show (∑ i, (crossProduct v1 v2) i * v1 i) = (crossProduct v1 v2) ⬝ᵥ v1 from rfl,
     dotProduct_comm]
  exact dot_self_cross v1 v2

name: dotQ_crossQ_right
statement: theorem dotQ_crossQ_right (v1 v2 : Point) : dotQ (crossQ v1 v2) v2 = 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [dotQ_eq_sum, crossQ_eq_crossProduct,
     show (∑ i, (crossProduct v1 v2) i * v2 i) = (crossProduct v1 v2) ⬝ᵥ v2 from rfl,
     dotProduct_comm]
  exact dot_cross_self v1 v2

name: dotQ_crossQ_det
statement: theorem dotQ_crossQ_det (v0 v1 v2 : Point) : dotQ (crossQ v1 v2) v0 = det3 v0 v1 v2
proof:
:= by
  rw [det3_eq, crossQ_eq_crossProduct, dotQ_eq_sum, dotProduct]
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl; intro i _; rw [mul_comm]

name: gOf_neg
statement: theorem gOf_neg (g : Half) (x : Point) : gOf (Half.neg g) x = - (gOf g x)
proof:
:= by
  show (Half.neg g).eval x = - (g.eval x)
  unfold Half.neg Half.eval
  have h0 : (psub (mkPoint 0 0 0) g.n) = fun i => - g.n i := by
    funext i; show mkPoint 0 0 0 i - g.n i = - g.n i; fin_cases i <;> simp [mkPoint]
  rw [h0]
  simp only [dotQ]; ring

name: origin_facet_eval
statement:
theorem origin_facet_eval (n vk : Point) (hvk : dotQ n vk ≠ 0)
    (g : Half) (hg : g = if 0 ≤ dotQ n vk then (⟨n, 0⟩ : Half) else Half.neg ⟨n, 0⟩) :
    gOf g 0 = 0 ∧ 0 < gOf g vk
      ∧ (∀ x, dotQ n x = 0 → gOf g x = 0)
      ∧ (∀ x, gOf g x = (if 0 ≤ dotQ n vk then (1 : ℚ) else -1) * (dotQ n x))
proof:
:= by
  have heval : ∀ x, gOf (⟨n, 0⟩ : Half) x = dotQ n x := by
    intro x; show Half.eval ⟨n, 0⟩ x = dotQ n x; simp [Half.eval]
  by_cases hpos : 0 ≤ dotQ n vk
  · subst hg; simp only [hpos, if_true]
    refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
    · rw [heval]; simp [dotQ]
    · rw [heval]; exact lt_of_le_of_ne hpos (Ne.symm hvk)
    · intro x hx; rw [heval]; exact hx
    · intro x; rw [heval]; ring
  · subst hg; simp only [hpos, if_false]
    have hneg : dotQ n vk < 0 := lt_of_le_of_ne (le_of_not_le hpos) hvk
    refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
    · rw [gOf_neg, heval]; simp [dotQ]
    · rw [gOf_neg, heval]; linarith
    · intro x hx; rw [gOf_neg, heval, hx]; simp
    · intro x; rw [gOf_neg, heval]; ring

name: dotQ_psub
statement: theorem dotQ_psub (n a b : Point) : dotQ n (psub a b) = dotQ n a - dotQ n b
proof:
:= by
  simp only [dotQ, psub]; ring

name: base_facet_eval
statement:
theorem base_facet_eval (v0 v1 v2 : Point)
    (n3 : Point) (hn3 : n3 = crossQ (psub v1 v0) (psub v2 v0))
    (c3 : ℚ) (hc3 : c3 = dotQ n3 v0) (hc3ne : c3 ≠ 0)
    (g3 : Half) (hg3 : g3 = if c3 ≤ 0 then (⟨n3, c3⟩ : Half) else Half.neg ⟨n3, c3⟩) :
    gOf g3 v0 = 0 ∧ gOf g3 v1 = 0 ∧ gOf g3 v2 = 0 ∧ 0 < gOf g3 0
      ∧ (∀ x, gOf g3 x = (if c3 ≤ 0 then (1 : ℚ) else -1) * (dotQ n3 x - c3))
proof:
:= by
  have heval : ∀ x, gOf (⟨n3, c3⟩ : Half) x = dotQ n3 x - c3 := by
    intro x; show Half.eval ⟨n3, c3⟩ x = dotQ n3 x - c3; simp [Half.eval]
  
  have hperp1 : dotQ n3 v1 = c3 := by
    have h := dotQ_crossQ_left (psub v1 v0) (psub v2 v0)
    rw [← hn3] at h; rw [dotQ_psub] at h; rw [hc3]; linarith
  have hperp2 : dotQ n3 v2 = c3 := by
    have h := dotQ_crossQ_right (psub v1 v0) (psub v2 v0)
    rw [← hn3] at h; rw [dotQ_psub] at h; rw [hc3]; linarith
  by_cases hpos : c3 ≤ 0
  · subst hg3; simp only [hpos, if_true]
    refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
    · rw [heval, ← hc3]; ring
    · rw [heval, hperp1]; ring
    · rw [heval, hperp2]; ring
    · rw [heval]; have : dotQ n3 (0 : Point) = 0 := by simp [dotQ]
      rw [this]; have hneg : c3 < 0 := lt_of_le_of_ne hpos hc3ne; linarith
    · intro x; rw [heval]; ring
  · subst hg3; simp only [hpos, if_false]
    have hpos' : 0 < c3 := lt_of_not_le hpos
    refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
    · rw [gOf_neg, heval, ← hc3]; ring
    · rw [gOf_neg, heval, hperp1]; ring
    · rw [gOf_neg, heval, hperp2]; ring
    · rw [gOf_neg, heval]; have : dotQ n3 (0 : Point) = 0 := by simp [dotQ]
      rw [this]; linarith
    · intro x; rw [gOf_neg, heval]; ring

name: mem_dedup_imp
statement:
theorem mem_dedup_imp (f : Point → Point → Bool) (xs : Array Point) {p : Point}
    (hp : p ∈ dedup f xs) : p ∈ xs
proof:
:= by
  rw [dedup] at hp
  refine Array.foldl_induction
    (motive := fun _ acc => ∀ q, q ∈ acc → q ∈ xs) (by intro q hq; simp at hq) ?_ p hp
  intro i acc ih q hq
  by_cases hany : acc.any (fun y => f xs[i] y) = true
  · rw [if_pos hany] at hq; exact ih q hq
  · rw [if_neg hany] at hq
    rw [Array.mem_push] at hq
    rcases hq with hq | rfl
    · exact ih q hq
    · exact Array.getElem_mem i.2

name: nodup_dedup_pointBEq
statement: theorem nodup_dedup_pointBEq (xs : Array Point) : (dedup pointBEq xs).toList.Nodup
proof:
:= by
  rw [dedup]
  refine Array.foldl_induction
    (as := xs) (init := (#[] : Array Point))
    (motive := fun _ acc => acc.toList.Nodup) (by simp) ?_
  intro i acc ih
  by_cases hany : acc.any (fun y => pointBEq xs[i] y) = true
  · rw [if_pos hany]; exact ih
  · rw [if_neg hany]
    rw [Array.push_toList, List.nodup_append]
    refine ⟨ih, by simp, ?_⟩
    simp only [List.mem_singleton, List.disjoint_singleton]
    intro hmem
    apply hany
    rw [Array.any_eq_true]
    obtain ⟨j, hj⟩ := Array.mem_iff_getElem.mp (Array.mem_toList.mp hmem)
    exact ⟨⟨j, hj.1⟩, (pointBEq_iff _ _).mpr hj.2.symm⟩

name: nodup_verts
statement: theorem nodup_verts (G : Array Half) : (verts G).toList.Nodup
proof:
:= by
  show (dedup pointBEq _).toList.Nodup
  exact nodup_dedup_pointBEq _

name: nodup_facetVerts
statement: theorem nodup_facetVerts (G : Array Half) (i : Nat) : (facetVerts G i).toList.Nodup
proof:
:= by
  rw [facetVerts, Array.toList_filter]
  exact (nodup_verts G).filter _

name: mem_dedup_pointBEq
statement:
theorem mem_dedup_pointBEq (xs : Array Point) {p : Point} :
    p ∈ dedup pointBEq xs ↔ p ∈ xs
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · exact mem_dedup_imp pointBEq xs
  · intro hp
    rw [dedup]
    obtain ⟨k, hk, rfl⟩ := Array.mem_iff_getElem.mp hp
    
    refine Array.foldl_induction
      (motive := fun n acc => k < n → xs[k] ∈ acc)
      (by intro h; omega) ?_ (by omega)
    intro i acc ih hki
    rcases Nat.lt_succ_iff_lt_or_eq.mp hki with hlt | heq
    · 
      have hmem := ih hlt
      by_cases hany : acc.any (fun z => pointBEq xs[i] z) = true
      · rw [if_pos hany]; exact hmem
      · rw [if_neg hany]; exact Array.mem_push.mpr (Or.inl hmem)
    · 
      subst heq
      by_cases hany : acc.any (fun z => pointBEq xs[i] z) = true
      · 
        rw [if_pos hany]
        obtain ⟨j, hj⟩ := Array.any_eq_true.mp hany
        have heqj : xs[i] = acc[j] := (pointBEq_iff _ _).mp hj
        exact heqj ▸ Array.getElem_mem j.2
      · rw [if_neg hany]; exact Array.mem_push.mpr (Or.inr rfl)

name: mem_planeTriples_inner
statement:
theorem mem_planeTriples_inner (n i j : Nat) (acc : Array (Nat × Nat × Nat))
    (t : Nat × Nat × Nat) :
    t ∈ (Array.range n).foldl (fun acc k => if j < k then acc.push (i, j, k) else acc) acc
      ↔ t ∈ acc ∨ (t.1 = i ∧ t.2.1 = j ∧ j < t.2.2 ∧ t.2.2 < n)
proof:
:= by
  have key := Array.foldl_induction
    (as := Array.range n)
    (init := acc)
    (motive := fun m acc' => t ∈ acc' ↔ t ∈ acc ∨ (t.1 = i ∧ t.2.1 = j ∧ j < t.2.2 ∧ t.2.2 < m))
    (f := fun acc k => if j < k then acc.push (i, j, k) else acc)
    (by simp)
    (by
      intro k acc' ih
      rw [show (Array.range n)[k] = (↑k : Nat) from Array.getElem_range _]
      dsimp only
      by_cases hjk : j < (k : Nat)
      · rw [if_pos hjk, Array.mem_push, ih]
        obtain ⟨t1, t2, t3⟩ := t
        constructor
        · rintro ((h | h) | h)
          · exact Or.inl h
          · exact Or.inr ⟨h.1, h.2.1, h.2.2.1, by omega⟩
          · rw [Prod.mk.injEq, Prod.mk.injEq] at h
            obtain ⟨e1, e2, e3⟩ := h
            exact Or.inr ⟨e1, e2, by simp only; omega, by simp only; omega⟩
        · rintro (h | h)
          · exact Or.inl (Or.inl h)
          · simp only at h
            obtain ⟨e1, e2, e3, e4⟩ := h
            rcases Nat.lt_succ_iff_lt_or_eq.mp e4 with hlt | heq
            · exact Or.inl (Or.inr ⟨e1, e2, e3, hlt⟩)
            · refine Or.inr ?_
              rw [Prod.mk.injEq, Prod.mk.injEq]
              exact ⟨e1, e2, heq⟩
      · rw [if_neg hjk, ih]
        constructor
        · rintro (h | h)
          · exact Or.inl h
          · exact Or.inr ⟨h.1, h.2.1, h.2.2.1, by omega⟩
        · rintro (h | h)
          · exact Or.inl h
          · rcases Nat.lt_succ_iff_lt_or_eq.mp h.2.2.2 with hlt | heq
            · exact Or.inr ⟨h.1, h.2.1, h.2.2.1, hlt⟩
            · exact absurd (heq ▸ h.2.2.1) (by omega))
  simpa only [Array.size_range] using key

name: mem_planeTriples_mid
statement:
theorem mem_planeTriples_mid (n i : Nat) (acc : Array (Nat × Nat × Nat))
    (t : Nat × Nat × Nat) :
    t ∈ (Array.range n).foldl (fun acc j =>
        if i < j then
          (Array.range n).foldl (fun acc k => if j < k then acc.push (i, j, k) else acc) acc
        else acc) acc
      ↔ t ∈ acc ∨ (t.1 = i ∧ i < t.2.1 ∧ t.2.1 < t.2.2 ∧ t.2.2 < n)
proof:
:= by
  have key := Array.foldl_induction
    (as := Array.range n)
    (init := acc)
    (motive := fun m acc' => t ∈ acc'
      ↔ t ∈ acc ∨ (t.1 = i ∧ i < t.2.1 ∧ t.2.1 < m ∧ t.2.1 < t.2.2 ∧ t.2.2 < n))
    (f := fun acc j =>
        if i < j then
          (Array.range n).foldl (fun acc k => if j < k then acc.push (i, j, k) else acc) acc
        else acc)
    (by simp)
    (by
      intro j acc' ih
      rw [show (Array.range n)[j] = (↑j : Nat) from Array.getElem_range _]
      dsimp only
      by_cases hij : i < (j : Nat)
      · rw [if_pos hij, mem_planeTriples_inner, ih]
        constructor
        · rintro ((h | h) | h)
          · exact Or.inl h
          · 
            exact Or.inr ⟨h.1, h.2.1, by omega, h.2.2.2.1, h.2.2.2.2⟩
          · 
            obtain ⟨e1, e2, e3, e4⟩ := h
            exact Or.inr ⟨e1, by omega, by omega, by omega, e4⟩
        · rintro (h | h)
          · exact Or.inl (Or.inl h)
          · 
            rcases Nat.lt_succ_iff_lt_or_eq.mp h.2.2.1 with hlt | heq
            · exact Or.inl (Or.inr ⟨h.1, h.2.1, hlt, h.2.2.2.1, h.2.2.2.2⟩)
            · obtain ⟨e1, e2, e3, e4, e5⟩ := h
              exact Or.inr ⟨e1, heq, by omega, e5⟩
      · rw [if_neg hij, ih]
        constructor
        · rintro (h | h)
          · exact Or.inl h
          · exact Or.inr ⟨h.1, h.2.1, by omega, h.2.2.2.1, h.2.2.2.2⟩
        · rintro (h | h)
          · exact Or.inl h
          · rcases Nat.lt_succ_iff_lt_or_eq.mp h.2.2.1 with hlt | heq
            · exact Or.inr ⟨h.1, h.2.1, hlt, h.2.2.2.1, h.2.2.2.2⟩
            · exact absurd (heq ▸ h.2.1) (by omega))
  refine key.trans ?_
  rw [Array.size_range]
  constructor
  · rintro (h | h)
    · exact Or.inl h
    · exact Or.inr ⟨h.1, h.2.1, h.2.2.2.1, h.2.2.2.2⟩
  · rintro (h | h)
    · exact Or.inl h
    · exact Or.inr ⟨h.1, h.2.1, by omega, h.2.2.1, h.2.2.2⟩

name: mem_planeTriples
statement:
theorem mem_planeTriples (n : Nat) (a b c : Nat) :
    (a, b, c) ∈ planeTriples n ↔ a < b ∧ b < c ∧ c < n
proof:
:= by
  rw [planeTriples]
  have key := Array.foldl_induction
    (as := Array.range n)
    (init := (#[] : Array (Nat × Nat × Nat)))
    (motive := fun m acc => (a, b, c) ∈ acc ↔ (a < b ∧ b < c ∧ c < n ∧ a < m))
    (f := fun acc i =>
      (Array.range n).foldl (fun acc j =>
        if i < j then
          (Array.range n).foldl (fun acc k => if j < k then acc.push (i, j, k) else acc) acc
        else acc) acc)
    (by simp)
    (by
      intro i acc ih
      rw [show (Array.range n)[i] = (↑i : Nat) from Array.getElem_range _]
      dsimp only
      rw [mem_planeTriples_mid, ih]
      constructor
      · rintro (h | h)
        · exact ⟨h.1, h.2.1, h.2.2.1, by omega⟩
        · simp only at h; exact ⟨by omega, by omega, h.2.2.2, by omega⟩
      · rintro h
        rcases Nat.lt_succ_iff_lt_or_eq.mp h.2.2.2 with hlt | heq
        · exact Or.inl ⟨h.1, h.2.1, h.2.2.1, hlt⟩
        · exact Or.inr ⟨heq, heq ▸ h.1, h.2.1, h.2.2.1⟩)
  refine key.trans ?_
  rw [Array.size_range]
  constructor
  · rintro h; exact ⟨h.1, h.2.1, h.2.2.1⟩
  · rintro h; exact ⟨h.1, h.2.1, h.2.2, by omega⟩

name: tripleVertex_eq_some
statement:
theorem tripleVertex_eq_some {G : Array Half} {i j k : Nat}
    (hi : i < G.size) (hj : j < G.size) (hk : k < G.size) {p : Point} :
    tripleVertex G i j k = some p ↔
      det3 G[i].n G[j].n G[k].n ≠ 0
        ∧ p = cramer3 G[i].n G[j].n G[k].n (mkPoint G[i].c G[j].c G[k].c)
proof:
:= by
  rw [tripleVertex]
  rw [Array.getElem?_eq_getElem hi, Array.getElem?_eq_getElem hj, Array.getElem?_eq_getElem hk]
  simp only
  by_cases hd : det3 G[i].n G[j].n G[k].n = 0
  · rw [if_pos (by rw [hd]; rfl)]
    constructor
    · intro h; exact absurd h (by simp)
    · rintro ⟨hne, _⟩; exact absurd hd hne
  · rw [if_neg (by simpa using hd)]
    simp only [Option.some.injEq]
    constructor
    · intro h; exact ⟨hd, h.symm⟩
    · rintro ⟨_, hp⟩; exact hp.symm

name: mem_verts
statement:
theorem mem_verts {G : Array Half} {p : Point} :
    p ∈ verts G ↔ feasible G p = true ∧ ∃ a b c, a < b ∧ b < c ∧ c < G.size
        ∧ tripleVertex G a b c = some p
proof:
:= by
  rw [verts, mem_dedup_pointBEq, Array.mem_filter]
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨hmem, hfeas⟩
    refine ⟨hfeas, ?_⟩
    rw [Array.mem_filterMap] at hmem
    obtain ⟨⟨a, b, c⟩, htmem, hsome⟩ := hmem
    rw [mem_planeTriples] at htmem
    exact ⟨a, b, c, htmem.1, htmem.2.1, htmem.2.2, hsome⟩
  · rintro ⟨hfeas, a, b, c, hab, hbc, hcn, hsome⟩
    refine ⟨?_, hfeas⟩
    rw [Array.mem_filterMap]
    exact ⟨(a, b, c), (mem_planeTriples G.size a b c).mpr ⟨hab, hbc, hcn⟩, hsome⟩

name: mem_facetVerts
statement:
theorem mem_facetVerts {G : Array Half} {i : Nat} {p : Point} :
    p ∈ facetVerts G i ↔ p ∈ verts G ∧ onPlane G i p = true
proof:
:= by
  rw [facetVerts, Array.mem_filter]

name: dotQ_smul_left
statement: theorem dotQ_smul_left (lam : ℚ) (u v : Point) : dotQ (lam • u) v = lam * dotQ u v
proof:
:= by
  rw [dotQ, dotQ]; simp only [Pi.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul]; ring

name: dotQ_smul_right
statement: theorem dotQ_smul_right (lam : ℚ) (u v : Point) : dotQ u (lam • v) = lam * dotQ u v
proof:
:= by
  rw [dotQ, dotQ]; simp only [Pi.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul]; ring

name: ratProp_pos_of_primDir_eq
statement:
theorem ratProp_pos_of_primDir_eq {g h : IPlane} (hγg : gamma g ≠ 0) (hγh : gamma h ≠ 0)
    (heq : IPlane.primDir g = IPlane.primDir h) :
    ∃ ρ : ℚ, 0 < ρ ∧ (h.a : ℚ) = ρ * g.a ∧ (h.b : ℚ) = ρ * g.b ∧
      (h.c : ℚ) = ρ * g.c ∧ (h.d : ℚ) = ρ * g.d
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨(gamma h : ℚ) / (gamma g : ℚ),
    div_pos (by exact_mod_cast Nat.pos_of_ne_zero hγh)
      (by exact_mod_cast Nat.pos_of_ne_zero hγg), ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · have hga := primDir_entry_a hγg
    have hha := primDir_entry_a hγh
    rw [heq] at hga
    have hγg0 : (gamma g : ℚ) ≠ 0 := by exact_mod_cast hγg
    have e1 : (g.a : ℚ) = (gamma g : ℚ) * ((IPlane.primDir h).a : ℚ) := by exact_mod_cast hga
    have e2 : (h.a : ℚ) = (gamma h : ℚ) * ((IPlane.primDir h).a : ℚ) := by exact_mod_cast hha
    rw [e2, e1]; field_simp; ring
  · have hga := primDir_entry_b hγg
    have hha := primDir_entry_b hγh
    rw [heq] at hga
    have hγg0 : (gamma g : ℚ) ≠ 0 := by exact_mod_cast hγg
    have e1 : (g.b : ℚ) = (gamma g : ℚ) * ((IPlane.primDir h).b : ℚ) := by exact_mod_cast hga
    have e2 : (h.b : ℚ) = (gamma h : ℚ) * ((IPlane.primDir h).b : ℚ) := by exact_mod_cast hha
    rw [e2, e1]; field_simp; ring
  · have hga := primDir_entry_c hγg
    have hha := primDir_entry_c hγh
    rw [heq] at hga
    have hγg0 : (gamma g : ℚ) ≠ 0 := by exact_mod_cast hγg
    have e1 : (g.c : ℚ) = (gamma g : ℚ) * ((IPlane.primDir h).c : ℚ) := by exact_mod_cast hga
    have e2 : (h.c : ℚ) = (gamma h : ℚ) * ((IPlane.primDir h).c : ℚ) := by exact_mod_cast hha
    rw [e2, e1]; field_simp; ring
  · have hga := primDir_entry_d hγg
    have hha := primDir_entry_d hγh
    rw [heq] at hga
    have hγg0 : (gamma g : ℚ) ≠ 0 := by exact_mod_cast hγg
    have e1 : (g.d : ℚ) = (gamma g : ℚ) * ((IPlane.primDir h).d : ℚ) := by exact_mod_cast hga
    have e2 : (h.d : ℚ) = (gamma h : ℚ) * ((IPlane.primDir h).d : ℚ) := by exact_mod_cast hha
    rw [e2, e1]; field_simp; ring

name: primDir_eq_ismul_sign
statement:
theorem primDir_eq_ismul_sign {g h : IPlane} {ρ : ℚ} (hρ : ρ ≠ 0)
    (ha : (h.a : ℚ) = ρ * g.a) (hb : (h.b : ℚ) = ρ * g.b)
    (hc : (h.c : ℚ) = ρ * g.c) (hd : (h.d : ℚ) = ρ * g.d) :
    IPlane.primDir h = ismul (Int.sign ρ.num) (IPlane.primDir g)
proof:
:= by
  set q : Int := (ρ.den : Int) with hq
  set p : Int := ρ.num with hpn
  have hqpos : (0 : Int) < q := by rw [hq]; exact_mod_cast ρ.pos
  have hqne : q ≠ 0 := ne_of_gt hqpos
  have hpne : p ≠ 0 := by rw [hpn]; exact Rat.num_ne_zero.mpr hρ
  have hqρ : (q : ℚ) * ρ = (p : ℚ) := by
    rw [hq, hpn]; exact_mod_cast Rat.den_mul_eq_num ρ
  have eqa : q * h.a = p * g.a := by
    have : (q : ℚ) * (h.a : ℚ) = (p : ℚ) * (g.a : ℚ) := by rw [ha, ← mul_assoc, hqρ]
    exact_mod_cast this
  have eqb : q * h.b = p * g.b := by
    have : (q : ℚ) * (h.b : ℚ) = (p : ℚ) * (g.b : ℚ) := by rw [hb, ← mul_assoc, hqρ]
    exact_mod_cast this
  have eqc : q * h.c = p * g.c := by
    have : (q : ℚ) * (h.c : ℚ) = (p : ℚ) * (g.c : ℚ) := by rw [hc, ← mul_assoc, hqρ]
    exact_mod_cast this
  have eqd : q * h.d = p * g.d := by
    have : (q : ℚ) * (h.d : ℚ) = (p : ℚ) * (g.d : ℚ) := by rw [hd, ← mul_assoc, hqρ]
    exact_mod_cast this
  have heq : ismul q h = ismul p g := by
    unfold ismul; rw [IPlane.mk.injEq]; exact ⟨eqa, eqb, eqc, eqd⟩
  
  have hpd : IPlane.primDir (ismul q h) = IPlane.primDir (ismul p g) := by rw [heq]
  rw [primDir_ismul h hqne, primDir_ismul g hpne] at hpd
  rw [Int.sign_eq_one_of_pos hqpos] at hpd
  
  have hone : ismul (1 : Int) (IPlane.primDir h) = IPlane.primDir h := by
    unfold ismul; cases (IPlane.primDir h); simp
  rw [hone] at hpd
  rw [hpd]

name: gamma_faceSOf_ne
statement:
theorem gamma_faceSOf_ne {t : Triangle} (hdet : detOrigin t ≠ 0) :
    gamma (faceSOf t).plane ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  intro hγ
  obtain ⟨ha, hb, hc, hd⟩ := (gamma_eq_zero_iff (faceSOf t).plane).mp hγ
  obtain ⟨m, hm, _, _, _, hdm⟩ := Proof.MeshIntersectKeep.isMulOf_faceSOf_plane t
  rw [hd] at hdm
  have : (0 : ℚ) = m * detOrigin t := by exact_mod_cast hdm
  exact hdet (by
    rcases mul_eq_zero.mp this.symm with h | h
    · exact absurd h (ne_of_gt hm)
    · exact h)

name: carrier_ratio_of_ratProp
statement:
theorem carrier_ratio_of_ratProp {s t : Triangle} {ρ : ℚ}
    (ha : ((faceSOf t).plane.a : ℚ) = ρ * (faceSOf s).plane.a)
    (hb : ((faceSOf t).plane.b : ℚ) = ρ * (faceSOf s).plane.b)
    (hc : ((faceSOf t).plane.c : ℚ) = ρ * (faceSOf s).plane.c)
    (hd : ((faceSOf t).plane.d : ℚ) = ρ * (faceSOf s).plane.d) :
    ∃ κ : ℚ, (0 < ρ → 0 < κ) ∧ (ρ < 0 → κ < 0)
      ∧ carrierNormal t = κ • carrierNormal s ∧ detOrigin t = κ * detOrigin s
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨ms, hms, hsa, hsb, hsc, hsd⟩ := Proof.MeshIntersectKeep.isMulOf_faceSOf_plane s
  obtain ⟨mt, hmt, hta, htb, htc, htd⟩ := Proof.MeshIntersectKeep.isMulOf_faceSOf_plane t
  have hmtne : mt ≠ 0 := ne_of_gt hmt
  refine ⟨ρ * ms / mt, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · intro hρ; exact div_pos (mul_pos hρ hms) hmt
  · intro hρ; exact div_neg_of_neg_of_pos (mul_neg_of_neg_of_pos hρ hms) hmt
  · 
    funext i
    simp only [Pi.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul]
    rw [div_mul_eq_mul_div, eq_div_iff hmtne]
    fin_cases i <;> rw [mul_comm]
    · have e : mt * carrierNormal t 0 = ρ * ms * carrierNormal s 0 := by
        rw [← hta, ha, hsa]; ring
      exact e
    · have e : mt * carrierNormal t 1 = ρ * ms * carrierNormal s 1 := by
        rw [← htb, hb, hsb]; ring
      exact e
    · have e : mt * carrierNormal t 2 = ρ * ms * carrierNormal s 2 := by
        rw [← htc, hc, hsc]; ring
      exact e
  · 
    have e : mt * detOrigin t = ρ * ms * detOrigin s := by
      rw [← htd, hd, hsd]; ring
    field_simp
    linarith [e]

name: carrier_ratio_of_oppOrient
statement:
theorem carrier_ratio_of_oppOrient {s t : Triangle}
    (hds : detOrigin s ≠ 0) (hdt : detOrigin t ≠ 0)
    (hcop : coplanarPlane (faceSOf s).plane (faceSOf t).plane = true)
    (hso : sameOrient (faceSOf s).plane (faceSOf t).plane = false) :
    ∃ κ : ℚ, κ < 0
      ∧ carrierNormal t = κ • carrierNormal s ∧ detOrigin t = κ * detOrigin s
proof:
:= by
  have hγs := gamma_faceSOf_ne hds
  have hγt := gamma_faceSOf_ne hdt
  
  obtain ⟨ρ, hρ, ha, hb, hc, hd⟩ := (coplanarPlane_iff_ratMul hγs hγt).mp hcop
  
  have hρneg : ρ < 0 := by
    rcases lt_trichotomy ρ 0 with h | h | h
    · exact h
    · exact absurd h hρ
    · exfalso
      have hpd := primDir_eq_ismul_sign hρ ha hb hc hd
      rw [Int.sign_eq_one_of_pos (Rat.num_pos.mpr h)] at hpd
      have hone : ismul (1 : Int) (IPlane.primDir (faceSOf s).plane)
          = IPlane.primDir (faceSOf s).plane := by
        unfold ismul; cases (IPlane.primDir (faceSOf s).plane); simp
      rw [hone] at hpd
      
      have : sameOrient (faceSOf s).plane (faceSOf t).plane = true := by
        unfold sameOrient; exact beqIPlane_eq_true_iff.mpr hpd.symm
      rw [hso] at this; exact Bool.noConfusion this
  obtain ⟨κ, _, hκneg, hcN, hcD⟩ := carrier_ratio_of_ratProp ha hb hc hd
  exact ⟨κ, hκneg hρneg, hcN, hcD⟩

name: orientSign_eq_of_oppOrient
statement:
theorem orientSign_eq_of_oppOrient {s t : Triangle}
    (hds : detOrigin s ≠ 0) (hdt : detOrigin t ≠ 0)
    (hcop : coplanarPlane (faceSOf s).plane (faceSOf t).plane = true)
    (hso : sameOrient (faceSOf s).plane (faceSOf t).plane = false) :
    orientSign t = - orientSign s
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨κ, hκneg, _, hcD⟩ := carrier_ratio_of_oppOrient hds hdt hcop hso
  unfold orientSign
  rcases lt_trichotomy (detOrigin s) 0 with hs | hs | hs
  · have : 0 < detOrigin t := by rw [hcD]; exact mul_pos_of_neg_of_neg hκneg hs
    simp [hs, not_lt.mpr (le_of_lt hs), this, not_lt.mpr (le_of_lt this)]
  · exact absurd hs hds
  · have : detOrigin t < 0 := by rw [hcD]; exact mul_neg_of_neg_of_pos hκneg hs
    simp [hs, not_lt.mpr (le_of_lt hs), this, not_lt.mpr (le_of_lt this)]

name: cop_emit_jump
statement:
theorem cop_emit_jump {s : Triangle} {f : Frag} (vs : Array Vtx)
    (hvs : ∀ v ∈ vs.toList, repr4 v.h (P3.toPoint v.p))
    (hnd : vs.toList.Pairwise (fun u v => u.p ≠ v.p))
    (hdetA : detOrigin s ≠ 0)
    (hinv : FragInv (carrierNormal s) (detOrigin s) f)
    {Q : Point} (hQ : dotQ (carrierNormal s) Q ≠ 0)
    (hσ : ∀ k : Fin (atomizeFrag vs f).poly.size,
      areaForm (carrierNormal s)
        (fanApex (fragCycle (atomizeFrag vs f)))
        (fragCycle (atomizeFrag vs f) k)
        ((detOrigin s / dotQ (carrierNormal s) Q) • Q) ≠ 0) :
    winding (meshChain (emitFrag (atomizeFrag vs f))) Q
      = (orientSign s * (if 1 ≤ faceParam s Q then 1 else 0))
        * (if faceParam s Q • Q ∈ vpoly (fragCycle f) then 1 else 0)
proof:
:= by
  have h := Proof.MeshIntersectOrient.emit_winding_frag_univ vs hvs hnd
    (tA := s) rfl rfl hdetA hinv hQ hσ
  rw [h, faceParam]

name: cop_emit_jump_scaled
statement:
theorem cop_emit_jump_scaled {s : Triangle} {f : Frag} (vs : Array Vtx)
    (hvs : ∀ v ∈ vs.toList, repr4 v.h (P3.toPoint v.p))
    (hnd : vs.toList.Pairwise (fun u v => u.p ≠ v.p))
    (hdetA : detOrigin s ≠ 0)
    (hinv : FragInv (carrierNormal s) (detOrigin s) f)
    {Q : Point} (hQ : dotQ (carrierNormal s) Q ≠ 0)
    {t : ℚ} (ht : 0 < t)
    (hσ : ∀ k : Fin (atomizeFrag vs f).poly.size,
      areaForm (carrierNormal s)
        (fanApex (fragCycle (atomizeFrag vs f)))
        (fragCycle (atomizeFrag vs f) k)
        (Proof.MeshIntersectStep.faceHit s Q) ≠ 0) :
    winding (meshChain (emitFrag (atomizeFrag vs f))) (t • Q)
      = (orientSign s * (if t ≤ Proof.MeshIntersectStep.faceParam s Q then 1 else 0))
        * (if Proof.MeshIntersectStep.faceHit s Q ∈ vpoly (fragCycle f) then 1 else 0)
proof:
:= by
  have htne : t ≠ 0 := ne_of_gt ht
  
  have hQt : dotQ (carrierNormal s) (t • Q) ≠ 0 := by
    rw [Proof.MeshIntersectRay.dotQ_smul_right]; exact mul_ne_zero htne hQ
  
  have hfp : Proof.MeshIntersectStep.faceParam s (t • Q)
      = Proof.MeshIntersectStep.faceParam s Q / t := by
    rw [Proof.MeshIntersectStep.faceParam, Proof.MeshIntersectStep.faceParam,
      Proof.MeshIntersectRay.dotQ_smul_right, div_div, mul_comm t]
  
  have hhit : Proof.MeshIntersectStep.faceParam s (t • Q) • (t • Q)
      = Proof.MeshIntersectStep.faceHit s Q := by
    rw [hfp, Proof.MeshIntersectStep.faceHit, smul_smul, div_mul_cancel₀ _ htne]
  
  have hσ' : ∀ k : Fin (atomizeFrag vs f).poly.size,
      areaForm (carrierNormal s)
        (fanApex (fragCycle (atomizeFrag vs f)))
        (fragCycle (atomizeFrag vs f) k)
        ((detOrigin s / dotQ (carrierNormal s) (t • Q)) • (t • Q)) ≠ 0 := by
    intro k
    have : (detOrigin s / dotQ (carrierNormal s) (t • Q)) • (t • Q)
        = Proof.MeshIntersectStep.faceHit s Q := by
      rw [show detOrigin s / dotQ (carrierNormal s) (t • Q)
          = Proof.MeshIntersectStep.faceParam s (t • Q) from rfl, hhit]
    rw [this]; exact hσ k
  rw [cop_emit_jump vs hvs hnd hdetA hinv hQt hσ', hhit, hfp]
  congr 2
  
  by_cases h : t ≤ Proof.MeshIntersectStep.faceParam s Q
  · rw [if_pos h, if_pos]; rw [le_div_iff₀ ht, one_mul]; exact h
  · rw [if_neg h, if_neg]; rw [le_div_iff₀ ht, one_mul]; exact h

name: tie_zero_of_carrier_ratio
proof:
:= by
  rw [hcN, hcD]
  funext k
  simp only [Pi.sub_apply, Pi.smul_apply, Pi.zero_apply, smul_eq_mul]
  ring

name: muF_eq_of_coplanar_carrier
statement:
theorem muF_eq_of_coplanar_carrier {t u : Triangle} {Q : Point}
    (hdt : detOrigin t ≠ 0) (hdu : detOrigin u ≠ 0)
    (hQt : dotQ (carrierNormal t) Q ≠ 0) (hQu : dotQ (carrierNormal u) Q ≠ 0)
    (hcop : coplanarPlane (faceSOf u).plane (faceSOf t).plane = true) :
    muF t Q = muF u Q
proof:
:= by
  
  have hγt := gamma_faceSOf_ne hdt
  have hγu := gamma_faceSOf_ne hdu
  obtain ⟨ρ, hρ, ha, hb, hc, hd⟩ := (coplanarPlane_iff_ratMul hγu hγt).mp hcop
  
  obtain ⟨κ, _, _, hcN, hcD⟩ := carrier_ratio_of_ratProp (s := u) (t := t) ha hb hc hd
  
  rw [muF_eq_iff_tie hQt hQu]
  rw [tie_zero_of_carrier_ratio hcN hcD]
  simp [dotQ]

name: no_overlap_cell_at_transverse_crossing
statement:
theorem no_overlap_cell_at_transverse_crossing
    {M₂ : Mesh} {tA : Triangle}
    {Q : Point} {v : ℚ}
    (hdA : detOrigin tA ≠ 0)
    (hQA : dotQ (carrierNormal tA) Q ≠ 0)
    (hjmpA : FaceJumps tA Q v)
    (hTnoM2 : ∀ j : Fin M₂.size, ¬ FaceJumps M₂[j] Q v)
    (hQ2 : ∀ j : Fin M₂.size, detOrigin M₂[j] ≠ 0 ∧ dotQ (carrierNormal M₂[j]) Q ≠ 0)
    {f : Frag}
    (hsub : ∃ j : Fin M₂.size,
        coplanarPlane (faceSOf M₂[j]).plane (faceSOf tA).plane = true
        ∧ Proof.MeshIntersectClip.vpoly (fragCycle f) ⊆ triangleSet M₂[j]) :
    hitF tA Q ∉ Proof.MeshIntersectClip.vpoly (fragCycle f)
proof:
:= by
  intro hmem
  
  obtain ⟨j, hcop, hsub⟩ := hsub
  obtain ⟨hdj, hQj⟩ := hQ2 j
  
  have hpj : hitF tA Q ∈ triangleSet M₂[j] := hsub hmem
  
  have hmuEq : muF tA Q = muF M₂[j] Q :=
    muF_eq_of_coplanar_carrier hdA hdj hQA hQj hcop
  
  have hhitEq : hitF M₂[j] Q = hitF tA Q := by
    rw [hitF, hitF, hmuEq]
  
  have hposA : 0 < muF tA Q := hjmpA.2.1
  have hposj : 0 < muF M₂[j] Q := by rw [← hmuEq]; exact hposA
  
  apply hTnoM2 j
  refine ⟨?_, hposj, ?_⟩
  · rw [← hmuEq]; exact hjmpA.1
  · rw [hhitEq]; exact hpj

name: scale_segments_nonempty
statement:
theorem scale_segments_nonempty (c : ℚ) (hc : c ≠ 0) (a b p q : Fin 3 → ℚ) :
    (segment ℚ (c • a) (c • b) ∩ segment ℚ (c • p) (c • q)).Nonempty ↔
      (segment ℚ a b ∩ segment ℚ p q).Nonempty
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨x, hx1, hx2⟩
    refine ⟨c⁻¹ • x, ?_, ?_⟩
    · rw [← scale_mem_segment c hc]; rwa [smul_smul, mul_inv_cancel₀ hc, one_smul]
    · rw [← scale_mem_segment c hc]; rwa [smul_smul, mul_inv_cancel₀ hc, one_smul]
  · rintro ⟨x, hx1, hx2⟩
    exact ⟨c • x, (scale_mem_segment c hc _ _ _).mpr hx1, (scale_mem_segment c hc _ _ _).mpr hx2⟩

name: not_segsIntersect_iff_disjoint
statement:
theorem not_segsIntersect_iff_disjoint (ea eb pa pb : I3) (Λ : ℚ) (hΛ : Λ ≠ 0)
    (a b p q : Fin 3 → ℚ)
    (ha : decI ea = Λ • a) (hb : decI eb = Λ • b) (hp : decI pa = Λ • p) (hq : decI pb = Λ • q) :
    (!segsIntersect ea eb pa pb) = true ↔ segment ℚ a b ∩ segment ℚ p q = ∅
proof:
:= by
  rw [Bool.not_eq_true', ← Bool.not_eq_true, segsIntersect_iff, ha, hb, hp, hq,
    scale_segments_nonempty Λ hΛ, Set.not_nonempty_iff_eq_empty]

name: edgeClauseOK_eq_true_iff
statement:
theorem edgeClauseOK_eq_true_iff (s t : FaceH) :
    edgeClauseOK s t = true ↔
      (∀ es ∈ edgesOf s, ∀ et ∈ edgesOf t,
        (!segsIntersect es.1 es.2 et.1 et.2) = true)
proof:
:= by
  unfold edgeClauseOK
  rw [Array.all_eq_true]
  constructor
  · intro h es hes et het
    obtain ⟨i, hi, rfl⟩ := Array.mem_iff_getElem.mp hes
    have hall := h ⟨i, hi⟩
    rw [Array.all_eq_true] at hall
    obtain ⟨j, hj, rfl⟩ := Array.mem_iff_getElem.mp het
    exact hall ⟨j, hj⟩
  · intro h i
    rw [Array.all_eq_true]
    intro j
    exact h _ (Array.mem_iff_getElem.mpr ⟨i.1, i.2, rfl⟩)
      _ (Array.mem_iff_getElem.mpr ⟨j.1, j.2, rfl⟩)

name: forall_edgesOf
statement:
theorem forall_edgesOf (s : FaceH) (P : (I3 × I3) → Prop) :
    (∀ es ∈ edgesOf s, P es) ↔ (P (s.v₀, s.v₁) ∧ P (s.v₁, s.v₂) ∧ P (s.v₂, s.v₀))
proof:
:= by
  unfold edgesOf
  constructor
  · intro h; exact ⟨h _ (by simp), h _ (by simp), h _ (by simp)⟩
  · rintro ⟨h1, h2, h3⟩ es hes
    simp only [Array.mem_def, Array.toList, List.mem_cons, List.mem_singleton,
      List.not_mem_nil, or_false] at hes
    rcases hes with h | h | h <;> subst h <;> assumption

name: edgeClauseOK_iff
statement:
theorem edgeClauseOK_iff (S T : Triangle) :
    edgeClauseOK (rescale (faceHOf T).w (faceHOf S)) (rescale (faceHOf S).w (faceHOf T)) = true
      ↔ edgeSet S ∩ edgeSet T = ∅
proof:
:= by
  set Λ : ℚ := (((faceHOf T).w * (faceHOf S).w : ℤ) : ℚ) with hΛdef
  have hΛint : (0 : ℤ) < (faceHOf T).w * (faceHOf S).w := by
    have := faceHOf_w_pos T; have := faceHOf_w_pos S; positivity
  have hΛ : Λ ≠ 0 := by rw [hΛdef]; exact_mod_cast hΛint.ne'
  
  have hS0 : decI (rescale (faceHOf T).w (faceHOf S)).v₀ = Λ • (S.v₀ : Fin 3 → ℚ) := by
    rw [decI_rescale_faceHOf_v₀, hΛdef]
  have hS1 : decI (rescale (faceHOf T).w (faceHOf S)).v₁ = Λ • (S.v₁ : Fin 3 → ℚ) := by
    rw [decI_rescale_faceHOf_v₁, hΛdef]
  have hS2 : decI (rescale (faceHOf T).w (faceHOf S)).v₂ = Λ • (S.v₂ : Fin 3 → ℚ) := by
    rw [decI_rescale_faceHOf_v₂, hΛdef]
  
  have hT0 : decI (rescale (faceHOf S).w (faceHOf T)).v₀ = Λ • (T.v₀ : Fin 3 → ℚ) := by
    rw [decI_rescale_faceHOf_v₀, hΛdef]; push_cast; rw [mul_comm]
  have hT1 : decI (rescale (faceHOf S).w (faceHOf T)).v₁ = Λ • (T.v₁ : Fin 3 → ℚ) := by
    rw [decI_rescale_faceHOf_v₁, hΛdef]; push_cast; rw [mul_comm]
  have hT2 : decI (rescale (faceHOf S).w (faceHOf T)).v₂ = Λ • (T.v₂ : Fin 3 → ℚ) := by
    rw [decI_rescale_faceHOf_v₂, hΛdef]; push_cast; rw [mul_comm]
  rw [edgeClauseOK_eq_true_iff]
  simp only [forall_edgesOf]
  
  rw [not_segsIntersect_iff_disjoint _ _ _ _ Λ hΛ _ _ _ _ hS0 hS1 hT0 hT1,
      not_segsIntersect_iff_disjoint _ _ _ _ Λ hΛ _ _ _ _ hS0 hS1 hT1 hT2,
      not_segsIntersect_iff_disjoint _ _ _ _ Λ hΛ _ _ _ _ hS0 hS1 hT2 hT0,
      not_segsIntersect_iff_disjoint _ _ _ _ Λ hΛ _ _ _ _ hS1 hS2 hT0 hT1,
      not_segsIntersect_iff_disjoint _ _ _ _ Λ hΛ _ _ _ _ hS1 hS2 hT1 hT2,
      not_segsIntersect_iff_disjoint _ _ _ _ Λ hΛ _ _ _ _ hS1 hS2 hT2 hT0,
      not_segsIntersect_iff_disjoint _ _ _ _ Λ hΛ _ _ _ _ hS2 hS0 hT0 hT1,
      not_segsIntersect_iff_disjoint _ _ _ _ Λ hΛ _ _ _ _ hS2 hS0 hT1 hT2,
      not_segsIntersect_iff_disjoint _ _ _ _ Λ hΛ _ _ _ _ hS2 hS0 hT2 hT0]
  
  unfold edgeSet
  rw [Set.union_inter_distrib_right, Set.inter_union_distrib_left,
    Set.inter_union_distrib_left, Set.inter_union_distrib_left]
  simp only [Set.union_inter_distrib_right, Set.inter_union_distrib_left,
    Set.union_empty_iff]
  tauto

name: clipBySide_fragInv
statement:
theorem clipBySide_fragInv (g : IPlane) {f : Frag} (hf : FragInv nt ct f) :
    (∀ f' ∈ (clipBySide g f).1, FragInv nt ct f')
      ∧ (∀ f' ∈ (clipBySide g f).2, FragInv nt ct f')
proof:
:= by
  
  
  unfold clipBySide
  have hpieces : ∀ p ∈ clipFrag g f, FragInv nt ct p := fun p hp =>
    fragInv_clipFrag g hf hp
  
  refine Array.foldl_induction
    (motive := fun i (acc : Array Frag × Array Frag) =>
      (∀ f' ∈ acc.1, FragInv nt ct f') ∧ (∀ f' ∈ acc.2, FragInv nt ct f'))
    ⟨by simp, by simp⟩ ?_
  intro i acc ih
  have hpi : FragInv nt ct (clipFrag g f)[i] := hpieces _ (Array.getElem_mem i.isLt)
  obtain ⟨ih1, ih2⟩ := ih
  by_cases hs : sideOf g (clipFrag g f)[i] = true
  · simp only [hs, if_true]
    refine ⟨fun f' hf' => ?_, ih2⟩
    rcases Array.mem_push.mp hf' with h | h
    · exact ih1 _ h
    · exact h ▸ hpi
  · simp only [hs, Bool.false_eq_true, if_false]
    refine ⟨ih1, fun f' hf' => ?_⟩
    rcases Array.mem_push.mp hf' with h | h
    · exact ih2 _ h
    · exact h ▸ hpi

name: coplanarClip_fragInv
statement:
theorem coplanarClip_fragInv (fb : Frag) {fa : Frag} (hfa : FragInv nt ct fa) :
    (∀ f' ∈ (coplanarClip fa fb).1, FragInv nt ct f')
      ∧ (∀ f' ∈ (coplanarClip fa fb).2, FragInv nt ct f')
proof:
:= by
  unfold coplanarClip
  
  
  refine Array.foldl_induction
    (motive := fun i (acc : Array Frag × Array Frag) =>
      (∀ f' ∈ acc.1, FragInv nt ct f') ∧ (∀ f' ∈ acc.2, FragInv nt ct f'))
    ⟨by intro f' hf'; simp only [Array.mem_singleton] at hf'; exact hf' ▸ hfa,
      by simp⟩ ?_
  intro i acc ih
  obtain ⟨ihIn, ihComp⟩ := ih
  
  set g := (edgePlanesOf fb)[i] with hg
  
  have hstep :
      (∀ f' ∈ (acc.1.foldl (fun st piece =>
          let (i2, o2) := clipBySide g piece
          (st.1 ++ i2, st.2 ++ o2)) ((#[] : Array Frag), (#[] : Array Frag))).1,
        FragInv nt ct f')
      ∧ (∀ f' ∈ (acc.1.foldl (fun st piece =>
          let (i2, o2) := clipBySide g piece
          (st.1 ++ i2, st.2 ++ o2)) ((#[] : Array Frag), (#[] : Array Frag))).2,
        FragInv nt ct f') := by
    refine Array.foldl_induction
      (motive := fun j (st : Array Frag × Array Frag) =>
        (∀ f' ∈ st.1, FragInv nt ct f') ∧ (∀ f' ∈ st.2, FragInv nt ct f'))
      ⟨by simp, by simp⟩ ?_
    intro j st ihst
    obtain ⟨hst1, hst2⟩ := ihst
    have hpiece : FragInv nt ct acc.1[j] := ihIn _ (Array.getElem_mem j.isLt)
    obtain ⟨hcs1, hcs2⟩ := clipBySide_fragInv (nt := nt) (ct := ct) g hpiece
    refine ⟨fun f' hf' => ?_, fun f' hf' => ?_⟩
    · rcases Array.mem_append.mp hf' with h | h
      · exact hst1 _ h
      · exact hcs1 _ h
    · rcases Array.mem_append.mp hf' with h | h
      · exact hst2 _ h
      · exact hcs2 _ h
  obtain ⟨hstep1, hstep2⟩ := hstep
  refine ⟨hstep1, fun f' hf' => ?_⟩
  rcases Array.mem_append.mp hf' with h | h
  · exact ihComp _ h
  · exact hstep2 _ h

name: pushFold_fragInv
statement:
theorem pushFold_fragInv {comp acc : Array Frag}
    (hcomp : ∀ f' ∈ comp, FragInv nt ct f')
    (hacc : ∀ f' ∈ acc, FragInv nt ct f') :
    ∀ f' ∈ comp.foldl (fun pd p => if p.poly.size ≥ 3 then pd.push p else pd) acc,
      FragInv nt ct f'
proof:
:= by
  refine Array.foldl_induction
    (motive := fun _ (pd : Array Frag) => ∀ f' ∈ pd, FragInv nt ct f')
    hacc ?_
  intro k pd ihpd f' hmem
  by_cases hsz : comp[k].poly.size ≥ 3
  · rw [if_pos hsz] at hmem
    rcases Array.mem_push.mp hmem with h | h
    · exact ihpd _ h
    · exact h ▸ (hcomp _ (Array.getElem_mem k.isLt))
  · rw [if_neg hsz] at hmem
    exact ihpd _ hmem

name: resolveStep_fragInv
statement:
theorem resolveStep_fragInv (fb piece : Frag) (sameOr : Bool) {st : Array Frag × Array Frag}
    (hpiece : FragInv nt ct piece)
    (hst1 : ∀ f' ∈ st.1, FragInv nt ct f') (hst2 : ∀ f' ∈ st.2, FragInv nt ct f') :
    (∀ f' ∈
        (if (Array.filter (fun p => decide (p.poly.size ≥ 3))
              (coplanarClip piece fb).1).isEmpty = true then (st.1, st.2.push piece)
         else
           (if sameOr = true then
              st.1 ++ Array.filter (fun p => decide (p.poly.size ≥ 3)) (coplanarClip piece fb).1
            else st.1,
            Array.foldl (fun pd p => if p.poly.size ≥ 3 then pd.push p else pd)
              st.2 (coplanarClip piece fb).2)).1,
      FragInv nt ct f')
    ∧ (∀ f' ∈
        (if (Array.filter (fun p => decide (p.poly.size ≥ 3))
              (coplanarClip piece fb).1).isEmpty = true then (st.1, st.2.push piece)
         else
           (if sameOr = true then
              st.1 ++ Array.filter (fun p => decide (p.poly.size ≥ 3)) (coplanarClip piece fb).1
            else st.1,
            Array.foldl (fun pd p => if p.poly.size ≥ 3 then pd.push p else pd)
              st.2 (coplanarClip piece fb).2)).2,
      FragInv nt ct f')
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨hov, hcomp⟩ := coplanarClip_fragInv (nt := nt) (ct := ct) fb hpiece
  by_cases hre : (Array.filter (fun p => decide (p.poly.size ≥ 3))
      (coplanarClip piece fb).1).isEmpty = true
  · simp only [hre, if_true]
    exact ⟨hst1, fun f' hf' => by
      rcases Array.mem_push.mp hf' with h | h
      · exact hst2 _ h
      · exact h ▸ hpiece⟩
  · simp only [hre, Bool.false_eq_true, if_false]
    refine ⟨fun f' hf' => ?_, ?_⟩
    · by_cases hso : sameOr = true
      · simp only [hso, if_true] at hf'
        rcases Array.mem_append.mp hf' with h | h
        · exact hst1 _ h
        · exact hov _ (Array.mem_of_mem_filter h)
      · simp only [hso, Bool.false_eq_true, if_false] at hf'
        exact hst1 _ hf'
    · exact pushFold_fragInv (nt := nt) (ct := ct) hcomp hst2

name: resolveFrag_fragInv
statement:
theorem resolveFrag_fragInv (bvh : Impl.BVH.BVH) (opp : Array Frag) (wOpp : Array PFace)
    {fa : Frag} (hfa : FragInv nt ct fa) :
    ∀ f' ∈ resolveFrag bvh fa opp wOpp, FragInv nt ct f'
proof:
:= by
  unfold resolveFrag
  
  have hfold :
      (∀ f' ∈ (opp.foldl (fun acc fb =>
          if !(coplanarPlane fa.plane fb.plane) then acc
          else
            acc.2.foldl (fun st piece =>
              let (ov, comp) := coplanarClip piece fb
              let realOv := ov.filter (fun p => p.poly.size ≥ 3)
              if realOv.isEmpty then (st.1, st.2.push piece)
              else
                let kept := if sameOrient fa.plane fb.plane then st.1 ++ realOv else st.1
                let pending := comp.foldl (fun pd p =>
                  if p.poly.size ≥ 3 then pd.push p else pd) st.2
                (kept, pending)) (acc.1, #[]))
          ((#[] : Array Frag), #[fa])).1, FragInv nt ct f')
      ∧ (∀ f' ∈ (opp.foldl (fun acc fb =>
          if !(coplanarPlane fa.plane fb.plane) then acc
          else
            acc.2.foldl (fun st piece =>
              let (ov, comp) := coplanarClip piece fb
              let realOv := ov.filter (fun p => p.poly.size ≥ 3)
              if realOv.isEmpty then (st.1, st.2.push piece)
              else
                let kept := if sameOrient fa.plane fb.plane then st.1 ++ realOv else st.1
                let pending := comp.foldl (fun pd p =>
                  if p.poly.size ≥ 3 then pd.push p else pd) st.2
                (kept, pending)) (acc.1, #[]))
          ((#[] : Array Frag), #[fa])).2, FragInv nt ct f') := by
    refine Array.foldl_induction
      (motive := fun i (acc : Array Frag × Array Frag) =>
        (∀ f' ∈ acc.1, FragInv nt ct f') ∧ (∀ f' ∈ acc.2, FragInv nt ct f'))
      ⟨by simp, by intro f' hf'; simp only [Array.mem_singleton] at hf'; exact hf' ▸ hfa⟩ ?_
    intro i acc ih
    obtain ⟨ihK, ihP⟩ := ih
    by_cases hcop : (!(coplanarPlane fa.plane opp[i].plane)) = true
    · simp only [hcop, if_true]; exact ⟨ihK, ihP⟩
    · simp only [hcop, Bool.not_eq_true', Bool.not_eq_false] at hcop ⊢
      simp only [hcop, Bool.not_true, Bool.false_eq_true, if_false]
      
      refine Array.foldl_induction
        (motive := fun j (st : Array Frag × Array Frag) =>
          (∀ f' ∈ st.1, FragInv nt ct f') ∧ (∀ f' ∈ st.2, FragInv nt ct f'))
        (by exact ⟨ihK, fun f' hf' => absurd hf' (Array.not_mem_empty f')⟩) ?_
      intro j st ihst
      obtain ⟨hst1, hst2⟩ := ihst
      have hpiece : FragInv nt ct acc.2[j] := ihP _ (Array.getElem_mem j.isLt)
      exact resolveStep_fragInv (nt := nt) (ct := ct) opp[i] acc.2[j]
        (sameOrient fa.plane opp[i].plane) hpiece hst1 hst2
  
  obtain ⟨hK, hP⟩ := hfold
  intro f' hf'
  rcases Array.mem_append.mp hf' with h | h
  · exact hK _ h
  · exact hP _ (Array.mem_of_mem_filter h)

name: clipBySide_fragProv
statement:
theorem clipBySide_fragProv (g : IPlane) (hgL : g ∈ L) {piece : Frag}
    (hpInv : FragInv nt ct piece) (hpProv : FragProv nt w₀ L piece) :
    (∀ f' ∈ (clipBySide g piece).1, FragProv nt w₀ L f')
      ∧ (∀ f' ∈ (clipBySide g piece).2, FragProv nt w₀ L f')
proof:
:= by
  unfold clipBySide
  
  
  have hpieces : ∀ p ∈ clipFrag g piece, FragProv nt w₀ L p := fun p hp =>
    fragProv_clipFrag g hgL hpInv hpProv hp
  refine Array.foldl_induction
    (motive := fun i (acc : Array Frag × Array Frag) =>
      (∀ f' ∈ acc.1, FragProv nt w₀ L f') ∧ (∀ f' ∈ acc.2, FragProv nt w₀ L f'))
    ⟨by simp, by simp⟩ ?_
  intro i acc ih
  have hpi : FragProv nt w₀ L (clipFrag g piece)[i] := hpieces _ (Array.getElem_mem i.isLt)
  obtain ⟨ih1, ih2⟩ := ih
  by_cases hs : sideOf g (clipFrag g piece)[i] = true
  · simp only [hs, if_true]
    refine ⟨fun f' hf' => ?_, ih2⟩
    rcases Array.mem_push.mp hf' with h | h
    · exact ih1 _ h
    · subst h; exact hpi
  · simp only [hs, Bool.false_eq_true, if_false]
    refine ⟨ih1, fun f' hf' => ?_⟩
    rcases Array.mem_push.mp hf' with h | h
    · exact ih2 _ h
    · subst h; exact hpi

name: coplanarClip_fragProv
statement:
theorem coplanarClip_fragProv (fb : Frag) {fa : Frag} (hfaInv : FragInv nt ct fa)
    (hfaProv : FragProv nt w₀ L fa)
    (hLfb : ∀ g ∈ edgePlanesOf fb, g ∈ L) :
    (∀ f' ∈ (coplanarClip fa fb).1, FragProv nt w₀ L f')
      ∧ (∀ f' ∈ (coplanarClip fa fb).2, FragProv nt w₀ L f')
proof:
:= by
  
  
  
  suffices h : (∀ f' ∈ (coplanarClip fa fb).1, FragInv nt ct f' ∧ FragProv nt w₀ L f')
      ∧ (∀ f' ∈ (coplanarClip fa fb).2, FragInv nt ct f' ∧ FragProv nt w₀ L f') by
    exact ⟨fun f' hf' => (h.1 f' hf').2, fun f' hf' => (h.2 f' hf').2⟩
  unfold coplanarClip
  
  
  refine Array.foldl_induction
    (motive := fun i (acc : Array Frag × Array Frag) =>
      (∀ f' ∈ acc.1, FragInv nt ct f' ∧ FragProv nt w₀ L f')
        ∧ (∀ f' ∈ acc.2, FragInv nt ct f' ∧ FragProv nt w₀ L f'))
    ⟨by intro f' hf'; simp only [Array.mem_singleton] at hf'; subst hf'; exact ⟨hfaInv, hfaProv⟩,
      by simp⟩ ?_
  intro i acc ih
  obtain ⟨ihIn, ihComp⟩ := ih
  set g := (edgePlanesOf fb)[i] with hg
  have hgL : g ∈ L := hLfb g (hg ▸ Array.getElem_mem i.isLt)
  
  have hstep :
      (∀ f' ∈ (acc.1.foldl (fun st piece =>
          let (i2, o2) := clipBySide g piece
          (st.1 ++ i2, st.2 ++ o2)) ((#[] : Array Frag), (#[] : Array Frag))).1,
        FragInv nt ct f' ∧ FragProv nt w₀ L f')
      ∧ (∀ f' ∈ (acc.1.foldl (fun st piece =>
          let (i2, o2) := clipBySide g piece
          (st.1 ++ i2, st.2 ++ o2)) ((#[] : Array Frag), (#[] : Array Frag))).2,
        FragInv nt ct f' ∧ FragProv nt w₀ L f') := by
    refine Array.foldl_induction
      (motive := fun j (st : Array Frag × Array Frag) =>
        (∀ f' ∈ st.1, FragInv nt ct f' ∧ FragProv nt w₀ L f')
          ∧ (∀ f' ∈ st.2, FragInv nt ct f' ∧ FragProv nt w₀ L f'))
      ⟨by simp, by simp⟩ ?_
    intro j st ihst
    obtain ⟨hst1, hst2⟩ := ihst
    have hpieceInv : FragInv nt ct acc.1[j] := (ihIn _ (Array.getElem_mem j.isLt)).1
    have hpieceProv : FragProv nt w₀ L acc.1[j] := (ihIn _ (Array.getElem_mem j.isLt)).2
    obtain ⟨hcs1Inv, hcs2Inv⟩ := clipBySide_fragInv (nt := nt) (ct := ct) g hpieceInv
    obtain ⟨hcs1Prov, hcs2Prov⟩ :=
      clipBySide_fragProv (nt := nt) (ct := ct) (w₀ := w₀) g hgL hpieceInv hpieceProv
    refine ⟨fun f' hf' => ?_, fun f' hf' => ?_⟩
    · rcases Array.mem_append.mp hf' with h | h
      · exact hst1 _ h
      · exact ⟨hcs1Inv _ h, hcs1Prov _ h⟩
    · rcases Array.mem_append.mp hf' with h | h
      · exact hst2 _ h
      · exact ⟨hcs2Inv _ h, hcs2Prov _ h⟩
  obtain ⟨hstep1, hstep2⟩ := hstep
  refine ⟨hstep1, fun f' hf' => ?_⟩
  rcases Array.mem_append.mp hf' with h | h
  · exact ihComp _ h
  · exact hstep2 _ h

name: pushFold_fragProv
statement:
theorem pushFold_fragProv {comp acc : Array Frag}
    (hcomp : ∀ f' ∈ comp, FragProv nt w₀ L f')
    (hacc : ∀ f' ∈ acc, FragProv nt w₀ L f') :
    ∀ f' ∈ comp.foldl (fun pd p => if p.poly.size ≥ 3 then pd.push p else pd) acc,
      FragProv nt w₀ L f'
proof:
:= by
  refine Array.foldl_induction
    (motive := fun _ (pd : Array Frag) => ∀ f' ∈ pd, FragProv nt w₀ L f')
    hacc ?_
  intro k pd ihpd f' hmem
  by_cases hsz : comp[k].poly.size ≥ 3
  · rw [if_pos hsz] at hmem
    rcases Array.mem_push.mp hmem with h | h
    · exact ihpd _ h
    · subst h; exact hcomp _ (Array.getElem_mem k.isLt)
  · rw [if_neg hsz] at hmem
    exact ihpd _ hmem

name: resolveStep_fragProv
statement:
theorem resolveStep_fragProv (fb piece : Frag) (sameOr : Bool)
    {st : Array Frag × Array Frag}
    (hpieceInv : FragInv nt ct piece) (hpieceProv : FragProv nt w₀ L piece)
    (hLfb : ∀ g ∈ edgePlanesOf fb, g ∈ L)
    (hst1 : ∀ f' ∈ st.1, FragProv nt w₀ L f') (hst2 : ∀ f' ∈ st.2, FragProv nt w₀ L f') :
    (∀ f' ∈
        (if (Array.filter (fun p => decide (p.poly.size ≥ 3))
              (coplanarClip piece fb).1).isEmpty = true then (st.1, st.2.push piece)
         else
           (if sameOr = true then
              st.1 ++ Array.filter (fun p => decide (p.poly.size ≥ 3)) (coplanarClip piece fb).1
            else st.1,
            Array.foldl (fun pd p => if p.poly.size ≥ 3 then pd.push p else pd)
              st.2 (coplanarClip piece fb).2)).1,
      FragProv nt w₀ L f')
    ∧ (∀ f' ∈
        (if (Array.filter (fun p => decide (p.poly.size ≥ 3))
              (coplanarClip piece fb).1).isEmpty = true then (st.1, st.2.push piece)
         else
           (if sameOr = true then
              st.1 ++ Array.filter (fun p => decide (p.poly.size ≥ 3)) (coplanarClip piece fb).1
            else st.1,
            Array.foldl (fun pd p => if p.poly.size ≥ 3 then pd.push p else pd)
              st.2 (coplanarClip piece fb).2)).2,
      FragProv nt w₀ L f')
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨hov, hcomp⟩ :=
    coplanarClip_fragProv (nt := nt) (ct := ct) (w₀ := w₀) fb hpieceInv hpieceProv hLfb
  by_cases hre : (Array.filter (fun p => decide (p.poly.size ≥ 3))
      (coplanarClip piece fb).1).isEmpty = true
  · simp only [hre, if_true]
    exact ⟨hst1, fun f' hf' => by
      rcases Array.mem_push.mp hf' with h | h
      · exact hst2 _ h
      · subst h; exact hpieceProv⟩
  · simp only [hre, Bool.false_eq_true, if_false]
    refine ⟨fun f' hf' => ?_, ?_⟩
    · by_cases hso : sameOr = true
      · simp only [hso, if_true] at hf'
        rcases Array.mem_append.mp hf' with h | h
        · exact hst1 _ h
        · exact hov _ (Array.mem_of_mem_filter h)
      · simp only [hso, Bool.false_eq_true, if_false] at hf'
        exact hst1 _ hf'
    · exact pushFold_fragProv (nt := nt) (w₀ := w₀) hcomp hst2

name: resolveFrag_fragProv
statement:
theorem resolveFrag_fragProv (bvh : Impl.BVH.BVH) (opp : Array Frag) (wOpp : Array PFace)
    {fa : Frag} (hfaInv : FragInv nt ct fa) (hfaProv : FragProv nt w₀ L fa)
    (hLopp : ∀ fb ∈ opp, coplanarPlane fa.plane fb.plane = true →
      ∀ g ∈ edgePlanesOf fb, g ∈ L) :
    ∀ f' ∈ resolveFrag bvh fa opp wOpp, FragProv nt w₀ L f'
proof:
:= by
  unfold resolveFrag
  
  
  have hfold :
      ((∀ f' ∈ (opp.foldl (fun acc fb =>
          if !(coplanarPlane fa.plane fb.plane) then acc
          else
            acc.2.foldl (fun st piece =>
              let (ov, comp) := coplanarClip piece fb
              let realOv := ov.filter (fun p => p.poly.size ≥ 3)
              if realOv.isEmpty then (st.1, st.2.push piece)
              else
                let kept := if sameOrient fa.plane fb.plane then st.1 ++ realOv else st.1
                let pending := comp.foldl (fun pd p =>
                  if p.poly.size ≥ 3 then pd.push p else pd) st.2
                (kept, pending)) (acc.1, #[]))
          ((#[] : Array Frag), #[fa])).1, FragInv nt ct f')
        ∧ (∀ f' ∈ (opp.foldl (fun acc fb =>
          if !(coplanarPlane fa.plane fb.plane) then acc
          else
            acc.2.foldl (fun st piece =>
              let (ov, comp) := coplanarClip piece fb
              let realOv := ov.filter (fun p => p.poly.size ≥ 3)
              if realOv.isEmpty then (st.1, st.2.push piece)
              else
                let kept := if sameOrient fa.plane fb.plane then st.1 ++ realOv else st.1
                let pending := comp.foldl (fun pd p =>
                  if p.poly.size ≥ 3 then pd.push p else pd) st.2
                (kept, pending)) (acc.1, #[]))
          ((#[] : Array Frag), #[fa])).2, FragInv nt ct f'))
      ∧ ((∀ f' ∈ (opp.foldl (fun acc fb =>
          if !(coplanarPlane fa.plane fb.plane) then acc
          else
            acc.2.foldl (fun st piece =>
              let (ov, comp) := coplanarClip piece fb
              let realOv := ov.filter (fun p => p.poly.size ≥ 3)
              if realOv.isEmpty then (st.1, st.2.push piece)
              else
                let kept := if sameOrient fa.plane fb.plane then st.1 ++ realOv else st.1
                let pending := comp.foldl (fun pd p =>
                  if p.poly.size ≥ 3 then pd.push p else pd) st.2
                (kept, pending)) (acc.1, #[]))
          ((#[] : Array Frag), #[fa])).1, FragProv nt w₀ L f')
        ∧ (∀ f' ∈ (opp.foldl (fun acc fb =>
          if !(coplanarPlane fa.plane fb.plane) then acc
          else
            acc.2.foldl (fun st piece =>
              let (ov, comp) := coplanarClip piece fb
              let realOv := ov.filter (fun p => p.poly.size ≥ 3)
              if realOv.isEmpty then (st.1, st.2.push piece)
              else
                let kept := if sameOrient fa.plane fb.plane then st.1 ++ realOv else st.1
                let pending := comp.foldl (fun pd p =>
                  if p.poly.size ≥ 3 then pd.push p else pd) st.2
                (kept, pending)) (acc.1, #[]))
          ((#[] : Array Frag), #[fa])).2, FragProv nt w₀ L f')) := by
    refine Array.foldl_induction
      (motive := fun i (acc : Array Frag × Array Frag) =>
        ((∀ f' ∈ acc.1, FragInv nt ct f') ∧ (∀ f' ∈ acc.2, FragInv nt ct f'))
          ∧ ((∀ f' ∈ acc.1, FragProv nt w₀ L f') ∧ (∀ f' ∈ acc.2, FragProv nt w₀ L f')))
      (init := ((#[] : Array Frag), #[fa]))
      ⟨⟨by simp, by intro f' hf'; simp only [Array.mem_singleton] at hf'; subst hf'; exact hfaInv⟩,
        ⟨by simp, by intro f' hf'; simp only [Array.mem_singleton] at hf'; subst hf'; exact hfaProv⟩⟩ ?_
    intro i acc ih
    obtain ⟨⟨ihKInv, ihPInv⟩, ihKProv, ihPProv⟩ := ih
    by_cases hcop : (!(coplanarPlane fa.plane opp[i].plane)) = true
    · simp only [hcop, if_true]; exact ⟨⟨ihKInv, ihPInv⟩, ihKProv, ihPProv⟩
    · have hcopT : coplanarPlane fa.plane opp[i].plane = true := by
        simpa using hcop
      simp only [hcop, Bool.not_eq_true', Bool.not_eq_false] at hcop ⊢
      simp only [hcop, Bool.not_true, Bool.false_eq_true, if_false]
      have hLi : ∀ g ∈ edgePlanesOf opp[i], g ∈ L :=
        hLopp opp[i] (Array.getElem_mem i.isLt) hcopT
      
      refine Array.foldl_induction
        (motive := fun j (st : Array Frag × Array Frag) =>
          ((∀ f' ∈ st.1, FragInv nt ct f') ∧ (∀ f' ∈ st.2, FragInv nt ct f'))
            ∧ ((∀ f' ∈ st.1, FragProv nt w₀ L f') ∧ (∀ f' ∈ st.2, FragProv nt w₀ L f')))
        (init := (acc.1, #[]))
        ⟨⟨ihKInv, fun f' hf' => absurd hf' (Array.not_mem_empty f')⟩,
          ⟨ihKProv, fun f' hf' => absurd hf' (Array.not_mem_empty f')⟩⟩ ?_
      intro j st ihst
      obtain ⟨⟨hst1Inv, hst2Inv⟩, hst1Prov, hst2Prov⟩ := ihst
      set fbi := opp[i] with hfbi
      set piece := acc.2[j] with hpiecej
      have hpieceInv : FragInv nt ct piece := ihPInv _ (hpiecej ▸ Array.getElem_mem j.isLt)
      have hpieceProv : FragProv nt w₀ L piece := ihPProv _ (hpiecej ▸ Array.getElem_mem j.isLt)
      refine ⟨resolveStep_fragInv (nt := nt) (ct := ct) fbi piece
        (sameOrient fa.plane fbi.plane) hpieceInv hst1Inv hst2Inv,
        resolveStep_fragProv (nt := nt) (ct := ct) (w₀ := w₀) (L := L) fbi piece
        (sameOrient fa.plane fbi.plane) hpieceInv hpieceProv hLi hst1Prov hst2Prov⟩
  
  obtain ⟨_, hK, hP⟩ := hfold
  intro f' hf'
  rcases Array.mem_append.mp hf' with h | h
  · exact hK _ h
  · exact hP _ (Array.mem_of_mem_filter h)
