      set piece := acc.2[j] with hpiecej
      have hpieceInv : FragInv nt ct piece := ihPInv _ (hpiecej ▸ Array.getElem_mem j.isLt)
      have hpieceProv : FragProv nt w₀ L piece := ihPProv _ (hpiecej ▸ Array.getElem_mem j.isLt)
      refine ⟨resolveStepB_fragInv (nt := nt) (ct := ct) fai piece
        hpieceInv hst1Inv hst2Inv,
        resolveStepB_fragProv (nt := nt) (ct := ct) (w₀ := w₀) (L := L) fai piece
        hpieceInv hpieceProv hLi hst1Prov hst2Prov⟩
  obtain ⟨_, hK, hP⟩ := hfold
  intro f' hf'
  rcases Array.mem_append.mp hf' with h | h
  · exact hK _ h
  · exact hP _ (Array.mem_of_mem_filter h)

name: clipFace_hasInputCarrier
statement:
theorem clipFace_hasInputCarrier (M₁ M₂ M : Mesh) (_meshId i : ℕ)
    (hMmem : M = M₁ ∨ M = M₂) (hi : i < M.size) (hdet : detOrigin (M[i]'hi) ≠ 0)
    {L : Array (IPlane × Box3)} {f' : Frag}
    (hmem : f' ∈ clipFaceScoped (fragOfFace (faceSOf (M[i]'hi))) L) :
    HasInputCarrier M₁ M₂ f'
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨M, i, hi, hMmem, hdet, ?_⟩
  exact fragInv_clipFaceScoped (fragInv_base hdet) L hmem

name: stageGen_hasInputCarrier
statement:
theorem stageGen_hasInputCarrier (M₁ M₂ M : Mesh) (meshId : ℕ)
    (hMmem : M = M₁ ∨ M = M₂) (hM : NoPlaneThroughOrigin M)
    (planes : Nat → Array (IPlane × Box3)) {f' : Frag}
    (hmem : f' ∈ (Array.range (materialize M).size).flatMap
      (fun i => clipFaceScoped (fragOfFace ((materialize M).getD i default))
        (planes i))) :
    HasInputCarrier M₁ M₂ f'
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨i, hi, hf'⟩ := mem_flatMap_arr.mp hmem
  rw [Array.mem_def, Array.toList_range, List.mem_range] at hi
  have hi' : i < M.size := by rwa [materialize_size] at hi
  have hdet : detOrigin (M[i]'hi') ≠ 0 := hM ⟨i, hi'⟩
  rw [arr_getD _ _ _ hi, materialize_getElem M i hi'] at hf'
  exact clipFace_hasInputCarrier M₁ M₂ M meshId i hMmem hi' hdet hf'

name: kept_fragInv
statement:
theorem kept_fragInv {M₁ M₂ : Mesh} (h₁ : NoPlaneThroughOrigin M₁)
    (h₂ : NoPlaneThroughOrigin M₂) {f : Frag} (hf : f ∈ keptGen M₁ M₂) :
    HasInputCarrier M₁ M₂ f
proof:
:= by
  rw [keptGen] at hf
  simp only at hf
  
  rw [Array.mem_append] at hf
  rcases hf with hf | hf
  · rw [Array.mem_append] at hf
    rcases hf with hf | hf
    · 
      rw [mem_classify] at hf
      obtain ⟨hmem, -⟩ := hf
      have hmemFrags : f ∈ (Array.range (materialize M₁).size).flatMap
          (fun i => clipFaceScoped (fragOfFace ((materialize M₁).getD i default))
            (planesForScoped ((materialize M₁).getD i default).plane (materialize M₂)
              ((candP M₁ M₂).getD i #[]))) := by
        have := Array.mem_of_mem_filter hmem
        exact this
      exact stageGen_hasInputCarrier M₁ M₂ M₁ 1 (Or.inl rfl) h₁ _ hmemFrags
    · 
      rw [mem_classify] at hf
      obtain ⟨hmem, -⟩ := hf
      have hmemFrags : f ∈ (Array.range (materialize M₂).size).flatMap
          (fun j => clipFaceScoped (fragOfFace ((materialize M₂).getD j default))
            (planesForScoped ((materialize M₂).getD j default).plane (materialize M₁)
              ((candP M₂ M₁).getD j #[]))) := by
        have := Array.mem_of_mem_filter hmem
        exact this
      exact stageGen_hasInputCarrier M₁ M₂ M₂ 2 (Or.inr rfl) h₂ _ hmemFrags
  · 
    rw [resolveCoplanar, Array.mem_append] at hf
    rcases hf with hf | hf
    · 
      obtain ⟨fa, hfa, hpiece⟩ := mem_flatMap_arr.mp hf
      have hfaIn : HasInputCarrier M₁ M₂ fa := by
        have hfaFrags : fa ∈ (Array.range (materialize M₁).size).flatMap
            (fun i => clipFaceScoped (fragOfFace ((materialize M₁).getD i default))
              (planesForScoped ((materialize M₁).getD i default).plane (materialize M₂)
                ((candP M₁ M₂).getD i #[]))) :=
          Array.mem_of_mem_filter hfa
        exact stageGen_hasInputCarrier M₁ M₂ M₁ 1 (Or.inl rfl) h₁ _ hfaFrags
      exact resolveFrag_hasInputCarrier _ _ _ hfaIn f hpiece
    · 
      obtain ⟨fb, hfb, hpiece⟩ := mem_flatMap_arr.mp hf
      have hfbIn : HasInputCarrier M₁ M₂ fb := by
        have hfbFrags : fb ∈ (Array.range (materialize M₂).size).flatMap
            (fun j => clipFaceScoped (fragOfFace ((materialize M₂).getD j default))
              (planesForScoped ((materialize M₂).getD j default).plane (materialize M₁)
                ((candP M₂ M₁).getD j #[]))) :=
          Array.mem_of_mem_filter hfb
        exact stageGen_hasInputCarrier M₁ M₂ M₂ 2 (Or.inr rfl) h₂ _ hfbFrags
      exact resolveFragB_hasInputCarrier _ _ _ hfbIn f hpiece

name: vsGen_facts
statement:
theorem vsGen_facts {M₁ M₂ : Mesh} (h₁ : NoPlaneThroughOrigin M₁)
    (h₂ : NoPlaneThroughOrigin M₂) :
    (∀ v ∈ (vsGen M₁ M₂).toList, repr4 v.h (P3.toPoint v.p))
      ∧ (vsGen M₁ M₂).toList.Pairwise (fun u v => u.p ≠ v.p)
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro v hv
    obtain ⟨f, hfk, hvf⟩ := mem_vertexUniverse _ hv
    obtain ⟨M, i, hi, -, -, hinv⟩ := kept_fragInv h₁ h₂ hfk
    rw [Array.mem_def, List.mem_iff_getElem] at hvf
    obtain ⟨n, hn, rfl⟩ := hvf
    have hn' : n < f.poly.size := by simpa using hn
    exact hinv.vrepr ⟨n, hn'⟩
  · have := vertexUniverse_pairwise (keptGen M₁ M₂)
    apply this.imp
    intro a b hab hc
    rw [hc, p3Lt_irrefl] at hab
    exact Bool.false_ne_true hab

name: keptGen_atomize_size3
statement:
theorem keptGen_atomize_size3 {M₁ M₂ : Mesh} (h₁ : NoPlaneThroughOrigin M₁)
    (h₂ : NoPlaneThroughOrigin M₂) {f : Frag} (hf : f ∈ keptGen M₁ M₂) :
    3 ≤ (atomizeFrag (vsGen M₁ M₂) f).poly.size
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨M, i, hi, -, hdet, hinv⟩ := kept_fragInv h₁ h₂ hf
  obtain ⟨hvs, hnd⟩ := vsGen_facts h₁ h₂
  obtain ⟨hm, -⟩ := atomize_refShape hinv (vsGen M₁ M₂) hvs hnd
  exact hm

name: keptGen_refShape
statement:
theorem keptGen_refShape {M₁ M₂ : Mesh} (h₁ : NoPlaneThroughOrigin M₁)
    (h₂ : NoPlaneThroughOrigin M₂) {f : Frag} (hf : f ∈ keptGen M₁ M₂)
    [NeZero f.poly.size]
    [NeZero (atomizeFrag (vsGen M₁ M₂) f).poly.size] :
    ∃ (M : Mesh) (i : ℕ) (hi : i < M.size),
      detOrigin (M[i]'hi) ≠ 0
      ∧ FragInv (carrierNormal (M[i]'hi)) (detOrigin (M[i]'hi)) f
      ∧ 3 ≤ (atomizeFrag (vsGen M₁ M₂) f).poly.size
      ∧ RefShapeOrd (fragCycle f) (fragCycle (atomizeFrag (vsGen M₁ M₂) f))
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨M, i, hi, -, hdet, hinv⟩ := kept_fragInv h₁ h₂ hf
  obtain ⟨hvs, hnd⟩ := vsGen_facts h₁ h₂
  obtain ⟨hm, hshape⟩ := atomize_refShape hinv (vsGen M₁ M₂) hvs hnd
  
  
  
  exact ⟨M, i, hi, hdet, hinv, hm, hshape⟩

name: emit_facts_gen
statement:
theorem emit_facts_gen {g : Frag} [NeZero g.poly.size] {r : ℕ} [NeZero r]
    {nt : Point} {ct : ℚ} {w : Fin r → Point}
    (hr : 3 ≤ r) (hm3 : 3 ≤ g.poly.size)
    (hpl : OnPlane nt ct w) (hstrict : StrictConv nt w)
    (hs : RefShape w (fragCycle g)) {τ : Triangle}
    (hτg : τ ∈ emitFrag g) :
    dotQ nt τ.v₀ = ct ∧ dotQ nt τ.v₁ = ct ∧ dotQ nt τ.v₂ = ct
      ∧ 0 < dotQ nt (crossQ (τ.v₁ - τ.v₀) (τ.v₂ - τ.v₀))
proof:
:= by
  have hpl' : OnPlane nt ct (fragCycle g) := hs.onPlane hpl
  have hp0 : 0 < g.poly.size := by omega
  have hp1 : 1 < g.poly.size := by omega
  have hp2 : 2 < g.poly.size := by omega
  by_cases h3 : g.poly.size = 3
  · 
    have e0 : g.poly.getD 0 default = g.poly[(⟨0, hp0⟩ : Fin g.poly.size)] :=
      getD_eq_getElem _ hp0 _
    have e1 : g.poly.getD 1 default = g.poly[(⟨1, hp1⟩ : Fin g.poly.size)] :=
      getD_eq_getElem _ hp1 _
    have e2 : g.poly.getD 2 default = g.poly[(⟨2, hp2⟩ : Fin g.poly.size)] :=
      getD_eq_getElem _ hp2 _
    have h1m : (1 : ℕ) % g.poly.size = 1 := Nat.mod_eq_of_lt (by omega)
    have hsucc0 : (⟨0, hp0⟩ : Fin g.poly.size) + 1 = ⟨1, hp1⟩ := by
      apply Fin.ext
      rw [Fin.val_add, Fin.val_one', h1m]
      show (0 + 1) % g.poly.size = 1
      rw [h3]
    have hsucc1 : (⟨1, hp1⟩ : Fin g.poly.size) + 1 = ⟨2, hp2⟩ := by
      apply Fin.ext
      rw [Fin.val_add, Fin.val_one', h1m]
      show (1 + 1) % g.poly.size = 2
      rw [h3]
    have hsucc2 : (⟨2, hp2⟩ : Fin g.poly.size) + 1 = ⟨0, hp0⟩ := by
      apply Fin.ext
      rw [Fin.val_add, Fin.val_one', h1m]
      show (2 + 1) % g.poly.size = 0
      rw [h3]
    have hne01 : fragCycle g ⟨0, hp0⟩ ≠ fragCycle g ⟨1, hp1⟩ := by
      have := hs.consec_ne hr hstrict ⟨0, hp0⟩
      rwa [hsucc0] at this
    have hne12 : fragCycle g ⟨1, hp1⟩ ≠ fragCycle g ⟨2, hp2⟩ := by
      have := hs.consec_ne hr hstrict ⟨1, hp1⟩
      rwa [hsucc1] at this
    have hne20 : fragCycle g ⟨2, hp2⟩ ≠ fragCycle g ⟨0, hp0⟩ := by
      have := hs.consec_ne hr hstrict ⟨2, hp2⟩
      rwa [hsucc2] at this
    have hemit := emitFrag_eq_triangle h3
      (by rw [e0, e1]; exact hne01)
      (by rw [e1, e2]; exact hne12)
      (by rw [e2, e0]; exact hne20)
    rw [hemit] at hτg
    have hτeq : τ = ⟨P3.toPoint (g.poly.getD 0 default).p,
        P3.toPoint (g.poly.getD 1 default).p,
        P3.toPoint (g.poly.getD 2 default).p⟩ := by
      simpa using hτg
    subst hτeq
    refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
    · rw [e0]; exact hpl' ⟨0, hp0⟩
    · rw [e1]; exact hpl' ⟨1, hp1⟩
    · rw [e2]; exact hpl' ⟨2, hp2⟩
    · show 0 < dotQ nt (crossQ
        (P3.toPoint (g.poly.getD 1 default).p - P3.toPoint (g.poly.getD 0 default).p)
        (P3.toPoint (g.poly.getD 2 default).p - P3.toPoint (g.poly.getD 0 default).p))
      have := hs.tri_ccw hr h3 hpl hstrict
      rw [e0, e1, e2]
      exact this
  · 
    have hemit := emitFrag_eq_fan h3 hm3
      (fun k => hs.apex_ne hr hm3 hpl hstrict k)
      (fun k => hs.consec_ne hr hstrict k)
    rw [Array.mem_def, hemit, List.mem_ofFn] at hτg
    obtain ⟨k, hk⟩ := hτg
    subst hk
    refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
    · exact apexQ_onPlane hpl'
    · exact hpl' k
    · exact hpl' (k + 1)
    · exact hs.fan_ccw hr hm3 hpl hstrict k

name: emit_face_spec_gen
statement:
theorem emit_face_spec_gen {M₁ M₂ : Mesh} (hg₁ : GenWF M₁) (hg₂ : GenWF M₂)
    {τ : Triangle} (hτ : τ ∈ meshIntersect M₁ M₂) :
    ∃ (M : Mesh) (i : ℕ) (hi : i < M.size),
      detOrigin (M[i]'hi) ≠ 0
      ∧ dotQ (carrierNormal (M[i]'hi)) τ.v₀ = detOrigin (M[i]'hi)
      ∧ dotQ (carrierNormal (M[i]'hi)) τ.v₁ = detOrigin (M[i]'hi)
      ∧ dotQ (carrierNormal (M[i]'hi)) τ.v₂ = detOrigin (M[i]'hi)
      ∧ 0 < dotQ (carrierNormal (M[i]'hi))
          (crossQ (τ.v₁ - τ.v₀) (τ.v₂ - τ.v₀))
proof:
:= by
  have h₁ : NoPlaneThroughOrigin M₁ := hg₁.2.2
  have h₂ : NoPlaneThroughOrigin M₂ := hg₂.2.2
  rw [meshIntersect_eq M₁ M₂ hg₁ hg₂] at hτ
  obtain ⟨g, hg, hτg⟩ := mem_flatMap_arr.mp hτ
  rw [Array.mem_map] at hg
  obtain ⟨f, hfk, rfl⟩ := hg
  
  
  
  obtain ⟨_M, _i, _hi, -, _hdet, hinv₀⟩ := kept_fragInv h₁ h₂ hfk
  haveI instr : NeZero f.poly.size := hinv₀.neZero
  haveI instm : NeZero (atomizeFrag (vsGen M₁ M₂) f).poly.size :=
    ⟨by have := keptGen_atomize_size3 h₁ h₂ hfk; omega⟩
  obtain ⟨M, i, hi, hdet, hinv, hm, hshape⟩ := keptGen_refShape h₁ h₂ hfk
  exact ⟨M, i, hi, hdet,
    emit_facts_gen hinv.size3 hm hinv.onPlane hinv.strictConv
      hshape.toRefShape hτg⟩

name: meshIntersect_noPlaneThroughOrigin
statement:
theorem meshIntersect_noPlaneThroughOrigin (M₁ M₂ : Mesh)
    (h₁ : Legacy.WellFormedMesh M₁) (h₂ : Legacy.WellFormedMesh M₂) :
    NoPlaneThroughOrigin (Impl.MeshIntersect.meshIntersect M₁ M₂)
proof:
:= by
  intro idx
  obtain ⟨M, i, hi, hdet, hp, hq, hr', hA⟩ :=
    emit_face_spec_gen (GenWF.of_legacy h₁) (GenWF.of_legacy h₂)
      (Array.getElem_mem idx.isLt)
  exact (orientSign_inherit hdet hp hq hr' hA).1

name: smul_of_ann_ker
statement:
theorem smul_of_ann_ker {n m : Point} (hn : n ≠ 0)
    (hker : ∀ v : Point, dotQ n v = 0 → dotQ m v = 0) :
    m = (dotQ m n / dotQ n n) • n
proof:
:= by
  have hnn : 0 < dotQ n n := dotQ_self_pos hn
  set ρ : ℚ := dotQ m n / dotQ n n with hρ
  set v : Point := m - ρ • n with hv
  have hnv : dotQ n v = 0 := by
    rw [hv, dotQ_sub_right, Proof.SimImplCover.dotQ_smul_right, hρ, dotQ_comm m n,
      div_mul_cancel₀ _ (ne_of_gt hnn), sub_self]
  have hmv : dotQ m v = 0 := hker v hnv
  have hvv : dotQ v v = 0 := by
    have hexp : dotQ v v = dotQ m v - ρ * dotQ n v := by
      rw [hv, dotQ_comm (m - ρ • n) v, dotQ_sub_right,
        Proof.SimImplCover.dotQ_smul_right, dotQ_comm v m, dotQ_comm v n]
    rw [hexp, hmv, hnv]; ring
  have hv0 : v = 0 := by
    by_contra hc
    exact (ne_of_gt (dotQ_self_pos hc)) hvv
  rw [hv, sub_eq_zero] at hv0
  exact hv0

name: trVtx_faithful
statement: theorem trVtx_faithful (o : P3) (v : Vtx) : VtxFaithful (trVtx o v)
proof: := rfl

name: dP3_dotProduct
statement: theorem dP3_dotProduct (u v : P3) : dP3 u ⬝ᵥ dP3 v = dotS u v
proof:
:= by
  simp [dP3, dotProduct, Fin.sum_univ_three, dotS]

name: dI3_hsub_faithful
statement:
theorem dI3_hsub_faithful (a b : Vtx) (ha : VtxFaithful a) (hb : VtxFaithful b) :
    dI3 (hsub b.h a.h) = ((toH4W a.p * toH4W b.p : Int) : ℚ) • dP3 (psubS b.p a.p)
proof:
:= by
  rw [dI3_hsub, ha, hb, dH4_toH4, dH4_toH4, toH4_w, toH4_w, dP3_psubS]
  funext i
  simp only [Pi.sub_apply, Pi.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul]
  push_cast
  ring

name: ScM_hsub_seam
statement:
theorem ScM_hsub_seam (o : P3) (a b : Vtx) (ha : VtxFaithful a) (hb : VtxFaithful b) :
    ∃ c : ℚ, 0 < c ∧ ScM c (hsub b.h a.h) (hsub (trVtx o b).h (trVtx o a).h)
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨((toH4W (psubS a.p o) * toH4W (psubS b.p o) : Int) : ℚ) /
      ((toH4W a.p * toH4W b.p : Int) : ℚ), ?_, ?_⟩
  · apply div_pos
    · exact_mod_cast mul_pos (toH4W_pos _) (toH4W_pos _)
    · exact_mod_cast mul_pos (toH4W_pos _) (toH4W_pos _)
  · unfold ScM
    rw [dI3_hsub_faithful (trVtx o a) (trVtx o b) (trVtx_faithful o a) (trVtx_faithful o b),
        dI3_hsub_faithful a b ha hb]
    simp only [trVtx_p, psubS_translate]
    rw [smul_smul]
    congr 1
    have hne : ((toH4W a.p * toH4W b.p : Int) : ℚ) ≠ 0 := by
      push_cast; exact ne_of_gt (mul_pos (by exact_mod_cast toH4W_pos a.p)
        (by exact_mod_cast toH4W_pos b.p))
    exact (div_mul_cancel₀ _ hne).symm

name: decide_pos_scale
statement:
theorem decide_pos_scale {m n : Int} {c : ℚ} (hc : 0 < c) (h : ((m : Int) : ℚ) = c * (n : ℚ)) :
    decide (0 < m) = decide (0 < n)
proof:
:= by
  have hsign : Int.sign m = Int.sign n :=
    intSign_eq_of_pos_mul hc one_pos h (by rw [one_mul])
  have hiff : (0 < m) ↔ (0 < n) := by
    rw [← Int.sign_eq_one_iff_pos, ← Int.sign_eq_one_iff_pos, hsign]
  simp only [hiff]

name: decide_lt_pos_scale
statement:
theorem decide_lt_pos_scale {m n : Int} {P G H : ℚ} (hP : 0 < P)
    (em : ((m : Int) : ℚ) = P * G) (en : ((n : Int) : ℚ) = P * H) :
    decide (m < n) = decide (G < H)
proof:
:= by
  have hiff : (m < n) ↔ (G < H) := by
    rw [show (m < n) ↔ ((m : ℚ) < (n : ℚ)) by norm_cast, em, en, mul_lt_mul_left hP]
  simp only [hiff]

name: decide_le_sub
statement: theorem decide_le_sub (x y k : ℚ) : decide (x - k ≤ y - k) = decide (x ≤ y)
proof:
:= by
  simp only [sub_le_sub_iff_right]

name: hsub_dotI_geom
statement:
theorem hsub_dotI_geom (a b w : Vtx) (ha : VtxFaithful a) (hb : VtxFaithful b) (hw : VtxFaithful w) :
    ((dotI (hsub b.h a.h) (hsub w.h a.h) : Int) : ℚ)
    = ((toH4W a.p : ℚ) * toH4W a.p * toH4W b.p * toH4W w.p)
      * dotS (psubS b.p a.p) (psubS w.p a.p)
proof:
:= by
  rw [dI3_dot, dI3_hsub_faithful a b ha hb, dI3_hsub_faithful a w ha hw,
      smul_dotProduct, dotProduct_smul, dP3_dotProduct]
  simp only [smul_eq_mul]
  push_cast; ring

name: hbw_faithful
statement: theorem hbw_faithful (b : Vtx) (hb : VtxFaithful b) : ((b.h.w : Int) : ℚ) = (toH4W b.p : ℚ)
proof:
:= by
  rw [hb, toH4_w]

name: hitCompare_geom
statement:
theorem hitCompare_geom (a b v : Vtx)
    (ha : VtxFaithful a) (hb : VtxFaithful b) (hv : VtxFaithful v) :
    decide (b.h.w * dotI (hsub b.h a.h) (hsub v.h a.h)
        < v.h.w * dotI (hsub b.h a.h) (hsub b.h a.h))
    = decide (dotS (psubS b.p a.p) (psubS v.p a.p) < dotS (psubS b.p a.p) (psubS b.p a.p))
proof:
:= by
  have hWa : (0 : ℚ) < (toH4W a.p : ℚ) := by exact_mod_cast toH4W_pos a.p
  have hWb : (0 : ℚ) < (toH4W b.p : ℚ) := by exact_mod_cast toH4W_pos b.p
  have hWv : (0 : ℚ) < (toH4W v.p : ℚ) := by exact_mod_cast toH4W_pos v.p
  refine decide_lt_pos_scale
    (P := (toH4W a.p : ℚ) * toH4W a.p * toH4W b.p * toH4W b.p * toH4W v.p)
    (mul_pos (mul_pos (mul_pos (mul_pos hWa hWa) hWb) hWb) hWv) ?_ ?_
  · push_cast
    rw [hbw_faithful b hb, hsub_dotI_geom a b v ha hb hv]
    ring
  · push_cast
    rw [hbw_faithful v hv, hsub_dotI_geom a b b ha hb hb]
    ring

name: hitTest_seam
statement:
theorem hitTest_seam (o : P3) (a b v : Vtx)
    (ha : VtxFaithful a) (hb : VtxFaithful b) (hv : VtxFaithful v) :
    hitTest (trVtx o a) (trVtx o b) (trVtx o v) = hitTest a b v
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨cu, hcu, hSu⟩ := ScM_hsub_seam o a b ha hb
  obtain ⟨cw, hcw, hSw⟩ := ScM_hsub_seam o a v ha hv
  have hcoll : isZeroI (crossI (hsub (trVtx o v).h (trVtx o a).h) (hsub (trVtx o b).h (trVtx o a).h))
      = isZeroI (crossI (hsub v.h a.h) (hsub b.h a.h)) :=
    ScM_isZero (mul_pos hcw hcu) (ScM_cross hSw hSu)
  have hsgn : decide (0 < dotI (hsub (trVtx o b).h (trVtx o a).h) (hsub (trVtx o v).h (trVtx o a).h))
      = decide (0 < dotI (hsub b.h a.h) (hsub v.h a.h)) :=
    decide_pos_scale (mul_pos hcu hcw) (ScM_dot hSu hSw)
  have hcmp := hitCompare_geom (trVtx o a) (trVtx o b) (trVtx o v)
    (trVtx_faithful o a) (trVtx_faithful o b) (trVtx_faithful o v)
  have hcmp0 := hitCompare_geom a b v ha hb hv
  simp only [trVtx_p, psubS_translate] at hcmp
  simp only [hitTest, trVtx_p, psubS, miRmin_sub, miRmax_sub, decide_le_sub, hcoll, hsgn,
    hcmp, hcmp0]

statement:

name: hitsOnB_eq
statement:
theorem hitsOnB_eq (bvh : Impl.BVH.BVH) (vs : Array Vtx) (a b : Vtx) :
    hitsOnB bvh vs a b =
      if isZeroI (hsub b.h a.h) then #[]
      else
        (((Impl.BVH.boxQuery bvh (edgeBox a b)).filterMap (fun i =>
            if h : i < vs.size then
              (if hitTest a b vs[i] then some vs[i] else none) else none)).toList.mergeSort
          (hitKey a b)).toArray
proof: := rfl

name: hitsOnB_seam
statement:
theorem hitsOnB_seam (o : P3) (vs : Array Vtx) (a b : Vtx)
    (ha : VtxFaithful a) (hb : VtxFaithful b) (hvs : ∀ v ∈ vs, VtxFaithful v) :
    hitsOnB (univBVH (vs.map (trVtx o))) (vs.map (trVtx o)) (trVtx o a) (trVtx o b)
    = (hitsOnB (univBVH vs) vs a b).map (trVtx o)
proof:
:= by
  rw [hitsOnB_eq, hitsOnB_eq]
  obtain ⟨cu, hcu, hSu⟩ := ScM_hsub_seam o a b ha hb
  rw [(ScM_isZero hcu hSu : isZeroI (hsub (trVtx o b).h (trVtx o a).h) = isZeroI (hsub b.h a.h))]
  split
  · simp
  · rw [boxQuery_univBVH_seam]
    set idxs := Impl.BVH.boxQuery (univBVH vs) (edgeBox a b) with hidxs
    have hfun : (fun (i : Nat) => if h : i < (vs.map (trVtx o)).size then
          (if hitTest (trVtx o a) (trVtx o b) (vs.map (trVtx o))[i] then
            some (vs.map (trVtx o))[i] else none) else none)
        = (fun i => Option.map (trVtx o) (if h : i < vs.size then
          (if hitTest a b vs[i] then some vs[i] else none) else none)) := by
      funext i
      by_cases hi : i < vs.size
      · have hi' : i < (vs.map (trVtx o)).size := by rwa [Array.size_map]
        rw [dif_pos hi, dif_pos hi', Array.getElem_map,
            hitTest_seam o a b vs[i] ha hb (hvs vs[i] (Array.getElem_mem hi))]
        split_ifs <;> rfl
      · have hi' : ¬ i < (vs.map (trVtx o)).size := by rw [Array.size_map]; exact hi
        rw [dif_neg hi, dif_neg hi']; rfl
    have hhits : idxs.filterMap (fun (i : Nat) => if h : i < (vs.map (trVtx o)).size then
            (if hitTest (trVtx o a) (trVtx o b) (vs.map (trVtx o))[i] then
              some (vs.map (trVtx o))[i] else none) else none)
        = (idxs.filterMap (fun i => if h : i < vs.size then
            (if hitTest a b vs[i] then some vs[i] else none) else none)).map (trVtx o) := by
      rw [hfun]
      apply Array.ext'
      rw [Array.toList_map, arr_filterMap_toList, arr_filterMap_toList, List.map_filterMap]
    rw [hhits]
    generalize (idxs.filterMap (fun i => if h : i < vs.size then
      (if hitTest a b vs[i] then some vs[i] else none) else none)) = hits
    apply Array.ext'
    simp only [Array.toList_toArray, Array.toList_map]
    exact (List.map_mergeSort (fun x _ y _ => (hitKey_seam o a b x y).symm)).symm

name: atomizeFragB_eq
proof: := rfl

name: foldl_rel2_mem
statement:
theorem foldl_rel2_mem {α β β'} (R : β → β' → Prop) (F : β → α → β) (F' : β' → α → β') :
    ∀ (l : List α), (∀ a ∈ l, ∀ b b', R b b' → R (F b a) (F' b' a)) →
    ∀ (b : β) (b' : β'), R b b' → R (l.foldl F b) (l.foldl F' b')
  | [], _, b, b', hR => hR
  | a :: l, hstep, b, b', hR => by
      simp only [List.foldl_cons]
      exact foldl_rel2_mem R F F' l (fun x hx => hstep x (List.mem_cons_of_mem a hx))
        (F b a) (F' b' a) (hstep a (List.mem_cons_self a l) b b' hR)

/

name: atomStep_rel
statement:
theorem atomStep_rel (o : P3) (vs : Array Vtx) (f f' : Frag) (hff : FragSeam o f f')
    (hf : FragFaithful f) (hvs : ∀ v ∈ vs, VtxFaithful v) (r : Nat) (hr : r = f.poly.size)
    (i : Nat) (hi : i < r) (pv pv' : Array Vtx)
    (hR : pv' = pv.map (trVtx o)) :
    atomStep (univBVH (vs.map (trVtx o))) (vs.map (trVtx o)) f' r pv' i
      = (atomStep (univBVH vs) vs f r pv i).map (trVtx o)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨hpoly, _⟩ := hff
  have hisz : i < f.poly.size := hr ▸ hi
  have hi1sz : (i + 1) % r < f.poly.size :=
    hr ▸ Nat.mod_lt _ (Nat.lt_of_le_of_lt (Nat.zero_le i) hi)
  have haf : VtxFaithful (f.poly.getD i default) := hf _ (getD_mem f.poly i hisz default)
  have hbf : VtxFaithful (f.poly.getD ((i + 1) % r) default) := hf _ (getD_mem f.poly _ hi1sz default)
  have ha : f'.poly.getD i default = trVtx o (f.poly.getD i default) := by
    rw [hpoly]; exact map_getD_lt (trVtx o) f.poly i hisz default default
  have hb : f'.poly.getD ((i + 1) % r) default = trVtx o (f.poly.getD ((i + 1) % r) default) := by
    rw [hpoly]; exact map_getD_lt (trVtx o) f.poly _ hi1sz default default
  have hhits : hitsOnB (univBVH (vs.map (trVtx o))) (vs.map (trVtx o))
        (f'.poly.getD i default) (f'.poly.getD ((i + 1) % r) default)
      = (hitsOnB (univBVH vs) vs (f.poly.getD i default)
          (f.poly.getD ((i + 1) % r) default)).map (trVtx o) := by
    rw [ha, hb]; exact hitsOnB_seam o vs _ _ haf hbf hvs
  simp only [atomStep]
  rw [hhits, ha, hR,
      show (pv.map (trVtx o)).push (trVtx o (f.poly.getD i default))
        = (pv.push (f.poly.getD i default)).map (trVtx o) from Array.map_push.symm,
      ← Array.foldl_toList, ← Array.foldl_toList, Array.toList_map]
  exact foldl_map_fusion (trVtx o) (Array.map (trVtx o)) (fun pv h => pv.push h)
    (fun pv h => pv.push h) (fun _ _ => Array.map_push.symm)
    _ (pv.push (f.poly.getD i default))

name: atomizeFragB_seam
statement:
theorem atomizeFragB_seam (o : P3) (vs : Array Vtx) (f f' : Frag) (hff : FragSeam o f f')
    (hf : FragFaithful f) (hvs : ∀ v ∈ vs, VtxFaithful v) :
    FragSeam o (atomizeFragB (univBVH vs) vs f)
      (atomizeFragB (univBVH (vs.map (trVtx o))) (vs.map (trVtx o)) f')
proof:
:= by
  have hr : f'.poly.size = f.poly.size := by rw [hff.1, Array.size_map]
  rw [atomizeFragB_eq, atomizeFragB_eq, hr]
  simp only [← Array.foldl_toList]
  set stU := (Array.range f.poly.size).toList.foldl (atomStep (univBVH vs) vs f f.poly.size) #[]
    with hstU
  set stT := (Array.range f.poly.size).toList.foldl
    (atomStep (univBVH (vs.map (trVtx o))) (vs.map (trVtx o)) f' f.poly.size) #[] with hstT
  have hRel : stT = stU.map (trVtx o) := by
    rw [hstU, hstT]
    exact foldl_rel2_mem
      (fun (s s' : Array Vtx) => s' = s.map (trVtx o))
      (atomStep (univBVH vs) vs f f.poly.size)
      (atomStep (univBVH (vs.map (trVtx o))) (vs.map (trVtx o)) f' f.poly.size)
      (Array.range f.poly.size).toList
      (fun i hi s s' hs => atomStep_rel o vs f f' hff hf hvs f.poly.size rfl i
        (by rw [Array.toList_range, List.mem_range] at hi; exact hi) s s' hs)
      #[] #[] (by simp)
  exact ⟨hRel, hff.2⟩

name: vertexUniverse_flatMap_congr
proof:
:= by
  simp only [vertexUniverse, h]

name: forall2_flatMap_eq
statement:
theorem forall2_flatMap_eq {α β} (S : α → α → Prop) (g g' : α → List β)
    (hg : ∀ a a', S a a' → g' a' = g a) :
    ∀ {l l' : List α}, List.Forall₂ S l l' → l'.flatMap g' = l.flatMap g
  | _, _, List.Forall₂.nil => rfl
  | _, _, List.Forall₂.cons hab htl => by
      simp only [List.flatMap_cons]; rw [hg _ _ hab, forall2_flatMap_eq S g g' hg htl]

/

name: vertexUniverse_seam
statement:
theorem vertexUniverse_seam (o : P3) (K K' : Array Frag)
    (hK : List.Forall₂ (FragSeam o) K.toList K'.toList) :
    vertexUniverse K' = (vertexUniverse K).map (trVtx o)
proof:
:= by
  rw [← vertexUniverse_tr o K]
  apply vertexUniverse_flatMap_congr
  rw [arr_flatMap_map]
  apply Array.ext'
  rw [toList_flatMap, toList_flatMap]
  exact forall2_flatMap_eq (FragSeam o) (fun f => (trFrag o f).poly.toList)
    (fun f => f.poly.toList) (fun f g hs => by simp only [hs.1, trFrag_poly]) hK

name: rayHits_window_slide
statement:
theorem rayHits_window_slide {t : Triangle} {Q d : Point} {c : ℚ} (hc : 0 < c)
    (hnd : dot (faceNormal t) d ≠ 0)
    (hwin : ∀ s : ℚ, 0 < s → s ≤ c → Q + s • d ∉ triangleSet t) :
    RayHits (Q + c • d) d t ↔ RayHits Q d t
proof:
:= by
  rw [rayHits_iff hnd, rayHits_iff hnd, sStar_slide hnd, hitPt_slide hnd]
  by_cases hhit : RayHits Q d t
  · obtain ⟨hpos, hmem⟩ := (rayHits_iff hnd Q).mp hhit
    
    
    have hgt : c < sStar t d Q := by
      by_contra h; push_neg at h
      
      exact hwin (sStar t d Q) hpos h (by rw [← hitPt]; exact hmem)
    simp only [hmem, and_true]
    constructor <;> intro _ <;> [linarith; linarith]
  · rw [rayHits_iff hnd] at hhit
    push_neg at hhit
    constructor
    · rintro ⟨hpos, hmem⟩; exact absurd hmem (hhit (by linarith))
    · rintro ⟨hpos, hmem⟩; exact absurd hmem (hhit hpos)

name: crossingCount_window_slide
statement:
theorem crossingCount_window_slide {M : Mesh} {Q d : Point} {c : ℚ}
    (_hd : d ≠ 0) (hc : 0 < c)
    (hwin : ∀ s : ℚ, 0 < s → s ≤ c → Q + s • d ∉ surface M) :
    crossingCount M Q d = crossingCount M (Q + c • d) d
proof:
:= by
  rw [crossingCount_eq_sum, crossingCount_eq_sum]
  refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun u _ => ?_)
  unfold crossSummand
  by_cases hnd : dot (faceNormal M[u]) d = 0
  · rw [hnd]; simp
  · 
    have hwinu : ∀ s : ℚ, 0 < s → s ≤ c → Q + s • d ∉ triangleSet M[u] := by
      intro s hs hsc hmem
      exact hwin s hs hsc (Set.mem_iUnion.mpr ⟨u, hmem⟩)
    rw [rayHits_window_slide hc hnd hwinu]

name: sStar_shift
statement:
theorem sStar_shift {t : Triangle} {d : Point} (hnd : dot (faceNormal t) d ≠ 0)

statement:
theorem hitPt_shift {t : Triangle} {d : Point} (hnd : dot (faceNormal t) d ≠ 0)

name: rayHits_probe_eq_of_off
statement:
theorem rayHits_probe_eq_of_off {X : Mesh} {x d : Point} {ε : ℚ} (hε : 0 < ε)
    {u : Fin X.size} (hnd : dot (faceNormal X[u]) d ≠ 0)
    (hseg : ∀ r : ℚ, |r| ≤ ε → x + r • d ∉ triangleSet X[u]) :
    RayHits (x + (-ε) • d) d X[u] ↔ RayHits (x + ε • d) d X[u]
proof:
:= by
  rw [rayHits_iff hnd, rayHits_iff hnd, hitPt_shift hnd, hitPt_shift hnd]
  have hpm : sStar X[u] d (x + (-ε) • d) = sStar X[u] d x + ε := by
    rw [sStar_shift hnd]; ring
  have hpp : sStar X[u] d (x + ε • d) = sStar X[u] d x - ε := sStar_shift hnd x ε
  rw [hpm, hpp]
  by_cases hmem : hitPt X[u] d x ∈ triangleSet X[u]
  · 
    simp only [hmem, and_true]
    have hbig : ε < |sStar X[u] d x| := by
      by_contra h; push_neg at h
      
      have hoff : x + (sStar X[u] d x) • d ∉ triangleSet X[u] := hseg _ h
      rw [← hitPt] at hoff; exact hoff hmem
    rcases lt_or_gt_of_ne (abs_pos.mp (lt_trans hε hbig)) with hlt | hgt
    · have hslt : sStar X[u] d x < -ε := by rw [abs_of_neg hlt] at hbig; linarith
      constructor <;> intro _ <;> linarith
    · have hsgt : ε < sStar X[u] d x := by rw [abs_of_pos hgt] at hbig; exact hbig
      constructor <;> intro _ <;> linarith
  · 
    simp only [hmem, and_false]

name: crossSummand_probe_face_i
statement:
theorem crossSummand_probe_face_i {f : Triangle} {x d : Point} {ε : ℚ} (hε : 0 < ε)
    (_hn : faceNormal f ≠ 0) (hxmem : x ∈ triangleSet f) (hD : 0 < dot (faceNormal f) d) :
    crossSummand f (x + (-ε) • d) d = crossSummand f (x + ε • d) d + 1
proof:
:= by
  have hnd : dot (faceNormal f) d ≠ 0 := ne_of_gt hD
  
  have hcar : dot (faceNormal f) x = cOf f := triangleSet_carrier hxmem
  have hs0 : sStar f d x = 0 := by rw [sStar, hcar, sub_self, zero_div]
  
  have hitm : RayHits (x + (-ε) • d) d f := by
    rw [rayHits_iff hnd, hitPt_shift hnd]
    refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
    · rw [sStar_shift hnd, hs0]; linarith
    · rw [show hitPt f d x = x by rw [hitPt, hs0, zero_smul, add_zero]]; exact hxmem
  
  have hitp : ¬ RayHits (x + ε • d) d f := by
    rw [rayHits_iff hnd]; push_neg; intro hpos
    rw [sStar_shift hnd, hs0] at hpos; linarith
  unfold crossSummand
  rw [if_pos hitm, if_neg hitp, if_pos hD]; ring

name: jump_count_diff
statement:
theorem jump_count_diff {X : Mesh} {i : Fin X.size} {x d : Point} {ε : ℚ} (hε : 0 < ε)
    (hn : faceNormal X[i] ≠ 0) (hxmem : x ∈ triangleSet X[i])
    (hD : 0 < dot (faceNormal X[i]) d)
    (hoff : ∀ u : Fin X.size, u ≠ i → x ∉ triangleSet X[u])
    (hseg : ∀ (u : Fin X.size), u ≠ i →
      ∀ r : ℚ, |r| ≤ ε → x + r • d ∉ triangleSet X[u]) :
    crossingCount X (x + (-ε) • d) d = crossingCount X (x + ε • d) d + 1
proof:
:= by
  rw [crossingCount_eq_sum, crossingCount_eq_sum]
  
  have hpair : ∀ u : Fin X.size,
      crossSummand X[u] (x + (-ε) • d) d
        = crossSummand X[u] (x + ε • d) d + (if u = i then 1 else 0) := by
    intro u
    by_cases hu : u = i
    · subst hu
      rw [if_pos rfl]
      exact crossSummand_probe_face_i hε hn hxmem hD
    · rw [if_neg hu, add_zero]
      
      unfold crossSummand
      by_cases hnd : dot (faceNormal X[u]) d = 0
      · rw [hnd]; simp
      · rw [rayHits_probe_eq_of_off hε hnd (hseg u hu)]
  rw [Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun u _ => hpair u), Finset.sum_add_distrib]
  congr 1
  rw [Finset.sum_ite_eq' Finset.univ i (fun _ => (1:ℤ))]
  simp

name: maxAbsD_nonneg
statement: theorem maxAbsD_nonneg (d : Point) : 0 ≤ maxAbsD d
proof:
:=
  le_trans (abs_nonneg _) (le_max_left _ _)

name: coord_le_maxAbsD
statement: theorem coord_le_maxAbsD (d : Point) (i : Fin 3) : |d i| ≤ maxAbsD d
proof:
:= by
  rw [maxAbsD]; fin_cases i
  · exact le_max_left _ _
  · exact le_trans (le_max_left _ _) (le_max_right _ _)
  · exact le_trans (le_max_right _ _) (le_max_right _ _)

name: shifted_mem_box
statement:
theorem shifted_mem_box {x d : Point} {r ρ : ℚ} (h : |r| * maxAbsD d ≤ ρ) :
    x + r • d ∈ Box x ρ
proof:
:= by
  intro i
  simp only [Pi.add_apply, Pi.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul, add_sub_cancel_left, abs_mul]
  exact le_trans (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (coord_le_maxAbsD d i) (abs_nonneg _)) h

name: exists_probe_radius
statement:
theorem exists_probe_radius {X : Mesh} (hndf : NoDegenerateFaces X) {i : Fin X.size}
    {x : Point} (hiso : ∀ u : Fin X.size, u ≠ i → x ∉ triangleSet X[u])
    {R : ℚ} (hR : 0 < R) {d : Point} (hmax : 0 ≤ maxAbsD d)
    (hcoord : ∀ j : Fin 3, |d j| ≤ maxAbsD d) :
    ∃ ε : ℚ, 0 < ε ∧ ε * maxAbsD d ≤ R ∧
      ∀ (u : Fin X.size), u ≠ i → ∀ r : ℚ, |r| ≤ ε → x + r • d ∉ triangleSet X[u]
proof:
:= by
  classical
  
  have hbox : ∀ u : Fin X.size,
      ∃ ρ : ℚ, 0 < ρ ∧ (x ∉ triangleSet X[u] →
        ∀ P, P ∈ Box x ρ → P ∉ triangleSet X[u]) := by
    intro u
    by_cases hu : x ∈ triangleSet X[u]
    · exact ⟨1, one_pos, fun h => absurd hu h⟩
    · obtain ⟨ρ, hρpos, hρspec⟩ := exists_separating_box (hndf u) hu
      exact ⟨ρ, hρpos, fun _ => hρspec⟩
  choose ρf hρfpos hρfspec using hbox
  have hune : (Finset.univ : Finset (Fin X.size)).Nonempty := ⟨i, Finset.mem_univ i⟩
  set ρ₀ : ℚ := Finset.univ.inf' hune ρf with hρ₀
  have hρ₀pos : 0 < ρ₀ := by rw [hρ₀, Finset.lt_inf'_iff]; exact fun u _ => hρfpos u
  have hρ₀le : ∀ u, ρ₀ ≤ ρf u := fun u => Finset.inf'_le _ (Finset.mem_univ u)
  refine ⟨min ρ₀ R / (maxAbsD d + 1), div_pos (lt_min hρ₀pos hR) (by linarith), ?_, ?_⟩
  · 
    rw [div_mul_eq_mul_div, div_le_iff₀ (by linarith)]
    nlinarith [min_le_right ρ₀ R, lt_min hρ₀pos hR, hmax]
  · intro u hu r hr
    apply hρfspec u (hiso u hu)
    
    intro j
    simp only [Pi.add_apply, Pi.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul, add_sub_cancel_left, abs_mul]
    have hstep : |r| * |d j| ≤ (min ρ₀ R / (maxAbsD d + 1)) * maxAbsD d := by
      apply mul_le_mul hr (hcoord j) (abs_nonneg _)
      exact le_of_lt (div_pos (lt_min hρ₀pos hR) (by linarith))
    refine le_trans hstep ?_
    rw [div_mul_eq_mul_div, div_le_iff₀ (by linarith)]
    have h1 : min ρ₀ R ≤ ρ₀ := min_le_left _ _
    nlinarith [hρ₀le u, hmax, hρ₀pos, h1]

name: jump_probe_of_clean
statement:
theorem jump_probe_of_clean {X : Mesh} (hwzo : WindingZeroOrOne X) {i : Fin X.size}
    {x d : Point} {ε : ℚ} (hεpos : 0 < ε)
    (hn : faceNormal X[i] ≠ 0) (hxmem : x ∈ triangleSet X[i])
    (hD : 0 < dot (faceNormal X[i]) d)
    (hiso : ∀ u : Fin X.size, u ≠ i → x ∉ triangleSet X[u])
    (hlineclean : ∀ (j : Fin X.size) (r : ℚ), x + r • d ∉ edgeSet X[j])
    (hseg : ∀ (u : Fin X.size), u ≠ i → ∀ r : ℚ, |r| ≤ ε → x + r • d ∉ triangleSet X[u]) :
    (crossingCount X (x + ε • d) d = 0 ∧ AdmissibleRay X (x + ε • d) d ∧
        x + ε • d ∉ surface X) ∧
      (crossingCount X (x + (-ε) • d) d = 1 ∧ AdmissibleRay X (x + (-ε) • d) d ∧
        x + (-ε) • d ∉ surface X)
proof:
:= by
  have hnd : dot (faceNormal X[i]) d ≠ 0 := ne_of_gt hD
  have hd0 : d ≠ 0 := by intro h; rw [h] at hD; simp [dot] at hD
  have hcarI : dot (faceNormal X[i]) x = cOf X[i] := triangleSet_carrier hxmem
  
  have hadm : ∀ σ : ℚ, AdmissibleRay X (x + σ • d) d := by
    intro σ
    refine ⟨hd0, fun u s hs hmem => ?_⟩
    have hrw : (x + σ • d) + s • d = x + (σ + s) • d := by
      funext k; simp only [Pi.add_apply, Pi.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul, add_mul]; ring
    rw [hrw] at hmem
    exact hlineclean u (σ + s) hmem
  
  have hoffsurf : ∀ σ : ℚ, σ ≠ 0 → |σ| ≤ ε → x + σ • d ∉ surface X := by
    intro σ hσ0 hσε
    rw [surface, Set.mem_iUnion, not_exists]
    intro u hu
    by_cases hui : u = i
    · rw [hui] at hu
      have hcar : dot (faceNormal X[i]) (x + σ • d) = cOf X[i] := triangleSet_carrier hu
      rw [dot_line, hcarI] at hcar
      have hz : σ * dot (faceNormal X[i]) d = 0 := by linarith
      rcases mul_eq_zero.mp hz with h | h
      · exact hσ0 h
      · exact hnd h
    · exact hseg u hui σ hσε hu
  have hoffP : x + ε • d ∉ surface X :=
    hoffsurf ε (ne_of_gt hεpos) (by rw [abs_of_pos hεpos])
  have hoffM : x + (-ε) • d ∉ surface X :=
    hoffsurf (-ε) (neg_ne_zero.mpr (ne_of_gt hεpos)) (by rw [abs_neg, abs_of_pos hεpos])
  
  have hjump : crossingCount X (x + (-ε) • d) d = crossingCount X (x + ε • d) d + 1 :=
    jump_count_diff hεpos hn hxmem hD hiso hseg
  have hwM := hwzo (x + (-ε) • d) d (hadm (-ε))
  have hwP := hwzo (x + ε • d) d (hadm ε)
  have hP0 : crossingCount X (x + ε • d) d = 0 := by
    rcases hwM with hM | hM <;> rcases hwP with hP | hP <;> omega
  have hM1 : crossingCount X (x + (-ε) • d) d = 1 := by omega
  exact ⟨⟨hP0, hadm ε, hoffP⟩, ⟨hM1, hadm (-ε), hoffM⟩⟩

name: exists_jump_probe
statement:
theorem exists_jump_probe {X : Mesh} (hwzo : WindingZeroOrOne X)
    (hndf : NoDegenerateFaces X) {i : Fin X.size}
    {x : Point} (hxmem : x ∈ triangleSet X[i]) (hxedge : x ∉ edgeSet X[i])
    (hiso : ∀ u : Fin X.size, u ≠ i → x ∉ triangleSet X[u])
    {R : ℚ} (hR : 0 < R) :
    ∃ (P₀ P₁ d : Point),
      (P₀ ∈ Box x R ∧ crossingCount X P₀ d = 0 ∧
        AdmissibleRay X P₀ d ∧ P₀ ∉ surface X) ∧
      (P₁ ∈ Box x R ∧ crossingCount X P₁ d = 1 ∧
        AdmissibleRay X P₁ d ∧ P₁ ∉ surface X)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have hn : faceNormal X[i] ≠ 0 := hndf i
  
  have hxnoedge : ∀ j : Fin X.size, x ∉ edgeSet X[j] := by
    intro j
    by_cases hj : j = i
    · rw [hj]; exact hxedge
    · exact fun hc => hiso j hj
        (Proof.MeshIntersectRayClassify.edgeSet_subset_triangleSet _ hc)
  
  obtain ⟨d, hDpos, hclean⟩ := exists_edge_clean_line hxnoedge hn
  
  have hlineclean : ∀ (j : Fin X.size) (r : ℚ), x + r • d ∉ edgeSet X[j] := by
    intro j r
    by_cases hr0 : r = 0
    · rw [hr0]; simpa using hxnoedge j
    · exact hclean j r hr0
  
  obtain ⟨ε, hεpos, hεR, hseg⟩ := exists_probe_radius hndf hiso hR
    (d := d) (maxAbsD_nonneg d) (coord_le_maxAbsD d)
  
  obtain ⟨⟨hP0, hadmP, hoffP⟩, ⟨hM1, hadmM, hoffM⟩⟩ :=
    jump_probe_of_clean hwzo hεpos hn hxmem hDpos hiso hlineclean hseg
  refine ⟨x + ε • d, x + (-ε) • d, d, ⟨?_, hP0, hadmP, hoffP⟩, ⟨?_, hM1, hadmM, hoffM⟩⟩
  · apply shifted_mem_box
    rw [abs_of_pos hεpos]; exact hεR
  · apply shifted_mem_box
    rw [abs_neg, abs_of_pos hεpos]; exact hεR

name: clipBySide_faithful
statement:
theorem clipBySide_faithful (g : IPlane) (f : Frag) (hf : FragFaithful f) :
    (∀ x ∈ (clipBySide g f).1, FragFaithful x) ∧ (∀ x ∈ (clipBySide g f).2, FragFaithful x)
proof:
:= by
  rw [clipBySide_eq, ← Array.foldl_toList]
  refine foldl_inv (fun st => (∀ x ∈ st.1, FragFaithful x) ∧ (∀ x ∈ st.2, FragFaithful x))
    (partStep (sideOf g)) (clipFrag g f).toList (#[], #[]) ⟨by simp, by simp⟩ ?_
  intro st hP piece hpiece
  obtain ⟨hP1, hP2⟩ := hP
  have hpf : FragFaithful piece :=
    clipFrag_faithful g f hf piece (Array.mem_toList.mp hpiece)
  simp only [partStep]
  split
  · refine ⟨fun x hx => ?_, hP2⟩
    rcases Array.mem_push.mp hx with h | h
    · exact hP1 x h
    · exact h ▸ hpf
  · refine ⟨hP1, fun x hx => ?_⟩
    rcases Array.mem_push.mp hx with h | h
    · exact hP2 x h
    · exact h ▸ hpf

name: innerFold_faithful
statement:
theorem innerFold_faithful (g : IPlane) (inside : Array Frag)
    (hin : ∀ p ∈ inside, FragFaithful p) :
    (∀ x ∈ (inside.foldl (innerStep g) (#[], #[])).1, FragFaithful x)
    ∧ (∀ x ∈ (inside.foldl (innerStep g) (#[], #[])).2, FragFaithful x)
proof:
:= by
  rw [← Array.foldl_toList]
  refine foldl_inv (fun st => (∀ x ∈ st.1, FragFaithful x) ∧ (∀ x ∈ st.2, FragFaithful x))
    (innerStep g) inside.toList (#[], #[]) ⟨by simp, by simp⟩ ?_
  intro st ⟨hP1, hP2⟩ piece hpiece
  have hpf : FragFaithful piece := hin piece (Array.mem_toList.mp hpiece)
  obtain ⟨hc1, hc2⟩ := clipBySide_faithful g piece hpf
  refine ⟨fun x hx => ?_, fun x hx => ?_⟩
  · rcases Array.mem_append.mp hx with h | h
    · exact hP1 x h
    · exact hc1 x h
  · rcases Array.mem_append.mp hx with h | h
    · exact hP2 x h
    · exact hc2 x h

name: innerStep_map
statement:
theorem innerStep_map (o : P3) (g g' : IPlane) (st : Array Frag × Array Frag) (piece : Frag)
    (hpiece : FragFaithful piece)
    (hsign : ∀ v : Vtx, VtxFaithful v → signI g' (trVtx o v).h = signI g v.h)
    (hcut : ∀ A B : Vtx, VtxFaithful A → VtxFaithful B →
      cutVtx g' (trVtx o A) (trVtx o B) = trVtx o (cutVtx g A B)) :
    innerStep g' (mapPair (trFrag o) st) (trFrag o piece)
    = mapPair (trFrag o) (innerStep g st piece)
proof:
:= by
  simp only [innerStep, mapPair, clipBySide_ss o g g' piece hpiece hsign hcut, array_map_append]

name: foldl_map_fusion_memS
statement:
theorem foldl_map_fusion_memS {α β} (h : α → α) (mapf : β → β) (F F' : β → α → β) (S : α → Prop)
    (hstep : ∀ acc a, S a → F' (mapf acc) (h a) = mapf (F acc a)) :
    ∀ (l : List α), (∀ a ∈ l, S a) → ∀ init,
      (l.map h).foldl F' (mapf init) = mapf (l.foldl F init)
  | [], _, init => rfl
  | a :: l, hS, init => by
      simp only [List.map_cons, List.foldl_cons]
      rw [hstep init a (hS a (List.mem_cons_self _ _))]
      exact foldl_map_fusion_memS h mapf F F' S hstep l
        (fun x hx => hS x (List.mem_cons_of_mem _ hx)) (F init a)

/-! ## 2. `coplanarClip` as an edge-plane fold; the step commutes -/

/
def copStep (acc : Array Frag × Array Frag) (g : IPlane) : Array Frag × Array Frag

name: coplanarClip_eq
statement:
theorem coplanarClip_eq (fa fb : Frag) :
    coplanarClip fa fb = (edgePlanesOf fb).foldl copStep (#[fa], #[])
proof: := rfl

name: copStep_faithful
statement:
theorem copStep_faithful (acc : Array Frag × Array Frag) (g : IPlane)
    (h1 : ∀ x ∈ acc.1, FragFaithful x) : ∀ x ∈ (copStep acc g).1, FragFaithful x
proof:
:= by
  exact (innerFold_faithful g acc.1 h1).1

name: copStep_map
statement:
theorem copStep_map (o : P3) (g g' : IPlane) (acc : Array Frag × Array Frag)
    (hR : EdgeShiftScale o g g') (hfaith : ∀ x ∈ acc.1, FragFaithful x) :
    copStep (mapPair (trFrag o) acc) g' = mapPair (trFrag o) (copStep acc g)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨hsign, hcut⟩ := hR
  have hstepFold : (acc.1.map (trFrag o)).foldl (innerStep g') (#[], #[])
      = mapPair (trFrag o) (acc.1.foldl (innerStep g) (#[], #[])) := by
    rw [← Array.foldl_toList, ← Array.foldl_toList, Array.toList_map]
    have key := foldl_map_fusion_memS (trFrag o) (mapPair (trFrag o)) (innerStep g) (innerStep g')
      FragFaithful
      (fun acc0 piece hpf => innerStep_map o g g' acc0 piece hpf hsign hcut)
      acc.1.toList (fun p hp => hfaith p (Array.mem_toList.mp hp)) (#[], #[])
    simpa using key
  simp only [copStep, mapPair, hstepFold]
  simp [mapPair, array_map_append]

name: forall2_map_map
statement:
theorem forall2_map_map {α β γ} (R : β → γ → Prop) (F : α → β) (G : α → γ) :
    ∀ (l : List α), (∀ a ∈ l, R (F a) (G a)) → List.Forall₂ R (l.map F) (l.map G)
  | [], _ => List.Forall₂.nil
  | a :: l, h => List.Forall₂.cons (h a (List.mem_cons_self _ _))
      (forall2_map_map R F G l (fun x hx => h x (List.mem_cons_of_mem _ hx)))

/

name: edgePlanesOf_seam
statement:
theorem edgePlanesOf_seam (o : P3) (fb fb' : Frag) (μ : Rat) (hμ : 0 < μ)
    (hn : carrierNormalP fb' = smulS μ (carrierNormalP fb))
    (hpoly : fb'.poly = fb.poly.map (trVtx o)) (_hfaith : FragFaithful fb) :
    List.Forall₂ (EdgeShiftScale o) (edgePlanesOf fb).toList (edgePlanesOf fb').toList
proof:
:= by
  simp only [edgePlanesOf, hpoly, Array.size_map, carrierNormalP_eq, Array.toList_map,
    Array.toList_range]
  apply forall2_map_map
  intro i hi
  rw [List.mem_range] at hi
  have hia : ((fb.poly.map (trVtx o)).getD i default).p = psubS (fb.poly.getD i default).p o := by
    rw [map_getD_lt (trVtx o) fb.poly i hi default default]; rfl
  have hib : ((fb.poly.map (trVtx o)).getD ((i + 1) % fb.poly.size) default).p
           = psubS (fb.poly.getD ((i + 1) % fb.poly.size) default).p o := by
    have hi1 : (i + 1) % fb.poly.size < fb.poly.size := Nat.mod_lt _ (Nat.pos_of_ne_zero
      (by intro hz; rw [hz] at hi; exact absurd hi (Nat.not_lt_zero i)))
    rw [map_getD_lt (trVtx o) fb.poly _ hi1 default default]; rfl
  rw [hia, hib]
  have hn' : planeNrm fb'.plane = smulS μ (planeNrm fb.plane) := by
    rw [← carrierNormalP_eq, ← carrierNormalP_eq]; exact hn
  refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
  · intro v hv
    exact edgePlane_sign_ss o (planeNrm fb.plane) (planeNrm fb'.plane)
      (fb.poly.getD i default).p (fb.poly.getD ((i + 1) % fb.poly.size) default).p μ hμ hn' v hv
  · intro A B hA hB
    exact edgePlane_cut_ss o (planeNrm fb.plane) (planeNrm fb'.plane)
      (fb.poly.getD i default).p (fb.poly.getD ((i + 1) % fb.poly.size) default).p μ hμ hn' A B hA hB

name: foldl_fusion_inv
statement:
theorem foldl_fusion_inv {α α' β} (mapf : β → β) (F : β → α → β) (F' : β → α' → β)
    (Inv : β → Prop) (R : α → α' → Prop)
    (hstep : ∀ a a', R a a' → ∀ acc, Inv acc → F' (mapf acc) a' = mapf (F acc a))
    (hinv : ∀ a acc, Inv acc → Inv (F acc a)) :
    ∀ {l : List α} {l' : List α'}, List.Forall₂ R l l' → ∀ init, Inv init →
      l'.foldl F' (mapf init) = mapf (l.foldl F init)
  | _, _, List.Forall₂.nil, _, _ => rfl
  | _, _, List.Forall₂.cons (a := a) (b := a') hR htl, init, hinit => by
      simp only [List.foldl_cons]
      rw [hstep a a' hR init hinit]
      exact foldl_fusion_inv mapf F F' Inv R hstep hinv htl (F init a) (hinv a init hinit)

/
opponent `fb'` is the pair-map of the untranslated coplanar clip. -/

name: coplanarClip_ss
statement:
theorem coplanarClip_ss (o : P3) (fa fb fb' : Frag) (hfa : FragFaithful fa) (hfb : FragFaithful fb)
    (μ : Rat) (hμ : 0 < μ) (hn : carrierNormalP fb' = smulS μ (carrierNormalP fb))
    (hpoly : fb'.poly = fb.poly.map (trVtx o)) :
    coplanarClip (trFrag o fa) fb' = mapPair (trFrag o) (coplanarClip fa fb)
proof:
:= by
  rw [coplanarClip_eq, coplanarClip_eq, ← Array.foldl_toList, ← Array.foldl_toList]
  have hinit : ((#[trFrag o fa], #[]) : Array Frag × Array Frag)
      = mapPair (trFrag o) (#[fa], #[]) := by simp [mapPair]
  rw [hinit]
  refine foldl_fusion_inv (mapf := mapPair (trFrag o)) (F := copStep) (F' := copStep)
    (Inv := fun acc => ∀ x ∈ acc.1, FragFaithful x) (R := EdgeShiftScale o)
    (fun a a' hR acc hInv => copStep_map o a a' acc hR hInv)
    (fun a acc hInv => copStep_faithful acc a hInv)
    (edgePlanesOf_seam o fb fb' μ hμ hn hpoly hfb) (#[fa], #[]) ?_
  intro x hx
  rw [Array.mem_def] at hx
  fin_cases hx
  exact hfa

name: dotself_nonneg
statement: theorem dotself_nonneg (u : Fin 3 → ℚ) : 0 ≤ u ⬝ᵥ u
proof:
:= by
  rw [dotProduct, Fin.sum_univ_three]
  nlinarith [sq_nonneg (u 0), sq_nonneg (u 1), sq_nonneg (u 2)]

name: dotself_pos
statement: theorem dotself_pos (u : Fin 3 → ℚ) (h : u ≠ 0) : 0 < u ⬝ᵥ u
proof:
:= by
  rcases (dotself_nonneg u).lt_or_eq with h1 | h1
  · exact h1
  · exact absurd (dotProduct_self_eq_zero.mp h1.symm) h

name: dot_cross_eq_cross_dot
statement:
theorem dot_cross_eq_cross_dot (u v r : Fin 3 → ℚ) :
    u ⬝ᵥ (crossProduct v r) = (crossProduct u v) ⬝ᵥ r
proof:
:= by
  rw [triple_product_permutation u v r, triple_product_permutation v r u, dotProduct_comm]

name: segs_meet_iff_params
statement:
theorem segs_meet_iff_params (a b c d : Fin 3 → ℚ) :
    (segment ℚ a b ∩ segment ℚ c d).Nonempty ↔
      ∃ σ τ : ℚ, 0 ≤ σ ∧ σ ≤ 1 ∧ 0 ≤ τ ∧ τ ≤ 1 ∧
        σ • (b - a) - τ • (d - c) = (c - a)
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨x, hx1, hx2⟩
    rw [segment_eq_image'] at hx1 hx2
    simp only [Set.mem_image] at hx1 hx2
    obtain ⟨σ, hσ, hσe⟩ := hx1
    obtain ⟨τ, hτ, hτe⟩ := hx2
    refine ⟨σ, τ, hσ.1, hσ.2, hτ.1, hτ.2, ?_⟩
    have : a + σ • (b - a) = c + τ • (d - c) := by rw [hσe, hτe]
    
    rw [sub_eq_iff_eq_add]
    have := this
    linear_combination (norm := module) this
  · rintro ⟨σ, τ, h0, h1, h2, h3, he⟩
    refine ⟨a + σ • (b - a), ?_, ?_⟩
    · rw [segment_eq_image']; exact ⟨σ, ⟨h0, h1⟩, rfl⟩
    · rw [segment_eq_image']
      refine ⟨τ, ⟨h2, h3⟩, ?_⟩
      
      show c + τ • (d - c) = a + σ • (b - a)
      have := he
      linear_combination (norm := module) (-he)

name: mem_segment_iff_param
statement:
theorem mem_segment_iff_param (a b p : Fin 3 → ℚ) :
    p ∈ segment ℚ a b ↔ ∃ θ : ℚ, 0 ≤ θ ∧ θ ≤ 1 ∧ p = a + θ • (b - a)
proof:
:= by
  rw [segment_eq_image']
  simp only [Set.mem_image, Set.mem_Icc]
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨θ, hθ, rfl⟩; exact ⟨θ, hθ.1, hθ.2, rfl⟩
  · rintro ⟨θ, h0, h1, rfl⟩; exact ⟨θ, ⟨h0, h1⟩, rfl⟩

name: mem_segment_iff_cross_dot
statement:
theorem mem_segment_iff_cross_dot (A B P : Fin 3 → ℚ) (hU : B - A ≠ 0) :
    P ∈ segment ℚ A B ↔
      (crossProduct (P - A) (B - A) = 0 ∧
        0 ≤ (B - A) ⬝ᵥ (P - A) ∧ (B - A) ⬝ᵥ (P - A) ≤ (B - A) ⬝ᵥ (B - A))
proof:
:= by
  rw [mem_segment_iff_param]
  set U := B - A with hUdef
  set W := P - A with hWdef
  have hUU : 0 < U ⬝ᵥ U := dotself_pos U hU
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨θ, h0, h1, hP⟩
    have hW : W = θ • U := by rw [hWdef, hP]; ring
    refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_⟩
    · rw [hW, LinearMap.map_smul₂, cross_self, smul_zero]
    · rw [hW, dotProduct_smul, smul_eq_mul]; positivity
    · rw [hW, dotProduct_smul, smul_eq_mul]; nlinarith [hUU, h1]
  · rintro ⟨hcross, hlo, hhi⟩
    have hWspan : W ∈ Submodule.span ℚ {U} := by
      rw [mem_span_singleton_iff_cross_zero W U hU]; exact hcross
    rw [Submodule.mem_span_singleton] at hWspan
    obtain ⟨θ, hθ⟩ := hWspan
    have hdotW : U ⬝ᵥ W = θ * (U ⬝ᵥ U) := by rw [← hθ, dotProduct_smul, smul_eq_mul]
    refine ⟨θ, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
    · rw [hdotW] at hlo; nlinarith [hUU]
    · rw [hdotW] at hhi; nlinarith [hUU]
    · have hθ' : θ • U = P - A := hθ; linear_combination (norm := module) -hθ'

name: ptOnSeg_iff
statement:
theorem ptOnSeg_iff (p a b : I3) :
    ptOnSeg p a b = true ↔ (decI p) ∈ segment ℚ (decI a) (decI b)
proof:
:= by
  unfold ptOnSeg
  by_cases hU : isZeroI (subI b a) = true
  · 
    rw [if_pos hU]
    have hUeq : decI b - decI a = 0 := by rw [← decI_sub]; exact (decI_isZero _).mp hU
    have hab : decI a = decI b := (sub_eq_zero.mp hUeq).symm
    rw [decI_beq, hab, segment_same, Set.mem_singleton_iff]
  · rw [if_neg hU]
    have hUne : decI b - decI a ≠ 0 := by
      rw [← decI_sub]; intro h; exact hU ((decI_isZero _).mpr h)
    rw [mem_segment_iff_cross_dot _ _ _ hUne]
    
    have hcross : isZeroI (crossI (subI p a) (subI b a)) = true
        ↔ crossProduct (decI p - decI a) (decI b - decI a) = 0 := by
      rw [decI_isZero, decI_cross, decI_sub, decI_sub]
    have hdotbp : (decI b - decI a) ⬝ᵥ (decI p - decI a)
        = ((dotI (subI b a) (subI p a) : ℤ) : ℚ) := by
      rw [← decI_sub b a, ← decI_sub p a, ← decI_dot]
    have hdotbb : (decI b - decI a) ⬝ᵥ (decI b - decI a)
        = ((dotI (subI b a) (subI b a) : ℤ) : ℚ) := by
      rw [← decI_sub b a, ← decI_dot]
    have hlo : decide (0 ≤ dotI (subI b a) (subI p a)) = true
        ↔ 0 ≤ (decI b - decI a) ⬝ᵥ (decI p - decI a) := by
      rw [decide_eq_true_iff, hdotbp, show (0:ℚ) = ((0:ℤ):ℚ) by norm_num, Int.cast_le]
    have hhi : decide (dotI (subI b a) (subI p a) ≤ dotI (subI b a) (subI b a)) = true
        ↔ (decI b - decI a) ⬝ᵥ (decI p - decI a) ≤ (decI b - decI a) ⬝ᵥ (decI b - decI a) := by
      rw [decide_eq_true_iff, hdotbp, hdotbb, Int.cast_le]
    rw [Bool.and_eq_true, Bool.and_eq_true, hcross, hlo, hhi, and_assoc]

name: cramer_fwd
statement:
theorem cramer_fwd (U V R : Fin 3 → ℚ) (σ τ : ℚ) (he : σ • U - τ • V = R) :
    σ * ((crossProduct U V) ⬝ᵥ (crossProduct U V)) = (crossProduct R V) ⬝ᵥ (crossProduct U V) ∧
    τ * ((crossProduct U V) ⬝ᵥ (crossProduct U V)) = (crossProduct R U) ⬝ᵥ (crossProduct U V)
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · have hrv : crossProduct R V = σ • crossProduct U V := by
      rw [← he, show (σ • U - τ • V) = (σ • U) + (-(τ • V)) by ring,
         LinearMap.map_add₂, LinearMap.map_smul₂, LinearMap.map_neg₂, LinearMap.map_smul₂, cross_self]
      simp
    rw [hrv, smul_dotProduct, smul_eq_mul]
  · have hru : crossProduct R U = τ • crossProduct U V := by
      rw [← he, show (σ • U - τ • V) = (σ • U) + (-(τ • V)) by ring,
         LinearMap.map_add₂, LinearMap.map_smul₂, LinearMap.map_neg₂, LinearMap.map_smul₂, cross_self]
      rw [smul_zero, zero_add, ← cross_anticomm]; module
    rw [hru, smul_dotProduct, smul_eq_mul]

name: meet_A_point
statement:
theorem meet_A_point (A C D : Fin 3 → ℚ) :
    (segment ℚ A A ∩ segment ℚ C D).Nonempty ↔ A ∈ segment ℚ C D
proof:
:= by
  rw [segment_same]
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨x, hx1, hx2⟩; rw [Set.mem_singleton_iff] at hx1; rwa [hx1] at hx2
  · intro h; exact ⟨A, Set.mem_singleton A, h⟩

name: meet_C_point
statement:
theorem meet_C_point (A B C : Fin 3 → ℚ) :
    (segment ℚ A B ∩ segment ℚ C C).Nonempty ↔ C ∈ segment ℚ A B
proof:
:= by
  rw [segment_same]
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨x, hx1, hx2⟩; rw [Set.mem_singleton_iff] at hx2; rwa [hx2] at hx1
  · intro h; exact ⟨C, h, Set.mem_singleton C⟩

name: no_meet_skew
statement:
theorem no_meet_skew (U V R : Fin 3 → ℚ) (hdet : U ⬝ᵥ (crossProduct V R) ≠ 0) :
    ¬ ∃ σ τ : ℚ, σ • U - τ • V = R
proof:
:= by
  rintro ⟨σ, τ, he⟩
  apply hdet
  rw [dot_cross_eq_cross_dot, ← he, dotProduct_sub, dotProduct_smul, dotProduct_smul,
      show (crossProduct U V) ⬝ᵥ U = 0 by rw [dotProduct_comm]; exact dot_self_cross U V,
      show (crossProduct U V) ⬝ᵥ V = 0 by rw [dotProduct_comm]; exact dot_cross_self U V]
  simp

name: no_meet_parallel
statement:
theorem no_meet_parallel (U V R : Fin 3 → ℚ) (hU : U ≠ 0)
    (hUV : crossProduct U V = 0) (hRU : crossProduct R U ≠ 0) :
    ¬ ∃ σ τ : ℚ, σ • U - τ • V = R
proof:
:= by
  rintro ⟨σ, τ, he⟩
  apply hRU
  have hVspan : V ∈ Submodule.span ℚ {U} := by
    rw [mem_span_singleton_iff_cross_zero V U hU, ← neg_cross, hUV, neg_zero]
  rw [Submodule.mem_span_singleton] at hVspan
  obtain ⟨μ, hμ⟩ := hVspan
  have hR : R = (σ - τ * μ) • U := by rw [← he, ← hμ]; module
  rw [hR, LinearMap.map_smul₂, cross_self, smul_zero]

name: coplanar_solve
statement:
theorem coplanar_solve (U V R : Fin 3 → ℚ) (hM : crossProduct U V ≠ 0)
    (hdet : U ⬝ᵥ (crossProduct V R) = 0) (σ τ : ℚ) :
    σ • U - τ • V = R ↔
      (σ * ((crossProduct U V) ⬝ᵥ (crossProduct U V)) = (crossProduct R V) ⬝ᵥ (crossProduct U V) ∧
       τ * ((crossProduct U V) ⬝ᵥ (crossProduct U V)) = (crossProduct R U) ⬝ᵥ (crossProduct U V))
proof:
:= by
  set M := crossProduct U V with hMdef
  set ww := M ⬝ᵥ M with hww
  have hwwpos : 0 < ww := dotself_pos M hM
  constructor
  · intro he; exact cramer_fwd U V R σ τ he
  · rintro ⟨hs, ht⟩
    have hRspan : R ∈ Submodule.span ℚ {U, V} := by
      rw [mem_span_pair_iff_dot_cross_zero U V R hM, ← dot_cross_eq_cross_dot]; exact hdet
    rw [Submodule.mem_span_pair] at hRspan
    obtain ⟨α, β, hαβ⟩ := hRspan
    have hsol : α • U - (-β) • V = R := by rw [← hαβ]; module
    obtain ⟨hα, hβ⟩ := cramer_fwd U V R α (-β) hsol
    have hαeq : α = σ := by
      have : α * ww = σ * ww := by rw [hα, ← hMdef, hs]
      exact mul_right_cancel₀ (ne_of_gt hwwpos) this
    have hβeq : -β = τ := by
      have : (-β) * ww = τ * ww := by rw [hβ, ← hMdef, ht]
      exact mul_right_cancel₀ (ne_of_gt hwwpos) this
    rw [hαeq, hβeq] at hsol; exact hsol

name: meet_coplanar_iff
statement:
theorem meet_coplanar_iff (U V R : Fin 3 → ℚ) (hM : crossProduct U V ≠ 0)
    (hdet : U ⬝ᵥ (crossProduct V R) = 0) :
    (∃ σ τ : ℚ, 0 ≤ σ ∧ σ ≤ 1 ∧ 0 ≤ τ ∧ τ ≤ 1 ∧ σ • U - τ • V = R) ↔
      ((0 ≤ (crossProduct R V) ⬝ᵥ (crossProduct U V) ∧
          (crossProduct R V) ⬝ᵥ (crossProduct U V) ≤ (crossProduct U V) ⬝ᵥ (crossProduct U V)) ∧
       (0 ≤ (crossProduct R U) ⬝ᵥ (crossProduct U V) ∧
          (crossProduct R U) ⬝ᵥ (crossProduct U V) ≤ (crossProduct U V) ⬝ᵥ (crossProduct U V)))
proof:
:= by
  set ww := (crossProduct U V) ⬝ᵥ (crossProduct U V) with hww
  set sn := (crossProduct R V) ⬝ᵥ (crossProduct U V) with hsn
  set tn := (crossProduct R U) ⬝ᵥ (crossProduct U V) with htn
  have hwwpos : 0 < ww := dotself_pos _ hM
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨σ, τ, hσ0, hσ1, hτ0, hτ1, he⟩
    obtain ⟨hs, ht⟩ := (coplanar_solve U V R hM hdet σ τ).mp he
    rw [← hww, ← hsn] at hs
    rw [← hww, ← htn] at ht
    refine ⟨⟨?_, ?_⟩, ?_, ?_⟩
    · rw [← hs]; positivity
    · rw [← hs]; nlinarith
    · rw [← ht]; positivity
    · rw [← ht]; nlinarith
  · rintro ⟨⟨hs0, hs1⟩, ht0, ht1⟩
    refine ⟨sn / ww, tn / ww, by positivity, by rw [div_le_one hwwpos]; exact hs1,
      by positivity, by rw [div_le_one hwwpos]; exact ht1, ?_⟩
    rw [coplanar_solve U V R hM hdet, ← hww, ← hsn, ← htn]
    exact ⟨div_mul_cancel₀ sn (ne_of_gt hwwpos), div_mul_cancel₀ tn (ne_of_gt hwwpos)⟩

name: collinear_scalar
statement:
theorem collinear_scalar (U V R : Fin 3 → ℚ) (hU : U ≠ 0)
    (hUV : crossProduct U V = 0) (hRU : crossProduct R U = 0) (σ τ : ℚ) :
    σ • U - τ • V = R ↔ σ * (U ⬝ᵥ U) - τ * (U ⬝ᵥ V) = U ⬝ᵥ R
proof:
:= by
  have hVspan : V ∈ Submodule.span ℚ {U} := by
    rw [mem_span_singleton_iff_cross_zero V U hU, ← neg_cross, hUV, neg_zero]
  rw [Submodule.mem_span_singleton] at hVspan; obtain ⟨ν, hν⟩ := hVspan
  have hRspan : R ∈ Submodule.span ℚ {U} := by
    rw [mem_span_singleton_iff_cross_zero R U hU]; exact hRU
  rw [Submodule.mem_span_singleton] at hRspan; obtain ⟨ρ, hρ⟩ := hRspan
  have ht1 : 0 < U ⬝ᵥ U := dotself_pos U hU
  have hUV' : U ⬝ᵥ V = ν * (U ⬝ᵥ U) := by rw [← hν, dotProduct_smul, smul_eq_mul]
  have hUR' : U ⬝ᵥ R = ρ * (U ⬝ᵥ U) := by rw [← hρ, dotProduct_smul, smul_eq_mul]
  have hvec : (σ • U - τ • V = R) ↔ (σ - τ * ν - ρ) = 0 := by
    rw [← hν, ← hρ]
    constructor
    · intro he
      have hz : (σ - τ * ν - ρ) • U = 0 := by linear_combination (norm := module) he
      rcases smul_eq_zero.mp hz with h | h
      · exact h
      · exact absurd h hU
    · intro he
      have : (σ - τ * ν - ρ) • U = 0 := by rw [he, zero_smul]
      linear_combination (norm := module) this
  rw [hvec, hUV', hUR']
  constructor
  · intro he; nlinarith [he]
  · intro he
    have : (σ - τ * ν - ρ) * (U ⬝ᵥ U) = 0 := by nlinarith [he]
    rcases mul_eq_zero.mp this with h | h
    · exact h
    · exact absurd h (ne_of_gt ht1)

name: interval_overlap
statement:
theorem interval_overlap (t1 s0 s1 : ℚ) (ht1 : 0 < t1) :
    (∃ σ τ : ℚ, (0 ≤ σ ∧ σ ≤ 1) ∧ (0 ≤ τ ∧ τ ≤ 1) ∧ σ * t1 = s0 + τ * (s1 - s0)) ↔
      (min s0 s1 ≤ t1 ∧ 0 ≤ max s0 s1)
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨σ, τ, ⟨hσ0, hσ1⟩, ⟨hτ0, hτ1⟩, he⟩
    refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
    · rcases le_total s0 s1 with hle | hle
      · rw [min_eq_left hle]; nlinarith [he, hτ0, hσ1, mul_nonneg hτ0 (by linarith : (0:ℚ) ≤ s1 - s0)]
      · rw [min_eq_right hle]; nlinarith [he, hσ1, mul_nonneg hτ0 (by linarith : (0:ℚ) ≤ s0 - s1)]
    · rcases le_total s0 s1 with hle | hle
      · rw [max_eq_right hle]; nlinarith [he, hσ0, mul_nonneg hτ0 (by linarith : (0:ℚ) ≤ s1 - s0), ht1]
      · rw [max_eq_left hle]; nlinarith [he, hσ0, hτ1, ht1, hle]
  · rintro ⟨hlo, hhi⟩
    have hlohi : min s0 s1 ≤ max s0 s1 := min_le_max
    set y := max 0 (min s0 s1) with hy
    have hy0 : 0 ≤ y := le_max_left _ _
    have hylo : min s0 s1 ≤ y := le_max_right _ _
    have hyt1 : y ≤ t1 := max_le (le_of_lt ht1) hlo
    have hyhi : y ≤ max s0 s1 := max_le hhi hlohi
    have hσrange : 0 ≤ y / t1 ∧ y / t1 ≤ 1 := ⟨by positivity, by rw [div_le_one ht1]; exact hyt1⟩
    by_cases hs : s1 = s0
    · subst hs
      simp only [min_self, max_self] at hylo hyhi
      have hyeq : y = s1 := le_antisymm hyhi hylo
      refine ⟨y / t1, 0, hσrange, ⟨le_refl 0, zero_le_one⟩, ?_⟩
      rw [div_mul_cancel₀ _ (ne_of_gt ht1)]; simp [hyeq]
    · have hne : s1 - s0 ≠ 0 := sub_ne_zero.mpr hs
      refine ⟨y / t1, (y - s0)/(s1 - s0), hσrange, ⟨?_, ?_⟩, ?_⟩
      · rcases lt_or_gt_of_ne hs with hlt | hgt
        · rw [min_eq_right (le_of_lt hlt)] at hylo
          rw [max_eq_left (le_of_lt hlt)] at hyhi
          exact div_nonneg_of_nonpos (by linarith) (by linarith)
        · rw [min_eq_left (le_of_lt hgt)] at hylo
          rw [max_eq_right (le_of_lt hgt)] at hyhi
          exact div_nonneg (by linarith) (by linarith)
      · rcases lt_or_gt_of_ne hs with hlt | hgt
        · rw [min_eq_right (le_of_lt hlt)] at hylo
          rw [max_eq_left (le_of_lt hlt)] at hyhi
          rw [div_le_one_iff]; right; right; exact ⟨by linarith, by linarith⟩
        · rw [min_eq_left (le_of_lt hgt)] at hylo
          rw [max_eq_right (le_of_lt hgt)] at hyhi
          rw [div_le_one_iff]; left; exact ⟨by linarith, by linarith⟩
      · rw [div_mul_cancel₀ _ (ne_of_gt ht1), div_mul_cancel₀ _ hne]; ring

name: meet_collinear_iff
statement:
theorem meet_collinear_iff (A B C D : Fin 3 → ℚ) (hU : B - A ≠ 0)
    (hUV : crossProduct (B - A) (D - C) = 0) (hRU : crossProduct (C - A) (B - A) = 0) :
    (∃ σ τ : ℚ, 0 ≤ σ ∧ σ ≤ 1 ∧ 0 ≤ τ ∧ τ ≤ 1 ∧
        σ • (B - A) - τ • (D - C) = (C - A)) ↔
      (min ((B - A) ⬝ᵥ (C - A)) ((B - A) ⬝ᵥ (D - A)) ≤ (B - A) ⬝ᵥ (B - A) ∧
        0 ≤ max ((B - A) ⬝ᵥ (C - A)) ((B - A) ⬝ᵥ (D - A)))
proof:
:= by
  set U := B - A with hUdef
  have ht1 : 0 < U ⬝ᵥ U := dotself_pos U hU
  have hUVR : U ⬝ᵥ (D - C) = U ⬝ᵥ (D - A) - U ⬝ᵥ (C - A) := by
    rw [← dotProduct_sub]; congr 1; abel
  have hbody : ∀ σ τ : ℚ, (σ • U - τ • (D - C) = (C - A)) ↔
      (σ * (U ⬝ᵥ U) = (U ⬝ᵥ (C - A)) + τ * ((U ⬝ᵥ (D - A)) - (U ⬝ᵥ (C - A)))) := by
    intro σ τ; rw [collinear_scalar U (D - C) (C - A) hU hUV hRU, hUVR]
    constructor <;> intro h <;> linarith [h]
  have hstep : (∃ σ τ : ℚ, 0 ≤ σ ∧ σ ≤ 1 ∧ 0 ≤ τ ∧ τ ≤ 1 ∧
        σ • U - τ • (D - C) = (C - A)) ↔
      (∃ σ τ : ℚ, (0 ≤ σ ∧ σ ≤ 1) ∧ (0 ≤ τ ∧ τ ≤ 1) ∧
          σ * (U ⬝ᵥ U) = (U ⬝ᵥ (C - A)) + τ * ((U ⬝ᵥ (D - A)) - (U ⬝ᵥ (C - A)))) := by
    apply exists_congr; intro σ; apply exists_congr; intro τ
    rw [hbody σ τ]; tauto
  rw [hstep, interval_overlap (U ⬝ᵥ U) (U ⬝ᵥ (C - A)) (U ⬝ᵥ (D - A)) ht1]

name: imin_cast
statement: theorem imin_cast (a b : ℤ) : ((imin a b : ℤ) : ℚ) = min (a : ℚ) (b : ℚ)
proof:
:= by
  unfold imin; split
  · rw [min_eq_left]; exact_mod_cast ‹a ≤ b›
  · rw [min_eq_right]; push_neg at *; exact_mod_cast le_of_lt ‹b < a›

name: imax_cast
statement: theorem imax_cast (a b : ℤ) : ((imax a b : ℤ) : ℚ) = max (a : ℚ) (b : ℚ)
proof:
:= by
  unfold imax; split
  · rw [max_eq_right]; exact_mod_cast ‹a ≤ b›
  · rw [max_eq_left]; push_neg at *; exact_mod_cast le_of_lt ‹b < a›

name: det3I_ne_zero_iff
statement:
theorem det3I_ne_zero_iff (u v r : I3) :
    (det3I u v r != 0) = true ↔ (decI u) ⬝ᵥ (crossProduct (decI v) (decI r)) ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [bne_iff_ne, ne_eq, ne_eq, ← decI_det3, Int.cast_eq_zero]

name: segsIntersect_iff
statement:
theorem segsIntersect_iff (a b c d : I3) :
    segsIntersect a b c d = true ↔
      (segment ℚ (decI a) (decI b) ∩ segment ℚ (decI c) (decI d)).Nonempty
proof:
:= by
  
  set A := decI a with hAdef
  set B := decI b with hBdef
  set C := decI c with hCdef
  set D := decI d with hDdef
  
  have hu : decI (subI b a) = B - A := by rw [decI_sub]
  have hv : decI (subI d c) = D - C := by rw [decI_sub]
  have hr : decI (subI c a) = C - A := by rw [decI_sub]
  
  rw [segs_meet_iff_params A B C D]
  
  have hUz : isZeroI (subI b a) = true ↔ B - A = 0 := by rw [decI_isZero, hu]
  have hVz : isZeroI (subI d c) = true ↔ D - C = 0 := by rw [decI_isZero, hv]
  by_cases hU : isZeroI (subI b a) = true
  · 
    have hUeq : B - A = 0 := hUz.mp hU
    have hAB : A = B := (sub_eq_zero.mp hUeq).symm
    by_cases hV : isZeroI (subI d c) = true
    · 
      have hVeq : D - C = 0 := hVz.mp hV
      have hCD : C = D := (sub_eq_zero.mp hVeq).symm
      have hcomp : segsIntersect a b c d = beqI a c := by
        simp only [segsIntersect, hU, hV, Bool.and_self, if_true]
      rw [hcomp, decI_beq, ← hAdef, ← hCdef]
      
      constructor
      · intro h
        refine ⟨0, 0, le_refl 0, zero_le_one, le_refl 0, zero_le_one, ?_⟩
        simp only [hUeq, hVeq, smul_zero, sub_zero]
        rw [h]; abel
      · rintro ⟨σ, τ, _, _, _, _, he⟩
        simp only [hUeq, hVeq, smul_zero, sub_zero] at he
        exact (sub_eq_zero.mp he.symm).symm
    · 
      have hVf : isZeroI (subI d c) = false := Bool.not_eq_true _ ▸ hV
      have hcomp : segsIntersect a b c d = ptOnSeg a c d := by
        simp only [segsIntersect, hU, hVf, Bool.and_false, Bool.false_eq_true, if_false, if_true]
      rw [hcomp, ptOnSeg_iff, ← hAdef, ← hCdef, ← hDdef, ← meet_A_point A C D,
        show segment ℚ A A = segment ℚ A B by rw [hAB], segs_meet_iff_params A B C D]
  · 
    have hUne : B - A ≠ 0 := fun h => hU (hUz.mpr h)
    have hUf : isZeroI (subI b a) = false := Bool.not_eq_true _ ▸ hU
    by_cases hV : isZeroI (subI d c) = true
    · 
      have hVeq : D - C = 0 := hVz.mp hV
      have hCD : C = D := (sub_eq_zero.mp hVeq).symm
      have hcomp : segsIntersect a b c d = ptOnSeg c a b := by
        simp only [segsIntersect, hUf, hV, Bool.false_and, Bool.false_eq_true, if_false, if_true]
      rw [hcomp, ptOnSeg_iff, ← hAdef, ← hBdef, ← hCdef, ← meet_C_point A B C,
        show segment ℚ C C = segment ℚ C D by rw [hCD], segs_meet_iff_params A B C D]
    · 
      have hVf : isZeroI (subI d c) = false := Bool.not_eq_true _ ▸ hV
      
      have hw : decI (crossI (subI b a) (subI d c)) = crossProduct (B - A) (D - C) := by
        rw [decI_cross, hu, hv]
      have hru' : decI (crossI (subI c a) (subI b a)) = crossProduct (C - A) (B - A) := by
        rw [decI_cross, hr, hu]
      have hdetbridge : (det3I (subI b a) (subI d c) (subI c a) != 0) = true ↔
          (B - A) ⬝ᵥ (crossProduct (D - C) (C - A)) ≠ 0 := by
        rw [det3I_ne_zero_iff, hu, hv, hr]
      by_cases hdet : (det3I (subI b a) (subI d c) (subI c a) != 0) = true
      · 
        have hdet' : (B - A) ⬝ᵥ (crossProduct (D - C) (C - A)) ≠ 0 := hdetbridge.mp hdet
        have hcomp : segsIntersect a b c d = false := by
          simp only [segsIntersect, hUf, hVf, Bool.false_and, Bool.and_false,
            Bool.false_eq_true, Bool.not_true, Bool.not_false, if_false, hdet, if_true]
        rw [hcomp]
        constructor
        · intro h; exact absurd h Bool.false_ne_true
        · rintro ⟨σ, τ, _, _, _, _, he⟩
          exact absurd ⟨σ, τ, he⟩ (no_meet_skew (B - A) (D - C) (C - A) hdet')
      · 
        have hdetf : (det3I (subI b a) (subI d c) (subI c a) != 0) = false :=
          Bool.not_eq_true _ ▸ hdet
        have hdet0 : (B - A) ⬝ᵥ (crossProduct (D - C) (C - A)) = 0 :=
          not_not.mp (fun h => hdet (hdetbridge.mpr h))
        by_cases hcr : isZeroI (crossI (subI b a) (subI d c)) = true
        · 
          have hMzero : crossProduct (B - A) (D - C) = 0 := by
            rw [← hw]; exact (decI_isZero _).mp hcr
          by_cases hcru : isZeroI (crossI (subI c a) (subI b a)) = true
          · 
            have hRUzero : crossProduct (C - A) (B - A) = 0 := by
              rw [← hru']; exact (decI_isZero _).mp hcru
            have hcomp : segsIntersect a b c d =
                (decide (imin (dotI (subI b a) (subI c a)) (dotI (subI b a) (subI d a))
                    ≤ dotI (subI b a) (subI b a)) &&
                  decide (0 ≤ imax (dotI (subI b a) (subI c a)) (dotI (subI b a) (subI d a)))) := by
              simp only [segsIntersect, hUf, hVf, Bool.false_and, Bool.and_false,
                Bool.false_eq_true, Bool.not_true, Bool.not_false, if_false, hdetf, hcr, hcru, if_true]
            rw [hcomp, meet_collinear_iff A B C D hUne hMzero hRUzero,
              Bool.and_eq_true, decide_eq_true_iff, decide_eq_true_iff]
            
            have hd1 : (B - A) ⬝ᵥ (C - A) = ((dotI (subI b a) (subI c a) : ℤ) : ℚ) := by
              rw [← hu, ← hr, ← decI_dot]
            have hd2 : (B - A) ⬝ᵥ (D - A) = ((dotI (subI b a) (subI d a) : ℤ) : ℚ) := by
              rw [← hu, show D - A = decI (subI d a) by rw [decI_sub], ← decI_dot]
            have hd3 : (B - A) ⬝ᵥ (B - A) = ((dotI (subI b a) (subI b a) : ℤ) : ℚ) := by
              rw [← hu, ← decI_dot]
            rw [hd1, hd2, hd3, ← imin_cast, ← imax_cast, Int.cast_le,
              show (0 : ℚ) = ((0 : ℤ) : ℚ) by norm_num, Int.cast_le]
          · 
            have hRUne : crossProduct (C - A) (B - A) ≠ 0 := by
              rw [← hru']; intro h; exact hcru ((decI_isZero _).mpr h)
            have hcruf : isZeroI (crossI (subI c a) (subI b a)) = false :=
              Bool.not_eq_true _ ▸ hcru
            have hcomp : segsIntersect a b c d = false := by
              simp only [segsIntersect, hUf, hVf, Bool.false_and, Bool.and_false,
                Bool.false_eq_true, Bool.not_true, Bool.not_false, if_false, hdetf, hcr, hcruf, if_true]
            rw [hcomp]
            constructor
            · intro h; exact absurd h Bool.false_ne_true
            · rintro ⟨σ, τ, _, _, _, _, he⟩
              exact absurd ⟨σ, τ, he⟩ (no_meet_parallel (B - A) (D - C) (C - A) hUne hMzero hRUne)
        · 
          have hMne : crossProduct (B - A) (D - C) ≠ 0 := by
            rw [← hw]; intro h; exact hcr ((decI_isZero _).mpr h)
          have hcrf : isZeroI (crossI (subI b a) (subI d c)) = false :=
            Bool.not_eq_true _ ▸ hcr
          have hcomp : segsIntersect a b c d =
              (decide (0 ≤ dotI (crossI (subI c a) (subI d c)) (crossI (subI b a) (subI d c))) &&
                decide (dotI (crossI (subI c a) (subI d c)) (crossI (subI b a) (subI d c)) ≤
                  dotI (crossI (subI b a) (subI d c)) (crossI (subI b a) (subI d c))) &&
                decide (0 ≤ dotI (crossI (subI c a) (subI b a)) (crossI (subI b a) (subI d c))) &&
                decide (dotI (crossI (subI c a) (subI b a)) (crossI (subI b a) (subI d c)) ≤
                  dotI (crossI (subI b a) (subI d c)) (crossI (subI b a) (subI d c)))) := by
            simp only [segsIntersect, hUf, hVf, Bool.false_and, Bool.and_false,
              Bool.false_eq_true, Bool.not_true, Bool.not_false, if_false, hdetf, hcrf, if_true]
          rw [hcomp]
          
          rw [meet_coplanar_iff (B - A) (D - C) (C - A) hMne hdet0]
          
          have hd_ww : (crossProduct (B - A) (D - C)) ⬝ᵥ (crossProduct (B - A) (D - C))
              = ((dotI (crossI (subI b a) (subI d c)) (crossI (subI b a) (subI d c)) : ℤ) : ℚ) := by
            rw [← hw, ← decI_dot]
          have hd_sn : (crossProduct (C - A) (D - C)) ⬝ᵥ (crossProduct (B - A) (D - C))
              = ((dotI (crossI (subI c a) (subI d c)) (crossI (subI b a) (subI d c)) : ℤ) : ℚ) := by
            rw [← hw, show crossProduct (C - A) (D - C) = decI (crossI (subI c a) (subI d c)) by
              rw [decI_cross, hr, hv], ← decI_dot]
          have hd_tn : (crossProduct (C - A) (B - A)) ⬝ᵥ (crossProduct (B - A) (D - C))
              = ((dotI (crossI (subI c a) (subI b a)) (crossI (subI b a) (subI d c)) : ℤ) : ℚ) := by
            rw [← hw, ← hru', ← decI_dot]
          rw [hd_ww, hd_sn, hd_tn]
          rw [Bool.and_eq_true, Bool.and_eq_true, Bool.and_eq_true,
            decide_eq_true_iff, decide_eq_true_iff, decide_eq_true_iff, decide_eq_true_iff]
          rw [show ((0 : ℤ) ≤ dotI (crossI (subI c a) (subI d c)) (crossI (subI b a) (subI d c)))
              ↔ (0 : ℚ) ≤ ((dotI (crossI (subI c a) (subI d c)) (crossI (subI b a) (subI d c)) : ℤ) : ℚ)
            from by rw [show (0:ℚ) = ((0:ℤ):ℚ) by norm_num, Int.cast_le],
            show ((dotI (crossI (subI c a) (subI d c)) (crossI (subI b a) (subI d c)))
                ≤ dotI (crossI (subI b a) (subI d c)) (crossI (subI b a) (subI d c)))
              ↔ ((dotI (crossI (subI c a) (subI d c)) (crossI (subI b a) (subI d c)) : ℤ) : ℚ)
                ≤ ((dotI (crossI (subI b a) (subI d c)) (crossI (subI b a) (subI d c)) : ℤ) : ℚ)
            from by rw [Int.cast_le],
            show ((0 : ℤ) ≤ dotI (crossI (subI c a) (subI b a)) (crossI (subI b a) (subI d c)))
              ↔ (0 : ℚ) ≤ ((dotI (crossI (subI c a) (subI b a)) (crossI (subI b a) (subI d c)) : ℤ) : ℚ)
            from by rw [show (0:ℚ) = ((0:ℤ):ℚ) by norm_num, Int.cast_le],
            show ((dotI (crossI (subI c a) (subI b a)) (crossI (subI b a) (subI d c)))
                ≤ dotI (crossI (subI b a) (subI d c)) (crossI (subI b a) (subI d c)))
              ↔ ((dotI (crossI (subI c a) (subI b a)) (crossI (subI b a) (subI d c)) : ℤ) : ℚ)
                ≤ ((dotI (crossI (subI b a) (subI d c)) (crossI (subI b a) (subI d c)) : ℤ) : ℚ)
            from by rw [Int.cast_le],
            and_assoc]

name: foldl_measure_mono
statement:
theorem foldl_measure_mono {α β} (μ : β → Nat) (F : β → α → β) (hmono : ∀ b a, μ b ≤ μ (F b a)) :
    ∀ (l : List α) (init : β), μ init ≤ μ (l.foldl F init)
  | [], _ => le_refl _
  | a :: l, init => le_trans (hmono init a) (foldl_measure_mono μ F hmono l (F init a))

/
fold is positive. -/

name: foldl_measure_pos
statement:
theorem foldl_measure_pos {α β} (μ : β → Nat) (F : β → α → β) (hmono : ∀ b a, μ b ≤ μ (F b a))
    (a₀ : α) (hpos : ∀ b, 0 < μ (F b a₀)) :
    ∀ (l : List α), a₀ ∈ l → ∀ (init : β), 0 < μ (l.foldl F init)
  | [], h, _ => absurd h (List.not_mem_nil a₀)
  | a :: l, h, init => by
      rcases List.mem_cons.mp h with rfl | h'
      · exact Nat.lt_of_lt_of_le (hpos init) (foldl_measure_mono μ F hmono l (F init a₀))
      · exact foldl_measure_pos μ F hmono a₀ hpos l h' (F init a)

/
`cstep` is `irreducible`, so cannot be unfolded for the monotonicity argument). -/
def myCstep (g : IPlane) (poly : Array Vtx)
    (signs : Array Int) (r : Nat)
    (st : Array Vtx × Array Vtx) (i : Nat) :
    Array Vtx × Array Vtx
proof:
:=
  let (pV, nV) := st
  let a := poly.getD i default
  let sa := signs.getD i 0
  let sb := signs.getD ((i + 1) % r) 0
  if 0 ≤ sa then
    if sb < 0 then
      if 0 < sa then
        let b := poly.getD ((i + 1) % r) default
        let X := cutVtx g a b
        (pV.push a |>.push X, nV.push X)
      else
        (pV.push a, nV.push a)
    else
      if sa == 0 then
        (pV.push a, nV.push a)
      else
        (pV.push a, nV)
  else
    if 0 < sb then
      let b := poly.getD ((i + 1) % r) default
      let X := cutVtx g a b
      (pV.push X, nV.push a |>.push X)
    else
      (pV, nV.push a)

name: myCstep_pv_mono
statement:
theorem myCstep_pv_mono (g : IPlane) (poly : Array Vtx)
    (signs : Array Int) (r : Nat) (st : Array Vtx × Array Vtx)
    (i : Nat) : st.1.size ≤ (myCstep g poly signs r st i).1.size
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨pV, nV⟩ := st
  simp only [myCstep]
  split_ifs <;> simp only [Array.size_push] <;> omega

name: any_get_index
statement:
theorem any_get_index {p : Int → Bool} (signs : Array Int) (h : signs.any p = true) :
    ∃ i, i < signs.size ∧ p (signs.getD i 0) = true
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨⟨i, hi⟩, hpi⟩ := Array.any_eq_true.mp h
  exact ⟨i, hi, by rw [getD_getElem signs i hi 0]; exact hpi⟩

name: clipFrag_poly_pos
statement:
theorem clipFrag_poly_pos (g : IPlane) (f : Frag) (hf : 0 < f.poly.size) :
    ∀ f' ∈ clipFrag g f, 0 < f'.poly.size
proof:
:= by
  intro f' hf'
  simp only [clipFrag] at hf'
  split_ifs at hf' with hcond
  · rw [Array.mem_singleton] at hf'; rw [hf']; exact hf
  · set signs := f.poly.map (fun v => signI g v.h) with hsigns
    have hsz : signs.size = f.poly.size := by rw [hsigns, Array.size_map]
    have hPQ : (signs.any (fun s => decide (0 < s)) && signs.any (fun s => decide (s < 0))) = true := by
      cases hPQ' : signs.any (fun s => decide (0 < s)) && signs.any (fun s => decide (s < 0))
      · rw [hPQ'] at hcond; simp at hcond
      · rfl
    rw [Bool.and_eq_true] at hPQ
    obtain ⟨hAny, hAnyN⟩ := hPQ
    obtain ⟨iP, hiP, hpP⟩ := any_get_index signs hAny
    obtain ⟨iN, hiN, hpN⟩ := any_get_index signs hAnyN
    rw [Array.mem_def] at hf'
    fin_cases hf'
    · show 0 < ((Array.range f.poly.size).foldl
          (myCstep g f.poly signs f.poly.size) (#[], #[])).1.size
      rw [← Array.foldl_toList]
      refine foldl_measure_pos (fun st => st.1.size)
        (myCstep g f.poly signs f.poly.size)
        (fun st i => myCstep_pv_mono g f.poly signs f.poly.size st i)
        iP (fun st => myCstep_pv_pos g f.poly signs f.poly.size iP
          (le_of_lt (by exact_mod_cast decide_eq_true_eq.mp hpP)) st) _ ?_ _
      rw [Array.toList_range, List.mem_range]; rw [hsz] at hiP; exact hiP
    · show 0 < ((Array.range f.poly.size).foldl
          (myCstep g f.poly signs f.poly.size) (#[], #[])).2.size
      rw [← Array.foldl_toList]
      refine foldl_measure_pos (fun st => st.2.size)
        (myCstep g f.poly signs f.poly.size)
        (fun st i => myCstep_nv_mono g f.poly signs f.poly.size st i)
        iN (fun st => myCstep_nv_pos g f.poly signs f.poly.size iN
          (by exact_mod_cast decide_eq_true_eq.mp hpN) st) _ ?_ _
      rw [Array.toList_range, List.mem_range]; rw [hsz] at hiN; exact hiN

name: forall2_flatMap_map_eq
statement:
theorem forall2_flatMap_map_eq {α β} (R : α → α → Prop) (φ : β → β) (g g' : α → List β)
    (hg : ∀ a a', R a a' → g' a' = (g a).map φ) :
    ∀ {l l' : List α}, List.Forall₂ R l l' → l'.flatMap g' = (l.flatMap g).map φ
  | _, _, List.Forall₂.nil => rfl
  | _, _, List.Forall₂.cons hab htl => by
      simp only [List.flatMap_cons, List.map_append]
      rw [hg _ _ hab, forall2_flatMap_map_eq R φ g g' hg htl]

name: forall2_map_map2
statement:
theorem forall2_map_map2 {α} {R S : α → α → Prop} (φ ψ : α → α) (h : ∀ a a', R a a' → S (φ a) (ψ a')) :
    ∀ {l l' : List α}, List.Forall₂ R l l' → List.Forall₂ S (l.map φ) (l'.map ψ)
  | _, _, List.Forall₂.nil => List.Forall₂.nil
  | _, _, List.Forall₂.cons hab htl => List.Forall₂.cons (h _ _ hab) (forall2_map_map2 φ ψ h htl)

name: forall2_and_left
statement:
theorem forall2_and_left {α} {R : α → α → Prop} {P : α → Prop} :
    ∀ {l l' : List α}, List.Forall₂ R l l' → (∀ a ∈ l, P a) →
      List.Forall₂ (fun a b => R a b ∧ P a) l l'
  | _, _, List.Forall₂.nil, _ => List.Forall₂.nil
  | _, _, List.Forall₂.cons hab htl, hP =>
      List.Forall₂.cons ⟨hab, hP _ (List.mem_cons_self _ _)⟩
        (forall2_and_left htl (fun a ha => hP a (List.mem_cons_of_mem _ ha)))

/

name: dedupStep_pred
statement:
theorem dedupStep_pred {P : Vtx → Prop} (l : List Vtx) (acc : Array Vtx)
    (hacc : ∀ x ∈ acc, P x) (hl : ∀ x ∈ l, P x) : ∀ x ∈ l.foldl dedupStep acc, P x
proof:
:= by
  refine foldl_inv (fun a => ∀ x ∈ a, P x) dedupStep l acc hacc ?_
  intro b hb v hv
  simp only [dedupStep]
  split
  · split
    · exact hb
    · exact fun x hx => by rcases Array.mem_push.mp hx with h | h; exacts [hb x h, h ▸ hl v hv]
  · exact fun x hx => by rcases Array.mem_push.mp hx with h | h; exacts [hb x h, h ▸ hl v hv]

name: vertexUniverse_faithful
statement:
theorem vertexUniverse_faithful (K : Array Frag) (hfaith : ∀ f ∈ K, FragFaithful f) :
    ∀ v ∈ vertexUniverse K, VtxFaithful v
proof:
:= by
  rw [vertexUniverse_dedupStep, ← Array.foldl_toList, Array.toList_toArray]
  refine dedupStep_pred _ #[] (by simp) ?_
  intro x hx
  have hx' : x ∈ (K.flatMap (fun f => f.poly)).toList :=
    (List.mergeSort_perm _ _).mem_iff.mp hx
  obtain ⟨f, hf, hxf⟩ := mem_flatMap_arr.mp (Array.mem_toList.mp hx')
  exact hfaith f hf x hxf

name: tail_seam
statement:
theorem tail_seam (o : P3) (O : Point) (ho : o = ofPoint O) (K K' : Array Frag)
    (hK : List.Forall₂ (FragSeam o) K.toList K'.toList) (hfaith : ∀ f ∈ K, FragFaithful f) :
    atomEmit K' = (atomEmit K).map (trTri O)
proof:
:= by
  have hvs : vertexUniverse K' = (vertexUniverse K).map (trVtx o) := vertexUniverse_seam o K K' hK
  have hvsf : ∀ v ∈ vertexUniverse K, VtxFaithful v := vertexUniverse_faithful K hfaith
  have hKf : List.Forall₂ (fun f f' => FragSeam o f f' ∧ FragFaithful f) K.toList K'.toList :=
    forall2_and_left hK (fun f hf => hfaith f (Array.mem_toList.mp hf))
  have hrefined : List.Forall₂ (FragSeam o)
      (K.map (atomizeFragB (univBVH (vertexUniverse K)) (vertexUniverse K))).toList
      (K'.map (atomizeFragB (univBVH (vertexUniverse K')) (vertexUniverse K'))).toList := by
    rw [hvs, Array.toList_map, Array.toList_map]
    exact forall2_map_map2 (atomizeFragB (univBVH (vertexUniverse K)) (vertexUniverse K))
      (atomizeFragB (univBVH ((vertexUniverse K).map (trVtx o))) ((vertexUniverse K).map (trVtx o)))
      (fun a a' hR => atomizeFragB_seam o (vertexUniverse K) a a' hR.1 hR.2 hvsf) hKf
  simp only [atomEmit]
  apply Array.ext'
  rw [toList_flatMap]
  conv_rhs => rw [Array.toList_map, toList_flatMap]
  exact forall2_flatMap_map_eq (FragSeam o) (trTri O) (fun f => (emitFrag f).toList)
    (fun f => (emitFrag f).toList)
    (fun f f' hs => by simp only [emitFrag_seam o O ho hs, Array.toList_map]) hrefined

name: foldl_bboxStep_shift
statement:
theorem foldl_bboxStep_shift (o : P3) :
    ∀ (l : List P3) (s : Box3),
      (l.map (fun p => psubS p o)).foldl (fun b p => ⟨pminS b.lo p, pmaxS b.hi p⟩) (shBox3 o s)
      = shBox3 o (l.foldl (fun b p => ⟨pminS b.lo p, pmaxS b.hi p⟩) s)
  | [], _ => rfl
  | a :: l, s => by
      simp only [List.map_cons, List.foldl_cons]
      have hstep : (⟨pminS (shBox3 o s).lo (psubS a o), pmaxS (shBox3 o s).hi (psubS a o)⟩ : Box3)
          = shBox3 o ⟨pminS s.lo a, pmaxS s.hi a⟩
proof:
:= by
        simp only [shBox3, pminS_translate, pmaxS_translate]
      rw [hstep]
      exact foldl_bboxStep_shift o l ⟨pminS s.lo a, pmaxS s.hi a⟩

name: bboxOfPts_tr
statement:
theorem bboxOfPts_tr (o : P3) (ps : Array P3) (hps : 0 < ps.size) :
    bboxOfPts (ps.map (fun p => psubS p o)) = shBox3 o (bboxOfPts ps)
proof:
:= by
  simp only [bboxOfPts]
  rw [map_getD_lt (fun p => psubS p o) ps 0 hps default default]
  rw [show (⟨psubS (ps.getD 0 default) o, psubS (ps.getD 0 default) o⟩ : Box3)
        = shBox3 o ⟨ps.getD 0 default, ps.getD 0 default⟩ from rfl]
  rw [← Array.foldl_toList, ← Array.foldl_toList, Array.toList_map]
  exact foldl_bboxStep_shift o ps.toList ⟨ps.getD 0 default, ps.getD 0 default⟩

name: fragPolyBox_tr
statement:
theorem fragPolyBox_tr (o : P3) (f : Frag) (hpos : 0 < f.poly.size) :
    fragPolyBox (trFrag o f) = shBox3 o (fragPolyBox f)
proof:
:= by
  simp only [fragPolyBox, trFrag_poly, shBox3]
  rw [map_getD_lt (trVtx o) f.poly 0 hpos default default, trVtx_p]
  refine congrArg₂ Box3.mk ?_ ?_
