name: sectionPts_tr
statement:
theorem sectionPts_tr (o a₀ b₀ c₀ : P3) (g : FaceS)
    (hg : VtxFaithful g.v₀ ∧ VtxFaithful g.v₁ ∧ VtxFaithful g.v₂) :
    sectionPts (iFacePlaneP (psubS a₀ o) (psubS b₀ o) (psubS c₀ o)) (trFaceS o g)
    = (sectionPts (iFacePlaneP a₀ b₀ c₀) g).map (fun p => psubS p o)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨hg0, hg1, hg2⟩ := hg
  have s0 : signI (iFacePlaneP (psubS a₀ o) (psubS b₀ o) (psubS c₀ o)) (trVtx o g.v₀).h
      = signI (iFacePlaneP a₀ b₀ c₀) g.v₀.h := faceVtxSign_tr o a₀ b₀ c₀ g.v₀ hg0
  have s1 : signI (iFacePlaneP (psubS a₀ o) (psubS b₀ o) (psubS c₀ o)) (trVtx o g.v₁).h
      = signI (iFacePlaneP a₀ b₀ c₀) g.v₁.h := faceVtxSign_tr o a₀ b₀ c₀ g.v₁ hg1
  have s2 : signI (iFacePlaneP (psubS a₀ o) (psubS b₀ o) (psubS c₀ o)) (trVtx o g.v₂).h
      = signI (iFacePlaneP a₀ b₀ c₀) g.v₂.h := faceVtxSign_tr o a₀ b₀ c₀ g.v₂ hg2
  have x01 : (cutVtx (iFacePlaneP (psubS a₀ o) (psubS b₀ o) (psubS c₀ o)) (trVtx o g.v₀) (trVtx o g.v₁)).p
      = psubS (cutVtx (iFacePlaneP a₀ b₀ c₀) g.v₀ g.v₁).p o := by
    rw [cutVtx_tr o a₀ b₀ c₀ g.v₀ g.v₁ hg0 hg1, trVtx_p]
  have x12 : (cutVtx (iFacePlaneP (psubS a₀ o) (psubS b₀ o) (psubS c₀ o)) (trVtx o g.v₁) (trVtx o g.v₂)).p
      = psubS (cutVtx (iFacePlaneP a₀ b₀ c₀) g.v₁ g.v₂).p o := by
    rw [cutVtx_tr o a₀ b₀ c₀ g.v₁ g.v₂ hg1 hg2, trVtx_p]
  have x20 : (cutVtx (iFacePlaneP (psubS a₀ o) (psubS b₀ o) (psubS c₀ o)) (trVtx o g.v₂) (trVtx o g.v₀)).p
      = psubS (cutVtx (iFacePlaneP a₀ b₀ c₀) g.v₂ g.v₀).p o := by
    rw [cutVtx_tr o a₀ b₀ c₀ g.v₂ g.v₀ hg2 hg0, trVtx_p]
  simp only [sectionPts, trFaceS, s0, s1, s2, x01, x12, x20, trVtx_p,
    apply_ite (Array.map (fun p => psubS p o)), Array.map_push, Array.map_empty]

name: scopeBoxSEG_tr
statement:
theorem scopeBoxSEG_tr (o a₀ b₀ c₀ : P3) (g : FaceS)
    (hg : VtxFaithful g.v₀ ∧ VtxFaithful g.v₁ ∧ VtxFaithful g.v₂) :
    scopeBoxSEG (iFacePlaneP (psubS a₀ o) (psubS b₀ o) (psubS c₀ o)) (trFaceS o g)
    = Option.map (shBox3 o) (scopeBoxSEG (iFacePlaneP a₀ b₀ c₀) g)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨hg0, hg1, hg2⟩ := hg
  have hsec := sectionPts_tr o a₀ b₀ c₀ g ⟨hg0, hg1, hg2⟩
  have hE : ((sectionPts (iFacePlaneP a₀ b₀ c₀) g).map (fun p => psubS p o)).isEmpty
      = (sectionPts (iFacePlaneP a₀ b₀ c₀) g).isEmpty := by simp only [Array.isEmpty, Array.size_map]
  simp only [scopeBoxSEG,
    dropByPlane_trFaceS o a₀ b₀ c₀ g ⟨hg0, hg1, hg2⟩,
    show (trFaceS o g).v₀.h = (trVtx o g.v₀).h from rfl,
    show (trFaceS o g).v₁.h = (trVtx o g.v₁).h from rfl,
    show (trFaceS o g).v₂.h = (trVtx o g.v₂).h from rfl,
    faceVtxSign_tr o a₀ b₀ c₀ g.v₀ hg0,
    faceVtxSign_tr o a₀ b₀ c₀ g.v₁ hg1,
    faceVtxSign_tr o a₀ b₀ c₀ g.v₂ hg2,
    hsec, hE, bboxOfFace_trFaceS o g]
  split_ifs with h1 h2 h3
  · rfl
  · rfl
  · rfl
  · have hpos : 0 < (sectionPts (iFacePlaneP a₀ b₀ c₀) g).size := by
      rcases Nat.eq_zero_or_pos (sectionPts (iFacePlaneP a₀ b₀ c₀) g).size with hz | hp
      · exact absurd (by simp [Array.isEmpty, hz]) h3
      · exact hp
    rw [bboxOfPts_tr o (sectionPts (iFacePlaneP a₀ b₀ c₀) g) hpos]
    rfl

name: clipFragScoped_tr
statement:
theorem clipFragScoped_tr (o : P3) (t t' : IPlane × Box3) (ht : ScopedTr o t t')
    (fb : Frag × Box3) (hf : FragFaithful fb.1) (hpos : 0 < fb.1.poly.size) :
    clipFragScoped t'.1 t'.2 (trPair o fb)
    = (clipFragScoped t.1 t.2 fb).map (trPair o)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨⟨a, b, c, hg, hg'⟩, hbox⟩ := ht
  have hsk : boxesOverlap (trPair o fb).2 t'.2 = boxesOverlap fb.2 t.2 := by
    simp only [trPair, hbox, boxesOverlap_sh]
  simp only [clipFragScoped, hsk]
  by_cases hov : boxesOverlap fb.2 t.2 = true
  · rw [if_pos hov, if_pos hov]
    have hfrag : clipFrag t'.1 (trPair o fb).1 = (clipFrag t.1 fb.1).map (trFrag o) := by
      simp only [trPair]
      rw [hg', hg]
      exact clipFrag_tr o a b c fb.1 hf
    rw [hfrag, Array.map_map, Array.map_map]
    apply Array.ext'
    rw [Array.toList_map, Array.toList_map]
    apply List.map_congr_left
    intro p hp
    have hpp : 0 < p.poly.size := clipFrag_poly_pos t.1 fb.1 hpos p (Array.mem_toList.mp hp)
    simp only [Function.comp, trPair]
    rw [fragPolyBox_tr o p hpp]
  · rw [if_neg hov, if_neg hov]
    rfl

name: flatMap_clipFragScoped_wf
statement:
theorem flatMap_clipFragScoped_wf (t : IPlane × Box3) (acc : Array (Frag × Box3))
    (hacc : ∀ fb ∈ acc, FragFaithful fb.1 ∧ 0 < fb.1.poly.size) :
    ∀ fb' ∈ acc.flatMap (clipFragScoped t.1 t.2),
      FragFaithful fb'.1 ∧ 0 < fb'.1.poly.size
proof:
:= by
  intro fb' hfb'
  obtain ⟨fb, hfb, hfb'⟩ := mem_flatMap_arr.mp hfb'
  obtain ⟨hf, hp⟩ := hacc fb hfb
  simp only [clipFragScoped] at hfb'
  split at hfb'
  · obtain ⟨q, hq, rfl⟩ := Array.mem_map.mp hfb'
    exact ⟨clipFrag_faithful t.1 fb.1 hf q hq, clipFrag_poly_pos t.1 fb.1 hp q hq⟩
  · rw [Array.mem_singleton] at hfb'; rw [hfb']; exact ⟨hf, hp⟩

name: flatMap_clipFragScoped_tr
statement:
theorem flatMap_clipFragScoped_tr (o : P3) (t t' : IPlane × Box3) (ht : ScopedTr o t t')
    (acc : Array (Frag × Box3)) (hacc : ∀ fb ∈ acc, FragFaithful fb.1 ∧ 0 < fb.1.poly.size) :
    (acc.map (trPair o)).flatMap (clipFragScoped t'.1 t'.2)
    = (acc.flatMap (clipFragScoped t.1 t.2)).map (trPair o)
proof:
:= by
  rw [arr_flatMap_map, arr_map_flatMap]
  apply arr_flatMap_congr
  intro fb hfb
  obtain ⟨hf, hp⟩ := hacc fb hfb
  exact clipFragScoped_tr o t t' ht fb hf hp

name: clipFaceScoped_fold
statement:
theorem clipFaceScoped_fold (o : P3) :
    ∀ (l l' : List (IPlane × Box3)), List.Forall₂ (ScopedTr o) l l' →
    ∀ (acc : Array (Frag × Box3)), (∀ fb ∈ acc, FragFaithful fb.1 ∧ 0 < fb.1.poly.size) →
      l'.foldl (fun fs t => fs.flatMap (clipFragScoped t.1 t.2)) (acc.map (trPair o))
      = (l.foldl (fun fs t => fs.flatMap (clipFragScoped t.1 t.2)) acc).map (trPair o)
proof:
:= by
  intro l l' h
  induction h with
  | nil => intro acc _; rfl
  | @cons t t' l l' ht _ ih =>
    intro acc hacc
    rw [List.foldl_cons, List.foldl_cons, flatMap_clipFragScoped_tr o t t' ht acc hacc]
    exact ih (acc.flatMap (clipFragScoped t.1 t.2)) (flatMap_clipFragScoped_wf t acc hacc)

name: clipFaceScoped_tr
statement:
theorem clipFaceScoped_tr (o : P3) (f₀ : Frag) (hf₀ : FragFaithful f₀) (hp₀ : 0 < f₀.poly.size)
    (L L' : Array (IPlane × Box3)) (hLL : List.Forall₂ (ScopedTr o) L.toList L'.toList) :
    clipFaceScoped (trFrag o f₀) L' = (clipFaceScoped f₀ L).map (trFrag o)
proof:
:= by
  simp only [clipFaceScoped]
  rw [← Array.foldl_toList, ← Array.foldl_toList]
  have hinit : (#[(trFrag o f₀, fragPolyBox (trFrag o f₀))] : Array (Frag × Box3))
      = (#[(f₀, fragPolyBox f₀)]).map (trPair o) := by
    simp only [trPair, fragPolyBox_tr o f₀ hp₀]; rfl
  rw [hinit, clipFaceScoped_fold o L.toList L'.toList hLL #[(f₀, fragPolyBox f₀)]
      (by intro fb hfb; rw [Array.mem_singleton] at hfb; subst hfb; exact ⟨hf₀, hp₀⟩)]
  rw [Array.map_map, Array.map_map]
  apply Array.ext'
  rw [Array.toList_map, Array.toList_map]
  apply List.map_congr_left
  intro fb _
  simp only [Function.comp, trPair]

name: clipFaceScoped_setPlane_fold
statement:
theorem clipFaceScoped_setPlane_fold (p : IPlane) :
    ∀ (l : List (IPlane × Box3)) (acc : Array (Frag × Box3)),

name: clipFaceScoped_setPlane
statement:
theorem clipFaceScoped_setPlane (p : IPlane) (f₀ : Frag) (L : Array (IPlane × Box3)) :
    clipFaceScoped (setPlane p f₀) L = (clipFaceScoped f₀ L).map (setPlane p)
proof:
:= by

  rw [← Array.foldl_toList, ← Array.foldl_toList]
  have hinit : (#[(setPlane p f₀, fragPolyBox (setPlane p f₀))] : Array (Frag × Box3))
      = (#[(f₀, fragPolyBox f₀)]).map (setPlaneP p) := by
    simp only [setPlaneP, fragPolyBox_setPlane]; rfl
  rw [hinit, clipFaceScoped_setPlane_fold p L.toList #[(f₀, fragPolyBox f₀)]]
  rw [Array.map_map, Array.map_map]
  apply Array.ext'
  rw [Array.toList_map, Array.toList_map]
  apply List.map_congr_left
  intro fb _
  simp only [Function.comp, setPlaneP]

name: clipFaceScoped_wf
statement:
theorem clipFaceScoped_wf (f₀ : Frag) (L : Array (IPlane × Box3))
    (hf₀ : FragFaithful f₀) (hp₀ : 0 < f₀.poly.size) :
    ∀ f ∈ clipFaceScoped f₀ L, FragFaithful f ∧ 0 < f.poly.size
proof:
:= by
  intro f hf
  simp only [clipFaceScoped] at hf
  rw [← Array.foldl_toList] at hf
  obtain ⟨fb, hfb, rfl⟩ := Array.mem_map.mp hf
  refine foldl_inv (fun a => ∀ fb ∈ a, FragFaithful fb.1 ∧ 0 < fb.1.poly.size)
    (fun fs t => fs.flatMap (clipFragScoped t.1 t.2)) L.toList #[(f₀, fragPolyBox f₀)]
    (by intro fb hfb; rw [Array.mem_singleton] at hfb; subst hfb; exact ⟨hf₀, hp₀⟩)
    (fun acc hacc t _ => flatMap_clipFragScoped_wf t acc hacc) fb hfb

name: planesForScoped_tr
statement:
theorem planesForScoped_tr (o a₀ b₀ c₀ : P3) (B : Array FaceS) (cand : Array Nat)
    (hB : ∀ f ∈ B, f.plane = iFacePlaneP f.v₀.p f.v₁.p f.v₂.p)
    (hBf : ∀ f ∈ B, VtxFaithful f.v₀ ∧ VtxFaithful f.v₁ ∧ VtxFaithful f.v₂)
    (hcand : ∀ j ∈ cand, j < B.size) :
    List.Forall₂ (ScopedTr o)
      (planesForScoped (iFacePlaneP a₀ b₀ c₀) B cand).toList
      (planesForScoped (iFacePlaneP (psubS a₀ o) (psubS b₀ o) (psubS c₀ o))
        (B.map (trFaceS o)) cand).toList
proof:
:= by
  simp only [planesForScoped, Array.toList_filterMap]
  have key : ∀ (l : List Nat), (∀ j ∈ l, j < B.size) →
      List.Forall₂ (ScopedTr o)
        (l.filterMap (fun j => match scopeBoxSEG (iFacePlaneP a₀ b₀ c₀) (B.getD j default) with
          | some box => some ((B.getD j default).plane, box) | none => none))
        (l.filterMap (fun j =>
          match scopeBoxSEG (iFacePlaneP (psubS a₀ o) (psubS b₀ o) (psubS c₀ o))
              ((B.map (trFaceS o)).getD j default) with
          | some box => some (((B.map (trFaceS o)).getD j default).plane, box) | none => none)) := by
    intro l
    induction l with
    | nil => simp
    | cons j l ih =>
        intro hl
        have hj : j < B.size := hl j (List.mem_cons_self _ _)
        have hget : B.getD j default = B[j] := by
          simp only [Array.getD_eq_get?, Array.getElem?_eq_getElem hj, Option.getD_some]
        have hgetT : (B.map (trFaceS o)).getD j default = trFaceS o B[j] := by
          rw [map_getD_lt (trFaceS o) B j hj default default, hget]
        have hdec : scopeBoxSEG (iFacePlaneP (psubS a₀ o) (psubS b₀ o) (psubS c₀ o))
              ((B.map (trFaceS o)).getD j default)
            = Option.map (shBox3 o) (scopeBoxSEG (iFacePlaneP a₀ b₀ c₀) (B.getD j default)) := by
          rw [hgetT, hget]
          exact scopeBoxSEG_tr o a₀ b₀ c₀ B[j] (hBf B[j] (Array.getElem_mem hj))
        have ihl := ih (fun k hk => hl k (List.mem_cons_of_mem _ hk))
        cases hsb : scopeBoxSEG (iFacePlaneP a₀ b₀ c₀) (B.getD j default) with
        | none =>
            simp only [List.filterMap_cons, hsb, hdec, hsb, Option.map_none]
            exact ihl
        | some box =>
            simp only [List.filterMap_cons, hsb, hdec, Option.map_some]
            refine List.Forall₂.cons ⟨⟨B[j].v₀.p, B[j].v₁.p, B[j].v₂.p, ?_, ?_⟩, rfl⟩ ihl
            · rw [hget]; exact hB _ (Array.getElem_mem hj)
            · rw [hgetT]; rfl
  exact key cand.toList (fun j hj => hcand j (Array.mem_toList.mp hj))

name: clipFragScoped_plane_mem
statement:
theorem clipFragScoped_plane_mem (g : IPlane) (scope : Box3) (p : IPlane)
    (fb : Frag × Box3) (hfb : fb.1.plane = p) :
    ∀ fb' ∈ clipFragScoped g scope fb, fb'.1.plane = p
proof:
:= by
  intro fb' hfb'
  simp only [clipFragScoped] at hfb'
  split at hfb'
  · obtain ⟨q, hq, rfl⟩ := Array.mem_map.mp hfb'
    exact (clipFrag_plane_mem g fb.1 q hq).trans hfb
  · rw [Array.mem_singleton] at hfb'; rw [hfb']; exact hfb

name: clipFaceScoped_plane_mem
statement:
theorem clipFaceScoped_plane_mem (f₀ : Frag) (L : Array (IPlane × Box3)) :
    ∀ f ∈ clipFaceScoped f₀ L, f.plane = f₀.plane
proof:
:= by
  intro f hf
  simp only [clipFaceScoped] at hf
  rw [← Array.foldl_toList] at hf
  obtain ⟨fb, hfb, rfl⟩ := Array.mem_map.mp hf
  refine foldl_inv (fun a => ∀ fb ∈ a, fb.1.plane = f₀.plane)
    (fun fs t => fs.flatMap (clipFragScoped t.1 t.2)) L.toList #[(f₀, fragPolyBox f₀)]
    (by intro fb hfb; rw [Array.mem_singleton] at hfb; subst hfb; rfl)
    ?_ fb hfb
  intro acc hacc t _ fb' hfb'
  obtain ⟨fb, hfb, hfb'⟩ := mem_flatMap_arr.mp hfb'
  exact clipFragScoped_plane_mem t.1 t.2 f₀.plane fb (hacc fb hfb) fb' hfb'

name: clipFaceScoped_fragOfFace_trFaceS
statement:
theorem clipFaceScoped_fragOfFace_trFaceS (o : P3) (f : FaceS)
    (B : Array FaceS) (cand : Array Nat)
    (hf : FragFaithful (fragOfFace f))
    (hfpl : f.plane = iFacePlaneP f.v₀.p f.v₁.p f.v₂.p)
    (hB : ∀ g ∈ B, g.plane = iFacePlaneP g.v₀.p g.v₁.p g.v₂.p)
    (hBf : ∀ g ∈ B, VtxFaithful g.v₀ ∧ VtxFaithful g.v₁ ∧ VtxFaithful g.v₂)
    (hcand : ∀ j ∈ cand, j < B.size) :
    clipFaceScoped (fragOfFace (trFaceS o f))
        (planesForScoped (trFaceS o f).plane (B.map (trFaceS o)) cand)
    = ((clipFaceScoped (fragOfFace f) (planesForScoped f.plane B cand)).map (trFrag o)).map
        (setPlane (iFacePlaneP (psubS f.v₀.p o) (psubS f.v₁.p o) (psubS f.v₂.p o)))
proof:
:= by
  have hp₀ : 0 < (fragOfFace f).poly.size := by
    have h3 : (fragOfFace f).poly.size = 3 := rfl
    omega
  rw [fragOfFace_trFaceS, clipFaceScoped_setPlane, hfpl,
      show (trFaceS o f).plane
        = iFacePlaneP (psubS f.v₀.p o) (psubS f.v₁.p o) (psubS f.v₂.p o) from rfl,
      clipFaceScoped_tr o (fragOfFace f) hf hp₀
        (planesForScoped (iFacePlaneP f.v₀.p f.v₁.p f.v₂.p) B cand)
        (planesForScoped (iFacePlaneP (psubS f.v₀.p o) (psubS f.v₁.p o) (psubS f.v₂.p o))
          (B.map (trFaceS o)) cand)
        (planesForScoped_tr o f.v₀.p f.v₁.p f.v₂.p B cand hB hBf hcand)]

name: fragsBuilderScoped_seam
statement:
theorem fragsBuilderScoped_seam (o : P3) (_meshId : Nat) (A B : Array FaceS)
    (hA : ∀ f ∈ A, f.plane = iFacePlaneP f.v₀.p f.v₁.p f.v₂.p)
    (hAf : ∀ f ∈ A, VtxFaithful f.v₀ ∧ VtxFaithful f.v₁ ∧ VtxFaithful f.v₂)
    (hB : ∀ g ∈ B, g.plane = iFacePlaneP g.v₀.p g.v₁.p g.v₂.p)
    (hBf : ∀ g ∈ B, VtxFaithful g.v₀ ∧ VtxFaithful g.v₁ ∧ VtxFaithful g.v₂)
    (hcand : ∀ i j : Nat, j ∈ ((candidates A B).getD i #[]) → j < B.size) :
    List.Forall₂ (FragSeam o)
      ((Array.range A.size).flatMap (fun i =>
        clipFaceScoped (fragOfFace (A.getD i default))
          (planesForScoped (A.getD i default).plane B ((candidates A B).getD i #[]))) ).toList
      ((Array.range (A.map (trFaceS o)).size).flatMap (fun i =>
        clipFaceScoped (fragOfFace ((A.map (trFaceS o)).getD i default))
          (planesForScoped ((A.map (trFaceS o)).getD i default).plane (B.map (trFaceS o))
            ((candidates (A.map (trFaceS o)) (B.map (trFaceS o))).getD i #[]))) ).toList
proof:
:= by
  simp only [Array.size_map, candidates_tr o A B]
  rw [toList_flatMap, toList_flatMap]
  apply list_forall2_flatMap
  intro i hi
  rw [Array.toList_range, List.mem_range] at hi
  rw [map_getD_lt (trFaceS o) A i hi default default]
  set f := A.getD i default with hf
  have hfmem : f ∈ A := getD_mem A i hi default
  rw [clipFaceScoped_fragOfFace_trFaceS o f B ((candidates A B).getD i #[])
      (fragOfFace_faithful f (hAf f hfmem)) (hA f hfmem) hB hBf
      (fun j hj => hcand i j hj)]
  apply block_forall2
  intro g hg
  rw [clipFaceScoped_plane_mem _ _ g hg]
  simp only [fragOfFace]
  exact hA f hfmem

name: prepOf_tr
statement:
theorem prepOf_tr (O : Point) (M : Mesh) :
    prepOf (trMesh O M) = trPrep (ofPoint O) (prepOf M)

    = trPrep (ofPoint O) (prepOf M)

name: trPrep_QSh
statement:
theorem trPrep_QSh (o : P3) (p : Prep) (hp : p.bvh = Impl.BVH.buildBVHM (p.W.map faceBoxOf)) :
    QSh o p.bvh (trPrep o p).bvh

name: array_filter_congr
statement:
theorem array_filter_congr {α} (l : Array α) (p q : α → Bool) (h : ∀ x ∈ l, p x = q x) :
    l.filter p = l.filter q
proof:
:= by
  apply Array.ext'
  rw [Array.toList_filter, Array.toList_filter]
  exact List.filter_congr (fun x hx => h x (Array.mem_toList.mp hx))

name: boxQuery_prepBVH_seam
statement:
theorem boxQuery_prepBVH_seam (o : P3) (W : Array PFace) (f : FaceS) :
    Impl.BVH.boxQuery (Impl.BVH.buildBVHM ((W.map (trPFace o)).map faceBoxOf))
        (boxToBVH (bboxOfFace (trFaceS o f)))
    = Impl.BVH.boxQuery (Impl.BVH.buildBVHM (W.map faceBoxOf)) (boxToBVH (bboxOfFace f))
proof:
:= by
  rw [faceBoxOf_map_trPFace, boxToBVH_bboxOfFace_trFaceS]
  exact boxQuery_buildBVHM_sh (W.map faceBoxOf) o.x o.y o.z (boxToBVH (bboxOfFace f))

name: boxQuery_prep_mem_lt
statement:
theorem boxQuery_prep_mem_lt (B : Array FaceS) (W : Array PFace) (hsz : W.size = B.size)
    (q : Impl.BVH.Box) (p : Nat → Bool) {j : Nat}
    (hj : j ∈ (Impl.BVH.boxQuery (Impl.BVH.buildBVHM (W.map faceBoxOf)) q).filter p) :
    j < B.size
proof:
:= by
  have := Proof.BVH.boxQueryM_mem_lt (W.map faceBoxOf) q j (Array.mem_of_mem_filter hj)
  rwa [Array.size_map, hsz] at this

name: candOf_mem_lt
statement:
theorem candOf_mem_lt (A B : Array FaceS) (W : Array PFace) (hsz : W.size = B.size)
    (i j : Nat) (hj : j ∈ (candOf A B (Impl.BVH.buildBVHM (W.map faceBoxOf))).getD i #[]) :
    j < B.size
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hi : i < A.size
  · rw [candOf, arr_getD _ _ _ (by rw [Array.size_map]; exact hi), Array.getElem_map] at hj
    exact boxQuery_prep_mem_lt B W hsz _ _ hj
  · rw [candOf, Array.getD, dif_neg (by rw [Array.size_map]; exact hi)] at hj
    simp at hj

name: candOf_tr
statement:
theorem candOf_tr (o : P3) (A B : Array FaceS) (W : Array PFace) (hsz : W.size = B.size) :
    candOf (A.map (trFaceS o)) (B.map (trFaceS o))
        (Impl.BVH.buildBVHM ((W.map (trPFace o)).map faceBoxOf))
      = candOf A B (Impl.BVH.buildBVHM (W.map faceBoxOf))
proof:
:= by
  have hBbox : (B.map (trFaceS o)).map bboxOfFace = (B.map bboxOfFace).map (shBox3 o) := by
    rw [Array.map_map, Array.map_map]
    refine congrArg (fun g => B.map g) ?_
    funext g
    exact bboxOfFace_trFaceS o g
  unfold candOf
  rw [Array.map_map]
  refine congrArg (fun g => A.map g) ?_
  funext f
  simp only [Function.comp]
  rw [boxQuery_prepBVH_seam o W f]
  refine array_filter_congr _ _ _ ?_
  intro j hj
  have hjlt : j < B.size := by
    have := Proof.BVH.boxQueryM_mem_lt (W.map faceBoxOf) (boxToBVH (bboxOfFace f)) j hj
    rwa [Array.size_map, hsz] at this
  rw [hBbox, bboxOfFace_trFaceS,
    map_getD_lt (shBox3 o) (B.map bboxOfFace) j (by rwa [Array.size_map]) default default,
    boxesOverlap_sh]

name: freeOf_tr
statement:
theorem freeOf_tr (o : P3) (A B : Array FaceS) (W : Array PFace) (hsz : W.size = B.size) :
    freeOf (candOf (A.map (trFaceS o)) (B.map (trFaceS o))
        (Impl.BVH.buildBVHM ((W.map (trPFace o)).map faceBoxOf)))
      = freeOf (candOf A B (Impl.BVH.buildBVHM (W.map faceBoxOf)))
proof:
:= by
  rw [candOf_tr o A B W hsz]

name: keepRootOf_tr
statement:
theorem keepRootOf_tr (o : P3) {bvh bvh' : Impl.BVH.BVH} (A : Array FaceS) (free : Array Bool)
    (label : Array Nat) (W : Array PFace)
    (hA : ∀ f ∈ A, VtxFaithful f.v₀ ∧ VtxFaithful f.v₁ ∧ VtxFaithful f.v₂)
    (hq : QSh o bvh bvh') (hW : Faithful W) :
    keepRootOf (A.map (trFaceS o)) free label bvh' (W.map (trPFace o))
      = keepRootOf A free label bvh W
proof:
:= by
  rw [keepRootOf_eq_foldl, keepRootOf_eq_foldl, Array.size_map]
  refine foldl_rel Eq _ _ (List.range A.size) ?_ ∅ ∅ rfl
  rintro mp mp' i hi rfl
  have hlt : i < A.size := List.mem_range.mp hi
  have hface : (A.map (trFaceS o)).getD i default = trFaceS o (A.getD i default) :=
    map_getD_lt (trFaceS o) A i hlt default default
  have hmem : A.getD i default ∈ A := getD_mem A i hlt default
  have hseed : FragFaithful (fragOfFace (A.getD i default)) :=
    fragOfFace_faithful (A.getD i default) (hA _ hmem)
  have hpos : 0 < (fragOfFace (A.getD i default)).poly.size := by
    have h3 : (fragOfFace (A.getD i default)).poly.size = 3 := rfl
    omega
  have hkeep : keepFragB bvh' (W.map (trPFace o))
        (fragOfFace ((A.map (trFaceS o)).getD i default))
      = keepFragB bvh W (fragOfFace (A.getD i default)) := by
    rw [hface, fragOfFace_trFaceS,
      keepFragB_poly_congr _ _ (show (setPlane
          (iFacePlaneP (psubS (A.getD i default).v₀.p o) (psubS (A.getD i default).v₁.p o)
            (psubS (A.getD i default).v₂.p o)) (trFrag o (fragOfFace (A.getD i default)))).poly
        = (trFrag o (fragOfFace (A.getD i default))).poly from rfl)]
    exact keepFragB_tr o W (fragOfFace (A.getD i default)) hpos hseed hq hW
  simp only [krStep, hkeep]

name: blkA_seam
statement:
theorem blkA_seam (o : P3) (A B : Array FaceS) (cand : Array (Array Nat)) (i : Nat)
    (hi : i < A.size)
    (hA : ∀ f ∈ A, f.plane = iFacePlaneP f.v₀.p f.v₁.p f.v₂.p)
    (hAf : ∀ f ∈ A, VtxFaithful f.v₀ ∧ VtxFaithful f.v₁ ∧ VtxFaithful f.v₂)
    (hB : ∀ g ∈ B, g.plane = iFacePlaneP g.v₀.p g.v₁.p g.v₂.p)
    (hBf : ∀ g ∈ B, VtxFaithful g.v₀ ∧ VtxFaithful g.v₁ ∧ VtxFaithful g.v₂)
    (hcand : ∀ j ∈ cand.getD i #[], j < B.size) :
    List.Forall₂ (FragSeam o) (blkA A B cand i).toList
      (blkA (A.map (trFaceS o)) (B.map (trFaceS o)) cand i).toList
proof:
:= by
  have hmem : A.getD i default ∈ A := getD_mem A i hi default
  show List.Forall₂ (FragSeam o)
    (clipFaceScoped (fragOfFace (A.getD i default))
      (planesForScoped (A.getD i default).plane B (cand.getD i #[]))).toList
    (clipFaceScoped (fragOfFace ((A.map (trFaceS o)).getD i default))
      (planesForScoped ((A.map (trFaceS o)).getD i default).plane (B.map (trFaceS o))
        (cand.getD i #[]))).toList
  rw [map_getD_lt (trFaceS o) A i hi default default,
    clipFaceScoped_fragOfFace_trFaceS o (A.getD i default) B (cand.getD i #[])
      (fragOfFace_faithful (A.getD i default) (hAf _ hmem)) (hA _ hmem) hB hBf hcand]
  apply block_forall2
  intro g hg
  rw [clipFaceScoped_plane_mem _ _ g hg]
  simp only [fragOfFace]
  exact hA _ hmem

name: fusedA_seam
statement:
theorem fusedA_seam (o : P3) (A B : Array FaceS) (cand : Array (Array Nat))
    (free : Array Bool) (label : Array Nat) (keepRoot : Std.HashMap Nat Bool)
    {bvh bvh' : Impl.BVH.BVH} (W : Array PFace)
    (hA : ∀ f ∈ A, f.plane = iFacePlaneP f.v₀.p f.v₁.p f.v₂.p)
    (hAf : ∀ f ∈ A, VtxFaithful f.v₀ ∧ VtxFaithful f.v₁ ∧ VtxFaithful f.v₂)
    (hB : ∀ g ∈ B, g.plane = iFacePlaneP g.v₀.p g.v₁.p g.v₂.p)
    (hBf : ∀ g ∈ B, VtxFaithful g.v₀ ∧ VtxFaithful g.v₁ ∧ VtxFaithful g.v₂)
    (hcand : ∀ i j : Nat, j ∈ cand.getD i #[] → j < B.size)
    (hq : QSh o bvh bvh') (hW : Faithful W) :
    List.Forall₂ (FragSeam o)
        (fusedA A B cand free label keepRoot (primKeys B) bvh W).1.toList
        (fusedA (A.map (trFaceS o)) (B.map (trFaceS o)) cand free label keepRoot
          (primKeys (B.map (trFaceS o))) bvh' (W.map (trPFace o))).1.toList
      ∧ List.Forall₂ (FragSeam o)
        (fusedA A B cand free label keepRoot (primKeys B) bvh W).2.toList
        (fusedA (A.map (trFaceS o)) (B.map (trFaceS o)) cand free label keepRoot
          (primKeys (B.map (trFaceS o))) bvh' (W.map (trPFace o))).2.toList
proof:
:= by
  rw [fusedA_eq_foldl, fusedA_eq_foldl, Array.size_map]
  refine foldl_rel
    (fun (st st' : MProd (Array Frag) (Array Frag)) =>
      List.Forall₂ (FragSeam o) st.1.toList st'.1.toList
        ∧ List.Forall₂ (FragSeam o) st.2.toList st'.2.toList)
    _ _ (List.range A.size) ?_ ⟨#[], #[]⟩ ⟨#[], #[]⟩ ⟨List.Forall₂.nil, List.Forall₂.nil⟩
  intro st st' i hi hst
  have hlt : i < A.size := List.mem_range.mp hi
  have hmem : A.getD i default ∈ A := getD_mem A i hlt default
  have hface : (A.map (trFaceS o)).getD i default = trFaceS o (A.getD i default) :=
    map_getD_lt (trFaceS o) A i hlt default default
  
  have hblk := blkA_seam o A B cand i hlt hA hAf hB hBf (fun j hj => hcand i j hj)
  have hwf : ∀ f ∈ (blkA A B cand i).toList, 0 < f.poly.size ∧ FragFaithful f := by
    intro f hf
    have h := clipFaceScoped_wf (fragOfFace (A.getD i default))
      (planesForScoped (A.getD i default).plane B (cand.getD i #[]))
      (fragOfFace_faithful (A.getD i default) (hAf _ hmem))
      (by have h3 : (fragOfFace (A.getD i default)).poly.size = 3 := rfl; omega)
      f (Array.mem_toList.mp hf)
    exact ⟨h.2, h.1⟩
  
  have hplaneSeam : PlaneSeam o (A.getD i default).plane
      ((A.map (trFaceS o)).getD i default).plane := by
    refine ⟨(A.getD i default).v₀.p, (A.getD i default).v₁.p, (A.getD i default).v₂.p,
      hA _ hmem, ?_⟩
    rw [hface]
    rfl
  have hmp : memPrim (primKeys (B.map (trFaceS o))) ((A.map (trFaceS o)).getD i default).plane
      = memPrim (primKeys B) (A.getD i default).plane :=
    memPrim_primKeys_seam o _ _ B hplaneSeam hB
  simp only [stepA, hmp]
  by_cases h1 : memPrim (primKeys B) (A.getD i default).plane = true
  · simp only [if_pos h1]
    exact ⟨by rw [Array.toList_append, Array.toList_append]; exact List.rel_append hst.1 hblk,
      hst.2⟩
  · simp only [if_neg h1]
    by_cases h2 : free.getD i false = true
    · simp only [if_pos h2]
      by_cases h3 : keepRoot.getD (label.getD i i) false = true
      · simp only [if_pos h3]
        exact ⟨hst.1, by
          rw [Array.toList_append, Array.toList_append]; exact List.rel_append hst.2 hblk⟩
      · simp only [if_neg h3]
        exact hst
    · simp only [if_neg h2]
      refine ⟨hst.1, ?_⟩
      rw [Array.toList_append, Array.toList_append]
      refine List.rel_append hst.2 ?_
      rw [Array.toList_filter, Array.toList_filter]
      exact forall2_filter_pos (FragSeam o) (keepFragB bvh W)
        (keepFragB bvh' (W.map (trPFace o)))
        (fun f => 0 < f.poly.size ∧ FragFaithful f)
        (fun a b hs hSa => (keepFragB_seam o W a b hs hSa.1 hSa.2 hq hW).symm) hblk hwf

name: edgeKeyC_psubS
statement: theorem edgeKeyC_psubS (o u v : P3) : edgeKeyC (psubS u o) (psubS v o) = phiKey o (edgeKeyC u v)
proof:
:=
  rfl

name: phiKey_inj
statement: theorem phiKey_inj (o : P3) : Function.Injective (phiKey o)
proof:
:= by
  rintro ⟨a0, a1, a2, b0, b1, b2⟩ ⟨c0, c1, c2, d0, d1, d2⟩ h
  simp only [phiKey, EdgeKeyC.mk.injEq, sub_left_inj] at h
  simp only [EdgeKeyC.mk.injEq]
  exact h

name: phiKey_beq
statement: theorem phiKey_beq (o : P3) (k k' : EdgeKeyC) : (phiKey o k == phiKey o k') = (k == k')
proof:
:= by
  rw [Bool.eq_iff_iff, beq_iff_eq, beq_iff_eq]
  exact ⟨fun h => phiKey_inj o h, fun h => by rw [h]⟩

name: faceEdgesC_trFaceS
statement:
theorem faceEdgesC_trFaceS (o : P3) (f : FaceS) :
    (faceEdgesC (trFaceS o f)).toList
      = (faceEdgesC f).toList.map (fun e => (psubS e.1 o, psubS e.2 o))
proof: := rfl

name: list_foldl_rel
statement:
theorem list_foldl_rel {α β γ} (R : α → β → Prop) (F : α → γ → α) (F' : β → γ → β)
    (hstep : ∀ a b c, R a b → R (F a c) (F' b c)) :
    ∀ (l : List γ) (a : α) (b : β), R a b → R (l.foldl F a) (l.foldl F' b)
proof:
:= by
  intro l
  induction l with
  | nil => intro a b h; exact h
  | cons c cs ih =>
    intro a b h
    simp only [List.foldl_cons]
    exact ih _ _ (hstep a b c h)

name: list_foldl_congr
statement:
theorem list_foldl_congr {α γ} (F F' : α → γ → α) (h : ∀ a c, F a c = F' a c) :
    ∀ (l : List γ) (a : α), l.foldl F a = l.foldl F' a
proof:
:= by
  intro l
  induction l with
  | nil => intro a; rfl
  | cons c cs ih => intro a; simp only [List.foldl_cons, h a c, ih]

name: edgeMapOf_sh
statement:
theorem edgeMapOf_sh (o : P3) (A : Array FaceS) (free : Array Bool) :
    MSh o (edgeMapOf A free) (edgeMapOf (A.map (trFaceS o)) free)
proof:
:= by
  have hins : ∀ (i : Nat) (m m' : Std.HashMap EdgeKeyC (List Nat)) (e : P3 × P3), MSh o m m' →
      MSh o (insStep i e m) (insStep i (psubS e.1 o, psubS e.2 o) m') := by
    intro i m m' e hm k
    simp only [insStep, edgeKeyC_psubS, Std.HashMap.getD_insert, phiKey_beq]
    split
    · rw [hm]
    · rw [hm]
  have hsize : (A.map (trFaceS o)).size = A.size := Array.size_map _ _
  simp only [edgeMapOf, hsize]
  refine foldl_rel (MSh o) _ _ (List.range A.size) ?_ ∅ ∅ (fun k => by simp only [Std.HashMap.getD_emptyc])
  intro m m' i hi hm
  have hlt : i < A.size := List.mem_range.mp hi
  simp only [emStep, map_getD_lt (trFaceS o) A i hlt default default, faceEdgesC_trFaceS,
    List.foldl_map]
  split
  · exact list_foldl_rel (MSh o) _ _ (fun a b e hab => hins i a b e hab) _ _ _ hm
  · exact hm

name: bfsStep_sh
statement:
theorem bfsStep_sh (o : P3) (A : Array FaceS) (free : Array Bool)
    {m m' : Std.HashMap EdgeKeyC (List Nat)} (hm : MSh o m m') {st : BSt}
    (hOk : Ok A free st.1 st.2.2.1 st.2.2.2.2) :
    bfsStep (A.map (trFaceS o)) free m' st = bfsStep A free m st
proof:
:= by
  have hsize : (A.map (trFaceS o)).size = A.size := Array.size_map _ _
  simp only [bfsStep, hsize]
  by_cases hwk : st.2.2.2.1 < st.2.2.2.2.size
  · rw [if_pos hwk, if_pos hwk]
    have hmem : st.2.2.2.2.getD st.2.2.2.1 0 ∈ st.2.2.2.2 := by
      rw [arr_getD _ _ _ hwk]; exact Array.getElem_mem hwk
    obtain ⟨hilt, -, -, -, -, -, -⟩ := hOk.vis _ (hOk.wrk _ hmem)
    rw [map_getD_lt (trFaceS o) A _ hilt default default, faceEdgesC_trFaceS, List.foldl_map]
    refine congrArg (fun r : ISt => (⟨r.1, st.2.1, r.2.1, st.2.2.2.1 + 1, r.2.2⟩ : BSt)) ?_
    exact (list_foldl_congr _ _
      (fun s e => by simp only [edgeStep, edgeKeyC_psubS]; rw [hm]) _ _).symm
  · rw [if_neg hwk, if_neg hwk]

name: bfsFold_sh
statement:
theorem bfsFold_sh (o : P3) (A : Array FaceS) (free : Array Bool)
    {m m' : Std.HashMap EdgeKeyC (List Nat)} (hm : MSh o m m') (hmok : MapOk A free m) :
    ∀ (l : List Nat) (st : BSt), Ok A free st.1 st.2.2.1 st.2.2.2.2 →
      l.foldl (fun st _ => bfsStep (A.map (trFaceS o)) free m' st) st
        = l.foldl (fun st _ => bfsStep A free m st) st
proof:
:= by
  intro l
  induction l with
  | nil => intro st _; rfl
  | cons a l ih =>
    intro st hOk
    simp only [List.foldl_cons]
    rw [bfsStep_sh o A free hm hOk]
    exact ih _ (bfsStep_ok A free hmok hOk)

name: bfsRun_sh
statement:
theorem bfsRun_sh (o : P3) (A : Array FaceS) (free : Array Bool) :
    bfsRun (A.map (trFaceS o)) free = bfsRun A free
proof:
:= by
  have hsize : (A.map (trFaceS o)).size = A.size := Array.size_map _ _
  have hinit : (⟨Array.range (A.map (trFaceS o)).size, 0,
      mkArray (A.map (trFaceS o)).size false, 0, #[]⟩ : BSt)
      = ⟨Array.range A.size, 0, mkArray A.size false, 0, #[]⟩ := by rw [hsize]
  have hlist : List.range (2 * (A.map (trFaceS o)).size) = List.range (2 * A.size) := by
    rw [hsize]
  simp only [bfsRun, hinit, hlist]
  exact bfsFold_sh o A free (edgeMapOf_sh o A free) (edgeMapOf_ok A free) _ _
    (ok_init A free)

name: clusterFree_sh
statement:
theorem clusterFree_sh (o : P3) (A : Array FaceS) (free : Array Bool) :
    clusterFree (A.map (trFaceS o)) free = clusterFree A free
proof:
:= by
  rw [clusterFree_eq, clusterFree_eq, bfsRun_sh]

name: fusedA_wf
statement:
theorem fusedA_wf (A B : Array FaceS) (cand : Array (Array Nat)) (free : Array Bool)
    (label : Array Nat) (keepRoot : Std.HashMap Nat Bool) (keysB : Array IPlane)
    (bvh : Impl.BVH.BVH) (W : Array PFace)
    (hAf : ∀ f ∈ A, VtxFaithful f.v₀ ∧ VtxFaithful f.v₁ ∧ VtxFaithful f.v₂) :
    (∀ f ∈ (fusedA A B cand free label keepRoot keysB bvh W).1,
        FragFaithful f ∧ 0 < f.poly.size)
      ∧ (∀ f ∈ (fusedA A B cand free label keepRoot keysB bvh W).2,
        FragFaithful f ∧ 0 < f.poly.size)
proof:
:= by
  have hblk : ∀ i : Nat, i < A.size →
      ∀ f ∈ blkA A B cand i, FragFaithful f ∧ 0 < f.poly.size := by
    intro i hi
    exact clipFaceScoped_wf (fragOfFace (A.getD i default))
      (planesForScoped (A.getD i default).plane B (cand.getD i #[]))
      (fragOfFace_faithful (A.getD i default) (hAf _ (getD_mem A i hi default)))
      (by have h3 : (fragOfFace (A.getD i default)).poly.size = 3 := rfl; omega)
  rw [fusedA_eq_foldl]
  refine foldl_inv
    (fun st : MProd (Array Frag) (Array Frag) =>
      (∀ f ∈ st.1, FragFaithful f ∧ 0 < f.poly.size)
        ∧ (∀ f ∈ st.2, FragFaithful f ∧ 0 < f.poly.size))
    _ (List.range A.size) ⟨#[], #[]⟩ ⟨by simp, by simp⟩ ?_
  intro st hst i hi
  have hlt : i < A.size := List.mem_range.mp hi
  simp only [stepA]
  by_cases h1 : memPrim keysB (A.getD i default).plane = true
  · simp only [if_pos h1]
    refine ⟨fun f hf => ?_, hst.2⟩
    rcases Array.mem_append.mp hf with h | h
    · exact hst.1 f h
    · exact hblk i hlt f h
  · simp only [if_neg h1]
    by_cases h2 : free.getD i false = true
    · simp only [if_pos h2]
      by_cases h3 : keepRoot.getD (label.getD i i) false = true
      · simp only [if_pos h3]
        refine ⟨hst.1, fun f hf => ?_⟩
        rcases Array.mem_append.mp hf with h | h
        · exact hst.2 f h
        · exact hblk i hlt f h
      · simp only [if_neg h3]
        exact hst
    · simp only [if_neg h2]
      refine ⟨hst.1, fun f hf => ?_⟩
      rcases Array.mem_append.mp hf with h | h
      · exact hst.2 f h
      · exact hblk i hlt f (Array.mem_of_mem_filter h)

name: pipelineTail_eq
statement:
theorem pipelineTail_eq (pa pb : Prep) (copA keptNcA copB keptNcB : Array Frag) :
    pipelineTail pa pb copA keptNcA copB keptNcB
      = atomEmit (keptNcA ++ keptNcB ++ resolveCoplanar pb.bvh pa.bvh copA copB pb.W pa.W)
proof: := rfl

name: pipelineTail_seam
statement:
theorem pipelineTail_seam (o : P3) (O : Point) (ho : o = ofPoint O) (pa pb : Prep)
    {bvhA' bvhB' : Impl.BVH.BVH} (WA' WB' : Array PFace)
    (copA keptNcA copB keptNcB copA' keptNcA' copB' keptNcB' : Array Frag)
    (hqA : QSh o pa.bvh bvhA') (hqB : QSh o pb.bvh bvhB')
    (hWA' : WA' = pa.W.map (trPFace o)) (hWB' : WB' = pb.W.map (trPFace o))
    (hWa : Faithful pa.W) (hWb : Faithful pb.W)
    (hcopA : List.Forall₂ (RCop o) copA.toList copA'.toList)
    (hcopB : List.Forall₂ (RCop o) copB.toList copB'.toList)
    (hncA : List.Forall₂ (FragSeam o) keptNcA.toList keptNcA'.toList)
    (hncB : List.Forall₂ (FragSeam o) keptNcB.toList keptNcB'.toList)
    (hncAf : ∀ f ∈ keptNcA, FragFaithful f) (hncBf : ∀ f ∈ keptNcB, FragFaithful f)
    (hcopAf : ∀ f ∈ copA, FragFaithful f) (hcopBf : ∀ f ∈ copB, FragFaithful f) :
    atomEmit (keptNcA' ++ keptNcB' ++ resolveCoplanar bvhB' bvhA' copA' copB' WB' WA')
      = (atomEmit (keptNcA ++ keptNcB
          ++ resolveCoplanar pb.bvh pa.bvh copA copB pb.W pa.W)).map (trTri O)
proof:
:= by
  subst hWA'
  subst hWB'
  have hcop := resolveCoplanar_seam o copA copA' copB copB' pb.W pa.W hcopA hcopB hqB hqA hWb hWa
  have hcopf := resolveCoplanar_faithful pb.bvh pa.bvh copA copB pb.W pa.W hcopAf hcopBf
  refine tail_seam o O ho _ _ ?_ ?_
  · rw [Array.toList_append, Array.toList_append, Array.toList_append, Array.toList_append]
    exact List.rel_append (List.rel_append hncA hncB) hcop
  · intro f hf
    rcases Array.mem_append.mp hf with h | h
    · rcases Array.mem_append.mp h with h' | h'
      · exact hncAf f h'
      · exact hncBf f h'
    · exact hcopf f h

name: meshIntersectPre_tr
statement:
theorem meshIntersectPre_tr (o : P3) (O : Point) (ho : o = ofPoint O) (pa pb : Prep)
    (hpa : pa.bvh = Impl.BVH.buildBVHM (pa.W.map faceBoxOf))
    (hpb : pb.bvh = Impl.BVH.buildBVHM (pb.W.map faceBoxOf))
    (hWa : Faithful pa.W) (hWb : Faithful pb.W)
    (hAa : ∀ f ∈ pa.A, VtxFaithful f.v₀ ∧ VtxFaithful f.v₁ ∧ VtxFaithful f.v₂)
    (hAb : ∀ f ∈ pb.A, VtxFaithful f.v₀ ∧ VtxFaithful f.v₁ ∧ VtxFaithful f.v₂)
    (hPa : ∀ f ∈ pa.A, f.plane = iFacePlaneP f.v₀.p f.v₁.p f.v₂.p)
    (hPb : ∀ f ∈ pb.A, f.plane = iFacePlaneP f.v₀.p f.v₁.p f.v₂.p)
    (hsza : pa.W.size = pa.A.size) (hszb : pb.W.size = pb.A.size) :
    meshIntersectPre (trPrep o pa) (trPrep o pb)
      = (meshIntersectPre pa pb).map (trTri O)
proof:
:= by
  have hqA : QSh o pa.bvh (trPrep o pa).bvh := trPrep_QSh o pa hpa
  have hqB : QSh o pb.bvh (trPrep o pb).bvh := trPrep_QSh o pb hpb
  have hcandA : candOf (trPrep o pa).A (trPrep o pb).A (trPrep o pb).bvh
      = candOf pa.A pb.A pb.bvh := by
    show candOf (pa.A.map (trFaceS o)) (pb.A.map (trFaceS o))
      (Impl.BVH.buildBVHM ((pb.W.map (trPFace o)).map faceBoxOf)) = _
    rw [candOf_tr o pa.A pb.A pb.W hszb, hpb]
  have hcandB : candOf (trPrep o pb).A (trPrep o pa).A (trPrep o pa).bvh
      = candOf pb.A pa.A pa.bvh := by
    show candOf (pb.A.map (trFaceS o)) (pa.A.map (trFaceS o))
      (Impl.BVH.buildBVHM ((pa.W.map (trPFace o)).map faceBoxOf)) = _
    rw [candOf_tr o pb.A pa.A pa.W hsza, hpa]
  have hcandAlt : ∀ i j : Nat, j ∈ (candOf pa.A pb.A pb.bvh).getD i #[] → j < pb.A.size := by
    intro i j hj
    refine candOf_mem_lt pa.A pb.A pb.W hszb i j ?_
    rwa [← hpb]
  have hcandBlt : ∀ i j : Nat, j ∈ (candOf pb.A pa.A pa.bvh).getD i #[] → j < pa.A.size := by
    intro i j hj
    refine candOf_mem_lt pb.A pa.A pa.W hsza i j ?_
    rwa [← hpa]
  rw [MeshIntersectClusterLoop.meshIntersectPre_decomp,
    MeshIntersectClusterLoop.meshIntersectPre_decomp, hcandA, hcandB]
  rw [show clusterFree (trPrep o pa).A (freeOf (candOf pa.A pb.A pb.bvh))
      = clusterFree pa.A (freeOf (candOf pa.A pb.A pb.bvh)) from
    clusterFree_sh o pa.A (freeOf (candOf pa.A pb.A pb.bvh)),
    show clusterFree (trPrep o pb).A (freeOf (candOf pb.A pa.A pa.bvh))
      = clusterFree pb.A (freeOf (candOf pb.A pa.A pa.bvh)) from
    clusterFree_sh o pb.A (freeOf (candOf pb.A pa.A pa.bvh)),
    show keepRootOf (trPrep o pa).A (freeOf (candOf pa.A pb.A pb.bvh))
        (clusterFree pa.A (freeOf (candOf pa.A pb.A pb.bvh))) (trPrep o pb).bvh (trPrep o pb).W
      = keepRootOf pa.A (freeOf (candOf pa.A pb.A pb.bvh))
        (clusterFree pa.A (freeOf (candOf pa.A pb.A pb.bvh))) pb.bvh pb.W from
    keepRootOf_tr o pa.A _ _ pb.W hAa hqB hWb,
    show keepRootOf (trPrep o pb).A (freeOf (candOf pb.A pa.A pa.bvh))
        (clusterFree pb.A (freeOf (candOf pb.A pa.A pa.bvh))) (trPrep o pa).bvh (trPrep o pa).W
      = keepRootOf pb.A (freeOf (candOf pb.A pa.A pa.bvh))
        (clusterFree pb.A (freeOf (candOf pb.A pa.A pa.bvh))) pa.bvh pa.W from
    keepRootOf_tr o pb.A _ _ pa.W hAb hqA hWa]
  
  set freeA := freeOf (candOf pa.A pb.A pb.bvh) with hfreeA
  set freeB := freeOf (candOf pb.A pa.A pa.bvh) with hfreeB
  set labelA := clusterFree pa.A freeA with hlabelA
  set labelB := clusterFree pb.A freeB with hlabelB
  set keepRootA := keepRootOf pa.A freeA labelA pb.bvh pb.W with hkrA
  set keepRootB := keepRootOf pb.A freeB labelB pa.bvh pa.W with hkrB
  have hseamA := fusedA_seam o pa.A pb.A (candOf pa.A pb.A pb.bvh) freeA labelA keepRootA
    pb.W hPa hAa hPb hAb hcandAlt hqB hWb
  have hseamB := fusedA_seam o pb.A pa.A (candOf pb.A pa.A pa.bvh) freeB labelB keepRootB
    pa.W hPb hAb hPa hAa hcandBlt hqA hWa
  have hwfA := fusedA_wf pa.A pb.A (candOf pa.A pb.A pb.bvh) freeA labelA keepRootA
    (primKeys pb.A) pb.bvh pb.W hAa
  have hwfB := fusedA_wf pb.A pa.A (candOf pb.A pa.A pa.bvh) freeB labelB keepRootB
    (primKeys pa.A) pa.bvh pa.W hAb
  rw [pipelineTail_eq, pipelineTail_eq]
  refine pipelineTail_seam o O ho pa pb _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ hqA hqB rfl rfl hWa hWb ?_ ?_
    hseamA.2 hseamB.2 (fun f hf => (hwfA.2 f hf).1) (fun f hf => (hwfB.2 f hf).1)
    (fun f hf => (hwfA.1 f hf).1) (fun f hf => (hwfB.1 f hf).1)
  · exact forall2_and_left hseamA.1
      (fun f hf => ⟨(hwfA.1 f (Array.mem_toList.mp hf)).1, (hwfA.1 f (Array.mem_toList.mp hf)).2⟩)
  · exact forall2_and_left hseamB.1
      (fun f hf => ⟨(hwfB.1 f (Array.mem_toList.mp hf)).1, (hwfB.1 f (Array.mem_toList.mp hf)).2⟩)

name: meshIntersect_equivariant
statement:
theorem meshIntersect_equivariant (O : Point) (M₁ M₂ : Mesh) :
    Impl.MeshIntersect.meshIntersect (trMesh O M₁) (trMesh O M₂)
    = trMesh O (Impl.MeshIntersect.meshIntersect M₁ M₂)
proof:
:= by
  show meshIntersectPre (prepOf (trMesh O M₁)) (prepOf (trMesh O M₂))
    = (meshIntersectPre (prepOf M₁) (prepOf M₂)).map (trTri O)
  rw [prepOf_tr, prepOf_tr]
  exact meshIntersectPre_tr (ofPoint O) O rfl (prepOf M₁) (prepOf M₂) rfl rfl
    (faithful_prepare_materialize M₁) (faithful_prepare_materialize M₂)
    (materialize_faithful M₁) (materialize_faithful M₂)
    (materialize_plane M₁) (materialize_plane M₂)
    (by show (prepare (materialize M₁)).size = (materialize M₁).size
        rw [prepare_eq_map, Array.size_map])
    (by show (prepare (materialize M₂)).size = (materialize M₂).size
        rw [prepare_eq_map, Array.size_map])

name: faceNormal_eq_crossProduct
statement:
theorem faceNormal_eq_crossProduct (t : Triangle) :
    (CSG.faceNormal t : Fin 3 → ℚ)
      = crossProduct ((t.v₁ : Fin 3 → ℚ) - t.v₀) ((t.v₂ : Fin 3 → ℚ) - t.v₀)
proof:
:= by
  funext i
  fin_cases i <;>
    simp [CSG.faceNormal, crossProduct, Pi.sub_apply] <;> ring

name: faceNormal_ne_zero_of_detOrigin
statement:
theorem faceNormal_ne_zero_of_detOrigin (t : Triangle) (h : NDeg t) :
    crossProduct ((t.v₁ : Fin 3 → ℚ) - t.v₀) ((t.v₂ : Fin 3 → ℚ) - t.v₀) ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [← faceNormal_eq_crossProduct]; exact h

name: affineIndependent_of_detOrigin
statement:
theorem affineIndependent_of_detOrigin (t : Triangle) (h : NDeg t) :
    AffineIndependent ℚ ![(t.v₀ : Fin 3 → ℚ), t.v₁, t.v₂]
proof:
:= by
  have hn := faceNormal_ne_zero_of_detOrigin t h
  have hli : LinearIndependent ℚ ![(t.v₁ : Fin 3 → ℚ) - t.v₀, (t.v₂ : Fin 3 → ℚ) - t.v₀] :=
    crossProduct_ne_zero_iff_linearIndependent.mp hn
  
  
  rw [affineIndependent_iff_linearIndependent_vsub ℚ _ (0 : Fin 3)]
  
  let e : { x : Fin 3 // x ≠ 0 } ≃ Fin 2 :=
    { toFun := fun i => if (i : Fin 3) = 1 then 0 else 1
      invFun := fun j => if j = 0 then ⟨1, by decide⟩ else ⟨2, by decide⟩
      left_inv := by rintro ⟨i, hi⟩; fin_cases i <;> first | (exact absurd rfl hi) | rfl
      right_inv := by rintro j; fin_cases j <;> rfl }
  refine (linearIndependent_equiv' e ?_).mpr hli
  funext i
  obtain ⟨i, hi⟩ := i
  fin_cases i <;>
    first
      | (exact absurd rfl hi)
      | (simp only [e, Equiv.coe_fn_mk, Function.comp_apply, Matrix.cons_val_zero,
          Matrix.cons_val_one, Matrix.head_cons, Fin.isValue]
         rfl)

name: mem_triangleSet_of_bary
statement:
theorem mem_triangleSet_of_bary (t : Triangle) (μ : Fin 3 → ℚ)
    (hμ : ∀ j, 0 ≤ μ j) (hsum : ∑ j, μ j = 1) :
    μ 0 • (t.v₀ : Point) + μ 1 • (t.v₁ : Point) + μ 2 • (t.v₂ : Point) ∈ triangleSet t
proof:
:= by
  unfold triangleSet
  refine mem_convexHull_of_exists_fintype μ ![t.v₀, t.v₁, t.v₂] hμ hsum ?_ ?_
  · intro i; fin_cases i <;> simp
  · simp [Fin.sum_univ_three]

name: bary_unique
statement:
theorem bary_unique (t : Triangle) (hnd : NDeg t) (μ ν : Fin 3 → ℚ)
    (hm : ∑ j, μ j = 1) (hn : ∑ j, ν j = 1)
    (heq : ∑ j, μ j • (![t.v₀, t.v₁, t.v₂] j : Point)
          = ∑ j, ν j • (![t.v₀, t.v₁, t.v₂] j : Point)) :
    μ = ν
proof:
:= by
  have hai := affineIndependent_of_detOrigin t hnd
  rw [affineIndependent_iff_eq_of_fintype_affineCombination_eq] at hai
  apply hai μ ν hm hn
  rw [Finset.affineCombination_eq_linear_combination _ _ _ hm,
      Finset.affineCombination_eq_linear_combination _ _ _ hn]
  exact heq

name: triangleSet_bary
statement:
theorem triangleSet_bary (t : Triangle) (x : Point) (hx : x ∈ triangleSet t) :
    ∃ μ : Fin 3 → ℚ, (∀ j, 0 ≤ μ j) ∧ ∑ j, μ j = 1 ∧
      x = μ 0 • (t.v₀ : Point) + μ 1 • (t.v₁ : Point) + μ 2 • (t.v₂ : Point)
proof:
:= by
  have hr : ({t.v₀, t.v₁, t.v₂} : Set Point) = Set.range ![t.v₀, t.v₁, t.v₂] := by
    ext y; simp only [Set.mem_insert_iff, Set.mem_singleton_iff, Set.mem_range]
    constructor
    · rintro (h | h | h); exacts [⟨0, by simp [h]⟩, ⟨1, by simp [h]⟩, ⟨2, by simp [h]⟩]
    · rintro ⟨i, rfl⟩; fin_cases i <;> simp
  unfold triangleSet at hx
  rw [hr, convexHull_range_eq_exists_affineCombination] at hx
  obtain ⟨s, w, hw0, hw1, hcomb⟩ := hx
  refine ⟨fun j => if j ∈ s then w j else 0, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · intro j; by_cases h : j ∈ s <;> simp [h]; exact hw0 j h
  · rw [← hw1, Finset.sum_ite_mem, Finset.univ_inter]
  · rw [Finset.affineCombination_eq_linear_combination _ _ _ hw1] at hcomb
    rw [← hcomb]
    have hsplit : ∀ j : Fin 3, (if j ∈ s then w j else 0) • (![t.v₀, t.v₁, t.v₂] j : Point)
        = if j ∈ s then w j • (![t.v₀, t.v₁, t.v₂] j : Point) else 0 := by
      intro j; by_cases h : j ∈ s <;> simp [h]
    rw [show (fun j => if j ∈ s then w j else 0) 0 • (t.v₀ : Point)
          + (fun j => if j ∈ s then w j else 0) 1 • (t.v₁ : Point)
          + (fun j => if j ∈ s then w j else 0) 2 • (t.v₂ : Point)
        = ∑ j, (if j ∈ s then w j else 0) • (![t.v₀, t.v₁, t.v₂] j : Point) from by
        rw [Fin.sum_univ_three]; rfl]
    simp_rw [hsplit]; rw [Finset.sum_ite_mem, Finset.univ_inter]

name: triangleSet_subset_relint_union_edge
statement:
theorem triangleSet_subset_relint_union_edge (t : Triangle)
    (_hnd : NDeg t) :
    triangleSet t ⊆ triRelint t ∪ edgeSet t
proof:
:= by
  intro x hx
  obtain ⟨μ, hμ0, hμsum, hμx⟩ := triangleSet_bary t x hx
  by_cases hall : ∀ j, 0 < μ j
  · exact Or.inl ⟨μ, hall, hμsum, hμx⟩
  · 
    right
    push_neg at hall
    obtain ⟨k, hk⟩ := hall
    have hsum3 : μ 0 + μ 1 + μ 2 = 1 := by rw [Fin.sum_univ_three] at hμsum; exact hμsum
    unfold edgeSet
    
    have hzero : μ 0 = 0 ∨ μ 1 = 0 ∨ μ 2 = 0 := by
      have : μ k = 0 := le_antisymm hk (hμ0 k)
      fin_cases k <;> simp_all
    
    
    rcases hzero with h0 | h1 | h2
    · 
      left; right
      rw [segment_eq_image]
      refine ⟨μ 2, ⟨hμ0 2, by linarith [hμ0 1]⟩, ?_⟩
      show (1 - μ 2) • (t.v₁ : Point) + μ 2 • t.v₂ = x
      rw [hμx, h0]
      have h1 : (1 : ℚ) - μ 2 = μ 1 := by linarith
      rw [h1]; simp [add_comm]
    · 
      right
      rw [segment_eq_image]
      refine ⟨μ 0, ⟨hμ0 0, by linarith [hμ0 2]⟩, ?_⟩
      show (1 - μ 0) • (t.v₂ : Point) + μ 0 • t.v₀ = x
      rw [hμx, h1]
      have h2 : (1 : ℚ) - μ 0 = μ 2 := by linarith
      rw [h2]; simp [add_comm]
    · 
      left; left
      rw [segment_eq_image]
      refine ⟨μ 1, ⟨hμ0 1, by linarith [hμ0 0]⟩, ?_⟩
      show (1 - μ 1) • (t.v₀ : Point) + μ 1 • t.v₁ = x
      rw [hμx, h2]
      have h0 : (1 : ℚ) - μ 1 = μ 0 := by linarith
      rw [h0]; simp [add_comm]

name: triRelint_not_bary_zero
statement:
theorem triRelint_not_bary_zero (t : Triangle) (hnd : NDeg t) (x : Point)
    (μ : Fin 3 → ℚ) (hpos : ∀ j, 0 < μ j) (hsum : ∑ j, μ j = 1)
    (hx : x = μ 0 • (t.v₀ : Point) + μ 1 • (t.v₁ : Point) + μ 2 • (t.v₂ : Point))
    (ν : Fin 3 → ℚ) (hnsum : ∑ j, ν j = 1)
    (hxν : x = ν 0 • (t.v₀ : Point) + ν 1 • (t.v₁ : Point) + ν 2 • (t.v₂ : Point))
    (k : Fin 3) (hk : ν k = 0) : False
proof:
:= by
  have hrepμ : x = ∑ j, μ j • (![t.v₀, t.v₁, t.v₂] j : Point) := by
    rw [Fin.sum_univ_three]; simp only [Matrix.cons_val_zero, Matrix.cons_val_one,
      Matrix.head_cons, Matrix.cons_val_two, Matrix.tail_cons]; exact hx
  have hrepν : x = ∑ j, ν j • (![t.v₀, t.v₁, t.v₂] j : Point) := by
    rw [Fin.sum_univ_three]; simp only [Matrix.cons_val_zero, Matrix.cons_val_one,
      Matrix.head_cons, Matrix.cons_val_two, Matrix.tail_cons]; exact hxν
  have heqv := bary_unique t hnd μ ν hsum hnsum (by rw [← hrepμ, ← hrepν])
  have : μ k = ν k := congrFun heqv k
  rw [hk] at this
  exact absurd this (ne_of_gt (hpos k))

name: triRelint_edge_disjoint
statement:
theorem triRelint_edge_disjoint (t : Triangle) (hnd : NDeg t) :
    triRelint t ∩ edgeSet t = ∅
proof:
:= by
  rw [Set.eq_empty_iff_forall_not_mem]
  rintro x ⟨⟨μ, hpos, hsum, hx⟩, hedge⟩
  
  rcases hedge with (h | h) | h
  · 
    rw [segment_eq_image] at h
    obtain ⟨θ, _, hθeq⟩ := h
    exact triRelint_not_bary_zero t hnd x μ hpos hsum hx ![1-θ, θ, 0]
      (by simp [Fin.sum_univ_three])
      (by simp only [Matrix.cons_val_zero, Matrix.cons_val_one, Matrix.head_cons,
            Matrix.cons_val_two, Matrix.tail_cons]; rw [← hθeq]; simp) 2 rfl
  · 
    rw [segment_eq_image] at h
    obtain ⟨θ, _, hθeq⟩ := h
    exact triRelint_not_bary_zero t hnd x μ hpos hsum hx ![0, 1-θ, θ]
      (by simp [Fin.sum_univ_three])
      (by simp only [Matrix.cons_val_zero, Matrix.cons_val_one, Matrix.head_cons,
            Matrix.cons_val_two, Matrix.tail_cons]; rw [← hθeq]; simp) 0 rfl
  · 
    rw [segment_eq_image] at h
    obtain ⟨θ, _, hθeq⟩ := h
    exact triRelint_not_bary_zero t hnd x μ hpos hsum hx ![θ, 0, 1-θ]
      (by simp [Fin.sum_univ_three])
      (by simp only [Matrix.cons_val_zero, Matrix.cons_val_one, Matrix.head_cons,
            Matrix.cons_val_two, Matrix.tail_cons]; rw [← hθeq, zero_smul, add_zero,
            add_comm]) 1 rfl

name: triRelint_subset_triangleSet
statement:
theorem triRelint_subset_triangleSet (t : Triangle) :
    triRelint t ⊆ triangleSet t
proof:
:= by
  rintro x ⟨μ, hpos, hsum, rfl⟩
  exact mem_triangleSet_of_bary t μ (fun j => le_of_lt (hpos j)) hsum

name: instance_iff_relint_empty
statement:
theorem instance_iff_relint_empty (s t : Triangle) (hs : NDeg s) :
    (triangleSet s ∩ triangleSet t ⊆ edgeSet s) ↔
      triRelint s ∩ triangleSet t = ∅
proof:
:= by
  have hdisj := triRelint_edge_disjoint s hs
  constructor
  · 
    intro hcont
    rw [Set.eq_empty_iff_forall_not_mem]
    rintro p ⟨hpr, hpt⟩
    have hps : p ∈ triangleSet s := triRelint_subset_triangleSet s hpr
    have hpe : p ∈ edgeSet s := hcont ⟨hps, hpt⟩
    have : p ∈ triRelint s ∩ edgeSet s := ⟨hpr, hpe⟩
    rw [hdisj] at this; exact this
  · 
    intro hempty
    rintro p ⟨hps, hpt⟩
    rcases triangleSet_subset_relint_union_edge s hs hps with hpr | hpe
    · exfalso
      have : p ∈ triRelint s ∩ triangleSet t := ⟨hpr, hpt⟩
      rw [hempty] at this; exact this
    · exact hpe

name: inBox_convex
statement: theorem inBox_convex (box : Box3) : Convex ℚ {p : Point | inBox box p}
proof:
:= by
  have hco : ∀ (k : Fin 3) (c : ℚ), Convex ℚ {p : Point | c ≤ p k} := fun k c =>
    convex_halfSpace_ge (LinearMap.proj k).isLinear c
  have hco' : ∀ (k : Fin 3) (c : ℚ), Convex ℚ {p : Point | p k ≤ c} := fun k c =>
    convex_halfSpace_le (LinearMap.proj k).isLinear c
  have hset : {p : Point | inBox box p} =
      ({p | box.lo.x ≤ p 0} ∩ {p | p 0 ≤ box.hi.x}) ∩
        (({p | box.lo.y ≤ p 1} ∩ {p | p 1 ≤ box.hi.y}) ∩
          ({p | box.lo.z ≤ p 2} ∩ {p | p 2 ≤ box.hi.z})) := by
    ext p; simp [inBox, Set.mem_inter_iff, and_assoc]
  rw [hset]
  exact ((hco 0 _).inter (hco' 0 _)).inter
    (((hco 1 _).inter (hco' 1 _)).inter ((hco 2 _).inter (hco' 2 _)))

name: triangleSet_subset_boxOfTri
statement:
theorem triangleSet_subset_boxOfTri (S : Triangle) :
    triangleSet S ⊆ {p : Point | inBox (boxOfTri S) p}
proof:
:= by
  unfold triangleSet
  apply convexHull_min _ (inBox_convex _)
  intro v hv
  have hmem : ∀ q : Point, q ∈ edgeSet S → inBox (boxOfTri S) q :=
    fun q hq => edgeSet_subset_box S q hq
  simp only [Set.mem_insert_iff, Set.mem_singleton_iff] at hv
  rcases hv with h | h | h
  · subst h; exact hmem _ (by unfold edgeSet; exact Or.inl (Or.inl (left_mem_segment ℚ _ _)))
  · subst h; exact hmem _ (by unfold edgeSet; exact Or.inl (Or.inr (left_mem_segment ℚ _ _)))
  · subst h; exact hmem _ (by unfold edgeSet; exact Or.inr (left_mem_segment ℚ _ _))

name: boxesOverlap_of_common
statement:
theorem boxesOverlap_of_common (b₁ b₂ : Box3) (p : Point)
    (h₁ : inBox b₁ p) (h₂ : inBox b₂ p) : boxesOverlap b₁ b₂ = true
proof:
:= by
  by_contra hne
  rw [Bool.not_eq_true] at hne
  exact not_boxesOverlap_disjoint b₁ b₂ hne p h₁ h₂

name: mem_sortAscN
statement:
private theorem mem_sortAscN (s : Array Nat) (j : Nat) :
    j ∈ Impl.MeshIntersect.sortAscN s ↔ j ∈ s
proof:
:= by
  simp only [Impl.MeshIntersect.sortAscN, Array.mem_def, Array.toList_toArray,
    List.mem_mergeSort]

name: back
statement:
private theorem back?_eq_getLast? {α : Type*} (a : Array α) :
    a.back? = a.toList.getLast?
proof:
:= by
  rcases a with ⟨l⟩
  simp [Array.back?, List.getLast?_eq_getElem?]

name: dedupAdjN_eq
statement:
private theorem dedupAdjN_eq (arr : Array Nat) :
    Impl.MeshIntersect.dedupAdjN arr = arr.toList.foldl dstepN #[]
proof:
:= by
  rw [Impl.MeshIntersect.dedupAdjN, ← Array.foldl_toList]; rfl

name: dstepN_none
statement:
private theorem dstepN_none {acc : Array Nat} {i : Nat} (h : acc.back? = none) :
    dstepN acc i = acc.push i
proof: := by unfold dstepN; rw [h]

name: dstepN_some_eq
statement:
private theorem dstepN_some_eq {acc : Array Nat} {i u : Nat} (h : acc.back? = some u)
    (he : u == i) : dstepN acc i = acc
proof: := by unfold dstepN; rw [h]; simp [he]

name: dstepN_some_ne
statement:
private theorem dstepN_some_ne {acc : Array Nat} {i u : Nat} (h : acc.back? = some u)
    (he : ¬ (u == i)) : dstepN acc i = acc.push i
proof: := by unfold dstepN; rw [h]; simp [he]

name: dstepN_fold_mono
proof:
:= by
  intro l
  induction l with
  | nil => exact fun acc i hi => hi
  | cons j rest ih =>
    intro acc i hi
    rw [List.foldl_cons]
    apply ih
    rcases hb : acc.back? with - | u
    · rw [dstepN_none hb]; simpa using Or.inl hi
    · by_cases he : u == j
      · rw [dstepN_some_eq hb he]; exact hi
      · rw [dstepN_some_ne hb he]; simpa using Or.inl hi

name: dstepN_fold_complete
proof:
:= by
  intro l
  induction l with
  | nil => intro acc i hi; exact absurd hi (List.not_mem_nil i)
  | cons j rest ih =>
    intro acc i hi
    rw [List.foldl_cons]
    rcases List.mem_cons.mp hi with rfl | hi'
    · rcases hb : acc.back? with - | u
      · rw [dstepN_none hb]; exact dstepN_fold_mono rest _ i (by simp)
      · by_cases he : u == i
        · rw [dstepN_some_eq hb he]
          have huu : u = i := by simpa using he
          have hu_mem : u ∈ acc.toList := by
            rw [back?_eq_getLast?] at hb
            exact List.mem_of_mem_getLast? hb
          rw [← huu]
          exact dstepN_fold_mono rest acc u hu_mem
        · rw [dstepN_some_ne hb he]; exact dstepN_fold_mono rest _ i (by simp)
    · exact ih (dstepN acc j) i hi'

name: dstepN_fold_subset
proof:
:= by
  intro l
  induction l with
  | nil => intro acc i hi; exact Or.inl (by simpa using hi)
  | cons j rest ih =>
    intro acc i hi
    rw [List.foldl_cons] at hi
    have hstep : i ∈ (dstepN acc j).toList → i ∈ acc.toList ∨ i = j := by
      intro h
      rcases hb : acc.back? with - | u
      · rw [dstepN_none hb, show (acc.push j).toList = acc.toList ++ [j] from by simp,
          List.mem_append, List.mem_singleton] at h
        exact h
      · by_cases he : u == j
        · rw [dstepN_some_eq hb he] at h; exact Or.inl h
        · rw [dstepN_some_ne hb he, show (acc.push j).toList = acc.toList ++ [j] from by simp,
            List.mem_append, List.mem_singleton] at h
          exact h
    rcases ih (dstepN acc j) i hi with h | h
    · rcases hstep h with h' | h'
      · exact Or.inl h'
      · exact Or.inr (h' ▸ List.mem_cons_self _ _)
    · exact Or.inr (List.mem_cons_of_mem _ h)

name: mem_dedupAdjN
statement:
private theorem mem_dedupAdjN (s : Array Nat) (j : Nat) :
    j ∈ Impl.MeshIntersect.dedupAdjN s ↔ j ∈ s
proof:
:= by
  rw [dedupAdjN_eq, Array.mem_def]
  constructor
  · intro h
    rcases dstepN_fold_subset s.toList #[] j h with h' | h'
    · simp at h'
    · exact Array.mem_def.mpr h'
  · intro h
    exact dstepN_fold_complete s.toList #[] j (Array.mem_def.mp h)

name: overlap_box3ToBVH
statement:
private theorem overlap_box3ToBVH (u v : Box3) :
    Impl.BVH.overlap (box3ToBVH u) (box3ToBVH v) = boxesOverlap u v
proof: := rfl

name: nsiBoxes_size
statement:
private theorem nsiBoxes_size (A : Array (FaceH × Box3)) :
    (A.map (fun fb => box3ToBVH fb.2)).size = A.size
proof: := by simp

name: nsiBoxes_getD
statement:
private theorem nsiBoxes_getD (A : Array (FaceH × Box3)) (j : Nat) (hj : j < A.size) :
    (A.map (fun fb => box3ToBVH fb.2)).getD j default = box3ToBVH ((A.getD j default).2)
proof:
:= by
  have hj' : j < (A.map (fun fb => box3ToBVH fb.2)).size := by rw [nsiBoxes_size]; exact hj
  rw [Array.getD_eq_get?, Array.getElem?_eq_getElem hj', Option.getD_some, Array.getElem_map,
    Array.getD_eq_get?, Array.getElem?_eq_getElem hj, Option.getD_some]

name: mem_nsiCandidates
statement:
theorem mem_nsiCandidates (A : Array (FaceH × Box3)) (a b : Nat) (hab : a < b)
    (hb : b < A.size)
    (hovl : boxesOverlap (A.getD a default).2 (A.getD b default).2 = true) :
    (a, b) ∈ nsiCandidates A
proof:
:= by
  
  
  
  
  unfold nsiCandidates
  rw [show Array.range A.size = (List.range A.size).toArray from by apply Array.ext'; simp]
  rw [Array.flatMap_toArray, Array.mem_def]
  simp only [Array.toList_toArray, List.mem_flatMap, List.mem_range, Array.toList_map,
    List.mem_map, Array.toList_filter, List.mem_filter]
  
  refine ⟨a, hab.trans hb, b, ⟨⟨?_, ?_⟩, rfl⟩⟩
  · 
    rw [← Array.mem_def, mem_dedupAdjN, mem_sortAscN]
    apply CSG.Proof.BVH.boxQuery_sound
    · rw [nsiBoxes_size]; exact hb
    · rw [nsiBoxes_getD A b hb, overlap_box3ToBVH]; exact hovl
  · 
    simp only [hab, decide_true, Bool.true_and]
    simpa only [Array.getD_eq_get?] using hovl

name: nsiCandidates_sound
statement:
theorem nsiCandidates_sound (M : Mesh) (i j : Fin M.size) (hij : i ≠ j)
    (hne : (triangleSet M[i] ∩ triangleSet M[j]).Nonempty) :
    (min i.1 j.1, max i.1 j.1) ∈ nsiCandidates (materialize M)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨p, hpi, hpj⟩ := hne
  have hsz : (materialize M).size = M.size := materialize_size M
  
  have hbox : ∀ k : Fin M.size,
      ((materialize M).getD k.1 default).2 = boxOfTri M[k] := by
    intro k
    have hk : k.1 < (materialize M).size := by rw [hsz]; exact k.2
    rw [Array.getD_eq_get?, Array.getElem?_eq_getElem hk, Option.getD_some]
    have heq : (materialize M)[k.1]'hk = (materialize M)[(⟨k.1, hk⟩ : Fin _)] := rfl
    rw [heq, materialize_getElem M ⟨k.1, hk⟩ k.2]
    rfl
  
  have hpbi : inBox (boxOfTri M[i]) p := triangleSet_subset_boxOfTri M[i] hpi
  have hpbj : inBox (boxOfTri M[j]) p := triangleSet_subset_boxOfTri M[j] hpj
  
  rcases lt_or_gt_of_ne (by simpa [Fin.ext_iff] using hij : i.1 ≠ j.1) with hlt | hgt
  · rw [min_eq_left (le_of_lt hlt), max_eq_right (le_of_lt hlt)]
    apply mem_nsiCandidates _ _ _ hlt (by rw [hsz]; exact j.2)
    rw [hbox i, hbox j]
    exact boxesOverlap_of_common _ _ p hpbi hpbj
  · rw [min_eq_right (le_of_lt hgt), max_eq_left (le_of_lt hgt)]
    apply mem_nsiCandidates _ _ _ hgt (by rw [hsz]; exact i.2)
    rw [hbox j, hbox i]
    exact boxesOverlap_of_common _ _ p hpbj hpbi

name: dotProduct_isLinear
statement: theorem dotProduct_isLinear (n : Point) : IsLinearMap ℚ (fun x : Point => n ⬝ᵥ x)

name: affineHalfSpace_gt_convex
statement:
theorem affineHalfSpace_gt_convex (n p : Point) :
    Convex ℚ {x : Point | 0 < n ⬝ᵥ (x - p)}
proof:
:= by
  rw [show {x : Point | 0 < n ⬝ᵥ (x - p)} = {x : Point | n ⬝ᵥ p < n ⬝ᵥ x} from by
    ext x; simp only [Set.mem_setOf_eq, dotProduct_sub]; constructor <;> intro h <;> linarith]
  exact convex_halfSpace_gt (dotProduct_isLinear n) _

name: affineHalfSpace_lt_convex
statement:
theorem affineHalfSpace_lt_convex (n p : Point) :
    Convex ℚ {x : Point | n ⬝ᵥ (x - p) < 0}
proof:
:= by
  rw [show {x : Point | n ⬝ᵥ (x - p) < 0} = {x : Point | n ⬝ᵥ x < n ⬝ᵥ p} from by
    ext x; simp only [Set.mem_setOf_eq, dotProduct_sub]; constructor <;> intro h <;> linarith]
  exact convex_halfSpace_lt (dotProduct_isLinear n) _

name: affineHalfSpace_ge_convex
statement:
theorem affineHalfSpace_ge_convex (n p : Point) :
    Convex ℚ {x : Point | 0 ≤ n ⬝ᵥ (x - p)}
proof:
:= by
  rw [show {x : Point | 0 ≤ n ⬝ᵥ (x - p)} = {x : Point | n ⬝ᵥ p ≤ n ⬝ᵥ x} from by
    ext x; simp only [Set.mem_setOf_eq, dotProduct_sub]; constructor <;> intro h <;> linarith]
  exact convex_halfSpace_ge (dotProduct_isLinear n) _

name: affineHalfSpace_le_convex
statement:
theorem affineHalfSpace_le_convex (n p : Point) :
    Convex ℚ {x : Point | n ⬝ᵥ (x - p) ≤ 0}
proof:
:= by
  rw [show {x : Point | n ⬝ᵥ (x - p) ≤ 0} = {x : Point | n ⬝ᵥ x ≤ n ⬝ᵥ p} from by
    ext x; simp only [Set.mem_setOf_eq, dotProduct_sub]; constructor <;> intro h <;> linarith]
  exact convex_halfSpace_le (dotProduct_isLinear n) _

name: triangleSet_functional_nonneg
statement:
theorem triangleSet_functional_nonneg (t : Triangle) (n p : Point)
    (h0 : 0 ≤ n ⬝ᵥ ((t.v₀ : Point) - p)) (h1 : 0 ≤ n ⬝ᵥ ((t.v₁ : Point) - p))
    (h2 : 0 ≤ n ⬝ᵥ ((t.v₂ : Point) - p)) :
    ∀ x ∈ triangleSet t, 0 ≤ n ⬝ᵥ (x - p)
proof:
:= by
  have hsub : triangleSet t ⊆ {x : Point | 0 ≤ n ⬝ᵥ (x - p)} := by
    unfold triangleSet
    apply convexHull_min _ (affineHalfSpace_ge_convex n p)
    intro v hv
    simp only [Set.mem_insert_iff, Set.mem_singleton_iff] at hv
    rcases hv with h | h | h <;> subst h <;> assumption
  exact fun x hx => hsub hx

name: triangleSet_functional_nonpos
statement:
theorem triangleSet_functional_nonpos (t : Triangle) (n p : Point)
    (h0 : n ⬝ᵥ ((t.v₀ : Point) - p) ≤ 0) (h1 : n ⬝ᵥ ((t.v₁ : Point) - p) ≤ 0)
    (h2 : n ⬝ᵥ ((t.v₂ : Point) - p) ≤ 0) :
    ∀ x ∈ triangleSet t, n ⬝ᵥ (x - p) ≤ 0
proof:
:= by
  have hsub : triangleSet t ⊆ {x : Point | n ⬝ᵥ (x - p) ≤ 0} := by
    unfold triangleSet
    apply convexHull_min _ (affineHalfSpace_le_convex n p)
    intro v hv
    simp only [Set.mem_insert_iff, Set.mem_singleton_iff] at hv
    rcases hv with h | h | h <;> subst h <;> assumption
  exact fun x hx => hsub hx

name: triangleSet_subset_plane
statement:
theorem triangleSet_subset_plane (t : Triangle) (n p : Point) (c : ℚ)
    (h0 : n ⬝ᵥ ((t.v₀ : Point) - p) = c) (h1 : n ⬝ᵥ ((t.v₁ : Point) - p) = c)
    (h2 : n ⬝ᵥ ((t.v₂ : Point) - p) = c) :
    triangleSet t ⊆ {x : Point | n ⬝ᵥ (x - p) = c}
proof:
:= by
  intro x hx
  obtain ⟨μ, hμ0, hμsum, rfl⟩ := triangleSet_bary t x hx
  have hsum3 : μ 0 + μ 1 + μ 2 = 1 := by rw [Fin.sum_univ_three] at hμsum; exact hμsum
  show n ⬝ᵥ ((μ 0 • (t.v₀ : Point) + μ 1 • (t.v₁ : Point) + μ 2 • (t.v₂ : Point)) - p) = c
  
  have hkey : (μ 0 • (t.v₀ : Point) + μ 1 • (t.v₁ : Point) + μ 2 • (t.v₂ : Point)) - p
      = μ 0 • ((t.v₀ : Point) - p) + μ 1 • ((t.v₁ : Point) - p) + μ 2 • ((t.v₂ : Point) - p) := by
    match_scalars <;> linarith [hsum3]
  rw [hkey]
  simp only [dotProduct_add, dotProduct_smul, smul_eq_mul, h0, h1, h2]
  linear_combination c * hsum3

name: strict_separation_disjoint
statement:
theorem strict_separation_disjoint (s t : Triangle) (n p : Point)
    (hsplane : triangleSet s ⊆ {x : Point | n ⬝ᵥ (x - p) = 0})
    (ht0 : 0 < n ⬝ᵥ ((t.v₀ : Point) - p)) (ht1 : 0 < n ⬝ᵥ ((t.v₁ : Point) - p))
    (ht2 : 0 < n ⬝ᵥ ((t.v₂ : Point) - p)) :
    triangleSet s ∩ triangleSet t = ∅
proof:
:= by
  have httgt : triangleSet t ⊆ {x : Point | 0 < n ⬝ᵥ (x - p)} := by
    unfold triangleSet
    apply convexHull_min _ (affineHalfSpace_gt_convex n p)
    intro v hv
    simp only [Set.mem_insert_iff, Set.mem_singleton_iff] at hv
    rcases hv with h | h | h <;> subst h <;> assumption
  rw [Set.eq_empty_iff_forall_not_mem]
  rintro x ⟨hxs, hxt⟩
  have h1 : n ⬝ᵥ (x - p) = 0 := hsplane hxs
  have h2 : 0 < n ⬝ᵥ (x - p) := httgt hxt
  rw [h1] at h2; exact lt_irrefl 0 h2

name: strict_separation_disjoint_neg
statement:
theorem strict_separation_disjoint_neg (s t : Triangle) (n p : Point)
    (hsplane : triangleSet s ⊆ {x : Point | n ⬝ᵥ (x - p) = 0})
    (ht0 : n ⬝ᵥ ((t.v₀ : Point) - p) < 0) (ht1 : n ⬝ᵥ ((t.v₁ : Point) - p) < 0)
    (ht2 : n ⬝ᵥ ((t.v₂ : Point) - p) < 0) :
    triangleSet s ∩ triangleSet t = ∅
proof:
:= by
  have httlt : triangleSet t ⊆ {x : Point | n ⬝ᵥ (x - p) < 0} := by
    unfold triangleSet
    apply convexHull_min _ (affineHalfSpace_lt_convex n p)
    intro v hv
    simp only [Set.mem_insert_iff, Set.mem_singleton_iff] at hv
    rcases hv with h | h | h <;> subst h <;> assumption
  rw [Set.eq_empty_iff_forall_not_mem]
  rintro x ⟨hxs, hxt⟩
  have h1 : n ⬝ᵥ (x - p) = 0 := hsplane hxs
  have h2 : n ⬝ᵥ (x - p) < 0 := httlt hxt
  rw [h1] at h2; exact lt_irrefl 0 h2

name: disjoint_pair_ok
statement:
theorem disjoint_pair_ok (s t : Triangle) (hdisj : triangleSet s ∩ triangleSet t = ∅) :
    (triangleSet s ∩ triangleSet t ⊆ edgeSet s) ∧
      (triangleSet s ∩ triangleSet t ⊆ edgeSet t)
proof:
:= by
  rw [hdisj]; exact ⟨Set.empty_subset _, Set.empty_subset _⟩

name: faceNormal_dot_vertex
statement:
theorem faceNormal_dot_vertex (t : Triangle) :
    let n
proof:
:= crossProduct ((t.v₁ : Point) - t.v₀) ((t.v₂ : Point) - t.v₀)
    n ⬝ᵥ ((t.v₀ : Point) - t.v₀) = 0 ∧ n ⬝ᵥ ((t.v₁ : Point) - t.v₀) = 0 ∧
      n ⬝ᵥ ((t.v₂ : Point) - t.v₀) = 0 := by
  intro n
  refine ⟨by simp, ?_, ?_⟩
  · show crossProduct ((t.v₁ : Point) - t.v₀) ((t.v₂ : Point) - t.v₀) ⬝ᵥ ((t.v₁ : Point) - t.v₀) = 0
    rw [dotProduct_comm]; exact dot_self_cross _ _
  · show crossProduct ((t.v₁ : Point) - t.v₀) ((t.v₂ : Point) - t.v₀) ⬝ᵥ ((t.v₂ : Point) - t.v₀) = 0
    rw [dotProduct_comm]; exact dot_cross_self _ _

name: noncoplanar_line_dir
statement:
theorem noncoplanar_line_dir (t : Triangle) (ns q : Point)
    (hnt : crossProduct ((t.v₁ : Point) - t.v₀) ((t.v₂ : Point) - t.v₀) ≠ 0)
    (hnc : ¬ (ns ⬝ᵥ ((t.v₀ : Point) - q) = ns ⬝ᵥ ((t.v₁ : Point) - q) ∧
              ns ⬝ᵥ ((t.v₁ : Point) - q) = ns ⬝ᵥ ((t.v₂ : Point) - q))) :
    crossProduct ns (crossProduct ((t.v₁ : Point) - t.v₀) ((t.v₂ : Point) - t.v₀)) ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  set nt := crossProduct ((t.v₁ : Point) - t.v₀) ((t.v₂ : Point) - t.v₀) with hnt_def
  
  rw [crossProduct_ne_zero_iff_linearIndependent, LinearIndependent.pair_iff' (by
    
    intro hns0
    apply hnc
    rw [hns0]; simp)]
  intro a ha
  
  obtain ⟨_, h1, h2⟩ := faceNormal_dot_vertex t
  
  have ha0 : a ≠ 0 := by
    rintro rfl; rw [zero_smul] at ha; exact hnt ha.symm
  
  have key1 : ns ⬝ᵥ ((t.v₁ : Point) - t.v₀) = 0 := by
    have hmul : a * (ns ⬝ᵥ ((t.v₁ : Point) - t.v₀)) = 0 := by
      have hh : nt ⬝ᵥ ((t.v₁ : Point) - t.v₀) = 0 := h1
      rw [← ha, smul_dotProduct, smul_eq_mul] at hh; exact hh
    rcases mul_eq_zero.mp hmul with h | h
    · exact absurd h ha0
    · exact h
  have key2 : ns ⬝ᵥ ((t.v₂ : Point) - t.v₀) = 0 := by
    have hmul : a * (ns ⬝ᵥ ((t.v₂ : Point) - t.v₀)) = 0 := by
      have hh : nt ⬝ᵥ ((t.v₂ : Point) - t.v₀) = 0 := h2
      rw [← ha, smul_dotProduct, smul_eq_mul] at hh; exact hh
    rcases mul_eq_zero.mp hmul with h | h
    · exact absurd h ha0
    · exact h
  
  apply hnc
  refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
  · have hdiff : ns ⬝ᵥ ((t.v₁ : Point) - q) - ns ⬝ᵥ ((t.v₀ : Point) - q)
        = ns ⬝ᵥ ((t.v₁ : Point) - t.v₀) := by rw [← dotProduct_sub]; congr 1; abel
    linarith [key1, hdiff]
  · have hdiff : ns ⬝ᵥ ((t.v₂ : Point) - q) - ns ⬝ᵥ ((t.v₁ : Point) - q)
        = ns ⬝ᵥ ((t.v₂ : Point) - t.v₀) - ns ⬝ᵥ ((t.v₁ : Point) - t.v₀) := by
      rw [← dotProduct_sub, ← dotProduct_sub]; congr 1; abel
    linarith [key1, key2, hdiff]

name: sign_eq_of_cast_pos_mul
statement:
theorem sign_eq_of_cast_pos_mul (z : ℤ) (c r : ℚ) (hc : 0 < c)
    (hzr : (z : ℚ) = c * r) :
    (Int.sign z = 1 ↔ 0 < r) ∧ (Int.sign z = -1 ↔ r < 0) ∧ (Int.sign z = 0 ↔ r = 0)
proof:
:= by
  have hz0 : (0 : ℚ) < (z : ℚ) ↔ 0 < r := by rw [hzr]; constructor <;> intro h <;> nlinarith
  have hzn : (z : ℚ) < 0 ↔ r < 0 := by rw [hzr]; constructor <;> intro h <;> nlinarith
  have hze : (z : ℚ) = 0 ↔ r = 0 := by
    rw [hzr]; constructor
    · intro h; rcases mul_eq_zero.mp h with h' | h'
      · exact absurd h' (ne_of_gt hc)
      · exact h'
    · intro h; rw [h, mul_zero]
  refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · rw [Int.sign_eq_one_iff_pos, ← hz0]; exact ⟨fun h => by exact_mod_cast h, fun h => by exact_mod_cast h⟩
  · rw [Int.sign_eq_neg_one_iff_neg, ← hzn]; exact ⟨fun h => by exact_mod_cast h, fun h => by exact_mod_cast h⟩
  · rw [Int.sign_eq_zero_iff_zero, ← hze]; exact ⟨fun h => by exact_mod_cast h, fun h => by exact_mod_cast h⟩

name: dotI_sideS_cast
statement:
theorem dotI_sideS_cast (S T : Triangle) (vsel : I3) (qsel : Point)
    (hv : decI vsel = (((faceHOf T).w * (faceHOf S).w : ℤ) : ℚ) • qsel) :
    ((dotI (Impl.WellFormedCheck.faceNormal (rescale (faceHOf T).w (faceHOf S))) (subI vsel
        (rescale (faceHOf T).w (faceHOf S)).v₀) : ℤ) : ℚ)
      = (((faceHOf T).w * (faceHOf S).w : ℤ) : ℚ) ^ 3 *
        (crossProduct ((S.v₁ : Point) - S.v₀) ((S.v₂ : Point) - S.v₀) ⬝ᵥ (qsel - S.v₀))
proof:
:= by
  rw [decI_dot, decI_faceNormal_S, decI_sub, hv, decI_rescaleS_v₀, ← smul_sub,
    smul_dotProduct, dotProduct_smul, smul_eq_mul, smul_eq_mul]
  ring

        (rescale (faceHOf S).w (faceHOf T)).v₀) : ℤ) : ℚ)

name: sigma_entry_sign
statement:
theorem sigma_entry_sign (S T : Triangle) (vsel : I3) (qsel : Point)
    (hv : decI vsel = (((faceHOf T).w * (faceHOf S).w : ℤ) : ℚ) • qsel) :
    (Int.sign (dotI (Impl.WellFormedCheck.faceNormal (rescale (faceHOf T).w (faceHOf S)))
        (subI vsel (rescale (faceHOf T).w (faceHOf S)).v₀)) = 1 ↔
      0 < crossProduct ((S.v₁ : Point) - S.v₀) ((S.v₂ : Point) - S.v₀) ⬝ᵥ (qsel - S.v₀)) ∧
    (Int.sign (dotI (Impl.WellFormedCheck.faceNormal (rescale (faceHOf T).w (faceHOf S)))
        (subI vsel (rescale (faceHOf T).w (faceHOf S)).v₀)) = -1 ↔
      crossProduct ((S.v₁ : Point) - S.v₀) ((S.v₂ : Point) - S.v₀) ⬝ᵥ (qsel - S.v₀) < 0) ∧
    (Int.sign (dotI (Impl.WellFormedCheck.faceNormal (rescale (faceHOf T).w (faceHOf S)))
        (subI vsel (rescale (faceHOf T).w (faceHOf S)).v₀)) = 0 ↔
      crossProduct ((S.v₁ : Point) - S.v₀) ((S.v₂ : Point) - S.v₀) ⬝ᵥ (qsel - S.v₀) = 0)
proof:
:= by
  have hΛ3 : (0 : ℚ) < (((faceHOf T).w * (faceHOf S).w : ℤ) : ℚ) ^ 3 := by
    have := sharedScale_pos S T; positivity
  exact sign_eq_of_cast_pos_mul _ _ _ hΛ3 (dotI_sideS_cast S T vsel qsel hv)

name: sideSigns_all_eq
statement:
theorem sideSigns_all_eq (ns sv0 : I3) (f : FaceH) (v : Int) :
    (sideSigns ns sv0 (vertsOf f)).all (fun s => s == v) = true ↔
      ((sideSigns ns sv0 (vertsOf f)).getD 0 0 = v ∧
       (sideSigns ns sv0 (vertsOf f)).getD 1 0 = v ∧
       (sideSigns ns sv0 (vertsOf f)).getD 2 0 = v)
proof:
:= by
  rw [show sideSigns ns sv0 (vertsOf f)
        = #[(dotI ns (subI f.v₀ sv0)).sign, (dotI ns (subI f.v₁ sv0)).sign,
            (dotI ns (subI f.v₂ sv0)).sign] from by simp [sideSigns, vertsOf]]
  rw [Array.all_eq_true]
  constructor
  · intro h
    refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_⟩
    · have := h ⟨0, by simp⟩; simpa [Array.getD] using this
    · have := h ⟨1, by simp⟩; simpa [Array.getD] using this
    · have := h ⟨2, by simp⟩; simpa [Array.getD] using this
  · rintro ⟨h0, h1, h2⟩ i
    simp only [Array.getD] at h0 h1 h2
    fin_cases i
    · simpa using h0
    · simpa using h1
    · simpa using h2

name: case1_sigma_disjoint
statement:
theorem case1_sigma_disjoint (S T : Triangle) (_hS : NDeg S)
    (hone : allStrictOneSide (sideSigns (Impl.WellFormedCheck.faceNormal (rescale (faceHOf T).w (faceHOf S)))
      (rescale (faceHOf T).w (faceHOf S)).v₀ (vertsOf (rescale (faceHOf S).w (faceHOf T)))) = true) :
    triangleSet S ∩ triangleSet T = ∅
proof:
:= by
  set sfS := rescale (faceHOf T).w (faceHOf S) with hsfS
  set sfT := rescale (faceHOf S).w (faceHOf T) with hsfT
  set nS := crossProduct ((S.v₁ : Point) - S.v₀) ((S.v₂ : Point) - S.v₀) with hnS
  
  have e0 := sigma_entry_sign S T sfT.v₀ T.v₀ (by rw [hsfT, decI_rescaleT_v₀, mul_comm])
  have e1 := sigma_entry_sign S T sfT.v₁ T.v₁ (by rw [hsfT, decI_rescaleT_v₁, mul_comm])
  have e2 := sigma_entry_sign S T sfT.v₂ T.v₂ (by rw [hsfT, decI_rescaleT_v₂, mul_comm])
  
  have hg0 : (sideSigns (Impl.WellFormedCheck.faceNormal sfS) sfS.v₀ (vertsOf sfT)).getD 0 0
      = Int.sign (dotI (Impl.WellFormedCheck.faceNormal sfS) (subI sfT.v₀ sfS.v₀)) := by
    simp [sideSigns, vertsOf, Array.getD]
  have hg1 : (sideSigns (Impl.WellFormedCheck.faceNormal sfS) sfS.v₀ (vertsOf sfT)).getD 1 0
      = Int.sign (dotI (Impl.WellFormedCheck.faceNormal sfS) (subI sfT.v₁ sfS.v₀)) := by
    simp [sideSigns, vertsOf, Array.getD]
  have hg2 : (sideSigns (Impl.WellFormedCheck.faceNormal sfS) sfS.v₀ (vertsOf sfT)).getD 2 0
      = Int.sign (dotI (Impl.WellFormedCheck.faceNormal sfS) (subI sfT.v₂ sfS.v₀)) := by
    simp [sideSigns, vertsOf, Array.getD]
  have hsplane : triangleSet S ⊆ {x : Point | nS ⬝ᵥ (x - S.v₀) = 0} :=
    triangleSet_subset_facePlane S
  rw [allStrictOneSide, Bool.or_eq_true, sideSigns_all_eq, sideSigns_all_eq,
    hg0, hg1, hg2] at hone
  rcases hone with ⟨p0, p1, p2⟩ | ⟨p0, p1, p2⟩
  · 
    exact strict_separation_disjoint S T nS S.v₀ hsplane
      (e0.1.mp p0) (e1.1.mp p1) (e2.1.mp p2)
  · 
    exact strict_separation_disjoint_neg S T nS S.v₀ hsplane
      (e0.2.1.mp p0) (e1.2.1.mp p1) (e2.2.1.mp p2)

name: case1_tau_disjoint
statement:
theorem case1_tau_disjoint (S T : Triangle) (_hT : NDeg T)
    (hone : allStrictOneSide (sideSigns (Impl.WellFormedCheck.faceNormal (rescale (faceHOf S).w (faceHOf T)))
      (rescale (faceHOf S).w (faceHOf T)).v₀ (vertsOf (rescale (faceHOf T).w (faceHOf S)))) = true) :

proof:
:= by

  set nT := crossProduct ((T.v₁ : Point) - T.v₀) ((T.v₂ : Point) - T.v₀) with hnT
  have e0 := tau_entry_sign S T sfS.v₀ S.v₀ (by rw [hsfS, decI_rescaleS_v₀, mul_comm])
  have e1 := tau_entry_sign S T sfS.v₁ S.v₁ (by rw [hsfS, decI_rescaleS_v₁, mul_comm])
  have e2 := tau_entry_sign S T sfS.v₂ S.v₂ (by rw [hsfS, decI_rescaleS_v₂, mul_comm])
  have hg0 : (sideSigns (Impl.WellFormedCheck.faceNormal sfT) sfT.v₀ (vertsOf sfS)).getD 0 0
      = Int.sign (dotI (Impl.WellFormedCheck.faceNormal sfT) (subI sfS.v₀ sfT.v₀)) := by
    simp [sideSigns, vertsOf, Array.getD]
  have hg1 : (sideSigns (Impl.WellFormedCheck.faceNormal sfT) sfT.v₀ (vertsOf sfS)).getD 1 0
      = Int.sign (dotI (Impl.WellFormedCheck.faceNormal sfT) (subI sfS.v₁ sfT.v₀)) := by
    simp [sideSigns, vertsOf, Array.getD]
  have hg2 : (sideSigns (Impl.WellFormedCheck.faceNormal sfT) sfT.v₀ (vertsOf sfS)).getD 2 0
      = Int.sign (dotI (Impl.WellFormedCheck.faceNormal sfT) (subI sfS.v₂ sfT.v₀)) := by
    simp [sideSigns, vertsOf, Array.getD]
  have hsplane : triangleSet T ⊆ {x : Point | nT ⬝ᵥ (x - T.v₀) = 0} :=
    triangleSet_subset_facePlane T
  rw [allStrictOneSide, Bool.or_eq_true, sideSigns_all_eq, sideSigns_all_eq,
    hg0, hg1, hg2] at hone
  rw [Set.inter_comm]
  rcases hone with ⟨p0, p1, p2⟩ | ⟨p0, p1, p2⟩
  · exact strict_separation_disjoint T S nT T.v₀ hsplane
      (e0.1.mp p0) (e1.1.mp p1) (e2.1.mp p2)
  · exact strict_separation_disjoint_neg T S nT T.v₀ hsplane
      (e0.2.1.mp p0) (e1.2.1.mp p1) (e2.2.1.mp p2)

name: sigma_mixed_nonconstant
statement:
theorem sigma_mixed_nonconstant (S T : Triangle)
    (hns1 : allStrictOneSide (sideSigns (Impl.WellFormedCheck.faceNormal (rescale (faceHOf T).w (faceHOf S)))
      (rescale (faceHOf T).w (faceHOf S)).v₀ (vertsOf (rescale (faceHOf S).w (faceHOf T)))) = false)
    (hncop : allZero (sideSigns (Impl.WellFormedCheck.faceNormal (rescale (faceHOf T).w (faceHOf S)))
      (rescale (faceHOf T).w (faceHOf S)).v₀ (vertsOf (rescale (faceHOf S).w (faceHOf T)))) = false) :
    ¬ (crossProduct ((S.v₁ : Point) - S.v₀) ((S.v₂ : Point) - S.v₀) ⬝ᵥ ((T.v₀ : Point) - S.v₀)
        = crossProduct ((S.v₁ : Point) - S.v₀) ((S.v₂ : Point) - S.v₀) ⬝ᵥ ((T.v₁ : Point) - S.v₀)
      ∧ crossProduct ((S.v₁ : Point) - S.v₀) ((S.v₂ : Point) - S.v₀) ⬝ᵥ ((T.v₁ : Point) - S.v₀)
        = crossProduct ((S.v₁ : Point) - S.v₀) ((S.v₂ : Point) - S.v₀) ⬝ᵥ ((T.v₂ : Point) - S.v₀))
proof:
:= by
  set sfS := rescale (faceHOf T).w (faceHOf S) with hsfS
  set sfT := rescale (faceHOf S).w (faceHOf T) with hsfT
  set nS := crossProduct ((S.v₁ : Point) - S.v₀) ((S.v₂ : Point) - S.v₀) with hnS
  rintro ⟨h01, h12⟩
  
  have e0 := sigma_entry_sign S T sfT.v₀ T.v₀ (by rw [hsfT, decI_rescaleT_v₀, mul_comm])
  have e1 := sigma_entry_sign S T sfT.v₁ T.v₁ (by rw [hsfT, decI_rescaleT_v₁, mul_comm])
  have e2 := sigma_entry_sign S T sfT.v₂ T.v₂ (by rw [hsfT, decI_rescaleT_v₂, mul_comm])
  
  have hg0 : (sideSigns (Impl.WellFormedCheck.faceNormal sfS) sfS.v₀ (vertsOf sfT)).getD 0 0
      = Int.sign (dotI (Impl.WellFormedCheck.faceNormal sfS) (subI sfT.v₀ sfS.v₀)) := by simp [sideSigns, vertsOf, Array.getD]
  have hg1 : (sideSigns (Impl.WellFormedCheck.faceNormal sfS) sfS.v₀ (vertsOf sfT)).getD 1 0
      = Int.sign (dotI (Impl.WellFormedCheck.faceNormal sfS) (subI sfT.v₁ sfS.v₀)) := by simp [sideSigns, vertsOf, Array.getD]
  have hg2 : (sideSigns (Impl.WellFormedCheck.faceNormal sfS) sfS.v₀ (vertsOf sfT)).getD 2 0
      = Int.sign (dotI (Impl.WellFormedCheck.faceNormal sfS) (subI sfT.v₂ sfS.v₀)) := by simp [sideSigns, vertsOf, Array.getD]
  have hns1' := hns1
  rw [allStrictOneSide, Bool.or_eq_false_iff] at hns1'
  
  rcases lt_trichotomy (nS ⬝ᵥ ((T.v₀ : Point) - S.v₀)) 0 with hc | hc | hc
  · 
    have hall : (sideSigns (Impl.WellFormedCheck.faceNormal sfS) sfS.v₀ (vertsOf sfT)).all (fun s => s == -1) = true := by
      rw [sideSigns_all_eq, hg0, hg1, hg2,
        e0.2.1.mpr hc, e1.2.1.mpr (h01 ▸ hc), e2.2.1.mpr (h12 ▸ h01 ▸ hc)]
      exact ⟨rfl, rfl, rfl⟩
    rw [hall] at hns1'; exact absurd hns1'.2 (by simp)
  · 
    have hall : (sideSigns (Impl.WellFormedCheck.faceNormal sfS) sfS.v₀ (vertsOf sfT)).all (fun s => s == 0) = true := by
      rw [sideSigns_all_eq, hg0, hg1, hg2,
        e0.2.2.mpr hc, e1.2.2.mpr (h01 ▸ hc), e2.2.2.mpr (h12 ▸ h01 ▸ hc)]
      exact ⟨rfl, rfl, rfl⟩
    rw [allZero, hall] at hncop; exact absurd hncop (by simp)
  · 
    have hall : (sideSigns (Impl.WellFormedCheck.faceNormal sfS) sfS.v₀ (vertsOf sfT)).all (fun s => s == 1) = true := by
      rw [sideSigns_all_eq, hg0, hg1, hg2,
        e0.1.mpr hc, e1.1.mpr (h01 ▸ hc), e2.1.mpr (h12 ▸ h01 ▸ hc)]
      exact ⟨rfl, rfl, rfl⟩
    rw [hall] at hns1'; exact absurd hns1'.1 (by simp)

name: crossProduct_smul_both
statement:
theorem crossProduct_smul_both (a b : ℚ) (u v : Point) :
    crossProduct (a • u) (b • v) = (a * b) • crossProduct u v
proof:
:= by
  ext i; fin_cases i <;> simp [crossProduct, mul_comm, mul_left_comm] <;> ring

name: decI_lineDir
statement:
theorem decI_lineDir (S T : Triangle) :
    decI (crossI (Impl.WellFormedCheck.faceNormal (rescale (faceHOf T).w (faceHOf S)))
        (Impl.WellFormedCheck.faceNormal (rescale (faceHOf S).w (faceHOf T))))
      = ((((faceHOf T).w * (faceHOf S).w : ℤ) : ℚ) ^ 2
          * (((faceHOf S).w * (faceHOf T).w : ℤ) : ℚ) ^ 2) •
        crossProduct (crossProduct ((S.v₁ : Point) - S.v₀) ((S.v₂ : Point) - S.v₀))
          (crossProduct ((T.v₁ : Point) - T.v₀) ((T.v₂ : Point) - T.v₀))
proof:
:= by
  rw [decI_cross, decI_faceNormal_S, decI_faceNormal_T, crossProduct_smul_both]

name: case3_lineDir_ne_zero
statement:
theorem case3_lineDir_ne_zero (S T : Triangle) (hT : NDeg T)
    (hns1 : allStrictOneSide (sideSigns (Impl.WellFormedCheck.faceNormal (rescale (faceHOf T).w (faceHOf S)))
      (rescale (faceHOf T).w (faceHOf S)).v₀ (vertsOf (rescale (faceHOf S).w (faceHOf T)))) = false)
    (hncop : allZero (sideSigns (Impl.WellFormedCheck.faceNormal (rescale (faceHOf T).w (faceHOf S)))
      (rescale (faceHOf T).w (faceHOf S)).v₀ (vertsOf (rescale (faceHOf S).w (faceHOf T)))) = false) :
    isZeroI (crossI (Impl.WellFormedCheck.faceNormal (rescale (faceHOf T).w (faceHOf S)))
      (Impl.WellFormedCheck.faceNormal (rescale (faceHOf S).w (faceHOf T)))) = false
proof:
:= by
  rw [Bool.eq_false_iff, ne_eq, decI_isZero, decI_lineDir]
  intro h
  have hcross : crossProduct (crossProduct ((S.v₁ : Point) - S.v₀) ((S.v₂ : Point) - S.v₀))
      (crossProduct ((T.v₁ : Point) - T.v₀) ((T.v₂ : Point) - T.v₀)) ≠ 0 :=
    noncoplanar_line_dir T (crossProduct ((S.v₁ : Point) - S.v₀) ((S.v₂ : Point) - S.v₀)) S.v₀
      (faceNormal_ne_zero_of_detOrigin T hT) (sigma_mixed_nonconstant S T hns1 hncop)
  have hΛ : (((faceHOf T).w * (faceHOf S).w : ℤ) : ℚ) ^ 2
      * (((faceHOf S).w * (faceHOf T).w : ℤ) : ℚ) ^ 2 ≠ 0 := by
    have := sharedScale_pos S T; have := sharedScale_pos T S; positivity
  rcases smul_eq_zero.mp h with h' | h'
  · exact hΛ h'
  · exact hcross h'

name: bary_affine_eval
statement:
theorem bary_affine_eval (n q : Point) (t : Triangle) (μ : Fin 3 → ℚ)
    (hsum : μ 0 + μ 1 + μ 2 = 1)
    (P : Point) (hP : P = μ 0 • (t.v₀ : Point) + μ 1 • (t.v₁ : Point) + μ 2 • (t.v₂ : Point)) :
    n ⬝ᵥ (P - q) = μ 0 * (n ⬝ᵥ ((t.v₀ : Point) - q)) + μ 1 * (n ⬝ᵥ ((t.v₁ : Point) - q))
      + μ 2 * (n ⬝ᵥ ((t.v₂ : Point) - q))
proof:
:= by
  have key : (P - q : Point)
      = μ 0 • ((t.v₀ : Point) - q) + μ 1 • ((t.v₁ : Point) - q) + μ 2 • ((t.v₂ : Point) - q) := by
    rw [hP]; match_scalars <;> linarith [hsum]
  rw [key]; simp only [dotProduct_add, dotProduct_smul, smul_eq_mul]

name: baryPt_own_plane
statement:
theorem baryPt_own_plane (s : Triangle) (μ : Fin 3 → ℚ) (hsum : μ 0 + μ 1 + μ 2 = 1) :
    crossProduct ((s.v₁ : Point) - s.v₀) ((s.v₂ : Point) - s.v₀)
        ⬝ᵥ (baryPt s μ - s.v₀) = 0
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨h0, h1, h2⟩ := faceNormal_dot_vertex s
  rw [baryPt_plane s _ s.v₀ μ hsum, h0, h1, h2]; ring

name: baryPt_edge_of_zero
statement:
theorem baryPt_edge_of_zero (s : Triangle) (μ : Fin 3 → ℚ)
    (hnn : ∀ j, 0 ≤ μ j) (hsum : μ 0 + μ 1 + μ 2 = 1)
    (hz : μ 0 = 0 ∨ μ 1 = 0 ∨ μ 2 = 0) :
    baryPt s μ ∈ edgeSet s
proof:
:= by
  unfold edgeSet baryPt
  rcases hz with h0 | h1 | h2
  · 
    left; right
    rw [segment_eq_image]
