    refine ⟨μ 2, ⟨hnn 2, by linarith [hnn 1]⟩, ?_⟩
    show (1 - μ 2) • (s.v₁ : Point) + μ 2 • s.v₂ = _
    rw [h0]
    have h1 : (1 : ℚ) - μ 2 = μ 1 := by linarith
    rw [h1]; simp [add_comm]
  · 
    right
    rw [segment_eq_image]
    refine ⟨μ 0, ⟨hnn 0, by linarith [hnn 2]⟩, ?_⟩
    show (1 - μ 0) • (s.v₂ : Point) + μ 0 • s.v₀ = _
    rw [h1]
    have h2 : (1 : ℚ) - μ 0 = μ 2 := by linarith
    rw [h2]; simp [add_comm]
  · 
    left; left
    rw [segment_eq_image]
    refine ⟨μ 1, ⟨hnn 1, by linarith [hnn 0]⟩, ?_⟩
    show (1 - μ 1) • (s.v₀ : Point) + μ 1 • s.v₁ = _
    rw [h2]
    have h0 : (1 : ℚ) - μ 1 = μ 0 := by linarith
    rw [h0]; simp

name: ownProj_strict
statement:
theorem ownProj_strict (s t : Triangle) (hs : NDeg s) (m : Fin 3)
    (ns nt dq : Point) (Λ : ℚ)
    (vs : Array I3) (signs : Array Int) (nO qO : I3) (lo hi : Int × Int)
    (hns : ns = crossProduct ((s.v₁ : Point) - s.v₀) ((s.v₂ : Point) - s.v₀))
    (hdq : dq = crossProduct ns nt)
    (hdqm : dq m ≠ 0) (hcross : dq ≠ 0)
    (hC : ∀ j : Fin 3, Cval m vs (j : ℕ) = Λ * (Vert s j) m)
    (hE : ∀ j : Fin 3, Eval nO qO vs (j : ℕ) = Λ ^ 3 * (nt ⬝ᵥ ((Vert s j) - t.v₀)))
    (hΛ : 0 < Λ)
    (hsm : ∀ k, k < 3 → signs.getD k 0 = Int.sign (dotI nO (subI (vs.getD k default) qO)))
    (hpos : ∀ p ∈ collectParams (m : ℕ) vs signs nO qO, 0 < p.2)
    (hIown : fracInterval (collectParams (m : ℕ) vs signs nO qO) = some (lo, hi))
    (x : Point) (hx : x ∈ triRelint s) (hxP : nt ⬝ᵥ (x - t.v₀) = 0) :
    fracVal lo < Λ * x m ∧ Λ * x m < fracVal hi
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨μ, hμpos, hμsum1, hxμ⟩ := hx
  have hμsum : μ 0 + μ 1 + μ 2 = 1 := by rw [Fin.sum_univ_three] at hμsum1; exact hμsum1
  have hμnn : ∀ j, 0 ≤ μ j := fun j => le_of_lt (hμpos j)
  have hxb : x = baryPt s μ := by rw [hxμ]; rfl
  have hΛ3 : (0:ℚ) < Λ ^ 3 := by positivity
  have hplane : nt ⬝ᵥ (baryPt s μ - t.v₀) = 0 := by rw [← hxb]; exact hxP
  
  have hbound := bary_proj_bound s m nt t.v₀ Λ vs signs nO qO lo hi hC hE hΛ3 hsm hpos hIown
    μ hμnn hμsum hplane
  rw [← hxb] at hbound
  
  obtain ⟨hloM, hhiM⟩ := fracInterval_endpoints_mem _ hpos lo hi hIown
  
  obtain ⟨νlo, hlonn, hlosum, hloz, hlopl, hloproj⟩ :=
    member_incidence s m nt t.v₀ Λ vs signs nO qO hC hE hΛ hsm lo hloM
  obtain ⟨νhi, hhinn, hhisum, hhiz, hhipl, hhiproj⟩ :=
    member_incidence s m nt t.v₀ Λ vs signs nO qO hC hE hΛ hsm hi hhiM
  
  have hxsel : ns ⬝ᵥ (x - s.v₀) = 0 := by
    rw [hns, hxb]; exact baryPt_own_plane s μ hμsum
  
  have hne : ∀ (ν : Fin 3 → ℚ), (∀ j, 0 ≤ ν j) → ν 0 + ν 1 + ν 2 = 1 →
      (ν 0 = 0 ∨ ν 1 = 0 ∨ ν 2 = 0) → nt ⬝ᵥ (baryPt s ν - t.v₀) = 0 →
      Λ * x m = Λ * (baryPt s ν) m → False := by
    intro ν hνnn hνsum hνz hνpl heq
    set w := baryPt s ν with hw
    have hxm : x m = w m := by
      have := mul_left_cancel₀ (ne_of_gt hΛ) heq; exact this
    
    have hwsel : ns ⬝ᵥ (w - s.v₀) = 0 := by rw [hns, hw]; exact baryPt_own_plane s ν hνsum
    obtain ⟨c, hc⟩ := line_points_collinear ns nt s.v₀ t.v₀ x w (by rw [← hdq]; exact hcross)
      hxsel hwsel hxP hνpl
    have hcd : x - w = c • dq := by rw [hdq]; exact hc
    have hc0 : c = 0 := (coord_eq_iff_param_zero x w dq c m hdqm hcd).mp hxm
    have hxw : x = w := by
      rw [hc0, zero_smul, sub_eq_zero] at hcd; exact hcd
    
    have hwe : w ∈ edgeSet s := by rw [hw]; exact baryPt_edge_of_zero s ν hνnn hνsum hνz
    have hxr : x ∈ triRelint s := ⟨μ, hμpos, hμsum1, hxμ⟩
    have : x ∈ triRelint s ∩ edgeSet s := ⟨hxr, by rw [hxw]; exact hwe⟩
    rw [triRelint_edge_disjoint s hs] at this; exact this
  refine ⟨lt_of_le_of_ne hbound.1 (fun heq => ?_), lt_of_le_of_ne hbound.2 (fun heq => ?_)⟩
  · 
    exact hne νlo hlonn hlosum (kind_some_zero hloz) hlopl (by rw [hloproj, ← heq])
  · exact hne νhi hhinn hhisum (kind_some_zero hhiz) hhipl (by rw [hhiproj, heq])

name: ownProj_cover
statement:
theorem ownProj_cover (s : Triangle) (_hs : NDeg s) (m : Fin 3)
    (nt q : Point) (Λ : ℚ)
    (vs : Array I3) (signs : Array Int) (nO qO : I3) (lo hi : Int × Int)
    (hC : ∀ j : Fin 3, Cval m vs (j : ℕ) = Λ * (Vert s j) m)
    (hE : ∀ j : Fin 3, Eval nO qO vs (j : ℕ) = Λ ^ 3 * (nt ⬝ᵥ ((Vert s j) - q)))
    (hΛ : 0 < Λ)
    (hsm : ∀ k, k < 3 → signs.getD k 0 = Int.sign (dotI nO (subI (vs.getD k default) qO)))
    (hedge : hasEdgeOnLine signs = false)
    (r : ℚ) (hr : fracVal lo < r ∧ r < fracVal hi)
    (hloM : lo ∈ collectParams (m : ℕ) vs signs nO qO)
    (hhiM : hi ∈ collectParams (m : ℕ) vs signs nO qO) :
    ∃ x, x ∈ triRelint s ∧ nt ⬝ᵥ (x - q) = 0 ∧ Λ * x m = r
proof:
:= by
  classical
  obtain ⟨hr1, hr2⟩ := hr
  have hne : fracVal lo ≠ fracVal hi := ne_of_lt (lt_trans hr1 hr2)
  
  obtain ⟨νlo, hlonn, hlosum, hlokind, hlopl, hloproj⟩ :=
    member_incidence' s m nt q Λ vs signs nO qO hC hE hΛ hsm lo hloM
  obtain ⟨νhi, hhinn, hhisum, hhikind, hhipl, hhiproj⟩ :=
    member_incidence' s m nt q Λ vs signs nO qO hC hE hΛ hsm hi hhiM
  
  have hsame_frac : ∀ ν : Fin 3 → ℚ, baryPt s ν = baryPt s νlo → Λ * (baryPt s ν) m = fracVal hi →
      False := by
    intro ν hνlo hνhi
    apply hne; rw [← hloproj, ← hνhi, hνlo]
  
  have hnz : ∀ j, ¬ (νlo j = 0 ∧ νhi j = 0) := by
    intro j ⟨h0l, h0h⟩
    
    rcases hlokind with ⟨jl, ⟨hjl1, hjloff⟩, hjlsg⟩ | ⟨jl, ⟨hjl0, hjloff⟩, hjlsgoff, hjluniq⟩ <;>
      rcases hhikind with ⟨jh, ⟨hjh1, hjhoff⟩, hjhsg⟩ | ⟨jh, ⟨hjh0, hjhoff⟩, hjhsgoff, hjhuniq⟩
    · 
      by_cases hjj : jl = jh
      · 
        have hνeq : νhi = νlo := by
          funext i; by_cases hij : i = jl
          · rw [hij, hjl1, hjj]; exact hjh1
          · rw [hjloff i hij, hjhoff i (hjj ▸ hij)]
        exact hsame_frac νhi (by rw [hνeq]) hhiproj
      · 
        have : hasEdgeOnLine signs = true :=
          (hasEdgeOnLine_iff signs).mpr ⟨jl, jh, jl.2, jh.2, fun h => hjj (Fin.ext h), hjlsg, hjhsg⟩
        rw [hedge] at this; exact absurd this (by simp)
    · 
      have hjleqh : jl = jh := by
        by_contra hne'; exact hjhsgoff jl hne' hjlsg
      
      by_cases hjjl : j = jl
      · rw [hjjl, hjl1] at h0l; exact one_ne_zero h0l
      · have : j ≠ jh := hjleqh ▸ hjjl
        exact (ne_of_gt (hjhoff j this)) h0h
    · 
      have hjleqh : jl = jh := by
        by_contra hne'; exact hjlsgoff jh (fun h => hne' h.symm) hjhsg
      by_cases hjjh : j = jh
      · rw [hjjh, hjh1] at h0h; exact one_ne_zero h0h
      · have : j ≠ jl := hjleqh.symm ▸ hjjh
        exact (ne_of_gt (hjloff j this)) h0l
    · 
      by_cases hjj : jl = jh
      · 
        have hνeq : νhi = νlo :=
          hjluniq νhi hhisum (by rw [hjj]; exact hjh0) hhipl
        exact hsame_frac νhi (by rw [hνeq]) hhiproj
      · 
        by_cases hjjl : j = jl
        · have : j ≠ jh := hjjl ▸ hjj
          exact (ne_of_gt (hjhoff j this)) h0h
        · exact (ne_of_gt (hjloff j hjjl)) h0l
  
  obtain ⟨lam, hl0, hl1, hlam⟩ :=
    mix_param_of_between (fracVal lo) (fracVal hi) r hne (Or.inl ⟨hr1, hr2⟩)
  set μ : Fin 3 → ℚ := fun j => (1 - lam) * νlo j + lam * νhi j with hμdef
  have hμpos : ∀ j, 0 < μ j := mix_pos_of_not_share νlo νhi lam hlonn hhinn hl0 hl1 hnz
  have hμsum : μ 0 + μ 1 + μ 2 = 1 := by
    simp only [hμdef]
    linear_combination (1 - lam) * hlosum + lam * hhisum
  
  have hmix : baryPt s μ = (1 - lam) • baryPt s νlo + lam • baryPt s νhi := by
    simp only [baryPt, hμdef]; match_scalars <;> ring
  refine ⟨baryPt s μ, ⟨μ, hμpos, by rw [Fin.sum_univ_three]; exact hμsum, rfl⟩, ?_, ?_⟩
  · 
    rw [hmix]
    have : (((1 - lam) • baryPt s νlo + lam • baryPt s νhi : Point) - q)
        = (1 - lam) • (baryPt s νlo - q) + lam • (baryPt s νhi - q) := by
      match_scalars <;> ring
    rw [this, dotProduct_add, dotProduct_smul, dotProduct_smul, hlopl, hhipl,
      smul_zero, smul_zero, add_zero]
  · 
    rw [hmix]
    have hcoordmix : ((1 - lam) • baryPt s νlo + lam • baryPt s νhi : Point) m
        = (1 - lam) * (baryPt s νlo) m + lam * (baryPt s νhi) m := by
      simp [Pi.add_apply, Pi.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul]
    rw [hcoordmix, mul_add, ← mul_assoc, ← mul_assoc, mul_comm Λ (1-lam), mul_comm Λ lam,
      mul_assoc, mul_assoc, hloproj, hhiproj, ← hlam]

name: noIncidence_empty
statement:
theorem noIncidence_empty (s : Triangle) (m : Fin 3) (n q : Point) (Λ : ℚ)
    (vs : Array I3) (signs : Array Int) (nO qO : I3)
    (hE : ∀ j : Fin 3, Eval nO qO vs (j : ℕ) = Λ ^ 3 * (n ⬝ᵥ ((Vert s j) - q)))
    (hΛ3 : (0:ℚ) < Λ ^ 3)
    (hsm : ∀ k, k < 3 → signs.getD k 0 = Int.sign (dotI nO (subI (vs.getD k default) qO)))
    (hpos : ∀ p ∈ collectParams (m : ℕ) vs signs nO qO, 0 < p.2)
    (hnone : fracInterval (collectParams (m : ℕ) vs signs nO qO) = none) :
    triangleSet s ∩ {x : Point | n ⬝ᵥ (x - q) = 0} = ∅
proof:
:= by
  
  have hsize := fracInterval_none_empty _ hpos hnone
  have hempty : collectParams (m : ℕ) vs signs nO qO = #[] :=
    Array.eq_empty_of_size_eq_zero hsize
  obtain ⟨hnov, hnoe⟩ := collectParams_empty_signs (m : ℕ) vs signs nO qO hempty
  
  set e : Fin 3 → ℚ := fun j => n ⬝ᵥ ((Vert s j) - q) with he
  
  have hev : ∀ j : Fin 3, (signs.getD (j:ℕ) 0 < 0 → e j < 0) ∧
      (0 < signs.getD (j:ℕ) 0 → 0 < e j) := by
    intro j
    have htri := eval_sign_iff vs signs nO qO (j : ℕ) (hsm (j : ℕ) j.2)
    have hEj : Eval nO qO vs (j : ℕ) = Λ ^ 3 * e j := hE j
    refine ⟨fun hs => ?_, fun hs => ?_⟩
    · have := htri.2.1.mp hs; rw [hEj] at this; nlinarith
    · have := htri.2.2.mp hs; rw [hEj] at this; nlinarith
  
  have hsv : ∀ j : Fin 3, signs.getD (j:ℕ) 0 < 0 ∨ 0 < signs.getD (j:ℕ) 0 := by
    intro j; rcases lt_trichotomy (signs.getD (j:ℕ) 0) 0 with h | h | h
    · exact Or.inl h
    · exact absurd h (hnov (j:ℕ) j.2)
    · exact Or.inr h
  
  have h01 := hnoe 0 (by norm_num)
  have h12 := hnoe 1 (by norm_num)
  have h20 := hnoe 2 (by norm_num)
  simp only [show ((0:ℕ)+1)%3 = 1 from rfl, show ((1:ℕ)+1)%3 = 2 from rfl,
    show ((2:ℕ)+1)%3 = 0 from rfl] at h01 h12 h20
  have hs0 : signs.getD 0 0 < 0 ∨ 0 < signs.getD 0 0 := hsv 0
  have hs1 : signs.getD 1 0 < 0 ∨ 0 < signs.getD 1 0 := hsv 1
  have hs2 : signs.getD 2 0 < 0 ∨ 0 < signs.getD 2 0 := hsv 2
  have hev0 : (signs.getD 0 0 < 0 → e 0 < 0) ∧ (0 < signs.getD 0 0 → 0 < e 0) := hev 0
  have hev1 : (signs.getD 1 0 < 0 → e 1 < 0) ∧ (0 < signs.getD 1 0 → 0 < e 1) := hev 1
  have hev2 : (signs.getD 2 0 < 0 → e 2 < 0) ∧ (0 < signs.getD 2 0 → 0 < e 2) := hev 2
  
  have hallsign : (0 < e 0 ∧ 0 < e 1 ∧ 0 < e 2) ∨ (e 0 < 0 ∧ e 1 < 0 ∧ e 2 < 0) := by
    rcases hs0 with hs0 | hs0
    · 
      have hs1' : signs.getD 1 0 < 0 := by
        rcases hs1 with h | h
        · exact h
        · exact absurd (Or.inl ⟨hs0, h⟩) h01
      have hs2' : signs.getD 2 0 < 0 := by
        rcases hs2 with h | h
        · exact h
        · exact absurd (Or.inl ⟨hs1', h⟩) h12
      exact Or.inr ⟨hev0.1 hs0, hev1.1 hs1', hev2.1 hs2'⟩
    · 
      have hs1' : 0 < signs.getD 1 0 := by
        rcases hs1 with h | h
        · exact absurd (Or.inr ⟨hs0, h⟩) h01
        · exact h
      have hs2' : 0 < signs.getD 2 0 := by
        rcases hs2 with h | h
        · exact absurd (Or.inr ⟨hs1', h⟩) h12
        · exact h
      exact Or.inl ⟨hev0.2 hs0, hev1.2 hs1', hev2.2 hs2'⟩
  
  rw [Set.eq_empty_iff_forall_not_mem]
  rintro x ⟨hxt, hxpl⟩
  simp only [Set.mem_setOf_eq] at hxpl
  obtain ⟨μ, hμnn, hμsum, hμx⟩ := triangleSet_bary s x hxt
  have hsum3 : μ 0 + μ 1 + μ 2 = 1 := by rw [Fin.sum_univ_three] at hμsum; exact hμsum
  have hfeas : μ 0 * e 0 + μ 1 * e 1 + μ 2 * e 2 = 0 := by
    have := bary_affine_eval n q s μ hsum3 x hμx
    rw [hxpl] at this
    simpa only [he, Vert, Fin.isValue] using this.symm
  exact same_sign_absurd (e 0) (e 1) (e 2) (μ 0) (μ 1) (μ 2)
    (hμnn 0) (hμnn 1) (hμnn 2) hsum3 hfeas hallsign.symm

name: othProj_bound
statement:
theorem othProj_bound (u : Triangle) (m : Fin 3) (n q : Point) (Λ : ℚ)
    (vs : Array I3) (signs : Array Int) (nO qO : I3) (lo hi : Int × Int)
    (hC : ∀ j : Fin 3, Cval m vs (j : ℕ) = Λ * (Vert u j) m)
    (hE : ∀ j : Fin 3, Eval nO qO vs (j : ℕ) = Λ ^ 3 * (n ⬝ᵥ ((Vert u j) - q)))
    (hΛ3 : (0:ℚ) < Λ ^ 3)
    (hsm : ∀ k, k < 3 → signs.getD k 0 = Int.sign (dotI nO (subI (vs.getD k default) qO)))
    (hpos : ∀ p ∈ collectParams (m : ℕ) vs signs nO qO, 0 < p.2)
    (hI : fracInterval (collectParams (m : ℕ) vs signs nO qO) = some (lo, hi))
    (x : Point) (hx : x ∈ triangleSet u) (hxP : n ⬝ᵥ (x - q) = 0) :
    fracVal lo ≤ Λ * x m ∧ Λ * x m ≤ fracVal hi
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨μ, hμnn, hμsum, hxμ⟩ := triangleSet_bary u x hx
  have hsum3 : μ 0 + μ 1 + μ 2 = 1 := by rw [Fin.sum_univ_three] at hμsum; exact hμsum
  have hxb : x = baryPt u μ := by rw [hxμ]; rfl
  have hplane : n ⬝ᵥ (baryPt u μ - q) = 0 := by rw [← hxb]; exact hxP
  have hbound := bary_proj_bound u m n q Λ vs signs nO qO lo hi hC hE hΛ3 hsm hpos hI
    μ hμnn hsum3 hplane
  rw [← hxb] at hbound; exact hbound

name: othProj_cover
statement:
theorem othProj_cover (u : Triangle) (m : Fin 3) (n q : Point) (Λ : ℚ)
    (vs : Array I3) (signs : Array Int) (nO qO : I3) (lo hi : Int × Int)
    (hC : ∀ j : Fin 3, Cval m vs (j : ℕ) = Λ * (Vert u j) m)
    (hE : ∀ j : Fin 3, Eval nO qO vs (j : ℕ) = Λ ^ 3 * (n ⬝ᵥ ((Vert u j) - q)))
    (hΛ : 0 < Λ)
    (hsm : ∀ k, k < 3 → signs.getD k 0 = Int.sign (dotI nO (subI (vs.getD k default) qO)))
    (hpos : ∀ p ∈ collectParams (m : ℕ) vs signs nO qO, 0 < p.2)
    (hI : fracInterval (collectParams (m : ℕ) vs signs nO qO) = some (lo, hi))
    (r : ℚ) (hr : fracVal lo ≤ r ∧ r ≤ fracVal hi) :
    ∃ x, x ∈ triangleSet u ∧ n ⬝ᵥ (x - q) = 0 ∧ Λ * x m = r
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨hr1, hr2⟩ := hr
  obtain ⟨hloM, hhiM⟩ := fracInterval_endpoints_mem _ hpos lo hi hI
  obtain ⟨νlo, hlonn, hlosum, _, hlopl, hloproj⟩ :=
    member_incidence u m n q Λ vs signs nO qO hC hE hΛ hsm lo hloM
  obtain ⟨νhi, hhinn, hhisum, _, hhipl, hhiproj⟩ :=
    member_incidence u m n q Λ vs signs nO qO hC hE hΛ hsm hi hhiM
  by_cases hlohi : fracVal lo = fracVal hi
  · 
    refine ⟨baryPt u νlo, mem_triangleSet_of_bary u νlo hlonn (by rw [Fin.sum_univ_three]; exact hlosum),
      hlopl, ?_⟩
    rw [hloproj]; linarith [hr1, hr2, hlohi]
  · 
    have hne : fracVal lo ≠ fracVal hi := hlohi
    have hlt : fracVal lo < fracVal hi := lt_of_le_of_ne (le_trans hr1 hr2) hne
    rcases eq_or_lt_of_le hr1 with heq | hlt1
    · refine ⟨baryPt u νlo, mem_triangleSet_of_bary u νlo hlonn (by rw [Fin.sum_univ_three]; exact hlosum),
        hlopl, ?_⟩
      rw [hloproj]; exact heq
    · rcases eq_or_lt_of_le hr2 with heq | hlt2
      · refine ⟨baryPt u νhi, mem_triangleSet_of_bary u νhi hhinn (by rw [Fin.sum_univ_three]; exact hhisum),
          hhipl, ?_⟩
        rw [hhiproj]; exact heq.symm
      · 
        obtain ⟨lam, hl0, hl1, hlam⟩ :=
          mix_param_of_between (fracVal lo) (fracVal hi) r hne (Or.inl ⟨hlt1, hlt2⟩)
        set μ : Fin 3 → ℚ := fun j => (1 - lam) * νlo j + lam * νhi j with hμdef
        have hμnn : ∀ j, 0 ≤ μ j := by
          intro j; simp only [hμdef]
          exact add_nonneg (mul_nonneg (by linarith) (hlonn j)) (mul_nonneg (by linarith) (hhinn j))
        have hμsum : μ 0 + μ 1 + μ 2 = 1 := by
          simp only [hμdef]; linear_combination (1 - lam) * hlosum + lam * hhisum
        have hmix : baryPt u μ = (1 - lam) • baryPt u νlo + lam • baryPt u νhi := by
          simp only [baryPt, hμdef]; match_scalars <;> ring
        refine ⟨baryPt u μ, mem_triangleSet_of_bary u μ hμnn (by rw [Fin.sum_univ_three]; exact hμsum),
          ?_, ?_⟩
        · rw [hmix]
          have : (((1 - lam) • baryPt u νlo + lam • baryPt u νhi : Point) - q)
              = (1 - lam) • (baryPt u νlo - q) + lam • (baryPt u νhi - q) := by
            match_scalars <;> ring
          rw [this, dotProduct_add, dotProduct_smul, dotProduct_smul, hlopl, hhipl,
            smul_zero, smul_zero, add_zero]
        · rw [hmix]
          have hcoordmix : ((1 - lam) • baryPt u νlo + lam • baryPt u νhi : Point) m
              = (1 - lam) * (baryPt u νlo) m + lam * (baryPt u νhi) m := by
            simp [Pi.add_apply, Pi.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul]
          rw [hcoordmix, mul_add, ← mul_assoc, ← mul_assoc, mul_comm Λ (1-lam), mul_comm Λ lam,
            mul_assoc, mul_assoc, hloproj, hhiproj, ← hlam]

name: caseE_relint_empty
statement:
theorem caseE_relint_empty (s : Triangle) (nt q : Point)
    (signs : Array Int) (e : Fin 3 → ℚ)
    (he : ∀ j : Fin 3, e j = nt ⬝ᵥ ((Vert s j) - q))
    (hcross : crossProduct (crossProduct ((s.v₁ : Point) - s.v₀) ((s.v₂ : Point) - s.v₀)) nt ≠ 0)
    (hsign0 : ∀ j : Fin 3, signs.getD (j : ℕ) 0 = 0 ↔ e j = 0)
    (hedge : hasEdgeOnLine signs = true) :
    triRelint s ∩ {x : Point | nt ⬝ᵥ (x - q) = 0} = ∅
proof:
:= by
  
  obtain ⟨i, j, hi3, hj3, hij, hsi, hsj⟩ := (hasEdgeOnLine_iff signs).mp hedge
  have hei : e ⟨i, hi3⟩ = 0 := (hsign0 ⟨i, hi3⟩).mp (by simpa using hsi)
  have hej : e ⟨j, hj3⟩ = 0 := (hsign0 ⟨j, hj3⟩).mp (by simpa using hsj)
  have hijF : (⟨i, hi3⟩ : Fin 3) ≠ ⟨j, hj3⟩ := fun h => hij (by simpa using congrArg Fin.val h)
  rw [Set.eq_empty_iff_forall_not_mem]
  rintro x ⟨⟨μ, hμpos, hμsum1, hxμ⟩, hxpl⟩
  simp only [Set.mem_setOf_eq] at hxpl
  have hμsum : μ 0 + μ 1 + μ 2 = 1 := by rw [Fin.sum_univ_three] at hμsum1; exact hμsum1
  
  have he0v : e 0 = nt ⬝ᵥ ((s.v₀ : Point) - q) := he 0
  have he1v : e 1 = nt ⬝ᵥ ((s.v₁ : Point) - q) := he 1
  have he2v : e 2 = nt ⬝ᵥ ((s.v₂ : Point) - q) := he 2
  have hfeas : μ 0 * e 0 + μ 1 * e 1 + μ 2 * e 2 = 0 := by
    have hxb : x = μ 0 • (s.v₀ : Point) + μ 1 • s.v₁ + μ 2 • s.v₂ := hxμ
    have hba := bary_affine_eval nt q s μ hμsum x hxb
    rw [hxpl] at hba
    rw [he0v, he1v, he2v]; linarith [hba]
  
  have hzi : e (⟨i, hi3⟩ : Fin 3) = 0 := hei
  have hzj : e (⟨j, hj3⟩ : Fin 3) = 0 := hej
  have hp0 := hμpos 0; have hp1 := hμpos 1; have hp2 := hμpos 2
  
  have hkill0 : e 1 = 0 → e 2 = 0 → e 0 = 0 := fun h1 h2 =>
    (mul_eq_zero.mp (by linear_combination hfeas - μ 1 * h1 - μ 2 * h2 : μ 0 * e 0 = 0)).resolve_left (ne_of_gt hp0)
  have hkill1 : e 0 = 0 → e 2 = 0 → e 1 = 0 := fun h0 h2 =>
    (mul_eq_zero.mp (by linear_combination hfeas - μ 0 * h0 - μ 2 * h2 : μ 1 * e 1 = 0)).resolve_left (ne_of_gt hp1)
  have hkill2 : e 0 = 0 → e 1 = 0 → e 2 = 0 := fun h0 h1 =>
    (mul_eq_zero.mp (by linear_combination hfeas - μ 0 * h0 - μ 1 * h1 : μ 2 * e 2 = 0)).resolve_left (ne_of_gt hp2)
  
  have hall0 : e 0 = 0 ∧ e 1 = 0 ∧ e 2 = 0 := by
    interval_cases i <;> interval_cases j <;>
      first
        | (exfalso; omega)
        | exact ⟨hzi, hzj, hkill2 hzi hzj⟩
        | exact ⟨hzi, hkill1 hzi hzj, hzj⟩
        | exact ⟨hkill0 hzi hzj, hzi, hzj⟩
        | exact ⟨hzj, hzi, hkill2 hzj hzi⟩
        | exact ⟨hzj, hkill1 hzj hzi, hzi⟩
        | exact ⟨hkill0 hzj hzi, hzj, hzi⟩
  obtain ⟨h0, h1, h2⟩ := hall0
  rw [he0v] at h0; rw [he1v] at h1; rw [he2v] at h2
  
  have hd1 : nt ⬝ᵥ ((s.v₁ : Point) - s.v₀) = 0 := by
    have hsub : nt ⬝ᵥ ((s.v₁ : Point) - s.v₀)
        = nt ⬝ᵥ ((s.v₁:Point) - q) - nt ⬝ᵥ ((s.v₀:Point) - q) := by
      rw [← dotProduct_sub]; congr 1; abel
    rw [hsub, h1, h0, sub_zero]
  have hd2 : nt ⬝ᵥ ((s.v₂ : Point) - s.v₀) = 0 := by
    have hsub : nt ⬝ᵥ ((s.v₂ : Point) - s.v₀)
        = nt ⬝ᵥ ((s.v₂:Point) - q) - nt ⬝ᵥ ((s.v₀:Point) - q) := by
      rw [← dotProduct_sub]; congr 1; abel
    rw [hsub, h2, h0, sub_zero]
  
  have hcr12 : crossProduct ((s.v₁:Point) - s.v₀) ((s.v₂:Point) - s.v₀) ≠ 0 := by
    intro h; apply hcross; rw [h]; simp
  obtain ⟨c, hc⟩ := collinear_of_dot_zero_pair ((s.v₁:Point) - s.v₀) ((s.v₂:Point) - s.v₀) nt
    hcr12 (by rw [dotProduct_comm]; exact hd1) (by rw [dotProduct_comm]; exact hd2)
  apply hcross
  rw [hc, LinearMap.map_smul, cross_self, smul_zero]

name: instanceOK3_relint_iff
statement:
theorem instanceOK3_relint_iff (s t : Triangle) (m : Fin 3)
    (ns nt qs qt dq : Point) (Λ : ℚ) (hΛ : 0 < Λ)
    (τ _σ : Array Int)
    (Iown Ioth : Option ((Int × Int) × (Int × Int)))
    (hdqm : dq m ≠ 0)
    
    (hrelint_s : ∀ x ∈ triRelint s, ns ⬝ᵥ (x - qs) = 0)
    (htri_t : ∀ x ∈ triangleSet t, nt ⬝ᵥ (x - qt) = 0)
    (hcollin : ∀ x y : Point, ns ⬝ᵥ (x - qs) = 0 → nt ⬝ᵥ (x - qt) = 0 →
      ns ⬝ᵥ (y - qs) = 0 → nt ⬝ᵥ (y - qt) = 0 → ∃ c : ℚ, x - y = c • dq)
    
    (hcaseE : hasEdgeOnLine τ = true → triRelint s ∩ {x | nt ⬝ᵥ (x - qt) = 0} = ∅)
    (hown_none : Iown = none → triRelint s ∩ {x | nt ⬝ᵥ (x - qt) = 0} = ∅)
    (hoth_none : Ioth = none → triangleSet t ∩ {x | ns ⬝ᵥ (x - qs) = 0} = ∅)
    
    (hown_fwd : ∀ lo hi, Iown = some (lo, hi) → ∀ x, x ∈ triRelint s →
      nt ⬝ᵥ (x - qt) = 0 → fracVal lo < Λ * x m ∧ Λ * x m < fracVal hi)
    (hown_cov : ∀ lo hi, Iown = some (lo, hi) → hasEdgeOnLine τ = false →
      ∀ r, fracVal lo < r → r < fracVal hi →
      ∃ x, x ∈ triRelint s ∧ nt ⬝ᵥ (x - qt) = 0 ∧ Λ * x m = r)
    (hoth_bound : ∀ ao bo, Ioth = some (ao, bo) → ∀ x, x ∈ triangleSet t →
      ns ⬝ᵥ (x - qs) = 0 → fracVal ao ≤ Λ * x m ∧ Λ * x m ≤ fracVal bo)
    (hoth_cov : ∀ ao bo, Ioth = some (ao, bo) → ∀ r, fracVal ao ≤ r → r ≤ fracVal bo →
      ∃ x, x ∈ triangleSet t ∧ ns ⬝ᵥ (x - qs) = 0 ∧ Λ * x m = r)
    
    (hreflect : ∀ af bf ao bo, Iown = some (af, bf) → Ioth = some (ao, bo) →
      hasEdgeOnLine τ = false → fracVal ao ≤ fracVal bo →
      (instanceOK3 τ Iown Ioth = true ↔
        ¬ (fracVal af < fracVal bf ∧ fracVal af < fracVal bo ∧ fracVal ao < fracVal bf)))
    (hothwf : ∀ ao bo, Ioth = some (ao, bo) → fracVal ao ≤ fracVal bo)
    (hnoneE : hasEdgeOnLine τ = false → Iown = none ∨ Ioth = none →
      instanceOK3 τ Iown Ioth = true) :
    instanceOK3 τ Iown Ioth = true ↔ triRelint s ∩ triangleSet t = ∅
proof:
:= by
  
  
  have hAB : triRelint s ∩ triangleSet t
      = (triRelint s ∩ {x | nt ⬝ᵥ (x - qt) = 0}) ∩ (triangleSet t ∩ {x | ns ⬝ᵥ (x - qs) = 0}) := by
    ext x
    simp only [Set.mem_inter_iff, Set.mem_setOf_eq]
    constructor
    · rintro ⟨hxs, hxt⟩
      exact ⟨⟨hxs, htri_t x hxt⟩, hxt, hrelint_s x hxs⟩
    · rintro ⟨⟨hxs, _⟩, hxt, _⟩; exact ⟨hxs, hxt⟩
  
  by_cases hE : hasEdgeOnLine τ = true
  · 
    have hOK : instanceOK3 τ Iown Ioth = true := by unfold instanceOK3; rw [hE]; rfl
    rw [hAB]
    have hAempty : triRelint s ∩ {x | nt ⬝ᵥ (x - qt) = 0} = ∅ := hcaseE hE
    constructor
    · intro _; rw [Set.eq_empty_iff_forall_not_mem]; intro x hx
      have : x ∈ (∅ : Set Point) := by rw [← hAempty]; exact hx.1
      exact this
    · intro _; exact hOK
  · 
    rw [Bool.not_eq_true] at hE
    
    rcases hIown : Iown with _ | ⟨af, bf⟩
    · rw [hAB]
      have hempty : triRelint s ∩ {x | nt ⬝ᵥ (x - qt) = 0} = ∅ := hown_none hIown
      constructor
      · intro _; rw [Set.eq_empty_iff_forall_not_mem]; intro x hx
        have : x ∈ (∅ : Set Point) := by rw [← hempty]; exact hx.1
        exact this
      · intro _; exact hIown ▸ hnoneE hE (Or.inl hIown)
    · rcases hIoth : Ioth with _ | ⟨ao, bo⟩
      · rw [hAB]
        have hempty : triangleSet t ∩ {x | ns ⬝ᵥ (x - qs) = 0} = ∅ := hoth_none hIoth
        constructor
        · intro _; rw [Set.eq_empty_iff_forall_not_mem]; intro x hx
          have : x ∈ (∅ : Set Point) := by rw [← hempty]; exact hx.2
          exact this
        · intro _; exact hIown ▸ hIoth ▸ hnoneE hE (Or.inr hIoth)
      · have hob : fracVal ao ≤ fracVal bo := hothwf ao bo hIoth
        rw [hIown, hIoth] at hreflect
        rw [hreflect af bf ao bo rfl rfl hE hob, hAB]
        
        rw [← Set.not_nonempty_iff_eq_empty, not_iff_not]
        constructor
        · 
          rintro ⟨hab, had, hcb⟩
          obtain ⟨v, hav, hvb, hcv, hvd⟩ :=
            (open_closed_meet (fracVal af) (fracVal bf) (fracVal ao) (fracVal bo) hob).mpr
              ⟨hab, had, hcb⟩
          obtain ⟨x, hxr, hxpl, hxproj⟩ := hown_cov af bf hIown hE v hav hvb
          obtain ⟨y, hyt, hypl, hyproj⟩ := hoth_cov ao bo hIoth v hcv hvd
          
          have hxs : ns ⬝ᵥ (x - qs) = 0 := hrelint_s x hxr
          have hyt' : nt ⬝ᵥ (y - qt) = 0 := htri_t y hyt
          obtain ⟨c, hc⟩ := hcollin x y hxs hxpl hypl hyt'
          have hxym : x m = y m := by
            have : Λ * x m = Λ * y m := by rw [hxproj, hyproj]
            exact mul_left_cancel₀ (ne_of_gt hΛ) this
          have hc0 : c = 0 := (coord_eq_iff_param_zero x y dq c m hdqm hc).mp hxym
          have hxy : x = y := by rw [hc0, zero_smul, sub_eq_zero] at hc; exact hc
          exact ⟨x, ⟨⟨hxr, hxpl⟩, by rw [hxy]; exact ⟨hyt, hypl⟩⟩⟩
        · 
          rintro ⟨x, ⟨⟨hxr, hxpl⟩, hxt, hxs⟩⟩
          have hfwd := hown_fwd af bf hIown x hxr hxpl
          have hbnd := hoth_bound ao bo hIoth x hxt hxs
          exact ⟨lt_trans hfwd.1 hfwd.2, lt_of_lt_of_le hfwd.1 hbnd.2,
            lt_of_le_of_lt hbnd.1 hfwd.2⟩

name: instance_one
statement:
theorem instance_one (s t : Triangle) (hs : NDeg s) (_ht : NDeg t)
    (m : Fin 3)
    (hcross : crossProduct ((s.v₁ : Point) - s.v₀) ((s.v₂ : Point) - s.v₀)
        ×₃ crossProduct ((t.v₁ : Point) - t.v₀) ((t.v₂ : Point) - t.v₀) ≠ 0)
    (hcoord : (crossProduct ((s.v₁ : Point) - s.v₀) ((s.v₂ : Point) - s.v₀)
        ×₃ crossProduct ((t.v₁ : Point) - t.v₀) ((t.v₂ : Point) - t.v₀)) m ≠ 0) :
    instanceOK3
        (sideSigns (Impl.WellFormedCheck.faceNormal (rescale (faceHOf s).w (faceHOf t)))
          (rescale (faceHOf s).w (faceHOf t)).v₀ (vertsOf (rescale (faceHOf t).w (faceHOf s))))
        (fracInterval (collectParams (m : ℕ) (vertsOf (rescale (faceHOf t).w (faceHOf s)))
          (sideSigns (Impl.WellFormedCheck.faceNormal (rescale (faceHOf s).w (faceHOf t)))
            (rescale (faceHOf s).w (faceHOf t)).v₀ (vertsOf (rescale (faceHOf t).w (faceHOf s))))
          (Impl.WellFormedCheck.faceNormal (rescale (faceHOf s).w (faceHOf t))) (rescale (faceHOf s).w (faceHOf t)).v₀))
        (fracInterval (collectParams (m : ℕ) (vertsOf (rescale (faceHOf s).w (faceHOf t)))
          (sideSigns (Impl.WellFormedCheck.faceNormal (rescale (faceHOf t).w (faceHOf s)))
            (rescale (faceHOf t).w (faceHOf s)).v₀ (vertsOf (rescale (faceHOf s).w (faceHOf t))))
          (Impl.WellFormedCheck.faceNormal (rescale (faceHOf t).w (faceHOf s))) (rescale (faceHOf t).w (faceHOf s)).v₀))
      = true ↔
    triangleSet s ∩ triangleSet t ⊆ edgeSet s
proof:
:= by
  rw [instance_iff_relint_empty s t hs]
  
  set sfs := rescale (faceHOf t).w (faceHOf s) with hsfs
  set sft := rescale (faceHOf s).w (faceHOf t) with hsft
  
  set nt := crossProduct ((t.v₁ : Point) - t.v₀) ((t.v₂ : Point) - t.v₀) with hnt
  set ns := crossProduct ((s.v₁ : Point) - s.v₀) ((s.v₂ : Point) - s.v₀) with hns
  
  set τ := sideSigns (Impl.WellFormedCheck.faceNormal sft) sft.v₀ (vertsOf sfs) with hτ
  set σ := sideSigns (Impl.WellFormedCheck.faceNormal sfs) sfs.v₀ (vertsOf sft) with hσ
  
  have hΛs_pos : (0:ℤ) < (faceHOf t).w * (faceHOf s).w := sharedScale_pos s t
  
  set V : Fin 3 → Point := ![s.v₀, s.v₁, s.v₂] with hV
  
  set e : Fin 3 → ℚ := fun j => nt ⬝ᵥ ((V j : Point) - t.v₀) with he
  
  set c : Fin 3 → ℚ := fun j => (V j : Point) m with hc
  
  have hdecv : ∀ j : Fin 3, decI ((vertsOf sfs).getD (j : ℕ) default)
      = (((faceHOf t).w * (faceHOf s).w : ℤ) : ℚ) • (V j : Point) := by
    intro j; fin_cases j
    · show decI sfs.v₀ = _; rw [hsfs, decI_rescaleS_v₀]; simp [hV]
    · show decI sfs.v₁ = _; rw [hsfs, decI_rescaleS_v₁]; simp [hV]
    · show decI sfs.v₂ = _; rw [hsfs, decI_rescaleS_v₂]; simp [hV]
  
  have hcoordv : ∀ j : Fin 3, ((coordAt (m : ℕ) ((vertsOf sfs).getD (j : ℕ) default) : Int) : ℚ)
      = (((faceHOf t).w * (faceHOf s).w : ℤ) : ℚ) * c j := by
    intro j
    rw [Proof.WellFormedCheckNSILine.coordAt_cast (m : ℕ) _ m.2]
    rw [show (⟨(m:ℕ), m.2⟩ : Fin 3) = m from rfl, hdecv j]
    rw [hc]; simp [Pi.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul]
  
  have hdece : ∀ j : Fin 3,
      ((dotI (Impl.WellFormedCheck.faceNormal sft) (subI ((vertsOf sfs).getD (j : ℕ) default) sft.v₀) : ℤ) : ℚ)
        = (((faceHOf s).w * (faceHOf t).w : ℤ) : ℚ) ^ 3 * e j := by
    intro j
    have hv : decI ((vertsOf sfs).getD (j : ℕ) default)
        = (((faceHOf s).w * (faceHOf t).w : ℤ) : ℚ) • (V j : Point) := by
      rw [hdecv j, mul_comm]
    rw [hsft]
    rw [dotI_sideT_cast s t _ (V j) hv]
  
  have hτsign : ∀ j : Fin 3, τ.getD (j : ℕ) 0 = Int.sign (dotI (Impl.WellFormedCheck.faceNormal sft) (subI ((vertsOf sfs).getD (j:ℕ) default) sft.v₀)) := by
    intro j
    rw [hτ]
    exact Proof.WellFormedCheckNSIInterval.sideSigns_getD_eval (Impl.WellFormedCheck.faceNormal sft) sft.v₀
      (vertsOf sfs) (j:ℕ) (by simp only [vertsOf, Array.size_toArray, List.length_cons,
        List.length_singleton]; omega)
  
  have hesign : ∀ j : Fin 3,
      (τ.getD (j:ℕ) 0 = 1 ↔ 0 < e j) ∧ (τ.getD (j:ℕ) 0 = -1 ↔ e j < 0) ∧
      (τ.getD (j:ℕ) 0 = 0 ↔ e j = 0) := by
    intro j
    have hv : decI ((vertsOf sfs).getD (j : ℕ) default)
        = (((faceHOf s).w * (faceHOf t).w : ℤ) : ℚ) • (V j : Point) := by
      rw [hdecv j, mul_comm]
    have htes := tau_entry_sign s t ((vertsOf sfs).getD (j:ℕ) default) (V j) hv
    rw [hτsign j]
    rw [← hsft] at htes
    rw [he]; exact htes
  
  have hsize3 : (vertsOf sfs).size = 3 := by simp [vertsOf]
  have hden : ∀ p ∈ collectParams (m:ℕ) (vertsOf sfs) τ (Impl.WellFormedCheck.faceNormal sft) sft.v₀, 0 < p.2 := by
    intro p hp
    exact Proof.WellFormedCheckNSIInterval.collectParams_sideSigns_den_pos (m:ℕ) (vertsOf sfs)
      (Impl.WellFormedCheck.faceNormal sft) sft.v₀ hsize3 p hp
  
  set Wt : Fin 3 → Point := ![t.v₀, t.v₁, t.v₂] with hWt
  have hΛt_pos : (0:ℤ) < (faceHOf s).w * (faceHOf t).w := sharedScale_pos t s
  have hdecvσ : ∀ j : Fin 3, decI ((vertsOf sft).getD (j : ℕ) default)
      = (((faceHOf s).w * (faceHOf t).w : ℤ) : ℚ) • (Wt j : Point) := by
    intro j; fin_cases j
    · show decI sft.v₀ = _; rw [hsft, decI_rescaleT_v₀]; simp [hWt]
    · show decI sft.v₁ = _; rw [hsft, decI_rescaleT_v₁]; simp [hWt]
    · show decI sft.v₂ = _; rw [hsft, decI_rescaleT_v₂]; simp [hWt]
  have hcoordvσ : ∀ j : Fin 3, ((coordAt (m : ℕ) ((vertsOf sft).getD (j : ℕ) default) : Int) : ℚ)
      = (((faceHOf s).w * (faceHOf t).w : ℤ) : ℚ) * (Wt j : Point) m := by
    intro j
    rw [Proof.WellFormedCheckNSILine.coordAt_cast (m : ℕ) _ m.2]
    rw [show (⟨(m:ℕ), m.2⟩ : Fin 3) = m from rfl, hdecvσ j]
    simp [Pi.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul]
  have hdeceσ : ∀ j : Fin 3,
      ((dotI (Impl.WellFormedCheck.faceNormal sfs) (subI ((vertsOf sft).getD (j : ℕ) default) sfs.v₀) : ℤ) : ℚ)
        = (((faceHOf t).w * (faceHOf s).w : ℤ) : ℚ) ^ 3 * (ns ⬝ᵥ ((Wt j : Point) - s.v₀)) := by
    intro j
    have hv : decI ((vertsOf sft).getD (j : ℕ) default)
        = (((faceHOf t).w * (faceHOf s).w : ℤ) : ℚ) • (Wt j : Point) := by
      rw [hdecvσ j, mul_comm]
    rw [hsfs, dotI_sideS_cast s t _ (Wt j) hv, hns]
  have hτsignσ : ∀ k, k < 3 → σ.getD k 0 = Int.sign (dotI (Impl.WellFormedCheck.faceNormal sfs)
      (subI ((vertsOf sft).getD k default) sfs.v₀)) := by
    intro k hk
    rw [hσ]
    exact Proof.WellFormedCheckNSIInterval.sideSigns_getD_eval (Impl.WellFormedCheck.faceNormal sfs) sfs.v₀
      (vertsOf sft) k (by simp only [vertsOf, Array.size_toArray, List.length_cons,
        List.length_singleton]; omega)
  have hsize3σ : (vertsOf sft).size = 3 := by simp [vertsOf]
  have hdenσ : ∀ p ∈ collectParams (m:ℕ) (vertsOf sft) σ (Impl.WellFormedCheck.faceNormal sfs) sfs.v₀, 0 < p.2 := by
    intro p hp
    exact Proof.WellFormedCheckNSIInterval.collectParams_sideSigns_den_pos (m:ℕ) (vertsOf sft)
      (Impl.WellFormedCheck.faceNormal sfs) sfs.v₀ hsize3σ p hp
  
  set Λ : ℚ := (((faceHOf t).w * (faceHOf s).w : ℤ) : ℚ) with hΛdef
  have hΛpos : 0 < Λ := by rw [hΛdef]; exact_mod_cast hΛs_pos
  
  have hCτ : ∀ j : Fin 3, Cval m (vertsOf sfs) (j : ℕ) = Λ * (Vert s j) m := by
    intro j
    have := hcoordv j
    rw [Proof.WellFormedCheckNSILine.coordAt_cast m _ m.2] at this
    simp only [show (⟨(m:ℕ), m.2⟩ : Fin 3) = m from rfl] at this
    simp only [Cval]
    rw [this, hΛdef, hc]; rfl
  have hEτ : ∀ j : Fin 3,
      Eval (Impl.WellFormedCheck.faceNormal sft) sft.v₀ (vertsOf sfs) (j : ℕ) = Λ ^ 3 * (nt ⬝ᵥ ((Vert s j) - t.v₀)) := by
    intro j; simp only [Eval]; rw [hdece j, hΛdef]
    rw [show (((faceHOf s).w * (faceHOf t).w : ℤ) : ℚ) = (((faceHOf t).w * (faceHOf s).w : ℤ) : ℚ)
        from by push_cast; ring]
    rw [he]; rfl
  have hsmτ : ∀ k, k < 3 → τ.getD k 0 = Int.sign (dotI (Impl.WellFormedCheck.faceNormal sft)
      (subI ((vertsOf sfs).getD k default) sft.v₀)) := by
    intro k hk
    rw [hτ]
    exact Proof.WellFormedCheckNSIInterval.sideSigns_getD_eval (Impl.WellFormedCheck.faceNormal sft) sft.v₀
      (vertsOf sfs) k (by rw [hsize3] at *; omega)
  
  have hCσ : ∀ j : Fin 3, Cval m (vertsOf sft) (j : ℕ) = Λ * (Vert t j) m := by
    intro j
    have := hcoordvσ j
    rw [Proof.WellFormedCheckNSILine.coordAt_cast m _ m.2] at this
    simp only [show (⟨(m:ℕ), m.2⟩ : Fin 3) = m from rfl] at this
    simp only [Cval]
    rw [this, hΛdef]
    rw [show (((faceHOf s).w * (faceHOf t).w : ℤ) : ℚ) = (((faceHOf t).w * (faceHOf s).w : ℤ) : ℚ)
        from by push_cast; ring]
    rfl
  have hEσ : ∀ j : Fin 3,
      Eval (Impl.WellFormedCheck.faceNormal sfs) sfs.v₀ (vertsOf sft) (j : ℕ) = Λ ^ 3 * (ns ⬝ᵥ ((Vert t j) - s.v₀)) := by
    intro j; simp only [Eval]; rw [hdeceσ j, hΛdef]; rfl
  
  set dq : Point := crossProduct ns nt with hdq
  have hdqm : dq m ≠ 0 := by rw [hdq, hns, hnt]; exact hcoord
  have hcrossd : dq ≠ 0 := by rw [hdq, hns, hnt]; exact hcross
  
  have hcrossσ : crossProduct (crossProduct ((t.v₁:Point) - t.v₀) ((t.v₂:Point) - t.v₀)) ns ≠ 0 := by
    rw [← hnt]
    intro h; apply hcross
    rw [hdq, ← neg_cross, h, neg_zero]
  
  apply instanceOK3_relint_iff s t m ns nt s.v₀ t.v₀ dq Λ hΛpos τ σ
    (fracInterval (collectParams (m:ℕ) (vertsOf sfs) τ (Impl.WellFormedCheck.faceNormal sft) sft.v₀))
    (fracInterval (collectParams (m:ℕ) (vertsOf sft) σ (Impl.WellFormedCheck.faceNormal sfs) sfs.v₀)) hdqm
  · 
    rintro x ⟨μ, hμpos, hμsum, rfl⟩
    rw [hns]
    have hsum3 : μ 0 + μ 1 + μ 2 = 1 := by rw [Fin.sum_univ_three] at hμsum; exact hμsum
    exact baryPt_own_plane s μ hsum3
  · 
    intro x hx; rw [hnt]; exact triangleSet_subset_facePlane t hx
  · 
    intro x y hxs hxt hys hyt
    exact line_points_collinear ns nt s.v₀ t.v₀ x y hcrossd hxs hys hxt hyt
  · 
    intro hE
    refine caseE_relint_empty s nt t.v₀ τ e ?_ ?_ ?_ hE
    · intro j; rw [he]; rfl
    · rw [← hns]; exact hcross
    · intro j; exact (hesign j).2.2
  · 
    intro hnone
    have hempty := noIncidence_empty s m nt t.v₀ Λ (vertsOf sfs) τ (Impl.WellFormedCheck.faceNormal sft) sft.v₀
      hEτ (by positivity) hsmτ hden hnone
    rw [Set.eq_empty_iff_forall_not_mem] at hempty ⊢
    intro x hx
    exact hempty x ⟨triRelint_subset_triangleSet s hx.1, hx.2⟩
  · 
    intro hnone
    exact noIncidence_empty t m ns s.v₀ Λ (vertsOf sft) σ (Impl.WellFormedCheck.faceNormal sfs) sfs.v₀
      hEσ (by positivity) hτsignσ hdenσ hnone
  · 
    intro lo hi hIown x hxr hxpl
    exact ownProj_strict s t hs m ns nt dq Λ (vertsOf sfs) τ (Impl.WellFormedCheck.faceNormal sft) sft.v₀ lo hi
      hns hdq hdqm hcrossd hCτ hEτ hΛpos hsmτ hden hIown x hxr hxpl
  · 
    intro lo hi hIown hedge r hr1 hr2
    obtain ⟨hloM, hhiM⟩ := fracInterval_endpoints_mem _ hden lo hi hIown
    exact ownProj_cover s hs m nt t.v₀ Λ (vertsOf sfs) τ (Impl.WellFormedCheck.faceNormal sft) sft.v₀ lo hi
      hCτ hEτ hΛpos hsmτ hedge r ⟨hr1, hr2⟩ hloM hhiM
  · 
    intro ao bo hIoth x hxt hxs
    exact othProj_bound t m ns s.v₀ Λ (vertsOf sft) σ (Impl.WellFormedCheck.faceNormal sfs) sfs.v₀ ao bo
      hCσ hEσ (by positivity) hτsignσ hdenσ hIoth x hxt hxs
  · 
    intro ao bo hIoth r hr1 hr2
    exact othProj_cover t m ns s.v₀ Λ (vertsOf sft) σ (Impl.WellFormedCheck.faceNormal sfs) sfs.v₀ ao bo
      hCσ hEσ hΛpos hτsignσ hdenσ hIoth r ⟨hr1, hr2⟩
  · 
    intro af bf ao bo hIown hIoth hedge hob
    obtain ⟨_, _, _⟩ := fracInterval_some_le _ hden af bf hIown
    obtain ⟨_, _, _⟩ := fracInterval_some_le _ hdenσ ao bo hIoth
    rw [hIown, hIoth]
    exact instanceOK3_reflect τ af bf ao bo (by assumption) (by assumption) (by assumption)
      (by assumption) hob hedge
  · 
    intro ao bo hIoth
    exact (fracInterval_some_le _ hdenσ ao bo hIoth).2.2
  · 
    intro hedge hnone
    unfold instanceOK3; rw [hedge]
    simp only [Bool.false_eq_true, if_false]
    rcases hnone with h | h
    · rw [h]
    · rw [h]; cases (fracInterval (collectParams (↑m) (vertsOf sfs) τ (Impl.WellFormedCheck.faceNormal sft) sft.v₀)) <;> rfl

name: allZero_sigma_decode
statement:
theorem allZero_sigma_decode (S T : Triangle)
    (hcop : allZero (sideSigns (Impl.WellFormedCheck.faceNormal (rescale (faceHOf T).w (faceHOf S)))
      (rescale (faceHOf T).w (faceHOf S)).v₀ (vertsOf (rescale (faceHOf S).w (faceHOf T)))) = true) :
    crossProduct ((S.v₁ : Point) - S.v₀) ((S.v₂ : Point) - S.v₀) ⬝ᵥ ((T.v₀ : Point) - S.v₀) = 0
    ∧ crossProduct ((S.v₁ : Point) - S.v₀) ((S.v₂ : Point) - S.v₀) ⬝ᵥ ((T.v₁ : Point) - S.v₀) = 0
    ∧ crossProduct ((S.v₁ : Point) - S.v₀) ((S.v₂ : Point) - S.v₀) ⬝ᵥ ((T.v₂ : Point) - S.v₀) = 0
proof:
:= by
  set sfS := rescale (faceHOf T).w (faceHOf S) with hsfS
  set sfT := rescale (faceHOf S).w (faceHOf T) with hsfT
  
  have e0 := sigma_entry_sign S T sfT.v₀ T.v₀ (by rw [hsfT, decI_rescaleT_v₀, mul_comm])
  have e1 := sigma_entry_sign S T sfT.v₁ T.v₁ (by rw [hsfT, decI_rescaleT_v₁, mul_comm])
  have e2 := sigma_entry_sign S T sfT.v₂ T.v₂ (by rw [hsfT, decI_rescaleT_v₂, mul_comm])
  have hg0 : (sideSigns (Impl.WellFormedCheck.faceNormal sfS) sfS.v₀ (vertsOf sfT)).getD 0 0
      = Int.sign (dotI (Impl.WellFormedCheck.faceNormal sfS) (subI sfT.v₀ sfS.v₀)) := by simp [sideSigns, vertsOf, Array.getD]
  have hg1 : (sideSigns (Impl.WellFormedCheck.faceNormal sfS) sfS.v₀ (vertsOf sfT)).getD 1 0
      = Int.sign (dotI (Impl.WellFormedCheck.faceNormal sfS) (subI sfT.v₁ sfS.v₀)) := by simp [sideSigns, vertsOf, Array.getD]
  have hg2 : (sideSigns (Impl.WellFormedCheck.faceNormal sfS) sfS.v₀ (vertsOf sfT)).getD 2 0
      = Int.sign (dotI (Impl.WellFormedCheck.faceNormal sfS) (subI sfT.v₂ sfS.v₀)) := by simp [sideSigns, vertsOf, Array.getD]
  rw [allZero, sideSigns_all_eq] at hcop
  obtain ⟨z0, z1, z2⟩ := hcop
  rw [hg0] at z0; rw [hg1] at z1; rw [hg2] at z2
  exact ⟨e0.2.2.mp z0, e1.2.2.mp z1, e2.2.2.mp z2⟩

name: coplanar_normal_parallel
statement:
theorem coplanar_normal_parallel (S T : Triangle) (hS : NDeg S) (hT : NDeg T)
    (h0 : crossProduct ((S.v₁ : Point) - S.v₀) ((S.v₂ : Point) - S.v₀) ⬝ᵥ ((T.v₀ : Point) - S.v₀) = 0)
    (h1 : crossProduct ((S.v₁ : Point) - S.v₀) ((S.v₂ : Point) - S.v₀) ⬝ᵥ ((T.v₁ : Point) - S.v₀) = 0)
    (h2 : crossProduct ((S.v₁ : Point) - S.v₀) ((S.v₂ : Point) - S.v₀) ⬝ᵥ ((T.v₂ : Point) - S.v₀) = 0) :
    ∃ c : ℚ, c ≠ 0 ∧ crossProduct ((S.v₁ : Point) - S.v₀) ((S.v₂ : Point) - S.v₀)
      = c • crossProduct ((T.v₁ : Point) - T.v₀) ((T.v₂ : Point) - T.v₀)
proof:
:= by
  set nS := crossProduct ((S.v₁ : Point) - S.v₀) ((S.v₂ : Point) - S.v₀) with hnS
  have hnT : crossProduct ((T.v₁ : Point) - T.v₀) ((T.v₂ : Point) - T.v₀) ≠ 0 :=
    faceNormal_ne_zero_of_detOrigin T hT
  
  have he1 : (T.v₁ : Point) - T.v₀ = ((T.v₁ : Point) - S.v₀) - ((T.v₀ : Point) - S.v₀) := by abel
  have he2 : (T.v₂ : Point) - T.v₀ = ((T.v₂ : Point) - S.v₀) - ((T.v₀ : Point) - S.v₀) := by abel
  have hd1 : ((T.v₁ : Point) - T.v₀) ⬝ᵥ nS = 0 := by
    rw [dotProduct_comm, he1, dotProduct_sub, h1, h0, sub_zero]
  have hd2 : ((T.v₂ : Point) - T.v₀) ⬝ᵥ nS = 0 := by
    rw [dotProduct_comm, he2, dotProduct_sub, h2, h0, sub_zero]
  
  obtain ⟨c, hc⟩ := Proof.WellFormedCheckNSILine.collinear_of_dot_zero_pair
    ((T.v₁ : Point) - T.v₀) ((T.v₂ : Point) - T.v₀) nS hnT hd1 hd2
  refine ⟨c, ?_, hc⟩
  intro hc0
  apply faceNormal_ne_zero_of_detOrigin S hS
  rw [← hnS, hc, hc0, zero_smul]

name: triRelint_functional_pos
statement:
theorem triRelint_functional_pos (own : Triangle) (n q : Point)
    (h0 : 0 ≤ n ⬝ᵥ ((own.v₀ : Point) - q)) (h1 : 0 ≤ n ⬝ᵥ ((own.v₁ : Point) - q))
    (h2 : 0 ≤ n ⬝ᵥ ((own.v₂ : Point) - q))
    (hpos : 0 < n ⬝ᵥ ((own.v₀ : Point) - q) ∨ 0 < n ⬝ᵥ ((own.v₁ : Point) - q)
      ∨ 0 < n ⬝ᵥ ((own.v₂ : Point) - q))
    (p : Point) (hp : p ∈ triRelint own) :
    0 < n ⬝ᵥ (p - q)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨μ, hμpos, hμsum, hμx⟩ := hp
  have hsum3 : μ 0 + μ 1 + μ 2 = 1 := by rw [Fin.sum_univ_three] at hμsum; exact hμsum
  rw [bary_affine_eval n q own μ hsum3 p hμx]
  rcases hpos with hp | hp | hp
  · have := mul_pos (hμpos 0) hp
    linarith [mul_nonneg (le_of_lt (hμpos 1)) h1, mul_nonneg (le_of_lt (hμpos 2)) h2]
  · have := mul_pos (hμpos 1) hp
    linarith [mul_nonneg (le_of_lt (hμpos 0)) h0, mul_nonneg (le_of_lt (hμpos 2)) h2]
  · have := mul_pos (hμpos 2) hp
    linarith [mul_nonneg (le_of_lt (hμpos 0)) h0, mul_nonneg (le_of_lt (hμpos 1)) h1]

name: coplanar_easy_disjoint
statement:
theorem coplanar_easy_disjoint (own other : Triangle) (m u : Point) (c : ℚ)
    (hself0 : 0 ≤ c * (m ⬝ᵥ ((own.v₀ : Point) - u)))
    (hself1 : 0 ≤ c * (m ⬝ᵥ ((own.v₁ : Point) - u)))
    (hself2 : 0 ≤ c * (m ⬝ᵥ ((own.v₂ : Point) - u)))
    (hselfpos : 0 < c * (m ⬝ᵥ ((own.v₀ : Point) - u)) ∨ 0 < c * (m ⬝ᵥ ((own.v₁ : Point) - u))
      ∨ 0 < c * (m ⬝ᵥ ((own.v₂ : Point) - u)))
    (hoth0 : c * (m ⬝ᵥ ((other.v₀ : Point) - u)) ≤ 0)
    (hoth1 : c * (m ⬝ᵥ ((other.v₁ : Point) - u)) ≤ 0)
    (hoth2 : c * (m ⬝ᵥ ((other.v₂ : Point) - u)) ≤ 0) :
    triRelint own ∩ triangleSet other = ∅
proof:
:= by
  
  have hcm : ∀ x : Point, (c • m) ⬝ᵥ (x - u) = c * (m ⬝ᵥ (x - u)) := by
    intro x; rw [smul_dotProduct, smul_eq_mul]
  rw [Set.eq_empty_iff_forall_not_mem]
  rintro p ⟨hpr, hpt⟩
  have hpos : 0 < (c • m) ⬝ᵥ (p - u) := by
    apply triRelint_functional_pos own (c • m) u
    · rw [hcm]; exact hself0
    · rw [hcm]; exact hself1
    · rw [hcm]; exact hself2
    · rcases hselfpos with h | h | h
      · exact Or.inl (by rw [hcm]; exact h)
      · exact Or.inr (Or.inl (by rw [hcm]; exact h))
      · exact Or.inr (Or.inr (by rw [hcm]; exact h))
    · exact hpr
  have hnonpos : (c • m) ⬝ᵥ (p - u) ≤ 0 := by
    apply triangleSet_functional_nonpos other (c • m) u
    · rw [hcm]; exact hoth0
    · rw [hcm]; exact hoth1
    · rw [hcm]; exact hoth2
    · exact hpt
  linarith

name: triRelint_functional_neg
statement:
theorem triRelint_functional_neg (own : Triangle) (n q : Point)
    (h0 : n ⬝ᵥ ((own.v₀ : Point) - q) ≤ 0) (h1 : n ⬝ᵥ ((own.v₁ : Point) - q) ≤ 0)
    (h2 : n ⬝ᵥ ((own.v₂ : Point) - q) ≤ 0)
    (hneg : n ⬝ᵥ ((own.v₀ : Point) - q) < 0 ∨ n ⬝ᵥ ((own.v₁ : Point) - q) < 0
      ∨ n ⬝ᵥ ((own.v₂ : Point) - q) < 0)
    (p : Point) (hp : p ∈ triRelint own) :
    n ⬝ᵥ (p - q) < 0
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨μ, hμpos, hμsum, hμx⟩ := hp
  have hsum3 : μ 0 + μ 1 + μ 2 = 1 := by rw [Fin.sum_univ_three] at hμsum; exact hμsum
  rw [bary_affine_eval n q own μ hsum3 p hμx]
  rcases hneg with hp | hp | hp
  · have := mul_neg_of_pos_of_neg (hμpos 0) hp
    linarith [mul_nonpos_of_nonneg_of_nonpos (le_of_lt (hμpos 1)) h1,
      mul_nonpos_of_nonneg_of_nonpos (le_of_lt (hμpos 2)) h2]
  · have := mul_neg_of_pos_of_neg (hμpos 1) hp
    linarith [mul_nonpos_of_nonneg_of_nonpos (le_of_lt (hμpos 0)) h0,
      mul_nonpos_of_nonneg_of_nonpos (le_of_lt (hμpos 2)) h2]
  · have := mul_neg_of_pos_of_neg (hμpos 2) hp
    linarith [mul_nonpos_of_nonneg_of_nonpos (le_of_lt (hμpos 0)) h0,
      mul_nonpos_of_nonneg_of_nonpos (le_of_lt (hμpos 1)) h1]

name: coplanar_easy_disjoint_other
statement:
theorem coplanar_easy_disjoint_other (own other : Triangle) (m u : Point) (c : ℚ)
    (hown0 : 0 ≤ c * (m ⬝ᵥ ((own.v₀ : Point) - u)))
    (hown1 : 0 ≤ c * (m ⬝ᵥ ((own.v₁ : Point) - u)))
    (hown2 : 0 ≤ c * (m ⬝ᵥ ((own.v₂ : Point) - u)))
    (hoth0 : c * (m ⬝ᵥ ((other.v₀ : Point) - u)) ≤ 0)
    (hoth1 : c * (m ⬝ᵥ ((other.v₁ : Point) - u)) ≤ 0)
    (hoth2 : c * (m ⬝ᵥ ((other.v₂ : Point) - u)) ≤ 0)
    (hwit : c * (m ⬝ᵥ ((other.v₀ : Point) - u)) < 0 ∨ c * (m ⬝ᵥ ((other.v₁ : Point) - u)) < 0
      ∨ c * (m ⬝ᵥ ((other.v₂ : Point) - u)) < 0) :
    triRelint other ∩ triangleSet own = ∅
proof:
:= by
  have hcm : ∀ x : Point, (c • m) ⬝ᵥ (x - u) = c * (m ⬝ᵥ (x - u)) := by
    intro x; rw [smul_dotProduct, smul_eq_mul]
  rw [Set.eq_empty_iff_forall_not_mem]
  rintro p ⟨hpr, hpt⟩
  have hneg : (c • m) ⬝ᵥ (p - u) < 0 := by
    apply triRelint_functional_neg other (c • m) u
    · rw [hcm]; exact hoth0
    · rw [hcm]; exact hoth1
    · rw [hcm]; exact hoth2
    · rcases hwit with h | h | h
      · exact Or.inl (by rw [hcm]; exact h)
      · exact Or.inr (Or.inl (by rw [hcm]; exact h))
      · exact Or.inr (Or.inr (by rw [hcm]; exact h))
    · exact hpr
  have hnonneg : 0 ≤ (c • m) ⬝ᵥ (p - u) := by
    apply triangleSet_functional_nonneg own (c • m) u
    · rw [hcm]; exact hown0
    · rw [hcm]; exact hown1
    · rw [hcm]; exact hown2
    · exact hpt
  linarith

name: coplanar_edgeval_decode
statement:
theorem coplanar_edgeval_decode (nsI uI vI wI : I3) (Λ : ℚ) (nf u v w : Point)
    (hns : decI nsI = (Λ ^ 2) • nf) (hu : decI uI = Λ • u) (hv : decI vI = Λ • v)
    (hw : decI wI = Λ • w) :
    ((dotI (crossI nsI (subI vI uI)) (subI wI uI) : ℤ) : ℚ)
      = Λ ^ 4 * (crossProduct nf (v - u) ⬝ᵥ (w - u))
proof:
:= by
  rw [decI_dot, decI_cross, decI_sub, decI_sub, hns, hv, hu, hw,
    ← smul_sub, ← smul_sub, crossProduct_smul_both, smul_dotProduct, dotProduct_smul,
    smul_eq_mul, smul_eq_mul]
  ring

name: coplanar_edge_sep_disjoint
statement:
theorem coplanar_edge_sep_disjoint (own other : Triangle) (nf : Point) (Λ : ℚ) (hΛ : 0 < Λ)
    (hnf : nf ≠ 0)
    (hothernd : crossProduct ((other.v₁ : Point) - other.v₀) ((other.v₂ : Point) - other.v₀) ≠ 0)
    (hcop : ∃ κ : ℚ, crossProduct ((other.v₁ : Point) - other.v₀) ((other.v₂ : Point) - other.v₀)
      = κ • nf)
    (nsI uI vI zI w0I w1I w2I : I3) (u v z : Point)
    (hns : decI nsI = (Λ ^ 2) • nf)
    (hu : decI uI = Λ • u) (hv : decI vI = Λ • v) (hz : decI zI = Λ • z)
    (hw0 : decI w0I = Λ • (other.v₀ : Point)) (hw1 : decI w1I = Λ • (other.v₁ : Point))
    (hw2 : decI w2I = Λ • (other.v₂ : Point))
    
    (hown : ((own.v₀ : Point) = u ∧ (own.v₁ : Point) = v ∧ (own.v₂ : Point) = z)
      ∨ ((own.v₀ : Point) = v ∧ (own.v₁ : Point) = z ∧ (own.v₂ : Point) = u)
      ∨ ((own.v₀ : Point) = z ∧ (own.v₁ : Point) = u ∧ (own.v₂ : Point) = v))
    (hc : dotI (crossI nsI (subI vI uI)) (subI zI uI) ≠ 0)
    (ho0 : dotI (crossI nsI (subI vI uI)) (subI zI uI)
        * dotI (crossI nsI (subI vI uI)) (subI w0I uI) ≤ 0)
    (ho1 : dotI (crossI nsI (subI vI uI)) (subI zI uI)
        * dotI (crossI nsI (subI vI uI)) (subI w1I uI) ≤ 0)
    (ho2 : dotI (crossI nsI (subI vI uI)) (subI zI uI)
        * dotI (crossI nsI (subI vI uI)) (subI w2I uI) ≤ 0) :
    triRelint own ∩ triangleSet other = ∅
      ∧ triRelint other ∩ triangleSet own = ∅
proof:
:= by
  
  set m : Point := crossProduct nf (v - u) with hm
  set c : ℚ := m ⬝ᵥ (z - u) with hcdef
  
  have hapex : ((dotI (crossI nsI (subI vI uI)) (subI zI uI) : ℤ) : ℚ) = Λ ^ 4 * c :=
    coplanar_edgeval_decode nsI uI vI zI Λ nf u v z hns hu hv hz
  
  have hcne : c ≠ 0 := by
    intro h0; apply hc
    have : ((dotI (crossI nsI (subI vI uI)) (subI zI uI) : ℤ) : ℚ) = 0 := by rw [hapex, h0, mul_zero]
    exact_mod_cast this
  
  have decprod : ∀ (wI : I3) (w : Point), decI wI = Λ • w →
      (((dotI (crossI nsI (subI vI uI)) (subI zI uI)
        * dotI (crossI nsI (subI vI uI)) (subI wI uI) : ℤ)) : ℚ)
        = Λ ^ 8 * (c * (m ⬝ᵥ (w - u))) := by
    intro wI w hw
    have hwval : ((dotI (crossI nsI (subI vI uI)) (subI wI uI) : ℤ) : ℚ)
        = Λ ^ 4 * (m ⬝ᵥ (w - u)) :=
      coplanar_edgeval_decode nsI uI vI wI Λ nf u v w hns hu hv hw
    push_cast
    rw [hapex, hwval]; ring
  
  have hΛ8 : (0 : ℚ) < Λ ^ 8 := by positivity
  have hoth0 : c * (m ⬝ᵥ ((other.v₀ : Point) - u)) ≤ 0 := by
    have heq := decprod w0I other.v₀ hw0
    have hle : (((dotI (crossI nsI (subI vI uI)) (subI zI uI)
        * dotI (crossI nsI (subI vI uI)) (subI w0I uI) : ℤ)) : ℚ) ≤ 0 := by exact_mod_cast ho0
    rw [heq] at hle; exact nonpos_of_mul_nonpos_right hle hΛ8
  have hoth1 : c * (m ⬝ᵥ ((other.v₁ : Point) - u)) ≤ 0 := by
    have heq := decprod w1I other.v₁ hw1
    have hle : (((dotI (crossI nsI (subI vI uI)) (subI zI uI)
        * dotI (crossI nsI (subI vI uI)) (subI w1I uI) : ℤ)) : ℚ) ≤ 0 := by exact_mod_cast ho1
    rw [heq] at hle; exact nonpos_of_mul_nonpos_right hle hΛ8
  have hoth2 : c * (m ⬝ᵥ ((other.v₂ : Point) - u)) ≤ 0 := by
    have heq := decprod w2I other.v₂ hw2
    have hle : (((dotI (crossI nsI (subI vI uI)) (subI zI uI)
        * dotI (crossI nsI (subI vI uI)) (subI w2I uI) : ℤ)) : ℚ) ≤ 0 := by exact_mod_cast ho2
    rw [heq] at hle; exact nonpos_of_mul_nonpos_right hle hΛ8
  
  have hgu : m ⬝ᵥ ((u : Point) - u) = 0 := by rw [sub_self]; simp
  have hgv : m ⬝ᵥ ((v : Point) - u) = 0 := by
    rw [hm, dotProduct_comm]; exact dot_cross_self nf (v - u)
  have hgz : m ⬝ᵥ ((z : Point) - u) = c := rfl
  have hcc : (0 : ℚ) < c * c := mul_self_pos.mpr hcne
  
  have hown0 : 0 ≤ c * (m ⬝ᵥ ((own.v₀ : Point) - u)) := by
    rcases hown with ⟨e0, _, _⟩ | ⟨e0, _, _⟩ | ⟨e0, _, _⟩ <;>
      rw [e0] <;> simp only [hgu, hgv, hgz, mul_zero, le_refl]
    exact hcc.le
  have hown1 : 0 ≤ c * (m ⬝ᵥ ((own.v₁ : Point) - u)) := by
    rcases hown with ⟨_, e1, _⟩ | ⟨_, e1, _⟩ | ⟨_, e1, _⟩ <;>
      rw [e1] <;> simp only [hgu, hgv, hgz, mul_zero, le_refl]
    exact hcc.le
  have hown2 : 0 ≤ c * (m ⬝ᵥ ((own.v₂ : Point) - u)) := by
    rcases hown with ⟨_, _, e2⟩ | ⟨_, _, e2⟩ | ⟨_, _, e2⟩ <;>
      rw [e2] <;> simp only [hgu, hgv, hgz, mul_zero, le_refl]
    exact hcc.le
  have hownpos : 0 < c * (m ⬝ᵥ ((own.v₀ : Point) - u)) ∨ 0 < c * (m ⬝ᵥ ((own.v₁ : Point) - u))
      ∨ 0 < c * (m ⬝ᵥ ((own.v₂ : Point) - u)) := by
    rcases hown with ⟨e0, e1, e2⟩ | ⟨e0, e1, e2⟩ | ⟨e0, e1, e2⟩
    · exact Or.inr (Or.inr (by rw [e2, hgz]; exact hcc))
    · exact Or.inr (Or.inl (by rw [e1, hgz]; exact hcc))
    · exact Or.inl (by rw [e0, hgz]; exact hcc)
  
  have hm0 : m ≠ 0 := by
    intro h; apply hcne; rw [hcdef, h]; simp
  have hwit : c * (m ⬝ᵥ ((other.v₀ : Point) - u)) < 0 ∨ c * (m ⬝ᵥ ((other.v₁ : Point) - u)) < 0
      ∨ c * (m ⬝ᵥ ((other.v₂ : Point) - u)) < 0 := by
    by_contra hall
    push_neg at hall
    obtain ⟨ha0, ha1, ha2⟩ := hall
    
    have z0 : c * (m ⬝ᵥ ((other.v₀ : Point) - u)) = 0 := le_antisymm hoth0 ha0
    have z1 : c * (m ⬝ᵥ ((other.v₁ : Point) - u)) = 0 := le_antisymm hoth1 ha1
    have z2 : c * (m ⬝ᵥ ((other.v₂ : Point) - u)) = 0 := le_antisymm hoth2 ha2
    
    have g0 : m ⬝ᵥ ((other.v₀ : Point) - u) = 0 := by
      rcases mul_eq_zero.mp z0 with h | h; exact absurd h hcne; exact h
    have g1 : m ⬝ᵥ ((other.v₁ : Point) - u) = 0 := by
      rcases mul_eq_zero.mp z1 with h | h; exact absurd h hcne; exact h
    have g2 : m ⬝ᵥ ((other.v₂ : Point) - u) = 0 := by
      rcases mul_eq_zero.mp z2 with h | h; exact absurd h hcne; exact h
    
    have he1 : ((other.v₁ : Point) - other.v₀) ⬝ᵥ m = 0 := by
      have : (other.v₁ : Point) - other.v₀ = ((other.v₁ : Point) - u) - ((other.v₀ : Point) - u) := by abel
      rw [dotProduct_comm, this, dotProduct_sub, g1, g0, sub_zero]
    have he2 : ((other.v₂ : Point) - other.v₀) ⬝ᵥ m = 0 := by
      have : (other.v₂ : Point) - other.v₀ = ((other.v₂ : Point) - u) - ((other.v₀ : Point) - u) := by abel
      rw [dotProduct_comm, this, dotProduct_sub, g2, g0, sub_zero]
    
    obtain ⟨κ, hκ⟩ := hcop
    obtain ⟨c', hc'⟩ := Proof.WellFormedCheckNSILine.collinear_of_dot_zero_pair
      ((other.v₁ : Point) - other.v₀) ((other.v₂ : Point) - other.v₀) m hothernd he1 he2
    
    have hmnf : m ⬝ᵥ nf = 0 := by
      rw [hm, dotProduct_comm]; exact dot_self_cross nf (v - u)
    rw [hc', hκ, smul_smul, smul_dotProduct, smul_eq_mul] at hmnf
    have hnfsq : (0 : ℚ) < nf ⬝ᵥ nf := by
      have hge : (0 : ℚ) ≤ nf ⬝ᵥ nf := by
        rw [show nf ⬝ᵥ nf = ∑ i, nf i * nf i from rfl]
        apply Finset.sum_nonneg; intro i _; exact mul_self_nonneg _
      rcases lt_or_eq_of_le hge with h | h
      · exact h
      · exact absurd ((dotProduct_self_eq_zero (v := nf)).mp h.symm) hnf
    have hck0 : c' * κ = 0 := by
      rcases mul_eq_zero.mp hmnf with h | h
      · exact h
      · exact absurd h (ne_of_gt hnfsq)
    exact hm0 (by rw [hc', hκ, smul_smul, hck0, zero_smul])
  refine ⟨coplanar_easy_disjoint own other m u c hown0 hown1 hown2 hownpos hoth0 hoth1 hoth2,
    coplanar_easy_disjoint_other own other m u c hown0 hown1 hown2 hoth0 hoth1 hoth2 hwit⟩

name: coplanarSeparated_imp_disjoint
statement:
theorem coplanarSeparated_imp_disjoint (S T : Triangle) (hS : NDeg S) (hT : NDeg T)
    (hcopz : allZero (sideSigns (Impl.WellFormedCheck.faceNormal (rescale (faceHOf T).w (faceHOf S)))
      (rescale (faceHOf T).w (faceHOf S)).v₀ (vertsOf (rescale (faceHOf S).w (faceHOf T)))) = true)
    (hsep : coplanarSeparated (Impl.WellFormedCheck.faceNormal (rescale (faceHOf T).w (faceHOf S)))
        (vertsOf (rescale (faceHOf T).w (faceHOf S)))
        (vertsOf (rescale (faceHOf S).w (faceHOf T))) = true) :
    (triRelint S ∩ triangleSet T = ∅) ∧ (triRelint T ∩ triangleSet S = ∅)
proof:
:= by
  set sfS := rescale (faceHOf T).w (faceHOf S) with hsfS
  set sfT := rescale (faceHOf S).w (faceHOf T) with hsfT
  set Λ : ℚ := (((faceHOf T).w * (faceHOf S).w : ℤ) : ℚ) with hΛdef
  have hΛpos : (0 : ℚ) < Λ := by rw [hΛdef]; exact_mod_cast sharedScale_pos S T
  set nS : Point := crossProduct ((S.v₁ : Point) - S.v₀) ((S.v₂ : Point) - S.v₀) with hnSdef
  set nT : Point := crossProduct ((T.v₁ : Point) - T.v₀) ((T.v₂ : Point) - T.v₀) with hnTdef
  have hnSne : nS ≠ 0 := faceNormal_ne_zero_of_detOrigin S hS
  have hnTne : nT ≠ 0 := faceNormal_ne_zero_of_detOrigin T hT
  
  obtain ⟨z0, z1, z2⟩ := allZero_sigma_decode S T hcopz
  obtain ⟨cpar, hcpar0, hcparS⟩ := coplanar_normal_parallel S T hS hT z0 z1 z2
  
  have hcopT : ∃ κ : ℚ, nT = κ • nS := by
    refine ⟨cpar⁻¹, ?_⟩
    rw [hnTdef, hnSdef, hcparS, smul_smul, inv_mul_cancel₀ hcpar0, one_smul]
  
  have hcopS : ∃ κ : ℚ, nS = κ • nS := ⟨1, (one_smul ℚ nS).symm⟩
  
  have hnsS : decI (Impl.WellFormedCheck.faceNormal sfS) = (Λ ^ 2) • nS := by
    rw [hsfS, decI_faceNormal_S]
  have hSv0 : decI sfS.v₀ = Λ • (S.v₀ : Point) := by rw [hsfS, decI_rescaleS_v₀]
  have hSv1 : decI sfS.v₁ = Λ • (S.v₁ : Point) := by rw [hsfS, decI_rescaleS_v₁]
  have hSv2 : decI sfS.v₂ = Λ • (S.v₂ : Point) := by rw [hsfS, decI_rescaleS_v₂]
  have hTv0 : decI sfT.v₀ = Λ • (T.v₀ : Point) := by rw [hsfT, decI_rescaleT_v₀, hΛdef, mul_comm]
  have hTv1 : decI sfT.v₁ = Λ • (T.v₁ : Point) := by rw [hsfT, decI_rescaleT_v₁, hΛdef, mul_comm]
  have hTv2 : decI sfT.v₂ = Λ • (T.v₂ : Point) := by rw [hsfT, decI_rescaleT_v₂, hΛdef, mul_comm]
  
  
  have gS0 : (vertsOf sfS).getD 0 default = sfS.v₀ := rfl
  have gS1 : (vertsOf sfS).getD 1 default = sfS.v₁ := rfl
  have gS2 : (vertsOf sfS).getD 2 default = sfS.v₂ := rfl
  have gT0 : (vertsOf sfT).getD 0 default = sfT.v₀ := rfl
  have gT1 : (vertsOf sfT).getD 1 default = sfT.v₁ := rfl
  have gT2 : (vertsOf sfT).getD 2 default = sfT.v₂ := rfl
  simp only [coplanarSeparated, Bool.or_eq_true, Bool.and_eq_true, range3_any_iff, range3_all_iff,
    bne_iff_ne, ne_eq, decide_eq_true_eq,
    show ((0 : Nat) + 1) % 3 = 1 from rfl, show ((0 : Nat) + 2) % 3 = 2 from rfl,
    show ((1 : Nat) + 1) % 3 = 2 from rfl, show ((1 : Nat) + 2) % 3 = 0 from rfl,
    show ((2 : Nat) + 1) % 3 = 0 from rfl, show ((2 : Nat) + 2) % 3 = 1 from rfl,
    gS0, gS1, gS2, gT0, gT1, gT2] at hsep
  obtain (h | h | h) | (h | h | h) := hsep
  · obtain ⟨hc, ho0, ho1, ho2⟩ := h
    exact coplanar_edge_sep_disjoint S T nS Λ hΛpos hnSne hnTne hcopT
      (Impl.WellFormedCheck.faceNormal sfS) sfS.v₀ sfS.v₁ sfS.v₂ sfT.v₀ sfT.v₁ sfT.v₂ S.v₀ S.v₁ S.v₂
      hnsS hSv0 hSv1 hSv2 hTv0 hTv1 hTv2
      (Or.inl ⟨rfl, rfl, rfl⟩) hc ho0 ho1 ho2
  · obtain ⟨hc, ho0, ho1, ho2⟩ := h
    exact coplanar_edge_sep_disjoint S T nS Λ hΛpos hnSne hnTne hcopT
      (Impl.WellFormedCheck.faceNormal sfS) sfS.v₁ sfS.v₂ sfS.v₀ sfT.v₀ sfT.v₁ sfT.v₂ S.v₁ S.v₂ S.v₀
      hnsS hSv1 hSv2 hSv0 hTv0 hTv1 hTv2
      (Or.inr (Or.inr ⟨rfl, rfl, rfl⟩)) hc ho0 ho1 ho2
  · obtain ⟨hc, ho0, ho1, ho2⟩ := h
    exact coplanar_edge_sep_disjoint S T nS Λ hΛpos hnSne hnTne hcopT
      (Impl.WellFormedCheck.faceNormal sfS) sfS.v₂ sfS.v₀ sfS.v₁ sfT.v₀ sfT.v₁ sfT.v₂ S.v₂ S.v₀ S.v₁
      hnsS hSv2 hSv0 hSv1 hTv0 hTv1 hTv2
      (Or.inr (Or.inl ⟨rfl, rfl, rfl⟩)) hc ho0 ho1 ho2
  · obtain ⟨hc, ho0, ho1, ho2⟩ := h
    exact (coplanar_edge_sep_disjoint T S nS Λ hΛpos hnSne hnSne hcopS
      (Impl.WellFormedCheck.faceNormal sfS) sfT.v₀ sfT.v₁ sfT.v₂ sfS.v₀ sfS.v₁ sfS.v₂ T.v₀ T.v₁ T.v₂
      hnsS hTv0 hTv1 hTv2 hSv0 hSv1 hSv2
      (Or.inl ⟨rfl, rfl, rfl⟩) hc ho0 ho1 ho2).symm
  · obtain ⟨hc, ho0, ho1, ho2⟩ := h
    exact (coplanar_edge_sep_disjoint T S nS Λ hΛpos hnSne hnSne hcopS
      (Impl.WellFormedCheck.faceNormal sfS) sfT.v₁ sfT.v₂ sfT.v₀ sfS.v₀ sfS.v₁ sfS.v₂ T.v₁ T.v₂ T.v₀
      hnsS hTv1 hTv2 hTv0 hSv0 hSv1 hSv2
      (Or.inr (Or.inr ⟨rfl, rfl, rfl⟩)) hc ho0 ho1 ho2).symm
  · obtain ⟨hc, ho0, ho1, ho2⟩ := h
    exact (coplanar_edge_sep_disjoint T S nS Λ hΛpos hnSne hnSne hcopS
      (Impl.WellFormedCheck.faceNormal sfS) sfT.v₂ sfT.v₀ sfT.v₁ sfS.v₀ sfS.v₁ sfS.v₂ T.v₂ T.v₀ T.v₁
      hnsS hTv2 hTv0 hTv1 hSv0 hSv1 hSv2
      (Or.inr (Or.inl ⟨rfl, rfl, rfl⟩)) hc ho0 ho1 ho2).symm

name: coplanar_point_bary
statement:
theorem coplanar_point_bary (S : Triangle) (hS : NDeg S) (x : Point)
    (hx : crossProduct ((S.v₁ : Point) - S.v₀) ((S.v₂ : Point) - S.v₀) ⬝ᵥ (x - S.v₀) = 0) :
    ∃ μ : Fin 3 → ℚ, μ 0 + μ 1 + μ 2 = 1 ∧
      x = μ 0 • (S.v₀ : Point) + μ 1 • (S.v₁ : Point) + μ 2 • (S.v₂ : Point)
proof:
:= by
  have hn : crossProduct ((S.v₁ : Point) - S.v₀) ((S.v₂ : Point) - S.v₀) ≠ 0 :=
    faceNormal_ne_zero_of_detOrigin S hS
  have hmem : (x - S.v₀) ∈ Submodule.span ℚ {((S.v₁ : Point) - S.v₀), ((S.v₂ : Point) - S.v₀)} :=
    (CSG.Proof.GenPosCheck.mem_span_pair_iff_dot_cross_zero _ _ _ hn).mpr hx
  rw [Submodule.mem_span_pair] at hmem
  obtain ⟨s, t, hst⟩ := hmem
  refine ⟨![1 - s - t, s, t], by simp only [Matrix.cons_val_zero, Matrix.cons_val_one,
    Matrix.head_cons, Matrix.cons_val_two, Matrix.tail_cons]; ring, ?_⟩
  have : x = (x - S.v₀) + S.v₀ := by abel
  rw [this, ← hst]
  simp only [Matrix.cons_val_zero, Matrix.cons_val_one, Matrix.head_cons, Matrix.cons_val_two,
    Matrix.tail_cons]
  match_scalars <;> ring

name: Pval_eq_apex
statement:
theorem Pval_eq_apex (nf u v z x : Point) (av az : ℚ)
    (hx : x - u = av • (v - u) + az • (z - u)) :
    Pval nf u v z x = az * (nf ⬝ᵥ (crossProduct (v - u) (z - u)))^2
proof:
:= by
  unfold Pval
  rw [Proof.WellFormedCheckNSICoplanar.apex_eval_raw nf u v z av az x hx,
    Proof.WellFormedCheckNSICoplanar.cross_dot_eq_dot_cross]
  ring

name: Pval_chart_affine
statement:
theorem Pval_chart_affine (S : Triangle) (nf u v z : Point) (y : Fin 2 → ℚ) :
    Pval nf u v z (chartPhi S y)
      = (![Pval nf u v z (chartPhi S ![1,0]) - Pval nf u v z (chartPhi S ![0,0]),
          Pval nf u v z (chartPhi S ![0,1]) - Pval nf u v z (chartPhi S ![0,0])] : Fin 2 → ℚ) ⬝ᵥ y
        + Pval nf u v z (chartPhi S ![0,0])
proof:
:= by
  simp only [Pval, chartPhi, dotProduct, Fin.sum_univ_two, Fin.sum_univ_three,
    Matrix.cons_val_zero, Matrix.cons_val_one, Matrix.head_cons, Pi.add_apply, Pi.smul_apply,
    Pi.sub_apply, smul_eq_mul]
  ring

name: chartPhi_affine
statement:
theorem chartPhi_affine (S : Triangle) (q : Fin 3 → (Fin 2 → ℚ)) (ν : Fin 3 → ℚ)
    (hsum : ν 0 + ν 1 + ν 2 = 1) :
    chartPhi S (ν 0 • q 0 + ν 1 • q 1 + ν 2 • q 2)
      = ν 0 • chartPhi S (q 0) + ν 1 • chartPhi S (q 1) + ν 2 • chartPhi S (q 2)
proof:
:= by
  simp only [chartPhi, Pi.add_apply, Pi.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul]
  match_scalars <;> linarith [hsum]

name: chartS_mem_triRelint
statement:
theorem chartS_mem_triRelint (S : Triangle) (y : Fin 2 → ℚ)
    (h0 : 0 < 1 - y 0 - y 1) (h1 : 0 < y 0) (h2 : 0 < y 1) :
    chartPhi S y ∈ triRelint S
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨![1 - y 0 - y 1, y 0, y 1], ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · intro j; fin_cases j
    · exact h0
    · exact h1
    · exact h2
  · simp only [Fin.sum_univ_three, Matrix.cons_val_zero, Matrix.cons_val_one, Matrix.head_cons,
      Matrix.cons_val_two, Matrix.tail_cons]; ring
  · simp only [chartPhi, Matrix.cons_val_zero, Matrix.cons_val_one, Matrix.head_cons,
      Matrix.cons_val_two, Matrix.tail_cons]

name: chartPhi_of_bary
statement:
theorem chartPhi_of_bary (S : Triangle) (x : Point) (μ : Fin 3 → ℚ)
    (hsum : μ 0 + μ 1 + μ 2 = 1)
    (hx : x = μ 0 • (S.v₀ : Point) + μ 1 • (S.v₁ : Point) + μ 2 • (S.v₂ : Point)) :
    chartPhi S ![μ 1, μ 2] = x
proof:
:= by
  rw [chartPhi, hx]
  simp only [Matrix.cons_val_zero, Matrix.cons_val_one, Matrix.head_cons]
  rw [show (1:ℚ) - μ 1 - μ 2 = μ 0 from by linarith [hsum]]

name: Pval_at_u
statement: theorem Pval_at_u (nf u v z : Point) : Pval nf u v z u = 0
proof: := by simp [Pval, sub_self]

name: Pval_at_v
statement: theorem Pval_at_v (nf u v z : Point) : Pval nf u v z v = 0
proof:
:= by
  unfold Pval
  rw [show (crossProduct nf (v-u)) ⬝ᵥ (v - u) = 0 by
    rw [dotProduct_comm]; exact dot_cross_self nf (v-u)]
  ring

name: Pval_at_z
statement:
theorem Pval_at_z (nf u v z : Point) :
    Pval nf u v z z = (nf ⬝ᵥ (crossProduct (v - u) (z - u)))^2
proof:
:= by
  unfold Pval
  rw [Proof.WellFormedCheckNSICoplanar.cross_dot_eq_dot_cross]; ring

name: Pval_pos_of_apex
statement:
theorem Pval_pos_of_apex (nf u v z x : Point) (av az : ℚ)
    (hx : x - u = av • (v - u) + az • (z - u)) (haz : 0 < az)
    (hD : nf ⬝ᵥ (crossProduct (v - u) (z - u)) ≠ 0) :
    0 < Pval nf u v z x
proof:
:= by
  rw [Pval_eq_apex nf u v z x av az hx]
  have : 0 < (nf ⬝ᵥ (crossProduct (v - u) (z - u)))^2 := by positivity
  positivity

name: Pval_vertex_nonneg
statement:
theorem Pval_vertex_nonneg (nf u v z w : Point) (hw : w = u ∨ w = v ∨ w = z) :
    0 ≤ Pval nf u v z w
proof:
:= by
  rcases hw with h | h | h <;> subst h
  · rw [Pval_at_u]
  · rw [Pval_at_v]
  · rw [Pval_at_z]; positivity

name: coplanar_meet_core
statement:
theorem coplanar_meet_core (S T : Triangle) (hS : NDeg S) (hT : NDeg T)
    (cpar : ℚ) (hcpar0 : cpar ≠ 0)
    (hpar : crossProduct ((S.v₁ : Point) - S.v₀) ((S.v₂ : Point) - S.v₀)
      = cpar • crossProduct ((T.v₁ : Point) - T.v₀) ((T.v₂ : Point) - T.v₀))
    
    (hcopT0 : crossProduct ((S.v₁ : Point) - S.v₀) ((S.v₂ : Point) - S.v₀) ⬝ᵥ ((T.v₀ : Point) - S.v₀) = 0)
    (hcopT1 : crossProduct ((S.v₁ : Point) - S.v₀) ((S.v₂ : Point) - S.v₀) ⬝ᵥ ((T.v₁ : Point) - S.v₀) = 0)
    (hcopT2 : crossProduct ((S.v₁ : Point) - S.v₀) ((S.v₂ : Point) - S.v₀) ⬝ᵥ ((T.v₂ : Point) - S.v₀) = 0)
    
    (wS0 : ∃ j : Fin 3, 0 < Pval (faceNormalP S) S.v₀ S.v₁ S.v₂ (Tvert T j))
    (wS1 : ∃ j : Fin 3, 0 < Pval (faceNormalP S) S.v₁ S.v₂ S.v₀ (Tvert T j))
    (wS2 : ∃ j : Fin 3, 0 < Pval (faceNormalP S) S.v₂ S.v₀ S.v₁ (Tvert T j))
    (wT0 : ∃ j : Fin 3, 0 < Pval (faceNormalP S) T.v₀ T.v₁ T.v₂ (Svert S j))
    (wT1 : ∃ j : Fin 3, 0 < Pval (faceNormalP S) T.v₁ T.v₂ T.v₀ (Svert S j))
    (wT2 : ∃ j : Fin 3, 0 < Pval (faceNormalP S) T.v₂ T.v₀ T.v₁ (Svert S j)) :
    ∃ p : Point, p ∈ triRelint S ∧ p ∈ triRelint T
proof:
:= by
  classical
  set nS : Point := faceNormalP S with hnSdef
  set nT : Point := crossProduct ((T.v₁ : Point) - T.v₀) ((T.v₂ : Point) - T.v₀) with hnTdef
  have hnSne : nS ≠ 0 := by rw [hnSdef, faceNormalP]; exact faceNormal_ne_zero_of_detOrigin S hS
  have hnTne : nT ≠ 0 := by rw [hnTdef]; exact faceNormal_ne_zero_of_detOrigin T hT
  
  have hDS : 0 < nS ⬝ᵥ nS := by
    have := Proof.GenPosCheck.dotself_pos nS hnSne; exact this
  
  have hnTT : 0 < nT ⬝ᵥ nT := Proof.GenPosCheck.dotself_pos nT hnTne
  have hDT_eq : nS ⬝ᵥ nT = cpar * (nT ⬝ᵥ nT) := by
    rw [hnSdef, faceNormalP, hpar, smul_dotProduct, smul_eq_mul]
  have hDTne : nS ⬝ᵥ nT ≠ 0 := by rw [hDT_eq]; exact mul_ne_zero hcpar0 (ne_of_gt hnTT)
  
  obtain ⟨μ0, hμ0sum, hμ0⟩ := coplanar_point_bary S hS T.v₀ (by rw [← faceNormalP]; exact hcopT0)
  obtain ⟨μ1, hμ1sum, hμ1⟩ := coplanar_point_bary S hS T.v₁ (by rw [← faceNormalP]; exact hcopT1)
  obtain ⟨μ2, hμ2sum, hμ2⟩ := coplanar_point_bary S hS T.v₂ (by rw [← faceNormalP]; exact hcopT2)
  set q : Fin 3 → (Fin 2 → ℚ) := ![![μ0 1, μ0 2], ![μ1 1, μ1 2], ![μ2 1, μ2 2]] with hq
  have hqphi0 : chartPhi S (q 0) = (T.v₀ : Point) := by
    rw [hq]; simp only [Matrix.cons_val_zero]; exact chartPhi_of_bary S _ μ0 hμ0sum hμ0
  have hqphi1 : chartPhi S (q 1) = (T.v₁ : Point) := by
    rw [hq]; simp only [Matrix.cons_val_one, Matrix.head_cons]
    exact chartPhi_of_bary S _ μ1 hμ1sum hμ1
  have hqphi2 : chartPhi S (q 2) = (T.v₂ : Point) := by
    rw [hq]; simp only [Matrix.cons_val_two, Matrix.tail_cons, Matrix.head_cons]
    exact chartPhi_of_bary S _ μ2 hμ2sum hμ2
  
  set eU : Fin 6 → Point := ![S.v₀, S.v₁, S.v₂, T.v₀, T.v₁, T.v₂] with heU
  set eV : Fin 6 → Point := ![S.v₁, S.v₂, S.v₀, T.v₁, T.v₂, T.v₀] with heV
  set eZ : Fin 6 → Point := ![S.v₂, S.v₀, S.v₁, T.v₂, T.v₀, T.v₁] with heZ
  set g : Fin 6 → (Fin 2 → ℚ) → ℚ :=
    fun i y => Pval nS (eU i) (eV i) (eZ i) (chartPhi S y) with hg
  set A : Fin 6 → (Fin 2 → ℚ) := fun i =>
    ![Pval nS (eU i) (eV i) (eZ i) (chartPhi S ![1,0]) - Pval nS (eU i) (eV i) (eZ i) (chartPhi S ![0,0]),
      Pval nS (eU i) (eV i) (eZ i) (chartPhi S ![0,1]) - Pval nS (eU i) (eV i) (eZ i) (chartPhi S ![0,0])]
    with hA
  set B : Fin 6 → ℚ := fun i => Pval nS (eU i) (eV i) (eZ i) (chartPhi S ![0,0]) with hB
  have gconn : ∀ i y, (A i) ⬝ᵥ y + B i = g i y := by
    intro i y; rw [hg, hA, hB]; exact (Pval_chart_affine S nS (eU i) (eV i) (eZ i) y).symm
  
  have hc00 : chartPhi S ![0,0] = (S.v₀ : Point) := by simp [chartPhi]
  have hc10 : chartPhi S ![(1:ℚ),0] = (S.v₁ : Point) := by simp [chartPhi]
  have hc01 : chartPhi S ![(0:ℚ),1] = (S.v₂ : Point) := by simp [chartPhi]
  
  have hcycS := Proof.WellFormedCheckNSICoplanar.cyclic_normal (S.v₀ : Point) S.v₁ S.v₂
  have hcycT := Proof.WellFormedCheckNSICoplanar.cyclic_normal (T.v₀ : Point) T.v₁ T.v₂
  
  have hDS2 : 0 < (nS ⬝ᵥ nS)^2 := by positivity
  have hDT2 : 0 < (nS ⬝ᵥ nT)^2 := by positivity
  
  set bS : Fin 2 → ℚ := ![1/3, 1/3] with hbS_def
  set bT : Fin 2 → ℚ := (1/3 : ℚ) • q 0 + (1/3 : ℚ) • q 1 + (1/3 : ℚ) • q 2 with hbT_def
  set cS : Fin 3 → (Fin 2 → ℚ) := ![![0,0], ![1,0], ![0,1]] with hcS_def
  
  have hcSimg : ∀ a : Fin 3, chartPhi S (cS a) = Svert S a := by
    intro a; fin_cases a <;> simp [hcS_def, Svert, hc00, hc10, hc01, chartPhi]
  have hcTimg : ∀ a : Fin 3, chartPhi S (q a) = Tvert T a := by
    intro a; fin_cases a
    · show chartPhi S (q 0) = Tvert T 0; rw [hqphi0]; rfl
    · show chartPhi S (q 1) = Tvert T 1; rw [hqphi1]; rfl
    · show chartPhi S (q 2) = Tvert T 2; rw [hqphi2]; rfl
  
  have hDne : nS ⬝ᵥ nS ≠ 0 := ne_of_gt hDS
  have hDS0 : nS ⬝ᵥ (crossProduct ((S.v₁:Point) - S.v₀) ((S.v₂:Point) - S.v₀)) ≠ 0 := by
    rw [hcycS.1]; exact hDne
  have hDS1 : nS ⬝ᵥ (crossProduct ((S.v₂:Point) - S.v₁) ((S.v₀:Point) - S.v₁)) ≠ 0 := by
    rw [hcycS.2.1]; exact hDne
  have hDS2' : nS ⬝ᵥ (crossProduct ((S.v₀:Point) - S.v₂) ((S.v₁:Point) - S.v₂)) ≠ 0 := by
    rw [hcycS.2.2]; exact hDne
  have hDT0 : nS ⬝ᵥ (crossProduct ((T.v₁:Point) - T.v₀) ((T.v₂:Point) - T.v₀)) ≠ 0 := by
    rw [hcycT.1, ← hnTdef]; exact hDTne
  have hDT1 : nS ⬝ᵥ (crossProduct ((T.v₂:Point) - T.v₁) ((T.v₀:Point) - T.v₁)) ≠ 0 := by
    rw [hcycT.2.1, ← hnTdef]; exact hDTne
  have hDT2' : nS ⬝ᵥ (crossProduct ((T.v₀:Point) - T.v₂) ((T.v₁:Point) - T.v₂)) ≠ 0 := by
    rw [hcycT.2.2, ← hnTdef]; exact hDTne
  
  have hbSexp : chartPhi S bS - (S.v₀ : Point) = ((1:ℚ)/3) • ((S.v₁:Point) - S.v₀) + ((1:ℚ)/3) • ((S.v₂:Point) - S.v₀) := by
    rw [hbS_def, chartPhi]; match_scalars <;> norm_num
  have hbSexp1 : chartPhi S bS - (S.v₁ : Point) = ((1:ℚ)/3) • ((S.v₂:Point) - S.v₁) + ((1:ℚ)/3) • ((S.v₀:Point) - S.v₁) := by
    rw [hbS_def, chartPhi]; match_scalars <;> norm_num
  have hbSexp2 : chartPhi S bS - (S.v₂ : Point) = ((1:ℚ)/3) • ((S.v₀:Point) - S.v₂) + ((1:ℚ)/3) • ((S.v₁:Point) - S.v₂) := by
    rw [hbS_def, chartPhi]; match_scalars <;> norm_num
  
  have hbSpos : ∀ i : Fin 6, i.val < 3 → 0 < g i bS := by
    intro i hi
    fin_cases i
    · exact Pval_pos_of_apex nS S.v₀ S.v₁ S.v₂ (chartPhi S bS) _ _ hbSexp (by norm_num) hDS0
    · exact Pval_pos_of_apex nS S.v₁ S.v₂ S.v₀ (chartPhi S bS) _ _ hbSexp1 (by norm_num) hDS1
    · exact Pval_pos_of_apex nS S.v₂ S.v₀ S.v₁ (chartPhi S bS) _ _ hbSexp2 (by norm_num) hDS2'
    · exact absurd hi (by norm_num)
    · exact absurd hi (by norm_num)
    · exact absurd hi (by norm_num)
  
  have hbTimg : chartPhi S bT = ((1:ℚ)/3) • (T.v₀ : Point) + ((1:ℚ)/3) • (T.v₁:Point) + ((1:ℚ)/3) • (T.v₂:Point) := by
    have h3 := chartPhi_affine S q ![(1:ℚ)/3, 1/3, 1/3] (by norm_num)
    simp only [Matrix.cons_val_zero, Matrix.cons_val_one, Matrix.head_cons, Matrix.cons_val_two,
      Matrix.tail_cons] at h3
    rw [hbT_def, h3, hqphi0, hqphi1, hqphi2]
  have hbTexp : chartPhi S bT - (T.v₀ : Point) = ((1:ℚ)/3) • ((T.v₁:Point) - T.v₀) + ((1:ℚ)/3) • ((T.v₂:Point) - T.v₀) := by
    rw [hbTimg]; match_scalars <;> norm_num
  have hbTexp1 : chartPhi S bT - (T.v₁ : Point) = ((1:ℚ)/3) • ((T.v₂:Point) - T.v₁) + ((1:ℚ)/3) • ((T.v₀:Point) - T.v₁) := by
    rw [hbTimg]; match_scalars <;> norm_num
  have hbTexp2 : chartPhi S bT - (T.v₂ : Point) = ((1:ℚ)/3) • ((T.v₀:Point) - T.v₂) + ((1:ℚ)/3) • ((T.v₁:Point) - T.v₂) := by
    rw [hbTimg]; match_scalars <;> norm_num
  
  have hbTpos : ∀ i : Fin 6, 3 ≤ i.val → 0 < g i bT := by
    intro i hi
    fin_cases i
    · exact absurd hi (by norm_num)
    · exact absurd hi (by norm_num)
    · exact absurd hi (by norm_num)
    · exact Pval_pos_of_apex nS T.v₀ T.v₁ T.v₂ (chartPhi S bT) _ _ hbTexp (by norm_num) hDT0
    · exact Pval_pos_of_apex nS T.v₁ T.v₂ T.v₀ (chartPhi S bT) _ _ hbTexp1 (by norm_num) hDT1
    · exact Pval_pos_of_apex nS T.v₂ T.v₀ T.v₁ (chartPhi S bT) _ _ hbTexp2 (by norm_num) hDT2'
  
  have hmemS : ∀ a : Fin 3, ∀ i : Fin 6, i.val < 3 →
      Svert S a = eU i ∨ Svert S a = eV i ∨ Svert S a = eZ i := by
    rw [heU, heV, heZ]
    clear * -
    intro a i hi
    fin_cases a <;> fin_cases i <;>
      simp_all only [Fin.isValue] <;>
      first
        | (exact Or.inl rfl) | (exact Or.inr (Or.inl rfl)) | (exact Or.inr (Or.inr rfl))
        | omega
  have hmemT : ∀ a : Fin 3, ∀ i : Fin 6, 3 ≤ i.val →
      Tvert T a = eU i ∨ Tvert T a = eV i ∨ Tvert T a = eZ i := by
    rw [heU, heV, heZ]
    clear * -
    intro a i hi
    fin_cases a <;> fin_cases i <;>
      simp_all only [Fin.isValue] <;>
      first
        | (exact Or.inl rfl) | (exact Or.inr (Or.inl rfl)) | (exact Or.inr (Or.inr rfl))
        | omega
  
  have hcSnn : ∀ a : Fin 3, ∀ i : Fin 6, i.val < 3 → 0 ≤ g i (cS a) := by
    intro a i hi
    have hg' : g i (cS a) = Pval nS (eU i) (eV i) (eZ i) (Svert S a) := by
      rw [hg]; simp only [hcSimg a]
    rw [hg']; exact Pval_vertex_nonneg nS _ _ _ _ (hmemS a i hi)
  
  have hcTnn : ∀ a : Fin 3, ∀ i : Fin 6, 3 ≤ i.val → 0 ≤ g i (q a) := by
    intro a i hi
    have hg' : g i (q a) = Pval nS (eU i) (eV i) (eZ i) (Tvert T a) := by
      rw [hg]; simp only [hcTimg a]
    rw [hg']; exact Pval_vertex_nonneg nS _ _ _ _ (hmemT a i hi)
  
  have hgcS : ∀ a : Fin 3, ∀ j : Fin 6, g j (cS a) = Pval nS (eU j) (eV j) (eZ j) (Svert S a) := by
    intro a j; rw [hg]; simp only [hcSimg a]
  have hgcT : ∀ a : Fin 3, ∀ j : Fin 6, g j (q a) = Pval nS (eU j) (eV j) (eZ j) (Tvert T a) := by
    intro a j; rw [hg]; simp only [hcTimg a]
  
  have hwitT : ∀ j : Fin 6, 3 ≤ j.val → ∃ a : Fin 3, 0 < g j (cS a) := by
    intro j hj
    fin_cases j
    · exact absurd hj (by norm_num)
    · exact absurd hj (by norm_num)
    · exact absurd hj (by norm_num)
    · obtain ⟨a, ha⟩ := wT0; exact ⟨a, by rw [hgcS]; exact ha⟩
    · obtain ⟨a, ha⟩ := wT1; exact ⟨a, by rw [hgcS]; exact ha⟩
    · obtain ⟨a, ha⟩ := wT2; exact ⟨a, by rw [hgcS]; exact ha⟩
  
  have hwitS : ∀ i : Fin 6, i.val < 3 → ∃ a : Fin 3, 0 < g i (q a) := by
    intro i hi
    fin_cases i
    · obtain ⟨a, ha⟩ := wS0; exact ⟨a, by rw [hgcT]; exact ha⟩
    · obtain ⟨a, ha⟩ := wS1; exact ⟨a, by rw [hgcT]; exact ha⟩
    · obtain ⟨a, ha⟩ := wS2; exact ⟨a, by rw [hgcT]; exact ha⟩
    · exact absurd hi (by norm_num)
    · exact absurd hi (by norm_num)
    · exact absurd hi (by norm_num)
  
  obtain ⟨ystar, hystar⟩ := Proof.WellFormedCheckNSICoplanar.helly2_six A B bS bT cS q
    (by intro i hi; rw [gconn]; exact hbSpos i hi)
    (by intro i hi; rw [gconn]; exact hbTpos i hi)
    (by intro a i hi; rw [gconn]; exact hcSnn a i hi)
    (by intro a i hi; rw [gconn]; exact hcTnn a i hi)
    (by intro j hj; obtain ⟨a, ha⟩ := hwitT j hj; exact ⟨a, by rw [gconn]; exact ha⟩)
    (by intro i hi; obtain ⟨a, ha⟩ := hwitS i hi; exact ⟨a, by rw [gconn]; exact ha⟩)
  
  have hyg : ∀ i, 0 < g i ystar := by intro i; rw [← gconn]; exact hystar i
  
  have hyexp0 : chartPhi S ystar - (S.v₀:Point) = (ystar 0) • ((S.v₁:Point) - S.v₀) + (ystar 1) • ((S.v₂:Point) - S.v₀) := by
    rw [chartPhi]; match_scalars <;> ring
  have hyexp1 : chartPhi S ystar - (S.v₁:Point) = (ystar 1) • ((S.v₂:Point) - S.v₁) + (1 - ystar 0 - ystar 1) • ((S.v₀:Point) - S.v₁) := by
    rw [chartPhi]; match_scalars <;> ring
  have hyexp2 : chartPhi S ystar - (S.v₂:Point) = (1 - ystar 0 - ystar 1) • ((S.v₀:Point) - S.v₂) + (ystar 0) • ((S.v₁:Point) - S.v₂) := by
    rw [chartPhi]; match_scalars <;> ring
  
  have hy1pos : 0 < ystar 1 := by
    have := hyg 0
    rw [show g 0 ystar = Pval nS S.v₀ S.v₁ S.v₂ (chartPhi S ystar) from rfl,
      Pval_eq_apex nS S.v₀ S.v₁ S.v₂ (chartPhi S ystar) _ _ hyexp0, hcycS.1] at this
    exact (mul_pos_iff_of_pos_right hDS2).mp this
  have hy0pos : 0 < ystar 0 := by
    have := hyg 2
    rw [show g 2 ystar = Pval nS S.v₂ S.v₀ S.v₁ (chartPhi S ystar) from rfl,
      Pval_eq_apex nS S.v₂ S.v₀ S.v₁ (chartPhi S ystar) _ _ hyexp2, hcycS.2.2] at this
    exact (mul_pos_iff_of_pos_right hDS2).mp this
  have hysum : 0 < 1 - ystar 0 - ystar 1 := by
    have := hyg 1
    rw [show g 1 ystar = Pval nS S.v₁ S.v₂ S.v₀ (chartPhi S ystar) from rfl,
      Pval_eq_apex nS S.v₁ S.v₂ S.v₀ (chartPhi S ystar) _ _ hyexp1, hcycS.2.1] at this
    exact (mul_pos_iff_of_pos_right hDS2).mp this
  
  refine ⟨chartPhi S ystar, chartS_mem_triRelint S ystar hysum hy0pos hy1pos, ?_⟩
  
  
  have hperpS : nS ⬝ᵥ (chartPhi S ystar - (S.v₀:Point)) = 0 := by
    rw [chartPhi]
    have : (((1 - ystar 0 - ystar 1) • (S.v₀:Point) + ystar 0 • (S.v₁:Point) + ystar 1 • (S.v₂:Point)) - S.v₀)
        = ystar 0 • ((S.v₁:Point) - S.v₀) + ystar 1 • ((S.v₂:Point) - S.v₀) := by
      match_scalars <;> ring
    rw [this, dotProduct_add, dotProduct_smul, dotProduct_smul, smul_eq_mul, smul_eq_mul,
      hnSdef, faceNormalP]
    rw [show (crossProduct ((S.v₁:Point) - S.v₀) ((S.v₂:Point) - S.v₀)) ⬝ᵥ ((S.v₁:Point) - S.v₀) = 0 from by
        rw [dotProduct_comm]; exact dot_self_cross _ _,
      show (crossProduct ((S.v₁:Point) - S.v₀) ((S.v₂:Point) - S.v₀)) ⬝ᵥ ((S.v₂:Point) - S.v₀) = 0 from by
        rw [dotProduct_comm]; exact dot_cross_self _ _]
    ring
  have hcopT0' : nS ⬝ᵥ ((T.v₀:Point) - S.v₀) = 0 := by rw [hnSdef, faceNormalP]; exact hcopT0
  have hcopY : crossProduct ((T.v₁:Point) - T.v₀) ((T.v₂:Point) - T.v₀) ⬝ᵥ (chartPhi S ystar - (T.v₀:Point)) = 0 := by
    
    have hnTS : nT = cpar⁻¹ • nS := by
      rw [hnSdef, faceNormalP, hpar, smul_smul, inv_mul_cancel₀ hcpar0, one_smul]
    have hsplit : chartPhi S ystar - (T.v₀:Point) = (chartPhi S ystar - (S.v₀:Point)) - ((T.v₀:Point) - S.v₀) := by abel
    rw [← hnTdef, hnTS, hsplit, dotProduct_sub, smul_dotProduct, smul_dotProduct, hperpS, hcopT0']
    simp
  obtain ⟨ν, hνsum, hνeq⟩ := coplanar_point_bary T hT (chartPhi S ystar)
    (by rw [hcopY])
  
  refine ⟨ν, ?_, by rw [Fin.sum_univ_three]; exact hνsum, hνeq⟩
  
  have hYexpT0 : chartPhi S ystar - (T.v₀:Point) = (ν 1) • ((T.v₁:Point) - T.v₀) + (ν 2) • ((T.v₂:Point) - T.v₀) := by
    rw [hνeq]; match_scalars <;> linarith [hνsum]
  have hYexpT1 : chartPhi S ystar - (T.v₁:Point) = (ν 2) • ((T.v₂:Point) - T.v₁) + (ν 0) • ((T.v₀:Point) - T.v₁) := by
    rw [hνeq]; match_scalars <;> linarith [hνsum]
  have hYexpT2 : chartPhi S ystar - (T.v₂:Point) = (ν 0) • ((T.v₀:Point) - T.v₂) + (ν 1) • ((T.v₁:Point) - T.v₂) := by
    rw [hνeq]; match_scalars <;> linarith [hνsum]
  intro j
  fin_cases j
  · 
    have := hyg 4
    rw [show g 4 ystar = Pval nS T.v₁ T.v₂ T.v₀ (chartPhi S ystar) from rfl,
      Pval_eq_apex nS T.v₁ T.v₂ T.v₀ (chartPhi S ystar) _ _ hYexpT1, hcycT.2.1, ← hnTdef] at this
    exact (mul_pos_iff_of_pos_right hDT2).mp this
  · 
    have := hyg 5
    rw [show g 5 ystar = Pval nS T.v₂ T.v₀ T.v₁ (chartPhi S ystar) from rfl,
      Pval_eq_apex nS T.v₂ T.v₀ T.v₁ (chartPhi S ystar) _ _ hYexpT2, hcycT.2.2, ← hnTdef] at this
    exact (mul_pos_iff_of_pos_right hDT2).mp this
  · 
    have := hyg 3
    rw [show g 3 ystar = Pval nS T.v₀ T.v₁ T.v₂ (chartPhi S ystar) from rfl,
      Pval_eq_apex nS T.v₀ T.v₁ T.v₂ (chartPhi S ystar) _ _ hYexpT0, hcycT.1, ← hnTdef] at this
    exact (mul_pos_iff_of_pos_right hDT2).mp this

name: edge_false_witness
statement:
theorem edge_false_witness (nf u v z : Point) (Λ : ℚ) (hΛ : 0 < Λ)
    (nsI uI vI zI w0I w1I w2I : I3) (other : Triangle)
    (hns : decI nsI = (Λ ^ 2) • nf) (hu : decI uI = Λ • u) (hv : decI vI = Λ • v)
    (hz : decI zI = Λ • z)
    (hw0 : decI w0I = Λ • (other.v₀ : Point)) (hw1 : decI w1I = Λ • (other.v₁ : Point))
    (hw2 : decI w2I = Λ • (other.v₂ : Point))
    (hcne : Pval nf u v z z ≠ 0)
    (hfalse : (dotI (crossI nsI (subI vI uI)) (subI zI uI) != 0 &&
      (Array.range 3).all (fun i =>
        decide (dotI (crossI nsI (subI vI uI)) (subI zI uI)
          * dotI (crossI nsI (subI vI uI)) (subI (#[w0I, w1I, w2I].getD i default) uI) ≤ 0))) = false) :
    ∃ j : Fin 3, 0 < Pval nf u v z (Tvert other j)
proof:
:= by
  
  have hcI : dotI (crossI nsI (subI vI uI)) (subI zI uI) ≠ 0 := by
    intro h0
    apply hcne
    have hPv : ((dotI (crossI nsI (subI vI uI)) (subI zI uI) : ℤ) : ℚ)
        = Λ ^ 4 * (crossProduct nf (v - u) ⬝ᵥ (z - u)) :=
      coplanar_edgeval_decode nsI uI vI zI Λ nf u v z hns hu hv hz
    rw [h0] at hPv; push_cast at hPv
    have hΛ4 : (Λ^4 : ℚ) ≠ 0 := by positivity
    have hc0 : (crossProduct nf (v - u) ⬝ᵥ (z - u)) = 0 := by
      rcases mul_eq_zero.mp hPv.symm with h | h
      · exact absurd h hΛ4
      · exact h
    rw [Pval, hc0]; ring
  
  rw [Bool.and_eq_false_iff] at hfalse
  rcases hfalse with h | h
  · exact absurd (by simpa using h) hcI
  · rw [range3_all_false_iff] at h
    
    have decprod : ∀ (wI : I3) (w : Point), decI wI = Λ • w →
        (((dotI (crossI nsI (subI vI uI)) (subI zI uI)
          * dotI (crossI nsI (subI vI uI)) (subI wI uI) : ℤ)) : ℚ)
          = Λ ^ 8 * (Pval nf u v z w) := by
      intro wI w hw
      have hz' := coplanar_edgeval_decode nsI uI vI zI Λ nf u v z hns hu hv hz
      have hw' := coplanar_edgeval_decode nsI uI vI wI Λ nf u v w hns hu hv hw
      push_cast; rw [hz', hw', Pval]; ring
    have hΛ8 : (0:ℚ) < Λ^8 := by positivity
    
    have extract : ∀ (wI : I3) (w : Point), decI wI = Λ • w →
        decide (dotI (crossI nsI (subI vI uI)) (subI zI uI)
          * dotI (crossI nsI (subI vI uI)) (subI wI uI) ≤ 0) = false → 0 < Pval nf u v z w := by
      intro wI w hw hdec
      rw [decide_eq_false_iff_not, not_le] at hdec
      have hq : (0:ℚ) < ((dotI (crossI nsI (subI vI uI)) (subI zI uI)
          * dotI (crossI nsI (subI vI uI)) (subI wI uI) : ℤ) : ℚ) := by exact_mod_cast hdec
      rw [decprod wI w hw] at hq; exact (mul_pos_iff_of_pos_left hΛ8).mp hq
    rcases h with h | h | h
    · exact ⟨0, extract w0I other.v₀ hw0 (by simpa using h)⟩
    · exact ⟨1, extract w1I other.v₁ hw1 (by simpa using h)⟩
    · exact ⟨2, extract w2I other.v₂ hw2 (by simpa using h)⟩

name: coplanarSeparated_false_relint_meet
statement:
theorem coplanarSeparated_false_relint_meet (S T : Triangle)
    (hS : NDeg S) (hT : NDeg T)
    (hcop : allZero (sideSigns (Impl.WellFormedCheck.faceNormal (rescale (faceHOf T).w (faceHOf S)))
      (rescale (faceHOf T).w (faceHOf S)).v₀ (vertsOf (rescale (faceHOf S).w (faceHOf T)))) = true)
    (hsep : coplanarSeparated (Impl.WellFormedCheck.faceNormal (rescale (faceHOf T).w (faceHOf S)))
        (vertsOf (rescale (faceHOf T).w (faceHOf S)))
        (vertsOf (rescale (faceHOf S).w (faceHOf T))) = false) :
    ∃ p : Point, p ∈ triRelint S ∧ p ∈ triRelint T
proof:
:= by
  classical
  set sfS := rescale (faceHOf T).w (faceHOf S) with hsfS
  set sfT := rescale (faceHOf S).w (faceHOf T) with hsfT
