  set Λ : ℚ := (((faceHOf T).w * (faceHOf S).w : ℤ) : ℚ) with hΛdef
  have hΛpos : (0 : ℚ) < Λ := by rw [hΛdef]; exact_mod_cast sharedScale_pos S T
  set nS : Point := crossProduct ((S.v₁ : Point) - S.v₀) ((S.v₂ : Point) - S.v₀) with hnSdef
  set nT : Point := crossProduct ((T.v₁ : Point) - T.v₀) ((T.v₂ : Point) - T.v₀) with hnTdef
  have hnSne : nS ≠ 0 := faceNormal_ne_zero_of_detOrigin S hS
  have hnTne : nT ≠ 0 := faceNormal_ne_zero_of_detOrigin T hT
  
  obtain ⟨z0, z1, z2⟩ := allZero_sigma_decode S T hcop
  obtain ⟨cpar, hcpar0, hcparS⟩ := coplanar_normal_parallel S T hS hT z0 z1 z2
  
  have hnsS : decI (Impl.WellFormedCheck.faceNormal sfS) = (Λ ^ 2) • nS := by rw [hsfS, decI_faceNormal_S]
  have hSv0 : decI sfS.v₀ = Λ • (S.v₀ : Point) := by rw [hsfS, decI_rescaleS_v₀]
  have hSv1 : decI sfS.v₁ = Λ • (S.v₁ : Point) := by rw [hsfS, decI_rescaleS_v₁]
  have hSv2 : decI sfS.v₂ = Λ • (S.v₂ : Point) := by rw [hsfS, decI_rescaleS_v₂]
  have hTv0 : decI sfT.v₀ = Λ • (T.v₀ : Point) := by rw [hsfT, decI_rescaleT_v₀, hΛdef, mul_comm]
  have hTv1 : decI sfT.v₁ = Λ • (T.v₁ : Point) := by rw [hsfT, decI_rescaleT_v₁, hΛdef, mul_comm]
  have hTv2 : decI sfT.v₂ = Λ • (T.v₂ : Point) := by rw [hsfT, decI_rescaleT_v₂, hΛdef, mul_comm]
  
  have hDS : 0 < nS ⬝ᵥ nS := Proof.GenPosCheck.dotself_pos nS hnSne
  have hDTeq : nS ⬝ᵥ nT = cpar * (nT ⬝ᵥ nT) := by
    rw [hnSdef, hcparS, ← hnTdef, smul_dotProduct, smul_eq_mul]
  have hDTne : nS ⬝ᵥ nT ≠ 0 := by
    rw [hDTeq]; exact mul_ne_zero hcpar0 (ne_of_gt (Proof.GenPosCheck.dotself_pos nT hnTne))
  have hcyc := Proof.WellFormedCheckNSICoplanar.cyclic_normal (S.v₀ : Point) S.v₁ S.v₂
  have hcycT := Proof.WellFormedCheckNSICoplanar.cyclic_normal (T.v₀ : Point) T.v₁ T.v₂
  
  have pvS0 : Pval nS S.v₀ S.v₁ S.v₂ S.v₂ ≠ 0 := by
    rw [Pval_at_z, hcyc.1, ← hnSdef]; positivity
  have pvS1 : Pval nS S.v₁ S.v₂ S.v₀ S.v₀ ≠ 0 := by
    rw [Pval_at_z, hcyc.2.1, ← hnSdef]; positivity
  have pvS2 : Pval nS S.v₂ S.v₀ S.v₁ S.v₁ ≠ 0 := by
    rw [Pval_at_z, hcyc.2.2, ← hnSdef]; positivity
  have pvT0 : Pval nS T.v₀ T.v₁ T.v₂ T.v₂ ≠ 0 := by
    rw [Pval_at_z, hcycT.1, ← hnTdef]; intro h; exact hDTne (sq_eq_zero_iff.mp h)
  have pvT1 : Pval nS T.v₁ T.v₂ T.v₀ T.v₀ ≠ 0 := by
    rw [Pval_at_z, hcycT.2.1, ← hnTdef]; intro h; exact hDTne (sq_eq_zero_iff.mp h)
  have pvT2 : Pval nS T.v₂ T.v₀ T.v₁ T.v₁ ≠ 0 := by
    rw [Pval_at_z, hcycT.2.2, ← hnTdef]; intro h; exact hDTne (sq_eq_zero_iff.mp h)
  
  have gS0 : (vertsOf sfS).getD 0 default = sfS.v₀ := rfl
  have gS1 : (vertsOf sfS).getD 1 default = sfS.v₁ := rfl
  have gS2 : (vertsOf sfS).getD 2 default = sfS.v₂ := rfl
  have gT0 : (vertsOf sfT).getD 0 default = sfT.v₀ := rfl
  have gT1 : (vertsOf sfT).getD 1 default = sfT.v₁ := rfl
  have gT2 : (vertsOf sfT).getD 2 default = sfT.v₂ := rfl
  rw [coplanarSeparated, Bool.or_eq_false_iff] at hsep
  obtain ⟨hsepS, hsepT⟩ := hsep
  rw [Proof.WellFormedCheckNSICoplanar.range3_any_false_iff] at hsepS hsepT
  simp only [show ((0:Nat)+1)%3 = 1 from rfl, show ((0:Nat)+2)%3 = 2 from rfl,
    show ((1:Nat)+1)%3 = 2 from rfl, show ((1:Nat)+2)%3 = 0 from rfl,
    show ((2:Nat)+1)%3 = 0 from rfl, show ((2:Nat)+2)%3 = 1 from rfl,
    gS0, gS1, gS2, gT0, gT1, gT2] at hsepS hsepT
  obtain ⟨hfS0, hfS1, hfS2⟩ := hsepS
  obtain ⟨hfT0, hfT1, hfT2⟩ := hsepT
  
  have wS0 := edge_false_witness nS S.v₀ S.v₁ S.v₂ Λ hΛpos (Impl.WellFormedCheck.faceNormal sfS) sfS.v₀ sfS.v₁ sfS.v₂
    sfT.v₀ sfT.v₁ sfT.v₂ T hnsS hSv0 hSv1 hSv2 hTv0 hTv1 hTv2 pvS0 hfS0
  have wS1 := edge_false_witness nS S.v₁ S.v₂ S.v₀ Λ hΛpos (Impl.WellFormedCheck.faceNormal sfS) sfS.v₁ sfS.v₂ sfS.v₀
    sfT.v₀ sfT.v₁ sfT.v₂ T hnsS hSv1 hSv2 hSv0 hTv0 hTv1 hTv2 pvS1 hfS1
  have wS2 := edge_false_witness nS S.v₂ S.v₀ S.v₁ Λ hΛpos (Impl.WellFormedCheck.faceNormal sfS) sfS.v₂ sfS.v₀ sfS.v₁
    sfT.v₀ sfT.v₁ sfT.v₂ T hnsS hSv2 hSv0 hSv1 hTv0 hTv1 hTv2 pvS2 hfS2
  have wT0 := edge_false_witness nS T.v₀ T.v₁ T.v₂ Λ hΛpos (Impl.WellFormedCheck.faceNormal sfS) sfT.v₀ sfT.v₁ sfT.v₂
    sfS.v₀ sfS.v₁ sfS.v₂ S hnsS hTv0 hTv1 hTv2 hSv0 hSv1 hSv2 pvT0 hfT0
  have wT1 := edge_false_witness nS T.v₁ T.v₂ T.v₀ Λ hΛpos (Impl.WellFormedCheck.faceNormal sfS) sfT.v₁ sfT.v₂ sfT.v₀
    sfS.v₀ sfS.v₁ sfS.v₂ S hnsS hTv1 hTv2 hTv0 hSv0 hSv1 hSv2 pvT1 hfT1
  have wT2 := edge_false_witness nS T.v₂ T.v₀ T.v₁ Λ hΛpos (Impl.WellFormedCheck.faceNormal sfS) sfT.v₂ sfT.v₀ sfT.v₁
    sfS.v₀ sfS.v₁ sfS.v₂ S hnsS hTv2 hTv0 hTv1 hSv0 hSv1 hSv2 pvT2 hfT2
  
  refine coplanar_meet_core S T hS hT cpar hcpar0 ?_ z0 z1 z2 ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_
  · exact hcparS
  · simpa [faceNormalP, hnSdef] using wS0
  · simpa [faceNormalP, hnSdef] using wS1
  · simpa [faceNormalP, hnSdef] using wS2
  · simpa [faceNormalP, hnSdef] using wT0
  · simpa [faceNormalP, hnSdef] using wT1
  · simpa [faceNormalP, hnSdef] using wT2

name: case2_coplanar_iff
statement:
theorem case2_coplanar_iff (S T : Triangle) (hS : NDeg S) (hT : NDeg T)
    (hcop : allZero (sideSigns (Impl.WellFormedCheck.faceNormal (rescale (faceHOf T).w (faceHOf S)))
      (rescale (faceHOf T).w (faceHOf S)).v₀ (vertsOf (rescale (faceHOf S).w (faceHOf T)))) = true) :
    coplanarSeparated (Impl.WellFormedCheck.faceNormal (rescale (faceHOf T).w (faceHOf S)))
        (vertsOf (rescale (faceHOf T).w (faceHOf S)))
        (vertsOf (rescale (faceHOf S).w (faceHOf T))) = true ↔
      (triangleSet S ∩ triangleSet T ⊆ edgeSet S) ∧
        (triangleSet S ∩ triangleSet T ⊆ edgeSet T)
proof:
:= by
  
  rw [instance_iff_relint_empty S T hS,
      show (triangleSet S ∩ triangleSet T ⊆ edgeSet T)
        = (triangleSet T ∩ triangleSet S ⊆ edgeSet T) from by rw [Set.inter_comm],
      instance_iff_relint_empty T S hT]
  constructor
  · 
    intro hsep
    exact coplanarSeparated_imp_disjoint S T hS hT hcop hsep
  · 
    
    rintro ⟨hSemp, hTemp⟩
    by_contra hne
    
    rw [Bool.not_eq_true] at hne
    obtain ⟨p, hpS, hpT⟩ := coplanarSeparated_false_relint_meet S T hS hT hcop hne
    
    have : p ∈ triRelint S ∩ triangleSet T :=
      ⟨hpS, triRelint_subset_triangleSet T hpT⟩
    rw [hSemp] at this; exact this

name: case3_noncoplanar_iff
statement:
theorem case3_noncoplanar_iff (S T : Triangle) (hS : NDeg S) (hT : NDeg T)
    (hns1 : allStrictOneSide (sideSigns (Impl.WellFormedCheck.faceNormal (rescale (faceHOf T).w (faceHOf S)))
      (rescale (faceHOf T).w (faceHOf S)).v₀ (vertsOf (rescale (faceHOf S).w (faceHOf T)))) = false)
    (_hns2 : allStrictOneSide (sideSigns (Impl.WellFormedCheck.faceNormal (rescale (faceHOf S).w (faceHOf T)))
      (rescale (faceHOf S).w (faceHOf T)).v₀ (vertsOf (rescale (faceHOf T).w (faceHOf S)))) = false)
    (hncop : allZero (sideSigns (Impl.WellFormedCheck.faceNormal (rescale (faceHOf T).w (faceHOf S)))
      (rescale (faceHOf T).w (faceHOf S)).v₀ (vertsOf (rescale (faceHOf S).w (faceHOf T)))) = false) :
    (let ns := Impl.WellFormedCheck.faceNormal (rescale (faceHOf T).w (faceHOf S))
     let nt := Impl.WellFormedCheck.faceNormal (rescale (faceHOf S).w (faceHOf T))
     let sv := vertsOf (rescale (faceHOf T).w (faceHOf S))
     let tv := vertsOf (rescale (faceHOf S).w (faceHOf T))
     let σ := sideSigns ns (rescale (faceHOf T).w (faceHOf S)).v₀ tv
     let τ := sideSigns nt (rescale (faceHOf S).w (faceHOf T)).v₀ sv
     let d := crossI ns nt
     if isZeroI d then true
     else
       let axis := dominantAxis d
       let Is := fracInterval (collectParams axis sv τ nt (rescale (faceHOf S).w (faceHOf T)).v₀)
       let It := fracInterval (collectParams axis tv σ ns (rescale (faceHOf T).w (faceHOf S)).v₀)
       instanceOK3 τ Is It && instanceOK3 σ It Is) = true ↔
      (triangleSet S ∩ triangleSet T ⊆ edgeSet S) ∧
        (triangleSet S ∩ triangleSet T ⊆ edgeSet T)
proof:
:= by
  
  simp only [case3_lineDir_ne_zero S T hT hns1 hncop, Bool.false_eq_true, if_false]
  
  set d := crossI (Impl.WellFormedCheck.faceNormal (rescale (faceHOf T).w (faceHOf S)))
    (Impl.WellFormedCheck.faceNormal (rescale (faceHOf S).w (faceHOf T))) with hd
  have hdne : isZeroI d = false := case3_lineDir_ne_zero S T hT hns1 hncop
  set m : Fin 3 := ⟨dominantAxis d, Proof.WellFormedCheckNSILine.dominantAxis_lt_three d⟩ with hm
  
  have hcross : crossProduct (crossProduct ((S.v₁ : Point) - S.v₀) ((S.v₂ : Point) - S.v₀))
      (crossProduct ((T.v₁ : Point) - T.v₀) ((T.v₂ : Point) - T.v₀)) ≠ 0 :=
    noncoplanar_line_dir T (crossProduct ((S.v₁ : Point) - S.v₀) ((S.v₂ : Point) - S.v₀)) S.v₀
      (faceNormal_ne_zero_of_detOrigin T hT) (sigma_mixed_nonconstant S T hns1 hncop)
  have hcoordS : (crossProduct (crossProduct ((S.v₁ : Point) - S.v₀) ((S.v₂ : Point) - S.v₀))
      (crossProduct ((T.v₁ : Point) - T.v₀) ((T.v₂ : Point) - T.v₀))) m ≠ 0 := by
    have hdec := Proof.WellFormedCheckNSILine.decI_dominantCoord_ne_zero d hdne
      (Proof.WellFormedCheckNSILine.dominantAxis_lt_three d)
    rw [decI_lineDir] at hdec
    simp only [Pi.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul] at hdec
    intro h
    apply hdec
    rw [show (⟨dominantAxis d, Proof.WellFormedCheckNSILine.dominantAxis_lt_three d⟩ : Fin 3) = m from rfl,
      h, mul_zero]
  
  have hcrossT : crossProduct (crossProduct ((T.v₁ : Point) - T.v₀) ((T.v₂ : Point) - T.v₀))
      (crossProduct ((S.v₁ : Point) - S.v₀) ((S.v₂ : Point) - S.v₀)) ≠ 0 := by
    rw [← neg_cross]; exact neg_ne_zero.mpr hcross
  have hcoordT : (crossProduct (crossProduct ((T.v₁ : Point) - T.v₀) ((T.v₂ : Point) - T.v₀))
      (crossProduct ((S.v₁ : Point) - S.v₀) ((S.v₂ : Point) - S.v₀))) m ≠ 0 := by
    rw [← neg_cross]; simp only [Pi.neg_apply, ne_eq, neg_eq_zero]; exact hcoordS
  rw [Bool.and_eq_true]
  rw [instance_one S T hS hT m hcross hcoordS,
      instance_one T S hT hS m hcrossT hcoordT]
  rw [Set.inter_comm (triangleSet T) (triangleSet S)]

name: triPairOK_iff
statement:
theorem triPairOK_iff (S T : Triangle) (hS : NDeg S) (hT : NDeg T) :
    triPairOK (rescale (faceHOf T).w (faceHOf S)) (rescale (faceHOf S).w (faceHOf T)) = true ↔
      (triangleSet S ∩ triangleSet T ⊆ edgeSet S) ∧
        (triangleSet S ∩ triangleSet T ⊆ edgeSet T)
proof:
:= by
  rw [triPairOK]
  simp only [faceNormal_rescaleS_ne_zero S T hS, faceNormal_rescaleT_ne_zero S T hT,
    Bool.or_self, Bool.false_or, Bool.or_false, if_false]
  
  by_cases h1 : (allStrictOneSide (sideSigns (Impl.WellFormedCheck.faceNormal (rescale (faceHOf T).w (faceHOf S)))
      (rescale (faceHOf T).w (faceHOf S)).v₀ (vertsOf (rescale (faceHOf S).w (faceHOf T)))) ||
    allStrictOneSide (sideSigns (Impl.WellFormedCheck.faceNormal (rescale (faceHOf S).w (faceHOf T)))
      (rescale (faceHOf S).w (faceHOf T)).v₀ (vertsOf (rescale (faceHOf T).w (faceHOf S))))) = true
  · rw [if_pos h1]
    rw [Bool.or_eq_true] at h1
    have hdisj : triangleSet S ∩ triangleSet T = ∅ := by
      rcases h1 with h | h
      · exact case1_sigma_disjoint S T hS h
      · exact case1_tau_disjoint S T hT h
    simp only [ite_self, true_iff]; exact disjoint_pair_ok S T hdisj
  · rw [if_neg h1]
    rw [Bool.not_eq_true, Bool.or_eq_false_iff] at h1
    obtain ⟨hns1, hns2⟩ := h1
    
    by_cases h2 : allZero (sideSigns (Impl.WellFormedCheck.faceNormal (rescale (faceHOf T).w (faceHOf S)))
        (rescale (faceHOf T).w (faceHOf S)).v₀ (vertsOf (rescale (faceHOf S).w (faceHOf T)))) = true
    · rw [if_pos h2]; exact case2_coplanar_iff S T hS hT h2
    · rw [if_neg h2]
      rw [Bool.not_eq_true] at h2
      exact case3_noncoplanar_iff S T hS hT hns1 hns2 h2

name: nsiCandidates_mem_bound
statement:
theorem nsiCandidates_mem_bound (A : Array (FaceH × Box3)) (a b : Nat)
    (hmem : (a, b) ∈ nsiCandidates A) : a < b ∧ b < A.size
proof:
:= by
  unfold nsiCandidates at hmem
  rw [show Array.range A.size = (List.range A.size).toArray from by apply Array.ext'; simp]
    at hmem
  rw [Array.flatMap_toArray, Array.mem_def] at hmem
  simp only [Array.toList_toArray, List.mem_flatMap, List.mem_range, Array.toList_map,
    List.mem_map, Array.toList_filter, List.mem_filter] at hmem
  obtain ⟨i, _hi, j, ⟨⟨hjmem, hcond⟩, heq⟩⟩ := hmem
  
  
  rw [Prod.mk.injEq] at heq
  obtain ⟨hia, hjb⟩ := heq
  subst hia; subst hjb
  rw [Bool.and_eq_true, decide_eq_true_eq] at hcond
  refine ⟨hcond.1, ?_⟩
  
  
  rw [← Array.mem_def, mem_dedupAdjN, mem_sortAscN] at hjmem
  have hlt := CSG.Proof.BVH.boxQuery_mem_lt _ _ _ hjmem
  rwa [nsiBoxes_size] at hlt

name: L_nsi
statement:
theorem L_nsi (M : Mesh) (_hcyc : IsClosedOrientedSurface M) (hnd : NoDegenerateFaces M) :
    checkNoSelfIntersection M = true ↔ NoFaceInteriorContact M
proof:
:= by
  
  set A := materialize M with hA
  have hsz : A.size = M.size := materialize_size M
  
  have hgetA : ∀ (k : Nat) (hk : k < M.size),
      A.getD k default = (faceHOf (M[k]'hk), boxOfTri (M[k]'hk)) := by
    intro k hk
    have hk' : k < A.size := by rw [hsz]; exact hk
    rw [Array.getD_eq_get?, Array.getElem?_eq_getElem hk', Option.getD_some]
    have : A[k]'hk' = (materialize M)[(⟨k, hk'⟩ : Fin _)] := rfl
    rw [this, materialize_getElem M ⟨k, hk'⟩ hk]
  
  
  
  
  have hpairForm : ∀ (a b : Nat) (ha : a < M.size) (hb : b < M.size),
      triPairOKAt (faceNormals A) A a b
        = triPairOK (rescale (faceHOf (M[b]'hb)).w (faceHOf (M[a]'ha)))
            (rescale (faceHOf (M[a]'ha)).w (faceHOf (M[b]'hb))) := by
    intro a b ha hb
    have hwa : 0 < (A.getD a default).1.w := by
      rw [hgetA a ha]; exact faceHOf_w_pos _
    rw [CSG.Proof.WellFormedCheckNSIFast.triPairOKAt_eq A a b hwa]
    simp only [hgetA a ha, hgetA b hb]
  unfold checkNoSelfIntersection
  rw [← hA, Array.all_eq_true]
  constructor
  · 
    intro hall
    intro i j hij
    
    by_cases hempty : (triangleSet M[i] ∩ triangleSet M[j]).Nonempty
    · 
      have hmem := nsiCandidates_sound M i j hij hempty
      rw [← hA] at hmem
      
      rw [Array.mem_iff_getElem] at hmem
      obtain ⟨idx, hidx, hidxeq⟩ := hmem
      have hbool := hall ⟨idx, hidx⟩
      have hidxeq' : (nsiCandidates A)[(⟨idx, hidx⟩ : Fin _)] = (i.1 ⊓ j.1, i.1 ⊔ j.1) := hidxeq
      rw [hidxeq'] at hbool
      
      have hmin : min i.1 j.1 < M.size := lt_of_le_of_lt (min_le_left _ _) i.2
      have hmax : max i.1 j.1 < M.size := max_lt i.2 j.2
      rw [hpairForm _ _ hmin hmax] at hbool
      have hndmin : NDeg (M[min i.1 j.1]'hmin) := hnd ⟨_, hmin⟩
      have hndmax : NDeg (M[max i.1 j.1]'hmax) := hnd ⟨_, hmax⟩
      rw [triPairOK_iff _ _ hndmin hndmax] at hbool
      obtain ⟨hcmin, hcmax⟩ := hbool
      
      rcases le_total i.1 j.1 with hle | hle
      · 
        have hmineq : M[i.1 ⊓ j.1]'hmin = M[i] := by congr 1; exact min_eq_left hle
        have hmaxeq : M[i.1 ⊔ j.1]'hmax = M[j] := by congr 1; exact max_eq_right hle
        rw [hmineq, hmaxeq] at hcmin
        exact hcmin
      · 
        have hmineq : M[i.1 ⊓ j.1]'hmin = M[j] := by congr 1; exact min_eq_right hle
        have hmaxeq : M[i.1 ⊔ j.1]'hmax = M[i] := by congr 1; exact max_eq_left hle
        rw [hmineq, hmaxeq] at hcmax
        
        rw [Set.inter_comm]; exact hcmax
    · 
      rw [Set.not_nonempty_iff_eq_empty] at hempty
      rw [hempty]; exact Set.empty_subset _
  · 
    intro hnsi
    intro idx
    
    set ab := (nsiCandidates A)[idx] with hab_def
    obtain ⟨a, b⟩ := ab
    have hmem : (a, b) ∈ nsiCandidates A := by
      rw [hab_def]; exact Array.getElem_mem idx.2
    obtain ⟨hab, hb⟩ := nsiCandidates_mem_bound A a b hmem
    have ha : a < M.size := hsz ▸ (hab.trans hb)
    have hb' : b < M.size := hsz ▸ hb
    show triPairOKAt (faceNormals A) A a b = true
    rw [hpairForm a b ha hb']
    have hnda : NDeg (M[a]'ha) := hnd ⟨a, ha⟩
    have hndb : NDeg (M[b]'hb') := hnd ⟨b, hb'⟩
    rw [triPairOK_iff _ _ hnda hndb]
    
    have hi : a < M.size := ha
    have hj : b < M.size := hb'
    have hne : (⟨a, ha⟩ : Fin M.size) ≠ ⟨b, hb'⟩ := by
      simp only [ne_eq, Fin.mk.injEq]; exact Nat.ne_of_lt hab
    have c1 := hnsi ⟨a, ha⟩ ⟨b, hb'⟩ hne
    have c2 := hnsi ⟨b, hb'⟩ ⟨a, ha⟩ hne.symm
    refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
    · 
      simpa using c1
    · 
      rw [Set.inter_comm]; simpa using c2

name: toList_eq_map_finRange
statement:
private theorem toList_eq_map_finRange (w : Chain) :
    w.toList = (List.finRange w.size).map (fun i => w[i])
proof:
:= by
  apply List.ext_getElem
  · simp
  · intro i h₁ h₂
    simp only [List.getElem_map, List.getElem_finRange]
    rfl

name: winding_eq_finSum
proof:
:= by
  rw [Fin.sum_univ_def]
  unfold winding
  rw [toList_eq_map_finRange w, List.map_map]
  rfl

name: winding_eq_finSum_indicator
proof:
:= by
  rw [winding_eq_finSum]
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro i _
  by_cases h : Q ∈ simplex w[i].2 <;> simp [h]

name: sum_flatMap
statement:
private theorem sum_flatMap {α β : Type*} [AddCommMonoid β]
    (l : List α) (f : α → List β) :
    (l.flatMap f).sum = (l.map (fun a => (f a).sum)).sum
proof:
:= by
  rw [List.flatMap_def, List.sum_flatten, List.map_map]
  rfl

name: winding_productChainOf_double_sum
statement:
theorem winding_productChainOf_double_sum (f : Triangle → Triangle → Chain)
    (w₁ w₂ : Chain) (Q : Point) :
    winding (productChainOf f w₁ w₂) Q
      = ∑ i : Fin w₁.size, ∑ j : Fin w₂.size,
          (w₁[i].1 * w₂[j].1) * winding (f w₁[i].2 w₂[j].2) Q
proof:
:= by
  
  unfold winding productChainOf
  rw [Array.toList_toArray]
  
  rw [List.map_flatMap]
  
  rw [sum_flatMap, ← Fin.sum_univ_def]
  
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro i _
  rw [List.map_flatMap, sum_flatMap, ← Fin.sum_univ_def]
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro j _
  
  have hblock :
      (((f w₁[i].2 w₂[j].2).map (fun e => (w₁[i].1 * w₂[j].1 * e.1, e.2))).toList.map
          (fun e => if Q ∈ simplex e.2 then e.1 else 0)).sum
        = winding ((f w₁[i].2 w₂[j].2).map
            (fun e => (w₁[i].1 * w₂[j].1 * e.1, e.2))) Q := rfl
  rw [hblock]
  
  rw [CSG.Proof.WindingAlgebra.winding_scale]
  
  rfl

name: winding_mul_off_planes_of
statement:
theorem winding_mul_off_planes_of (f : Triangle → Triangle → Chain)
    (hf : WindingSpec f) (w₁ w₂ : Chain) :
    ∃ N : Set Point, Negligible N
      ∧ ∀ Q ∉ N, winding (productChainOf f w₁ w₂) Q
          = winding w₁ Q * winding w₂ Q
proof:
:= by
  classical
  
  choose N hN using fun (p : Fin w₁.size × Fin w₂.size) =>
    hf w₁[p.1].2 w₂[p.2].2
  
  refine ⟨⋃ p : Fin w₁.size × Fin w₂.size, N p, ?_, ?_⟩
  · exact CSG.Proof.Negligible.negligible_iUnion_fintype (fun p => (hN p).1)
  · intro Q hQ
    
    have hQp : ∀ p : Fin w₁.size × Fin w₂.size, Q ∉ N p := by
      intro p hp
      exact hQ (Set.mem_iUnion.2 ⟨p, hp⟩)
    
    rw [winding_productChainOf_double_sum]
    
    
    have hstep : ∀ (i : Fin w₁.size) (j : Fin w₂.size),
        (w₁[i].1 * w₂[j].1) * winding (f w₁[i].2 w₂[j].2) Q
          = (w₁[i].1 * w₂[j].1) *
              ((if Q ∈ simplex w₁[i].2 then (1 : ℤ) else 0)
                * (if Q ∈ simplex w₂[j].2 then (1 : ℤ) else 0)) := by
      intro i j
      have hwind := (hN (i, j)).2 Q (hQp (i, j))
      rw [hwind, CSG.Proof.WindingAlgebra.indicator_inter_eq_mul]
    
    calc
      ∑ i : Fin w₁.size, ∑ j : Fin w₂.size,
          (w₁[i].1 * w₂[j].1) * winding (f w₁[i].2 w₂[j].2) Q
          = ∑ i : Fin w₁.size, ∑ j : Fin w₂.size,
              (w₁[i].1 * w₂[j].1) *
                ((if Q ∈ simplex w₁[i].2 then (1 : ℤ) else 0)
                  * (if Q ∈ simplex w₂[j].2 then (1 : ℤ) else 0)) := by
            apply Finset.sum_congr rfl; intro i _
            apply Finset.sum_congr rfl; intro j _
            exact hstep i j
      _ = (∑ i : Fin w₁.size,
              w₁[i].1 * (if Q ∈ simplex w₁[i].2 then (1 : ℤ) else 0))
            * (∑ j : Fin w₂.size,
                w₂[j].1 * (if Q ∈ simplex w₂[j].2 then (1 : ℤ) else 0)) :=
          CSG.Proof.WindingAlgebra.double_sum_factors
            (fun i => w₁[i].1) (fun j => w₂[j].1)
            (fun i => if Q ∈ simplex w₁[i].2 then (1 : ℤ) else 0)
            (fun j => if Q ∈ simplex w₂[j].2 then (1 : ℤ) else 0)
      _ = winding w₁ Q * winding w₂ Q := by
            rw [← winding_eq_finSum_indicator w₁ Q, ← winding_eq_finSum_indicator w₂ Q]

name: normal_of_productOf
statement:
theorem normal_of_productOf (f : Triangle → Triangle → Chain)
    (hf : WindingSpec f) (w₁ w₂ : Chain)
    (h₁ : Legacy.Normal w₁) (h₂ : Legacy.Normal w₂) :
    Legacy.Normal (productChainOf f w₁ w₂)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  obtain ⟨N₁, hN₁neg, hN₁⟩ := h₁
  obtain ⟨N₂, hN₂neg, hN₂⟩ := h₂
  obtain ⟨Nalg, hNalgNeg, hNalg⟩ := winding_mul_off_planes_of f hf w₁ w₂
  refine ⟨N₁ ∪ N₂ ∪ Nalg, ?_, ?_⟩
  · exact CSG.Proof.Negligible.negligible_union
      (CSG.Proof.Negligible.negligible_union hN₁neg hN₂neg) hNalgNeg
  · intro Q hQ
    have hQ1 : Q ∉ N₁ := fun h => hQ (Or.inl (Or.inl h))
    have hQ2 : Q ∉ N₂ := fun h => hQ (Or.inl (Or.inr h))
    have hQa : Q ∉ Nalg := fun h => hQ (Or.inr h)
    rw [hNalg Q hQa]
    rcases hN₁ Q hQ1 with h1 | h1 <;> rcases hN₂ Q hQ2 with h2 | h2 <;>
      rw [h1, h2] <;> simp

name: eqOffPlanes_of_productOf
statement:
theorem eqOffPlanes_of_productOf (f : Triangle → Triangle → Chain)
    (hf : WindingSpec f) (w₁ w₂ : Chain) :
    EqOffPlanes (Legacy.solid (productChainOf f w₁ w₂)) (Legacy.solid w₁ ∩ Legacy.solid w₂)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  obtain ⟨Nalg, hNalgNeg, hNalg⟩ := winding_mul_off_planes_of f hf w₁ w₂
  refine ⟨Nalg, hNalgNeg, ?_⟩
  
  intro Q hQ
  by_contra hc
  
  have hfact := hNalg Q hc
  
  have hmem : Q ∈ Legacy.solid (productChainOf f w₁ w₂) ↔ Q ∈ Legacy.solid w₁ ∩ Legacy.solid w₂ := by
    unfold Legacy.solid
    simp only [Set.mem_inter_iff, Set.mem_setOf_eq]
    rw [hfact, mul_ne_zero_iff]
  
  rcases hQ with hQ | hQ
  · exact (Set.not_mem_of_mem_diff (hQ)) ((hmem.1) (Set.mem_of_mem_diff hQ))
  · exact (Set.not_mem_of_mem_diff (hQ)) ((hmem.2) (Set.mem_of_mem_diff hQ))

name: tetra_Hrep
proof:
:= by
  classical
  obtain ⟨b, a₀, hbcoe, hbset, hba₀⟩ := Proof.AffineBasisSimplex.simplexAffineBasis t h
  have hsz4 : (tetraHalves t).size = 4 := rfl
  
  set f0 : Half := (tetraHalves t)[0]'(by rw [hsz4]; omega) with hf0d
  set f1 : Half := (tetraHalves t)[1]'(by rw [hsz4]; omega) with hf1d
  set f2 : Half := (tetraHalves t)[2]'(by rw [hsz4]; omega) with hf2d
  set f3 : Half := (tetraHalves t)[3]'(by rw [hsz4]; omega) with hf3d
  
  have hb0 : b 0 = (0 : Point) := by rw [hbcoe]; rfl
  have hb1 : b 1 = t.v₀ := by rw [hbcoe]; rfl
  have hb2 : b 2 = t.v₁ := by rw [hbcoe]; rfl
  have hb3 : b 3 = t.v₂ := by rw [hbcoe]; rfl
  
  have hdet : det3 t.v₀ t.v₁ t.v₂ ≠ 0 := by
    rw [det3_ne_zero_iff_linearIndependent]
    rw [affineIndependent_iff] at h
    rw [Fintype.linearIndependent_iff]
    intro s hst i0
    
    set w : Fin 4 → ℚ := ![-(s 0 + s 1 + s 2), s 0, s 1, s 2] with hw
    have hwsum : ∑ i, w i = 0 := by
      simp only [hw, Fin.sum_univ_four, Matrix.cons_val_zero, Matrix.cons_val_one,
        Matrix.head_cons, Matrix.cons_val_two, Matrix.cons_val_three, Matrix.tail_cons]; ring
    have hwcomb : ∑ i, w i • (![(0 : Point), t.v₀, t.v₁, t.v₂] i) = 0 := by
      have hst' : s 0 • t.v₀ + s 1 • t.v₁ + s 2 • t.v₂ = 0 := by
        have := hst; rw [Fin.sum_univ_three] at this
        simpa [Matrix.cons_val_zero, Matrix.cons_val_one, Matrix.head_cons,
          Matrix.cons_val_two, Matrix.tail_cons] using this
      simp only [hw, Fin.sum_univ_four, Matrix.cons_val_zero, Matrix.cons_val_one,
        Matrix.head_cons, Matrix.cons_val_two, Matrix.cons_val_three, Matrix.tail_cons]
      rw [smul_zero, zero_add]; linear_combination (norm := module) hst'
    have hz := h Finset.univ w hwsum hwcomb
    fin_cases i0
    · exact hz 1 (Finset.mem_univ _)
    · exact hz 2 (Finset.mem_univ _)
    · exact hz 3 (Finset.mem_univ _)
  
  
  have hfacet0 : ∃ lam : ℚ, 0 < lam ∧ gOf f0 = lam • b.coord 1 := by
    set n0 := crossQ t.v₁ t.v₂ with hn0
    have hg0 : f0
        = (if 0 ≤ dotQ n0 t.v₀ then (⟨n0, 0⟩ : Half) else Half.neg ⟨n0, 0⟩) := by rw [hf0d]; rfl
    have hvk : dotQ n0 t.v₀ ≠ 0 := by rw [hn0, dotQ_crossQ_det]; exact hdet
    obtain ⟨hz0, hpos, hvanish, _⟩ := origin_facet_eval n0 t.v₀ hvk _ hg0
    refine ⟨gOf f0 t.v₀, ?_, ?_⟩
    · exact hpos
    · apply gOf_eq_smul_coord (b := b) _ 1 _ (by rw [hb1])
      intro i hi
      fin_cases i
      · simp only [Fin.zero_eta, Fin.mk_one, Fin.reduceFinMk]; rw [hb0]; exact hz0
      · exact absurd rfl hi
      · simp only [Fin.zero_eta, Fin.mk_one, Fin.reduceFinMk]; rw [hb2]; exact hvanish t.v₁ (by rw [hn0]; exact dotQ_crossQ_left t.v₁ t.v₂)
      · simp only [Fin.zero_eta, Fin.mk_one, Fin.reduceFinMk]; rw [hb3]; exact hvanish t.v₂ (by rw [hn0]; exact dotQ_crossQ_right t.v₁ t.v₂)
  have hfacet1 : ∃ lam : ℚ, 0 < lam ∧ gOf f1 = lam • b.coord 2 := by
    set n1 := crossQ t.v₀ t.v₂ with hn1
    have hg1 : f1
        = (if 0 ≤ dotQ n1 t.v₁ then (⟨n1, 0⟩ : Half) else Half.neg ⟨n1, 0⟩) := by rw [hf1d]; rfl
    have hvk : dotQ n1 t.v₁ ≠ 0 := by
      rw [hn1, dotQ_crossQ_det]
      intro hc; apply hdet
      
      have : det3 t.v₁ t.v₀ t.v₂ = - det3 t.v₀ t.v₁ t.v₂ := by
        simp only [det3_expand]; ring
      rw [this] at hc; linarith
    obtain ⟨hz0, hpos, hvanish, _⟩ := origin_facet_eval n1 t.v₁ hvk _ hg1
    refine ⟨gOf f1 t.v₁, ?_, ?_⟩
    · exact hpos
    · apply gOf_eq_smul_coord (b := b) _ 2 _ (by rw [hb2])
      intro i hi
      fin_cases i
      · simp only [Fin.zero_eta, Fin.mk_one, Fin.reduceFinMk]; rw [hb0]; exact hz0
      · simp only [Fin.zero_eta, Fin.mk_one, Fin.reduceFinMk]; rw [hb1]; exact hvanish t.v₀ (by rw [hn1]; exact dotQ_crossQ_left t.v₀ t.v₂)
      · exact absurd rfl hi
      · simp only [Fin.zero_eta, Fin.mk_one, Fin.reduceFinMk]; rw [hb3]; exact hvanish t.v₂ (by rw [hn1]; exact dotQ_crossQ_right t.v₀ t.v₂)
  have hfacet2 : ∃ lam : ℚ, 0 < lam ∧ gOf f2 = lam • b.coord 3 := by
    set n2 := crossQ t.v₀ t.v₁ with hn2
    have hg2 : f2
        = (if 0 ≤ dotQ n2 t.v₂ then (⟨n2, 0⟩ : Half) else Half.neg ⟨n2, 0⟩) := by rw [hf2d]; rfl
    have hvk : dotQ n2 t.v₂ ≠ 0 := by
      rw [hn2, dotQ_crossQ_det]
      intro hc; apply hdet
      have : det3 t.v₂ t.v₀ t.v₁ = det3 t.v₀ t.v₁ t.v₂ := by
        simp only [det3_expand]; ring
      rw [this] at hc; exact hc
    obtain ⟨hz0, hpos, hvanish, _⟩ := origin_facet_eval n2 t.v₂ hvk _ hg2
    refine ⟨gOf f2 t.v₂, ?_, ?_⟩
    · exact hpos
    · apply gOf_eq_smul_coord (b := b) _ 3 _ (by rw [hb3])
      intro i hi
      fin_cases i
      · simp only [Fin.zero_eta, Fin.mk_one, Fin.reduceFinMk]; rw [hb0]; exact hz0
      · simp only [Fin.zero_eta, Fin.mk_one, Fin.reduceFinMk]; rw [hb1]; exact hvanish t.v₀ (by rw [hn2]; exact dotQ_crossQ_left t.v₀ t.v₁)
      · simp only [Fin.zero_eta, Fin.mk_one, Fin.reduceFinMk]; rw [hb2]; exact hvanish t.v₁ (by rw [hn2]; exact dotQ_crossQ_right t.v₀ t.v₁)
      · exact absurd rfl hi
  have hfacet3 : ∃ lam : ℚ, 0 < lam ∧ gOf f3 = lam • b.coord 0 := by
    set n3 := crossQ (psub t.v₁ t.v₀) (psub t.v₂ t.v₀) with hn3
    set c3 := dotQ n3 t.v₀ with hc3
    have hg3 : f3
        = (if c3 ≤ 0 then (⟨n3, c3⟩ : Half) else Half.neg ⟨n3, c3⟩) := by rw [hf3d]; rfl
    have hc3ne : c3 ≠ 0 := by
      rw [hc3, hn3]
      
      rw [dotQ_crossQ_det]
      intro hc; apply hdet
      
      have : det3 t.v₀ (psub t.v₁ t.v₀) (psub t.v₂ t.v₀) = det3 t.v₀ t.v₁ t.v₂ := by
        simp only [det3_expand, psub]; ring
      rw [this] at hc; exact hc
    obtain ⟨hzv0, hzv1, hzv2, hpos, _⟩ := base_facet_eval t.v₀ t.v₁ t.v₂ n3 hn3 c3 hc3 hc3ne _ hg3
    refine ⟨gOf f3 0, ?_, ?_⟩
    · exact hpos
    · apply gOf_eq_smul_coord (b := b) _ 0 _ (by rw [hb0])
      intro i hi
      fin_cases i
      · exact absurd rfl hi
      · simp only [Fin.zero_eta, Fin.mk_one, Fin.reduceFinMk]; rw [hb1]; exact hzv0
      · simp only [Fin.zero_eta, Fin.mk_one, Fin.reduceFinMk]; rw [hb2]; exact hzv1
      · simp only [Fin.zero_eta, Fin.mk_one, Fin.reduceFinMk]; rw [hb3]; exact hzv2
  
  obtain ⟨l0, hl0, he0⟩ := hfacet0
  obtain ⟨l1, hl1, he1⟩ := hfacet1
  obtain ⟨l2, hl2, he2⟩ := hfacet2
  obtain ⟨l3, hl3, he3⟩ := hfacet3
  have hhs0 : {x : Point | 0 ≤ gOf f0 x} = {x | 0 ≤ b.coord 1 x} :=
    halfspace_eq_of_pos_smul hl0 he0
  have hhs1 : {x : Point | 0 ≤ gOf f1 x} = {x | 0 ≤ b.coord 2 x} :=
    halfspace_eq_of_pos_smul hl1 he1
  have hhs2 : {x : Point | 0 ≤ gOf f2 x} = {x | 0 ≤ b.coord 3 x} :=
    halfspace_eq_of_pos_smul hl2 he2
  have hhs3 : {x : Point | 0 ≤ gOf f3 x} = {x | 0 ≤ b.coord 0 x} :=
    halfspace_eq_of_pos_smul hl3 he3
  rw [Proof.AffineBasisSimplex.simplex_eq_iInter_halfspaces t b hbset]
  
  
  have hfeq : ∀ x, (x ∈ ⋂ k : Fin (tetraHalves t).size, {y : Point | 0 ≤ gOf (tetraHalves t)[k] y})
      ↔ (0 ≤ gOf f0 x ∧ 0 ≤ gOf f1 x ∧ 0 ≤ gOf f2 x ∧ 0 ≤ gOf f3 x) := by
    intro x
    simp only [Set.mem_iInter, Set.mem_setOf_eq]
    constructor
    · intro hx
      exact ⟨hx ⟨0, by rw [hsz4]; omega⟩, hx ⟨1, by rw [hsz4]; omega⟩,
             hx ⟨2, by rw [hsz4]; omega⟩, hx ⟨3, by rw [hsz4]; omega⟩⟩
    · rintro ⟨h0, h1, h2, h3⟩ k
      have hk4 : (k : ℕ) < 4 := by rw [← hsz4]; exact k.2
      match hkv : (k : ℕ), hk4 with
      | 0, _ => have hke : k = ⟨0, by rw [hsz4]; omega⟩ := by ext; rw [hkv]
                rw [hke]; exact h0
      | 1, _ => have hke : k = ⟨1, by rw [hsz4]; omega⟩ := by ext; rw [hkv]
                rw [hke]; exact h1
      | 2, _ => have hke : k = ⟨2, by rw [hsz4]; omega⟩ := by ext; rw [hkv]
                rw [hke]; exact h2
      | 3, _ => have hke : k = ⟨3, by rw [hsz4]; omega⟩ := by ext; rw [hkv]
                rw [hke]; exact h3
  ext x
  rw [hfeq x]
  simp only [Set.mem_iInter, Set.mem_setOf_eq]
  rw [Set.ext_iff] at hhs0 hhs1 hhs2 hhs3
  simp only [Set.mem_setOf_eq] at hhs0 hhs1 hhs2 hhs3
  constructor
  · 
    intro hx
    refine ⟨(hhs0 x).mpr (hx 1), (hhs1 x).mpr (hx 2), (hhs2 x).mpr (hx 3), (hhs3 x).mpr (hx 0)⟩
  · 
    rintro ⟨h0, h1, h2, h3⟩ k
    fin_cases k
    · exact (hhs3 x).mp h3
    · exact (hhs0 x).mp h0
    · exact (hhs1 x).mp h1
    · exact (hhs2 x).mp h2

name: tetra_Hrep_mem
proof:
:= by
  rw [tetra_Hrep t h]
  ext x
  simp only [Set.mem_iInter, Set.mem_setOf_eq]
  constructor
  · intro hx g hg
    obtain ⟨k, hk, rfl⟩ := Array.mem_iff_getElem.mp hg
    exact hx ⟨k, hk⟩
  · intro hx k
    exact hx (tetraHalves t)[k] (Array.getElem_mem k.2)

name: K_Hrep_mem
statement:
theorem K_Hrep_mem (s t : Triangle)
    (hs : AffineIndependent ℚ ![(0 : Point), s.v₀, s.v₁, s.v₂])
    (ht : AffineIndependent ℚ ![(0 : Point), t.v₀, t.v₁, t.v₂]) :
    simplex s ∩ simplex t = ⋂ g ∈ Gfun s t, {x : Point | 0 ≤ gOf g x}
proof:
:= by
  rw [tetra_Hrep_mem s hs, tetra_Hrep_mem t ht]
  ext x
  simp only [Set.mem_inter_iff, Set.mem_iInter, Set.mem_setOf_eq, Gfun, Array.mem_append]
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨h1, h2⟩ g hg
    rcases hg with hg | hg
    · exact h1 g hg
    · exact h2 g hg
  · intro h
    exact ⟨fun g hg => h g (Or.inl hg), fun g hg => h g (Or.inr hg)⟩

name: tripleVertex_active
proof:

proof: := by simp only [det3_expand]; ring

name: exists_pair_with_N
statement:
theorem exists_pair_with_N {na nb nc N : Point} (hdet : det3 na nb nc ≠ 0) (hN : N ≠ 0) :
    det3 na nb N ≠ 0 ∨ det3 na nc N ≠ 0 ∨ det3 nb nc N ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  by_contra hcon
  push_neg at hcon
  obtain ⟨h1, h2, h3⟩ := hcon
  
  have hli : LinearIndependent ℚ ![na, nb, nc] := (det3_ne_zero_iff_linearIndependent _ _ _).mp hdet
  
  have hspan : Submodule.span ℚ (Set.range ![na, nb, nc]) = ⊤ := by
    apply Submodule.eq_top_of_finrank_eq
    rw [finrank_span_eq_card hli]
    simp [Module.finrank_pi]
  have hNmem : N ∈ Submodule.span ℚ (Set.range ![na, nb, nc]) := by rw [hspan]; trivial
  rw [Finsupp.mem_span_range_iff_exists_finsupp] at hNmem
  obtain ⟨w, hw⟩ := hNmem
  
  have hNexp : N = w 0 • na + w 1 • nb + w 2 • nc := by
    rw [← hw, Finsupp.sum_fintype _ _ (by intro i; simp)]
    rw [Fin.sum_univ_three]
    simp only [Matrix.cons_val_zero, Matrix.cons_val_one, Matrix.head_cons, Matrix.cons_val_two,
      Matrix.tail_cons]
  
  have hd := hdet
  rw [det3_expand] at hd
  have e1 : det3 na nb N = w 2 * det3 na nb nc := by
    conv_lhs => rw [hNexp]
    simp only [det3_expand, Pi.add_apply, Pi.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul]; ring
  have e3 : det3 nb nc N = w 0 * det3 na nb nc := by
    conv_lhs => rw [hNexp]
    simp only [det3_expand, Pi.add_apply, Pi.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul]; ring
  have e5 : det3 na nc N = - (w 1 * det3 na nb nc) := by
    conv_lhs => rw [hNexp]
    simp only [det3_expand, Pi.add_apply, Pi.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul]; ring
  have hw2 : w 2 = 0 := by
    have := e1.symm.trans h1; rcases mul_eq_zero.mp this with h | h
    · exact h
    · exact absurd h hdet
  have hw0 : w 0 = 0 := by
    have := e3.symm.trans h3; rcases mul_eq_zero.mp this with h | h
    · exact h
    · exact absurd h hdet
  have hw1 : w 1 = 0 := by
    have h2' : w 1 * det3 na nb nc = 0 := by have := e5.symm.trans h2; linarith
    rcases mul_eq_zero.mp h2' with h | h
    · exact h
    · exact absurd h hdet
  apply hN
  rw [hNexp, hw0, hw1, hw2]; simp

name: cell_on_plane
statement:
theorem cell_on_plane (gi : Half) (s t : Triangle) :
    ∀ p ∈ ({x : Point | (gOf gi) x = 0} ∩ Kpair s t),
      ∀ q ∈ ({x : Point | (gOf gi) x = 0} ∩ Kpair s t),
      linOf gi.n (p - q) = 0
proof:
:= by
  intro p hp q hq
  have hgp : (gOf gi) p = 0 := hp.1
  have hgq : (gOf gi) q = 0 := hq.1
  have : (gOf gi).linear (p - q) = (gOf gi) p - (gOf gi) q := by
    have := AffineMap.linearMap_vsub (gOf gi) p q; simpa [vsub_eq_sub] using this
  rw [gOf_linear] at this
  rw [this, hgp, hgq, sub_zero]

name: g'_linear

    ((Gtil s t j).comp (iotaAff N o)).linear

proof:
:= by

name: exists_aff_indep_triple_of_dim2
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨tt, hts, hspan, hai⟩ := exists_affineIndependent ℚ _ P
  have hvs : vectorSpan ℚ tt = vectorSpan ℚ P := by
    rw [← direction_affineSpan ℚ tt, ← direction_affineSpan ℚ P, hspan]
  have hfint : tt.Finite := finite_set_of_fin_dim_affineIndependent ℚ hai
  have hft : Fintype tt := hfint.fintype
  have hcard : Fintype.card tt = 3 := by
    have hf2 : Module.finrank ℚ (vectorSpan ℚ (Set.range (Subtype.val : tt → Point))) = 2 := by
      rw [Subtype.range_coe, hvs]; exact hdim
    rcases Nat.eq_zero_or_pos (Fintype.card tt) with h0 | hpos
    · exfalso
      have hemp : IsEmpty tt := Fintype.card_eq_zero_iff.mp h0
      have hr : Set.range (Subtype.val : tt → Point) = ∅ := Set.range_eq_empty_iff.mpr hemp
      rw [hr, vectorSpan_empty] at hf2; simp at hf2
    · obtain ⟨n, hn⟩ := Nat.exists_eq_succ_of_ne_zero hpos.ne'
      have := hai.finrank_vectorSpan (n := n) (by rw [hn])
      rw [this] at hf2; omega
  have e : tt ≃ Fin 3 := Fintype.equivFinOfCardEq hcard
  exact ⟨fun i => (e.symm i : Point), fun i => hts (e.symm i).2, hai.comp_embedding e.symm.toEmbedding⟩

name: apex_aff_indep
statement:
theorem apex_aff_indep (gi : Half) (hapex : (gOf gi) 0 ≠ 0)
    {q : Fin 3 → Point} (hqP : ∀ i, (gOf gi) (q i) = 0) (hqai : AffineIndependent ℚ q) :
    AffineIndependent ℚ ![(0 : Point), q 0, q 1, q 2]
proof:
:= by
  
  have hbase : AffineIndependent ℚ ![q 0, q 1, q 2] := by
    have : (![q 0, q 1, q 2] : Fin 3 → Point) = q := by funext j; fin_cases j <;> rfl
    rw [this]; exact hqai
  
  
  rcases lt_or_gt_of_ne hapex with hneg | hpos
  · 
    have hpos' : 0 < (-(gOf gi)) 0 := by show 0 < -((gOf gi) 0); linarith
    have h0 : (-(gOf gi)) (q 0) = 0 := by show -((gOf gi) (q 0)) = 0; rw [hqP 0]; ring
    have h1 : (-(gOf gi)) (q 1) = 0 := by show -((gOf gi) (q 1)) = 0; rw [hqP 1]; ring
    have h2 : (-(gOf gi)) (q 2) = 0 := by show -((gOf gi) (q 2)) = 0; rw [hqP 2]; ring
    exact Proof.SimWinding.affineIndependent_origin_apex (-(gOf gi)) hpos' h0 h1 h2 hbase
  · exact Proof.SimWinding.affineIndependent_origin_apex (gOf gi) hpos
      (hqP 0) (hqP 1) (hqP 2) hbase

name: range_vec4
statement: theorem range_vec4 (a b c d : Point) : Set.range ![a, b, c, d] = {a, b, c, d}
proof:
:= by
  ext x
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨i, rfl⟩; fin_cases i <;> simp
  · intro h; simp only [Set.mem_insert_iff, Set.mem_singleton_iff] at h
    rcases h with h | h | h | h <;> subst h
    exacts [⟨0, rfl⟩, ⟨1, rfl⟩, ⟨2, rfl⟩, ⟨3, rfl⟩]

name: tetra_nondeg_of_four_indep
statement:
theorem tetra_nondeg_of_four_indep (tt : Triangle)
    {q : Fin 4 → Point} (hqai : AffineIndependent ℚ q) (hqs : ∀ j, q j ∈ simplex tt) :
    AffineIndependent ℚ ![(0 : Point), tt.v₀, tt.v₁, tt.v₂]
proof:
:= by
  
  have hqspan : Module.finrank ℚ (vectorSpan ℚ (Set.range q)) = 3 :=
    hqai.finrank_vectorSpan (by simp)
  have hsub : Set.range q ⊆ simplex tt := Set.range_subset_iff.mpr hqs
  have hvsConv : vectorSpan ℚ (simplex tt) = vectorSpan ℚ ({0, tt.v₀, tt.v₁, tt.v₂} : Set Point) := by
    rw [simplex, ← direction_affineSpan, ← direction_affineSpan ℚ ({0, tt.v₀, tt.v₁, tt.v₂} : Set Point),
      affineSpan_convexHull]
  have hle1 : vectorSpan ℚ (Set.range q) ≤ vectorSpan ℚ (simplex tt) := vectorSpan_mono ℚ hsub
  have h3le : 3 ≤ Module.finrank ℚ (vectorSpan ℚ (simplex tt)) := by
    have := Submodule.finrank_mono hle1
    rw [hqspan] at this; exact this
  
  have heq : vectorSpan ℚ ({0, tt.v₀, tt.v₁, tt.v₂} : Set Point)
      = vectorSpan ℚ (Set.range ![(0 : Point), tt.v₀, tt.v₁, tt.v₂]) := by
    rw [range_vec4]
  have h3 : Module.finrank ℚ (vectorSpan ℚ (Set.range ![(0 : Point), tt.v₀, tt.v₁, tt.v₂])) = 3 := by
    have hupper : Module.finrank ℚ (vectorSpan ℚ (Set.range ![(0 : Point), tt.v₀, tt.v₁, tt.v₂])) ≤ 3 := by
      have := finrank_vectorSpan_range_le ℚ (![(0 : Point), tt.v₀, tt.v₁, tt.v₂]) (n := 3) (by simp)
      omega
    have hlower : 3 ≤ Module.finrank ℚ (vectorSpan ℚ (Set.range ![(0 : Point), tt.v₀, tt.v₁, tt.v₂])) := by
      rw [← heq, ← hvsConv]; exact h3le
    omega
  exact (affineIndependent_iff_finrank_vectorSpan_eq ℚ ![(0 : Point), tt.v₀, tt.v₁, tt.v₂]
    (by simp)).mpr h3

name: both_tetra_nondeg
statement:
theorem both_tetra_nondeg (s t : Triangle) (gi : Half)
    (houter : 0 < (gOf gi) 0)
    (hdim : Module.finrank ℚ
      (vectorSpan ℚ ({x : Point | (gOf gi) x = 0} ∩ Kpair s t)) = 2) :
    AffineIndependent ℚ ![(0 : Point), s.v₀, s.v₁, s.v₂]
      ∧ AffineIndependent ℚ ![(0 : Point), t.v₀, t.v₁, t.v₂]
proof:
:= by
  
  obtain ⟨q, hqPi, hqai⟩ := exists_aff_indep_triple_of_dim2 hdim
  have hqplane : ∀ j, (gOf gi) (q j) = 0 := fun j => (hqPi j).1
  have hqK : ∀ j, q j ∈ Kpair s t := fun j => (hqPi j).2
  
  have h4 : AffineIndependent ℚ ![(0 : Point), q 0, q 1, q 2] :=
    apex_aff_indep gi (ne_of_gt houter) hqplane hqai
  
  have h0s : (0 : Point) ∈ simplex s := by
    rw [simplex]; exact subset_convexHull ℚ _ (by simp)
  have h0t : (0 : Point) ∈ simplex t := by
    rw [simplex]; exact subset_convexHull ℚ _ (by simp)
  have hqsS : ∀ j : Fin 4, (![(0 : Point), q 0, q 1, q 2] : Fin 4 → Point) j ∈ simplex s := by
    intro j; fin_cases j
    · exact h0s
    · exact (hqK 0).1
    · exact (hqK 1).1
    · exact (hqK 2).1
  have hqsT : ∀ j : Fin 4, (![(0 : Point), q 0, q 1, q 2] : Fin 4 → Point) j ∈ simplex t := by
    intro j; fin_cases j
    · exact h0t
    · exact (hqK 0).2
    · exact (hqK 1).2
    · exact (hqK 2).2
  exact ⟨tetra_nondeg_of_four_indep s h4 hqsS, tetra_nondeg_of_four_indep t h4 hqsT⟩

name: feasible_imp_K
statement:
theorem feasible_imp_K (s t : Triangle) (gi : Half)
    (houter : 0 < (gOf gi) 0)
    (hdim : Module.finrank ℚ
      (vectorSpan ℚ ({x : Point | (gOf gi) x = 0} ∩ Kpair s t)) = 2)
    {p : Point} (hpfeas : feasible (Gfun s t) p = true) :
    p ∈ Kpair s t
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨hs, ht⟩ := both_tetra_nondeg s t gi houter hdim
  rw [Kpair, K_Hrep_mem s t hs ht, Set.mem_iInter₂]
  intro g hg
  exact (feasible_iff (Gfun s t) p).mp hpfeas g hg

name: det3_ne_zero_perm
statement:
theorem det3_ne_zero_perm {a b c : Point} (h : det3 a b c ≠ 0) :
    det3 b a c ≠ 0 ∧ det3 a c b ≠ 0 ∧ det3 c b a ≠ 0
      ∧ det3 b c a ≠ 0 ∧ det3 c a b ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩ <;> intro hc <;> apply h <;>
    · rw [det3_expand] at hc ⊢; linarith [hc]

name: tripleVertex_of_active
statement:
theorem tripleVertex_of_active {G : Array Half} {a b c : Nat}
    (ha : a < G.size) (hb : b < G.size) (hc : c < G.size)
    (hdet : det3 G[a].n G[b].n G[c].n ≠ 0)
    {p : Point} (hpa : dotQ G[a].n p = G[a].c) (hpb : dotQ G[b].n p = G[b].c)
    (hpc : dotQ G[c].n p = G[c].c) :
    tripleVertex G a b c = some p
proof:
:= by
  rw [tripleVertex_eq_some ha hb hc]
  refine ⟨hdet, ?_⟩
  exact cramer3_unique hdet
    (by rw [hpa]; rfl) (by rw [hpb]; rfl) (by rw [hpc]; rfl)

name: three_active_in_verts
statement:
theorem three_active_in_verts {G : Array Half} {u v w : Nat}
    (hu : u < G.size) (hv : v < G.size) (hw : w < G.size)
    (huv : u ≠ v) (huw : u ≠ w) (hvw : v ≠ w)
    (hdet : det3 G[u].n G[v].n G[w].n ≠ 0)
    {p : Point} (hpu : dotQ G[u].n p = G[u].c) (hpv : dotQ G[v].n p = G[v].c)
    (hpw : dotQ G[w].n p = G[w].c) (hpfeas : feasible G p = true) :
    p ∈ verts G
proof:
:= by
  
  have key : ∀ a b c : Nat, (ha : a < G.size) → (hb : b < G.size) → (hc : c < G.size) →
      a < b → b < c →
      det3 (G[a]'ha).n (G[b]'hb).n (G[c]'hc).n ≠ 0 →
      dotQ (G[a]'ha).n p = (G[a]'ha).c → dotQ (G[b]'hb).n p = (G[b]'hb).c →
      dotQ (G[c]'hc).n p = (G[c]'hc).c → p ∈ verts G := by
    intro a b c ha hb hc hab hbc hd hpa hpb hpc
    rw [mem_verts]
    exact ⟨hpfeas, a, b, c, hab, hbc, hc, tripleVertex_of_active ha hb hc hd hpa hpb hpc⟩
  
  obtain ⟨h1, h2, h3, h4, h5⟩ := det3_ne_zero_perm hdet
  rcases lt_trichotomy u v with huvlt | huveq | huvgt
  · rcases lt_trichotomy v w with hvwlt | hvweq | hvwgt
    · exact key u v w hu hv hw huvlt hvwlt hdet hpu hpv hpw
    · exact absurd hvweq hvw
    · rcases lt_trichotomy u w with huwlt | huweq | huwgt
      · 
        exact key u w v hu hw hv huwlt hvwgt h2 hpu hpw hpv
      · exact absurd huweq huw
      · 
        exact key w u v hw hu hv huwgt huvlt h5 hpw hpu hpv
  · exact absurd huveq huv
  · rcases lt_trichotomy v w with hvwlt | hvweq | hvwgt
    · rcases lt_trichotomy u w with huwlt | huweq | huwgt
      · 
        exact key v u w hv hu hw huvgt huwlt h1 hpv hpu hpw
      · exact absurd huweq huw
      · 
        exact key v w u hv hw hu hvwlt huwgt h4 hpv hpw hpu
    · exact absurd hvweq hvw
    · 
      exact key w v u hw hv hu hvwgt huvgt h3 hpw hpv hpu

name: K_imp_feasible

    (hdim : Module.finrank ℚ
      (vectorSpan ℚ ({x : Point | (gOf gi) x = 0} ∩ Kpair s t)) = 2)

  rw [feasible_iff]
  intro g hg
  rw [Kpair, K_Hrep_mem s t hs ht, Set.mem_iInter₂] at hpK

name: facetVert_to_vertexSet
statement:
theorem facetVert_to_vertexSet (s t : Triangle) {i : Nat} {gi : Half}
    (hgi : (Gfun s t)[i]? = some gi) (houter : 0 < (gOf gi) 0)
    (hdim : Module.finrank ℚ
      (vectorSpan ℚ ({x : Point | (gOf gi) x = 0} ∩ Kpair s t)) = 2) (o : Point)
    {p : Point} (hp : p ∈ facetVerts (Gfun s t) i)
    (hpfix : iotaAff gi.n o (iotaInvAff gi.n o p) = p) :
    iotaInvAff gi.n o p ∈
      Proof.HpolytopeVertex.vertexSet
        (fun j : Fin (Gfun s t).size => (Gtil s t j).comp (iotaAff gi.n o))
        (iotaAff gi.n o ⁻¹' ({x : Point | (gOf gi) x = 0} ∩ Kpair s t))
proof:
:= by
  classical
  set G := Gfun s t with hG
  have hN : gi.n ≠ 0 := by
    intro h0
    
    
    
    
    
    
    
    
    
    
    have hlin0 : (gOf gi).linear = 0 := by rw [gOf_linear, h0]; exact (linOf_eq_zero_iff 0).mpr rfl
    have hconst : ∀ x, (gOf gi) x = (gOf gi) 0 := by
      intro x
      have hvs : (gOf gi).linear (x - 0) = (gOf gi) x - (gOf gi) 0 := by
        have := AffineMap.linearMap_vsub (gOf gi) x 0; simpa [vsub_eq_sub] using this
      rw [hlin0, LinearMap.zero_apply] at hvs
      linarith
    have hempty : ({x : Point | (gOf gi) x = 0} ∩ Kpair s t) = ∅ := by
      ext x; simp only [Set.mem_inter_iff, Set.mem_setOf_eq, Set.mem_empty_iff_false, iff_false]
      rintro ⟨hx, _⟩; rw [hconst x] at hx; linarith
    rw [hempty, vectorSpan_empty] at hdim; simp at hdim
  set iota := iotaAff gi.n o with hiotadef
  set iotaInv := iotaInvAff gi.n o with hiotaInvdef
  set Pi : Set Point := {x : Point | (gOf gi) x = 0} ∩ Kpair s t with hPidef
  set g' : Fin G.size → (Plane2 →ᵃ[ℚ] ℚ) := fun j => (Gtil s t j).comp iota with hg'def
  rw [mem_facetVerts] at hp
  obtain ⟨hpverts, hponplane⟩ := hp
  have hgip : (gOf gi) p = 0 := onPlane_imp_gi_zero s t hgi hponplane
  rw [mem_verts] at hpverts
  obtain ⟨hpfeas, a, b, c, hab, hbc, hcsize, hsome⟩ := hpverts
  have ha : a < G.size := by omega
  have hb : b < G.size := by omega
  have hc : c < G.size := hcsize
  obtain ⟨hdet, hga, hgb, hgc⟩ := tripleVertex_active ha hb hc hsome
  have hpK : p ∈ Kpair s t := feasible_imp_K s t gi houter hdim hpfeas
  have hpPi : p ∈ Pi := ⟨hgip, hpK⟩
  set y := iotaInv p with hy
  have hyP' : y ∈ iota ⁻¹' Pi := by rw [Set.mem_preimage, hy, hpfix]; exact hpPi
  
  have hactive : ∀ (j : Fin G.size), (gOf G[j]) p = 0 → g' j y = 0 := by
    intro j hj
    show (Gtil s t j).comp iota y = 0
    rw [AffineMap.comp_apply, hy, hpfix]
    show (gOf G[(j : Fin G.size)]) p = 0
    exact hj
  
  have hpair := exists_pair_with_N hdet hN
  
  refine ⟨hyP', ?_⟩
  rcases hpair with hp1 | hp2 | hp3
  · 
    refine ⟨⟨a, ha⟩, ⟨b, hb⟩, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
    · 
      have hind := active_pullback_pair hN o G[a].n G[b].n hp1
      show ((Gtil s t ⟨a, ha⟩).comp iota).linear ≠ 0
      rw [g'_linear s t ⟨a, ha⟩ gi.n o]
      exact (by simpa using hind.ne_zero (0 : Fin 2))
    · have hind := active_pullback_pair hN o G[a].n G[b].n hp1
      show ((Gtil s t ⟨b, hb⟩).comp iota).linear ≠ 0
      rw [g'_linear s t ⟨b, hb⟩ gi.n o]
      exact (by simpa using hind.ne_zero (1 : Fin 2))
    · have hind := active_pullback_pair hN o G[a].n G[b].n hp1
      rw [show ((fun j : Fin G.size => (Gtil s t j).comp iota) ⟨a, ha⟩).linear
            = (linOf G[a].n).comp iota.linear from g'_linear s t ⟨a, ha⟩ gi.n o,
          show ((fun j : Fin G.size => (Gtil s t j).comp iota) ⟨b, hb⟩).linear
            = (linOf G[b].n).comp iota.linear from g'_linear s t ⟨b, hb⟩ gi.n o]
      exact hind
    · exact hactive ⟨a, ha⟩ (by rw [getElem_fin_eq]; exact hga)
    · exact hactive ⟨b, hb⟩ (by rw [getElem_fin_eq]; exact hgb)
  · 
    refine ⟨⟨a, ha⟩, ⟨c, hc⟩, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
    · have hind := active_pullback_pair hN o G[a].n G[c].n hp2
      show ((Gtil s t ⟨a, ha⟩).comp iota).linear ≠ 0
      rw [g'_linear s t ⟨a, ha⟩ gi.n o]; exact (by simpa using hind.ne_zero (0 : Fin 2))
    · have hind := active_pullback_pair hN o G[a].n G[c].n hp2
      show ((Gtil s t ⟨c, hc⟩).comp iota).linear ≠ 0
      rw [g'_linear s t ⟨c, hc⟩ gi.n o]; exact (by simpa using hind.ne_zero (1 : Fin 2))
    · have hind := active_pullback_pair hN o G[a].n G[c].n hp2
      rw [show ((fun j : Fin G.size => (Gtil s t j).comp iota) ⟨a, ha⟩).linear
            = (linOf G[a].n).comp iota.linear from g'_linear s t ⟨a, ha⟩ gi.n o,
          show ((fun j : Fin G.size => (Gtil s t j).comp iota) ⟨c, hc⟩).linear
            = (linOf G[c].n).comp iota.linear from g'_linear s t ⟨c, hc⟩ gi.n o]
      exact hind
    · exact hactive ⟨a, ha⟩ (by rw [getElem_fin_eq]; exact hga)
    · exact hactive ⟨c, hc⟩ (by rw [getElem_fin_eq]; exact hgc)
  · 
    refine ⟨⟨b, hb⟩, ⟨c, hc⟩, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
    · have hind := active_pullback_pair hN o G[b].n G[c].n hp3
      show ((Gtil s t ⟨b, hb⟩).comp iota).linear ≠ 0
      rw [g'_linear s t ⟨b, hb⟩ gi.n o]; exact (by simpa using hind.ne_zero (0 : Fin 2))
    · have hind := active_pullback_pair hN o G[b].n G[c].n hp3
      show ((Gtil s t ⟨c, hc⟩).comp iota).linear ≠ 0
      rw [g'_linear s t ⟨c, hc⟩ gi.n o]; exact (by simpa using hind.ne_zero (1 : Fin 2))
    · have hind := active_pullback_pair hN o G[b].n G[c].n hp3
      rw [show ((fun j : Fin G.size => (Gtil s t j).comp iota) ⟨b, hb⟩).linear
            = (linOf G[b].n).comp iota.linear from g'_linear s t ⟨b, hb⟩ gi.n o,
          show ((fun j : Fin G.size => (Gtil s t j).comp iota) ⟨c, hc⟩).linear
            = (linOf G[c].n).comp iota.linear from g'_linear s t ⟨c, hc⟩ gi.n o]
      exact hind
    · exact hactive ⟨b, hb⟩ (by rw [getElem_fin_eq]; exact hgb)
    · exact hactive ⟨c, hc⟩ (by rw [getElem_fin_eq]; exact hgc)

name: gi_zero_imp_onPlane
proof:
:= by
  rw [onPlane, hgi]
  show (gi.eval p == 0) = true

name: vertexSet_to_facetVert
statement:
theorem vertexSet_to_facetVert (s t : Triangle) {i : Nat} {gi : Half}
    (hgi : (Gfun s t)[i]? = some gi) (houter : 0 < (gOf gi) 0)
    (hdim : Module.finrank ℚ
      (vectorSpan ℚ ({x : Point | (gOf gi) x = 0} ∩ Kpair s t)) = 2) (o : Point)
    {y : Plane2}
    (hy : y ∈ Proof.HpolytopeVertex.vertexSet
        (fun j : Fin (Gfun s t).size => (Gtil s t j).comp (iotaAff gi.n o))
        (iotaAff gi.n o ⁻¹' ({x : Point | (gOf gi) x = 0} ∩ Kpair s t))) :
    iotaAff gi.n o y ∈ facetVerts (Gfun s t) i
proof:
:= by
  classical
  set G := Gfun s t with hG
  have hN : gi.n ≠ 0 := by
    intro h0
    have hlin0 : (gOf gi).linear = 0 := by rw [gOf_linear, h0]; exact (linOf_eq_zero_iff 0).mpr rfl
    have hconst : ∀ x, (gOf gi) x = (gOf gi) 0 := by
      intro x
      have hvs : (gOf gi).linear (x - 0) = (gOf gi) x - (gOf gi) 0 := by
        have := AffineMap.linearMap_vsub (gOf gi) x 0; simpa [vsub_eq_sub] using this
      rw [hlin0, LinearMap.zero_apply] at hvs; linarith
    have hempty : ({x : Point | (gOf gi) x = 0} ∩ Kpair s t) = ∅ := by
      ext x; simp only [Set.mem_inter_iff, Set.mem_setOf_eq, Set.mem_empty_iff_false, iff_false]
      rintro ⟨hx, _⟩; rw [hconst x] at hx; linarith
    rw [hempty, vectorSpan_empty] at hdim; simp at hdim
  set iota := iotaAff gi.n o with hiotadef
  set Pi : Set Point := {x : Point | (gOf gi) x = 0} ∩ Kpair s t with hPidef
  obtain ⟨hyP', jx, jy, hjxnv, hjynv, hindep, hjxact, hjyact⟩ := hy
  set p := iota y with hpdef
  
  have hpPi : p ∈ Pi := hyP'
  have hpK : p ∈ Kpair s t := hpPi.2
  have hgip : (gOf gi) p = 0 := hpPi.1
  
  have hgjx : (gOf G[jx]) p = 0 := by
    have : ((Gtil s t jx).comp iota) y = 0 := hjxact
    rw [AffineMap.comp_apply] at this; exact this
  have hgjy : (gOf G[jy]) p = 0 := by
    have : ((Gtil s t jy).comp iota) y = 0 := hjyact
    rw [AffineMap.comp_apply] at this; exact this
  
  have hindep' : LinearIndependent ℚ
      ![(linOf G[jx].n).comp iota.linear, (linOf G[jy].n).comp iota.linear] := by
    have he : (![((Gtil s t jx).comp iota).linear, ((Gtil s t jy).comp iota).linear] : Fin 2 → _)
        = ![(linOf G[jx].n).comp iota.linear, (linOf G[jy].n).comp iota.linear] := by
      funext k; fin_cases k
      · exact g'_linear s t jx gi.n o
      · exact g'_linear s t jy gi.n o
    rw [he] at hindep; exact hindep
  have hdet : det3 G[jx].n G[jy].n gi.n ≠ 0 := lift_vertex_triple hN o G[jx].n G[jy].n hindep'
  
  have hisize : i < G.size := by
    rw [Array.getElem?_eq_some_iff] at hgi; exact hgi.choose
  have hgi_eq : G[i]'hisize = gi := by
    rw [Array.getElem?_eq_some_iff] at hgi; exact hgi.choose_spec
  have hjxy : (jx : Nat) ≠ (jy : Nat) := by
    intro he
    have hjj : jx = jy := Fin.ext he
    rw [hjj] at hindep
    rw [LinearIndependent.pair_iff] at hindep
    obtain ⟨ha, _⟩ := hindep 1 (-1) (by simp)
    exact one_ne_zero ha
  
  have hijx : i ≠ (jx : Nat) := by
    intro he
    apply hdet
    have hjxi : jx = ⟨i, hisize⟩ := Fin.ext he.symm
    have hg : G[jx].n = gi.n := by rw [hjxi]; show (G[i]'hisize).n = gi.n; rw [hgi_eq]
    calc det3 G[jx].n G[jy].n gi.n = det3 gi.n G[jy].n gi.n := by rw [hg]
      _ = 0 := det3_self02 _ _
  have hijy : i ≠ (jy : Nat) := by
    intro he
    apply hdet
    have hjyi : jy = ⟨i, hisize⟩ := Fin.ext he.symm
    have hg : G[jy].n = gi.n := by rw [hjyi]; show (G[i]'hisize).n = gi.n; rw [hgi_eq]
    calc det3 G[jx].n G[jy].n gi.n = det3 G[jx].n gi.n gi.n := by rw [hg]
      _ = 0 := det3_self12 _ _
  
  have hpa_jx : dotQ G[jx].n p = G[jx].c := (gOf_eq_zero_iff _ _).mp hgjx
  have hpa_jy : dotQ G[jy].n p = G[jy].c := (gOf_eq_zero_iff _ _).mp hgjy
  have hpa_i : dotQ (G[i]'hisize).n p = (G[i]'hisize).c := by
    rw [hgi_eq]; exact (gOf_eq_zero_iff _ _).mp hgip
  
  have hdetI : det3 G[jx].n G[jy].n (G[i]'hisize).n ≠ 0 := by rw [hgi_eq]; exact hdet
  
  have hpfeas : feasible G p = true := K_imp_feasible s t gi houter hdim hpK
  
  have hpverts : p ∈ verts G :=
    three_active_in_verts jx.2 jy.2 hisize hjxy
      (by exact fun h => hijx h.symm) (by exact fun h => hijy h.symm)
      hdetI hpa_jx hpa_jy hpa_i hpfeas
  rw [mem_facetVerts]
  exact ⟨hpverts, gi_zero_imp_onPlane s t hgi hgip⟩

name: cell_eq_iInter_gAug
proof:
:= by
  classical
  obtain ⟨hs, ht⟩ := both_tetra_nondeg s t gi houter hdim
  have hKHrep : Kpair s t = ⋂ g ∈ Gfun s t, {x : Point | 0 ≤ gOf g x} :=
    K_Hrep_mem s t hs ht
  ext x
  rw [Set.mem_inter_iff, Set.mem_iInter]
  simp only [Set.mem_setOf_eq]
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨hx0, hxK⟩ j
    refine Fin.addCases ?_ ?_ j
    · intro j'
      show 0 ≤ gAug s t gi (Fin.castAdd 2 j') x
      rw [gAug, Fin.append_left]
      rw [hKHrep, Set.mem_iInter₂] at hxK
      exact hxK (Gfun s t)[j'] (Array.getElem_mem j'.2)
    · intro j'
      show 0 ≤ gAug s t gi (Fin.natAdd (Gfun s t).size j') x
      rw [gAug, Fin.append_right]
      fin_cases j'
      · show 0 ≤ (gOf gi) x; rw [hx0]
      · show 0 ≤ (-(gOf gi)) x; show 0 ≤ -((gOf gi) x); rw [hx0]; simp
  · intro h
    refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
    · have h1 := h (Fin.natAdd (Gfun s t).size 0)
      have h2 := h (Fin.natAdd (Gfun s t).size 1)
      rw [gAug, Fin.append_right] at h1 h2
      simp only [Matrix.cons_val_zero, Matrix.cons_val_one, Matrix.head_cons] at h1 h2
      have h2' : (0 : ℚ) ≤ -((gOf gi) x) := h2
      linarith
    · rw [hKHrep, Set.mem_iInter₂]
      intro g hg
      obtain ⟨k, hk, rfl⟩ := Array.mem_iff_getElem.mp hg
      have := h (Fin.castAdd 2 ⟨k, hk⟩)
      rw [gAug, Fin.append_left] at this
      exact this

name: gAug_castAdd
statement:
theorem gAug_castAdd (s t : Triangle) (gi : Half) (j : Fin (Gfun s t).size) :
    gAug s t gi (Fin.castAdd 2 j) = Gtil s t j
proof: := by rw [gAug, Fin.append_left]

name: gi_pullback_vacuous
statement:
theorem gi_pullback_vacuous {N o : Point} (_hN : N ≠ 0)
    (f : Point →ᵃ[ℚ] ℚ) (hf : f.linear = linOf N) :
    ¬ Proof.HpolytopeVertex.NonVacuous (f.comp (iotaAff N o))
proof:
:= by
  rw [Proof.HpolytopeVertex.NonVacuous, not_not]
  show f.linear.comp (iotaAff N o).linear = 0
  rw [hf, iotaAff_linear]
  rw [← LinearMap.range_le_ker_iff]
  exact range_Lframe_le_ker N

name: neg_gi_pullback_vacuous
statement:
theorem neg_gi_pullback_vacuous {N o : Point} (_hN : N ≠ 0)
    (f : Point →ᵃ[ℚ] ℚ) (hf : f.linear = linOf N) :
    ¬ Proof.HpolytopeVertex.NonVacuous ((-f).comp (iotaAff N o))
proof:
:= by
  rw [Proof.HpolytopeVertex.NonVacuous, not_not]
  show (-f).linear.comp (iotaAff N o).linear = 0
  have : (-f).linear = - f.linear := rfl
  rw [this, hf, iotaAff_linear]
  rw [show (- linOf N).comp (Lframe (planeFrame N).1 (planeFrame N).2)
        = - ((linOf N).comp (Lframe (planeFrame N).1 (planeFrame N).2)) from rfl]
  rw [show ((linOf N).comp (Lframe (planeFrame N).1 (planeFrame N).2)) = 0 from by
    rw [← LinearMap.range_le_ker_iff]; exact range_Lframe_le_ker N]
  simp

name: nonvacuous_aug_imp_castAdd
proof:
:= by
  revert hnv
  refine Fin.addCases (fun j' => ?_) (fun j' => ?_) j
  · exact fun _ => ⟨j', rfl⟩
  · intro hnv'
    exfalso
    rw [gAug, Fin.append_right] at hnv'
    fin_cases j'
    · simp only [Matrix.cons_val_zero] at hnv'
      exact gi_pullback_vacuous (N := N) hN (gOf gi)
        (by rw [gOf_linear, hNgi]) hnv'
    · simp only [Matrix.cons_val_one, Matrix.head_cons] at hnv'
      exact neg_gi_pullback_vacuous (N := N) hN (gOf gi)
        (by rw [gOf_linear, hNgi]) hnv'

name: gAug_comp_castAdd
statement:
theorem gAug_comp_castAdd (s t : Triangle) (gi : Half) (N o : Point) (j : Fin (Gfun s t).size) :
    (gAug s t gi (Fin.castAdd 2 j)).comp (iotaAff N o)
      = (Gtil s t j).comp (iotaAff N o)

  rw [gAug_castAdd]

name: facetVert_to_vertexSet_aug
statement:
theorem facetVert_to_vertexSet_aug (s t : Triangle) {i : Nat} {gi : Half}
    (hgi : (Gfun s t)[i]? = some gi) (houter : 0 < (gOf gi) 0)
    (hdim : Module.finrank ℚ
      (vectorSpan ℚ ({x : Point | (gOf gi) x = 0} ∩ Kpair s t)) = 2) (o : Point)
    {p : Point} (hp : p ∈ facetVerts (Gfun s t) i)
    (hpfix : iotaAff gi.n o (iotaInvAff gi.n o p) = p) :
    iotaInvAff gi.n o p ∈
      Proof.HpolytopeVertex.vertexSet
        (fun j => (gAug s t gi j).comp (iotaAff gi.n o))
        (iotaAff gi.n o ⁻¹' ({x : Point | (gOf gi) x = 0} ∩ Kpair s t))
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨hyP', jx, jy, hjxnv, hjynv, hindep, hjxact, hjyact⟩ :=
    facetVert_to_vertexSet s t hgi houter hdim o hp hpfix
  refine ⟨hyP', Fin.castAdd 2 jx, Fin.castAdd 2 jy, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · simp only [gAug_comp_castAdd]; exact hjxnv
  · simp only [gAug_comp_castAdd]; exact hjynv
  · simp only [gAug_comp_castAdd]; exact hindep
  · simp only [gAug_comp_castAdd]; exact hjxact
  · simp only [gAug_comp_castAdd]; exact hjyact

name: vertexSet_aug_to_facetVert
statement:
theorem vertexSet_aug_to_facetVert (s t : Triangle) {i : Nat} {gi : Half}
    (hgi : (Gfun s t)[i]? = some gi) (houter : 0 < (gOf gi) 0)
    (hdim : Module.finrank ℚ
      (vectorSpan ℚ ({x : Point | (gOf gi) x = 0} ∩ Kpair s t)) = 2) (o : Point)
    (hN : gi.n ≠ 0) {y : Plane2}
    (hy : y ∈ Proof.HpolytopeVertex.vertexSet
        (fun j => (gAug s t gi j).comp (iotaAff gi.n o))
        (iotaAff gi.n o ⁻¹' ({x : Point | (gOf gi) x = 0} ∩ Kpair s t))) :
    iotaAff gi.n o y ∈ facetVerts (Gfun s t) i
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨hyP', jx, jy, hjxnv, hjynv, hindep, hjxact, hjyact⟩ := hy
  
  obtain ⟨jx', rfl⟩ := nonvacuous_aug_imp_castAdd s t rfl hN hjxnv
  obtain ⟨jy', rfl⟩ := nonvacuous_aug_imp_castAdd s t rfl hN hjynv
  
  refine vertexSet_to_facetVert s t hgi houter hdim o ⟨hyP', jx', jy', ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · have := hjxnv; simp only [gAug_comp_castAdd] at this; exact this
  · have := hjynv; simp only [gAug_comp_castAdd] at this; exact this
  · have := hindep; simp only [gAug_comp_castAdd] at this; exact this
  · have := hjxact; simp only [gAug_comp_castAdd] at this; exact this
  · have := hjyact; simp only [gAug_comp_castAdd] at this; exact this

name: computed_fan_cover_of_data
statement:
theorem computed_fan_cover_of_data
    (gℓ : Point →ᵃ[ℚ] ℚ) (houter : 0 < gℓ 0)
    (iota : Plane2 →ᵃ[ℚ] Point) (hiotaLin : Function.Injective iota.linear)
    (iotaInv : Point →ᵃ[ℚ] Plane2) (hiotaInv : ∀ y : Plane2, iotaInv (iota y) = y)
    (P : Set Point) (hconv : Convex ℚ P) (hbdd : ∃ (tB : Triangle), P ⊆ simplex tB)
    (honplane : ∀ x ∈ P, gℓ x = 0)
    (P' : Set Plane2) (hPP' : iota '' P' = P)
    {k : ℕ} (g' : Fin k → (Plane2 →ᵃ[ℚ] ℚ)) (hP'eq : P' = ⋂ j, {y | 0 ≤ g' j y})
    (V : Finset Plane2) (hVeq : P' = convexHull ℚ (↑V : Set Plane2))
    (hVP : (↑V : Set Plane2) ⊆ P')
    (hext : ∀ v ∈ V, v ∈ Set.extremePoints ℚ P')
    (hcoll : ∀ a ∈ V, ∀ b ∈ V, ∀ cc ∈ V, a ≠ b → a ≠ cc → b ≠ cc →
      AffineIndependent ℚ ![a, b, cc])
    (rr : ℕ) (hr : 3 ≤ rr) (uu : ℕ → Point)
    (huu : ∀ n, n < rr → iota (iotaInv (uu n)) = uu n)
    (hmem : ∀ n, n < rr → iotaInv (uu n) ∈ V)
    (henum : ∀ v ∈ V, ∃ j, j < rr ∧ iotaInv (uu j) = v)
    (hnodup : ∀ a b, a < rr → b < rr → a ≠ b → iotaInv (uu a) ≠ iotaInv (uu b))
    {c : Plane2}
    (hcfeas : ∀ j, Proof.HpolytopeVertex.NonVacuous (g' j) → 0 < g' j c)
    (hMc : ∀ a, a < rr → 0 < Proof.CrossProduct.cross (iotaInv (uu a) - c) (iotaInv (uu ((a + 1) % rr)) - c))
    (hconsec : ∀ a, a < rr → ∀ w ∈ V, w ≠ iotaInv (uu a) → w ≠ iotaInv (uu ((a + 1) % rr)) →
      ¬ (0 < Proof.CrossProduct.cross (iotaInv (uu a) - c) (w - c)
          ∧ 0 < Proof.CrossProduct.cross (w - c) (iotaInv (uu ((a + 1) % rr)) - c))) :
    3 ≤ rr
      ∧ P = ⋃ kk ∈ Finset.range (rr - 2),
              convexHull ℚ {uu 0, uu (kk + 1), uu (kk + 2)}
      ∧ (∀ kk ∈ Finset.range (rr - 2),
          AffineIndependent ℚ ![(0 : Point), uu 0, uu (kk + 1), uu (kk + 2)])
      ∧ (∀ a ∈ Finset.range (rr - 2), ∀ b ∈ Finset.range (rr - 2), a ≠ b →
          (convexHull ℚ {uu 0, uu (a + 1), uu (a + 2)}
            ∩ convexHull ℚ {uu 0, uu (b + 1), uu (b + 2)})
          ⊆ ⋃ kk ∈ Finset.range (rr - 2),
              (convexHull ℚ {uu 0, uu (kk + 1)} ∪ convexHull ℚ {uu (kk + 1), uu (kk + 2)}))
proof:
:= by
  classical
  
  set u' : ℕ → Plane2 := fun n => iotaInv (uu n) with hu'
  
  have hidx : ∀ kk, kk < rr - 2 → (kk + 2 < rr) := by intro kk hkk; omega
  
  obtain ⟨hwnondeg, hwcover, hwdisj⟩ :=
    Proof.ConvexPolygonFan.exit_cell_fan_of_data
      iota hiotaLin iotaInv hiotaInv P hconv hbdd P' hPP' g' hP'eq V hVeq hVP
      hext hcoll rr hr u' hmem henum hnodup hcfeas hMc hconsec
  
  have hiu : ∀ n, n < rr → iota (u' n) = uu n := by
    intro n hn; simpa [hu'] using huu n hn
  refine ⟨hr, ?_cover, ?_nondeg, ?_disj⟩
  · 
    rw [hwcover]
    apply Set.iUnion_congr; intro kk
    apply Set.iUnion_congr; intro hkk
    rw [Finset.mem_range] at hkk
    have h0 : iota (u' 0) = uu 0 := hiu 0 (by omega)
    have h1 : iota (u' (kk + 1)) = uu (kk + 1) := hiu (kk + 1) (by have := hidx kk hkk; omega)
    have h2 : iota (u' (kk + 2)) = uu (kk + 2) := hiu (kk + 2) (hidx kk hkk)
    rw [h0, h1, h2]
  · 
    intro kk hkk
    have hkk' := hkk
    rw [Finset.mem_range] at hkk'
    have h0 : iota (u' 0) = uu 0 := hiu 0 (by omega)
    have h1 : iota (u' (kk + 1)) = uu (kk + 1) := hiu (kk + 1) (by have := hidx kk hkk'; omega)
    have h2 : iota (u' (kk + 2)) = uu (kk + 2) := hiu (kk + 2) (hidx kk hkk')
    have hbase : AffineIndependent ℚ ![uu 0, uu (kk + 1), uu (kk + 2)] := by
      have := hwnondeg kk hkk
      rwa [h0, h1, h2] at this
    
    have hin0 : uu 0 ∈ P := by rw [← h0]; rw [← hPP']; exact ⟨u' 0, hVP (hmem 0 (by omega)), rfl⟩
    have hin1 : uu (kk + 1) ∈ P := by
      rw [← h1]; rw [← hPP']
      exact ⟨u' (kk + 1), hVP (hmem (kk + 1) (by have := hidx kk hkk'; omega)), rfl⟩
    have hin2 : uu (kk + 2) ∈ P := by
      rw [← h2]; rw [← hPP']
      exact ⟨u' (kk + 2), hVP (hmem (kk + 2) (hidx kk hkk')), rfl⟩
    exact Proof.SimWinding.affineIndependent_origin_apex gℓ houter
      (honplane _ hin0) (honplane _ hin1) (honplane _ hin2) hbase
  · 
    
    have htri : ∀ kk, kk < rr - 2 →
        Proof.ConvexPolygonFan.fanTri (fun n => iota (u' n)) kk
          = convexHull ℚ {uu 0, uu (kk + 1), uu (kk + 2)} := by
      intro kk hkk
      have hk0 : iota (u' 0) = uu 0 := hiu 0 (by omega)
      have hk1 : iota (u' (kk + 1)) = uu (kk + 1) := hiu (kk + 1) (by have := hidx kk hkk; omega)
      have hk2 : iota (u' (kk + 2)) = uu (kk + 2) := hiu (kk + 2) (hidx kk hkk)
      simp only [Proof.ConvexPolygonFan.fanTri, hk0, hk1, hk2]
    have hedges : Proof.ConvexPolygonFan.fanEdges rr (fun n => iota (u' n))
        = ⋃ kk ∈ Finset.range (rr - 2),
            (convexHull ℚ {uu 0, uu (kk + 1)} ∪ convexHull ℚ {uu (kk + 1), uu (kk + 2)}) := by
      simp only [Proof.ConvexPolygonFan.fanEdges]
      apply Set.iUnion_congr; intro kk
      apply Set.iUnion_congr; intro hkk
      rw [Finset.mem_range] at hkk
      have hk0 : iota (u' 0) = uu 0 := hiu 0 (by omega)
      have hk1 : iota (u' (kk + 1)) = uu (kk + 1) := hiu (kk + 1) (by have := hidx kk hkk; omega)
      have hk2 : iota (u' (kk + 2)) = uu (kk + 2) := hiu (kk + 2) (hidx kk hkk)
      rw [hk0, hk1, hk2]
    intro a ha b hb hab
    have hwd := hwdisj a ha b hb hab
    rw [Finset.mem_range] at ha hb
    rw [htri a ha, htri b hb, hedges] at hwd
    exact hwd

name: gi_n_ne_zero
statement:
theorem gi_n_ne_zero (s t : Triangle) {gi : Half}
    (houter : 0 < (gOf gi) 0)
    (hdim : Module.finrank ℚ
      (vectorSpan ℚ ({x : Point | (gOf gi) x = 0} ∩ Kpair s t)) = 2) :
    gi.n ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  intro h0
  have hlin0 : (gOf gi).linear = 0 := by rw [gOf_linear, h0]; exact (linOf_eq_zero_iff 0).mpr rfl
  have hconst : ∀ x, (gOf gi) x = (gOf gi) 0 := by
    intro x
    have hvs : (gOf gi).linear (x - 0) = (gOf gi) x - (gOf gi) 0 := by
      have := AffineMap.linearMap_vsub (gOf gi) x 0; simpa [vsub_eq_sub] using this
    rw [hlin0, LinearMap.zero_apply] at hvs
    linarith
  have hempty : ({x : Point | (gOf gi) x = 0} ∩ Kpair s t) = ∅ := by
    ext x; simp only [Set.mem_inter_iff, Set.mem_setOf_eq, Set.mem_empty_iff_false, iff_false]
    rintro ⟨hx, _⟩; rw [hconst x] at hx; linarith
  rw [hempty, vectorSpan_empty] at hdim; simp at hdim

name: facetVert_mem_cell
statement:
theorem facetVert_mem_cell (s t : Triangle) {i : Nat} {gi : Half}
    (hgi : (Gfun s t)[i]? = some gi) (houter : 0 < (gOf gi) 0)
    (hdim : Module.finrank ℚ
      (vectorSpan ℚ ({x : Point | (gOf gi) x = 0} ∩ Kpair s t)) = 2)
    {p : Point} (hp : p ∈ facetVerts (Gfun s t) i) :
    p ∈ ({x : Point | (gOf gi) x = 0} ∩ Kpair s t)
proof:
:= by
  rw [mem_facetVerts] at hp
  obtain ⟨hpverts, hponplane⟩ := hp
  have hgip : (gOf gi) p = 0 := onPlane_imp_gi_zero s t hgi hponplane
  rw [mem_verts] at hpverts
  obtain ⟨hpfeas, _, _, _, _, _, _, _⟩ := hpverts
  exact ⟨hgip, feasible_imp_K s t gi houter hdim hpfeas⟩

name: cell_data_bundle
statement:
theorem cell_data_bundle (s t : Triangle) {i : Nat} {gi : Half}
    (hgi : (Gfun s t)[i]? = some gi) (houter : 0 < (gOf gi) 0)
    (hdim : Module.finrank ℚ
      (vectorSpan ℚ ({x : Point | (gOf gi) x = 0} ∩ Kpair s t)) = 2)
    {o : Point} (hoPi : o ∈ ({x : Point | (gOf gi) x = 0} ∩ Kpair s t)) :
    ∃ (iota : Plane2 →ᵃ[ℚ] Point) (iotaInv : Point →ᵃ[ℚ] Plane2)
      (gf : Fin ((Gfun s t).size + 2) → (Plane2 →ᵃ[ℚ] ℚ)) (Pq : Set Plane2)
      (V : Finset Plane2),
      iota = iotaAff gi.n o
      ∧ iotaInv = iotaInvAff gi.n o
      ∧ V = ((facetVerts (Gfun s t) i).toList.map iotaInv).toFinset
      ∧ Function.Injective iota.linear
      ∧ (∀ y : Plane2, iotaInv (iota y) = y)
      ∧ Pq = ⋂ j, {y | 0 ≤ gf j y}
      ∧ iota '' Pq = ({x : Point | (gOf gi) x = 0} ∩ Kpair s t)
      ∧ (∀ p ∈ ({x : Point | (gOf gi) x = 0} ∩ Kpair s t), iota (iotaInv p) = p)
      ∧ (∀ p ∈ facetVerts (Gfun s t) i, p ∈ ({x : Point | (gOf gi) x = 0} ∩ Kpair s t))
      ∧ (↑V : Set Plane2) = Proof.HpolytopeVertex.vertexSet gf Pq
      ∧ Pq = convexHull ℚ (↑V : Set Plane2)
      ∧ (↑V : Set Plane2) ⊆ Pq
      ∧ (∀ v ∈ V, v ∈ Set.extremePoints ℚ Pq)
      ∧ (∀ a ∈ V, ∀ b ∈ V, ∀ cc ∈ V, a ≠ b → a ≠ cc → b ≠ cc →
          AffineIndependent ℚ ![a, b, cc])
      ∧ 3 ≤ V.card
proof:
:= by
  classical
  set Pi : Set Point := {x : Point | (gOf gi) x = 0} ∩ Kpair s t with hPidef
  set iota := iotaAff gi.n o with hiotadef
  set iotaInv := iotaInvAff gi.n o with hiotaInvdef
  set gf : Fin ((Gfun s t).size + 2) → (Plane2 →ᵃ[ℚ] ℚ) :=
    fun j => (gAug s t gi j).comp iota with hgfdef
  set Pq : Set Plane2 := iota ⁻¹' Pi with hPqdef0
  set V : Finset Plane2 := ((facetVerts (Gfun s t) i).toList.map iotaInv).toFinset with hVdef
  have hN : gi.n ≠ 0 := gi_n_ne_zero s t houter hdim
  have hcellint : Pi = ⋂ j, {x | 0 ≤ gAug s t gi j x} := cell_eq_iInter_gAug s t hgi houter hdim
  have hcellplane : ∀ p ∈ Pi, ∀ q ∈ Pi, linOf gi.n (p - q) = 0 := cell_on_plane gi s t
  obtain ⟨g', Pq', hinj, hrange, hinv, hPqdef, hg'eq, hiotaPq, hdim'⟩ :=
    iotaAff_plane_iso (gAug s t gi) Pi gi.n o hcellint hoPi hN hcellplane hdim
  have hg'gf : g' = gf := by funext j; rw [hg'eq]
  
  have hPq'pre : Pq' = Pq := by
    rw [hPqdef, hPqdef0]; ext y
    simp only [Set.mem_iInter, Set.mem_setOf_eq, Set.mem_preimage]
    rw [hcellint, Set.mem_iInter]; simp only [Set.mem_setOf_eq]
    constructor
    · intro h j; have := h j; rw [hg'eq j] at this; simpa [AffineMap.comp_apply] using this
    · intro h j; rw [hg'eq j]; simpa [AffineMap.comp_apply] using h j
  have hPqeq : Pq = ⋂ j, {y | 0 ≤ gf j y} := by rw [← hPq'pre, hPqdef, hg'gf]
  have hiotaPq2 : iota '' Pq = Pi := by rw [← hPq'pre]; exact hiotaPq
  have hPisub : Pi ⊆ Set.range iota := by rw [hrange]; exact subset_affineSpan ℚ Pi
  have hpfix : ∀ p ∈ Pi, iota (iotaInv p) = p := by
    intro p hp; obtain ⟨y, rfl⟩ := hPisub hp; rw [hinv]
  have hfvPi : ∀ p ∈ facetVerts (Gfun s t) i, p ∈ Pi :=
    fun p hp => facetVert_mem_cell s t hgi houter hdim hp
  have hVcoe : (↑V : Set Plane2) = iotaInv '' {p : Point | p ∈ facetVerts (Gfun s t) i} := by
    rw [hVdef, List.coe_toFinset]
    ext y; simp only [Set.mem_setOf_eq, List.mem_map, Array.mem_toList, Set.mem_image]
  have hVvert : (↑V : Set Plane2) = Proof.HpolytopeVertex.vertexSet gf Pq := by
    rw [hVcoe, hPqdef0]
    apply Set.Subset.antisymm
    · rintro y ⟨p, hp, rfl⟩
      exact facetVert_to_vertexSet_aug s t hgi houter hdim o hp (hpfix p (hfvPi p hp))
    · intro y hy
      have hyf := vertexSet_aug_to_facetVert s t hgi houter hdim o hN hy
      exact ⟨iota y, hyf, by rw [hinv]⟩
  
  have hbdd_Pi : ∃ tB : Triangle, Pi ⊆ simplex tB := cell_bdd (gOf gi) s t
  have hbox : ∃ (R : ℚ), Pq ⊆ {y | |y 0| ≤ R ∧ |y 1| ≤ R} :=
    Proof.ConvexPolygonFan.bounded_box_of_simplex_bound iota iotaInv hinv Pq Pi hiotaPq2 hbdd_Pi
  have hdimPq : Module.finrank ℚ (vectorSpan ℚ Pq) = 2 := by rw [← hPq'pre]; exact hdim'
  have hHV : Pq = convexHull ℚ (Proof.HpolytopeVertex.vertexSet gf Pq) :=
    Proof.HpolytopeVertex.hpolytope_eq_convexHull_vertexSet gf Pq hPqeq hbox hdimPq
  have hVeq : Pq = convexHull ℚ (↑V : Set Plane2) := by rw [hVvert]; exact hHV
  have hVP : (↑V : Set Plane2) ⊆ Pq := by rw [hVvert]; intro x hx; exact hx.1
  have hext : ∀ v ∈ V, v ∈ Set.extremePoints ℚ Pq := by
    intro v hv
    have : v ∈ Proof.HpolytopeVertex.vertexSet gf Pq := by rw [← hVvert]; exact hv
    exact Proof.HpolytopeVertex.vertex_mem_extremePoints gf Pq hPqeq this
  have hcoll : ∀ a ∈ V, ∀ b ∈ V, ∀ cc ∈ V, a ≠ b → a ≠ cc → b ≠ cc →
      AffineIndependent ℚ ![a, b, cc] := by
    intro a ha b hb cc hcc hab hacc hbcc
    have haV : a ∈ Proof.HpolytopeVertex.vertexSet gf Pq := by rw [← hVvert]; exact ha
    have hbV : b ∈ Proof.HpolytopeVertex.vertexSet gf Pq := by rw [← hVvert]; exact hb
    have hccV : cc ∈ Proof.HpolytopeVertex.vertexSet gf Pq := by rw [← hVvert]; exact hcc
    exact Proof.HpolytopeVertex.vertices_not_collinear gf Pq hPqeq haV hbV hccV hab hacc hbcc
  have hcard : 3 ≤ V.card := by
    have hnc := Proof.HpolytopeVertex.three_le_vertexSet_ncard gf Pq hPqeq hbox hdimPq
    have heq : (Proof.HpolytopeVertex.vertexSet gf Pq).ncard = V.card := by
      rw [← hVvert, Set.ncard_coe_Finset]
    rw [heq] at hnc; exact hnc
  exact ⟨iota, iotaInv, gf, Pq, V, hiotadef, hiotaInvdef, hVdef, hinj, hinv, hPqeq, hiotaPq2,
    hpfix, hfvPi, hVvert, hVeq, hVP, hext, hcoll, hcard⟩

name: sorted_merge_restricted_nodup
statement:
theorem sorted_merge_restricted_nodup {α : Type*} (le : α → α → Bool) :
    ∀ (l₁ l₂ : List α),
    (l₁ ++ l₂).Nodup →
    (∀ a ∈ l₁ ++ l₂, ∀ b ∈ l₁ ++ l₂, ∀ c ∈ l₁ ++ l₂, a ≠ b → b ≠ c → a ≠ c →
        le a b → le b c → le a c) →
    (∀ a ∈ l₁ ++ l₂, ∀ b ∈ l₁ ++ l₂, a ≠ b → le a b || le b a) →
    l₁.Pairwise (fun a b => le a b = true) →
    l₂.Pairwise (fun a b => le a b = true) →
    (List.merge l₁ l₂ le).Pairwise (fun a b => le a b = true)
  | [], l₂, _, _, _, _, h₂ => by simpa only [List.merge] using h₂
  | x :: l₁, [], _, _, _, h₁, _ => by simpa only [List.merge] using h₁
  | x :: l₁, y :: l₂, hnd, htrans, htotal, h₁, h₂ => by
    have hndA
proof:
:= List.nodup_append.mp hnd
    have hmemxL : x ∈ (x :: l₁) ++ (y :: l₂) := List.mem_append_left _ (List.mem_cons_self _ _)
    have hmemyL : y ∈ (x :: l₁) ++ (y :: l₂) := List.mem_append_right _ (List.mem_cons_self _ _)
    have hxy : x ≠ y := fun he => by
      subst he; exact hndA.2.2 (List.mem_cons_self _ _) (List.mem_cons_self _ _)
    simp only [List.merge]
    split <;> rename_i h
    · apply List.Pairwise.cons
      · intro z m
        rw [List.mem_merge, List.mem_cons] at m
        rcases m with (m|rfl|m)
        · exact List.rel_of_pairwise_cons h₁ m
        · exact h
        · have hmemzL : z ∈ (x :: l₁) ++ (y :: l₂) :=
            List.mem_append_right _ (List.mem_cons_of_mem _ m)
          have hxz : x ≠ z := fun he => by
            subst he; exact hndA.2.2 (List.mem_cons_self _ _) (List.mem_cons_of_mem _ m)
          have hyz : y ≠ z := fun he => by
            subst he; exact (List.nodup_cons.mp hndA.2.1).1 m
          refine htrans x hmemxL y hmemyL z hmemzL hxy hyz hxz h
            (List.rel_of_pairwise_cons h₂ m)
      · 
        have hsub : ∀ a ∈ l₁ ++ (y :: l₂), a ∈ (x :: l₁) ++ (y :: l₂) := by
          intro a ha
          rcases List.mem_append.mp ha with h' | h'
          · exact List.mem_append_left _ (List.mem_cons_of_mem _ h')
          · exact List.mem_append_right _ h'
        refine sorted_merge_restricted_nodup le l₁ (y :: l₂) ?_ ?_ ?_ h₁.tail h₂
        · rw [List.nodup_append]
          exact ⟨hndA.1.of_cons, hndA.2.1, fun a ha => hndA.2.2 (List.mem_cons_of_mem _ ha)⟩
        · intro a ha b hb c hc hab hbc hac
          exact htrans a (hsub a ha) b (hsub b hb) c (hsub c hc) hab hbc hac
        · intro a ha b hb hab; exact htotal a (hsub a ha) b (hsub b hb) hab
    · apply List.Pairwise.cons
      · intro z m
        rw [List.mem_merge, List.mem_cons] at m
        simp only [Bool.not_eq_true] at h
        rcases m with (⟨rfl|m⟩|m)
        · have := htotal y hmemyL z hmemxL (Ne.symm hxy); simpa [h] using this
        · have hmemzL : z ∈ (x :: l₁) ++ (y :: l₂) :=
            List.mem_append_left _ (List.mem_cons_of_mem _ m)
          have hxz : x ≠ z := fun he => by
            subst he; exact (List.nodup_cons.mp hndA.1).1 m
          have hyz : y ≠ z := fun he => by
            subst he; exact hndA.2.2 (List.mem_cons_of_mem _ m) (List.mem_cons_self _ _)
          have hyx : le y x := by
            have := htotal x hmemxL y hmemyL hxy; simpa [h] using this
          refine htrans y hmemyL x hmemxL z hmemzL (Ne.symm hxy) hxz hyz hyx
            (List.rel_of_pairwise_cons h₁ m)
        · exact List.rel_of_pairwise_cons h₂ m
      · 
        have hsub : ∀ a ∈ (x :: l₁) ++ l₂, a ∈ (x :: l₁) ++ (y :: l₂) := by
          intro a ha
          rcases List.mem_append.mp ha with h' | h'
          · exact List.mem_append_left _ h'
          · exact List.mem_append_right _ (List.mem_cons_of_mem _ h')
        refine sorted_merge_restricted_nodup le (x :: l₁) l₂ ?_ ?_ ?_ h₁ h₂.tail
        · rw [List.nodup_append]
          refine ⟨hndA.1, hndA.2.1.of_cons, ?_⟩
          intro a ha hb; exact hndA.2.2 ha (List.mem_cons_of_mem _ hb)
        · intro a ha b hb c hc hab hbc hac
          exact htrans a (hsub a ha) b (hsub b hb) c (hsub c hc) hab hbc hac
        · intro a ha b hb hab; exact htotal a (hsub a ha) b (hsub b hb) hab

name: sorted_mergeSort_restricted_nodup
statement:
theorem sorted_mergeSort_restricted_nodup {α : Type*} (le : α → α → Bool) :
    ∀ (l : List α),
    l.Nodup →
    (∀ a ∈ l, ∀ b ∈ l, ∀ c ∈ l, a ≠ b → b ≠ c → a ≠ c → le a b → le b c → le a c) →
    (∀ a ∈ l, ∀ b ∈ l, a ≠ b → le a b || le b a) →
    (List.mergeSort l le).Pairwise (fun a b => le a b = true)
  | [], _, _, _ => by simp [List.mergeSort]
  | [a], _, _, _ => by simp [List.mergeSort]
  | a :: b :: xs, hnd, htrans, htotal => by
    rw [List.mergeSort]
    set h1
proof:
:= (List.splitInTwo ⟨a :: b :: xs, rfl⟩).1.1 with hh1
    set h2 := (List.splitInTwo ⟨a :: b :: xs, rfl⟩).2.1 with hh2
    have happ : h1 ++ h2 = a :: b :: xs :=
      List.splitInTwo_fst_append_splitInTwo_snd ⟨a :: b :: xs, rfl⟩
    have hndapp : (h1 ++ h2).Nodup := by rw [happ]; exact hnd
    have hmem1 : ∀ x ∈ h1, x ∈ a :: b :: xs := by
      intro x hx; rw [← happ, List.mem_append]; exact Or.inl hx
    have hmem2 : ∀ x ∈ h2, x ∈ a :: b :: xs := by
      intro x hx; rw [← happ, List.mem_append]; exact Or.inr hx
    have hnd1 : h1.Nodup := (List.nodup_append.mp hndapp).1
    have hnd2 : h2.Nodup := (List.nodup_append.mp hndapp).2.1
    have hs1 : (List.mergeSort h1 le).Pairwise (fun a b => le a b = true) :=
      sorted_mergeSort_restricted_nodup le h1 hnd1
        (fun x hx y hy z hz => htrans x (hmem1 x hx) y (hmem1 y hy) z (hmem1 z hz))
        (fun x hx y hy => htotal x (hmem1 x hx) y (hmem1 y hy))
    have hs2 : (List.mergeSort h2 le).Pairwise (fun a b => le a b = true) :=
      sorted_mergeSort_restricted_nodup le h2 hnd2
        (fun x hx y hy z hz => htrans x (hmem2 x hx) y (hmem2 y hy) z (hmem2 z hz))
        (fun x hx y hy => htotal x (hmem2 x hx) y (hmem2 y hy))
    have hperm1 : (List.mergeSort h1 le).Perm h1 := List.mergeSort_perm h1 le
    have hperm2 : (List.mergeSort h2 le).Perm h2 := List.mergeSort_perm h2 le
    have hndMS : (List.mergeSort h1 le ++ List.mergeSort h2 le).Nodup := by
      have : (List.mergeSort h1 le ++ List.mergeSort h2 le).Perm (h1 ++ h2) :=
        (hperm1.append hperm2)
      exact this.nodup_iff.mpr hndapp
    have hmemMS : ∀ x ∈ (List.mergeSort h1 le) ++ (List.mergeSort h2 le), x ∈ a :: b :: xs := by
      intro x hx; rw [List.mem_append] at hx
      rcases hx with hx | hx
      · exact hmem1 x (by rwa [List.mem_mergeSort] at hx)
      · exact hmem2 x (by rwa [List.mem_mergeSort] at hx)
    exact sorted_merge_restricted_nodup le (List.mergeSort h1 le) (List.mergeSort h2 le) hndMS
      (fun x hx y hy z hz => htrans x (hmemMS x hx) y (hmemMS y hy) z (hmemMS z hz))
      (fun x hx y hy => htotal x (hmemMS x hx) y (hmemMS y hy)) hs1 hs2
  termination_by l => l.length
  decreasing_by
  · simp only [hh1, List.splitInTwo_fst, List.length_take, List.length_cons]; omega
  · simp only [hh2, List.splitInTwo_snd, List.length_drop, List.length_cons]; omega

name: rr_c_eq_size
statement: theorem rr_c_eq_size (G : Array Half) (i : Nat) : rr_c G i = (facetVerts G i).size
proof:
:= by
  unfold rr_c Usort
  simp only [Array.size_toArray, List.length_mergeSort, Array.length_toList]

name: Usort_perm
statement:
theorem Usort_perm (G : Array Half) (i : Nat) :
    (Usort G i).toList.Perm (facetVerts G i).toList
proof:
:= by
  unfold Usort; simp only [Array.toList_toArray]; exact List.mergeSort_perm _ _

name: nodup_Usort
statement: theorem nodup_Usort (G : Array Half) (i : Nat) : (Usort G i).toList.Nodup
