:=
  (Usort_perm G i).nodup_iff.mpr (nodup_facetVerts G i)

name: uu_c_getElem
statement:
theorem uu_c_getElem (G : Array Half) (i n : Nat) (h : n < rr_c G i) :
    uu_c G i n = (Usort G i).toList[n]'(by rw [Array.length_toList]; exact h)
proof:
:= by
  unfold uu_c
  rw [Array.getD_eq_get? _ _ _, Array.getElem?_eq_getElem (show n < (Usort G i).size from h)]
  simp [Array.getElem_toList]

name: uu_c_mem_facetVerts
statement:
theorem uu_c_mem_facetVerts (G : Array Half) (i n : Nat) (h : n < rr_c G i) :
    uu_c G i n ∈ facetVerts G i
proof:
:= by
  have hn : n < (Usort G i).size := h
  have : uu_c G i n ∈ Usort G i := by
    unfold uu_c
    rw [Array.getD_eq_get? _ _ _, Array.getElem?_eq_getElem hn]; simp only [Option.getD_some]
    exact Array.getElem_mem hn
  rw [← Array.mem_toList] at this ⊢; exact (Usort_perm G i).mem_iff.mp this

name: uu_c_ne
statement:
theorem uu_c_ne (G : Array Half) (i a b : Nat) (ha : a < rr_c G i) (hb : b < rr_c G i)
    (hab : a ≠ b) : uu_c G i a ≠ uu_c G i b
proof:
:= by
  rw [uu_c_getElem G i a ha, uu_c_getElem G i b hb]
  intro heq
  rw [List.Nodup.getElem_inj_iff (nodup_Usort G i)] at heq
  exact hab heq

name: centroid_affine_sum
statement:
theorem centroid_affine_sum {r : ℕ} (g : Plane2 →ᵃ[ℚ] ℚ) (c : Plane2) (u : ℕ → Plane2)
    (hr0 : (0:ℚ) < r) (hcent : (r:ℚ) • c = ∑ j ∈ Finset.range r, u j) :
    (r:ℚ) * g c = ∑ k ∈ Finset.range r, g (u k)
proof:
:= by
  have hkey : g c - g (u 0) = g.linear (c - u 0) :=
    (Proof.HpolytopeVertex.affine_linear_sub g c (u 0)).symm
  have hcu : (r:ℚ) • (c - u 0) = (∑ k ∈ Finset.range r, (u k - u 0)) := by
    rw [Finset.sum_sub_distrib, Finset.sum_const, Finset.card_range, ← hcent, smul_sub,
      Nat.cast_smul_eq_nsmul]
    simp [Nat.cast_smul_eq_nsmul]
  have hcu2 : c - u 0 = (r:ℚ)⁻¹ • (∑ k ∈ Finset.range r, (u k - u 0)) := by
    rw [← hcu, smul_smul, inv_mul_cancel₀ (ne_of_gt hr0), one_smul]
  rw [hcu2, map_smul, smul_eq_mul] at hkey
  have hsumlin : g.linear (∑ k ∈ Finset.range r, (u k - u 0))
      = ∑ k ∈ Finset.range r, (g (u k) - g (u 0)) := by
    rw [map_sum]; apply Finset.sum_congr rfl; intro k _
    rw [Proof.HpolytopeVertex.affine_linear_sub]
  rw [hsumlin, Finset.sum_sub_distrib, Finset.sum_const, Finset.card_range, nsmul_eq_mul] at hkey
  have hrne : (r:ℚ) ≠ 0 := ne_of_gt hr0
  field_simp at hkey
  linarith [hkey]

name: centroid_feasible
statement:
theorem centroid_feasible {m r : ℕ} (g : Fin m → (Plane2 →ᵃ[ℚ] ℚ))
    (P' : Set Plane2) (hP' : P' = ⋂ i, {y | 0 ≤ g i y})
    (V : Finset Plane2) (hVeq : P' = convexHull ℚ (↑V : Set Plane2))
    (hcoll : ∀ a ∈ V, ∀ b ∈ V, ∀ cc ∈ V, a ≠ b → a ≠ cc → b ≠ cc →
      AffineIndependent ℚ ![a, b, cc])
    (hr : 3 ≤ r) (u : ℕ → Plane2)
    (hmem : ∀ i, i < r → u i ∈ V)
    (hnodup : ∀ i j, i < r → j < r → i ≠ j → u i ≠ u j)
    {c : Plane2} (hcent : (r : ℚ) • c = ∑ j ∈ Finset.range r, u j) :
    ∀ j, Proof.HpolytopeVertex.NonVacuous (g j) → 0 < g j c
proof:
:= by
  intro j hnv
  have hr0 : (0:ℚ) < r := by exact_mod_cast (show 0 < r by omega)
  have hge : ∀ k, k < r → 0 ≤ g j (u k) := by
    intro k hk
    have : u k ∈ P' := by rw [hVeq]; exact subset_convexHull ℚ _ (hmem k hk)
    rw [hP'] at this; simpa using Set.mem_iInter.mp this j
  have hgc := centroid_affine_sum (g j) c u hr0 hcent
  have hnotall : ∃ k, k < r ∧ g j (u k) ≠ 0 := by
    by_contra hcon; push_neg at hcon
    apply hnv
    have z0 := hcon 0 (by omega); have z1 := hcon 1 (by omega); have z2 := hcon 2 (by omega)
    have hai : AffineIndependent ℚ ![u 0, u 1, u 2] :=
      hcoll _ (hmem 0 (by omega)) _ (hmem 1 (by omega)) _ (hmem 2 (by omega))
        (hnodup 0 1 (by omega) (by omega) (by omega))
        (hnodup 0 2 (by omega) (by omega) (by omega))
        (hnodup 1 2 (by omega) (by omega) (by omega))
    have hdet : Proof.CrossProduct.cross (u 1 - u 0) (u 2 - u 0) ≠ 0 :=
      Proof.CyclicOrder.cross_ne_zero_of_affineIndependent hai
    have l1 : (g j).linear (u 1 - u 0) = 0 := by
      rw [Proof.HpolytopeVertex.affine_linear_sub, z1, z0, sub_zero]
    have l2 : (g j).linear (u 2 - u 0) = 0 := by
      rw [Proof.HpolytopeVertex.affine_linear_sub, z2, z0, sub_zero]
    apply LinearMap.ext; intro W
    rw [LinearMap.zero_apply, Proof.CyclicOrder.cramer (u 1 - u 0) (u 2 - u 0) W hdet,
      map_add, map_smul, map_smul, l1, l2, smul_zero, smul_zero, add_zero]
  obtain ⟨k0, hk0, hk0ne⟩ := hnotall
  have hsum_pos : 0 < ∑ k ∈ Finset.range r, g j (u k) := by
    have hpos : 0 < g j (u k0) := lt_of_le_of_ne (hge k0 hk0) (Ne.symm hk0ne)
    rw [← Finset.add_sum_erase _ _ (Finset.mem_range.mpr hk0)]
    have hrest : 0 ≤ ∑ k ∈ (Finset.range r).erase k0, g j (u k) :=
      Finset.sum_nonneg (fun k hk => hge k (Finset.mem_range.mp (Finset.mem_of_mem_erase hk)))
    linarith
  exact (mul_pos_iff_of_pos_left hr0).mp (hgc ▸ hsum_pos)

name: three_le_rr_c
statement:
theorem three_le_rr_c (s t : Triangle) {i : Nat} {gi : Half}
    (hgi : (Gfun s t)[i]? = some gi) (houter : 0 < (gOf gi) 0)
    (hdim : Module.finrank ℚ
      (vectorSpan ℚ ({x : Point | (gOf gi) x = 0} ∩ Kpair s t)) = 2) :
    3 ≤ rr_c (Gfun s t) i
proof:
:= by
  classical
  obtain ⟨o0, ho0⟩ : ({x : Point | (gOf gi) x = 0} ∩ Kpair s t).Nonempty := by
    rcases ({x : Point | (gOf gi) x = 0} ∩ Kpair s t).eq_empty_or_nonempty with he | hne
    · rw [he, vectorSpan_empty] at hdim; simp at hdim
    · exact hne
  obtain ⟨iota0, iotaInv0, gf0, Pq0, V0, _, _, hV0eq, _, _, _, _, hpfix0, hfv0, _, _, _, _, _,
    hcard0⟩ := cell_data_bundle s t hgi houter hdim ho0
  have hVcard : V0.card = (facetVerts (Gfun s t) i).size := by
    rw [hV0eq, List.toFinset_card_of_nodup, List.length_map, Array.length_toList]
    apply List.Nodup.map_on ?_ (nodup_facetVerts (Gfun s t) i)
    intro a ha b hb hab
    rw [Array.mem_toList] at ha hb
    have e1 := hpfix0 a (hfv0 a ha)
    have e2 := hpfix0 b (hfv0 b hb)
    rw [← e1, ← e2, hab]
  rw [rr_c_eq_size, ← hVcard]; exact hcard0

name: dotQ_eq_dotProduct
statement: theorem dotQ_eq_dotProduct (u v : Point) : dotQ u v = u ⬝ᵥ v
proof:
:= by
  rw [dotQ_eq_sum, dotProduct]

name: centroid2_coord0
statement:
theorem centroid2_coord0 (qs : Array (Fin 2 → ℚ)) :
    centroid2 qs 0 = ((qs.toList.map (· 0)).sum) / (qs.size : ℚ)
proof:
:= by
  show mkVec2 _ _ 0 = _
  rw [mkVec2, if_pos rfl, ← Array.foldl_toList, ← List.sum_eq_foldl, Array.toList_map]

name: centroid2_coord1
statement:
theorem centroid2_coord1 (qs : Array (Fin 2 → ℚ)) :
    centroid2 qs 1 = ((qs.toList.map (· 1)).sum) / (qs.size : ℚ)
proof:

  show mkVec2 _ _ 1 = _

name: iotaInv_sub_centroid_coord
statement:
theorem iotaInv_sub_centroid_coord {e1 e2 o : Point}
    (_he1 : (e1 ⬝ᵥ e1) ≠ 0) (_he2 : (e2 ⬝ᵥ e2) ≠ 0)
    {c : Plane2} {ctr0 ctr1 : ℚ}
    (hc0 : c 0 = (ctr0 - e1 ⬝ᵥ o) / (e1 ⬝ᵥ e1))
    (hc1 : c 1 = (ctr1 - e2 ⬝ᵥ o) / (e2 ⬝ᵥ e2)) (p : Point) :
    (Mframe e1 e2 (p - o) - c) 0 = (e1 ⬝ᵥ p - ctr0) / (e1 ⬝ᵥ e1)
    ∧ (Mframe e1 e2 (p - o) - c) 1 = (e2 ⬝ᵥ p - ctr1) / (e2 ⬝ᵥ e2)
proof:
:= by
  have h0 : (Mframe e1 e2 (p - o)) 0 = (e1 ⬝ᵥ p - e1 ⬝ᵥ o) / (e1 ⬝ᵥ e1) := by
    rw [show (Mframe e1 e2 (p - o)) 0 = coordFun e1 (p - o) from rfl, coordFun_apply,
      dotProduct_sub]
  have h1 : (Mframe e1 e2 (p - o)) 1 = (e2 ⬝ᵥ p - e2 ⬝ᵥ o) / (e2 ⬝ᵥ e2) := by
    rw [show (Mframe e1 e2 (p - o)) 1 = coordFun e2 (p - o) from rfl, coordFun_apply,
      dotProduct_sub]
  refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
  · rw [Pi.sub_apply, h0, hc0]; field_simp; ring
  · rw [Pi.sub_apply, h1, hc1]; field_simp; ring

name: uu_c_sum_eq
statement:
theorem uu_c_sum_eq (G : Array Half) (i : Nat) (f : Point → ℚ) :
    ∑ j ∈ Finset.range (rr_c G i), f (uu_c G i j)
      = ((facetVerts G i).toList.map f).sum
proof:
:= by
  have step1 : ∑ j ∈ Finset.range (rr_c G i), f (uu_c G i j)
      = ((Usort G i).toList.map f).sum := by
    have hlen : (rr_c G i) = (Usort G i).toList.length := by rw [Array.length_toList]; rfl
    rw [Finset.sum_range, ← List.sum_ofFn]
    congr 1
    apply List.ext_getElem
    · rw [List.length_ofFn, List.length_map, ← hlen]
    · intro n h1 h2
      rw [List.getElem_ofFn, List.getElem_map]
      congr 1
      rw [uu_c_getElem G i n (by rw [hlen] at h1; simpa using h1)]
  rw [step1]
  exact List.Perm.sum_eq ((Usort_perm G i).map f)

name: centroid_coord
statement:
theorem centroid_coord (G : Array Half) (i : Nat) {e1 e2 o : Point}
    (he1 : (e1 ⬝ᵥ e1) ≠ 0) (he2 : (e2 ⬝ᵥ e2) ≠ 0) (hrrpos : 0 < rr_c G i)
    {u' : ℕ → Plane2} (hu' : ∀ n, u' n = Mframe e1 e2 (uu_c G i n - o))
    {c : Plane2} (hc : c = (rr_c G i : ℚ)⁻¹ • (∑ j ∈ Finset.range (rr_c G i), u' j))
    {ctr : Plane2} (hctr : ctr = centroid2 ((facetVerts G i).map (piProj e1 e2))) :
    c 0 = (ctr 0 - e1 ⬝ᵥ o) / (e1 ⬝ᵥ e1) ∧ c 1 = (ctr 1 - e2 ⬝ᵥ o) / (e2 ⬝ᵥ e2)
proof:
:= by
  set rr := rr_c G i with hrr
  have hrrQ : (rr : ℚ) ≠ 0 := by
    have : 0 < rr := hrrpos
    exact_mod_cast this.ne'
  have hsize : ((facetVerts G i).size : ℚ) = (rr : ℚ) := by rw [hrr, rr_c_eq_size]
  have hmain : ∀ (e : Point) (k : Fin 2), (e ⬝ᵥ e) ≠ 0 →
      ctr k = ((facetVerts G i).toList.map (fun p => e ⬝ᵥ p)).sum / (rr : ℚ) →
      (∀ j, u' j k = (e ⬝ᵥ (uu_c G i j) - e ⬝ᵥ o) / (e ⬝ᵥ e)) →
      c k = (ctr k - e ⬝ᵥ o) / (e ⬝ᵥ e) := by
    intro e k he hctrk hu'k
    have hck : c k = (rr : ℚ)⁻¹ * ∑ j ∈ Finset.range rr, (u' j k) := by
      rw [hc]; show (rr:ℚ)⁻¹ • (∑ j ∈ Finset.range rr, u' j) k = _
      rw [Finset.sum_apply, smul_eq_mul]
    rw [hck]; simp_rw [hu'k]; rw [hctrk]
    rw [← Finset.sum_div, Finset.sum_sub_distrib, Finset.sum_const, Finset.card_range,
      nsmul_eq_mul, uu_c_sum_eq G i (fun p => e ⬝ᵥ p)]
    field_simp
  refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
  · apply hmain e1 0 he1
    · rw [hctr, centroid2_coord0, Array.size_map, Array.toList_map, List.map_map, hsize]
      rw [show ((fun (x : Fin 2 → ℚ) => x 0) ∘ piProj e1 e2) = (fun p => e1 ⬝ᵥ p) from ?_]
      funext p; show piProj e1 e2 p 0 = e1 ⬝ᵥ p
      rw [piProj, mkVec2, if_pos rfl, dotQ_eq_dotProduct]
    · intro j; rw [hu' j]
      show (Mframe e1 e2 (uu_c G i j - o)) 0 = _
      rw [show (Mframe e1 e2 (uu_c G i j - o)) 0 = coordFun e1 (uu_c G i j - o) from rfl,
        coordFun_apply, dotProduct_sub]
  · apply hmain e2 1 he2
    · rw [hctr, centroid2_coord1, Array.size_map, Array.toList_map, List.map_map, hsize]
      rw [show ((fun (x : Fin 2 → ℚ) => x 1) ∘ piProj e1 e2) = (fun p => e2 ⬝ᵥ p) from ?_]
      funext p; show piProj e1 e2 p 1 = e2 ⬝ᵥ p
      rw [piProj, mkVec2, if_neg (by decide), dotQ_eq_dotProduct]
    · intro j; rw [hu' j]
      show (Mframe e1 e2 (uu_c G i j - o)) 1 = _
      rw [show (Mframe e1 e2 (uu_c G i j - o)) 1 = coordFun e2 (uu_c G i j - o) from rfl,
        coordFun_apply, dotProduct_sub]

name: psub2_piProj_coord0
statement:
theorem psub2_piProj_coord0 (e1 e2 : Point) (ctr : Plane2) (p : Point) :
    (psub2 (piProj e1 e2 p) ctr) 0 = e1 ⬝ᵥ p - ctr 0
proof:
:= by
  show piProj e1 e2 p 0 - ctr 0 = _
  rw [piProj, mkVec2, if_pos rfl, dotQ_eq_dotProduct]

name: psub2_piProj_coord1
statement:
theorem psub2_piProj_coord1 (e1 e2 : Point) (ctr : Plane2) (p : Point) :
    (psub2 (piProj e1 e2 p) ctr) 1 = e2 ⬝ᵥ p - ctr 1
proof:
:= by
  show piProj e1 e2 p 1 - ctr 1 = _
  rw [piProj, mkVec2, if_neg (by decide), dotQ_eq_dotProduct]

name: cross2_eq_cross
statement: theorem cross2_eq_cross (a b : Plane2) : cross2 a b = Proof.CrossProduct.cross a b
proof:
:= by
  rw [cross2]; rfl

name: iotaInv_sub_eq_scaled
statement:
theorem iotaInv_sub_eq_scaled {e1 e2 o : Point}
    (he1 : (e1 ⬝ᵥ e1) ≠ 0) (he2 : (e2 ⬝ᵥ e2) ≠ 0)
    {c ctr : Plane2}
    (hc0 : c 0 = (ctr 0 - e1 ⬝ᵥ o) / (e1 ⬝ᵥ e1))
    (hc1 : c 1 = (ctr 1 - e2 ⬝ᵥ o) / (e2 ⬝ᵥ e2)) (p : Point) :
    (Mframe e1 e2 (p - o) - c) 0 = (psub2 (piProj e1 e2 p) ctr) 0 / (e1 ⬝ᵥ e1)
    ∧ (Mframe e1 e2 (p - o) - c) 1 = (psub2 (piProj e1 e2 p) ctr) 1 / (e2 ⬝ᵥ e2)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨h0, h1⟩ := iotaInv_sub_centroid_coord he1 he2 hc0 hc1 p
  rw [psub2_piProj_coord0, psub2_piProj_coord1]
  exact ⟨h0, h1⟩

name: upperHalf_iff_upper
statement:
theorem upperHalf_iff_upper {e1 e2 o : Point}
    (he1 : 0 < (e1 ⬝ᵥ e1)) (he2 : 0 < (e2 ⬝ᵥ e2))
    {c ctr : Plane2}
    (hc0 : c 0 = (ctr 0 - e1 ⬝ᵥ o) / (e1 ⬝ᵥ e1))
    (hc1 : c 1 = (ctr 1 - e2 ⬝ᵥ o) / (e2 ⬝ᵥ e2)) (p : Point) :
    Proof.CyclicOrder.upperHalf c (Mframe e1 e2 (p - o))
      ↔ upper (psub2 (piProj e1 e2 p) ctr) = true
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨h0, h1⟩ := iotaInv_sub_eq_scaled he1.ne' he2.ne' hc0 hc1 p
  set A := psub2 (piProj e1 e2 p) ctr with hA
  have hupd : upper A = true ↔ (0 < A 1 ∨ (A 1 = 0 ∧ 0 < A 0)) := by
    rw [upper]
    simp only [Bool.or_eq_true, Bool.and_eq_true, decide_eq_true_eq, beq_iff_eq]
  rw [hupd]
  unfold Proof.CyclicOrder.upperHalf
  rw [Pi.sub_apply, Pi.sub_apply, ← Pi.sub_apply, ← Pi.sub_apply, h0, h1]
  constructor
  · rintro (hgt | ⟨heq0, hgt0⟩)
    · left; rw [div_pos_iff] at hgt; rcases hgt with ⟨hp, _⟩ | ⟨hn, hd⟩
      · exact hp
      · exact absurd he2 (by linarith)
    · right
      have hAz : A 1 = 0 := by
        have := heq0; rw [div_eq_zero_iff] at this; rcases this with h | h
        · exact h
        · exact absurd h he2.ne'
      refine ⟨hAz, ?_⟩
      rw [div_pos_iff] at hgt0; rcases hgt0 with ⟨hp, _⟩ | ⟨hn, hd⟩
      · exact hp
      · exact absurd he1 (by linarith)
  · rintro (hgt | ⟨hAz, hgt0⟩)
    · left; rw [div_pos_iff]; left; exact ⟨hgt, he2⟩
    · right; refine ⟨by rw [hAz, zero_div], ?_⟩
      rw [div_pos_iff]; left; exact ⟨hgt0, he1⟩

name: cross_scaled_eq
statement:
theorem cross_scaled_eq {e1 e2 o : Point}
    (he1 : (e1 ⬝ᵥ e1) ≠ 0) (he2 : (e2 ⬝ᵥ e2) ≠ 0)
    {c ctr : Plane2}
    (hc0 : c 0 = (ctr 0 - e1 ⬝ᵥ o) / (e1 ⬝ᵥ e1))
    (hc1 : c 1 = (ctr 1 - e2 ⬝ᵥ o) / (e2 ⬝ᵥ e2)) (p q : Point) :
    Proof.CrossProduct.cross (Mframe e1 e2 (p - o) - c) (Mframe e1 e2 (q - o) - c)
      = ((e1 ⬝ᵥ e1) * (e2 ⬝ᵥ e2))⁻¹
        * cross2 (psub2 (piProj e1 e2 p) ctr) (psub2 (piProj e1 e2 q) ctr)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨hp0, hp1⟩ := iotaInv_sub_eq_scaled he1 he2 hc0 hc1 p
  obtain ⟨hq0, hq1⟩ := iotaInv_sub_eq_scaled he1 he2 hc0 hc1 q
  rw [show Proof.CrossProduct.cross (Mframe e1 e2 (p - o) - c) (Mframe e1 e2 (q - o) - c)
        = (Mframe e1 e2 (p - o) - c) 0 * (Mframe e1 e2 (q - o) - c) 1
          - (Mframe e1 e2 (p - o) - c) 1 * (Mframe e1 e2 (q - o) - c) 0 from rfl]
  rw [hp0, hp1, hq0, hq1, cross2]
  field_simp; ring

name: cell_fan_data
statement:
theorem cell_fan_data (s t : Triangle)
    {i : ℕ} {gi : Half} (hgi : (Gfun s t)[i]? = some gi)
    (houter : 0 < (gOf gi) 0)
    (hdim : Module.finrank ℚ
      (vectorSpan ℚ ({x : Point | (gOf gi) x = 0} ∩ Kpair s t)) = 2) :
    ∃ (iota : Plane2 →ᵃ[ℚ] Point) (iotaInv : Point →ᵃ[ℚ] Plane2)
      (P' : Set Plane2) (m : ℕ) (g' : Fin m → (Plane2 →ᵃ[ℚ] ℚ))
      (V : Finset Plane2) (c : Plane2),
      Function.Injective iota.linear
      ∧ (∀ y : Plane2, iotaInv (iota y) = y)
      ∧ (∀ x ∈ ({x : Point | (gOf gi) x = 0} ∩ Kpair s t), (gOf gi) x = 0)
      ∧ iota '' P' = ({x : Point | (gOf gi) x = 0} ∩ Kpair s t)
      ∧ P' = ⋂ j, {y | 0 ≤ g' j y}
      ∧ P' = convexHull ℚ (↑V : Set Plane2)
      ∧ (↑V : Set Plane2) ⊆ P'
      ∧ (∀ v ∈ V, v ∈ Set.extremePoints ℚ P')
      ∧ (∀ a ∈ V, ∀ b ∈ V, ∀ cc ∈ V, a ≠ b → a ≠ cc → b ≠ cc →
          AffineIndependent ℚ ![a, b, cc])
      ∧ 3 ≤ rr_c (Gfun s t) i
      ∧ (∀ n, n < rr_c (Gfun s t) i →
          iota (iotaInv (uu_c (Gfun s t) i n)) = uu_c (Gfun s t) i n)
      ∧ (∀ n, n < rr_c (Gfun s t) i → iotaInv (uu_c (Gfun s t) i n) ∈ V)
      ∧ (∀ v ∈ V, ∃ j, j < rr_c (Gfun s t) i ∧ iotaInv (uu_c (Gfun s t) i j) = v)
      ∧ (∀ a b, a < rr_c (Gfun s t) i → b < rr_c (Gfun s t) i → a ≠ b →
          iotaInv (uu_c (Gfun s t) i a) ≠ iotaInv (uu_c (Gfun s t) i b))
      ∧ (∀ j, Proof.HpolytopeVertex.NonVacuous (g' j) → 0 < g' j c)
      ∧ (∀ a, a < rr_c (Gfun s t) i →
          0 < Proof.CrossProduct.cross
            (iotaInv (uu_c (Gfun s t) i a) - c)
            (iotaInv (uu_c (Gfun s t) i ((a + 1) % rr_c (Gfun s t) i)) - c))
      ∧ (∀ a, a < rr_c (Gfun s t) i → ∀ w ∈ V,
          w ≠ iotaInv (uu_c (Gfun s t) i a) →
          w ≠ iotaInv (uu_c (Gfun s t) i ((a + 1) % rr_c (Gfun s t) i)) →
          ¬ (0 < Proof.CrossProduct.cross (iotaInv (uu_c (Gfun s t) i a) - c) (w - c)
              ∧ 0 < Proof.CrossProduct.cross (w - c)
                  (iotaInv (uu_c (Gfun s t) i ((a + 1) % rr_c (Gfun s t) i)) - c)))
proof:
:= by
  classical
  set Pi : Set Point := {x : Point | (gOf gi) x = 0} ∩ Kpair s t with hPidef
  have hrr3 : 3 ≤ rr_c (Gfun s t) i := three_le_rr_c s t hgi houter hdim
  
  set o : Point := uu_c (Gfun s t) i 0 with hodef
  have hoFV : o ∈ facetVerts (Gfun s t) i := uu_c_mem_facetVerts (Gfun s t) i 0 (by omega)
  have hoPi : o ∈ Pi := facetVert_mem_cell s t hgi houter hdim hoFV
  
  obtain ⟨iota, iotaInv, gf, Pq, V, hiotaeq, hiotaInveq, hVeqdef, hinj, hinv, hPqeq, hiotaPq2,
    hpfix, hfvPi, hVvert, hVeq, hVP, hext, hcoll, hcard⟩ :=
    cell_data_bundle s t hgi houter hdim hoPi
  
  set u' : ℕ → Plane2 := fun n => iotaInv (uu_c (Gfun s t) i n) with hu'
  set rr : ℕ := rr_c (Gfun s t) i with hrr
  
  have hmem : ∀ n, n < rr → u' n ∈ V := by
    intro n hn
    rw [hVeqdef, List.mem_toFinset, List.mem_map]
    exact ⟨uu_c (Gfun s t) i n, by rw [Array.mem_toList]; exact uu_c_mem_facetVerts _ i n hn, rfl⟩
  
  have hnodup : ∀ a b, a < rr → b < rr → a ≠ b → u' a ≠ u' b := by
    intro a b ha hb hab heq
    exact uu_c_ne (Gfun s t) i a b ha hb hab
      (by have e1 := hpfix _ (hfvPi _ (uu_c_mem_facetVerts (Gfun s t) i a ha))
          have e2 := hpfix _ (hfvPi _ (uu_c_mem_facetVerts (Gfun s t) i b hb))
          rw [← e1, ← e2]; exact congrArg iota heq)
  
  have henum : ∀ v ∈ V, ∃ j, j < rr ∧ u' j = v := by
    intro v hv
    rw [hVeqdef, List.mem_toFinset, List.mem_map] at hv
    obtain ⟨p, hp, rfl⟩ := hv
    rw [Array.mem_toList] at hp
    have hpU : p ∈ Usort (Gfun s t) i := by
      rw [← Array.mem_toList]
      exact (Usort_perm (Gfun s t) i).mem_iff.mpr (by rw [Array.mem_toList]; exact hp)
    rw [← Array.mem_toList, List.mem_iff_getElem] at hpU
    obtain ⟨j, hj, hjp⟩ := hpU
    have hjr : j < rr := by rw [Array.length_toList] at hj; exact hj
    exact ⟨j, hjr, by show iotaInv (uu_c (Gfun s t) i j) = _; rw [uu_c_getElem (Gfun s t) i j hjr, hjp]⟩
  
  set c : Plane2 := (rr : ℚ)⁻¹ • (∑ j ∈ Finset.range rr, u' j) with hcdef
  have hrrpos : (0:ℚ) < rr := by exact_mod_cast (show 0 < rr by omega)
  have hcent : (rr : ℚ) • c = ∑ j ∈ Finset.range rr, u' j := by
    rw [hcdef, smul_smul, mul_inv_cancel₀ (ne_of_gt hrrpos), one_smul]
  
  have hcfeas : ∀ j, Proof.HpolytopeVertex.NonVacuous (gf j) → 0 < gf j c :=
    centroid_feasible gf Pq hPqeq V hVeq hcoll hrr3 u' hmem hnodup hcent
  
  
  
  have hN : gi.n ≠ 0 := gi_n_ne_zero s t houter hdim
  set e1 := (planeFrame gi.n).1 with he1def
  set e2 := (planeFrame gi.n).2 with he2def
  have hfr : frame_c (Gfun s t) i = (e1, e2) := by unfold frame_c; rw [hgi]
  have he1ne : e1 ≠ 0 := by rw [he1def, frame_c_fst]; exact frame_e1_ne_zero hN
  have he2ne : e2 ≠ 0 := by rw [he2def, frame_c_snd]; exact frame_e2_ne_zero hN
  have he1 : 0 < e1 ⬝ᵥ e1 := dotProduct_self_pos he1ne
  have he2 : 0 < e2 ⬝ᵥ e2 := dotProduct_self_pos he2ne
  set ctr : Plane2 := centroid2 ((facetVerts (Gfun s t) i).map (piProj e1 e2)) with hctrdef
  
  have hiotaInvM : ∀ p : Point, iotaInv p = Mframe e1 e2 (p - o) := by
    intro p; rw [hiotaInveq]
    show Mframe (planeFrame gi.n).1 (planeFrame gi.n).2 (p -ᵥ o) = _; rfl
  have hu'M : ∀ n, u' n = Mframe e1 e2 (uu_c (Gfun s t) i n - o) := by
    intro n; show iotaInv (uu_c (Gfun s t) i n) = _; rw [hiotaInvM]
  
  have hrrposNat : 0 < rr_c (Gfun s t) i := by rw [← hrr]; omega
  obtain ⟨hc0, hc1⟩ := centroid_coord (Gfun s t) i he1.ne' he2.ne' hrrposNat
    (u' := fun n => Mframe e1 e2 (uu_c (Gfun s t) i n - o)) (fun n => rfl)
    (c := c)
    (by rw [hcdef, ← hrr]; congr 1; apply Finset.sum_congr rfl; intro k _; rw [hu'M k])
    (ctr := ctr) rfl
  
  have hnchalfV : ∀ a ∈ V, ∀ b ∈ V, a ≠ b →
      (Proof.CyclicOrder.upperHalf c a ↔ Proof.CyclicOrder.upperHalf c b) →
      Proof.CrossProduct.cross (a - c) (b - c) ≠ 0 := by
    intro a haV b hbV hab hiff
    obtain ⟨iA, hiA, rfl⟩ := henum a haV
    obtain ⟨iB, hiB, rfl⟩ := henum b hbV
    have hiAB : iA ≠ iB := fun he => hab (by rw [he])
    exact Proof.CyclicOrder.centroid_within_half_ne gf Pq hPqeq V hVeq hVP hext hrr3 u'
      hmem hnodup hcent hcfeas iA iB hiA hiB hiAB hiff
  
  have hbridge : ∀ p q : Point, Mframe e1 e2 (p - o) ∈ V → Mframe e1 e2 (q - o) ∈ V →
      Mframe e1 e2 (p - o) ≠ Mframe e1 e2 (q - o) →
      (angBefore (psub2 (piProj e1 e2 p) ctr) (psub2 (piProj e1 e2 q) ctr) = true
        ↔ Proof.CyclicOrder.cmp c (Mframe e1 e2 (p - o)) (Mframe e1 e2 (q - o)) = true) := by
    intro p q hpV hqV hpq
    have hupP := upperHalf_iff_upper he1 he2 hc0 hc1 p
    have hupQ := upperHalf_iff_upper he1 he2 hc0 hc1 q
    have hcrPQ := cross_scaled_eq he1.ne' he2.ne' hc0 hc1 p q
    rw [cross2_eq_cross] at hcrPQ
    have hposfac : 0 < ((e1 ⬝ᵥ e1) * (e2 ⬝ᵥ e2))⁻¹ := by positivity
    unfold angBefore
    by_cases hsame : upper (psub2 (piProj e1 e2 p) ctr) = upper (psub2 (piProj e1 e2 q) ctr)
    · rw [if_neg (by simp [hsame])]
      have hiffhalf : Proof.CyclicOrder.upperHalf c (Mframe e1 e2 (p - o)) ↔
          Proof.CyclicOrder.upperHalf c (Mframe e1 e2 (q - o)) := by rw [hupP, hupQ, hsame]
      rw [Proof.CyclicOrder.cmp_same_half c _ _ hiffhalf]
      have hne := hnchalfV _ hpV _ hqV hpq hiffhalf
      rw [decide_eq_true_eq, decide_eq_true_eq, cross2_eq_cross]
      constructor
      · intro hlt; rw [hcrPQ]; exact le_of_lt (mul_pos hposfac hlt)
      · intro hle
        have hlt : 0 < Proof.CrossProduct.cross (Mframe e1 e2 (p - o) - c) (Mframe e1 e2 (q - o) - c) :=
          lt_of_le_of_ne hle (Ne.symm hne)
        rw [hcrPQ] at hlt; exact (mul_pos_iff_of_pos_left hposfac).mp hlt
    · rw [if_pos (by simp [hsame])]
      by_cases hPup : upper (psub2 (piProj e1 e2 p) ctr) = true
      · have hQlo : ¬ (upper (psub2 (piProj e1 e2 q) ctr) = true) := by
          rw [hPup] at hsame; intro h; exact hsame h.symm
        have hPupH : Proof.CyclicOrder.upperHalf c (Mframe e1 e2 (p - o)) := hupP.mpr hPup
        have hQloH : ¬ Proof.CyclicOrder.upperHalf c (Mframe e1 e2 (q - o)) :=
          fun h => hQlo (hupQ.mp h)
        rw [Proof.CyclicOrder.cmp_up_low c _ _ hPupH hQloH]; simp [hPup]
      · rw [Bool.not_eq_true] at hPup
        have hQup : upper (psub2 (piProj e1 e2 q) ctr) = true := by
          rcases Bool.eq_false_or_eq_true (upper (psub2 (piProj e1 e2 q) ctr)) with h | h
          · exact h
          · exact absurd (hPup.trans h.symm) hsame
        have hPloH : ¬ Proof.CyclicOrder.upperHalf c (Mframe e1 e2 (p - o)) := by
          intro h; rw [hupP, hPup] at h; exact absurd h (by decide)
        have hQupH : Proof.CyclicOrder.upperHalf c (Mframe e1 e2 (q - o)) := hupQ.mpr hQup
        have hcf : Proof.CyclicOrder.cmp c (Mframe e1 e2 (p - o)) (Mframe e1 e2 (q - o)) = false := by
          unfold Proof.CyclicOrder.cmp; rw [if_neg (by tauto), if_pos ⟨hPloH, hQupH⟩]
        rw [hcf]; simp [hPup]
  
  set cmpAlg : Point → Point → Bool := fun p q =>
    angBefore (psub2 (piProj e1 e2 p) ctr) (psub2 (piProj e1 e2 q) ctr) with hcmpAlg
  
  have hfvV : ∀ p ∈ facetVerts (Gfun s t) i, Mframe e1 e2 (p - o) ∈ V := by
    intro p hp
    rw [← hiotaInvM]; rw [hVeqdef, List.mem_toFinset, List.mem_map]
    exact ⟨p, by rw [Array.mem_toList]; exact hp, rfl⟩
  
  have hfvNe : ∀ p ∈ facetVerts (Gfun s t) i, ∀ q ∈ facetVerts (Gfun s t) i, p ≠ q →
      Mframe e1 e2 (p - o) ≠ Mframe e1 e2 (q - o) := by
    intro p hp q hq hpq he
    apply hpq
    have ep := hpfix p (hfvPi p hp)
    have eq := hpfix q (hfvPi q hq)
    rw [hiotaInvM] at ep eq
    rw [← ep, ← eq, he]
  
  have hbridgeFV : ∀ p ∈ facetVerts (Gfun s t) i, ∀ q ∈ facetVerts (Gfun s t) i, p ≠ q →
      (cmpAlg p q = true ↔ Proof.CyclicOrder.cmp c (iotaInv p) (iotaInv q) = true) := by
    intro p hp q hq hpq
    rw [hiotaInvM p, hiotaInvM q]
    exact hbridge p q (hfvV p hp) (hfvV q hq) (hfvNe p hp q hq hpq)
  
  have hsortMS : (List.mergeSort (facetVerts (Gfun s t) i).toList cmpAlg).Pairwise
      (fun p q => cmpAlg p q = true) := by
    apply sorted_mergeSort_restricted_nodup cmpAlg (facetVerts (Gfun s t) i).toList
      (nodup_facetVerts (Gfun s t) i)
    · 
      intro p hp q hq w hw hpq hqw hpw hAlg1 hAlg2
      rw [Array.mem_toList] at hp hq hw
      rw [hbridgeFV p hp q hq hpq] at hAlg1
      rw [hbridgeFV q hq w hw hqw] at hAlg2
      rw [hbridgeFV p hp w hw hpw]
      have hpV : iotaInv p ∈ V := by rw [hiotaInvM p]; exact hfvV p hp
      have hqV : iotaInv q ∈ V := by rw [hiotaInvM q]; exact hfvV q hq
      have hwV : iotaInv w ∈ V := by rw [hiotaInvM w]; exact hfvV w hw
      exact Proof.CyclicOrder.cmp_trans_half hnchalfV (iotaInv p) (iotaInv q) (iotaInv w)
        hpV hqV hwV hAlg1 hAlg2
    · 
      intro p hp q hq hpq
      rw [Array.mem_toList] at hp hq
      have htot := Proof.CyclicOrder.cmp_total c (iotaInv p) (iotaInv q)
      rw [Bool.or_eq_true] at htot ⊢
      rcases htot with h | h
      · left; rw [hbridgeFV p hp q hq hpq]; exact h
      · right; rw [hbridgeFV q hq p hp (Ne.symm hpq)]; exact h
  
  have hUsortList : (Usort (Gfun s t) i).toList =
      List.mergeSort (facetVerts (Gfun s t) i).toList cmpAlg := by
    unfold Usort; simp only [Array.toList_toArray]
    rw [hcmpAlg, hctrdef, hfr]
  
  have hsorted : ∀ a b, a < b → b < rr → Proof.CyclicOrder.cmp c (u' a) (u' b) := by
    intro a b hab hbrr
    have ha : a < rr := lt_trans hab hbrr
    have hbr : b < rr := hbrr
    
    have hPair := List.pairwise_iff_get.mp hsortMS
    rw [← hUsortList] at hPair
    have hlenU : (Usort (Gfun s t) i).toList.length = rr := by
      rw [Array.length_toList]; rw [hrr]; rfl
    have haL : a < (Usort (Gfun s t) i).toList.length := by rw [hlenU]; exact ha
    have hbL : b < (Usort (Gfun s t) i).toList.length := by rw [hlenU]; exact hbr
    have hcmpab : cmpAlg ((Usort (Gfun s t) i).toList[a]) ((Usort (Gfun s t) i).toList[b]) = true :=
      hPair ⟨a, haL⟩ ⟨b, hbL⟩ (by simpa using hab)
    rw [← uu_c_getElem (Gfun s t) i a ha, ← uu_c_getElem (Gfun s t) i b hbr] at hcmpab
    
    have hpFV : uu_c (Gfun s t) i a ∈ facetVerts (Gfun s t) i := uu_c_mem_facetVerts _ i a ha
    have hqFV : uu_c (Gfun s t) i b ∈ facetVerts (Gfun s t) i := uu_c_mem_facetVerts _ i b hbr
    have hne : uu_c (Gfun s t) i a ≠ uu_c (Gfun s t) i b :=
      uu_c_ne (Gfun s t) i a b ha hbr (by omega)
    have hres := (hbridgeFV _ hpFV _ hqFV hne).mp hcmpab
    show Proof.CyclicOrder.cmp c (u' a) (u' b) = true
    exact hres
  
  obtain ⟨hMc, hconsec⟩ :=
    Proof.CyclicOrder.centroid_order_signs gf Pq hPqeq V hVeq hVP hext hcoll hrr3 u' hmem henum
      hnodup hcent hcfeas hsorted
  refine ⟨iota, iotaInv, Pq, (Gfun s t).size + 2, gf, V, c,
    hinj, hinv, fun x hx => hx.1, hiotaPq2, hPqeq, hVeq, hVP, hext, hcoll, hrr3, ?_huu,
    hmem, henum, hnodup, hcfeas, hMc, hconsec⟩
  
  intro n hn
  exact hpfix (uu_c (Gfun s t) i n) (hfvPi _ (uu_c_mem_facetVerts (Gfun s t) i n hn))

name: computed_fan_cover
statement:
theorem computed_fan_cover (s t : Triangle)
    {i : ℕ} {gi : Half} (hgi : (Gfun s t)[i]? = some gi)
    (houter : 0 < (gOf gi) 0)
    (hdim : Module.finrank ℚ
      (vectorSpan ℚ ({x : Point | (gOf gi) x = 0} ∩ Kpair s t)) = 2) :
    3 ≤ rr_c (Gfun s t) i
      ∧ ({x : Point | (gOf gi) x = 0} ∩ Kpair s t)
          = ⋃ kk ∈ Finset.range (rr_c (Gfun s t) i - 2),
              convexHull ℚ {uu_c (Gfun s t) i 0,
                            uu_c (Gfun s t) i (kk + 1), uu_c (Gfun s t) i (kk + 2)}
      ∧ (∀ kk ∈ Finset.range (rr_c (Gfun s t) i - 2),
          AffineIndependent ℚ ![(0 : Point), uu_c (Gfun s t) i 0,
            uu_c (Gfun s t) i (kk + 1), uu_c (Gfun s t) i (kk + 2)])
      ∧ (∀ a ∈ Finset.range (rr_c (Gfun s t) i - 2),
          ∀ b ∈ Finset.range (rr_c (Gfun s t) i - 2), a ≠ b →
          (convexHull ℚ {uu_c (Gfun s t) i 0,
              uu_c (Gfun s t) i (a + 1), uu_c (Gfun s t) i (a + 2)}
            ∩ convexHull ℚ {uu_c (Gfun s t) i 0,
              uu_c (Gfun s t) i (b + 1), uu_c (Gfun s t) i (b + 2)})
          ⊆ ⋃ kk ∈ Finset.range (rr_c (Gfun s t) i - 2),
              (convexHull ℚ {uu_c (Gfun s t) i 0, uu_c (Gfun s t) i (kk + 1)}
                ∪ convexHull ℚ {uu_c (Gfun s t) i (kk + 1), uu_c (Gfun s t) i (kk + 2)}))
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨iota, iotaInv, P', m, g', V, c, hiotaLin, hiotaInv, honplane, hPP', hP'eq,
    hVeq, hVP, hext, hcoll, hr, huu, hmem, henum, hnodup, hcfeas, hMc, hconsec⟩ :=
    cell_fan_data s t hgi houter hdim
  exact computed_fan_cover_of_data (gOf gi) houter iota hiotaLin iotaInv hiotaInv
    ({x : Point | (gOf gi) x = 0} ∩ Kpair s t)
    (cell_convex (gOf gi) s t) (cell_bdd (gOf gi) s t) honplane P' hPP' g' hP'eq
    V hVeq hVP hext hcoll (rr_c (Gfun s t) i) hr (uu_c (Gfun s t) i)
    huu hmem henum hnodup hcfeas hMc hconsec

name: flatMap_perm_congr
statement:
theorem flatMap_perm_congr {α β : Type*} (l : List α) (f g : α → List β)
    (hf : ∀ x ∈ l, (f x).Perm (g x)) : (l.flatMap f).Perm (l.flatMap g)
proof:
:= by
  induction l with
  | nil => simp
  | cons a tl ih =>
    simp only [List.flatMap_cons]
    exact (hf a (by simp)).append (ih (fun x hx => hf x (by simp [hx])))

name: mkPoint000_eq_zero
statement: theorem mkPoint000_eq_zero : mkPoint 0 0 0 = (0 : Point)
proof:
:= by
  funext i; fin_cases i <;> simp [mkPoint]

name: gi_eval0_iff
statement: theorem gi_eval0_iff (gi : Half) : 0 < gi.eval (mkPoint 0 0 0) ↔ 0 < (gOf gi) 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [mkPoint000_eq_zero, gOf_apply]

name: affRank3_iff
statement:
theorem affRank3_iff (vs : Array Point) :
    affRank3 vs = true ↔
      ∃ a ∈ vs, ∃ b ∈ vs, ∃ c ∈ vs, crossQ (psub b a) (psub c a) ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  unfold affRank3
  rw [Array.any_eq_true]
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨ia, ha⟩
    rw [Array.any_eq_true] at ha; obtain ⟨ib, hb⟩ := ha
    rw [Array.any_eq_true] at hb; obtain ⟨ic, hc⟩ := hb
    refine ⟨vs[ia], Array.getElem_mem ia.2, vs[ib], Array.getElem_mem ib.2,
      vs[ic], Array.getElem_mem ic.2, ?_⟩
    intro hz
    rw [Bool.not_eq_true'] at hc
    rw [show pointBEq (crossQ (psub vs[ib] vs[ia]) (psub vs[ic] vs[ia])) (mkPoint 0 0 0) = true
        from by rw [pointBEq_iff, hz, mkPoint000_eq_zero]] at hc
    exact absurd hc (by simp)
  · rintro ⟨a, ha, b, hb, c, hc, hne⟩
    rw [Array.mem_iff_getElem] at ha hb hc
    obtain ⟨ia, hia, rfl⟩ := ha; obtain ⟨ib, hib, rfl⟩ := hb; obtain ⟨ic, hic, rfl⟩ := hc
    refine ⟨⟨ia, hia⟩, ?_⟩
    rw [Array.any_eq_true]; refine ⟨⟨ib, hib⟩, ?_⟩
    rw [Array.any_eq_true]; refine ⟨⟨ic, hic⟩, ?_⟩
    rw [Bool.not_eq_true', Bool.eq_false_iff]
    intro hbeq
    rw [pointBEq_iff, mkPoint000_eq_zero] at hbeq
    exact hne hbeq

name: crossQ_ne_zero_of_affineIndependent
statement:
theorem crossQ_ne_zero_of_affineIndependent {a b c : Point}
    (h : AffineIndependent ℚ ![a, b, c]) : crossQ (psub b a) (psub c a) ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [crossQ_eq_crossProduct, psub_eq_sub, psub_eq_sub,
     crossProduct_ne_zero_iff_linearIndependent]
  rw [LinearIndependent.pair_iff]
  intro s t hst
  rw [affineIndependent_iff] at h
  have hw := h Finset.univ ![-(s + t), s, t]
    (by simp only [Fin.sum_univ_three, Matrix.cons_val_zero, Matrix.cons_val_one,
        Matrix.head_cons, Matrix.cons_val_two, Matrix.tail_cons]; ring)
    (by
      simp only [Fin.sum_univ_three, Matrix.cons_val_zero, Matrix.cons_val_one, Matrix.head_cons,
        Matrix.cons_val_two, Matrix.tail_cons]
      have he : (-(s + t)) • a + s • b + t • c = s • (b - a) + t • (c - a) := by module
      rw [he]; exact hst)
  exact ⟨hw 1 (Finset.mem_univ _), hw 2 (Finset.mem_univ _)⟩

name: coplanar_simplex_of_not_ai
statement:
theorem coplanar_simplex_of_not_ai (tt : Triangle)
    (h : ¬ AffineIndependent ℚ ![(0 : Point), tt.v₀, tt.v₁, tt.v₂]) :
    Coplanar ℚ (simplex tt)
proof:
:= by
  have hle : Module.finrank ℚ
      (vectorSpan ℚ (Set.range ![(0 : Point), tt.v₀, tt.v₁, tt.v₂])) ≤ 2 := by
    rw [finrank_vectorSpan_le_iff_not_affineIndependent ℚ _ (n := 2) (by simp)]; exact h
  have hrange : Set.range ![(0 : Point), tt.v₀, tt.v₁, tt.v₂]
      = ({0, tt.v₀, tt.v₁, tt.v₂} : Set Point) := range_vec4 _ _ _ _
  rw [hrange] at hle
  rw [show simplex tt = (convexHull ℚ) ({0, tt.v₀, tt.v₁, tt.v₂} : Set Point) from rfl,
    coplanar_iff_finrank_le_two]
  rwa [show vectorSpan ℚ ((convexHull ℚ) ({0, tt.v₀, tt.v₁, tt.v₂} : Set Point))
      = vectorSpan ℚ ({0, tt.v₀, tt.v₁, tt.v₂} : Set Point) from by
    rw [← direction_affineSpan, ← direction_affineSpan, affineSpan_convexHull]]

name: both_tetra_nondeg_of_not_coplanar
statement:
theorem both_tetra_nondeg_of_not_coplanar (s t : Triangle)
    (hco : ¬ Coplanar ℚ (Kpair s t)) :
    AffineIndependent ℚ ![(0 : Point), s.v₀, s.v₁, s.v₂]
      ∧ AffineIndependent ℚ ![(0 : Point), t.v₀, t.v₁, t.v₂]
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · by_contra h
    exact hco ((coplanar_simplex_of_not_ai s h).subset (Set.inter_subset_left))
  · by_contra h
    exact hco ((coplanar_simplex_of_not_ai t h).subset (Set.inter_subset_right))

name: feasible_imp_K'
statement:
theorem feasible_imp_K' (s t : Triangle)
    (hs : AffineIndependent ℚ ![(0 : Point), s.v₀, s.v₁, s.v₂])
    (ht : AffineIndependent ℚ ![(0 : Point), t.v₀, t.v₁, t.v₂])
    {p : Point} (hpfeas : feasible (Gfun s t) p = true) :
    p ∈ Kpair s t
proof:
:= by
  rw [Kpair, K_Hrep_mem s t hs ht, Set.mem_iInter₂]
  intro g hg
  exact (feasible_iff (Gfun s t) p).mp hpfeas g hg

name: onplane_diff_ker
statement:
theorem onplane_diff_ker (gi : Half) {p q : Point}
    (hp : (gOf gi) p = 0) (hq : (gOf gi) q = 0) : linOf gi.n (p - q) = 0
proof:
:= by
  have hlin : (gOf gi).linear (p - q) = (gOf gi) p - (gOf gi) q := by
    have := AffineMap.linearMap_vsub (gOf gi) p q
    simpa [vsub_eq_sub] using this
  rw [gOf_linear] at hlin
  rw [hlin, hp, hq, sub_zero]

name: gin_ne_zero_of_facetVert
proof:
:= by
  intro h0
  rw [mem_facetVerts] at ha
  have hgia : (gOf gi) a = 0 := onPlane_imp_gi_zero s t hgi ha.2
  have hlin0 : (gOf gi).linear = 0 := by rw [gOf_linear, h0]; exact (linOf_eq_zero_iff 0).mpr rfl
  have hconst : (gOf gi) a = (gOf gi) 0 := by
    have hvs : (gOf gi).linear (a - 0) = (gOf gi) a - (gOf gi) 0 := by
      have := AffineMap.linearMap_vsub (gOf gi) a 0; simpa [vsub_eq_sub] using this
    rw [hlin0, LinearMap.zero_apply] at hvs; linarith
  rw [hconst] at hgia; linarith

name: range_vec3
statement: theorem range_vec3 (a b c : Point) : Set.range ![a, b, c] = {a, b, c}
proof:
:= by
  ext x
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨i, rfl⟩; fin_cases i <;> simp
  · intro h; simp only [Set.mem_insert_iff, Set.mem_singleton_iff] at h
    rcases h with h | h | h <;> subst h
    exacts [⟨0, rfl⟩, ⟨1, rfl⟩, ⟨2, rfl⟩]

name: affRank3_imp_dim2
statement:
theorem affRank3_imp_dim2 (s t : Triangle) {i : Nat} {gi : Half}
    (hgi : (Gfun s t)[i]? = some gi)
    (hs : AffineIndependent ℚ ![(0 : Point), s.v₀, s.v₁, s.v₂])
    (ht : AffineIndependent ℚ ![(0 : Point), t.v₀, t.v₁, t.v₂])
    (houter : 0 < (gOf gi) 0)
    (hrk : affRank3 (facetVerts (Gfun s t) i) = true) :
    Module.finrank ℚ (vectorSpan ℚ ({x : Point | (gOf gi) x = 0} ∩ Kpair s t)) = 2
proof:
:= by
  classical
  obtain ⟨a, ha, b, hb, c, hc, hcr⟩ := (affRank3_iff _).mp hrk
  have hN : gi.n ≠ 0 := gin_ne_zero_of_facetVert s t hgi houter ha
  
  have hai : AffineIndependent ℚ ![a, b, c] := affineIndependent_of_crossQ_ne_zero hcr
  
  set Pi : Set Point := {x : Point | (gOf gi) x = 0} ∩ Kpair s t with hPidef
  have hmemPi : ∀ p ∈ facetVerts (Gfun s t) i, p ∈ Pi := by
    intro p hp
    rw [mem_facetVerts] at hp
    have hgp : (gOf gi) p = 0 := onPlane_imp_gi_zero s t hgi hp.2
    rw [mem_verts] at hp
    obtain ⟨hpfeas, _⟩ := hp.1
    exact ⟨hgp, feasible_imp_K' s t hs ht hpfeas⟩
  have haPi : a ∈ Pi := hmemPi a ha
  have hbPi : b ∈ Pi := hmemPi b hb
  have hcPi : c ∈ Pi := hmemPi c hc
  
  have hsub : (Set.range ![a, b, c]) ⊆ Pi := by
    rw [range_vec3]; intro x hx
    simp only [Set.mem_insert_iff, Set.mem_singleton_iff] at hx
    rcases hx with rfl | rfl | rfl
    exacts [haPi, hbPi, hcPi]
  have hlow : 2 ≤ Module.finrank ℚ (vectorSpan ℚ Pi) := by
    have h2 : Module.finrank ℚ (vectorSpan ℚ (Set.range ![a, b, c])) = 2 :=
      hai.finrank_vectorSpan (by simp)
    have hmono : vectorSpan ℚ (Set.range ![a, b, c]) ≤ vectorSpan ℚ Pi :=
      vectorSpan_mono ℚ hsub
    have := Submodule.finrank_mono hmono
    rw [h2] at this; exact this
  
  have hplane : ∀ p ∈ Pi, ∀ q ∈ Pi, linOf gi.n (p - q) = 0 := by
    intro p hp q hq; exact onplane_diff_ker gi hp.1 hq.1
  have hup : Module.finrank ℚ (vectorSpan ℚ Pi) ≤ 2 := by
    have hle : vectorSpan ℚ Pi ≤ LinearMap.ker (linOf gi.n) := vectorSpan_le_ker_linOf hplane
    have := Submodule.finrank_mono hle
    rw [finrank_ker_linOf hN] at this; exact this
  omega

name: dim2_imp_affRank3
statement:
theorem dim2_imp_affRank3 (s t : Triangle) {i : Nat} {gi : Half}
    (hgi : (Gfun s t)[i]? = some gi) (houter : 0 < (gOf gi) 0)
    (hdim : Module.finrank ℚ
      (vectorSpan ℚ ({x : Point | (gOf gi) x = 0} ∩ Kpair s t)) = 2) :
    affRank3 (facetVerts (Gfun s t) i) = true
proof:
:= by
  classical
  
  obtain ⟨q, hqPi, _⟩ := exists_aff_indep_triple_of_dim2 hdim
  have hoPi : q 0 ∈ ({x : Point | (gOf gi) x = 0} ∩ Kpair s t) := hqPi 0
  obtain ⟨iota, iotaInv, gf, Pq, V, hiotaeq, hiotaInveq, hVeqdef, hinj, hinv, hPqeq, hiotaPq2,
    hpfix, hfvPi, hVvert, hVeq, hVP, hext, hcoll, hcard⟩ :=
    cell_data_bundle s t hgi houter hdim hoPi
  
  obtain ⟨v1, hv1, v2, hv2, v3, hv3, h12, h13, h23⟩ :
      ∃ v1 ∈ V, ∃ v2 ∈ V, ∃ v3 ∈ V, v1 ≠ v2 ∧ v1 ≠ v3 ∧ v2 ≠ v3 := by
    obtain ⟨s3, hs3sub, hs3card⟩ := Finset.exists_subset_card_eq hcard
    rw [Finset.card_eq_three] at hs3card
    obtain ⟨v1, v2, v3, h12, h13, h23, heq⟩ := hs3card
    refine ⟨v1, hs3sub (by rw [heq]; simp), v2, hs3sub (by rw [heq]; simp),
      v3, hs3sub (by rw [heq]; simp), h12, h13, h23⟩
  
  have hVfacet : ∀ v ∈ V, iota v ∈ facetVerts (Gfun s t) i ∧ iotaInv (iota v) = v := by
    intro v hv
    rw [hVeqdef, List.mem_toFinset, List.mem_map] at hv
    obtain ⟨p, hp, rfl⟩ := hv
    rw [Array.mem_toList] at hp
    have hppi : p ∈ ({x : Point | (gOf gi) x = 0} ∩ Kpair s t) := hfvPi p hp
    refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
    · rw [hpfix p hppi]; exact hp
    · rw [hpfix p hppi]
  obtain ⟨hp1, hi1⟩ := hVfacet v1 hv1
  obtain ⟨hp2, hi2⟩ := hVfacet v2 hv2
  obtain ⟨hp3, hi3⟩ := hVfacet v3 hv3
  
  have haiV : AffineIndependent ℚ ![v1, v2, v3] := hcoll v1 hv1 v2 hv2 v3 hv3 h12 h13 h23
  
  have hiotaInjective : Function.Injective iota := by
    intro x y hxy
    have : iotaInv (iota x) = iotaInv (iota y) := by rw [hxy]
    rwa [hinv, hinv] at this
  have haiP : AffineIndependent ℚ ![iota v1, iota v2, iota v3] := by
    have := haiV.map' iota hiotaInjective
    have hcongr : (iota ∘ ![v1, v2, v3]) = ![iota v1, iota v2, iota v3] := by
      funext k; fin_cases k <;> rfl
    rwa [hcongr] at this
  
  have hcr : crossQ (psub (iota v2) (iota v1)) (psub (iota v3) (iota v1)) ≠ 0 :=
    crossQ_ne_zero_of_affineIndependent haiP
  rw [affRank3_iff]
  exact ⟨iota v1, hp1, iota v2, hp2, iota v3, hp3, hcr⟩

name: Gtil_gOf_zero_set
proof:
:= by
  ext x; simp only [Set.mem_setOf_eq]
  show (Gfun s t)[n].eval x = 0 ↔ _
  rw [gOf_apply]

name: isOuter2D_iff_Outer2D
statement:
theorem isOuter2D_iff_Outer2D (s t : Triangle)
    (hco : ¬ Coplanar ℚ (Kpair s t)) {n : Nat} (hn : n < (Gfun s t).size) :
    isOuter2D (Gfun s t) n = true
      ↔ Proof.SimWinding.Outer2D (SimImplCover.Gtil s t) (Kpair s t) ⟨n, hn⟩
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨hs, ht⟩ := both_tetra_nondeg_of_not_coplanar s t hco
  set gi := (Gfun s t)[n] with hgidef
  have hgi : (Gfun s t)[n]? = some gi := by rw [Array.getElem?_eq_getElem hn]
  have happ : SimImplCover.Gtil s t ⟨n, hn⟩ 0 = (gOf gi) 0 := by
    show (Gfun s t)[n].eval 0 = _; rw [gOf_apply]
  have hzset : {x : Point | (SimImplCover.Gtil s t ⟨n, hn⟩) x = 0}
      = {x : Point | (gOf gi) x = 0} := Gtil_gOf_zero_set s t hn
  
  rw [isOuter2D, hgi]
  rw [Proof.SimWinding.Outer2D, happ, hzset]
  rw [Bool.and_eq_true, decide_eq_true_eq, gi_eval0_iff]
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨houter, hrk⟩
    exact ⟨houter, affRank3_imp_dim2 s t hgi hs ht houter hrk⟩
  · rintro ⟨houter, hdim⟩
    exact ⟨houter, dim2_imp_affRank3 s t hgi houter hdim⟩

name: dotQ_add_right'
statement: theorem dotQ_add_right' (u v w : Point) : dotQ u (v + w) = dotQ u v + dotQ u w
proof:
:= by
  rw [dotQ, dotQ, dotQ]; simp only [Pi.add_apply]; ring

name: linOf_eq_dotQ
statement: theorem linOf_eq_dotQ (n v : Point) : linOf n v = dotQ n v
proof:
:= by
  rw [linOf_apply, dotQ, Fin.sum_univ_three]

name: half_scalar_of_planeEq
statement:
theorem half_scalar_of_planeEq (gi gj : Half) (hni : gi.n ≠ 0)
    (hZ : {x : Point | gi.eval x = 0} = {x : Point | gj.eval x = 0}) :
    ∃ lam : ℚ, gj.n = lam • gi.n ∧ gj.c = lam • gi.c
proof:
:= by
  have hdpos : (0 : ℚ) < dotQ gi.n gi.n := by
    rw [dotQ_eq_dotProduct]; exact dotProduct_self_pos hni
  set x0 : Point := (gi.c / dotQ gi.n gi.n) • gi.n with hx0
  have hgix0 : gi.eval x0 = 0 := by
    show dotQ gi.n x0 - gi.c = 0
    rw [hx0, dotQ_smul_right, div_mul_cancel₀ _ (ne_of_gt hdpos)]; ring
  have hgjx0 : gj.eval x0 = 0 := by
    have : x0 ∈ {x : Point | gi.eval x = 0} := hgix0; rw [hZ] at this; exact this
  have hkerle : LinearMap.ker (linOf gi.n) ≤ LinearMap.ker (linOf gj.n) := by
    intro v hv
    rw [LinearMap.mem_ker] at hv ⊢
    rw [linOf_eq_dotQ] at hv
    have hgi2 : gi.eval (x0 + v) = 0 := by
      show dotQ gi.n (x0 + v) - gi.c = 0
      rw [dotQ_add_right', hv, add_zero]
      have : gi.eval x0 = dotQ gi.n x0 - gi.c := rfl; linarith [hgix0]
    have hgj2 : gj.eval (x0 + v) = 0 := by
      have : (x0 + v) ∈ {x : Point | gi.eval x = 0} := hgi2; rw [hZ] at this; exact this
    rw [show gj.eval (x0 + v) = dotQ gj.n (x0 + v) - gj.c from rfl, dotQ_add_right'] at hgj2
    rw [show gj.eval x0 = dotQ gj.n x0 - gj.c from rfl] at hgjx0
    rw [linOf_eq_dotQ]; linarith
  obtain ⟨lam, hlam⟩ := factor_covec (linOf gj.n) (linOf gi.n) (linOf_surjective hni) hkerle
  have hnscale : gj.n = lam • gi.n := by
    apply linOfMap_injective
    show linOf gj.n = linOf (lam • gi.n)
    rw [hlam]; apply LinearMap.ext; intro x
    rw [LinearMap.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul, linOf_eq_dotQ, linOf_eq_dotQ, dotQ_smul_left]
  refine ⟨lam, hnscale, ?_⟩
  have hgjc : dotQ gj.n x0 = gj.c := by
    have : gj.eval x0 = dotQ gj.n x0 - gj.c := rfl; linarith [hgjx0]
  have hgic : dotQ gi.n x0 = gi.c := by
    have : gi.eval x0 = dotQ gi.n x0 - gi.c := rfl; linarith [hgix0]
  have hl : dotQ gj.n x0 = lam * dotQ gi.n x0 := by rw [hnscale, dotQ_smul_left]
  rw [hgjc, hgic] at hl; rw [hl, smul_eq_mul]

name: samePlane_iff_planeEq
statement:
theorem samePlane_iff_planeEq (gi gj : Half) (hci : gi.c < 0) (hcj : gj.c < 0)
    (hni : gi.n ≠ 0) (hnj : gj.n ≠ 0) :
    samePlane gi gj = true
      ↔ {x : Point | gi.eval x = 0} = {x : Point | gj.eval x = 0}
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro hsp
    
    unfold samePlane at hsp
    simp only [Bool.and_eq_true, decide_eq_true_eq, beq_iff_eq] at hsp
    obtain ⟨⟨⟨⟨⟨_, _⟩, hpos⟩, hk0⟩, hk1⟩, hk2⟩ := hsp
    
    set lam : ℚ := gj.c / gi.c with hlamdef
    have hlampos : 0 < lam := by
      rw [hlamdef]; rcases lt_or_gt_of_ne (ne_of_lt hci) with h | h
      · exact div_pos_of_neg_of_neg hcj hci
      · exact absurd hci (by linarith)
    have hnscale : gj.n = lam • gi.n := by
      funext k
      fin_cases k
      · show gj.n 0 = lam * gi.n 0
        rw [hlamdef, div_mul_eq_mul_div, eq_div_iff (ne_of_lt hci)]; linarith [hk0]
      · show gj.n 1 = lam * gi.n 1
        rw [hlamdef, div_mul_eq_mul_div, eq_div_iff (ne_of_lt hci)]; linarith [hk1]
      · show gj.n 2 = lam * gi.n 2
        rw [hlamdef, div_mul_eq_mul_div, eq_div_iff (ne_of_lt hci)]; linarith [hk2]
    have hcscale : gj.c = lam * gi.c := by
      rw [hlamdef, div_mul_cancel₀ _ (ne_of_lt hci)]
    
    ext x; simp only [Set.mem_setOf_eq]
    have hev : gj.eval x = lam * gi.eval x := by
      show dotQ gj.n x - gj.c = lam * (dotQ gi.n x - gi.c)
      rw [hnscale, dotQ_smul_left, hcscale]; ring
    rw [hev]
    constructor
    · intro h; rw [h, mul_zero]
    · intro h; have := mul_eq_zero.mp h; rcases this with h' | h'
      · exact absurd h' (ne_of_gt hlampos)
      · exact h'
  · intro hZ
    obtain ⟨lam, hnscale, hcscale⟩ := half_scalar_of_planeEq gi gj hni hZ
    
    have hlamne : lam ≠ 0 := by
      intro h0; apply hnj; rw [hnscale, h0, zero_smul]
    have hlampos : 0 < lam := by
      rcases lt_or_gt_of_ne hlamne with h | h
      · exfalso; rw [hcscale, smul_eq_mul] at hcj
        exact absurd hcj (not_lt.mpr (le_of_lt (mul_pos_of_neg_of_neg h hci)))
      · exact h
    
    unfold samePlane
    simp only [Bool.and_eq_true, decide_eq_true_eq, beq_iff_eq]
    refine ⟨⟨⟨⟨⟨ne_of_lt hci, ne_of_lt hcj⟩, ?_⟩, ?_⟩, ?_⟩, ?_⟩
    · 
      rw [hcscale, smul_eq_mul]
      have hp : 0 < lam * (gi.c * gi.c) := mul_pos hlampos (mul_pos_of_neg_of_neg hci hci)
      have heq : lam * (gi.c * gi.c) = gi.c * (lam * gi.c) := by ring
      rwa [heq] at hp
    · 
      have h0 : gj.n 0 = lam * gi.n 0 := by rw [hnscale]; rfl
      rw [h0, hcscale, smul_eq_mul]; ring
    · have h1 : gj.n 1 = lam * gi.n 1 := by rw [hnscale]; rfl
      rw [h1, hcscale, smul_eq_mul]; ring
    · have h2 : gj.n 2 = lam * gi.n 2 := by rw [hnscale]; rfl
      rw [h2, hcscale, smul_eq_mul]; ring

name: keepL_append_one
statement:
theorem keepL_append_one (rel : Nat → Nat → Bool) (l : List Nat) (i : Nat) :
    keepL rel (l ++ [i])
      = if (keepL rel l).all (fun j => ! rel j i) then keepL rel l ++ [i] else keepL rel l
proof:
:= by
  unfold keepL; rw [List.foldl_append]; simp only [List.foldl_cons, List.foldl_nil]

name: keepL_sublist
statement:
theorem keepL_sublist (rel : Nat → Nat → Bool) (l : List Nat) :
    List.Sublist (keepL rel l) l
proof:
:= by
  induction l using List.reverseRecOn with
  | nil => simp [keepL]
  | append_singleton l i ih =>
    rw [keepL_append_one]
    by_cases h : (keepL rel l).all (fun j => ! rel j i) = true
    · rw [if_pos h]; exact List.Sublist.append ih (List.Sublist.refl _)
    · rw [if_neg h]; exact ih.trans (List.sublist_append_left l [i])

name: keepL_subset
statement: theorem keepL_subset (rel : Nat → Nat → Bool) (l : List Nat) : ∀ x ∈ keepL rel l, x ∈ l
proof:
:=
  fun _ hx => (keepL_sublist rel l).subset hx

name: keepL_nodup
statement:
theorem keepL_nodup (rel : Nat → Nat → Bool) {l : List Nat} (h : l.Nodup) :
    (keepL rel l).Nodup
proof: := (keepL_sublist rel l).nodup h

name: keepL_rep
statement:
theorem keepL_rep (rel : Nat → Nat → Bool) :
    ∀ (l : List Nat), ∀ j ∈ l, j ∈ keepL rel l ∨ ∃ j' ∈ keepL rel l, rel j' j = true
proof:
:= by
  intro l
  induction l using List.reverseRecOn with
  | nil => intro j hj; simp at hj
  | append_singleton l i ih =>
    intro j hj; rw [List.mem_append, List.mem_singleton] at hj; rw [keepL_append_one]
    by_cases hk : (keepL rel l).all (fun j => ! rel j i) = true
    · rw [if_pos hk]
      rcases hj with hjl | rfl
      · rcases ih j hjl with h | ⟨j', hj', hrel⟩
        · left; rw [List.mem_append]; left; exact h
        · right; exact ⟨j', by rw [List.mem_append]; left; exact hj', hrel⟩
      · left; rw [List.mem_append, List.mem_singleton]; right; rfl
    · rw [if_neg hk]
      rcases hj with hjl | rfl
      · exact ih j hjl
      · rw [List.all_eq_true] at hk; push_neg at hk
        obtain ⟨j', hj', hrel⟩ := hk; right; exact ⟨j', hj', by simpa using hrel⟩

name: keepL_all_iff
statement:
theorem keepL_all_iff (rel : Nat → Nat → Bool)
    (htrans : ∀ a b c, rel a b = true → rel b c = true → rel a c = true)
    (l : List Nat) (i : Nat) :
    ((keepL rel l).all (fun j => ! rel j i) = true ↔ l.all (fun j => ! rel j i) = true)
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro hk; rw [List.all_eq_true]; intro j hj; rw [List.all_eq_true] at hk
    rcases keepL_rep rel l j hj with hjk | ⟨j', hj', hrel⟩
    · exact hk j hjk
    · by_contra hjc
      have hji : rel j i = true := by simpa using hjc
      have hj'i : rel j' i = true := htrans j' j i hrel hji
      have hcontra := hk j' hj'; rw [hj'i] at hcontra; simp at hcontra
  · intro hl; rw [List.all_eq_true] at hl ⊢; intro j hj; exact hl j (keepL_subset rel l j hj)

name: keepL_mem_sorted
statement:
theorem keepL_mem_sorted (rel : Nat → Nat → Bool)
    (htrans : ∀ a b c, rel a b = true → rel b c = true → rel a c = true)
    (l : List Nat) (hsorted : l.Sorted (· < ·)) (i : Nat) :
    i ∈ keepL rel l ↔ i ∈ l ∧ ∀ j ∈ l, j < i → rel j i = false
proof:
:= by
  induction l using List.reverseRecOn with
  | nil => simp [keepL]
  | append_singleton l x ih =>
    have hsl : l.Sorted (· < ·) := by
      unfold List.Sorted at *; rw [List.pairwise_append] at hsorted; exact hsorted.1
    have hxgt : ∀ j ∈ l, j < x := by
      unfold List.Sorted at hsorted; rw [List.pairwise_append] at hsorted
      intro j hj; exact hsorted.2.2 j hj x (by simp)
    rw [keepL_append_one]
    by_cases hkx : (keepL rel l).all (fun j => ! rel j x) = true
    · rw [if_pos hkx]
      rw [List.mem_append, List.mem_singleton]
      by_cases hix : i = x
      · subst hix
        constructor
        · intro _; refine ⟨by rw [List.mem_append, List.mem_singleton]; right; rfl, ?_⟩
          intro j hj hji; rw [List.mem_append, List.mem_singleton] at hj
          rcases hj with hjl | rfl
          · have hall := (keepL_all_iff rel htrans l i).mp hkx
            rw [List.all_eq_true] at hall; have := hall j hjl; simpa using this
          · exact absurd hji (lt_irrefl _)
        · intro _; right; rfl
      · constructor
        · rintro (hil | rfl)
          · obtain ⟨_, hcond⟩ := (ih hsl).mp hil
            refine ⟨by rw [List.mem_append]; left; exact keepL_subset rel l i hil, ?_⟩
            intro j hj hji; rw [List.mem_append, List.mem_singleton] at hj
            rcases hj with hjl | rfl
            · exact hcond j hjl hji
            · exact absurd hji (by have := hxgt i (keepL_subset rel l i hil); omega)
          · exact absurd rfl hix
        · rintro ⟨hmem, hcond⟩
          rw [List.mem_append, List.mem_singleton] at hmem
          rcases hmem with hil | rfl
          · left; rw [ih hsl]
            exact ⟨hil, fun j hjl hji => hcond j (by rw [List.mem_append]; left; exact hjl) hji⟩
          · exact absurd rfl hix
    · rw [if_neg hkx]
      by_cases hix : i = x
      · subst hix
        constructor
        · intro hmem
          exact absurd (keepL_subset rel l i hmem) (by intro hc; have := hxgt i hc; omega)
        · rintro ⟨_, hcond⟩
          rw [List.all_eq_true] at hkx; push_neg at hkx
          obtain ⟨j, hjl, hrel⟩ := hkx
          have hji : rel j i = true := by simpa using hrel
          have hc2 := hcond j (by rw [List.mem_append]; left; exact keepL_subset rel l j hjl)
            (hxgt j (keepL_subset rel l j hjl))
          rw [hji] at hc2; simp at hc2
      · rw [ih hsl]
        constructor
        · rintro ⟨hil, hcond⟩
          refine ⟨by rw [List.mem_append]; left; exact hil, ?_⟩
          intro j hj hji; rw [List.mem_append, List.mem_singleton] at hj
          rcases hj with hjl | rfl
          · exact hcond j hjl hji
          · exact absurd hji (by have := hxgt i hil; omega)
        · rintro ⟨hmem, hcond⟩
          rw [List.mem_append, List.mem_singleton] at hmem
          rcases hmem with hil | rfl
          · exact ⟨hil, fun j hjl hji => hcond j (by rw [List.mem_append]; left; exact hjl) hji⟩
          · exact absurd rfl hix

name: list_all_congr
statement:
theorem list_all_congr {α} (L : List α) (p q : α → Bool) (h : ∀ x ∈ L, p x = q x) :
    L.all p = L.all q
proof:
:= by
  induction L with
  | nil => rfl
  | cons a tl ih =>
    simp only [List.all_cons]; rw [h a (by simp), ih (fun x hx => h x (by simp [hx]))]

name: kfpc_pred_eq
statement:
theorem kfpc_pred_eq (G : Array Half) (acc : Array Nat) (a : Nat) :
    (acc.all (fun j => match G[j]?, G[a]? with | some gj, some gi => ! samePlane gj gi | _, _ => true))
      = acc.toList.all (fun j => ! relB G j a)
proof:
:= by
  rw [← Array.all_toList]
  apply list_all_congr; intro j _
  show (match G[j]?, G[a]? with | some gj, some gi => ! samePlane gj gi | _, _ => true) = ! relB G j a
  unfold relB; cases G[j]? <;> cases G[a]? <;> rfl

name: kfpc_eq
statement:
theorem kfpc_eq (G : Array Half) (idxs : Array Nat) :
    (keepFirstPerClass G idxs).toList = keepL (relB G) idxs.toList
proof:
:= by
  unfold keepFirstPerClass keepL
  rw [← Array.foldl_toList]
  generalize idxs.toList = L
  have hstep : ∀ (acc : Array Nat) (a : Nat),
      ((if (acc.all (fun j =>
          match G[j]?, G[a]? with | some gj, some gi => ! samePlane gj gi | _, _ => true))
        then acc.push a else acc) : Array Nat).toList
      = (if acc.toList.all (fun j => ! relB G j a) then acc.toList ++ [a] else acc.toList) := by
    intro acc a
    rw [kfpc_pred_eq G acc a]
    by_cases hb : acc.toList.all (fun j => ! relB G j a) = true
    · rw [if_pos hb, if_pos hb, Array.push_toList]
    · rw [if_neg hb, if_neg hb]
  suffices h : ∀ (acc : Array Nat),
      (L.foldl (fun acc i =>
        if (acc.all (fun j =>
          match G[j]?, G[i]? with | some gj, some gi => ! samePlane gj gi | _, _ => true))
        then acc.push i else acc) acc).toList
      = L.foldl (fun acc i => if acc.all (fun j => ! relB G j i) then acc ++ [i] else acc) acc.toList by
    convert h #[] using 3
  intro acc
  induction L generalizing acc with
  | nil => simp
  | cons a tl ih => rw [List.foldl_cons, List.foldl_cons, ih, hstep acc a]

name: samePlane_trans
statement:
theorem samePlane_trans (gi gj gk : Half) (h1 : samePlane gi gj = true)
    (h2 : samePlane gj gk = true) : samePlane gi gk = true
proof:
:= by
  unfold samePlane at h1 h2 ⊢
  simp only [Bool.and_eq_true, decide_eq_true_eq, beq_iff_eq] at h1 h2 ⊢
  obtain ⟨⟨⟨⟨⟨hi1, hj1⟩, hpos1⟩, hk01⟩, hk11⟩, hk21⟩ := h1
  obtain ⟨⟨⟨⟨⟨_, hk2c⟩, hpos2⟩, hk02⟩, hk12⟩, hk22⟩ := h2
  have hjc : gj.c ≠ 0 := hj1
  have hjc2 : (0 : ℚ) < gj.c * gj.c := mul_self_pos.mpr hjc
  refine ⟨⟨⟨⟨⟨hi1, hk2c⟩, ?_⟩, ?_⟩, ?_⟩, ?_⟩
  · have hmul : 0 < (gi.c * gk.c) * (gj.c * gj.c) := by
      have h := mul_pos hpos1 hpos2
      have heq : (gi.c * gj.c) * (gj.c * gk.c) = (gi.c * gk.c) * (gj.c * gj.c) := by ring
      rwa [heq] at h
    exact (mul_pos_iff_of_pos_right hjc2).mp hmul
  · apply mul_right_cancel₀ hjc
    have a1 : gj.n 0 * gi.c * gk.c = gi.n 0 * gj.c * gk.c := by rw [hk01]
    have a2 : gk.n 0 * gj.c * gi.c = gj.n 0 * gk.c * gi.c := by rw [hk02]
    linear_combination a1 + a2
  · apply mul_right_cancel₀ hjc
    have a1 : gj.n 1 * gi.c * gk.c = gi.n 1 * gj.c * gk.c := by rw [hk11]
    have a2 : gk.n 1 * gj.c * gi.c = gj.n 1 * gk.c * gi.c := by rw [hk12]
    linear_combination a1 + a2
  · apply mul_right_cancel₀ hjc
    have a1 : gj.n 2 * gi.c * gk.c = gi.n 2 * gj.c * gk.c := by rw [hk21]
    have a2 : gk.n 2 * gj.c * gi.c = gj.n 2 * gk.c * gi.c := by rw [hk22]
    linear_combination a1 + a2

name: relB_trans
statement:
theorem relB_trans (G : Array Half) (a b c : Nat)
    (h1 : relB G a b = true) (h2 : relB G b c = true) : relB G a c = true
proof:
:= by
  unfold relB at h1 h2 ⊢
  cases ha : G[a]? with
  | none => simp only [ha] at h1; simp at h1
  | some ga =>
    cases hb : G[b]? with
    | none => simp only [ha, hb] at h1; simp at h1
    | some gb =>
      cases hc : G[c]? with
      | none => simp only [hb, hc] at h2; simp at h2
      | some gc =>
        simp only [ha, hb] at h1; simp only [hb, hc] at h2; simp only [ha, hc]
        exact samePlane_trans ga gb gc h1 h2

name: outer_precond
statement:
theorem outer_precond (s t : Triangle) (hco : ¬ Coplanar ℚ (Kpair s t))
    {n : Nat} (hn : n < (Gfun s t).size) (hout : isOuter2D (Gfun s t) n = true) :
    (Gfun s t)[n].c < 0 ∧ (Gfun s t)[n].n ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  have hgi : (Gfun s t)[n]? = some (Gfun s t)[n] := by rw [Array.getElem?_eq_getElem hn]
  have hO2 := (isOuter2D_iff_Outer2D s t hco hn).mp hout
  obtain ⟨happex, hdim⟩ := hO2
  have happex' : 0 < (gOf (Gfun s t)[n]) 0 := by
    have : SimImplCover.Gtil s t ⟨n, hn⟩ 0 = (gOf (Gfun s t)[n]) 0 := by
      show (Gfun s t)[n].eval 0 = _; rw [gOf_apply]
    rwa [this] at happex
  have hc : (Gfun s t)[n].c < 0 := by
    have he : (gOf (Gfun s t)[n]) 0 = -(Gfun s t)[n].c := gOf_apply_zero _
    rw [he] at happex'; linarith
  have hzset : {x : Point | (SimImplCover.Gtil s t ⟨n, hn⟩) x = 0}
      = {x : Point | (gOf (Gfun s t)[n]) x = 0} := Gtil_gOf_zero_set s t hn
  rw [hzset] at hdim
  exact ⟨hc, gi_n_ne_zero s t happex' hdim⟩

name: relB_false_iff
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨hcj, hnj⟩ := outer_precond s t hco hj houtj
  obtain ⟨hci, hni⟩ := outer_precond s t hco hi houti
  
  have hrelB : relB (Gfun s t) j i = samePlane (Gfun s t)[j] (Gfun s t)[i] := by
    unfold relB
    rw [Array.getElem?_eq_getElem hj, Array.getElem?_eq_getElem hi]
  rw [hrelB]
  have hspec := samePlane_iff_planeEq (Gfun s t)[j] (Gfun s t)[i] hcj hci hnj hni
  
  have hzj : {x : Point | (SimImplCover.Gtil s t ⟨j, hj⟩) x = 0}
      = {x : Point | (Gfun s t)[j].eval x = 0} := by
    ext x; simp only [Set.mem_setOf_eq]; rfl
  have hzi : {x : Point | (SimImplCover.Gtil s t ⟨i, hi⟩) x = 0}
      = {x : Point | (Gfun s t)[i].eval x = 0} := by
    ext x; simp only [Set.mem_setOf_eq]; rfl
  rw [hzj, hzi]
  constructor
  · intro hfalse heq
    rw [hspec.mpr heq] at hfalse; simp at hfalse
  · intro hne
    by_contra hc
    rw [Bool.not_eq_false] at hc
    exact hne (hspec.mp hc)

name: outerIdxs_toList
statement:
theorem outerIdxs_toList (G : Array Half) :
    (outerIdxs G).toList = (List.range G.size).filter (isOuter2D G)
proof:
:= by
  unfold outerIdxs allIdxs
  rw [Array.toList_filter, Array.toList_range]

name: outerIdxs_sorted
statement: theorem outerIdxs_sorted (G : Array Half) : (outerIdxs G).toList.Sorted (· < ·)
proof:
:= by
  rw [outerIdxs_toList]; exact (List.sorted_lt_range _).filter _

name: mem_outerIdxs_toList
statement:
theorem mem_outerIdxs_toList (G : Array Half) (j : Nat) :
    j ∈ (outerIdxs G).toList ↔ j < G.size ∧ isOuter2D G j = true
proof:
:= by
  rw [outerIdxs_toList, List.mem_filter, List.mem_range]

name: mem_Rc_toList
statement:
theorem mem_Rc_toList (s t : Triangle) (i : Nat) :
    i ∈ (R_c (Gfun s t)).toList ↔
      (i < (Gfun s t).size ∧ isOuter2D (Gfun s t) i = true) ∧
      ∀ j ∈ (outerIdxs (Gfun s t)).toList, j < i → relB (Gfun s t) j i = false
proof:
:= by
  rw [R_c, kfpc_eq,
    keepL_mem_sorted (relB (Gfun s t)) (relB_trans (Gfun s t)) _ (outerIdxs_sorted (Gfun s t)) i,
    mem_outerIdxs_toList]

name: Rc_mem_iff_leaders
statement:
theorem Rc_mem_iff_leaders (s t : Triangle) (hco : ¬ Coplanar ℚ (Kpair s t))
    {i : Nat} (hi : i < (Gfun s t).size) :
    i ∈ (R_c (Gfun s t)).toList
      ↔ (⟨i, hi⟩ : Fin (Gfun s t).size)
          ∈ Proof.SimWinding.leaders (SimImplCover.Gtil s t) (Kpair s t)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  rw [mem_Rc_toList]
  rw [Proof.SimWinding.leaders, Finset.mem_filter]
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨⟨_, houti⟩, hcond⟩
    refine ⟨Finset.mem_univ _, (isOuter2D_iff_Outer2D s t hco hi).mp houti, ?_⟩
    intro j hjlt hjO2
    
    have hjn : (j : Nat) < i := hjlt
    have hjsize : (j : Nat) < (Gfun s t).size := j.2
    have houtj : isOuter2D (Gfun s t) (j : Nat) = true :=
      (isOuter2D_iff_Outer2D s t hco hjsize).mpr (by
        have : (⟨(j : Nat), hjsize⟩ : Fin (Gfun s t).size) = j := Fin.ext rfl
        rw [this]; exact hjO2)
    have hmem : (j : Nat) ∈ (outerIdxs (Gfun s t)).toList :=
      (mem_outerIdxs_toList _ _).mpr ⟨hjsize, houtj⟩
    have hrb := hcond (j : Nat) hmem hjn
    
    have := (relB_false_iff s t hco hjsize hi houtj houti).mp hrb
    
    have hfj : (⟨(j : Nat), hjsize⟩ : Fin (Gfun s t).size) = j := Fin.ext rfl
    rw [hfj] at this
    exact this
  · rintro ⟨_, hO2i, hcond⟩
    have houti : isOuter2D (Gfun s t) i = true := (isOuter2D_iff_Outer2D s t hco hi).mpr hO2i
    refine ⟨⟨hi, houti⟩, ?_⟩
    intro j hjmem hjn
    obtain ⟨hjsize, houtj⟩ := (mem_outerIdxs_toList _ _).mp hjmem
    
    have hjlt : (⟨j, hjsize⟩ : Fin (Gfun s t).size) < ⟨i, hi⟩ := by rw [Fin.lt_def]; exact hjn
    have hO2j : Proof.SimWinding.Outer2D (SimImplCover.Gtil s t) (Kpair s t) ⟨j, hjsize⟩ :=
      (isOuter2D_iff_Outer2D s t hco hjsize).mp houtj
    have hzne := hcond ⟨j, hjsize⟩ hjlt hO2j
    exact (relB_false_iff s t hco hjsize hi houtj houti).mpr hzne

name: det3_ne_zero_of_affineIndependent
statement:
theorem det3_ne_zero_of_affineIndependent {v0 v1 v2 : Point}
    (h : AffineIndependent ℚ ![(0 : Point), v0, v1, v2]) : det3 v0 v1 v2 ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [det3_ne_zero_iff_linearIndependent]
  rw [affineIndependent_iff] at h
  rw [Fintype.linearIndependent_iff]
  intro s hst i0
  set w : Fin 4 → ℚ := ![-(s 0 + s 1 + s 2), s 0, s 1, s 2] with hw
  have hwsum : ∑ i, w i = 0 := by
    simp only [hw, Fin.sum_univ_four, Matrix.cons_val_zero, Matrix.cons_val_one,
      Matrix.head_cons, Matrix.cons_val_two, Matrix.cons_val_three, Matrix.tail_cons]; ring
  have hwcomb : ∑ i, w i • (![(0 : Point), v0, v1, v2] i) = 0 := by
    have hst' : s 0 • v0 + s 1 • v1 + s 2 • v2 = 0 := by
      have := hst; rw [Fin.sum_univ_three] at this
      simpa [Matrix.cons_val_zero, Matrix.cons_val_one, Matrix.head_cons,
        Matrix.cons_val_two, Matrix.tail_cons] using this
    simp only [hw, Fin.sum_univ_four, Matrix.cons_val_zero, Matrix.cons_val_one,
      Matrix.head_cons, Matrix.cons_val_two, Matrix.cons_val_three, Matrix.tail_cons]
    rw [smul_zero, zero_add]; linear_combination (norm := module) hst'
  have hz := h Finset.univ w hwsum hwcomb
  fin_cases i0
  · exact hz 1 (Finset.mem_univ _)
  · exact hz 2 (Finset.mem_univ _)
  · exact hz 3 (Finset.mem_univ _)

name: affineIndependent_origin_apex_of_det3
statement:
theorem affineIndependent_origin_apex_of_det3 {v0 v1 v2 : Point}
    (hd : det3 v0 v1 v2 ≠ 0) : AffineIndependent ℚ ![(0 : Point), v0, v1, v2]
proof:
:= by
  have hli : LinearIndependent ℚ ![v0, v1, v2] :=
    (det3_ne_zero_iff_linearIndependent v0 v1 v2).mp hd
  rw [Fintype.linearIndependent_iff] at hli
  rw [affineIndependent_iff_of_fintype]
  intro w hwsum hvs
  
  have hcomb : ∑ i, w i • (![(0 : Point), v0, v1, v2] : Fin 4 → Point) i = 0 := by
    rw [Finset.weightedVSub_eq_linear_combination Finset.univ hwsum] at hvs
    exact hvs
  rw [Fin.sum_univ_four] at hcomb
  simp only [Matrix.cons_val_zero, Matrix.cons_val_one, Matrix.head_cons,
    Matrix.cons_val_two, Matrix.cons_val_three, Matrix.tail_cons, smul_zero, zero_add] at hcomb
  
  have hucomb : ∑ j, (![w 1, w 2, w 3] : Fin 3 → ℚ) j • (![v0, v1, v2] : Fin 3 → Point) j = 0 := by
    rw [Fin.sum_univ_three]
    simpa using hcomb
  have hu0 := hli ![w 1, w 2, w 3] hucomb
  have hw1 : w 1 = 0 := by have := hu0 0; simpa using this
  have hw2 : w 2 = 0 := by have := hu0 1; simpa using this
  have hw3 : w 3 = 0 := by have := hu0 2; simpa using this
  have hw0 : w 0 = 0 := by
    rw [Fin.sum_univ_four] at hwsum; rw [hw1, hw2, hw3] at hwsum; linarith
  intro i; fin_cases i
  · exact hw0
  · exact hw1
  · exact hw2
  · exact hw3

name: simImpl_eq_chainOf_of_not_coplanar
statement:
theorem simImpl_eq_chainOf_of_not_coplanar (s t : Triangle)
    (hco : ¬ Coplanar ℚ (SimImplCover.Kpair s t)) :
    simImpl s t = chainOf (Gfun s t)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨hAIs, hAIt⟩ := both_tetra_nondeg_of_not_coplanar s t hco
  have hds : det3 s.v₀ s.v₁ s.v₂ ≠ 0 := det3_ne_zero_of_affineIndependent hAIs
  have hdt : det3 t.v₀ t.v₁ t.v₂ ≠ 0 := det3_ne_zero_of_affineIndependent hAIt
  unfold simImpl
  rw [if_pos]
  rw [Bool.and_eq_true, bne_iff_ne, bne_iff_ne]
  exact ⟨hds, hdt⟩

name: simImpl_chain_perm
statement:
theorem simImpl_chain_perm (s t : Triangle)
    (hco : ¬ Coplanar ℚ (SimImplCover.Kpair s t)) :
    (simImpl s t).toList.Perm
      ((Proof.SimWinding.leaders (SimImplCover.Gtil s t) (SimImplCover.Kpair s t)).toList.flatMap
        fun i =>
          ((Finset.range (rr_c (Gfun s t) (i:ℕ) - 2)).toList.map fun k =>
            ((1 : Int),
             (⟨uu_c (Gfun s t) (i:ℕ) 0, uu_c (Gfun s t) (i:ℕ) (k+1),
               uu_c (Gfun s t) (i:ℕ) (k+2)⟩ : Triangle))))
proof:
:= by
  
  have hBperm : (R_c (Gfun s t)).toList.Perm
      ((Proof.SimWinding.leaders (SimImplCover.Gtil s t)
        (SimImplCover.Kpair s t)).toList.map (·.val)) := by
    classical
    have hNodupRc : (R_c (Gfun s t)).toList.Nodup := by
      rw [R_c, kfpc_eq]
      refine keepL_nodup _ ?_
      rw [outerIdxs_toList]
      exact List.Nodup.filter _ (List.nodup_range (Gfun s t).size)
    have hNodupLead :
        ((Proof.SimWinding.leaders (SimImplCover.Gtil s t)
          (SimImplCover.Kpair s t)).toList.map (·.val)).Nodup :=
      List.Nodup.map Fin.val_injective (Finset.nodup_toList _)
    rw [List.perm_ext_iff_of_nodup hNodupRc hNodupLead]
    intro x
    rw [List.mem_map]
    constructor
    · intro hx
      have hxsize : x < (Gfun s t).size := (mem_Rc_toList s t x).mp hx |>.1.1
      refine ⟨⟨x, hxsize⟩, ?_, rfl⟩
      rw [Finset.mem_toList]
      exact (Rc_mem_iff_leaders s t hco hxsize).mp hx
    · rintro ⟨j, hjlead, rfl⟩
      rw [Finset.mem_toList] at hjlead
      exact (Rc_mem_iff_leaders s t hco j.2).mpr (by
        have : (⟨(j : Nat), j.2⟩ : Fin (Gfun s t).size) = j := Fin.ext rfl
        rw [this]; exact hjlead)
  
  have hinner : ∀ (n : ℕ),
      ((fanTriangles (Gfun s t) n).toList.map (fun τ => ((1 : Int), τ))).Perm
        ((Finset.range (rr_c (Gfun s t) n - 2)).toList.map (fun k =>
            ((1 : Int), (⟨uu_c (Gfun s t) n 0, uu_c (Gfun s t) n (k+1),
              uu_c (Gfun s t) n (k+2)⟩ : Triangle)))) := by
    intro n
    unfold fanTriangles
    simp only [Array.toList_map, Array.toList_range, List.map_map]
    apply List.Perm.map
    apply (List.perm_ext_iff_of_nodup (List.nodup_range _) (Finset.nodup_toList _)).mpr
    intro a; rw [List.mem_range, Finset.mem_toList, Finset.mem_range]
  
  rw [simImpl_eq_chainOf_of_not_coplanar s t hco]
  show (chainOf (Gfun s t)).toList.Perm _
  rw [chainOf, Array.toList_toArray]
  set innerF : ℕ → List (Int × Triangle) :=
    fun i => (Finset.range (rr_c (Gfun s t) i - 2)).toList.map (fun k =>
      ((1 : Int), (⟨uu_c (Gfun s t) i 0, uu_c (Gfun s t) i (k+1),
        uu_c (Gfun s t) i (k+2)⟩ : Triangle))) with hinnerF
  refine (flatMap_perm_congr (R_c (Gfun s t)).toList
    (fun i => (fanTriangles (Gfun s t) i).toList.map (fun τ => ((1 : Int), τ))) innerF
    (fun i _ => hinner i)).trans ?_
  refine (List.Perm.flatMap_right innerF hBperm).trans ?_
  rw [List.flatMap_map]

name: dP3_psubS
statement: theorem dP3_psubS (u v : P3) : dP3 (psubS u v) = dP3 u - dP3 v
proof:
:= by
  funext i; fin_cases i <;> simp [dP3, psubS]

name: dI3_hsub
statement:
theorem dI3_hsub (u v : H4) :
    dI3 (hsub u v) = (v.w : ℚ) • dH4 u - (u.w : ℚ) • dH4 v
proof:
:= by
  funext i; fin_cases i <;> simp [dI3, dH4, hsub] <;> ring

name: dI3_cross
statement:
theorem dI3_cross (u v : I3) :
    dI3 (crossI u v) = crossProduct (dI3 u) (dI3 v)
proof:
:= by
  funext i; fin_cases i <;> simp [dI3, crossI, crossProduct]

name: dI3_dot
statement: theorem dI3_dot (u v : I3) : ((dotI u v : Int) : ℚ) = (dI3 u) ⬝ᵥ (dI3 v)
proof:
:= by
  simp [dI3, dotI, dotProduct, Fin.sum_univ_three]

name: dI3_eq_zero_iff
statement: theorem dI3_eq_zero_iff (u : I3) : dI3 u = 0 ↔ u.x = 0 ∧ u.y = 0 ∧ u.z = 0
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro h
    have h0 := congrFun h (0 : Fin 3)
    have h1 := congrFun h (1 : Fin 3)
    have h2 := congrFun h (2 : Fin 3)
    simp only [dI3, Matrix.cons_val_zero, Matrix.cons_val_one, Matrix.head_cons,
      Matrix.cons_val_two, Matrix.tail_cons, Pi.zero_apply, Int.cast_eq_zero] at h0 h1 h2
    exact ⟨h0, h1, h2⟩
  · rintro ⟨hx, hy, hz⟩; funext i; fin_cases i <;> simp [dI3, hx, hy, hz]

name: dI3_isZero
statement: theorem dI3_isZero (u : I3) : isZeroI u = true ↔ dI3 u = 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [dI3_eq_zero_iff]
  simp only [isZeroI, Bool.and_eq_true, beq_iff_eq, and_assoc]

name: toH4_w
statement: theorem toH4_w (p : P3) : (toH4 p).w = toH4W p
proof: := rfl

name: toH4W_pos
statement: theorem toH4W_pos (p : P3) : 0 < toH4W p
proof:
:= by
  have h : ((p.x.den.lcm p.y.den).lcm p.z.den) ≠ 0 :=
    Nat.lcm_ne_zero (Nat.lcm_ne_zero p.x.den_nz p.y.den_nz) p.z.den_nz
  have : 0 < ((p.x.den.lcm p.y.den).lcm p.z.den) := Nat.pos_of_ne_zero h
  simpa [toH4W] using this

name: toH4W_dvd_x
statement: theorem toH4W_dvd_x (p : P3) : (p.x.den : ℤ) ∣ toH4W p
proof:
:= by
  have : p.x.den ∣ ((p.x.den.lcm p.y.den).lcm p.z.den) :=
    (Nat.dvd_lcm_left _ _).trans (Nat.dvd_lcm_left _ _)
  simpa [toH4W] using Int.natCast_dvd_natCast.mpr this

name: toH4W_dvd_y
statement: theorem toH4W_dvd_y (p : P3) : (p.y.den : ℤ) ∣ toH4W p
proof:
:= by
  have : p.y.den ∣ ((p.x.den.lcm p.y.den).lcm p.z.den) :=
    (Nat.dvd_lcm_right _ _).trans (Nat.dvd_lcm_left _ _)
  simpa [toH4W] using Int.natCast_dvd_natCast.mpr this

name: toH4W_dvd_z
statement: theorem toH4W_dvd_z (p : P3) : (p.z.den : ℤ) ∣ toH4W p
proof:
:= by
  have : p.z.den ∣ ((p.x.den.lcm p.y.den).lcm p.z.den) := Nat.dvd_lcm_right _ _
  simpa [toH4W] using Int.natCast_dvd_natCast.mpr this

name: dH4_toH4
statement: theorem dH4_toH4 (p : P3) : dH4 (toH4 p) = (toH4W p : ℚ) • dP3 p
proof:
:= by
  funext i; fin_cases i
  · show ((((toH4W p : ℚ) * p.x).num : Int) : ℚ) = _
    rw [Proof.GenPosCheck.num_clear _ _ (toH4W_dvd_x p)]; simp [dP3, smul_eq_mul]
  · show ((((toH4W p : ℚ) * p.y).num : Int) : ℚ) = _
    rw [Proof.GenPosCheck.num_clear _ _ (toH4W_dvd_y p)]; simp [dP3, smul_eq_mul]
  · show ((((toH4W p : ℚ) * p.z).num : Int) : ℚ) = _
    rw [Proof.GenPosCheck.num_clear _ _ (toH4W_dvd_z p)]; simp [dP3, smul_eq_mul]

name: ScM_cross
statement:
theorem ScM_cross {ca cb : ℚ} {a b a' b' : I3} (ha : ScM ca a a') (hb : ScM cb b b') :
    ScM (ca * cb) (crossI a b) (crossI a' b')
proof:
:= by
  unfold ScM at *
  rw [dI3_cross, dI3_cross, ha, hb]
  funext i; fin_cases i <;>
    simp [crossProduct, Pi.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul] <;> ring

name: ScM_dot
statement:
theorem ScM_dot {ca cb : ℚ} {a b a' b' : I3} (ha : ScM ca a a') (hb : ScM cb b b') :
    ((dotI a' b' : Int) : ℚ) = (ca * cb) * ((dotI a b : Int) : ℚ)
proof:
:= by
  unfold ScM at *
  rw [dI3_dot, dI3_dot, ha, hb, smul_dotProduct, dotProduct_smul, smul_smul, smul_eq_mul]

name: ScM_isZero
statement:
theorem ScM_isZero {c : ℚ} (hc : 0 < c) {u u' : I3} (h : ScM c u u') :
    isZeroI u' = isZeroI u
proof:
:= by
  unfold ScM at h
  rw [Bool.eq_iff_iff, dI3_isZero, dI3_isZero, h, smul_eq_zero]
  constructor
  · rintro (hc0 | h0)
    · exact absurd hc0 hc.ne'
    · exact h0
  · intro h0; exact Or.inr h0

name: evalI_decode
statement:
theorem evalI_decode (g : IPlane) (p : P3) :
    ((evalI g (toH4 p) : Int) : ℚ) = (toH4W p : ℚ) * gAff g p
proof:
:= by
  have hx : ((toH4 p).x : ℚ) = (toH4W p : ℚ) * p.x := by
    have := congrFun (dH4_toH4 p) 0; simpa [dH4, dP3, smul_eq_mul] using this
  have hy : ((toH4 p).y : ℚ) = (toH4W p : ℚ) * p.y := by
    have := congrFun (dH4_toH4 p) 1; simpa [dH4, dP3, smul_eq_mul] using this
  have hz : ((toH4 p).z : ℚ) = (toH4W p : ℚ) * p.z := by
    have := congrFun (dH4_toH4 p) 2; simpa [dH4, dP3, smul_eq_mul] using this
  have hw : ((toH4 p).w : ℚ) = (toH4W p : ℚ) := by rw [toH4_w]
  simp only [evalI, gAff]
  push_cast
  rw [hx, hy, hz, hw]; ring

name: clearPlaneW_pos
statement: theorem clearPlaneW_pos (n : P3) (c : Rat) : 0 < clearPlaneW n c
proof:
:= by
  have h : (((n.x.den.lcm n.y.den).lcm n.z.den).lcm c.den) ≠ 0 :=
    Nat.lcm_ne_zero (Nat.lcm_ne_zero (Nat.lcm_ne_zero n.x.den_nz n.y.den_nz) n.z.den_nz) c.den_nz
  simpa [clearPlaneW] using Nat.pos_of_ne_zero h

name: cpw_dvd_nx
statement: private theorem cpw_dvd_nx (n : P3) (c : Rat) : (n.x.den : ℤ) ∣ clearPlaneW n c
proof:
:= by
  have : n.x.den ∣ (((n.x.den.lcm n.y.den).lcm n.z.den).lcm c.den) :=
    (((Nat.dvd_lcm_left _ _).trans (Nat.dvd_lcm_left _ _)).trans (Nat.dvd_lcm_left _ _))
  simpa [clearPlaneW] using Int.natCast_dvd_natCast.mpr this

name: cpw_dvd_ny
statement: private theorem cpw_dvd_ny (n : P3) (c : Rat) : (n.y.den : ℤ) ∣ clearPlaneW n c
proof:
:= by
  have : n.y.den ∣ (((n.x.den.lcm n.y.den).lcm n.z.den).lcm c.den) :=
    (((Nat.dvd_lcm_right _ _).trans (Nat.dvd_lcm_left _ _)).trans (Nat.dvd_lcm_left _ _))
  simpa [clearPlaneW] using Int.natCast_dvd_natCast.mpr this

name: cpw_dvd_nz
statement: private theorem cpw_dvd_nz (n : P3) (c : Rat) : (n.z.den : ℤ) ∣ clearPlaneW n c
proof:
:= by
  have : n.z.den ∣ (((n.x.den.lcm n.y.den).lcm n.z.den).lcm c.den) :=
    ((Nat.dvd_lcm_right _ _).trans (Nat.dvd_lcm_left _ _))
  simpa [clearPlaneW] using Int.natCast_dvd_natCast.mpr this

name: cpw_dvd_c
statement: private theorem cpw_dvd_c (n : P3) (c : Rat) : (c.den : ℤ) ∣ clearPlaneW n c
proof:
:= by
  have : c.den ∣ (((n.x.den.lcm n.y.den).lcm n.z.den).lcm c.den) := Nat.dvd_lcm_right _ _
  simpa [clearPlaneW] using Int.natCast_dvd_natCast.mpr this

name: gAff_clearPlane
statement:
theorem gAff_clearPlane (n : P3) (c : Rat) (p : P3) :
    gAff (clearPlane n c) p = (clearPlaneW n c : ℚ) * (dotS n p - c)
proof:
:= by
  have ha : ((clearPlane n c).a : ℚ) = (clearPlaneW n c : ℚ) * n.x :=
    Proof.GenPosCheck.num_clear _ _ (cpw_dvd_nx n c)
  have hb : ((clearPlane n c).b : ℚ) = (clearPlaneW n c : ℚ) * n.y :=
    Proof.GenPosCheck.num_clear _ _ (cpw_dvd_ny n c)
  have hc : ((clearPlane n c).c : ℚ) = (clearPlaneW n c : ℚ) * n.z :=
    Proof.GenPosCheck.num_clear _ _ (cpw_dvd_nz n c)
  have hd : ((clearPlane n c).d : ℚ) = (clearPlaneW n c : ℚ) * c :=
    Proof.GenPosCheck.num_clear _ _ (cpw_dvd_c n c)
  simp only [gAff, dotS, ha, hb, hc, hd]; ring

name: psubS_translate
statement: theorem psubS_translate (x y o : P3) : psubS (psubS x o) (psubS y o) = psubS x y
proof:
:= by
  simp only [psubS, P3.mk.injEq]; refine ⟨by ring, by ring, by ring⟩

name: crossNormal_translate
statement:
theorem crossNormal_translate (a b c o : P3) :
    crossS (psubS (psubS b o) (psubS a o)) (psubS (psubS c o) (psubS a o))
    = crossS (psubS b a) (psubS c a)
proof:
:= by
  rw [psubS_translate, psubS_translate]

name: dotS_psubS
statement: theorem dotS_psubS (n p o : P3) : dotS n (psubS p o) = dotS n p - dotS n o
proof:
:= by
  simp only [dotS, psubS]; ring

name: signI_iFacePlane_translate
statement:
theorem signI_iFacePlane_translate (a b c p o : P3) :
    signI (iFacePlane (psubS a o) (psubS b o) (psubS c o)) (toH4 (psubS p o))
    = signI (iFacePlane a b c) (toH4 p)
proof:
:= by
  set n := crossS (psubS b a) (psubS c a) with hn
  
  have hnorm : crossS (psubS (psubS b o) (psubS a o)) (psubS (psubS c o) (psubS a o)) = n :=
    crossNormal_translate a b c o
  
  have hg : iFacePlane a b c = clearPlane n (dotS n a) := rfl
  have hg' : iFacePlane (psubS a o) (psubS b o) (psubS c o)
           = clearPlane n (dotS n (psubS a o)) := by
    simp only [iFacePlane, hnorm]
  
  set D : ℚ := dotS n p - dotS n a with hD
  
  have hval : ((evalI (iFacePlane a b c) (toH4 p) : Int) : ℚ)
            = (toH4W p : ℚ) * ((clearPlaneW n (dotS n a) : ℚ) * D) := by
    rw [evalI_decode, hg, gAff_clearPlane]
  have hval' : ((evalI (iFacePlane (psubS a o) (psubS b o) (psubS c o)) (toH4 (psubS p o)) : Int) : ℚ)
             = (toH4W (psubS p o) : ℚ) * ((clearPlaneW n (dotS n (psubS a o)) : ℚ) * D) := by
    rw [evalI_decode, hg', gAff_clearPlane]
    congr 2
    rw [dotS_psubS, dotS_psubS]; ring
  
  set kNum : ℚ := (toH4W (psubS p o) : ℚ) * (clearPlaneW n (dotS n (psubS a o)) : ℚ) with hkNum
  set kDen : ℚ := (toH4W p : ℚ) * (clearPlaneW n (dotS n a) : ℚ) with hkDen
  have hkNumpos : 0 < kNum := by
    rw [hkNum]; exact mul_pos (by exact_mod_cast toH4W_pos _) (by exact_mod_cast clearPlaneW_pos _ _)
  have hkDenpos : 0 < kDen := by
    rw [hkDen]; exact mul_pos (by exact_mod_cast toH4W_pos _) (by exact_mod_cast clearPlaneW_pos _ _)
  have hrel : ((evalI (iFacePlane (psubS a o) (psubS b o) (psubS c o)) (toH4 (psubS p o)) : Int) : ℚ)
            = (kNum / kDen) * ((evalI (iFacePlane a b c) (toH4 p) : Int) : ℚ) := by
    rw [hval, hval']
    field_simp
    ring
  exact sc_sign (div_pos hkNumpos hkDenpos) hrel

name: posMul_iFacePlaneP
statement:
theorem posMul_iFacePlaneP (a b c : P3) :
    MeshIntersectPlaneH.PosMul (iFacePlane a b c) (iFacePlaneP a b c)
proof:
:=
  MeshIntersectPlaneKey.posMul_iFacePlane_iFacePlaneH a b c

name: evalI_posMul
statement:
theorem evalI_posMul {g g' : IPlane} {ρ : ℚ}
    (ha : (g'.a : ℚ) = ρ * g.a) (hb : (g'.b : ℚ) = ρ * g.b)
    (hc : (g'.c : ℚ) = ρ * g.c) (hd : (g'.d : ℚ) = ρ * g.d) (q : H4) :
    ((evalI g' q : Int) : ℚ) = ρ * ((evalI g q : Int) : ℚ)
proof:
:= by
  simp only [evalI]
  push_cast
  rw [ha, hb, hc, hd]
  ring

name: signI_posMul
statement:
theorem signI_posMul {g g' : IPlane} (h : MeshIntersectPlaneH.PosMul g g') (q : H4) :
    signI g' q = signI g q
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨ρ, hρ, ha, hb, hc, hd⟩ := h
  exact sc_sign hρ (evalI_posMul ha hb hc hd q)

name: cutVtx_posMul
statement:
theorem cutVtx_posMul {g g' : IPlane} (h : MeshIntersectPlaneH.PosMul g g') (A B : Vtx) :
    cutVtx g' A B = cutVtx g A B
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨ρ, hρ, ha, hb, hc, hd⟩ := h
  have hnum : ((evalI g' A.h * B.h.w : Int) : ℚ) = ρ * ((evalI g A.h * B.h.w : Int) : ℚ) := by
    push_cast
    rw [evalI_posMul ha hb hc hd A.h]
    ring
  have hden : ((evalI g' A.h * B.h.w - evalI g' B.h * A.h.w : Int) : ℚ)
      = ρ * ((evalI g A.h * B.h.w - evalI g B.h * A.h.w : Int) : ℚ) := by
    push_cast
    rw [evalI_posMul ha hb hc hd A.h, evalI_posMul ha hb hc hd B.h]
    ring
  have ht : ((evalI g' A.h * B.h.w : Int) : ℚ)
        / ((evalI g' A.h * B.h.w - evalI g' B.h * A.h.w : Int) : ℚ)
      = ((evalI g A.h * B.h.w : Int) : ℚ)
        / ((evalI g A.h * B.h.w - evalI g B.h * A.h.w : Int) : ℚ) := by
    rw [hnum, hden, mul_div_mul_left _ _ (ne_of_gt hρ)]
  simp only [cutVtx]
  rw [ht]

statement: theorem ofPoint_trPoint (O q : Point) : ofPoint (trPoint O q) = psubS (ofPoint q) (ofPoint O)
proof:

name: matFace_trTri
statement:
theorem matFace_trTri (O : Point) (t : Triangle) :
    matFace (trTri O t) = trFaceS (ofPoint O) (matFace t)
proof:
:= by
  simp only [matFace, trFaceS, trVtx, trTri, ofPoint_trPoint, mkVtx_p, iFacePlaneP, mkVtx]

statement:
theorem prepFace_trFaceS (o : P3) (f : FaceS) :
    prepFace (trFaceS o f) = trPFace o (prepFace f)

name: materialize_tr
statement:
theorem materialize_tr (O : Point) (M : Mesh) :
    materialize (trMesh O M) = (materialize M).map (trFaceS (ofPoint O))
proof:
:= by
  rw [materialize_eq_map, trMesh, Array.map_map, materialize_eq_map, Array.map_map]

name: prepare_materialize_tr

    prepare (materialize (trMesh O M)) = (prepare (materialize M)).map (trPFace (ofPoint O))
proof:

  have hfun : prepFace ∘ trFaceS (ofPoint O) = trPFace (ofPoint O) ∘ prepFace := by
    funext f; exact prepFace_trFaceS (ofPoint O) f

name: vecOf_apply
statement:
private theorem vecOf_apply (L : Point →ₗ[ℚ] ℚ) (x : Point) :
    L x = ∑ i, vecOf L i * x i
proof:
:= by
  have hx : x = ∑ i, x i • (Pi.single i (1 : ℚ) : Point) := by
    ext j; simp [Pi.single_apply, Finset.sum_ite_eq]
  calc L x = L (∑ i, x i • (Pi.single i (1 : ℚ) : Point)) := by rw [← hx]
    _ = ∑ i, x i • L (Pi.single i (1 : ℚ) : Point) := by rw [map_sum]; simp only [map_smul]
    _ = ∑ i, vecOf L i * x i := by
          simp only [vecOf, smul_eq_mul]
          exact Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun i _ => mul_comm _ _)

name: vecOf_eq_zero_iff
statement: private theorem vecOf_eq_zero_iff (L : Point →ₗ[ℚ] ℚ) : vecOf L = 0 ↔ L = 0
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro h
    apply LinearMap.ext; intro x
    rw [vecOf_apply L x, h]; simp
  · intro h; rw [h]; ext i; simp [vecOf]

name: defaultPlane_isPlane
statement: private theorem defaultPlane_isPlane : IsPlane defaultPlane
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨(1 : Point), 0, ?_, rfl⟩
  intro hcon
  have := congrFun hcon 0
  simp at this

name: mkPlane_isPlane
statement: private theorem mkPlane_isPlane (L : Point →ₗ[ℚ] ℚ) : IsPlane (mkPlane L)
proof:
:= by
  unfold mkPlane
  by_cases h : L = 0
  · simp only [h, if_pos]; exact defaultPlane_isPlane
  · simp only [h, if_neg, not_false_iff]
    refine ⟨vecOf L, 0, ?_, rfl⟩
    rw [Ne, vecOf_eq_zero_iff]; exact h

name: mem_mkPlane_of
statement:
private theorem mem_mkPlane_of (L : Point →ₗ[ℚ] ℚ) (hL : L ≠ 0) {x : Point}
    (hx : L x = 0) : x ∈ mkPlane L
proof:
:= by
  unfold mkPlane
  simp only [hL, if_neg, not_false_iff, Set.mem_setOf_eq]
  rw [← vecOf_apply L x]; exact hx

name: affineIndependent_origin_apex
statement:
