theorem affineIndependent_origin_apex (gℓ : Point →ᵃ[ℚ] ℚ)
    {p q r : Point} (houter : 0 < gℓ 0)
    (hp : gℓ p = 0) (hq : gℓ q = 0) (hr : gℓ r = 0)
    (hbase : AffineIndependent ℚ ![p, q, r]) :
    AffineIndependent ℚ ![(0 : Point), p, q, r]
proof:
:= by
  set pts : Fin 4 → Point := ![(0 : Point), p, q, r] with hpts
  
  
  have key : ∀ w : Fin 4 → ℚ, ∑ i, w i = 0 → ∑ i, w i • pts i = 0 → ∀ i, w i = 0 := by
    intro w hw hcomb
    
    have hlin : ∑ i, w i * (gℓ.linear (pts i)) = 0 := by
      have : gℓ.linear (∑ i, w i • pts i) = 0 := by rw [hcomb]; simp
      rw [map_sum] at this
      simpa [map_smul, smul_eq_mul] using this
    have hval : ∀ i, gℓ.linear (pts i) = gℓ (pts i) - gℓ 0 := by
      intro i
      have hd : gℓ (pts i) = gℓ.linear (pts i) + gℓ 0 := by
        rw [AffineMap.decomp gℓ]; simp
      linarith [hd]
    have hgval : ∀ i, gℓ (pts i) = if i = 0 then gℓ 0 else 0 := by
      intro i
      fin_cases i <;> simp [hpts, hp, hq, hr]
    have hsum_split : ∑ i, w i * (gℓ.linear (pts i)) = w 0 * gℓ 0 := by
      have hrw : ∑ i, w i * (gℓ.linear (pts i))
          = ∑ i, w i * (gℓ (pts i) - gℓ 0) := by
        apply Finset.sum_congr rfl; intro i _; rw [hval i]
      rw [hrw]
      have hsd : ∑ i, w i * (gℓ (pts i) - gℓ 0)
          = (∑ i, w i * gℓ (pts i)) - gℓ 0 * (∑ i, w i) := by
        rw [Finset.mul_sum, ← Finset.sum_sub_distrib]
        apply Finset.sum_congr rfl; intro i _; ring
      rw [hsd, hw, mul_zero, sub_zero]
      rw [show (∑ i, w i * gℓ (pts i)) = ∑ i, w i * (if i = 0 then gℓ 0 else 0) from
          Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun i _ => by rw [hgval i])]
      simp [Fin.sum_univ_four]
    have hw0 : w 0 = 0 := by
      have hz : w 0 * gℓ 0 = 0 := by rw [← hsum_split, hlin]
      rcases mul_eq_zero.mp hz with h | h
      · exact h
      · exact absurd h (ne_of_gt houter)
    
    rw [affineIndependent_iff] at hbase
    set w' : Fin 3 → ℚ := ![w 1, w 2, w 3] with hw'
    have hw'sum : ∑ i, w' i = 0 := by
      have hsum4 : w 0 + w 1 + w 2 + w 3 = 0 := by
        have := hw; rw [Fin.sum_univ_four] at this; linarith
      simp only [hw', Fin.sum_univ_three, Matrix.cons_val_zero, Matrix.cons_val_one,
        Matrix.head_cons, Matrix.cons_val_two, Matrix.tail_cons]
      linarith [hw0, hsum4]
    have hw'comb : ∑ i, w' i • (![p, q, r] : Fin 3 → Point) i = 0 := by
      have hc := hcomb
      rw [Fin.sum_univ_four] at hc
      simp only [hpts, Matrix.cons_val_zero, Matrix.cons_val_one, Matrix.head_cons,
        Matrix.cons_val_two, Matrix.tail_cons, Matrix.cons_val_three] at hc
      rw [hw0, zero_smul, zero_add] at hc
      simp only [hw', Fin.sum_univ_three, Matrix.cons_val_zero, Matrix.cons_val_one,
        Matrix.head_cons, Matrix.cons_val_two, Matrix.tail_cons]
      exact hc
    have hbz := hbase Finset.univ w' hw'sum hw'comb
    intro i
    fin_cases i
    · exact hw0
    · exact hbz 0 (Finset.mem_univ _)
    · exact hbz 1 (Finset.mem_univ _)
    · exact hbz 2 (Finset.mem_univ _)
  
  rw [affineIndependent_iff]
  intro s w hsum hcomb e he
  
  set w0 : Fin 4 → ℚ := fun i => if i ∈ s then w i else 0 with hw0def
  have hsum0 : ∑ i, w0 i = 0 := by
    rw [← hsum]
    rw [← Finset.sum_filter_add_sum_filter_not Finset.univ (· ∈ s) w0]
    have h1 : ∑ i ∈ Finset.univ.filter (· ∈ s), w0 i = ∑ i ∈ s, w i := by
      rw [Finset.filter_mem_eq_inter, Finset.univ_inter]
      apply Finset.sum_congr rfl; intro i hi; simp [hw0def, hi]
    have h2 : ∑ i ∈ Finset.univ.filter (¬ · ∈ s), w0 i = 0 := by
      apply Finset.sum_eq_zero; intro i hi
      rw [Finset.mem_filter] at hi; simp [hw0def, hi.2]
    rw [h1, h2, add_zero]
  have hcomb0 : ∑ i, w0 i • pts i = 0 := by
    rw [← hcomb]
    rw [← Finset.sum_filter_add_sum_filter_not Finset.univ (· ∈ s) (fun i => w0 i • pts i)]
    have h1 : ∑ i ∈ Finset.univ.filter (· ∈ s), w0 i • pts i = ∑ i ∈ s, w i • pts i := by
      rw [Finset.filter_mem_eq_inter, Finset.univ_inter]
      apply Finset.sum_congr rfl; intro i hi; simp [hw0def, hi]
    have h2 : ∑ i ∈ Finset.univ.filter (¬ · ∈ s), w0 i • pts i = 0 := by
      apply Finset.sum_eq_zero; intro i hi
      rw [Finset.mem_filter] at hi; simp [hw0def, hi.2]
    rw [h1, h2, add_zero]
  have := key w0 hsum0 hcomb0 e
  simpa [hw0def, he] using this

name: winding_eq_zero_of_not_mem
proof:
:= by
  unfold winding
  apply List.sum_eq_zero
  intro y hy
  rw [List.mem_map] at hy
  obtain ⟨e, he, rfl⟩ := hy
  rw [if_neg]
  intro hmem
  exact hQ (hsub e he hmem)

name: winding_eq_card_of_coeff_one
proof:
:= by
  unfold winding
  apply congrArg List.sum
  apply List.map_congr_left
  intro e he
  rw [hcoeff e he]

name: vectorSpan_convexHull_eq
statement:
private theorem vectorSpan_convexHull_eq (S : Set Point) :
    vectorSpan ℚ ((convexHull ℚ) S) = vectorSpan ℚ S
proof:
:= by
  rw [← direction_affineSpan, ← direction_affineSpan, affineSpan_convexHull]

name: coplanar_simplex_of_not_affineIndependent
proof:
:= by
  have hle : Module.finrank ℚ
      (vectorSpan ℚ (Set.range ![(0 : Point), t.v₀, t.v₁, t.v₂])) ≤ 2 := by
    rw [finrank_vectorSpan_le_iff_not_affineIndependent ℚ _ (n := 2) (by simp)]
    exact h
  have hrange : Set.range ![(0 : Point), t.v₀, t.v₁, t.v₂]
      = ({0, t.v₀, t.v₁, t.v₂} : Set Point) := by
    ext x; constructor
    · rintro ⟨i, rfl⟩; fin_cases i <;> simp
    · rintro (rfl | rfl | rfl | rfl)
      exacts [⟨0, rfl⟩, ⟨1, rfl⟩, ⟨2, rfl⟩, ⟨3, rfl⟩]
  rw [hrange] at hle
  rw [show simplex t = (convexHull ℚ) ({0, t.v₀, t.v₁, t.v₂} : Set Point) from rfl,
    coplanar_iff_finrank_le_two, vectorSpan_convexHull_eq]
  exact hle

name: affineIndependent_of_not_coplanar_inter
proof:
:= by
  by_contra h
  exact hco ((coplanar_simplex_of_not_affineIndependent t h).subset hKsub)

name: affineZero_isPlane
statement:
private theorem affineZero_isPlane (g : Point →ᵃ[ℚ] ℚ) (hg : g.linear ≠ 0) :
    IsPlane {x : Point | g x = 0}
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨vecOf g.linear, -g 0, ?_, ?_⟩
  · rw [Ne, vecOf_eq_zero_iff]; exact hg
  · ext x
    simp only [Set.mem_setOf_eq]
    have hd : g x = (∑ i, vecOf g.linear i * x i) + g 0 := by
      have h1 : g x = g.linear x + g 0 := by rw [AffineMap.decomp g]; simp
      rw [h1, vecOf_apply g.linear x]
    rw [hd]; constructor <;> intro h <;> linarith

name: linIndep_pair_of_origin
statement:
private theorem linIndep_pair_of_origin (p q : Point)
    (h : AffineIndependent ℚ ![(0 : Point), p, q]) : LinearIndependent ℚ ![p, q]
proof:
:= by
  rw [affineIndependent_iff] at h
  rw [LinearIndependent.pair_iff]
  intro s t hst
  set w : Fin 3 → ℚ := ![-(s + t), s, t] with hw
  have hwsum : ∑ i, w i = 0 := by
    simp only [hw, Fin.sum_univ_three, Matrix.cons_val_zero, Matrix.cons_val_one,
      Matrix.head_cons, Matrix.cons_val_two, Matrix.tail_cons]; ring
  have hwcomb : ∑ i, w i • (![(0 : Point), p, q] i) = 0 := by
    simp only [hw, Fin.sum_univ_three, Matrix.cons_val_zero, Matrix.cons_val_one,
      Matrix.head_cons, Matrix.cons_val_two, Matrix.tail_cons]
    rw [smul_zero, zero_add]; exact hst
  have := h Finset.univ w hwsum hwcomb
  exact ⟨this 1 (Finset.mem_univ _), this 2 (Finset.mem_univ _)⟩

name: fanEdge_pairs_linIndep
statement:
private theorem fanEdge_pairs_linIndep (a b c : Point)
    (h : AffineIndependent ℚ ![(0 : Point), a, b, c]) :
    LinearIndependent ℚ ![a, b]
      ∧ LinearIndependent ℚ ![b, c]
      ∧ LinearIndependent ℚ ![b, a]
proof:
:= by
  
  have sub : ∀ (e : Fin 3 ↪ Fin 4) (x y : Point),
      (![(0 : Point), a, b, c] ∘ e) = ![(0 : Point), x, y] → LinearIndependent ℚ ![x, y] := by
    intro e x y heq
    have h3 := h.comp_embedding e
    rw [heq] at h3
    exact linIndep_pair_of_origin x y h3
  refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · exact sub ⟨![0, 1, 2], by decide⟩ a b (by funext i; fin_cases i <;> simp [Function.comp])
  · exact sub ⟨![0, 2, 3], by decide⟩ b c (by funext i; fin_cases i <;> simp [Function.comp])
  · exact sub ⟨![0, 2, 1], by decide⟩ b a (by funext i; fin_cases i <;> simp [Function.comp])

name: negligible_biUnion
statement:
private theorem negligible_biUnion {ι : Type*} (s : Finset ι) {N : ι → Set Point}
    (h : ∀ i ∈ s, Negligible (N i)) : Negligible (⋃ i ∈ s, N i)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have heq : (⋃ i ∈ s, N i) = ⋃ (i : {x // x ∈ s}), N i := by
    ext x; simp only [Set.mem_iUnion, Subtype.exists]
  rw [heq]
  exact Proof.Negligible.negligible_iUnion_fintype (fun i => h i.1 i.2)

name: negligible_of_isPlane
statement: private theorem negligible_of_isPlane {H : Set Point} (h : IsPlane H) : Negligible H
proof:
:=
  ⟨1, fun _ => H, fun _ => h, fun _x hx => Set.mem_iUnion.mpr ⟨0, hx⟩⟩

name: flatMap_double_sum
statement:
private theorem flatMap_double_sum {m : ℕ} (R : Finset (Fin m)) (rr : Fin m → ℕ)
    (f : Fin m → ℕ → ℤ) :
    ((R.toList.flatMap fun i =>
      (Finset.range (rr i - 2)).toList.map fun k => f i k)).sum
    = ∑ i ∈ R, ∑ k ∈ Finset.range (rr i - 2), f i k
proof:
:= by
  rw [List.flatMap_def, List.sum_flatten, List.map_map]
  have hcomp : (List.sum ∘ fun i => (Finset.range (rr i - 2)).toList.map fun k => f i k)
       = (fun i => ∑ k ∈ Finset.range (rr i - 2), f i k) := by
    funext i
    simp only [Function.comp_apply]
    rw [← Finset.sum_to_list (Finset.range (rr i - 2)) (fun k => f i k)]
  rw [hcomp, ← Finset.sum_to_list R (fun i => ∑ k ∈ Finset.range (rr i - 2), f i k)]

name: vspan_zeroset_le_ker
statement:
private theorem vspan_zeroset_le_ker (g : Point →ᵃ[ℚ] ℚ) :
    vectorSpan ℚ {x : Point | g x = 0} ≤ LinearMap.ker g.linear
proof:
:= by
  rw [vectorSpan_def, Submodule.span_le]
  rintro v ⟨a, ha, b, hb, rfl⟩
  simp only [SetLike.mem_coe, LinearMap.mem_ker]
  have hv : g.linear (a -ᵥ b) = g a - g b := by rw [AffineMap.linearMap_vsub, vsub_eq_sub]
  rw [hv, Set.mem_setOf_eq.mp ha, Set.mem_setOf_eq.mp hb, sub_zero]

name: cell_finrank_le_two
statement:
private theorem cell_finrank_le_two (g : Point →ᵃ[ℚ] ℚ) (hg : g.linear ≠ 0) (K : Set Point) :
    Module.finrank ℚ (vectorSpan ℚ ({x : Point | g x = 0} ∩ K)) ≤ 2
proof:
:= by
  have hmono : Module.finrank ℚ (vectorSpan ℚ ({x : Point | g x = 0} ∩ K))
      ≤ Module.finrank ℚ (vectorSpan ℚ {x : Point | g x = 0}) :=
    Submodule.finrank_mono (vectorSpan_mono ℚ Set.inter_subset_left)
  have hker : Module.finrank ℚ (vectorSpan ℚ {x : Point | g x = 0})
      ≤ Module.finrank ℚ (LinearMap.ker g.linear) :=
    Submodule.finrank_mono (vspan_zeroset_le_ker g)
  
  have hkdim : Module.finrank ℚ (LinearMap.ker g.linear) = 2 := by
    have hrk : Module.finrank ℚ (LinearMap.range g.linear)
        + Module.finrank ℚ (LinearMap.ker g.linear) = Module.finrank ℚ Point :=
      g.linear.finrank_range_add_finrank_ker
    have hran : LinearMap.range g.linear = ⊤ := Module.Dual.range_eq_top_of_ne_zero hg
    have hran1 : Module.finrank ℚ (LinearMap.range g.linear) = 1 := by
      rw [hran, finrank_top]; simp [Module.finrank_self]
    have hp : Module.finrank ℚ Point = 3 := by simp [Point, Module.finrank_pi]
    rw [hran1, hp] at hrk; omega
  rw [hkdim] at hker
  omega

name: double_indicator_unique
statement:
private theorem double_indicator_unique {m : ℕ} (R : Finset (Fin m)) (rr : Fin m → ℕ)
    (P : Fin m → ℕ → Prop) [∀ i k, Decidable (P i k)]
    (hex : ∃! p : (Fin m) × ℕ,
      p.1 ∈ R ∧ p.2 ∈ Finset.range (rr p.1 - 2) ∧ P p.1 p.2) :
    ∑ i ∈ R, ∑ k ∈ Finset.range (rr i - 2), (if P i k then (1 : ℤ) else 0) = 1
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨⟨i0, k0⟩, ⟨hi0, hk0, hP0⟩, huniq⟩ := hex
  rw [Finset.sum_eq_single i0]
  · rw [Finset.sum_eq_single k0]
    · rw [if_pos hP0]
    · intro k hk hkne
      rw [if_neg]; intro hP
      exact hkne (congrArg Prod.snd (huniq (i0, k) ⟨hi0, hk, hP⟩))
    · intro hk0notin; exact absurd hk0 hk0notin
  · intro i hi hine
    apply Finset.sum_eq_zero
    intro k hk
    rw [if_neg]; intro hP
    exact hine (congrArg Prod.fst (huniq (i, k) ⟨hi, hk, hP⟩))
  · intro hi0notin; exact absurd hi0 hi0notin

name: exit_cell_fan_exists
statement:
theorem exit_cell_fan_exists {m : ℕ} (gℓ : Point →ᵃ[ℚ] ℚ)
    (g : Fin m → (Point →ᵃ[ℚ] ℚ)) (K : Set Point)
    (hK : K = ⋂ j, {x | 0 ≤ g j x}) (_h0 : (0 : Point) ∈ K) (houter : 0 < gℓ 0)
    (hbdd : ∃ tB : Triangle, K ⊆ simplex tB)
    (hdim : Module.finrank ℚ (vectorSpan ℚ ({x : Point | gℓ x = 0} ∩ K)) = 2) :
    ∃ (r : ℕ) (u : ℕ → Point), 3 ≤ r
      ∧ ({x : Point | gℓ x = 0} ∩ K)
          = ⋃ k ∈ Finset.range (r - 2),
              convexHull ℚ {u 0, u (k + 1), u (k + 2)}
      ∧ (∀ k ∈ Finset.range (r - 2),
          AffineIndependent ℚ ![(0 : Point), u 0, u (k + 1), u (k + 2)])
      
      
      
      
      ∧ (∀ a ∈ Finset.range (r - 2), ∀ b ∈ Finset.range (r - 2), a ≠ b →
          (convexHull ℚ {u 0, u (a + 1), u (a + 2)}
            ∩ convexHull ℚ {u 0, u (b + 1), u (b + 2)})
          ⊆ ⋃ kk ∈ Finset.range (r - 2),
              (convexHull ℚ {u 0, u (kk + 1)} ∪ convexHull ℚ {u (kk + 1), u (kk + 2)}))
proof:
:= by
  classical
  set P : Set Point := {x : Point | gℓ x = 0} ∩ K with hP
  
  
  set G : Fin (m + 2) → (Point →ᵃ[ℚ] ℚ) := Fin.append g ![gℓ, -gℓ] with hG
  have hPeq : P = ⋂ i, {x : Point | 0 ≤ G i x} := by
    rw [hP, hK]
    ext x
    simp only [Set.mem_inter_iff, Set.mem_iInter, Set.mem_setOf_eq]
    constructor
    · rintro ⟨hgℓx, hKx⟩
      intro i
      refine Fin.addCases ?_ ?_ i
      · intro j
        simp only [hG, Fin.append_left]
        exact hKx j
      · intro j
        simp only [hG, Fin.append_right]
        fin_cases j
        · show 0 ≤ gℓ x; exact le_of_eq hgℓx.symm
        · show 0 ≤ (-gℓ) x
          simp only [AffineMap.coe_neg, Pi.neg_apply]
          rw [hgℓx]; norm_num
    · intro hall
      refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
      · 
        have hpos : 0 ≤ gℓ x := by
          have := hall (Fin.natAdd m 0)
          simpa [hG, Fin.append_right] using this
        have hneg : 0 ≤ (-gℓ) x := by
          have := hall (Fin.natAdd m 1)
          simpa [hG, Fin.append_right] using this
        simp only [AffineMap.coe_neg, Pi.neg_apply] at hneg
        linarith
      · intro j
        have := hall (Fin.castAdd 2 j)
        simpa [hG, Fin.append_left] using this
  
  have hbddP : ∃ tB : Triangle, P ⊆ simplex tB := by
    obtain ⟨tB, htB⟩ := hbdd
    exact ⟨tB, (Set.inter_subset_right.trans htB)⟩
  
  
  obtain ⟨r, u, hr, hcover, hdisj, hnondeg⟩ :=
    Proof.ConvexPolygonFan.bounded_rational_planar_Hpolygon_has_cyclic_vertex_list
      G P hPeq hbddP hdim
  
  have hcover' : P = ⋃ k ∈ Finset.range (r - 2),
      convexHull ℚ {u 0, u (k + 1), u (k + 2)} := by
    rw [hcover]; rfl
  
  
  have hdisj' : ∀ a ∈ Finset.range (r - 2), ∀ b ∈ Finset.range (r - 2), a ≠ b →
      (convexHull ℚ {u 0, u (a + 1), u (a + 2)}
        ∩ convexHull ℚ {u 0, u (b + 1), u (b + 2)})
      ⊆ ⋃ kk ∈ Finset.range (r - 2),
          (convexHull ℚ {u 0, u (kk + 1)} ∪ convexHull ℚ {u (kk + 1), u (kk + 2)}) :=
    hdisj
  refine ⟨r, u, hr, hcover', ?_, hdisj'⟩
  
  
  
  
  intro k hk
  
  have hbaseP : ∀ p ∈ ({u 0, u (k + 1), u (k + 2)} : Set Point), p ∈ P := by
    intro p hp
    rw [hcover']
    refine Set.mem_iUnion₂.mpr ⟨k, hk, ?_⟩
    exact subset_convexHull ℚ _ hp
  have hgℓ0 : gℓ (u 0) = 0 := (hbaseP _ (by simp)).1
  have hgℓ1 : gℓ (u (k + 1)) = 0 :=
    (hbaseP _ (by simp)).1
  have hgℓ2 : gℓ (u (k + 2)) = 0 :=
    (hbaseP _ (by simp)).1
  
  
  
  have hbaseAI : AffineIndependent ℚ ![u 0, u (k + 1), u (k + 2)] := hnondeg k hk
  exact affineIndependent_origin_apex gℓ houter hgℓ0 hgℓ1 hgℓ2 hbaseAI

name: edge_cone_excludes
statement:
theorem edge_cone_excludes {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι] (g : ι → (Point →ᵃ[ℚ] ℚ)) :
    ∃ (k : ℕ) (Sig : Fin k → Set Point), (∀ i, IsPlane (Sig i))
      ∧ ∀ {Q : Point} (ρ : ℚ), Q ≠ 0 → 0 < ρ →
          (∀ {ℓ ℓ' : ι},
              LinearIndependent ℚ ![(g ℓ).linear, (g ℓ').linear] →
              g ℓ (ρ • Q) = 0 → g ℓ' (ρ • Q) = 0 →
            Q ∈ (⋃ i, Sig i))
proof:
:= by
  classical
  
  
  
  set M : ι → ι → (Point →ₗ[ℚ] ℚ) :=
    fun ℓ ℓ' => (g ℓ' 0) • (g ℓ).linear - (g ℓ 0) • (g ℓ').linear with hM
  
  
  set fam : ι × ι × Fin 3 → Set Point :=
    fun p =>
      match p.2.2 with
      | 0 => mkPlane (M p.1 p.2.1)
      | 1 => mkPlane (g p.1).linear
      | _ => mkPlane (g p.2.1).linear with hfam
  set e : Fin (Fintype.card (ι × ι × Fin 3)) ≃ (ι × ι × Fin 3) :=
    (Fintype.equivFin (ι × ι × Fin 3)).symm with he
  refine ⟨Fintype.card (ι × ι × Fin 3), fam ∘ e, ?_, ?_⟩
  · 
    intro i
    simp only [Function.comp_apply, hfam]
    obtain ⟨a, b, j⟩ := e i
    fin_cases j <;> exact mkPlane_isPlane _
  · 
    
    intro Q ρ hQ hρ ℓ ℓ' hindep hgℓ hgℓ'
    
    
    have hLℓ_ne : (g ℓ).linear ≠ 0 := by
      have := hindep.ne_zero (0 : Fin 2)
      simpa using this
    have hLℓ'_ne : (g ℓ').linear ≠ 0 := by
      have := hindep.ne_zero (1 : Fin 2)
      simpa using this
    
    have hexpand : ∀ h : Point →ᵃ[ℚ] ℚ, h (ρ • Q) = h 0 + ρ * h.linear Q := by
      intro h
      have hd : h (ρ • Q) = h.linear (ρ • Q) + h 0 := by rw [AffineMap.decomp h]; simp
      rw [hd, map_smul, smul_eq_mul]; ring
    have hLℓ : g ℓ 0 + ρ * (g ℓ).linear Q = 0 := by rw [← hexpand]; exact hgℓ
    have hLℓ' : g ℓ' 0 + ρ * (g ℓ').linear Q = 0 := by rw [← hexpand]; exact hgℓ'
    
    have hMQ : (M ℓ ℓ') Q = 0 := by
      have hρne : ρ ≠ 0 := ne_of_gt hρ
      have key : ρ * ((M ℓ ℓ') Q) = 0 := by
        simp only [hM, LinearMap.sub_apply, LinearMap.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul]
        
        
        
        have e1 : ρ * (g ℓ).linear Q = -(g ℓ 0) := by linarith [hLℓ]
        have e2 : ρ * (g ℓ').linear Q = -(g ℓ' 0) := by linarith [hLℓ']
        have expand : ρ * ((g ℓ' 0) * (g ℓ).linear Q - (g ℓ 0) * (g ℓ').linear Q)
            = (g ℓ' 0) * (ρ * (g ℓ).linear Q) - (g ℓ 0) * (ρ * (g ℓ').linear Q) := by ring
        rw [expand, e1, e2]; ring
      rcases mul_eq_zero.mp key with h | h
      · exact absurd h hρne
      · exact h
    
    have mem_fam : ∀ (a b : ι) (j : Fin 3) (x : Point),
        x ∈ fam (a, b, j) → x ∈ ⋃ i, (fam ∘ e) i := by
      intro a b j x hx
      refine Set.mem_iUnion.mpr ⟨e.symm (a, b, j), ?_⟩
      simp only [Function.comp_apply, he, Equiv.apply_symm_apply]
      simpa [he] using hx
    
    by_cases hM0 : M ℓ ℓ' = 0
    · 
      by_cases ha : g ℓ 0 = 0
      · 
        have hLℓQ : (g ℓ).linear Q = 0 := by
          have : ρ * (g ℓ).linear Q = 0 := by linarith [hLℓ]
          rcases mul_eq_zero.mp this with h | h
          · exact absurd h (ne_of_gt hρ)
          · exact h
        by_cases hLne : (g ℓ).linear = 0
        · 
          by_cases ha' : g ℓ' 0 = 0
          · have hLℓ'Q : (g ℓ').linear Q = 0 := by
              have : ρ * (g ℓ').linear Q = 0 := by linarith [hLℓ']
              rcases mul_eq_zero.mp this with h | h
              · exact absurd h (ne_of_gt hρ)
              · exact h
            by_cases hL'ne : (g ℓ').linear = 0
            · 
              
              exact absurd hL'ne hLℓ'_ne
            · exact mem_fam ℓ ℓ' 2 Q (mem_mkPlane_of _ hL'ne hLℓ'Q)
          · 
            
            
            exact absurd hLne hLℓ_ne
        · exact mem_fam ℓ ℓ' 1 Q (mem_mkPlane_of _ hLne hLℓQ)
      · 
        
        
        
        
        
        have hgℓ0_eq : g ℓ 0 = 0 := by
          
          
          have hdep : (g ℓ' 0) • (g ℓ).linear + (-(g ℓ 0)) • (g ℓ').linear
              = (0 : Point →ₗ[ℚ] ℚ) := by
            have := hM0; rw [hM] at this
            simpa [sub_eq_add_neg, neg_smul] using this
          rw [LinearIndependent.pair_iff] at hindep
          have hcoeff := hindep (g ℓ' 0) (-(g ℓ 0)) hdep
          
          linarith [hcoeff.2]
        exact absurd hgℓ0_eq ha
    · 
      exact mem_fam ℓ ℓ' 0 Q (mem_mkPlane_of _ hM0 hMQ)

name: finrank_point
statement: private theorem finrank_point : Module.finrank ℚ Point = 3
proof:
:= by
  simp [Point, Module.finrank_pi]

name: finrank_ker_of_ne_zero
statement:
private theorem finrank_ker_of_ne_zero (L : Point →ₗ[ℚ] ℚ) (hL : L ≠ 0) :
    Module.finrank ℚ (LinearMap.ker L) = 2
proof:
:= by
  classical
  
  have hrk : Module.finrank ℚ (LinearMap.range L) + Module.finrank ℚ (LinearMap.ker L)
      = Module.finrank ℚ Point := L.finrank_range_add_finrank_ker
  
  
  have hran : LinearMap.range L = ⊤ := Module.Dual.range_eq_top_of_ne_zero hL
  have hran1 : Module.finrank ℚ (LinearMap.range L) = 1 := by
    rw [hran, finrank_top]; simp [Module.finrank_self]
  rw [hran1, finrank_point] at hrk
  omega

name: exists_two_indep_ker
proof:
:= by
  classical
  
  have hdim := finrank_ker_of_ne_zero L hL
  haveI : FiniteDimensional ℚ (LinearMap.ker L) := FiniteDimensional.finiteDimensional_submodule _
  let b := Module.finBasisOfFinrankEq ℚ (LinearMap.ker L) hdim
  refine ⟨(b 0 : Point), (b 1 : Point), ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · exact (b 0).2
  · exact (b 1).2
  · 
    
    have hbi : LinearIndependent ℚ (fun i : Fin 2 => (b i : Point)) := by
      have hb := b.linearIndependent
      have := hb.map' (LinearMap.ker L).subtype (by simp)
      simpa using this
    
    have heq : (fun i : Fin 2 => (b i : Point)) = ![(b 0 : Point), (b 1 : Point)] := by
      funext i; fin_cases i <;> simp
    rwa [heq] at hbi

name: indep_of_distinct_meeting
statement:
private theorem indep_of_distinct_meeting
    (f h : Point →ᵃ[ℚ] ℚ) (hf : f.linear ≠ 0) (hh : h.linear ≠ 0)
    {p : Point} (hfp : f p = 0) (hhp : h p = 0)
    (hne : {x | f x = 0} ≠ {x | h x = 0}) :
    LinearIndependent ℚ ![f.linear, h.linear]
proof:
:= by
  classical
  rw [LinearIndependent.pair_iff]
  intro s t hst
  
  
  
  
  by_contra hcon
  
  have hs : s ≠ 0 := by
    intro h0
    apply hcon
    refine ⟨h0, ?_⟩
    rw [h0, zero_smul, zero_add] at hst
    rcases smul_eq_zero.mp hst with h1 | h1
    · exact h1
    · exact absurd h1 hh
  have ht : t ≠ 0 := by
    intro h0
    apply hcon
    refine ⟨?_, h0⟩
    rw [h0, zero_smul, add_zero] at hst
    rcases smul_eq_zero.mp hst with h1 | h1
    · exact h1
    · exact absurd h1 hf
  
  set c : ℚ := -(t / s) with hc
  have hcne : c ≠ 0 := by simp only [hc, neg_ne_zero]; exact div_ne_zero ht hs
  have hprop : f.linear = c • h.linear := by
    have hfe : s • f.linear = -(t • h.linear) := by
      rw [eq_comm, neg_eq_iff_add_eq_zero, add_comm]; exact hst
    have hf1 : f.linear = s⁻¹ • (-(t • h.linear)) := by
      rw [← hfe, smul_smul, inv_mul_cancel₀ hs, one_smul]
    rw [hf1, smul_neg, smul_smul]
    have hsc : -(s⁻¹ * t) = c := by rw [hc, div_eq_mul_inv, mul_comm]
    rw [← hsc, neg_smul]
  
  have hfun : ∀ x, f x = c * h x := by
    intro x
    have hfx : f x = f.linear (x -ᵥ p) + f p := by
      conv_lhs => rw [show x = (x -ᵥ p) +ᵥ p by simp]
      rw [AffineMap.map_vadd]; simp
    have hhx : h x = h.linear (x -ᵥ p) + h p := by
      conv_lhs => rw [show x = (x -ᵥ p) +ᵥ p by simp]
      rw [AffineMap.map_vadd]; simp
    rw [hfx, hhx, hfp, hhp, add_zero, add_zero, hprop, LinearMap.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul]
  
  apply hne
  ext x
  simp only [Set.mem_setOf_eq, hfun x, mul_eq_zero]
  constructor
  · rintro (h0 | h0)
    · exact absurd h0 hcne
    · exact h0
  · intro h0; exact Or.inr h0

name: perturb_along
statement:
private theorem perturb_along {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι] (g : ι → (Point →ᵃ[ℚ] ℚ))
    (K : Set Point) (hK : K = ⋂ j, {x | 0 ≤ g j x}) (a d : Point) (haK : a ∈ K)
    (hdich : ∀ j, (g j).linear d = 0 ∨ 0 < g j a) :
    ∃ ε : ℚ, 0 < ε ∧ (a + ε • d) ∈ K
proof:
:= by
  classical
  
  have hstep : ∀ (j : ι) (ε : ℚ), g j (a + ε • d) = g j a + ε * (g j).linear d := by
    intro j ε
    have hd : g j (a + ε • d) = (g j).linear (ε • d) + g j a := by
      rw [show (a + ε • d) = (ε • d) +ᵥ a by rw [vadd_eq_add]; ring]
      rw [AffineMap.map_vadd, vadd_eq_add]
    rw [hd, map_smul, smul_eq_mul]; ring
  
  
  set e : ι → ℚ := fun j => if 0 < g j a then g j a / (1 + |(g j).linear d|) else 1
    with he
  have he_pos : ∀ j, 0 < e j := by
    intro j
    simp only [he]
    by_cases hj : 0 < g j a
    · rw [if_pos hj]
      exact div_pos hj (by have := abs_nonneg ((g j).linear d); linarith)
    · rw [if_neg hj]; norm_num
  
  have hbound : ∀ (j : ι) (ε : ℚ), 0 < ε → ε ≤ e j → 0 ≤ g j (a + ε • d) := by
    intro j ε hεpos hεle
    rw [hstep j ε]
    rcases hdich j with hker | hpos
    · 
      rw [hker, mul_zero, add_zero]
      have : a ∈ {x | 0 ≤ g j x} := by rw [hK] at haK; exact Set.mem_iInter.mp haK j
      exact this
    · 
      
      have heval : e j = g j a / (1 + |(g j).linear d|) := by simp only [he, if_pos hpos]
      rw [heval] at hεle
      have hden : (0 : ℚ) < 1 + |(g j).linear d| := by
        have := abs_nonneg ((g j).linear d); linarith
      have hmul : ε * (1 + |(g j).linear d|) ≤ g j a := by
        rw [le_div_iff₀ hden] at hεle; exact hεle
      
      have hle1 : -(ε * |(g j).linear d|) ≤ ε * (g j).linear d :=
        neg_le_of_neg_le (by
          have := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (neg_abs_le ((g j).linear d)) (le_of_lt hεpos)
          rw [mul_neg] at this; linarith)
      have hle2 : ε * |(g j).linear d| ≤ g j a := by nlinarith [hmul, abs_nonneg ((g j).linear d)]
      linarith
  
  rcases isEmpty_or_nonempty ι with hempty | hne
  · 
    refine ⟨1, by norm_num, ?_⟩
    rw [hK]; simp only [Set.mem_iInter]; intro j; exact (IsEmpty.false j).elim
  · 
    haveI : Nonempty ι := hne
    obtain ⟨j0⟩ := hne
    set ε : ℚ := min 1 (Finset.univ.inf' ⟨j0, Finset.mem_univ _⟩ e) with hεdef
    have hinf_pos : 0 < Finset.univ.inf' ⟨j0, Finset.mem_univ _⟩ e := by
      rw [Finset.lt_inf'_iff]; intro j _; exact he_pos j
    have hεpos : 0 < ε := lt_min (by norm_num) hinf_pos
    refine ⟨ε, hεpos, ?_⟩
    rw [hK]; simp only [Set.mem_iInter, Set.mem_setOf_eq]
    intro j
    refine hbound j ε hεpos ?_
    calc ε ≤ Finset.univ.inf' ⟨j0, Finset.mem_univ _⟩ e := min_le_right _ _
      _ ≤ e j := Finset.inf'_le _ (Finset.mem_univ j)

name: cross_cell_uniqueness
statement:
theorem cross_cell_uniqueness {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι] (g : ι → (Point →ᵃ[ℚ] ℚ))
    (K : Set Point) (hK : K = ⋂ j, {x | 0 ≤ g j x})
    {Q : Point} (ρ : ℚ)
    (_hQK : Q ∈ K) (_hQ0 : Q ≠ 0) (_hρ : 0 < ρ)
    (hrhoK : (ρ • Q) ∈ K)                              
    (hbind : ∃ ℓ, 0 < g ℓ 0 ∧ g ℓ (ρ • Q) = 0)
    (hP0 : ∀ j, (g j).linear Q ≠ 0)
    (hdedup : ∀ ℓ ℓ', 0 < g ℓ 0 → 0 < g ℓ' 0 →        
              {x | g ℓ x = 0} ≠ {x | g ℓ' x = 0} →
              (∃ x, g ℓ x = 0 ∧ g ℓ' x = 0) →          
              LinearIndependent ℚ ![(g ℓ).linear, (g ℓ').linear])
    
    
    
    
    
    
    (ksig : ℕ) (Sigf : Fin ksig → Set Point) (_hSigPlanef : ∀ i, IsPlane (Sigf i))
    (hSigcovf : ∀ {ℓ ℓ' : ι}, LinearIndependent ℚ ![(g ℓ).linear, (g ℓ').linear] →
          g ℓ (ρ • Q) = 0 → g ℓ' (ρ • Q) = 0 → Q ∈ (⋃ i, Sigf i))
    (hQoffSig : Q ∉ (⋃ i, Sigf i)) :
    ∃ ℓ, (0 < g ℓ 0 ∧ g ℓ (ρ • Q) = 0)
      ∧ (∀ ℓ', 0 < g ℓ' 0 → g ℓ' (ρ • Q) = 0 →
           {x | g ℓ' x = 0} = {x | g ℓ x = 0})          
      ∧ 2 ≤ Module.finrank ℚ (vectorSpan ℚ ({x : Point | g ℓ x = 0} ∩ K))
proof:
:= by
  classical
  
  obtain ⟨ℓ, hℓouter, hℓexit⟩ := hbind
  
  
  
  
  
  
  
  
  
  
  
  
  
  
  have huniq : ∀ ℓ', 0 < g ℓ' 0 → g ℓ' (ρ • Q) = 0 →
      {x | g ℓ' x = 0} = {x | g ℓ x = 0} := by
    intro ℓ' hℓ'outer hℓ'exit
    by_contra hne
    
    have hne' : {x | g ℓ' x = 0} ≠ {x | g ℓ x = 0} := hne
    
    
    have hindep' : LinearIndependent ℚ ![(g ℓ').linear, (g ℓ).linear] :=
      hdedup ℓ' ℓ hℓ'outer hℓouter hne' ⟨ρ • Q, hℓ'exit, hℓexit⟩
    
    have hQin : Q ∈ (⋃ i, Sigf i) := hSigcovf hindep' hℓ'exit hℓexit
    exact hQoffSig hQin
  refine ⟨ℓ, ⟨hℓouter, hℓexit⟩, huniq, ?_⟩
  · 
    
    
    
    
    set Fℓ : Set Point := {x : Point | g ℓ x = 0} ∩ K with hFℓ
    
    
    have hQstarFℓ : (ρ • Q) ∈ Fℓ := ⟨hℓexit, hrhoK⟩
    
    suffices hpts : ∃ a b c : Point, a ∈ Fℓ ∧ b ∈ Fℓ ∧ c ∈ Fℓ
        ∧ AffineIndependent ℚ ![a, b, c] by
      obtain ⟨a, b, c, ha, hb, hc, hAI⟩ := hpts
      
      have hsub : ({a, b, c} : Set Point) ⊆ Fℓ := by
        intro x hx; rcases hx with rfl | rfl | rfl <;> assumption
      have hrange : Set.range ![a, b, c] = ({a, b, c} : Set Point) := by
        ext x; constructor
        · rintro ⟨i, rfl⟩; fin_cases i <;> simp
        · rintro (rfl | rfl | rfl)
          · exact ⟨0, rfl⟩
          · exact ⟨1, rfl⟩
          · exact ⟨2, rfl⟩
      have hrank3 : Module.finrank ℚ (vectorSpan ℚ ({a, b, c} : Set Point)) = 2 := by
        have := hAI.finrank_vectorSpan (n := 2) (by simp)
        rwa [hrange] at this
      have hmono : Module.finrank ℚ (vectorSpan ℚ ({a, b, c} : Set Point))
          ≤ Module.finrank ℚ (vectorSpan ℚ Fℓ) :=
        Submodule.finrank_mono (vectorSpan_mono ℚ hsub)
      rw [hrank3] at hmono
      exact hmono
    
    
    
    
    
    
    
    
    have hLℓne : (g ℓ).linear ≠ 0 := by
      intro h; exact hP0 ℓ (by rw [h]; rfl)
    obtain ⟨d₁, d₂, hd₁0, hd₂0, hdindep⟩ := exists_two_indep_ker (g ℓ).linear hLℓne
    
    
    
    
    
    
    
    
    
    
    
    
    
    
    
    
    
    
    
    
    
    have hdich : ∀ (d : Point), (g ℓ).linear d = 0 →
        ∀ j, (g j).linear d = 0 ∨ 0 < g j (ρ • Q) := by
      intro d hdℓ j
      
      have hge : 0 ≤ g j (ρ • Q) := by
        rw [hK] at hrhoK; exact Set.mem_iInter.mp hrhoK j
      rcases lt_or_eq_of_le hge with hpos | hzero
      · exact Or.inr hpos
      · 
        refine Or.inl ?_
        have hact : g j (ρ • Q) = 0 := hzero.symm
        by_cases hLjne : (g j).linear = 0
        · 
          rw [hLjne]; rfl
        · 
          by_cases hsame : {x | g j x = 0} = {x | g ℓ x = 0}
          · 
            have hℓshift : g ℓ (ρ • Q + d) = 0 := by
              have hd : g ℓ (ρ • Q + d) = (g ℓ).linear d + g ℓ (ρ • Q) := by
                rw [show (ρ • Q + d) = d +ᵥ (ρ • Q) by rw [vadd_eq_add]; ring]
                rw [AffineMap.map_vadd, vadd_eq_add]
              rw [hd, hdℓ, hℓexit, add_zero]
            have hmemℓ : (ρ • Q + d) ∈ {x | g ℓ x = 0} := hℓshift
            have hmemj : (ρ • Q + d) ∈ {x | g j x = 0} := by rw [hsame]; exact hmemℓ
            have hjshift : g j (ρ • Q + d) = 0 := hmemj
            have hd2 : g j (ρ • Q + d) = (g j).linear d + g j (ρ • Q) := by
              rw [show (ρ • Q + d) = d +ᵥ (ρ • Q) by rw [vadd_eq_add]; ring]
              rw [AffineMap.map_vadd, vadd_eq_add]
            rw [hd2, hact, add_zero] at hjshift
            exact hjshift
          · 
            exfalso
            have hindep : LinearIndependent ℚ ![(g j).linear, (g ℓ).linear] :=
              indep_of_distinct_meeting (g j) (g ℓ) hLjne hLℓne hact hℓexit hsame
            have hQin : Q ∈ (⋃ i, Sigf i) := hSigcovf hindep hact hℓexit
            exact hQoffSig hQin
    
    have hperturb : ∃ ε₁ ε₂ : ℚ, 0 < ε₁ ∧ 0 < ε₂
        ∧ (ρ • Q + ε₁ • d₁) ∈ K ∧ (ρ • Q + ε₂ • d₂) ∈ K := by
      obtain ⟨ε₁, hε₁pos, hε₁K⟩ :=
        perturb_along g K hK (ρ • Q) d₁ hrhoK (hdich d₁ hd₁0)
      obtain ⟨ε₂, hε₂pos, hε₂K⟩ :=
        perturb_along g K hK (ρ • Q) d₂ hrhoK (hdich d₂ hd₂0)
      exact ⟨ε₁, ε₂, hε₁pos, hε₂pos, hε₁K, hε₂K⟩
    obtain ⟨ε₁, ε₂, hε₁, hε₂, hK₁, hK₂⟩ := hperturb
    
    
    set a : Point := ρ • Q with ha
    set b : Point := ρ • Q + ε₁ • d₁ with hb
    set cc : Point := ρ • Q + ε₂ • d₂ with hcc
    
    
    have hgb : g ℓ b = 0 := by
      have : g ℓ b = g ℓ a + (g ℓ).linear (ε₁ • d₁) := by
        rw [hb, ha]
        rw [show (ρ • Q + ε₁ • d₁) = (ε₁ • d₁) +ᵥ (ρ • Q) by simp [add_comm]]
        rw [AffineMap.map_vadd, vadd_eq_add]; ring
      rw [this, ha, hℓexit, map_smul, hd₁0, smul_zero, add_zero]
    have hgc : g ℓ cc = 0 := by
      have : g ℓ cc = g ℓ a + (g ℓ).linear (ε₂ • d₂) := by
        rw [hcc, ha]
        rw [show (ρ • Q + ε₂ • d₂) = (ε₂ • d₂) +ᵥ (ρ • Q) by simp [add_comm]]
        rw [AffineMap.map_vadd, vadd_eq_add]; ring
      rw [this, ha, hℓexit, map_smul, hd₂0, smul_zero, add_zero]
    have haFℓ : a ∈ Fℓ := hQstarFℓ
    have hbFℓ : b ∈ Fℓ := ⟨hgb, hK₁⟩
    have hcFℓ : cc ∈ Fℓ := ⟨hgc, hK₂⟩
    
    refine ⟨a, b, cc, haFℓ, hbFℓ, hcFℓ, ?_⟩
    
    
    
    rw [affineIndependent_iff_linearIndependent_vsub ℚ _ (0 : Fin 3)]
    
    have hba : b -ᵥ a = ε₁ • d₁ := by rw [hb, ha]; simp [vsub_eq_sub]
    have hca : cc -ᵥ a = ε₂ • d₂ := by rw [hcc, ha]; simp [vsub_eq_sub]
    
    
    have hscaled : LinearIndependent ℚ ![ε₁ • d₁, ε₂ • d₂] := by
      have := hdindep
      rw [LinearIndependent.pair_iff] at this ⊢
      intro s t hst
      
      have hst' : (s * ε₁) • d₁ + (t * ε₂) • d₂ = 0 := by
        rw [mul_smul, mul_smul]; exact hst
      obtain ⟨h1, h2⟩ := this (s * ε₁) (t * ε₂) hst'
      constructor
      · rcases mul_eq_zero.mp h1 with h | h
        · exact h
        · exact absurd h (ne_of_gt hε₁)
      · rcases mul_eq_zero.mp h2 with h | h
        · exact h
        · exact absurd h (ne_of_gt hε₂)
    
    have hfun : (fun i : { x : Fin 3 // x ≠ 0 } => (![a, b, cc] ↑i) -ᵥ (![a, b, cc] 0))
        = (fun i : { x : Fin 3 // x ≠ 0 } =>
            ![ε₁ • d₁, ε₂ • d₂] (Fin.pred ↑i (i.2))) := by
      funext i
      obtain ⟨iv, hiv⟩ := i
      fin_cases iv
      · exact absurd rfl hiv
      · simp only [Fin.pred]
        show (![a, b, cc] 1) -ᵥ (![a, b, cc] 0) = _
        rw [show (![a, b, cc] 1) = b from rfl, show (![a, b, cc] 0) = a from rfl, hba]
        rfl
      · simp only [Fin.pred]
        show (![a, b, cc] 2) -ᵥ (![a, b, cc] 0) = _
        rw [show (![a, b, cc] 2) = cc from rfl, show (![a, b, cc] 0) = a from rfl, hca]
        rfl
    rw [hfun]
    
    
    exact hscaled.comp _ (fun i j hij => by
      apply Subtype.ext
      have := congrArg (Fin.succ) hij
      simpa [Fin.succ_pred] using this)

name: leaderExists
proof:
:= by
  classical
  set S : Finset (Fin m) :=
    Finset.univ.filter (fun j => Outer2D G K j ∧
      {x : Point | G j x = 0} = {x : Point | G i x = 0}) with hS
  have hiS : i ∈ S := by rw [hS, Finset.mem_filter]; exact ⟨Finset.mem_univ _, hi, rfl⟩
  obtain ⟨ℓ, hℓS, hℓmin⟩ := S.exists_min_image id ⟨i, hiS⟩
  rw [hS, Finset.mem_filter] at hℓS
  obtain ⟨_, hℓO, hℓZ⟩ := hℓS
  refine ⟨ℓ, ?_, hℓZ⟩
  rw [leaders, Finset.mem_filter]
  refine ⟨Finset.mem_univ _, hℓO, ?_⟩
  intro j hj hjO hjZeq
  have hjS : j ∈ S := by
    rw [hS, Finset.mem_filter]; exact ⟨Finset.mem_univ _, hjO, hjZeq.trans hℓZ⟩
  have hle := hℓmin j hjS
  simp only [id] at hle
  exact absurd hj (not_lt.mpr hle)

name: affine_eval_smul
statement:
private theorem affine_eval_smul (g : Point →ᵃ[ℚ] ℚ) (Q : Point) (μ : ℚ) :
    g (μ • Q) = g 0 + μ * g.linear Q
proof:
:= by
  have h : g (μ • Q) = g.linear (μ • Q) + g 0 := by rw [AffineMap.decomp g]; simp
  rw [h, map_smul, smul_eq_mul]; ring

name: radial_mult_eq
statement:
private theorem radial_mult_eq {K : Set Point} {Q : Point} {ρ μ : ℚ}
    (hfeas : {ν : ℚ | 0 ≤ ν ∧ ν • Q ∈ K} = Set.Icc 0 ρ)
    (hμpos : 0 < μ) (hμK : (μ • Q) ∈ K)
    {g : Point →ᵃ[ℚ] ℚ} (hgK : ∀ x ∈ K, 0 ≤ g x)
    (hg0 : 0 < g 0) (hgbind : g (μ • Q) = 0) :
    μ = ρ
proof:
:= by
  
  have hμIcc : μ ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℚ) ρ := by
    rw [← hfeas]; exact ⟨le_of_lt hμpos, hμK⟩
  have hμle : μ ≤ ρ := hμIcc.2
  
  have hval : g 0 + μ * g.linear Q = 0 := by rw [← affine_eval_smul]; exact hgbind
  have hlinneg : g.linear Q < 0 := by
    by_contra hcon
    push_neg at hcon  
    have : 0 < g 0 + μ * g.linear Q :=
      add_pos_of_pos_of_nonneg hg0 (mul_nonneg (le_of_lt hμpos) hcon)
    linarith
  
  
  have hρle : ρ ≤ μ := by
    by_contra hcon
    push_neg at hcon  
    set μ' : ℚ := (μ + ρ) / 2 with hμ'def
    have hμ'lo : μ < μ' := by rw [hμ'def]; linarith
    have hμ'hi : μ' ≤ ρ := by rw [hμ'def]; linarith
    have hμ'nn : 0 ≤ μ' := le_trans (le_of_lt hμpos) (le_of_lt hμ'lo)
    have hμ'feas : μ' • Q ∈ K := by
      have : μ' ∈ {ν : ℚ | 0 ≤ ν ∧ ν • Q ∈ K} := by rw [hfeas]; exact ⟨hμ'nn, hμ'hi⟩
      exact this.2
    have hge : 0 ≤ g (μ' • Q) := hgK _ hμ'feas
    have hlt : g (μ' • Q) < 0 := by
      have hv : g (μ' • Q) = g 0 + μ' * g.linear Q := affine_eval_smul g Q μ'
      have heq : g 0 + μ' * g.linear Q = (μ' - μ) * g.linear Q := by nlinarith [hval]
      rw [hv, heq]
      exact mul_neg_of_pos_of_neg (by linarith) hlinneg
    linarith
  exact le_antisymm hμle hρle

name: base_AI_of_apex
proof:
:= by
  have he := h.comp_embedding (Fin.succEmb 3)
  have hcongr : (![(0 : Point), p, q, r] ∘ ⇑(Fin.succEmb 3)) = ![p, q, r] := by
    funext j; fin_cases j <;> rfl
  rwa [hcongr] at he

name: leader_unique
statement:
theorem leader_unique {m : ℕ} (G : Fin m → (Point →ᵃ[ℚ] ℚ)) (K : Set Point)
    {i i' : Fin m} (hi : i ∈ leaders G K) (hi' : i' ∈ leaders G K)
    (hZ : {x : Point | G i x = 0} = {x : Point | G i' x = 0}) : i = i'
proof:
:= by
  classical
  rw [leaders, Finset.mem_filter] at hi hi'
  obtain ⟨_, hiO, himin⟩ := hi
  obtain ⟨_, hi'O, hi'min⟩ := hi'
  rcases lt_trichotomy i i' with hlt | heq | hgt
  · exact absurd hZ (hi'min i hlt hiO)
  · exact heq
  · exact absurd hZ.symm (himin i' hgt hi'O)

name: conv_subset_crossPlane
proof:
:= by
  
  set c : Point := crossProduct a b with hc
  set L : Point →ₗ[ℚ] ℚ :=
    { toFun := fun x => ∑ j, c j * x j
      map_add' := by
        intro x y
        simp only [Pi.add_apply, mul_add]
        rw [← Finset.sum_add_distrib]
      map_smul' := by
        intro s x
        simp only [Pi.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul, RingHom.id_apply, Finset.mul_sum]
        apply Finset.sum_congr rfl; intro j _; ring } with hL
  have hconv : Convex ℚ {x : Point | (∑ j, c j * x j) = 0} := by
    have hset : {x : Point | (∑ j, c j * x j) = 0} = L ⁻¹' {0} := by
      ext x; simp only [Set.mem_setOf_eq, Set.mem_preimage, Set.mem_singleton_iff, hL,
        LinearMap.coe_mk, AddHom.coe_mk]
    rw [hset]
    exact (convex_singleton (0 : ℚ)).linear_preimage L
  
  have ha : (∑ j, c j * a j) = 0 := by
    have he : (∑ j, c j * a j) = c ⬝ᵥ a := rfl
    rw [he, hc, dotProduct_comm]; exact dot_self_cross a b
  have hb : (∑ j, c j * b j) = 0 := by
    have he : (∑ j, c j * b j) = c ⬝ᵥ b := rfl
    rw [he, hc, dotProduct_comm]; exact dot_cross_self a b
  apply convexHull_min _ hconv
  intro x hx
  simp only [Set.mem_insert_iff, Set.mem_singleton_iff] at hx
  rcases hx with hxa | hxb
  · rw [Set.mem_setOf_eq, hxa]; exact ha
  · rw [Set.mem_setOf_eq, hxb]; exact hb

name: crossPlane_descale
proof:
:= by
  have hscale : (∑ j, (crossProduct a b) j * (ρ • Q) j)
      = ρ * (∑ j, (crossProduct a b) j * Q j) := by
    rw [Finset.mul_sum]
    apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
    intro j _
    simp only [Pi.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul]; ring
  rw [hscale] at h
  rcases mul_eq_zero.mp h with hρ0 | hQ0
  · exact absurd hρ0 hρ
  · exact hQ0

name: originFan_winding_one
statement:
theorem originFan_winding_one {m : ℕ} (G : Fin m → (Point →ᵃ[ℚ] ℚ)) (K : Set Point)
    (hKG : K = ⋂ i, {x : Point | 0 ≤ G i x}) (h0K : (0 : Point) ∈ K)
    (hbdd : ∃ tB : Triangle, K ⊆ simplex tB)
    (hbind : ∀ {Q : Point}, Q ≠ 0 → ∃ i, (G i).linear Q < 0)
    (hg0 : ∀ i, 0 ≤ G i 0) (hLnz : ∀ i, (G i).linear ≠ 0)
    (R : Finset (Fin m)) (hRleaders : R = leaders G K)
    (rr : Fin m → ℕ) (uu : Fin m → ℕ → Point)
    (hrr : ∀ i ∈ R, 3 ≤ rr i)
    (hcoverr : ∀ i ∈ R, ({x : Point | G i x = 0} ∩ K)
        = ⋃ k ∈ Finset.range (rr i - 2), convexHull ℚ {uu i 0, uu i (k + 1), uu i (k + 2)})
    (hnondegr : ∀ i ∈ R, ∀ k ∈ Finset.range (rr i - 2),
        AffineIndependent ℚ ![(0 : Point), uu i 0, uu i (k + 1), uu i (k + 2)])
    (hdisjr : ∀ i ∈ R, ∀ a ∈ Finset.range (rr i - 2), ∀ b ∈ Finset.range (rr i - 2), a ≠ b →
        (convexHull ℚ {uu i 0, uu i (a + 1), uu i (a + 2)}
          ∩ convexHull ℚ {uu i 0, uu i (b + 1), uu i (b + 2)})
        ⊆ ⋃ kk ∈ Finset.range (rr i - 2),
            (convexHull ℚ {uu i 0, uu i (kk + 1)} ∪ convexHull ℚ {uu i (kk + 1), uu i (kk + 2)}))
    (c : Chain)
    (hcperm : c.toList.Perm (R.toList.flatMap fun i =>
      ((Finset.range (rr i - 2)).toList.map fun k =>
        ((1 : Int), (⟨uu i 0, uu i (k + 1), uu i (k + 2)⟩ : Triangle))))) :
    (∀ e ∈ c.toList, e.1 = 1)
    ∧ (∀ e ∈ c.toList, simplex e.2 ⊆ K)
    ∧ ∃ N : Set Point, Negligible N
        ∧ ∀ Q, Q ∈ K → Q ∉ N → winding c Q = 1
proof:
:= by
  classical
  
  have hKconv : Convex ℚ K := by
    rw [hKG]; exact convex_iInter (fun i => Proof.ConvexPolygonFan.convex_halfspace (G i))
  
  have hRmem : ∀ {i}, i ∈ R → Outer2D G K i ∧
      ∀ j, j < i → Outer2D G K j → {x : Point | G j x = 0} ≠ {x : Point | G i x = 0} := by
    intro i hi; rw [hRleaders, leaders, Finset.mem_filter] at hi; exact hi.2
  
  set L : List (Int × Triangle) := R.toList.flatMap fun i =>
    ((Finset.range (rr i - 2)).toList.map fun k =>
      ((1 : Int), (⟨uu i 0, uu i (k + 1), uu i (k + 2)⟩ : Triangle))) with hLdef
  
  have hLmem : ∀ e, e ∈ L ↔ ∃ i ∈ R, ∃ k ∈ Finset.range (rr i - 2),
      e = ((1 : Int), (⟨uu i 0, uu i (k + 1), uu i (k + 2)⟩ : Triangle)) := by
    intro e
    rw [hLdef, List.mem_flatMap]
    constructor
    · rintro ⟨i, hi, he⟩
      rw [List.mem_map] at he
      obtain ⟨k, hk, rfl⟩ := he
      exact ⟨i, by simpa using hi, k, by simpa using hk, rfl⟩
    · rintro ⟨i, hi, k, hk, rfl⟩
      refine ⟨i, by simpa using hi, ?_⟩
      rw [List.mem_map]
      exact ⟨k, by simpa using hk, rfl⟩
  
  have hcmem : ∀ e, e ∈ c.toList ↔ ∃ i ∈ R, ∃ k ∈ Finset.range (rr i - 2),
      e = ((1 : Int), (⟨uu i 0, uu i (k + 1), uu i (k + 2)⟩ : Triangle)) := by
    intro e; rw [hcperm.mem_iff]; exact hLmem e
  
  have hcoeff : ∀ e ∈ c.toList, e.1 = 1 := by
    intro e he; obtain ⟨i, _, k, _, rfl⟩ := (hcmem e).mp he; rfl
  
  
  
  have hsub : ∀ e ∈ c.toList, simplex e.2 ⊆ K := by
    intro e he
    obtain ⟨i, hi, k, hk, rfl⟩ := (hcmem e).mp he
    
    have hbaseK : ∀ p ∈ ({uu i 0, uu i (k + 1), uu i (k + 2)} : Set Point), p ∈ K := by
      intro p hp
      have hpcell : p ∈ {x : Point | G i x = 0} ∩ K := by
        rw [hcoverr i hi]
        refine Set.mem_iUnion₂.mpr ⟨k, hk, ?_⟩
        exact subset_convexHull ℚ _ hp
      exact hpcell.2
    have h0 : (0 : Point) ∈ K := h0K
    have hv0 : uu i 0 ∈ K := hbaseK _ (by simp)
    have hv1 : uu i (k + 1) ∈ K := hbaseK _ (by simp)
    have hv2 : uu i (k + 2) ∈ K := hbaseK _ (by simp)
    show simplex (⟨uu i 0, uu i (k + 1), uu i (k + 2)⟩ : Triangle) ⊆ K
    unfold simplex
    apply convexHull_min _ hKconv
    intro x hx
    simp only [Set.mem_insert_iff, Set.mem_singleton_iff] at hx
    rcases hx with rfl | rfl | rfl | rfl
    · exact h0
    · exact hv0
    · exact hv1
    · exact hv2
  refine ⟨hcoeff, hsub, ?_⟩
  
  
  
  
  
  obtain ⟨ks, Sig, hSigPlane, hSigcov⟩ := edge_cone_excludes G
  
  set Nbound : Set Point := ⋃ i : Fin m, {x : Point | G i x = 0} with hNbound
  have hNboundNeg : Negligible Nbound := by
    refine ⟨m, fun i => {x : Point | G i x = 0}, fun i => affineZero_isPlane (G i) (hLnz i), ?_⟩
    rw [hNbound]
  
  set NP0 : Set Point := ⋃ j : Fin m, mkPlane (G j).linear with hNP0
  have hNP0Neg : Negligible NP0 :=
    ⟨m, fun j => mkPlane (G j).linear, fun j => mkPlane_isPlane _, by rw [hNP0]⟩
  
  
  have h0NP0 : (0 : Point) ∈ NP0 := by
    rw [hNP0]
    obtain ⟨j⟩ : Nonempty (Fin m) := by
      by_contra hempty
      rw [not_nonempty_iff] at hempty
      exact absurd (hbind (Q := (1 : Point)) (by
        intro hc; have := congrFun hc 0; simp at this)) (by
        rintro ⟨i, _⟩; exact (IsEmpty.false i))
    exact Set.mem_iUnion.mpr ⟨j, mem_mkPlane_of _ (hLnz j) (by rw [map_zero])⟩
  
  set NSig : Set Point := ⋃ i, Sig i with hNSig
  have hNSigNeg : Negligible NSig := ⟨ks, Sig, hSigPlane, by rw [hNSig]⟩
  
  
  
  
  
  set Nedge : Set Point := ⋃ i ∈ R, ⋃ k ∈ Finset.range (rr i - 2),
      ({x : Point | (∑ j, (crossProduct (uu i 0) (uu i (k + 1))) j * x j) = 0}
       ∪ {x : Point | (∑ j, (crossProduct (uu i (k + 1)) (uu i (k + 2))) j * x j) = 0}
       ∪ {x : Point | (∑ j, (crossProduct (uu i (k + 1)) (uu i 0)) j * x j) = 0}) with hNedge
  
  have hNedgeNeg : Negligible Nedge := by
    rw [hNedge]
    apply negligible_biUnion
    intro i hi
    apply negligible_biUnion
    intro k hk
    
    
    obtain ⟨h1, h2, h3⟩ := fanEdge_pairs_linIndep _ _ _ (hnondegr i hi k hk)
    have p1 : IsPlane {x : Point | (∑ j, (crossProduct (uu i 0) (uu i (k + 1))) j * x j) = 0} :=
      Proof.Planes.originPlane_isPlane h1
    have p2 : IsPlane {x : Point | (∑ j, (crossProduct (uu i (k + 1)) (uu i (k + 2))) j * x j) = 0} :=
      Proof.Planes.originPlane_isPlane h2
    have p3 : IsPlane {x : Point | (∑ j, (crossProduct (uu i (k + 1)) (uu i 0)) j * x j) = 0} :=
      Proof.Planes.originPlane_isPlane h3
    
    exact Proof.Negligible.negligible_union
      (Proof.Negligible.negligible_union (negligible_of_isPlane p1) (negligible_of_isPlane p2))
      (negligible_of_isPlane p3)
  
  set N : Set Point := ((Nbound ∪ NP0) ∪ NSig) ∪ Nedge with hNdef
  have hNNeg : Negligible N :=
    Proof.Negligible.negligible_union
      (Proof.Negligible.negligible_union
        (Proof.Negligible.negligible_union hNboundNeg hNP0Neg) hNSigNeg) hNedgeNeg
  refine ⟨N, hNNeg, ?_⟩
  
  intro Q hQK hQN
  
  have hQNbound : Q ∉ Nbound := fun h => hQN (Or.inl (Or.inl (Or.inl h)))
  have hQNP0 : Q ∉ NP0 := fun h => hQN (Or.inl (Or.inl (Or.inr h)))
  have hQNSig : Q ∉ NSig := fun h => hQN (Or.inl (Or.inr h))
  have hQNedge : Q ∉ Nedge := fun h => hQN (Or.inr h)
  
  have hQ0 : Q ≠ 0 := by
    rintro rfl; exact hQNP0 h0NP0
  
  have hP0Q : ∀ j, (G j).linear Q ≠ 0 := by
    intro j hj
    exact hQNP0 (by rw [hNP0]; exact Set.mem_iUnion.mpr ⟨j, mem_mkPlane_of _ (hLnz j) hj⟩)
  
  have hoffbound : ∀ j, G j Q ≠ 0 := by
    intro j hj
    exact hQNbound (by rw [hNbound]; exact Set.mem_iUnion.mpr ⟨j, hj⟩)
  
  
  
  
  have hP₀ : ∀ ℓ, G ℓ 0 = 0 → 0 < (G ℓ).linear Q := by
    intro ℓ h0
    
    have hval : G ℓ Q = (G ℓ).linear Q := by
      have := AffineMap.decomp (G ℓ); rw [this]; simp [h0]
    have hge : 0 ≤ G ℓ Q := by
      rw [hKG] at hQK; have := Set.mem_iInter.mp hQK ℓ; simpa using this
    rw [hval] at hge
    exact lt_of_le_of_ne hge (Ne.symm (hP0Q ℓ))
  obtain ⟨ρ, hρnn, hρeq⟩ :=
    Proof.RadialExit.radial_exit G K hKG hg0 (fun {Q} h => hbind h) hQ0
  obtain ⟨h1ρ, ℓstar, hℓstar_outer, hℓstar_neg, _hℓstar_ratio, hℓstar_exit⟩ :=
    Proof.RadialExit.radial_exit_pos_outer G K hKG hg0 (fun {Q} h => hbind h) hQ0 hQK ρ hρeq hP₀
  have hρpos : 0 < ρ := lt_of_lt_of_le zero_lt_one h1ρ
  
  have hrhoK : (ρ • Q) ∈ K := by
    have : ρ ∈ {μ : ℚ | 0 ≤ μ ∧ μ • Q ∈ K} := by
      rw [hρeq]; exact Set.right_mem_Icc.mpr hρnn
    exact this.2
  
  
  
  
  have hdedup : ∀ ℓ ℓ', 0 < G ℓ 0 → 0 < G ℓ' 0 →
      {x : Point | G ℓ x = 0} ≠ {x : Point | G ℓ' x = 0} →
      (∃ x, G ℓ x = 0 ∧ G ℓ' x = 0) →
      LinearIndependent ℚ ![(G ℓ).linear, (G ℓ').linear] := by
    intro ℓ ℓ' _ _ hne ⟨p, hp, hp'⟩
    exact indep_of_distinct_meeting (G ℓ) (G ℓ') (hLnz ℓ) (hLnz ℓ') hp hp' hne
  
  
  
  have hSigcovf : ∀ {ℓ ℓ' : Fin m}, LinearIndependent ℚ ![(G ℓ).linear, (G ℓ').linear] →
      G ℓ (ρ • Q) = 0 → G ℓ' (ρ • Q) = 0 → Q ∈ (⋃ i, Sig i) := by
    intro ℓ ℓ' hindep ha ha'
    exact hSigcov ρ hQ0 hρpos hindep ha ha'
  have hQoffSig : Q ∉ (⋃ i, Sig i) := by rw [hNSig] at hQNSig; exact hQNSig
  obtain ⟨ℓ0, ⟨hℓ0outer, hℓ0exit⟩, huniq, hdim2⟩ :=
    cross_cell_uniqueness G K hKG ρ hQK hQ0 hρpos hrhoK
      ⟨ℓstar, hℓstar_outer, hℓstar_exit⟩ hP0Q hdedup ks Sig hSigPlane hSigcovf hQoffSig
  
  
  rw [winding_eq_card_of_coeff_one hcoeff]
  
  
  
  rw [(hcperm.map fun e => if Q ∈ simplex e.2 then (1 : ℤ) else 0).sum_eq]
  
  have hmapeq : (L.map fun e => if Q ∈ simplex e.2 then (1 : ℤ) else 0)
      = (R.toList.flatMap fun i =>
          (Finset.range (rr i - 2)).toList.map fun k =>
            if Q ∈ simplex (⟨uu i 0, uu i (k + 1), uu i (k + 2)⟩ : Triangle)
              then (1 : ℤ) else 0) := by
    rw [hLdef, List.map_flatMap]
    apply List.flatMap_congr
    intro i _
    rw [List.map_map]
    apply List.map_congr_left
    intro k _
    rfl
  rw [hmapeq, flatMap_double_sum R rr
    (fun i k => if Q ∈ simplex (⟨uu i 0, uu i (k + 1), uu i (k + 2)⟩ : Triangle)
      then (1 : ℤ) else 0)]
  
  apply double_indicator_unique R rr
    (fun i k => Q ∈ simplex (⟨uu i 0, uu i (k + 1), uu i (k + 2)⟩ : Triangle))
  
  
  
  
  
  
  
  
  
  have hℓ0le2 : Module.finrank ℚ (vectorSpan ℚ ({x : Point | G ℓ0 x = 0} ∩ K)) ≤ 2 :=
    cell_finrank_le_two (G ℓ0) (hLnz ℓ0) K
  have hO0 : Outer2D G K ℓ0 := ⟨hℓ0outer, le_antisymm hℓ0le2 hdim2⟩
  
  obtain ⟨ℓstar', hℓstar'R0, hℓstar'Z⟩ := leaderExists G K hO0
  have hℓstar'R : ℓstar' ∈ R := by rw [hRleaders]; exact hℓstar'R0
  
  have hcellEq : {x : Point | G ℓstar' x = 0} ∩ K = {x : Point | G ℓ0 x = 0} ∩ K := by
    rw [hℓstar'Z]
  have hQstarCell : (ρ • Q) ∈ ({x : Point | G ℓstar' x = 0} ∩ K) := by
    rw [hcellEq]; exact ⟨hℓ0exit, hrhoK⟩
  
  have hcover := hcoverr ℓstar' hℓstar'R
  have hQstarFan : (ρ • Q) ∈ ⋃ k ∈ Finset.range (rr ℓstar' - 2),
      convexHull ℚ {uu ℓstar' 0, uu ℓstar' (k + 1), uu ℓstar' (k + 2)} := by
    rw [← hcover]; exact hQstarCell
  obtain ⟨kstar, hkstarMem, hQstarTri⟩ := Set.mem_iUnion₂.mp hQstarFan
  
  
  have hQmemStar : Q ∈ simplex (⟨uu ℓstar' 0, uu ℓstar' (kstar + 1), uu ℓstar' (kstar + 2)⟩ : Triangle) := by
    
    
    have htetra : simplex (⟨uu ℓstar' 0, uu ℓstar' (kstar + 1), uu ℓstar' (kstar + 2)⟩ : Triangle)
        = convexHull ℚ ({0, uu ℓstar' 0, uu ℓstar' (kstar + 1), uu ℓstar' (kstar + 2)} : Set Point) := rfl
    rw [htetra]
    have hconvT : Convex ℚ (convexHull ℚ ({0, uu ℓstar' 0, uu ℓstar' (kstar + 1), uu ℓstar' (kstar + 2)} : Set Point)) :=
      convex_convexHull ℚ _
    have h0T : (0 : Point) ∈ convexHull ℚ ({0, uu ℓstar' 0, uu ℓstar' (kstar + 1), uu ℓstar' (kstar + 2)} : Set Point) :=
      subset_convexHull ℚ _ (by simp)
    have hQstarT : (ρ • Q) ∈ convexHull ℚ ({0, uu ℓstar' 0, uu ℓstar' (kstar + 1), uu ℓstar' (kstar + 2)} : Set Point) := by
      apply convexHull_mono _ hQstarTri
      intro x hx
      simp only [Set.mem_insert_iff, Set.mem_singleton_iff] at hx ⊢
      tauto
    
    have hμ : (0 : ℚ) ≤ 1 / ρ := le_of_lt (by positivity)
    have hμ1 : 1 / ρ ≤ 1 := by rw [div_le_one hρpos]; exact h1ρ
    have hcc := hconvT hQstarT h0T (a := 1 / ρ) (b := 1 - 1 / ρ) hμ (by linarith) (by ring)
    have heq : (1 / ρ) • (ρ • Q) + (1 - 1 / ρ) • (0 : Point) = Q := by
      rw [smul_zero, add_zero, smul_smul]
      rw [one_div, inv_mul_cancel₀ (ne_of_gt hρpos), one_smul]
    rwa [heq] at hcc
  
  refine ⟨(ℓstar', kstar), ⟨hℓstar'R, hkstarMem, hQmemStar⟩, ?_⟩
  
  
  
  
  
  
  
  rintro ⟨i, k⟩ ⟨hiR, hkMem, hQmem⟩
  
  set p : Point := uu i 0 with hpdef
  set q : Point := uu i (k + 1) with hqdef
  set rr2 : Point := uu i (k + 2) with hrr2def
  
  have hiOuter : 0 < G i 0 := (hRmem hiR).1.1
  
  
  have hbaseCell : ∀ x ∈ ({p, q, rr2} : Set Point), x ∈ ({y : Point | G i y = 0} ∩ K) := by
    intro x hx
    rw [hcoverr i hiR]
    refine Set.mem_iUnion₂.mpr ⟨k, hkMem, ?_⟩
    exact subset_convexHull ℚ _ hx
  have hGip : G i p = 0 := (hbaseCell p (by simp)).1
  have hGiq : G i q = 0 := (hbaseCell q (by simp)).1
  have hGir : G i rr2 = 0 := (hbaseCell rr2 (by simp)).1
  have hpK : p ∈ K := (hbaseCell p (by simp)).2
  have hqK : q ∈ K := (hbaseCell q (by simp)).2
  have hrK : rr2 ∈ K := (hbaseCell rr2 (by simp)).2
  
  have hGiK : ∀ x ∈ K, 0 ≤ G i x := by
    intro x hx; rw [hKG] at hx; have := Set.mem_iInter.mp hx i; simpa using this
  
  have hAI4 : AffineIndependent ℚ ![(0 : Point), p, q, rr2] := hnondegr i hiR k hkMem
  
  obtain ⟨b, a₀, hbcoe, hbrange, hba₀⟩ :=
    Proof.AffineBasisSimplex.simplexAffineBasis ⟨p, q, rr2⟩ hAI4
  
  have hsimplexEq : simplex (⟨p, q, rr2⟩ : Triangle) = convexHull ℚ (Set.range ⇑b) := by
    unfold simplex; rw [← hbrange]
  
  have hcoordnn : ∀ j, 0 ≤ b.coord j Q := by
    have hmem : Q ∈ convexHull ℚ (Set.range ⇑b) := by rw [← hsimplexEq]; exact hQmem
    rw [b.convexHull_eq_nonneg_coord] at hmem; exact hmem
  have hsum1 : ∑ j, b.coord j Q = 1 := b.sum_coord_apply_eq_one Q
  
  have hb0 : b 0 = (0 : Point) := by have := congrFun hbcoe 0; simpa using this
  have hb1 : b 1 = p := by have := congrFun hbcoe 1; simpa using this
  have hb2 : b 2 = q := by have := congrFun hbcoe 2; simpa using this
  have hb3 : b 3 = rr2 := by have := congrFun hbcoe 3; simpa using this
  
  have hGivals : ∀ j, G i (b j) = if j = 0 then G i 0 else 0 := by
    intro j
    fin_cases j
    · show G i (b 0) = _; rw [hb0]; simp
    · show G i (b 1) = _; rw [hb1, hGip]; simp
    · show G i (b 2) = _; rw [hb2, hGiq]; simp
    · show G i (b 3) = _; rw [hb3, hGir]; simp
  
  set lam : Fin 4 → ℚ := fun j => b.coord j Q with hlam
  set lam0 : ℚ := lam 0 with hlam0
  
  have hQcombV : Q = ∑ j, lam j • (b j) := (b.linear_combination_coord_eq_self Q).symm
  have hGiQ : G i Q = lam0 * G i 0 := by
    have hQc : Q = Finset.univ.affineCombination ℚ b lam :=
      (b.affineCombination_coord_eq_self Q).symm
    have hpush : G i (Finset.univ.affineCombination ℚ b lam)
        = Finset.univ.affineCombination ℚ ((G i) ∘ b) lam :=
      Finset.univ.map_affineCombination b lam hsum1 (G i)
    rw [hQc, hpush, Finset.univ.affineCombination_eq_linear_combination _ _ hsum1]
    
    simp only [Function.comp_apply]
    rw [Fin.sum_univ_four]
    simp only [hGivals]
    simp only [show ((0 : Fin 4) = 0) = True from by simp,
      show ((1 : Fin 4) = 0) = False from by simp,
      show ((2 : Fin 4) = 0) = False from by simp,
      show ((3 : Fin 4) = 0) = False from by simp, if_true, if_false]
    simp only [smul_eq_mul, mul_zero, add_zero, hlam0, hlam]
  
  have hlamnn : ∀ j, 0 ≤ lam j := fun j => hcoordnn j
  have hlam0nn : 0 ≤ lam0 := hlamnn 0
  have hsumlam : lam 0 + lam 1 + lam 2 + lam 3 = 1 := by
    have := hsum1; rw [Fin.sum_univ_four] at this; simpa [hlam] using this
  
  have hQexp : Q = lam 1 • p + lam 2 • q + lam 3 • rr2 := by
    rw [hQcombV, Fin.sum_univ_four, hb0, hb1, hb2, hb3, smul_zero, zero_add, add_assoc]
  
  have hlam0lt1 : lam0 < 1 := by
    rcases lt_or_eq_of_le (show lam0 ≤ 1 from by
      have h1 : lam 1 + lam 2 + lam 3 = 1 - lam0 := by rw [hlam0]; linarith [hsumlam]
      have hnn : 0 ≤ lam 1 + lam 2 + lam 3 :=
        add_nonneg (add_nonneg (hlamnn 1) (hlamnn 2)) (hlamnn 3)
      linarith) with h | h
    · exact h
    · 
      exfalso
      have hsum0 : lam 1 + lam 2 + lam 3 = 0 := by rw [hlam0] at h; linarith [hsumlam]
      have h1 : lam 1 = 0 := le_antisymm (by linarith [hlamnn 2, hlamnn 3]) (hlamnn 1)
      have h2 : lam 2 = 0 := le_antisymm (by linarith [hlamnn 1, hlamnn 3]) (hlamnn 2)
      have h3 : lam 3 = 0 := le_antisymm (by linarith [hlamnn 1, hlamnn 2]) (hlamnn 3)
      apply hQ0
      rw [hQexp, h1, h2, h3, zero_smul, zero_smul, zero_smul, add_zero, add_zero]
  
  have h1mlam0 : 0 < 1 - lam0 := by linarith [hlam0lt1]
  set μw : ℚ := 1 / (1 - lam0) with hμw
  have hμwpos : 0 < μw := by rw [hμw]; positivity
  set w : Point := μw • Q with hwdef
  
  have hwconv : w ∈ convexHull ℚ ({p, q, rr2} : Set Point) := by
    
    refine mem_convexHull_of_exists_fintype
      (![μw * lam 1, μw * lam 2, μw * lam 3] : Fin 3 → ℚ)
      (![p, q, rr2] : Fin 3 → Point) ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_
    · intro j; fin_cases j <;>
        simp only [Matrix.cons_val_zero, Matrix.cons_val_one, Matrix.head_cons,
          Matrix.cons_val_two, Matrix.tail_cons] <;>
        exact mul_nonneg (le_of_lt hμwpos) (by first | exact hlamnn 1 | exact hlamnn 2 | exact hlamnn 3)
    · rw [Fin.sum_univ_three]
      simp only [Matrix.cons_val_zero, Matrix.cons_val_one, Matrix.head_cons,
        Matrix.cons_val_two, Matrix.tail_cons]
      rw [← mul_add, ← mul_add, hμw]
      have hs : lam 1 + lam 2 + lam 3 = 1 - lam0 := by rw [hlam0]; linarith [hsumlam]
      rw [hs]; field_simp
    · intro j; fin_cases j <;>
        simp only [Matrix.cons_val_zero, Matrix.cons_val_one, Matrix.head_cons,
          Matrix.cons_val_two, Matrix.tail_cons] <;>
        simp
    · rw [Fin.sum_univ_three]
      simp only [Matrix.cons_val_zero, Matrix.cons_val_one, Matrix.head_cons,
        Matrix.cons_val_two, Matrix.tail_cons]
      rw [hwdef, hQexp]
      rw [smul_add, smul_add, smul_smul, smul_smul, smul_smul]
  
  have hcellSub : convexHull ℚ ({p, q, rr2} : Set Point) ⊆ {y : Point | G i y = 0} ∩ K := by
    rw [hcoverr i hiR]
    intro x hx
    exact Set.mem_iUnion₂.mpr ⟨k, hkMem, hx⟩
  have hwCell : w ∈ {y : Point | G i y = 0} ∩ K := hcellSub hwconv
  have hGiw : G i w = 0 := hwCell.1
  have hwK : w ∈ K := hwCell.2
  
  have hμweq : μw = ρ := by
    refine radial_mult_eq hρeq hμwpos (by rw [← hwdef]; exact hwK) hGiK hiOuter ?_
    rw [← hwdef]; exact hGiw
  
  have hwQstar : w = ρ • Q := by rw [hwdef, hμweq]
  
  have hQstar_in_ik : (ρ • Q) ∈ convexHull ℚ ({p, q, rr2} : Set Point) := by
    rw [← hwQstar]; exact hwconv
  have hGiQstar : G i (ρ • Q) = 0 := by rw [← hwQstar]; exact hGiw
  
  
  have hZi : {x : Point | G i x = 0} = {x : Point | G ℓ0 x = 0} :=
    huniq i hiOuter hGiQstar
  
  have hZeq : {x : Point | G i x = 0} = {x : Point | G ℓstar' x = 0} := by
    rw [hZi, ← hℓstar'Z]
  
  have hieq : i = ℓstar' :=
    leader_unique G K (hRleaders ▸ hiR) (hRleaders ▸ hℓstar'R) hZeq
  
  subst hieq
  
  
  have hkeq : k = kstar := by
    
    set u : ℕ → Point := uu i with hu
    set Pcell : Set Point := {y : Point | G i y = 0} ∩ K with hPcell
    
    have hQstarOffEdges : (ρ • Q) ∉ Proof.ConvexPolygonFan.fanEdges (rr i) u := by
      intro hmem
      rw [Proof.ConvexPolygonFan.fanEdges, Set.mem_iUnion₂] at hmem
      obtain ⟨k', hk', hmem'⟩ := hmem
      
      
      apply hQNedge
      rw [hNedge]
      refine Set.mem_iUnion₂.mpr ⟨i, hiR, ?_⟩
      refine Set.mem_iUnion₂.mpr ⟨k', hk', ?_⟩
      rcases hmem' with hseg1 | hseg2
      · 
        left; left
        have hplane : (ρ • Q) ∈ {x : Point | (∑ j, (crossProduct (u 0) (u (k' + 1))) j * x j) = 0} :=
          conv_subset_crossPlane (u 0) (u (k' + 1)) hseg1
        have hQ' : (∑ j, (crossProduct (u 0) (u (k' + 1))) j * Q j) = 0 :=
          crossPlane_descale (ne_of_gt hρpos) hplane
        exact hQ'
      · 
        left; right
        have hplane : (ρ • Q) ∈ {x : Point | (∑ j, (crossProduct (u (k' + 1)) (u (k' + 2))) j * x j) = 0} :=
          conv_subset_crossPlane (u (k' + 1)) (u (k' + 2)) hseg2
        have hQ' : (∑ j, (crossProduct (u (k' + 1)) (u (k' + 2))) j * Q j) = 0 :=
          crossPlane_descale (ne_of_gt hρpos) hplane
        exact hQ'
    
    obtain ⟨_, _, _, hpart⟩ :=
      Proof.ConvexPolygonFan.convexPolygonFan_partition Pcell (hrr i hℓstar'R) u
        (by rw [hPcell, hcoverr i hℓstar'R]; rfl)
        (hdisjr i hℓstar'R)
        (fun k' hk' => base_AI_of_apex (hnondegr i hℓstar'R k' hk'))
    
    have hQstarP : (ρ • Q) ∈ Pcell := hQstarCell
    obtain ⟨k0, _, huniqk⟩ := hpart (ρ • Q) hQstarP hQstarOffEdges
    
    have hk_eq : k = k0 :=
      huniqk k ⟨hkMem, hQstar_in_ik⟩
    have hkstar_eq : kstar = k0 :=
      huniqk kstar ⟨hkstarMem, hQstarTri⟩
    rw [hk_eq, hkstar_eq]
  
  rw [hkeq]

name: emitExists
statement:
private theorem emitExists {m : ℕ} (G : Fin m → (Point →ᵃ[ℚ] ℚ)) (K : Set Point)
    (hKG : K = ⋂ i, {x : Point | 0 ≤ G i x}) (h0K : (0 : Point) ∈ K)
    (hbdd : ∃ tB : Triangle, K ⊆ simplex tB)
    (hbind : ∀ {Q : Point}, Q ≠ 0 → ∃ i, (G i).linear Q < 0)
    (hg0 : ∀ i, 0 ≤ G i 0) (hLnz : ∀ i, (G i).linear ≠ 0) :
    ∃ (c : Chain),
      (∀ e ∈ c.toList, e.1 = 1)
      ∧ (∀ e ∈ c.toList, simplex e.2 ⊆ K)
      ∧ ∃ N : Set Point, Negligible N
          ∧ ∀ Q, Q ∈ K → Q ∉ N → winding c Q = 1
proof:
:= by
  classical
  
  have hKconv : Convex ℚ K := by
    rw [hKG]; exact convex_iInter (fun i => Proof.ConvexPolygonFan.convex_halfspace (G i))
  
  
  set R : Finset (Fin m) := leaders G K with hRdef
  have hRmem : ∀ {i}, i ∈ R → Outer2D G K i ∧
      ∀ j, j < i → Outer2D G K j → {x : Point | G j x = 0} ≠ {x : Point | G i x = 0} := by
    intro i hi; rw [hRdef, leaders, Finset.mem_filter] at hi; exact hi.2
  
  have hfan : ∀ i : Fin m, i ∈ R →
      ∃ (r : ℕ) (u : ℕ → Point), 3 ≤ r
        ∧ ({x : Point | G i x = 0} ∩ K)
            = ⋃ k ∈ Finset.range (r - 2), convexHull ℚ {u 0, u (k + 1), u (k + 2)}
        ∧ (∀ k ∈ Finset.range (r - 2),
            AffineIndependent ℚ ![(0 : Point), u 0, u (k + 1), u (k + 2)])
        ∧ (∀ a ∈ Finset.range (r - 2), ∀ b ∈ Finset.range (r - 2), a ≠ b →
            (convexHull ℚ {u 0, u (a + 1), u (a + 2)}
              ∩ convexHull ℚ {u 0, u (b + 1), u (b + 2)})
            ⊆ ⋃ kk ∈ Finset.range (r - 2),
                (convexHull ℚ {u 0, u (kk + 1)} ∪ convexHull ℚ {u (kk + 1), u (kk + 2)})) := by
    intro i hi
    obtain ⟨⟨houter, hdim⟩, _⟩ := hRmem hi
    exact exit_cell_fan_exists (G i) G K hKG h0K houter hbdd hdim
  
  choose! rr uu hrr hcoverr hnondegr hdisjr using hfan
  
  set c : Chain := (R.toList.flatMap fun i =>
    ((Finset.range (rr i - 2)).toList.map fun k =>
      ((1 : Int), (⟨uu i 0, uu i (k + 1), uu i (k + 2)⟩ : Triangle)))).toArray with hc
  
  have hcmem : ∀ e, e ∈ c.toList ↔ ∃ i ∈ R, ∃ k ∈ Finset.range (rr i - 2),
      e = ((1 : Int), (⟨uu i 0, uu i (k + 1), uu i (k + 2)⟩ : Triangle)) := by
    intro e
    rw [hc, Array.toList_toArray, List.mem_flatMap]
    constructor
    · rintro ⟨i, hi, he⟩
      rw [List.mem_map] at he
      obtain ⟨k, hk, rfl⟩ := he
      exact ⟨i, by simpa using hi, k, by simpa using hk, rfl⟩
    · rintro ⟨i, hi, k, hk, rfl⟩
      refine ⟨i, by simpa using hi, ?_⟩
      rw [List.mem_map]
      exact ⟨k, by simpa using hk, rfl⟩
  
  have hcoeff : ∀ e ∈ c.toList, e.1 = 1 := by
    intro e he; obtain ⟨i, _, k, _, rfl⟩ := (hcmem e).mp he; rfl
  
  
  
  have hsub : ∀ e ∈ c.toList, simplex e.2 ⊆ K := by
    intro e he
    obtain ⟨i, hi, k, hk, rfl⟩ := (hcmem e).mp he
    
    have hbaseK : ∀ p ∈ ({uu i 0, uu i (k + 1), uu i (k + 2)} : Set Point), p ∈ K := by
      intro p hp
      have hpcell : p ∈ {x : Point | G i x = 0} ∩ K := by
        rw [hcoverr i hi]
        refine Set.mem_iUnion₂.mpr ⟨k, hk, ?_⟩
        exact subset_convexHull ℚ _ hp
      exact hpcell.2
    have h0 : (0 : Point) ∈ K := h0K
    have hv0 : uu i 0 ∈ K := hbaseK _ (by simp)
    have hv1 : uu i (k + 1) ∈ K := hbaseK _ (by simp)
    have hv2 : uu i (k + 2) ∈ K := hbaseK _ (by simp)
    show simplex (⟨uu i 0, uu i (k + 1), uu i (k + 2)⟩ : Triangle) ⊆ K
    unfold simplex
    apply convexHull_min _ hKconv
    intro x hx
    simp only [Set.mem_insert_iff, Set.mem_singleton_iff] at hx
    rcases hx with rfl | rfl | rfl | rfl
    · exact h0
    · exact hv0
    · exact hv1
    · exact hv2
  
  
  
  
  
  obtain ⟨ks, Sig, hSigPlane, hSigcov⟩ := edge_cone_excludes G
  
  set Nbound : Set Point := ⋃ i : Fin m, {x : Point | G i x = 0} with hNbound
  have hNboundNeg : Negligible Nbound := by
    refine ⟨m, fun i => {x : Point | G i x = 0}, fun i => affineZero_isPlane (G i) (hLnz i), ?_⟩
    rw [hNbound]
  
  set NP0 : Set Point := ⋃ j : Fin m, mkPlane (G j).linear with hNP0
  have hNP0Neg : Negligible NP0 :=
    ⟨m, fun j => mkPlane (G j).linear, fun j => mkPlane_isPlane _, by rw [hNP0]⟩
  
  
  have h0NP0 : (0 : Point) ∈ NP0 := by
    rw [hNP0]
    obtain ⟨j⟩ : Nonempty (Fin m) := by
      by_contra hempty
      rw [not_nonempty_iff] at hempty
      exact absurd (hbind (Q := (1 : Point)) (by
        intro hc; have := congrFun hc 0; simp at this)) (by
        rintro ⟨i, _⟩; exact (IsEmpty.false i))
    exact Set.mem_iUnion.mpr ⟨j, mem_mkPlane_of _ (hLnz j) (by rw [map_zero])⟩
  
  set NSig : Set Point := ⋃ i, Sig i with hNSig
  have hNSigNeg : Negligible NSig := ⟨ks, Sig, hSigPlane, by rw [hNSig]⟩
  
  
  
  
  
  set Nedge : Set Point := ⋃ i ∈ R, ⋃ k ∈ Finset.range (rr i - 2),
      ({x : Point | (∑ j, (crossProduct (uu i 0) (uu i (k + 1))) j * x j) = 0}
       ∪ {x : Point | (∑ j, (crossProduct (uu i (k + 1)) (uu i (k + 2))) j * x j) = 0}
       ∪ {x : Point | (∑ j, (crossProduct (uu i (k + 1)) (uu i 0)) j * x j) = 0}) with hNedge
  
  have hNedgeNeg : Negligible Nedge := by
    rw [hNedge]
    apply negligible_biUnion
    intro i hi
    apply negligible_biUnion
    intro k hk
    
    
    obtain ⟨h1, h2, h3⟩ := fanEdge_pairs_linIndep _ _ _ (hnondegr i hi k hk)
    have p1 : IsPlane {x : Point | (∑ j, (crossProduct (uu i 0) (uu i (k + 1))) j * x j) = 0} :=
      Proof.Planes.originPlane_isPlane h1
    have p2 : IsPlane {x : Point | (∑ j, (crossProduct (uu i (k + 1)) (uu i (k + 2))) j * x j) = 0} :=
      Proof.Planes.originPlane_isPlane h2
    have p3 : IsPlane {x : Point | (∑ j, (crossProduct (uu i (k + 1)) (uu i 0)) j * x j) = 0} :=
      Proof.Planes.originPlane_isPlane h3
    
    exact Proof.Negligible.negligible_union
      (Proof.Negligible.negligible_union (negligible_of_isPlane p1) (negligible_of_isPlane p2))
      (negligible_of_isPlane p3)
  
  set N : Set Point := ((Nbound ∪ NP0) ∪ NSig) ∪ Nedge with hNdef
  have hNNeg : Negligible N :=
    Proof.Negligible.negligible_union
      (Proof.Negligible.negligible_union
        (Proof.Negligible.negligible_union hNboundNeg hNP0Neg) hNSigNeg) hNedgeNeg
  refine ⟨c, hcoeff, hsub, N, hNNeg, ?_⟩
  
  intro Q hQK hQN
  
  have hQNbound : Q ∉ Nbound := fun h => hQN (Or.inl (Or.inl (Or.inl h)))
  have hQNP0 : Q ∉ NP0 := fun h => hQN (Or.inl (Or.inl (Or.inr h)))
  have hQNSig : Q ∉ NSig := fun h => hQN (Or.inl (Or.inr h))
  have hQNedge : Q ∉ Nedge := fun h => hQN (Or.inr h)
  
  have hQ0 : Q ≠ 0 := by
    rintro rfl; exact hQNP0 h0NP0
  
  have hP0Q : ∀ j, (G j).linear Q ≠ 0 := by
    intro j hj
    exact hQNP0 (by rw [hNP0]; exact Set.mem_iUnion.mpr ⟨j, mem_mkPlane_of _ (hLnz j) hj⟩)
  
  have hoffbound : ∀ j, G j Q ≠ 0 := by
    intro j hj
    exact hQNbound (by rw [hNbound]; exact Set.mem_iUnion.mpr ⟨j, hj⟩)
  
  
  
  
  have hP₀ : ∀ ℓ, G ℓ 0 = 0 → 0 < (G ℓ).linear Q := by
    intro ℓ h0
    
    have hval : G ℓ Q = (G ℓ).linear Q := by
      have := AffineMap.decomp (G ℓ); rw [this]; simp [h0]
    have hge : 0 ≤ G ℓ Q := by
      rw [hKG] at hQK; have := Set.mem_iInter.mp hQK ℓ; simpa using this
    rw [hval] at hge
    exact lt_of_le_of_ne hge (Ne.symm (hP0Q ℓ))
  obtain ⟨ρ, hρnn, hρeq⟩ :=
    Proof.RadialExit.radial_exit G K hKG hg0 (fun {Q} h => hbind h) hQ0
  obtain ⟨h1ρ, ℓstar, hℓstar_outer, hℓstar_neg, _hℓstar_ratio, hℓstar_exit⟩ :=
    Proof.RadialExit.radial_exit_pos_outer G K hKG hg0 (fun {Q} h => hbind h) hQ0 hQK ρ hρeq hP₀
  have hρpos : 0 < ρ := lt_of_lt_of_le zero_lt_one h1ρ
  
  have hrhoK : (ρ • Q) ∈ K := by
    have : ρ ∈ {μ : ℚ | 0 ≤ μ ∧ μ • Q ∈ K} := by
      rw [hρeq]; exact Set.right_mem_Icc.mpr hρnn
    exact this.2
  
  
  
  
  have hdedup : ∀ ℓ ℓ', 0 < G ℓ 0 → 0 < G ℓ' 0 →
      {x : Point | G ℓ x = 0} ≠ {x : Point | G ℓ' x = 0} →
      (∃ x, G ℓ x = 0 ∧ G ℓ' x = 0) →
      LinearIndependent ℚ ![(G ℓ).linear, (G ℓ').linear] := by
    intro ℓ ℓ' _ _ hne ⟨p, hp, hp'⟩
    exact indep_of_distinct_meeting (G ℓ) (G ℓ') (hLnz ℓ) (hLnz ℓ') hp hp' hne
  
  
  
  have hSigcovf : ∀ {ℓ ℓ' : Fin m}, LinearIndependent ℚ ![(G ℓ).linear, (G ℓ').linear] →
      G ℓ (ρ • Q) = 0 → G ℓ' (ρ • Q) = 0 → Q ∈ (⋃ i, Sig i) := by
    intro ℓ ℓ' hindep ha ha'
    exact hSigcov ρ hQ0 hρpos hindep ha ha'
  have hQoffSig : Q ∉ (⋃ i, Sig i) := by rw [hNSig] at hQNSig; exact hQNSig
  obtain ⟨ℓ0, ⟨hℓ0outer, hℓ0exit⟩, huniq, hdim2⟩ :=
    cross_cell_uniqueness G K hKG ρ hQK hQ0 hρpos hrhoK
      ⟨ℓstar, hℓstar_outer, hℓstar_exit⟩ hP0Q hdedup ks Sig hSigPlane hSigcovf hQoffSig
  
  
  rw [winding_eq_card_of_coeff_one hcoeff]
  
  have hmapeq : (c.toList.map fun e => if Q ∈ simplex e.2 then (1 : ℤ) else 0)
      = (R.toList.flatMap fun i =>
          (Finset.range (rr i - 2)).toList.map fun k =>
            if Q ∈ simplex (⟨uu i 0, uu i (k + 1), uu i (k + 2)⟩ : Triangle)
              then (1 : ℤ) else 0) := by
    rw [hc, Array.toList_toArray, List.map_flatMap]
    apply List.flatMap_congr
    intro i _
    rw [List.map_map]
    apply List.map_congr_left
    intro k _
    rfl
  rw [hmapeq, flatMap_double_sum R rr
    (fun i k => if Q ∈ simplex (⟨uu i 0, uu i (k + 1), uu i (k + 2)⟩ : Triangle)
      then (1 : ℤ) else 0)]
  
  apply double_indicator_unique R rr
    (fun i k => Q ∈ simplex (⟨uu i 0, uu i (k + 1), uu i (k + 2)⟩ : Triangle))
  
  
  
  
  
  
  
  
  
  have hℓ0le2 : Module.finrank ℚ (vectorSpan ℚ ({x : Point | G ℓ0 x = 0} ∩ K)) ≤ 2 :=
    cell_finrank_le_two (G ℓ0) (hLnz ℓ0) K
  have hO0 : Outer2D G K ℓ0 := ⟨hℓ0outer, le_antisymm hℓ0le2 hdim2⟩
  
  obtain ⟨ℓstar', hℓstar'R, hℓstar'Z⟩ := leaderExists G K hO0
  
  have hcellEq : {x : Point | G ℓstar' x = 0} ∩ K = {x : Point | G ℓ0 x = 0} ∩ K := by
    rw [hℓstar'Z]
  have hQstarCell : (ρ • Q) ∈ ({x : Point | G ℓstar' x = 0} ∩ K) := by
    rw [hcellEq]; exact ⟨hℓ0exit, hrhoK⟩
  
  have hcover := hcoverr ℓstar' hℓstar'R
  have hQstarFan : (ρ • Q) ∈ ⋃ k ∈ Finset.range (rr ℓstar' - 2),
      convexHull ℚ {uu ℓstar' 0, uu ℓstar' (k + 1), uu ℓstar' (k + 2)} := by
    rw [← hcover]; exact hQstarCell
  obtain ⟨kstar, hkstarMem, hQstarTri⟩ := Set.mem_iUnion₂.mp hQstarFan
  
  
  have hQmemStar : Q ∈ simplex (⟨uu ℓstar' 0, uu ℓstar' (kstar + 1), uu ℓstar' (kstar + 2)⟩ : Triangle) := by
    
    
    have htetra : simplex (⟨uu ℓstar' 0, uu ℓstar' (kstar + 1), uu ℓstar' (kstar + 2)⟩ : Triangle)
        = convexHull ℚ ({0, uu ℓstar' 0, uu ℓstar' (kstar + 1), uu ℓstar' (kstar + 2)} : Set Point) := rfl
    rw [htetra]
    have hconvT : Convex ℚ (convexHull ℚ ({0, uu ℓstar' 0, uu ℓstar' (kstar + 1), uu ℓstar' (kstar + 2)} : Set Point)) :=
      convex_convexHull ℚ _
    have h0T : (0 : Point) ∈ convexHull ℚ ({0, uu ℓstar' 0, uu ℓstar' (kstar + 1), uu ℓstar' (kstar + 2)} : Set Point) :=
      subset_convexHull ℚ _ (by simp)
    have hQstarT : (ρ • Q) ∈ convexHull ℚ ({0, uu ℓstar' 0, uu ℓstar' (kstar + 1), uu ℓstar' (kstar + 2)} : Set Point) := by
      apply convexHull_mono _ hQstarTri
      intro x hx
      simp only [Set.mem_insert_iff, Set.mem_singleton_iff] at hx ⊢
      tauto
    
    have hμ : (0 : ℚ) ≤ 1 / ρ := le_of_lt (by positivity)
    have hμ1 : 1 / ρ ≤ 1 := by rw [div_le_one hρpos]; exact h1ρ
    have hcc := hconvT hQstarT h0T (a := 1 / ρ) (b := 1 - 1 / ρ) hμ (by linarith) (by ring)
    have heq : (1 / ρ) • (ρ • Q) + (1 - 1 / ρ) • (0 : Point) = Q := by
      rw [smul_zero, add_zero, smul_smul]
      rw [one_div, inv_mul_cancel₀ (ne_of_gt hρpos), one_smul]
    rwa [heq] at hcc
  
  refine ⟨(ℓstar', kstar), ⟨hℓstar'R, hkstarMem, hQmemStar⟩, ?_⟩
  
  
  
  
  
  
  
  rintro ⟨i, k⟩ ⟨hiR, hkMem, hQmem⟩
  
  set p : Point := uu i 0 with hpdef
  set q : Point := uu i (k + 1) with hqdef
  set rr2 : Point := uu i (k + 2) with hrr2def
  
  have hiOuter : 0 < G i 0 := (hRmem hiR).1.1
  
  
  have hbaseCell : ∀ x ∈ ({p, q, rr2} : Set Point), x ∈ ({y : Point | G i y = 0} ∩ K) := by
    intro x hx
    rw [hcoverr i hiR]
    refine Set.mem_iUnion₂.mpr ⟨k, hkMem, ?_⟩
    exact subset_convexHull ℚ _ hx
  have hGip : G i p = 0 := (hbaseCell p (by simp)).1
  have hGiq : G i q = 0 := (hbaseCell q (by simp)).1
  have hGir : G i rr2 = 0 := (hbaseCell rr2 (by simp)).1
  have hpK : p ∈ K := (hbaseCell p (by simp)).2
  have hqK : q ∈ K := (hbaseCell q (by simp)).2
  have hrK : rr2 ∈ K := (hbaseCell rr2 (by simp)).2
  
  have hGiK : ∀ x ∈ K, 0 ≤ G i x := by
    intro x hx; rw [hKG] at hx; have := Set.mem_iInter.mp hx i; simpa using this
  
  have hAI4 : AffineIndependent ℚ ![(0 : Point), p, q, rr2] := hnondegr i hiR k hkMem
  
  obtain ⟨b, a₀, hbcoe, hbrange, hba₀⟩ :=
    Proof.AffineBasisSimplex.simplexAffineBasis ⟨p, q, rr2⟩ hAI4
  
  have hsimplexEq : simplex (⟨p, q, rr2⟩ : Triangle) = convexHull ℚ (Set.range ⇑b) := by
    unfold simplex; rw [← hbrange]
  
  have hcoordnn : ∀ j, 0 ≤ b.coord j Q := by
    have hmem : Q ∈ convexHull ℚ (Set.range ⇑b) := by rw [← hsimplexEq]; exact hQmem
    rw [b.convexHull_eq_nonneg_coord] at hmem; exact hmem
  have hsum1 : ∑ j, b.coord j Q = 1 := b.sum_coord_apply_eq_one Q
  
  have hb0 : b 0 = (0 : Point) := by have := congrFun hbcoe 0; simpa using this
  have hb1 : b 1 = p := by have := congrFun hbcoe 1; simpa using this
  have hb2 : b 2 = q := by have := congrFun hbcoe 2; simpa using this
  have hb3 : b 3 = rr2 := by have := congrFun hbcoe 3; simpa using this
  
  have hGivals : ∀ j, G i (b j) = if j = 0 then G i 0 else 0 := by
    intro j
    fin_cases j
    · show G i (b 0) = _; rw [hb0]; simp
    · show G i (b 1) = _; rw [hb1, hGip]; simp
    · show G i (b 2) = _; rw [hb2, hGiq]; simp
    · show G i (b 3) = _; rw [hb3, hGir]; simp
  
  set lam : Fin 4 → ℚ := fun j => b.coord j Q with hlam
  set lam0 : ℚ := lam 0 with hlam0
  
  have hQcombV : Q = ∑ j, lam j • (b j) := (b.linear_combination_coord_eq_self Q).symm
  have hGiQ : G i Q = lam0 * G i 0 := by
    have hQc : Q = Finset.univ.affineCombination ℚ b lam :=
      (b.affineCombination_coord_eq_self Q).symm
    have hpush : G i (Finset.univ.affineCombination ℚ b lam)
        = Finset.univ.affineCombination ℚ ((G i) ∘ b) lam :=
      Finset.univ.map_affineCombination b lam hsum1 (G i)
    rw [hQc, hpush, Finset.univ.affineCombination_eq_linear_combination _ _ hsum1]
    
    simp only [Function.comp_apply]
    rw [Fin.sum_univ_four]
    simp only [hGivals]
    simp only [show ((0 : Fin 4) = 0) = True from by simp,
      show ((1 : Fin 4) = 0) = False from by simp,
      show ((2 : Fin 4) = 0) = False from by simp,
      show ((3 : Fin 4) = 0) = False from by simp, if_true, if_false]
    simp only [smul_eq_mul, mul_zero, add_zero, hlam0, hlam]
  
  have hlamnn : ∀ j, 0 ≤ lam j := fun j => hcoordnn j
  have hlam0nn : 0 ≤ lam0 := hlamnn 0
  have hsumlam : lam 0 + lam 1 + lam 2 + lam 3 = 1 := by
    have := hsum1; rw [Fin.sum_univ_four] at this; simpa [hlam] using this
  
  have hQexp : Q = lam 1 • p + lam 2 • q + lam 3 • rr2 := by
    rw [hQcombV, Fin.sum_univ_four, hb0, hb1, hb2, hb3, smul_zero, zero_add, add_assoc]
  
  have hlam0lt1 : lam0 < 1 := by
    rcases lt_or_eq_of_le (show lam0 ≤ 1 from by
      have h1 : lam 1 + lam 2 + lam 3 = 1 - lam0 := by rw [hlam0]; linarith [hsumlam]
      have hnn : 0 ≤ lam 1 + lam 2 + lam 3 :=
        add_nonneg (add_nonneg (hlamnn 1) (hlamnn 2)) (hlamnn 3)
      linarith) with h | h
    · exact h
    · 
      exfalso
      have hsum0 : lam 1 + lam 2 + lam 3 = 0 := by rw [hlam0] at h; linarith [hsumlam]
      have h1 : lam 1 = 0 := le_antisymm (by linarith [hlamnn 2, hlamnn 3]) (hlamnn 1)
      have h2 : lam 2 = 0 := le_antisymm (by linarith [hlamnn 1, hlamnn 3]) (hlamnn 2)
      have h3 : lam 3 = 0 := le_antisymm (by linarith [hlamnn 1, hlamnn 2]) (hlamnn 3)
      apply hQ0
      rw [hQexp, h1, h2, h3, zero_smul, zero_smul, zero_smul, add_zero, add_zero]
  
  have h1mlam0 : 0 < 1 - lam0 := by linarith [hlam0lt1]
  set μw : ℚ := 1 / (1 - lam0) with hμw
  have hμwpos : 0 < μw := by rw [hμw]; positivity
  set w : Point := μw • Q with hwdef
  
  have hwconv : w ∈ convexHull ℚ ({p, q, rr2} : Set Point) := by
    
    refine mem_convexHull_of_exists_fintype
      (![μw * lam 1, μw * lam 2, μw * lam 3] : Fin 3 → ℚ)
      (![p, q, rr2] : Fin 3 → Point) ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_
    · intro j; fin_cases j <;>
        simp only [Matrix.cons_val_zero, Matrix.cons_val_one, Matrix.head_cons,
          Matrix.cons_val_two, Matrix.tail_cons] <;>
        exact mul_nonneg (le_of_lt hμwpos) (by first | exact hlamnn 1 | exact hlamnn 2 | exact hlamnn 3)
    · rw [Fin.sum_univ_three]
      simp only [Matrix.cons_val_zero, Matrix.cons_val_one, Matrix.head_cons,
        Matrix.cons_val_two, Matrix.tail_cons]
      rw [← mul_add, ← mul_add, hμw]
      have hs : lam 1 + lam 2 + lam 3 = 1 - lam0 := by rw [hlam0]; linarith [hsumlam]
      rw [hs]; field_simp
    · intro j; fin_cases j <;>
        simp only [Matrix.cons_val_zero, Matrix.cons_val_one, Matrix.head_cons,
          Matrix.cons_val_two, Matrix.tail_cons] <;>
        simp
    · rw [Fin.sum_univ_three]
      simp only [Matrix.cons_val_zero, Matrix.cons_val_one, Matrix.head_cons,
        Matrix.cons_val_two, Matrix.tail_cons]
      rw [hwdef, hQexp]
      rw [smul_add, smul_add, smul_smul, smul_smul, smul_smul]
  
  have hcellSub : convexHull ℚ ({p, q, rr2} : Set Point) ⊆ {y : Point | G i y = 0} ∩ K := by
    rw [hcoverr i hiR]
    intro x hx
    exact Set.mem_iUnion₂.mpr ⟨k, hkMem, hx⟩
  have hwCell : w ∈ {y : Point | G i y = 0} ∩ K := hcellSub hwconv
  have hGiw : G i w = 0 := hwCell.1
  have hwK : w ∈ K := hwCell.2
  
  have hμweq : μw = ρ := by
    refine radial_mult_eq hρeq hμwpos (by rw [← hwdef]; exact hwK) hGiK hiOuter ?_
    rw [← hwdef]; exact hGiw
  
  have hwQstar : w = ρ • Q := by rw [hwdef, hμweq]
  
  have hQstar_in_ik : (ρ • Q) ∈ convexHull ℚ ({p, q, rr2} : Set Point) := by
    rw [← hwQstar]; exact hwconv
  have hGiQstar : G i (ρ • Q) = 0 := by rw [← hwQstar]; exact hGiw
  
  
  have hZi : {x : Point | G i x = 0} = {x : Point | G ℓ0 x = 0} :=
    huniq i hiOuter hGiQstar
  
  have hZeq : {x : Point | G i x = 0} = {x : Point | G ℓstar' x = 0} := by
    rw [hZi, ← hℓstar'Z]
  
  have hieq : i = ℓstar' := leader_unique G K hiR hℓstar'R hZeq
  
  subst hieq
  
  
  have hkeq : k = kstar := by
    
    set u : ℕ → Point := uu i with hu
    set Pcell : Set Point := {y : Point | G i y = 0} ∩ K with hPcell
    
    have hQstarOffEdges : (ρ • Q) ∉ Proof.ConvexPolygonFan.fanEdges (rr i) u := by
      intro hmem
      rw [Proof.ConvexPolygonFan.fanEdges, Set.mem_iUnion₂] at hmem
      obtain ⟨k', hk', hmem'⟩ := hmem
      
      
      apply hQNedge
      rw [hNedge]
      refine Set.mem_iUnion₂.mpr ⟨i, hiR, ?_⟩
      refine Set.mem_iUnion₂.mpr ⟨k', hk', ?_⟩
      rcases hmem' with hseg1 | hseg2
      · 
        left; left
        have hplane : (ρ • Q) ∈ {x : Point | (∑ j, (crossProduct (u 0) (u (k' + 1))) j * x j) = 0} :=
          conv_subset_crossPlane (u 0) (u (k' + 1)) hseg1
        have hQ' : (∑ j, (crossProduct (u 0) (u (k' + 1))) j * Q j) = 0 :=
          crossPlane_descale (ne_of_gt hρpos) hplane
        exact hQ'
      · 
        left; right
        have hplane : (ρ • Q) ∈ {x : Point | (∑ j, (crossProduct (u (k' + 1)) (u (k' + 2))) j * x j) = 0} :=
          conv_subset_crossPlane (u (k' + 1)) (u (k' + 2)) hseg2
        have hQ' : (∑ j, (crossProduct (u (k' + 1)) (u (k' + 2))) j * Q j) = 0 :=
          crossPlane_descale (ne_of_gt hρpos) hplane
        exact hQ'
    
    obtain ⟨_, _, _, hpart⟩ :=
      Proof.ConvexPolygonFan.convexPolygonFan_partition Pcell (hrr i hℓstar'R) u
        (by rw [hPcell, hcoverr i hℓstar'R]; rfl)
        (hdisjr i hℓstar'R)
        (fun k' hk' => base_AI_of_apex (hnondegr i hℓstar'R k' hk'))
    
    have hQstarP : (ρ • Q) ∈ Pcell := hQstarCell
    obtain ⟨k0, _, huniqk⟩ := hpart (ρ • Q) hQstarP hQstarOffEdges
    
    have hk_eq : k = k0 :=
      huniqk k ⟨hkMem, hQstar_in_ik⟩
    have hkstar_eq : kstar = k0 :=
      huniqk kstar ⟨hkstarMem, hQstarTri⟩
    rw [hk_eq, hkstar_eq]
  
  rw [hkeq]

name: simExists
statement: theorem simExists (s t : Triangle) : simSpec s t
proof:
:= by
  classical
  set K : Set Point := simplex s ∩ simplex t with hKdef
  
  have h0A : (0 : Point) ∈ simplex s := by
    apply subset_convexHull ℚ; simp [simplex]
  have h0B : (0 : Point) ∈ simplex t := by
    apply subset_convexHull ℚ; simp [simplex]
  have h0K : (0 : Point) ∈ K := ⟨h0A, h0B⟩
  by_cases hco : Coplanar ℚ K
  · 
    
    obtain ⟨H, hHplane, hKH⟩ := Proof.Planes.coplanar_subset_isPlane hco ⟨0, h0K⟩
    refine ⟨#[], ?_, H, ⟨1, fun _ => H, fun _ => hHplane, ?_⟩, ?_⟩
    · intro e he; simp at he
    · intro x hx; exact Set.mem_iUnion.mpr ⟨0, hx⟩
    · intro Q hQ
      
      have hw : winding (#[] : Chain) Q = 0 := by simp [winding]
      rw [hw]
      
      have hQK : Q ∉ K := fun hQK => hQ (hKH hQK)
      rw [if_neg]
      exact fun h => hQK h
  · 
    
    
    
    
    
    
    
    have hKA : K ⊆ simplex s := hKdef ▸ Set.inter_subset_left
    have hKB : K ⊆ simplex t := hKdef ▸ Set.inter_subset_right
    have hAIs : AffineIndependent ℚ ![(0 : Point), s.v₀, s.v₁, s.v₂] :=
      affineIndependent_of_not_coplanar_inter s K hKA hco
    have hAIt : AffineIndependent ℚ ![(0 : Point), t.v₀, t.v₁, t.v₂] :=
      affineIndependent_of_not_coplanar_inter t K hKB hco
    
    obtain ⟨bA, aA, hbAcoe, hbArange, hbAapex⟩ :=
      Proof.AffineBasisSimplex.simplexAffineBasis s hAIs
    obtain ⟨bB, aB, hbBcoe, hbBrange, hbBapex⟩ :=
      Proof.AffineBasisSimplex.simplexAffineBasis t hAIt
    
    set G : Fin (4 + 4) → (Point →ᵃ[ℚ] ℚ) :=
      Fin.append (fun k => bA.coord k) (fun k => bB.coord k) with hGdef
    
    have hsA : simplex s = ⋂ k : Fin 4, {x : Point | 0 ≤ bA.coord k x} :=
      Proof.AffineBasisSimplex.simplex_eq_iInter_halfspaces s bA hbArange
    have hsB : simplex t = ⋂ k : Fin 4, {x : Point | 0 ≤ bB.coord k x} :=
      Proof.AffineBasisSimplex.simplex_eq_iInter_halfspaces t bB hbBrange
    have hKG : K = ⋂ i : Fin (4 + 4), {x : Point | 0 ≤ G i x} := by
      rw [hKdef, hsA, hsB]
      ext x
