      simp only [Set.mem_inter_iff, Set.mem_iInter, Set.mem_setOf_eq, hGdef]
      constructor
      · rintro ⟨hA, hB⟩ i
        refine Fin.addCases ?_ ?_ i
        · intro j; rw [Fin.append_left]; exact hA j
        · intro j; rw [Fin.append_right]; exact hB j
      · intro hall
        refine ⟨fun j => ?_, fun j => ?_⟩
        · have := hall (Fin.castAdd 4 j); rwa [Fin.append_left] at this
        · have := hall (Fin.natAdd 4 j); rwa [Fin.append_right] at this
    
    have hG0 : ∀ i, 0 ≤ G i 0 := by
      intro i
      have h0mem : (0 : Point) ∈ ⋂ i : Fin (4 + 4), {x : Point | 0 ≤ G i x} := by
        rw [← hKG]; exact h0K
      have := Set.mem_iInter.mp h0mem i
      simpa using this
    
    have hbdd : ∃ tB : Triangle, K ⊆ simplex tB := ⟨s, hKA⟩
    
    
    have hbind : ∀ {Q : Point}, Q ≠ 0 → ∃ i, (G i).linear Q < 0 := by
      intro Q hQ
      obtain ⟨k, hk⟩ := Proof.AffineBasisSimplex.directions_bounded_by_A_faces bA hQ
      refine ⟨Fin.castAdd 4 k, ?_⟩
      simpa [hGdef, Fin.append_left] using hk
    
    
    
    
    
    
    
    
    
    
    
    
    
    
    
    
    
    
    
    
    
    have hLnz : ∀ i, (G i).linear ≠ 0 := by
      intro i
      refine Fin.addCases ?_ ?_ i
      · intro j
        rw [hGdef, Fin.append_left]
        exact Proof.Planes.affineBasis_coord_linear_ne_zero bA j
      · intro j
        rw [hGdef, Fin.append_right]
        exact Proof.Planes.affineBasis_coord_linear_ne_zero bB j
    have hemit : ∃ (c : Chain),
        (∀ e ∈ c.toList, e.1 = 1)
        ∧ (∀ e ∈ c.toList, simplex e.2 ⊆ K)
        ∧ ∃ N : Set Point, Negligible N
            ∧ ∀ Q, Q ∈ K → Q ∉ N → winding c Q = 1 :=
      emitExists G K hKG h0K hbdd hbind hG0 hLnz
    
    obtain ⟨c, hcoeff, hsub, N, hN, hcount⟩ := hemit
    refine ⟨c, hcoeff, N, hN, ?_⟩
    intro Q hQN
    by_cases hQK : Q ∈ K
    · 
      have hw1 : winding c Q = 1 := hcount Q hQK hQN
      rw [hw1]
      rw [if_pos]
      exact hKdef ▸ hQK
    · 
      
      have hw0 : winding c Q = 0 :=
        winding_eq_zero_of_not_mem hsub hQK
      rw [hw0]
      rw [if_neg]
      exact fun h => hQK (hKdef ▸ h)

name: sim_winding
statement:
theorem sim_winding (s t : Triangle) :
    ∃ N : Set Point, Negligible N
      ∧ (∀ e ∈ (sim s t).toList, e.1 = 1)
      ∧ ∀ Q ∉ N, winding (sim s t) Q
          = (if Q ∈ simplex s ∩ simplex t then (1 : ℤ) else 0)
proof:
:= by
  
  
  have hspec := (simExists s t).choose_spec
  obtain ⟨hcoeff, N, hN, hwind⟩ := hspec
  exact ⟨N, hN, by simpa only [sim] using hcoeff, by simpa only [sim] using hwind⟩

name: forIn_list_eq
statement:
theorem forIn_list_eq {α β : Type} (l : List α) (init : β) (F : α → β → Id (ForInStep β))
    (f : α → β → β) (hF : ∀ a b, F a b = ForInStep.yield (f a b)) :
    forIn (m := Id) l init F = l.foldl (fun b a => f a b) init
proof:
:= by
  induction l generalizing init with
  | nil => rfl
  | cons a l ih =>
    rw [List.forIn_cons]
    show (match F a init with
      | ForInStep.done b => pure b
      | ForInStep.yield b => forIn (m := Id) l b F) = _
    rw [hF a init]
    exact ih (f a init)

name: forIn_array_eq
statement:
theorem forIn_array_eq {α β : Type} (as : Array α) (init : β) (F : α → β → Id (ForInStep β))
    (f : α → β → β) (hF : ∀ a b, F a b = ForInStep.yield (f a b)) :
    forIn (m := Id) as init F = as.toList.foldl (fun b a => f a b) init
proof:
:= by
  have h : as = as.toList.toArray := by simp
  rw [h, List.forIn_toArray, forIn_list_eq _ _ _ f hF, Array.toList_toArray]

name: getD_set_ne
statement:
theorem getD_set_ne {α : Type} (a : Array α) (j i : Nat) (v d : α) (h : i ≠ j) :
    (a.set! j v).getD i d = a.getD i d
proof:
:= by
  simp only [Array.set!_is_setIfInBounds, Array.getD, Array.size_setIfInBounds]
  by_cases hi : i < a.size
  · rw [dif_pos hi, dif_pos hi]
    show (Array.setIfInBounds a j v)[i]'(by simpa using hi) = a[i]
    simp only [Array.setIfInBounds]
    split
    · exact Array.getElem_set_ne _ _ _ _ _ (fun hc => h hc.symm)
    · rfl
  · rw [dif_neg hi, dif_neg hi]

name: getD_set_self
statement:
theorem getD_set_self {α : Type} (a : Array α) (j : Nat) (v d : α) (h : j < a.size) :
    (a.set! j v).getD j d = v
proof:
:= by
  simp only [Array.set!_is_setIfInBounds, Array.getD, Array.size_setIfInBounds, dif_pos h]
  exact Array.getElem_setIfInBounds_eq _ _ _

name: getD_true_lt
statement: theorem getD_true_lt (a : Array Bool) (i : Nat) (h : a.getD i false = true) : i < a.size
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hc : i < a.size
  · exact hc
  · rw [Array.getD, dif_neg hc] at h; exact absurd h (by simp)

name: getD_range
statement: theorem getD_range (n i : Nat) : (Array.range n).getD i i = i
proof:
:= by
  rw [Array.getD]
  by_cases h : i < (Array.range n).size
  · rw [dif_pos h]; exact Array.getElem_range _
  · rw [dif_neg h]

name: getD_mkArray_false
statement: theorem getD_mkArray_false (n i : Nat) : (mkArray n false).getD i false = false
proof:
:= by
  rw [Array.getD]
  by_cases h : i < (mkArray n false).size
  · rw [dif_pos h]; exact Array.getElem_mkArray _ _ _
  · rw [dif_neg h]

name: edgeMapOf_eq
statement:
theorem edgeMapOf_eq (A : Array FaceS) (free : Array Bool) :
    (forIn (m := Id) (⟨0, A.size, 1⟩ : Std.Range) (∅ : Std.HashMap EdgeKeyC (List Nat))
      (P1body A free)) = edgeMapOf A free
proof:
:= by
  rw [forIn_range_eq _ _ _ (fun i mm => emStep A free i mm) ?_]
  · rfl
  · intro i b
    simp only [emStep, P1body]
    split
    · exact congrArg ForInStep.yield
        (forIn_array_eq _ _ _ (fun e mm => insStep i e mm) (fun _ _ => rfl))
    · rfl

name: inner_eq
statement:
theorem inner_eq (m : Std.HashMap EdgeKeyC (List Nat)) (root : Nat) (es : Array (P3 × P3))
    (s : ISt) :
    forIn (m := Id) es s (fun e s => do
        let r ← forIn (m := Id) (m.getD (edgeKeyC e.2 e.1) []) (⟨s.1, s.2.1, s.2.2⟩ : ISt)
          (fun j s => if (!s.2.1.getD j false) = true then
              pure (ForInStep.yield (⟨s.1.set! j root, s.2.1.set! j true, s.2.2.push j⟩ : ISt))
            else pure (ForInStep.yield s))
        pure (ForInStep.yield r))
      = es.toList.foldl (fun s e => edgeStep m root e s) s
proof:
:= by
  refine forIn_array_eq _ _ _ (fun e s => edgeStep m root e s) ?_
  intro e s
  refine congrArg ForInStep.yield ?_
  refine forIn_list_eq _ _ _ (fun j s => nbrStep root j s) ?_
  intro j s
  simp only [nbrStep]
  split <;> rfl

name: phase2_eq
statement:
theorem phase2_eq (A : Array FaceS) (free : Array Bool) (m : Std.HashMap EdgeKeyC (List Nat))
    (init : BSt) :
    forIn (m := Id) (⟨0, 2 * A.size, 1⟩ : Std.Range) init (P2body A free m)
      = (List.range (2 * A.size)).foldl (fun st _ => bfsStep A free m st) init
proof:
:= by
  refine forIn_range_eq _ _ _ (fun _ st => bfsStep A free m st) ?_
  intro x st
  show P2body A free m x st = ForInStep.yield (bfsStep A free m st)
  unfold P2body bfsStep
  split
  · rw [inner_eq]; rfl
  · split
    · split <;> rfl
    · rfl

name: clusterFree_eq
statement:
theorem clusterFree_eq (A : Array FaceS) (free : Array Bool) :
    clusterFree A free = (bfsRun A free).1
proof:
:= by
  show (forIn (m := Id) (⟨0, 2 * A.size, 1⟩ : Std.Range)
      (⟨Array.range A.size, 0, mkArray A.size false, 0, #[]⟩ : BSt)
      (P2body A free (forIn (m := Id) (⟨0, A.size, 1⟩ : Std.Range)
        (∅ : Std.HashMap EdgeKeyC (List Nat)) (P1body A free)))).1 = _
  rw [edgeMapOf_eq, phase2_eq]
  rfl

name: mapOk_empty
statement:
theorem mapOk_empty (A : Array FaceS) (free : Array Bool) :
    MapOk A free (∅ : Std.HashMap EdgeKeyC (List Nat))
proof:
:= by
  intro k j hj
  rw [Std.HashMap.getD_emptyc] at hj
  exact absurd hj (List.not_mem_nil j)

name: mapOk_insStep
statement:
theorem mapOk_insStep (A : Array FaceS) (free : Array Bool) {m : Std.HashMap EdgeKeyC (List Nat)}
    (hm : MapOk A free m) {i : Nat} (hi : i < A.size) (hfi : free.getD i false = true)
    {e : P3 × P3} (he : e ∈ (faceEdgesC (A.getD i default)).toList) :
    MapOk A free (insStep i e m)
proof:
:= by
  intro k j hj
  rw [insStep, Std.HashMap.getD_insert] at hj
  split at hj
  · rename_i hk
    have hk' : edgeKeyC e.1 e.2 = k := by simpa using hk
    rcases List.mem_cons.mp hj with h | h
    · exact ⟨h ▸ hi, h ▸ hfi, h ▸ ⟨e, he, hk'⟩⟩
    · exact hm k j (hk' ▸ h)
  · exact hm k j hj

name: mapOk_foldl_insStep
statement:
theorem mapOk_foldl_insStep (A : Array FaceS) (free : Array Bool) {i : Nat} (hi : i < A.size)
    (hfi : free.getD i false = true) :
    ∀ (l : List (P3 × P3)), (∀ e ∈ l, e ∈ (faceEdgesC (A.getD i default)).toList) →
      ∀ m, MapOk A free m → MapOk A free (l.foldl (fun m e => insStep i e m) m)
proof:
:= by
  intro l
  induction l with
  | nil => intro _ m hm; exact hm
  | cons e l ih =>
    intro hl m hm
    rw [List.foldl_cons]
    exact ih (fun e' he' => hl e' (List.mem_cons_of_mem _ he')) _
      (mapOk_insStep A free hm hi hfi (hl e (List.mem_cons_self _ _)))

name: mapOk_emStep
statement:
theorem mapOk_emStep (A : Array FaceS) (free : Array Bool) {i : Nat} (hi : i < A.size)
    {m : Std.HashMap EdgeKeyC (List Nat)} (hm : MapOk A free m) :
    MapOk A free (emStep A free i m)
proof:
:= by
  unfold emStep
  by_cases hfi : free.getD i false = true
  · rw [if_pos hfi]
    exact mapOk_foldl_insStep A free hi hfi _ (fun _ he => he) _ hm
  · rw [if_neg hfi]
    exact hm

name: edgeMapOf_ok
statement: theorem edgeMapOf_ok (A : Array FaceS) (free : Array Bool) : MapOk A free (edgeMapOf A free)
proof:
:= by
  rw [edgeMapOf]
  have key : ∀ (l : List Nat), (∀ i ∈ l, i < A.size) →
      ∀ m, MapOk A free m → MapOk A free (l.foldl (fun m i => emStep A free i m) m) := by
    intro l
    induction l with
    | nil => intro _ m hm; exact hm
    | cons i l ih =>
      intro hl m hm
      rw [List.foldl_cons]
      exact ih (fun i' hi' => hl i' (List.mem_cons_of_mem _ hi')) _
        (mapOk_emStep A free (hl i (List.mem_cons_self _ _)) hm)
  exact key _ (fun i hi => List.mem_range.mp hi) _ (mapOk_empty A free)

name: AdjC.symm
statement:
theorem AdjC.symm {A : Array FaceS} {free : Array Bool} {i j : Nat} (h : AdjC A free i j) :
    AdjC A free j i
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨hi, hj, hfi, hfj, e, he, e', he', hk⟩ := h
  refine ⟨hj, hi, hfj, hfi, e', he', e, he, ?_⟩
  simp only [edgeKeyC, EdgeKeyC.mk.injEq] at hk ⊢
  exact ⟨hk.2.2.2.1.symm, hk.2.2.2.2.1.symm, hk.2.2.2.2.2.symm, hk.1.symm, hk.2.1.symm,
    hk.2.2.1.symm⟩

name: ok_init
statement:
theorem ok_init (A : Array FaceS) (free : Array Bool) :
    Ok A free (Array.range A.size) (mkArray A.size false) #[] where
  labelSize
proof:
:= Array.size_range
  visitedSize := Array.size_mkArray _ _
  vis := by
    intro j hj
    rw [getD_mkArray_false] at hj
    exact absurd hj (by simp)
  unvis := fun j _ => getD_range _ _
  wrk := by
    intro i hi
    exact absurd hi (by simp)

name: nbrStep_ok
statement:
theorem nbrStep_ok (A : Array FaceS) (free : Array Bool) {s : ISt} {root i j : Nat}
    (hOk : Ok A free s.1 s.2.1 s.2.2) (hR : RootOk A free s.1 s.2.1 root i)
    (hadj : AdjC A free i j) :
    Ok A free (nbrStep root j s).1 (nbrStep root j s).2.1 (nbrStep root j s).2.2 ∧
      RootOk A free (nbrStep root j s).1 (nbrStep root j s).2.1 root i
proof:
:= by
  rw [nbrStep]
  split
  · rename_i hnv
    
    have hjv : ¬ (s.2.1.getD j false = true) := by
      intro h; rw [h] at hnv; exact absurd hnv (by simp)
    have hjlt : j < A.size := hadj.2.1
    have hjlab : j < s.1.size := by rw [hOk.labelSize]; exact hjlt
    have hjvis : j < s.2.1.size := by rw [hOk.visitedSize]; exact hjlt
    
    have hrj : root ≠ j := fun h => hjv (h ▸ hR.isVis)
    have hvis_root : (s.2.1.set! j true).getD root false = true := by
      rw [getD_set_ne _ _ _ _ _ hrj]; exact hR.isVis
    have hlab_root : (s.1.set! j root).getD root root = root := by
      rw [getD_set_ne _ _ _ _ _ hrj]; exact hR.isRoot
    
    have hread : ∀ x, (s.2.1.set! j true).getD x false = true ↔
        (x = j ∨ s.2.1.getD x false = true) := by
      intro x
      by_cases hx : x = j
      · subst hx
        rw [getD_set_self _ _ _ _ hjvis]
        exact ⟨fun _ => Or.inl rfl, fun _ => rfl⟩
      · rw [getD_set_ne _ _ _ _ _ hx]
        exact ⟨fun h => Or.inr h, fun h => h.resolve_left hx⟩
    refine ⟨⟨?_, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩, ⟨hR.lt, hR.isFree, hvis_root, hlab_root, hR.chain⟩⟩
    · show (s.1.set! j root).size = A.size
      rw [Array.set!_is_setIfInBounds, Array.size_setIfInBounds]; exact hOk.labelSize
    · show (s.2.1.set! j true).size = A.size
      rw [Array.set!_is_setIfInBounds, Array.size_setIfInBounds]; exact hOk.visitedSize
    · intro x hx
      rcases (hread x).mp hx with rfl | hxv
      · 
        rw [getD_set_self _ _ _ _ hjlab]
        exact ⟨hjlt, hadj.2.2.2.1, hR.lt, hR.isFree, hvis_root, hlab_root,
          ChainC.step hR.chain hadj⟩
      · 
        obtain ⟨hxlt, hxf, hrlt, hrf, hrv, hrr, hch⟩ := hOk.vis x hxv
        have hxj : x ≠ j := fun h => hjv (h ▸ hxv)
        have hrj' : s.1.getD x x ≠ j := fun h => hjv (h ▸ hrv)
        rw [getD_set_ne _ _ _ _ _ hxj, getD_set_ne _ _ _ _ _ hrj',
          getD_set_ne _ _ _ _ _ hrj']
        exact ⟨hxlt, hxf, hrlt, hrf, hrv, hrr, hch⟩
    · intro x hx
      have hxj : x ≠ j := by
        intro h; exact hx ((hread x).mpr (Or.inl h))
      rw [getD_set_ne _ _ _ _ _ hxj]
      exact hOk.unvis x (fun h => hx ((hread x).mpr (Or.inr h)))
    · intro x hx
      rcases Array.mem_push.mp hx with hx' | rfl
      · exact (hread x).mpr (Or.inr (hOk.wrk x hx'))
      · exact (hread x).mpr (Or.inl rfl)
  · exact ⟨hOk, hR⟩

name: nbrFold_ok
statement:
theorem nbrFold_ok (A : Array FaceS) (free : Array Bool) {root i : Nat} :
    ∀ (l : List Nat), (∀ j ∈ l, AdjC A free i j) → ∀ s : ISt,
      Ok A free s.1 s.2.1 s.2.2 → RootOk A free s.1 s.2.1 root i →
      Ok A free (l.foldl (fun s j => nbrStep root j s) s).1
          (l.foldl (fun s j => nbrStep root j s) s).2.1
          (l.foldl (fun s j => nbrStep root j s) s).2.2 ∧
        RootOk A free (l.foldl (fun s j => nbrStep root j s) s).1
          (l.foldl (fun s j => nbrStep root j s) s).2.1 root i
proof:
:= by
  intro l
  induction l with
  | nil => intro _ s hOk hR; exact ⟨hOk, hR⟩
  | cons j l ih =>
    intro hl s hOk hR
    rw [List.foldl_cons]
    obtain ⟨hOk', hR'⟩ := nbrStep_ok A free hOk hR (hl j (List.mem_cons_self _ _))
    exact ih (fun j' hj' => hl j' (List.mem_cons_of_mem _ hj')) _ hOk' hR'

name: edgeFold_ok
statement:
theorem edgeFold_ok (A : Array FaceS) (free : Array Bool) {m : Std.HashMap EdgeKeyC (List Nat)}
    (hm : MapOk A free m) {root i : Nat} (hi : i < A.size) (hfi : free.getD i false = true) :
    ∀ (l : List (P3 × P3)), (∀ e ∈ l, e ∈ (faceEdgesC (A.getD i default)).toList) →
      ∀ s : ISt, Ok A free s.1 s.2.1 s.2.2 → RootOk A free s.1 s.2.1 root i →
      Ok A free (l.foldl (fun s e => edgeStep m root e s) s).1
          (l.foldl (fun s e => edgeStep m root e s) s).2.1
          (l.foldl (fun s e => edgeStep m root e s) s).2.2 ∧
        RootOk A free (l.foldl (fun s e => edgeStep m root e s) s).1
          (l.foldl (fun s e => edgeStep m root e s) s).2.1 root i
proof:
:= by
  intro l
  induction l with
  | nil => intro _ s hOk hR; exact ⟨hOk, hR⟩
  | cons e l ih =>
    intro hl s hOk hR
    rw [List.foldl_cons]
    have hadj : ∀ j ∈ m.getD (edgeKeyC e.2 e.1) [], AdjC A free i j := by
      intro j hj
      obtain ⟨hjlt, hjf, e', he', hk⟩ := hm _ j hj
      exact ⟨hi, hjlt, hfi, hjf, e, hl e (List.mem_cons_self _ _), e', he', hk⟩
    obtain ⟨hOk', hR'⟩ := nbrFold_ok A free _ hadj s hOk hR
    exact ih (fun e' he'' => hl e' (List.mem_cons_of_mem _ he'')) _ hOk' hR'

name: bfsStep_ok
statement:
theorem bfsStep_ok (A : Array FaceS) (free : Array Bool) {m : Std.HashMap EdgeKeyC (List Nat)}
    (hm : MapOk A free m) {st : BSt} (hOk : Ok A free st.1 st.2.2.1 st.2.2.2.2) :
    Ok A free (bfsStep A free m st).1 (bfsStep A free m st).2.2.1
      (bfsStep A free m st).2.2.2.2
proof:
:= by
  unfold bfsStep
  by_cases hwk : st.2.2.2.1 < st.2.2.2.2.size
  · 
    rw [if_pos hwk]
    have hmem : st.2.2.2.2.getD st.2.2.2.1 0 ∈ st.2.2.2.2 := by
      rw [arr_getD _ _ _ hwk]; exact Array.getElem_mem hwk
    have hvis := hOk.wrk _ hmem
    obtain ⟨hilt, hif, hrlt, hrf, hrv, hrr, hch⟩ := hOk.vis _ hvis
    exact (edgeFold_ok A free hm hilt hif _ (fun _ he => he)
      (⟨st.1, st.2.2.1, st.2.2.2.2⟩ : ISt) hOk ⟨hrlt, hrf, hrv, hrr, hch⟩).1
  · rw [if_neg hwk]
    by_cases hseed : st.2.1 < A.size
    · rw [if_pos hseed]
      by_cases hpush : (free.getD st.2.1 false && !st.2.2.1.getD st.2.1 false) = true
      · 
        rw [if_pos hpush]
        obtain ⟨hsf, hsnv⟩ := (Bool.and_eq_true _ _).mp hpush
        have hsv : ¬ (st.2.2.1.getD st.2.1 false = true) := by
          intro h; rw [h] at hsnv; exact absurd hsnv (by simp)
        have hslab : st.2.1 < st.1.size := by rw [hOk.labelSize]; exact hseed
        have hsvis : st.2.1 < st.2.2.1.size := by rw [hOk.visitedSize]; exact hseed
        have hread : ∀ x, (st.2.2.1.set! st.2.1 true).getD x false = true ↔
            (x = st.2.1 ∨ st.2.2.1.getD x false = true) := by
          intro x
          by_cases hx : x = st.2.1
          · subst hx
            rw [getD_set_self _ _ _ _ hsvis]
            exact ⟨fun _ => Or.inl rfl, fun _ => rfl⟩
          · rw [getD_set_ne _ _ _ _ _ hx]
            exact ⟨fun h => Or.inr h, fun h => h.resolve_left hx⟩
        refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
        · show (st.1.set! st.2.1 st.2.1).size = A.size
          rw [Array.set!_is_setIfInBounds, Array.size_setIfInBounds]; exact hOk.labelSize
        · show (st.2.2.1.set! st.2.1 true).size = A.size
          rw [Array.set!_is_setIfInBounds, Array.size_setIfInBounds]; exact hOk.visitedSize
        · intro x hx
          rcases (hread x).mp hx with rfl | hxv
          · rw [getD_set_self _ _ _ _ hslab, getD_set_self _ _ _ _ hslab,
              getD_set_self _ _ _ _ hsvis]
            exact ⟨hseed, hsf, hseed, hsf, rfl, rfl, ChainC.refl _⟩
          · obtain ⟨hxlt, hxf, hrlt, hrf, hrv, hrr, hch⟩ := hOk.vis x hxv
            have hxj : x ≠ st.2.1 := fun h => hsv (h ▸ hxv)
            have hrj : st.1.getD x x ≠ st.2.1 := fun h => hsv (h ▸ hrv)
            rw [getD_set_ne _ _ _ _ _ hxj, getD_set_ne _ _ _ _ _ hrj,
              getD_set_ne _ _ _ _ _ hrj]
            exact ⟨hxlt, hxf, hrlt, hrf, hrv, hrr, hch⟩
        · intro x hx
          have hxj : x ≠ st.2.1 := fun h => hx ((hread x).mpr (Or.inl h))
          rw [getD_set_ne _ _ _ _ _ hxj]
          exact hOk.unvis x (fun h => hx ((hread x).mpr (Or.inr h)))
        · intro x hx
          rcases Array.mem_push.mp hx with hx' | rfl
          · exact (hread x).mpr (Or.inr (hOk.wrk x hx'))
          · exact (hread _).mpr (Or.inl rfl)
      · rw [if_neg hpush]; exact hOk
    · rw [if_neg hseed]; exact hOk

name: bfsRun_ok
statement:
theorem bfsRun_ok (A : Array FaceS) (free : Array Bool) :
    Ok A free (bfsRun A free).1 (bfsRun A free).2.2.1 (bfsRun A free).2.2.2.2
proof:
:= by
  rw [bfsRun]
  have key : ∀ (l : List Nat) (st : BSt), Ok A free st.1 st.2.2.1 st.2.2.2.2 →
      Ok A free (l.foldl (fun st _ => bfsStep A free (edgeMapOf A free) st) st).1
        (l.foldl (fun st _ => bfsStep A free (edgeMapOf A free) st) st).2.2.1
        (l.foldl (fun st _ => bfsStep A free (edgeMapOf A free) st) st).2.2.2.2 := by
    intro l
    induction l with
    | nil => intro st h; exact h
    | cons _ l ih =>
      intro st h
      rw [List.foldl_cons]
      exact ih _ (bfsStep_ok A free (edgeMapOf_ok A free) h)
  exact key _ _ (ok_init A free)

name: clusterFree_spec
statement:
theorem clusterFree_spec (A : Array FaceS) (free : Array Bool) (hfs : free.size = A.size)
    {i : Nat} (hfree : free.getD i false = true) :
    (clusterFree A free).getD i i < A.size ∧
      free.getD ((clusterFree A free).getD i i) false = true ∧
      (clusterFree A free).getD ((clusterFree A free).getD i i)
        ((clusterFree A free).getD i i) = (clusterFree A free).getD i i ∧
      ChainC A free ((clusterFree A free).getD i i) i
proof:
:= by
  have hOk := bfsRun_ok A free
  rw [clusterFree_eq]
  by_cases hv : (bfsRun A free).2.2.1.getD i false = true
  · obtain ⟨_, _, hrlt, hrf, _, hrr, hch⟩ := hOk.vis i hv
    exact ⟨hrlt, hrf, hrr, hch⟩
  · have hlab : (bfsRun A free).1.getD i i = i := hOk.unvis i hv
    have hilt : i < A.size := by rw [← hfs]; exact getD_true_lt free i hfree
    rw [hlab]
    exact ⟨hilt, hfree, hlab, ChainC.refl i⟩

statement:
theorem e_decomp_x (t : Triangle) (P : Point) :
    (dotQ (Proof.MeshIntersectJump.faceNormal t) (Proof.MeshIntersectJump.faceNormal t)) * P 0
      = ee1 t P * t.v₀ 0 + ee2 t P * t.v₁ 0 + ee0 t P * t.v₂ 0
        + dotQ (Proof.MeshIntersectJump.faceNormal t) (psub P t.v₀) * Proof.MeshIntersectJump.faceNormal t 0

statement:

name: e_decomp
statement:
theorem e_decomp (t : Triangle) (P : Point) :
    (dotQ (Proof.MeshIntersectJump.faceNormal t) (Proof.MeshIntersectJump.faceNormal t)) • P
      = (ee1 t P) • t.v₀ + (ee2 t P) • t.v₁ + (ee0 t P) • t.v₂
        + (dotQ (Proof.MeshIntersectJump.faceNormal t) (psub P t.v₀)) • (Proof.MeshIntersectJump.faceNormal t)
proof:
:= by
  funext k
  simp only [Pi.add_apply, Pi.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul]
  fin_cases k
  · exact e_decomp_x t P
  · exact e_decomp_y t P
  · exact e_decomp_z t P

name: e_sum
statement:
theorem e_sum (t : Triangle) (P : Point) :
    ee0 t P + ee1 t P + ee2 t P = dotQ (Proof.MeshIntersectJump.faceNormal t) (Proof.MeshIntersectJump.faceNormal t)
proof:
:= by
  simp only [ee0, ee1, ee2, Proof.MeshIntersectJump.faceNormal, det3, dotQ, crossQ, psub, mkPoint_zero, mkPoint_one, mkPoint_two]; ring

name: carrier_repr
statement:
theorem carrier_repr {t : Triangle} {P : Point}
    (hP : dotQ (Proof.MeshIntersectJump.faceNormal t) P = detOrigin t) (hdet : detOrigin t ≠ 0) :
    P = (ee1 t P / dotQ (Proof.MeshIntersectJump.faceNormal t) (Proof.MeshIntersectJump.faceNormal t)) • t.v₀
      + (ee2 t P / dotQ (Proof.MeshIntersectJump.faceNormal t) (Proof.MeshIntersectJump.faceNormal t)) • t.v₁
      + (ee0 t P / dotQ (Proof.MeshIntersectJump.faceNormal t) (Proof.MeshIntersectJump.faceNormal t)) • t.v₂
proof:
:= by
  set N := dotQ (Proof.MeshIntersectJump.faceNormal t) (Proof.MeshIntersectJump.faceNormal t) with hN
  have hNne : N ≠ 0 := (N_pos hdet).ne'
  have hoff : dotQ (Proof.MeshIntersectJump.faceNormal t) (psub P t.v₀) = 0 := by
    have h1 : dotQ (Proof.MeshIntersectJump.faceNormal t) (psub P t.v₀)
        = dotQ (Proof.MeshIntersectJump.faceNormal t) P - dotQ (Proof.MeshIntersectJump.faceNormal t) t.v₀ := by
      simp only [dotQ, psub]; ring
    rw [h1, hP, faceNormal_offset]; ring
  have hkey := e_decomp t P
  rw [hoff, zero_smul, add_zero] at hkey
  
  have he : ∀ e : ℚ, N * (e / N) = e := fun e => by
    rw [← mul_div_assoc, mul_comm, mul_div_assoc, div_self hNne, mul_one]
  apply smul_right_injective (Fin 3 → ℚ) hNne
  show N • P = N • ((ee1 t P / N) • t.v₀ + (ee2 t P / N) • t.v₁ + (ee0 t P / N) • t.v₂)
  rw [hkey, smul_add, smul_add, smul_smul, smul_smul, smul_smul, he, he, he]

name: ee_affine
statement:
theorem ee_affine (a v n x y : Point) (s r : ℚ) (hsr : s + r = 1) :
    det3 a (psub (s • x + r • y) v) n
      = s * det3 a (psub x v) n + r * det3 a (psub y v) n
proof:
:= by
  have hr : r = 1 - s := by linarith
  subst hr
  simp only [det3, dotQ, crossQ, psub, mkPoint_zero, mkPoint_one, mkPoint_two, Pi.add_apply, Pi.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul]; ring

name: convex_ee0_nonneg

  simp only [ee0, Set.mem_setOf_eq] at hx hy ⊢

name: ee_nonneg_of_mem_triangleSet
statement:
theorem ee_nonneg_of_mem_triangleSet {t : Triangle} {P : Point} (hP : P ∈ triangleSet t) :
    0 ≤ ee0 t P ∧ 0 ≤ ee1 t P ∧ 0 ≤ ee2 t P
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · have hsub : ({t.v₀, t.v₁, t.v₂} : Set Point) ⊆ {P : Point | 0 ≤ ee0 t P} := by
      intro y hy; simp only [Set.mem_insert_iff, Set.mem_singleton_iff] at hy
      rcases hy with rfl | rfl | rfl
      · rw [Set.mem_setOf_eq, ee0_v0]
      · rw [Set.mem_setOf_eq, ee0_v1]
      · rw [Set.mem_setOf_eq, ee0_v2]; exact N_nonneg t
    exact convexHull_min hsub (convex_ee0_nonneg t) hP
  · have hsub : ({t.v₀, t.v₁, t.v₂} : Set Point) ⊆ {P : Point | 0 ≤ ee1 t P} := by
      intro y hy; simp only [Set.mem_insert_iff, Set.mem_singleton_iff] at hy
      rcases hy with rfl | rfl | rfl
      · rw [Set.mem_setOf_eq, ee1_v0]; exact N_nonneg t
      · rw [Set.mem_setOf_eq, ee1_v1]
      · rw [Set.mem_setOf_eq, ee1_v2]
    exact convexHull_min hsub (convex_ee1_nonneg t) hP
  · have hsub : ({t.v₀, t.v₁, t.v₂} : Set Point) ⊆ {P : Point | 0 ≤ ee2 t P} := by
      intro y hy; simp only [Set.mem_insert_iff, Set.mem_singleton_iff] at hy
      rcases hy with rfl | rfl | rfl
      · rw [Set.mem_setOf_eq, ee2_v0]
      · rw [Set.mem_setOf_eq, ee2_v1]; exact N_nonneg t
      · rw [Set.mem_setOf_eq, ee2_v2]
    exact convexHull_min hsub (convex_ee2_nonneg t) hP

name: mem_convexHull_triple
statement:
theorem mem_convexHull_triple {a b c : ℚ} (ha : 0 ≤ a) (hb : 0 ≤ b) (hc : 0 ≤ c)
    (habc : a + b + c = 1) (v0 v1 v2 : Point) :
    a • v0 + b • v1 + c • v2 ∈ convexHull ℚ ({v0, v1, v2} : Set Point)
proof:
:= by
  have hconv := convex_convexHull ℚ ({v0, v1, v2} : Set Point)
  have hmem : ∀ i : Fin 3, ![v0, v1, v2] i ∈ convexHull ℚ ({v0, v1, v2} : Set Point) := by
    intro i; fin_cases i <;> exact subset_convexHull ℚ _ (by simp)
  have hw : ∀ i : Fin 3, 0 ≤ ![a, b, c] i := by intro i; fin_cases i <;> assumption
  have hsum : ∑ i : Fin 3, ![a, b, c] i = 1 := by
    rw [Fin.sum_univ_three]; simpa using habc
  have := hconv.sum_mem (fun i _ => hw i) hsum (fun i _ => hmem i)
  rw [Fin.sum_univ_three] at this
  simpa using this

name: mem_triangleSet_of_carrier
statement:
theorem mem_triangleSet_of_carrier {t : Triangle} {P : Point}
    (hdet : detOrigin t ≠ 0) (hP : dotQ (Proof.MeshIntersectJump.faceNormal t) P = detOrigin t)
    (h0 : 0 ≤ ee0 t P) (h1 : 0 ≤ ee1 t P) (h2 : 0 ≤ ee2 t P) :
    P ∈ triangleSet t
proof:
:= by
  set N := dotQ (Proof.MeshIntersectJump.faceNormal t) (Proof.MeshIntersectJump.faceNormal t) with hN
  have hNpos : 0 < N := N_pos hdet
  have hrepr := carrier_repr hP hdet
  rw [hrepr]
  refine mem_convexHull_triple (div_nonneg h1 hNpos.le) (div_nonneg h2 hNpos.le)
    (div_nonneg h0 hNpos.le) ?_ t.v₀ t.v₁ t.v₂
  rw [div_add_div_same, div_add_div_same,
    show ee1 t P + ee2 t P + ee0 t P = N from by rw [hN]; linarith [e_sum t P]]
  exact div_self hNpos.ne'

name: ee_zero_of_mem_edgeSet
statement:
theorem ee_zero_of_mem_edgeSet {t : Triangle} {P : Point} (hP : P ∈ edgeSet t) :
    ee0 t P = 0 ∨ ee1 t P = 0 ∨ ee2 t P = 0
proof:
:= by
  simp only [edgeSet, Set.mem_union, segment, Set.mem_setOf_eq] at hP
  rcases hP with (h | h) | h
  · 
    left
    obtain ⟨p, q, hp, hq, hpq, hPeq⟩ := h
    have hPv : psub P t.v₀ = q • psub t.v₁ t.v₀ := by
      rw [← hPeq]; funext i
      simp only [psub, Pi.add_apply, Pi.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul]
      have : p = 1 - q := by linarith
      rw [this]; ring
    rw [show ee0 t P = det3 (psub t.v₁ t.v₀) (psub P t.v₀) (Proof.MeshIntersectJump.faceNormal t) from rfl, hPv]
    simp only [det3, dotQ, crossQ, psub, mkPoint_zero, mkPoint_one, mkPoint_two, Proof.MeshIntersectJump.faceNormal, Pi.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul]; ring
  · 
    right; left
    obtain ⟨p, q, hp, hq, hpq, hPeq⟩ := h
    have hPv : psub P t.v₁ = q • psub t.v₂ t.v₁ := by
      rw [← hPeq]; funext i
      simp only [psub, Pi.add_apply, Pi.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul]
      have : p = 1 - q := by linarith
      rw [this]; ring
    rw [show ee1 t P = det3 (psub t.v₂ t.v₁) (psub P t.v₁) (Proof.MeshIntersectJump.faceNormal t) from rfl, hPv]
    simp only [det3, dotQ, crossQ, psub, mkPoint_zero, mkPoint_one, mkPoint_two, Proof.MeshIntersectJump.faceNormal, Pi.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul]; ring
  · 
    right; right
    obtain ⟨p, q, hp, hq, hpq, hPeq⟩ := h
    have hPv : psub P t.v₂ = q • psub t.v₀ t.v₂ := by
      rw [← hPeq]; funext i
      simp only [psub, Pi.add_apply, Pi.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul]
      have : p = 1 - q := by linarith
      rw [this]; ring
    rw [show ee2 t P = det3 (psub t.v₀ t.v₂) (psub P t.v₂) (Proof.MeshIntersectJump.faceNormal t) from rfl, hPv]
    simp only [det3, dotQ, crossQ, psub, mkPoint_zero, mkPoint_one, mkPoint_two, Proof.MeshIntersectJump.faceNormal, Pi.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul]; ring

name: mem_edgeSet_of_carrier
statement:
theorem mem_edgeSet_of_carrier {t : Triangle} {P : Point}
    (hdet : detOrigin t ≠ 0) (hP : dotQ (Proof.MeshIntersectJump.faceNormal t) P = detOrigin t)
    (h0 : 0 ≤ ee0 t P) (h1 : 0 ≤ ee1 t P) (h2 : 0 ≤ ee2 t P)
    (hz : ee0 t P = 0 ∨ ee1 t P = 0 ∨ ee2 t P = 0) :
    P ∈ edgeSet t
proof:
:= by
  set N := dotQ (Proof.MeshIntersectJump.faceNormal t) (Proof.MeshIntersectJump.faceNormal t) with hN
  have hNpos : 0 < N := N_pos hdet
  have hrepr := carrier_repr hP hdet
  rw [← hN] at hrepr
  have hsum : ee0 t P + ee1 t P + ee2 t P = N := e_sum t P
  simp only [edgeSet, Set.mem_union, segment, Set.mem_setOf_eq]
  rcases hz with hz0 | hz1 | hz2
  · 
    rw [hz0, zero_div, zero_smul, add_zero] at hrepr
    refine Or.inl (Or.inl ⟨ee1 t P / N, ee2 t P / N, div_nonneg h1 hNpos.le,
      div_nonneg h2 hNpos.le, ?_, hrepr.symm⟩)
    rw [div_add_div_same, show ee1 t P + ee2 t P = N from by linarith]
    exact div_self hNpos.ne'
  · 
    rw [hz1, zero_div, zero_smul, zero_add] at hrepr
    refine Or.inl (Or.inr ⟨ee2 t P / N, ee0 t P / N, div_nonneg h2 hNpos.le,
      div_nonneg h0 hNpos.le, ?_, hrepr.symm⟩)
    rw [div_add_div_same, show ee2 t P + ee0 t P = N from by linarith]
    exact div_self hNpos.ne'
  · 
    rw [hz2, zero_div, zero_smul, add_zero] at hrepr
    refine Or.inr ⟨ee0 t P / N, ee1 t P / N, div_nonneg h0 hNpos.le,
      div_nonneg h1 hNpos.le, ?_, ?_⟩
    · rw [div_add_div_same, show ee0 t P + ee1 t P = N from by linarith]
      exact div_self hNpos.ne'
    · rw [add_comm]; exact hrepr.symm

  rw [h1, faceNormal_offset]

name: rat_num_cast_of_den_one
statement: theorem rat_num_cast_of_den_one {q : ℚ} (h : q.den = 1) : (q.num : ℚ) = q
proof:
:= by
  conv_rhs => rw [← Rat.num_div_den q, h]
  simp

name: p3Int_ofPoint
statement: theorem p3Int_ofPoint {d : Point} (h : IntDir d) : P3Int (ofPoint d)

name: i3Q_numI3
statement: theorem i3Q_numI3 {p : P3} (h : P3Int p) : i3Q (numI3 p) = P3.toPoint p
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨hx, hy, hz⟩ := h
  funext i
  fin_cases i <;>
    simp only [i3Q, numI3, P3.toPoint, mkPoint, mkPoint_zero, mkPoint_one, mkPoint_two,
      rat_num_cast_of_den_one hx, rat_num_cast_of_den_one hy, rat_num_cast_of_den_one hz]

name: i3Q_numI3_ofPoint
statement: theorem i3Q_numI3_ofPoint {d : Point} (h : IntDir d) : i3Q (numI3 (ofPoint d)) = d
proof:
:= by
  rw [i3Q_numI3 (p3Int_ofPoint h), ofPoint_toPoint]

name: repr4_coord
statement:
theorem repr4_coord {q : H4} {X : Point} (h : repr4 q X) :
    (0 < q.w) ∧ (q.x : ℚ) = (q.w : ℚ) * X 0 ∧ (q.y : ℚ) = (q.w : ℚ) * X 1
      ∧ (q.z : ℚ) = (q.w : ℚ) * X 2
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨hw, hX⟩ := h
  have hwne : (q.w : ℚ) ≠ 0 := by exact_mod_cast hw.ne'
  refine ⟨hw, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩ <;>
    · rw [hX]; simp only [mkPoint_zero, mkPoint_one, mkPoint_two]; field_simp

name: numI3_neg
statement: theorem numI3_neg (p : P3) : numI3 (smulS (-1) p) = negI3 (numI3 p)
proof:
:= by
  simp only [numI3, negI3, smulS, I3.mk.injEq]
  refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_⟩ <;> rw [show ((-1 : ℚ) * _) = -_ by ring, Rat.neg_num]

name: p3Int_neg
statement: theorem p3Int_neg {p : P3} (h : P3Int p) : P3Int (smulS (-1) p)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨hx, hy, hz⟩ := h
  refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_⟩ <;>
    simp only [smulS, show ((-1 : ℚ) * p.x) = -p.x by ring, show ((-1 : ℚ) * p.y) = -p.y by ring,
      show ((-1 : ℚ) * p.z) = -p.z by ring, Rat.neg_den, hx, hy, hz]

name: p3Int_rayDirAt
statement: theorem p3Int_rayDirAt (j : ℕ) : P3Int (rayDirAt j)
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_⟩ <;> simp only [rayDirAt]
  · rfl
  · exact Rat.den_natCast j
  · rw [show ((j : ℚ) * (j : ℚ)) = ((j * j : ℕ) : ℚ) by push_cast; ring]; exact Rat.den_natCast _

name: dotI_hsub_distrib
statement:
theorem dotI_hsub_distrib (n : I3) (u v : H4) :
    v.w * dotI n ⟨u.x, u.y, u.z⟩ - u.w * dotI n ⟨v.x, v.y, v.z⟩ = dotI n (hsub u v)
proof:
:= by
  simp only [dotI, hsub]; ring

name: dotI_negI3
statement: theorem dotI_negI3 (n u : I3) : dotI n (negI3 u) = - dotI n u
proof:
:= by
  simp only [dotI, negI3]; ring

name: i3Q_hsub_cast
statement:
theorem i3Q_hsub_cast (u v : H4) :
    i3Q (hsub u v) = ((v.w : ℤ) : ℚ) • i3Q ⟨u.x, u.y, u.z⟩ - ((u.w : ℤ) : ℚ) • i3Q ⟨v.x, v.y, v.z⟩
proof:
:= by
  funext i
  fin_cases i <;>
    · simp only [i3Q, hsub, mkPoint, mkPoint_zero, mkPoint_one, mkPoint_two, Pi.smul_apply,
        Pi.sub_apply, smul_eq_mul]
      push_cast; ring

name: pfaceGood_repr
statement:
theorem pfaceGood_repr {f : PFace} {t : Triangle} (h : PFaceGood f t) :
    repr4 f.h0 t.v₀ ∧ repr4 f.h1 t.v₁ ∧ repr4 f.h2 t.v₂
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨_, _, _, hh0, hh1, hh2, _⟩ := h
  refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · rw [hh0]; have := toH4_repr (ofPoint t.v₀); rwa [ofPoint_toPoint] at this
  · rw [hh1]; have := toH4_repr (ofPoint t.v₁); rwa [ofPoint_toPoint] at this
  · rw [hh2]; have := toH4_repr (ofPoint t.v₂); rwa [ofPoint_toPoint] at this

name: disj_scale_iff
proof:
:= by
  
  have key : ∀ (e : ℤ) (r g : ℚ), 0 < r → (e : ℚ) = r * (D * g) →
      (0 < e ↔ 0 < D * g) ∧ (e < 0 ↔ D * g < 0)
        ∧ (0 ≤ e ↔ 0 ≤ D * g) ∧ (e ≤ 0 ↔ D * g ≤ 0) := by
    intro e r g hr he
    have hpos : 0 < e ↔ 0 < D * g := by
      constructor
      · intro h; have h' : (0 : ℚ) < r * (D * g) := by rw [← he]; exact_mod_cast h
        exact (mul_pos_iff_of_pos_left hr).mp h'
      · intro h; have h' : (0 : ℚ) < r * (D * g) := (mul_pos_iff_of_pos_left hr).mpr h
        rw [← he] at h'; exact_mod_cast h'
    have hnn : 0 ≤ e ↔ 0 ≤ D * g := by
      constructor
      · intro h; have h' : (0 : ℚ) ≤ r * (D * g) := by rw [← he]; exact_mod_cast h
        exact (mul_nonneg_iff_of_pos_left hr).mp h'
      · intro h; have h' : (0 : ℚ) ≤ r * (D * g) := (mul_nonneg_iff_of_pos_left hr).mpr h
        rw [← he] at h'; exact_mod_cast h'
    exact ⟨hpos, by rw [← not_le, ← not_le]; exact not_congr hnn,
      hnn, by rw [← not_lt, ← not_lt]; exact not_congr hpos⟩
  obtain ⟨p0, n0, q0, m0⟩ := key e0 r0 g0 hr0 he0
  obtain ⟨p1, n1, q1, m1⟩ := key e1 r1 g1 hr1 he1
  obtain ⟨p2, n2, q2, m2⟩ := key e2 r2 g2 hr2 he2
  rcases lt_or_gt_of_ne hD with hDneg | hDpos
  · 
    have gp : ∀ g : ℚ, (0 < D * g ↔ g < 0) ∧ (D * g < 0 ↔ 0 < g)
        ∧ (0 ≤ D * g ↔ g ≤ 0) ∧ (D * g ≤ 0 ↔ 0 ≤ g) := by
      intro g
      refine ⟨⟨fun h => ?_, fun h => by nlinarith [mul_pos (neg_pos.mpr hDneg) (neg_pos.mpr h)]⟩,
        ⟨fun h => ?_, fun h => by nlinarith [mul_pos (neg_pos.mpr hDneg) h]⟩,
        ⟨fun h => ?_, fun h => by nlinarith [mul_nonneg (neg_nonneg.mpr hDneg.le) (neg_nonneg.mpr h)]⟩,
        ⟨fun h => ?_, fun h => by nlinarith [mul_nonneg (neg_nonneg.mpr hDneg.le) h]⟩⟩
      · by_contra hc; push_neg at hc; nlinarith [mul_nonneg (neg_nonneg.mpr hDneg.le) hc]
      · by_contra hc; push_neg at hc; nlinarith [mul_nonneg (neg_nonneg.mpr hDneg.le) (neg_nonneg.mpr hc)]
      · by_contra hc; push_neg at hc; nlinarith [mul_pos (neg_pos.mpr hDneg) hc]
      · by_contra hc; push_neg at hc; nlinarith [mul_pos (neg_pos.mpr hDneg) (neg_pos.mpr hc)]
    obtain ⟨gp0a, gp0b, gp0c, gp0d⟩ := gp g0
    obtain ⟨gp1a, gp1b, gp1c, gp1d⟩ := gp g1
    obtain ⟨gp2a, gp2b, gp2c, gp2d⟩ := gp g2
    exact ⟨(or_congr (and_congr (p0.trans gp0a) (and_congr (p1.trans gp1a) (p2.trans gp2a)))
        (and_congr (n0.trans gp0b) (and_congr (n1.trans gp1b) (n2.trans gp2b)))).trans or_comm,
      (or_congr (and_congr (q0.trans gp0c) (and_congr (q1.trans gp1c) (q2.trans gp2c)))
        (and_congr (m0.trans gp0d) (and_congr (m1.trans gp1d) (m2.trans gp2d)))).trans or_comm⟩
  · 
    have gp : ∀ g : ℚ, (0 < D * g ↔ 0 < g) ∧ (D * g < 0 ↔ g < 0)
        ∧ (0 ≤ D * g ↔ 0 ≤ g) ∧ (D * g ≤ 0 ↔ g ≤ 0) := by
      intro g
      refine ⟨mul_pos_iff_of_pos_left hDpos, ?_, mul_nonneg_iff_of_pos_left hDpos, ?_⟩
      · rw [← not_le, ← not_le]; exact not_congr (mul_nonneg_iff_of_pos_left hDpos)
      · rw [← not_lt, ← not_lt]; exact not_congr (mul_pos_iff_of_pos_left hDpos)
    obtain ⟨gp0a, gp0b, gp0c, gp0d⟩ := gp g0
    obtain ⟨gp1a, gp1b, gp1c, gp1d⟩ := gp g1
    obtain ⟨gp2a, gp2b, gp2c, gp2d⟩ := gp g2
    exact ⟨or_congr (and_congr (p0.trans gp0a) (and_congr (p1.trans gp1a) (p2.trans gp2a)))
        (and_congr (n0.trans gp0b) (and_congr (n1.trans gp1b) (n2.trans gp2b))),
      or_congr (and_congr (q0.trans gp0c) (and_congr (q1.trans gp1c) (q2.trans gp2c)))
        (and_congr (m0.trans gp0d) (and_congr (m1.trans gp1d) (m2.trans gp2d)))⟩

name: rayFaceCross_reduce
statement:
theorem rayFaceCross_reduce {t : Triangle} (Q d : Point) {f : PFace}
    (hgood : PFaceGood f t) (hint : IntDir d) :
    rayFaceCross f (toH4 (ofPoint Q)) (numI3 (ofPoint d))
      = (if dotQ (Proof.MeshIntersectJump.faceNormal t) d = 0 then
          (if dotQ (Proof.MeshIntersectJump.faceNormal t) Q = detOrigin t then none else some 0)
        else if (detOrigin t - dotQ (Proof.MeshIntersectJump.faceNormal t) Q) / dotQ (Proof.MeshIntersectJump.faceNormal t) d ≤ 0 then some 0
        else
          (if (0 < ee0 t (lineAt Q d ((detOrigin t - dotQ (Proof.MeshIntersectJump.faceNormal t) Q) / dotQ (Proof.MeshIntersectJump.faceNormal t) d))
                ∧ 0 < ee1 t (lineAt Q d ((detOrigin t - dotQ (Proof.MeshIntersectJump.faceNormal t) Q) / dotQ (Proof.MeshIntersectJump.faceNormal t) d))
                ∧ 0 < ee2 t (lineAt Q d ((detOrigin t - dotQ (Proof.MeshIntersectJump.faceNormal t) Q) / dotQ (Proof.MeshIntersectJump.faceNormal t) d)))
              ∨ (ee0 t (lineAt Q d ((detOrigin t - dotQ (Proof.MeshIntersectJump.faceNormal t) Q) / dotQ (Proof.MeshIntersectJump.faceNormal t) d)) < 0
                ∧ ee1 t (lineAt Q d ((detOrigin t - dotQ (Proof.MeshIntersectJump.faceNormal t) Q) / dotQ (Proof.MeshIntersectJump.faceNormal t) d)) < 0
                ∧ ee2 t (lineAt Q d ((detOrigin t - dotQ (Proof.MeshIntersectJump.faceNormal t) Q) / dotQ (Proof.MeshIntersectJump.faceNormal t) d)) < 0)
            then some (if dotQ (Proof.MeshIntersectJump.faceNormal t) d < 0 then -1 else 1)
          else if (0 ≤ ee0 t (lineAt Q d ((detOrigin t - dotQ (Proof.MeshIntersectJump.faceNormal t) Q) / dotQ (Proof.MeshIntersectJump.faceNormal t) d))
                ∧ 0 ≤ ee1 t (lineAt Q d ((detOrigin t - dotQ (Proof.MeshIntersectJump.faceNormal t) Q) / dotQ (Proof.MeshIntersectJump.faceNormal t) d))
                ∧ 0 ≤ ee2 t (lineAt Q d ((detOrigin t - dotQ (Proof.MeshIntersectJump.faceNormal t) Q) / dotQ (Proof.MeshIntersectJump.faceNormal t) d)))
              ∨ (ee0 t (lineAt Q d ((detOrigin t - dotQ (Proof.MeshIntersectJump.faceNormal t) Q) / dotQ (Proof.MeshIntersectJump.faceNormal t) d)) ≤ 0
                ∧ ee1 t (lineAt Q d ((detOrigin t - dotQ (Proof.MeshIntersectJump.faceNormal t) Q) / dotQ (Proof.MeshIntersectJump.faceNormal t) d)) ≤ 0
                ∧ ee2 t (lineAt Q d ((detOrigin t - dotQ (Proof.MeshIntersectJump.faceNormal t) Q) / dotQ (Proof.MeshIntersectJump.faceNormal t) d)) ≤ 0)
            then none
          else some 0))
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨hr0, hr1, hr2⟩ := pfaceGood_repr hgood
  obtain ⟨hv0e, hv1e, hv2e, hh0e, hh1e, hh2e, hnrmIe, he01, he12, he20, hnd0⟩ := hgood
  set n := Proof.MeshIntersectJump.faceNormal t with hn_def
  set qh := toH4 (ofPoint Q) with hqh_def
  set di := numI3 (ofPoint d) with hdi_def
  have hrq : repr4 qh Q := by
    rw [hqh_def]; have h := toH4_repr (ofPoint Q); rwa [ofPoint_toPoint] at h
  obtain ⟨hw0, hh0x, hh0y, hh0z⟩ := repr4_coord hr0
  obtain ⟨hw1, _, _, _⟩ := repr4_coord hr1
  obtain ⟨hw2, _, _, _⟩ := repr4_coord hr2
  obtain ⟨hwq, hqhx, hqhy, hqhz⟩ := repr4_coord hrq
  have hidi : i3Q di = d := i3Q_numI3_ofPoint hint
  have hdix : ((di.x : ℤ) : ℚ) = d 0 := by
    have h := congrFun hidi 0; simpa only [i3Q, mkPoint_zero] using h
  have hdiy : ((di.y : ℤ) : ℚ) = d 1 := by
    have h := congrFun hidi 1; simpa only [i3Q, mkPoint_one] using h
  have hdiz : ((di.z : ℤ) : ℚ) = d 2 := by
    have h := congrFun hidi 2; simpa only [i3Q, mkPoint_two] using h
  
  set cN : ℤ := f.h1.w * f.h0.w * (f.h2.w * f.h0.w) with hcN_def
  have hcNpos : 0 < cN := by rw [hcN_def]; exact mul_pos (mul_pos hw1 hw0) (mul_pos hw2 hw0)
  have hcNQ : (0 : ℚ) < (cN : ℚ) := by exact_mod_cast hcNpos
  have hcNne : (cN : ℚ) ≠ 0 := ne_of_gt hcNQ
  
  have hnrm : i3Q f.nrmI = (cN : ℚ) • n := by
    rw [hnrmIe, i3Q_crossI, i3Q_hsub hr0 hr1, i3Q_hsub hr0 hr2,
      Proof.MeshIntersectClip.crossQ_smul_left, Proof.MeshIntersectClip.crossQ_smul_right,
      smul_smul, hn_def, Proof.MeshIntersectJump.faceNormal, psub_eq_sub, psub_eq_sub]
    congr 1
    rw [hcN_def]; push_cast; ring
  
  have hDn_cast : ((dotI f.nrmI di : ℤ) : ℚ) = (cN : ℚ) * dotQ n d := by
    rw [dotI_i3Q, hnrm, hidi, Proof.MeshIntersectSample.dotQ_smul_left]
  
  have hN_int : qh.w * f.nd0 - f.h0.w * dotI f.nrmI ⟨qh.x, qh.y, qh.z⟩
      = dotI f.nrmI (hsub f.h0 qh) := by
    rw [hnd0]; exact dotI_hsub_distrib f.nrmI f.h0 qh
  
  have hN_cast : ((dotI f.nrmI (hsub f.h0 qh) : ℤ) : ℚ)
      = ((cN * f.h0.w * qh.w : ℤ) : ℚ) * (detOrigin t - dotQ n Q) := by
    rw [dotI_i3Q, hnrm, i3Q_hsub hrq hr0, Proof.MeshIntersectSample.dotQ_smul_left,
      Proof.MeshIntersectRay.dotQ_smul_right]
    have hbase : dotQ n (t.v₀ - Q) = detOrigin t - dotQ n Q := by
      rw [← psub_eq_sub, hn_def]; exact dotQ_faceNormal_v0_sub t Q
    rw [hbase]; push_cast; ring
  
  have hh0cast : i3Q ⟨f.h0.x, f.h0.y, f.h0.z⟩ = (f.h0.w : ℚ) • t.v₀ := by
    funext i; fin_cases i <;>
      simp only [i3Q, mkPoint_zero, mkPoint_one, mkPoint_two, Pi.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul]
    · exact hh0x
    · exact hh0y
    · exact hh0z
  
  have hDn0 : dotI f.nrmI di = 0 ↔ dotQ n d = 0 := by
    constructor
    · intro h; have h' : (cN : ℚ) * dotQ n d = 0 := by rw [← hDn_cast, h]; simp
      rcases mul_eq_zero.mp h' with h1 | h1
      · exact absurd h1 hcNne
      · exact h1
    · intro h; have h' : ((dotI f.nrmI di : ℤ) : ℚ) = 0 := by rw [hDn_cast, h, mul_zero]
      exact_mod_cast h'
  have hDnpos : 0 < dotI f.nrmI di ↔ 0 < dotQ n d := by
    constructor
    · intro h; have h' : (0 : ℚ) < (cN : ℚ) * dotQ n d := by rw [← hDn_cast]; exact_mod_cast h
      exact (mul_pos_iff_of_pos_left hcNQ).mp h'
    · intro h; have h' : (0 : ℚ) < (cN : ℚ) * dotQ n d := (mul_pos_iff_of_pos_left hcNQ).mpr h
      rw [← hDn_cast] at h'; exact_mod_cast h'
  have hDnnn : 0 ≤ dotI f.nrmI di ↔ 0 ≤ dotQ n d := by
    constructor
    · intro h; have h' : (0 : ℚ) ≤ (cN : ℚ) * dotQ n d := by rw [← hDn_cast]; exact_mod_cast h
      exact (mul_nonneg_iff_of_pos_left hcNQ).mp h'
    · intro h; have h' : (0 : ℚ) ≤ (cN : ℚ) * dotQ n d := (mul_nonneg_iff_of_pos_left hcNQ).mpr h
      rw [← hDn_cast] at h'; exact_mod_cast h'
  have hDnneg : dotI f.nrmI di < 0 ↔ dotQ n d < 0 := by
    rw [← not_le, ← not_le]; exact not_congr hDnnn
  
  have hcNwpos : 0 < cN * f.h0.w * qh.w := mul_pos (mul_pos hcNpos hw0) hwq
  have hcNwQ : (0 : ℚ) < ((cN * f.h0.w * qh.w : ℤ) : ℚ) := by exact_mod_cast hcNwpos
  have hNI0 : dotI f.nrmI (hsub f.h0 qh) = 0 ↔ dotQ n Q = detOrigin t := by
    constructor
    · intro h
      have h' : ((cN * f.h0.w * qh.w : ℤ) : ℚ) * (detOrigin t - dotQ n Q) = 0 := by
        rw [← hN_cast]; exact_mod_cast h
      rcases mul_eq_zero.mp h' with h1 | h1
      · exact absurd h1 (ne_of_gt hcNwQ)
      · exact (sub_eq_zero.mp h1).symm
    · intro h
      have h' : ((dotI f.nrmI (hsub f.h0 qh) : ℤ) : ℚ) = 0 := by
        rw [hN_cast, sub_eq_zero.mpr h.symm, mul_zero]
      exact_mod_cast h'
  have hh1cast : i3Q ⟨f.h1.x, f.h1.y, f.h1.z⟩ = (f.h1.w : ℚ) • t.v₁ := by
    funext i; fin_cases i <;>
      simp only [i3Q, mkPoint_zero, mkPoint_one, mkPoint_two, Pi.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul]
    · exact ‹↑f.h1.x = ↑f.h1.w * t.v₁ 0›
    · exact ‹↑f.h1.y = ↑f.h1.w * t.v₁ 1›
    · exact ‹↑f.h1.z = ↑f.h1.w * t.v₁ 2›
  have hh2cast : i3Q ⟨f.h2.x, f.h2.y, f.h2.z⟩ = (f.h2.w : ℚ) • t.v₂ := by
    funext i; fin_cases i <;>
      simp only [i3Q, mkPoint_zero, mkPoint_one, mkPoint_two, Pi.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul]
    · exact ‹↑f.h2.x = ↑f.h2.w * t.v₂ 0›
    · exact ‹↑f.h2.y = ↑f.h2.w * t.v₂ 1›
    · exact ‹↑f.h2.z = ↑f.h2.w * t.v₂ 2›
  simp only [rayFaceCross, hN_int, beq_iff_eq, decide_eq_true_eq, Bool.and_eq_true,
    Bool.or_eq_true, and_assoc]
  set Dn := dotI f.nrmI di with hDnv
  set NI := dotI f.nrmI (hsub f.h0 qh) with hNIv
  by_cases hd0 : dotQ n d = 0
  · 
    rw [if_pos (hDn0.mpr hd0), if_pos hd0]
    by_cases hQ : dotQ n Q = detOrigin t
    · rw [if_pos (hNI0.mpr hQ), if_pos hQ]
    · rw [if_neg (fun hc => hQ (hNI0.mp hc)), if_neg hQ]
  · 
    rw [if_neg (fun hc => hd0 (hDn0.mp hc)), if_neg hd0]
    
    have hNIpos : 0 < NI ↔ 0 < detOrigin t - dotQ n Q := by
      constructor
      · intro h; have h' : (0:ℚ) < ((cN*f.h0.w*qh.w:ℤ):ℚ)*(detOrigin t - dotQ n Q) := by
          rw [← hN_cast]; exact_mod_cast h
        exact (mul_pos_iff_of_pos_left hcNwQ).mp h'
      · intro h; have h' : (0:ℚ) < ((cN*f.h0.w*qh.w:ℤ):ℚ)*(detOrigin t - dotQ n Q) :=
          (mul_pos_iff_of_pos_left hcNwQ).mpr h
        rw [← hN_cast] at h'; exact_mod_cast h'
    have hNInn : 0 ≤ NI ↔ 0 ≤ detOrigin t - dotQ n Q := by
      constructor
      · intro h; have h' : (0:ℚ) ≤ ((cN*f.h0.w*qh.w:ℤ):ℚ)*(detOrigin t - dotQ n Q) := by
          rw [← hN_cast]; exact_mod_cast h
        exact (mul_nonneg_iff_of_pos_left hcNwQ).mp h'
      · intro h; have h' : (0:ℚ) ≤ ((cN*f.h0.w*qh.w:ℤ):ℚ)*(detOrigin t - dotQ n Q) :=
          (mul_nonneg_iff_of_pos_left hcNwQ).mpr h
        rw [← hN_cast] at h'; exact_mod_cast h'
    have hNInp : NI ≤ 0 ↔ detOrigin t - dotQ n Q ≤ 0 := by
      rw [← not_lt, ← not_lt]; exact not_congr hNIpos
    
    have hgate : ((if 0 < Dn then decide (NI ≤ 0) else decide (0 ≤ NI)) = true)
        ↔ (detOrigin t - dotQ n Q) / dotQ n d ≤ 0 := by
      rcases lt_or_gt_of_ne hd0 with hdn | hdp
      · rw [if_neg (not_lt.mpr (le_of_lt (hDnneg.mpr hdn))), decide_eq_true_eq, hNInn,
          div_le_iff_of_neg hdn, zero_mul]
      · rw [if_pos (hDnpos.mpr hdp), decide_eq_true_eq, hNInp, div_le_iff₀ hdp, zero_mul]
    by_cases hg : (detOrigin t - dotQ n Q) / dotQ n d ≤ 0
    · rw [if_pos (by rw [hgate]; exact hg), if_pos hg]
    · rw [if_neg (by rw [hgate]; exact hg), if_neg hg]
      
      set root := (detOrigin t - dotQ n Q) / dotQ n d with hroot_def
      set P := lineAt Q d root with hP_def
      have hDfull_cast : ((Dn * f.h0.w * qh.w : ℤ) : ℚ) = ((cN * f.h0.w * qh.w : ℤ) : ℚ) * dotQ n d := by
        have h := hDn_cast; push_cast at h ⊢; rw [h]; ring
      have hDfroot : ((Dn * f.h0.w * qh.w : ℤ) : ℚ) * root = (NI : ℚ) := by
        have h1 : ((Dn * f.h0.w * qh.w : ℤ) : ℚ) * root
            = ((cN * f.h0.w * qh.w : ℤ) : ℚ) * (dotQ n d * root) := by rw [hDfull_cast]; ring
        rw [h1, hroot_def, mul_div_assoc', mul_div_cancel_left₀ _ hd0, ← hN_cast]
      have hDf := hDfroot; push_cast at hDf
      have hPh : i3Q ⟨Dn * f.h0.w * qh.x + NI * di.x, Dn * f.h0.w * qh.y + NI * di.y,
            Dn * f.h0.w * qh.z + NI * di.z⟩ = ((Dn * f.h0.w * qh.w : ℤ) : ℚ) • P := by
        funext i
        fin_cases i
        · simp only [i3Q, mkPoint, Pi.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul, hP_def, lineAt]
          push_cast [hqhx, hdix]; linear_combination -(d 0) * hDf
        · simp only [i3Q, mkPoint, Pi.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul, hP_def, lineAt]
          push_cast [hqhy, hdiy]; linear_combination -(d 1) * hDf
        · simp only [i3Q, mkPoint, Pi.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul, hP_def, lineAt]
          push_cast [hqhz, hdiz]; linear_combination -(d 2) * hDf
      
      have hedge : ∀ (hk : H4) (Vk : Point) (ek : I3) (Uk : Point) (ck : ℤ),
          i3Q ⟨hk.x, hk.y, hk.z⟩ = (hk.w : ℚ) • Vk → i3Q ek = (ck : ℚ) • Uk →
          ((dotI ek (crossI (hsub ⟨Dn * f.h0.w * qh.x + NI * di.x, Dn * f.h0.w * qh.y + NI * di.y,
              Dn * f.h0.w * qh.z + NI * di.z, Dn * f.h0.w * qh.w⟩ hk) f.nrmI) : ℤ) : ℚ)
            = ((ck * (hk.w * (Dn * f.h0.w * qh.w)) * cN : ℤ) : ℚ)
              * dotQ Uk (crossQ (P - Vk) n) := by
        intro hk Vk ek Uk ck hhk hek
        rw [dotI_i3Q, i3Q_crossI, hek, hnrm, i3Q_hsub_cast]
        rw [show ((⟨Dn * f.h0.w * qh.x + NI * di.x, Dn * f.h0.w * qh.y + NI * di.y,
              Dn * f.h0.w * qh.z + NI * di.z, Dn * f.h0.w * qh.w⟩ : H4).w : ℤ) = Dn * f.h0.w * qh.w from rfl]
        show ((dotQ ((ck:ℚ) • Uk)
            (crossQ (((hk.w:ℤ):ℚ) • i3Q ⟨Dn * f.h0.w * qh.x + NI * di.x, Dn * f.h0.w * qh.y + NI * di.y,
                Dn * f.h0.w * qh.z + NI * di.z⟩ - ((Dn * f.h0.w * qh.w:ℤ):ℚ) • i3Q ⟨hk.x, hk.y, hk.z⟩)
              ((cN:ℚ) • n)))) = _
        rw [hPh, hhk]
        rw [show (((hk.w:ℤ):ℚ) • ((Dn * f.h0.w * qh.w:ℤ):ℚ) • P
              - ((Dn * f.h0.w * qh.w:ℤ):ℚ) • (hk.w:ℚ) • Vk)
            = (((hk.w:ℤ):ℚ) * ((Dn * f.h0.w * qh.w:ℤ):ℚ)) • (P - Vk) from by
          rw [smul_smul, smul_smul, mul_comm ((Dn * f.h0.w * qh.w:ℤ):ℚ) ((hk.w:ℤ):ℚ), smul_sub]]
        rw [Proof.MeshIntersectClip.crossQ_smul_left, Proof.MeshIntersectClip.crossQ_smul_right,
          Proof.MeshIntersectSample.dotQ_smul_left, Proof.MeshIntersectRay.dotQ_smul_right,
          Proof.MeshIntersectRay.dotQ_smul_right]
        push_cast; ring
      
      have he01cast : i3Q f.e01 = ((f.h1.w * f.h0.w : ℤ) : ℚ) • (t.v₁ - t.v₀) := by
        rw [he01, i3Q_hsub hr0 hr1]
      have he12cast : i3Q f.e12 = ((f.h2.w * f.h1.w : ℤ) : ℚ) • (t.v₂ - t.v₁) := by
        rw [he12, i3Q_hsub hr1 hr2]
      have he20cast : i3Q f.e20 = ((f.h0.w * f.h2.w : ℤ) : ℚ) • (t.v₀ - t.v₂) := by
        rw [he20, i3Q_hsub hr2 hr0]
      have hee0 : dotQ (t.v₁ - t.v₀) (crossQ (P - t.v₀) n) = ee0 t P := by
        simp only [ee0, det3, psub_eq_sub, ← hn_def]
      have hee1 : dotQ (t.v₂ - t.v₁) (crossQ (P - t.v₁) n) = ee1 t P := by
        simp only [ee1, det3, psub_eq_sub, ← hn_def]
      have hee2 : dotQ (t.v₀ - t.v₂) (crossQ (P - t.v₂) n) = ee2 t P := by
        simp only [ee2, det3, psub_eq_sub, ← hn_def]
      have he0 : ((edgeDetsI f f.nrmI NI Dn qh di).1 : ℚ)
          = ((f.h1.w * f.h0.w * f.h0.w * cN : ℤ) : ℚ) * (((Dn * f.h0.w * qh.w : ℤ) : ℚ) * ee0 t P) := by
        simp only [edgeDetsI]
        rw [hedge f.h0 t.v₀ f.e01 (t.v₁ - t.v₀) (f.h1.w * f.h0.w) hh0cast he01cast, hee0]
        push_cast; ring
      have he1 : ((edgeDetsI f f.nrmI NI Dn qh di).2.1 : ℚ)
          = ((f.h2.w * f.h1.w * f.h1.w * cN : ℤ) : ℚ) * (((Dn * f.h0.w * qh.w : ℤ) : ℚ) * ee1 t P) := by
        simp only [edgeDetsI]
        rw [hedge f.h1 t.v₁ f.e12 (t.v₂ - t.v₁) (f.h2.w * f.h1.w) hh1cast he12cast, hee1]
        push_cast; ring
      have he2 : ((edgeDetsI f f.nrmI NI Dn qh di).2.2 : ℚ)
          = ((f.h0.w * f.h2.w * f.h2.w * cN : ℤ) : ℚ) * (((Dn * f.h0.w * qh.w : ℤ) : ℚ) * ee2 t P) := by
        simp only [edgeDetsI]
        rw [hedge f.h2 t.v₂ f.e20 (t.v₀ - t.v₂) (f.h0.w * f.h2.w) hh2cast he20cast, hee2]
        push_cast; ring
      have hr0Q : (0 : ℚ) < ((f.h1.w * f.h0.w * f.h0.w * cN : ℤ) : ℚ) := by
        exact_mod_cast mul_pos (mul_pos (mul_pos hw1 hw0) hw0) hcNpos
      have hr1Q : (0 : ℚ) < ((f.h2.w * f.h1.w * f.h1.w * cN : ℤ) : ℚ) := by
        exact_mod_cast mul_pos (mul_pos (mul_pos hw2 hw1) hw1) hcNpos
      have hr2Q : (0 : ℚ) < ((f.h0.w * f.h2.w * f.h2.w * cN : ℤ) : ℚ) := by
        exact_mod_cast mul_pos (mul_pos (mul_pos hw0 hw2) hw2) hcNpos
      have hDfull_ne : ((Dn * f.h0.w * qh.w : ℤ) : ℚ) ≠ 0 := by
        rw [hDfull_cast]; exact mul_ne_zero (ne_of_gt hcNwQ) hd0
      obtain ⟨hstrict, hweak⟩ := disj_scale_iff hr0Q hr1Q hr2Q hDfull_ne he0 he1 he2
      refine if_congr hstrict ?_ (if_congr hweak rfl rfl)
      congr 1
      by_cases hlt : dotQ n d < 0
      · rw [if_pos (hDnneg.mpr hlt), if_pos hlt]
      · rw [if_neg (fun hc => hlt (hDnneg.mp hc)), if_neg hlt]

name: rayFaceCross_reduce_model
proof:
:= by
  have hi : IntDir (P3.toPoint d) := by
    obtain ⟨hx, hy, hz⟩ := hint
    refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_⟩
    · rw [P3.toPoint, mkPoint_zero]; exact hx
    · rw [P3.toPoint, mkPoint_one]; exact hy
    · rw [P3.toPoint, mkPoint_two]; exact hz
  exact rayFaceCross_reduce (P3.toPoint Q) (P3.toPoint d) hgood hi

name: faceNormal_shift
statement:
theorem faceNormal_shift (s : Point) (t : Triangle) :
    Proof.MeshIntersectJump.faceNormal ⟨psub t.v₀ s, psub t.v₁ s, psub t.v₂ s⟩
    = Proof.MeshIntersectJump.faceNormal t
proof:
:= by
  funext i
  fin_cases i <;>
    simp only [Proof.MeshIntersectJump.faceNormal, crossQ, psub, mkPoint_zero, mkPoint_one,
      mkPoint_two] <;> ring_nf

name: detOrigin_shift
statement:
theorem detOrigin_shift (s : Point) (t : Triangle) :
    detOrigin ⟨psub t.v₀ s, psub t.v₁ s, psub t.v₂ s⟩
    = detOrigin t - dotQ (Proof.MeshIntersectJump.faceNormal t) s
proof:
:= by
  rw [← faceNormal_offset ⟨psub t.v₀ s, psub t.v₁ s, psub t.v₂ s⟩, faceNormal_shift]
  show dotQ (Proof.MeshIntersectJump.faceNormal t) (psub t.v₀ s) = _
  rw [psub_eq_sub, Proof.MeshIntersectRay.dotQ_sub_right, faceNormal_offset]

name: dotQ_faceNormal_shift
statement:
theorem dotQ_faceNormal_shift (s : Point) (t : Triangle) (Q : Point) :
    dotQ (Proof.MeshIntersectJump.faceNormal ⟨psub t.v₀ s, psub t.v₁ s, psub t.v₂ s⟩) (psub Q s)
    = dotQ (Proof.MeshIntersectJump.faceNormal t) Q - dotQ (Proof.MeshIntersectJump.faceNormal t) s
proof:
:= by
  rw [faceNormal_shift, psub_eq_sub, Proof.MeshIntersectRay.dotQ_sub_right]

name: ee0_shift
statement:
theorem ee0_shift (s : Point) (t : Triangle) (Q d : Point) (r : ℚ) :
    ee0 ⟨psub t.v₀ s, psub t.v₁ s, psub t.v₂ s⟩ (lineAt (psub Q s) d r) = ee0 t (lineAt Q d r)
proof:
:= by
  simp only [ee0, Proof.MeshIntersectJump.faceNormal, det3, dotQ, crossQ, psub, lineAt,
    mkPoint_zero, mkPoint_one, mkPoint_two]; ring

name: ee1_shift
statement:
theorem ee1_shift (s : Point) (t : Triangle) (Q d : Point) (r : ℚ) :
    ee1 ⟨psub t.v₀ s, psub t.v₁ s, psub t.v₂ s⟩ (lineAt (psub Q s) d r) = ee1 t (lineAt Q d r)
proof:
:= by
  simp only [ee1, Proof.MeshIntersectJump.faceNormal, det3, dotQ, crossQ, psub, lineAt,
    mkPoint_zero, mkPoint_one, mkPoint_two]; ring

name: ee2_shift
statement:
theorem ee2_shift (s : Point) (t : Triangle) (Q d : Point) (r : ℚ) :
    ee2 ⟨psub t.v₀ s, psub t.v₁ s, psub t.v₂ s⟩ (lineAt (psub Q s) d r) = ee2 t (lineAt Q d r)
proof:
:= by
  simp only [ee2, Proof.MeshIntersectJump.faceNormal, det3, dotQ, crossQ, psub, lineAt,
    mkPoint_zero, mkPoint_one, mkPoint_two]; ring

name: rfcModel_congr
statement:
theorem rfcModel_congr {t₁ t₂ : Triangle} {Q₁ Q₂ d : Point}
    (hn : Proof.MeshIntersectJump.faceNormal t₁ = Proof.MeshIntersectJump.faceNormal t₂)
    (hnum : detOrigin t₁ - dotQ (Proof.MeshIntersectJump.faceNormal t₁) Q₁
          = detOrigin t₂ - dotQ (Proof.MeshIntersectJump.faceNormal t₂) Q₂)
    (hinp : (dotQ (Proof.MeshIntersectJump.faceNormal t₁) Q₁ = detOrigin t₁)
          ↔ (dotQ (Proof.MeshIntersectJump.faceNormal t₂) Q₂ = detOrigin t₂))
    (hee0 : ∀ r, ee0 t₁ (lineAt Q₁ d r) = ee0 t₂ (lineAt Q₂ d r))
    (hee1 : ∀ r, ee1 t₁ (lineAt Q₁ d r) = ee1 t₂ (lineAt Q₂ d r))
    (hee2 : ∀ r, ee2 t₁ (lineAt Q₁ d r) = ee2 t₂ (lineAt Q₂ d r)) :
    rfcModel t₁ Q₁ d = rfcModel t₂ Q₂ d
proof:
:= by
  have hden : dotQ (Proof.MeshIntersectJump.faceNormal t₁) d
            = dotQ (Proof.MeshIntersectJump.faceNormal t₂) d := by rw [hn]
  have hroot : (detOrigin t₁ - dotQ (Proof.MeshIntersectJump.faceNormal t₁) Q₁)
                 / dotQ (Proof.MeshIntersectJump.faceNormal t₁) d
             = (detOrigin t₂ - dotQ (Proof.MeshIntersectJump.faceNormal t₂) Q₂)
                 / dotQ (Proof.MeshIntersectJump.faceNormal t₂) d := by rw [hnum, hden]
  unfold rfcModel
  rw [hroot, hee0, hee1, hee2, hden]
  simp only [hinp]

name: rfcModel_shift
statement:
theorem rfcModel_shift (s : Point) (t : Triangle) (Q d : Point) :
    rfcModel ⟨psub t.v₀ s, psub t.v₁ s, psub t.v₂ s⟩ (psub Q s) d = rfcModel t Q d
proof:
:= by
  apply rfcModel_congr
  · exact faceNormal_shift s t
  · rw [detOrigin_shift, dotQ_faceNormal_shift]; ring
  · rw [detOrigin_shift, dotQ_faceNormal_shift]; constructor <;> intro h <;> linarith
  · intro r; exact ee0_shift s t Q d r
  · intro r; exact ee1_shift s t Q d r
  · intro r; exact ee2_shift s t Q d r

name: edgeSet_subset_triangleSet
statement: theorem edgeSet_subset_triangleSet (t : Triangle) : edgeSet t ⊆ triangleSet t
proof:
:= by
  intro x hx
  simp only [edgeSet, Set.mem_union] at hx
  have h0 : t.v₀ ∈ triangleSet t := subset_convexHull ℚ _ (by simp)
  have h1 : t.v₁ ∈ triangleSet t := subset_convexHull ℚ _ (by simp)
  have h2 : t.v₂ ∈ triangleSet t := subset_convexHull ℚ _ (by simp)
  have hconv := convex_convexHull ℚ ({t.v₀, t.v₁, t.v₂} : Set Point)
  rcases hx with (h | h) | h
  · exact hconv.segment_subset h0 h1 h
  · exact hconv.segment_subset h1 h2 h
  · exact hconv.segment_subset h2 h0 h

name: dotQ_lineAt
statement:
theorem dotQ_lineAt (t : Triangle) (Q d : Point) (s : ℚ) :
    dotQ (Proof.MeshIntersectJump.faceNormal t) (lineAt Q d s)
      = dotQ (Proof.MeshIntersectJump.faceNormal t) Q + s * dotQ (Proof.MeshIntersectJump.faceNormal t) d
proof:
:= by
  simp only [dotQ, lineAt]; ring

name: qsign_of_ne
statement: theorem qsign_of_ne {q : ℚ} (h : q ≠ 0) : qsign q = if q < 0 then -1 else 1
proof:
:= by
  unfold qsign
  by_cases h1 : q < 0
  · rw [if_neg (not_lt.mpr h1.le), if_pos h1, if_pos h1]
  · have hq : 0 < q := lt_of_le_of_ne (not_lt.mp h1) (Ne.symm h)
    rw [if_pos hq, if_neg h1]

name: hit_at_root
proof:
:= by
  have hc := triangleSet_on_carrier hmem
  rw [dotQ_lineAt] at hc
  field_simp
  linarith

name: rayFaceCross_eq_sigma
statement:
theorem rayFaceCross_eq_sigma {MB : Mesh} {u : Fin MB.size}
    (hdet : detOrigin MB[u] ≠ 0) (Q d : Point) (hint : IntDir d) {f : PFace}
    (hgood : PFaceGood f MB[u]) :
    (∀ c : ℤ, rayFaceCross f (toH4 (ofPoint Q)) (numI3 (ofPoint d)) = some c →
        c = (if MeetsRelint MB Q d u then qsign (dotQ (Proof.MeshIntersectJump.faceNormal MB[u]) d) else 0)
        ∧ (∀ s : ℚ, 0 < s → lineAt Q d s ∉ edgeSet MB[u]))
    ∧ (rayFaceCross f (toH4 (ofPoint Q)) (numI3 (ofPoint d)) = none ↔
        (dotQ (Proof.MeshIntersectJump.faceNormal MB[u]) d = 0 ∧ dotQ (Proof.MeshIntersectJump.faceNormal MB[u]) Q = detOrigin MB[u])
        ∨ (∃ s : ℚ, 0 < s ∧ lineAt Q d s ∈ edgeSet MB[u]))
proof:
:= by
  set t := MB[u] with ht
  rw [rayFaceCross_reduce Q d hgood hint]
  set tp := (detOrigin t - dotQ (Proof.MeshIntersectJump.faceNormal t) Q) / dotQ (Proof.MeshIntersectJump.faceNormal t) d with htp
  set P := lineAt Q d tp with hPdef
  have hedge_tri : ∀ s : ℚ, lineAt Q d s ∈ edgeSet t → lineAt Q d s ∈ triangleSet t :=
    fun s hs => edgeSet_subset_triangleSet t hs
  have hNpos : 0 < dotQ (Proof.MeshIntersectJump.faceNormal t) (Proof.MeshIntersectJump.faceNormal t) := N_pos hdet
  have hmeets_forces : ∀ s : ℚ, lineAt Q d s ∈ triangleSet t →
      dotQ (Proof.MeshIntersectJump.faceNormal t) (lineAt Q d s) = detOrigin t := fun s hs => triangleSet_on_carrier hs
  have hMR : MeetsRelint MB Q d u ↔
      ∃ s : ℚ, 0 < s ∧ lineAt Q d s ∈ triangleSet t ∧ lineAt Q d s ∉ edgeSet t := Iff.rfl
  by_cases hden0 : dotQ (Proof.MeshIntersectJump.faceNormal t) d = 0
  · 
    rw [if_pos hden0]
    have hno_tri : ∀ s : ℚ, dotQ (Proof.MeshIntersectJump.faceNormal t) Q ≠ detOrigin t → lineAt Q d s ∉ triangleSet t := by
      intro s hc hmem
      have h := hmeets_forces s hmem
      rw [dotQ_lineAt, hden0, mul_zero, add_zero] at h
      exact hc h
    by_cases hQc : dotQ (Proof.MeshIntersectJump.faceNormal t) Q = detOrigin t
    · 
      rw [if_pos hQc]
      refine ⟨fun c hc => Option.noConfusion hc, ?_⟩
      exact ⟨fun _ => Or.inl ⟨hden0, hQc⟩, fun _ => rfl⟩
    · 
      rw [if_neg hQc]
      have hnorelint : ¬ MeetsRelint MB Q d u := by
        rw [hMR]; rintro ⟨s, _, hmem, _⟩; exact hno_tri s hQc hmem
      have hclean : ∀ s : ℚ, 0 < s → lineAt Q d s ∉ edgeSet t :=
        fun s _ hs => hno_tri s hQc (hedge_tri s hs)
      refine ⟨fun c hc => ?_, ?_⟩
      · rw [Option.some.injEq] at hc
        exact ⟨by rw [← hc, if_neg hnorelint], hclean⟩
      · refine ⟨fun hc => Option.noConfusion hc, ?_⟩
        rintro (⟨_, h⟩ | ⟨s, hs, hmem⟩)
        · exact absurd h hQc
        · exact absurd hmem (hclean s hs)
  · 
    rw [if_neg hden0]
    have hPc : dotQ (Proof.MeshIntersectJump.faceNormal t) P = detOrigin t := by
      rw [hPdef, dotQ_lineAt, htp, div_mul_cancel₀ _ hden0]; ring
    have hroot : ∀ s : ℚ, lineAt Q d s ∈ triangleSet t → s = tp := by
      intro s hs; rw [htp]; exact hit_at_root hden0 hs
    have hsumP : ee0 t P + ee1 t P + ee2 t P = dotQ (Proof.MeshIntersectJump.faceNormal t) (Proof.MeshIntersectJump.faceNormal t) := e_sum t P
    have hnotallneg : ¬ (ee0 t P < 0 ∧ ee1 t P < 0 ∧ ee2 t P < 0) := by
      rintro ⟨a, b, c⟩; linarith
    have hnotallnonpos : ¬ (ee0 t P ≤ 0 ∧ ee1 t P ≤ 0 ∧ ee2 t P ≤ 0) := by
      rintro ⟨a, b, c⟩; linarith
    by_cases htp0 : tp ≤ 0
    · 
      rw [if_pos htp0]
      have hnorelint : ¬ MeetsRelint MB Q d u := by
        rw [hMR]; rintro ⟨s, hs, hmem, _⟩
        rw [hroot s hmem] at hs; exact absurd hs (not_lt.mpr htp0)
      have hclean : ∀ s : ℚ, 0 < s → lineAt Q d s ∉ edgeSet t := by
        intro s hspos hs
        rw [hroot s (hedge_tri s hs)] at hspos; exact absurd hspos (not_lt.mpr htp0)
      refine ⟨fun c hc => ?_, ?_⟩
      · rw [Option.some.injEq] at hc
        exact ⟨by rw [← hc, if_neg hnorelint], hclean⟩
      · refine ⟨fun hc => Option.noConfusion hc, ?_⟩
        rintro (⟨h, _⟩ | ⟨s, hspos, hs⟩)
        · exact absurd h hden0
        · exact absurd hs (hclean s hspos)
    · 
      push_neg at htp0
      rw [if_neg (not_le.mpr htp0)]
      by_cases hpos : 0 < ee0 t P ∧ 0 < ee1 t P ∧ 0 < ee2 t P
      · 
        rw [if_pos (Or.inl hpos)]
        obtain ⟨he0, he1, he2⟩ := hpos
        have hPtri : P ∈ triangleSet t := mem_triangleSet_of_carrier hdet hPc he0.le he1.le he2.le
        have hPnotedge : P ∉ edgeSet t := by
          intro he
          rcases ee_zero_of_mem_edgeSet he with h | h | h
          · exact absurd h he0.ne'
          · exact absurd h he1.ne'
          · exact absurd h he2.ne'
        have hrelint : MeetsRelint MB Q d u := by
          rw [hMR]; exact ⟨tp, htp0, hPtri, hPnotedge⟩
        have hclean : ∀ s : ℚ, 0 < s → lineAt Q d s ∉ edgeSet t := by
          intro s _ hs
          rw [hroot s (hedge_tri s hs), ← hPdef] at hs
          exact hPnotedge hs
        refine ⟨fun c hc => ?_, ?_⟩
        · rw [Option.some.injEq] at hc
          exact ⟨by rw [← hc, if_pos hrelint, qsign_of_ne hden0], hclean⟩
        · refine ⟨fun hc => Option.noConfusion hc, ?_⟩
          rintro (⟨h, _⟩ | ⟨s, hspos, hs⟩)
          · exact absurd h hden0
          · exact absurd hs (hclean s hspos)
      · 
        rw [if_neg (by rw [not_or]; exact ⟨hpos, hnotallneg⟩)]
        by_cases hnonneg : 0 ≤ ee0 t P ∧ 0 ≤ ee1 t P ∧ 0 ≤ ee2 t P
        · 
          rw [if_pos (Or.inl hnonneg)]
          obtain ⟨he0, he1, he2⟩ := hnonneg
          have hsome0 : ee0 t P = 0 ∨ ee1 t P = 0 ∨ ee2 t P = 0 := by
            by_contra hcon
            push_neg at hcon
            exact hpos ⟨lt_of_le_of_ne he0 (Ne.symm hcon.1),
              lt_of_le_of_ne he1 (Ne.symm hcon.2.1), lt_of_le_of_ne he2 (Ne.symm hcon.2.2)⟩
          have hPedge : P ∈ edgeSet t := mem_edgeSet_of_carrier hdet hPc he0 he1 he2 hsome0
          refine ⟨fun c hc => Option.noConfusion hc, ?_⟩
          exact ⟨fun _ => Or.inr ⟨tp, htp0, hPdef ▸ hPedge⟩, fun _ => rfl⟩
        · 
          rw [if_neg (by rw [not_or]; exact ⟨hnonneg, hnotallnonpos⟩)]
          have hPnottri : P ∉ triangleSet t :=
            fun hmem => hnonneg (ee_nonneg_of_mem_triangleSet hmem)
          have hnorelint : ¬ MeetsRelint MB Q d u := by
            rw [hMR]; rintro ⟨s, _, hmem, _⟩
            rw [hroot s hmem, ← hPdef] at hmem
            exact hPnottri hmem
          have hclean : ∀ s : ℚ, 0 < s → lineAt Q d s ∉ edgeSet t := by
            intro s _ hs
            have hmem := hedge_tri s hs
            rw [hroot s hmem, ← hPdef] at hmem
            exact hPnottri hmem
          refine ⟨fun c hc => ?_, ?_⟩
          · rw [Option.some.injEq] at hc
            exact ⟨by rw [← hc, if_neg hnorelint], hclean⟩
          · refine ⟨fun hc => Option.noConfusion hc, ?_⟩
            rintro (⟨h, _⟩ | ⟨s, hspos, hs⟩)
            · exact absurd h hden0
            · exact absurd hs (hclean s hspos)

name: foldl_body_none
statement:
theorem foldl_body_none {W : Array PFace} {qh : H4} {di : I3} (l : List ℕ) :
    l.foldl (fun acc i =>
      match acc with
      | none => none
      | some s =>
        match rayFaceCross (W.getD i default) qh di with
        | none => none
        | some c => some (s + c)) none = none
proof:
:= by
  induction l with
  | nil => rfl
  | cons a l ih => exact ih

name: foldl_body_some
statement:
theorem foldl_body_some {W : Array PFace} {qh : H4} {di : I3} :
    ∀ (l : List ℕ) (init w : ℤ),
    l.foldl (fun acc i =>
      match acc with
      | none => none
      | some s =>
        match rayFaceCross (W.getD i default) qh di with
        | none => none
        | some c => some (s + c)) (some init) = some w →
    (∀ i ∈ l, ∃ c, rayFaceCross (W.getD i default) qh di = some c)
    ∧ w = init + (l.map (fun i => (rayFaceCross (W.getD i default) qh di).getD 0)).sum
proof:
:= by
  intro l
  induction l with
  | nil =>
    intro init w h
    simp only [List.foldl_nil, Option.some.injEq] at h
    subst h
    exact ⟨by simp, by simp⟩
  | cons a l ih =>
    intro init w h
    rw [List.foldl_cons] at h
    rcases hc : rayFaceCross (W.getD a default) qh di with _ | c
    · simp only [hc] at h
      rw [foldl_body_none] at h
      exact absurd h (by simp)
    · simp only [hc] at h
      obtain ⟨hall, hw⟩ := ih (init + c) w h
      refine ⟨fun i hi => ?_, ?_⟩
      · rcases List.mem_cons.mp hi with rfl | hi'
        · exact ⟨c, hc⟩
        · exact hall i hi'
      · rw [hw, List.map_cons, List.sum_cons, hc, Option.getD_some]; ring

name: windingRayDir_some_eq_rayCount
statement:
theorem windingRayDir_some_eq_rayCount {MB : Mesh} (hnpo : NoPlaneThroughOrigin MB)
    (Q d : Point) (hint : IntDir d) {w : ℤ}
    (hsome : windingRayDir (faceBVH (prepare (materialize MB)))
        (prepare (materialize MB)) (ofPoint Q) (ofPoint d) = some w) :
    w = RayCount MB Q d ∧
    (∀ u : Fin MB.size, ∀ s : ℚ, 0 < s → lineAt Q d s ∉ edgeSet MB[u])
proof:
:= by
  classical
  
  
  rw [MeshIntersectWedge.windingRayDir_eq_old _ _
    (MeshIntersectWedge.materialize_wedgeOK MB)] at hsome
  simp only [MeshIntersectWedge.windingRayDirOld, faceBVH,
    show (⟨(ofPoint d).x.num, (ofPoint d).y.num, (ofPoint d).z.num⟩ : I3) = numI3 (ofPoint d) from rfl]
    at hsome
  rw [← Array.foldl_toList] at hsome
  set W := prepare (materialize MB) with hW
  have hWsize : W.size = MB.size := prepare_size MB
  set boxes : Array Impl.BVH.Box := W.map (fun f => faceBoxOf f) with hboxes
  have hboxsize : boxes.size = MB.size := by rw [hboxes, Array.size_map, hWsize]
  set xpt : Impl.BVH.Pt := ⟨(ofPoint Q).x, (ofPoint Q).y, (ofPoint Q).z⟩ with hxpt
  set dpt : Impl.BVH.Pt := ⟨(ofPoint d).x, (ofPoint d).y, (ofPoint d).z⟩ with hdpt
  set hits := Impl.BVH.rayQueryFwd (Impl.BVH.buildBVH boxes) xpt dpt with hhits
  
  obtain ⟨hallsome, hwsum⟩ := foldl_body_some hits.toList 0 w hsome
  
  set σf : Fin MB.size → ℤ := fun u =>
    if MeetsRelint MB Q d u then qsign (dotQ (Proof.MeshIntersectJump.faceNormal MB[u]) d) else 0 with hσf
  
  have hgood : ∀ (i : ℕ) (hi : i < MB.size), PFaceGood (W.getD i default) MB[i] :=
    fun i hi => prepare_getD_fields MB i hi
  
  have hσface : ∀ (i : ℕ) (hi : i < MB.size) (c₀ : ℤ),
      rayFaceCross (W.getD i default) (toH4 (ofPoint Q)) (numI3 (ofPoint d)) = some c₀ →
      c₀ = σf ⟨i, hi⟩ := by
    intro i hi c₀ hc₀
    have hsig := (rayFaceCross_eq_sigma (MB := MB) (u := ⟨i, hi⟩) (f := W.getD i default)
      (hnpo ⟨i, hi⟩) Q d hint (hgood i hi)).1 c₀ hc₀
    simpa only [hσf] using hsig.1
  
  have hnohit : ∀ (u : Fin MB.size), u.val ∉ hits.toList →
      ∀ s : ℚ, 0 ≤ s → lineAt Q d s ∉ triangleSet MB[u] := by
    intro u hu s hsnn hmem
    have hmeet : Impl.BVH.rayLineMeetsBoxFwd xpt dpt (boxes[u.val]'(by rw [hboxsize]; exact u.isLt))
        = true := tri_meets_box_fwd u Q d s hsnn hmem
    have hin := rayQueryFwd_complete boxes xpt dpt (by rw [hboxsize]; have := u.isLt; omega)
      u.val (by rw [hboxsize]; exact u.isLt) hmeet
    exact hu (by rw [hhits]; exact hin)
  
  have hσ0 : ∀ (u : Fin MB.size), u.val ∉ hits.toList → σf u = 0 := by
    intro u hu
    simp only [hσf]
    rw [if_neg]
    rintro ⟨s, hspos, hmem, _⟩
    exact hnohit u hu s (le_of_lt hspos) hmem
  
  have hclean : ∀ u : Fin MB.size, ∀ s : ℚ, 0 < s → lineAt Q d s ∉ edgeSet MB[u] := by
    intro u s hspos hs
    by_cases hu : u.val ∈ hits.toList
    · obtain ⟨c, hcsome⟩ := hallsome u.val hu
      have hclean1 := (rayFaceCross_eq_sigma (MB := MB) (u := u) (f := W.getD u.val default)
        (hnpo u) Q d hint (hgood u.val u.isLt)).1 c hcsome
      exact hclean1.2 s hspos hs
    · exact hnohit u hu s (le_of_lt hspos) (edgeSet_subset_triangleSet _ hs)
  refine ⟨?_, hclean⟩
  
  
  rcases Nat.eq_zero_or_pos MB.size with hz | hpos
  · 
    have hbz : boxes.size = 0 := by rw [hboxsize]; exact hz
    have hemptyL : hits.toList = [] := by
      rw [hhits, rayQueryFwd_empty boxes xpt dpt hbz, Array.toList_empty]
    rw [hwsum, hemptyL, List.map_nil, List.sum_nil, add_zero, RayCount]
    symm
    apply Finset.sum_eq_zero
    intro u _
    exact absurd (lt_of_lt_of_eq u.isLt hz) (Nat.not_lt_zero u.val)
  · obtain ⟨hnodup, hlt⟩ := rayQueryFwd_toList_props boxes xpt dpt (by rw [hboxsize]; omega)
    have hltMB : ∀ i ∈ hits.toList, i < MB.size := by
      intro i hi; have := hlt i hi; rwa [hboxsize] at this
    
    set g : ℕ → ℤ := fun i => if h : i < MB.size then σf ⟨i, h⟩ else 0 with hg
    have hgσ : ∀ u : Fin MB.size, g u.val = σf u := by
      intro u; simp only [hg, u.isLt, dif_pos]
    
    have hmapg : hits.toList.map (fun i => (rayFaceCross (W.getD i default) (toH4 (ofPoint Q))
        (numI3 (ofPoint d))).getD 0) = hits.toList.map g := by
      apply List.map_congr_left
      intro i hi
      have hi' := hltMB i hi
      obtain ⟨c, hcsome⟩ := hallsome i hi
      have hval : (rayFaceCross (W.getD i default) (toH4 (ofPoint Q)) (numI3 (ofPoint d))).getD 0 = σf ⟨i, hi'⟩ := by
        rw [hcsome, Option.getD_some]; exact hσface i hi' c hcsome
      rw [hval, hg]; simp only [hi', dif_pos]
    rw [hwsum, hmapg, zero_add]
    
    have hsubset : hits.toList.toFinset ⊆ Finset.range MB.size := by
      intro i hi
      rw [List.mem_toFinset] at hi
      exact Finset.mem_range.mpr (hltMB i hi)
    have hzero : ∀ i ∈ Finset.range MB.size, i ∉ hits.toList.toFinset → g i = 0 := by
      intro i hi hni
      rw [Finset.mem_range] at hi
      simp only [hg, hi, dif_pos]
      exact hσ0 ⟨i, hi⟩ (by rwa [List.mem_toFinset] at hni)
    have hlist : (hits.toList.map g).sum = ∑ i ∈ hits.toList.toFinset, g i :=
      (List.sum_toFinset g hnodup).symm
    rw [hlist, Finset.sum_subset hsubset hzero, ← Fin.sum_univ_eq_sum_range g MB.size, RayCount]
    exact Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun u _ => by rw [hgσ u])

name: den_dvd_clearPlaneW_x
