name: planeNrm_clearPlane
statement:
theorem planeNrm_clearPlane (n : P3) (c : Rat) :
    planeNrm (clearPlane n c) = smulS (clearPlaneW n c : ℚ) n
proof:
:= by
  simp only [planeNrm, smulS, clearPlane_a, clearPlane_b, clearPlane_c]

name: planeNrm_posMul
statement:
theorem planeNrm_posMul {g g' : IPlane} (h : MeshIntersectPlaneH.PosMul g g') :
    ∃ ρ : ℚ, 0 < ρ ∧ planeNrm g' = smulS ρ (planeNrm g)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨ρ, hρ, ha, hb, hc, -⟩ := h
  exact ⟨ρ, hρ, by simp only [planeNrm, smulS, ha, hb, hc]⟩

name: smulS_smulS
statement: theorem smulS_smulS (μ ν : ℚ) (u : P3) : smulS μ (smulS ν u) = smulS (μ * ν) u
proof:
:= by
  simp only [smulS, P3.mk.injEq]; refine ⟨by ring, by ring, by ring⟩

name: planeNrm_seam
statement:
theorem planeNrm_seam (o : P3) (g g' : IPlane) (h : PlaneSeam o g g') :
    ∃ μ : ℚ, 0 < μ ∧ planeNrm g' = smulS μ (planeNrm g)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨a, b, c, hg, hg'⟩ := h
  set N : P3 := crossS (psubS b a) (psubS c a) with hN
  obtain ⟨ρ₁, hρ₁, hp1⟩ := planeNrm_posMul (posMul_iFacePlaneP a b c)
  obtain ⟨ρ₂, hρ₂, hp2⟩ :=
    planeNrm_posMul (posMul_iFacePlaneP (psubS a o) (psubS b o) (psubS c o))
  have hgN : planeNrm g = smulS (ρ₁ * (clearPlaneW N (dotS N a) : ℚ)) N := by
    rw [hg, hp1, ← smulS_smulS]
    exact congrArg (smulS ρ₁) (planeNrm_clearPlane N (dotS N a))
  have hg'N : planeNrm g' = smulS (ρ₂ * (clearPlaneW N (dotS N (psubS a o)) : ℚ)) N := by
    have hnorm : crossS (psubS (psubS b o) (psubS a o)) (psubS (psubS c o) (psubS a o)) = N :=
      crossNormal_translate a b c o
    rw [hg', hp2, ← smulS_smulS]
    refine congrArg (smulS ρ₂) ?_
    rw [show iFacePlane (psubS a o) (psubS b o) (psubS c o)
          = clearPlane N (dotS N (psubS a o)) by simp only [iFacePlane, hnorm]]
    exact planeNrm_clearPlane N (dotS N (psubS a o))
  set W : ℚ := ρ₁ * (clearPlaneW N (dotS N a) : ℚ) with hW
  set W' : ℚ := ρ₂ * (clearPlaneW N (dotS N (psubS a o)) : ℚ) with hW'
  have hWpos : 0 < W := by
    rw [hW]; exact mul_pos hρ₁ (by exact_mod_cast clearPlaneW_pos _ _)
  have hW'pos : 0 < W' := by
    rw [hW']; exact mul_pos hρ₂ (by exact_mod_cast clearPlaneW_pos _ _)
  have hWne : W ≠ 0 := ne_of_gt hWpos
  refine ⟨W' / W, by positivity, ?_⟩
  rw [hg'N, hgN, smulS, smulS, smulS]
  simp only [P3.mk.injEq]
  refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_⟩ <;> field_simp <;> ring

name: crossS_smulS_left
statement: theorem crossS_smulS_left (μ : Rat) (u v : P3) : crossS (smulS μ u) v = smulS μ (crossS u v)
proof:
:= by
  simp only [crossS, smulS, P3.mk.injEq]; refine ⟨by ring, by ring, by ring⟩

name: edgePlane_shiftScale
statement:
theorem edgePlane_shiftScale (o nPi nPi' a b : P3) (μ : Rat) (_hμ : 0 < μ)
    (hn : nPi' = smulS μ nPi) :
    edgePlane nPi' (psubS a o) (psubS b o)
    = clearPlane (smulS μ (smulS (-1) (crossS nPi (psubS b a))))
        (μ * (dotS (smulS (-1) (crossS nPi (psubS b a))) a
              - dotS (smulS (-1) (crossS nPi (psubS b a))) o))
proof:
:= by
  simp only [edgePlane, psubS_translate, hn, crossS_smulS_left]
  
  congr 1
  · simp only [smulS, P3.mk.injEq]; refine ⟨by ring, by ring, by ring⟩
  · simp only [dotS_smulS, dotS_psubS]; ring

name: edgePlane_eq
statement:
theorem edgePlane_eq (nPi a b : P3) :
    edgePlane nPi a b
    = clearPlane (smulS (-1) (crossS nPi (psubS b a)))
        (dotS (smulS (-1) (crossS nPi (psubS b a))) a)
proof: := rfl

name: edgePlane_sign_ss
statement:
theorem edgePlane_sign_ss (o nPi nPi' a b : P3) (μ : Rat) (hμ : 0 < μ) (hn : nPi' = smulS μ nPi)
    (v : Vtx) (hv : VtxFaithful v) :
    signI (edgePlane nPi' (psubS a o) (psubS b o)) (trVtx o v).h
    = signI (edgePlane nPi a b) v.h
proof:
:= by
  rw [edgePlane_shiftScale o nPi nPi' a b μ hμ hn, edgePlane_eq nPi a b]
  have h1 : (trVtx o v).h = toH4 (psubS v.p o) := rfl
  rw [h1,
    signI_shiftScale o (smulS (-1) (crossS nPi (psubS b a)))
      (smulS μ (smulS (-1) (crossS nPi (psubS b a))))
      (dotS (smulS (-1) (crossS nPi (psubS b a))) a)
      (μ * (dotS (smulS (-1) (crossS nPi (psubS b a))) a
            - dotS (smulS (-1) (crossS nPi (psubS b a))) o)) μ v.p hμ rfl rfl, hv]

name: edgePlane_cut_ss
statement:
theorem edgePlane_cut_ss (o nPi nPi' a b : P3) (μ : Rat) (hμ : 0 < μ) (hn : nPi' = smulS μ nPi)
    (A B : Vtx) (hA : VtxFaithful A) (hB : VtxFaithful B) :
    cutVtx (edgePlane nPi' (psubS a o) (psubS b o)) (trVtx o A) (trVtx o B)
    = trVtx o (cutVtx (edgePlane nPi a b) A B)
proof:
:= by
  rw [edgePlane_shiftScale o nPi nPi' a b μ hμ hn, edgePlane_eq nPi a b]
  exact cutVtx_shiftScale o (smulS (-1) (crossS nPi (psubS b a)))
    (smulS μ (smulS (-1) (crossS nPi (psubS b a))))
    (dotS (smulS (-1) (crossS nPi (psubS b a))) a)
    (μ * (dotS (smulS (-1) (crossS nPi (psubS b a))) a
          - dotS (smulS (-1) (crossS nPi (psubS b a))) o)) μ A B hμ rfl rfl hA hB

name: sideOf_ss
statement:
theorem sideOf_ss (o : P3) (g g' : IPlane) (f : Frag) (hf : FragFaithful f)
    (hsign : ∀ v : Vtx, VtxFaithful v → signI g' (trVtx o v).h = signI g v.h) :
    sideOf g' (trFrag o f) = sideOf g f
proof:
:= by
  simp only [sideOf, trFrag_poly]
  rw [clip_signs_ss o g g' f hf hsign]

name: resultant_ne'
proof:
:= by
  intro h0
  have heq : (slot t k).eval P • (slot t k').n = (slot t k').eval P • (slot t k).n :=
    sub_eq_zero.mp h0
  
  have hcross : crossQ ((slot t k).eval P • (slot t k').n) (slot t k).n
      = crossQ ((slot t k').eval P • (slot t k).n) (slot t k).n := by rw [heq]
  rw [Proof.MeshIntersectRayClassifyGen.crossQ_smul_left,
    Proof.MeshIntersectRayClassifyGen.crossQ_smul_left, crossQ_self, smul_zero] at hcross
  rcases smul_eq_zero.mp hcross with hk0 | hcz
  · 
    have hk'0 : (slot t k').eval P = 0 := by
      have hz : (slot t k').eval P • (slot t k).n = 0 := by rw [← heq, hk0, zero_smul]
      rcases smul_eq_zero.mp hz with h | h
      · exact h
      · exact absurd h (facet_n_ne_zero hdet _ (slot_mem t k))
    exact hnotboth ⟨hk0, hk'0⟩
  · 
    have : crossQ (slot t k).n (slot t k').n = 0 := by rw [crossQ_antisymm, hcz, neg_zero]
    exact crossQ_slot_ne hdet hkk this

name: summand_zero_of_on_carrier
statement:
theorem summand_zero_of_on_carrier {MB : Mesh} {P : Point} {u : Fin MB.size} (dir : Point)
    (hcar : dotQ (Proof.MeshIntersectJump.faceNormal MB[u]) P = detOrigin MB[u]) :
    (if MeetsRelint MB P dir u then qsign (dotQ (Proof.MeshIntersectJump.faceNormal MB[u]) dir) else (0 : ℤ)) = 0
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hden : dotQ (Proof.MeshIntersectJump.faceNormal MB[u]) dir = 0
  · have hq : qsign (dotQ (Proof.MeshIntersectJump.faceNormal MB[u]) dir) = 0 := by rw [hden]; simp [qsign]
    rw [hq]; simp
  · have hnMR : ¬ MeetsRelint MB P dir u := by
      rintro ⟨s, hs, hmem, -⟩
      have hc := Proof.MeshIntersectRayClassify.triangleSet_on_carrier hmem
      rw [Proof.MeshIntersectRayClassify.dotQ_lineAt, hcar] at hc
      have hs0 : s * dotQ (Proof.MeshIntersectJump.faceNormal MB[u]) dir = 0 := by linarith
      rcases mul_eq_zero.mp hs0 with h | h
      · exact hs.ne' h
      · exact hden h
    rw [if_neg hnMR]

name: rayCount_local_const_dir_cop
statement:
theorem rayCount_local_const_dir_cop {MB : Mesh} (hnpo : NoPlaneThroughOrigin MB) {P d d' : Point}
    (hdθ : ∀ θ : ℚ, 0 ≤ θ → θ ≤ 1 → (fun i => (1 - θ) * d i + θ * d' i) ≠ 0)
    (hedge : ∀ θ : ℚ, 0 ≤ θ → θ ≤ 1 → ∀ u : Fin MB.size, ∀ s : ℚ, 0 < s →
      lineAt P (fun i => (1 - θ) * d i + θ * d' i) s ∉ edgeSet MB[u]) :
    RayCount MB P d = RayCount MB P d'
proof:
:= by
  unfold RayCount
  refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun u _ => ?_)
  by_cases hAcar : dotQ (Proof.MeshIntersectJump.faceNormal MB[u]) P = detOrigin MB[u]
  · rw [summand_zero_of_on_carrier d hAcar, summand_zero_of_on_carrier d' hAcar]
  · have hdet := hnpo u
    set A : ℚ := detOrigin MB[u] - dotQ (Proof.MeshIntersectJump.faceNormal MB[u]) P with hAeq
    have hA : A ≠ 0 := by rw [hAeq, sub_ne_zero]; exact fun h => hAcar h.symm
    have hdseg : ∀ θ : ℚ, (fun i => (1 - θ) * d i + θ * d' i) = seg d d' θ := by
      intro θ; funext i; simp only [seg]; ring
    rw [summand_dir_eq (P := P) (u := u) d hdet hAeq hA,
        summand_dir_eq (P := P) (u := u) d' hdet hAeq hA]
    refine if_congr ?_ rfl rfl
    refine four_cond_const _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ ?_
    intro θ hθ0 hθ1 hnn
    have hdir_ne : seg d d' θ ≠ 0 := by rw [← hdseg θ]; exact hdθ θ hθ0 hθ1
    have hedge1 : ∀ s : ℚ, 0 < s → lineAt P (seg d d' θ) s ∉ edgeSet MB[u] := by
      intro s hs; rw [← hdseg θ]; exact hedge θ hθ0 hθ1 u s hs
    have hI0 : (1 - θ) * ((qsign A : ℚ) * dotQ (Proof.MeshIntersectJump.faceNormal MB[u]) d)
          + θ * ((qsign A : ℚ) * dotQ (Proof.MeshIntersectJump.faceNormal MB[u]) d')
        = (qsign A : ℚ) * dotQ (Proof.MeshIntersectJump.faceNormal MB[u]) (seg d d' θ) := by
      rw [dotQ_seg]; ring
    have hI1 : (1 - θ) * ((qsign A : ℚ) * (dotQ (Proof.MeshIntersectJump.faceNormal MB[u]) d * ee0 MB[u] P
            + A * det3 (psub MB[u].v₁ MB[u].v₀) d (Proof.MeshIntersectJump.faceNormal MB[u])))
          + θ * ((qsign A : ℚ) * (dotQ (Proof.MeshIntersectJump.faceNormal MB[u]) d' * ee0 MB[u] P
            + A * det3 (psub MB[u].v₁ MB[u].v₀) d' (Proof.MeshIntersectJump.faceNormal MB[u])))
        = (qsign A : ℚ) * (dotQ (Proof.MeshIntersectJump.faceNormal MB[u]) (seg d d' θ) * ee0 MB[u] P
            + A * det3 (psub MB[u].v₁ MB[u].v₀) (seg d d' θ) (Proof.MeshIntersectJump.faceNormal MB[u])) := by
      rw [dotQ_seg, det3_seg_mid]; ring
    have hI2 : (1 - θ) * ((qsign A : ℚ) * (dotQ (Proof.MeshIntersectJump.faceNormal MB[u]) d * ee1 MB[u] P
            + A * det3 (psub MB[u].v₂ MB[u].v₁) d (Proof.MeshIntersectJump.faceNormal MB[u])))
          + θ * ((qsign A : ℚ) * (dotQ (Proof.MeshIntersectJump.faceNormal MB[u]) d' * ee1 MB[u] P
            + A * det3 (psub MB[u].v₂ MB[u].v₁) d' (Proof.MeshIntersectJump.faceNormal MB[u])))
        = (qsign A : ℚ) * (dotQ (Proof.MeshIntersectJump.faceNormal MB[u]) (seg d d' θ) * ee1 MB[u] P
            + A * det3 (psub MB[u].v₂ MB[u].v₁) (seg d d' θ) (Proof.MeshIntersectJump.faceNormal MB[u])) := by
      rw [dotQ_seg, det3_seg_mid]; ring
    have hI3 : (1 - θ) * ((qsign A : ℚ) * (dotQ (Proof.MeshIntersectJump.faceNormal MB[u]) d * ee2 MB[u] P
            + A * det3 (psub MB[u].v₀ MB[u].v₂) d (Proof.MeshIntersectJump.faceNormal MB[u])))
          + θ * ((qsign A : ℚ) * (dotQ (Proof.MeshIntersectJump.faceNormal MB[u]) d' * ee2 MB[u] P
            + A * det3 (psub MB[u].v₀ MB[u].v₂) d' (Proof.MeshIntersectJump.faceNormal MB[u])))
        = (qsign A : ℚ) * (dotQ (Proof.MeshIntersectJump.faceNormal MB[u]) (seg d d' θ) * ee2 MB[u] P
            + A * det3 (psub MB[u].v₀ MB[u].v₂) (seg d d' θ) (Proof.MeshIntersectJump.faceNormal MB[u])) := by
      rw [dotQ_seg, det3_seg_mid]; ring
    obtain ⟨hnn0, hnn1, hnn2, hnn3⟩ := hnn
    rw [hI0] at hnn0; rw [hI1] at hnn1; rw [hI2] at hnn2; rw [hI3] at hnn3
    have hpos := H_pos_of_nonneg hdet hAeq hA hdir_ne hedge1 hnn0 hnn1 hnn2 hnn3
    obtain ⟨hp0, hp1, hp2, hp3⟩ := hpos
    refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
    · rw [hI0]; exact hp0
    · rw [hI1]; exact hp1
    · rw [hI2]; exact hp2
    · rw [hI3]; exact hp3

name: cop_dense_codir
statement:
theorem cop_dense_codir {MB : Mesh} (hnpo : NoPlaneThroughOrigin MB)
    {r : ℕ} [NeZero r] (hr : 3 ≤ r) {n : Point} {c : ℚ} {w : Fin r → Point}
    {Cop : Fin MB.size → Prop}
    (hpl : OnPlane n c w) (hs : StrictConv n w)
    {fc d_fc : Point}
    (hfc_bary : fc = ∑ i, (r : ℚ)⁻¹ • w i)
    (hoff_surf : ∀ (u : Fin MB.size), ∀ x ∈ vrelint w, x ∉ triangleSet MB[u])
    (hd_fc_ne : d_fc ≠ 0)
    (hd_fc_clean : ∀ (u : Fin MB.size) (s : ℚ), 0 < s → lineAt fc d_fc s ∉ edgeSet MB[u])
    (hfacet_feas : ∀ (j : Fin MB.size) (k : Fin 4), ¬ (Cop j ∧ k = 3) →
      ∃ y, dotQ n y = c ∧ (slot MB[j] k).eval y ≠ 0)
    (hmoment : ∀ (u : Fin MB.size) (k : Fin 3),
      ∃ m : Point, dotQ m (psub (edgeHead MB[u] k) (edgeTail MB[u] k)) = 0 ∧
        ∃ y, dotQ n y = c ∧ dotQ m (psub y (edgeTail MB[u] k)) ≠ 0) :
    ∃ P d' : Point,
      P ∈ vrelint w ∧
      (∀ k : Fin MB.size, ¬ Cop k → ∀ g ∈ tetraHalves MB[k], g.eval P ≠ 0) ∧
      d' ≠ 0 ∧
      (∀ u : Fin MB.size, dotQ (Proof.MeshIntersectJump.faceNormal MB[u]) d' ≠ 0) ∧
      (∀ (j : Fin MB.size) (k : Fin 4), dotQ (slot MB[j] k).n d' ≠ 0) ∧
      (∀ (j : Fin MB.size), ∀ g ∈ tetraHalves MB[j], ∀ g' ∈ tetraHalves MB[j],
        g ≠ g' → ∀ t : ℚ, ¬ (g.eval (lineAt P d' t) = 0 ∧ g'.eval (lineAt P d' t) = 0)) ∧
      (∀ (u : Fin MB.size) (t : ℚ), t ≠ 0 → lineAt P d' t ∉ edgeSet MB[u]) ∧
      (∀ θ : ℚ, 0 ≤ θ → θ ≤ 1 → ∀ u : Fin MB.size,
        (fun i => fc i + θ * (P i - fc i)) ∉ triangleSet MB[u]) ∧
      (∀ θ : ℚ, 0 ≤ θ → θ ≤ 1 → ∀ u : Fin MB.size, ∀ s : ℚ, 0 < s →
        lineAt (fun i => fc i + θ * (P i - fc i)) d_fc s ∉ edgeSet MB[u]) ∧
      (∀ θ : ℚ, 0 ≤ θ → θ ≤ 1 → (fun i => (1 - θ) * d_fc i + θ * d' i) ≠ 0) ∧
      (∀ θ : ℚ, 0 ≤ θ → θ ≤ 1 → ∀ u : Fin MB.size, ∀ s : ℚ, 0 < s →
        lineAt P (fun i => (1 - θ) * d_fc i + θ * d' i) s ∉ edgeSet MB[u])
proof:
:= by
  classical
  
  have hfc_plane : dotQ n fc = c := by
    have h := hfc_bary ▸ barycenter_mem_vrelint hr w
    rw [vrelint_eq hr hpl hs] at h; exact h.1
  have hfc_mem : fc ∈ vrelint w := hfc_bary ▸ barycenter_mem_vrelint hr w
  have hbary : (∑ i, (r : ℚ)⁻¹ • w i) = fc := hfc_bary.symm
  have hddfc : 0 < dotQ d_fc d_fc := Proof.WellFormedCheckNormal.dotQ_self_pos hd_fc_ne
  have hedge_ne : ∀ (u : Fin MB.size) (k : Fin 3),
      psub (edgeHead MB[u] k) (edgeTail MB[u] k) ≠ 0 := by
    intro u k
    fin_cases k
    · show psub MB[u].v₁ MB[u].v₀ ≠ 0
      intro h; apply faceNormal_ne_zero (hnpo u); rw [Proof.MeshIntersectJump.faceNormal, h]
      exact Proof.MeshIntersectRayClassifyGen.crossQ_zero_left _
    · show psub MB[u].v₂ MB[u].v₁ ≠ 0
      intro h; apply faceNormal_ne_zero (hnpo u); rw [Proof.MeshIntersectJump.faceNormal]
      have he : psub MB[u].v₂ MB[u].v₀ = psub MB[u].v₁ MB[u].v₀ := by
        funext i; have := congrFun h i; simp only [psub, Pi.zero_apply] at this ⊢; linarith
      rw [he]; exact crossQ_self _
    · show psub MB[u].v₀ MB[u].v₂ ≠ 0
      intro h; apply faceNormal_ne_zero (hnpo u); rw [Proof.MeshIntersectJump.faceNormal]
      have he : psub MB[u].v₂ MB[u].v₀ = 0 := by
        funext i; have := congrFun h i; simp only [psub, Pi.zero_apply] at this ⊢; linarith
      rw [he]; exact Proof.MeshIntersectRayClassifyGen.crossQ_zero_right _
  have hfcnotin : ∀ (u : Fin MB.size) (k : Fin 3), ∀ q s : ℚ, 0 ≤ q → q ≤ 1 → 0 ≤ s →
      fc ≠ (fun i => (edgeTail MB[u] k) i
        + q * ((edgeHead MB[u] k) i - (edgeTail MB[u] k) i) - s * d_fc i) := by
    intro u k q s hq0 hq1 hs0 heq
    set a := edgeTail MB[u] k with hadef
    set b := edgeHead MB[u] k with hbdef
    have hseg : (fun i => a i + q * (b i - a i)) ∈ segment ℚ a b := by
      refine ⟨1 - q, q, by linarith, hq0, by ring, ?_⟩
      funext i; simp only [Pi.add_apply, Pi.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul]; ring
    have hsub : segment ℚ a b ⊆ edgeSet MB[u] := by
      rw [edgeSet_eq_iUnion]
      exact Set.subset_iUnion
        (fun k' => segment ℚ (edgeTail MB[u] k') (edgeHead MB[u] k')) k
    rcases eq_or_lt_of_le hs0 with hs | hs
    · apply hoff_surf u fc hfc_mem
      have hfceq : fc = (fun i => a i + q * (b i - a i)) := by
        rw [heq]; funext i; rw [← hs]; ring
      rw [hfceq]; exact segment_edge_subset_triangle MB[u] k hseg
    · apply hd_fc_clean u s hs
      have hpt : lineAt fc d_fc s = (fun i => a i + q * (b i - a i)) := by
        funext i; simp only [lineAt]; rw [congrFun heq i]; ring
      rw [hpt]; exact hsub hseg
  choose mfun hmperp hmfeas using hmoment
  have hsupp : ∀ (u : Fin MB.size) (k : Fin 3), ∃ (Nℓ : Point) (dℓ : ℚ),
      (dotQ Nℓ fc - dℓ < 0) ∧
      (∀ q s : ℚ, 0 ≤ q → q ≤ 1 → 0 < s →
        0 ≤ dotQ Nℓ (fun i => (edgeTail MB[u] k) i
          + q * ((edgeHead MB[u] k) i - (edgeTail MB[u] k) i) - s * d_fc i) - dℓ) :=
    fun u k => exists_edge_support (edgeTail MB[u] k) (edgeHead MB[u] k) d_fc fc
      (hedge_ne u k) hd_fc_ne (hfcnotin u k)
  choose Nlfun dlfun hl1 hl2 using hsupp
  have hsource_clean : ∀ (Q : Point),
      (∀ (u : Fin MB.size) (k : Fin 3), dotQ (Nlfun u k) Q - dlfun u k < 0) →
      ∀ (u : Fin MB.size) (s : ℚ), 0 < s → lineAt Q d_fc s ∉ edgeSet MB[u] := by
    intro Q hQneg u s hs hmem
    rw [edgeSet_eq_iUnion] at hmem
    simp only [Set.mem_iUnion] at hmem
    obtain ⟨k, hk⟩ := hmem
    obtain ⟨q, hq0, hq1, hQeq⟩ := graze_source_param hs hk
    have hge := hl2 u k q s hq0 hq1 hs
    rw [← hQeq] at hge
    linarith [hQneg u k, hge]
  
  obtain ⟨P, hPmem, hPall⟩ := side_dense_vrelint' hr hpl hs
    (Sum.elim (fun jk : Fin MB.size × Fin 4 =>
        if (Cop jk.1 ∧ jk.2 = 3) then n else (slot MB[jk.1] jk.2).n)
      (Sum.elim (fun uk : Fin MB.size × Fin 3 => mfun uk.1 uk.2)
        (fun uk : Fin MB.size × Fin 3 => Nlfun uk.1 uk.2)))
    (Sum.elim (fun jk : Fin MB.size × Fin 4 =>
        if (Cop jk.1 ∧ jk.2 = 3) then c - 1 else (slot MB[jk.1] jk.2).c)
      (Sum.elim (fun uk : Fin MB.size × Fin 3 => dotQ (mfun uk.1 uk.2) (edgeTail MB[uk.1] uk.2))
        (fun uk : Fin MB.size × Fin 3 => dlfun uk.1 uk.2)))
    (by
      rintro (⟨j, k⟩ | ⟨u, k⟩ | ⟨u, k⟩)
      · by_cases hst : Cop j ∧ (k : Fin 4) = 3
        · refine ⟨fc, hfc_plane, ?_⟩
          simp only [Sum.elim_inl, if_pos hst]
          rw [hfc_plane]; intro h; linarith
        · obtain ⟨y, hy1, hy2⟩ := hfacet_feas j k hst
          refine ⟨y, hy1, ?_⟩
          simp only [Sum.elim_inl, if_neg hst]
          intro h; exact hy2 (by simp only [Half.eval]; rw [h, sub_self])
      · obtain ⟨y, hy1, hy2⟩ := hmfeas u k
        refine ⟨y, hy1, ?_⟩
        simp only [Sum.elim_inl, Sum.elim_inr]
        intro h; apply hy2
        have hd : dotQ (mfun u k) (psub y (edgeTail MB[u] k))
            = dotQ (mfun u k) y - dotQ (mfun u k) (edgeTail MB[u] k) := by
          simp only [dotQ, psub]; ring
        rw [hd, h, sub_self]
      · refine ⟨fc, hfc_plane, ?_⟩
        simp only [Sum.elim_inr]
        exact sub_ne_zero.mp (ne_of_lt (hl1 u k)))
  
  have hPfacet : ∀ (j : Fin MB.size) (k : Fin 4), ¬ (Cop j ∧ k = 3) →
      (slot MB[j] k).eval P ≠ 0 := by
    intro j k hst h
    have hne := (hPall (Sum.inl (j, k))).1
    simp only [Sum.elim_inl, if_neg hst] at hne
    simp only [Half.eval, sub_eq_zero] at h
    exact hne h
  have hTrClean : ∀ (k : Fin MB.size), ¬ Cop k → ∀ g ∈ tetraHalves MB[k], g.eval P ≠ 0 := by
    intro j hcop g hg
    obtain ⟨k, rfl⟩ := mem_tetraHalves_iff.mp hg
    exact hPfacet j k (fun hh => hcop hh.1)
  have hnotboth : ∀ (j : Fin MB.size) (k k' : Fin 4), k ≠ k' →
      ¬ ((slot MB[j] k).eval P = 0 ∧ (slot MB[j] k').eval P = 0) := by
    intro j k k' hkk hc
    by_cases hk3 : k = 3
    · have hk'3 : (k' : Fin 4) ≠ 3 := fun h => hkk (hk3.trans h.symm)
      exact hPfacet j k' (fun hh => hk'3 hh.2) hc.2
    · exact hPfacet j k (fun hh => hk3 hh.2) hc.1
  have hP_offline : ∀ (u : Fin MB.size) (k : Fin 3),
      dotQ (mfun u k) (psub P (edgeTail MB[u] k)) ≠ 0 := by
    intro u k h
    have hne := (hPall (Sum.inr (Sum.inl (u, k)))).1
    simp only [Sum.elim_inl, Sum.elim_inr] at hne
    apply hne
    have hd : dotQ (mfun u k) (psub P (edgeTail MB[u] k))
        = dotQ (mfun u k) P - dotQ (mfun u k) (edgeTail MB[u] k) := by
      simp only [dotQ, psub]; ring
    rw [hd] at h; linarith
  have hP_he_ne : ∀ (u : Fin MB.size) (k : Fin 3),
      crossQ (psub (edgeTail MB[u] k) P) (psub (edgeHead MB[u] k) P) ≠ 0 := by
    intro u k
    rw [crossQ_edge_source]
    intro hc
    apply hP_offline u k
    rw [dotQ_symm]
    exact perp_of_parallel (hedge_ne u k) hc (by rw [dotQ_symm]; exact hmperp u k)
  have hℓP : ∀ (u : Fin MB.size) (k : Fin 3), dotQ (Nlfun u k) P - dlfun u k < 0 := by
    intro u k
    have hside := (hPall (Sum.inr (Sum.inr (u, k)))).2
    simp only [Sum.elim_inr] at hside
    rw [hbary] at hside
    have hpos := hside (sub_ne_zero.mp (ne_of_lt (hl1 u k)))
    rcases mul_pos_iff.mp hpos with ⟨h, _⟩ | ⟨_, h⟩
    · exact absurd h (not_lt.mpr (hl1 u k).le)
    · exact h
  have hℓseg : ∀ (u : Fin MB.size) (k : Fin 3) (θ : ℚ), 0 ≤ θ → θ ≤ 1 →
      dotQ (Nlfun u k) (fun i => fc i + θ * (P i - fc i)) - dlfun u k < 0 := by
    intro u k θ hθ0 hθ1
    have hlin : dotQ (Nlfun u k) (fun i => fc i + θ * (P i - fc i)) - dlfun u k
        = (1 - θ) * (dotQ (Nlfun u k) fc - dlfun u k) + θ * (dotQ (Nlfun u k) P - dlfun u k) := by
      simp only [dotQ]; ring
    rw [hlin]; exact interp_neg (hl1 u k) (hℓP u k) hθ0 hθ1
  have hP_dfc_clean := hsource_clean P hℓP
  
  obtain ⟨d', hdall⟩ := side_dense_dir' d_fc
    (Sum.elim (fun u : Fin MB.size => Proof.MeshIntersectJump.faceNormal MB[u])
      (Sum.elim (fun jk : Fin MB.size × Fin 4 => (slot MB[jk.1] jk.2).n)
        (Sum.elim (fun t : Fin MB.size × Fin 4 × Fin 4 =>
            if t.2.1 = t.2.2 then d_fc
            else (slot MB[t.1] t.2.1).eval P • (slot MB[t.1] t.2.2).n
              - (slot MB[t.1] t.2.2).eval P • (slot MB[t.1] t.2.1).n)
          (Sum.elim
            (fun uk : Fin MB.size × Fin 3 =>
              crossQ (psub (edgeTail MB[uk.1] uk.2) P) (psub (edgeHead MB[uk.1] uk.2) P))
            (fun _ : Unit => d_fc)))))
    (by
      rintro (u | ⟨j, k⟩ | ⟨j, k, k'⟩ | ⟨u, k⟩ | _)
      · simp only [Sum.elim_inl]; exact faceNormal_ne_zero (hnpo u)
      · simp only [Sum.elim_inl, Sum.elim_inr]; exact facet_n_ne_zero (hnpo j) _ (slot_mem _ _)
      · simp only [Sum.elim_inl, Sum.elim_inr]
        split_ifs with hkk
        · exact hd_fc_ne
        · exact resultant_ne' (hnpo j) hkk (hnotboth j k k' hkk)
      · simp only [Sum.elim_inl, Sum.elim_inr]; exact hP_he_ne u k
      · simp only [Sum.elim_inr]; exact hd_fc_ne)
  have hφ := hdall (Sum.inr (Sum.inr (Sum.inr (Sum.inr ()))))
  simp only [Sum.elim_inr] at hφ
  have hdd' : 0 < dotQ d_fc d' := by
    have hmul := hφ.2 (ne_of_gt hddfc)
    by_contra h; push_neg at h
    exact absurd hmul (not_lt.mpr (mul_nonpos_of_nonneg_of_nonpos hddfc.le h))
  have hd'ne : d' ≠ 0 := by
    intro h; apply hφ.1; rw [h]; exact Proof.WellFormedCheckNormal.dotQ_zero_right d_fc
  
  refine ⟨P, d', hPmem, hTrClean, hd'ne,
    fun u => by have := (hdall (Sum.inl u)).1; simpa only [Sum.elim_inl] using this,
    fun j k => by
      have := (hdall (Sum.inr (Sum.inl (j, k)))).1
      simpa only [Sum.elim_inl, Sum.elim_inr] using this,
    ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · 
    intro j g hg g' hg' hne t ht
    obtain ⟨k, rfl⟩ := mem_tetraHalves_iff.mp hg
    obtain ⟨k', rfl⟩ := mem_tetraHalves_iff.mp hg'
    have hkk : k ≠ k' := fun h => hne (by rw [h])
    obtain ⟨he1, he2⟩ := ht
    have hres := (hdall (Sum.inr (Sum.inr (Sum.inl (j, k, k'))))).1
    simp only [Sum.elim_inl, Sum.elim_inr, if_neg hkk] at hres
    rw [eval_lineAt] at he1 he2
    apply hres
    rw [dotQ_resultant]
    linear_combination (dotQ (slot MB[j] k').n d') * he1 - (dotQ (slot MB[j] k).n d') * he2
  · 
    intro u t ht hmem
    rw [edgeSet_eq_iUnion] at hmem
    simp only [Set.mem_iUnion] at hmem
    obtain ⟨k, hk⟩ := hmem
    have hhe := (hdall (Sum.inr (Sum.inr (Sum.inr (Sum.inl (u, k)))))).1
    simp only [Sum.elim_inl, Sum.elim_inr] at hhe
    exact no_graze_from_P ht hhe hk
  · 
    intro θ hθ0 hθ1 u
    have heq : (fun i => fc i + θ * (P i - fc i)) = (1 - θ) • fc + θ • P := by
      funext i; simp only [Pi.add_apply, Pi.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul]; ring
    rw [heq]
    exact hoff_surf u _ (vrelint_convex hr hpl hs hfc_mem hPmem
      (by linarith : (0:ℚ) ≤ 1 - θ) hθ0 (by ring : (1 - θ) + θ = 1))
  · 
    intro θ hθ0 hθ1 u s hs
    exact hsource_clean (fun i => fc i + θ * (P i - fc i))
      (fun u' k => hℓseg u' k θ hθ0 hθ1) u s hs
  · 
    intro θ hθ0 hθ1 h
    have hdotθ : dotQ d_fc (fun i => (1 - θ) * d_fc i + θ * d' i)
        = (1 - θ) * dotQ d_fc d_fc + θ * dotQ d_fc d' := by simp only [dotQ]; ring
    have hpos : 0 < dotQ d_fc (fun i => (1 - θ) * d_fc i + θ * d' i) := by
      rw [hdotθ]; exact interp_pos hddfc hdd' hθ0 hθ1
    rw [h, Proof.WellFormedCheckNormal.dotQ_zero_right] at hpos
    exact lt_irrefl 0 hpos
  · 
    intro θ hθ0 hθ1 u s hs hmem
    rcases eq_or_lt_of_le hθ0 with hθ | hθ
    · have hdθ0 : (fun i => (1 - θ) * d_fc i + θ * d' i) = d_fc := by
        rw [← hθ]; funext i; ring
      rw [hdθ0] at hmem
      exact hP_dfc_clean u s hs hmem
    · rw [edgeSet_eq_iUnion] at hmem
      simp only [Set.mem_iUnion] at hmem
      obtain ⟨k, hk⟩ := hmem
      refine no_graze_from_P hs.ne' ?_ hk
      have hheP := hdall (Sum.inr (Sum.inr (Sum.inr (Sum.inl (u, k)))))
      simp only [Sum.elim_inl, Sum.elim_inr] at hheP
      have hlin : dotQ (crossQ (psub (edgeTail MB[u] k) P) (psub (edgeHead MB[u] k) P))
            (fun i => (1 - θ) * d_fc i + θ * d' i)
          = (1 - θ) * dotQ (crossQ (psub (edgeTail MB[u] k) P) (psub (edgeHead MB[u] k) P)) d_fc
            + θ * dotQ (crossQ (psub (edgeTail MB[u] k) P) (psub (edgeHead MB[u] k) P)) d' := by
        simp only [dotQ]; ring
      rw [hlin]
      by_cases hdfc0 : dotQ (crossQ (psub (edgeTail MB[u] k) P) (psub (edgeHead MB[u] k) P)) d_fc = 0
      · rw [hdfc0]; simp only [mul_zero, zero_add]
        exact mul_ne_zero hθ.ne' hheP.1
      · exact interp_ne (hheP.2 hdfc0) hθ0 hθ1

name: keepFallback_windingAt_eq
statement:
theorem keepFallback_windingAt_eq {MB : Mesh}
    {r : ℕ} [NeZero r] {w : Fin r → Point} {fc n : Point} {c : ℚ}
    {Cop : Fin MB.size → Prop}
    (hwf : Legacy.WellFormedMesh MB)
    (hr : 3 ≤ r)
    (hpl : OnPlane n c w)
    (hs : StrictConv n w)
    (hfc_bary : fc = ∑ i, (r : ℚ)⁻¹ • w i)
    (hoff_surf : ∀ (u : Fin MB.size), ∀ x ∈ vrelint w, x ∉ triangleSet MB[u])
    (hCopSimplex : ∀ (k : Fin MB.size), Cop k → ∀ x ∈ vrelint w, x ∉ simplex MB[k])
    (hfacet_feas : ∀ (j : Fin MB.size) (k : Fin 4), ¬ (Cop j ∧ k = 3) →
      ∃ y, dotQ n y = c ∧ (slot MB[j] k).eval y ≠ 0)
    (hmoment : ∀ (u : Fin MB.size) (k : Fin 3),
      ∃ m : Point, dotQ m (psub (edgeHead MB[u] k) (edgeTail MB[u] k)) = 0 ∧
        ∃ y, dotQ n y = c ∧ dotQ m (psub y (edgeTail MB[u] k)) ≠ 0) :
    ∃ P : Point,
      (∀ u : Fin MB.size, P ∉ triangleSet MB[u]) ∧
      (∀ k : Fin MB.size, Cop k → P ∉ simplex MB[k]) ∧
      (∀ k : Fin MB.size, ¬ Cop k → ∀ g ∈ tetraHalves MB[k], g.eval P ≠ 0) ∧
      P ∈ vrelint w ∧
      windingAt (faceBVH (prepare (materialize MB))) (prepare (materialize MB)) (ofPoint fc)
        = winding (meshChain MB) P
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have hnpo : NoPlaneThroughOrigin MB := hwf.2.2.2
  obtain ⟨d_fc, hd_fc_ne, hd_fc_clean, hWA⟩ := windingAt_clean_dir hnpo fc
  obtain ⟨P, d', hPmem, hTrClean, hd'ne, hdN, hdA, hG2line, hnoedge, hoffSeg, hedgeSeg, hdθ,
      hedgeArc⟩ :=
    cop_dense_codir hnpo hr hpl hs hfc_bary hoff_surf hd_fc_ne hd_fc_clean hfacet_feas hmoment
  have hPoff := fun u => hoff_surf u P hPmem
  have hCopS := fun k hk => hCopSimplex k hk P hPmem
  
  have hL : RayCount MB fc d_fc = RayCount MB P d_fc :=
    rayCount_local_const hnpo hoffSeg hedgeSeg
  
  have hD : RayCount MB P d_fc = RayCount MB P d' :=
    rayCount_local_const_dir_cop hnpo hdθ hedgeArc
  
  have hW5 : winding (meshChain MB) P = RayCount MB P d' :=
    raycount_eq_winding_cop hwf.1 hnpo hwf.2.2.1 hPoff hCopS hTrClean hd'ne hdN hdA hG2line hnoedge
  exact ⟨P, hPoff, hCopS, hTrClean, hPmem, hWA.trans (hL.trans (hD.trans hW5.symm))⟩

name: keepFallback_iff_winding
statement:
theorem keepFallback_iff_winding {MB : Mesh} {wOpp : Array PFace} {fa : Frag}
    {r : ℕ} [NeZero r] {w : Fin r → Point} {fc n : Point} {c : ℚ}
    {Cop : Fin MB.size → Prop}
    (hwf : Legacy.WellFormedMesh MB)
    (hW : wOpp = prepare (materialize MB))
    (hr : 3 ≤ r)
    (hpl : OnPlane n c w)
    (hs : StrictConv n w)
    (hfc_pt : fragCentroid fa = ofPoint fc)
    (hne : fa.poly.size ≠ 0)
    (hmir : FragMirrors fa)
    (hfc_bary : fc = ∑ i, (r : ℚ)⁻¹ • w i)
    (hoff_surf : ∀ (u : Fin MB.size), ∀ x ∈ vrelint w, x ∉ triangleSet MB[u])
    (hCopSimplex : ∀ (k : Fin MB.size), Cop k → ∀ x ∈ vrelint w, x ∉ simplex MB[k])
    (hfacet_feas : ∀ (j : Fin MB.size) (k : Fin 4), ¬ (Cop j ∧ k = 3) →
      ∃ y, dotQ n y = c ∧ (slot MB[j] k).eval y ≠ 0)
    (hmoment : ∀ (u : Fin MB.size) (k : Fin 3),
      ∃ m : Point, dotQ m (psub (edgeHead MB[u] k) (edgeTail MB[u] k)) = 0 ∧
        ∃ y, dotQ n y = c ∧ dotQ m (psub y (edgeTail MB[u] k)) ≠ 0) :
    ∃ P : Point,
      (∀ u : Fin MB.size, P ∉ triangleSet MB[u]) ∧
      (∀ k : Fin MB.size, Cop k → P ∉ simplex MB[k]) ∧
      (∀ k : Fin MB.size, ¬ Cop k → ∀ g ∈ tetraHalves MB[k], g.eval P ≠ 0) ∧
      P ∈ vrelint w ∧
      keepFallback (faceBVH wOpp) wOpp fa = decide (winding (meshChain MB) P = 1)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨P, hPoff, hCopS, hTrClean, hPmem, hbridge⟩ :=
    keepFallback_windingAt_eq hwf hr hpl hs hfc_bary hoff_surf hCopSimplex hfacet_feas hmoment
  refine ⟨P, hPoff, hCopS, hTrClean, hPmem, ?_⟩
  subst hW
  rw [keepFallback_eq _ _ (materialize_wedgeOK MB) hne hmir, hfc_pt, hbridge]
  exact Bool.beq_eq_decide_eq _ _

name: i3Q_hsub
statement:
theorem i3Q_hsub {a b : H4} {A B : Point} (ha : repr4 a A) (hb : repr4 b B) :
    i3Q (hsub b a) = ((b.w * a.w : ℤ) : ℚ) • (B - A)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨haw, rfl⟩ := ha
  obtain ⟨hbw, rfl⟩ := hb
  have haw0 : ((a.w : ℤ) : ℚ) ≠ 0 := by exact_mod_cast haw.ne'
  have hbw0 : ((b.w : ℤ) : ℚ) ≠ 0 := by exact_mod_cast hbw.ne'
  funext i
  fin_cases i <;>
    · simp only [i3Q, hsub, mkPoint, Pi.smul_apply, Pi.sub_apply, smul_eq_mul]
      push_cast
      field_simp
      ring

name: i3Q_crossI

name: dotI_i3Q
statement: theorem dotI_i3Q (u v : I3) : ((dotI u v : ℤ) : ℚ) = dotQ (i3Q u) (i3Q v)

name: i3Q_xyz
statement:
theorem i3Q_xyz {q : H4} {Q : Point} (h : repr4 q Q) :

name: dotQ_smulL

name: dotQ_smulR
statement: private theorem dotQ_smulR (m : ℚ) (u v : Point) : dotQ u (m • v) = m * dotQ u v

name: i3Q_nrmI
statement:
theorem i3Q_nrmI {h0 h1 h2 : H4} {V0 V1 V2 : Point}
    (r0 : repr4 h0 V0) (r1 : repr4 h1 V1) (r2 : repr4 h2 V2) :
    i3Q (crossI (hsub h1 h0) (hsub h2 h0))
      = ((h1.w * h0.w * (h2.w * h0.w) : ℤ) : ℚ) • crossQ (V1 - V0) (V2 - V0)
proof:
:= by
  rw [i3Q_crossI, i3Q_hsub r0 r1, i3Q_hsub r0 r2,
    CSG.Proof.MeshIntersectClip.crossQ_smul_left,
    CSG.Proof.MeshIntersectClip.crossQ_smul_right, smul_smul]
  congr 1
  push_cast
  ring

name: isMulOf_primDir
statement:
theorem isMulOf_primDir {g : IPlane} {N : Point} {d : ℚ} (h : IsMulOf g N d) :
    IsMulOf (IPlane.primDir g) N d
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hγ : gamma g = 0
  · 
    obtain ⟨ha0, hb0, hc0, hd0⟩ := (gamma_eq_zero_iff g).mp hγ
    have hg : g = ⟨0, 0, 0, 0⟩ := by cases g; simp_all
    have hpd : IPlane.primDir g = g := by rw [hg]; rfl
    rw [hpd]
    exact h
  · obtain ⟨m, hm, ha, hb, hc, hd⟩ := h
    have hγpos : (0 : ℚ) < (gamma g : ℚ) := by
      exact_mod_cast Nat.pos_of_ne_zero hγ
    have hγ0 : (gamma g : ℚ) ≠ 0 := ne_of_gt hγpos
    refine ⟨m / (gamma g : ℚ), div_pos hm hγpos, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
    · have e : (g.a : ℚ) = (gamma g : ℚ) * ((IPlane.primDir g).a : ℚ) := by
        exact_mod_cast primDir_entry_a hγ
      rw [ha] at e
      field_simp
      linarith [e]
    · have e : (g.b : ℚ) = (gamma g : ℚ) * ((IPlane.primDir g).b : ℚ) := by
        exact_mod_cast primDir_entry_b hγ
      rw [hb] at e
      field_simp
      linarith [e]
    · have e : (g.c : ℚ) = (gamma g : ℚ) * ((IPlane.primDir g).c : ℚ) := by
        exact_mod_cast primDir_entry_c hγ
      rw [hc] at e
      field_simp
      linarith [e]
    · have e : (g.d : ℚ) = (gamma g : ℚ) * ((IPlane.primDir g).d : ℚ) := by
        exact_mod_cast primDir_entry_d hγ
      rw [hd] at e
      field_simp
      linarith [e]

name: isMulOf_iFacePlaneH_pre
statement:
theorem isMulOf_iFacePlaneH_pre {h0 h1 h2 : H4} {V0 V1 V2 : Point}
    (r0 : repr4 h0 V0) (r1 : repr4 h1 V1) (r2 : repr4 h2 V2) :
    IsMulOf
      (let nrmI := crossI (hsub h1 h0) (hsub h2 h0)
       (⟨h0.w * nrmI.x, h0.w * nrmI.y, h0.w * nrmI.z,
         nrmI.x * h0.x + nrmI.y * h0.y + nrmI.z * h0.z⟩ : IPlane))
      (crossQ (V1 - V0) (V2 - V0))
      (dotQ (crossQ (V1 - V0) (V2 - V0)) V0)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨hw0, -⟩ := id r0
  obtain ⟨hw1, -⟩ := id r1
  obtain ⟨hw2, -⟩ := id r2
  have hμpos : (0 : ℤ) < h1.w * h0.w * (h2.w * h0.w) :=
    mul_pos (mul_pos hw1 hw0) (mul_pos hw2 hw0)
  have hw0Q : (0 : ℚ) < ((h0.w : ℤ) : ℚ) := by exact_mod_cast hw0
  have hμQ : (0 : ℚ) < ((h1.w * h0.w * (h2.w * h0.w) : ℤ) : ℚ) := by exact_mod_cast hμpos
  have hL1 := i3Q_nrmI r0 r1 r2
  
  have hx : ((crossI (hsub h1 h0) (hsub h2 h0)).x : ℚ)
      = ((h1.w * h0.w * (h2.w * h0.w) : ℤ) : ℚ) * (crossQ (V1 - V0) (V2 - V0)) 0 := by
    have := congrFun hL1 0
    simpa only [i3Q, mkPoint_zero, Pi.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul] using this
  have hy : ((crossI (hsub h1 h0) (hsub h2 h0)).y : ℚ)
      = ((h1.w * h0.w * (h2.w * h0.w) : ℤ) : ℚ) * (crossQ (V1 - V0) (V2 - V0)) 1 := by
    have := congrFun hL1 1
    simpa only [i3Q, mkPoint_one, Pi.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul] using this
  have hz : ((crossI (hsub h1 h0) (hsub h2 h0)).z : ℚ)
      = ((h1.w * h0.w * (h2.w * h0.w) : ℤ) : ℚ) * (crossQ (V1 - V0) (V2 - V0)) 2 := by
    have := congrFun hL1 2
    simpa only [i3Q, mkPoint_two, Pi.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul] using this
  
  have hdot : ((dotI (crossI (hsub h1 h0) (hsub h2 h0)) ⟨h0.x, h0.y, h0.z⟩ : ℤ) : ℚ)
      = ((h1.w * h0.w * (h2.w * h0.w) : ℤ) : ℚ) * ((h0.w : ℤ) : ℚ)
        * dotQ (crossQ (V1 - V0) (V2 - V0)) V0 := by
    rw [dotI_i3Q, hL1, i3Q_xyz r0, dotQ_smulL, dotQ_smulR]
    ring
  refine ⟨((h0.w : ℤ) : ℚ) * ((h1.w * h0.w * (h2.w * h0.w) : ℤ) : ℚ),
    mul_pos hw0Q hμQ, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · show ((h0.w * (crossI (hsub h1 h0) (hsub h2 h0)).x : ℤ) : ℚ) = _
    push_cast
    push_cast at hx
    rw [hx]
    ring
  · show ((h0.w * (crossI (hsub h1 h0) (hsub h2 h0)).y : ℤ) : ℚ) = _
    push_cast
    push_cast at hy
    rw [hy]
    ring
  · show ((h0.w * (crossI (hsub h1 h0) (hsub h2 h0)).z : ℤ) : ℚ) = _
    push_cast
    push_cast at hz
    rw [hz]
    ring
  · show (((crossI (hsub h1 h0) (hsub h2 h0)).x * h0.x
        + (crossI (hsub h1 h0) (hsub h2 h0)).y * h0.y
        + (crossI (hsub h1 h0) (hsub h2 h0)).z * h0.z : ℤ) : ℚ) = _
    have hd : dotI (crossI (hsub h1 h0) (hsub h2 h0)) ⟨h0.x, h0.y, h0.z⟩
        = (crossI (hsub h1 h0) (hsub h2 h0)).x * h0.x
          + (crossI (hsub h1 h0) (hsub h2 h0)).y * h0.y
          + (crossI (hsub h1 h0) (hsub h2 h0)).z * h0.z := rfl
    rw [← hd, hdot]
    ring

name: isMulOf_iFacePlaneH
statement:
theorem isMulOf_iFacePlaneH {h0 h1 h2 : H4} {V0 V1 V2 : Point}
    (r0 : repr4 h0 V0) (r1 : repr4 h1 V1) (r2 : repr4 h2 V2) :

name: posMul_of_isMulOf

theorem posMul_of_isMulOf {g g' : IPlane} {N : Point} {d : ℚ}

name: simplexAffineBasis
statement:
theorem simplexAffineBasis (t : Triangle)
    (h : AffineIndependent ℚ ![0, t.v₀, t.v₁, t.v₂]) :
    ∃ (b : AffineBasis (Fin 4) ℚ (Fin 3 → ℚ)) (a₀ : Fin 4),
      (⇑b = ![0, t.v₀, t.v₁, t.v₂])
        ∧ ({0, t.v₀, t.v₁, t.v₂} : Set Point) = Set.range ⇑b
        ∧ b a₀ = 0
proof:
:= by
  
  have hspan : affineSpan ℚ (Set.range ![(0 : Point), t.v₀, t.v₁, t.v₂]) = ⊤ := by
    rw [h.affineSpan_eq_top_iff_card_eq_finrank_add_one]
    simp
  refine ⟨AffineBasis.mk ![(0 : Point), t.v₀, t.v₁, t.v₂] h hspan, 0, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · rfl
  · have hcoe : (⇑(AffineBasis.mk ![(0 : Point), t.v₀, t.v₁, t.v₂] h hspan))
        = ![(0 : Point), t.v₀, t.v₁, t.v₂] := rfl
    rw [hcoe]
    simp only [Matrix.range_cons, Matrix.range_empty, Set.union_empty]
    ext x
    simp only [Set.mem_union, Set.mem_singleton_iff, Set.mem_insert_iff]
  · rfl

name: simplex_eq_iInter_halfspaces
statement:
theorem simplex_eq_iInter_halfspaces (t : Triangle)
    (b : AffineBasis (Fin 4) ℚ (Fin 3 → ℚ))
    (hb : ({0, t.v₀, t.v₁, t.v₂} : Set Point) = Set.range ⇑b) :
    simplex t = ⋂ k : Fin 4, {x : Point | 0 ≤ b.coord k x}
proof:
:= by
  unfold simplex
  rw [hb, b.convexHull_eq_nonneg_coord]
  ext x
  simp only [Set.mem_setOf_eq, Set.mem_iInter]

name: directions_bounded_by_A_faces
statement:
theorem directions_bounded_by_A_faces
    (b : AffineBasis (Fin 4) ℚ (Fin 3 → ℚ))
    {Q : Point} (hQ : Q ≠ 0) :
    ∃ k : Fin 4, (b.coord k).linear Q < 0
proof:
:= by
  by_contra hcon
  push_neg at hcon  
  
  have hsum : ∑ k, (b.coord k).linear Q = 0 := by
    have e1 : ∀ k, (b.coord k) Q = (b.coord k).linear Q + (b.coord k) 0 := by
      intro k
      rw [AffineMap.decomp (b.coord k)]; simp
    have s1 : ∑ k, (b.coord k) Q = 1 := b.sum_coord_apply_eq_one Q
    have s0 : ∑ k, (b.coord k) 0 = 1 := b.sum_coord_apply_eq_one 0
    have hsplit : ∑ k, (b.coord k) Q
        = (∑ k, (b.coord k).linear Q) + ∑ k, (b.coord k) 0 := by
      rw [← Finset.sum_add_distrib]
      exact Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun k _ => e1 k)
    rw [s1, s0] at hsplit
    linarith [hsplit]
  
  have hall0 : ∀ k, (b.coord k).linear Q = 0 := by
    intro k
    by_contra hk
    have hpos : 0 < (b.coord k).linear Q := lt_of_le_of_ne (hcon k) (Ne.symm hk)
    have hpossum : 0 < ∑ k, (b.coord k).linear Q :=
      Finset.sum_pos' (fun i _ => hcon i) ⟨k, Finset.mem_univ k, hpos⟩
    rw [hsum] at hpossum
    exact lt_irrefl 0 hpossum
  
  apply hQ
  apply b.ext_elem
  intro k
  have eQ : (b.coord k) Q = (b.coord k).linear Q + (b.coord k) 0 := by
    rw [AffineMap.decomp (b.coord k)]; simp
  rw [eQ, hall0 k, zero_add]

name: excludes_cop_sigma
statement:
theorem excludes_cop_sigma {M₁ M₂ : Mesh}
    (h₁ : NoPlaneThroughOrigin M₁) (h₂ : NoPlaneThroughOrigin M₂)

          (planesForScoped ((materialize MA).getD i.1 default).plane (materialize MB)
            ((candP MA MB).getD i.1 #[])),
        ∀ k : Fin (atomizeFrag (Proof.MeshIntersectNpo.vsGen M₁ M₂) f).poly.size,

            (fragCycle (atomizeFrag (Proof.MeshIntersectNpo.vsGen M₁ M₂) f) k)

proof:

name: excl_hsigma_kept
statement:
theorem excl_hsigma_kept {M₁ M₂ : Mesh} {t : Triangle}
    (h₁ : NoPlaneThroughOrigin M₁) (h₂ : NoPlaneThroughOrigin M₂)
    (hdetA : detOrigin t ≠ 0) (K : Array Frag)
    (hK : ∀ f ∈ K, FragInv (carrierNormal t) (detOrigin t) f) :
    Excludes (fun Q => dotQ (carrierNormal t) Q ≠ 0 →
      ∀ f ∈ K, ∀ k : Fin (atomizeFrag (Proof.MeshIntersectNpo.vsGen M₁ M₂) f).poly.size,
        Proof.MeshIntersectClip.areaForm (carrierNormal t)
          (fanApex (fragCycle (atomizeFrag (Proof.MeshIntersectNpo.vsGen M₁ M₂) f)))
          (fragCycle (atomizeFrag (Proof.MeshIntersectNpo.vsGen M₁ M₂) f) k)
          ((detOrigin t / dotQ (carrierNormal t) Q) • Q) ≠ 0)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have hnt : carrierNormal t ≠ 0 := carrierNormal_ne_zero hdetA
  obtain ⟨hvs, hnd⟩ := Proof.MeshIntersectNpo.vsGen_facts h₁ h₂
  have hper : ∀ f ∈ K,
      Excludes (fun Q => dotQ (carrierNormal t) Q ≠ 0 →
        ∀ k : Fin (atomizeFrag (Proof.MeshIntersectNpo.vsGen M₁ M₂) f).poly.size,
          Proof.MeshIntersectClip.areaForm (carrierNormal t)
            (fanApex (fragCycle (atomizeFrag (Proof.MeshIntersectNpo.vsGen M₁ M₂) f)))
            (fragCycle (atomizeFrag (Proof.MeshIntersectNpo.vsGen M₁ M₂) f) k)
            ((detOrigin t / dotQ (carrierNormal t) Q) • Q) ≠ 0) := by
    intro f hf
    have hinvf := hK f hf
    haveI := hinvf.neZero
    obtain ⟨hm, hshape⟩ := atomize_refShape hinvf (Proof.MeshIntersectNpo.vsGen M₁ M₂) hvs hnd
    haveI : NeZero (atomizeFrag (Proof.MeshIntersectNpo.vsGen M₁ M₂) f).poly.size := ⟨by omega⟩
    have hupl : Proof.MeshIntersectClip.OnPlane (carrierNormal t) (detOrigin t)
        (fragCycle (atomizeFrag (Proof.MeshIntersectNpo.vsGen M₁ M₂) f)) :=
      hshape.toRefShape.onPlane hinvf.onPlane
    have hk : ∀ k : Fin (atomizeFrag (Proof.MeshIntersectNpo.vsGen M₁ M₂) f).poly.size,
        Excludes (fun Q => dotQ (carrierNormal t) Q ≠ 0 →
          Proof.MeshIntersectClip.areaForm (carrierNormal t)
            (fanApex (fragCycle (atomizeFrag (Proof.MeshIntersectNpo.vsGen M₁ M₂) f)))
            (fragCycle (atomizeFrag (Proof.MeshIntersectNpo.vsGen M₁ M₂) f) k)
            ((detOrigin t / dotQ (carrierNormal t) Q) • Q) ≠ 0) := by
      intro k
      exact pull_area hnt hdetA (fanApex_onPlane hupl) (hupl k)
        (hshape.toRefShape.apex_ne hinvf.size3 hm hinvf.onPlane hinvf.strictConv k)
    exact (Excludes.forall_fintype hk).mono (fun Q hQ hntQ k => hQ k hntQ)
  exact (Excludes.forall_mem_array hper).mono
    (fun Q hQ hntQ f hfm => hQ f hfm hntQ)

name: excl_hsigma_kept_fintype
statement:
theorem excl_hsigma_kept_fintype {M₁ M₂ : Mesh} {n : ℕ}
    (h₁ : NoPlaneThroughOrigin M₁) (h₂ : NoPlaneThroughOrigin M₂)
    (t : Fin n → Triangle) (hdet : ∀ i, detOrigin (t i) ≠ 0)
    (K : Fin n → Array Frag)
    (hK : ∀ i, ∀ f ∈ K i, FragInv (carrierNormal (t i)) (detOrigin (t i)) f) :
    Excludes (fun Q => ∀ i : Fin n, dotQ (carrierNormal (t i)) Q ≠ 0 →
      ∀ f ∈ K i, ∀ k : Fin (atomizeFrag (Proof.MeshIntersectNpo.vsGen M₁ M₂) f).poly.size,
        Proof.MeshIntersectClip.areaForm (carrierNormal (t i))
          (fanApex (fragCycle (atomizeFrag (Proof.MeshIntersectNpo.vsGen M₁ M₂) f)))
          (fragCycle (atomizeFrag (Proof.MeshIntersectNpo.vsGen M₁ M₂) f) k)
          ((detOrigin (t i) / dotQ (carrierNormal (t i)) Q) • Q) ≠ 0)

    excl_hsigma_kept h₁ h₂ (hdet i) (K i) (hK i))

name: excl_coneClean_pending_fintype
statement:
theorem excl_coneClean_pending_fintype {MB : Mesh} {n : ℕ}
    (hnpoB : NoPlaneThroughOrigin MB)
    (t : Fin n → Triangle) (hdet : ∀ i, detOrigin (t i) ≠ 0)
    (K : Fin n → Array Frag) :
    Excludes (fun Q => ∀ i : Fin n, dotQ (carrierNormal (t i)) Q ≠ 0 →
      ∀ f ∈ K i,
        ∀ k : Fin MB.size,
            coplanarPlane (faceSOf MB[k]).plane (faceSOf (t i)).plane = false →
            ∀ g ∈ tetraHalves (MB[k]),
              g.eval ((detOrigin (t i) / dotQ (carrierNormal (t i)) Q) • Q) ≠ 0)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  refine Excludes.forall_fintype (fun i : Fin n => ?_)
  
  have hcone : Excludes (fun Q => dotQ (carrierNormal (t i)) Q ≠ 0 →
      ∀ k : Fin MB.size,
        coplanarPlane (faceSOf MB[k]).plane (faceSOf (t i)).plane = false →
        ∀ g ∈ tetraHalves (MB[k]),
          g.eval ((detOrigin (t i) / dotQ (carrierNormal (t i)) Q) • Q) ≠ 0) := by
    have hk : ∀ k : Fin MB.size,
        Excludes (fun Q => dotQ (carrierNormal (t i)) Q ≠ 0 →
          coplanarPlane (faceSOf MB[k]).plane (faceSOf (t i)).plane = false →
          ∀ g ∈ tetraHalves (MB[k]),
            g.eval ((detOrigin (t i) / dotQ (carrierNormal (t i)) Q) • Q) ≠ 0) := by
      intro k
      by_cases hcop : coplanarPlane (faceSOf MB[k]).plane (faceSOf (t i)).plane = false
      · have hslot : ∀ k0 : Fin 4,
            Excludes (fun Q => dotQ (carrierNormal (t i)) Q ≠ 0 →
              (Proof.MeshIntersectCancel.slot (MB[k]) k0).eval
                ((detOrigin (t i) / dotQ (carrierNormal (t i)) Q) • Q) ≠ 0) :=
          fun k0 => Proof.MeshIntersectFaceLedger.excl_E1_slot_tr (hdet i) (hnpoB k) hcop k0
        refine ((Excludes.forall_fintype hslot).mono ?_)
        intro Q hQ hntQ _ g hg
        obtain ⟨k0, rfl⟩ := Proof.MeshIntersectCancel.mem_tetraHalves_iff.mp hg
        exact hQ k0 hntQ
      · exact Excludes.trivial (fun Q _ hc => absurd hc hcop)
    exact (Excludes.forall_fintype hk).mono
      (fun Q hQ hntQ k hcop g hg => hQ k hntQ hcop g hg)
  exact hcone.mono (fun Q hQ hntQ f _ k hcop g hg => hQ hntQ k hcop g hg)

name: excludes_edge_lines
statement:
theorem excludes_edge_lines (M : Mesh) (hM : NoPlaneThroughOrigin M) (_meshId : Nat) :
    Excludes (fun Q => ∀ i : Fin M.size,
      dotQ (carrierNormal M[i]) Q ≠ 0 →
        ∀ k : Fin (fragOfFace (faceSOf M[i])).poly.size,
          Proof.MeshIntersectClip.eta (carrierNormal M[i])
              (fragCycle (fragOfFace (faceSOf M[i]))) k
              ((detOrigin M[i] / dotQ (carrierNormal M[i]) Q) • Q) ≠ 0)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  refine Excludes.forall_fintype (fun i : Fin M.size => ?_)
  have hdet : detOrigin M[i] ≠ 0 := hM i
  set nt := carrierNormal M[i] with hnt_def
  set ct := detOrigin M[i] with hct_def
  set base := fragOfFace (faceSOf M[i]) with hbase
  have hnt : nt ≠ 0 := carrierNormal_ne_zero hdet
  have hinv : FragInv nt ct base :=
    Proof.MeshIntersectKeep.fragInv_base hdet
  haveI := hinv.neZero
  
  
  
  have h := Excludes.forall_fintype
    (F := fun (k : Fin base.poly.size) Q =>
      dotQ nt Q ≠ 0 →
      Proof.MeshIntersectClip.eta nt (fragCycle base) k ((ct / dotQ nt Q) • Q) ≠ 0)
    (fun k => pull_area hnt hdet (hinv.onPlane k) (hinv.onPlane (k + 1))
      (Proof.MeshIntersectClip.consec_ne hinv.size3 hinv.strictConv k))
  exact h.mono (fun Q hQ hntQ k => hQ k hntQ)

name: copDescA_eq
statement:
theorem copDescA_eq (M₁ M₂ : Mesh) (i : ℕ) :
    copDescA M₁ M₂ i
      = ((clipFaceScoped (fragOfFace ((materialize M₁).getD i default))
            (planesForScoped ((materialize M₁).getD i default).plane (materialize M₂)
              ((candP M₁ M₂).getD i #[]))).filter
          (fun f => isCoplanarWith f (materialize M₂))).flatMap
        (fun fa => resolveFrag (faceBVH (prepare (materialize M₂))) fa
          ((splitCoplanar
            ((Array.range (materialize M₂).size).flatMap (fun j =>
              clipFaceScoped (fragOfFace ((materialize M₂).getD j default))
                (planesForScoped ((materialize M₂).getD j default).plane (materialize M₁)
                  ((candP M₂ M₁).getD j #[]))))
            (materialize M₁)).1)
          (prepare (materialize M₂)))

name: mem_copDescA_parent
statement:
theorem mem_copDescA_parent (M₁ M₂ : Mesh) (i : ℕ) (hi : i < M₁.size)
    {f : Frag} (hf : f ∈ copDescA M₁ M₂ i) :
    ∃ fa ∈ (splitCoplanar (Proof.MeshIntersectNsi.fragsAOf M₁ M₂) (materialize M₂)).1,
      fa.plane = (faceSOf M₁[i]).plane
      ∧ fa ∈ clipFaceScoped (fragOfFace ((materialize M₁).getD i default))
          (planesForScoped ((materialize M₁).getD i default).plane (materialize M₂)
            ((candP M₁ M₂).getD i #[]))
      ∧ f ∈ resolveFrag (faceBVH (prepare (materialize M₂))) fa
          (splitCoplanar (Proof.MeshIntersectNsi.fragsBOf M₁ M₂) (materialize M₁)).1
          (prepare (materialize M₂))
proof:
:= by
  rw [copDescA_eq] at hf
  obtain ⟨fa, hfa, hfmem⟩ := mem_flatMap_arr.mp hf
  
  obtain ⟨hfaclip, hfacop⟩ := Array.mem_filter.mp hfa
  
  have hgetD : (materialize M₁).getD i default = faceSOf M₁[i] := by
    have hiA : i < (materialize M₁).size := by simpa [materialize] using hi
    rw [Proof.MeshIntersectKeep.arr_getD _ _ _ hiA, materialize_getElem M₁ i hi]
  
  have hfapl : fa.plane = (faceSOf M₁[i]).plane := by
    have := Proof.MeshIntersectNsi.clipFaceScoped_plane
      (fragOfFace ((materialize M₁).getD i default)) _ hfaclip
    rw [hgetD, fragOfFace] at this; simpa using this
  
  have hfaA : fa ∈ (splitCoplanar (Proof.MeshIntersectNsi.fragsAOf M₁ M₂) (materialize M₂)).1 := by
    rw [splitCoplanar]; simp only
    refine Array.mem_filter.mpr ⟨?_, hfacop⟩
    rw [Proof.MeshIntersectNsi.fragsAOf]
    refine mem_flatMap_arr.mpr ⟨i, ?_, hfaclip⟩
    rw [Array.mem_def, Array.toList_range, List.mem_range]
    simpa [materialize] using hi
  exact ⟨fa, hfaA, hfapl, hfaclip, hfmem⟩

name: mem_copDescB_parent
statement:
theorem mem_copDescB_parent (M₁ M₂ : Mesh) (j : ℕ) (hj : j < M₂.size)
    {f : Frag} (hf : f ∈ copDescB M₁ M₂ j) :
    ∃ fb ∈ (splitCoplanar (Proof.MeshIntersectNsi.fragsBOf M₁ M₂) (materialize M₁)).1,
      fb.plane = (faceSOf M₂[j]).plane
      ∧ fb ∈ clipFaceScoped (fragOfFace ((materialize M₂).getD j default))
          (planesForScoped ((materialize M₂).getD j default).plane (materialize M₁)
            ((candP M₂ M₁).getD j #[]))
      ∧ f ∈ resolveCoplanar.resolveFragB (faceBVH (prepare (materialize M₁))) fb
          (splitCoplanar (Proof.MeshIntersectNsi.fragsAOf M₁ M₂) (materialize M₂)).1
          (prepare (materialize M₁))
proof:
:= by
  rw [copDescB_eq] at hf
  obtain ⟨fb, hfb, hfmem⟩ := mem_flatMap_arr.mp hf
  obtain ⟨hfbclip, hfbcop⟩ := Array.mem_filter.mp hfb
  have hgetD : (materialize M₂).getD j default = faceSOf M₂[j] := by
    have hjA : j < (materialize M₂).size := by simpa [materialize] using hj
    rw [Proof.MeshIntersectKeep.arr_getD _ _ _ hjA, materialize_getElem M₂ j hj]
  have hfbpl : fb.plane = (faceSOf M₂[j]).plane := by
    have := Proof.MeshIntersectNsi.clipFaceScoped_plane
      (fragOfFace ((materialize M₂).getD j default)) _ hfbclip
    rw [hgetD, fragOfFace] at this; simpa using this
  have hfbB : fb ∈ (splitCoplanar (Proof.MeshIntersectNsi.fragsBOf M₁ M₂) (materialize M₁)).1 := by
    rw [splitCoplanar]; simp only
    refine Array.mem_filter.mpr ⟨?_, hfbcop⟩
    rw [Proof.MeshIntersectNsi.fragsBOf]
    refine mem_flatMap_arr.mpr ⟨j, ?_, hfbclip⟩
    rw [Array.mem_def, Array.toList_range, List.mem_range]
    simpa [materialize] using hj
  exact ⟨fb, hfbB, hfbpl, hfbclip, hfmem⟩

name: nbData_eq_of_normal
statement:
theorem nbData_eq_of_normal {M : Mesh} (h : Legacy.Normal (meshChain M)) :
    nbData M = ⟨h.choose_spec.1.choose,
      (fun i => (h.choose_spec.1.choose_spec.choose_spec.1 i).choose),
      (fun i => (h.choose_spec.1.choose_spec.choose_spec.1 i).choose_spec.choose)⟩
proof:
:= by
  rw [nbData, dif_pos h]

name: nbData_ne
statement:
theorem nbData_ne {M : Mesh} (h : Legacy.Normal (meshChain M)) (m : Fin (nbData M).1) :
    (nbData M).2.1 m ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  
  
  revert m
  rw [nbData_eq_of_normal h]
  intro m
  exact (h.choose_spec.1.choose_spec.choose_spec.1 m).choose_spec.choose_spec.1

name: nbData_covers
proof:
:= by
  
  revert hX
  rw [nbData_eq_of_normal h]
  intro hX
  
  have hN := h.choose_spec
  have hsub : h.choose ⊆ ⋃ i, hN.1.choose_spec.choose i :=
    hN.1.choose_spec.choose_spec.2
  have hplanes : ∀ i, IsPlane (hN.1.choose_spec.choose i) :=
    hN.1.choose_spec.choose_spec.1
  
  refine hN.2 X (fun hXN => ?_)
  
  obtain ⟨i₀, hXS⟩ := Set.mem_iUnion.mp (hsub hXN)
  
  have hp := (hplanes i₀).choose_spec.choose_spec.2
  rw [hp, Set.mem_setOf_eq] at hXS
  exact hX i₀ (by rw [dotQ_eq_sum]; exact hXS)

name: gap_point_off_negligible
statement:
theorem gap_point_off_negligible {K : ℕ} (n : Fin K → Point) (c : Fin K → ℚ) (Q : Point)
    (hne : ∀ m, dotQ (n m) Q ≠ 0) {v μg : ℚ} (hlt : v < μg) :
    ∃ μ : ℚ, v < μ ∧ μ < μg ∧ ∀ m, dotQ (n m) (μ • Q) ≠ c m
proof:
:= by
  classical
  
  set S : Finset ℚ := Finset.image (fun m => c m / dotQ (n m) Q) Finset.univ with hS
  
  have hIoo : (Set.Ioo v μg).Infinite := Set.Ioo_infinite hlt
  have hdiff : (Set.Ioo v μg \ (↑S : Set ℚ)).Infinite :=
    hIoo.diff (Finset.finite_toSet S)
  obtain ⟨μ, hμmem⟩ := hdiff.nonempty
  obtain ⟨⟨hvμ, hμμg⟩, hμnotS⟩ := hμmem
  refine ⟨μ, hvμ, hμμg, fun m hbad => ?_⟩
  
  rw [dotQ_smul_right] at hbad
  apply hμnotS
  rw [Finset.mem_coe, hS, Finset.mem_image]
  exact ⟨m, Finset.mem_univ m, by rw [div_eq_iff (hne m)]; linarith [hbad]⟩

name: excludes_Gen
statement:
theorem excludes_Gen (M₁ M₂ : Mesh)
    (h₁ : NoPlaneThroughOrigin M₁) (h₂ : NoPlaneThroughOrigin M₂) :
    Excludes (Gen M₁ M₂)
proof:
:= by
  have hPi₁ := excludes_carrier M₁ h₁
  have hPi₂ := excludes_carrier M₂ h₂
  have htie := Excludes.forall_fintype (fun i : Fin M₁.size =>
    Excludes.forall_fintype (fun j : Fin M₂.size =>
      excludes_tie_cond M₁[i] M₂[j]))
  have hbundA := Proof.MeshIntersectCop.excludes_ledger_bundle M₁ M₂ M₁ M₂
    h₁ h₂ 1 h₁ h₂
  have hbundB := Proof.MeshIntersectCop.excludes_ledger_bundle M₁ M₂ M₂ M₁
    h₁ h₂ 2 h₂ h₁
  have hcsA := excludes_cop_sigma h₁ h₂ M₁ M₂ h₁ 1
  have hcsB := excludes_cop_sigma h₁ h₂ M₂ M₁ h₂ 2
  have heA := excludes_edge_lines M₁ h₁ 1
  have heB := excludes_edge_lines M₂ h₂ 2
  
  
  
  have hbaseA : ∀ i : Fin M₁.size, FragInv (carrierNormal M₁[i]) (detOrigin M₁[i])
      (fragOfFace ((materialize M₁).getD i.1 default)) := fun i => by
    rw [show (materialize M₁).getD i.1 default = faceSOf M₁[i] from by
      rw [getD_eq_getElem (materialize M₁) (by rw [materialize_size]; exact i.isLt) default,
        materialize_getElem M₁ i.1 i.isLt]; rfl]
    exact Proof.MeshIntersectKeep.fragInv_base (h₁ i)
  have hbaseB : ∀ j : Fin M₂.size, FragInv (carrierNormal M₂[j]) (detOrigin M₂[j])
      (fragOfFace ((materialize M₂).getD j.1 default)) := fun j => by
    rw [show (materialize M₂).getD j.1 default = faceSOf M₂[j] from by
      rw [getD_eq_getElem (materialize M₂) (by rw [materialize_size]; exact j.isLt) default,
        materialize_getElem M₂ j.1 j.isLt]; rfl]
    exact Proof.MeshIntersectKeep.fragInv_base (h₂ j)
  have hkdA := excl_hsigma_kept_fintype h₁ h₂ (fun i : Fin M₁.size => M₁[i])
    (fun i => h₁ i) (fun i => copDescA M₁ M₂ i.1)
    (fun i f hf => copDescA_fragInv M₁ M₂ i.1 (hbaseA i) hf)
  have hkdB := excl_hsigma_kept_fintype h₁ h₂ (fun j : Fin M₂.size => M₂[j])
    (fun j => h₂ j) (fun j => copDescB M₁ M₂ j.1)
    (fun j f hf => copDescB_fragInv M₁ M₂ j.1 (hbaseB j) hf)
  
  
  
  
  have heNbB : Excludes (fun Q => ∀ m : Fin (nbData M₂).1,
      dotQ ((nbData M₂).2.1 m) Q ≠ 0) := by
    by_cases hN : Legacy.Normal (meshChain M₂)
    · exact Excludes.forall_fintype (fun m => excludes_dotQ_ne (nbData_ne hN m) 0)
    · refine Excludes.trivial (fun Q m => ?_)
      exact (Fin.cast (by rw [nbData, dif_neg hN]) m).elim0
  have heNbA : Excludes (fun Q => ∀ m : Fin (nbData M₁).1,
      dotQ ((nbData M₁).2.1 m) Q ≠ 0) := by
    by_cases hN : Legacy.Normal (meshChain M₁)
    · exact Excludes.forall_fintype (fun m => excludes_dotQ_ne (nbData_ne hN m) 0)
    · refine Excludes.trivial (fun Q m => ?_)
      exact (Fin.cast (by rw [nbData, dif_neg hN]) m).elim0
  
  have hcaA := Proof.MeshIntersectFaceLedger.excl_cop_avoidsLines M₁ M₂ h₁ h₂
  have hcaB := Proof.MeshIntersectFaceLedger.excl_cop_avoidsLinesB M₁ M₂ h₁ h₂
  
  
  have hpendA := excl_coneClean_pending_fintype (MB := M₂) h₂
    (fun i : Fin M₁.size => M₁[i]) (fun i => h₁ i) (fun i => pendDescA M₁ M₂ i.1)
  have hpendB := excl_coneClean_pending_fintype (MB := M₁) h₁
    (fun j : Fin M₂.size => M₂[j]) (fun j => h₂ j) (fun j => pendDescB M₁ M₂ j.1)
  exact (hPi₁.and (hPi₂.and (htie.and (hbundA.and (hbundB.and
    (hcsA.and (hcsB.and (heA.and (heB.and (hkdA.and (hkdB.and
      (heNbB.and (heNbA.and (hcaA.and (hcaB.and (hpendA.and hpendB))))))))))))))))

name: hit_off_edgeSet_of_eta
statement:
theorem hit_off_edgeSet_of_eta {t : Triangle} {Q : Point} (_meshId _parent : Nat)
    (hg : ∀ k : Fin (fragOfFace (faceSOf t)).poly.size,
        Proof.MeshIntersectClip.eta (carrierNormal t)
            (fragCycle (fragOfFace (faceSOf t))) k
            ((detOrigin t / dotQ (carrierNormal t) Q) • Q) ≠ 0) :
    ((detOrigin t / dotQ (carrierNormal t) Q) • Q) ∉ edgeSet t
proof:
:= by
  classical
  obtain ⟨hsz, hpt⟩ := Proof.MeshIntersectKeep.fragOfFace_cycle t
  haveI : NeZero (fragOfFace (faceSOf t)).poly.size := ⟨by omega⟩
  set base := fragOfFace (faceSOf t) with hbase
  have hm3 : 3 ≤ base.poly.size := by omega
  have lt0 : 0 < base.poly.size := by omega
  have lt1 : 1 < base.poly.size := by omega
  have lt2 : 2 < base.poly.size := by omega
  have w0 : fragCycle base ⟨0, lt0⟩ = t.v₀ := by simpa using hpt ⟨0, lt0⟩
  have w1 : fragCycle base ⟨1, lt1⟩ = t.v₁ := by simpa using hpt ⟨1, lt1⟩
  have w2 : fragCycle base ⟨2, lt2⟩ = t.v₂ := by simpa using hpt ⟨2, lt2⟩
  have hsz3 : base.poly.size = 3 := hsz
  have s0 : (⟨0, lt0⟩ : Fin base.poly.size) + 1 = ⟨1, lt1⟩ := by
    apply Fin.ext; simp only [Fin.add_def, Fin.val_one', hsz3]
  have s1 : (⟨1, lt1⟩ : Fin base.poly.size) + 1 = ⟨2, lt2⟩ := by
    apply Fin.ext; simp only [Fin.add_def, Fin.val_one', hsz3]
  have s2 : (⟨2, lt2⟩ : Fin base.poly.size) + 1 = ⟨0, lt0⟩ := by
    apply Fin.ext; simp only [Fin.add_def, Fin.val_one', hsz3]
  rintro ((h | h) | h)
  · rw [← w0, ← w1, ← s0] at h
    exact hg _ (Proof.MeshIntersectNoSelfAsm.eta_zero_on_segment _ _ _ h)
  · rw [← w1, ← w2, ← s1] at h
    exact hg _ (Proof.MeshIntersectNoSelfAsm.eta_zero_on_segment _ _ _ h)
  · rw [← w2, ← w0, ← s2] at h
    exact hg _ (Proof.MeshIntersectNoSelfAsm.eta_zero_on_segment _ _ _ h)

name: gen_Aprime_seg
statement:
theorem gen_Aprime_seg₁_pending {M₁ M₂ : Mesh} {Q : Point} (hG : Gen M₁ M₂ Q)
    (i : Fin M₁.size) (hQ : dotQ (carrierNormal M₁[i]) Q ≠ 0)
    {fa : Frag}
    (hfaClip : fa ∈ clipFaceScoped (fragOfFace ((materialize M₁).getD i.1 default))
        (planesForScoped ((materialize M₁).getD i.1 default).plane (materialize M₂)
          ((candP M₁ M₂).getD i.1 #[])))
    {opp : Array Frag}
    (hopp : opp = (splitCoplanar (Proof.MeshIntersectNsi.fragsBOf M₁ M₂) (materialize M₁)).1)
    {f : Frag} (hf : f ∈ Proof.MeshIntersectResolve.resolveFragPending fa opp) :
    ∀ (k : ℕ) (hk : k < M₂.size),
        coplanarPlane (faceSOf (M₂[k]'hk)).plane fa.plane = false →
        ∀ g ∈ Impl.Legacy.Sim.tetraHalves (M₂[k]'hk),
          g.eval ((detOrigin M₁[i] / dotQ (carrierNormal M₁[i]) Q) • Q) ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  
  have hgetD : (materialize M₁).getD i.1 default = faceSOf M₁[i] := by
    rw [getD_eq_getElem (materialize M₁) (by rw [materialize_size]; exact i.isLt) default,
      materialize_getElem M₁ i.1 i.isLt]; rfl
  have hfapl : fa.plane = (faceSOf M₁[i]).plane := by
    have := Proof.MeshIntersectNsi.clipFaceScoped_plane _ _ hfaClip
    rw [hgetD, fragOfFace] at this; simpa using this
  
  
  have hfPend : f ∈ pendDescA M₁ M₂ i.1 := by
    rw [pendDescA_eq]
    refine mem_flatMap_arr.mpr ⟨fa, hfaClip, ?_⟩
    rw [hopp] at hf; exact hf
  
  
  have hres := hG.2.2.2.2.2.2.2.2.2.2.2.2.2.2.2.1 i hQ f hfPend
  intro k hk hcop g hg
  exact hres ⟨k, hk⟩ (by rw [hfapl] at hcop; exact hcop) g hg

statement:
theorem gen_Aprime_seg₂_pending {M₁ M₂ : Mesh} {Q : Point} (hG : Gen M₁ M₂ Q)

    {fb : Frag}
    (hfbClip : fb ∈ clipFaceScoped (fragOfFace ((materialize M₂).getD j.1 default))
        (planesForScoped ((materialize M₂).getD j.1 default).plane (materialize M₁)
          ((candP M₂ M₁).getD j.1 #[])))
    {opp : Array Frag}
    (hopp : opp = (splitCoplanar (Proof.MeshIntersectNsi.fragsAOf M₁ M₂) (materialize M₂)).1)
    {f : Frag} (hf : f ∈ Proof.MeshIntersectResolve.resolveFragBPending fb opp) :
    ∀ (k : ℕ) (hk : k < M₁.size),
        coplanarPlane (faceSOf (M₁[k]'hk)).plane fb.plane = false →
        ∀ g ∈ Impl.Legacy.Sim.tetraHalves (M₁[k]'hk),
          g.eval ((detOrigin M₂[j] / dotQ (carrierNormal M₂[j]) Q) • Q) ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  have hgetD : (materialize M₂).getD j.1 default = faceSOf M₂[j] := by
    rw [getD_eq_getElem (materialize M₂) (by rw [materialize_size]; exact j.isLt) default,
      materialize_getElem M₂ j.1 j.isLt]; rfl
  have hfbpl : fb.plane = (faceSOf M₂[j]).plane := by
    have := Proof.MeshIntersectNsi.clipFaceScoped_plane _ _ hfbClip
    rw [hgetD, fragOfFace] at this; simpa using this
  have hfPend : f ∈ pendDescB M₁ M₂ j.1 := by
    rw [pendDescB_eq]
    refine mem_flatMap_arr.mpr ⟨fb, hfbClip, ?_⟩
    rw [hopp] at hf; exact hf

name: keptRegion_indicator_le_one
statement:
theorem keptRegion_indicator_le_one (L : List Frag) {p : Point}
    (hpw : L.Pairwise RelDisj)
    (hrel : ∀ f ∈ L, p ∈ Proof.MeshIntersectClip.vpoly (fragCycle f) → p ∈ Proof.MeshIntersectClip.vrelint (fragCycle f)) :
    (L.map (fun f => if p ∈ Proof.MeshIntersectClip.vpoly (fragCycle f) then (1 : ℤ) else 0)).sum ≤ 1
proof:
:= by
  classical
  induction L with
  | nil => simp
  | cons g t ih =>
    rw [List.map_cons, List.sum_cons]
    have hpwt : t.Pairwise RelDisj := (List.pairwise_cons.mp hpw).2
    have hrelt : ∀ f ∈ t, p ∈ Proof.MeshIntersectClip.vpoly (fragCycle f) → p ∈ Proof.MeshIntersectClip.vrelint (fragCycle f) :=
      fun f hf => hrel f (List.mem_cons_of_mem _ hf)
    by_cases hg : p ∈ Proof.MeshIntersectClip.vpoly (fragCycle g)
    · 
      rw [if_pos hg]
      have hgrel : p ∈ Proof.MeshIntersectClip.vrelint (fragCycle g) := hrel g (List.mem_cons_self _ _) hg
      have htail0 : (t.map (fun f => if p ∈ Proof.MeshIntersectClip.vpoly (fragCycle f) then (1 : ℤ) else 0)).sum = 0 := by
        have hz : ∀ f ∈ t, (if p ∈ Proof.MeshIntersectClip.vpoly (fragCycle f) then (1 : ℤ) else 0) = 0 := by
          intro f hf
          by_cases hfp : p ∈ Proof.MeshIntersectClip.vpoly (fragCycle f)
          · 
            have hgf : RelDisj g f := (List.pairwise_cons.mp hpw).1 f hf
            have hfrel : p ∈ Proof.MeshIntersectClip.vrelint (fragCycle f) := hrelt f hf hfp
            exact absurd (Set.eq_empty_iff_forall_not_mem.mp hgf p ⟨hgrel, hfrel⟩) (by simp)
          · rw [if_neg hfp]
        calc (t.map (fun f => if p ∈ Proof.MeshIntersectClip.vpoly (fragCycle f) then (1 : ℤ) else 0)).sum
            = (t.map (fun _ => (0 : ℤ))).sum := by
              apply congrArg List.sum; apply List.map_congr_left; exact hz
          _ = 0 := by simp
      linarith
    · rw [if_neg hg, zero_add]
      exact ih hpwt hrelt

name: cop_cell_relint_dichotomy
statement:
theorem cop_cell_relint_dichotomy (M₁ M₂ : Mesh)
    (h₁ : Legacy.WellFormedMesh M₁) (_h₂ : Legacy.WellFormedMesh M₂)
    {Q : Point} (hG : Gen M₁ M₂ Q) (i : Fin M₁.size)
    {fa : Frag}
    (hfaClip : fa ∈ clipFaceScoped (fragOfFace ((materialize M₁).getD i.1 default))
        (planesForScoped ((materialize M₁).getD i.1 default).plane (materialize M₂)
          ((candP M₁ M₂).getD i.1 #[])))
    {opp : Array Frag}
    (hopp : opp = (splitCoplanar (Proof.MeshIntersectNsi.fragsBOf M₁ M₂) (materialize M₁)).1)
    {bvh : Impl.BVH.BVH} {wOpp : Array PFace} {f : Frag}
    (hf : f ∈ resolveFrag bvh fa opp wOpp)
    (hpoly : Proof.MeshIntersectStep.faceHit M₁[i] Q
        ∈ Proof.MeshIntersectClip.vpoly (fragCycle f)) :
    Proof.MeshIntersectStep.faceHit M₁[i] Q
      ∈ Proof.MeshIntersectClip.vrelint (fragCycle f)
proof:
:= by
  have hdetA : detOrigin M₁[i] ≠ 0 := h₁.2.2.2 i
  
  have hgetD : (materialize M₁).getD i.1 default = faceSOf M₁[i] := by
    rw [getD_eq_getElem (materialize M₁) (by rw [materialize_size]; exact i.isLt) default,
      materialize_getElem M₁ i.1 i.isLt]; rfl
  
  have hinv₀ : FragInv (carrierNormal M₁[i]) (detOrigin M₁[i])
      (fragOfFace ((materialize M₁).getD i.1 default)) := by
    rw [hgetD]; exact Proof.MeshIntersectKeep.fragInv_base hdetA
  have hfaInv : FragInv (carrierNormal M₁[i]) (detOrigin M₁[i]) fa :=
    fragInv_clipFaceScoped hinv₀ _ hfaClip
  have hfInv : FragInv (carrierNormal M₁[i]) (detOrigin M₁[i]) f :=
    Proof.MeshIntersectResolve.resolveFrag_kept_fromFa _ _ _ hfaInv hf
  haveI := hfaInv.neZero
  haveI := hfInv.neZero
  
  have hfapl : fa.plane = (faceSOf M₁[i]).plane := by
    have := Proof.MeshIntersectNsi.clipFaceScoped_plane _ _ hfaClip
    rw [hgetD, fragOfFace] at this; simpa using this
  
  have hLopp : ∀ fb ∈ opp,
      coplanarPlane fa.plane fb.plane = true →
      ∀ g ∈ edgePlanesOf fb, g ∈ Proof.MeshIntersectFaceLedger.copEdgePlanes M₁ M₂ i.1 := by
    intro fb hfb hcop g hg
    rw [hopp] at hfb
    rw [Proof.MeshIntersectFaceLedger.copEdgePlanes, List.mem_flatMap]
    refine ⟨fb, ?_, ?_⟩
    · rw [Array.mem_toList, Array.mem_filter]
      refine ⟨hfb, ?_⟩
      rw [hgetD, ← hfapl]; exact hcop
    · exact Array.mem_toList.mpr hg
  have hfProv : FragProv (carrierNormal M₁[i]) (fragCycle fa)
      (Proof.MeshIntersectFaceLedger.copEdgePlanes M₁ M₂ i.1) f :=
    Proof.MeshIntersectNpo.resolveFrag_fragProv
      (nt := carrierNormal M₁[i]) (ct := detOrigin M₁[i])
      (w₀ := fragCycle fa) (L := Proof.MeshIntersectFaceLedger.copEdgePlanes M₁ M₂ i.1)
      _ _ _ hfaInv (Proof.MeshIntersectNpo.fragProv_self (carrierNormal M₁[i])) hLopp f hf
  
  have hP := gen_cop_avoidsLines hG i (hG.1 i) hfaClip
  
  show Proof.MeshIntersectStep.faceParam M₁[i] Q • Q
      ∈ Proof.MeshIntersectClip.vrelint (fragCycle f)
  rw [Proof.MeshIntersectStep.faceParam]
  refine (vrelint_or_not_vpoly_of_avoids hfInv hfProv hP).resolve_right
    (not_not_intro ?_)
  show Proof.MeshIntersectStep.faceHit M₁[i] Q ∈ Proof.MeshIntersectClip.vpoly (fragCycle f)
  exact hpoly

name: cop_cell_relint_dichotomyB
statement:
theorem cop_cell_relint_dichotomyB (M₁ M₂ : Mesh)
    (_h₁ : Legacy.WellFormedMesh M₁) (h₂ : Legacy.WellFormedMesh M₂)
    {Q : Point} (hG : Gen M₁ M₂ Q) (j : Fin M₂.size)
    {fb : Frag}
    (hfbClip : fb ∈ clipFaceScoped (fragOfFace ((materialize M₂).getD j.1 default))
        (planesForScoped ((materialize M₂).getD j.1 default).plane (materialize M₁)
          ((candP M₂ M₁).getD j.1 #[])))
    {opp : Array Frag}
    (hopp : opp = (splitCoplanar (Proof.MeshIntersectNsi.fragsAOf M₁ M₂) (materialize M₂)).1)
    {bvh : Impl.BVH.BVH} {wOpp : Array PFace} {f : Frag}
    (hf : f ∈ resolveCoplanar.resolveFragB bvh fb opp wOpp)
    (hpoly : Proof.MeshIntersectStep.faceHit M₂[j] Q
        ∈ Proof.MeshIntersectClip.vpoly (fragCycle f)) :
    Proof.MeshIntersectStep.faceHit M₂[j] Q
      ∈ Proof.MeshIntersectClip.vrelint (fragCycle f)
proof:
:= by
  have hdetB : detOrigin M₂[j] ≠ 0 := h₂.2.2.2 j
  have hgetD : (materialize M₂).getD j.1 default = faceSOf M₂[j] := by
    rw [getD_eq_getElem (materialize M₂) (by rw [materialize_size]; exact j.isLt) default,
      materialize_getElem M₂ j.1 j.isLt]; rfl
  have hinv₀ : FragInv (carrierNormal M₂[j]) (detOrigin M₂[j])
      (fragOfFace ((materialize M₂).getD j.1 default)) := by
    rw [hgetD]; exact Proof.MeshIntersectKeep.fragInv_base hdetB
  have hfbInv : FragInv (carrierNormal M₂[j]) (detOrigin M₂[j]) fb :=
    fragInv_clipFaceScoped hinv₀ _ hfbClip
  have hfInv : FragInv (carrierNormal M₂[j]) (detOrigin M₂[j]) f :=
    Proof.MeshIntersectResolve.resolveFragB_kept_fromFb _ _ _ hfbInv hf
  haveI := hfbInv.neZero
  haveI := hfInv.neZero
  have hfbpl : fb.plane = (faceSOf M₂[j]).plane := by
    have := Proof.MeshIntersectNsi.clipFaceScoped_plane _ _ hfbClip
    rw [hgetD, fragOfFace] at this; simpa using this
  have hLopp : ∀ fa ∈ opp,
      coplanarPlane fb.plane fa.plane = true →
      ∀ g ∈ edgePlanesOf fa, g ∈ Proof.MeshIntersectFaceLedger.copEdgePlanesB M₁ M₂ j.1 := by
    intro fa hfa hcop g hg
    rw [hopp] at hfa
    rw [Proof.MeshIntersectFaceLedger.copEdgePlanesB, List.mem_flatMap]
    refine ⟨fa, ?_, ?_⟩
    · rw [Array.mem_toList, Array.mem_filter]
      refine ⟨hfa, ?_⟩
      rw [hgetD, ← hfbpl]; exact hcop
    · exact Array.mem_toList.mpr hg
  have hfProv : FragProv (carrierNormal M₂[j]) (fragCycle fb)
      (Proof.MeshIntersectFaceLedger.copEdgePlanesB M₁ M₂ j.1) f :=
    Proof.MeshIntersectNpo.resolveFragB_fragProv
      (nt := carrierNormal M₂[j]) (ct := detOrigin M₂[j])
      (w₀ := fragCycle fb) (L := Proof.MeshIntersectFaceLedger.copEdgePlanesB M₁ M₂ j.1)
      _ _ _ hfbInv (Proof.MeshIntersectNpo.fragProv_self (carrierNormal M₂[j])) hLopp f hf
  have hP := gen_cop_avoidsLinesB hG j (hG.2.1 j) hfbClip
  show Proof.MeshIntersectStep.faceParam M₂[j] Q • Q
      ∈ Proof.MeshIntersectClip.vrelint (fragCycle f)
  rw [Proof.MeshIntersectStep.faceParam]
  refine (vrelint_or_not_vpoly_of_avoids hfInv hfProv hP).resolve_right
    (not_not_intro ?_)
  show Proof.MeshIntersectStep.faceHit M₂[j] Q ∈ Proof.MeshIntersectClip.vpoly (fragCycle f)
  exact hpoly

name: fdiv_neg_neg
statement:
theorem fdiv_neg_neg : ∀ (N D : ℤ), Int.fdiv N D = Int.fdiv (-N) (-D)
  | 0, d => by cases d <;> simp [Int.fdiv]
  | Int.ofNat (n + 1), Int.ofNat 0 => by simp [Int.fdiv_zero]
  | Int.ofNat (n + 1), Int.ofNat (d + 1) => by
      show Int.fdiv (Int.ofNat (n + 1)) (Int.ofNat (d + 1))
        = Int.fdiv (Int.negSucc n) (Int.negSucc d)
      simp [Int.fdiv]
  | Int.ofNat (n + 1), Int.negSucc d => by
      show Int.fdiv (Int.ofNat (n + 1)) (Int.negSucc d)
        = Int.fdiv (Int.negSucc n) (Int.ofNat (d + 1))
      simp [Int.fdiv]
  | Int.negSucc n, Int.ofNat 0 => by simp [Int.fdiv_zero]
  | Int.negSucc n, Int.ofNat (d + 1) => by
      show Int.fdiv (Int.negSucc n) (Int.ofNat (d + 1))
        = Int.fdiv (Int.ofNat (n + 1)) (Int.negSucc d)
      simp [Int.fdiv]
  | Int.negSucc n, Int.negSucc d => by
      show Int.fdiv (Int.negSucc n) (Int.negSucc d)
        = Int.fdiv (Int.ofNat (n + 1)) (Int.ofNat (d + 1))
      simp [Int.fdiv]

/
(including `0` and negatives — the corpus' `fdiv_eq_floor` needs `0 < D`). -/

name: fdiv_add_fdiv_neg_le
statement: theorem fdiv_add_fdiv_neg_le (N D : ℤ) : Int.fdiv N D + Int.fdiv (-N) D ≤ 0
proof:
:= by
  rcases lt_trichotomy D 0 with hD | hD | hD
  · rw [fdiv_neg_neg N D, fdiv_neg_neg (-N) D, neg_neg]
    have h1 := Int.fdiv_add_fmod (-N) (-D)
    have h2 := Int.fdiv_add_fmod N (-D)
    have b1 : 0 ≤ Int.fmod (-N) (-D) := Int.fmod_nonneg' (-N) (by omega)
    have b2 : 0 ≤ Int.fmod N (-D) := Int.fmod_nonneg' N (by omega)
    have c1 : Int.fmod (-N) (-D) < -D := Int.fmod_lt_of_pos (-N) (by omega)
    have c2 : Int.fmod N (-D) < -D := Int.fmod_lt_of_pos N (by omega)
    nlinarith [h1, h2, b1, b2, c1, c2]
  · subst hD; simp [Int.fdiv_zero]
  · have h1 := Int.fdiv_add_fmod N D
    have h2 := Int.fdiv_add_fmod (-N) D
    have b1 : 0 ≤ Int.fmod N D := Int.fmod_nonneg' N hD
    have b2 : 0 ≤ Int.fmod (-N) D := Int.fmod_nonneg' (-N) hD
    have c1 : Int.fmod N D < D := Int.fmod_lt_of_pos N hD
    have c2 : Int.fmod (-N) D < D := Int.fmod_lt_of_pos (-N) hD
    nlinarith [h1, h2, b1, b2, c1, c2]

name: dyFloor_le_dyCeil
statement: theorem dyFloor_le_dyCeil (n d e : ℤ) : dyFloor n d e ≤ dyCeil n d e
proof:
:= by
  unfold dyCeil dyFloor
  split
  · have := fdiv_add_fdiv_neg_le n (d * 2 ^ e.toNat); omega
  · have := fdiv_add_fdiv_neg_le (n * 2 ^ (-e).toNat) d
    rw [show (-n) * 2 ^ (-e).toNat = -(n * 2 ^ (-e).toNat) by ring]
    omega

name: daxisParamND_ok
statement:
theorem daxisParamND_ok (dα : ℚ) (xn xd : ℤ) (a : ℚ) (e : ℤ) :
    DParamOK (daxisParamND dα xn xd a e)
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · unfold daxisParamND
    dsimp only
    split
    · exact dyFloor_le_dyCeil _ _ _
    · exact dyFloor_le_dyCeil _ _ _
  · intro hz
    by_cases hdn : dα.num = 0
    · exfalso
      rw [show daxisParamND dα xn xd a e
          = { zero := true, sgnDd := 0, absDn := 0,
              xlo := dyFloor (xn * (a.den : ℤ) - a.num * xd) ((a.den : ℤ) * xd) e,
              xhi := dyCeil (xn * (a.den : ℤ) - a.num * xd) ((a.den : ℤ) * xd) e } from by
        unfold daxisParamND; simp only [hdn, if_pos]] at hz
      exact absurd hz (by simp)
    · rw [show (daxisParamND dα xn xd a e).absDn = (if dα.num < 0 then -dα.num else dα.num) from by
        unfold daxisParamND; simp only [hdn, if_neg, if_false]]
      rcases lt_trichotomy dα.num 0 with h | h | h
      · rw [if_pos h]; omega
      · exact absurd h hdn
      · rw [if_neg (by omega)]; omega

name: mtreeQuery_mem_pred
statement:
theorem mtreeQuery_mem_pred (mbs : Array MBox) (P : MBox → Bool) :
    ∀ (t : Impl.BVH.Tree) (acc : Array ℕ) (k : ℕ),
      k ∈ mtreeQuery mbs P t acc → k ∈ acc ∨ P (mbs.getD k default) = true
proof:
:= by
  intro t
  induction t with
  | leaf j b =>
    intro acc k hk
    simp only [mtreeQuery] at hk
    by_cases hP : P (mbs.getD j default) = true
    · rw [if_pos hP] at hk
      rcases Array.mem_push.mp hk with h | h
      · exact Or.inl h
      · subst h; exact Or.inr hP
    · rw [if_neg hP] at hk
      exact Or.inl hk
  | node b l r ihl ihr =>
    intro acc k hk
    simp only [mtreeQuery] at hk
    split at hk
    · rcases ihr _ k hk with h | h
      · rcases ihl _ k h with h' | h'
        · exact Or.inl h'
        · exact Or.inr h'
      · exact Or.inr h
    · exact Or.inl hk

name: mtreeQuery_mem_iff
statement:
theorem mtreeQuery_mem_iff (mbs : Array MBox) (P : MBox → Bool)
    (hmono : ∀ m m', MSubbox m m' → P m = true → P m' = true)
    (t : Impl.BVH.Tree) (k : ℕ) :
    k ∈ mtreeQuery mbs P t #[] ↔ (k ∈ t.leaves ∧ P (mbs.getD k default) = true)
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro hk
    refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
    · rcases mtreeQuery_mem_leaves mbs P t #[] k hk with h | h
      · simp at h
      · exact h
    · rcases mtreeQuery_mem_pred mbs P t #[] k hk with h | h
      · simp at h
      · exact h
  · rintro ⟨hl, hP⟩
    exact mtreeQuery_sound mbs P hmono t #[] k hl hP

name: mtreeQuery_perm
statement:
theorem mtreeQuery_perm (mbs : Array MBox) (P : MBox → Bool)
    (hmono : ∀ m m', MSubbox m m' → P m = true → P m' = true)
    {t₁ t₂ : Impl.BVH.Tree} (hnd₁ : t₁.leaves.Nodup) (hnd₂ : t₂.leaves.Nodup)
    (hperm : t₁.leaves.Perm t₂.leaves) :
    (mtreeQuery mbs P t₁ #[]).toList.Perm (mtreeQuery mbs P t₂ #[]).toList
proof:
:= by
  refine (List.perm_ext_iff_of_nodup
    (mtreeQuery_nodup mbs P t₁ #[] hnd₁ (by simp) (by simp))
    (mtreeQuery_nodup mbs P t₂ #[] hnd₂ (by simp) (by simp))).mpr (fun a => ?_)
  rw [Array.mem_toList, Array.mem_toList, mtreeQuery_mem_iff mbs P hmono,
    mtreeQuery_mem_iff mbs P hmono]
  exact ⟨fun ⟨h1, h2⟩ => ⟨hperm.mem_iff.mp h1, h2⟩,
    fun ⟨h1, h2⟩ => ⟨hperm.mem_iff.mpr h1, h2⟩⟩

name: mrayMeetsBoxFwdAx_mono
statement:
theorem mrayMeetsBoxFwdAx_mono (px py pz : DAxisParam) (axis : ℕ) (pos : Bool)
    {m m' : MBox} (hsub : MSubbox m m')
    (h : mrayMeetsBoxFwdAx px py pz axis pos m = true) :
    mrayMeetsBoxFwdAx px py pz axis pos m' = true
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨s1, s2, s3, s4, s5, s6⟩ := hsub
  simp only [mrayMeetsBoxFwdAx, mlineMeetsBoxAx, maxLo, maxHi, Bool.and_eq_true,
    Bool.or_eq_true, decide_eq_true_eq, beq_iff_eq] at h ⊢
  by_cases ha0 : axis = 0
  · subst ha0; cases pos <;> simp_all <;> omega
  · by_cases ha1 : axis = 1
    · subst ha1; cases pos <;> simp_all <;> omega
    · cases pos <;> simp_all <;> omega

name: rayQueryFwd_goAx_eq
statement:
theorem rayQueryFwd_goAx_eq (h : BVH) (mbs : Array MBox) (px py pz : DAxisParam)
    (axis : ℕ) (pos : Bool) :
    ∀ (t : Impl.BVH.Tree) (base fuel : ℕ) (acc : Array ℕ),
      Agrees h.nodes mbs base t → t.size ≤ fuel →
      rayQueryFwdGoAx h px py pz axis pos base fuel acc
        = mtreeQuery mbs (mrayMeetsBoxFwdAx px py pz axis pos) t acc
proof:
:= by
  intro t
  induction t with
  | leaf k b =>
    intro base fuel acc hag hfuel
    cases fuel with
    | zero => simp [Impl.BVH.Tree.size] at hfuel
    | succ fuel' =>
      rw [rayQueryFwdGoAx, agrees_root hag]
      simp only [mtreeQuery, rootNodeM]
      cases hov : mrayMeetsBoxFwdAx px py pz axis pos (mbs.getD k default) <;> simp
  | node b l r ihl ihr =>
    intro base fuel acc hag hfuel
    cases fuel with
    | zero => simp only [Impl.BVH.Tree.size] at hfuel; omega
    | succ fuel' =>
      rw [rayQueryFwdGoAx, agrees_root hag]
      simp only [mtreeQuery, rootNodeM, mboxOfTree]
      have hsl : l.size ≤ fuel' := by simp only [Impl.BVH.Tree.size] at hfuel; omega
      have hsr : r.size ≤ fuel' := by simp only [Impl.BVH.Tree.size] at hfuel; omega
      by_cases hov : mrayMeetsBoxFwdAx px py pz axis pos
          (munion (mboxOfTree mbs l) (mboxOfTree mbs r)) = true
      · simp only [hov, Bool.not_true, Bool.false_eq_true, if_false, if_true]
        rw [ihl (base + 1) fuel' acc (agrees_left hag) hsl]
        rw [ihr (base + 1 + l.size) fuel' _ (agrees_right hag) hsr]
      · simp only [Bool.not_eq_true] at hov; simp [hov]
