name: goFwd_sentinel
statement:
theorem goFwd_sentinel (h : BVH) (hn : h.nodes = sentinelNodes) (px py pz : DAxisParam) :
    rayQueryFwdGo h px py pz 0 h.nodes.size #[] = #[]
proof:
:= by
  have hgo1 : ∀ acc : Array ℕ, rayQueryFwdGo h px py pz 1 0 acc = acc := by
    intro acc; rw [rayQueryFwdGo]
  have hsz : h.nodes.size = 1 := by rw [hn]; rfl
  have hget : h.nodes[0]? = some (⟨default, default, false, 0, 0, 1, 1⟩ : Node) := by
    rw [hn]; rfl
  rw [hsz, rayQueryFwdGo, hget]
  simp only []
  by_cases hov : mrayLineMeetsBoxFwd px py pz (default : MBox) = true
  · simp only [hov, Bool.not_true, Bool.false_eq_true, if_false]
    rw [hgo1, hgo1]
  · simp only [Bool.not_eq_true] at hov
    simp only [hov, Bool.not_false, if_true]

name: goAxFwd_sentinel
statement:
theorem goAxFwd_sentinel (h : BVH) (hn : h.nodes = sentinelNodes) (px py pz : DAxisParam)
    (axis : ℕ) (pos : Bool) :
    rayQueryFwdGoAx h px py pz axis pos 0 h.nodes.size #[] = #[]
proof:
:= by
  have hgo1 : ∀ acc : Array ℕ, rayQueryFwdGoAx h px py pz axis pos 1 0 acc = acc := by
    intro acc; rw [rayQueryFwdGoAx]
  have hsz : h.nodes.size = 1 := by rw [hn]; rfl
  have hget : h.nodes[0]? = some (⟨default, default, false, 0, 0, 1, 1⟩ : Node) := by
    rw [hn]; rfl
  rw [hsz, rayQueryFwdGoAx, hget]
  simp only []
  by_cases hov : mrayMeetsBoxFwdAx px py pz axis pos (default : MBox) = true
  · simp only [hov, Bool.not_true, Bool.false_eq_true, if_false]
    rw [hgo1, hgo1]
  · simp only [Bool.not_eq_true] at hov
    simp only [hov, Bool.not_false, if_true]

name: mbs_eq
statement:
theorem mbs_eq (bs : Array Box) :
    bs.map (mboxOfBox (buildBVH bs).ax (buildBVH bs).ay (buildBVH bs).az (buildBVH bs).ce)
      = bs.map (mboxOfBox (buildBVHM bs).ax (buildBVHM bs).ay (buildBVHM bs).az
          (buildBVHM bs).ce)
proof:
:= by
  rw [bvh_ax_eq, bvh_ay_eq, bvh_az_eq, bvh_ce_eq]

name: goFwd_perm
statement:
theorem goFwd_perm (bs : Array Box) (px py pz : DAxisParam)
    (hpx : DParamOK px) (hpy : DParamOK py) (hpz : DParamOK pz) :
    (rayQueryFwdGo (buildBVH bs) px py pz 0 (buildBVH bs).nodes.size #[]).toList.Perm
      (rayQueryFwdGo (buildBVHM bs) px py pz 0 (buildBVHM bs).nodes.size #[]).toList
proof:
:= by
  rcases Nat.eq_zero_or_pos bs.size with hz | hpos
  · have h1 : (buildBVH bs).nodes = sentinelNodes := buildBVHFast_nodes_empty bs hz
    rw [goFwd_sentinel _ h1, goFwd_sentinel _ (buildBVHM_nodes_empty bs hz)]
  · have hb1 : Built (buildBVH bs) bs _ := buildBVHFast_built bs hpos
    have hb2 := buildBVHM_built bs hpos
    rw [rayQueryFwd_go_eq (buildBVH bs) _ px py pz _ 0 _ #[] hb1.agrees hb1.fuel,
      rayQueryFwd_go_eq (buildBVHM bs) _ px py pz _ 0 _ #[] hb2.agrees hb2.fuel]
    rw [show bs.map (mboxOfBox (buildBVH bs).ax (buildBVH bs).ay (buildBVH bs).az
        (buildBVH bs).ce) = bs.map (mboxOfBox (buildBVHM bs).ax (buildBVHM bs).ay
        (buildBVHM bs).az (buildBVHM bs).ce) from mbs_eq bs]
    refine mtreeQuery_perm _ _ (fun m m' hs hp =>
      mrayLineMeetsBoxFwd_mono hpx hpy hpz hs hp) ?_ ?_ ?_
    · exact hb1.hperm.nodup_iff.mpr (List.nodup_range _)
    · exact hb2.hperm.nodup_iff.mpr (List.nodup_range _)
    · exact hb1.hperm.trans hb2.hperm.symm

name: goAxFwd_perm
statement:
theorem goAxFwd_perm (bs : Array Box) (px py pz : DAxisParam) (axis : ℕ) (pos : Bool) :
    (rayQueryFwdGoAx (buildBVH bs) px py pz axis pos 0
        (buildBVH bs).nodes.size #[]).toList.Perm
      (rayQueryFwdGoAx (buildBVHM bs) px py pz axis pos 0
        (buildBVHM bs).nodes.size #[]).toList
proof:
:= by
  rcases Nat.eq_zero_or_pos bs.size with hz | hpos
  · have h1 : (buildBVH bs).nodes = sentinelNodes := buildBVHFast_nodes_empty bs hz
    rw [goAxFwd_sentinel _ h1, goAxFwd_sentinel _ (buildBVHM_nodes_empty bs hz)]
  · have hb1 : Built (buildBVH bs) bs _ := buildBVHFast_built bs hpos
    have hb2 := buildBVHM_built bs hpos
    rw [rayQueryFwd_goAx_eq (buildBVH bs) _ px py pz axis pos _ 0 _ #[] hb1.agrees hb1.fuel,
      rayQueryFwd_goAx_eq (buildBVHM bs) _ px py pz axis pos _ 0 _ #[] hb2.agrees hb2.fuel]
    rw [show bs.map (mboxOfBox (buildBVH bs).ax (buildBVH bs).ay (buildBVH bs).az
        (buildBVH bs).ce) = bs.map (mboxOfBox (buildBVHM bs).ax (buildBVHM bs).ay
        (buildBVHM bs).az (buildBVHM bs).ce) from mbs_eq bs]
    refine mtreeQuery_perm _ _ (fun m m' hs hp =>
      mrayMeetsBoxFwdAx_mono px py pz axis pos hs hp) ?_ ?_ ?_
    · exact hb1.hperm.nodup_iff.mpr (List.nodup_range _)
    · exact hb2.hperm.nodup_iff.mpr (List.nodup_range _)
    · exact hb1.hperm.trans hb2.hperm.symm

name: boxQuery_perm
statement:
theorem boxQuery_perm (bs : Array Box) (q : Box) :
    (boxQuery (buildBVH bs) q).toList.Perm (boxQuery (buildBVHM bs) q).toList
proof:
:= by
  rcases Nat.eq_zero_or_pos bs.size with hz | hpos
  · rw [boxQuery_empty bs hz, boxQueryM_empty bs hz]
  · have hb1 : Built (buildBVH bs) bs _ := buildBVHFast_built bs hpos
    have hb2 := buildBVHM_built bs hpos
    rw [hb1.boxQuery_eq q, hb2.boxQuery_eq q]
    rw [show mboxQ (buildBVH bs) q = mboxQ (buildBVHM bs) q by
      unfold mboxQ
      rw [bvh_ax_eq, bvh_ay_eq, bvh_az_eq, bvh_ce_eq]]
    rw [show bs.map (mboxOfBox (buildBVH bs).ax (buildBVH bs).ay (buildBVH bs).az
        (buildBVH bs).ce) = bs.map (mboxOfBox (buildBVHM bs).ax (buildBVHM bs).ay
        (buildBVHM bs).az (buildBVHM bs).ce) from mbs_eq bs]
    refine mtreeQuery_perm _ _ (fun m m' hs hp => moverlap_mono_right _ hs hp) ?_ ?_ ?_
    · exact hb1.hperm.nodup_iff.mpr (List.nodup_range _)
    · exact hb2.hperm.nodup_iff.mpr (List.nodup_range _)
    · exact hb1.hperm.trans hb2.hperm.symm

name: rayQueryFwd_perm
statement:
theorem rayQueryFwd_perm (bs : Array Box) (x d : Pt) :
    (rayQueryFwd (buildBVH bs) x d).toList.Perm (rayQueryFwd (buildBVHM bs) x d).toList
proof:
:= by
  rw [rayQueryFwd_eq_go (buildBVH bs) x d, rayQueryFwd_eq_go (buildBVHM bs) x d,
    bvh_ax_eq, bvh_ay_eq, bvh_az_eq, bvh_ce_eq]
  exact goFwd_perm bs _ _ _ (daxisParam_ok _ _ _ _) (daxisParam_ok _ _ _ _)
    (daxisParam_ok _ _ _ _)

name: rayQueryFwdND_perm
statement:
theorem rayQueryFwdND_perm (bs : Array Box) (xn yn zn xw : ℤ) (d : Pt) :
    (rayQueryFwdND (buildBVH bs) xn yn zn xw d).toList.Perm
      (rayQueryFwdND (buildBVHM bs) xn yn zn xw d).toList

  unfold rayQueryFwdND
  rw [bvh_ax_eq, bvh_ay_eq, bvh_az_eq, bvh_ce_eq]

  | none =>

name: foldOpt_none
statement:
theorem foldOpt_none (f : ℕ → Option ℤ) :
    ∀ l : List ℕ, l.foldl (fun acc i =>
      match acc with
      | none => none
      | some s => match f i with | none => none | some c => some (s + c)) none = none
proof:
:= by
  intro l
  induction l with
  | nil => rfl
  | cons a t ih => exact ih

name: foldOpt_eq
statement:
theorem foldOpt_eq (f : ℕ → Option ℤ) :
    ∀ (l : List ℕ) (init : ℤ), l.foldl (fun acc i =>
        match acc with
        | none => none
        | some s => match f i with | none => none | some c => some (s + c)) (some init)
      = if (∀ i ∈ l, (f i).isSome = true)
        then some (init + (l.map (fun i => (f i).getD 0)).sum) else none
proof:
:= by
  classical
  intro l
  induction l with
  | nil => intro init; simp
  | cons a t ih =>
    intro init
    rw [List.foldl_cons]
    rcases hfa : f a with _ | c
    · simp only [hfa]
      rw [foldOpt_none, if_neg]
      intro h
      have := h a (List.mem_cons_self a t)
      rw [hfa] at this
      exact Bool.false_ne_true this
    · simp only [hfa]
      rw [ih (init + c)]
      by_cases hall : ∀ i ∈ t, (f i).isSome = true
      · rw [if_pos hall, if_pos (fun i hi => by
          rcases List.mem_cons.mp hi with rfl | hi'
          · rw [hfa]; rfl
          · exact hall i hi')]
        simp only [List.map_cons, List.sum_cons, hfa, Option.getD_some]
        ring_nf
      · rw [if_neg hall, if_neg (fun h => hall (fun i hi => h i (List.mem_cons_of_mem a hi)))]

name: foldOpt_perm
statement:
theorem foldOpt_perm (f : ℕ → Option ℤ) {l₁ l₂ : List ℕ} (hp : l₁.Perm l₂) (init : ℤ) :
    l₁.foldl (fun acc i =>
        match acc with
        | none => none
        | some s => match f i with | none => none | some c => some (s + c)) (some init)
      = l₂.foldl (fun acc i =>
        match acc with
        | none => none
        | some s => match f i with | none => none | some c => some (s + c)) (some init)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  rw [foldOpt_eq f l₁ init, foldOpt_eq f l₂ init]
  have hmem : (∀ i ∈ l₁, (f i).isSome = true) ↔ (∀ i ∈ l₂, (f i).isSome = true) :=
    ⟨fun h i hi => h i (hp.mem_iff.mpr hi), fun h i hi => h i (hp.mem_iff.mp hi)⟩
  have hsum : (l₁.map (fun i => (f i).getD 0)).sum = (l₂.map (fun i => (f i).getD 0)).sum :=
    (hp.map _).sum_eq
  split_ifs with h1 h2 h2
  · rw [hsum]
  · exact absurd (hmem.mp h1) h2
  · exact absurd (hmem.mpr h2) h1
  · rfl

name: isZeroI_nrmI_eq
statement:
theorem isZeroI_nrmI_eq (M : Mesh) (j : ℕ) (hj : j < M.size) :
    isZeroI ((prepare (materialize M)).getD j default).nrmI
      = isZeroS (crossS (psubS (ofPoint (M[j]'hj).v₁) (ofPoint (M[j]'hj).v₀))
          (psubS (ofPoint (M[j]'hj).v₂) (ofPoint (M[j]'hj).v₀)))
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨-, -, -, hh0, hh1, hh2, hnrm, -⟩ :=
    Proof.MeshIntersectRayClassifyFound.prepare_getD_fields M j hj
  set f := (prepare (materialize M)).getD j default with hf
  set t := M[j]'hj with ht
  
  have r0 : repr4 f.h0 t.v₀ := by
    rw [hh0]; have := toH4_repr (ofPoint t.v₀); rwa [ofPoint_toPoint] at this
  have r1 : repr4 f.h1 t.v₁ := by
    rw [hh1]; have := toH4_repr (ofPoint t.v₁); rwa [ofPoint_toPoint] at this
  have r2 : repr4 f.h2 t.v₂ := by
    rw [hh2]; have := toH4_repr (ofPoint t.v₂); rwa [ofPoint_toPoint] at this
  
  have hmul : i3Q f.nrmI
      = ((f.h1.w * f.h0.w * (f.h2.w * f.h0.w) : ℤ) : ℚ) • crossQ (t.v₁ - t.v₀) (t.v₂ - t.v₀) := by
    rw [hnrm]; exact Proof.MeshIntersectPlaneH.i3Q_nrmI r0 r1 r2
  have hpos : (0 : ℚ) < ((f.h1.w * f.h0.w * (f.h2.w * f.h0.w) : ℤ) : ℚ) := by
    have p0 := r0.1
    have p1 := r1.1
    have p2 := r2.1
    have : (0 : ℤ) < f.h1.w * f.h0.w * (f.h2.w * f.h0.w) := by positivity
    exact_mod_cast this
  
  have hcross : P3.toPoint (crossS (psubS (ofPoint t.v₁) (ofPoint t.v₀))
      (psubS (ofPoint t.v₂) (ofPoint t.v₀))) = crossQ (t.v₁ - t.v₀) (t.v₂ - t.v₀) := by
    rw [crossS_toPoint, psubS_toPoint, psubS_toPoint, ofPoint_toPoint, ofPoint_toPoint,
      ofPoint_toPoint]
    rfl
  
  have hI : isZeroI f.nrmI = true ↔ crossQ (t.v₁ - t.v₀) (t.v₂ - t.v₀) = 0 := by
    rw [Proof.MeshIntersectAtomize.isZeroI_iff, hmul, smul_eq_zero]
    constructor
    · rintro (h | h)
      · exact absurd h (ne_of_gt hpos)
      · exact h
    · exact fun h => Or.inr h
  have hS : isZeroS (crossS (psubS (ofPoint t.v₁) (ofPoint t.v₀))
      (psubS (ofPoint t.v₂) (ofPoint t.v₀))) = true
      ↔ crossQ (t.v₁ - t.v₀) (t.v₂ - t.v₀) = 0 := by
    rw [← hcross]
    set N := crossS (psubS (ofPoint t.v₁) (ofPoint t.v₀))
      (psubS (ofPoint t.v₂) (ofPoint t.v₀)) with hN
    simp only [isZeroS, Bool.and_eq_true, beq_iff_eq]
    constructor
    · rintro ⟨⟨hx0, hy0⟩, hz0⟩
      funext k
      fin_cases k <;> simp [P3.toPoint, Impl.Legacy.Sim.mkPoint, hx0, hy0, hz0]
    · intro h
      refine ⟨⟨?_, ?_⟩, ?_⟩
      · have := congrFun h 0; simpa [P3.toPoint, Impl.Legacy.Sim.mkPoint] using this
      · have := congrFun h 1; simpa [P3.toPoint, Impl.Legacy.Sim.mkPoint] using this
      · have := congrFun h 2; simpa [P3.toPoint, Impl.Legacy.Sim.mkPoint] using this
  rw [Bool.eq_iff_iff, hI, hS]

name: checkNonDegeneratePre_eq
statement:
theorem checkNonDegeneratePre_eq (M : Mesh) :
    checkNonDegeneratePre (prepOf M).W = checkNonDegenerate M
proof:
:= by
  show checkNonDegeneratePre (prepare (materialize M)) = checkNonDegenerate M
  have hsz : (prepare (materialize M)).size = M.size :=
    Proof.MeshIntersectRayClassifyFound.prepare_size M
  unfold checkNonDegeneratePre checkNonDegenerate
  rw [Bool.eq_iff_iff, Array.all_eq_true, Array.all_eq_true]
  constructor
  · intro h i
    have hi : i.1 < (prepare (materialize M)).size := by rw [hsz]; exact i.2
    have hkey := isZeroI_nrmI_eq M i.1 i.2
    rw [Proof.MeshIntersectKeep.arr_getD _ _ default hi] at hkey
    have h2 : (!isZeroI ((prepare (materialize M))[i.1]'hi).nrmI) = true := h ⟨i.1, hi⟩
    rw [hkey] at h2
    exact h2
  · intro h i
    have hi : i.1 < M.size := by rw [← hsz]; exact i.2
    have hkey := isZeroI_nrmI_eq M i.1 hi
    rw [Proof.MeshIntersectKeep.arr_getD _ _ default i.2] at hkey
    have h2 : (!isZeroS (crossS (psubS (ofPoint (M[i.1]'hi).v₁) (ofPoint (M[i.1]'hi).v₀))
        (psubS (ofPoint (M[i.1]'hi).v₂) (ofPoint (M[i.1]'hi).v₀)))) = true := h ⟨i.1, hi⟩
    rw [← hkey] at h2
    exact h2

name: cstep_map
statement:
theorem cstep_map (o : P3) (a₀ b₀ c₀ : P3) (poly : Array Vtx)
    (signs : Array Int) (r : Nat) (hr : r = poly.size)
    (hfaith : ∀ v ∈ poly, VtxFaithful v)
    (st : Array Vtx × Array Vtx) (i : Nat) (hi : i < r) :
    cstep (iFacePlaneP (psubS a₀ o) (psubS b₀ o) (psubS c₀ o)) (poly.map (trVtx o))
        signs r (mapSt o st) i
    = mapSt o (cstep (iFacePlaneP a₀ b₀ c₀) poly signs r st i)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨pV, nV⟩ := st
  have hisz : i < poly.size := hr ▸ hi
  have hrpos : 0 < r := Nat.lt_of_le_of_lt (Nat.zero_le i) hi
  have hi1sz : (i + 1) % r < poly.size := hr ▸ Nat.mod_lt _ hrpos
  have hAf : VtxFaithful (poly.getD i default) := hfaith _ (getD_mem poly i hisz default)
  have hBf : VtxFaithful (poly.getD ((i + 1) % r) default) :=
    hfaith _ (getD_mem poly _ hi1sz default)
  have haGet : (poly.map (trVtx o)).getD i default = trVtx o (poly.getD i default) :=
    map_getD_lt _ _ _ hisz _ _
  have hbGet : (poly.map (trVtx o)).getD ((i + 1) % r) default
             = trVtx o (poly.getD ((i + 1) % r) default) := map_getD_lt _ _ _ hi1sz _ _
  have hcut : cutVtx (iFacePlaneP (psubS a₀ o) (psubS b₀ o) (psubS c₀ o))
                (trVtx o (poly.getD i default)) (trVtx o (poly.getD ((i + 1) % r) default))
            = trVtx o (cutVtx (iFacePlaneP a₀ b₀ c₀) (poly.getD i default)
                (poly.getD ((i + 1) % r) default)) :=
    cutVtx_tr o a₀ b₀ c₀ _ _ hAf hBf
  simp only [cstep, mapSt, haGet, hbGet, hcut]
  split_ifs <;> simp [Array.map_push]

name: cwalkP_tr
statement:
theorem cwalkP_tr (o : P3) (a b c : P3) (poly : Array Vtx)
    (signs : Array Int) (hf : ∀ v ∈ poly, VtxFaithful v) :
    cwalkP (iFacePlaneP (psubS a o) (psubS b o) (psubS c o)) (poly.map (trVtx o)) signs
      = mapSt o (cwalkP (iFacePlaneP a b c) poly signs)
proof:
:= by
  simp only [cwalkP, Array.size_map]
  have hinit : mapSt o ((#[], #[]) :
      Array Vtx × Array Vtx) = (#[], #[]) := by
    simp [mapSt]
  rw [← Array.foldl_toList, ← Array.foldl_toList]
  conv_lhs => rw [← hinit]
  refine foldl_shift (mapSt o) _ _ _ ?_ _
  intro stt k hk
  have hk' : k < poly.size := by rw [Array.toList_range, List.mem_range] at hk; exact hk
  exact cstep_map o a b c poly signs poly.size rfl hf stt k hk'

name: clip_signs_tr
statement:
theorem clip_signs_tr (o : P3) (a b c : P3) (f : Frag) (hf : FragFaithful f) :
    (f.poly.map (trVtx o)).map
        (fun v => signI (iFacePlaneP (psubS a o) (psubS b o) (psubS c o)) v.h)
      = f.poly.map (fun v => signI (iFacePlaneP a b c) v.h)
proof:
:= by
  rw [Array.map_map]
  apply Array.ext'
  rw [Array.toList_map, Array.toList_map]
  apply List.map_congr_left
  intro v hv
  show signI (iFacePlaneP (psubS a o) (psubS b o) (psubS c o)) (trVtx o v).h
     = signI (iFacePlaneP a b c) v.h
  exact faceVtxSign_tr o a b c v (hf v (Array.mem_toList.mp hv))

name: cwalk_tr
statement:
theorem cwalk_tr (o : P3) (a b c : P3) (f : Frag) (hf : FragFaithful f) :
    cwalk (iFacePlaneP (psubS a o) (psubS b o) (psubS c o)) (trFrag o f)
    = mapSt o (cwalk (iFacePlaneP a b c) f)
proof:
:= by
  rw [cwalk_cwalkP, cwalk_cwalkP, trFrag_poly, clip_signs_tr o a b c f hf]
  exact cwalkP_tr o a b c f.poly _ hf

name: clipFrag_tr
statement:
theorem clipFrag_tr (o : P3) (a b c : P3) (f : Frag) (hf : FragFaithful f) :
    clipFrag (iFacePlaneP (psubS a o) (psubS b o) (psubS c o)) (trFrag o f)
    = (clipFrag (iFacePlaneP a b c) f).map (trFrag o)
proof:
:= by
  rw [clipFrag_eq, clipFrag_eq]
  simp only [trFrag_poly, Array.size_map]
  rw [clip_signs_tr o a b c f hf, cwalk_tr o a b c f hf]
  split_ifs with h <;> apply Array.ext' <;> simp [Array.toList_map, mapSt, trFrag]

name: affine_eval_add_smul
statement:
theorem affine_eval_add_smul (g : Plane2 →ᵃ[ℚ] ℚ) (x d : Plane2) (t : ℚ) :
    g (x + t • d) = g x + t * g.linear d
proof:
:= by
  have hxd : x + t • d = (t • d) +ᵥ x := by simp [vadd_eq_add, add_comm]
  rw [hxd, AffineMap.map_vadd]
  simp [vadd_eq_add, map_smul]
  ring

name: affine_linear_sub
statement:
theorem affine_linear_sub (g : Plane2 →ᵃ[ℚ] ℚ) (a b : Plane2) :
    g.linear (a - b) = g a - g b
proof:
:= by
  have := AffineMap.linearMap_vsub g a b
  simpa [vsub_eq_sub, vadd_eq_add] using this

name: covec_common_kernel_trivial
statement:
theorem covec_common_kernel_trivial (L1 L2 : Plane2 →ₗ[ℚ] ℚ)
    (hindep : LinearIndependent ℚ ![L1, L2])
    (d : Plane2) (h1 : L1 d = 0) (h2 : L2 d = 0) : d = 0
proof:
:= by
  by_contra hd
  let ev : (Plane2 →ₗ[ℚ] ℚ) →ₗ[ℚ] ℚ :=
    { toFun := fun f => f d, map_add' := by intro f g; simp, map_smul' := by intro c f; simp }
  have hev_ne : ev ≠ 0 := by
    rw [DFunLike.ne_iff]
    obtain ⟨i, hi⟩ : ∃ i, d i ≠ 0 := by
      by_contra h; push_neg at h; exact hd (funext h)
    exact ⟨LinearMap.proj i, by simp [ev, LinearMap.proj, hi]⟩
  have h1' : L1 ∈ LinearMap.ker ev := by simp only [LinearMap.mem_ker]; exact h1
  have h2' : L2 ∈ LinearMap.ker ev := by simp only [LinearMap.mem_ker]; exact h2
  have hdual : Module.finrank ℚ (Plane2 →ₗ[ℚ] ℚ) = 2 := by
    rw [Module.finrank_linearMap]; simp
  have hker_lt : LinearMap.ker ev < ⊤ := by
    rw [lt_top_iff_ne_top]
    intro h
    apply hev_ne
    ext f
    have : f ∈ LinearMap.ker ev := h ▸ Submodule.mem_top
    simpa [LinearMap.mem_ker] using this
  have hker_le1 : Module.finrank ℚ (LinearMap.ker ev) ≤ 1 := by
    have := Submodule.finrank_lt (K := ℚ) hker_lt
    rw [hdual] at this; omega
  have hspan_le : Submodule.span ℚ (Set.range ![L1, L2]) ≤ LinearMap.ker ev := by
    rw [Submodule.span_le]
    rintro x hx
    simp only [Set.mem_range] at hx
    obtain ⟨i, rfl⟩ := hx
    fin_cases i
    · exact h1'
    · exact h2'
  have hspan2 : Module.finrank ℚ (Submodule.span ℚ (Set.range ![L1, L2])) = 2 := by
    rw [finrank_span_eq_card hindep]; simp
  have := Submodule.finrank_mono hspan_le
  rw [hspan2] at this
  omega

name: unique_common_zero
statement:
theorem unique_common_zero {g1 g2 : Plane2 →ᵃ[ℚ] ℚ}
    (hindep : LinearIndependent ℚ ![g1.linear, g2.linear])
    {a b : Plane2} (ha1 : g1 a = 0) (ha2 : g2 a = 0) (hb1 : g1 b = 0) (hb2 : g2 b = 0) :
    a = b
proof:
:= by
  have hd : a - b = 0 := by
    refine covec_common_kernel_trivial g1.linear g2.linear hindep (a - b) ?_ ?_
    · rw [affine_linear_sub, ha1, hb1, sub_zero]
    · rw [affine_linear_sub, ha2, hb2, sub_zero]
  rwa [sub_eq_zero] at hd

name: covec_eval
statement:
theorem covec_eval (L : Plane2 →ₗ[ℚ] ℚ) (d : Plane2) :
    L d = d 0 * L (Pi.single 0 1) + d 1 * L (Pi.single 1 1)
proof:
:= by
  have hd : d = d 0 • (Pi.single 0 1 : Plane2) + d 1 • (Pi.single 1 1 : Plane2) := by
    funext i; fin_cases i <;> simp [Pi.single_apply]
  conv_lhs => rw [hd]
  rw [map_add, map_smul, map_smul]
  simp [smul_eq_mul]

name: covec_nonzero_kernel
statement:
theorem covec_nonzero_kernel (L : Plane2 →ₗ[ℚ] ℚ) (hL : L ≠ 0) :
    ∃ d : Plane2, d ≠ 0 ∧ L d = 0
proof:
:= by
  set c0 := L (Pi.single 0 1 : Plane2) with hc0
  set c1 := L (Pi.single 1 1 : Plane2) with hc1
  have hcne : c0 ≠ 0 ∨ c1 ≠ 0 := by
    by_contra h; push_neg at h; obtain ⟨h0, h1⟩ := h
    apply hL; apply LinearMap.ext; intro d
    rw [covec_eval, ← hc0, ← hc1, h0, h1]; simp
  refine ⟨![- c1, c0], ?_, ?_⟩
  · intro h
    have e0 : -c1 = 0 := congrFun h 0
    have e1 : c0 = 0 := congrFun h 1
    rcases hcne with hh | hh
    · exact hh e1
    · exact hh (by linarith)
  · rw [covec_eval]; simp; ring

name: pair_dependent_smul
statement:
theorem pair_dependent_smul {L0 Lj : Plane2 →ₗ[ℚ] ℚ} (h0 : L0 ≠ 0)
    (hni : ¬ LinearIndependent ℚ ![L0, Lj]) : ∃ c : ℚ, Lj = c • L0
proof:
:= by
  rw [LinearIndependent.pair_iff' h0] at hni
  push_neg at hni
  obtain ⟨a, ha⟩ := hni
  exact ⟨a, ha.symm⟩

name: exists_pos_lower_bound
statement:
theorem exists_pos_lower_bound {m : ℕ} (hm : 0 < m) (ε : Fin m → ℚ) (hε : ∀ i, 0 < ε i) :
    ∃ t : ℚ, 0 < t ∧ ∀ i, t ≤ ε i
proof:
:= by
  have hne : (Finset.univ : Finset (Fin m)).Nonempty := by
    rw [Finset.univ_nonempty_iff]; exact Fin.pos_iff_nonempty.mp hm
  refine ⟨(Finset.univ.image ε).min' (by rwa [Finset.image_nonempty]), ?_, ?_⟩
  · rw [Finset.lt_min'_iff]
    intro y hy
    rw [Finset.mem_image] at hy
    obtain ⟨i, _, rfl⟩ := hy
    exact hε i
  · intro i
    apply Finset.min'_le
    rw [Finset.mem_image]
    exact ⟨i, Finset.mem_univ i, rfl⟩

name: nonneg_of_mem
statement:
theorem nonneg_of_mem {m : ℕ} (g : Fin m → (Plane2 →ᵃ[ℚ] ℚ))
    (P' : Set Plane2) (hP' : P' = ⋂ i, {y | 0 ≤ g i y})
    {x : Plane2} (hx : x ∈ P') (i : Fin m) : 0 ≤ g i x
proof:
:= by
  rw [hP'] at hx
  simp only [Set.mem_iInter, Set.mem_setOf_eq] at hx
  exact hx i

name: convex_halfspace_ge
statement: theorem convex_halfspace_ge (g : Plane2 →ᵃ[ℚ] ℚ) : Convex ℚ {y | 0 ≤ g y}
proof:
:= by
  intro x hx y hy a b ha hb hab
  simp only [Set.mem_setOf_eq] at hx hy ⊢
  have hc : g (a • x + b • y) = a * g x + b * g y :=
    Convex.combo_affine_apply (𝕜 := ℚ) (f := g) hab
  rw [hc]
  have h1 := mul_nonneg ha hx
  have h2 := mul_nonneg hb hy
  linarith

name: mem_of_nonneg
statement:
theorem mem_of_nonneg {m : ℕ} (g : Fin m → (Plane2 →ᵃ[ℚ] ℚ))
    (P' : Set Plane2) (hP' : P' = ⋂ i, {y | 0 ≤ g i y})
    {x : Plane2} (hx : ∀ i, 0 ≤ g i x) : x ∈ P'
proof:
:= by
  rw [hP']
  simp only [Set.mem_iInter, Set.mem_setOf_eq]
  exact hx

name: convex_P'
statement:
theorem convex_P' {m : ℕ} (g : Fin m → (Plane2 →ᵃ[ℚ] ℚ))
    (P' : Set Plane2) (hP' : P' = ⋂ i, {y | 0 ≤ g i y}) : Convex ℚ P'
proof:
:= by
  rw [hP']
  exact convex_iInter (fun i => convex_halfspace_ge (g i))

name: vertexSet_finite
statement:
theorem vertexSet_finite {m : ℕ} (g : Fin m → (Plane2 →ᵃ[ℚ] ℚ)) (P' : Set Plane2) :
    (vertexSet g P').Finite
proof:
:= by
  rcases Nat.eq_zero_or_pos m with hm | hm
  · 
    subst hm
    convert Set.finite_empty
    ext y
    simp only [Set.mem_empty_iff_false, iff_false]
    rintro ⟨_, i, _⟩
    exact i.elim0
  · 
    have hne : Nonempty (Fin m) := Fin.pos_iff_nonempty.mp hm
    
    have hwit' : ∀ y : Plane2, ∃ ij : Fin m × Fin m, y ∈ vertexSet g P' →
        LinearIndependent ℚ ![(g ij.1).linear, (g ij.2).linear] ∧ g ij.1 y = 0 ∧ g ij.2 y = 0 := by
      intro y
      by_cases hy : y ∈ vertexSet g P'
      · obtain ⟨_, i, j, _, _, hindep, hai, haj⟩ := hy
        exact ⟨⟨i, j⟩, fun _ => ⟨hindep, hai, haj⟩⟩
      · exact ⟨⟨Classical.arbitrary (Fin m), Classical.arbitrary (Fin m)⟩, fun h => absurd h hy⟩
    choose f hf using hwit'
    apply Set.Finite.of_finite_image (f := f) (Set.toFinite _)
    
    intro y1 hy1 y2 hy2 hfeq
    obtain ⟨hindep1, ha1, hb1⟩ := hf y1 hy1
    obtain ⟨_, ha2, hb2⟩ := hf y2 hy2
    
    rw [hfeq] at ha1 hb1 hindep1
    exact unique_common_zero hindep1 ha1 hb1 ha2 hb2

name: extremePoint_mem_vertexSet
statement:
theorem extremePoint_mem_vertexSet {m : ℕ} (g : Fin m → (Plane2 →ᵃ[ℚ] ℚ))
    (P' : Set Plane2) (hP' : P' = ⋂ i, {y | 0 ≤ g i y})
    {x : Plane2} (hx : x ∈ Set.extremePoints ℚ P') :
    x ∈ vertexSet g P'
proof:
:= by
  rw [mem_extremePoints] at hx
  obtain ⟨hxP, hext⟩ := hx
  
  refine ⟨hxP, ?_⟩
  by_contra hno
  push_neg at hno
  
  
  
  obtain ⟨d, hd0, hdkill⟩ :
      ∃ d : Plane2, d ≠ 0 ∧ ∀ i, NonVacuous (g i) → g i x = 0 → (g i).linear d = 0 := by
    by_cases hex : ∃ i, NonVacuous (g i) ∧ g i x = 0
    · obtain ⟨i0, hi0nv, hi0act⟩ := hex
      obtain ⟨d, hd0, hdk0⟩ := covec_nonzero_kernel (g i0).linear hi0nv
      refine ⟨d, hd0, ?_⟩
      intro j hjnv hjact
      
      have hni : ¬ LinearIndependent ℚ ![(g i0).linear, (g j).linear] := by
        intro hindep
        exact hno i0 j hi0nv hjnv hindep hi0act hjact
      obtain ⟨c, hc⟩ := pair_dependent_smul hi0nv hni
      rw [hc]; simp [hdk0]
    · push_neg at hex
      
      refine ⟨![1, 0], ?_, ?_⟩
      · intro h; have := congrFun h 0; simp at this
      · intro i hinv hiact; exact absurd hiact (hex i hinv)
  
  
  have hactkill : ∀ i, g i x = 0 → (g i).linear d = 0 := by
    intro i hi
    by_cases hnv : NonVacuous (g i)
    · exact hdkill i hnv hi
    · 
      simp only [NonVacuous, not_not] at hnv
      rw [hnv]; rfl
  
  have hm : 0 < m := by
    rcases Nat.eq_zero_or_pos m with h | h
    · subst h
      
      
      have hmem : ∀ y : Plane2, y ∈ P' := by
        intro y; rw [hP']; simp
      have hseg : x ∈ openSegment ℚ (x - d) (x + d) := by
        refine ⟨1/2, 1/2, by norm_num, by norm_num, by norm_num, ?_⟩
        module
      obtain ⟨he1, _⟩ := hext (x - d) (hmem (x - d)) (x + d) (hmem (x + d)) hseg
      exfalso
      apply hd0
      have hxd : d = 0 := by rw [sub_eq_self] at he1; exact he1
      exact hxd
    · exact h
  set ε : Fin m → ℚ := fun i => if g i x = 0 then 1 else g i x / (1 + |(g i).linear d|) with hεdef
  have hεpos : ∀ i, 0 < ε i := by
    intro i
    simp only [hεdef]
    by_cases hi : g i x = 0
    · simp [hi]
    · simp only [hi, if_false]
      have hgxpos : 0 < g i x := lt_of_le_of_ne (nonneg_of_mem g P' hP' hxP i) (Ne.symm hi)
      have hden : 0 < 1 + |(g i).linear d| := by positivity
      exact div_pos hgxpos hden
  obtain ⟨t, htpos, htle⟩ := exists_pos_lower_bound hm ε hεpos
  
  have hfeas_plus : x + t • d ∈ P' := by
    apply mem_of_nonneg g P' hP'
    intro i
    rw [affine_eval_add_smul]
    by_cases hi : g i x = 0
    · rw [hi, hactkill i hi]; simp
    · have hgxpos : 0 < g i x := lt_of_le_of_ne (nonneg_of_mem g P' hP' hxP i) (Ne.symm hi)
      have htlei : t ≤ g i x / (1 + |(g i).linear d|) := by
        have := htle i; simp only [hεdef, hi, if_false] at this; exact this
      have hden : 0 < 1 + |(g i).linear d| := by positivity
      have key : t * |(g i).linear d| ≤ g i x := by
        calc t * |(g i).linear d| ≤ (g i x / (1 + |(g i).linear d|)) * |(g i).linear d| :=
              mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right htlei (abs_nonneg _)
          _ = g i x * (|(g i).linear d| / (1 + |(g i).linear d|)) := by ring
          _ ≤ g i x * 1 := by
              apply mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left _ hgxpos.le
              rw [div_le_one hden]; linarith [abs_nonneg ((g i).linear d)]
          _ = g i x := by ring
      have hbound : -(t * |(g i).linear d|) ≤ t * (g i).linear d := by
        have : t * (-|(g i).linear d|) ≤ t * (g i).linear d :=
          mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (neg_abs_le _) htpos.le
        linarith
      linarith
  have hfeas_minus : x - t • d ∈ P' := by
    apply mem_of_nonneg g P' hP'
    intro i
    have : x - t • d = x + (-t) • d := by module
    rw [this, affine_eval_add_smul]
    by_cases hi : g i x = 0
    · rw [hi, hactkill i hi]; simp
    · have hgxpos : 0 < g i x := lt_of_le_of_ne (nonneg_of_mem g P' hP' hxP i) (Ne.symm hi)
      have htlei : t ≤ g i x / (1 + |(g i).linear d|) := by
        have := htle i; simp only [hεdef, hi, if_false] at this; exact this
      have hden : 0 < 1 + |(g i).linear d| := by positivity
      have key : t * |(g i).linear d| ≤ g i x := by
        calc t * |(g i).linear d| ≤ (g i x / (1 + |(g i).linear d|)) * |(g i).linear d| :=
              mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right htlei (abs_nonneg _)
          _ = g i x * (|(g i).linear d| / (1 + |(g i).linear d|)) := by ring
          _ ≤ g i x * 1 := by
              apply mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left _ hgxpos.le
              rw [div_le_one hden]; linarith [abs_nonneg ((g i).linear d)]
          _ = g i x := by ring
      have hbound : -(t * |(g i).linear d|) ≤ (-t) * (g i).linear d := by
        have h1 : (-t) * (g i).linear d = t * (-(g i).linear d) := by ring
        rw [h1]
        have : t * (-|(g i).linear d|) ≤ t * (-(g i).linear d) :=
          mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (neg_le_neg (le_abs_self _)) htpos.le
        linarith
      linarith
  
  have hseg : x ∈ openSegment ℚ (x - t • d) (x + t • d) := by
    refine ⟨1/2, 1/2, by norm_num, by norm_num, by norm_num, ?_⟩
    module
  obtain ⟨he1, _⟩ := hext (x - t • d) hfeas_minus (x + t • d) hfeas_plus hseg
  
  have htd : t • d = 0 := by rw [sub_eq_self] at he1; exact he1
  have : d = 0 := by
    rcases smul_eq_zero.mp htd with h | h
    · exact absurd h htpos.ne'
    · exact h
  exact hd0 this

name: affine_combo
statement:
theorem affine_combo (g : Plane2 →ᵃ[ℚ] ℚ) (x1 x2 : Plane2) (a b : ℚ) (hab : a + b = 1) :
    g (a • x1 + b • x2) = a * g x1 + b * g x2
proof:
:= by
  have := Convex.combo_affine_apply (𝕜 := ℚ) (f := g) (a := a) (b := b) (x := x1) (y := x2) hab
  simpa using this

name: active_at_endpoints
proof:
:= by
  have h1 : 0 ≤ a * g x1 := mul_nonneg ha.le hx1
  have h2 : 0 ≤ b * g x2 := mul_nonneg hb.le hx2
  have ea : a * g x1 = 0 := le_antisymm (by linarith) h1
  have eb : b * g x2 = 0 := le_antisymm (by linarith) h2
  refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
  · rcases mul_eq_zero.mp ea with h | h
    · exact absurd h ha.ne'
    · exact h
  · rcases mul_eq_zero.mp eb with h | h
    · exact absurd h hb.ne'
    · exact h

name: vertex_mem_extremePoints
statement:
theorem vertex_mem_extremePoints {m : ℕ} (g : Fin m → (Plane2 →ᵃ[ℚ] ℚ))
    (P' : Set Plane2) (hP' : P' = ⋂ i, {y | 0 ≤ g i y})
    {v : Plane2} (hv : v ∈ vertexSet g P') :
    v ∈ Set.extremePoints ℚ P'
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨hvP, i, j, _, _, hindep, hai, haj⟩ := hv
  rw [mem_extremePoints]
  refine ⟨hvP, ?_⟩
  intro x1 hx1 x2 hx2 hseg
  obtain ⟨a, b, ha, hb, hab, hcomb⟩ := hseg
  
  have hi_v : g i v = 0 := hai
  have hj_v : g j v = 0 := haj
  have hi_combo : g i (a • x1 + b • x2) = a * g i x1 + b * g i x2 := affine_combo _ _ _ _ _ hab
  have hj_combo : g j (a • x1 + b • x2) = a * g j x1 + b * g j x2 := affine_combo _ _ _ _ _ hab
  rw [hcomb, hi_v] at hi_combo
  rw [hcomb, hj_v] at hj_combo
  have hi1 := nonneg_of_mem g P' hP' hx1 i
  have hi2 := nonneg_of_mem g P' hP' hx2 i
  have hj1 := nonneg_of_mem g P' hP' hx1 j
  have hj2 := nonneg_of_mem g P' hP' hx2 j
  obtain ⟨hgi1, hgi2⟩ := active_at_endpoints hi1 hi2 ha hb hab hi_combo.symm
  obtain ⟨hgj1, hgj2⟩ := active_at_endpoints hj1 hj2 ha hb hab hj_combo.symm
  
  have hx1v : x1 = v := unique_common_zero hindep hgi1 hgj1 hi_v hj_v
  have hx2v : x2 = v := unique_common_zero hindep hgi2 hgj2 hi_v hj_v
  exact ⟨hx1v, hx2v⟩

name: vertices_not_collinear
statement:
theorem vertices_not_collinear {m : ℕ} (g : Fin m → (Plane2 →ᵃ[ℚ] ℚ))
    (P' : Set Plane2) (hP' : P' = ⋂ i, {y | 0 ≤ g i y})
    {a b c : Plane2} (ha : a ∈ vertexSet g P') (hb : b ∈ vertexSet g P')
    (hc : c ∈ vertexSet g P') (hab : a ≠ b) (hac : a ≠ c) (hbc : b ≠ c) :
    AffineIndependent ℚ ![a, b, c]
proof:
:= by
  
  have hae := vertex_mem_extremePoints g P' hP' ha
  have hbe := vertex_mem_extremePoints g P' hP' hb
  have hce := vertex_mem_extremePoints g P' hP' hc
  rw [mem_extremePoints] at hae hbe hce
  
  
  have hmid : ∀ {p q1 q2 : Plane2}, p ∈ vertexSet g P' → q1 ∈ P' → q2 ∈ P' →
      p ∈ openSegment ℚ q1 q2 → q1 = p ∧ q2 = p := by
    intro p q1 q2 hp hq1 hq2 hseg
    have hpe := vertex_mem_extremePoints g P' hP' hp
    rw [mem_extremePoints] at hpe
    exact hpe.2 q1 hq1 q2 hq2 hseg
  
  have haP : a ∈ P' := ha.1
  have hbP : b ∈ P' := hb.1
  have hcP : c ∈ P' := hc.1
  rw [affineIndependent_iff_not_collinear_set]
  intro hcol
  
  rcases hcol.wbtw_or_wbtw_or_wbtw with hw | hw | hw
  · 
    have hsb : Sbtw ℚ a b c := ⟨hw, fun h => hab h.symm, fun h => hbc h⟩
    have hmem : b ∈ openSegment ℚ a c := by
      have := hsb.mem_image_Ioo; rwa [← openSegment_eq_image_lineMap] at this
    obtain ⟨h1, _⟩ := hmid hb haP hcP hmem
    exact hab h1
  · 
    have hsb : Sbtw ℚ b c a := ⟨hw, fun h => hbc h.symm, fun h => hac h.symm⟩
    have hmem : c ∈ openSegment ℚ b a := by
      have := hsb.mem_image_Ioo; rwa [← openSegment_eq_image_lineMap] at this
    obtain ⟨h1, _⟩ := hmid hc hbP haP hmem
    exact hbc h1
  · 
    have hsb : Sbtw ℚ c a b := ⟨hw, fun h => hac h, fun h => hab h⟩
    have hmem : a ∈ openSegment ℚ c b := by
      have := hsb.mem_image_Ioo; rwa [← openSegment_eq_image_lineMap] at this
    obtain ⟨h1, _⟩ := hmid ha hcP hbP hmem
    exact hac h1.symm

name: g_crossingPt
statement:
theorem g_crossingPt (g : Plane2 →ᵃ[ℚ] ℚ) {a b : Plane2} (ha : 0 ≤ g a) (hb : g b < 0) :
    g (crossingPt g a b) = 0
proof:
:= by
  unfold crossingPt
  set s := g a / (g a - g b) with hs
  have hden : 0 < g a - g b := by linarith
  have hcombo : g ((1 - s) • a + s • b) = (1 - s) * g a + s * g b := by
    have := Convex.combo_affine_apply (𝕜 := ℚ) (f := g) (a := 1 - s) (b := s)
      (x := a) (y := b) (by ring)
    simpa using this
  rw [hcombo, hs]; field_simp; ring

name: crossingPt_mem_hull
statement:
theorem crossingPt_mem_hull (g : Plane2 →ᵃ[ℚ] ℚ) {a b : Plane2} (ha : 0 ≤ g a) (hb : g b < 0) :
    crossingPt g a b ∈ convexHull ℚ ({a, b} : Set Plane2)
proof:
:= by
  unfold crossingPt
  set s := g a / (g a - g b) with hs
  have hden : 0 < g a - g b := by linarith
  have hs0 : 0 ≤ s := by rw [hs]; positivity
  have hs1 : s ≤ 1 := by rw [hs, div_le_one hden]; linarith
  exact (convex_convexHull ℚ _)
    (subset_convexHull ℚ _ (by left; rfl)) (subset_convexHull ℚ _ (by right; rfl))
    (by linarith) hs0 (by ring)

name: g_centerMass_eq
statement:
private theorem g_centerMass_eq (g : Plane2 →ᵃ[ℚ] ℚ) (T : Finset Plane2) (w : Plane2 → ℚ)
    (hw1 : ∑ y ∈ T, w y = 1) : g (T.centerMass w id) = ∑ y ∈ T, w y * g y
proof:
:= by
  classical
  rw [← affineCombination_eq_centerMass hw1, T.map_affineCombination id w hw1 g,
    affineCombination_eq_centerMass hw1, Finset.centerMass_eq_of_sum_1 _ _ hw1]
  simp only [Function.comp_apply, id_eq, smul_eq_mul, mul_comm]

name: hub_neg
statement:
private theorem hub_neg (g : Plane2 →ᵃ[ℚ] ℚ) (T : Finset Plane2) (w : Plane2 → ℚ)
    (hw0 : ∀ y ∈ T, 0 ≤ w y) (hw1 : ∑ y ∈ T, w y = 1)
    {n : Plane2} (hnT : n ∈ T) (hgn : g n < 0)
    (hrest : ∀ y ∈ T, y ≠ n → 0 ≤ g y) (hx : 0 ≤ g (T.centerMass w id))
    (K : Set Plane2)
    (hKkeep : ∀ y ∈ T, 0 ≤ g y → y ∈ K)
    (hKcross : ∀ p ∈ T, 0 ≤ g p → crossingPt g p n ∈ K) :
    T.centerMass w id ∈ convexHull ℚ K
proof:
:= by
  classical
  set P : Finset Plane2 := T.erase n with hP
  have hppos : ∀ p ∈ P, 0 ≤ g p := by
    intro p hp; rw [hP, Finset.mem_erase] at hp; exact hrest p hp.2 hp.1
  
  set D : ℚ := ∑ p ∈ P, w p * g p with hD
  have hD0 : 0 ≤ D := by
    rw [hD]; apply Finset.sum_nonneg; intro p hp
    exact mul_nonneg (hw0 p (Finset.mem_of_mem_erase hp)) (hppos p hp)
  have hgsum : g (T.centerMass w id) = ∑ y ∈ T, w y * g y := g_centerMass_eq g T w hw1
  have hgx_split : g (T.centerMass w id) = w n * g n + D := by
    rw [hgsum, hD, hP]
    exact (Finset.add_sum_erase T (fun y => w y * g y) hnT).symm
  
  rcases eq_or_lt_of_le hD0 with hDeq | hDpos
  · 
    have hDz : D = 0 := hDeq.symm
    have hwn0 : w n = 0 := by
      have hle : w n * g n ≤ 0 := mul_nonpos_iff.mpr (Or.inl ⟨hw0 n hnT, hgn.le⟩)
      have : 0 ≤ w n * g n := by rw [hgx_split, hDz, add_zero] at hx; exact hx
      have heq : w n * g n = 0 := le_antisymm hle this
      rcases mul_eq_zero.mp heq with h | h
      · exact h
      · exact absurd h hgn.ne
    
    have hxeq : T.centerMass w id = P.centerMass w id := by
      rw [Finset.centerMass_eq_of_sum_1 _ _ hw1]
      have hPsum : ∑ p ∈ P, w p = 1 := by
        rw [hP]; have := Finset.add_sum_erase T w hnT; rw [hwn0, zero_add] at this; rw [this]; exact hw1
      rw [Finset.centerMass_eq_of_sum_1 _ _ hPsum]
      rw [hP, ← Finset.add_sum_erase T (fun y => w y • (id y : Plane2)) hnT, hwn0, zero_smul,
        zero_add]
    rw [hxeq]
    apply Finset.centerMass_mem_convexHull P (fun p hp => hw0 p (Finset.mem_of_mem_erase hp))
    · have hPsum : ∑ p ∈ P, w p = 1 := by
        rw [hP]; have := Finset.add_sum_erase T w hnT; rw [hwn0, zero_add] at this; rw [this]; exact hw1
      rw [hPsum]; norm_num
    · intro p hp; exact hKkeep p (Finset.mem_of_mem_erase hp) (hppos p hp)
  · 
    
    set t : Plane2 → ℚ := fun p => g p / (g p - g n) with ht
    set k : ℚ := w n * (-g n) / D with hk
    set lam : Plane2 → ℚ := fun p => (1 - k) * w p with hlam
    set mu : Plane2 → ℚ := fun p => k * w p / (1 - t p) with hmu
    have hden : ∀ p ∈ P, 0 < g p - g n := by intro p hp; have := hppos p hp; linarith
    have ht0 : ∀ p ∈ P, 0 ≤ t p := by
      intro p hp; simp only [ht]; exact div_nonneg (hppos p hp) (hden p hp).le
    have h1mt : ∀ p ∈ P, 1 - t p = (-g n) / (g p - g n) := by
      intro p hp; simp only [ht]
      rw [eq_div_iff (hden p hp).ne', sub_mul, div_mul_cancel₀ _ (hden p hp).ne']; ring
    have h1mtpos : ∀ p ∈ P, 0 < 1 - t p := by
      intro p hp; rw [h1mt p hp]; apply div_pos (by linarith) (hden p hp)
    
    have hk0 : 0 ≤ k := by
      rw [hk]; apply div_nonneg (mul_nonneg (hw0 n hnT) (by linarith)) hDpos.le
    have hk1 : k ≤ 1 := by
      rw [hk, div_le_one hDpos]
      have : w n * (-g n) = -(w n * g n) := by ring
      rw [this]
      
      have : 0 ≤ w n * g n + D := by rw [← hgx_split]; exact hx
      linarith
    
    have hlam0 : ∀ p ∈ P, 0 ≤ lam p := by
      intro p hp; rw [hlam]; exact mul_nonneg (by linarith) (hw0 p (Finset.mem_of_mem_erase hp))
    have hmu0 : ∀ p ∈ P, 0 ≤ mu p := by
      intro p hp; rw [hmu]
      exact div_nonneg (mul_nonneg hk0 (hw0 p (Finset.mem_of_mem_erase hp))) (h1mtpos p hp).le
    
    have hgnn : (-g n) ≠ 0 := by intro h; apply hgn.ne; linarith [neg_eq_zero.mp h]
    have htp : ∀ p ∈ P, t p = g p / (g p - g n) := by intro p hp; simp only [ht]
    have hmu1mt : ∀ p ∈ P, mu p * (1 - t p) = k * w p := by
      intro p hp; simp only [mu]; field_simp [(h1mtpos p hp).ne']
    have hmut : ∀ p ∈ P, mu p * t p = k * w p * g p / (-g n) := by
      intro p hp
      have hd := hden p hp
      
      have hne : (1 - t p) ≠ 0 := (h1mtpos p hp).ne'
      have hrearr : mu p * t p = (mu p * (1 - t p)) * (t p / (1 - t p)) := by
        field_simp; ring
      have hratio : t p / (1 - t p) = g p / (-g n) := by
        rw [htp p hp, h1mt p hp, div_div_div_cancel_right₀ hd.ne']
      rw [hrearr, hmu1mt p hp, hratio]; ring
    
    have hcross : ∀ p ∈ P, crossingPt g p n = (1 - t p) • p + t p • n := by
      intro p hp; simp only [ht]; rw [crossingPt]
    
    have hsummut : ∑ p ∈ P, mu p * t p = w n := by
      have h1 : ∑ p ∈ P, mu p * t p = ∑ p ∈ P, k * w p * g p / (-g n) := by
        apply Finset.sum_congr rfl; intro p hp; exact hmut p hp
      rw [h1]
      have h2 : ∑ p ∈ P, k * w p * g p / (-g n) = (k * ∑ p ∈ P, w p * g p) / (-g n) := by
        rw [Finset.mul_sum, Finset.sum_div]; apply Finset.sum_congr rfl; intro p hp; ring
      rw [h2, ← hD, hk]
      rw [div_mul_cancel₀ _ hDpos.ne', mul_div_assoc, div_self hgnn, mul_one]
    
    set Widx : Plane2 ⊕ Plane2 → ℚ := Sum.elim lam mu with hWidx
    set Zidx : Plane2 ⊕ Plane2 → Plane2 := Sum.elim id (fun p => crossingPt g p n) with hZidx
    set tt : Finset (Plane2 ⊕ Plane2) := P.disjSum P with htt
    
    have hsumlam : ∑ p ∈ P, lam p = (1 - k) * (1 - w n) := by
      rw [hlam, ← Finset.mul_sum]
      congr 1
      rw [hP]; have := Finset.add_sum_erase T w hnT; rw [← hP] at this; linarith [hw1, this]
    have hsummu : ∑ p ∈ P, mu p = k * (1 - w n) + w n := by
      have hsplit : ∑ p ∈ P, mu p = ∑ p ∈ P, (mu p * t p + mu p * (1 - t p)) := by
        apply Finset.sum_congr rfl; intro p hp; ring
      rw [hsplit, Finset.sum_add_distrib, hsummut]
      have hmu1mtsum : ∑ p ∈ P, mu p * (1 - t p) = k * (1 - w n) := by
        have h1 : ∑ p ∈ P, mu p * (1 - t p) = ∑ p ∈ P, k * w p := by
          apply Finset.sum_congr rfl; intro p hp; exact hmu1mt p hp
        rw [h1, ← Finset.mul_sum]
        congr 1
        rw [hP]; have := Finset.add_sum_erase T w hnT; rw [← hP] at this; linarith [hw1, this]
      rw [hmu1mtsum]; ring
    have hWsum : ∑ x ∈ tt, Widx x = 1 := by
      rw [htt, hWidx, Finset.sum_sum_elim, hsumlam, hsummu]; ring
    
    have hrecomb : tt.centerMass Widx Zidx = T.centerMass w id := by
      rw [Finset.centerMass_eq_of_sum_1 _ _ hWsum, Finset.centerMass_eq_of_sum_1 _ _ hw1]
      rw [htt, Finset.sum_disj_sum]
      simp only [hWidx, hZidx, Sum.elim_inl, Sum.elim_inr, id_eq]
      
      have hμterm : ∑ p ∈ P, mu p • crossingPt g p n
          = (∑ p ∈ P, (mu p * (1 - t p)) • p) + (∑ p ∈ P, mu p * t p) • n := by
        rw [Finset.sum_smul]
        rw [← Finset.sum_add_distrib]
        apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
        intro p hp
        rw [hcross p hp, smul_add, smul_smul, smul_smul]
      rw [hμterm, hsummut]
      
      have hAB : (∑ p ∈ P, lam p • (p : Plane2)) + (∑ p ∈ P, (mu p * (1 - t p)) • p)
          = ∑ p ∈ P, w p • (p : Plane2) := by
        rw [← Finset.sum_add_distrib]
        apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
        intro p hp
        rw [hlam, ← add_smul]
        congr 1
        rw [hmu1mt p hp]; ring
      
      rw [← add_assoc, hAB]
      have hRHS : ∑ y ∈ T, w y • (y : Plane2) = w n • n + ∑ p ∈ P, w p • (p : Plane2) := by
        rw [hP]; exact (Finset.add_sum_erase T (fun y => w y • (y : Plane2)) hnT).symm
      rw [hRHS]; exact add_comm _ _
    rw [← hrecomb]
    apply Finset.centerMass_mem_convexHull tt
    · intro x hx'
      rw [htt, Finset.mem_disjSum] at hx'
      rw [hWidx]
      rcases hx' with ⟨p, hp, rfl⟩ | ⟨p, hp, rfl⟩
      · simp only [Sum.elim_inl]; exact hlam0 p hp
      · simp only [Sum.elim_inr]; exact hmu0 p hp
    · rw [hWsum]; norm_num
    · intro x hx'
      rw [htt, Finset.mem_disjSum] at hx'
      rw [hZidx]
      rcases hx' with ⟨p, hp, rfl⟩ | ⟨p, hp, rfl⟩
      · simp only [Sum.elim_inl, id_eq]; exact hKkeep p (Finset.mem_of_mem_erase hp) (hppos p hp)
      · simp only [Sum.elim_inr]
        exact hKcross p (Finset.mem_of_mem_erase hp) (hppos p hp)

name: hub_pos
statement:
private theorem hub_pos (g : Plane2 →ᵃ[ℚ] ℚ) (T : Finset Plane2) (w : Plane2 → ℚ)
    (hw0 : ∀ y ∈ T, 0 ≤ w y) (hw1 : ∑ y ∈ T, w y = 1)
    {p : Plane2} (hpT : p ∈ T) (hgp : 0 < g p)
    (hrest : ∀ y ∈ T, y ≠ p → g y < 0) (hx : 0 ≤ g (T.centerMass w id))
    (K : Set Plane2)
    (hKp : p ∈ K)
    (hKcross : ∀ q ∈ T, g q < 0 → crossingPt g p q ∈ K) :
    T.centerMass w id ∈ convexHull ℚ K
proof:
:= by
  classical
  
  set N : Finset Plane2 := T.erase p with hN
  
  set τ : Plane2 → ℚ := fun q => g p / (g p - g q) with hτ
  set μ : Plane2 → ℚ := fun q => w q / τ q with hμ
  
  set lam : ℚ := g (T.centerMass w id) / g p with hlam
  
  set z : Plane2 → Plane2 := fun y => if y = p then p else crossingPt g p y with hz
  set W : Plane2 → ℚ := fun y => if y = p then lam else μ y with hW
  
  have hqneg : ∀ q ∈ N, g q < 0 := by
    intro q hq; rw [hN, Finset.mem_erase] at hq; exact hrest q hq.2 hq.1
  have hden : ∀ q ∈ N, 0 < g p - g q := by intro q hq; have := hqneg q hq; linarith
  have hτpos : ∀ q ∈ N, 0 < τ q := by intro q hq; rw [hτ]; exact div_pos hgp (hden q hq)
  
  have hμτ : ∀ q ∈ N, μ q * τ q = w q := by
    intro q hq; rw [hμ]; field_simp [(hτpos q hq).ne']
  have hμ1mτ : ∀ q ∈ N, μ q * (1 - τ q) = w q * (-g q) / g p := by
    intro q hq
    have hd := (hden q hq)
    rw [hμ, hτ]
    field_simp
    ring
  
  have hcross : ∀ q ∈ N, crossingPt g p q = (1 - τ q) • p + τ q • q := by
    intro q hq; rw [crossingPt, hτ]
  
  have hgsum : g (T.centerMass w id) = ∑ y ∈ T, w y * g y := g_centerMass_eq g T w hw1
  have hgx_split : g (T.centerMass w id) = w p * g p + ∑ q ∈ N, w q * g q := by
    rw [hgsum, hN, ← Finset.add_sum_erase T (fun y => w y * g y) hpT]
  
  
  have hμ0 : ∀ q ∈ N, 0 ≤ μ q := by
    intro q hq
    rw [hμ]
    exact div_nonneg (hw0 q (Finset.mem_of_mem_erase hq)) (hτpos q hq).le
  have hlam0 : 0 ≤ lam := by rw [hlam]; exact div_nonneg hx hgp.le
  
  have hW0 : ∀ y ∈ T, 0 ≤ W y := by
    intro y hy
    rw [hW]
    by_cases hyp : y = p
    · simp [hyp, hlam0]
    · simp only [hyp, if_false]
      exact hμ0 y (by rw [hN, Finset.mem_erase]; exact ⟨hyp, hy⟩)
  
  have hsum1mτ : ∑ q ∈ N, μ q * (1 - τ q) = (∑ q ∈ N, w q * (-g q)) / g p := by
    rw [Finset.sum_div]
    apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
    intro q hq; rw [hμ1mτ q hq]
  
  have hsumneg : ∑ q ∈ N, w q * (-g q) = -(∑ q ∈ N, w q * g q) := by
    simp only [mul_neg, Finset.sum_neg_distrib]
  
  have hlam_eq : lam = w p - ∑ q ∈ N, μ q * (1 - τ q) := by
    rw [hsum1mτ, hsumneg, hlam, hgx_split]
    field_simp
  
  have hWsum : ∑ y ∈ T, W y = 1 := by
    rw [← Finset.add_sum_erase T W hpT]
    have hWp : W p = lam := by rw [hW]; simp
    have hWq : ∀ q ∈ T.erase p, W q = μ q := by
      intro q hq; rw [hW]; rw [Finset.mem_erase] at hq; simp [hq.1]
    rw [hWp, Finset.sum_congr rfl hWq, ← hN]
    have hsplit : ∑ q ∈ N, μ q = ∑ q ∈ N, (μ q * τ q + μ q * (1 - τ q)) := by
      apply Finset.sum_congr rfl; intro q hq; ring
    rw [hsplit, Finset.sum_add_distrib]
    have hμτsum : ∑ q ∈ N, μ q * τ q = ∑ q ∈ N, w q := by
      apply Finset.sum_congr rfl; intro q hq; exact hμτ q hq
    rw [hμτsum, hlam_eq]
    have hwsum : w p + ∑ q ∈ N, w q = 1 := by rw [hN, Finset.add_sum_erase T w hpT]; exact hw1
    linarith [hwsum]
  
  have hrecomb : T.centerMass W z = T.centerMass w id := by
    rw [Finset.centerMass_eq_of_sum_1 _ _ hWsum, Finset.centerMass_eq_of_sum_1 _ _ hw1]
    rw [← Finset.add_sum_erase T (fun y => W y • z y) hpT,
        ← Finset.add_sum_erase T (fun y => w y • (id y : Plane2)) hpT]
    have hWp : W p • z p = lam • p := by rw [hW, hz]; simp
    rw [hWp]
    
    have hterm : ∀ q ∈ T.erase p, W q • z q
        = (μ q * (1 - τ q)) • p + (μ q * τ q) • q := by
      intro q hq
      have hqn : q ∈ N := by rw [hN]; exact hq
      have hqne : q ≠ p := (Finset.mem_erase.mp hq).1
      rw [hW, hz]; simp only [hqne, if_false]
      rw [hcross q hqn, smul_add, smul_smul, smul_smul]
    rw [Finset.sum_congr rfl hterm]
    rw [Finset.sum_add_distrib, ← Finset.sum_smul]
    
    have hqq : ∑ q ∈ T.erase p, (μ q * τ q) • q = ∑ q ∈ T.erase p, w q • (id q : Plane2) := by
      apply Finset.sum_congr rfl; intro q hq
      rw [hμτ q (by rw [hN]; exact hq)]; rfl
    rw [hqq]
    
    rw [← hN]
    have : lam • p + ((∑ q ∈ N, μ q * (1 - τ q)) • p + ∑ q ∈ T.erase p, w q • (id q : Plane2))
        = (lam + ∑ q ∈ N, μ q * (1 - τ q)) • p + ∑ q ∈ T.erase p, w q • (id q : Plane2) := by
      rw [add_smul]; abel
    rw [this]
    congr 1
    rw [hlam_eq]; congr 1; ring
  
  rw [← hrecomb]
  apply Finset.centerMass_mem_convexHull T hW0 (by rw [hWsum]; norm_num)
  intro y hy
  rw [hz]
  by_cases hyp : y = p
  · simp only [hyp, if_true]; exact hKp
  · simp only [hyp, if_false]
    exact hKcross y hy (hrest y hy hyp)

name: triangle_cut
statement:
private theorem triangle_cut (g : Plane2 →ᵃ[ℚ] ℚ) (T : Finset Plane2)
    (hcard : T.card ≤ 3) {x : Plane2} (hxT : x ∈ convexHull ℚ (↑T : Set Plane2)) (hgx : 0 ≤ g x)
    (K : Set Plane2)
    (hKkeep : ∀ y ∈ T, 0 ≤ g y → y ∈ K)
    (hKcross : ∀ p ∈ T, ∀ q ∈ T, 0 ≤ g p → g q < 0 → crossingPt g p q ∈ K) :
    x ∈ convexHull ℚ K
proof:
:= by
  classical
  
  rw [Finset.convexHull_eq] at hxT
  obtain ⟨w, hw0, hw1, hwcm⟩ := hxT
  subst hwcm
  
  set Pset : Finset Plane2 := T.filter (fun y => 0 ≤ g y) with hPset
  set Nset : Finset Plane2 := T.filter (fun y => ¬ (0 ≤ g y)) with hNset
  have hpart : Pset.card + Nset.card = T.card :=
    Finset.filter_card_add_filter_neg_card_eq_card (fun y => 0 ≤ g y)
  have hgx' : 0 ≤ g (T.centerMass w id) := hgx
  
  have hNmem : ∀ y ∈ Nset, g y < 0 := by
    intro y hy; rw [hNset, Finset.mem_filter] at hy; exact lt_of_not_le hy.2
  have hPmem : ∀ y ∈ Pset, 0 ≤ g y := by
    intro y hy; rw [hPset, Finset.mem_filter] at hy; exact hy.2
  
  rcases Nat.lt_or_ge Nset.card 2 with hN2 | hN2
  · 
    rcases Nat.lt_or_ge Nset.card 1 with hN0 | hN1
    · 
      have hNe : Nset = ∅ := Finset.card_eq_zero.mp (by omega)
      have hallpos : ∀ y ∈ T, 0 ≤ g y := by
        intro y hy
        by_contra hneg
        have : y ∈ Nset := by rw [hNset, Finset.mem_filter]; exact ⟨hy, hneg⟩
        rw [hNe] at this; exact absurd this (Finset.not_mem_empty y)
      apply Finset.centerMass_mem_convexHull T hw0 (by rw [hw1]; norm_num)
      intro y hy; exact hKkeep y hy (hallpos y hy)
    · 
      have hNcard1 : Nset.card = 1 := by omega
      obtain ⟨n, hNeq⟩ := Finset.card_eq_one.mp hNcard1
      have hnN : n ∈ Nset := by rw [hNeq]; exact Finset.mem_singleton_self n
      have hnT : n ∈ T := by rw [hNset, Finset.mem_filter] at hnN; exact hnN.1
      have hgn : g n < 0 := hNmem n hnN
      have hrest : ∀ y ∈ T, y ≠ n → 0 ≤ g y := by
        intro y hy hyn
        by_contra hneg
        have hyN : y ∈ Nset := by rw [hNset, Finset.mem_filter]; exact ⟨hy, hneg⟩
        rw [hNeq, Finset.mem_singleton] at hyN; exact hyn hyN
      exact hub_neg g T w hw0 hw1 hnT hgn hrest hgx' K hKkeep
        (fun p hp hgp => hKcross p hp n hnT hgp hgn)
  · 
    have hPle1 : Pset.card ≤ 1 := by omega
    rcases Nat.lt_or_ge Pset.card 1 with hP0 | hP1
    · 
      exfalso
      have hPe : Pset = ∅ := Finset.card_eq_zero.mp (by omega)
      have hallneg : ∀ y ∈ T, g y < 0 := by
        intro y hy
        by_contra hpos
        push_neg at hpos
        have : y ∈ Pset := by rw [hPset, Finset.mem_filter]; exact ⟨hy, hpos⟩
        rw [hPe] at this; exact absurd this (Finset.not_mem_empty y)
      
      have hgeq : g (T.centerMass w id) = ∑ y ∈ T, w y * g y := g_centerMass_eq g T w hw1
      have hTne : T.Nonempty := by
        rw [← Finset.card_pos]; omega
      have hnonpos : ∀ y ∈ T, w y * g y ≤ 0 := by
        intro y hy; exact mul_nonpos_iff.mpr (Or.inl ⟨hw0 y hy, (hallneg y hy).le⟩)
      have hexneg : ∃ y ∈ T, w y * g y < 0 := by
        obtain ⟨y, hy, hwy⟩ : ∃ y ∈ T, 0 < w y := by
          by_contra hcon; push_neg at hcon
          have : ∑ y ∈ T, w y = 0 := by
            apply Finset.sum_eq_zero; intro y hy; exact le_antisymm (hcon y hy) (hw0 y hy)
          rw [this] at hw1; norm_num at hw1
        exact ⟨y, hy, mul_neg_of_pos_of_neg hwy (hallneg y hy)⟩
      have hsumneg : ∑ y ∈ T, w y * g y < 0 := Finset.sum_neg' hnonpos hexneg
      rw [hgeq] at hgx'; linarith
    · 
      have hPcard1 : Pset.card = 1 := by omega
      obtain ⟨p, hPeq⟩ := Finset.card_eq_one.mp hPcard1
      have hpP : p ∈ Pset := by rw [hPeq]; exact Finset.mem_singleton_self p
      have hpT : p ∈ T := by rw [hPset, Finset.mem_filter] at hpP; exact hpP.1
      have hgp : 0 ≤ g p := hPmem p hpP
      have hrest : ∀ y ∈ T, y ≠ p → g y < 0 := by
        intro y hy hyp
        by_contra hpos
        push_neg at hpos
        have hyP : y ∈ Pset := by rw [hPset, Finset.mem_filter]; exact ⟨hy, hpos⟩
        rw [hPeq, Finset.mem_singleton] at hyP; exact hyp hyP
      rcases lt_or_eq_of_le hgp with hgppos | hgpz
      · 
        exact hub_pos g T w hw0 hw1 hpT hgppos hrest hgx' K
          (hKkeep p hpT hgp)
          (fun q hq hgq => hKcross p hpT q hq hgp hgq)
      · 
        
        have hgeq : g (T.centerMass w id) = ∑ y ∈ T, w y * g y := g_centerMass_eq g T w hw1
        have hgple : 0 = g p := hgpz
        have hterm_nonpos : ∀ y ∈ T, w y * g y ≤ 0 := by
          intro y hy
          by_cases hyp : y = p
          · rw [hyp, ← hgple, mul_zero]
          · exact mul_nonpos_iff.mpr (Or.inl ⟨hw0 y hy, (hrest y hy hyp).le⟩)
        have hsum0 : ∑ y ∈ T, w y * g y = 0 := by
          have hle : ∑ y ∈ T, w y * g y ≤ 0 := Finset.sum_nonpos hterm_nonpos
          have hge : 0 ≤ ∑ y ∈ T, w y * g y := by rw [← hgeq]; exact hgx'
          linarith
        
        have hterm0 : ∀ y ∈ T, w y * g y = 0 := by
          intro y hy
          by_contra hne
          have hlt : w y * g y < 0 := lt_of_le_of_ne (hterm_nonpos y hy) hne
          have hrest' : ∀ z ∈ T, w z * g z ≤ 0 := hterm_nonpos
          have : ∑ z ∈ T, w z * g z < 0 :=
            Finset.sum_neg' hrest' ⟨y, hy, hlt⟩
          rw [hsum0] at this; exact absurd this (lt_irrefl 0)
        
        have hwneg0 : ∀ y ∈ T, y ≠ p → w y = 0 := by
          intro y hy hyp
          have := hterm0 y hy
          rcases mul_eq_zero.mp this with h | h
          · exact h
          · exact absurd h (hrest y hy hyp).ne
        
        have hxp : T.centerMass w id = p := by
          rw [Finset.centerMass_eq_of_sum_1 _ _ hw1]
          rw [← Finset.add_sum_erase T (fun y => w y • (id y : Plane2)) hpT]
          have hzero : ∑ y ∈ T.erase p, w y • (id y : Plane2) = 0 := by
            apply Finset.sum_eq_zero
            intro y hy
            rw [Finset.mem_erase] at hy
            rw [hwneg0 y hy.2 hy.1, zero_smul]
          rw [hzero, add_zero]
          have hwp1 : w p = 1 := by
            have := hw1
            rw [← Finset.add_sum_erase T w hpT] at this
            have hez : ∑ y ∈ T.erase p, w y = 0 := by
              apply Finset.sum_eq_zero; intro y hy; rw [Finset.mem_erase] at hy
              exact hwneg0 y hy.2 hy.1
            rw [hez, add_zero] at this; exact this
          rw [hwp1, one_smul]; rfl
        rw [hxp]
        exact subset_convexHull ℚ K (hKkeep p hpT hgp)

name: convex_cut
statement:
theorem convex_cut (g : Plane2 →ᵃ[ℚ] ℚ) (_hg : NonVacuous g) (S : Finset Plane2) :
    ∃ S' : Finset Plane2,
      convexHull ℚ (↑S : Set Plane2) ∩ {y | 0 ≤ g y} = convexHull ℚ (↑S' : Set Plane2)
        ∧ (↑S' : Set Plane2) ⊆ {y | 0 ≤ g y}
proof:
:= by
  classical
  
  set Skeep : Finset Plane2 := S.filter (fun y => 0 ≤ g y) with hSkeep
  
  set Xset : Finset Plane2 :=
    ((S ×ˢ S).filter (fun p => 0 ≤ g p.1 ∧ g p.2 < 0)).image
      (fun p => crossingPt g p.1 p.2) with hXset
  refine ⟨Skeep ∪ Xset, ?_, ?_⟩
  · 
    apply Set.Subset.antisymm
    · 
      
      rintro x ⟨hxhull, hxg⟩
      simp only [Set.mem_setOf_eq] at hxg
      
      rw [convexHull_eq_union] at hxhull
      simp only [Set.mem_iUnion] at hxhull
      obtain ⟨T, hTS, hTai, hxT⟩ := hxhull
      
      have hcard : T.card ≤ 3 := by
        have hb := hTai.card_le_finrank_succ
        
        have key : Fintype.card {x // x ∈ (↑T : Set Plane2)} ≤ Module.finrank ℚ Plane2 + 1 :=
          le_trans hb (by gcongr; exact Submodule.finrank_le _)
        rw [show Module.finrank ℚ Plane2 = 2 from Module.finrank_fin_fun ℚ,
            show Fintype.card {x // x ∈ (↑T : Set Plane2)} = T.card from by
              simp [Fintype.card_coe]] at key
        omega
      
      refine triangle_cut g T hcard hxT hxg (↑(Skeep ∪ Xset) : Set Plane2) ?_ ?_
      · 
        intro y hyT hgy
        have hyS : y ∈ S := hTS hyT
        rw [Finset.coe_union, Set.mem_union]
        left
        rw [hSkeep, Finset.coe_filter, Set.mem_setOf_eq]
        exact ⟨hyS, hgy⟩
      · 
        intro p hpT q hqT hgp hgq
        have hpS : p ∈ S := hTS hpT
        have hqS : q ∈ S := hTS hqT
        rw [Finset.coe_union, Set.mem_union]
        right
        rw [hXset, Finset.coe_image, Set.mem_image]
        refine ⟨(p, q), ?_, rfl⟩
        rw [Finset.coe_filter, Set.mem_setOf_eq]
        refine ⟨?_, hgp, hgq⟩
        simp only [Finset.mem_coe, Finset.mem_product]
        exact ⟨hpS, hqS⟩
    · 
      apply convexHull_min
      · 
        rintro x hx
        simp only [Finset.coe_union, Set.mem_union] at hx
        refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
        · rcases hx with hk | hc
          · 
            rw [hSkeep, Finset.coe_filter] at hk
            exact subset_convexHull ℚ _ hk.1
          · 
            rw [hXset, Finset.coe_image, Set.mem_image] at hc
            obtain ⟨p, hp, rfl⟩ := hc
            rw [Finset.coe_filter, Set.mem_setOf_eq] at hp
            obtain ⟨hpS, hp1, hp2⟩ := hp
            simp only [Finset.mem_coe, Finset.mem_product] at hpS
            refine convexHull_mono ?_ (crossingPt_mem_hull g hp1 hp2)
            rintro z hz
            simp only [Set.mem_insert_iff, Set.mem_singleton_iff] at hz
            rcases hz with rfl | rfl
            · exact hpS.1
            · exact hpS.2
        · 
          rcases hx with hk | hc
          · rw [hSkeep, Finset.coe_filter, Set.mem_setOf_eq] at hk
            exact hk.2
          · rw [hXset, Finset.coe_image, Set.mem_image] at hc
            obtain ⟨p, hp, rfl⟩ := hc
            rw [Finset.coe_filter, Set.mem_setOf_eq] at hp
            obtain ⟨_, hp1, hp2⟩ := hp
            rw [Set.mem_setOf_eq, g_crossingPt g hp1 hp2]
      · exact (convex_convexHull ℚ _).inter (convex_halfspace_ge g)
  · 
    rintro x hx
    simp only [Finset.coe_union, Set.mem_union] at hx
    rcases hx with hk | hc
    · rw [hSkeep, Finset.coe_filter, Set.mem_setOf_eq] at hk
      exact hk.2
    · rw [hXset, Finset.coe_image, Set.mem_image] at hc
      obtain ⟨p, hp, rfl⟩ := hc
      rw [Finset.coe_filter, Set.mem_setOf_eq] at hp
      obtain ⟨_, hp1, hp2⟩ := hp
      rw [Set.mem_setOf_eq, g_crossingPt g hp1 hp2]

name: mem_convexHull_erase_of_coeff_lt_one
statement:
private theorem mem_convexHull_erase_of_coeff_lt_one (W : Finset Plane2) (w : Plane2)
    (hw : w ∈ W) (wa : Plane2 → ℚ) (hwa0 : ∀ y ∈ W, 0 ≤ wa y) (hwa1 : ∑ y ∈ W, wa y = 1)
    (hcm : W.centerMass wa id = w) (hlt : wa w < 1) :
    w ∈ convexHull ℚ (↑(W.erase w) : Set Plane2)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have hpos : 0 < 1 - wa w := by linarith
  have hsumerase : ∑ y ∈ W.erase w, wa y = 1 - wa w := by
    have := Finset.add_sum_erase W wa hw; linarith
  have hsum : wa w • w + ∑ y ∈ W.erase w, wa y • (id y) = w := by
    have h1 : W.centerMass wa id = ∑ y ∈ W, wa y • (id y) :=
      Finset.centerMass_eq_of_sum_1 _ _ hwa1
    rw [← Finset.add_sum_erase W (fun y => wa y • (id y)) hw] at h1
    rw [h1] at hcm; exact hcm
  set S := ∑ y ∈ W.erase w, wa y • (id y) with hS
  have hiso : (1 - wa w) • w = S := by
    have hSeq : S = w - wa w • w := by
      have := eq_sub_of_add_eq (by rw [add_comm]; exact hsum :
        ∑ y ∈ W.erase w, wa y • (id y) + wa w • w = w)
      rw [← hS] at this; exact this
    rw [hSeq, sub_smul, one_smul]
  rw [Finset.convexHull_eq]
  refine ⟨fun y => wa y / (1 - wa w), ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · intro y hy; exact div_nonneg (hwa0 y (Finset.mem_of_mem_erase hy)) hpos.le
  · rw [← Finset.sum_div, hsumerase]; field_simp
  · rw [Finset.centerMass_eq_of_sum_1 _ _ (by rw [← Finset.sum_div, hsumerase]; field_simp)]
    have hrw : ∑ y ∈ W.erase w, (wa y / (1 - wa w)) • (id y) = (1 - wa w)⁻¹ • S := by
      rw [hS, Finset.smul_sum]; apply Finset.sum_congr rfl; intro y hy
      rw [smul_smul, div_eq_inv_mul]
    rw [hrw, ← hiso, smul_smul, inv_mul_cancel₀ hpos.ne', one_smul]

name: centerMass_eq_of_coeff_one
proof:
:= by
  classical
  rw [Finset.centerMass_eq_of_sum_1 _ _ hα1]
  have hzero : ∀ y ∈ W, y ≠ w → α y = 0 := by
    intro y hy hyw
    by_contra h
    have hpos : 0 < α y := lt_of_le_of_ne (hα0 y hy) (Ne.symm h)
    have hle : α w + α y ≤ ∑ z ∈ W, α z := by
      have hsub : ({w, y} : Finset Plane2) ⊆ W := by
        intro z hz; simp only [Finset.mem_insert, Finset.mem_singleton] at hz
        rcases hz with rfl | rfl <;> assumption
      calc α w + α y = ∑ z ∈ ({w, y} : Finset Plane2), α z := by rw [Finset.sum_pair (Ne.symm hyw)]
        _ ≤ ∑ z ∈ W, α z := Finset.sum_le_sum_of_subset_of_nonneg hsub (fun z hz _ => hα0 z hz)
    rw [hα1, hαw] at hle; linarith
  rw [Finset.sum_eq_single w]
  · rw [hαw, one_smul]; rfl
  · intro y hy hyw; rw [hzero y hy hyw, zero_smul]
  · intro h; exact absurd hw h

name: mem_convexHull_erase_of_not_extreme
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have hwhull : w ∈ convexHull ℚ (↑W : Set Plane2) := subset_convexHull ℚ _ hw
  obtain ⟨a, ha, b, hb, hab, hseg⟩ :
      ∃ a ∈ convexHull ℚ (↑W : Set Plane2), ∃ b ∈ convexHull ℚ (↑W : Set Plane2),
        a ≠ b ∧ w ∈ openSegment ℚ a b := by
    rw [mem_extremePoints] at hne; push_neg at hne
    obtain ⟨a, ha, b, hb, hsg, hc⟩ := hne hwhull
    refine ⟨a, ha, b, hb, ?_, hsg⟩
    intro heq; rw [heq, openSegment_same] at hsg
    simp only [Set.mem_singleton_iff] at hsg
    exact hc (heq.trans hsg.symm) hsg.symm
  rw [Finset.convexHull_eq] at ha hb
  obtain ⟨α, hα0, hα1, hαcm⟩ := ha
  obtain ⟨β, hβ0, hβ1, hβcm⟩ := hb
  obtain ⟨θ1, θ2, hθ1, hθ2, hθsum, hwθ⟩ := hseg
  set wa : Plane2 → ℚ := fun v => θ1 * α v + θ2 * β v with hwadef
  have hwa0 : ∀ y ∈ W, 0 ≤ wa y := fun y hy =>
    add_nonneg (mul_nonneg hθ1.le (hα0 y hy)) (mul_nonneg hθ2.le (hβ0 y hy))
  have hwa1 : ∑ y ∈ W, wa y = 1 := by
    simp only [hwadef, Finset.sum_add_distrib, ← Finset.mul_sum, hα1, hβ1, mul_one]; linarith
  have hwacm : W.centerMass wa id = w := by
    have hcmsplit : W.centerMass wa id = θ1 • W.centerMass α id + θ2 • W.centerMass β id := by
      rw [Finset.centerMass_eq_of_sum_1 _ _ hwa1, Finset.centerMass_eq_of_sum_1 _ _ hα1,
          Finset.centerMass_eq_of_sum_1 _ _ hβ1, Finset.smul_sum, Finset.smul_sum,
          ← Finset.sum_add_distrib]
      apply Finset.sum_congr rfl; intro y hy
      simp only [hwadef, smul_smul, add_smul]
    rw [hcmsplit, hαcm, hβcm, ← hwθ]
  have hwawlt : wa w < 1 := by
    by_contra hge
    push_neg at hge
    have hαle : α w ≤ 1 := by have := Finset.single_le_sum hα0 hw; rw [hα1] at this; exact this
    have hβle : β w ≤ 1 := by have := Finset.single_le_sum hβ0 hw; rw [hβ1] at this; exact this
    have hwaw_le : wa w ≤ 1 := by
      have h1 : θ1 * α w ≤ θ1 * 1 := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hαle hθ1.le
      have h2 : θ2 * β w ≤ θ2 * 1 := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hβle hθ2.le
      simp only [hwadef]; rw [mul_one] at h1 h2; linarith
    have hwaw_eq : wa w = 1 := le_antisymm hwaw_le hge
    have hαw1 : α w = 1 := by
      by_contra hαne
      have hαlt : α w < 1 := lt_of_le_of_ne hαle hαne
      have hlt1 : θ1 * α w < θ1 * 1 := mul_lt_mul_of_pos_left hαlt hθ1
      have h2 : θ2 * β w ≤ θ2 * 1 := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hβle hθ2.le
      simp only [hwadef] at hwaw_eq; rw [mul_one] at hlt1 h2; linarith
    have hβw1 : β w = 1 := by
      by_contra hβne
      have hβlt : β w < 1 := lt_of_le_of_ne hβle hβne
      have hlt2 : θ2 * β w < θ2 * 1 := mul_lt_mul_of_pos_left hβlt hθ2
      have h1 : θ1 * α w ≤ θ1 * 1 := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hαle hθ1.le
      simp only [hwadef] at hwaw_eq; rw [mul_one] at hlt2 h1; linarith
    have haw : a = w := by rw [← hαcm]; exact centerMass_eq_of_coeff_one W α hα0 hα1 w hw hαw1
    have hbw : b = w := by rw [← hβcm]; exact centerMass_eq_of_coeff_one W β hβ0 hβ1 w hw hβw1
    exact hab (haw.trans hbw.symm)
  exact mem_convexHull_erase_of_coeff_lt_one W w hw wa hwa0 hwa1 hwacm hwawlt

name: convexHull_erase_eq_of_mem
proof:
:= by
  classical
  apply Set.Subset.antisymm
  · exact convexHull_mono (by simp [Finset.erase_subset])
  · apply convexHull_min _ (convex_convexHull ℚ _)
    intro x hx
    rw [Finset.mem_coe] at hx
    by_cases hxw : x = w
    · rw [hxw]; exact hwin
    · exact subset_convexHull ℚ _ (by rw [Finset.coe_erase]; exact ⟨hx, hxw⟩)

name: subset_convexHull_of_finite_generating
proof:
:= by
  intro W
  induction W using Finset.strongInduction with
  | _ W IH =>
    intro hWP
    by_cases hall : ∀ w ∈ W, w ∈ Set.extremePoints ℚ Pset
    · rw [← hWP]
      apply convexHull_min _ (convex_convexHull ℚ _)
      intro x hx
      rw [Finset.mem_coe] at hx
      exact subset_convexHull ℚ _ (hext_sub (hall x hx))
    · push_neg at hall
      obtain ⟨w, hwW, hwne⟩ := hall
      have hwne' : w ∉ Set.extremePoints ℚ (convexHull ℚ (↑W : Set Plane2)) := by
        rw [hWP]; exact hwne
      have hwin := mem_convexHull_erase_of_not_extreme W w hwW hwne'
      have hpres := convexHull_erase_eq_of_mem W w hwin
      have hsmaller : W.erase w ⊂ W := Finset.erase_ssubset hwW
      have hWP' : convexHull ℚ (↑(W.erase w) : Set Plane2) = Pset := by rw [hpres]; exact hWP
      exact IH (W.erase w) hsmaller hWP'

name: convex_boxSet
statement: private theorem convex_boxSet (R : ℚ) : Convex ℚ (boxSet R)
proof:
:= by
  intro x hx y hy a b ha hb hab
  simp only [boxSet, Set.mem_setOf_eq] at hx hy ⊢
  obtain ⟨hx0, hx1⟩ := hx
  obtain ⟨hy0, hy1⟩ := hy
  have hcoord : ∀ i : Fin 2, (a • x + b • y) i = a * x i + b * y i := by
    intro i; simp [Pi.add_apply, Pi.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul]
  refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
  · rw [hcoord 0]
    calc |a * x 0 + b * y 0| ≤ |a * x 0| + |b * y 0| := abs_add _ _
      _ = a * |x 0| + b * |y 0| := by rw [abs_mul, abs_mul, abs_of_nonneg ha, abs_of_nonneg hb]
      _ ≤ a * R + b * R := by
          apply add_le_add (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hx0 ha) (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hy0 hb)
      _ = R := by rw [← add_mul, hab, one_mul]
  · rw [hcoord 1]
    calc |a * x 1 + b * y 1| ≤ |a * x 1| + |b * y 1| := abs_add _ _
      _ = a * |x 1| + b * |y 1| := by rw [abs_mul, abs_mul, abs_of_nonneg ha, abs_of_nonneg hb]
      _ ≤ a * R + b * R := by
          apply add_le_add (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hx1 ha) (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hy1 hb)
      _ = R := by rw [← add_mul, hab, one_mul]

name: boxCorners_subset
statement:
private theorem boxCorners_subset (R : ℚ) (hR : 0 ≤ R) :
    (↑(boxCorners R) : Set Plane2) ⊆ boxSet R
proof:
:= by
  intro z hz
  simp only [boxCorners, Finset.coe_insert, Finset.coe_singleton, Set.mem_insert_iff,
    Set.mem_singleton_iff] at hz
  simp only [boxSet, Set.mem_setOf_eq]
  rcases hz with rfl | rfl | rfl | rfl <;>
    simp only [Matrix.cons_val_zero, Matrix.cons_val_one, Matrix.head_cons, abs_neg,
      abs_of_nonneg hR] <;> exact ⟨le_refl R, le_refl R⟩

name: convexHull_boxCorners
statement:
private theorem convexHull_boxCorners (R : ℚ) (hR : 0 ≤ R) :
    convexHull ℚ (↑(boxCorners R) : Set Plane2) = boxSet R
proof:
:= by
  apply Set.Subset.antisymm
  · exact convexHull_min (boxCorners_subset R hR) (convex_boxSet R)
  · 
    intro y hy
    simp only [boxSet, Set.mem_setOf_eq] at hy
    obtain ⟨hy0, hy1⟩ := hy
    rcases eq_or_lt_of_le hR with hR0 | hRpos
    · 
      have hRz : R = 0 := hR0.symm
      subst hRz
      have hy00 : y 0 = 0 := by rw [abs_le] at hy0; linarith [hy0.1, hy0.2]
      have hy10 : y 1 = 0 := by rw [abs_le] at hy1; linarith [hy1.1, hy1.2]
      have hyeq : y = ![(0:ℚ), 0] := by
        funext i; fin_cases i <;> simp [hy00, hy10]
      rw [hyeq]
      apply subset_convexHull ℚ
      simp only [boxCorners, neg_zero, Finset.coe_insert, Finset.coe_singleton,
        Set.mem_insert_iff, Set.mem_singleton_iff]
      tauto
    · 
      set p : ℚ := (y 0 + R) / (2 * R) with hp
      set q : ℚ := (y 1 + R) / (2 * R) with hq
      have h2R : 0 < 2 * R := by linarith
      have hp0 : 0 ≤ p := by rw [hp]; apply div_nonneg _ h2R.le; rw [abs_le] at hy0; linarith [hy0.1]
      have hp1 : p ≤ 1 := by rw [hp, div_le_one h2R]; rw [abs_le] at hy0; linarith [hy0.2]
      have hq0 : 0 ≤ q := by rw [hq]; apply div_nonneg _ h2R.le; rw [abs_le] at hy1; linarith [hy1.1]
      have hq1 : q ≤ 1 := by rw [hq, div_le_one h2R]; rw [abs_le] at hy1; linarith [hy1.2]
      
      have hp2 : R * (2 * p - 1) = y 0 := by rw [hp]; field_simp; ring
      have hq2 : R * (2 * q - 1) = y 1 := by rw [hq]; field_simp; ring
      set wf : Fin 4 → ℚ := ![p * q, p * (1 - q), (1 - p) * q, (1 - p) * (1 - q)] with hwf
      set zf : Fin 4 → Plane2 := ![![R, R], ![R, -R], ![-R, R], ![-R, -R]] with hzf
      apply mem_convexHull_of_exists_fintype wf zf
      · 
        intro i; fin_cases i <;> simp only [hwf, Matrix.cons_val_zero, Matrix.cons_val_one,
          Matrix.head_cons, Matrix.cons_val_fin_one] <;>
          [exact mul_nonneg hp0 hq0; exact mul_nonneg hp0 (by linarith);
           exact mul_nonneg (by linarith) hq0; exact mul_nonneg (by linarith) (by linarith)]
      · 
        rw [hwf, Fin.sum_univ_four]
        simp only [Matrix.cons_val_zero, Matrix.cons_val_one, Matrix.head_cons,
          Matrix.cons_val_two, Matrix.tail_cons, Matrix.cons_val_three]
        ring
      · 
        intro i
        simp only [boxCorners, Finset.coe_insert, Finset.coe_singleton, Set.mem_insert_iff,
          Set.mem_singleton_iff]
        fin_cases i <;> simp only [hzf, Matrix.cons_val_zero, Matrix.cons_val_one, Matrix.head_cons,
          Matrix.cons_val_two, Matrix.tail_cons, Matrix.cons_val_three] <;> tauto
      · 
        funext j
        rw [Fin.sum_univ_four]
        simp only [hwf, hzf, Pi.add_apply, Pi.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul]
        fin_cases j <;>
          simp only [Matrix.cons_val_zero, Matrix.cons_val_one, Matrix.head_cons,
            Matrix.cons_val_two, Matrix.tail_cons, Matrix.cons_val_three, Matrix.cons_val_fin_one,
            Fin.mk_zero, Fin.mk_one] <;>
          [(rw [← hp2]; ring); (rw [← hq2]; ring)]

name: vacuous_const
statement:
private theorem vacuous_const (f : Plane2 →ᵃ[ℚ] ℚ) (hf : f.linear = 0) (y z : Plane2) :
    f y = f z
proof:
:= by
  have := affine_linear_sub f y z
  rw [hf] at this
  simp only [LinearMap.zero_apply] at this
  linarith

name: box_constraint_hull
statement:
private theorem box_constraint_hull {m : ℕ} (g : Fin m → (Plane2 →ᵃ[ℚ] ℚ)) (R : ℚ) (hR : 0 ≤ R)
    (s : Finset (Fin m)) :
    ∃ W : Finset Plane2,
      (↑W : Set Plane2) ⊆ boxSet R ∩ (⋂ i ∈ s, {y | 0 ≤ g i y})
      ∧ convexHull ℚ (↑W : Set Plane2) = boxSet R ∩ (⋂ i ∈ s, {y | 0 ≤ g i y})
proof:
:= by
  classical
  induction s using Finset.induction with
  | empty =>
    refine ⟨boxCorners R, ?_, ?_⟩
    · simp only [Finset.not_mem_empty, Set.iInter_of_empty, Set.iInter_univ, Set.inter_univ]
      exact boxCorners_subset R hR
    · simp only [Finset.not_mem_empty, Set.iInter_of_empty, Set.iInter_univ, Set.inter_univ]
      exact convexHull_boxCorners R hR
  | @insert i₀ s hi₀ IH =>
    obtain ⟨W, hWsub, hWhull⟩ := IH
    
    set Q : Set Plane2 := boxSet R ∩ (⋂ i ∈ s, {y | 0 ≤ g i y}) with hQ
    
    have hregion : boxSet R ∩ (⋂ i ∈ insert i₀ s, {y | 0 ≤ g i y}) = Q ∩ {y | 0 ≤ g i₀ y} := by
      rw [hQ]
      rw [Finset.set_biInter_insert]
      ext y; simp only [Set.mem_inter_iff, Set.mem_iInter, Set.mem_setOf_eq]; tauto
    rw [hregion]
    by_cases hnv : (g i₀).linear = 0
    · 
      by_cases hc : 0 ≤ g i₀ (0 : Plane2)
      · 
        have huniv : {y | 0 ≤ g i₀ y} = (Set.univ : Set Plane2) := by
          ext y; simp only [Set.mem_setOf_eq, Set.mem_univ, iff_true]
          rw [vacuous_const (g i₀) hnv y 0]; exact hc
        rw [huniv, Set.inter_univ]
        exact ⟨W, hWsub, hWhull⟩
      · 
        have hempty : {y | 0 ≤ g i₀ y} = (∅ : Set Plane2) := by
          ext y; simp only [Set.mem_setOf_eq, Set.mem_empty_iff_false, iff_false, not_le]
          rw [vacuous_const (g i₀) hnv y 0]; exact lt_of_not_le hc
        rw [hempty, Set.inter_empty]
        refine ⟨∅, by simp, by simp⟩
    · 
      obtain ⟨W', hW'hull, hW'feas⟩ := convex_cut (g i₀) hnv W
      refine ⟨W', ?_, ?_⟩
      · 
        have hsub1 : (↑W' : Set Plane2) ⊆ convexHull ℚ (↑W' : Set Plane2) :=
          subset_convexHull ℚ _
        have heq : convexHull ℚ (↑W' : Set Plane2) = Q ∩ {y | 0 ≤ g i₀ y} := by
          rw [← hW'hull, hWhull]
        rw [heq] at hsub1
        exact hsub1
      · 
        rw [← hW'hull, hWhull]

name: hpolytope_eq_convexHull_vertexSet
statement:
theorem hpolytope_eq_convexHull_vertexSet {m : ℕ} (g : Fin m → (Plane2 →ᵃ[ℚ] ℚ))
    (P' : Set Plane2) (hP' : P' = ⋂ i, {y | 0 ≤ g i y})
    (hbdd : ∃ (R : ℚ), P' ⊆ {y | |y 0| ≤ R ∧ |y 1| ≤ R})
    (hdim : Module.finrank ℚ (vectorSpan ℚ P') = 2) :
    P' = convexHull ℚ (vertexSet g P')
proof:
:= by
  have hconv : Convex ℚ P' := convex_P' g P' hP'
  apply Set.Subset.antisymm
  · 
    
    
    
    
    
    
    
    
    have hext_sub : Set.extremePoints ℚ P' ⊆ vertexSet g P' :=
      fun x hx => extremePoint_mem_vertexSet g P' hP' hx
    
    
    
    
    
    obtain ⟨W, _hWP', hWgen⟩ :
        ∃ W : Finset Plane2, (↑W : Set Plane2) ⊆ P' ∧ convexHull ℚ (↑W : Set Plane2) = P' := by
      
      obtain ⟨R, hRbdd⟩ := hbdd
      have hPne : P'.Nonempty := by
        rcases Set.eq_empty_or_nonempty P' with hpe | hpne
        · rw [hpe, vectorSpan_empty] at hdim; simp at hdim
        · exact hpne
      obtain ⟨y0, hy0P⟩ := hPne
      
      have hR0 : 0 ≤ R := by
        have := hRbdd hy0P
        simp only [Set.mem_setOf_eq] at this
        exact le_trans (abs_nonneg _) this.1
      
      have hPbox : P' ⊆ boxSet R := fun y hy => hRbdd hy
      
      have hfull : boxSet R ∩ (⋂ i ∈ (Finset.univ : Finset (Fin m)), {y | 0 ≤ g i y}) = P' := by
        have hiInter : (⋂ i ∈ (Finset.univ : Finset (Fin m)), {y | 0 ≤ g i y})
            = ⋂ i, {y | 0 ≤ g i y} := by
          ext y; simp only [Finset.mem_univ, Set.mem_iInter, Set.mem_setOf_eq, true_implies]
        rw [hiInter, ← hP']
        exact Set.inter_eq_self_of_subset_right hPbox
      obtain ⟨W, hWsub, hWhull⟩ := box_constraint_hull g R hR0 Finset.univ
      rw [hfull] at hWsub hWhull
      exact ⟨W, hWsub, hWhull⟩
    
    exact subset_convexHull_of_finite_generating P' (vertexSet g P') hext_sub W hWgen
  · 
    apply convexHull_min _ hconv
    intro v hv
    exact hv.1

name: three_le_vertexSet_ncard
statement:
theorem three_le_vertexSet_ncard {m : ℕ} (g : Fin m → (Plane2 →ᵃ[ℚ] ℚ))
    (P' : Set Plane2) (hP' : P' = ⋂ i, {y | 0 ≤ g i y})
    (hbdd : ∃ (R : ℚ), P' ⊆ {y | |y 0| ≤ R ∧ |y 1| ≤ R})
    (hdim : Module.finrank ℚ (vectorSpan ℚ P') = 2) :
    3 ≤ (vertexSet g P').ncard
proof:
:= by
  
  
  
  
  
  
  
  
  
  
  
  classical
  by_contra hlt
  push_neg at hlt
  have hle : (vertexSet g P').ncard ≤ 2 := by omega
  have hfin : (vertexSet g P').Finite := vertexSet_finite g P'
  
  obtain ⟨p, hpP, hpai⟩ : ∃ (p : Fin 3 → Plane2), (∀ i, p i ∈ P') ∧ AffineIndependent ℚ p := by
    obtain ⟨t, hts, hspan, hai⟩ := exists_affineIndependent ℚ _ P'
    have hvs : vectorSpan ℚ t = vectorSpan ℚ P' := by
      rw [← direction_affineSpan ℚ t, ← direction_affineSpan ℚ P', hspan]
    have hfint : t.Finite := finite_set_of_fin_dim_affineIndependent ℚ hai
    have hft : Fintype t := hfint.fintype
    have hcard : Fintype.card t = 3 := by
      have hf2 : Module.finrank ℚ (vectorSpan ℚ (Set.range (Subtype.val : t → Plane2))) = 2 := by
        rw [Subtype.range_coe, hvs]; exact hdim
      rcases Nat.eq_zero_or_pos (Fintype.card t) with h0 | hpos
      · exfalso
        have hemp : IsEmpty t := Fintype.card_eq_zero_iff.mp h0
        have hr : Set.range (Subtype.val : t → Plane2) = ∅ := Set.range_eq_empty_iff.mpr hemp
        rw [hr, vectorSpan_empty] at hf2; simp at hf2
      · obtain ⟨n, hn⟩ := Nat.exists_eq_succ_of_ne_zero hpos.ne'
        have := hai.finrank_vectorSpan (n := n) (by rw [hn])
        rw [this] at hf2; omega
    have e : t ≃ Fin 3 := Fintype.equivFinOfCardEq hcard
    exact ⟨fun i => (e.symm i : Plane2), fun i => hts (e.symm i).2,
      hai.comp_embedding e.symm.toEmbedding⟩
  
  have hHV := hpolytope_eq_convexHull_vertexSet g P' hP' hbdd hdim
  have hpHull : ∀ i, p i ∈ convexHull ℚ (vertexSet g P') := fun i => by rw [← hHV]; exact hpP i
  
  have h2 : Module.finrank ℚ (vectorSpan ℚ (Set.range p)) = 2 := hpai.finrank_vectorSpan (by simp)
  have hsub : Set.range p ⊆ convexHull ℚ (vertexSet g P') := Set.range_subset_iff.mpr hpHull
  have heq : vectorSpan ℚ (convexHull ℚ (vertexSet g P')) = vectorSpan ℚ (vertexSet g P') := by
    rw [← direction_affineSpan ℚ _, ← direction_affineSpan ℚ _, affineSpan_convexHull]
  have hspan_le : vectorSpan ℚ (Set.range p) ≤ vectorSpan ℚ (vertexSet g P') := by
    have h1 : vectorSpan ℚ (Set.range p) ≤ vectorSpan ℚ (convexHull ℚ (vertexSet g P')) :=
      vectorSpan_mono ℚ hsub
    rwa [heq] at h1
  
  have hVdim : Module.finrank ℚ (vectorSpan ℚ (vertexSet g P')) ≤ 1 := by
    set F := hfin.toFinset with hF
    have hVF : (vertexSet g P' : Set Plane2) = (↑F : Set Plane2) := (Set.Finite.coe_toFinset hfin).symm
    have hcardF : F.card ≤ 2 := by
      have hc : (vertexSet g P').ncard = F.card := by rw [hF, Set.ncard_eq_toFinset_card _ hfin]
      omega
    rw [hVF]
    rcases Finset.eq_empty_or_nonempty F with hFe | hFne
    · rw [hFe, Finset.coe_empty, vectorSpan_empty]; simp
    · have hpos : 1 ≤ F.card := Finset.Nonempty.card_pos hFne
      obtain ⟨n, hn⟩ : ∃ n, F.card = n + 1 := ⟨F.card - 1, by omega⟩
      have hb := finrank_vectorSpan_image_finset_le (k := ℚ) (id : Plane2 → Plane2) F hn
      rw [Finset.image_id] at hb
      exact le_trans hb (by omega)
  have hcontra := Submodule.finrank_mono hspan_le
  rw [h2] at hcontra
  omega

name: exists_convexPosition_vertexFinset
statement:
theorem exists_convexPosition_vertexFinset {m : ℕ} (g : Fin m → (Plane2 →ᵃ[ℚ] ℚ))
    (P' : Set Plane2) (hP' : P' = ⋂ i, {y | 0 ≤ g i y})
    (hbdd : ∃ (R : ℚ), P' ⊆ {y | |y 0| ≤ R ∧ |y 1| ≤ R})
    (hdim : Module.finrank ℚ (vectorSpan ℚ P') = 2) :
    ∃ V : Finset Plane2,
      P' = convexHull ℚ (↑V : Set Plane2)
      ∧ (↑V : Set Plane2) ⊆ P'
      ∧ 3 ≤ V.card
      ∧ (∀ a ∈ V, ∀ b ∈ V, ∀ c ∈ V, a ≠ b → a ≠ c → b ≠ c →
          AffineIndependent ℚ ![a, b, c])
      ∧ (∀ v ∈ V, v ∈ Set.extremePoints ℚ P')
proof:
:= by
  classical
  
  have hfin := vertexSet_finite g P'
  refine ⟨hfin.toFinset, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · 
    rw [hfin.coe_toFinset]
    exact hpolytope_eq_convexHull_vertexSet g P' hP' hbdd hdim
  · 
    rw [hfin.coe_toFinset]
    intro v hv; exact hv.1
  · 
    have hncard := three_le_vertexSet_ncard g P' hP' hbdd hdim
    rw [Set.ncard_eq_toFinset_card _ hfin] at hncard
    exact hncard
  · 
    intro a ha b hb c hc hab hac hbc
    rw [hfin.mem_toFinset] at ha hb hc
    exact vertices_not_collinear g P' hP' ha hb hc hab hac hbc
  · 
    intro v hv
    rw [hfin.mem_toFinset] at hv
    exact vertex_mem_extremePoints g P' hP' hv

name: I3.ext_iff'
statement: theorem I3.ext_iff' (u v : I3) : u = v ↔ u.x = v.x ∧ u.y = v.y ∧ u.z = v.z
proof:
:= by
  constructor

  · rintro ⟨hx, hy, hz⟩; cases u; cases v; simp_all

name: decI_cross
statement:
theorem decI_cross (u v : I3) :

name: decI_dot

name: decI_det3
