name: decI_eq_zero_iff
statement: theorem decI_eq_zero_iff (u : I3) : decI u = 0 ↔ u.x = 0 ∧ u.y = 0 ∧ u.z = 0
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro h
    have h0 := congrFun h (0 : Fin 3)
    have h1 := congrFun h (1 : Fin 3)
    have h2 := congrFun h (2 : Fin 3)
    simp only [decI, Matrix.cons_val_zero, Matrix.cons_val_one, Matrix.head_cons,
      Matrix.cons_val_two, Matrix.tail_cons, Pi.zero_apply, Int.cast_eq_zero] at h0 h1 h2
    exact ⟨h0, h1, h2⟩
  · rintro ⟨hx, hy, hz⟩; funext i; fin_cases i <;> simp [decI, hx, hy, hz]

name: decI_isZero
statement: theorem decI_isZero (u : I3) : isZeroI u = true ↔ decI u = 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [decI_eq_zero_iff]
  simp only [isZeroI, Bool.and_eq_true, beq_iff_eq, and_assoc]

name: decI_eq_iff
statement: theorem decI_eq_iff (u v : I3) : decI u = decI v ↔ u = v
proof:
:= by
  rw [I3.ext_iff']
  constructor
  · intro h
    have h0 := congrFun h (0 : Fin 3)
    have h1 := congrFun h (1 : Fin 3)
    have h2 := congrFun h (2 : Fin 3)
    simp only [decI, Matrix.cons_val_zero, Matrix.cons_val_one, Matrix.head_cons,
      Matrix.cons_val_two, Matrix.tail_cons, Int.cast_inj] at h0 h1 h2
    exact ⟨h0, h1, h2⟩
  · rintro ⟨hx, hy, hz⟩; funext i; fin_cases i <;> simp [decI, hx, hy, hz]

name: decI_beq
statement: theorem decI_beq (u v : I3) : beqI u v = true ↔ decI u = decI v
proof:
:= by
  rw [decI_eq_iff, I3.ext_iff']
  simp only [beqI, Bool.and_eq_true, beq_iff_eq, and_assoc]

name: span_scale_mem
statement:
theorem span_scale_mem (c : ℚ) (hc : c ≠ 0) (w : Fin 3 → ℚ) (S : Set (Fin 3 → ℚ)) :
    c • w ∈ Submodule.span ℚ ((c • ·) '' S) ↔ w ∈ Submodule.span ℚ S
proof:
:= by
  set f : (Fin 3 → ℚ) →ₗ[ℚ] (Fin 3 → ℚ) := c • LinearMap.id with hf
  have hfp : ∀ x, f x = c • x := fun x => by simp [hf]
  have hinj : Function.Injective f := by
    intro a b hab; rw [hfp, hfp] at hab; exact smul_right_injective _ hc hab
  have hL : (c • ·) '' S = f '' S := by apply Set.image_congr'; intro x; rw [hfp]
  rw [hL, ← Submodule.map_span, ← hfp w, Submodule.mem_map]
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨q, hq, hqe⟩; rwa [hinj hqe] at hq
  · intro hp; exact ⟨w, hp, rfl⟩

name: scale_segment
statement:
theorem scale_segment (c : ℚ) (a b : Fin 3 → ℚ) :
    (c • ·) '' (segment ℚ a b) = segment ℚ (c • a) (c • b)
proof:
:= by
  rw [segment_eq_image_lineMap, segment_eq_image_lineMap, ← Set.image_comp]
  apply Set.image_congr'
  intro x
  simp [AffineMap.lineMap_apply, smul_add, smul_sub, smul_smul, mul_comm]

name: scale_mem_segment
statement:
theorem scale_mem_segment (c : ℚ) (hc : c ≠ 0) (p a b : Fin 3 → ℚ) :
    (c • p) ∈ segment ℚ (c • a) (c • b) ↔ p ∈ segment ℚ a b
proof:
:= by
  rw [← scale_segment]
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨q, hq, hqe⟩
    have : q = p := smul_right_injective _ hc hqe
    rwa [this] at hq
  · intro hp; exact ⟨p, hp, rfl⟩

name: isNormal_spec
statement:
theorem isNormal_spec (w : Chain) :
    Impl.Legacy.NormalCheck.isNormal w = true ↔ Legacy.Normal w
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · exact Proof.NormalCheckMain.isNormal_true_imp_normal
  · intro hNormal
    by_contra hne
    rw [Bool.not_eq_true] at hne
    exact Proof.NormalCheckMain.not_normal_of_isNormal_false hne hNormal

name: mul_den_eq_num
statement: private theorem mul_den_eq_num (q : ℚ) : q * (q.den : ℚ) = (q.num : ℚ)
proof:
:= by
  have hd0 : ((q.den : ℕ) : ℚ) ≠ 0 := by exact_mod_cast q.den_ne_zero
  have h := Rat.num_div_den q
  rw [div_eq_iff hd0] at h
  exact h.symm

name: num_cast_eq
statement:
private theorem num_cast_eq {q : ℚ} {L : ℕ} (hd : q.den ∣ L) :
    ((((Int.ofNat L : ℤ) : ℚ) * q).num : ℚ) = (L : ℚ) * q
proof:
:= by
  have hcast : ((Int.ofNat L : ℤ) : ℚ) = (L : ℚ) := by norm_cast
  rw [hcast]
  obtain ⟨k, hk⟩ := hd
  have heq : (L : ℚ) * q = ((q.num * k : ℤ) : ℚ) := by
    rw [hk]
    push_cast
    linear_combination (k : ℚ) * mul_den_eq_num q
  rw [heq, Rat.num_intCast]

name: toH4_x
statement:
private theorem toH4_x (p : P3) :
    (toH4 p).x = ((Int.ofNat ((p.x.den.lcm p.y.den).lcm p.z.den) : ℚ) * p.x).num
proof: := rfl

name: toH4_y
statement:
private theorem toH4_y (p : P3) :
    (toH4 p).y = ((Int.ofNat ((p.x.den.lcm p.y.den).lcm p.z.den) : ℚ) * p.y).num
proof: := rfl

name: toH4_z
statement:
private theorem toH4_z (p : P3) :
    (toH4 p).z = ((Int.ofNat ((p.x.den.lcm p.y.den).lcm p.z.den) : ℚ) * p.z).num
proof: := rfl

name: toH4_w
statement:
private theorem toH4_w (p : P3) :
    (toH4 p).w = Int.ofNat ((p.x.den.lcm p.y.den).lcm p.z.den)
proof: := rfl

name: toH4_repr
statement: theorem toH4_repr (p : P3) : repr4 (toH4 p) (P3.toPoint p)
proof:
:= by
  set L : ℕ := (p.x.den.lcm p.y.den).lcm p.z.den with hL
  have hLne : L ≠ 0 :=
    Nat.lcm_ne_zero (Nat.lcm_ne_zero (Rat.den_ne_zero _) (Rat.den_ne_zero _))
      (Rat.den_ne_zero _)
  have hLpos : 0 < L := Nat.pos_of_ne_zero hLne
  have hLQ : ((Int.ofNat L : ℤ) : ℚ) = (L : ℚ) := by norm_cast
  have hLQ0 : (L : ℚ) ≠ 0 := by exact_mod_cast hLne
  constructor
  · rw [toH4_w, ← hL]
    exact Int.ofNat_pos.mpr hLpos
  · have hcoord : ∀ r : ℚ, r.den ∣ L →
        ((((Int.ofNat L : ℚ) * r).num : ℤ) : ℚ) / ((Int.ofNat L : ℤ) : ℚ) = r := by
      intro r hr
      rw [num_cast_eq hr, hLQ, mul_comm, mul_div_assoc, div_self hLQ0, mul_one]
    rw [toH4_x, toH4_y, toH4_z, toH4_w, ← hL]
    rw [hcoord p.x (dvd_trans (Nat.dvd_lcm_left _ _) (Nat.dvd_lcm_left _ _)),
      hcoord p.y (dvd_trans (Nat.dvd_lcm_right _ _) (Nat.dvd_lcm_left _ _)),
      hcoord p.z (Nat.dvd_lcm_right _ _)]
    rfl

name: mkVtx_repr
statement: theorem mkVtx_repr (p : P3) : repr4 (mkVtx p).h (P3.toPoint (mkVtx p).p)
proof:
:=
  toH4_repr p

name: clearPlane_a
proof: := rfl

name: clearPlane_b
proof: := rfl

name: clearPlane_c
proof: := rfl

name: clearPlane_d
proof: := rfl

name: clearPlane_spec
statement:
theorem clearPlane_spec (n : P3) (c : ℚ) :
    ∃ m : ℚ, 0 < m ∧
      ((clearPlane n c).a : ℚ) = m * n.x ∧ ((clearPlane n c).b : ℚ) = m * n.y ∧
      ((clearPlane n c).c : ℚ) = m * n.z ∧ ((clearPlane n c).d : ℚ) = m * c
proof:
:= by
  set L : ℕ := ((n.x.den.lcm n.y.den).lcm n.z.den).lcm c.den with hL
  have hLne : L ≠ 0 :=
    Nat.lcm_ne_zero
      (Nat.lcm_ne_zero (Nat.lcm_ne_zero (Rat.den_ne_zero _) (Rat.den_ne_zero _))
        (Rat.den_ne_zero _))
      (Rat.den_ne_zero _)
  refine ⟨(L : ℚ), by exact_mod_cast Nat.pos_of_ne_zero hLne, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · rw [clearPlane_a, ← hL]
    exact num_cast_eq (dvd_trans (Nat.dvd_lcm_left _ _)
      (dvd_trans (Nat.dvd_lcm_left _ _) (Nat.dvd_lcm_left _ _)))
  · rw [clearPlane_b, ← hL]
    exact num_cast_eq (dvd_trans (Nat.dvd_lcm_right _ _)
      (dvd_trans (Nat.dvd_lcm_left _ _) (Nat.dvd_lcm_left _ _)))
  · rw [clearPlane_c, ← hL]
    exact num_cast_eq (dvd_trans (Nat.dvd_lcm_right _ _) (Nat.dvd_lcm_left _ _))
  · rw [clearPlane_d, ← hL]
    exact num_cast_eq (Nat.dvd_lcm_right _ _)

name: evalI_cast
statement:
theorem evalI_cast (g : IPlane) (q : H4) :
    ((evalI g q : ℤ) : ℚ)
      = (g.a : ℚ) * (q.x : ℚ) + (g.b : ℚ) * (q.y : ℚ) + (g.c : ℚ) * (q.z : ℚ)
        - (g.d : ℚ) * (q.w : ℚ)
proof:
:= by
  unfold evalI
  push_cast
  ring

name: boxFunctional_true
statement:
@[simp] theorem boxFunctional_true (Q : Point) (r : ℚ) (k : Fin 3) (P : Point) :
    boxFunctional Q r k true P = r - (P k - Q k)
proof:
:= by
  show (AffineMap.const ℚ Point (r + Q k) - coordAff k) P = r - (P k - Q k)
  rw [AffineMap.coe_sub, Pi.sub_apply, AffineMap.const_apply, coordAff_apply]; ring

name: boxFunctional_false
statement:
@[simp] theorem boxFunctional_false (Q : Point) (r : ℚ) (k : Fin 3) (P : Point) :
    boxFunctional Q r k false P = r + (P k - Q k)
proof:
:= by
  show (coordAff k + AffineMap.const ℚ Point (r - Q k)) P = r + (P k - Q k)
  rw [AffineMap.coe_add, Pi.add_apply, AffineMap.const_apply, coordAff_apply]; ring

name: boxFunctional_pos_self
statement:
theorem boxFunctional_pos_self (Q : Point) {r : ℚ} (k : Fin 3) (b : Bool) (hr : 0 < r) :

proof:
:= by
  cases b <;> simp only [boxFunctional_true, boxFunctional_false, sub_self, add_zero] <;> linarith

name: affNorm_nonneg
statement: theorem affNorm_nonneg (g : Point →ᵃ[ℚ] ℚ) : 0 ≤ affNorm g
proof:
:=
  Finset.sum_nonneg (fun _ _ => abs_nonneg _)

name: eq_sum_single
statement: theorem eq_sum_single (v : Point) : v = ∑ i : Fin 3, (v i) • basisVec i
proof:
:= by
  funext j
  rw [Finset.sum_apply]
  simp only [basisVec, Pi.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul]
  rw [Finset.sum_eq_single j]
  · simp [Pi.single_eq_same]
  · intro b _ hbj; rw [Pi.single_eq_of_ne hbj.symm, mul_zero]
  · intro hj; exact absurd (Finset.mem_univ j) hj

name: abs_linear_le
statement:
theorem abs_linear_le (g : Point →ᵃ[ℚ] ℚ) (v : Point) {r : ℚ}
    (hv : ∀ i, |v i| ≤ r) : |g.linear v| ≤ affNorm g * r
proof:
:= by
  have hexp : g.linear v = ∑ i : Fin 3, (v i) * g.linear (basisVec i) := by
    conv_lhs => rw [eq_sum_single v]
    rw [map_sum]
    exact Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun i _ => by rw [map_smul, smul_eq_mul])
  rw [hexp]
  refine (Finset.abs_sum_le_sum_abs _ _).trans ?_
  rw [affNorm, Finset.sum_mul]
  refine Finset.sum_le_sum (fun i _ => ?_)
  rw [abs_mul, mul_comm]
  exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (hv i) (abs_nonneg _)

name: exists_box_pos
statement:
theorem exists_box_pos {g : Point →ᵃ[ℚ] ℚ} {Q : Point} (hgQ : 0 < g Q) :
    ∃ r : ℚ, 0 < r ∧ ∀ P, (∀ i, |P i - Q i| ≤ r) → 0 < g P
proof:
:= by
  have hden : 0 < affNorm g + 1 := by linarith [affNorm_nonneg g]
  refine ⟨g Q / (affNorm g + 1), div_pos hgQ hden, fun P hP => ?_⟩
  set r := g Q / (affNorm g + 1) with hr
  have hrpos : 0 < r := div_pos hgQ hden
  
  have hdecomp : g P = g Q + g.linear (P - Q) := by
    have := g.map_vadd Q (P - Q)
    simp only [vadd_eq_add] at this
    rw [show P - Q + Q = P by ring] at this
    rw [this]; ring
  rw [hdecomp]
  have hbound : |g.linear (P - Q)| ≤ affNorm g * r := by
    refine abs_linear_le g (P - Q) (fun i => ?_)
    simpa using hP i
  have hlt : affNorm g * r < g Q := by
    rw [hr]
    have h1 : affNorm g / (affNorm g + 1) < 1 :=
      (div_lt_one hden).mpr (by linarith [affNorm_nonneg g])
    calc affNorm g * (g Q / (affNorm g + 1))
        = (affNorm g / (affNorm g + 1)) * g Q := by ring
      _ < 1 * g Q := by
          apply mul_lt_mul_of_pos_right h1 hgQ
      _ = g Q := one_mul _
  have := (abs_le.mp hbound).1
  linarith

name: exists_box_pos_family
statement:
theorem exists_box_pos_family {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι] (g : ι → (Point →ᵃ[ℚ] ℚ))
    {Q : Point} (hgQ : ∀ α, 0 < g α Q) :
    ∃ r : ℚ, 0 < r ∧ ∀ P, (∀ i, |P i - Q i| ≤ r) → ∀ α, 0 < g α P
proof:
:= by
  classical
  by_cases hemp : Nonempty ι
  · 
    have hr : ∀ α, ∃ r : ℚ, 0 < r ∧ ∀ P, (∀ i, |P i - Q i| ≤ r) → 0 < g α P :=
      fun α => exists_box_pos (hgQ α)
    choose rf hrpos hrspec using hr
    obtain ⟨α₀⟩ := hemp
    set r := Finset.univ.inf' ⟨α₀, Finset.mem_univ α₀⟩ rf with hrdef
    have hrpos' : 0 < r := by
      rw [hrdef, Finset.lt_inf'_iff]
      exact fun α _ => hrpos α
    refine ⟨r, hrpos', fun P hP α => ?_⟩
    have hle : r ≤ rf α := Finset.inf'_le _ (Finset.mem_univ α)
    exact hrspec α P (fun i => (hP i).trans hle)
  · refine ⟨1, one_pos, fun P _ α => absurd ⟨α⟩ hemp⟩

statement:
@[simp] theorem phiAff_apply' (t : Triangle) (P : Point) :
    SurfaceBridge.phiAff t P = cOf t - dot (faceNormal t) P
proof: := SurfaceBridge.phiAff_apply t P

name: negA_apply
statement: @[simp] theorem negA_apply (g : Point →ᵃ[ℚ] ℚ) (P : Point) : negA g P = - g P
proof: := rfl

name: mem_triangleSet_iff_signs
statement:
theorem mem_triangleSet_iff_signs {t : Triangle} (hn : faceNormal t ≠ 0) (x : Point) :
    x ∈ triangleSet t ↔
      dot (faceNormal t) x = cOf t ∧ 0 ≤ ee0 t x ∧ 0 ≤ ee1 t x ∧ 0 ≤ ee2 t x
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro hmem
    obtain ⟨h0, h1, h2⟩ := ee_nonneg_of_mem hmem
    exact ⟨triangleSet_carrier hmem, h0, h1, h2⟩
  · rintro ⟨hcar, h0, h1, h2⟩
    exact mem_triangleSet_of_carrier' hn hcar h0 h1 h2

name: exists_separating_box
proof:
:= by
  
  rw [mem_triangleSet_iff_signs hn] at hQ
  push_neg at hQ
  by_cases hcar : dot (faceNormal t) Q = cOf t
  · 
    have hk : ee0 t Q < 0 ∨ ee1 t Q < 0 ∨ ee2 t Q < 0 := by
      by_cases h0 : ee0 t Q < 0
      · exact Or.inl h0
      · by_cases h1 : ee1 t Q < 0
        · exact Or.inr (Or.inl h1)
        · exact Or.inr (Or.inr (hQ hcar (not_lt.mp h0) (not_lt.mp h1)))
    
    have hpick : ∃ g : Point →ᵃ[ℚ] ℚ,
        0 < g Q ∧ ∀ P, dot (faceNormal t) P = cOf t → 0 < g P → P ∉ triangleSet t := by
      rcases hk with hk | hk | hk
      · refine ⟨negA (ee0A t), by rw [negA_apply, ee0A_apply]; linarith, ?_⟩
        intro P hcarP hgP hmem
        obtain ⟨h0, _, _⟩ := ee_nonneg_of_mem hmem
        rw [negA_apply, ee0A_apply] at hgP; linarith
      · refine ⟨negA (ee1A t), by rw [negA_apply, ee1A_apply]; linarith, ?_⟩
        intro P hcarP hgP hmem
        obtain ⟨_, h1, _⟩ := ee_nonneg_of_mem hmem
        rw [negA_apply, ee1A_apply] at hgP; linarith
      · refine ⟨negA (ee2A t), by rw [negA_apply, ee2A_apply]; linarith, ?_⟩
        intro P hcarP hgP hmem
        obtain ⟨_, _, h2⟩ := ee_nonneg_of_mem hmem
        rw [negA_apply, ee2A_apply] at hgP; linarith
    obtain ⟨g, hgQ, hgspec⟩ := hpick
    
    
    
    obtain ⟨r, hrpos, hrspec⟩ := exists_box_pos hgQ
    refine ⟨r, hrpos, fun P hP hmem => ?_⟩
    exact hgspec P (triangleSet_carrier hmem) (hrspec P (mem_Box.mp hP)) hmem
  · 
    have hphi : cOf t - dot (faceNormal t) Q ≠ 0 := fun h => hcar (by linarith)
    rcases lt_or_gt_of_ne hphi with hlt | hgt
    · 
      have hgQ : 0 < negA (SurfaceBridge.phiAff t) Q := by
        rw [negA_apply, phiAff_apply']; linarith
      obtain ⟨r, hrpos, hrspec⟩ := exists_box_pos hgQ
      refine ⟨r, hrpos, fun P hP hmem => ?_⟩
      have hval := hrspec P (mem_Box.mp hP)
      rw [negA_apply, phiAff_apply'] at hval
      have hcarP : dot (faceNormal t) P = cOf t := triangleSet_carrier hmem
      rw [hcarP] at hval; linarith
    · have hgQ : 0 < SurfaceBridge.phiAff t Q := by
        rw [phiAff_apply']; linarith
      obtain ⟨r, hrpos, hrspec⟩ := exists_box_pos hgQ
      refine ⟨r, hrpos, fun P hP hmem => ?_⟩
      have hval := hrspec P (mem_Box.mp hP)
      rw [phiAff_apply'] at hval
      have hcarP : dot (faceNormal t) P = cOf t := triangleSet_carrier hmem
      rw [hcarP] at hval; linarith

name: affine_comb_eval
statement:
theorem affine_comb_eval (g : Point →ᵃ[ℚ] ℚ) (a b c : ℚ) (x y z : Point)
    (habc : a + b + c = 1) :
    g (a • x + b • y + c • z) = a * g x + b * g y + c * g z
proof:
:= by
  
  have hcomb : a • x + b • y + c • z = (b • (y - x) + c • (z - x)) + x := by
    have ha : a = 1 - b - c := by linarith
    funext i
    simp only [Pi.add_apply, Pi.smul_apply, Pi.sub_apply, smul_eq_mul, ha]
    ring
  rw [hcomb]
  have hv := g.map_vadd x (b • (y - x) + c • (z - x))
  simp only [vadd_eq_add] at hv
  rw [hv, map_add, map_smul, map_smul, smul_eq_mul, smul_eq_mul]
  have hgy : g.linear (y - x) = g y - g x := by
    have := g.map_vadd x (y - x); simp only [vadd_eq_add] at this
    rw [show y - x + x = y by ring] at this; rw [this]; ring
  have hgz : g.linear (z - x) = g z - g x := by
    have := g.map_vadd x (z - x); simp only [vadd_eq_add] at this
    rw [show z - x + x = z by ring] at this; rw [this]; ring
  rw [hgy, hgz]; have ha : a = 1 - b - c := by linarith
  rw [ha]; ring

name: ee0_affine_comb
statement:
theorem ee0_affine_comb (t : Triangle) (a b c : ℚ) (habc : a + b + c = 1) :
    ee0 t (a • t.v₀ + b • t.v₁ + c • t.v₂) = c * Nt t
proof:
:= by
  have h := affine_comb_eval (ee0Aff t) a b c t.v₀ t.v₁ t.v₂ habc
  simp only [ee0Aff_apply] at h
  rw [show ee0 t (a • t.v₀ + b • t.v₁ + c • t.v₂) = _ from h,
    Proof.MeshIntersectRayClassify.ee0_v0, Proof.MeshIntersectRayClassify.ee0_v1,
    Proof.MeshIntersectRayClassify.ee0_v2, ← Nt_eq]
  ring

name: ee1_affine_comb
statement:
theorem ee1_affine_comb (t : Triangle) (a b c : ℚ) (habc : a + b + c = 1) :
    ee1 t (a • t.v₀ + b • t.v₁ + c • t.v₂) = a * Nt t
proof:
:= by
  have h := affine_comb_eval (ee1Aff t) a b c t.v₀ t.v₁ t.v₂ habc
  simp only [ee1Aff_apply] at h
  rw [show ee1 t (a • t.v₀ + b • t.v₁ + c • t.v₂) = _ from h,
    Proof.MeshIntersectRayClassify.ee1_v0, Proof.MeshIntersectRayClassify.ee1_v1,
    Proof.MeshIntersectRayClassify.ee1_v2, ← Nt_eq]
  ring

name: ee2_affine_comb
statement:
theorem ee2_affine_comb (t : Triangle) (a b c : ℚ) (habc : a + b + c = 1) :
    ee2 t (a • t.v₀ + b • t.v₁ + c • t.v₂) = b * Nt t
proof:
:= by
  have h := affine_comb_eval (ee2Aff t) a b c t.v₀ t.v₁ t.v₂ habc
  simp only [ee2Aff_apply] at h
  rw [show ee2 t (a • t.v₀ + b • t.v₁ + c • t.v₂) = _ from h,
    Proof.MeshIntersectRayClassify.ee2_v0, Proof.MeshIntersectRayClassify.ee2_v1,
    Proof.MeshIntersectRayClassify.ee2_v2, ← Nt_eq]
  ring

name: exists_relint_in_box
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have hNpos : 0 < Nt f := Nt_pos hn
  set c := (3:ℚ)⁻¹ • (f.v₀ + f.v₁ + f.v₂) with hc
  
  have hcarQ : dot (faceNormal f) Q = cOf f := triangleSet_carrier hQ
  obtain ⟨he0, he1, he2⟩ := ee_nonneg_of_mem hQ
  
  
  have hbary : ∀ lam : ℚ, mixPt f Q lam = (1 - lam) • Q + lam • c := fun lam => rfl
  
  have heelamA : ∀ (eeA : Point →ᵃ[ℚ] ℚ) (lam : ℚ),
      eeA (mixPt f Q lam) = (1 - lam) * eeA Q + lam * eeA c := by
    intro eeA lam
    have hkey := affine_comb_eval eeA (1 - lam) lam 0 Q c (0:Point) (by ring)
    simp only [zero_smul, add_zero, map_zero, zero_mul] at hkey
    rw [hbary]; exact hkey
  have hee0lam : ∀ lam : ℚ, ee0 f (mixPt f Q lam) = (1 - lam) * ee0 f Q + lam * ee0 f c := by
    intro lam; have := heelamA (ee0A f) lam; simpa only [ee0A_apply] using this
  have hee1lam : ∀ lam : ℚ, ee1 f (mixPt f Q lam) = (1 - lam) * ee1 f Q + lam * ee1 f c := by
    intro lam; have := heelamA (ee1A f) lam; simpa only [ee1A_apply] using this
  have hee2lam : ∀ lam : ℚ, ee2 f (mixPt f Q lam) = (1 - lam) * ee2 f Q + lam * ee2 f c := by
    intro lam; have := heelamA (ee2A f) lam; simpa only [ee2A_apply] using this
  
  have hee0c : ee0 f c = Nt f / 3 := by
    rw [hc]; have := ee0_affine_comb f (3:ℚ)⁻¹ (3:ℚ)⁻¹ (3:ℚ)⁻¹ (by norm_num)
    rw [show (3:ℚ)⁻¹ • (f.v₀ + f.v₁ + f.v₂) = (3:ℚ)⁻¹ • f.v₀ + (3:ℚ)⁻¹ • f.v₁ + (3:ℚ)⁻¹ • f.v₂ by
      funext i; simp only [Pi.add_apply, Pi.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul]; ring]
    rw [this]; ring
  have hee1c : ee1 f c = Nt f / 3 := by
    rw [hc]; have := ee1_affine_comb f (3:ℚ)⁻¹ (3:ℚ)⁻¹ (3:ℚ)⁻¹ (by norm_num)
    rw [show (3:ℚ)⁻¹ • (f.v₀ + f.v₁ + f.v₂) = (3:ℚ)⁻¹ • f.v₀ + (3:ℚ)⁻¹ • f.v₁ + (3:ℚ)⁻¹ • f.v₂ by
      funext i; simp only [Pi.add_apply, Pi.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul]; ring]
    rw [this]; ring
  have hee2c : ee2 f c = Nt f / 3 := by
    rw [hc]; have := ee2_affine_comb f (3:ℚ)⁻¹ (3:ℚ)⁻¹ (3:ℚ)⁻¹ (by norm_num)
    rw [show (3:ℚ)⁻¹ • (f.v₀ + f.v₁ + f.v₂) = (3:ℚ)⁻¹ • f.v₀ + (3:ℚ)⁻¹ • f.v₁ + (3:ℚ)⁻¹ • f.v₂ by
      funext i; simp only [Pi.add_apply, Pi.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul]; ring]
    rw [this]; ring
  
  have hcarmix : ∀ lam : ℚ, dot (faceNormal f) (mixPt f Q lam) = cOf f := by
    intro lam
    rw [hbary]
    rw [dot_add_right, dot_smul_right, dot_smul_right, hcarQ]
    have hcarc : dot (faceNormal f) c = cOf f := by
      rw [hc, dot_smul_right, dot_add_right, dot_add_right, carrier_v0, carrier_v1, carrier_v2]
      ring
    rw [hcarc]; ring
  
  
  set D := max (|c 0 - Q 0|) (max (|c 1 - Q 1|) (|c 2 - Q 2|)) with hD
  have hDnn : 0 ≤ D := le_trans (abs_nonneg _) (le_max_left _ _)
  set lam := min 1 (r / (D + 1)) with hlam
  have hlampos : 0 < lam := by
    rw [hlam]; refine lt_min one_pos (div_pos hr (by linarith))
  have hlamle1 : lam ≤ 1 := min_le_left _ _
  refine ⟨mixPt f Q lam, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · 
    refine mem_triangleSet_of_carrier' hn (hcarmix lam) ?_ ?_ ?_
    · rw [hee0lam lam, hee0c]
      nlinarith [hNpos, hlampos, mul_nonneg (by linarith : (0:ℚ) ≤ 1 - lam) he0]
    · rw [hee1lam lam, hee1c]
      nlinarith [hNpos, hlampos, mul_nonneg (by linarith : (0:ℚ) ≤ 1 - lam) he1]
    · rw [hee2lam lam, hee2c]
      nlinarith [hNpos, hlampos, mul_nonneg (by linarith : (0:ℚ) ≤ 1 - lam) he2]
  · 
    intro hedge
    rcases Proof.MeshIntersectRayClassify.ee_zero_of_mem_edgeSet hedge with hz | hz | hz
    · rw [hee0lam lam, hee0c] at hz
      nlinarith [hNpos, hlampos, mul_nonneg (by linarith : (0:ℚ) ≤ 1 - lam) he0]
    · rw [hee1lam lam, hee1c] at hz
      nlinarith [hNpos, hlampos, mul_nonneg (by linarith : (0:ℚ) ≤ 1 - lam) he1]
    · rw [hee2lam lam, hee2c] at hz
      nlinarith [hNpos, hlampos, mul_nonneg (by linarith : (0:ℚ) ≤ 1 - lam) he2]
  · 
    intro i
    have hdiff : mixPt f Q lam i - Q i = lam * (c i - Q i) := by
      rw [hbary]
      simp only [Pi.add_apply, Pi.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul]
      ring
    rw [hdiff, abs_mul, abs_of_pos hlampos]
    have hci : |c i - Q i| ≤ D := by
      rw [hD]; fin_cases i
      · exact le_max_left _ _
      · exact le_trans (le_max_left _ _) (le_max_right _ _)
      · exact le_trans (le_max_right _ _) (le_max_right _ _)
    have hlamle : lam ≤ r / (D + 1) := min_le_right _ _
    calc lam * |c i - Q i| ≤ (r / (D + 1)) * D := by
            apply mul_le_mul hlamle hci (abs_nonneg _) (le_of_lt (div_pos hr (by linarith)))
      _ ≤ r := by
            rw [div_mul_eq_mul_div, div_le_iff₀ (by linarith : (0:ℚ) < D + 1)]
            nlinarith [hr, hDnn]

name: relint_isolated
proof:
:= by

  exact hxe (hsub ⟨hxi, hxj⟩)

name: triangleSet_subset_plane
statement:
theorem triangleSet_subset_plane {t : Triangle} (hn : faceNormal t ≠ 0) :
    ∃ H : Set Point, IsPlane H ∧ triangleSet t ⊆ H
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨{x | (∑ i, (faceNormal t) i * x i) = cOf t}, ⟨faceNormal t, cOf t, hn, rfl⟩, ?_⟩
  intro x hx
  simp only [Set.mem_setOf_eq]
  have := triangleSet_carrier hx
  rw [dot] at this
  exact this

name: surface_negligible
statement:
theorem surface_negligible {M : Mesh} (hnd : NoDegenerateFaces M) :
    Negligible (surface M)
proof:
:= by
  rw [surface]
  refine Proof.Negligible.negligible_iUnion_fintype (fun i => ?_)
  obtain ⟨H, hplane, hsub⟩ := triangleSet_subset_plane (hnd i)
  exact ⟨1, fun _ => H, fun _ => hplane, fun x hx => Set.mem_iUnion.mpr ⟨0, hsub hx⟩⟩

name: winding_scale
statement:
theorem winding_scale (k : ℤ) (c : Chain) (Q : Point) :
    winding (c.map (fun e => (k * e.1, e.2))) Q = k * winding c Q
proof:
:= by
  unfold winding
  rw [Array.toList_map, List.map_map]
  rw [show (List.map ((fun e => if Q ∈ simplex e.2 then e.1 else 0) ∘ fun e => (k * e.1, e.2))
        c.toList)
      = (List.map (fun e => k * (if Q ∈ simplex e.2 then e.1 else 0)) c.toList) from ?_]
  · exact List.sum_map_mul_left (r := k)
      (f := fun e => if Q ∈ simplex e.2 then e.1 else 0) (l := c.toList)
  · apply List.map_congr_left
    intro e _
    simp only [Function.comp_apply]
    split_ifs <;> ring

name: winding_eq_indicatorSum
statement:
theorem winding_eq_indicatorSum (c : Chain) (Q : Point) :
    winding c Q
      = (c.toList.map
          (fun e => e.1 * (if Q ∈ simplex e.2 then (1 : ℤ) else 0))).sum
proof:
:= by
  unfold winding
  apply congrArg List.sum
  apply List.map_congr_left
  intro e _
  split_ifs <;> ring

name: indicator_inter_eq_mul
statement:
theorem indicator_inter_eq_mul (s t : Triangle) (Q : Point) :
    (if Q ∈ simplex s ∩ simplex t then (1 : ℤ) else 0)
      = (if Q ∈ simplex s then (1 : ℤ) else 0)
          * (if Q ∈ simplex t then (1 : ℤ) else 0)
proof:
:= by
  simp only [Set.mem_inter_iff]
  split_ifs with h <;> simp_all

name: double_sum_factors
statement:
theorem double_sum_factors {n m : ℕ} (a : Fin n → ℤ) (b : Fin m → ℤ)
    (f : Fin n → ℤ) (g : Fin m → ℤ) :
    (∑ i, ∑ j, (a i * b j) * (f i * g j))
      = (∑ i, a i * f i) * (∑ j, b j * g j)
proof:
:= by
  rw [Finset.sum_mul_sum]
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro i _
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro j _
  ring

name: coe_map_eq_sum_singletons
statement:
theorem coe_map_eq_sum_singletons {α β : Type*} (l : List α) (f : α → β) :
    (↑(l.map f) : Multiset β) = (l.map fun x => ({f x} : Multiset β)).sum
proof:
:= by
  induction l with
  | nil => rfl
  | cons a t ih =>
    rw [List.map_cons, List.map_cons, List.sum_cons, ← ih, ← Multiset.cons_coe,
      Multiset.singleton_add]

name: coe_flatMap
statement:
theorem coe_flatMap {α β : Type*} (l : List α) (F : α → List β) :
    (↑(l.flatMap F) : Multiset β)
      = (l.map fun x => (↑(F x) : Multiset β)).sum
proof:
:= by
  induction l with
  | nil => rfl
  | cons a t ih =>
    rw [List.flatMap_cons, List.map_cons, List.sum_cons, ← ih]
    exact (Multiset.coe_add _ _).symm

name: coe_triple
statement:
theorem coe_triple {α : Type*} (p q r : α) :
    (↑[p, q, r] : Multiset α) = {p} + {q} + {r}
proof: := rfl

name: fragBoundary_eq
statement:
theorem fragBoundary_eq (g : Frag) [NeZero g.poly.size]
    (hm3 : 3 ≤ g.poly.size) :
    fragBoundary g
      = ∑ k : Fin g.poly.size,
          ({(fragCycle g k, fragCycle g (k + 1))} : Multiset (Point × Point))
proof:
:= by
  unfold fragBoundary
  rw [coe_map_eq_sum_singletons, ← finRange_map_val g.poly.size, List.map_map,
    ← List.ofFn_eq_map, List.sum_ofFn]
  refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun k _ => ?_
  show ({(P3.toPoint (g.poly.getD k.val default).p,
        P3.toPoint (g.poly.getD ((k.val + 1) % g.poly.size) default).p)}
      : Multiset (Point × Point))
    = {(fragCycle g k, fragCycle g (k + 1))}
  simp only [poly_getD g k, poly_getD_succ hm3 k]
  rfl

name: edgeMultiset_singleton
statement:
theorem edgeMultiset_singleton (t : Triangle) :
    edgeMultiset #[t] = ↑(faceEdges t)
proof:
:= by
  show (↑((#[t] : Mesh).toList.flatMap faceEdges) : Multiset (Point × Point)) = _
  simp

name: fin_succ_mk
proof:
:= by
  apply Fin.ext
  rw [Fin.val_add, Fin.val_one', Nat.mod_eq_of_lt (show 1 < m by omega)]
  exact hab

name: emit_edgeMultiset
statement:
theorem emit_edgeMultiset {g : Frag} [NeZero g.poly.size]
    (hm3 : 3 ≤ g.poly.size)
    (hapex : ∀ k : Fin g.poly.size, apexQ g ≠ fragCycle g k)
    (hcons : ∀ k : Fin g.poly.size, fragCycle g k ≠ fragCycle g (k + 1)) :
    ∃ S, edgeMultiset (emitFrag g) = fragBoundary g + S ∧ Bal S
proof:
:= by
  by_cases h3 : g.poly.size = 3
  · 
    refine ⟨0, ?_, bal_zero⟩
    rw [add_zero]
    
    
    have lt0 : 0 < g.poly.size := by omega
    have lt1 : 1 < g.poly.size := by omega
    have lt2 : 2 < g.poly.size := by omega
    have h0 : (⟨0, lt0⟩ : Fin g.poly.size) + 1 = ⟨1, lt1⟩ :=
      fin_succ_mk hm3 _ _ (Nat.mod_eq_of_lt lt1)
    have h1 : (⟨1, lt1⟩ : Fin g.poly.size) + 1 = ⟨2, lt2⟩ :=
      fin_succ_mk hm3 _ _ (Nat.mod_eq_of_lt lt2)
    have h2 : (⟨2, lt2⟩ : Fin g.poly.size) + 1 = ⟨0, lt0⟩ :=
      fin_succ_mk hm3 _ _ (by rw [h3])
    have gd : ∀ (n : ℕ) (hn : n < g.poly.size),
        P3.toPoint (g.poly.getD n default).p = fragCycle g ⟨n, hn⟩ := by
      intro n hn
      rw [getD_eq_getElem g.poly hn]
      rfl
    have hne01 : P3.toPoint (g.poly.getD 0 default).p
        ≠ P3.toPoint (g.poly.getD 1 default).p := by
      rw [gd 0 lt0, gd 1 lt1]
      exact h0 ▸ hcons ⟨0, lt0⟩
    have hne12 : P3.toPoint (g.poly.getD 1 default).p
        ≠ P3.toPoint (g.poly.getD 2 default).p := by
      rw [gd 1 lt1, gd 2 lt2]
      exact h1 ▸ hcons ⟨1, lt1⟩
    have hne20 : P3.toPoint (g.poly.getD 2 default).p
        ≠ P3.toPoint (g.poly.getD 0 default).p := by
      rw [gd 2 lt2, gd 0 lt0]
      exact h2 ▸ hcons ⟨2, lt2⟩
    rw [emitFrag_eq_triangle h3 hne01 hne12 hne20, edgeMultiset_singleton]
    unfold fragBoundary
    simp only [h3]
    rfl
  · 
    have hofn := emitFrag_eq_fan h3 hm3 hapex hcons
    have hedge : edgeMultiset (emitFrag g)
        = ∑ k : Fin g.poly.size,
            (({(apexQ g, fragCycle g k)} : Multiset (Point × Point))
              + {(fragCycle g k, fragCycle g (k + 1))}
              + {(fragCycle g (k + 1), apexQ g)}) := by
      show (↑((emitFrag g).toList.flatMap faceEdges) : Multiset (Point × Point))
        = _
      rw [hofn, coe_flatMap, List.map_ofFn, List.sum_ofFn]
      exact Finset.sum_congr rfl fun k _ => coe_triple _ _ _
    refine ⟨(∑ k : Fin g.poly.size,
        ({(apexQ g, fragCycle g k)} : Multiset (Point × Point)))
      + ∑ k : Fin g.poly.size,
        ({(fragCycle g k, apexQ g)} : Multiset (Point × Point)), ?_, ?_⟩
    · rw [hedge, Finset.sum_add_distrib, Finset.sum_add_distrib,
        fragBoundary_eq g hm3]
      have hre : (∑ k : Fin g.poly.size,
            ({(fragCycle g (k + 1), apexQ g)} : Multiset (Point × Point)))
          = ∑ k : Fin g.poly.size,
            ({(fragCycle g k, apexQ g)} : Multiset (Point × Point)) :=
        Fintype.sum_equiv (Equiv.addRight (1 : Fin g.poly.size)) _ _
          (fun _ => rfl)
      rw [hre]
      abel
    · rw [← Finset.sum_add_distrib]
      exact bal_finsetSum fun k => bal_pair _ _

name: mem_listSum
statement:
theorem mem_listSum {α : Type*} {l : List (Multiset α)} {x : α}
    (hx : x ∈ l.sum) : ∃ X ∈ l, x ∈ X
proof:
:= by
  induction l with
  | nil => simp at hx
  | cons a t ih =>
    rw [List.sum_cons, Multiset.mem_add] at hx
    rcases hx with h | h
    · exact ⟨a, List.mem_cons_self _ _, h⟩
    · obtain ⟨X, hX, hxX⟩ := ih h
      exact ⟨X, List.mem_cons_of_mem _ hX, hxX⟩

name: mem_fragBoundary
statement:
theorem mem_fragBoundary {g : Frag} [NeZero g.poly.size]
    (hm3 : 3 ≤ g.poly.size) {e : Point × Point} (he : e ∈ fragBoundary g) :
    ∃ k : Fin g.poly.size, e = (fragCycle g k, fragCycle g (k + 1))
proof:
:= by
  rw [fragBoundary_eq g hm3] at he
  rw [Multiset.mem_sum] at he
  obtain ⟨k, -, hk⟩ := he
  exact ⟨k, Multiset.mem_singleton.mp hk⟩

name: atomize_vertex_mem
statement:
theorem atomize_vertex_mem (vs : Array Vtx) (f : Frag)
    (hpar : ∀ v ∈ f.poly.toList, ∃ u ∈ vs.toList, u.p = v.p) :
    ∀ v ∈ (atomizeFrag vs f).poly.toList, ∃ u ∈ vs.toList, u.p = v.p
proof:
:= by
  intro v hv
  rw [atomizeFrag_poly, List.mem_flatMap] at hv
  obtain ⟨i, hi, hv⟩ := hv
  rcases List.mem_cons.mp hv with rfl | hv'
  · apply hpar
    rw [List.mem_range] at hi
    rw [getD_eq_getElem f.poly hi]
    exact (Array.mem_def.mp (f.poly.getElem_mem hi))
  · exact ⟨v, hitsOn_mem_univ vs _ _ hv', rfl⟩

name: fragBoundary_endpoints
statement:
theorem fragBoundary_endpoints {vs : Array Vtx} {g : Frag} [NeZero g.poly.size]
    (hm3 : 3 ≤ g.poly.size)
    (hall : ∀ v ∈ g.poly.toList, ∃ u ∈ vs.toList, u.p = v.p)
    {e : Point × Point} (he : e ∈ fragBoundary g) :
    (∃ u ∈ vs.toList, P3.toPoint u.p = e.1)
      ∧ ∃ u ∈ vs.toList, P3.toPoint u.p = e.2
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨k, rfl⟩ := mem_fragBoundary hm3 he
  have hmem : ∀ j : Fin g.poly.size, g.poly[j] ∈ g.poly.toList := by
    intro j
    rw [Fin.getElem_fin, ← Array.getElem_toList j.isLt]
    exact List.getElem_mem _
  constructor
  · obtain ⟨u, hu, hup⟩ := hall _ (hmem k)
    exact ⟨u, hu, congrArg P3.toPoint hup⟩
  · obtain ⟨u, hu, hup⟩ := hall _ (hmem (k + 1))
    exact ⟨u, hu, congrArg P3.toPoint hup⟩

name: shBox_lox
statement: @[simp] theorem shBox_lox (ox oy oz : Rat) (b : Box) : (shBox ox oy oz b).lox = b.lox - ox
proof: := rfl

name: shBox_loy

name: bvh_rmin_sub
statement: theorem bvh_rmin_sub (a b k : Rat) : rmin (a - k) (b - k) = rmin a b - k
proof:
:= by
  unfold rmin
  by_cases h : a ≤ b
  · rw [if_pos (sub_le_sub_right h k), if_pos h]
  · rw [if_neg (by rw [sub_le_sub_iff_right]; exact h), if_neg h]

name: bvh_rmax_sub
statement: theorem bvh_rmax_sub (a b k : Rat) : rmax (a - k) (b - k) = rmax a b - k
proof:
:= by
  unfold rmax
  by_cases h : a ≤ b
  · rw [if_pos (sub_le_sub_right h k), if_pos h]
  · rw [if_neg (by rw [sub_le_sub_iff_right]; exact h), if_neg h]

name: overlap_sh
statement:
theorem overlap_sh (ox oy oz : Rat) (u v : Box) :
    overlap (shBox ox oy oz u) (shBox ox oy oz v) = overlap u v
proof:
:= by
  simp only [overlap, shBox, sub_le_sub_iff_right]

name: hull_sh
statement:
theorem hull_sh (ox oy oz : Rat) (u v : Box) :
    hull (shBox ox oy oz u) (shBox ox oy oz v) = shBox ox oy oz (hull u v)
proof:
:= by
  simp only [hull, shBox, bvh_rmin_sub, bvh_rmax_sub]

name: gcoord_sh
statement:
theorem gcoord_sh (a v k : ℚ) (e : ℤ) :
    Proof.BVH.gcoord (a - k) e (v - k) = Proof.BVH.gcoord a e v
proof:
:= by
  unfold Proof.BVH.gcoord
  congr 1
  ring

name: mantFloor_sh
statement: theorem mantFloor_sh (v a k : ℚ) (e : ℤ) : mantFloor (v - k) (a - k) e = mantFloor v a e
proof:
:= by
  rw [Proof.BVH.mantFloor_eq, Proof.BVH.mantFloor_eq, gcoord_sh]

name: mantCeil_sh
statement: theorem mantCeil_sh (v a k : ℚ) (e : ℤ) : mantCeil (v - k) (a - k) e = mantCeil v a e
proof:
:= by
  rw [Proof.BVH.mantCeil_eq, Proof.BVH.mantCeil_eq, gcoord_sh]

name: mboxOfBox_sh
statement:
theorem mboxOfBox_sh (ax ay az ox oy oz : ℚ) (e : ℤ) (b : Box) :
    mboxOfBox (ax - ox) (ay - oy) (az - oz) e (shBox ox oy oz b) = mboxOfBox ax ay az e b
proof:
:= by
  show MBox.mk (mantFloor (b.lox - ox) (ax - ox) e) (mantFloor (b.loy - oy) (ay - oy) e)
      (mantFloor (b.loz - oz) (az - oz) e) (mantCeil (b.hix - ox) (ax - ox) e)
      (mantCeil (b.hiy - oy) (ay - oy) e) (mantCeil (b.hiz - oz) (az - oz) e)
    = MBox.mk (mantFloor b.lox ax e) (mantFloor b.loy ay e) (mantFloor b.loz az e)
      (mantCeil b.hix ax e) (mantCeil b.hiy ay e) (mantCeil b.hiz az e)
  rw [mantFloor_sh, mantFloor_sh, mantFloor_sh, mantCeil_sh, mantCeil_sh, mantCeil_sh]

name: foldl_hull_sh
statement:
theorem foldl_hull_sh (ox oy oz : Rat) (l : List Box) (acc : Box) :
    l.foldl (fun a b => hull a (shBox ox oy oz b)) (shBox ox oy oz acc)
      = shBox ox oy oz (l.foldl (fun a b => hull a b) acc)
proof:
:= by
  induction l generalizing acc with
  | nil => rfl
  | cons b l ih => simpa only [List.foldl_cons, hull_sh] using ih (hull acc b)

name: rootBox_sh
statement:
theorem rootBox_sh (input : Array Box) (ox oy oz : Rat) (hpos : 0 < input.size) :
    rootBox (input.map (shBox ox oy oz)) = shBox ox oy oz (rootBox input)
proof:
:= by
  have hseed : (input.map (shBox ox oy oz)).getD 0 default
      = shBox ox oy oz (input.getD 0 default) := by
    have h0 : 0 < (input.map (shBox ox oy oz)).size := by rwa [Array.size_map]
    simp only [Array.getD, dif_pos h0, dif_pos hpos, Array.get_eq_getElem, Array.getElem_map]
  simp only [rootBox, hseed, ← Array.foldl_toList, Array.toList_map, List.foldl_map]
  exact foldl_hull_sh ox oy oz input.toList (input.getD 0 default)

name: gridExp_sh
statement: theorem gridExp_sh (ox oy oz : Rat) (rb : Box) : gridExp (shBox ox oy oz rb) = gridExp rb
proof:
:= by
  have h1 : rb.hix - ox - (rb.lox - ox) = rb.hix - rb.lox := by ring
  have h2 : rb.hiy - oy - (rb.loy - oy) = rb.hiy - rb.loy := by ring
  have h3 : rb.hiz - oz - (rb.loz - oz) = rb.hiz - rb.loz := by ring
  simp only [gridExp, shBox, h1, h2, h3]

name: map_mboxOfBox_sh
statement:
theorem map_mboxOfBox_sh (input : Array Box) (ox oy oz ax ay az : Rat) (e : ℤ) :
    (input.map (shBox ox oy oz)).map (mboxOfBox (ax - ox) (ay - oy) (az - oz) e)
      = input.map (mboxOfBox ax ay az e)
proof:
:= by
  rw [Array.map_map]
  refine congrArg (fun f => input.map f) ?_
  funext b
  exact mboxOfBox_sh ax ay az ox oy oz e b

name: mbs_sh
statement:
theorem mbs_sh (input : Array Box) (ox oy oz : Rat) (hpos : 0 < input.size) :
    (input.map (shBox ox oy oz)).map
        (mboxOfBox (rootBox (input.map (shBox ox oy oz))).lox
          (rootBox (input.map (shBox ox oy oz))).loy
          (rootBox (input.map (shBox ox oy oz))).loz
          (gridExp (rootBox (input.map (shBox ox oy oz)))))
      = input.map (mboxOfBox (rootBox input).lox (rootBox input).loy (rootBox input).loz
          (gridExp (rootBox input)))
proof:
:= by
  rw [rootBox_sh input ox oy oz hpos, gridExp_sh, shBox_lox, shBox_loy, shBox_loz,
    map_mboxOfBox_sh]

name: mboxQ_sh
statement:
theorem mboxQ_sh {h h' : BVH} (ox oy oz : Rat) (hax : h'.ax = h.ax - ox) (hay : h'.ay = h.ay - oy)
    (haz : h'.az = h.az - oz) (hce : h'.ce = h.ce) (q : Box) :
    mboxQ h' (shBox ox oy oz q) = mboxQ h q
proof:
:= by
  simp only [mboxQ, shBox, hax, hay, haz, hce, mantFloor_sh, mantCeil_sh]

name: anchor_val
proof:
:= by
  have hv : (0:ℚ) < (x.den:ℚ) := by exact_mod_cast x.pos
  have ha : (0:ℚ) < (a.den:ℚ) := by exact_mod_cast a.pos
  have hv' : (x.num:ℚ) = x * (x.den:ℚ) := (div_eq_iff (ne_of_gt hv)).mp (Rat.num_div_den x)
  have ha' : (a.num:ℚ) = a * (a.den:ℚ) := (div_eq_iff (ne_of_gt ha)).mp (Rat.num_div_den a)
  push_cast
  field_simp
  rw [hv', ha']
  ring

name: daxisParam_sh
statement:
theorem daxisParam_sh (dα xα a k : ℚ) (e : ℤ) :
    daxisParam dα (xα - k) (a - k) e = daxisParam dα xα a e
proof:
:= by
  have hd' : (0:ℤ) < ((a - k).den : ℤ) * ((xα - k).den : ℤ) := by positivity
  have hd : (0:ℤ) < (a.den : ℤ) * (xα.den : ℤ) := by positivity
  have hv : (((xα - k).num * ((a - k).den : ℤ) - (a - k).num * ((xα - k).den : ℤ) : ℤ) : ℚ)
        / ((((a - k).den : ℤ) * ((xα - k).den : ℤ) : ℤ) : ℚ)
      = ((xα.num * (a.den : ℤ) - a.num * (xα.den : ℤ) : ℤ) : ℚ)
        / (((a.den : ℤ) * (xα.den : ℤ) : ℤ) : ℚ) := by
    rw [anchor_val, anchor_val]; ring
  have hlo := Proof.BVH.dyFloor_congr e hd' hd hv
  have hhi := Proof.BVH.dyCeil_congr e hd' hd hv
  unfold daxisParam
  dsimp only
  split <;> simp only [hlo, hhi]

name: range3_any_iff
statement:
theorem range3_any_iff (f : Nat → Bool) :
    (Array.range 3).any f = true ↔ (f 0 = true ∨ f 1 = true ∨ f 2 = true)
proof:
:= by
  rw [Array.any_eq_true]
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨i, hfi⟩
    fin_cases i <;> (simp only [Array.getElem_range] at hfi; tauto)
  · rintro (h | h | h)
    · exact ⟨⟨0, by simp⟩, by simpa using h⟩
    · exact ⟨⟨1, by simp⟩, by simpa using h⟩
    · exact ⟨⟨2, by simp⟩, by simpa using h⟩

name: range3_all_iff
statement:
theorem range3_all_iff (f : Nat → Bool) :
    (Array.range 3).all f = true ↔ (f 0 = true ∧ f 1 = true ∧ f 2 = true)
proof:
:= by
  rw [Array.all_eq_true]
  constructor
  · intro h
    refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_⟩
    · have := h ⟨0, by simp⟩; simpa using this
    · have := h ⟨1, by simp⟩; simpa using this
    · have := h ⟨2, by simp⟩; simpa using this
  · rintro ⟨h0, h1, h2⟩ i
    fin_cases i <;> (simp only [Array.getElem_range]; assumption)

name: range3_any_false_iff
statement:
theorem range3_any_false_iff (f : Nat → Bool) :
    (Array.range 3).any f = false ↔ (f 0 = false ∧ f 1 = false ∧ f 2 = false)
proof:
:= by
  rw [← Bool.not_eq_true, range3_any_iff]
  simp only [not_or, Bool.not_eq_true]

name: range3_all_false_iff
statement:
theorem range3_all_false_iff (f : Nat → Bool) :
    (Array.range 3).all f = false ↔ (f 0 = false ∨ f 1 = false ∨ f 2 = false)
proof:
:= by
  rw [← Bool.not_eq_true, range3_all_iff]
  simp only [not_and_or, Bool.not_eq_true]

name: cross_dot_eq_dot_cross
statement:
theorem cross_dot_eq_dot_cross (nf a b : Point) :
    (crossProduct nf a) ⬝ᵥ b = nf ⬝ᵥ (crossProduct a b)
proof:
:= by
  rw [← Proof.GenPosCheck.dot_cross_eq_cross_dot]

name: apex_eval_raw
statement:
theorem apex_eval_raw (nf u v z : Point) (av az : ℚ) (x : Point)
    (hx : x - u = av • (v - u) + az • (z - u)) :
    (crossProduct nf (v - u)) ⬝ᵥ (x - u)
      = az * (nf ⬝ᵥ (crossProduct (v - u) (z - u)))
proof:
:= by
  rw [hx, cross_dot_eq_dot_cross, LinearMap.map_add, LinearMap.map_smul, LinearMap.map_smul]
  have hself : crossProduct (v - u) (v - u) = (0 : Point) := by
    funext i; fin_cases i <;> simp [crossProduct, Pi.sub_apply] <;> ring
  rw [hself, smul_zero, zero_add, dotProduct_smul, smul_eq_mul]

name: cyclic_normal
statement:
theorem cyclic_normal (a b c : Point) :
    crossProduct (b - a) (c - a) = crossProduct (b - a) (c - a)
    ∧ crossProduct (c - b) (a - b) = crossProduct (b - a) (c - a)
    ∧ crossProduct (a - c) (b - c) = crossProduct (b - a) (c - a)
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨rfl, ?_, ?_⟩ <;>
    (funext i; fin_cases i <;> simp [crossProduct, Pi.sub_apply] <;> ring)

name: slide_feasible
statement:
theorem slide_feasible {ι : Type} (corner bary : Fin 2 → ℚ) (J : Finset ι)
    (g : ι → (Fin 2 → ℚ) → ℚ) (h : (Fin 2 → ℚ) → ℚ)
    (gaff : ∀ j ∈ J, ∀ θ : ℚ,
      g j ((1-θ) • corner + θ • bary) = (1-θ) * g j corner + θ * g j bary)
    (haff : ∀ θ : ℚ, h ((1-θ) • corner + θ • bary) = (1-θ) * h corner + θ * h bary)
    (gc : ∀ j ∈ J, 0 ≤ g j corner) (gb : ∀ j ∈ J, 0 < g j bary)
    (hc : 0 < h corner) :
    ∃ y, (∀ j ∈ J, 0 < g j y) ∧ 0 < h y
proof:
:= by
  set θ : ℚ := min (1/2) (if h bary < 0 then h corner / (h corner - h bary) / 2 else 1/2) with hθ
  have hθpos : 0 < θ := by
    rw [hθ]; apply lt_min; norm_num
    split
    · next hb => have : 0 < h corner - h bary := by linarith
                 positivity
    · norm_num
  have hθle : θ ≤ 1/2 := min_le_left _ _
  refine ⟨(1-θ) • corner + θ • bary, ?_, ?_⟩
  · intro j hj
    rw [gaff j hj θ]; have := gc j hj; have := gb j hj; nlinarith
  · rw [haff θ]
    rcases lt_or_le (h bary) 0 with hb | hb
    · have hden : 0 < h corner - h bary := by linarith
      have hθ2 : θ ≤ h corner / (h corner - h bary) / 2 := by
        rw [hθ]; refine min_le_of_right_le ?_; rw [if_pos hb]
      have hp : 0 < h corner / (h corner - h bary) := by positivity
      have key : θ * (h corner - h bary) < h corner := by
        have : θ < h corner / (h corner - h bary) := by linarith
        rw [lt_div_iff₀ hden] at this; linarith
      nlinarith
    · nlinarith

name: helly2_affine_six
statement:
theorem helly2_affine_six (A : Fin 6 → (Fin 2 → ℚ)) (B : Fin 6 → ℚ)
    (htriple : ∀ I : Finset (Fin 6), I.card = 3 →
        ∃ y : Fin 2 → ℚ, ∀ i ∈ I, 0 < (A i) ⬝ᵥ y + B i) :
    ∃ y : Fin 2 → ℚ, ∀ i, 0 < (A i) ⬝ᵥ y + B i
proof:
:= by
  set F : Fin 6 → Set (Fin 2 → ℚ) := fun i => {y | 0 < (A i) ⬝ᵥ y + B i} with hF
  have hconv : ∀ i ∈ (Finset.univ : Finset (Fin 6)), Convex ℚ (F i) := by
    intro i _
    have hlin : IsLinearMap ℚ (fun y : Fin 2 → ℚ => (A i) ⬝ᵥ y) :=
      ⟨fun x y => by rw [dotProduct_add], fun c x => by rw [dotProduct_smul, smul_eq_mul]⟩
    have heq : F i = {w : Fin 2 → ℚ | -(B i) < (A i) ⬝ᵥ w} := by
      ext y; simp only [hF, Set.mem_setOf_eq]; constructor <;> intro h <;> linarith
    rw [heq]; exact convex_halfSpace_gt hlin (-(B i))
  have hcard : Module.finrank ℚ (Fin 2 → ℚ) + 1 ≤ (Finset.univ : Finset (Fin 6)).card := by simp
  have hinter : ∀ I ⊆ (Finset.univ : Finset (Fin 6)),
      I.card = Module.finrank ℚ (Fin 2 → ℚ) + 1 → (⋂ i ∈ I, F i).Nonempty := by
    intro I _ hcardI
    simp only [Module.finrank_pi, Fintype.card_fin] at hcardI
    obtain ⟨y, hy⟩ := htriple I (by omega)
    exact ⟨y, by simp only [Set.mem_iInter]; intro i hi; exact hy i hi⟩
  obtain ⟨y, hy⟩ := Convex.helly_theorem (𝕜 := ℚ) (F := F) (s := Finset.univ) hcard hconv hinter
  exact ⟨y, fun i => by simp only [Set.mem_iInter] at hy; exact hy i (Finset.mem_univ i)⟩

name: affine_seg
statement:
theorem affine_seg (A : Fin 2 → ℚ) (B : ℚ) (p q : Fin 2 → ℚ) (θ : ℚ) :
    A ⬝ᵥ ((1-θ) • p + θ • q) + B = (1-θ) * (A ⬝ᵥ p + B) + θ * (A ⬝ᵥ q + B)
proof:
:= by
  rw [dotProduct_add, dotProduct_smul, dotProduct_smul, smul_eq_mul, smul_eq_mul]; ring

name: helly2_six
statement:
theorem helly2_six (A : Fin 6 → (Fin 2 → ℚ)) (B : Fin 6 → ℚ)
    (bS bT : Fin 2 → ℚ) (cS cT : Fin 3 → (Fin 2 → ℚ))
    (hbS : ∀ i : Fin 6, i.val < 3 → 0 < (A i) ⬝ᵥ bS + B i)
    (hbT : ∀ i : Fin 6, 3 ≤ i.val → 0 < (A i) ⬝ᵥ bT + B i)
    (hcSnn : ∀ a : Fin 3, ∀ i : Fin 6, i.val < 3 → 0 ≤ (A i) ⬝ᵥ (cS a) + B i)
    (hcTnn : ∀ a : Fin 3, ∀ i : Fin 6, 3 ≤ i.val → 0 ≤ (A i) ⬝ᵥ (cT a) + B i)
    (hwitT : ∀ j : Fin 6, 3 ≤ j.val → ∃ a : Fin 3, 0 < (A j) ⬝ᵥ (cS a) + B j)
    (hwitS : ∀ i : Fin 6, i.val < 3 → ∃ a : Fin 3, 0 < (A i) ⬝ᵥ (cT a) + B i) :
    ∃ y : Fin 2 → ℚ, ∀ i, 0 < (A i) ⬝ᵥ y + B i
proof:
:= by
  apply helly2_affine_six A B
  intro I hI
  
  set Is := I.filter (fun i => i.val < 3) with hIs
  set It := I.filter (fun i => 3 ≤ i.val) with hIt
  have hpart : Is.card + It.card = 3 := by
    have hneg : It = I.filter (fun i => ¬ i.val < 3) := by
      rw [hIt]; congr 1; ext i; simp only [not_lt]
    rw [hIs, hneg, Finset.filter_card_add_filter_neg_card_eq_card]
    exact hI
  have hmem_low : ∀ i ∈ Is, i.val < 3 := by intro i hi; rw [hIs, Finset.mem_filter] at hi; exact hi.2
  have hmem_high : ∀ i ∈ It, 3 ≤ i.val := by intro i hi; rw [hIt, Finset.mem_filter] at hi; exact hi.2
  have hsplit : ∀ i ∈ I, i ∈ Is ∨ i ∈ It := by
    intro i hi; rcases lt_or_le i.val 3 with h | h
    · exact Or.inl (by rw [hIs, Finset.mem_filter]; exact ⟨hi, h⟩)
    · exact Or.inr (by rw [hIt, Finset.mem_filter]; exact ⟨hi, h⟩)
  have hItle : It.card ≤ 3 := by omega
  
  interval_cases hc : It.card
  · 
    refine ⟨bS, fun i hi => ?_⟩
    rcases hsplit i hi with h | h
    · exact hbS i (hmem_low i h)
    · exfalso; rw [Finset.card_eq_zero] at hc; rw [hc] at h; exact absurd h (Finset.not_mem_empty i)
  · 
    have hIscard : Is.card = 2 := by omega
    obtain ⟨j, hjIt⟩ := Finset.card_eq_one.mp hc
    have hjmem : j ∈ It := by rw [hjIt]; exact Finset.mem_singleton_self j
    have hj3 : 3 ≤ j.val := hmem_high j hjmem
    obtain ⟨a, hwit⟩ := hwitT j hj3
    obtain ⟨y, hgIs, hhj⟩ := slide_feasible (cS a) bS Is
      (fun i y => (A i) ⬝ᵥ y + B i) (fun y => (A j) ⬝ᵥ y + B j)
      (fun i _ θ => affine_seg (A i) (B i) (cS a) bS θ)
      (fun θ => affine_seg (A j) (B j) (cS a) bS θ)
      (fun i hi => hcSnn a i (hmem_low i hi)) (fun i hi => hbS i (hmem_low i hi)) hwit
    refine ⟨y, fun i hi => ?_⟩
    rcases hsplit i hi with h | h
    · exact hgIs i h
    · have : i = j := by rw [hjIt, Finset.mem_singleton] at h; exact h
      rw [this]; exact hhj
  · 
    have hItcard : It.card = 2 := by omega
    obtain ⟨i0, hi0Is⟩ := Finset.card_eq_one.mp (by omega : Is.card = 1)
    have hi0mem : i0 ∈ Is := by rw [hi0Is]; exact Finset.mem_singleton_self i0
    have hi03 : i0.val < 3 := hmem_low i0 hi0mem
    obtain ⟨a, hwit⟩ := hwitS i0 hi03
    obtain ⟨y, hgIt, hhi0⟩ := slide_feasible (cT a) bT It
      (fun i y => (A i) ⬝ᵥ y + B i) (fun y => (A i0) ⬝ᵥ y + B i0)
      (fun i _ θ => affine_seg (A i) (B i) (cT a) bT θ)
      (fun θ => affine_seg (A i0) (B i0) (cT a) bT θ)
      (fun i hi => hcTnn a i (hmem_high i hi)) (fun i hi => hbT i (hmem_high i hi)) hwit
    refine ⟨y, fun i hi => ?_⟩
    rcases hsplit i hi with h | h
    · have : i = i0 := by rw [hi0Is, Finset.mem_singleton] at h; exact h
      rw [this]; exact hhi0
    · exact hgIt i h
  · 
    refine ⟨bT, fun i hi => ?_⟩
    rcases hsplit i hi with h | h
    · exfalso
      have : Is.card = 0 := by omega
      rw [Finset.card_eq_zero] at this; rw [this] at h; exact absurd h (Finset.not_mem_empty i)
    · exact hbT i (hmem_high i h)

name: toList_eq_map_finRange
statement:
private theorem toList_eq_map_finRange (w : Chain) :
    w.toList = (List.finRange w.size).map (fun i => w[i])
proof:
:= by
  apply List.ext_getElem
  · simp
  · intro i h₁ h₂
    simp only [List.getElem_map, List.getElem_finRange]
    rfl

name: winding_eq_finSum
proof:
:= by
  rw [Fin.sum_univ_def]
  unfold winding
  rw [toList_eq_map_finRange w, List.map_map]
  rfl

name: winding_eq_finSum_indicator
proof:
:= by
  rw [winding_eq_finSum]
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro i _
  by_cases h : Q ∈ simplex w[i].2 <;> simp [h]

name: sum_flatMap
statement:
private theorem sum_flatMap {α β : Type*} [AddCommMonoid β]
    (l : List α) (f : α → List β) :
    (l.flatMap f).sum = (l.map (fun a => (f a).sum)).sum
proof:
:= by
  rw [List.flatMap_def, List.sum_flatten, List.map_map]
  rfl

name: winding_productChain_double_sum
statement:
theorem winding_productChain_double_sum (w₁ w₂ : Chain) (Q : Point) :
    winding (productChain w₁ w₂) Q
      = ∑ i : Fin w₁.size, ∑ j : Fin w₂.size,
          (w₁[i].1 * w₂[j].1) * winding (sim w₁[i].2 w₂[j].2) Q
proof:
:= by
  
  unfold winding productChain
  rw [Array.toList_toArray]
  
  rw [List.map_flatMap]
  
  rw [sum_flatMap, ← Fin.sum_univ_def]
  
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro i _
  rw [List.map_flatMap, sum_flatMap, ← Fin.sum_univ_def]
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro j _
  
  
  have hblock :
      (((sim w₁[i].2 w₂[j].2).map (fun e => (w₁[i].1 * w₂[j].1 * e.1, e.2))).toList.map
          (fun e => if Q ∈ simplex e.2 then e.1 else 0)).sum
        = winding ((sim w₁[i].2 w₂[j].2).map
            (fun e => (w₁[i].1 * w₂[j].1 * e.1, e.2))) Q := rfl
  rw [hblock]
  
  rw [CSG.Proof.WindingAlgebra.winding_scale]
  
  rfl

name: winding_mul_off_planes
statement:
theorem winding_mul_off_planes (w₁ w₂ : Chain) :
    ∃ N : Set Point, Negligible N
      ∧ ∀ Q ∉ N, winding (productChain w₁ w₂) Q = winding w₁ Q * winding w₂ Q
proof:
:= by
  classical
  
  choose N hN using fun (p : Fin w₁.size × Fin w₂.size) =>
    CSG.Proof.SimWinding.sim_winding w₁[p.1].2 w₂[p.2].2
  
  refine ⟨⋃ p : Fin w₁.size × Fin w₂.size, N p, ?_, ?_⟩
  · exact CSG.Proof.Negligible.negligible_iUnion_fintype (fun p => (hN p).1)
  · intro Q hQ
    
    have hQp : ∀ p : Fin w₁.size × Fin w₂.size, Q ∉ N p := by
      intro p hp
      exact hQ (Set.mem_iUnion.2 ⟨p, hp⟩)
    
    rw [winding_productChain_double_sum]
    
    
    have hstep : ∀ (i : Fin w₁.size) (j : Fin w₂.size),
        (w₁[i].1 * w₂[j].1) * winding (sim w₁[i].2 w₂[j].2) Q
          = (w₁[i].1 * w₂[j].1) *
              ((if Q ∈ simplex w₁[i].2 then (1 : ℤ) else 0)
                * (if Q ∈ simplex w₂[j].2 then (1 : ℤ) else 0)) := by
      intro i j
      have hwind := (hN (i, j)).2.2 Q (hQp (i, j))
      rw [hwind, CSG.Proof.WindingAlgebra.indicator_inter_eq_mul]
    
    calc
      ∑ i : Fin w₁.size, ∑ j : Fin w₂.size,
          (w₁[i].1 * w₂[j].1) * winding (sim w₁[i].2 w₂[j].2) Q
          = ∑ i : Fin w₁.size, ∑ j : Fin w₂.size,
              (w₁[i].1 * w₂[j].1) *
                ((if Q ∈ simplex w₁[i].2 then (1 : ℤ) else 0)
                  * (if Q ∈ simplex w₂[j].2 then (1 : ℤ) else 0)) := by
            apply Finset.sum_congr rfl; intro i _
            apply Finset.sum_congr rfl; intro j _
            exact hstep i j
      _ = (∑ i : Fin w₁.size,
              w₁[i].1 * (if Q ∈ simplex w₁[i].2 then (1 : ℤ) else 0))
            * (∑ j : Fin w₂.size,
                w₂[j].1 * (if Q ∈ simplex w₂[j].2 then (1 : ℤ) else 0)) :=
          CSG.Proof.WindingAlgebra.double_sum_factors
            (fun i => w₁[i].1) (fun j => w₂[j].1)
            (fun i => if Q ∈ simplex w₁[i].2 then (1 : ℤ) else 0)
            (fun j => if Q ∈ simplex w₂[j].2 then (1 : ℤ) else 0)
      _ = winding w₁ Q * winding w₂ Q := by
            rw [← winding_eq_finSum_indicator w₁ Q, ← winding_eq_finSum_indicator w₂ Q]

name: normal_of_product
statement:
theorem normal_of_product (w₁ w₂ : Chain) (h₁ : Legacy.Normal w₁) (h₂ : Legacy.Normal w₂) :
    Legacy.Normal (productChain w₁ w₂)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  obtain ⟨N₁, hN₁neg, hN₁⟩ := h₁
  obtain ⟨N₂, hN₂neg, hN₂⟩ := h₂
  obtain ⟨Nalg, hNalgNeg, hNalg⟩ := winding_mul_off_planes w₁ w₂
  refine ⟨N₁ ∪ N₂ ∪ Nalg, ?_, ?_⟩
  · exact CSG.Proof.Negligible.negligible_union
      (CSG.Proof.Negligible.negligible_union hN₁neg hN₂neg) hNalgNeg
  · intro Q hQ
    have hQ1 : Q ∉ N₁ := fun h => hQ (Or.inl (Or.inl h))
    have hQ2 : Q ∉ N₂ := fun h => hQ (Or.inl (Or.inr h))
    have hQa : Q ∉ Nalg := fun h => hQ (Or.inr h)
    rw [hNalg Q hQa]
    rcases hN₁ Q hQ1 with h1 | h1 <;> rcases hN₂ Q hQ2 with h2 | h2 <;>
      rw [h1, h2] <;> simp

name: eqOffPlanes_of_product
statement:
theorem eqOffPlanes_of_product (w₁ w₂ : Chain) :
    EqOffPlanes (Legacy.solid (productChain w₁ w₂)) (Legacy.solid w₁ ∩ Legacy.solid w₂)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  obtain ⟨Nalg, hNalgNeg, hNalg⟩ := winding_mul_off_planes w₁ w₂
  refine ⟨Nalg, hNalgNeg, ?_⟩
  
  intro Q hQ
  by_contra hc
  
  
  
  have hfact := hNalg Q hc
  
  have hmem : Q ∈ Legacy.solid (productChain w₁ w₂) ↔ Q ∈ Legacy.solid w₁ ∩ Legacy.solid w₂ := by
    unfold Legacy.solid
    simp only [Set.mem_inter_iff, Set.mem_setOf_eq]
    rw [hfact, mul_ne_zero_iff]
  
  rcases hQ with hQ | hQ
  · exact (Set.not_mem_of_mem_diff (hQ)) ((hmem.1) (Set.mem_of_mem_diff hQ))
  · exact (Set.not_mem_of_mem_diff (hQ)) ((hmem.2) (Set.mem_of_mem_diff hQ))

name: cross_self
statement: theorem cross_self (u : Fin 2 → ℚ) : cross u u = 0
proof:
:= by
  simp only [cross]; ring

name: cross_antisymm
statement: theorem cross_antisymm (u v : Fin 2 → ℚ) : cross u v = - cross v u
proof:
:= by
  simp only [cross]; ring

name: cross_add_right
statement:
theorem cross_add_right (u v w : Fin 2 → ℚ) :
    cross u (v + w) = cross u v + cross u w
proof:
:= by
  simp only [cross, Pi.add_apply]; ring

name: cross_smul_left
statement:
theorem cross_smul_left (a : ℚ) (u v : Fin 2 → ℚ) :
    cross (a • u) v = a * cross u v
proof:
:= by
  simp only [cross, Pi.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul]; ring

name: cross_smul_right
statement:
theorem cross_smul_right (a : ℚ) (u v : Fin 2 → ℚ) :
    cross u (a • v) = a * cross u v
proof:
:= by
  simp only [cross, Pi.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul]; ring

name: cross_sub_left
statement:
theorem cross_sub_left (u v w : Fin 2 → ℚ) :
    cross (u - v) w = cross u w - cross v w
proof:
:= by
  simp only [cross, Pi.sub_apply]; ring

name: cross_sub_right
statement:
theorem cross_sub_right (u v w : Fin 2 → ℚ) :
    cross u (v - w) = cross u v - cross u w
proof:
:= by
  simp only [cross, Pi.sub_apply]; ring

name: cross_otimes
statement:
theorem cross_otimes (a b d : Fin 2 → ℚ) :
    cross a d * b 1 = cross a b * d 1 + cross b d * a 1
proof:
:= by
  simp only [cross]; ring

name: inner_perp
statement:
theorem inner_perp (x w : Fin 2 → ℚ) :
    (∑ i, x i * perp w i) = cross w x
proof:
:= by
  simp only [Fin.sum_univ_two, perp, cross, Matrix.cons_val_zero, Matrix.cons_val_one,
    Matrix.head_cons]
  ring

name: cross_eq_zero_iff_not_linearIndependent
proof:
:= by
  rw [linearIndependent_fin2]
  simp only [Matrix.cons_val_zero, Matrix.cons_val_one, Matrix.head_cons]
  rw [not_and_or, not_not, or_iff_right_of_imp (by intro h; exact absurd h hv)]
  push_neg
  constructor
  · intro hc
    by_cases hv0 : v 0 = 0
    · have hv1 : v 1 ≠ 0 := by
        intro h1; apply hv; funext i; fin_cases i <;> simp_all
      have hu0 : u 0 = 0 := by
        have : u 0 * v 1 = 0 := by unfold cross at hc; rw [hv0] at hc; linarith
        rcases mul_eq_zero.1 this with h | h
        · exact h
        · exact absurd h hv1
      refine ⟨u 1 / v 1, ?_⟩
      funext i
      fin_cases i <;>
        simp only [Fin.isValue, Pi.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul, Fin.mk_zero, Fin.mk_one]
      · rw [hv0, mul_zero, hu0]
      · field_simp
    · refine ⟨u 0 / v 0, ?_⟩
      have hkey : u 0 * v 1 = u 1 * v 0 := by unfold cross at hc; linarith
      funext i
      fin_cases i <;>
        simp only [Fin.isValue, Pi.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul, Fin.mk_zero, Fin.mk_one]
      · field_simp
      · field_simp; linarith [hkey]
  · rintro ⟨a, ha⟩
    have h0 : u 0 = a * v 0 := by rw [← ha]; simp [Pi.smul_apply]
    have h1 : u 1 = a * v 1 := by rw [← ha]; simp [Pi.smul_apply]
    unfold cross; rw [h0, h1]; ring

name: half_plane_transitive
statement:
theorem half_plane_transitive {ν a b d : Fin 2 → ℚ} (_hν : ν ≠ 0)
    (_ha : a ≠ 0) (_hb : b ≠ 0) (_hd : d ≠ 0)
    (ha' : 0 < ∑ i, a i * ν i) (hb' : 0 < ∑ i, b i * ν i)
    (hd' : 0 < ∑ i, d i * ν i)
    (hab : 0 < cross a b) (hbd : 0 < cross b d) :
    0 < cross a d
proof:
:= by
  
  
  
  
  have hotimes : cross a d * (∑ i, b i * ν i)
      = cross a b * (∑ i, d i * ν i) + cross b d * (∑ i, a i * ν i) := by
    simp only [cross, Fin.sum_univ_two]; ring
  have hlhs : 0 < cross a d * (∑ i, b i * ν i) := by
    rw [hotimes]
    have t1 : 0 < cross a b * (∑ i, d i * ν i) := mul_pos hab hd'
    have t2 : 0 < cross b d * (∑ i, a i * ν i) := mul_pos hbd ha'
    linarith
  rcases lt_trichotomy (cross a d) 0 with hx | hx | hx
  · exact absurd hlhs (not_lt.mpr (le_of_lt (mul_neg_of_neg_of_pos hx hb')))
  · simp [hx] at hlhs
  · exact hx

name: rect_pair_bound
proof:
:= by
  rw [dotQ_add_right, dotQ_smul_right, dotQ_smul_right]
  calc |lam * dotQ n a + s * dotQ n b|
      ≤ |lam * dotQ n a| + |s * dotQ n b| := abs_add _ _
    _ = |lam| * |dotQ n a| + |s| * |dotQ n b| := by rw [abs_mul, abs_mul]
    _ ≤ 1 * |dotQ n a| + S * |dotQ n b| := by
        have h1 := abs_nonneg (dotQ n a)
        have h2 := abs_nonneg (dotQ n b)
        nlinarith
    _ = |dotQ n a| + S * |dotQ n b| := by ring

name: half_eval_add_smul
statement:
theorem half_eval_add_smul (g : Half) (z w : Point) (δ : ℚ) :
    g.eval (z + δ • w) = g.eval z + δ * dotQ g.n w
proof:
:= by
  simp only [Half.eval, dotQ_add_right, dotQ_smul_right]
  ring

name: triCycle_zero
statement: theorem triCycle_zero (t : Triangle) : triCycle t 0 = t.v₀
proof: := rfl

name: triCycle_one
statement: theorem triCycle_one (t : Triangle) : triCycle t 1 = t.v₁
proof: := rfl

name: triCycle_two
statement: theorem triCycle_two (t : Triangle) : triCycle t 2 = t.v₂
proof: := rfl

name: triCycle_onPlane
statement:
theorem triCycle_onPlane (t : Triangle) :
    Proof.MeshIntersectClip.OnPlane (carrierNormal t) (detOrigin t)
      (triCycle t)
proof:
:= by
  intro i
  fin_cases i
  · exact dotQ_carrierNormal_v₀ t
  · show dotQ (carrierNormal t) t.v₁ = detOrigin t
    simp only [carrierNormal, dotQ, crossQ, Proof.SimImplCover.mkPoint_zero,
      Proof.SimImplCover.mkPoint_one, Proof.SimImplCover.mkPoint_two,
      Pi.sub_apply, detOrigin]
    ring
  · show dotQ (carrierNormal t) t.v₂ = detOrigin t
    simp only [carrierNormal, dotQ, crossQ, Proof.SimImplCover.mkPoint_zero,
      Proof.SimImplCover.mkPoint_one, Proof.SimImplCover.mkPoint_two,
      Pi.sub_apply, detOrigin]
    ring

name: triCycle_eta0
statement:
theorem triCycle_eta0 (t : Triangle) :
    Proof.MeshIntersectClip.eta (carrierNormal t) (triCycle t) 0 t.v₂
      = dotQ (carrierNormal t) (carrierNormal t)
proof:
:= by
  rw [Proof.MeshIntersectClip.eta_eq, show ((0:Fin 3) + 1) = 1 from rfl,
    triCycle_zero, triCycle_one]
  rfl

name: triCycle_eta1
statement:
theorem triCycle_eta1 (t : Triangle) :
    Proof.MeshIntersectClip.eta (carrierNormal t) (triCycle t) 1 t.v₀
      = dotQ (carrierNormal t) (carrierNormal t)
proof:
:= by
  rw [Proof.MeshIntersectClip.eta_eq, show ((1:Fin 3) + 1) = 2 from rfl,
    triCycle_one, triCycle_two]
  simp only [carrierNormal, dotQ, crossQ, Proof.SimImplCover.mkPoint_zero,
    Proof.SimImplCover.mkPoint_one, Proof.SimImplCover.mkPoint_two,
    Pi.sub_apply]
  ring

name: triCycle_eta2
statement:
theorem triCycle_eta2 (t : Triangle) :
    Proof.MeshIntersectClip.eta (carrierNormal t) (triCycle t) 2 t.v₁
      = dotQ (carrierNormal t) (carrierNormal t)
proof:
:= by
  rw [Proof.MeshIntersectClip.eta_eq, show ((2:Fin 3) + 1) = 0 from rfl,
    triCycle_two, triCycle_zero]
  simp only [carrierNormal, dotQ, crossQ, Proof.SimImplCover.mkPoint_zero,
    Proof.SimImplCover.mkPoint_one, Proof.SimImplCover.mkPoint_two,
    Pi.sub_apply]
  ring

name: triCycle_strictConv
statement:
theorem triCycle_strictConv {t : Triangle} (hdet : detOrigin t ≠ 0) :
    Proof.MeshIntersectClip.StrictConv (carrierNormal t) (triCycle t)
proof:
:= by
  intro i j hji hji1
  have hcn := carrierNormal_ne_zero hdet
  have hpos := Proof.MeshIntersectGerm.dotQ_self_pos hcn
  fin_cases i <;> fin_cases j
  · exact absurd rfl hji
  · exact absurd (by decide) hji1
  · exact triCycle_eta0 t ▸ hpos
  · exact triCycle_eta1 t ▸ hpos
  · exact absurd rfl hji
  · exact absurd (by decide) hji1
  · exact absurd (by decide) hji1
  · exact triCycle_eta2 t ▸ hpos
  · exact absurd rfl hji

name: vpoly_triCycle
statement:
theorem vpoly_triCycle (t : Triangle) :
    Proof.MeshIntersectClip.vpoly (triCycle t) = triangleSet t
proof:
:= by
  rw [Proof.MeshIntersectClip.vpoly, triangleSet]
  congr 1
  ext p
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨i, rfl⟩
    fin_cases i
    · exact Set.mem_insert _ _
    · exact Set.mem_insert_of_mem _ (Set.mem_insert _ _)
    · exact Set.mem_insert_of_mem _ (Set.mem_insert_of_mem _ rfl)
  · intro hp
    rcases hp with rfl | rfl | rfl
    · exact ⟨0, rfl⟩
    · exact ⟨1, rfl⟩
    · exact ⟨2, rfl⟩

name: triangleSet_eq_eta
statement:
theorem triangleSet_eq_eta {t : Triangle} (hdet : detOrigin t ≠ 0) :
    triangleSet t = {p | dotQ (carrierNormal t) p = detOrigin t ∧
      ∀ i : Fin 3, 0 ≤ Proof.MeshIntersectClip.eta (carrierNormal t)
        (triCycle t) i p}
proof:
:= by
  rw [← vpoly_triCycle,
    Proof.MeshIntersectClip.vpoly_eq (by norm_num) (triCycle_onPlane t)
      (triCycle_strictConv hdet)]

name: inBox_bound
statement:
theorem inBox_bound {a b : Point} {S : ℚ} {w : Point} (n : Point)
    (hw : InBox a b S w) :
    |dotQ n w| ≤ |dotQ n a| + S * |dotQ n b|
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨lam, s, hlam, hs, rfl⟩ := hw
  exact rect_pair_bound hlam hs

name: qsign_ne_zero_iff
statement: theorem qsign_ne_zero_iff {q : ℚ} : qsign q ≠ 0 ↔ q ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro h hq
    rw [hq] at h
    exact h (by simp [qsign])
  · intro h
    rcases h.lt_or_lt with hlt | hlt
    · rw [qsign_of_neg hlt]; decide
    · rw [qsign_of_pos hlt]; decide

name: qsign_add_of_abs_lt
statement:
theorem qsign_add_of_abs_lt {c d : ℚ} (hc : c ≠ 0) (h : |d| < |c|) :
    qsign (c + d) = qsign c
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨hiff, hne⟩ := sign_stable hc h
  rcases hc.lt_or_lt with hneg | hpos
  · have hcd : c + d < 0 :=
      lt_of_le_of_ne (not_lt.mp (fun hlt => absurd (hiff.mp hlt)
        (not_lt.mpr hneg.le))) hne
    rw [qsign_of_neg hneg, qsign_of_neg hcd]
  · rw [qsign_of_pos hpos, qsign_of_pos (hiff.mpr hpos)]

name: exists_delta_qsign
statement:
theorem exists_delta_qsign (n a b : Point) {S : ℚ} (hS : 0 ≤ S) {c : ℚ}
    (hc : c ≠ 0) :
    ∃ δ₁ : ℚ, 0 < δ₁ ∧ ∀ δ : ℚ, 0 < δ → δ ≤ δ₁ → ∀ w, InBox a b S w →
      qsign (c + δ * dotQ n w) = qsign c
proof:
:= by
  set B := |dotQ n a| + S * |dotQ n b| with hB
  have hB0 : 0 ≤ B := by positivity
  refine ⟨|c| / (B + 1), by positivity, ?_⟩
  intro δ h0 hδ w hw
  apply qsign_add_of_abs_lt hc
  have hbound : |dotQ n w| ≤ B := inBox_bound n hw
  calc |δ * dotQ n w| = δ * |dotQ n w| := by
        rw [abs_mul, abs_of_pos h0]
    _ ≤ (|c| / (B + 1)) * B := by
        apply mul_le_mul hδ hbound (abs_nonneg _)
        positivity
    _ < |c| := by
        rw [div_mul_eq_mul_div, div_lt_iff₀ (by positivity : (0:ℚ) < B + 1)]
        have : 0 < |c| := abs_pos.mpr hc
        nlinarith

name: exists_delta_forall_mem
statement:
theorem exists_delta_forall_mem {α : Type*} (l : List α) (P : α → ℚ → Prop)
    (h : ∀ x ∈ l, ∃ δ₁ : ℚ, 0 < δ₁ ∧ ∀ δ : ℚ, 0 < δ → δ ≤ δ₁ → P x δ) :
    ∃ δ₁ : ℚ, 0 < δ₁ ∧ ∀ δ : ℚ, 0 < δ → δ ≤ δ₁ → ∀ x ∈ l, P x δ
proof:
:= by
  induction l with
  | nil => exact ⟨1, one_pos, fun δ _ _ x hx => absurd hx (List.not_mem_nil x)⟩
  | cons y l ih =>
    obtain ⟨δy, hδy, hy⟩ := h y (List.mem_cons_self y l)
    obtain ⟨δl, hδl, hl⟩ := ih (fun x hx => h x (List.mem_cons_of_mem _ hx))
    refine ⟨min δy δl, lt_min hδy hδl, fun δ h0 hδ x hx => ?_⟩
    rcases List.mem_cons.mp hx with rfl | hx
    · exact hy δ h0 (le_trans hδ (min_le_left _ _))
    · exact hl δ h0 (le_trans hδ (min_le_right _ _)) x hx

name: exists_delta_forall_fin
statement:
theorem exists_delta_forall_fin {n : ℕ} (P : Fin n → ℚ → Prop)
    (h : ∀ i, ∃ δ₁ : ℚ, 0 < δ₁ ∧ ∀ δ : ℚ, 0 < δ → δ ≤ δ₁ → P i δ) :
    ∃ δ₁ : ℚ, 0 < δ₁ ∧ ∀ δ : ℚ, 0 < δ → δ ≤ δ₁ → ∀ i, P i δ
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨δ₁, hδ₁, hP⟩ := exists_delta_forall_mem (List.finRange n) P
    (fun i _ => h i)
  exact ⟨δ₁, hδ₁, fun δ h0 hδ i => hP δ h0 hδ i (List.mem_finRange i)⟩

name: etaDir_eq_dotQ
statement:
theorem etaDir_eq_dotQ (n : Point) (w : Fin 3 → Point) (i : Fin 3)
    (v : Point) :
    Proof.MeshIntersectClip.etaDir n w i v
      = dotQ (crossQ n (w (i + 1) - w i)) v
proof:
:= by
  rw [Proof.MeshIntersectClip.etaDir]
  simp only [dotQ, crossQ, Proof.SimImplCover.mkPoint_zero,
    Proof.SimImplCover.mkPoint_one, Proof.SimImplCover.mkPoint_two,
    Pi.sub_apply]
  ring

name: exists_delta_mesh
statement:
theorem exists_delta_mesh (M : Mesh) (z a b : Point) {S : ℚ} (hS : 0 ≤ S) :
    ∃ δ₁ : ℚ, 0 < δ₁ ∧ ∀ δ : ℚ, 0 < δ → δ ≤ δ₁ → ∀ w, InBox a b S w →
      ∀ i : Fin M.size,
        (∀ g ∈ tetraHalves M[i], g.eval z ≠ 0 → g.eval (z + δ • w) ≠ 0)
        ∧ (∀ k : Fin 3,
            Proof.MeshIntersectClip.eta (carrierNormal M[i]) (triCycle M[i])
              k z ≠ 0 →
            qsign (Proof.MeshIntersectClip.eta (carrierNormal M[i])
                (triCycle M[i]) k (z + δ • w))
              = qsign (Proof.MeshIntersectClip.eta (carrierNormal M[i])
                (triCycle M[i]) k z))
        ∧ (dotQ (carrierNormal M[i]) z ≠ detOrigin M[i] →
            dotQ (carrierNormal M[i]) (z + δ • w) ≠ detOrigin M[i])
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have key : ∀ i : Fin M.size, ∃ δ₁ : ℚ, 0 < δ₁ ∧
      ∀ δ : ℚ, 0 < δ → δ ≤ δ₁ → ∀ w, InBox a b S w →
        (∀ g ∈ tetraHalves M[i], g.eval z ≠ 0 → g.eval (z + δ • w) ≠ 0)
        ∧ (∀ k : Fin 3,
            Proof.MeshIntersectClip.eta (carrierNormal M[i]) (triCycle M[i])
              k z ≠ 0 →
            qsign (Proof.MeshIntersectClip.eta (carrierNormal M[i])
                (triCycle M[i]) k (z + δ • w))
              = qsign (Proof.MeshIntersectClip.eta (carrierNormal M[i])
                (triCycle M[i]) k z))
        ∧ (dotQ (carrierNormal M[i]) z ≠ detOrigin M[i] →
            dotQ (carrierNormal M[i]) (z + δ • w) ≠ detOrigin M[i]) := by
    intro i
    
    have hfac : ∃ δ₁ : ℚ, 0 < δ₁ ∧ ∀ δ : ℚ, 0 < δ → δ ≤ δ₁ →
        ∀ w, InBox a b S w → ∀ g ∈ (tetraHalves M[i]).toList,
          g.eval z ≠ 0 → g.eval (z + δ • w) ≠ 0 := by
      have h := exists_delta_forall_mem (tetraHalves M[i]).toList
        (fun g δ => ∀ w, InBox a b S w → g.eval z ≠ 0 →
          g.eval (z + δ • w) ≠ 0) ?_
      · obtain ⟨δ₁, hδ₁, hP⟩ := h
        exact ⟨δ₁, hδ₁, fun δ h0 hδ w hw g hg hgz => hP δ h0 hδ g hg w hw hgz⟩
      · intro g _
        by_cases hgz : g.eval z = 0
        · exact ⟨1, one_pos, fun δ _ _ w _ h => absurd hgz h⟩
        · obtain ⟨δ₁, hδ₁, hq⟩ := exists_delta_qsign g.n a b hS hgz
          refine ⟨δ₁, hδ₁, fun δ h0 hδ w hw _ => ?_⟩
          rw [half_eval_add_smul]
          exact qsign_ne_zero_iff.mp (by
            rw [hq δ h0 hδ w hw]
            exact qsign_ne_zero_iff.mpr hgz)
    
    have heta : ∃ δ₁ : ℚ, 0 < δ₁ ∧ ∀ δ : ℚ, 0 < δ → δ ≤ δ₁ →
        ∀ w, InBox a b S w → ∀ k : Fin 3,
          Proof.MeshIntersectClip.eta (carrierNormal M[i]) (triCycle M[i])
            k z ≠ 0 →
          qsign (Proof.MeshIntersectClip.eta (carrierNormal M[i])
              (triCycle M[i]) k (z + δ • w))
            = qsign (Proof.MeshIntersectClip.eta (carrierNormal M[i])
              (triCycle M[i]) k z) := by
      have h := exists_delta_forall_fin (n := 3)
        (fun k δ => ∀ w, InBox a b S w →
          Proof.MeshIntersectClip.eta (carrierNormal M[i]) (triCycle M[i])
            k z ≠ 0 →
          qsign (Proof.MeshIntersectClip.eta (carrierNormal M[i])
              (triCycle M[i]) k (z + δ • w))
            = qsign (Proof.MeshIntersectClip.eta (carrierNormal M[i])
              (triCycle M[i]) k z)) ?_
      · obtain ⟨δ₁, hδ₁, hP⟩ := h
        exact ⟨δ₁, hδ₁, fun δ h0 hδ w hw k => hP δ h0 hδ k w hw⟩
      · intro k
        by_cases hez : Proof.MeshIntersectClip.eta (carrierNormal M[i])
            (triCycle M[i]) k z = 0
        · exact ⟨1, one_pos, fun δ _ _ w _ h => absurd hez h⟩
        · obtain ⟨δ₁, hδ₁, hq⟩ := exists_delta_qsign
            (crossQ (carrierNormal M[i])
              (triCycle M[i] (k + 1) - triCycle M[i] k)) a b hS hez
          refine ⟨δ₁, hδ₁, fun δ h0 hδ w hw _ => ?_⟩
          rw [Proof.MeshIntersectClip.eta_add_smul, etaDir_eq_dotQ]
          exact hq δ h0 hδ w hw
    
    have hpl : ∃ δ₁ : ℚ, 0 < δ₁ ∧ ∀ δ : ℚ, 0 < δ → δ ≤ δ₁ →
        ∀ w, InBox a b S w →
          dotQ (carrierNormal M[i]) z ≠ detOrigin M[i] →
          dotQ (carrierNormal M[i]) (z + δ • w) ≠ detOrigin M[i] := by
      by_cases hz : dotQ (carrierNormal M[i]) z = detOrigin M[i]
      · exact ⟨1, one_pos, fun δ _ _ w _ h => absurd hz h⟩
      · obtain ⟨δ₁, hδ₁, hq⟩ := exists_delta_qsign (carrierNormal M[i]) a b hS
          (sub_ne_zero.mpr hz)
        refine ⟨δ₁, hδ₁, fun δ h0 hδ w hw _ hc => ?_⟩
        have := hq δ h0 hδ w hw
        rw [dotQ_add_right, dotQ_smul_right] at hc
        have hzero : dotQ (carrierNormal M[i]) z - detOrigin M[i]
            + δ * dotQ (carrierNormal M[i]) w = 0 := by linarith
        rw [hzero] at this
        exact (qsign_ne_zero_iff.mpr (sub_ne_zero.mpr hz))
          (by rw [← this]; simp [qsign])
    obtain ⟨δa, hδa, ha⟩ := hfac
    obtain ⟨δb, hδb, hb⟩ := heta
    obtain ⟨δc, hδc, hc⟩ := hpl
    refine ⟨min δa (min δb δc), lt_min hδa (lt_min hδb hδc),
      fun δ h0 hδ w hw => ⟨?_, ?_, ?_⟩⟩
    · intro g hg
      exact ha δ h0 (le_trans hδ (min_le_left _ _)) w hw g
        (Array.mem_toList.mpr hg)
    · exact hb δ h0 (le_trans hδ (le_trans (min_le_right _ _)
        (min_le_left _ _))) w hw
    · exact hc δ h0 (le_trans hδ (le_trans (min_le_right _ _)
        (min_le_right _ _))) w hw
  obtain ⟨δ₁, hδ₁, hP⟩ := exists_delta_forall_fin _ key
  exact ⟨δ₁, hδ₁, fun δ h0 hδ w hw i => hP δ h0 hδ i w hw⟩

name: box_off_face
statement:
theorem box_off_face {t : Triangle} (hdet : detOrigin t ≠ 0) {z P : Point}
    (hz : z ∉ triangleSet t)
    (hpl : dotQ (carrierNormal t) z ≠ detOrigin t →
      dotQ (carrierNormal t) P ≠ detOrigin t)
    (heta : ∀ k : Fin 3,
      Proof.MeshIntersectClip.eta (carrierNormal t) (triCycle t) k z ≠ 0 →
      qsign (Proof.MeshIntersectClip.eta (carrierNormal t) (triCycle t) k P)
        = qsign (Proof.MeshIntersectClip.eta (carrierNormal t)
            (triCycle t) k z)) :
    P ∉ triangleSet t
proof:
:= by
  intro hP
  rw [triangleSet_eq_eta hdet] at hP hz
  by_cases hplz : dotQ (carrierNormal t) z = detOrigin t
  · 
    have hbad : ¬ ∀ k : Fin 3, 0 ≤ Proof.MeshIntersectClip.eta
        (carrierNormal t) (triCycle t) k z := fun h => hz ⟨hplz, h⟩
    push_neg at hbad
    obtain ⟨k, hkneg⟩ := hbad
    have hsign := heta k (ne_of_lt hkneg)
    rw [qsign_of_neg hkneg] at hsign
    have hPk := hP.2 k
    rcases lt_trichotomy (Proof.MeshIntersectClip.eta (carrierNormal t)
        (triCycle t) k P) 0 with h | h | h
    · exact absurd hPk (not_le.mpr h)
    · rw [h] at hsign
      simp [qsign] at hsign
    · rw [qsign_of_pos h] at hsign
      exact absurd hsign (by decide)
  · exact hpl hplz hP.1

name: tetraHalves_n_ne_zero
statement:
theorem tetraHalves_n_ne_zero {t : Triangle} (hdet : detOrigin t ≠ 0)
    {g : Half} (hg : g ∈ tetraHalves t) : g.n ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨k, rfl⟩ := mem_tetraHalves_iff.mp hg
  intro h0
  fin_cases k
  · have h0' : (slot t 0).n = 0 := h0
    have := slot0_lat hdet t.v₀
    rw [h0', Proof.MeshIntersectClip.dotQ_comm,
      Proof.MeshIntersectClip.dotQ_zero_right, Proof.SimImplCover.dotQ_crossQ_det,
      det3_eq_detOrigin] at this
    rcases orientSign_cases hdet with hor | hor <;> rw [hor] at this <;>
      exact hdet (by push_cast at this; linarith)
  · have h0' : (slot t 1).n = 0 := h0
    have := slot1_lat hdet t.v₁
    have hv : dotQ (crossQ t.v₂ t.v₀) t.v₁ = detOrigin t := by
      rw [Proof.SimImplCover.dotQ_crossQ_det, ← det3_eq_detOrigin]
      simp only [Proof.SimImplCover.det3_expand]
      ring
    rw [h0', Proof.MeshIntersectClip.dotQ_comm,
      Proof.MeshIntersectClip.dotQ_zero_right, hv] at this
    rcases orientSign_cases hdet with hor | hor <;> rw [hor] at this <;>
      exact hdet (by push_cast at this; linarith)
  · have h0' : (slot t 2).n = 0 := h0
    have := slot2_lat hdet t.v₂
    have hv : dotQ (crossQ t.v₀ t.v₁) t.v₂ = detOrigin t := by
      rw [Proof.SimImplCover.dotQ_crossQ_det, ← det3_eq_detOrigin]
      simp only [Proof.SimImplCover.det3_expand]
      ring
    rw [h0', Proof.MeshIntersectClip.dotQ_comm,
      Proof.MeshIntersectClip.dotQ_zero_right, hv] at this
    rcases orientSign_cases hdet with hor | hor <;> rw [hor] at this <;>
      exact hdet (by push_cast at this; linarith)
  · have h0' : (slot t 3).n = 0 := h0
    have := slot3_n_sign hdet t.v₀
    rw [h0', Proof.MeshIntersectClip.dotQ_comm,
      Proof.MeshIntersectClip.dotQ_zero_right, faceNormal_offset] at this
    rcases orientSign_cases hdet with hor | hor <;> rw [hor] at this <;>
      exact hdet (by push_cast at this; linarith)

name: slot_eval_matrix
statement:
theorem slot_eval_matrix {t : Triangle} (hdet : detOrigin t ≠ 0)
    (k : Fin 4) :
    0 < (slot t k).eval (slotVert t k)
      ∧ ∀ k' : Fin 4, k ≠ k' → (slot t k).eval (slotVert t k') = 0
proof:
:= by
  have hd3 : dotQ (crossQ t.v₁ t.v₂) t.v₀ = detOrigin t := by
    rw [Proof.SimImplCover.dotQ_crossQ_det, det3_eq_detOrigin]
  have hd1 : dotQ (crossQ t.v₀ t.v₂) t.v₁ = - detOrigin t := by
    rw [Proof.SimImplCover.dotQ_crossQ_det, ← det3_eq_detOrigin]
    simp only [Proof.SimImplCover.det3_expand]
    ring
  have hd2 : dotQ (crossQ t.v₀ t.v₁) t.v₂ = detOrigin t := by
    rw [Proof.SimImplCover.dotQ_crossQ_det, ← det3_eq_detOrigin]
    simp only [Proof.SimImplCover.det3_expand]
    ring
  have hself : ∀ u v : Point,
      dotQ (crossQ u v) u = 0 ∧ dotQ (crossQ u v) v = 0 := by
    intro u v
    constructor <;>
    · simp only [dotQ, crossQ, Proof.SimImplCover.mkPoint_zero,
        Proof.SimImplCover.mkPoint_one, Proof.SimImplCover.mkPoint_two]
      ring
  fin_cases k
  · 
    obtain ⟨hz, hpos, hvan, -⟩ := Proof.SimImplCover.origin_facet_eval
      (crossQ t.v₁ t.v₂) t.v₀ (by rw [hd3]; exact hdet) (slot t 0) rfl
    refine ⟨by simpa using hpos, ?_⟩
    intro k' hk'
    fin_cases k' <;> first
    | exact absurd rfl hk'
    | (show (slot t 0).eval _ = 0
       first
       | simpa using hvan t.v₁ (hself t.v₁ t.v₂).1
       | simpa using hvan t.v₂ (hself t.v₁ t.v₂).2
       | simpa using hz)
  · obtain ⟨hz, hpos, hvan, -⟩ := Proof.SimImplCover.origin_facet_eval
      (crossQ t.v₀ t.v₂) t.v₁ (by rw [hd1]; exact neg_ne_zero.mpr hdet)
      (slot t 1) rfl
    refine ⟨by simpa using hpos, ?_⟩
    intro k' hk'
    fin_cases k' <;> first
    | exact absurd rfl hk'
    | (show (slot t 1).eval _ = 0
       first
       | simpa using hvan t.v₀ (hself t.v₀ t.v₂).1
       | simpa using hvan t.v₂ (hself t.v₀ t.v₂).2
       | simpa using hz)
  · obtain ⟨hz, hpos, hvan, -⟩ := Proof.SimImplCover.origin_facet_eval
      (crossQ t.v₀ t.v₁) t.v₂ (by rw [hd2]; exact hdet) (slot t 2) rfl
    refine ⟨by simpa using hpos, ?_⟩
    intro k' hk'
    fin_cases k' <;> first
    | exact absurd rfl hk'
    | (show (slot t 2).eval _ = 0
       first
       | simpa using hvan t.v₀ (hself t.v₀ t.v₁).1
       | simpa using hvan t.v₁ (hself t.v₀ t.v₁).2
       | simpa using hz)
  · 
    have hc3 : dotQ (crossQ (psub t.v₁ t.v₀) (psub t.v₂ t.v₀)) t.v₀
        = detOrigin t := faceNormal_offset t
    obtain ⟨h0, h1, h2, hpos, -⟩ := Proof.SimImplCover.base_facet_eval
      t.v₀ t.v₁ t.v₂ _ rfl _ rfl (by rw [hc3]; exact hdet) (slot t 3) rfl
    refine ⟨by simpa using hpos, ?_⟩
    intro k' hk'
    fin_cases k' <;> first
    | exact absurd rfl hk'
    | (show (slot t 3).eval _ = 0
       first
       | simpa using h0
       | simpa using h1
       | simpa using h2)

name: facet_pair_vertex
statement:
theorem facet_pair_vertex {t : Triangle} (hdet : detOrigin t ≠ 0)
    {g g' : Half} (hg : g ∈ tetraHalves t) (hg' : g' ∈ tetraHalves t)
    (hne : g ≠ g') :
    ∃ p : Point, g.eval p ≠ 0 ∧ g'.eval p = 0
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨k, rfl⟩ := mem_tetraHalves_iff.mp hg
  obtain ⟨k', rfl⟩ := mem_tetraHalves_iff.mp hg'
  have hkk : k' ≠ k := fun h => hne (by rw [h])
  exact ⟨slotVert t k, ne_of_gt (slot_eval_matrix hdet k).1,
    (slot_eval_matrix hdet k').2 k hkk⟩

name: slot_lat_c
statement:
theorem slot_lat_c (t : Triangle) (k : Fin 4) (hk : k ≠ 3) :
    (slot t k).c = 0
proof:
:= by
  fin_cases k
  · show (slot t 0).c = 0
    have h : slot t 0
        = (if 0 ≤ dotQ (crossQ t.v₁ t.v₂) t.v₀
           then (⟨crossQ t.v₁ t.v₂, 0⟩ : Half)
           else Half.neg ⟨crossQ t.v₁ t.v₂, 0⟩) := rfl
    rw [h]
    split_ifs <;> simp [Half.neg]
  · show (slot t 1).c = 0
    have h : slot t 1
        = (if 0 ≤ dotQ (crossQ t.v₀ t.v₂) t.v₁
           then (⟨crossQ t.v₀ t.v₂, 0⟩ : Half)
           else Half.neg ⟨crossQ t.v₀ t.v₂, 0⟩) := rfl
    rw [h]
    split_ifs <;> simp [Half.neg]
  · show (slot t 2).c = 0
    have h : slot t 2
        = (if 0 ≤ dotQ (crossQ t.v₀ t.v₁) t.v₂
           then (⟨crossQ t.v₀ t.v₁, 0⟩ : Half)
           else Half.neg ⟨crossQ t.v₀ t.v₁, 0⟩) := rfl
    rw [h]
    split_ifs <;> simp [Half.neg]
  · exact absurd rfl hk

name: originPlane_isPlane
proof:
:= by

name: affineBasis_coord_linear_ne_zero
statement:
theorem affineBasis_coord_linear_ne_zero
    (b : AffineBasis (Fin 4) ℚ (Fin 3 → ℚ)) (k : Fin 4) :
    (b.coord k).linear ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  
  
  intro hlin
  
  obtain ⟨j, hj⟩ : ∃ j : Fin 4, k ≠ j := by
    obtain ⟨j, hj⟩ := exists_ne k
    exact ⟨j, fun h => hj h.symm⟩
  
  have hdiff : (b.coord k).linear (b k - b j) = b.coord k (b k) - b.coord k (b j) := by
    have := (b.coord k).linearMap_vsub (b k) (b j)
    simpa [vsub_eq_sub] using this
  rw [hlin, LinearMap.zero_apply, AffineBasis.coord_apply_eq,
    AffineBasis.coord_apply_ne b hj] at hdiff
  norm_num at hdiff

name: coplanar_subset_isPlane
proof:
:= by
  
  have hfd : Module.finrank ℚ (vectorSpan ℚ K) ≤ 2 := (coplanar_iff_finrank_le_two).1 hco
  have hlt : vectorSpan ℚ K < ⊤ := by
    rw [lt_top_iff_ne_top]
    intro htop
    have hrank : Module.finrank ℚ (vectorSpan ℚ K) = Module.finrank ℚ (Fin 3 → ℚ) := by
      rw [htop]; exact finrank_top ℚ (Fin 3 → ℚ)
    rw [Module.finrank_pi ℚ] at hrank
    simp only [Fintype.card_fin] at hrank
    omega
  
  obtain ⟨f, hfne, hfbot⟩ :=
    (vectorSpan ℚ K).exists_dual_map_eq_bot_of_lt_top hlt inferInstance
  
  set n : Point := fun i => f (Pi.single i (1 : ℚ)) with hn
  have hfdot : ∀ x : Point, f x = ∑ i, n i * x i := by
    intro x
    have hx : x = ∑ i, x i • (Pi.single i (1 : ℚ) : Point) := by
      ext j
      simp [Pi.single_apply, Finset.sum_ite_eq]
    calc f x = f (∑ i, x i • (Pi.single i (1 : ℚ) : Point)) := by rw [← hx]
      _ = ∑ i, x i • f (Pi.single i (1 : ℚ) : Point) := by rw [map_sum]; simp only [map_smul]
      _ = ∑ i, n i * x i := by
            simp only [hn, smul_eq_mul]
            exact Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun i _ => mul_comm _ _)
  
  have hfvanish : ∀ v ∈ vectorSpan ℚ K, f v = 0 := by
    intro v hv
    have : f v ∈ (vectorSpan ℚ K).map f := Submodule.mem_map_of_mem hv
    rw [hfbot] at this
    exact this
  
  obtain ⟨p, hp⟩ := hne
  refine ⟨{x : Point | (∑ i, n i * x i) = ∑ i, n i * p i}, ?_, ?_⟩
  · 
    refine ⟨n, ∑ i, n i * p i, ?_, rfl⟩
    intro hn0
    apply hfne
    apply LinearMap.ext
    intro x
    rw [hfdot x, hn0]
    simp
  · 
    intro x hx
    simp only [Set.mem_setOf_eq]
    have hvsub : x - p ∈ vectorSpan ℚ K := by
      have := vsub_mem_vectorSpan ℚ hx hp
      simpa [vsub_eq_sub] using this
    have hf0 : f (x - p) = 0 := hfvanish _ hvsub
    rw [hfdot (x - p)] at hf0
    have hkey : ∑ i, n i * x i - ∑ i, n i * p i = 0 := by
      rw [← Finset.sum_sub_distrib]
      rw [← hf0]
      apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
      intro i _
      simp only [Pi.sub_apply]
      ring
    linarith [hkey]

statement: theorem trMesh_size (O : Point) (M : Mesh) : (trMesh O M).size = M.size

name: trMesh_getElem
statement:
theorem trMesh_getElem (O : Point) (M : Mesh) (i : Fin (trMesh O M).size) (hi' : i.1 < M.size) :

proof:
