name: noPlaneThroughOrigin_trMesh_iff
statement:
theorem noPlaneThroughOrigin_trMesh_iff (O : Point) (M : Mesh) :
    NoPlaneThroughOrigin (trMesh O M) ↔
      ∀ i : Fin M.size, dot (faceNormal M[i]) O ≠ dot (faceNormal M[i]) M[i].v₀
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro h i
    have hb : (i : Nat) < (trMesh O M).size := by rw [trMesh_size O M]; exact i.isLt
    have hh := h ⟨(i : Nat), hb⟩
    rw [trMesh_getElem O M ⟨(i : Nat), hb⟩ i.isLt] at hh
    exact (detOrigin_trTri_ne_zero_iff O M[i]).mp hh
  · intro h i
    have hi' : (i : Nat) < M.size := by rw [← trMesh_size O M]; exact i.isLt
    rw [trMesh_getElem O M i hi']
    exact (detOrigin_trTri_ne_zero_iff O (M[(i : Nat)]'hi')).mpr (h ⟨(i : Nat), hi'⟩)

name: good_origin
statement:
theorem good_origin {M : Mesh} (hM : NoDegenerateFaces M)
    {ι : Type} [Fintype ι] (N : ι → Point) (c : ι → ℚ) (hN : ∀ α, N α ≠ 0) :
    ∃ O : Point, NoPlaneThroughOrigin (trMesh O M) ∧ ∀ α, dot (N α) O ≠ c α
proof:
:= by
  classical
  obtain ⟨O, hO, -⟩ := Proof.MeshIntersectRayClassifyNormal.side_dense_ball' (0 : Point)
    (Sum.elim (fun i : Fin M.size => faceNormal M[i]) N)
    (Sum.elim (fun i : Fin M.size => dotQ (faceNormal M[i]) M[i].v₀) c)
    (by rintro (i | α)
        · exact hM i
        · exact hN α)
    1 one_pos
  refine ⟨O, (noPlaneThroughOrigin_trMesh_iff O M).mpr (fun i => ?_), fun α => ?_⟩
  · have hne := (hO (Sum.inl i)).1
    simp only [Sum.elim_inl] at hne
    rw [dot_eq_dotQ, dot_eq_dotQ]
    exact hne
  · have hne := (hO (Sum.inr α)).1
    simp only [Sum.elim_inr] at hne
    rw [dot_eq_dotQ]
    exact hne

name: good_origin_of_nonDegenerate
statement:
theorem good_origin_of_nonDegenerate {M : Mesh} (hM : NoDegenerateFaces M) :
    ∃ O : Point, NoPlaneThroughOrigin (trMesh O M)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨O, hO, -⟩ := good_origin hM (ι := Empty) Empty.elim Empty.elim (fun e => e.elim)
  exact ⟨O, hO⟩

name: good_origin
statement:
theorem good_origin₂ {M₁ M₂ : Mesh} (h₁ : NoDegenerateFaces M₁) (h₂ : NoDegenerateFaces M₂)
    {ι : Type} [Fintype ι] (N : ι → Point) (c : ι → ℚ) (hN : ∀ α, N α ≠ 0) :
    ∃ O : Point, NoPlaneThroughOrigin (trMesh O M₁) ∧ NoPlaneThroughOrigin (trMesh O M₂) ∧
      ∀ α, dot (N α) O ≠ c α
proof:
:= by
  classical
  obtain ⟨O, h1, hrest⟩ := good_origin h₁
    (N := Sum.elim (fun j : Fin M₂.size => faceNormal M₂[j]) N)
    (c := Sum.elim (fun j : Fin M₂.size => dot (faceNormal M₂[j]) M₂[j].v₀) c)
    (by rintro (j | α)
        · exact h₂ j
        · exact hN α)
  refine ⟨O, h1, (noPlaneThroughOrigin_trMesh_iff O M₂).mpr (fun j => ?_), fun α => ?_⟩
  · have := hrest (Sum.inl j); simpa using this
  · have := hrest (Sum.inr α); simpa using this

name: not_noPlaneThroughOrigin_of_degenerate
statement:
theorem not_noPlaneThroughOrigin_of_degenerate {M : Mesh} (i : Fin M.size)
    (hdeg : faceNormal M[i] = 0) (O : Point) : ¬ NoPlaneThroughOrigin (trMesh O M)
proof:
:= by
  rw [noPlaneThroughOrigin_trMesh_iff]
  intro h
  exact h i (by rw [hdeg]; simp [dot])

name: rayHits_trTri
statement:
theorem rayHits_trTri (O Q d : Point) (t : Triangle) :
    RayHits (trPoint O Q) d (trTri O t) ↔ RayHits Q d t
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨s, hs, hmem⟩
    rw [trPoint_add_smul] at hmem
    exact ⟨s, hs, (mem_triangleSet_trTri O t (Q + s • d)).mp hmem⟩
  · rintro ⟨s, hs, hmem⟩
    refine ⟨s, hs, ?_⟩
    rw [trPoint_add_smul]
    exact (mem_triangleSet_trTri O t (Q + s • d)).mpr hmem

name: admissible_trMesh_iff
statement:
theorem admissible_trMesh_iff (O : Point) (M : Mesh) (Q d : Point) :
    AdmissibleRay (trMesh O M) (trPoint O Q) d ↔ AdmissibleRay M Q d
proof:
:= by
  unfold AdmissibleRay
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨hd, hedge⟩
    refine ⟨hd, fun i s hs hmem => ?_⟩
    have hb : (i : Nat) < (trMesh O M).size := by rw [trMesh_size O M]; exact i.isLt
    apply hedge ⟨(i : Nat), hb⟩ s hs
    rw [trMesh_getElem O M ⟨(i : Nat), hb⟩ i.isLt, trPoint_add_smul]
    exact (mem_edgeSet_trTri O M[i] (Q + s • d)).mpr hmem
  · rintro ⟨hd, hedge⟩
    refine ⟨hd, fun i s hs hmem => ?_⟩
    have hi' : (i : Nat) < M.size := by rw [← trMesh_size O M]; exact i.isLt
    rw [trMesh_getElem O M i hi', trPoint_add_smul] at hmem
    exact hedge ⟨(i : Nat), hi'⟩ s hs ((mem_edgeSet_trTri O (M[(i : Nat)]'hi') (Q + s • d)).mp hmem)

name: crossingCount_trMesh
statement:
theorem crossingCount_trMesh (O : Point) (M : Mesh) (Q d : Point) :
    crossingCount (trMesh O M) (trPoint O Q) d = crossingCount M Q d
proof:
:= by
  unfold crossingCount
  refine Fintype.sum_equiv (finCongr (trMesh_size O M)) _ _ (fun i => ?_)
  have hi' : (i : Nat) < M.size := by rw [← trMesh_size O M]; exact i.isLt
  have hget : (trMesh O M)[i] = trTri O (M[(i : Nat)]'hi') := trMesh_getElem O M i hi'
  have he : M[finCongr (trMesh_size O M) i] = M[(i : Nat)]'hi' := rfl
  rw [hget, he, faceNormal_trTri, rayHits_trTri]

name: faceEdges_trTri
statement:
theorem faceEdges_trTri (O : Point) (t : Triangle) :
    faceEdges (trTri O t) = (faceEdges t).map (Prod.map (trPoint O) (trPoint O))
proof:
:= by
  simp [faceEdges, trTri, Prod.map]

name: list_flatMap_faceEdges_map
statement:
theorem list_flatMap_faceEdges_map (O : Point) (l : List Triangle) :
    (l.map (trTri O)).flatMap faceEdges
      = (l.flatMap faceEdges).map (Prod.map (trPoint O) (trPoint O))
proof:
:= by
  induction l with
  | nil => rfl
  | cons t ts ih =>
    simp only [List.map_cons, List.flatMap_cons, List.map_append, faceEdges_trTri, ih]

name: edgeMultiset_trMesh
statement:
theorem edgeMultiset_trMesh (O : Point) (M : Mesh) :
    edgeMultiset (trMesh O M)
      = (edgeMultiset M).map (Prod.map (trPoint O) (trPoint O))
proof:
:= by
  simp only [edgeMultiset, trMesh, Array.toList_map, Multiset.map_coe,
    list_flatMap_faceEdges_map]

name: isCycle_trMesh_iff
statement: theorem isCycle_trMesh_iff (O : Point) (M : Mesh) : IsClosedOrientedSurface (trMesh O M) ↔ IsClosedOrientedSurface M
proof:
:= by
  have hcomm : Prod.swap ∘ Prod.map (trPoint O) (trPoint O)
      = Prod.map (trPoint O) (trPoint O) ∘ Prod.swap := by
    funext p; cases p; rfl
  have hginj : Function.Injective (Prod.map (trPoint O) (trPoint O)) :=
    Prod.map_injective.mpr ⟨trPoint_injective O, trPoint_injective O⟩
  unfold IsClosedOrientedSurface
  rw [edgeMultiset_trMesh, Multiset.map_map, hcomm, ← Multiset.map_map]
  exact (Multiset.map_injective hginj).eq_iff

name: noSelfIntersection_trMesh_iff
statement:
theorem noSelfIntersection_trMesh_iff (O : Point) (M : Mesh) :
    NoFaceInteriorContact (trMesh O M) ↔ NoFaceInteriorContact M
proof:
:= by
  unfold NoFaceInteriorContact
  constructor
  · intro h i j hij
    have hbi : (i : Nat) < (trMesh O M).size := by rw [trMesh_size O M]; exact i.isLt
    have hbj : (j : Nat) < (trMesh O M).size := by rw [trMesh_size O M]; exact j.isLt
    have hij' : (⟨(i : Nat), hbi⟩ : Fin (trMesh O M).size) ≠ ⟨(j : Nat), hbj⟩ := by
      intro hc
      rw [Fin.mk.injEq] at hc
      exact hij (Fin.ext hc)
    have hsub := h ⟨(i : Nat), hbi⟩ ⟨(j : Nat), hbj⟩ hij'
    rw [trMesh_getElem O M ⟨(i : Nat), hbi⟩ i.isLt, trMesh_getElem O M ⟨(j : Nat), hbj⟩ j.isLt,
        triangleSet_trTri, triangleSet_trTri, edgeSet_trTri,
        ← Set.image_inter (trPoint_injective O),
        Set.image_subset_image_iff (trPoint_injective O)] at hsub
    exact hsub
  · intro h i j hij
    have hi' : (i : Nat) < M.size := by rw [← trMesh_size O M]; exact i.isLt
    have hj' : (j : Nat) < M.size := by rw [← trMesh_size O M]; exact j.isLt
    have hij' : (⟨(i : Nat), hi'⟩ : Fin M.size) ≠ ⟨(j : Nat), hj'⟩ := by
      intro hc
      rw [Fin.mk.injEq] at hc
      exact hij (Fin.ext hc)
    have hsub := h ⟨(i : Nat), hi'⟩ ⟨(j : Nat), hj'⟩ hij'
    rw [trMesh_getElem O M i hi', trMesh_getElem O M j hj', triangleSet_trTri, triangleSet_trTri,
        edgeSet_trTri, ← Set.image_inter (trPoint_injective O),
        Set.image_subset_image_iff (trPoint_injective O)]
    exact hsub

name: isPlane_image
statement:
theorem isPlane_image (O : Point) {H : Set Point} (h : IsPlane H) :
    IsPlane (trPoint O '' H)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨n, c, hn, rfl⟩ := h
  refine ⟨n, c - ∑ i, n i * O i, hn, ?_⟩
  ext y
  simp only [Set.mem_image, Set.mem_setOf_eq]
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨x, hx, rfl⟩
    simp only [trPoint, Fin.sum_univ_three, mul_sub] at hx ⊢
    linarith
  · intro hy
    refine ⟨fun i => y i + O i, ?_, ?_⟩
    · simp only [Fin.sum_univ_three, mul_add] at hy ⊢
      linarith
    · funext i; simp only [trPoint]; ring

name: negligible_image
statement:
theorem negligible_image (O : Point) {N : Set Point} (h : Negligible N) :
    Negligible (trPoint O '' N)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨k, H, hH, hsub⟩ := h
  refine ⟨k, fun i => trPoint O '' H i, fun i => isPlane_image O (hH i), ?_⟩
  rw [← Set.image_iUnion]
  exact Set.image_subset _ hsub

name: eqOffPlanes_image
statement:
theorem eqOffPlanes_image (O : Point) {P R : Set Point} (h : EqOffPlanes P R) :
    EqOffPlanes (trPoint O '' P) (trPoint O '' R)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨N, hN, hsub⟩ := h
  refine ⟨trPoint O '' N, negligible_image O hN, ?_⟩
  rw [← Set.image_diff (trPoint_injective O), ← Set.image_diff (trPoint_injective O),
      ← Set.image_union]
  exact Set.image_subset _ hsub

name: trPoint_image_inter
statement:
theorem trPoint_image_inter (O : Point) (P R : Set Point) :
    trPoint O '' (P ∩ R) = trPoint O '' P ∩ trPoint O '' R
proof:
:=
  Set.image_inter (trPoint_injective O)

name: crossingCount_eq_rayCount
statement:
theorem crossingCount_eq_rayCount (M : Mesh) (Q d : Point) :
    crossingCount M Q d = Proof.MeshIntersectRayClassifyBridge.rayCount M Q d
proof:
:= by
  unfold crossingCount Proof.MeshIntersectRayClassifyBridge.rayCount
  refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun u _ => ?_)
  have hR : RayHits Q d M[u] ↔ Proof.MeshIntersectRayClassifyBridge.faceCrossed M Q d u := by
    unfold RayHits Proof.MeshIntersectRayClassifyBridge.faceCrossed
    constructor
    · rintro ⟨s, hs, hmem⟩; exact ⟨s, hs, by rw [← lineAt_eq]; exact hmem⟩
    · rintro ⟨s, hs, hmem⟩; exact ⟨s, hs, by rw [lineAt_eq]; exact hmem⟩
  by_cases h : RayHits Q d M[u]
  · rw [if_pos h, if_pos (hR.mp h), faceNormal_eq, dot_eq_dotQ]
    rfl
  · rw [if_neg h, if_neg (fun hc => h (hR.mpr hc))]

name: rayCount_eq_RayCount'
statement:
theorem rayCount_eq_RayCount' (M : Mesh) (Q d : Point)
    (hedge : ∀ (u : Fin M.size) (t : ℚ), 0 < t →
      Proof.WellFormedCheckNormal.lineAt Q d t ∉ edgeSet M[u]) :
    Proof.MeshIntersectRayClassifyBridge.rayCount M Q d
      = Proof.MeshIntersectRayClassify.RayCount M Q d
proof:
:= by
  unfold Proof.MeshIntersectRayClassifyBridge.rayCount Proof.MeshIntersectRayClassify.RayCount
  refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun u _ => ?_)
  have hiff : Proof.MeshIntersectRayClassifyBridge.faceCrossed M Q d u ↔
      Proof.MeshIntersectRayClassify.MeetsRelint M Q d u := by
    constructor
    · rintro ⟨t, ht, hmem⟩; exact ⟨t, ht, hmem, hedge u t ht⟩
    · rintro ⟨s, hs, hmem, _⟩; exact ⟨s, hs, hmem⟩
  by_cases h : Proof.MeshIntersectRayClassifyBridge.faceCrossed M Q d u
  · rw [if_pos h, if_pos (hiff.mp h)]
  · rw [if_neg h, if_neg (fun hc => h (hiff.mpr hc))]

name: span_pair_ne_top
statement: theorem span_pair_ne_top (x y : Point) : Submodule.span ℚ ({x, y} : Set Point) ≠ ⊤
proof:
:= by
  intro htop
  have hle : Module.finrank ℚ ↥(Submodule.span ℚ ({x, y} : Set Point)) ≤ 2 := by
    refine (finrank_span_le_card ({x, y} : Set Point)).trans ?_
    simp only [Set.toFinset_insert, Set.toFinset_singleton]
    exact (Finset.card_insert_le _ _).trans (by simp)
  rw [htop, finrank_top] at hle
  have h3 : Module.finrank ℚ Point = 3 := Module.finrank_fin_fun ℚ
  rw [h3] at hle
  omega

name: mem_span_of_segment
statement:
theorem mem_span_of_segment {a b Q d : Point} {s : ℚ} (hs : 0 < s)
    (hmem : Q + s • d ∈ segment ℚ a b) :
    d ∈ Submodule.span ℚ ({a - Q, b - a} : Set Point)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨u, v, _, _, huv, heq⟩ := hmem
  have hu1 : u = 1 - v := by linarith
  rw [hu1] at heq
  have hkey : s • d = (a - Q) + v • (b - a) := by
    funext k
    have hk := congrFun heq k
    simp only [Pi.add_apply, Pi.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul, Pi.sub_apply] at hk ⊢
    linear_combination -hk
  have hsne : s ≠ 0 := ne_of_gt hs
  rw [Submodule.mem_span_pair]
  refine ⟨s⁻¹, s⁻¹ * v, ?_⟩
  have hthis : s⁻¹ • (s • d) = s⁻¹ • ((a - Q) + v • (b - a)) := by rw [hkey]
  rw [smul_smul, inv_mul_cancel₀ hsne, one_smul] at hthis
  rw [hthis, smul_add, smul_smul]

name: exists_admissible
statement: theorem exists_admissible (M : Mesh) (Q : Point) : ∃ d, AdmissibleRay M Q d
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have hne : (⋃ o : Option (Fin M.size × Fin 3),
      ((o.elim ⊥ (fun ik => Submodule.span ℚ ({edgeTail M[ik.1] ik.2 - Q,
        edgeHead M[ik.1] ik.2 - edgeTail M[ik.1] ik.2} : Set Point)) : Submodule ℚ Point) :
        Set Point)) ≠ Set.univ := by
    intro huniv
    obtain ⟨o, ho⟩ := Subspace.exists_eq_top_of_iUnion_eq_univ huniv
    cases o with
    | none => exact bot_ne_top ho
    | some ik => exact span_pair_ne_top _ _ ho
  obtain ⟨d, hd⟩ := (Set.ne_univ_iff_exists_not_mem _).mp hne
  simp only [Set.mem_iUnion, not_exists] at hd
  refine ⟨d, ?_, fun i s hs hmem => ?_⟩
  · have h0 := hd none
    simp only [Option.elim, SetLike.mem_coe, Submodule.mem_bot] at h0
    exact h0
  · rw [edgeSet_eq_iUnion, Set.mem_iUnion] at hmem
    obtain ⟨k, hk⟩ := hmem
    exact hd (some (i, k)) (mem_span_of_segment hs hk)

name: comb_le
statement:
private theorem comb_le {lo p q a a' : ℚ} (ha : 0 ≤ a) (ha' : 0 ≤ a')
    (haa : a + a' = 1) (hp : lo ≤ p) (hq : lo ≤ q) : lo ≤ a * p + a' * q
proof:
:= by
  have h1 : a * lo ≤ a * p := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hp ha
  have h2 : a' * lo ≤ a' * q := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hq ha'
  have h3 : a * lo + a' * lo = lo := by rw [← add_mul, haa, one_mul]
  linarith

name: le_comb
statement:
private theorem le_comb {hi p q a a' : ℚ} (ha : 0 ≤ a) (ha' : 0 ≤ a')
    (haa : a + a' = 1) (hp : p ≤ hi) (hq : q ≤ hi) : a * p + a' * q ≤ hi
proof:
:= by
  have h1 : a * p ≤ a * hi := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hp ha
  have h2 : a' * q ≤ a' * hi := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hq ha'
  have h3 : a * hi + a' * hi = hi := by rw [← add_mul, haa, one_mul]
  linarith

name: inFBox_convex
statement: theorem inFBox_convex (b : Impl.BVH.Box) : Convex ℚ {x : Point | InFBox b x}
proof:
:= by
  rintro x hx y hy a a' ha ha' haa
  obtain ⟨⟨hx1, hx2⟩, ⟨hx3, hx4⟩, hx5, hx6⟩ := hx
  obtain ⟨⟨hy1, hy2⟩, ⟨hy3, hy4⟩, hy5, hy6⟩ := hy
  refine ⟨⟨?_, ?_⟩, ⟨?_, ?_⟩, ?_, ?_⟩ <;>
      simp only [Pi.add_apply, Pi.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul]
  · exact comb_le ha ha' haa hx1 hy1
  · exact le_comb ha ha' haa hx2 hy2
  · exact comb_le ha ha' haa hx3 hy3
  · exact le_comb ha ha' haa hx4 hy4
  · exact comb_le ha ha' haa hx5 hy5
  · exact le_comb ha ha' haa hx6 hy6

name: foldl_pminS_le
statement:
private theorem foldl_pminS_le {init : P3} :
    ∀ (l : List Vtx),
      ((l.foldl (fun a v => pminS a v.p) init).x ≤ init.x
        ∧ (l.foldl (fun a v => pminS a v.p) init).y ≤ init.y
        ∧ (l.foldl (fun a v => pminS a v.p) init).z ≤ init.z)
      ∧ ∀ v ∈ l, (l.foldl (fun a v => pminS a v.p) init).x ≤ v.p.x
          ∧ (l.foldl (fun a v => pminS a v.p) init).y ≤ v.p.y
          ∧ (l.foldl (fun a v => pminS a v.p) init).z ≤ v.p.z
proof:
:= by
  intro l
  induction l generalizing init with
  | nil => exact ⟨⟨le_rfl, le_rfl, le_rfl⟩, by simp⟩
  | cons w t ih =>
    simp only [List.foldl_cons]
    obtain ⟨⟨hx, hy, hz⟩, hmem⟩ := ih (init := pminS init w.p)
    have hwx : (pminS init w.p).x ≤ init.x := Proof.BVH.rmin_le_left _ _
    have hwy : (pminS init w.p).y ≤ init.y := Proof.BVH.rmin_le_left _ _
    have hwz : (pminS init w.p).z ≤ init.z := Proof.BVH.rmin_le_left _ _
    have hwx' : (pminS init w.p).x ≤ w.p.x := Proof.BVH.rmin_le_right _ _
    have hwy' : (pminS init w.p).y ≤ w.p.y := Proof.BVH.rmin_le_right _ _
    have hwz' : (pminS init w.p).z ≤ w.p.z := Proof.BVH.rmin_le_right _ _
    refine ⟨⟨hx.trans hwx, hy.trans hwy, hz.trans hwz⟩, ?_⟩
    intro v hv
    rcases List.mem_cons.mp hv with rfl | hvt
    · exact ⟨hx.trans hwx', hy.trans hwy', hz.trans hwz'⟩
    · exact hmem v hvt

name: le_foldl_pmaxS
statement:
private theorem le_foldl_pmaxS {init : P3} :
    ∀ (l : List Vtx),
      (init.x ≤ (l.foldl (fun a v => pmaxS a v.p) init).x
        ∧ init.y ≤ (l.foldl (fun a v => pmaxS a v.p) init).y
        ∧ init.z ≤ (l.foldl (fun a v => pmaxS a v.p) init).z)
      ∧ ∀ v ∈ l, v.p.x ≤ (l.foldl (fun a v => pmaxS a v.p) init).x
          ∧ v.p.y ≤ (l.foldl (fun a v => pmaxS a v.p) init).y
          ∧ v.p.z ≤ (l.foldl (fun a v => pmaxS a v.p) init).z
proof:
:= by
  intro l
  induction l generalizing init with
  | nil => exact ⟨⟨le_rfl, le_rfl, le_rfl⟩, by simp⟩
  | cons w t ih =>
    simp only [List.foldl_cons]
    obtain ⟨⟨hx, hy, hz⟩, hmem⟩ := ih (init := pmaxS init w.p)
    have hwx : init.x ≤ (pmaxS init w.p).x := Proof.BVH.le_rmax_left _ _
    have hwy : init.y ≤ (pmaxS init w.p).y := Proof.BVH.le_rmax_left _ _
    have hwz : init.z ≤ (pmaxS init w.p).z := Proof.BVH.le_rmax_left _ _
    have hwx' : w.p.x ≤ (pmaxS init w.p).x := Proof.BVH.le_rmax_right _ _
    have hwy' : w.p.y ≤ (pmaxS init w.p).y := Proof.BVH.le_rmax_right _ _
    have hwz' : w.p.z ≤ (pmaxS init w.p).z := Proof.BVH.le_rmax_right _ _
    refine ⟨⟨hwx.trans hx, hwy.trans hy, hwz.trans hz⟩, ?_⟩
    intro v hv
    rcases List.mem_cons.mp hv with rfl | hvt
    · exact ⟨hwx'.trans hx, hwy'.trans hy, hwz'.trans hz⟩
    · exact hmem v hvt

name: fragBox_lox
statement:
private theorem fragBox_lox (f : Frag) :
    (fragBox f).lox = (f.poly.foldl (fun a v => pminS a v.p) (f.poly.getD 0 default).p).x
proof: := rfl

name: fragBox_mem_vtx
statement:
theorem fragBox_mem_vtx (f : Frag) {v : Vtx} (hv : v ∈ f.poly) :
    InFBox (fragBox f) (P3.toPoint v.p)
proof:
:= by
  have hvl : v ∈ f.poly.toList := Array.mem_toList.mpr hv
  obtain ⟨_, hmin⟩ := foldl_pminS_le (init := (f.poly.getD 0 default).p) f.poly.toList
  obtain ⟨_, hmax⟩ := le_foldl_pmaxS (init := (f.poly.getD 0 default).p) f.poly.toList
  have hlo := hmin v hvl
  have hhi := hmax v hvl
  have hfl : f.poly.foldl (fun a v => pminS a v.p) (f.poly.getD 0 default).p
      = f.poly.toList.foldl (fun a v => pminS a v.p) (f.poly.getD 0 default).p :=
    Array.foldl_toList .. ▸ rfl
  have hfh : f.poly.foldl (fun a v => pmaxS a v.p) (f.poly.getD 0 default).p
      = f.poly.toList.foldl (fun a v => pmaxS a v.p) (f.poly.getD 0 default).p :=
    Array.foldl_toList .. ▸ rfl
  
  refine ⟨⟨?_, ?_⟩, ⟨?_, ?_⟩, ?_, ?_⟩
  · show (fragBox f).lox ≤ v.p.x; rw [fragBox_lox, hfl]; exact hlo.1
  · show v.p.x ≤ (fragBox f).hix; rw [fragBox_hix, hfh]; exact hhi.1
  · show (fragBox f).loy ≤ v.p.y; rw [fragBox_loy, hfl]; exact hlo.2.1
  · show v.p.y ≤ (fragBox f).hiy; rw [fragBox_hiy, hfh]; exact hhi.2.1
  · show (fragBox f).loz ≤ v.p.z; rw [fragBox_loz, hfl]; exact hlo.2.2
  · show v.p.z ≤ (fragBox f).hiz; rw [fragBox_hiz, hfh]; exact hhi.2.2

name: fragBox_bounds_vpoly
statement:
theorem fragBox_bounds_vpoly (f : Frag) {x : Point}
    (hx : x ∈ vpoly (fragCycle f)) : InFBox (fragBox f) x
proof:
:= by
  have hsub : vpoly (fragCycle f) ⊆ {y : Point | InFBox (fragBox f) y} := by
    rw [vpoly]
    refine convexHull_min ?_ (inFBox_convex _)
    rintro y ⟨i, rfl⟩
    exact fragBox_mem_vtx f (Array.getElem_mem i.isLt)
  exact hsub hx

name: overlap_of_common
statement:
theorem overlap_of_common {b b' : Impl.BVH.Box} {x : Point}
    (h : InFBox b x) (h' : InFBox b' x) : Impl.BVH.overlap b b' = true
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨⟨a1, a2⟩, ⟨a3, a4⟩, a5, a6⟩ := h
  obtain ⟨⟨c1, c2⟩, ⟨c3, c4⟩, c5, c6⟩ := h'
  simp only [Impl.BVH.overlap, Bool.and_eq_true, decide_eq_true_eq]
  refine ⟨⟨⟨⟨⟨?_, ?_⟩, ?_⟩, ?_⟩, ?_⟩, ?_⟩ <;> linarith

name: box_disjoint_vpoly_disjoint
proof:
:= by
  rw [Set.eq_empty_iff_forall_not_mem]
  rintro x ⟨hxg, hxg'⟩
  have hb := fragBox_bounds_vpoly g hxg
  have hb' := fragBox_bounds_vpoly g' hxg'
  rw [overlap_of_common hb hb'] at hov
  exact absurd hov (by simp)

name: foldl_sublist_noop
statement:
theorem foldl_sublist_noop {S : Type} (gi : S → Nat → S) (P : S → Prop)
    (hP : ∀ s a, P s → P (gi s a)) :
    ∀ {l' l : List Nat}, l'.Sublist l → l.Nodup →
      (∀ a ∈ l, a ∉ l' → ∀ s, P s → gi s a = s) →
      ∀ s, P s → l.foldl gi s = l'.foldl gi s
proof:
:= by
  intro l' l hsub
  induction hsub with
  | slnil => intro _ _ s _; rfl
  | @cons l₁ l₂ a hsub ih =>
    intro hnd hnoop s hs
    have hand : a ∉ l₂ := (List.nodup_cons.mp hnd).1
    have hndl₂ : l₂.Nodup := (List.nodup_cons.mp hnd).2
    have hal₁ : a ∉ l₁ := fun hmem => hand (hsub.subset hmem)
    have hnoopa : gi s a = s := hnoop a (List.mem_cons_self a l₂) hal₁ s hs
    simp only [List.foldl_cons, hnoopa]
    exact ih hndl₂ (fun b hb hbl₁ s' hs' => hnoop b (List.mem_cons_of_mem a hb) hbl₁ s' hs') s hs
  | @cons₂ l₁ l₂ a hsub ih =>
    intro hnd hnoop s hs
    have hndl₂ : l₂.Nodup := (List.nodup_cons.mp hnd).2
    have hand : a ∉ l₂ := (List.nodup_cons.mp hnd).1
    simp only [List.foldl_cons]
    apply ih hndl₂ ?_ (gi s a) (hP s a hs)
    intro b hb hbl₁
    apply hnoop b (List.mem_cons_of_mem a hb)
    intro hbmem
    rcases List.mem_cons.mp hbmem with h | h
    · exact hand (h ▸ hb)
    · exact hbl₁ h

name: list_foldl_eq_range
statement:
private theorem list_foldl_eq_range {α S : Type} (g : S → α → S) :
    ∀ (l : List α) (s : S),
      l.foldl g s = (List.range l.length).foldl
        (fun s i => if h : i < l.length then g s l[i] else s) s
proof:
:= by
  intro l
  induction l with
  | nil => intro s; rfl
  | cons a t ih =>
    intro s
    simp only [List.length_cons, List.range_succ_eq_map, List.foldl_cons, List.foldl_map]
    rw [show (if h : (0:Nat) < t.length + 1 then g s (a :: t)[0] else s) = g s a from by simp]
    rw [ih (g s a)]
    apply List.foldl_ext
    intro s' i hi
    simp only [List.mem_range] at hi
    rw [dif_pos (by omega : i < t.length),
        dif_pos (show Nat.succ i < t.length + 1 by omega)]
    congr 1

name: array_foldl_eq_range
statement:
theorem array_foldl_eq_range {α S : Type} (g : S → α → S) (arr : Array α) (s : S) :
    arr.foldl g s = (List.range arr.size).foldl
      (fun s i => if h : i < arr.size then g s arr[i] else s) s
proof:
:= by
  rw [← Array.foldl_toList, list_foldl_eq_range g arr.toList s]
  simp only [Array.length_toList, Array.getElem_toList]

name: filterMap_foldl_eq
statement:
theorem filterMap_foldl_eq {α S : Type} (g : S → α → S) (arr : Array α) (near : List Nat)
    (hrange : ∀ i ∈ near, i < arr.size) (s : S) :
    (near.filterMap (fun i => if h : i < arr.size then some arr[i] else none)).foldl g s
      = near.foldl (fun s i => if h : i < arr.size then g s arr[i] else s) s
proof:
:= by
  induction near generalizing s with
  | nil => rfl
  | cons a t ih =>
    have ha : a < arr.size := hrange a (List.mem_cons_self a t)
    simp only [List.filterMap_cons, dif_pos ha, List.foldl_cons, dif_pos ha]
    exact ih (fun i hi => hrange i (List.mem_cons_of_mem a hi)) (g s arr[a])

name: mergeSort_sorted_le
statement: theorem mergeSort_sorted_le (l : List Nat) : List.Sorted (· ≤ ·) (l.mergeSort (· ≤ ·))
proof:
:= by
  have h := List.sorted_mergeSort (le := fun x y => decide (x ≤ y))
    (by intro a b c hab hbc; simp only [decide_eq_true_eq] at *; omega)
    (by intro a b; simp only [Bool.or_eq_true, decide_eq_true_eq]; omega) l
  exact h.imp (by intro a b hab; simpa using hab)

name: sorted_nodup_sublist_range
proof:
:= by
  have hsubperm : idxs.Subperm (List.range n) :=
    hnd.subperm (fun i hi => List.mem_range.mpr (hsub i hi))
  have := List.sublist_insertionSort' hs hsubperm
  rwa [List.Sorted.insertionSort_eq (List.pairwise_le_range n)] at this

name: near_sublist_and_noop
statement:
theorem near_sublist_and_noop (opp : Array Frag) (q : Impl.BVH.Box) :
    let near
proof:
:= sortAscN (Impl.BVH.boxQuery (copBVH opp) q)
    near.toList.Sublist (List.range opp.size)
      ∧ (∀ i (hi : i < opp.size), i ∉ near.toList →
          Impl.BVH.overlap q (fragBox opp[i]) = false) := by
  intro near
  
  have hnear : near.toList = (Impl.BVH.boxQuery (copBVH opp) q).toList.mergeSort (· ≤ ·) := by
    simp only [near, sortAscN, Array.toList_toArray]
  
  have hmemlt : ∀ i ∈ near.toList, i < opp.size := by
    intro i hi
    rw [hnear, List.mem_mergeSort, Array.mem_toList] at hi
    have := Proof.BVH.boxQueryM_mem_lt (opp.map fragBox) q i (by rw [copBVH] at hi; exact hi)
    rwa [Array.size_map] at this
  
  have hsublist : near.toList.Sublist (List.range opp.size) := by
    refine sorted_nodup_sublist_range ?_ ?_ hmemlt
    · rw [hnear]; exact mergeSort_sorted_le _
    · rw [hnear]
      exact (List.mergeSort_perm _ _).nodup_iff.mpr (by rw [copBVH]; exact Proof.BVH.boxQueryM_nodup _ _)
  refine ⟨hsublist, ?_⟩
  
  intro i hi hinear
  have hnotmem : i ∉ Impl.BVH.boxQuery (copBVH opp) q := by
    intro hmem
    exact hinear (by rw [hnear, List.mem_mergeSort, Array.mem_toList]; exact hmem)
  by_contra hov
  rw [Bool.not_eq_false] at hov
  
  apply hnotmem
  rw [copBVH]
  refine Proof.BVH.boxQueryM_sound (opp.map fragBox) q i (by rw [Array.size_map]; exact hi) ?_
  have hi' : i < (opp.map fragBox).size := by rw [Array.size_map]; exact hi
  rw [Array.getD, dif_pos hi', Array.get_eq_getElem, Array.getElem_map]
  exact hov

name: near_foldl_eq
statement:
theorem near_foldl_eq {S : Type} (outerStep : S → Frag → S) (P : S → Prop)
    (hP : ∀ s fb, P s → P (outerStep s fb))
    (opp : Array Frag) (q : Impl.BVH.Box)
    (hnoop : ∀ i, (hi : i < opp.size) →
      Impl.BVH.overlap q (fragBox opp[i]) = false → ∀ s, P s → outerStep s opp[i] = s)
    (init : S) (hinit : P init) :
    ((sortAscN (Impl.BVH.boxQuery (copBVH opp) q)).filterMap
        (fun i => if h : i < opp.size then some opp[i] else none)).foldl outerStep init
      = opp.foldl outerStep init
proof:
:= by
  set near := sortAscN (Impl.BVH.boxQuery (copBVH opp) q) with hnearDef
  obtain ⟨hsub, hcov⟩ := near_sublist_and_noop opp q
  
  set gi : S → Nat → S := fun s i => if h : i < opp.size then outerStep s opp[i] else s with hgi
  have hPgi : ∀ s i, P s → P (gi s i) := by
    intro s i hs; rw [hgi]; dsimp only
    split
    · exact hP _ _ hs
    · exact hs
  
  rw [← Array.foldl_toList outerStep init (near.filterMap _), Array.toList_filterMap]
  rw [filterMap_foldl_eq outerStep opp near.toList (fun i hi =>
        List.mem_range.mp (hsub.subset hi)) init]
  rw [array_foldl_eq_range outerStep opp init]
  
  symm
  refine foldl_sublist_noop gi P hPgi hsub (List.nodup_range _) ?_ init hinit
  intro a ha hanear s hs
  rw [List.mem_range] at ha
  rw [hgi]; dsimp only; rw [dif_pos ha]
  exact hnoop a ha (hcov a ha hanear) s hs

name: foldl_push_toArray
statement:
theorem foldl_push_toArray {α : Type} (l : List α) (acc : Array α) :
    l.foldl (fun a x => a.push x) acc = acc ++ l.toArray
proof:
:= by
  induction l generalizing acc with
  | nil => simp
  | cons x xs ih =>
    simp only [List.foldl_cons, ih]
    rw [show (x :: xs).toArray = #[x] ++ xs.toArray from by simp]
    rw [show acc.push x = acc ++ #[x] from by simp [Array.push_eq_append_singleton]]
    rw [Array.append_assoc]

name: array_foldl_congr_mem
statement:
theorem array_foldl_congr_mem {α S : Type} (f g : S → α → S) (arr : Array α) (s : S)
    (H : ∀ s a, a ∈ arr → f s a = g s a) : arr.foldl f s = arr.foldl g s
proof:
:= by
  rw [← Array.foldl_toList, ← Array.foldl_toList]
  have : ∀ (l : List α), (∀ s a, a ∈ l → f s a = g s a) → ∀ s, l.foldl f s = l.foldl g s := by
    intro l
    induction l with
    | nil => intro _ s; rfl
    | cons x xs ih =>
      intro Hl s
      simp only [List.foldl_cons]
      rw [Hl s x (List.mem_cons_self x xs)]
      exact ih (fun s' a ha => Hl s' a (List.mem_cons_of_mem x ha)) (g s x)
  exact this arr.toList (fun s a ha => H s a (Array.mem_toList.mp ha)) s

name: array_flatMap_congr_mem
statement:
theorem array_flatMap_congr_mem {α β : Type} (arr : Array α) (f g : α → Array β)
    (H : ∀ a ∈ arr, f a = g a) : arr.flatMap f = arr.flatMap g
proof:
:= by
  apply Array.ext'
  rw [Proof.MeshIntersectClipBridge.toList_flatMap_arr,
    Proof.MeshIntersectClipBridge.toList_flatMap_arr]
  refine List.flatMap_congr ?_
  intro a ha
  rw [H a (Array.mem_toList.mp ha)]

name: push_rebuild
statement:
theorem push_rebuild {α : Type} (pending kept : Array α) :
    pending.foldl (fun (st : Array α × Array α) piece => (st.1, st.2.push piece)) (kept, #[])
      = (kept, pending)
proof:
:= by
  rw [← Array.foldl_toList]
  suffices h : ∀ (acc : Array α) (l : List α),
      l.foldl (fun (st : Array α × Array α) piece => (st.1, st.2.push piece)) (kept, acc)
        = (kept, l.foldl (fun a x => a.push x) acc) by
    rw [h #[] pending.toList]
    have : pending.toList.foldl (fun a x => a.push x) #[] = pending := by
      rw [foldl_push_toArray]; simp
    rw [this]
  intro acc l
  induction l generalizing acc with
  | nil => rfl
  | cons x xs ih => simp only [List.foldl_cons]; rw [ih]

name: realOv_empty_of_box_disjoint
statement:
theorem realOv_empty_of_box_disjoint {nt : Point} {ctv : ℚ} {n' : Point} {c' : ℚ}
    {fa fb piece : Frag}
    (hbox : Impl.BVH.overlap (fragBox fa) (fragBox fb) = false)
    (hpiece : FragInv nt ctv piece)
    (hpsub : vpoly (fragCycle piece) ⊆ vpoly (fragCycle fa))
    (hfbInv : FragInv n' c' fb)
    (hplPiece : Proof.MeshIntersectClip.OnPlane n' c' (fragCycle piece)) :
    (Array.filter (fun p => decide (p.poly.size ≥ 3)) (coplanarClip piece fb).1).isEmpty = true
proof:
:= by
  have hdisj : vpoly (fragCycle fa) ∩ vpoly (fragCycle fb) = ∅ :=
    box_disjoint_vpoly_disjoint hbox
  
  have hno : ∀ q ∈ (coplanarClip piece fb).1, ¬ (decide (q.poly.size ≥ 3) = true) := by
    intro q hq hq3
    rw [decide_eq_true_eq] at hq3
    haveI : NeZero q.poly.size := ⟨by omega⟩
    
    have hbary : (∑ j, (q.poly.size : ℚ)⁻¹ • fragCycle q j) ∈ vrelint (fragCycle q) :=
      barycenter_mem_vrelint hq3 (fragCycle q)
    have hbvp : (∑ j, (q.poly.size : ℚ)⁻¹ • fragCycle q j) ∈ vpoly (fragCycle q) :=
      vrelint_subset_vpoly _ hbary
    
    have hqfa : vpoly (fragCycle q) ⊆ vpoly (fragCycle fa) :=
      (coplanarClip_inside_vpoly_subset_fa hpiece hq).trans hpsub
    have hqfb : vpoly (fragCycle q) ⊆ vpoly (fragCycle fb) :=
      coplanarClip_inside_vpoly_subset_fb_free hpiece hfbInv hplPiece hq
    rw [Set.eq_empty_iff_forall_not_mem] at hdisj
    exact hdisj _ ⟨hqfa hbvp, hqfb hbvp⟩
  
  have hnil : (Array.filter (fun p => decide (p.poly.size ≥ 3)) (coplanarClip piece fb).1).toList = [] := by
    rw [Array.toList_filter, List.filter_eq_nil_iff]
    intro p hp
    exact hno p (Array.mem_toList.mp hp)
  show ((Array.filter (fun p => decide (p.poly.size ≥ 3)) (coplanarClip piece fb).1).size == 0) = true
  rw [beq_iff_eq, ← Array.length_toList, hnil, List.length_nil]

name: resolveFrag_foldl_eq
statement:
private theorem resolveFrag_foldl_eq (bvhW : Impl.BVH.BVH) (fa : Frag) (X : Array Frag)
    (wOpp : Array PFace) :
    resolveFrag bvhW fa X wOpp =
      (X.foldl (outerStepA fa) (#[], #[fa])).1
        ++ (X.foldl (outerStepA fa) (#[], #[fa])).2.filter (fun p => keepFallback bvhW wOpp p)
proof:
:= by
  rfl

name: resolveFragB_foldl_eq
statement:
private theorem resolveFragB_foldl_eq (bvhW : Impl.BVH.BVH) (fb : Frag) (X : Array Frag)
    (wOpp : Array PFace) :
    resolveCoplanar.resolveFragB bvhW fb X wOpp =
      (X.foldl (outerStepB fb) (#[], #[fb])).1
        ++ (X.foldl (outerStepB fb) (#[], #[fb])).2.filter (fun p => keepFallback bvhW wOpp p)
proof:
:= by
  rfl

name: stP_outerStepA
proof:
:= by
  rw [outerStepA]
  by_cases hcop : (!(coplanarPlane fa.plane fb.plane)) = true
  · rw [if_pos hcop]; exact hst
  · rw [if_neg hcop]
    obtain ⟨hst1, hst2⟩ := hst
    refine Array.foldl_induction
      (motive := fun _ (s : Array Frag × Array Frag) => StP nt ct fa s)
      (init := (st.1, #[]))
      ⟨hst1, fun f' hf' => absurd hf' (Array.not_mem_empty f')⟩ ?_
    intro j s ihs
    obtain ⟨hs1, hs2⟩ := ihs
    obtain ⟨hpieceInv, hpieceSub⟩ := hst2 _ (Array.getElem_mem j.isLt)
    have hstep := Proof.MeshIntersectResolve.resolveStep_vpoly_subset fa fb st.2[j]
      (sameOrient fa.plane fb.plane) hpieceInv hpieceSub
      (fun f' hf' => (hs1 f' hf').2) (fun f' hf' => (hs2 f' hf').2)
    have hstepInv := Proof.MeshIntersectNpo.resolveStep_fragInv
      (nt := nt) (ct := ct) fb st.2[j]
      (sameOrient fa.plane fb.plane) hpieceInv
      (fun f' hf' => (hs1 f' hf').1) (fun f' hf' => (hs2 f' hf').1)
    exact ⟨fun f' hf' => ⟨hstepInv.1 _ hf', hstep.1 _ hf'⟩,
      fun f' hf' => ⟨hstepInv.2 _ hf', hstep.2 _ hf'⟩⟩

name: stP_outerStepB
proof:
:= by
  rw [outerStepB]
  by_cases hcop : (!(coplanarPlane fb.plane fa.plane)) = true
  · rw [if_pos hcop]; exact hst
  · rw [if_neg hcop]
    obtain ⟨hst1, hst2⟩ := hst
    refine Array.foldl_induction
      (motive := fun _ (s : Array Frag × Array Frag) => StP nt ct fb s)
      (init := (st.1, #[]))
      ⟨hst1, fun f' hf' => absurd hf' (Array.not_mem_empty f')⟩ ?_
    intro j s ihs
    obtain ⟨hs1, hs2⟩ := ihs
    obtain ⟨hpieceInv, hpieceSub⟩ := hst2 _ (Array.getElem_mem j.isLt)
    have hstep := Proof.MeshIntersectResolve.resolveStepB_vpoly_subset fa st.2[j]
      hpieceInv hpieceSub (fun f' hf' => (hs2 f' hf').2)
    have hstepInv := Proof.MeshIntersectNpo.resolveStepB_fragInv
      (nt := nt) (ct := ct) fa st.2[j] hpieceInv
      (fun f' hf' => (hs1 f' hf').1) (fun f' hf' => (hs2 f' hf').1)
    
    refine ⟨fun f' hf' => ?_, fun f' hf' => ⟨hstepInv.2 _ hf', hstep _ hf'⟩⟩
    have hmem1 : f' ∈ s.1 := by
      by_cases hre : (Array.filter (fun p => decide (p.poly.size ≥ 3))
          (coplanarClip st.2[j] fa).1).isEmpty = true
      · simpa only [hre, if_true] using hf'
      · simpa only [hre, Bool.false_eq_true, if_false] using hf'
    exact hs1 _ hmem1

name: outerStepA_noop
statement:
private theorem outerStepA_noop {nt : Point} {ct : ℚ} {fa : Frag} {opp : Array Frag}
    (hopp : OppCarrier nt ct fa.plane opp) {fb : Frag} (hfbMem : fb ∈ opp)
    (hbox : Impl.BVH.overlap (fragBox fa) (fragBox fb) = false)
    (st : Array Frag × Array Frag) (hst : StP nt ct fa st) :
    outerStepA fa st fb = st
proof:
:= by
  rw [outerStepA]
  by_cases hcop : (!(coplanarPlane fa.plane fb.plane)) = true
  · rw [if_pos hcop]
  · rw [if_neg hcop]
    have hcopT : coplanarPlane fa.plane fb.plane = true := by simpa using hcop
    obtain ⟨hst1, hst2⟩ := hst
    obtain ⟨n', c', hfbInv, hfbProp⟩ := hopp fb hfbMem
    obtain ⟨ρ, hρ, hn', hc'⟩ := hfbProp hcopT
    rw [array_foldl_congr_mem _
        (fun (s : Array Frag × Array Frag) piece => (s.1, s.2.push piece)) st.2 (st.1, #[]) ?_]
    · exact push_rebuild st.2 st.1
    · intro s piece hmem
      obtain ⟨hpInv, hpSub⟩ := hst2 piece hmem
      have hplPiece : Proof.MeshIntersectClip.OnPlane n' c' (fragCycle piece) := by
        rw [hn', hc']; exact onPlane_smul hpInv.onPlane
      have hre : (Array.filter (fun p => decide (p.poly.size ≥ 3))
          (coplanarClip piece fb).1).isEmpty = true :=
        realOv_empty_of_box_disjoint hbox hpInv hpSub hfbInv hplPiece
      simp only [hre, if_true]

name: outerStepB_noop
statement:
private theorem outerStepB_noop {nt : Point} {ct : ℚ} {fb : Frag} {opp : Array Frag}
    (hopp : OppCarrier nt ct fb.plane opp) {fa : Frag} (hfaMem : fa ∈ opp)
    (hbox : Impl.BVH.overlap (fragBox fb) (fragBox fa) = false)
    (st : Array Frag × Array Frag) (hst : StP nt ct fb st) :
    outerStepB fb st fa = st
proof:
:= by
  rw [outerStepB]
  by_cases hcop : (!(coplanarPlane fb.plane fa.plane)) = true
  · rw [if_pos hcop]
  · rw [if_neg hcop]
    have hcopT : coplanarPlane fb.plane fa.plane = true := by simpa using hcop
    obtain ⟨hst1, hst2⟩ := hst
    obtain ⟨n', c', hfaInv, hfaProp⟩ := hopp fa hfaMem
    obtain ⟨ρ, hρ, hn', hc'⟩ := hfaProp hcopT
    rw [array_foldl_congr_mem _
        (fun (s : Array Frag × Array Frag) piece => (s.1, s.2.push piece)) st.2 (st.1, #[]) ?_]
    · exact push_rebuild st.2 st.1
    · intro s piece hmem
      obtain ⟨hpInv, hpSub⟩ := hst2 piece hmem
      have hplPiece : Proof.MeshIntersectClip.OnPlane n' c' (fragCycle piece) := by
        rw [hn', hc']; exact onPlane_smul hpInv.onPlane
      have hre : (Array.filter (fun p => decide (p.poly.size ≥ 3))
          (coplanarClip piece fa).1).isEmpty = true :=
        realOv_empty_of_box_disjoint hbox hpInv hpSub hfaInv hplPiece
      simp only [hre, if_true]

name: resolveFragNear_eq
statement:
theorem resolveFragNear_eq (bvhW : Impl.BVH.BVH) (opp : Array Frag) (fa : Frag)
    (wOpp : Array PFace) {nt : Point} {ct : ℚ} (hfa : FragInv nt ct fa)
    (hopp : OppCarrier nt ct fa.plane opp) :
    resolveFragNear (copBVH opp) bvhW opp fa wOpp = resolveFrag bvhW fa opp wOpp
proof:
:= by
  rw [resolveFragNear, resolveFrag_foldl_eq, resolveFrag_foldl_eq]
  rw [near_foldl_eq (outerStepA fa) (StP nt ct fa)
    (fun st fb hst => stP_outerStepA hfa st fb hst) opp (fragBox fa)
    (fun i hi hbox st hst => outerStepA_noop hopp (Array.getElem_mem hi) hbox st hst)
    (#[], #[fa])
    ⟨fun f' hf' => absurd hf' (Array.not_mem_empty f'), by
      intro f' hf'; simp only [Array.mem_singleton] at hf'; subst hf'; exact ⟨hfa, le_refl _⟩⟩]

name: resolveFragBNear_eq
statement:
theorem resolveFragBNear_eq (bvhW : Impl.BVH.BVH) (opp : Array Frag) (fb : Frag)
    (wOpp : Array PFace) {nt : Point} {ct : ℚ} (hfb : FragInv nt ct fb)
    (hopp : OppCarrier nt ct fb.plane opp) :
    resolveCoplanar.resolveFragBNear (copBVH opp) bvhW opp fb wOpp
      = resolveCoplanar.resolveFragB bvhW fb opp wOpp
proof:
:= by
  rw [resolveCoplanar.resolveFragBNear, resolveFragB_foldl_eq, resolveFragB_foldl_eq]
  rw [near_foldl_eq (outerStepB fb) (StP nt ct fb)
    (fun st fa hst => stP_outerStepB hfb st fa hst) opp (fragBox fb)
    (fun i hi hbox st hst => outerStepB_noop hopp (Array.getElem_mem hi) hbox st hst)
    (#[], #[fb])
    ⟨fun f' hf' => absurd hf' (Array.not_mem_empty f'), by
      intro f' hf'; simp only [Array.mem_singleton] at hf'; subst hf'; exact ⟨hfb, le_refl _⟩⟩]

name: resolveCoplanar_eq_full
statement:
theorem resolveCoplanar_eq_full (bvhWB bvhWA : Impl.BVH.BVH) (copA copB : Array Frag)
    (wB wA : Array PFace)
    (hcopA : ∀ fa ∈ copA, ∃ (nt : Point) (ct : ℚ), FragInv nt ct fa ∧ OppCarrier nt ct fa.plane copB)
    (hcopB : ∀ fb ∈ copB, ∃ (nt : Point) (ct : ℚ), FragInv nt ct fb ∧ OppCarrier nt ct fb.plane copA) :
    resolveCoplanar bvhWB bvhWA copA copB wB wA
      = copA.flatMap (fun fa => resolveFrag bvhWB fa copB wB)
        ++ copB.flatMap (fun fb => resolveCoplanar.resolveFragB bvhWA fb copA wA)
proof:
:= by
  conv_lhs => unfold resolveCoplanar
  refine congrArg₂ (· ++ ·) ?_ ?_
  · refine array_flatMap_congr_mem copA _ _ (fun fa hfa => ?_)
    obtain ⟨nt, ct, hInv, hcar⟩ := hcopA fa hfa
    exact resolveFragNear_eq _ _ _ _ hInv hcar
  · refine array_flatMap_congr_mem copB _ _ (fun fb hfb => ?_)
    obtain ⟨nt, ct, hInv, hcar⟩ := hcopB fb hfb
    exact resolveFragBNear_eq _ _ _ _ hInv hcar

name: setPlane_poly

name: excl_hsigma_gen
statement:
theorem excl_hsigma_gen {M₁ M₂ : Mesh}
    (h₁ : NoPlaneThroughOrigin M₁) (h₂ : NoPlaneThroughOrigin M₂)
    (_meshId : Nat) (hi : i < MA.size)
    (hdetA : detOrigin (MA[i]'hi) ≠ 0) :
    Excludes (fun Q => dotQ (carrierNormal (MA[i]'hi)) Q ≠ 0 →
      ∀ f ∈ clipFaceScoped
          (fragOfFace ((materialize MA).getD i default))
          (planesForScoped ((materialize MA).getD i default).plane (materialize MB)
            ((candP MA MB).getD i #[])),
        ∀ k : Fin (atomizeFrag (vsGen M₁ M₂) f).poly.size,
          areaForm (carrierNormal (MA[i]'hi))
            (fanApex (fragCycle (atomizeFrag (vsGen M₁ M₂) f)))
            (fragCycle (atomizeFrag (vsGen M₁ M₂) f) k)
            ((detOrigin (MA[i]'hi)
              / dotQ (carrierNormal (MA[i]'hi)) Q) • Q) ≠ 0)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  set t := MA[i]'hi
  have hnt : carrierNormal t ≠ 0 := carrierNormal_ne_zero hdetA
  have hiA : i < (materialize MA).size := by simpa [materialize] using hi
  have hgetD : (materialize MA).getD i default = faceSOf t := by
    rw [arr_getD _ _ _ hiA, materialize_getElem MA i hi]
  have hinv₀ : FragInv (carrierNormal t) (detOrigin t)
      (fragOfFace ((materialize MA).getD i default)) := by
    rw [hgetD]
    exact fragInv_base hdetA
  obtain ⟨hvs, hnd⟩ := vsGen_facts h₁ h₂
  have hper : ∀ f ∈ clipFaceScoped
      (fragOfFace ((materialize MA).getD i default))
      (planesForScoped ((materialize MA).getD i default).plane (materialize MB)
        ((candP MA MB).getD i #[])),
      Excludes (fun Q => dotQ (carrierNormal t) Q ≠ 0 →
        ∀ k : Fin (atomizeFrag (vsGen M₁ M₂) f).poly.size,
          areaForm (carrierNormal t)
            (fanApex (fragCycle (atomizeFrag (vsGen M₁ M₂) f)))
            (fragCycle (atomizeFrag (vsGen M₁ M₂) f) k)
            ((detOrigin t / dotQ (carrierNormal t) Q) • Q) ≠ 0) := by
    intro f hf
    have hinvf := fragInv_clipFaceScoped hinv₀ _ hf
    haveI := hinvf.neZero
    obtain ⟨hm, hshape⟩ := atomize_refShape hinvf (vsGen M₁ M₂) hvs hnd
    haveI : NeZero (atomizeFrag (vsGen M₁ M₂) f).poly.size := ⟨by omega⟩
    have hupl : OnPlane (carrierNormal t) (detOrigin t)
        (fragCycle (atomizeFrag (vsGen M₁ M₂) f)) :=
      hshape.toRefShape.onPlane hinvf.onPlane
    have hk : ∀ k : Fin (atomizeFrag (vsGen M₁ M₂) f).poly.size,
        Excludes (fun Q => dotQ (carrierNormal t) Q ≠ 0 →
          areaForm (carrierNormal t)
            (fanApex (fragCycle (atomizeFrag (vsGen M₁ M₂) f)))
            (fragCycle (atomizeFrag (vsGen M₁ M₂) f) k)
            ((detOrigin t / dotQ (carrierNormal t) Q) • Q) ≠ 0) := by
      intro k
      exact pull_area hnt hdetA (fanApex_onPlane hupl) (hupl k)
        (hshape.toRefShape.apex_ne hinvf.size3 hm hinvf.onPlane
          hinvf.strictConv k)
    exact (Excludes.forall_fintype hk).mono
      (fun Q hQ hntQ k => hQ k hntQ)
  exact (Excludes.forall_mem_array hper).mono
    (fun Q hQ hntQ f hfm => hQ f hfm hntQ)

name: tie_cert_tr
statement:
theorem tie_cert_tr {tA u : Triangle} (hdetA : detOrigin tA ≠ 0)
    (hdetU : detOrigin u ≠ 0)
    (hcop : coplanarPlane (faceSOf u).plane (faceSOf tA).plane = false) :
    detOrigin tA • carrierNormal u - detOrigin u • carrierNormal tA ≠ 0
proof:
:=
  tie_of_transverse (t := u) (u := tA) hdetU hdetA
    (not_ratPropCarrier_of_coplanarPlane_false hcop)

name: excl_hav_tr
statement:
theorem excl_hav_tr (_meshId : Nat) (hi : i < MA.size)
    (hdetA : detOrigin (MA[i]'hi) ≠ 0)
    (hnpoB : NoPlaneThroughOrigin MB)
    (htr : ∀ j : Fin MB.size,
      coplanarPlane (faceSOf MB[j]).plane (faceSOf (MA[i]'hi)).plane = false) :
    Excludes (fun Q => dotQ (carrierNormal (MA[i]'hi)) Q ≠ 0 →
      AvoidsLines (carrierNormal (MA[i]'hi)) (detOrigin (MA[i]'hi))
        (fragCycle (fragOfFace ((materialize MA).getD i default)))
        ((planesForScoped ((materialize MA).getD i default).plane (materialize MB)
          ((candP MA MB).getD i #[])).toList.map
            (fun t => t.1))
        ((detOrigin (MA[i]'hi) / dotQ (carrierNormal (MA[i]'hi)) Q) • Q))
proof:
:= by
  classical
  set t := MA[i]'hi
  set nt := carrierNormal t
  set ct := detOrigin t
  have hnt : nt ≠ 0 := carrierNormal_ne_zero hdetA
  have hiA : i < (materialize MA).size := by simpa [materialize] using hi
  have hgetD : (materialize MA).getD i default = faceSOf t := by
    rw [arr_getD _ _ _ hiA, materialize_getElem MA i hi]
  have hinv₀ : FragInv nt ct
      (fragOfFace ((materialize MA).getD i default)) := by
    rw [hgetD]
    exact fragInv_base hdetA
  haveI := hinv₀.neZero
  
  have hb : Excludes (fun Q => dotQ nt Q ≠ 0 →
      ∀ k : Fin (fragOfFace 
          ((materialize MA).getD i default)).poly.size,
        eta nt (fragCycle (fragOfFace 
          ((materialize MA).getD i default))) k
          ((ct / dotQ nt Q) • Q) ≠ 0) := by
    have h := Excludes.forall_fintype
      (F := fun (k : Fin (fragOfFace 
          ((materialize MA).getD i default)).poly.size) Q =>
        dotQ nt Q ≠ 0 →
        areaForm nt
          (fragCycle (fragOfFace 
            ((materialize MA).getD i default)) k)
          (fragCycle (fragOfFace 
            ((materialize MA).getD i default)) (k + 1))
          ((ct / dotQ nt Q) • Q) ≠ 0)
      (fun k => pull_area hnt hdetA (hinv₀.onPlane k) (hinv₀.onPlane (k + 1))
        (Proof.MeshIntersectClip.consec_ne hinv₀.size3 hinv₀.strictConv k))
    exact h.mono (fun Q hQ hntQ k => hQ k hntQ)
  
  have hc : Excludes (fun Q => dotQ nt Q ≠ 0 →
      ∀ pg ∈ ((planesForScoped ((materialize MA).getD i default).plane (materialize MB)
          ((candP MA MB).getD i #[])).toList.map
            (fun t => t.1)),
        ce (iplaneN pg) (iplaneD pg) ((ct / dotQ nt Q) • Q) ≠ 0) := by
    have hper : ∀ pg ∈ ((planesForScoped ((materialize MA).getD i default).plane (materialize MB)
        ((candP MA MB).getD i #[])).toList.map
          (fun t => t.1)),
        Excludes (fun Q => dotQ nt Q ≠ 0 →
          ce (iplaneN pg) (iplaneD pg) ((ct / dotQ nt Q) • Q) ≠ 0) := by
      intro pg hpg
      rw [List.mem_map] at hpg
      obtain ⟨s, hs, rfl⟩ := hpg
      obtain ⟨j, hjmem, box, rfl⟩ :=
        mem_planesForScoped_inv (Array.mem_def.mpr hs)
      have hjB : j < MB.size := by
        have := Proof.MeshIntersectPrep.mem_candP_lt hjmem
        simpa [materialize] using this
      have hgetDj : (materialize MB).getD j default = faceSOf (MB[j]'hjB) := by
        rw [arr_getD _ _ _ (by simpa [materialize] using hjB),
          materialize_getElem MB j hjB]
      rw [hgetDj]
      obtain ⟨m, hm, hce⟩ := ce_iplane_of_mul (isMulOf_faceSOf_plane (MB[j]'hjB))
      have hdetB : detOrigin (MB[j]'hjB) ≠ 0 := hnpoB ⟨j, hjB⟩
      have hcert : ct • carrierNormal (MB[j]'hjB)
          - detOrigin (MB[j]'hjB) • nt ≠ 0 :=
        tie_cert_tr hdetA hdetB (htr ⟨j, hjB⟩)
      refine (pull_aff hcert).mono ?_
      intro Q h hntQ hzero
      apply h hntQ
      rw [hce] at hzero
      have hzero' : ce (carrierNormal (MB[j]'hjB)) (detOrigin (MB[j]'hjB))
          ((ct / dotQ nt Q) • Q) = 0 :=
        (mul_eq_zero.mp hzero).resolve_left (ne_of_gt hm)
      rw [ce] at hzero'
      linarith
    exact (Excludes.forall_mem_list hper).mono
      (fun Q hQ hntQ pg hpg => hQ pg hpg hntQ)
  refine (hb.and hc).mono ?_
  intro Q ⟨h2, h3⟩ hntQ
  exact ⟨hit_on_carrier hntQ, h2 hntQ, h3 hntQ⟩

name: excl_E1_slot_tr
statement:
theorem excl_E1_slot_tr {tA u : Triangle} (hdetA : detOrigin tA ≠ 0)
    (hdetU : detOrigin u ≠ 0)
    (hcop : coplanarPlane (faceSOf u).plane (faceSOf tA).plane = false) (k : Fin 4) :
    Excludes (fun Q => dotQ (carrierNormal tA) Q ≠ 0 →
      (slot u k).eval ((detOrigin tA / dotQ (carrierNormal tA) Q) • Q) ≠ 0)
proof:
:= by
  set nt := carrierNormal tA
  set ct := detOrigin tA
  have hcert : ct • (slot u k).n - (slot u k).c • nt ≠ 0 := by
    by_cases hk : (k : ℕ) < 3
    · rw [slot_c_lateral u k hk]
      exact cert_lat hdetA (slot_n_lateral_ne hdetU k hk)
    · have hk3 : k = 3 := by
        apply Fin.ext; omega
      subst hk3
      
      have hN : crossQ (psub u.v₁ u.v₀) (psub u.v₂ u.v₀) = carrierNormal u := by
        rw [Proof.SimImplCover.psub_eq_sub, Proof.SimImplCover.psub_eq_sub]; rfl
      have hc0 : dotQ (carrierNormal u) u.v₀ = detOrigin u := dotQ_carrierNormal_v₀ u
      have htie : ct • carrierNormal u - detOrigin u • nt ≠ 0 :=
        tie_cert_tr hdetA hdetU hcop
      have hps : psub (mkPoint 0 0 0) (crossQ (psub u.v₁ u.v₀) (psub u.v₂ u.v₀))
          = - carrierNormal u := by
        funext idx
        simp only [psub, Pi.neg_apply, mkPoint]
        fin_cases idx <;> simp [← hN, psub, mkPoint]
      have hg3 : slot u 3
          = (if dotQ (crossQ (psub u.v₁ u.v₀) (psub u.v₂ u.v₀)) u.v₀ ≤ 0 then
              (⟨crossQ (psub u.v₁ u.v₀) (psub u.v₂ u.v₀),
                dotQ (crossQ (psub u.v₁ u.v₀) (psub u.v₂ u.v₀)) u.v₀⟩ : Half)
            else Half.neg ⟨crossQ (psub u.v₁ u.v₀) (psub u.v₂ u.v₀),
              dotQ (crossQ (psub u.v₁ u.v₀) (psub u.v₂ u.v₀)) u.v₀⟩) := rfl
      rw [hg3]
      split
      · show ct • crossQ (psub u.v₁ u.v₀) (psub u.v₂ u.v₀)
            - dotQ (crossQ (psub u.v₁ u.v₀) (psub u.v₂ u.v₀)) u.v₀ • nt ≠ 0
        rw [hN, hc0]; exact htie
      · show ct • (Half.neg ⟨crossQ (psub u.v₁ u.v₀) (psub u.v₂ u.v₀),
              dotQ (crossQ (psub u.v₁ u.v₀) (psub u.v₂ u.v₀)) u.v₀⟩).n
            - (Half.neg ⟨crossQ (psub u.v₁ u.v₀) (psub u.v₂ u.v₀),
              dotQ (crossQ (psub u.v₁ u.v₀) (psub u.v₂ u.v₀)) u.v₀⟩).c • nt ≠ 0
        have hps' : psub (mkPoint 0 0 0) (carrierNormal u) = - carrierNormal u := by
          funext idx
          simp only [psub, Pi.neg_apply, mkPoint]
          fin_cases idx <;> simp [psub, mkPoint]
        simp only [Half.neg, hN, hc0, hps']
        have heq : ct • -carrierNormal u - -detOrigin u • nt
            = -(ct • carrierNormal u - detOrigin u • nt) := by
          rw [smul_neg, neg_smul]; abel
        rw [heq]
        exact neg_ne_zero.mpr htie
  refine (pull_aff hcert).mono ?_
  intro Q h hntQ hzero
  apply h hntQ
  rw [Half.eval] at hzero
  linarith

name: excl_hE1_tr
statement:
theorem excl_hE1_tr (hi : i < MA.size)
    (hdetA : detOrigin (MA[i]'hi) ≠ 0)
    (hnpoB : NoPlaneThroughOrigin MB)
    (htr : ∀ j : Fin MB.size,
      coplanarPlane (faceSOf MB[j]).plane (faceSOf (MA[i]'hi)).plane = false) :
    Excludes (fun Q => dotQ (carrierNormal (MA[i]'hi)) Q ≠ 0 →
      ∀ j : Fin MB.size, ∀ g ∈ tetraHalves (MB[j]),
        g.eval ((detOrigin (MA[i]'hi)
          / dotQ (carrierNormal (MA[i]'hi)) Q) • Q) ≠ 0)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have hper : ∀ j : Fin MB.size,
      Excludes (fun Q => dotQ (carrierNormal (MA[i]'hi)) Q ≠ 0 →
        ∀ g ∈ tetraHalves (MB[j]),
          g.eval ((detOrigin (MA[i]'hi)
            / dotQ (carrierNormal (MA[i]'hi)) Q) • Q) ≠ 0) := by
    intro j
    have hgg : ∀ g ∈ tetraHalves (MB[j]),
        Excludes (fun Q => dotQ (carrierNormal (MA[i]'hi)) Q ≠ 0 →
          g.eval ((detOrigin (MA[i]'hi)
            / dotQ (carrierNormal (MA[i]'hi)) Q) • Q) ≠ 0) := by
      intro g hg
      obtain ⟨k, rfl⟩ := mem_tetraHalves_iff.mp hg
      exact excl_E1_slot_tr hdetA (hnpoB j) (htr j) k
    exact (Excludes.forall_mem_array hgg).mono
      (fun Q hQ hntQ g hgm => hQ g hgm hntQ)
  exact (Excludes.forall_fintype hper).mono
    (fun Q hQ hntQ j => hQ j hntQ)

name: ledger_face_gen
statement:
theorem ledger_face_gen {M₁ M₂ : Mesh}
    (h₁ : NoPlaneThroughOrigin M₁) (h₂ : NoPlaneThroughOrigin M₂)
    (meshId : Nat) (hi : i < MA.size)
    (hdetA : detOrigin (MA[i]'hi) ≠ 0)
    (hnpoB : NoPlaneThroughOrigin MB)
    (htr : ∀ j : Fin MB.size,
      coplanarPlane (faceSOf MB[j]).plane (faceSOf (MA[i]'hi)).plane = false) :
    Excludes (fun Q => dotQ (carrierNormal (MA[i]'hi)) Q ≠ 0
      ∧ AvoidsLines (carrierNormal (MA[i]'hi)) (detOrigin (MA[i]'hi))
          (fragCycle (fragOfFace ((materialize MA).getD i default)))
          ((planesForScoped ((materialize MA).getD i default).plane (materialize MB)
            ((candP MA MB).getD i #[])).toList.map
              (fun t => t.1))
          ((detOrigin (MA[i]'hi) / dotQ (carrierNormal (MA[i]'hi)) Q) • Q)
      ∧ (∀ j : Fin MB.size, ∀ g ∈ tetraHalves (MB[j]),
          g.eval ((detOrigin (MA[i]'hi)
            / dotQ (carrierNormal (MA[i]'hi)) Q) • Q) ≠ 0)
      ∧ (∀ f ∈ clipFaceScoped
            (fragOfFace ((materialize MA).getD i default))
            (planesForScoped ((materialize MA).getD i default).plane (materialize MB)
              ((candP MA MB).getD i #[])),
          ∀ k : Fin (atomizeFrag (vsGen M₁ M₂) f).poly.size,
            areaForm (carrierNormal (MA[i]'hi))
              (fanApex (fragCycle (atomizeFrag (vsGen M₁ M₂) f)))
              (fragCycle (atomizeFrag (vsGen M₁ M₂) f) k)
              ((detOrigin (MA[i]'hi)
                / dotQ (carrierNormal (MA[i]'hi)) Q) • Q) ≠ 0))
proof:
:= by
  have h0 := excludes_dotQ_ne (carrierNormal_ne_zero hdetA) (0 : ℚ)
  have h1' := excl_hav_tr (MA := MA) (MB := MB) meshId hi hdetA hnpoB htr
  have h2' := excl_hE1_tr (MA := MA) (MB := MB) hi hdetA hnpoB htr
  have h4' := excl_hsigma_gen (MA := MA) (MB := MB) (M₁ := M₁) (M₂ := M₂)
    h₁ h₂ meshId hi hdetA
  have hcomb := h0.and (h1'.and (h2'.and h4'))
  exact hcomb.mono (fun Q h =>
    ⟨h.1, h.2.1 h.1, h.2.2.1 h.1, h.2.2.2 h.1⟩)

name: excl_edgePlane_cop
statement:
theorem excl_edgePlane_cop {nt : Point} {ct : ℚ} (hnt : nt ≠ 0) (hct : ct ≠ 0)
    {fb : Frag} {n' : Point} {c' ρ : ℚ} (hfbInv : FragInv n' c' fb)
    (hρ : ρ ≠ 0) (hn' : n' = ρ • nt) (hc' : c' = ρ * ct)
    {g : IPlane} (hg : g ∈ edgePlanesOf fb) :
    Excludes (fun Q => dotQ nt Q ≠ 0 →
      ce (iplaneN g) (iplaneD g) ((ct / dotQ nt Q) • Q) ≠ 0)
proof:
:= by
  haveI := hfbInv.neZero
  obtain ⟨k, hk, rfl⟩ := mem_edgePlanesOf hg
  
  have honp : OnPlane nt ct (fragCycle fb) := by
    intro kk
    have h := hfbInv.onPlane kk
    rw [hn', Proof.MeshIntersectCoplanarClip.dotQ_smul_left, hc'] at h
    exact mul_left_cancel₀ hρ h
  
  obtain ⟨m', hm', hcarn, -⟩ := carrierNormalPt_eq_smul hfbInv
  have hcar : carrierNormalPt fb = (m' * ρ) • nt := by
    rw [hcarn, hn', smul_smul]
  have hc : m' * ρ ≠ 0 := mul_ne_zero (ne_of_gt hm') hρ
  set u : Point := P3.toPoint (fb.poly.getD k default).p with hu_def
  set v : Point := P3.toPoint (fb.poly.getD ((k + 1) % fb.poly.size) default).p with hv_def
  have huc : u = fragCycle fb ⟨k, hk⟩ := (fragCycle_getD hk).symm
  have hvc : v = fragCycle fb (⟨k, hk⟩ + 1) := (fragCycle_succ_getD hk).symm
  have hu : dotQ nt u = ct := by rw [huc]; exact honp _
  have hv : dotQ nt v = ct := by rw [hvc]; exact honp _
  have huv : u ≠ v := by
    rw [huc, hvc]; exact consec_ne hfbInv.size3 hfbInv.strictConv ⟨k, hk⟩
  
  refine (pull_area hnt hct hu hv huv).mono ?_
  intro Q harea hntQ hzero
  apply harea hntQ
  
  obtain ⟨m, hm, hce⟩ := ce_iplane_of_mul (isMulOf_edgePlane (carrierNormalP fb) _ _)
  rw [hce, ce_edgePlane_eq_neg_areaForm] at hzero
  
  rw [show P3.toPoint (carrierNormalP fb) = carrierNormalPt fb from rfl, hcar,
    areaForm_smul_left] at hzero
  
  rcases mul_eq_zero.mp hzero with h | h
  · exact absurd h (ne_of_gt hm)
  · rw [neg_eq_zero] at h
    exact (mul_eq_zero.mp h).resolve_left hc

name: excl_cop_edge
statement:
theorem excl_cop_edge (M₁ M₂ : Mesh) (i : ℕ) (hi : i < M₁.size)
    (h₂ : NoPlaneThroughOrigin M₂) (hdetA : detOrigin (M₁[i]'hi) ≠ 0) :
    Excludes (fun Q => dotQ (carrierNormal (M₁[i]'hi)) Q ≠ 0 →
      ∀ pg ∈ copEdgePlanes M₁ M₂ i,
        ce (iplaneN pg) (iplaneD pg)
          ((detOrigin (M₁[i]'hi) / dotQ (carrierNormal (M₁[i]'hi)) Q) • Q) ≠ 0)
proof:
:= by
  set nt := carrierNormal (M₁[i]'hi) with hnt_def
  set ct := detOrigin (M₁[i]'hi) with hct_def
  have hnt : nt ≠ 0 := carrierNormal_ne_zero hdetA
  have hgetD : (materialize M₁).getD i default = faceSOf (M₁[i]'hi) := by
    rw [arr_getD _ _ _ (by simpa [materialize] using hi), materialize_getElem M₁ i hi]
  
  have hper : ∀ pg ∈ copEdgePlanes M₁ M₂ i,
      Excludes (fun Q => dotQ nt Q ≠ 0 →
        ce (iplaneN pg) (iplaneD pg) ((ct / dotQ nt Q) • Q) ≠ 0) := by
    intro pg hpg
    
    rw [copEdgePlanes, List.mem_flatMap] at hpg
    obtain ⟨fb, hfbfilt, hpgmem⟩ := hpg
    rw [Array.mem_toList] at hpgmem
    rw [Array.mem_toList, Array.mem_filter] at hfbfilt
    obtain ⟨hfbbucket, hfbcop⟩ := hfbfilt
    
    obtain ⟨j, hj, hfbInv, hdetB, hfbpl, -⟩ :=
      Proof.MeshIntersectNsi.copB_carrier h₂ hfbbucket
    
    have hcopij : coplanarPlane (faceSOf (M₁[i]'hi)).plane (faceSOf (M₂[j]'hj)).plane = true := by
      have h := hfbcop
      rw [hgetD, hfbpl] at h
      simpa using h
    obtain ⟨ρ, hρ, hcarn, hdet⟩ := coplanar_carrier_prop hdetA hdetB hcopij
    exact excl_edgePlane_cop hnt hdetA hfbInv hρ hcarn hdet hpgmem
  refine (Excludes.forall_mem_list hper).mono ?_
  intro Q hQ hntQ pg hpg
  exact hQ pg hpg hntQ

name: excl_cop_edgeB
statement:
theorem excl_cop_edgeB (M₁ M₂ : Mesh) (j : ℕ) (hj : j < M₂.size)
    (h₁ : NoPlaneThroughOrigin M₁) (hdetB : detOrigin (M₂[j]'hj) ≠ 0) :
    Excludes (fun Q => dotQ (carrierNormal (M₂[j]'hj)) Q ≠ 0 →
      ∀ pg ∈ copEdgePlanesB M₁ M₂ j,
        ce (iplaneN pg) (iplaneD pg)
          ((detOrigin (M₂[j]'hj) / dotQ (carrierNormal (M₂[j]'hj)) Q) • Q) ≠ 0)
proof:
:= by
  set nt := carrierNormal (M₂[j]'hj) with hnt_def
  set ct := detOrigin (M₂[j]'hj) with hct_def
  have hnt : nt ≠ 0 := carrierNormal_ne_zero hdetB
  have hgetD : (materialize M₂).getD j default = faceSOf (M₂[j]'hj) := by
    rw [arr_getD _ _ _ (by simpa [materialize] using hj), materialize_getElem M₂ j hj]
  have hper : ∀ pg ∈ copEdgePlanesB M₁ M₂ j,
      Excludes (fun Q => dotQ nt Q ≠ 0 →
        ce (iplaneN pg) (iplaneD pg) ((ct / dotQ nt Q) • Q) ≠ 0) := by
    intro pg hpg
    rw [copEdgePlanesB, List.mem_flatMap] at hpg
    obtain ⟨fa, hfafilt, hpgmem⟩ := hpg
    rw [Array.mem_toList] at hpgmem
    rw [Array.mem_toList, Array.mem_filter] at hfafilt
    obtain ⟨hfabucket, hfacop⟩ := hfafilt
    obtain ⟨i, hi, hfaInv, hdetA, hfapl, -⟩ :=
      Proof.MeshIntersectNsi.copA_carrier h₁ hfabucket
    have hcopji : coplanarPlane (faceSOf (M₂[j]'hj)).plane (faceSOf (M₁[i]'hi)).plane = true := by
      have h := hfacop
      rw [hgetD, hfapl] at h
      simpa using h
    obtain ⟨ρ, hρ, hcarn, hdet⟩ := coplanar_carrier_prop hdetB hdetA hcopji
    exact excl_edgePlane_cop hnt hdetB hfaInv hρ hcarn hdet hpgmem
  refine (Excludes.forall_mem_list hper).mono ?_
  intro Q hQ hntQ pg hpg
  exact hQ pg hpg hntQ

name: excl_eta_fa
statement:
theorem excl_eta_fa (M₁ _M₂ : Mesh) (i : ℕ) (hi : i < M₁.size)
    (hdetA : detOrigin (M₁[i]'hi) ≠ 0)
    {fa : Frag} [NeZero fa.poly.size]
    (hfaInv : FragInv (carrierNormal (M₁[i]'hi)) (detOrigin (M₁[i]'hi)) fa) :
    Excludes (fun Q => dotQ (carrierNormal (M₁[i]'hi)) Q ≠ 0 →
      ∀ k : Fin fa.poly.size,
        eta (carrierNormal (M₁[i]'hi)) (fragCycle fa) k
          ((detOrigin (M₁[i]'hi) / dotQ (carrierNormal (M₁[i]'hi)) Q) • Q) ≠ 0)
proof:
:= by
  have hnt : carrierNormal (M₁[i]'hi) ≠ 0 := carrierNormal_ne_zero hdetA
  have h := Excludes.forall_fintype
    (F := fun (k : Fin fa.poly.size) Q =>
      dotQ (carrierNormal (M₁[i]'hi)) Q ≠ 0 →
      areaForm (carrierNormal (M₁[i]'hi)) (fragCycle fa k) (fragCycle fa (k + 1))
        ((detOrigin (M₁[i]'hi) / dotQ (carrierNormal (M₁[i]'hi)) Q) • Q) ≠ 0)
    (fun k => pull_area hnt hdetA (hfaInv.onPlane k) (hfaInv.onPlane (k + 1))
      (consec_ne hfaInv.size3 hfaInv.strictConv k))
  exact h.mono (fun Q hQ hntQ k => hQ k hntQ)

name: excl_cop_avoidsLines
statement:
theorem excl_cop_avoidsLines (M₁ M₂ : Mesh)
    (h₁ : NoPlaneThroughOrigin M₁) (h₂ : NoPlaneThroughOrigin M₂) :
    Excludes (fun Q => ∀ i : Fin M₁.size,
      dotQ (carrierNormal M₁[i]) Q ≠ 0 →
      ∀ fa ∈ clipFaceScoped
          (fragOfFace ((materialize M₁).getD i.1 default))
          (planesForScoped ((materialize M₁).getD i.1 default).plane (materialize M₂)
            ((candP M₁ M₂).getD i.1 #[])),
        ∀ [NeZero fa.poly.size],
        AvoidsLines (carrierNormal M₁[i]) (detOrigin M₁[i]) (fragCycle fa)
          (copEdgePlanes M₁ M₂ i.1)
          ((detOrigin M₁[i] / dotQ (carrierNormal M₁[i]) Q) • Q))
proof:
:= by
  refine Excludes.forall_fintype (fun i : Fin M₁.size => ?_)
  have hdetA : detOrigin M₁[i] ≠ 0 := h₁ i
  
  have hbase : FragInv (carrierNormal M₁[i]) (detOrigin M₁[i])
      (fragOfFace ((materialize M₁).getD i.1 default)) := by
    rw [show (materialize M₁).getD i.1 default = faceSOf M₁[i] from by
      rw [getD_eq_getElem (materialize M₁) (by rw [materialize_size]; exact i.isLt) default,
        materialize_getElem M₁ i.1 i.isLt]; rfl]
    exact fragInv_base hdetA
  
  have hce := excl_cop_edge M₁ M₂ i.1 i.isLt h₂ hdetA
  
  have hfam : Excludes (fun Q => dotQ (carrierNormal M₁[i]) Q ≠ 0 →
      ∀ fa ∈ clipFaceScoped
          (fragOfFace ((materialize M₁).getD i.1 default))
          (planesForScoped ((materialize M₁).getD i.1 default).plane (materialize M₂)
            ((candP M₁ M₂).getD i.1 #[])),
        ∀ [NeZero fa.poly.size],
        ∀ k : Fin fa.poly.size,
          eta (carrierNormal M₁[i]) (fragCycle fa) k
            ((detOrigin M₁[i] / dotQ (carrierNormal M₁[i]) Q) • Q) ≠ 0) := by
    have hperfa : ∀ fa ∈ clipFaceScoped
        (fragOfFace ((materialize M₁).getD i.1 default))
        (planesForScoped ((materialize M₁).getD i.1 default).plane (materialize M₂)
          ((candP M₁ M₂).getD i.1 #[])),
        Excludes (fun Q => dotQ (carrierNormal M₁[i]) Q ≠ 0 →
          ∀ [NeZero fa.poly.size],
          ∀ k : Fin fa.poly.size,
            eta (carrierNormal M₁[i]) (fragCycle fa) k
              ((detOrigin M₁[i] / dotQ (carrierNormal M₁[i]) Q) • Q) ≠ 0) := by
      intro fa hfa
      haveI := (fragInv_clipFaceScoped hbase _ hfa).neZero
      refine (excl_eta_fa M₁ M₂ i.1 i.isLt hdetA (fragInv_clipFaceScoped hbase _ hfa)).mono ?_
      intro Q hQ hntQ _ k
      exact hQ hntQ k
    refine (Excludes.forall_mem_array hperfa).mono ?_
    intro Q hQ hntQ fa hfa _ k
    exact hQ fa hfa hntQ k
  refine (hce.and hfam).mono ?_
  rintro Q ⟨hceQ, hfaQ⟩ hntQ fa hfa _
  exact ⟨hit_on_carrier hntQ, hfaQ hntQ fa hfa, fun pg hpg => hceQ hntQ pg hpg⟩

name: excl_eta_fb
statement:
theorem excl_eta_fb (_M₁ M₂ : Mesh) (j : ℕ) (hj : j < M₂.size)
    (hdetB : detOrigin (M₂[j]'hj) ≠ 0)
    {fb : Frag} [NeZero fb.poly.size]
    (hfbInv : FragInv (carrierNormal (M₂[j]'hj)) (detOrigin (M₂[j]'hj)) fb) :
    Excludes (fun Q => dotQ (carrierNormal (M₂[j]'hj)) Q ≠ 0 →
      ∀ k : Fin fb.poly.size,
        eta (carrierNormal (M₂[j]'hj)) (fragCycle fb) k
          ((detOrigin (M₂[j]'hj) / dotQ (carrierNormal (M₂[j]'hj)) Q) • Q) ≠ 0)
proof:
:= by
  have hnt : carrierNormal (M₂[j]'hj) ≠ 0 := carrierNormal_ne_zero hdetB
  have h := Excludes.forall_fintype
    (F := fun (k : Fin fb.poly.size) Q =>
      dotQ (carrierNormal (M₂[j]'hj)) Q ≠ 0 →
      areaForm (carrierNormal (M₂[j]'hj)) (fragCycle fb k) (fragCycle fb (k + 1))
        ((detOrigin (M₂[j]'hj) / dotQ (carrierNormal (M₂[j]'hj)) Q) • Q) ≠ 0)
    (fun k => pull_area hnt hdetB (hfbInv.onPlane k) (hfbInv.onPlane (k + 1))
      (consec_ne hfbInv.size3 hfbInv.strictConv k))
