name: excl_cop_avoidsLinesB
statement:
theorem excl_cop_avoidsLinesB (M₁ M₂ : Mesh)
    (h₁ : NoPlaneThroughOrigin M₁) (h₂ : NoPlaneThroughOrigin M₂) :
    Excludes (fun Q => ∀ j : Fin M₂.size,
      dotQ (carrierNormal M₂[j]) Q ≠ 0 →
      ∀ fb ∈ clipFaceScoped
          (fragOfFace ((materialize M₂).getD j.1 default))
          (planesForScoped ((materialize M₂).getD j.1 default).plane (materialize M₁)
            ((candP M₂ M₁).getD j.1 #[])),
        ∀ [NeZero fb.poly.size],
        AvoidsLines (carrierNormal M₂[j]) (detOrigin M₂[j]) (fragCycle fb)
          (copEdgePlanesB M₁ M₂ j.1)
          ((detOrigin M₂[j] / dotQ (carrierNormal M₂[j]) Q) • Q))
proof:
:= by
  refine Excludes.forall_fintype (fun j : Fin M₂.size => ?_)
  have hdetB : detOrigin M₂[j] ≠ 0 := h₂ j
  have hbase : FragInv (carrierNormal M₂[j]) (detOrigin M₂[j])
      (fragOfFace ((materialize M₂).getD j.1 default)) := by
    rw [show (materialize M₂).getD j.1 default = faceSOf M₂[j] from by
      rw [getD_eq_getElem (materialize M₂) (by rw [materialize_size]; exact j.isLt) default,
        materialize_getElem M₂ j.1 j.isLt]; rfl]
    exact fragInv_base hdetB
  have hce := excl_cop_edgeB M₁ M₂ j.1 j.isLt h₁ hdetB
  have hfam : Excludes (fun Q => dotQ (carrierNormal M₂[j]) Q ≠ 0 →
      ∀ fb ∈ clipFaceScoped
          (fragOfFace ((materialize M₂).getD j.1 default))
          (planesForScoped ((materialize M₂).getD j.1 default).plane (materialize M₁)
            ((candP M₂ M₁).getD j.1 #[])),
        ∀ [NeZero fb.poly.size],
        ∀ k : Fin fb.poly.size,
          eta (carrierNormal M₂[j]) (fragCycle fb) k
            ((detOrigin M₂[j] / dotQ (carrierNormal M₂[j]) Q) • Q) ≠ 0) := by
    have hperfb : ∀ fb ∈ clipFaceScoped
        (fragOfFace ((materialize M₂).getD j.1 default))
        (planesForScoped ((materialize M₂).getD j.1 default).plane (materialize M₁)
          ((candP M₂ M₁).getD j.1 #[])),
        Excludes (fun Q => dotQ (carrierNormal M₂[j]) Q ≠ 0 →
          ∀ [NeZero fb.poly.size],
          ∀ k : Fin fb.poly.size,
            eta (carrierNormal M₂[j]) (fragCycle fb) k
              ((detOrigin M₂[j] / dotQ (carrierNormal M₂[j]) Q) • Q) ≠ 0) := by
      intro fb hfb
      haveI := (fragInv_clipFaceScoped hbase _ hfb).neZero
      refine (excl_eta_fb M₁ M₂ j.1 j.isLt hdetB (fragInv_clipFaceScoped hbase _ hfb)).mono ?_
      intro Q hQ hntQ _ k
      exact hQ hntQ k
    refine (Excludes.forall_mem_array hperfb).mono ?_
    intro Q hQ hntQ fb hfb _ k
    exact hQ fb hfb hntQ k
  refine (hce.and hfam).mono ?_
  rintro Q ⟨hceQ, hfbQ⟩ hntQ fb hfb _
  exact ⟨hit_on_carrier hntQ, hfbQ hntQ fb hfb, fun pg hpg => hceQ hntQ pg hpg⟩

name: leg_descent
statement:
theorem leg_descent (M : Mesh) (hcyc : IsClosedOrientedSurface M)
    (hnpo : NoPlaneThroughOrigin M) {i : Fin M.size} {x y : Point} {τc : ℚ}
    (hp : AdmPair M i x y τc) {ρ : ℚ} (h0 : 0 < ρ) (h1 : ρ < 1)
    (hg1 : G1Clean M (seg x y (τc * (1 - ρ)))) :
    winding (meshChain M) x = winding (meshChain M) (seg x y (τc * (1 - ρ)))
proof:
:= by
  set τ₀ : ℚ := τc * (1 - ρ) with hτ₀
  have hτ₀pos : 0 < τ₀ := by
    rw [hτ₀]
    exact mul_pos hp.lt0 (by linarith)
  have hτ₀lt : τ₀ < τc := by
    rw [hτ₀]
    nlinarith [hp.lt0]
  have hτ₀lt1 : τ₀ < 1 := lt_trans hτ₀lt hp.lt1
  
  have hpt : ∀ τ : ℚ,
      (fun k => x k + τ * (seg x y τ₀ k - x k)) = seg x y (τ * τ₀) := by
    intro τ
    have h := seg_subseg x y 0 τ₀ τ
    rw [seg_zero] at h
    have harg : (0 : ℚ) + τ * (τ₀ - 0) = τ * τ₀ := by ring
    calc (fun k => x k + τ * (seg x y τ₀ k - x k))
        = seg x (seg x y τ₀) τ := rfl
      _ = seg x y (0 + τ * (τ₀ - 0)) := h
      _ = seg x y (τ * τ₀) := by rw [harg]
  apply winding_const_of_avoiding M hcyc hnpo x (seg x y τ₀)
  · 
    intro j τ ht0 ht1
    rw [hpt τ]
    exact hp.h1 j (τ * τ₀) (mul_pos ht0 hτ₀pos)
      (lt_trans (by nlinarith) hτ₀lt1)
      (by intro hc; nlinarith [hτ₀lt])
  · 
    intro j g hg
    exact ⟨hp.g1x j g hg, hg1 j g hg⟩
  · 
    intro j g hg g' hg' hne τ ht0 ht1
    rw [hpt τ]
    exact hp.g2 j g hg g' hg' hne (τ * τ₀) (mul_pos ht0 hτ₀pos)
      (lt_trans (by nlinarith) hτ₀lt1)

name: polyline_arm
statement:
private theorem polyline_arm (M : Mesh) (hcyc : IsClosedOrientedSurface M)
    (hnpo : NoPlaneThroughOrigin M) {i : Fin M.size}
    {x y : Point} {τc : ℚ} (hp : AdmPair M i x y τc)
    (c v : Point) (hc : c = seg x y τc) (hv : v = psub x c)
    {cs nv : Point} {ν θ β₀ : ℚ}
    (hcsT : cs ∈ triangleSet M[i])
    (hnv : nv = fun kk => ν * Proof.MeshIntersectJump.faceNormal M[i] kk)
    (hν2 : ν * ν = 1) (hσν : 0 < ν * dotQ (Proof.MeshIntersectJump.faceNormal M[i]) v)
    (hβ₀ : 0 < β₀) (hθ0 : 0 < θ) (hθβ : θ ≤ β₀)
    (hthr2 : ThrChord M i c v cs β₀) (hthr3 : ThrNormal M i v nv cs β₀)
    (hXF1 : OracleF1 M i cs) (hX2 : OracleF2 M i v cs) (hX3 : OracleF3 M i c cs)
    (hTL2 : OracleTL M (psub cs c) v c β₀) (hTL3 : OracleTL M nv v cs β₀)
    (hTLb : OracleTLb M nv cs β₀)
    (hg1θ : G1Clean M (lineAt cs nv θ)) :
    winding (meshChain M) x = winding (meshChain M) (lineAt cs nv θ)
proof:
:= by
  have hσ : dotQ (Proof.MeshIntersectJump.faceNormal M[i]) v ≠ 0 := by
    intro h
    rw [h, mul_zero] at hσν
    exact lt_irrefl 0 hσν
  have hcT : c ∈ triangleSet M[i] := by rw [hc]; exact hp.footMem
  
  have hX0 : ∀ (j : Fin M.size) (k : Fin 4), dotQ (slot M[j] k).n v = 0 →
      (slot M[j] k).eval c ≠ 0 := by
    intro j k hz hc0
    have hxl : x = lineAt c v 1 := by
      funext kk
      simp only [lineAt, hv, psub]
      ring
    have hxev : (slot M[j] k).eval x = 0 := by
      rw [hxl, eval_lineAt, hc0, hz, mul_zero, add_zero]
    exact hp.g1x j _ (slot_mem _ _) hxev
  
  have hXcs : ∀ (j : Fin M.size) (k : Fin 4), dotQ (slot M[j] k).n v = 0 →
      (slot M[j] k).eval cs ≠ 0 := by
    intro j k hz
    exact hXF1 j k (edge_disj_of_dot_zero (hnpo i)
      (facet_n_ne_zero (hnpo j) _ (slot_mem _ _)) hz hσ)
  
  obtain ⟨ρ, hρ0, hρm, hρav⟩ :=
    exists_pos_lt_avoiding (lt_min hβ₀ one_pos) (g1RootList M c v)
  have hρβ : ρ ≤ β₀ := le_of_lt (lt_of_lt_of_le hρm (min_le_left _ _))
  have hρ1 : ρ < 1 := lt_of_lt_of_le hρm (min_le_right _ _)
  obtain ⟨η, hη0, hηm, hηav⟩ := exists_pos_lt_avoiding hβ₀ (g1RootList M cs v)
  have hηβ : η ≤ β₀ := le_of_lt hηm
  have hg1ρ : G1Clean M (lineAt c v ρ) := g1_trace_avoid M hX0 hρav
  have hg1η : G1Clean M (lineAt cs v η) := g1_trace_avoid M hXcs hηav
  
  have hfoot : ∀ (j : Fin M.size) (k k' : Fin 4), slot M[j] k ≠ slot M[j] k' →
      ¬ ((slot M[j] k).eval c = 0 ∧ (slot M[j] k').eval c = 0) := by
    intro j k k' hne
    rw [hc]
    exact hp.g2 j _ (slot_mem _ _) _ (slot_mem _ _) hne τc hp.lt0 hp.lt1
  
  have hl1 : winding (meshChain M) x = winding (meshChain M) (lineAt c v ρ) := by
    have hy₁ : seg x y (τc * (1 - ρ)) = lineAt c v ρ := by
      funext kk
      simp only [seg, lineAt, hv, psub, hc]
      ring
    rw [← hy₁]
    exact leg_descent M hcyc hnpo hp hρ0 hρ1 (by rw [hy₁]; exact hg1ρ)
  have hl2 := leg_chord M hcyc hnpo hcT hcsT hσ hρ0 hρβ hη0 hηβ hthr2 hg1ρ
    hg1η hfoot hX0 hX2 hX3 hTL2
  have hl3 := leg_normal M hcyc hnpo hcsT hnv hν2 hσν hη0 hηβ hθ0 hθβ hthr3
    hg1η hg1θ hXF1 hX2 hTL3 hTLb
  exact hl1.trans (hl2.trans hl3)

name: germ_const
statement:
theorem germ_const (M : Mesh) (hcyc : IsClosedOrientedSurface M) (hnpo : NoPlaneThroughOrigin M)
    (hns : NoFaceInteriorContact M) (i : Fin M.size) (s : ℤ) {x x' : Point}
    (hx : AdmPt M i s x) (hx' : AdmPt M i s x') :
    winding (meshChain M) x = winding (meshChain M) x'
proof:
:= by
  have hs := admPt_side hnpo hx
  obtain ⟨y, τc, hp, hsx⟩ := hx
  obtain ⟨y', τc', hp', hsx'⟩ := hx'
  set c : Point := seg x y τc with hc
  clear_value c
  set v : Point := psub x c with hv
  clear_value v
  set c' : Point := seg x' y' τc' with hc'
  clear_value c'
  set v' : Point := psub x' c' with hv'
  clear_value v'
  set nv : Point := fun kk => (s : ℚ) * Proof.MeshIntersectJump.faceNormal M[i] kk with hnv
  clear_value nv
  
  have hν2 : (s : ℚ) * (s : ℚ) = 1 := by
    rcases hs with rfl | rfl <;> norm_num
  have hν0 : (s : ℚ) ≠ 0 := by
    rcases hs with rfl | rfl <;> norm_num
  have hside : ∀ (z w : Point) (τz : ℚ), AdmPair M i z w τz →
      sideOf M[i] z = s →
      0 < (s : ℚ) * dotQ (Proof.MeshIntersectJump.faceNormal M[i]) (psub z (seg z w τz)) := by
    intro z w τz hpz hsz
    have hfm : dotQ (Proof.MeshIntersectJump.faceNormal M[i]) (seg z w τz) = detOrigin M[i] :=
      triangleSet_on_carrier hpz.footMem
    have hval : dotQ (Proof.MeshIntersectJump.faceNormal M[i]) z - detOrigin M[i]
        = dotQ (Proof.MeshIntersectJump.faceNormal M[i]) (psub z (seg z w τz)) := by
      have h := dotQ_eq_add_psub (Proof.MeshIntersectJump.faceNormal M[i]) (seg z w τz) z
      rw [hfm] at h
      linarith
    unfold sideOf at hsz
    rw [← hval]
    rcases lt_trichotomy (dotQ (Proof.MeshIntersectJump.faceNormal M[i]) z - detOrigin M[i]) 0 with
      hlt | heq | hgt
    · rw [qsign_of_neg hlt] at hsz
      rw [← hsz]
      push_cast
      nlinarith
    · rw [heq, show qsign 0 = 0 from rfl] at hsz
      rcases hs with hs1 | hs1 <;> rw [hs1] at hsz <;> norm_num at hsz
    · rw [qsign_of_pos hgt] at hsz
      rw [← hsz]
      push_cast
      nlinarith
  have hσν : 0 < (s : ℚ) * dotQ (Proof.MeshIntersectJump.faceNormal M[i]) v := by
    rw [hv, hc]
    exact hside x y τc hp hsx
  have hσν' : 0 < (s : ℚ) * dotQ (Proof.MeshIntersectJump.faceNormal M[i]) v' := by
    rw [hv', hc']
    exact hside x' y' τc' hp' hsx'
  
  have hHs : ∀ h ∈ exF1 M i ++ (exF2 M i v ++ (exF2 M i v' ++
      (exF3 M i c ++ exF3 M i c'))),
      dotQ h.1 (psub M[i].v₁ M[i].v₀) ≠ 0 ∨
        dotQ h.1 (psub M[i].v₂ M[i].v₀) ≠ 0 ∨
        dotQ h.1 (curveAt M[i] 0) ≠ h.2 := by
    intro h hm
    rcases List.mem_append.mp hm with h1 | hm
    · exact (exF1_disj h h1).imp id Or.inl
    rcases List.mem_append.mp hm with h2 | hm
    · exact (exF2_disj h h2).imp id Or.inl
    rcases List.mem_append.mp hm with h3 | hm
    · exact (exF2_disj h h3).imp id Or.inl
    rcases List.mem_append.mp hm with h4 | h5
    · exact (exF3_disj h h4).imp id Or.inl
    · exact (exF3_disj h h5).imp id Or.inl
  obtain ⟨cs, hcsT, hcsE, -, -, hcsH⟩ := relint_pick M hnpo i [] [] _ hHs
  
  have hXF1g : OracleF1 M i cs := by
    intro j k hd
    have h := hcsH _ (List.mem_append_left _ (mem_exF1 j k hd))
    simp only [Half.eval]
    exact sub_ne_zero.mpr h
  have hX2v : OracleF2 M i v cs :=
    fun j k k' hgv hd => hcsH _ (List.mem_append_right _
      (List.mem_append_left _ (mem_exF2 j k k' hgv hd)))
  have hX2v' : OracleF2 M i v' cs :=
    fun j k k' hgv hd => hcsH _ (List.mem_append_right _
      (List.mem_append_right _ (List.mem_append_left _ (mem_exF2 j k k' hgv hd))))
  have hX3c : OracleF3 M i c cs :=
    fun j k k' hd => hcsH _ (List.mem_append_right _ (List.mem_append_right _
      (List.mem_append_right _ (List.mem_append_left _ (mem_exF3 j k k' hd)))))
  have hX3c' : OracleF3 M i c' cs :=
    fun j k k' hd => hcsH _ (List.mem_append_right _ (List.mem_append_right _
      (List.mem_append_right _ (List.mem_append_right _ (mem_exF3 j k k' hd)))))
  
  have hcE : c ∉ edgeSet M[i] := by rw [hc]; exact hp.footOff
  have hcE' : c' ∉ edgeSet M[i] := by rw [hc']; exact hp'.footOff
  have hcT : c ∈ triangleSet M[i] := by rw [hc]; exact hp.footMem
  have hcT' : c' ∈ triangleSet M[i] := by rw [hc']; exact hp'.footMem
  obtain ⟨ε₁, hε₁, hth₁⟩ := chord_thresh M hnpo hns i v hcT hcE hcsT hcsE
  obtain ⟨ε₂, hε₂, hth₂⟩ := chord_thresh M hnpo hns i v' hcT' hcE' hcsT hcsE
  obtain ⟨ε₃, hε₃, hth₃⟩ := normal_thresh M hnpo hns i v nv hcsT hcsE
  obtain ⟨ε₄, hε₄, hth₄⟩ := normal_thresh M hnpo hns i v' nv hcsT hcsE
  obtain ⟨βT, hβT0, hβTlt⟩ := exists_below_pos
    (rootList M (psub cs c) v c ++ (rootList M (psub cs c') v' c' ++
      (rootList M nv v cs ++ (rootList M nv v' cs ++ g1RootList M cs nv))))
  set β₀ : ℚ := min ε₁ (min ε₂ (min ε₃ (min ε₄ βT))) with hβ₀def
  have hβ₀ : 0 < β₀ := lt_min hε₁ (lt_min hε₂ (lt_min hε₃ (lt_min hε₄ hβT0)))
  have hβε₁ : β₀ ≤ ε₁ := min_le_left _ _
  have hβε₂ : β₀ ≤ ε₂ := le_trans (min_le_right _ _) (min_le_left _ _)
  have hβε₃ : β₀ ≤ ε₃ :=
    le_trans (min_le_right _ _) (le_trans (min_le_right _ _) (min_le_left _ _))
  have hβε₄ : β₀ ≤ ε₄ := le_trans (min_le_right _ _) (le_trans (min_le_right _ _)
    (le_trans (min_le_right _ _) (min_le_left _ _)))
  have hβεT : β₀ ≤ βT := le_trans (min_le_right _ _) (le_trans (min_le_right _ _)
    (le_trans (min_le_right _ _) (min_le_right _ _)))
  clear_value β₀
  have hthr2 : ThrChord M i c v cs β₀ :=
    fun u hu a b ha0 ha1 hb0 hbβ =>
      hth₁ u hu a b ha0 ha1 hb0 (le_trans hbβ hβε₁)
  have hthr2' : ThrChord M i c' v' cs β₀ :=
    fun u hu a b ha0 ha1 hb0 hbβ =>
      hth₂ u hu a b ha0 ha1 hb0 (le_trans hbβ hβε₂)
  have hthr3 : ThrNormal M i v nv cs β₀ :=
    fun u hu a b ha0 hab hbβ => hth₃ u hu a b ha0 hab (le_trans hbβ hβε₃)
  have hthr3' : ThrNormal M i v' nv cs β₀ :=
    fun u hu a b ha0 hab hbβ => hth₄ u hu a b ha0 hab (le_trans hbβ hβε₄)
  have hTL2 : OracleTL M (psub cs c) v c β₀ :=
    fun j k k' hD hpos => lt_of_le_of_lt hβεT (hβTlt _
      (List.mem_append_left _ (mem_rootList j k k' hD)) hpos)
  have hTL2' : OracleTL M (psub cs c') v' c' β₀ :=
    fun j k k' hD hpos => lt_of_le_of_lt hβεT (hβTlt _
      (List.mem_append_right _ (List.mem_append_left _ (mem_rootList j k k' hD)))
      hpos)
  have hTL3 : OracleTL M nv v cs β₀ :=
    fun j k k' hD hpos => lt_of_le_of_lt hβεT (hβTlt _
      (List.mem_append_right _ (List.mem_append_right _
        (List.mem_append_left _ (mem_rootList j k k' hD)))) hpos)
  have hTL3' : OracleTL M nv v' cs β₀ :=
    fun j k k' hD hpos => lt_of_le_of_lt hβεT (hβTlt _
      (List.mem_append_right _ (List.mem_append_right _
        (List.mem_append_right _ (List.mem_append_left _
          (mem_rootList j k k' hD))))) hpos)
  have hTLb : OracleTLb M nv cs β₀ :=
    fun j k hgn hpos => lt_of_le_of_lt hβεT (hβTlt _
      (List.mem_append_right _ (List.mem_append_right _
        (List.mem_append_right _ (List.mem_append_right _
          (mem_g1RootList j k hgn))))) hpos)
  
  obtain ⟨θ, hθ0, hθm, hθav⟩ := exists_pos_lt_avoiding hβ₀ (g1RootList M cs nv)
  have hθβ : θ ≤ β₀ := le_of_lt hθm
  have hnne : Proof.MeshIntersectJump.faceNormal M[i] ≠ 0 :=
    ne_zero_of_dotQ (u := M[i].v₀) (by rw [faceNormal_offset]; exact hnpo i)
  have hnn : 0 < dotQ (Proof.MeshIntersectJump.faceNormal M[i]) (Proof.MeshIntersectJump.faceNormal M[i]) := dotQ_self_pos hnne
  have hXθ : ∀ (j : Fin M.size) (k : Fin 4), dotQ (slot M[j] k).n nv = 0 →
      (slot M[j] k).eval cs ≠ 0 := by
    intro j k hz
    have hzz : dotQ (slot M[j] k).n nv
        = (s : ℚ) * dotQ (slot M[j] k).n (Proof.MeshIntersectJump.faceNormal M[i]) := by
      rw [hnv]
      simp only [dotQ]
      ring
    rw [hzz] at hz
    have hgnn := (mul_eq_zero.mp hz).resolve_left hν0
    exact hXF1g j k (edge_disj_of_dot_zero (hnpo i)
      (facet_n_ne_zero (hnpo j) _ (slot_mem _ _)) hgnn (ne_of_gt hnn))
  have hg1θ : G1Clean M (lineAt cs nv θ) := g1_trace_avoid M hXθ hθav
  
  have harm := polyline_arm M hcyc hnpo hp c v hc hv hcsT hnv hν2 hσν hβ₀
    hθ0 hθβ hthr2 hthr3 hXF1g hX2v hX3c hTL2 hTL3 hTLb hg1θ
  have harm' := polyline_arm M hcyc hnpo hp' c' v' hc' hv' hcsT hnv hν2 hσν'
    hβ₀ hθ0 hθβ hthr2' hthr3' hXF1g hX2v' hX3c' hTL2' hTL3' hTLb hg1θ
  exact harm.trans harm'.symm

name: exA_mem
statement:
private theorem exA_mem {M : Mesh} {i : Fin M.size} (Φ : List (Point × ℚ))
    (j : Fin M.size) (k : Fin 4)
    (hz : dotQ (slot M[j] k).n (Proof.MeshIntersectJump.faceNormal M[i]) = 0) :
    ((slot M[j] k).n, (slot M[j] k).c) ∈ exAll M i Φ
proof:
:= by
  apply List.mem_append.mpr; left
  apply List.mem_append.mpr; left
  refine List.mem_filterMap.mpr ⟨(j, k),
    List.pair_mem_product.mpr ⟨List.mem_finRange j, List.mem_finRange k⟩, ?_⟩
  show (if dotQ (slot M[j] k).n (Proof.MeshIntersectJump.faceNormal M[i]) = 0
      then some ((slot M[j] k).n, (slot M[j] k).c) else none)
    = some ((slot M[j] k).n, (slot M[j] k).c)
  rw [if_pos hz]

name: exC_mem
proof:
:= by
  apply List.mem_append.mpr; left
  apply List.mem_append.mpr; right
  refine List.mem_filterMap.mpr ⟨φ, hφ, ?_⟩
  show (if dotQ φ.1 (Proof.MeshIntersectJump.faceNormal M[i]) = 0 then some φ else none) = some φ
  rw [if_pos hz]

name: exB_mem
statement:
private theorem exB_mem {M : Mesh} {i : Fin M.size} (Φ : List (Point × ℚ))
    (j : Fin M.size) (k k' : Fin 4)
    (hν : crossQ (crossQ (slot M[j] k).n (slot M[j] k').n) (Proof.MeshIntersectJump.faceNormal M[i]) ≠ 0) :
    (crossQ (crossQ (slot M[j] k).n (slot M[j] k').n) (Proof.MeshIntersectJump.faceNormal M[i]),
     dotQ (slot M[j] k).n (Proof.MeshIntersectJump.faceNormal M[i]) * (slot M[j] k').c
       - dotQ (slot M[j] k').n (Proof.MeshIntersectJump.faceNormal M[i]) * (slot M[j] k).c)
      ∈ exAll M i Φ
proof:
:= by
  apply List.mem_append.mpr; right
  refine List.mem_filterMap.mpr ⟨((j, k), k'),
    List.pair_mem_product.mpr ⟨List.pair_mem_product.mpr
      ⟨List.mem_finRange j, List.mem_finRange k⟩, List.mem_finRange k'⟩, ?_⟩
  show (if dotQ (crossQ (crossQ (slot M[j] k).n (slot M[j] k').n) (Proof.MeshIntersectJump.faceNormal M[i]))
        (crossQ (crossQ (slot M[j] k).n (slot M[j] k').n) (Proof.MeshIntersectJump.faceNormal M[i])) = 0
      then none
      else some
        (crossQ (crossQ (slot M[j] k).n (slot M[j] k').n) (Proof.MeshIntersectJump.faceNormal M[i]),
         dotQ (slot M[j] k).n (Proof.MeshIntersectJump.faceNormal M[i]) * (slot M[j] k').c
           - dotQ (slot M[j] k').n (Proof.MeshIntersectJump.faceNormal M[i]) * (slot M[j] k).c))
    = some
        (crossQ (crossQ (slot M[j] k).n (slot M[j] k').n) (Proof.MeshIntersectJump.faceNormal M[i]),
         dotQ (slot M[j] k).n (Proof.MeshIntersectJump.faceNormal M[i]) * (slot M[j] k').c
           - dotQ (slot M[j] k').n (Proof.MeshIntersectJump.faceNormal M[i]) * (slot M[j] k).c)
  rw [if_neg (ne_of_gt (dotQ_self_pos hν))]

name: exAll_perp
proof:
:= by
  intro h hmem
  rcases List.mem_append.mp hmem with hAC | hB
  · rcases List.mem_append.mp hAC with hA | hC
    · obtain ⟨jk, -, hf⟩ := List.mem_filterMap.mp hA
      by_cases hz : dotQ (slot M[jk.1] jk.2).n (Proof.MeshIntersectJump.faceNormal M[i]) = 0
      · simp only [if_pos hz] at hf
        obtain rfl := Option.some.inj hf
        exact ⟨facet_n_ne_zero (hnpo jk.1) _ (slot_mem _ _), hz⟩
      · simp only [if_neg hz] at hf
        exact Option.noConfusion hf
    · obtain ⟨φ, hφmem, hf⟩ := List.mem_filterMap.mp hC
      by_cases hz : dotQ φ.1 (Proof.MeshIntersectJump.faceNormal M[i]) = 0
      · simp only [if_pos hz] at hf
        obtain rfl := Option.some.inj hf
        exact ⟨hΦ φ hφmem, hz⟩
      · simp only [if_neg hz] at hf
        exact Option.noConfusion hf
  · obtain ⟨jkk, -, hf⟩ := List.mem_filterMap.mp hB
    by_cases hz : dotQ (crossQ (crossQ (slot M[jkk.1.1] jkk.1.2).n
          (slot M[jkk.1.1] jkk.2).n) (Proof.MeshIntersectJump.faceNormal M[i]))
        (crossQ (crossQ (slot M[jkk.1.1] jkk.1.2).n (slot M[jkk.1.1] jkk.2).n)
          (Proof.MeshIntersectJump.faceNormal M[i])) = 0
    · simp only [if_pos hz] at hf
      exact Option.noConfusion hf
    · simp only [if_neg hz] at hf
      obtain rfl := Option.some.inj hf
      exact ⟨ne_zero_of_dotQ hz, dotQ_crossQ_self_right _ _⟩

name: admPair_exists_avoiding
statement:
theorem admPair_exists_avoiding (M : Mesh) (hnpo : NoPlaneThroughOrigin M)
    (i : Fin M.size) (s : ℤ) (hs : s = 1 ∨ s = -1) (Φ : List (Point × ℚ))
    (hΦ : ∀ φ ∈ Φ, φ.1 ≠ 0) :
    ∃ x, AdmPt M i s x ∧ ∀ φ ∈ Φ, dotQ φ.1 x ≠ φ.2
proof:
:= by
  have hdet : detOrigin M[i] ≠ 0 := hnpo i
  have hs1 : |(s : ℚ)| = 1 := by rcases hs with rfl | rfl <;> norm_num
  have hs2 : (s : ℚ) * (s : ℚ) = 1 := by rcases hs with rfl | rfl <;> norm_num
  have hsQ : (s : ℚ) ≠ 0 := by rcases hs with rfl | rfl <;> norm_num
  set nrm : Point := Proof.MeshIntersectJump.faceNormal M[i] with hnrm
  have hn : nrm ≠ 0 := by
    rw [hnrm]
    exact ne_zero_of_dotQ (u := M[i].v₀) (by rw [faceNormal_offset]; exact hdet)
  
  have hHs : ∀ h ∈ exAll M i Φ, dotQ h.1 (psub M[i].v₁ M[i].v₀) ≠ 0 ∨
      dotQ h.1 (psub M[i].v₂ M[i].v₀) ≠ 0 ∨ dotQ h.1 (curveAt M[i] 0) ≠ h.2 := by
    intro h hmem
    obtain ⟨hne, hp⟩ := exAll_perp hnpo hΦ h hmem
    rcases perp_normal_nondegen hdet hne hp with h1 | h2
    · exact Or.inl h1
    · exact Or.inr (Or.inl h2)
  obtain ⟨c, hcT, hcE, -, -, hcH⟩ := relint_pick M hnpo i [] [] (exAll M i Φ) hHs
  
  have hAc : ∀ (j : Fin M.size) (k : Fin 4),
      dotQ (slot M[j] k).n nrm = 0 → (slot M[j] k).eval c ≠ 0 := by
    intro j k hz
    have hne := hcH _ (exA_mem Φ j k (by rw [← hnrm]; exact hz))
    simp only [Half.eval]
    exact sub_ne_zero.mpr hne
  
  set R : List ℚ := ((List.finRange M.size).product (List.finRange 4)).filterMap
    (fun jk =>
      if dotQ (slot M[jk.1] jk.2).n nrm ≠ 0 ∧ (slot M[jk.1] jk.2).eval c ≠ 0
      then some |(slot M[jk.1] jk.2).eval c / dotQ (slot M[jk.1] jk.2).n nrm|
      else none) with hRdef
  have hRpos : ∀ r ∈ R, 0 < r := by
    intro r hr
    rw [hRdef] at hr
    obtain ⟨jk, -, hf⟩ := List.mem_filterMap.mp hr
    by_cases hcond : dotQ (slot M[jk.1] jk.2).n nrm ≠ 0 ∧
        (slot M[jk.1] jk.2).eval c ≠ 0
    · simp only [if_pos hcond] at hf
      obtain rfl := Option.some.inj hf
      exact abs_pos.mpr (div_ne_zero hcond.2 hcond.1)
    · simp only [if_neg hcond] at hf
      exact Option.noConfusion hf
  have hbound : ∀ (j : Fin M.size) (k : Fin 4),
      dotQ (slot M[j] k).n nrm ≠ 0 → (slot M[j] k).eval c ≠ 0 →
      R.foldr min 1 ≤ |(slot M[j] k).eval c / dotQ (slot M[j] k).n nrm| := by
    intro j k h1 h2
    refine foldr_min_le ?_ 1
    rw [hRdef]
    refine List.mem_filterMap.mpr ⟨(j, k),
      List.pair_mem_product.mpr ⟨List.mem_finRange j, List.mem_finRange k⟩, ?_⟩
    show (if dotQ (slot M[j] k).n nrm ≠ 0 ∧ (slot M[j] k).eval c ≠ 0
        then some |(slot M[j] k).eval c / dotQ (slot M[j] k).n nrm| else none)
      = some |(slot M[j] k).eval c / dotQ (slot M[j] k).n nrm|
    rw [if_pos ⟨h1, h2⟩]
  have hmpos : 0 < R.foldr min 1 := foldr_min_pos hRpos one_pos
  
  obtain ⟨δ, hδ0, hδm, hδΦ⟩ := exists_pos_lt_avoiding hmpos
    (Φ.filterMap (fun φ => if dotQ φ.1 nrm = 0 then none
      else some ((s : ℚ) * ((φ.2 - dotQ φ.1 c) / dotQ φ.1 nrm))))
  
  have htrace : ∀ (j : Fin M.size) (k : Fin 4) (γ : ℚ), |γ| ≤ δ →
      (γ ≠ 0 ∨ (slot M[j] k).eval c ≠ 0) →
      (slot M[j] k).eval (lineAt c nrm γ) ≠ 0 := by
    intro j k γ hγ hor
    rw [eval_lineAt]
    by_cases hz : dotQ (slot M[j] k).n nrm = 0
    · rw [hz, mul_zero, add_zero]
      exact hAc j k hz
    · by_cases hc0 : (slot M[j] k).eval c = 0
      · rw [hc0, zero_add]
        exact mul_ne_zero (hor.resolve_right (fun hcon => hcon hc0)) hz
      · intro heq
        have hb := hbound j k hz hc0
        rw [show (slot M[j] k).eval c = -(γ * dotQ (slot M[j] k).n nrm) from
            by linarith, neg_div, abs_neg, mul_div_assoc, div_self hz,
          mul_one] at hb
        linarith [hγ, hδm, hb]
  
  set x : Point := lineAt c nrm (δ * (s : ℚ)) with hx
  set y : Point := lineAt c nrm (-(δ * (s : ℚ))) with hy
  have hseg : ∀ τ : ℚ, seg x y τ = lineAt c nrm ((1 - 2*τ) * (δ * (s : ℚ))) := by
    intro τ
    funext kk
    rw [hx, hy]
    simp only [seg, lineAt]
    ring
  have habs_ds : |δ * (s : ℚ)| = δ := by
    rw [abs_mul, hs1, mul_one, abs_of_pos hδ0]
  have habs : ∀ τ : ℚ, 0 < τ → τ < 1 → |(1 - 2*τ) * (δ * (s : ℚ))| ≤ δ := by
    intro τ h0 h1
    rw [abs_mul, habs_ds]
    have h12 : |1 - 2*τ| ≤ 1 := by rw [abs_le]; constructor <;> linarith
    nlinarith [abs_nonneg (1 - 2*τ)]
  have hG1 : ∀ γ : ℚ, |γ| ≤ δ → γ ≠ 0 → G1Clean M (lineAt c nrm γ) := by
    intro γ hγ hγ0 j g hg
    obtain ⟨k, rfl⟩ := mem_tetraHalves_iff.mp hg
    exact htrace j k γ hγ (Or.inl hγ0)
  have hfoot : seg x y (1/2 : ℚ) = c := by
    rw [hseg, show (1 - 2*(1/2 : ℚ)) * (δ * (s : ℚ)) = 0 from by ring, lineAt_zero]
  
  have hH1 : ∀ (j : Fin M.size) (τ : ℚ), 0 < τ → τ < 1 → τ ≠ 1/2 →
      seg x y τ ∉ triangleSet M[j] := by
    intro j τ h0 h1 hτ hmem
    have hzero : (slot M[j] 3).eval (seg x y τ) = 0 := by
      rw [slot3_eval (hnpo j), triangleSet_on_carrier hmem]; ring
    rw [hseg τ] at hzero
    have h2τ : (1 : ℚ) - 2*τ ≠ 0 := fun h => hτ (by linarith)
    exact htrace j 3 _ (habs τ h0 h1)
      (Or.inl (mul_ne_zero h2τ (mul_ne_zero (ne_of_gt hδ0) hsQ))) hzero
  
  have hG2 : ∀ (j : Fin M.size), ∀ g ∈ tetraHalves M[j], ∀ g' ∈ tetraHalves M[j],
      g ≠ g' → ∀ τ : ℚ, 0 < τ → τ < 1 →
      ¬ (g.eval (seg x y τ) = 0 ∧ g'.eval (seg x y τ) = 0) := by
    rintro j g hg g' hg' hne τ h0 h1 ⟨hgz, hgz'⟩
    rw [hseg τ] at hgz hgz'
    by_cases hu : crossQ g.n g'.n = 0
    · 
      have hb := eq_smul_of_crossQ_zero (facet_n_ne_zero (hnpo j) g hg) hu
      set κ : ℚ := dotQ g.n g'.n / dotQ g.n g.n with hκ
      have hap : dotQ g.n (lineAt c nrm ((1 - 2*τ) * (δ * (s : ℚ)))) = g.c := by
        simp only [Half.eval] at hgz; linarith
      have hbp : dotQ g'.n (lineAt c nrm ((1 - 2*τ) * (δ * (s : ℚ)))) = g'.c := by
        simp only [Half.eval] at hgz'; linarith
      have hκc : g'.c = κ * g.c := by
        rw [← hbp, hb, dotQ_smul_left, hap]
      exact tetraHalves_not_proportional (hnpo j) hg hg' hne κ
        (fun z => by
          simp only [Half.eval]
          rw [hb, dotQ_smul_left, hκc]
          ring)
    · by_cases hν : crossQ (crossQ g.n g'.n) (Proof.MeshIntersectJump.faceNormal M[i]) = 0
      · 
        have hperpa : dotQ g.n nrm = 0 := by
          rw [hnrm, eq_smul_of_crossQ_zero hu hν, dotQ_smul_right,
            dotQ_comm g.n (crossQ g.n g'.n), dotQ_crossQ_self_left, mul_zero]
        obtain ⟨k, rfl⟩ := mem_tetraHalves_iff.mp hg
        exact htrace j k _ (habs τ h0 h1) (Or.inr (hAc j k hperpa)) hgz
      · 
        obtain ⟨k, rfl⟩ := mem_tetraHalves_iff.mp hg
        obtain ⟨k', rfl⟩ := mem_tetraHalves_iff.mp hg'
        refine absurd ?_ (hcH _ (exB_mem Φ j k k' hν))
        show dotQ (crossQ (crossQ (slot M[j] k).n (slot M[j] k').n)
            (Proof.MeshIntersectJump.faceNormal M[i])) c
          = dotQ (slot M[j] k).n (Proof.MeshIntersectJump.faceNormal M[i]) * (slot M[j] k').c
            - dotQ (slot M[j] k').n (Proof.MeshIntersectJump.faceNormal M[i]) * (slot M[j] k).c
        have hap : dotQ (slot M[j] k).n
            (lineAt c nrm ((1 - 2*τ) * (δ * (s : ℚ)))) = (slot M[j] k).c := by
          simp only [Half.eval] at hgz; linarith
        have hbp : dotQ (slot M[j] k').n
            (lineAt c nrm ((1 - 2*τ) * (δ * (s : ℚ)))) = (slot M[j] k').c := by
          simp only [Half.eval] at hgz'; linarith
        have hνn : dotQ (crossQ (crossQ (slot M[j] k).n (slot M[j] k').n)
            (Proof.MeshIntersectJump.faceNormal M[i])) nrm = 0 := by
          rw [hnrm]
          exact dotQ_crossQ_self_right _ _
        have hconst : dotQ (crossQ (crossQ (slot M[j] k).n (slot M[j] k').n)
              (Proof.MeshIntersectJump.faceNormal M[i])) (lineAt c nrm ((1 - 2*τ) * (δ * (s : ℚ))))
            = dotQ (crossQ (crossQ (slot M[j] k).n (slot M[j] k').n)
              (Proof.MeshIntersectJump.faceNormal M[i])) c := by
          rw [dotQ_lineAt, hνn, mul_zero, add_zero]
        rw [← hconst, dotQ_double_cross, hap, hbp]
  
  have hcc : dotQ nrm c = detOrigin M[i] := by
    rw [hnrm]
    exact triangleSet_on_carrier hcT
  have hside : sideOf M[i] x = s := by
    have hval : dotQ (Proof.MeshIntersectJump.faceNormal M[i]) x - detOrigin M[i]
        = δ * (s : ℚ) * dotQ nrm nrm := by
      rw [← hnrm, hx, dotQ_lineAt, hcc]; ring
    unfold sideOf
    rw [hval]
    have hnn : (0 : ℚ) < dotQ nrm nrm := dotQ_self_pos hn
    rcases hs with rfl | rfl
    · push_cast
      exact qsign_of_pos (by nlinarith)
    · push_cast
      exact qsign_of_neg (by nlinarith)
  
  have hΦx : ∀ φ ∈ Φ, dotQ φ.1 x ≠ φ.2 := by
    intro φ hφ
    by_cases hz : dotQ φ.1 nrm = 0
    · have hne := hcH _ (exC_mem hφ (by rw [← hnrm]; exact hz))
      rw [hx, dotQ_lineAt, hz, mul_zero, add_zero]
      exact hne
    · intro heq
      rw [hx, dotQ_lineAt] at heq
      refine absurd ?_ (hδΦ ((s : ℚ) * ((φ.2 - dotQ φ.1 c) / dotQ φ.1 nrm))
        (List.mem_filterMap.mpr ⟨φ, hφ, ?_⟩))
      · show δ = (s : ℚ) * ((φ.2 - dotQ φ.1 c) / dotQ φ.1 nrm)
        rw [show φ.2 - dotQ φ.1 c = δ * (s : ℚ) * dotQ φ.1 nrm from by linarith,
          mul_div_assoc, div_self hz, mul_one,
          show (s : ℚ) * (δ * (s : ℚ)) = δ * ((s : ℚ) * (s : ℚ)) from by ring,
          hs2, mul_one]
      · show (if dotQ φ.1 nrm = 0 then none
            else some ((s : ℚ) * ((φ.2 - dotQ φ.1 c) / dotQ φ.1 nrm)))
          = some ((s : ℚ) * ((φ.2 - dotQ φ.1 c) / dotQ φ.1 nrm))
        rw [if_neg hz]
  
  refine ⟨x, ⟨y, 1/2, ⟨by norm_num, by norm_num, ?_, ?_, hH1, ?_, ?_, hG2⟩,
    hside⟩, hΦx⟩
  · rw [hfoot]; exact hcT
  · rw [hfoot]; exact hcE
  · rw [hx]
    exact hG1 _ (le_of_eq habs_ds) (mul_ne_zero (ne_of_gt hδ0) hsQ)
  · rw [hy]
    exact hG1 _ (by rw [abs_neg]; exact le_of_eq habs_ds)
      (neg_ne_zero.mpr (mul_ne_zero (ne_of_gt hδ0) hsQ))

name: germValue_eq
proof:
:= by
  have hex : ∃ x, AdmPt M i s x := ⟨x, hx⟩
  rw [germValue, dif_pos hex]
  exact germ_const M hcyc hnpo hns i s hex.choose_spec hx

name: foldl_acc_shift
statement:
theorem foldl_acc_shift {α β} (mapf : β → β) (F F' : β → α → β)
    (h : ∀ acc a, F' (mapf acc) a = mapf (F acc a)) :
    ∀ (l : List α) (init : β), l.foldl F' (mapf init) = mapf (l.foldl F init)
  | [], init => rfl
  | a :: l, init => by
      simp only [List.foldl_cons]
      rw [h init a]
      exact foldl_acc_shift mapf F F' h l (F init a)

/

name: forall2_imp_left_mem
statement:
theorem forall2_imp_left_mem {α} {R : α → α → Prop} {P : α → Prop} (hR : ∀ a b, R a b → P a) :
    ∀ {l l' : List α}, List.Forall₂ R l l' → ∀ a ∈ l, P a
  | _, _, List.Forall₂.nil, a, ha => absurd ha (List.not_mem_nil a)
  | _, _, List.Forall₂.cons hab htl, a, ha => by
      rcases List.mem_cons.mp ha with rfl | h
      · exact hR _ _ hab
      · exact forall2_imp_left_mem hR htl a h

/-! ## 1. `setPlane` commutes through `coplanarClip`'s first argument -/

name: sideOf_setPlane
statement: theorem sideOf_setPlane (g p : IPlane) (f : Frag) : sideOf g (setPlane p f) = sideOf g f
proof:
:= by
  simp only [sideOf, setPlane_poly]

name: clipBySide_setPlane
statement:
theorem clipBySide_setPlane (g p : IPlane) (f : Frag) :
    clipBySide g (setPlane p f) = mapPair (setPlane p) (clipBySide g f)
proof:
:= by
  rw [clipBySide_eq, clipBySide_eq, clipFrag_setPlane g p f,
      ← Array.foldl_toList, ← Array.foldl_toList, Array.toList_map]
  have hl : ∀ piece ∈ (clipFrag g f).toList, sideOf g (setPlane p piece) = sideOf g piece :=
    fun piece _ => sideOf_setPlane g p piece
  have key := foldl_partStep_mem (setPlane p) (sideOf g) (sideOf g) (clipFrag g f).toList hl (#[], #[])
  simpa using key

name: innerStep_setPlane
statement:
theorem innerStep_setPlane (g p : IPlane) (st : Array Frag × Array Frag) (piece : Frag) :
    innerStep g (mapPair (setPlane p) st) (setPlane p piece)
    = mapPair (setPlane p) (innerStep g st piece)
proof:
:= by
  simp only [innerStep, mapPair, clipBySide_setPlane, array_map_append]

name: copStep_setPlane
statement:
theorem copStep_setPlane (p : IPlane) (acc : Array Frag × Array Frag) (g : IPlane) :
    copStep (mapPair (setPlane p) acc) g = mapPair (setPlane p) (copStep acc g)
proof:
:= by
  have hstepFold : (acc.1.map (setPlane p)).foldl (innerStep g) (#[], #[])
      = mapPair (setPlane p) (acc.1.foldl (innerStep g) (#[], #[])) := by
    rw [← Array.foldl_toList, ← Array.foldl_toList, Array.toList_map]
    have key := foldl_map_fusion_memS (setPlane p) (mapPair (setPlane p)) (innerStep g) (innerStep g)
      (fun _ => True) (fun acc0 piece _ => innerStep_setPlane g p acc0 piece) acc.1.toList
      (fun _ _ => trivial) (#[], #[])
    simpa using key
  simp only [copStep, mapPair, hstepFold]
  simp [mapPair, array_map_append]

name: coplanarClip_setPlane_left
statement:
theorem coplanarClip_setPlane_left (p : IPlane) (fa fb : Frag) :
    coplanarClip (setPlane p fa) fb = mapPair (setPlane p) (coplanarClip fa fb)
proof:
:= by
  rw [coplanarClip_eq, coplanarClip_eq, ← Array.foldl_toList, ← Array.foldl_toList]
  have hinit : ((#[setPlane p fa], #[]) : Array Frag × Array Frag)
      = mapPair (setPlane p) (#[fa], #[]) := by simp [mapPair]
  rw [hinit]
  exact foldl_acc_shift (mapPair (setPlane p)) copStep copStep
    (fun acc g => copStep_setPlane p acc g) (edgePlanesOf fb).toList (#[fa], #[])

name: clipBySide_plane_mem
statement:
theorem clipBySide_plane_mem (g : IPlane) (f : Frag) (p : IPlane) (hp : f.plane = p) :
    (∀ x ∈ (clipBySide g f).1, x.plane = p) ∧ (∀ x ∈ (clipBySide g f).2, x.plane = p)
proof:
:= by
  rw [clipBySide_eq, ← Array.foldl_toList]
  refine foldl_inv (fun st => (∀ x ∈ st.1, x.plane = p) ∧ (∀ x ∈ st.2, x.plane = p))
    (partStep (sideOf g)) (clipFrag g f).toList (#[], #[]) ⟨by simp, by simp⟩ ?_
  intro st ⟨hP1, hP2⟩ piece hpiece
  have hpp : piece.plane = p := by
    rw [clipFrag_plane_mem g f piece (Array.mem_toList.mp hpiece), hp]
  simp only [partStep]
  split
  · refine ⟨fun x hx => ?_, hP2⟩
    rcases Array.mem_push.mp hx with h | h
    · exact hP1 x h
    · exact h ▸ hpp
  · refine ⟨hP1, fun x hx => ?_⟩
    rcases Array.mem_push.mp hx with h | h
    · exact hP2 x h
    · exact h ▸ hpp

name: innerStep_plane_mem
statement:
theorem innerStep_plane_mem (g : IPlane) (p : IPlane) (st : Array Frag × Array Frag)
    (hst : (∀ x ∈ st.1, x.plane = p) ∧ (∀ x ∈ st.2, x.plane = p))
    (piece : Frag) (hpiece : piece.plane = p) :
    (∀ x ∈ (innerStep g st piece).1, x.plane = p) ∧ (∀ x ∈ (innerStep g st piece).2, x.plane = p)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨hc1, hc2⟩ := clipBySide_plane_mem g piece p hpiece
  refine ⟨fun x hx => ?_, fun x hx => ?_⟩
  · rcases Array.mem_append.mp hx with h | h
    · exact hst.1 x h
    · exact hc1 x h
  · rcases Array.mem_append.mp hx with h | h
    · exact hst.2 x h
    · exact hc2 x h

name: innerFold_plane_mem
statement:
theorem innerFold_plane_mem (g : IPlane) (p : IPlane) (inside : Array Frag)
    (hin : ∀ x ∈ inside, x.plane = p) :
    (∀ x ∈ (inside.foldl (innerStep g) (#[], #[])).1, x.plane = p)
    ∧ (∀ x ∈ (inside.foldl (innerStep g) (#[], #[])).2, x.plane = p)
proof:
:= by
  rw [← Array.foldl_toList]
  refine foldl_inv (fun st => (∀ x ∈ st.1, x.plane = p) ∧ (∀ x ∈ st.2, x.plane = p))
    (innerStep g) inside.toList (#[], #[]) ⟨by simp, by simp⟩ ?_
  intro st hst piece hpiece
  exact innerStep_plane_mem g p st hst piece (hin piece (Array.mem_toList.mp hpiece))

name: copStep_plane_mem
statement:
theorem copStep_plane_mem (p : IPlane) (acc : Array Frag × Array Frag) (g : IPlane)
    (hacc : (∀ x ∈ acc.1, x.plane = p) ∧ (∀ x ∈ acc.2, x.plane = p)) :
    (∀ x ∈ (copStep acc g).1, x.plane = p) ∧ (∀ x ∈ (copStep acc g).2, x.plane = p)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨h1, h2⟩ := innerFold_plane_mem g p acc.1 hacc.1
  refine ⟨h1, fun x hx => ?_⟩
  simp only [copStep] at hx
  rcases Array.mem_append.mp hx with h | h
  · exact hacc.2 x h
  · exact h2 x h

name: coplanarClip_plane_mem
statement:
theorem coplanarClip_plane_mem (fa fb : Frag) :
    (∀ x ∈ (coplanarClip fa fb).1, x.plane = fa.plane)
    ∧ (∀ x ∈ (coplanarClip fa fb).2, x.plane = fa.plane)
proof:
:= by
  rw [coplanarClip_eq, ← Array.foldl_toList]
  refine foldl_inv (fun st => (∀ x ∈ st.1, x.plane = fa.plane) ∧ (∀ x ∈ st.2, x.plane = fa.plane))
    copStep (edgePlanesOf fb).toList (#[fa], #[]) ⟨?_, by simp⟩ ?_
  · intro x hx; rw [Array.mem_def] at hx; fin_cases hx; rfl
  · intro st hst g _
    exact copStep_plane_mem fa.plane st g hst

name: copStep_faithful_both
statement:
theorem copStep_faithful_both (acc : Array Frag × Array Frag) (g : IPlane)
    (hacc : (∀ x ∈ acc.1, FragFaithful x) ∧ (∀ x ∈ acc.2, FragFaithful x)) :
    (∀ x ∈ (copStep acc g).1, FragFaithful x) ∧ (∀ x ∈ (copStep acc g).2, FragFaithful x)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨h1, h2⟩ := innerFold_faithful g acc.1 hacc.1
  refine ⟨h1, fun x hx => ?_⟩
  simp only [copStep] at hx
  rcases Array.mem_append.mp hx with h | h
  · exact hacc.2 x h
  · exact h2 x h

name: coplanarClip_faithful
statement:
theorem coplanarClip_faithful (fa fb : Frag) (hfa : FragFaithful fa) :
    (∀ x ∈ (coplanarClip fa fb).1, FragFaithful x)
    ∧ (∀ x ∈ (coplanarClip fa fb).2, FragFaithful x)
proof:
:= by
  rw [coplanarClip_eq, ← Array.foldl_toList]
  refine foldl_inv (fun st => (∀ x ∈ st.1, FragFaithful x) ∧ (∀ x ∈ st.2, FragFaithful x))
    copStep (edgePlanesOf fb).toList (#[fa], #[]) ⟨?_, by simp⟩ ?_
  · intro x hx; rw [Array.mem_def] at hx; fin_cases hx; exact hfa
  · intro st hst g _
    exact copStep_faithful_both st g hst

name: sfTr_poly
statement:
@[simp] theorem sfTr_poly (o : P3) (P' : IPlane) (f : Frag) :
    (sfTr o P' f).poly = f.poly.map (trVtx o)
proof: := rfl

name: sfTr_plane
statement: @[simp] theorem sfTr_plane (o : P3) (P' : IPlane) (f : Frag) : (sfTr o P' f).plane = P'
proof: := rfl

name: sfTr_size
statement:
@[simp] theorem sfTr_size (o : P3) (P' : IPlane) (f : Frag) :
    (sfTr o P' f).poly.size = f.poly.size
proof: := by rw [sfTr_poly, Array.size_map]

name: mapPair_comp2
statement:
theorem mapPair_comp2 (f g : Frag → Frag) (p : Array Frag × Array Frag) :
    mapPair f (mapPair g p) = mapPair (fun x => f (g x)) p
proof:
:= by
  simp only [mapPair, Array.map_map, Function.comp_def]

name: map_isEmpty
statement: theorem map_isEmpty (φ : Frag → Frag) (X : Array Frag) : (X.map φ).isEmpty = X.isEmpty
proof:
:= by
  show ((X.map φ).size == 0) = (X.size == 0)
  rw [Array.size_map]

name: sfTr_fragSeam
statement:
theorem sfTr_fragSeam (o : P3) (P' : IPlane) (fa k : Frag)
    (hk : k.plane = fa.plane) (hfaP : PlaneSeam o fa.plane P') :
    FragSeam o k (sfTr o P' k)
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨rfl, ?_⟩
  rw [sfTr_plane, hk]
  exact hfaP

name: resolveFrag_eq
statement:
theorem resolveFrag_eq (bvh : Impl.BVH.BVH) (fa : Frag) (opp : Array Frag) (wOpp : Array PFace) :
    resolveFrag bvh fa opp wOpp
    = (let st := opp.foldl (rOuter fa) (#[], #[fa]);
       st.1 ++ st.2.filter (fun p => keepFallback bvh wOpp p))
proof: := rfl

name: pushGuard_map
statement:
theorem pushGuard_map (o : P3) (P' : IPlane) (pd : Array Frag) (p : Frag) :
    pushGuard (pd.map (sfTr o P')) (sfTr o P' p) = (pushGuard pd p).map (sfTr o P')
proof:
:= by
  simp only [pushGuard, sfTr_size]
  split <;> simp [Array.map_push]

name: foldl_pushGuard_map
statement:
theorem foldl_pushGuard_map (o : P3) (P' : IPlane) (comp : Array Frag) (pending : Array Frag) :
    (comp.map (sfTr o P')).foldl pushGuard (pending.map (sfTr o P'))
    = (comp.foldl pushGuard pending).map (sfTr o P')
proof:
:= by
  rw [← Array.foldl_toList, ← Array.foldl_toList, Array.toList_map]
  exact foldl_map_fusion_memS (sfTr o P') (Array.map (sfTr o P')) pushGuard pushGuard
    (fun _ => True) (fun pd p _ => pushGuard_map o P' pd p) comp.toList (fun _ _ => trivial) pending

name: rInner_map
statement:
theorem rInner_map (o : P3) (P' : IPlane) (fa fb fb' : Frag)
    (hfaP : PlaneSeam o fa.plane P') (hfb : FragSeam o fb fb') (hfbf : FragFaithful fb)
    (st : Array Frag × Array Frag) (piece : Frag) (hpf : FragFaithful piece) :
    rInner (sfTr o P' fa) fb' (mapPair (sfTr o P') st) (sfTr o P' piece)
    = mapPair (sfTr o P') (rInner fa fb st piece)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨kept, pending⟩ := st
  obtain ⟨μ, hμ, hn⟩ := planeNrm_seam o fb.plane fb'.plane hfb.2
  have hcc : coplanarClip (sfTr o P' piece) fb'
      = mapPair (sfTr o P') (coplanarClip piece fb) := by
    rw [sfTr, coplanarClip_setPlane_left,
        coplanarClip_ss o piece fb fb' hpf hfbf μ hμ
          (by rw [carrierNormalP_eq, carrierNormalP_eq]; exact hn) hfb.1, mapPair_comp2]
    rfl
  have hsame : sameOrient (sfTr o P' fa).plane fb'.plane = sameOrient fa.plane fb.plane := by
    rw [sfTr_plane]
    exact sameOrient_seam o fa.plane P' fb.plane fb'.plane hfaP hfb.2
  have hfilter : ((coplanarClip piece fb).1.map (sfTr o P')).filter (fun p => p.poly.size ≥ 3)
      = ((coplanarClip piece fb).1.filter (fun p => p.poly.size ≥ 3)).map (sfTr o P') := by
    apply filter_map_congr
    intro x _; simp only [sfTr_size]
  simp only [rInner, mapPair, hcc]
  rw [hfilter, map_isEmpty, hsame]
  split
  · simp [Array.map_push]
  · rw [foldl_pushGuard_map]
    split <;> simp [array_map_append]

name: foldl_pushGuard_pend
statement:
theorem foldl_pushGuard_pend (comp : Array Frag) (pending : Array Frag)
    (hcf : ∀ x ∈ comp, FragFaithful x)
    (hpf : ∀ x ∈ pending, FragFaithful x) (hps : ∀ x ∈ pending, 0 < x.poly.size) :
    (∀ x ∈ comp.foldl pushGuard pending, FragFaithful x)
    ∧ (∀ x ∈ comp.foldl pushGuard pending, 0 < x.poly.size)
proof:
:= by
  rw [← Array.foldl_toList]
  refine foldl_inv (fun pd => (∀ x ∈ pd, FragFaithful x) ∧ (∀ x ∈ pd, 0 < x.poly.size))
    pushGuard comp.toList pending ⟨hpf, hps⟩ ?_
  intro pd ⟨hpdf, hpds⟩ p hp
  have hpfait : FragFaithful p := hcf p (Array.mem_toList.mp hp)
  simp only [pushGuard]
  split
  · next hsz =>
      refine ⟨fun x hx => by rcases Array.mem_push.mp hx with h | h; exacts [hpdf x h, h ▸ hpfait],
             fun x hx => ?_⟩
      rcases Array.mem_push.mp hx with h | h
      · exact hpds x h
      · exact h ▸ (by omega : 0 < p.poly.size)
  · exact ⟨hpdf, hpds⟩

name: rInner_pend
statement:
theorem rInner_pend (fa fb : Frag) (st : Array Frag × Array Frag) (hst : PendInv st)
    (piece : Frag) (hpf : FragFaithful piece) (hps : 0 < piece.poly.size) :
    PendInv (rInner fa fb st piece)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨kept, pending⟩ := st
  obtain ⟨hf, hs⟩ := hst
  have hcomp := (coplanarClip_faithful piece fb hpf).2
  simp only [rInner, PendInv]
  split
  · exact ⟨fun x hx => by rcases Array.mem_push.mp hx with h | h; exacts [hf x h, h ▸ hpf],
           fun x hx => by rcases Array.mem_push.mp hx with h | h; exacts [hs x h, h ▸ hps]⟩
  · exact foldl_pushGuard_pend (coplanarClip piece fb).2 pending hcomp hf hs

name: rOuter_pend
statement:
theorem rOuter_pend (fa fb : Frag) (acc : Array Frag × Array Frag) (hacc : PendInv acc) :
    PendInv (rOuter fa acc fb)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨kept, pending⟩ := acc
  obtain ⟨hf, hs⟩ := hacc
  simp only [rOuter]
  split
  · exact ⟨hf, hs⟩
  · rw [← Array.foldl_toList]
    refine foldl_inv PendInv (rInner fa fb) pending.toList (kept, #[]) ⟨by simp, by simp⟩ ?_
    intro st hst piece hp
    exact rInner_pend fa fb st hst piece (hf piece (Array.mem_toList.mp hp))
      (hs piece (Array.mem_toList.mp hp))

name: rOuter_map
statement:
theorem rOuter_map (o : P3) (P' : IPlane) (fa fb fb' : Frag) (acc : Array Frag × Array Frag)
    (hfaP : PlaneSeam o fa.plane P') (hfb : FragSeam o fb fb') (hfbf : FragFaithful fb)
    (hInv : PendInv acc) :
    rOuter (sfTr o P' fa) (mapPair (sfTr o P') acc) fb'
    = mapPair (sfTr o P') (rOuter fa acc fb)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨kept, pending⟩ := acc
  obtain ⟨hf, _⟩ := hInv
  have hcop : coplanarPlane (sfTr o P' fa).plane fb'.plane = coplanarPlane fa.plane fb.plane := by
    rw [sfTr_plane]; exact coplanarPlane_seam o fa.plane P' fb.plane fb'.plane hfaP hfb.2
  have hLacc : mapPair (sfTr o P') (kept, pending)
      = (kept.map (sfTr o P'), pending.map (sfTr o P')) := by simp [mapPair]
  rw [hLacc]
  simp only [rOuter, hcop]
  split_ifs with hc
  · exact hLacc.symm
  · rw [← Array.foldl_toList, ← Array.foldl_toList, Array.toList_map]
    have hinit : ((kept.map (sfTr o P'), #[]) : Array Frag × Array Frag)
        = mapPair (sfTr o P') (kept, #[]) := by simp [mapPair]
    rw [hinit]
    exact foldl_map_fusion_memS (sfTr o P') (mapPair (sfTr o P')) (rInner fa fb)
      (rInner (sfTr o P' fa) fb') FragFaithful
      (fun st piece hpf => rInner_map o P' fa fb fb' hfaP hfb hfbf st piece hpf)
      pending.toList (fun p hp => hf p (Array.mem_toList.mp hp)) (kept, #[])

name: foldl_pushGuard_plane
statement:
theorem foldl_pushGuard_plane (P : IPlane) (comp pending : Array Frag)
    (hc : ∀ x ∈ comp, x.plane = P) (hp : ∀ x ∈ pending, x.plane = P) :
    ∀ x ∈ comp.foldl pushGuard pending, x.plane = P
proof:
:= by
  rw [← Array.foldl_toList]
  refine foldl_inv (fun pd => ∀ x ∈ pd, x.plane = P) pushGuard comp.toList pending hp ?_
  intro pd hpd p hp2
  simp only [pushGuard]
  split
  · intro x hx; rcases Array.mem_push.mp hx with h | h
    · exact hpd x h
    · exact h ▸ hc p (Array.mem_toList.mp hp2)
  · exact hpd

name: rInner_plane
statement:
theorem rInner_plane (fa fb : Frag) (st : Array Frag × Array Frag)
    (hst : PlaneInv fa.plane st) (piece : Frag) (hpp : piece.plane = fa.plane) :
    PlaneInv fa.plane (rInner fa fb st piece)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨kept, pending⟩ := st
  obtain ⟨hk, hp⟩ := hst
  have hcc1 : ∀ x ∈ (coplanarClip piece fb).1, x.plane = fa.plane := by
    intro x hx; rw [(coplanarClip_plane_mem piece fb).1 x hx, hpp]
  have hcc2 : ∀ x ∈ (coplanarClip piece fb).2, x.plane = fa.plane := by
    intro x hx; rw [(coplanarClip_plane_mem piece fb).2 x hx, hpp]
  simp only [rInner, PlaneInv]
  split
  · exact ⟨hk, fun x hx => by rcases Array.mem_push.mp hx with h | h; exacts [hp x h, h ▸ hpp]⟩
  · refine ⟨?_, foldl_pushGuard_plane fa.plane _ pending hcc2 hp⟩
    split
    · intro x hx; rcases Array.mem_append.mp hx with h | h
      · exact hk x h
      · exact hcc1 x (Array.mem_filter.mp h).1
    · exact hk

name: rOuter_plane
statement:
theorem rOuter_plane (fa fb : Frag) (acc : Array Frag × Array Frag)
    (hacc : PlaneInv fa.plane acc) : PlaneInv fa.plane (rOuter fa acc fb)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨kept, pending⟩ := acc
  obtain ⟨hk, hp⟩ := hacc
  simp only [rOuter]
  split
  · exact ⟨hk, hp⟩
  · rw [← Array.foldl_toList]
    refine foldl_inv (PlaneInv fa.plane) (rInner fa fb) pending.toList (kept, #[]) ⟨hk, by simp⟩ ?_
    intro st hst piece hpc
    exact rInner_plane fa fb st hst piece (hp piece (Array.mem_toList.mp hpc))

name: resolveFrag_plane_mem
statement:
theorem resolveFrag_plane_mem (bvh : Impl.BVH.BVH) (fa : Frag) (opp : Array Frag)
    (wOpp : Array PFace) : ∀ k ∈ resolveFrag bvh fa opp wOpp, k.plane = fa.plane
proof:
:= by
  have hst : PlaneInv fa.plane (opp.foldl (rOuter fa) (#[], #[fa])) := by
    rw [← Array.foldl_toList]
    refine foldl_inv (PlaneInv fa.plane) (rOuter fa) opp.toList (#[], #[fa])
      ⟨by simp, fun x hx => by rw [Array.mem_singleton] at hx; rw [hx]⟩ ?_
    intro st hst fb _; exact rOuter_plane fa fb st hst
  rw [resolveFrag_eq]
  intro k hk
  rw [Array.mem_append] at hk
  rcases hk with h | h
  · exact hst.1 k h
  · exact hst.2 k (Array.mem_filter.mp h).1

name: resolveFrag_st_pend
statement:
theorem resolveFrag_st_pend (fa : Frag) (opp : Array Frag)
    (hfa_faith : FragFaithful fa) (hfa_sz : 0 < fa.poly.size)
    (_hopp : ∀ f ∈ opp, FragFaithful f) :
    PendInv (opp.foldl (rOuter fa) (#[], #[fa]))
proof:
:= by
  rw [← Array.foldl_toList]
  refine foldl_inv PendInv (rOuter fa) opp.toList (#[], #[fa])
    ⟨fun x hx => by rw [Array.mem_singleton] at hx; exact hx ▸ hfa_faith,
     fun x hx => by rw [Array.mem_singleton] at hx; exact hx ▸ hfa_sz⟩ ?_
  intro st hst fb _; exact rOuter_pend fa fb st hst

name: resolveFrag_map
statement:
theorem resolveFrag_map (o : P3) (P' : IPlane) (fa : Frag) (opp opp' : Array Frag)
    {bvhW bvhW' : Impl.BVH.BVH} (wOpp : Array PFace) (hfaP : PlaneSeam o fa.plane P')
    (hfa_faith : FragFaithful fa) (hfa_sz : 0 < fa.poly.size)
    (hopp : List.Forall₂ (fun fb fb' => FragSeam o fb fb' ∧ FragFaithful fb) opp.toList opp'.toList)
    (hq : QSh o bvhW bvhW') (hW : Faithful wOpp) :
    resolveFrag bvhW' (sfTr o P' fa) opp' (wOpp.map (trPFace o))
    = (resolveFrag bvhW fa opp wOpp).map (sfTr o P')
proof:
:= by
  rw [resolveFrag_eq, resolveFrag_eq]
  have hoppf : ∀ f ∈ opp, FragFaithful f :=
    fun f hf => forall2_imp_left_mem
      (fun (a b : Frag) (hab : FragSeam o a b ∧ FragFaithful a) => hab.2) hopp f
      (Array.mem_toList.mpr hf)
  have hpend := resolveFrag_st_pend fa opp hfa_faith hfa_sz hoppf
  have hplane : PlaneInv fa.plane (opp.foldl (rOuter fa) (#[], #[fa])) := by
    rw [← Array.foldl_toList]
    refine foldl_inv (PlaneInv fa.plane) (rOuter fa) opp.toList (#[], #[fa])
      ⟨by simp, fun x hx => by rw [Array.mem_singleton] at hx; rw [hx]⟩ ?_
    intro st hst fb _; exact rOuter_plane fa fb st hst
  have hfold : opp'.foldl (rOuter (sfTr o P' fa)) (#[], #[sfTr o P' fa])
             = mapPair (sfTr o P') (opp.foldl (rOuter fa) (#[], #[fa])) := by
    rw [← Array.foldl_toList, ← Array.foldl_toList]
    have hinit : ((#[], #[sfTr o P' fa]) : Array Frag × Array Frag)
        = mapPair (sfTr o P') (#[], #[fa]) := by simp [mapPair]
    rw [hinit]
    exact foldl_fusion_inv (mapf := mapPair (sfTr o P')) (F := rOuter fa)
      (F' := rOuter (sfTr o P' fa)) (Inv := PendInv)
      (R := fun fb fb' => FragSeam o fb fb' ∧ FragFaithful fb)
      (fun a a' hR acc hI => rOuter_map o P' fa a a' acc hfaP hR.1 hR.2 hI)
      (fun a acc hI => rOuter_pend fa a acc hI) hopp (#[], #[fa])
      ⟨fun x hx => by rw [Array.mem_singleton] at hx; exact hx ▸ hfa_faith,
       fun x hx => by rw [Array.mem_singleton] at hx; exact hx ▸ hfa_sz⟩
  simp only [hfold, mapPair]
  rw [array_map_append]
  congr 1
  apply filter_map_congr
  intro x hx
  have hseam : FragSeam o x (sfTr o P' x) := sfTr_fragSeam o P' fa x (hplane.2 x hx) hfaP
  have hpos : 0 < x.poly.size := hpend.2 x hx
  exact keepFallback_seam o wOpp x (sfTr o P' x) hseam hpos (hpend.1 x hx) hq hW

name: resolveFrag_seam
statement:
theorem resolveFrag_seam (o : P3) (fa fa' : Frag) (opp opp' : Array Frag)
    {bvhW bvhW' : Impl.BVH.BVH} (wOpp : Array PFace)
    (hfa : FragSeam o fa fa') (hfa_faith : FragFaithful fa) (hfa_sz : 0 < fa.poly.size)
    (hopp : List.Forall₂ (fun fb fb' => FragSeam o fb fb' ∧ FragFaithful fb) opp.toList opp'.toList)
    (hq : QSh o bvhW bvhW') (hW : Faithful wOpp) :
    List.Forall₂ (FragSeam o) (resolveFrag bvhW fa opp wOpp).toList
      (resolveFrag bvhW' fa' opp' (wOpp.map (trPFace o))).toList
proof:
:= by
  have hfaP : PlaneSeam o fa.plane fa'.plane := hfa.2
  have hfa' : fa' = sfTr o fa'.plane fa := FragSeam.eq_setPlane hfa
  rw [hfa', resolveFrag_map o fa'.plane fa opp opp' wOpp hfaP hfa_faith hfa_sz hopp hq hW,
      Array.toList_map, List.forall₂_map_right_iff, List.forall₂_same]
  intro k hk
  exact sfTr_fragSeam o fa'.plane fa k
    (resolveFrag_plane_mem bvhW fa opp wOpp k (Array.mem_toList.mp hk)) hfaP

name: foldl_pminS_map
statement:
theorem foldl_pminS_map (o : P3) : ∀ (L : List Vtx) (s : P3),
    (L.map (trVtx o)).foldl (fun a v => pminS a v.p) (psubS s o)
    = psubS (L.foldl (fun a v => pminS a v.p) s) o
  | [], s => rfl
  | v :: L, s => by
      show (L.map (trVtx o)).foldl (fun a v => pminS a v.p) (pminS (psubS s o) (psubS v.p o)) = _
      rw [pminS_translate]; exact foldl_pminS_map o L (pminS s v.p)

name: foldl_pmaxS_map
statement:
theorem foldl_pmaxS_map (o : P3) : ∀ (L : List Vtx) (s : P3),
    (L.map (trVtx o)).foldl (fun a v => pmaxS a v.p) (psubS s o)
    = psubS (L.foldl (fun a v => pmaxS a v.p) s) o
  | [], s => rfl
  | v :: L, s => by
      show (L.map (trVtx o)).foldl (fun a v => pmaxS a v.p) (pmaxS (psubS s o) (psubS v.p o)) = _
      rw [pmaxS_translate]; exact foldl_pmaxS_map o L (pmaxS s v.p)

/

name: fragBox_seam
statement:
theorem fragBox_seam (o : P3) (f f' : Frag) (hs : FragSeam o f f') (hpos : 0 < f.poly.size) :
    fragBox f' = shBox o.x o.y o.z (fragBox f)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨hpoly, _⟩ := hs
  have hv0 : ((f.poly.map (trVtx o)).getD 0 default).p = psubS (f.poly.getD 0 default).p o := by
    rw [map_getD_lt (trVtx o) f.poly 0 hpos default default]; rfl
  have hlo : f'.poly.foldl (fun a v => pminS a v.p) (f'.poly.getD 0 default).p
      = psubS (f.poly.foldl (fun a v => pminS a v.p) (f.poly.getD 0 default).p) o := by
    rw [hpoly, hv0, ← Array.foldl_toList, ← Array.foldl_toList, Array.toList_map]
    exact foldl_pminS_map o f.poly.toList (f.poly.getD 0 default).p
  have hhi : f'.poly.foldl (fun a v => pmaxS a v.p) (f'.poly.getD 0 default).p
      = psubS (f.poly.foldl (fun a v => pmaxS a v.p) (f.poly.getD 0 default).p) o := by
    rw [hpoly, hv0, ← Array.foldl_toList, ← Array.foldl_toList, Array.toList_map]
    exact foldl_pmaxS_map o f.poly.toList (f.poly.getD 0 default).p
  simp only [fragBox, hlo, hhi, shBox, psubS]

name: forall2_map_eq
statement:
theorem forall2_map_eq {α β} (S : α → α → Prop) (g g' : α → β)
    (hg : ∀ a a', S a a' → g' a' = g a) :
    ∀ {l l' : List α}, List.Forall₂ S l l' → l'.map g' = l.map g
  | _, _, List.Forall₂.nil => rfl
  | _, _, List.Forall₂.cons hab htl => by
      simp only [List.map_cons]; rw [hg _ _ hab, forall2_map_eq S g g' hg htl]

/

name: forall2_fragBox_map
statement:
theorem forall2_fragBox_map (o : P3) (L L' : Array Frag)
    (h : List.Forall₂ (RCop o) L.toList L'.toList) :
    L'.map fragBox = (L.map fragBox).map (shBox o.x o.y o.z)
proof:
:= by
  apply Array.ext'
  rw [Array.toList_map, Array.toList_map, Array.toList_map, List.map_map]
  exact forall2_map_eq (RCop o) (shBox o.x o.y o.z ∘ fragBox) fragBox
    (fun f f' hff => fragBox_seam o f f' hff.1 hff.2.2) h

name: boxQuery_copBVH_seam
statement:
theorem boxQuery_copBVH_seam (o : P3) (opp opp' : Array Frag) (fa fa' : Frag)
    (hopp : List.Forall₂ (RCop o) opp.toList opp'.toList)
    (hfa : FragSeam o fa fa') (hfaSz : 0 < fa.poly.size) :
    Impl.BVH.boxQuery (copBVH opp') (fragBox fa') = Impl.BVH.boxQuery (copBVH opp) (fragBox fa)
proof:
:= by
  unfold copBVH
  rw [forall2_fragBox_map o opp opp' hopp, fragBox_seam o fa fa' hfa hfaSz]
  exact boxQuery_buildBVHM_sh (opp.map fragBox) o.x o.y o.z (fragBox fa)

name: forall2_getElem
statement:
theorem forall2_getElem {R : Frag → Frag → Prop} :
    ∀ {l l' : List Frag}, List.Forall₂ R l l' → ∀ i (hi : i < l.length) (hi' : i < l'.length),
      R l[i] l'[i]
  | _, _, List.Forall₂.nil, i, hi, _ => absurd hi (Nat.not_lt_zero i)
  | _, _, List.Forall₂.cons hab _, 0, _, _ => hab
  | _, _, List.Forall₂.cons _ htl, i + 1, hi, hi' =>
      forall2_getElem htl i (by simpa using hi) (by simpa using hi')

/

name: resolveFragNear_seam
statement:
theorem resolveFragNear_seam (o : P3) (copB copB' : Array Frag) (fa fa' : Frag)
    {bvhW bvhW' : Impl.BVH.BVH} (wB : Array PFace)
    (hopp : List.Forall₂ (RCop o) copB.toList copB'.toList)
    (hfa : FragSeam o fa fa') (hfa_faith : FragFaithful fa) (hfa_sz : 0 < fa.poly.size)
    (hq : QSh o bvhW bvhW') (hW : Faithful wB) :
    List.Forall₂ (FragSeam o)
      (resolveFragNear (copBVH copB) bvhW copB fa wB).toList
      (resolveFragNear (copBVH copB') bvhW' copB' fa' (wB.map (trPFace o))).toList
proof:
:= by
  unfold resolveFragNear
  rw [boxQuery_copBVH_seam o copB copB' fa fa' hopp hfa hfa_sz]
  set near := sortAscN (Impl.BVH.boxQuery (copBVH copB) (fragBox fa))
  have hsz : copB.size = copB'.size := by
    have := List.Forall₂.length_eq hopp; rwa [Array.length_toList, Array.length_toList] at this
  refine resolveFrag_seam o fa fa' _ _ wB hfa hfa_faith hfa_sz ?_ hq hW
  rw [arr_filterMap_toList, arr_filterMap_toList]
  apply list_filterMap_forall₂
  intro i _
  by_cases hi : i < copB.size
  · have hi' : i < copB'.size := hsz ▸ hi
    have hrel : RCop o copB[i] copB'[i] :=
      forall2_getElem hopp i (by rwa [Array.length_toList]) (by rwa [Array.length_toList])
    exact Or.inr ⟨copB[i], copB'[i], dif_pos hi, dif_pos hi', hrel.1, hrel.2.1⟩
  · exact Or.inl ⟨dif_neg hi, dif_neg (fun h => hi (hsz ▸ h))⟩

name: resolveFragB_eq
statement:
theorem resolveFragB_eq (bvh : Impl.BVH.BVH) (fb : Frag) (opp : Array Frag) (wOpp : Array PFace) :
    resolveCoplanar.resolveFragB bvh fb opp wOpp
    = (let st := opp.foldl (rOuterB fb) (#[], #[fb]);
       st.1 ++ st.2.filter (fun p => keepFallback bvh wOpp p))
proof: := rfl

name: rInnerB_map
statement:
theorem rInnerB_map (o : P3) (P' : IPlane) (fa fa' : Frag)
    (hfa : FragSeam o fa fa') (hfaf : FragFaithful fa)
    (st : Array Frag × Array Frag) (piece : Frag) (hpf : FragFaithful piece) :
    rInnerB fa' (mapPair (sfTr o P') st) (sfTr o P' piece)
    = mapPair (sfTr o P') (rInnerB fa st piece)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨kept, pending⟩ := st
  obtain ⟨μ, hμ, hn⟩ := planeNrm_seam o fa.plane fa'.plane hfa.2
  have hcc : coplanarClip (sfTr o P' piece) fa'
      = mapPair (sfTr o P') (coplanarClip piece fa) := by
    rw [sfTr, coplanarClip_setPlane_left,
        coplanarClip_ss o piece fa fa' hpf hfaf μ hμ
          (by rw [carrierNormalP_eq, carrierNormalP_eq]; exact hn) hfa.1, mapPair_comp2]
    rfl
  have hfilter : ((coplanarClip piece fa).1.map (sfTr o P')).filter (fun p => p.poly.size ≥ 3)
      = ((coplanarClip piece fa).1.filter (fun p => p.poly.size ≥ 3)).map (sfTr o P') := by
    apply filter_map_congr; intro x _; simp only [sfTr_size]
  simp only [rInnerB, mapPair, hcc]
  rw [hfilter, map_isEmpty]
  split
  · simp [Array.map_push]
  · rw [foldl_pushGuard_map]

name: rInnerB_pend
statement:
theorem rInnerB_pend (fa : Frag) (st : Array Frag × Array Frag) (hst : PendInv st)
    (piece : Frag) (hpf : FragFaithful piece) (hps : 0 < piece.poly.size) :
    PendInv (rInnerB fa st piece)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨kept, pending⟩ := st
  obtain ⟨hf, hs⟩ := hst
  have hcomp := (coplanarClip_faithful piece fa hpf).2
  simp only [rInnerB, PendInv]
  split
  · exact ⟨fun x hx => by rcases Array.mem_push.mp hx with h | h; exacts [hf x h, h ▸ hpf],
           fun x hx => by rcases Array.mem_push.mp hx with h | h; exacts [hs x h, h ▸ hps]⟩
  · exact foldl_pushGuard_pend (coplanarClip piece fa).2 pending hcomp hf hs

name: rInnerB_plane
statement:
theorem rInnerB_plane (P : IPlane) (fa : Frag) (st : Array Frag × Array Frag)
    (hst : PlaneInv P st) (piece : Frag) (hpp : piece.plane = P) :
    PlaneInv P (rInnerB fa st piece)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨kept, pending⟩ := st
  obtain ⟨hk, hp⟩ := hst
  have hcc2 : ∀ x ∈ (coplanarClip piece fa).2, x.plane = P := by
    intro x hx; rw [(coplanarClip_plane_mem piece fa).2 x hx, hpp]
  simp only [rInnerB, PlaneInv]
  split
  · exact ⟨hk, fun x hx => by rcases Array.mem_push.mp hx with h | h; exacts [hp x h, h ▸ hpp]⟩
  · exact ⟨hk, foldl_pushGuard_plane P _ pending hcc2 hp⟩

name: rOuterB_map
statement:
theorem rOuterB_map (o : P3) (P' : IPlane) (fb fa fa' : Frag) (acc : Array Frag × Array Frag)
    (hfbP : PlaneSeam o fb.plane P') (hfa : FragSeam o fa fa') (hfaf : FragFaithful fa)
    (hInv : PendInv acc) :
    rOuterB (sfTr o P' fb) (mapPair (sfTr o P') acc) fa'
    = mapPair (sfTr o P') (rOuterB fb acc fa)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨kept, pending⟩ := acc
  obtain ⟨hf, _⟩ := hInv
  have hcop : coplanarPlane (sfTr o P' fb).plane fa'.plane = coplanarPlane fb.plane fa.plane := by
    rw [sfTr_plane]; exact coplanarPlane_seam o fb.plane P' fa.plane fa'.plane hfbP hfa.2
  have hLacc : mapPair (sfTr o P') (kept, pending)
      = (kept.map (sfTr o P'), pending.map (sfTr o P')) := by simp [mapPair]
  rw [hLacc]
  simp only [rOuterB, hcop]
  split_ifs with hc
  · exact hLacc.symm
  · rw [← Array.foldl_toList, ← Array.foldl_toList, Array.toList_map]
    have hinit : ((kept.map (sfTr o P'), #[]) : Array Frag × Array Frag)
        = mapPair (sfTr o P') (kept, #[]) := by simp [mapPair]
    rw [hinit]
    exact foldl_map_fusion_memS (sfTr o P') (mapPair (sfTr o P')) (rInnerB fa)
      (rInnerB fa') FragFaithful
      (fun st piece hpf => rInnerB_map o P' fa fa' hfa hfaf st piece hpf)
      pending.toList (fun p hp => hf p (Array.mem_toList.mp hp)) (kept, #[])

name: rOuterB_pend
statement:
theorem rOuterB_pend (fb fa : Frag) (acc : Array Frag × Array Frag) (hacc : PendInv acc) :
    PendInv (rOuterB fb acc fa)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨kept, pending⟩ := acc
  obtain ⟨hf, hs⟩ := hacc
  simp only [rOuterB]
  split
  · exact ⟨hf, hs⟩
  · rw [← Array.foldl_toList]
    refine foldl_inv PendInv (rInnerB fa) pending.toList (kept, #[]) ⟨by simp, by simp⟩ ?_
    intro st hst piece hp
    exact rInnerB_pend fa st hst piece (hf piece (Array.mem_toList.mp hp))
      (hs piece (Array.mem_toList.mp hp))

name: rOuterB_plane
statement:
theorem rOuterB_plane (fb fa : Frag) (acc : Array Frag × Array Frag)
    (hacc : PlaneInv fb.plane acc) : PlaneInv fb.plane (rOuterB fb acc fa)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨kept, pending⟩ := acc
  obtain ⟨hk, hp⟩ := hacc
  simp only [rOuterB]
  split
  · exact ⟨hk, hp⟩
  · rw [← Array.foldl_toList]
    refine foldl_inv (PlaneInv fb.plane) (rInnerB fa) pending.toList (kept, #[]) ⟨hk, by simp⟩ ?_
    intro st hst piece hpc
    exact rInnerB_plane fb.plane fa st hst piece (hp piece (Array.mem_toList.mp hpc))

name: resolveFragB_plane_mem
statement:
theorem resolveFragB_plane_mem (bvh : Impl.BVH.BVH) (fb : Frag) (opp : Array Frag)
    (wOpp : Array PFace) : ∀ k ∈ resolveCoplanar.resolveFragB bvh fb opp wOpp, k.plane = fb.plane
proof:
:= by
  have hst : PlaneInv fb.plane (opp.foldl (rOuterB fb) (#[], #[fb])) := by
    rw [← Array.foldl_toList]
    refine foldl_inv (PlaneInv fb.plane) (rOuterB fb) opp.toList (#[], #[fb])
      ⟨by simp, fun x hx => by rw [Array.mem_singleton] at hx; rw [hx]⟩ ?_
    intro st hst fa _; exact rOuterB_plane fb fa st hst
  rw [resolveFragB_eq]
  intro k hk
  rw [Array.mem_append] at hk
  rcases hk with h | h
  · exact hst.1 k h
  · exact hst.2 k (Array.mem_filter.mp h).1

name: resolveFragB_st_pend
statement:
theorem resolveFragB_st_pend (fb : Frag) (opp : Array Frag)
    (hfb_faith : FragFaithful fb) (hfb_sz : 0 < fb.poly.size) (_hopp : ∀ f ∈ opp, FragFaithful f) :
    PendInv (opp.foldl (rOuterB fb) (#[], #[fb]))
proof:
:= by
  rw [← Array.foldl_toList]
  refine foldl_inv PendInv (rOuterB fb) opp.toList (#[], #[fb])
    ⟨fun x hx => by rw [Array.mem_singleton] at hx; exact hx ▸ hfb_faith,
     fun x hx => by rw [Array.mem_singleton] at hx; exact hx ▸ hfb_sz⟩ ?_
  intro st hst fa _; exact rOuterB_pend fb fa st hst

name: resolveFragB_map
statement:
theorem resolveFragB_map (o : P3) (P' : IPlane) (fb : Frag) (opp opp' : Array Frag)
    {bvhW bvhW' : Impl.BVH.BVH} (wOpp : Array PFace) (hfbP : PlaneSeam o fb.plane P')
    (hfb_faith : FragFaithful fb) (hfb_sz : 0 < fb.poly.size)
    (hopp : List.Forall₂ (fun fa fa' => FragSeam o fa fa' ∧ FragFaithful fa) opp.toList opp'.toList)
    (hq : QSh o bvhW bvhW') (hW : Faithful wOpp) :
    resolveCoplanar.resolveFragB bvhW' (sfTr o P' fb) opp' (wOpp.map (trPFace o))
    = (resolveCoplanar.resolveFragB bvhW fb opp wOpp).map (sfTr o P')
proof:
:= by
  rw [resolveFragB_eq, resolveFragB_eq]
  have hoppf : ∀ f ∈ opp, FragFaithful f :=
    fun f hf => forall2_imp_left_mem
      (fun (a b : Frag) (hab : FragSeam o a b ∧ FragFaithful a) => hab.2) hopp f
      (Array.mem_toList.mpr hf)
  have hpend := resolveFragB_st_pend fb opp hfb_faith hfb_sz hoppf
  have hplane : PlaneInv fb.plane (opp.foldl (rOuterB fb) (#[], #[fb])) := by
    rw [← Array.foldl_toList]
    refine foldl_inv (PlaneInv fb.plane) (rOuterB fb) opp.toList (#[], #[fb])
      ⟨by simp, fun x hx => by rw [Array.mem_singleton] at hx; rw [hx]⟩ ?_
    intro st hst fa _; exact rOuterB_plane fb fa st hst
  have hfold : opp'.foldl (rOuterB (sfTr o P' fb)) (#[], #[sfTr o P' fb])
             = mapPair (sfTr o P') (opp.foldl (rOuterB fb) (#[], #[fb])) := by
    rw [← Array.foldl_toList, ← Array.foldl_toList]
    have hinit : ((#[], #[sfTr o P' fb]) : Array Frag × Array Frag)
        = mapPair (sfTr o P') (#[], #[fb]) := by simp [mapPair]
    rw [hinit]
    exact foldl_fusion_inv (mapf := mapPair (sfTr o P')) (F := rOuterB fb)
      (F' := rOuterB (sfTr o P' fb)) (Inv := PendInv)
      (R := fun fa fa' => FragSeam o fa fa' ∧ FragFaithful fa)
      (fun a a' hR acc hI => rOuterB_map o P' fb a a' acc hfbP hR.1 hR.2 hI)
      (fun a acc hI => rOuterB_pend fb a acc hI) hopp (#[], #[fb])
      ⟨fun x hx => by rw [Array.mem_singleton] at hx; exact hx ▸ hfb_faith,
       fun x hx => by rw [Array.mem_singleton] at hx; exact hx ▸ hfb_sz⟩
  simp only [hfold, mapPair]
  rw [array_map_append]
  congr 1
  apply filter_map_congr
  intro x hx
  have hseam : FragSeam o x (sfTr o P' x) := sfTr_fragSeam o P' fb x (hplane.2 x hx) hfbP
  have hpos : 0 < x.poly.size := hpend.2 x hx
  exact keepFallback_seam o wOpp x (sfTr o P' x) hseam hpos (hpend.1 x hx) hq hW

name: resolveFragB_seam
statement:
theorem resolveFragB_seam (o : P3) (fb fb' : Frag) (opp opp' : Array Frag)
    {bvhW bvhW' : Impl.BVH.BVH} (wOpp : Array PFace)
    (hfb : FragSeam o fb fb') (hfb_faith : FragFaithful fb) (hfb_sz : 0 < fb.poly.size)
    (hopp : List.Forall₂ (fun fa fa' => FragSeam o fa fa' ∧ FragFaithful fa) opp.toList opp'.toList)
    (hq : QSh o bvhW bvhW') (hW : Faithful wOpp) :
    List.Forall₂ (FragSeam o) (resolveCoplanar.resolveFragB bvhW fb opp wOpp).toList
      (resolveCoplanar.resolveFragB bvhW' fb' opp' (wOpp.map (trPFace o))).toList
proof:
:= by
  have hfbP : PlaneSeam o fb.plane fb'.plane := hfb.2
  have hfb' : fb' = sfTr o fb'.plane fb := FragSeam.eq_setPlane hfb
  rw [hfb', resolveFragB_map o fb'.plane fb opp opp' wOpp hfbP hfb_faith hfb_sz hopp hq hW,
      Array.toList_map, List.forall₂_map_right_iff, List.forall₂_same]
  intro k hk
  exact sfTr_fragSeam o fb'.plane fb k
    (resolveFragB_plane_mem bvhW fb opp wOpp k (Array.mem_toList.mp hk)) hfbP

name: resolveFragBNear_seam
statement:
theorem resolveFragBNear_seam (o : P3) (copA copA' : Array Frag) (fb fb' : Frag)
    {bvhW bvhW' : Impl.BVH.BVH} (wA : Array PFace)
    (hopp : List.Forall₂ (RCop o) copA.toList copA'.toList)
    (hfb : FragSeam o fb fb') (hfb_faith : FragFaithful fb) (hfb_sz : 0 < fb.poly.size)
    (hq : QSh o bvhW bvhW') (hW : Faithful wA) :
    List.Forall₂ (FragSeam o)
      (resolveCoplanar.resolveFragBNear (copBVH copA) bvhW copA fb wA).toList
      (resolveCoplanar.resolveFragBNear (copBVH copA') bvhW' copA' fb'
        (wA.map (trPFace o))).toList
proof:
:= by
  unfold resolveCoplanar.resolveFragBNear
  rw [boxQuery_copBVH_seam o copA copA' fb fb' hopp hfb hfb_sz]
  set near := sortAscN (Impl.BVH.boxQuery (copBVH copA) (fragBox fb))
  have hsz : copA.size = copA'.size := by
    have := List.Forall₂.length_eq hopp; rwa [Array.length_toList, Array.length_toList] at this
  refine resolveFragB_seam o fb fb' _ _ wA hfb hfb_faith hfb_sz ?_ hq hW
  rw [arr_filterMap_toList, arr_filterMap_toList]
  apply list_filterMap_forall₂
  intro i _
  by_cases hi : i < copA.size
  · have hi' : i < copA'.size := hsz ▸ hi
    have hrel : RCop o copA[i] copA'[i] :=
      forall2_getElem hopp i (by rwa [Array.length_toList]) (by rwa [Array.length_toList])
    exact Or.inr ⟨copA[i], copA'[i], dif_pos hi, dif_pos hi', hrel.1, hrel.2.1⟩
  · exact Or.inl ⟨dif_neg hi, dif_neg (fun h => hi (hsz ▸ h))⟩

name: forall2_flatMap2
statement:
theorem forall2_flatMap2 {α β} (S : α → α → Prop) (R : β → β → Prop) (g g' : α → List β)
    (hg : ∀ a a', S a a' → List.Forall₂ R (g a) (g' a')) :
    ∀ {l l' : List α}, List.Forall₂ S l l' → List.Forall₂ R (l.flatMap g) (l'.flatMap g')
  | _, _, List.Forall₂.nil => List.Forall₂.nil
  | _, _, List.Forall₂.cons hab htl => List.rel_append (hg _ _ hab) (forall2_flatMap2 S R g g' hg htl)

/

name: resolveCoplanar_seam
statement:
theorem resolveCoplanar_seam (o : P3) (copA copA' copB copB' : Array Frag) (wB wA : Array PFace)
    {bvhWB bvhWA bvhWB' bvhWA' : Impl.BVH.BVH}
    (hA : List.Forall₂ (RCop o) copA.toList copA'.toList)
    (hB : List.Forall₂ (RCop o) copB.toList copB'.toList)
    (hqB : QSh o bvhWB bvhWB') (hqA : QSh o bvhWA bvhWA')
    (hWB : Faithful wB) (hWA : Faithful wA) :
    List.Forall₂ (FragSeam o) (resolveCoplanar bvhWB bvhWA copA copB wB wA).toList
      (resolveCoplanar bvhWB' bvhWA' copA' copB' (wB.map (trPFace o))
        (wA.map (trPFace o))).toList
proof:
:= by
  simp only [resolveCoplanar]
  rw [Array.toList_append, Array.toList_append]
  refine List.rel_append ?_ ?_
  · rw [toList_flatMap, toList_flatMap]
    exact forall2_flatMap2 (RCop o) (FragSeam o)
      (fun fa => (resolveFragNear (copBVH copB) bvhWB copB fa wB).toList)
      (fun fa' => (resolveFragNear (copBVH copB') bvhWB' copB' fa' (wB.map (trPFace o))).toList)
      (fun fa fa' hff =>
        resolveFragNear_seam o copB copB' fa fa' wB hB hff.1 hff.2.1 hff.2.2 hqB hWB) hA
  · rw [toList_flatMap, toList_flatMap]
    exact forall2_flatMap2 (RCop o) (FragSeam o)
      (fun fb => (resolveCoplanar.resolveFragBNear (copBVH copA) bvhWA copA fb wA).toList)
      (fun fb' => (resolveCoplanar.resolveFragBNear (copBVH copA') bvhWA' copA' fb'
        (wA.map (trPFace o))).toList)
      (fun fb fb' hff =>
        resolveFragBNear_seam o copA copA' fb fb' wA hA hff.1 hff.2.1 hff.2.2 hqA hWA) hB

name: foldl_pushGuard_faith
statement:
theorem foldl_pushGuard_faith (comp pending : Array Frag)
    (hc : ∀ x ∈ comp, FragFaithful x) (hp : ∀ x ∈ pending, FragFaithful x) :
    ∀ x ∈ comp.foldl pushGuard pending, FragFaithful x
proof:
:= by
  rw [← Array.foldl_toList]
  refine foldl_inv (fun pd => ∀ x ∈ pd, FragFaithful x) pushGuard comp.toList pending hp ?_
  intro pd hpd p hp2
  simp only [pushGuard]
  split
  · intro x hx; rcases Array.mem_push.mp hx with h | h
    · exact hpd x h
    · exact h ▸ hc p (Array.mem_toList.mp hp2)
  · exact hpd

name: rInner_faith
statement:
theorem rInner_faith (fa fb : Frag) (st : Array Frag × Array Frag) (hst : FaithInv st)
    (piece : Frag) (hpf : FragFaithful piece) : FaithInv (rInner fa fb st piece)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨kept, pending⟩ := st
  obtain ⟨hk, hp⟩ := hst
  have hcc := coplanarClip_faithful piece fb hpf
  simp only [rInner, FaithInv]
  split
  · exact ⟨hk, fun x hx => by rcases Array.mem_push.mp hx with h | h; exacts [hp x h, h ▸ hpf]⟩
  · refine ⟨?_, foldl_pushGuard_faith _ pending hcc.2 hp⟩
    split
    · intro x hx; rcases Array.mem_append.mp hx with h | h
      · exact hk x h
      · exact hcc.1 x (Array.mem_filter.mp h).1
    · exact hk

name: rOuter_faith
statement:
theorem rOuter_faith (fa fb : Frag) (acc : Array Frag × Array Frag) (hacc : FaithInv acc) :
    FaithInv (rOuter fa acc fb)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨kept, pending⟩ := acc
  obtain ⟨hk, hp⟩ := hacc
  simp only [rOuter]
  split
  · exact ⟨hk, hp⟩
  · rw [← Array.foldl_toList]
    refine foldl_inv FaithInv (rInner fa fb) pending.toList (kept, #[]) ⟨hk, by simp⟩ ?_
    intro st hst piece hpc
    exact rInner_faith fa fb st hst piece (hp piece (Array.mem_toList.mp hpc))

name: resolveFrag_faithful
statement:
theorem resolveFrag_faithful (bvh : Impl.BVH.BVH) (fa : Frag) (opp : Array Frag) (wOpp : Array PFace)
    (hfa : FragFaithful fa) : ∀ f ∈ resolveFrag bvh fa opp wOpp, FragFaithful f
proof:
:= by
  have hst : FaithInv (opp.foldl (rOuter fa) (#[], #[fa])) := by
    rw [← Array.foldl_toList]
    refine foldl_inv FaithInv (rOuter fa) opp.toList (#[], #[fa])
      ⟨by simp, fun x hx => by rw [Array.mem_singleton] at hx; rw [hx]; exact hfa⟩ ?_
    intro st hst fb _; exact rOuter_faith fa fb st hst
  rw [resolveFrag_eq]
  intro k hk
  rw [Array.mem_append] at hk
  rcases hk with h | h
  · exact hst.1 k h
  · exact hst.2 k (Array.mem_filter.mp h).1

name: rInnerB_faith
statement:
theorem rInnerB_faith (fa : Frag) (st : Array Frag × Array Frag) (hst : FaithInv st)
    (piece : Frag) (hpf : FragFaithful piece) : FaithInv (rInnerB fa st piece)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨kept, pending⟩ := st
  obtain ⟨hk, hp⟩ := hst
  have hcc := coplanarClip_faithful piece fa hpf
  simp only [rInnerB, FaithInv]
  split
  · exact ⟨hk, fun x hx => by rcases Array.mem_push.mp hx with h | h; exacts [hp x h, h ▸ hpf]⟩
  · exact ⟨hk, foldl_pushGuard_faith _ pending hcc.2 hp⟩

name: rOuterB_faith
statement:
theorem rOuterB_faith (fb fa : Frag) (acc : Array Frag × Array Frag) (hacc : FaithInv acc) :
    FaithInv (rOuterB fb acc fa)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨kept, pending⟩ := acc
  obtain ⟨hk, hp⟩ := hacc
  simp only [rOuterB]
  split
  · exact ⟨hk, hp⟩
  · rw [← Array.foldl_toList]
    refine foldl_inv FaithInv (rInnerB fa) pending.toList (kept, #[]) ⟨hk, by simp⟩ ?_
    intro st hst piece hpc
    exact rInnerB_faith fa st hst piece (hp piece (Array.mem_toList.mp hpc))

name: resolveFragB_faithful
statement:
theorem resolveFragB_faithful (bvh : Impl.BVH.BVH) (fb : Frag) (opp : Array Frag) (wOpp : Array PFace)
    (hfb : FragFaithful fb) : ∀ f ∈ resolveCoplanar.resolveFragB bvh fb opp wOpp, FragFaithful f
proof:
:= by
  have hst : FaithInv (opp.foldl (rOuterB fb) (#[], #[fb])) := by
    rw [← Array.foldl_toList]
    refine foldl_inv FaithInv (rOuterB fb) opp.toList (#[], #[fb])
      ⟨by simp, fun x hx => by rw [Array.mem_singleton] at hx; rw [hx]; exact hfb⟩ ?_
    intro st hst fa _; exact rOuterB_faith fb fa st hst
  rw [resolveFragB_eq]
  intro k hk
  rw [Array.mem_append] at hk
  rcases hk with h | h
  · exact hst.1 k h
  · exact hst.2 k (Array.mem_filter.mp h).1

name: resolveCoplanar_faithful
statement:
theorem resolveCoplanar_faithful (bvhWB bvhWA : Impl.BVH.BVH) (copA copB : Array Frag)
    (wB wA : Array PFace)
    (hA : ∀ f ∈ copA, FragFaithful f) (hB : ∀ f ∈ copB, FragFaithful f) :
    ∀ f ∈ resolveCoplanar bvhWB bvhWA copA copB wB wA, FragFaithful f
proof:
:= by
  simp only [resolveCoplanar]
  intro f hf
  rw [Array.mem_append] at hf
  rcases hf with h | h
  · obtain ⟨fa, hfa, hf⟩ := mem_flatMap_arr.mp h
    unfold resolveFragNear at hf
    exact resolveFrag_faithful _ fa _ wB (hA fa hfa) f hf
  · obtain ⟨fb, hfb, hf⟩ := mem_flatMap_arr.mp h
    unfold resolveCoplanar.resolveFragBNear at hf
    exact resolveFragB_faithful _ fb _ wA (hB fb hfb) f hf

name: keptGen_vpoly_sub
statement:
theorem keptGen_vpoly_sub {M₁ M₂ : Mesh} (h₁ : NoPlaneThroughOrigin M₁)
    (h₂ : NoPlaneThroughOrigin M₂) {f : Frag} (hf : f ∈ keptGen M₁ M₂) :
    ∃ (M : Mesh) (i : ℕ) (hi : i < M.size),
      (M = M₁ ∨ M = M₂) ∧ vpoly (fragCycle f) ⊆ triangleSet (M[i]'hi)
proof:
:= by
  rw [keptGen] at hf
  simp only at hf
  
  rw [Array.mem_append] at hf
  rcases hf with hf | hf
  · rw [Array.mem_append] at hf
    rcases hf with hf | hf
    · 
      obtain ⟨i, hi, hfclip, -, -⟩ := keptNcA_provenance hf
      have hdet : detOrigin (M₁[i]'hi) ≠ 0 := h₁ ⟨i, hi⟩
      have hiMz : i < (materialize M₁).size := by rwa [materialize_size]
      refine ⟨M₁, i, hi, Or.inl rfl, ?_⟩
      have hbase := fragInv_base hdet
      rw [arr_getD _ _ _ hiMz, materialize_getElem M₁ i hi] at hfclip
      refine (clipFaceScoped_vpoly_subset hbase _ hfclip).trans ?_
      rw [vpoly_fragOfFace]
    · 
      obtain ⟨j, hj, hfclip, -, -⟩ := keptNcB_provenance hf
      have hdet : detOrigin (M₂[j]'hj) ≠ 0 := h₂ ⟨j, hj⟩
      have hjMz : j < (materialize M₂).size := by rwa [materialize_size]
      refine ⟨M₂, j, hj, Or.inr rfl, ?_⟩
      have hbase := fragInv_base hdet
      rw [arr_getD _ _ _ hjMz, materialize_getElem M₂ j hj] at hfclip
      refine (clipFaceScoped_vpoly_subset hbase _ hfclip).trans ?_
      rw [vpoly_fragOfFace]
  · 
    obtain ⟨M, k, hk, g, hprov, -, -, hvsub, -, -, -⟩ := keptCop_provenance h₁ h₂ hf
    refine ⟨M, k, hk, ?_, hvsub⟩
    rcases hprov with ⟨hM, -⟩ | ⟨hM, -⟩
    · exact Or.inl hM
    · exact Or.inr hM

name: emitted_triangleSet_sub
statement:
theorem emitted_triangleSet_sub {M₁ M₂ : Mesh} (h₁ : NoPlaneThroughOrigin M₁)
    (h₂ : NoPlaneThroughOrigin M₂) (hg₁ : CSG.Proof.MeshIntersectNpo.GenWF M₁) (hg₂ : CSG.Proof.MeshIntersectNpo.GenWF M₂) {τ : Triangle}
    (hτ : τ ∈ Impl.MeshIntersect.meshIntersect M₁ M₂) :
    ∃ (M : Mesh) (i : ℕ) (hi : i < M.size),
      (M = M₁ ∨ M = M₂) ∧ triangleSet τ ⊆ triangleSet (M[i]'hi)
proof:
:= by
  
  rw [CSG.Proof.MeshIntersectNpo.meshIntersect_eq M₁ M₂ hg₁ hg₂] at hτ
  obtain ⟨af, hafmem, hτin⟩ := mem_flatMap_arr.mp hτ
  obtain ⟨f, hf, rfl⟩ := Array.mem_map.mp hafmem
  
  have hpkg := (keptGen_emitPackage h₁ h₂ hf).2 τ (Array.mem_toList.mpr hτin)
  have hτsub : triangleSet τ ⊆ vpoly (fragCycle f) := hpkg.1
  
  obtain ⟨M, i, hi, hMmem, hvsub⟩ := keptGen_vpoly_sub h₁ h₂ hf
  exact ⟨M, i, hi, hMmem, hτsub.trans hvsub⟩

name: surface_subset_of_faces
statement:
theorem surface_subset_of_faces {out M₁ M₂ : Mesh}
    (H : ∀ τ ∈ out, ∃ (M : Mesh) (k : ℕ) (hk : k < M.size),
      (M = M₁ ∨ M = M₂) ∧ triangleSet τ ⊆ triangleSet (M[k]'hk)) :
    surface out ⊆ surface M₁ ∪ surface M₂
proof:
:= by
  intro x hx
  simp only [surface, Set.mem_iUnion] at hx
  obtain ⟨i, hxi⟩ := hx
  have hface : out[i] ∈ out := Array.getElem_mem i.isLt
  obtain ⟨M, k, hk, hMmem, hsub⟩ := H out[i] hface
  have hxk : x ∈ triangleSet (M[k]'hk) := hsub hxi
  rcases hMmem with rfl | rfl
  · exact Or.inl (by simp only [surface, Set.mem_iUnion]; exact ⟨⟨k, hk⟩, hxk⟩)
  · exact Or.inr (by simp only [surface, Set.mem_iUnion]; exact ⟨⟨k, hk⟩, hxk⟩)

name: surface_meshIntersect_subset_npo
statement:
theorem surface_meshIntersect_subset_npo {M₁ M₂ : Mesh}
    (h₁ : NoPlaneThroughOrigin M₁) (h₂ : NoPlaneThroughOrigin M₂)
    (hg₁ : CSG.Proof.MeshIntersectNpo.GenWF M₁) (hg₂ : CSG.Proof.MeshIntersectNpo.GenWF M₂) :
    surface (Impl.MeshIntersect.meshIntersect M₁ M₂) ⊆ surface M₁ ∪ surface M₂
proof:
:=
  surface_subset_of_faces (fun _τ hτ => emitted_triangleSet_sub h₁ h₂ hg₁ hg₂ hτ)

name: surface_trMesh
statement:
theorem surface_trMesh (O : Point) (M : Mesh) :
    surface (Proof.MeshIntersectM2Kit.trMesh O M)
      = Proof.MeshIntersectM2Kit.trPoint O '' surface M
proof:
:= by
  have hsize := Proof.MeshIntersectM2Kit.trMesh_size O M
  simp only [surface, Set.image_iUnion]
  ext x
  simp only [Set.mem_iUnion]
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨i, hxi⟩
    have hi' : i.1 < M.size := by rw [← hsize]; exact i.2
    rw [Proof.MeshIntersectM2Kit.trMesh_getElem O M i hi',
      Proof.MeshIntersectM2Kit.triangleSet_trTri] at hxi
    exact ⟨⟨i.1, hi'⟩, hxi⟩
  · rintro ⟨i, hxi⟩
    have hi' : i.1 < (Proof.MeshIntersectM2Kit.trMesh O M).size := by rw [hsize]; exact i.2
    refine ⟨⟨i.1, hi'⟩, ?_⟩
    rw [Proof.MeshIntersectM2Kit.trMesh_getElem O M ⟨i.1, hi'⟩ i.2,
      Proof.MeshIntersectM2Kit.triangleSet_trTri]
    exact hxi

name: surface_meshIntersect_subset
statement:
theorem surface_meshIntersect_subset (M₁ M₂ : Mesh)
    (h₁ : WellFormedMesh M₁) (h₂ : WellFormedMesh M₂) :
    surface (Impl.MeshIntersect.meshIntersect M₁ M₂) ⊆ surface M₁ ∪ surface M₂
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨hcyc1, -, hns1, hnd1⟩ := h₁
  obtain ⟨hcyc2, -, hns2, hnd2⟩ := h₂
  
  obtain ⟨O, hO1, hO2, -⟩ :=
    Proof.MeshIntersectM2Kit.good_origin₂ hnd1 hnd2 (ι := Empty) Empty.elim Empty.elim
      (fun e => e.elim)
  
  have hnpo := surface_meshIntersect_subset_npo hO1 hO2
    ⟨(Proof.MeshIntersectM2Kit.isCycle_trMesh_iff O M₁).mpr hcyc1,
      (Proof.MeshIntersectM2Kit.noSelfIntersection_trMesh_iff O M₁).mpr hns1, hO1⟩
    ⟨(Proof.MeshIntersectM2Kit.isCycle_trMesh_iff O M₂).mpr hcyc2,
      (Proof.MeshIntersectM2Kit.noSelfIntersection_trMesh_iff O M₂).mpr hns2, hO2⟩
  
  
  have hequiv : Impl.MeshIntersect.meshIntersect
      (Proof.MeshIntersectM2Kit.trMesh O M₁) (Proof.MeshIntersectM2Kit.trMesh O M₂)
      = Proof.MeshIntersectM2Kit.trMesh O (Impl.MeshIntersect.meshIntersect M₁ M₂) :=
    Proof.MeshIntersectM2Equiv.meshIntersect_equivariant O M₁ M₂
  rw [hequiv] at hnpo
  
  rw [surface_trMesh, surface_trMesh, surface_trMesh, ← Set.image_union] at hnpo
  
  exact (Set.image_subset_image_iff (Proof.MeshIntersectM2Kit.trPoint_injective O)).mp hnpo

name: exists_intersection_chain
statement:
theorem exists_intersection_chain (w₁ w₂ : Chain)
    (h₁ : Legacy.Normal w₁) (h₂ : Legacy.Normal w₂) :
    ∃ w : Chain, Legacy.Normal w ∧ EqOffPlanes (Legacy.solid w) (Legacy.solid w₁ ∩ Legacy.solid w₂)
proof:
:=
  ⟨Proof.ProductChain.productChain w₁ w₂,
    Proof.ProductChain.normal_of_product w₁ w₂ h₁ h₂,
    Proof.ProductChain.eqOffPlanes_of_product w₁ w₂⟩

name: coplanarPlane_seam
statement:
theorem coplanarPlane_seam (o : P3) (ga ga' gb gb' : IPlane)
    (ha : PlaneSeam o ga ga') (hb : PlaneSeam o gb gb') :
    coplanarPlane ga' gb' = coplanarPlane ga gb
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨a1, b1, c1, hga, hga'⟩ := ha
  obtain ⟨a2, b2, c2, hgb, hgb'⟩ := hb
  rw [hga, hga', hgb, hgb']
  exact coplanarPlane_iFacePlaneP_tr o a1 b1 c1 a2 b2 c2

name: sameOrient_seam
statement:
theorem sameOrient_seam (o : P3) (ga ga' gb gb' : IPlane)
    (ha : PlaneSeam o ga ga') (hb : PlaneSeam o gb gb') :
    sameOrient ga' gb' = sameOrient ga gb
proof:
:= by
