name: windingRayDir_tr
statement:
theorem windingRayDir_tr (o : P3) {bvh bvh' : Impl.BVH.BVH} (W : Array PFace) (Q d : P3)
    (hq : QSh o bvh bvh') (hW : Faithful W) (hint : P3Int d) :
    windingRayDir bvh' (W.map (trPFace o)) (psubS Q o) d = windingRayDir bvh W Q d
proof:
:= by
  rw [windingRayDir_eq_old bvh' _ (wedgeOK_getD (faithful_map_trPFace o W)) (psubS Q o) d,
    windingRayDir_eq_old bvh W (wedgeOK_getD hW) Q d]
  simp only [windingRayDirOld]
  have hpt : (⟨(psubS Q o).x, (psubS Q o).y, (psubS Q o).z⟩ : Impl.BVH.Pt)
      = shPt o.x o.y o.z ⟨Q.x, Q.y, Q.z⟩ := rfl
  rw [hpt, hq ⟨Q.x, Q.y, Q.z⟩ ⟨d.x, d.y, d.z⟩]
  have hbody : ∀ i : Nat,
      rayFaceCross ((W.map (trPFace o)).getD i default) (toH4 (psubS Q o))
          ⟨d.x.num, d.y.num, d.z.num⟩
      = rayFaceCross (W.getD i default) (toH4 Q) ⟨d.x.num, d.y.num, d.z.num⟩ :=
    fun i => rayFaceCross_getD_tr o W Q d i hW hint
  simp only [hbody]

theorem windingRayDirH_tr (o : P3) {bvh bvh' : Impl.BVH.BVH} (W : Array PFace)

    (hq : QSh o bvh bvh') (hW : Faithful W) (hint : P3Int d) :

name: windingAt_tr
statement:
theorem windingAt_tr (o : P3) {bvh bvh' : Impl.BVH.BVH} (W : Array PFace) (Q : P3)

    windingAt bvh' (W.map (trPFace o)) (psubS Q o) = windingAt bvh W Q
proof:
:= by
  unfold windingAt
  have hattempt :
      (fun j => windingRayDir bvh' (W.map (trPFace o)) (psubS Q o) (rayDirAt j))
      = (fun j => windingRayDir bvh W Q (rayDirAt j)) := by
    funext j; exact windingRayDir_tr o W Q (rayDirAt j) hq hW (p3Int_rayDirAt j)
  rw [Array.size_map, hattempt]

name: windingAtH_tr
statement:
theorem windingAtH_tr (o : P3) {bvh bvh' : Impl.BVH.BVH} (W : Array PFace)

    windingAtH_eq bvh W (wedgeOK_getD hW) hrep]
  exact windingAt_tr o W Q hq hW

name: materialize_getElem
statement:
theorem materialize_getElem (M : Mesh) (i : Fin (materialize M).size) (hi' : i.1 < M.size) :

name: pairOK_iff
statement:
theorem pairOK_iff (S T : Triangle) :
    pairOK (faceHOf S, boxOfTri S) (faceHOf T, boxOfTri T) = true ↔
      (((S.v₀ : Point) ∉ facePlane T ∧ (S.v₁ : Point) ∉ facePlane T ∧
          (S.v₂ : Point) ∉ facePlane T) ∧
       ((T.v₀ : Point) ∉ facePlane S ∧ (T.v₁ : Point) ∉ facePlane S ∧
          (T.v₂ : Point) ∉ facePlane S)) ∧
      edgeSet S ∩ edgeSet T = ∅
proof:
:= by
  unfold pairOK
  simp only []
  rw [Bool.and_eq_true, vertexClauseOK_iff S T, Bool.or_eq_true, Bool.not_eq_true',
    edgeClauseOK_iff S T]
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨hv, hbe⟩
    refine ⟨hv, ?_⟩
    rcases hbe with hbox | hee
    · exact boxes_miss_edgeSet_disjoint S T hbox
    · exact hee
  · rintro ⟨hv, hee⟩
    exact ⟨hv, Or.inr hee⟩

name: forall_mem_triple
statement:
theorem forall_mem_triple (T : Triangle) (P : Point → Prop) :
    (∀ v ∈ [T.v₀, T.v₁, T.v₂], P v) ↔ (P T.v₀ ∧ P T.v₁ ∧ P T.v₂)
proof:
:= by
  simp only [List.mem_cons, List.mem_singleton, List.not_mem_nil]
  constructor
  · intro h; exact ⟨h _ (by tauto), h _ (by tauto), h _ (by tauto)⟩
  · rintro ⟨h0, h1, h2⟩ v hv
    rcases hv with rfl | rfl | rfl | h <;> first | assumption | exact absurd h (by simp)

name: checkGeneralPosition_spec_main
statement:
theorem checkGeneralPosition_spec_main (M₁ M₂ : Mesh) :
    Impl.Legacy.GenPosCheck.checkGeneralPosition M₁ M₂ = true ↔ GeneralPosition M₁ M₂
proof:
:= by
  unfold checkGeneralPosition
  rw [Array.all_eq_true]
  rw [GeneralPosition]
  constructor
  · intro h i j
    
    have hi : i.1 < (materialize M₁).size := by rw [materialize_size]; exact i.2
    have hj : j.1 < (materialize M₂).size := by rw [materialize_size]; exact j.2
    have hall := h ⟨i.1, hi⟩
    rw [Array.all_eq_true] at hall
    have hpair := hall ⟨j.1, hj⟩
    rw [materialize_getElem M₁ ⟨i.1, hi⟩ i.2, materialize_getElem M₂ ⟨j.1, hj⟩ j.2] at hpair
    rw [pairOK_iff (M₁[i.1]'i.2) (M₂[j.1]'j.2)] at hpair
    obtain ⟨⟨hvS, hvT⟩, hee⟩ := hpair
    refine ⟨?_, ?_, hee⟩
    · rw [forall_mem_triple]; exact hvS
    · rw [forall_mem_triple]; exact hvT
  · intro h i
    rw [Array.all_eq_true]
    intro j
    
    have hi : i.1 < M₁.size := (materialize_size M₁) ▸ i.2
    have hj : j.1 < M₂.size := (materialize_size M₂) ▸ j.2
    have hpair := h ⟨i.1, hi⟩ ⟨j.1, hj⟩
    rw [forall_mem_triple, forall_mem_triple] at hpair
    obtain ⟨hvS, hvT, hee⟩ := hpair
    rw [materialize_getElem M₁ i hi, materialize_getElem M₂ j hj,
        pairOK_iff (M₁[i.1]'hi) (M₂[j.1]'hj)]
    exact ⟨⟨hvS, hvT⟩, hee⟩

name: dotQ_self_pos
statement: theorem dotQ_self_pos {n : Point} (hn : n ≠ 0) : 0 < dotQ n n
proof:
:= by
  have h0 : ∀ i : Fin 3, 0 ≤ n i * n i := fun i => mul_self_nonneg _
  have hle : 0 ≤ dotQ n n := by
    unfold dotQ; have := h0 0; have := h0 1; have := h0 2; linarith
  refine hle.lt_of_ne fun heq => hn ?_
  unfold dotQ at heq
  have e0 : n 0 * n 0 = 0 := by linarith [h0 0, h0 1, h0 2]
  have e1 : n 1 * n 1 = 0 := by linarith [h0 0, h0 1, h0 2]
  have e2 : n 2 * n 2 = 0 := by linarith [h0 0, h0 1, h0 2]
  funext i
  fin_cases i
  · simpa using mul_self_eq_zero.mp e0
  · simpa using mul_self_eq_zero.mp e1
  · simpa using mul_self_eq_zero.mp e2

name: cross_parallel_normal
proof:
:= by
  have hu : dotQ n (q - p) = 0 := by rw [dotQ_sub_right, hp, hq, sub_self]
  have hv : dotQ n (r - p) = 0 := by rw [dotQ_sub_right, hp, hr, sub_self]
  set u := q - p
  set v := r - p
  simp only [dotQ] at hu hv
  
  
  funext i
  fin_cases i
  · simp [crossQ, mkPoint, dotQ, Pi.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul]
    linear_combination (n 1 * v 2 - n 2 * v 1) * hu - (n 1 * u 2 - n 2 * u 1) * hv
  · simp [crossQ, mkPoint, dotQ, Pi.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul]
    linear_combination (n 2 * v 0 - n 0 * v 2) * hu - (n 2 * u 0 - n 0 * u 2) * hv
  · simp [crossQ, mkPoint, dotQ, Pi.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul]
    linear_combination (n 0 * v 1 - n 1 * v 0) * hu - (n 0 * u 1 - n 1 * u 0) * hv

name: det3_mul_normSq
proof:
:= by
  have hpar := cross_parallel_normal hp hq hr
  
  have hdet : det3 p q r = dotQ p (crossQ (q - p) (r - p)) := by
    simp only [det3, dotQ, crossQ, Pi.sub_apply, mkPoint_zero, mkPoint_one, mkPoint_two]
    ring
  have hswap : ∀ x y : Point, dotQ x y = dotQ y x := by
    intro x y; simp only [dotQ]; ring
  calc det3 p q r * dotQ n n
      = dotQ p (dotQ n n • crossQ (q - p) (r - p)) := by
        rw [dotQ_smul_right, hdet]; ring
    _ = dotQ p (dotQ n (crossQ (q - p) (r - p)) • n) := by rw [hpar]
    _ = dotQ n (crossQ (q - p) (r - p)) * dotQ p n := by rw [dotQ_smul_right]
    _ = dotQ n (crossQ (q - p) (r - p)) * c := by rw [hswap p n, hp]

name: orientSign_inherit
statement:
theorem orientSign_inherit {t τ : Triangle} (hdet : detOrigin t ≠ 0)
    (hp : dotQ (carrierNormal t) τ.v₀ = detOrigin t)
    (hq : dotQ (carrierNormal t) τ.v₁ = detOrigin t)
    (hr : dotQ (carrierNormal t) τ.v₂ = detOrigin t)
    (hA : 0 < dotQ (carrierNormal t) (crossQ (τ.v₁ - τ.v₀) (τ.v₂ - τ.v₀))) :
    detOrigin τ ≠ 0 ∧ orientSign τ = orientSign t
proof:
:= by
  have hnn : 0 < dotQ (carrierNormal t) (carrierNormal t) :=
    dotQ_self_pos (carrierNormal_ne_zero hdet)
  have key : detOrigin τ * dotQ (carrierNormal t) (carrierNormal t)
      = dotQ (carrierNormal t) (crossQ (τ.v₁ - τ.v₀) (τ.v₂ - τ.v₀)) * detOrigin t := by
    rw [← det3_eq_detOrigin]
    exact det3_mul_normSq hp hq hr
  rcases hdet.lt_or_lt with hneg | hpos
  · have hτ : detOrigin τ < 0 := by nlinarith
    refine ⟨ne_of_lt hτ, ?_⟩
    rw [orientSign, orientSign, if_neg (by linarith), if_pos hτ,
      if_neg (by linarith), if_pos hneg]
  · have hτ : 0 < detOrigin τ := by nlinarith
    refine ⟨ne_of_gt hτ, ?_⟩
    rw [orientSign, orientSign, if_pos hτ, if_pos hpos]

name: triangleSet_subset_level
proof:
:= by
  have hcvx : Convex ℚ {x : Point | dotQ n x = c} := by
    intro x hx y hy a b ha hb hab
    simp only [Set.mem_setOf_eq] at hx hy ⊢
    have hcomb : dotQ n (a • x + b • y) = a * dotQ n x + b * dotQ n y := by
      rw [dotQ_add_right, dotQ_smul_right, dotQ_smul_right]
    rw [hcomb, hx, hy, ← add_mul, hab, one_mul]
  intro z hz
  have hsub : triangleSet τ ⊆ {x : Point | dotQ n x = c} := by
    rw [triangleSet]
    apply convexHull_min ?_ hcvx
    rintro x hx
    simp only [Set.mem_insert_iff, Set.mem_singleton_iff] at hx
    rcases hx with rfl | rfl | rfl <;> assumption
  exact hsub hz

name: mem_simplex_iff_radial
statement:
theorem mem_simplex_iff_radial {τ : Triangle} {n : Point} {c : ℚ}
    (h0 : dotQ n τ.v₀ = c) (h1 : dotQ n τ.v₁ = c) (h2 : dotQ n τ.v₂ = c)
    (hc : c ≠ 0) {Q : Point} (hQ : dotQ n Q ≠ 0) :
    Q ∈ simplex τ ↔ 1 ≤ c / dotQ n Q ∧ (c / dotQ n Q) • Q ∈ triangleSet τ
proof:
:= by
  rw [simplex_eq_convexJoin, mem_convexJoin]
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨a, ha, z, hz, hseg⟩
    rw [Set.mem_singleton_iff] at ha
    subst ha
    rw [segment_eq_image] at hseg
    obtain ⟨μ, hμIcc, hQz'⟩ := hseg
    have hQz : μ • z = Q := by simpa using hQz'
    have hnz : dotQ n z = c := triangleSet_subset_level h0 h1 h2 z hz
    have hQn : dotQ n Q = μ * c := by rw [← hQz, dotQ_smul_right, hnz]
    have hμ0 : μ ≠ 0 := by
      rintro rfl
      rw [zero_mul] at hQn
      exact hQ hQn
    obtain ⟨hμ0le, hμ1⟩ := hμIcc
    have hμpos : 0 < μ := hμ0le.lt_of_ne (Ne.symm hμ0)
    have hlam : c / dotQ n Q = 1 / μ := by
      rw [hQn, mul_comm, div_mul_eq_div_div, div_self hc]
    constructor
    · rw [hlam, le_div_iff₀ hμpos, one_mul]; exact hμ1
    · rw [hlam, ← hQz, smul_smul, one_div_mul_cancel hμ0, one_smul]; exact hz
  · rintro ⟨hlam, hP⟩
    have hlampos : 0 < c / dotQ n Q := lt_of_lt_of_le one_pos hlam
    have hlamne : c / dotQ n Q ≠ 0 := ne_of_gt hlampos
    refine ⟨0, Set.mem_singleton 0, (c / dotQ n Q) • Q, hP, ?_⟩
    rw [segment_eq_image]
    refine ⟨1 / (c / dotQ n Q), ⟨by positivity, ?_⟩, ?_⟩
    · rw [div_le_one hlampos]; exact hlam
    · show (1 - 1 / (c / dotQ n Q)) • (0 : Point)
          + (1 / (c / dotQ n Q)) • ((c / dotQ n Q) • Q) = Q
      rw [smul_zero, zero_add, smul_smul, one_div_mul_cancel hlamne, one_smul]

name: exists_off_negligible_in_cell
statement:
theorem exists_off_negligible_in_cell {m : ℕ} (g : Fin m → (Point →ᵃ[ℚ] ℚ))
    (s : Fin m → ℚ) (hs : ∀ j, s j = 1 ∨ s j = -1) {p₀ : Point}
    (hp₀ : ∀ j, 0 < s j * g j p₀) {N : Set Point} (hN : Negligible N) :
    ∃ Q, (∀ j, 0 < s j * g j Q) ∧ Q ∉ N
proof:
:= by
  by_contra hcon
  push_neg at hcon
  exact fullDimCell_not_negligible g s hs hp₀
    (negligible_mono (fun Q hQ => hcon Q hQ) hN)

name: winding_zero_or_one
proof:
:= by
  classical
  set w := meshChain M with hw
  set A := planes w with hA
  have hmem : ∀ j : Fin A.size, A[j] ∈ A := fun j => Array.getElem_mem _
  set gj : Fin A.size → (Point →ᵃ[ℚ] ℚ) := fun j => gOf A[j] with hgj
  set s : Fin A.size → ℚ := fun j => if 0 < (A[j]).eval Q then 1 else -1 with hsdef
  have hs1 : ∀ j, s j = 1 ∨ s j = -1 := by
    intro j
    rw [hsdef]
    dsimp only
    split_ifs
    · exact Or.inl rfl
    · exact Or.inr rfl
  have hp₀ : ∀ j, 0 < s j * gj j Q := by
    intro j
    have hne : (A[j]).eval Q ≠ 0 := hoff _ (hmem j)
    rw [hsdef, hgj]
    dsimp only
    rw [gOf_apply]
    split_ifs with h
    · rw [one_mul]; exact h
    · have hlt : (A[j]).eval Q < 0 := (not_lt.mp h).lt_of_ne hne
      rw [neg_one_mul]
      linarith
  obtain ⟨N, hNneg, hNval⟩ := hnorm
  obtain ⟨Q', hQ'cell, hQ'N⟩ := exists_off_negligible_in_cell gj s hs1 hp₀ hNneg
  
  have hcell : ∀ j : Fin A.size,
      ((A[j]).eval Q' ≠ 0) ∧ (0 < (A[j]).eval Q ↔ 0 < (A[j]).eval Q') := by
    intro j
    have hc := hQ'cell j
    rw [hgj] at hc
    dsimp only at hc
    rw [gOf_apply] at hc
    by_cases h : 0 < (A[j]).eval Q
    · have hsj : s j = 1 := by rw [hsdef]; exact if_pos h
      rw [hsj, one_mul] at hc
      exact ⟨ne_of_gt hc, iff_of_true h hc⟩
    · have hsj : s j = -1 := by rw [hsdef]; exact if_neg h
      rw [hsj, neg_one_mul] at hc
      have hlt : (A[j]).eval Q' < 0 := by linarith
      exact ⟨ne_of_lt hlt, iff_of_false h (not_lt.mpr hlt.le)⟩
  have hidx : ∀ h' ∈ A, ∃ j : Fin A.size, A[j] = h' := by
    intro h' hh'
    obtain ⟨j, hjlt, hj⟩ := Array.mem_iff_getElem.mp hh'
    exact ⟨⟨j, hjlt⟩, hj⟩
  have hvac : ∀ Q₀ : Point, ∀ e ∈ w.toList, isDegen e.2 = true → Q₀ ∉ simplex e.2 := by
    intro Q₀ e he hd
    rw [meshChain_nondegen hnpo e he] at hd
    exact absurd hd Bool.false_ne_true
  have htrans : winding w Q = winding w Q' := by
    apply winding_const_on_cell
    · exact hoff
    · exact hvac Q
    · intro h' hh'
      obtain ⟨j, rfl⟩ := hidx h' hh'
      exact (hcell j).1
    · exact hvac Q'
    · intro h' hh'
      obtain ⟨j, rfl⟩ := hidx h' hh'
      exact (hcell j).2
  rw [htrans]
  exact hNval Q' hQ'N

name: winding_zero_or_one_facets
proof:
:=
  winding_zero_or_one hnpo hnorm fun g hg => by
    obtain ⟨i, hi⟩ := mem_planes_imp hg
    exact hoff i g hi

name: linearIndependent_iff_originApex_affineIndependent
statement:
theorem linearIndependent_iff_originApex_affineIndependent (v0 v1 v2 : Point) :
    LinearIndependent ℚ ![v0, v1, v2] ↔
      AffineIndependent ℚ ![(0 : Point), v0, v1, v2]
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · 
    intro hlin
    rw [Fintype.linearIndependent_iff] at hlin
    rw [affineIndependent_iff]
    intro s w hsum hcomb e he
    
    
    set W : Fin 4 → ℚ := fun i => if i ∈ s then w i else 0 with hW
    have hWmem : ∀ i ∈ s, W i = w i := fun i hi => by simp only [hW, if_pos hi]
    have hWnmem : ∀ i, i ∉ s → W i = 0 := fun i hi => by simp only [hW, if_neg hi]
    have hsum' : W 0 + W 1 + W 2 + W 3 = 0 := by
      have he1 : ∑ i, W i = ∑ i ∈ s, w i := by
        rw [← Finset.sum_subset (Finset.subset_univ s) (fun i _ hi => hWnmem i hi)]
        exact Finset.sum_congr rfl hWmem
      rw [Fin.sum_univ_four] at he1; rw [he1]; exact hsum
    have hcomb' : W 0 • (0 : Point) + W 1 • v0 + W 2 • v1 + W 3 • v2 = 0 := by
      have he2 : ∑ i, W i • (![(0 : Point), v0, v1, v2] i)
          = ∑ i ∈ s, w i • (![(0 : Point), v0, v1, v2] i) := by
        rw [← Finset.sum_subset (Finset.subset_univ s)
          (fun i _ hi => by rw [hWnmem i hi, zero_smul])]
        exact Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun i hi => by rw [hWmem i hi])
      rw [hcomb] at he2
      rw [Fin.sum_univ_four] at he2
      simpa only [Matrix.cons_val_zero, Matrix.cons_val_one, Matrix.head_cons,
        Matrix.cons_val_two, Matrix.tail_cons, Matrix.cons_val_three] using he2
    have hlc : W 1 • v0 + W 2 • v1 + W 3 • v2 = 0 := by
      rw [smul_zero, zero_add] at hcomb'; exact hcomb'
    
    have hcoeff : ∀ k : Fin 3, ![W 1, W 2, W 3] k = 0 := by
      apply hlin ![W 1, W 2, W 3]
      simp only [Fin.sum_univ_three, Matrix.cons_val_zero, Matrix.cons_val_one,
        Matrix.head_cons, Matrix.cons_val_two, Matrix.tail_cons]
      exact hlc
    have h1 : W 1 = 0 := hcoeff 0
    have h2 : W 2 = 0 := hcoeff 1
    have h3 : W 3 = 0 := hcoeff 2
    have hW0 : W 0 = 0 := by rw [h1, h2, h3] at hsum'; linarith
    
    have hWe : W e = 0 := by fin_cases e <;> assumption
    have hWeq : W e = w e := by simp only [hW, if_pos he]
    rw [hWeq] at hWe; exact hWe
  · 
    intro h
    
    rw [affineIndependent_iff] at h
    rw [Fintype.linearIndependent_iff]
    intro ss hst i0
    set ww : Fin 4 → ℚ := ![-(ss 0 + ss 1 + ss 2), ss 0, ss 1, ss 2] with hww
    have hwsum : ∑ i, ww i = 0 := by
      simp only [hww, Fin.sum_univ_four, Matrix.cons_val_zero, Matrix.cons_val_one,
        Matrix.head_cons, Matrix.cons_val_two, Matrix.cons_val_three, Matrix.tail_cons]; ring
    have hwcomb : ∑ i, ww i • (![(0 : Point), v0, v1, v2] i) = 0 := by
      have hst' : ss 0 • v0 + ss 1 • v1 + ss 2 • v2 = 0 := by
        have := hst; rw [Fin.sum_univ_three] at this
        simpa [Matrix.cons_val_zero, Matrix.cons_val_one, Matrix.head_cons,
          Matrix.cons_val_two, Matrix.tail_cons] using this
      simp only [hww, Fin.sum_univ_four, Matrix.cons_val_zero, Matrix.cons_val_one,
        Matrix.head_cons, Matrix.cons_val_two, Matrix.cons_val_three, Matrix.tail_cons]
      rw [smul_zero, zero_add]; linear_combination (norm := module) hst'
    have hz := h Finset.univ ww hwsum hwcomb
    fin_cases i0
    · exact hz 1 (Finset.mem_univ _)
    · exact hz 2 (Finset.mem_univ _)
    · exact hz 3 (Finset.mem_univ _)

name: det3_ne_zero_iff_originApex_affineIndependent
statement:
theorem det3_ne_zero_iff_originApex_affineIndependent (t : Triangle) :
    det3 t.v₀ t.v₁ t.v₂ ≠ 0 ↔ AffineIndependent ℚ ![(0 : Point), t.v₀, t.v₁, t.v₂]
proof:

name: tetraHalf_n_ne_zero
proof:
:= by
  intro g hg
  
  have hAI : AffineIndependent ℚ ![(0 : Point), t.v₀, t.v₁, t.v₂] :=
    (det3_ne_zero_iff_originApex_affineIndependent t).mp hdet
  
  obtain ⟨b, a₀, hbcoe, _hset, _ha₀⟩ := Proof.AffineBasisSimplex.simplexAffineBasis t hAI
  
  obtain ⟨hfwd, _hbwd⟩ := Proof.SimImplWinding.tetra_facet_pos_smul t hAI b hbcoe
  obtain ⟨j, lam, hlampos, hgeq⟩ := hfwd g hg
  
  have hcoord : (b.coord j).linear ≠ 0 := Proof.Planes.affineBasis_coord_linear_ne_zero b j
  
  have hglin : (gOf g).linear ≠ 0 := by
    rw [hgeq]
    exact Proof.SimImplWinding.smul_affine_linear_ne_zero (ne_of_gt hlampos) hcoord
  
  exact (gOf_linear_ne_zero_iff g).mp hglin

name: dotQ_momentDir
statement:
private theorem dotQ_momentDir (n : Point) (r : Nat) :
    dotQ n (momentDir r) = n 0 + n 1 * (r : ℚ) + n 2 * ((r : ℚ) * (r : ℚ))
proof:
:= by
  rw [dotQ_eq_sum, momentDir, Fin.sum_univ_three]
  simp only [mkPoint]
  norm_num [show ((2:Fin 3) = 0) = False from by decide,
    show ((2:Fin 3) = 1) = False from by decide,
    show ((1:Fin 3) = 0) = False from by decide]

name: momentPoly_eval
statement:
private theorem momentPoly_eval (n : Point) (r : Nat) :
    (momentPoly n).eval (r : ℚ) = dotQ n (momentDir r)
proof:
:= by
  rw [dotQ_momentDir, momentPoly]
  simp only [Polynomial.eval_add, Polynomial.eval_mul, Polynomial.eval_C, Polynomial.eval_X,
    Polynomial.eval_pow]
  ring

name: momentPoly_natDegree_le
statement: private theorem momentPoly_natDegree_le (n : Point) : (momentPoly n).natDegree ≤ 2
proof:
:= by
  rw [momentPoly]
  refine le_trans (Polynomial.natDegree_add_le _ _) ?_
  refine max_le ?_ ?_
  · refine le_trans (Polynomial.natDegree_add_le _ _) ?_
    refine max_le (by simp [Polynomial.natDegree_C]) ?_
    refine le_trans (Polynomial.natDegree_mul_le) ?_
    simp [Polynomial.natDegree_C]
  · refine le_trans (Polynomial.natDegree_mul_le) ?_
    simp [Polynomial.natDegree_X_pow_le]

name: momentPoly_ne_zero
statement: private theorem momentPoly_ne_zero {n : Point} (hn : n ≠ 0) : momentPoly n ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  intro hP
  apply hn
  funext i
  
  have hc0 : (momentPoly n).coeff 0 = n 0 := by
    rw [momentPoly]; simp [Polynomial.coeff_C, Polynomial.coeff_X, Polynomial.coeff_X_pow]
  have hc1 : (momentPoly n).coeff 1 = n 1 := by
    rw [momentPoly]; simp [Polynomial.coeff_C, Polynomial.coeff_X, Polynomial.coeff_X_pow]
  have hc2 : (momentPoly n).coeff 2 = n 2 := by
    rw [momentPoly]; simp [Polynomial.coeff_C, Polynomial.coeff_X, Polynomial.coeff_X_pow]
  rw [hP] at hc0 hc1 hc2
  simp only [Polynomial.coeff_zero] at hc0 hc1 hc2
  fin_cases i
  · exact hc0.symm
  · exact hc1.symm
  · exact hc2.symm

name: momentDir_roots_le_two
statement:
theorem momentDir_roots_le_two {n : Point} (hn : n ≠ 0) (N : Nat) :
    ((Finset.Icc 1 N).filter (fun r => dotQ n (momentDir r) = 0)).card ≤ 2
proof:
:= by
  
  set P := momentPoly n with hPdef
  have hP0 : P ≠ 0 := momentPoly_ne_zero hn
  
  have hrootcard : (P.roots.toFinset).card ≤ 2 :=
    le_trans (Multiset.toFinset_card_le P.roots) (le_trans (Polynomial.card_roots' P)
      (momentPoly_natDegree_le n))
  refine le_trans ?_ hrootcard
  
  refine Finset.card_le_card_of_injOn (fun r => (r : ℚ)) ?_ ?_
  · intro r hr
    rw [Finset.mem_filter] at hr
    rw [Multiset.mem_toFinset, Polynomial.mem_roots hP0, Polynomial.IsRoot.def, hPdef,
      momentPoly_eval]
    exact hr.2
  · intro a _ b _ hab
    simp only at hab
    exact_mod_cast hab

name: genericFor_eq_true_iff
statement:
private theorem genericFor_eq_true_iff (ns : Array Point) (dir : Point) :
    genericFor ns dir = true ↔ ∀ i : Fin ns.size, dotQ ns[i] dir ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [genericFor, Array.all_eq_true]
  constructor
  · intro h i; have := h i; simpa using this
  · intro h i; have := h i; simpa using this

name: not_genericFor
proof:
:= by
  by_contra hc; push_neg at hc
  exact h ((genericFor_eq_true_iff ns dir).mpr hc)

name: findGenericR_generic_of_exists
statement:
private theorem findGenericR_generic_of_exists (ns : Array Point) :
    ∀ (fuel start : Nat),
      (∃ r, start ≤ r ∧ r < start + fuel ∧ genericFor ns (momentDir r) = true) →
      genericFor ns (momentDir (findGenericR ns start fuel)) = true
proof:
:= by
  intro fuel
  induction fuel with
  | zero => intro start ⟨r, hr1, hr2, _⟩; omega
  | succ f ih =>
    intro start ⟨r, hr1, hr2, hgen⟩
    rw [findGenericR]
    by_cases hstart : genericFor ns (momentDir start) = true
    · rw [if_pos hstart]; exact hstart
    · rw [if_neg hstart]
      apply ih (start + 1)
      refine ⟨r, ?_, ?_, hgen⟩
      · 
        rcases Nat.lt_or_ge start r with h | h
        · omega
        · 
          have : r = start := le_antisymm h hr1
          rw [this] at hgen; exact absurd hgen hstart
      · omega

name: findGenericR_genericFor
proof:
:= by
  
  apply findGenericR_generic_of_exists
  set N := 2 * ns.size + 1 with hN
  
  set bad := (Finset.Icc 1 N).filter (fun r => genericFor ns (momentDir r) ≠ true) with hbad
  
  have hsub : bad ⊆ (Finset.univ : Finset (Fin ns.size)).biUnion
      (fun i => (Finset.Icc 1 N).filter (fun r => dotQ ns[i] (momentDir r) = 0)) := by
    intro r hr
    rw [hbad, Finset.mem_filter] at hr
    obtain ⟨i, hi0⟩ := not_genericFor ns (momentDir r) hr.2
    rw [Finset.mem_biUnion]
    exact ⟨i, Finset.mem_univ i, Finset.mem_filter.mpr ⟨hr.1, hi0⟩⟩
  
  have hcardbad : bad.card ≤ 2 * ns.size := by
    refine le_trans (Finset.card_le_card hsub) ?_
    refine le_trans (Finset.card_biUnion_le) ?_
    calc ∑ i : Fin ns.size,
            ((Finset.Icc 1 N).filter (fun r => dotQ ns[i] (momentDir r) = 0)).card
          ≤ ∑ _i : Fin ns.size, 2 :=
            Finset.sum_le_sum (fun i _ => momentDir_roots_le_two (hns i) N)
      _ = 2 * ns.size := by rw [Finset.sum_const, Finset.card_univ, Fintype.card_fin]; ring
  
  have hIcc : (Finset.Icc 1 N).card = N := by rw [Nat.card_Icc]; omega
  have hgoodexists : ∃ r ∈ Finset.Icc 1 N, genericFor ns (momentDir r) = true := by
    by_contra hc; push_neg at hc
    
    have hbadeq : bad = Finset.Icc 1 N := by
      rw [hbad]
      apply Finset.filter_true_of_mem
      intro r hr
      exact hc r hr
    rw [hbadeq, hIcc, hN] at hcardbad
    omega
  obtain ⟨r, hrIcc, hrgen⟩ := hgoodexists
  rw [Finset.mem_Icc] at hrIcc
  exact ⟨r, hrIcc.1, by omega, hrgen⟩

name: plane_meets_line_le_one
proof:
:= by
  
  have hlin : ∀ r : ℚ, dotQ n (fun i => p₀ i + r * v i) = dotQ n p₀ + r * dotQ n v := by
    intro r; simp only [dotQ]; ring
  refine ⟨(c - dotQ n p₀) / dotQ n v, ?_, ?_⟩
  · dsimp only; rw [hlin]; field_simp
  · intro r hr
    rw [hlin] at hr
    
    have hh : r * dotQ n v = c - dotQ n p₀ := by linarith
    field_simp
    linarith [hh]

name: mem_arrVerts
statement:
theorem mem_arrVerts {G : Array Half} {p : Point} :
    p ∈ arrVerts G ↔
      ∃ a b c, a < b ∧ b < c ∧ c < G.size ∧ tripleVertex G a b c = some p
proof:
:= by
  rw [arrVerts, mem_dedup_pointBEq]
  constructor
  · intro hmem
    rw [Array.mem_filterMap] at hmem
    obtain ⟨⟨a, b, c⟩, htmem, hsome⟩ := hmem
    rw [mem_planeTriples] at htmem
    exact ⟨a, b, c, htmem.1, htmem.2.1, htmem.2.2, hsome⟩
  · rintro ⟨a, b, c, hab, hbc, hcn, hsome⟩
    rw [Array.mem_filterMap]
    exact ⟨(a, b, c), (mem_planeTriples G.size a b c).mpr ⟨hab, hbc, hcn⟩, hsome⟩

name: finrank_point
statement: private theorem finrank_point : Module.finrank ℚ Point = 3
proof:
:= by
  simp [Point, Module.finrank_pi]

name: finrank_ker_linOf
statement:
private theorem finrank_ker_linOf {n : Point} (hn : n ≠ 0) :
    Module.finrank ℚ (LinearMap.ker (linOf n)) = 2
proof:
:= by
  have hf : (linOf n : Module.Dual ℚ Point) ≠ 0 := (linOf_eq_zero_iff n).not.mpr hn
  have := Module.Dual.finrank_ker_add_one_of_ne_zero (f := linOf n) hf
  rw [finrank_point] at this
  omega

name: not_affineIndependent_four_of_mem_plane
statement:
theorem not_affineIndependent_four_of_mem_plane {n : Point} (hn : n ≠ 0) (c : ℚ) :
    ¬ ∃ (u : Fin 4 → Point), AffineIndependent ℚ u ∧ ∀ i, (∑ k, n k * u i k) = c
proof:
:= by
  rintro ⟨u, hAI, hmem⟩
  
  have hcard : Fintype.card (Fin 4) = 3 + 1 := rfl
  have hfs3 : Module.finrank ℚ (vectorSpan ℚ (Set.range u)) = 3 :=
    hAI.finrank_vectorSpan hcard
  
  have hle : vectorSpan ℚ (Set.range u) ≤ LinearMap.ker (linOf n) := by
    rw [vectorSpan_def]
    rw [Submodule.span_le]
    rintro x hx
    simp only [Set.mem_vsub, Set.mem_range] at hx
    obtain ⟨a, ⟨i, rfl⟩, b, ⟨j, rfl⟩, rfl⟩ := hx
    rw [SetLike.mem_coe, LinearMap.mem_ker]
    
    rw [show (u i -ᵥ u j) = u i - u j from rfl, map_sub, linOf_apply, linOf_apply,
      hmem i, hmem j, sub_self]
  
  have hmono : Module.finrank ℚ (vectorSpan ℚ (Set.range u))
      ≤ Module.finrank ℚ (LinearMap.ker (linOf n)) := Submodule.finrank_mono hle
  rw [hfs3, finrank_ker_linOf hn] at hmono
  omega

name: dotQ_zero_right
statement: private theorem dotQ_zero_right (n : Point) : dotQ n (0 : Point) = 0
proof:
:= by

name: dotQ_zero_left

name: convex_dotQ_zero
statement: private theorem convex_dotQ_zero (n : Point) : Convex ℚ {x : Point | dotQ n x = 0}
proof:
:= by
  have hset : {x : Point | dotQ n x = 0} = (LinearMap.ker (linOf n) : Set Point) := by
    ext x
    simp only [Set.mem_setOf_eq, SetLike.mem_coe, LinearMap.mem_ker, linOf_apply,
      ← dotQ_eq_sum]
  rw [hset]
  exact (LinearMap.ker (linOf n)).convex

name: simplex_subset_dotQ_zero
proof:
:= by
  unfold simplex
  apply convexHull_min _ (convex_dotQ_zero n)
  intro x hx
  simp only [Set.mem_insert_iff, Set.mem_singleton_iff] at hx
  rcases hx with rfl | rfl | rfl | rfl
  · exact dotQ_zero_right n
  · exact h0
  · exact h1
  · exact h2

name: crossQ_self
statement: private theorem crossQ_self (a : Point) : crossQ a a = 0
proof:
:= by
  funext i; fin_cases i <;> simp [crossQ, mkPoint] <;> ring

name: crossQ_antisymm
statement: private theorem crossQ_antisymm (a b : Point) : crossQ a b = - crossQ b a
proof:
:= by
  funext i; fin_cases i <;> simp [crossQ, mkPoint] <;> ring

name: dotQ_crossQ_swap
statement:
private theorem dotQ_crossQ_swap (u v w : Point) :
    dotQ (crossQ u w) v = - dotQ (crossQ u v) w
proof:
:= by
  rw [dotQ_crossQ_det, dotQ_crossQ_det]
  
  simp only [det3_expand]; ring

name: point_eq_zero_iff
statement: private theorem point_eq_zero_iff (p : Point) : p = 0 ↔ p 0 = 0 ∧ p 1 = 0 ∧ p 2 = 0
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro h; subst h; exact ⟨rfl, rfl, rfl⟩
  · rintro ⟨h0, h1, h2⟩; funext i; fin_cases i <;> assumption

name: u_zero_of_cross_basis_zero
proof:
:= by
  rw [point_eq_zero_iff]
  
  have e0 := h0; have e1 := h1
  rw [point_eq_zero_iff] at e0 e1
  simp only [crossQ, mkPoint] at e0 e1
  norm_num [show ((2:Fin 3) = 0) = False from by decide,
    show ((2:Fin 3) = 1) = False from by decide,
    show ((1:Fin 3) = 0) = False from by decide,
    show ((0:Fin 3) = 1) = False from by decide] at e0 e1
  exact ⟨e1.2, e0.2, e0.1⟩

name: cross01_dots
statement:
private theorem cross01_dots {v0 v1 v2 : Point} (hdet : det3 v0 v1 v2 = 0) :
    dotQ (crossQ v0 v1) v0 = 0 ∧ dotQ (crossQ v0 v1) v1 = 0 ∧ dotQ (crossQ v0 v1) v2 = 0
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨dotQ_crossQ_left v0 v1, dotQ_crossQ_right v0 v1, ?_⟩
  rw [dotQ_crossQ_det]
  
  rw [show det3 v2 v0 v1 = det3 v0 v1 v2 by simp only [det3_expand]; ring]; exact hdet

name: cross02_dots
statement:
private theorem cross02_dots {v0 v1 v2 : Point} (hdet : det3 v0 v1 v2 = 0) :
    dotQ (crossQ v0 v2) v0 = 0 ∧ dotQ (crossQ v0 v2) v1 = 0 ∧ dotQ (crossQ v0 v2) v2 = 0
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨dotQ_crossQ_left v0 v2, ?_, dotQ_crossQ_right v0 v2⟩
  rw [dotQ_crossQ_det]
  
  rw [show det3 v1 v0 v2 = - det3 v0 v1 v2 by simp only [det3_expand]; ring, hdet, neg_zero]

name: cross12_dots
statement:
private theorem cross12_dots {v0 v1 v2 : Point} (hdet : det3 v0 v1 v2 = 0) :
    dotQ (crossQ v1 v2) v0 = 0 ∧ dotQ (crossQ v1 v2) v1 = 0 ∧ dotQ (crossQ v1 v2) v2 = 0
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨?_, dotQ_crossQ_left v1 v2, dotQ_crossQ_right v1 v2⟩
  rw [dotQ_crossQ_det]; exact hdet

name: degenBarrierNormal_crossbasis_case
proof:
:= by
  
  
  have hannih : ∀ e : Point, dotQ (crossQ u e) v0 = 0 ∧ dotQ (crossQ u e) v1 = 0
      ∧ dotQ (crossQ u e) v2 = 0 := fun e =>
    ⟨by rw [dotQ_crossQ_swap, huv0, dotQ_zero_left, neg_zero],
      by rw [dotQ_crossQ_swap, huv1, dotQ_zero_left, neg_zero],
      by rw [dotQ_crossQ_swap, huv2, dotQ_zero_left, neg_zero]⟩
  
  have pbeq : ∀ w : Point, (!pointBEq w z) = decide (w ≠ 0) := by
    intro w
    by_cases hw : w = 0
    · subst hw; simp [pointBEq_iff, hzeq]
    · have : pointBEq w z = false := by
        rw [← Bool.not_eq_true, pointBEq_iff, hzeq]; exact hw
      rw [this]; simp [hw]
  
  by_cases hcr0 : crossQ u (mkPoint 1 0 0) = 0
  · rw [show (!pointBEq (crossQ u (mkPoint 1 0 0)) z) = false by rw [pbeq]; simp [hcr0]]
    rw [if_neg (by simp)]
    by_cases hcr1 : crossQ u (mkPoint 0 1 0) = 0
    · exact absurd (u_zero_of_cross_basis_zero hcr0 hcr1) hune
    · rw [show (!pointBEq (crossQ u (mkPoint 0 1 0)) z) = true by rw [pbeq]; simp [hcr1]]
      rw [if_pos (by simp)]
      exact ⟨hcr1, (hannih _).1, (hannih _).2.1, (hannih _).2.2⟩
  · rw [show (!pointBEq (crossQ u (mkPoint 1 0 0)) z) = true by rw [pbeq]; simp [hcr0]]
    rw [if_pos (by simp)]
    exact ⟨hcr0, (hannih _).1, (hannih _).2.1, (hannih _).2.2⟩

name: degenBarrierNormal_spec
statement:
theorem degenBarrierNormal_spec {t : Triangle}
    (hdet : det3 t.v₀ t.v₁ t.v₂ = 0) :
    degenBarrierNormal t ≠ 0
      ∧ dotQ (degenBarrierNormal t) t.v₀ = 0
      ∧ dotQ (degenBarrierNormal t) t.v₁ = 0
      ∧ dotQ (degenBarrierNormal t) t.v₂ = 0
      ∧ simplex t ⊆ {x : Point | dotQ (degenBarrierNormal t) x = 0}
proof:
:= by
  
  
  suffices h : degenBarrierNormal t ≠ 0
      ∧ dotQ (degenBarrierNormal t) t.v₀ = 0
      ∧ dotQ (degenBarrierNormal t) t.v₁ = 0
      ∧ dotQ (degenBarrierNormal t) t.v₂ = 0 by
    obtain ⟨hne, h0, h1, h2⟩ := h
    exact ⟨hne, h0, h1, h2, simplex_subset_dotQ_zero h0 h1 h2⟩
  
  obtain ⟨v0, v1, v2⟩ := t
  simp only at hdet ⊢
  have hzeq : (mkPoint 0 0 0 : Point) = (0 : Point) := by funext i; fin_cases i <;> rfl
  
  have pbT : ∀ w : Point, w = 0 → pointBEq w (mkPoint 0 0 0) = true := fun w hw => by
    rw [pointBEq_iff, hzeq]; exact hw
  have pbF : ∀ w : Point, w ≠ 0 → pointBEq w (mkPoint 0 0 0) = false := fun w hw => by
    rw [← Bool.not_eq_true, pointBEq_iff, hzeq]; exact hw
  
  by_cases hc01 : crossQ v0 v1 = 0
  · by_cases hc02 : crossQ v0 v2 = 0
    · by_cases hc12 : crossQ v1 v2 = 0
      · 
        have c10 : crossQ v1 v0 = 0 := by rw [crossQ_antisymm, hc01, neg_zero]
        have c20 : crossQ v2 v0 = 0 := by rw [crossQ_antisymm, hc02, neg_zero]
        have c21 : crossQ v2 v1 = 0 := by rw [crossQ_antisymm, hc12, neg_zero]
        
        by_cases hu0 : v0 = 0
        · by_cases hu1 : v1 = 0
          · by_cases hu2 : v2 = 0
            · 
              simp only [degenBarrierNormal, pbT _ hc01, pbT _ hc02, pbT _ hc12,
                pbT _ hu0, pbT _ hu1, pbT _ hu2, Bool.not_true, Bool.false_eq_true, if_false,
                if_true]
              refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
              · intro h; have := congrFun h 0; simp [mkPoint] at this
              · rw [hu0]; exact dotQ_zero_right _
              · rw [hu1]; exact dotQ_zero_right _
              · rw [hu2]; exact dotQ_zero_right _
            · 
              simp only [degenBarrierNormal, pbT _ hc01, pbT _ hc02, pbT _ hc12,
                pbT _ hu0, pbT _ hu1, pbF _ hu2, Bool.not_true, Bool.not_false,
                Bool.false_eq_true, if_false, if_true]
              exact degenBarrierNormal_crossbasis_case (u := v2) hzeq hu2
                c20 c21 (crossQ_self v2)
          · 
            simp only [degenBarrierNormal, pbT _ hc01, pbT _ hc02, pbT _ hc12,
              pbT _ hu0, pbF _ hu1, Bool.not_true, Bool.not_false,
              Bool.false_eq_true, if_false, if_true]
            exact degenBarrierNormal_crossbasis_case (u := v1) hzeq hu1
              c10 (crossQ_self v1) hc12
        · 
          simp only [degenBarrierNormal, pbT _ hc01, pbT _ hc02, pbT _ hc12,
            pbF _ hu0, Bool.not_true, Bool.not_false, Bool.false_eq_true, if_false, if_true]
          exact degenBarrierNormal_crossbasis_case (u := v0) hzeq hu0
            (crossQ_self v0) hc01 hc02
      · 
        simp only [degenBarrierNormal, pbT _ hc01, pbT _ hc02, pbF _ hc12,
          Bool.not_true, Bool.not_false, Bool.false_eq_true, if_false, if_true]
        obtain ⟨d0, d1, d2⟩ := cross12_dots hdet
        exact ⟨hc12, d0, d1, d2⟩
    · 
      simp only [degenBarrierNormal, pbT _ hc01, pbF _ hc02,
        Bool.not_true, Bool.not_false, Bool.false_eq_true, if_false, if_true]
      obtain ⟨d0, d1, d2⟩ := cross02_dots hdet
      exact ⟨hc02, d0, d1, d2⟩
  · 
    simp only [degenBarrierNormal, pbF _ hc01,
      Bool.not_true, Bool.not_false, Bool.false_eq_true, if_false, if_true]
    obtain ⟨d0, d1, d2⟩ := cross01_dots hdet
    exact ⟨hc01, d0, d1, d2⟩

name: unitCube_size
statement: theorem unitCube_size : unitCube.size = 12
proof: := rfl

name: cube_cyc
statement: theorem cube_cyc : IsClosedOrientedSurface unitCube
proof:
:= by
  unfold IsClosedOrientedSurface
  decide

name: cubeGet
statement: theorem cubeGet (i : Fin unitCube.size) : unitCube[i] = faceOf ⟨i, i.isLt⟩
proof:
:= by
  fin_cases i <;> rfl

name: faceNormal_table
statement: theorem faceNormal_table (i : Fin 12) : faceNormal (faceOf i) = fnOf i
proof:
:= by
  fin_cases i <;>
    (funext k; fin_cases k <;>
      simp only [faceOf, fnOf, faceNormal, Fin.isValue,
        show ((⟨0, by decide⟩ : Fin 3)) = (0 : Fin 3) from rfl,
        show ((⟨1, by decide⟩ : Fin 3)) = (1 : Fin 3) from rfl,
        show ((⟨2, by decide⟩ : Fin 3)) = (2 : Fin 3) from rfl,
        Fin.reduceAdd, Matrix.cons_val_zero, Matrix.cons_val_one, Matrix.head_cons,
        Matrix.cons_val_two, Matrix.tail_cons] <;> norm_num)

name: axis_ne_zero
statement:
private theorem axis_ne_zero {a b c : ℚ} (h : a ≠ 0 ∨ b ≠ 0 ∨ c ≠ 0) :
    (![a,b,c] : Point) ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  intro he
  have e0 := congrFun he 0; have e1 := congrFun he 1; have e2 := congrFun he 2
  simp only [Matrix.cons_val_zero, Matrix.cons_val_one, Matrix.head_cons, Matrix.cons_val_two,
    Matrix.tail_cons, Pi.zero_apply] at e0 e1 e2
  rcases h with h | h | h
  · exact h e0
  · exact h e1
  · exact h e2

name: faceNormal_ne
statement: theorem faceNormal_ne (i : Fin 12) : faceNormal (faceOf i) ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [faceNormal_table]; fin_cases i <;> exact axis_ne_zero (by norm_num)

name: cube_ndf
statement: theorem cube_ndf : NoDegenerateFaces unitCube
proof:
:= by
  intro i; rw [cubeGet]; exact faceNormal_ne _

name: ee0_table
statement: theorem ee0_table (i : Fin 12) (P : Point) : ee0 (faceOf i) P = eeExpr0 i P
proof:
:= by
  fin_cases i <;> (simp only [eeExpr0]; eeUnfold; ring)

name: ee1_table
statement: theorem ee1_table (i : Fin 12) (P : Point) : ee1 (faceOf i) P = eeExpr1 i P
proof:
:= by
  fin_cases i <;> (simp only [eeExpr1]; eeUnfold; ring)

name: ee2_table
statement: theorem ee2_table (i : Fin 12) (P : Point) : ee2 (faceOf i) P = eeExpr2 i P
proof:
:= by
  fin_cases i <;> (simp only [eeExpr2]; eeUnfold; ring)

name: dotFN_table
statement:
theorem dotFN_table (i : Fin 12) (P : Point) :
    dot (faceNormal (faceOf i)) P = carrierExpr i P
proof:
:= by
  fin_cases i <;> (simp only [carrierExpr]; eeUnfold; ring)

name: cOf_table
statement: theorem cOf_table (i : Fin 12) : cOf (faceOf i) = bOf i
proof:
:= by
  fin_cases i <;> (simp only [bOf]; eeUnfold; ring)

name: cube_nfic
statement: theorem cube_nfic : NoFaceInteriorContact unitCube
proof:
:= by
  intro i j hij P hP
  obtain ⟨hi, hj⟩ := hP
  rw [cubeGet] at hi hj
  rw [show unitCube[i] = faceOf ⟨i, i.isLt⟩ from cubeGet i]
  have hcarI := triangleSet_carrier hi
  have hcarJ := triangleSet_carrier hj
  obtain ⟨hi0, hi1, hi2⟩ := ee_nonneg_of_mem hi
  obtain ⟨hj0, hj1, hj2⟩ := ee_nonneg_of_mem hj
  have hijf : (⟨i, i.isLt⟩ : Fin 12) ≠ ⟨j, j.isLt⟩ :=
    fun h => hij (Fin.ext (by simpa using congrArg Fin.val h))
  refine mem_edgeSet_of_carrier' (faceNormal_ne _) hcarI hi0 hi1 hi2 ?_
  
  simp only [ee0_table, ee1_table, ee2_table] at hi0 hi1 hi2 hj0 hj1 hj2 ⊢
  simp only [dotFN_table, cOf_table] at hcarI hcarJ
  clear hi hj
  fin_cases i <;> fin_cases j <;>
    first
    | exact absurd rfl hijf
    | (simp only [eeExpr0, eeExpr1, eeExpr2, carrierExpr, bOf] at hcarI hcarJ hi0 hi1 hi2 hj0 hj1 hj2 ⊢
       first
       | (left; linarith) | (right; left; linarith) | (right; right; linarith))

name: mem_box
statement:
theorem mem_box (i : Fin 12) {P : Point} (hP : P ∈ triangleSet (faceOf i)) (k : Fin 3) :
    0 ≤ P k ∧ P k ≤ 1
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
  · have hb := Proof.SurfaceBridge.triangleSet_coord_bounded_lo hP k
    have hlo : min ((faceOf i).v₀ k) (min ((faceOf i).v₁ k) ((faceOf i).v₂ k)) = 0 ∨
        min ((faceOf i).v₀ k) (min ((faceOf i).v₁ k) ((faceOf i).v₂ k)) = 1 := by
      fin_cases i <;> fin_cases k <;>
        simp only [faceOf, Fin.isValue,
          show ((⟨0, by decide⟩ : Fin 3)) = (0 : Fin 3) from rfl,
          show ((⟨1, by decide⟩ : Fin 3)) = (1 : Fin 3) from rfl,
          show ((⟨2, by decide⟩ : Fin 3)) = (2 : Fin 3) from rfl,
          Matrix.cons_val_zero, Matrix.cons_val_one, Matrix.head_cons, Matrix.cons_val_two,
          Matrix.tail_cons] <;> norm_num
    rcases hlo with h | h <;> rw [h] at hb <;> linarith
  · have hb := Proof.SurfaceBridge.triangleSet_coord_bounded hP k
    have hhi : max ((faceOf i).v₀ k) (max ((faceOf i).v₁ k) ((faceOf i).v₂ k)) = 0 ∨
        max ((faceOf i).v₀ k) (max ((faceOf i).v₁ k) ((faceOf i).v₂ k)) = 1 := by
      fin_cases i <;> fin_cases k <;>
        simp only [faceOf, Fin.isValue,
          show ((⟨0, by decide⟩ : Fin 3)) = (0 : Fin 3) from rfl,
          show ((⟨1, by decide⟩ : Fin 3)) = (1 : Fin 3) from rfl,
          show ((⟨2, by decide⟩ : Fin 3)) = (2 : Fin 3) from rfl,
          Matrix.cons_val_zero, Matrix.cons_val_one, Matrix.head_cons, Matrix.cons_val_two,
          Matrix.tail_cons] <;> norm_num
    rcases hhi with h | h <;> rw [h] at hb <;> linarith

name: not_mem_below
statement:
theorem not_mem_below (i : Fin 12) {x : Point} {k : Fin 3} (h : x k < 0) :
    x ∉ triangleSet (faceOf i)
proof: := fun hx => absurd (mem_box i hx k).1 (not_le.mpr h)

name: not_mem_above
statement:
theorem not_mem_above (i : Fin 12) {x : Point} {k : Fin 3} (h : 1 < x k) :
    x ∉ triangleSet (faceOf i)
proof: := fun hx => absurd (mem_box i hx k).2 (not_le.mpr h)

name: mem_faceOf
statement:
theorem mem_faceOf (i : Fin 12) {P : Point} (hcar : carrierExpr i P = bOf i)
    (h0 : 0 ≤ eeExpr0 i P) (h1 : 0 ≤ eeExpr1 i P) (h2 : 0 ≤ eeExpr2 i P) :
    P ∈ triangleSet (faceOf i)
proof:
:= by
  refine mem_triangleSet_of_carrier' (faceNormal_ne i) ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_
  · rw [dotFN_table, cOf_table]; exact hcar
  · rw [ee0_table]; exact h0
  · rw [ee1_table]; exact h1
  · rw [ee2_table]; exact h2

name: cube_tiling
statement:
theorem cube_tiling (P : Point) (hbox : ∀ k, 0 ≤ P k ∧ P k ≤ 1) (k : Fin 3)
    (hk : P k = 0 ∨ P k = 1) : ∃ i, P ∈ triangleSet (faceOf i)
proof:
:= by
  have b0 := hbox 0; have b1 := hbox 1; have b2 := hbox 2
  fin_cases k <;>
    simp only [show ((⟨0, by decide⟩ : Fin 3)) = (0 : Fin 3) from rfl,
      show ((⟨1, by decide⟩ : Fin 3)) = (1 : Fin 3) from rfl,
      show ((⟨2, by decide⟩ : Fin 3)) = (2 : Fin 3) from rfl] at hk <;>
    rcases hk with hk | hk
  · rcases le_total (P 1) (P 2) with h | h
    · exact ⟨4, mem_faceOf 4 (by simp only [carrierExpr, bOf]; linarith)
        (by simp only [eeExpr0]; linarith) (by simp only [eeExpr1]; linarith)
        (by simp only [eeExpr2]; linarith)⟩
    · exact ⟨5, mem_faceOf 5 (by simp only [carrierExpr, bOf]; linarith)
        (by simp only [eeExpr0]; linarith) (by simp only [eeExpr1]; linarith)
        (by simp only [eeExpr2]; linarith)⟩
  · rcases le_total (P 2) (P 1) with h | h
    · exact ⟨6, mem_faceOf 6 (by simp only [carrierExpr, bOf]; linarith)
        (by simp only [eeExpr0]; linarith) (by simp only [eeExpr1]; linarith)
        (by simp only [eeExpr2]; linarith)⟩
    · exact ⟨7, mem_faceOf 7 (by simp only [carrierExpr, bOf]; linarith)
        (by simp only [eeExpr0]; linarith) (by simp only [eeExpr1]; linarith)
        (by simp only [eeExpr2]; linarith)⟩
  · rcases le_total (P 2) (P 0) with h | h
    · exact ⟨8, mem_faceOf 8 (by simp only [carrierExpr, bOf]; linarith)
        (by simp only [eeExpr0]; linarith) (by simp only [eeExpr1]; linarith)
        (by simp only [eeExpr2]; linarith)⟩
    · exact ⟨9, mem_faceOf 9 (by simp only [carrierExpr, bOf]; linarith)
        (by simp only [eeExpr0]; linarith) (by simp only [eeExpr1]; linarith)
        (by simp only [eeExpr2]; linarith)⟩
  · rcases le_total (P 0) (P 2) with h | h
    · exact ⟨10, mem_faceOf 10 (by simp only [carrierExpr, bOf]; linarith)
        (by simp only [eeExpr0]; linarith) (by simp only [eeExpr1]; linarith)
        (by simp only [eeExpr2]; linarith)⟩
    · exact ⟨11, mem_faceOf 11 (by simp only [carrierExpr, bOf]; linarith)
        (by simp only [eeExpr0]; linarith) (by simp only [eeExpr1]; linarith)
        (by simp only [eeExpr2]; linarith)⟩
  · rcases le_total (P 0) (P 1) with h | h
    · exact ⟨0, mem_faceOf 0 (by simp only [carrierExpr, bOf]; linarith)
        (by simp only [eeExpr0]; linarith) (by simp only [eeExpr1]; linarith)
        (by simp only [eeExpr2]; linarith)⟩
    · exact ⟨1, mem_faceOf 1 (by simp only [carrierExpr, bOf]; linarith)
        (by simp only [eeExpr0]; linarith) (by simp only [eeExpr1]; linarith)
        (by simp only [eeExpr2]; linarith)⟩
  · rcases le_total (P 1) (P 0) with h | h
    · exact ⟨2, mem_faceOf 2 (by simp only [carrierExpr, bOf]; linarith)
        (by simp only [eeExpr0]; linarith) (by simp only [eeExpr1]; linarith)
        (by simp only [eeExpr2]; linarith)⟩
    · exact ⟨3, mem_faceOf 3 (by simp only [carrierExpr, bOf]; linarith)
        (by simp only [eeExpr0]; linarith) (by simp only [eeExpr1]; linarith)
        (by simp only [eeExpr2]; linarith)⟩

name: mem_surface_iff
statement:
theorem mem_surface_iff (P : Point) :
    P ∈ Proof.surface unitCube ↔ ∃ i : Fin 12, P ∈ triangleSet (faceOf i)
proof:
:= by
  rw [Proof.surface, Set.mem_iUnion]
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨i, hi⟩; rw [cubeGet] at hi; exact ⟨⟨i, i.isLt⟩, hi⟩
  · rintro ⟨i, hi⟩
    have hlt : (i : Nat) < unitCube.size := by rw [unitCube_size]; exact i.isLt
    exact ⟨⟨i, hlt⟩, by rw [cubeGet]; exact hi⟩

name: openCube_off_surface
statement: theorem openCube_off_surface {Q : Point} (hQ : Q ∈ openCube) : Q ∉ Proof.surface unitCube
proof:
:= by
  rw [mem_surface_iff]; rintro ⟨i, hi⟩
  obtain ⟨k, hlt⟩ : ∃ k : Fin 3, Q k = 0 ∨ Q k = 1 := by
    
    have hcar := triangleSet_carrier hi
    rw [dotFN_table, cOf_table] at hcar
    fin_cases i <;>
      first
      | exact ⟨2, by left; simp only [carrierExpr, bOf] at hcar; linarith⟩
      | exact ⟨2, by right; simp only [carrierExpr, bOf] at hcar; linarith⟩
      | exact ⟨0, by left; simp only [carrierExpr, bOf] at hcar; linarith⟩
      | exact ⟨0, by right; simp only [carrierExpr, bOf] at hcar; linarith⟩
      | exact ⟨1, by left; simp only [carrierExpr, bOf] at hcar; linarith⟩
      | exact ⟨1, by right; simp only [carrierExpr, bOf] at hcar; linarith⟩
  rcases hlt with h | h
  · exact absurd h (ne_of_gt (hQ k).1)
  · exact absurd h (ne_of_lt (hQ k).2)

name: offSurface_class
statement:
theorem offSurface_class {Q : Point} (hQ : Q ∉ Proof.surface unitCube) :
    Q ∈ openCube ∨ ∃ k, Q k < 0 ∨ 1 < Q k
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hbox : ∀ k, 0 ≤ Q k ∧ Q k ≤ 1
  · left
    intro k
    refine ⟨lt_of_le_of_ne (hbox k).1 (fun h => ?_), lt_of_le_of_ne (hbox k).2 (fun h => ?_)⟩
    · exact hQ (mem_surface_iff Q |>.mpr (cube_tiling Q hbox k (Or.inl h.symm)))
    · exact hQ (mem_surface_iff Q |>.mpr (cube_tiling Q hbox k (Or.inr h)))
  · right
    push_neg at hbox
    obtain ⟨k, hk⟩ := hbox
    by_cases h0 : 0 ≤ Q k
    · exact ⟨k, Or.inr (hk h0)⟩
    · exact ⟨k, Or.inl (not_le.mp h0)⟩

name: cc_faceOf
statement:
theorem cc_faceOf (Q d : Point) :
    crossingCount unitCube Q d
      = ∑ u : Fin unitCube.size, crossSummand (faceOf ⟨u, u.isLt⟩) Q d
proof:
:= by
  rw [crossingCount_eq_sum]
  exact Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun u _ => by rw [cubeGet])

name: ek_self
statement: theorem ek_self (k : Fin 3) : ek k k = 1
proof: := by simp [ek]

name: ek_ne
statement: theorem ek_ne (k : Fin 3) : ek k ≠ 0
proof:
:= fun h => by
  have := congrFun h k; rw [ek_self] at this; norm_num at this

name: neg_ek_ne
statement: theorem neg_ek_ne (k : Fin 3) : (- ek k) ≠ 0
proof:
:=
  fun h => ek_ne k (by rw [← neg_neg (ek k), h, neg_zero])

name: exterior_ray
statement:
theorem exterior_ray {Q d : Point} (hd : d ≠ 0)
    (hray : ∀ (i : Fin 12) (s : ℚ), 0 < s → Q + s • d ∉ triangleSet (faceOf i)) :
    AdmissibleRay unitCube Q d ∧ crossingCount unitCube Q d = 0
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨⟨hd, ?_⟩, ?_⟩
  · intro i s hs hmem
    rw [cubeGet] at hmem
    exact hray ⟨i, i.isLt⟩ s hs
      (Proof.MeshIntersectRayClassify.edgeSet_subset_triangleSet _ hmem)
  · rw [cc_faceOf]
    refine Finset.sum_eq_zero (fun u _ => ?_)
    unfold crossSummand; rw [if_neg]; rintro ⟨s, hs, hmem⟩
    exact hray ⟨u, u.isLt⟩ s hs hmem

name: cube_count_exterior_lo
statement:
theorem cube_count_exterior_lo {Q : Point} {k : Fin 3} (hQ : Q k < 0) :
    AdmissibleRay unitCube Q (- ek k) ∧ crossingCount unitCube Q (- ek k) = 0
proof:
:= by
  apply exterior_ray (neg_ek_ne k); intro i s hs
  apply not_mem_below i (k := k)
  simp only [Pi.add_apply, Pi.smul_apply, Pi.neg_apply, smul_eq_mul, ek_self]; nlinarith [hQ, hs]

name: cube_count_exterior_hi
statement:
theorem cube_count_exterior_hi {Q : Point} {k : Fin 3} (hQ : 1 < Q k) :
    AdmissibleRay unitCube Q (ek k) ∧ crossingCount unitCube Q (ek k) = 0
proof:
:= by
  apply exterior_ray (ek_ne k); intro i s hs
  apply not_mem_above i (k := k)
  simp only [Pi.add_apply, Pi.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul, ek_self]; nlinarith [hQ, hs]

name: ray_pt
statement:
theorem ray_pt (Q : Point) (s : ℚ) (k : Fin 3) :
    (Q + s • (cen - Q)) k = (1 - s) * Q k + s * cen k
proof:
:= by
  simp only [Pi.add_apply, Pi.smul_apply, Pi.sub_apply, smul_eq_mul]; ring

name: ray_at_one
statement: theorem ray_at_one (Q : Point) : Q + (1 : ℚ) • (cen - Q) = cen
proof: := by funext k; rw [ray_pt]; ring

name: ray_openCube
statement:
theorem ray_openCube {Q : Point} (hQ : Q ∈ openCube) {s : ℚ} (hs0 : 0 < s) (hs1 : s < 1) :
    (Q + s • (cen - Q)) ∈ openCube
proof:
:= by
  intro k; rw [ray_pt]
  have h0 := hQ 0; have h1 := hQ 1; have h2 := hQ 2
  fin_cases k <;>
    simp only [show ((⟨0, by decide⟩ : Fin 3)) = (0 : Fin 3) from rfl,
      show ((⟨1, by decide⟩ : Fin 3)) = (1 : Fin 3) from rfl,
      show ((⟨2, by decide⟩ : Fin 3)) = (2 : Fin 3) from rfl,
      show cen 0 = 1/3 from rfl, show cen 1 = 2/3 from rfl, show cen 2 = 0 from rfl]
  · constructor <;> nlinarith [h0.1, h0.2, hs0, hs1]
  · constructor <;> nlinarith [h1.1, h1.2, hs0, hs1]
  · constructor <;> nlinarith [h2.1, h2.2, hs0, hs1]

name: ray_z_neg
statement:
theorem ray_z_neg {Q : Point} (hQ : Q ∈ openCube) {s : ℚ} (hs : 1 < s) :
    (Q + s • (cen - Q)) 2 < 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [ray_pt]; simp only [show cen 2 = 0 from rfl]; have := (hQ 2).1; nlinarith

name: cen_in_face0
statement: theorem cen_in_face0 : cen ∈ triangleSet (faceOf 0)
proof:
:= by
  apply mem_faceOf 0
  · simp only [carrierExpr, bOf, show cen 2 = 0 from rfl]; norm_num
  · simp only [eeExpr0, show cen 0 = 1/3 from rfl]; norm_num
  · simp only [eeExpr1, show cen 1 = 2/3 from rfl]; norm_num
  · simp only [eeExpr2, show cen 0 = 1/3 from rfl, show cen 1 = 2/3 from rfl]; norm_num

name: cen_not_edge0
statement: theorem cen_not_edge0 : cen ∉ edgeSet (faceOf 0)
proof:
:=
  (mem_triangleSet_not_edge_of_carrier' (P := cen) (faceNormal_ne 0)
    (by rw [dotFN_table, cOf_table]; simp only [carrierExpr, bOf, show cen 2 = 0 from rfl]; norm_num)
    (by rw [ee0_table]; simp only [eeExpr0, show cen 0 = 1/3 from rfl]; norm_num)
    (by rw [ee1_table]; simp only [eeExpr1, show cen 1 = 2/3 from rfl]; norm_num)
    (by rw [ee2_table]; simp only [eeExpr2, show cen 0 = 1/3 from rfl,
        show cen 1 = 2/3 from rfl]; norm_num)).2

name: cen_not_face
statement: theorem cen_not_face {j : Fin 12} (hj : j ≠ 0) : cen ∉ triangleSet (faceOf j)
proof:
:= by
  intro hmem
  have hcar := triangleSet_carrier hmem; rw [dotFN_table, cOf_table] at hcar
  obtain ⟨e0, e1, e2⟩ := ee_nonneg_of_mem hmem
  rw [ee0_table] at e0; rw [ee1_table] at e1; rw [ee2_table] at e2
  fin_cases j <;>
    (first
      | exact absurd rfl hj
      | (revert hcar e0 e1 e2
         simp only [carrierExpr, bOf, eeExpr0, eeExpr1, eeExpr2,
           show cen 0 = 1/3 from rfl, show cen 1 = 2/3 from rfl, show cen 2 = 0 from rfl]
         intros; linarith))

name: openCube_off_face
statement:
theorem openCube_off_face {Q : Point} (hQ : Q ∈ openCube) (i : Fin 12) :
    Q ∉ triangleSet (faceOf i)
proof:
:=
  fun hmem => openCube_off_surface hQ (mem_surface_iff Q |>.mpr ⟨i, hmem⟩)

name: interior_ray_off
statement:
theorem interior_ray_off {Q : Point} (hQ : Q ∈ openCube) (j : Fin 12) (s : ℚ) (hs : 0 < s)
    (hnot : ¬ (j = 0 ∧ s = 1)) : Q + s • (cen - Q) ∉ triangleSet (faceOf j)
proof:
:= by
  rcases lt_trichotomy s 1 with h | h | h
  · exact openCube_off_face (ray_openCube hQ hs h) j
  · subst h; rw [ray_at_one]
    by_cases hj : j = 0
    · exact absurd ⟨hj, rfl⟩ hnot
    · exact cen_not_face hj
  · exact not_mem_below j (k := 2) (ray_z_neg hQ h)

name: dot_n0
statement: theorem dot_n0 (Q : Point) : dot (faceNormal (faceOf 0)) (cen - Q) = Q 2
proof:
:= by
  rw [dotFN_table]; simp only [carrierExpr, Pi.sub_apply, show cen 2 = 0 from rfl]; ring

name: cube_count_interior
statement:
theorem cube_count_interior {Q : Point} (hQ : Q ∈ openCube) :
    AdmissibleRay unitCube Q (cen - Q) ∧ crossingCount unitCube Q (cen - Q) = 1
proof:
:= by
  have hd : (cen - Q) ≠ 0 := by
    intro h; have h2 := congrFun h 2
    simp only [Pi.sub_apply, Pi.zero_apply, show cen 2 = 0 from rfl] at h2
    have := (hQ 2).1; linarith
  refine ⟨⟨hd, ?_⟩, ?_⟩
  · intro u s hs hmem
    rw [cubeGet] at hmem
    by_cases hj1 : (⟨u, u.isLt⟩ : Fin 12) = 0 ∧ s = 1
    · obtain ⟨hj0, hs1⟩ := hj1
      rw [hj0, hs1, ray_at_one] at hmem; exact cen_not_edge0 hmem
    · exact interior_ray_off hQ ⟨u, u.isLt⟩ s hs hj1
        (Proof.MeshIntersectRayClassify.edgeSet_subset_triangleSet _ hmem)
  · rw [cc_faceOf, Finset.sum_eq_single ⟨0, by rw [unitCube_size]; norm_num⟩]
    · show crossSummand (faceOf 0) Q (cen - Q) = 1
      unfold crossSummand
      rw [if_pos ⟨1, one_pos, by rw [ray_at_one]; exact cen_in_face0⟩,
        if_pos (by rw [dot_n0]; exact (hQ 2).1)]
    · intro u _ hu
      unfold crossSummand; rw [if_neg]; rintro ⟨s, hs, hmem⟩
      refine interior_ray_off hQ ⟨u, u.isLt⟩ s hs (fun hc => hu ?_) hmem
      exact Fin.ext (by simpa using congrArg Fin.val hc.1)
    · intro h; exact absurd (Finset.mem_univ _) h

name: cube_good_origin
statement:
theorem cube_good_origin :
    ∃ O : Point, Legacy.NoPlaneThroughOrigin (Proof.MeshIntersectM2Kit.trMesh O unitCube)
proof:
:=
  Proof.MeshIntersectM2Kit.good_origin_of_nonDegenerate cube_ndf

name: offSurface_count
statement:
theorem offSurface_count {Q d : Point} (hQoff : Q ∉ Proof.surface unitCube)
    (hadm : AdmissibleRay unitCube Q d) :
    crossingCount unitCube Q d = 0 ∨ crossingCount unitCube Q d = 1
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨O, hnpo⟩ := cube_good_origin
  rcases offSurface_class hQoff with hint | ⟨k, hext⟩
  · obtain ⟨hadm6, hcount6⟩ := cube_count_interior hint
    exact Or.inr (by rw [Proof.SurfaceSolid.crossingCount_eq_of_offSurface cube_cyc cube_nfic
      hnpo hQoff hadm hadm6, hcount6])
  · refine Or.inl ?_
    rcases hext with hlo | hhi
    · obtain ⟨hadm7, hcount7⟩ := cube_count_exterior_lo hlo
      rw [Proof.SurfaceSolid.crossingCount_eq_of_offSurface cube_cyc cube_nfic hnpo hQoff
        hadm hadm7, hcount7]
    · obtain ⟨hadm7, hcount7⟩ := cube_count_exterior_hi hhi
      rw [Proof.SurfaceSolid.crossingCount_eq_of_offSurface cube_cyc cube_nfic hnpo hQoff
        hadm hadm7, hcount7]

name: cube_wzo
statement: theorem cube_wzo : WindingZeroOrOne unitCube
proof:
:= by
  intro Q d hadm
  have hεpos : 0 < eps0 unitCube Q d := eps0_pos unitCube Q d
  have hoff : Q + (eps0 unitCube Q d) • d ∉ Proof.surface unitCube :=
    slid_off_surface hadm hεpos le_rfl
  have hadm' : AdmissibleRay unitCube (Q + (eps0 unitCube Q d) • d) d :=
    admissible_slide hadm hεpos
  rw [← crossingCount_slide (Q := Q) (d := d) hεpos le_rfl]
  exact offSurface_count hoff hadm'

name: cube_wellFormed
statement: theorem cube_wellFormed : WellFormedMesh unitCube
proof:
:=
  ⟨cube_cyc, cube_wzo, cube_nfic, cube_ndf⟩

name: cube_solid
statement: theorem cube_solid : solid unitCube = { Q : Point | ∀ i, 0 < Q i ∧ Q i < 1 }
proof:
:= by
  ext Q
  simp only [Set.mem_setOf_eq]
  constructor
  · intro hsolid
    by_cases hoff : Q ∈ Proof.surface unitCube
    · exact absurd hsolid (Proof.SurfaceBoundary.surface_disjoint_solid_wf cube_wellFormed hoff)
    · rcases offSurface_class hoff with hint | ⟨k, hext⟩
      · exact hint
      · exfalso
        rcases hext with hlo | hhi
        · obtain ⟨hadm7, hcount7⟩ := cube_count_exterior_lo hlo
          exact hsolid _ hadm7 hcount7
        · obtain ⟨hadm7, hcount7⟩ := cube_count_exterior_hi hhi
          exact hsolid _ hadm7 hcount7
  · intro hint
    have hQ : Q ∈ openCube := hint
    obtain ⟨O, hnpo⟩ := cube_good_origin
    have hoff : Q ∉ Proof.surface unitCube := openCube_off_surface hQ
    intro d hadm
    obtain ⟨hadm6, hcount6⟩ := cube_count_interior hQ
    rw [Proof.SurfaceSolid.crossingCount_eq_of_offSurface cube_cyc cube_nfic hnpo hoff
      hadm hadm6, hcount6]
    norm_num

name: prim_zero
statement: theorem prim_zero : IPlane.prim ⟨0, 0, 0, 0⟩ = ⟨0, 0, 0, 0⟩
proof: := rfl

name: primDir_zero
statement: theorem primDir_zero : IPlane.primDir ⟨0, 0, 0, 0⟩ = ⟨0, 0, 0, 0⟩
proof: := rfl

name: ismul_one
statement: theorem ismul_one (g : IPlane) : ismul 1 g = g
proof:
:= by
  unfold ismul; cases g; simp

name: eq_zero_of_gamma_eq_zero
statement: theorem eq_zero_of_gamma_eq_zero {g : IPlane} (hγ : gamma g = 0) : g = ⟨0, 0, 0, 0⟩
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨ha, hb, hc, hd⟩ := (gamma_eq_zero_iff g).mp hγ
  cases g; simp_all

name: prim_ne_zero_of_gamma_ne
statement:
theorem prim_ne_zero_of_gamma_ne {g : IPlane} (hγ : gamma g ≠ 0) :
    IPlane.prim g ≠ ⟨0, 0, 0, 0⟩
proof:
:= by
  intro hp
  obtain ⟨k, _, hka, hkb, hkc, hkd⟩ := exists_intMul_prim hγ
  rw [hp] at hka hkb hkc hkd
  simp only [mul_zero] at hka hkb hkc hkd
  exact hγ ((gamma_eq_zero_iff _).mpr ⟨hka, hkb, hkc, hkd⟩)

name: primDir_ne_zero_of_gamma_ne
statement:
theorem primDir_ne_zero_of_gamma_ne {g : IPlane} (hγ : gamma g ≠ 0) :
    IPlane.primDir g ≠ ⟨0, 0, 0, 0⟩
proof:
:= by
  intro hp
  have ea := primDir_entry_a hγ
  have eb := primDir_entry_b hγ
  have ec := primDir_entry_c hγ
  have ed := primDir_entry_d hγ
  rw [hp] at ea eb ec ed
  simp only [mul_zero] at ea eb ec ed
  exact hγ ((gamma_eq_zero_iff _).mpr ⟨ea, eb, ec, ed⟩)

name: ratProp_pos_of_primDir_eq
statement:
theorem ratProp_pos_of_primDir_eq {g h : IPlane} (hγg : gamma g ≠ 0) (hγh : gamma h ≠ 0)
    (heq : IPlane.primDir g = IPlane.primDir h) : PosMul g h
proof:
:= by
  have hγg0 : (gamma g : ℚ) ≠ 0 := by exact_mod_cast hγg
  refine ⟨(gamma h : ℚ) / (gamma g : ℚ),
    div_pos (by exact_mod_cast Nat.pos_of_ne_zero hγh)
      (by exact_mod_cast Nat.pos_of_ne_zero hγg), ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · have hga := primDir_entry_a hγg
    have hha := primDir_entry_a hγh
    rw [heq] at hga
    have e1 : (g.a : ℚ) = (gamma g : ℚ) * ((IPlane.primDir h).a : ℚ) := by exact_mod_cast hga
    have e2 : (h.a : ℚ) = (gamma h : ℚ) * ((IPlane.primDir h).a : ℚ) := by exact_mod_cast hha
    rw [e2, e1]; field_simp; ring
  · have hga := primDir_entry_b hγg
    have hha := primDir_entry_b hγh
    rw [heq] at hga
    have e1 : (g.b : ℚ) = (gamma g : ℚ) * ((IPlane.primDir h).b : ℚ) := by exact_mod_cast hga
    have e2 : (h.b : ℚ) = (gamma h : ℚ) * ((IPlane.primDir h).b : ℚ) := by exact_mod_cast hha
    rw [e2, e1]; field_simp; ring
  · have hga := primDir_entry_c hγg
    have hha := primDir_entry_c hγh
    rw [heq] at hga
    have e1 : (g.c : ℚ) = (gamma g : ℚ) * ((IPlane.primDir h).c : ℚ) := by exact_mod_cast hga
    have e2 : (h.c : ℚ) = (gamma h : ℚ) * ((IPlane.primDir h).c : ℚ) := by exact_mod_cast hha
    rw [e2, e1]; field_simp; ring
  · have hga := primDir_entry_d hγg
    have hha := primDir_entry_d hγh
    rw [heq] at hga
    have e1 : (g.d : ℚ) = (gamma g : ℚ) * ((IPlane.primDir h).d : ℚ) := by exact_mod_cast hga
    have e2 : (h.d : ℚ) = (gamma h : ℚ) * ((IPlane.primDir h).d : ℚ) := by exact_mod_cast hha
    rw [e2, e1]; field_simp; ring

name: primDir_eq_of_posMul
statement:
theorem primDir_eq_of_posMul {g g' : IPlane} (h : PosMul g g') :
    IPlane.primDir g = IPlane.primDir g'
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨ρ, hρ, ha, hb, hc, hd⟩ := h
  have hqpos : (0 : Int) < (ρ.den : Int) := by exact_mod_cast ρ.pos
  have hppos : (0 : Int) < ρ.num := Rat.num_pos.mpr hρ
  have heq : ismul (ρ.den : Int) g' = ismul ρ.num g := ismul_den_num_eq ha hb hc hd
  have hpd : IPlane.primDir (ismul (ρ.den : Int) g') = IPlane.primDir (ismul ρ.num g) := by
    rw [heq]
  rw [primDir_ismul g' (ne_of_gt hqpos), primDir_ismul g (ne_of_gt hppos),
    Int.sign_eq_one_of_pos hqpos, Int.sign_eq_one_of_pos hppos, ismul_one, ismul_one] at hpd
  exact hpd.symm

name: gamma_eq_zero_iff_of_mul
statement:
theorem gamma_eq_zero_iff_of_mul {g : IPlane} {N : Point} {c : ℚ} (hg : IsMulOf g N c) :
    gamma g = 0 ↔ N = 0 ∧ c = 0
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨m, hm, ha, hb, hc', hd⟩ := hg
  have hm0 : m ≠ 0 := ne_of_gt hm
  rw [gamma_eq_zero_iff]
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨za, zb, zc, zd⟩
    have e0 : N 0 = 0 := by
      have : m * N 0 = 0 := by rw [← ha]; exact_mod_cast za
      exact (mul_eq_zero.mp this).resolve_left hm0
    have e1 : N 1 = 0 := by
      have : m * N 1 = 0 := by rw [← hb]; exact_mod_cast zb
      exact (mul_eq_zero.mp this).resolve_left hm0
    have e2 : N 2 = 0 := by
      have : m * N 2 = 0 := by rw [← hc']; exact_mod_cast zc
      exact (mul_eq_zero.mp this).resolve_left hm0
    refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
    · funext i
      fin_cases i <;> simp [e0, e1, e2]
    · have : m * c = 0 := by rw [← hd]; exact_mod_cast zd
      exact (mul_eq_zero.mp this).resolve_left hm0
  · rintro ⟨hN, hc0⟩
    have e0 : N 0 = 0 := by rw [hN]; rfl
    have e1 : N 1 = 0 := by rw [hN]; rfl
    have e2 : N 2 = 0 := by rw [hN]; rfl
    refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
    · have : (g.a : ℚ) = 0 := by rw [ha, e0, mul_zero]
      exact_mod_cast this
    · have : (g.b : ℚ) = 0 := by rw [hb, e1, mul_zero]
      exact_mod_cast this
    · have : (g.c : ℚ) = 0 := by rw [hc', e2, mul_zero]
      exact_mod_cast this
    · have : (g.d : ℚ) = 0 := by rw [hd, hc0, mul_zero]
      exact_mod_cast this

name: prim_eq_iff_ratProp4_of_mul
statement:
theorem prim_eq_iff_ratProp4_of_mul {g h : IPlane} {N₁ N₂ : Point} {c₁ c₂ : ℚ}
    (hg : IsMulOf g N₁ c₁) (hh : IsMulOf h N₂ c₂) :
    IPlane.prim g = IPlane.prim h
      ↔ RatProp4 (N₁ 0) (N₁ 1) (N₁ 2) c₁ (N₂ 0) (N₂ 1) (N₂ 2) c₂
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨m₁, hm₁, ha₁, hb₁, hc₁, hd₁⟩ := hg
  obtain ⟨m₂, hm₂, ha₂, hb₂, hc₂, hd₂⟩ := hh
  rw [← ratProp_iff_ratProp4_of_decomp (ne_of_gt hm₁) (ne_of_gt hm₂)
    ha₁ hb₁ hc₁ hd₁ ha₂ hb₂ hc₂ hd₂]
  constructor
  · intro heq
    by_cases hγ1 : gamma g = 0
    · have hgz := eq_zero_of_gamma_eq_zero hγ1
      rw [hgz, prim_zero] at heq
      have hγ2 : gamma h = 0 := by
        by_contra hγ2
        exact prim_ne_zero_of_gamma_ne hγ2 heq.symm
      have hhz := eq_zero_of_gamma_eq_zero hγ2
      exact ⟨1, one_ne_zero, by simp [hgz, hhz], by simp [hgz, hhz],
        by simp [hgz, hhz], by simp [hgz, hhz]⟩
    · by_cases hγ2 : gamma h = 0
      · exfalso
        rw [eq_zero_of_gamma_eq_zero hγ2, prim_zero] at heq
        exact prim_ne_zero_of_gamma_ne hγ1 heq
      · exact ratMul_of_prim_eq hγ1 hγ2 heq
  · exact prim_eq_of_ratMul

name: sameOrient_iff_pos_ratProp
statement:
theorem sameOrient_iff_pos_ratProp {g h : IPlane} {N₁ N₂ : Point} {c₁ c₂ : ℚ}
    (hg : IsMulOf g N₁ c₁) (hh : IsMulOf h N₂ c₂) :
    sameOrient g h = true
      ↔ ∃ ρ : ℚ, 0 < ρ ∧ N₂ 0 = ρ * N₁ 0 ∧ N₂ 1 = ρ * N₁ 1 ∧ N₂ 2 = ρ * N₁ 2
          ∧ c₂ = ρ * c₁
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨m₁, hm₁, ha₁, hb₁, hc₁, hd₁⟩ := id hg
  obtain ⟨m₂, hm₂, ha₂, hb₂, hc₂, hd₂⟩ := id hh
  have hm₁' : m₁ ≠ 0 := ne_of_gt hm₁
  have hm₂' : m₂ ≠ 0 := ne_of_gt hm₂
  unfold sameOrient
  rw [beqIPlane_eq_true_iff]
  constructor
  · intro heq
    by_cases hγ1 : gamma g = 0
    · obtain ⟨hN1, hc1⟩ := (gamma_eq_zero_iff_of_mul hg).mp hγ1
      have hpd1 : IPlane.primDir g = ⟨0, 0, 0, 0⟩ := by
        rw [eq_zero_of_gamma_eq_zero hγ1, primDir_zero]
      have hγ2 : gamma h = 0 := by
        by_contra hγ2
        exact primDir_ne_zero_of_gamma_ne hγ2 (hpd1 ▸ heq).symm
      obtain ⟨hN2, hc2⟩ := (gamma_eq_zero_iff_of_mul hh).mp hγ2
      refine ⟨1, one_pos, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
      · rw [hN1, hN2]; simp
      · rw [hN1, hN2]; simp
      · rw [hN1, hN2]; simp
      · rw [hc1, hc2]; ring
    · by_cases hγ2 : gamma h = 0
      · exfalso
        have hpd2 : IPlane.primDir h = ⟨0, 0, 0, 0⟩ := by
          rw [eq_zero_of_gamma_eq_zero hγ2, primDir_zero]
        exact primDir_ne_zero_of_gamma_ne hγ1 (hpd2 ▸ heq)
      · obtain ⟨ρ, hρ, pa, pb, pc, pd⟩ := ratProp_pos_of_primDir_eq hγ1 hγ2 heq
        refine ⟨ρ * m₁ / m₂, by positivity, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
        · have e : m₂ * N₂ 0 = ρ * m₁ * N₁ 0 := by rw [← ha₂, pa, ha₁]; ring
          rw [div_mul_eq_mul_div, eq_div_iff hm₂']; linear_combination e
        · have e : m₂ * N₂ 1 = ρ * m₁ * N₁ 1 := by rw [← hb₂, pb, hb₁]; ring
          rw [div_mul_eq_mul_div, eq_div_iff hm₂']; linear_combination e
        · have e : m₂ * N₂ 2 = ρ * m₁ * N₁ 2 := by rw [← hc₂, pc, hc₁]; ring
          rw [div_mul_eq_mul_div, eq_div_iff hm₂']; linear_combination e
        · have e : m₂ * c₂ = ρ * m₁ * c₁ := by rw [← hd₂, pd, hd₁]; ring
          rw [div_mul_eq_mul_div, eq_div_iff hm₂']; linear_combination e
  · rintro ⟨ρ, hρ, hx, hy, hz, hcc⟩
    refine primDir_eq_of_posMul ⟨m₂ * ρ / m₁, by positivity, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
    · rw [ha₂, hx, ha₁, div_mul_eq_mul_div, eq_div_iff hm₁']; ring
    · rw [hb₂, hy, hb₁, div_mul_eq_mul_div, eq_div_iff hm₁']; ring
    · rw [hc₂, hz, hc₁, div_mul_eq_mul_div, eq_div_iff hm₁']; ring
    · rw [hd₂, hcc, hd₁, div_mul_eq_mul_div, eq_div_iff hm₁']; ring

name: isMulOf_iFacePlane
statement:
theorem isMulOf_iFacePlane (p q r : P3) :
    IsMulOf (iFacePlane p q r)
      (crossQ (P3.toPoint q - P3.toPoint p) (P3.toPoint r - P3.toPoint p))
      (dotQ (crossQ (P3.toPoint q - P3.toPoint p) (P3.toPoint r - P3.toPoint p))
        (P3.toPoint p))
proof:
:= by
  have h := isMulOf_clearPlane (crossS (psubS q p) (psubS r p))
    (dotS (crossS (psubS q p) (psubS r p)) p)
  have hmirror : P3.toPoint (crossS (psubS q p) (psubS r p))
      = crossQ (P3.toPoint q - P3.toPoint p) (P3.toPoint r - P3.toPoint p) := by
    rw [crossS_toPoint, psubS_toPoint, psubS_toPoint]
    rfl
  have hcval : (dotS (crossS (psubS q p) (psubS r p)) p : ℚ)
      = dotQ (crossQ (P3.toPoint q - P3.toPoint p) (P3.toPoint r - P3.toPoint p))
          (P3.toPoint p) := by
    rw [dotS_toPoint, hmirror]
  rw [hmirror, hcval] at h
  exact h

name: posMul_iFacePlane_iFacePlaneH
statement:
theorem posMul_iFacePlane_iFacePlaneH (p q r : P3) :
    PosMul (iFacePlane p q r) (iFacePlaneH (toH4 p) (toH4 q) (toH4 r))
proof:
:=
  posMul_of_isMulOf (isMulOf_iFacePlane p q r)
    (isMulOf_iFacePlaneH (toH4_repr p) (toH4_repr q) (toH4_repr r))

name: prim_iFacePlaneH_eq
statement:
theorem prim_iFacePlaneH_eq (p q r : P3) :
    IPlane.prim (iFacePlaneH (toH4 p) (toH4 q) (toH4 r)) = IPlane.prim (iFacePlane p q r)
proof:
:=
  (prim_eq_of_ratMul (ratProp_of_posMul (posMul_iFacePlane_iFacePlaneH p q r))).symm

name: primDir_iFacePlaneH_eq
statement:
theorem primDir_iFacePlaneH_eq (p q r : P3) :
    IPlane.primDir (iFacePlaneH (toH4 p) (toH4 q) (toH4 r))
      = IPlane.primDir (iFacePlane p q r)
proof:
:=
  (primDir_eq_of_posMul (posMul_iFacePlane_iFacePlaneH p q r)).symm

name: negligible_unclean
statement:
theorem negligible_unclean (M : Mesh) (hnpo : NoPlaneThroughOrigin M) :
    Negligible {x : Point | ¬ G1Clean M x}
proof:
:= by
  have hsub : {x : Point | ¬ G1Clean M x} ⊆
      ⋃ p : Fin M.size × Fin 4, {x : Point | (slot M[p.1] p.2).eval x = 0} := by
    intro x hx
    rw [Set.mem_setOf_eq] at hx
    unfold G1Clean at hx
    push_neg at hx
    obtain ⟨i, g, hg, hev⟩ := hx
    rw [mem_tetraHalves_iff] at hg
    obtain ⟨k, rfl⟩ := hg
    exact Set.mem_iUnion.mpr ⟨(i, k), hev⟩
  apply Proof.Negligible.negligible_mono hsub
  apply Proof.Negligible.negligible_iUnion_fintype
  intro p
  refine ⟨1, fun _ => {x : Point | (slot M[p.1] p.2).eval x = 0}, fun _ => ?_,
    Set.subset_iUnion (fun _ : Fin 1 => {x : Point | (slot M[p.1] p.2).eval x = 0}) 0⟩
  refine ⟨(slot M[p.1] p.2).n, (slot M[p.1] p.2).c,
    facet_n_ne_zero (hnpo p.1) _ (slot_mem _ _), ?_⟩
  ext x
  simp only [Set.mem_setOf_eq, Half.eval]
  rw [← dotQ_eq_sum]
  constructor <;> intro h <;> linarith

name: normal_iff_germValues
statement:
theorem normal_iff_germValues (M : Mesh) (hcyc : IsClosedOrientedSurface M)
    (hnpo : NoPlaneThroughOrigin M) (hns : NoFaceInteriorContact M) :
    Legacy.Normal (meshChain M) ↔ ∀ (i : Fin M.size) (s : ℤ), s = 1 ∨ s = -1 →
      germValue M i s = 0 ∨ germValue M i s = 1
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · 
    rintro ⟨N, ⟨k, H, hplanes, hsub⟩, hwind⟩ i s hs
    set Φ : List (Point × ℚ) := (List.finRange k).map (fun l =>
      ((hplanes l).choose, (hplanes l).choose_spec.choose)) with hΦdef
    have hΦ : ∀ φ ∈ Φ, φ.1 ≠ 0 := by
      intro φ hφ
      rw [hΦdef, List.mem_map] at hφ
      obtain ⟨l, _, rfl⟩ := hφ
      exact (hplanes l).choose_spec.choose_spec.1
    obtain ⟨x, hx, havoid⟩ := admPair_exists_avoiding M hnpo i s hs Φ hΦ
    have hxN : x ∉ N := by
      intro hxN
      obtain ⟨l, hl⟩ := Set.mem_iUnion.mp (hsub hxN)
      have hHl := (hplanes l).choose_spec.choose_spec.2
      rw [hHl, Set.mem_setOf_eq] at hl
      refine havoid ((hplanes l).choose, (hplanes l).choose_spec.choose) ?_ ?_
      · rw [hΦdef]
        exact List.mem_map.mpr ⟨l, List.mem_finRange l, rfl⟩
      · rw [dotQ_eq_sum]
        exact hl
    rw [germValue_eq M hcyc hnpo hns hx]
    exact hwind x hxN
  · 
    intro hg
    refine ⟨{x : Point | ¬ G1Clean M x}, negligible_unclean M hnpo, fun Q hQ => ?_⟩
    have hQc : G1Clean M Q := not_not.mp hQ
    rcases winding_eq_germ_or_zero M hcyc hnpo hns Q hQc with h0 | ⟨i, s, hs, heq⟩
    · exact Or.inl h0
    · rw [heq]
      exact hg i s hs

name: checkNormalCondPre_correct
statement:
theorem checkNormalCondPre_correct (M : Mesh) (hcyc : IsClosedOrientedSurface M)
    (hnpo : NoPlaneThroughOrigin M) (hns : NoFaceInteriorContact M)
    {bvh : Impl.BVH.BVH}
    (hq : Proof.MeshIntersectRayClassifyNormal.FwdQueryOK bvh
      ((prepare (materialize M)).map (fun f => faceBoxOf f))) :
    Impl.WellFormedCheck.checkNormalCondPre (materialize M) (prepare (materialize M)) bvh = true
      ↔ Legacy.Normal (meshChain M)
proof:
:=
  (Proof.MeshIntersectRayClassifyNormal.checkNormalCondPre_characterization hcyc hnpo hns hq
      (Proof.MeshIntersectRayClassifyF6Supply.baryPt_off_other_faces hns hnpo)).trans
    (normal_iff_germValues M hcyc hnpo hns).symm

name: checkNormalCond_correct
statement:
theorem checkNormalCond_correct : ∀ M : Mesh, IsClosedOrientedSurface M → NoPlaneThroughOrigin M →
    NoFaceInteriorContact M →
    (checkNormalCond M = true ↔ Legacy.Normal (meshChain M))
proof:
:= by
  intro M hcyc hnpo hns

    (Proof.MeshIntersectRayClassifyNormal.fwdQueryOK_faceBVH _)

statement:

        (Impl.BVH.buildBVHM ((prepare (materialize M)).map (fun f => faceBoxOf f))) = true
