name: reparam_seg
statement:
theorem reparam_seg (Q d : Point) (a b τ : ℚ) :
    seg (lineAt Q d a) (lineAt Q d b) τ = lineAt Q d (a + τ * (b - a))
proof:
:= by
  funext k; simp only [seg, lineAt]; ring

name: dotQ_psub_lineAt
statement:
theorem dotQ_psub_lineAt (n Q d : Point) (a b : ℚ) :
    dotQ n (psub (lineAt Q d b) (lineAt Q d a)) = (b - a) * dotQ n d
proof:
:= by
  simp only [psub, dotQ, lineAt]; ring

name: qsign_pos_mul
statement: theorem qsign_pos_mul {c : ℚ} (hc : 0 < c) (q : ℚ) : qsign (c * q) = qsign q
proof:
:= by
  unfold qsign
  rcases lt_trichotomy q 0 with h | h | h
  · rw [if_neg (not_lt.mpr (le_of_lt (mul_neg_of_pos_of_neg hc h))),
        if_pos (mul_neg_of_pos_of_neg hc h), if_neg (not_lt.mpr (le_of_lt h)), if_pos h]
  · subst h; simp
  · rw [if_pos (mul_pos hc h), if_pos h]

name: rayCount_eq_winding_hist
statement:
theorem rayCount_eq_winding_hist (M : Mesh) (hcyc : IsClosedOrientedSurface M)
    (hnpo : NoPlaneThroughOrigin M) (hns : NoFaceInteriorContact M)
    (Q d : Point) (hQ : G1Clean M Q) (hd : d ≠ 0)
    (hdN : ∀ u : Fin M.size, dotQ (Proof.MeshIntersectJump.faceNormal M[u]) d ≠ 0)
    (hdA : ∀ (j : Fin M.size) (k : Fin 4), dotQ (slot M[j] k).n d ≠ 0)
    (hG2line : ∀ (j : Fin M.size), ∀ g ∈ Impl.Legacy.Sim.tetraHalves M[j],
      ∀ g' ∈ Impl.Legacy.Sim.tetraHalves M[j], g ≠ g' → ∀ t : ℚ,
      ¬ (g.eval (lineAt Q d t) = 0 ∧ g'.eval (lineAt Q d t) = 0))
    (hnoedge : ∀ (u : Fin M.size) (t : ℚ), t ≠ 0 →
      lineAt Q d t ∉ edgeSet M[u]) :
    winding (meshChain M) Q = rayCount M Q d
proof:
:= by
  classical
  
  set root : Fin M.size → ℚ := faceRoot M Q d with hrootdef
  set Sset : ℚ → Finset (Fin M.size) :=
    fun a => Finset.univ.filter (fun u => faceCrossed M Q d u ∧ a < root u) with hSdef
  have hSmem : ∀ (a : ℚ) (u : Fin M.size),
      u ∈ Sset a ↔ (faceCrossed M Q d u ∧ a < root u) := by
    intro a u; simp [hSdef]
  
  have hcar : ∀ (u : Fin M.size) (t : ℚ), lineAt Q d t ∈ triangleSet M[u] →
      t = root u := by
    intro u t hmem
    have h1 := Proof.MeshIntersectRayClassify.triangleSet_on_carrier hmem
    rw [dotQ_lineAt] at h1
    rw [hrootdef]; unfold faceRoot; rw [eq_div_iff (hdN u)]; linarith
  
  have huniq : ∀ (u u' : Fin M.size), u ≠ u' → faceCrossed M Q d u →
      faceCrossed M Q d u' → root u = root u' → False := by
    intro u u' hne hu hu' hroot
    obtain ⟨t, htpos, htmem⟩ := hu
    obtain ⟨t', _, ht'mem⟩ := hu'
    have e1 := hcar u t htmem
    have e2 := hcar u' t' ht'mem
    have htt' : t = t' := by rw [e1, hroot, ← e2]
    subst htt'
    exact relint_clear_of_nsi hns (Ne.symm hne) ht'mem htmem (hnoedge u t (ne_of_gt htpos))
  
  set RL : List ℚ := ((List.finRange M.size).product (List.finRange 4)).map
    (fun jk => -(slot M[jk.1] jk.2).eval Q / dotQ (slot M[jk.1] jk.2).n d) with hRLdef
  have hclean : ∀ t : ℚ, (∀ r ∈ RL, t ≠ r) → G1Clean M (lineAt Q d t) := by
    intro t havoid j g hg
    obtain ⟨k, rfl⟩ := mem_tetraHalves_iff.mp hg
    intro heval
    rw [eval_lineAt] at heval
    apply havoid (-(slot M[j] k).eval Q / dotQ (slot M[j] k).n d)
      (List.mem_map.mpr ⟨(j, k), List.pair_mem_product.mpr
        ⟨List.mem_finRange j, List.mem_finRange k⟩, rfl⟩)
    rw [eq_div_iff (hdA j k)]
    linarith
  
  have stepCancel : ∀ (a b : ℚ), a < b → G1Clean M (lineAt Q d a) →
      G1Clean M (lineAt Q d b) →
      (∀ (i : Fin M.size) (t : ℚ), a < t → t < b → lineAt Q d t ∉ triangleSet M[i]) →
      winding (meshChain M) (lineAt Q d a) = winding (meshChain M) (lineAt Q d b) := by
    intro a b hab hcA hcB hgap
    have hrep : ∀ τ : ℚ,
        (fun k => (lineAt Q d a) k + τ * ((lineAt Q d b) k - (lineAt Q d a) k))
          = lineAt Q d (a + τ * (b - a)) := by
      intro τ; have := reparam_seg Q d a b τ; simpa [seg] using this
    apply winding_const_of_avoiding M hcyc hnpo (lineAt Q d a) (lineAt Q d b)
    · intro i τ h0 h1; rw [hrep]; exact hgap i _ (by nlinarith) (by nlinarith)
    · intro i g hg; exact ⟨hcA i g hg, hcB i g hg⟩
    · intro i g hg g' hg' hne τ _ _; rw [hrep]; exact hG2line i g hg g' hg' hne (a + τ * (b - a))
  
  have stepJump : ∀ (a s tstar : ℚ), 0 ≤ a → a < s → a < tstar → tstar < s →
      ∀ ustar : Fin M.size, G1Clean M (lineAt Q d a) → G1Clean M (lineAt Q d s) →
      lineAt Q d tstar ∈ triangleSet M[ustar] →
      (∀ (i : Fin M.size) (t : ℚ), a < t → t < s → t ≠ tstar →
        lineAt Q d t ∉ triangleSet M[i]) →
      winding (meshChain M) (lineAt Q d s) - winding (meshChain M) (lineAt Q d a)
        = - qsign (dotQ (Proof.MeshIntersectJump.faceNormal M[ustar]) d) := by
    intro a s tstar ha0 has hat hts ustar hcA hcS hmemstar hH1
    have htstar0 : tstar ≠ 0 := by
      intro hc; rw [hc] at hat; linarith
    have hedgestar : lineAt Q d tstar ∉ edgeSet M[ustar] := hnoedge ustar tstar htstar0
    set τs := (tstar - a) / (s - a) with hτsdef
    have hsa : 0 < s - a := by linarith
    have hτ0 : 0 < τs := div_pos (by linarith) hsa
    have hτ1 : τs < 1 := (div_lt_one hsa).mpr (by linarith)
    have hrep : ∀ τ : ℚ, seg (lineAt Q d a) (lineAt Q d s) τ = lineAt Q d (a + τ * (s - a)) :=
      reparam_seg Q d a s
    have hτstar : a + τs * (s - a) = tstar := by rw [hτsdef]; field_simp
    have hjump := jump_normal_form hcyc hnpo hns ustar hτ0 hτ1
      (by rw [hrep, hτstar]; exact hmemstar)
      (by rw [hrep, hτstar]; exact hedgestar)
      (by intro i τ h0 h1 hne
          rw [hrep]
          apply hH1 i _ (by nlinarith) (by nlinarith) ?_
          intro hc; apply hne
          have h2 : τ * (s - a) = τs * (s - a) := by
            have : a + τ * (s - a) = a + τs * (s - a) := by rw [hc, hτstar]
            linarith
          exact mul_right_cancel₀ (ne_of_gt hsa) h2)
      (by intro i g hg; exact ⟨hcA i g hg, hcS i g hg⟩)
      (by intro i g hg g' hg' hne τ _ _
          rw [hrep]; exact hG2line i g hg g' hg' hne (a + τ * (s - a)))
    rw [hjump]; congr 1
    rw [dotQ_psub_lineAt, qsign_pos_mul hsa]
  
  have key : ∀ (n : ℕ) (a : ℚ), 0 ≤ a → G1Clean M (lineAt Q d a) →
      (Sset a).card = n →
      winding (meshChain M) (lineAt Q d a)
        = ∑ u ∈ Sset a, qsign (dotQ (Proof.MeshIntersectJump.faceNormal M[u]) d) := by
    intro n
    induction n with
    | zero =>
      intro a ha0 hcA hcard
      have hSempty : Sset a = ∅ := Finset.card_eq_zero.mp hcard
      rw [hSempty, Finset.sum_empty]
      
      obtain ⟨T₀, hT₀pos, hT₀⟩ := ray_escapes_box M Q d hd
      obtain ⟨T, hT1, _, hTRL⟩ := exists_between_avoiding
        (show max a T₀ < max a T₀ + 1 by linarith) RL
      have haT : a < T := lt_of_le_of_lt (le_max_left a T₀) hT1
      have hT₀T : T₀ ≤ T := le_of_lt (lt_of_le_of_lt (le_max_right a T₀) hT1)
      have hTclean : G1Clean M (lineAt Q d T) := hclean T hTRL
      have hgap : ∀ (i : Fin M.size) (t : ℚ), a < t → t < T →
          lineAt Q d t ∉ triangleSet M[i] := by
        intro i t hat _ hmem
        have hcrossed : faceCrossed M Q d i := ⟨t, by linarith, hmem⟩
        have : i ∈ Sset a := (hSmem a i).mpr ⟨hcrossed, by rw [← hcar i t hmem]; exact hat⟩
        rw [hSempty] at this; exact absurd this (Finset.not_mem_empty i)
      rw [stepCancel a T haT hcA hTclean hgap]
      exact winding_zero_outside_box M (hT₀ T hT₀T)
    | succ n ih =>
      intro a ha0 hcA hcard
      
      have hSne : (Sset a).Nonempty := by
        rw [← Finset.card_pos, hcard]; exact Nat.succ_pos n
      
      obtain ⟨ustar, hustar, hmin⟩ := (Sset a).exists_min_image root hSne
      obtain ⟨hcrU, hatstar⟩ := (hSmem a ustar).mp hustar
      set tstar := root ustar with htstardef
      have htstar0 : 0 < tstar := lt_of_le_of_lt ha0 hatstar
      
      have hmemstar : lineAt Q d tstar ∈ triangleSet M[ustar] := by
        obtain ⟨t, ht, hmem⟩ := hcrU
        rw [htstardef, ← hcar ustar t hmem]; exact hmem
      
      have hs : ∃ s : ℚ, tstar < s ∧
          (∀ u ∈ Sset a, tstar < root u → s < root u) ∧ (∀ r ∈ RL, s ≠ r) := by
        by_cases hL : ((Sset a).filter (fun u => tstar < root u)).Nonempty
        · obtain ⟨v, hvL, hvmin⟩ :=
            ((Sset a).filter (fun u => tstar < root u)).exists_min_image root hL
          obtain ⟨hvmem, hvlt⟩ := Finset.mem_filter.mp hvL
          obtain ⟨s, hs1, hs2, hsRL⟩ := exists_between_avoiding hvlt RL
          refine ⟨s, hs1, ?_, hsRL⟩
          intro u huS hu
          exact lt_of_lt_of_le hs2 (hvmin u (Finset.mem_filter.mpr ⟨huS, hu⟩))
        · obtain ⟨s, hs1, _, hsRL⟩ :=
            exists_between_avoiding (show tstar < tstar + 1 by linarith) RL
          refine ⟨s, hs1, ?_, hsRL⟩
          intro u huS hu
          exact absurd (Finset.mem_filter.mpr ⟨huS, hu⟩) (by
            intro hmem; exact hL ⟨u, hmem⟩)
      obtain ⟨s, hts, hsupper, hsRL⟩ := hs
      have has : a < s := lt_trans hatstar hts
      have hs0 : 0 ≤ s := le_of_lt (lt_trans htstar0 hts)
      have hcS : G1Clean M (lineAt Q d s) := hclean s hsRL
      
      have hH1 : ∀ (i : Fin M.size) (t : ℚ), a < t → t < s → t ≠ tstar →
          lineAt Q d t ∉ triangleSet M[i] := by
        intro i t hat hts' htne hmem
        have hcr : faceCrossed M Q d i := ⟨t, by linarith, hmem⟩
        have hroot : root i = t := (hcar i t hmem).symm
        have hiS : i ∈ Sset a := (hSmem a i).mpr ⟨hcr, by rw [hroot]; exact hat⟩
        have hge : tstar ≤ root i := hmin i hiS
        rcases lt_or_eq_of_le hge with hlt | heq
        · have := hsupper i hiS hlt
          rw [hroot] at this; linarith
        · rw [hroot] at heq; exact htne heq.symm
      
      have hjump := stepJump a s tstar ha0 has hatstar hts ustar hcA hcS hmemstar hH1
      
      have hSs : Sset s = (Sset a).erase ustar := by
        ext u
        simp only [Finset.mem_erase, hSmem]
        constructor
        · rintro ⟨hcr, hlt⟩
          refine ⟨?_, hcr, lt_trans has hlt⟩
          rintro rfl; linarith
        · rintro ⟨hne, hcr, hau⟩
          refine ⟨hcr, ?_⟩
          have hiS : u ∈ Sset a := (hSmem a u).mpr ⟨hcr, hau⟩
          have hge : tstar ≤ root u := hmin u hiS
          rcases lt_or_eq_of_le hge with hlt | heq
          · exact hsupper u hiS hlt
          · exact absurd (huniq ustar u (Ne.symm hne) hcrU hcr heq) id
      
      have hcardS : (Sset s).card = n := by
        rw [hSs, Finset.card_erase_of_mem hustar, hcard]; rfl
      have hwinS := ih s hs0 hcS hcardS
      
      have hsum : ∑ u ∈ Sset a, qsign (dotQ (Proof.MeshIntersectJump.faceNormal M[u]) d)
          = qsign (dotQ (Proof.MeshIntersectJump.faceNormal M[ustar]) d) + ∑ u ∈ Sset s, qsign (dotQ (Proof.MeshIntersectJump.faceNormal M[u]) d) := by
        rw [hSs]
        exact (Finset.add_sum_erase (Sset a) (fun u => qsign (dotQ (Proof.MeshIntersectJump.faceNormal M[u]) d)) hustar).symm
      rw [hsum, ← hwinS]
      linarith [hjump]
  
  have hl0 : lineAt Q d 0 = Q := by funext k; simp only [lineAt]; ring
  have hpos : ∀ u, faceCrossed M Q d u → 0 < root u := by
    rintro u ⟨t, ht, hmem⟩; rw [← hcar u t hmem]; exact ht
  have hS0 : Sset 0 = Finset.univ.filter (faceCrossed M Q d) := by
    apply Finset.filter_congr
    intro u _
    exact ⟨fun h => h.1, fun h => ⟨h, hpos u h⟩⟩
  have hkey := key ((Sset 0).card) 0 le_rfl (by rw [hl0]; exact hQ) rfl
  rw [hl0] at hkey
  rw [hkey, hS0]
  unfold rayCount
  rw [Finset.sum_filter]

name: faceCrossed_iff_meetsRelint
statement:
theorem faceCrossed_iff_meetsRelint {M : Mesh} {Q d : Point}
    (hnoedge : ∀ (u : Fin M.size) (t : ℚ), t ≠ 0 → lineAt Q d t ∉ edgeSet M[u])
    (u : Fin M.size) :
    faceCrossed M Q d u ↔ Proof.MeshIntersectRayClassify.MeetsRelint M Q d u
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨t, ht, hmem⟩
    exact ⟨t, ht, hmem, hnoedge u t (ne_of_gt ht)⟩
  · rintro ⟨s, hs, hmem, _⟩
    exact ⟨s, hs, hmem⟩

name: rayCount_eq_RayCount
statement:
theorem rayCount_eq_RayCount (M : Mesh) (Q d : Point)
    (hnoedge : ∀ (u : Fin M.size) (t : ℚ), t ≠ 0 → lineAt Q d t ∉ edgeSet M[u]) :
    rayCount M Q d = Proof.MeshIntersectRayClassify.RayCount M Q d
proof:
:= by
  unfold rayCount Proof.MeshIntersectRayClassify.RayCount
  refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun u _ => ?_)
  have hiff := faceCrossed_iff_meetsRelint hnoedge u
  by_cases h : faceCrossed M Q d u
  · rw [if_pos h, if_pos (hiff.mp h)]
  · rw [if_neg h, if_neg (fun hc => h (hiff.mpr hc))]

name: raycount_eq_winding
statement:
theorem raycount_eq_winding {MB : Mesh} (hcyc : IsClosedOrientedSurface MB)
    (hnpo : NoPlaneThroughOrigin MB) (hns : NoFaceInteriorContact MB) {Q d : Point}
    (hQ : G1Clean MB Q) (hd : d ≠ 0)
    (hdN : ∀ u : Fin MB.size, dotQ (Proof.MeshIntersectJump.faceNormal MB[u]) d ≠ 0)
    (hdA : ∀ (j : Fin MB.size) (k : Fin 4), dotQ (slot MB[j] k).n d ≠ 0)
    (hG2line : ∀ (j : Fin MB.size), ∀ g ∈ Impl.Legacy.Sim.tetraHalves MB[j],
      ∀ g' ∈ Impl.Legacy.Sim.tetraHalves MB[j], g ≠ g' → ∀ t : ℚ,
      ¬ (g.eval (lineAt Q d t) = 0 ∧ g'.eval (lineAt Q d t) = 0))
    (hnoedge : ∀ (u : Fin MB.size) (t : ℚ), t ≠ 0 →
      lineAt Q d t ∉ edgeSet MB[u]) :
    winding (meshChain MB) Q = Proof.MeshIntersectRayClassify.RayCount MB Q d
proof:
:= by
  rw [rayCount_eq_winding_hist MB hcyc hnpo hns Q d hQ hd hdN hdA hG2line hnoedge]
  exact rayCount_eq_RayCount MB Q d hnoedge

name: open_closed_meet
statement:
theorem open_closed_meet {K : Type*} [LinearOrderedField K]
    (a b c d : K) (hcd : c ≤ d) :
    (∃ x, a < x ∧ x < b ∧ c ≤ x ∧ x ≤ d) ↔ (a < b ∧ a < d ∧ c < b)
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨x, hax, hxb, hcx, hxd⟩
    exact ⟨lt_trans hax hxb, lt_of_lt_of_le hax hxd, lt_of_le_of_lt hcx hxb⟩
  · rintro ⟨hab, had, hcb⟩
    refine ⟨(max a c + min b d) / 2, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
    · have h1 : a < min b d := lt_min hab had
      have h2 : a ≤ max a c := le_max_left a c
      have : a + a < max a c + min b d := by linarith
      linarith
    · have h1 : max a c < b := max_lt hab hcb
      have h2 : min b d ≤ b := min_le_left b d
      have : max a c + min b d < b + b := by linarith
      linarith
    · have h1 : c ≤ max a c := le_max_right a c
      have h2 : max a c ≤ min b d := by
        apply le_min <;> apply max_le <;> [skip; skip; skip; exact hcd] <;>
          first
            | (exact le_of_lt hab) | (exact le_of_lt had) | (exact le_of_lt hcb)
      linarith
    · have h1 : min b d ≤ d := min_le_right b d
      have h2 : max a c ≤ min b d := by
        apply le_min <;> apply max_le <;> [skip; skip; skip; exact hcd] <;>
          first
            | (exact le_of_lt hab) | (exact le_of_lt had) | (exact le_of_lt hcb)
      linarith

name: fracLt_iff'
statement:
theorem fracLt_iff' (a b : Int × Int) (ha : 0 < a.2) (hb : 0 < b.2) :
    fracLt a b = true ↔ fracVal a < fracVal b
proof:
:= by
  have ha' : (0 : ℚ) < (a.2 : ℚ) := by exact_mod_cast ha
  have hb' : (0 : ℚ) < (b.2 : ℚ) := by exact_mod_cast hb
  unfold fracVal
  rw [fracLt, decide_eq_true_eq, div_lt_div_iff₀ ha' hb']
  constructor
  · intro h; have : ((a.1 * b.2 : Int) : ℚ) < ((b.1 * a.2 : Int) : ℚ) := by exact_mod_cast h
    push_cast at this; linarith
  · intro h
    have : ((a.1 * b.2 : Int) : ℚ) < ((b.1 * a.2 : Int) : ℚ) := by push_cast; linarith
    exact_mod_cast this

name: fracInterval_inv
statement:
theorem fracInterval_inv (ps : Array (Int × Int)) (hpos : ∀ p ∈ ps, 0 < p.2) :
    fracIntervalInv ps ps.size (fracInterval ps)
proof:
:= by
  unfold fracInterval
  refine Array.foldl_induction (motive := fun n acc => fracIntervalInv ps n acc) ?_ ?_
  · simp only [fracIntervalInv]
  · intro i acc hacc
    
    set p := ps[i] with hp
    have hpp : 0 < p.2 := hpos p (by rw [hp]; exact Array.getElem_mem i.isLt)
    have hpval : 0 < (p.2 : ℚ) := by exact_mod_cast hpp
    cases acc with
    | none =>
      
      have hi0 : (i : ℕ) = 0 := hacc
      simp only [fracIntervalInv]
      refine ⟨hpp, hpp, le_refl _, ⟨i, i.isLt, Nat.lt_succ_self _, rfl⟩,
        ⟨i, i.isLt, Nat.lt_succ_self _, rfl⟩, ?_⟩
      intro k hk hkn
      have hki : k = i.1 := by omega
      subst hki
      exact ⟨le_refl _, le_refl _⟩
    | some loHi =>
      obtain ⟨lo, hi⟩ := loHi
      obtain ⟨hlo, hhi, hlohi, ⟨ilo, hilo, hilon, hilop⟩, ⟨ihi, hihi, hihin, hihip⟩, hbound⟩ := hacc
      
      simp only [fracIntervalInv]
      by_cases hltlo : fracLt p lo = true <;> by_cases hgthi : fracLt hi p = true
      
      · simp only [if_pos hltlo, if_pos hgthi]
        refine ⟨hpp, hpp, le_refl _, ⟨i, i.isLt, Nat.lt_succ_self _, rfl⟩,
          ⟨i, i.isLt, Nat.lt_succ_self _, rfl⟩, ?_⟩
        intro k hk hkn
        rcases Nat.lt_succ_iff_lt_or_eq.mp hkn with hkn' | hkn'
        · have ⟨hlk, hkh⟩ := hbound k hk hkn'
          have hplo : fracVal p < fracVal lo := (fracLt_iff' p lo hpp hlo).mp hltlo
          have hhip : fracVal hi < fracVal p := (fracLt_iff' hi p hhi hpp).mp hgthi
          exact ⟨by linarith, by linarith⟩
        · have hki : k = i.1 := by omega
          subst hki; exact ⟨le_refl _, le_refl _⟩
      
      · simp only [if_pos hltlo, if_neg hgthi]
        refine ⟨hpp, hhi, ?_, ⟨i, i.isLt, Nat.lt_succ_self _, rfl⟩,
          ⟨ihi, hihi, Nat.lt_succ_of_lt hihin, hihip⟩, ?_⟩
        · have hplo : fracVal p < fracVal lo := (fracLt_iff' p lo hpp hlo).mp hltlo
          linarith
        · intro k hk hkn
          rcases Nat.lt_succ_iff_lt_or_eq.mp hkn with hkn' | hkn'
          · have ⟨hlk, hkh⟩ := hbound k hk hkn'
            have hplo : fracVal p < fracVal lo := (fracLt_iff' p lo hpp hlo).mp hltlo
            exact ⟨by linarith, hkh⟩
          · have hki : k = i.1 := by omega
            subst hki
            rw [show ps[(i.1 : ℕ)] = p from hp.symm]
            have hph : ¬ fracVal hi < fracVal p := by
              rw [← fracLt_iff' hi p hhi hpp]; exact hgthi
            exact ⟨le_refl _, by linarith⟩
      
      · simp only [if_neg hltlo, if_pos hgthi]
        refine ⟨hlo, hpp, ?_, ⟨ilo, hilo, Nat.lt_succ_of_lt hilon, hilop⟩,
          ⟨i, i.isLt, Nat.lt_succ_self _, rfl⟩, ?_⟩
        · have hhip : fracVal hi < fracVal p := (fracLt_iff' hi p hhi hpp).mp hgthi
          linarith
        · intro k hk hkn
          rcases Nat.lt_succ_iff_lt_or_eq.mp hkn with hkn' | hkn'
          · have ⟨hlk, hkh⟩ := hbound k hk hkn'
            have hhip : fracVal hi < fracVal p := (fracLt_iff' hi p hhi hpp).mp hgthi
            exact ⟨hlk, by linarith⟩
          · have hki : k = i.1 := by omega
            subst hki
            rw [show ps[(i.1 : ℕ)] = p from hp.symm]
            have hpl : ¬ fracVal p < fracVal lo := by
              rw [← fracLt_iff' p lo hpp hlo]; exact hltlo
            exact ⟨by linarith, le_refl _⟩
      
      · simp only [if_neg hltlo, if_neg hgthi]
        refine ⟨hlo, hhi, hlohi, ⟨ilo, hilo, Nat.lt_succ_of_lt hilon, hilop⟩,
          ⟨ihi, hihi, Nat.lt_succ_of_lt hihin, hihip⟩, ?_⟩
        intro k hk hkn
        rcases Nat.lt_succ_iff_lt_or_eq.mp hkn with hkn' | hkn'
        · exact hbound k hk hkn'
        · have hki : k = i.1 := by omega
          subst hki
          rw [show ps[(i.1 : ℕ)] = p from hp.symm]
          have hpl : ¬ fracVal p < fracVal lo := by
            rw [← fracLt_iff' p lo hpp hlo]; exact hltlo
          have hph : ¬ fracVal hi < fracVal p := by
            rw [← fracLt_iff' hi p hhi hpp]; exact hgthi
          exact ⟨by linarith, by linarith⟩

name: fracInterval_some_le
statement:
theorem fracInterval_some_le (ps : Array (Int × Int)) (hpos : ∀ p ∈ ps, 0 < p.2)
    (lo hi : Int × Int) (h : fracInterval ps = some (lo, hi)) :
    0 < lo.2 ∧ 0 < hi.2 ∧ fracVal lo ≤ fracVal hi
proof:
:= by
  have := fracInterval_inv ps hpos
  rw [h] at this
  simp only [fracIntervalInv] at this
  exact ⟨this.1, this.2.1, this.2.2.1⟩

name: fracInterval_none_empty
statement:
theorem fracInterval_none_empty (ps : Array (Int × Int)) (hpos : ∀ p ∈ ps, 0 < p.2)
    (h : fracInterval ps = none) :
    ps.size = 0
proof:
:= by
  have := fracInterval_inv ps hpos
  rw [h] at this
  simpa only [fracIntervalInv] using this

name: fracInterval_endpoints_mem
statement:
theorem fracInterval_endpoints_mem (ps : Array (Int × Int)) (hpos : ∀ p ∈ ps, 0 < p.2)
    (lo hi : Int × Int) (h : fracInterval ps = some (lo, hi)) :
    lo ∈ ps ∧ hi ∈ ps
proof:
:= by
  have := fracInterval_inv ps hpos
  rw [h] at this
  simp only [fracIntervalInv] at this
  obtain ⟨_, _, _, ⟨ilo, hilo, _, hilop⟩, ⟨ihi, hihi, _, hihip⟩, _⟩ := this
  exact ⟨by rw [← hilop]; exact Array.getElem_mem hilo,
         by rw [← hihip]; exact Array.getElem_mem hihi⟩

name: fracInterval_mem_bound
statement:
theorem fracInterval_mem_bound (ps : Array (Int × Int)) (hpos : ∀ p ∈ ps, 0 < p.2)
    (lo hi : Int × Int) (h : fracInterval ps = some (lo, hi))
    (p : Int × Int) (hp : p ∈ ps) :
    fracVal lo ≤ fracVal p ∧ fracVal p ≤ fracVal hi
proof:
:= by
  have hinv := fracInterval_inv ps hpos
  rw [h] at hinv
  simp only [fracIntervalInv] at hinv
  obtain ⟨_, _, _, _, _, hbound⟩ := hinv
  obtain ⟨i, hi, hip⟩ := Array.getElem_of_mem hp
  have := hbound i hi hi
  rw [hip] at this
  exact this

name: instanceOK3_reflect
statement:
theorem instanceOK3_reflect (sf : Array Int)
    (af bf ao bo : Int × Int)
    (haf : 0 < af.2) (hbf : 0 < bf.2) (hao : 0 < ao.2) (hbo : 0 < bo.2)
    (hob : fracVal ao ≤ fracVal bo)
    (hedge : hasEdgeOnLine sf = false) :
    instanceOK3 sf (some (af, bf)) (some (ao, bo)) = true ↔
      ¬ (fracVal af < fracVal bf ∧ fracVal af < fracVal bo ∧ fracVal ao < fracVal bf)
proof:
:= by
  unfold instanceOK3
  rw [hedge]
  simp only [Bool.false_eq_true, if_false]
  
  set l := if fracLt af ao then ao else af with hl
  set r := if fracLt bo bf then bo else bf with hr
  
  have hlval : fracVal l = max (fracVal af) (fracVal ao) := by
    rw [hl]; by_cases hc : fracLt af ao = true
    · rw [if_pos hc]
      have := (fracLt_iff' af ao haf hao).mp hc
      rw [max_eq_right (le_of_lt this)]
    · rw [if_neg hc]
      have : ¬ fracVal af < fracVal ao := by rw [← fracLt_iff' af ao haf hao]; exact hc
      rw [max_eq_left (le_of_not_lt this)]
  have hrval : fracVal r = min (fracVal bf) (fracVal bo) := by
    rw [hr]; by_cases hc : fracLt bo bf = true
    · rw [if_pos hc]
      have := (fracLt_iff' bo bf hbo hbf).mp hc
      rw [min_eq_right (le_of_lt this)]
    · rw [if_neg hc]
      have : ¬ fracVal bo < fracVal bf := by rw [← fracLt_iff' bo bf hbo hbf]; exact hc
      rw [min_eq_left (le_of_not_lt this)]
  
  have hlpos : 0 < l.2 := by rw [hl]; split <;> assumption
  have hrpos : 0 < r.2 := by rw [hr]; split <;> assumption
  by_cases hJ : fracLt r l = true
  · 
    rw [if_pos hJ]
    have hrl : fracVal r < fracVal l := (fracLt_iff' r l hrpos hlpos).mp hJ
    rw [hlval, hrval] at hrl
    
    simp only [true_iff]
    rintro ⟨h1, h2, h3⟩
    
    rcases (open_closed_meet (fracVal af) (fracVal bf) (fracVal ao) (fracVal bo) hob).mpr
      ⟨h1, h2, h3⟩ with ⟨x, hax, hxb, hcx, hxd⟩
    have hmax : max (fracVal af) (fracVal ao) ≤ x := max_le (le_of_lt hax) hcx
    have hmin : x ≤ min (fracVal bf) (fracVal bo) := le_min (le_of_lt hxb) hxd
    linarith
  · 
    rw [if_neg hJ]
    have hlr : ¬ fracVal r < fracVal l := by rw [← fracLt_iff' r l hrpos hlpos]; exact hJ
    rw [hlval, hrval] at hlr
    have hlr' : max (fracVal af) (fracVal ao) ≤ min (fracVal bf) (fracVal bo) := le_of_not_lt hlr
    
    rw [Bool.not_eq_true', Bool.and_eq_false_iff]
    
    have hLbf : fracLt l bf = true ↔ fracVal l < fracVal bf := fracLt_iff' l bf hlpos hbf
    have hafR : fracLt af r = true ↔ fracVal af < fracVal r := fracLt_iff' af r haf hrpos
    constructor
    · 
      intro hbool
      rintro ⟨h1, h2, h3⟩
      have hlbf : fracVal l < fracVal bf := by rw [hlval]; exact max_lt h1 h3
      have hafr : fracVal af < fracVal r := by rw [hrval]; exact lt_min h1 h2
      rcases hbool with hb | hb
      · exact absurd ((hLbf).mpr hlbf) (by rw [hb]; simp)
      · exact absurd ((hafR).mpr hafr) (by rw [hb]; simp)
    · 
      intro hnm
      by_contra hcon
      push_neg at hcon
      obtain ⟨hb1, hb2⟩ := hcon
      have hlbf : fracVal l < fracVal bf := (hLbf).mp (by simpa using hb1)
      have hafr : fracVal af < fracVal r := (hafR).mp (by simpa using hb2)
      rw [hlval] at hlbf; rw [hrval] at hafr
      exact hnm ⟨lt_of_le_of_lt (le_max_left _ _) hlbf,
        lt_of_lt_of_le hafr (min_le_right _ _),
        lt_of_le_of_lt (le_max_right _ _) hlbf⟩

name: fracNorm_den_pos
statement: theorem fracNorm_den_pos (num den : Int) (hden : den ≠ 0) : 0 < (fracNorm num den).2
proof:
:= by
  unfold fracNorm
  by_cases h : den < 0
  · simp only [h, if_true]; omega
  · simp only [h, if_false]; omega

name: int_neg_of_sign_neg
statement: theorem int_neg_of_sign_neg {x : Int} (h : x.sign < 0) : x < 0
proof:
:= by
  rcases lt_trichotomy x 0 with hx | hx | hx
  · exact hx
  · rw [hx] at h; simp at h
  · rw [Int.sign_eq_one_iff_pos.mpr hx] at h; omega

name: int_pos_of_sign_pos
statement: theorem int_pos_of_sign_pos {x : Int} (h : 0 < x.sign) : 0 < x
proof:
:= by
  rcases lt_trichotomy x 0 with hx | hx | hx
  · rw [Int.sign_eq_neg_one_iff_neg.mpr hx] at h; omega
  · rw [hx] at h; simp at h
  · exact hx

name: collectParams_den_pos
statement:
theorem collectParams_den_pos (axis : Nat) (vs : Array I3) (signs : Array Int)
    (nOther sv0Other : I3)
    (hmatch : ∀ k : ℕ, k < 3 →
      signs.getD k 0 = Int.sign (dotI nOther (subI (vs.getD k default) sv0Other)))
    (p : Int × Int) (hp : p ∈ collectParams axis vs signs nOther sv0Other) :
    0 < p.2
proof:
:= by
  unfold collectParams at hp
  simp only at hp
  rw [Array.mem_append] at hp
  rcases hp with hv | he
  · 
    rw [Array.mem_filterMap] at hv
    obtain ⟨k, _, hk⟩ := hv
    split at hk
    · 
      rw [Option.some.injEq] at hk
      rw [← hk]; exact one_pos
    · exact absurd hk (by simp)
  · 
    rw [Array.mem_filterMap] at he
    obtain ⟨k, hkrange, hk⟩ := he
    have hk3 : k < 3 := by
      rw [Array.mem_def, Array.toList_range, List.mem_range] at hkrange; exact hkrange
    split at hk
    · rename_i hguard
      rw [Option.some.injEq] at hk
      rw [← hk]
      apply fracNorm_den_pos
      
      set ea := dotI nOther (subI (vs.getD k default) sv0Other) with hea
      set eb := dotI nOther (subI (vs.getD ((k + 1) % 3) default) sv0Other) with heb
      have hk1 : (k + 1) % 3 < 3 := Nat.mod_lt _ (by norm_num)
      have hsa : signs.getD k 0 = Int.sign ea := hmatch k hk3
      have hsb : signs.getD ((k + 1) % 3) 0 = Int.sign eb := hmatch ((k + 1) % 3) hk1
      rw [hsa, hsb] at hguard
      
      rcases (Bool.or_eq_true _ _).mp hguard with hg | hg
      · rw [Bool.and_eq_true] at hg
        obtain ⟨h1, h2⟩ := hg
        have hs1 : Int.sign ea < 0 := by simpa using h1
        have hs2 : 0 < Int.sign eb := by simpa using h2
        have he1 : ea < 0 := int_neg_of_sign_neg hs1
        have he2 : 0 < eb := int_pos_of_sign_pos hs2
        omega
      · rw [Bool.and_eq_true] at hg
        obtain ⟨h1, h2⟩ := hg
        have hs1 : 0 < Int.sign ea := by simpa using h1
        have hs2 : Int.sign eb < 0 := by simpa using h2
        have he1 : 0 < ea := int_pos_of_sign_pos hs1
        have he2 : eb < 0 := int_neg_of_sign_neg hs2
        omega
    · exact absurd hk (by simp)

name: sideSigns_getD_eval
statement:
theorem sideSigns_getD_eval (ns sv0 : I3) (vs : Array I3) (k : ℕ) (hk : k < vs.size) :
    (sideSigns ns sv0 vs).getD k 0 = Int.sign (dotI ns (subI (vs.getD k default) sv0))
proof:
:= by
  unfold sideSigns
  have hkm : k < (vs.map (fun v => Int.sign (dotI ns (subI v sv0)))).size := by
    rw [Array.size_map]; exact hk
  simp only [Array.getD, hkm, hk, dif_pos, Array.get_eq_getElem, Array.getElem_map]

name: collectParams_sideSigns_den_pos
statement:
theorem collectParams_sideSigns_den_pos (axis : Nat) (vs : Array I3)
    (nOther sv0Other : I3) (hvs : vs.size = 3)
    (p : Int × Int)
    (hp : p ∈ collectParams axis vs (sideSigns nOther sv0Other vs) nOther sv0Other) :
    0 < p.2
proof:
:=
  collectParams_den_pos axis vs (sideSigns nOther sv0Other vs) nOther sv0Other
    (fun k hk => sideSigns_getD_eval nOther sv0Other vs k (by omega)) p hp

name: bound_two_cuts
statement:
theorem bound_two_cuts (e0 e1 e2 c0 c1 c2 m0 m1 m2 K1 K2 ub : ℚ)
    (he2 : e2 < 0) (hm0 : 0 ≤ m0) (hm1 : 0 ≤ m1) (_hm2 : 0 ≤ m2)
    (hsum : m0 + m1 + m2 = 1) (hfeas : m0*e0 + m1*e1 + m2*e2 = 0)
    (hK1 : K1 = e1*c2 - e2*c1) (hK2 : K2 = e0*c2 - e2*c0)
    (hb1 : K1 ≤ ub * (e1 - e2)) (hb2 : K2 ≤ ub * (e0 - e2))
    (_hD1 : 0 < e1 - e2) (_hD2 : 0 < e0 - e2) :
    m0*c0 + m1*c1 + m2*c2 ≤ ub
proof:
:= by
  have hid : (-e2) * (m0*c0 + m1*c1 + m2*c2) = m1*K1 + m0*K2 := by
    rw [hK1, hK2]; linear_combination (-c2) * hfeas
  have hcoef : m1*(e1-e2) + m0*(e0-e2) = -e2 := by linear_combination hfeas - e2*hsum
  have t1 : m1*K1 ≤ m1*(ub*(e1-e2)) := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hb1 hm1
  have t2 : m0*K2 ≤ m0*(ub*(e0-e2)) := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hb2 hm0
  have hcombo : m1*(ub*(e1-e2)) + m0*(ub*(e0-e2)) = ub*(-e2) := by rw [← hcoef]; ring
  have hstep : m1*K1 + m0*K2 ≤ ub * (-e2) := by rw [← hcombo]; linarith [t1, t2]
  have hle : (-e2) * (m0*c0 + m1*c1 + m2*c2) ≤ (-e2) * ub := by
    rw [hid, mul_comm (-e2) ub]; exact hstep
  exact le_of_mul_le_mul_left hle (by linarith)

name: bound_vertex_cut
statement:
theorem bound_vertex_cut (e1 e2 c0 c1 c2 m0 m1 m2 K1 ub : ℚ)
    (_he1 : 0 < e1) (_he2 : e2 < 0) (hm0 : 0 ≤ m0) (hm1 : 0 ≤ m1) (hm2 : 0 ≤ m2)
    (hsum : m0 + m1 + m2 = 1) (hfeas : m1*e1 + m2*e2 = 0)
    (hK1 : K1 = e1*c2 - e2*c1)
    (hbv : c0 ≤ ub) (hb1 : K1 ≤ ub * (e1 - e2)) (hD1 : 0 < e1 - e2) :
    m0*c0 + m1*c1 + m2*c2 ≤ ub
proof:
:= by
  have hid : (e1-e2)*(m1*c1+m2*c2) = (m1+m2)*K1 := by rw [hK1]; linear_combination (c1 - c2)*hfeas
  have hv : (e1-e2)*(m0*c0) ≤ (e1-e2)*(m0*ub) :=
    mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hbv hm0) (le_of_lt hD1)
  have hb1' : (m1+m2)*K1 ≤ (m1+m2)*(ub*(e1-e2)) := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hb1 (by linarith)
  have hexp : (e1-e2)*(m0*c0+m1*c1+m2*c2) = (e1-e2)*(m0*c0) + (m1+m2)*K1 := by rw [← hid]; ring
  have hrhs : (e1-e2)*ub = (e1-e2)*(m0*ub) + (m1+m2)*(ub*(e1-e2)) := by
    linear_combination (-(ub*(e1-e2)))*hsum
  have hfin : (e1-e2)*(m0*c0+m1*c1+m2*c2) ≤ (e1-e2)*ub := by rw [hexp, hrhs]; linarith [hv, hb1']
  exact le_of_mul_le_mul_left hfin hD1

name: feasible_one_zero_same_sign
statement:
theorem feasible_one_zero_same_sign (e1 e2 c0 c1 c2 m0 m1 m2 : ℚ)
    (he1 : 0 < e1) (he2 : 0 < e2) (_hm0 : 0 ≤ m0) (hm1 : 0 ≤ m1) (hm2 : 0 ≤ m2)
    (hsum : m0 + m1 + m2 = 1) (hfeas : m1*e1 + m2*e2 = 0) :
    m0*c0 + m1*c1 + m2*c2 = c0
proof:
:= by
  have h1 : m1 = 0 := by nlinarith [mul_nonneg hm1 (le_of_lt he1), mul_nonneg hm2 (le_of_lt he2)]
  have h2 : m2 = 0 := by nlinarith [mul_nonneg hm1 (le_of_lt he1), mul_nonneg hm2 (le_of_lt he2)]
  have h0 : m0 = 1 := by linarith
  rw [h0, h1, h2]; ring

name: prepOf_bvh

name: mem_candOf_iff
statement:
theorem mem_candOf_iff (hbvh : Impl.BVH.BVH)
    (hb : hbvh = Impl.BVH.buildBVHM (B.map (fun f => boxToBVH (bboxOfFace f))))
    {i j : ℕ} (hi : i < A.size) :
    j ∈ (candOf A B hbvh).getD i #[]
      ↔ j < B.size ∧ boxesOverlap (bboxOfFace (A.getD i default)) (bboxOfFace (B.getD j default)) = true
proof:
:= by
  have hsz : (candOf A B hbvh).size = A.size := Array.size_map ..
  have hget : (candOf A B hbvh).getD i #[]
      = (Impl.BVH.boxQuery hbvh (boxToBVH (bboxOfFace (A.getD i default)))).filter
          (fun j => boxesOverlap (bboxOfFace (A.getD i default)) ((B.map bboxOfFace).getD j default)) := by
    rw [arr_getD _ _ _ (by rw [hsz]; exact hi)]
    simp only [candOf, Array.getElem_map]
    rw [arr_getD A i default hi]
  have hboxsz : (B.map (fun f => boxToBVH (bboxOfFace f))).size = B.size := Array.size_map ..
  constructor
  · intro hmem
    rw [hget, Array.mem_filter] at hmem
    obtain ⟨hq, hov⟩ := hmem
    have hjlt : j < B.size := by
      have := Proof.BVH.boxQueryM_mem_lt (B.map (fun f => boxToBVH (bboxOfFace f)))
        (boxToBVH (bboxOfFace (A.getD i default))) j (by rw [← hb]; exact hq)
      rwa [hboxsz] at this
    refine ⟨hjlt, ?_⟩
    rw [arr_getD B j default hjlt]
    rwa [arr_getD (B.map bboxOfFace) j default (by rw [Array.size_map]; exact hjlt),
      Array.getElem_map] at hov
  · rintro ⟨hjlt, hov⟩
    rw [hget, Array.mem_filter]
    refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
    · rw [hb]
      refine Proof.BVH.boxQueryM_sound _ _ j (by rw [hboxsz]; exact hjlt) ?_
      rw [arr_getD (B.map (fun f => boxToBVH (bboxOfFace f))) j default
          (by rw [hboxsz]; exact hjlt), Array.getElem_map, ← arr_getD B j default hjlt]
      exact hov
    · rw [arr_getD (B.map bboxOfFace) j default (by rw [Array.size_map]; exact hjlt),
        Array.getElem_map, ← arr_getD B j default hjlt]
      exact hov

name: candOf_isEmpty_iff
statement:
theorem candOf_isEmpty_iff (hbvh : Impl.BVH.BVH)
    (hb : hbvh = Impl.BVH.buildBVHM (B.map (fun f => boxToBVH (bboxOfFace f))))
    {i : ℕ} (hi : i < A.size) :
    ((candOf A B hbvh).getD i #[]).isEmpty = true
      ↔ ∀ j, j < B.size → boxesOverlap (bboxOfFace (A.getD i default)) (bboxOfFace (B.getD j default)) = false
proof:
:= by
  rw [← Array.isEmpty_toList, List.isEmpty_iff, List.eq_nil_iff_forall_not_mem]
  constructor
  · intro h j hj
    by_contra hov
    exact h j (Array.mem_toList.mpr
      ((mem_candOf_iff hbvh hb hi).mpr ⟨hj, by simpa using hov⟩))
  · intro h j hj
    obtain ⟨hjlt, hov⟩ := (mem_candOf_iff hbvh hb hi).mp (Array.mem_toList.mp hj)
    rw [h j hjlt] at hov
    exact Bool.false_ne_true hov

name: freeOf_getD_iff
statement:
theorem freeOf_getD_iff (hbvh : Impl.BVH.BVH)
    (hb : hbvh = Impl.BVH.buildBVHM (B.map (fun f => boxToBVH (bboxOfFace f))))
    {i : ℕ} (hi : i < A.size) :
    (freeOf (candOf A B hbvh)).getD i false = true
      ↔ ∀ j, j < B.size → boxesOverlap (bboxOfFace (A.getD i default)) (bboxOfFace (B.getD j default)) = false
proof:
:= by
  have hsz : (candOf A B hbvh).size = A.size := Array.size_map ..
  have hfg : (freeOf (candOf A B hbvh)).getD i false
      = ((candOf A B hbvh).getD i #[]).isEmpty := by
    unfold freeOf
    rw [arr_getD ((candOf A B hbvh).map (fun c => c.isEmpty)) i false
        (by rw [Array.size_map, hsz]; exact hi),
      arr_getD (candOf A B hbvh) i #[] (by rw [hsz]; exact hi), Array.getElem_map]
  rw [hfg]
  exact candOf_isEmpty_iff hbvh hb hi

statement:
@[simp] theorem phiAff_apply (t : Triangle) (P : Point) :
    phiAff t P = cOf t - dot (faceNormal t) P

name: sStar_pos_iff
statement:
theorem sStar_pos_iff {t : Triangle} {d : Point} (_hnd : dot (faceNormal t) d ≠ 0)
    (P : Point) : 0 < sStar t d P ↔ 0 < phiAff t P * dot (faceNormal t) d
proof:
:= by
  rw [sStar, phiAff_apply, cOf, div_pos_iff, mul_pos_iff]

name: sStar_zero_iff
statement:
theorem sStar_zero_iff {t : Triangle} {d : Point} (hnd : dot (faceNormal t) d ≠ 0)
    (P : Point) : sStar t d P = 0 ↔ phiAff t P * dot (faceNormal t) d = 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [sStar, phiAff_apply, cOf, div_eq_zero_iff]
  constructor
  · rintro (h | h)
    · rw [h, zero_mul]
    · exact absurd h hnd
  · intro h
    rcases mul_eq_zero.mp h with h | h
    · exact Or.inl h
    · exact absurd h hnd

name: rayHits_iff_signs
statement:
theorem rayHits_iff_signs {t : Triangle} {d : Point} (hnd : dot (faceNormal t) d ≠ 0)
    (P : Point) :
    RayHits P d t ↔
      0 < phiAff t P * dot (faceNormal t) d ∧
      0 ≤ psi0 t d P ∧ 0 ≤ psi1 t d P ∧ 0 ≤ psi2 t d P
proof:
:= by
  have hn : faceNormal t ≠ 0 := by
    intro h; apply hnd; rw [h]; simp [dot]
  rw [rayHits_iff hnd, sStar_pos_iff hnd]
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨hpos, hmem⟩
    refine ⟨hpos, ?_⟩
    obtain ⟨h0, h1, h2⟩ := ee_nonneg_of_mem hmem
    exact ⟨h0, h1, h2⟩
  · rintro ⟨hpos, h0, h1, h2⟩
    refine ⟨hpos, ?_⟩
    exact mem_triangleSet_of_carrier' hn (hitPt_on_carrier hnd P)
      (by simpa using h0) (by simpa using h1) (by simpa using h2)

name: exists_off_negligible_in_cell'
statement:
theorem exists_off_negligible_in_cell' {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι]
    (g : ι → (Point →ᵃ[ℚ] ℚ)) (s : ι → ℚ) (hs : ∀ j, s j = 1 ∨ s j = -1)
    {p₀ : Point} (hp₀ : ∀ j, 0 < s j * g j p₀)
    {N : Set Point} (hN : Negligible N) :
    ∃ Q, (∀ j, 0 < s j * g j Q) ∧ Q ∉ N
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let e := Fintype.equivFin ι
  obtain ⟨Q, hQcell, hQN⟩ := Proof.MeshIntersectRay.exists_off_negligible_in_cell
    (fun k => g (e.symm k)) (fun k => s (e.symm k)) (fun k => hs _)
    (fun k => hp₀ _) hN
  exact ⟨Q, fun j => by have := hQcell (e j); simpa using this, hQN⟩

name: oneAff_apply
statement: @[simp] theorem oneAff_apply (P : Point) : oneAff P = 1
proof: := rfl

name: sigmaD_mem
statement: theorem sigmaD_mem (t : Triangle) (d : Point) : sigmaD t d = 1 ∨ sigmaD t d = -1
proof:
:= by
  unfold sigmaD; split_ifs <;> [exact Or.inl rfl; exact Or.inr rfl]

name: sigmaD_pos_iff
statement:
theorem sigmaD_pos_iff {t : Triangle} {d : Point} (hnd : dot (faceNormal t) d ≠ 0)
    (x : ℚ) : 0 < sigmaD t d * x ↔ 0 < x * dot (faceNormal t) d
proof:
:= by
  unfold sigmaD
  split_ifs with h
  · rw [one_mul]
    constructor
    · intro hx; exact mul_pos hx h
    · intro hx; nlinarith [hx, h]
  · have hneg : dot (faceNormal t) d < 0 := (not_lt.mp h).lt_of_ne hnd
    rw [neg_one_mul, neg_pos]
    constructor
    · intro hx; nlinarith [hx, hneg]
    · intro hx; nlinarith [hx, hneg]

name: wfam_sign
statement:
theorem wfam_sign (t : Triangle) (d Q : Point) (j : Fin 4) :
    (wfam t d Q j).2 = 1 ∨ (wfam t d Q j).2 = -1
proof:
:= by
  unfold wfam
  split_ifs <;> fin_cases j <;>
    simp only [Matrix.cons_val_zero, Matrix.cons_val_one, Matrix.head_cons,
      Matrix.cons_val_two, Matrix.tail_cons, Matrix.cons_val_three] <;>
    first
    | exact Or.inl rfl
    | exact Or.inr rfl
    | (rcases sigmaD_mem t d with h | h) <;> simp [h]

name: wfam_strict
statement:
theorem wfam_strict {t : Triangle} {d Q : Point}
    (hQ : Q ∉ triangleSet t)
    (hedge : ∀ s : ℚ, 0 < s → Q + s • d ∉ edgeSet t)
    (j : Fin 4) : 0 < (wfam t d Q j).2 * (wfam t d Q j).1 Q
proof:
:= by
  unfold wfam
  by_cases hnd : dot (faceNormal t) d = 0
  · simp only [hnd, dif_pos]; fin_cases j <;> norm_num
  · simp only [hnd, dif_neg, not_false_iff]
    by_cases hhit : RayHits Q d t
    · 
      simp only [hhit, if_pos]
      obtain ⟨hsStar, hmemtri⟩ := (rayHits_iff hnd Q).mp hhit
      
      have hoff : hitPt t d Q ∉ edgeSet t := by
        rw [hitPt, lineAt_eq]; exact hedge (sStar t d Q) hsStar
      obtain ⟨he0, he1, he2⟩ := ee_pos_of_mem_not_edge
        (by intro hc; apply hnd; rw [hc]; simp [dot]) hmemtri hoff
      fin_cases j
      · show (0:ℚ) < sigmaD t d * phiAff t Q
        rw [sigmaD_pos_iff hnd]
        exact (sStar_pos_iff hnd Q).mp hsStar
      · show (0:ℚ) < 1 * psi0 t d Q; rw [one_mul, psi0_apply]; exact he0
      · show (0:ℚ) < 1 * psi1 t d Q; rw [one_mul, psi1_apply]; exact he1
      · show (0:ℚ) < 1 * psi2 t d Q; rw [one_mul, psi2_apply]; exact he2
    · 
      simp only [hhit, if_neg, not_false_iff]
      by_cases h0 : ee0 t (hitPt t d Q) < 0
      · simp only [h0, dif_pos]; fin_cases j <;> simp only [Matrix.cons_val_zero,
          Matrix.cons_val_one, Matrix.head_cons, Matrix.cons_val_two, Matrix.tail_cons,
          Matrix.cons_val_three]
        · show (0:ℚ) < -1 * psi0 t d Q; rw [psi0_apply]; nlinarith [h0]
        all_goals norm_num
      · simp only [h0, dif_neg, not_false_iff]
        by_cases h1 : ee1 t (hitPt t d Q) < 0
        · simp only [h1, dif_pos]; fin_cases j <;> simp only [Matrix.cons_val_zero,
            Matrix.cons_val_one, Matrix.head_cons, Matrix.cons_val_two, Matrix.tail_cons,
            Matrix.cons_val_three]
          · show (0:ℚ) < -1 * psi1 t d Q; rw [psi1_apply]; nlinarith [h1]
          all_goals norm_num
        · simp only [h1, dif_neg, not_false_iff]
          by_cases h2 : ee2 t (hitPt t d Q) < 0
          · simp only [h2, dif_pos]; fin_cases j <;> simp only [Matrix.cons_val_zero,
              Matrix.cons_val_one, Matrix.head_cons, Matrix.cons_val_two, Matrix.tail_cons,
              Matrix.cons_val_three]
            · show (0:ℚ) < -1 * psi2 t d Q; rw [psi2_apply]; nlinarith [h2]
            all_goals norm_num
          · 
            simp only [h2, dif_neg, not_false_iff]
            push_neg at h0 h1 h2
            have hn : faceNormal t ≠ 0 := by intro hc; apply hnd; rw [hc]; simp [dot]
            
            have hmemtri : hitPt t d Q ∈ triangleSet t :=
              mem_triangleSet_of_carrier' hn (hitPt_on_carrier hnd Q) h0 h1 h2
            
            have hsle : ¬ 0 < sStar t d Q := by
              intro hs; exact hhit ((rayHits_iff hnd Q).mpr ⟨hs, hmemtri⟩)
            
            have hsne : sStar t d Q ≠ 0 := by
              intro hs0
              apply hQ
              have : hitPt t d Q = Q := by rw [hitPt, hs0, zero_smul, add_zero]
              rwa [this] at hmemtri
            have hslt : sStar t d Q < 0 := (not_lt.mp hsle).lt_of_ne hsne
            
            have hphineg : phiAff t Q * dot (faceNormal t) d < 0 := by
              by_contra hc; push_neg at hc
              rcases eq_or_lt_of_le hc with heq | hpos
              · exact hsne ((sStar_zero_iff hnd Q).mpr heq.symm)
              · exact absurd ((sStar_pos_iff hnd Q).mpr hpos) hsle
            fin_cases j <;> simp only [Matrix.cons_val_zero, Matrix.cons_val_one,
              Matrix.head_cons, Matrix.cons_val_two, Matrix.tail_cons, Matrix.cons_val_three]
            · show (0:ℚ) < - sigmaD t d * phiAff t Q
              rw [neg_mul, ← mul_neg, sigmaD_pos_iff hnd]
              nlinarith [hphineg]
            all_goals norm_num

name: wfam_forces
proof:
:= by
  unfold crossSummand
  by_cases hnd : dot (faceNormal t) d = 0
  · rw [hnd]; simp
  · 
    have hrayiff : RayHits P d t ↔ RayHits Q d t := by
      
      have hwfam := hP
      unfold wfam at hwfam
      simp only [hnd, dif_neg, not_false_iff] at hwfam
      by_cases hhit : RayHits Q d t
      · 
        simp only [hhit, if_pos] at hwfam
        constructor
        · intro _; exact hhit
        · intro _
          
          have hφ := hwfam 0
          have hp0 := hwfam 1
          have hp1 := hwfam 2
          have hp2 := hwfam 3
          simp only [Matrix.cons_val_zero, Matrix.cons_val_one, Matrix.head_cons,
            Matrix.cons_val_two, Matrix.tail_cons, Matrix.cons_val_three, one_mul] at hφ hp0 hp1 hp2
          rw [rayHits_iff_signs hnd]
          exact ⟨(sigmaD_pos_iff hnd _).mp hφ, hp0.le, hp1.le, hp2.le⟩
      · 
        simp only [hhit, if_neg, not_false_iff] at hwfam
        constructor
        · intro hpP
          exfalso
          
          rw [rayHits_iff_signs hnd] at hpP
          obtain ⟨hφP, hpe0, hpe1, hpe2⟩ := hpP
          
          by_cases h0 : ee0 t (hitPt t d Q) < 0
          · simp only [h0, dif_pos] at hwfam
            have := hwfam 0
            simp only [Matrix.cons_val_zero] at this
            rw [show ((psi0 t d, (-1:ℚ)).2) * (psi0 t d, (-1:ℚ)).1 P = -1 * psi0 t d P from rfl] at this
            linarith [hpe0]
          · simp only [h0, dif_neg, not_false_iff] at hwfam
            by_cases h1 : ee1 t (hitPt t d Q) < 0
            · simp only [h1, dif_pos] at hwfam
              have := hwfam 0
              simp only [Matrix.cons_val_zero] at this
              rw [show ((psi1 t d, (-1:ℚ)).2) * (psi1 t d, (-1:ℚ)).1 P = -1 * psi1 t d P from rfl] at this
              linarith [hpe1]
            · simp only [h1, dif_neg, not_false_iff] at hwfam
              by_cases h2 : ee2 t (hitPt t d Q) < 0
              · simp only [h2, dif_pos] at hwfam
                have := hwfam 0
                simp only [Matrix.cons_val_zero] at this
                rw [show ((psi2 t d, (-1:ℚ)).2) * (psi2 t d, (-1:ℚ)).1 P = -1 * psi2 t d P from rfl] at this
                linarith [hpe2]
              · 
                simp only [h2, dif_neg, not_false_iff] at hwfam
                have := hwfam 0
                simp only [Matrix.cons_val_zero] at this
                rw [show ((phiAff t, - sigmaD t d).2) * (phiAff t, - sigmaD t d).1 P
                  = - sigmaD t d * phiAff t P from rfl] at this
                rw [neg_mul, ← mul_neg, sigmaD_pos_iff hnd] at this
                nlinarith [this, hφP]
        · intro hqP; exact absurd hqP hhit
    rw [hrayiff]

name: crossingCount_eq_sum
statement:
theorem crossingCount_eq_sum (M : Mesh) (Q d : Point) :
    crossingCount M Q d = ∑ u : Fin M.size, crossSummand M[u] Q d
proof: := rfl

name: exists_count_eq_off_negligible
statement:
theorem exists_count_eq_off_negligible {M : Mesh} {Q d : Point}
    (hQ : Q ∉ surface M) (hadm : AdmissibleRay M Q d)
    {N : Set Point} (hN : Negligible N) :
    ∃ P, crossingCount M P d = crossingCount M Q d ∧ P ∉ N
proof:
:= by
  classical
  obtain ⟨_, hedge⟩ := hadm
  
  have hQtri : ∀ u : Fin M.size, Q ∉ triangleSet M[u] := by
    intro u hmem; exact hQ (Set.mem_iUnion.mpr ⟨u, hmem⟩)
  have hQedge : ∀ (u : Fin M.size) (s : ℚ), 0 < s → Q + s • d ∉ edgeSet M[u] :=
    fun u s hs => hedge u s hs
  
  set G : (Fin M.size × Fin 4) → (Point →ᵃ[ℚ] ℚ) :=
    fun uk => (wfam M[uk.1] d Q uk.2).1 with hG
  set S : (Fin M.size × Fin 4) → ℚ :=
    fun uk => (wfam M[uk.1] d Q uk.2).2 with hS
  have hSsign : ∀ uk, S uk = 1 ∨ S uk = -1 := fun uk => wfam_sign M[uk.1] d Q uk.2
  have hStrict : ∀ uk, 0 < S uk * G uk Q :=
    fun uk => wfam_strict (hQtri uk.1) (hQedge uk.1) uk.2
  obtain ⟨P, hPcell, hPN⟩ := exists_off_negligible_in_cell' G S hSsign hStrict hN
  refine ⟨P, ?_, hPN⟩
  rw [crossingCount_eq_sum, crossingCount_eq_sum]
  refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun u _ => ?_)
  refine wfam_forces (fun j => ?_)
  exact hPcell (u, j)

name: fragOfFace_cycle
statement:
theorem fragOfFace_cycle (t : Triangle) :
    ∃ hsz : (fragOfFace (faceSOf t)).poly.size = 3,

        fragCycle (fragOfFace (faceSOf t)) k
          = ![t.v₀, t.v₁, t.v₂] (Fin.cast hsz k)
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨rfl, fun k => ?_⟩
  fin_cases k
  · exact ofPoint_toPoint t.v₀
  · exact ofPoint_toPoint t.v₁
  · exact ofPoint_toPoint t.v₂

name: vpoly_fragOfFace
statement:
theorem vpoly_fragOfFace (t : Triangle) :
    vpoly (fragCycle (fragOfFace (faceSOf t)))
      = triangleSet t
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨hsz, hpt⟩ := fragOfFace_cycle t
  haveI : NeZero (fragOfFace (faceSOf t)).poly.size :=
    ⟨by omega⟩
  rw [vpoly_transport hsz hpt, vpoly, triangleSet]
  congr 1
  ext x
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨k, rfl⟩
    fin_cases k <;> simp
  · intro hx
    rcases hx with rfl | rfl | rfl
    · exact ⟨0, rfl⟩
    · exact ⟨1, rfl⟩
    · exact ⟨2, rfl⟩

name: comb_le
statement:
private theorem comb_le {lo p q a a' : ℚ} (ha : 0 ≤ a) (ha' : 0 ≤ a')
    (haa : a + a' = 1) (hp : lo ≤ p) (hq : lo ≤ q) : lo ≤ a * p + a' * q
proof:
:= by
  have h1 : a * lo ≤ a * p := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hp ha
  have h2 : a' * lo ≤ a' * q := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hq ha'
  have h3 : a * lo + a' * lo = lo := by rw [← add_mul, haa, one_mul]
  linarith

name: le_comb
statement:
private theorem le_comb {hi p q a a' : ℚ} (ha : 0 ≤ a) (ha' : 0 ≤ a')
    (haa : a + a' = 1) (hp : p ≤ hi) (hq : q ≤ hi) : a * p + a' * q ≤ hi
proof:
:= by
  have h1 : a * p ≤ a * hi := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hp ha
  have h2 : a' * q ≤ a' * hi := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hq ha'
  have h3 : a * hi + a' * hi = hi := by rw [← add_mul, haa, one_mul]
  linarith

name: inBox_convex
statement: theorem inBox_convex (b : Box3) : Convex ℚ {x : Point | InBox b x}
proof:
:= by
  rintro x hx y hy a a' ha ha' haa
  obtain ⟨⟨hx1, hx2⟩, ⟨hx3, hx4⟩, hx5, hx6⟩ := hx
  obtain ⟨⟨hy1, hy2⟩, ⟨hy3, hy4⟩, hy5, hy6⟩ := hy
  refine ⟨⟨?_, ?_⟩, ⟨?_, ?_⟩, ?_, ?_⟩ <;>
      simp only [Pi.add_apply, Pi.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul]
  · exact comb_le ha ha' haa hx1 hy1
  · exact le_comb ha ha' haa hx2 hy2
  · exact comb_le ha ha' haa hx3 hy3
  · exact le_comb ha ha' haa hx4 hy4
  · exact comb_le ha ha' haa hx5 hy5
  · exact le_comb ha ha' haa hx6 hy6

name: bboxOfFace_faceSOf
statement:
theorem bboxOfFace_faceSOf (t : Triangle) :
    bboxOfFace (faceSOf t)
      = ⟨⟨min (t.v₀ 0) (min (t.v₁ 0) (t.v₂ 0)),
          min (t.v₀ 1) (min (t.v₁ 1) (t.v₂ 1)),
          min (t.v₀ 2) (min (t.v₁ 2) (t.v₂ 2))⟩,
         ⟨max (t.v₀ 0) (max (t.v₁ 0) (t.v₂ 0)),
          max (t.v₀ 1) (max (t.v₁ 1) (t.v₂ 1)),
          max (t.v₀ 2) (max (t.v₁ 2) (t.v₂ 2))⟩⟩
proof:
:= by
  show (⟨pminS (ofPoint t.v₀) (pminS (ofPoint t.v₁) (ofPoint t.v₂)),
         pmaxS (ofPoint t.v₀) (pmaxS (ofPoint t.v₁) (ofPoint t.v₂))⟩ : Box3)
      = _
  simp only [pminS, pmaxS, ofPoint, rmin_eq, rmax_eq]

name: triangleSet_subset_bbox
statement:
theorem triangleSet_subset_bbox (t : Triangle) :
    triangleSet t ⊆ {x | InBox (bboxOfFace (faceSOf t)) x}
proof:
:= by
  rw [triangleSet]
  apply convexHull_min ?_ (inBox_convex _)
  rintro v hv
  show InBox (bboxOfFace (faceSOf t)) v
  rw [bboxOfFace_faceSOf t]
  rcases hv with rfl | rfl | rfl
  · exact ⟨⟨min_le_left _ _, le_max_left _ _⟩,
      ⟨min_le_left _ _, le_max_left _ _⟩,
      min_le_left _ _, le_max_left _ _⟩
  · exact ⟨⟨le_trans (min_le_right _ _) (min_le_left _ _),
        le_trans (le_max_left _ _) (le_max_right _ _)⟩,
      ⟨le_trans (min_le_right _ _) (min_le_left _ _),
        le_trans (le_max_left _ _) (le_max_right _ _)⟩,
      le_trans (min_le_right _ _) (min_le_left _ _),
      le_trans (le_max_left _ _) (le_max_right _ _)⟩
  · exact ⟨⟨le_trans (min_le_right _ _) (min_le_right _ _),
        le_trans (le_max_right _ _) (le_max_right _ _)⟩,
      ⟨le_trans (min_le_right _ _) (min_le_right _ _),
        le_trans (le_max_right _ _) (le_max_right _ _)⟩,
      le_trans (min_le_right _ _) (min_le_right _ _),
      le_trans (le_max_right _ _) (le_max_right _ _)⟩

name: mem_candidates
statement:
theorem mem_candidates {A B : Array FaceS} {i j : ℕ}
    (hi : i < A.size) (hj : j < B.size)
    (hov : boxesOverlap (bboxOfFace (A[i])) (bboxOfFace (B[j])) = true) :
    j ∈ (candidates A B).getD i #[]
proof:
:= by
  have hsz : (candidates A B).size = A.size := Array.size_map ..
  rw [arr_getD _ _ _ (by omega : i < (candidates A B).size)]
  unfold candidates
  rw [Array.getElem_map]
  
  have hjb : j < (B.map (fun g => boxToBVH (bboxOfFace g))).size := by
    rw [Array.size_map]; exact hj
  
  have hget : (B.map (fun g => boxToBVH (bboxOfFace g))).getD j default
      = boxToBVH (bboxOfFace (B[j])) := by
    rw [arr_getD _ _ _ hjb, Array.getElem_map]
  
  have hov' : Impl.BVH.overlap (boxToBVH (bboxOfFace (A[i])))
      ((B.map (fun g => boxToBVH (bboxOfFace g))).getD j default) = true := by
    rw [hget]
    
    show Impl.BVH.overlap (boxToBVH (bboxOfFace (A[i]))) (boxToBVH (bboxOfFace (B[j]))) = true
    exact hov
  exact Proof.BVH.boxQuery_sound (B.map (fun g => boxToBVH (bboxOfFace g)))
    (boxToBVH (bboxOfFace (A[i]))) j hjb hov'

name: cutPt_symm
statement:
theorem cutPt_symm {N : Point} {c : ℚ} {a b : Point}
    (h : ce N c a ≠ ce N c b) : cutPt N c a b = cutPt N c b a
proof:
:= by
  have hd : ce N c a - ce N c b ≠ 0 := sub_ne_zero.mpr h
  have hd' : ce N c b - ce N c a ≠ 0 := sub_ne_zero.mpr (Ne.symm h)
  unfold cutPt cutT

name: scopeBoxSEG_some_superset
proof:
:= by
  have hplane : {x : Point | dotQ N x = c} = {x : Point | ce N c x = 0} := by
    ext x; simp only [Set.mem_setOf_eq, ce, sub_eq_zero]
  rw [hplane]
  
  by_cases hdrop : dropByPlane P (faceSOf u) = true
  · rw [scopeBoxSEG, if_pos hdrop] at hsome; exact absurd hsome (by simp)
  rw [Bool.not_eq_true] at hdrop
  rw [scopeBoxSEG, if_neg (by rw [hdrop]; decide)] at hsome
  by_cases hcop : (signI P (faceSOf u).v₀.h == 0 && signI P (faceSOf u).v₁.h == 0
      && signI P (faceSOf u).v₂.h == 0) = true
  · 
    rw [if_pos hcop] at hsome
    obtain rfl : bboxOfFace (faceSOf u) = box := by injection hsome
    rintro x ⟨hxt, -⟩
    exact triangleSet_subset_bbox u hxt
  rw [if_neg hcop] at hsome
  by_cases hemp : (sectionPts P (faceSOf u)).isEmpty = true
  · rw [if_pos hemp] at hsome
    obtain rfl : bboxOfFace (faceSOf u) = box := by injection hsome
    rintro x ⟨hxt, -⟩
    exact triangleSet_subset_bbox u hxt
  rw [if_neg hemp] at hsome
  
  obtain rfl : bboxOfPts (sectionPts P (faceSOf u)) = box := by injection hsome
  refine triangleSet_inter_plane_subset (boxSet_convex _) ?_ ?_
  · 
    rintro v (rfl | rfl | rfl) hce0
    · have hs : signI P (faceSOf u).v₀.h = 0 :=
        (signI_iff_of_mul hP (repr4_faceSOf₀ u)).2.2.2.mpr hce0
      have := mem_bboxOfPts (Array.mem_toList.mpr (mem_sectionPts_v₀ hs))
      rwa [show P3.toPoint (faceSOf u).v₀.p = u.v₀ from ofPoint_toPoint u.v₀] at this
    · have hs : signI P (faceSOf u).v₁.h = 0 :=
        (signI_iff_of_mul hP (repr4_faceSOf₁ u)).2.2.2.mpr hce0
      have := mem_bboxOfPts (Array.mem_toList.mpr (mem_sectionPts_v₁ hs))
      rwa [show P3.toPoint (faceSOf u).v₁.p = u.v₁ from ofPoint_toPoint u.v₁] at this
    · have hs : signI P (faceSOf u).v₂.h = 0 :=
        (signI_iff_of_mul hP (repr4_faceSOf₂ u)).2.2.2.mpr hce0
      have := mem_bboxOfPts (Array.mem_toList.mpr (mem_sectionPts_v₂ hs))
      rwa [show P3.toPoint (faceSOf u).v₂.p = u.v₂ from ofPoint_toPoint u.v₂] at this
  · 
    have hr₀ : repr4 (faceSOf u).v₀.h (P3.toPoint (faceSOf u).v₀.p) := mkVtx_repr _
    have hr₁ : repr4 (faceSOf u).v₁.h (P3.toPoint (faceSOf u).v₁.p) := mkVtx_repr _
    have hr₂ : repr4 (faceSOf u).v₂.h (P3.toPoint (faceSOf u).v₂.p) := mkVtx_repr _
    have e₀ : P3.toPoint (faceSOf u).v₀.p = u.v₀ := ofPoint_toPoint u.v₀
    have e₁ : P3.toPoint (faceSOf u).v₁.p = u.v₁ := ofPoint_toPoint u.v₁
    have e₂ : P3.toPoint (faceSOf u).v₂.p = u.v₂ := ofPoint_toPoint u.v₂
    have hcut01 : P3.toPoint (cutVtx P (faceSOf u).v₀ (faceSOf u).v₁).p = cutPt N c u.v₀ u.v₁ := by
      rw [cutVtx_p_toPoint hP hr₀ hr₁, e₀, e₁]
    have hcut12 : P3.toPoint (cutVtx P (faceSOf u).v₁ (faceSOf u).v₂).p = cutPt N c u.v₁ u.v₂ := by
      rw [cutVtx_p_toPoint hP hr₁ hr₂, e₁, e₂]
    have hcut20 : P3.toPoint (cutVtx P (faceSOf u).v₂ (faceSOf u).v₀).p = cutPt N c u.v₂ u.v₀ := by
      rw [cutVtx_p_toPoint hP hr₂ hr₀, e₂, e₀]
    have p0 : 0 < ce N c u.v₀ → 0 < signI P (faceSOf u).v₀.h :=
      (signI_iff_of_mul hP (repr4_faceSOf₀ u)).1.mpr
    have n0 : ce N c u.v₀ < 0 → signI P (faceSOf u).v₀.h < 0 :=
      (signI_iff_of_mul hP (repr4_faceSOf₀ u)).2.1.mpr
    have p1 : 0 < ce N c u.v₁ → 0 < signI P (faceSOf u).v₁.h :=
      (signI_iff_of_mul hP (repr4_faceSOf₁ u)).1.mpr
    have n1 : ce N c u.v₁ < 0 → signI P (faceSOf u).v₁.h < 0 :=
      (signI_iff_of_mul hP (repr4_faceSOf₁ u)).2.1.mpr
    have p2 : 0 < ce N c u.v₂ → 0 < signI P (faceSOf u).v₂.h :=
      (signI_iff_of_mul hP (repr4_faceSOf₂ u)).1.mpr
    have n2 : ce N c u.v₂ < 0 → signI P (faceSOf u).v₂.h < 0 :=
      (signI_iff_of_mul hP (repr4_faceSOf₂ u)).2.1.mpr
    rintro a (rfl | rfl | rfl) b (rfl | rfl | rfl) hpos hneg <;>
      first
      | (exfalso; linarith)
      | skip
    
    · rw [← hcut01]
      exact mem_bboxOfPts (Array.mem_toList.mpr
        (mem_sectionPts_cross₀₁ (Or.inl ⟨p0 hpos, n1 hneg⟩)))
    
    · rw [cutPt_symm (ne_of_gt (show ce N c u.v₂ < ce N c u.v₀ by linarith)), ← hcut20]
      exact mem_bboxOfPts (Array.mem_toList.mpr
        (mem_sectionPts_cross₂₀ (Or.inr ⟨n2 hneg, p0 hpos⟩)))
    
    · rw [cutPt_symm (ne_of_gt (show ce N c u.v₀ < ce N c u.v₁ by linarith)), ← hcut01]
      exact mem_bboxOfPts (Array.mem_toList.mpr
        (mem_sectionPts_cross₀₁ (Or.inr ⟨n0 hneg, p1 hpos⟩)))
    
    · rw [← hcut12]
      exact mem_bboxOfPts (Array.mem_toList.mpr
        (mem_sectionPts_cross₁₂ (Or.inl ⟨p1 hpos, n2 hneg⟩)))
    
    · rw [← hcut20]
      exact mem_bboxOfPts (Array.mem_toList.mpr
        (mem_sectionPts_cross₂₀ (Or.inl ⟨p2 hpos, n0 hneg⟩)))
    
    · rw [cutPt_symm (ne_of_gt (show ce N c u.v₁ < ce N c u.v₂ by linarith)), ← hcut12]
      exact mem_bboxOfPts (Array.mem_toList.mpr
        (mem_sectionPts_cross₁₂ (Or.inr ⟨n1 hneg, p2 hpos⟩)))

name: planesForScoped_of_meet
statement:
theorem planesForScoped_of_meet {MA MB : Mesh} {i j : ℕ}
    (hi : i < MA.size) (hj : j < MB.size)
    (hmeet : (triangleSet (MA[i]'hi) ∩ triangleSet (MB[j]'hj)).Nonempty) :
    ∃ pg ∈ planesForScoped ((materialize MA).getD i default).plane (materialize MB)
        ((candidates (materialize MA) (materialize MB)).getD i #[]),
      IsMulOf pg.1 (carrierNormal (MB[j]'hj)) (detOrigin (MB[j]'hj))
      ∧ triangleSet (MB[j]'hj)
          ∩ {x : Point | dotQ (carrierNormal (MA[i]'hi)) x = detOrigin (MA[i]'hi)}
          ⊆ BoxSet pg.2
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨x, hxA, hxB⟩ := hmeet
  have hiA : i < (materialize MA).size := by simpa [materialize] using hi
  have hjB : j < (materialize MB).size := by simpa [materialize] using hj
  have hov : boxesOverlap (bboxOfFace ((materialize MA)[i]))
      (bboxOfFace ((materialize MB)[j])) = true := by
    rw [materialize_getElem MA i hi, materialize_getElem MB j hj]
    exact boxesOverlap_of_common (triangleSet_subset_bbox _ hxA)
      (triangleSet_subset_bbox _ hxB)
  have hcand := mem_candidates hiA hjB hov
  
  
  have hlvl : dotQ (carrierNormal (MA[i]'hi)) x = detOrigin (MA[i]'hi) :=
    triangleSet_subset_level (dotQ_carrierNormal_v₀ _) (dotQ_carrierNormal_v₁ _)
      (dotQ_carrierNormal_v₂ _) x hxA
  have hP : IsMulOf ((materialize MA).getD i default).plane
      (carrierNormal (MA[i]'hi)) (detOrigin (MA[i]'hi)) := by
    rw [arr_getD _ _ _ hiA, materialize_getElem MA i hi]
    exact isMulOf_faceSOf_plane _
  have hnd : dropByPlane ((materialize MA).getD i default).plane
      ((materialize MB).getD j default) = false := by
    rw [arr_getD _ _ _ hjB, materialize_getElem MB j hj]
    exact not_dropByPlane_of_meet hP hxB hlvl
  have hsome := scopeBoxSEG_isSome_of_not_drop hnd
  rw [Option.isSome_iff_exists] at hsome
  obtain ⟨box, hbox⟩ := hsome
  refine ⟨(((materialize MB).getD j default).plane, box),
    mem_planesForScoped hcand hbox, ?_, ?_⟩
  · rw [arr_getD _ _ _ hjB, materialize_getElem MB j hj]
    exact isMulOf_faceSOf_plane _
  · have hbox' : scopeBoxSEG ((materialize MA).getD i default).plane
        (faceSOf (MB[j]'hj)) = some box := by
      rw [arr_getD _ _ _ hjB, materialize_getElem MB j hj] at hbox; exact hbox
    exact scopeBoxSEG_some_superset hP hbox'

name: side_dense_ball
statement:
theorem side_dense_ball {K : ℕ} (Q : Point) (N : Fin K → Point) (dfun : Fin K → ℚ)
    (hNne : ∀ α, N α ≠ 0) (ρ : ℚ) (hρ : 0 < ρ) :
    ∃ x : Point,
      (∀ α,
        dotQ (N α) x ≠ dfun α ∧
        (dotQ (N α) Q ≠ dfun α → 0 < (dotQ (N α) Q - dfun α) * (dotQ (N α) x - dfun α))) ∧
      (∀ k, |x k - Q k| ≤ ρ)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨j, hjtr⟩ := exists_mdir_transverse N hNne
  set dv := mdir (j : ℚ) with hdvdef
  
  set B := max (|dv 0|) (max (|dv 1|) (|dv 2|)) with hBdef
  have hB0 : 0 ≤ B := by rw [hBdef]; exact le_trans (abs_nonneg _) (le_max_left _ _)
  have hdvB : ∀ c : Fin 3, |dv c| ≤ B := by
    intro c
    rw [hBdef]
    fin_cases c
    · exact le_max_left _ _
    · exact le_max_of_le_right (le_max_left _ _)
    · exact le_max_of_le_right (le_max_right _ _)
  have h1B : (0 : ℚ) < 1 + B := by linarith
  set σ := min 1 (ρ / (1 + B)) with hσdef
  have hσpos : 0 < σ := by rw [hσdef]; exact lt_min (by norm_num) (div_pos hρ h1B)
  have hσle1 : σ ≤ 1 := by rw [hσdef]; exact min_le_left _ _
  have hσmin : σ ≤ ρ / (1 + B) := by rw [hσdef]; exact min_le_right _ _
  
  set S1 := Finset.univ.filter (fun α : Fin K =>
    dotQ (N α) Q - dfun α ≠ 0 ∧ 0 < -(dotQ (N α) Q - dfun α) / dotQ (N α) dv) with hS1def
  set cands1 : Finset ℚ :=
    insert 1 (S1.image (fun α => -(dotQ (N α) Q - dfun α) / dotQ (N α) dv)) with hcands1def
  have hc1ne : cands1.Nonempty := ⟨1, Finset.mem_insert_self 1 _⟩
  set δ₁ := cands1.min' hc1ne with hδ₁def
  have hδ₁pos : 0 < δ₁ := by
    rw [hδ₁def, Finset.lt_min'_iff]
    intro y hy
    rcases Finset.mem_insert.mp hy with rfl | hy'
    · norm_num
    · obtain ⟨α, hαS, rfl⟩ := Finset.mem_image.mp hy'
      exact (Finset.mem_filter.mp hαS).2.2
  have hδ₁le1 : δ₁ ≤ 1 := Finset.min'_le _ _ (Finset.mem_insert_self 1 _)
  
  
  
  obtain ⟨k, hk⟩ := exists_candidate_avoiding
    (fun α => {x : ℚ | (dotQ (N α) Q - dfun α) + x * dotQ (N α) dv = 0})
    (fun α => by
      intro x hx x' hx'
      simp only [Set.mem_setOf_eq] at hx hx'
      have : x * dotQ (N α) dv = x' * dotQ (N α) dv := by linarith
      exact mul_right_cancel₀ (hjtr α) this)
    (fun k : Fin (K + 1) => σ * (δ₁ / ((k : ℚ) + 2)))
    (fun k k' h => by
      apply Fin.ext
      have h' := mul_left_cancel₀ (ne_of_gt hσpos) h
      have h2 : ((k : ℚ) + 2) ≠ 0 := by positivity
      have h2' : ((k' : ℚ) + 2) ≠ 0 := by positivity
      rw [div_eq_div_iff h2 h2'] at h'
      have hcancel := mul_left_cancel₀ (ne_of_gt hδ₁pos) h'
      have hcast : (k : ℚ) = (k' : ℚ) := by linarith
      exact_mod_cast hcast)
  set δ := σ * (δ₁ / ((k : ℚ) + 2)) with hδdef
  have hk0 : (0 : ℚ) ≤ (k : ℚ) := by positivity
  have hquotpos : 0 < δ₁ / ((k : ℚ) + 2) := div_pos hδ₁pos (by linarith)
  have hfrac : δ₁ / ((k : ℚ) + 2) ≤ 1 / 2 := by
    rw [div_le_iff₀ (by linarith : (0 : ℚ) < (k : ℚ) + 2)]; nlinarith [hδ₁le1, hk0]
  have hδpos : 0 < δ := mul_pos hσpos hquotpos
  have hδlt1 : δ < δ₁ := by
    rw [hδdef]
    calc σ * (δ₁ / ((k : ℚ) + 2)) ≤ 1 * (δ₁ / ((k : ℚ) + 2)) :=
          mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hσle1 hquotpos.le
      _ = δ₁ / ((k : ℚ) + 2) := one_mul _
      _ < δ₁ := by rw [div_lt_iff₀ (by linarith : (0 : ℚ) < (k : ℚ) + 2)]; nlinarith
  refine ⟨Q + δ • dv, fun α => ?_, ?_⟩
  · have hval : dotQ (N α) (Q + δ • dv) - dfun α
        = (dotQ (N α) Q - dfun α) + δ * dotQ (N α) dv := by rw [dotQ_step']; ring
    have hoff : dotQ (N α) (Q + δ • dv) ≠ dfun α := by
      intro heq
      have hz : (dotQ (N α) Q - dfun α) + δ * dotQ (N α) dv = 0 := by rw [← hval, heq]; ring
      exact hk α (by simp only [Set.mem_setOf_eq]; linarith)
    refine ⟨hoff, ?_⟩
    intro hLne
    have hLne0 : dotQ (N α) Q - dfun α ≠ 0 := sub_ne_zero.mpr hLne
    rw [hval]
    refine sign_preserve_core hLne0 hδpos ?_
    intro hLD
    have hαS1 : α ∈ S1 := by
      rw [hS1def, Finset.mem_filter]
      refine ⟨Finset.mem_univ α, hLne0, ?_⟩
      rcases mul_neg_iff.mp hLD with ⟨hLpos, hDneg⟩ | ⟨hLneg, hDpos⟩
      · exact div_pos_iff.mpr (Or.inr ⟨by linarith, hDneg⟩)
      · exact div_pos_iff.mpr (Or.inl ⟨by linarith, hDpos⟩)
    have hle : δ₁ ≤ -(dotQ (N α) Q - dfun α) / dotQ (N α) dv := Finset.min'_le _ _
      (Finset.mem_insert_of_mem (Finset.mem_image_of_mem _ hαS1))
    linarith
  · 
    intro c
    have hxc : (Q + δ • dv) c - Q c = δ * dv c := by
      simp only [Pi.add_apply, Pi.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul]; ring
    rw [hxc, abs_mul, abs_of_pos hδpos]
    have hδhalf : δ ≤ σ / 2 := by
      rw [hδdef]
      calc σ * (δ₁ / ((k : ℚ) + 2)) ≤ σ * (1 / 2) := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hfrac hσpos.le
        _ = σ / 2 := by ring
    have hcancel : ρ / (1 + B) * (1 + B) = ρ := by
      rw [div_mul_eq_mul_div, mul_div_assoc, div_self (ne_of_gt h1B), mul_one]
    have hσB : σ * B ≤ ρ := by
      have h1 : σ * (1 + B) ≤ ρ := by
        have := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hσmin h1B.le
        rwa [hcancel] at this
      nlinarith [h1, hσpos, hB0]
    calc δ * |dv c| ≤ (σ / 2) * B :=
          mul_le_mul hδhalf (hdvB c) (abs_nonneg _) (by linarith : (0 : ℚ) ≤ σ / 2)
      _ ≤ σ * B := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (by linarith : σ / 2 ≤ σ) hB0
      _ ≤ ρ := hσB

name: side_dense_ball'
statement:
theorem side_dense_ball' {ι : Type} [Fintype ι] (Q : Point) (N : ι → Point) (dfun : ι → ℚ)
    (hNne : ∀ α, N α ≠ 0) (ρ : ℚ) (hρ : 0 < ρ) :
    ∃ x : Point,
      (∀ α,
        dotQ (N α) x ≠ dfun α ∧
        (dotQ (N α) Q ≠ dfun α → 0 < (dotQ (N α) Q - dfun α) * (dotQ (N α) x - dfun α))) ∧
      (∀ k, |x k - Q k| ≤ ρ)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  obtain ⟨e⟩ : Nonempty (ι ≃ Fin (Fintype.card ι)) := ⟨Fintype.equivFin ι⟩
  obtain ⟨x, hforall, hrad⟩ := side_dense_ball Q (N ∘ e.symm) (dfun ∘ e.symm)
    (fun j => hNne (e.symm j)) ρ hρ
  refine ⟨x, fun α => ?_, hrad⟩
  have := hforall (e α)
  simpa only [Function.comp_apply, Equiv.symm_apply_apply] using this

name: crossQ_perp_ne
statement:
theorem crossQ_perp_ne {u v : Point} (hu : u ≠ 0) (hv : v ≠ 0) (hperp : dotQ u v = 0) :
    crossQ u v ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  intro h
  have hsq := cross_sq u v
  rw [h, Proof.MeshIntersectClip.dotQ_zero_right, hperp] at hsq
  have := mul_pos (Proof.MeshIntersectRay.dotQ_self_pos hu) (Proof.MeshIntersectRay.dotQ_self_pos hv)
  nlinarith [hsq]

statement:
theorem dot_faceNormal_edgeTail {M : Mesh} (u : Fin M.size) (k : Fin 3) :

proof:
:= by

  · exact faceNormal_offset M[u]
  · exact dotQ_faceNormal_v1 M[u]
  · exact dotQ_faceNormal_v2 M[u]

statement:
theorem dot_faceNormal_edgeHead {M : Mesh} (u : Fin M.size) (k : Fin 3) :

proof:

name: he_ne_of_G1Clean
proof:
:= by
  rw [crossQ_edge_source]
  intro hc
  have hev : psub (edgeHead M[u] k) (edgeTail M[u] k) ≠ 0 := edge_vec_ne_zero hnpo u k
  have hperp : dotQ (psub (edgeHead M[u] k) (edgeTail M[u] k)) (Proof.MeshIntersectJump.faceNormal M[u]) = 0 := by
    rw [dotQ_symm, dotQ_psub_right, dot_faceNormal_edgeHead, dot_faceNormal_edgeTail, sub_self]
  have hpp := perp_of_parallel hev hc hperp
  
  apply clean_off_carrier hnpo hP u
  have hkey : dotQ (Proof.MeshIntersectJump.faceNormal M[u]) P - dotQ (Proof.MeshIntersectJump.faceNormal M[u]) (edgeTail M[u] k) = 0 := by
    rw [← dotQ_psub_right, dotQ_symm]; exact hpp
  rw [dot_faceNormal_edgeTail] at hkey
  linarith [hkey]

statement:

    ee0 t R = dotQ (crossQ (Proof.MeshIntersectJump.faceNormal t) (psub t.v₁ t.v₀)) R

proof:
:= by
  simp only [ee0, det3, dotQ, crossQ, psub, Proof.MeshIntersectJump.faceNormal, mkPoint_zero, mkPoint_one, mkPoint_two]; ring

name: ee_grad_ne
statement:
theorem ee_grad_ne {M : Mesh} (hnpo : NoPlaneThroughOrigin M) (u : Fin M.size) :
    crossQ (Proof.MeshIntersectJump.faceNormal M[u]) (psub M[u].v₁ M[u].v₀) ≠ 0
      ∧ crossQ (Proof.MeshIntersectJump.faceNormal M[u]) (psub M[u].v₂ M[u].v₁) ≠ 0
      ∧ crossQ (Proof.MeshIntersectJump.faceNormal M[u]) (psub M[u].v₀ M[u].v₂) ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  have hn : Proof.MeshIntersectJump.faceNormal M[u] ≠ 0 := faceNormal_ne_zero (hnpo u)
  refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · refine crossQ_perp_ne hn (edge_vec_ne_zero hnpo u 0) ?_
    rw [dotQ_psub_right, dotQ_faceNormal_v1, faceNormal_offset, sub_self]
  · refine crossQ_perp_ne hn (edge_vec_ne_zero hnpo u 1) ?_
    rw [dotQ_psub_right, dotQ_faceNormal_v2, dotQ_faceNormal_v1, sub_self]
  · refine crossQ_perp_ne hn (edge_vec_ne_zero hnpo u 2) ?_
    rw [dotQ_psub_right, faceNormal_offset, dotQ_faceNormal_v2, sub_self]

name: exists_triangle_support
statement:
theorem exists_triangle_support {M : Mesh} (hnpo : NoPlaneThroughOrigin M) (u : Fin M.size)
    {Q : Point} (hQ : Q ∉ triangleSet M[u]) :
    ∃ (Nℓ : Point) (dℓ : ℚ), Nℓ ≠ 0 ∧ (dotQ Nℓ Q - dℓ < 0) ∧
      (∀ R, R ∈ triangleSet M[u] → 0 ≤ dotQ Nℓ R - dℓ)
proof:
:= by
  have hdet := hnpo u
  set t := M[u] with htdef
  by_cases hcar : dotQ (Proof.MeshIntersectJump.faceNormal t) Q = detOrigin t
  · 
    have hnall : ¬ (0 ≤ ee0 t Q ∧ 0 ≤ ee1 t Q ∧ 0 ≤ ee2 t Q) := by
      intro ⟨h0, h1, h2⟩; exact hQ (mem_triangleSet_of_carrier hdet hcar h0 h1 h2)
    obtain ⟨hg0, hg1, hg2⟩ := ee_grad_ne hnpo u
    by_cases he0 : 0 ≤ ee0 t Q
    · by_cases he1 : 0 ≤ ee1 t Q
      · have he2 : ee2 t Q < 0 := by
          by_contra h; push_neg at h; exact hnall ⟨he0, he1, h⟩
        refine ⟨crossQ (Proof.MeshIntersectJump.faceNormal t) (psub t.v₀ t.v₂),
          dotQ (crossQ (Proof.MeshIntersectJump.faceNormal t) (psub t.v₀ t.v₂)) t.v₂, hg2, ?_, ?_⟩
        · rw [← ee2_as_dot]; exact he2
        · intro R hR; rw [← ee2_as_dot]; exact (ee_nonneg_of_mem_triangleSet hR).2.2
      · push_neg at he1
        refine ⟨crossQ (Proof.MeshIntersectJump.faceNormal t) (psub t.v₂ t.v₁),
          dotQ (crossQ (Proof.MeshIntersectJump.faceNormal t) (psub t.v₂ t.v₁)) t.v₁, hg1, ?_, ?_⟩
        · rw [← ee1_as_dot]; exact he1
        · intro R hR; rw [← ee1_as_dot]; exact (ee_nonneg_of_mem_triangleSet hR).2.1
    · push_neg at he0
      refine ⟨crossQ (Proof.MeshIntersectJump.faceNormal t) (psub t.v₁ t.v₀),
        dotQ (crossQ (Proof.MeshIntersectJump.faceNormal t) (psub t.v₁ t.v₀)) t.v₀, hg0, ?_, ?_⟩
      · rw [← ee0_as_dot]; exact he0
      · intro R hR; rw [← ee0_as_dot]; exact (ee_nonneg_of_mem_triangleSet hR).1
  · 
    have hne : dotQ (Proof.MeshIntersectJump.faceNormal t) Q - detOrigin t ≠ 0 := sub_ne_zero.mpr hcar
    have hn : Proof.MeshIntersectJump.faceNormal t ≠ 0 := faceNormal_ne_zero hdet
    rcases lt_or_gt_of_ne hne with hlt | hgt
    · refine ⟨Proof.MeshIntersectJump.faceNormal t, detOrigin t, hn, hlt, ?_⟩
      intro R hR; rw [Proof.MeshIntersectRayClassify.triangleSet_on_carrier hR, sub_self]
    · refine ⟨(-1 : ℚ) • Proof.MeshIntersectJump.faceNormal t, (-1 : ℚ) * detOrigin t, smul_ne_zero (by norm_num) hn, ?_, ?_⟩
      · rw [Proof.WellFormedCheckNormal.dotQ_smul_left]; linarith
      · intro R hR
        rw [Proof.WellFormedCheckNormal.dotQ_smul_left, Proof.MeshIntersectRayClassify.triangleSet_on_carrier hR]; linarith

name: gen_dense_ball
statement:
theorem gen_dense_ball {M : Mesh} (hnpo : NoPlaneThroughOrigin M)
    {Q d_fc : Point}
    (hQoff : ∀ (u : Fin M.size), Q ∉ triangleSet M[u])
    (hd_fc_ne : d_fc ≠ 0)
    (hd_fc_clean : ∀ (u : Fin M.size) (s : ℚ), 0 < s → lineAt Q d_fc s ∉ edgeSet M[u])
    (ρ : ℚ) (hρ : 0 < ρ)
    {ιx : Type} [Fintype ιx] (Nx : ιx → Point) (dx : ιx → ℚ) (hNx : ∀ α, Nx α ≠ 0) :
    ∃ P d' : Point,
      G1Clean M P ∧
      d' ≠ 0 ∧
      (∀ u : Fin M.size, dotQ (Proof.MeshIntersectJump.faceNormal M[u]) P ≠ detOrigin M[u]) ∧
      (∀ u : Fin M.size, dotQ (Proof.MeshIntersectJump.faceNormal M[u]) d' ≠ 0) ∧
      (∀ (j : Fin M.size) (k : Fin 4), dotQ (slot M[j] k).n d' ≠ 0) ∧
      (∀ (j : Fin M.size), ∀ g ∈ tetraHalves M[j], ∀ g' ∈ tetraHalves M[j],
        g ≠ g' → ∀ t : ℚ, ¬ (g.eval (lineAt P d' t) = 0 ∧ g'.eval (lineAt P d' t) = 0)) ∧
      (∀ (u : Fin M.size) (t : ℚ), t ≠ 0 → lineAt P d' t ∉ edgeSet M[u]) ∧
      (∀ θ : ℚ, 0 ≤ θ → θ ≤ 1 → ∀ u : Fin M.size,
        (fun i => Q i + θ * (P i - Q i)) ∉ triangleSet M[u]) ∧
      (∀ θ : ℚ, 0 ≤ θ → θ ≤ 1 → ∀ u : Fin M.size, ∀ s : ℚ, 0 < s →
        lineAt (fun i => Q i + θ * (P i - Q i)) d_fc s ∉ edgeSet M[u]) ∧
      (∀ θ : ℚ, 0 ≤ θ → θ ≤ 1 → (fun i => (1 - θ) * d_fc i + θ * d' i) ≠ 0) ∧
      (∀ θ : ℚ, 0 ≤ θ → θ ≤ 1 → ∀ u : Fin M.size, ∀ s : ℚ, 0 < s →
        lineAt P (fun i => (1 - θ) * d_fc i + θ * d' i) s ∉ edgeSet M[u]) ∧
      (∀ k, |P k - Q k| ≤ ρ) ∧
      (∀ α, dotQ (Nx α) P ≠ dx α)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have hddfc : 0 < dotQ d_fc d_fc := Proof.WellFormedCheckNormal.dotQ_self_pos hd_fc_ne
  
  have hfcnotin : ∀ (u : Fin M.size) (k : Fin 3), ∀ q s : ℚ, 0 ≤ q → q ≤ 1 → 0 ≤ s →
      Q ≠ (fun i => (edgeTail M[u] k) i
        + q * ((edgeHead M[u] k) i - (edgeTail M[u] k) i) - s * d_fc i) := by
    intro u k q s hq0 hq1 hs0 heq
    set a := edgeTail M[u] k with hadef
    set b := edgeHead M[u] k with hbdef
    have hseg : (fun i => a i + q * (b i - a i)) ∈ segment ℚ a b := by
      refine ⟨1 - q, q, by linarith, hq0, by ring, ?_⟩
      funext i; simp only [Pi.add_apply, Pi.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul]; ring
    have hsub : segment ℚ a b ⊆ edgeSet M[u] := by
      rw [edgeSet_eq_iUnion]
      exact Set.subset_iUnion
        (fun k' => segment ℚ (edgeTail M[u] k') (edgeHead M[u] k')) k
    rcases eq_or_lt_of_le hs0 with hs | hs
    · apply hQoff u
      have hQeq : Q = (fun i => a i + q * (b i - a i)) := by
        rw [heq]; funext i; rw [← hs]; ring
      rw [hQeq]; exact segment_edge_subset_triangle M[u] k hseg
    · apply hd_fc_clean u s hs
      have hpt : lineAt Q d_fc s = (fun i => a i + q * (b i - a i)) := by
        funext i; simp only [lineAt]; rw [congrFun heq i]; ring
      rw [hpt]; exact hsub hseg
  
  have hsupp : ∀ (u : Fin M.size) (k : Fin 3), ∃ (Nℓ : Point) (dℓ : ℚ),
      (dotQ Nℓ Q - dℓ < 0) ∧
      (∀ q s : ℚ, 0 ≤ q → q ≤ 1 → 0 < s →
        0 ≤ dotQ Nℓ (fun i => (edgeTail M[u] k) i
          + q * ((edgeHead M[u] k) i - (edgeTail M[u] k) i) - s * d_fc i) - dℓ) :=
    fun u k => exists_edge_support (edgeTail M[u] k) (edgeHead M[u] k) d_fc Q
      (edge_vec_ne_zero hnpo u k) hd_fc_ne (hfcnotin u k)
  choose Nlfun dlfun hl1 hl2 using hsupp
  
  have hsupp_tri : ∀ (u : Fin M.size), ∃ (Nℓ : Point) (dℓ : ℚ),
      Nℓ ≠ 0 ∧ (dotQ Nℓ Q - dℓ < 0) ∧ (∀ R, R ∈ triangleSet M[u] → 0 ≤ dotQ Nℓ R - dℓ) :=
    fun u => exists_triangle_support hnpo u (hQoff u)
  choose Ntfun dtfun hNtne htneg htnn using hsupp_tri
  
  have hz0 : ∀ y : Point, dotQ (0 : Point) y = 0 := by intro y; simp only [dotQ, Pi.zero_apply]; ring
  have hNlne : ∀ (u : Fin M.size) (k : Fin 3), Nlfun u k ≠ 0 := by
    intro u k hzero
    have hp1 := hl1 u k
    have hp2 := hl2 u k 0 1 (le_refl 0) zero_le_one one_pos
    simp only [hzero, hz0] at hp1 hp2
    linarith
  
  have hsource_clean : ∀ (R : Point),
      (∀ (u : Fin M.size) (k : Fin 3), dotQ (Nlfun u k) R - dlfun u k < 0) →
      ∀ (u : Fin M.size) (s : ℚ), 0 < s → lineAt R d_fc s ∉ edgeSet M[u] := by
    intro R hRneg u s hs hmem
    rw [edgeSet_eq_iUnion] at hmem
    simp only [Set.mem_iUnion] at hmem
    obtain ⟨k, hk⟩ := hmem
    obtain ⟨q, hq0, hq1, hReq⟩ := graze_source_param hs hk
    have hge := hl2 u k q s hq0 hq1 hs
    rw [← hReq] at hge
    linarith [hRneg u k, hge]
  
  obtain ⟨P, hPall, hPrad⟩ := side_dense_ball' Q
    (Sum.elim (fun jk : Fin M.size × Fin 4 => (slot M[jk.1] jk.2).n)
      (Sum.elim (fun uk : Fin M.size × Fin 3 => Nlfun uk.1 uk.2)
        (Sum.elim (fun u : Fin M.size => Ntfun u)
          (fun α : ιx => Nx α))))
    (Sum.elim (fun jk : Fin M.size × Fin 4 => (slot M[jk.1] jk.2).c)
      (Sum.elim (fun uk : Fin M.size × Fin 3 => dlfun uk.1 uk.2)
        (Sum.elim (fun u : Fin M.size => dtfun u)
          (fun α : ιx => dx α))))
    (by
      rintro (⟨j, k⟩ | ⟨u, k⟩ | u | α)
      · exact facet_n_ne_zero (hnpo j) _ (slot_mem _ _)
      · exact hNlne u k
      · exact hNtne u
      · exact hNx α)
    ρ hρ
  
  have hG1 : ∀ (j : Fin M.size) (k : Fin 4), (slot M[j] k).eval P ≠ 0 := by
    intro j k h
    have hne := (hPall (Sum.inl (j, k))).1
    simp only [Sum.elim_inl] at hne
    simp only [Half.eval, sub_eq_zero] at h
    exact hne h
  have hG1clean : G1Clean M P := by
    intro j g hg
    obtain ⟨k, rfl⟩ := mem_tetraHalves_iff.mp hg
    exact hG1 j k
  have hℓP_edge : ∀ (u : Fin M.size) (k : Fin 3), dotQ (Nlfun u k) P - dlfun u k < 0 := by
    intro u k
    have hside := (hPall (Sum.inr (Sum.inl (u, k)))).2
    simp only [Sum.elim_inl, Sum.elim_inr] at hside
    have hpos := hside (sub_ne_zero.mp (ne_of_lt (hl1 u k)))
    rcases mul_pos_iff.mp hpos with ⟨h, _⟩ | ⟨_, h⟩
    · exact absurd h (not_lt.mpr (hl1 u k).le)
    · exact h
  have hℓseg_edge : ∀ (u : Fin M.size) (k : Fin 3) (θ : ℚ), 0 ≤ θ → θ ≤ 1 →
      dotQ (Nlfun u k) (fun i => Q i + θ * (P i - Q i)) - dlfun u k < 0 := by
    intro u k θ hθ0 hθ1
    have hlin : dotQ (Nlfun u k) (fun i => Q i + θ * (P i - Q i)) - dlfun u k
        = (1 - θ) * (dotQ (Nlfun u k) Q - dlfun u k)
          + θ * (dotQ (Nlfun u k) P - dlfun u k) := by simp only [dotQ]; ring
    rw [hlin]; exact interp_neg (hl1 u k) (hℓP_edge u k) hθ0 hθ1
  have hP_dfc_clean := hsource_clean P hℓP_edge
  have hℓP_tri : ∀ (u : Fin M.size), dotQ (Ntfun u) P - dtfun u < 0 := by
    intro u
    have hside := (hPall (Sum.inr (Sum.inr (Sum.inl u)))).2
    simp only [Sum.elim_inr, Sum.elim_inl] at hside
    have hpos := hside (sub_ne_zero.mp (ne_of_lt (htneg u)))
    rcases mul_pos_iff.mp hpos with ⟨h, _⟩ | ⟨_, h⟩
    · exact absurd h (not_lt.mpr (htneg u).le)
    · exact h
  have hℓseg_tri : ∀ (u : Fin M.size) (θ : ℚ), 0 ≤ θ → θ ≤ 1 →
      dotQ (Ntfun u) (fun i => Q i + θ * (P i - Q i)) - dtfun u < 0 := by
    intro u θ hθ0 hθ1
    have hlin : dotQ (Ntfun u) (fun i => Q i + θ * (P i - Q i)) - dtfun u
        = (1 - θ) * (dotQ (Ntfun u) Q - dtfun u)
          + θ * (dotQ (Ntfun u) P - dtfun u) := by simp only [dotQ]; ring
    rw [hlin]; exact interp_neg (htneg u) (hℓP_tri u) hθ0 hθ1
  have hP_he_ne : ∀ (u : Fin M.size) (k : Fin 3),
      crossQ (psub (edgeTail M[u] k) P) (psub (edgeHead M[u] k) P) ≠ 0 :=
    fun u k => he_ne_of_G1Clean hnpo hG1clean u k
  
  obtain ⟨d', hdall⟩ := side_dense_dir' d_fc
    (Sum.elim (fun u : Fin M.size => Proof.MeshIntersectJump.faceNormal M[u])
      (Sum.elim (fun jk : Fin M.size × Fin 4 => (slot M[jk.1] jk.2).n)
        (Sum.elim (fun t : Fin M.size × Fin 4 × Fin 4 =>
            if t.2.1 = t.2.2 then d_fc
            else (slot M[t.1] t.2.1).eval P • (slot M[t.1] t.2.2).n
              - (slot M[t.1] t.2.2).eval P • (slot M[t.1] t.2.1).n)
          (Sum.elim
            (fun uk : Fin M.size × Fin 3 =>
              crossQ (psub (edgeTail M[uk.1] uk.2) P) (psub (edgeHead M[uk.1] uk.2) P))
            (fun _ : Unit => d_fc)))))
    (by
      rintro (u | ⟨j, k⟩ | ⟨j, k, k'⟩ | ⟨u, k⟩ | _)
      · simp only [Sum.elim_inl]; exact faceNormal_ne_zero (hnpo u)
      · simp only [Sum.elim_inl, Sum.elim_inr]; exact facet_n_ne_zero (hnpo j) _ (slot_mem _ _)
      · simp only [Sum.elim_inl, Sum.elim_inr]
        split_ifs with hkk
        · exact hd_fc_ne
        · exact resultant_ne (hnpo j) hkk (hG1 j k) (hG1 j k')
      · simp only [Sum.elim_inl, Sum.elim_inr]; exact hP_he_ne u k
      · simp only [Sum.elim_inr]; exact hd_fc_ne)
  
  have hφ := hdall (Sum.inr (Sum.inr (Sum.inr (Sum.inr ()))))
  simp only [Sum.elim_inr] at hφ
  have hdd' : 0 < dotQ d_fc d' := by
    have hmul := hφ.2 (ne_of_gt hddfc)
    by_contra h; push_neg at h
    exact absurd hmul (not_lt.mpr (mul_nonpos_of_nonneg_of_nonpos hddfc.le h))
  have hd'ne : d' ≠ 0 := by
    intro h; apply hφ.1; rw [h]; exact Proof.WellFormedCheckNormal.dotQ_zero_right d_fc
  
  refine ⟨P, d', hG1clean, hd'ne,
    fun u => sub_ne_zero.mp (clean_off_carrier hnpo hG1clean u),
    fun u => by have := (hdall (Sum.inl u)).1; simpa only [Sum.elim_inl] using this,
    fun j k => by
      have := (hdall (Sum.inr (Sum.inl (j, k)))).1
      simpa only [Sum.elim_inl, Sum.elim_inr] using this,
    ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_, hPrad, ?_⟩
  · 
    intro j g hg g' hg' hne t ht
    obtain ⟨k, rfl⟩ := mem_tetraHalves_iff.mp hg
    obtain ⟨k', rfl⟩ := mem_tetraHalves_iff.mp hg'
    have hkk : k ≠ k' := fun h => hne (by rw [h])
    obtain ⟨he1, he2⟩ := ht
    have hres := (hdall (Sum.inr (Sum.inr (Sum.inl (j, k, k'))))).1
    simp only [Sum.elim_inl, Sum.elim_inr, if_neg hkk] at hres
    rw [eval_lineAt] at he1 he2
    apply hres
    rw [dotQ_resultant]
    linear_combination (dotQ (slot M[j] k').n d') * he1 - (dotQ (slot M[j] k).n d') * he2
  · 
    intro u t ht hmem
    rw [edgeSet_eq_iUnion] at hmem
    simp only [Set.mem_iUnion] at hmem
    obtain ⟨k, hk⟩ := hmem
    have hhe := (hdall (Sum.inr (Sum.inr (Sum.inr (Sum.inl (u, k)))))).1
    simp only [Sum.elim_inl, Sum.elim_inr] at hhe
    exact no_graze_from_P ht hhe hk
  · 
    intro θ hθ0 hθ1 u hmem
    have := htnn u _ hmem
    linarith [hℓseg_tri u θ hθ0 hθ1]
  · 
    intro θ hθ0 hθ1 u s hs
    exact hsource_clean (fun i => Q i + θ * (P i - Q i))
      (fun u' k => hℓseg_edge u' k θ hθ0 hθ1) u s hs
  · 
    intro θ hθ0 hθ1 h
    have hdotθ : dotQ d_fc (fun i => (1 - θ) * d_fc i + θ * d' i)
        = (1 - θ) * dotQ d_fc d_fc + θ * dotQ d_fc d' := by simp only [dotQ]; ring
    have hpos : 0 < dotQ d_fc (fun i => (1 - θ) * d_fc i + θ * d' i) := by
      rw [hdotθ]; exact interp_pos hddfc hdd' hθ0 hθ1
    rw [h, Proof.WellFormedCheckNormal.dotQ_zero_right] at hpos
    exact lt_irrefl 0 hpos
  · 
    intro θ hθ0 hθ1 u s hs hmem
    rcases eq_or_lt_of_le hθ0 with hθ | hθ
    · have hdθ0 : (fun i => (1 - θ) * d_fc i + θ * d' i) = d_fc := by
        rw [← hθ]; funext i; ring
      rw [hdθ0] at hmem
      exact hP_dfc_clean u s hs hmem
    · rw [edgeSet_eq_iUnion] at hmem
      simp only [Set.mem_iUnion] at hmem
      obtain ⟨k, hk⟩ := hmem
      refine no_graze_from_P hs.ne' ?_ hk
      have hheP := hdall (Sum.inr (Sum.inr (Sum.inr (Sum.inl (u, k)))))
      simp only [Sum.elim_inl, Sum.elim_inr] at hheP
      have hlin : dotQ (crossQ (psub (edgeTail M[u] k) P) (psub (edgeHead M[u] k) P))
            (fun i => (1 - θ) * d_fc i + θ * d' i)
          = (1 - θ) * dotQ (crossQ (psub (edgeTail M[u] k) P) (psub (edgeHead M[u] k) P)) d_fc
            + θ * dotQ (crossQ (psub (edgeTail M[u] k) P) (psub (edgeHead M[u] k) P)) d' := by
        simp only [dotQ]; ring
      rw [hlin]
      by_cases hdfc0 : dotQ (crossQ (psub (edgeTail M[u] k) P) (psub (edgeHead M[u] k) P)) d_fc = 0
      · rw [hdfc0]; simp only [mul_zero, zero_add]
        exact mul_ne_zero hθ.ne' hheP.1
      · exact interp_ne (hheP.2 hdfc0) hθ0 hθ1
  · 
    intro α
    have := (hPall (Sum.inr (Sum.inr (Sum.inr α)))).1
    simpa only [Sum.elim_inr] using this

name: okWinding_eq_true
