statement: theorem okWinding_eq_true (v : Int) : Impl.WellFormedCheck.okWinding v = true ↔ (v = 0 ∨ v = 1)
proof:
:= by
  unfold Impl.WellFormedCheck.okWinding
  rw [Bool.or_eq_true, beq_iff_eq, beq_iff_eq]

name: baryPt_on_plane
statement: theorem baryPt_on_plane (t : Triangle) : dotQ (Proof.MeshIntersectJump.faceNormal t) (baryPt t) = detOrigin t
proof:
:= by
  have h0 := faceNormal_offset t
  have h1 := dotQ_faceNormal_v1 t
  have h2 := dotQ_faceNormal_v2 t
  have : dotQ (Proof.MeshIntersectJump.faceNormal t) (baryPt t)
      = (dotQ (Proof.MeshIntersectJump.faceNormal t) t.v₀ + dotQ (Proof.MeshIntersectJump.faceNormal t) t.v₁ + dotQ (Proof.MeshIntersectJump.faceNormal t) t.v₂) / 3 := by
    simp only [dotQ, baryPt]; ring
  rw [this, h0, h1, h2]; ring

name: materialize_getD_fields
statement:
private theorem materialize_getD_fields {M : Mesh} (i : ℕ) (hi : i < M.size) :
    ((materialize M).getD i default).v₀.p = ofPoint (M[i]'hi).v₀ ∧
    ((materialize M).getD i default).v₁.p = ofPoint (M[i]'hi).v₁ ∧
    ((materialize M).getD i default).v₂.p = ofPoint (M[i]'hi).v₂
proof:
:= by
  have hisz : i < (materialize M).size := by unfold materialize; rw [Array.size_map]; exact hi
  rw [arr_getD _ _ _ hisz]
  unfold materialize
  rw [Array.getElem_map]
  exact ⟨rfl, rfl, rfl⟩

name: baryS_eq
statement:
private theorem baryS_eq {M : Mesh} (i : ℕ) (hi : i < M.size) :
    smulS (1 / 3) (paddS ((materialize M).getD i default).v₀.p
        (paddS ((materialize M).getD i default).v₁.p ((materialize M).getD i default).v₂.p))
      = ofPoint (baryPt (M[i]'hi))
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨hv0, hv1, hv2⟩ := materialize_getD_fields i hi
  rw [hv0, hv1, hv2]
  simp only [smulS, paddS, ofPoint, baryPt, P3.mk.injEq]
  refine ⟨by ring, by ring, by ring⟩

name: baryS_ofPoint
proof:
:= by
  simp only [smulS, paddS, ofPoint, baryPt, P3.mk.injEq]
  refine ⟨by ring, by ring, by ring⟩

name: ee_baryPt
statement:
theorem ee_baryPt (t : Triangle) :
    ee0 t (baryPt t) = dotQ (Proof.MeshIntersectJump.faceNormal t) (Proof.MeshIntersectJump.faceNormal t) / 3 ∧
    ee1 t (baryPt t) = dotQ (Proof.MeshIntersectJump.faceNormal t) (Proof.MeshIntersectJump.faceNormal t) / 3 ∧
    ee2 t (baryPt t) = dotQ (Proof.MeshIntersectJump.faceNormal t) (Proof.MeshIntersectJump.faceNormal t) / 3
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_⟩ <;>
    simp only [Proof.MeshIntersectRayClassify.ee0, Proof.MeshIntersectRayClassify.ee1,
      Proof.MeshIntersectRayClassify.ee2, baryPt, Proof.MeshIntersectJump.faceNormal, det3, dotQ, crossQ, psub,
      mkPoint_zero, mkPoint_one, mkPoint_two] <;> ring

name: dotQ_hoelder
statement:
theorem dotQ_hoelder (N v : Point) {ρ : ℚ} (hv : ∀ k, |v k| ≤ ρ) :
    |dotQ N v| ≤ (|N 0| + |N 1| + |N 2|) * ρ
proof:
:= by
  have hexp : dotQ N v = N 0 * v 0 + N 1 * v 1 + N 2 * v 2 := rfl
  rw [hexp]
  have e : ∀ k, |N k * v k| ≤ |N k| * ρ := by
    intro k; rw [abs_mul]; exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (hv k) (abs_nonneg _)
  calc |N 0 * v 0 + N 1 * v 1 + N 2 * v 2|
      ≤ |N 0 * v 0| + |N 1 * v 1| + |N 2 * v 2| := abs_add_three _ _ _
    _ ≤ |N 0| * ρ + |N 1| * ρ + |N 2| * ρ := by
        exact add_le_add (add_le_add (e 0) (e 1)) (e 2)
    _ = (|N 0| + |N 1| + |N 2|) * ρ := by ring

name: aff_shift
statement:
theorem aff_shift (N f b d : Point) (τ τ0 : ℚ) :
    dotQ N (lineAt f d τ) = dotQ N (lineAt b d τ0) + (τ - τ0) * dotQ N d
      + dotQ N (psub f b)
proof:
:= by
  rw [Proof.WellFormedCheckNormal.dotQ_lineAt, Proof.WellFormedCheckNormal.dotQ_lineAt,
    dotQ_psub_right]; ring

name: ee0_shift
statement:
theorem ee0_shift (t : Triangle) (f b d : Point) (τ τ0 : ℚ) :
    ee0 t (lineAt f d τ) = ee0 t (lineAt b d τ0)
      + (τ - τ0) * dotQ (crossQ (Proof.MeshIntersectJump.faceNormal t) (psub t.v₁ t.v₀)) d
      + dotQ (crossQ (Proof.MeshIntersectJump.faceNormal t) (psub t.v₁ t.v₀)) (psub f b)
proof:
:= by
  rw [ee0_as_dot t (lineAt f d τ), ee0_as_dot t (lineAt b d τ0),
    aff_shift (crossQ (Proof.MeshIntersectJump.faceNormal t) (psub t.v₁ t.v₀)) f b d τ τ0]; ring

name: ee1_shift
statement:
theorem ee1_shift (t : Triangle) (f b d : Point) (τ τ0 : ℚ) :
    ee1 t (lineAt f d τ) = ee1 t (lineAt b d τ0)
      + (τ - τ0) * dotQ (crossQ (Proof.MeshIntersectJump.faceNormal t) (psub t.v₂ t.v₁)) d
      + dotQ (crossQ (Proof.MeshIntersectJump.faceNormal t) (psub t.v₂ t.v₁)) (psub f b)
proof:
:= by
  rw [ee1_as_dot t (lineAt f d τ), ee1_as_dot t (lineAt b d τ0),
    aff_shift (crossQ (Proof.MeshIntersectJump.faceNormal t) (psub t.v₂ t.v₁)) f b d τ τ0]; ring

name: ee2_shift
statement:
theorem ee2_shift (t : Triangle) (f b d : Point) (τ τ0 : ℚ) :
    ee2 t (lineAt f d τ) = ee2 t (lineAt b d τ0)
      + (τ - τ0) * dotQ (crossQ (Proof.MeshIntersectJump.faceNormal t) (psub t.v₀ t.v₂)) d
      + dotQ (crossQ (Proof.MeshIntersectJump.faceNormal t) (psub t.v₀ t.v₂)) (psub f b)
proof:
:= by
  rw [ee2_as_dot t (lineAt f d τ), ee2_as_dot t (lineAt b d τ0),
    aff_shift (crossQ (Proof.MeshIntersectJump.faceNormal t) (psub t.v₀ t.v₂)) f b d τ τ0]; ring

name: arm_off_carrier
statement:
theorem arm_off_carrier {M : Mesh} (u : Fin M.size) {d b f : Point} {κ tb t μ σ : ℚ}
    (hκd : dotQ (Proof.MeshIntersectJump.faceNormal M[u]) d = κ)
    (hcr : dotQ (Proof.MeshIntersectJump.faceNormal M[u]) (lineAt b d tb) = detOrigin M[u])
    (hf : ∀ k, |f k - b k| ≤ σ)
    (hmarg : (|Proof.MeshIntersectJump.faceNormal M[u] 0| + |Proof.MeshIntersectJump.faceNormal M[u] 1| + |Proof.MeshIntersectJump.faceNormal M[u] 2|) * σ < |κ| * μ)
    (hμle : μ ≤ |t - tb|) : lineAt f d t ∉ triangleSet M[u]
proof:
:= by
  intro hmem
  have hcar := Proof.MeshIntersectRayClassify.triangleSet_on_carrier hmem
  have hval : dotQ (Proof.MeshIntersectJump.faceNormal M[u]) (lineAt f d t) - detOrigin M[u]
      = κ * (t - tb) + dotQ (Proof.MeshIntersectJump.faceNormal M[u]) (psub f b) := by
    rw [aff_shift (Proof.MeshIntersectJump.faceNormal M[u]) f b d t tb, hcr, hκd]; ring
  have hdisp : |dotQ (Proof.MeshIntersectJump.faceNormal M[u]) (psub f b)|
      ≤ (|Proof.MeshIntersectJump.faceNormal M[u] 0| + |Proof.MeshIntersectJump.faceNormal M[u] 1| + |Proof.MeshIntersectJump.faceNormal M[u] 2|) * σ :=
    dotQ_hoelder (Proof.MeshIntersectJump.faceNormal M[u]) (psub f b) (fun k => hf k)
  have hmag : |κ| * μ ≤ |κ * (t - tb)| := by
    rw [abs_mul]; exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hμle (abs_nonneg κ)
  have hz : dotQ (Proof.MeshIntersectJump.faceNormal M[u]) (lineAt f d t) - detOrigin M[u] = 0 := by rw [hcar]; ring
  rw [hval] at hz
  have hcontr : κ * (t - tb) = -dotQ (Proof.MeshIntersectJump.faceNormal M[u]) (psub f b) := by linarith
  rw [hcontr, abs_neg] at hmag
  linarith [hdisp, hmarg, hmag]

name: near_edge_clear
statement:
theorem near_edge_clear {M : Mesh} (u : Fin M.size) {d b : Point} {κ tb : ℚ}
    (hκ0 : κ ≠ 0) (hκd : dotQ (Proof.MeshIntersectJump.faceNormal M[u]) d = κ)
    (hcr : dotQ (Proof.MeshIntersectJump.faceNormal M[u]) (lineAt b d tb) = detOrigin M[u])
    (g : Point) (eeval : Point → ℚ)
    (hnn : ∀ R, R ∈ triangleSet M[u] → 0 ≤ eeval R)
    (hshift : ∀ (f : Point) (τ : ℚ), eeval (lineAt f d τ)
        = eeval (lineAt b d tb) + (τ - tb) * dotQ g d + dotQ g (psub f b))
    (hnegB : eeval (lineAt b d tb) < 0) :
    ∃ σc : ℚ, 0 < σc ∧ ∀ (f : Point) (t : ℚ),
      (∀ k, |f k - b k| ≤ σc) → lineAt f d t ∉ triangleSet M[u]
proof:
:= by
  have hκabs : 0 < |κ| := abs_pos.mpr hκ0
  set e0 := eeval (lineAt b d tb) with he0
  set G := dotQ g d with hGdef
  set β := -e0 with hβ
  have hβ0 : 0 < β := by rw [hβ]; linarith
  set Lg := |g 0| + |g 1| + |g 2| with hLg
  have hLg0 : (0 : ℚ) ≤ Lg := by
    rw [hLg]; exact add_nonneg (add_nonneg (abs_nonneg _) (abs_nonneg _)) (abs_nonneg _)
  have hden0 : (0 : ℚ) < 2 * |G| + 1 := by positivity
  set θ := β / (2 * |G| + 1) with hθ
  have hθ0 : 0 < θ := div_pos hβ0 hden0
  have hθG : θ * |G| ≤ β / 2 := by
    rw [hθ, div_mul_eq_mul_div, div_le_div_iff₀ hden0 (by norm_num : (0 : ℚ) < 2)]
    nlinarith [abs_nonneg G, hβ0]
  set Ln := |Proof.MeshIntersectJump.faceNormal M[u] 0| + |Proof.MeshIntersectJump.faceNormal M[u] 1| + |Proof.MeshIntersectJump.faceNormal M[u] 2| with hLn
  have hLn0 : (0 : ℚ) ≤ Ln := by
    rw [hLn]; exact add_nonneg (add_nonneg (abs_nonneg _) (abs_nonneg _)) (abs_nonneg _)
  have hLn1 : (0 : ℚ) < Ln + 1 := by linarith
  set σc := min (β / (2 * (Lg + 1))) (|κ| * θ / (Ln + 1)) with hσcdef
  have hσc0 : 0 < σc :=
    lt_min (div_pos hβ0 (by positivity)) (div_pos (mul_pos hκabs hθ0) hLn1)
  have hgσ : Lg * σc < β / 2 := by
    have hmin1 : σc ≤ β / (2 * (Lg + 1)) := by rw [hσcdef]; exact min_le_left _ _
    have hkey : Lg * β / (2 * (Lg + 1)) < β / 2 := by
      rw [div_lt_div_iff₀ (by positivity) (by norm_num : (0 : ℚ) < 2)]; nlinarith [hβ0]
    calc Lg * σc ≤ Lg * (β / (2 * (Lg + 1))) := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hmin1 hLg0
      _ = Lg * β / (2 * (Lg + 1)) := by ring
      _ < β / 2 := hkey
  refine ⟨σc, hσc0, fun f t hf => ?_⟩
  have hdispg : |dotQ g (psub f b)| ≤ Lg * σc := by
    rw [hLg]; exact dotQ_hoelder g (psub f b) (fun k => hf k)
  by_cases hnearpt : |t - tb| < θ
  · intro hmem
    have hnnZ : 0 ≤ eeval (lineAt f d t) := hnn _ hmem
    have heeZ := hshift f t
    have hlin : (t - tb) * G ≤ β / 2 := by
      have ha : (t - tb) * G ≤ |(t - tb) * G| := le_abs_self _
      have hb2 : |(t - tb) * G| ≤ θ * |G| := by
        rw [abs_mul]; exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (le_of_lt hnearpt) (abs_nonneg G)
      linarith [ha, hb2, hθG]
    have hdgstrict : dotQ g (psub f b) < β / 2 :=
      lt_of_le_of_lt (le_abs_self _) (lt_of_le_of_lt hdispg hgσ)
    have he0β : e0 = -β := by rw [hβ]; ring
    have hltZ : eeval (lineAt f d t) < 0 := by
      rw [heeZ, he0β]; linarith [hlin, hdgstrict, hβ0]
    linarith [hnnZ, hltZ]
  · push_neg at hnearpt
    refine arm_off_carrier u hκd hcr hf ?_ hnearpt
    rw [← hLn]
    have hmin2 : σc ≤ |κ| * θ / (Ln + 1) := by rw [hσcdef]; exact min_le_right _ _
    have hkey : Ln * (|κ| * θ / (Ln + 1)) < |κ| * θ := by
      have heq : Ln * (|κ| * θ / (Ln + 1)) = Ln * (|κ| * θ) / (Ln + 1) := by ring
      rw [heq, div_lt_iff₀ hLn1]; nlinarith [mul_pos hκabs hθ0, hLn0]
    calc Ln * σc ≤ Ln * (|κ| * θ / (Ln + 1)) := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hmin2 hLn0
      _ < |κ| * θ := hkey

name: column_shift_off_triangle
statement:
theorem column_shift_off_triangle {M : Mesh} (hnpo : NoPlaneThroughOrigin M)
    (i u : Fin M.size) {d : Point}
    (hAu : dotQ (Proof.MeshIntersectJump.faceNormal M[u]) d ≠ 0)
    (hbu : baryPt M[i] ∉ triangleSet M[u])
    {δ δm : ℚ} (hδ : 0 < δ) (hδm : 0 < δm)
    (hfree_p : ∀ s, 0 < s → s < 2 * δ → lineAt (baryPt M[i]) d s ∉ triangleSet M[u])
    (hfree_m : ∀ s, 0 < s → s < 2 * δm →
      lineAt (baryPt M[i]) ((-1 : ℚ) • d) s ∉ triangleSet M[u]) :
    ∃ σc : ℚ, 0 < σc ∧
      ∀ (f : Point) (t : ℚ), (∀ k, |f k - baryPt M[i] k| ≤ σc) →
        -δm ≤ t → t ≤ 3 * δ / 2 → lineAt f d t ∉ triangleSet M[u]
proof:
:= by
  classical
  set b := baryPt M[i] with hb
  have hκ0 : dotQ (Proof.MeshIntersectJump.faceNormal M[u]) d ≠ 0 := hAu
  set κ := dotQ (Proof.MeshIntersectJump.faceNormal M[u]) d with hκ
  have hκd : dotQ (Proof.MeshIntersectJump.faceNormal M[u]) d = κ := hκ.symm
  set tb := (detOrigin M[u] - dotQ (Proof.MeshIntersectJump.faceNormal M[u]) b) / κ with htb
  have hκtb : κ * tb = detOrigin M[u] - dotQ (Proof.MeshIntersectJump.faceNormal M[u]) b := by
    rw [htb, ← mul_div_assoc, mul_div_cancel_left₀ _ hκ0]
  have hcol : ∀ τ : ℚ, dotQ (Proof.MeshIntersectJump.faceNormal M[u]) (lineAt b d τ) - detOrigin M[u] = κ * (τ - tb) := by
    intro τ
    rw [Proof.WellFormedCheckNormal.dotQ_lineAt, ← hκ]; linear_combination hκtb
  have hBcar : dotQ (Proof.MeshIntersectJump.faceNormal M[u]) (lineAt b d tb) = detOrigin M[u] := by
    have h := hcol tb; rw [sub_self, mul_zero] at h; linarith
  by_cases hnear : -δm ≤ tb ∧ tb < 2 * δ
  · obtain ⟨hnearlo, hnearhi⟩ := hnear
    have hBoff : lineAt b d tb ∉ triangleSet M[u] := by
      rcases lt_trichotomy tb 0 with htneg | htzero | htpos
      · have hlineeq : lineAt b d tb = lineAt b ((-1 : ℚ) • d) (-tb) := by
          funext k; simp only [lineAt, Pi.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul]; ring
        rw [hlineeq]
        
        exact hfree_m (-tb) (by linarith) (by linarith)
      · rw [htzero, Proof.WellFormedCheckNormal.lineAt_zero]; exact hbu
      · 
        exact hfree_p tb htpos hnearhi
    have hneg3 : ee0 M[u] (lineAt b d tb) < 0 ∨ ee1 M[u] (lineAt b d tb) < 0
        ∨ ee2 M[u] (lineAt b d tb) < 0 := by
      by_contra hc; push_neg at hc
      exact hBoff (mem_triangleSet_of_carrier (hnpo u) hBcar hc.1 hc.2.1 hc.2.2)
    rcases hneg3 with h0 | h1 | h2
    · obtain ⟨σc, hσc0, hcl⟩ := near_edge_clear u hκ0 hκd hBcar
        (crossQ (Proof.MeshIntersectJump.faceNormal M[u]) (psub M[u].v₁ M[u].v₀)) (ee0 M[u])
        (fun R hR => (ee_nonneg_of_mem_triangleSet hR).1)
        (fun f τ => ee0_shift M[u] f b d τ tb) h0
      exact ⟨σc, hσc0, fun f t hf _ _ => hcl f t hf⟩
    · obtain ⟨σc, hσc0, hcl⟩ := near_edge_clear u hκ0 hκd hBcar
        (crossQ (Proof.MeshIntersectJump.faceNormal M[u]) (psub M[u].v₂ M[u].v₁)) (ee1 M[u])
        (fun R hR => (ee_nonneg_of_mem_triangleSet hR).2.1)
        (fun f τ => ee1_shift M[u] f b d τ tb) h1
      exact ⟨σc, hσc0, fun f t hf _ _ => hcl f t hf⟩
    · obtain ⟨σc, hσc0, hcl⟩ := near_edge_clear u hκ0 hκd hBcar
        (crossQ (Proof.MeshIntersectJump.faceNormal M[u]) (psub M[u].v₀ M[u].v₂)) (ee2 M[u])
        (fun R hR => (ee_nonneg_of_mem_triangleSet hR).2.2)
        (fun f τ => ee2_shift M[u] f b d τ tb) h2
      exact ⟨σc, hσc0, fun f t hf _ _ => hcl f t hf⟩
  · have hκabs : 0 < |κ| := abs_pos.mpr hκ0
    set Ln := |Proof.MeshIntersectJump.faceNormal M[u] 0| + |Proof.MeshIntersectJump.faceNormal M[u] 1| + |Proof.MeshIntersectJump.faceNormal M[u] 2| with hLndef
    have hLn0 : (0 : ℚ) ≤ Ln := by
      rw [hLndef]; exact add_nonneg (add_nonneg (abs_nonneg _) (abs_nonneg _)) (abs_nonneg _)
    have hLn1 : (0 : ℚ) < Ln + 1 := by linarith
    have build : ∀ μ : ℚ, 0 < μ → ∃ σc : ℚ, 0 < σc ∧ ∀ (f : Point) (t : ℚ),
        (∀ k, |f k - b k| ≤ σc) → μ ≤ |t - tb| → lineAt f d t ∉ triangleSet M[u] := by
      intro μ hμ0
      refine ⟨|κ| * μ / (Ln + 1), div_pos (mul_pos hκabs hμ0) hLn1, fun f t hf hμle => ?_⟩
      refine arm_off_carrier u hκd hBcar hf ?_ hμle
      rw [← hLndef]
      have heq : Ln * (|κ| * μ / (Ln + 1)) = Ln * (|κ| * μ) / (Ln + 1) := by ring
      rw [heq, div_lt_iff₀ hLn1]; nlinarith [mul_pos hκabs hμ0, hLn0]
    rcases lt_or_le tb (-δm) with hlo | hge
    · obtain ⟨σc, hσc0, hcl⟩ := build (-δm - tb) (by linarith)
      refine ⟨σc, hσc0, fun f t hf ht1 ht2 => hcl f t hf ?_⟩
      calc -δm - tb ≤ t - tb := by linarith
        _ ≤ |t - tb| := le_abs_self _
    · have h2δ : 2 * δ ≤ tb := by
        by_contra hc; push_neg at hc; exact hnear ⟨hge, hc⟩
      obtain ⟨σc, hσc0, hcl⟩ := build (tb - 3 * δ / 2) (by linarith)
      refine ⟨σc, hσc0, fun f t hf ht1 ht2 => hcl f t hf ?_⟩
      calc tb - 3 * δ / 2 ≤ tb - t := by linarith
        _ ≤ |tb - t| := le_abs_self _
        _ = |t - tb| := abs_sub_comm tb t

name: disp_bound
statement:
theorem disp_bound {n d : Point} {κ ρ : ℚ} (hκ0 : κ ≠ 0)
    {P Q : Point} (hPQ : ∀ k, |P k - Q k| ≤ ρ) (k : Fin 3) :
    |(P k - Q k) - dotQ n (psub P Q) / κ * d k|
      ≤ (1 + (|n 0| + |n 1| + |n 2|) * (max (max |d 0| |d 1|) |d 2|) / |κ|) * ρ
proof:
:= by
  have hκabs : 0 < |κ| := abs_pos.mpr hκ0
  have hρ : 0 ≤ ρ := le_trans (abs_nonneg _) (hPQ 0)
  have hdk : |d k| ≤ max (max |d 0| |d 1|) |d 2| := by
    fin_cases k
    · exact le_trans (le_max_left _ _) (le_max_left _ _)
    · exact le_trans (le_max_right _ _) (le_max_left _ _)
    · exact le_max_right _ _
  have hdot : |dotQ n (psub P Q)| ≤ (|n 0| + |n 1| + |n 2|) * ρ :=
    dotQ_hoelder n (psub P Q) (fun j => by simpa [psub] using hPQ j)
  set L1 := |n 0| + |n 1| + |n 2| with hL1
  set dmax := max (max |d 0| |d 1|) |d 2| with hdmax
  have hL10 : 0 ≤ L1 := by
    rw [hL1]; exact add_nonneg (add_nonneg (abs_nonneg _) (abs_nonneg _)) (abs_nonneg _)
  have hdmax0 : 0 ≤ dmax := le_trans (abs_nonneg (d k)) hdk
  have htri : |(P k - Q k) - dotQ n (psub P Q) / κ * d k|
      ≤ |P k - Q k| + |dotQ n (psub P Q)| / |κ| * |d k| := by
    have h := abs_add (P k - Q k) (-(dotQ n (psub P Q) / κ * d k))
    rw [abs_neg, abs_mul, abs_div] at h
    simpa [sub_eq_add_neg] using h
  have hb2 : |dotQ n (psub P Q)| / |κ| * |d k| ≤ L1 * ρ / |κ| * dmax := by
    gcongr
  have hexp : (1 + L1 * dmax / |κ|) * ρ = ρ + L1 * ρ / |κ| * dmax := by
    field_simp; ring
  rw [hexp]; linarith [htri, hb2, hPQ k]

name: side_sign_height
statement:
theorem side_sign_height {M : Mesh} (i : Fin M.size) {_d P Q : Point} {κ δ ρ : ℚ} {s : ℤ}
    (hs : s = 1 ∨ s = -1) (hκs : 0 < (s : ℚ) * κ) (_hδ : 0 < δ)
    (hQ : dotQ (Proof.MeshIntersectJump.faceNormal M[i]) Q = detOrigin M[i] + δ * κ)
    (hPQ : ∀ k, |P k - Q k| ≤ ρ)
    (hb1 : (|Proof.MeshIntersectJump.faceNormal M[i] 0| + |Proof.MeshIntersectJump.faceNormal M[i] 1| + |Proof.MeshIntersectJump.faceNormal M[i] 2|) * ρ < δ * |κ|)
    (hb2 : (|Proof.MeshIntersectJump.faceNormal M[i] 0| + |Proof.MeshIntersectJump.faceNormal M[i] 1| + |Proof.MeshIntersectJump.faceNormal M[i] 2|) * ρ ≤ δ * |κ| / 2) :
    Proof.WellFormedCheckNormal.sideOf M[i] P = s ∧
    δ / 2 ≤ (dotQ (Proof.MeshIntersectJump.faceNormal M[i]) P - detOrigin M[i]) / κ ∧
    (dotQ (Proof.MeshIntersectJump.faceNormal M[i]) P - detOrigin M[i]) / κ ≤ 3 * δ / 2
proof:
:= by
  have hκ0 : κ ≠ 0 := by rintro rfl; simp at hκs
  have hκabs : 0 < |κ| := abs_pos.mpr hκ0
  set x := dotQ (Proof.MeshIntersectJump.faceNormal M[i]) (psub P Q) with hx
  have hval : dotQ (Proof.MeshIntersectJump.faceNormal M[i]) P - detOrigin M[i] = δ * κ + x := by
    rw [hx, dotQ_psub_right, hQ]; ring
  have hxbound : |x| ≤ (|Proof.MeshIntersectJump.faceNormal M[i] 0| + |Proof.MeshIntersectJump.faceNormal M[i] 1| + |Proof.MeshIntersectJump.faceNormal M[i] 2|) * ρ := by
    rw [hx]; exact dotQ_hoelder _ _ (fun k => by simpa [psub] using hPQ k)
  have hHval : (dotQ (Proof.MeshIntersectJump.faceNormal M[i]) P - detOrigin M[i]) / κ = δ + x / κ := by
    rw [hval]; field_simp
  have hsmall : |x / κ| ≤ δ / 2 := by
    rw [abs_div, div_le_iff₀ hκabs]
    calc |x| ≤ (|Proof.MeshIntersectJump.faceNormal M[i] 0| + |Proof.MeshIntersectJump.faceNormal M[i] 1| + |Proof.MeshIntersectJump.faceNormal M[i] 2|) * ρ := hxbound
      _ ≤ δ * |κ| / 2 := hb2
      _ = δ / 2 * |κ| := by ring
  obtain ⟨hlo, hhi⟩ := abs_le.mp hsmall
  refine ⟨?_, by rw [hHval]; linarith, by rw [hHval]; linarith⟩
  unfold Proof.WellFormedCheckNormal.sideOf
  rw [hval]
  rcases hs with rfl | rfl
  · have hκpos : 0 < κ := by have h := hκs; push_cast at h; linarith
    have hxlt : |x| < δ * κ := by
      have := lt_of_le_of_lt hxbound hb1; rwa [abs_of_pos hκpos] at this
    exact qsign_of_pos (by linarith [neg_abs_le x, hxlt])
  · have hκneg : κ < 0 := by have h := hκs; push_cast at h; linarith
    have hxlt : |x| < -(δ * κ) := by
      have h := lt_of_le_of_lt hxbound hb1
      rw [abs_of_neg hκneg] at h; linarith [h]
    exact qsign_of_neg (by linarith [le_abs_self x, hxlt])

name: seg_arm_off_triangles
statement:
theorem seg_arm_off_triangles {M : Mesh} (hnpo : NoPlaneThroughOrigin M) (i : Fin M.size)
    {d : Point} (hκ0 : dotQ (Proof.MeshIntersectJump.faceNormal M[i]) d ≠ 0)
    (hbary_off : ∀ u : Fin M.size, u ≠ i → baryPt M[i] ∉ triangleSet M[u])
    {δ δm : ℚ} (hδ : 0 < δ) (hδm : 0 < δm)
    (hfree_p : ∀ (u : Fin M.size) (s : ℚ), 0 < s → s < 2 * δ →
      lineAt (baryPt M[i]) d s ∉ triangleSet M[u])
    (hfree_m : ∀ (u : Fin M.size) (s : ℚ), 0 < s → s < 2 * δm →
      lineAt (baryPt M[i]) ((-1 : ℚ) • d) s ∉ triangleSet M[u]) :
    ∃ Δ₀ : ℚ, 0 < Δ₀ ∧ ∀ (f P : Point),
      (∀ k, |f k - baryPt M[i] k| ≤ Δ₀) →
      dotQ (Proof.MeshIntersectJump.faceNormal M[i]) f = detOrigin M[i] →
      (∀ u : Fin M.size, dotQ (Proof.MeshIntersectJump.faceNormal M[u]) P ≠ detOrigin M[u]) →
      (∀ u : Fin M.size, dotQ (Proof.MeshIntersectJump.faceNormal M[u]) d = 0 →
        dotQ (Proof.MeshIntersectJump.faceNormal M[u]) f = dotQ (Proof.MeshIntersectJump.faceNormal M[u]) P) →
      ∀ (j : Fin M.size) (t : ℚ), -δm ≤ t → t ≤ 3 * δ / 2 → t ≠ 0 →
        lineAt f d t ∉ triangleSet M[j]
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have hfloor : ∀ u : Fin M.size, ∃ σ : ℚ, 0 < σ ∧
      (u ≠ i → dotQ (Proof.MeshIntersectJump.faceNormal M[u]) d ≠ 0 → ∀ (f : Point) (t : ℚ),
        (∀ k, |f k - baryPt M[i] k| ≤ σ) → -δm ≤ t → t ≤ 3 * δ / 2 →
        lineAt f d t ∉ triangleSet M[u]) := by
    intro u
    by_cases hui : u = i
    · exact ⟨1, one_pos, fun h => absurd hui h⟩
    · by_cases hAu : dotQ (Proof.MeshIntersectJump.faceNormal M[u]) d = 0
      · exact ⟨1, one_pos, fun _ hA => absurd hAu hA⟩
      · obtain ⟨σc, hσc0, hcl⟩ :=
          column_shift_off_triangle hnpo i u hAu (hbary_off u hui) hδ hδm (hfree_p u) (hfree_m u)
        exact ⟨σc, hσc0, fun _ _ => hcl⟩
  choose φ hφpos hφcl using hfloor
  set Δ₀ := ((List.finRange M.size).map φ).foldr min 1 with hΔ₀
  have hΔ₀pos : 0 < Δ₀ := by
    rw [hΔ₀]
    refine Proof.WellFormedCheckNormal.foldr_min_pos ?_ one_pos
    intro a ha; obtain ⟨u, _, rfl⟩ := List.mem_map.mp ha; exact hφpos u
  have hΔ₀le : ∀ u : Fin M.size, Δ₀ ≤ φ u := by
    intro u; rw [hΔ₀]
    exact Proof.WellFormedCheckNormal.foldr_min_le (List.mem_map_of_mem φ (List.mem_finRange u)) 1
  refine ⟨Δ₀, hΔ₀pos, fun f P hfb hfcar hoffc hfPa j t htlo tthi htne => ?_⟩
  by_cases hji : j = i
  · subst hji
    intro hmem
    have hcar := Proof.MeshIntersectRayClassify.triangleSet_on_carrier hmem
    rw [Proof.WellFormedCheckNormal.dotQ_lineAt, hfcar] at hcar
    have h0 : t * dotQ (Proof.MeshIntersectJump.faceNormal M[j]) d = 0 := by linarith
    rcases mul_eq_zero.mp h0 with h | h
    · exact htne h
    · exact hκ0 h
  · by_cases hAj : dotQ (Proof.MeshIntersectJump.faceNormal M[j]) d = 0
    · intro hmem
      have hcar := Proof.MeshIntersectRayClassify.triangleSet_on_carrier hmem
      rw [Proof.WellFormedCheckNormal.dotQ_lineAt, hAj, mul_zero, add_zero,
        hfPa j hAj] at hcar
      exact hoffc j hcar
    · exact hφcl j hji hAj f t (fun k => le_trans (hfb k) (hΔ₀le j)) htlo tthi

name: foot_no_double_vanish
statement:
theorem foot_no_double_vanish {M : Mesh} (hnpo : NoPlaneThroughOrigin M)
    {d P f : Point}
    (hfP : ∀ w : Point, dotQ w d = 0 → dotQ w f = dotQ w P)
    (hG1P : G1Clean M P)
    (hS2d : ∀ (j : Fin M.size) (k k' : Fin 4),
        crossQ (crossQ (slot M[j] k).n (slot M[j] k').n) d ≠ 0 →
        dotQ (crossQ (crossQ (slot M[j] k).n (slot M[j] k').n) d) P
          ≠ dotQ (slot M[j] k).n d * (slot M[j] k').c
            - dotQ (slot M[j] k').n d * (slot M[j] k).c) :
    ∀ (j : Fin M.size), ∀ g ∈ tetraHalves M[j], ∀ g' ∈ tetraHalves M[j], g ≠ g' →
      ∀ t : ℚ, ¬ (g.eval (lineAt f d t) = 0 ∧ g'.eval (lineAt f d t) = 0)
proof:
:= by
  rintro j g hg g' hg' hne t ⟨hgz, hgz'⟩
  by_cases hu : crossQ g.n g'.n = 0
  · 
    have hb := eq_smul_of_crossQ_zero (facet_n_ne_zero (hnpo j) g hg) hu
    set κ : ℚ := dotQ g.n g'.n / dotQ g.n g.n with hκ
    have hap : dotQ g.n (lineAt f d t) = g.c := by
      simp only [Half.eval] at hgz; linarith
    have hbp : dotQ g'.n (lineAt f d t) = g'.c := by
      simp only [Half.eval] at hgz'; linarith
    have hκc : g'.c = κ * g.c := by
      rw [← hbp, hb, Proof.WellFormedCheckNormal.dotQ_smul_left, hap]
    exact tetraHalves_not_proportional (hnpo j) hg hg' hne κ
      (fun z => by
        simp only [Half.eval]
        rw [hb, Proof.WellFormedCheckNormal.dotQ_smul_left, hκc]
        ring)
  · by_cases hν : crossQ (crossQ g.n g'.n) d = 0
    · 
      have hgd : dotQ g.n d = 0 := by
        rw [eq_smul_of_crossQ_zero hu hν, Proof.WellFormedCheckNormal.dotQ_smul_right,
          Proof.WellFormedCheckNormal.dotQ_comm g.n (crossQ g.n g'.n), dotQ_crossQ_self_left,
          mul_zero]
      have hZf : g.eval (lineAt f d t) = g.eval P := by
        rw [eval_lineAt, hgd, mul_zero, add_zero]
        simp only [Half.eval]; rw [hfP g.n hgd]
      rw [hZf] at hgz
      exact hG1P j g hg hgz
    · 
      obtain ⟨k, rfl⟩ := mem_tetraHalves_iff.mp hg
      obtain ⟨k', rfl⟩ := mem_tetraHalves_iff.mp hg'
      set w := crossQ (crossQ (slot M[j] k).n (slot M[j] k').n) d with hw
      have hap : dotQ (slot M[j] k).n (lineAt f d t) = (slot M[j] k).c := by
        simp only [Half.eval] at hgz; linarith
      have hbp : dotQ (slot M[j] k').n (lineAt f d t) = (slot M[j] k').c := by
        simp only [Half.eval] at hgz'; linarith
      have hwperp : dotQ w d = 0 := by
        rw [hw]; exact dotQ_crossQ_self_right _ _
      have hwZ : dotQ w (lineAt f d t)
          = dotQ (slot M[j] k).n d * (slot M[j] k').c
            - dotQ (slot M[j] k').n d * (slot M[j] k).c := by
        rw [hw, dotQ_double_cross, hap, hbp]
      have hwtrans : dotQ w (lineAt f d t) = dotQ w P := by
        rw [Proof.WellFormedCheckNormal.dotQ_lineAt, hwperp, mul_zero, add_zero, hfP w hwperp]
      exact hS2d j k k' hν (by rw [← hwtrans, hwZ])

name: admissible_of_foot
statement:
private theorem admissible_of_foot {M : Mesh} (hnpo : NoPlaneThroughOrigin M) (fi : Fin M.size)
    (s : ℤ) {d P f : Point} {δ δm Δ₀ H : ℚ}
    (hδm : 0 < δm) (hHpos : 0 < H) (hHhi : H ≤ 3 * δ / 2)
    (hf : f = fun k => P k - H * d k)
    (hfP : ∀ w : Point, dotQ w d = 0 → dotQ w f = dotQ w P)
    (hfcar : dotQ (Proof.MeshIntersectJump.faceNormal M[fi]) f = detOrigin M[fi])
    (hee0pos : 0 < ee0 M[fi] f) (hee1pos : 0 < ee1 M[fi] f) (hee2pos : 0 < ee2 M[fi] f)
    (hfootΔ : ∀ k, |f k - baryPt M[fi] k| ≤ Δ₀)
    (hΔ₀ : ∀ (f' P' : Point),
      (∀ k, |f' k - baryPt M[fi] k| ≤ Δ₀) →
      dotQ (Proof.MeshIntersectJump.faceNormal M[fi]) f' = detOrigin M[fi] →
      (∀ u : Fin M.size, dotQ (Proof.MeshIntersectJump.faceNormal M[u]) P' ≠ detOrigin M[u]) →
      (∀ u : Fin M.size, dotQ (Proof.MeshIntersectJump.faceNormal M[u]) d = 0 →
        dotQ (Proof.MeshIntersectJump.faceNormal M[u]) f' = dotQ (Proof.MeshIntersectJump.faceNormal M[u]) P') →
      ∀ (j : Fin M.size) (t : ℚ), -δm ≤ t → t ≤ 3 * δ / 2 → t ≠ 0 →
        lineAt f' d t ∉ triangleSet M[j])
    (hoffcP : ∀ u : Fin M.size, dotQ (Proof.MeshIntersectJump.faceNormal M[u]) P ≠ detOrigin M[u])
    (hG1P : G1Clean M P)
    (hS2d : ∀ (j : Fin M.size) (k k' : Fin 4),
        crossQ (crossQ (slot M[j] k).n (slot M[j] k').n) d ≠ 0 →
        dotQ (crossQ (crossQ (slot M[j] k).n (slot M[j] k').n) d) P
          ≠ dotQ (slot M[j] k).n d * (slot M[j] k').c
            - dotQ (slot M[j] k').n d * (slot M[j] k).c)
    (hside : Proof.WellFormedCheckNormal.sideOf M[fi] P = s) :
    AdmPt M fi s P
proof:
:= by
  classical
  set RL := ((List.finRange M.size).product (List.finRange 4)).filterMap (fun jk =>
      if dotQ (slot M[jk.1] jk.2).n ((-1 : ℚ) • d) ≠ 0
      then some (-(slot M[jk.1] jk.2).eval f / dotQ (slot M[jk.1] jk.2).n ((-1 : ℚ) • d))
      else none) with hRL
  obtain ⟨η, hη0, hηm, hηav⟩ := exists_pos_lt_avoiding hδm RL
  set y := lineAt f ((-1 : ℚ) • d) η with hy
  set τc := H / (H + η) with hτc
  have hHη : 0 < H + η := by linarith [hHpos, hη0]
  have hHηne : H + η ≠ 0 := ne_of_gt hHη
  have hseg : ∀ τ : ℚ, seg P y τ = lineAt f d (H - τ * (H + η)) := by
    intro τ; funext k
    simp only [seg, hy, hf, lineAt, Pi.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul]; ring
  have htc0 : H - τc * (H + η) = 0 := by rw [hτc]; field_simp
  have hsegtc : seg P y τc = f := by rw [hseg τc, htc0, Proof.WellFormedCheckNormal.lineAt_zero]
  have hg1y : G1Clean M y := by
    rw [hy]; intro j g hg
    obtain ⟨k, rfl⟩ := mem_tetraHalves_iff.mp hg
    rw [eval_lineAt]
    by_cases hz : dotQ (slot M[j] k).n ((-1 : ℚ) • d) = 0
    · rw [hz, mul_zero, add_zero]
      have hzd : dotQ (slot M[j] k).n d = 0 := by
        have h := hz; rw [Proof.WellFormedCheckNormal.dotQ_smul_right] at h; linarith
      have hef : (slot M[j] k).eval f = (slot M[j] k).eval P := by
        simp only [Half.eval]; rw [hfP (slot M[j] k).n hzd]
      rw [hef]; exact hG1P j (slot M[j] k) (slot_mem _ _)
    · intro hc
      have hmem : (-(slot M[j] k).eval f / dotQ (slot M[j] k).n ((-1 : ℚ) • d)) ∈ RL := by
        rw [hRL]
        exact List.mem_filterMap.mpr ⟨(j, k),
          List.pair_mem_product.mpr ⟨List.mem_finRange j, List.mem_finRange k⟩, by rw [if_pos hz]⟩
      exact hηav _ hmem (by rw [eq_div_iff hz]; linarith [hc])
  refine ⟨y, τc, ⟨?_, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_, hG1P, hg1y, ?_⟩, hside⟩
  · exact div_pos hHpos hHη
  · rw [hτc, div_lt_one hHη]; linarith [hη0]
  · rw [hsegtc]
    exact mem_triangleSet_of_carrier (hnpo fi) hfcar hee0pos.le hee1pos.le hee2pos.le
  · rw [hsegtc]; intro hmem
    rcases ee_zero_of_mem_edgeSet hmem with h | h | h
    · exact (ne_of_gt hee0pos) h
    · exact (ne_of_gt hee1pos) h
    · exact (ne_of_gt hee2pos) h
  · intro j τ hτ0 hτ1 hτne
    rw [hseg τ]
    refine hΔ₀ f P hfootΔ hfcar hoffcP
      (fun u hu => hfP (Proof.MeshIntersectJump.faceNormal M[u]) hu) j (H - τ * (H + η)) ?_ ?_ ?_
    · nlinarith [hη0, hHη, hτ1, hδm, hηm, hHpos]
    · nlinarith [hHhi, hτ0, hHη, hη0, hHpos]
    · intro hzero
      apply hτne
      rw [hτc]
      field_simp
      nlinarith [hzero, hHη]
  · intro j g hg g' hg' hne τ _ _
    rw [hseg τ]
    exact foot_no_double_vanish hnpo hfP hG1P hS2d j g hg g' hg' hne (H - τ * (H + η))

name: radius_floors
statement:
private theorem radius_floors {Ln dmax Aq Lgs δ κ Δ₀ : ℚ}
    (hLn0 : 0 ≤ Ln) (hdmax0 : 0 ≤ dmax) (hAqpos : 0 < Aq) (hLgs0 : 0 ≤ Lgs)
    (hδ : 0 < δ) (hκabs : 0 < |κ|) (hΔ₀pos : 0 < Δ₀) :
    ∃ ρ : ℚ, 0 < ρ ∧
      Ln * ρ < δ * |κ| ∧
      Ln * ρ ≤ δ * |κ| / 2 ∧
      (1 + Ln * dmax / |κ|) * ρ ≤ Δ₀ ∧
      ∀ G : Point, |G 0| + |G 1| + |G 2| ≤ Lgs →
        (|G 0| + |G 1| + |G 2|) * ((1 + Ln * dmax / |κ|) * ρ) < Aq / 3
proof:
:= by
  set Lπ := 1 + Ln * dmax / |κ| with hLπdef
  have hLπpos : 0 < Lπ := by
    rw [hLπdef]; have : 0 ≤ Ln * dmax / |κ| := div_nonneg (mul_nonneg hLn0 hdmax0) hκabs.le
    linarith
  set FH := δ * |κ| / (2 * (Ln + 1)) with hFH
  set F2 := (Aq / 3) / ((Lgs + 1) * Lπ) with hF2
  set F3 := Δ₀ / Lπ with hF3
  have hFHpos : 0 < FH := div_pos (mul_pos hδ hκabs) (by linarith [hLn0])
  have hF2pos : 0 < F2 := div_pos (by linarith [hAqpos]) (mul_pos (by linarith [hLgs0]) hLπpos)
  have hF3pos : 0 < F3 := div_pos hΔ₀pos hLπpos
  set ρ := (1 / 2) * min (min FH F2) F3 with hρdef
  have hminpos : 0 < min (min FH F2) F3 := lt_min (lt_min hFHpos hF2pos) hF3pos
  have hρpos : 0 < ρ := by rw [hρdef]; linarith [hminpos]
  have hle1 : min (min FH F2) F3 ≤ FH := le_trans (min_le_left _ _) (min_le_left _ _)
  have hle2 : min (min FH F2) F3 ≤ F2 := le_trans (min_le_left _ _) (min_le_right _ _)
  have hle3 : min (min FH F2) F3 ≤ F3 := min_le_right _ _
  have hρFH : ρ < FH := by rw [hρdef]; linarith [hle1, hFHpos]
  have hρF2 : ρ < F2 := by rw [hρdef]; linarith [hle2, hF2pos]
  have hρF3 : ρ < F3 := by rw [hρdef]; linarith [hle3, hF3pos]
  have hden : (0 : ℚ) < 2 * (Ln + 1) := by linarith [hLn0]
  have hb2 : Ln * ρ ≤ δ * |κ| / 2 := by
    have hk : ρ * (2 * (Ln + 1)) < δ * |κ| := by rw [hFH] at hρFH; exact (lt_div_iff₀ hden).mp hρFH
    nlinarith [hLn0, hρpos, hk]
  have hb1 : Ln * ρ < δ * |κ| := by nlinarith [hb2, mul_pos hδ hκabs]
  have hdenLg : (0 : ℚ) < (Lgs + 1) * Lπ := mul_pos (by linarith [hLgs0]) hLπpos
  have hF2k : ρ * ((Lgs + 1) * Lπ) < Aq / 3 := by rw [hF2] at hρF2; exact (lt_div_iff₀ hdenLg).mp hρF2
  have hLρΔ : Lπ * ρ ≤ Δ₀ := by
    have hk : ρ * Lπ < Δ₀ := by rw [hF3] at hρF3; exact (lt_div_iff₀ hLπpos).mp hρF3
    linarith [hk]
  refine ⟨ρ, hρpos, hb1, hb2, hLρΔ, ?_⟩
  intro G hG
  have hLπρ : 0 ≤ Lπ * ρ := (mul_pos hLπpos hρpos).le
  calc (|G 0| + |G 1| + |G 2|) * (Lπ * ρ)
      ≤ Lgs * (Lπ * ρ) := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hG hLπρ
    _ ≤ (Lgs + 1) * (Lπ * ρ) := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (by linarith) hLπρ
    _ = ρ * ((Lgs + 1) * Lπ) := by ring
    _ < Aq / 3 := hF2k

name: foot_ee_pos
statement:
private theorem foot_ee_pos {M : Mesh} (fi : Fin M.size) {f : Point} {B Aq Lgs : ℚ}
    {g0 g1v g2v : Point}
    (hg0 : g0 = crossQ (Proof.MeshIntersectJump.faceNormal M[fi]) (psub M[fi].v₁ M[fi].v₀))
    (hg1v : g1v = crossQ (Proof.MeshIntersectJump.faceNormal M[fi]) (psub M[fi].v₂ M[fi].v₁))
    (hg2v : g2v = crossQ (Proof.MeshIntersectJump.faceNormal M[fi]) (psub M[fi].v₀ M[fi].v₂))
    (hLgs : Lgs = (|g0 0| + |g0 1| + |g0 2|) + (|g1v 0| + |g1v 1| + |g1v 2|)
      + (|g2v 0| + |g2v 1| + |g2v 2|))
    (hee0b : ee0 M[fi] (baryPt M[fi]) = Aq / 3)
    (hee1b : ee1 M[fi] (baryPt M[fi]) = Aq / 3)
    (hee2b : ee2 M[fi] (baryPt M[fi]) = Aq / 3)
    (hfbL : ∀ k, |f k - baryPt M[fi] k| ≤ B)
    (hkey : ∀ G : Point, |G 0| + |G 1| + |G 2| ≤ Lgs →
      (|G 0| + |G 1| + |G 2|) * B < Aq / 3) :
    0 < ee0 M[fi] f ∧ 0 < ee1 M[fi] f ∧ 0 < ee2 M[fi] f
proof:
:= by
  have hg0nn : 0 ≤ |g0 0| + |g0 1| + |g0 2| := by positivity
  have hg1nn : 0 ≤ |g1v 0| + |g1v 1| + |g1v 2| := by positivity
  have hg2nn : 0 ≤ |g2v 0| + |g2v 1| + |g2v 2| := by positivity
  refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · have hid : ee0 M[fi] f = ee0 M[fi] (baryPt M[fi]) + dotQ g0 (psub f (baryPt M[fi])) := by
      rw [ee0_as_dot M[fi] f, ee0_as_dot M[fi] (baryPt M[fi]), ← hg0, dotQ_psub_right]; ring
    rw [hid, hee0b]
    have habs := dotQ_hoelder g0 (psub f (baryPt M[fi])) (fun k => by simpa [psub] using hfbL k)
    have hlt := hkey g0 (by rw [hLgs]; linarith [hg1nn, hg2nn])
    linarith [(abs_lt.mp (lt_of_le_of_lt habs hlt)).1]
  · have hid : ee1 M[fi] f = ee1 M[fi] (baryPt M[fi]) + dotQ g1v (psub f (baryPt M[fi])) := by
      rw [ee1_as_dot M[fi] f, ee1_as_dot M[fi] (baryPt M[fi]), ← hg1v, dotQ_psub_right]; ring
    rw [hid, hee1b]
    have habs := dotQ_hoelder g1v (psub f (baryPt M[fi])) (fun k => by simpa [psub] using hfbL k)
    have hlt := hkey g1v (by rw [hLgs]; linarith [hg0nn, hg2nn])
    linarith [(abs_lt.mp (lt_of_le_of_lt habs hlt)).1]
  · have hid : ee2 M[fi] f = ee2 M[fi] (baryPt M[fi]) + dotQ g2v (psub f (baryPt M[fi])) := by
      rw [ee2_as_dot M[fi] f, ee2_as_dot M[fi] (baryPt M[fi]), ← hg2v, dotQ_psub_right]; ring
    rw [hid, hee2b]
    have habs := dotQ_hoelder g2v (psub f (baryPt M[fi])) (fun k => by simpa [psub] using hfbL k)
    have hlt := hkey g2v (by rw [hLgs]; linarith [hg0nn, hg1nn])
    linarith [(abs_lt.mp (lt_of_le_of_lt habs hlt)).1]

name: barySample_admPt_core
statement:
private theorem barySample_admPt_core {M : Mesh} (hcyc : IsClosedOrientedSurface M) (hnpo : NoPlaneThroughOrigin M)
    (hns : NoFaceInteriorContact M) (fi : Fin M.size) (s : ℤ) (hs : s = 1 ∨ s = -1)
    {d Qₛ : Point} {κ δ δm Δ₀ : ℚ}
    (hκ : κ = dotQ (Proof.MeshIntersectJump.faceNormal M[fi]) d)
    (hsκ : 0 < (s : ℚ) * κ)
    (hδ : 0 < δ) (hδm : 0 < δm)
    (hQs : Qₛ = lineAt (baryPt M[fi]) d δ)
    (hQn : dotQ (Proof.MeshIntersectJump.faceNormal M[fi]) Qₛ = detOrigin M[fi] + δ * κ)
    (hQoff : ∀ u : Fin M.size, Qₛ ∉ triangleSet M[u])
    (hΔ₀pos : 0 < Δ₀)
    (hΔ₀ : ∀ (f P : Point),
      (∀ k, |f k - baryPt M[fi] k| ≤ Δ₀) →
      dotQ (Proof.MeshIntersectJump.faceNormal M[fi]) f = detOrigin M[fi] →
      (∀ u : Fin M.size, dotQ (Proof.MeshIntersectJump.faceNormal M[u]) P ≠ detOrigin M[u]) →
      (∀ u : Fin M.size, dotQ (Proof.MeshIntersectJump.faceNormal M[u]) d = 0 →
        dotQ (Proof.MeshIntersectJump.faceNormal M[u]) f = dotQ (Proof.MeshIntersectJump.faceNormal M[u]) P) →
      ∀ (j : Fin M.size) (t : ℚ), -δm ≤ t → t ≤ 3 * δ / 2 → t ≠ 0 →
        lineAt f d t ∉ triangleSet M[j])
    (d_fc : Point) (hd_fc_ne : d_fc ≠ 0)
    (hd_fc_clean : ∀ (u : Fin M.size) (t : ℚ), 0 < t → lineAt Qₛ d_fc t ∉ edgeSet M[u]) :
    ∃ P : Point,
      G1Clean M P ∧
      winding (meshChain M) P = RayCount M Qₛ d_fc ∧
      AdmPt M fi s P
proof:
:= by
  classical
  
  set n := Proof.MeshIntersectJump.faceNormal M[fi] with hn
  set b := baryPt M[fi] with hb
  set c := detOrigin M[fi] with hc
  set Aq := dotQ n n with hAqdef
  have hn_ne : n ≠ 0 := faceNormal_ne_zero (hnpo fi)
  have hAqpos : 0 < Aq := Proof.MeshIntersectRay.dotQ_self_pos hn_ne
  have hnb : dotQ n b = c := baryPt_on_plane M[fi]
  have hκ0 : κ ≠ 0 := fun h => by rw [h, mul_zero] at hsκ; exact lt_irrefl 0 hsκ
  have hκabs : 0 < |κ| := abs_pos.mpr hκ0
  
  set Ln := |n 0| + |n 1| + |n 2| with hLndef
  have hLn0 : 0 ≤ Ln := by rw [hLndef]; positivity
  set dmax := max (max |d 0| |d 1|) |d 2| with hdmaxdef
  have hdmax0 : 0 ≤ dmax := le_trans (abs_nonneg (d 2)) (le_max_right _ _)
  set g0 := crossQ n (psub M[fi].v₁ M[fi].v₀) with hg0
  set g1v := crossQ n (psub M[fi].v₂ M[fi].v₁) with hg1v
  set g2v := crossQ n (psub M[fi].v₀ M[fi].v₂) with hg2v
  set Lgs := (|g0 0| + |g0 1| + |g0 2|) + (|g1v 0| + |g1v 1| + |g1v 2|)
    + (|g2v 0| + |g2v 1| + |g2v 2|) with hLgsdef
  have hLgs0 : 0 ≤ Lgs := by rw [hLgsdef]; positivity
  
  obtain ⟨ρ, hρpos, hb1, hb2, hLρΔ, keyfloor⟩ :=
    radius_floors hLn0 hdmax0 hAqpos hLgs0 hδ hκabs hΔ₀pos
  set Lπ := 1 + Ln * dmax / |κ| with hLπdef
  
  obtain ⟨P, d', hG1P, hd'ne, hoffcP, hdNface, hdAslot, hG2line, hnoedge, hoffseg, hedgeseg,
      hdθ, hedgeDir, hPrad, hS2out⟩ :=
    gen_dense_ball hnpo hQoff hd_fc_ne hd_fc_clean ρ hρpos
      (ιx := {p : Fin M.size × Fin 4 × Fin 4 //
        crossQ (crossQ (slot M[p.1] p.2.1).n (slot M[p.1] p.2.2).n) d ≠ 0})
      (fun p => crossQ (crossQ (slot M[p.1.1] p.1.2.1).n (slot M[p.1.1] p.1.2.2).n) d)
      (fun p => dotQ (slot M[p.1.1] p.1.2.1).n d * (slot M[p.1.1] p.1.2.2).c
        - dotQ (slot M[p.1.1] p.1.2.2).n d * (slot M[p.1.1] p.1.2.1).c)
      (fun p => p.2)
  
  have hwind : winding (meshChain M) P = RayCount M Qₛ d_fc := by
    have hrc1 : RayCount M Qₛ d_fc = RayCount M P d_fc := rayCount_local_const hnpo hoffseg hedgeseg
    have hrc2 : RayCount M P d_fc = RayCount M P d' :=
      rayCount_local_const_dir hnpo hoffcP hdθ hedgeDir
    have hrc3 : winding (meshChain M) P = RayCount M P d' :=
      raycount_eq_winding hcyc hnpo hns hG1P hd'ne hdNface hdAslot hG2line hnoedge
    rw [hrc3, ← hrc2, ← hrc1]
  clear hoffseg hedgeseg hdθ hedgeDir hd'ne hdNface hdAslot hG2line hnoedge hd_fc_ne hd_fc_clean
    hcyc hns d'
  
  set H := (dotQ n P - c) / κ with hH
  set f := (fun k => P k - H * d k : Point) with hf
  have hdotf : ∀ w : Point, dotQ w f = dotQ w P - H * dotQ w d := by
    intro w; simp only [hf, dotQ]; ring
  have hfP : ∀ w : Point, dotQ w d = 0 → dotQ w f = dotQ w P :=
    fun w hw => by rw [hdotf w, hw, mul_zero, sub_zero]
  have hHκ : H * κ = dotQ n P - c := by rw [hH]; field_simp
  have hfcar : dotQ n f = c := by rw [hdotf n, ← hκ, hHκ]; ring
  
  have hsh := side_sign_height fi (_d := d) hs hsκ hδ hQn hPrad hb1 hb2
  have hside : Proof.WellFormedCheckNormal.sideOf M[fi] P = s := hsh.1
  have hHlo : δ / 2 ≤ H := hsh.2.1
  have hHhi : H ≤ 3 * δ / 2 := hsh.2.2
  have hHpos : 0 < H := lt_of_lt_of_le (by linarith [hδ]) hHlo
  
  have hbk : ∀ k, b k = Qₛ k - δ * d k := by intro k; rw [hQs]; simp only [lineAt]; ring
  have hHδ : H - δ = dotQ n (psub P Qₛ) / κ := by
    rw [hH, dotQ_psub_right, show δ = (dotQ n Qₛ - c) / κ from by rw [hQn]; field_simp]
    field_simp
  have hfbid : ∀ k, f k - b k = (P k - Qₛ k) - dotQ n (psub P Qₛ) / κ * d k := by
    intro k; simp only [hf]; rw [hbk k, ← hHδ]; ring
  have hfbL : ∀ k, |f k - b k| ≤ Lπ * ρ := by
    intro k; rw [hfbid k]; exact disp_bound (n := n) (d := d) hκ0 hPrad k
  
  have hee0b : ee0 M[fi] b = Aq / 3 := (ee_baryPt M[fi]).1
  have hee1b : ee1 M[fi] b = Aq / 3 := (ee_baryPt M[fi]).2.1
  have hee2b : ee2 M[fi] b = Aq / 3 := (ee_baryPt M[fi]).2.2
  obtain ⟨hee0pos, hee1pos, hee2pos⟩ :=
    foot_ee_pos fi hg0 hg1v hg2v hLgsdef hee0b hee1b hee2b hfbL keyfloor
  
  have hS2d : ∀ (j : Fin M.size) (k k' : Fin 4),
      crossQ (crossQ (slot M[j] k).n (slot M[j] k').n) d ≠ 0 →
      dotQ (crossQ (crossQ (slot M[j] k).n (slot M[j] k').n) d) P
        ≠ dotQ (slot M[j] k).n d * (slot M[j] k').c
          - dotQ (slot M[j] k').n d * (slot M[j] k).c :=
    fun j k k' htr => hS2out ⟨(j, k, k'), htr⟩
  
  exact ⟨P, hG1P, hwind, admissible_of_foot hnpo fi s hδm hHpos hHhi hf hfP hfcar
    hee0pos hee1pos hee2pos (fun k => le_trans (hfbL k) hLρΔ) hΔ₀ hoffcP hG1P hS2d hside⟩

name: aff_window_bound
statement:
private theorem aff_window_bound (a0 a1 : ℚ) {t : ℚ} (ht : |t| ≤ |a0| / (2 * (|a1| + 1))) :
    |t * a1| ≤ |a0| / 2
proof:
:= by
  have hd : (0 : ℚ) < 2 * (|a1| + 1) := by positivity
  have h2 : |t| * |a1| ≤ (|a0| / (2 * (|a1| + 1))) * |a1| :=
    mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right ht (abs_nonneg _)
  have h3 : (|a0| / (2 * (|a1| + 1))) * |a1| ≤ |a0| / 2 := by
    rw [div_mul_eq_mul_div, div_le_div_iff₀ hd (by norm_num : (0:ℚ) < 2)]
    nlinarith [abs_nonneg a0, abs_nonneg a1]
  rw [abs_mul]; linarith

name: aff_window_ne
statement:
private theorem aff_window_ne {a0 : ℚ} (a1 : ℚ) (h : a0 ≠ 0) :
    ∃ ε : ℚ, 0 < ε ∧ ∀ t : ℚ, |t| ≤ ε → a0 + t * a1 ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨|a0| / (2 * (|a1| + 1)), div_pos (abs_pos.mpr h) (by positivity), fun t ht hc => ?_⟩
  have hb := aff_window_bound a0 a1 ht
  have habs : 0 < |a0| := abs_pos.mpr h
  have h5 : |a0| ≤ |a0 + t * a1| + |t * a1| := by
    have e : a0 = (a0 + t * a1) + (-(t * a1)) := by ring
    calc |a0| = |(a0 + t * a1) + (-(t * a1))| := by rw [← e]
      _ ≤ |a0 + t * a1| + |(-(t * a1))| := abs_add _ _
      _ = |a0 + t * a1| + |t * a1| := by rw [abs_neg]
  rw [hc, abs_zero] at h5
  linarith

name: aff_window_neg
statement:
private theorem aff_window_neg {a0 : ℚ} (a1 : ℚ) (h : a0 < 0) :
    ∃ ε : ℚ, 0 < ε ∧ ∀ t : ℚ, |t| ≤ ε → a0 + t * a1 < 0
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨|a0| / (2 * (|a1| + 1)), div_pos (abs_pos.mpr (ne_of_lt h)) (by positivity),
    fun t ht => ?_⟩
  have hb := aff_window_bound a0 a1 ht
  have ha : |a0| = -a0 := abs_of_neg h
  have := (abs_le.mp hb).2
  rw [ha] at this
  linarith

name: lineAt_lineAt
statement:
private theorem lineAt_lineAt (b d : Point) (a s : ℚ) :
    lineAt (lineAt b d a) d s = lineAt b d (a + s)
proof:
:= by
  funext k; simp only [lineAt]; ring

name: lineAt_neg_dir
statement:
private theorem lineAt_neg_dir (b d : Point) (s : ℚ) :
    lineAt b ((-1 : ℚ) • d) s = lineAt b d (-s)
proof:
:= by
  funext k; simp only [lineAt, Pi.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul]; ring

name: face_line_off
statement:
theorem face_line_off {M : Mesh} (i : Fin M.size) {b d : Point}
    (hb : dotQ (Proof.MeshIntersectJump.faceNormal M[i]) b = detOrigin M[i])
    (hκ : dotQ (Proof.MeshIntersectJump.faceNormal M[i]) d ≠ 0)
    {t : ℚ} (ht : t ≠ 0) : lineAt b d t ∉ triangleSet M[i]
proof:
:= by
  intro hmem
  have hc := Proof.MeshIntersectRayClassify.triangleSet_on_carrier hmem
  rw [Proof.WellFormedCheckNormal.dotQ_lineAt, hb] at hc
  rcases mul_eq_zero.mp (show t * dotQ (Proof.MeshIntersectJump.faceNormal M[i]) d = 0 by linarith)
    with h | h
  · exact ht h
  · exact hκ h

name: arm_clear_face
statement:
theorem arm_clear_face {M : Mesh} (hnpo : NoPlaneThroughOrigin M) (u : Fin M.size)
    (b d : Point) (hb : b ∉ triangleSet M[u]) :
    ∃ ε : ℚ, 0 < ε ∧ ∀ t : ℚ, |t| ≤ ε → lineAt b d t ∉ triangleSet M[u]
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hcar : dotQ (Proof.MeshIntersectJump.faceNormal M[u]) b = detOrigin M[u]
  · 
    have hneg : ee0 M[u] b < 0 ∨ ee1 M[u] b < 0 ∨ ee2 M[u] b < 0 := by
      by_contra hc
      push_neg at hc
      exact hb (Proof.MeshIntersectRayClassify.mem_triangleSet_of_carrier (hnpo u) hcar
        hc.1 hc.2.1 hc.2.2)
    rcases hneg with h | h | h
    · obtain ⟨ε, hε, hw⟩ := aff_window_neg
        (det3 (psub M[u].v₁ M[u].v₀) d (Proof.MeshIntersectJump.faceNormal M[u])) h
      refine ⟨ε, hε, fun t ht hmem => ?_⟩
      have hnn := (Proof.MeshIntersectRayClassify.ee_nonneg_of_mem_triangleSet hmem).1
      rw [Proof.MeshIntersectRayClassifyLocal.ee0_lineAt] at hnn
      exact absurd hnn (not_le.mpr (hw t ht))
    · obtain ⟨ε, hε, hw⟩ := aff_window_neg
        (det3 (psub M[u].v₂ M[u].v₁) d (Proof.MeshIntersectJump.faceNormal M[u])) h
      refine ⟨ε, hε, fun t ht hmem => ?_⟩
      have hnn := (Proof.MeshIntersectRayClassify.ee_nonneg_of_mem_triangleSet hmem).2.1
      rw [Proof.MeshIntersectRayClassifyLocal.ee1_lineAt] at hnn
      exact absurd hnn (not_le.mpr (hw t ht))
    · obtain ⟨ε, hε, hw⟩ := aff_window_neg
        (det3 (psub M[u].v₀ M[u].v₂) d (Proof.MeshIntersectJump.faceNormal M[u])) h
      refine ⟨ε, hε, fun t ht hmem => ?_⟩
      have hnn := (Proof.MeshIntersectRayClassify.ee_nonneg_of_mem_triangleSet hmem).2.2
      rw [Proof.MeshIntersectRayClassifyLocal.ee2_lineAt] at hnn
      exact absurd hnn (not_le.mpr (hw t ht))
  · 
    obtain ⟨ε, hε, hw⟩ := aff_window_ne (dotQ (Proof.MeshIntersectJump.faceNormal M[u]) d)
      (sub_ne_zero.mpr hcar)
    refine ⟨ε, hε, fun t ht hmem => ?_⟩
    have hc := Proof.MeshIntersectRayClassify.triangleSet_on_carrier hmem
    rw [Proof.WellFormedCheckNormal.dotQ_lineAt] at hc
    exact hw t ht (by linarith)

name: bary_arm_clear
statement:
theorem bary_arm_clear {M : Mesh} (hnpo : NoPlaneThroughOrigin M) (i : Fin M.size) (d : Point)
    (hκ : dotQ (Proof.MeshIntersectJump.faceNormal M[i]) d ≠ 0)
    (hbo : ∀ u : Fin M.size, u ≠ i → baryPt M[i] ∉ triangleSet M[u]) :
    ∃ ε : ℚ, 0 < ε ∧ ∀ (u : Fin M.size) (t : ℚ), t ≠ 0 → |t| ≤ ε →
      lineAt (baryPt M[i]) d t ∉ triangleSet M[u]
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have hfloor : ∀ u : Fin M.size, ∃ σ : ℚ, 0 < σ ∧
      (u ≠ i → ∀ t : ℚ, |t| ≤ σ → lineAt (baryPt M[i]) d t ∉ triangleSet M[u]) := by
    intro u
    by_cases hui : u = i
    · exact ⟨1, one_pos, fun h => absurd hui h⟩
    · obtain ⟨ε, hε, hcl⟩ := arm_clear_face hnpo u (baryPt M[i]) d (hbo u hui)
      exact ⟨ε, hε, fun _ => hcl⟩
  choose φ hφpos hφcl using hfloor
  refine ⟨((List.finRange M.size).map φ).foldr min 1, ?_, ?_⟩
  · refine Proof.WellFormedCheckNormal.foldr_min_pos ?_ one_pos
    intro a ha; obtain ⟨u, _, rfl⟩ := List.mem_map.mp ha; exact hφpos u
  · intro u t ht hle
    by_cases hui : u = i
    · rw [hui]
      exact face_line_off i (baryPt_on_plane M[i]) hκ ht
    · exact hφcl u hui t (le_trans hle (Proof.WellFormedCheckNormal.foldr_min_le
        (List.mem_map_of_mem φ (List.mem_finRange u)) 1))

name: baryPt_relint
statement:
theorem baryPt_relint {M : Mesh} (hnpo : NoPlaneThroughOrigin M) (i : Fin M.size) :
    baryPt M[i] ∈ triangleSet M[i] ∧ baryPt M[i] ∉ edgeSet M[i]
proof:
:= by
  have hA : 0 < dotQ (Proof.MeshIntersectJump.faceNormal M[i]) (Proof.MeshIntersectJump.faceNormal M[i]) :=
    Proof.MeshIntersectRayClassify.N_pos (hnpo i)
  obtain ⟨h0, h1, h2⟩ := ee_baryPt M[i]
  refine ⟨Proof.MeshIntersectRayClassify.mem_triangleSet_of_carrier (hnpo i)
      (baryPt_on_plane M[i]) (by rw [h0]; linarith) (by rw [h1]; linarith)
      (by rw [h2]; linarith), fun hmem => ?_⟩
  rcases Proof.MeshIntersectRayClassify.ee_zero_of_mem_edgeSet hmem with h | h | h
  · rw [h0] at h; linarith
  · rw [h1] at h; linarith
  · rw [h2] at h; linarith

name: rayCount_shift_fwd
statement:
theorem rayCount_shift_fwd {M : Mesh} {b d : Point} {ε : ℚ} (hε : 0 < ε)
    (hclear : ∀ (u : Fin M.size) (t : ℚ), 0 < t → t ≤ ε → lineAt b d t ∉ triangleSet M[u]) :
    RayCount M (lineAt b d ε) d = RayCount M b d
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have hiff : ∀ u : Fin M.size, MeetsRelint M (lineAt b d ε) d u ↔ MeetsRelint M b d u := by
    intro u
    constructor
    · rintro ⟨s, hs, hmem, hoff⟩
      rw [lineAt_lineAt] at hmem hoff
      exact ⟨ε + s, by linarith, hmem, hoff⟩
    · rintro ⟨s, hs, hmem, hoff⟩
      have hsε : ε < s := by
        by_contra hc
        push_neg at hc
        exact hclear u s hs hc hmem
      refine ⟨s - ε, by linarith, ?_, ?_⟩ <;>
        rw [lineAt_lineAt, show ε + (s - ε) = s by ring] <;> assumption
  unfold RayCount
  refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun u _ => ?_)
  by_cases h : MeetsRelint M b d u
  · rw [if_pos ((hiff u).mpr h), if_pos h]
  · rw [if_neg (fun hc => h ((hiff u).mp hc)), if_neg h]

name: rayCount_shift_bwd
statement:
theorem rayCount_shift_bwd {M : Mesh} (i : Fin M.size) {b d : Point} {ε : ℚ} (hε : 0 < ε)
    (hbi : b ∈ triangleSet M[i]) (hbe : b ∉ edgeSet M[i])
    (hbo : ∀ u : Fin M.size, u ≠ i → b ∉ triangleSet M[u])
    (hcar : dotQ (Proof.MeshIntersectJump.faceNormal M[i]) b = detOrigin M[i])
    (hκ : dotQ (Proof.MeshIntersectJump.faceNormal M[i]) d ≠ 0)
    (hclear : ∀ (u : Fin M.size) (t : ℚ), t ≠ 0 → |t| ≤ ε → lineAt b d t ∉ triangleSet M[u]) :
    RayCount M (lineAt b d (-ε)) d
      = RayCount M b d + qsign (dotQ (Proof.MeshIntersectJump.faceNormal M[i]) d)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have hi_new : MeetsRelint M (lineAt b d (-ε)) d i := by
    refine ⟨ε, hε, ?_, ?_⟩ <;>
      rw [lineAt_lineAt, show -ε + ε = 0 by ring, Proof.WellFormedCheckNormal.lineAt_zero]
    · exact hbi
    · exact hbe
  have hi_old : ¬ MeetsRelint M b d i := by
    rintro ⟨s, hs, hmem, _⟩
    exact face_line_off i hcar hκ (ne_of_gt hs) hmem
  have hiff : ∀ u : Fin M.size, u ≠ i →
      (MeetsRelint M (lineAt b d (-ε)) d u ↔ MeetsRelint M b d u) := by
    intro u hu
    constructor
    · rintro ⟨s, hs, hmem, hoff⟩
      rw [lineAt_lineAt] at hmem hoff
      rcases lt_trichotomy (-ε + s) 0 with h | h | h
      · exact absurd hmem (hclear u _ (ne_of_lt h) (by rw [abs_of_neg h]; linarith))
      · rw [h, Proof.WellFormedCheckNormal.lineAt_zero] at hmem
        exact absurd hmem (hbo u hu)
      · exact ⟨-ε + s, h, hmem, hoff⟩
    · rintro ⟨s, hs, hmem, hoff⟩
      refine ⟨ε + s, by linarith, ?_, ?_⟩ <;>
        rw [lineAt_lineAt, show -ε + (ε + s) = s by ring] <;> assumption
  unfold RayCount
  have key : (∑ u : Fin M.size, if MeetsRelint M (lineAt b d (-ε)) d u then
        qsign (dotQ (Proof.MeshIntersectJump.faceNormal M[u]) d) else 0)
      - (∑ u : Fin M.size, if MeetsRelint M b d u then
        qsign (dotQ (Proof.MeshIntersectJump.faceNormal M[u]) d) else 0)
      = qsign (dotQ (Proof.MeshIntersectJump.faceNormal M[i]) d) := by
    rw [← Finset.sum_sub_distrib]
    refine (Finset.sum_eq_single i ?_ ?_).trans ?_
    · intro u _ hu
      by_cases h : MeetsRelint M b d u
      · rw [if_pos ((hiff u hu).mpr h), if_pos h, sub_self]
      · rw [if_neg (fun hc => h ((hiff u hu).mp hc)), if_neg h, sub_self]
    · intro h; exact absurd (Finset.mem_univ i) h
    · rw [if_pos hi_new, if_neg hi_old, sub_zero]
  linarith

name: germValue_of_cast
statement:
theorem germValue_of_cast {M : Mesh} (hcyc : IsClosedOrientedSurface M)
    (hnpo : NoPlaneThroughOrigin M) (hns : NoFaceInteriorContact M) (i : Fin M.size)
    {d : Point}
    (hbo : ∀ u : Fin M.size, u ≠ i → baryPt M[i] ∉ triangleSet M[u])
    (hclean : ∀ (u : Fin M.size) (s : ℚ), 0 < s → lineAt (baryPt M[i]) d s ∉ edgeSet M[u])
    (hκ : dotQ (Proof.MeshIntersectJump.faceNormal M[i]) d ≠ 0) :
    germValue M i (qsign (dotQ (Proof.MeshIntersectJump.faceNormal M[i]) d))
        = RayCount M (baryPt M[i]) d ∧
    germValue M i (-(qsign (dotQ (Proof.MeshIntersectJump.faceNormal M[i]) d)))
        = RayCount M (baryPt M[i]) d
          + qsign (dotQ (Proof.MeshIntersectJump.faceNormal M[i]) d)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  set n := Proof.MeshIntersectJump.faceNormal M[i] with hn
  set b := baryPt M[i] with hb
  set κ := dotQ n d with hκdef
  have hcar : dotQ n b = detOrigin M[i] := baryPt_on_plane M[i]
  obtain ⟨hbi, hbe⟩ := baryPt_relint hnpo i
  obtain ⟨ε₀, hε₀, hclear₀⟩ := bary_arm_clear hnpo i d hκ hbo
  set ε := ε₀ / 2 with hεdef
  have hε : 0 < ε := by rw [hεdef]; linarith
  have hεle : ε ≤ ε₀ := by rw [hεdef]; linarith
  have hd_ne : d ≠ 0 := by
    intro h; exact hκ (by rw [hκdef, h]; exact Proof.WellFormedCheckNormal.dotQ_zero_right n)
  
  set dm : Point := (-1 : ℚ) • d with hdm
  have hdmκ : dotQ n dm = -κ := by
    rw [hdm, Proof.MeshIntersectRay.dotQ_smul_right, hκdef]; ring
  have hκm : dotQ n dm ≠ 0 := by rw [hdmκ]; exact neg_ne_zero.mpr hκ
  have hdmdm : ((-1 : ℚ) • dm) = d := by
    funext k; simp only [hdm, Pi.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul]; ring
  
  have hfree_p : ∀ (u : Fin M.size) (s : ℚ), 0 < s → s < 2 * ε → lineAt b d s ∉ triangleSet M[u] :=
    fun u s hs hlt => hclear₀ u s (ne_of_gt hs) (by rw [abs_of_pos hs]; rw [hεdef] at hlt; linarith)
  have hfree_m : ∀ (u : Fin M.size) (s : ℚ), 0 < s → s < 2 * ε →
      lineAt b dm s ∉ triangleSet M[u] := by
    intro u s hs hlt
    rw [hdm, lineAt_neg_dir]
    exact hclear₀ u (-s) (by linarith) (by rw [abs_neg, abs_of_pos hs]; rw [hεdef] at hlt; linarith)
  have hfree_mm : ∀ (u : Fin M.size) (s : ℚ), 0 < s → s < 2 * ε →
      lineAt b ((-1 : ℚ) • dm) s ∉ triangleSet M[u] := by
    intro u s hs hlt; rw [hdmdm]; exact hfree_p u s hs hlt
  
  obtain ⟨Δp, hΔppos, hΔp⟩ := seg_arm_off_triangles hnpo i hκ hbo hε hε hfree_p hfree_m
  obtain ⟨Δm, hΔmpos, hΔm⟩ := seg_arm_off_triangles hnpo i hκm hbo hε hε hfree_m hfree_mm
  
  have hQoff_p : ∀ u : Fin M.size, lineAt b d ε ∉ triangleSet M[u] :=
    fun u => hclear₀ u ε (ne_of_gt hε) (by rw [abs_of_pos hε]; exact hεle)
  have hQoff_m : ∀ u : Fin M.size, lineAt b dm ε ∉ triangleSet M[u] := by
    intro u
    rw [hdm, lineAt_neg_dir]
    exact hclear₀ u (-ε) (by linarith) (by rw [abs_neg, abs_of_pos hε]; exact hεle)
  have hQn_p : dotQ n (lineAt b d ε) = detOrigin M[i] + ε * κ := by
    rw [Proof.WellFormedCheckNormal.dotQ_lineAt, hcar, hκdef]
  have hQn_m : dotQ n (lineAt b dm ε) = detOrigin M[i] + ε * (dotQ n dm) := by
    rw [Proof.WellFormedCheckNormal.dotQ_lineAt, hcar]
  
  have hd_fc_p : ∀ (u : Fin M.size) (t : ℚ), 0 < t → lineAt (lineAt b d ε) d t ∉ edgeSet M[u] := by
    intro u t ht
    rw [lineAt_lineAt]
    exact hclean u (ε + t) (by linarith)
  have hd_fc_m : ∀ (u : Fin M.size) (t : ℚ), 0 < t →
      lineAt (lineAt b dm ε) d t ∉ edgeSet M[u] := by
    intro u t ht
    rw [hdm, lineAt_neg_dir, lineAt_lineAt]
    rcases lt_trichotomy (-ε + t) 0 with h | h | h
    · intro hmem
      exact hclear₀ u (-ε + t) (ne_of_lt h) (by rw [abs_of_neg h]; linarith)
        (Proof.MeshIntersectRayClassify.edgeSet_subset_triangleSet M[u] hmem)
    · rw [h, Proof.WellFormedCheckNormal.lineAt_zero]
      by_cases hui : u = i
      · rw [hui]; exact hbe
      · intro hmem
        exact hbo u hui (Proof.MeshIntersectRayClassify.edgeSet_subset_triangleSet M[u] hmem)
    · exact hclean u (-ε + t) h
  
  obtain ⟨Pp, _hG1p, hwindp, hadmp⟩ :=
    barySample_admPt_core hcyc hnpo hns i (qsign κ) (Proof.WellFormedCheckNormal.qsign_ne_zero hκ)
      hκdef (Proof.MeshIntersectRayClassifyLocal.qsign_self_pos hκ) hε hε rfl hQn_p hQoff_p
      hΔppos hΔp d hd_ne hd_fc_p
  
  obtain ⟨Pm, _hG1m, hwindm, hadmm⟩ :=
    barySample_admPt_core hcyc hnpo hns i (-(qsign κ))
      (by rcases Proof.WellFormedCheckNormal.qsign_ne_zero hκ with h | h <;> rw [h] <;> simp)
      rfl (by rw [hdmκ]; push_cast
              have := Proof.MeshIntersectRayClassifyLocal.qsign_self_pos hκ
              push_cast at this; nlinarith [this])
      hε hε rfl hQn_m hQoff_m hΔmpos hΔm d hd_ne hd_fc_m
  constructor
  · rw [germValue_eq M hcyc hnpo hns hadmp, hwindp]
    exact rayCount_shift_fwd hε (fun u t ht htle =>
      hclear₀ u t (ne_of_gt ht) (by rw [abs_of_pos ht]; linarith))
  · rw [germValue_eq M hcyc hnpo hns hadmm, hwindm, hdm, lineAt_neg_dir]
    exact rayCount_shift_bwd i hε hbi hbe hbo hcar hκ (fun u t ht htle =>
      hclear₀ u t ht (le_trans htle hεle))

name: fwdQueryOK_buildBVH
statement:
theorem fwdQueryOK_buildBVH (boxes : Array Impl.BVH.Box) :
    FwdQueryOK (Impl.BVH.buildBVH boxes) boxes where
  nodup
proof:
:= fun x dd => Proof.BVH.rayQueryFwd_nodup boxes x dd
  mem_lt := fun x dd k hk => Proof.BVH.rayQueryFwd_mem_lt boxes x dd k (Array.mem_toList.mp hk)
  complete := fun x dd k hk hmeet => Array.mem_toList.mpr
    (Proof.BVH.rayQueryFwd_sound boxes x dd k hk (by rw [arr_getD _ _ _ hk]; exact hmeet))

name: fwdQueryOK_buildBVHM
statement:
theorem fwdQueryOK_buildBVHM (boxes : Array Impl.BVH.Box) :
    FwdQueryOK (Impl.BVH.buildBVHM boxes) boxes where
  nodup
proof:
:= fun x dd => Proof.BVH.rayQueryFwdM_nodup boxes x dd
  mem_lt := fun x dd k hk => Proof.BVH.rayQueryFwdM_mem_lt boxes x dd k (Array.mem_toList.mp hk)
  complete := fun x dd k hk hmeet => Array.mem_toList.mpr
    (Proof.BVH.rayQueryFwdM_sound boxes x dd k hk (by rw [arr_getD _ _ _ hk]; exact hmeet))

name: fwdQueryOK_faceBVH
statement:
theorem fwdQueryOK_faceBVH (W : Array PFace) :
    FwdQueryOK (faceBVH W) (W.map (fun f => faceBoxOf f))
proof:
:=
  fwdQueryOK_buildBVH _

name: windingRayDir_some_eq_rayCount'
statement:
theorem windingRayDir_some_eq_rayCount' {MB : Mesh} (hnpo : NoPlaneThroughOrigin MB)
    {bvh : Impl.BVH.BVH}
    (hq : FwdQueryOK bvh ((prepare (materialize MB)).map (fun f => faceBoxOf f)))
    (Q d : Point) (hint : IntDir d) {w : ℤ}
    (hsome : windingRayDir bvh (prepare (materialize MB)) (ofPoint Q) (ofPoint d) = some w) :
    w = RayCount MB Q d ∧
    (∀ (u : Fin MB.size) (s : ℚ), 0 < s → lineAt Q d s ∉ edgeSet MB[u]) ∧
    (∀ (u : Fin MB.size) (s : ℚ), 0 ≤ s → lineAt Q d s ∈ triangleSet MB[u] →
      ¬ (dotQ (Proof.MeshIntersectJump.faceNormal MB[u]) d = 0 ∧
         dotQ (Proof.MeshIntersectJump.faceNormal MB[u]) Q = detOrigin MB[u]))
proof:
:= by
  classical
  rw [MeshIntersectWedge.windingRayDir_eq_old _ _
    (MeshIntersectWedge.materialize_wedgeOK MB)] at hsome
  simp only [MeshIntersectWedge.windingRayDirOld,
    show (⟨(ofPoint d).x.num, (ofPoint d).y.num, (ofPoint d).z.num⟩ : I3)
      = numI3 (ofPoint d) from rfl] at hsome
  rw [← Array.foldl_toList] at hsome
  set W := prepare (materialize MB) with hW
  have hWsize : W.size = MB.size := prepare_size MB
  set boxes : Array Impl.BVH.Box := W.map (fun f => faceBoxOf f) with hboxes
  have hboxsize : boxes.size = MB.size := by rw [hboxes, Array.size_map, hWsize]
  set xpt : Impl.BVH.Pt := ⟨(ofPoint Q).x, (ofPoint Q).y, (ofPoint Q).z⟩ with hxpt
  set dpt : Impl.BVH.Pt := ⟨(ofPoint d).x, (ofPoint d).y, (ofPoint d).z⟩ with hdpt
  set hits := Impl.BVH.rayQueryFwd bvh xpt dpt with hhits
  obtain ⟨hallsome, hwsum⟩ := Proof.MeshIntersectRayClassify.foldl_body_some hits.toList 0 w hsome
  set σf : Fin MB.size → ℤ := fun u =>
    if MeetsRelint MB Q d u then qsign (dotQ (Proof.MeshIntersectJump.faceNormal MB[u]) d) else 0
    with hσf
  have hgood : ∀ (i : ℕ) (hi : i < MB.size), PFaceGood (W.getD i default) MB[i] :=
    fun i hi => prepare_getD_fields MB i hi
  have hσface : ∀ (i : ℕ) (hi : i < MB.size) (c₀ : ℤ),
      rayFaceCross (W.getD i default) (toH4 (ofPoint Q)) (numI3 (ofPoint d)) = some c₀ →
      c₀ = σf ⟨i, hi⟩ := by
    intro i hi c₀ hc₀
    have hsig := (Proof.MeshIntersectRayClassify.rayFaceCross_eq_sigma (MB := MB) (u := ⟨i, hi⟩)
      (f := W.getD i default) (hnpo ⟨i, hi⟩) Q d hint (hgood i hi)).1 c₀ hc₀
    simpa only [hσf] using hsig.1
  
  have hqin : ∀ (u : Fin MB.size) (s : ℚ), 0 ≤ s → lineAt Q d s ∈ triangleSet MB[u] →
      u.val ∈ hits.toList := by
    intro u s hsnn hmem
    exact hq.complete xpt dpt u.val (by rw [hboxsize]; exact u.isLt)
      (tri_meets_box_fwd u Q d s hsnn hmem)
  have hnohit : ∀ (u : Fin MB.size), u.val ∉ hits.toList →
      ∀ s : ℚ, 0 ≤ s → lineAt Q d s ∉ triangleSet MB[u] :=
    fun u hu s hsnn hmem => hu (hqin u s hsnn hmem)
  have hσ0 : ∀ (u : Fin MB.size), u.val ∉ hits.toList → σf u = 0 := by
    intro u hu
    simp only [hσf]
    rw [if_neg]
    rintro ⟨s, hspos, hmem, _⟩
    exact hnohit u hu s (le_of_lt hspos) hmem
  have hclean : ∀ (u : Fin MB.size) (s : ℚ), 0 < s → lineAt Q d s ∉ edgeSet MB[u] := by
    intro u s hspos hs
    by_cases hu : u.val ∈ hits.toList
    · obtain ⟨c, hcsome⟩ := hallsome u.val hu
      exact ((Proof.MeshIntersectRayClassify.rayFaceCross_eq_sigma (MB := MB) (u := u)
        (f := W.getD u.val default) (hnpo u) Q d hint (hgood u.val u.isLt)).1 c hcsome).2 s hspos hs
    · exact hnohit u hu s (le_of_lt hspos)
        (Proof.MeshIntersectRayClassify.edgeSet_subset_triangleSet _ hs)
  have htrans : ∀ (u : Fin MB.size) (s : ℚ), 0 ≤ s → lineAt Q d s ∈ triangleSet MB[u] →
      ¬ (dotQ (Proof.MeshIntersectJump.faceNormal MB[u]) d = 0 ∧
         dotQ (Proof.MeshIntersectJump.faceNormal MB[u]) Q = detOrigin MB[u]) := by
    rintro u s hsnn hmem ⟨hd0, hQ0⟩
    obtain ⟨c, hc⟩ := hallsome u.val (hqin u s hsnn hmem)
    have hnone := (Proof.MeshIntersectRayClassify.rayFaceCross_eq_sigma (MB := MB) (u := u)
      (f := W.getD u.val default) (hnpo u) Q d hint (hgood u.val u.isLt)).2.mpr
      (Or.inl ⟨hd0, hQ0⟩)
    rw [hnone] at hc
    exact Option.noConfusion hc
  refine ⟨?_, hclean, htrans⟩
  rcases Nat.eq_zero_or_pos MB.size with hz | hpos
  · have hemptyL : hits.toList = [] := by
      rw [List.eq_nil_iff_forall_not_mem]
      intro i hi
      have := hq.mem_lt xpt dpt i hi
      rw [hboxsize, hz] at this
      exact absurd this (Nat.not_lt_zero i)
    rw [hwsum, hemptyL, List.map_nil, List.sum_nil, add_zero, RayCount]
    symm
    apply Finset.sum_eq_zero
    intro u _
    exact absurd (lt_of_lt_of_eq u.isLt hz) (Nat.not_lt_zero u.val)
  · have hnodup := hq.nodup xpt dpt
    have hltMB : ∀ i ∈ hits.toList, i < MB.size := by
      intro i hi; have := hq.mem_lt xpt dpt i hi; rwa [hboxsize] at this
    set g : ℕ → ℤ := fun i => if h : i < MB.size then σf ⟨i, h⟩ else 0 with hg
    have hgσ : ∀ u : Fin MB.size, g u.val = σf u := by
      intro u; simp only [hg, u.isLt, dif_pos]
    have hmapg : hits.toList.map (fun i => (rayFaceCross (W.getD i default) (toH4 (ofPoint Q))
        (numI3 (ofPoint d))).getD 0) = hits.toList.map g := by
      apply List.map_congr_left
      intro i hi
      have hi' := hltMB i hi
      obtain ⟨c, hcsome⟩ := hallsome i hi
      have hval : (rayFaceCross (W.getD i default) (toH4 (ofPoint Q))
          (numI3 (ofPoint d))).getD 0 = σf ⟨i, hi'⟩ := by
        rw [hcsome, Option.getD_some]; exact hσface i hi' c hcsome
      rw [hval, hg]; simp only [hi', dif_pos]
    rw [hwsum, hmapg, zero_add]
    have hsubset : hits.toList.toFinset ⊆ Finset.range MB.size := by
      intro i hi
      rw [List.mem_toFinset] at hi
      exact Finset.mem_range.mpr (hltMB i hi)
    have hzero : ∀ i ∈ Finset.range MB.size, i ∉ hits.toList.toFinset → g i = 0 := by
      intro i hi hni
      rw [Finset.mem_range] at hi
      simp only [hg, hi, dif_pos]
      exact hσ0 ⟨i, hi⟩ (by rwa [List.mem_toFinset] at hni)
    have hlist : (hits.toList.map g).sum = ∑ i ∈ hits.toList.toFinset, g i :=
      (List.sum_toFinset g hnodup).symm
    rw [hlist, Finset.sum_subset hsubset hzero, ← Fin.sum_univ_eq_sum_range g MB.size, RayCount]
    exact Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun u _ => by rw [hgσ u])

name: winding_none_face'
statement:
theorem winding_none_face' {MB : Mesh} {bvh : Impl.BVH.BVH}
    (hq : FwdQueryOK bvh ((prepare (materialize MB)).map (fun f => faceBoxOf f)))
    (Q : Point) (d : P3)
    (hnone : windingRayDir bvh (prepare (materialize MB)) (ofPoint Q) d = none) :
    ∃ u : Fin MB.size,
      rayFaceCross ((prepare (materialize MB)).getD u.val default) (toH4 (ofPoint Q))
        (numI3 d) = none
proof:
:= by
  rw [MeshIntersectWedge.windingRayDir_eq_old _ _
    (MeshIntersectWedge.materialize_wedgeOK MB)] at hnone
  set W := prepare (materialize MB) with hW
  have hWsize : W.size = MB.size := prepare_size MB
  simp only [MeshIntersectWedge.windingRayDirOld,
    show (⟨d.x.num, d.y.num, d.z.num⟩ : I3) = numI3 d from rfl] at hnone
  rw [← Array.foldl_toList] at hnone
  set boxes : Array Impl.BVH.Box := W.map (fun f => faceBoxOf f) with hboxes
  have hboxsize : boxes.size = MB.size := by rw [hboxes, Array.size_map, hWsize]
  set xpt : Impl.BVH.Pt := ⟨(ofPoint Q).x, (ofPoint Q).y, (ofPoint Q).z⟩ with hxpt
  set dpt : Impl.BVH.Pt := ⟨d.x, d.y, d.z⟩ with hdpt
  obtain ⟨i, hi_mem, hi_none⟩ :=
    Proof.MeshIntersectRayClassifyGen.foldl_body_none_witness _ 0 hnone
  have hiMB : i < MB.size := by
    have := hq.mem_lt xpt dpt i hi_mem; rwa [hboxsize] at this
  exact ⟨⟨i, hiMB⟩, hi_none⟩

name: exists_good_dir'
statement:
theorem exists_good_dir' {MB : Mesh} (hnpo : NoPlaneThroughOrigin MB) {bvh : Impl.BVH.BVH}
    (hq : FwdQueryOK bvh ((prepare (materialize MB)).map (fun f => faceBoxOf f)))
    (Q : Point) :
    ∃ j : ℕ, j < 8 * (prepare (materialize MB)).size + 8 ∧
      windingRayDir bvh (prepare (materialize MB)) (ofPoint Q) (rayDirAt j) ≠ none
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have hWsize : (prepare (materialize MB)).size = MB.size := prepare_size MB
  set fuel := 8 * (prepare (materialize MB)).size + 8 with hfuel
  set Bad := (Finset.range fuel).filter (fun j =>
    windingRayDir bvh (prepare (materialize MB)) (ofPoint Q) (rayDirAt j) = none) with hBad
  have hBadUnion : Bad ⊆ Finset.univ.biUnion (fun u : Fin MB.size =>
      (Finset.range fuel).filter (fun j =>
        rayFaceCross ((prepare (materialize MB)).getD u.val default)
          (toH4 (ofPoint Q)) (numI3 (rayDirAt j)) = none)) := by
    intro j hj
    rw [hBad, Finset.mem_filter] at hj
    obtain ⟨u, hu⟩ := winding_none_face' hq Q (rayDirAt j) hj.2
    rw [Finset.mem_biUnion]
    exact ⟨u, Finset.mem_univ u, Finset.mem_filter.mpr ⟨hj.1, hu⟩⟩
  have hcardBad : Bad.card ≤ 8 * MB.size := by
    calc Bad.card ≤ _ := Finset.card_le_card hBadUnion
      _ ≤ ∑ _u : Fin MB.size, 8 :=
          le_trans (Finset.card_biUnion_le)
            (Finset.sum_le_sum (fun u _ =>
              Proof.MeshIntersectRayClassifyGen.badFace_card_le_eight hnpo Q u
                (Finset.range fuel)))
      _ = 8 * MB.size := by
          rw [Finset.sum_const, Finset.card_univ, Fintype.card_fin, smul_eq_mul, Nat.mul_comm]
  have hCcard : (Finset.range fuel).card = 8 * MB.size + 8 := by
    rw [Finset.card_range, hfuel, hWsize]
  have hExists : ∃ j ∈ Finset.range fuel, j ∉ Bad := by
    by_contra h
    push_neg at h
    have hsub : Finset.range fuel ⊆ Bad := fun j hj => h j hj
    have := Finset.card_le_card hsub
    omega
  obtain ⟨j, hjC, hjBad⟩ := hExists
  refine ⟨j, Finset.mem_range.mp hjC, fun hnone => ?_⟩
  exact hjBad (by rw [hBad]; exact Finset.mem_filter.mpr ⟨hjC, hnone⟩)

name: dotI_nrmI_pos_mul
statement:
theorem dotI_nrmI_pos_mul {f : PFace} {t : Triangle} (hgood : PFaceGood f t) {d : Point}
    (hint : IntDir d) :
    ∃ c : ℚ, 0 < c ∧
      ((dotI f.nrmI (numI3 (ofPoint d)) : ℤ) : ℚ)
        = c * dotQ (Proof.MeshIntersectJump.faceNormal t) d
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨hr0, hr1, hr2⟩ := Proof.MeshIntersectRayClassify.pfaceGood_repr hgood
  obtain ⟨hw0, _, _, _⟩ := Proof.MeshIntersectRayClassify.repr4_coord hr0
  obtain ⟨hw1, _, _, _⟩ := Proof.MeshIntersectRayClassify.repr4_coord hr1
  obtain ⟨hw2, _, _, _⟩ := Proof.MeshIntersectRayClassify.repr4_coord hr2
  obtain ⟨_, _, _, _, _, _, hnrmIe, _, _, _, _⟩ := hgood
  set cN : ℤ := f.h1.w * f.h0.w * (f.h2.w * f.h0.w) with hcN_def
  have hcNpos : 0 < cN := mul_pos (mul_pos hw1 hw0) (mul_pos hw2 hw0)
  refine ⟨(cN : ℚ), by exact_mod_cast hcNpos, ?_⟩
  have hidi : i3Q (numI3 (ofPoint d)) = d := Proof.MeshIntersectRayClassify.i3Q_numI3_ofPoint hint
  have hnrm : i3Q f.nrmI = ((cN : ℤ) : ℚ) • Proof.MeshIntersectJump.faceNormal t := by
    rw [hnrmIe, i3Q_crossI, i3Q_hsub hr0 hr1, i3Q_hsub hr0 hr2,
      Proof.MeshIntersectClip.crossQ_smul_left, Proof.MeshIntersectClip.crossQ_smul_right,
      smul_smul, Proof.MeshIntersectJump.faceNormal, Proof.SimImplCover.psub_eq_sub,
      Proof.SimImplCover.psub_eq_sub]
    congr 1
    rw [hcN_def]; push_cast; ring
  rw [dotI_i3Q, hnrm, hidi, Proof.MeshIntersectSample.dotQ_smul_left]

name: faceSideWindings_eq
statement:
theorem faceSideWindings_eq {M : Mesh} (hcyc : IsClosedOrientedSurface M)
    (hnpo : NoPlaneThroughOrigin M) (hns : NoFaceInteriorContact M) {bvh : Impl.BVH.BVH}
    (hq : FwdQueryOK bvh ((prepare (materialize M)).map (fun f => faceBoxOf f)))
    (hbary_off : ∀ (i : ℕ) (hi : i < M.size), ∀ u : Fin M.size, u.val ≠ i →
      baryPt (M[i]'hi) ∉ triangleSet M[u])
    (i : ℕ) (hi : i < M.size) :
    Impl.WellFormedCheck.faceSideWindings bvh (prepare (materialize M)) i
      = some (germValue M ⟨i, hi⟩ 1, germValue M ⟨i, hi⟩ (-1))
proof:
:= by
  classical
  set fi : Fin M.size := ⟨i, hi⟩ with hfi
  set W := prepare (materialize M) with hW
  have hWsize : W.size = M.size := prepare_size M
  set pf := W.getD i default with hpf
  set n := Proof.MeshIntersectJump.faceNormal M[fi] with hn
  set b := baryPt M[fi] with hb
  have hgood : PFaceGood pf M[fi] := prepare_getD_fields M i hi
  have hcar : dotQ n b = detOrigin M[fi] := baryPt_on_plane M[fi]
  obtain ⟨hbi, hbe⟩ := baryPt_relint hnpo fi
  have hbo : ∀ u : Fin M.size, u ≠ fi → b ∉ triangleSet M[u] :=
    fun u hu => hbary_off i hi u (fun h => hu (Fin.ext h))
  
  set w' : ℤ := (((pf.h0.w.natAbs.lcm pf.h1.w.natAbs).lcm pf.h2.w.natAbs : ℕ) : ℤ) with hw'
  set qh : Impl.MeshIntersect.H4 :=
    ⟨pf.h0.x * (w' / pf.h0.w) + pf.h1.x * (w' / pf.h1.w) + pf.h2.x * (w' / pf.h2.w),
     pf.h0.y * (w' / pf.h0.w) + pf.h1.y * (w' / pf.h1.w) + pf.h2.y * (w' / pf.h2.w),
     pf.h0.z * (w' / pf.h0.w) + pf.h1.z * (w' / pf.h1.w) + pf.h2.z * (w' / pf.h2.w),
     3 * w'⟩ with hqhdef
  have hrepr : MeshIntersectWedge.H4Repr qh (ofPoint b) := by
    obtain ⟨_, _, _, hh0, hh1, hh2, _, _, _, _, _⟩ := hgood
    have r0 : MeshIntersectWedge.H4Repr pf.h0 (ofPoint M[fi].v₀) := by
      rw [hh0]; exact MeshIntersectWedge.toH4_H4Repr _
    have r1 : MeshIntersectWedge.H4Repr pf.h1 (ofPoint M[fi].v₁) := by
      rw [hh1]; exact MeshIntersectWedge.toH4_H4Repr _
    have r2 : MeshIntersectWedge.H4Repr pf.h2 (ofPoint M[fi].v₂) := by
      rw [hh2]; exact MeshIntersectWedge.toH4_H4Repr _
    have hbary := MeshIntersectWedge.baryH_repr r0 r1 r2 hw'
    rw [baryS_ofPoint] at hbary
    exact hbary
  
  set att : ℕ → Option (ℤ × ℤ) := fun j =>
    match Impl.MeshIntersect.windingRayDirH bvh W qh (rayDirAt j) with
    | none => none
    | some w =>
      if 0 < dotI pf.nrmI ⟨(rayDirAt j).x.num, (rayDirAt j).y.num, (rayDirAt j).z.num⟩ then
        some (w, w + 1)
      else if dotI pf.nrmI ⟨(rayDirAt j).x.num, (rayDirAt j).y.num, (rayDirAt j).z.num⟩ < 0 then
        some (w - 1, w)
      else none with hatt
  have hbody : Impl.WellFormedCheck.faceSideWindings bvh W i
      = searchFirst att 0 (16 * W.size + 16) := rfl
  
  have hHeq : ∀ j : ℕ, Impl.MeshIntersect.windingRayDirH bvh W qh (rayDirAt j)
      = windingRayDir bvh W (ofPoint b) (ofPoint (mdir (j : ℚ))) := by
    intro j
    rw [MeshIntersectWedge.windingRayDirH_eq bvh W (MeshIntersectWedge.materialize_wedgeOK M)
      hrepr (rayDirAt j), rayDirAt_eq_ofPoint]
  have hsgeq : ∀ j : ℕ,
      (⟨(rayDirAt j).x.num, (rayDirAt j).y.num, (rayDirAt j).z.num⟩ : I3)
        = numI3 (ofPoint (mdir (j : ℚ))) := by
    intro j
    rw [show (⟨(rayDirAt j).x.num, (rayDirAt j).y.num, (rayDirAt j).z.num⟩ : I3)
        = numI3 (rayDirAt j) from rfl, rayDirAt_eq_ofPoint]
  
  have main : ∀ (j : ℕ) (w : ℤ), Impl.MeshIntersect.windingRayDirH bvh W qh (rayDirAt j) = some w →
      dotI pf.nrmI ⟨(rayDirAt j).x.num, (rayDirAt j).y.num, (rayDirAt j).z.num⟩ ≠ 0 ∧
      (0 < dotI pf.nrmI ⟨(rayDirAt j).x.num, (rayDirAt j).y.num, (rayDirAt j).z.num⟩ →
        ((w, w + 1) : ℤ × ℤ) = (germValue M fi 1, germValue M fi (-1))) ∧
      (dotI pf.nrmI ⟨(rayDirAt j).x.num, (rayDirAt j).y.num, (rayDirAt j).z.num⟩ < 0 →
        ((w - 1, w) : ℤ × ℤ) = (germValue M fi 1, germValue M fi (-1))) := by
    intro j w hw
    set d : Point := mdir (j : ℚ) with hd
    have hint : IntDir d := by
      show P3Int (ofPoint (mdir (j : ℚ)))
      rw [← rayDirAt_eq_ofPoint]; exact Proof.MeshIntersectRayClassify.p3Int_rayDirAt j
    have hsome : windingRayDir bvh W (ofPoint b) (ofPoint d) = some w := by
      rw [← hHeq j]; exact hw
    obtain ⟨hval, hclean, htrans⟩ :=
      windingRayDir_some_eq_rayCount' hnpo hq b d hint hsome
    have hκ : dotQ n d ≠ 0 := by
      intro h0
      exact htrans fi 0 le_rfl (by rw [Proof.WellFormedCheckNormal.lineAt_zero]; exact hbi)
        ⟨h0, hcar⟩
    obtain ⟨c, hcpos, hcast⟩ := dotI_nrmI_pos_mul hgood hint
    rw [← hn] at hcast
    rw [hsgeq j]
    have hsg0 : (dotI pf.nrmI (numI3 (ofPoint d)) : ℤ) ≠ 0 := by
      intro h0
      apply hκ
      have hz : (0 : ℚ) = c * dotQ n d := by rw [← hcast, h0]; norm_num
      rcases mul_eq_zero.mp hz.symm with h | h
      · exact absurd h (ne_of_gt hcpos)
      · exact h
    obtain ⟨hgp, hgm⟩ := germValue_of_cast hcyc hnpo hns fi hbo hclean hκ
    rw [← hn, ← hb] at hgp hgm
    refine ⟨hsg0, fun hpos => ?_, fun hneg => ?_⟩
    · 
      have hdpos : 0 < dotQ n d := by
        have h1 : (0 : ℚ) < c * dotQ n d := by rw [← hcast]; exact_mod_cast hpos
        by_contra hc
        push_neg at hc
        nlinarith [h1, hcpos, hc]
      rw [qsign_of_pos hdpos] at hgp hgm
      rw [Prod.mk.injEq]
      exact ⟨by rw [hgp, hval], by rw [hgm, hval]⟩
    · 
      have hdneg : dotQ n d < 0 := by
        have h1 : (c * dotQ n d : ℚ) < 0 := by rw [← hcast]; exact_mod_cast hneg
        by_contra hc
        push_neg at hc
        nlinarith [h1, hcpos, hc]
      rw [qsign_of_neg hdneg] at hgp hgm
      rw [neg_neg] at hgm
      rw [Prod.mk.injEq]
      exact ⟨by rw [hgm, hval]; ring, by rw [hgp, hval]⟩
  
  obtain ⟨j, hjlt, hjne⟩ := exists_good_dir' hnpo hq b
  have hattne : att j ≠ none := by
    rcases hwj : Impl.MeshIntersect.windingRayDirH bvh W qh (rayDirAt j) with _ | w
    · exact absurd (by rw [hHeq j, ← rayDirAt_eq_ofPoint] at hwj; exact hwj) hjne
    · obtain ⟨hsg0, _, _⟩ := main j w hwj
      simp only [hatt, hwj]
      rcases lt_trichotomy (dotI pf.nrmI
        (⟨(rayDirAt j).x.num, (rayDirAt j).y.num, (rayDirAt j).z.num⟩ : I3)) 0 with h | h | h
      · rw [if_neg (not_lt.mpr h.le), if_pos h]; exact fun hc => Option.noConfusion hc
      · exact absurd h hsg0
      · rw [if_pos h]; exact fun hc => Option.noConfusion hc
  obtain ⟨z, hz⟩ := Proof.MeshIntersectRayClassifyGen.searchFirst_success (attempt := att)
    (fuel := 16 * W.size + 16) (s := 0) j (Nat.zero_le _)
    (by rw [hWsize]; rw [hWsize] at hjlt; omega) hattne
  
  obtain ⟨j', hj'⟩ := Proof.MeshIntersectRayClassifyGen.searchFirst_some hz
  rw [hbody, hz]
  rcases hwj' : Impl.MeshIntersect.windingRayDirH bvh W qh (rayDirAt j') with _ | w
  · rw [hatt] at hj'; simp only [hwj'] at hj'; exact absurd hj' (by simp)
  · obtain ⟨_, hposcase, hnegcase⟩ := main j' w hwj'
    rw [hatt] at hj'
    simp only [hwj'] at hj'
    by_cases hpos : 0 < dotI pf.nrmI
        (⟨(rayDirAt j').x.num, (rayDirAt j').y.num, (rayDirAt j').z.num⟩ : I3)
    · rw [if_pos hpos, Option.some.injEq] at hj'
      rw [← hj']; exact congrArg some (hposcase hpos)
    · rw [if_neg hpos] at hj'
      by_cases hneg : dotI pf.nrmI
          (⟨(rayDirAt j').x.num, (rayDirAt j').y.num, (rayDirAt j').z.num⟩ : I3) < 0
      · rw [if_pos hneg, Option.some.injEq] at hj'
        rw [← hj']; exact congrArg some (hnegcase hneg)
      · rw [if_neg hneg] at hj'; exact absurd hj' (by simp)

name: checkNormalCondPre_characterization
statement:
theorem checkNormalCondPre_characterization {M : Mesh} (hcyc : IsClosedOrientedSurface M)
    (hnpo : NoPlaneThroughOrigin M) (hns : NoFaceInteriorContact M) {bvh : Impl.BVH.BVH}
    (hq : FwdQueryOK bvh ((prepare (materialize M)).map (fun f => faceBoxOf f)))
    (hbary_off : ∀ (i : ℕ) (hi : i < M.size), ∀ u : Fin M.size, u.val ≠ i →
      baryPt (M[i]'hi) ∉ triangleSet M[u]) :
    Impl.WellFormedCheck.checkNormalCondPre (materialize M) (prepare (materialize M)) bvh = true
      ↔ ∀ (i : Fin M.size) (s : ℤ), s = 1 ∨ s = -1 →
          germValue M i s = 0 ∨ germValue M i s = 1
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have hsz : (materialize M).size = M.size := by unfold materialize; rw [Array.size_map]
  rw [show Impl.WellFormedCheck.checkNormalCondPre (materialize M) (prepare (materialize M)) bvh
      = (Array.range (materialize M).size).all (fun i =>
          match Impl.WellFormedCheck.faceSideWindings bvh (prepare (materialize M)) i with
          | some (wp, wm) => Impl.WellFormedCheck.okWinding wp && Impl.WellFormedCheck.okWinding wm
          | none => false) from rfl]
  rw [Array.all_eq_true_iff_forall_mem]
  have hmem : ∀ x : ℕ, x ∈ Array.range (materialize M).size ↔ x < M.size := by
    intro x
    rw [← Array.mem_toList, Array.toList_range, List.mem_range, hsz]
  have hkey : ∀ (i : ℕ) (hi : i < M.size),
      (match Impl.WellFormedCheck.faceSideWindings bvh (prepare (materialize M)) i with
        | some (wp, wm) => Impl.WellFormedCheck.okWinding wp && Impl.WellFormedCheck.okWinding wm
        | none => false) = true
      ↔ ((germValue M ⟨i, hi⟩ 1 = 0 ∨ germValue M ⟨i, hi⟩ 1 = 1)
        ∧ (germValue M ⟨i, hi⟩ (-1) = 0 ∨ germValue M ⟨i, hi⟩ (-1) = 1)) := by
    intro i hi
    rw [faceSideWindings_eq hcyc hnpo hns hq hbary_off i hi]
    rw [Bool.and_eq_true, okWinding_eq_true, okWinding_eq_true]
  constructor
  · intro hall i s hs
    have h := (hkey i.val i.isLt).mp (hall i.val ((hmem i.val).mpr i.isLt))
    rcases hs with rfl | rfl
    · exact h.1
    · exact h.2
  · intro hall i hi
    have hi' := (hmem i).mp hi
    exact (hkey i hi').mpr ⟨hall ⟨i, hi'⟩ 1 (Or.inl rfl), hall ⟨i, hi'⟩ (-1) (Or.inr rfl)⟩

name: coordAt_cast
statement:
theorem coordAt_cast (axis : Nat) (p : I3) (haxis : axis < 3) :
    ((coordAt axis p : Int) : ℚ) = decI p ⟨axis, haxis⟩
proof:
:= by
  unfold coordAt
  
  interval_cases axis
  · simp [decI]
  · simp [decI]
  · simp [decI]

name: dominantAxis_coord_ne_zero
statement:
theorem dominantAxis_coord_ne_zero (d : I3) (hd : isZeroI d = false) :
    coordAt (dominantAxis d) d ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  have hd' : d.x ≠ 0 ∨ d.y ≠ 0 ∨ d.z ≠ 0 := by
    simp only [isZeroI, Bool.and_eq_false_iff, beq_eq_false_iff_ne, ne_eq] at hd
    tauto
  simp only [dominantAxis, coordAt]
  split <;> split <;> simp_all <;> omega

name: dominantAxis_lt_three
statement: theorem dominantAxis_lt_three (d : I3) : dominantAxis d < 3
proof:
:= by
  simp only [dominantAxis]; split <;> [skip; split] <;> omega

name: decI_dominantCoord_ne_zero
statement:
theorem decI_dominantCoord_ne_zero (d : I3) (hd : isZeroI d = false)
    (hax : dominantAxis d < 3) :
    decI d ⟨dominantAxis d, hax⟩ ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [← coordAt_cast (dominantAxis d) d hax]
  exact_mod_cast dominantAxis_coord_ne_zero d hd

name: coord_diff_of_collinear
statement:
theorem coord_diff_of_collinear (x y dq : Point) (c : ℚ) (m : Fin 3)
    (hcol : x - y = c • dq) :
    x m - y m = c * dq m
proof:
:= by
  have : (x - y) m = (c • dq) m := by rw [hcol]
  simpa [Pi.sub_apply, Pi.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul] using this

name: coord_eq_iff_param_zero
statement:
theorem coord_eq_iff_param_zero (x y dq : Point) (c : ℚ) (m : Fin 3)
    (hdq : dq m ≠ 0) (hcol : x - y = c • dq) :
    x m = y m ↔ c = 0
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro hxy
    have hdiff : x m - y m = c * dq m := coord_diff_of_collinear x y dq c m hcol
    rw [hxy, sub_self] at hdiff
    rcases mul_eq_zero.mp hdiff.symm with h | h
    · exact h
    · exact absurd h hdq
  · intro hc
    have hdiff : x m - y m = c * dq m := coord_diff_of_collinear x y dq c m hcol
    rw [hc, zero_mul] at hdiff
    linarith

name: collinear_of_dot_zero_pair
statement:
theorem collinear_of_dot_zero_pair (e1 e2 w : Point)
    (hcross : crossProduct e1 e2 ≠ 0)
    (h1 : e1 ⬝ᵥ w = 0) (h2 : e2 ⬝ᵥ w = 0) :
    ∃ c : ℚ, w = c • crossProduct e1 e2
proof:
:= by
  
  have hwd : crossProduct w (crossProduct e1 e2) = 0 := by
    
    have hcc : crossProduct (crossProduct e1 e2) w
        = (e1 ⬝ᵥ w) • e2 - (e2 ⬝ᵥ w) • e1 := by
      ext i; fin_cases i <;>
        simp [crossProduct, dotProduct, Fin.sum_univ_three] <;> ring
    rw [h1, h2, zero_smul, zero_smul, sub_zero] at hcc
    
    rw [← neg_cross, hcc, neg_zero]
  have hmem : w ∈ Submodule.span ℚ {crossProduct e1 e2} :=
    (mem_span_singleton_iff_cross_zero w (crossProduct e1 e2) hcross).mpr hwd
  rw [Submodule.mem_span_singleton] at hmem
  obtain ⟨c, hc⟩ := hmem
  exact ⟨c, hc.symm⟩

name: line_points_collinear
statement:
theorem line_points_collinear (ns nt ps pt x y : Point)
    (hd : crossProduct ns nt ≠ 0)
    (hxs : ns ⬝ᵥ (x - ps) = 0) (hys : ns ⬝ᵥ (y - ps) = 0)
    (hxt : nt ⬝ᵥ (x - pt) = 0) (hyt : nt ⬝ᵥ (y - pt) = 0) :
    ∃ c : ℚ, x - y = c • crossProduct ns nt
proof:
:= by
  apply collinear_of_dot_zero_pair ns nt (x - y) hd
  · 
    have : ns ⬝ᵥ (x - y) = ns ⬝ᵥ (x - ps) - ns ⬝ᵥ (y - ps) := by
      rw [← dotProduct_sub]; congr 1; abel
    rw [this, hxs, hys, sub_zero]
  · have : nt ⬝ᵥ (x - y) = nt ⬝ᵥ (x - pt) - nt ⬝ᵥ (y - pt) := by
      rw [← dotProduct_sub]; congr 1; abel
    rw [this, hxt, hyt, sub_zero]

name: ce_add_smul
statement:
theorem ce_add_smul (N : Point) (d : ℚ) (a v : Point) (s : ℚ) :
    ce N d (a + s • v) = ce N d a + s * dotQ N v
proof:
:= by
  simp only [ce, dotQ, Pi.add_apply, Pi.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul]
  ring

name: ce_comb
statement:
theorem ce_comb (N : Point) (d : ℚ) {a b : ℚ} (hab : a + b = 1) (x y : Point) :
