    ce N d (a • x + b • y) = a * ce N d x + b * ce N d y
proof:
:= by
  have hb : b = 1 - a := by linarith
  subst hb
  simp only [ce, dotQ, Pi.add_apply, Pi.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul]
  ring

name: ce_frame
statement:
theorem ce_frame (N : Point) (d : ℚ) (a b z : Point) (s t : ℚ) :
    ce N d (a + s • (b - a) + t • (z - a))
      = ce N d a + s * (ce N d b - ce N d a) + t * (ce N d z - ce N d a)
proof:
:= by
  simp only [ce, dotQ, Pi.add_apply, Pi.sub_apply, Pi.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul]
  ring

name: cutT_pos
statement: theorem cutT_pos (hab : ce N d a * ce N d b < 0) : 0 < cutT N d a b
proof:
:= by
  rcases mul_neg_iff.mp hab with ⟨h1, h2⟩ | ⟨h1, h2⟩ <;>
    · rw [cutT]
      apply div_pos_iff.mpr
      first
      | exact Or.inl ⟨h1, by linarith⟩
      | exact Or.inr ⟨h1, by linarith⟩

name: cutT_lt_one
statement: theorem cutT_lt_one (hab : ce N d a * ce N d b < 0) : cutT N d a b < 1
proof:
:= by
  rcases mul_neg_iff.mp hab with ⟨h1, h2⟩ | ⟨h1, h2⟩
  · rw [cutT, div_lt_one (by linarith)]
    linarith
  · rw [cutT, div_lt_one_iff]
    exact Or.inr (Or.inr ⟨by linarith, by linarith⟩)

name: ce_cutPt
statement: theorem ce_cutPt (hab : ce N d a * ce N d b < 0) : ce N d (cutPt N d a b) = 0
proof:
:= by
  have hne : ce N d a - ce N d b ≠ 0 := by
    rcases mul_neg_iff.mp hab with ⟨h1, h2⟩ | ⟨h1, h2⟩ <;> intro h <;> nlinarith
  have hNv : dotQ N (b - a) = ce N d b - ce N d a := by
    simp only [ce, dotQ, Pi.sub_apply]
    ring
  rw [cutPt, ce_add_smul, hNv, cutT]
  field_simp
  ring

name: cutPt_comb
statement:
theorem cutPt_comb (N : Point) (d : ℚ) (a b : Point) :
    cutPt N d a b = (1 - cutT N d a b) • a + cutT N d a b • b
proof:
:= by
  funext k
  simp only [cutPt, Pi.add_apply, Pi.smul_apply, Pi.sub_apply, smul_eq_mul]
  ring

name: chunk_of_pos_neg
statement:
theorem chunk_of_pos_neg {i : Fin r} (h1 : 0 < ce N d (w i))
    (h2 : ce N d (w (i + 1)) < 0) :
    chunk N d w i = [w i, cutPt N d (w i) (w (i + 1))]
proof:
:= by
  rw [chunk, if_pos h1, if_pos h2]

name: chunk_of_pos_nonneg
statement:
theorem chunk_of_pos_nonneg {i : Fin r} (h1 : 0 < ce N d (w i))
    (h2 : 0 ≤ ce N d (w (i + 1))) :
    chunk N d w i = [w i]
proof:
:= by
  rw [chunk, if_pos h1, if_neg (not_lt.mpr h2)]

name: chunk_of_zero
statement:
theorem chunk_of_zero {i : Fin r} (h1 : ce N d (w i) = 0) :
    chunk N d w i = [w i]
proof:
:= by
  rw [chunk, if_neg (by rw [h1]; exact lt_irrefl 0), if_pos h1]

name: chunk_of_neg_pos
statement:
theorem chunk_of_neg_pos {i : Fin r} (h1 : ce N d (w i) < 0)
    (h2 : 0 < ce N d (w (i + 1))) :
    chunk N d w i = [cutPt N d (w i) (w (i + 1))]
proof:
:= by
  rw [chunk, if_neg (not_lt.mpr h1.le), if_neg (ne_of_lt h1), if_pos h2]

name: chunk_of_neg_nonpos
statement:
theorem chunk_of_neg_nonpos {i : Fin r} (h1 : ce N d (w i) < 0)
    (h2 : ce N d (w (i + 1)) ≤ 0) :
    chunk N d w i = []
proof:
:= by
  rw [chunk, if_neg (not_lt.mpr h1.le), if_neg (ne_of_lt h1), if_neg (not_lt.mpr h2)]

name: chunk_eq_nil_iff
statement:
theorem chunk_eq_nil_iff {i : Fin r} :
    chunk N d w i = [] ↔ ce N d (w i) < 0 ∧ ce N d (w (i + 1)) ≤ 0
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro h
    by_cases h1 : 0 < ce N d (w i)
    · by_cases h2 : ce N d (w (i + 1)) < 0
      · rw [chunk_of_pos_neg h1 h2] at h; cases h
      · rw [chunk_of_pos_nonneg h1 (not_lt.mp h2)] at h; cases h
    · by_cases h0 : ce N d (w i) = 0
      · rw [chunk_of_zero h0] at h; cases h
      · have h1' : ce N d (w i) < 0 := lt_of_le_of_ne (not_lt.mp h1) h0
        by_cases h2 : 0 < ce N d (w (i + 1))
        · rw [chunk_of_neg_pos h1' h2] at h; cases h
        · exact ⟨h1', not_lt.mp h2⟩
  · rintro ⟨h1, h2⟩
    exact chunk_of_neg_nonpos h1 h2

name: mem_chunk_iff
statement:
theorem mem_chunk_iff {i : Fin r} {y : Point} :
    y ∈ chunk N d w i ↔
      (y = w i ∧ 0 ≤ ce N d (w i)) ∨
      (y = cutPt N d (w i) (w (i + 1)) ∧
        ce N d (w i) * ce N d (w (i + 1)) < 0)
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro hy
    by_cases h1 : 0 < ce N d (w i)
    · by_cases h2 : ce N d (w (i + 1)) < 0
      · rw [chunk_of_pos_neg h1 h2] at hy
        simp only [List.mem_cons, List.not_mem_nil, or_false] at hy
        rcases hy with hy | hy
        · exact Or.inl ⟨hy, h1.le⟩
        · exact Or.inr ⟨hy, mul_neg_of_pos_of_neg h1 h2⟩
      · rw [chunk_of_pos_nonneg h1 (not_lt.mp h2)] at hy
        rw [List.mem_singleton] at hy
        exact Or.inl ⟨hy, h1.le⟩
    · by_cases h0 : ce N d (w i) = 0
      · rw [chunk_of_zero h0] at hy
        rw [List.mem_singleton] at hy
        exact Or.inl ⟨hy, le_of_eq h0.symm⟩
      · have h1' : ce N d (w i) < 0 := lt_of_le_of_ne (not_lt.mp h1) h0
        by_cases h2 : 0 < ce N d (w (i + 1))
        · rw [chunk_of_neg_pos h1' h2] at hy
          rw [List.mem_singleton] at hy
          exact Or.inr ⟨hy, mul_neg_of_neg_of_pos h1' h2⟩
        · rw [chunk_of_neg_nonpos h1' (not_lt.mp h2)] at hy
          exact absurd hy (List.not_mem_nil y)
  · rintro (⟨hye, h1⟩ | ⟨hye, h2⟩) <;> subst hye
    · rcases lt_or_eq_of_le h1 with h1' | h1'
      · by_cases h2 : ce N d (w (i + 1)) < 0
        · rw [chunk_of_pos_neg h1' h2]; exact List.mem_cons_self _ _
        · rw [chunk_of_pos_nonneg h1' (not_lt.mp h2)]
          exact List.mem_singleton.mpr rfl
      · rw [chunk_of_zero h1'.symm]
        exact List.mem_singleton.mpr rfl
    · rcases mul_neg_iff.mp h2 with ⟨ha, hb⟩ | ⟨ha, hb⟩
      · rw [chunk_of_pos_neg ha hb]
        exact List.mem_cons_of_mem _ (List.mem_singleton.mpr rfl)
      · rw [chunk_of_neg_pos ha hb]
        exact List.mem_singleton.mpr rfl

name: mem_walk_iff
statement:
theorem mem_walk_iff {y : Point} :
    y ∈ walk N d w ↔ ∃ i, y ∈ chunk N d w i
proof:
:= by
  rw [walk, List.mem_flatMap]
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨i, _, hy⟩; exact ⟨i, hy⟩
  · rintro ⟨i, hy⟩; exact ⟨i, List.mem_finRange i, hy⟩

name: chunk_subset_walk
statement:
theorem chunk_subset_walk {i : Fin r} {y : Point} (hy : y ∈ chunk N d w i) :
    y ∈ walk N d w
proof:
:=
  mem_walk_iff.mpr ⟨i, hy⟩

name: w_mem_walk
statement: theorem w_mem_walk {i : Fin r} (h : 0 ≤ ce N d (w i)) : w i ∈ walk N d w
proof:
:=
  chunk_subset_walk (mem_chunk_iff.mpr (Or.inl ⟨rfl, h⟩))

name: cut_mem_walk
proof:
:=
  chunk_subset_walk (mem_chunk_iff.mpr (Or.inr ⟨rfl, h⟩))

name: comb_mem_vpoly
proof:
:=
  (convex_convexHull ℚ _) (subset_convexHull ℚ _ (Set.mem_range_self i))
    (subset_convexHull ℚ _ (Set.mem_range_self j)) ha hb hab

name: cut_mem_vpoly
proof:
:= by
  rw [cutPt_comb]
  exact comb_mem_vpoly w i (i + 1) (by linarith [cutT_lt_one h])
    (cutT_pos h).le (by ring)

name: cut_on_plane
statement:
theorem cut_on_plane (hpl : OnPlane n c w) (i : Fin r) :
    dotQ n (cutPt N d (w i) (w (i + 1))) = c
proof:
:= by
  rw [cutPt_comb, dotQ_affine_comb, hpl, hpl]
  ring

name: eta_cut_self
statement:
theorem eta_cut_self (i : Fin r) :
    eta n w i (cutPt N d (w i) (w (i + 1))) = 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [cutPt_comb, eta_affine_comb n w i (by ring), eta_self, eta_succ]
  ring

name: eta_cut_pos
proof:
:= by
  have ht0 := cutT_pos h
  have ht1 := cutT_lt_one h
  rw [cutPt_comb, eta_affine_comb n w j (by ring)]
  have h1 : 0 ≤ eta n w j (w i) := convPos_of_strict hs j i
  have h2 : 0 ≤ eta n w j (w (i + 1)) := convPos_of_strict hs j (i + 1)
  by_cases hii : i = j + 1
  · 
    have hne1 : i + 1 ≠ j := fun hcon => by
      rw [hii] at hcon
      exact fin_add_two_ne hr j hcon
    have hne2 : i + 1 ≠ j + 1 := fun hcon => hj (add_right_cancel hcon).symm
    have h2' : 0 < eta n w j (w (i + 1)) := hs j (i + 1) hne1 hne2
    nlinarith
  · have h1' : 0 < eta n w j (w i) := hs j i (Ne.symm hj) hii
    nlinarith

name: cut_ne_vertex
proof:
:= by
  intro heq
  have ht0 := cutT_pos h
  have ht1 := cutT_lt_one h
  have he : w (i + 1) - w i ≠ 0 := fun hcon =>
    consec_ne hr hs i (sub_eq_zero.mp hcon).symm
  by_cases hji : j = i
  · 
    rw [hji] at heq
    rw [cutPt] at heq
    have h0 : cutT N d (w i) (w (i + 1)) • (w (i + 1) - w i) = 0 := by
      have h := congrArg (fun z => z - w i) heq
      simpa using h
    rcases smul_eq_zero.mp h0 with hc | hc
    · exact absurd hc (ne_of_gt ht0)
    · exact he hc
  by_cases hji' : j = i + 1
  · 
    rw [hji'] at heq
    rw [cutPt] at heq
    have h : cutT N d (w i) (w (i + 1)) • (w (i + 1) - w i) = w (i + 1) - w i := by
      have h := congrArg (fun z => z - w i) heq
      simpa using h
    have hsub : (1 - cutT N d (w i) (w (i + 1))) • (w (i + 1) - w i) = 0 := by
      rw [sub_smul, one_smul, h, sub_self]
    rcases smul_eq_zero.mp hsub with hc | hc
    · have : cutT N d (w i) (w (i + 1)) = 1 := by
        have := sub_eq_zero.mp hc
        linarith
      linarith
    · exact he hc
  · 
    have hpos := hs i j (fun hcon => hji hcon) (fun hcon => hji' hcon)
    have hzero : eta n w i (w j) = 0 := by rw [← heq]; exact eta_cut_self i
    rw [hzero] at hpos
    exact lt_irrefl 0 hpos

name: cut_ne_cut
proof:
:= by
  intro heq
  have hpos := eta_cut_pos hr hs hi (j := j) (Ne.symm hij)
  rw [heq, eta_cut_self j] at hpos
  exact lt_irrefl 0 hpos

name: mem_walk_elim
statement:
theorem mem_walk_elim {y : Point} (hy : y ∈ walk N d w) :
    ∃ m : Fin r, (y = w m ∧ 0 ≤ ce N d (w m)) ∨
      (y = cutPt N d (w m) (w (m + 1)) ∧
        ce N d (w m) * ce N d (w (m + 1)) < 0)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨m, hm⟩ := mem_walk_iff.mp hy
  exact ⟨m, mem_chunk_iff.mp hm⟩

name: mem_vpoly_of_mem_walk
statement:
theorem mem_vpoly_of_mem_walk {y : Point} (hy : y ∈ walk N d w) :
    y ∈ vpoly w
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨m, (⟨rfl, _⟩ | ⟨rfl, hcut⟩)⟩ := mem_walk_elim hy
  · exact subset_convexHull ℚ _ ⟨m, rfl⟩
  · exact cut_mem_vpoly hcut

name: on_plane_of_mem_walk
statement:
theorem on_plane_of_mem_walk (hpl : OnPlane n c w) {y : Point}
    (hy : y ∈ walk N d w) : dotQ n y = c
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨m, (⟨rfl, _⟩ | ⟨rfl, hcut⟩)⟩ := mem_walk_elim hy
  · exact hpl m
  · exact cut_on_plane hpl m

name: ce_nonneg_of_mem_walk
statement:
theorem ce_nonneg_of_mem_walk {y : Point} (hy : y ∈ walk N d w) :
    0 ≤ ce N d y
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨m, (⟨rfl, h⟩ | ⟨rfl, hcut⟩)⟩ := mem_walk_elim hy
  · exact h
  · exact le_of_eq (ce_cutPt hcut).symm

name: eta_nonneg_of_mem_walk
statement:
theorem eta_nonneg_of_mem_walk (hr : 3 ≤ r) (hpl : OnPlane n c w)
    (hs : StrictConv n w) {y : Point} (hy : y ∈ walk N d w) (k : Fin r) :
    0 ≤ eta n w k y
proof:
:= by
  have := mem_vpoly_of_mem_walk hy
  rw [vpoly_eq hr hpl hs] at this
  exact this.2 k

name: exists_eta_zero_of_mem_walk
statement:
theorem exists_eta_zero_of_mem_walk {y : Point} (hy : y ∈ walk N d w) :
    ∃ k : Fin r, eta n w k y = 0
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨m, (⟨rfl, _⟩ | ⟨rfl, hcut⟩)⟩ := mem_walk_elim hy
  · exact ⟨m, eta_self n w m⟩
  · exact ⟨m, eta_cut_self m⟩

name: eta_zero_walk_cases
statement:
theorem eta_zero_walk_cases (hr : 3 ≤ r) (hs : StrictConv n w)
    {y : Point} (hy : y ∈ walk N d w) (i : Fin r) (hz : eta n w i y = 0) :
    (y = w i ∧ 0 ≤ ce N d (w i)) ∨
    (y = w (i + 1) ∧ 0 ≤ ce N d (w (i + 1))) ∨
    (y = cutPt N d (w i) (w (i + 1)) ∧
      ce N d (w i) * ce N d (w (i + 1)) < 0)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨m, (⟨rfl, hce⟩ | ⟨rfl, hcut⟩)⟩ := mem_walk_elim hy
  · by_cases hmi : m = i
    · exact Or.inl ⟨by rw [hmi], by rw [← hmi]; exact hce⟩
    by_cases hmi' : m = i + 1
    · exact Or.inr (Or.inl ⟨by rw [hmi'], by rw [← hmi']; exact hce⟩)
    · have := hs i m hmi hmi'
      rw [hz] at this
      exact absurd this (lt_irrefl 0)
  · by_cases hmi : m = i
    · subst hmi
      exact Or.inr (Or.inr ⟨rfl, hcut⟩)
    · have := eta_cut_pos hr hs hcut (j := i) (Ne.symm hmi)
      rw [hz] at this
      exact absurd this (lt_irrefl 0)

name: chunk_disjoint
statement:
theorem chunk_disjoint (hr : 3 ≤ r) (hs : StrictConv n w) {i j : Fin r}
    (hij : i ≠ j) : List.Disjoint (chunk N d w i) (chunk N d w j)
proof:
:= by
  intro y hyi hyj
  rcases mem_chunk_iff.mp hyi with ⟨hy1, h1⟩ | ⟨hy1, h1⟩ <;>
    rcases mem_chunk_iff.mp hyj with ⟨hy2, h2⟩ | ⟨hy2, h2⟩
  · exact hij (strictConv_injective hr hs (hy1.symm.trans hy2))
  · exact cut_ne_vertex hr hs h2 i (hy2.symm.trans hy1)
  · exact cut_ne_vertex hr hs h1 j (hy1.symm.trans hy2)
  · exact cut_ne_cut hr hs h1 hij (hy1.symm.trans hy2)

name: chunk_nodup
statement:
theorem chunk_nodup (hr : 3 ≤ r) (hs : StrictConv n w) (i : Fin r) :
    (chunk N d w i).Nodup
proof:
:= by
  by_cases h1 : 0 < ce N d (w i)
  · by_cases h2 : ce N d (w (i + 1)) < 0
    · rw [chunk_of_pos_neg h1 h2]
      refine List.nodup_cons.mpr ⟨?_, List.nodup_singleton _⟩
      intro hmem
      rw [List.mem_singleton] at hmem
      exact cut_ne_vertex hr hs (mul_neg_of_pos_of_neg h1 h2) i hmem.symm
    · rw [chunk_of_pos_nonneg h1 (not_lt.mp h2)]; exact List.nodup_singleton _
  · by_cases h0 : ce N d (w i) = 0
    · rw [chunk_of_zero h0]; exact List.nodup_singleton _
    · have h1' : ce N d (w i) < 0 := lt_of_le_of_ne (not_lt.mp h1) h0
      by_cases h2 : 0 < ce N d (w (i + 1))
      · rw [chunk_of_neg_pos h1' h2]; exact List.nodup_singleton _
      · rw [chunk_of_neg_nonpos h1' (not_lt.mp h2)]; exact List.nodup_nil

name: walk_nodup
statement:
theorem walk_nodup (hr : 3 ≤ r) (hs : StrictConv n w) :
    (walk N d w).Nodup
proof:
:= by
  rw [walk, List.nodup_flatMap]
  refine ⟨fun i _ => chunk_nodup hr hs i, ?_⟩
  rw [List.pairwise_iff_getElem]
  intro a b ha hb hab
  have hne : (List.finRange r)[a] ≠ (List.finRange r)[b] := by
    simp only [List.getElem_finRange, Fin.cast_mk, ne_eq, Fin.mk.injEq]
    omega
  exact chunk_disjoint hr hs hne

name: eta_as_affine
statement:
theorem eta_as_affine (n : Point) (w : Fin r → Point) (i : Fin r) (x : Point) :
    eta n w i x = dotQ (crossQ n (w (i + 1) - w i)) x
      - dotQ (crossQ n (w (i + 1) - w i)) (w i)
proof:
:= by
  simp only [eta, areaForm, dotQ, crossQ, mkPoint_zero, mkPoint_one, mkPoint_two,
    Pi.sub_apply]
  ring

name: ce_line
statement:
theorem ce_line (N : Point) (d : ℚ) (a b : Point) (s : ℚ) :
    ce N d (a + s • (b - a)) = (1 - s) * ce N d a + s * ce N d b
proof:
:= by
  simp only [ce, dotQ, Pi.add_apply, Pi.sub_apply, Pi.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul]
  ring

name: line_comb
statement:
theorem line_comb (a b : Point) (s : ℚ) :
    a + s • (b - a) = (1 - s) • a + s • b
proof:
:= by
  funext k
  simp only [Pi.add_apply, Pi.smul_apply, Pi.sub_apply, smul_eq_mul]
  ring

name: collinear_of_areaForm_zero
proof:
:= by
  have hu : dotQ n (b - a) = 0 := by rw [dotQ_sub_right, hb, ha, sub_self]
  have hv : dotQ n (z - a) = 0 := by rw [dotQ_sub_right, hz, ha, sub_self]
  have hpar := crossQ_parallel_of_orth (n := n) hu hv
  have h0' : dotQ n (crossQ (b - a) (z - a)) = 0 := h0
  rw [h0', zero_smul] at hpar
  have hcross : crossQ (b - a) (z - a) = 0 :=
    (smul_eq_zero.mp hpar).resolve_left (ne_of_gt (dotQ_self_pos hn))
  have hcross' : crossQ (z - a) (b - a) = 0 := by
    rw [crossQ_anticomm, hcross, neg_zero]
  obtain ⟨s, hsv⟩ := exists_smul_of_crossQ_eq_zero (sub_ne_zero.mpr (Ne.symm hab)) hcross'
  refine ⟨s, ?_⟩
  rw [← hsv]
  abel

name: no_adjacent_zeros
statement:
theorem no_adjacent_zeros (hr : 3 ≤ r) (hpl : OnPlane n c w) (hs : StrictConv n w)
    (hpos : ∃ i, 0 < ce N d (w i)) (hneg : ∃ i, ce N d (w i) < 0) (k : Fin r)
    (h0 : ce N d (w k) = 0) (h1 : ce N d (w (k + 1)) = 0) : False
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨ip, hip⟩ := hpos
  obtain ⟨iq, hiq⟩ := hneg
  have hn := n_ne_zero_of_strict hr hs
  have hipk : ip ≠ k := fun h => by rw [h, h0] at hip; exact lt_irrefl 0 hip
  have hipk1 : ip ≠ k + 1 := fun h => by rw [h, h1] at hip; exact lt_irrefl 0 hip
  have hiqk : iq ≠ k := fun h => by rw [h, h0] at hiq; exact lt_irrefl 0 hiq
  have hiqk1 : iq ≠ k + 1 := fun h => by rw [h, h1] at hiq; exact lt_irrefl 0 hiq
  have hindp : 0 < eta n w k (w ip) := hs k ip hipk hipk1
  have hindq : 0 < eta n w k (w iq) := hs k iq hiqk hiqk1
  have h2a : dotQ N (w k) = d := by
    have := h0
    simp only [ce] at this
    linarith
  have h2b : dotQ N (w (k + 1)) = d := by
    have := h1
    simp only [ce] at this
    linarith
  have h1b : dotQ (crossQ n (w (k + 1) - w k)) (w (k + 1))
      = dotQ (crossQ n (w (k + 1) - w k)) (w k) := by
    have := eta_succ n w k
    rw [eta_as_affine] at this
    linarith
  have key := prop_on_plane hn (hpl k) (hpl (k + 1)) (hpl ip)
    (show areaForm n (w k) (w (k + 1)) (w ip) ≠ 0 from ne_of_gt hindp)
    (m₁ := crossQ n (w (k + 1) - w k)) (d₁ := dotQ (crossQ n (w (k + 1) - w k)) (w k))
    rfl h1b h2a h2b (hpl iq)
  rw [← eta_as_affine n w k (w iq), ← eta_as_affine n w k (w ip)] at key
  have hce1 : dotQ N (w ip) - d = ce N d (w ip) := rfl
  have hce2 : dotQ N (w iq) - d = ce N d (w iq) := rfl
  rw [hce1, hce2] at key
  nlinarith

name: middle_contra
statement:
theorem middle_contra (hr : 3 ≤ r) (hpl : OnPlane n c w) (hs : StrictConv n w)
    (hpos : ∃ i, 0 < ce N d (w i)) (hneg : ∃ i, ce N d (w i) < 0)
    {p q mid : Point} (hpmem : p ∈ walk N d w) (hqmem : q ∈ walk N d w)
    (hmidmem : mid ∈ walk N d w) (hcep : ce N d p = 0) (hceq : ce N d q = 0)
    (hpq : p ≠ q) {σ : ℚ} (hσ0 : 0 < σ) (hσ1 : σ < 1)
    (hmid : mid = (1 - σ) • p + σ • q) : False
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨k, hk⟩ := exists_eta_zero_of_mem_walk (n := n) hmidmem
  have hp := eta_nonneg_of_mem_walk hr hpl hs hpmem k
  have hq := eta_nonneg_of_mem_walk hr hpl hs hqmem k
  have hsum : (1 - σ) * eta n w k p + σ * eta n w k q = 0 := by
    rw [← eta_affine_comb n w k (show (1 - σ) + σ = 1 by ring) p q, ← hmid]
    exact hk
  have hpk : eta n w k p = 0 := by nlinarith
  have hqk : eta n w k q = 0 := by nlinarith
  obtain ⟨sp, _, _, hpe⟩ := feasible_eta_zero_mem_edge hr hpl hs k
    (on_plane_of_mem_walk hpl hpmem) (eta_nonneg_of_mem_walk hr hpl hs hpmem) hpk
  obtain ⟨sq, _, _, hqe⟩ := feasible_eta_zero_mem_edge hr hpl hs k
    (on_plane_of_mem_walk hpl hqmem) (eta_nonneg_of_mem_walk hr hpl hs hqmem) hqk
  have hspq : sp ≠ sq := by
    intro h
    exact hpq (by rw [hpe, hqe, h])
  have hcp : (1 - sp) * ce N d (w k) + sp * ce N d (w (k + 1)) = 0 := by
    rw [← ce_comb N d (show (1 - sp) + sp = 1 by ring), ← hpe]
    exact hcep
  have hcq : (1 - sq) * ce N d (w k) + sq * ce N d (w (k + 1)) = 0 := by
    rw [← ce_comb N d (show (1 - sq) + sq = 1 by ring), ← hqe]
    exact hceq
  have h5 : (sp - sq) * (ce N d (w k) - ce N d (w (k + 1))) = 0 := by
    linear_combination hcq - hcp
  have hAB : ce N d (w k) = ce N d (w (k + 1)) :=
    sub_eq_zero.mp ((mul_eq_zero.mp h5).resolve_left (sub_ne_zero.mpr hspq))
  have hA : ce N d (w k) = 0 := by linear_combination hcp + sp * hAB
  have hB : ce N d (w (k + 1)) = 0 := by rw [← hAB]; exact hA
  exact no_adjacent_zeros hr hpl hs hpos hneg k hA hB

name: online_le_two
statement:
theorem online_le_two (hr : 3 ≤ r) (hpl : OnPlane n c w) (hs : StrictConv n w)
    (hpos : ∃ i, 0 < ce N d (w i)) (hneg : ∃ i, ce N d (w i) < 0)
    {x₁ x₂ x₃ : Point} (h1 : x₁ ∈ walk N d w) (h2 : x₂ ∈ walk N d w)
    (h3 : x₃ ∈ walk N d w) (hz1 : ce N d x₁ = 0) (hz2 : ce N d x₂ = 0)
    (hz3 : ce N d x₃ = 0) : x₁ = x₂ ∨ x₁ = x₃ ∨ x₂ = x₃
proof:
:= by
  by_contra hcon
  push_neg at hcon
  obtain ⟨hd12, hd13, hd23⟩ := hcon
  have hn := n_ne_zero_of_strict hr hs
  have hpl1 := on_plane_of_mem_walk hpl h1
  have hpl2 := on_plane_of_mem_walk hpl h2
  have hpl3 := on_plane_of_mem_walk hpl h3
  by_cases hcol : areaForm n x₁ x₂ x₃ = 0
  · 
    obtain ⟨s, hs3⟩ := collinear_of_areaForm_zero hn hpl1 hpl2 hpl3 hd12 hcol
    have hs0 : s ≠ 0 := by
      intro h
      apply hd13
      rw [hs3, h, zero_smul, add_zero]
    have hs1 : s ≠ 1 := by
      intro h
      apply hd23
      rw [hs3, h, one_smul]
      funext k'
      simp only [Pi.add_apply, Pi.sub_apply]
      ring
    rcases lt_trichotomy s 0 with hlt | hzero | hgt
    · 
      have h1s : (1 : ℚ) - s ≠ 0 := by linarith
      have hcomb : x₁ = (1 - (-s / (1 - s))) • x₃ + (-s / (1 - s)) • x₂ := by
        rw [hs3]
        funext k'
        simp only [Pi.add_apply, Pi.smul_apply, Pi.sub_apply, smul_eq_mul]
        field_simp
        ring
      exact middle_contra hr hpl hs hpos hneg h3 h2 h1 hz3 hz2 hd23.symm
        (div_pos (by linarith) (by linarith))
        ((div_lt_one (by linarith)).mpr (by linarith)) hcomb
    · exact hs0 hzero
    · rcases lt_trichotomy s 1 with hlt1 | hone | hgt1
      · 
        have hcomb : x₃ = (1 - s) • x₁ + s • x₂ := by
          rw [hs3, line_comb]
        exact middle_contra hr hpl hs hpos hneg h1 h2 h3 hz1 hz2 hd12
          hgt hlt1 hcomb
      · exact hs1 hone
      · 
        have hcomb : x₂ = (1 - 1 / s) • x₁ + (1 / s) • x₃ := by
          rw [hs3]
          funext k'
          simp only [Pi.add_apply, Pi.smul_apply, Pi.sub_apply, smul_eq_mul]
          field_simp
          ring
        exact middle_contra hr hpl hs hpos hneg h1 h3 h2 hz1 hz3 hd13
          (by positivity) ((div_lt_one (by linarith)).mpr (by linarith)) hcomb
  · 
    obtain ⟨ip, hip⟩ := hpos
    obtain ⟨st, tt, hrep⟩ := plane_coords hn hpl1 hpl2 hpl3 hcol (hpl ip)
    have hzero : ce N d (w ip) = 0 := by
      rw [hrep, ce_frame, hz1, hz2, hz3]
      ring
    rw [hzero] at hip
    exact lt_irrefl 0 hip

name: epair_full
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨i, 0, 1, le_refl 0, zero_lt_one, le_refl 1, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · rw [zero_smul, add_zero]
  · rw [one_smul]; abel
  · intro y hy hz
    rcases eta_zero_walk_cases hr hs hy i hz with ⟨h, _⟩ | ⟨h, _⟩ | ⟨h, hprod⟩
    · exact Or.inl h
    · exact Or.inr h
    · nlinarith

name: epair_init
proof:
:= by
  have hprod := mul_neg_of_pos_of_neg hp hn
  refine ⟨i, 0, cutT N d (w i) (w (i + 1)), le_refl 0, cutT_pos hprod,
    (cutT_lt_one hprod).le, by rw [zero_smul, add_zero], rfl, ?_⟩
  intro y hy hz
  rcases eta_zero_walk_cases hr hs hy i hz with ⟨h, _⟩ | ⟨_, h⟩ | ⟨h, _⟩
  · exact Or.inl h
  · linarith
  · exact Or.inr h

name: epair_exit
proof:
:= by
  have hprod := mul_neg_of_neg_of_pos hn hp
  refine ⟨i, cutT N d (w i) (w (i + 1)), 1, (cutT_pos hprod).le,
    cutT_lt_one hprod, le_refl 1, rfl, by rw [one_smul]; abel, ?_⟩
  intro y hy hz
  rcases eta_zero_walk_cases hr hs hy i hz with ⟨_, h⟩ | ⟨h, _⟩ | ⟨h, _⟩
  · linarith
  · exact Or.inr h
  · exact Or.inl h

name: cpair_mk
statement:
theorem cpair_mk (hr : 3 ≤ r) (hs : StrictConv n w) {i j : Fin r} (hij : i ≠ j)
    {u u' : Point} (hin : ce N d (w (i + 1)) < 0)
    (hexit : (0 < ce N d (w i) ∧ u = cutPt N d (w i) (w (i + 1))) ∨
      (ce N d (w i) = 0 ∧ u = w i))
    (hentry : (ce N d (w j) < 0 ∧ 0 < ce N d (w (j + 1)) ∧
        u' = cutPt N d (w j) (w (j + 1))) ∨
      (ce N d (w j) = 0 ∧ u' = w j)) :
    CPair N d w u u'
proof:
:= by
  have humem : u ∈ walk N d w := by
    rcases hexit with ⟨hp, rfl⟩ | ⟨hz, rfl⟩
    · exact cut_mem_walk (mul_neg_of_pos_of_neg hp hin)
    · exact w_mem_walk (le_of_eq hz.symm)
  have huce : ce N d u = 0 := by
    rcases hexit with ⟨hp, rfl⟩ | ⟨hz, rfl⟩
    · exact ce_cutPt (mul_neg_of_pos_of_neg hp hin)
    · exact hz
  have hu'mem : u' ∈ walk N d w := by
    rcases hentry with ⟨hn', hp', rfl⟩ | ⟨hz, rfl⟩
    · exact cut_mem_walk (mul_neg_of_neg_of_pos hn' hp')
    · exact w_mem_walk (le_of_eq hz.symm)
  have hu'ce : ce N d u' = 0 := by
    rcases hentry with ⟨hn', hp', rfl⟩ | ⟨hz, rfl⟩
    · exact ce_cutPt (mul_neg_of_neg_of_pos hn' hp')
    · exact hz
  have hne : u ≠ u' := by
    rcases hexit with ⟨hp, rfl⟩ | ⟨hz, rfl⟩ <;>
      rcases hentry with ⟨hn', hp', rfl⟩ | ⟨hz', rfl⟩
    · exact cut_ne_cut hr hs (mul_neg_of_pos_of_neg hp hin) hij
    · exact cut_ne_vertex hr hs (mul_neg_of_pos_of_neg hp hin) j
    · exact (cut_ne_vertex hr hs (mul_neg_of_neg_of_pos hn' hp') i).symm
    · exact fun h => hij (strictConv_injective hr hs h)
  exact ⟨humem, hu'mem, huce, hu'ce, hne, i, hin, hexit⟩

name: junction_adj
statement:
theorem junction_adj (hr : 3 ≤ r) (hs : StrictConv n w) (i : Fin r) :
    ∀ x ∈ (chunk N d w i).getLast?, ∀ y ∈ (chunk N d w (i + 1)).head?,
      WalkAdj n N d w x y
proof:
:= by
  intro x hx y hy
  rcases lt_trichotomy (ce N d (w (i + 1))) 0 with hc1 | hc1 | hc1
  · 
    rcases lt_trichotomy (ce N d (w (i + 1 + 1))) 0 with hc2 | hc2 | hc2
    · rw [chunk_of_neg_nonpos hc1 hc2.le] at hy
      simp at hy
    · rw [chunk_of_neg_nonpos hc1 (le_of_eq hc2)] at hy
      simp at hy
    · rw [chunk_of_neg_pos hc1 hc2] at hy
      simp only [List.head?_cons, Option.mem_some_iff] at hy
      subst hy
      
      rcases lt_trichotomy (ce N d (w i)) 0 with hc0 | hc0 | hc0
      · rw [chunk_of_neg_nonpos hc0 hc1.le] at hx
        simp at hx
      · rw [chunk_of_zero hc0] at hx
        simp only [List.getLast?_singleton, Option.mem_some_iff] at hx
        subst hx
        exact Or.inr (cpair_mk hr hs (fin_add_one_ne hr i).symm hc1
          (Or.inr ⟨hc0, rfl⟩) (Or.inl ⟨hc1, hc2, rfl⟩))
      · rw [chunk_of_pos_neg hc0 hc1] at hx
        have hx' : cutPt N d (w i) (w (i + 1)) = x := by
          simpa using hx
        subst hx'
        exact Or.inr (cpair_mk hr hs (fin_add_one_ne hr i).symm hc1
          (Or.inl ⟨hc0, rfl⟩) (Or.inl ⟨hc1, hc2, rfl⟩))
  · 
    rw [chunk_of_zero hc1] at hy
    simp only [List.head?_cons, Option.mem_some_iff] at hy
    subst hy
    rcases lt_trichotomy (ce N d (w i)) 0 with hc0 | hc0 | hc0
    · rw [chunk_of_neg_nonpos hc0 (le_of_eq hc1)] at hx
      simp at hx
    · rw [chunk_of_zero hc0] at hx
      simp only [List.getLast?_singleton, Option.mem_some_iff] at hx
      subst hx
      exact Or.inl (epair_full hr hs (le_of_eq hc0.symm) (le_of_eq hc1.symm))
    · rw [chunk_of_pos_nonneg hc0 (le_of_eq hc1.symm)] at hx
      simp only [List.getLast?_singleton, Option.mem_some_iff] at hx
      subst hx
      exact Or.inl (epair_full hr hs hc0.le (le_of_eq hc1.symm))
  · 
    have hy' : w (i + 1) = y := by
      by_cases hc2 : ce N d (w (i + 1 + 1)) < 0
      · rw [chunk_of_pos_neg hc1 hc2] at hy
        simpa using hy
      · rw [chunk_of_pos_nonneg hc1 (not_lt.mp hc2)] at hy
        simpa using hy
    subst hy'
    rcases lt_trichotomy (ce N d (w i)) 0 with hc0 | hc0 | hc0
    · rw [chunk_of_neg_pos hc0 hc1] at hx
      simp only [List.getLast?_singleton, Option.mem_some_iff] at hx
      subst hx
      exact Or.inl (epair_exit hr hs hc0 hc1)
    · rw [chunk_of_zero hc0] at hx
      simp only [List.getLast?_singleton, Option.mem_some_iff] at hx
      subst hx
      exact Or.inl (epair_full hr hs (le_of_eq hc0.symm) hc1.le)
    · rw [chunk_of_pos_nonneg hc0 hc1.le] at hx
      simp only [List.getLast?_singleton, Option.mem_some_iff] at hx
      subst hx
      exact Or.inl (epair_full hr hs hc0.le hc1.le)

name: junction_gap
statement:
theorem junction_gap (hr : 3 ≤ r) (hs : StrictConv n w) {i j : Fin r}
    (hij : i ≠ j) (hX : ce N d (w (i + 1)) < 0) (hY : ce N d (w j) ≤ 0) :
    ∀ x ∈ (chunk N d w i).getLast?, ∀ y ∈ (chunk N d w j).head?,
      WalkAdj n N d w x y
proof:
:= by
  intro x hx y hy
  
  have hexit : (0 < ce N d (w i) ∧ x = cutPt N d (w i) (w (i + 1))) ∨
      (ce N d (w i) = 0 ∧ x = w i) := by
    rcases lt_trichotomy (ce N d (w i)) 0 with hc0 | hc0 | hc0
    · rw [chunk_of_neg_nonpos hc0 hX.le] at hx
      simp at hx
    · rw [chunk_of_zero hc0] at hx
      simp only [List.getLast?_singleton, Option.mem_some_iff] at hx
      exact Or.inr ⟨hc0, hx.symm⟩
    · rw [chunk_of_pos_neg hc0 hX] at hx
      have hx' : cutPt N d (w i) (w (i + 1)) = x := by simpa using hx
      exact Or.inl ⟨hc0, hx'.symm⟩
  
  rcases lt_or_eq_of_le hY with hc0 | hc0
  · rcases lt_trichotomy (ce N d (w (j + 1))) 0 with hc1 | hc1 | hc1
    · rw [chunk_of_neg_nonpos hc0 hc1.le] at hy
      simp at hy
    · rw [chunk_of_neg_nonpos hc0 (le_of_eq hc1)] at hy
      simp at hy
    · rw [chunk_of_neg_pos hc0 hc1] at hy
      simp only [List.head?_cons, Option.mem_some_iff] at hy
      subst hy
      exact Or.inr (cpair_mk hr hs hij hX hexit (Or.inl ⟨hc0, hc1, rfl⟩))
  · rw [chunk_of_zero hc0] at hy
    simp only [List.head?_cons, Option.mem_some_iff] at hy
    subst hy
    exact Or.inr (cpair_mk hr hs hij hX hexit (Or.inr ⟨hc0, rfl⟩))

name: chain'_chunk
statement:
theorem chain'_chunk (hr : 3 ≤ r) (hs : StrictConv n w) (i : Fin r) :
    List.Chain' (WalkAdj n N d w) (chunk N d w i)
proof:
:= by
  rcases lt_trichotomy (ce N d (w i)) 0 with hc0 | hc0 | hc0
  · by_cases hc1 : 0 < ce N d (w (i + 1))
    · rw [chunk_of_neg_pos hc0 hc1]; exact List.chain'_singleton _
    · rw [chunk_of_neg_nonpos hc0 (not_lt.mp hc1)]; exact List.chain'_nil
  · rw [chunk_of_zero hc0]; exact List.chain'_singleton _
  · by_cases hc1 : ce N d (w (i + 1)) < 0
    · rw [chunk_of_pos_neg hc0 hc1]
      refine List.chain'_cons.mpr ⟨Or.inl (epair_init hr hs hc0 hc1), ?_⟩
      exact List.chain'_singleton _
    · rw [chunk_of_pos_nonneg hc0 (not_lt.mp hc1)]; exact List.chain'_singleton _

name: chain'_filter_of_gaps
statement:
theorem chain'_filter_of_gaps {p : α → Bool} {R : α → α → Prop} :
    ∀ (L : List α),
      (∀ (pre gap post : List α) (l₁ l₂ : α),
        L = pre ++ l₁ :: (gap ++ l₂ :: post) → p l₁ = true → p l₂ = true →
        (∀ g ∈ gap, ¬ p g = true) → R l₁ l₂) →
      List.Chain' R (L.filter p)
  | [], _ => by simp
  | l :: L, h => by
    have hrec
proof:
:= chain'_filter_of_gaps L (fun pre gap post l₁ l₂ hdec h1 h2 hgap =>
      h (l :: pre) gap post l₁ l₂ (by rw [List.cons_append, hdec]) h1 h2 hgap)
    by_cases hl : p l
    · rw [List.filter_cons_of_pos hl, List.chain'_cons']
      refine ⟨?_, hrec⟩
      intro y hy
      obtain ⟨t, ht⟩ : ∃ t, L.filter p = y :: t := by
        cases hLf : L.filter p with
        | nil => rw [hLf] at hy; simp at hy
        | cons a t =>
          rw [hLf] at hy
          simp only [List.head?_cons, Option.mem_some_iff] at hy
          exact ⟨t, by rw [hy]⟩
      obtain ⟨gap, post, hdec, hgap, hpy, -⟩ := List.filter_eq_cons_iff.mp ht
      exact h [] gap post l y (by rw [List.nil_append, hdec]) hl hpy hgap
    · rw [List.filter_cons_of_neg hl]
      exact hrec

name: decomp_getElem
statement:
theorem decomp_getElem?_self {L pre post : List α} {a : α}
    (hdec : L = pre ++ a :: post) : L[pre.length]? = some a
proof:
:= by
  rw [hdec, List.getElem?_append_right (le_refl pre.length), Nat.sub_self,
    List.getElem?_cons_zero]

name: decomp_getElem
proof:
:= by
  rw [hdec, List.getElem?_append, if_pos hm]

name: decomp_getElem
proof:
:= by
  rw [hdec, List.getElem?_append_right (by omega)]
  have h : pre.length + 1 + k - pre.length = k + 1 := by omega
  rw [h, List.getElem?_cons_succ]

name: mem_of_getElem
statement:
theorem mem_of_getElem?_eq_some {l : List α} {m : ℕ} {g : α}
    (h : l[m]? = some g) : g ∈ l
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨hlt, hg⟩ := List.getElem?_eq_some_iff.mp h
  exact hg ▸ List.getElem_mem hlt

name: head
statement:
theorem head?_flatten_of_ne_nil :
    ∀ {M : List (List α)}, (∀ l ∈ M, l ≠ []) →
      M.flatten.head? = M.head?.bind List.head?
  | [], _ => rfl
  | l :: M, h => by
    rw [List.flatten_cons, List.head?_append]
    have hl : l ≠ []
proof:
:= h l (List.mem_cons_self l M)
    obtain ⟨a, t, rfl⟩ : ∃ a t, l = a :: t := by
      cases l with
      | nil => exact absurd rfl hl
      | cons a t => exact ⟨a, t, rfl⟩
    simp

name: getLast
statement:
theorem getLast?_flatten_of_ne_nil :
    ∀ {M : List (List α)}, (∀ l ∈ M, l ≠ []) →
      M.flatten.getLast? = M.getLast?.bind List.getLast?
  | [], _ => rfl
  | [l], _h => by simp
  | l :: l' :: M, h => by
    have hIH
proof:
:= getLast?_flatten_of_ne_nil (M := l' :: M)
      (fun x hx => h x (List.mem_cons_of_mem l hx))
    rw [List.flatten_cons, List.getLast?_append, hIH, List.getLast?_cons_cons]
    have hne : (l' :: M).flatten ≠ [] := by
      rw [List.flatten_cons]
      intro hcon
      exact h l' (List.mem_cons_of_mem l (List.mem_cons_self l' M))
        (List.append_eq_nil.mp hcon).1
    have h2 : (l' :: M).flatten.getLast? ≠ none :=
      fun hcon => hne (List.getLast?_eq_none_iff.mp hcon)
    rw [hIH] at h2
    cases hx : ((l' :: M).getLast?.bind List.getLast?) with
    | none => exact absurd hx h2
    | some y => rw [Option.some_or]

name: chunkList_length
statement: theorem chunkList_length : (chunkList N d w).length = r
proof:
:= by
  simp [chunkList]

name: walk_eq_flatten
statement: theorem walk_eq_flatten : walk N d w = (chunkList N d w).flatten
proof:
:=
  List.flatMap_def _ _

name: chunkList_getElem
statement:
theorem chunkList_getElem? {m : ℕ} (hm : m < r) :
    (chunkList N d w)[m]? = some (chunk N d w ⟨m, hm⟩)
proof:
:= by
  rw [chunkList, List.getElem?_map, List.getElem?_eq_getElem (by simpa using hm)]
  simp [List.getElem_finRange]

name: fin_mk_succ
statement:
theorem fin_mk_succ (hr : 3 ≤ r) {m : ℕ} (hm1 : m + 1 < r) :
    (⟨m, by omega⟩ : Fin r) + 1 = ⟨m + 1, hm1⟩
proof:
:= by
  ext
  rw [Fin.val_add, Fin.val_one']
  have h1 : 1 % r = 1 := Nat.mod_eq_of_lt (by omega)
  rw [h1]
  exact Nat.mod_eq_of_lt hm1

name: fin_mk_last_succ
statement:
theorem fin_mk_last_succ (hr : 3 ≤ r) :
    (⟨r - 1, by omega⟩ : Fin r) + 1 = (⟨0, by omega⟩ : Fin r)
proof:
:= by
  ext
  rw [Fin.val_add, Fin.val_one']
  have h1 : 1 % r = 1 := Nat.mod_eq_of_lt (by omega)
  rw [h1]
  have h2 : r - 1 + 1 = r := by omega
  rw [h2, Nat.mod_self]

name: walk_ne_nil
statement: theorem walk_ne_nil (hpos : ∃ i, 0 < ce N d (w i)) : walk N d w ≠ []
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨i, hi⟩ := hpos
  intro hcon
  have := w_mem_walk (N := N) (d := d) (w := w) hi.le
  rw [hcon] at this
  exact List.not_mem_nil _ this

name: not_single_nonempty
statement:
theorem not_single_nonempty (hr : 3 ≤ r) (hpos : ∃ i, 0 < ce N d (w i))
    {i₀ : Fin r} (hall : ∀ m : Fin r, m ≠ i₀ → chunk N d w m = []) : False
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨ip, hip⟩ := hpos
  have hipi : ip = i₀ := by
    by_contra hne
    have := (chunk_eq_nil_iff.mp (hall ip hne)).1
    linarith
  subst hipi
  have hprev : ip - 1 ≠ ip := by
    intro h
    have h2 : ip - 1 + 1 = ip + 1 := by rw [h]
    rw [sub_add_cancel] at h2
    exact fin_add_one_ne hr ip h2.symm
  have hnil := hall (ip - 1) hprev
  have h3 := (chunk_eq_nil_iff.mp hnil).2
  rw [sub_add_cancel] at h3
  linarith

name: chain'_walk
statement:
theorem chain'_walk (hr : 3 ≤ r) (hs : StrictConv n w) :
    List.Chain' (WalkAdj n N d w) (walk N d w)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have hflat : walk N d w
      = ((chunkList N d w).filter (fun l => decide (l ≠ []))).flatten := by
    rw [List.flatten_filter_ne_nil, walk_eq_flatten]
  rw [hflat]
  have hnil : [] ∉ (chunkList N d w).filter (fun l => decide (l ≠ [])) := by
    intro hmem
    have := List.of_mem_filter hmem
    simp at this
  rw [List.chain'_flatten hnil]
  constructor
  · 
    intro l hl
    obtain ⟨i, _, rfl⟩ := List.mem_map.mp (List.mem_of_mem_filter hl)
    exact chain'_chunk hr hs i
  · 
    apply chain'_filter_of_gaps
    intro pre gap post l₁ l₂ hdec hp1 hp2 hgap
    have hlen := congrArg List.length hdec
    rw [chunkList_length] at hlen
    simp only [List.length_append, List.length_cons] at hlen
    have hi : pre.length < r := by omega
    have hj : pre.length + 1 + gap.length < r := by omega
    have hl₁ : l₁ = chunk N d w ⟨pre.length, hi⟩ :=
      Option.some_injective _
        ((decomp_getElem?_self hdec).symm.trans (chunkList_getElem? hi))
    have hl₂ : l₂ = chunk N d w ⟨pre.length + 1 + gap.length, hj⟩ := by
      have h1 : (chunkList N d w)[pre.length + 1 + gap.length]? = some l₂ := by
        rw [decomp_getElem?_after hdec gap.length,
          List.getElem?_append_right (le_refl gap.length), Nat.sub_self,
          List.getElem?_cons_zero]
      exact Option.some_injective _ (h1.symm.trans (chunkList_getElem? hj))
    by_cases hgapnil : gap = []
    · 
      subst hgapnil
      have hj' : pre.length + 1 < r := by simpa using hj
      have hfin : (⟨pre.length, hi⟩ : Fin r) + 1 = ⟨pre.length + 1, hj'⟩ :=
        fin_mk_succ hr hj'
      intro x hx y hy
      refine junction_adj hr hs ⟨pre.length, hi⟩ x ?_ y ?_
      · rw [← hl₁]; exact hx
      · rw [hfin]
        have hl₂' : l₂ = chunk N d w ⟨pre.length + 1, hj'⟩ := hl₂
        rw [← hl₂']
        exact hy
    · 
      have hglen : 0 < gap.length := List.length_pos.mpr hgapnil
      have hii1 : pre.length + 1 < r := by omega
      have hjj1 : pre.length + gap.length < r := by omega
      
      have hgap1 : chunk N d w ⟨pre.length + 1, hii1⟩ = [] := by
        have h1 : (chunkList N d w)[pre.length + 1 + 0]?
            = some (gap[0]'(hglen)) := by
          rw [decomp_getElem?_after hdec 0, List.getElem?_append (n := 0),
            if_pos hglen]
          exact List.getElem?_eq_getElem hglen
        have h1' : (chunkList N d w)[pre.length + 1]?
            = some (gap[0]'(hglen)) := by simpa using h1
        have h2 := (chunkList_getElem? hii1).symm.trans h1'
        have h4 := hgap _ (List.getElem_mem (l := gap) (n := 0) (by omega))
        simp only [ne_eq, decide_not, Bool.not_eq_true', decide_eq_false_iff_not,
          not_not] at h4
        rw [Option.some_injective _ h2]
        exact h4
      
      have hgap2 : chunk N d w ⟨pre.length + gap.length, hjj1⟩ = [] := by
        have h1 : (chunkList N d w)[pre.length + 1 + (gap.length - 1)]?
            = some (gap[gap.length - 1]'(by omega)) := by
          rw [decomp_getElem?_after hdec,
            List.getElem?_append (n := gap.length - 1), if_pos (by omega)]
          exact List.getElem?_eq_getElem (by omega)
        have heq : pre.length + 1 + (gap.length - 1) = pre.length + gap.length := by
          omega
        rw [heq] at h1
        have h2 := (chunkList_getElem? hjj1).symm.trans h1
        have h4 := hgap _ (List.getElem_mem (l := gap) (n := gap.length - 1) (by omega))
        simp only [ne_eq, decide_not, Bool.not_eq_true', decide_eq_false_iff_not,
          not_not] at h4
        rw [Option.some_injective _ h2]
        exact h4
      
      have hsigns1 := chunk_eq_nil_iff.mp hgap1
      have hsigns2 := chunk_eq_nil_iff.mp hgap2
      have hfin1 : (⟨pre.length, hi⟩ : Fin r) + 1 = ⟨pre.length + 1, hii1⟩ :=
        fin_mk_succ hr hii1
      have hfin2 : (⟨pre.length + gap.length, hjj1⟩ : Fin r) + 1
          = ⟨pre.length + 1 + gap.length, hj⟩ := by
        rw [fin_mk_succ hr (show pre.length + gap.length + 1 < r by omega)]
        ext
        simp
        omega
      have hX : ce N d (w ((⟨pre.length, hi⟩ : Fin r) + 1)) < 0 := by
        rw [hfin1]
        exact hsigns1.1
      have hY : ce N d (w (⟨pre.length + 1 + gap.length, hj⟩ : Fin r)) ≤ 0 := by
        rw [← hfin2]
        exact hsigns2.2
      have hij : (⟨pre.length, hi⟩ : Fin r)
          ≠ ⟨pre.length + 1 + gap.length, hj⟩ := by
        simp only [ne_eq, Fin.mk.injEq]
        omega
      intro x hx y hy
      refine junction_gap hr hs hij hX hY x ?_ y ?_
      · rw [← hl₁]; exact hx
      · rw [← hl₂]; exact hy

name: chain'_walk_cyclic
statement:
theorem chain'_walk_cyclic (hr : 3 ≤ r) (hs : StrictConv n w)
    (hpos : ∃ i, 0 < ce N d (w i)) :
    List.Chain' (WalkAdj n N d w) (walk N d w ++ (walk N d w).take 1)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  rw [List.chain'_append]
  refine ⟨chain'_walk hr hs, ?_, ?_⟩
  · 
    cases walk N d w with
    | nil => simp
    | cons a t =>
      rw [List.take_succ_cons, List.take_zero]
      exact List.chain'_singleton _
  
  intro x hx y hy
  rw [List.head?_take, if_neg one_ne_zero] at hy
  have hallne : ∀ l ∈ (chunkList N d w).filter (fun l => decide (l ≠ [])),
      l ≠ [] := fun l hl => by simpa using List.of_mem_filter hl
  have hflat : walk N d w
      = ((chunkList N d w).filter (fun l => decide (l ≠ []))).flatten := by
    rw [List.flatten_filter_ne_nil, walk_eq_flatten]
  rw [hflat, getLast?_flatten_of_ne_nil hallne] at hx
  rw [hflat, head?_flatten_of_ne_nil hallne] at hy
  
  cases hlast : ((chunkList N d w).filter (fun l => decide (l ≠ []))).getLast? with
  | none => rw [hlast] at hx; simp at hx
  | some l₁ =>
  rw [hlast, Option.some_bind] at hx
  
  cases hfirst : ((chunkList N d w).filter (fun l => decide (l ≠ []))).head? with
  | none => rw [hfirst] at hy; simp at hy
  | some l₂ =>
  rw [hfirst, Option.some_bind] at hy
  
  obtain ⟨T₂, hT₂⟩ : ∃ T, (chunkList N d w).filter (fun l => decide (l ≠ []))
      = l₂ :: T := by
    cases hF : (chunkList N d w).filter (fun l => decide (l ≠ [])) with
    | nil => rw [hF] at hfirst; cases hfirst
    | cons a t =>
      rw [hF] at hfirst
      simp only [List.head?_cons, Option.some.injEq] at hfirst
      exact ⟨t, by rw [hfirst]⟩
  obtain ⟨pre₂, rest₂, hdec₂, hrej₂, hp₂, -⟩ := List.filter_eq_cons_iff.mp hT₂
  
  have hlastrev : ((chunkList N d w).reverse.filter
      (fun l => decide (l ≠ []))).head? = some l₁ := by
    rw [List.filter_reverse, ← List.getLast?_eq_head?_reverse]
    exact hlast
  obtain ⟨T₁, hT₁⟩ : ∃ T, (chunkList N d w).reverse.filter (fun l => decide (l ≠ []))
      = l₁ :: T := by
    cases hF : (chunkList N d w).reverse.filter (fun l => decide (l ≠ [])) with
    | nil => rw [hF] at hlastrev; cases hlastrev
    | cons a t =>
      rw [hF] at hlastrev
      simp only [List.head?_cons, Option.some.injEq] at hlastrev
      exact ⟨t, by rw [hlastrev]⟩
  obtain ⟨pre₁, rest₁, hdec₁, hrej₁, hp₁, -⟩ := List.filter_eq_cons_iff.mp hT₁
  have hdecL : chunkList N d w = rest₁.reverse ++ l₁ :: pre₁.reverse := by
    have h := congrArg List.reverse hdec₁
    rw [List.reverse_reverse] at h
    rw [h, List.reverse_append, List.reverse_cons]
    simp [List.append_assoc]
  
  have hlen1 := congrArg List.length hdecL
  rw [chunkList_length] at hlen1
  simp only [List.length_append, List.length_cons, List.length_reverse] at hlen1
  have hlen2 := congrArg List.length hdec₂
  rw [chunkList_length] at hlen2
  simp only [List.length_append, List.length_cons] at hlen2
  have hi' : rest₁.reverse.length < r := by
    rw [List.length_reverse]
    omega
  have hj' : pre₂.length < r := by omega
  have hl₁ : l₁ = chunk N d w ⟨rest₁.reverse.length, hi'⟩ :=
    Option.some_injective _
      ((decomp_getElem?_self hdecL).symm.trans (chunkList_getElem? hi'))
  have hl₂ : l₂ = chunk N d w ⟨pre₂.length, hj'⟩ :=
    Option.some_injective _
      ((decomp_getElem?_self hdec₂).symm.trans (chunkList_getElem? hj'))
  
  have hbefore : ∀ m (hm : m < pre₂.length),
      chunk N d w ⟨m, by omega⟩ = [] := by
    intro m hm
    have h1 := decomp_getElem?_before hdec₂ hm
    rw [chunkList_getElem? (show m < r by omega)] at h1
    have h4 := hrej₂ _ (mem_of_getElem?_eq_some h1.symm)
    simpa using h4
  
  have hafter : ∀ m (hm1 : rest₁.reverse.length < m) (hm2 : m < r),
      chunk N d w ⟨m, hm2⟩ = [] := by
    intro m hm1 hm2
    have hk : m = rest₁.reverse.length + 1 + (m - rest₁.reverse.length - 1) := by
      omega
    have h1 := decomp_getElem?_after hdecL (m - rest₁.reverse.length - 1)
    rw [← hk, chunkList_getElem? hm2] at h1
    have h4 := hrej₁ _ (List.mem_reverse.mp (mem_of_getElem?_eq_some h1.symm))
    simpa using h4
  have hl₁ne : chunk N d w ⟨rest₁.reverse.length, hi'⟩ ≠ [] := by
    rw [← hl₁]
    simpa using hp₁
  
  have hj'le : pre₂.length ≤ rest₁.reverse.length := by
    by_contra hcon
    exact hl₁ne (hbefore _ (by omega))
  rcases eq_or_lt_of_le hj'le with heq | hlt
  · 
    exfalso
    apply not_single_nonempty (N := N) (d := d) hr hpos
      (i₀ := ⟨rest₁.reverse.length, hi'⟩)
    intro m hm
    have hmv : m.val ≠ rest₁.reverse.length := fun h => hm (Fin.ext h)
    rcases lt_or_gt_of_ne hmv with h | h
    · exact hbefore m.val (by omega)
    · exact hafter m.val h m.isLt
  · 
    rw [hl₁] at hx
    rw [hl₂] at hy
    by_cases hadj : rest₁.reverse.length = r - 1 ∧ pre₂.length = 0
    · 
      obtain ⟨hi'eq, hj'eq⟩ := hadj
      have hfin : (⟨rest₁.reverse.length, hi'⟩ : Fin r) + 1
          = ⟨pre₂.length, hj'⟩ := by
        have h1 : (⟨rest₁.reverse.length, hi'⟩ : Fin r) = ⟨r - 1, by omega⟩ := by
          ext; simp [hi'eq]
        have h2 : (⟨pre₂.length, hj'⟩ : Fin r) = ⟨0, by omega⟩ := by
          ext; simp [hj'eq]
        rw [h1, h2]
        exact fin_mk_last_succ hr
      refine junction_adj hr hs ⟨rest₁.reverse.length, hi'⟩ x hx y ?_
      rw [hfin]
      exact hy
    · 
      have hX : ce N d (w ((⟨rest₁.reverse.length, hi'⟩ : Fin r) + 1)) < 0 := by
        by_cases hi'top : rest₁.reverse.length = r - 1
        · have hj'pos : 0 < pre₂.length := by
            rcases Nat.eq_zero_or_pos pre₂.length with h0 | h0
            · exact absurd ⟨hi'top, h0⟩ hadj
            · exact h0
          have hnil := hbefore 0 hj'pos
          have hsig := (chunk_eq_nil_iff.mp hnil).1
          have hfin : (⟨rest₁.reverse.length, hi'⟩ : Fin r) + 1
              = ⟨0, by omega⟩ := by
            have h1 : (⟨rest₁.reverse.length, hi'⟩ : Fin r)
                = ⟨r - 1, by omega⟩ := by
              ext; simp [hi'top]
            rw [h1]
            exact fin_mk_last_succ hr
          rw [hfin]
          exact hsig
        · have hlt2 : rest₁.reverse.length + 1 < r := by omega
          have hnil := hafter (rest₁.reverse.length + 1) (by omega) hlt2
          have hsig := (chunk_eq_nil_iff.mp hnil).1
          rw [fin_mk_succ hr hlt2]
          exact hsig
      have hY : ce N d (w (⟨pre₂.length, hj'⟩ : Fin r)) ≤ 0 := by
        by_cases hj0 : pre₂.length = 0
        · have hi'lt : rest₁.reverse.length < r - 1 := by
            rcases Nat.lt_or_ge rest₁.reverse.length (r - 1) with h0 | h0
            · exact h0
            · exact absurd ⟨by omega, hj0⟩ hadj
          have hnil := hafter (r - 1) (by omega) (by omega)
          have hsig := (chunk_eq_nil_iff.mp hnil).2
          have hfin : (⟨r - 1, by omega⟩ : Fin r) + 1 = ⟨pre₂.length, hj'⟩ := by
            have h2 : (⟨pre₂.length, hj'⟩ : Fin r) = ⟨0, by omega⟩ := by
              ext; simp [hj0]
            rw [h2]
            exact fin_mk_last_succ hr
          rw [← hfin]
          exact hsig
        · have hnil := hbefore (pre₂.length - 1) (by omega)
          have hsig := (chunk_eq_nil_iff.mp hnil).2
          have hfin : (⟨pre₂.length - 1, by omega⟩ : Fin r) + 1
              = ⟨pre₂.length, hj'⟩ := by
            rw [fin_mk_succ hr (show pre₂.length - 1 + 1 < r by omega)]
            ext
            simp
            omega
          rw [← hfin]
          exact hsig
      have hij : (⟨rest₁.reverse.length, hi'⟩ : Fin r)
          ≠ ⟨pre₂.length, hj'⟩ := by
        simp only [ne_eq, Fin.mk.injEq]
        omega
      exact junction_gap hr hs hij hX hY x hx y hy

name: areaForm_as_affine
statement:
theorem areaForm_as_affine (n a b x : Point) :
    areaForm n a b x = dotQ (crossQ n (b - a)) x - dotQ (crossQ n (b - a)) a
proof:
:= by
  simp only [areaForm, dotQ, crossQ, mkPoint_zero, mkPoint_one, mkPoint_two,
    Pi.sub_apply]
  ring

name: EPair.goodPair
statement:
theorem EPair.goodPair (hr : 3 ≤ r) (hpl : OnPlane n c w) (hs : StrictConv n w)
    {u u' : Point} (h : EPair n N d w u u') :
    ∀ y ∈ walk N d w, y ≠ u → y ≠ u' → 0 < areaForm n u u' y
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨i, α, β, _hα, hαβ, _hβ, hu, hu', hconf⟩ := h
  intro y hy hyu hyu'
  have hfeas := eta_nonneg_of_mem_walk hr hpl hs hy i
  have hne : eta n w i y ≠ 0 := by
    intro h0
    rcases hconf y hy h0 with h1 | h1
    · exact hyu h1
    · exact hyu' h1
  rw [hu, hu', areaForm_sub_edge]
  exact mul_pos (by linarith) (lt_of_le_of_ne hfeas (Ne.symm hne))

name: CPair.goodPair
statement:
theorem CPair.goodPair (hr : 3 ≤ r) (hpl : OnPlane n c w) (hs : StrictConv n w)
    (hpos : ∃ i, 0 < ce N d (w i)) (hneg : ∃ i, ce N d (w i) < 0)
    {u u' : Point} (h : CPair N d w u u') :
    ∀ y ∈ walk N d w, y ≠ u → y ≠ u' → 0 < areaForm n u u' y
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨humem, hu'mem, huce, hu'ce, huu', i, hin, hexit⟩ := h
  intro y hy hyu hyu'
  have hn := n_ne_zero_of_strict hr hs
  
  have hyce : 0 < ce N d y := by
    rcases lt_or_eq_of_le (ce_nonneg_of_mem_walk hy) with h0 | h0
    · exact h0
    · exfalso
      rcases online_le_two hr hpl hs hpos hneg hy humem hu'mem h0.symm huce hu'ce
        with h1 | h1 | h1
      · exact hyu h1
      · exact hyu' h1
      · exact huu' h1
  
  obtain ⟨α, hα0, hα1, hurep⟩ :
      ∃ α : ℚ, 0 ≤ α ∧ α < 1 ∧ u = w i + α • (w (i + 1) - w i) := by
    rcases hexit with ⟨hp, hue⟩ | ⟨hz, hue⟩
    · have hprod := mul_neg_of_pos_of_neg hp hin
      exact ⟨cutT N d (w i) (w (i + 1)), (cutT_pos hprod).le,
        cutT_lt_one hprod, hue⟩
    · exact ⟨0, le_refl 0, zero_lt_one, by rw [hue, zero_smul, add_zero]⟩
  have hroot_u : (1 - α) * ce N d (w i) + α * ce N d (w (i + 1)) = 0 := by
    have h0 := huce
    rw [hurep, ce_line] at h0
    exact h0
  have hABpos : 0 < ce N d (w i) - ce N d (w (i + 1)) := by
    rcases hexit with ⟨hp, _⟩ | ⟨hz, _⟩
    · linarith
    · linarith
  
  have hu'eta : 0 < eta n w i u' := by
    rcases lt_or_eq_of_le (eta_nonneg_of_mem_walk hr hpl hs hu'mem i) with h0 | h0
    · exact h0
    · exfalso
      obtain ⟨s, _hs0, _hs1, hrep⟩ := feasible_eta_zero_mem_edge hr hpl hs i
        (on_plane_of_mem_walk hpl hu'mem)
        (eta_nonneg_of_mem_walk hr hpl hs hu'mem) h0.symm
      have hceu' : (1 - s) * ce N d (w i) + s * ce N d (w (i + 1)) = 0 := by
        rw [← ce_comb N d (show (1 - s) + s = 1 by ring), ← hrep]
        exact hu'ce
      have h5 : (s - α) * (ce N d (w (i + 1)) - ce N d (w i)) = 0 := by
        linear_combination hceu' - hroot_u
      have hsα : s = α := by
        have h6 := (mul_eq_zero.mp h5).resolve_right (by linarith)
        have := sub_eq_zero.mp h6
        linarith [this]
      apply huu'
      rw [hurep, line_comb, hrep, hsα]
  
  have hkey := areaForm_sub_edge n (w i) (w (i + 1)) u' α 1
  rw [show w i + (1 : ℚ) • (w (i + 1) - w i) = w (i + 1) by
    rw [one_smul]; abel] at hkey
  have hpsineg : areaForm n u u' (w (i + 1)) < 0 := by
    rw [areaForm_swap, hurep, hkey]
    have h7 : 0 < (1 - α) * areaForm n (w i) (w (i + 1)) u' :=
      mul_pos (by linarith) hu'eta
    linarith
  
  have h1b : dotQ (crossQ n (u' - u)) u' = dotQ (crossQ n (u' - u)) u := by
    have h0 := areaForm_self_right n u u'
    rw [areaForm_as_affine] at h0
    linarith
  have h2a : dotQ N u = d := by
    have h0 := huce
    simp only [ce] at h0
    linarith
  have h2b : dotQ N u' = d := by
    have h0 := hu'ce
    simp only [ce] at h0
    linarith
  have hind : areaForm n u u' (w (i + 1)) ≠ 0 := ne_of_lt hpsineg
  have hprop := prop_on_plane hn (on_plane_of_mem_walk hpl humem)
    (on_plane_of_mem_walk hpl hu'mem) (hpl (i + 1)) hind
    (m₁ := crossQ n (u' - u)) (d₁ := dotQ (crossQ n (u' - u)) u)
    rfl h1b h2a h2b (on_plane_of_mem_walk hpl hy)
  rw [← areaForm_as_affine n u u' y, ← areaForm_as_affine n u u' (w (i + 1))]
    at hprop
  have hce1 : dotQ N (w (i + 1)) - d = ce N d (w (i + 1)) := rfl
  have hce2 : dotQ N y - d = ce N d y := rfl
  rw [hce1, hce2] at hprop
  nlinarith

name: WalkAdj.goodPair
statement:
theorem WalkAdj.goodPair (hr : 3 ≤ r) (hpl : OnPlane n c w) (hs : StrictConv n w)
    (hpos : ∃ i, 0 < ce N d (w i)) (hneg : ∃ i, ce N d (w i) < 0)
    {u u' : Point} (h : WalkAdj n N d w u u') :
    ∀ y ∈ walk N d w, y ≠ u → y ≠ u' → 0 < areaForm n u u' y
proof:
:= by
  rcases h with h | h
  · exact h.goodPair hr hpl hs
  · exact h.goodPair hr hpl hs hpos hneg

name: cyclic_transition
statement:
theorem cyclic_transition {P : Fin r → Prop} {i₀ j₀ : Fin r}
    (hP : P i₀) (hnP : ¬ P j₀) : ∃ i : Fin r, P i ∧ ¬ P (i + 1)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  by_contra hcon
  push_neg at hcon
  have hstep : ∀ m : ℕ, P (i₀ + (m : Fin r)) := by
    intro m
    induction m with
    | zero => simpa using hP
    | succ k ih =>
      have h1 := hcon _ ih
      have h2 : i₀ + ((k : ℕ) : Fin r) + 1 = i₀ + (((k + 1 : ℕ)) : Fin r) := by
        push_cast
        ring
      rwa [h2] at h1
  have h3 := hstep ((j₀ - i₀).val)
  rw [Fin.cast_val_eq_self, add_sub_cancel] at h3
  exact hnP h3

name: exists_exit
statement:
theorem exists_exit (hpos : ∃ i, 0 < ce N d (w i))
    (hneg : ∃ i, ce N d (w i) < 0) :
    ∃ i, 0 ≤ ce N d (w i) ∧ ce N d (w (i + 1)) < 0
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨ip, hip⟩ := hpos
  obtain ⟨iq, hiq⟩ := hneg
  obtain ⟨i, h1, h2⟩ := cyclic_transition (P := fun i => 0 ≤ ce N d (w i))
    hip.le (not_le.mpr hiq)
  exact ⟨i, h1, not_le.mp h2⟩

name: exists_entry
statement:
theorem exists_entry (hpos : ∃ i, 0 < ce N d (w i))
    (hneg : ∃ i, ce N d (w i) < 0) :
    ∃ j, ce N d (w j) ≤ 0 ∧ 0 < ce N d (w (j + 1))
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨ip, hip⟩ := hpos
  obtain ⟨iq, hiq⟩ := hneg
  obtain ⟨j, h1, h2⟩ := cyclic_transition (P := fun i => ce N d (w i) ≤ 0)
    hiq.le (not_le.mpr hip)
  exact ⟨j, h1, not_le.mp h2⟩

name: three_le_length_of_mem
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have hsub : ({a, b, e} : Finset Point) ⊆ l.toFinset := by
    intro x hx
    simp only [Finset.mem_insert, Finset.mem_singleton] at hx
    rcases hx with rfl | rfl | rfl <;> simpa [List.mem_toFinset]
  have hcard : ({a, b, e} : Finset Point).card = 3 := by
    rw [Finset.card_insert_of_not_mem (by simp [hab, hae]),
      Finset.card_insert_of_not_mem (by simp [hbe]),
      Finset.card_singleton]
  calc 3 = ({a, b, e} : Finset Point).card := hcard.symm
    _ ≤ l.toFinset.card := Finset.card_le_card hsub
    _ ≤ l.length := List.toFinset_card_le l

name: three_le_walk_length
statement:
theorem three_le_walk_length (hr : 3 ≤ r) (hs : StrictConv n w)
    (hpos : ∃ i, 0 < ce N d (w i)) (hneg : ∃ i, ce N d (w i) < 0) :
    3 ≤ (walk N d w).length
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨i, hi0, hi1⟩ := exists_exit hpos hneg
  obtain ⟨j, hj0, hj1⟩ := exists_entry hpos hneg
  have hij : i ≠ j := by
    intro hcon
    rw [hcon] at hi1
    linarith
  obtain ⟨ip, hip⟩ := hpos
  
  have hvp : w ip ∈ walk N d w := w_mem_walk hip.le
  obtain ⟨u, hu, huce, hutag⟩ : ∃ u, u ∈ walk N d w ∧ ce N d u = 0 ∧
      ((0 < ce N d (w i) ∧ u = cutPt N d (w i) (w (i + 1))) ∨
        (ce N d (w i) = 0 ∧ u = w i)) := by
    rcases lt_or_eq_of_le hi0 with h | h
    · exact ⟨_, cut_mem_walk (mul_neg_of_pos_of_neg h hi1),
        ce_cutPt (mul_neg_of_pos_of_neg h hi1), Or.inl ⟨h, rfl⟩⟩
    · exact ⟨w i, w_mem_walk hi0, h.symm, Or.inr ⟨h.symm, rfl⟩⟩
  obtain ⟨u', hu', hu'ce, hu'tag⟩ : ∃ u', u' ∈ walk N d w ∧ ce N d u' = 0 ∧
      ((ce N d (w j) < 0 ∧ 0 < ce N d (w (j + 1)) ∧
          u' = cutPt N d (w j) (w (j + 1))) ∨
        (ce N d (w j) = 0 ∧ u' = w j)) := by
    rcases lt_or_eq_of_le hj0 with h | h
    · exact ⟨_, cut_mem_walk (mul_neg_of_neg_of_pos h hj1),
        ce_cutPt (mul_neg_of_neg_of_pos h hj1), Or.inl ⟨h, hj1, rfl⟩⟩
    · exact ⟨w j, w_mem_walk (le_of_eq h.symm), h, Or.inr ⟨h, rfl⟩⟩
  have huu' : u ≠ u' := by
    rcases hutag with ⟨hp, rfl⟩ | ⟨hz, rfl⟩ <;>
      rcases hu'tag with ⟨hn', hp', rfl⟩ | ⟨hz', rfl⟩
    · exact cut_ne_cut hr hs (mul_neg_of_pos_of_neg hp hi1) hij
    · exact cut_ne_vertex hr hs (mul_neg_of_pos_of_neg hp hi1) j
    · exact (cut_ne_vertex hr hs (mul_neg_of_neg_of_pos hn' hp') i).symm
    · exact fun hcon => hij (strictConv_injective hr hs hcon)
  have h1 : u ≠ w ip := by
    intro hcon
    rw [hcon] at huce
    linarith
  have h2 : u' ≠ w ip := by
    intro hcon
    rw [hcon] at hu'ce
    linarith
  exact three_le_length_of_mem hu hu' hvp huu' h1 h2

name: walk_length_neZero
statement:
theorem walk_length_neZero (hpos : ∃ i, 0 < ce N d (w i)) :
    NeZero (walk N d w).length
proof:
:=
  ⟨fun h => walk_ne_nil hpos (List.length_eq_zero.mp h)⟩

name: walkCycle_adj
statement:
theorem walkCycle_adj (hr : 3 ≤ r) (hs : StrictConv n w)
    (hpos : ∃ i, 0 < ce N d (w i)) (hneg : ∃ i, ce N d (w i) < 0)
    [NeZero (walk N d w).length] (k : Fin (walk N d w).length) :
    WalkAdj n N d w (walkCycle N d w k) (walkCycle N d w (k + 1))
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have hL : 3 ≤ (walk N d w).length := three_le_walk_length hr hs hpos hneg
  have hch := chain'_walk_cyclic (n := n) hr hs hpos
  rw [List.chain'_iff_get] at hch
  have hlen1 : (walk N d w ++ (walk N d w).take 1).length
      = (walk N d w).length + 1 := by
    rw [List.length_append, List.length_take]
    omega
  have hk : k.val < (walk N d w ++ (walk N d w).take 1).length - 1 := by
    have := k.isLt
    omega
  have hpair := hch k.val hk
  have h1 : (walk N d w ++ (walk N d w).take 1).get ⟨k.val, by omega⟩
      = walkCycle N d w k := by
    simp only [walkCycle, List.get_eq_getElem]
    exact List.getElem_append_left k.isLt
  rw [h1] at hpair
  by_cases hkL : k.val + 1 < (walk N d w).length
  · have hfin : k + 1 = (⟨k.val + 1, hkL⟩ : Fin (walk N d w).length) := by
      conv_lhs => rw [← Fin.eta k k.isLt]
      exact fin_mk_succ hL hkL
    have h2 : (walk N d w ++ (walk N d w).take 1).get ⟨k.val + 1, by omega⟩
        = walkCycle N d w (k + 1) := by
      simp only [walkCycle, List.get_eq_getElem, hfin]
      exact List.getElem_append_left hkL
    rwa [h2] at hpair
  · have hkeq : k.val + 1 = (walk N d w).length := by
      have := k.isLt
      omega
    have hfin : k + 1 = (⟨0, by omega⟩ : Fin (walk N d w).length) := by
      conv_lhs => rw [← Fin.eta k k.isLt]
      have hkv : k.val = (walk N d w).length - 1 := by omega
      have : (⟨k.val, k.isLt⟩ : Fin (walk N d w).length)
          = ⟨(walk N d w).length - 1, by omega⟩ := by
        ext
        simpa using hkv
      rw [this]
      exact fin_mk_last_succ hL
    have h2 : (walk N d w ++ (walk N d w).take 1).get ⟨k.val + 1, by omega⟩
        = walkCycle N d w (k + 1) := by
      simp only [walkCycle, List.get_eq_getElem, hfin]
      rw [List.getElem_append_right (by omega)]
      simp only [hkeq, Nat.sub_self]
      rw [List.getElem_take]
    rwa [h2] at hpair

name: walkCycle_onPlane
statement:
theorem walkCycle_onPlane (hpl : OnPlane n c w)
    [NeZero (walk N d w).length] :
    OnPlane n c (walkCycle N d w)
proof:
:=
  fun k => on_plane_of_mem_walk hpl (List.get_mem _ k)

name: walkCycle_strictConv
statement:
theorem walkCycle_strictConv (hr : 3 ≤ r) (hpl : OnPlane n c w)
    (hs : StrictConv n w)
    (hpos : ∃ i, 0 < ce N d (w i)) (hneg : ∃ i, ce N d (w i) < 0)
    [NeZero (walk N d w).length] :
    StrictConv n (walkCycle N d w)
proof:
:= by
  intro i j hj1 hj2
  have hadj := walkCycle_adj hr hs hpos hneg i
  have hnd := walk_nodup (N := N) (d := d) hr hs
  have hmem : walkCycle N d w j ∈ walk N d w := List.get_mem _ _
  have hne1 : walkCycle N d w j ≠ walkCycle N d w i := by
    intro hcon
    exact hj1 (hnd.get_inj_iff.mp hcon)
  have hne2 : walkCycle N d w j ≠ walkCycle N d w (i + 1) := by
    intro hcon
    exact hj2 (hnd.get_inj_iff.mp hcon)
  exact hadj.goodPair hr hpl hs hpos hneg _ hmem hne1 hne2

name: range_walkCycle
statement:
theorem range_walkCycle [NeZero (walk N d w).length] :
    Set.range (walkCycle N d w) = {y | y ∈ walk N d w}
proof:
:= by
  ext y
  simp only [Set.mem_range, Set.mem_setOf_eq, walkCycle]
  exact ⟨fun ⟨k, hk⟩ => hk ▸ List.get_mem _ _, fun h => by
    obtain ⟨k, hk⟩ := List.mem_iff_get.mp h
    exact ⟨k, hk⟩⟩

name: convex_ce_nonneg
statement:
theorem convex_ce_nonneg (N : Point) (d : ℚ) :
    Convex ℚ {x : Point | 0 ≤ ce N d x}
proof:
:= by
  intro x hx y hy a b ha hb hab
  simp only [Set.mem_setOf_eq] at hx hy ⊢
  rw [ce_comb N d hab]
  exact add_nonneg (mul_nonneg ha hx) (mul_nonneg hb hy)

name: dotQ_n_cutDir
statement: theorem dotQ_n_cutDir (n N : Point) : dotQ n (crossQ n N) = 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [dotQ_crossQ_cyclic, crossQ_self, dotQ_zero_right]

name: dotQ_N_cutDir
statement: theorem dotQ_N_cutDir (n N : Point) : dotQ N (crossQ n N) = 0
proof:
:= by
  have h := dotQ_crossQ_cyclic N n N
  rw [crossQ_anticomm N n, dotQ_neg_right] at h
  linarith

name: cutDir_ne_zero
statement:
theorem cutDir_ne_zero (hr : 3 ≤ r) (hpl : OnPlane n c w) (hs : StrictConv n w)
    (hpos : ∃ i, 0 < ce N d (w i)) (hneg : ∃ i, ce N d (w i) < 0) :
    crossQ n N ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  intro hcon
  have hcon' : crossQ N n = 0 := by rw [crossQ_anticomm, hcon, neg_zero]
  obtain ⟨t, ht⟩ := exists_smul_of_crossQ_eq_zero (n_ne_zero_of_strict hr hs)
    hcon'
  obtain ⟨ip, hip⟩ := hpos
  obtain ⟨iq, hiq⟩ := hneg
  have hval : ∀ i : Fin r, ce N d (w i) = t * c - d := by
    intro i
    have hdot : dotQ N (w i) = t * dotQ n (w i) := by
      rw [ht]
      simp only [dotQ, Pi.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul]
      ring
    simp only [ce, hdot, hpl i]
  rw [hval ip] at hip
  rw [hval iq] at hiq
  linarith

name: edge_point_mem_hull
statement:
theorem edge_point_mem_hull (i : Fin r) {s : ℚ} (hs0 : 0 ≤ s) (hs1 : s ≤ 1)
    (hce : 0 ≤ ce N d ((1 - s) • w i + s • w (i + 1))) :
    (1 - s) • w i + s • w (i + 1)
      ∈ convexHull ℚ {y | y ∈ walk N d w}
proof:
:= by
  classical
  set a := ce N d (w i) with hadef
  set b := ce N d (w (i + 1)) with hbdef
  have hcomb : ce N d ((1 - s) • w i + s • w (i + 1)) = (1 - s) * a + s * b :=
    ce_comb N d (by ring) _ _
  rw [hcomb] at hce
  have hmem : ∀ {y : Point}, y ∈ walk N d w →
      y ∈ convexHull ℚ {y | y ∈ walk N d w} := fun hy =>
    subset_convexHull ℚ _ hy
  rcases le_or_lt 0 a with ha | ha <;> rcases le_or_lt 0 b with hb | hb
  · 
    exact (convex_convexHull ℚ _) (hmem (w_mem_walk ha)) (hmem (w_mem_walk hb))
      (by linarith) hs0 (by ring)
  · 
    rcases eq_or_lt_of_le ha with ha0 | hapos
    · 
      have hs00 : s = 0 := by nlinarith
      have : (1 - s) • w i + s • w (i + 1) = w i := by
        rw [hs00]
        funext k
        simp
      rw [this]
      exact hmem (w_mem_walk ha)
    · 
      have hprod : a * b < 0 := mul_neg_of_pos_of_neg hapos hb
      set t := cutT N d (w i) (w (i + 1)) with htdef
      have ht : t = a / (a - b) := rfl
      have htpos : 0 < t := cutT_pos hprod
      have hst : s ≤ t := by
        rw [ht, le_div_iff₀ (by linarith)]
        nlinarith
      have hXmem := hmem (cut_mem_walk hprod)
      have hX : cutPt N d (w i) (w (i + 1)) = (1 - t) • w i + t • w (i + 1) :=
        cutPt_comb N d _ _
      have hrep : (1 - s) • w i + s • w (i + 1)
          = (1 - s / t) • w i + (s / t) • cutPt N d (w i) (w (i + 1)) := by
        rw [hX]
        funext k
        simp only [Pi.add_apply, Pi.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul]
        field_simp
        ring
      rw [hrep]
      exact (convex_convexHull ℚ _) (hmem (w_mem_walk hapos.le)) hXmem
        (by rw [sub_nonneg, div_le_one htpos]; exact hst)
        (div_nonneg hs0 htpos.le) (by field_simp)
  · 
    rcases eq_or_lt_of_le hb with hb0 | hbpos
    · 
      have hs11 : s = 1 := by nlinarith
      have : (1 - s) • w i + s • w (i + 1) = w (i + 1) := by
        rw [hs11]
        funext k
        simp
      rw [this]
      exact hmem (w_mem_walk hb)
    · 
      have hprod : a * b < 0 := mul_neg_of_neg_of_pos ha hbpos
      set t := cutT N d (w i) (w (i + 1)) with htdef
      have ht : t = a / (a - b) := rfl
      have htpos : 0 < t := cutT_pos hprod
      have htlt : t < 1 := cutT_lt_one hprod
      have hts : t ≤ s := by
        rw [ht, div_le_iff_of_neg (by linarith : a - b < 0)]
        nlinarith
      have hXmem := hmem (cut_mem_walk hprod)
      have hX : cutPt N d (w i) (w (i + 1)) = (1 - t) • w i + t • w (i + 1) :=
        cutPt_comb N d _ _
      set μ := (s - t) / (1 - t) with hμdef
      have hμ0 : 0 ≤ μ := div_nonneg (by linarith) (by linarith)
      have hμ1 : μ ≤ 1 := by
        rw [hμdef, div_le_one (by linarith)]
        linarith
      have h1t : (1 : ℚ) - t ≠ 0 := by linarith
      have hrep : (1 - s) • w i + s • w (i + 1)
          = (1 - μ) • cutPt N d (w i) (w (i + 1)) + μ • w (i + 1) := by
        rw [hX, hμdef]
        funext k
        simp only [Pi.add_apply, Pi.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul]
        field_simp [h1t]
        ring
      rw [hrep]
      exact (convex_convexHull ℚ _) hXmem (hmem (w_mem_walk hbpos.le))
        (by linarith) hμ0 (by ring)
  · 
    exfalso
    rcases eq_or_lt_of_le hs0 with hs00 | hspos
    · nlinarith
    · nlinarith [mul_neg_of_pos_of_neg hspos hb,
        mul_nonneg (by linarith : (0 : ℚ) ≤ 1 - s) (by linarith : (0 : ℚ) ≤ -a)]

name: vpoly_walkCycle
statement:
theorem vpoly_walkCycle (hr : 3 ≤ r) (hpl : OnPlane n c w) (hs : StrictConv n w)
    (hpos : ∃ i, 0 < ce N d (w i)) (hneg : ∃ i, ce N d (w i) < 0)
    [NeZero (walk N d w).length] :
    vpoly (walkCycle N d w) = vpoly w ∩ {x | 0 ≤ ce N d x}
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have hhull : vpoly (walkCycle N d w) = convexHull ℚ {y | y ∈ walk N d w} := by
    rw [vpoly, range_walkCycle]
  apply Set.Subset.antisymm
  · 
    rw [hhull]
    apply convexHull_min
    · intro y hy
      exact ⟨mem_vpoly_of_mem_walk hy, ce_nonneg_of_mem_walk hy⟩
    · exact (convex_convexHull ℚ _).inter (convex_ce_nonneg N d)
  · 
    rintro z ⟨hz_mem, hz_ce⟩
    simp only [Set.mem_setOf_eq] at hz_ce
    rw [hhull]
    obtain ⟨hzpl, hzfeas⟩ := (Set.ext_iff.mp (vpoly_eq hr hpl hs) z).mp hz_mem
    set dd := crossQ n N with hdddef
    have hddn : dotQ n dd = 0 := dotQ_n_cutDir n N
    have hddN : dotQ N dd = 0 := dotQ_N_cutDir n N
    have hddne : dd ≠ 0 := cutDir_ne_zero hr hpl hs hpos hneg
    
    obtain ⟨shp, iP, sp, hshp, hsp0, hsp1, _, hrepp⟩ :=
      exit_point hr hpl hs hzpl hzfeas hddne hddn
    
    have hddne' : -dd ≠ 0 := neg_ne_zero.mpr hddne
    have hddn' : dotQ n (-dd) = 0 := by rw [dotQ_neg_right, hddn, neg_zero]
    obtain ⟨shm, iM, sm, hshm, hsm0, hsm1, _, hrepm⟩ :=
      exit_point hr hpl hs hzpl hzfeas hddne' hddn'
    
    have hcep : 0 ≤ ce N d ((1 - sp) • w iP + sp • w (iP + 1)) := by
      rw [← hrepp, ce_add_smul, hddN]
      linarith
    have hcem : 0 ≤ ce N d ((1 - sm) • w iM + sm • w (iM + 1)) := by
      rw [← hrepm, ce_add_smul]
      have : dotQ N (-dd) = 0 := by rw [dotQ_neg_right, hddN, neg_zero]
      rw [this]
      linarith
    have hmemp := edge_point_mem_hull (N := N) (d := d) iP hsp0 hsp1 hcep
    have hmemm := edge_point_mem_hull (N := N) (d := d) iM hsm0 hsm1 hcem
    rw [← hrepp] at hmemp
    rw [← hrepm] at hmemm
    
    rcases eq_or_lt_of_le (by linarith : (0 : ℚ) ≤ shp + shm) with hzero | hsum
    · 
      have hp0 : shp = 0 := by linarith
      have hz' : z + shp • dd = z := by
        rw [hp0]
        funext k
        simp
      rwa [hz'] at hmemp
    · have hrepz : z = (shm / (shp + shm)) • (z + shp • dd)
          + (shp / (shp + shm)) • (z + shm • (-dd)) := by
        funext k
        simp only [Pi.add_apply, Pi.smul_apply, Pi.neg_apply, smul_eq_mul]
        field_simp [hsum.ne']
        ring
      rw [hrepz]
      exact (convex_convexHull ℚ _) hmemp hmemm
        (div_nonneg hshm hsum.le) (div_nonneg hshp hsum.le)
        (by field_simp [hsum.ne']; ring)

name: apexQ_onPlane
statement:
theorem apexQ_onPlane (hpl : OnPlane nt ct u) :
    dotQ nt (∑ j, (m : ℚ)⁻¹ • u j) = ct
proof:
:= by
  have hm0 : (m : ℚ) ≠ 0 := by
    exact_mod_cast (NeZero.ne m)
  exact dotQ_comb nt u (by
    rw [Finset.sum_const, Finset.card_univ, Fintype.card_fin, nsmul_eq_mul,
      mul_inv_cancel₀ hm0]) hpl

name: sum_filter_map
statement:
theorem sum_filter_map {α : Type} (p : α → Bool) (F : α → ℤ) (l : List α) :
    ((l.filter p).map F).sum
      = (l.map (fun x => if p x = true then F x else 0)).sum
proof:
:= by
  induction l with
  | nil => rfl
  | cons a t ih =>
    rw [List.filter_cons, List.map_cons]
    by_cases hp : p a = true
    · rw [if_pos hp, if_pos hp, List.map_cons, List.sum_cons, List.sum_cons,
        ih]
    · rw [if_neg hp, if_neg hp, List.sum_cons, ih, zero_add]

name: winding_meshChain_map
statement:
theorem winding_meshChain_map (m : Mesh) (Q : Point) :
    winding (meshChain m) Q
      = (m.toList.map (fun τ =>
          orientSign τ * (if Q ∈ simplex τ then 1 else 0))).sum
proof:
:= by
  unfold winding meshChain
  rw [Array.toList_map, List.map_map]
  congr 1
  apply List.map_congr_left
  intro τ _
  show (if Q ∈ simplex τ then orientSign τ else 0) = _
  by_cases h : Q ∈ simplex τ
  · rw [if_pos h, if_pos h, mul_one]
  · rw [if_neg h, if_neg h, mul_zero]

name: ite_and_mul
statement:
theorem ite_and_mul (A B : Prop) [Decidable A] [Decidable B] :
    (if A ∧ B then (1 : ℤ) else 0)
      = (if A then 1 else 0) * (if B then 1 else 0)
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hA : A <;> by_cases hB : B <;>
    simp [hA, hB]

name: sum_map_eq_finSum
statement:
theorem sum_map_eq_finSum {α : Type} (l : List α) (F : α → ℤ) :
    (l.map F).sum = ∑ k : Fin l.length, F l[k]
proof:
:= by
  conv_lhs => rw [← List.ofFn_getElem l]
  rw [List.map_ofFn, List.sum_ofFn]
  rfl

name: filter_flatMap
statement:
theorem filter_flatMap {α β : Type} (l : List α) (B : α → List β)
    (p : β → Bool) :
    (l.flatMap B).filter p = l.flatMap (fun a => (B a).filter p)
proof:
:= by
  induction l with
  | nil => rfl
  | cons a t ih =>
    rw [List.flatMap_cons, List.flatMap_cons, List.filter_append, ih]

name: dotQ_psub_right
statement: theorem dotQ_psub_right (n a b : Point) : dotQ n (psub a b) = dotQ n a - dotQ n b
proof:
:= by
  simp only [dotQ, psub]; ring

name: edge_vec_ne_zero
statement:
theorem edge_vec_ne_zero {M : Mesh} (hnpo : NoPlaneThroughOrigin M) (u : Fin M.size) (k : Fin 3) :
    psub (edgeHead M[u] k) (edgeTail M[u] k) ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  fin_cases k
  · show psub M[u].v₁ M[u].v₀ ≠ 0
    intro h; apply faceNormal_ne_zero (hnpo u); rw [Proof.MeshIntersectJump.faceNormal, h]; exact Proof.MeshIntersectRayClassifyGen.crossQ_zero_left _
  · show psub M[u].v₂ M[u].v₁ ≠ 0
    intro h; apply faceNormal_ne_zero (hnpo u); rw [Proof.MeshIntersectJump.faceNormal]
    have he : psub M[u].v₂ M[u].v₀ = psub M[u].v₁ M[u].v₀ := by
      funext i; have := congrFun h i; simp only [psub, Pi.zero_apply] at this ⊢; linarith
    rw [he]; exact Proof.MeshIntersectClip.crossQ_self _
  · show psub M[u].v₀ M[u].v₂ ≠ 0
    intro h; apply faceNormal_ne_zero (hnpo u); rw [Proof.MeshIntersectJump.faceNormal]
    have he : psub M[u].v₂ M[u].v₀ = 0 := by
      funext i; have := congrFun h i; simp only [psub, Pi.zero_apply] at this ⊢; linarith
    rw [he]; exact Proof.MeshIntersectRayClassifyGen.crossQ_zero_right _

name: ofPoint_P3toPoint
statement: theorem ofPoint_P3toPoint (p : P3) : ofPoint (P3.toPoint p) = p
proof:
:= by
  cases p with
  | mk x y z =>
    simp only [ofPoint, P3.toPoint, mkPoint_zero, mkPoint_one, mkPoint_two]

name: exists_multi_count_eq_off_negligible
statement:
theorem exists_multi_count_eq_off_negligible {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι]
    (Ms : ι → Mesh) (ds : ι → Point) (Q : Point)
    (hQ : ∀ i, Q ∉ surface (Ms i)) (hadm : ∀ i, AdmissibleRay (Ms i) Q (ds i))
    {N : Set Point} (hN : Negligible N) :
    ∃ P, (∀ i, crossingCount (Ms i) P (ds i) = crossingCount (Ms i) Q (ds i)) ∧ P ∉ N
proof:
:= by
  classical
  
  set ρ : Type _ := Σ i : ι, Fin (Ms i).size × Fin 4 with hρ
  
  set G : ρ → (Point →ᵃ[ℚ] ℚ) :=
    fun p => (Proof.SurfaceBridge.wfam (Ms p.1)[p.2.1] (ds p.1) Q p.2.2).1 with hG
  set S : ρ → ℚ :=
    fun p => (Proof.SurfaceBridge.wfam (Ms p.1)[p.2.1] (ds p.1) Q p.2.2).2 with hS
  have hSsign : ∀ p, S p = 1 ∨ S p = -1 :=
    fun p => Proof.SurfaceBridge.wfam_sign (Ms p.1)[p.2.1] (ds p.1) Q p.2.2
  
  have hQtri : ∀ (i : ι) (u : Fin (Ms i).size), Q ∉ triangleSet (Ms i)[u] :=
    fun i u hmem => hQ i (Set.mem_iUnion.mpr ⟨u, hmem⟩)
  have hQedge : ∀ (i : ι) (u : Fin (Ms i).size) (s : ℚ), 0 < s → Q + s • ds i ∉ edgeSet (Ms i)[u] :=
    fun i u s hs => (hadm i).2 u s hs
  have hStrict : ∀ p, 0 < S p * G p Q :=
    fun p => Proof.SurfaceBridge.wfam_strict (hQtri p.1 p.2.1) (hQedge p.1 p.2.1) p.2.2
  obtain ⟨P, hPcell, hPN⟩ :=
    Proof.SurfaceBridge.exists_off_negligible_in_cell' G S hSsign hStrict hN
  refine ⟨P, fun i => ?_, hPN⟩
  rw [Proof.SurfaceBridge.crossingCount_eq_sum, Proof.SurfaceBridge.crossingCount_eq_sum]
  refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun u _ => ?_)
  refine Proof.SurfaceBridge.wfam_forces (fun j => ?_)
  exact hPcell ⟨i, (u, j)⟩

name: crossingCount_eq_windOf
statement:
theorem crossingCount_eq_windOf {X : Mesh} (hcyc : IsClosedOrientedSurface X)
    (hns : NoFaceInteriorContact X) {O : Point}
    (hnpo : Legacy.NoPlaneThroughOrigin (trMesh O X))
    {P : Point} (hclean : G1Clean (trMesh O X) (trPoint O P))
    {d : Point} (hadm : AdmissibleRay X P d) :
    crossingCount X P d = windOf O X P
proof:
:=
  Proof.MeshIntersectM2Core.crossingCount_eq_winding hcyc hns hnpo hclean hadm

name: solid_iff_windOf
statement:
theorem solid_iff_windOf {X : Mesh} (hcyc : IsClosedOrientedSurface X)
    (hns : NoFaceInteriorContact X) {O : Point}
    (hnpo : Legacy.NoPlaneThroughOrigin (trMesh O X))
    {P : Point} (hclean : G1Clean (trMesh O X) (trPoint O P)) :
    P ∈ solid X ↔ windOf O X P ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro hmem
    obtain ⟨d, hadm⟩ := Proof.MeshIntersectM2Kit.exists_admissible X P
    rw [← crossingCount_eq_windOf hcyc hns hnpo hclean hadm]
    exact hmem d hadm
  · intro hne d hadm
    rw [crossingCount_eq_windOf hcyc hns hnpo hclean hadm]
    exact hne

name: negligible_unclean_pb
proof:
:= by
  have hneg := Proof.WellFormedCheckNormal.negligible_unclean (trMesh O X) hnpo
  have himg := Proof.MeshIntersectM2Kit.negligible_image (-O) hneg
  refine Proof.Negligible.negligible_mono (fun P hP => ?_) himg
  rw [Set.mem_setOf_eq] at hP
  refine ⟨trPoint O P, hP, ?_⟩
  funext i; simp only [trPoint, Pi.neg_apply]; ring

name: crossingCount_eq_of_offSurface
statement:
theorem crossingCount_eq_of_offSurface {X : Mesh} (hcyc : IsClosedOrientedSurface X)
    (hns : NoFaceInteriorContact X) {O : Point}
    (hnpo : Legacy.NoPlaneThroughOrigin (trMesh O X))
    {Q : Point} (hQ : Q ∉ surface X)
    {d d₀ : Point} (hadm : AdmissibleRay X Q d) (hadm₀ : AdmissibleRay X Q d₀) :
    crossingCount X Q d = crossingCount X Q d₀
proof:
:= by
  classical
  
  set Ms : Bool → Mesh := fun _ => X with hMs
  set ds : Bool → Point := fun b => bif b then d₀ else d with hds
  have hQ' : ∀ b, Q ∉ surface (Ms b) := fun _ => hQ
  have hadm' : ∀ b, AdmissibleRay (Ms b) Q (ds b) := by
    intro b; cases b <;> simpa [hMs, hds] using ‹_›
  
  have hN : Negligible
      ({P | ¬ AdmissibleRay X P d} ∪ {P | ¬ AdmissibleRay X P d₀}
        ∪ {P | ¬ G1Clean (trMesh O X) (trPoint O P)}) :=
    Proof.Negligible.negligible_union
      (Proof.Negligible.negligible_union
        (Proof.SurfaceBridge.negligible_not_admissible hadm.1)
        (Proof.SurfaceBridge.negligible_not_admissible hadm₀.1))
      (negligible_unclean_pb hnpo)
  obtain ⟨P, hPcount, hPN⟩ :=
    exists_multi_count_eq_off_negligible Ms ds Q hQ' hadm' hN
  simp only [Set.mem_union, Set.mem_setOf_eq, not_or, not_not] at hPN
  obtain ⟨⟨hPadm, hPadm₀⟩, hPclean⟩ := hPN
  
  have hcd : crossingCount X P d = crossingCount X Q d := by
    have := hPcount false; simpa [hMs, hds] using this
  have hcd₀ : crossingCount X P d₀ = crossingCount X Q d₀ := by
    have := hPcount true; simpa [hMs, hds] using this
  
  rw [← hcd, ← hcd₀,
    crossingCount_eq_windOf hcyc hns hnpo hPclean hPadm,
    crossingCount_eq_windOf hcyc hns hnpo hPclean hPadm₀]

name: solid_iff_count_of_offSurface
statement:
theorem solid_iff_count_of_offSurface {X : Mesh} (hcyc : IsClosedOrientedSurface X)
    (hns : NoFaceInteriorContact X) {O : Point}
    (hnpo : Legacy.NoPlaneThroughOrigin (trMesh O X))
    {Q : Point} (hQ : Q ∉ surface X)
    {d₀ : Point} (hadm₀ : AdmissibleRay X Q d₀) :
    Q ∈ solid X ↔ crossingCount X Q d₀ ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro hmem; exact hmem d₀ hadm₀
  · intro hne d hadm
    rw [crossingCount_eq_of_offSurface hcyc hns hnpo hQ hadm hadm₀]
    exact hne

name: admissibleRay_append_left
statement:
theorem admissibleRay_append_left {A B : Mesh} {Q d : Point}
    (h : AdmissibleRay (A ++ B) Q d) : AdmissibleRay A Q d
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨hd, hedge⟩ := h
  refine ⟨hd, fun i s hs hmem => ?_⟩
  have hb : (i : Nat) < (A ++ B).size := by
    rw [Array.size_append]; exact Nat.lt_of_lt_of_le i.isLt (Nat.le_add_right _ _)
  have hget : (A ++ B)[(i : Nat)]'hb = A[i] := Array.getElem_append_left i.isLt
  refine hedge ⟨(i : Nat), hb⟩ s hs ?_
  rw [show (A ++ B)[(⟨(i : Nat), hb⟩ : Fin (A ++ B).size)] = (A ++ B)[(i : Nat)]'hb from rfl, hget]
  exact hmem

name: admissibleRay_append_right
statement:
theorem admissibleRay_append_right {A B : Mesh} {Q d : Point}
    (h : AdmissibleRay (A ++ B) Q d) : AdmissibleRay B Q d
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨hd, hedge⟩ := h
  refine ⟨hd, fun i s hs hmem => ?_⟩
  have hb : A.size + (i : Nat) < (A ++ B).size := by
    rw [Array.size_append]; exact Nat.add_lt_add_left i.isLt _
  have hget : (A ++ B)[A.size + (i : Nat)]'hb = B[i] := by
    rw [Array.getElem_append_right (Nat.le_add_right _ _)]
    congr 1
    rw [Nat.add_sub_cancel_left]
  refine hedge ⟨A.size + (i : Nat), hb⟩ s hs ?_
  rw [show (A ++ B)[(⟨A.size + (i : Nat), hb⟩ : Fin (A ++ B).size)]
      = (A ++ B)[A.size + (i : Nat)]'hb from rfl, hget]
  exact hmem

name: exists_admissible
statement:
theorem exists_admissible₃ (X₁ X₂ X₃ : Mesh) (Q : Point) :
    ∃ d, AdmissibleRay X₁ Q d ∧ AdmissibleRay X₂ Q d ∧ AdmissibleRay X₃ Q d
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨d, hd⟩ := Proof.MeshIntersectM2Kit.exists_admissible ((X₁ ++ X₂) ++ X₃) Q
  have h12 := admissibleRay_append_left hd
  exact ⟨d, admissibleRay_append_left h12, admissibleRay_append_right h12,
    admissibleRay_append_right hd⟩

name: ekey_inj
statement:
theorem ekey_inj {a b a' b' : Point} :
    ekey a b = ekey a' b' ↔ a = a' ∧ b = b'
proof:
:= by
  unfold ekey
  constructor
  · intro h
    injection h with h0 h1 h2 h3 h4 h5
    refine ⟨funext fun i => ?_, funext fun i => ?_⟩ <;> fin_cases i <;> assumption
  · rintro ⟨rfl, rfl⟩; rfl

name: ekey_swap
statement: theorem ekey_swap (a b : Point) : (ekey a b).swap = ekey b a
proof: := rfl

name: swap_swap
statement: theorem swap_swap (k : EKey) : k.swap.swap = k
proof: := rfl

name: swap_eq_comm
statement: theorem swap_eq_comm (k κ : EKey) : k.swap = κ ↔ k = κ.swap
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro h; rw [← h, swap_swap]
  · intro h; rw [h, swap_swap]

name: step_getD
statement:
theorem step_getD (m : Std.HashMap EKey Int) (k κ : EKey) :
    (step m k).getD κ 0
      = m.getD κ 0 + (if k = κ then 1 else 0) - (if k.swap = κ then 1 else 0)
proof:
:= by
  unfold step bump
  
  rw [Std.HashMap.getD_insert, Std.HashMap.getD_insert, Std.HashMap.getD_insert]
  by_cases h1 : k.swap = κ <;> by_cases h2 : k = κ <;>
    simp_all [beq_iff_eq]
  · 
    
    omega

name: foldl_step_getD
statement:
theorem foldl_step_getD (l : List EKey) (m₀ : Std.HashMap EKey Int) (κ : EKey) :
    (l.foldl step m₀).getD κ 0
      = m₀.getD κ 0 + ((l.count κ : Int) - (l.count κ.swap : Int))
proof:
:= by
  induction l generalizing m₀ with
  | nil => simp
  | cons k rest ih =>
    rw [List.foldl_cons, ih (step m₀ k), step_getD m₀ k κ]
    rw [List.count_cons, List.count_cons]
    
    
    
    
    simp only [beq_iff_eq, swap_eq_comm]
    by_cases h1 : k = κ <;> by_cases h2 : k = κ.swap <;>
      simp only [h1, h2, if_true, if_false] <;> push_cast <;> ring

name: ekeyPair_inj
statement: theorem ekeyPair_inj : Function.Injective (fun e : Point × Point => ekey e.1 e.2)
proof:
:= by
  intro ⟨a, b⟩ ⟨a', b'⟩ h
  simp only at h
  obtain ⟨ha, hb⟩ := ekey_inj.mp h
  simp [ha, hb]

name: array_flatMap_toList
statement:
theorem array_flatMap_toList (M : Mesh) (g : Triangle → Array EKey) :
    (M.flatMap g).toList = M.toList.flatMap (fun t => (g t).toList)
proof:
:= by
  unfold Array.flatMap
  rw [← Array.foldl_toList]
  rw [Array.foldl_toList_eq_flatMap _ _ _ (fun t => (g t).toList) (fun acc a => by simp)]
  rfl

name: edgeKeys_count
statement:
theorem edgeKeys_count (M : Mesh) (a b : Point) :
    (edgeKeys M).toList.count (ekey a b) = (edgeMultiset M).count (a, b)
proof:
:= by
  
  have hlist : (edgeKeys M).toList
      = (M.toList.flatMap faceEdges).map (fun e => ekey e.1 e.2) := by
    rw [edgeKeys, array_flatMap_toList]
    rw [List.map_flatMap]
    apply List.flatMap_congr
    intro t _
    rfl
  rw [hlist]
  
  rw [List.count_map_of_injective _ _ ekeyPair_inj (a, b)]
  
  rw [edgeMultiset, Multiset.coe_count]

name: fold_getD_eq
statement:
theorem fold_getD_eq (M : Mesh) (a b : Point) :
    (let ks := edgeKeys M
     ks.foldl (fun m k => step m k) (∅ : Std.HashMap EKey Int)).getD (ekey a b) 0
      = ((edgeMultiset M).count (a, b) : Int) - ((edgeMultiset M).count (b, a) : Int)
proof:
:= by
  simp only
  rw [← Array.foldl_toList]
  rw [foldl_step_getD (edgeKeys M).toList ∅ (ekey a b)]
  rw [Std.HashMap.getD_emptyc]
  rw [edgeKeys_count, ekey_swap, edgeKeys_count]
  ring

name: mem_edgeKeys
statement:
theorem mem_edgeKeys {M : Mesh} {k : EKey} (hk : k ∈ (edgeKeys M).toList) :
    ∃ a b : Point, k = ekey a b
proof:
:= by
  rw [edgeKeys, array_flatMap_toList, List.mem_flatMap] at hk
  obtain ⟨t, _, hk⟩ := hk
  
  simp only [Array.toList, List.mem_cons, List.mem_singleton] at hk
  rcases hk with h | h | h | h
  · exact ⟨t.v₀, t.v₁, h⟩
  · exact ⟨t.v₁, t.v₂, h⟩
  · exact ⟨t.v₂, t.v₀, h⟩
  · simp at h

name: ekey_mem_of_count_pos
statement:
theorem ekey_mem_of_count_pos {M : Mesh} {a b : Point}
    (h : 0 < (edgeMultiset M).count (a, b)) : ekey a b ∈ (edgeKeys M).toList
proof:
:= by
  rw [← edgeKeys_count] at h
  exact List.count_pos_iff.mp h

name: foldMap_getD
statement:
theorem foldMap_getD (M : Mesh) (a b : Point) :
    ((edgeKeys M).foldl (fun m k => bump (bump m k 1) k.swap (-1))
