      (∅ : Std.HashMap EKey Int)).getD (ekey a b) 0
      = ((edgeMultiset M).count (a, b) : Int) - ((edgeMultiset M).count (b, a) : Int)
proof:
:= by
  have := fold_getD_eq M a b
  simpa [step] using this

name: checkIsCycle_spec
statement:
theorem checkIsCycle_spec (M : Mesh) :
    Impl.WellFormedCheck.checkIsCycle M = true ↔ IsClosedOrientedSurface M
proof:
:= by
  rw [CSG.Proof.MeshIntersectCycle.isCycle_iff_count]
  unfold Impl.WellFormedCheck.checkIsCycle
  simp only
  rw [Array.all_eq_true]
  constructor
  · 
    intro hall a b
    
    by_cases hz : (edgeMultiset M).count (a, b) = 0 ∧ (edgeMultiset M).count (b, a) = 0
    · rw [hz.1, hz.2]
    · 
      
      have key : ∀ x y : Point, ekey x y ∈ (edgeKeys M).toList →
          (edgeMultiset M).count (x, y) = (edgeMultiset M).count (y, x) := by
        intro x y hmem
        obtain ⟨i, hi, hieq⟩ := List.getElem_of_mem hmem
        rw [Array.length_toList] at hi
        have hball := hall ⟨i, hi⟩
        rw [show (edgeKeys M)[(⟨i, hi⟩ : Fin _)] = ekey x y from hieq] at hball
        rw [Bool.and_eq_true, beq_iff_eq, beq_iff_eq] at hball
        rw [foldMap_getD] at hball
        omega
      
      rcases Nat.eq_zero_or_pos ((edgeMultiset M).count (a, b)) with h1 | h1
      · 
        have h2 : 0 < (edgeMultiset M).count (b, a) := by
          rcases Nat.eq_zero_or_pos ((edgeMultiset M).count (b, a)) with h2 | h2
          · exact absurd ⟨h1, h2⟩ hz
          · exact h2
        exact (key b a (ekey_mem_of_count_pos h2)).symm
      · exact key a b (ekey_mem_of_count_pos h1)
  · 
    intro hcount i
    obtain ⟨a, b, hk⟩ := mem_edgeKeys (Array.getElem_mem_toList _ i.2)
    rw [show (edgeKeys M)[i] = ekey a b from hk, Bool.and_eq_true, beq_iff_eq, beq_iff_eq,
      ekey_swap]
    rw [foldMap_getD, foldMap_getD]
    rw [hcount a b, hcount b a]
    constructor <;> ring

name: dotQ_symm
statement: theorem dotQ_symm (a b : Point) : dotQ a b = dotQ b a
proof: := by simp only [dotQ]; ring

name: rayDirAt_eq_ofPoint
statement: theorem rayDirAt_eq_ofPoint (j : ℕ) : rayDirAt j = ofPoint (mdir (j : ℚ))
proof:
:= by
  simp only [ofPoint, mdir, mkPoint_zero, mkPoint_one, mkPoint_two, rayDirAt]

name: mdir_ne_zero
statement: theorem mdir_ne_zero (r : ℚ) : mdir r ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  intro h
  have := congrFun h 0
  simp only [mdir, mkPoint_zero, Pi.zero_apply] at this
  exact one_ne_zero this

name: det3_mdir
statement:
theorem det3_mdir (a b c : ℚ) :
    det3 (mdir a) (mdir b) (mdir c) = (c - b) * (a - b) * (a - c)
proof:
:= by
  simp only [det3, dotQ, crossQ, mdir, mkPoint_zero, mkPoint_one, mkPoint_two]; ring

name: det3_mdir_ne
statement:
theorem det3_mdir_ne {a b c : ℚ} (hab : a ≠ b) (hac : a ≠ c) (hbc : b ≠ c) :
    det3 (mdir a) (mdir b) (mdir c) ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [det3_mdir]
  exact mul_ne_zero (mul_ne_zero (sub_ne_zero.mpr (Ne.symm hbc)) (sub_ne_zero.mpr hab))
    (sub_ne_zero.mpr hac)

name: det3_span_zero
statement:
theorem det3_span_zero (u v : Point) (a0 b0 a1 b1 a2 b2 : ℚ) :
    det3 (a0 • u + b0 • v) (a1 • u + b1 • v) (a2 • u + b2 • v) = 0
proof:
:= by
  simp only [det3, dotQ, crossQ, Pi.add_apply, Pi.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul,
    mkPoint_zero, mkPoint_one, mkPoint_two]; ring

name: card_filter_le_two
statement:
theorem card_filter_le_two {C : Finset ℕ} (P : ℕ → Prop) [DecidablePred P]
    (h3 : ∀ a ∈ C, ∀ b ∈ C, ∀ c ∈ C, P a → P b → P c → a ≠ b → a ≠ c → b ≠ c → False) :
    (C.filter P).card ≤ 2
proof:
:= by
  by_contra h
  rw [not_le] at h
  obtain ⟨a, b, c, ha, hb, hc, hab, hac, hbc⟩ := Finset.two_lt_card_iff.mp h
  rw [Finset.mem_filter] at ha hb hc
  exact h3 a ha.1 b hb.1 c hc.1 ha.2 hb.2 hc.2 hab hac hbc

name: cast_ne
statement: private theorem cast_ne {a b : ℕ} (h : a ≠ b) : (a : ℚ) ≠ (b : ℚ)
proof: := by exact_mod_cast h

name: card_inplane_le_two
statement:
theorem card_inplane_le_two {C : Finset ℕ} {n : Point} (hn : n ≠ 0) :
    (C.filter (fun (j : ℕ) => dotQ n (mdir (j : ℚ)) = 0)).card ≤ 2
proof:
:= by
  apply card_filter_le_two
  intro a _ b _ c _ ha hb hc hab hac hbc
  apply hn
  refine cramer_kernel (a := mdir (a : ℚ)) (b := mdir (b : ℚ)) (u := mdir (c : ℚ))
    (det3_mdir_ne (cast_ne hab) (cast_ne hac) (cast_ne hbc)) ?_ ?_ ?_
  · rw [dotQ_symm]; exact ha
  · rw [dotQ_symm]; exact hb
  · rw [dotQ_symm]; exact hc

name: edge_span
statement:
theorem edge_span {fc a b : Point} {r s : ℚ} (hs : 0 < s)
    (hmem : lineAt fc (mdir r) s ∈ segment ℚ a b) :
    ∃ α β : ℚ, mdir r = α • (psub a fc) + β • (psub b a)
proof:
:= by
  simp only [segment, Set.mem_setOf_eq] at hmem
  obtain ⟨p, q, _, _, hpq, hPeq⟩ := hmem
  have hsne : s ≠ 0 := ne_of_gt hs
  refine ⟨1 / s, q / s, ?_⟩
  funext k
  have hk := congrFun hPeq k
  simp only [Pi.add_apply, Pi.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul, lineAt] at hk
  have hp1 : p = 1 - q := by linarith
  rw [hp1] at hk
  have hcore : s * (mdir r) k = (a k - fc k) + q * (b k - a k) := by linear_combination -hk
  simp only [Pi.add_apply, Pi.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul, psub]
  field_simp
  linear_combination hcore

name: card_edge_le_two
statement:
theorem card_edge_le_two {C : Finset ℕ} (fc a b : Point) :
    (C.filter (fun (j : ℕ) => ∃ s : ℚ, 0 < s ∧
      lineAt fc (mdir (j : ℚ)) s ∈ segment ℚ a b)).card ≤ 2
proof:
:= by
  apply card_filter_le_two
  intro x _ y _ z _ hx hy hz hxy hxz hyz
  obtain ⟨sx, hsx, hmx⟩ := hx
  obtain ⟨sy, hsy, hmy⟩ := hy
  obtain ⟨sz, hsz, hmz⟩ := hz
  obtain ⟨αx, βx, ex⟩ := edge_span hsx hmx
  obtain ⟨αy, βy, ey⟩ := edge_span hsy hmy
  obtain ⟨αz, βz, ez⟩ := edge_span hsz hmz
  apply det3_mdir_ne (cast_ne hxy) (cast_ne hxz) (cast_ne hyz)
  rw [ex, ey, ez]
  exact det3_span_zero (psub a fc) (psub b a) αx βx αy βy αz βz

name: badFace_card_le_eight
statement:
theorem badFace_card_le_eight {MB : Mesh} (hnpo : NoPlaneThroughOrigin MB) (fc : Point)
    (u : Fin MB.size) (C : Finset ℕ) :
    (C.filter (fun j => rayFaceCross ((prepare (materialize MB)).getD u.val default)
        (toH4 (ofPoint fc)) (numI3 (rayDirAt j)) = none)).card ≤ 8
proof:
:= by
  have hnne : Proof.MeshIntersectJump.faceNormal MB[u] ≠ 0 := faceNormal_ne_zero (hnpo u)
  set A := C.filter (fun (j : ℕ) => dotQ (Proof.MeshIntersectJump.faceNormal MB[u]) (mdir (j : ℚ)) = 0) with hA
  set B01 := C.filter (fun (j : ℕ) => ∃ s : ℚ, 0 < s ∧
    lineAt fc (mdir (j : ℚ)) s ∈ segment ℚ MB[u].v₀ MB[u].v₁) with hB01
  set B12 := C.filter (fun (j : ℕ) => ∃ s : ℚ, 0 < s ∧
    lineAt fc (mdir (j : ℚ)) s ∈ segment ℚ MB[u].v₁ MB[u].v₂) with hB12
  set B20 := C.filter (fun (j : ℕ) => ∃ s : ℚ, 0 < s ∧
    lineAt fc (mdir (j : ℚ)) s ∈ segment ℚ MB[u].v₂ MB[u].v₀) with hB20
  have hsub : C.filter (fun j => rayFaceCross ((prepare (materialize MB)).getD u.val default)
      (toH4 (ofPoint fc)) (numI3 (rayDirAt j)) = none) ⊆ A ∪ B01 ∪ B12 ∪ B20 := by
    intro j hj
    rw [Finset.mem_filter] at hj
    obtain ⟨hjC, hjnone⟩ := hj
    rw [rayDirAt_eq_ofPoint] at hjnone
    have hintj : IntDir (mdir (j : ℚ)) := by
      show P3Int (ofPoint (mdir (j : ℚ))); rw [← rayDirAt_eq_ofPoint]; exact p3Int_rayDirAt j
    have hchar := (rayFaceCross_eq_sigma (MB := MB) (u := u)
      (f := (prepare (materialize MB)).getD u.val default) (hnpo u) fc (mdir (j : ℚ)) hintj
      (prepare_getD_fields MB u.val u.isLt)).2
    rcases hchar.mp hjnone with ⟨hden, _⟩ | ⟨s, hs, hmem⟩
    · refine Finset.mem_union_left _ (Finset.mem_union_left _ (Finset.mem_union_left _ ?_))
      rw [hA]; exact Finset.mem_filter.mpr ⟨hjC, hden⟩
    · simp only [edgeSet, Set.mem_union] at hmem
      rcases hmem with (h01 | h12) | h20
      · refine Finset.mem_union_left _ (Finset.mem_union_left _ (Finset.mem_union_right _ ?_))
        rw [hB01]; exact Finset.mem_filter.mpr ⟨hjC, s, hs, h01⟩
      · refine Finset.mem_union_left _ (Finset.mem_union_right _ ?_)
        rw [hB12]; exact Finset.mem_filter.mpr ⟨hjC, s, hs, h12⟩
      · refine Finset.mem_union_right _ ?_
        rw [hB20]; exact Finset.mem_filter.mpr ⟨hjC, s, hs, h20⟩
  calc (C.filter (fun j => rayFaceCross ((prepare (materialize MB)).getD u.val default)
          (toH4 (ofPoint fc)) (numI3 (rayDirAt j)) = none)).card
      ≤ (A ∪ B01 ∪ B12 ∪ B20).card := Finset.card_le_card hsub
    _ ≤ (A ∪ B01 ∪ B12).card + B20.card := Finset.card_union_le _ _
    _ ≤ ((A ∪ B01).card + B12.card) + B20.card :=
        Nat.add_le_add_right (Finset.card_union_le _ _) _
    _ ≤ ((A.card + B01.card) + B12.card) + B20.card :=
        Nat.add_le_add_right (Nat.add_le_add_right (Finset.card_union_le _ _) _) _
    _ ≤ ((2 + 2) + 2) + 2 := by
        have hAc : A.card ≤ 2 := by rw [hA]; exact card_inplane_le_two hnne
        have h01 : B01.card ≤ 2 := by rw [hB01]; exact card_edge_le_two fc MB[u].v₀ MB[u].v₁
        have h12 : B12.card ≤ 2 := by rw [hB12]; exact card_edge_le_two fc MB[u].v₁ MB[u].v₂
        have h20 : B20.card ≤ 2 := by rw [hB20]; exact card_edge_le_two fc MB[u].v₂ MB[u].v₀
        omega
    _ = 8 := by norm_num

name: foldl_body_none_witness
statement:
theorem foldl_body_none_witness {W : Array PFace} {qh : H4} {di : I3} :
    ∀ (l : List ℕ) (init : ℤ),
    l.foldl (fun acc i =>
      match acc with
      | none => none
      | some s =>
        match rayFaceCross (W.getD i default) qh di with
        | none => none
        | some c => some (s + c)) (some init) = none →
    ∃ i ∈ l, rayFaceCross (W.getD i default) qh di = none
proof:
:= by
  intro l
  induction l with
  | nil => intro init h; rw [List.foldl_nil] at h; exact Option.noConfusion h
  | cons a l ih =>
    intro init h
    rw [List.foldl_cons] at h
    rcases hc : rayFaceCross (W.getD a default) qh di with _ | c
    · exact ⟨a, List.mem_cons_self _ _, hc⟩
    · simp only [hc] at h
      obtain ⟨i, hi, hii⟩ := ih (init + c) h
      exact ⟨i, List.mem_cons_of_mem _ hi, hii⟩

name: winding_none_face
statement:
theorem winding_none_face {MB : Mesh} (fc : Point) (d : P3)
    (hnone : windingRayDir (faceBVH (prepare (materialize MB))) (prepare (materialize MB))
        (ofPoint fc) d = none) :
    ∃ u : Fin MB.size,
      rayFaceCross ((prepare (materialize MB)).getD u.val default) (toH4 (ofPoint fc)) (numI3 d) = none
proof:
:= by
  
  rw [MeshIntersectWedge.windingRayDir_eq_old _ _
    (MeshIntersectWedge.materialize_wedgeOK MB)] at hnone
  set W := prepare (materialize MB) with hW
  have hWsize : W.size = MB.size := by rw [hW]; exact prepare_size MB
  simp only [MeshIntersectWedge.windingRayDirOld, faceBVH,
    show (⟨d.x.num, d.y.num, d.z.num⟩ : I3) = numI3 d from rfl] at hnone
  rw [← Array.foldl_toList] at hnone
  set boxes := W.map (fun f => faceBoxOf f) with hboxes
  set xpt : Impl.BVH.Pt := ⟨(ofPoint fc).x, (ofPoint fc).y, (ofPoint fc).z⟩ with hxpt
  set dpt : Impl.BVH.Pt := ⟨d.x, d.y, d.z⟩ with hdpt
  have hboxsize : boxes.size = MB.size := by rw [hboxes, Array.size_map, hWsize]
  by_cases hbz : boxes.size = 0
  · exfalso
    rw [rayQueryFwd_empty boxes xpt dpt hbz, Array.toList_empty, List.foldl_nil] at hnone
    exact Option.noConfusion hnone
  · have hpos : 0 < boxes.size := Nat.pos_of_ne_zero hbz
    obtain ⟨i, hi_mem, hi_none⟩ := foldl_body_none_witness _ 0 hnone
    obtain ⟨_, hlt⟩ := rayQueryFwd_toList_props boxes xpt dpt hpos
    have hiMB : i < MB.size := by rw [← hboxsize]; exact hlt i hi_mem
    exact ⟨⟨i, hiMB⟩, hi_none⟩

name: searchFirst_some
proof:
:= by
  induction fuel generalizing s with
  | zero => simp [searchFirst] at h
  | succ n ih =>
    rw [searchFirst] at h
    cases ha : attempt s with
    | some y => rw [ha] at h; exact ⟨s, ha.trans h⟩
    | none => rw [ha] at h; exact ih h

name: searchFirst_success
statement:
theorem searchFirst_success {α : Type} {attempt : ℕ → Option α} {fuel : ℕ} :
    ∀ {s : ℕ} (j : ℕ), s ≤ j → j < s + fuel → attempt j ≠ none →
    ∃ x, searchFirst attempt s fuel = some x
proof:
:= by
  induction fuel with
  | zero => intro s j hj1 hj2 _; omega
  | succ n ih =>
    intro s j hj1 hj2 hjne
    rw [searchFirst]
    cases ha : attempt s with
    | some y => exact ⟨y, rfl⟩
    | none =>
      have hne : s ≠ j := by rintro rfl; exact hjne ha
      exact ih j (by omega) (by omega) hjne

name: exists_good_dir
statement:
theorem exists_good_dir {MB : Mesh} (hnpo : NoPlaneThroughOrigin MB) (fc : Point) :
    ∃ j : ℕ, j < 8 * (prepare (materialize MB)).size + 8 ∧
      windingRayDir (faceBVH (prepare (materialize MB))) (prepare (materialize MB))
        (ofPoint fc) (rayDirAt j) ≠ none
proof:
:= by
  have hWsize : (prepare (materialize MB)).size = MB.size := prepare_size MB
  set fuel := 8 * (prepare (materialize MB)).size + 8 with hfuel
  set Bad := (Finset.range fuel).filter (fun j =>
    windingRayDir (faceBVH (prepare (materialize MB))) (prepare (materialize MB))
      (ofPoint fc) (rayDirAt j) = none) with hBad
  have hBadUnion : Bad ⊆ Finset.univ.biUnion (fun u : Fin MB.size =>
      (Finset.range fuel).filter (fun j => rayFaceCross ((prepare (materialize MB)).getD u.val default)
        (toH4 (ofPoint fc)) (numI3 (rayDirAt j)) = none)) := by
    intro j hj
    rw [hBad, Finset.mem_filter] at hj
    obtain ⟨u, hu⟩ := winding_none_face fc (rayDirAt j) hj.2
    rw [Finset.mem_biUnion]
    exact ⟨u, Finset.mem_univ u, Finset.mem_filter.mpr ⟨hj.1, hu⟩⟩
  have hcardBad : Bad.card ≤ 8 * MB.size := by
    calc Bad.card ≤ _ := Finset.card_le_card hBadUnion
      _ ≤ ∑ _u : Fin MB.size, 8 :=
          le_trans (Finset.card_biUnion_le)
            (Finset.sum_le_sum (fun u _ => badFace_card_le_eight hnpo fc u (Finset.range fuel)))
      _ = 8 * MB.size := by
          rw [Finset.sum_const, Finset.card_univ, Fintype.card_fin, smul_eq_mul, Nat.mul_comm]
  have hCcard : (Finset.range fuel).card = 8 * MB.size + 8 := by
    rw [Finset.card_range, hfuel, hWsize]
  have hExists : ∃ j ∈ Finset.range fuel, j ∉ Bad := by
    by_contra h
    push_neg at h
    have hsub : Finset.range fuel ⊆ Bad := fun j hj => h j hj
    have := Finset.card_le_card hsub
    omega
  obtain ⟨j, hjC, hjBad⟩ := hExists
  refine ⟨j, Finset.mem_range.mp hjC, ?_⟩
  intro hnone
  exact hjBad (by rw [hBad]; exact Finset.mem_filter.mpr ⟨hjC, hnone⟩)

name: windingAt_clean_dir
statement:
theorem windingAt_clean_dir {MB : Mesh} (hnpo : NoPlaneThroughOrigin MB) (fc : Point) :
    ∃ d : Point, d ≠ 0 ∧
      (∀ (u : Fin MB.size) (s : ℚ), 0 < s → lineAt fc d s ∉ edgeSet MB[u]) ∧
      (windingAt (faceBVH (prepare (materialize MB))) (prepare (materialize MB)) (ofPoint fc) : ℤ)
        = RayCount MB fc d
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨j, hjlt, hjne⟩ := exists_good_dir hnpo fc
  obtain ⟨x, hx⟩ := searchFirst_success (attempt := fun j =>
      windingRayDir (faceBVH (prepare (materialize MB))) (prepare (materialize MB))
        (ofPoint fc) (rayDirAt j))
    (fuel := 16 * (prepare (materialize MB)).size + 16) (s := 0) j (Nat.zero_le _)
    (by omega) hjne
  have hWA : windingAt (faceBVH (prepare (materialize MB))) (prepare (materialize MB))
      (ofPoint fc) = x := by
    simp only [windingAt, hx, Option.getD_some]
  obtain ⟨j', hj'⟩ := searchFirst_some hx
  rw [rayDirAt_eq_ofPoint] at hj'
  have hintj' : IntDir (mdir (j' : ℚ)) := by
    show P3Int (ofPoint (mdir (j' : ℚ))); rw [← rayDirAt_eq_ofPoint]; exact p3Int_rayDirAt j'
  obtain ⟨hval, hclean⟩ := windingRayDir_some_eq_rayCount hnpo fc (mdir (j' : ℚ)) hintj' hj'
  exact ⟨mdir (j' : ℚ), mdir_ne_zero _, hclean, by rw [hWA, hval]⟩

name: dotQ_step'
statement:
theorem dotQ_step' (N b dv : Point) (δ : ℚ) :
    dotQ N (b + δ • dv) = dotQ N b + δ * dotQ N dv
proof:
:= by
  simp only [dotQ, Pi.add_apply, Pi.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul]; ring

name: side_dense_vrelint
statement:
theorem side_dense_vrelint {r : ℕ} [NeZero r] (hr : 3 ≤ r) {n : Point} {c : ℚ}
    {w : Fin r → Point} (hpl : OnPlane n c w) (hs : StrictConv n w)
    {K : ℕ} (N : Fin K → Point) (dfun : Fin K → ℚ)
    (hP : ∀ α, ∃ y, dotQ n y = c ∧ dotQ (N α) y ≠ dfun α) :
    ∃ x ∈ vrelint w, ∀ α,
      dotQ (N α) x ≠ dfun α ∧
      (dotQ (N α) (∑ i, (r : ℚ)⁻¹ • w i) ≠ dfun α →
        0 < (dotQ (N α) (∑ i, (r : ℚ)⁻¹ • w i) - dfun α) * (dotQ (N α) x - dfun α))
proof:
:= by
  have hn : n ≠ 0 := n_ne_zero_of_strict hr hs
  set u₁ := w (0 + 1) - w 0 with hu₁def
  set u₂ := w (0 + 1 + 1) - w 0 with hu₂def
  have hA : areaForm n (w 0) (w (0 + 1)) (w (0 + 1 + 1)) ≠ 0 :=
    ne_of_gt (hs 0 (0 + 1 + 1) (fin_add_two_ne hr 0) (fin_add_one_ne hr (0 + 1)))
  set Tr : Fin K → Prop := fun α => ¬(dotQ (N α) u₁ = 0 ∧ dotQ (N α) u₂ = 0) with hTrdef
  
  have hpar : ∀ α, ¬ Tr α → ∀ x, dotQ n x = c → dotQ (N α) x ≠ dfun α := by
    intro α hα x hx
    simp only [hTrdef, not_not] at hα
    have hconst : ∀ p : Point, dotQ n p = c → dotQ (N α) p = dotQ (N α) (w 0) := by
      intro p hp
      obtain ⟨s, t, hrep⟩ := plane_coords hn (hpl 0) (hpl (0 + 1)) (hpl (0 + 1 + 1)) hA hp
      have hexp : dotQ (N α) (w 0 + s • (w (0 + 1) - w 0) + t • (w (0 + 1 + 1) - w 0))
          = dotQ (N α) (w 0) + s * dotQ (N α) u₁ + t * dotQ (N α) u₂ := by
        rw [hu₁def, hu₂def]
        simp only [dotQ, Pi.add_apply, Pi.sub_apply, Pi.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul]; ring
      rw [hrep, hexp, hα.1, hα.2]; ring
    obtain ⟨y, hy, hyne⟩ := hP α
    rw [hconst x hx, ← hconst y hy]; exact hyne
  
  obtain ⟨j, hj⟩ := exists_candidate_avoiding
    (fun α => {x : ℚ | Tr α ∧ dotQ (N α) u₁ + x * dotQ (N α) u₂ = 0})
    (fun α => affine_bad_subsingleton (Tr α) _ _ (fun h => h))
    (fun j : Fin (K + 1) => (j : ℚ))
    (fun j j' h => by
      apply Fin.ext; have h' : ((j : ℕ) : ℚ) = ((j' : ℕ) : ℚ) := h; exact_mod_cast h')
  set dv := u₁ + (j : ℚ) • u₂ with hdvdef
  have hdv_eval : ∀ q : Point, dotQ q dv = dotQ q u₁ + (j : ℚ) * dotQ q u₂ := by
    intro q; rw [hdvdef, dotQ_add_right, Proof.MeshIntersectRay.dotQ_smul_right]
  have hdvtr : ∀ α, Tr α → dotQ (N α) dv ≠ 0 := by
    intro α hα hzero; rw [hdv_eval (N α)] at hzero; exact hj α ⟨hα, hzero⟩
  have hdvn : dotQ n dv = 0 := by
    have h1 : dotQ n u₁ = 0 := by rw [hu₁def, dotQ_sub_right, hpl, hpl, sub_self]
    have h2 : dotQ n u₂ = 0 := by rw [hu₂def, dotQ_sub_right, hpl, hpl, sub_self]
    rw [hdv_eval n, h1, h2]; ring
  
  have hbmem : (∑ i, (r : ℚ)⁻¹ • w i) ∈ vrelint w := barycenter_mem_vrelint hr w
  set b := ∑ i, (r : ℚ)⁻¹ • w i with hbdef
  have hbdata := hbmem
  rw [vrelint_eq hr hpl hs] at hbdata
  obtain ⟨hbpl, hbeta⟩ := hbdata
  
  set S := Finset.univ.filter (fun i : Fin r => etaDir n w i dv < 0) with hSdef
  set cands : Finset ℚ :=
    insert 1 (S.image (fun i => eta n w i b / (-etaDir n w i dv))) with hcandsdef
  have hcne : cands.Nonempty := ⟨1, Finset.mem_insert_self 1 _⟩
  set δ₀ := cands.min' hcne with hδ₀def
  have hδ₀pos : 0 < δ₀ := by
    rw [hδ₀def, Finset.lt_min'_iff]
    intro y hy
    rcases Finset.mem_insert.mp hy with rfl | hy'
    · norm_num
    · obtain ⟨i, hiS, rfl⟩ := Finset.mem_image.mp hy'
      have hD : etaDir n w i dv < 0 := (Finset.mem_filter.mp hiS).2
      exact div_pos (hbeta i) (by linarith)
  have hfeas : ∀ δ : ℚ, 0 < δ → δ < δ₀ → b + δ • dv ∈ vrelint w := by
    intro δ hδ hδlt
    rw [vrelint_eq hr hpl hs]
    refine ⟨?_, fun i => ?_⟩
    · rw [dotQ_step', hbpl, hdvn]; ring
    · rw [eta_add_smul]
      by_cases hD : etaDir n w i dv < 0
      · have hiS : i ∈ S := Finset.mem_filter.mpr ⟨Finset.mem_univ i, hD⟩
        have hmem : eta n w i b / (-etaDir n w i dv) ∈ cands :=
          Finset.mem_insert_of_mem (Finset.mem_image_of_mem _ hiS)
        have hle : δ₀ ≤ eta n w i b / (-etaDir n w i dv) := Finset.min'_le _ _ hmem
        have hlt : δ < eta n w i b / (-etaDir n w i dv) := lt_of_lt_of_le hδlt hle
        rw [lt_div_iff₀ (by linarith : (0 : ℚ) < -etaDir n w i dv)] at hlt
        nlinarith
      · push_neg at hD; have := hbeta i; nlinarith [mul_nonneg hδ.le hD]
  
  set S1 := Finset.univ.filter (fun α : Fin K =>
    dotQ (N α) dv ≠ 0 ∧ dotQ (N α) b - dfun α ≠ 0 ∧
    0 < -(dotQ (N α) b - dfun α) / dotQ (N α) dv) with hS1def
  set cands1 : Finset ℚ :=
    insert 1 (S1.image (fun α => -(dotQ (N α) b - dfun α) / dotQ (N α) dv)) with hcands1def
  have hc1ne : cands1.Nonempty := ⟨1, Finset.mem_insert_self 1 _⟩
  set δ₁ := cands1.min' hc1ne with hδ₁def
  have hδ₁pos : 0 < δ₁ := by
    rw [hδ₁def, Finset.lt_min'_iff]
    intro y hy
    rcases Finset.mem_insert.mp hy with rfl | hy'
    · norm_num
    · obtain ⟨α, hαS, rfl⟩ := Finset.mem_image.mp hy'
      exact (Finset.mem_filter.mp hαS).2.2.2
  set ρ := min δ₀ δ₁ with hρdef
  have hρpos : 0 < ρ := lt_min hδ₀pos hδ₁pos
  
  obtain ⟨k, hk⟩ := exists_candidate_avoiding
    (fun α => {x : ℚ | Tr α ∧ (dotQ (N α) b - dfun α) + x * dotQ (N α) dv = 0})
    (fun α => affine_bad_subsingleton (Tr α) _ _ (fun hα hAB => hdvtr α hα hAB.2))
    (fun k : Fin (K + 1) => ρ / ((k : ℚ) + 2))
    (fun k k' h => by
      apply Fin.ext
      have h2 : ((k : ℚ) + 2) ≠ 0 := by positivity
      have h2' : ((k' : ℚ) + 2) ≠ 0 := by positivity
      rw [div_eq_div_iff h2 h2'] at h
      have hcancel := mul_left_cancel₀ (ne_of_gt hρpos) h
      have hcast : (k : ℚ) = (k' : ℚ) := by linarith
      exact_mod_cast hcast)
  set δ := ρ / ((k : ℚ) + 2) with hδdef
  have hk0 : (0 : ℚ) ≤ (k : ℚ) := by positivity
  have hδpos : 0 < δ := div_pos hρpos (by linarith)
  have hδltρ : δ < ρ := by
    rw [hδdef, div_lt_iff₀ (by linarith : (0 : ℚ) < (k : ℚ) + 2)]; nlinarith
  have hδlt0 : δ < δ₀ := lt_of_lt_of_le hδltρ (min_le_left _ _)
  have hδlt1 : δ < δ₁ := lt_of_lt_of_le hδltρ (min_le_right _ _)
  refine ⟨b + δ • dv, hfeas δ hδpos hδlt0, fun α => ?_⟩
  
  have hoff : dotQ (N α) (b + δ • dv) ≠ dfun α := by
    by_cases hα : Tr α
    · intro heq; rw [dotQ_step'] at heq; exact hk α ⟨hα, by linarith⟩
    · apply hpar α hα; rw [dotQ_step', hbpl, hdvn]; ring
  refine ⟨hoff, ?_⟩
  
  intro hbne
  set L := dotQ (N α) b - dfun α with hLdef
  set D := dotQ (N α) dv with hDdef
  have hLne : L ≠ 0 := sub_ne_zero.mpr hbne
  have hxeq : dotQ (N α) (b + δ • dv) - dfun α = L + δ * D := by
    rw [dotQ_step']; rw [hLdef, hDdef]; ring
  rw [hxeq]
  by_cases hLD : 0 ≤ L * D
  · nlinarith [mul_self_pos.mpr hLne, mul_nonneg hδpos.le hLD]
  · push_neg at hLD
    have hDne : D ≠ 0 := fun h => by rw [h, mul_zero] at hLD; exact lt_irrefl 0 hLD
    have hαS1 : α ∈ S1 := by
      rw [hS1def, Finset.mem_filter]
      refine ⟨Finset.mem_univ α, hDne, hLne, ?_⟩
      rw [← hLdef, ← hDdef]
      rcases mul_neg_iff.mp hLD with ⟨hLpos, hDneg⟩ | ⟨hLneg, hDpos⟩
      · exact div_pos_iff.mpr (Or.inr ⟨by linarith, hDneg⟩)
      · exact div_pos_iff.mpr (Or.inl ⟨by linarith, hDpos⟩)
    set R := -L / D with hRdef
    have hRpos : 0 < R := (Finset.mem_filter.mp hαS1).2.2.2
    have hle : δ₁ ≤ R := Finset.min'_le _ _
      (Finset.mem_insert_of_mem (Finset.mem_image_of_mem _ hαS1))
    have hδR : δ < R := lt_of_lt_of_le hδlt1 hle
    have hRD : R * D = -L := by rw [hRdef]; field_simp
    have hkey : L * (L + δ * D) = R * (R - δ) * (D * D) := by
      have : L = -(R * D) := by rw [hRD]; ring
      rw [this]; ring
    rw [hkey]
    exact mul_pos (mul_pos hRpos (by linarith)) (mul_self_pos.mpr hDne)

name: sign_preserve_core
statement:
theorem sign_preserve_core {L D δ : ℚ} (hLne : L ≠ 0) (hδpos : 0 < δ)
    (hb : L * D < 0 → δ < -L / D) : 0 < L * (L + δ * D)
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hLD : 0 ≤ L * D
  · nlinarith [mul_self_pos.mpr hLne, mul_nonneg hδpos.le hLD]
  · push_neg at hLD
    have hDne : D ≠ 0 := fun h => by rw [h, mul_zero] at hLD; exact lt_irrefl 0 hLD
    have hδR : δ < -L / D := hb hLD
    rcases mul_neg_iff.mp hLD with ⟨hLpos, hDneg⟩ | ⟨hLneg, hDpos⟩
    · rw [lt_div_iff_of_neg hDneg] at hδR
      nlinarith [mul_pos hLpos (show (0 : ℚ) < L + δ * D by linarith)]
    · rw [lt_div_iff₀ hDpos] at hδR
      nlinarith [mul_pos_of_neg_of_neg hLneg (show L + δ * D < 0 by linarith)]

name: exists_mdir_transverse
statement:
theorem exists_mdir_transverse {K : ℕ} (N : Fin K → Point) (hNne : ∀ α, N α ≠ 0) :
    ∃ j : ℕ, ∀ α, dotQ (N α) (mdir (j : ℚ)) ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  set C := Finset.range (2 * K + 1) with hC
  set Bad := C.filter (fun (j : ℕ) => ∃ α, dotQ (N α) (mdir (j : ℚ)) = 0) with hBad
  have hBadUnion : Bad ⊆ Finset.univ.biUnion (fun α : Fin K =>
      C.filter (fun (j : ℕ) => dotQ (N α) (mdir (j : ℚ)) = 0)) := by
    intro j hj
    rw [hBad, Finset.mem_filter] at hj
    obtain ⟨α, hα⟩ := hj.2
    exact Finset.mem_biUnion.mpr ⟨α, Finset.mem_univ α, Finset.mem_filter.mpr ⟨hj.1, hα⟩⟩
  have hcardBad : Bad.card ≤ 2 * K := by
    calc Bad.card ≤ _ := Finset.card_le_card hBadUnion
      _ ≤ ∑ _α : Fin K, 2 :=
          le_trans Finset.card_biUnion_le
            (Finset.sum_le_sum (fun α _ => card_inplane_le_two (hNne α)))
      _ = 2 * K := by
          rw [Finset.sum_const, Finset.card_univ, Fintype.card_fin, smul_eq_mul, Nat.mul_comm]
  have hCcard : C.card = 2 * K + 1 := by rw [hC, Finset.card_range]
  have hExists : ∃ j ∈ C, j ∉ Bad := by
    by_contra h
    push_neg at h
    have hsub : C ⊆ Bad := fun j hj => h j hj
    have := Finset.card_le_card hsub
    omega
  obtain ⟨j, hjC, hjBad⟩ := hExists
  refine ⟨j, fun α hα => ?_⟩
  exact hjBad (by rw [hBad]; exact Finset.mem_filter.mpr ⟨hjC, α, hα⟩)

name: side_dense_dir
statement:
theorem side_dense_dir {K : ℕ} (dfc : Point) (N : Fin K → Point) (hNne : ∀ α, N α ≠ 0) :
    ∃ d' : Point, ∀ α,
      dotQ (N α) d' ≠ 0 ∧
      (dotQ (N α) dfc ≠ 0 → 0 < dotQ (N α) dfc * dotQ (N α) d')
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨j, hjtr⟩ := exists_mdir_transverse N hNne
  set dv := mdir (j : ℚ) with hdvdef
  
  set S1 := Finset.univ.filter (fun α : Fin K =>
    dotQ (N α) dfc ≠ 0 ∧ 0 < -(dotQ (N α) dfc) / dotQ (N α) dv) with hS1def
  set cands1 : Finset ℚ :=
    insert 1 (S1.image (fun α => -(dotQ (N α) dfc) / dotQ (N α) dv)) with hcands1def
  have hc1ne : cands1.Nonempty := ⟨1, Finset.mem_insert_self 1 _⟩
  set δ₁ := cands1.min' hc1ne with hδ₁def
  have hδ₁pos : 0 < δ₁ := by
    rw [hδ₁def, Finset.lt_min'_iff]
    intro y hy
    rcases Finset.mem_insert.mp hy with rfl | hy'
    · norm_num
    · obtain ⟨α, hαS, rfl⟩ := Finset.mem_image.mp hy'
      exact (Finset.mem_filter.mp hαS).2.2
  
  obtain ⟨k, hk⟩ := exists_candidate_avoiding
    (fun α => {x : ℚ | dotQ (N α) dfc + x * dotQ (N α) dv = 0})
    (fun α => by
      intro x hx x' hx'
      simp only [Set.mem_setOf_eq] at hx hx'
      have : x * dotQ (N α) dv = x' * dotQ (N α) dv := by linarith
      exact mul_right_cancel₀ (hjtr α) this)
    (fun k : Fin (K + 1) => δ₁ / ((k : ℚ) + 2))
    (fun k k' h => by
      apply Fin.ext
      have h2 : ((k : ℚ) + 2) ≠ 0 := by positivity
      have h2' : ((k' : ℚ) + 2) ≠ 0 := by positivity
      rw [div_eq_div_iff h2 h2'] at h
      have hcancel := mul_left_cancel₀ (ne_of_gt hδ₁pos) h
      have hcast : (k : ℚ) = (k' : ℚ) := by linarith
      exact_mod_cast hcast)
  set δ := δ₁ / ((k : ℚ) + 2) with hδdef
  have hk0 : (0 : ℚ) ≤ (k : ℚ) := by positivity
  have hδpos : 0 < δ := div_pos hδ₁pos (by linarith)
  have hδlt1 : δ < δ₁ := by
    rw [hδdef, div_lt_iff₀ (by linarith : (0 : ℚ) < (k : ℚ) + 2)]; nlinarith
  refine ⟨dfc + δ • dv, fun α => ?_⟩
  have hoff : dotQ (N α) (dfc + δ • dv) ≠ 0 := by
    intro heq; rw [dotQ_step'] at heq
    exact hk α (by simp only [Set.mem_setOf_eq]; linarith)
  refine ⟨hoff, ?_⟩
  intro hLne
  have hval : dotQ (N α) (dfc + δ • dv) = dotQ (N α) dfc + δ * dotQ (N α) dv := dotQ_step' _ _ _ _
  rw [hval]
  refine sign_preserve_core hLne hδpos ?_
  intro hLD
  have hαS1 : α ∈ S1 := by
    rw [hS1def, Finset.mem_filter]
    refine ⟨Finset.mem_univ α, hLne, ?_⟩
    rcases mul_neg_iff.mp hLD with ⟨hLpos, hDneg⟩ | ⟨hLneg, hDpos⟩
    · exact div_pos_iff.mpr (Or.inr ⟨by linarith, hDneg⟩)
    · exact div_pos_iff.mpr (Or.inl ⟨by linarith, hDpos⟩)
  have hle : δ₁ ≤ -(dotQ (N α) dfc) / dotQ (N α) dv := Finset.min'_le _ _
    (Finset.mem_insert_of_mem (Finset.mem_image_of_mem _ hαS1))
  linarith

name: edgeSet_eq_iUnion
statement:
theorem edgeSet_eq_iUnion (t : Triangle) :
    edgeSet t = ⋃ k : Fin 3, segment ℚ (edgeTail t k) (edgeHead t k)
proof:
:= by
  simp only [edgeSet, edgeTail, edgeHead]
  ext x
  simp only [Set.mem_union, Set.mem_iUnion]
  constructor
  · rintro ((h | h) | h)
    · exact ⟨0, h⟩
    · exact ⟨1, h⟩
    · exact ⟨2, h⟩
  · rintro ⟨k, hk⟩
    fin_cases k
    · exact Or.inl (Or.inl hk)
    · exact Or.inl (Or.inr hk)
    · exact Or.inr hk

name: dotQ_neg
statement: theorem dotQ_neg (u v : Point) : dotQ (-u) v = - dotQ u v
proof:
:= by
  simp only [dotQ, Pi.neg_apply]; ring

name: crossQ_antisymm
statement: theorem crossQ_antisymm (u v : Point) : crossQ u v = - crossQ v u
proof:
:= by
  funext i; fin_cases i <;> simp [crossQ, mkPoint] <;> ring

name: crossQ_smul_left
statement: theorem crossQ_smul_left (a : ℚ) (u v : Point) : crossQ (a • u) v = a • crossQ u v
proof:
:= by
  funext i; fin_cases i <;> simp [crossQ, mkPoint, Pi.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul] <;> ring

name: dotQ_self_nonneg
statement: theorem dotQ_self_nonneg (v : Point) : 0 ≤ dotQ v v
proof:
:= by
  have h : dotQ v v = v 0 * v 0 + v 1 * v 1 + v 2 * v 2 := rfl
  rw [h]; nlinarith [mul_self_nonneg (v 0), mul_self_nonneg (v 1), mul_self_nonneg (v 2)]

name: cross_sq
statement:
theorem cross_sq (u v : Point) :
    dotQ (crossQ u v) (crossQ u v) = dotQ u u * dotQ v v - dotQ u v * dotQ u v
proof:
:= by
  simp only [dotQ, crossQ, mkPoint_zero, mkPoint_one, mkPoint_two]; ring

name: smul_eq_of_cross_zero
statement:
theorem smul_eq_of_cross_zero (u v : Point) (h : crossQ u v = 0) :
    (dotQ u u) • v = (dotQ u v) • u
proof:
:= by
  have hbac : crossQ u (crossQ u v) = (dotQ u v) • u - (dotQ u u) • v := by
    funext i; fin_cases i <;>
      simp [crossQ, dotQ, mkPoint, Pi.sub_apply, Pi.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul] <;> ring
  rw [h] at hbac
  have h0 : crossQ u (0 : Point) = 0 := by
    funext i; fin_cases i <;> simp [crossQ, mkPoint]
  rw [h0] at hbac
  exact (sub_eq_zero.mp hbac.symm).symm

name: perp_of_parallel
statement:
theorem perp_of_parallel {u v p : Point} (hu : u ≠ 0) (hpar : crossQ u v = 0)
    (hp : dotQ u p = 0) : dotQ v p = 0
proof:
:= by
  have h := smul_eq_of_cross_zero u v hpar
  have h2 := congrArg (fun x => dotQ x p) h
  simp only [dotQ_smul_left] at h2
  rw [hp, mul_zero] at h2
  exact (mul_eq_zero.mp h2).resolve_left (ne_of_gt (Proof.WellFormedCheckNormal.dotQ_self_pos hu))

name: side_dense_vrelint'
statement:
theorem side_dense_vrelint' {r : ℕ} [NeZero r] (hr : 3 ≤ r) {n : Point} {c : ℚ}
    {w : Fin r → Point} (hpl : OnPlane n c w) (hs : StrictConv n w)
    {ι : Type} [Fintype ι] (N : ι → Point) (dfun : ι → ℚ)
    (hP : ∀ α, ∃ y, dotQ n y = c ∧ dotQ (N α) y ≠ dfun α) :
    ∃ x ∈ vrelint w, ∀ α,
      dotQ (N α) x ≠ dfun α ∧
      (dotQ (N α) (∑ i, (r : ℚ)⁻¹ • w i) ≠ dfun α →
        0 < (dotQ (N α) (∑ i, (r : ℚ)⁻¹ • w i) - dfun α) * (dotQ (N α) x - dfun α))
proof:
:= by
  classical
  obtain ⟨e⟩ : Nonempty (ι ≃ Fin (Fintype.card ι)) := ⟨Fintype.equivFin ι⟩
  obtain ⟨x, hx, hforall⟩ := side_dense_vrelint hr hpl hs (N ∘ e.symm) (dfun ∘ e.symm)
    (fun j => hP (e.symm j))
  refine ⟨x, hx, fun α => ?_⟩
  have := hforall (e α)
  simpa only [Function.comp_apply, Equiv.symm_apply_apply] using this

name: side_dense_dir'
statement:
theorem side_dense_dir' {ι : Type} [Fintype ι] (dfc : Point) (N : ι → Point)
    (hNne : ∀ α, N α ≠ 0) :
    ∃ d' : Point, ∀ α,
      dotQ (N α) d' ≠ 0 ∧
      (dotQ (N α) dfc ≠ 0 → 0 < dotQ (N α) dfc * dotQ (N α) d')
proof:
:= by
  classical
  obtain ⟨e⟩ : Nonempty (ι ≃ Fin (Fintype.card ι)) := ⟨Fintype.equivFin ι⟩
  obtain ⟨d', hforall⟩ := side_dense_dir dfc (N ∘ e.symm) (fun j => hNne (e.symm j))
  refine ⟨d', fun α => ?_⟩
  have := hforall (e α)
  simpa only [Function.comp_apply, Equiv.symm_apply_apply] using this

name: neg_via_psub
statement: private theorem neg_via_psub (u : Point) : psub (mkPoint 0 0 0) u = -u
proof:
:= by
  funext i; fin_cases i <;> simp [psub, mkPoint, Pi.neg_apply]

name: slot0_n_cases
statement:
theorem slot0_n_cases (t : Triangle) :
    (slot t 0).n = crossQ t.v₁ t.v₂ ∨ (slot t 0).n = -(crossQ t.v₁ t.v₂)
proof:
:= by
  have h : slot t 0 = (if 0 ≤ dotQ (crossQ t.v₁ t.v₂) t.v₀
      then (⟨crossQ t.v₁ t.v₂, 0⟩ : Half) else Half.neg ⟨crossQ t.v₁ t.v₂, 0⟩) := rfl
  rw [h]; split_ifs
  · exact Or.inl rfl
  · exact Or.inr (neg_via_psub _)

name: slot1_n_cases
statement:
theorem slot1_n_cases (t : Triangle) :
    (slot t 1).n = crossQ t.v₀ t.v₂ ∨ (slot t 1).n = -(crossQ t.v₀ t.v₂)
proof:
:= by
  have h : slot t 1 = (if 0 ≤ dotQ (crossQ t.v₀ t.v₂) t.v₁
      then (⟨crossQ t.v₀ t.v₂, 0⟩ : Half) else Half.neg ⟨crossQ t.v₀ t.v₂, 0⟩) := rfl
  rw [h]; split_ifs
  · exact Or.inl rfl
  · exact Or.inr (neg_via_psub _)

name: slot2_n_cases
statement:
theorem slot2_n_cases (t : Triangle) :
    (slot t 2).n = crossQ t.v₀ t.v₁ ∨ (slot t 2).n = -(crossQ t.v₀ t.v₁)
proof:
:= by
  have h : slot t 2 = (if 0 ≤ dotQ (crossQ t.v₀ t.v₁) t.v₂
      then (⟨crossQ t.v₀ t.v₁, 0⟩ : Half) else Half.neg ⟨crossQ t.v₀ t.v₁, 0⟩) := rfl
  rw [h]; split_ifs
  · exact Or.inl rfl
  · exact Or.inr (neg_via_psub _)

name: slot3_n_cases
statement:
theorem slot3_n_cases (t : Triangle) :
    (slot t 3).n = Proof.MeshIntersectJump.faceNormal t ∨ (slot t 3).n = -(Proof.MeshIntersectJump.faceNormal t)
proof:
:= by
  have h : slot t 3 = (if dotQ (crossQ (psub t.v₁ t.v₀) (psub t.v₂ t.v₀)) t.v₀ ≤ 0
      then (⟨crossQ (psub t.v₁ t.v₀) (psub t.v₂ t.v₀),
            dotQ (crossQ (psub t.v₁ t.v₀) (psub t.v₂ t.v₀)) t.v₀⟩ : Half)
       else Half.neg ⟨crossQ (psub t.v₁ t.v₀) (psub t.v₂ t.v₀),
            dotQ (crossQ (psub t.v₁ t.v₀) (psub t.v₂ t.v₀)) t.v₀⟩) := rfl
  rw [h]; split_ifs
  · exact Or.inl rfl
  · exact Or.inr (neg_via_psub _)

name: dotQ_zero_of_cases
statement:
theorem dotQ_zero_of_cases {u p : Point} {v : Point} (h : v = u ∨ v = -u)
    (hp : dotQ u p = 0) : dotQ v p = 0
proof:
:= by
  rcases h with h | h <;> rw [h]
  · exact hp
  · rw [dotQ_neg, hp, neg_zero]

name: slot_normal_zero_of
statement:
theorem slot_normal_zero_of {t : Triangle} (hdet : detOrigin t ≠ 0)
    {k' : Fin 4} {p q rr : Point} (hpqr : det3 p q rr ≠ 0)
    (hp : dotQ (slot t k').n p = 0) (hq : dotQ (slot t k').n q = 0)
    (hr : dotQ (slot t k').n rr = 0) : False
proof:
:=
  facet_n_ne_zero hdet _ (slot_mem t k')
    (cramer_kernel hpqr (by rw [dotQ_symm]; exact hp) (by rw [dotQ_symm]; exact hq)
      (by rw [dotQ_symm]; exact hr))

name: crossQ_slot_ne
statement:
theorem crossQ_slot_ne {t : Triangle} (hdet : detOrigin t ≠ 0) {k k' : Fin 4}
    (hkk : k ≠ k') : crossQ (slot t k).n (slot t k').n ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  intro hcz
  
  have d012 : det3 t.v₀ t.v₁ t.v₂ ≠ 0 := by
    have : det3 t.v₀ t.v₁ t.v₂ = detOrigin t := by
      simp only [det3, dotQ, crossQ, detOrigin, mkPoint_zero, mkPoint_one, mkPoint_two]; ring
    rw [this]; exact hdet
  have d12e : det3 t.v₁ t.v₂ (psub t.v₁ t.v₀) ≠ 0 := by
    have : det3 t.v₁ t.v₂ (psub t.v₁ t.v₀) = -(detOrigin t) := by
      simp only [det3, dotQ, crossQ, psub, detOrigin, mkPoint_zero, mkPoint_one, mkPoint_two]; ring
    rw [this]; exact neg_ne_zero.mpr hdet
  have d02e : det3 t.v₀ t.v₂ (psub t.v₁ t.v₀) ≠ 0 := by
    have : det3 t.v₀ t.v₂ (psub t.v₁ t.v₀) = -(detOrigin t) := by
      simp only [det3, dotQ, crossQ, psub, detOrigin, mkPoint_zero, mkPoint_one, mkPoint_two]; ring
    rw [this]; exact neg_ne_zero.mpr hdet
  have d01e : det3 t.v₀ t.v₁ (psub t.v₂ t.v₀) ≠ 0 := by
    have : det3 t.v₀ t.v₁ (psub t.v₂ t.v₀) = detOrigin t := by
      simp only [det3, dotQ, crossQ, psub, detOrigin, mkPoint_zero, mkPoint_one, mkPoint_two]; ring
    rw [this]; exact hdet
  
  have b0v1 : dotQ (slot t 0).n t.v₁ = 0 := dotQ_zero_of_cases (slot0_n_cases t) (dotQ_crossQ_self_left _ _)
  have b0v2 : dotQ (slot t 0).n t.v₂ = 0 := dotQ_zero_of_cases (slot0_n_cases t) (dotQ_crossQ_self_right _ _)
  have b1v0 : dotQ (slot t 1).n t.v₀ = 0 := dotQ_zero_of_cases (slot1_n_cases t) (dotQ_crossQ_self_left _ _)
  have b1v2 : dotQ (slot t 1).n t.v₂ = 0 := dotQ_zero_of_cases (slot1_n_cases t) (dotQ_crossQ_self_right _ _)
  have b2v0 : dotQ (slot t 2).n t.v₀ = 0 := dotQ_zero_of_cases (slot2_n_cases t) (dotQ_crossQ_self_left _ _)
  have b2v1 : dotQ (slot t 2).n t.v₁ = 0 := dotQ_zero_of_cases (slot2_n_cases t) (dotQ_crossQ_self_right _ _)
  have b3e1 : dotQ (slot t 3).n (psub t.v₁ t.v₀) = 0 :=
    dotQ_zero_of_cases (slot3_n_cases t) (by rw [Proof.MeshIntersectJump.faceNormal]; exact dotQ_crossQ_self_left _ _)
  have b3e2 : dotQ (slot t 3).n (psub t.v₂ t.v₀) = 0 :=
    dotQ_zero_of_cases (slot3_n_cases t) (by rw [Proof.MeshIntersectJump.faceNormal]; exact dotQ_crossQ_self_right _ _)
  
  have hne : ∀ j : Fin 4, (slot t j).n ≠ 0 := fun j => facet_n_ne_zero hdet _ (slot_mem t j)
  
  fin_cases k <;> fin_cases k'
  · exact absurd rfl hkk
  · exact slot_normal_zero_of hdet d012 b1v0 (perp_of_parallel (hne 0) hcz b0v1) b1v2
  · exact slot_normal_zero_of hdet d012 b2v0 b2v1 (perp_of_parallel (hne 0) hcz b0v2)
  · exact slot_normal_zero_of hdet d12e (perp_of_parallel (hne 0) hcz b0v1)
      (perp_of_parallel (hne 0) hcz b0v2) b3e1
  · exact slot_normal_zero_of hdet d012 (perp_of_parallel (hne 1) hcz b1v0) b0v1 b0v2
  · exact absurd rfl hkk
  · exact slot_normal_zero_of hdet d012 b2v0 b2v1 (perp_of_parallel (hne 1) hcz b1v2)
  · exact slot_normal_zero_of hdet d02e (perp_of_parallel (hne 1) hcz b1v0)
      (perp_of_parallel (hne 1) hcz b1v2) b3e1
  · exact slot_normal_zero_of hdet d012 (perp_of_parallel (hne 2) hcz b2v0) b0v1 b0v2
  · exact slot_normal_zero_of hdet d012 b1v0 (perp_of_parallel (hne 2) hcz b2v1) b1v2
  · exact absurd rfl hkk
  · exact slot_normal_zero_of hdet d01e (perp_of_parallel (hne 2) hcz b2v0)
      (perp_of_parallel (hne 2) hcz b2v1) b3e2
  · exact slot_normal_zero_of hdet d12e b0v1 b0v2 (perp_of_parallel (hne 3) hcz b3e1)
  · exact slot_normal_zero_of hdet d02e b1v0 b1v2 (perp_of_parallel (hne 3) hcz b3e1)
  · exact slot_normal_zero_of hdet d01e b2v0 b2v1 (perp_of_parallel (hne 3) hcz b3e2)
  · exact absurd rfl hkk

name: resultant_ne
proof:
:= by
  intro h0
  
  have heq : (slot t k).eval P • (slot t k').n = (slot t k').eval P • (slot t k).n :=
    sub_eq_zero.mp h0
  have hcross : crossQ ((slot t k).eval P • (slot t k').n) (slot t k).n
      = crossQ ((slot t k').eval P • (slot t k).n) (slot t k).n := by rw [heq]
  rw [crossQ_smul_left, crossQ_smul_left, crossQ_self, smul_zero] at hcross
  
  rcases smul_eq_zero.mp hcross with h | h
  · exact hgk h
  · have : crossQ (slot t k).n (slot t k').n = 0 := by
      rw [crossQ_antisymm, h, neg_zero]
    exact crossQ_slot_ne hdet hkk this

name: graze_source_param
statement:
theorem graze_source_param {Q a b d_fc : Point} {s : ℚ} (_hs : 0 < s)
    (hmem : lineAt Q d_fc s ∈ segment ℚ a b) :
    ∃ q : ℚ, 0 ≤ q ∧ q ≤ 1 ∧ Q = (fun i => a i + q * (b i - a i) - s * d_fc i)
proof:
:= by
  simp only [segment, Set.mem_setOf_eq] at hmem
  obtain ⟨p, q, hp0, hq0, hpq, hEq⟩ := hmem
  refine ⟨q, hq0, by linarith, ?_⟩
  funext i
  have hi := congrFun hEq i
  simp only [Pi.add_apply, Pi.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul, lineAt] at hi
  have hp1 : p = 1 - q := by linarith
  rw [hp1] at hi
  linear_combination -hi

name: cramer_reconstruct
statement:
theorem cramer_reconstruct (A B C v : Point) :
    det3 A B C • v = det3 v B C • A + det3 A v C • B + det3 A B v • C
proof:
:= by
  funext i
  fin_cases i
  · show det3 A B C * v 0 = det3 v B C * A 0 + det3 A v C * B 0 + det3 A B v * C 0
    simp only [det3, dotQ, crossQ, mkPoint_zero, mkPoint_one, mkPoint_two]; ring
  · show det3 A B C * v 1 = det3 v B C * A 1 + det3 A v C * B 1 + det3 A B v * C 1
    simp only [det3, dotQ, crossQ, mkPoint_zero, mkPoint_one, mkPoint_two]; ring
  · show det3 A B C * v 2 = det3 v B C * A 2 + det3 A v C * B 2 + det3 A B v * C 2
    simp only [det3, dotQ, crossQ, mkPoint_zero, mkPoint_one, mkPoint_two]; ring

name: exists_edge_support
statement:
theorem exists_edge_support (a b d_fc fc : Point) (hev : psub b a ≠ 0) (hdfc : d_fc ≠ 0)
    (hfc_notin : ∀ q s : ℚ, 0 ≤ q → q ≤ 1 → 0 ≤ s →
       fc ≠ (fun i => a i + q * (b i - a i) - s * d_fc i)) :
    ∃ (Nℓ : Point) (dℓ : ℚ),
      (dotQ Nℓ fc - dℓ < 0) ∧
      (∀ q s : ℚ, 0 ≤ q → q ≤ 1 → 0 < s →
        0 ≤ dotQ Nℓ (fun i => a i + q * (b i - a i) - s * d_fc i) - dℓ)
proof:
:= by
  set ev := psub b a with hevdef
  set Ne := crossQ ev d_fc with hNedef
  set nsq := dotQ Ne Ne with hnsqdef
  have hnsq_nonneg : 0 ≤ nsq := dotQ_self_nonneg Ne
  by_cases hNe0 : Ne = 0
  · 
    have hcross : crossQ ev d_fc = 0 := by rw [← hNedef]; exact hNe0
    have hpar : dotQ ev ev • d_fc = dotQ ev d_fc • ev := smul_eq_of_cross_zero ev d_fc hcross
    have hE : 0 < dotQ ev ev := Proof.WellFormedCheckNormal.dotQ_self_pos hev
    have hF : dotQ ev d_fc ≠ 0 := by
      intro hF0
      have hlag := cross_sq ev d_fc
      rw [hcross, Proof.WellFormedCheckNormal.dotQ_zero_right, hF0] at hlag
      nlinarith [mul_pos hE (Proof.WellFormedCheckNormal.dotQ_self_pos hdfc), hlag]
    by_cases hL : crossQ ev (psub fc a) = 0
    · 
      have hpar2 : dotQ ev ev • psub fc a = dotQ ev (psub fc a) • ev :=
        smul_eq_of_cross_zero ev (psub fc a) hL
      have hfc_line : ∀ i, fc i = a i + (dotQ ev (psub fc a) / dotQ ev ev) * (b i - a i) := by
        intro i
        have hi := congrFun hpar2 i
        simp only [hevdef, Pi.smul_apply, psub, smul_eq_mul] at hi
        field_simp
        linear_combination hi
      have hdfc_line : ∀ i, d_fc i = (dotQ ev d_fc / dotQ ev ev) * (b i - a i) := by
        intro i
        have hi := congrFun hpar i
        simp only [hevdef, Pi.smul_apply, psub, smul_eq_mul] at hi
        field_simp
        linear_combination hi
      by_cases hFpos : 0 < dotQ ev d_fc
      · 
        refine ⟨-ev, -(dotQ ev ev + dotQ ev a), ?_, ?_⟩
        · have hval : dotQ (-ev) fc - -(dotQ ev ev + dotQ ev a)
              = dotQ ev ev - dotQ ev (psub fc a) := by
            simp only [dotQ, psub, Pi.neg_apply]; ring
          rw [hval]
          by_contra hcon; push_neg at hcon
          have hμE : dotQ ev (psub fc a) ≤ dotQ ev ev := by linarith
          rcases le_or_lt 0 (dotQ ev (psub fc a)) with hμ0 | hμ0
          · refine hfc_notin (dotQ ev (psub fc a) / dotQ ev ev) 0
              (div_nonneg hμ0 hE.le) ((div_le_one hE).mpr hμE) (le_refl 0) ?_
            funext i; rw [hfc_line i]; ring
          · refine hfc_notin 0 (-(dotQ ev (psub fc a)) / dotQ ev d_fc) (le_refl 0) (by norm_num)
              (div_nonneg (by linarith) hFpos.le) ?_
            funext i; rw [hfc_line i, hdfc_line i]
            field_simp
            ring
        · intro q s hq0 hq1 hs
          have hval : dotQ (-ev) (fun i => a i + q * (b i - a i) - s * d_fc i)
                - -(dotQ ev ev + dotQ ev a)
              = dotQ ev ev - (q * dotQ ev ev - s * dotQ ev d_fc) := by
            simp only [hevdef, dotQ, psub, Pi.neg_apply]; ring
          rw [hval]
          nlinarith [mul_nonneg (by linarith : (0:ℚ) ≤ 1 - q) hE.le, mul_pos hs hFpos]
      · 
        have hFneg : dotQ ev d_fc < 0 := lt_of_le_of_ne (not_lt.mp hFpos) hF
        refine ⟨ev, dotQ ev a, ?_, ?_⟩
        · have hval : dotQ ev fc - dotQ ev a = dotQ ev (psub fc a) := by
            simp only [dotQ, psub]; ring
          rw [hval]
          by_contra hcon; push_neg at hcon
          rcases le_or_lt (dotQ ev (psub fc a)) (dotQ ev ev) with hμE | hμE
          · refine hfc_notin (dotQ ev (psub fc a) / dotQ ev ev) 0
              (div_nonneg hcon hE.le) ((div_le_one hE).mpr hμE) (le_refl 0) ?_
            funext i; rw [hfc_line i]; ring
          · refine hfc_notin 1 ((dotQ ev ev - dotQ ev (psub fc a)) / dotQ ev d_fc)
              (by norm_num) (le_refl 1)
              (div_nonneg_of_nonpos (by linarith) hFneg.le) ?_
            funext i; rw [hfc_line i, hdfc_line i]
            field_simp
            ring
        · intro q s hq0 hq1 hs
          have hval : dotQ ev (fun i => a i + q * (b i - a i) - s * d_fc i) - dotQ ev a
              = q * dotQ ev ev - s * dotQ ev d_fc := by
            simp only [hevdef, dotQ, psub]; ring
          rw [hval]
          nlinarith [mul_nonneg hq0 hE.le, mul_pos hs (neg_pos.mpr hFneg)]
    · 
      set m := dotQ ev ev • (psub fc a) - dotQ ev (psub fc a) • ev with hmdef
      have hmev : dotQ m ev = 0 := by
        rw [hmdef]; simp only [hevdef, dotQ, psub, Pi.sub_apply, Pi.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul]; ring
      have hmd : dotQ m d_fc = 0 := by
        have h1 : dotQ ev ev * dotQ m d_fc = dotQ ev d_fc * dotQ m ev := by
          have h := congrArg (fun x => dotQ m x) hpar
          simpa only [Proof.WellFormedCheckNormal.dotQ_smul_right] using h
        rw [hmev, mul_zero] at h1
        exact (mul_eq_zero.mp h1).resolve_left (ne_of_gt hE)
      have hmfc : 0 < dotQ m (psub fc a) := by
        have hlag : dotQ m (psub fc a)
            = dotQ (crossQ ev (psub fc a)) (crossQ ev (psub fc a)) := by
          rw [hmdef]
          simp only [hevdef, dotQ, crossQ, psub, Pi.sub_apply, Pi.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul,
            mkPoint_zero, mkPoint_one, mkPoint_two]; ring
        rw [hlag]; exact Proof.WellFormedCheckNormal.dotQ_self_pos hL
      refine ⟨-m, -(dotQ m a), ?_, ?_⟩
      · have hval : dotQ (-m) fc - -(dotQ m a) = -(dotQ m (psub fc a)) := by
          simp only [dotQ, psub, Pi.neg_apply]; ring
        rw [hval]; linarith [hmfc]
      · intro q s hq0 hq1 hs
        have hval : dotQ (-m) (fun i => a i + q * (b i - a i) - s * d_fc i) - -(dotQ m a)
            = -(q * dotQ m ev - s * dotQ m d_fc) := by
          simp only [hevdef, dotQ, psub, Pi.neg_apply]; ring
        rw [hval, hmev, hmd]; norm_num
  · 
    have hnsqpos : 0 < nsq := Proof.WellFormedCheckNormal.dotQ_self_pos hNe0
    set gfc := dotQ Ne (psub a fc) with hgfcdef
    set Lfc := dotQ (crossQ d_fc Ne) (psub fc a) with hLfcdef
    set Sfc := dotQ (crossQ ev Ne) (psub fc a) with hSfcdef
    by_cases hg0 : gfc = 0
    · by_cases hL0 : Lfc < 0
      · 
        refine ⟨crossQ d_fc Ne, dotQ (crossQ d_fc Ne) a, ?_, ?_⟩
        · have hb : dotQ (crossQ d_fc Ne) fc - dotQ (crossQ d_fc Ne) a = Lfc := by
            rw [hLfcdef]; simp only [dotQ, psub]; ring
          rw [hb]; exact hL0
        · intro q s hq0 hq1 hs
          have hb : dotQ (crossQ d_fc Ne) (fun i => a i + q * (b i - a i) - s * d_fc i)
              - dotQ (crossQ d_fc Ne) a = q * nsq := by
            simp only [hnsqdef, hNedef, hevdef, dotQ, crossQ, psub,
              mkPoint_zero, mkPoint_one, mkPoint_two]; ring
          rw [hb]; exact mul_nonneg hq0 hnsq_nonneg
      · push_neg at hL0
        by_cases hLn : nsq < Lfc
        · 
          refine ⟨-(crossQ d_fc Ne), -(nsq) - dotQ (crossQ d_fc Ne) a, ?_, ?_⟩
          · have hb : dotQ (-(crossQ d_fc Ne)) fc - (-(nsq) - dotQ (crossQ d_fc Ne) a)
                = nsq - Lfc := by
              rw [hLfcdef]; simp only [dotQ, psub, Pi.neg_apply]; ring
            rw [hb]; linarith
          · intro q s hq0 hq1 hs
            have hb : dotQ (-(crossQ d_fc Ne)) (fun i => a i + q * (b i - a i) - s * d_fc i)
                - (-(nsq) - dotQ (crossQ d_fc Ne) a) = nsq - q * nsq := by
              simp only [hnsqdef, hNedef, hevdef, dotQ, crossQ, psub, Pi.neg_apply,
                mkPoint_zero, mkPoint_one, mkPoint_two]; ring
            rw [hb]; nlinarith [mul_nonneg (by linarith : (0:ℚ) ≤ 1 - q) hnsq_nonneg]
        · push_neg at hLn
          by_cases hS0 : Sfc < 0
          · 
            refine ⟨crossQ ev Ne, dotQ (crossQ ev Ne) a, ?_, ?_⟩
            · have hb : dotQ (crossQ ev Ne) fc - dotQ (crossQ ev Ne) a = Sfc := by
                rw [hSfcdef]; simp only [dotQ, psub]; ring
              rw [hb]; exact hS0
            · intro q s hq0 hq1 hs
              have hb : dotQ (crossQ ev Ne) (fun i => a i + q * (b i - a i) - s * d_fc i)
                  - dotQ (crossQ ev Ne) a = s * nsq := by
                simp only [hnsqdef, hNedef, hevdef, dotQ, crossQ, psub,
                  mkPoint_zero, mkPoint_one, mkPoint_two]; ring
              rw [hb]; exact mul_nonneg hs.le hnsq_nonneg
          · 
            exfalso
            push_neg at hS0
            have e1 : det3 ev d_fc Ne = nsq := by
              rw [hnsqdef, hNedef]; exact det3_crossQ_self ev d_fc
            have e2 : det3 (psub fc a) d_fc Ne = Lfc := by
              rw [hLfcdef]; simp only [det3]; exact dotQ_symm _ _
            have e3 : det3 ev (psub fc a) Ne = -Sfc := by
              rw [hSfcdef]; simp only [det3, dotQ, crossQ, psub,
                mkPoint_zero, mkPoint_one, mkPoint_two]; ring
            have e4 : det3 ev d_fc (psub fc a) = -gfc := by
              rw [hgfcdef, hNedef]; simp only [det3, dotQ, crossQ, psub,
                mkPoint_zero, mkPoint_one, mkPoint_two]; ring
            have hrec := cramer_reconstruct ev d_fc Ne (psub fc a)
            rw [e1, e2, e3, e4, hg0, neg_zero, zero_smul, add_zero] at hrec
            have hfceq : fc = (fun i => a i + (Lfc / nsq) * (b i - a i) - (Sfc / nsq) * d_fc i) := by
              funext i
              have hi := congrFun hrec i
              simp only [hevdef, Pi.add_apply, Pi.smul_apply, psub, smul_eq_mul] at hi
              field_simp
              linear_combination hi
            exact hfc_notin (Lfc / nsq) (Sfc / nsq) (div_nonneg hL0 hnsqpos.le)
              ((div_le_one hnsqpos).mpr hLn) (div_nonneg hS0 hnsqpos.le) hfceq
    · 
      rcases lt_or_gt_of_ne hg0 with hgneg | hgpos
      · refine ⟨-Ne, -(dotQ Ne a), ?_, ?_⟩
        · have hb : dotQ (-Ne) fc - -(dotQ Ne a) = gfc := by
            rw [hgfcdef]; simp only [dotQ, psub, Pi.neg_apply]; ring
          rw [hb]; exact hgneg
        · intro q s hq0 hq1 hs
          have hb : dotQ (-Ne) (fun i => a i + q * (b i - a i) - s * d_fc i) - -(dotQ Ne a) = 0 := by
            simp only [hNedef, hevdef, dotQ, crossQ, psub, Pi.neg_apply,
              mkPoint_zero, mkPoint_one, mkPoint_two]; ring
          rw [hb]
      · refine ⟨Ne, dotQ Ne a, ?_, ?_⟩
        · have hb : dotQ Ne fc - dotQ Ne a = -gfc := by
            rw [hgfcdef]; simp only [dotQ, psub]; ring
          rw [hb]; linarith
        · intro q s hq0 hq1 hs
          have hb : dotQ Ne (fun i => a i + q * (b i - a i) - s * d_fc i) - dotQ Ne a = 0 := by
            simp only [hNedef, hevdef, dotQ, crossQ, psub,
              mkPoint_zero, mkPoint_one, mkPoint_two]; ring
          rw [hb]

name: crossQ_zero_left
statement: theorem crossQ_zero_left (v : Point) : crossQ 0 v = 0
proof:
:= by
  funext i; fin_cases i <;> simp [crossQ, mkPoint]

name: crossQ_zero_right
statement: theorem crossQ_zero_right (v : Point) : crossQ v 0 = 0
proof:
:= by
  funext i; fin_cases i <;> simp [crossQ, mkPoint]

name: segment_edge_subset_triangle
statement:
theorem segment_edge_subset_triangle (t : Triangle) (k : Fin 3) :
    segment ℚ (edgeTail t k) (edgeHead t k) ⊆ triangleSet t
proof:
:= by
  have hconv : Convex ℚ (triangleSet t) := convex_convexHull ℚ _
  refine hconv.segment_subset (subset_convexHull ℚ _ ?_) (subset_convexHull ℚ _ ?_)
  · fin_cases k <;> simp [edgeTail]
  · fin_cases k <;> simp [edgeHead]

name: interp_neg
statement:
theorem interp_neg {X Y θ : ℚ} (hX : X < 0) (hY : Y < 0) (h0 : 0 ≤ θ) (h1 : θ ≤ 1) :
    (1 - θ) * X + θ * Y < 0
proof:
:= by
  rcases eq_or_lt_of_le h1 with h | h
  · rw [h]; simpa using hY
  · nlinarith [mul_pos (by linarith : (0:ℚ) < 1 - θ) (neg_pos.mpr hX),
      mul_nonneg h0 (neg_nonneg.mpr hY.le)]

name: interp_pos
statement:
theorem interp_pos {X Y θ : ℚ} (hX : 0 < X) (hY : 0 < Y) (h0 : 0 ≤ θ) (h1 : θ ≤ 1) :
    0 < (1 - θ) * X + θ * Y
proof:
:= by
  rcases eq_or_lt_of_le h1 with h | h
  · rw [h]; simpa using hY
  · nlinarith [mul_pos (by linarith : (0:ℚ) < 1 - θ) hX, mul_nonneg h0 hY.le]

name: interp_ne
statement:
theorem interp_ne {X Y θ : ℚ} (hXY : 0 < X * Y) (h0 : 0 ≤ θ) (h1 : θ ≤ 1) :
    (1 - θ) * X + θ * Y ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  rcases mul_pos_iff.mp hXY with ⟨hX, hY⟩ | ⟨hX, hY⟩
  · exact ne_of_gt (interp_pos hX hY h0 h1)
  · exact ne_of_lt (interp_neg hX hY h0 h1)

name: det3_span2
statement: theorem det3_span2 (p q : ℚ) (u v : Point) : det3 (p • u + q • v) u v = 0
proof:
:= by
  simp only [det3, dotQ, crossQ, Pi.add_apply, Pi.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul,
    mkPoint_zero, mkPoint_one, mkPoint_two]; ring

name: crossQ_edge_source
statement:
theorem crossQ_edge_source (a b P : Point) :
    crossQ (psub a P) (psub b P) = crossQ (psub b a) (psub P a)
proof:
:= by
  funext i; fin_cases i <;> simp [crossQ, psub, mkPoint] <;> ring

name: dotQ_resultant
statement:
theorem dotQ_resultant (A B : ℚ) (u w d : Point) :
    dotQ (A • u - B • w) d = A * dotQ u d - B * dotQ w d
proof:
:= by
  simp only [dotQ, Pi.sub_apply, Pi.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul]; ring

name: no_graze_from_P
statement:
theorem no_graze_from_P {a b P dir : Point} {t : ℚ} (ht : t ≠ 0)
    (hne : dotQ (crossQ (psub a P) (psub b P)) dir ≠ 0)
    (hmem : lineAt P dir t ∈ segment ℚ a b) : False
proof:
:= by
  simp only [segment, Set.mem_setOf_eq] at hmem
  obtain ⟨p, q, hp0, hq0, hpq, hEq⟩ := hmem
  have hspan : (fun i => t * dir i) = p • (psub a P) + q • (psub b P) := by
    funext i
    have hi := congrFun hEq i
    simp only [Pi.add_apply, Pi.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul, lineAt, psub] at hi ⊢
    have hp1 : p = 1 - q := by linarith
    rw [hp1] at hi ⊢
    linear_combination -hi
  have hkey : t * det3 dir (psub a P) (psub b P) = 0 := by
    have h1 : det3 (fun i => t * dir i) (psub a P) (psub b P)
        = t * det3 dir (psub a P) (psub b P) := by
      simp only [det3, dotQ, crossQ, mkPoint_zero, mkPoint_one, mkPoint_two]; ring
    rw [← h1, hspan]; exact det3_span2 p q _ _
  have hdet0 : det3 dir (psub a P) (psub b P) = 0 :=
    (mul_eq_zero.mp hkey).resolve_left ht
  apply hne
  have : det3 dir (psub a P) (psub b P) = dotQ (crossQ (psub a P) (psub b P)) dir := by
    simp only [det3]; exact dotQ_symm _ _
  rw [← this]; exact hdet0

name: gen_dense_codir
statement:
theorem gen_dense_codir {MB : Mesh} (hnpo : NoPlaneThroughOrigin MB)
    {r : ℕ} [NeZero r] (hr : 3 ≤ r) {n : Point} {c : ℚ} {w : Fin r → Point}
    (hpl : OnPlane n c w) (hs : StrictConv n w)
    {fc d_fc : Point}
    (hfc_bary : fc = ∑ i, (r : ℚ)⁻¹ • w i)
    (hoff_surf : ∀ (u : Fin MB.size), ∀ x ∈ vrelint w, x ∉ triangleSet MB[u])
    (hd_fc_ne : d_fc ≠ 0)
    (hd_fc_clean : ∀ (u : Fin MB.size) (s : ℚ), 0 < s → lineAt fc d_fc s ∉ edgeSet MB[u])
    (hfacet_feas : ∀ (j : Fin MB.size) (g : Half), g ∈ tetraHalves MB[j] →
      ∃ y, dotQ n y = c ∧ g.eval y ≠ 0)
    (hmoment : ∀ (u : Fin MB.size) (k : Fin 3),
      ∃ m : Point, dotQ m (psub (edgeHead MB[u] k) (edgeTail MB[u] k)) = 0 ∧
        ∃ y, dotQ n y = c ∧ dotQ m (psub y (edgeTail MB[u] k)) ≠ 0) :
    ∃ P d' : Point,
      P ∈ vrelint w ∧
      G1Clean MB P ∧
      d' ≠ 0 ∧
      (∀ u : Fin MB.size, dotQ (Proof.MeshIntersectJump.faceNormal MB[u]) P ≠ detOrigin MB[u]) ∧
      (∀ u : Fin MB.size, dotQ (Proof.MeshIntersectJump.faceNormal MB[u]) d' ≠ 0) ∧
      (∀ (j : Fin MB.size) (k : Fin 4), dotQ (slot MB[j] k).n d' ≠ 0) ∧
      (∀ (j : Fin MB.size), ∀ g ∈ tetraHalves MB[j], ∀ g' ∈ tetraHalves MB[j],
        g ≠ g' → ∀ t : ℚ, ¬ (g.eval (lineAt P d' t) = 0 ∧ g'.eval (lineAt P d' t) = 0)) ∧
      (∀ (u : Fin MB.size) (t : ℚ), t ≠ 0 → lineAt P d' t ∉ edgeSet MB[u]) ∧
      (∀ θ : ℚ, 0 ≤ θ → θ ≤ 1 → ∀ u : Fin MB.size,
        (fun i => fc i + θ * (P i - fc i)) ∉ triangleSet MB[u]) ∧
      (∀ θ : ℚ, 0 ≤ θ → θ ≤ 1 → ∀ u : Fin MB.size, ∀ s : ℚ, 0 < s →
        lineAt (fun i => fc i + θ * (P i - fc i)) d_fc s ∉ edgeSet MB[u]) ∧
      (∀ θ : ℚ, 0 ≤ θ → θ ≤ 1 → (fun i => (1 - θ) * d_fc i + θ * d' i) ≠ 0) ∧
      (∀ θ : ℚ, 0 ≤ θ → θ ≤ 1 → ∀ u : Fin MB.size, ∀ s : ℚ, 0 < s →
        lineAt P (fun i => (1 - θ) * d_fc i + θ * d' i) s ∉ edgeSet MB[u])
proof:
:= by
  classical
  
  have hfc_plane : dotQ n fc = c := by
    have h := hfc_bary ▸ barycenter_mem_vrelint hr w
    rw [vrelint_eq hr hpl hs] at h; exact h.1
  have hfc_mem : fc ∈ vrelint w := hfc_bary ▸ barycenter_mem_vrelint hr w
  have hbary : (∑ i, (r : ℚ)⁻¹ • w i) = fc := hfc_bary.symm
  have hddfc : 0 < dotQ d_fc d_fc := Proof.WellFormedCheckNormal.dotQ_self_pos hd_fc_ne
  
  have hedge_ne : ∀ (u : Fin MB.size) (k : Fin 3),
      psub (edgeHead MB[u] k) (edgeTail MB[u] k) ≠ 0 := by
    intro u k
    fin_cases k
    · show psub MB[u].v₁ MB[u].v₀ ≠ 0
      intro h; apply faceNormal_ne_zero (hnpo u); rw [Proof.MeshIntersectJump.faceNormal, h]; exact crossQ_zero_left _
    · show psub MB[u].v₂ MB[u].v₁ ≠ 0
      intro h; apply faceNormal_ne_zero (hnpo u); rw [Proof.MeshIntersectJump.faceNormal]
      have he : psub MB[u].v₂ MB[u].v₀ = psub MB[u].v₁ MB[u].v₀ := by
        funext i; have := congrFun h i; simp only [psub, Pi.zero_apply] at this ⊢; linarith
      rw [he]; exact crossQ_self _
    · show psub MB[u].v₀ MB[u].v₂ ≠ 0
      intro h; apply faceNormal_ne_zero (hnpo u); rw [Proof.MeshIntersectJump.faceNormal]
      have he : psub MB[u].v₂ MB[u].v₀ = 0 := by
        funext i; have := congrFun h i; simp only [psub, Pi.zero_apply] at this ⊢; linarith
      rw [he]; exact crossQ_zero_right _
  
  have hfcnotin : ∀ (u : Fin MB.size) (k : Fin 3), ∀ q s : ℚ, 0 ≤ q → q ≤ 1 → 0 ≤ s →
      fc ≠ (fun i => (edgeTail MB[u] k) i
        + q * ((edgeHead MB[u] k) i - (edgeTail MB[u] k) i) - s * d_fc i) := by
    intro u k q s hq0 hq1 hs0 heq
    set a := edgeTail MB[u] k with hadef
    set b := edgeHead MB[u] k with hbdef
    have hseg : (fun i => a i + q * (b i - a i)) ∈ segment ℚ a b := by
      refine ⟨1 - q, q, by linarith, hq0, by ring, ?_⟩
      funext i; simp only [Pi.add_apply, Pi.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul]; ring
    have hsub : segment ℚ a b ⊆ edgeSet MB[u] := by
      rw [edgeSet_eq_iUnion]
      exact Set.subset_iUnion
        (fun k' => segment ℚ (edgeTail MB[u] k') (edgeHead MB[u] k')) k
    rcases eq_or_lt_of_le hs0 with hs | hs
    · apply hoff_surf u fc hfc_mem
      have hfceq : fc = (fun i => a i + q * (b i - a i)) := by
        rw [heq]; funext i; rw [← hs]; ring
      rw [hfceq]; exact segment_edge_subset_triangle MB[u] k hseg
    · apply hd_fc_clean u s hs
      have hpt : lineAt fc d_fc s = (fun i => a i + q * (b i - a i)) := by
        funext i; simp only [lineAt]; rw [congrFun heq i]; ring
      rw [hpt]; exact hsub hseg
  
  choose mfun hmperp hmfeas using hmoment
  have hsupp : ∀ (u : Fin MB.size) (k : Fin 3), ∃ (Nℓ : Point) (dℓ : ℚ),
      (dotQ Nℓ fc - dℓ < 0) ∧
      (∀ q s : ℚ, 0 ≤ q → q ≤ 1 → 0 < s →
        0 ≤ dotQ Nℓ (fun i => (edgeTail MB[u] k) i
          + q * ((edgeHead MB[u] k) i - (edgeTail MB[u] k) i) - s * d_fc i) - dℓ) :=
    fun u k => exists_edge_support (edgeTail MB[u] k) (edgeHead MB[u] k) d_fc fc
      (hedge_ne u k) hd_fc_ne (hfcnotin u k)
  choose Nlfun dlfun hl1 hl2 using hsupp
  
  have hsource_clean : ∀ (Q : Point),
      (∀ (u : Fin MB.size) (k : Fin 3), dotQ (Nlfun u k) Q - dlfun u k < 0) →
      ∀ (u : Fin MB.size) (s : ℚ), 0 < s → lineAt Q d_fc s ∉ edgeSet MB[u] := by
    intro Q hQneg u s hs hmem
    rw [edgeSet_eq_iUnion] at hmem
    simp only [Set.mem_iUnion] at hmem
    obtain ⟨k, hk⟩ := hmem
    obtain ⟨q, hq0, hq1, hQeq⟩ := graze_source_param hs hk
    have hge := hl2 u k q s hq0 hq1 hs
    rw [← hQeq] at hge
    linarith [hQneg u k, hge]
  
  obtain ⟨P, hPmem, hPall⟩ := side_dense_vrelint' hr hpl hs
    (Sum.elim (fun jk : Fin MB.size × Fin 4 => (slot MB[jk.1] jk.2).n)
      (Sum.elim (fun uk : Fin MB.size × Fin 3 => mfun uk.1 uk.2)
        (fun uk : Fin MB.size × Fin 3 => Nlfun uk.1 uk.2)))
    (Sum.elim (fun jk : Fin MB.size × Fin 4 => (slot MB[jk.1] jk.2).c)
      (Sum.elim (fun uk : Fin MB.size × Fin 3 => dotQ (mfun uk.1 uk.2) (edgeTail MB[uk.1] uk.2))
        (fun uk : Fin MB.size × Fin 3 => dlfun uk.1 uk.2)))
    (by
      rintro (⟨j, k⟩ | ⟨u, k⟩ | ⟨u, k⟩)
      · obtain ⟨y, hy1, hy2⟩ := hfacet_feas j (slot MB[j] k) (slot_mem _ _)
        refine ⟨y, hy1, ?_⟩
        simp only [Sum.elim_inl]
        intro h; exact hy2 (by simp only [Half.eval]; rw [h, sub_self])
      · obtain ⟨y, hy1, hy2⟩ := hmfeas u k
        refine ⟨y, hy1, ?_⟩
        simp only [Sum.elim_inl, Sum.elim_inr]
        intro h; apply hy2
        have hd : dotQ (mfun u k) (psub y (edgeTail MB[u] k))
            = dotQ (mfun u k) y - dotQ (mfun u k) (edgeTail MB[u] k) := by
          simp only [dotQ, psub]; ring
        rw [hd, h, sub_self]
      · refine ⟨fc, hfc_plane, ?_⟩
        simp only [Sum.elim_inr]
        exact sub_ne_zero.mp (ne_of_lt (hl1 u k)))
  
  have hG1 : ∀ (j : Fin MB.size) (k : Fin 4), (slot MB[j] k).eval P ≠ 0 := by
    intro j k h
    have hne := (hPall (Sum.inl (j, k))).1
    simp only [Sum.elim_inl] at hne
    simp only [Half.eval, sub_eq_zero] at h
    exact hne h
  have hG1clean : G1Clean MB P := by
    intro j g hg
    obtain ⟨k, rfl⟩ := mem_tetraHalves_iff.mp hg
    exact hG1 j k
  have hP_offline : ∀ (u : Fin MB.size) (k : Fin 3),
      dotQ (mfun u k) (psub P (edgeTail MB[u] k)) ≠ 0 := by
    intro u k h
    have hne := (hPall (Sum.inr (Sum.inl (u, k)))).1
    simp only [Sum.elim_inl, Sum.elim_inr] at hne
    apply hne
    have hd : dotQ (mfun u k) (psub P (edgeTail MB[u] k))
        = dotQ (mfun u k) P - dotQ (mfun u k) (edgeTail MB[u] k) := by
      simp only [dotQ, psub]; ring
    rw [hd] at h; linarith
  have hP_he_ne : ∀ (u : Fin MB.size) (k : Fin 3),
      crossQ (psub (edgeTail MB[u] k) P) (psub (edgeHead MB[u] k) P) ≠ 0 := by
    intro u k
    rw [crossQ_edge_source]
    intro hc
    apply hP_offline u k
    rw [dotQ_symm]
    exact perp_of_parallel (hedge_ne u k) hc (by rw [dotQ_symm]; exact hmperp u k)
  have hℓP : ∀ (u : Fin MB.size) (k : Fin 3), dotQ (Nlfun u k) P - dlfun u k < 0 := by
    intro u k
    have hside := (hPall (Sum.inr (Sum.inr (u, k)))).2
    simp only [Sum.elim_inr] at hside
    rw [hbary] at hside
    have hpos := hside (sub_ne_zero.mp (ne_of_lt (hl1 u k)))
    rcases mul_pos_iff.mp hpos with ⟨h, _⟩ | ⟨_, h⟩
    · exact absurd h (not_lt.mpr (hl1 u k).le)
    · exact h
  have hℓseg : ∀ (u : Fin MB.size) (k : Fin 3) (θ : ℚ), 0 ≤ θ → θ ≤ 1 →
      dotQ (Nlfun u k) (fun i => fc i + θ * (P i - fc i)) - dlfun u k < 0 := by
    intro u k θ hθ0 hθ1
    have hlin : dotQ (Nlfun u k) (fun i => fc i + θ * (P i - fc i)) - dlfun u k
        = (1 - θ) * (dotQ (Nlfun u k) fc - dlfun u k) + θ * (dotQ (Nlfun u k) P - dlfun u k) := by
      simp only [dotQ]; ring
    rw [hlin]; exact interp_neg (hl1 u k) (hℓP u k) hθ0 hθ1
  have hP_dfc_clean := hsource_clean P hℓP
  
  obtain ⟨d', hdall⟩ := side_dense_dir' d_fc
    (Sum.elim (fun u : Fin MB.size => Proof.MeshIntersectJump.faceNormal MB[u])
      (Sum.elim (fun jk : Fin MB.size × Fin 4 => (slot MB[jk.1] jk.2).n)
        (Sum.elim (fun t : Fin MB.size × Fin 4 × Fin 4 =>
            if t.2.1 = t.2.2 then d_fc
            else (slot MB[t.1] t.2.1).eval P • (slot MB[t.1] t.2.2).n
              - (slot MB[t.1] t.2.2).eval P • (slot MB[t.1] t.2.1).n)
          (Sum.elim
            (fun uk : Fin MB.size × Fin 3 =>
              crossQ (psub (edgeTail MB[uk.1] uk.2) P) (psub (edgeHead MB[uk.1] uk.2) P))
            (fun _ : Unit => d_fc)))))
    (by
      rintro (u | ⟨j, k⟩ | ⟨j, k, k'⟩ | ⟨u, k⟩ | _)
      · simp only [Sum.elim_inl]; exact faceNormal_ne_zero (hnpo u)
      · simp only [Sum.elim_inl, Sum.elim_inr]; exact facet_n_ne_zero (hnpo j) _ (slot_mem _ _)
      · simp only [Sum.elim_inl, Sum.elim_inr]
        split_ifs with hkk
        · exact hd_fc_ne
        · exact resultant_ne (hnpo j) hkk (hG1 j k) (hG1 j k')
      · simp only [Sum.elim_inl, Sum.elim_inr]; exact hP_he_ne u k
      · simp only [Sum.elim_inr]; exact hd_fc_ne)
  
  have hφ := hdall (Sum.inr (Sum.inr (Sum.inr (Sum.inr ()))))
  simp only [Sum.elim_inr] at hφ
  have hdd' : 0 < dotQ d_fc d' := by
    have hmul := hφ.2 (ne_of_gt hddfc)
    by_contra h; push_neg at h
    exact absurd hmul (not_lt.mpr (mul_nonpos_of_nonneg_of_nonpos hddfc.le h))
  have hd'ne : d' ≠ 0 := by
    intro h; apply hφ.1; rw [h]; exact Proof.WellFormedCheckNormal.dotQ_zero_right d_fc
  
  refine ⟨P, d', hPmem, hG1clean, hd'ne,
    fun u => sub_ne_zero.mp (clean_off_carrier hnpo hG1clean u),
    fun u => by have := (hdall (Sum.inl u)).1; simpa only [Sum.elim_inl] using this,
    fun j k => by
      have := (hdall (Sum.inr (Sum.inl (j, k)))).1
      simpa only [Sum.elim_inl, Sum.elim_inr] using this,
    ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · 
    intro j g hg g' hg' hne t ht
    obtain ⟨k, rfl⟩ := mem_tetraHalves_iff.mp hg
    obtain ⟨k', rfl⟩ := mem_tetraHalves_iff.mp hg'
    have hkk : k ≠ k' := fun h => hne (by rw [h])
    obtain ⟨he1, he2⟩ := ht
    have hres := (hdall (Sum.inr (Sum.inr (Sum.inl (j, k, k'))))).1
    simp only [Sum.elim_inl, Sum.elim_inr, if_neg hkk] at hres
    rw [eval_lineAt] at he1 he2
    apply hres
    rw [dotQ_resultant]
    linear_combination (dotQ (slot MB[j] k').n d') * he1 - (dotQ (slot MB[j] k).n d') * he2
  · 
    intro u t ht hmem
    rw [edgeSet_eq_iUnion] at hmem
    simp only [Set.mem_iUnion] at hmem
    obtain ⟨k, hk⟩ := hmem
    have hhe := (hdall (Sum.inr (Sum.inr (Sum.inr (Sum.inl (u, k)))))).1
    simp only [Sum.elim_inl, Sum.elim_inr] at hhe
    exact no_graze_from_P ht hhe hk
  · 
    intro θ hθ0 hθ1 u
    have heq : (fun i => fc i + θ * (P i - fc i)) = (1 - θ) • fc + θ • P := by
      funext i; simp only [Pi.add_apply, Pi.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul]; ring
    rw [heq]
    exact hoff_surf u _ (vrelint_convex hr hpl hs hfc_mem hPmem
      (by linarith : (0:ℚ) ≤ 1 - θ) hθ0 (by ring : (1 - θ) + θ = 1))
  · 
    intro θ hθ0 hθ1 u s hs
    exact hsource_clean (fun i => fc i + θ * (P i - fc i))
      (fun u' k => hℓseg u' k θ hθ0 hθ1) u s hs
  · 
    intro θ hθ0 hθ1 h
    have hdotθ : dotQ d_fc (fun i => (1 - θ) * d_fc i + θ * d' i)
        = (1 - θ) * dotQ d_fc d_fc + θ * dotQ d_fc d' := by simp only [dotQ]; ring
    have hpos : 0 < dotQ d_fc (fun i => (1 - θ) * d_fc i + θ * d' i) := by
      rw [hdotθ]; exact interp_pos hddfc hdd' hθ0 hθ1
    rw [h, Proof.WellFormedCheckNormal.dotQ_zero_right] at hpos
    exact lt_irrefl 0 hpos
  · 
    intro θ hθ0 hθ1 u s hs hmem
    rcases eq_or_lt_of_le hθ0 with hθ | hθ
    · have hdθ0 : (fun i => (1 - θ) * d_fc i + θ * d' i) = d_fc := by
        rw [← hθ]; funext i; ring
      rw [hdθ0] at hmem
      exact hP_dfc_clean u s hs hmem
    · rw [edgeSet_eq_iUnion] at hmem
      simp only [Set.mem_iUnion] at hmem
      obtain ⟨k, hk⟩ := hmem
      refine no_graze_from_P hs.ne' ?_ hk
      have hheP := hdall (Sum.inr (Sum.inr (Sum.inr (Sum.inl (u, k)))))
      simp only [Sum.elim_inl, Sum.elim_inr] at hheP
      have hlin : dotQ (crossQ (psub (edgeTail MB[u] k) P) (psub (edgeHead MB[u] k) P))
            (fun i => (1 - θ) * d_fc i + θ * d' i)
          = (1 - θ) * dotQ (crossQ (psub (edgeTail MB[u] k) P) (psub (edgeHead MB[u] k) P)) d_fc
            + θ * dotQ (crossQ (psub (edgeTail MB[u] k) P) (psub (edgeHead MB[u] k) P)) d' := by
        simp only [dotQ]; ring
      rw [hlin]
      by_cases hdfc0 : dotQ (crossQ (psub (edgeTail MB[u] k) P) (psub (edgeHead MB[u] k) P)) d_fc = 0
      · rw [hdfc0]; simp only [mul_zero, zero_add]
        exact mul_ne_zero hθ.ne' hheP.1
      · exact interp_ne (hheP.2 hdfc0) hθ0 hθ1

name: miRmin_sub
statement: theorem miRmin_sub (a b k : Rat) : rmin (a - k) (b - k) = rmin a b - k
proof:
:= by
  unfold rmin
  by_cases h : a ≤ b
  · rw [if_pos (sub_le_sub_right h k), if_pos h]
  · rw [if_neg (by rw [sub_le_sub_iff_right]; exact h), if_neg h]

name: miRmax_sub
statement: theorem miRmax_sub (a b k : Rat) : rmax (a - k) (b - k) = rmax a b - k
proof:
:= by
  unfold rmax
  by_cases h : a ≤ b
  · rw [if_pos (sub_le_sub_right h k), if_pos h]
  · rw [if_neg (by rw [sub_le_sub_iff_right]; exact h), if_neg h]

name: pminS_translate
statement: theorem pminS_translate (a b o : P3) : pminS (psubS a o) (psubS b o) = psubS (pminS a b) o
proof:
:= by
  simp only [pminS, psubS, miRmin_sub]

name: pmaxS_translate
statement: theorem pmaxS_translate (a b o : P3) : pmaxS (psubS a o) (psubS b o) = psubS (pmaxS a b) o
proof:
:= by
  simp only [pmaxS, psubS, miRmax_sub]

name: trFaceS_v0p
statement: theorem trFaceS_v0p (o : P3) (f : FaceS) : (trFaceS o f).v₀.p = psubS f.v₀.p o
proof: := rfl

name: trFaceS_v1p
statement: theorem trFaceS_v1p (o : P3) (f : FaceS) : (trFaceS o f).v₁.p = psubS f.v₁.p o
proof: := rfl

name: trFaceS_v2p
statement: theorem trFaceS_v2p (o : P3) (f : FaceS) : (trFaceS o f).v₂.p = psubS f.v₂.p o
proof: := rfl

name: boxToBVH_bboxOfFace_trFaceS
statement:
theorem boxToBVH_bboxOfFace_trFaceS (o : P3) (f : FaceS) :
    boxToBVH (bboxOfFace (trFaceS o f))
    = shBox o.x o.y o.z (boxToBVH (bboxOfFace f))
proof:
:= by
  simp only [bboxOfFace, trFaceS_v0p, trFaceS_v1p, trFaceS_v2p,
    pminS_translate, pmaxS_translate]
  simp only [boxToBVH, shBox, psubS]

name: candidates_tr
statement:
theorem candidates_tr (o : P3) (A B : Array FaceS) :
    candidates (A.map (trFaceS o)) (B.map (trFaceS o)) = candidates A B
proof:
:= by
  simp only [candidates]
  have hB : (B.map (trFaceS o)).map (fun g => boxToBVH (bboxOfFace g))
          = (B.map (fun g => boxToBVH (bboxOfFace g))).map (shBox o.x o.y o.z) := by
    rw [Array.map_map, Array.map_map]
    have hfun : (fun g => boxToBVH (bboxOfFace g)) ∘ trFaceS o
              = shBox o.x o.y o.z ∘ (fun g => boxToBVH (bboxOfFace g)) := by
      funext g; exact boxToBVH_bboxOfFace_trFaceS o g
    rw [hfun]
  rw [hB, Array.map_map]
  have hAfun :
      (fun f => Impl.BVH.boxQuery
        (Impl.BVH.buildBVH ((B.map (fun g => boxToBVH (bboxOfFace g))).map (shBox o.x o.y o.z)))
        (boxToBVH (bboxOfFace f))) ∘ trFaceS o
    = (fun f => Impl.BVH.boxQuery
        (Impl.BVH.buildBVH (B.map (fun g => boxToBVH (bboxOfFace g))))
        (boxToBVH (bboxOfFace f))) := by
    funext af
    simp only [Function.comp]
    rw [boxToBVH_bboxOfFace_trFaceS o af]
    exact boxQuery_buildBVH_sh (B.map (fun g => boxToBVH (bboxOfFace g)))
      o.x o.y o.z (boxToBVH (bboxOfFace af))
  rw [hAfun]

name: copB_hoppInv
statement:
theorem copB_hoppInv {M₁ M₂ : Mesh} (h₂ : NoPlaneThroughOrigin M₂)
    {u : Triangle} (hdetA : detOrigin u ≠ 0)
    {fa : Frag} (hfapl : fa.plane = (faceSOf u).plane) :
    ∀ fb ∈ (splitCoplanar (Proof.MeshIntersectNsi.fragsBOf M₁ M₂) (materialize M₁)).1,
      ∃ n' c', FragInv n' c' fb
        ∧ (coplanarPlane fa.plane fb.plane = true →
            ∃ ρ : ℚ, ρ ≠ 0 ∧ n' = ρ • carrierNormal u ∧ c' = ρ * detOrigin u)
proof:
:= by
  intro fb hfb
  obtain ⟨j, hj, hfbInv, hdetB, hfbpl, -⟩ := Proof.MeshIntersectNsi.copB_carrier h₂ hfb
  refine ⟨carrierNormal (M₂[j]'hj), detOrigin (M₂[j]'hj), hfbInv, fun hcop' => ?_⟩
  have hcopij : coplanarPlane (faceSOf u).plane (faceSOf (M₂[j]'hj)).plane = true := by
    rw [← hfapl, ← hfbpl]; exact hcop'
  obtain ⟨ρ, hρ, hnρ, hcρ⟩ := Proof.MeshIntersectNsi.coplanar_carrier_prop hdetA hdetB hcopij
  exact ⟨ρ, hρ, hnρ, hcρ⟩

name: cop_cell_relint_dichotomy_pending
statement:
theorem cop_cell_relint_dichotomy_pending (M₁ M₂ : Mesh)
    (h₁ : Legacy.WellFormedMesh M₁) (_h₂ : Legacy.WellFormedMesh M₂)
    {Q : Point} (hG : Gen M₁ M₂ Q) (i : Fin M₁.size)
    {fa : Frag}
    (hfaClip : fa ∈ clipFaceScoped (fragOfFace ((materialize M₁).getD i.1 default))
        (planesForScoped ((materialize M₁).getD i.1 default).plane (materialize M₂)
          ((candP M₁ M₂).getD i.1 #[])))
    {opp : Array Frag}
    (hopp : opp = (splitCoplanar (Proof.MeshIntersectNsi.fragsBOf M₁ M₂) (materialize M₁)).1)
    {p : Frag}
    (hp : p ∈ Proof.MeshIntersectResolve.resolveFragPending fa opp)
    (hpoly : Proof.MeshIntersectStep.faceHit M₁[i] Q
        ∈ Proof.MeshIntersectClip.vpoly (fragCycle p)) :
    Proof.MeshIntersectStep.faceHit M₁[i] Q
      ∈ Proof.MeshIntersectClip.vrelint (fragCycle p)
proof:
:= by
  have hdetA : detOrigin M₁[i] ≠ 0 := h₁.2.2.2 i
  have hgetD : (materialize M₁).getD i.1 default = faceSOf M₁[i] := by
    rw [getD_eq_getElem (materialize M₁) (by rw [materialize_size]; exact i.isLt) default,
      materialize_getElem M₁ i.1 i.isLt]; rfl
  have hinv₀ : FragInv (carrierNormal M₁[i]) (detOrigin M₁[i])
      (fragOfFace ((materialize M₁).getD i.1 default)) := by
    rw [hgetD]; exact Proof.MeshIntersectKeep.fragInv_base hdetA
  have hfaInv : FragInv (carrierNormal M₁[i]) (detOrigin M₁[i]) fa :=
    fragInv_clipFaceScoped hinv₀ _ hfaClip
  have hfInv : FragInv (carrierNormal M₁[i]) (detOrigin M₁[i]) p :=
    Proof.MeshIntersectResolve.resolveFragPending_fragInv _ hfaInv p hp
  haveI := hfaInv.neZero
  haveI := hfInv.neZero
  have hfapl : fa.plane = (faceSOf M₁[i]).plane := by
    have := Proof.MeshIntersectNsi.clipFaceScoped_plane _ _ hfaClip
    rw [hgetD, fragOfFace] at this; simpa using this
  have hLopp : ∀ fb ∈ opp,
      coplanarPlane fa.plane fb.plane = true →
      ∀ g ∈ edgePlanesOf fb, g ∈ Proof.MeshIntersectFaceLedger.copEdgePlanes M₁ M₂ i.1 := by
    intro fb hfb hcop g hg
    rw [hopp] at hfb
    rw [Proof.MeshIntersectFaceLedger.copEdgePlanes, List.mem_flatMap]
    refine ⟨fb, ?_, ?_⟩
    · rw [Array.mem_toList, Array.mem_filter]
      refine ⟨hfb, ?_⟩
      rw [hgetD, ← hfapl]; exact hcop
    · exact Array.mem_toList.mpr hg
  have hfProv : FragProv (carrierNormal M₁[i]) (fragCycle fa)
      (Proof.MeshIntersectFaceLedger.copEdgePlanes M₁ M₂ i.1) p :=
    Proof.MeshIntersectResolve.resolveFragPending_fragProv
      (nt := carrierNormal M₁[i]) (ct := detOrigin M₁[i])
      (w₀ := fragCycle fa) (L := Proof.MeshIntersectFaceLedger.copEdgePlanes M₁ M₂ i.1)
      _ hfaInv (Proof.MeshIntersectNpo.fragProv_self (carrierNormal M₁[i])) hLopp p hp
  have hP := gen_cop_avoidsLines hG i (hG.1 i) hfaClip
  show Proof.MeshIntersectStep.faceParam M₁[i] Q • Q
      ∈ Proof.MeshIntersectClip.vrelint (fragCycle p)
  rw [Proof.MeshIntersectStep.faceParam]
  refine (vrelint_or_not_vpoly_of_avoids hfInv hfProv hP).resolve_right
    (not_not_intro ?_)
  show Proof.MeshIntersectStep.faceHit M₁[i] Q ∈ Proof.MeshIntersectClip.vpoly (fragCycle p)
  exact hpoly

    {fa : Frag} (hfaA : fa ∈ (splitCoplanar (Proof.MeshIntersectNsi.fragsAOf M₁ M₂) (materialize M₂)).1)

    (hpend : f ∈ Proof.MeshIntersectResolve.resolveFragPending fa

    (havoid : ∀ fb ∈ (splitCoplanar (Proof.MeshIntersectNsi.fragsBOf M₁ M₂) (materialize M₁)).1,

        Proof.MeshIntersectClip.vrelint (fragCycle f)

    {p_i : Point} (hPrel : p_i ∈ Proof.MeshIntersectClip.vrelint (fragCycle f))
    (hoff : Proof.MeshIntersectRadialTransport.OffBdy M₂ p_i) :
    keepFallback (faceBVH (prepare (materialize M₂))) (prepare (materialize M₂)) f = true
      ↔ winding (meshChain M₂) p_i = 1
proof:
:= by
  classical
  obtain ⟨i', hi', hfaInv, hdetA', hfapl', hfaclip'⟩ :=
    Proof.MeshIntersectNsi.copA_carrier h₁.2.2.2 hfaA
  have hfInv : FragInv (carrierNormal M₁[i']) (detOrigin M₁[i']) f :=

  have hInvDesc : ∀ {n c : _}, FragInv n c fa → FragInv n c f :=

  have hVpDesc : Proof.MeshIntersectClip.vpoly (fragCycle f)
      ⊆ Proof.MeshIntersectClip.vpoly (fragCycle fa) :=
    Proof.MeshIntersectResolve.resolveFragPending_vpoly_subset_fa _ hfaInv hpend
  obtain ⟨hoffT, hrelintCop⟩ := keptCopA_geom M₁ M₂ h₁ h₂ hfaA hInvDesc hVpDesc havoid hi' hfapl'
  clear hInvDesc hVpDesc hpend havoid hfaInv hfaclip'
  exact keep_iff_winding_core h₂ hdetA' hfInv hoffT hrelintCop hPrel hoff

name: keptFaceA_cover_ge_one
statement:
theorem keptFaceA_cover_ge_one (M₁ M₂ : Mesh)
    (h₁ : Legacy.WellFormedMesh M₁) (h₂ : Legacy.WellFormedMesh M₂)
    {Q : Point} (hG : Gen M₁ M₂ Q) (i : Fin M₁.size)
    (hcop : ¬ Proof.MeshIntersectCop.TrFace M₁ M₂ i.1 i.isLt)
    (hpos : 0 < Proof.MeshIntersectStep.faceParam M₁[i] Q)
    (hno2 : ∀ j : Fin M₂.size,
        ¬ Proof.MeshIntersectDelta.FaceJumps M₂[j] Q (Proof.MeshIntersectStep.faceParam M₁[i] Q))
    (hwind : winding (meshChain M₂) (Proof.MeshIntersectStep.faceHit M₁[i] Q) = 1)
    (hPS : Proof.MeshIntersectStep.faceHit M₁[i] Q ∈ triangleSet M₁[i]) :
    1 ≤ ((copDescA M₁ M₂ i.1).toList.map
        (fun f => if Proof.MeshIntersectStep.faceHit M₁[i] Q
            ∈ Proof.MeshIntersectClip.vpoly (fragCycle f) then (1 : ℤ) else 0)).sum
proof:
:= by
  classical
  set P := Proof.MeshIntersectStep.faceHit M₁[i] Q with hP
  have hdetA : detOrigin M₁[i] ≠ 0 := h₁.2.2.2 i
  have hQ1 : dotQ (carrierNormal M₁[i]) Q ≠ 0 := hG.1 i
  have hQ2 : ∀ j : Fin M₂.size, dotQ (carrierNormal M₂[j]) Q ≠ 0 := hG.2.1
  
  have hgetD : (materialize M₁).getD i.1 default = faceSOf M₁[i] := by
    rw [getD_eq_getElem (materialize M₁) (by rw [materialize_size]; exact i.isLt) default,
      materialize_getElem M₁ i.1 i.isLt]; rfl
  
  set base := fragOfFace ((materialize M₁).getD i.1 default) with hbase
  have hbaseInv : FragInv (carrierNormal M₁[i]) (detOrigin M₁[i]) base := by
    rw [hbase, hgetD]; exact Proof.MeshIntersectKeep.fragInv_base hdetA
  have hbaseT : Proof.MeshIntersectClip.vpoly (fragCycle base) = triangleSet M₁[i] := by
    rw [hbase, hgetD, Proof.MeshIntersectKeep.vpoly_fragOfFace]
  
  have hPbase : P ∈ Proof.MeshIntersectClip.vpoly (fragCycle base) := by rw [hbaseT]; exact hPS
  
  set L := planesForScoped ((materialize M₁).getD i.1 default).plane (materialize M₂)
    ((candP M₁ M₂).getD i.1 #[]) with hL
  
  obtain ⟨fa, hfaClip, hPfa⟩ := (clipFaceScoped_mem_vpoly_iff hbaseInv L P).mpr hPbase
  
  have hfaInv : FragInv (carrierNormal M₁[i]) (detOrigin M₁[i]) fa :=
    fragInv_clipFaceScoped hbaseInv _ hfaClip
  haveI := hfaInv.neZero
  
  have hfapl : fa.plane = (faceSOf M₁[i]).plane := by
    have := Proof.MeshIntersectNsi.clipFaceScoped_plane base L hfaClip
    rw [hbase, hgetD, fragOfFace] at this; simpa using this
  
  
  
  
  
  
  set copB := (splitCoplanar (Proof.MeshIntersectNsi.fragsBOf M₁ M₂) (materialize M₁)).1 with hcopB
  
  have hcopB_eq : copB = (splitCoplanar
      ((Array.range (materialize M₂).size).flatMap (fun j =>
        clipFaceScoped (fragOfFace ((materialize M₂).getD j default))
          (planesForScoped ((materialize M₂).getD j default).plane (materialize M₁)
            ((candP M₂ M₁).getD j #[]))))
      (materialize M₁)).1 := by rw [hcopB, Proof.MeshIntersectNsi.fragsBOf]
  
  
  have hoppInv : ∀ fb ∈ copB, ∃ n' c', FragInv n' c' fb
      ∧ (coplanarPlane fa.plane fb.plane = true →
          ∃ ρ : ℚ, ρ ≠ 0 ∧ n' = ρ • carrierNormal M₁[i] ∧ c' = ρ * detOrigin M₁[i]) := by
    intro fb hfb
    obtain ⟨j, hj, hfbInv, hdetB, hfbpl, -⟩ := Proof.MeshIntersectNsi.copB_carrier h₂.2.2.2 hfb
    refine ⟨carrierNormal (M₂[j]'hj), detOrigin (M₂[j]'hj), hfbInv, fun hcop' => ?_⟩
    
    have hcopij : coplanarPlane (faceSOf M₁[i]).plane (faceSOf (M₂[j]'hj)).plane = true := by
      rw [← hfapl, ← hfbpl]; exact hcop'
    obtain ⟨ρ, hρ, hnρ, hcρ⟩ := Proof.MeshIntersectNsi.coplanar_carrier_prop hdetA hdetB hcopij
    exact ⟨ρ, hρ, hnρ, hcρ⟩
  
  have hPeqv : P = Proof.MeshIntersectStep.faceParam M₁[i] Q • Q := by
    rw [hP]; rfl
  have hxov : ∀ fb ∈ copB, P ∉ Proof.MeshIntersectClip.vpoly (fragCycle fb) := by
    intro fb hfb
    rw [hPeqv]
    exact copB_hull_off_of_no_jump M₁ M₂ h₂ hQ2 hpos hno2 hfb
  
  obtain ⟨p, hpPend, hPp⟩ := Proof.MeshIntersectResolve.resolveFrag_cover copB
    hfaInv hoppInv hPfa hxov
  
  have hpInv : FragInv (carrierNormal M₁[i]) (detOrigin M₁[i]) p :=
    resolveFragPending_fragInv copB hfaInv p hpPend
  haveI := hpInv.neZero
  
  have hPrel : P ∈ Proof.MeshIntersectClip.vrelint (fragCycle p) :=
    cop_cell_relint_dichotomy_pending M₁ M₂ h₁ h₂ hG i hfaClip hcopB_eq hpPend hPp
  
  have hfaClip' : fa ∈ clipFaceScoped (fragOfFace (faceSOf M₁[i])) L := by
    rwa [hbase, hgetD] at hfaClip
  have hfacop : isCoplanarWith fa (materialize M₂) = true := by
    by_contra hc
    rw [Bool.not_eq_true,
      (Proof.MeshIntersectCop.isCoplanarWith_clipFace_iff (MB := M₂) 1 i.isLt hfaClip')] at hc
    exact hcop hc
  have hfaFilt : fa ∈ (clipFaceScoped base L).filter (fun f => isCoplanarWith f (materialize M₂)) :=
    Array.mem_filter.mpr ⟨hfaClip, hfacop⟩
  
  
  have hPeqParam : P = (detOrigin M₁[i] / dotQ (carrierNormal M₁[i]) Q) • Q := by
    rw [hP]; simp only [Proof.MeshIntersectStep.faceHit, Proof.MeshIntersectStep.faceParam,
      Fin.getElem_fin]
  have hG1pi'0 := gen_Aprime_seg₁_pending hG i hQ1 hfaClip hcopB_eq hpPend
  
  have hG1pi' : ∀ (k : ℕ) (hk : k < M₂.size),
      coplanarPlane (faceSOf (M₂[k]'hk)).plane fa.plane = false →
      ∀ g ∈ Impl.Legacy.Sim.tetraHalves (M₂[k]'hk), g.eval P ≠ 0 := by
    rw [hPeqParam]; exact hG1pi'0
  
  have havoid : ∀ fb ∈ copB, coplanarPlane fa.plane fb.plane = true →
      Proof.MeshIntersectClip.vrelint (fragCycle p)
        ∩ Proof.MeshIntersectClip.vrelint (fragCycle fb) = ∅ := by
    intro fb hfb hcofb
    exact Proof.MeshIntersectResolve.resolveFrag_pending_avoids copB hfaInv hoppInv hfb hcofb hpPend
  
  have hfaA : fa ∈ (splitCoplanar (Proof.MeshIntersectNsi.fragsAOf M₁ M₂) (materialize M₂)).1 := by
    rw [splitCoplanar]; simp only
    refine Array.mem_filter.mpr ⟨?_, by simpa using hfacop⟩
