    rw [Proof.MeshIntersectNsi.fragsAOf]
    refine mem_flatMap_arr.mpr ⟨i.1, ?_, ?_⟩
    · rw [Array.mem_def, Array.toList_range, List.mem_range, materialize_size]; exact i.isLt
    · rw [hbase] at hfaClip; exact hfaClip
  
  
  
  have hoff : Proof.MeshIntersectRadialTransport.OffBdy M₂ P := by
    intro k
    by_cases hCk : coplanarPlane (faceSOf M₂[k]).plane fa.plane = false
    · exact Or.inl (hG1pi' k.1 k.isLt hCk)
    · refine Or.inr ?_
      rw [Bool.not_eq_false] at hCk
      have hns := Aprime_seg_offSimplex_cop_pending h₁ h₂ hfaA (hcopB ▸ hpPend)
        (fun fb hfb hc => havoid fb (hcopB ▸ hfb) hc) hPrel hPrel k.1 k.isLt hCk 0
        (le_refl (0:ℚ)) zero_le_one
      have hseg0 : Proof.MeshIntersectCancel.seg P P (0:ℚ) = P := by
        funext c; simp [Proof.MeshIntersectCancel.seg]
      rwa [hseg0] at hns
  
  have hkeep : keepFallback (faceBVH (prepare (materialize M₂))) (prepare (materialize M₂)) p
      = true := by
    have hiff := keep_iff_winding_of_Aprime_pending M₁ M₂ h₁ h₂ hfaA
      (hcopB ▸ hpPend) (fun fb hfb hc => havoid fb (hcopB ▸ hfb) hc)
      hPrel hoff
    rw [hiff]; exact hwind
  
  have hpKept : p ∈ resolveFrag (faceBVH (prepare (materialize M₂))) fa copB
      (prepare (materialize M₂)) :=
    Proof.MeshIntersectResolve.mem_resolveFrag_of_pending_keepFallback _ fa copB
      (prepare (materialize M₂)) hpPend hkeep
  have hpCop : p ∈ copDescA M₁ M₂ i.1 := by
    rw [copDescA_eq]
    refine mem_flatMap_arr.mpr ⟨fa, hfaFilt, ?_⟩
    rw [← hcopB_eq]; exact hpKept
  
  have hmemList : p ∈ (copDescA M₁ M₂ i.1).toList := Array.mem_toList.mpr hpCop
  have hone : (if P ∈ Proof.MeshIntersectClip.vpoly (fragCycle p) then (1 : ℤ) else 0) = 1 := by
    rw [if_pos hPp]
  refine le_trans ?_ (List.single_le_sum ?_ _ (List.mem_map_of_mem _ hmemList))
  · show (1 : ℤ) ≤ (if P ∈ Proof.MeshIntersectClip.vpoly (fragCycle p) then (1 : ℤ) else 0)
    rw [hone]
  · intro x hx
    rw [List.mem_map] at hx
    obtain ⟨g, _, rfl⟩ := hx
    by_cases hfp : P ∈ Proof.MeshIntersectClip.vpoly (fragCycle g) <;> simp [hfp]

name: keptFaceA_overlap_cell_off
statement:
theorem keptFaceA_overlap_cell_off (M₁ M₂ : Mesh)
    (h₁ : Legacy.WellFormedMesh M₁) (h₂ : Legacy.WellFormedMesh M₂)
    {Q : Point} (hG : Gen M₁ M₂ Q) (i : Fin M₁.size)
    (hpos : 0 < Proof.MeshIntersectStep.faceParam M₁[i] Q)
    (hno2 : ∀ j : Fin M₂.size,
        ¬ Proof.MeshIntersectDelta.FaceJumps M₂[j] Q (Proof.MeshIntersectStep.faceParam M₁[i] Q))
    {fa : Frag}
    (hfaClip : fa ∈ clipFaceScoped (fragOfFace ((materialize M₁).getD i.1 default))
        (planesForScoped ((materialize M₁).getD i.1 default).plane (materialize M₂)
          ((candP M₁ M₂).getD i.1 #[])))
    (hfapl : fa.plane = (faceSOf M₁[i]).plane)
    {opp : Array Frag}
    (hopp : opp = (splitCoplanar (Proof.MeshIntersectNsi.fragsBOf M₁ M₂) (materialize M₁)).1)
    {f : Frag} (hkeptArm : f ∈ Proof.MeshIntersectResolve.resolveFragKept fa opp) :
    Proof.MeshIntersectStep.faceHit M₁[i] Q ∉ Proof.MeshIntersectClip.vpoly (fragCycle f)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  intro hPp
  have hdetA : detOrigin M₁[i] ≠ 0 := h₁.2.2.2 i
  have hQ1 : dotQ (carrierNormal M₁[i]) Q ≠ 0 := hG.1 i
  have hQ2 : ∀ j : Fin M₂.size, dotQ (carrierNormal M₂[j]) Q ≠ 0 := hG.2.1
  have hgetD : (materialize M₁).getD i.1 default = faceSOf M₁[i] := by
    rw [getD_eq_getElem (materialize M₁) (by rw [materialize_size]; exact i.isLt) default,
      materialize_getElem M₁ i.1 i.isLt]; rfl
  have hbaseInvi : FragInv (carrierNormal M₁[i]) (detOrigin M₁[i])
      (fragOfFace ((materialize M₁).getD i.1 default)) := by
    rw [hgetD]; exact Proof.MeshIntersectKeep.fragInv_base hdetA
  have hfaInv : FragInv (carrierNormal M₁[i]) (detOrigin M₁[i]) fa := fragInv_clipFaceScoped hbaseInvi _ hfaClip
  subst hopp
  set copB := (splitCoplanar (Proof.MeshIntersectNsi.fragsBOf M₁ M₂) (materialize M₁)).1 with hcopB
  have hoppInv : ∀ fb ∈ copB, ∃ n' c', FragInv n' c' fb
      ∧ (coplanarPlane fa.plane fb.plane = true →
          ∃ ρ : ℚ, ρ ≠ 0 ∧ n' = ρ • carrierNormal M₁[i] ∧ c' = ρ * detOrigin M₁[i]) := by
    intro fb hfb
    obtain ⟨j, hj, hfbInv, hdetB, hfbpl, -⟩ := Proof.MeshIntersectNsi.copB_carrier h₂.2.2.2 hfb
    refine ⟨carrierNormal (M₂[j]'hj), detOrigin (M₂[j]'hj), hfbInv, fun hcop' => ?_⟩
    have hcopij : coplanarPlane (faceSOf M₁[i]).plane (faceSOf (M₂[j]'hj)).plane = true := by
      rw [← hfapl, ← hfbpl]; exact hcop'
    obtain ⟨ρ, hρ, hnρ, hcρ⟩ := Proof.MeshIntersectNsi.coplanar_carrier_prop hdetA hdetB hcopij
    exact ⟨ρ, hρ, hnρ, hcρ⟩
  obtain ⟨fb, hfb, hcopfb, hsub⟩ :=
    Proof.MeshIntersectResolve.resolveFrag_kept_descent copB hfaInv hoppInv hkeptArm
  obtain ⟨j, hj, hfbInv, hdetB, hfbpl, hfbClip⟩ := Proof.MeshIntersectNsi.copB_carrier h₂.2.2.2 hfb
  have hjMz : j < (materialize M₂).size := by rw [materialize_size]; exact hj
  have hgetDj : (materialize M₂).getD j default = faceSOf (M₂[j]'hj) := by
    rw [Proof.MeshIntersectKeep.arr_getD _ _ _ hjMz, materialize_getElem M₂ j hj]
  have hbaseB : FragInv (carrierNormal (M₂[j]'hj)) (detOrigin (M₂[j]'hj))
      (fragOfFace ((materialize M₂).getD j default)) := by
    rw [hgetDj]; exact Proof.MeshIntersectKeep.fragInv_base hdetB
  have hfbsub : Proof.MeshIntersectClip.vpoly (fragCycle fb) ⊆ triangleSet (M₂[j]'hj) := by
    refine (clipFaceScoped_vpoly_subset hbaseB _ hfbClip).trans ?_
    rw [hgetDj, Proof.MeshIntersectKeep.vpoly_fragOfFace]
  have hcopj : coplanarPlane (faceSOf (M₂[j]'hj)).plane (faceSOf M₁[i]).plane = true := by
    rw [← hfbpl, ← hfapl, Proof.MeshIntersectNsi.coplanarPlane_symm]; exact hcopfb
  have hjmpA : Proof.MeshIntersectDelta.FaceJumps M₁[i] Q
      (Proof.MeshIntersectStep.faceParam M₁[i] Q) := by
    refine ⟨rfl, hpos, ?_⟩
    show Proof.MeshIntersectStep.faceHit M₁[i] Q ∈ triangleSet M₁[i]
    have hfaT : Proof.MeshIntersectClip.vpoly (fragCycle fa) ⊆ triangleSet M₁[i] := by
      refine (clipFaceScoped_vpoly_subset hbaseInvi _ hfaClip).trans ?_
      rw [hgetD, Proof.MeshIntersectKeep.vpoly_fragOfFace]
    have hPfa : Proof.MeshIntersectStep.faceHit M₁[i] Q ∈ Proof.MeshIntersectClip.vpoly (fragCycle fa) :=
      Proof.MeshIntersectResolve.resolveFrag_kept_vpoly_subset_fa (faceBVH (prepare (materialize M₂))) copB
        (prepare (materialize M₂)) hfaInv
        (Proof.MeshIntersectResolve.mem_resolveFrag_of_kept (faceBVH (prepare (materialize M₂))) fa copB
          (prepare (materialize M₂)) hkeptArm) hPp
    exact hfaT hPfa
  have hQ2' : ∀ j : Fin M₂.size, detOrigin M₂[j] ≠ 0 ∧ dotQ (carrierNormal M₂[j]) Q ≠ 0 :=
    fun j => ⟨h₂.2.2.2 j, hQ2 j⟩
  exact Proof.MeshIntersectCopDelta.no_overlap_cell_at_transverse_crossing
    (M₂ := M₂) (tA := M₁[i]) (Q := Q) (v := Proof.MeshIntersectStep.faceParam M₁[i] Q)
    hdetA hQ1 hjmpA hno2 hQ2' (f := f)
    ⟨⟨j, hj⟩, by rw [Fin.getElem_fin]; exact hcopj, by rw [Fin.getElem_fin]; exact hsub.trans hfbsub⟩ hPp

name: keptFaceA_pending_cell_winding
statement:
theorem keptFaceA_pending_cell_winding (M₁ M₂ : Mesh)
    (h₁ : Legacy.WellFormedMesh M₁) (h₂ : Legacy.WellFormedMesh M₂)
    {Q : Point} (hG : Gen M₁ M₂ Q) (i : Fin M₁.size)
    {fa : Frag}
    (hfaClip : fa ∈ clipFaceScoped (fragOfFace ((materialize M₁).getD i.1 default))
        (planesForScoped ((materialize M₁).getD i.1 default).plane (materialize M₂)
          ((candP M₁ M₂).getD i.1 #[])))
    (hfapl : fa.plane = (faceSOf M₁[i]).plane)
    (hfaA : fa ∈ (splitCoplanar (Proof.MeshIntersectNsi.fragsAOf M₁ M₂) (materialize M₂)).1)
    {opp : Array Frag}
    (hopp : opp = (splitCoplanar (Proof.MeshIntersectNsi.fragsBOf M₁ M₂) (materialize M₁)).1)
    {f : Frag} (hpPend : f ∈ Proof.MeshIntersectResolve.resolveFragPending fa opp)
    {bvhW : Impl.BVH.BVH} (hbvhW : bvhW = faceBVH (prepare (materialize M₂)))
    (hkeepfT : keepFallback bvhW (prepare (materialize M₂)) f = true)
    (hPp : Proof.MeshIntersectStep.faceHit M₁[i] Q
        ∈ Proof.MeshIntersectClip.vpoly (fragCycle f)) :
    winding (meshChain M₂) (Proof.MeshIntersectStep.faceHit M₁[i] Q) = 1
proof:
:= by
  classical
  set P := Proof.MeshIntersectStep.faceHit M₁[i] Q with hP
  have hdetA : detOrigin M₁[i] ≠ 0 := h₁.2.2.2 i
  have hQ1 : dotQ (carrierNormal M₁[i]) Q ≠ 0 := hG.1 i
  have hgetD : (materialize M₁).getD i.1 default = faceSOf M₁[i] := by
    rw [getD_eq_getElem (materialize M₁) (by rw [materialize_size]; exact i.isLt) default,
      materialize_getElem M₁ i.1 i.isLt]; rfl
  have hbaseInvi : FragInv (carrierNormal M₁[i]) (detOrigin M₁[i])
      (fragOfFace ((materialize M₁).getD i.1 default)) := by
    rw [hgetD]; exact Proof.MeshIntersectKeep.fragInv_base hdetA
  have hfaInv : FragInv (carrierNormal M₁[i]) (detOrigin M₁[i]) fa := fragInv_clipFaceScoped hbaseInvi _ hfaClip
  subst hopp
  set copB := (splitCoplanar (Proof.MeshIntersectNsi.fragsBOf M₁ M₂) (materialize M₁)).1 with hcopB
  have hcopB_eq : copB = (splitCoplanar
      ((Array.range (materialize M₂).size).flatMap (fun j =>
        clipFaceScoped (fragOfFace ((materialize M₂).getD j default))
          (planesForScoped ((materialize M₂).getD j default).plane (materialize M₁)
            ((candP M₂ M₁).getD j #[]))))
      (materialize M₁)).1 := by rw [hcopB, Proof.MeshIntersectNsi.fragsBOf]
  have hoppInv : ∀ fb ∈ copB, ∃ n' c', FragInv n' c' fb
      ∧ (coplanarPlane fa.plane fb.plane = true →
          ∃ ρ : ℚ, ρ ≠ 0 ∧ n' = ρ • carrierNormal M₁[i] ∧ c' = ρ * detOrigin M₁[i]) := by
    intro fb hfb
    obtain ⟨j, hj, hfbInv, hdetB, hfbpl, -⟩ := Proof.MeshIntersectNsi.copB_carrier h₂.2.2.2 hfb
    refine ⟨carrierNormal (M₂[j]'hj), detOrigin (M₂[j]'hj), hfbInv, fun hcop' => ?_⟩
    have hcopij : coplanarPlane (faceSOf M₁[i]).plane (faceSOf (M₂[j]'hj)).plane = true := by
      rw [← hfapl, ← hfbpl]; exact hcop'
    obtain ⟨ρ, hρ, hnρ, hcρ⟩ := Proof.MeshIntersectNsi.coplanar_carrier_prop hdetA hdetB hcopij
    exact ⟨ρ, hρ, hnρ, hcρ⟩
  have hPrel : P ∈ Proof.MeshIntersectClip.vrelint (fragCycle f) :=
    cop_cell_relint_dichotomy_pending M₁ M₂ h₁ h₂ hG i hfaClip hcopB_eq hpPend hPp
  have hPeqParam : P = (detOrigin M₁[i] / dotQ (carrierNormal M₁[i]) Q) • Q := by
    rw [hP]; simp only [Proof.MeshIntersectStep.faceHit, Proof.MeshIntersectStep.faceParam,
      Fin.getElem_fin]
  have hG1pi'0 := gen_Aprime_seg₁_pending hG i hQ1 hfaClip hcopB_eq hpPend
  have hG1pi' : ∀ (k : ℕ) (hk : k < M₂.size),
      coplanarPlane (faceSOf (M₂[k]'hk)).plane fa.plane = false →
      ∀ g ∈ Impl.Legacy.Sim.tetraHalves (M₂[k]'hk), g.eval P ≠ 0 := by
    rw [hPeqParam]; exact hG1pi'0
  have havoid : ∀ fb ∈ (splitCoplanar (Proof.MeshIntersectNsi.fragsBOf M₁ M₂)
        (materialize M₁)).1, coplanarPlane fa.plane fb.plane = true →
      Proof.MeshIntersectClip.vrelint (fragCycle f)
        ∩ Proof.MeshIntersectClip.vrelint (fragCycle fb) = ∅ := by
    intro fb hfb hcofb
    exact Proof.MeshIntersectResolve.resolveFrag_pending_avoids copB hfaInv hoppInv
      (hcopB ▸ hfb) hcofb hpPend
  
  have hoff : Proof.MeshIntersectRadialTransport.OffBdy M₂ P := by
    intro k
    by_cases hCk : coplanarPlane (faceSOf M₂[k]).plane fa.plane = false
    · exact Or.inl (hG1pi' k.1 k.isLt hCk)
    · refine Or.inr ?_
      rw [Bool.not_eq_false] at hCk
      have hns := Aprime_seg_offSimplex_cop_pending h₁ h₂ hfaA (hcopB ▸ hpPend)
        havoid hPrel hPrel k.1 k.isLt hCk 0 (le_refl (0:ℚ)) zero_le_one
      have hseg0 : Proof.MeshIntersectCancel.seg P P (0:ℚ) = P := by
        funext c; simp [Proof.MeshIntersectCancel.seg]
      rwa [hseg0] at hns
  have hiff := keep_iff_winding_of_Aprime_pending M₁ M₂ h₁ h₂ hfaA (hcopB ▸ hpPend)
    havoid hPrel hoff
  rw [hbvhW] at hkeepfT
  exact hiff.mp hkeepfT

name: keptFaceA_cop_pierce_winding
statement:
theorem keptFaceA_cop_pierce_winding (M₁ M₂ : Mesh)
    (h₁ : Legacy.WellFormedMesh M₁) (h₂ : Legacy.WellFormedMesh M₂)
    {Q : Point} (hG : Gen M₁ M₂ Q) (i : Fin M₁.size)
    (hpos : 0 < Proof.MeshIntersectStep.faceParam M₁[i] Q)
    (hno2 : ∀ j : Fin M₂.size,
        ¬ Proof.MeshIntersectDelta.FaceJumps M₂[j] Q (Proof.MeshIntersectStep.faceParam M₁[i] Q))
    {f : Frag} (hf : f ∈ copDescA M₁ M₂ i.1)
    (hPp : Proof.MeshIntersectStep.faceHit M₁[i] Q
        ∈ Proof.MeshIntersectClip.vpoly (fragCycle f)) :
    winding (meshChain M₂) (Proof.MeshIntersectStep.faceHit M₁[i] Q) = 1
proof:
:= by
  classical
  obtain ⟨fa, hfaA, hfapl, hfaClipD, hfmem⟩ := mem_copDescA_parent M₁ M₂ i.1 i.isLt hf
  rcases Proof.MeshIntersectResolve.mem_resolveFragKept_or_pending _ _ _ _ hfmem
    with hkeptArm | hpendArm
  · exact absurd hPp
      (keptFaceA_overlap_cell_off M₁ M₂ h₁ h₂ hG i hpos hno2 hfaClipD hfapl rfl hkeptArm)
  · obtain ⟨hpPend, hkeepf⟩ := Array.mem_filter.mp hpendArm
    exact keptFaceA_pending_cell_winding M₁ M₂ h₁ h₂ hG i hfaClipD hfapl hfaA rfl hpPend
      rfl (by simpa using hkeepf) hPp

name: copDescA_indicator_eq_w2
statement:
theorem copDescA_indicator_eq_w2 (M₁ M₂ : Mesh)
    (h₁ : Legacy.WellFormedMesh M₁) (h₂ : Legacy.WellFormedMesh M₂)
    {Q : Point} (hG : Gen M₁ M₂ Q) (i : Fin M₁.size)
    (hcop : ¬ Proof.MeshIntersectCop.TrFace M₁ M₂ i.1 i.isLt)
    (hpos : 0 < Proof.MeshIntersectStep.faceParam M₁[i] Q)
    (hno2 : ∀ j : Fin M₂.size,
        ¬ Proof.MeshIntersectDelta.FaceJumps M₂[j] Q (Proof.MeshIntersectStep.faceParam M₁[i] Q)) :
    ((copDescA M₁ M₂ i.1).toList.map
        (fun f => if Proof.MeshIntersectStep.faceHit M₁[i] Q
            ∈ Proof.MeshIntersectClip.vpoly (fragCycle f) then (1 : ℤ) else 0)).sum
      = (if Proof.MeshIntersectStep.faceHit M₁[i] Q ∈ triangleSet M₁[i] then 1 else 0)
        * winding (meshChain M₂) (Proof.MeshIntersectStep.faceHit M₁[i] Q)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  set P := Proof.MeshIntersectStep.faceHit M₁[i] Q with hP
  have hnpo₁ : NoPlaneThroughOrigin M₁ := h₁.2.2.2
  have hQ2 : ∀ j : Fin M₂.size, dotQ (carrierNormal M₂[j]) Q ≠ 0 := hG.2.1
  have hPeqv : P = Proof.MeshIntersectStep.faceParam M₁[i] Q • Q := by rw [hP]; rfl
  by_cases hPS : P ∈ triangleSet M₁[i]
  · rw [if_pos hPS, one_mul]
    have hwind01 : winding (meshChain M₂) P = 0 ∨ winding (meshChain M₂) P = 1 := by
      rw [hPeqv]
      exact winding_in_01_of_radial_gap M₂ h₂.2.2.2 h₂.2.1 hQ2 (gen_Q_off_NB_planes hG) hpos hno2
    rcases hwind01 with hw0 | hw1
    · rw [hw0]
      refine List.sum_eq_zero ?_
      intro x hx
      rw [List.mem_map] at hx; obtain ⟨f, hf, rfl⟩ := hx
      by_cases hfp : P ∈ Proof.MeshIntersectClip.vpoly (fragCycle f)
      · exfalso
        have := keptFaceA_cop_pierce_winding M₁ M₂ h₁ h₂ hG i hpos hno2 (Array.mem_toList.mp hf) hfp
        rw [hw0] at this; exact absurd this (by norm_num)
      · rw [if_neg hfp]
    · rw [hw1]
      have hge1 : (1 : ℤ) ≤ ((copDescA M₁ M₂ i.1).toList.map
          (fun f => if P ∈ Proof.MeshIntersectClip.vpoly (fragCycle f) then (1 : ℤ) else 0)).sum :=
        keptFaceA_cover_ge_one M₁ M₂ h₁ h₂ hG i hcop hpos hno2 hw1 hPS
      have hle1 : ((copDescA M₁ M₂ i.1).toList.map
          (fun f => if P ∈ Proof.MeshIntersectClip.vpoly (fragCycle f) then (1 : ℤ) else 0)).sum ≤ 1 :=
        keptRegion_indicator_le_one (copDescA M₁ M₂ i.1).toList
          (copDescA_pairwise_relDisj M₁ M₂ hnpo₁ i)
          (fun f hf hfp => copDescA_pierce_relint M₁ M₂ h₁ h₂ hG i (Array.mem_toList.mp hf) hfp)
      omega
  · rw [if_neg hPS, zero_mul]
    
    have hdet : detOrigin M₁[i] ≠ 0 := hnpo₁ i
    have hgetD : (materialize M₁).getD i.1 default = faceSOf (M₁[i.1]'i.isLt) := by
      have hiA : i.1 < (materialize M₁).size := by rw [materialize_size]; exact i.isLt
      rw [Proof.MeshIntersectKeep.arr_getD _ _ _ hiA, materialize_getElem M₁ i.1 i.isLt]
    have hbase : FragInv (carrierNormal M₁[i]) (detOrigin M₁[i])
        (fragOfFace ((materialize M₁).getD i.1 default)) := by
      rw [hgetD]; exact Proof.MeshIntersectKeep.fragInv_base hdet
    have hbaseT : Proof.MeshIntersectClip.vpoly
        (fragCycle (fragOfFace ((materialize M₁).getD i.1 default)))
          ⊆ triangleSet (M₁[i.1]'i.isLt) := by
      rw [hgetD, Proof.MeshIntersectKeep.vpoly_fragOfFace]
    exact indicator_sum_eq_zero_of_hull_off (copDescA M₁ M₂ i.1) P (triangleSet M₁[i])
      (fun f hf => (copDescA_vpoly_subset_base M₁ M₂ i.1 hbase hf).trans hbaseT) hPS

name: keptFaceA_indicator_coplanar
statement:
theorem keptFaceA_indicator_coplanar (M₁ M₂ : Mesh)
    (h₁ : Legacy.WellFormedMesh M₁) (h₂ : Legacy.WellFormedMesh M₂)
    {Q : Point} (hG : Gen M₁ M₂ Q) (i : Fin M₁.size)
    (hcop : ¬ Proof.MeshIntersectCop.TrFace M₁ M₂ i.1 i.isLt)
    (hpos : 0 < Proof.MeshIntersectStep.faceParam M₁[i] Q)
    (hno2 : ∀ j : Fin M₂.size,
        ¬ Proof.MeshIntersectDelta.FaceJumps M₂[j] Q (Proof.MeshIntersectStep.faceParam M₁[i] Q)) :
    ((keptFaceA M₁ M₂ i.1).toList.map
        (fun f => if Proof.MeshIntersectStep.faceHit M₁[i] Q
            ∈ Proof.MeshIntersectClip.vpoly (fragCycle f) then (1 : ℤ) else 0)).sum
      = (if Proof.MeshIntersectStep.faceHit M₁[i] Q ∈ triangleSet M₁[i] then 1 else 0)
        * winding (meshChain M₂) (Proof.MeshIntersectStep.faceHit M₁[i] Q)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  rw [show keptFaceA M₁ M₂ i.1 = keptNcFaceA M₁ M₂ i.1 ++ copDescA M₁ M₂ i.1 from rfl,
    Array.toList_append, List.map_append, List.sum_append,
    keptNcFaceA_toList_eq_nil_of_not_TrFace M₁ M₂ i.isLt hcop]
  simp only [List.map_nil, List.sum_nil, zero_add]
  exact copDescA_indicator_eq_w2 M₁ M₂ h₁ h₂ hG i hcop hpos hno2

name: copDescA_indicator_le_one
statement:
theorem copDescA_indicator_le_one (M₁ M₂ : Mesh)
    (h₁ : Legacy.WellFormedMesh M₁) (h₂ : Legacy.WellFormedMesh M₂)
    {Q : Point} (hG : Gen M₁ M₂ Q) (i : Fin M₁.size) :
    ((copDescA M₁ M₂ i.1).toList.map
        (fun f => if Proof.MeshIntersectStep.faceHit M₁[i] Q
            ∈ Proof.MeshIntersectClip.vpoly (fragCycle f) then (1 : ℤ) else 0)).sum ≤ 1
proof:
:=
  keptRegion_indicator_le_one (copDescA M₁ M₂ i.1).toList
    (copDescA_pairwise_relDisj M₁ M₂ h₁.2.2.2 i)
    (fun _f hf hfp => copDescA_pierce_relint M₁ M₂ h₁ h₂ hG i (Array.mem_toList.mp hf) hfp)

name: copDescA_cover_ge_one_at_C
statement:
theorem copDescA_cover_ge_one_at_C (M₁ M₂ : Mesh)
    (h₁ : Legacy.WellFormedMesh M₁) (h₂ : Legacy.WellFormedMesh M₂)
    {Q : Point} (i₀ : Fin M₁.size) (j₀ : Fin M₂.size)
    {fa : Frag}
    (hfaClip : fa ∈ clipFaceScoped (fragOfFace ((materialize M₁).getD i₀.1 default))
        (planesForScoped ((materialize M₁).getD i₀.1 default).plane (materialize M₂)
          ((candP M₁ M₂).getD i₀.1 #[])))
    (hfacop : isCoplanarWith fa (materialize M₂) = true)
    (hfapl : fa.plane = (faceSOf M₁[i₀]).plane)
    (hPfa : Proof.MeshIntersectStep.faceHit M₁[i₀] Q ∈ Proof.MeshIntersectClip.vpoly (fragCycle fa))
    {fb₀ : Frag}
    (hfb₀ : fb₀ ∈ (splitCoplanar (Proof.MeshIntersectNsi.fragsBOf M₁ M₂) (materialize M₁)).1)
    (hfb₀pl : fb₀.plane = (faceSOf M₂[j₀]).plane)
    (hso : sameOrient (faceSOf M₁[i₀]).plane (faceSOf M₂[j₀]).plane = true)
    (hPrel : Proof.MeshIntersectStep.faceHit M₁[i₀] Q
        ∈ Proof.MeshIntersectClip.vrelint (fragCycle fb₀))
    (hxdrop : ∀ fb ∈ (splitCoplanar (Proof.MeshIntersectNsi.fragsBOf M₁ M₂) (materialize M₁)).1,
        coplanarPlane fa.plane fb.plane = true → sameOrient fa.plane fb.plane = false →
        Proof.MeshIntersectStep.faceHit M₁[i₀] Q ∉ Proof.MeshIntersectClip.vpoly (fragCycle fb)) :
    1 ≤ ((copDescA M₁ M₂ i₀.1).toList.map
        (fun f => if Proof.MeshIntersectStep.faceHit M₁[i₀] Q
            ∈ Proof.MeshIntersectClip.vpoly (fragCycle f) then (1 : ℤ) else 0)).sum
proof:
:= by
  classical
  set P := Proof.MeshIntersectStep.faceHit M₁[i₀] Q with hP
  have hdetA : detOrigin M₁[i₀] ≠ 0 := h₁.2.2.2 i₀
  set copB := (splitCoplanar (Proof.MeshIntersectNsi.fragsBOf M₁ M₂) (materialize M₁)).1 with hcopB
  have hgetD : (materialize M₁).getD i₀.1 default = faceSOf M₁[i₀] := by
    rw [getD_eq_getElem (materialize M₁) (by rw [materialize_size]; exact i₀.isLt) default,
      materialize_getElem M₁ i₀.1 i₀.isLt]; rfl
  have hbaseInv : FragInv (carrierNormal M₁[i₀]) (detOrigin M₁[i₀])
      (fragOfFace ((materialize M₁).getD i₀.1 default)) := by
    rw [hgetD]; exact Proof.MeshIntersectKeep.fragInv_base hdetA
  have hfaInv : FragInv (carrierNormal M₁[i₀]) (detOrigin M₁[i₀]) fa :=
    fragInv_clipFaceScoped hbaseInv _ hfaClip
  
  have hoppInv : ∀ fb ∈ copB, ∃ n' c', FragInv n' c' fb
      ∧ (coplanarPlane fa.plane fb.plane = true →
          ∃ ρ : ℚ, ρ ≠ 0 ∧ n' = ρ • carrierNormal M₁[i₀] ∧ c' = ρ * detOrigin M₁[i₀]) := by
    intro fb hfb
    obtain ⟨j, hj, hfbInv, hdetB, hfbpl, -⟩ := Proof.MeshIntersectNsi.copB_carrier h₂.2.2.2 hfb
    refine ⟨carrierNormal (M₂[j]'hj), detOrigin (M₂[j]'hj), hfbInv, fun hcop' => ?_⟩
    have hcopij : coplanarPlane (faceSOf M₁[i₀]).plane (faceSOf (M₂[j]'hj)).plane = true := by
      rw [← hfapl, ← hfbpl]; exact hcop'
    obtain ⟨ρ, hρ, hnρ, hcρ⟩ := Proof.MeshIntersectNsi.coplanar_carrier_prop hdetA hdetB hcopij
    exact ⟨ρ, hρ, hnρ, hcρ⟩
  
  have hso' : sameOrient fa.plane fb₀.plane = true := by rw [hfapl, hfb₀pl]; exact hso
  
  obtain ⟨pcell, hpcell, hPp⟩ :=
    Proof.MeshIntersectResolve.resolveFrag_kept_cover_mem (faceBVH (prepare (materialize M₂)))
      copB (prepare (materialize M₂))
      hfaInv hoppInv hPfa hfb₀ hso' hPrel hxdrop
  
  have hfaFilt : fa ∈ (clipFaceScoped (fragOfFace ((materialize M₁).getD i₀.1 default))
      (planesForScoped ((materialize M₁).getD i₀.1 default).plane (materialize M₂)
        ((candP M₁ M₂).getD i₀.1 #[]))).filter
      (fun f => isCoplanarWith f (materialize M₂)) :=
    Array.mem_filter.mpr ⟨hfaClip, hfacop⟩
  have hpCop : pcell ∈ copDescA M₁ M₂ i₀.1 := by
    rw [copDescA_eq]
    exact mem_flatMap_arr.mpr ⟨fa, hfaFilt, hpcell⟩
  have hmemList : pcell ∈ (copDescA M₁ M₂ i₀.1).toList := Array.mem_toList.mpr hpCop
  have hone : (if P ∈ Proof.MeshIntersectClip.vpoly (fragCycle pcell) then (1 : ℤ) else 0) = 1 := by
    rw [if_pos hPp]
  refine le_trans ?_ (List.single_le_sum ?_ _ (List.mem_map_of_mem _ hmemList))
  · show (1 : ℤ) ≤ (if P ∈ Proof.MeshIntersectClip.vpoly (fragCycle pcell) then (1 : ℤ) else 0)
    rw [hone]
  · intro y hy
    rw [List.mem_map] at hy; obtain ⟨g, _, rfl⟩ := hy
    by_cases hfp : P ∈ Proof.MeshIntersectClip.vpoly (fragCycle g) <;> simp [hfp]

name: overlap_cell_pierced_once_at_C
statement:
theorem overlap_cell_pierced_once_at_C (M₁ M₂ : Mesh)
    (h₁ : Legacy.WellFormedMesh M₁) (h₂ : Legacy.WellFormedMesh M₂)
    {Q : Point} (hG : Gen M₁ M₂ Q) (i₀ : Fin M₁.size) (j₀ : Fin M₂.size)
    (hcop : ¬ Proof.MeshIntersectCop.TrFace M₁ M₂ i₀.1 i₀.isLt)
    {fa : Frag}
    (hfaClip : fa ∈ clipFaceScoped (fragOfFace ((materialize M₁).getD i₀.1 default))
        (planesForScoped ((materialize M₁).getD i₀.1 default).plane (materialize M₂)
          ((candP M₁ M₂).getD i₀.1 #[])))
    (hfacop : isCoplanarWith fa (materialize M₂) = true)
    (hfapl : fa.plane = (faceSOf M₁[i₀]).plane)
    (hPfa : Proof.MeshIntersectStep.faceHit M₁[i₀] Q ∈ Proof.MeshIntersectClip.vpoly (fragCycle fa))
    {fb₀ : Frag}
    (hfb₀ : fb₀ ∈ (splitCoplanar (Proof.MeshIntersectNsi.fragsBOf M₁ M₂) (materialize M₁)).1)
    (hfb₀pl : fb₀.plane = (faceSOf M₂[j₀]).plane)
    (hPrel : Proof.MeshIntersectStep.faceHit M₁[i₀] Q
        ∈ Proof.MeshIntersectClip.vrelint (fragCycle fb₀))
    (hxdrop : sameOrient (faceSOf M₁[i₀]).plane (faceSOf M₂[j₀]).plane = true →
        ∀ fb ∈ (splitCoplanar (Proof.MeshIntersectNsi.fragsBOf M₁ M₂) (materialize M₁)).1,
        coplanarPlane fa.plane fb.plane = true → sameOrient fa.plane fb.plane = false →
        Proof.MeshIntersectStep.faceHit M₁[i₀] Q ∉ Proof.MeshIntersectClip.vpoly (fragCycle fb))
    (hno_opp : sameOrient (faceSOf M₁[i₀]).plane (faceSOf M₂[j₀]).plane = false →
        ∀ f ∈ copDescA M₁ M₂ i₀.1,
          Proof.MeshIntersectStep.faceHit M₁[i₀] Q ∉ Proof.MeshIntersectClip.vpoly (fragCycle f)) :
    ((keptFaceA M₁ M₂ i₀.1).toList.map
        (fun f => if Proof.MeshIntersectStep.faceHit M₁[i₀] Q
            ∈ Proof.MeshIntersectClip.vpoly (fragCycle f) then (1 : ℤ) else 0)).sum
      = (if sameOrient (faceSOf M₁[i₀]).plane (faceSOf M₂[j₀]).plane then 1 else 0)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  set P := Proof.MeshIntersectStep.faceHit M₁[i₀] Q with hP
  have hnpo₁ : NoPlaneThroughOrigin M₁ := h₁.2.2.2
  
  rw [show keptFaceA M₁ M₂ i₀.1 = keptNcFaceA M₁ M₂ i₀.1 ++ copDescA M₁ M₂ i₀.1 from rfl,
    Array.toList_append, List.map_append, List.sum_append,
    keptNcFaceA_toList_eq_nil_of_not_TrFace M₁ M₂ i₀.isLt hcop]
  simp only [List.map_nil, List.sum_nil, zero_add]
  by_cases hso : sameOrient (faceSOf M₁[i₀]).plane (faceSOf M₂[j₀]).plane = true
  · 
    rw [if_pos hso]
    have hle1 := copDescA_indicator_le_one M₁ M₂ h₁ h₂ hG i₀
    have hge1 := copDescA_cover_ge_one_at_C M₁ M₂ h₁ h₂ i₀ j₀
      hfaClip hfacop hfapl hPfa hfb₀ hfb₀pl hso hPrel (hxdrop hso)
    rw [← hP] at hle1 hge1
    omega
  · 
    have hsoF : sameOrient (faceSOf M₁[i₀]).plane (faceSOf M₂[j₀]).plane = false := by
      simpa using hso
    rw [if_neg hso]
    refine List.sum_eq_zero ?_
    intro y hy; rw [List.mem_map] at hy; obtain ⟨f, hf, rfl⟩ := hy
    rw [if_neg (hno_opp hsoF f (Array.mem_toList.mp hf))]

name: eIdx_val
statement:
@[simp] theorem eIdx_val (hm : m + 3 = r) (k : ZMod (m + 3)) :
    (eIdx hm k : ℕ) = k.val
proof: := rfl

name: eIdx_injective
statement: theorem eIdx_injective (hm : m + 3 = r) : Function.Injective (eIdx hm)
proof:
:= by
  intro a b hab
  have hv : a.val = b.val := by simpa using congrArg Fin.val hab
  calc a = ((a.val : ℕ) : ZMod (m + 3)) := (ZMod.natCast_rightInverse a).symm
  _ = ((b.val : ℕ) : ZMod (m + 3)) := by rw [hv]
  _ = b := ZMod.natCast_rightInverse b

name: eIdx_surjective
statement: theorem eIdx_surjective (hm : m + 3 = r) : Function.Surjective (eIdx hm)
proof:
:= by
  intro i
  refine ⟨((i.val : ℕ) : ZMod (m + 3)), Fin.ext ?_⟩
  rw [eIdx_val, ZMod.val_cast_of_lt (by rw [hm]; exact i.isLt)]

name: eIdx_symm_apply
statement:
@[simp] theorem eIdx_symm_apply (hm : m + 3 = r) (k : Fin r) :
    eIdx hm ((eEquiv hm).symm k) = k
proof:
:=
  Equiv.ofBijective_apply_symm_apply _ _ k

name: eIdx_symm_cancel
statement:
theorem eIdx_symm_cancel (hm : m + 3 = r) (k : ZMod (m + 3)) :
    (eEquiv hm).symm (eIdx hm k) = k
proof:
:=
  Equiv.symm_apply_apply (eEquiv hm) k

name: eIdx_add_one
statement:
theorem eIdx_add_one (hm : m + 3 = r) (k : ZMod (m + 3)) :
    eIdx hm (k + 1) = eIdx hm k + 1
proof:
:= by
  subst hm
  apply Fin.ext
  show (k + 1).val = (eIdx rfl k + 1).val
  rw [Fin.val_add, Fin.val_one']
  show (k + 1).val = (k.val + 1 % (m + 3)) % (m + 3)
  rw [ZMod.val_add, ZMod.val_one_eq_one_mod]

name: mkFan_poly
statement:
theorem mkFan_poly :
    poly (mkFan hm u eta' apex hsl hsr hnn hps hinj hsat hcoll hap)
      = vpoly u
proof:
:= by
  show convexHull ℚ (Set.range fun k => u (eIdx hm k)) = convexHull ℚ (Set.range u)
  congr 1
  rw [show (fun k => u (eIdx hm k)) = u ∘ eIdx hm from rfl, Set.range_comp,
    (eIdx_surjective hm).range_eq, Set.image_univ]

name: mkFan_relint
statement:
theorem mkFan_relint :
    relint (mkFan hm u eta' apex hsl hsr hnn hps hinj hsat hcoll hap)
      = vrelint u
proof:
:= by
  ext x
  show (∃ v : ZMod (m + 3) → ℚ, (∀ j, 0 < v j) ∧ ∑ j, v j = 1
      ∧ ∑ j, v j • u (eIdx hm j) = x)
    ↔ x ∈ vrelint u
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨v, hv0, hv1, hv2⟩
    refine ⟨fun j => v ((eEquiv hm).symm j), fun j => hv0 _, ?_, ?_⟩
    · rw [← hv1]
      exact Fintype.sum_bijective ((eEquiv hm).symm) (Equiv.bijective _)
        _ _ (fun j => rfl)
    · rw [← hv2]
      refine Fintype.sum_bijective (eIdx hm)
        ⟨eIdx_injective hm, eIdx_surjective hm⟩ _ _ (fun k => ?_)
      show v k • u (eIdx hm k)
        = v ((eEquiv hm).symm (eIdx hm k)) • u (eIdx hm k)
      rw [eIdx_symm_cancel]
  · rintro ⟨μ, hμ0, hμ1, hμ2⟩
    refine ⟨fun k => μ (eIdx hm k), fun j => hμ0 _, ?_, ?_⟩
    · rw [← hμ1]
      exact Fintype.sum_bijective (eIdx hm)
        ⟨eIdx_injective hm, eIdx_surjective hm⟩ _ _ (fun k => rfl)
    · rw [hμ2]
      exact Fintype.sum_bijective (eIdx hm)
        ⟨eIdx_injective hm, eIdx_surjective hm⟩ _ _ (fun k => rfl)

name: mkFan_fanTri
statement:
theorem mkFan_fanTri (k : Fin r) :
    fanTri (mkFan hm u eta' apex hsl hsr hnn hps hinj hsat hcoll hap)
        ((eEquiv hm).symm k)
      = ⟨apex, u k, u (k + 1)⟩
proof:
:= by
  show (⟨apex, u (eIdx hm ((eEquiv hm).symm k)),
      u (eIdx hm ((eEquiv hm).symm k + 1))⟩ : Triangle)
    = ⟨apex, u k, u (k + 1)⟩
  rw [eIdx_add_one, eIdx_symm_apply]

name: mkFan_wholeTri
statement:
theorem mkFan_wholeTri (hm0 : m = 0) :
    wholeTri (mkFan hm u eta' apex hsl hsr hnn hps hinj hsat hcoll hap)
      = ⟨u ⟨0, by omega⟩, u ⟨1, by omega⟩, u ⟨2, by omega⟩⟩
proof:
:= by
  have hv : ∀ (a : ℕ) (ha : a < m + 3),
      eIdx hm ((a : ℕ) : ZMod (m + 3)) = ⟨a, by omega⟩ :=
    fun a ha => Fin.ext (by rw [eIdx_val, ZMod.val_cast_of_lt ha])
  show (⟨u (eIdx hm 0), u (eIdx hm 1), u (eIdx hm 2)⟩ : Triangle) = _
  have h0 : eIdx hm (0 : ZMod (m + 3)) = ⟨0, by omega⟩ := by
    rw [show (0 : ZMod (m + 3)) = ((0 : ℕ) : ZMod (m + 3)) by norm_cast]
    exact hv 0 (by omega)
  have h1 : eIdx hm (1 : ZMod (m + 3)) = ⟨1, by omega⟩ := by
    rw [show (1 : ZMod (m + 3)) = ((1 : ℕ) : ZMod (m + 3)) by norm_cast]
    exact hv 1 (by omega)
  have h2 : eIdx hm (2 : ZMod (m + 3)) = ⟨2, by omega⟩ := by
    rw [show (2 : ZMod (m + 3)) = ((2 : ℕ) : ZMod (m + 3)) by norm_cast]
    exact hv 2 (by omega)
  rw [h0, h1, h2]

name: eta_factor
statement:
theorem eta_factor (hs : RefShape w u) (k : Fin m) :
    ∃ (i : Fin r) (ρ : ℚ), 0 < ρ ∧ ∀ x, eta nt u k x = ρ * eta nt w i x
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨i, α, β, h0, hαβ, h1, hk, hk1⟩ := hs.consec k
  refine ⟨i, β - α, by linarith, fun x => ?_⟩
  show areaForm nt (u k) (u (k + 1)) x = (β - α) * areaForm nt (w i) (w (i + 1)) x
  rw [hk, hk1, areaForm_sub_edge]

name: eta_nonneg_field
statement:
theorem eta_nonneg_field (hr : 3 ≤ r) (hpl : OnPlane nt ct w)
    (hstrict : StrictConv nt w) (hs : RefShape w u) (k j : Fin m) :
    0 ≤ eta nt u k (u j)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨i, ρ, hρ, hfac⟩ := eta_factor (nt := nt) hs k
  rw [hfac]
  refine mul_nonneg hρ.le ?_
  have hmem : u j ∈ vpoly w := by
    rw [← hs.vpoly_eq]
    exact subset_convexHull ℚ _ (Set.mem_range_self j)
  rw [Proof.MeshIntersectClip.vpoly_eq hr hpl hstrict] at hmem
  exact hmem.2 i

name: eta_pos_field
statement:
theorem eta_pos_field (hr : 3 ≤ r) (hstrict : StrictConv nt w)
    (hs : RefShape w u) (k : Fin m) :
    ∃ j, 0 < eta nt u k (u j)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨i, ρ, hρ, hfac⟩ := eta_factor (nt := nt) hs k
  obtain ⟨j₀, hj₀⟩ := hs.orig (i + 1 + 1)
  refine ⟨j₀, ?_⟩
  rw [hfac, hj₀]
  exact mul_pos hρ
    (hstrict i (i + 1 + 1) (fin_add_two_ne hr i) (fin_add_one_ne hr (i + 1)))

name: online_of_eta_zero
statement:
theorem online_of_eta_zero (hr : 3 ≤ r) (hpl : OnPlane nt ct w)
    (hstrict : StrictConv nt w) (hs : RefShape w u) {l : Fin m} {x : Point}
    (hxpl : dotQ nt x = ct) (hzero : eta nt u l x = 0) :
    ∃ t : ℚ, x = t • (u (l + 1) - u l) + u l
proof:
:= by
  have hn : nt ≠ 0 := n_ne_zero_of_strict hr hstrict
  have hupl : OnPlane nt ct u := hs.onPlane hpl
  have hpar := cross_parallel_normal (n := nt) (hupl l) (hupl (l + 1)) hxpl
  have hval : dotQ nt (crossQ (u (l + 1) - u l) (x - u l)) = 0 := by
    rw [← eta_eq]
    exact hzero
  rw [hval, zero_smul] at hpar
  have hcross : crossQ (u (l + 1) - u l) (x - u l) = 0 :=
    (smul_eq_zero.mp hpar).resolve_left (ne_of_gt (dotQ_self_pos hn))
  have hcross' : crossQ (x - u l) (u (l + 1) - u l) = 0 := by
    rw [crossQ_anticomm, hcross, neg_zero]
  have hne : u (l + 1) - u l ≠ 0 := fun h =>
    hs.consec_ne hr hstrict l (sub_eq_zero.mp h).symm
  obtain ⟨t, ht⟩ := exists_smul_of_crossQ_eq_zero hne hcross'
  refine ⟨t, ?_⟩
  rw [← ht]
  abel

name: coll_field
statement:
theorem coll_field (hr : 3 ≤ r) (hpl : OnPlane nt ct w)
    (hstrict : StrictConv nt w) (hs : RefShape w u) (k l : Fin m)
    (h1 : eta nt u l (u k) = 0) (h2 : eta nt u l (u (k + 1)) = 0) :
    Collinear ℚ ({u k, u (k + 1), u l, u (l + 1)} : Set Point)
proof:
:= by
  have hupl : OnPlane nt ct u := hs.onPlane hpl
  obtain ⟨t₁, ht₁⟩ := online_of_eta_zero hr hpl hstrict hs (hupl k) h1
  obtain ⟨t₂, ht₂⟩ := online_of_eta_zero hr hpl hstrict hs (hupl (k + 1)) h2
  rw [collinear_iff_of_mem
    (show u l ∈ ({u k, u (k + 1), u l, u (l + 1)} : Set Point) by simp)]
  refine ⟨u (l + 1) - u l, ?_⟩
  intro p hp
  simp only [Set.mem_insert_iff, Set.mem_singleton_iff] at hp
  rcases hp with rfl | rfl | rfl | rfl
  · exact ⟨t₁, ht₁⟩
  · exact ⟨t₂, ht₂⟩
  · exact ⟨0, by rw [zero_smul, zero_vadd]⟩
  · refine ⟨1, ?_⟩
    rw [one_smul]
    show u (l + 1) = u (l + 1) - u l + u l
    abel

name: apexQ_relint
statement:
theorem apexQ_relint {g : Frag} [NeZero g.poly.size] (hm3 : 3 ≤ g.poly.size) :
    ∃ wt : Fin g.poly.size → ℚ, (∀ j, 0 < wt j) ∧ ∑ j, wt j = 1
      ∧ ∑ j, wt j • fragCycle g j = apexQ g
proof:
:= by
  have hpos : (0 : ℚ) < (g.poly.size : ℚ) := by
    have h0 : 0 < g.poly.size := by omega
    exact_mod_cast h0
  refine ⟨fun _ => ((g.poly.size : ℚ))⁻¹, fun j => by positivity, ?_, rfl⟩
  rw [Finset.sum_const, Finset.card_univ, Fintype.card_fin, nsmul_eq_mul]
  field_simp

name: fin_succ_mk
proof:
:= by
  apply Fin.ext
  rw [Fin.val_add, Fin.val_one', Nat.mod_eq_of_lt (show 1 < m by omega)]
  exact hab

name: emit_package_core
statement:
theorem emit_package_core {f g : Frag} [NeZero f.poly.size]
    [NeZero g.poly.size] {nt : Point} {ct : ℚ}
    (hinv : FragInv nt ct f) (hm3 : 3 ≤ g.poly.size)
    (hshape : RefShapeOrd (fragCycle f) (fragCycle g))
    (hsat : ∀ k j : Fin g.poly.size,
      fragCycle g j ∉ openSegment ℚ (fragCycle g k) (fragCycle g (k + 1))) :
    (emitFrag g).toList.Pairwise TriRel
    ∧ ∀ t ∈ (emitFrag g).toList,
        triangleSet t ⊆ vpoly (fragCycle f)
        ∧ ∀ S : Set Point, vrelint (fragCycle f) ∩ S = ∅ →
            triangleSet t ∩ S ⊆ edgeSet t
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have hr : 3 ≤ f.poly.size := hinv.size3
  have hpl := hinv.onPlane
  have hstrict := hinv.strictConv
  have hmm : (g.poly.size - 3) + 3 = g.poly.size := by omega
  
  have e1 : ∀ k, etaAff nt (fragCycle g) k (fragCycle g k) = 0 :=
    fun k => eta_self nt (fragCycle g) k
  have e2 : ∀ k, etaAff nt (fragCycle g) k (fragCycle g (k + 1)) = 0 :=
    fun k => eta_succ nt (fragCycle g) k
  have e3 : ∀ k j, 0 ≤ etaAff nt (fragCycle g) k (fragCycle g j) :=
    fun k j => eta_nonneg_field hr hpl hstrict hshape.toRefShape k j
  have e4 : ∀ k, ∃ j, 0 < etaAff nt (fragCycle g) k (fragCycle g j) :=
    fun k => eta_pos_field hr hstrict hshape.toRefShape k
  have e5 : Function.Injective (fragCycle g) :=
    RefShapeOrd.inj hr hstrict hshape
  have e6 : ∀ k l, etaAff nt (fragCycle g) l (fragCycle g k) = 0 →
      etaAff nt (fragCycle g) l (fragCycle g (k + 1)) = 0 →
      Collinear ℚ ({fragCycle g k, fragCycle g (k + 1), fragCycle g l,
        fragCycle g (l + 1)} : Set Point) :=
    fun k l h1 h2 => coll_field hr hpl hstrict hshape.toRefShape k l h1 h2
  have e7 : ∃ wt : Fin g.poly.size → ℚ, (∀ j, 0 < wt j) ∧ ∑ j, wt j = 1
      ∧ ∑ j, wt j • fragCycle g j = apexQ g := apexQ_relint hm3
  
  set F : FanPoly := mkFan hmm (fragCycle g) (etaAff nt (fragCycle g))
    (apexQ g) e1 e2 e3 e4 e5 hsat e6 e7 with hF
  have hFm : F.m = g.poly.size - 3 := rfl
  have hpoly : poly F = vpoly (fragCycle g) :=
    mkFan_poly hmm (fragCycle g) _ _ e1 e2 e3 e4 e5 hsat e6 e7
  have hrelint : relint F = vrelint (fragCycle g) :=
    mkFan_relint hmm (fragCycle g) _ _ e1 e2 e3 e4 e5 hsat e6 e7
  have hfanTri : ∀ k : Fin g.poly.size,
      fanTri F ((eEquiv hmm).symm k)
        = ⟨apexQ g, fragCycle g k, fragCycle g (k + 1)⟩ :=
    fun k => mkFan_fanTri hmm (fragCycle g) _ _ e1 e2 e3 e4 e5 hsat e6 e7 k
  
  have hvp : vpoly (fragCycle g) = vpoly (fragCycle f) :=
    hshape.toRefShape.vpoly_eq
  have hvr : vrelint (fragCycle g) = vrelint (fragCycle f) :=
    RefShape.vrelint_eq hr hstrict hshape.toRefShape
  
  by_cases h3 : g.poly.size = 3
  · 
    have hm0 : F.m = 0 := by rw [hFm]; omega
    have lt0 : 0 < g.poly.size := by omega
    have lt1 : 1 < g.poly.size := by omega
    have lt2 : 2 < g.poly.size := by omega
    have h0 : (⟨0, lt0⟩ : Fin g.poly.size) + 1 = ⟨1, lt1⟩ :=
      fin_succ_mk hm3 _ _ (Nat.mod_eq_of_lt lt1)
    have h1 : (⟨1, lt1⟩ : Fin g.poly.size) + 1 = ⟨2, lt2⟩ :=
      fin_succ_mk hm3 _ _ (Nat.mod_eq_of_lt lt2)
    have h2 : (⟨2, lt2⟩ : Fin g.poly.size) + 1 = ⟨0, lt0⟩ :=
      fin_succ_mk hm3 _ _ (by rw [h3])
    have hcons := fun k : Fin g.poly.size =>
      hshape.toRefShape.consec_ne hr hstrict k
    have gd : ∀ (n : ℕ) (hn : n < g.poly.size),
        P3.toPoint (g.poly.getD n default).p = fragCycle g ⟨n, hn⟩ := by
      intro n hn
      rw [getD_eq_getElem g.poly hn]
      rfl
    have hne01 : P3.toPoint (g.poly.getD 0 default).p
        ≠ P3.toPoint (g.poly.getD 1 default).p := by
      rw [gd 0 lt0, gd 1 lt1]
      exact h0 ▸ hcons ⟨0, lt0⟩
    have hne12 : P3.toPoint (g.poly.getD 1 default).p
        ≠ P3.toPoint (g.poly.getD 2 default).p := by
      rw [gd 1 lt1, gd 2 lt2]
      exact h1 ▸ hcons ⟨1, lt1⟩
    have hne20 : P3.toPoint (g.poly.getD 2 default).p
        ≠ P3.toPoint (g.poly.getD 0 default).p := by
      rw [gd 2 lt2, gd 0 lt0]
      exact h2 ▸ hcons ⟨2, lt2⟩
    have hwhole : wholeTri F
        = ⟨fragCycle g ⟨0, lt0⟩, fragCycle g ⟨1, lt1⟩, fragCycle g ⟨2, lt2⟩⟩ :=
      mkFan_wholeTri hmm (fragCycle g) _ _ e1 e2 e3 e4 e5 hsat e6 e7
        (by omega)
    have hlist : (emitFrag g).toList = [wholeTri F] := by
      rw [emitFrag_eq_triangle h3 hne01 hne12 hne20]
      show [(⟨P3.toPoint (g.poly.getD 0 default).p,
        P3.toPoint (g.poly.getD 1 default).p,
        P3.toPoint (g.poly.getD 2 default).p⟩ : Triangle)] = _
      rw [gd 0 lt0, gd 1 lt1, gd 2 lt2, hwhole]
    rw [hlist]
    refine ⟨List.pairwise_singleton _ _, ?_⟩
    intro t ht
    rw [List.mem_singleton] at ht
    subst ht
    constructor
    · exact (wholeTri_subset_poly F).trans (by rw [hpoly, hvp])
    · intro S hS
      refine triBd_disjoint F hm0 ?_
      rw [hrelint, hvr]
      exact hS
  · 
    have hapex : ∀ k : Fin g.poly.size, apexQ g ≠ fragCycle g k :=
      fun k => hshape.toRefShape.apex_ne hr hm3 hpl hstrict k
    have hcons : ∀ k : Fin g.poly.size, fragCycle g k ≠ fragCycle g (k + 1) :=
      fun k => hshape.toRefShape.consec_ne hr hstrict k
    have hlist : (emitFrag g).toList
        = List.ofFn (fun k : Fin g.poly.size => fanTri F ((eEquiv hmm).symm k)) := by
      rw [emitFrag_eq_fan h3 hm3 hapex hcons]
      congr 1
      funext k
      rw [hfanTri k]
    rw [hlist]
    constructor
    · rw [List.pairwise_ofFn]
      intro i j hij
      have hne : (eEquiv hmm).symm i ≠ (eEquiv hmm).symm j :=
        fun hc => absurd ((eEquiv hmm).symm.injective hc) (Fin.ne_of_lt hij)
      intro x hx
      exact fanSep F hne hx
    · intro t ht
      obtain ⟨k, hk⟩ := (List.mem_ofFn _ _).mp ht
      rw [← hk]
      constructor
      · exact (fanTri_subset_poly F _).trans (by rw [hpoly, hvp])
      · intro S hS
        refine fanBd_disjoint F _ ?_
        rw [hrelint, hvr]
        exact hS

name: eta_zero_on_segment
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨a, b, ha, hb, hab, rfl⟩ := hy
  rw [eta_affine_comb nt w i hab, eta_self, eta_succ]
  ring

name: fragOfFace_vrelint_off_edgeSet
statement:
theorem fragOfFace_vrelint_off_edgeSet (_meshId _parent : Nat) {t : Triangle}
    (hdet : detOrigin t ≠ 0) :
    vrelint (fragCycle (fragOfFace (faceSOf t)))
      ∩ edgeSet t = ∅
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have hb := fragInv_base hdet
  haveI := hb.neZero
  obtain ⟨hsz, hpt⟩ := fragOfFace_cycle t
  set base := fragOfFace (faceSOf t) with hbase
  have hm3 : 3 ≤ base.poly.size := hb.size3
  have lt0 : 0 < base.poly.size := by omega
  have lt1 : 1 < base.poly.size := by omega
  have lt2 : 2 < base.poly.size := by omega
  have w0 : fragCycle base ⟨0, lt0⟩ = t.v₀ := by simpa using hpt ⟨0, lt0⟩
  have w1 : fragCycle base ⟨1, lt1⟩ = t.v₁ := by simpa using hpt ⟨1, lt1⟩
  have w2 : fragCycle base ⟨2, lt2⟩ = t.v₂ := by simpa using hpt ⟨2, lt2⟩
  have s0 : (⟨0, lt0⟩ : Fin base.poly.size) + 1 = ⟨1, lt1⟩ :=
    fin_succ_mk hm3 _ _ (Nat.mod_eq_of_lt lt1)
  have s1 : (⟨1, lt1⟩ : Fin base.poly.size) + 1 = ⟨2, lt2⟩ :=
    fin_succ_mk hm3 _ _ (Nat.mod_eq_of_lt lt2)
  have s2 : (⟨2, lt2⟩ : Fin base.poly.size) + 1 = ⟨0, lt0⟩ :=
    fin_succ_mk hm3 _ _ (by rw [hsz])
  rw [Set.eq_empty_iff_forall_not_mem]
  rintro x ⟨hx, hxe⟩
  rw [vrelint_eq hb.size3 hb.onPlane hb.strictConv] at hx
  obtain ⟨-, hpos⟩ := hx
  rcases hxe with (h | h) | h
  · 
    rw [← w0, ← w1, ← s0] at h
    exact absurd (eta_zero_on_segment _ _ _ h) (ne_of_gt (hpos _))
  · 
    rw [← w1, ← w2, ← s1] at h
    exact absurd (eta_zero_on_segment _ _ _ h) (ne_of_gt (hpos _))
  · 
    rw [← w2, ← w0, ← s2] at h
    exact absurd (eta_zero_on_segment _ _ _ h) (ne_of_gt (hpos _))

name: crossSep_of_relDisj
proof:
:= by
  haveI := h₁.neZero
  haveI := h₂.neZero
  exact ⟨vrelint_disjoint_vpoly h₁.size3 h₂.size3 h₁.onPlane h₁.strictConv
      h₂.onPlane h₂.strictConv hd,
    vrelint_disjoint_vpoly h₂.size3 h₁.size3 h₂.onPlane h₂.strictConv
      h₁.onPlane h₁.strictConv hd.symm⟩

name: clipFaceScoped_vrelint_subset
proof:
:= by
  haveI := hf₀.neZero
  have hf' := fragInv_clipFaceScoped hf₀ L hmem
  haveI := hf'.neZero
  refine vrelint_mono hf'.size3 hf₀.size3 hf'.onPlane hf'.strictConv
    hf₀.onPlane hf₀.strictConv (fun j => ?_)
  exact clipFaceScoped_vpoly_subset hf₀ L hmem
    (subset_convexHull ℚ _ (Set.mem_range_self j))

name: sameStage_half
statement:
theorem sameStage_half {MA : Mesh} (meshId : Nat)
    (hA : NoPlaneThroughOrigin MA) (hns : NoFaceInteriorContact MA)
    {i i' : ℕ} (hi : i < MA.size) (hi' : i' < MA.size) (hne : i ≠ i')
    {f₁ f₂ : Frag} {L₁ L₂ : Array (IPlane × Box3)}
    (hm₁ : f₁ ∈ clipFaceScoped
      (fragOfFace ((materialize MA).getD i default)) L₁)
    (hm₂ : f₂ ∈ clipFaceScoped
      (fragOfFace ((materialize MA).getD i' default)) L₂) :
    vrelint (fragCycle f₁) ∩ vpoly (fragCycle f₂) = ∅
proof:
:= by
  classical
  
  have hiM : i < (materialize MA).size := by rwa [materialize_size]
  have hi'M : i' < (materialize MA).size := by rwa [materialize_size]
  rw [arr_getD _ _ _ hiM, materialize_getElem MA i hi] at hm₁
  rw [arr_getD _ _ _ hi'M, materialize_getElem MA i' hi'] at hm₂
  have hdet : detOrigin (MA[i]'hi) ≠ 0 := hA ⟨i, hi⟩
  have hdet' : detOrigin (MA[i']'hi') ≠ 0 := hA ⟨i', hi'⟩
  have hb₁ := fragInv_base hdet
  have hb₂ := fragInv_base hdet'
  
  have step1 : vrelint (fragCycle f₁)
      ⊆ vrelint (fragCycle (fragOfFace (faceSOf (MA[i]'hi)))) :=
    clipFaceScoped_vrelint_subset hb₁ L₁ hm₁
  have step2 : vpoly (fragCycle f₂) ⊆ triangleSet (MA[i']'hi') := by
    refine (clipFaceScoped_vpoly_subset hb₂ L₂ hm₂).trans ?_
    rw [vpoly_fragOfFace]
  
  have step3 : vrelint (fragCycle (fragOfFace (faceSOf (MA[i]'hi))))
      ∩ triangleSet (MA[i']'hi') = ∅ := by
    rw [Set.eq_empty_iff_forall_not_mem]
    rintro x ⟨hx1, hx2⟩
    have hxT : x ∈ triangleSet (MA[i]'hi) := by
      rw [← vpoly_fragOfFace (MA[i]'hi)]
      exact vrelint_subset_vpoly _ hx1
    have hfne : (⟨i, hi⟩ : Fin MA.size) ≠ ⟨i', hi'⟩ :=
      fun hc => hne (congrArg Fin.val hc)
    have hedge : x ∈ edgeSet (MA[i]'hi) :=
      hns ⟨i, hi⟩ ⟨i', hi'⟩ hfne ⟨hxT, hx2⟩
    have hoff := fragOfFace_vrelint_off_edgeSet meshId i hdet
    rw [Set.eq_empty_iff_forall_not_mem] at hoff
    exact hoff x ⟨hx1, hedge⟩
  rw [Set.eq_empty_iff_forall_not_mem]
  rintro x ⟨hx1, hx2⟩
  rw [Set.eq_empty_iff_forall_not_mem] at step3
  exact step3 x ⟨step1 hx1, step2 hx2⟩

name: fragInv_base_getD
statement:
theorem fragInv_base_getD {MA : Mesh} (_meshId : Nat)
    (hA : NoPlaneThroughOrigin MA) {i : ℕ} (hiA : i < MA.size) :
    FragInv (carrierNormal (MA[i]'hiA)) (detOrigin (MA[i]'hiA))
      (fragOfFace ((materialize MA).getD i default))
proof:
:= by
  have hiM : i < (materialize MA).size := by rwa [materialize_size]
  rw [arr_getD _ _ _ hiM, materialize_getElem MA i hiA]
  exact fragInv_base (hA ⟨i, hiA⟩)

name: stage_pairwise
statement:
theorem stage_pairwise {MA : Mesh} (meshId : Nat)
    (hA : NoPlaneThroughOrigin MA) (hns : NoFaceInteriorContact MA)
    (LFor : ℕ → Array (IPlane × Box3)) :
    ((Array.range (materialize MA).size).flatMap (fun i =>
      clipFaceScoped (fragOfFace ((materialize MA).getD i default))
        (LFor i))).toList.Pairwise CrossSep
proof:
:= by
  classical
  rw [toList_flatMap_arr, Array.toList_range]
  rw [show (List.range (materialize MA).size).flatMap
        (fun i => (clipFaceScoped
          (fragOfFace ((materialize MA).getD i default))
          (LFor i)).toList)
      = ((List.range (materialize MA).size).map
        (fun i => (clipFaceScoped
          (fragOfFace ((materialize MA).getD i default))
          (LFor i)).toList)).flatten from rfl]
  rw [List.pairwise_flatten]
  constructor
  · 
    intro l hl
    rw [List.mem_map] at hl
    obtain ⟨i, hir, rfl⟩ := hl
    rw [List.mem_range] at hir
    have hiA : i < MA.size := by rwa [materialize_size] at hir
    have hb := fragInv_base_getD meshId hA hiA
    refine (clipFaceScoped_pairwise hb (LFor i)).imp_of_mem ?_
    intro a b ha hb' hd
    exact crossSep_of_relDisj
      (fragInv_clipFaceScoped hb _ (Array.mem_def.mpr ha))
      (fragInv_clipFaceScoped hb _ (Array.mem_def.mpr hb')) hd
  · 
    rw [List.pairwise_map]
    refine (List.pairwise_lt_range _).imp_of_mem ?_
    intro i i' hir hi'r hlt
    rw [List.mem_range] at hir hi'r
    have hiA : i < MA.size := by rwa [materialize_size] at hir
    have hi'A : i' < MA.size := by rwa [materialize_size] at hi'r
    intro x hx y hy
    have hx' := Array.mem_def.mpr hx
    have hy' := Array.mem_def.mpr hy
    exact ⟨sameStage_half meshId hA hns hiA hi'A (Nat.ne_of_lt hlt) hx' hy',
      sameStage_half meshId hA hns hi'A hiA (Nat.ne_of_lt hlt).symm hy' hx'⟩

name: noSelf_of_pairwise_triRel
statement:
theorem noSelf_of_pairwise_triRel {out : Mesh}
    (h : out.toList.Pairwise TriRel) : NoFaceInteriorContact out
proof:
:= by
  have hpw' := List.pairwise_iff_getElem.mp h
  intro i j hij
  have hlen : out.toList.length = out.size := Array.length_toList
  have hi' : i.val < out.toList.length := by
    rw [hlen]
    exact i.isLt
  have hj' : j.val < out.toList.length := by
    rw [hlen]
    exact j.isLt
  have hgi : out.toList[i.val]'hi' = out[i] := Array.getElem_toList i.isLt
  have hgj : out.toList[j.val]'hj' = out[j] := Array.getElem_toList j.isLt
  rcases Nat.lt_or_ge i.val j.val with hlt | hge
  · have hrel := hpw' i.val j.val hi' hj' hlt
    rw [hgi, hgj] at hrel
    exact fun x hx => (hrel hx).1
  · have hlt : j.val < i.val := by
      rcases Nat.eq_or_lt_of_le hge with heq | h
      · exact absurd (Fin.ext heq.symm) hij
      · exact h
    have hrel := hpw' j.val i.val hj' hi' hlt
    rw [hgi, hgj] at hrel
    exact fun x hx => (hrel ⟨hx.2, hx.1⟩).2

name: mem_candP_iff
statement:
theorem mem_candP_iff {MA MB : Mesh} {i j : ℕ} (hi : i < (materialize MA).size) :
    j ∈ (candP MA MB).getD i #[]
      ↔ j < (materialize MB).size ∧
        boxesOverlap (bboxOfFace ((materialize MA).getD i default))
          (bboxOfFace ((materialize MB).getD j default)) = true
proof:
:=
  mem_candOf_iff _ (prepOf_bvh MB) hi

name: mem_candP_lt
statement:
theorem mem_candP_lt {MA MB : Mesh} {i : ℕ} {j : Nat}
    (hj : j ∈ (candP MA MB).getD i #[]) : j < (materialize MB).size
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hi : i < (materialize MA).size
  · exact ((mem_candP_iff (MB := MB) hi).mp hj).1
  · exfalso
    have hsz : (candP MA MB).size = (materialize MA).size := by
      rw [candP, candOf, Array.size_map]
    rw [Array.getD, dif_neg (by rw [hsz]; exact hi)] at hj
    simp at hj

name: mem_candP
statement:
theorem mem_candP {MA MB : Mesh} {i j : ℕ}
    (hi : i < (materialize MA).size) (hj : j < (materialize MB).size)
    (hov : boxesOverlap (bboxOfFace ((materialize MA)[i]))
      (bboxOfFace ((materialize MB)[j])) = true) :
    j ∈ (candP MA MB).getD i #[]
proof:
:= by
  refine (mem_candP_iff hi).mpr ⟨hj, ?_⟩
  rwa [MeshIntersectKeep.arr_getD _ _ _ hi, MeshIntersectKeep.arr_getD _ _ _ hj]

name: planesForScoped_of_meet_P
statement:
theorem planesForScoped_of_meet_P {MA MB : Mesh} {i j : ℕ}
    (hi : i < MA.size) (hj : j < MB.size)
    (hmeet : (triangleSet (MA[i]'hi) ∩ triangleSet (MB[j]'hj)).Nonempty) :
    ∃ pg ∈ planesForScoped ((materialize MA).getD i default).plane (materialize MB)
        ((candP MA MB).getD i #[]),
      IsMulOf pg.1 (carrierNormal (MB[j]'hj)) (detOrigin (MB[j]'hj))
      ∧ triangleSet (MB[j]'hj)
          ∩ {x : Point | dotQ (carrierNormal (MA[i]'hi)) x = detOrigin (MA[i]'hi)}
          ⊆ BoxSet pg.2
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨x, hxA, hxB⟩ := hmeet
  have hiA : i < (materialize MA).size := by simpa [materialize] using hi
  have hjB : j < (materialize MB).size := by simpa [materialize] using hj
  have hov : boxesOverlap (bboxOfFace ((materialize MA)[i]))
      (bboxOfFace ((materialize MB)[j])) = true := by
    rw [materialize_getElem MA i hi, materialize_getElem MB j hj]
    exact boxesOverlap_of_common (triangleSet_subset_bbox _ hxA)
      (triangleSet_subset_bbox _ hxB)
  have hcand := mem_candP hiA hjB hov
  have hlvl : dotQ (carrierNormal (MA[i]'hi)) x = detOrigin (MA[i]'hi) :=
    triangleSet_subset_level (dotQ_carrierNormal_v₀ _) (dotQ_carrierNormal_v₁ _)
      (dotQ_carrierNormal_v₂ _) x hxA
  have hP : IsMulOf ((materialize MA).getD i default).plane
      (carrierNormal (MA[i]'hi)) (detOrigin (MA[i]'hi)) := by
    rw [MeshIntersectKeep.arr_getD _ _ _ hiA, materialize_getElem MA i hi]
    exact isMulOf_faceSOf_plane _
  have hnd : dropByPlane ((materialize MA).getD i default).plane
      ((materialize MB).getD j default) = false := by
    rw [MeshIntersectKeep.arr_getD _ _ _ hjB, materialize_getElem MB j hj]
    exact not_dropByPlane_of_meet hP hxB hlvl
  have hsome := scopeBoxSEG_isSome_of_not_drop hnd
  rw [Option.isSome_iff_exists] at hsome
  obtain ⟨box, hbox⟩ := hsome
  refine ⟨(((materialize MB).getD j default).plane, box),
    mem_planesForScoped hcand hbox, ?_, ?_⟩
  · rw [MeshIntersectKeep.arr_getD _ _ _ hjB, materialize_getElem MB j hj]
    exact isMulOf_faceSOf_plane _
  · have hbox' : scopeBoxSEG ((materialize MA).getD i default).plane
        (faceSOf (MB[j]'hj)) = some box := by
      rw [MeshIntersectKeep.arr_getD _ _ _ hjB, materialize_getElem MB j hj] at hbox; exact hbox
    exact scopeBoxSEG_some_superset hP hbox'

name: point_ext
statement:
theorem point_ext {p q : Point} (h0 : p 0 = q 0) (h1 : p 1 = q 1) (h2 : p 2 = q 2) :
    p = q
proof:
:= by
  funext i
  fin_cases i
  · exact h0
  · exact h1
  · exact h2

name: crossQ_self
statement: theorem crossQ_self (a : Point) : crossQ a a = 0
proof:
:= by
  funext i; fin_cases i <;> simp [crossQ, mkPoint] <;> ring

name: crossQ_anticomm
statement: theorem crossQ_anticomm (a b : Point) : crossQ a b = -crossQ b a
proof:
:= by
  funext i; fin_cases i <;> simp [crossQ, mkPoint] <;> ring

name: crossQ_smul_right
statement:
theorem crossQ_smul_right (t : ℚ) (a b : Point) :
    crossQ a (t • b) = t • crossQ a b
proof:
:= by
  funext i; fin_cases i <;>
    simp [crossQ, mkPoint, Pi.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul] <;> ring

name: crossQ_smul_left
statement:
theorem crossQ_smul_left (t : ℚ) (a b : Point) :
    crossQ (t • a) b = t • crossQ a b
proof:
:= by
  funext i; fin_cases i <;>
    simp [crossQ, mkPoint, Pi.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul] <;> ring

name: dotQ_comm
statement: theorem dotQ_comm (a b : Point) : dotQ a b = dotQ b a
proof:
:= by
  simp only [dotQ]; ring

name: dotQ_zero_right
statement: theorem dotQ_zero_right (a : Point) : dotQ a 0 = 0
proof:
:= by
  simp [dotQ]

name: dotQ_crossQ_cyclic
statement:
theorem dotQ_crossQ_cyclic (a b c : Point) :
    dotQ a (crossQ b c) = dotQ c (crossQ a b)
proof:
:= by
  simp only [dotQ, crossQ, mkPoint_zero, mkPoint_one, mkPoint_two]
  ring

name: crossQ_crossQ
statement:
theorem crossQ_crossQ (a b c : Point) :
    crossQ a (crossQ b c) = dotQ a c • b - dotQ a b • c
proof:
:= by
  funext i
  fin_cases i <;>
    · simp [crossQ, dotQ, mkPoint, Pi.sub_apply, Pi.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul]
      ring

name: exists_smul_of_crossQ_eq_zero
statement:
theorem exists_smul_of_crossQ_eq_zero {e v : Point} (hv : v ≠ 0)
    (h : crossQ e v = 0) : ∃ t : ℚ, e = t • v
proof:
:= by
  have h0 : e 1 * v 2 - e 2 * v 1 = 0 := congrFun h 0
  have h1 : e 2 * v 0 - e 0 * v 2 = 0 := congrFun h 1
  have h2 : e 0 * v 1 - e 1 * v 0 = 0 := congrFun h 2
  by_cases hv0 : v 0 = 0
  · by_cases hv1 : v 1 = 0
    · have hv2 : v 2 ≠ 0 := fun hv2 => hv (point_ext hv0 hv1 hv2)
      refine ⟨e 2 / v 2, point_ext ?_ ?_ ?_⟩ <;>
        · simp only [Pi.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul]
          field_simp
          try linarith
    · refine ⟨e 1 / v 1, point_ext ?_ ?_ ?_⟩ <;>
        · simp only [Pi.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul]
          field_simp
          try linarith
  · refine ⟨e 0 / v 0, point_ext ?_ ?_ ?_⟩ <;>
      · simp only [Pi.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul]
        field_simp
        try linarith

name: crossDotLin_apply
statement:
@[simp] theorem crossDotLin_apply (n u x : Point) :
    crossDotLin n u x = dotQ n (crossQ u x)
proof: := rfl

name: dotLin_apply
statement: @[simp] theorem dotLin_apply (n x : Point) : dotLin n x = dotQ n x
proof: := rfl

name: areaForm_cyclic
statement:
theorem areaForm_cyclic (n x u v : Point) :
    areaForm n x u v = areaForm n u v x
proof:
:= by
  simp only [areaForm, dotQ, crossQ, mkPoint_zero, mkPoint_one, mkPoint_two, Pi.sub_apply]
  ring

name: areaForm_swap
statement:
theorem areaForm_swap (n x u v : Point) :
    areaForm n x u v = -areaForm n x v u
proof:
:= by
  simp only [areaForm, dotQ, crossQ, mkPoint_zero, mkPoint_one, mkPoint_two, Pi.sub_apply]
  ring

name: areaForm_self_left
statement: theorem areaForm_self_left (n x v : Point) : areaForm n x x v = 0
proof:
:= by
  simp only [areaForm, dotQ, crossQ, mkPoint_zero, mkPoint_one, mkPoint_two, Pi.sub_apply]
  ring

name: areaForm_self_right
statement: theorem areaForm_self_right (n x u : Point) : areaForm n x u u = 0
proof:
:= by
  simp only [areaForm, dotQ, crossQ, mkPoint_zero, mkPoint_one, mkPoint_two, Pi.sub_apply]
  ring

name: areaForm_decomp
statement:
theorem areaForm_decomp (n a b x : Point) :
    areaForm n a b x = crossDotLin n (b - a) x - crossDotLin n (b - a) a
proof:
:= by
  simp only [areaForm, crossDotLin_apply, dotQ, crossQ, mkPoint_zero, mkPoint_one,
    mkPoint_two, Pi.sub_apply]
  ring

name: dotQ_neg_right
statement: theorem dotQ_neg_right (n u : Point) : dotQ n (-u) = - dotQ n u
proof:
:= by
  simp only [dotQ, Pi.neg_apply]; ring

name: crossQ_zero_right
statement: theorem crossQ_zero_right (u : Point) : crossQ u 0 = 0
proof:
:= by
  funext k; fin_cases k <;> simp [crossQ, mkPoint]

name: crossQ_parallel_of_orth
proof:
:= by
  have h := cross_parallel_normal (n := n) (c := 0) (p := 0) (q := u) (r := v)
    (by simp [dotQ]) hu hv
  simpa using h

name: plane_coords
statement:
theorem plane_coords {n : Point} (hn : n ≠ 0) {c : ℚ} {a b z x : Point}
    (ha : dotQ n a = c) (hb : dotQ n b = c) (hz : dotQ n z = c)
    (hind : areaForm n a b z ≠ 0) (hx : dotQ n x = c) :
    ∃ s t : ℚ, x = a + s • (b - a) + t • (z - a)
proof:
:= by
  set u := b - a with hudef
  set v := z - a with hvdef
  set y := x - a with hydef
  have hu : dotQ n u = 0 := by rw [hudef, dotQ_sub_right, hb, ha, sub_self]
  have hv : dotQ n v = 0 := by rw [hvdef, dotQ_sub_right, hz, ha, sub_self]
  have hy : dotQ n y = 0 := by rw [hydef, dotQ_sub_right, hx, ha, sub_self]
  set A := dotQ n (crossQ u v) with hAdef
  have hAeq : areaForm n a b z = A := by rw [hAdef, hudef, hvdef]; rfl
  have hA : A ≠ 0 := hAeq ▸ hind
  set s := dotQ n (crossQ y v) / A with hsdef
  set t := dotQ n (crossQ u y) / A with htdef
  set w := y - s • u - t • v with hwdef
  have hnn : 0 < dotQ n n := dotQ_self_pos hn
  have hwn : dotQ n w = 0 := by
    rw [hwdef, dotQ_sub_right, dotQ_sub_right,
      Proof.MeshIntersectRay.dotQ_smul_right, Proof.MeshIntersectRay.dotQ_smul_right,
      hy, hu, hv]
    ring
  
  have hwv : crossQ w v = 0 := by
    have h1 : dotQ n (crossQ v w) = s * A - dotQ n (crossQ y v) := by
      rw [hwdef, hAdef]
      simp only [dotQ, crossQ, mkPoint_zero, mkPoint_one, mkPoint_two,
        Pi.sub_apply, Pi.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul]
      ring
    have hzero : dotQ n (crossQ v w) = 0 := by
      rw [h1, hsdef, div_mul_cancel₀ _ hA, sub_self]
    have hpar := crossQ_parallel_of_orth (n := n) hv hwn
    rw [hzero, zero_smul] at hpar
    have hvw : crossQ v w = 0 :=
      (smul_eq_zero.mp hpar).resolve_left (ne_of_gt hnn)
    rw [crossQ_anticomm, hvw, neg_zero]
  have huw : crossQ u w = 0 := by
    have h2 : dotQ n (crossQ u w) = dotQ n (crossQ u y) - t * A := by
      rw [hwdef, hAdef]
      simp only [dotQ, crossQ, mkPoint_zero, mkPoint_one, mkPoint_two,
        Pi.sub_apply, Pi.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul]
      ring
    have hzero : dotQ n (crossQ u w) = 0 := by
      rw [h2, htdef, div_mul_cancel₀ _ hA, sub_self]
    have hpar := crossQ_parallel_of_orth (n := n) hu hwn
    rw [hzero, zero_smul] at hpar
    exact (smul_eq_zero.mp hpar).resolve_left (ne_of_gt hnn)
  
  have hv0 : v ≠ 0 := by
    intro h
    exact hA (by rw [hAdef, h, crossQ_zero_right, dotQ_zero_right])
  have huv0 : crossQ u v ≠ 0 := fun h => hA (by rw [hAdef, h, dotQ_zero_right])
  obtain ⟨t₁, ht₁⟩ := exists_smul_of_crossQ_eq_zero hv0 hwv
  have ht₁0 : t₁ = 0 := by
    have h := huw
    rw [ht₁, crossQ_smul_right] at h
    exact (smul_eq_zero.mp h).resolve_right huv0
  have hw0 : w = 0 := by rw [ht₁, ht₁0, zero_smul]
  refine ⟨s, t, ?_⟩
  rw [hwdef, hydef, hudef, hvdef] at hw0
  rw [hudef, hvdef]
  funext k
  have hk := congrFun hw0 k
  simp only [Pi.sub_apply, Pi.add_apply, Pi.smul_apply, Pi.zero_apply,
    smul_eq_mul] at hk ⊢
  linarith

name: prop_on_plane
statement:
theorem prop_on_plane {n : Point} (hn : n ≠ 0) {c : ℚ} {a b z : Point}
    (ha : dotQ n a = c) (hb : dotQ n b = c) (hz : dotQ n z = c)
    (hind : areaForm n a b z ≠ 0) {m₁ m₂ : Point} {d₁ d₂ : ℚ}
    (h1a : dotQ m₁ a = d₁) (h1b : dotQ m₁ b = d₁)
    (h2a : dotQ m₂ a = d₂) (h2b : dotQ m₂ b = d₂)
    {x : Point} (hx : dotQ n x = c) :
    (dotQ m₁ x - d₁) * (dotQ m₂ z - d₂) = (dotQ m₂ x - d₂) * (dotQ m₁ z - d₁)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨s, t, hxrep⟩ := plane_coords hn ha hb hz hind hx
  have key : ∀ m : Point, ∀ d : ℚ, dotQ m a = d → dotQ m b = d →
      dotQ m (a + s • (b - a) + t • (z - a)) - d = t * (dotQ m z - d) := by
    intro m d hma hmb
    have hexp : dotQ m (a + s • (b - a) + t • (z - a))
        = dotQ m a + s * (dotQ m b - dotQ m a) + t * (dotQ m z - dotQ m a) := by
      simp only [dotQ, Pi.add_apply, Pi.sub_apply, Pi.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul]
      ring
    rw [hexp, hma, hmb]
    ring
  rw [hxrep, key m₁ d₁ h1a h1b, key m₂ d₂ h2a h2b]
  ring

name: eta_eq
statement:
theorem eta_eq (n : Point) (w : Fin r → Point) (i : Fin r) (x : Point) :
    eta n w i x = dotQ n (crossQ (w (i + 1) - w i) (x - w i))
proof: := rfl

name: eta_add_smul
statement:
theorem eta_add_smul (n : Point) (w : Fin r → Point) (i : Fin r) (x v : Point) (s : ℚ) :
    eta n w i (x + s • v) = eta n w i x + s * etaDir n w i v
proof:
:= by
  simp only [eta, etaDir, areaForm, dotQ, crossQ, mkPoint_zero, mkPoint_one, mkPoint_two,
    Pi.sub_apply, Pi.add_apply, Pi.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul]
  ring

name: eta_self
statement:
theorem eta_self (n : Point) (w : Fin r → Point) (i : Fin r) :
    eta n w i (w i) = 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [eta, areaForm_cyclic]
  exact areaForm_self_right n _ _

name: eta_succ
statement:
theorem eta_succ (n : Point) (w : Fin r → Point) (i : Fin r) :
    eta n w i (w (i + 1)) = 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [eta, areaForm_cyclic]
  exact areaForm_self_left n _ _

name: areaForm_comb
statement:
theorem areaForm_comb (n a b : Point) {μ : Fin r → ℚ} (h1 : ∑ j, μ j = 1)
    (p : Fin r → Point) :
    areaForm n a b (∑ j, μ j • p j) = ∑ j, μ j * areaForm n a b (p j)
proof:
:= by
  rw [areaForm_decomp, map_sum]
  have hsm : ∀ j, crossDotLin n (b - a) (μ j • p j)
      = μ j * crossDotLin n (b - a) (p j) := fun j => by
    rw [map_smul, smul_eq_mul]
  rw [Finset.sum_congr rfl fun j _ => hsm j]
  have hexp : ∀ j, μ j * areaForm n a b (p j)
      = μ j * crossDotLin n (b - a) (p j) - μ j * crossDotLin n (b - a) a := fun j => by
    rw [areaForm_decomp]; ring
  rw [Finset.sum_congr rfl fun j _ => hexp j, Finset.sum_sub_distrib, ← Finset.sum_mul, h1,
    one_mul]

name: eta_comb
proof:
:=
  areaForm_comb n (w i) (w (i + 1)) h1 w

name: dotQ_comb
proof:
:= by
  have hL : dotQ n (∑ j, μ j • w j) = ∑ j, μ j * dotQ n (w j) := by
    rw [show dotQ n (∑ j, μ j • w j) = dotLin n (∑ j, μ j • w j) from rfl, map_sum]
    exact Finset.sum_congr rfl fun j _ => by rw [map_smul, smul_eq_mul, dotLin_apply]
  rw [hL, Finset.sum_congr rfl fun j _ => by rw [hpl j], ← Finset.sum_mul, h1, one_mul]

name: fin_one_ne_zero
statement: theorem fin_one_ne_zero (hr : 3 ≤ r) : (1 : Fin r) ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  have : r ≠ 1 := by omega
  exact fun h => this (Fin.one_eq_zero_iff.mp h)

name: fin_two_ne_zero
statement: theorem fin_two_ne_zero (hr : 3 ≤ r) : (1 + 1 : Fin r) ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  intro h
  have hval : ((1 + 1 : Fin r) : ℕ) = 0 := by rw [h]; rfl
  rw [Fin.val_add, Fin.val_one'] at hval
  have h1 : (1 : ℕ) % r = 1 := Nat.mod_eq_of_lt (by omega)
  rw [h1] at hval
  have h2 : (1 + 1 : ℕ) % r = 2 := Nat.mod_eq_of_lt (by omega)
  omega

name: fin_add_one_ne
statement: theorem fin_add_one_ne (hr : 3 ≤ r) (i : Fin r) : i + 1 ≠ i
proof:
:= by
  intro h
  have h' : i + 1 = i + 0 := by rw [h, add_zero]
  exact fin_one_ne_zero hr (add_left_cancel h')

name: fin_add_two_ne
statement: theorem fin_add_two_ne (hr : 3 ≤ r) (i : Fin r) : i + 1 + 1 ≠ i
proof:
:= by
  intro h
  apply fin_two_ne_zero hr
  have : i + (1 + 1) = i + 0 := by rw [← add_assoc, h, add_zero]
  exact add_left_cancel this

name: n_ne_zero_of_strict
statement:
theorem n_ne_zero_of_strict (hr : 3 ≤ r) {n : Point} {w : Fin r → Point}
    (hs : StrictConv n w) : n ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  rintro rfl
  have h := hs 0 (0 + 1 + 1) (fin_add_two_ne hr 0) (fin_add_one_ne hr (0 + 1))
  simp [eta, areaForm, dotQ] at h

name: consec_ne
statement:
theorem consec_ne (hr : 3 ≤ r) {n : Point} {w : Fin r → Point}
    (hs : StrictConv n w) (i : Fin r) : w i ≠ w (i + 1)
proof:
:= by
  intro heq
  have h := hs i (i + 1 + 1) (fin_add_two_ne hr i) (fin_add_one_ne hr (i + 1))
  rw [eta, ← heq, areaForm_self_left] at h
  exact lt_irrefl 0 h

name: convPos_of_strict
statement:
theorem convPos_of_strict {n : Point} {w : Fin r → Point} (hs : StrictConv n w) :
    ConvPos n w
proof:
:= by
  intro i j
  by_cases h1 : j = i
  · rw [h1, eta_self]
  by_cases h2 : j = i + 1
  · rw [h2, eta_succ]
  exact (hs i j h1 h2).le

name: exists_etaDir_neg
statement:
theorem exists_etaDir_neg (hr : 3 ≤ r) {n : Point} {c : ℚ} {w : Fin r → Point}
    (hpl : OnPlane n c w) (hs : StrictConv n w)
    {v : Point} (hv : v ≠ 0) (hnv : dotQ n v = 0) :
    ∃ i, etaDir n w i v < 0
proof:
:= by
  by_contra hcon
  push_neg at hcon
  
  have htel : ∑ i, etaDir n w i v = 0 := by
    have hterm : ∀ i : Fin r, etaDir n w i v
        = dotQ n (crossQ (w (i + 1)) v) - dotQ n (crossQ (w i) v) := by
      intro i
      simp only [etaDir, dotQ, crossQ, mkPoint_zero, mkPoint_one, mkPoint_two, Pi.sub_apply]
      ring
    rw [Finset.sum_congr rfl fun i _ => hterm i, Finset.sum_sub_distrib]
    have hbij : ∑ i : Fin r, dotQ n (crossQ (w (i + 1)) v)
        = ∑ i : Fin r, dotQ n (crossQ (w i) v) :=
      Fintype.sum_equiv (Equiv.addRight 1) _ _ (fun i => rfl)
    rw [hbij, sub_self]
  have hall : ∀ i : Fin r, etaDir n w i v = 0 := fun i =>
    (Finset.sum_eq_zero_iff_of_nonneg fun i _ => hcon i).mp htel i (Finset.mem_univ i)
  have hn : n ≠ 0 := n_ne_zero_of_strict hr hs
  
  have hpar : ∀ i : Fin r, crossQ (w (i + 1) - w i) v = 0 := by
    intro i
    set e := w (i + 1) - w i with he
    have hen : dotQ n e = 0 := by rw [he, dotQ_sub_right, hpl, hpl, sub_self]
    have hevn : dotQ e (crossQ v n) = 0 := by
      rw [dotQ_crossQ_cyclic]
      exact hall i
    have hbac1 : crossQ n (crossQ v n) = dotQ n n • v := by
      rw [crossQ_crossQ, hnv, zero_smul, sub_zero]
    have hbac2 : crossQ e (crossQ n (crossQ v n)) = 0 := by
      rw [crossQ_crossQ, hevn, zero_smul, dotQ_comm, hen, zero_smul, sub_zero]
    have hsm : dotQ n n • crossQ e v = 0 := by
      calc dotQ n n • crossQ e v = crossQ e (dotQ n n • v) :=
            (crossQ_smul_right _ _ _).symm
        _ = crossQ e (crossQ n (crossQ v n)) := by rw [hbac1]
        _ = 0 := hbac2
    exact (smul_eq_zero.mp hsm).resolve_left (ne_of_gt (dotQ_self_pos hn))
  
  obtain ⟨t, ht⟩ := exists_smul_of_crossQ_eq_zero hv (hpar 0)
  obtain ⟨t', ht'⟩ := exists_smul_of_crossQ_eq_zero hv (hpar (0 + 1))
  have h2 : w (0 + 1 + 1) - w 0 = (t' + t) • v := by
    have : w (0 + 1 + 1) - w 0 = (w (0 + 1 + 1) - w (0 + 1)) + (w (0 + 1) - w 0) := by
      abel
    rw [this, ht, ht', add_smul]
  have hzero : eta n w 0 (w (0 + 1 + 1)) = 0 := by
    show dotQ n (crossQ (w (0 + 1) - w 0) (w (0 + 1 + 1) - w 0)) = 0
    rw [ht, h2, crossQ_smul_left, crossQ_smul_right, crossQ_self, smul_zero, smul_zero,
      dotQ_zero_right]
  have hstrict := hs 0 (0 + 1 + 1) (fin_add_two_ne hr 0) (fin_add_one_ne hr (0 + 1))
  rw [hzero] at hstrict
  exact lt_irrefl 0 hstrict

name: feasible_eta_zero_mem_edge
statement:
theorem feasible_eta_zero_mem_edge (hr : 3 ≤ r) {n : Point} {c : ℚ} {w : Fin r → Point}
    (hpl : OnPlane n c w) (hs : StrictConv n w) {z : Point} (i : Fin r)
    (hz : dotQ n z = c) (hfeas : ∀ k, 0 ≤ eta n w k z) (hzero : eta n w i z = 0) :
    ∃ s : ℚ, 0 ≤ s ∧ s ≤ 1 ∧ z = (1 - s) • w i + s • w (i + 1)
proof:
:= by
  have hn : n ≠ 0 := n_ne_zero_of_strict hr hs
  have he : w (i + 1) - w i ≠ 0 := fun h =>
    consec_ne hr hs i (sub_eq_zero.mp h).symm
  
  have hpar := cross_parallel_normal (n := n) (hpl i) (hpl (i + 1)) hz
  have hcoef : dotQ n (crossQ (w (i + 1) - w i) (z - w i)) = 0 := by
    rw [← eta_eq]; exact hzero
  rw [hcoef, zero_smul] at hpar
  have hcross : crossQ (w (i + 1) - w i) (z - w i) = 0 :=
    (smul_eq_zero.mp hpar).resolve_left (ne_of_gt (dotQ_self_pos hn))
  have hcross' : crossQ (z - w i) (w (i + 1) - w i) = 0 := by
    rw [crossQ_anticomm, hcross, neg_zero]
  obtain ⟨s, hsval⟩ := exists_smul_of_crossQ_eq_zero he hcross'
  have hzrep : z = w i + s • (w (i + 1) - w i) := by rw [← hsval]; abel
  
  have hpos1 : 0 < eta n w (i + 1) (w i) :=
    hs (i + 1) i (fin_add_one_ne hr i).symm (Ne.symm (fin_add_two_ne hr i))
  have hdir1 : etaDir n w (i + 1) (w (i + 1) - w i) = - eta n w (i + 1) (w i) := by
    show dotQ n (crossQ (w (i + 1 + 1) - w (i + 1)) (w (i + 1) - w i))
      = - areaForm n (w (i + 1)) (w (i + 1 + 1)) (w i)
    simp only [areaForm, dotQ, crossQ, mkPoint_zero, mkPoint_one, mkPoint_two, Pi.sub_apply]
    ring
  have hle1 : s ≤ 1 := by
    have hfz := hfeas (i + 1)
    rw [hzrep, eta_add_smul, hdir1] at hfz
    nlinarith
  
  have hidx : (i - 1) + 1 = i := by abel
  have hzeroprev : eta n w (i - 1) (w i) = 0 := by
    have h := eta_succ n w (i - 1)
    rwa [hidx] at h
  have hdir0 : etaDir n w (i - 1) (w (i + 1) - w i) = eta n w (i - 1) (w (i + 1)) := by
    have h1 : w ((i - 1) + 1) = w i := by rw [hidx]
    show dotQ n (crossQ (w ((i - 1) + 1) - w (i - 1)) (w (i + 1) - w i))
      = areaForm n (w (i - 1)) (w ((i - 1) + 1)) (w (i + 1))
    rw [h1]
    simp only [areaForm, dotQ, crossQ, mkPoint_zero, mkPoint_one, mkPoint_two, Pi.sub_apply]
    ring
  have hpos0 : 0 < eta n w (i - 1) (w (i + 1)) := by
    refine hs (i - 1) (i + 1) ?_ ?_
    · intro hcon
      apply fin_add_two_ne hr i
      rw [hcon]
      exact hidx
    · rw [hidx]
      exact fin_add_one_ne hr i
  have hge0 : 0 ≤ s := by
    have hfz := hfeas (i - 1)
    rw [hzrep, eta_add_smul, hzeroprev, hdir0, zero_add] at hfz
    nlinarith
  refine ⟨s, hge0, hle1, ?_⟩
  rw [hzrep]
  funext k
  simp only [Pi.add_apply, Pi.smul_apply, Pi.sub_apply, smul_eq_mul]
  ring

name: dotQ_affine_comb
statement:
theorem dotQ_affine_comb (n : Point) (a b : ℚ) (x y : Point) :
    dotQ n (a • x + b • y) = a * dotQ n x + b * dotQ n y
proof:
:= by
  simp only [dotQ, Pi.add_apply, Pi.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul]; ring

name: eta_affine_comb
proof:
:= by
  have hb : b = 1 - a := by linarith
  subst hb
  simp only [eta, areaForm, dotQ, crossQ, mkPoint_zero, mkPoint_one, mkPoint_two,
    Pi.sub_apply, Pi.add_apply, Pi.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul]
  ring

name: sum_mem_vpoly
statement:
theorem sum_mem_vpoly {w : Fin r → Point} {μ : Fin r → ℚ} (h0 : ∀ j, 0 ≤ μ j)
    (h1 : ∑ j, μ j = 1) : ∑ j, μ j • w j ∈ vpoly w
proof:
:= by
  have hmem := Finset.centerMass_mem_convexHull (t := Finset.univ)
    (fun i _ => h0 i) (by rw [h1]; norm_num)
    (fun i _ => Set.mem_range_self (f := w) i)
  rwa [Finset.centerMass, h1, inv_one, one_smul] at hmem

name: vrelint_subset_vpoly
statement: theorem vrelint_subset_vpoly (w : Fin r → Point) : vrelint w ⊆ vpoly w
proof:
:= by
  rintro x ⟨μ, hpos, hsum, rfl⟩
  exact sum_mem_vpoly (fun j => (hpos j).le) hsum

name: sum_scaled_smul
statement:
private theorem sum_scaled_smul (w : Fin r → Point) (x : ℚ) (y : Fin r → ℚ) :
    ∑ j, (x * y j) • w j = x • ∑ j, y j • w j
proof:
:= by
  rw [Finset.smul_sum]
  exact Finset.sum_congr rfl fun j _ => by rw [smul_smul]

name: sum_ite_smul
statement:
private theorem sum_ite_smul (w : Fin r → Point) (i₀ : Fin r) (t : ℚ) :
    ∑ j, (if j = i₀ then t else 0) • w j = t • w i₀
proof:
:= by
  have h : ∀ j : Fin r, (if j = i₀ then t else 0) • w j
      = if j = i₀ then t • w j else 0 := by
    intro j; split_ifs <;> simp
  rw [Finset.sum_congr rfl fun j _ => h j,
    Finset.sum_ite_eq' Finset.univ i₀ (fun j => t • w j)]
  simp

name: barycenter_mem_vrelint
statement:
theorem barycenter_mem_vrelint (hr : 3 ≤ r) (w : Fin r → Point) :
    (∑ j, (r : ℚ)⁻¹ • w j) ∈ vrelint w
proof:
:= by
  have hrpos : (0 : ℚ) < (r : ℚ) := by
    have : 0 < r := by omega
    exact_mod_cast this
  refine ⟨fun _ => (r : ℚ)⁻¹, fun j => by positivity, ?_, rfl⟩
  rw [Finset.sum_const, Finset.card_univ, Fintype.card_fin, nsmul_eq_mul]
  field_simp

name: exit_point
statement:
theorem exit_point (hr : 3 ≤ r) {n : Point} {c : ℚ} {w : Fin r → Point}
    (hpl : OnPlane n c w) (hs : StrictConv n w) {z v : Point}
    (hz : dotQ n z = c) (hfeas : ∀ k, 0 ≤ eta n w k z)
    (hv : v ≠ 0) (hnv : dotQ n v = 0) :
    ∃ (sh : ℚ) (i₀ : Fin r) (s : ℚ), 0 ≤ sh ∧ 0 ≤ s ∧ s ≤ 1 ∧
      ((∀ k, 0 < eta n w k z) → 0 < sh) ∧
      z + sh • v = (1 - s) • w i₀ + s • w (i₀ + 1)
proof:
:= by
  have hSne : (Finset.univ.filter (fun i => etaDir n w i v < 0)).Nonempty := by
    obtain ⟨i, hi⟩ := exists_etaDir_neg hr hpl hs hv hnv
    exact ⟨i, Finset.mem_filter.mpr ⟨Finset.mem_univ i, hi⟩⟩
  set S := Finset.univ.filter (fun i => etaDir n w i v < 0) with hSdef
  set q : Fin r → ℚ := fun i => eta n w i z / (-etaDir n w i v) with hqdef
  set sh := S.inf' hSne q with hshdef
  obtain ⟨i₀, hi₀S, hi₀min⟩ := Finset.exists_mem_eq_inf' hSne q
  have hi₀neg : etaDir n w i₀ v < 0 := (Finset.mem_filter.mp hi₀S).2
  have hshnn : 0 ≤ sh := by
    rw [hshdef]
    apply Finset.le_inf'
    intro i hiS
    have hneg : etaDir n w i v < 0 := (Finset.mem_filter.mp hiS).2
    exact div_nonneg (hfeas i) (by linarith)
  set z' := z + sh • v with hz'def
  have hz'pl : dotQ n z' = c := by
    rw [hz'def, dotQ_add_right, Proof.MeshIntersectRay.dotQ_smul_right, hnv, mul_zero,
      add_zero, hz]
  have hz'feas : ∀ k, 0 ≤ eta n w k z' := by
    intro k
    rw [hz'def, eta_add_smul]
    by_cases hk : etaDir n w k v < 0
    · have hkS : k ∈ S := Finset.mem_filter.mpr ⟨Finset.mem_univ k, hk⟩
      have hle : sh ≤ q k := Finset.inf'_le q hkS
      rw [hqdef] at hle
      rw [le_div_iff₀ (by linarith : (0 : ℚ) < -etaDir n w k v)] at hle
      nlinarith
    · push_neg at hk
      have := hfeas k
      nlinarith [mul_nonneg hshnn hk]
  have hz'zero : eta n w i₀ z' = 0 := by
    rw [hz'def, eta_add_smul]
    have hD' : -etaDir n w i₀ v ≠ 0 := ne_of_gt (by linarith)
    have hq : sh = eta n w i₀ z / (-etaDir n w i₀ v) := hi₀min
    rw [hq]
    field_simp
  obtain ⟨s, hs0, hs1, hz'rep⟩ :=
    feasible_eta_zero_mem_edge hr hpl hs i₀ hz'pl hz'feas hz'zero
  refine ⟨sh, i₀, s, hshnn, hs0, hs1, ?_, by rw [← hz'def, hz'rep]⟩
  intro hstrict
  rw [hshdef]
  rw [Finset.lt_inf'_iff]
  intro i hiS
  have hneg : etaDir n w i v < 0 := (Finset.mem_filter.mp hiS).2
  rw [hqdef]
  exact div_pos (hstrict i) (by linarith)

name: vpoly_eq
proof:
:= by
  apply Set.Subset.antisymm
  · apply convexHull_min
    · rintro x ⟨j, rfl⟩
      exact ⟨hpl j, fun i => convPos_of_strict hs i j⟩
    · intro x hx y hy a b ha hb hab
      refine ⟨?_, fun i => ?_⟩
      · rw [dotQ_affine_comb, hx.1, hy.1, ← add_mul, hab, one_mul]
      · rw [eta_affine_comb n w i hab]
        exact add_nonneg (mul_nonneg ha (hx.2 i)) (mul_nonneg hb (hy.2 i))
  · rintro z ⟨hz, hfeas⟩
    
    have hrpos : (0 : ℚ) < (r : ℚ) := by
      have : 0 < r := by omega
      exact_mod_cast this
    have hbsum1 : ∑ _j : Fin r, (r : ℚ)⁻¹ = 1 := by
      rw [Finset.sum_const, Finset.card_univ, Fintype.card_fin, nsmul_eq_mul]
      field_simp
    set b := ∑ j, (r : ℚ)⁻¹ • w j with hbdef
    have hbplane : dotQ n b = c := by
      rw [hbdef]
      exact dotQ_comb n w hbsum1 hpl
    by_cases hv : z - b = 0
    · have hzb : z = b := sub_eq_zero.mp hv
      rw [hzb, hbdef]
      exact sum_mem_vpoly (fun j => by positivity) hbsum1
    · have hnv : dotQ n (z - b) = 0 := by
        rw [dotQ_sub_right, hz, hbplane, sub_self]
      obtain ⟨sh, i₀, s, hshnn, hs0, hs1, _, hrep⟩ :=
        exit_point hr hpl hs hz hfeas hv hnv
      
      have hb_mem : b ∈ vpoly w := vrelint_subset_vpoly w (hbdef ▸ barycenter_mem_vrelint hr w)
      have hedge_mem : (1 - s) • w i₀ + s • w (i₀ + 1) ∈ vpoly w :=
        (convex_convexHull ℚ _)
          (subset_convexHull ℚ _ (Set.mem_range_self i₀))
          (subset_convexHull ℚ _ (Set.mem_range_self (i₀ + 1)))
          (by linarith) hs0 (by ring)
      have h1sh : (0 : ℚ) < 1 + sh := by linarith
      have hzcomb : z = (sh / (1 + sh)) • b
          + (1 / (1 + sh)) • ((1 - s) • w i₀ + s • w (i₀ + 1)) := by
        rw [← hrep]
        funext k
        simp only [Pi.add_apply, Pi.smul_apply, Pi.sub_apply, smul_eq_mul]
        field_simp
        ring
      rw [hzcomb]
      exact (convex_convexHull ℚ _) hb_mem hedge_mem
        (div_nonneg hshnn h1sh.le) (div_nonneg zero_le_one h1sh.le)
        (by rw [div_add_div_same, add_comm sh 1, div_self (ne_of_gt h1sh)])

name: vrelint_eq
proof:
:= by
  apply Set.Subset.antisymm
  · rintro x ⟨μ, hμpos, hμsum, rfl⟩
    refine ⟨dotQ_comb n w hμsum hpl, fun i => ?_⟩
    rw [eta_comb n w i hμsum]
    calc (0 : ℚ) < μ (i + 1 + 1) * eta n w i (w (i + 1 + 1)) :=
          mul_pos (hμpos _) (hs i _ (fin_add_two_ne hr i) (fin_add_one_ne hr (i + 1)))
      _ ≤ ∑ j, μ j * eta n w i (w j) :=
          Finset.single_le_sum
            (f := fun j => μ j * eta n w i (w j))
            (fun j _ => mul_nonneg (hμpos j).le (convPos_of_strict hs i j))
            (Finset.mem_univ _)
  · rintro z ⟨hz, hstrict⟩
    have hrpos : (0 : ℚ) < (r : ℚ) := by
      have : 0 < r := by omega
      exact_mod_cast this
    have hbsum1 : ∑ _j : Fin r, (r : ℚ)⁻¹ = 1 := by
      rw [Finset.sum_const, Finset.card_univ, Fintype.card_fin, nsmul_eq_mul]
      field_simp
    set b := ∑ j, (r : ℚ)⁻¹ • w j with hbdef
    have hbplane : dotQ n b = c := by
      rw [hbdef]
      exact dotQ_comb n w hbsum1 hpl
    by_cases hv : z - b = 0
    · have hzb : z = b := sub_eq_zero.mp hv
      rw [hzb, hbdef]
      exact barycenter_mem_vrelint hr w
    · have hnv : dotQ n (z - b) = 0 := by
        rw [dotQ_sub_right, hz, hbplane, sub_self]
      obtain ⟨sh, i₀, s, hshnn, hs0, hs1, hshpos', hrep⟩ :=
        exit_point hr hpl hs hz (fun k => (hstrict k).le) hv hnv
      have hshpos : 0 < sh := hshpos' hstrict
      have h1sh : (0 : ℚ) < 1 + sh := by linarith
      
      set μ : Fin r → ℚ := fun j =>
        (sh / (1 + sh)) * (r : ℚ)⁻¹
          + (1 / (1 + sh)) * ((if j = i₀ then 1 - s else 0)
            + (if j = i₀ + 1 then s else 0)) with hμdef
      have hμpos : ∀ j, 0 < μ j := by
        intro j
        rw [hμdef]
        have h1 : 0 < (sh / (1 + sh)) * (r : ℚ)⁻¹ := by positivity
        have h2 : (0 : ℚ) ≤ (if j = i₀ then 1 - s else 0) := by
          split_ifs <;> linarith
        have h3 : (0 : ℚ) ≤ (if j = i₀ + 1 then s else 0) := by
          split_ifs <;> linarith
        have h4 : (0 : ℚ) ≤ 1 / (1 + sh) := by positivity
        nlinarith
      have hμsum : ∑ j, μ j = 1 := by
        rw [hμdef]
        rw [Finset.sum_add_distrib, ← Finset.sum_mul,
          Finset.sum_const, Finset.card_univ, Fintype.card_fin, nsmul_eq_mul,
          ← Finset.mul_sum, Finset.sum_add_distrib,
          Finset.sum_ite_eq' Finset.univ i₀ (fun _ => 1 - s),
          Finset.sum_ite_eq' Finset.univ (i₀ + 1) (fun _ => s)]
        simp only [Finset.mem_univ, if_true]
        field_simp
        ring
      refine ⟨μ, hμpos, hμsum, ?_⟩
      
      have hsplit : ∑ j, μ j • w j
          = (sh / (1 + sh)) • b
            + (1 / (1 + sh)) • ((1 - s) • w i₀ + s • w (i₀ + 1)) := by
        rw [hμdef]
        have hterm : ∀ j : Fin r,
            ((sh / (1 + sh)) * (r : ℚ)⁻¹
              + (1 / (1 + sh)) * ((if j = i₀ then 1 - s else 0)
                + (if j = i₀ + 1 then s else 0))) • w j
            = ((sh / (1 + sh)) * (r : ℚ)⁻¹) • w j
              + ((1 / (1 + sh)) * (if j = i₀ then 1 - s else 0)) • w j
              + ((1 / (1 + sh)) * (if j = i₀ + 1 then s else 0)) • w j := by
          intro j
          rw [mul_add, add_smul, add_smul]
          abel
        rw [Finset.sum_congr rfl fun j _ => hterm j, Finset.sum_add_distrib,
          Finset.sum_add_distrib, sum_scaled_smul w (sh / (1 + sh)) (fun _ => (r : ℚ)⁻¹)]
        have hite1 : ∀ j : Fin r, ((1 / (1 + sh)) * (if j = i₀ then 1 - s else 0)) • w j
            = ((if j = i₀ then (1 / (1 + sh)) * (1 - s) else 0)) • w j := by
          intro j; split_ifs <;> simp
        have hite2 : ∀ j : Fin r, ((1 / (1 + sh)) * (if j = i₀ + 1 then s else 0)) • w j
            = ((if j = i₀ + 1 then (1 / (1 + sh)) * s else 0)) • w j := by
          intro j; split_ifs <;> simp
        rw [Finset.sum_congr rfl fun j _ => hite1 j,
          Finset.sum_congr rfl fun j _ => hite2 j,
          sum_ite_smul w i₀ _, sum_ite_smul w (i₀ + 1) _, ← hbdef]
        rw [smul_add, smul_smul, smul_smul]
        abel
      rw [hsplit, ← hrep]
      funext k
      simp only [Pi.add_apply, Pi.smul_apply, Pi.sub_apply, smul_eq_mul]
      field_simp
      ring

name: vrelint_convex
statement:
theorem vrelint_convex (hr : 3 ≤ r) {n : Point} {c : ℚ} {w : Fin r → Point}
    (hpl : OnPlane n c w) (hs : StrictConv n w) : Convex ℚ (vrelint w)
proof:
:= by
  rw [vrelint_eq hr hpl hs]
  intro x hx y hy a b ha hb hab
  by_cases ha0 : a = 0
  · subst ha0
    have hb1 : b = 1 := by linarith
    subst hb1
    simpa using hy
  have ha' : 0 < a := ha.lt_of_ne (Ne.symm ha0)
  refine ⟨?_, fun i => ?_⟩
  · rw [dotQ_affine_comb, hx.1, hy.1, ← add_mul, hab, one_mul]
  · rw [eta_affine_comb n w i hab]
    exact add_pos_of_pos_of_nonneg (mul_pos ha' (hx.2 i))
      (mul_nonneg hb (hy.2 i).le)

name: vrelint_absorb
proof:
:= by
  rw [vrelint_eq hr hpl hs] at hx ⊢
  rw [vpoly_eq hr hpl hs] at hy
  refine ⟨?_, fun i => ?_⟩
  · rw [dotQ_affine_comb, hx.1, hy.1]
    ring
  · rw [eta_affine_comb n w i (by ring : (1 - θ) + θ = 1)]
    exact add_pos_of_nonneg_of_pos
      (mul_nonneg (by linarith) (hy.2 i)) (mul_pos h0 (hx.2 i))

name: vrelint_mono
proof:
:= by
  rintro x ⟨μ, hμpos, hμsum, rfl⟩
  rw [vrelint_eq hr₂ hpl₂ hs₂]
  have hfj : ∀ j, dotQ n (w₁ j) = c ∧ ∀ i, 0 ≤ eta n w₂ i (w₁ j) := by
    intro j
    have h := hsub j
    rwa [vpoly_eq hr₂ hpl₂ hs₂] at h
  refine ⟨dotQ_comb n w₁ hμsum fun j => (hfj j).1, fun i => ?_⟩
  
  have hex : ∃ j, 0 < eta n w₂ i (w₁ j) := by
    by_contra hcon
    push_neg at hcon
    have hz : ∀ j, eta n w₂ i (w₁ j) = 0 := fun j =>
      le_antisymm (hcon j) ((hfj j).2 i)
    have hseg : ∀ j, ∃ s : ℚ, w₁ j = (1 - s) • w₂ i + s • w₂ (i + 1) := by
      intro j
      obtain ⟨s, _, _, hrep⟩ := feasible_eta_zero_mem_edge hr₂ hpl₂ hs₂ i
        (hfj j).1 (fun k => (hfj j).2 k) (hz j)
      exact ⟨s, hrep⟩
    obtain ⟨sa, ha⟩ := hseg 0
    obtain ⟨sb, hb⟩ := hseg (0 + 1)
    obtain ⟨sc, hc⟩ := hseg (0 + 1 + 1)
    have hstrict := hs₁ 0 (0 + 1 + 1) (fin_add_two_ne hr₁ 0) (fin_add_one_ne hr₁ (0 + 1))
