    have hzero : areaForm n (w₁ 0) (w₁ (0 + 1)) (w₁ (0 + 1 + 1)) = 0 := by
      rw [ha, hb, hc]
      simp only [areaForm, dotQ, crossQ, mkPoint_zero, mkPoint_one, mkPoint_two,
        Pi.sub_apply, Pi.add_apply, Pi.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul]
      ring
    rw [eta, hzero] at hstrict
    exact lt_irrefl 0 hstrict
  obtain ⟨j₀, hj₀⟩ := hex
  have hcomb : eta n w₂ i (∑ j, μ j • w₁ j) = ∑ j, μ j * eta n w₂ i (w₁ j) :=
    areaForm_comb n (w₂ i) (w₂ (i + 1)) hμsum w₁
  rw [hcomb]
  calc (0 : ℚ) < μ j₀ * eta n w₂ i (w₁ j₀) := mul_pos (hμpos _) hj₀
    _ ≤ ∑ j, μ j * eta n w₂ i (w₁ j) :=
        Finset.single_le_sum
          (f := fun j => μ j * eta n w₂ i (w₁ j))
          (fun j _ => mul_nonneg (hμpos j).le ((hfj j).2 i))
          (Finset.mem_univ _)

name: vrelint_disjoint_vpoly
proof:
:= by
  by_contra hne
  obtain ⟨x, hx₁, hx₂⟩ := Set.nonempty_iff_ne_empty.mpr hne
  
  have hx₁' := hx₁
  rw [vrelint_eq hr₁ hpl₁ hs₁] at hx₁'
  obtain ⟨hxpl, hxstrict⟩ := hx₁'
  
  have hb₂ : (∑ j, (r₂ : ℚ)⁻¹ • w₂ j) ∈ vrelint w₂ := barycenter_mem_vrelint hr₂ w₂
  set b₂ := ∑ j, (r₂ : ℚ)⁻¹ • w₂ j with hb₂def
  
  haveI hne₁ : Nonempty (Fin r₁) := ⟨0⟩
  set a : Fin r₁ → ℚ := fun i => eta n w₁ i x with hadef
  set B : Fin r₁ → ℚ := fun i => |eta n w₁ i b₂| with hBdef
  set θ : ℚ := Finset.univ.inf' Finset.univ_nonempty (fun i => a i / (a i + B i + 1))
    with hθdef
  have hθpos : 0 < θ := by
    rw [hθdef, Finset.lt_inf'_iff]
    intro i _
    have ha : 0 < a i := hxstrict i
    have hB : 0 ≤ B i := abs_nonneg _
    positivity
  have hθlt : θ < 1 := by
    have hle : θ ≤ a 0 / (a 0 + B 0 + 1) :=
      Finset.inf'_le _ (Finset.mem_univ 0)
    have ha : 0 < a 0 := hxstrict 0
    have hB : 0 ≤ B 0 := abs_nonneg _
    have : a 0 / (a 0 + B 0 + 1) < 1 := by
      rw [div_lt_one (by linarith)]
      linarith
    linarith
  
  set zθ := (1 - θ) • x + θ • b₂ with hzθdef
  have hz₂ : zθ ∈ vrelint w₂ :=
    vrelint_absorb hr₂ hpl₂ hs₂ hb₂ hx₂ hθpos hθlt.le
  have hz₁ : zθ ∈ vrelint w₁ := by
    rw [vrelint_eq hr₁ hpl₁ hs₁]
    have hb₂pl : dotQ n b₂ = c := by
      have h := hb₂
      rw [vrelint_eq hr₂ hpl₂ hs₂] at h
      exact h.1
    refine ⟨?_, fun i => ?_⟩
    · rw [hzθdef, dotQ_affine_comb, hxpl, hb₂pl]; ring
    · rw [hzθdef, eta_affine_comb n w₁ i (by ring : (1 - θ) + θ = 1)]
      have hle : θ ≤ a i / (a i + B i + 1) := Finset.inf'_le _ (Finset.mem_univ i)
      have ha : 0 < a i := hxstrict i
      have hB : 0 ≤ B i := abs_nonneg _
      have hbound : -(B i) ≤ eta n w₁ i b₂ := neg_abs_le _
      have hkey : θ * (a i + B i + 1) ≤ a i :=
        (le_div_iff₀ (by linarith : (0:ℚ) < a i + B i + 1)).mp hle
      nlinarith
  have : zθ ∈ vrelint w₁ ∩ vrelint w₂ := ⟨hz₁, hz₂⟩
  rw [hdisj] at this
  exact this

name: areaForm_sub_edge
statement:
theorem areaForm_sub_edge (n a b x : Point) (α β : ℚ) :
    areaForm n (a + α • (b - a)) (a + β • (b - a)) x
      = (β - α) * areaForm n a b x
proof:
:= by
  simp only [areaForm, dotQ, crossQ, mkPoint_zero, mkPoint_one, mkPoint_two,
    Pi.sub_apply, Pi.add_apply, Pi.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul]
  ring

name: vpoly_refines
statement:
theorem vpoly_refines {w : Fin r → Point} {u : Fin m → Point}
    (horig : ∀ i, ∃ k, u k = w i)
    (hcomb : ∀ k, ∃ c : Fin r → ℚ, (∀ i, 0 ≤ c i) ∧ (∑ i, c i) = 1 ∧
      u k = ∑ i, c i • w i) :
    vpoly u = vpoly w
proof:
:= by
  apply Set.Subset.antisymm
  · apply convexHull_min
    · rintro x ⟨k, rfl⟩
      obtain ⟨c, hc0, hc1, hrep⟩ := hcomb k
      rw [hrep]
      exact sum_mem_vpoly hc0 hc1
    · exact convex_convexHull ℚ _
  · apply convexHull_min
    · rintro x ⟨i, rfl⟩
      obtain ⟨k, hk⟩ := horig i
      rw [← hk]
      exact subset_convexHull ℚ _ (Set.mem_range_self k)
    · exact convex_convexHull ℚ _

name: vrelint_refines
statement:
theorem vrelint_refines {w : Fin r → Point} {u : Fin m → Point}
    (hinj : Function.Injective w)
    (horig : ∀ i, ∃ k, u k = w i)
    (hcomb : ∀ k, ∃ c : Fin r → ℚ, (∀ i, 0 ≤ c i) ∧ (∑ i, c i) = 1 ∧
      u k = ∑ i, c i • w i) :
    vrelint u = vrelint w
proof:
:= by
  choose g hg using horig
  choose c hc0 hc1 hcrep using hcomb
  have ginj : Function.Injective g := by
    intro i i' h
    apply hinj
    rw [← hg i, ← hg i', h]
  
  
  set C : Fin m → Fin r → ℚ := fun k i =>
    if g i = k then 1 else if ∃ i', g i' = k then 0 else c k i
    with hCdef
  have hC0 : ∀ k i, 0 ≤ C k i := by
    intro k i
    simp only [hCdef]
    split_ifs
    · norm_num
    · norm_num
    · exact hc0 k i
  have hCval : ∀ i₀ i : Fin r, C (g i₀) i = if i = i₀ then 1 else 0 := by
    intro i₀ i
    by_cases hi : i = i₀
    · subst hi
      simp [hCdef]
    · simp only [hCdef]
      rw [if_neg (fun hc => hi (ginj hc)),
        if_pos (⟨i₀, rfl⟩ : ∃ i', g i' = g i₀), if_neg hi]
  have hCout : ∀ k, (¬ ∃ i', g i' = k) → ∀ i, C k i = c k i := by
    intro k hk i
    simp only [hCdef]
    rw [if_neg (fun hc => hk ⟨i, hc⟩), if_neg hk]
  have hC1 : ∀ k, (∑ i, C k i) = 1 := by
    intro k
    by_cases h : ∃ i', g i' = k
    · obtain ⟨i₀, rfl⟩ := h
      rw [Finset.sum_congr rfl fun i _ => hCval i₀ i,
        Finset.sum_ite_eq' Finset.univ i₀ (fun _ => (1 : ℚ))]
      simp
    · rw [Finset.sum_congr rfl fun i _ => hCout k h i]
      exact hc1 k
  have hCrep : ∀ k, u k = ∑ i, C k i • w i := by
    intro k
    by_cases h : ∃ i', g i' = k
    · obtain ⟨i₀, rfl⟩ := h
      rw [Finset.sum_congr rfl fun i _ => by rw [hCval i₀ i],
        sum_ite_smul w i₀ 1, one_smul]
      exact hg i₀
    · rw [Finset.sum_congr rfl fun i _ => by rw [hCout k h i]]
      exact hcrep k
  have hCg : ∀ i, C (g i) i = 1 := by
    intro i
    rw [hCval i i, if_pos rfl]
  apply Set.Subset.antisymm
  · 
    rintro x ⟨μ, hμpos, hμsum, rfl⟩
    refine ⟨fun i => ∑ k, μ k * C k i, fun i => ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
    all_goals dsimp only
    · have h1 : (0 : ℚ) < μ (g i) * C (g i) i := by
        rw [hCg i, mul_one]
        exact hμpos _
      have h2 : μ (g i) * C (g i) i ≤ ∑ k, μ k * C k i :=
        Finset.single_le_sum
          (f := fun k => μ k * C k i)
          (fun k _ => mul_nonneg (hμpos k).le (hC0 k i)) (Finset.mem_univ _)
      linarith
    · rw [Finset.sum_comm]
      have h1 : ∀ k : Fin m, (∑ i, μ k * C k i) = μ k := by
        intro k
        rw [← Finset.mul_sum, hC1 k, mul_one]
      rw [Finset.sum_congr rfl fun k _ => h1 k]
      exact hμsum
    · have h1 : ∀ k : Fin m, μ k • u k = ∑ i, (μ k * C k i) • w i := by
        intro k
        rw [hCrep k, Finset.smul_sum]
        exact Finset.sum_congr rfl fun i _ => smul_smul _ _ _
      rw [Finset.sum_congr rfl fun k _ => h1 k, Finset.sum_comm]
      exact Finset.sum_congr rfl fun i _ => Finset.sum_smul.symm
  · 
    rintro x ⟨lam, hlampos, hlamsum, rfl⟩
    have hrr : 0 < m := Nat.pos_of_ne_zero (NeZero.ne m)
    have hmpos : (0 : ℚ) < (m : ℚ) := by exact_mod_cast hrr
    haveI : Nonempty (Fin r) := ⟨⟨0, Nat.pos_of_ne_zero (NeZero.ne r)⟩⟩
    have hlmin : 0 < Finset.univ.inf' Finset.univ_nonempty lam := by
      rw [Finset.lt_inf'_iff]
      exact fun i _ => hlampos i
    set ε := Finset.univ.inf' Finset.univ_nonempty lam / m with hεdef
    have hε : 0 < ε := div_pos hlmin hmpos
    have hCle : ∀ k i, C k i ≤ 1 := by
      intro k i
      have h1 : C k i ≤ ∑ i', C k i' :=
        Finset.single_le_sum (fun i' _ => hC0 k i') (Finset.mem_univ i)
      rw [hC1 k] at h1
      exact h1
    have hsumm : ∀ i, (∑ k, C k i) ≤ (m : ℚ) := by
      intro i
      have h1 : (∑ k, C k i) ≤ ∑ _k : Fin m, (1 : ℚ) :=
        Finset.sum_le_sum fun k _ => hCle k i
      rwa [Finset.sum_const, Finset.card_univ, Fintype.card_fin, nsmul_eq_mul,
        mul_one] at h1
    have hlam'0 : ∀ i, 0 ≤ lam i - ε * ∑ k, C k i := by
      intro i
      have h2 : ε * (∑ k, C k i) ≤ ε * (m : ℚ) :=
        mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (hsumm i) hε.le
      have h3 : ε * (m : ℚ) = Finset.univ.inf' Finset.univ_nonempty lam := by
        rw [hεdef]
        field_simp
      have h4 : Finset.univ.inf' Finset.univ_nonempty lam ≤ lam i :=
        Finset.inf'_le _ (Finset.mem_univ i)
      linarith
    refine ⟨fun k => ε + ∑ i, (if g i = k then lam i - ε * ∑ k', C k' i else 0),
      fun k => ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
    all_goals dsimp only
    · have hnn : (0 : ℚ) ≤ ∑ i, (if g i = k then lam i - ε * ∑ k', C k' i else 0) :=
        Finset.sum_nonneg fun i _ => by
          split_ifs
          · exact hlam'0 i
          · exact le_refl 0
      linarith
    · rw [Finset.sum_add_distrib, Finset.sum_const, Finset.card_univ,
        Fintype.card_fin, nsmul_eq_mul, Finset.sum_comm]
      have hinner : ∀ i, (∑ k, if g i = k then lam i - ε * ∑ k', C k' i else 0)
          = lam i - ε * ∑ k', C k' i := by
        intro i
        rw [Finset.sum_ite_eq Finset.univ (g i)
          (fun _ => lam i - ε * ∑ k', C k' i)]
        simp
      rw [Finset.sum_congr rfl fun i _ => hinner i, Finset.sum_sub_distrib,
        hlamsum, ← Finset.mul_sum, Finset.sum_comm]
      have hCtot : (∑ k : Fin m, ∑ i, C k i) = (m : ℚ) := by
        rw [Finset.sum_congr rfl fun k _ => hC1 k, Finset.sum_const,
          Finset.card_univ, Fintype.card_fin, nsmul_eq_mul, mul_one]
      rw [hCtot]
      ring
    · 
      have hA : (∑ k : Fin m, ε • u k) = ∑ i, (ε * ∑ k, C k i) • w i := by
        have h1 : ∀ k : Fin m, ε • u k = ∑ i, (ε * C k i) • w i := by
          intro k
          rw [hCrep k, Finset.smul_sum]
          exact Finset.sum_congr rfl fun i _ => smul_smul _ _ _
        rw [Finset.sum_congr rfl fun k _ => h1 k, Finset.sum_comm]
        refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun i _ => ?_
        rw [← Finset.sum_smul, ← Finset.mul_sum]
      have hB : (∑ k : Fin m,
            (∑ i, if g i = k then lam i - ε * ∑ k', C k' i else 0) • u k)
          = ∑ i, (lam i - ε * ∑ k', C k' i) • w i := by
        have h1 : ∀ k : Fin m,
            (∑ i, if g i = k then lam i - ε * ∑ k', C k' i else 0) • u k
            = ∑ i, (if g i = k then lam i - ε * ∑ k', C k' i else 0) • u k := by
          intro k
          exact Finset.sum_smul
        rw [Finset.sum_congr rfl fun k _ => h1 k, Finset.sum_comm]
        refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun i _ => ?_
        have h2 : ∀ k : Fin m,
            (if g i = k then lam i - ε * ∑ k', C k' i else 0) • u k
            = if g i = k then (lam i - ε * ∑ k', C k' i) • u k else 0 := by
          intro k
          split_ifs
          · rfl
          · exact zero_smul _ _
        rw [Finset.sum_congr rfl fun k _ => h2 k,
          Finset.sum_ite_eq Finset.univ (g i)
            (fun k => (lam i - ε * ∑ k', C k' i) • u k)]
        simp only [Finset.mem_univ, if_pos]
        rw [hg i]
      have hgoal : (∑ k : Fin m,
            (ε + ∑ i, if g i = k then lam i - ε * ∑ k', C k' i else 0) • u k)
          = ∑ k : Fin m, (ε • u k
              + (∑ i, if g i = k then lam i - ε * ∑ k', C k' i else 0) • u k) :=
        Finset.sum_congr rfl fun k _ => add_smul _ _ _
      rw [hgoal, Finset.sum_add_distrib, hA, hB, ← Finset.sum_add_distrib]
      refine (Finset.sum_congr rfl fun i _ => ?_).symm
      rw [← add_smul]
      congr 1
      ring

name: exists_candidate_avoiding
statement:
theorem exists_candidate_avoiding {K : ℕ} (bad : Fin K → Set ℚ)
    (hbad : ∀ α, (bad α).Subsingleton) (cand : Fin (K + 1) → ℚ)
    (hcand : Function.Injective cand) :
    ∃ j, ∀ α, cand j ∉ bad α
proof:
:= by
  by_contra hcon
  push_neg at hcon
  choose f hf using hcon
  obtain ⟨j, j', hne, heq⟩ := Fintype.exists_ne_map_eq_of_card_lt f
    (by simp [Fintype.card_fin])
  have h2 : cand j' ∈ bad (f j) := by rw [heq]; exact hf j'
  exact hne (hcand (hbad (f j) (hf j) h2))

name: affine_bad_subsingleton
statement:
theorem affine_bad_subsingleton (P : Prop) (A B : ℚ)
    (h : P → ¬(A = 0 ∧ B = 0)) :
    {x : ℚ | P ∧ A + x * B = 0}.Subsingleton
proof:
:= by
  rintro x ⟨hP, hx⟩ x' ⟨_, hx'⟩
  rcases eq_or_ne B 0 with hB | hB
  · refine absurd ⟨?_, hB⟩ (h hP)
    have hxB : x * B = 0 := mul_eq_zero_of_right x hB
    linarith
  · have hxx : x * B = x' * B := by linarith
    exact mul_right_cancel₀ hB hxx

name: strictConv_injective
statement:
theorem strictConv_injective (hr : 3 ≤ r) {n : Point} {w : Fin r → Point}
    (hs : StrictConv n w) : Function.Injective w
proof:
:= by
  intro i j hij
  by_contra hne
  by_cases hj : j = i + 1
  · exact consec_ne hr hs i (by rw [← hj, hij])
  · have hpos := hs i j (fun h => hne h.symm) hj
    rw [← hij, eta_self] at hpos
    exact lt_irrefl 0 hpos

name: refined_barycenter_mem_vrelint
statement:
theorem refined_barycenter_mem_vrelint (hr : 3 ≤ r) (hm : 3 ≤ m)
    {n : Point} {w : Fin r → Point} {u : Fin m → Point}
    (hs : StrictConv n w)
    (horig : ∀ i, ∃ k, u k = w i)
    (hcomb : ∀ k, ∃ c : Fin r → ℚ, (∀ i, 0 ≤ c i) ∧ (∑ i, c i) = 1 ∧
      u k = ∑ i, c i • w i) :
    (∑ k, (m : ℚ)⁻¹ • u k) ∈ vrelint w
proof:
:= by
  rw [← vrelint_refines (strictConv_injective hr hs) horig hcomb]
  exact barycenter_mem_vrelint hm u

name: fan_triangle_ccw
proof:
:= by
  rw [areaForm_cyclic, areaForm_sub_edge]
  rw [vrelint_eq hr hpl hs] at ha
  exact mul_pos (by linarith) (ha.2 i)

name: stepIndicator_gt
statement:
@[simp] theorem stepIndicator_gt (μ₀ μ : ℚ) (h : μ₀ < μ) :
    stepIndicator μ₀ μ = 0
proof:
:= by
  simp [stepIndicator, not_le.mpr h]

name: stepIndicator_le
statement:
@[simp] theorem stepIndicator_le (μ₀ μ : ℚ) (h : μ ≤ μ₀) :
    stepIndicator μ₀ μ = 1
proof: := by simp [stepIndicator, h]

name: step_telescope
statement:
theorem step_telescope {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι] (S : ι → ℚ × ℤ) :
    stepSum S 1 = ∑ k ∈ Finset.univ.filter (fun k => 1 ≤ (S k).1), (S k).2
proof:
:= by
  classical
  rw [stepSum]
  rw [← Finset.sum_filter_add_sum_filter_not Finset.univ (fun k => 1 ≤ (S k).1)]
  have h1 : ∑ k ∈ Finset.univ.filter (fun k => 1 ≤ (S k).1),
        (S k).2 * stepIndicator (S k).1 1
      = ∑ k ∈ Finset.univ.filter (fun k => 1 ≤ (S k).1), (S k).2 := by
    apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
    intro k hk
    rw [Finset.mem_filter] at hk
    rw [stepIndicator_le _ _ hk.2, mul_one]
  have h2 : ∑ k ∈ Finset.univ.filter (fun k => ¬ 1 ≤ (S k).1),
        (S k).2 * stepIndicator (S k).1 1 = 0 := by
    apply Finset.sum_eq_zero
    intro k hk
    rw [Finset.mem_filter] at hk
    rw [stepIndicator_gt _ _ (not_le.mp hk.2), mul_zero]
  rw [h1, h2, add_zero]

name: stepLeft_sub_stepRight
statement:
theorem stepLeft_sub_stepRight {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι] (S : ι → ℚ × ℤ) (μ₀ : ℚ) :
    stepLeft S μ₀ - stepRight S μ₀
      = ∑ k ∈ Finset.univ.filter (fun k => (S k).1 = μ₀), (S k).2
proof:
:= by
  classical
  rw [stepLeft, stepRight]
  
  rw [eq_comm, ← Finset.sum_filter_add_sum_filter_not
      (Finset.univ.filter (fun k => μ₀ ≤ (S k).1)) (fun k => μ₀ < (S k).1)]
  have hr : (Finset.univ.filter (fun k => μ₀ ≤ (S k).1)).filter (fun k => μ₀ < (S k).1)
      = Finset.univ.filter (fun k => μ₀ < (S k).1) := by
    ext k; simp only [Finset.mem_filter, Finset.mem_univ, true_and]
    exact ⟨fun h => h.2, fun h => ⟨h.le, h⟩⟩
  have hl : (Finset.univ.filter (fun k => μ₀ ≤ (S k).1)).filter
        (fun k => ¬ μ₀ < (S k).1)
      = Finset.univ.filter (fun k => (S k).1 = μ₀) := by
    ext k; simp only [Finset.mem_filter, Finset.mem_univ, true_and, not_lt]
    constructor
    · rintro ⟨hle, hge⟩; exact le_antisymm hge hle
    · rintro h; exact ⟨h.ge, h.le⟩
  rw [hr, hl]; ring

name: dotQ_carrierNormal_smul
statement:
theorem dotQ_carrierNormal_smul (f : Triangle) (Q : Point) (μ : ℚ) :
    dotQ (carrierNormal f) (μ • Q) = μ * dotQ (carrierNormal f) Q
proof:
:=
  dotQ_smul_right μ _ Q

name: face_indicator_radial
statement:
theorem face_indicator_radial (f : Triangle) {Q : Point}
    (hdf : detOrigin f ≠ 0) (hQ : dotQ (carrierNormal f) Q ≠ 0)
    {μ : ℚ} (hμ : 0 < μ) :
    (if (μ • Q) ∈ simplex f then (1 : ℤ) else 0)
      = stepIndicator (faceParam f Q) μ
        * (if faceHit f Q ∈ triangleSet f then 1 else 0)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  
  have hμne : μ ≠ 0 := ne_of_gt hμ
  have hQμ : dotQ (carrierNormal f) (μ • Q) ≠ 0 := by
    rw [dotQ_carrierNormal_smul]
    exact mul_ne_zero hμne hQ
  
  rw [mem_simplex_iff_radial (dotQ_carrierNormal_v₀ f) (dotQ_carrierNormal_v₁ f)
        (dotQ_carrierNormal_v₂ f) hdf hQμ]
  
  have hlam : detOrigin f / dotQ (carrierNormal f) (μ • Q) = faceParam f Q / μ := by
    rw [dotQ_carrierNormal_smul, faceParam, div_div, mul_comm μ]
  
  rw [hlam]
  have hpt : (faceParam f Q / μ) • (μ • Q) = faceHit f Q := by
    rw [faceHit, smul_smul, div_mul_cancel₀]
    exact hμne
  rw [hpt]
  
  
  have hiff : (1 : ℚ) ≤ faceParam f Q / μ ↔ μ ≤ faceParam f Q := by
    rw [le_div_iff₀ hμ, one_mul]
  by_cases hhit : faceHit f Q ∈ triangleSet f
  · rw [if_pos hhit, mul_one, stepIndicator]
    by_cases hstep : μ ≤ faceParam f Q
    · rw [if_pos hstep, if_pos ⟨hiff.mpr hstep, hhit⟩]
    · rw [if_neg hstep, if_neg]
      rintro ⟨hle, _⟩
      exact hstep (hiff.mp hle)
  · rw [if_neg hhit, mul_zero, if_neg]
    rintro ⟨_, hmem⟩
    exact hhit hmem

name: winding_radial_step
statement:
theorem winding_radial_step (M : Mesh) {Q : Point}
    (hM : NoPlaneThroughOrigin M)
    (hQ : ∀ j : Fin M.size, dotQ (carrierNormal M[j]) Q ≠ 0)
    {μ : ℚ} (hμ : 0 < μ) :
    winding (meshChain M) (μ • Q) = stepSum (meshSteps M Q) μ
proof:
:= by
  classical
  rw [winding_meshChain_fin, stepSum]
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro j _
  rw [meshSteps, faceJump]
  
  rw [face_indicator_radial M[j] (hM j) (hQ j) hμ]
  ring

name: stepSum_mul
statement:
theorem stepSum_mul {ι₁ ι₂ : Type*} [Fintype ι₁] [Fintype ι₂]
    (S₁ : ι₁ → ℚ × ℤ) (S₂ : ι₂ → ℚ × ℤ) (μ : ℚ) :
    stepSum S₁ μ * stepSum S₂ μ = stepSum (prodSteps S₁ S₂) μ
proof:
:= by
  classical
  rw [stepSum, stepSum, Finset.sum_mul_sum, stepSum]
  rw [← Finset.sum_product']
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro p _
  rw [prodSteps]
  
  have hind : stepIndicator (S₁ p.1).1 μ * stepIndicator (S₂ p.2).1 μ
      = stepIndicator (min (S₁ p.1).1 (S₂ p.2).1) μ := by
    rw [stepIndicator, stepIndicator, stepIndicator]
    by_cases h1 : μ ≤ (S₁ p.1).1 <;> by_cases h2 : μ ≤ (S₂ p.2).1 <;>
      simp [h1, h2, le_min_iff]
  
  calc (S₁ p.1).2 * stepIndicator (S₁ p.1).1 μ
          * ((S₂ p.2).2 * stepIndicator (S₂ p.2).1 μ)
      = (S₁ p.1).2 * (S₂ p.2).2
          * (stepIndicator (S₁ p.1).1 μ * stepIndicator (S₂ p.2).1 μ) := by ring
    _ = (S₁ p.1).2 * (S₂ p.2).2 * stepIndicator (min (S₁ p.1).1 (S₂ p.2).1) μ := by
          rw [hind]

name: tetraHalves_mem_planes
statement:
theorem tetraHalves_mem_planes {w : Chain} {e : Int × Triangle} (he : e ∈ w.toList)
    (hd : isDegen e.2 = false) {g : Half} (hg : g ∈ tetraHalves e.2) :
    g ∈ planes w
proof:
:= by
  rw [planes, ← Array.foldl_toList]
  have key : ∀ (l : List (Int × Triangle)) (acc : Array Half),
      (g ∈ acc ∨ (e ∈ l ∧ isDegen e.2 = false ∧ g ∈ tetraHalves e.2)) →
      g ∈ l.foldl (fun acc e => if isDegen e.2 then acc else acc ++ tetraHalves e.2) acc := by
    intro l
    induction l with
    | nil =>
      intro acc h
      rcases h with h | ⟨h, _, _⟩
      · exact h
      · simp at h
    | cons hd' tl ih =>
      intro acc h
      simp only [List.foldl_cons]
      apply ih
      rcases h with hacc | ⟨hmem, hdg, hgt⟩
      · left
        by_cases hdh : isDegen hd'.2
        · rw [if_pos hdh]; exact hacc
        · rw [if_neg hdh]; exact Array.mem_append.mpr (Or.inl hacc)
      · rw [List.mem_cons] at hmem
        rcases hmem with rfl | htl
        · left
          rw [if_neg (by simp [hdg])]
          exact Array.mem_append.mpr (Or.inr hgt)
        · right; exact ⟨htl, hdg, hgt⟩
  exact key w.toList #[] (Or.inr ⟨he, hd, hg⟩)

name: feasible_iff_mem_simplex
proof:
:= by
  
  have hAI : AffineIndependent ℚ ![(0 : Point), t.v₀, t.v₁, t.v₂] :=
    (det3_ne_zero_iff_originApex_affineIndependent t).mp hdet
  obtain ⟨b, a₀, hbcoe, hset, _ha₀⟩ := Proof.AffineBasisSimplex.simplexAffineBasis t hAI
  obtain ⟨hfwd, hbwd⟩ := Proof.SimImplWinding.tetra_facet_pos_smul t hAI b hbcoe
  rw [Proof.SimImplCover.feasible_iff,
      Proof.AffineBasisSimplex.simplex_eq_iInter_halfspaces t b hset]
  simp only [Set.mem_iInter, Set.mem_setOf_eq]
  constructor
  · 
    intro h k
    obtain ⟨g, hg, lam, hlampos, hgeq⟩ := hbwd k
    have hge := h g hg
    rw [hgeq] at hge
    
    have hge' : 0 ≤ lam * (b.coord k Q) := hge
    
    exact (mul_nonneg_iff_of_pos_left hlampos).mp hge'
  · 
    intro h g hg
    obtain ⟨k, lam, hlampos, hgeq⟩ := hfwd g hg
    rw [hgeq]
    show 0 ≤ lam * (b.coord k Q)
    exact mul_nonneg (le_of_lt hlampos) (h k)

name: not_mem_simplex_of_off_barrier
proof:
:= by
  intro hmem
  obtain ⟨_, _, _, _, hsub⟩ := degenBarrierNormal_spec hdet
  exact hoff (hsub hmem)

name: windingAt_eq_sum
statement:
theorem windingAt_eq_sum (w : Chain) (Q : Point) :
    windingAt w Q
      = (w.toList.map (fun e => if inSimplexOff e.2 Q then e.1 else 0)).sum
proof:
:= by
  rw [windingAt, ← Array.foldl_toList]
  
  have key : ∀ (l : List (Int × Triangle)) (a : Int),
      l.foldl (fun acc e => if inSimplexOff e.2 Q then acc + e.1 else acc) a
        = a + (l.map (fun e => if inSimplexOff e.2 Q then e.1 else 0)).sum := by
    intro l
    induction l with
    | nil => intro a; simp
    | cons hd tl ih =>
      intro a
      simp only [List.foldl_cons, List.map_cons, List.sum_cons]
      rw [ih]; split_ifs <;> ring
  rw [key, zero_add]

name: inSimplexOff_eq_decide_mem
statement:
theorem inSimplexOff_eq_decide_mem {w : Chain} {Q : Point}
    (hii : ∀ e ∈ w.toList, isDegen e.2 = true → Q ∉ simplex e.2)
    {e : Int × Triangle} (he : e ∈ w.toList) :
    (if inSimplexOff e.2 Q then e.1 else 0)
      = e.1 * (if Q ∈ simplex e.2 then (1 : ℤ) else 0)
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hd : isDegen e.2 = true
  · 
    simp only [inSimplexOff, hd, if_true]
    have hnot : Q ∉ simplex e.2 := hii e he hd
    simp [hnot]
  · 
    rw [Bool.not_eq_true] at hd
    simp only [inSimplexOff, hd, if_false]
    have hdet : det3 e.2.v₀ e.2.v₁ e.2.v₂ ≠ 0 := by
      rw [isDegen, beq_eq_false_iff_ne] at hd; exact hd
    by_cases hmem : Q ∈ simplex e.2
    · have hf : feasible (tetraHalves e.2) Q = true :=
        (feasible_iff_mem_simplex hdet Q).mpr hmem
      rw [hf]; simp [hmem]
    · have hf : feasible (tetraHalves e.2) Q = false := by
        rw [← Bool.not_eq_true]; intro hcontra
        exact hmem ((feasible_iff_mem_simplex hdet Q).mp hcontra)
      rw [hf]; simp [hmem]

name: windingAt_eq_winding_sample
statement:
theorem windingAt_eq_winding_sample {w : Chain} {Q : Point}
    (_hi : ∀ g ∈ planes w, g.eval Q ≠ 0)
    (hii : ∀ e ∈ w.toList, isDegen e.2 = true → Q ∉ simplex e.2) :
    windingAt w Q = winding w Q
proof:
:= by
  rw [windingAt_eq_sum, winding_eq_indicatorSum]
  apply congrArg List.sum
  apply List.map_congr_left
  intro e he
  exact inSimplexOff_eq_decide_mem hii he

name: degenerate_off_barrier
proof:
:= by
  intro e he hd
  have hdet : det3 e.2.v₀ e.2.v₁ e.2.v₂ = 0 := by
    rw [isDegen, beq_iff_eq] at hd; exact hd
  exact not_mem_simplex_of_off_barrier hdet (hbar e he hd)

name: winding_const_on_cell
statement:
theorem winding_const_on_cell {w : Chain} {Q Q' : Point}
    (hiQ : ∀ g ∈ planes w, g.eval Q ≠ 0)
    (hiiQ : ∀ e ∈ w.toList, isDegen e.2 = true → Q ∉ simplex e.2)
    (hiQ' : ∀ g ∈ planes w, g.eval Q' ≠ 0)
    (hiiQ' : ∀ e ∈ w.toList, isDegen e.2 = true → Q' ∉ simplex e.2)
    (hsign : ∀ g ∈ planes w, (0 < g.eval Q ↔ 0 < g.eval Q')) :
    winding w Q = winding w Q'
proof:
:= by
  rw [← windingAt_eq_winding_sample hiQ hiiQ, ← windingAt_eq_winding_sample hiQ' hiiQ']
  rw [windingAt_eq_sum, windingAt_eq_sum]
  apply congrArg List.sum
  apply List.map_congr_left
  intro e he
  
  have hind : inSimplexOff e.2 Q = inSimplexOff e.2 Q' := by
    rw [inSimplexOff, inSimplexOff]
    by_cases hd : isDegen e.2 = true
    · rw [if_pos hd, if_pos hd]
    · rw [Bool.not_eq_true] at hd
      rw [if_neg (by simp [hd]), if_neg (by simp [hd])]
      have hdet : det3 e.2.v₀ e.2.v₁ e.2.v₂ ≠ 0 := by
        rw [isDegen, beq_eq_false_iff_ne] at hd; exact hd
      
      rw [Bool.eq_iff_iff, Proof.SimImplCover.feasible_iff, Proof.SimImplCover.feasible_iff]
      
      have hfacet_in : ∀ g ∈ tetraHalves e.2, g ∈ planes w :=
        fun g hg => tetraHalves_mem_planes he hd hg
      constructor
      · intro h g hg
        have hposQ : 0 < g.eval Q :=
          lt_of_le_of_ne (by simpa [gOf_apply] using h g hg)
            (fun hh => (hiQ g (hfacet_in g hg)) hh.symm)
        have hposQ' : 0 < g.eval Q' := (hsign g (hfacet_in g hg)).mp hposQ
        rw [gOf_apply]; exact le_of_lt hposQ'
      · intro h g hg
        have hposQ' : 0 < g.eval Q' :=
          lt_of_le_of_ne (by simpa [gOf_apply] using h g hg)
            (fun hh => (hiQ' g (hfacet_in g hg)) hh.symm)
        have hposQ : 0 < g.eval Q := (hsign g (hfacet_in g hg)).mpr hposQ'
        rw [gOf_apply]; exact le_of_lt hposQ
  rw [hind]

name: windingAt_eq_winding_sample'
proof:
:= by
  rw [windingAt_eq_sum, winding_eq_indicatorSum]
  apply congrArg List.sum
  apply List.map_congr_left
  intro e he
  exact inSimplexOff_eq_decide_mem hii he

name: winding_const_on_cell_cop
statement:
theorem winding_const_on_cell_cop {w : Chain} {Q Q' : Point}
    {Cop : Int × Triangle → Prop}
    (hiQ  : ∀ g ∈ planes w, (∃ e ∈ w.toList, ¬ Cop e ∧ g ∈ tetraHalves e.2) →
      g.eval Q  ≠ 0)
    (hiQ' : ∀ g ∈ planes w, (∃ e ∈ w.toList, ¬ Cop e ∧ g ∈ tetraHalves e.2) →
      g.eval Q' ≠ 0)
    (hsign : ∀ g ∈ planes w, (∃ e ∈ w.toList, ¬ Cop e ∧ g ∈ tetraHalves e.2) →
      (0 < g.eval Q ↔ 0 < g.eval Q'))
    (hcop : ∀ e ∈ w.toList, Cop e → Q ∉ simplex e.2 ∧ Q' ∉ simplex e.2)
    (hiiQ  : ∀ e ∈ w.toList, isDegen e.2 = true → Q ∉ simplex e.2)
    (hiiQ' : ∀ e ∈ w.toList, isDegen e.2 = true → Q' ∉ simplex e.2) :
    winding w Q = winding w Q'
proof:
:= by
  rw [← windingAt_eq_winding_sample' hiiQ, ← windingAt_eq_winding_sample' hiiQ']
  rw [windingAt_eq_sum, windingAt_eq_sum]
  apply congrArg List.sum
  apply List.map_congr_left
  intro e he
  
  have hind : inSimplexOff e.2 Q = inSimplexOff e.2 Q' := by
    by_cases hCe : Cop e
    · 
      obtain ⟨hQ, hQ'⟩ := hcop e he hCe
      have hfalse : ∀ {R : Point}, R ∉ simplex e.2 → inSimplexOff e.2 R = false := by
        intro R hR
        rw [inSimplexOff]
        by_cases hd : isDegen e.2 = true
        · rw [if_pos hd]
        · rw [Bool.not_eq_true] at hd
          rw [if_neg (by simp [hd])]
          have hdet : det3 e.2.v₀ e.2.v₁ e.2.v₂ ≠ 0 := by
            rw [isDegen, beq_eq_false_iff_ne] at hd; exact hd
          rw [← Bool.not_eq_true]; intro hcontra
          exact hR ((feasible_iff_mem_simplex hdet R).mp hcontra)
      rw [hfalse hQ, hfalse hQ']
    · 
      rw [inSimplexOff, inSimplexOff]
      by_cases hd : isDegen e.2 = true
      · rw [if_pos hd, if_pos hd]
      · rw [Bool.not_eq_true] at hd
        rw [if_neg (by simp [hd]), if_neg (by simp [hd])]
        have hdet : det3 e.2.v₀ e.2.v₁ e.2.v₂ ≠ 0 := by
          rw [isDegen, beq_eq_false_iff_ne] at hd; exact hd
        rw [Bool.eq_iff_iff, Proof.SimImplCover.feasible_iff, Proof.SimImplCover.feasible_iff]
        have hfacet_in : ∀ g ∈ tetraHalves e.2, g ∈ planes w :=
          fun g hg => tetraHalves_mem_planes he hd hg
        have hwit : ∀ g ∈ tetraHalves e.2,
            (∃ e' ∈ w.toList, ¬ Cop e' ∧ g ∈ tetraHalves e'.2) :=
          fun g hg => ⟨e, he, hCe, hg⟩
        constructor
        · intro h g hg
          have hposQ : 0 < g.eval Q :=
            lt_of_le_of_ne (by simpa [gOf_apply] using h g hg)
              (fun hh => (hiQ g (hfacet_in g hg) (hwit g hg)) hh.symm)
          have hposQ' : 0 < g.eval Q' :=
            (hsign g (hfacet_in g hg) (hwit g hg)).mp hposQ
          rw [gOf_apply]; exact le_of_lt hposQ'
        · intro h g hg
          have hposQ' : 0 < g.eval Q' :=
            lt_of_le_of_ne (by simpa [gOf_apply] using h g hg)
              (fun hh => (hiQ' g (hfacet_in g hg) (hwit g hg)) hh.symm)
          have hposQ : 0 < g.eval Q :=
            (hsign g (hfacet_in g hg) (hwit g hg)).mpr hposQ'
          rw [gOf_apply]; exact le_of_lt hposQ
  rw [hind]

name: cell_subset_nondegenerate_simplex
statement:
theorem cell_subset_nondegenerate_simplex {w : Chain} {Q : Point}
    (hi : ∀ g ∈ planes w, g.eval Q ≠ 0)
    (hii : ∀ e ∈ w.toList, isDegen e.2 = true → Q ∉ simplex e.2)
    (hwind : winding w Q ≠ 0) :
    ∃ e0 ∈ w.toList, isDegen e0.2 = false ∧ Q ∈ simplex e0.2 ∧
      ∀ Q' : Point,
        (∀ g ∈ planes w, (0 < g.eval Q ↔ 0 < g.eval Q') ∧ (g.eval Q < 0 ↔ g.eval Q' < 0)) →
        Q' ∈ simplex e0.2
proof:
:= by
  
  have hsum : winding w Q
      = (w.toList.map (fun e => e.1 * (if Q ∈ simplex e.2 then (1 : ℤ) else 0))).sum :=
    winding_eq_indicatorSum w Q
  have hmem_exists : ∃ e ∈ w.toList, Q ∈ simplex e.2 := by
    by_contra hcon
    push_neg at hcon
    apply hwind
    rw [hsum]
    apply List.sum_eq_zero
    intro x hx
    rw [List.mem_map] at hx
    obtain ⟨e, he, rfl⟩ := hx
    rw [if_neg (hcon e he), mul_zero]
  obtain ⟨e0, he0, hQe0⟩ := hmem_exists
  
  have hnd : isDegen e0.2 = false := by
    by_contra hdg
    rw [Bool.not_eq_false] at hdg
    exact hii e0 he0 hdg hQe0
  refine ⟨e0, he0, hnd, hQe0, ?_⟩
  
  intro Q' hcell
  have hdet : det3 e0.2.v₀ e0.2.v₁ e0.2.v₂ ≠ 0 := by
    rw [isDegen, beq_eq_false_iff_ne] at hnd; exact hnd
  
  have hfacet_in : ∀ g ∈ tetraHalves e0.2, g ∈ planes w :=
    fun g hg => tetraHalves_mem_planes he0 hnd hg
  
  rw [← feasible_iff_mem_simplex hdet]
  rw [Proof.SimImplCover.feasible_iff]
  intro g hg
  rw [gOf_apply]
  
  have hgeQ : 0 ≤ g.eval Q := by
    have := (Proof.SimImplCover.feasible_iff (tetraHalves e0.2) Q).mp
      ((feasible_iff_mem_simplex hdet Q).mpr hQe0) g hg
    simpa [gOf_apply] using this
  have hgne : g.eval Q ≠ 0 := hi g (hfacet_in g hg)
  have hgposQ : 0 < g.eval Q := lt_of_le_of_ne hgeQ (fun hh => hgne hh.symm)
  
  have hposQ' : 0 < g.eval Q' := ((hcell g (hfacet_in g hg)).1).mp hgposQ
  exact le_of_lt hposQ'

name: boundary_step
statement:
private theorem boundary_step {out M₁ M₂ Mk : Mesh}
    (hwfout : WellFormedMesh out) (hwf1 : WellFormedMesh M₁) (hwf2 : WellFormedMesh M₂)
    (hwfk : WellFormedMesh Mk) (hMk : Mk = M₁ ∨ Mk = M₂)
    (hagree : ∀ P, P ∉ surface M₁ ∪ surface M₂ →
      (P ∈ solid out ↔ P ∈ solid M₁ ∧ P ∈ solid M₂))
    {Q : Point} (hQk : Q ∈ surface Mk) :
    Q ∉ solid out ∧ Q ∉ solid M₁ ∩ solid M₂
proof:
:= by
  classical
  
  have hQnotMk : Q ∉ solid Mk := surface_disjoint_solid_wf hwfk hQk
  have hRight : Q ∉ solid M₁ ∩ solid M₂ := by
    rcases hMk with h | h
    · subst h; exact fun hmem => hQnotMk hmem.1
    · subst h; exact fun hmem => hQnotMk hmem.2
  refine ⟨?_, hRight⟩
  
  by_cases hQout : Q ∈ surface out
  · exact surface_disjoint_solid_wf hwfout hQout
  · 
    obtain ⟨hcycO, hwzoO, hnsO, hndfO⟩ := hwfout
    obtain ⟨hcyc1, hwzo1, hns1, hndf1⟩ := hwf1
    obtain ⟨hcyc2, hwzo2, hns2, hndf2⟩ := hwf2
    obtain ⟨hcyck, hwzok, hnsk, hndfk⟩ := hwfk
    
    obtain ⟨d₀, hadm0⟩ := Proof.MeshIntersectM2Kit.exists_admissible out Q
    
    obtain ⟨Oo, hnpoO⟩ := Proof.MeshIntersectM2Kit.good_origin_of_nonDegenerate hndfO
    obtain ⟨Ok, hnpok⟩ := Proof.MeshIntersectM2Kit.good_origin_of_nonDegenerate hndfk
    
    
    obtain ⟨hd0ne, hd0edge⟩ := hadm0
    have hQouttri : ∀ u : Fin out.size, Q ∉ triangleSet out[u] :=
      fun u hmem => hQout (Set.mem_iUnion.mpr ⟨u, hmem⟩)
    have hQoutedge : ∀ (u : Fin out.size) (s : ℚ), 0 < s → Q + s • d₀ ∉ edgeSet out[u] :=
      fun u s hs => hd0edge u s hs
    set g : (Fin out.size × Fin 4) → (Point →ᵃ[ℚ] ℚ) :=
      fun uk => (wfam out[uk.1] d₀ Q uk.2).1 with hg
    set s : (Fin out.size × Fin 4) → ℚ :=
      fun uk => (wfam out[uk.1] d₀ Q uk.2).2 with hs
    have hssign : ∀ uk, s uk = 1 ∨ s uk = -1 := fun uk => wfam_sign out[uk.1] d₀ Q uk.2
    have hsstrict : ∀ uk, 0 < s uk * g uk Q :=
      fun uk => wfam_strict (hQouttri uk.1) (hQoutedge uk.1) uk.2
    
    
    
    set N : Set Point :=
      (surface M₁ ∪ surface M₂ ∪ surface out) ∪ {P | ¬ AdmissibleRay out P d₀} with hN
    have hNneg : Negligible N :=
      Proof.Negligible.negligible_union
        (Proof.Negligible.negligible_union
          (Proof.Negligible.negligible_union
            (Proof.SurfaceBoundary.surface_negligible hndf1)
            (Proof.SurfaceBoundary.surface_negligible hndf2))
          (Proof.SurfaceBoundary.surface_negligible hndfO))
        (Proof.SurfaceBridge.negligible_not_admissible hd0ne)
    
    obtain ⟨P, hPstrict, hPN, hPsurfk, hPcountk⟩ :=
      outside_density_in_cell hcyck hnsk hwzok hndfk hnpok hQk hNneg g s hssign hsstrict
    
    simp only [hN, Set.mem_union, Set.mem_setOf_eq, not_or, not_not] at hPN
    obtain ⟨⟨⟨hPnot1, hPnot2⟩, hPnotout⟩, hPadmout⟩ := hPN
    have hPnotU : P ∉ surface M₁ ∪ surface M₂ := by
      simp only [Set.mem_union, not_or]; exact ⟨hPnot1, hPnot2⟩
    
    have hcountout : crossingCount out P d₀ = crossingCount out Q d₀ := by
      rw [Proof.SurfaceBridge.crossingCount_eq_sum, Proof.SurfaceBridge.crossingCount_eq_sum]
      refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun u _ => ?_)
      refine wfam_forces (fun j => ?_)
      have := hPstrict (u, j); simpa [hg, hs] using this
    
    have hPnotMk : P ∉ solid Mk := by
      intro hmem
      obtain ⟨d, hadm⟩ := Proof.MeshIntersectM2Kit.exists_admissible Mk P
      exact (hmem d hadm) (hPcountk d hadm)
    have hPnotInter : P ∉ solid M₁ ∩ solid M₂ := by
      rcases hMk with h | h
      · subst h; exact fun hmem => hPnotMk hmem.1
      · subst h; exact fun hmem => hPnotMk hmem.2
    
    have hPnotSolidOut : P ∉ solid out := by
      intro hmem
      exact hPnotInter (Set.mem_inter_iff P _ _ |>.mpr ((hagree P hPnotU).mp hmem))
    
    have hPcount0 : crossingCount out P d₀ = 0 := by
      by_contra hne
      exact hPnotSolidOut
        ((solid_iff_count_of_offSurface hcycO hnsO hnpoO hPnotout hPadmout).mpr hne)
    
    have hcountQ0 : crossingCount out Q d₀ = 0 := by rw [← hcountout]; exact hPcount0
    intro hmem
    exact (hmem d₀ ⟨hd0ne, hd0edge⟩) hcountQ0

name: mem_solid_out_iff_exact
statement:
theorem mem_solid_out_iff_exact {out M₁ M₂ : Mesh}
    (hwfout : WellFormedMesh out) (hwf1 : WellFormedMesh M₁) (hwf2 : WellFormedMesh M₂)
    (heqoff : solid out \ (surface M₁ ∪ surface M₂)
      = (solid M₁ ∩ solid M₂) \ (surface M₁ ∪ surface M₂)) :
    solid out = solid M₁ ∩ solid M₂
proof:
:= by
  classical
  
  have hagree : ∀ P, P ∉ surface M₁ ∪ surface M₂ →
      (P ∈ solid out ↔ P ∈ solid M₁ ∧ P ∈ solid M₂) := by
    intro P hP
    have hmemdiff : P ∈ solid out \ (surface M₁ ∪ surface M₂)
        ↔ P ∈ (solid M₁ ∩ solid M₂) \ (surface M₁ ∪ surface M₂) := by rw [heqoff]
    simp only [Set.mem_diff, hP, not_false_iff, and_true, Set.mem_inter_iff] at hmemdiff
    exact hmemdiff
  ext Q
  simp only [Set.mem_inter_iff]
  by_cases hQ : Q ∈ surface M₁ ∪ surface M₂
  · 
    rw [Set.mem_union] at hQ
    have hstep : Q ∉ solid out ∧ Q ∉ solid M₁ ∩ solid M₂ := by
      rcases hQ with hQ1 | hQ2
      · exact boundary_step hwfout hwf1 hwf2 hwf1 (Or.inl rfl) hagree hQ1
      · exact boundary_step hwfout hwf1 hwf2 hwf2 (Or.inr rfl) hagree hQ2
    obtain ⟨hL, hR⟩ := hstep
    rw [Set.mem_inter_iff] at hR
    constructor
    · intro hmem; exact absurd hmem hL
    · intro hmem; exact absurd hmem hR
  · 
    exact hagree Q hQ

name: eval_comb
statement:
theorem eval_comb (g : Half) {X Y z : Point} {a b : ℚ} (hab : a + b = 1)
    (hz : a • X + b • Y = z) : g.eval z = a * g.eval X + b * g.eval Y
proof:
:= by
  subst hz
  have ha : a = 1 - b := by linarith
  rw [ha]
  simp only [Half.eval, dotQ, Pi.add_apply, Pi.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul]
  ring

name: mem_triangleSet_iff_slots
statement:
theorem mem_triangleSet_iff_slots {t : Triangle} (hdet : detOrigin t ≠ 0)
    (z : Point) :
    z ∈ triangleSet t
      ↔ (slot t 3).eval z = 0 ∧ ∀ k : Fin 4, 0 ≤ (slot t k).eval z
proof:
:= by
  have hdet3 : det3 t.v₀ t.v₁ t.v₂ ≠ 0 := by
    rw [det3_eq_detOrigin]; exact hdet
  constructor
  · intro hz
    constructor
    · rw [slot3_eval hdet, triangleSet_on_carrier hz]; ring
    · have hsub : triangleSet t ⊆ simplex t := by
        apply convexHull_mono
        intro w hw
        simp only [Set.mem_insert_iff, Set.mem_singleton_iff] at hw ⊢
        tauto
      exact (mem_simplex_iff_slots hdet3 z).mp (hsub hz)
  · rintro ⟨h3, hall⟩
    have hAI := (det3_ne_zero_iff_originApex_affineIndependent t).mp hdet3
    obtain ⟨b, a₀, hbcoe, _, _⟩ := Proof.AffineBasisSimplex.simplexAffineBasis t hAI
    have hb0 : b 0 = (0 : Point) := by rw [hbcoe]; rfl
    have hb1 : b 1 = t.v₀ := by rw [hbcoe]; rfl
    have hb2 : b 2 = t.v₁ := by rw [hbcoe]; rfl
    have hb3 : b 3 = t.v₂ := by rw [hbcoe]; rfl
    
    have hkey : ∀ k : Fin 4, ∃ lam : ℚ, 0 < lam ∧
        ∀ u, (slot t k).eval u = lam * b.coord (slotIdx k) u := by
      intro k
      obtain ⟨lam, hlam, heq⟩ := slot_coord hdet3 b hbcoe k
      exact ⟨lam, hlam, fun u => DFunLike.congr_fun heq u⟩
    choose lam hlam hev using hkey
    have hc0 : b.coord 0 z = 0 := by
      have h := hev 3 z
      rw [show slotIdx 3 = 0 from rfl] at h
      rw [h3] at h
      have := (mul_eq_zero.mp h.symm).resolve_left (ne_of_gt (hlam 3))
      exact this
    have hcnn : ∀ k : Fin 4, 0 ≤ b.coord (slotIdx k) z := by
      intro k
      have h := hev k z
      have hkk := hall k
      rw [h, mul_comm] at hkk
      exact nonneg_of_mul_nonneg_left hkk (hlam k)
    have hc1 : 0 ≤ b.coord 1 z := by
      have := hcnn 0; rwa [show slotIdx 0 = 1 from rfl] at this
    have hc2 : 0 ≤ b.coord 2 z := by
      have := hcnn 1; rwa [show slotIdx 1 = 2 from rfl] at this
    have hc3 : 0 ≤ b.coord 3 z := by
      have := hcnn 2; rwa [show slotIdx 2 = 3 from rfl] at this
    have hsum : b.coord 1 z + b.coord 2 z + b.coord 3 z = 1 := by
      have hs := b.sum_coord_apply_eq_one z
      rw [Fin.sum_univ_four] at hs
      linarith [hc0, hs]
    have hcomb := b.affineCombination_coord_eq_self z
    rw [Finset.affineCombination_eq_linear_combination Finset.univ ⇑b _
      (b.sum_coord_apply_eq_one z), Fin.sum_univ_four] at hcomb
    rw [hb0, smul_zero, zero_add, hb1, hb2, hb3] at hcomb
    exact mem_triangleSet_of_coords hc1 hc2 hc3 hsum hcomb.symm

name: mem_relint_iff_slots
statement:
theorem mem_relint_iff_slots {t : Triangle} (hdet : detOrigin t ≠ 0)
    (z : Point) :
    (z ∈ triangleSet t ∧ z ∉ edgeSet t)
      ↔ ((slot t 3).eval z = 0 ∧ 0 < (slot t 0).eval z ∧
          0 < (slot t 1).eval z ∧ 0 < (slot t 2).eval z)
proof:
:= by
  have hdet3 : det3 t.v₀ t.v₁ t.v₂ ≠ 0 := by
    rw [det3_eq_detOrigin]; exact hdet
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨hzT, hzE⟩
    obtain ⟨h3, hall⟩ := (mem_triangleSet_iff_slots hdet z).mp hzT
    have hAI := (det3_ne_zero_iff_originApex_affineIndependent t).mp hdet3
    obtain ⟨b, a₀, hbcoe, _, _⟩ := Proof.AffineBasisSimplex.simplexAffineBasis t hAI
    have hstrict : ∀ k : Fin 4, k ≠ 3 → (slot t k).eval z ≠ 0 := by
      intro k hk3 hzero
      obtain ⟨lam, hlam, heq⟩ := slot_coord hdet3 b hbcoe k
      have hev : ∀ u, (slot t k).eval u = lam * b.coord (slotIdx k) u :=
        fun u => DFunLike.congr_fun heq u
      have hcz : b.coord (slotIdx k) z = 0 := by
        have h := hev z
        rw [hzero] at h
        exact (mul_eq_zero.mp h.symm).resolve_left (ne_of_gt hlam)
      apply hzE
      apply mem_edgeSet_of_coord_zero b hbcoe hzT
      fin_cases k
      · exact Or.inl hcz
      · exact Or.inr (Or.inl hcz)
      · exact Or.inr (Or.inr hcz)
      · exact absurd rfl hk3
    exact ⟨h3, lt_of_le_of_ne (hall 0) (Ne.symm (hstrict 0 (by decide))),
      lt_of_le_of_ne (hall 1) (Ne.symm (hstrict 1 (by decide))),
      lt_of_le_of_ne (hall 2) (Ne.symm (hstrict 2 (by decide)))⟩
  · rintro ⟨h3, h0, h1, h2⟩
    have hzT : z ∈ triangleSet t := by
      rw [mem_triangleSet_iff_slots hdet]
      refine ⟨h3, fun k => ?_⟩
      fin_cases k
      · exact le_of_lt h0
      · exact le_of_lt h1
      · exact le_of_lt h2
      · exact le_of_eq h3.symm
    refine ⟨hzT, fun hzE => ?_⟩
    
    have hvan : ∀ (k : Fin 4) (m m' : Fin 4), m ≠ slotIdx k → m' ≠ slotIdx k →
        z ∈ segment ℚ (tetraVert t m) (tetraVert t m') →
        (slot t k).eval z = 0 := by
      intro k m m' hm hm' hseg
      obtain ⟨a, b, ha, hb, hab, hz⟩ := hseg
      rw [eval_comb (slot t k) hab hz, slot_eval_vanish hdet hm,
        slot_eval_vanish hdet hm']
      ring
    rcases hzE with (h01 | h12) | h20
    · exact absurd (hvan 2 1 2 (by decide) (by decide) h01) (ne_of_gt h2)
    · exact absurd (hvan 0 2 3 (by decide) (by decide) h12) (ne_of_gt h0)
    · exact absurd (hvan 1 3 1 (by decide) (by decide) h20) (ne_of_gt h1)

name: dotQ_psub_eval
statement:
private theorem dotQ_psub_eval (g : Half) (z₂ z₁ : Point) :
    dotQ g.n (psub z₂ z₁) = g.eval z₂ - g.eval z₁
proof:
:= by
  simp only [Half.eval, dotQ, psub]; ring

name: seg_mem_relint
statement:
theorem seg_mem_relint {t : Triangle} (hdet : detOrigin t ≠ 0)
    {z₁ z₂ : Point} (h₁T : z₁ ∈ triangleSet t) (h₁E : z₁ ∉ edgeSet t)
    (h₂T : z₂ ∈ triangleSet t) (h₂E : z₂ ∉ edgeSet t)
    {τ : ℚ} (h0 : 0 ≤ τ) (h1 : τ ≤ 1) :
    seg z₁ z₂ τ ∈ triangleSet t ∧ seg z₁ z₂ τ ∉ edgeSet t
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨e3, e0, e1, e2⟩ := (mem_relint_iff_slots hdet z₁).mp ⟨h₁T, h₁E⟩
  obtain ⟨f3, f0, f1, f2⟩ := (mem_relint_iff_slots hdet z₂).mp ⟨h₂T, h₂E⟩
  have htr : ∀ g : Half, g.eval (seg z₁ z₂ τ)
      = (1 - τ) * g.eval z₁ + τ * g.eval z₂ := by
    intro g
    rw [eval_seg, dotQ_psub_eval]; ring
  have hpos : ∀ {p q : ℚ}, 0 < p → 0 < q → 0 < (1 - τ) * p + τ * q := by
    intro p q hp hq
    rcases le_or_lt p q with hpq | hpq
    · nlinarith [mul_nonneg h0 (sub_nonneg.mpr hpq)]
    · nlinarith [mul_nonneg (sub_nonneg.mpr h1) (sub_nonneg.mpr (le_of_lt hpq))]
  rw [mem_relint_iff_slots hdet]
  refine ⟨by rw [htr, e3, f3]; ring, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · rw [htr]; exact hpos e0 f0
  · rw [htr]; exact hpos e1 f1
  · rw [htr]; exact hpos e2 f2

name: perp_edges_eq_smul_normal
statement:
theorem perp_edges_eq_smul_normal {t : Triangle} (hdet : detOrigin t ≠ 0)
    {m : Point} (h1 : dotQ m (psub t.v₁ t.v₀) = 0)
    (h2 : dotQ m (psub t.v₂ t.v₀) = 0) :
    ∃ μ : ℚ, m = μ • Proof.MeshIntersectJump.faceNormal t
proof:
:= by
  have hn : Proof.MeshIntersectJump.faceNormal t ≠ 0 :=
    ne_zero_of_dotQ (u := t.v₀) (by rw [faceNormal_offset]; exact hdet)
  have hnn : dotQ (Proof.MeshIntersectJump.faceNormal t) (Proof.MeshIntersectJump.faceNormal t) ≠ 0 := ne_of_gt (dotQ_self_pos hn)
  set μ : ℚ := dotQ (Proof.MeshIntersectJump.faceNormal t) m / dotQ (Proof.MeshIntersectJump.faceNormal t) (Proof.MeshIntersectJump.faceNormal t) with hμ
  have hd : det3 (psub t.v₁ t.v₀) (psub t.v₂ t.v₀) (Proof.MeshIntersectJump.faceNormal t) ≠ 0 := by
    have hl : det3 (psub t.v₁ t.v₀) (psub t.v₂ t.v₀) (Proof.MeshIntersectJump.faceNormal t)
        = dotQ (Proof.MeshIntersectJump.faceNormal t) (Proof.MeshIntersectJump.faceNormal t) := by
      simp only [det3, dotQ, crossQ, psub, Proof.MeshIntersectJump.faceNormal, mkPoint_zero, mkPoint_one,
        mkPoint_two]
      ring
    rw [hl]; exact hnn
  have hw : (fun k => m k - μ * Proof.MeshIntersectJump.faceNormal t k) = (0 : Point) := by
    apply cramer_kernel hd
    · have he : dotQ (psub t.v₁ t.v₀) (Proof.MeshIntersectJump.faceNormal t) = 0 := by
        simp only [dotQ, crossQ, psub, Proof.MeshIntersectJump.faceNormal, mkPoint_zero, mkPoint_one,
          mkPoint_two]
        ring
      have hm1 : dotQ (psub t.v₁ t.v₀) m = 0 := by rw [dotQ_comm]; exact h1
      simp only [dotQ] at he hm1 ⊢
      linear_combination hm1 - μ * he
    · have he : dotQ (psub t.v₂ t.v₀) (Proof.MeshIntersectJump.faceNormal t) = 0 := by
        simp only [dotQ, crossQ, psub, Proof.MeshIntersectJump.faceNormal, mkPoint_zero, mkPoint_one,
          mkPoint_two]
        ring
      have hm2 : dotQ (psub t.v₂ t.v₀) m = 0 := by rw [dotQ_comm]; exact h2
      simp only [dotQ] at he hm2 ⊢
      linear_combination hm2 - μ * he
    · have : dotQ (Proof.MeshIntersectJump.faceNormal t) m - μ * dotQ (Proof.MeshIntersectJump.faceNormal t) (Proof.MeshIntersectJump.faceNormal t) = 0 := by
        rw [hμ]; field_simp
      simp only [dotQ] at this ⊢
      linear_combination this
  refine ⟨μ, funext fun k => ?_⟩
  have := congrFun hw k
  simp only [Pi.zero_apply] at this
  rw [Pi.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul]
  linarith

name: edge_disj_of_dot_zero
statement:
theorem edge_disj_of_dot_zero {t : Triangle} (hdet : detOrigin t ≠ 0)
    {m u : Point} (hm : m ≠ 0) (hmu : dotQ m u = 0)
    (hnu : dotQ (Proof.MeshIntersectJump.faceNormal t) u ≠ 0) :
    dotQ m (psub t.v₁ t.v₀) ≠ 0 ∨ dotQ m (psub t.v₂ t.v₀) ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  by_contra hc
  push_neg at hc
  obtain ⟨μ, hμ⟩ := perp_edges_eq_smul_normal hdet hc.1 hc.2
  rw [hμ, dotQ_smul_left] at hmu
  rcases mul_eq_zero.mp hmu with rfl | h
  · rw [zero_smul] at hμ; exact hm hμ
  · exact hnu h

name: crossQ_zero_of_proportional
statement:
theorem crossQ_zero_of_proportional {u w : Point} (lam : ℚ)
    (h : ∀ k, w k = lam * u k) : crossQ u w = 0
proof:
:= by
  funext k
  rw [Pi.zero_apply]
  fin_cases k
  · show u 1 * w 2 - u 2 * w 1 = 0
    rw [h 1, h 2]; ring
  · show u 2 * w 0 - u 0 * w 2 = 0
    rw [h 0, h 2]; ring
  · show u 0 * w 1 - u 1 * w 0 = 0
    rw [h 0, h 1]; ring

name: pair_locus_nonparallel
statement:
theorem pair_locus_nonparallel {M : Mesh} (hnpo : NoPlaneThroughOrigin M)
    {j : Fin M.size} {g g' : Half} (hg : g ∈ tetraHalves M[j])
    (hg' : g' ∈ tetraHalves M[j]) (hne : g ≠ g') {z : Point}
    (hgz : g.eval z = 0) (hgz' : g'.eval z = 0) : crossQ g.n g'.n ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  intro hu
  have hb := eq_smul_of_crossQ_zero (facet_n_ne_zero (hnpo j) g hg) hu
  set κ : ℚ := dotQ g.n g'.n / dotQ g.n g.n with hκ
  have hap : dotQ g.n z = g.c := by
    simp only [Half.eval] at hgz; linarith
  have hbp : dotQ g'.n z = g'.c := by
    simp only [Half.eval] at hgz'; linarith
  have hκc : g'.c = κ * g.c := by
    rw [← hbp, hb, dotQ_smul_left, hap]
  exact tetraHalves_not_proportional (hnpo j) hg hg' hne κ
    (fun w => by
      simp only [Half.eval]
      rw [hb, dotQ_smul_left, hκc]
      ring)

name: exists_below_pos
statement:
theorem exists_below_pos (L : List ℚ) :
    ∃ β : ℚ, 0 < β ∧ ∀ r ∈ L, 0 < r → β < r
proof:
:= by
  set P : List ℚ := L.filterMap (fun r => if 0 < r then some r else none) with hP
  have hPpos : ∀ r ∈ P, 0 < r := by
    intro r hr
    rw [hP] at hr
    obtain ⟨s, _, hf⟩ := List.mem_filterMap.mp hr
    by_cases h0 : 0 < s
    · simp only [if_pos h0] at hf
      obtain rfl := Option.some.inj hf
      exact h0
    · simp only [if_neg h0] at hf
      exact Option.noConfusion hf
  have hm : 0 < P.foldr min 1 := foldr_min_pos hPpos one_pos
  refine ⟨P.foldr min 1 / 2, by linarith, ?_⟩
  intro r hr hrpos
  have hmem : r ∈ P := by
    rw [hP]
    refine List.mem_filterMap.mpr ⟨r, hr, ?_⟩
    rw [if_pos hrpos]
  have := foldr_min_le hmem 1
  linarith

name: chart_off_face
statement:
theorem chart_off_face (M : Mesh) (hnpo : NoPlaneThroughOrigin M)
    (hns : NoFaceInteriorContact M) {i u : Fin M.size} (hui : u ≠ i)
    (c₀ d₁ d₂ : Point) (K₀ : List (ℚ × ℚ × ℚ))
    (hK₀b : ∀ a b : ℚ, (∀ k ∈ K₀, k.1 * a + k.2.1 * b ≤ k.2.2) → 0 ≤ b)
    (hK₀0 : ∀ a : ℚ, (∀ k ∈ K₀, k.1 * a + k.2.1 * 0 ≤ k.2.2) →
      lineAt c₀ d₁ a ∈ triangleSet M[i] ∧ lineAt c₀ d₁ a ∉ edgeSet M[i]) :
    ∃ ε : ℚ, 0 < ε ∧ ∀ a b : ℚ,
      (∀ k ∈ K₀, k.1 * a + k.2.1 * b ≤ k.2.2) → b ≤ ε →
      lineAt (lineAt c₀ d₁ a) d₂ b ∉ triangleSet M[u]
proof:
:= by
  have hdetu : detOrigin M[u] ≠ 0 := hnpo u
  have htr : ∀ (g : Half) (a b : ℚ),
      g.eval (lineAt (lineAt c₀ d₁ a) d₂ b)
        = g.eval c₀ + a * dotQ g.n d₁ + b * dotQ g.n d₂ := by
    intro g a b
    rw [eval_lineAt, eval_lineAt]
  obtain ⟨ε, hε, hthr⟩ := thresh_strip
    (K₀ ++ ((List.finRange 4).map (fun k =>
        (-(dotQ (slot M[u] k).n d₁), -(dotQ (slot M[u] k).n d₂),
          (slot M[u] k).eval c₀)) ++
      [(dotQ (slot M[u] 3).n d₁, dotQ (slot M[u] 3).n d₂,
        -((slot M[u] 3).eval c₀))]))
    (fun a b h => hK₀b a b (fun k hk => h k (List.mem_append_left _ hk)))
    (by
    intro a h
    obtain ⟨hT, hE⟩ := hK₀0 a (fun k hk => h k (List.mem_append_left _ hk))
    have hmemu : lineAt c₀ d₁ a ∈ triangleSet M[u] := by
      rw [mem_triangleSet_iff_slots hdetu]
      have hm : ∀ k : Fin 4, 0 ≤ (slot M[u] k).eval (lineAt c₀ d₁ a) := by
        intro k
        have hk : -(dotQ (slot M[u] k).n d₁) * a + -(dotQ (slot M[u] k).n d₂) * 0
            ≤ (slot M[u] k).eval c₀ :=
          h _ (List.mem_append_right _ (List.mem_append_left _
            (List.mem_map.mpr ⟨k, List.mem_finRange k, rfl⟩)))
        rw [eval_lineAt]
        linarith
      have h3 : dotQ (slot M[u] 3).n d₁ * a + dotQ (slot M[u] 3).n d₂ * 0
          ≤ -((slot M[u] 3).eval c₀) :=
        h _ (List.mem_append_right _ (List.mem_append_right _
          (List.mem_singleton_self _)))
      refine ⟨?_, hm⟩
      have hm3 := hm 3
      rw [eval_lineAt] at hm3 ⊢
      linarith
    exact relint_clear_of_nsi hns hui hmemu hT hE)
  refine ⟨ε, hε, ?_⟩
  intro a b hK₀sat hb hmem
  apply hthr a b hb
  intro k hk
  rcases List.mem_append.mp hk with hk₀ | hk'
  · exact hK₀sat k hk₀
  rcases List.mem_append.mp hk' with hkm | hks
  · obtain ⟨kf, -, rfl⟩ := List.mem_map.mp hkm
    show -(dotQ (slot M[u] kf).n d₁) * a + -(dotQ (slot M[u] kf).n d₂) * b
        ≤ (slot M[u] kf).eval c₀
    have h0 := ((mem_triangleSet_iff_slots hdetu _).mp hmem).2 kf
    rw [htr] at h0
    linarith
  · rw [List.mem_singleton.mp hks]
    show dotQ (slot M[u] 3).n d₁ * a + dotQ (slot M[u] 3).n d₂ * b
        ≤ -((slot M[u] 3).eval c₀)
    have h3 := ((mem_triangleSet_iff_slots hdetu _).mp hmem).1
    rw [htr] at h3
    linarith

name: chart_off_others
statement:
theorem chart_off_others (M : Mesh) (hnpo : NoPlaneThroughOrigin M)
    (hns : NoFaceInteriorContact M) (i : Fin M.size)
    (c₀ d₁ d₂ : Point) (K₀ : List (ℚ × ℚ × ℚ))
    (hK₀b : ∀ a b : ℚ, (∀ k ∈ K₀, k.1 * a + k.2.1 * b ≤ k.2.2) → 0 ≤ b)
    (hK₀0 : ∀ a : ℚ, (∀ k ∈ K₀, k.1 * a + k.2.1 * 0 ≤ k.2.2) →
      lineAt c₀ d₁ a ∈ triangleSet M[i] ∧ lineAt c₀ d₁ a ∉ edgeSet M[i]) :
    ∃ ε : ℚ, 0 < ε ∧ ∀ u : Fin M.size, u ≠ i → ∀ a b : ℚ,
      (∀ k ∈ K₀, k.1 * a + k.2.1 * b ≤ k.2.2) → b ≤ ε →
      lineAt (lineAt c₀ d₁ a) d₂ b ∉ triangleSet M[u]
proof:
:= by
  suffices h : ∀ us : List (Fin M.size), ∃ ε : ℚ, 0 < ε ∧ ∀ u ∈ us, u ≠ i →
      ∀ a b : ℚ, (∀ k ∈ K₀, k.1 * a + k.2.1 * b ≤ k.2.2) → b ≤ ε →
      lineAt (lineAt c₀ d₁ a) d₂ b ∉ triangleSet M[u] by
    obtain ⟨ε, hε, hall⟩ := h (List.finRange M.size)
    exact ⟨ε, hε, fun u hu => hall u (List.mem_finRange u) hu⟩
  intro us
  induction us with
  | nil => exact ⟨1, one_pos, fun u hu => absurd hu (List.not_mem_nil u)⟩
  | cons u us ih =>
    obtain ⟨ε₂, hε₂, hih⟩ := ih
    by_cases hui : u = i
    · refine ⟨ε₂, hε₂, fun w hw hwi => ?_⟩
      rcases List.mem_cons.mp hw with rfl | hw'
      · exact absurd hui hwi
      · exact hih w hw' hwi
    · obtain ⟨ε₁, hε₁, h₁⟩ := chart_off_face M hnpo hns hui c₀ d₁ d₂ K₀ hK₀b hK₀0
      refine ⟨min ε₁ ε₂, lt_min hε₁ hε₂, fun w hw hwi a b hsat hb => ?_⟩
      rcases List.mem_cons.mp hw with rfl | hw'
      · exact h₁ a b hsat (le_trans hb (min_le_left _ _))
      · exact hih w hw' hwi a b hsat (le_trans hb (min_le_right _ _))

name: chord_thresh
statement:
theorem chord_thresh (M : Mesh) (hnpo : NoPlaneThroughOrigin M)
    (hns : NoFaceInteriorContact M) (i : Fin M.size) {c cs : Point} (v : Point)
    (hcT : c ∈ triangleSet M[i]) (hcE : c ∉ edgeSet M[i])
    (hcsT : cs ∈ triangleSet M[i]) (hcsE : cs ∉ edgeSet M[i]) :
    ∃ ε : ℚ, 0 < ε ∧ ∀ u : Fin M.size, u ≠ i → ∀ a b : ℚ,
      0 ≤ a → a ≤ 1 → 0 ≤ b → b ≤ ε →
      lineAt (lineAt c (psub cs c) a) v b ∉ triangleSet M[u]
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨ε, hε, hall⟩ := chart_off_others M hnpo hns i c (psub cs c) v
    [(-1, 0, 0), (1, 0, 1), (0, -1, 0)]
    (by
      intro a b h
      have h3 : (0 : ℚ) * a + -1 * b ≤ 0 := h (0, -1, 0) (by simp)
      linarith)
    (by
      intro a h
      have h1 : (-1 : ℚ) * a + 0 * 0 ≤ 0 := h (-1, 0, 0) (by simp)
      have h2 : (1 : ℚ) * a + 0 * 0 ≤ 1 := h (1, 0, 1) (by simp)
      have hseg : lineAt c (psub cs c) a = seg c cs a := rfl
      rw [hseg]
      exact seg_mem_relint (hnpo i) hcT hcE hcsT hcsE (by linarith) (by linarith))
  refine ⟨ε, hε, fun u hu a b ha0 ha1 hb0 hbε => hall u hu a b ?_ hbε⟩
  intro k hk
  simp only [List.mem_cons, List.not_mem_nil, or_false] at hk
  rcases hk with rfl | rfl | rfl
  · show (-1 : ℚ) * a + 0 * b ≤ 0
    linarith
  · show (1 : ℚ) * a + 0 * b ≤ 1
    linarith
  · show (0 : ℚ) * a + -1 * b ≤ 0
    linarith

name: normal_thresh
statement:
theorem normal_thresh (M : Mesh) (hnpo : NoPlaneThroughOrigin M)
    (hns : NoFaceInteriorContact M) (i : Fin M.size) {cs : Point} (v nv : Point)
    (hcsT : cs ∈ triangleSet M[i]) (hcsE : cs ∉ edgeSet M[i]) :
    ∃ ε : ℚ, 0 < ε ∧ ∀ u : Fin M.size, u ≠ i → ∀ a b : ℚ,
      0 ≤ a → a ≤ b → b ≤ ε →
      lineAt (lineAt cs (psub v nv) a) nv b ∉ triangleSet M[u]
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨ε, hε, hall⟩ := chart_off_others M hnpo hns i cs (psub v nv) nv
    [(-1, 0, 0), (1, -1, 0)]
    (by
      intro a b h
      have h1 : (-1 : ℚ) * a + 0 * b ≤ 0 := h (-1, 0, 0) (by simp)
      have h2 : (1 : ℚ) * a + -1 * b ≤ 0 := h (1, -1, 0) (by simp)
      linarith)
    (by
      intro a h
      have h1 : (-1 : ℚ) * a + 0 * 0 ≤ 0 := h (-1, 0, 0) (by simp)
      have h2 : (1 : ℚ) * a + -1 * 0 ≤ 0 := h (1, -1, 0) (by simp)
      have ha : a = 0 := le_antisymm (by linarith) (by linarith)
      rw [ha, lineAt_zero]
      exact ⟨hcsT, hcsE⟩)
  refine ⟨ε, hε, fun u hu a b ha0 hab hbε => hall u hu a b ?_ hbε⟩
  intro k hk
  simp only [List.mem_cons, List.not_mem_nil, or_false] at hk
  rcases hk with rfl | rfl
  · show (-1 : ℚ) * a + 0 * b ≤ 0
    linarith
  · show (1 : ℚ) * a + -1 * b ≤ 0
    linarith

name: dotQ_mvec
statement:
theorem dotQ_mvec (g g' : Half) (v u : Point) :
    dotQ (mvec g g' v) u
      = dotQ g'.n u - dotQ g'.n v / dotQ g.n v * dotQ g.n u
proof:
:= by
  simp only [mvec, dotQ]; ring

name: dotQ_psivec
statement:
theorem dotQ_psivec (g g' : Half) (c u : Point) :
    dotQ (psivec g g' c) u
      = g.eval c * dotQ g'.n u - g'.eval c * dotQ g.n u
proof:
:= by
  simp only [psivec, dotQ]; ring

name: dotQ_eq_add_psub
statement:
theorem dotQ_eq_add_psub (m z₁ z₂ : Point) :
    dotQ m z₂ = dotQ m z₁ + dotQ m (psub z₂ z₁)
proof:
:= by
  simp only [dotQ, psub]; ring

name: mem_exF1
statement:
theorem mem_exF1 {M : Mesh} {i : Fin M.size} (j : Fin M.size) (k : Fin 4)
    (hdisj : dotQ (slot M[j] k).n (psub M[i].v₁ M[i].v₀) ≠ 0 ∨
      dotQ (slot M[j] k).n (psub M[i].v₂ M[i].v₀) ≠ 0) :
    ((slot M[j] k).n, (slot M[j] k).c) ∈ exF1 M i
proof:
:= by
  refine List.mem_filterMap.mpr ⟨(j, k),
    List.pair_mem_product.mpr ⟨List.mem_finRange j, List.mem_finRange k⟩, ?_⟩
  rw [if_pos hdisj]

name: mem_exF2
statement:
theorem mem_exF2 {M : Mesh} {i : Fin M.size} {v : Point} (j : Fin M.size)
    (k k' : Fin 4) (hgv : dotQ (slot M[j] k).n v ≠ 0)
    (hdisj : dotQ (mvec (slot M[j] k) (slot M[j] k') v) (psub M[i].v₁ M[i].v₀) ≠ 0 ∨
      dotQ (mvec (slot M[j] k) (slot M[j] k') v) (psub M[i].v₂ M[i].v₀) ≠ 0) :
    (mvec (slot M[j] k) (slot M[j] k') v, moff (slot M[j] k) (slot M[j] k') v)
      ∈ exF2 M i v
proof:
:= by
  refine List.mem_filterMap.mpr ⟨((j, k), k'),
    List.pair_mem_product.mpr ⟨List.pair_mem_product.mpr
      ⟨List.mem_finRange j, List.mem_finRange k⟩, List.mem_finRange k'⟩, ?_⟩
  rw [if_pos ⟨hgv, hdisj⟩]

name: mem_exF3
statement:
theorem mem_exF3 {M : Mesh} {i : Fin M.size} {c : Point} (j : Fin M.size)
    (k k' : Fin 4)
    (hdisj : dotQ (psivec (slot M[j] k) (slot M[j] k') c) (psub M[i].v₁ M[i].v₀) ≠ 0 ∨
      dotQ (psivec (slot M[j] k) (slot M[j] k') c) (psub M[i].v₂ M[i].v₀) ≠ 0) :
    (psivec (slot M[j] k) (slot M[j] k') c,
      dotQ (psivec (slot M[j] k) (slot M[j] k') c) c) ∈ exF3 M i c
proof:
:= by
  refine List.mem_filterMap.mpr ⟨((j, k), k'),
    List.pair_mem_product.mpr ⟨List.pair_mem_product.mpr
      ⟨List.mem_finRange j, List.mem_finRange k⟩, List.mem_finRange k'⟩, ?_⟩
  rw [if_pos hdisj]

name: exF1_disj
statement:
theorem exF1_disj {M : Mesh} {i : Fin M.size} :
    ∀ h ∈ exF1 M i, dotQ h.1 (psub M[i].v₁ M[i].v₀) ≠ 0 ∨
      dotQ h.1 (psub M[i].v₂ M[i].v₀) ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  intro h hm
  obtain ⟨jk, -, hf⟩ := List.mem_filterMap.mp hm
  by_cases hc : dotQ (slot M[jk.1] jk.2).n (psub M[i].v₁ M[i].v₀) ≠ 0 ∨
      dotQ (slot M[jk.1] jk.2).n (psub M[i].v₂ M[i].v₀) ≠ 0
  · rw [if_pos hc] at hf
    obtain rfl := Option.some.inj hf
    exact hc
  · rw [if_neg hc] at hf
    exact Option.noConfusion hf

name: exF2_disj
statement:
theorem exF2_disj {M : Mesh} {i : Fin M.size} {v : Point} :
    ∀ h ∈ exF2 M i v, dotQ h.1 (psub M[i].v₁ M[i].v₀) ≠ 0 ∨
      dotQ h.1 (psub M[i].v₂ M[i].v₀) ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  intro h hm
  obtain ⟨jkk, -, hf⟩ := List.mem_filterMap.mp hm
  by_cases hc : dotQ (slot M[jkk.1.1] jkk.1.2).n v ≠ 0 ∧
      (dotQ (mvec (slot M[jkk.1.1] jkk.1.2) (slot M[jkk.1.1] jkk.2) v)
        (psub M[i].v₁ M[i].v₀) ≠ 0 ∨
       dotQ (mvec (slot M[jkk.1.1] jkk.1.2) (slot M[jkk.1.1] jkk.2) v)
        (psub M[i].v₂ M[i].v₀) ≠ 0)
  · rw [if_pos hc] at hf
    obtain rfl := Option.some.inj hf
    exact hc.2
  · rw [if_neg hc] at hf
    exact Option.noConfusion hf

name: exF3_disj
statement:
theorem exF3_disj {M : Mesh} {i : Fin M.size} {c : Point} :
    ∀ h ∈ exF3 M i c, dotQ h.1 (psub M[i].v₁ M[i].v₀) ≠ 0 ∨
      dotQ h.1 (psub M[i].v₂ M[i].v₀) ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  intro h hm
  obtain ⟨jkk, -, hf⟩ := List.mem_filterMap.mp hm
  by_cases hc : dotQ (psivec (slot M[jkk.1.1] jkk.1.2) (slot M[jkk.1.1] jkk.2) c)
        (psub M[i].v₁ M[i].v₀) ≠ 0 ∨
      dotQ (psivec (slot M[jkk.1.1] jkk.1.2) (slot M[jkk.1.1] jkk.2) c)
        (psub M[i].v₂ M[i].v₀) ≠ 0
  · rw [if_pos hc] at hf
    obtain rfl := Option.some.inj hf
    exact hc
  · rw [if_neg hc] at hf
    exact Option.noConfusion hf

name: mem_rootList
statement:
theorem mem_rootList {M : Mesh} {w v c : Point} (j : Fin M.size) (k k' : Fin 4)
    (hD : chartD (slot M[j] k) (slot M[j] k') w v ≠ 0) :
    chartRoot (slot M[j] k) (slot M[j] k') w v c ∈ rootList M w v c
proof:
:= by
  refine List.mem_filterMap.mpr ⟨((j, k), k'),
    List.pair_mem_product.mpr ⟨List.pair_mem_product.mpr
      ⟨List.mem_finRange j, List.mem_finRange k⟩, List.mem_finRange k'⟩, ?_⟩
  rw [if_pos hD]

name: mem_g1RootList
statement:
theorem mem_g1RootList {M : Mesh} {p d : Point} (j : Fin M.size) (k : Fin 4)
    (hd : dotQ (slot M[j] k).n d ≠ 0) :
    -(slot M[j] k).eval p / dotQ (slot M[j] k).n d ∈ g1RootList M p d
proof:
:= by
  refine List.mem_filterMap.mpr ⟨(j, k),
    List.pair_mem_product.mpr ⟨List.mem_finRange j, List.mem_finRange k⟩, ?_⟩
  rw [if_pos hd]

name: g1_trace_avoid
statement:
theorem g1_trace_avoid (M : Mesh) {p d : Point}
    (hnz : ∀ (j : Fin M.size) (k : Fin 4), dotQ (slot M[j] k).n d = 0 →
      (slot M[j] k).eval p ≠ 0)
    {τ : ℚ} (hτ : ∀ r ∈ g1RootList M p d, τ ≠ r) : G1Clean M (lineAt p d τ)
proof:
:= by
  intro j g hg
  obtain ⟨k, rfl⟩ := mem_tetraHalves_iff.mp hg
  rw [eval_lineAt]
  by_cases hz : dotQ (slot M[j] k).n d = 0
  · rw [hz, mul_zero, add_zero]
    exact hnz j k hz
  · intro hc
    apply hτ _ (mem_g1RootList j k hz)
    rw [eq_div_iff hz]
    linarith

name: leg_chord
statement:
theorem leg_chord (M : Mesh) (hcyc : IsClosedOrientedSurface M) (hnpo : NoPlaneThroughOrigin M)
    {i : Fin M.size} {c cs v : Point} {ρ η β₀ : ℚ}
    (hcT : c ∈ triangleSet M[i]) (hcsT : cs ∈ triangleSet M[i])
    (hσ : dotQ (Proof.MeshIntersectJump.faceNormal M[i]) v ≠ 0)
    (hρ0 : 0 < ρ) (hρβ : ρ ≤ β₀) (hη0 : 0 < η) (hηβ : η ≤ β₀)
    (hthr : ThrChord M i c v cs β₀)
    (hg1ρ : G1Clean M (lineAt c v ρ)) (hg1η : G1Clean M (lineAt cs v η))
    (hfoot : ∀ (j : Fin M.size) (k k' : Fin 4), slot M[j] k ≠ slot M[j] k' →
      ¬ ((slot M[j] k).eval c = 0 ∧ (slot M[j] k').eval c = 0))
    (hX0 : ∀ (j : Fin M.size) (k : Fin 4), dotQ (slot M[j] k).n v = 0 →
      (slot M[j] k).eval c ≠ 0)
    (hX2 : OracleF2 M i v cs) (hX3 : OracleF3 M i c cs)
    (hTL : OracleTL M (psub cs c) v c β₀) :
    winding (meshChain M) (lineAt c v ρ) = winding (meshChain M) (lineAt cs v η)
proof:
:= by
  unfold ThrChord at hthr
  unfold OracleF2 at hX2
  unfold OracleF3 at hX3
  unfold OracleTL at hTL
  set n : Point := Proof.MeshIntersectJump.faceNormal M[i] with hn
  set w : Point := psub cs c with hw
  
  have hseg : ∀ τ : ℚ, seg (lineAt c v ρ) (lineAt cs v η) τ
      = lineAt (lineAt c w τ) v (ρ + τ * (η - ρ)) := by
    intro τ
    funext kk
    simp only [seg, lineAt, hw, psub]
    ring
  
  have hb0 : ∀ τ : ℚ, 0 < τ → τ < 1 → 0 < ρ + τ * (η - ρ) := by
    intro τ h0 h1
    nlinarith [mul_pos h0 hη0, mul_pos (sub_pos.mpr h1) hρ0]
  have hbβ : ∀ τ : ℚ, 0 ≤ τ → τ ≤ 1 → ρ + τ * (η - ρ) ≤ β₀ := by
    intro τ h0 h1
    nlinarith [mul_nonneg h0 (sub_nonneg.mpr hηβ),
      mul_nonneg (sub_nonneg.mpr h1) (sub_nonneg.mpr hρβ)]
  
  have htr : ∀ (g : Half) (a b : ℚ),
      g.eval (lineAt (lineAt c w a) v b)
        = g.eval c + a * dotQ g.n w + b * dotQ g.n v := by
    intro g a b
    rw [eval_lineAt, eval_lineAt]
  
  have hcc : dotQ n c = detOrigin M[i] := triangleSet_on_carrier hcT
  have hcsc : dotQ n cs = detOrigin M[i] := triangleSet_on_carrier hcsT
  have hcw : dotQ n w = 0 := by
    have h := dotQ_eq_add_psub n c cs
    rw [hcc, hcsc, ← hw] at h
    linarith
  apply winding_const_of_avoiding M hcyc hnpo (lineAt c v ρ) (lineAt cs v η)
  · 
    intro j τ h0 h1
    show seg (lineAt c v ρ) (lineAt cs v η) τ ∉ triangleSet M[j]
    rw [hseg τ]
    by_cases hji : j = i
    · subst hji
      intro hmem
      have hcar := triangleSet_on_carrier hmem
      rw [← hn, dotQ_lineAt, dotQ_lineAt, hcc, hcw, mul_zero, add_zero] at hcar
      have hne : (ρ + τ * (η - ρ)) * dotQ n v ≠ 0 :=
        mul_ne_zero (ne_of_gt (hb0 τ h0 h1)) hσ
      apply hne
      linarith
    · exact hthr j hji τ _ (le_of_lt h0) (le_of_lt h1)
        (le_of_lt (hb0 τ h0 h1)) (hbβ τ (le_of_lt h0) (le_of_lt h1))
  · 
    intro j g hg
    exact ⟨hg1ρ j g hg, hg1η j g hg⟩
  · 
    rintro j g hg g' hg' hne τ h0 h1 ⟨hgz, hgz'⟩
    obtain ⟨k, rfl⟩ := mem_tetraHalves_iff.mp hg
    obtain ⟨k', rfl⟩ := mem_tetraHalves_iff.mp hg'
    
    have hcr : crossQ (slot M[j] k).n (slot M[j] k').n ≠ 0 :=
      pair_locus_nonparallel hnpo (slot_mem _ _) (slot_mem _ _) hne hgz hgz'
    
    have hEc : (slot M[j] k).eval c + τ * dotQ (slot M[j] k).n w
        + (ρ + τ * (η - ρ)) * dotQ (slot M[j] k).n v = 0 := by
      rw [← htr (slot M[j] k) τ (ρ + τ * (η - ρ)), ← hseg τ]
      exact hgz
    have hEc' : (slot M[j] k').eval c + τ * dotQ (slot M[j] k').n w
        + (ρ + τ * (η - ρ)) * dotQ (slot M[j] k').n v = 0 := by
      rw [← htr (slot M[j] k') τ (ρ + τ * (η - ρ)), ← hseg τ]
      exact hgz'
    by_cases hD : chartD (slot M[j] k) (slot M[j] k') w v = 0
    · by_cases hgv : dotQ (slot M[j] k).n v = 0
      · by_cases hgw : dotQ (slot M[j] k).n w = 0
        · 
          apply hX0 j k hgv
          rw [hgv, hgw, mul_zero, mul_zero, add_zero, add_zero] at hEc
          exact hEc
        · 
          have hg'v : dotQ (slot M[j] k').n v = 0 := by
            rw [chartD, hgv, mul_zero, sub_zero] at hD
            exact (mul_eq_zero.mp hD).resolve_left hgw
          by_cases hg'w : dotQ (slot M[j] k').n w = 0
          · 
            apply hX0 j k' hg'v
            rw [hg'v, hg'w, mul_zero, mul_zero, add_zero, add_zero] at hEc'
            exact hEc'
          · 
            have hac : (slot M[j] k).eval c + τ * dotQ (slot M[j] k).n w = 0 := by
              rw [hgv, mul_zero] at hEc
              linarith
            have hac' : (slot M[j] k').eval c + τ * dotQ (slot M[j] k').n w = 0 := by
              rw [hg'v, mul_zero] at hEc'
              linarith
            have hψw : dotQ (psivec (slot M[j] k) (slot M[j] k') c) w = 0 := by
              rw [dotQ_psivec]
              linear_combination dotQ (slot M[j] k').n w * hac
                - dotQ (slot M[j] k).n w * hac'
            have hψv : dotQ (psivec (slot M[j] k) (slot M[j] k') c) v = 0 := by
              rw [dotQ_psivec, hgv, hg'v]
              ring
            have hψne : psivec (slot M[j] k) (slot M[j] k') c ≠ 0 := by
              intro hzero
              by_cases hgc : (slot M[j] k).eval c = 0
              · 
                have hg'c : (slot M[j] k').eval c = 0 := by
                  by_contra hg'c
                  apply facet_n_ne_zero (hnpo j) _ (slot_mem M[j] k)
                  funext kk
                  have hcomp := congrFun hzero kk
                  simp only [psivec, Pi.zero_apply, hgc, zero_mul] at hcomp
                  rw [Pi.zero_apply]
                  have hmul : (slot M[j] k').eval c * (slot M[j] k).n kk = 0 := by
                    linarith
                  exact (mul_eq_zero.mp hmul).resolve_left hg'c
                exact hfoot j k k' hne ⟨hgc, hg'c⟩
              · 
                apply hcr
                apply crossQ_zero_of_proportional
                  ((slot M[j] k').eval c / (slot M[j] k).eval c)
                intro kk
                have hcomp := congrFun hzero kk
                simp only [psivec, Pi.zero_apply] at hcomp
                rw [div_mul_eq_mul_div, eq_div_iff hgc]
                linarith
            have hdisj := edge_disj_of_dot_zero (hnpo i) hψne hψv hσ
            apply hX3 j k k' hdisj
            rw [dotQ_eq_add_psub (psivec (slot M[j] k) (slot M[j] k') c) c cs,
              ← hw, hψw, add_zero]
      · 
        have hlv : dotQ (slot M[j] k').n v / dotQ (slot M[j] k).n v
            * dotQ (slot M[j] k).n v = dotQ (slot M[j] k').n v :=
          div_mul_cancel₀ _ hgv
        have hlw : dotQ (slot M[j] k').n v / dotQ (slot M[j] k).n v
            * dotQ (slot M[j] k).n w = dotQ (slot M[j] k').n w := by
          rw [div_mul_eq_mul_div, div_eq_iff hgv]
          rw [chartD] at hD
          linear_combination hD
        have hmv : dotQ (mvec (slot M[j] k) (slot M[j] k') v) v = 0 := by
          rw [dotQ_mvec, hlv, sub_self]
        have hmw : dotQ (mvec (slot M[j] k) (slot M[j] k') v) w = 0 := by
          rw [dotQ_mvec, hlw, sub_self]
        have hmne : mvec (slot M[j] k) (slot M[j] k') v ≠ 0 := by
          intro hzero
          apply hcr
          apply crossQ_zero_of_proportional
            (dotQ (slot M[j] k').n v / dotQ (slot M[j] k).n v)
          intro kk
          have hcomp := congrFun hzero kk
          simp only [mvec, Pi.zero_apply] at hcomp
          linarith
        have hdisj := edge_disj_of_dot_zero (hnpo i) hmne hmv hσ
        apply hX2 j k k' hgv hdisj
        have hmc : dotQ (mvec (slot M[j] k) (slot M[j] k') v) c
            = moff (slot M[j] k) (slot M[j] k') v := by
          rw [dotQ_mvec, moff]
          simp only [Half.eval] at hEc hEc'
          linear_combination hEc' - (dotQ (slot M[j] k').n v / dotQ (slot M[j] k).n v) * hEc
            + τ * hlw + (ρ + τ * (η - ρ)) * hlv
        rw [dotQ_eq_add_psub (mvec (slot M[j] k) (slot M[j] k') v) c cs,
          ← hw, hmw, add_zero, hmc]
    · 
      have hroot : ρ + τ * (η - ρ)
          = chartRoot (slot M[j] k) (slot M[j] k') w v c := by
        rw [chartRoot, eq_div_iff hD, chartD]
        linear_combination dotQ (slot M[j] k).n w * hEc'
          - dotQ (slot M[j] k').n w * hEc
      have hRpos : 0 < chartRoot (slot M[j] k) (slot M[j] k') w v c :=
        hroot ▸ hb0 τ h0 h1
      have hgt := hTL j k k' hD hRpos
      have hble := hbβ τ (le_of_lt h0) (le_of_lt h1)
      rw [hroot] at hble
      linarith

name: leg_normal
statement:
theorem leg_normal (M : Mesh) (hcyc : IsClosedOrientedSurface M) (hnpo : NoPlaneThroughOrigin M)
    {i : Fin M.size} {cs v nv : Point} {ν η θ β₀ : ℚ}
    (hcsT : cs ∈ triangleSet M[i])
    (hnv : nv = fun kk => ν * Proof.MeshIntersectJump.faceNormal M[i] kk)
    (hν2 : ν * ν = 1)
    (hσν : 0 < ν * dotQ (Proof.MeshIntersectJump.faceNormal M[i]) v)
    (hη0 : 0 < η) (hηβ : η ≤ β₀) (hθ0 : 0 < θ) (hθβ : θ ≤ β₀)
    (hthr : ThrNormal M i v nv cs β₀)
    (hg1η : G1Clean M (lineAt cs v η)) (hg1θ : G1Clean M (lineAt cs nv θ))
    (hXF1 : OracleF1 M i cs) (hX2 : OracleF2 M i v cs)
    (hTL3 : OracleTL M nv v cs β₀) (hTLb : OracleTLb M nv cs β₀) :
    winding (meshChain M) (lineAt cs v η)
      = winding (meshChain M) (lineAt cs nv θ)
proof:
:= by
  unfold ThrNormal at hthr
  unfold OracleF1 at hXF1
  unfold OracleF2 at hX2
  unfold OracleTL at hTL3
  unfold OracleTLb at hTLb
  set n : Point := Proof.MeshIntersectJump.faceNormal M[i] with hn
  have hν0 : ν ≠ 0 := by
    intro h
    rw [h, zero_mul] at hν2
    norm_num at hν2
  have hσ : dotQ n v ≠ 0 := by
    intro h
    rw [h, mul_zero] at hσν
    exact lt_irrefl 0 hσν
  have hnne : n ≠ 0 :=
    ne_zero_of_dotQ (u := M[i].v₀) (by rw [hn, faceNormal_offset]; exact hnpo i)
  have hnn : 0 < dotQ n n := dotQ_self_pos hnne
  have hgnv : ∀ m : Point, dotQ m nv = ν * dotQ m n := by
    intro m
    rw [hnv]
    simp only [dotQ]
    ring
  
  have hseg : ∀ τ : ℚ, seg (lineAt cs v η) (lineAt cs nv θ) τ
      = lineAt (lineAt cs (psub v nv) ((1 - τ) * η)) nv ((1 - τ) * η + τ * θ) := by
    intro τ
    funext kk
    simp only [seg, lineAt, psub]
    ring
  have hseg2 : ∀ τ : ℚ, seg (lineAt cs v η) (lineAt cs nv θ) τ
      = lineAt (lineAt cs v ((1 - τ) * η)) nv (τ * θ) := by
    intro τ
    funext kk
    simp only [seg, lineAt]
    ring
  have htr : ∀ (g : Half) (a b : ℚ),
      g.eval (lineAt (lineAt cs v a) nv b)
        = g.eval cs + a * dotQ g.n v + b * dotQ g.n nv := by
    intro g a b
    rw [eval_lineAt, eval_lineAt]
  have hcsc : dotQ n cs = detOrigin M[i] := triangleSet_on_carrier hcsT
  apply winding_const_of_avoiding M hcyc hnpo (lineAt cs v η) (lineAt cs nv θ)
  · 
    intro j τ h0 h1
    show seg (lineAt cs v η) (lineAt cs nv θ) τ ∉ triangleSet M[j]
    by_cases hji : j = i
    · subst hji
      rw [hseg2 τ]
      intro hmem
      have hcar := triangleSet_on_carrier hmem
      rw [← hn, dotQ_lineAt, dotQ_lineAt, hcsc, hgnv n] at hcar
      have hzero : (1 - τ) * η * dotQ n v + τ * θ * (ν * dotQ n n) = 0 := by
        linarith
      have hcontra : 0 < ν * ((1 - τ) * η * dotQ n v + τ * θ * (ν * dotQ n n)) := by
        have e1 : 0 < (1 - τ) * η * (ν * dotQ n v) :=
          mul_pos (mul_pos (by linarith) hη0) hσν
        have e2 : 0 < τ * θ * dotQ n n := mul_pos (mul_pos h0 hθ0) hnn
        have heq : ν * ((1 - τ) * η * dotQ n v + τ * θ * (ν * dotQ n n))
            = (1 - τ) * η * (ν * dotQ n v) + τ * θ * dotQ n n := by
          linear_combination (τ * θ * dotQ n n) * hν2
        rw [heq]
        linarith
      rw [hzero, mul_zero] at hcontra
      exact lt_irrefl 0 hcontra
    · rw [hseg τ]
      have hb1 : (0:ℚ) ≤ (1 - τ) * η := mul_nonneg (by linarith) (le_of_lt hη0)
      have hb2 : (1 - τ) * η ≤ (1 - τ) * η + τ * θ := by
        nlinarith [mul_nonneg (le_of_lt h0) (le_of_lt hθ0)]
      have hb3 : (1 - τ) * η + τ * θ ≤ β₀ := by
        have e1 : (0:ℚ) ≤ (1 - τ) * (β₀ - η) :=
          mul_nonneg (by linarith) (by linarith)
        have e2 : (0:ℚ) ≤ τ * (β₀ - θ) := mul_nonneg (le_of_lt h0) (by linarith)
        nlinarith [e1, e2]
      exact hthr j hji ((1 - τ) * η) ((1 - τ) * η + τ * θ) hb1 hb2 hb3
  · 
    intro j g hg
    exact ⟨hg1η j g hg, hg1θ j g hg⟩
  · 
    rintro j g hg g' hg' hne τ h0 h1 ⟨hgz, hgz'⟩
    obtain ⟨k, rfl⟩ := mem_tetraHalves_iff.mp hg
    obtain ⟨k', rfl⟩ := mem_tetraHalves_iff.mp hg'
    have hcr : crossQ (slot M[j] k).n (slot M[j] k').n ≠ 0 :=
      pair_locus_nonparallel hnpo (slot_mem _ _) (slot_mem _ _) hne hgz hgz'
    have hEc : (slot M[j] k).eval cs + (1 - τ) * η * dotQ (slot M[j] k).n v
        + τ * θ * dotQ (slot M[j] k).n nv = 0 := by
      rw [← htr (slot M[j] k) ((1 - τ) * η) (τ * θ), ← hseg2 τ]
      exact hgz
    have hEc' : (slot M[j] k').eval cs + (1 - τ) * η * dotQ (slot M[j] k').n v
        + τ * θ * dotQ (slot M[j] k').n nv = 0 := by
      rw [← htr (slot M[j] k') ((1 - τ) * η) (τ * θ), ← hseg2 τ]
      exact hgz'
    have hb'0 : 0 < (1 - τ) * η := mul_pos (by linarith) hη0
    have hb''0 : 0 < τ * θ := mul_pos h0 hθ0
    
    have hsingle : ∀ (kk : Fin 4),
        dotQ (slot M[j] kk).n v = 0 →
        (slot M[j] kk).eval cs + τ * θ * dotQ (slot M[j] kk).n nv = 0 → False := by
      intro kk hv0 hE
      by_cases hgn : dotQ (slot M[j] kk).n nv = 0
      · 
        have hgnn : dotQ (slot M[j] kk).n n = 0 := by
          have h := hgnv (slot M[j] kk).n
          rw [hgn] at h
          exact (mul_eq_zero.mp h.symm).resolve_left hν0
        have hdisj := edge_disj_of_dot_zero (hnpo i)
          (facet_n_ne_zero (hnpo j) _ (slot_mem M[j] kk)) hgnn (ne_of_gt hnn)
        apply hXF1 j kk hdisj
        rw [hgn, mul_zero, add_zero] at hE
        exact hE
      · 
        have hroot : τ * θ = -(slot M[j] kk).eval cs / dotQ (slot M[j] kk).n nv := by
          rw [eq_div_iff hgn]
          linarith
        have hRpos : 0 < -(slot M[j] kk).eval cs / dotQ (slot M[j] kk).n nv :=
          hroot ▸ hb''0
        have hgt := hTLb j kk hgn hRpos
        have hle : τ * θ ≤ β₀ := by
          nlinarith [mul_nonneg (sub_nonneg.mpr (le_of_lt h1)) (le_of_lt hθ0)]
        rw [hroot] at hle
        linarith
    by_cases hgv : dotQ (slot M[j] k).n v = 0
    · exact hsingle k hgv (by rw [hgv, mul_zero] at hEc; linarith)
    · by_cases hg'v : dotQ (slot M[j] k').n v = 0
      · exact hsingle k' hg'v (by rw [hg'v, mul_zero] at hEc'; linarith)
      · by_cases hD : chartD (slot M[j] k) (slot M[j] k') nv v = 0
        · 
          have hlv : dotQ (slot M[j] k').n v / dotQ (slot M[j] k).n v
              * dotQ (slot M[j] k).n v = dotQ (slot M[j] k').n v :=
            div_mul_cancel₀ _ hgv
          have hln : dotQ (slot M[j] k').n v / dotQ (slot M[j] k).n v
              * dotQ (slot M[j] k).n nv = dotQ (slot M[j] k').n nv := by
            rw [div_mul_eq_mul_div, div_eq_iff hgv]
            rw [chartD] at hD
            linear_combination hD
          have hmv : dotQ (mvec (slot M[j] k) (slot M[j] k') v) v = 0 := by
            rw [dotQ_mvec, hlv, sub_self]
          have hmn : dotQ (mvec (slot M[j] k) (slot M[j] k') v) nv = 0 := by
            rw [dotQ_mvec, hln, sub_self]
          have hmne : mvec (slot M[j] k) (slot M[j] k') v ≠ 0 := by
            intro hzero
            apply hcr
            apply crossQ_zero_of_proportional
              (dotQ (slot M[j] k').n v / dotQ (slot M[j] k).n v)
            intro kk
            have hcomp := congrFun hzero kk
            simp only [mvec, Pi.zero_apply] at hcomp
            linarith
          have hdisj := edge_disj_of_dot_zero (hnpo i) hmne hmv hσ
          apply hX2 j k k' hgv hdisj
          rw [dotQ_mvec, moff]
          simp only [Half.eval] at hEc hEc'
          linear_combination hEc'
            - (dotQ (slot M[j] k').n v / dotQ (slot M[j] k).n v) * hEc
            + ((1 - τ) * η) * hlv + (τ * θ) * hln
        · 
          have hroot : (1 - τ) * η
              = chartRoot (slot M[j] k) (slot M[j] k') nv v cs := by
            rw [chartRoot, eq_div_iff hD, chartD]
            linear_combination dotQ (slot M[j] k).n nv * hEc'
              - dotQ (slot M[j] k').n nv * hEc
          have hRpos : 0 < chartRoot (slot M[j] k) (slot M[j] k') nv v cs := by
            rw [← hroot]
            exact hb'0
          have hgt := hTL3 j k k' hD hRpos
          have hle : (1 - τ) * η ≤ β₀ := by
            nlinarith [mul_nonneg (le_of_lt h0) (le_of_lt hη0)]
          rw [hroot] at hle
          linarith

name: psub_ne_zero_of_ne
statement: private theorem psub_ne_zero_of_ne {a b : Point} (h : a ≠ b) : psub a b ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  intro hc
  apply h
  funext k
  have := congrFun hc k
  simp only [psub, Pi.zero_apply] at this
  linarith

name: crossQ_pickVec_ne
statement:
private theorem crossQ_pickVec_ne {u : Point} (hu : u ≠ 0) :
    crossQ u (pickVec u) ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  unfold pickVec
  split_ifs with h0
  · 
    have hk : u 1 ≠ 0 ∨ u 2 ≠ 0 := by
      by_contra hc
      push_neg at hc
      exact hu (funext fun k => by fin_cases k <;> simp [h0, hc.1, hc.2])
    intro hc
    rcases hk with h | h
    · apply h
      have := congrFun hc 2
      simp only [crossQ, mkPoint_two, mkPoint_zero, mkPoint_one, Pi.zero_apply] at this
      linarith
    · apply h
      have := congrFun hc 1
      simp only [crossQ, mkPoint_two, mkPoint_zero, mkPoint_one, Pi.zero_apply] at this
      linarith
  · 
    intro hc
    apply h0
    have := congrFun hc 2
    simp only [crossQ, mkPoint_two, mkPoint_zero, mkPoint_one, Pi.zero_apply] at this
    linarith

name: edgePsi_ne_zero
statement:
private theorem edgePsi_ne_zero {Q a b : Point} (haQ : psub a Q ≠ 0) :
    edgePsi Q a b ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  unfold edgePsi
  split_ifs with hdep
  · exact crossQ_pickVec_ne haQ
  · exact hdep

name: edge_miss
proof:
:= by
  intro hmem
  obtain ⟨ta, tb, hta, htb, htab, hsum⟩ := hmem
  
  have htd : ∀ k : Fin 3, t * d k = ta * (psub a Q) k + tb * (psub b Q) k := by
    intro k
    have hk := congrFun hsum k
    simp only [Pi.add_apply, Pi.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul, lineAt] at hk
    simp only [psub]
    linear_combination Q k * htab - hk
  apply hψ
  unfold edgePsi
  split_ifs with hdep
  · 
    have hb := eq_smul_of_crossQ_zero haQ hdep
    set κ : ℚ := dotQ (psub a Q) (psub b Q) / dotQ (psub a Q) (psub a Q) with hκ
    
    have htd' : ∀ k : Fin 3, t * d k = (ta + tb * κ) * (psub a Q) k := by
      intro k
      have h1 := htd k
      have h2 := congrFun hb k
      simp only [Pi.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul] at h2
      rw [h2] at h1
      linarith
    have hkey : dotQ (crossQ (psub a Q) (pickVec (psub a Q))) d * t
        = (ta + tb * κ) * dotQ (crossQ (psub a Q) (pickVec (psub a Q))) (psub a Q) := by
      simp only [dotQ]
      linear_combination
        crossQ (psub a Q) (pickVec (psub a Q)) 0 * htd' 0
        + crossQ (psub a Q) (pickVec (psub a Q)) 1 * htd' 1
        + crossQ (psub a Q) (pickVec (psub a Q)) 2 * htd' 2
    rw [dotQ_crossQ_self_left, mul_zero] at hkey
    exact (mul_eq_zero.mp hkey).resolve_right ht
  · 
    have hkey : dotQ (crossQ (psub a Q) (psub b Q)) d * t
        = ta * dotQ (crossQ (psub a Q) (psub b Q)) (psub a Q)
          + tb * dotQ (crossQ (psub a Q) (psub b Q)) (psub b Q) := by
      simp only [dotQ]
      linear_combination
        crossQ (psub a Q) (psub b Q) 0 * htd 0
        + crossQ (psub a Q) (psub b Q) 1 * htd 1
        + crossQ (psub a Q) (psub b Q) 2 * htd 2
    rw [dotQ_crossQ_self_left, dotQ_crossQ_self_right, mul_zero, mul_zero,
      add_zero] at hkey
    exact (mul_eq_zero.mp hkey).resolve_right ht

name: dotQ_pairPsi
proof:
:= by
  simp only [pairPsi, dotQ]
  ring

name: pairPsi_ne_zero
statement:
private theorem pairPsi_ne_zero {t : Triangle} (hdet : detOrigin t ≠ 0)
    {g g' : Half} (hg : g ∈ tetraHalves t) (hg' : g' ∈ tetraHalves t)
    (hne : g ≠ g') {Q : Point} (hQg : g.eval Q ≠ 0)
    (hψ : pairPsi Q g g' = 0) : False
proof:
:= by
  
  set κ : ℚ := g'.eval Q / g.eval Q with hκ
  have hκn : ∀ m : Fin 3, g'.n m = κ * g.n m := by
    intro m
    have := congrFun hψ m
    simp only [pairPsi, Pi.zero_apply] at this
    rw [hκ, div_mul_eq_mul_div, eq_div_iff hQg]
    linarith
  
  have hκc : g'.c = κ * g.c := by
    have hQ' : g'.eval Q = κ * g.eval Q := by
      rw [hκ, div_mul_cancel₀ _ hQg]
    simp only [Half.eval, dotQ] at hQ'
    rw [hκn 0, hκn 1, hκn 2] at hQ'
    linarith
  refine tetraHalves_not_proportional hdet hg hg' hne κ (fun z => ?_)
  simp only [Half.eval, dotQ, hκn 0, hκn 1, hκn 2, hκc]
  ring

name: pairPsi_sep
statement:
private theorem pairPsi_sep {Q d : Point} {g g' : Half}
    (hψ : dotQ (pairPsi Q g g') d ≠ 0) (t : ℚ)
    (hgz : g.eval (lineAt Q d t) = 0) (hgz' : g'.eval (lineAt Q d t) = 0) :
    False
proof:
:= by
  rw [eval_lineAt] at hgz hgz'
  apply hψ
  rw [dotQ_pairPsi]
  linear_combination dotQ g'.n d * hgz - dotQ g.n d * hgz'

name: vertex_mem_triangleSet
statement:
private theorem vertex_mem_triangleSet (t : Triangle) :
    t.v₀ ∈ triangleSet t ∧ t.v₁ ∈ triangleSet t ∧ t.v₂ ∈ triangleSet t
proof:
:=
  ⟨subset_convexHull ℚ _ (by simp), subset_convexHull ℚ _ (by simp),
   subset_convexHull ℚ _ (by simp)⟩

name: winding_eq_germ_or_zero
statement:
theorem winding_eq_germ_or_zero (M : Mesh) (hcyc : IsClosedOrientedSurface M)
    (hnpo : NoPlaneThroughOrigin M) (hns : NoFaceInteriorContact M)
    (Q : Point) (hQ : G1Clean M Q) :
    winding (meshChain M) Q = 0 ∨
      ∃ (i : Fin M.size) (s : ℤ), (s = 1 ∨ s = -1) ∧
        winding (meshChain M) Q = germValue M i s
proof:
:= by
  
  
  set ΨN : List Point := (List.finRange M.size).map (fun u => Proof.MeshIntersectJump.faceNormal M[u])
    with hΨN
