  set ΨA : List Point := ((List.finRange M.size).product (List.finRange 4)).map
    (fun jk => (slot M[jk.1] jk.2).n) with hΨA
  set ΨE : List Point := (List.finRange M.size).flatMap
    (fun j => (faceEdges M[j]).map (fun e => edgePsi Q e.1 e.2)) with hΨE
  set ΨP : List Point := (((List.finRange M.size).product (List.finRange 4)).product
      (List.finRange 4)).filterMap (fun jkk =>
    if jkk.1.2 = jkk.2 then none
    else some (pairPsi Q (slot M[jkk.1.1] jkk.1.2) (slot M[jkk.1.1] jkk.2)))
    with hΨP
  
  have hvQ : ∀ (j : Fin M.size), ∀ e ∈ faceEdges M[j], psub e.1 Q ≠ 0 := by
    intro j e he
    apply psub_ne_zero_of_ne
    intro hc
    apply clean_off_surface hnpo hQ j
    obtain ⟨h0, h1, h2⟩ := vertex_mem_triangleSet M[j]
    rw [← hc]
    simp only [faceEdges, List.mem_cons, List.not_mem_nil, or_false] at he
    rcases he with rfl | rfl | rfl
    exacts [h0, h1, h2]
  have hΨ : ∀ ψ ∈ mkPoint 1 0 0 :: (ΨN ++ ΨA ++ ΨE ++ ΨP), ψ ≠ 0 := by
    intro ψ hψ
    rcases List.mem_cons.mp hψ with rfl | hψ
    · intro hc
      have := congrFun hc 0
      simp [mkPoint_zero] at this
    rcases List.mem_append.mp hψ with hψ | hP
    rcases List.mem_append.mp hψ with hψ | hE
    rcases List.mem_append.mp hψ with hN | hA
    · rw [hΨN] at hN
      obtain ⟨u, -, rfl⟩ := List.mem_map.mp hN
      exact ne_zero_of_dotQ (u := M[u].v₀)
        (by rw [faceNormal_offset]; exact hnpo u)
    · rw [hΨA] at hA
      obtain ⟨jk, -, rfl⟩ := List.mem_map.mp hA
      exact facet_n_ne_zero (hnpo jk.1) _ (slot_mem _ _)
    · rw [hΨE] at hE
      obtain ⟨j, -, hj⟩ := List.mem_flatMap.mp hE
      obtain ⟨e, he, rfl⟩ := List.mem_map.mp hj
      exact edgePsi_ne_zero (hvQ j e he)
    · rw [hΨP] at hP
      obtain ⟨jkk, -, hf⟩ := List.mem_filterMap.mp hP
      by_cases hkk : jkk.1.2 = jkk.2
      · simp only [if_pos hkk] at hf
        exact Option.noConfusion hf
      · simp only [if_neg hkk] at hf
        obtain rfl := Option.some.inj hf
        intro hc
        exact pairPsi_ne_zero (hnpo jkk.1.1) (slot_mem _ _) (slot_mem _ _)
          (slot_ne_of_idx_ne (hnpo jkk.1.1) hkk)
          (hQ jkk.1.1 _ (slot_mem _ _)) hc
  obtain ⟨d, hd⟩ := generic_direction _ hΨ
  have hd0 : d ≠ 0 := by
    intro hc
    apply hd (mkPoint 1 0 0) (List.mem_cons_self _ _)
    rw [hc, dotQ_zero_right]
  
  have hdN : ∀ u : Fin M.size, dotQ (Proof.MeshIntersectJump.faceNormal M[u]) d ≠ 0 := by
    intro u
    refine hd _ (List.mem_cons_of_mem _ (List.mem_append.mpr (Or.inl
      (List.mem_append.mpr (Or.inl (List.mem_append.mpr (Or.inl ?_)))))))
    rw [hΨN]
    exact List.mem_map.mpr ⟨u, List.mem_finRange u, rfl⟩
  have hdA : ∀ (j : Fin M.size) (k : Fin 4), dotQ (slot M[j] k).n d ≠ 0 := by
    intro j k
    refine hd _ (List.mem_cons_of_mem _ (List.mem_append.mpr (Or.inl
      (List.mem_append.mpr (Or.inl (List.mem_append.mpr (Or.inr ?_)))))))
    rw [hΨA]
    exact List.mem_map.mpr ⟨(j, k),
      List.pair_mem_product.mpr ⟨List.mem_finRange j, List.mem_finRange k⟩, rfl⟩
  have hdE : ∀ (j : Fin M.size), ∀ e ∈ faceEdges M[j],
      dotQ (edgePsi Q e.1 e.2) d ≠ 0 := by
    intro j e he
    refine hd _ (List.mem_cons_of_mem _ (List.mem_append.mpr (Or.inl
      (List.mem_append.mpr (Or.inr ?_)))))
    rw [hΨE]
    exact List.mem_flatMap.mpr ⟨j, List.mem_finRange j,
      List.mem_map.mpr ⟨e, he, rfl⟩⟩
  have hdP : ∀ (j : Fin M.size) (k k' : Fin 4), k ≠ k' →
      dotQ (pairPsi Q (slot M[j] k) (slot M[j] k')) d ≠ 0 := by
    intro j k k' hkk
    refine hd _ (List.mem_cons_of_mem _ (List.mem_append.mpr (Or.inr ?_)))
    rw [hΨP]
    refine List.mem_filterMap.mpr ⟨((j, k), k'),
      List.pair_mem_product.mpr ⟨List.pair_mem_product.mpr
        ⟨List.mem_finRange j, List.mem_finRange k⟩, List.mem_finRange k'⟩, ?_⟩
    show (if k = k' then none
        else some (pairPsi Q (slot M[j] k) (slot M[j] k'))) = some _
    rw [if_neg hkk]
  
  
  have hG2line : ∀ (j : Fin M.size), ∀ g ∈ tetraHalves M[j],
      ∀ g' ∈ tetraHalves M[j], g ≠ g' → ∀ t : ℚ,
      ¬ (g.eval (lineAt Q d t) = 0 ∧ g'.eval (lineAt Q d t) = 0) := by
    rintro j g hg g' hg' hne t ⟨hgz, hgz'⟩
    obtain ⟨k, rfl⟩ := mem_tetraHalves_iff.mp hg
    obtain ⟨k', rfl⟩ := mem_tetraHalves_iff.mp hg'
    have hkk : k ≠ k' := fun h => hne (by rw [h])
    exact pairPsi_sep (hdP j k k' hkk) t hgz hgz'
  
  set RL : List ℚ := ((List.finRange M.size).product (List.finRange 4)).map
    (fun jk => -(slot M[jk.1] jk.2).eval Q / dotQ (slot M[jk.1] jk.2).n d)
    with hRL
  have hclean : ∀ t : ℚ, (∀ r ∈ RL, t ≠ r) → G1Clean M (lineAt Q d t) := by
    intro t havoid j g hg
    obtain ⟨k, rfl⟩ := mem_tetraHalves_iff.mp hg
    intro heval
    rw [eval_lineAt] at heval
    apply havoid (-(slot M[j] k).eval Q / dotQ (slot M[j] k).n d)
      (by rw [hRL]
          exact List.mem_map.mpr ⟨(j, k), List.pair_mem_product.mpr
            ⟨List.mem_finRange j, List.mem_finRange k⟩, rfl⟩)
    rw [eq_div_iff (hdA j k)]
    linarith
  
  
  have hcarrier : ∀ (u : Fin M.size) (t : ℚ), lineAt Q d t ∈ triangleSet M[u] →
      t = (detOrigin M[u] - dotQ (Proof.MeshIntersectJump.faceNormal M[u]) Q) / dotQ (Proof.MeshIntersectJump.faceNormal M[u]) d := by
    intro u t hmem
    have h1 := triangleSet_on_carrier hmem
    rw [dotQ_lineAt] at h1
    rw [eq_div_iff (hdN u)]
    linarith
  set X : Set ℚ := {t : ℚ | 0 < t ∧ ∃ u : Fin M.size,
    lineAt Q d t ∈ triangleSet M[u]} with hX
  have hXfin : X.Finite := by
    apply Set.Finite.subset (((List.finRange M.size).map (fun u =>
      (detOrigin M[u] - dotQ (Proof.MeshIntersectJump.faceNormal M[u]) Q)
        / dotQ (Proof.MeshIntersectJump.faceNormal M[u]) d)).finite_toSet)
    rintro t ⟨-, u, hmem⟩
    exact List.mem_map.mpr ⟨u, List.mem_finRange u, (hcarrier u t hmem).symm⟩
  
  have hnoedge : ∀ (u : Fin M.size) (t : ℚ), t ≠ 0 →
      lineAt Q d t ∉ edgeSet M[u] := by
    intro u t ht hmem
    have hmiss : ∀ e ∈ faceEdges M[u], lineAt Q d t ∉ segment ℚ e.1 e.2 :=
      fun e he => edge_miss (hvQ u e he) (hdE u e he) ht
    rcases hmem with (h01 | h12) | h20
    · exact hmiss (M[u].v₀, M[u].v₁) (by simp [faceEdges]) h01
    · exact hmiss (M[u].v₁, M[u].v₂) (by simp [faceEdges]) h12
    · exact hmiss (M[u].v₂, M[u].v₀) (by simp [faceEdges]) h20
  by_cases hXne : X.Nonempty
  · 
    right
    obtain ⟨t₁, ht₁X, ht₁min⟩ := Set.exists_min_image X id hXfin hXne
    obtain ⟨ht₁pos, u₁, hu₁⟩ := ht₁X
    
    have hsecond : ∃ t₂ : ℚ, t₁ < t₂ ∧ ∀ t ∈ X, t ≠ t₁ → t₂ ≤ t := by
      by_cases hX' : (X \ {t₁}).Nonempty
      · obtain ⟨t₂, ht₂, ht₂min⟩ :=
          Set.exists_min_image _ id (hXfin.subset Set.diff_subset) hX'
        refine ⟨t₂, lt_of_le_of_ne (ht₁min t₂ ht₂.1) (Ne.symm ht₂.2), ?_⟩
        intro t htX htne
        exact ht₂min t ⟨htX, htne⟩
      · refine ⟨t₁ + 1, by linarith, fun t htX htne => ?_⟩
        exact absurd (Set.nonempty_of_mem
          (Set.mem_diff_singleton.mpr ⟨htX, htne⟩)) hX'
    obtain ⟨t₂, ht₁₂, ht₂min⟩ := hsecond
    
    obtain ⟨σ, hσ₁, hσ₂, hσRL⟩ := exists_between_avoiding ht₁₂ RL
    have hσpos : 0 < σ := lt_trans ht₁pos hσ₁
    have hσclean : G1Clean M (lineAt Q d σ) := hclean σ hσRL
    
    have hseg : ∀ τ : ℚ, seg Q (lineAt Q d σ) τ = lineAt Q d (τ * σ) := by
      intro τ
      funext k
      simp only [seg, lineAt]
      ring
    have hτc : t₁ / σ * σ = t₁ := div_mul_cancel₀ t₁ (ne_of_gt hσpos)
    
    have hpair : AdmPair M u₁ Q (lineAt Q d σ) (t₁ / σ) := by
      refine ⟨div_pos ht₁pos hσpos, (div_lt_one hσpos).mpr hσ₁, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
      · rw [hseg, hτc]
        exact hu₁
      · rw [hseg, hτc]
        exact hnoedge u₁ t₁ (ne_of_gt ht₁pos)
      · 
        intro j τ h0 h1 hτne hmem
        rw [hseg] at hmem
        have hpos : 0 < τ * σ := mul_pos h0 hσpos
        have hXmem : τ * σ ∈ X := ⟨hpos, j, hmem⟩
        have hne₁ : τ * σ ≠ t₁ := by
          intro hc
          apply hτne
          rw [← hc, mul_div_assoc, div_self (ne_of_gt hσpos), mul_one]
        have h2 := ht₂min _ hXmem hne₁
        have : τ * σ < σ := by nlinarith
        linarith
      · exact hQ
      · exact hσclean
      · 
        intro j g hg g' hg' hne τ h0 h1
        rw [hseg]
        exact hG2line j g hg g' hg' hne (τ * σ)
    
    have hQside := clean_off_carrier hnpo hQ u₁
    have hAdm : AdmPt M u₁ (sideOf M[u₁] Q) Q := by
      unfold AdmPt
      exact ⟨lineAt Q d σ, t₁ / σ, hpair, rfl⟩
    exact ⟨u₁, sideOf M[u₁] Q, qsign_ne_zero hQside,
      (germValue_eq M hcyc hnpo hns hAdm).symm⟩
  · 
    left
    obtain ⟨T₀, hT₀pos, hT₀⟩ := ray_escapes_box M Q d hd0
    obtain ⟨T, hT₁, -, hTRL⟩ := exists_between_avoiding (lt_add_one T₀) RL
    have hTpos : 0 < T := lt_trans hT₀pos hT₁
    have hTclean : G1Clean M (lineAt Q d T) := hclean T hTRL
    have hsegT : ∀ τ : ℚ, (fun k => Q k + τ * (lineAt Q d T k - Q k))
        = lineAt Q d (τ * T) := by
      intro τ
      funext k
      simp only [lineAt]
      ring
    rw [winding_const_of_avoiding M hcyc hnpo Q (lineAt Q d T)
      (fun j τ h0 h1 hmem => hXne ⟨τ * T, mul_pos h0 hTpos, j, by
        rw [← hsegT]; exact hmem⟩)
      (fun j g hg => ⟨hQ j g hg, hTclean j g hg⟩)
      (fun j g hg g' hg' hne τ h0 h1 => by
        rw [hsegT]
        exact hG2line j g hg g' hg' hne (τ * T))]
    exact winding_zero_outside_box M (hT₀ T (le_of_lt hT₁))

name: linePoint_eq
statement:
private theorem linePoint_eq (p v : Point) (δ : ℚ) :
    (fun i => p i + δ * v i) = δ • v +ᵥ p
proof:
:= by
  funext i; simp [vadd_eq_add]; ring

name: affine_line_eval
statement:
private theorem affine_line_eval (g : Point →ᵃ[ℚ] ℚ) (p v : Point) (δ : ℚ) :
    g (fun i => p i + δ * v i) = g p + δ * (g.linear v)
proof:
:= by
  rw [linePoint_eq, AffineMap.map_vadd]; simp [map_smul, add_comm]

name: half_line_eval
statement:
private theorem half_line_eval (g : Half) (p v : Point) (δ : ℚ) :
    g.eval (fun i => p i + δ * v i) = g.eval p + δ * dotQ g.n v
proof:
:= by
  have := affine_line_eval (gOf g) p v δ
  simpa [gOf_apply, gOf_linear, linOf_apply, ← dotQ_eq_sum] using this

name: slack_pos
statement:
private theorem slack_pos {a b r δ₀ : ℚ}
    (_ha : 0 < a) (hr0 : 0 ≤ r) (hrδ : r ≤ δ₀)
    (hδpos : 0 < δ₀) (hδle : δ₀ ≤ a / (1 + |b|)) :
    0 < a + r * b
proof:
:= by
  have hden : 0 < 1 + |b| := by positivity
  have hδmul : δ₀ * (1 + |b|) ≤ a := by
    rw [div_eq_mul_inv] at hδle
    have := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hδle (le_of_lt hden)
    rwa [mul_assoc, inv_mul_cancel₀ (ne_of_gt hden), mul_one] at this
  have hrb_lt : r * |b| < a := by
    have h1 : r * |b| ≤ δ₀ * |b| := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hrδ (abs_nonneg b)
    have h2 : δ₀ * |b| < δ₀ * (1 + |b|) := by
      apply mul_lt_mul_of_pos_left _ hδpos; linarith [abs_nonneg b]
    linarith
  have habs : |r * b| < a := by rw [abs_mul, abs_of_nonneg hr0]; exact hrb_lt
  linarith [(abs_lt.mp habs).1]

name: diagVec_linearIndependent
statement:
private theorem diagVec_linearIndependent {ε : ℚ} (hε : ε ≠ 0) :
    LinearIndependent ℚ ![diagVec ε 0, diagVec ε 1, diagVec ε 2]
proof:
:= by
  rw [← det3_ne_zero_iff_linearIndependent]
  show det3 _ _ _ ≠ 0
  have hval : det3 (diagVec ε 0) (diagVec ε 1) (diagVec ε 2) = ε ^ 3 := by
    simp only [det3, dotQ, crossQ, mkPoint, diagVec]
    norm_num [show ((1:Fin 3) = 2) = False from by decide,
              show ((2:Fin 3) = 1) = False from by decide,
              show ((2:Fin 3) = 0) = False from by decide,
              show ((0:Fin 3) = 2) = False from by decide,
              show ((1:Fin 3) = 0) = False from by decide,
              show ((0:Fin 3) = 1) = False from by decide]
    ring
  rw [hval]; exact pow_ne_zero 3 hε

name: quad_affineIndependent
statement:
private theorem quad_affineIndependent (p : Point) {ε : ℚ} (hε : ε ≠ 0) :
    AffineIndependent ℚ (quad p ε)
proof:
:= by
  have hli := diagVec_linearIndependent hε
  have hAI0 : AffineIndependent ℚ
      ![(0 : Point), diagVec ε 0, diagVec ε 1, diagVec ε 2] :=
    (linearIndependent_iff_originApex_affineIndependent _ _ _).mp hli
  have hres := ((AffineEquiv.constVAdd ℚ Point p).affineIndependent_iff
    (p := ![(0 : Point), diagVec ε 0, diagVec ε 1, diagVec ε 2])).mpr hAI0
  have heq : (⇑(AffineEquiv.constVAdd ℚ Point p) ∘
        ![(0 : Point), diagVec ε 0, diagVec ε 1, diagVec ε 2]) = quad p ε := by
    funext k i
    fin_cases k <;>
      simp [quad, diagVec, Function.comp_apply, AffineEquiv.constVAdd_apply, vadd_eq_add,
        Pi.add_apply, Matrix.cons_val_zero, Matrix.cons_val_one, Matrix.head_cons,
        Matrix.cons_val_two, Matrix.tail_cons, Matrix.cons_val_three]
  rwa [heq] at hres

name: openCell_aff_indep_4
statement:
theorem openCell_aff_indep_4 {m : ℕ} (g : Fin m → (Point →ᵃ[ℚ] ℚ)) (s : Fin m → ℚ)
    {p₀ : Point} (hp₀ : ∀ j, 0 < s j * g j p₀) :
    ∃ q : Fin 4 → Point, AffineIndependent ℚ q ∧ (∀ k j, 0 < s j * g j (q k))
proof:
:= by
  
  set bnd : Fin m → Fin 3 → ℚ :=
    fun j k => (s j * g j p₀) / (1 + |s j * (g j).linear (diagVec 1 k)|) with hbnd
  obtain ⟨ε, hεpos, hεle⟩ :
      ∃ ε : ℚ, 0 < ε ∧ ∀ j k, ε ≤ bnd j k ∧ ε ≤ 1 := by
    rcases Nat.eq_zero_or_pos m with hm0 | hmpos
    · subst hm0; exact ⟨1, one_pos, fun j => j.elim0⟩
    · haveI : Nonempty (Fin m) := ⟨⟨0, hmpos⟩⟩
      set M := Finset.univ.inf' (Finset.univ_nonempty (α := Fin m × Fin 3))
        (fun jk => bnd jk.1 jk.2) with hM
      refine ⟨min M 1, ?_, ?_⟩
      · rw [lt_min_iff]
        refine ⟨?_, one_pos⟩
        rw [hM, Finset.lt_inf'_iff]
        rintro ⟨j, k⟩ _
        have hden : 0 < 1 + |s j * (g j).linear (diagVec 1 k)| := by positivity
        exact div_pos (hp₀ j) hden
      · intro j k
        refine ⟨le_trans (min_le_left _ _) ?_, min_le_right _ _⟩
        rw [hM]; exact Finset.inf'_le _ (Finset.mem_univ (j, k))
  have hε : ε ≠ 0 := ne_of_gt hεpos
  refine ⟨quad p₀ ε, quad_affineIndependent p₀ hε, ?_⟩
  
  have hshift : ∀ (k' : Fin 3) (j : Fin m),
      0 < s j * g j (fun i => p₀ i + ε * diagVec 1 k' i) := by
    intro k' j
    rw [affine_line_eval, mul_add]
    
    have hrw : s j * (ε * (g j).linear (diagVec 1 k'))
        = ε * (s j * (g j).linear (diagVec 1 k')) := by ring
    rw [hrw]
    have hden : 0 < 1 + |s j * (g j).linear (diagVec 1 k')| := by positivity
    have hbpos : 0 < bnd j k' := div_pos (hp₀ j) hden
    exact slack_pos (hp₀ j) (le_of_lt hεpos) (hεle j k').1 hbpos (le_of_eq (by rw [hbnd]))
  
  have hdveq : ∀ (k' : Fin 3) (i : Fin 3), diagVec ε k' i = ε * diagVec 1 k' i := by
    intro k' i; simp only [diagVec]; split <;> ring
  intro k j
  fin_cases k
  · 
    show 0 < s j * g j (quad p₀ ε 0)
    exact hp₀ j
  · 
    show 0 < s j * g j (quad p₀ ε 1)
    have he : (quad p₀ ε 1) = (fun i => p₀ i + ε * diagVec 1 0 i) := by
      funext i; simp only [quad, Matrix.cons_val_one, Matrix.head_cons]; rw [hdveq]
    rw [he]; exact hshift 0 j
  · show 0 < s j * g j (quad p₀ ε 2)
    have he : (quad p₀ ε 2) = (fun i => p₀ i + ε * diagVec 1 1 i) := by
      funext i
      simp only [quad, Matrix.cons_val_two, Matrix.tail_cons, Matrix.head_cons,
        Matrix.cons_val_one]
      rw [hdveq]
    rw [he]; exact hshift 1 j
  · show 0 < s j * g j (quad p₀ ε 3)
    have he : (quad p₀ ε 3) = (fun i => p₀ i + ε * diagVec 1 2 i) := by
      funext i
      simp only [quad, Matrix.cons_val_three, Matrix.tail_cons, Matrix.head_cons,
        Matrix.cons_val_one, Matrix.cons_val_two]
      rw [hdveq]
    rw [he]; exact hshift 2 j

name: finrank_point
statement: private theorem finrank_point : Module.finrank ℚ Point = 3
proof:
:= by
  simp [Point, Module.finrank_pi]

name: openCell_finrank_three
statement:
theorem openCell_finrank_three {m : ℕ} (g : Fin m → (Point →ᵃ[ℚ] ℚ)) (s : Fin m → ℚ)
    {p₀ : Point} (hp₀ : ∀ j, 0 < s j * g j p₀) :
    Module.finrank ℚ (vectorSpan ℚ {Q : Point | ∀ j, 0 < s j * g j Q}) = 3
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨q, hAI, hmem⟩ := openCell_aff_indep_4 g s hp₀
  
  have hcard : Fintype.card (Fin 4) = 3 + 1 := rfl
  have hfs3 : Module.finrank ℚ (vectorSpan ℚ (Set.range q)) = 3 :=
    hAI.finrank_vectorSpan hcard
  
  have hsub : Set.range q ⊆ {Q : Point | ∀ j, 0 < s j * g j Q} := by
    rintro x ⟨k, rfl⟩; exact fun j => hmem k j
  have hmono : Module.finrank ℚ (vectorSpan ℚ (Set.range q))
      ≤ Module.finrank ℚ (vectorSpan ℚ {Q : Point | ∀ j, 0 < s j * g j Q}) :=
    Submodule.finrank_mono (vectorSpan_mono ℚ hsub)
  
  have hamb : Module.finrank ℚ (vectorSpan ℚ {Q : Point | ∀ j, 0 < s j * g j Q})
      ≤ Module.finrank ℚ Point := Submodule.finrank_le _
  rw [hfs3] at hmono; rw [finrank_point] at hamb
  omega

name: closedCell_recessionCone_trivial
statement:
theorem closedCell_recessionCone_trivial {m : ℕ} (g : Fin m → (Point →ᵃ[ℚ] ℚ))
    (s : Fin m → ℚ) {p₀ : Point} (hp₀ : ∀ j, 0 < s j * g j p₀)
    {K : Set Point} {R : ℚ}
    (hKbound : ∀ x ∈ K, ∀ i, |x i| ≤ R)
    (hCsub : {Q : Point | ∀ j, 0 < s j * g j Q} ⊆ K) :
    ∀ v : Point, (∀ j, 0 ≤ s j * (g j).linear v) → v = 0
proof:
:= by
  intro v hrec
  by_contra hv0
  
  obtain ⟨i, hvi⟩ : ∃ i, v i ≠ 0 := by
    by_contra hc; push_neg at hc; exact hv0 (funext hc)
  have hviabs : 0 < |v i| := abs_pos.mpr hvi
  
  have hray : ∀ r : ℚ, 0 ≤ r → (fun i => p₀ i + r * v i) ∈ {Q : Point | ∀ j, 0 < s j * g j Q} := by
    intro r hr
    simp only [Set.mem_setOf_eq]
    intro j
    rw [affine_line_eval, mul_add]
    have hslope : 0 ≤ r * (s j * (g j).linear v) :=
      mul_nonneg hr (hrec j)
    have hrw : s j * (r * (g j).linear v) = r * (s j * (g j).linear v) := by ring
    rw [hrw]
    have := hp₀ j
    linarith
  
  have hbox : ∀ r : ℚ, 0 ≤ r → |p₀ i + r * v i| ≤ R := by
    intro r hr
    exact hKbound _ (hCsub (hray r hr)) i
  
  set r : ℚ := (R + |p₀ i| + 1) / |v i| with hr
  
  have hp0K : p₀ ∈ K := hCsub (by intro j; exact hp₀ j)
  have hRnn : 0 ≤ R := le_trans (abs_nonneg _) (hKbound p₀ hp0K i)
  have hrpos : 0 ≤ r := by
    rw [hr]
    apply div_nonneg _ (le_of_lt hviabs)
    positivity
  have hrvi : r * |v i| = R + |p₀ i| + 1 := by
    rw [hr]; field_simp
  
  have hlow : R + 1 ≤ |p₀ i + r * v i| := by
    have h1 : |r * v i| - |p₀ i| ≤ |p₀ i + r * v i| := by
      have hraw := abs_sub_abs_le_abs_sub (r * v i) (-(p₀ i))
      rw [sub_neg_eq_add, abs_neg] at hraw
      have hcomm : |r * v i + p₀ i| = |p₀ i + r * v i| := by rw [add_comm]
      rw [hcomm] at hraw
      exact hraw
    have h2 : |r * v i| = r * |v i| := by rw [abs_mul, abs_of_nonneg hrpos]
    rw [h2, hrvi] at h1
    linarith
  have := hbox r hrpos
  linarith

name: safeStep_slack_fold_pos
statement:
private theorem safeStep_slack_fold_pos (G : Array Half) (p : Point) :
    ∀ m, (G.foldl (fun acc g =>
            let v := g.eval p
            if v == 0 then acc
            else
              let a := if v < 0 then -v else v
              match acc with
              | none => some a
              | some m => some (if a < m then a else m)) (none : Option ℚ)) = some m →
          0 < m
proof:
:= by
  refine Array.foldl_induction
    (motive := fun _ acc => ∀ m, acc = some m → 0 < m)
    (by intro m h; simp at h) ?_
  intro i acc ih m hm
  simp only at hm
  by_cases hv : (G[i].eval p == 0) = true
  · rw [if_pos hv] at hm; exact ih m hm
  · rw [if_neg hv] at hm
    have hvne : G[i].eval p ≠ 0 := by
      simp only [beq_iff_eq] at hv; exact hv
    set a : ℚ := if G[i].eval p < 0 then -(G[i].eval p) else G[i].eval p with ha
    have hapos : 0 < a := by
      rw [ha]; split
      · linarith
      · rename_i hge; rcases lt_or_eq_of_le (not_lt.mp hge) with h | h
        · exact h
        · exact absurd h.symm hvne
    cases hacc : acc with
    | none =>
      rw [hacc] at hm; simp only [Option.some.injEq] at hm; rw [← hm]; exact hapos
    | some m' =>
      have hm'pos : 0 < m' := ih m' hacc
      rw [hacc] at hm; simp only [Option.some.injEq] at hm
      rw [← hm]; split
      · exact hapos
      · exact hm'pos

name: safeStep_slack_fold_le
statement:
private theorem safeStep_slack_fold_le (G : Array Half) (p : Point) :
    ∀ j : Fin G.size, G[j].eval p ≠ 0 →
      ∃ m, (G.foldl (fun acc g =>
              let v := g.eval p
              if v == 0 then acc
              else
                let a := if v < 0 then -v else v
                match acc with
                | none => some a
                | some m => some (if a < m then a else m)) (none : Option ℚ)) = some m
            ∧ m ≤ |G[j].eval p|
proof:
:= by
  intro j hj
  
  refine Array.foldl_induction
    (motive := fun n acc => (j : ℕ) < n →
      ∃ m, acc = some m ∧ m ≤ |G[j].eval p|)
    (by intro h; exact absurd h (by omega)) ?_ (by omega)
  intro i acc ih hji
  simp only
  rcases Nat.lt_succ_iff_lt_or_eq.mp hji with hlt | heq
  · 
    obtain ⟨m, hm, hmle⟩ := ih hlt
    by_cases hv : (G[i].eval p == 0) = true
    · rw [if_pos hv]; exact ⟨m, hm, hmle⟩
    · rw [if_neg hv, hm]
      set a : ℚ := if G[i].eval p < 0 then -(G[i].eval p) else G[i].eval p with ha
      refine ⟨if a < m then a else m, rfl, ?_⟩
      split
      · rename_i hcase; linarith
      · exact hmle
  · 
    have hij : G[i] = G[j] := by
      congr 1; exact Fin.ext heq.symm
    have hvne : G[i].eval p ≠ 0 := by rw [hij]; exact hj
    rw [if_neg (by simp only [beq_iff_eq]; exact hvne)]
    rw [hij]
    set a : ℚ := if G[j].eval p < 0 then -(G[j].eval p) else G[j].eval p with ha
    have haeq : a = |G[j].eval p| := by
      rw [ha]; split
      · rename_i hlt'; rw [abs_of_neg hlt']
      · rename_i hge; rw [abs_of_nonneg (not_lt.mp hge)]
    cases hacc : acc with
    | none => exact ⟨a, rfl, le_of_eq haeq⟩
    | some m' =>
      refine ⟨if a < m' then a else m', rfl, ?_⟩
      rw [← haeq]
      split
      · rename_i hcase; exact le_refl a
      · rename_i hcase; exact le_of_not_lt hcase

name: safeStep_denom_fold_ge
statement:
private theorem safeStep_denom_fold_ge (G : Array Half) (d : Point) :
    0 ≤ (G.foldl (fun acc g =>
          let v := dotQ g.n d
          let a := if v < 0 then -v else v
          if a > acc then a else acc) (0 : ℚ))
    ∧ ∀ j : Fin G.size,
        |dotQ G[j].n d|
          ≤ (G.foldl (fun acc g =>
              let v := dotQ g.n d
              let a := if v < 0 then -v else v
              if a > acc then a else acc) (0 : ℚ))
proof:
:= by
  have key : 0 ≤ (G.foldl (fun acc g =>
          let v := dotQ g.n d
          let a := if v < 0 then -v else v
          if a > acc then a else acc) (0 : ℚ))
      ∧ ∀ j : Fin G.size, (j : ℕ) < G.size →
        |dotQ G[j].n d| ≤ (G.foldl (fun acc g =>
              let v := dotQ g.n d
              let a := if v < 0 then -v else v
              if a > acc then a else acc) (0 : ℚ)) := by
    refine Array.foldl_induction
      (motive := fun n acc => 0 ≤ acc ∧ ∀ j : Fin G.size, (j : ℕ) < n →
        |dotQ G[j].n d| ≤ acc)
      ⟨le_refl 0, by intro j h; exact absurd h (by omega)⟩ ?_
    intro i acc ih
    obtain ⟨hacc0, ihle⟩ := ih
    simp only
    set a : ℚ := if dotQ G[i].n d < 0 then -(dotQ G[i].n d) else dotQ G[i].n d with ha
    have haeq : a = |dotQ G[i].n d| := by
      rw [ha]; split
      · rename_i hlt'; rw [abs_of_neg hlt']
      · rename_i hge; rw [abs_of_nonneg (not_lt.mp hge)]
    have ha0 : 0 ≤ a := by rw [haeq]; exact abs_nonneg _
    refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
    · split
      · exact ha0
      · exact hacc0
    · intro j hji
      rcases Nat.lt_succ_iff_lt_or_eq.mp hji with hlt | heq
      · have hjle := ihle j hlt
        split
        · rename_i hgt; linarith
        · exact hjle
      · have hij : G[i] = G[j] := by
          congr 1; exact Fin.ext heq.symm
        rw [show |dotQ G[j].n d| = a by rw [haeq, hij]]
        split
        · rename_i hgt; exact le_refl a
        · rename_i hngt; exact le_of_not_lt hngt
  exact ⟨key.1, fun j => key.2 j j.2⟩

name: safeStep_s_pos
statement:
private theorem safeStep_s_pos (G : Array Half) (_d p : Point) :
    0 < (match (G.foldl (fun acc g =>
            let v := g.eval p
            if v == 0 then acc
            else
              let a := if v < 0 then -v else v
              match acc with
              | none => some a
              | some m => some (if a < m then a else m)) (none : Option ℚ)) with
          | none => (1 : ℚ)
          | some m => m)
proof:
:= by
  set slack := G.foldl (fun acc g =>
            let v := g.eval p
            if v == 0 then acc
            else
              let a := if v < 0 then -v else v
              match acc with
              | none => some a
              | some m => some (if a < m then a else m)) (none : Option ℚ) with hslack
  cases hs : slack with
  | none => simp
  | some m => simp only; exact safeStep_slack_fold_pos G p m (by rw [← hslack]; exact hs)

name: safeStep_pos
statement:
private theorem safeStep_pos (G : Array Half) (d p : Point) :
    0 < safeStep G d p
proof:
:= by
  rw [safeStep]
  set denom := G.foldl (fun acc g =>
          let v := dotQ g.n d
          let a := if v < 0 then -v else v
          if a > acc then a else acc) (0 : ℚ) with hdenom
  have hdenom0 : 0 ≤ denom := (safeStep_denom_fold_ge G d).1
  have hs := safeStep_s_pos G d p
  have hden : 0 < 1 + denom := by linarith
  positivity

name: safeStep_perturbation
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨j, hjlt, hjg⟩ := Array.mem_iff_getElem.mp hg
  subst hjg
  
  set denom := G.foldl (fun acc g =>
          let v := dotQ g.n d
          let a := if v < 0 then -v else v
          if a > acc then a else acc) (0 : ℚ) with hdenom
  have hdenom0 : 0 ≤ denom := (safeStep_denom_fold_ge G d).1
  have hdenge : |dotQ G[j].n d| ≤ denom := (safeStep_denom_fold_ge G d).2 ⟨j, hjlt⟩
  
  obtain ⟨mslack, hmeq, hmle⟩ := safeStep_slack_fold_le G p ⟨j, hjlt⟩ hgp
  set s := (match (G.foldl (fun acc g =>
            let v := g.eval p
            if v == 0 then acc
            else
              let a := if v < 0 then -v else v
              match acc with
              | none => some a
              | some m => some (if a < m then a else m)) (none : Option ℚ)) with
          | none => (1 : ℚ)
          | some m => m) with hs
  have hsle : s ≤ |G[j].eval p| := by
    rw [hs, hmeq]; exact hmle
  have hspos : 0 < s := safeStep_s_pos G d p
  
  have hstep : safeStep G d p = s / (1 + denom) / 2 := by
    rw [safeStep]; rfl
  rw [hstep]
  
  have hden1 : 0 < 1 + denom := by linarith
  have hdivpos : 0 < s / (1 + denom) / 2 := by positivity
  have hbound1 : s / (1 + denom) / 2 * |dotQ G[j].n d| ≤ s / (1 + denom) / 2 * denom :=
    mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hdenge (le_of_lt hdivpos)
  have hden1ne : (1 + denom) ≠ 0 := ne_of_gt hden1
  have heq2 : s / (1 + denom) / 2 * denom = (s / 2) * (denom / (1 + denom)) := by
    field_simp; left; ring
  have hfrac : denom / (1 + denom) < 1 := by
    rw [div_lt_one hden1]; linarith
  have hsdiv2pos : 0 < s / 2 := by linarith
  have hbound2 : (s / 2) * (denom / (1 + denom)) < (s / 2) * 1 :=
    mul_lt_mul_of_pos_left hfrac hsdiv2pos
  have hgpabs : 0 < |G[j].eval p| := abs_pos.mpr hgp
  calc s / (1 + denom) / 2 * |dotQ G[j].n d|
      ≤ s / (1 + denom) / 2 * denom := hbound1
    _ = (s / 2) * (denom / (1 + denom)) := heq2
    _ < (s / 2) * 1 := hbound2
    _ = s / 2 := by ring
    _ ≤ |G[j].eval p| / 2 := by linarith
    _ < |G[j].eval p| := by linarith

name: mem_planes_imp_n_ne_zero
statement:
private theorem mem_planes_imp_n_ne_zero {w : Chain} {g : Half}
    (hg : g ∈ planes w) : g.n ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [planes, ← Array.foldl_toList] at hg
  
  have key : ∀ (l : List (Int × Triangle)) (acc : Array Half),
      g ∈ l.foldl (fun acc e => if isDegen e.2 then acc else acc ++ tetraHalves e.2) acc →
      g ∈ acc ∨ ∃ e ∈ l, isDegen e.2 = false ∧ g ∈ tetraHalves e.2 := by
    intro l
    induction l with
    | nil => intro acc h; exact Or.inl (by simpa using h)
    | cons e tl ih =>
      intro acc h
      simp only [List.foldl_cons] at h
      rcases ih _ h with hacc | ⟨e', he'mem, he'd, he'g⟩
      · by_cases hde : isDegen e.2
        · rw [if_pos hde] at hacc; exact Or.inl hacc
        · rw [if_neg hde] at hacc
          rcases Array.mem_append.mp hacc with h1 | h2
          · exact Or.inl h1
          · exact Or.inr ⟨e, List.mem_cons_self _ _, by simp [hde], h2⟩
      · exact Or.inr ⟨e', List.mem_cons_of_mem _ he'mem, he'd, he'g⟩
  rcases key w.toList #[] hg with hempty | ⟨e, hemem, hed, heg⟩
  · simp at hempty
  · 
    have hdet : det3 e.2.v₀ e.2.v₁ e.2.v₂ ≠ 0 := by
      intro h0; rw [isDegen] at hed; simp [h0] at hed
    exact tetraHalf_n_ne_zero hdet g heg

name: mem_degenPlanes_imp_n_ne_zero
statement:
private theorem mem_degenPlanes_imp_n_ne_zero {w : Chain} {g : Half}
    (hg : g ∈ degenPlanes w) : g.n ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [degenPlanes, ← Array.foldl_toList] at hg
  have key : ∀ (l : List (Int × Triangle)) (acc : Array Half),
      g ∈ l.foldl (fun acc e =>
            if isDegen e.2 then acc.push (⟨degenBarrierNormal e.2, 0⟩ : Half) else acc) acc →
      g ∈ acc ∨ ∃ e ∈ l, isDegen e.2 = true ∧ g = (⟨degenBarrierNormal e.2, 0⟩ : Half) := by
    intro l
    induction l with
    | nil => intro acc h; exact Or.inl (by simpa using h)
    | cons e tl ih =>
      intro acc h
      simp only [List.foldl_cons] at h
      rcases ih _ h with hacc | ⟨e', he'mem, he'd, he'g⟩
      · by_cases hde : isDegen e.2
        · rw [if_pos hde] at hacc
          rcases Array.mem_push.mp hacc with h1 | h2
          · exact Or.inl h1
          · exact Or.inr ⟨e, List.mem_cons_self _ _, hde, h2⟩
        · rw [if_neg hde] at hacc; exact Or.inl hacc
      · exact Or.inr ⟨e', List.mem_cons_of_mem _ he'mem, he'd, he'g⟩
  rcases key w.toList #[] hg with hempty | ⟨e, hemem, hed, heg⟩
  · simp at hempty
  · 
    have hdet : det3 e.2.v₀ e.2.v₁ e.2.v₂ = 0 := by
      rw [isDegen] at hed; simpa using hed
    rw [heg]
    exact (degenBarrierNormal_spec hdet).1

name: mem_samplePlanes_imp_n_ne_zero
statement:
private theorem mem_samplePlanes_imp_n_ne_zero {w : Chain} {g : Half}
    (hg : g ∈ samplePlanes w) : g.n ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [samplePlanes, Array.mem_append] at hg
  rcases hg with h | h
  · exact mem_planes_imp_n_ne_zero h
  · exact mem_degenPlanes_imp_n_ne_zero h

name: scanNormals_ne_zero
statement:
private theorem scanNormals_ne_zero (w : Chain) :
    ∀ i : Fin (scanNormals w).size, (scanNormals w)[i] ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  intro i
  
  have hsize : (scanNormals w).size = (samplePlanes w).size := by
    unfold scanNormals; exact Array.size_map _ _
  have hilt : (i : ℕ) < (samplePlanes w).size := by rw [← hsize]; exact i.2
  have hget : (scanNormals w)[i] = ((samplePlanes w)[(i : ℕ)]'hilt).n := by
    have hfin : (scanNormals w)[i] = (scanNormals w)[(i : ℕ)]'i.2 := rfl
    rw [hfin]; unfold scanNormals; rw [Array.getElem_map]
  rw [hget]
  exact mem_samplePlanes_imp_n_ne_zero (Array.getElem_mem _)

name: samplePlanes_dotQ_dir_ne_zero
statement:
private theorem samplePlanes_dotQ_dir_ne_zero (w : Chain) :
    ∀ g ∈ samplePlanes w, dotQ g.n (dir w) ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  
  have hgen : genericFor (scanNormals w) (dir w) = true := by
    rw [dir]
    exact findGenericR_genericFor (scanNormals_ne_zero w)
  
  rw [genericFor, Array.all_eq_true] at hgen
  intro g hg
  obtain ⟨j, hjlt, hjg⟩ := Array.mem_iff_getElem.mp hg
  subst hjg
  
  have hsize : (scanNormals w).size = (samplePlanes w).size := by
    unfold scanNormals; exact Array.size_map _ _
  have hjlt' : (j : ℕ) < (scanNormals w).size := by rw [hsize]; exact hjlt
  have hscan_j : (scanNormals w)[(j : ℕ)]'hjlt' = (samplePlanes w)[j].n := by
    unfold scanNormals; rw [Array.getElem_map]
  have hne := hgen ⟨(j : ℕ), hjlt'⟩
  simp only [bne_iff_ne, ne_eq] at hne
  
  have hne' : dotQ ((scanNormals w)[(j : ℕ)]'hjlt') (dir w) ≠ 0 := hne
  rw [hscan_j] at hne'
  exact hne'

name: sample_sign_preserved
statement:
theorem sample_sign_preserved (w : Chain) (p : Point) :
    ∀ g ∈ samplePlanes w, g.eval p ≠ 0 →
      (0 < g.eval p ↔
        0 < g.eval (sampleAt (samplePlanes w) (dir w) p))
proof:
:= by
  intro g hg hgp
  set G := samplePlanes w with hG
  set d := dir w with hd
  set δ' := safeStep G d p with hδ
  
  have hqeval : g.eval (sampleAt G d p) = g.eval p + δ' * dotQ g.n d := by
    rw [sampleAt]
    exact half_line_eval g p d δ'
  rw [hqeval]
  
  have hδpos : 0 < δ' := safeStep_pos G d p
  have hpert : δ' * |dotQ g.n d| < |g.eval p| := safeStep_perturbation G d p hg hgp
  have habs : |δ' * dotQ g.n d| < |g.eval p| := by
    rw [abs_mul, abs_of_pos hδpos]; exact hpert
  
  rcases abs_lt.mp habs with ⟨hlo, hhi⟩
  constructor
  · intro hxpos
    
    rw [abs_of_pos hxpos] at hlo
    linarith
  · intro hsum
    by_contra hxnpos
    push_neg at hxnpos
    
    have hxneg : g.eval p < 0 := lt_of_le_of_ne hxnpos hgp
    rw [abs_of_neg hxneg] at hhi
    linarith

name: sample_off_samplePlanes
statement:
theorem sample_off_samplePlanes (w : Chain) (p : Point) :
    ∀ g ∈ samplePlanes w,
      g.eval (sampleAt (samplePlanes w) (dir w) p) ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  intro g hg
  set G := samplePlanes w with hG
  set d := dir w with hd
  set δ' := safeStep G d p with hδ
  have hqeval : g.eval (sampleAt G d p) = g.eval p + δ' * dotQ g.n d := by
    rw [sampleAt]; exact half_line_eval g p d δ'
  rw [hqeval]
  have hδpos : 0 < δ' := safeStep_pos G d p
  by_cases hgp : g.eval p = 0
  · 
    rw [hgp, zero_add]
    have hdir : dotQ g.n d ≠ 0 := by
      rw [hd]; exact samplePlanes_dotQ_dir_ne_zero w g hg
    exact mul_ne_zero (ne_of_gt hδpos) hdir
  · 
    have hpert : δ' * |dotQ g.n d| < |g.eval p| := safeStep_perturbation G d p hg hgp
    have habs : |δ' * dotQ g.n d| < |g.eval p| := by
      rw [abs_mul, abs_of_pos hδpos]; exact hpert
    rcases abs_lt.mp habs with ⟨hlo, hhi⟩
    rcases lt_or_gt_of_ne hgp with hneg | hpos
    · rw [abs_of_neg hneg] at hhi hlo
      intro hsum; linarith
    · rw [abs_of_pos hpos] at hhi hlo
      intro hsum; linarith

name: triangleSet_subset_pos
proof:
:= by
  intro z hz
  set m := min (dotQ N τ.v₀) (min (dotQ N τ.v₁) (dotQ N τ.v₂)) with hm
  have hcvx : Convex ℚ {x : Point | m ≤ dotQ N x} := by
    intro x hx y hy a b ha hb hab
    simp only [Set.mem_setOf_eq] at hx hy ⊢
    have hcomb : dotQ N (a • x + b • y) = a * dotQ N x + b * dotQ N y := by
      rw [dotQ_add_right, dotQ_smul_right, dotQ_smul_right]
    rw [hcomb]
    have hax : a * m ≤ a * dotQ N x := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hx ha
    have hby : b * m ≤ b * dotQ N y := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hy hb
    have hsum : a * m + b * m = m := by rw [← add_mul, hab, one_mul]
    linarith
  have hsub : triangleSet τ ⊆ {x : Point | m ≤ dotQ N x} := by
    rw [triangleSet]
    apply convexHull_min ?_ hcvx
    rintro x hx
    simp only [Set.mem_insert_iff, Set.mem_singleton_iff] at hx
    simp only [Set.mem_setOf_eq, hm]
    rcases hx with rfl | rfl | rfl
    · exact min_le_left _ _
    · exact min_le_of_right_le (min_le_left _ _)
    · exact min_le_of_right_le (min_le_right _ _)
  have hmz : m ≤ dotQ N z := hsub hz
  have hcm : c < m := by rw [hm]; exact lt_min h0 (lt_min h1 h2)
  linarith

name: triangleSet_subset_neg
proof:
:= by
  intro z hz
  set M := max (dotQ N τ.v₀) (max (dotQ N τ.v₁) (dotQ N τ.v₂)) with hM
  have hcvx : Convex ℚ {x : Point | dotQ N x ≤ M} := by
    intro x hx y hy a b ha hb hab
    simp only [Set.mem_setOf_eq] at hx hy ⊢
    have hcomb : dotQ N (a • x + b • y) = a * dotQ N x + b * dotQ N y := by
      rw [dotQ_add_right, dotQ_smul_right, dotQ_smul_right]
    rw [hcomb]
    have hax : a * dotQ N x ≤ a * M := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hx ha
    have hby : b * dotQ N y ≤ b * M := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hy hb
    have hsum : a * M + b * M = M := by rw [← add_mul, hab, one_mul]
    linarith
  have hsub : triangleSet τ ⊆ {x : Point | dotQ N x ≤ M} := by
    rw [triangleSet]
    apply convexHull_min ?_ hcvx
    rintro x hx
    simp only [Set.mem_insert_iff, Set.mem_singleton_iff] at hx
    simp only [Set.mem_setOf_eq, hM]
    rcases hx with rfl | rfl | rfl
    · exact le_max_left _ _
    · exact le_max_of_le_right (le_max_left _ _)
    · exact le_max_of_le_right (le_max_right _ _)
  have hMz : dotQ N z ≤ M := hsub hz
  have hMc : M < c := by rw [hM]; exact max_lt h0 (max_lt h1 h2)
  linarith

name: dropByPlane_disjoint
proof:
:= by
  have e0 := signI_iff_of_mul hP (repr4_faceSOf₀ u)
  have e1 := signI_iff_of_mul hP (repr4_faceSOf₁ u)
  have e2 := signI_iff_of_mul hP (repr4_faceSOf₂ u)
  simp only [dropByPlane, Bool.or_eq_true, Bool.and_eq_true, decide_eq_true_eq] at hdrop
  rw [Set.eq_empty_iff_forall_not_mem]
  rintro z ⟨hzu, hzP⟩
  simp only [Set.mem_setOf_eq] at hzP
  rcases hdrop with ⟨⟨hs0, hs1⟩, hs2⟩ | ⟨⟨hs0, hs1⟩, hs2⟩
  · have p0 : c < dotQ N u.v₀ := by have := e0.1.mp hs0; simp only [ce] at this; linarith
    have p1 : c < dotQ N u.v₁ := by have := e1.1.mp hs1; simp only [ce] at this; linarith
    have p2 : c < dotQ N u.v₂ := by have := e2.1.mp hs2; simp only [ce] at this; linarith
    have := triangleSet_subset_pos p0 p1 p2 z hzu; linarith
  · have p0 : dotQ N u.v₀ < c := by have := e0.2.1.mp hs0; simp only [ce] at this; linarith
    have p1 : dotQ N u.v₁ < c := by have := e1.2.1.mp hs1; simp only [ce] at this; linarith
    have p2 : dotQ N u.v₂ < c := by have := e2.2.1.mp hs2; simp only [ce] at this; linarith
    have := triangleSet_subset_neg p0 p1 p2 z hzu; linarith

name: not_dropByPlane_of_meet
proof:
:= by
  cases hb : dropByPlane P (faceSOf u) with
  | false => rfl
  | true =>
    exfalso
    have hemp := dropByPlane_disjoint hP hb
    rw [Set.eq_empty_iff_forall_not_mem] at hemp

      = ps.foldl (fun l p => pminS l p) seed.lo

name: mem_bboxOfPts
statement:
theorem mem_bboxOfPts {ps : Array P3} {p : P3} (hp : p ∈ ps.toList) :
    P3.toPoint p ∈ BoxSet (bboxOfPts ps)
proof:
:= by
  have hpx : (P3.toPoint p) 0 = p.x := rfl
  have hpy : (P3.toPoint p) 1 = p.y := rfl
  have hpz : (P3.toPoint p) 2 = p.z := rfl
  have eLoX : (bboxOfPts ps).lo.x
      = ps.toList.foldl (fun l q => rmin l q.x) (ps.getD 0 default).x := by
    show ((ps.foldl (fun b q => (⟨pminS b.lo q, pmaxS b.hi q⟩ : Box3))
      ⟨ps.getD 0 default, ps.getD 0 default⟩).lo).x = _
    rw [← Array.foldl_toList, foldl_box_lo, foldl_pminS_x (fun q : P3 => q)]
  have eLoY : (bboxOfPts ps).lo.y
      = ps.toList.foldl (fun l q => rmin l q.y) (ps.getD 0 default).y := by
    show ((ps.foldl (fun b q => (⟨pminS b.lo q, pmaxS b.hi q⟩ : Box3))
      ⟨ps.getD 0 default, ps.getD 0 default⟩).lo).y = _
    rw [← Array.foldl_toList, foldl_box_lo, foldl_pminS_y (fun q : P3 => q)]
  have eLoZ : (bboxOfPts ps).lo.z
      = ps.toList.foldl (fun l q => rmin l q.z) (ps.getD 0 default).z := by
    show ((ps.foldl (fun b q => (⟨pminS b.lo q, pmaxS b.hi q⟩ : Box3))
      ⟨ps.getD 0 default, ps.getD 0 default⟩).lo).z = _
    rw [← Array.foldl_toList, foldl_box_lo, foldl_pminS_z (fun q : P3 => q)]
  have eHiX : (bboxOfPts ps).hi.x
      = ps.toList.foldl (fun l q => rmax l q.x) (ps.getD 0 default).x := by
    show ((ps.foldl (fun b q => (⟨pminS b.lo q, pmaxS b.hi q⟩ : Box3))
      ⟨ps.getD 0 default, ps.getD 0 default⟩).hi).x = _
    rw [← Array.foldl_toList, foldl_box_hi, foldl_pmaxS_x (fun q : P3 => q)]
  have eHiY : (bboxOfPts ps).hi.y
      = ps.toList.foldl (fun l q => rmax l q.y) (ps.getD 0 default).y := by
    show ((ps.foldl (fun b q => (⟨pminS b.lo q, pmaxS b.hi q⟩ : Box3))
      ⟨ps.getD 0 default, ps.getD 0 default⟩).hi).y = _
    rw [← Array.foldl_toList, foldl_box_hi, foldl_pmaxS_y (fun q : P3 => q)]
  have eHiZ : (bboxOfPts ps).hi.z
      = ps.toList.foldl (fun l q => rmax l q.z) (ps.getD 0 default).z := by
    show ((ps.foldl (fun b q => (⟨pminS b.lo q, pmaxS b.hi q⟩ : Box3))
      ⟨ps.getD 0 default, ps.getD 0 default⟩).hi).z = _
    rw [← Array.foldl_toList, foldl_box_hi, foldl_pmaxS_z (fun q : P3 => q)]
  refine ⟨⟨?_, ?_⟩, ⟨?_, ?_⟩, ?_, ?_⟩
  · rw [hpx, eLoX]; exact (foldl_rmin_le (fun q : P3 => q.x) ps.toList _).2 _ hp
  · rw [hpx, eHiX]; exact (le_foldl_rmax (fun q : P3 => q.x) ps.toList _).2 _ hp
  · rw [hpy, eLoY]; exact (foldl_rmin_le (fun q : P3 => q.y) ps.toList _).2 _ hp
  · rw [hpy, eHiY]; exact (le_foldl_rmax (fun q : P3 => q.y) ps.toList _).2 _ hp
  · rw [hpz, eLoZ]; exact (foldl_rmin_le (fun q : P3 => q.z) ps.toList _).2 _ hp
  · rw [hpz, eHiZ]; exact (le_foldl_rmax (fun q : P3 => q.z) ps.toList _).2 _ hp

name: sum_sign_partition
statement:
private theorem sum_sign_partition {ι : Type} [Fintype ι] (d : ι → ℚ)
    {M : Type} [AddCommMonoid M] (f : ι → M) :
    (∑ i, f i) = ∑ i in Finset.univ.filter (fun i => 0 < d i), f i
      + ∑ i in Finset.univ.filter (fun i => d i < 0), f i
      + ∑ i in Finset.univ.filter (fun i => d i = 0), f i
proof:
:= by
  have hunion : (Finset.univ.filter (fun i => 0 < d i)) ∪ (Finset.univ.filter (fun i => d i < 0))
      ∪ (Finset.univ.filter (fun i => d i = 0)) = Finset.univ := by
    ext i
    simp only [Finset.mem_union, Finset.mem_filter, Finset.mem_univ, true_and, iff_true]
    rcases lt_trichotomy (d i) 0 with h | h | h
    · exact Or.inl (Or.inr h)
    · exact Or.inr h
    · exact Or.inl (Or.inl h)
  have hd1 : Disjoint (Finset.univ.filter (fun i => 0 < d i))
      (Finset.univ.filter (fun i => d i < 0)) := by
    rw [Finset.disjoint_left]; intro i hi hj
    rw [Finset.mem_filter] at hi hj; linarith [hi.2, hj.2]
  have hd2 : Disjoint ((Finset.univ.filter (fun i => 0 < d i))
      ∪ (Finset.univ.filter (fun i => d i < 0))) (Finset.univ.filter (fun i => d i = 0)) := by
    rw [Finset.disjoint_left]; intro i hi hj
    rw [Finset.mem_filter] at hj
    rw [Finset.mem_union, Finset.mem_filter, Finset.mem_filter] at hi
    rcases hi with h | h <;> linarith [h.2, hj.2]
  conv_lhs => rw [← hunion]
  rw [Finset.sum_union hd2, Finset.sum_union hd1]

name: triangleSet_inter_plane_subset_pos
statement:
theorem triangleSet_inter_plane_subset_pos {u : Triangle} {n : Point} {c : ℚ}
    {C : Set Point} (hC : Convex ℚ C)
    (hW : ∀ a ∈ ({u.v₀, u.v₁, u.v₂} : Set Point), ∀ b ∈ ({u.v₀, u.v₁, u.v₂} : Set Point),
        0 < ce n c a → ce n c b < 0 → cutPt n c a b ∈ C)
    {ι : Type} [Fintype ι] (w : ι → ℚ) (z : ι → Point) (d : ι → ℚ)
    (hd : ∀ i, d i = ce n c (z i))
    (hw0 : ∀ i, 0 ≤ w i) (hwsum : ∑ i, w i = 1) (x : Point) (hzcomb : ∑ i, w i • z i = x)
    (hzmem : ∀ i, z i ∈ ({u.v₀, u.v₁, u.v₂} : Set Point))
    (hzC0 : ∀ i, d i = 0 → z i ∈ C)
    (sp sn sz : Finset ι)
    (hspdef : sp = Finset.univ.filter (fun i => 0 < d i))
    (hsndef : sn = Finset.univ.filter (fun i => d i < 0))
    (hszdef : sz = Finset.univ.filter (fun i => d i = 0))
    (m : ℚ) (hmpos : 0 < m) (hspd : ∑ i in sp, w i * d i = m)
    (hsnd : ∑ i in sn, w i * d i = -m) : x ∈ C
proof:
:= by
  have hmne : m ≠ 0 := ne_of_gt hmpos
  have hsum3 : ∀ {M : Type} [AddCommMonoid M] (f : ι → M),
      (∑ i, f i) = ∑ i in sp, f i + ∑ i in sn, f i + ∑ i in sz, f i := by
    intro M _ f; rw [hspdef, hsndef, hszdef]; exact sum_sign_partition d f
  have hcross : ∑ p in sp ×ˢ sn,
      (w p.1 * w p.2 * (d p.1 - d p.2) / m) • cutPt n c (z p.1) (z p.2)
      = ∑ i in sp, w i • z i + ∑ j in sn, w j • z j := by
    have hterm : ∀ p ∈ sp ×ˢ sn,
        (w p.1 * w p.2 * (d p.1 - d p.2) / m) • cutPt n c (z p.1) (z p.2)
        = (-(w p.1 * w p.2 * d p.2) / m) • z p.1 + (w p.1 * w p.2 * d p.1 / m) • z p.2 := by
      intro p hp
      rw [Finset.mem_product, hspdef, hsndef, Finset.mem_filter, Finset.mem_filter] at hp
      have hk : d p.1 - d p.2 ≠ 0 := by have := hp.1.2; have := hp.2.2; linarith
      rw [cutPt, cutT, ← hd p.1, ← hd p.2]; funext t
      simp only [Pi.add_apply, Pi.smul_apply, Pi.sub_apply, smul_eq_mul]; field_simp; ring
    rw [Finset.sum_congr rfl hterm, Finset.sum_add_distrib]
    congr 1
    · rw [Finset.sum_product]; apply Finset.sum_congr rfl; intro i _; dsimp only
      rw [← Finset.sum_smul]; congr 1
      rw [show (∑ j in sn, -(w i * w j * d j) / m) = (-(w i) / m) * ∑ j in sn, w j * d j by
        rw [Finset.mul_sum]; apply Finset.sum_congr rfl; intro j _; ring, hsnd]; field_simp
    · rw [Finset.sum_product, Finset.sum_comm]; apply Finset.sum_congr rfl; intro j _; dsimp only
      rw [← Finset.sum_smul]; congr 1
      rw [show (∑ i in sp, w i * w j * d i / m) = (w j / m) * ∑ i in sp, w i * d i by
        rw [Finset.mul_sum]; apply Finset.sum_congr rfl; intro i _; ring, hspd]; field_simp
  have hWsum : ∑ p in sp ×ˢ sn, w p.1 * w p.2 * (d p.1 - d p.2) / m
      = ∑ j in sn, w j + ∑ i in sp, w i := by
    rw [← Finset.sum_div]
    have hfact : ∑ p in sp ×ˢ sn, w p.1 * w p.2 * (d p.1 - d p.2)
        = m * (∑ j in sn, w j) + (∑ i in sp, w i) * m := by
      rw [Finset.sum_product]; dsimp only
      have step : ∀ i ∈ sp, ∑ j in sn, w i * w j * (d i - d j)
          = w i * d i * (∑ j in sn, w j) - w i * (∑ j in sn, w j * d j) := by
        intro i _; rw [Finset.mul_sum, Finset.mul_sum, ← Finset.sum_sub_distrib]
        apply Finset.sum_congr rfl; intro j _; ring
      rw [Finset.sum_congr rfl step, Finset.sum_sub_distrib, ← Finset.sum_mul, ← Finset.sum_mul,
        hspd, hsnd]; ring
    rw [hfact]; field_simp; ring
  
  have hμ0 : ∀ p ∈ sp ×ˢ sn, 0 ≤ w p.1 * w p.2 * (d p.1 - d p.2) / m := by
    intro p hp
    rw [Finset.mem_product, hspdef, hsndef, Finset.mem_filter, Finset.mem_filter] at hp
    exact div_nonneg (mul_nonneg (mul_nonneg (hw0 _) (hw0 _)) (by linarith [hp.1.2, hp.2.2]))
      hmpos.le
  have hzC : ∀ i ∈ sz, z i ∈ C := by
    intro i hi; rw [hszdef, Finset.mem_filter] at hi; exact hzC0 i hi.2
  have hcutC : ∀ p ∈ sp ×ˢ sn, cutPt n c (z p.1) (z p.2) ∈ C := by
    intro p hp
    rw [Finset.mem_product, hspdef, hsndef, Finset.mem_filter, Finset.mem_filter] at hp
    exact hW (z p.1) (hzmem p.1) (z p.2) (hzmem p.2)
      (by rw [← hd]; exact hp.1.2) (by rw [← hd]; exact hp.2.2)
  have hsumW : ∑ i in sz, w i
      + ∑ p in sp ×ˢ sn, w p.1 * w p.2 * (d p.1 - d p.2) / m = 1 := by
    rw [hWsum]; have h3 := hsum3 w; rw [hwsum] at h3; linarith
  have hx : x = ∑ i in sz, w i • z i
      + ∑ p in sp ×ˢ sn, (w p.1 * w p.2 * (d p.1 - d p.2) / m) • cutPt n c (z p.1) (z p.2) := by
    rw [hcross]; have h3 := hsum3 (fun i => w i • z i); rw [hzcomb] at h3; rw [h3]; abel
  set W : ι ⊕ (ι × ι) → ℚ :=
    Sum.elim w (fun p => w p.1 * w p.2 * (d p.1 - d p.2) / m) with hWd
  set Z : ι ⊕ (ι × ι) → Point :=
    Sum.elim z (fun p => cutPt n c (z p.1) (z p.2)) with hZd
  set t : Finset (ι ⊕ (ι × ι)) :=
    sz.map ⟨Sum.inl, Sum.inl_injective⟩ ∪ (sp ×ˢ sn).map ⟨Sum.inr, Sum.inr_injective⟩ with htd
  have hdisj : Disjoint (sz.map ⟨Sum.inl, Sum.inl_injective⟩)
      ((sp ×ˢ sn).map ⟨Sum.inr, Sum.inr_injective⟩) := by
    rw [Finset.disjoint_left]; intro s hs1 hs2
    rw [Finset.mem_map] at hs1 hs2
    obtain ⟨i, _, rfl⟩ := hs1; obtain ⟨p, _, hp⟩ := hs2; cases hp
  have hsplit : ∀ {M : Type} [AddCommMonoid M] (F : ι ⊕ (ι × ι) → M),
      ∑ s in t, F s = ∑ i in sz, F (Sum.inl i) + ∑ p in sp ×ˢ sn, F (Sum.inr p) := by
    intro M _ F; rw [htd, Finset.sum_union hdisj, Finset.sum_map, Finset.sum_map]; rfl
  have hmemC : (∑ s in t, W s • Z s) ∈ C := by
    refine hC.sum_mem ?_ ?_ ?_
    · intro s hs; cases s with
      | inl i => exact hw0 i
      | inr p =>
        rw [htd, Finset.mem_union] at hs
        rcases hs with h | h
        · rw [Finset.mem_map] at h; obtain ⟨_, _, hc⟩ := h; exact absurd hc (by simp)
        · rw [Finset.mem_map] at h; obtain ⟨q, hq, hc⟩ := h
          exact Sum.inr_injective hc ▸ hμ0 q hq
    · rw [hsplit]; simp only [hWd, Sum.elim_inl, Sum.elim_inr]; exact hsumW
    · intro s hs; cases s with
      | inl i =>
        rw [htd, Finset.mem_union] at hs
        rcases hs with h | h
        · rw [Finset.mem_map] at h; obtain ⟨j, hj, hc⟩ := h
          exact Sum.inl_injective hc ▸ hzC j hj
        · rw [Finset.mem_map] at h; obtain ⟨_, _, hc⟩ := h; exact absurd hc (by simp)
      | inr p =>
        rw [htd, Finset.mem_union] at hs
        rcases hs with h | h
        · rw [Finset.mem_map] at h; obtain ⟨_, _, hc⟩ := h; exact absurd hc (by simp)
        · rw [Finset.mem_map] at h; obtain ⟨q, hq, hc⟩ := h
          exact Sum.inr_injective hc ▸ hcutC q hq
  have hxe : ∑ s in t, W s • Z s = x := by
    rw [hsplit]; simp only [hWd, hZd, Sum.elim_inl, Sum.elim_inr]; rw [hx]
  rw [← hxe]; exact hmemC

name: triangleSet_inter_plane_subset
statement:
theorem triangleSet_inter_plane_subset {u : Triangle} {n : Point} {c : ℚ}
    {C : Set Point} (hC : Convex ℚ C)
    (hZ : ∀ v ∈ ({u.v₀, u.v₁, u.v₂} : Set Point), ce n c v = 0 → v ∈ C)
    (hW : ∀ a ∈ ({u.v₀, u.v₁, u.v₂} : Set Point), ∀ b ∈ ({u.v₀, u.v₁, u.v₂} : Set Point),
        0 < ce n c a → ce n c b < 0 → cutPt n c a b ∈ C) :
    triangleSet u ∩ {x : Point | ce n c x = 0} ⊆ C
proof:
:= by
  rintro x ⟨hxtri, hxpl⟩
  simp only [Set.mem_setOf_eq] at hxpl
  rw [triangleSet, mem_convexHull_iff_exists_fintype] at hxtri
  obtain ⟨ι, hFin, w, z, hw0, hwsum, hzmem, hzcomb⟩ := hxtri
  set d : ι → ℚ := fun i => ce n c (z i) with hd
  have hzC0 : ∀ i, d i = 0 → z i ∈ C := fun i hi => hZ (z i) (hzmem i) hi
  
  have hce0 : ∑ i, w i * d i = 0 := by
    have hdot : dotQ n (∑ i, w i • z i) = ∑ i, w i * dotQ n (z i) := by
      rw [show dotQ n (∑ i, w i • z i)
          = CSG.Proof.MeshIntersectClip.dotLin n (∑ i, w i • z i) from rfl, map_sum]
      exact Finset.sum_congr rfl fun i _ => by
        rw [map_smul, smul_eq_mul, CSG.Proof.MeshIntersectClip.dotLin_apply]
    have hrw : ∑ i, w i * d i = dotQ n (∑ i, w i • z i) - c := by
      rw [hdot]
      have hstep : ∑ i, w i * d i = ∑ i, (w i * dotQ n (z i) - w i * c) := by
        apply Finset.sum_congr rfl; intro i _; rw [hd]; show w i * ce n c (z i) = _; rw [ce]; ring
      rw [hstep, Finset.sum_sub_distrib, ← Finset.sum_mul, hwsum, one_mul]
    rw [hrw, hzcomb, ← ce, hxpl]
  set sp := Finset.univ.filter (fun i => 0 < d i) with hspdef
  set sn := Finset.univ.filter (fun i => d i < 0) with hsndef
  set sz := Finset.univ.filter (fun i => d i = 0) with hszdef
  have hsum3 : ∀ {M : Type} [AddCommMonoid M] (f : ι → M),
      (∑ i, f i) = ∑ i in sp, f i + ∑ i in sn, f i + ∑ i in sz, f i := by
    intro M _ f; rw [hspdef, hsndef, hszdef]; exact sum_sign_partition d f
  set m := ∑ i in sp, w i * d i with hmdef
  have hm_nonneg : 0 ≤ m := Finset.sum_nonneg fun i hi => by
    rw [hspdef, Finset.mem_filter] at hi; exact mul_nonneg (hw0 i) (le_of_lt hi.2)
  have hsz0 : ∑ i in sz, w i * d i = 0 := by
    apply Finset.sum_eq_zero; intro i hi
    rw [hszdef, Finset.mem_filter] at hi; rw [hi.2, mul_zero]
  have hsn_eq : ∑ i in sn, w i * d i = -m := by
    have h3 := hsum3 (fun i => w i * d i)
    rw [hce0, hsz0, ← hmdef] at h3; linarith
  rcases eq_or_lt_of_le hm_nonneg with hm0 | hmpos
  · 
    have hwsp : ∀ i ∈ sp, w i = 0 := by
      have hnn : ∀ j ∈ sp, 0 ≤ w j * d j := fun j hj => by
        rw [hspdef, Finset.mem_filter] at hj; exact mul_nonneg (hw0 j) hj.2.le
      have hsum0 : ∑ j in sp, w j * d j = 0 := by rw [← hmdef, ← hm0]
      intro i hi
      have hwd := (Finset.sum_eq_zero_iff_of_nonneg hnn).mp hsum0 i hi
      rw [hspdef, Finset.mem_filter] at hi
      exact (mul_eq_zero.mp hwd).resolve_right (ne_of_gt hi.2)
    have hwsn : ∀ i ∈ sn, w i = 0 := by
      have hnn : ∀ j ∈ sn, 0 ≤ -(w j * d j) := fun j hj => by
        rw [hsndef, Finset.mem_filter] at hj
        have : w j * d j ≤ 0 := mul_nonpos_of_nonneg_of_nonpos (hw0 j) hj.2.le
        linarith
      have hsum0 : ∑ j in sn, -(w j * d j) = 0 := by
        rw [Finset.sum_neg_distrib, hsn_eq]; linarith
      intro i hi
      have hwd := (Finset.sum_eq_zero_iff_of_nonneg hnn).mp hsum0 i hi
      have : w i * d i = 0 := by linarith
      rw [hsndef, Finset.mem_filter] at hi
      exact (mul_eq_zero.mp this).resolve_right (ne_of_lt hi.2)
    have hwout : ∀ i, d i ≠ 0 → w i = 0 := by
      intro i hdi
      rcases lt_trichotomy (d i) 0 with h | h | h
      · exact hwsn i (by rw [hsndef, Finset.mem_filter]; exact ⟨Finset.mem_univ _, h⟩)
      · exact absurd h hdi
      · exact hwsp i (by rw [hspdef, Finset.mem_filter]; exact ⟨Finset.mem_univ _, h⟩)
    have hxsz : x = ∑ i in sz, w i • z i := by
      rw [← hzcomb]
      refine (Finset.sum_subset (Finset.subset_univ sz) ?_).symm
      intro i _ hinsz
      have : d i ≠ 0 := fun h0 =>
        hinsz (by rw [hszdef, Finset.mem_filter]; exact ⟨Finset.mem_univ _, h0⟩)
      rw [hwout i this, zero_smul]
    have hszsum : ∑ i in sz, w i = 1 := by
      rw [← hwsum]
      refine Finset.sum_subset (Finset.subset_univ sz) ?_
      intro i _ hinsz
      have : d i ≠ 0 := fun h0 =>
        hinsz (by rw [hszdef, Finset.mem_filter]; exact ⟨Finset.mem_univ _, h0⟩)
      exact hwout i this
    rw [hxsz]
    refine hC.sum_mem (fun i _ => hw0 i) hszsum ?_
    intro i hi
    rw [hszdef, Finset.mem_filter] at hi
    exact hzC0 i hi.2
  · 
    exact triangleSet_inter_plane_subset_pos hC hW w z d (fun i => congrFun hd i)
      hw0 hwsum x hzcomb hzmem hzC0 sp sn sz hspdef hsndef hszdef m hmpos hmdef.symm hsn_eq

name: convex_halfspace
statement:
theorem convex_halfspace (g : Point →ᵃ[ℚ] ℚ) :
    Convex ℚ {x : Point | 0 ≤ g x}
proof:
:= by
  have h : {x : Point | 0 ≤ g x} = g ⁻¹' (Set.Ici 0) := by
    ext x; simp [Set.mem_Ici]
  rw [h]
  exact (convex_Ici 0).affine_preimage g

name: convex_Hpolygon
statement:
theorem convex_Hpolygon {k : ℕ} (g : Fin k → (Point →ᵃ[ℚ] ℚ)) (P : Set Point)
    (hP : P = ⋂ i, {x | 0 ≤ g i x}) : Convex ℚ P
proof:
:= by
  rw [hP]
  exact convex_iInter (fun i => convex_halfspace (g i))

name: nonempty_of_dim2
statement:
theorem nonempty_of_dim2 (P : Set Point)
    (hdim : Module.finrank ℚ (vectorSpan ℚ P) = 2) : P.Nonempty
proof:
:= by
  by_contra h
  rw [Set.not_nonempty_iff_eq_empty] at h
  rw [h, vectorSpan_empty] at hdim
  simp at hdim

name: fan_union_subset
statement:
theorem fan_union_subset (P : Set Point) (hconv : Convex ℚ P) (u : ℕ → Point)
    {r : ℕ} (hr : 3 ≤ r) (hverts : ∀ j ∈ Finset.range r, u j ∈ P) :
    (⋃ k ∈ Finset.range (r - 2), fanTri u k) ⊆ P
proof:
:= by
  apply Set.iUnion₂_subset
  intro k hk
  rw [Finset.mem_range] at hk
  unfold fanTri
  apply convexHull_min _ hconv
  intro x hx
  simp only [Set.mem_insert_iff, Set.mem_singleton_iff] at hx
  rcases hx with rfl | rfl | rfl
  · exact hverts 0 (Finset.mem_range.mpr (by omega))
  · exact hverts (k + 1) (Finset.mem_range.mpr (by omega))
  · exact hverts (k + 2) (Finset.mem_range.mpr (by omega))

name: affineIndependent_of_cross_ne_zero
proof:
:= by
  rw [affineIndependent_iff_not_collinear_set]
  intro hcol
  
  rw [collinear_iff_of_mem (show a ∈ ({a, b, c} : Set Plane2) by simp)] at hcol
  obtain ⟨v, hv⟩ := hcol
  obtain ⟨rb, hrb⟩ := hv b (by simp)
  obtain ⟨rc, hrc⟩ := hv c (by simp)
  
  have hba : b - a = rb • v := by
    rw [hrb]; simp [vadd_eq_add]
  have hca : c - a = rc • v := by
    rw [hrc]; simp [vadd_eq_add]
  apply h
  rw [hba, hca, Proof.CrossProduct.cross_smul_left, Proof.CrossProduct.cross_smul_right,
    Proof.CrossProduct.cross_self]
  ring

name: cramer_decomp
statement:
private theorem cramer_decomp (P Q W : Plane2) (hdet : cross P Q ≠ 0) :
    W = (cross W Q / cross P Q) • P + (cross P W / cross P Q) • Q
proof:
:= by
  funext i
  rw [Pi.add_apply, Pi.smul_apply, Pi.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul, smul_eq_mul,
      div_mul_eq_mul_div, div_mul_eq_mul_div, div_add_div_same, eq_div_iff hdet]
  fin_cases i <;> simp only [cross, Fin.isValue, Fin.mk_zero, Fin.mk_one] <;> ring

name: exists_bracket_index
proof:
:= by
  classical
  
  
  set S : Finset ℕ := (Finset.range (r - 2)).filter (fun i => 0 ≤ σ (i + 1)) with hS
  have h0S : 0 ∈ S := by
    rw [hS, Finset.mem_filter, Finset.mem_range]
    exact ⟨by omega, by simpa using h1⟩
  have hSne : S.Nonempty := ⟨0, h0S⟩
  set i := S.max' hSne with hi
  have hiS : i ∈ S := S.max'_mem hSne
  rw [hS, Finset.mem_filter, Finset.mem_range] at hiS
  obtain ⟨hilt, hiσ⟩ := hiS
  
  refine ⟨i, hilt, hiσ, ?_⟩
  
  rcases Nat.lt_or_ge (i + 1) (r - 2) with hlt | hge
  · 
    by_contra hpos
    push_neg at hpos
    have hmem : (i + 1) ∈ S := by
      rw [hS, Finset.mem_filter, Finset.mem_range]
      exact ⟨hlt, le_of_lt hpos⟩
    have := S.le_max' (i + 1) hmem
    omega
  · 
    have heq : i + 2 = r - 1 := by omega
    rw [heq]; exact hlast

name: mem_tri_of_bary
statement:
private theorem mem_tri_of_bary {a b c x : Plane2} {γ α β : ℚ}
    (hγ : 0 ≤ γ) (hα : 0 ≤ α) (hβ : 0 ≤ β) (hsum : γ + α + β = 1)
    (hx : x = γ • a + α • b + β • c) :
    x ∈ convexHull ℚ ({a, b, c} : Set Plane2)
proof:
:= by
  refine mem_convexHull_of_exists_fintype (![γ, α, β]) (![a, b, c]) ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_
  · intro i
    fin_cases i
    · simpa using hγ
    · simpa using hα
    · simpa using hβ
  · simp only [Fin.sum_univ_three, Matrix.cons_val_zero, Matrix.cons_val_one,
      Matrix.head_cons, Matrix.cons_val_two, Matrix.tail_cons]; linarith [hsum]
  · intro i; fin_cases i <;> simp
  · simp only [Fin.sum_univ_three, Matrix.cons_val_zero, Matrix.cons_val_one,
      Matrix.head_cons, Matrix.cons_val_two, Matrix.tail_cons]
    rw [hx]

name: bounded_box_of_simplex_bound
statement:
theorem bounded_box_of_simplex_bound (iota : Plane2 →ᵃ[ℚ] Point)
    (iotaInv : Point →ᵃ[ℚ] Plane2) (hiotaInv : ∀ y : Plane2, iotaInv (iota y) = y)
    (P' : Set Plane2) (P : Set Point) (hPP' : iota '' P' = P)
    (hbdd : ∃ (t : Triangle), P ⊆ simplex t) :
    ∃ (R : ℚ), P' ⊆ {y | |y 0| ≤ R ∧ |y 1| ≤ R}
proof:
:= by
  classical
  obtain ⟨t, ht⟩ := hbdd
  
  set q : Fin 4 → Plane2 := ![iotaInv 0, iotaInv t.v₀, iotaInv t.v₁, iotaInv t.v₂] with hq
  
  set R : ℚ := Finset.univ.sup' ⟨0, Finset.mem_univ 0⟩
      (fun i : Fin 4 => max |q i 0| |q i 1|) with hR
  refine ⟨R, ?_⟩
  
  have hP'sub : P' ⊆ iotaInv '' (simplex t) := by
    intro y hy
    have hyP : iota y ∈ P := hPP' ▸ ⟨y, hy, rfl⟩
    have hsimp : iota y ∈ simplex t := ht hyP
    exact ⟨iota y, hsimp, hiotaInv y⟩
  
  have himg : iotaInv '' (simplex t)
      = convexHull ℚ (iotaInv '' ({0, t.v₀, t.v₁, t.v₂} : Set Point)) := by
    rw [simplex]
    exact AffineMap.image_convexHull iotaInv _
  
  have hboxconv : Convex ℚ {y : Plane2 | |y 0| ≤ R ∧ |y 1| ≤ R} := by
    have h0 : {y : Plane2 | |y 0| ≤ R} = (fun y : Plane2 => y 0) ⁻¹' (Set.Icc (-R) R) := by
      ext y; simp [abs_le]
    have h1 : {y : Plane2 | |y 1| ≤ R} = (fun y : Plane2 => y 1) ⁻¹' (Set.Icc (-R) R) := by
      ext y; simp [abs_le]
    have hc0 : Convex ℚ {y : Plane2 | |y 0| ≤ R} := by
      rw [h0]
      exact (convex_Icc (-R) R).linear_preimage (LinearMap.proj (R := ℚ) (φ := fun _ => ℚ) 0)
    have hc1 : Convex ℚ {y : Plane2 | |y 1| ≤ R} := by
      rw [h1]
      exact (convex_Icc (-R) R).linear_preimage (LinearMap.proj (R := ℚ) (φ := fun _ => ℚ) 1)
    have : {y : Plane2 | |y 0| ≤ R ∧ |y 1| ≤ R}
        = {y : Plane2 | |y 0| ≤ R} ∩ {y : Plane2 | |y 1| ≤ R} := by
      ext y; simp [Set.mem_inter_iff]
    rw [this]; exact hc0.inter hc1
  
  have hverts : (iotaInv '' ({0, t.v₀, t.v₁, t.v₂} : Set Point))
      ⊆ {y : Plane2 | |y 0| ≤ R ∧ |y 1| ≤ R} := by
    rintro y ⟨x, hx, rfl⟩
    
    have hi : ∃ i : Fin 4, iotaInv x = q i := by
      simp only [Set.mem_insert_iff, Set.mem_singleton_iff] at hx
      rcases hx with rfl | rfl | rfl | rfl
      · exact ⟨0, rfl⟩
      · exact ⟨1, rfl⟩
      · exact ⟨2, rfl⟩
      · exact ⟨3, rfl⟩
    obtain ⟨i, hi⟩ := hi
    rw [hi]
    have hle : max |q i 0| |q i 1| ≤ R :=
      Finset.le_sup' (fun i : Fin 4 => max |q i 0| |q i 1|) (Finset.mem_univ i)
    exact ⟨le_trans (le_max_left _ _) hle, le_trans (le_max_right _ _) hle⟩
  
  intro y hy
  have : y ∈ convexHull ℚ (iotaInv '' ({0, t.v₀, t.v₁, t.v₂} : Set Point)) := by
    rw [← himg]; exact hP'sub hy
  exact convexHull_min hverts hboxconv this

name: fan_nondeg_of_orderA
statement:
private theorem fan_nondeg_of_orderA (iota : Plane2 →ᵃ[ℚ] Point)
    (hiotaLin : Function.Injective iota.linear)
    {r : ℕ} (_hr : 3 ≤ r) (u' : ℕ → Plane2)
    (horderA : ∀ k, k < r - 2 → 0 < cross (u' (k + 1) - u' 0) (u' (k + 2) - u' 0))
    {k : ℕ} (hk : k ∈ Finset.range (r - 2)) :
    AffineIndependent ℚ
      ![iota (u' 0), iota (u' (k + 1)), iota (u' (k + 2))]
proof:
:= by
  rw [Finset.mem_range] at hk
  
  
  have hcross : cross (u' (k + 1) - u' 0) (u' (k + 2) - u' 0) ≠ 0 :=
    ne_of_gt (horderA k hk)
  have hai : AffineIndependent ℚ ![u' 0, u' (k + 1), u' (k + 2)] :=
    affineIndependent_of_cross_ne_zero hcross
  
  have := (Proof.PlaneIso.affineIndependent_image_iff iota hiotaLin
    ![u' 0, u' (k + 1), u' (k + 2)]).mpr hai
  
  convert this using 1
  funext i
  fin_cases i <;> rfl

name: convexHull_le_halfplane
proof:
:= by
  have hconv : Convex ℚ {y : Plane2 | cross d (y - base) ≤ c} := by
    have heq : {y : Plane2 | cross d (y - base) ≤ c}
        = (crossL d) ⁻¹' (Set.Iic (c + cross d base)) := by
      ext y
      simp only [Set.mem_setOf_eq, Set.mem_preimage, Set.mem_Iic, crossL,
        LinearMap.coe_mk, AddHom.coe_mk]
      rw [Proof.CrossProduct.cross_sub_right]
      constructor <;> intro h <;> linarith
    rw [heq]; exact (convex_Iic _).linear_preimage (crossL d)
  exact convexHull_min hS hconv

name: convexHull_ge_halfplane
proof:
:= by
  have hconv : Convex ℚ {y : Plane2 | c ≤ cross d (y - base)} := by
    have heq : {y : Plane2 | c ≤ cross d (y - base)}
        = (crossL d) ⁻¹' (Set.Ici (c + cross d base)) := by
      ext y
      simp only [Set.mem_setOf_eq, Set.mem_preimage, Set.mem_Ici, crossL,
        LinearMap.coe_mk, AddHom.coe_mk]
      rw [Proof.CrossProduct.cross_sub_right]
      constructor <;> intro h <;> linarith
    rw [heq]; exact (convex_Ici _).linear_preimage (crossL d)
  exact convexHull_min hS hconv

name: fan_cover_subset_of_order
statement:
private theorem fan_cover_subset_of_order (iota : Plane2 →ᵃ[ℚ] Point)
    (_hiotaLin : Function.Injective iota.linear)
    (P' : Set Plane2) (P : Set Point) (hPP' : iota '' P' = P)
    {m : ℕ} (g : Fin m → (Plane2 →ᵃ[ℚ] ℚ)) (hP' : P' = ⋂ i, {y | 0 ≤ g i y})
    (V : Finset Plane2) (hVeq : P' = convexHull ℚ (↑V : Set Plane2))
    (_hVP : (↑V : Set Plane2) ⊆ P')
    (hext : ∀ v ∈ V, v ∈ Set.extremePoints ℚ P')
    (hcoll : ∀ a ∈ V, ∀ b ∈ V, ∀ cc ∈ V, a ≠ b → a ≠ cc → b ≠ cc →
      AffineIndependent ℚ ![a, b, cc])
    {r : ℕ} (hr : 3 ≤ r) (u' : ℕ → Plane2)
    (_henum : ∀ v ∈ V, ∃ j, j < r ∧ u' j = v)
    (hmem : ∀ j, j < r → u' j ∈ V)
    {c : Plane2}
    (hcfeas : ∀ i, Proof.HpolytopeVertex.NonVacuous (g i) → 0 < g i c)
    (hMc : ∀ i, i < r → 0 < cross (u' i - c) (u' ((i + 1) % r) - c))
    (hconsec : ∀ i, i < r → ∀ w ∈ V, w ≠ u' i → w ≠ u' ((i + 1) % r) →
      ¬ (0 < cross (u' i - c) (w - c) ∧ 0 < cross (w - c) (u' ((i + 1) % r) - c)))
    (horderA : ∀ k, k < r - 2 → 0 < cross (u' (k + 1) - u' 0) (u' (k + 2) - u' 0))
    (_horderB : ∀ k k' j : ℕ, k < r - 2 → k' < r - 2 → k < k' → (j = 1 ∨ j = 2) →
        0 ≤ cross (u' (k + 2) - u' 0) (u' (k' + j) - u' 0)) :
    P ⊆ ⋃ k ∈ Finset.range (r - 2), fanTri (fun n => iota (u' n)) k
proof:
:= by
  
  
  
  
  
  have htri : ∀ cc : ℕ, fanTri (fun nn => iota (u' nn)) cc
      = iota '' (convexHull ℚ ({u' 0, u' (cc + 1), u' (cc + 2)} : Set Plane2)) := by
    intro cc
    unfold fanTri
    rw [Proof.PlaneIso.image_convexHull]
    congr 1
    rw [Set.image_insert_eq, Set.image_insert_eq, Set.image_singleton]
  
  
  
  
  have hedge : ∀ i, i < r → ∀ y ∈ convexHull ℚ (↑V : Set Plane2),
      0 ≤ cross (u' ((i + 1) % r) - u' i) (y - u' i) := by
    intro i hi y hy
    
    have hsupp : ∀ w ∈ V,
        0 ≤ cross (u' ((i + 1) % r) - u' i) (w - u' i) :=
      Proof.CyclicOrder.edge_support g P' hP' V hVeq hext hcoll hcfeas
        (hmem i hi) (hmem ((i + 1) % r) (Nat.mod_lt _ (by omega)))
        (hMc i hi) (hconsec i hi)
    exact convexHull_ge_halfplane (u' ((i + 1) % r) - u' i) (u' i) 0 (↑V : Set Plane2)
      (fun w hw => hsupp w hw) y hy
  have q2cover : convexHull ℚ (↑V : Set Plane2)
      ⊆ ⋃ k ∈ Finset.range (r - 2),
          convexHull ℚ ({u' 0, u' (k + 1), u' (k + 2)} : Set Plane2) := by
    
    
    
    
    
    
    
    
    intro x hxV
    
    set z : Plane2 := x - u' 0 with hz
    set σ : ℕ → ℚ := fun j => cross (u' j - u' 0) z with hσ
    
    have hmod0 : (0 + 1) % r = 1 := by
      have : (1 : ℕ) % r = 1 := Nat.mod_eq_of_lt (by omega)
      simpa using this
    have hmodlast : (r - 1 + 1) % r = 0 := by
      have hrr : r - 1 + 1 = r := by omega
      rw [hrr, Nat.mod_self]
    
    have hσ1 : 0 ≤ σ 1 := by
      have := hedge 0 (by omega) x hxV
      rw [hmod0] at this
      simpa [hσ, hz] using this
    
    have hσlast : σ (r - 1) ≤ 0 := by
      have hge := hedge (r - 1) (by omega) x hxV
      rw [hmodlast] at hge
      
      have hid : cross (u' 0 - u' (r - 1)) (x - u' (r - 1))
          = - cross (u' (r - 1) - u' 0) z := by
        rw [hz]; simp only [cross, Pi.sub_apply]; ring
      rw [hid] at hge
      have : 0 ≤ - cross (u' (r - 1) - u' 0) z := hge
      simp only [hσ]; linarith
    
    obtain ⟨k, hklt, hbk1, hbk2⟩ := exists_bracket_index hr σ hσ1 hσlast
    
    set d1 : Plane2 := u' (k + 1) - u' 0 with hd1
    set d2 : Plane2 := u' (k + 2) - u' 0 with hd2
    set det : ℚ := cross d1 d2 with hdet
    have hdetpos : 0 < det := by rw [hdet, hd1, hd2]; exact horderA k hklt
    have hdetne : det ≠ 0 := ne_of_gt hdetpos
    
    set α : ℚ := cross z d2 / det with hα
    set β : ℚ := cross d1 z / det with hβ
    have hzcomb : z = α • d1 + β • d2 := by
      have := cramer_decomp d1 d2 z hdetne
      rw [← hdet] at this; rw [hα, hβ]; exact this
    
    have hβnn : 0 ≤ β := by
      rw [hβ]
      have : cross d1 z = σ (k + 1) := by rw [hσ, hd1]
      rw [this]; exact div_nonneg hbk1 (le_of_lt hdetpos)
    have hαnn : 0 ≤ α := by
      rw [hα]
      have hzd2 : cross z d2 = - σ (k + 2) := by
        rw [hσ, hd2]; rw [Proof.CrossProduct.cross_antisymm z d2]
      rw [hzd2]
      exact div_nonneg (by linarith) (le_of_lt hdetpos)
    
    have hαβ : α + β ≤ 1 := by
      
      
      have hk1lt : k + 1 < r := by omega
      have hmodk : (k + 1 + 1) % r = k + 2 := by
        have : k + 1 + 1 = k + 2 := rfl
        rw [this]; exact Nat.mod_eq_of_lt (by omega)
      have hsx := hedge (k + 1) hk1lt x hxV
      rw [hmodk] at hsx
      
      
      have hxp : x - u' (k + 1) = (α - 1) • d1 + β • d2 := by
        have : x - u' (k + 1) = z - d1 := by rw [hz, hd1]; abel
        rw [this, hzcomb]
        rw [sub_smul, one_smul]; abel
      have hqp : u' (k + 2) - u' (k + 1) = d2 - d1 := by rw [hd1, hd2]; abel
      have hbil : cross (u' (k + 2) - u' (k + 1)) (x - u' (k + 1))
          = det * (1 - α - β) := by
        rw [hqp, hxp, hdet]
        simp only [cross, Pi.sub_apply, Pi.add_apply, Pi.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul,
          hd1, hd2]
        ring
      rw [hbil] at hsx
      
      nlinarith [hsx, hdetpos, mul_pos hdetpos (show (0:ℚ) < 1 by norm_num)]
    
    refine Set.mem_iUnion₂.mpr ⟨k, Finset.mem_range.mpr hklt, ?_⟩
    set γ : ℚ := 1 - α - β with hγ
    have hγnn : 0 ≤ γ := by rw [hγ]; linarith
    have hxbary : x = γ • u' 0 + α • u' (k + 1) + β • u' (k + 2) := by
      have hzc : x - u' 0 = α • (u' (k + 1) - u' 0) + β • (u' (k + 2) - u' 0) := by
        rw [← hd1, ← hd2, ← hzcomb, hz]
      have : x = u' 0 + (α • (u' (k + 1) - u' 0) + β • (u' (k + 2) - u' 0)) := by
        rw [← hzc]; abel
      rw [this, hγ]
      simp only [smul_sub]
      funext idx
      simp only [Pi.add_apply, Pi.sub_apply, Pi.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul]
      ring
    exact mem_tri_of_bary hγnn hαnn hβnn (by rw [hγ]; ring) hxbary
  
  intro x hxP
  rw [← hPP'] at hxP
  obtain ⟨y, hyP', rfl⟩ := hxP
  rw [hVeq] at hyP'
  obtain ⟨S, hSrange, hyS⟩ := Set.mem_iUnion₂.mp (q2cover hyP')
  refine Set.mem_iUnion₂.mpr ⟨S, hSrange, ?_⟩
  rw [htri S]
  exact ⟨y, hyS, rfl⟩

name: tri_on_vertexline_subset_edge
statement:
private theorem tri_on_vertexline_subset_edge
    {base p q : Plane2}
    (hp : cross (q - base) (p - base) < 0)
    {y : Plane2}
    (hy : y ∈ convexHull ℚ ({base, p, q} : Set Plane2))
    (hline : cross (q - base) (y - base) = 0) :
    y ∈ convexHull ℚ ({base, q} : Set Plane2)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  set d := q - base with hd
  
  rw [mem_convexHull_iff_exists_fintype] at hy
  obtain ⟨ι, hFin, w, z, hw0, hwsum, hzmem, hzcomb⟩ := hy
  
  have hsub : y - base = ∑ i, w i • (z i - base) := by
    rw [← hzcomb]
    have hb : (∑ i, w i • z i) - base = (∑ i, w i • z i) - (∑ i, w i) • base := by
      rw [hwsum, one_smul]
    rw [hb, Finset.sum_smul, ← Finset.sum_sub_distrib]
    exact Finset.sum_congr rfl fun i _ => by rw [smul_sub]
  have hkey : cross d (y - base) = ∑ i, w i * cross d (z i - base) := by
    have hcL : ∀ v : Plane2, cross d v = crossL d v := fun v => rfl
    rw [hcL, hsub, map_sum (crossL d)]
    exact Finset.sum_congr rfl fun i _ => by
      simp only [map_smul, smul_eq_mul, hcL]
  
  have hterm_nonpos : ∀ i, w i * cross d (z i - base) ≤ 0 := by
    intro i
    have hzi : cross d (z i - base) ≤ 0 := by
      have hm := hzmem i
      simp only [Set.mem_insert_iff, Set.mem_singleton_iff] at hm
      rcases hm with h | h | h
      · rw [h, sub_self]; simp [Proof.CrossProduct.cross]
      · rw [h]; exact le_of_lt hp
      · rw [h]; rw [show q - base = d from hd.symm, Proof.CrossProduct.cross_self _]
    exact mul_nonpos_of_nonneg_of_nonpos (hw0 i) hzi
  
  have hsum0 : ∑ i, w i * cross d (z i - base) = 0 := by rw [← hkey]; exact hline
  have hterm0 : ∀ i, w i * cross d (z i - base) = 0 := by
    have h := (Finset.sum_eq_zero_iff_of_nonpos (fun i _ => hterm_nonpos i)).mp hsum0
    exact fun i => h i (Finset.mem_univ i)
  
  have hwp : ∀ i, z i = p → w i = 0 := by
    intro i hzip
    have := hterm0 i
    rw [hzip] at this
    rcases mul_eq_zero.mp this with h | h
    · exact h
    · exact absurd h (ne_of_lt hp)
  
  set z' : ι → Plane2 := fun i => if z i = p then base else z i with hz'
  have hz'mem : ∀ i, z' i ∈ ({base, q} : Set Plane2) := by
    intro i
    simp only [hz']
    by_cases h : z i = p
    · rw [if_pos h]; exact Set.mem_insert _ _
    · rw [if_neg h]
      have hm := hzmem i
      simp only [Set.mem_insert_iff, Set.mem_singleton_iff] at hm
      rcases hm with hb | hp' | hq
      · rw [hb]; exact Set.mem_insert _ _
      · exact absurd hp' h
      · rw [hq]; exact Set.mem_insert_of_mem _ rfl
  have hcomb' : ∑ i, w i • z' i = y := by
    rw [← hzcomb]
    apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
    intro i _
    simp only [hz']
    by_cases h : z i = p
    · rw [if_pos h, hwp i h, zero_smul, zero_smul]
    · rw [if_neg h]
  rw [← hcomb']
  exact mem_convexHull_of_exists_fintype w z' hw0 hwsum hz'mem rfl

name: fan_disjoint_q2_core
statement:
private theorem fan_disjoint_q2_core
    {r : ℕ} (u' : ℕ → Plane2)
    (horderA : ∀ k, k < r - 2 → 0 < cross (u' (k + 1) - u' 0) (u' (k + 2) - u' 0))
    (horderB : ∀ k k' j : ℕ, k < r - 2 → k' < r - 2 → k < k' → (j = 1 ∨ j = 2) →
        0 ≤ cross (u' (k + 2) - u' 0) (u' (k' + j) - u' 0))
    {m M : ℕ} (hm : m < r - 2) (hM : M < r - 2) (hmM : m < M) :
    convexHull ℚ ({u' 0, u' (m + 1), u' (m + 2)} : Set Plane2)
        ∩ convexHull ℚ ({u' 0, u' (M + 1), u' (M + 2)} : Set Plane2)
      ⊆ convexHull ℚ ({u' 0, u' (m + 2)} : Set Plane2)
proof:
:= by
  set d := u' (m + 2) - u' 0 with hd
  rintro y ⟨hya, hyb⟩
  
  have hp : cross d (u' (m + 1) - u' 0) < 0 := by
    have := horderA m hm
    rw [hd, Proof.CrossProduct.cross_antisymm]
    linarith
  
  have hle : cross d (y - u' 0) ≤ 0 := by
    apply convexHull_le_halfplane d (u' 0) 0 _ _ _ hya
    intro s hs
    simp only [Set.mem_insert_iff, Set.mem_singleton_iff] at hs
    rcases hs with h | h | h
    · rw [h, sub_self]; simp [Proof.CrossProduct.cross]
    · rw [h]; exact le_of_lt hp
    · rw [h, ← hd]; rw [Proof.CrossProduct.cross_self]
  
  have hge : 0 ≤ cross d (y - u' 0) := by
    apply convexHull_ge_halfplane d (u' 0) 0 _ _ _ hyb
    intro s hs
    simp only [Set.mem_insert_iff, Set.mem_singleton_iff] at hs
    rcases hs with h | h | h
    · rw [h, sub_self]; simp [Proof.CrossProduct.cross]
    · rw [h, hd]; exact horderB m M 1 hm hM hmM (Or.inl rfl)
    · rw [h, hd]; exact horderB m M 2 hm hM hmM (Or.inr rfl)
  
  have hline : cross d (y - u' 0) = 0 := le_antisymm hle hge
  
  exact tri_on_vertexline_subset_edge (base := u' 0) (p := u' (m + 1)) (q := u' (m + 2))
    (by rw [← hd]; exact hp) hya hline

name: fan_disjoint_of_order
statement:
private theorem fan_disjoint_of_order (iota : Plane2 →ᵃ[ℚ] Point)
    (hiotaLin : Function.Injective iota.linear)
    {r : ℕ} (_hr : 3 ≤ r) (u' : ℕ → Plane2)
    (horderA : ∀ k, k < r - 2 → 0 < cross (u' (k + 1) - u' 0) (u' (k + 2) - u' 0))
    (horderB : ∀ k k' j : ℕ, k < r - 2 → k' < r - 2 → k < k' → (j = 1 ∨ j = 2) →
        0 ≤ cross (u' (k + 2) - u' 0) (u' (k' + j) - u' 0)) :
    ∀ a ∈ Finset.range (r - 2), ∀ b ∈ Finset.range (r - 2), a ≠ b →
      fanTri (fun n => iota (u' n)) a ∩ fanTri (fun n => iota (u' n)) b
        ⊆ fanEdges r (fun n => iota (u' n))
proof:
:= by
  
  have hinj : Function.Injective iota :=
    Proof.PlaneIso.injective_of_linear_injective iota hiotaLin
  
  have htri : ∀ c : ℕ, fanTri (fun nn => iota (u' nn)) c
      = iota '' (convexHull ℚ ({u' 0, u' (c + 1), u' (c + 2)} : Set Plane2)) := by
    intro c
    unfold fanTri
    rw [Proof.PlaneIso.image_convexHull]
    congr 1
    rw [Set.image_insert_eq, Set.image_insert_eq, Set.image_singleton]
  
  have htrans : ∀ (n : ℕ), n + 1 ∈ Finset.range (r - 2) → ∀ {z : Point},
      z ∈ iota '' (convexHull ℚ ({u' 0, u' (n + 2)} : Set Plane2)) →
      z ∈ fanEdges r (fun nn => iota (u' nn)) := by
    intro n hn z hz
    have himg : iota '' (convexHull ℚ ({u' 0, u' (n + 2)} : Set Plane2))
        = convexHull ℚ ({iota (u' 0), iota (u' (n + 2))} : Set Point) := by
      rw [Proof.PlaneIso.image_convexHull]
      congr 1
      rw [Set.image_insert_eq, Set.image_singleton]
    rw [himg] at hz
    
    refine Set.mem_iUnion₂.mpr ⟨n + 1, hn, ?_⟩
    apply Set.mem_union_left
    simpa using hz
  
  intro a ha b hb hab x hx
  rw [Finset.mem_range] at ha hb
  obtain ⟨hxa, hxb⟩ := hx
  
  rw [htri a] at hxa
  obtain ⟨y, hya, hxeq⟩ := hxa
  
  have hyb : y ∈ convexHull ℚ ({u' 0, u' (b + 1), u' (b + 2)} : Set Plane2) := by
    rw [htri b] at hxb
    obtain ⟨y0, hy0, hy0eq⟩ := hxb
    have : y0 = y := hinj (by rw [hy0eq, hxeq])
    rwa [← this]
  
  rcases lt_or_gt_of_ne hab with hlt | hgt
  · have hcore := fan_disjoint_q2_core u' horderA horderB ha hb hlt ⟨hya, hyb⟩
    exact htrans a (Finset.mem_range.mpr (by omega)) ⟨y, hcore, hxeq⟩
  · have hcore := fan_disjoint_q2_core u' horderA horderB hb ha hgt ⟨hyb, hya⟩
    exact htrans b (Finset.mem_range.mpr (by omega)) ⟨y, hcore, hxeq⟩

name: exists_cyclic_fan
statement:
private theorem exists_cyclic_fan
    {k : ℕ} (g : Fin k → (Point →ᵃ[ℚ] ℚ)) (P : Set Point)
    (_hconv : Convex ℚ P) (_hne : P.Nonempty)
    (hP : P = ⋂ i, {x | 0 ≤ g i x})
    (hbdd : ∃ (t : Triangle), P ⊆ simplex t)
    (hdim : Module.finrank ℚ (vectorSpan ℚ P) = 2) :
    ∃ (r : ℕ) (u : ℕ → Point), 3 ≤ r
      ∧ (∀ j ∈ Finset.range r, u j ∈ P)
      ∧ P ⊆ ⋃ k ∈ Finset.range (r - 2), fanTri u k
      ∧ (∀ a ∈ Finset.range (r - 2), ∀ b ∈ Finset.range (r - 2), a ≠ b →
          fanTri u a ∩ fanTri u b ⊆ fanEdges r u)
      ∧ (∀ k ∈ Finset.range (r - 2),
          AffineIndependent ℚ ![u 0, u (k + 1), u (k + 2)])
proof:
:= by
  classical
  
  
  obtain ⟨iota, iotaInv, g', P', hiotaLin, _hrange, hiotaInv, hP'eq, _hg'comp, hPP', hdim'⟩ :=
    Proof.PlaneIso.plane_iso g P hP hdim
  
  have hbox : ∃ (R : ℚ), P' ⊆ {y | |y 0| ≤ R ∧ |y 1| ≤ R} :=
    bounded_box_of_simplex_bound iota iotaInv hiotaInv P' P hPP' hbdd
  
  obtain ⟨V, hVconv, hVP', hVcard, hVcoll, hVext⟩ :=
    Proof.HpolytopeVertex.exists_convexPosition_vertexFinset g' P' hP'eq hbox hdim'
  
  
  obtain ⟨r, u', hrcard, hr3, hmem, henum, hcoll', horderA, horderB,
      c, hcfeas, hMc, hconsec⟩ :=
    Proof.CyclicOrder.exists_ordered_vertices g' P' hP'eq V hVconv hVP' hVcard
      hVcoll hVext hdim'
  
  refine ⟨r, fun n => iota (u' n), hr3, ?_hverts, ?_hsub, ?_hdisj, ?_hnondeg⟩
  · 
    intro j hj
    rw [Finset.mem_range] at hj
    have : u' j ∈ P' := hVP' (hmem j hj)
    rw [← hPP']
    exact ⟨u' j, this, rfl⟩
  · 
    exact fan_cover_subset_of_order iota hiotaLin P' P hPP' g' hP'eq V hVconv hVP'
      hVext hVcoll hr3 u' henum hmem hcfeas hMc hconsec horderA horderB
  · 
    exact fan_disjoint_of_order iota hiotaLin hr3 u' horderA horderB
  · 
    intro k hk
    exact fan_nondeg_of_orderA iota hiotaLin hr3 u' horderA hk

name: bounded_rational_planar_Hpolygon_has_cyclic_vertex_list
statement:
theorem bounded_rational_planar_Hpolygon_has_cyclic_vertex_list
    {k : ℕ} (g : Fin k → (Point →ᵃ[ℚ] ℚ)) (P : Set Point)
    (hP : P = ⋂ i, {x | 0 ≤ g i x})
    (hbdd : ∃ (t : Triangle), P ⊆ simplex t)
    (hdim : Module.finrank ℚ (vectorSpan ℚ P) = 2) :
    ∃ (r : ℕ) (u : ℕ → Point), 3 ≤ r
      ∧ P = ⋃ k ∈ Finset.range (r - 2), fanTri u k
      ∧ (∀ a ∈ Finset.range (r - 2), ∀ b ∈ Finset.range (r - 2), a ≠ b →
          fanTri u a ∩ fanTri u b ⊆ fanEdges r u)
      ∧ (∀ k ∈ Finset.range (r - 2),
          AffineIndependent ℚ ![u 0, u (k + 1), u (k + 2)])
proof:
:= by
  
  
  have hconv := convex_Hpolygon g P hP
  obtain ⟨r, u, hr, hverts, hsub, hdisj, hnondeg⟩ :=
    exists_cyclic_fan g P hconv (nonempty_of_dim2 P hdim) hP hbdd hdim
  refine ⟨r, u, hr, ?_, hdisj, hnondeg⟩
  
  
  exact Set.Subset.antisymm hsub (fan_union_subset P hconv u hr hverts)

name: convexPolygonFan_partition
statement:
theorem convexPolygonFan_partition (P : Set Point)
    {r : ℕ} (_hr : 3 ≤ r) (u : ℕ → Point)
    (hcover : P = ⋃ k ∈ Finset.range (r - 2), fanTri u k)
    (hdisj : ∀ k ∈ Finset.range (r - 2), ∀ k' ∈ Finset.range (r - 2), k ≠ k' →
      fanTri u k ∩ fanTri u k' ⊆ fanEdges r u)
    (hnondeg : ∀ k ∈ Finset.range (r - 2),
      AffineIndependent ℚ ![u 0, u (k + 1), u (k + 2)]) :
    (P = ⋃ k ∈ Finset.range (r - 2), fanTri u k)
      ∧ (∀ k ∈ Finset.range (r - 2), ∀ k' ∈ Finset.range (r - 2), k ≠ k' →
          fanTri u k ∩ fanTri u k' ⊆ fanEdges r u)
      ∧ (∀ k ∈ Finset.range (r - 2),
          AffineIndependent ℚ ![u 0, u (k + 1), u (k + 2)])
      ∧ (∀ x ∈ P, x ∉ fanEdges r u →
          ∃! k, k ∈ Finset.range (r - 2) ∧ x ∈ fanTri u k)
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨hcover, hdisj, hnondeg, ?_partition⟩
  · 
    
    intro x hxP hxE
    
    have hxU : x ∈ ⋃ k ∈ Finset.range (r - 2), fanTri u k := hcover ▸ hxP
    rw [Set.mem_iUnion₂] at hxU
    obtain ⟨k, hk, hxk⟩ := hxU
    refine ⟨k, ⟨hk, hxk⟩, ?_⟩
    
    rintro k' ⟨hk', hxk'⟩
    by_contra hne
    exact hxE (hdisj k' hk' k hk hne ⟨hxk', hxk⟩)

name: exit_cell_fan_of_data
statement:
theorem exit_cell_fan_of_data
    (iota : Plane2 →ᵃ[ℚ] Point) (hiotaLin : Function.Injective iota.linear)
    (iotaInv : Point →ᵃ[ℚ] Plane2) (hiotaInv : ∀ y : Plane2, iotaInv (iota y) = y)
    (P : Set Point) (hconv : Convex ℚ P) (hbdd : ∃ (tB : Triangle), P ⊆ simplex tB)
    (P' : Set Plane2) (hPP' : iota '' P' = P)
    {k : ℕ} (g' : Fin k → (Plane2 →ᵃ[ℚ] ℚ)) (hP'eq : P' = ⋂ j, {y | 0 ≤ g' j y})
    (V : Finset Plane2) (hVeq : P' = convexHull ℚ (↑V : Set Plane2))
    (hVP : (↑V : Set Plane2) ⊆ P')
    (hext : ∀ v ∈ V, v ∈ Set.extremePoints ℚ P')
    (hcoll : ∀ a ∈ V, ∀ b ∈ V, ∀ cc ∈ V, a ≠ b → a ≠ cc → b ≠ cc →
      AffineIndependent ℚ ![a, b, cc])
    (r : ℕ) (hr : 3 ≤ r) (u' : ℕ → Plane2)
    (hmem : ∀ i, i < r → u' i ∈ V) (henum : ∀ v ∈ V, ∃ j, j < r ∧ u' j = v)
    (hnodup : ∀ i j, i < r → j < r → i ≠ j → u' i ≠ u' j)
    {c : Plane2}
    (hcfeas : ∀ j, Proof.HpolytopeVertex.NonVacuous (g' j) → 0 < g' j c)
    (hMc : ∀ i, i < r → 0 < cross (u' i - c) (u' ((i + 1) % r) - c))
    (hconsec : ∀ i, i < r → ∀ w ∈ V, w ≠ u' i → w ≠ u' ((i + 1) % r) →
      ¬ (0 < cross (u' i - c) (w - c) ∧ 0 < cross (w - c) (u' ((i + 1) % r) - c))) :
    (∀ k' ∈ Finset.range (r - 2),
        AffineIndependent ℚ ![iota (u' 0), iota (u' (k' + 1)), iota (u' (k' + 2))])
      ∧ (P = ⋃ k' ∈ Finset.range (r - 2),
          convexHull ℚ {iota (u' 0), iota (u' (k' + 1)), iota (u' (k' + 2))})
      ∧ (∀ a ∈ Finset.range (r - 2), ∀ b ∈ Finset.range (r - 2), a ≠ b →
          fanTri (fun n => iota (u' n)) a ∩ fanTri (fun n => iota (u' n)) b
            ⊆ fanEdges r (fun n => iota (u' n)))
proof:
:= by
  classical
  
  
  have _hbox : ∃ (R : ℚ), P' ⊆ {y | |y 0| ≤ R ∧ |y 1| ≤ R} :=
    bounded_box_of_simplex_bound iota iotaInv hiotaInv P' P hPP' hbdd
  
  have horderA : ∀ kk, kk < r - 2 →
      0 < cross (u' (kk + 1) - u' 0) (u' (kk + 2) - u' 0) := by
    intro kk hkk
    exact Proof.CyclicOrder.order_A g' P' hP'eq V hVeq hVP hext hcoll hr u' hmem henum
      hnodup hcfeas hMc hconsec hkk
  have horderB : ∀ kk kk' j : ℕ, kk < r - 2 → kk' < r - 2 → kk < kk' →
      (j = 1 ∨ j = 2) →
      0 ≤ cross (u' (kk + 2) - u' 0) (u' (kk' + j) - u' 0) := by
    intro kk kk' j hkk hkk' hlt hj
    exact Proof.CyclicOrder.order_B g' P' hP'eq V hVeq hVP hext hcoll hr u' hmem henum
      hnodup hcfeas hMc hconsec hkk hkk' hlt hj
