  have hverts : ∀ j ∈ Finset.range r, (fun n => iota (u' n)) j ∈ P := by
    intro j hj
    rw [Finset.mem_range] at hj
    have hjP' : u' j ∈ P' := hVP (hmem j hj)
    rw [← hPP']
    exact ⟨u' j, hjP', rfl⟩
  refine ⟨?_nondeg, ?_cover, ?_disj⟩
  · 
    intro k' hk'
    exact fan_nondeg_of_orderA iota hiotaLin hr u' horderA hk'
  · 
    
    have hsub : P ⊆ ⋃ k' ∈ Finset.range (r - 2), fanTri (fun n => iota (u' n)) k' :=
      fan_cover_subset_of_order iota hiotaLin P' P hPP' g' hP'eq V hVeq hVP
        hext hcoll hr u' henum hmem hcfeas hMc hconsec horderA horderB
    have hsup : (⋃ k' ∈ Finset.range (r - 2), fanTri (fun n => iota (u' n)) k') ⊆ P :=
      fan_union_subset P hconv (fun n => iota (u' n)) hr hverts
    exact Set.Subset.antisymm hsub hsup
  · 
    exact fan_disjoint_of_order iota hiotaLin hr u' horderA horderB

name: indicator_agree
statement:
theorem indicator_agree {t : Triangle} (hdet : det3 t.v₀ t.v₁ t.v₂ ≠ 0)
    {P P' : Point}
    (hcase : (∀ g ∈ tetraHalves t, g.eval P ≠ 0 ∧
                (0 < g.eval P ↔ 0 < g.eval P') ∧ (g.eval P < 0 ↔ g.eval P' < 0))
              ∨ (P ∉ simplex t ∧ P' ∉ simplex t)) :
    (if P ∈ simplex t then (1 : ℤ) else 0) = (if P' ∈ simplex t then (1 : ℤ) else 0)
proof:
:= by
  rcases hcase with hsign | ⟨hP, hP'⟩
  · 
    have hiff : (P ∈ simplex t) ↔ (P' ∈ simplex t) := by
      rw [← feasible_iff_mem_simplex hdet, ← feasible_iff_mem_simplex hdet]
      rw [Proof.SimImplCover.feasible_iff, Proof.SimImplCover.feasible_iff]
      constructor
      · intro h g hg
        have hposP : 0 < g.eval P :=
          lt_of_le_of_ne (by simpa [Proof.SimImplCover.gOf_apply] using h g hg)
            (fun hh => (hsign g hg).1 hh.symm)
        have hposP' : 0 < g.eval P' := (hsign g hg).2.1.mp hposP
        rw [Proof.SimImplCover.gOf_apply]; exact le_of_lt hposP'
      · intro h g hg
        
        have hgeP' : 0 ≤ g.eval P' := by simpa [Proof.SimImplCover.gOf_apply] using h g hg
        have hPne := (hsign g hg).1
        rcases lt_trichotomy (g.eval P) 0 with hlt | h0 | hgt
        · 
          exact absurd ((hsign g hg).2.2.mp hlt) (not_lt.mpr hgeP')
        · exact absurd h0 hPne
        · rw [Proof.SimImplCover.gOf_apply]; exact le_of_lt hgt
    by_cases h : P ∈ simplex t
    · rw [if_pos h, if_pos (hiff.mp h)]
    · rw [if_neg h, if_neg (fun hc => h (hiff.mpr hc))]
  · 
    rw [if_neg hP, if_neg hP']

name: winding_offbdy
statement:
theorem winding_offbdy {M : Mesh} (hnpo : NoPlaneThroughOrigin M) {P P' : Point}
    (hcase : ∀ i : Fin M.size,
      (∀ g ∈ tetraHalves M[i], g.eval P ≠ 0 ∧
          (0 < g.eval P ↔ 0 < g.eval P') ∧ (g.eval P < 0 ↔ g.eval P' < 0))
        ∨ (P ∉ simplex M[i] ∧ P' ∉ simplex M[i])) :
    winding (meshChain M) P = winding (meshChain M) P'
proof:
:= by
  rw [winding_meshChain_eq M P, winding_meshChain_eq M P']
  apply congrArg List.sum
  apply List.map_congr_left
  intro t ht
  obtain ⟨i, rfl⟩ := mem_toList_iff.mp ht
  have hdet : det3 M[i].v₀ M[i].v₁ M[i].v₂ ≠ 0 := by
    rw [det3_eq_detOrigin]; exact hnpo i
  rw [indicator_agree hdet (hcase i)]

name: winding_eq_of_offBdyPair
statement:
theorem winding_eq_of_offBdyPair {M : Mesh} (hnpo : NoPlaneThroughOrigin M)
    {P Q : Point} (h : OffBdyPair M P Q) :
    winding (meshChain M) P = winding (meshChain M) Q
proof:
:=
  winding_offbdy hnpo h

name: exists_shared_pair_origin
statement:
private theorem exists_shared_pair_origin : ∀ x y : Fin 4, x ≠ y → x ≠ 0 → y ≠ 0 →
    ∃ m₂ : Fin 4, (0 : Fin 4) ≠ m₂ ∧ m₂ ≠ x ∧ m₂ ≠ y
      ∧ ∀ m : Fin 4, m = 0 ∨ m = m₂ ∨ m = x ∨ m = y
proof:
:= by
  decide

name: dotQ_self_pos
statement: private theorem dotQ_self_pos {v : Point} (hv : v ≠ 0) : 0 < dotQ v v
proof:
:=
  Proof.MeshIntersectRay.dotQ_self_pos hv

name: dotQ_smul_sub_left
statement:
private theorem dotQ_smul_sub_left (s t : ℚ) (u v w : Point) :
    dotQ (s • u - t • v) w = s * dotQ u w - t * dotQ v w
proof:
:= by
  simp only [dotQ, Pi.sub_apply, Pi.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul]
  ring

name: half_eval_step
statement:
private theorem half_eval_step (g : Half) (x v : Point) (s : ℚ) :
    g.eval (x + s • v) = g.eval x + s * dotQ g.n v
proof:
:= by
  show dotQ g.n (x + s • v) - g.c = _
  rw [dotQ_add_right, Proof.MeshIntersectRay.dotQ_smul_right]
  show _ = dotQ g.n x - g.c + s * dotQ g.n v
  ring

name: dotQ_step
statement:
private theorem dotQ_step (a x v : Point) (s : ℚ) :
    dotQ a (x + s • v) = dotQ a x + s * dotQ a v
proof:
:= by
  rw [dotQ_add_right, Proof.MeshIntersectRay.dotQ_smul_right]

name: cert_offpt
proof:
:= by
  intro hzero
  have hdot : ct * dotQ a p - b * dotQ nt p = 0 := by
    rw [← dotQ_smul_sub_left, hzero]; simp [dotQ]
  by_cases hb : b = 0
  · subst hb
    rw [zero_smul, sub_zero] at hzero
    exact ha ((smul_eq_zero.mp hzero).resolve_left hct)
  · apply hpt
    rw [hp] at hdot
    have hfac : b * (ct - dotQ nt p) = 0 := by linarith
    rcases mul_eq_zero.mp hfac with h | h
    · exact absurd h hb
    · linarith

name: mem_level_of_mem_affineSpan
proof:
:= by
  classical
  set E : AffineSubspace ℚ Point :=
    AffineSubspace.comap (Proof.SimImplCover.gOf ⟨a, b⟩)
      (AffineSubspace.mk' (0 : ℚ) ⊥) with hE
  have hcar : ∀ x : Point, x ∈ E ↔ dotQ a x = b := by
    intro x
    rw [hE]
    show Proof.SimImplCover.gOf ⟨a, b⟩ x ∈ AffineSubspace.mk' (0 : ℚ) ⊥ ↔ _
    rw [AffineSubspace.mem_mk'_iff_vsub_mem]
    simp only [Submodule.mem_bot, vsub_eq_sub, sub_zero,
      Proof.SimImplCover.gOf_apply]
    show Half.eval ⟨a, b⟩ x = 0 ↔ _
    rw [Half.eval]
    constructor
    · intro h; linarith
    · intro h; rw [h]; ring
  have hle : affineSpan ℚ S ≤ E := by
    rw [affineSpan_le]; intro x hx; exact (hcar x).mpr (hS x hx)
  exact (hcar z).mp (hle hz)

name: gram_pair
statement:
private theorem gram_pair (n nt e w : Point) :
    (dotQ nt nt * dotQ e e - dotQ nt e * dotQ nt e) * dotQ n w
      = (dotQ n e * dotQ nt nt - dotQ n nt * dotQ nt e) * dotQ e w
        + (dotQ n nt * dotQ e e - dotQ n e * dotQ nt e) * dotQ nt w
        + dotQ n (crossQ nt e) * dotQ (crossQ nt e) w
proof:
:= by
  simp only [dotQ, crossQ, Proof.SimImplCover.mkPoint_zero,
    Proof.SimImplCover.mkPoint_one, Proof.SimImplCover.mkPoint_two]
  ring

name: dotQ_symm
statement: private theorem dotQ_symm (u v : Point) : dotQ u v = dotQ v u
proof:
:= by
  simp only [dotQ]; ring

name: parallel_of_gram_zero
proof:
:= by
  have hpos : 0 < dotQ nt nt := dotQ_self_pos hnt
  refine ⟨dotQ NH nt / dotQ nt nt, ?_⟩
  set s := dotQ NH nt / dotQ nt nt with hs
  have hd : NH - s • nt = 0 := by
    have hself : dotQ (NH - s • nt) (NH - s • nt) = 0 := by
      have hexp : dotQ (NH - s • nt) (NH - s • nt)
          = dotQ NH NH - 2 * s * dotQ NH nt + s * s * dotQ nt nt := by
        simp only [dotQ, Pi.sub_apply, Pi.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul]; ring
      rw [hexp, hs]
      field_simp
      nlinarith [hgram, dotQ_symm NH nt]
    by_contra hne
    exact absurd hself (ne_of_gt (dotQ_self_pos hne))
  have := sub_eq_zero.mp hd
  rw [this]

name: transversal_of_not_parallel
statement:
private theorem transversal_of_not_parallel {nt NH a b z : Point} {c : ℚ}
    (hnt : nt ≠ 0)
    (hnp : dotQ nt nt * dotQ NH NH ≠ dotQ NH nt * dotQ NH nt)
    (ha : dotQ nt a = c) (hb : dotQ nt b = c) (hz : dotQ nt z = c)
    (hind : areaForm nt a b z ≠ 0) :
    ¬(dotQ NH (b - a) = 0 ∧ dotQ NH (z - a) = 0)
proof:
:= by
  rintro ⟨h1, h2⟩
  apply hnp
  
  set u₁ := b - a with hu₁
  set u₂ := z - a with hu₂
  have hu₁p : dotQ nt u₁ = 0 := by rw [hu₁, dotQ_sub_right, hb, ha, sub_self]
  have hu₂p : dotQ nt u₂ = 0 := by rw [hu₂, dotQ_sub_right, hz, ha, sub_self]
  
  have hcr_perp : dotQ nt (crossQ nt u₁) = 0 := by
    rw [dotQ_symm]; exact Proof.SimImplCover.dotQ_crossQ_left nt u₁
  have hareaeq : areaForm nt (0 : Point) u₁ u₂ = areaForm nt a b z := by
    rw [hu₁, hu₂]
    show dotQ nt (crossQ (u₁ - 0) (u₂ - 0)) = dotQ nt (crossQ (b - a) (z - a))
    rw [sub_zero, sub_zero, hu₁, hu₂]
  obtain ⟨s, t, hst⟩ := plane_coords hnt (a := (0 : Point)) (b := u₁) (z := u₂)
    (by simp [dotQ]) hu₁p hu₂p (hareaeq ▸ hind) hcr_perp
  have hNHcr : dotQ NH (crossQ nt u₁) = 0 := by
    rw [hst]
    simp only [zero_add]
    rw [dotQ_add_right, Proof.MeshIntersectRay.dotQ_smul_right,
      Proof.MeshIntersectRay.dotQ_smul_right, sub_zero, sub_zero, h1, h2,
      mul_zero, mul_zero, add_zero]
  
  have hu₁ne : u₁ ≠ 0 := by
    intro h0; apply hind
    have harea : areaForm nt a b z = dotQ nt (crossQ u₁ u₂) := by
      rw [hu₁, hu₂]; rfl
    rw [harea, h0]
    have : crossQ (0 : Point) u₂ = 0 := by
      funext k; fin_cases k <;> simp [crossQ, mkPoint]
    rw [this, dotQ_symm, dotQ]; simp
  have hg := gram_pair NH nt u₁ NH
  rw [hu₁p, h1, hNHcr] at hg
  
  have hu₁₁ : 0 < dotQ u₁ u₁ := dotQ_self_pos hu₁ne
  
  
  have hkey : dotQ nt nt * dotQ NH NH = dotQ NH nt * dotQ nt NH := by
    have := hg
    rw [dotQ_symm nt NH] at this ⊢
    nlinarith [this, hu₁₁]
  rw [dotQ_symm nt NH] at hkey
  linarith [hkey]

name: dotQ_sum
statement:
private theorem dotQ_sum {ι : Type*} (s : Finset ι) (a : Point) (g : ι → Point) :
    dotQ a (∑ i ∈ s, g i) = ∑ i ∈ s, dotQ a (g i)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  induction s using Finset.induction with
  | empty => simp [dotQ]
  | @insert i s hi ih =>
    rw [Finset.sum_insert hi, Finset.sum_insert hi, dotQ_add_right, ih]

name: hLL_plane_lat
statement:
private theorem hLL_plane_lat {nt : Point} {ct : ℚ} (hct : ct ≠ 0)
    {u : Triangle} (hdetB : detOrigin u ≠ 0)
    {xf : Point} (hs : ∀ g ∈ tetraHalves u, g.eval xf ≠ 0)
    {k k' : Fin 4} (hk : (k : ℕ) < 3) (hk' : (k' : ℕ) < 3) (hkk : k ≠ k') :
    ∃ NH : Point, NH ≠ 0
      ∧ (∀ x ∈ ({xf} ∪ {z | (slot u k).eval z = 0 ∧ (slot u k').eval z = 0}
            : Set Point), dotQ NH x = dotQ NH xf)
      ∧ ct • NH - (dotQ NH xf) • nt ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have hdet3 : det3 u.v₀ u.v₁ u.v₂ ≠ 0 := by
    rw [det3_eq_detOrigin]; exact hdetB
  have hAI := (det3_ne_zero_iff_originApex_affineIndependent u).mp hdet3
  obtain ⟨bb, a₀, hbcoe, -, -⟩ := Proof.AffineBasisSimplex.simplexAffineBasis u hAI
  obtain ⟨lam, hlam, hgeq⟩ := slot_coord hdet3 bb hbcoe k
  obtain ⟨lam', hlam', hgeq'⟩ := slot_coord hdet3 bb hbcoe k'
  have hσne : slotIdx k ≠ slotIdx k' := fun h => hkk (slotIdx_injective h)
  
  have hsk0 : slotIdx k ≠ 0 := by
    fin_cases k <;> simp_all (config := {decide := true}) [slotIdx]
  have hsk'0 : slotIdx k' ≠ 0 := by
    fin_cases k' <;> simp_all (config := {decide := true}) [slotIdx]
  obtain ⟨m₂, h0m2, hm2x, hm2y, hcomplete⟩ :=
    exists_shared_pair_origin _ _ hσne hsk0 hsk'0
  have heval : ∀ z : Point, (slot u k).eval z = lam * bb.coord (slotIdx k) z := by
    intro z
    have h := DFunLike.congr_fun hgeq z
    rw [Proof.SimImplCover.gOf_apply] at h; exact h
  have heval' : ∀ z : Point, (slot u k').eval z = lam' * bb.coord (slotIdx k') z := by
    intro z
    have h := DFunLike.congr_fun hgeq' z
    rw [Proof.SimImplCover.gOf_apply] at h; exact h
  have hvanish : ∀ m : Fin 4, m ≠ slotIdx k → (slot u k).eval (bb m) = 0 := by
    intro m hm; rw [heval, bb.coord_apply_ne (Ne.symm hm), mul_zero]
  have hvanish' : ∀ m : Fin 4, m ≠ slotIdx k' → (slot u k').eval (bb m) = 0 := by
    intro m hm; rw [heval', bb.coord_apply_ne (Ne.symm hm), mul_zero]
  have hxf0 : xf ≠ bb 0 := by
    intro h
    apply hs _ (slot_mem u k); rw [h]; exact hvanish 0 (Ne.symm hsk0)
  have hpq : bb 0 ≠ bb m₂ := fun h => h0m2 (bb.ind.injective h)
  set NH := crossQ (bb 0 - xf) (bb m₂ - xf) with hNHdef
  have hNH : NH ≠ 0 := by
    intro h0
    have hpx : bb 0 - xf ≠ 0 := sub_ne_zero.mpr (Ne.symm hxf0)
    have hcr : crossQ (bb m₂ - xf) (bb 0 - xf) = 0 := by
      rw [crossQ_anticomm, ← hNHdef, h0, neg_zero]
    obtain ⟨s, hsrep⟩ := exists_smul_of_crossQ_eq_zero hpx hcr
    have hq : bb m₂ = xf + s • (bb 0 - xf) := by rw [← hsrep]; abel
    have hgq : (slot u k).eval (bb m₂) = 0 := hvanish m₂ hm2x
    have hgp' : (slot u k).eval (bb 0) = 0 := hvanish 0 (Ne.symm hsk0)
    have haff : (slot u k).eval (bb m₂)
        = (slot u k).eval xf + s * dotQ (slot u k).n (bb 0 - xf) := by
      rw [hq, half_eval_step]
    rw [hgq, dotQ_sub_right] at haff
    have heq2 : (slot u k).eval (bb 0) - (slot u k).eval xf
        = dotQ (slot u k).n (bb 0) - dotQ (slot u k).n xf := by
      show (dotQ (slot u k).n (bb 0) - (slot u k).c)
        - (dotQ (slot u k).n xf - (slot u k).c) = _
      ring
    have hs1 : s = 1 := by
      have hxf0' : (slot u k).eval xf ≠ 0 := hs _ (slot_mem u k)
      have e1 : dotQ (slot u k).n (bb 0) - dotQ (slot u k).n xf
          = - (slot u k).eval xf := by rw [heq2.symm, hgp', zero_sub]
      have : (1 - s) * (slot u k).eval xf = 0 := by
        rw [e1] at haff; ring_nf at haff ⊢; linarith
      rcases mul_eq_zero.mp this with h | h
      · linarith
      · exact absurd h hxf0'
    rw [hs1, one_smul] at hq
    apply hpq; rw [hq]; abel
  have hpH : dotQ NH (bb 0) = dotQ NH xf := by
    have h := dotQ_crossQ_left (bb 0 - xf) (bb m₂ - xf)
    rw [← hNHdef, dotQ_sub_right] at h; linarith
  have hqH : dotQ NH (bb m₂) = dotQ NH xf := by
    have h := dotQ_crossQ_right (bb 0 - xf) (bb m₂ - xf)
    rw [← hNHdef, dotQ_sub_right] at h; linarith
  have hgen : ∀ x ∈ ({xf} ∪ {z | (slot u k).eval z = 0 ∧ (slot u k').eval z = 0}
      : Set Point), dotQ NH x = dotQ NH xf := by
    intro x hx
    rcases hx with hx | hx
    · rw [Set.mem_singleton_iff.mp hx]
    · obtain ⟨hz, hz'⟩ := hx
      have hco : bb.coord (slotIdx k) x = 0 := by
        rw [heval] at hz; exact (mul_eq_zero.mp hz).resolve_left (ne_of_gt hlam)
      have hco' : bb.coord (slotIdx k') x = 0 := by
        rw [heval'] at hz'; exact (mul_eq_zero.mp hz').resolve_left (ne_of_gt hlam')
      have hrep := bb.linear_combination_coord_eq_self x
      have hsum1 := bb.sum_coord_apply_eq_one x
      calc dotQ NH x = dotQ NH (∑ m, bb.coord m x • bb m) := by rw [hrep]
        _ = ∑ m, bb.coord m x * dotQ NH (bb m) := by
            rw [dotQ_sum]; congr 1; funext m
            rw [Proof.MeshIntersectRay.dotQ_smul_right]
        _ = ∑ m, bb.coord m x * dotQ NH xf := by
            apply Finset.sum_congr rfl; intro m _
            rcases hcomplete m with h | h | h | h
            · rw [h, hpH]
            · rw [h, hqH]
            · rw [h, hco, zero_mul, zero_mul]
            · rw [h, hco', zero_mul, zero_mul]
        _ = dotQ NH xf := by rw [← Finset.sum_mul, hsum1, one_mul]
  have hb00 : bb 0 = (0 : Point) := by rw [hbcoe]; rfl
  have hwit : dotQ nt (bb 0) ≠ ct := by
    rw [hb00]; simpa [dotQ] using (Ne.symm hct)
  exact ⟨NH, hNH, hgen, cert_offpt hct hNH hpH hwit⟩

name: exists_delta
statement:
private theorem exists_delta (c : ℚ) (hc : 0 < c) (bad : Finset ℚ) :
    ∃ δ : ℚ, 0 < δ ∧ δ < c ∧ δ ∉ bad
proof:
:= by
  classical
  
  set cand : Fin (bad.card + 1) → ℚ := fun k => c / ((k : ℚ) + 2) with hcand
  have hinj : Function.Injective cand := by
    intro k k' h
    apply Fin.ext
    have h2 : ((k : ℚ) + 2) ≠ 0 := by positivity
    have h2' : ((k' : ℚ) + 2) ≠ 0 := by positivity
    rw [hcand] at h; simp only at h
    rw [div_eq_div_iff h2 h2'] at h
    have := mul_left_cancel₀ (ne_of_gt hc) h
    have hcast : (k : ℚ) = (k' : ℚ) := by linarith
    exact_mod_cast hcast
  
  by_contra hcon
  push_neg at hcon
  have hall : ∀ k, cand k ∈ bad := by
    intro k
    by_contra hkbad
    have hpos : 0 < cand k := by rw [hcand]; positivity
    have hlt : cand k < c := by
      have hkpos : (0:ℚ) ≤ (k:ℚ) := by exact_mod_cast Nat.zero_le (k:ℕ)
      rw [hcand]; simp only
      rw [div_lt_iff₀ (by positivity : (0:ℚ) < (k:ℚ)+2)]
      nlinarith [hkpos, hc]
    exact hkbad (hcon (cand k) hpos hlt)
  have hcard : Fintype.card (Fin (bad.card + 1)) ≤ bad.card := by
    have := Finset.card_le_card_of_injOn (s := (Finset.univ : Finset (Fin (bad.card+1))))
      (t := bad) cand (fun k _ => hall k) (fun a _ b _ hab => hinj hab)
    simp only [Finset.card_univ] at this; exact this
  rw [Fintype.card_fin] at hcard
  omega

name: exists_carrier_dir
statement:
private theorem exists_carrier_dir {r : ℕ} [NeZero r] {n : Point} {c : ℚ}
    {w : Fin r → Point} (hpl : OnPlane n c w)
    {K : ℕ} (N : Fin K → Point) :
    ∃ dv : Point, dotQ n dv = 0 ∧
      ∀ α, ¬(dotQ (N α) (w (0+1) - w 0) = 0 ∧ dotQ (N α) (w (0+1+1) - w 0) = 0) →
        dotQ (N α) dv ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  set u₁ := w (0 + 1) - w 0 with hu₁def
  set u₂ := w (0 + 1 + 1) - w 0 with hu₂def
  set Tr : Fin K → Prop := fun α => ¬(dotQ (N α) u₁ = 0 ∧ dotQ (N α) u₂ = 0) with hTrdef
  obtain ⟨j, hj⟩ := exists_candidate_avoiding
    (fun α => {x : ℚ | Tr α ∧ dotQ (N α) u₁ + x * dotQ (N α) u₂ = 0})
    (fun α => affine_bad_subsingleton (Tr α) _ _ (fun h => h))
    (fun j : Fin (K + 1) => (j : ℚ))
    (fun j j' h => by
      apply Fin.ext
      have h' : ((j : ℕ) : ℚ) = ((j' : ℕ) : ℚ) := h
      exact_mod_cast h')
  set dv := u₁ + (j : ℚ) • u₂ with hdvdef
  have hdv_eval : ∀ q : Point, dotQ q dv = dotQ q u₁ + (j : ℚ) * dotQ q u₂ := by
    intro q; rw [hdvdef, dotQ_add_right, Proof.MeshIntersectRay.dotQ_smul_right]
  refine ⟨dv, ?_, ?_⟩
  · have h1 : dotQ n u₁ = 0 := by rw [hu₁def, dotQ_sub_right, hpl, hpl, sub_self]
    have h2 : dotQ n u₂ = 0 := by rw [hu₂def, dotQ_sub_right, hpl, hpl, sub_self]
    rw [hdv_eval n, h1, h2]; ring
  · intro α hα hzero
    rw [hdv_eval (N α)] at hzero
    exact hj α ⟨hα, hzero⟩

name: sign_preserve
proof:
:= by
  have hδs : |δ * s| < |a| := by
    rw [abs_mul, abs_of_nonneg hδ0]; exact hlt
  rcases lt_or_gt_of_ne ha with hneg | hpos
  · 
    have hane : |a| = -a := abs_of_neg hneg
    have h1 : -(- a) < δ * s := by
      have := (abs_lt.mp hδs).1; rw [hane] at this; linarith
    have h2 : δ * s < -a := by
      have := (abs_lt.mp hδs).2; rw [hane] at this; linarith
    refine ⟨by linarith, ?_, ?_⟩
    · constructor <;> intro h <;> linarith
    · constructor <;> intro _ <;> linarith
  · 
    have hane : |a| = a := abs_of_pos hpos
    have h1 : -a < δ * s := by
      have := (abs_lt.mp hδs).1; rw [hane] at this; linarith
    have h2 : δ * s < a := by
      have := (abs_lt.mp hδs).2; rw [hane] at this; linarith
    refine ⟨by linarith, ?_, ?_⟩
    · constructor <;> intro _ <;> linarith
    · constructor <;> intro h <;> linarith

name: step_ne_of_base_zero
statement:
private theorem step_ne_of_base_zero {s δ : ℚ} (hs : s ≠ 0) (hδ : 0 < δ) :
    δ * s ≠ 0
proof: := mul_ne_zero (ne_of_gt hδ) hs

name: companion_classify_cop_core
statement:
theorem companion_classify_cop_core {tA : Triangle} (hdetA : detOrigin tA ≠ 0)
    {MB : Mesh} (hwfB : Legacy.WellFormedMesh MB) {Cop : Fin MB.size → Prop}
    {f : Frag} (hf : FragInv (carrierNormal tA) (detOrigin tA) f)
    {x₀ : Point} (hx₀mem : x₀ ∈ vrelint (fragCycle f))
    (hx₀cleanTr : ∀ j : Fin MB.size, ¬ Cop j → ∀ g ∈ tetraHalves (MB[j]),
        g.eval x₀ ≠ 0)
    (hQstarCop : ∀ j : Fin MB.size, Cop j → ∀ Q : Point, Q ∈ vrelint (fragCycle f) →
        Q ∉ simplex MB[j])
    {Qstar : Point} (hmem : Qstar ∈ vrelint (fragCycle f))
    (hoff : OffBdy MB Qstar) :
    ∃ Qt : Point,
      Qt ∈ vrelint (fragCycle f)
      ∧ (∀ j : Fin MB.size, ¬ Cop j → ∀ g ∈ tetraHalves (MB[j]), g.eval Qt ≠ 0)
      ∧ OffBdyPair MB Qstar Qt
      ∧ (∀ j : Fin MB.size, ¬ Cop j → ∀ k k' : Fin 4,
          (k : ℕ) < 3 → (k' : ℕ) < 3 → k ≠ k' →
          Qt ∉ (affineSpan ℚ
            ({x₀}
              ∪ {z | (Proof.MeshIntersectCancel.slot (MB[j]) k).eval z = 0
                  ∧ (Proof.MeshIntersectCancel.slot (MB[j]) k').eval z = 0}) : Set Point))
proof:
:= by
  classical
  
  set n := carrierNormal tA with hndef
  set ct := detOrigin tA with hctdef
  set w := fragCycle f with hwdef
  have hnpoB : NoPlaneThroughOrigin MB := hwfB.2.2.2
  have hr3 : 3 ≤ f.poly.size := hf.size3
  haveI : NeZero f.poly.size := hf.neZero
  have hn : n ≠ 0 := Proof.MeshIntersectRay.carrierNormal_ne_zero hdetA
  have hpl : Proof.MeshIntersectClip.OnPlane n ct w := hf.onPlane
  have hsc : Proof.MeshIntersectClip.StrictConv n w := hf.strictConv
  
  have hx₀pl : dotQ n x₀ = ct := by
    rw [Proof.MeshIntersectClip.vrelint_eq hr3 hpl hsc] at hx₀mem; exact hx₀mem.1
  
  have hQdata : dotQ n Qstar = ct ∧ ∀ i, 0 < Proof.MeshIntersectClip.eta n w i Qstar := by
    rw [Proof.MeshIntersectClip.vrelint_eq hr3 hpl hsc] at hmem; exact hmem
  obtain ⟨hQpl, hQeta⟩ := hQdata
  
  have hNHdata : ∀ (j : Fin MB.size) (k k' : Fin 4), ∃ NH : Point,
      (¬ Cop j → (k : ℕ) < 3 → (k' : ℕ) < 3 → k ≠ k' →
        NH ≠ 0
        ∧ (∀ x ∈ ({x₀} ∪ {z | (Proof.MeshIntersectCancel.slot (MB[j]) k).eval z = 0
              ∧ (Proof.MeshIntersectCancel.slot (MB[j]) k').eval z = 0} : Set Point),
            dotQ NH x = dotQ NH x₀)
        ∧ ct • NH - (dotQ NH x₀) • n ≠ 0) := by
    intro j k k'
    by_cases hg : ¬ Cop j ∧ (k : ℕ) < 3 ∧ (k' : ℕ) < 3 ∧ k ≠ k'
    · obtain ⟨NH, hne, hgen, hcert⟩ := CompanionHelpers.hLL_plane_lat (nt := n) (ct := ct)
        (u := MB[j]) (xf := x₀) (k := k) (k' := k') hdetA (hnpoB j)
        (fun gg hgg => hx₀cleanTr j hg.1 gg hgg) hg.2.1 hg.2.2.1 hg.2.2.2
      exact ⟨NH, fun _ _ _ _ => ⟨hne, hgen, hcert⟩⟩
    · exact ⟨0, fun hc hk hk' hkk => absurd ⟨hc, hk, hk', hkk⟩ hg⟩
  choose! NHf hNH using hNHdata
  have hNHne : ∀ (j : Fin MB.size) (k k' : Fin 4),
      ¬ Cop j → (k : ℕ) < 3 → (k' : ℕ) < 3 → k ≠ k' → NHf j k k' ≠ 0 :=
    fun j k k' hc hk hk' hkk => (hNH j k k' hc hk hk' hkk).1
  have hNHgen : ∀ (j : Fin MB.size) (k k' : Fin 4),
      ¬ Cop j → (k : ℕ) < 3 → (k' : ℕ) < 3 → k ≠ k' →
      ∀ x ∈ ({x₀} ∪ {z | (Proof.MeshIntersectCancel.slot (MB[j]) k).eval z = 0
              ∧ (Proof.MeshIntersectCancel.slot (MB[j]) k').eval z = 0} : Set Point),
            dotQ (NHf j k k') x = dotQ (NHf j k k') x₀ :=
    fun j k k' hc hk hk' hkk => (hNH j k k' hc hk hk' hkk).2.1
  have hNHcert : ∀ (j : Fin MB.size) (k k' : Fin 4),
      ¬ Cop j → (k : ℕ) < 3 → (k' : ℕ) < 3 → k ≠ k' →
      ct • NHf j k k' - (dotQ (NHf j k k') x₀) • n ≠ 0 :=
    fun j k k' hc hk hk' hkk => (hNH j k k' hc hk hk' hkk).2.2
  
  have hnotpar : ∀ (j : Fin MB.size) (k k' : Fin 4),
      ¬ Cop j → (k : ℕ) < 3 → (k' : ℕ) < 3 → k ≠ k' →
      dotQ n n * dotQ (NHf j k k') (NHf j k k')
        ≠ dotQ (NHf j k k') n * dotQ (NHf j k k') n := by
    intro j k k' hc hk hk' hkk' hgram
    obtain ⟨s, hs⟩ := CompanionHelpers.parallel_of_gram_zero hn hgram
    apply hNHcert j k k' hc hk hk' hkk'
    have hval : dotQ (NHf j k k') x₀ = s * ct := by
      rw [hs, CompanionHelpers.dotQ_symm, Proof.MeshIntersectRay.dotQ_smul_right,
        CompanionHelpers.dotQ_symm x₀ n, hx₀pl]
    rw [hval, hs]
    funext c; simp only [Pi.sub_apply, Pi.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul, Pi.zero_apply]; ring
  set u₁ := w (0 + 1) - w 0 with hu₁def
  set u₂ := w (0 + 1 + 1) - w 0 with hu₂def
  have hAarea : Proof.MeshIntersectClip.areaForm n (w 0) (w (0 + 1)) (w (0 + 1 + 1)) ≠ 0 := by
    have h := hsc 0 (0 + 1 + 1) (Proof.MeshIntersectClip.fin_add_two_ne hr3 0)
      (Proof.MeshIntersectClip.fin_add_one_ne hr3 (0 + 1))
    rw [Proof.MeshIntersectClip.eta_eq] at h
    exact ne_of_gt h
  have hTrNH : ∀ (j : Fin MB.size) (k k' : Fin 4),
      ¬ Cop j → (k : ℕ) < 3 → (k' : ℕ) < 3 → k ≠ k' →
      ¬(dotQ (NHf j k k') u₁ = 0 ∧ dotQ (NHf j k k') u₂ = 0) := by
    intro j k k' hc hk hk' hkk'
    have := CompanionHelpers.transversal_of_not_parallel hn (hnotpar j k k' hc hk hk' hkk')
      (a := w 0) (b := w (0 + 1)) (z := w (0 + 1 + 1)) (c := ct)
      (hpl 0) (hpl (0 + 1)) (hpl (0 + 1 + 1)) hAarea
    rw [← hu₁def, ← hu₂def] at this
    exact this
  
  
  
  
  set Lcone : List Point :=
    (List.finRange MB.size).flatMap
      (fun j => ((tetraHalves (MB[j])).toList).map (fun g => g.n)) with hLconedef
  set LNH : List Point :=
    (List.finRange MB.size).flatMap
      (fun j => (List.finRange 4).flatMap
        (fun k => (List.finRange 4).map (fun k' => NHf j k k'))) with hLNHdef
  set Lall : List Point := Lcone ++ LNH with hLalldef
  set Nfam : Fin Lall.length → Point := fun α => Lall.get α with hNfamdef
  obtain ⟨dv, hdvn, hdvtr⟩ := CompanionHelpers.exists_carrier_dir hpl Nfam
  have hconemem : ∀ (j : Fin MB.size), ∀ g ∈ tetraHalves (MB[j]), g.n ∈ Lall := by
    intro j g hg
    refine List.mem_append.mpr (Or.inl ?_)
    rw [hLconedef, List.mem_flatMap]
    exact ⟨j, List.mem_finRange j, List.mem_map.mpr ⟨g, Array.mem_toList.mpr hg, rfl⟩⟩
  have hNHmem : ∀ (j : Fin MB.size) (k k' : Fin 4), NHf j k k' ∈ Lall := by
    intro j k k'
    refine List.mem_append.mpr (Or.inr ?_)
    rw [hLNHdef, List.mem_flatMap]
    exact ⟨j, List.mem_finRange j, List.mem_flatMap.mpr
      ⟨k, List.mem_finRange k, List.mem_map.mpr ⟨k', List.mem_finRange k', rfl⟩⟩⟩
  have htrans : ∀ N : Point, N ∈ Lall →
      ¬(dotQ N u₁ = 0 ∧ dotQ N u₂ = 0) → dotQ N dv ≠ 0 := by
    intro N hN hTr
    obtain ⟨α, hα⟩ := List.mem_iff_get.mp hN
    have := hdvtr α
    rw [hNfamdef] at this
    simp only at this
    rw [hα] at this
    exact this hTr
  
  set Sneg := Finset.univ.filter
    (fun i : Fin f.poly.size => Proof.MeshIntersectClip.etaDir n w i dv < 0) with hSnegdef
  set feasCands : Finset ℚ :=
    insert 1 (Sneg.image (fun i => Proof.MeshIntersectClip.eta n w i Qstar
      / (-Proof.MeshIntersectClip.etaDir n w i dv))) with hfeasCandsdef
  have hfeasNe : feasCands.Nonempty := ⟨1, Finset.mem_insert_self 1 _⟩
  set δfeas := feasCands.min' hfeasNe with hδfeasdef
  have hδfeaspos : 0 < δfeas := by
    rw [hδfeasdef, Finset.lt_min'_iff]
    intro y hy
    rcases Finset.mem_insert.mp hy with rfl | hy'
    · norm_num
    · obtain ⟨i, hiS, rfl⟩ := Finset.mem_image.mp hy'
      have hD : Proof.MeshIntersectClip.etaDir n w i dv < 0 := (Finset.mem_filter.mp hiS).2
      exact div_pos (hQeta i) (by linarith)
  have hfeas : ∀ δ : ℚ, 0 < δ → δ < δfeas → Qstar + δ • dv ∈ vrelint w := by
    intro δ hδ hδlt
    rw [Proof.MeshIntersectClip.vrelint_eq hr3 hpl hsc]
    refine ⟨?_, fun i => ?_⟩
    · rw [CompanionHelpers.dotQ_step, hQpl, hdvn]; ring
    · rw [Proof.MeshIntersectClip.eta_add_smul]
      by_cases hD : Proof.MeshIntersectClip.etaDir n w i dv < 0
      · have hiS : i ∈ Sneg := Finset.mem_filter.mpr ⟨Finset.mem_univ i, hD⟩
        have hmem' : Proof.MeshIntersectClip.eta n w i Qstar
            / (-Proof.MeshIntersectClip.etaDir n w i dv) ∈ feasCands :=
          Finset.mem_insert_of_mem (Finset.mem_image_of_mem _ hiS)
        have hle : δfeas ≤ Proof.MeshIntersectClip.eta n w i Qstar
            / (-Proof.MeshIntersectClip.etaDir n w i dv) := Finset.min'_le _ _ hmem'
        have hlt : δ < Proof.MeshIntersectClip.eta n w i Qstar
            / (-Proof.MeshIntersectClip.etaDir n w i dv) := lt_of_lt_of_le hδlt hle
        rw [lt_div_iff₀ (by linarith : (0:ℚ) < -Proof.MeshIntersectClip.etaDir n w i dv)] at hlt
        nlinarith [hQeta i]
      · push_neg at hD
        nlinarith [hQeta i, mul_nonneg hδ.le hD]
  
  set thr : Fin MB.size × Fin 4 → ℚ := fun p =>
    if (Proof.MeshIntersectCancel.slot (MB[p.1]) p.2).eval Qstar ≠ 0
        ∧ dotQ (Proof.MeshIntersectCancel.slot (MB[p.1]) p.2).n dv ≠ 0
      then |(Proof.MeshIntersectCancel.slot (MB[p.1]) p.2).eval Qstar|
        / |dotQ (Proof.MeshIntersectCancel.slot (MB[p.1]) p.2).n dv|
      else 1 with hthrdef
  set signCands : Finset ℚ := insert 1 (Finset.univ.image thr) with hsignCandsdef
  have hsignNe : signCands.Nonempty := ⟨1, Finset.mem_insert_self 1 _⟩
  set δsign := signCands.min' hsignNe with hδsigndef
  have hthrpos : ∀ p : Fin MB.size × Fin 4, 0 < thr p := by
    intro p
    rw [hthrdef]; dsimp only
    by_cases hc : (Proof.MeshIntersectCancel.slot (MB[p.1]) p.2).eval Qstar ≠ 0
        ∧ dotQ (Proof.MeshIntersectCancel.slot (MB[p.1]) p.2).n dv ≠ 0
    · rw [if_pos hc]
      exact div_pos (abs_pos.mpr hc.1) (abs_pos.mpr hc.2)
    · rw [if_neg hc]; norm_num
  have hδsignpos : 0 < δsign := by
    rw [hδsigndef, Finset.lt_min'_iff]
    intro y hy
    rcases Finset.mem_insert.mp hy with rfl | hy'
    · norm_num
    · obtain ⟨p, -, rfl⟩ := Finset.mem_image.mp hy'; exact hthrpos p
  have hδsignle : ∀ p : Fin MB.size × Fin 4, δsign ≤ thr p := by
    intro p
    rw [hδsigndef]
    exact Finset.min'_le _ _ (Finset.mem_insert_of_mem (Finset.mem_image_of_mem _ (Finset.mem_univ p)))
  
  set badNH : Finset ℚ := Finset.univ.image
    (fun t : Fin MB.size × Fin 4 × Fin 4 =>
      (dotQ (NHf t.1 t.2.1 t.2.2) x₀ - dotQ (NHf t.1 t.2.1 t.2.2) Qstar)
        / dotQ (NHf t.1 t.2.1 t.2.2) dv) with hbadNHdef
  obtain ⟨δ, hδpos, hδlt, hδbad⟩ :=
    CompanionHelpers.exists_delta (min δfeas δsign) (lt_min hδfeaspos hδsignpos) badNH
  set Qt := Qstar + δ • dv with hQtdef
  have hδltfeas : δ < δfeas := lt_of_lt_of_le hδlt (min_le_left _ _)
  have hδltsign : δ < δsign := lt_of_lt_of_le hδlt (min_le_right _ _)
  have hQtfeas_mem : Qt ∈ vrelint w := hfeas δ hδpos hδltfeas
  have hcarconst : ∀ N : Point, dotQ N u₁ = 0 → dotQ N u₂ = 0 →
      ∀ x : Point, dotQ n x = ct → dotQ N x = dotQ N (w 0) := by
    intro N hN1 hN2 x hx
    obtain ⟨s, t, hrep⟩ := Proof.MeshIntersectClip.plane_coords hn
      (hpl 0) (hpl (0 + 1)) (hpl (0 + 1 + 1)) hAarea hx
    rw [hrep]
    rw [← hu₁def, ← hu₂def, Proof.MeshIntersectRay.dotQ_add_right,
      Proof.MeshIntersectRay.dotQ_add_right, Proof.MeshIntersectRay.dotQ_smul_right,
      Proof.MeshIntersectRay.dotQ_smul_right, hN1, hN2, mul_zero, mul_zero, add_zero, add_zero]
  
  have hfacet_tr : ∀ (j : Fin MB.size), ¬ Cop j → ∀ (k : Fin 4),
      (Proof.MeshIntersectCancel.slot (MB[j]) k).eval Qstar = 0 →
      dotQ (Proof.MeshIntersectCancel.slot (MB[j]) k).n dv ≠ 0 := by
    intro j hc k hz
    apply htrans _ (hconemem j (Proof.MeshIntersectCancel.slot (MB[j]) k)
      (Proof.MeshIntersectCancel.slot_mem (MB[j]) k))
    rintro ⟨h1, h2⟩
    have hconst : dotQ (Proof.MeshIntersectCancel.slot (MB[j]) k).n Qstar
        = dotQ (Proof.MeshIntersectCancel.slot (MB[j]) k).n x₀ := by
      rw [hcarconst _ h1 h2 Qstar hQpl, hcarconst _ h1 h2 x₀ hx₀pl]
    have hevaleq : (Proof.MeshIntersectCancel.slot (MB[j]) k).eval Qstar
        = (Proof.MeshIntersectCancel.slot (MB[j]) k).eval x₀ := by
      show dotQ _ Qstar - _ = dotQ _ x₀ - _; rw [hconst]
    rw [hz] at hevaleq
    exact hx₀cleanTr j hc _ (Proof.MeshIntersectCancel.slot_mem (MB[j]) k) hevaleq.symm
  
  have hfacet : ∀ (j : Fin MB.size), ¬ Cop j → ∀ (k : Fin 4),
      (Proof.MeshIntersectCancel.slot (MB[j]) k).eval Qt ≠ 0
      ∧ ((Proof.MeshIntersectCancel.slot (MB[j]) k).eval Qstar ≠ 0 →
          (0 < (Proof.MeshIntersectCancel.slot (MB[j]) k).eval Qstar
              ↔ 0 < (Proof.MeshIntersectCancel.slot (MB[j]) k).eval Qt)
          ∧ ((Proof.MeshIntersectCancel.slot (MB[j]) k).eval Qstar < 0
              ↔ (Proof.MeshIntersectCancel.slot (MB[j]) k).eval Qt < 0)) := by
    intro j hc k
    set g := Proof.MeshIntersectCancel.slot (MB[j]) k with hgdef
    set a := g.eval Qstar with hadef
    set s := dotQ g.n dv with hsdef
    have hstep : g.eval Qt = a + δ * s := by
      rw [hQtdef, CompanionHelpers.half_eval_step]
    by_cases ha : a = 0
    · have hsne : s ≠ 0 := by rw [hsdef, hgdef]; exact hfacet_tr j hc k (by rw [← hadef, ha])
      refine ⟨?_, fun hcc => absurd ha hcc⟩
      rw [hstep, ha, zero_add]
      exact CompanionHelpers.step_ne_of_base_zero hsne hδpos
    · by_cases hs0 : s = 0
      · refine ⟨?_, fun _ => ?_⟩
        · rw [hstep, hs0, mul_zero, add_zero]; exact ha
        · rw [hstep, hs0, mul_zero, add_zero]
          exact ⟨Iff.rfl, Iff.rfl⟩
      · have hbnd : δ * |s| < |a| := by
          have hle : δsign ≤ thr (j, k) := hδsignle (j, k)
          have hthreq : thr (j, k) = |a| / |s| := by
            rw [hthrdef]; dsimp only
            rw [if_pos ⟨by rw [← hadef]; exact ha, by rw [← hsdef]; exact hs0⟩]
          have hδthr : δ < |a| / |s| := by rw [← hthreq]; linarith
          rw [lt_div_iff₀ (abs_pos.mpr hs0)] at hδthr
          linarith
        obtain ⟨hne, hsgn1, hsgn2⟩ := CompanionHelpers.sign_preserve ha hδpos.le hbnd
        rw [hstep]
        exact ⟨hne, fun _ => ⟨hsgn1, hsgn2⟩⟩
  
  have hNHstep : ∀ (j : Fin MB.size) (k k' : Fin 4), ¬ Cop j →
      (k : ℕ) < 3 → (k' : ℕ) < 3 → k ≠ k' →
      dotQ (NHf j k k') Qt ≠ dotQ (NHf j k k') x₀ := by
    intro j k k' hc hk hk' hkk'
    set NH := NHf j k k' with hNHvardef
    have hstr : dotQ NH dv ≠ 0 := by
      have := htrans (NHf j k k') (hNHmem j k k') (hTrNH j k k' hc hk hk' hkk')
      rwa [← hNHvardef] at this
    rw [hQtdef, CompanionHelpers.dotQ_step]
    intro hcontra
    apply hδbad
    rw [hbadNHdef, Finset.mem_image]
    refine ⟨(j, k, k'), Finset.mem_univ _, ?_⟩
    dsimp only
    rw [← hNHvardef]
    field_simp
    linarith
  
  refine ⟨Qt, hQtfeas_mem, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · 
    intro j hc g hg
    obtain ⟨k, rfl⟩ := Proof.MeshIntersectCancel.mem_tetraHalves_iff.mp hg
    exact (hfacet j hc k).1
  · 
    intro j
    by_cases hCj : Cop j
    · 
      right
      exact ⟨hQstarCop j hCj Qstar hmem, hQstarCop j hCj Qt hQtfeas_mem⟩
    · 
      rcases hoff j with hnear | hfar
      · left
        intro g hg
        obtain ⟨k, rfl⟩ := Proof.MeshIntersectCancel.mem_tetraHalves_iff.mp hg
        have hane : (Proof.MeshIntersectCancel.slot (MB[j]) k).eval Qstar ≠ 0 :=
          hnear _ (Proof.MeshIntersectCancel.slot_mem (MB[j]) k)
        obtain ⟨hsgn1, hsgn2⟩ := (hfacet j hCj k).2 hane
        exact ⟨hane, hsgn1, hsgn2⟩
      · right
        have hdet3 : det3 (MB[j]).v₀ (MB[j]).v₁ (MB[j]).v₂ ≠ 0 := by
          rw [Proof.MeshIntersectCancel.det3_eq_detOrigin]; exact hnpoB j
        refine ⟨hfar, ?_⟩
        intro hQtin
        have hQsnotfeas : ¬ (∀ g ∈ tetraHalves (MB[j]), (0 : ℚ) ≤ Proof.SimImplCover.gOf g Qstar) := by
          rw [← Proof.SimImplCover.feasible_iff]
          intro h
          exact hfar ((feasible_iff_mem_simplex hdet3 Qstar).mp h)
        push_neg at hQsnotfeas
        obtain ⟨g, hgmem, hgviol⟩ := hQsnotfeas
        obtain ⟨k, rfl⟩ := Proof.MeshIntersectCancel.mem_tetraHalves_iff.mp hgmem
        have hQslt : (Proof.MeshIntersectCancel.slot (MB[j]) k).eval Qstar < 0 := by
          rw [Proof.SimImplCover.gOf_apply] at hgviol; exact hgviol
        have hane : (Proof.MeshIntersectCancel.slot (MB[j]) k).eval Qstar ≠ 0 := ne_of_lt hQslt
        have hQtlt : (Proof.MeshIntersectCancel.slot (MB[j]) k).eval Qt < 0 :=
          ((hfacet j hCj k).2 hane).2.mp hQslt
        have hQtfeas : feasible (tetraHalves (MB[j])) Qt = true :=
          (feasible_iff_mem_simplex hdet3 Qt).mpr hQtin
        rw [Proof.SimImplCover.feasible_iff] at hQtfeas
        have := hQtfeas _ (Proof.MeshIntersectCancel.slot_mem (MB[j]) k)
        rw [Proof.SimImplCover.gOf_apply] at this
        linarith
  · 
    intro j hc k k' hk hk' hkk hQtin
    have hlevel : dotQ (NHf j k k') Qt = dotQ (NHf j k k') x₀ :=
      CompanionHelpers.mem_level_of_mem_affineSpan
        (fun x hx => hNHgen j k k' hc hk hk' hkk x hx) hQtin
    exact hNHstep j k k' hc hk hk' hkk hlevel

name: fragConst_cop
statement:
theorem fragConst_cop {tA : Triangle} (hdetA : detOrigin tA ≠ 0)
    {MB : Mesh} (hwfB : Legacy.WellFormedMesh MB) {Cop : Fin MB.size → Prop}
    {f : Frag} (hf : FragInv (carrierNormal tA) (detOrigin tA) f)
    (hoffT : ∀ j : Fin MB.size, vrelint (fragCycle f) ∩ triangleSet (MB[j]) = ∅)
    (hrelintCop : ∀ j : Fin MB.size, Cop j → ∀ Q : Point, Q ∈ vrelint (fragCycle f) →
        Q ∉ simplex MB[j])
    {x : Point} (hx₀mem : x ∈ vrelint (fragCycle f))
    (hx₀cleanTr : ∀ j : Fin MB.size, ¬ Cop j → ∀ g ∈ tetraHalves (MB[j]),
        g.eval x ≠ 0)
    {Qstar : Point} (hmem : Qstar ∈ vrelint (fragCycle f))
    (hoff : OffBdy MB Qstar) :
    winding (meshChain MB) Qstar = winding (meshChain MB) x
proof:
:= by
  have hcycB : IsClosedOrientedSurface MB := hwfB.1
  have hnpoB : NoPlaneThroughOrigin MB := hwfB.2.2.2
  haveI := hf.neZero
  have hr3 : 3 ≤ f.poly.size := hf.size3
  
  obtain ⟨Qt, hQtmem, hQtclean, hpair, hLLqt⟩ :=
    companion_classify_cop_core hdetA hwfB
      (Cop := Cop) hf hx₀mem hx₀cleanTr hrelintCop hmem hoff
  
  refine (winding_eq_of_offBdyPair hnpoB hpair).trans ?_
  
  
  have hseg : ∀ τ : ℚ, 0 < τ → τ < 1 →
      (fun k => Qt k + τ * (x k - Qt k)) ∈ vrelint (fragCycle f) := by
    intro τ h0 h1
    have hconv := Proof.MeshIntersectClip.vrelint_convex hr3 hf.onPlane hf.strictConv
    have hmix := hconv hQtmem hx₀mem (by linarith : (0 : ℚ) ≤ 1 - τ) h0.le (by ring)
    have heq : (fun k => Qt k + τ * (x k - Qt k)) = (1 - τ) • Qt + τ • x := by
      funext k
      simp only [Pi.add_apply, Pi.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul]; ring
    rw [heq]; exact hmix
  
  have hsegcl : ∀ τ : ℚ, 0 ≤ τ → τ ≤ 1 → seg Qt x τ ∈ vrelint (fragCycle f) := by
    intro τ h0 h1
    rcases eq_or_lt_of_le h0 with h0' | h0'
    · have hq : seg Qt x τ = Qt := by rw [← h0']; funext c; simp [seg]
      rw [hq]; exact hQtmem
    · rcases eq_or_lt_of_le h1 with h1' | h1'
      · have hq : seg Qt x τ = x := by rw [h1']; funext c; simp [seg]
        rw [hq]; exact hx₀mem
      · have heq : seg Qt x τ = (fun k => Qt k + τ * (x k - Qt k)) := rfl
        rw [heq]; exact hseg τ h0' h1'
  apply Proof.MeshIntersectCancel.winding_const_of_avoiding_offTri_cop MB hcycB hnpoB Qt x
    (Cop := Cop)
  · 
    intro i τ h0 h1 hmemtri
    have hin : (fun k => Qt k + τ * (x k - Qt k))
        ∈ vrelint (fragCycle f) ∩ triangleSet (MB[i]) := ⟨hseg τ h0 h1, hmemtri⟩
    rw [hoffT i] at hin; exact hin
  · 
    intro k hCk τ h0 h1
    exact hrelintCop k hCk (seg Qt x τ) (hsegcl τ h0 h1)
  · 
    intro k hCk g hg
    exact ⟨hQtclean k hCk g hg, hx₀cleanTr k hCk g hg⟩
  · 
    intro k hCk a b ha hb hab τ h0 h1 hboth
    apply hLLqt k hCk a b ha hb hab
    set L : Set Point :=
      {z | (Proof.MeshIntersectCancel.slot (MB[k]) a).eval z = 0
          ∧ (Proof.MeshIntersectCancel.slot (MB[k]) b).eval z = 0} with hL
    have hxmem : x ∈ (affineSpan ℚ ({x} ∪ L) : Set Point) :=
      subset_affineSpan _ _ (Or.inl rfl)
    have hpmem : (fun c => Qt c + τ * (x c - Qt c))
        ∈ (affineSpan ℚ ({x} ∪ L) : Set Point) :=
      subset_affineSpan _ _ (Or.inr hboth)
    have hQtmem' := AffineSubspace.smul_vsub_vadd_mem
      (affineSpan ℚ ({x} ∪ L)) (1 - τ)⁻¹ hpmem hxmem hxmem
    have hτ1 : (1 - τ) ≠ 0 := by intro hc; apply ne_of_gt h1; linarith
    
    have hQteq : Qt = (1 - τ)⁻¹ • ((fun c => Qt c + τ * (x c - Qt c)) -ᵥ x) +ᵥ x := by
      funext kk
      simp only [vsub_eq_sub, vadd_eq_add, Pi.add_apply, Pi.smul_apply,
        Pi.sub_apply, smul_eq_mul]
      field_simp
      ring
    rw [hQteq]
    exact hQtmem'

name: nudge
statement:
theorem nudge {M : Mesh} (hcyc : IsClosedOrientedSurface M)
    (hnpo : NoPlaneThroughOrigin M) (hns : NoFaceInteriorContact M)
    {Q d : Point} (hQoff : ∀ u : Fin M.size, Q ∉ triangleSet M[u]) (hd : d ≠ 0)
    (hdclean : ∀ (u : Fin M.size) (s : ℚ), 0 < s → lineAt Q d s ∉ edgeSet M[u])
    (ρ : ℚ) (hρ : 0 < ρ)
    {ι : Type} [Fintype ι] (Nx : ι → Point) (dx : ι → ℚ) (hNx : ∀ α, Nx α ≠ 0) :
    ∃ P : Point,
      G1Clean M P ∧
      (∀ k, |P k - Q k| ≤ ρ) ∧
      (∀ α, dotQ (Nx α) P ≠ dx α) ∧
      winding (meshChain M) P = RayCount M Q d
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨P, d', hPclean, hd'ne, hoffc, hdN, hdA, hG2line, hnoedge,
      hoffSeg, hedgeSeg, hdθ, hedgeArc, hball, havoid⟩ :=
    gen_dense_ball hnpo hQoff hd hdclean ρ hρ Nx dx hNx
  refine ⟨P, hPclean, hball, havoid, ?_⟩
  
  have hL : RayCount M Q d = RayCount M P d := rayCount_local_const hnpo hoffSeg hedgeSeg
  have hD : RayCount M P d = RayCount M P d' :=
    rayCount_local_const_dir hnpo hoffc hdθ hedgeArc
  have hW : winding (meshChain M) P = RayCount M P d' :=
    raycount_eq_winding hcyc hnpo hns hPclean hd'ne hdN hdA hG2line hnoedge
  rw [hW, hL, hD]

name: winding_zero_off
statement:
theorem winding_zero_off (c : Chain) (K : Set Point) (Q : Point)
    (hsub : ∀ e ∈ c.toList, simplex e.2 ⊆ K) (hQ : Q ∉ K) :
    winding c Q = 0
proof:
:= by
  unfold winding
  apply List.sum_eq_zero
  intro y hy
  rw [List.mem_map] at hy
  obtain ⟨e, he, rfl⟩ := hy
  rw [if_neg]
  intro hmem
  exact hQ (hsub e he hmem)

name: coplanar_simplex_of_dep
statement:
theorem coplanar_simplex_of_dep (t : Triangle)
    (h : ¬ AffineIndependent ℚ ![(0 : Point), t.v₀, t.v₁, t.v₂]) :
    Coplanar ℚ (simplex t)
proof:
:= by
  have hle : Module.finrank ℚ
      (vectorSpan ℚ (Set.range ![(0 : Point), t.v₀, t.v₁, t.v₂])) ≤ 2 := by
    rw [finrank_vectorSpan_le_iff_not_affineIndependent ℚ _ (n := 2) (by simp)]
    exact h
  have hrange : Set.range ![(0 : Point), t.v₀, t.v₁, t.v₂]
      = ({0, t.v₀, t.v₁, t.v₂} : Set Point) := by
    ext x; constructor
    · rintro ⟨i, rfl⟩; fin_cases i <;> simp
    · rintro (rfl | rfl | rfl | rfl)
      exacts [⟨0, rfl⟩, ⟨1, rfl⟩, ⟨2, rfl⟩, ⟨3, rfl⟩]
  rw [hrange] at hle
  have hvc : vectorSpan ℚ ((convexHull ℚ) ({0, t.v₀, t.v₁, t.v₂} : Set Point))
      = vectorSpan ℚ ({0, t.v₀, t.v₁, t.v₂} : Set Point) := by
    rw [← direction_affineSpan, ← direction_affineSpan, affineSpan_convexHull]
  rw [show simplex t = (convexHull ℚ) ({0, t.v₀, t.v₁, t.v₂} : Set Point) from rfl,
    coplanar_iff_finrank_le_two, hvc]
  exact hle

name: nondeg_of_not_coplanar
statement:
theorem nondeg_of_not_coplanar (t : Triangle)
    (K : Set Point) (hKsub : K ⊆ simplex t) (hco : ¬ Coplanar ℚ K) :
    AffineIndependent ℚ ![(0 : Point), t.v₀, t.v₁, t.v₂]
proof:
:= by
  by_contra h
  exact hco ((coplanar_simplex_of_dep t h).subset hKsub)

name: zero_mem_K
statement: theorem zero_mem_K (s t : Triangle) : (0 : Point) ∈ Kpair s t
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩ <;> · apply subset_convexHull ℚ; simp [simplex]

name: verts_mem_K_of_nondeg
statement:
theorem verts_mem_K_of_nondeg (s t : Triangle)
    (hs : AffineIndependent ℚ ![(0 : Point), s.v₀, s.v₁, s.v₂])
    (ht : AffineIndependent ℚ ![(0 : Point), t.v₀, t.v₁, t.v₂])
    {p : Point} (hp : p ∈ verts (Gfun s t)) : p ∈ Kpair s t
proof:
:=
  feasible_imp_K' s t hs ht (mem_verts.mp hp).1

name: chainOf_sub_K_of_nondeg
statement:
theorem chainOf_sub_K_of_nondeg (s t : Triangle)
    (hs : AffineIndependent ℚ ![(0 : Point), s.v₀, s.v₁, s.v₂])
    (ht : AffineIndependent ℚ ![(0 : Point), t.v₀, t.v₁, t.v₂]) :
    ∀ e ∈ (chainOf (Gfun s t)).toList, simplex e.2 ⊆ Kpair s t
proof:
:= by
  intro e he
  
  rw [chainOf, Array.toList_toArray, List.mem_flatMap] at he
  obtain ⟨i, _, hk⟩ := he
  rw [List.mem_map] at hk
  obtain ⟨τ, hτ, rfl⟩ := hk
  rw [fanTriangles, Array.mem_toList, Array.mem_map] at hτ
  obtain ⟨k, hkr, rfl⟩ := hτ
  rw [Array.mem_def, Array.toList_range, List.mem_range] at hkr
  
  have hr2 : k < rr_c (Gfun s t) i - 2 := hkr
  have h0lt : 0 < rr_c (Gfun s t) i := by omega
  have h1lt : k + 1 < rr_c (Gfun s t) i := by omega
  have h2lt : k + 2 < rr_c (Gfun s t) i := by omega
  
  have hv0 : uu_c (Gfun s t) i 0 ∈ Kpair s t :=
    verts_mem_K_of_nondeg s t hs ht (mem_facetVerts.mp (uu_c_mem_facetVerts _ i 0 h0lt)).1
  have hv1 : uu_c (Gfun s t) i (k + 1) ∈ Kpair s t :=
    verts_mem_K_of_nondeg s t hs ht (mem_facetVerts.mp (uu_c_mem_facetVerts _ i (k + 1) h1lt)).1
  have hv2 : uu_c (Gfun s t) i (k + 2) ∈ Kpair s t :=
    verts_mem_K_of_nondeg s t hs ht (mem_facetVerts.mp (uu_c_mem_facetVerts _ i (k + 2) h2lt)).1
  have h0 : (0 : Point) ∈ Kpair s t := zero_mem_K s t
  show simplex (⟨uu_c (Gfun s t) i 0, uu_c (Gfun s t) i (k + 1),
    uu_c (Gfun s t) i (k + 2)⟩ : Triangle) ⊆ Kpair s t
  unfold simplex
  apply convexHull_min _ (K_convex s t)
  intro x hx
  simp only [Set.mem_insert_iff, Set.mem_singleton_iff] at hx
  rcases hx with rfl | rfl | rfl | rfl
  · exact h0
  · exact hv0
  · exact hv1
  · exact hv2

name: simImpl_sub_K
statement:
theorem simImpl_sub_K (s t : Triangle) :
    ∀ e ∈ (simImpl s t).toList, simplex e.2 ⊆ Kpair s t
proof:
:= by
  intro e he
  by_cases hg : (det3 s.v₀ s.v₁ s.v₂ != 0 && det3 t.v₀ t.v₁ t.v₂ != 0) = true
  · 
    have hsimp : simImpl s t = chainOf (Gfun s t) := by
      unfold simImpl; rw [if_pos hg]
    rw [Bool.and_eq_true, bne_iff_ne, bne_iff_ne] at hg
    obtain ⟨hds, hdt⟩ := hg
    have hs : AffineIndependent ℚ ![(0 : Point), s.v₀, s.v₁, s.v₂] :=
      affineIndependent_origin_apex_of_det3 hds
    have ht : AffineIndependent ℚ ![(0 : Point), t.v₀, t.v₁, t.v₂] :=
      affineIndependent_origin_apex_of_det3 hdt
    rw [hsimp] at he
    exact chainOf_sub_K_of_nondeg s t hs ht e he
  · 
    have hsimp : simImpl s t = #[] := by
      unfold simImpl; rw [if_neg hg]
    rw [hsimp] at he
    simp at he

name: K_Hrep_fin
statement:
theorem K_Hrep_fin (s t : Triangle)
    (hs : AffineIndependent ℚ ![(0 : Point), s.v₀, s.v₁, s.v₂])
    (ht : AffineIndependent ℚ ![(0 : Point), t.v₀, t.v₁, t.v₂]) :
    Kpair s t = ⋂ i : Fin (Gfun s t).size, {x : Point | 0 ≤ Gtil s t i x}
proof:
:= by
  rw [Kpair, K_Hrep_mem s t hs ht]
  ext x
  simp only [Set.mem_iInter, Set.mem_setOf_eq, Set.mem_iInter₂]
  constructor
  · intro hx i
    exact hx ((Gfun s t)[(i : ℕ)]'i.2) (Array.getElem_mem i.2)
  · intro hx g hg
    obtain ⟨j, hj, rfl⟩ := Array.mem_iff_getElem.mp hg
    exact hx ⟨j, hj⟩

name: Gtil_linear_ne_zero
statement:
theorem Gtil_linear_ne_zero (s t : Triangle)
    (bA : AffineBasis (Fin 4) ℚ (Fin 3 → ℚ))
    (hbA : ⇑bA = ![(0 : Point), s.v₀, s.v₁, s.v₂])
    (hAIs : AffineIndependent ℚ ![(0 : Point), s.v₀, s.v₁, s.v₂])
    (bB : AffineBasis (Fin 4) ℚ (Fin 3 → ℚ))
    (hbB : ⇑bB = ![(0 : Point), t.v₀, t.v₁, t.v₂])
    (hAIt : AffineIndependent ℚ ![(0 : Point), t.v₀, t.v₁, t.v₂]) :
    ∀ i : Fin (Gfun s t).size, (Gtil s t i).linear ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨hfwdA, _⟩ := tetra_facet_pos_smul s hAIs bA hbA
  obtain ⟨hfwdB, _⟩ := tetra_facet_pos_smul t hAIt bB hbB
  intro i
  have hmem : (Gfun s t)[(i : ℕ)]'i.2 ∈ tetraHalves s ++ tetraHalves t :=
    Array.getElem_mem i.2
  show (gOf ((Gfun s t)[(i : ℕ)]'i.2)).linear ≠ 0
  rcases Array.mem_append.mp hmem with hgs | hgt
  · obtain ⟨j, lam, hlam, heq⟩ := hfwdA _ hgs
    rw [heq]
    exact smul_affine_linear_ne_zero (ne_of_gt hlam)
      (Proof.Planes.affineBasis_coord_linear_ne_zero bA j)
  · obtain ⟨j, lam, hlam, heq⟩ := hfwdB _ hgt
    rw [heq]
    exact smul_affine_linear_ne_zero (ne_of_gt hlam)
      (Proof.Planes.affineBasis_coord_linear_ne_zero bB j)

name: Gtil_bind
statement:
theorem Gtil_bind (s t : Triangle)
    (bA : AffineBasis (Fin 4) ℚ (Fin 3 → ℚ))
    (hbA : ⇑bA = ![(0 : Point), s.v₀, s.v₁, s.v₂])
    (hAIs : AffineIndependent ℚ ![(0 : Point), s.v₀, s.v₁, s.v₂]) :
    ∀ {Q : Point}, Q ≠ 0 → ∃ i : Fin (Gfun s t).size, (Gtil s t i).linear Q < 0
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨_, hbwdA⟩ := tetra_facet_pos_smul s hAIs bA hbA
  intro Q hQ
  obtain ⟨k, hk⟩ := Proof.AffineBasisSimplex.directions_bounded_by_A_faces bA hQ
  obtain ⟨g, hgmem, lam, hlam, heq⟩ := hbwdA k
  
  have hgGfun : g ∈ Gfun s t :=
    Array.mem_append.mpr (Or.inl hgmem)
  obtain ⟨i, hi, hgi⟩ := Array.mem_iff_getElem.mp hgGfun
  refine ⟨⟨i, hi⟩, ?_⟩
  show (gOf ((Gfun s t)[i]'hi)).linear Q < 0
  rw [hgi, heq, AffineMap.smul_linear]
  show lam • ((bA.coord k).linear Q) < 0
  rw [smul_eq_mul]
  exact mul_neg_of_pos_of_neg hlam hk

name: simImpl_winding
statement:
theorem simImpl_winding (s t : Triangle) :
    ∃ N : Set Point, Negligible N
      ∧ ∀ Q ∉ N, winding (CSG.Impl.Legacy.Sim.simImpl s t) Q
          = (if Q ∈ simplex s ∩ simplex t then (1 : ℤ) else 0)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  
  have hsub : ∀ e ∈ (simImpl s t).toList, simplex e.2 ⊆ Kpair s t := simImpl_sub_K s t
  have h0K : (0 : Point) ∈ Kpair s t := zero_mem_K s t
  by_cases hco : Coplanar ℚ (Kpair s t)
  · 
    obtain ⟨H, hHplane, hKH⟩ := Proof.Planes.coplanar_subset_isPlane hco ⟨0, h0K⟩
    refine ⟨H, ⟨1, fun _ => H, fun _ => hHplane, fun x hx => Set.mem_iUnion.mpr ⟨0, hx⟩⟩, ?_⟩
    intro Q hQ
    have hQK : Q ∉ Kpair s t := fun hQK => hQ (hKH hQK)
    rw [winding_zero_off (simImpl s t) (Kpair s t) Q hsub hQK]
    rw [if_neg]
    exact fun h => hQK h
  · 
    
    have hKA : Kpair s t ⊆ simplex s := Set.inter_subset_left
    have hKB : Kpair s t ⊆ simplex t := Set.inter_subset_right
    have hAIs : AffineIndependent ℚ ![(0 : Point), s.v₀, s.v₁, s.v₂] :=
      nondeg_of_not_coplanar s _ hKA hco
    have hAIt : AffineIndependent ℚ ![(0 : Point), t.v₀, t.v₁, t.v₂] :=
      nondeg_of_not_coplanar t _ hKB hco
    obtain ⟨bA, _, hbAcoe, _, _⟩ := Proof.AffineBasisSimplex.simplexAffineBasis s hAIs
    obtain ⟨bB, _, hbBcoe, _, _⟩ := Proof.AffineBasisSimplex.simplexAffineBasis t hAIt
    set G : Fin (Gfun s t).size → (Point →ᵃ[ℚ] ℚ) := Gtil s t with hGdef
    set K : Set Point := Kpair s t with hKdef
    
    have hKG : K = ⋂ i, {x : Point | 0 ≤ G i x} := K_Hrep_fin s t hAIs hAIt
    
    have hbdd : ∃ tB : Triangle, K ⊆ simplex tB := ⟨s, hKA⟩
    
    have hg0 : ∀ i, 0 ≤ G i 0 := by
      intro i
      have h0mem : (0 : Point) ∈ ⋂ i, {x : Point | 0 ≤ G i x} := by rw [← hKG]; exact h0K
      have := Set.mem_iInter.mp h0mem i
      simpa using this
    
    have hLnz : ∀ i, (G i).linear ≠ 0 :=
      Gtil_linear_ne_zero s t bA hbAcoe hAIs bB hbBcoe hAIt
    
    have hbind : ∀ {Q : Point}, Q ≠ 0 → ∃ i, (G i).linear Q < 0 :=
      fun {Q} hQ => Gtil_bind s t bA hbAcoe hAIs hQ
    
    set R : Finset (Fin (Gfun s t).size) := Proof.SimWinding.leaders G K with hRdef
    have hRleaders : R = Proof.SimWinding.leaders G K := rfl
    set rr : Fin (Gfun s t).size → ℕ := fun i => rr_c (Gfun s t) (i : ℕ) with hrrdef
    set uu : Fin (Gfun s t).size → ℕ → Point := fun i => uu_c (Gfun s t) (i : ℕ) with huudef
    
    have hleaderCover : ∀ i ∈ R,
        3 ≤ rr i
        ∧ ({x : Point | G i x = 0} ∩ K)
            = ⋃ kk ∈ Finset.range (rr i - 2),
                convexHull ℚ {uu i 0, uu i (kk + 1), uu i (kk + 2)}
        ∧ (∀ kk ∈ Finset.range (rr i - 2),
            AffineIndependent ℚ ![(0 : Point), uu i 0, uu i (kk + 1), uu i (kk + 2)])
        ∧ (∀ a ∈ Finset.range (rr i - 2), ∀ b ∈ Finset.range (rr i - 2), a ≠ b →
            (convexHull ℚ {uu i 0, uu i (a + 1), uu i (a + 2)}
              ∩ convexHull ℚ {uu i 0, uu i (b + 1), uu i (b + 2)})
            ⊆ ⋃ kk ∈ Finset.range (rr i - 2),
                (convexHull ℚ {uu i 0, uu i (kk + 1)}
                  ∪ convexHull ℚ {uu i (kk + 1), uu i (kk + 2)})) := by
      intro i hiR
      have hO : Proof.SimWinding.Outer2D G K i := by
        rw [hRdef, Proof.SimWinding.leaders, Finset.mem_filter] at hiR
        exact hiR.2.1
      have hlt : (i : ℕ) < (Gfun s t).size := i.2
      have hgi : (Gfun s t)[(i : ℕ)]? = some ((Gfun s t)[(i : ℕ)]'hlt) :=
        Array.getElem?_eq_getElem hlt
      have hGtil_eq : G i = gOf ((Gfun s t)[(i : ℕ)]'hlt) := rfl
      have houter : 0 < (gOf ((Gfun s t)[(i : ℕ)]'hlt)) 0 := by rw [← hGtil_eq]; exact hO.1
      have hdim : Module.finrank ℚ
          (vectorSpan ℚ ({x : Point | (gOf ((Gfun s t)[(i : ℕ)]'hlt)) x = 0} ∩ Kpair s t)) = 2 := by
        rw [← hGtil_eq]; exact hO.2
      have hcov := computed_fan_cover s t hgi houter hdim
      
      rw [← hGtil_eq] at hcov
      exact hcov
    have hrr : ∀ i ∈ R, 3 ≤ rr i := fun i hi => (hleaderCover i hi).1
    have hcoverr : ∀ i ∈ R, ({x : Point | G i x = 0} ∩ K)
        = ⋃ kk ∈ Finset.range (rr i - 2),
            convexHull ℚ {uu i 0, uu i (kk + 1), uu i (kk + 2)} :=
      fun i hi => (hleaderCover i hi).2.1
    have hnondegr : ∀ i ∈ R, ∀ kk ∈ Finset.range (rr i - 2),
        AffineIndependent ℚ ![(0 : Point), uu i 0, uu i (kk + 1), uu i (kk + 2)] :=
      fun i hi => (hleaderCover i hi).2.2.1
    have hdisjr : ∀ i ∈ R, ∀ a ∈ Finset.range (rr i - 2), ∀ b ∈ Finset.range (rr i - 2),
        a ≠ b →
        (convexHull ℚ {uu i 0, uu i (a + 1), uu i (a + 2)}
          ∩ convexHull ℚ {uu i 0, uu i (b + 1), uu i (b + 2)})
        ⊆ ⋃ kk ∈ Finset.range (rr i - 2),
            (convexHull ℚ {uu i 0, uu i (kk + 1)}
              ∪ convexHull ℚ {uu i (kk + 1), uu i (kk + 2)}) :=
      fun i hi => (hleaderCover i hi).2.2.2
    
    have hcperm : (simImpl s t).toList.Perm (R.toList.flatMap fun i =>
        ((Finset.range (rr i - 2)).toList.map fun k =>
          ((1 : Int), (⟨uu i 0, uu i (k + 1), uu i (k + 2)⟩ : Triangle)))) :=
      simImpl_chain_perm s t hco
    
    obtain ⟨_, _, N, hN, hcount⟩ :=
      Proof.SimWinding.originFan_winding_one G K hKG h0K hbdd hbind hg0 hLnz
        R hRleaders rr uu hrr hcoverr hnondegr hdisjr (simImpl s t) hcperm
    refine ⟨N, hN, ?_⟩
    intro Q hQN
    have hKeq : K = simplex s ∩ simplex t := hKdef
    have hsubK : ∀ e ∈ (simImpl s t).toList, simplex e.2 ⊆ K := by
      rw [hKeq]; exact hsub
    by_cases hQK : Q ∈ K
    · rw [hcount Q hQK hQN, if_pos (hKeq ▸ hQK)]
    · rw [winding_zero_off (simImpl s t) K Q hsubK hQK, if_neg]
      rw [hKeq] at hQK; exact hQK

name: simImpl_windingSpec
statement:
theorem simImpl_windingSpec :
    CSG.Proof.ProductChainGen.WindingSpec CSG.Impl.Legacy.Sim.simImpl
proof:
:=
  simImpl_winding

name: exists_count_eq_cell_off_negligible
statement:
theorem exists_count_eq_cell_off_negligible {X : Mesh} {P₀ d : Point}
    (hP₀ : P₀ ∉ surface X) (hadm : AdmissibleRay X P₀ d)
    {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι] (G : ι → (Point →ᵃ[ℚ] ℚ)) (S : ι → ℚ)
    (hSsign : ∀ j, S j = 1 ∨ S j = -1) (hSstrict : ∀ j, 0 < S j * G j P₀)
    {N : Set Point} (hN : Negligible N) :
    ∃ P, crossingCount X P d = crossingCount X P₀ d ∧
      (∀ j, 0 < S j * G j P) ∧ P ∉ N
proof:
:= by
  classical
  obtain ⟨_, hedge⟩ := hadm
  
  have hP₀tri : ∀ u : Fin X.size, P₀ ∉ triangleSet X[u] :=
    fun u hmem => hP₀ (Set.mem_iUnion.mpr ⟨u, hmem⟩)
  have hP₀edge : ∀ (u : Fin X.size) (s : ℚ), 0 < s → P₀ + s • d ∉ edgeSet X[u] :=
    fun u s hs => hedge u s hs
  
  set ρ : Type _ := (Fin X.size × Fin 4) ⊕ ι with hρ
  set GG : ρ → (Point →ᵃ[ℚ] ℚ) :=
    Sum.elim (fun uk => (wfam X[uk.1] d P₀ uk.2).1) G with hGG
  set SS : ρ → ℚ :=
    Sum.elim (fun uk => (wfam X[uk.1] d P₀ uk.2).2) S with hSS
  have hSSsign : ∀ p, SS p = 1 ∨ SS p = -1 := by
    intro p; cases p with
    | inl uk => exact wfam_sign X[uk.1] d P₀ uk.2
    | inr j => exact hSsign j
  have hSSstrict : ∀ p, 0 < SS p * GG p P₀ := by
    intro p; cases p with
    | inl uk => exact wfam_strict (hP₀tri uk.1) (hP₀edge uk.1) uk.2
    | inr j => exact hSstrict j
  obtain ⟨P, hPcell, hPN⟩ := exists_off_negligible_in_cell' GG SS hSSsign hSSstrict hN
  refine ⟨P, ?_, ?_, hPN⟩
  · 
    rw [crossingCount_eq_sum, crossingCount_eq_sum]
    refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun u _ => ?_)
    refine wfam_forces (fun j => ?_)
    exact hPcell (Sum.inl (u, j))
  · 
    intro j; exact hPcell (Sum.inr j)

name: outside_density_in_cell
statement:
theorem outside_density_in_cell {X : Mesh}
    (hcyc : IsClosedOrientedSurface X) (hns : NoFaceInteriorContact X)
    (hwzo : WindingZeroOrOne X) (hndf : NoDegenerateFaces X)
    {O : Point} (hnpo : NoPlaneThroughOrigin (trMesh O X))
    {Q : Point} (hQ : Q ∈ surface X) {N : Set Point} (hN : Negligible N)
    {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι] (g : ι → (Point →ᵃ[ℚ] ℚ)) (s : ι → ℚ)
    (hssign : ∀ j, s j = 1 ∨ s j = -1) (hsstrict : ∀ j, 0 < s j * g j Q) :
    ∃ P, (∀ j, 0 < s j * g j P) ∧ P ∉ N ∧ P ∉ surface X ∧
      ∀ d', AdmissibleRay X P d' → crossingCount X P d' = 0
proof:
:= by
  classical
  
  rw [surface, Set.mem_iUnion] at hQ
  obtain ⟨i, hQi⟩ := hQ
  
  
  set gpos : ι → (Point →ᵃ[ℚ] ℚ) := fun j => (s j) • g j with hgpos
  have hgpos_apply : ∀ j P, gpos j P = s j * g j P := by
    intro j P; simp only [hgpos, AffineMap.coe_smul, Pi.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul]
  have hgposQ : ∀ j, 0 < gpos j Q := fun j => by rw [hgpos_apply]; exact hsstrict j
  obtain ⟨rg, hrgpos, hrgspec⟩ := exists_box_pos_family gpos hgposQ
  
  obtain ⟨x, hxmem, hxedge, hxbox⟩ :=
    exists_relint_in_box (hndf i) hQi (r := rg / 2) (by linarith)
  
  have hiso : ∀ u : Fin X.size, u ≠ i → x ∉ triangleSet X[u] :=
    fun u hu => relint_isolated hns hxmem hxedge hu
  
  obtain ⟨P₀, -, d, ⟨hP₀box, hP₀count, hP₀adm, hP₀surf⟩, -⟩ :=
    exists_jump_probe hwzo hndf hxmem hxedge hiso (R := rg / 2) (by linarith)
  
  have hP₀Qbox : ∀ k, |P₀ k - Q k| ≤ rg := by
    intro k
    have h1 := hxbox k    
    have h2 := hP₀box k   
    have : |P₀ k - Q k| ≤ |P₀ k - x k| + |x k - Q k| := by
      have := abs_sub_le (P₀ k) (x k) (Q k); linarith
    rw [mem_Box] at *  
    linarith [h1, h2, this]
  have hgposP₀ : ∀ j, 0 < s j * g j P₀ := by
    intro j; rw [← hgpos_apply]; exact hrgspec P₀ hP₀Qbox j
  
  have hNbig : Negligible (N ∪ surface X ∪ {P | ¬ AdmissibleRay X P d}) :=
    Proof.Negligible.negligible_union
      (Proof.Negligible.negligible_union hN (surface_negligible hndf))
      (negligible_not_admissible hP₀adm.1)
  obtain ⟨P, hPcount, hPstrict, hPN⟩ :=
    exists_count_eq_cell_off_negligible hP₀surf hP₀adm g s hssign hgposP₀ hNbig
  
  simp only [Set.mem_union, Set.mem_setOf_eq, not_or, not_not] at hPN
  obtain ⟨⟨hPnotN, hPsurf⟩, hPadm⟩ := hPN
  refine ⟨P, hPstrict, hPnotN, hPsurf, fun d' hadm' => ?_⟩
  
  have hcount_d : crossingCount X P d = 0 := by rw [hPcount]; exact hP₀count
  rw [crossingCount_eq_of_offSurface hcyc hns hnpo hPsurf hadm' hPadm, hcount_d]

name: outside_density
statement:
theorem outside_density {X : Mesh}
    (hcyc : IsClosedOrientedSurface X) (hns : NoFaceInteriorContact X)
    (hwzo : WindingZeroOrOne X) (hndf : NoDegenerateFaces X)
    {O : Point} (hnpo : NoPlaneThroughOrigin (trMesh O X))
    {Q : Point} (hQ : Q ∈ surface X) {N : Set Point} (hN : Negligible N)
    {r : ℚ} (hr : 0 < r) :
    ∃ P, P ∈ BoxO Q r ∧ P ∉ N ∧ P ∉ surface X ∧
      ∀ d', AdmissibleRay X P d' → crossingCount X P d' = 0
proof:
:= by
  classical
  
  
  set g : (Fin 3 × Bool) → (Point →ᵃ[ℚ] ℚ) := fun kb =>
    (boxFunctional Q r kb.1 kb.2) with hg
  have hssign : ∀ j : Fin 3 × Bool, (1 : ℚ) = 1 ∨ (1 : ℚ) = -1 := fun _ => Or.inl rfl
  have hstrict : ∀ j : Fin 3 × Bool, 0 < (1 : ℚ) * g j Q := by
    intro ⟨k, b⟩; rw [one_mul, hg]; exact boxFunctional_pos_self Q k b hr
  obtain ⟨P, hPstrict, hPN, hPsurf, hPcount⟩ :=
    outside_density_in_cell hcyc hns hwzo hndf hnpo hQ hN g (fun _ => 1) hssign hstrict
  refine ⟨P, ?_, hPN, hPsurf, hPcount⟩
  
  rw [mem_BoxO]; intro k
  have hpos := hPstrict (k, true)   
  have hneg := hPstrict (k, false)  
  rw [one_mul, hg] at hpos hneg
  simp only [boxFunctional_true, boxFunctional_false] at hpos hneg
  rw [abs_lt]; constructor <;> linarith

name: carrierPlane_isPlane
statement:
theorem carrierPlane_isPlane {t : Triangle} (hn : faceNormal t ≠ 0) :
    IsPlane (carrierPlane t)
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨faceNormal t, cOf t, hn, ?_⟩
  ext x; simp only [carrierPlane, Set.mem_setOf_eq, dot]

name: carrierUnion_negligible
statement:
theorem carrierUnion_negligible {X : Mesh} (hndf : NoDegenerateFaces X) :
    Negligible (⋃ i : Fin X.size, carrierPlane X[i])
proof:
:=
  Proof.Negligible.negligible_iUnion_fintype
    (fun i => ⟨1, fun _ => carrierPlane X[i], fun _ => carrierPlane_isPlane (hndf i),
      fun x hx => Set.mem_iUnion.mpr ⟨0, hx⟩⟩)

name: box_segment_mem
statement:
theorem box_segment_mem {Q P : Point} {r : ℚ} (_hQ : Q ∈ Box Q r) (hP : P ∈ Box Q r)
    {t : ℚ} (ht0 : 0 ≤ t) (ht1 : t ≤ 1) : Q + t • (P - Q) ∈ Box Q r
proof:
:= by
  intro k
  simp only [Pi.add_apply, Pi.smul_apply, Pi.sub_apply, smul_eq_mul, add_sub_cancel_left, abs_mul]
  have hPk : |P k - Q k| ≤ r := hP k
  rw [abs_of_nonneg ht0]
  calc t * |P k - Q k| ≤ 1 * r :=
        mul_le_mul ht1 hPk (abs_nonneg _) (by norm_num)
    _ = r := one_mul _

name: surface_disjoint_solid
statement:
theorem surface_disjoint_solid {X : Mesh}
    (hcyc : IsClosedOrientedSurface X) (hns : NoFaceInteriorContact X)
    (hwzo : WindingZeroOrOne X) (hndf : NoDegenerateFaces X)
    {O : Point} (hnpo : NoPlaneThroughOrigin (trMesh O X))
    {Q : Point} (hQsurf : Q ∈ surface X) : Q ∉ solid X
proof:
:= by
  classical
  
  have hbox : ∀ u : Fin X.size,
      ∃ ρ : ℚ, 0 < ρ ∧ (Q ∉ triangleSet X[u] → ∀ P, P ∈ Box Q ρ → P ∉ triangleSet X[u]) := by
    intro u
    by_cases hu : Q ∈ triangleSet X[u]
    · exact ⟨1, one_pos, fun h => absurd hu h⟩
    · obtain ⟨ρ, hρpos, hρspec⟩ := exists_separating_box (hndf u) hu
      exact ⟨ρ, hρpos, fun _ => hρspec⟩
  choose ρf hρfpos hρfspec using hbox
  have hune : (Finset.univ : Finset (Fin X.size)).Nonempty := by
    rw [surface, Set.mem_iUnion] at hQsurf; obtain ⟨i, _⟩ := hQsurf
    exact ⟨i, Finset.mem_univ i⟩
  set r : ℚ := Finset.univ.inf' hune ρf with hr
  have hrpos : 0 < r := by rw [hr, Finset.lt_inf'_iff]; exact fun u _ => hρfpos u
  have hrle : ∀ u, r ≤ ρf u := fun u => Finset.inf'_le _ (Finset.mem_univ u)
  have hboxdisj : ∀ (u : Fin X.size), Q ∉ triangleSet X[u] → ∀ P, P ∈ Box Q r → P ∉ triangleSet X[u] :=
    fun u hu P hP => hρfspec u hu P (Box_mono (hrle u) hP)
  
  have hN : Negligible ({P | ∃ (j : Fin X.size) (s : ℚ), 0 < s ∧ Q + s • (P - Q) ∈ edgeSet X[j]}
      ∪ (⋃ i : Fin X.size, carrierPlane X[i])) :=
    Proof.Negligible.negligible_union (coneShadow_negligible X Q) (carrierUnion_negligible hndf)
  obtain ⟨Pstar, hPbox, hPN, hPsurf, hPcount⟩ :=
    outside_density hcyc hns hwzo hndf hnpo hQsurf hN hrpos
  
  simp only [Set.mem_union, Set.mem_iUnion, not_or, Set.mem_setOf_eq, not_exists] at hPN
  obtain ⟨hPcone, hPplane⟩ := hPN
  
  have hPoffcarrier : ∀ i : Fin X.size, dot (faceNormal X[i]) Pstar ≠ cOf X[i] := by
    intro i hc; exact hPplane i (by rw [carrierPlane, Set.mem_setOf_eq]; exact hc)
  
  set d : Point := Pstar - Q with hd
  have hd0 : d ≠ 0 := by
    intro h
    have : Pstar = Q := by funext k; have := congrFun h k; simp only [hd, Pi.sub_apply, Pi.zero_apply] at this; linarith
    rw [this] at hPsurf; exact hPsurf hQsurf
  
  have hadmQ : AdmissibleRay X Q d := by
    refine ⟨hd0, fun j s hs hmem => ?_⟩
    exact hPcone j s ⟨hs, hmem⟩
  
  have hPboxc : Pstar ∈ Box Q r := BoxO_subset_Box Q r hPbox
  have hQboxc : Q ∈ Box Q r := self_mem_Box Q hrpos.le
  
  have hwindow : ∀ σ : ℚ, 0 < σ → σ ≤ 1 → Q + σ • d ∉ surface X := by
    intro σ hσ0 hσ1 hmem
    rw [surface, Set.mem_iUnion] at hmem
    obtain ⟨u, hu⟩ := hmem
    by_cases hQu : Q ∈ triangleSet X[u]
    · 
      have hcarQ : dot (faceNormal X[u]) Q = cOf X[u] := triangleSet_carrier hQu
      have hcarhit : dot (faceNormal X[u]) (Q + σ • d) = cOf X[u] := triangleSet_carrier hu
      rw [dot_line, hcarQ] at hcarhit
      
      have hnud : dot (faceNormal X[u]) d = dot (faceNormal X[u]) Pstar - cOf X[u] := by
        rw [hd, dot_sub_right, hcarQ]
      have hz : σ * dot (faceNormal X[u]) d = 0 := by linarith
      rcases mul_eq_zero.mp hz with h | h
      · exact absurd h (ne_of_gt hσ0)
      · rw [hnud, sub_eq_zero] at h; exact hPoffcarrier u h
    · 
      have hin : Q + σ • d ∈ Box Q r :=
        box_segment_mem hQboxc hPboxc hσ0.le hσ1
      exact hboxdisj u hQu (Q + σ • d) hin hu
  
  have hslide : crossingCount X Q d = crossingCount X (Q + (1:ℚ) • d) d :=
    crossingCount_window_slide hd0 one_pos hwindow
  have hPstar_eq : Q + (1:ℚ) • d = Pstar := by
    rw [hd, one_smul]; funext k; simp only [Pi.add_apply, Pi.sub_apply]; ring
  rw [hPstar_eq] at hslide
  
  have hadmP : AdmissibleRay X Pstar d := by
    have := admissibleRay_window_slide hadmQ one_pos
    rwa [hPstar_eq] at this
  have hcountP : crossingCount X Pstar d = 0 := hPcount d hadmP
  
  intro hsolid
  have hne := hsolid d hadmQ
  rw [hslide, hcountP] at hne
  exact hne rfl

name: mem_affineSpan_iff_sub_mem_span
proof:
:= by
  have hv0 : v0 ∈ ({v0, v1, v2} : Set (Fin 3 → ℚ)) := by simp
  have hv0' : v0 ∈ affineSpan ℚ ({v0, v1, v2} : Set (Fin 3 → ℚ)) :=
    subset_affineSpan ℚ _ hv0
  rw [AffineSubspace.mem_coe,
      ← AffineSubspace.vsub_right_mem_direction_iff_mem hv0' p,
      direction_affineSpan, vectorSpan_eq_span_vsub_set_right ℚ hv0]
  have himg : ((fun x => x -ᵥ v0) '' ({v0, v1, v2} : Set (Fin 3 → ℚ)))
      = {0, v1 - v0, v2 - v0} := by
    simp [Set.image_insert_eq, vsub_eq_sub]
  rw [himg, vsub_eq_sub, Submodule.span_insert_zero]

name: dot_cross_eq_zero_of_mem_span_pair
statement:
theorem dot_cross_eq_zero_of_mem_span_pair (e1 e2 w : Fin 3 → ℚ)
    (hw : w ∈ Submodule.span ℚ {e1, e2}) : (crossProduct e1 e2) ⬝ᵥ w = 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [Submodule.mem_span_pair] at hw
  obtain ⟨a, b, hab⟩ := hw
  rw [← hab, dotProduct_add, dotProduct_smul, dotProduct_smul,
      show (crossProduct e1 e2) ⬝ᵥ e1 = 0 by rw [dotProduct_comm]; exact dot_self_cross e1 e2,
      show (crossProduct e1 e2) ⬝ᵥ e2 = 0 by rw [dotProduct_comm]; exact dot_cross_self e1 e2]
  simp

name: mem_span_pair_iff_dot_cross_zero
statement:
theorem mem_span_pair_iff_dot_cross_zero (e1 e2 w : Fin 3 → ℚ)
    (hn : crossProduct e1 e2 ≠ 0) :
    w ∈ Submodule.span ℚ {e1, e2} ↔ (crossProduct e1 e2) ⬝ᵥ w = 0
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨dot_cross_eq_zero_of_mem_span_pair e1 e2 w, fun hw => ?_⟩
  have hind : LinearIndependent ℚ ![e1, e2] :=
    crossProduct_ne_zero_iff_linearIndependent.mp hn
  have hrange : ({e1, e2} : Set (Fin 3 → ℚ)) = Set.range ![e1, e2] := by
    rw [Matrix.range_cons, Matrix.range_cons, Matrix.range_empty]
    simp [Set.insert_comm, Set.pair_comm]
  let φ : (Fin 3 → ℚ) →ₗ[ℚ] ℚ :=
    { toFun := fun x => (crossProduct e1 e2) ⬝ᵥ x
      map_add' := by intro x y; simp [dotProduct_add]
      map_smul' := by intro a x; simp [dotProduct_smul] }
  have hφapp : ∀ x, φ x = (crossProduct e1 e2) ⬝ᵥ x := fun x => rfl
  have hφne : φ ≠ 0 := by
    intro h; apply hn
    have hnn : φ (crossProduct e1 e2) = 0 := by rw [h]; rfl
    rw [hφapp] at hnn; exact (dotProduct_self_eq_zero).mp hnn
  have hle : Submodule.span ℚ {e1, e2} ≤ LinearMap.ker φ := by
    rw [Submodule.span_le]
    intro x hx
    simp only [Set.mem_insert_iff, Set.mem_singleton_iff] at hx
    rw [SetLike.mem_coe, LinearMap.mem_ker, hφapp]
    rcases hx with h | h <;> rw [h, dotProduct_comm]
    · exact dot_self_cross e1 e2
    · exact dot_cross_self e1 e2
  have hspan2 : Module.finrank ℚ (Submodule.span ℚ {e1, e2}) = 2 := by
    rw [hrange, finrank_span_eq_card hind]; simp
  have hrange1 : Module.finrank ℚ (LinearMap.range φ) = 1 := by
    have htop : LinearMap.range φ = ⊤ :=
      LinearMap.range_eq_top.mpr (LinearMap.surjective_of_ne_zero hφne)
    rw [htop]; simp
  have hker2 : Module.finrank ℚ (LinearMap.ker φ) = 2 := by
    have hrk := φ.finrank_range_add_finrank_ker
    rw [hrange1] at hrk
    have htotal : Module.finrank ℚ (Fin 3 → ℚ) = 3 := by simp
    omega
  have heq : Submodule.span ℚ {e1, e2} = LinearMap.ker φ :=
    Submodule.eq_of_le_of_finrank_le hle (by rw [hspan2, hker2])
  rw [heq, LinearMap.mem_ker, hφapp]; exact hw

name: mem_span_singleton_iff_cross_zero
statement:
theorem mem_span_singleton_iff_cross_zero (w d : Fin 3 → ℚ) (hd : d ≠ 0) :
    w ∈ Submodule.span ℚ {d} ↔ crossProduct w d = 0
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro hw
    rw [Submodule.mem_span_singleton] at hw
    obtain ⟨a, ha⟩ := hw
    rw [← ha, LinearMap.map_smul₂, cross_self, smul_zero]
  · intro h
    rw [Submodule.mem_span_singleton]
    by_contra hcon
    push_neg at hcon
    have hi : LinearIndependent ℚ ![d, w] := by
      rw [LinearIndependent.pair_iff' hd]; exact hcon
    have hcross : crossProduct d w ≠ 0 :=
      crossProduct_ne_zero_iff_linearIndependent.mpr hi
    apply hcross; rw [← neg_cross, h, neg_zero]

name: span_pair_eq_span_singleton_left
proof:
:= by
  have he2 : e2 ∈ Submodule.span ℚ {e1} := by
    rw [mem_span_singleton_iff_cross_zero e2 e1 he1, ← neg_cross, h, neg_zero]
  rw [Set.pair_comm, show ({e2, e1} : Set (Fin 3 → ℚ)) = insert e2 {e1} from rfl,
      Submodule.span_insert_eq_span he2]

name: inFacePlane_iff_mem_span
statement:
theorem inFacePlane_iff_mem_span (p : I3) (t : FaceH) :
    inFacePlane p t = true ↔
      (decI p - decI t.v₀) ∈
        Submodule.span ℚ {decI t.v₁ - decI t.v₀, decI t.v₂ - decI t.v₀}
proof:
:= by
  
  set e1 := decI t.v₁ - decI t.v₀ with he1
  set e2 := decI t.v₂ - decI t.v₀ with he2
  set w := decI p - decI t.v₀ with hw
  
  have hdsub1 : decI (subI t.v₁ t.v₀) = e1 := by rw [decI_sub, he1]
  have hdsub2 : decI (subI t.v₂ t.v₀) = e2 := by rw [decI_sub, he2]
  have hdsubw : decI (subI p t.v₀) = w := by rw [decI_sub, hw]
  have hdcross : decI (crossI (subI t.v₁ t.v₀) (subI t.v₂ t.v₀)) = crossProduct e1 e2 := by
    rw [decI_cross, hdsub1, hdsub2]
  unfold inFacePlane
  simp only []
  
  by_cases hnz : isZeroI (crossI (subI t.v₁ t.v₀) (subI t.v₂ t.v₀)) = true
  · 
    have hcz : crossProduct e1 e2 = 0 := by
      rw [← hdcross]; exact (decI_isZero _).mp hnz
    rw [if_neg (by simp [hnz])]
    by_cases he1z : isZeroI (subI t.v₁ t.v₀) = true
    · 
      have he1eq : e1 = 0 := by rw [← hdsub1]; exact (decI_isZero _).mp he1z
      rw [if_neg (by simp [he1z])]
      by_cases he2z : isZeroI (subI t.v₂ t.v₀) = true
      · 
        have he2eq : e2 = 0 := by rw [← hdsub2]; exact (decI_isZero _).mp he2z
        rw [if_neg (by simp [he2z])]
        
        have hspanbot : Submodule.span ℚ ({e1, e2} : Set (Fin 3 → ℚ)) = ⊥ := by
          rw [he1eq, he2eq, Submodule.span_insert_zero, Submodule.span_zero_singleton]
        rw [hspanbot, Submodule.mem_bot, decI_beq, sub_eq_zero]
      · 
        have he2ne : e2 ≠ 0 := by
          rw [← hdsub2]; intro h; exact he2z ((decI_isZero _).mpr h)
        rw [if_pos (by simp at he2z ⊢; exact he2z)]
        
        have hspaneq : Submodule.span ℚ ({e1, e2} : Set (Fin 3 → ℚ))
            = Submodule.span ℚ {e2} := by
          rw [he1eq, Submodule.span_insert_zero]
        rw [hspaneq]
        have hbool : isZeroI (crossI (subI p t.v₀) (subI t.v₂ t.v₀)) = true
            ↔ crossProduct w e2 = 0 := by
          rw [decI_isZero, decI_cross, hdsubw, hdsub2]
        rw [hbool, mem_span_singleton_iff_cross_zero w e2 he2ne]
    · 
      have he1ne : e1 ≠ 0 := by
        rw [← hdsub1]; intro h; exact he1z ((decI_isZero _).mpr h)
      rw [if_pos (by simp at he1z ⊢; exact he1z)]
      rw [span_pair_eq_span_singleton_left e1 e2 he1ne hcz]
      have hbool : isZeroI (crossI (subI p t.v₀) (subI t.v₁ t.v₀)) = true
          ↔ crossProduct w e1 = 0 := by
        rw [decI_isZero, decI_cross, hdsubw, hdsub1]
      rw [hbool, mem_span_singleton_iff_cross_zero w e1 he1ne]
  · 
    have hcne : crossProduct e1 e2 ≠ 0 := by
      rw [← hdcross]; intro h; exact hnz ((decI_isZero _).mpr h)
    rw [if_pos (by simp at hnz ⊢; exact hnz)]
    
    rw [mem_span_pair_iff_dot_cross_zero e1 e2 w hcne]
    have hbool : (dotI (crossI (subI t.v₁ t.v₀) (subI t.v₂ t.v₀)) (subI p t.v₀) == 0) = true
        ↔ (crossProduct e1 e2) ⬝ᵥ w = 0 := by
      rw [beq_iff_eq, ← Int.cast_eq_zero (α := ℚ), decI_dot, hdcross, hdsubw]
    rw [hbool]

name: inFacePlane_iff_mem_affineSpan_scaled
statement:
theorem inFacePlane_iff_mem_affineSpan_scaled (p : I3) (t : FaceH) (c : ℚ) (hc : c ≠ 0)
    (P V0 V1 V2 : Fin 3 → ℚ)
    (hp : decI p = c • P) (h0 : decI t.v₀ = c • V0) (h1 : decI t.v₁ = c • V1)
    (h2 : decI t.v₂ = c • V2) :
    inFacePlane p t = true ↔ P ∈ (affineSpan ℚ {V0, V1, V2} : Set (Fin 3 → ℚ))
proof:
:= by
  rw [inFacePlane_iff_mem_span, mem_affineSpan_iff_sub_mem_span,
      hp, h0, h1, h2, ← smul_sub, ← smul_sub, ← smul_sub,
      show ({c • (V1 - V0), c • (V2 - V0)} : Set (Fin 3 → ℚ))
        = (c • ·) '' {V1 - V0, V2 - V0} by simp [Set.image_pair],
      span_scale_mem c hc]

      = f.poly.toList.foldl (fun acc v => paddS acc v.p) ⟨0, 0, 0⟩ from

    poly_map_eq_ofFn, List.sum_ofFn, Finset.smul_sum]

name: slot_n_lateral_ne
statement:
theorem slot_n_lateral_ne {u : Triangle} (hdet : detOrigin u ≠ 0)
    (k : Fin 4) (hk : (k : ℕ) < 3) : (slot u k).n ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  have hbase : ∀ N : Point, ∀ x : Point, dotQ N x ≠ 0 → N ≠ 0 := by
    intro N x hNx hN0
    apply hNx
    rw [hN0]
    simp [dotQ]
  have hnegbase : ∀ N : Point, ∀ x : Point, dotQ N x ≠ 0 →
      (Half.neg ⟨N, (0 : ℚ)⟩).n ≠ 0 := by
    intro N x hNx h0
    rw [half_neg_n, neg_eq_zero] at h0
    exact hbase N x hNx h0
  fin_cases k
  · rw [show (⟨0, by omega⟩ : Fin 4) = 0 from rfl, slotH_0]
    have hp : dotQ (crossQ u.v₁ u.v₂) u.v₀ ≠ 0 := by
      rw [dotQ_crossQ_det, det3_eq_detOrigin]
      exact hdet
    split
    · exact hbase _ _ hp
    · exact hnegbase _ _ hp
  · rw [show (⟨1, by omega⟩ : Fin 4) = 1 from rfl, slotH_1]
    have hp : dotQ (crossQ u.v₀ u.v₂) u.v₁ ≠ 0 := by
      rw [dotQ_crossQ_det]
      intro h
      apply hdet
      rw [← det3_eq_detOrigin]
      rw [det3_expand] at h ⊢
      linarith [h]
    split
    · exact hbase _ _ hp
    · exact hnegbase _ _ hp
  · rw [show (⟨2, by omega⟩ : Fin 4) = 2 from rfl, slotH_2]
    have hp : dotQ (crossQ u.v₀ u.v₁) u.v₂ ≠ 0 := by
      rw [dotQ_crossQ_det]
      intro h
      apply hdet
      rw [← det3_eq_detOrigin]
      rw [det3_expand] at h ⊢
      linarith [h]
    split
    · exact hbase _ _ hp
    · exact hnegbase _ _ hp
  · simp at hk
