name: exists_perp_pair
statement:
theorem exists_perp_pair (u v : Point) :
    ∃ N : Point, N ≠ 0 ∧ dot N u = 0 ∧ dot N v = 0
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hc : crossQ u v = 0
  · 
    by_cases hu : u = 0
    · by_cases hv : v = 0
      · 
        exact ⟨![1, 0, 0], by
          intro h; have := congrFun h 0; simp at this,
          by rw [hu]; simp [dot], by rw [hv]; simp [dot]⟩
      · 
        obtain ⟨N, hN, hNv⟩ := exists_perp_ne_zero hv
        exact ⟨N, hN, by rw [hu]; simp [dot], hNv⟩
    · 
      obtain ⟨N, hN, hNu⟩ := exists_perp_ne_zero hu
      refine ⟨N, hN, hNu, ?_⟩
      
      have hpuN : dotQ u N = 0 := by
        rw [← dot_eq_dotQ, Proof.SurfaceBridge.dot_comm']; exact hNu
      have hvpar : dotQ v N = 0 :=
        Proof.MeshIntersectRayClassifyGen.perp_of_parallel hu hc hpuN
      rw [Proof.SurfaceBridge.dot_comm', dot_eq_dotQ]; exact hvpar
  · 
    exact ⟨crossQ u v, hc, dot_crossQ_fst u v, dot_crossQ_snd u v⟩

name: dot_perp_of_on_segment
statement:
theorem dot_perp_of_on_segment {a b x d N : Point} {s : ℚ} (hs : s ≠ 0)
    (hN0 : dot N (a - x) = 0) (hN1 : dot N (b - x) = 0)
    (hmem : x + s • d ∈ segment ℚ a b) : dot N d = 0
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨p, q, hp, hq, hpq, heq⟩ := hmem
  
  have hkey : s • d = p • (a - x) + q • (b - x) := by
    funext i
    have hk := congrFun heq i
    simp only [Pi.add_apply, Pi.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul, Pi.sub_apply] at hk ⊢
    
    have : p * (a i - x i) + q * (b i - x i) = p * a i + q * b i - (p + q) * x i := by ring
    rw [this, hpq, one_mul]; linarith
  
  have hdN : dot N (s • d) = 0 := by
    rw [hkey, dot_add_right, dot_smul_right, dot_smul_right, hN0, hN1]; ring
  rw [dot_smul_right] at hdN
  rcases mul_eq_zero.mp hdN with h | h
  · exact absurd h hs
  · exact h

name: exists_edge_clean_line
statement:
theorem exists_edge_clean_line {M : Mesh} {x : Point}
    (_hx : ∀ j : Fin M.size, x ∉ edgeSet M[j]) {nf : Point} (hnf : nf ≠ 0) :
    ∃ d : Point, 0 < dot nf d ∧
      ∀ (j : Fin M.size) (s : ℚ), s ≠ 0 → x + s • d ∉ edgeSet M[j]
proof:
:= by
  classical
  
  
  set ρ : Type := Option (Fin M.size × Fin 3) with hρ
  
  choose Nperp hNne hN0 hN1 using fun (u : Fin M.size) (k : Fin 3) =>
    exists_perp_pair ((edgeSeg M[u] k).1 - x) ((edgeSeg M[u] k).2 - x)
  set Nfam : ρ → Point := fun o => o.elim nf (fun uk => Nperp uk.1 uk.2) with hNfam
  have hNfamne : ∀ o, Nfam o ≠ 0 := by
    intro o; cases o with
    | none => exact hnf
    | some uk => exact hNne uk.1 uk.2
  
  obtain ⟨d, hd⟩ := Proof.MeshIntersectRayClassifyGen.side_dense_dir' nf Nfam hNfamne
  refine ⟨d, ?_, ?_⟩
  · 
    have hslot := hd none
    simp only [hNfam, Option.elim] at hslot
    obtain ⟨_, hside⟩ := hslot
    
    have hnn : dotQ nf nf ≠ 0 := by
      have := Proof.WellFormedCheckNormal.dotQ_self_pos hnf; linarith
    have hpos := hside hnn
    have hself : 0 < dotQ nf nf := Proof.WellFormedCheckNormal.dotQ_self_pos hnf
    rw [dot_eq_dotQ]
    nlinarith [hpos, hself]
  · 
    intro j s hs hmem
    rw [mem_edgeSet_iff] at hmem
    obtain ⟨k, hk⟩ := hmem
    have hdN : dot (Nperp j k) d = 0 :=
      dot_perp_of_on_segment hs (hN0 j k) (hN1 j k) hk
    
    have hne := (hd (some (j, k))).1
    simp only [hNfam, Option.elim] at hne
    rw [dot_eq_dotQ] at hdN
    exact hne hdN

name: coneShadow_negligible
statement:
theorem coneShadow_negligible (M : Mesh) (Q : Point) :
    Negligible {P | ∃ (j : Fin M.size) (s : ℚ), 0 < s ∧ Q + s • (P - Q) ∈ edgeSet M[j]}
proof:
:= by
  classical
  
  choose Nperp hNne hN0 hN1 using fun (u : Fin M.size) (k : Fin 3) =>
    exists_perp_pair ((edgeSeg M[u] k).1 - Q) ((edgeSeg M[u] k).2 - Q)
  
  refine Proof.Negligible.negligible_mono
    (M := ⋃ uk : Fin M.size × Fin 3,
      {P | dot (Nperp uk.1 uk.2) (P - Q) = 0}) ?_ ?_
  · 
    rintro P ⟨j, s, hs, hmem⟩
    rw [mem_edgeSet_iff] at hmem
    obtain ⟨k, hk⟩ := hmem
    refine Set.mem_iUnion.mpr ⟨(j, k), ?_⟩
    simp only [Set.mem_setOf_eq]
    
    have hd := dot_perp_of_on_segment (x := Q) (d := P - Q) (s := s)
      (ne_of_gt hs) (hN0 j k) (hN1 j k) hk
    exact hd
  · 
    refine Proof.Negligible.negligible_iUnion_fintype (fun uk => ?_)
    
    refine ⟨1, fun _ => {P | dot (Nperp uk.1 uk.2) (P - Q) = 0}, fun _ => ?_,
      fun P hP => Set.mem_iUnion.mpr ⟨0, hP⟩⟩
    refine ⟨Nperp uk.1 uk.2, dot (Nperp uk.1 uk.2) Q, hNne uk.1 uk.2, ?_⟩
    ext P
    simp only [Set.mem_setOf_eq, dot_sub_right, sub_eq_zero]
    rw [dot, dot]

name: hitF_eq_of_jumps
statement:
theorem hitF_eq_of_jumps {f : Triangle} {Q : Point} {μk : ℚ}
    (h : FaceJumps f Q μk) : hitF f Q = μk • Q
proof:
:= by
  rw [hitF, h.1]

name: jump_same_mesh_unique
statement:
theorem jump_same_mesh_unique {M : Mesh} (hnsi : NoFaceInteriorContact M)
    {i j : Fin M.size} {Q : Point} {μk : ℚ}
    (hji : FaceJumps M[i] Q μk) (hjj : FaceJumps M[j] Q μk)
    (hrelint : hitF M[i] Q ∉ edgeSet M[i]) : i = j
proof:
:= by
  by_contra hne
  
  have hi : hitF M[i] Q ∈ triangleSet M[i] := hji.2.2
  have hj : hitF M[j] Q ∈ triangleSet M[j] := hjj.2.2
  have heq : hitF M[j] Q = hitF M[i] Q := by
    rw [hitF_eq_of_jumps hji, hitF_eq_of_jumps hjj]
  rw [heq] at hj
  have hmem : hitF M[i] Q ∈ triangleSet M[i] ∩ triangleSet M[j] := ⟨hi, hj⟩
  exact hrelint (hnsi i j hne hmem)

name: muF_eq_iff_tie
statement:
theorem muF_eq_iff_tie {t u : Triangle} {Q : Point}
    (hQt : dotQ (carrierNormal t) Q ≠ 0) (hQu : dotQ (carrierNormal u) Q ≠ 0) :
    muF t Q = muF u Q ↔
      dotQ (detOrigin u • carrierNormal t - detOrigin t • carrierNormal u) Q = 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [Proof.MeshIntersectLedger.dotQ_smul_sub_left, muF, muF, div_eq_div_iff hQt hQu]
  constructor
  · intro h; linarith
  · intro h; linarith

name: jump_transverse_distinct
statement:
theorem jump_transverse_distinct {t u : Triangle} {Q : Point} {μk : ℚ}
    (hQt : dotQ (carrierNormal t) Q ≠ 0) (hQu : dotQ (carrierNormal u) Q ≠ 0)
    (htie : dotQ (detOrigin u • carrierNormal t - detOrigin t • carrierNormal u) Q ≠ 0)
    (hjt : FaceJumps t Q μk) (hju : FaceJumps u Q μk) : False
proof:
:= by
  apply htie
  rw [← muF_eq_iff_tie hQt hQu]
  rw [hjt.1, hju.1]

name: isolated_crossing
statement:
theorem isolated_crossing {M₁ M₂ : Mesh}
    (hnsi₁ : NoFaceInteriorContact M₁) (hnsi₂ : NoFaceInteriorContact M₂)
    {Q : Point} {μk : ℚ}
    (hrelint₁ : ∀ i : Fin M₁.size, FaceJumps M₁[i] Q μk → hitF M₁[i] Q ∉ edgeSet M₁[i])
    (hrelint₂ : ∀ j : Fin M₂.size, FaceJumps M₂[j] Q μk → hitF M₂[j] Q ∉ edgeSet M₂[j])
    (htie : ∀ (i : Fin M₁.size) (j : Fin M₂.size),
      dotQ (detOrigin M₂[j] • carrierNormal M₁[i]
            - detOrigin M₁[i] • carrierNormal M₂[j]) Q ≠ 0
      → ¬ (FaceJumps M₁[i] Q μk ∧ FaceJumps M₂[j] Q μk)) :
    
    (∀ i i' : Fin M₁.size, FaceJumps M₁[i] Q μk → FaceJumps M₁[i'] Q μk → i = i')
    ∧ (∀ j j' : Fin M₂.size, FaceJumps M₂[j] Q μk → FaceJumps M₂[j'] Q μk → j = j')
    
    
    ∧ (∀ (i : Fin M₁.size) (j : Fin M₂.size),
        FaceJumps M₁[i] Q μk → FaceJumps M₂[j] Q μk →
        dotQ (detOrigin M₂[j] • carrierNormal M₁[i]
              - detOrigin M₁[i] • carrierNormal M₂[j]) Q = 0)
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · intro i i' hi hi'
    exact jump_same_mesh_unique hnsi₁ hi hi' (hrelint₁ i hi)
  · intro j j' hj hj'
    exact jump_same_mesh_unique hnsi₂ hj hj' (hrelint₂ j hj)
  · intro i j hi hj
    by_contra hne
    exact htie i j hne ⟨hi, hj⟩

name: bilinear_product_delta
statement:
theorem bilinear_product_delta (w1m w1p w2m w2p : ℤ) :
    w1m * w2m - w1p * w2p = (w1m - w1p) * w2p + w1m * (w2m - w2p)
proof:
:= by
  ring

name: coincident_delta_opp
proof:
:= by
  rw [hw] at hΔ ⊢
  linear_combination w2p * hΔ

name: coincident_delta_opp_product
proof:
:= by
  rw [bilinear_product_delta]
  exact coincident_delta_opp hΔ hw

name: coincident_delta_same
statement:
theorem coincident_delta_same {w1m w1p w2m w2p σs : ℤ}
    (hΔ1 : w1m - w1p = σs) (hΔ2 : w2m - w2p = σs)
    (hcompl : w1m + w2p = 1) :
    (w1m - w1p) * w2p + w1m * (w2m - w2p) = σs
proof:
:= by
  rw [hΔ1, hΔ2]
  linear_combination σs * hcompl

name: coincident_delta_same_product
statement:
theorem coincident_delta_same_product {w1m w1p w2m w2p σs : ℤ}
    (hΔ1 : w1m - w1p = σs) (hΔ2 : w2m - w2p = σs)
    (hcompl : w1m + w2p = 1) :
    w1m * w2m - w1p * w2p = σs
proof:
:= by
  rw [bilinear_product_delta]
  exact coincident_delta_same hΔ1 hΔ2 hcompl

name: evalI_eq_of_mul
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨m, hm, ha, hb, hc', hd⟩ := hg
  obtain ⟨hw, hQ⟩ := hq
  have hwQ : (0 : ℚ) < (q.w : ℚ) := by exact_mod_cast hw
  refine ⟨m * (q.w : ℚ), mul_pos hm hwQ, ?_⟩
  rw [evalI_cast, ha, hb, hc', hd, hQ]
  simp only [ce, dotQ, mkPoint_zero, mkPoint_one, mkPoint_two]
  field_simp
  ring

name: evalI_iff_of_mul
statement:
theorem evalI_iff_of_mul {g : IPlane} {N : Point} {d : ℚ}
    (hg : IsMulOf g N d) {q : H4} {Q : Point} (hq : repr4 q Q) :
    (0 < evalI g q ↔ 0 < ce N d Q) ∧
    (0 ≤ evalI g q ↔ 0 ≤ ce N d Q) ∧
    (evalI g q = 0 ↔ ce N d Q = 0)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨m, hm, heq⟩ := evalI_eq_of_mul hg hq
  have hposQ : (0 : ℚ) < ((evalI g q : ℤ) : ℚ) ↔ 0 < evalI g q := by
    exact_mod_cast Iff.rfl
  have hnnQ : (0 : ℚ) ≤ ((evalI g q : ℤ) : ℚ) ↔ 0 ≤ evalI g q := by
    exact_mod_cast Iff.rfl
  have hzQ : ((evalI g q : ℤ) : ℚ) = 0 ↔ evalI g q = 0 := by
    exact_mod_cast Iff.rfl
  refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · rw [← hposQ, heq]
    constructor
    · intro h
      by_contra hcon
      push_neg at hcon
      nlinarith
    · intro h
      exact mul_pos hm h
  · rw [← hnnQ, heq]
    constructor
    · intro h
      by_contra hcon
      push_neg at hcon
      nlinarith
    · intro h
      exact mul_nonneg hm.le h
  · rw [← hzQ, heq]
    constructor
    · intro h
      rcases mul_eq_zero.mp h with h | h
      · exact absurd h hm.ne'
      · exact h
    · intro h
      rw [h, mul_zero]

name: signI_iff_of_mul
statement:
theorem signI_iff_of_mul {g : IPlane} {N : Point} {d : ℚ}
    (hg : IsMulOf g N d) {q : H4} {Q : Point} (hq : repr4 q Q) :
    (0 < signI g q ↔ 0 < ce N d Q) ∧
    (signI g q < 0 ↔ ce N d Q < 0) ∧
    (0 ≤ signI g q ↔ 0 ≤ ce N d Q) ∧
    (signI g q = 0 ↔ ce N d Q = 0)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨hpos, hnn, hz⟩ := evalI_iff_of_mul hg hq
  have e1 : signI g q = 1 ↔ 0 < evalI g q := Int.sign_eq_one_iff_pos
  have e0 : signI g q = 0 ↔ evalI g q = 0 := Int.sign_eq_zero_iff_zero
  have em : signI g q = -1 ↔ evalI g q < 0 := Int.sign_eq_neg_one_iff_neg
  have hrange : signI g q = 1 ∨ signI g q = 0 ∨ signI g q = -1 := by
    rcases lt_trichotomy (evalI g q) 0 with h | h | h
    · exact Or.inr (Or.inr (em.mpr h))
    · exact Or.inr (Or.inl (e0.mpr h))
    · exact Or.inl (e1.mpr h)
  have hevneg : ce N d Q < 0 → evalI g q < 0 := by
    intro h
    rcases lt_trichotomy (evalI g q) 0 with hh | hh | hh
    · exact hh
    · exact absurd (hz.mp hh) (by linarith)
    · exact absurd (hpos.mp hh) (by linarith)
  refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · constructor
    · intro h
      have h1 : signI g q = 1 := by omega
      exact hpos.mp (e1.mp h1)
    · intro h
      have := e1.mpr (hpos.mpr h)
      omega
  · constructor
    · intro h
      have h1 : signI g q = -1 := by omega
      have hev := em.mp h1
      rcases lt_trichotomy (ce N d Q) 0 with hh | hh | hh
      · exact hh
      · exact absurd (hz.mpr hh) (by omega)
      · exact absurd (hpos.mpr hh) (by omega)
    · intro h
      have := em.mpr (hevneg h)
      omega
  · constructor
    · intro h
      have h1 : signI g q = 1 ∨ signI g q = 0 := by omega
      rcases h1 with hh | hh
      · exact (hpos.mp (e1.mp hh)).le
      · exact le_of_eq (hz.mp (e0.mp hh)).symm
    · intro h
      rcases eq_or_lt_of_le h with hh | hh
      · have := e0.mpr (hz.mpr hh.symm)
        omega
      · have := e1.mpr (hpos.mpr hh)
        omega
  · constructor
    · intro h
      exact hz.mp (e0.mp h)
    · intro h
      exact e0.mpr (hz.mpr h)

name: clipFrag_eq
statement:
theorem clipFrag_eq (g : IPlane) (f : Frag) :
    clipFrag g f =
      (if !(walkBranch g f) then #[f]
       else
         let st := (Array.range f.poly.size).foldl (clipStep g f)
           (#[], #[])
         #[{ f with poly := st.1 },
           { f with poly := st.2 }])
proof: := rfl

name: clipStep_toList
statement:
theorem clipStep_toList (g : IPlane) (f : Frag)
    (st : Array Vtx × Array Vtx) (i : Nat) :
    ((clipStep g f st i).1.toList
        = st.1.toList ++ chunkPV g f i)
    ∧ ((clipStep g f st i).2.toList
        = st.2.toList ++ chunkNV g f i)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨pV, nV⟩ := st
  simp only [clipStep, chunkPV, chunkNV]
  split
  · split
    · split <;> simp [Array.push_toList]
    · split <;> simp [Array.push_toList]
  · split <;> simp [Array.push_toList]

name: foldl_clipStep_toList
statement:
theorem foldl_clipStep_toList (g : IPlane) (f : Frag) :
    ∀ (l : List Nat) (st : Array Vtx × Array Vtx),
      ((l.foldl (clipStep g f) st).1.toList
          = st.1.toList ++ l.flatMap (chunkPV g f))
      ∧ ((l.foldl (clipStep g f) st).2.toList
          = st.2.toList ++ l.flatMap (chunkNV g f))
proof:
:= by
  intro l
  induction l with
  | nil => intro st; simp
  | cons a l ih =>
    intro st
    obtain ⟨ih1, ih3⟩ := ih (clipStep g f st a)
    obtain ⟨h1, h3⟩ := clipStep_toList g f st a
    refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩ <;>
      simp [List.foldl_cons, ih1, ih3, h1, h3]

name: clipFrag_walk_eq
statement:
theorem clipFrag_walk_eq (g : IPlane) (f : Frag)
    (hb : walkBranch g f = true) :
    clipFrag g f
      = #[{ f with poly := (walkPV g f).toArray },
          { f with poly := (walkNV g f).toArray }]
proof:
:= by
  rw [clipFrag_eq, hb]
  simp only [Bool.not_true, Bool.false_eq_true, if_false]
  obtain ⟨h1, h3⟩ := foldl_clipStep_toList g f
    (Array.range f.poly.size).toList (#[], #[])
  rw [Array.foldl_toList] at h1 h3
  have e1 : ((Array.range f.poly.size).foldl (clipStep g f)
      (#[], #[])).1 = (walkPV g f).toArray := by
    apply Array.ext'
    rw [h1]
    simp [walkPV, Array.toList_range]
  have e3 : ((Array.range f.poly.size).foldl (clipStep g f)
      (#[], #[])).2 = (walkNV g f).toArray := by
    apply Array.ext'
    rw [h3]
    simp [walkNV, Array.toList_range]
  rw [e1, e3]

name: clipFrag_allWeak_eq
statement:
theorem clipFrag_allWeak_eq (g : IPlane) (f : Frag)
    (hb : walkBranch g f = false) :
    clipFrag g f = #[f]
proof:
:= by
  rw [clipFrag_eq, hb]
  simp

name: evalI_eq_of_mul_uniform
statement:
theorem evalI_eq_of_mul_uniform {g : IPlane} {N : Point} {d : ℚ}
    (hg : IsMulOf g N d) :
    ∃ m : ℚ, 0 < m ∧ ∀ (q : H4) (Q : Point), repr4 q Q →
      ((evalI g q : ℤ) : ℚ) = m * (q.w : ℚ) * ce N d Q
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨m, hm, ha, hb, hc', hd⟩ := hg
  refine ⟨m, hm, fun q Q hq => ?_⟩
  obtain ⟨hw, hQ⟩ := hq
  have hwQ : (0 : ℚ) < (q.w : ℚ) := by exact_mod_cast hw
  rw [evalI_cast, ha, hb, hc', hd, hQ]
  simp only [ce, dotQ, mkPoint_zero, mkPoint_one, mkPoint_two]
  field_simp
  ring

name: ce_neg
statement:
theorem ce_neg (N : Point) (d : ℚ) (x : Point) :
    ce (-N) (-d) x = - ce N d x
proof:
:= by
  simp only [ce, dotQ, Pi.neg_apply]
  ring

name: cutPt_negPlane
statement:
theorem cutPt_negPlane (N : Point) (d : ℚ) (a b : Point) :
    cutPt (-N) (-d) a b = cutPt N d a b
proof:
:= by
  have ht : cutT (-N) (-d) a b = cutT N d a b := by
    rw [cutT, cutT, ce_neg, ce_neg,
      show -ce N d a - -ce N d b = -(ce N d a - ce N d b) by ring,
      neg_div_neg_eq]
  rw [cutPt, cutPt, ht]

name: cutVtx_p_toPoint
statement:
theorem cutVtx_p_toPoint {g : IPlane} {N : Point} {d : ℚ} (hg : IsMulOf g N d)
    {A B : Vtx} (hA : repr4 A.h (P3.toPoint A.p)) (hB : repr4 B.h (P3.toPoint B.p)) :
    P3.toPoint (cutVtx g A B).p
      = cutPt N d (P3.toPoint A.p) (P3.toPoint B.p)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨m, hm, heval⟩ := evalI_eq_of_mul_uniform hg
  have heA := heval A.h _ hA
  have heB := heval B.h _ hB
  have hwa : (0 : ℚ) < (A.h.w : ℚ) := by exact_mod_cast hA.1
  have hwb : (0 : ℚ) < (B.h.w : ℚ) := by exact_mod_cast hB.1
  set ca := ce N d (P3.toPoint A.p) with hca
  set cb := ce N d (P3.toPoint B.p) with hcb
  have hfac : (0 : ℚ) < m * (A.h.w : ℚ) * (B.h.w : ℚ) := by positivity
  have ht : ((evalI g A.h * B.h.w : ℤ) : ℚ)
      / ((evalI g A.h * B.h.w - evalI g B.h * A.h.w : ℤ) : ℚ)
      = cutT N d (P3.toPoint A.p) (P3.toPoint B.p) := by
    push_cast
    rw [heA, heB]
    rw [show m * (A.h.w : ℚ) * ca * (B.h.w : ℚ) - m * (B.h.w : ℚ) * cb * (A.h.w : ℚ)
        = (m * (A.h.w : ℚ) * (B.h.w : ℚ)) * (ca - cb) by ring,
      show m * (A.h.w : ℚ) * ca * (B.h.w : ℚ)
        = (m * (A.h.w : ℚ) * (B.h.w : ℚ)) * ca by ring]
    rw [mul_div_mul_left _ _ (ne_of_gt hfac)]
    rfl
  simp only [cutVtx]
  rw [ht]
  funext k
  fin_cases k <;>
    simp [mkVtx, P3.toPoint, mkPoint, cutPt, Pi.add_apply, Pi.smul_apply,
      Pi.sub_apply, smul_eq_mul, mkPoint_zero, mkPoint_one, mkPoint_two]

name: getD_eq_getElem
statement:
theorem getD_eq_getElem {α : Type} [Inhabited α] (a : Array α) {i : ℕ}
    (h : i < a.size) (d : α) : a.getD i d = a[i]
proof:
:= by
  unfold Array.getD
  split
  · rfl
  · omega

name: signs_getD
statement:
theorem signs_getD {g : IPlane} {f : Frag} {i : ℕ} (hi : i < f.poly.size) :
    (f.poly.map (fun v => signI g v.h)).getD i 0
      = signI g (f.poly[i]'hi).h
proof:
:= by
  rw [getD_eq_getElem _ (by simpa using hi), Array.getElem_map]

name: walkBranch_iff
statement:
theorem walkBranch_iff {g : IPlane} {N : Point} {d : ℚ} (hg : IsMulOf g N d)
    {f : Frag}
    (hrep : ∀ i : Fin f.poly.size, repr4 (f.poly[i]).h (fragCycle f i)) :
    walkBranch g f = true
      ↔ (∃ i : Fin f.poly.size, 0 < ce N d (fragCycle f i))
        ∧ (∃ i : Fin f.poly.size, ce N d (fragCycle f i) < 0)
proof:
:= by
  unfold walkBranch
  rw [Bool.and_eq_true, Array.any_eq_true, Array.any_eq_true]
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨⟨i, hi⟩, ⟨j, hj⟩⟩
    simp only [Fin.getElem_fin, Array.getElem_map, decide_eq_true_iff] at hi hj
    have hi' : i.val < f.poly.size := by
      have := i.isLt
      simpa using this
    have hj' : j.val < f.poly.size := by
      have := j.isLt
      simpa using this
    refine ⟨⟨⟨i.val, hi'⟩, ?_⟩, ⟨⟨j.val, hj'⟩, ?_⟩⟩
    · exact ((signI_iff_of_mul hg (hrep ⟨i.val, hi'⟩)).1).mp hi
    · exact ((signI_iff_of_mul hg (hrep ⟨j.val, hj'⟩)).2.1).mp hj
  · rintro ⟨⟨i, hi⟩, ⟨j, hj⟩⟩
    have hi' : i.val < (f.poly.map (fun v => signI g v.h)).size := by
      simp
    have hj' : j.val < (f.poly.map (fun v => signI g v.h)).size := by
      simp
    refine ⟨⟨⟨i.val, hi'⟩, ?_⟩, ⟨⟨j.val, hj'⟩, ?_⟩⟩
    · simp only [Fin.getElem_fin, Array.getElem_map, decide_eq_true_iff]
      exact ((signI_iff_of_mul hg (hrep i)).1).mpr hi
    · simp only [Fin.getElem_fin, Array.getElem_map, decide_eq_true_iff]
      exact ((signI_iff_of_mul hg (hrep j)).2.1).mpr hj

name: allWeak_signs
statement:
theorem allWeak_signs {g : IPlane} {N : Point} {d : ℚ} (hg : IsMulOf g N d)
    {f : Frag}
    (hrep : ∀ i : Fin f.poly.size, repr4 (f.poly[i]).h (fragCycle f i))
    (hb : walkBranch g f = false) :
    (∀ i : Fin f.poly.size, ce N d (fragCycle f i) ≤ 0)
    ∨ (∀ i : Fin f.poly.size, 0 ≤ ce N d (fragCycle f i))
proof:
:= by
  unfold walkBranch at hb
  rw [Bool.and_eq_false_iff] at hb
  rcases hb with hb | hb
  · left
    intro i
    by_contra hcon
    push_neg at hcon
    have hi' : i.val < (f.poly.map (fun v => signI g v.h)).size := by
      simp
    have : (f.poly.map (fun v => signI g v.h)).any (fun s => decide (0 < s))
        = true := by
      rw [Array.any_eq_true]
      refine ⟨⟨i.val, hi'⟩, ?_⟩
      simp only [Fin.getElem_fin, Array.getElem_map, decide_eq_true_iff]
      exact ((signI_iff_of_mul hg (hrep i)).1).mpr hcon
    rw [this] at hb
    exact absurd hb (by simp)
  · right
    intro i
    by_contra hcon
    push_neg at hcon
    have hi' : i.val < (f.poly.map (fun v => signI g v.h)).size := by
      simp
    have : (f.poly.map (fun v => signI g v.h)).any (fun s => decide (s < 0))
        = true := by
      rw [Array.any_eq_true]
      refine ⟨⟨i.val, hi'⟩, ?_⟩
      simp only [Fin.getElem_fin, Array.getElem_map, decide_eq_true_iff]
      exact ((signI_iff_of_mul hg (hrep i)).2.1).mpr hcon
    rw [this] at hb
    exact absurd hb (by simp)

name: fin_succ_val
statement:
theorem fin_succ_val (hr : 3 ≤ f.poly.size) (i : Fin f.poly.size) :
    ((i + 1 : Fin f.poly.size)).val = (i.val + 1) % f.poly.size
proof:
:= by
  rw [Fin.val_add, Fin.val_one']
  have h1 : 1 % f.poly.size = 1 := Nat.mod_eq_of_lt (by omega)
  rw [h1]

name: poly_getD
statement:
theorem poly_getD (f : Frag) (i : Fin f.poly.size) :
    f.poly.getD i.val default = f.poly[i]
proof:
:=
  getD_eq_getElem _ i.isLt _

name: poly_getD_succ
statement:
theorem poly_getD_succ (hr : 3 ≤ f.poly.size) (i : Fin f.poly.size) :
    f.poly.getD ((i.val + 1) % f.poly.size) default = f.poly[i + 1]
proof:
:= by
  rw [← fin_succ_val hr i]
  exact getD_eq_getElem _ (i + 1).isLt _

name: signs_getD_fin
statement:
theorem signs_getD_fin (g : IPlane) (f : Frag) (i : Fin f.poly.size) :
    (f.poly.map (fun v => signI g v.h)).getD i.val 0 = signI g (f.poly[i]).h
proof:
:=
  signs_getD i.isLt

name: signs_getD_succ
statement:
theorem signs_getD_succ (g : IPlane) (hr : 3 ≤ f.poly.size) (i : Fin f.poly.size) :
    (f.poly.map (fun v => signI g v.h)).getD ((i.val + 1) % f.poly.size) 0
      = signI g (f.poly[i + 1]).h
proof:
:= by
  rw [← fin_succ_val hr i]
  exact signs_getD (i + 1).isLt

name: chunkPV_map
statement:
theorem chunkPV_map (hg : IsMulOf g N d) (hr : 3 ≤ f.poly.size)
    (hrep : ∀ i : Fin f.poly.size, repr4 (f.poly[i]).h (fragCycle f i))
    (i : Fin f.poly.size) :
    (chunkPV g f i.val).map (fun v => P3.toPoint v.p)
      = chunk N d (fragCycle f) i
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨ip, im, inn, iz⟩ := signI_iff_of_mul hg (hrep i)
  obtain ⟨jp, jm, jnn, jz⟩ := signI_iff_of_mul hg (hrep (i + 1))
  have hX := cutVtx_p_toPoint hg (hrep i) (hrep (i + 1))
  simp only [Fin.getElem_fin] at hX
  simp only [chunkPV, signs_getD_fin g f i, signs_getD_succ g hr i,
    poly_getD f i, poly_getD_succ hr i]
  rcases lt_trichotomy (ce N d (fragCycle f i)) 0 with hci | hci | hci
  · 
    rw [if_neg (fun h => absurd (inn.mp h) (not_le.mpr hci))]
    rcases le_or_lt (ce N d (fragCycle f (i + 1))) 0 with hcj | hcj
    · rw [if_neg (fun h => absurd (jp.mp h) (not_lt.mpr hcj)),
        chunk_of_neg_nonpos hci hcj]
      rfl
    · rw [if_pos (jp.mpr hcj), chunk_of_neg_pos hci hcj]
      simp [fragCycle, Fin.getElem_fin, hX]
  · 
    rw [if_pos (inn.mpr (le_of_eq hci.symm)), chunk_of_zero hci]
    have hnp : ¬ 0 < signI g (f.poly[i]).h :=
      fun h => absurd (ip.mp h) (by rw [hci]; exact lt_irrefl 0)
    by_cases hj : signI g (f.poly[i + 1]).h < 0
    · rw [if_pos hj, if_neg hnp]
      simp [fragCycle]
    · rw [if_neg hj]
      simp [fragCycle]
  · 
    rw [if_pos (inn.mpr hci.le)]
    rcases lt_or_le (ce N d (fragCycle f (i + 1))) 0 with hcj | hcj
    · rw [if_pos (jm.mpr hcj), if_pos (ip.mpr hci), chunk_of_pos_neg hci hcj]
      simp [fragCycle, Fin.getElem_fin, hX]
    · rw [if_neg (fun h => absurd (jm.mp h) (not_lt.mpr hcj)),
        chunk_of_pos_nonneg hci hcj]
      simp [fragCycle]

name: chunkNV_map
statement:
theorem chunkNV_map (hg : IsMulOf g N d) (hr : 3 ≤ f.poly.size)
    (hrep : ∀ i : Fin f.poly.size, repr4 (f.poly[i]).h (fragCycle f i))
    (i : Fin f.poly.size) :
    (chunkNV g f i.val).map (fun v => P3.toPoint v.p)
      = chunk (-N) (-d) (fragCycle f) i
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨ip, im, inn, iz⟩ := signI_iff_of_mul hg (hrep i)
  obtain ⟨jp, jm, jnn, jz⟩ := signI_iff_of_mul hg (hrep (i + 1))
  have hX := cutVtx_p_toPoint hg (hrep i) (hrep (i + 1))
  have hXn : cutPt N d (fragCycle f i) (fragCycle f (i + 1))
      = cutPt (-N) (-d) (fragCycle f i) (fragCycle f (i + 1)) :=
    (cutPt_negPlane N d _ _).symm
  simp only [Fin.getElem_fin] at hX
  simp only [fragCycle, Fin.getElem_fin] at hXn
  simp only [chunkNV, signs_getD_fin g f i, signs_getD_succ g hr i,
    poly_getD f i, poly_getD_succ hr i]
  rcases lt_trichotomy (ce N d (fragCycle f i)) 0 with hci | hci | hci
  · 
    have hci' : 0 < ce (-N) (-d) (fragCycle f i) := by
      rw [ce_neg]; linarith
    rw [if_neg (fun h => absurd (inn.mp h) (not_le.mpr hci))]
    rcases le_or_lt (ce N d (fragCycle f (i + 1))) 0 with hcj | hcj
    · have hcj' : 0 ≤ ce (-N) (-d) (fragCycle f (i + 1)) := by
        rw [ce_neg]; linarith
      rw [if_neg (fun h => absurd (jp.mp h) (not_lt.mpr hcj)),
        chunk_of_pos_nonneg hci' hcj']
      simp [fragCycle]
    · have hcj' : ce (-N) (-d) (fragCycle f (i + 1)) < 0 := by
        rw [ce_neg]; linarith
      rw [if_pos (jp.mpr hcj), chunk_of_pos_neg hci' hcj']
      simp [fragCycle, Fin.getElem_fin, hX, hXn]
  · 
    have hci' : ce (-N) (-d) (fragCycle f i) = 0 := by
      rw [ce_neg, hci, neg_zero]
    rw [if_pos (inn.mpr (le_of_eq hci.symm)), chunk_of_zero hci']
    have hz0 : signI g (f.poly[i]).h = 0 := iz.mpr hci
    by_cases hj : signI g (f.poly[i + 1]).h < 0
    · rw [if_pos hj, if_neg (fun h => absurd (ip.mp h)
        (by rw [hci]; exact lt_irrefl 0))]
      simp [fragCycle]
    · have h00 : (signI g (f.poly[i]).h == 0) = true := by
        simp only [beq_iff_eq]
        exact hz0
      rw [if_neg hj, if_pos h00]
      simp [fragCycle]
  · 
    have hci' : ce (-N) (-d) (fragCycle f i) < 0 := by
      rw [ce_neg]; linarith
    rw [if_pos (inn.mpr hci.le)]
    rcases lt_or_le (ce N d (fragCycle f (i + 1))) 0 with hcj | hcj
    · have hcj' : 0 < ce (-N) (-d) (fragCycle f (i + 1)) := by
        rw [ce_neg]; linarith
      rw [if_pos (jm.mpr hcj), if_pos (ip.mpr hci), chunk_of_neg_pos hci' hcj']
      simp [fragCycle, Fin.getElem_fin, hX, hXn]
    · have hcj' : ce (-N) (-d) (fragCycle f (i + 1)) ≤ 0 := by
        rw [ce_neg]; linarith
      have hne0 : ¬ ((signI g (f.poly[i]).h == 0) = true) := by
        rw [beq_iff_eq]
        exact fun h => absurd (iz.mp h) (ne_of_gt hci)
      rw [if_neg (fun h => absurd (jm.mp h) (not_lt.mpr hcj)), if_neg hne0,
        chunk_of_neg_nonpos hci' hcj']
      rfl

name: finRange_map_val
statement:
theorem finRange_map_val (r : ℕ) :
    (List.finRange r).map Fin.val = List.range r
proof:
:= by
  apply List.ext_getElem <;> simp

name: walkPV_map
statement:
theorem walkPV_map {g : IPlane} {N : Point} {d : ℚ} {f : Frag}
    [NeZero f.poly.size] (hg : IsMulOf g N d) (hr : 3 ≤ f.poly.size)
    (hrep : ∀ i : Fin f.poly.size, repr4 (f.poly[i]).h (fragCycle f i)) :
    (walkPV g f).map (fun v => P3.toPoint v.p) = walk N d (fragCycle f)
proof:
:= by
  rw [walkPV, walk, List.map_flatMap, ← finRange_map_val f.poly.size,
    List.flatMap_map]
  congr 1
  funext i
  exact chunkPV_map hg hr hrep i

name: walkNV_map
statement:
theorem walkNV_map {g : IPlane} {N : Point} {d : ℚ} {f : Frag}
    [NeZero f.poly.size] (hg : IsMulOf g N d) (hr : 3 ≤ f.poly.size)
    (hrep : ∀ i : Fin f.poly.size, repr4 (f.poly[i]).h (fragCycle f i)) :
    (walkNV g f).map (fun v => P3.toPoint v.p)
      = walk (-N) (-d) (fragCycle f)
proof:
:= by
  rw [walkNV, walk, List.map_flatMap, ← finRange_map_val f.poly.size,
    List.flatMap_map]
  congr 1
  funext i
  exact chunkNV_map hg hr hrep i

name: mem_chunkPV
statement:
theorem mem_chunkPV {g : IPlane} {f : Frag} {i : ℕ} {v : Vtx}
    (hv : v ∈ chunkPV g f i) :
    v = f.poly.getD i default
    ∨ v = cutVtx g (f.poly.getD i default)
        (f.poly.getD ((i + 1) % f.poly.size) default)
proof:
:= by
  revert hv
  simp only [chunkPV]
  split
  · split
    · split
      · intro hv
        simp only [List.mem_cons, List.mem_singleton, List.not_mem_nil,
          or_false] at hv
        tauto
      · intro hv
        rw [List.mem_singleton] at hv
        exact Or.inl hv
    · intro hv
      rw [List.mem_singleton] at hv
      exact Or.inl hv
  · split
    · intro hv
      rw [List.mem_singleton] at hv
      exact Or.inr hv
    · intro hv
      exact absurd hv (List.not_mem_nil v)

name: mem_chunkNV
statement:
theorem mem_chunkNV {g : IPlane} {f : Frag} {i : ℕ} {v : Vtx}
    (hv : v ∈ chunkNV g f i) :
    v = f.poly.getD i default
    ∨ v = cutVtx g (f.poly.getD i default)
        (f.poly.getD ((i + 1) % f.poly.size) default)
proof:
:= by
  revert hv
  simp only [chunkNV]
  split
  · split
    · split
      · intro hv
        rw [List.mem_singleton] at hv
        exact Or.inr hv
      · intro hv
        rw [List.mem_singleton] at hv
        exact Or.inl hv
    · split
      · intro hv
        rw [List.mem_singleton] at hv
        exact Or.inl hv
      · intro hv
        exact absurd hv (List.not_mem_nil v)
  · split
    · intro hv
      simp only [List.mem_cons, List.mem_singleton, List.not_mem_nil,
        or_false] at hv
      tauto
    · intro hv
      rw [List.mem_singleton] at hv
      exact Or.inl hv

name: chunk_repr
statement:
theorem chunk_repr {g : IPlane} {f : Frag}
    (hrep : ∀ i : Fin f.poly.size, repr4 (f.poly[i]).h (fragCycle f i))
    {i : ℕ} (hi : i < f.poly.size) {v : Vtx}
    (hv : v = f.poly.getD i default
      ∨ v = cutVtx g (f.poly.getD i default)
          (f.poly.getD ((i + 1) % f.poly.size) default)) :
    repr4 v.h (P3.toPoint v.p)
proof:
:= by
  rcases hv with rfl | rfl
  · rw [getD_eq_getElem _ hi]
    exact hrep ⟨i, hi⟩
  · exact mkVtx_repr _

name: walkPV_repr
proof:
:= by
  intro v hv
  rw [walkPV, List.mem_flatMap] at hv
  obtain ⟨i, hi, hvi⟩ := hv
  exact chunk_repr hrep (List.mem_range.mp hi) (mem_chunkPV hvi)

name: walkNV_repr
proof:
:= by
  intro v hv
  rw [walkNV, List.mem_flatMap] at hv
  obtain ⟨i, hi, hvi⟩ := hv
  exact chunk_repr hrep (List.mem_range.mp hi) (mem_chunkNV hvi)

name: fin_cast_add_one
statement:
theorem fin_cast_add_one (hsz : r₁ = r₂) (k : Fin r₁) :
    Fin.cast hsz (k + 1) = Fin.cast hsz k + 1
proof:
:= by
  subst hsz
  rfl

name: eta_transport
statement:
theorem eta_transport (hsz : r₁ = r₂)
    (hpt : ∀ k : Fin r₁, w₁ k = w₂ (Fin.cast hsz k)) (i : Fin r₁) (x : Point) :
    eta n w₁ i x = eta n w₂ (Fin.cast hsz i) x
proof:
:= by
  rw [eta, eta, hpt i, hpt (i + 1), fin_cast_add_one]

name: onPlane_transport
statement:
theorem onPlane_transport (hsz : r₁ = r₂)
    (hpt : ∀ k : Fin r₁, w₁ k = w₂ (Fin.cast hsz k))
    (h : OnPlane n c w₂) : OnPlane n c w₁
proof:
:= by
  intro i
  rw [hpt i]
  exact h _

name: strictConv_transport
statement:
theorem strictConv_transport (hsz : r₁ = r₂)
    (hpt : ∀ k : Fin r₁, w₁ k = w₂ (Fin.cast hsz k))
    (h : StrictConv n w₂) : StrictConv n w₁
proof:
:= by
  intro i j hj1 hj2
  rw [eta_transport hsz hpt, hpt j]
  refine h _ _ (fun hcon => hj1 ?_) (fun hcon => hj2 ?_)
  · have := congrArg (Fin.cast hsz.symm) hcon
    simpa using this
  · rw [← fin_cast_add_one hsz] at hcon
    have := congrArg (Fin.cast hsz.symm) hcon
    simpa using this

name: range_transport
statement:
theorem range_transport (hsz : r₁ = r₂)
    (hpt : ∀ k : Fin r₁, w₁ k = w₂ (Fin.cast hsz k)) :
    Set.range w₁ = Set.range w₂
proof:
:= by
  subst hsz
  ext y
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨k, rfl⟩
    exact ⟨k, (hpt k).symm⟩
  · rintro ⟨k, rfl⟩
    exact ⟨k, hpt k⟩

name: vpoly_transport
statement:
theorem vpoly_transport (hsz : r₁ = r₂)
    (hpt : ∀ k : Fin r₁, w₁ k = w₂ (Fin.cast hsz k)) :
    vpoly w₁ = vpoly w₂
proof:
:= by
  rw [vpoly, vpoly, range_transport hsz hpt]

name: toPoint_get_of_map_eq
statement:
theorem toPoint_get_of_map_eq {A : Array Vtx} {W : List Point}
    (h : A.toList.map (fun v => P3.toPoint v.p) = W) (k : Fin A.size)
    (hk : k.val < W.length) :
    P3.toPoint (A[k]).p = W.get ⟨k.val, hk⟩
proof:
:= by
  subst h
  rw [List.get_eq_getElem, List.getElem_map]
  rfl

name: isMulOf_self
statement: theorem isMulOf_self (g : IPlane) : IsMulOf g (iplaneN g) (iplaneD g)
proof:
:=
  ⟨1, one_pos, by rw [iplaneN, mkPoint_zero]; ring,
    by rw [iplaneN, mkPoint_one]; ring, by rw [iplaneN, mkPoint_two]; ring,
    by rw [iplaneD]; ring⟩

name: FragInv.neZero
statement:
theorem FragInv.neZero {nt : Point} {ct : ℚ} {f : Frag} (hf : FragInv nt ct f) :
    NeZero f.poly.size
proof:
:=
  ⟨by have := hf.size3; omega⟩

name: mem_clipFrag_walk
proof:
:= by
  rw [clipFrag_walk_eq g f hb, Array.mem_def] at hmem
  simpa [fragP, fragN] using hmem

name: frag_read_walkCycle
statement:
theorem frag_read_walkCycle {f' : Frag} {r : ℕ} [NeZero r] {w : Fin r → Point}
    (hmap : f'.poly.toList.map (fun v => P3.toPoint v.p) = walk N d w) :
    ∃ hsz : f'.poly.size = (walk N d w).length,
      ∀ k : Fin f'.poly.size,
        fragCycle f' k = walkCycle N d w (Fin.cast hsz k)
proof:
:= by
  have hsz : f'.poly.size = (walk N d w).length := by
    rw [← hmap, List.length_map, Array.length_toList]
  refine ⟨hsz, fun k => ?_⟩
  show P3.toPoint (f'.poly[k]).p = (walk N d w).get (Fin.cast hsz k)
  exact toPoint_get_of_map_eq hmap k (by omega)

name: fragP_map
statement:
theorem fragP_map [NeZero f.poly.size] (hg : IsMulOf g N d)
    (hr : 3 ≤ f.poly.size)
    (hrep : ∀ i : Fin f.poly.size, repr4 (f.poly[i]).h (fragCycle f i)) :
    (fragP g f).poly.toList.map (fun v => P3.toPoint v.p)
      = walk N d (fragCycle f)
proof:
:= by
  show ((walkPV g f).toArray).toList.map (fun v => P3.toPoint v.p)
    = walk N d (fragCycle f)
  rw [Array.toList_toArray]
  exact walkPV_map hg hr hrep

name: fragN_map
statement:
theorem fragN_map [NeZero f.poly.size] (hg : IsMulOf g N d)
    (hr : 3 ≤ f.poly.size)
    (hrep : ∀ i : Fin f.poly.size, repr4 (f.poly[i]).h (fragCycle f i)) :
    (fragN g f).poly.toList.map (fun v => P3.toPoint v.p)
      = walk (-N) (-d) (fragCycle f)
proof:
:= by
  show ((walkNV g f).toArray).toList.map (fun v => P3.toPoint v.p)
    = walk (-N) (-d) (fragCycle f)
  rw [Array.toList_toArray]
  exact walkNV_map hg hr hrep

name: ce_neg_pos_neg
statement:
theorem ce_neg_pos_neg (hpos : ∃ i : Fin f.poly.size, 0 < ce N d (fragCycle f i))
    (hneg : ∃ i : Fin f.poly.size, ce N d (fragCycle f i) < 0) :
    (∃ i : Fin f.poly.size, 0 < ce (-N) (-d) (fragCycle f i))
      ∧ (∃ i : Fin f.poly.size, ce (-N) (-d) (fragCycle f i) < 0)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨i, hi⟩ := hneg
  obtain ⟨j, hj⟩ := hpos
  exact ⟨⟨i, by rw [ce_neg]; linarith⟩, ⟨j, by rw [ce_neg]; linarith⟩⟩

name: fragInv_fragP
statement:
theorem fragInv_fragP [NeZero f.poly.size] 
    (hg : IsMulOf g N d) (hf : FragInv nt ct f) (hb : walkBranch g f = true) :
    FragInv nt ct (fragP g f)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨hpos, hneg⟩ := (walkBranch_iff hg hf.vrepr).mp hb
  haveI := walk_length_neZero hpos
  have hmap := fragP_map hg hf.size3 hf.vrepr
  obtain ⟨hsz, hpt⟩ := frag_read_walkCycle hmap
  have h3 : 3 ≤ (fragP g f).poly.size := by
    rw [hsz]
    exact three_le_walk_length hf.size3 hf.strictConv hpos hneg
  haveI : NeZero (fragP g f).poly.size := ⟨by omega⟩
  refine ⟨h3, onPlane_transport hsz hpt (walkCycle_onPlane hf.onPlane),
    strictConv_transport hsz hpt
      (walkCycle_strictConv hf.size3 hf.onPlane hf.strictConv hpos hneg),
    fun k => ?_, hf.mul⟩
  refine walkPV_repr (g := g) hf.vrepr _ ?_
  have : (fragP g f).poly[k] ∈ (fragP g f).poly.toList := by
    exact Array.getElem_mem_toList _ k.isLt
  simpa [fragP] using this

name: fragInv_fragN
statement:
theorem fragInv_fragN [NeZero f.poly.size] 
    (hg : IsMulOf g N d) (hf : FragInv nt ct f) (hb : walkBranch g f = true) :
    FragInv nt ct (fragN g f)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨hpos, hneg⟩ := (walkBranch_iff hg hf.vrepr).mp hb
  obtain ⟨hpos', hneg'⟩ := ce_neg_pos_neg hpos hneg
  haveI := walk_length_neZero hpos'
  have hmap := fragN_map hg hf.size3 hf.vrepr
  obtain ⟨hsz, hpt⟩ := frag_read_walkCycle hmap
  have h3 : 3 ≤ (fragN g f).poly.size := by
    rw [hsz]
    exact three_le_walk_length hf.size3 hf.strictConv hpos' hneg'
  haveI : NeZero (fragN g f).poly.size := ⟨by omega⟩
  refine ⟨h3, onPlane_transport hsz hpt (walkCycle_onPlane hf.onPlane),
    strictConv_transport hsz hpt
      (walkCycle_strictConv hf.size3 hf.onPlane hf.strictConv hpos' hneg'),
    fun k => ?_, hf.mul⟩
  refine walkNV_repr (g := g) hf.vrepr _ ?_
  have : (fragN g f).poly[k] ∈ (fragN g f).poly.toList := by
    exact Array.getElem_mem_toList _ k.isLt
  simpa [fragN] using this

name: fragInv_clipFrag
statement:
theorem fragInv_clipFrag (g : IPlane)
    (hf : FragInv nt ct f) {f' : Frag} (hmem : f' ∈ clipFrag g f) :
    FragInv nt ct f'
proof:
:= by
  haveI := hf.neZero
  cases hb : walkBranch g f with
  | false =>
    rw [clipFrag_allWeak_eq g f hb, Array.mem_def] at hmem
    obtain rfl : f' = f := by simpa using hmem
    exact hf
  | true =>
    rcases mem_clipFrag_walk hb hmem with rfl | rfl
    · exact fragInv_fragP (isMulOf_self g) hf hb
    · exact fragInv_fragN (isMulOf_self g) hf hb

name: vpoly_subset_ce_nonneg
statement:
theorem vpoly_subset_ce_nonneg {r : ℕ} [NeZero r] {w : Fin r → Point}
    (h : ∀ i, 0 ≤ ce N d (w i)) : vpoly w ⊆ {x | 0 ≤ ce N d x}
proof:
:=
  convexHull_min (by rintro y ⟨i, rfl⟩; exact h i) (convex_ce_nonneg N d)

name: ce_neg_nonneg_set
statement:
theorem ce_neg_nonneg_set (N : Point) (d : ℚ) :
    {x : Point | 0 ≤ ce (-N) (-d) x} = {x | ce N d x ≤ 0}
proof:
:= by
  ext x
  simp only [Set.mem_setOf_eq, ce_neg]
  constructor <;> intro h <;> linarith

name: vpoly_fragP
statement:
theorem vpoly_fragP [NeZero f.poly.size] 
    (hg : IsMulOf g N d) (hf : FragInv nt ct f) (hb : walkBranch g f = true) :
    vpoly (fragCycle (fragP g f))
      = vpoly (fragCycle f) ∩ {x | 0 ≤ ce N d x}
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨hpos, hneg⟩ := (walkBranch_iff hg hf.vrepr).mp hb
  haveI := walk_length_neZero hpos
  have hmap := fragP_map hg hf.size3 hf.vrepr
  obtain ⟨hsz, hpt⟩ := frag_read_walkCycle hmap
  haveI : NeZero (fragP g f).poly.size :=
    ⟨by rw [hsz]; exact (walk_length_neZero hpos).out⟩
  rw [vpoly_transport hsz hpt,
    vpoly_walkCycle hf.size3 hf.onPlane hf.strictConv hpos hneg]

name: vpoly_fragN
statement:
theorem vpoly_fragN [NeZero f.poly.size] 
    (hg : IsMulOf g N d) (hf : FragInv nt ct f) (hb : walkBranch g f = true) :
    vpoly (fragCycle (fragN g f))
      = vpoly (fragCycle f) ∩ {x | ce N d x ≤ 0}
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨hpos, hneg⟩ := (walkBranch_iff hg hf.vrepr).mp hb
  obtain ⟨hpos', hneg'⟩ := ce_neg_pos_neg hpos hneg
  haveI := walk_length_neZero hpos'
  have hmap := fragN_map hg hf.size3 hf.vrepr
  obtain ⟨hsz, hpt⟩ := frag_read_walkCycle hmap
  haveI : NeZero (fragN g f).poly.size :=
    ⟨by rw [hsz]; exact (walk_length_neZero hpos').out⟩
  rw [vpoly_transport hsz hpt,
    vpoly_walkCycle hf.size3 hf.onPlane hf.strictConv hpos' hneg',
    ce_neg_nonneg_set]

name: clipFrag_mem_vpoly
statement:
theorem clipFrag_mem_vpoly (g : IPlane) (hf : FragInv nt ct f)
    {f' : Frag} (hmem : f' ∈ clipFrag g f) (k : Fin f'.poly.size) :
    fragCycle f' k ∈ vpoly (fragCycle f)
proof:
:= by
  haveI := hf.neZero
  cases hb : walkBranch g f with
  | false =>
    rw [clipFrag_allWeak_eq g f hb, Array.mem_def] at hmem
    obtain rfl : f' = f := by simpa using hmem
    exact subset_convexHull ℚ _ ⟨k, rfl⟩
  | true =>
    obtain ⟨hpos, hneg⟩ :=
      (walkBranch_iff (isMulOf_self g) hf.vrepr).mp hb
    obtain ⟨hpos', _⟩ := ce_neg_pos_neg hpos hneg
    rcases mem_clipFrag_walk hb hmem with rfl | rfl
    · haveI := walk_length_neZero hpos
      obtain ⟨hsz, hpt⟩ := frag_read_walkCycle
        (fragP_map (isMulOf_self g) hf.size3 hf.vrepr)
      rw [hpt k]
      exact mem_vpoly_of_mem_walk (List.get_mem _ _)
    · haveI := walk_length_neZero hpos'
      obtain ⟨hsz, hpt⟩ := frag_read_walkCycle
        (fragN_map (isMulOf_self g) hf.size3 hf.vrepr)
      rw [hpt k]
      exact mem_vpoly_of_mem_walk (List.get_mem _ _)

name: clipFrag_oneSided
statement:
theorem clipFrag_oneSided (hg : IsMulOf g N d)
    (hf : FragInv nt ct f) {f' : Frag} (hmem : f' ∈ clipFrag g f) :
    (∀ k : Fin f'.poly.size, 0 ≤ ce N d (fragCycle f' k))
      ∨ (∀ k : Fin f'.poly.size, ce N d (fragCycle f' k) ≤ 0)
proof:
:= by
  haveI := hf.neZero
  cases hb : walkBranch g f with
  | false =>
    rw [clipFrag_allWeak_eq g f hb, Array.mem_def] at hmem
    obtain rfl : f' = f := by simpa using hmem
    exact (allWeak_signs hg hf.vrepr hb).symm
  | true =>
    obtain ⟨hpos, hneg⟩ := (walkBranch_iff hg hf.vrepr).mp hb
    obtain ⟨hpos', _⟩ := ce_neg_pos_neg hpos hneg
    rcases mem_clipFrag_walk hb hmem with rfl | rfl
    · left
      haveI := walk_length_neZero hpos
      obtain ⟨hsz, hpt⟩ := frag_read_walkCycle
        (fragP_map hg hf.size3 hf.vrepr)
      intro k
      rw [hpt k]
      exact ce_nonneg_of_mem_walk (List.get_mem _ _)
    · right
      haveI := walk_length_neZero hpos'
      obtain ⟨hsz, hpt⟩ := frag_read_walkCycle
        (fragN_map hg hf.size3 hf.vrepr)
      intro k
      rw [hpt k]
      show ce N d ((walk (-N) (-d) (fragCycle f)).get (Fin.cast hsz k)) ≤ 0
      have := ce_nonneg_of_mem_walk
        (N := -N) (d := -d) (List.get_mem (walk (-N) (-d) (fragCycle f))
          (Fin.cast hsz k))
      rw [ce_neg] at this
      linarith

name: toList_flatMap_arr
statement:
theorem toList_flatMap_arr {α β : Type} (as : Array α) (F : α → Array β) :
    (as.flatMap F).toList = as.toList.flatMap (fun a => (F a).toList)
proof:
:= by
  show (as.foldl (fun bs a => bs ++ F a) #[]).toList = _
  rw [← Array.foldl_toList]
  suffices h : ∀ (l : List α) (init : Array β),
      (l.foldl (fun bs a => bs ++ F a) init).toList
        = init.toList ++ l.flatMap (fun a => (F a).toList) by
    simpa using h as.toList #[]
  intro l
  induction l with
  | nil => intro init; simp
  | cons a l ih =>
    intro init
    rw [List.foldl_cons, ih, List.flatMap_cons, Array.toList_append,
      List.append_assoc]

name: mem_flatMap_arr
statement:
theorem mem_flatMap_arr {α β : Type} {b : β} {as : Array α}
    {F : α → Array β} : b ∈ as.flatMap F ↔ ∃ a ∈ as, b ∈ F a
proof:
:= by
  rw [Array.mem_def, toList_flatMap_arr, List.mem_flatMap]
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨a, ha, hb⟩
    exact ⟨a, Array.mem_def.mpr ha, Array.mem_def.mpr hb⟩
  · rintro ⟨a, ha, hb⟩
    exact ⟨a, Array.mem_def.mp ha, Array.mem_def.mp hb⟩

name: vpoly_subset_of_forall_mem
statement:
theorem vpoly_subset_of_forall_mem {r : ℕ} [NeZero r] {w : Fin r → Point}
    {C : Set Point} (hC : Convex ℚ C) (h : ∀ i, w i ∈ C) : vpoly w ⊆ C
proof:
:=
  convexHull_min (by rintro y ⟨i, rfl⟩; exact h i) hC

name: convex_ce_nonpos
statement:
theorem convex_ce_nonpos (N : Point) (d : ℚ) :
    Convex ℚ {x : Point | ce N d x ≤ 0}
proof:
:= by
  rw [← ce_neg_nonneg_set]
  exact convex_ce_nonneg (-N) (-d)

name: vpoly_subset_ce_nonpos
statement:
theorem vpoly_subset_ce_nonpos {r : ℕ} [NeZero r] {w : Fin r → Point}
    (h : ∀ i, ce N d (w i) ≤ 0) : vpoly w ⊆ {x | ce N d x ≤ 0}
proof:
:=
  vpoly_subset_of_forall_mem (convex_ce_nonpos N d) h

name: clipFrag_vpoly_subset
statement:
theorem clipFrag_vpoly_subset (g : IPlane)
    (hf : FragInv nt ct f) {f' : Frag} (hmem : f' ∈ clipFrag g f) :
    vpoly (fragCycle f') ⊆ vpoly (fragCycle f)
proof:
:= by
  haveI := hf.neZero
  haveI := (fragInv_clipFrag g hf hmem).neZero
  exact vpoly_subset_of_forall_mem (convex_convexHull ℚ _)
    (clipFrag_mem_vpoly g hf hmem)

name: clipFrag_mem_vpoly_iff
statement:
theorem clipFrag_mem_vpoly_iff (g : IPlane)
    (hf : FragInv nt ct f) (x : Point) :
    (∃ f' ∈ clipFrag g f, x ∈ vpoly (fragCycle f'))
      ↔ x ∈ vpoly (fragCycle f)
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨f', hmem, hx⟩
    exact clipFrag_vpoly_subset g hf hmem hx
  · intro hx
    haveI := hf.neZero
    cases hb : walkBranch g f with
    | false =>
      refine ⟨f, ?_, hx⟩
      rw [clipFrag_allWeak_eq g f hb]
      simp [Array.mem_def]
    | true =>
      rcases le_or_lt 0 (ce (iplaneN g) (iplaneD g) x) with hside | hside
      · refine ⟨fragP g f, ?_, ?_⟩
        · rw [clipFrag_walk_eq g f hb]
          simp [Array.mem_def, fragP]
        · rw [vpoly_fragP (isMulOf_self g) hf hb]
          exact ⟨hx, hside⟩
      · refine ⟨fragN g f, ?_, ?_⟩
        · rw [clipFrag_walk_eq g f hb]
          simp [Array.mem_def, fragN]
        · rw [vpoly_fragN (isMulOf_self g) hf hb]
          exact ⟨hx, hside.le⟩

name: ce_sum_comb
proof:
:= by
  have hdot : dotQ N (∑ j, μ j • y j) = ∑ j, μ j * dotQ N (y j) := by
    rw [show dotQ N (∑ j, μ j • y j) = dotLin N (∑ j, μ j • y j) from rfl,
      map_sum]
    exact Finset.sum_congr rfl fun j _ => by
      rw [map_smul, smul_eq_mul, dotLin_apply]
  have hsum : ∑ j, μ j * ce N d (y j)
      = (∑ j, μ j * dotQ N (y j)) - (∑ j, μ j) * d := by
    rw [Finset.sum_mul, ← Finset.sum_sub_distrib]
    exact Finset.sum_congr rfl fun j _ => by rw [ce]; ring
  rw [hsum, h1, one_mul, ce, hdot]

name: vrelint_fragP_pos
proof:
:= by
  haveI := hf.neZero
  obtain ⟨hpos, hneg⟩ := (walkBranch_iff hg hf.vrepr).mp hb
  haveI := walk_length_neZero hpos
  obtain ⟨hsz, hpt⟩ := frag_read_walkCycle
    (fragP_map hg hf.size3 hf.vrepr)
  rintro x ⟨μ, hμpos, hμsum, rfl⟩
  simp only [Set.mem_setOf_eq]
  rw [ce_sum_comb N d hμsum]
  have hnn : ∀ j, 0 ≤ μ j * ce N d (fragCycle (fragP g f) j) := by
    intro j
    refine mul_nonneg (hμpos j).le ?_
    rw [hpt j]
    exact ce_nonneg_of_mem_walk (List.get_mem _ _)
  obtain ⟨ip, hip⟩ := hpos
  have hwmem : fragCycle f ip ∈ walk N d (fragCycle f) := w_mem_walk hip.le
  obtain ⟨jw, hjw⟩ := List.mem_iff_get.mp hwmem
  refine Finset.sum_pos' (fun j _ => hnn j)
    ⟨Fin.cast hsz.symm jw, Finset.mem_univ _, ?_⟩
  have hval : fragCycle (fragP g f) (Fin.cast hsz.symm jw)
      = fragCycle f ip := by
    rw [hpt]
    show (walk N d (fragCycle f)).get (Fin.cast hsz (Fin.cast hsz.symm jw)) = _
    rw [show Fin.cast hsz (Fin.cast hsz.symm jw) = jw from rfl]
    exact hjw
  rw [hval]
  exact mul_pos (hμpos _) hip

name: vrelint_fragN_neg
proof:
:= by
  haveI := hf.neZero
  obtain ⟨hpos, hneg⟩ := (walkBranch_iff hg hf.vrepr).mp hb
  obtain ⟨hpos', hneg'⟩ := ce_neg_pos_neg hpos hneg
  haveI := walk_length_neZero hpos'
  obtain ⟨hsz, hpt⟩ := frag_read_walkCycle
    (fragN_map hg hf.size3 hf.vrepr)
  rintro x ⟨μ, hμpos, hμsum, rfl⟩
  simp only [Set.mem_setOf_eq]
  have hlt : 0 < ce (-N) (-d) (∑ j, μ j • fragCycle (fragN g f) j) := by
    rw [ce_sum_comb (-N) (-d) hμsum]
    have hnn : ∀ j, 0 ≤ μ j * ce (-N) (-d) (fragCycle (fragN g f) j) := by
      intro j
      refine mul_nonneg (hμpos j).le ?_
      rw [hpt j]
      exact ce_nonneg_of_mem_walk (List.get_mem _ _)
    obtain ⟨ip, hip⟩ := hpos'
    have hwmem : fragCycle f ip ∈ walk (-N) (-d) (fragCycle f) :=
      w_mem_walk hip.le
    obtain ⟨jw, hjw⟩ := List.mem_iff_get.mp hwmem
    refine Finset.sum_pos' (fun j _ => hnn j)
      ⟨Fin.cast hsz.symm jw, Finset.mem_univ _, ?_⟩
    have hval : fragCycle (fragN g f) (Fin.cast hsz.symm jw)
        = fragCycle f ip := by
      rw [hpt]
      show (walk (-N) (-d) (fragCycle f)).get
        (Fin.cast hsz (Fin.cast hsz.symm jw)) = _
      rw [show Fin.cast hsz (Fin.cast hsz.symm jw) = jw from rfl]
      exact hjw
    rw [hval]
    exact mul_pos (hμpos _) hip
  rw [ce_neg] at hlt
  linarith

name: RelDisj.symm
statement: theorem RelDisj.symm {f₁ f₂ : Frag} (h : RelDisj f₁ f₂) : RelDisj f₂ f₁
proof:
:= by
  rw [RelDisj, Set.inter_comm]
  exact h

name: relDisj_fragP_fragN
statement:
theorem relDisj_fragP_fragN (g : IPlane)
    (hf : FragInv nt ct f) (hb : walkBranch g f = true) :
    RelDisj (fragP g f) (fragN g f)
proof:
:= by
  rw [RelDisj, Set.eq_empty_iff_forall_not_mem]
  rintro x ⟨hxP, hxN⟩
  have h1 := vrelint_fragP_pos (isMulOf_self g) hf hb hxP
  have h2 := vrelint_fragN_neg (isMulOf_self g) hf hb hxN
  simp only [Set.mem_setOf_eq] at h1 h2
  linarith

name: clipFrag_vrelint_subset
statement:
theorem clipFrag_vrelint_subset (g : IPlane)
    (hf : FragInv nt ct f) {f' : Frag} (hmem : f' ∈ clipFrag g f) :
    vrelint (fragCycle f') ⊆ vrelint (fragCycle f)
proof:
:= by
  haveI := hf.neZero
  have hf' := fragInv_clipFrag g hf hmem
  haveI := hf'.neZero
  exact vrelint_mono hf'.size3 hf.size3 hf'.onPlane hf'.strictConv
    hf.onPlane hf.strictConv (clipFrag_mem_vpoly g hf hmem)

name: pairwise_clipFrag
statement:
theorem pairwise_clipFrag (g : IPlane)
    (hf : FragInv nt ct f) :
    (clipFrag g f).toList.Pairwise RelDisj
proof:
:= by
  haveI := hf.neZero
  cases hb : walkBranch g f with
  | false =>
    rw [clipFrag_allWeak_eq g f hb]
    simp
  | true =>
    rw [clipFrag_walk_eq g f hb]
    refine List.pairwise_cons.mpr ⟨?_, by simp⟩
    intro f' hf'
    obtain rfl : f' = fragN g f := by simpa [fragN] using hf'
    exact relDisj_fragP_fragN g hf hb

name: areaForm_self_normal
statement:
theorem areaForm_self_normal (A B C : Point) :
    areaForm (crossQ (psub B A) (psub C A)) A B C
      = dotQ (crossQ (psub B A) (psub C A)) (crossQ (psub B A) (psub C A))
proof:
:= by
  simp only [areaForm, dotQ, crossQ, psub, mkPoint_zero, mkPoint_one,
    mkPoint_two, Pi.sub_apply]

name: dotQ_normal_eq
statement:
theorem dotQ_normal_eq (A B C : Point) :
    dotQ (crossQ (psub B A) (psub C A)) B = dotQ (crossQ (psub B A) (psub C A)) A
    ∧ dotQ (crossQ (psub B A) (psub C A)) C
        = dotQ (crossQ (psub B A) (psub C A)) A
proof:
:= by
  constructor <;>
    · simp only [dotQ, crossQ, psub, mkPoint_zero, mkPoint_one, mkPoint_two]
      ring

name: strictConv_triple
proof:
:= by
  intro i j hj1 hj2
  set n := crossQ (psub B A) (psub C A) with hndef
  have hpos : 0 < areaForm n A B C := by
    rw [hndef, areaForm_self_normal]
    exact CSG.Proof.MeshIntersectRay.dotQ_self_pos hn
  fin_cases i <;> fin_cases j
  · exact absurd rfl hj1
  · exact absurd rfl hj2
  · show 0 < areaForm n A B C
    exact hpos
  · show 0 < areaForm n B C A
    rw [← areaForm_cyclic]
    exact hpos
  · exact absurd rfl hj1
  · exact absurd rfl hj2
  · exact absurd rfl hj2
  · show 0 < areaForm n C A B
    rw [← areaForm_cyclic, ← areaForm_cyclic]
    exact hpos
  · exact absurd rfl hj1

name: onPlane_triple
proof:
:= by
  intro i
  obtain ⟨hB, hC⟩ := dotQ_normal_eq A B C
  fin_cases i
  · rfl
  · exact hB
  · exact hC

name: materialize_getElem
statement:
theorem materialize_getElem (M : Mesh) (i : ℕ) (hi : i < M.size) :
    (materialize M)[i]'(by simpa [materialize] using hi) = faceSOf (M[i]'hi)
proof:
:= by
  simp [materialize, faceSOf, mkVtx]

name: fragInv_fragOfFace
statement:
theorem fragInv_fragOfFace (t : Triangle)
    (hn : crossQ (psub t.v₁ t.v₀) (psub t.v₂ t.v₀) ≠ 0) :
    FragInv (crossQ (psub t.v₁ t.v₀) (psub t.v₂ t.v₀))
      (dotQ (crossQ (psub t.v₁ t.v₀) (psub t.v₂ t.v₀)) t.v₀)
      (fragOfFace (faceSOf t))
proof:
:= by
  have hsz : (fragOfFace (faceSOf t)).poly.size = 3 := rfl
  have hpt : ∀ k : Fin (fragOfFace (faceSOf t)).poly.size,
      fragCycle (fragOfFace (faceSOf t)) k
        = ![t.v₀, t.v₁, t.v₂] (Fin.cast hsz k) := by
    intro k
    fin_cases k
    · exact ofPoint_toPoint t.v₀
    · exact ofPoint_toPoint t.v₁
    · exact ofPoint_toPoint t.v₂
  haveI : NeZero (fragOfFace (faceSOf t)).poly.size :=
    ⟨by omega⟩
  refine ⟨by omega,
    onPlane_transport hsz hpt (onPlane_triple t.v₀ t.v₁ t.v₂),
    strictConv_transport hsz hpt (strictConv_triple hn), ?_, ?_⟩
  · intro i
    fin_cases i
    · exact mkVtx_repr (ofPoint t.v₀)
    · exact mkVtx_repr (ofPoint t.v₁)
    · exact mkVtx_repr (ofPoint t.v₂)
  · 
    
    exact CSG.Proof.MeshIntersectPlaneH.isMulOf_iFacePlaneH_materialize t

name: eta_zero_on_line
statement:
theorem eta_zero_on_line (nt : Point) (w₀ : Fin r₀ → Point) (i : Fin r₀)
    {u u' : Point} (h0 : eta nt w₀ i u = 0) (h1 : eta nt w₀ i u' = 0)
    (s : ℚ) : eta nt w₀ i (u + s • (u' - u)) = 0
proof:
:= by
  have hd := eta_add_smul nt w₀ i u (u' - u) 1
  rw [one_smul, show u + (u' - u) = u' from by abel, h0, h1] at hd
  have hdir : etaDir nt w₀ i (u' - u) = 0 := by linarith
  rw [eta_add_smul, h0, hdir]
  ring

name: ce_zero_on_line
proof:
:= by
  have hd := ce_add_smul N d u (u' - u) 1
  rw [one_smul, show u + (u' - u) = u' from by abel, h0, h1] at hd
  have hdot : dotQ N (u' - u) = 0 := by linarith
  rw [ce_add_smul, h0, hdot]
  ring

name: EdgeProv.sub
statement:
theorem EdgeProv.sub {u u' : Point} (h : EdgeProv nt w₀ L u u') (α β : ℚ) :
    EdgeProv nt w₀ L (u + α • (u' - u)) (u + β • (u' - u))
proof:
:= by
  rcases h with ⟨i, h0, h1⟩ | ⟨pg, hpg, h0, h1⟩
  · exact Or.inl ⟨i, eta_zero_on_line nt w₀ i h0 h1 α,
      eta_zero_on_line nt w₀ i h0 h1 β⟩
  · exact Or.inr ⟨pg, hpg, ce_zero_on_line _ _ h0 h1 α,
      ce_zero_on_line _ _ h0 h1 β⟩

name: walkAdj_edgeProv
statement:
theorem walkAdj_edgeProv {r : ℕ} [NeZero r] {n N : Point} {d : ℚ}
    {w : Fin r → Point} {u u' : Point} (hadj : WalkAdj n N d w u u')
    (hpar : ∀ i : Fin r, EdgeProv nt w₀ L (w i) (w (i + 1)))
    (hcut : ∀ x x' : Point, ce N d x = 0 → ce N d x' = 0
      → EdgeProv nt w₀ L x x') :
    EdgeProv nt w₀ L u u'
proof:
:= by
  rcases hadj with ⟨i, α, β, _, _, _, hu, hu', _⟩ | ⟨_, _, hcu, hcu', _, _⟩
  · rw [hu, hu']
    exact (hpar i).sub α β
  · exact hcut _ _ hcu hcu'

name: fragProv_clipFrag
statement:
theorem fragProv_clipFrag {f : Frag} (g : IPlane)
    (hgL : g ∈ L) (hf : FragInv nt ct f)
    (hpar : FragProv nt w₀ L f) {f' : Frag}
    (hmem : f' ∈ clipFrag g f) : FragProv nt w₀ L f'
proof:
:= by
  haveI := hf.neZero
  cases hb : walkBranch g f with
  | false =>
    rw [clipFrag_allWeak_eq g f hb, Array.mem_def] at hmem
    obtain rfl : f' = f := by simpa using hmem
    intro _ k
    exact hpar k
  | true =>
    have hcutP : ∀ x x', ce (iplaneN g) (iplaneD g) x = 0 →
        ce (iplaneN g) (iplaneD g) x' = 0 → EdgeProv nt w₀ L x x' :=
      fun x x' h h' => Or.inr ⟨g, hgL, h, h'⟩
    obtain ⟨hpos, hneg⟩ := (walkBranch_iff (isMulOf_self g) hf.vrepr).mp hb
    rcases mem_clipFrag_walk hb hmem with rfl | rfl
    · haveI := walk_length_neZero hpos
      obtain ⟨hsz, hpt⟩ := frag_read_walkCycle
        (fragP_map (isMulOf_self g) hf.size3 hf.vrepr)
      intro _ k
      rw [hpt k, hpt (k + 1), fin_cast_add_one hsz]
      exact walkAdj_edgeProv
        (walkCycle_adj hf.size3 hf.strictConv hpos hneg (Fin.cast hsz k))
        (fun i => hpar i) hcutP
    · obtain ⟨hpos', hneg'⟩ := ce_neg_pos_neg hpos hneg
      haveI := walk_length_neZero hpos'
      obtain ⟨hsz, hpt⟩ := frag_read_walkCycle
        (fragN_map (isMulOf_self g) hf.size3 hf.vrepr)
      intro _ k
      rw [hpt k, hpt (k + 1), fin_cast_add_one hsz]
      refine walkAdj_edgeProv
        (walkCycle_adj hf.size3 hf.strictConv hpos' hneg' (Fin.cast hsz k))
        (fun i => hpar i) ?_
      intro x x' h h'
      rw [ce_neg] at h h'
      exact hcutP x x' (by linarith) (by linarith)

name: eta_ne_zero_of_avoids
statement:
theorem eta_ne_zero_of_avoids {f' : Frag} (hf' : FragInv nt ct f')
    (hprov : FragProv nt w₀ L f') {P : Point}
    (hP : AvoidsLines nt ct w₀ L P) :
    ∀ [NeZero f'.poly.size] (k : Fin f'.poly.size),
      eta nt (fragCycle f') k P ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  intro _ k h0
  have hne : fragCycle f' k ≠ fragCycle f' (k + 1) :=
    consec_ne hf'.size3 hf'.strictConv k
  have hnt : nt ≠ 0 := n_ne_zero_of_strict hf'.size3 hf'.strictConv
  obtain ⟨s, hs⟩ := collinear_of_areaForm_zero hnt (hf'.onPlane k)
    (hf'.onPlane (k + 1)) hP.1 hne h0
  rcases hprov k with ⟨i, h1, h2⟩ | ⟨pg, hpg, h1, h2⟩
  · exact hP.2.1 i (hs ▸ eta_zero_on_line nt w₀ i h1 h2 s)
  · exact hP.2.2 pg hpg (hs ▸ ce_zero_on_line _ _ h1 h2 s)

name: vrelint_or_not_vpoly_of_avoids
statement:
theorem vrelint_or_not_vpoly_of_avoids {f' : Frag} (hf' : FragInv nt ct f')
    (hprov : FragProv nt w₀ L f') {P : Point}
    (hP : AvoidsLines nt ct w₀ L P) :
    P ∈ vrelint (fragCycle f') ∨ P ∉ vpoly (fragCycle f')
proof:
:= by
  haveI := hf'.neZero
  by_cases hall : ∀ k, 0 < eta nt (fragCycle f') k P
  · left
    rw [vrelint_eq hf'.size3 hf'.onPlane hf'.strictConv]
    exact ⟨hP.1, hall⟩
  · right
    rw [vpoly_eq hf'.size3 hf'.onPlane hf'.strictConv]
    push_neg at hall
    obtain ⟨k, hk⟩ := hall
    rintro ⟨-, hge⟩
    exact absurd (lt_of_le_of_ne (hge k)
        (Ne.symm (eta_ne_zero_of_avoids hf' hprov hP k)))
      (not_lt.mpr hk)

name: carrier_subset_of_cycle_on_plane
proof:
:= by
  have hn : n ≠ 0 := n_ne_zero_of_strict hr hs
  have hind : areaForm n (w 0) (w (0 + 1)) (w (0 + 1 + 1)) ≠ 0 :=
    ne_of_gt (hs 0 (0 + 1 + 1) (fin_add_two_ne hr 0) (fin_add_one_ne hr (0 + 1)))
  obtain ⟨s, t, hrep⟩ :=
    plane_coords hn (hpl 0) (hpl (0 + 1)) (hpl (0 + 1 + 1)) hind hx
  rw [hrep]
  have hexp : dotQ m (w 0 + s • (w (0 + 1) - w 0) + t • (w (0 + 1 + 1) - w 0))
      = dotQ m (w 0) + s * (dotQ m (w (0 + 1)) - dotQ m (w 0))
        + t * (dotQ m (w (0 + 1 + 1)) - dotQ m (w 0)) := by
    simp only [dotQ, Pi.add_apply, Pi.sub_apply, Pi.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul]
    ring
  rw [hexp, hall, hall, hall]
  ring

name: vrelint_ce_pos
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨μ, hpos, hsum, rfl⟩ := hx
  rw [ce_sum_comb N d hsum]
  calc (0 : ℚ) < μ k0 * ce N d (w k0) :=
        mul_pos (hpos k0) (lt_of_le_of_ne (h k0) (Ne.symm hk0))
    _ ≤ ∑ j, μ j * ce N d (w j) :=
        Finset.single_le_sum
          (fun j _ => mul_nonneg (hpos j).le (h j)) (Finset.mem_univ k0)

name: vrelint_ce_ne_zero
proof:
:= by
  rcases hone with h | h
  · exact ne_of_gt (vrelint_ce_pos h hk0 hx)
  · have h' : ∀ k, 0 ≤ ce (-N) (-d) (w k) := fun k => by
      rw [ce_neg]; linarith [h k]
    have hk0' : ce (-N) (-d) (w k0) ≠ 0 := by
      rw [ce_neg]; exact neg_ne_zero.mpr hk0
    have := vrelint_ce_pos h' hk0' hx
    rw [ce_neg] at this
    intro h0
    rw [h0] at this
    exact lt_irrefl 0 (by linarith)

name: rmin_le_left
statement: theorem rmin_le_left (a b : ℚ) : rmin a b ≤ a
proof:

name: box_comb_le
statement:
private theorem box_comb_le {lo p q a a' : ℚ} (ha : 0 ≤ a) (ha' : 0 ≤ a')
    (haa : a + a' = 1) (hp : lo ≤ p) (hq : lo ≤ q) : lo ≤ a * p + a' * q
proof:
:= by
  have h1 : a * lo ≤ a * p := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hp ha
  have h2 : a' * lo ≤ a' * q := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hq ha'
  have h3 : a * lo + a' * lo = lo := by rw [← add_mul, haa, one_mul]
  linarith

name: box_le_comb
statement:
private theorem box_le_comb {hi p q a a' : ℚ} (ha : 0 ≤ a) (ha' : 0 ≤ a')
    (haa : a + a' = 1) (hp : p ≤ hi) (hq : q ≤ hi) : a * p + a' * q ≤ hi
proof:
:= by
  have h1 : a * p ≤ a * hi := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hp ha
  have h2 : a' * q ≤ a' * hi := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hq ha'
  have h3 : a * hi + a' * hi = hi := by rw [← add_mul, haa, one_mul]
  linarith

name: boxSet_convex
statement: theorem boxSet_convex (b : Box3) : Convex ℚ (BoxSet b)
proof:
:= by
  rintro x hx y hy a a' ha ha' haa
  obtain ⟨⟨hx1, hx2⟩, ⟨hx3, hx4⟩, hx5, hx6⟩ := hx
  obtain ⟨⟨hy1, hy2⟩, ⟨hy3, hy4⟩, hy5, hy6⟩ := hy
  refine ⟨⟨?_, ?_⟩, ⟨?_, ?_⟩, ?_, ?_⟩ <;>
      simp only [Pi.add_apply, Pi.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul]
  · exact box_comb_le ha ha' haa hx1 hy1
  · exact box_le_comb ha ha' haa hx2 hy2
  · exact box_comb_le ha ha' haa hx3 hy3
  · exact box_le_comb ha ha' haa hx4 hy4
  · exact box_comb_le ha ha' haa hx5 hy5
  · exact box_le_comb ha ha' haa hx6 hy6

name: boxesOverlap_of_boxSet
statement:
theorem boxesOverlap_of_boxSet {b₁ b₂ : Box3} {x : Point}
    (h₁ : x ∈ BoxSet b₁) (h₂ : x ∈ BoxSet b₂) : boxesOverlap b₁ b₂ = true
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨⟨a1, a2⟩, ⟨a3, a4⟩, a5, a6⟩ := h₁
  obtain ⟨⟨c1, c2⟩, ⟨c3, c4⟩, c5, c6⟩ := h₂
  simp only [boxesOverlap, Bool.and_eq_true, decide_eq_true_eq]
  refine ⟨⟨⟨⟨⟨?_, ?_⟩, ?_⟩, ?_⟩, ?_⟩, ?_⟩ <;> linarith

name: not_boxesOverlap_disjoint
statement:
theorem not_boxesOverlap_disjoint {b₁ b₂ : Box3}
    (h : boxesOverlap b₁ b₂ = false) : BoxSet b₁ ∩ BoxSet b₂ = ∅
proof:
:= by
  rw [Set.eq_empty_iff_forall_not_mem]
  rintro x ⟨hx1, hx2⟩
  rw [boxesOverlap_of_boxSet hx1 hx2] at h
  exact Bool.noConfusion h

name: foldl_rmin_le
statement:
theorem foldl_rmin_le {α : Type} (proj : α → ℚ) :
    ∀ (l : List α) (seed : ℚ),
      (l.foldl (fun acc a => rmin acc (proj a)) seed) ≤ seed ∧
      ∀ a ∈ l, (l.foldl (fun acc a => rmin acc (proj a)) seed) ≤ proj a
proof:
:= by
  intro l
  induction l with
  | nil => intro seed; exact ⟨le_refl _, by simp⟩
  | cons b l ih =>
    intro seed
    obtain ⟨h1, h2⟩ := ih (rmin seed (proj b))
    refine ⟨le_trans h1 (rmin_le_left _ _), ?_⟩
    intro a ha
    rcases List.mem_cons.mp ha with rfl | ha'
    · exact le_trans h1 (rmin_le_right _ _)
    · exact h2 a ha'

name: le_foldl_rmax
statement:
theorem le_foldl_rmax {α : Type} (proj : α → ℚ) :
    ∀ (l : List α) (seed : ℚ),
      seed ≤ (l.foldl (fun acc a => rmax acc (proj a)) seed) ∧
      ∀ a ∈ l, proj a ≤ (l.foldl (fun acc a => rmax acc (proj a)) seed)
proof:
:= by
  intro l
  induction l with
  | nil => intro seed; exact ⟨le_refl _, by simp⟩
  | cons b l ih =>
    intro seed
    obtain ⟨h1, h2⟩ := ih (rmax seed (proj b))
    refine ⟨le_trans (le_rmax_left _ _) h1, ?_⟩
    intro a ha
    rcases List.mem_cons.mp ha with rfl | ha'
    · exact le_trans (le_rmax_right _ _) h1
    · exact h2 a ha'

name: mem_boxSet_fragPolyBox
statement:
theorem mem_boxSet_fragPolyBox {f : Frag} (k : Fin f.poly.size) :
    fragCycle f k ∈ BoxSet (fragPolyBox f)
proof:
:= by
  have hmem : f.poly[k] ∈ f.poly.toList := by
    rw [Array.mem_toList]; exact Array.getElem_mem k.isLt
  have hx : (fragCycle f k) 0 = (f.poly[k]).p.x := by
    simp [fragCycle, P3.toPoint, mkPoint_zero]
  have hy : (fragCycle f k) 1 = (f.poly[k]).p.y := by
    simp [fragCycle, P3.toPoint, mkPoint_one]
  have hz : (fragCycle f k) 2 = (f.poly[k]).p.z := by
    simp [fragCycle, P3.toPoint, mkPoint_two]
  have eLoX : (fragPolyBox f).lo.x
      = f.poly.toList.foldl (fun acc v => rmin acc v.p.x) ((f.poly.getD 0 default).p).x := by
    rw [show (fragPolyBox f).lo
        = f.poly.foldl (fun a v => pminS a v.p) ((f.poly.getD 0 default).p) from rfl,
      ← Array.foldl_toList, foldl_pminS_x (fun v : Vtx => v.p)]
  have eLoY : (fragPolyBox f).lo.y
      = f.poly.toList.foldl (fun acc v => rmin acc v.p.y) ((f.poly.getD 0 default).p).y := by
    rw [show (fragPolyBox f).lo
        = f.poly.foldl (fun a v => pminS a v.p) ((f.poly.getD 0 default).p) from rfl,
      ← Array.foldl_toList, foldl_pminS_y (fun v : Vtx => v.p)]
  have eLoZ : (fragPolyBox f).lo.z
      = f.poly.toList.foldl (fun acc v => rmin acc v.p.z) ((f.poly.getD 0 default).p).z := by
    rw [show (fragPolyBox f).lo
        = f.poly.foldl (fun a v => pminS a v.p) ((f.poly.getD 0 default).p) from rfl,
      ← Array.foldl_toList, foldl_pminS_z (fun v : Vtx => v.p)]
  have eHiX : (fragPolyBox f).hi.x
      = f.poly.toList.foldl (fun acc v => rmax acc v.p.x) ((f.poly.getD 0 default).p).x := by
    rw [show (fragPolyBox f).hi
        = f.poly.foldl (fun a v => pmaxS a v.p) ((f.poly.getD 0 default).p) from rfl,
      ← Array.foldl_toList, foldl_pmaxS_x (fun v : Vtx => v.p)]
  have eHiY : (fragPolyBox f).hi.y
      = f.poly.toList.foldl (fun acc v => rmax acc v.p.y) ((f.poly.getD 0 default).p).y := by
    rw [show (fragPolyBox f).hi
        = f.poly.foldl (fun a v => pmaxS a v.p) ((f.poly.getD 0 default).p) from rfl,
      ← Array.foldl_toList, foldl_pmaxS_y (fun v : Vtx => v.p)]
  have eHiZ : (fragPolyBox f).hi.z
      = f.poly.toList.foldl (fun acc v => rmax acc v.p.z) ((f.poly.getD 0 default).p).z := by
    rw [show (fragPolyBox f).hi
        = f.poly.foldl (fun a v => pmaxS a v.p) ((f.poly.getD 0 default).p) from rfl,
      ← Array.foldl_toList, foldl_pmaxS_z (fun v : Vtx => v.p)]
  refine ⟨⟨?_, ?_⟩, ⟨?_, ?_⟩, ?_, ?_⟩
  · rw [hx, eLoX]; exact (foldl_rmin_le (fun v : Vtx => v.p.x) f.poly.toList _).2 _ hmem
  · rw [hx, eHiX]; exact (le_foldl_rmax (fun v : Vtx => v.p.x) f.poly.toList _).2 _ hmem
  · rw [hy, eLoY]; exact (foldl_rmin_le (fun v : Vtx => v.p.y) f.poly.toList _).2 _ hmem
  · rw [hy, eHiY]; exact (le_foldl_rmax (fun v : Vtx => v.p.y) f.poly.toList _).2 _ hmem
  · rw [hz, eLoZ]; exact (foldl_rmin_le (fun v : Vtx => v.p.z) f.poly.toList _).2 _ hmem
  · rw [hz, eHiZ]; exact (le_foldl_rmax (fun v : Vtx => v.p.z) f.poly.toList _).2 _ hmem

name: vpoly_subset_fragPolyBox
statement:
theorem vpoly_subset_fragPolyBox {f : Frag} [NeZero f.poly.size] :
    vpoly (fragCycle f) ⊆ BoxSet (fragPolyBox f)
proof:
:=
  vpoly_subset_of_forall_mem (boxSet_convex _)
    (fun k => mem_boxSet_fragPolyBox k)

name: sclipFold_cons
statement:
theorem sclipFold_cons (fs : Array Frag) (t : IPlane × Box3)
    (L : List (IPlane × Box3)) :
    sclipFold fs (t :: L) = sclipFold (fs.flatMap (clipFragS t.1 t.2)) L
proof:
:=
  rfl

statement:

    sclipFold fs (L₁ ++ L₂) = sclipFold (sclipFold fs L₁) L₂
proof:
:=
  List.foldl_append ..

name: clipFragScoped_map_fst
statement:
theorem clipFragScoped_map_fst (g : IPlane) (box : Box3)
    {fb : Frag × Box3} (h : fb.2 = fragPolyBox fb.1) :
    (clipFragScoped g box fb).map Prod.fst = clipFragS g box fb.1
proof:
:= by
  unfold clipFragScoped clipFragS
  rw [h]
  by_cases hb : boxesOverlap (fragPolyBox fb.1) box
  · rw [if_pos hb, if_pos hb, Array.map_map,
      show (Prod.fst ∘ fun p => (p, fragPolyBox p)) = (id : Frag → Frag) from rfl,
      Array.map_id]
  · rw [if_neg hb, if_neg hb]
    rfl

name: boxTagged_clipFragScoped
statement:
theorem boxTagged_clipFragScoped (g : IPlane) (box : Box3)
    {fb : Frag × Box3} (h : fb.2 = fragPolyBox fb.1) :
    BoxTagged (clipFragScoped g box fb)
proof:
:= by
  unfold clipFragScoped
  by_cases hb : boxesOverlap fb.2 box
  · rw [if_pos hb]
    intro p hp
    rw [Array.mem_map] at hp
    obtain ⟨q, _, rfl⟩ := hp
    rfl
  · rw [if_neg hb]
    intro p hp
    obtain rfl : p = fb := by simpa using hp
    exact h

name: boxTagged_flatMap
statement:
theorem boxTagged_flatMap {fbs : Array (Frag × Box3)} (h : BoxTagged fbs)
    (g : IPlane) (box : Box3) :
    BoxTagged (fbs.flatMap (clipFragScoped g box))
proof:
:= by
  intro p hp
  rw [mem_flatMap_arr] at hp
  obtain ⟨fb, hfb, hp'⟩ := hp
  exact boxTagged_clipFragScoped g box (h fb hfb) p hp'

name: map_fst_flatMap_clipFragScoped
statement:
theorem map_fst_flatMap_clipFragScoped {fbs : Array (Frag × Box3)}
    (h : BoxTagged fbs) (g : IPlane) (box : Box3) :
    (fbs.flatMap (clipFragScoped g box)).map Prod.fst
      = (fbs.map Prod.fst).flatMap (clipFragS g box)
proof:
:= by
  apply Array.ext'
  rw [Array.toList_map, toList_flatMap_arr, toList_flatMap_arr, Array.toList_map,
    List.map_flatMap, List.flatMap_map]
  apply List.flatMap_congr
  intro fb hfb
  rw [← Array.toList_map, clipFragScoped_map_fst g box (h fb (Array.mem_def.mpr hfb))]

name: foldl_clipFragScoped_map_fst
statement:
theorem foldl_clipFragScoped_map_fst (L : List (IPlane × Box3)) :
    ∀ (fbs : Array (Frag × Box3)), BoxTagged fbs →
      (L.foldl (fun fs t => fs.flatMap (clipFragScoped t.1 t.2)) fbs).map Prod.fst
        = sclipFold (fbs.map Prod.fst) L
proof:
:= by
  induction L with
  | nil => intro fbs _; rfl
  | cons t L ih =>
    intro fbs h
    rw [List.foldl_cons, sclipFold_cons,
      ih (fbs.flatMap (clipFragScoped t.1 t.2)) (boxTagged_flatMap h t.1 t.2),
      map_fst_flatMap_clipFragScoped h t.1 t.2]

name: clipFaceScoped_eq_sclipFold
statement:
theorem clipFaceScoped_eq_sclipFold (f₀ : Frag) (L : Array (IPlane × Box3)) :
    clipFaceScoped f₀ L = sclipFold #[f₀] L.toList
proof:
:= by
  have hbt : BoxTagged #[(f₀, fragPolyBox f₀)] := by
    intro p hp
    obtain rfl : p = (f₀, fragPolyBox f₀) := by simpa using hp
    rfl
  show Array.map Prod.fst (Array.foldl
    (fun fs t => Array.flatMap (clipFragScoped t.1 t.2) fs)
    #[(f₀, fragPolyBox f₀)] L) = sclipFold #[f₀] L.toList
  rw [← Array.foldl_toList, foldl_clipFragScoped_map_fst L.toList #[(f₀, fragPolyBox f₀)] hbt,
    show Array.map Prod.fst #[(f₀, fragPolyBox f₀)] = #[f₀] from rfl]

name: fragInv_clipFragS
statement:
theorem fragInv_clipFragS {f : Frag} (g : IPlane) (box : Box3)
    (hf : FragInv nt ct f) {f' : Frag} (hmem : f' ∈ clipFragS g box f) :
    FragInv nt ct f'
proof:
:= by
  unfold clipFragS at hmem
  by_cases hb : boxesOverlap (fragPolyBox f) box
  · rw [if_pos hb] at hmem; exact fragInv_clipFrag g hf hmem
  · rw [if_neg hb] at hmem
    obtain rfl : f' = f := by simpa using hmem
    exact hf

name: clipFragS_vpoly_subset
statement:
theorem clipFragS_vpoly_subset {f : Frag} (g : IPlane) (box : Box3)
    (hf : FragInv nt ct f) {f' : Frag} (hmem : f' ∈ clipFragS g box f) :

proof:
:= by
  unfold clipFragS at hmem
  by_cases hb : boxesOverlap (fragPolyBox f) box
  · rw [if_pos hb] at hmem; exact clipFrag_vpoly_subset g hf hmem
  · rw [if_neg hb] at hmem
    obtain rfl : f' = f := by simpa using hmem

name: clipFragS_vrelint_subset
statement:
theorem clipFragS_vrelint_subset {f : Frag} (g : IPlane) (box : Box3)
    (hf : FragInv nt ct f) {f' : Frag} (hmem : f' ∈ clipFragS g box f) :
    vrelint (fragCycle f') ⊆ vrelint (fragCycle f)
proof:
:= by

  · rw [if_pos hb] at hmem; exact clipFrag_vrelint_subset g hf hmem

name: clipFragS_mem_vpoly_iff
statement:
theorem clipFragS_mem_vpoly_iff {f : Frag} (g : IPlane) (box : Box3)
    (hf : FragInv nt ct f) (x : Point) :
    (∃ f' ∈ clipFragS g box f, x ∈ vpoly (fragCycle f'))
      ↔ x ∈ vpoly (fragCycle f)
proof:
:= by
  unfold clipFragS
  by_cases hb : boxesOverlap (fragPolyBox f) box
  · rw [if_pos hb]; exact clipFrag_mem_vpoly_iff g hf x
  · rw [if_neg hb]
    constructor
    · rintro ⟨f', hf', hx⟩
      obtain rfl : f' = f := by simpa using hf'
      exact hx
    · intro hx; exact ⟨f, by simp, hx⟩

name: pairwise_clipFragS
statement:
theorem pairwise_clipFragS {f : Frag} (g : IPlane) (box : Box3)
    (hf : FragInv nt ct f) :
    (clipFragS g box f).toList.Pairwise RelDisj
proof:
:= by
  unfold clipFragS
  by_cases hb : boxesOverlap (fragPolyBox f) box
  · rw [if_pos hb]; exact pairwise_clipFrag g hf
  · rw [if_neg hb]; simp

name: fragProv_clipFragS
proof:
:= by
  unfold clipFragS at hmem
  by_cases hb : boxesOverlap (fragPolyBox f) box
  · rw [if_pos hb] at hmem; exact fragProv_clipFrag g hgL hf hpar hmem
  · rw [if_neg hb] at hmem
    obtain rfl : f' = f := by simpa using hmem
