name: clipFragS_side_or_disjoint
statement:
theorem clipFragS_side_or_disjoint {f : Frag} (g : IPlane) (box : Box3)
    {N : Point} {d : ℚ} (hg : IsMulOf g N d) (hf : FragInv nt ct f)
    {f' : Frag} (hmem : f' ∈ clipFragS g box f) :
    (∀ k : Fin f'.poly.size, 0 ≤ ce N d (fragCycle f' k))
      ∨ (∀ k : Fin f'.poly.size, ce N d (fragCycle f' k) ≤ 0)
      ∨ vpoly (fragCycle f') ∩ BoxSet box = ∅
proof:
:= by
  unfold clipFragS at hmem
  by_cases hb : boxesOverlap (fragPolyBox f) box
  · rw [if_pos hb] at hmem
    rcases clipFrag_oneSided hg hf hmem with h | h
    · exact Or.inl h
    · exact Or.inr (Or.inl h)
  · rw [if_neg hb] at hmem
    obtain rfl : f' = f := by simpa using hmem
    refine Or.inr (Or.inr ?_)
    haveI := hf.neZero
    have hb' : boxesOverlap (fragPolyBox f') box = false := by
      rw [Bool.not_eq_true] at hb; exact hb
    have hdisj := not_boxesOverlap_disjoint hb'
    rw [Set.eq_empty_iff_forall_not_mem]
    rintro x ⟨hxv, hxb⟩
    have : x ∈ BoxSet (fragPolyBox f') ∩ BoxSet box := ⟨vpoly_subset_fragPolyBox hxv, hxb⟩
    rw [hdisj] at this; exact this

name: sclipFold_elim
proof:
:= by
  induction L generalizing fs with
  | nil => exact ⟨hfs f' hmem, f', hmem, subset_rfl⟩
  | cons t L ih =>
    rw [sclipFold_cons] at hmem
    have hmid : ∀ fmid ∈ fs.flatMap (clipFragS t.1 t.2),
        FragInv nt ct fmid := by
      intro fmid hf
      rw [mem_flatMap_arr] at hf
      obtain ⟨f, hfmem, hfrag⟩ := hf
      exact fragInv_clipFragS t.1 t.2 (hfs f hfmem) hfrag
    obtain ⟨hinv, fmid, hfmid, hsub⟩ := ih hmid hmem
    rw [mem_flatMap_arr] at hfmid
    obtain ⟨f, hfmem, hfrag⟩ := hfmid
    exact ⟨hinv, f, hfmem,
      hsub.trans (clipFragS_vpoly_subset t.1 t.2 (hfs f hfmem) hfrag)⟩

name: fragInv_clipFaceScoped
statement:
theorem fragInv_clipFaceScoped {f₀ : Frag} (hf₀ : FragInv nt ct f₀)
    (L : Array (IPlane × Box3)) {f' : Frag} (hmem : f' ∈ clipFaceScoped f₀ L) :
    FragInv nt ct f'
proof:
:= by
  rw [clipFaceScoped_eq_sclipFold] at hmem
  exact (sclipFold_elim (by simpa using hf₀) hmem).1

name: clipFaceScoped_vpoly_subset
statement:
theorem clipFaceScoped_vpoly_subset {f₀ : Frag} (hf₀ : FragInv nt ct f₀)
    (L : Array (IPlane × Box3)) {f' : Frag} (hmem : f' ∈ clipFaceScoped f₀ L) :
    vpoly (fragCycle f') ⊆ vpoly (fragCycle f₀)
proof:
:= by
  rw [clipFaceScoped_eq_sclipFold] at hmem
  obtain ⟨_, f, hf, hsub⟩ := sclipFold_elim (by simpa using hf₀) hmem
  obtain rfl : f = f₀ := by simpa using hf
  exact hsub

name: sclipFold_mem_vpoly_iff
statement:
theorem sclipFold_mem_vpoly_iff {fs : Array Frag} {L : List (IPlane × Box3)}
    (hfs : ∀ f ∈ fs, FragInv nt ct f) (x : Point) :
    (∃ f' ∈ sclipFold fs L, x ∈ vpoly (fragCycle f'))
      ↔ ∃ f ∈ fs, x ∈ vpoly (fragCycle f)
proof:
:= by
  induction L generalizing fs with
  | nil => exact Iff.rfl
  | cons t L ih =>
    rw [sclipFold_cons]
    have hmid : ∀ fmid ∈ fs.flatMap (clipFragS t.1 t.2),
        FragInv nt ct fmid := by
      intro fmid h
      rw [mem_flatMap_arr] at h
      obtain ⟨f, hfmem, hfrag⟩ := h
      exact fragInv_clipFragS t.1 t.2 (hfs f hfmem) hfrag
    rw [ih hmid]
    constructor
    · rintro ⟨fmid, hfmid, hx⟩
      rw [mem_flatMap_arr] at hfmid
      obtain ⟨f, hfmem, hfrag⟩ := hfmid
      exact ⟨f, hfmem, clipFragS_vpoly_subset t.1 t.2 (hfs f hfmem) hfrag hx⟩
    · rintro ⟨f, hfmem, hx⟩
      obtain ⟨fmid, hfrag, hx'⟩ :=
        (clipFragS_mem_vpoly_iff t.1 t.2 (hfs f hfmem) x).mpr hx
      exact ⟨fmid, mem_flatMap_arr.mpr ⟨f, hfmem, hfrag⟩, hx'⟩

name: clipFaceScoped_mem_vpoly_iff
statement:
theorem clipFaceScoped_mem_vpoly_iff {f₀ : Frag} (hf₀ : FragInv nt ct f₀)
    (L : Array (IPlane × Box3)) (x : Point) :
    (∃ f' ∈ clipFaceScoped f₀ L, x ∈ vpoly (fragCycle f'))
      ↔ x ∈ vpoly (fragCycle f₀)
proof:
:= by
  rw [clipFaceScoped_eq_sclipFold, sclipFold_mem_vpoly_iff (by simpa using hf₀) x]
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨f, hf, hx⟩
    obtain rfl : f = f₀ := by simpa using hf
    exact hx
  · intro hx; exact ⟨f₀, by simp, hx⟩

name: sclipFold_pairwise
statement:
theorem sclipFold_pairwise {fs : Array Frag} {L : List (IPlane × Box3)}
    (hfs : ∀ f ∈ fs, FragInv nt ct f)
    (hpw : fs.toList.Pairwise RelDisj) :
    (sclipFold fs L).toList.Pairwise RelDisj
proof:
:= by
  induction L generalizing fs with
  | nil => exact hpw
  | cons t L ih =>
    rw [sclipFold_cons]
    refine ih ?_ ?_
    · intro fmid h
      rw [mem_flatMap_arr] at h
      obtain ⟨f, hfmem, hfrag⟩ := h
      exact fragInv_clipFragS t.1 t.2 (hfs f hfmem) hfrag
    · rw [toList_flatMap_arr,
        show (fs.toList.flatMap fun a => ((clipFragS t.1 t.2 a).toList))
          = (fs.toList.map fun a => (clipFragS t.1 t.2 a).toList).flatten
          from rfl]
      rw [List.pairwise_flatten]
      constructor
      · intro l hl
        rw [List.mem_map] at hl
        obtain ⟨f, hfmem, rfl⟩ := hl
        exact pairwise_clipFragS t.1 t.2 (hfs f (Array.mem_def.mpr hfmem))
      · rw [List.pairwise_map]
        refine hpw.imp_of_mem ?_
        intro f₁ f₂ h1 h2 hdisj x hx y hy
        have hm1 : x ∈ clipFragS t.1 t.2 f₁ := Array.mem_def.mpr hx
        have hm2 : y ∈ clipFragS t.1 t.2 f₂ := Array.mem_def.mpr hy
        have hs1 := clipFragS_vrelint_subset t.1 t.2
          (hfs f₁ (Array.mem_def.mpr h1)) hm1
        have hs2 := clipFragS_vrelint_subset t.1 t.2
          (hfs f₂ (Array.mem_def.mpr h2)) hm2
        rw [RelDisj, Set.eq_empty_iff_forall_not_mem]
        rintro z ⟨hz1, hz2⟩
        have : z ∈ vrelint (fragCycle f₁) ∩ vrelint (fragCycle f₂) :=
          ⟨hs1 hz1, hs2 hz2⟩
        rw [hdisj] at this
        exact this

name: clipFaceScoped_pairwise
statement:
theorem clipFaceScoped_pairwise {f₀ : Frag} (hf₀ : FragInv nt ct f₀)
    (L : Array (IPlane × Box3)) :
    (clipFaceScoped f₀ L).toList.Pairwise RelDisj
proof:
:= by
  rw [clipFaceScoped_eq_sclipFold]
  exact sclipFold_pairwise (by simpa using hf₀) (by simp)

name: sclipFold_fragProv
proof:
:= by
  induction L' generalizing fs with
  | nil => exact hps f' hmem
  | cons t L' ih =>
    rw [sclipFold_cons] at hmem
    refine ih ?_ ?_ (fun t' h => hL' t' (List.mem_cons_of_mem _ h)) hmem
    · intro fmid h
      rw [mem_flatMap_arr] at h
      obtain ⟨f, hfmem, hfrag⟩ := h
      exact fragInv_clipFragS t.1 t.2 (hfs f hfmem) hfrag
    · intro fmid h
      rw [mem_flatMap_arr] at h
      obtain ⟨f, hfmem, hfrag⟩ := h
      exact fragProv_clipFragS t.1 t.2 (hL' t (List.mem_cons_self ..))
        (hfs f hfmem) (hps f hfmem) hfrag

name: clipFaceScoped_fragProv
statement:
theorem clipFaceScoped_fragProv {f₀ : Frag} [NeZero f₀.poly.size]
    (hf₀ : FragInv nt ct f₀) (L : Array (IPlane × Box3)) {f' : Frag}
    (hmem : f' ∈ clipFaceScoped f₀ L) :
    FragProv nt (fragCycle f₀) (L.toList.map (fun t => t.1)) f'
proof:
:= by
  rw [clipFaceScoped_eq_sclipFold] at hmem
  refine sclipFold_fragProv (by simpa using hf₀) ?_ (fun t h => ?_) hmem
  · intro f h
    obtain rfl : f = f₀ := by simpa using h
    intro _ k
    exact Or.inl ⟨k, eta_self _ _ k, eta_succ _ _ k⟩
  · exact List.mem_map_of_mem _ h

name: clipFaceScoped_scoped_side
statement:
theorem clipFaceScoped_scoped_side {f₀ : Frag} (hf₀ : FragInv nt ct f₀)
    (L : Array (IPlane × Box3)) {f' : Frag} (hmem : f' ∈ clipFaceScoped f₀ L)
    {g : IPlane} {box : Box3} (hpg : (g, box) ∈ L)
    {N : Point} {d : ℚ} (hg : IsMulOf g N d) :
    (∀ k : Fin f'.poly.size, 0 ≤ ce N d (fragCycle f' k))
      ∨ (∀ k : Fin f'.poly.size, ce N d (fragCycle f' k) ≤ 0)
      ∨ vpoly (fragCycle f') ∩ BoxSet box = ∅
proof:
:= by
  rw [clipFaceScoped_eq_sclipFold] at hmem
  have hpg' : (g, box) ∈ L.toList := by simpa using hpg
  obtain ⟨L₁, L₂, hL⟩ := List.append_of_mem hpg'
  rw [hL, sclipFold_append, sclipFold_cons] at hmem
  have hmid : ∀ fmid ∈ sclipFold #[f₀] L₁, FragInv nt ct fmid := fun fmid h =>
    (sclipFold_elim (by simpa using hf₀) h).1
  have hmid2 : ∀ fmid ∈ (sclipFold #[f₀] L₁).flatMap (clipFragS g box),
      FragInv nt ct fmid := by
    intro fmid h
    rw [mem_flatMap_arr] at h
    obtain ⟨f, hfmem, hfrag⟩ := h
    exact fragInv_clipFragS g box (hmid f hfmem) hfrag
  obtain ⟨hinv, fpiv, hfpiv, hsub⟩ := sclipFold_elim hmid2 hmem
  rw [mem_flatMap_arr] at hfpiv
  obtain ⟨fpar, hfparmem, hfrag⟩ := hfpiv
  haveI := (fragInv_clipFragS g box (hmid fpar hfparmem) hfrag).neZero
  rcases clipFragS_side_or_disjoint g box hg (hmid fpar hfparmem) hfrag with
    hside | hside | hboxdisj
  · left; intro k
    exact hsub.trans (vpoly_subset_ce_nonneg hside) (subset_convexHull ℚ _ ⟨k, rfl⟩)
  · right; left; intro k
    exact hsub.trans (vpoly_subset_ce_nonpos hside) (subset_convexHull ℚ _ ⟨k, rfl⟩)
  · right; right
    rw [Set.eq_empty_iff_forall_not_mem]
    rintro x ⟨hxv, hxb⟩
    have : x ∈ vpoly (fragCycle fpiv) ∩ BoxSet box := ⟨hsub hxv, hxb⟩
    rw [hboxdisj] at this; exact this

name: clipFaceScoped_avoid_dichotomy
proof:
:=
  vrelint_or_not_vpoly_of_avoids (fragInv_clipFaceScoped hf₀ L hmem)
    (clipFaceScoped_fragProv hf₀ L hmem) hP

name: clipFaceScoped_tile_relint
statement:
theorem clipFaceScoped_tile_relint {f₀ : Frag} [NeZero f₀.poly.size]
    (hf₀ : FragInv nt ct f₀) (L : Array (IPlane × Box3)) {P : Point}
    (hP : AvoidsLines nt ct (fragCycle f₀) (L.toList.map (fun t => t.1)) P)
    (hmem : P ∈ vpoly (fragCycle f₀)) :
    ∃ f' ∈ clipFaceScoped f₀ L, P ∈ vrelint (fragCycle f')
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨f', hf', hPf'⟩ := (clipFaceScoped_mem_vpoly_iff hf₀ L P).mpr hmem
  rcases clipFaceScoped_avoid_dichotomy hf₀ L hf' hP with h | h
  · exact ⟨f', hf', h⟩
  · exact absurd hPf' h

name: clipFaceScoped_tile_unique
statement:
theorem clipFaceScoped_tile_unique {f₀ : Frag} [NeZero f₀.poly.size]
    (hf₀ : FragInv nt ct f₀) (L : Array (IPlane × Box3)) {P : Point}
    (hP : AvoidsLines nt ct (fragCycle f₀) (L.toList.map (fun t => t.1)) P)
    {i j : ℕ} (hi : i < (clipFaceScoped f₀ L).size)
    (hj : j < (clipFaceScoped f₀ L).size)
    (hPi : P ∈ vpoly (fragCycle ((clipFaceScoped f₀ L)[i])))
    (hPj : P ∈ vpoly (fragCycle ((clipFaceScoped f₀ L)[j]))) : i = j
proof:
:= by
  have key : ∀ {a b : ℕ} (ha : a < (clipFaceScoped f₀ L).size)
      (hb : b < (clipFaceScoped f₀ L).size), a < b →
      P ∈ vpoly (fragCycle ((clipFaceScoped f₀ L)[a])) →
      P ∈ vpoly (fragCycle ((clipFaceScoped f₀ L)[b])) → False := by
    intro a b ha hb hab hPa hPb
    have hra : P ∈ vrelint (fragCycle ((clipFaceScoped f₀ L)[a])) :=
      (clipFaceScoped_avoid_dichotomy hf₀ L (Array.getElem_mem ha) hP).resolve_right
        (not_not_intro hPa)
    have hrb : P ∈ vrelint (fragCycle ((clipFaceScoped f₀ L)[b])) :=
      (clipFaceScoped_avoid_dichotomy hf₀ L (Array.getElem_mem hb) hP).resolve_right
        (not_not_intro hPb)
    have hpw := clipFaceScoped_pairwise hf₀ L
    rw [List.pairwise_iff_getElem] at hpw
    have hdisj := hpw a b (by simpa using ha) (by simpa using hb) hab
    rw [Array.getElem_toList, Array.getElem_toList] at hdisj
    have : P ∈ vrelint (fragCycle ((clipFaceScoped f₀ L)[a]))
        ∩ vrelint (fragCycle ((clipFaceScoped f₀ L)[b])) := ⟨hra, hrb⟩
    rw [hdisj] at this
    exact this
  rcases lt_trichotomy i j with h | h | h
  · exact absurd (key hi hj h hPi hPj) (fun h => h)
  · exact h
  · exact absurd (key hj hi h hPj hPi) (fun h => h)

name: vpoly_dotQ_eq
statement:
theorem vpoly_dotQ_eq {f : Frag} [NeZero f.poly.size] (hf : FragInv nt ct f)
    {x : Point} (hx : x ∈ vpoly (fragCycle f)) : dotQ nt x = ct
proof:
:= by
  have hnn : ∀ k, 0 ≤ ce nt ct (fragCycle f k) := fun k => by simp [ce, hf.onPlane k]
  have hnp : ∀ k, ce nt ct (fragCycle f k) ≤ 0 := fun k => by simp [ce, hf.onPlane k]
  have h1 := vpoly_subset_ce_nonneg hnn hx
  have h2 := vpoly_subset_ce_nonpos hnp hx
  simp only [Set.mem_setOf_eq] at h1 h2
  have hz : ce nt ct x = 0 := le_antisymm h2 h1
  rw [ce] at hz; linarith

name: clipFaceScoped_vrelint_off_triangle
statement:
theorem clipFaceScoped_vrelint_off_triangle
    {f₀ : Frag} [NeZero f₀.poly.size] (hf₀ : FragInv nt ct f₀)
    {L : Array (IPlane × Box3)} {f : Frag} (hmem : f ∈ clipFaceScoped f₀ L)
    {u : Triangle} {nu : Point} {cu : ℚ}
    (h0 : dotQ nu u.v₀ = cu) (h1 : dotQ nu u.v₁ = cu) (h2 : dotQ nu u.v₂ = cu)
    (hS1 : (∃ t ∈ L, IsMulOf t.1 nu cu
              ∧ triangleSet u ∩ {x : Point | dotQ nt x = ct} ⊆ BoxSet t.2)
      ∨ vpoly (fragCycle f₀) ∩ triangleSet u = ∅)
    (hbase : ∃ k : Fin f₀.poly.size, dotQ nu (fragCycle f₀ k) ≠ cu) :
    vrelint (fragCycle f) ∩ triangleSet u = ∅
proof:
:= by
  have hf' := fragInv_clipFaceScoped hf₀ L hmem
  haveI := hf'.neZero
  rw [Set.eq_empty_iff_forall_not_mem]
  rintro x ⟨hxr, hxu⟩
  have hxlevel : dotQ nu x = cu :=
    Proof.MeshIntersectRay.triangleSet_subset_level h0 h1 h2 x hxu
  rcases hS1 with ⟨t, hpg, hmul, hbox⟩ | hdisj
  · obtain ⟨g, box⟩ := t
    have hone := clipFaceScoped_scoped_side hf₀ L hmem hpg hmul
    rcases hone with hone | hone | hboxdisj
    · by_cases hallz : ∀ k : Fin f.poly.size, ce nu cu (fragCycle f k) = 0
      · obtain ⟨k0, hk0⟩ := hbase
        refine hk0 (carrier_subset_of_cycle_on_plane hf'.size3 hf'.onPlane
          hf'.strictConv (m := nu) (d := cu) (fun k => ?_) (hf₀.onPlane k0))
        have := hallz k; simp only [ce] at this; linarith
      · push_neg at hallz; obtain ⟨k0, hk0⟩ := hallz
        refine vrelint_ce_ne_zero (Or.inl hone) hk0 hxr ?_
        simp only [ce, hxlevel, sub_self]
    · by_cases hallz : ∀ k : Fin f.poly.size, ce nu cu (fragCycle f k) = 0
      · obtain ⟨k0, hk0⟩ := hbase
        refine hk0 (carrier_subset_of_cycle_on_plane hf'.size3 hf'.onPlane
          hf'.strictConv (m := nu) (d := cu) (fun k => ?_) (hf₀.onPlane k0))
        have := hallz k; simp only [ce] at this; linarith
      · push_neg at hallz; obtain ⟨k0, hk0⟩ := hallz
        refine vrelint_ce_ne_zero (Or.inr hone) hk0 hxr ?_
        simp only [ce, hxlevel, sub_self]
    · have hxvp : x ∈ vpoly (fragCycle f) := vrelint_subset_vpoly _ hxr
      have hxcarrier : dotQ nt x = ct := vpoly_dotQ_eq hf' hxvp
      have hxbox : x ∈ BoxSet box := hbox ⟨hxu, hxcarrier⟩
      have hbad : x ∈ vpoly (fragCycle f) ∩ BoxSet box := ⟨hxvp, hxbox⟩
      rw [hboxdisj] at hbad; exact hbad
  · have hsub := clipFaceScoped_vpoly_subset hf₀ L hmem
    have hbad : x ∈ vpoly (fragCycle f₀) ∩ triangleSet u :=
      ⟨hsub (vrelint_subset_vpoly _ hxr), hxu⟩
    rw [hdisj] at hbad; exact hbad

name: mem_triangleSet_onPlane
statement:
theorem mem_triangleSet_onPlane {t : Triangle} (hdet : detOrigin t ≠ 0)
    {z : Point} (hz : z ∈ triangleSet t) :
    dotQ (carrierNormal t) z = detOrigin t
proof:
:= by
  have hinv := fragInv_base hdet
  haveI := hinv.neZero
  rw [← vpoly_fragOfFace t,
    vpoly_eq hinv.size3 hinv.onPlane hinv.strictConv] at hz
  exact hz.1

name: isCycle_iff_bal
statement: theorem isCycle_iff_bal (M : Mesh) : IsClosedOrientedSurface M ↔ Bal (edgeMultiset M)
proof:
:=
  Iff.rfl

name: count_map_swap
statement:
theorem count_map_swap (D : Multiset (Point × Point)) (a b : Point) :
    (D.map Prod.swap).count (a, b) = D.count (b, a)
proof:
:= by
  rw [show ((a, b) : Point × Point) = Prod.swap (b, a) from rfl,
    Multiset.count_map_eq_count' _ _ Prod.swap_injective]

name: bal_iff_count
statement:
theorem bal_iff_count {D : Multiset (Point × Point)} :
    Bal D ↔ ∀ a b : Point, D.count (a, b) = D.count (b, a)
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro h a b
    conv_lhs => rw [h]
    exact count_map_swap D a b
  · intro h
    refine Multiset.ext.mpr fun c => ?_
    obtain ⟨a, b⟩ := c
    rw [count_map_swap D a b]
    exact h a b

name: isCycle_iff_count
statement:
theorem isCycle_iff_count (M : Mesh) :
    IsClosedOrientedSurface M ↔ ∀ a b : Point,
      (edgeMultiset M).count (a, b) = (edgeMultiset M).count (b, a)
proof:
:=
  (isCycle_iff_bal M).trans bal_iff_count

name: bal_zero
statement: theorem bal_zero : Bal 0
proof:
:= by
  simp [Bal]

name: bal_add
statement:
theorem bal_add {D E : Multiset (Point × Point)} (hD : Bal D) (hE : Bal E) :
    Bal (D + E)
proof:
:= by
  unfold Bal at *
  rw [Multiset.map_add, ← hD, ← hE]

name: bal_sum
statement:
theorem bal_sum {S : Multiset (Multiset (Point × Point))}
    (h : ∀ E ∈ S, Bal E) : Bal S.sum
proof:
:= by
  revert h
  refine Multiset.induction_on S (fun _ => by simpa using bal_zero) ?_
  intro a s ih h
  rw [Multiset.sum_cons]
  exact bal_add (h a (Multiset.mem_cons_self _ _))
    (ih fun E hE => h E (Multiset.mem_cons_of_mem hE))

name: bal_pair
statement: theorem bal_pair (x y : Point) : Bal ({(x, y)} + {(y, x)})
proof:
:= by
  unfold Bal
  rw [Multiset.map_add, Multiset.map_singleton, Multiset.map_singleton]
  show {(x, y)} + {(y, x)} = {(y, x)} + {(x, y)}
  exact add_comm _ _

name: bal_finsetSum
statement:
theorem bal_finsetSum {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι]
    {E : ι → Multiset (Point × Point)} (h : ∀ i, Bal (E i)) :
    Bal (∑ i, E i)
proof:
:= by
  rw [Finset.sum_eq_multiset_sum]
  refine bal_sum fun X hX => ?_
  obtain ⟨i, -, rfl⟩ := Multiset.mem_map.mp hX
  exact h i

name: edgeMultiset_append
statement:
theorem edgeMultiset_append (X Y : Mesh) :
    edgeMultiset (X ++ Y) = edgeMultiset X + edgeMultiset Y
proof:
:= by
  unfold CSG.edgeMultiset
  rw [Array.toList_append, List.flatMap_append]
  exact (Multiset.coe_add _ _).symm

name: edgeMultiset_empty
statement: theorem edgeMultiset_empty : edgeMultiset #[] = 0
proof: := rfl

name: edgeMultiset_flatMap
statement:
theorem edgeMultiset_flatMap {α : Type*} (A : Array α) (F : α → Array Triangle) :
    edgeMultiset (A.flatMap F) = (A.toList.map fun a => edgeMultiset (F a)).sum
proof:
:= by
  show edgeMultiset (A.foldl (fun bs a => bs ++ F a) #[]) = _
  rw [← Array.foldl_toList]
  suffices h : ∀ (l : List α) (init : Mesh),
      edgeMultiset (l.foldl (fun bs a => bs ++ F a) init)
        = edgeMultiset init + (l.map fun a => edgeMultiset (F a)).sum by
    simpa [edgeMultiset_empty] using h A.toList #[]
  intro l
  induction l with
  | nil => intro init; simp
  | cons a l ih =>
    intro init
    rw [List.foldl_cons, ih, edgeMultiset_append, List.map_cons, List.sum_cons,
      add_assoc]

name: bal_iff_mu
statement:
theorem bal_iff_mu {D : Multiset (Point × Point)} :
    Bal D ↔ ∀ x y : Point, mu D x y = 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [bal_iff_count]
  constructor
  · intro h x y
    simp [mu, h x y]
  · intro h a b
    have := h a b
    simp only [mu, sub_eq_zero] at this
    exact_mod_cast this

name: fst_mem_verts
statement:
theorem fst_mem_verts {D : Multiset (Point × Point)} {e : Point × Point}
    (he : e ∈ D) : e.1 ∈ verts D
proof:
:=
  Multiset.mem_add.mpr (Or.inl (Multiset.mem_map_of_mem _ he))

name: snd_mem_verts
statement:
theorem snd_mem_verts {D : Multiset (Point × Point)} {e : Point × Point}
    (he : e ∈ D) : e.2 ∈ verts D
proof:
:=
  Multiset.mem_add.mpr (Or.inr (Multiset.mem_map_of_mem _ he))

name: mem_line_of_mem_segment
statement:
theorem mem_line_of_mem_segment {a b z : Point} (h : z ∈ segment ℚ a b) :
    z ∈ line[ℚ, a, b]
proof:
:= by
  rw [segment_eq_image_lineMap] at h
  obtain ⟨t, -, rfl⟩ := h
  exact AffineMap.lineMap_mem_affineSpan_pair t a b

name: exists_lineMap_eq
statement:
theorem exists_lineMap_eq {a b p : Point} (h : p ∈ line[ℚ, a, b]) :
    ∃ t : ℚ, AffineMap.lineMap (k := ℚ) a b t = p
proof:
:= by
  have h' : (p -ᵥ a) +ᵥ a ∈ line[ℚ, a, b] := by rwa [vsub_vadd]
  obtain ⟨r, hr⟩ := vadd_left_mem_affineSpan_pair.mp h'
  exact ⟨r, by rw [AffineMap.lineMap_apply, hr, vsub_vadd]⟩

name: ioo_endpoints
statement:
theorem ioo_endpoints {c d t : ℚ}
    (ht1 : t ∈ Ioo (0 : ℚ) 1) (ht2 : t ∈ Ioo c d)
    (hc : c ∉ Ioo (0 : ℚ) 1) (hd : d ∉ Ioo (0 : ℚ) 1)
    (h0 : (0 : ℚ) ∉ Ioo c d) (h1 : (1 : ℚ) ∉ Ioo c d) : c = 0 ∧ d = 1
proof:
:= by
  simp only [Set.mem_Ioo, not_and, not_lt] at ht1 ht2 hc hd h0 h1
  obtain ⟨ht0, ht1'⟩ := ht1
  obtain ⟨htc, htd⟩ := ht2
  have hc0 : c = 0 := by
    rcases lt_trichotomy c 0 with h | h | h
    · have := h0 h; linarith
    · exact h
    · have := hc h; linarith
  refine ⟨hc0, ?_⟩
  rcases lt_trichotomy d 1 with h | h | h
  · have := hd (by linarith); linarith
  · exact h
  · have := h1 (by linarith); linarith

name: collinear_overlap_dichotomy
statement:
theorem collinear_overlap_dichotomy {p₁ q₁ p₂ q₂ : Point}
    (hne₁ : p₁ ≠ q₁) (hne₂ : p₂ ≠ q₂)
    (hcol : Collinear ℚ ({p₁, q₁, p₂, q₂} : Set Point))
    (hover : (openSegment ℚ p₁ q₁ ∩ openSegment ℚ p₂ q₂).Nonempty)
    (hs₁ : p₂ ∉ openSegment ℚ p₁ q₁) (hs₂ : q₂ ∉ openSegment ℚ p₁ q₁)
    (hs₃ : p₁ ∉ openSegment ℚ p₂ q₂) (hs₄ : q₁ ∉ openSegment ℚ p₂ q₂) :
    (p₂ = p₁ ∧ q₂ = q₁) ∨ (p₂ = q₁ ∧ q₂ = p₁)
proof:
:= by
  set L : ℚ →ᵃ[ℚ] Point := AffineMap.lineMap p₁ q₁ with hL
  have hinj : Function.Injective L := AffineMap.lineMap_injective ℚ hne₁
  
  obtain ⟨c, hc⟩ := exists_lineMap_eq
    (hcol.mem_affineSpan_of_mem_of_ne (by simp) (by simp) (by simp) hne₁ :
      p₂ ∈ line[ℚ, p₁, q₁])
  obtain ⟨d, hd⟩ := exists_lineMap_eq
    (hcol.mem_affineSpan_of_mem_of_ne (by simp) (by simp) (by simp) hne₁ :
      q₂ ∈ line[ℚ, p₁, q₁])
  have hcd : c ≠ d := fun h => hne₂ (by rw [← hc, ← hd, h])
  
  have h1 : openSegment ℚ p₁ q₁ = L '' Ioo (0 : ℚ) 1 :=
    openSegment_eq_image_lineMap ℚ p₁ q₁
  have h2 : openSegment ℚ p₂ q₂ = L '' openSegment ℚ c d := by
    rw [← hc, ← hd, image_openSegment]
  
  obtain ⟨z, hz₁, hz₂⟩ := hover
  rw [h1] at hz₁
  obtain ⟨t, ht, rfl⟩ := hz₁
  rw [h2] at hz₂
  obtain ⟨t', ht', het⟩ := hz₂
  rw [hinj het] at ht'
  
  have hC : c ∉ Ioo (0 : ℚ) 1 := fun h => hs₁ (h1 ▸ ⟨c, h, hc⟩)
  have hD : d ∉ Ioo (0 : ℚ) 1 := fun h => hs₂ (h1 ▸ ⟨d, h, hd⟩)
  have h0 : (0 : ℚ) ∉ openSegment ℚ c d := fun h =>
    hs₃ (h2 ▸ ⟨0, h, AffineMap.lineMap_apply_zero p₁ q₁⟩)
  have h1' : (1 : ℚ) ∉ openSegment ℚ c d := fun h =>
    hs₄ (h2 ▸ ⟨1, h, AffineMap.lineMap_apply_one p₁ q₁⟩)
  
  rcases hcd.lt_or_lt with hlt | hlt
  · rw [openSegment_eq_Ioo hlt] at ht' h0 h1'
    obtain ⟨hc0, hd1⟩ := ioo_endpoints ht ht' hC hD h0 h1'
    exact Or.inl ⟨by rw [← hc, hc0]; exact AffineMap.lineMap_apply_zero p₁ q₁,
      by rw [← hd, hd1]; exact AffineMap.lineMap_apply_one p₁ q₁⟩
  · rw [openSegment_symm, openSegment_eq_Ioo hlt] at ht' h0 h1'
    obtain ⟨hd0, hc1⟩ := ioo_endpoints ht ht' hD hC h0 h1'
    exact Or.inr ⟨by rw [← hc, hc1]; exact AffineMap.lineMap_apply_one p₁ q₁,
      by rw [← hd, hd0]; exact AffineMap.lineMap_apply_zero p₁ q₁⟩

name: saturated_collinear_dichotomy
proof:
:=
  collinear_overlap_dichotomy (hnd e₁ h₁) (hnd e₂ h₂) hcol hover
    (hsat e₁ h₁ e₂.1 (fst_mem_verts h₂)) (hsat e₁ h₁ e₂.2 (snd_mem_verts h₂))
    (hsat e₂ h₂ e₁.1 (fst_mem_verts h₁)) (hsat e₂ h₂ e₁.2 (snd_mem_verts h₁))

name: collinear_of_forall_mem_line
statement:
theorem collinear_of_forall_mem_line {z₁ z₂ : Point} {s : Set Point}
    (h : ∀ p ∈ s, p ∈ line[ℚ, z₁, z₂]) : Collinear ℚ s
proof:
:= by
  rw [collinear_iff_exists_forall_eq_smul_vadd]
  refine ⟨z₁, z₂ -ᵥ z₁, fun p hp => ?_⟩
  have h' := h p hp
  rw [← vsub_vadd p z₁] at h'
  obtain ⟨r, hr⟩ := vadd_left_mem_affineSpan_pair.mp h'
  exact ⟨r, by rw [hr, vsub_vadd]⟩

name: bad_subsingleton
statement:
theorem bad_subsingleton {x y : Point} (e : Point × Point) :
    {z | z ∈ segment ℚ e.1 e.2 ∧ z ∈ openSegment ℚ x y ∧
      ¬Collinear ℚ ({e.1, e.2, x, y} : Set Point)}.Subsingleton
proof:
:= by
  intro z₁ hz₁ z₂ hz₂
  by_contra hne
  apply hz₁.2.2
  
  have a₁ : z₁ ∈ line[ℚ, e.1, e.2] := mem_line_of_mem_segment hz₁.1
  have a₂ : z₂ ∈ line[ℚ, e.1, e.2] := mem_line_of_mem_segment hz₂.1
  have b₁ : z₁ ∈ line[ℚ, x, y] :=
    mem_line_of_mem_segment (openSegment_subset_segment ℚ x y hz₁.2.1)
  have b₂ : z₂ ∈ line[ℚ, x, y] :=
    mem_line_of_mem_segment (openSegment_subset_segment ℚ x y hz₂.2.1)
  have hcolA : Collinear ℚ ({z₁, z₂, e.1, e.2} : Set Point) :=
    collinear_insert_insert_of_mem_affineSpan_pair a₁ a₂
  have hcolB : Collinear ℚ ({z₁, z₂, x, y} : Set Point) :=
    collinear_insert_insert_of_mem_affineSpan_pair b₁ b₂
  
  refine collinear_of_forall_mem_line (z₁ := z₁) (z₂ := z₂) ?_
  rintro p hp
  simp only [Set.mem_insert_iff, Set.mem_singleton_iff] at hp
  rcases hp with rfl | rfl | rfl | rfl
  · exact hcolA.mem_affineSpan_of_mem_of_ne (by simp) (by simp) (by simp) hne
  · exact hcolA.mem_affineSpan_of_mem_of_ne (by simp) (by simp) (by simp) hne
  · exact hcolB.mem_affineSpan_of_mem_of_ne (by simp) (by simp) (by simp) hne
  · exact hcolB.mem_affineSpan_of_mem_of_ne (by simp) (by simp) (by simp) hne

name: cover_eq_carrier
proof:
:= by
  have hxy : x ≠ y := by
    rcases hcar with h | h
    · exact hnd _ h
    · exact (hnd _ h).symm
  obtain ⟨hzo, hzv, hzc⟩ := hgen
  
  have key : ∀ e ∈ D, z ∈ segment ℚ e.1 e.2 → e = (x, y) ∨ e = (y, x) := by
    intro e he hseg
    have hz1 : e.1 ≠ z := fun h => hzv (h ▸ fst_mem_verts he)
    have hz2 : e.2 ≠ z := fun h => hzv (h ▸ snd_mem_verts he)
    have hzoe : z ∈ openSegment ℚ e.1 e.2 :=
      mem_openSegment_of_ne_left_right hz1 hz2 hseg
    rcases hcar with hc | hc
    · have hcol : Collinear ℚ ({x, y, e.1, e.2} : Set Point) :=
        (hzc e he hseg).subset (by
          intro p hp
          simp only [Set.mem_insert_iff, Set.mem_singleton_iff] at hp ⊢
          tauto)
      have := saturated_collinear_dichotomy hsat hnd hc he hcol ⟨z, hzo, hzoe⟩
      rcases this with ⟨h1, h2⟩ | ⟨h1, h2⟩
      · exact Or.inl (Prod.ext h1 h2)
      · exact Or.inr (Prod.ext h1 h2)
    · have hcol : Collinear ℚ ({y, x, e.1, e.2} : Set Point) :=
        (hzc e he hseg).subset (by
          intro p hp
          simp only [Set.mem_insert_iff, Set.mem_singleton_iff] at hp ⊢
          tauto)
      have hzo' : z ∈ openSegment ℚ y x := by rwa [openSegment_symm]
      have := saturated_collinear_dichotomy hsat hnd hc he hcol ⟨z, hzo', hzoe⟩
      rcases this with ⟨h1, h2⟩ | ⟨h1, h2⟩
      · exact Or.inr (Prod.ext h1 h2)
      · exact Or.inl (Prod.ext h1 h2)
  
  have hyx : ((y, x) : Point × Point) ≠ (x, y) := fun h => hxy (congrArg Prod.snd h)
  have hxy' : ((x, y) : Point × Point) ≠ (y, x) := fun h => hxy (congrArg Prod.fst h)
  refine Multiset.ext.mpr fun c => ?_
  rw [Multiset.count_filter, Multiset.count_add, Multiset.count_replicate,
    Multiset.count_replicate]
  by_cases hc1 : c = (x, y)
  · subst hc1
    rw [if_pos (openSegment_subset_segment ℚ x y hzo), if_pos rfl, if_neg hyx]
    exact (add_zero _).symm
  · by_cases hc2 : c = (y, x)
    · subst hc2
      rw [if_pos (by rw [segment_symm]; exact openSegment_subset_segment ℚ x y hzo),
        if_neg hxy', if_pos rfl]
      exact (zero_add _).symm
    · rw [if_neg (fun h : (x, y) = c => hc1 h.symm),
        if_neg (fun h : (y, x) = c => hc2 h.symm)]
      split_ifs with hp
      · have hmem : c ∉ D := by
          intro hm
          rcases key c hm hp with h | h
          · exact hc1 h
          · exact hc2 h
        rw [Multiset.count_eq_zero_of_not_mem hmem]
      · rfl

name: affine_root_subsingleton
proof:
:= by
  intro z₁ hz₁ z₂ hz₂
  rw [Set.mem_setOf_eq, openSegment_eq_image_lineMap] at hz₁ hz₂
  obtain ⟨⟨τ₁, hτ₁, rfl⟩, hv₁⟩ := hz₁
  obtain ⟨⟨τ₂, hτ₂, rfl⟩, hv₂⟩ := hz₂
  rw [AffineMap.apply_lineMap, AffineMap.lineMap_apply_module] at hv₁ hv₂
  simp only [smul_eq_mul] at hv₁ hv₂
  by_cases hd : φ y - φ x = 0
  · exfalso
    have hyx : φ y = φ x := by linarith
    rw [hyx] at hv₁
    have hx0 : φ x = 0 := by linear_combination hv₁
    have hy0 : φ y = 0 := by rw [hyx]; exact hx0
    rcases h with h | h
    · exact h hx0
    · exact h hy0
  · have key : (τ₁ - τ₂) * (φ y - φ x) = 0 := by linear_combination hv₁ - hv₂
    have hττ : τ₁ = τ₂ := by
      rcases mul_eq_zero.mp key with h0 | h0
      · linarith
      · exact absurd h0 hd
    rw [hττ]

name: exists_zpick
statement:
theorem exists_zpick (D : Multiset (Point × Point)) {x y : Point} (hxy : x ≠ y)
    (B : List Point) (G : List (Point →ᵃ[ℚ] ℚ)) :
    ∃ z, GenericPt D x y z ∧ (∀ b ∈ B, z ≠ b)
      ∧ ∀ φ ∈ G, (φ x ≠ 0 ∨ φ y ≠ 0) → φ z ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  have hinf : (openSegment ℚ x y).Infinite := by
    rw [openSegment_eq_image_lineMap]
    exact (Set.Ioo_infinite zero_lt_one).image
      (AffineMap.lineMap_injective ℚ hxy).injOn
  set Bad : Set Point :=
    ((↑(verts D).toFinset : Set Point)
      ∪ ⋃ e ∈ D.toFinset, {z | z ∈ segment ℚ e.1 e.2 ∧ z ∈ openSegment ℚ x y ∧
          ¬Collinear ℚ ({e.1, e.2, x, y} : Set Point)})
      ∪ ((↑B.toFinset : Set Point)
      ∪ ⋃ φ ∈ G.toFinset, {z | (φ x ≠ 0 ∨ φ y ≠ 0)
          ∧ z ∈ openSegment ℚ x y ∧ φ z = 0}) with hBad
  have hBadFin : Bad.Finite := by
    refine Set.Finite.union (Set.Finite.union (Finset.finite_toSet _)
      (Set.Finite.biUnion (Finset.finite_toSet _)
        fun e _ => (bad_subsingleton e).finite))
      (Set.Finite.union (Finset.finite_toSet _)
        (Set.Finite.biUnion (Finset.finite_toSet _) fun φ _ => ?_))
    by_cases hφ : φ x ≠ 0 ∨ φ y ≠ 0
    · exact Set.Finite.subset (affine_root_subsingleton hφ).finite
        fun z hz => ⟨hz.2.1, hz.2.2⟩
    · exact Set.Finite.subset Set.finite_empty fun z hz => absurd hz.1 hφ
  obtain ⟨z, hz⟩ := (hinf.diff hBadFin).nonempty
  refine ⟨z, ⟨hz.1, fun hv => hz.2 ?_, fun e he hseg => ?_⟩,
    fun b hb hzb => hz.2 ?_, fun φ hφG hφ hz0 => hz.2 ?_⟩
  · exact hBad ▸ Or.inl (Or.inl (by simpa using Multiset.mem_toFinset.mpr hv))
  · by_contra hncol
    exact hz.2 (hBad ▸ Or.inl (Or.inr
      (Set.mem_biUnion (Multiset.mem_toFinset.mpr he) ⟨hseg, hz.1, hncol⟩)))
  · refine hBad ▸ Or.inr (Or.inl ?_)
    rw [hzb]
    simpa using hb
  · exact hBad ▸ Or.inr (Or.inr
      (Set.mem_biUnion (List.mem_toFinset.mpr hφG) ⟨hφ, hz.1, hz0⟩))

name: resolveFragB_kept_fallback
statement:
theorem resolveFragB_kept_fallback (bvh : Impl.BVH.BVH) (fb : Frag) (opp : Array Frag) (wOpp : Array PFace)
    {f' : Frag} (hf' : f' ∈ resolveCoplanar.resolveFragB bvh fb opp wOpp) :
    keepFallback bvh wOpp f' = true
proof:
:= by
  unfold resolveCoplanar.resolveFragB at hf'
  
  have hfold :
      ∀ f' ∈ (opp.foldl (fun acc fa =>
          if !(coplanarPlane fb.plane fa.plane) then acc
          else
            acc.2.foldl (fun st piece =>
              if (Array.filter (fun p => decide (p.poly.size ≥ 3))
                    (coplanarClip piece fa).1).isEmpty = true then (st.1, st.2.push piece)
              else
                (st.1, (coplanarClip piece fa).2.foldl
                  (fun pd p => if p.poly.size ≥ 3 then pd.push p else pd) st.2))
              (acc.1, #[]))
          ((#[] : Array Frag), #[fb])).1, False := by
    refine Array.foldl_induction
      (motive := fun i (acc : Array Frag × Array Frag) => (∀ f' ∈ acc.1, False))
      (by intro f' hf'; simp at hf') ?_
    intro i acc ih
    by_cases hcop : (!(coplanarPlane fb.plane (opp[i]'i.isLt).plane)) = true
    · simp only [hcop, if_true]; exact ih
    · simp only [hcop, Bool.not_eq_true', Bool.not_eq_false] at hcop ⊢
      simp only [hcop, Bool.not_true, Bool.false_eq_true, if_false]
      refine Array.foldl_induction
        (motive := fun j (st : Array Frag × Array Frag) => (∀ f' ∈ st.1, False))
        (by exact ih) ?_
      intro j st ihst f' hf'
      
      by_cases hre : (Array.filter (fun p => decide (p.poly.size ≥ 3))
          (coplanarClip (acc.2[j]'j.isLt) (opp[i]'i.isLt)).1).isEmpty = true
      · simp only [hre, if_true] at hf'; exact ihst _ hf'
      · simp only [hre, Bool.false_eq_true, if_false] at hf'; exact ihst _ hf'
  rcases Array.mem_append.mp hf' with h | h
  · exact absurd (hfold _ h) (by simp)
  · exact (Array.mem_filter.mp h).2

name: outerFold_comp_subset
statement:
theorem outerFold_comp_subset {nt : Point} {ct : ℚ} (gs : List IPlane) (fa : Frag)
    (_hfa : FragInv nt ct fa) :
    ∀ (init : Array Frag × Array Frag),
    (∀ q ∈ init.1, FragInv nt ct q ∧ vpoly (fragCycle q) ⊆ vpoly (fragCycle fa)) →
    (∀ q ∈ init.2, vpoly (fragCycle q) ⊆ vpoly (fragCycle fa)) →
    (∀ p ∈ (gs.foldl outerStep init).2,
      vpoly (fragCycle p) ⊆ vpoly (fragCycle fa))
proof:
:= by
  induction gs with
  | nil => intro init _ hi2 p hp; exact hi2 p hp
  | cons g gs ih =>
    intro init hi1 hi2 p hp
    simp only [List.foldl_cons] at hp
    have hnew1 : ∀ q ∈ (outerStep init g).1,
        FragInv nt ct q ∧ vpoly (fragCycle q) ⊆ vpoly (fragCycle fa) := by
      intro q hq
      have hq' : q ∈ (innerFold g init.1).1 := hq
      rw [mem_innerFold_fst] at hq'
      obtain ⟨r, hr, hqr⟩ := hq'
      obtain ⟨hrinv, hrsub⟩ := hi1 r hr
      rw [mem_clipBySide_fst] at hqr
      refine ⟨fragInv_clipFrag g hrinv hqr.1, ?_⟩
      exact (clipFrag_vpoly_subset g hrinv hqr.1).trans hrsub
    have hnew2 : ∀ q ∈ (outerStep init g).2,
        vpoly (fragCycle q) ⊆ vpoly (fragCycle fa) := by
      intro q hq
      have hq' : q ∈ init.2 ++ (innerFold g init.1).2 := hq
      rw [Array.mem_append] at hq'
      rcases hq' with h | h
      · exact hi2 q h
      · rw [mem_innerFold_snd] at h
        obtain ⟨r, hr, hqr⟩ := h
        obtain ⟨hrinv, hrsub⟩ := hi1 r hr
        rw [mem_clipBySide_snd] at hqr
        exact (clipFrag_vpoly_subset g hrinv hqr.1).trans hrsub
    exact ih (outerStep init g) hnew1 hnew2 p hp

name: coplanarClip_comp_vpoly_subset
proof:
:= by
  rw [coplanarClip_eq_foldl] at hp
  refine outerFold_comp_subset (edgePlanesOf fb).toList fa hfa (#[fa], #[]) ?_ ?_ p hp
  · intro q hq
    obtain rfl : q = fa := by simpa using hq
    exact ⟨hfa, le_refl _⟩
  · intro q hq; simp at hq

name: coplanarClip_inside_vpoly_subset_fa
proof:
:= by
  rw [coplanarClip_eq_foldl] at hp
  have hinit : ∀ q ∈ (#[fa], (#[] : Array Frag)).1, FragInv nt ct q := by
    intro q hq
    obtain rfl : q = fa := by simpa using hq
    exact hfa
  obtain ⟨-, ⟨q, hq, hsub⟩, -⟩ :=
    outerFold_inside_invariant (edgePlanesOf fb).toList (#[fa], #[]) hinit p hp
  obtain rfl : q = fa := by simpa using hq
  exact hsub

name: coplanarClip_piece_vpoly_subset
proof:
:= by
  rcases hp with h | h
  · exact coplanarClip_inside_vpoly_subset_fa hfa h
  · exact coplanarClip_comp_vpoly_subset hfa h

name: pushFold_vpoly_subset
statement:
theorem pushFold_vpoly_subset {fa : Frag} {comp acc : Array Frag}
    (hcomp : ∀ f' ∈ comp, vpoly (fragCycle f') ⊆ vpoly (fragCycle fa))
    (hacc : ∀ f' ∈ acc, vpoly (fragCycle f') ⊆ vpoly (fragCycle fa)) :
    ∀ f' ∈ comp.foldl (fun pd p => if p.poly.size ≥ 3 then pd.push p else pd) acc,
      vpoly (fragCycle f') ⊆ vpoly (fragCycle fa)
proof:
:= by
  refine Array.foldl_induction
    (motive := fun _ (pd : Array Frag) =>
      ∀ f' ∈ pd, vpoly (fragCycle f') ⊆ vpoly (fragCycle fa))
    hacc ?_
  intro k pd ihpd f' hmem
  by_cases hsz : comp[k].poly.size ≥ 3
  · rw [if_pos hsz] at hmem
    rcases Array.mem_push.mp hmem with h | h
    · exact ihpd _ h
    · exact h ▸ (hcomp _ (Array.getElem_mem k.isLt))
  · rw [if_neg hsz] at hmem
    exact ihpd _ hmem

name: resolveStep_vpoly_subset
statement:
theorem resolveStep_vpoly_subset {nt : Point} {ct : ℚ} (fa fb piece : Frag)
    (sameOr : Bool)
    (hpiece : FragInv nt ct piece)
    (hps : vpoly (fragCycle piece) ⊆ vpoly (fragCycle fa))
    {st : Array Frag × Array Frag}
    (hst1 : ∀ f' ∈ st.1, vpoly (fragCycle f') ⊆ vpoly (fragCycle fa))
    (hst2 : ∀ f' ∈ st.2, vpoly (fragCycle f') ⊆ vpoly (fragCycle fa)) :
    (∀ f' ∈
        (if (Array.filter (fun p => decide (p.poly.size ≥ 3))
              (coplanarClip piece fb).1).isEmpty = true then (st.1, st.2.push piece)
         else
           (if sameOr = true then
              st.1 ++ Array.filter (fun p => decide (p.poly.size ≥ 3)) (coplanarClip piece fb).1
            else st.1,
            Array.foldl (fun pd p => if p.poly.size ≥ 3 then pd.push p else pd)
              st.2 (coplanarClip piece fb).2)).1,
      vpoly (fragCycle f') ⊆ vpoly (fragCycle fa))
    ∧ (∀ f' ∈
        (if (Array.filter (fun p => decide (p.poly.size ≥ 3))
              (coplanarClip piece fb).1).isEmpty = true then (st.1, st.2.push piece)
         else
           (if sameOr = true then
              st.1 ++ Array.filter (fun p => decide (p.poly.size ≥ 3)) (coplanarClip piece fb).1
            else st.1,
            Array.foldl (fun pd p => if p.poly.size ≥ 3 then pd.push p else pd)
              st.2 (coplanarClip piece fb).2)).2,
      vpoly (fragCycle f') ⊆ vpoly (fragCycle fa))
proof:
:= by
  
  have hcomp : ∀ q ∈ (coplanarClip piece fb).2,
      vpoly (fragCycle q) ⊆ vpoly (fragCycle fa) := fun q hq =>
    (coplanarClip_comp_vpoly_subset hpiece hq).trans hps
  
  have hov : ∀ q ∈ (coplanarClip piece fb).1,
      vpoly (fragCycle q) ⊆ vpoly (fragCycle fa) := fun q hq =>
    (coplanarClip_inside_vpoly_subset_fa hpiece hq).trans hps
  by_cases hre : (Array.filter (fun p => decide (p.poly.size ≥ 3))
      (coplanarClip piece fb).1).isEmpty = true
  · simp only [hre, if_true]
    refine ⟨hst1, fun f' hf' => ?_⟩
    rcases Array.mem_push.mp hf' with h | h
    · exact hst2 _ h
    · exact h ▸ hps
  · simp only [hre, Bool.false_eq_true, if_false]
    refine ⟨fun f' hf' => ?_, pushFold_vpoly_subset hcomp hst2⟩
    by_cases hso : sameOr = true
    · simp only [hso, if_true] at hf'
      rcases Array.mem_append.mp hf' with h | h
      · exact hst1 _ h
      · exact hov _ (Array.mem_of_mem_filter h)
    · simp only [hso, Bool.false_eq_true, if_false] at hf'
      exact hst1 _ hf'

name: resolveFrag_kept_vpoly_subset_fa
statement:
theorem resolveFrag_kept_vpoly_subset_fa {nt : Point} {ct : ℚ} (bvh : Impl.BVH.BVH) (opp : Array Frag)
    (wOpp : Array PFace) {fa : Frag} (hfa : FragInv nt ct fa)
    {f' : Frag} (hf' : f' ∈ resolveFrag bvh fa opp wOpp) :
    vpoly (fragCycle f') ⊆ vpoly (fragCycle fa)
proof:
:= by
  revert f' hf'
  unfold resolveFrag
  
  
  suffices hfold :
      (∀ f' ∈ (opp.foldl (fun acc fb =>
          if !(coplanarPlane fa.plane fb.plane) then acc
          else
            acc.2.foldl (fun st piece =>
              let (ov, comp) := coplanarClip piece fb
              let realOv := ov.filter (fun p => p.poly.size ≥ 3)
              if realOv.isEmpty then (st.1, st.2.push piece)
              else
                let kept := if sameOrient fa.plane fb.plane then st.1 ++ realOv else st.1
                let pending := comp.foldl (fun pd p =>
                  if p.poly.size ≥ 3 then pd.push p else pd) st.2
                (kept, pending)) (acc.1, #[]))
          ((#[] : Array Frag), #[fa])).1,
        FragInv nt ct f' ∧ vpoly (fragCycle f') ⊆ vpoly (fragCycle fa))
      ∧ (∀ f' ∈ (opp.foldl (fun acc fb =>
          if !(coplanarPlane fa.plane fb.plane) then acc
          else
            acc.2.foldl (fun st piece =>
              let (ov, comp) := coplanarClip piece fb
              let realOv := ov.filter (fun p => p.poly.size ≥ 3)
              if realOv.isEmpty then (st.1, st.2.push piece)
              else
                let kept := if sameOrient fa.plane fb.plane then st.1 ++ realOv else st.1
                let pending := comp.foldl (fun pd p =>
                  if p.poly.size ≥ 3 then pd.push p else pd) st.2
                (kept, pending)) (acc.1, #[]))
          ((#[] : Array Frag), #[fa])).2,
        FragInv nt ct f' ∧ vpoly (fragCycle f') ⊆ vpoly (fragCycle fa)) by
    intro f' hf'
    rcases Array.mem_append.mp hf' with h | h
    · exact (hfold.1 _ h).2
    · exact (hfold.2 _ (Array.mem_of_mem_filter h)).2
  refine Array.foldl_induction
    (motive := fun i (acc : Array Frag × Array Frag) =>
      (∀ f' ∈ acc.1, FragInv nt ct f' ∧ vpoly (fragCycle f') ⊆ vpoly (fragCycle fa))
        ∧ (∀ f' ∈ acc.2, FragInv nt ct f' ∧ vpoly (fragCycle f') ⊆ vpoly (fragCycle fa)))
    ⟨by intro f' hf'; simp at hf', by
      intro f' hf'; simp only [Array.mem_singleton] at hf'
      subst hf'; exact ⟨hfa, le_refl _⟩⟩ ?_
  intro i acc ih
  obtain ⟨ihK, ihP⟩ := ih
  by_cases hcop : (!(coplanarPlane fa.plane opp[i].plane)) = true
  · simp only [hcop, if_true]; exact ⟨ihK, ihP⟩
  · simp only [hcop, Bool.not_eq_true', Bool.not_eq_false] at hcop ⊢
    simp only [hcop, Bool.not_true, Bool.false_eq_true, if_false]
    refine Array.foldl_induction
      (motive := fun j (st : Array Frag × Array Frag) =>
        (∀ f' ∈ st.1, FragInv nt ct f' ∧ vpoly (fragCycle f') ⊆ vpoly (fragCycle fa))
          ∧ (∀ f' ∈ st.2, FragInv nt ct f' ∧ vpoly (fragCycle f') ⊆ vpoly (fragCycle fa)))
      (init := (acc.1, #[])) ⟨ihK, by intro f' hf'; simp at hf'⟩ ?_
    intro j st ihst
    obtain ⟨hst1, hst2⟩ := ihst
    obtain ⟨hpieceInv, hpieceSub⟩ := ihP _ (Array.getElem_mem j.isLt)
    set piece := acc.2[j] with hpd
    
    have hstep := resolveStep_vpoly_subset fa opp[i] piece
      (sameOrient fa.plane opp[i].plane) hpieceInv hpieceSub
      (fun f' hf' => (hst1 f' hf').2)
      (fun f' hf' => (hst2 f' hf').2)
    
    have hstepInv := Proof.MeshIntersectNpo.resolveStep_fragInv
      (nt := nt) (ct := ct) opp[i] piece
      (sameOrient fa.plane opp[i].plane) hpieceInv
      (fun f' hf' => (hst1 f' hf').1)
      (fun f' hf' => (hst2 f' hf').1)
    exact ⟨fun f' hf' => ⟨hstepInv.1 _ hf', hstep.1 _ hf'⟩,
      fun f' hf' => ⟨hstepInv.2 _ hf', hstep.2 _ hf'⟩⟩

name: resolveStep_overlap_opp_subset
statement:
theorem resolveStep_overlap_opp_subset {nt : Point} {ct : ℚ} (fa : Frag)
    (opp : Array Frag) {fb piece : Frag} (sameOr : Bool)
    {n' : Point} {c' : ℚ}
    (hpieceInv : FragInv nt ct piece) (hfbInv : FragInv n' c' fb)
    (hplPiece : Proof.MeshIntersectClip.OnPlane n' c' (fragCycle piece))
    (hfbMem : fb ∈ opp) (hcop : coplanarPlane fa.plane fb.plane = true)
    {st : Array Frag × Array Frag}
    (hst1 : ∀ f' ∈ st.1, OverlapOppSubset fa opp f')
    (hst2 : ∀ f' ∈ st.2, FragInv nt ct f') :
    (∀ f' ∈
        (if (Array.filter (fun p => decide (p.poly.size ≥ 3))
              (coplanarClip piece fb).1).isEmpty = true then (st.1, st.2.push piece)
         else
           (if sameOr = true then
              st.1 ++ Array.filter (fun p => decide (p.poly.size ≥ 3)) (coplanarClip piece fb).1
            else st.1,
            Array.foldl (fun pd p => if p.poly.size ≥ 3 then pd.push p else pd)
              st.2 (coplanarClip piece fb).2)).1,
      OverlapOppSubset fa opp f')
    ∧ (∀ f' ∈
        (if (Array.filter (fun p => decide (p.poly.size ≥ 3))
              (coplanarClip piece fb).1).isEmpty = true then (st.1, st.2.push piece)
         else
           (if sameOr = true then
              st.1 ++ Array.filter (fun p => decide (p.poly.size ≥ 3)) (coplanarClip piece fb).1
            else st.1,
            Array.foldl (fun pd p => if p.poly.size ≥ 3 then pd.push p else pd)
              st.2 (coplanarClip piece fb).2)).2,
      FragInv nt ct f')
proof:
:= by
  
  have hov : ∀ q ∈ (coplanarClip piece fb).1,
      OverlapOppSubset fa opp q := fun q hq =>
    ⟨fb, hfbMem, hcop,
      coplanarClip_inside_vpoly_subset_fb_free hpieceInv hfbInv hplPiece hq⟩
  
  obtain ⟨_, hcomp⟩ := Proof.MeshIntersectNpo.coplanarClip_fragInv
    (nt := nt) (ct := ct) fb hpieceInv
  by_cases hre : (Array.filter (fun p => decide (p.poly.size ≥ 3))
      (coplanarClip piece fb).1).isEmpty = true
  · simp only [hre, if_true]
    refine ⟨hst1, fun f' hf' => ?_⟩
    rcases Array.mem_push.mp hf' with h | h
    · exact hst2 _ h
    · exact h ▸ hpieceInv
  · simp only [hre, Bool.false_eq_true, if_false]
    refine ⟨fun f' hf' => ?_, ?_⟩
    · by_cases hso : sameOr = true
      · simp only [hso, if_true] at hf'
        rcases Array.mem_append.mp hf' with h | h
        · exact hst1 _ h
        · exact hov _ (Array.mem_of_mem_filter h)
      · simp only [hso, Bool.false_eq_true, if_false] at hf'
        exact hst1 _ hf'
    · 
      exact Proof.MeshIntersectNpo.pushFold_fragInv (nt := nt) (ct := ct) hcomp hst2

name: resolveFrag_kept_descent
statement:
theorem resolveFrag_kept_descent {nt : Point} {ct : ℚ} (opp : Array Frag)
    {fa : Frag} (hfa : FragInv nt ct fa)
    (hoppInv : ∀ fb ∈ opp, ∃ n' c', FragInv n' c' fb
      ∧ (coplanarPlane fa.plane fb.plane = true →
          ∃ ρ : ℚ, ρ ≠ 0 ∧ n' = ρ • nt ∧ c' = ρ * ct))
    {f : Frag} (hf : f ∈ resolveFragKept fa opp) :
    OverlapOppSubset fa opp f
proof:
:= by
  rw [resolveFragKept] at hf
  refine And.left (Array.foldl_induction
    (motive := fun i (acc : Array Frag × Array Frag) =>
      (∀ f' ∈ acc.1, OverlapOppSubset fa opp f')
        ∧ (∀ f' ∈ acc.2, FragInv nt ct f'))
    ⟨by intro f' hf'; simp at hf', by
      intro f' hf'; simp only [Array.mem_singleton] at hf'
      subst hf'; exact hfa⟩ ?_) f hf
  intro i acc ih
  obtain ⟨ihK, ihP⟩ := ih
  by_cases hcop : (!(coplanarPlane fa.plane opp[i].plane)) = true
  · simp only [hcop, if_true]; exact ⟨ihK, ihP⟩
  · 
    have hcopT : coplanarPlane fa.plane opp[i].plane = true := by
      simpa using hcop
    simp only [hcop, Bool.not_eq_true', Bool.not_eq_false] at hcop ⊢
    simp only [hcop, Bool.not_true, Bool.false_eq_true, if_false]
    
    obtain ⟨n', c', hfbInv, hfbProp⟩ := hoppInv opp[i] (Array.getElem_mem i.isLt)
    obtain ⟨ρ, hρ, hn', hc'⟩ := hfbProp hcopT
    refine Array.foldl_induction
      (motive := fun j (st : Array Frag × Array Frag) =>
        (∀ f' ∈ st.1, OverlapOppSubset fa opp f')
          ∧ (∀ f' ∈ st.2, FragInv nt ct f'))
      (init := (acc.1, #[])) ⟨ihK, by intro f' hf'; simp at hf'⟩ ?_
    intro j st ihst
    obtain ⟨hst1, hst2⟩ := ihst
    have hpieceInv : FragInv nt ct acc.2[j] := ihP _ (Array.getElem_mem j.isLt)
    set piece := acc.2[j] with hpd
    
    have hplPiece : Proof.MeshIntersectClip.OnPlane n' c' (fragCycle piece) := by
      rw [hn', hc']; exact onPlane_smul hpieceInv.onPlane
    exact resolveStep_overlap_opp_subset fa opp
      (sameOrient fa.plane opp[i].plane) hpieceInv hfbInv hplPiece
      (Array.getElem_mem i.isLt) hcopT hst1 hst2

name: resolveStep_sameOrient_opp_subset
statement:
theorem resolveStep_sameOrient_opp_subset {nt : Point} {ct : ℚ} (fa : Frag)
    (opp : Array Frag) {fb piece : Frag} (sameOr : Bool)
    {n' : Point} {c' : ℚ}
    (hpieceInv : FragInv nt ct piece) (hfbInv : FragInv n' c' fb)
    (hplPiece : Proof.MeshIntersectClip.OnPlane n' c' (fragCycle piece))
    (hfbMem : fb ∈ opp) (hsoEq : sameOr = sameOrient fa.plane fb.plane)
    {st : Array Frag × Array Frag}
    (hst1 : ∀ f' ∈ st.1, KeptOppSameOrient fa opp f')
    (hst2 : ∀ f' ∈ st.2, FragInv nt ct f') :
    (∀ f' ∈
        (if (Array.filter (fun p => decide (p.poly.size ≥ 3))
              (coplanarClip piece fb).1).isEmpty = true then (st.1, st.2.push piece)
         else
           (if sameOr = true then
              st.1 ++ Array.filter (fun p => decide (p.poly.size ≥ 3)) (coplanarClip piece fb).1
            else st.1,
            Array.foldl (fun pd p => if p.poly.size ≥ 3 then pd.push p else pd)
              st.2 (coplanarClip piece fb).2)).1,
      KeptOppSameOrient fa opp f')
    ∧ (∀ f' ∈
        (if (Array.filter (fun p => decide (p.poly.size ≥ 3))
              (coplanarClip piece fb).1).isEmpty = true then (st.1, st.2.push piece)
         else
           (if sameOr = true then
              st.1 ++ Array.filter (fun p => decide (p.poly.size ≥ 3)) (coplanarClip piece fb).1
            else st.1,
            Array.foldl (fun pd p => if p.poly.size ≥ 3 then pd.push p else pd)
              st.2 (coplanarClip piece fb).2)).2,
      FragInv nt ct f')
proof:
:= by
  
  obtain ⟨_, hcomp⟩ := Proof.MeshIntersectNpo.coplanarClip_fragInv
    (nt := nt) (ct := ct) fb hpieceInv
  by_cases hre : (Array.filter (fun p => decide (p.poly.size ≥ 3))
      (coplanarClip piece fb).1).isEmpty = true
  · simp only [hre, if_true]
    refine ⟨hst1, fun f' hf' => ?_⟩
    rcases Array.mem_push.mp hf' with h | h
    · exact hst2 _ h
    · exact h ▸ hpieceInv
  · simp only [hre, Bool.false_eq_true, if_false]
    refine ⟨fun f' hf' => ?_, ?_⟩
    · by_cases hso : sameOr = true
      · 
        have hsoT : sameOrient fa.plane fb.plane = true := by rw [← hsoEq]; exact hso
        
        have hov : ∀ q ∈ (coplanarClip piece fb).1,
            KeptOppSameOrient fa opp q := fun q hq =>
          ⟨fb, hfbMem, hsoT,
            coplanarClip_inside_vpoly_subset_fb_free hpieceInv hfbInv hplPiece hq⟩
        simp only [hso, if_true] at hf'
        rcases Array.mem_append.mp hf' with h | h
        · exact hst1 _ h
        · exact hov _ (Array.mem_of_mem_filter h)
      · simp only [hso, Bool.false_eq_true, if_false] at hf'
        exact hst1 _ hf'
    · 
      exact Proof.MeshIntersectNpo.pushFold_fragInv (nt := nt) (ct := ct) hcomp hst2

name: SameOrientOppSubset
statement:
theorem SameOrientOppSubset {nt : Point} {ct : ℚ} (opp : Array Frag)
    {fa : Frag} (hfa : FragInv nt ct fa)
    (hoppInv : ∀ fb ∈ opp, ∃ n' c', FragInv n' c' fb
      ∧ (coplanarPlane fa.plane fb.plane = true →
          ∃ ρ : ℚ, ρ ≠ 0 ∧ n' = ρ • nt ∧ c' = ρ * ct))
    {f : Frag} (hf : f ∈ resolveFragKept fa opp) :
    ∃ fb ∈ opp, sameOrient fa.plane fb.plane = true
      ∧ vpoly (fragCycle f) ⊆ vpoly (fragCycle fb)
proof:
:= by
  rw [resolveFragKept] at hf
  refine And.left (Array.foldl_induction
    (motive := fun i (acc : Array Frag × Array Frag) =>
      (∀ f' ∈ acc.1, KeptOppSameOrient fa opp f')
        ∧ (∀ f' ∈ acc.2, FragInv nt ct f'))
    ⟨by intro f' hf'; simp at hf', by
      intro f' hf'; simp only [Array.mem_singleton] at hf'
      subst hf'; exact hfa⟩ ?_) f hf
  intro i acc ih
  obtain ⟨ihK, ihP⟩ := ih
  by_cases hcop : (!(coplanarPlane fa.plane opp[i].plane)) = true
  · simp only [hcop, if_true]; exact ⟨ihK, ihP⟩
  · 
    have hcopT : coplanarPlane fa.plane opp[i].plane = true := by
      simpa using hcop
    simp only [hcop, Bool.not_eq_true', Bool.not_eq_false] at hcop ⊢
    simp only [hcop, Bool.not_true, Bool.false_eq_true, if_false]
    
    obtain ⟨n', c', hfbInv, hfbProp⟩ := hoppInv opp[i] (Array.getElem_mem i.isLt)
    obtain ⟨ρ, hρ, hn', hc'⟩ := hfbProp hcopT
    refine Array.foldl_induction
      (motive := fun j (st : Array Frag × Array Frag) =>
        (∀ f' ∈ st.1, KeptOppSameOrient fa opp f')
          ∧ (∀ f' ∈ st.2, FragInv nt ct f'))
      (init := (acc.1, #[])) ⟨ihK, by intro f' hf'; simp at hf'⟩ ?_
    intro j st ihst
    obtain ⟨hst1, hst2⟩ := ihst
    have hpieceInv : FragInv nt ct acc.2[j] := ihP _ (Array.getElem_mem j.isLt)
    set piece := acc.2[j] with hpd
    
    have hplPiece : Proof.MeshIntersectClip.OnPlane n' c' (fragCycle piece) := by
      rw [hn', hc']; exact onPlane_smul hpieceInv.onPlane
    exact resolveStep_sameOrient_opp_subset fa opp
      (sameOrient fa.plane opp[i].plane) hpieceInv hfbInv hplPiece
      (Array.getElem_mem i.isLt) rfl hst1 hst2

name: resolveStepB_vpoly_subset
statement:
theorem resolveStepB_vpoly_subset {nt : Point} {ct : ℚ} (fa piece : Frag)
    (hpiece : FragInv nt ct piece) {fb : Frag}
    (hps : vpoly (fragCycle piece) ⊆ vpoly (fragCycle fb))
    {st : Array Frag × Array Frag}
    (hst2 : ∀ f' ∈ st.2, vpoly (fragCycle f') ⊆ vpoly (fragCycle fb)) :
    ∀ f' ∈
        (if (Array.filter (fun p => decide (p.poly.size ≥ 3))
              (coplanarClip piece fa).1).isEmpty = true then (st.1, st.2.push piece)
         else
           (st.1,
            Array.foldl (fun pd p => if p.poly.size ≥ 3 then pd.push p else pd)
              st.2 (coplanarClip piece fa).2)).2,
      vpoly (fragCycle f') ⊆ vpoly (fragCycle fb)
proof:
:= by
  have hcomp : ∀ q ∈ (coplanarClip piece fa).2,
      vpoly (fragCycle q) ⊆ vpoly (fragCycle fb) := fun q hq =>
    (coplanarClip_comp_vpoly_subset hpiece hq).trans hps
  by_cases hre : (Array.filter (fun p => decide (p.poly.size ≥ 3))
      (coplanarClip piece fa).1).isEmpty = true
  · simp only [hre, if_true]
    intro f' hf'
    rcases Array.mem_push.mp hf' with h | h
    · exact hst2 _ h
    · exact h ▸ hps
  · simp only [hre, Bool.false_eq_true, if_false]
    exact pushFold_vpoly_subset hcomp hst2

name: resolveFragB_kept_vpoly_subset_fb
statement:
theorem resolveFragB_kept_vpoly_subset_fb {nt : Point} {ct : ℚ} (bvh : Impl.BVH.BVH) (opp : Array Frag)
    (wOpp : Array PFace) {fb : Frag} (hfb : FragInv nt ct fb)
    {f' : Frag} (hf' : f' ∈ resolveCoplanar.resolveFragB bvh fb opp wOpp) :
    vpoly (fragCycle f') ⊆ vpoly (fragCycle fb)
proof:
:= by
  revert f' hf'
  unfold resolveCoplanar.resolveFragB
  suffices hfold :
      (∀ f' ∈ (opp.foldl (fun acc fa =>
          if !(coplanarPlane fb.plane fa.plane) then acc
          else
            acc.2.foldl (fun st piece =>
              if (Array.filter (fun p => decide (p.poly.size ≥ 3))
                    (coplanarClip piece fa).1).isEmpty = true then (st.1, st.2.push piece)
              else
                (st.1, (coplanarClip piece fa).2.foldl
                  (fun pd p => if p.poly.size ≥ 3 then pd.push p else pd) st.2))
              (acc.1, #[]))
          ((#[] : Array Frag), #[fb])).1,
        FragInv nt ct f' ∧ vpoly (fragCycle f') ⊆ vpoly (fragCycle fb))
      ∧ (∀ f' ∈ (opp.foldl (fun acc fa =>
          if !(coplanarPlane fb.plane fa.plane) then acc
          else
            acc.2.foldl (fun st piece =>
              if (Array.filter (fun p => decide (p.poly.size ≥ 3))
                    (coplanarClip piece fa).1).isEmpty = true then (st.1, st.2.push piece)
              else
                (st.1, (coplanarClip piece fa).2.foldl
                  (fun pd p => if p.poly.size ≥ 3 then pd.push p else pd) st.2))
              (acc.1, #[]))
          ((#[] : Array Frag), #[fb])).2,
        FragInv nt ct f' ∧ vpoly (fragCycle f') ⊆ vpoly (fragCycle fb)) by
    intro f' hf'
    rcases Array.mem_append.mp hf' with h | h
    · exact (hfold.1 _ h).2
    · exact (hfold.2 _ (Array.mem_of_mem_filter h)).2
  refine Array.foldl_induction
    (motive := fun i (acc : Array Frag × Array Frag) =>
      (∀ f' ∈ acc.1, FragInv nt ct f' ∧ vpoly (fragCycle f') ⊆ vpoly (fragCycle fb))
        ∧ (∀ f' ∈ acc.2, FragInv nt ct f' ∧ vpoly (fragCycle f') ⊆ vpoly (fragCycle fb)))
    ⟨by intro f' hf'; simp at hf', by
      intro f' hf'; simp only [Array.mem_singleton] at hf'
      subst hf'; exact ⟨hfb, le_refl _⟩⟩ ?_
  intro i acc ih
  obtain ⟨ihK, ihP⟩ := ih
  by_cases hcop : (!(coplanarPlane fb.plane (opp[i]'i.isLt).plane)) = true
  · simp only [hcop, if_true]; exact ⟨ihK, ihP⟩
  · simp only [hcop, Bool.not_eq_true', Bool.not_eq_false] at hcop ⊢
    simp only [hcop, Bool.not_true, Bool.false_eq_true, if_false]
    refine Array.foldl_induction
      (motive := fun j (st : Array Frag × Array Frag) =>
        (∀ f' ∈ st.1, FragInv nt ct f' ∧ vpoly (fragCycle f') ⊆ vpoly (fragCycle fb))
          ∧ (∀ f' ∈ st.2, FragInv nt ct f' ∧ vpoly (fragCycle f') ⊆ vpoly (fragCycle fb)))
      (init := (acc.1, #[])) ⟨ihK, by intro f' hf'; simp at hf'⟩ ?_
    intro j st ihst
    obtain ⟨hst1, hst2⟩ := ihst
    obtain ⟨hpieceInv, hpieceSub⟩ := ihP _ (Array.getElem_mem j.isLt)
    set piece := acc.2[j]'j.isLt with hpd
    have hstep := resolveStepB_vpoly_subset (opp[i]'i.isLt) piece hpieceInv hpieceSub
      (fun f' hf' => (hst2 f' hf').2)
    have hstepInv := Proof.MeshIntersectNpo.resolveStepB_fragInv
      (nt := nt) (ct := ct) (opp[i]'i.isLt) piece hpieceInv
      (fun f' hf' => (hst1 f' hf').1)
      (fun f' hf' => (hst2 f' hf').1)
    refine ⟨?_, fun f' hf' => ⟨hstepInv.2 _ hf', hstep _ hf'⟩⟩
    
    intro f' hf'
    have : f' ∈ st.1 := by
      by_cases hre : (Array.filter (fun p => decide (p.poly.size ≥ 3))
          (coplanarClip piece (opp[i]'i.isLt)).1).isEmpty = true
      · simpa only [hre, if_true] using hf'
      · simpa only [hre, Bool.false_eq_true, if_false] using hf'
    exact hst1 _ this

name: pairwise_relDisj_flatMap
statement:
theorem pairwise_relDisj_flatMap {L : List Frag} {ref : Frag → List Frag}
    (hpw : L.Pairwise RelDisj)
    (hin : ∀ q ∈ L, ∀ p ∈ ref q, vrelint (fragCycle p) ⊆ vrelint (fragCycle q))
    (href : ∀ q ∈ L, (ref q).Pairwise RelDisj) :
    (L.flatMap ref).Pairwise RelDisj
proof:
:= by
  induction L with
  | nil => simp
  | cons a L ih =>
    rw [List.flatMap_cons, List.pairwise_append]
    refine ⟨href a (List.mem_cons_self _ _), ?_, ?_⟩
    · 
      refine ih (List.Pairwise.of_cons hpw) ?_ ?_
      · exact fun q hq p hp => hin q (List.mem_cons_of_mem _ hq) p hp
      · exact fun q hq => href q (List.mem_cons_of_mem _ hq)
    · 
      intro p hp r hr
      rw [List.mem_flatMap] at hr
      obtain ⟨q, hqL, hrq⟩ := hr
      
      have haq : RelDisj a q := (List.pairwise_cons.mp hpw).1 q hqL
      
      have hpa := hin a (List.mem_cons_self _ _) p hp
      have hrq' := hin q (List.mem_cons_of_mem _ hqL) r hrq
      rw [RelDisj, Set.eq_empty_iff_forall_not_mem]
      rintro x ⟨hx1, hx2⟩
      rw [RelDisj, Set.eq_empty_iff_forall_not_mem] at haq
      exact haq x ⟨hpa hx1, hrq' hx2⟩

name: clipBySide_mem_clipFrag
proof:
:= by

  · exact (mem_clipBySide_fst gpl q p |>.mp h).1

name: perm_move_left
statement:
private theorem perm_move_left (A B l : List Frag) (a : Frag) :
    ((A ++ [a]) ++ B ++ l).Perm (A ++ B ++ (a :: l))
proof:
:= by
  have h : (A ++ [a] ++ B).Perm (A ++ B ++ [a]) := by
    simp only [List.append_assoc]; exact List.Perm.append_left A List.perm_append_comm
  have h2 : (A ++ [a] ++ B ++ l).Perm (A ++ B ++ [a] ++ l) := h.append_right l
  have h3 : A ++ B ++ [a] ++ l = A ++ B ++ (a :: l) := by simp
  rw [← h3]; exact h2

name: perm_move_right
statement:
private theorem perm_move_right (A B l : List Frag) (a : Frag) :
    (A ++ (B ++ [a]) ++ l).Perm (A ++ B ++ (a :: l))
proof:
:= by
  simp only [List.append_assoc]
  refine List.Perm.append_left A ?_
  refine List.Perm.append_left B ?_
  simp

name: sideSplit_foldl_perm
statement:
theorem sideSplit_foldl_perm (g : IPlane) (l : List Frag) :
    ∀ acc : Array Frag × Array Frag,
      ((l.foldl (sideSplit g) acc).1.toList ++ (l.foldl (sideSplit g) acc).2.toList).Perm
        (acc.1.toList ++ acc.2.toList ++ l)
proof:
:= by
  induction l with
  | nil => intro acc; simp
  | cons a l ih =>
    intro acc
    simp only [List.foldl_cons]
    cases hsa : sideOf g a with
    | true =>
      have hstep : sideSplit g acc a = (acc.1.push a, acc.2) := by simp [sideSplit, hsa]
      rw [hstep]
      refine (ih (acc.1.push a, acc.2)).trans ?_
      simp only [Array.push_toList]
      exact perm_move_left acc.1.toList acc.2.toList l a
    | false =>
      have hstep : sideSplit g acc a = (acc.1, acc.2.push a) := by simp [sideSplit, hsa]
      rw [hstep]
      refine (ih (acc.1, acc.2.push a)).trans ?_
      simp only [Array.push_toList]
      exact perm_move_right acc.1.toList acc.2.toList l a

name: clipBySide_combined_perm
statement:
theorem clipBySide_combined_perm (g : IPlane) (q : Frag) :
    ((clipBySide g q).1.toList ++ (clipBySide g q).2.toList).Perm
      (clipFrag g q).toList
proof:
:= by
  rw [clipBySide_eq_foldl]
  refine (sideSplit_foldl_perm g (clipFrag g q).toList (#[], #[])).trans ?_
  simp

name: clipBySide_combined_pairwise
proof:
:=
  (List.Perm.pairwise_iff (fun h => h.symm) (clipBySide_combined_perm g q)).mpr

name: innerStep_foldl_perm
statement:
theorem innerStep_foldl_perm (g : IPlane) (l : List Frag) :
    ∀ acc : Array Frag × Array Frag,
      ((l.foldl (innerStep g) acc).1.toList ++ (l.foldl (innerStep g) acc).2.toList).Perm
        (acc.1.toList ++ acc.2.toList ++ l.flatMap (cbCombined g))
proof:
:= by
  induction l with
  | nil => intro acc; simp
  | cons a l ih =>
    intro acc
    simp only [List.foldl_cons, List.flatMap_cons]
    refine (ih (innerStep g acc a)).trans ?_
    simp only [innerStep, Array.toList_append]
    
    rw [cbCombined]
    generalize (clipBySide g a).1.toList = c1
    generalize (clipBySide g a).2.toList = c2
    generalize l.flatMap (cbCombined g) = F
    
    refine List.perm_iff_count.mpr (fun x => ?_)
    simp only [List.count_append]; ring

name: innerStep_perm_init
statement:
theorem innerStep_perm_init (g : IPlane) (inside : Array Frag) :

name: coplanarClip_combined_pairwise
proof:
:= by
  rw [coplanarClip_eq_foldl]
  
  suffices H : ∀ (init : Array Frag × Array Frag),
      (∀ q ∈ init.1, FragInv nt ct q) → (∀ q ∈ init.2, FragInv nt ct q) →
      (init.1.toList ++ init.2.toList).Pairwise RelDisj →
      (∀ q ∈ ((edgePlanesOf fb).toList.foldl outerStep init).1, FragInv nt ct q)
        ∧ (((edgePlanesOf fb).toList.foldl outerStep init).1.toList
            ++ ((edgePlanesOf fb).toList.foldl outerStep init).2.toList).Pairwise RelDisj by
    refine (H (#[fa], #[]) (fun q hq => ?_) (by intro q hq; simp at hq) (by simp)).2
    obtain rfl : q = fa := by simpa using hq
    exact hfa
  intro init
  induction (edgePlanesOf fb).toList generalizing init with
  | nil => intro hi1 _ hpw; exact ⟨hi1, hpw⟩
  | cons g gs ih =>
    intro hi1 hi2 hpw
    rw [List.foldl_cons]
    
    refine ih (outerStep init g) ?_ ?_ ?_
    · 
      intro q hq
      have : q ∈ (innerFold g init.1).1 := hq
      rw [mem_innerFold_fst] at this
      obtain ⟨r, hr, hqr⟩ := this
      rw [mem_clipBySide_fst] at hqr
      exact fragInv_clipFrag g (hi1 r hr) hqr.1
    · 
      intro q hq
      have hq' : q ∈ init.2 ++ (innerFold g init.1).2 := hq
      rw [Array.mem_append] at hq'
      rcases hq' with h | h
      · exact hi2 q h
      · rw [mem_innerFold_snd] at h
        obtain ⟨r, hr, hqr⟩ := h
        rw [mem_clipBySide_snd] at hqr
        exact fragInv_clipFrag g (hi1 r hr) hqr.1
    · 
      
      have hperm : ((outerStep init g).1.toList ++ (outerStep init g).2.toList).Perm
          (init.2.toList ++ init.1.toList.flatMap (cbCombined g)) := by
        simp only [outerStep, Array.toList_append]
        
        
        have hstep : ((innerFold g init.1).1.toList ++
            (init.2.toList ++ (innerFold g init.1).2.toList)).Perm
            (init.2.toList ++ ((innerFold g init.1).1.toList
              ++ (innerFold g init.1).2.toList)) := by
          refine List.perm_iff_count.mpr (fun x => ?_)
          simp only [List.count_append]; ring
        exact hstep.trans (List.Perm.append_left _ (innerStep_perm_init g init.1))
      rw [(List.Perm.pairwise_iff (fun h => h.symm) hperm)]
      
      rw [List.pairwise_append]
      refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_⟩
      · 
        exact hpw.sublist (List.sublist_append_right init.1.toList init.2.toList)
      · 
        refine pairwise_relDisj_flatMap (hpw.sublist
          (List.sublist_append_left init.1.toList init.2.toList)) ?_ ?_
        · intro r hr p hp
          rw [cbCombined, List.mem_append] at hp
          have hrinv : FragInv nt ct r := hi1 r (Array.mem_toList.mp hr)
          rcases hp with hp | hp
          · exact clipBySide_vrelint_subset hrinv (Or.inl (Array.mem_toList.mp hp))
          · exact clipBySide_vrelint_subset hrinv (Or.inr (Array.mem_toList.mp hp))
        · intro r hr
          exact clipBySide_combined_pairwise (hi1 r (Array.mem_toList.mp hr))
      · 
        intro p hp r hr
        rw [List.mem_flatMap] at hr
        obtain ⟨q, hqL, hrq⟩ := hr
        have hqinv : FragInv nt ct q := hi1 q (Array.mem_toList.mp hqL)
        
        have hpq : RelDisj q p := by
          have hP := hpw
          rw [List.pairwise_append] at hP
          exact hP.2.2 q hqL p hp
        
        rw [cbCombined, List.mem_append] at hrq
        have hrsub : vrelint (fragCycle r) ⊆ vrelint (fragCycle q) := by
          rcases hrq with h | h
          · exact clipBySide_vrelint_subset hqinv (Or.inl (Array.mem_toList.mp h))
          · exact clipBySide_vrelint_subset hqinv (Or.inr (Array.mem_toList.mp h))
        rw [RelDisj, Set.eq_empty_iff_forall_not_mem]
        rintro x ⟨hx1, hx2⟩
        rw [RelDisj, Set.eq_empty_iff_forall_not_mem] at hpq
        exact hpq x ⟨hrsub hx2, hx1⟩

name: coplanarClip_piece_vrelint_subset
proof:
:= by
  haveI := hfa.neZero
  have hpinv : FragInv nt ct p := by
    rcases hp with h | h
    · exact (Proof.MeshIntersectNpo.coplanarClip_fragInv (nt := nt) (ct := ct) fb hfa).1 p h
    · exact (Proof.MeshIntersectNpo.coplanarClip_fragInv (nt := nt) (ct := ct) fb hfa).2 p h
  haveI := hpinv.neZero
  refine vrelint_mono hpinv.size3 hfa.size3 hpinv.onPlane hpinv.strictConv
    hfa.onPlane hfa.strictConv (fun j => ?_)
  exact (coplanarClip_piece_vpoly_subset hfa hp) (subset_convexHull ℚ _ (Set.mem_range_self j))

name: pushFold_toList_perm
statement:
theorem pushFold_toList_perm (comp acc : Array Frag) :
    (comp.foldl (fun pd p => if p.poly.size ≥ 3 then pd.push p else pd) acc).toList.Perm
      (acc.toList ++ (comp.foldl (fun pd p => if p.poly.size ≥ 3 then pd.push p else pd)
        (#[] : Array Frag)).toList)
proof:
:= by
  rw [← Array.foldl_toList, ← Array.foldl_toList]
  generalize comp.toList = L
  induction L generalizing acc with
  | nil => simp
  | cons a L ih =>
    simp only [List.foldl_cons]
    by_cases hsz : a.poly.size ≥ 3
    · simp only [hsz, if_true]
      have hL := ih (acc.push a)
      have hR := ih (#[].push a)
      refine hL.trans ?_
      refine List.Perm.trans ?_ (List.Perm.append_left acc.toList hR.symm)
      simp only [Array.push_toList]
      refine List.perm_iff_count.mpr (fun x => ?_)
      simp only [List.count_append, List.count_cons, List.count_nil]; ring
    · simp only [hsz, if_false]
      exact ih acc

name: resolveStep_refine_pairwise
statement:
theorem resolveStep_refine_pairwise {nt : Point} {ct : ℚ} (_fa fb piece : Frag)
    (sameOr : Bool) (hpiece : FragInv nt ct piece) :
    
    let st0 : Array Frag × Array Frag
proof:
:=
      (if (Array.filter (fun p => decide (p.poly.size ≥ 3))
            (coplanarClip piece fb).1).isEmpty = true then (#[], #[piece])
       else
         (if sameOr = true then
            Array.filter (fun p => decide (p.poly.size ≥ 3)) (coplanarClip piece fb).1
          else #[],
          Array.foldl (fun pd p => if p.poly.size ≥ 3 then pd.push p else pd)
            (#[] : Array Frag) (coplanarClip piece fb).2))
    (st0.1.toList ++ st0.2.toList).Pairwise RelDisj
      ∧ (∀ q ∈ st0.1.toList ++ st0.2.toList,
          FragInv nt ct q ∧ vrelint (fragCycle q) ⊆ vrelint (fragCycle piece)) := by
  intro st0
  haveI := hpiece.neZero
  
  
  have hcombpw := coplanarClip_combined_pairwise (fb := fb) hpiece
  by_cases hre : (Array.filter (fun p => decide (p.poly.size ≥ 3))
      (coplanarClip piece fb).1).isEmpty = true
  · 
    simp only [st0, hre, if_true]
    refine ⟨by simp, ?_⟩
    intro q hq
    simp only [Array.toList, List.nil_append, List.mem_singleton] at hq
    obtain rfl := hq
    exact ⟨hpiece, le_refl _⟩
  · 
    simp only [st0, hre, Bool.false_eq_true, if_false]
    
    
    have hovsub : ∀ q ∈ (Array.filter (fun p => decide (p.poly.size ≥ 3))
        (coplanarClip piece fb).1), q ∈ (coplanarClip piece fb).1 :=
      fun q hq => Array.mem_of_mem_filter hq
    have hcompsub : ∀ q ∈ Array.foldl (fun pd p => if p.poly.size ≥ 3 then pd.push p else pd)
        (#[] : Array Frag) (coplanarClip piece fb).2, q ∈ (coplanarClip piece fb).2 := by
      intro q hq
      have : ∀ q ∈ Array.foldl (fun pd p => if p.poly.size ≥ 3 then pd.push p else pd)
          (#[] : Array Frag) (coplanarClip piece fb).2,
          q ∈ (coplanarClip piece fb).2 := by
        refine Array.foldl_induction
          (motive := fun _ (pd : Array Frag) => ∀ q ∈ pd, q ∈ (coplanarClip piece fb).2)
          (by intro q hq; simp at hq) ?_
        intro k pd ihpd q hq
        by_cases hsz : ((coplanarClip piece fb).2[k]'k.isLt).poly.size ≥ 3
        · rw [if_pos hsz] at hq
          rcases Array.mem_push.mp hq with h | h
          · exact ihpd _ h
          · exact h ▸ Array.getElem_mem k.isLt
        · rw [if_neg hsz] at hq; exact ihpd _ hq
      exact this q hq
    
    have hkeptmem : ∀ q ∈ (if sameOr = true then
        Array.filter (fun p => decide (p.poly.size ≥ 3)) (coplanarClip piece fb).1
      else (#[] : Array Frag)), q ∈ (coplanarClip piece fb).1 := by
      intro q hq
      by_cases hso : sameOr = true
      · rw [if_pos hso] at hq; exact hovsub q hq
      · rw [if_neg hso] at hq; simp at hq
    
    have hmemcomb : ∀ q ∈ ((if sameOr = true then
        Array.filter (fun p => decide (p.poly.size ≥ 3)) (coplanarClip piece fb).1
      else (#[] : Array Frag)).toList
        ++ (Array.foldl (fun pd p => if p.poly.size ≥ 3 then pd.push p else pd)
            (#[] : Array Frag) (coplanarClip piece fb).2).toList),
        q ∈ (coplanarClip piece fb).1.toList ++ (coplanarClip piece fb).2.toList := by
      intro q hq
      rw [List.mem_append] at hq ⊢
      rcases hq with h | h
      · exact Or.inl (Array.mem_toList.mpr (hkeptmem q (Array.mem_toList.mp h)))
      · exact Or.inr (Array.mem_toList.mpr (hcompsub q (Array.mem_toList.mp h)))
    refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
    · 
      
      
      have hsub : ((if sameOr = true then
          Array.filter (fun p => decide (p.poly.size ≥ 3)) (coplanarClip piece fb).1
        else (#[] : Array Frag)).toList
          ++ (Array.foldl (fun pd p => if p.poly.size ≥ 3 then pd.push p else pd)
              (#[] : Array Frag) (coplanarClip piece fb).2).toList).Sublist
          ((coplanarClip piece fb).1.toList ++ (coplanarClip piece fb).2.toList) := by
        refine List.Sublist.append ?_ ?_
        · by_cases hso : sameOr = true
          · rw [if_pos hso, Array.toList_filter]; exact List.filter_sublist _
          · rw [if_neg hso]; simp
        · 
          have : (Array.foldl (fun pd p => if p.poly.size ≥ 3 then pd.push p else pd)
              (#[] : Array Frag) (coplanarClip piece fb).2).toList.Sublist
              (coplanarClip piece fb).2.toList := by
            rw [← Array.foldl_toList]
            generalize (coplanarClip piece fb).2.toList = L
            
            suffices H2 : ∀ (acc : Array Frag), acc.toList.Sublist (acc.toList) →
                (L.foldl (fun pd p => if p.poly.size ≥ 3 then pd.push p else pd) acc).toList.Sublist
                  (acc.toList ++ L) by
              have := H2 #[] (List.Sublist.refl _); simpa using this
            clear hcombpw hmemcomb hovsub hcompsub hkeptmem hre
            induction L with
            | nil => intro acc _; simp
            | cons a L ih =>
              intro acc _
              simp only [List.foldl_cons]
              by_cases hsz : a.poly.size ≥ 3
              · rw [if_pos hsz]
                refine (ih (acc.push a) (List.Sublist.refl _)).trans ?_
                simp only [Array.push_toList]
                rw [List.append_assoc]; simp
              · rw [if_neg hsz]
                refine (ih acc (List.Sublist.refl _)).trans ?_
                exact (List.sublist_cons_self a L).append_left acc.toList
          exact this
      exact hcombpw.sublist hsub
    · 
      intro q hq
      have hmem := hmemcomb q hq
      rw [List.mem_append] at hmem
      have hin : q ∈ (coplanarClip piece fb).1 ∨ q ∈ (coplanarClip piece fb).2 := by
        rcases hmem with h | h
        · exact Or.inl (Array.mem_toList.mp h)
        · exact Or.inr (Array.mem_toList.mp h)
      refine ⟨?_, coplanarClip_piece_vrelint_subset hpiece hin⟩
      rcases hin with h | h
      · exact (Proof.MeshIntersectNpo.coplanarClip_fragInv (nt := nt) (ct := ct)
          fb hpiece).1 q h
      · exact (Proof.MeshIntersectNpo.coplanarClip_fragInv (nt := nt) (ct := ct)
          fb hpiece).2 q h

name: innerResolveFold_pairwise
statement:
theorem innerResolveFold_pairwise {nt : Point} {ct : ℚ} (fb : Frag) (sameOr : Bool)
    (pending : Array Frag) (kept0 : Array Frag)
    (hk0 : ∀ q ∈ kept0, FragInv nt ct q) (hp0 : ∀ q ∈ pending, FragInv nt ct q)
    (hpw0 : (kept0.toList ++ pending.toList).Pairwise RelDisj) :
    let res
proof:
:= pending.foldl (fun st piece =>
        let (ov, comp) := coplanarClip piece fb
        let realOv := ov.filter (fun p => p.poly.size ≥ 3)
        if realOv.isEmpty then (st.1, st.2.push piece)
        else
          let kept := if sameOr then st.1 ++ realOv else st.1
          let pending := comp.foldl (fun pd p =>
            if p.poly.size ≥ 3 then pd.push p else pd) st.2
          (kept, pending)) (kept0, #[])
    (res.1.toList ++ res.2.toList).Pairwise RelDisj
      ∧ (∀ q ∈ res.1, FragInv nt ct q) ∧ (∀ q ∈ res.2, FragInv nt ct q) := by
  intro res
  
  
  suffices key : (res.1.toList ++ res.2.toList ++ pending.toList.drop pending.size).Pairwise
      RelDisj ∧ (∀ q ∈ res.1, FragInv nt ct q) ∧ (∀ q ∈ res.2, FragInv nt ct q) by
    obtain ⟨hpw, hk, hp⟩ := key
    rw [List.drop_eq_nil_of_le (le_refl _), List.append_nil] at hpw
    exact ⟨hpw, hk, hp⟩
  show (fun i (st : Array Frag × Array Frag) =>
      (st.1.toList ++ st.2.toList ++ (pending.toList.drop i)).Pairwise RelDisj
        ∧ (∀ q ∈ st.1, FragInv nt ct q) ∧ (∀ q ∈ st.2, FragInv nt ct q)) pending.size res
  refine Array.foldl_induction
    (motive := fun i (st : Array Frag × Array Frag) =>
      (st.1.toList ++ st.2.toList ++ (pending.toList.drop i)).Pairwise RelDisj
        ∧ (∀ q ∈ st.1, FragInv nt ct q) ∧ (∀ q ∈ st.2, FragInv nt ct q))
    ⟨by simp only [Array.toList, List.append_nil, List.drop_zero, List.nil_append]; exact hpw0,
      hk0, by intro q hq; simp at hq⟩ ?_
  rintro i st ⟨ihpw, ihk, ihp⟩
  set piece := pending[i] with hpiece_def
  have hpieceInv : FragInv nt ct piece := hp0 piece (Array.getElem_mem i.isLt)
  haveI := hpieceInv.neZero
  
  have hdrop : pending.toList.drop i = piece :: pending.toList.drop (i + 1) := by
    have hlt : (i : ℕ) < pending.toList.length := by simp [i.isLt]
    rw [List.drop_eq_getElem_cons hlt, hpiece_def]
    simp [Array.getElem_toList]
  rw [hdrop] at ihpw
  
  
  have hbase_pw : (st.1.toList ++ st.2.toList ++ pending.toList.drop (i + 1)).Pairwise
      RelDisj := by
    have hperm : (st.1.toList ++ st.2.toList ++ (piece :: pending.toList.drop (i + 1))).Perm
        ((st.1.toList ++ st.2.toList ++ pending.toList.drop (i + 1)) ++ [piece]) := by
      refine List.perm_iff_count.mpr (fun x => ?_)
      simp only [List.count_append, List.count_cons, List.count_nil]; ring
    have := (List.Perm.pairwise_iff (fun h => h.symm) hperm).mp ihpw
    rw [List.pairwise_append] at this
    exact this.1
  have hpiece_disj : ∀ r ∈ st.1.toList ++ st.2.toList ++ pending.toList.drop (i + 1),
      RelDisj piece r := by
    intro r hr
    
    
    have hperm : (st.1.toList ++ st.2.toList ++ (piece :: pending.toList.drop (i + 1))).Perm
        (piece :: (st.1.toList ++ st.2.toList ++ pending.toList.drop (i + 1))) := by
      refine List.perm_iff_count.mpr (fun x => ?_)
      simp only [List.count_append, List.count_cons, List.count_nil]; ring
    have hp2 := (List.Perm.pairwise_iff (fun h => h.symm) hperm).mp ihpw
    rw [List.pairwise_cons] at hp2
    exact hp2.1 r hr
  
  have hstep := resolveStep_refine_pairwise piece fb piece sameOr hpieceInv
  obtain ⟨hgain_pw, hgain_props⟩ := hstep
  
  by_cases hre : (Array.filter (fun p => decide (p.poly.size ≥ 3))
      (coplanarClip piece fb).1).isEmpty = true
  · 
    simp only [hre, if_true]
    refine ⟨?_, ihk, ?_⟩
    · 
      have hperm : (st.1.toList ++ (st.2.push piece).toList ++ pending.toList.drop (i + 1)).Perm
          (st.1.toList ++ st.2.toList ++ (piece :: pending.toList.drop (i + 1))) := by
        simp only [Array.push_toList]
        refine List.perm_iff_count.mpr (fun x => ?_)
        simp only [List.count_append, List.count_cons, List.count_nil]; ring
      exact (List.Perm.pairwise_iff (fun h => h.symm) hperm).mpr ihpw
    · intro q hq
      rcases Array.mem_push.mp hq with h | h
      · exact ihp q h
      · exact h ▸ hpieceInv
  · 
    simp only [hre, Bool.false_eq_true, if_false]
    
    set gainK : Array Frag := if sameOr = true then
        Array.filter (fun p => decide (p.poly.size ≥ 3)) (coplanarClip piece fb).1
      else (#[] : Array Frag) with hgainK
    set gainP : Array Frag := Array.foldl (fun pd p => if p.poly.size ≥ 3 then pd.push p else pd)
        st.2 (coplanarClip piece fb).2 with hgainP
    
    have hgainP_perm : gainP.toList.Perm (st.2.toList ++
        (Array.foldl (fun pd p => if p.poly.size ≥ 3 then pd.push p else pd)
          (#[] : Array Frag) (coplanarClip piece fb).2).toList) := by
      rw [hgainP]; exact pushFold_toList_perm (coplanarClip piece fb).2 st.2
    
    set compGains : List Frag := (Array.foldl (fun pd p => if p.poly.size ≥ 3 then pd.push p else pd)
      (#[] : Array Frag) (coplanarClip piece fb).2).toList with hcompGains
    
    rw [if_neg hre] at hgain_pw hgain_props
    simp only at hgain_pw hgain_props
    
    have hG_pw : (gainK.toList ++ compGains).Pairwise RelDisj := hgain_pw
    have hG_props : ∀ q ∈ gainK.toList ++ compGains,
        FragInv nt ct q ∧ vrelint (fragCycle q) ⊆ vrelint (fragCycle piece) := hgain_props
    
    have hkept'_eq : (if sameOr = true then
        st.1 ++ Array.filter (fun p => decide (p.poly.size ≥ 3)) (coplanarClip piece fb).1
      else st.1).toList = st.1.toList ++ gainK.toList := by
      by_cases hso : sameOr = true
      · rw [if_pos hso, hgainK, if_pos hso, Array.toList_append]
      · rw [if_neg hso, hgainK, if_neg hso]; simp
    
    refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_⟩
    · rw [hkept'_eq]
      have hperm : (st.1.toList ++ gainK.toList ++ gainP.toList ++ pending.toList.drop (i + 1)).Perm
          ((st.1.toList ++ st.2.toList ++ pending.toList.drop (i + 1))
            ++ (gainK.toList ++ compGains)) := by
        have hgp : (st.1.toList ++ gainK.toList ++ gainP.toList ++ pending.toList.drop (i + 1)).Perm
            (st.1.toList ++ gainK.toList ++ (st.2.toList ++ compGains)
              ++ pending.toList.drop (i + 1)) := by
          refine List.Perm.append_right _ (List.Perm.append_left _ ?_)
          rw [hcompGains]; exact hgainP_perm
        refine hgp.trans ?_
        refine List.perm_iff_count.mpr (fun x => ?_)
        simp only [List.count_append]; ring
      rw [List.Perm.pairwise_iff (fun h => h.symm) hperm]
      rw [List.pairwise_append]
      refine ⟨hbase_pw, hG_pw, ?_⟩
      intro b hb g hg
      
      have hbpiece : RelDisj piece b := hpiece_disj b hb
      have hgsub : vrelint (fragCycle g) ⊆ vrelint (fragCycle piece) := (hG_props g hg).2
      rw [RelDisj, Set.eq_empty_iff_forall_not_mem]
      rintro x ⟨hx1, hx2⟩
      rw [RelDisj, Set.eq_empty_iff_forall_not_mem] at hbpiece
      exact hbpiece x ⟨hgsub hx2, hx1⟩
    · 
      rw [hkept'_eq] at *
      intro q hq
      by_cases hso : sameOr = true
      · rw [if_pos hso] at hq
        rcases Array.mem_append.mp hq with h | h
        · exact ihk q h
        · exact (hG_props q (List.mem_append_left _ (by
            rw [hgainK, if_pos hso]; exact Array.mem_toList.mpr h))).1
      · rw [if_neg hso] at hq; exact ihk q hq
    · 
      intro q hq
      have hqp : q ∈ gainP.toList := Array.mem_toList.mpr hq
      have : q ∈ st.2.toList ++ compGains := (hgainP_perm).mem_iff.mp hqp
      rcases List.mem_append.mp this with h | h
      · exact ihp q (Array.mem_toList.mp h)
      · exact (hG_props q (List.mem_append_right _ h)).1

name: outerFold_resolve_invariant
statement:
theorem outerFold_resolve_invariant {nt : Point} {ct : ℚ} (fa : Frag)
    (opp : Array Frag) (init : Array Frag × Array Frag)
    (hi1 : ∀ q ∈ init.1, FragInv nt ct q) (hi2 : ∀ q ∈ init.2, FragInv nt ct q)
    (hpw : (init.1.toList ++ init.2.toList).Pairwise RelDisj) :
    let res
proof:
:= opp.foldl (fun acc fb =>
          if !(coplanarPlane fa.plane fb.plane) then acc
          else
            acc.2.foldl (fun st piece =>
              let (ov, comp) := coplanarClip piece fb
              let realOv := ov.filter (fun p => p.poly.size ≥ 3)
              if realOv.isEmpty then (st.1, st.2.push piece)
              else
                let kept := if sameOrient fa.plane fb.plane then st.1 ++ realOv else st.1
                let pending := comp.foldl (fun pd p =>
                  if p.poly.size ≥ 3 then pd.push p else pd) st.2
                (kept, pending)) (acc.1, #[])) init
    (∀ q ∈ res.1, FragInv nt ct q) ∧ (∀ q ∈ res.2, FragInv nt ct q)
      ∧ (res.1.toList ++ res.2.toList).Pairwise RelDisj := by
  intro res
  refine Array.foldl_induction
    (motive := fun _ (acc : Array Frag × Array Frag) =>
      (∀ q ∈ acc.1, FragInv nt ct q) ∧ (∀ q ∈ acc.2, FragInv nt ct q)
        ∧ (acc.1.toList ++ acc.2.toList).Pairwise RelDisj)
    ⟨hi1, hi2, hpw⟩ ?_
  rintro i acc ⟨ihKinv, ihPinv, ihpw⟩
  set fb := opp[i]'i.isLt with hfb
  by_cases hcop : (!(coplanarPlane fa.plane fb.plane)) = true
  · simp only [hcop, if_true]; exact ⟨ihKinv, ihPinv, ihpw⟩
  · simp only [hcop, Bool.not_eq_true', Bool.not_eq_false] at hcop ⊢
    simp only [hcop, Bool.not_true, Bool.false_eq_true, if_false]
    obtain ⟨hpw', hKinv', hPinv'⟩ := innerResolveFold_pairwise fb
      (sameOrient fa.plane fb.plane) acc.2 acc.1 ihKinv ihPinv ihpw
    exact ⟨hKinv', hPinv', hpw'⟩

name: resolveFrag_kept_pairwise
statement:
theorem resolveFrag_kept_pairwise {nt : Point} {ct : ℚ} (bvh : Impl.BVH.BVH) (opp : Array Frag)
    (wOpp : Array PFace) {fa : Frag} (hfa : FragInv nt ct fa) :
    (resolveFrag bvh fa opp wOpp).toList.Pairwise RelDisj
proof:
