:= by
  haveI := hfa.neZero
  unfold resolveFrag
  
  suffices H : ∀ (init : Array Frag × Array Frag),
      (∀ q ∈ init.1, FragInv nt ct q) → (∀ q ∈ init.2, FragInv nt ct q) →
      (init.1.toList ++ init.2.toList).Pairwise RelDisj →
      (∀ q ∈ (opp.foldl (fun acc fb =>
          if !(coplanarPlane fa.plane fb.plane) then acc
          else
            acc.2.foldl (fun st piece =>
              let (ov, comp) := coplanarClip piece fb
              let realOv := ov.filter (fun p => p.poly.size ≥ 3)
              if realOv.isEmpty then (st.1, st.2.push piece)
              else
                let kept := if sameOrient fa.plane fb.plane then st.1 ++ realOv else st.1
                let pending := comp.foldl (fun pd p =>
                  if p.poly.size ≥ 3 then pd.push p else pd) st.2
                (kept, pending)) (acc.1, #[])) init).1, FragInv nt ct q)
        ∧ ((opp.foldl (fun acc fb =>
          if !(coplanarPlane fa.plane fb.plane) then acc
          else
            acc.2.foldl (fun st piece =>
              let (ov, comp) := coplanarClip piece fb
              let realOv := ov.filter (fun p => p.poly.size ≥ 3)
              if realOv.isEmpty then (st.1, st.2.push piece)
              else
                let kept := if sameOrient fa.plane fb.plane then st.1 ++ realOv else st.1
                let pending := comp.foldl (fun pd p =>
                  if p.poly.size ≥ 3 then pd.push p else pd) st.2
                (kept, pending)) (acc.1, #[])) init).1.toList
            ++ (opp.foldl (fun acc fb =>
          if !(coplanarPlane fa.plane fb.plane) then acc
          else
            acc.2.foldl (fun st piece =>
              let (ov, comp) := coplanarClip piece fb
              let realOv := ov.filter (fun p => p.poly.size ≥ 3)
              if realOv.isEmpty then (st.1, st.2.push piece)
              else
                let kept := if sameOrient fa.plane fb.plane then st.1 ++ realOv else st.1
                let pending := comp.foldl (fun pd p =>
                  if p.poly.size ≥ 3 then pd.push p else pd) st.2
                (kept, pending)) (acc.1, #[])) init).2.toList).Pairwise RelDisj by
    have hinit2 : ∀ q ∈ ((#[] : Array Frag), #[fa]).2, FragInv nt ct q := by
      intro q hq
      have hqe : q = fa := by simpa using hq
      rw [hqe]; exact hfa
    obtain ⟨hKinv, hpw⟩ := H ((#[] : Array Frag), #[fa])
      (by intro q hq; simp at hq) hinit2 (by simp)
    
    rw [List.pairwise_append] at hpw
    rw [Array.toList_append]
    rw [List.pairwise_append]
    refine ⟨hpw.1, ?_, ?_⟩
    · 
      refine (hpw.2.1.sublist ?_)
      rw [Array.toList_filter]
      exact List.filter_sublist _
    · intro p hp r hr
      rw [Array.mem_toList, Array.mem_filter] at hr
      exact hpw.2.2 p hp r (Array.mem_toList.mpr hr.1)
  
  intro init hi1 hi2 hpw
  have main := outerFold_resolve_invariant (nt := nt) (ct := ct) fa opp init hi1 hi2 hpw
  exact ⟨main.1, main.2.2⟩

name: outerFoldB_resolve_invariant
statement:
theorem outerFoldB_resolve_invariant {nt : Point} {ct : ℚ} (fb : Frag)
    (opp : Array Frag) (init : Array Frag × Array Frag)
    (hi1 : ∀ q ∈ init.1, FragInv nt ct q) (hi2 : ∀ q ∈ init.2, FragInv nt ct q)
    (hpw : (init.1.toList ++ init.2.toList).Pairwise RelDisj) :
    let res
proof:
:= opp.foldl (fun acc fa =>
          if !(coplanarPlane fb.plane fa.plane) then acc
          else
            acc.2.foldl (fun st piece =>
              if (Array.filter (fun p => decide (p.poly.size ≥ 3))
                    (coplanarClip piece fa).1).isEmpty = true then (st.1, st.2.push piece)
              else
                (st.1, (coplanarClip piece fa).2.foldl
                  (fun pd p => if p.poly.size ≥ 3 then pd.push p else pd) st.2))
              (acc.1, #[])) init
    (∀ q ∈ res.1, FragInv nt ct q) ∧ (∀ q ∈ res.2, FragInv nt ct q)
      ∧ (res.1.toList ++ res.2.toList).Pairwise RelDisj := by
  intro res
  refine Array.foldl_induction
    (motive := fun _ (acc : Array Frag × Array Frag) =>
      (∀ q ∈ acc.1, FragInv nt ct q) ∧ (∀ q ∈ acc.2, FragInv nt ct q)
        ∧ (acc.1.toList ++ acc.2.toList).Pairwise RelDisj)
    ⟨hi1, hi2, hpw⟩ ?_
  rintro i acc ⟨ihKinv, ihPinv, ihpw⟩
  set fa := opp[i]'i.isLt with hfa
  by_cases hcop : (!(coplanarPlane fb.plane fa.plane)) = true
  · simp only [hcop, if_true]; exact ⟨ihKinv, ihPinv, ihpw⟩
  · simp only [hcop, Bool.not_eq_true', Bool.not_eq_false] at hcop ⊢
    simp only [hcop, Bool.not_true, Bool.false_eq_true, if_false]
    
    
    have hbody : (fun (st : Array Frag × Array Frag) piece =>
        if (Array.filter (fun p => decide (p.poly.size ≥ 3))
              (coplanarClip piece fa).1).isEmpty = true then (st.1, st.2.push piece)
        else
          (st.1, (coplanarClip piece fa).2.foldl
            (fun pd p => if p.poly.size ≥ 3 then pd.push p else pd) st.2))
        = (fun (st : Array Frag × Array Frag) piece =>
          let (ov, comp) := coplanarClip piece fa
          let realOv := ov.filter (fun p => p.poly.size ≥ 3)
          if realOv.isEmpty then (st.1, st.2.push piece)
          else
            let kept := if (false : Bool) then st.1 ++ realOv else st.1
            let pending := comp.foldl (fun pd p =>
              if p.poly.size ≥ 3 then pd.push p else pd) st.2
            (kept, pending)) := by
      funext st piece
      simp only [Bool.false_eq_true, if_false]
    rw [hbody]
    obtain ⟨hpw', hKinv', hPinv'⟩ := innerResolveFold_pairwise fa
      false acc.2 acc.1 ihKinv ihPinv ihpw
    exact ⟨hKinv', hPinv', hpw'⟩

name: resolveFragB_kept_pairwise
statement:
theorem resolveFragB_kept_pairwise {nt : Point} {ct : ℚ} (bvh : Impl.BVH.BVH) (opp : Array Frag)
    (wOpp : Array PFace) {fb : Frag} (hfb : FragInv nt ct fb) :
    (resolveCoplanar.resolveFragB bvh fb opp wOpp).toList.Pairwise RelDisj
proof:
:= by
  haveI := hfb.neZero
  unfold resolveCoplanar.resolveFragB
  have hinit2 : ∀ q ∈ ((#[] : Array Frag), #[fb]).2, FragInv nt ct q := by
    intro q hq
    have hqe : q = fb := by simpa using hq
    rw [hqe]; exact hfb
  obtain ⟨hKinv, hPinv, hpw⟩ := outerFoldB_resolve_invariant (nt := nt) (ct := ct) fb opp
    ((#[] : Array Frag), #[fb]) (by intro q hq; simp at hq) hinit2 (by simp)
  rw [List.pairwise_append] at hpw
  rw [Array.toList_append, List.pairwise_append]
  refine ⟨hpw.1, ?_, ?_⟩
  · refine (hpw.2.1.sublist ?_)
    rw [Array.toList_filter]; exact List.filter_sublist _
  · intro p hp r hr
    rw [Array.mem_toList, Array.mem_filter] at hr
    exact hpw.2.2 p hp r (Array.mem_toList.mpr hr.1)

name: vpoly_exists_combo
proof:
:= by
  classical
  rw [vpoly, ← Set.image_univ, ← Finset.coe_univ, ← Finset.coe_image,
    Finset.convexHull_eq] at hx
  obtain ⟨p, hp0, hp1, hcm⟩ := hx
  set N : Point → ℚ := fun y => ((Finset.univ.filter (fun k => w k = y)).card : ℚ)
    with hN
  have hNpos : ∀ j : Fin r, 0 < N (w j) := by
    intro j
    rw [hN]
    have h : (0 : ℕ) < (Finset.univ.filter (fun k => w k = w j)).card := by
      rw [Finset.card_pos]
      exact ⟨j, by simp⟩
    show (0 : ℚ) < ((Finset.univ.filter (fun k => w k = w j)).card : ℚ)
    exact_mod_cast h
  have hmaps : ∀ j ∈ (Finset.univ : Finset (Fin r)), w j ∈ Finset.univ.image w :=
    fun j _ => Finset.mem_image_of_mem w (Finset.mem_univ j)
  
  have hfiberμ : ∀ y ∈ Finset.univ.image w,
      ∑ j ∈ Finset.univ with w j = y, p (w j) / N (w j) = p y := by
    intro y hy
    have hconst : ∀ j ∈ Finset.univ.filter (fun k => w k = y),
        p (w j) / N (w j) = p y / N y := by
      intro j hj; rw [(Finset.mem_filter.mp hj).2]
    rw [Finset.sum_congr rfl hconst, Finset.sum_const]
    have hcard : ((Finset.univ.filter (fun k => w k = y)).card : ℚ) = N y := by rw [hN]
    obtain ⟨j0, hj0⟩ := Finset.mem_image.mp hy
    have hNy : 0 < N y := by rw [← hj0.2]; exact hNpos j0
    rw [nsmul_eq_mul, hcard]
    field_simp
  have hfiberμx : ∀ y ∈ Finset.univ.image w,
      ∑ j ∈ Finset.univ with w j = y, (p (w j) / N (w j)) • w j = p y • y := by
    intro y hy
    have hconst : ∀ j ∈ Finset.univ.filter (fun k => w k = y),
        (p (w j) / N (w j)) • w j = (p y / N y) • y := by
      intro j hj; rw [(Finset.mem_filter.mp hj).2]
    rw [Finset.sum_congr rfl hconst, Finset.sum_const]
    have hcard : ((Finset.univ.filter (fun k => w k = y)).card : ℚ) = N y := by rw [hN]
    obtain ⟨j0, hj0⟩ := Finset.mem_image.mp hy
    have hNy : 0 < N y := by rw [← hj0.2]; exact hNpos j0
    rw [← Nat.cast_smul_eq_nsmul ℚ, hcard, smul_smul, mul_div_cancel₀ _ (ne_of_gt hNy)]
  refine ⟨fun j => p (w j) / N (w j), fun j => ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · 
    apply div_nonneg
    · exact hp0 _ (Finset.mem_image_of_mem w (Finset.mem_univ j))
    · exact (hNpos j).le
  · 
    rw [← Finset.sum_fiberwise_of_maps_to hmaps (fun j => p (w j) / N (w j))]
    rw [Finset.sum_congr rfl hfiberμ, hp1]
  · 
    rw [← Finset.sum_fiberwise_of_maps_to hmaps (fun j => (p (w j) / N (w j)) • w j)]
    rw [Finset.sum_congr rfl hfiberμx]
    rw [← hcm, Finset.centerMass_eq_of_sum_1 _ id hp1]
    rfl

name: vrelint_absorb_free
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨μ, hμpos, hμsum, rfl⟩ := hx
  obtain ⟨ν, hν0, hνsum, rfl⟩ := vpoly_exists_combo w hy
  refine ⟨fun j => (1 - θ) * ν j + θ * μ j, fun j => ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · show 0 < (1 - θ) * ν j + θ * μ j
    have h1' : 0 ≤ 1 - θ := by linarith
    have := mul_nonneg h1' (hν0 j)
    have := mul_pos h0 (hμpos j)
    linarith
  · rw [Finset.sum_add_distrib, ← Finset.mul_sum, ← Finset.mul_sum, hμsum, hνsum]
    ring
  · rw [Finset.smul_sum, Finset.smul_sum, ← Finset.sum_add_distrib]
    refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun j _ => ?_)
    rw [add_smul, smul_smul, smul_smul]

name: vrelint_disjoint_vpoly_free
proof:
:= by
  by_contra hne
  obtain ⟨x, hx₁, hx₂⟩ := Set.nonempty_iff_ne_empty.mpr hne
  
  have hx₁' := hx₁
  rw [vrelint_eq hr₁ hpl₁ hs₁] at hx₁'
  obtain ⟨hxpl, hxstrict⟩ := hx₁'
  
  have hb₂ : (∑ j, (r₂ : ℚ)⁻¹ • w₂ j) ∈ vrelint w₂ := barycenter_mem_vrelint hr₂ w₂
  set b₂ := ∑ j, (r₂ : ℚ)⁻¹ • w₂ j with hb₂def
  
  obtain ⟨β, hβ0, hβsum, hb₂rep⟩ := vpoly_exists_combo w₂ (vrelint_subset_vpoly _ hb₂)
  
  haveI hne₁ : Nonempty (Fin r₁) := ⟨0⟩
  set a : Fin r₁ → ℚ := fun i => eta n w₁ i x with hadef
  set B : Fin r₁ → ℚ := fun i => |eta n w₁ i b₂| with hBdef
  set θ : ℚ := Finset.univ.inf' Finset.univ_nonempty (fun i => a i / (a i + B i + 1))
    with hθdef
  have hθpos : 0 < θ := by
    rw [hθdef, Finset.lt_inf'_iff]
    intro i _
    have ha : 0 < a i := hxstrict i
    have hB : 0 ≤ B i := abs_nonneg _
    positivity
  have hθlt : θ < 1 := by
    have hle : θ ≤ a 0 / (a 0 + B 0 + 1) :=
      Finset.inf'_le _ (Finset.mem_univ 0)
    have ha : 0 < a 0 := hxstrict 0
    have hB : 0 ≤ B 0 := abs_nonneg _
    have : a 0 / (a 0 + B 0 + 1) < 1 := by
      rw [div_lt_one (by linarith)]; linarith
    linarith
  set zθ := (1 - θ) • x + θ • b₂ with hzθdef
  
  have hz₂ : zθ ∈ vrelint w₂ := by
    rw [hzθdef]; exact vrelint_absorb_free w₂ hb₂ hx₂ hθpos hθlt.le
  
  have hz₁ : zθ ∈ vrelint w₁ := by
    rw [vrelint_eq hr₁ hpl₁ hs₁]
    have hb₂pl : dotQ n b₂ = c := by
      rw [hb₂rep]; exact dotQ_comb n w₂ hβsum hpl₂
    refine ⟨?_, fun i => ?_⟩
    · rw [hzθdef, dotQ_affine_comb, hxpl, hb₂pl]; ring
    · rw [hzθdef, eta_affine_comb n w₁ i (by ring : (1 - θ) + θ = 1)]
      have hle : θ ≤ a i / (a i + B i + 1) := Finset.inf'_le _ (Finset.mem_univ i)
      have ha : 0 < a i := hxstrict i
      have hB : 0 ≤ B i := abs_nonneg _
      have hbound : -(B i) ≤ eta n w₁ i b₂ := neg_abs_le _
      have hkey : θ * (a i + B i + 1) ≤ a i :=
        (le_div_iff₀ (by linarith : (0:ℚ) < a i + B i + 1)).mp hle
      nlinarith
  have : zθ ∈ vrelint w₁ ∩ vrelint w₂ := ⟨hz₁, hz₂⟩
  rw [hdisj] at this; exact this

name: crossSep_of_relDisj_free
statement:
theorem crossSep_of_relDisj_free {n₁ : Point} {c₁ : ℚ} {n₂ : Point} {c₂ : ℚ}
    {f₁ f₂ : Frag} (h₁ : FragInv n₁ c₁ f₁) (h₂ : FragInv n₂ c₂ f₂)
    (hpl12 : OnPlane n₁ c₁ (fragCycle f₂)) (hpl21 : OnPlane n₂ c₂ (fragCycle f₁))
    (hd : RelDisj f₁ f₂) :
    vrelint (fragCycle f₁) ∩ vpoly (fragCycle f₂) = ∅
      ∧ vrelint (fragCycle f₂) ∩ vpoly (fragCycle f₁) = ∅
proof:
:= by
  haveI := h₁.neZero
  haveI := h₂.neZero
  refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
  · exact vrelint_disjoint_vpoly_free h₁.size3 h₂.size3 h₁.onPlane h₁.strictConv
      hpl12 hd
  · exact vrelint_disjoint_vpoly_free h₂.size3 h₁.size3 h₂.onPlane h₂.strictConv
      hpl21 hd.symm

name: coplanarClip_comp_relint_disjoint_fb_free
proof:
:= by
  haveI := hfa.neZero
  haveI := hfb.neZero
  have hinit : ∀ q ∈ (#[fa], (#[] : Array Frag)).1, FragInv nt ct q := by
    intro q hq
    obtain rfl : q = fa := by simpa using hq
    exact hfa
  rw [coplanarClip_eq_foldl] at hp
  rcases outerFold_comp_dropped (edgePlanesOf fb).toList (#[fa], #[]) hinit p hp
    with hpnil | ⟨g, hg_mem, r, hr_frag, hpr⟩
  · exact absurd hpnil (by simp)
  have hg_mem' : g ∈ edgePlanesOf fb := Array.mem_toList.mp hg_mem
  obtain ⟨i, hi, hgeq⟩ := mem_edgePlanesOf hg_mem'
  set Ng := P3.toPoint (edgeNormal (carrierNormalP fb)
    (fb.poly.getD i default).p (fb.poly.getD ((i + 1) % fb.poly.size) default).p) with hNg
  set dg := edgeOffset (carrierNormalP fb)
    (fb.poly.getD i default).p (fb.poly.getD ((i + 1) % fb.poly.size) default).p with hdg
  have hgmul : IsMulOf g Ng dg := by rw [hgeq, hNg, hdg]; exact isMulOf_edgePlane _ _ _
  have hppos := clipBySide_snd_vrelint_pos hgmul hr_frag hpr
  have hfb_nonpos : vpoly (fragCycle fb) ⊆ {x | ce Ng dg x ≤ 0} := by
    obtain ⟨m', hm', hcar', hvfb⟩ := vpoly_fb_eq hfb
    intro x hx
    rw [hvfb] at hx
    obtain ⟨_, heta⟩ := hx
    simp only [Set.mem_setOf_eq]
    rw [hNg, hdg, edgePlane_nonpos_eq_eta hi x]
    exact heta ⟨i, hi⟩
  rw [Set.eq_empty_iff_forall_not_mem]
  rintro z ⟨hz1, hz2⟩
  have h1 := hppos hz1
  have h2 := hfb_nonpos hz2
  simp only [Set.mem_setOf_eq] at h1 h2
  linarith

name: overlaps_false_relint_disjoint_free
proof:
:= by
  haveI := hfb.neZero
  haveI := hfa.neZero
  obtain ⟨ρ, hρ, hn', hc'⟩ := hprop
  
  have honTo : ∀ {y : Point}, dotQ n y = c → dotQ n' y = c' := by
    intro y hy; rw [hn', hc', dotQ_smul_left, hy]
  rw [Set.eq_empty_iff_forall_not_mem]
  rintro x ⟨hxfb, hxfa'⟩
  have hxfa : x ∈ vpoly (fragCycle fa) := vrelint_subset_vpoly _ hxfa'
  have hxvfb : x ∈ vpoly (fragCycle fb) := vrelint_subset_vpoly _ hxfb
  have hcov := (coplanarClip_cover hfb (fb := fa) x).mpr hxvfb
  have hnoov : ¬ ∃ p ∈ (coplanarClip fb fa).1, x ∈ vpoly (fragCycle p) := by
    rintro ⟨p, hp, _⟩
    have hp3 := coplanarClip_inside_size3 hfb hp
    exact absurd ((overlaps_iff_exists_size3 fb fa).mpr ⟨p, hp, hp3⟩) (by rw [hov]; simp)
  rcases hcov with hov' | ⟨p, hp, hxp⟩
  · exact hnoov hov'
  have hpinv : FragInv n c p :=
    (Proof.MeshIntersectNpo.coplanarClip_fragInv (nt := n) (ct := c) fa hfb).2 p hp
  haveI := hpinv.neZero
  have hdisj : vrelint (fragCycle p) ∩ vpoly (fragCycle fa) = ∅ :=
    coplanarClip_comp_relint_disjoint_fb_free hfb hfa hp
  have hrr : vrelint (fragCycle p) ∩ vrelint (fragCycle fa) = ∅ := by
    rw [Set.eq_empty_iff_forall_not_mem]
    rintro y ⟨hy1, hy2⟩
    have : y ∈ vrelint (fragCycle p) ∩ vpoly (fragCycle fa) :=
      ⟨hy1, vrelint_subset_vpoly _ hy2⟩
    rw [hdisj] at this; exact this
  
  have hpl_p : OnPlane n' c' (fragCycle p) := fun k => honTo (hpinv.onPlane k)
  have hfa_p : vrelint (fragCycle fa) ∩ vpoly (fragCycle p) = ∅ :=
    vrelint_disjoint_vpoly_free hfa.size3 hpinv.size3 hfa.onPlane hfa.strictConv hpl_p
      (by rw [Set.inter_comm]; exact hrr)
  have : x ∈ vrelint (fragCycle fa) ∩ vpoly (fragCycle p) := ⟨hxfa', hxp⟩
  rw [hfa_p] at this; exact this

name: mem_getElem
statement:
theorem mem_getElem?_toList_eq (opp : Array Frag) (i : Fin opp.size) {fa : Frag}
    (h : fa ∈ opp.toList[(i : ℕ)]?.toList) : fa = opp[i]
proof:
:= by
  have hlt : (i : ℕ) < opp.toList.length := by simp [i.isLt]
  rw [List.getElem?_eq_getElem hlt] at h
  simp only [Option.toList_some, List.mem_singleton] at h
  rw [h]; simp [Array.getElem_toList]

name: pushFold_mem
statement:
theorem pushFold_mem (piece fa0 : Frag) (acc : Array Frag)
    {p : Frag}
    (hp : p ∈ (coplanarClip piece fa0).2.foldl
      (fun pd q => if q.poly.size ≥ 3 then pd.push q else pd) acc) :
    p ∈ acc ∨ (p ∈ (coplanarClip piece fa0).2 ∧ 3 ≤ p.poly.size)
proof:
:= by
  refine Array.foldl_induction
    (motive := fun _ (pd : Array Frag) =>
      p ∈ pd → p ∈ acc ∨ (p ∈ (coplanarClip piece fa0).2 ∧ 3 ≤ p.poly.size))
    (fun h => Or.inl h) ?_ hp
  intro k pd ihpd hmem
  by_cases hsz : (coplanarClip piece fa0).2[k].poly.size ≥ 3
  · rw [if_pos hsz] at hmem
    rcases Array.mem_push.mp hmem with h | h
    · exact ihpd h
    · exact Or.inr ⟨h ▸ Array.getElem_mem k.isLt, h ▸ hsz⟩
  · rw [if_neg hsz] at hmem; exact ihpd hmem

name: pushFold_mem_of_mem
statement:
theorem pushFold_mem_of_mem (piece fa0 : Frag) (acc : Array Frag)
    {p : Frag} (hp : p ∈ acc) :
    p ∈ (coplanarClip piece fa0).2.foldl
      (fun pd q => if q.poly.size ≥ 3 then pd.push q else pd) acc
proof:
:= by
  refine Array.foldl_induction
    (motive := fun _ (pd : Array Frag) => p ∈ pd) hp ?_
  intro k pd ihpd
  by_cases hsz : (coplanarClip piece fa0).2[k].poly.size ≥ 3
  · rw [if_pos hsz]; exact Array.mem_push.mpr (Or.inl ihpd)
  · rw [if_neg hsz]; exact ihpd

name: pushFold_list_mem_of_mem
statement:
theorem pushFold_list_mem_of_mem (L : List Frag) (acc : Array Frag)
    {p : Frag} (hp : p ∈ acc) :
    p ∈ L.foldl (fun pd q => if q.poly.size ≥ 3 then pd.push q else pd) acc
proof:
:= by
  induction L generalizing acc with
  | nil => simpa using hp
  | cons b L ih =>
    by_cases hb : b.poly.size ≥ 3
    · simp only [List.foldl_cons, hb, if_true]
      exact ih (acc.push b) (Array.mem_push.mpr (Or.inl hp))
    · simp only [List.foldl_cons, hb, if_false]; exact ih acc hp

name: pushFold_list_mem
statement:
theorem pushFold_list_mem (L : List Frag) (acc : Array Frag)
    {p : Frag} (hp : p ∈ L) (h3 : 3 ≤ p.poly.size) :
    p ∈ L.foldl (fun pd q => if q.poly.size ≥ 3 then pd.push q else pd) acc
proof:
:= by
  induction L generalizing acc with
  | nil => simp at hp
  | cons a L ih =>
    rcases List.mem_cons.mp hp with rfl | hpL
    · have hsz : p.poly.size ≥ 3 := h3
      simp only [List.foldl_cons, hsz, if_true]
      exact pushFold_list_mem_of_mem L (acc.push p) (Array.mem_push.mpr (Or.inr rfl))
    · by_cases ha : a.poly.size ≥ 3
      · simp only [List.foldl_cons, ha, if_true]; exact ih (acc.push a) hpL
      · simp only [List.foldl_cons, ha, if_false]; exact ih acc hpL

name: pushFold_mem_pushed
statement:
theorem pushFold_mem_pushed (piece fa0 : Frag) (acc : Array Frag)
    {p : Frag} (hp : p ∈ (coplanarClip piece fa0).2) (h3 : 3 ≤ p.poly.size) :
    p ∈ (coplanarClip piece fa0).2.foldl
      (fun pd q => if q.poly.size ≥ 3 then pd.push q else pd) acc
proof:
:= by
  rw [← Array.foldl_toList]
  exact pushFold_list_mem _ acc (Array.mem_toList.mpr hp) h3

name: pushFold_preserves_fragInv
statement:
theorem pushFold_preserves_fragInv {nt : Point} {ct : ℚ} (piece fa0 : Frag)
    (hpiece : FragInv nt ct piece) (acc : Array Frag)
    (hacc : ∀ q ∈ acc, FragInv nt ct q) {p : Frag}
    (hp : p ∈ (coplanarClip piece fa0).2.foldl
      (fun pd q => if q.poly.size ≥ 3 then pd.push q else pd) acc) :
    FragInv nt ct p
proof:
:= by
  rcases pushFold_mem piece fa0 acc hp with h | ⟨h, -⟩
  · exact hacc p h
  · exact (Proof.MeshIntersectNpo.coplanarClip_fragInv (nt := nt) (ct := ct)
      fa0 hpiece).2 p h

name: keptB_outerFold_empty
statement:
theorem keptB_outerFold_empty (fb : Frag) (opp : Array Frag) (q : Frag) :
    q ∉ (opp.foldl (fun acc fa0 =>
        if !(coplanarPlane fb.plane fa0.plane) then acc
        else
          acc.2.foldl (fun st piece =>
            if (Array.filter (fun p => decide (p.poly.size ≥ 3))
                  (coplanarClip piece fa0).1).isEmpty = true then (st.1, st.2.push piece)
            else
              (st.1, (coplanarClip piece fa0).2.foldl
                (fun pd p => if p.poly.size ≥ 3 then pd.push p else pd) st.2))
            (acc.1, #[]))
        ((#[] : Array Frag), #[fb])).1
proof:
:= by
  have hfold : ∀ q ∈ (opp.foldl (fun acc fa0 =>
        if !(coplanarPlane fb.plane fa0.plane) then acc
        else
          acc.2.foldl (fun st piece =>
            if (Array.filter (fun p => decide (p.poly.size ≥ 3))
                  (coplanarClip piece fa0).1).isEmpty = true then (st.1, st.2.push piece)
            else
              (st.1, (coplanarClip piece fa0).2.foldl
                (fun pd p => if p.poly.size ≥ 3 then pd.push p else pd) st.2))
            (acc.1, #[]))
        ((#[] : Array Frag), #[fb])).1, False := by
    refine Array.foldl_induction
      (motive := fun _ (acc : Array Frag × Array Frag) => (∀ q ∈ acc.1, False))
      (by intro q hq; simp at hq) ?_
    intro i acc ih
    by_cases hcop : (!(coplanarPlane fb.plane (opp[i]'i.isLt).plane)) = true
    · simp only [hcop, if_true]; exact ih
    · simp only [hcop, Bool.not_eq_true', Bool.not_eq_false] at hcop ⊢
      simp only [hcop, Bool.not_true, Bool.false_eq_true, if_false]
      refine Array.foldl_induction
        (motive := fun _ (st : Array Frag × Array Frag) => (∀ q ∈ st.1, False))
        (by exact ih) ?_
      intro j st ihst q hq
      by_cases hre : (Array.filter (fun p => decide (p.poly.size ≥ 3))
          (coplanarClip (acc.2[j]'j.isLt) (opp[i]'i.isLt)).1).isEmpty = true
      · simp only [hre, if_true] at hq; exact ihst _ hq
      · simp only [hre, Bool.false_eq_true, if_false] at hq; exact ihst _ hq
  exact fun hq => hfold q hq

name: resolveFragB_kept_avoids
statement:
theorem resolveFragB_kept_avoids {n : Point} {c : ℚ} (bvh : Impl.BVH.BVH) (opp : Array Frag)
    (wOpp : Array PFace) {fb : Frag} (hfb : FragInv n c fb)
    (hoppInv : ∀ fa ∈ opp, ∃ n' c', FragInv n' c' fa
      ∧ (coplanarPlane fb.plane fa.plane = true →
          ∃ ρ : ℚ, ρ ≠ 0 ∧ n' = ρ • n ∧ c' = ρ * c))
    {b : Frag} (hb : b ∈ resolveCoplanar.resolveFragB bvh fb opp wOpp)
    {fa : Frag} (hfa : fa ∈ opp) (hcop : coplanarPlane fb.plane fa.plane = true) :
    vrelint (fragCycle b) ∩ vrelint (fragCycle fa) = ∅
proof:
:= by
  haveI := hfb.neZero
  obtain ⟨n', c', hfaInv, hfaProp⟩ := hoppInv fa hfa
  obtain ⟨ρ, hρ, hn', hc'⟩ := hfaProp hcop
  
  
  have hbInv : FragInv n c b := resolveFragB_kept_fromFb bvh opp wOpp hfb hb
  
  have key : ∀ p ∈ (opp.foldl (fun acc fa0 =>
        if !(coplanarPlane fb.plane fa0.plane) then acc
        else
          acc.2.foldl (fun st piece =>
            if (Array.filter (fun q => decide (q.poly.size ≥ 3))
                  (coplanarClip piece fa0).1).isEmpty = true then (st.1, st.2.push piece)
            else
              (st.1, (coplanarClip piece fa0).2.foldl
                (fun pd q => if q.poly.size ≥ 3 then pd.push q else pd) st.2))
            (acc.1, #[]))
        ((#[] : Array Frag), #[fb])).2,
      FragInv n c p ∧ vrelint (fragCycle p) ∩ vrelint (fragCycle fa) = ∅ := by
    
    have hpropfa : ∃ ρ : ℚ, ρ ≠ 0 ∧ n' = ρ • n ∧ c' = ρ * c := ⟨ρ, hρ, hn', hc'⟩
    intro p hp
    
    suffices hmain : (fun i (acc : Array Frag × Array Frag) =>
        (∀ p ∈ acc.2, FragInv n c p)
          ∧ (fa ∈ opp.toList.take i → ∀ p ∈ acc.2,
              vrelint (fragCycle p) ∩ vrelint (fragCycle fa) = ∅)) opp.size
        (opp.foldl (fun acc fa0 =>
          if !(coplanarPlane fb.plane fa0.plane) then acc
          else
            acc.2.foldl (fun st piece =>
              if (Array.filter (fun q => decide (q.poly.size ≥ 3))
                    (coplanarClip piece fa0).1).isEmpty = true then (st.1, st.2.push piece)
              else
                (st.1, (coplanarClip piece fa0).2.foldl
                  (fun pd q => if q.poly.size ≥ 3 then pd.push q else pd) st.2))
              (acc.1, #[]))
          ((#[] : Array Frag), #[fb])) by
      have hfa_take : fa ∈ opp.toList.take opp.size := by
        rw [List.take_of_length_le (by simp)]; exact Array.mem_toList.mpr hfa
      exact ⟨hmain.1 p hp, hmain.2 hfa_take p hp⟩
    refine Array.foldl_induction
      (motive := fun i (acc : Array Frag × Array Frag) =>
        (∀ p ∈ acc.2, FragInv n c p)
          ∧ (fa ∈ opp.toList.take i → ∀ p ∈ acc.2,
              vrelint (fragCycle p) ∩ vrelint (fragCycle fa) = ∅))
      ⟨by intro p hp; simp only [Array.mem_singleton] at hp; rw [hp]; exact hfb,
        by intro hmem; simp at hmem⟩ ?_
    
    rintro i acc ⟨ihInv, ihAvoid⟩
    set fa0 := opp[i] with hfa0
    by_cases hcop0 : (!(coplanarPlane fb.plane fa0.plane)) = true
    · 
      simp only [hcop0, if_true]
      refine ⟨ihInv, ?_⟩
      intro hmem p hp
      
      
      rw [List.take_succ] at hmem
      rcases List.mem_append.mp hmem with h | h
      · exact ihAvoid h p hp
      · 
        exfalso
        have hfafa0 : fa = fa0 := mem_getElem?_toList_eq opp i h
        rw [hfafa0] at hcop
        rw [hcop] at hcop0; simp at hcop0
    · 
      simp only [hcop0, Bool.not_eq_true', Bool.not_eq_false] at hcop0 ⊢
      simp only [hcop0, Bool.not_true, Bool.false_eq_true, if_false]
      
      refine Array.foldl_induction
        (motive := fun _ (st : Array Frag × Array Frag) =>
          (∀ p ∈ st.2, FragInv n c p)
            ∧ (fa ∈ opp.toList.take (i + 1) → ∀ p ∈ st.2,
                vrelint (fragCycle p) ∩ vrelint (fragCycle fa) = ∅))
        ⟨by intro p hp; simp at hp, by intro _ p hp; simp at hp⟩ ?_
      rintro j st ⟨jInv, jAvoid⟩
      set piece := acc.2[j] with hpiece
      have hpieceInv : FragInv n c piece := ihInv piece (Array.getElem_mem j.isLt)
      haveI := hpieceInv.neZero
      by_cases hre : (Array.filter (fun q => decide (q.poly.size ≥ 3))
          (coplanarClip piece fa0).1).isEmpty = true
      · 
        simp only [hre, if_true]
        refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
        · intro p hp
          rcases Array.mem_push.mp hp with h | h
          · exact jInv p h
          · exact h ▸ hpieceInv
        · intro hmem p hp
          rcases Array.mem_push.mp hp with h | h
          · exact jAvoid hmem p h
          · 
            subst h
            rw [List.take_succ] at hmem
            rcases List.mem_append.mp hmem with hin | hin
            · exact ihAvoid hin piece (Array.getElem_mem j.isLt)
            · 
              have hfafa0 : fa = fa0 := by
                exact mem_getElem?_toList_eq opp i hin
              have hov : overlaps piece fa0 = false := by
                rw [Bool.eq_false_iff]
                intro hovt
                rw [overlaps_iff_exists_size3] at hovt
                obtain ⟨pp, hpp, hpp3⟩ := hovt
                have hppf : pp ∈ Array.filter (fun q => decide (q.poly.size ≥ 3))
                    (coplanarClip piece fa0).1 :=
                  Array.mem_filter.mpr ⟨hpp, by simpa using hpp3⟩
                rw [Array.isEmpty] at hre
                simp only [decide_eq_true_eq] at hre
                rw [Array.eq_empty_of_size_eq_zero hre] at hppf
                simp at hppf
              have hfaInv0 : FragInv n' c' fa0 := hfafa0 ▸ hfaInv
              rw [hfafa0]
              exact overlaps_false_relint_disjoint_free hpieceInv hfaInv0 hpropfa hov
      · 
        simp only [hre, Bool.false_eq_true, if_false]
        refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
        · 
          intro p hp
          exact pushFold_preserves_fragInv piece fa0 hpieceInv st.2 jInv hp
        · intro hmem p hp
          
          have hsplit := pushFold_mem piece fa0 st.2 hp
          rcases hsplit with hold | ⟨hcompmem, -⟩
          · 
            exact jAvoid hmem p hold
          · 
            rw [List.take_succ] at hmem
            rcases List.mem_append.mp hmem with hin | hin
            · 
              have hpieceAvoid := ihAvoid hin piece (Array.getElem_mem j.isLt)
              have hsub := coplanarClip_piece_vrelint_subset hpieceInv (Or.inr hcompmem)
              rw [Set.eq_empty_iff_forall_not_mem]
              rintro x ⟨hx1, hx2⟩
              rw [Set.eq_empty_iff_forall_not_mem] at hpieceAvoid
              exact hpieceAvoid x ⟨hsub hx1, hx2⟩
            · 
              have hfafa0 : fa = fa0 := mem_getElem?_toList_eq opp i hin
              have hfaInv0 : FragInv n' c' fa0 := hfafa0 ▸ hfaInv
              have hvp := coplanarClip_comp_relint_disjoint_fb_free hpieceInv hfaInv0 hcompmem
              rw [hfafa0, Set.eq_empty_iff_forall_not_mem]
              rintro x ⟨hx1, hx2⟩
              rw [Set.eq_empty_iff_forall_not_mem] at hvp
              exact hvp x ⟨hx1, vrelint_subset_vpoly _ hx2⟩
  
  unfold resolveCoplanar.resolveFragB at hb
  rcases Array.mem_append.mp hb with hbk | hbf
  · 
    exact absurd hbk (keptB_outerFold_empty fb opp _)
  · obtain ⟨hpf, -⟩ := Array.mem_filter.mp hbf
    exact (key b hpf).2

name: resolveFragPending_fragInv
statement:
theorem resolveFragPending_fragInv (opp : Array Frag)
    {nt : Point} {ct : ℚ} {fa : Frag} (hfa : FragInv nt ct fa) :
    ∀ p ∈ resolveFragPending fa opp, FragInv nt ct p
proof:
:= by
  unfold resolveFragPending
  refine Array.foldl_induction
    (motive := fun i (acc : Array Frag × Array Frag) =>
      (∀ f' ∈ acc.1, FragInv nt ct f') ∧ (∀ f' ∈ acc.2, FragInv nt ct f'))
    ⟨by simp, by intro f' hf'; simp only [Array.mem_singleton] at hf'; exact hf' ▸ hfa⟩ ?_ |>.2
  intro i acc ih
  obtain ⟨ihK, ihP⟩ := ih
  by_cases hcop : (!(coplanarPlane fa.plane (opp[i]'i.isLt).plane)) = true
  · simp only [hcop, if_true]; exact ⟨ihK, ihP⟩
  · simp only [hcop, Bool.not_eq_true', Bool.not_eq_false] at hcop ⊢
    simp only [hcop, Bool.not_true, Bool.false_eq_true, if_false]
    refine Array.foldl_induction
      (motive := fun j (st : Array Frag × Array Frag) =>
        (∀ f' ∈ st.1, FragInv nt ct f') ∧ (∀ f' ∈ st.2, FragInv nt ct f'))
      (by exact ⟨ihK, fun f' hf' => absurd hf' (Array.not_mem_empty f')⟩) ?_
    intro j st ihst
    obtain ⟨hst1, hst2⟩ := ihst
    have hpiece : FragInv nt ct (acc.2[j]'j.isLt) := ihP _ (Array.getElem_mem j.isLt)
    exact Proof.MeshIntersectNpo.resolveStep_fragInv (nt := nt) (ct := ct) (opp[i]'i.isLt) (acc.2[j]'j.isLt)
      (sameOrient fa.plane (opp[i]'i.isLt).plane) hpiece hst1 hst2

name: resolveFragPending_vpoly_subset_fa
statement:
theorem resolveFragPending_vpoly_subset_fa (opp : Array Frag)
    {nt : Point} {ct : ℚ} {fa : Frag} (hfa : FragInv nt ct fa)
    {p : Frag} (hp : p ∈ resolveFragPending fa opp) :
    vpoly (fragCycle p) ⊆ vpoly (fragCycle fa)
proof:
:= by
  rw [resolveFragPending] at hp
  refine (Array.foldl_induction
    (motive := fun i (acc : Array Frag × Array Frag) =>
      (∀ f' ∈ acc.1, FragInv nt ct f' ∧ vpoly (fragCycle f') ⊆ vpoly (fragCycle fa))
        ∧ (∀ f' ∈ acc.2, FragInv nt ct f' ∧ vpoly (fragCycle f') ⊆ vpoly (fragCycle fa)))
    (init := ((#[] : Array Frag), #[fa]))
    ⟨by intro f' hf'; simp at hf', by
      intro f' hf'; simp only [Array.mem_singleton] at hf'
      subst hf'; exact ⟨hfa, le_refl _⟩⟩ ?_).2 p hp |>.2
  intro i acc ih
  obtain ⟨ihK, ihP⟩ := ih
  by_cases hcop : (!(coplanarPlane fa.plane (opp[i]'i.isLt).plane)) = true
  · simp only [hcop, if_true]; exact ⟨ihK, ihP⟩
  · simp only [hcop, Bool.not_eq_true', Bool.not_eq_false] at hcop ⊢
    simp only [hcop, Bool.not_true, Bool.false_eq_true, if_false]
    refine Array.foldl_induction
      (motive := fun j (st : Array Frag × Array Frag) =>
        (∀ f' ∈ st.1, FragInv nt ct f' ∧ vpoly (fragCycle f') ⊆ vpoly (fragCycle fa))
          ∧ (∀ f' ∈ st.2, FragInv nt ct f' ∧ vpoly (fragCycle f') ⊆ vpoly (fragCycle fa)))
      (init := (acc.1, #[])) ⟨ihK, by intro f' hf'; simp at hf'⟩ ?_
    intro j st ihst
    obtain ⟨hst1, hst2⟩ := ihst
    obtain ⟨hpieceInv, hpieceSub⟩ := ihP _ (Array.getElem_mem j.isLt)
    set piece := acc.2[j]'j.isLt with hpd
    have hstep := resolveStep_vpoly_subset fa (opp[i]'i.isLt) piece
      (sameOrient fa.plane (opp[i]'i.isLt).plane) hpieceInv hpieceSub
      (fun f' hf' => (hst1 f' hf').2)
      (fun f' hf' => (hst2 f' hf').2)
    have hstepInv := Proof.MeshIntersectNpo.resolveStep_fragInv (nt := nt) (ct := ct)
      (opp[i]'i.isLt) piece (sameOrient fa.plane (opp[i]'i.isLt).plane) hpieceInv
      (fun f' hf' => (hst1 f' hf').1) (fun f' hf' => (hst2 f' hf').1)
    exact ⟨fun f' hf' => ⟨hstepInv.1 f' hf', hstep.1 f' hf'⟩,
      fun f' hf' => ⟨hstepInv.2 f' hf', hstep.2 f' hf'⟩⟩

name: resolveFragPending_fragProv
statement:
theorem resolveFragPending_fragProv (opp : Array Frag)
    {nt : Point} {r₀ : ℕ} [NeZero r₀] {w₀ : Fin r₀ → Point} {L : List IPlane}
    {ct : ℚ} {fa : Frag} (hfaInv : FragInv nt ct fa)
    (hfaProv : FragProv nt w₀ L fa)
    (hLopp : ∀ fb ∈ opp, coplanarPlane fa.plane fb.plane = true →
      ∀ g ∈ edgePlanesOf fb, g ∈ L) :
    ∀ p ∈ resolveFragPending fa opp, FragProv nt w₀ L p
proof:
:= by
  intro p hp
  rw [resolveFragPending] at hp
  refine (Array.foldl_induction
    (motive := fun i (acc : Array Frag × Array Frag) =>
      ((∀ f' ∈ acc.1, FragInv nt ct f') ∧ (∀ f' ∈ acc.2, FragInv nt ct f'))
        ∧ ((∀ f' ∈ acc.1, FragProv nt w₀ L f') ∧ (∀ f' ∈ acc.2, FragProv nt w₀ L f')))
    (init := ((#[] : Array Frag), #[fa]))
    ⟨⟨by simp, by intro f' hf'; simp only [Array.mem_singleton] at hf'; subst hf'; exact hfaInv⟩,
      ⟨by simp, by intro f' hf'; simp only [Array.mem_singleton] at hf'; subst hf'; exact hfaProv⟩⟩ ?_).2.2 p hp
  intro i acc ih
  obtain ⟨⟨ihKInv, ihPInv⟩, ihKProv, ihPProv⟩ := ih
  by_cases hcop : (!(coplanarPlane fa.plane opp[i].plane)) = true
  · simp only [hcop, if_true]; exact ⟨⟨ihKInv, ihPInv⟩, ihKProv, ihPProv⟩
  · have hcopT : coplanarPlane fa.plane opp[i].plane = true := by simpa using hcop
    simp only [hcop, Bool.not_eq_true', Bool.not_eq_false] at hcop ⊢
    simp only [hcop, Bool.not_true, Bool.false_eq_true, if_false]
    have hLi : ∀ g ∈ edgePlanesOf opp[i], g ∈ L :=
      hLopp opp[i] (Array.getElem_mem i.isLt) hcopT
    refine Array.foldl_induction
      (motive := fun j (st : Array Frag × Array Frag) =>
        ((∀ f' ∈ st.1, FragInv nt ct f') ∧ (∀ f' ∈ st.2, FragInv nt ct f'))
          ∧ ((∀ f' ∈ st.1, FragProv nt w₀ L f') ∧ (∀ f' ∈ st.2, FragProv nt w₀ L f')))
      (init := (acc.1, #[]))
      ⟨⟨ihKInv, fun f' hf' => absurd hf' (Array.not_mem_empty f')⟩,
        ⟨ihKProv, fun f' hf' => absurd hf' (Array.not_mem_empty f')⟩⟩ ?_
    intro j st ihst
    obtain ⟨⟨hst1Inv, hst2Inv⟩, hst1Prov, hst2Prov⟩ := ihst
    set fbi := opp[i] with hfbi
    set piece := acc.2[j] with hpiecej
    have hpieceInv : FragInv nt ct piece := ihPInv _ (hpiecej ▸ Array.getElem_mem j.isLt)
    have hpieceProv : FragProv nt w₀ L piece := ihPProv _ (hpiecej ▸ Array.getElem_mem j.isLt)
    refine ⟨Proof.MeshIntersectNpo.resolveStep_fragInv (nt := nt) (ct := ct) fbi piece
      (sameOrient fa.plane fbi.plane) hpieceInv hst1Inv hst2Inv,
      Proof.MeshIntersectNpo.resolveStep_fragProv (nt := nt) (ct := ct) (w₀ := w₀) (L := L)
        fbi piece (sameOrient fa.plane fbi.plane) hpieceInv hpieceProv hLi hst1Prov hst2Prov⟩

name: resolveFrag_pending_avoids
statement:
theorem resolveFrag_pending_avoids {n : Point} {c : ℚ} (opp : Array Frag)
    {fa : Frag} (hfa : FragInv n c fa)
    (hoppInv : ∀ fa' ∈ opp, ∃ n' c', FragInv n' c' fa'
      ∧ (coplanarPlane fa.plane fa'.plane = true →
          ∃ ρ : ℚ, ρ ≠ 0 ∧ n' = ρ • n ∧ c' = ρ * c))
    {fa' : Frag} (hfa' : fa' ∈ opp)
    (hcop : coplanarPlane fa.plane fa'.plane = true)
    {p : Frag} (hp : p ∈ resolveFragPending fa opp) :
    vrelint (fragCycle p) ∩ vrelint (fragCycle fa') = ∅
proof:
:= by
  haveI := hfa.neZero
  obtain ⟨n', c', hfa'Inv, hfa'Prop⟩ := hoppInv fa' hfa'
  obtain ⟨ρ, hρ, hn', hc'⟩ := hfa'Prop hcop
  rw [resolveFragPending] at hp
  refine And.right (a := FragInv n c p) ?_
  revert p
  
  show ∀ p ∈ _, FragInv n c p ∧ vrelint (fragCycle p) ∩ vrelint (fragCycle fa') = ∅
  
  have hpropfa : ∃ ρ : ℚ, ρ ≠ 0 ∧ n' = ρ • n ∧ c' = ρ * c := ⟨ρ, hρ, hn', hc'⟩
  intro p hp
  
  · suffices hmain : (fun i (acc : Array Frag × Array Frag) =>
        (∀ p ∈ acc.2, FragInv n c p)
          ∧ (fa' ∈ opp.toList.take i → ∀ p ∈ acc.2,
              vrelint (fragCycle p) ∩ vrelint (fragCycle fa') = ∅)) opp.size
        (opp.foldl (fun acc fb0 =>
          if !(coplanarPlane fa.plane fb0.plane) then acc
          else
            acc.2.foldl (fun st piece =>
              if (Array.filter (fun q => decide (q.poly.size ≥ 3))
                    (coplanarClip piece fb0).1).isEmpty = true then (st.1, st.2.push piece)
              else
                (if sameOrient fa.plane fb0.plane = true then
                    st.1 ++ Array.filter (fun q => decide (q.poly.size ≥ 3)) (coplanarClip piece fb0).1
                  else st.1,
                  (coplanarClip piece fb0).2.foldl
                    (fun pd q => if q.poly.size ≥ 3 then pd.push q else pd) st.2))
              (acc.1, #[]))
          ((#[] : Array Frag), #[fa])) by
      have hfa_take : fa' ∈ opp.toList.take opp.size := by
        rw [List.take_of_length_le (by simp)]; exact Array.mem_toList.mpr hfa'
      exact ⟨hmain.1 p hp, hmain.2 hfa_take p hp⟩
    refine Array.foldl_induction
      (motive := fun i (acc : Array Frag × Array Frag) =>
        (∀ p ∈ acc.2, FragInv n c p)
          ∧ (fa' ∈ opp.toList.take i → ∀ p ∈ acc.2,
              vrelint (fragCycle p) ∩ vrelint (fragCycle fa') = ∅))
      ⟨by intro p hp; simp only [Array.mem_singleton] at hp; rw [hp]; exact hfa,
        by intro hmem; simp at hmem⟩ ?_
    
    rintro i acc ⟨ihInv, ihAvoid⟩
    set fb0 := opp[i] with hfb0
    by_cases hcop0 : (!(coplanarPlane fa.plane fb0.plane)) = true
    · 
      simp only [hcop0, if_true]
      refine ⟨ihInv, ?_⟩
      intro hmem p hp
      
      
      rw [List.take_succ] at hmem
      rcases List.mem_append.mp hmem with h | h
      · exact ihAvoid h p hp
      · 
        exfalso
        have hfafa0 : fa' = fb0 := mem_getElem?_toList_eq opp i h
        rw [hfafa0] at hcop
        rw [hcop] at hcop0; simp at hcop0
    · 
      simp only [hcop0, Bool.not_eq_true', Bool.not_eq_false] at hcop0 ⊢
      simp only [hcop0, Bool.not_true, Bool.false_eq_true, if_false]
      
      refine Array.foldl_induction
        (motive := fun _ (st : Array Frag × Array Frag) =>
          (∀ p ∈ st.2, FragInv n c p)
            ∧ (fa' ∈ opp.toList.take (i + 1) → ∀ p ∈ st.2,
                vrelint (fragCycle p) ∩ vrelint (fragCycle fa') = ∅))
        ⟨by intro p hp; simp at hp, by intro _ p hp; simp at hp⟩ ?_
      rintro j st ⟨jInv, jAvoid⟩
      set piece := acc.2[j] with hpiece
      have hpieceInv : FragInv n c piece := ihInv piece (Array.getElem_mem j.isLt)
      haveI := hpieceInv.neZero
      by_cases hre : (Array.filter (fun q => decide (q.poly.size ≥ 3))
          (coplanarClip piece fb0).1).isEmpty = true
      · 
        simp only [hre, if_true]
        refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
        · intro p hp
          rcases Array.mem_push.mp hp with h | h
          · exact jInv p h
          · exact h ▸ hpieceInv
        · intro hmem p hp
          rcases Array.mem_push.mp hp with h | h
          · exact jAvoid hmem p h
          · 
            subst h
            rw [List.take_succ] at hmem
            rcases List.mem_append.mp hmem with hin | hin
            · exact ihAvoid hin piece (Array.getElem_mem j.isLt)
            · 
              have hfafa0 : fa' = fb0 := by
                exact mem_getElem?_toList_eq opp i hin
              have hov : overlaps piece fb0 = false := by
                rw [Bool.eq_false_iff]
                intro hovt
                rw [overlaps_iff_exists_size3] at hovt
                obtain ⟨pp, hpp, hpp3⟩ := hovt
                have hppf : pp ∈ Array.filter (fun q => decide (q.poly.size ≥ 3))
                    (coplanarClip piece fb0).1 :=
                  Array.mem_filter.mpr ⟨hpp, by simpa using hpp3⟩
                rw [Array.isEmpty] at hre
                simp only [decide_eq_true_eq] at hre
                rw [Array.eq_empty_of_size_eq_zero hre] at hppf
                simp at hppf
              have hfaInv0 : FragInv n' c' fb0 := hfafa0 ▸ hfa'Inv
              rw [hfafa0]
              exact overlaps_false_relint_disjoint_free hpieceInv hfaInv0 hpropfa hov
      · 
        simp only [hre, Bool.false_eq_true, if_false]
        refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
        · 
          intro p hp
          exact pushFold_preserves_fragInv piece fb0 hpieceInv st.2 jInv hp
        · intro hmem p hp
          
          have hsplit := pushFold_mem piece fb0 st.2 hp
          rcases hsplit with hold | ⟨hcompmem, -⟩
          · 
            exact jAvoid hmem p hold
          · 
            rw [List.take_succ] at hmem
            rcases List.mem_append.mp hmem with hin | hin
            · 
              have hpieceAvoid := ihAvoid hin piece (Array.getElem_mem j.isLt)
              have hsub := coplanarClip_piece_vrelint_subset hpieceInv (Or.inr hcompmem)
              rw [Set.eq_empty_iff_forall_not_mem]
              rintro x ⟨hx1, hx2⟩
              rw [Set.eq_empty_iff_forall_not_mem] at hpieceAvoid
              exact hpieceAvoid x ⟨hsub hx1, hx2⟩
            · 
              have hfafa0 : fa' = fb0 := mem_getElem?_toList_eq opp i hin
              have hfaInv0 : FragInv n' c' fb0 := hfafa0 ▸ hfa'Inv
              have hvp := coplanarClip_comp_relint_disjoint_fb_free hpieceInv hfaInv0 hcompmem
              rw [hfafa0, Set.eq_empty_iff_forall_not_mem]
              rintro x ⟨hx1, hx2⟩
              rw [Set.eq_empty_iff_forall_not_mem] at hvp
              exact hvp x ⟨hx1, vrelint_subset_vpoly _ hx2⟩

name: resolveFrag_cover
statement:
theorem resolveFrag_cover {n : Point} {c : ℚ} (opp : Array Frag)
    {fa : Frag} (hfa : FragInv n c fa)
    (hoppInv : ∀ fb ∈ opp, ∃ n' c', FragInv n' c' fb
      ∧ (coplanarPlane fa.plane fb.plane = true →
          ∃ ρ : ℚ, ρ ≠ 0 ∧ n' = ρ • n ∧ c' = ρ * c))
    {x : Point} (hx : x ∈ vpoly (fragCycle fa))
    (hxov : ∀ fb ∈ opp, x ∉ vpoly (fragCycle fb)) :
    ∃ p ∈ resolveFragPending fa opp, x ∈ vpoly (fragCycle p)
proof:
:= by
  haveI := hfa.neZero
  rw [resolveFragPending]
  
  suffices hmain : (fun (_ : ℕ) (acc : Array Frag × Array Frag) =>
      (∀ p ∈ acc.2, FragInv n c p)
        ∧ (∃ p ∈ acc.2, x ∈ vpoly (fragCycle p))) opp.size
      (opp.foldl (fun acc fb0 =>
          if !(coplanarPlane fa.plane fb0.plane) then acc
          else
            acc.2.foldl (fun st piece =>
              if (Array.filter (fun q => decide (q.poly.size ≥ 3))
                    (coplanarClip piece fb0).1).isEmpty = true then (st.1, st.2.push piece)
              else
                (if sameOrient fa.plane fb0.plane = true then
                    st.1 ++ Array.filter (fun q => decide (q.poly.size ≥ 3)) (coplanarClip piece fb0).1
                  else st.1,
                  (coplanarClip piece fb0).2.foldl
                    (fun pd q => if q.poly.size ≥ 3 then pd.push q else pd) st.2))
              (acc.1, #[]))
          ((#[] : Array Frag), #[fa])) by
    exact hmain.2
  refine Array.foldl_induction
    (motive := fun i (acc : Array Frag × Array Frag) =>
      (∀ p ∈ acc.2, FragInv n c p)
        ∧ (∃ p ∈ acc.2, x ∈ vpoly (fragCycle p)))
    ⟨by intro p hp; simp only [Array.mem_singleton] at hp; rw [hp]; exact hfa,
      ⟨fa, by simp, hx⟩⟩ ?_
  rintro i acc ⟨ihInv, ihCov⟩
  set fb0 := opp[i] with hfb0
  by_cases hcop0 : (!(coplanarPlane fa.plane fb0.plane)) = true
  · simp only [hcop0, if_true]; exact ⟨ihInv, ihCov⟩
  · have hcopT : coplanarPlane fa.plane fb0.plane = true := by simpa using hcop0
    simp only [show (!(coplanarPlane fa.plane fb0.plane)) = false from by rw [hcopT]; rfl,
      Bool.false_eq_true, if_false]
    
    have hxfb0 : x ∉ vpoly (fragCycle fb0) := hxov fb0 (Array.getElem_mem i.isLt)
    obtain ⟨n', c', hfb0Inv, hprop⟩ := hoppInv fb0 (Array.getElem_mem i.isLt)
    obtain ⟨ρ, hρ, hn', hc'⟩ := hprop hcopT
    
    
    
    
    have hinner := Array.foldl_induction (as := acc.2)
      (f := fun (st : Array Frag × Array Frag) piece =>
        if (Array.filter (fun q => decide (q.poly.size ≥ 3))
              (coplanarClip piece fb0).1).isEmpty = true then (st.1, st.2.push piece)
        else
          (if sameOrient fa.plane fb0.plane = true then
              st.1 ++ Array.filter (fun q => decide (q.poly.size ≥ 3)) (coplanarClip piece fb0).1
            else st.1,
            (coplanarClip piece fb0).2.foldl
              (fun pd q => if q.poly.size ≥ 3 then pd.push q else pd) st.2))
      (motive := fun j (st : Array Frag × Array Frag) =>
        (∀ p ∈ st.2, FragInv n c p)
          ∧ ((∃ p ∈ st.2, x ∈ vpoly (fragCycle p)) ∨
              ∃ q ∈ acc.2.toList.drop j, x ∈ vpoly (fragCycle q)))
      (init := (acc.1, #[]))
      (h0 := ⟨fun p hp => absurd hp (Array.not_mem_empty p), by
        rcases ihCov with ⟨q, hq, hxq⟩
        exact Or.inr ⟨q, by simpa using Array.mem_toList.mpr hq, hxq⟩⟩)
      (hf := ?_)
    · 
      refine ⟨hinner.1, ?_⟩
      rcases hinner.2 with hpend | ⟨q, hq, _⟩
      · exact hpend
      · rw [List.drop_eq_nil_of_le (by simp)] at hq; exact absurd hq (List.not_mem_nil q)
    rintro j st ⟨jInv, jCov⟩
    set piece := acc.2[j] with hpiece
    have hpieceInv : FragInv n c piece := ihInv piece (Array.getElem_mem j.isLt)
    haveI := hpieceInv.neZero
    
    have hplpiece : Proof.MeshIntersectClip.OnPlane n' c' (fragCycle piece) := by
      intro k
      rw [hn', hc', Proof.MeshIntersectCoplanarClip.dotQ_smul_left, hpieceInv.onPlane k]
    
    have hdrop : acc.2.toList.drop (j : ℕ)
        = piece :: acc.2.toList.drop ((j : ℕ) + 1) := by
      rw [List.drop_eq_getElem_cons (l := acc.2.toList) (by simp [j.isLt]), hpiece]
      simp [Array.getElem_toList]
    by_cases hre : (Array.filter (fun q => decide (q.poly.size ≥ 3))
        (coplanarClip piece fb0).1).isEmpty = true
    · 
      simp only [hre, if_true]
      refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
      · intro p hp
        rcases Array.mem_push.mp hp with h | h
        · exact jInv p h
        · exact h ▸ hpieceInv
      · 
        rcases jCov with ⟨p, hp, hxp⟩ | htail
        · exact Or.inl ⟨p, Array.mem_push.mpr (Or.inl hp), hxp⟩
        · 
          obtain ⟨q, hq, hxq⟩ := htail
          rw [hdrop, List.mem_cons] at hq
          rcases hq with hqp | hq
          · rw [hqp] at hxq; exact Or.inl ⟨piece, Array.mem_push.mpr (Or.inr rfl), hxq⟩
          · exact Or.inr ⟨q, hq, hxq⟩
    · 
      simp only [hre, Bool.false_eq_true, if_false]
      refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
      · 
        intro p hp
        exact pushFold_preserves_fragInv piece fb0 hpieceInv st.2 jInv hp
      · 
        rcases jCov with ⟨p, hp, hxp⟩ | htail
        · 
          exact Or.inl ⟨p, pushFold_mem_of_mem piece fb0 st.2 hp, hxp⟩
        · 
          obtain ⟨q, hq, hxq⟩ := htail
          rw [hdrop, List.mem_cons] at hq
          rcases hq with hqp | hq
          · 
            rw [hqp] at hxq
            rcases (coplanarClip_cover hpieceInv x).mpr hxq with ⟨ov, hov, hxov'⟩ | ⟨cp, hcp, hxcp⟩
            · 
              exact absurd (coplanarClip_inside_vpoly_subset_fb_free hpieceInv hfb0Inv hplpiece hov
                hxov') hxfb0
            · 
              have hcp3 : 3 ≤ cp.poly.size :=
                (Proof.MeshIntersectNpo.coplanarClip_fragInv (nt := n) (ct := c)
                  fb0 hpieceInv).2 cp hcp |>.size3
              exact Or.inl ⟨cp, pushFold_mem_pushed piece fb0 st.2 hcp hcp3, hxcp⟩
          · 
            exact Or.inr ⟨q, hq, hxq⟩

name: mem_resolveFrag_of_pending_keepFallback
statement:
theorem mem_resolveFrag_of_pending_keepFallback (bvh : Impl.BVH.BVH) (fa : Frag) (opp : Array Frag)
    (wOpp : Array PFace) {p : Frag} (hp : p ∈ resolveFragPending fa opp)
    (hkeep : keepFallback bvh wOpp p = true) :
    p ∈ resolveFrag bvh fa opp wOpp
proof:
:= by
  unfold resolveFrag
  simp only
  rw [Array.mem_append]
  exact Or.inr (Array.mem_filter.mpr ⟨hp, by simpa using hkeep⟩)

name: coplanarPlane_of_sameOrient
statement:
theorem coplanarPlane_of_sameOrient {g h : IPlane}
    (hso : sameOrient g h = true) : coplanarPlane g h = true
proof:
:= by
  have hpd : IPlane.primDir g = IPlane.primDir h := by
    have hh := hso
    simp only [sameOrient, beqIPlane, Bool.and_eq_true, beq_iff_eq] at hh
    rcases hpg : IPlane.primDir g with ⟨a1, b1, c1, d1⟩
    rcases hph : IPlane.primDir h with ⟨a2, b2, c2, d2⟩
    rw [hpg, hph] at hh
    obtain ⟨⟨⟨ha, hb⟩, hc⟩, hd⟩ := hh
    simp_all
  simp only [coplanarPlane, IPlane.prim, hpd, beqIPlane, beq_self_eq_true, Bool.and_self]

name: resolveFrag_kept_cover
statement:
theorem resolveFrag_kept_cover {n : Point} {c : ℚ} (opp : Array Frag)
    {fa : Frag} (hfa : FragInv n c fa)
    (hoppInv : ∀ fb ∈ opp, ∃ n' c', FragInv n' c' fb
      ∧ (coplanarPlane fa.plane fb.plane = true →
          ∃ ρ : ℚ, ρ ≠ 0 ∧ n' = ρ • n ∧ c' = ρ * c))
    {x : Point} (hx : x ∈ vpoly (fragCycle fa))
    {fb₀ : Frag} (hfb₀ : fb₀ ∈ opp)
    (hso₀ : sameOrient fa.plane fb₀.plane = true)
    (hxrel : x ∈ vrelint (fragCycle fb₀))
    (hxdrop : ∀ fb ∈ opp, coplanarPlane fa.plane fb.plane = true →
        sameOrient fa.plane fb.plane = false → x ∉ vpoly (fragCycle fb)) :
    ∃ p ∈ resolveFragKept fa opp, x ∈ vpoly (fragCycle p)
proof:
:= by
  haveI := hfa.neZero
  have hcop₀ : coplanarPlane fa.plane fb₀.plane = true := coplanarPlane_of_sameOrient hso₀
  rw [resolveFragKept]
  
  
  have hmain := Array.foldl_induction (as := opp)
    (f := fun (acc : Array Frag × Array Frag) fb0 =>
        if !(coplanarPlane fa.plane fb0.plane) then acc
        else
          acc.2.foldl (fun st piece =>
            if (Array.filter (fun q => decide (q.poly.size ≥ 3))
                  (coplanarClip piece fb0).1).isEmpty = true then (st.1, st.2.push piece)
            else
              (if sameOrient fa.plane fb0.plane = true then
                  st.1 ++ Array.filter (fun q => decide (q.poly.size ≥ 3)) (coplanarClip piece fb0).1
                else st.1,
                (coplanarClip piece fb0).2.foldl
                  (fun pd q => if q.poly.size ≥ 3 then pd.push q else pd) st.2))
            (acc.1, #[]))
    (motive := fun i (acc : Array Frag × Array Frag) =>
      (∀ p ∈ acc.2, FragInv n c p)
        ∧ ((∃ p ∈ acc.1, x ∈ vpoly (fragCycle p)) ∨
            (fb₀ ∉ opp.toList.take i ∧ ∃ p ∈ acc.2, x ∈ vpoly (fragCycle p))))
    (init := ((#[] : Array Frag), #[fa]))
    (h0 := ⟨by intro p hp; simp only [Array.mem_singleton] at hp; rw [hp]; exact hfa,
      Or.inr ⟨by simp, ⟨fa, by simp, hx⟩⟩⟩)
    (hf := ?_)
  · 
    obtain ⟨_, hcov⟩ := hmain
    rcases hcov with hkept | ⟨hnotin, _⟩
    · exact hkept
    · exact absurd (by simpa using Array.mem_toList.mpr hfb₀) hnotin
  
  rintro i acc ⟨ihInv, ihCov⟩
  set fb0 := opp[i] with hfb0def
  by_cases hcop0 : (!(coplanarPlane fa.plane fb0.plane)) = true
  · 
    simp only [hcop0, if_true]
    have hne0 : fb₀ ≠ fb0 := by
      intro h; rw [h] at hcop₀; rw [hcop₀] at hcop0; simp at hcop0
    have hsplit : List.take (↑i + 1) opp.toList
        = List.take (↑i) opp.toList ++ [fb0] := by
      have h := @List.take_succ _ opp.toList (i : ℕ)
      rw [getElem?_pos opp.toList (i : ℕ) (by simp only [Array.length_toList]; exact i.isLt)] at h
      rw [h, Array.getElem_toList]; rfl
    refine ⟨ihInv, ?_⟩
    rcases ihCov with hkept | ⟨hnotin, hpend⟩
    · exact Or.inl hkept
    · refine Or.inr ⟨?_, hpend⟩
      rw [hsplit]
      intro hmem
      rcases List.mem_append.mp hmem with h | h
      · exact hnotin h
      · exact hne0 (by simpa using h)
  · 
    have hcopT : coplanarPlane fa.plane fb0.plane = true := by simpa using hcop0
    simp only [show (!(coplanarPlane fa.plane fb0.plane)) = false from by rw [hcopT]; rfl,
      Bool.false_eq_true, if_false]
    obtain ⟨n', c', hfb0Inv, hprop⟩ := hoppInv fb0 (Array.getElem_mem i.isLt)
    obtain ⟨ρ, hρ, hn', hc'⟩ := hprop hcopT
    have hsplit : List.take (↑i + 1) opp.toList
        = List.take (↑i) opp.toList ++ [fb0] := by
      have h := @List.take_succ _ opp.toList (i : ℕ)
      rw [getElem?_pos opp.toList (i : ℕ) (by simp only [Array.length_toList]; exact i.isLt)] at h
      rw [h, Array.getElem_toList]; rfl
    
    
    have hinner := Array.foldl_induction (as := acc.2)
      (f := fun (st : Array Frag × Array Frag) piece =>
        if (Array.filter (fun q => decide (q.poly.size ≥ 3))
              (coplanarClip piece fb0).1).isEmpty = true then (st.1, st.2.push piece)
        else
          (if sameOrient fa.plane fb0.plane = true then
              st.1 ++ Array.filter (fun q => decide (q.poly.size ≥ 3)) (coplanarClip piece fb0).1
            else st.1,
            (coplanarClip piece fb0).2.foldl
              (fun pd q => if q.poly.size ≥ 3 then pd.push q else pd) st.2))
      (motive := fun j (st : Array Frag × Array Frag) =>
        (∀ p ∈ st.2, FragInv n c p)
          ∧ ((∃ p ∈ st.1, x ∈ vpoly (fragCycle p)) ∨
              ((fb0 ≠ fb₀ ∧ fb₀ ∉ opp.toList.take i) ∧ ∃ p ∈ st.2, x ∈ vpoly (fragCycle p)) ∨
              (fb₀ ∉ opp.toList.take i ∧ ∃ q ∈ acc.2.toList.drop j, x ∈ vpoly (fragCycle q))))
      (init := (acc.1, #[]))
      (h0 := ⟨fun p hp => absurd hp (Array.not_mem_empty p), by
        rcases ihCov with ⟨q, hq, hxq⟩ | ⟨hnotin, q, hq, hxq⟩
        · exact Or.inl ⟨q, hq, hxq⟩
        · exact Or.inr (Or.inr ⟨hnotin, q, by simpa using Array.mem_toList.mpr hq, hxq⟩)⟩)
      (hf := ?_)
    · 
      refine ⟨hinner.1, ?_⟩
      rcases hinner.2 with hkept | hmid | ⟨_, q, hq, _⟩
      · exact Or.inl hkept
      · obtain ⟨⟨hne, hnotin⟩, hpend⟩ := hmid
        refine Or.inr ⟨?_, hpend⟩
        rw [hsplit]
        intro hmem
        rcases List.mem_append.mp hmem with h | h
        · exact hnotin h
        · have heq : fb₀ = fb0 := by simpa using h
          exact hne heq.symm
      · rw [List.drop_eq_nil_of_le (by simp)] at hq; exact absurd hq (List.not_mem_nil q)
    
    rintro j st ⟨jInv, jCov⟩
    set piece := acc.2[j] with hpiecedef
    have hpieceInv : FragInv n c piece := ihInv piece (Array.getElem_mem j.isLt)
    haveI := hpieceInv.neZero
    
    have hplpiece : Proof.MeshIntersectClip.OnPlane n' c' (fragCycle piece) := by
      intro k
      rw [hn', hc', Proof.MeshIntersectCoplanarClip.dotQ_smul_left, hpieceInv.onPlane k]
    have hdrop : acc.2.toList.drop (j : ℕ)
        = piece :: acc.2.toList.drop ((j : ℕ) + 1) := by
      rw [List.drop_eq_getElem_cons (l := acc.2.toList) (by simp [j.isLt]), hpiecedef]
      simp [Array.getElem_toList]
    
    
    
    have comp_off_fb0_flip : ∀ cp ∈ (coplanarClip piece fb0).2,
        vrelint (fragCycle fb0) ∩ vpoly (fragCycle cp) = ∅ := by
      intro cp hcp
      haveI := hfb0Inv.neZero
      have hcpInv : FragInv n c cp :=
        (Proof.MeshIntersectNpo.coplanarClip_fragInv (nt := n) (ct := c) fb0 hpieceInv).2 cp hcp
      haveI := hcpInv.neZero
      have hdisj : vrelint (fragCycle cp) ∩ vpoly (fragCycle fb0) = ∅ :=
        coplanarClip_comp_relint_disjoint_fb_free hpieceInv hfb0Inv hcp
      have hrr : vrelint (fragCycle cp) ∩ vrelint (fragCycle fb0) = ∅ := by
        rw [Set.eq_empty_iff_forall_not_mem]
        rintro y ⟨hy1, hy2⟩
        have : y ∈ vrelint (fragCycle cp) ∩ vpoly (fragCycle fb0) :=
          ⟨hy1, vrelint_subset_vpoly _ hy2⟩
        rw [hdisj] at this; exact this
      have hpl_cp : Proof.MeshIntersectClip.OnPlane n' c' (fragCycle cp) := by
        intro k; rw [hn', hc', Proof.MeshIntersectCoplanarClip.dotQ_smul_left, hcpInv.onPlane k]
      exact vrelint_disjoint_vpoly_free hfb0Inv.size3 hcpInv.size3
        hfb0Inv.onPlane hfb0Inv.strictConv hpl_cp (by rw [Set.inter_comm]; exact hrr)
    by_cases hre : (Array.filter (fun q => decide (q.poly.size ≥ 3))
        (coplanarClip piece fb0).1).isEmpty = true
    · 
      simp only [hre, if_true]
      refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
      · intro p hp
        rcases Array.mem_push.mp hp with h | h
        · exact jInv p h
        · exact h ▸ hpieceInv
      · rcases jCov with hkept | hmid | htail
        · exact Or.inl hkept
        · obtain ⟨hg, p, hp, hxp⟩ := hmid
          exact Or.inr (Or.inl ⟨hg, p, Array.mem_push.mpr (Or.inl hp), hxp⟩)
        · obtain ⟨hnotin_i, q, hq, hxq⟩ := htail
          rw [hdrop, List.mem_cons] at hq
          rcases hq with hqp | hq
          · 
            
            rw [hqp] at hxq
            by_cases hib : fb0 = fb₀
            · exfalso
              
              
              have hxfb0 : x ∈ vpoly (fragCycle fb0) := hib ▸ vrelint_subset_vpoly _ hxrel
              rcases (coplanarClip_cover hpieceInv x).mpr hxq with ⟨ov, hov, hxov⟩ | ⟨cp, hcp, hxcp⟩
              · have hov3 : 3 ≤ ov.poly.size := coplanarClip_inside_size3 hpieceInv hov
                have hovFilt : ov ∈ Array.filter (fun q => decide (q.poly.size ≥ 3))
                    (coplanarClip piece fb0).1 := Array.mem_filter.mpr ⟨hov, by simpa using hov3⟩
                rw [Array.isEmpty] at hre
                have hsz0 := of_decide_eq_true hre
                have hpos := Array.size_pos_of_mem hovFilt
                omega
              · 
                have hmem : x ∈ vrelint (fragCycle fb0) ∩ vpoly (fragCycle cp) :=
                  ⟨hib ▸ hxrel, hxcp⟩
                rw [comp_off_fb0_flip cp hcp] at hmem; exact hmem
            · exact Or.inr (Or.inl ⟨⟨hib, hnotin_i⟩,
                piece, Array.mem_push.mpr (Or.inr rfl), hxq⟩)
          · exact Or.inr (Or.inr ⟨hnotin_i, q, hq, hxq⟩)
    · 
      simp only [hre, Bool.false_eq_true, if_false]
      refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
      · intro p hp
        exact pushFold_preserves_fragInv piece fb0 hpieceInv st.2 jInv hp
      · rcases jCov with hkept | hmid | htail
        · 
          obtain ⟨p, hp, hxp⟩ := hkept
          by_cases hso : sameOrient fa.plane fb0.plane = true
          · simp only [hso, if_true]
            exact Or.inl ⟨p, Array.mem_append.mpr (Or.inl hp), hxp⟩
          · simp only [hso, Bool.false_eq_true, if_false]
            exact Or.inl ⟨p, hp, hxp⟩
        · obtain ⟨hg, p, hp, hxp⟩ := hmid
          exact Or.inr (Or.inl ⟨hg, p, pushFold_mem_of_mem piece fb0 st.2 hp, hxp⟩)
        · obtain ⟨hnotin_i, q, hq, hxq⟩ := htail
          rw [hdrop, List.mem_cons] at hq
          rcases hq with hqp | hq
          · 
            rw [hqp] at hxq
            rcases (coplanarClip_cover hpieceInv x).mpr hxq with ⟨ov, hov, hxov⟩ | ⟨cp, hcp, hxcp⟩
            · 
              have hov3 : 3 ≤ ov.poly.size := coplanarClip_inside_size3 hpieceInv hov
              have hovFilt : ov ∈ Array.filter (fun q => decide (q.poly.size ≥ 3))
                  (coplanarClip piece fb0).1 := Array.mem_filter.mpr ⟨hov, by simpa using hov3⟩
              have hxfb0 : x ∈ vpoly (fragCycle fb0) :=
                coplanarClip_inside_vpoly_subset_fb_free hpieceInv hfb0Inv hplpiece hov hxov
              by_cases hso : sameOrient fa.plane fb0.plane = true
              · 
                simp only [hso, if_true]
                exact Or.inl ⟨ov, Array.mem_append.mpr (Or.inr hovFilt), hxov⟩
              · 
                exfalso
                exact hxdrop fb0 (Array.getElem_mem i.isLt) hcopT (by simpa using hso) hxfb0
            · 
              have hcp3 : 3 ≤ cp.poly.size :=
                (Proof.MeshIntersectNpo.coplanarClip_fragInv (nt := n) (ct := c)
                  fb0 hpieceInv).2 cp hcp |>.size3
              
              by_cases hib : fb0 = fb₀
              · exfalso
                have hmem : x ∈ vrelint (fragCycle fb0) ∩ vpoly (fragCycle cp) :=
                  ⟨hib ▸ hxrel, hxcp⟩
                rw [comp_off_fb0_flip cp hcp] at hmem; exact hmem
              · 
                have hcppd : cp ∈ (coplanarClip piece fb0).2.foldl
                    (fun pd q => if q.poly.size ≥ 3 then pd.push q else pd) st.2 :=
                  pushFold_mem_pushed piece fb0 st.2 hcp hcp3
                by_cases hso : sameOrient fa.plane fb0.plane = true
                · simp only [hso, if_true]
                  exact Or.inr (Or.inl ⟨⟨hib, hnotin_i⟩, cp, hcppd, hxcp⟩)
                · simp only [hso, Bool.false_eq_true, if_false]
                  exact Or.inr (Or.inl ⟨⟨hib, hnotin_i⟩, cp, hcppd, hxcp⟩)
          · 
            exact Or.inr (Or.inr ⟨hnotin_i, q, hq, hxq⟩)

name: mem_resolveFrag_of_kept
statement:
theorem mem_resolveFrag_of_kept (bvh : Impl.BVH.BVH) (fa : Frag) (opp : Array Frag)
    (wOpp : Array PFace) {p : Frag} (hp : p ∈ resolveFragKept fa opp) :
    p ∈ resolveFrag bvh fa opp wOpp
proof:
:= by
  unfold resolveFrag
  simp only
  rw [Array.mem_append]
  exact Or.inl hp

name: mem_resolveFragKept_or_pending
statement:
theorem mem_resolveFragKept_or_pending (bvh : Impl.BVH.BVH) (fa : Frag) (opp : Array Frag)
    (wOpp : Array PFace) {p : Frag} (hp : p ∈ resolveFrag bvh fa opp wOpp) :
    p ∈ resolveFragKept fa opp
      ∨ p ∈ (resolveFragPending fa opp).filter (fun q => keepFallback bvh wOpp q)
proof:
:= by
  unfold resolveFrag at hp
  simp only at hp
  rw [Array.mem_append] at hp
  exact hp

name: resolveFrag_kept_cover_mem
statement:
theorem resolveFrag_kept_cover_mem {n : Point} {c : ℚ} (bvh : Impl.BVH.BVH) (opp : Array Frag) (wOpp : Array PFace)
    {fa : Frag} (hfa : FragInv n c fa)
    (hoppInv : ∀ fb ∈ opp, ∃ n' c', FragInv n' c' fb
      ∧ (coplanarPlane fa.plane fb.plane = true →
          ∃ ρ : ℚ, ρ ≠ 0 ∧ n' = ρ • n ∧ c' = ρ * c))
    {x : Point} (hx : x ∈ vpoly (fragCycle fa))
    {fb₀ : Frag} (hfb₀ : fb₀ ∈ opp)
    (hso₀ : sameOrient fa.plane fb₀.plane = true)
    (hxrel : x ∈ vrelint (fragCycle fb₀))
    (hxdrop : ∀ fb ∈ opp, coplanarPlane fa.plane fb.plane = true →
        sameOrient fa.plane fb.plane = false → x ∉ vpoly (fragCycle fb)) :
    ∃ p ∈ resolveFrag bvh fa opp wOpp, x ∈ vpoly (fragCycle p)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨p, hp, hxp⟩ :=
    resolveFrag_kept_cover opp hfa hoppInv hx hfb₀ hso₀ hxrel hxdrop
  exact ⟨p, mem_resolveFrag_of_kept bvh fa opp wOpp hp, hxp⟩

name: resolveFragBPending_fragInv
statement:
theorem resolveFragBPending_fragInv (opp : Array Frag)
    {nt : Point} {ct : ℚ} {fb : Frag} (hfb : FragInv nt ct fb) :
    ∀ p ∈ resolveFragBPending fb opp, FragInv nt ct p
proof:
:= by
  unfold resolveFragBPending
  refine Array.foldl_induction
    (motive := fun i (acc : Array Frag × Array Frag) =>
      (∀ f' ∈ acc.1, FragInv nt ct f') ∧ (∀ f' ∈ acc.2, FragInv nt ct f'))
    ⟨by simp, by intro f' hf'; simp only [Array.mem_singleton] at hf'; exact hf' ▸ hfb⟩ ?_ |>.2
  intro i acc ih
  obtain ⟨ihK, ihP⟩ := ih
  by_cases hcop : (!(coplanarPlane fb.plane (opp[i]'i.isLt).plane)) = true
  · simp only [hcop, if_true]; exact ⟨ihK, ihP⟩
  · simp only [hcop, Bool.not_eq_true', Bool.not_eq_false] at hcop ⊢
    simp only [hcop, Bool.not_true, Bool.false_eq_true, if_false]
    refine Array.foldl_induction
      (motive := fun j (st : Array Frag × Array Frag) =>
        (∀ f' ∈ st.1, FragInv nt ct f') ∧ (∀ f' ∈ st.2, FragInv nt ct f'))
      (by exact ⟨ihK, fun f' hf' => absurd hf' (Array.not_mem_empty f')⟩) ?_
    intro j st ihst
    obtain ⟨hst1, hst2⟩ := ihst
    have hpiece : FragInv nt ct (acc.2[j]'j.isLt) := ihP _ (Array.getElem_mem j.isLt)
    exact Proof.MeshIntersectNpo.resolveStepB_fragInv (nt := nt) (ct := ct)
      (opp[i]'i.isLt) (acc.2[j]'j.isLt) hpiece hst1 hst2

name: resolveFragBPending_vpoly_subset_fb
statement:
theorem resolveFragBPending_vpoly_subset_fb (opp : Array Frag)
    {nt : Point} {ct : ℚ} {fb : Frag} (hfb : FragInv nt ct fb)
    {p : Frag} (hp : p ∈ resolveFragBPending fb opp) :
    vpoly (fragCycle p) ⊆ vpoly (fragCycle fb)
proof:
:= by
  rw [resolveFragBPending] at hp
  refine (Array.foldl_induction
    (motive := fun i (acc : Array Frag × Array Frag) =>
      (∀ f' ∈ acc.1, FragInv nt ct f' ∧ vpoly (fragCycle f') ⊆ vpoly (fragCycle fb))
        ∧ (∀ f' ∈ acc.2, FragInv nt ct f' ∧ vpoly (fragCycle f') ⊆ vpoly (fragCycle fb)))
    (init := ((#[] : Array Frag), #[fb]))
    ⟨by intro f' hf'; simp at hf', by
      intro f' hf'; simp only [Array.mem_singleton] at hf'
      subst hf'; exact ⟨hfb, le_refl _⟩⟩ ?_).2 p hp |>.2
  intro i acc ih
  obtain ⟨ihK, ihP⟩ := ih
  by_cases hcop : (!(coplanarPlane fb.plane (opp[i]'i.isLt).plane)) = true
  · simp only [hcop, if_true]; exact ⟨ihK, ihP⟩
  · simp only [hcop, Bool.not_eq_true', Bool.not_eq_false] at hcop ⊢
    simp only [hcop, Bool.not_true, Bool.false_eq_true, if_false]
    refine Array.foldl_induction
      (motive := fun j (st : Array Frag × Array Frag) =>
        (∀ f' ∈ st.1, FragInv nt ct f' ∧ vpoly (fragCycle f') ⊆ vpoly (fragCycle fb))
          ∧ (∀ f' ∈ st.2, FragInv nt ct f' ∧ vpoly (fragCycle f') ⊆ vpoly (fragCycle fb)))
      (init := (acc.1, #[])) ⟨ihK, by intro f' hf'; simp at hf'⟩ ?_
    intro j st ihst
    obtain ⟨hst1, hst2⟩ := ihst
    obtain ⟨hpieceInv, hpieceSub⟩ := ihP _ (Array.getElem_mem j.isLt)
    set piece := acc.2[j]'j.isLt with hpd
    have hstep := resolveStepB_vpoly_subset (opp[i]'i.isLt) piece hpieceInv hpieceSub
      (fun f' hf' => (hst2 f' hf').2)
    have hstepInv := Proof.MeshIntersectNpo.resolveStepB_fragInv
      (nt := nt) (ct := ct) (opp[i]'i.isLt) piece hpieceInv
      (fun f' hf' => (hst1 f' hf').1)
      (fun f' hf' => (hst2 f' hf').1)
    refine ⟨?_, fun f' hf' => ⟨hstepInv.2 _ hf', hstep _ hf'⟩⟩
    
    intro f' hf'
    have : f' ∈ st.1 := by
      by_cases hre : (Array.filter (fun q => decide (q.poly.size ≥ 3))
          (coplanarClip piece (opp[i]'i.isLt)).1).isEmpty = true
      · simpa only [hre, if_true] using hf'
      · simpa only [hre, Bool.false_eq_true, if_false] using hf'
    exact hst1 _ this

name: resolveFragBPending_fragProv
statement:
theorem resolveFragBPending_fragProv (opp : Array Frag)
    {nt : Point} {r₀ : ℕ} [NeZero r₀] {w₀ : Fin r₀ → Point} {L : List IPlane}
    {ct : ℚ} {fb : Frag} (hfbInv : FragInv nt ct fb)
    (hfbProv : FragProv nt w₀ L fb)
    (hLopp : ∀ fa ∈ opp, coplanarPlane fb.plane fa.plane = true →
      ∀ g ∈ edgePlanesOf fa, g ∈ L) :
    ∀ p ∈ resolveFragBPending fb opp, FragProv nt w₀ L p
proof:
:= by
  intro p hp
  rw [resolveFragBPending] at hp
  refine (Array.foldl_induction
    (motive := fun i (acc : Array Frag × Array Frag) =>
      ((∀ f' ∈ acc.1, FragInv nt ct f') ∧ (∀ f' ∈ acc.2, FragInv nt ct f'))
        ∧ ((∀ f' ∈ acc.1, FragProv nt w₀ L f') ∧ (∀ f' ∈ acc.2, FragProv nt w₀ L f')))
    (init := ((#[] : Array Frag), #[fb]))
    ⟨⟨by simp, by intro f' hf'; simp only [Array.mem_singleton] at hf'; subst hf'; exact hfbInv⟩,
      ⟨by simp, by intro f' hf'; simp only [Array.mem_singleton] at hf'; subst hf'; exact hfbProv⟩⟩ ?_).2.2 p hp
  intro i acc ih
  obtain ⟨⟨ihKInv, ihPInv⟩, ihKProv, ihPProv⟩ := ih
  by_cases hcop : (!(coplanarPlane fb.plane opp[i].plane)) = true
  · simp only [hcop, if_true]; exact ⟨⟨ihKInv, ihPInv⟩, ihKProv, ihPProv⟩
  · have hcopT : coplanarPlane fb.plane opp[i].plane = true := by simpa using hcop
    simp only [hcop, Bool.not_eq_true', Bool.not_eq_false] at hcop ⊢
    simp only [hcop, Bool.not_true, Bool.false_eq_true, if_false]
    have hLi : ∀ g ∈ edgePlanesOf opp[i], g ∈ L :=
      hLopp opp[i] (Array.getElem_mem i.isLt) hcopT
    refine Array.foldl_induction
      (motive := fun j (st : Array Frag × Array Frag) =>
        ((∀ f' ∈ st.1, FragInv nt ct f') ∧ (∀ f' ∈ st.2, FragInv nt ct f'))
          ∧ ((∀ f' ∈ st.1, FragProv nt w₀ L f') ∧ (∀ f' ∈ st.2, FragProv nt w₀ L f')))
      (init := (acc.1, #[]))
      ⟨⟨ihKInv, fun f' hf' => absurd hf' (Array.not_mem_empty f')⟩,
        ⟨ihKProv, fun f' hf' => absurd hf' (Array.not_mem_empty f')⟩⟩ ?_
    intro j st ihst
    obtain ⟨⟨hst1Inv, hst2Inv⟩, hst1Prov, hst2Prov⟩ := ihst
    set fai := opp[i] with hfai
    set piece := acc.2[j] with hpiecej
    have hpieceInv : FragInv nt ct piece := ihPInv _ (hpiecej ▸ Array.getElem_mem j.isLt)
    have hpieceProv : FragProv nt w₀ L piece := ihPProv _ (hpiecej ▸ Array.getElem_mem j.isLt)
    refine ⟨Proof.MeshIntersectNpo.resolveStepB_fragInv (nt := nt) (ct := ct) fai piece
      hpieceInv hst1Inv hst2Inv,
      Proof.MeshIntersectNpo.resolveStepB_fragProv (nt := nt) (ct := ct) (w₀ := w₀) (L := L)
        fai piece hpieceInv hpieceProv hLi hst1Prov hst2Prov⟩

name: resolveFragBPending_avoids
statement:
theorem resolveFragBPending_avoids {n : Point} {c : ℚ} (opp : Array Frag)
    {fb : Frag} (hfb : FragInv n c fb)
    (hoppInv : ∀ fa' ∈ opp, ∃ n' c', FragInv n' c' fa'
      ∧ (coplanarPlane fb.plane fa'.plane = true →
          ∃ ρ : ℚ, ρ ≠ 0 ∧ n' = ρ • n ∧ c' = ρ * c))
    {fa' : Frag} (hfa' : fa' ∈ opp)
    (hcop : coplanarPlane fb.plane fa'.plane = true)
    {p : Frag} (hp : p ∈ resolveFragBPending fb opp) :
    vrelint (fragCycle p) ∩ vrelint (fragCycle fa') = ∅
proof:
:= by
  haveI := hfb.neZero
  obtain ⟨n', c', hfa'Inv, hfa'Prop⟩ := hoppInv fa' hfa'
  obtain ⟨ρ, hρ, hn', hc'⟩ := hfa'Prop hcop
  rw [resolveFragBPending] at hp
  refine And.right (a := FragInv n c p) ?_
  revert p
  show ∀ p ∈ _, FragInv n c p ∧ vrelint (fragCycle p) ∩ vrelint (fragCycle fa') = ∅
  have hpropfa : ∃ ρ : ℚ, ρ ≠ 0 ∧ n' = ρ • n ∧ c' = ρ * c := ⟨ρ, hρ, hn', hc'⟩
  intro p hp
  · suffices hmain : (fun i (acc : Array Frag × Array Frag) =>
        (∀ p ∈ acc.2, FragInv n c p)
          ∧ (fa' ∈ opp.toList.take i → ∀ p ∈ acc.2,
              vrelint (fragCycle p) ∩ vrelint (fragCycle fa') = ∅)) opp.size
        (opp.foldl (fun acc fa0 =>
          if !(coplanarPlane fb.plane fa0.plane) then acc
          else
            acc.2.foldl (fun st piece =>
              if (Array.filter (fun q => decide (q.poly.size ≥ 3))
                    (coplanarClip piece fa0).1).isEmpty = true then (st.1, st.2.push piece)
              else
                (st.1, (coplanarClip piece fa0).2.foldl
                  (fun pd q => if q.poly.size ≥ 3 then pd.push q else pd) st.2))
              (acc.1, #[]))
          ((#[] : Array Frag), #[fb])) by
      have hfa_take : fa' ∈ opp.toList.take opp.size := by
        rw [List.take_of_length_le (by simp)]; exact Array.mem_toList.mpr hfa'
      exact ⟨hmain.1 p hp, hmain.2 hfa_take p hp⟩
    refine Array.foldl_induction
      (motive := fun i (acc : Array Frag × Array Frag) =>
        (∀ p ∈ acc.2, FragInv n c p)
          ∧ (fa' ∈ opp.toList.take i → ∀ p ∈ acc.2,
              vrelint (fragCycle p) ∩ vrelint (fragCycle fa') = ∅))
      ⟨by intro p hp; simp only [Array.mem_singleton] at hp; rw [hp]; exact hfb,
        by intro hmem; simp at hmem⟩ ?_
    rintro i acc ⟨ihInv, ihAvoid⟩
    set fa0 := opp[i] with hfa0
    by_cases hcop0 : (!(coplanarPlane fb.plane fa0.plane)) = true
    · simp only [hcop0, if_true]
      refine ⟨ihInv, ?_⟩
      intro hmem p hp
      rw [List.take_succ] at hmem
      rcases List.mem_append.mp hmem with h | h
      · exact ihAvoid h p hp
      · exfalso
        have hfafa0 : fa' = fa0 := mem_getElem?_toList_eq opp i h
        rw [hfafa0] at hcop
        rw [hcop] at hcop0; simp at hcop0
    · simp only [hcop0, Bool.not_eq_true', Bool.not_eq_false] at hcop0 ⊢
      simp only [hcop0, Bool.not_true, Bool.false_eq_true, if_false]
      refine Array.foldl_induction
        (motive := fun _ (st : Array Frag × Array Frag) =>
          (∀ p ∈ st.2, FragInv n c p)
            ∧ (fa' ∈ opp.toList.take (i + 1) → ∀ p ∈ st.2,
                vrelint (fragCycle p) ∩ vrelint (fragCycle fa') = ∅))
        ⟨by intro p hp; simp at hp, by intro _ p hp; simp at hp⟩ ?_
      rintro j st ⟨jInv, jAvoid⟩
      set piece := acc.2[j] with hpiece
      have hpieceInv : FragInv n c piece := ihInv piece (Array.getElem_mem j.isLt)
      haveI := hpieceInv.neZero
      by_cases hre : (Array.filter (fun q => decide (q.poly.size ≥ 3))
          (coplanarClip piece fa0).1).isEmpty = true
      · simp only [hre, if_true]
        refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
        · intro p hp
          rcases Array.mem_push.mp hp with h | h
          · exact jInv p h
          · exact h ▸ hpieceInv
        · intro hmem p hp
          rcases Array.mem_push.mp hp with h | h
          · exact jAvoid hmem p h
          · subst h
            rw [List.take_succ] at hmem
            rcases List.mem_append.mp hmem with hin | hin
            · exact ihAvoid hin piece (Array.getElem_mem j.isLt)
            · have hfafa0 : fa' = fa0 := mem_getElem?_toList_eq opp i hin
              have hov : overlaps piece fa0 = false := by
                rw [Bool.eq_false_iff]
                intro hovt
                rw [overlaps_iff_exists_size3] at hovt
                obtain ⟨pp, hpp, hpp3⟩ := hovt
                have hppf : pp ∈ Array.filter (fun q => decide (q.poly.size ≥ 3))
                    (coplanarClip piece fa0).1 :=
                  Array.mem_filter.mpr ⟨hpp, by simpa using hpp3⟩
                rw [Array.isEmpty] at hre
                simp only [decide_eq_true_eq] at hre
                rw [Array.eq_empty_of_size_eq_zero hre] at hppf
                simp at hppf
              have hfaInv0 : FragInv n' c' fa0 := hfafa0 ▸ hfa'Inv
              rw [hfafa0]
              exact overlaps_false_relint_disjoint_free hpieceInv hfaInv0 hpropfa hov
      · simp only [hre, Bool.false_eq_true, if_false]
        refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
        · intro p hp
          exact pushFold_preserves_fragInv piece fa0 hpieceInv st.2 jInv hp
        · intro hmem p hp
          have hsplit := pushFold_mem piece fa0 st.2 hp
          rcases hsplit with hold | ⟨hcompmem, -⟩
          · exact jAvoid hmem p hold
          · rw [List.take_succ] at hmem
            rcases List.mem_append.mp hmem with hin | hin
            · have hpieceAvoid := ihAvoid hin piece (Array.getElem_mem j.isLt)
              have hsub := coplanarClip_piece_vrelint_subset hpieceInv (Or.inr hcompmem)
              rw [Set.eq_empty_iff_forall_not_mem]
              rintro x ⟨hx1, hx2⟩
              rw [Set.eq_empty_iff_forall_not_mem] at hpieceAvoid
              exact hpieceAvoid x ⟨hsub hx1, hx2⟩
            · have hfafa0 : fa' = fa0 := mem_getElem?_toList_eq opp i hin
              have hfaInv0 : FragInv n' c' fa0 := hfafa0 ▸ hfa'Inv
              have hvp := coplanarClip_comp_relint_disjoint_fb_free hpieceInv hfaInv0 hcompmem
              rw [hfafa0, Set.eq_empty_iff_forall_not_mem]
              rintro x ⟨hx1, hx2⟩
              rw [Set.eq_empty_iff_forall_not_mem] at hvp
              exact hvp x ⟨hx1, vrelint_subset_vpoly _ hx2⟩

name: resolveFragB_cover
statement:
theorem resolveFragB_cover {n : Point} {c : ℚ} (opp : Array Frag)
    {fb : Frag} (hfb : FragInv n c fb)
    (hoppInv : ∀ fa ∈ opp, ∃ n' c', FragInv n' c' fa
      ∧ (coplanarPlane fb.plane fa.plane = true →
          ∃ ρ : ℚ, ρ ≠ 0 ∧ n' = ρ • n ∧ c' = ρ * c))
    {x : Point} (hx : x ∈ vpoly (fragCycle fb))
    (hxov : ∀ fa ∈ opp, x ∉ vpoly (fragCycle fa)) :
    ∃ p ∈ resolveFragBPending fb opp, x ∈ vpoly (fragCycle p)
proof:
:= by
  haveI := hfb.neZero
  rw [resolveFragBPending]
  suffices hmain : (fun (_ : ℕ) (acc : Array Frag × Array Frag) =>
      (∀ p ∈ acc.2, FragInv n c p)
        ∧ (∃ p ∈ acc.2, x ∈ vpoly (fragCycle p))) opp.size
      (opp.foldl (fun acc fa0 =>
          if !(coplanarPlane fb.plane fa0.plane) then acc
          else
            acc.2.foldl (fun st piece =>
              if (Array.filter (fun q => decide (q.poly.size ≥ 3))
                    (coplanarClip piece fa0).1).isEmpty = true then (st.1, st.2.push piece)
              else
                (st.1, (coplanarClip piece fa0).2.foldl
                  (fun pd q => if q.poly.size ≥ 3 then pd.push q else pd) st.2))
              (acc.1, #[]))
          ((#[] : Array Frag), #[fb])) by
    exact hmain.2
  refine Array.foldl_induction
    (motive := fun i (acc : Array Frag × Array Frag) =>
      (∀ p ∈ acc.2, FragInv n c p)
        ∧ (∃ p ∈ acc.2, x ∈ vpoly (fragCycle p)))
    ⟨by intro p hp; simp only [Array.mem_singleton] at hp; rw [hp]; exact hfb,
      ⟨fb, by simp, hx⟩⟩ ?_
  rintro i acc ⟨ihInv, ihCov⟩
  set fa0 := opp[i] with hfa0
  by_cases hcop0 : (!(coplanarPlane fb.plane fa0.plane)) = true
  · simp only [hcop0, if_true]; exact ⟨ihInv, ihCov⟩
  · have hcopT : coplanarPlane fb.plane fa0.plane = true := by simpa using hcop0
    simp only [show (!(coplanarPlane fb.plane fa0.plane)) = false from by rw [hcopT]; rfl,
      Bool.false_eq_true, if_false]
    have hxfa0 : x ∉ vpoly (fragCycle fa0) := hxov fa0 (Array.getElem_mem i.isLt)
    obtain ⟨n', c', hfa0Inv, hprop⟩ := hoppInv fa0 (Array.getElem_mem i.isLt)
    obtain ⟨ρ, hρ, hn', hc'⟩ := hprop hcopT
    have hinner := Array.foldl_induction (as := acc.2)
      (f := fun (st : Array Frag × Array Frag) piece =>
        if (Array.filter (fun q => decide (q.poly.size ≥ 3))
              (coplanarClip piece fa0).1).isEmpty = true then (st.1, st.2.push piece)
        else
          (st.1, (coplanarClip piece fa0).2.foldl
            (fun pd q => if q.poly.size ≥ 3 then pd.push q else pd) st.2))
      (motive := fun j (st : Array Frag × Array Frag) =>
        (∀ p ∈ st.2, FragInv n c p)
          ∧ ((∃ p ∈ st.2, x ∈ vpoly (fragCycle p)) ∨
              ∃ q ∈ acc.2.toList.drop j, x ∈ vpoly (fragCycle q)))
      (init := (acc.1, #[]))
      (h0 := ⟨fun p hp => absurd hp (Array.not_mem_empty p), by
        rcases ihCov with ⟨q, hq, hxq⟩
        exact Or.inr ⟨q, by simpa using Array.mem_toList.mpr hq, hxq⟩⟩)
      (hf := ?_)
    · refine ⟨hinner.1, ?_⟩
      rcases hinner.2 with hpend | ⟨q, hq, _⟩
      · exact hpend
      · rw [List.drop_eq_nil_of_le (by simp)] at hq; exact absurd hq (List.not_mem_nil q)
    rintro j st ⟨jInv, jCov⟩
    set piece := acc.2[j] with hpiece
    have hpieceInv : FragInv n c piece := ihInv piece (Array.getElem_mem j.isLt)
    haveI := hpieceInv.neZero
    have hplpiece : Proof.MeshIntersectClip.OnPlane n' c' (fragCycle piece) := by
      intro k
      rw [hn', hc', Proof.MeshIntersectCoplanarClip.dotQ_smul_left, hpieceInv.onPlane k]
    have hdrop : acc.2.toList.drop (j : ℕ)
        = piece :: acc.2.toList.drop ((j : ℕ) + 1) := by
      rw [List.drop_eq_getElem_cons (l := acc.2.toList) (by simp [j.isLt]), hpiece]
      simp [Array.getElem_toList]
    by_cases hre : (Array.filter (fun q => decide (q.poly.size ≥ 3))
        (coplanarClip piece fa0).1).isEmpty = true
    · simp only [hre, if_true]
      refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
      · intro p hp
        rcases Array.mem_push.mp hp with h | h
        · exact jInv p h
        · exact h ▸ hpieceInv
      · rcases jCov with ⟨p, hp, hxp⟩ | htail
        · exact Or.inl ⟨p, Array.mem_push.mpr (Or.inl hp), hxp⟩
        · obtain ⟨q, hq, hxq⟩ := htail
          rw [hdrop, List.mem_cons] at hq
          rcases hq with hqp | hq
          · rw [hqp] at hxq; exact Or.inl ⟨piece, Array.mem_push.mpr (Or.inr rfl), hxq⟩
          · exact Or.inr ⟨q, hq, hxq⟩
    · simp only [hre, Bool.false_eq_true, if_false]
      refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
      · intro p hp
        exact pushFold_preserves_fragInv piece fa0 hpieceInv st.2 jInv hp
      · rcases jCov with ⟨p, hp, hxp⟩ | htail
        · exact Or.inl ⟨p, pushFold_mem_of_mem piece fa0 st.2 hp, hxp⟩
        · obtain ⟨q, hq, hxq⟩ := htail
          rw [hdrop, List.mem_cons] at hq
          rcases hq with hqp | hq
          · rw [hqp] at hxq
            rcases (coplanarClip_cover hpieceInv x).mpr hxq with ⟨ov, hov, hxov'⟩ | ⟨cp, hcp, hxcp⟩
            · exact absurd (coplanarClip_inside_vpoly_subset_fb_free hpieceInv hfa0Inv hplpiece hov
                hxov') hxfa0
            · have hcp3 : 3 ≤ cp.poly.size :=
                (Proof.MeshIntersectNpo.coplanarClip_fragInv (nt := n) (ct := c)
                  fa0 hpieceInv).2 cp hcp |>.size3
              exact Or.inl ⟨cp, pushFold_mem_pushed piece fa0 st.2 hcp hcp3, hxcp⟩
          · exact Or.inr ⟨q, hq, hxq⟩

name: mem_resolveFragB_of_pending_keepFallback
statement:
theorem mem_resolveFragB_of_pending_keepFallback (bvh : Impl.BVH.BVH) (fb : Frag) (opp : Array Frag)
    (wOpp : Array PFace) {p : Frag} (hp : p ∈ resolveFragBPending fb opp)
    (hkeep : keepFallback bvh wOpp p = true) :
    p ∈ resolveCoplanar.resolveFragB bvh fb opp wOpp
proof:
:= by
  unfold resolveCoplanar.resolveFragB
  simp only
  rw [Array.mem_append]
  exact Or.inr (Array.mem_filter.mpr ⟨hp, by simpa using hkeep⟩)

name: mem_resolveFragBPending_of_resolveFragB
statement:
theorem mem_resolveFragBPending_of_resolveFragB (bvh : Impl.BVH.BVH) (fb : Frag) (opp : Array Frag)
    (wOpp : Array PFace) {p : Frag} (hp : p ∈ resolveCoplanar.resolveFragB bvh fb opp wOpp) :
    p ∈ resolveFragBPending fb opp
proof:
:= by
  unfold resolveCoplanar.resolveFragB at hp
  simp only at hp
  rw [Array.mem_append] at hp
  rcases hp with h | h
  · 
    exfalso
    revert h
    refine Array.foldl_induction
      (motive := fun i (acc : Array Frag × Array Frag) => (∀ f' ∈ acc.1, False))
      (by intro f' hf'; simp at hf') ?_ p
    intro i acc ih
    by_cases hcop : (!(coplanarPlane fb.plane (opp[i]'i.isLt).plane)) = true
    · simp only [hcop, if_true]; exact ih
