    · simp only [hcop, Bool.not_eq_true', Bool.not_eq_false] at hcop ⊢
      simp only [hcop, Bool.not_true, Bool.false_eq_true, if_false]
      refine Array.foldl_induction
        (motive := fun j (st : Array Frag × Array Frag) => (∀ f' ∈ st.1, False))
        (by exact ih) ?_
      intro j st ihst f' hf'
      by_cases hre : (Array.filter (fun q => decide (q.poly.size ≥ 3))
          (coplanarClip (acc.2[j]'j.isLt) (opp[i]'i.isLt)).1).isEmpty = true
      · simp only [hre, if_true] at hf'; exact ihst _ hf'
      · simp only [hre, Bool.false_eq_true, if_false] at hf'; exact ihst _ hf'
  · exact (Array.mem_filter.mp h).1

name: mem_resolveCoplanar
statement:
theorem mem_resolveCoplanar (bvhWB bvhWA : Impl.BVH.BVH) (copA copB : Array Frag)
    (wB wA : Array PFace)
    {f' : Frag} (hf' : f' ∈ resolveCoplanar bvhWB bvhWA copA copB wB wA) :
    (∃ fa ∈ copA, f' ∈ resolveFragNear (copBVH copB) bvhWB copB fa wB)
      ∨ (∃ fb ∈ copB, f' ∈ resolveCoplanar.resolveFragBNear (copBVH copA) bvhWA copA fb wA)
proof:
:= by
  unfold resolveCoplanar at hf'
  rcases Array.mem_append.mp hf' with h | h
  · left; exact mem_flatMap_arr.mp h
  · right; exact mem_flatMap_arr.mp h

name: range_triple
statement:
theorem range_triple (A B C : Point) :
    Set.range ![A, B, C] = {A, B, C}
proof:
:= by
  ext x
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨j, rfl⟩
    fin_cases j
    · exact Or.inl rfl
    · exact Or.inr (Or.inl rfl)
    · exact Or.inr (Or.inr rfl)
  · rintro (rfl | rfl | rfl)
    exacts [⟨0, rfl⟩, ⟨1, rfl⟩, ⟨2, rfl⟩]

name: triangleSet_eq_vpoly
statement:
theorem triangleSet_eq_vpoly (A B C : Point) :
    triangleSet ⟨A, B, C⟩ = vpoly ![A, B, C]
proof:
:= by
  show convexHull ℚ {A, B, C} = convexHull ℚ (Set.range ![A, B, C])
  rw [range_triple]

name: onPlane_triple_of
proof:
:= by
  intro i
  fin_cases i
  exacts [hA, hB, hC]

name: strictConv_triple_pos
proof:
:= by
  intro i j hj1 hj2
  fin_cases i <;> fin_cases j
  · exact absurd rfl hj1
  · exact absurd rfl hj2
  · show 0 < areaForm nt A B C
    exact h
  · show 0 < areaForm nt B C A
    rw [← areaForm_cyclic]
    exact h
  · exact absurd rfl hj1
  · exact absurd rfl hj2
  · exact absurd rfl hj2
  · show 0 < areaForm nt C A B
    rw [← areaForm_cyclic, ← areaForm_cyclic]
    exact h
  · exact absurd rfl hj1

name: mem_triangleSet_iff
statement:
theorem mem_triangleSet_iff {nt : Point} {ct : ℚ} {A B C : Point}
    (hpos : 0 < areaForm nt A B C)
    (hA : dotQ nt A = ct) (hB : dotQ nt B = ct) (hC : dotQ nt C = ct)
    (x : Point) :
    x ∈ triangleSet ⟨A, B, C⟩
      ↔ dotQ nt x = ct ∧ 0 ≤ areaForm nt A B x ∧ 0 ≤ areaForm nt B C x
        ∧ 0 ≤ areaForm nt C A x
proof:
:= by
  haveI : NeZero 3 := ⟨by omega⟩
  rw [triangleSet_eq_vpoly,
    vpoly_eq (le_refl 3) (onPlane_triple_of hA hB hC)
      (strictConv_triple_pos hpos)]
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨hcar, hall⟩
    exact ⟨hcar, hall 0, hall 1, hall 2⟩
  · rintro ⟨hcar, h0, h1, h2⟩
    refine ⟨hcar, fun i => ?_⟩
    fin_cases i
    exacts [h0, h1, h2]

name: fanApex_onPlane
statement:
theorem fanApex_onPlane (hpl : OnPlane nt ct u) :
    dotQ nt (fanApex u) = ct
proof:
:= by
  have hm0 : (m : ℚ) ≠ 0 := by
    exact_mod_cast (NeZero.ne m)
  exact dotQ_comb nt u (by
    rw [Finset.sum_const, Finset.card_univ, Fintype.card_fin, nsmul_eq_mul,
      mul_inv_cancel₀ hm0]) hpl

name: spoke_self
statement: theorem spoke_self (nt a x : Point) : areaForm nt a x a = 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [areaForm_cyclic]
  exact areaForm_self_right nt x a

name: ne_apex
statement:
theorem ne_apex {P : Point} (k : Fin m)
    (hσ : areaForm nt (fanApex u) (u k) P ≠ 0) : P ≠ fanApex u
proof:
:= by
  intro h
  rw [h] at hσ
  exact hσ (spoke_self _ _ _)

name: fan_sector
statement:
theorem fan_sector (hr : 3 ≤ r) (hm3 : 3 ≤ m)
    (hpl : OnPlane nt ct w) (hstrict : StrictConv nt w) (hs : RefShape w u)
    {P : Point} (k : Fin m)
    (hσk : areaForm nt (fanApex u) (u k) P ≠ 0)
    (hσk1 : areaForm nt (fanApex u) (u (k + 1)) P ≠ 0)
    (hPk : P ∈ triangleSet ⟨fanApex u, u k, u (k + 1)⟩) :
    dotQ nt P = ct ∧ 0 < areaForm nt (fanApex u) (u k) P
      ∧ areaForm nt (fanApex u) (u (k + 1)) P < 0
proof:
:= by
  have hupl : OnPlane nt ct u := hs.onPlane hpl
  have happ : dotQ nt (fanApex u) = ct := fanApex_onPlane hupl
  have hccw : 0 < areaForm nt (fanApex u) (u k) (u (k + 1)) :=
    hs.fan_ccw hr hm3 hpl hstrict k
  rw [mem_triangleSet_iff hccw happ (hupl k) (hupl (k + 1)) P] at hPk
  obtain ⟨hcar, h0, -, h2⟩ := hPk
  refine ⟨hcar, lt_of_le_of_ne h0 (Ne.symm hσk), ?_⟩
  have hflip : areaForm nt (u (k + 1)) (fanApex u) P
      = -areaForm nt (fanApex u) (u (k + 1)) P := by
    rw [areaForm_cyclic nt (u (k + 1)) (fanApex u) P,
      areaForm_swap nt (fanApex u) P (u (k + 1))]
  rw [hflip] at h2
  have hle : areaForm nt (fanApex u) (u (k + 1)) P ≤ 0 := by linarith
  exact lt_of_le_of_ne hle hσk1

name: fan_exit
statement:
theorem fan_exit (hr : 3 ≤ r) (hm3 : 3 ≤ m)
    (hpl : OnPlane nt ct w) (hstrict : StrictConv nt w) (hs : RefShape w u)
    {P : Point} (k : Fin m) (hcar : dotQ nt P = ct)
    (hσk : 0 < areaForm nt (fanApex u) (u k) P)
    (hσk1 : areaForm nt (fanApex u) (u (k + 1)) P < 0) :
    ∃ h θ : ℚ, 0 < h ∧ 0 < θ ∧ θ < 1
      ∧ fanApex u + h • (P - fanApex u)
        = u k + θ • (u (k + 1) - u k)
proof:
:= by
  have hupl : OnPlane nt ct u := hs.onPlane hpl
  have happ : dotQ nt (fanApex u) = ct := fanApex_onPlane hupl
  have hccw : 0 < areaForm nt (fanApex u) (u k) (u (k + 1)) :=
    hs.fan_ccw hr hm3 hpl hstrict k
  have hnt : nt ≠ 0 := n_ne_zero_of_strict hr hstrict
  obtain ⟨s, t, hst⟩ := plane_coords hnt happ (hupl k) (hupl (k + 1))
    (ne_of_gt hccw) hcar
  
  have hsk : areaForm nt (fanApex u) (u k) P
      = t * areaForm nt (fanApex u) (u k) (u (k + 1)) := by
    rw [hst]
    simp only [areaForm, dotQ, crossQ, mkPoint_zero, mkPoint_one, mkPoint_two,
      Pi.sub_apply, Pi.add_apply, Pi.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul]
    ring
  have hsk1 : areaForm nt (fanApex u) (u (k + 1)) P
      = -(s * areaForm nt (fanApex u) (u k) (u (k + 1))) := by
    rw [hst]
    simp only [areaForm, dotQ, crossQ, mkPoint_zero, mkPoint_one, mkPoint_two,
      Pi.sub_apply, Pi.add_apply, Pi.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul]
    ring
  have hspos : 0 < s := by
    have h := hσk1
    rw [hsk1] at h
    have hsA : 0 < s * areaForm nt (fanApex u) (u k) (u (k + 1)) := by
      linarith
    rcases mul_pos_iff.mp hsA with ⟨h1, -⟩ | ⟨-, h2⟩
    · exact h1
    · linarith
  have htpos : 0 < t := by
    have h := hσk
    rw [hsk] at h
    rcases mul_pos_iff.mp h with ⟨h1, -⟩ | ⟨-, h2⟩
    · exact h1
    · linarith
  have hstsum : (0 : ℚ) < s + t := by linarith
  refine ⟨(s + t)⁻¹, t / (s + t), inv_pos.mpr hstsum,
    div_pos htpos hstsum, ?_, ?_⟩
  · rw [div_lt_one hstsum]
    linarith
  · rw [hst]
    funext j
    simp only [Pi.add_apply, Pi.smul_apply, Pi.sub_apply, smul_eq_mul]
    field_simp
    ring

name: eta_edge_zero
statement:
theorem eta_edge_zero (nt : Point) (w : Fin r → Point) (i : Fin r) (γ : ℚ) :
    eta nt w i (w i + γ • (w (i + 1) - w i)) = 0
proof:
:= by
  have hrep : w i + γ • (w (i + 1) - w i) = (1 - γ) • w i + γ • w (i + 1) := by
    rw [smul_sub, sub_smul, one_smul]
    abel
  rw [hrep, eta_affine_comb nt w i (by ring : (1 - γ) + γ = 1), eta_self,
    eta_succ]
  ring

name: eta_pos_other
statement:
theorem eta_pos_other (hr : 3 ≤ r) (hstrict : StrictConv nt w)
    {i i' : Fin r} (hne : i ≠ i') {γ : ℚ} (h0 : 0 < γ) (h1 : γ < 1) :
    0 < eta nt w i' (w i + γ • (w (i + 1) - w i))
proof:
:= by
  have hrep : w i + γ • (w (i + 1) - w i) = (1 - γ) • w i + γ • w (i + 1) := by
    rw [smul_sub, sub_smul, one_smul]
    abel
  rw [hrep, eta_affine_comb nt w i' (by ring : (1 - γ) + γ = 1)]
  by_cases hcase : i = i' + 1
  · 
    have hz : eta nt w i' (w i) = 0 := by
      rw [hcase]
      exact eta_succ nt w i'
    have hp : 0 < eta nt w i' (w (i + 1)) := by
      refine hstrict i' (i + 1) ?_ ?_
      · rw [hcase]
        exact fin_add_two_ne hr i'
      · rw [hcase]
        intro hcon
        exact fin_add_one_ne hr (i' + 1) hcon
    rw [hz, mul_zero, zero_add]
    exact mul_pos h0 hp
  · have hp : 0 < eta nt w i' (w i) := hstrict i' i hne hcase
    have hq : 0 ≤ eta nt w i' (w (i + 1)) := convPos_of_strict hstrict i' (i + 1)
    have := mul_pos (by linarith : (0 : ℚ) < 1 - γ) hp
    nlinarith

name: fan_unique
statement:
theorem fan_unique (hr : 3 ≤ r) (hm3 : 3 ≤ m)
    (hpl : OnPlane nt ct w) (hstrict : StrictConv nt w) (hs : RefShapeOrd w u)
    {P : Point} (hcar : dotQ nt P = ct)
    (hσ : ∀ j : Fin m, areaForm nt (fanApex u) (u j) P ≠ 0)
    {k l : Fin m}
    (hPk : P ∈ triangleSet ⟨fanApex u, u k, u (k + 1)⟩)
    (hPl : P ∈ triangleSet ⟨fanApex u, u l, u (l + 1)⟩) :
    k = l
proof:
:= by
  by_contra hne
  have hamem : fanApex u ∈ vrelint w :=
    hs.toRefShape.apex_mem hr hm3 hstrict
  
  obtain ⟨-, hk0, hk1⟩ := fan_sector hr hm3 hpl hstrict hs.toRefShape k
    (hσ k) (hσ (k + 1)) hPk
  obtain ⟨-, hl0, hl1⟩ := fan_sector hr hm3 hpl hstrict hs.toRefShape l
    (hσ l) (hσ (l + 1)) hPl
  obtain ⟨hk', θk, hhk, hθk0, hθk1, heqk⟩ :=
    fan_exit hr hm3 hpl hstrict hs.toRefShape k hcar hk0 hk1
  obtain ⟨hl', θl, hhl, hθl0, hθl1, heql⟩ :=
    fan_exit hr hm3 hpl hstrict hs.toRefShape l hcar hl0 hl1
  
  obtain ⟨d, hreps, hdisj, -⟩ := hs.chart
  obtain ⟨hα0k, hαβk, hβ1k, hupk, hupk1⟩ := hreps k
  obtain ⟨hα0l, hαβl, hβ1l, hupl', hupl1⟩ := hreps l
  
  have hyk : u k + θk • (u (k + 1) - u k)
      = w (d k).1 + ((d k).2.1 + θk * ((d k).2.2 - (d k).2.1))
          • (w ((d k).1 + 1) - w (d k).1) := by
    rw [hupk, hupk1]
    funext j
    simp only [Pi.add_apply, Pi.smul_apply, Pi.sub_apply, smul_eq_mul]
    ring
  have hyl : u l + θl • (u (l + 1) - u l)
      = w (d l).1 + ((d l).2.1 + θl * ((d l).2.2 - (d l).2.1))
          • (w ((d l).1 + 1) - w (d l).1) := by
    rw [hupl', hupl1]
    funext j
    simp only [Pi.add_apply, Pi.smul_apply, Pi.sub_apply, smul_eq_mul]
    ring
  set γk := (d k).2.1 + θk * ((d k).2.2 - (d k).2.1) with hγkdef
  set γl := (d l).2.1 + θl * ((d l).2.2 - (d l).2.1) with hγldef
  have hγk_lo : (d k).2.1 < γk := by
    have := mul_pos hθk0 (by linarith : (0 : ℚ) < (d k).2.2 - (d k).2.1)
    rw [hγkdef]
    linarith
  have hγk_hi : γk < (d k).2.2 := by
    have := mul_pos (by linarith : (0 : ℚ) < 1 - θk)
      (by linarith : (0 : ℚ) < (d k).2.2 - (d k).2.1)
    rw [hγkdef]
    nlinarith
  have hγl_lo : (d l).2.1 < γl := by
    have := mul_pos hθl0 (by linarith : (0 : ℚ) < (d l).2.2 - (d l).2.1)
    rw [hγldef]
    linarith
  have hγl_hi : γl < (d l).2.2 := by
    have := mul_pos (by linarith : (0 : ℚ) < 1 - θl)
      (by linarith : (0 : ℚ) < (d l).2.2 - (d l).2.1)
    rw [hγldef]
    nlinarith
  
  have hkvan : eta nt w (d k).1 (fanApex u + hk' • (P - fanApex u)) = 0 := by
    rw [heqk, hyk]
    exact eta_edge_zero nt w (d k).1 _
  have hlvan : eta nt w (d l).1 (fanApex u + hl' • (P - fanApex u)) = 0 := by
    rw [heql, hyl]
    exact eta_edge_zero nt w (d l).1 _
  
  have hupoly : ∀ j : Fin m, u j ∈ vpoly w := by
    intro j
    rw [← hs.toRefShape.vpoly_eq]
    exact subset_convexHull ℚ _ (Set.mem_range_self j)
  have hexit_poly : ∀ (j : Fin m) (θ : ℚ), 0 ≤ θ → θ ≤ 1 →
      u j + θ • (u (j + 1) - u j) ∈ vpoly w := by
    intro j θ h0 h1
    have hmix : u j + θ • (u (j + 1) - u j)
        = (1 - θ) • u j + θ • u (j + 1) := by
      funext jj
      simp only [Pi.add_apply, Pi.smul_apply, Pi.sub_apply, smul_eq_mul]
      ring
    rw [hmix]
    exact (convex_convexHull ℚ _) (hupoly j) (hupoly (j + 1))
      (by linarith) h0 (by ring)
  
  have habs : ∀ {h1 h2 : ℚ} {i0 : Fin r}, 0 < h1 → h1 < h2 →
      fanApex u + h2 • (P - fanApex u) ∈ vpoly w →
      eta nt w i0 (fanApex u + h1 • (P - fanApex u)) = 0 → False := by
    intro h1 h2 i0 hpos hlt hpoly hvan
    have hθpos : 0 < 1 - h1 / h2 := by
      have : h1 / h2 < 1 := (div_lt_one (by linarith)).mpr hlt
      linarith
    have hθle : 1 - h1 / h2 ≤ 1 := by
      have : 0 < h1 / h2 := div_pos hpos (by linarith)
      linarith
    have hrel := vrelint_absorb hr hpl hstrict hamem hpoly hθpos hθle
    have h2ne : h2 ≠ 0 := ne_of_gt (lt_trans hpos hlt)
    have hmix : fanApex u + h1 • (P - fanApex u)
        = (1 - (1 - h1 / h2)) • (fanApex u + h2 • (P - fanApex u))
          + (1 - h1 / h2) • fanApex u := by
      funext j
      simp only [Pi.add_apply, Pi.smul_apply, Pi.sub_apply, smul_eq_mul]
      field_simp
      ring
    rw [← hmix] at hrel
    rw [vrelint_eq hr hpl hstrict] at hrel
    have hgt := hrel.2 i0
    rw [hvan] at hgt
    exact lt_irrefl 0 hgt
  rcases lt_trichotomy hk' hl' with hlt | heq | hgt
  · exact habs hhk hlt (by rw [heql]; exact hexit_poly l θl hθl0.le hθl1.le)
      hkvan
  · 
    have hsame : u k + θk • (u (k + 1) - u k)
        = u l + θl • (u (l + 1) - u l) := by
      rw [← heqk, ← heql, heq]
    rw [hyk, hyl] at hsame
    by_cases hii : (d k).1 = (d l).1
    · 
      rw [← hii, add_right_inj] at hsame
      have hcancel : (γk - γl) • (w ((d k).1 + 1) - w (d k).1) = 0 := by
        rw [sub_smul, hsame, sub_self]
      rcases smul_eq_zero.mp hcancel with hγ | he
      · 
        have hγeq : γk = γl := by linarith [sub_eq_zero.mp hγ]
        have hival : ((d k).1.val : ℚ) = ((d l).1.val : ℚ) := by
          rw [hii]
        rcases hdisj k l hne with hd | hd
        · linarith
        · linarith
      · exact consec_ne hr hstrict (d k).1 (sub_eq_zero.mp he).symm
    · 
      have hγk01 : 0 < γk ∧ γk < 1 := ⟨by linarith, by linarith⟩
      have hpos := eta_pos_other hr hstrict hii hγk01.1 hγk01.2
      have hvan : eta nt w (d l).1
          (w (d k).1 + γk • (w ((d k).1 + 1) - w (d k).1)) = 0 := by
        rw [hsame]
        exact eta_edge_zero nt w (d l).1 _
      rw [hvan] at hpos
      exact lt_irrefl 0 hpos
  · exact habs hhl hgt (by rw [heqk]; exact hexit_poly k θk hθk0.le hθk1.le)
      hlvan

name: fan_subset
statement:
theorem fan_subset (hr : 3 ≤ r) (hm3 : 3 ≤ m)
    (_hpl : OnPlane nt ct w) (hstrict : StrictConv nt w) (hs : RefShape w u)
    (k : Fin m) :
    triangleSet ⟨fanApex u, u k, u (k + 1)⟩ ⊆ vpoly w
proof:
:= by
  have hgen : ({fanApex u, u k, u (k + 1)} : Set Point) ⊆ vpoly w := by
    rintro x (rfl | rfl | rfl)
    · exact vrelint_subset_vpoly w (hs.apex_mem hr hm3 hstrict)
    · rw [← hs.vpoly_eq]
      exact subset_convexHull ℚ _ (Set.mem_range_self _)
    · rw [← hs.vpoly_eq]
      exact subset_convexHull ℚ _ (Set.mem_range_self _)
  exact convexHull_min hgen (convex_convexHull ℚ _)

name: fan_exists
statement:
theorem fan_exists (hr : 3 ≤ r) (hm3 : 3 ≤ m)
    (hpl : OnPlane nt ct w) (hstrict : StrictConv nt w) (hs : RefShapeOrd w u)
    {P : Point} (hcar : dotQ nt P = ct)
    (hσ : ∀ j : Fin m, areaForm nt (fanApex u) (u j) P ≠ 0)
    (hP : P ∈ vpoly w) :
    ∃ k : Fin m, P ∈ triangleSet ⟨fanApex u, u k, u (k + 1)⟩
proof:
:= by
  have hamem : fanApex u ∈ vrelint w :=
    hs.toRefShape.apex_mem hr hm3 hstrict
  have happ : dotQ nt (fanApex u) = ct :=
    fanApex_onPlane (hs.toRefShape.onPlane hpl)
  have hPa : P ≠ fanApex u := ne_apex 0 (hσ 0)
  have hv : P - fanApex u ≠ 0 := sub_ne_zero.mpr hPa
  have hnv : dotQ nt (P - fanApex u) = 0 := by
    rw [dotQ_sub_right, hcar, happ, sub_self]
  have hstrictfeas : ∀ j, 0 < eta nt w j (fanApex u) := by
    have h := hamem
    rw [vrelint_eq hr hpl hstrict] at h
    exact h.2
  obtain ⟨sh, i₀, s, hsh0, hs0, hs1, hshstrict, hexit⟩ :=
    exit_point hr hpl hstrict happ (fun j => (hstrictfeas j).le) hv hnv
  have hshpos : 0 < sh := hshstrict hstrictfeas
  
  have hexit' : fanApex u + sh • (P - fanApex u)
      = w i₀ + s • (w (i₀ + 1) - w i₀) := by
    rw [hexit]
    funext j
    simp only [Pi.add_apply, Pi.smul_apply, Pi.sub_apply, smul_eq_mul]
    ring
  
  have hsh1 : 1 ≤ sh := by
    by_contra hcon
    push_neg at hcon
    have hrel := vrelint_absorb hr hpl hstrict hamem hP
      (θ := 1 - sh) (by linarith) (by linarith)
    have hmix : fanApex u + sh • (P - fanApex u)
        = (1 - (1 - sh)) • P + (1 - sh) • fanApex u := by
      funext j
      simp only [Pi.add_apply, Pi.smul_apply, Pi.sub_apply, smul_eq_mul]
      ring
    rw [← hmix] at hrel
    rw [vrelint_eq hr hpl hstrict] at hrel
    have hz : eta nt w i₀ (fanApex u + sh • (P - fanApex u)) = 0 := by
      rw [hexit']
      exact eta_edge_zero nt w i₀ s
    have hgt := hrel.2 i₀
    rw [hz] at hgt
    exact lt_irrefl 0 hgt
  
  obtain ⟨i', s', hs'0, hs'1, hrep'⟩ :
      ∃ (i' : Fin r) (s' : ℚ), 0 ≤ s' ∧ s' < 1
        ∧ fanApex u + sh • (P - fanApex u)
          = w i' + s' • (w (i' + 1) - w i') := by
    rcases lt_or_eq_of_le hs1 with hlt | heq1
    · exact ⟨i₀, s, hs0, hlt, hexit'⟩
    · refine ⟨i₀ + 1, 0, le_refl 0, one_pos, ?_⟩
      rw [hexit', heq1]
      funext j
      simp only [Pi.add_apply, Pi.smul_apply, Pi.sub_apply, smul_eq_mul]
      ring
  
  obtain ⟨d, hreps, -, hcover⟩ := hs.chart
  obtain ⟨k, hki, hkα, hkβ⟩ := hcover i' s' hs'0 hs'1
  obtain ⟨hα0, hαβ, hβ1, hu1, hu2⟩ := hreps k
  have hden : (0 : ℚ) < (d k).2.2 - (d k).2.1 := by linarith
  have hexitseg : fanApex u + sh • (P - fanApex u)
      = u k + ((s' - (d k).2.1) / ((d k).2.2 - (d k).2.1))
          • (u (k + 1) - u k) := by
    rw [hrep', hu1, hu2, ← hki]
    have hdenne : (d k).2.2 - (d k).2.1 ≠ 0 := ne_of_gt hden
    funext j
    simp only [Pi.add_apply, Pi.smul_apply, Pi.sub_apply, smul_eq_mul]
    field_simp
    ring
  have hratio0 : 0 ≤ (s' - (d k).2.1) / ((d k).2.2 - (d k).2.1) :=
    div_nonneg (by linarith) hden.le
  have hratio1 : (s' - (d k).2.1) / ((d k).2.2 - (d k).2.1) ≤ 1 :=
    le_of_lt ((div_lt_one hden).mpr (by linarith))
  
  refine ⟨k, ?_⟩
  have hTconv : Convex ℚ (triangleSet ⟨fanApex u, u k, u (k + 1)⟩) :=
    convex_convexHull ℚ _
  have haT : fanApex u ∈ triangleSet ⟨fanApex u, u k, u (k + 1)⟩ :=
    subset_convexHull ℚ _ (Or.inl rfl)
  have hukT : u k ∈ triangleSet ⟨fanApex u, u k, u (k + 1)⟩ :=
    subset_convexHull ℚ _ (Or.inr (Or.inl rfl))
  have huk1T : u (k + 1) ∈ triangleSet ⟨fanApex u, u k, u (k + 1)⟩ :=
    subset_convexHull ℚ _ (Or.inr (Or.inr rfl))
  have hyT : fanApex u + sh • (P - fanApex u)
      ∈ triangleSet ⟨fanApex u, u k, u (k + 1)⟩ := by
    rw [hexitseg]
    have hmix : u k + ((s' - (d k).2.1) / ((d k).2.2 - (d k).2.1))
        • (u (k + 1) - u k)
        = (1 - (s' - (d k).2.1) / ((d k).2.2 - (d k).2.1)) • u k
          + ((s' - (d k).2.1) / ((d k).2.2 - (d k).2.1)) • u (k + 1) := by
      funext j
      simp only [Pi.add_apply, Pi.smul_apply, Pi.sub_apply, smul_eq_mul]
      ring
    rw [hmix]
    exact hTconv hukT huk1T (by linarith) hratio0 (by ring)
  have hshne : sh ≠ 0 := ne_of_gt hshpos
  have hPmix : P = (1 - sh⁻¹) • fanApex u
      + sh⁻¹ • (fanApex u + sh • (P - fanApex u)) := by
    funext j
    simp only [Pi.add_apply, Pi.smul_apply, Pi.sub_apply, smul_eq_mul]
    field_simp
    ring
  rw [hPmix]
  have hinvpos : 0 < sh⁻¹ := inv_pos.mpr hshpos
  have hinvle : sh⁻¹ ≤ 1 := by
    rw [← one_div]
    exact (div_le_one hshpos).mpr hsh1
  exact hTconv haT hyT (by linarith) hinvpos.le (by ring)

name: fan_count
statement:
theorem fan_count (hr : 3 ≤ r) (hm3 : 3 ≤ m)
    (hpl : OnPlane nt ct w) (hstrict : StrictConv nt w) (hs : RefShapeOrd w u)
    {P : Point} (hcar : dotQ nt P = ct)
    (hσ : ∀ j : Fin m, areaForm nt (fanApex u) (u j) P ≠ 0) :
    (∑ k : Fin m,
        if P ∈ triangleSet ⟨fanApex u, u k, u (k + 1)⟩ then (1 : ℤ) else 0)
      = if P ∈ vpoly w then 1 else 0
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hP : P ∈ vpoly w
  · rw [if_pos hP]
    obtain ⟨k₀, hk₀⟩ := fan_exists hr hm3 hpl hstrict hs hcar hσ hP
    have hiff : ∀ k : Fin m,
        (if P ∈ triangleSet ⟨fanApex u, u k, u (k + 1)⟩ then (1 : ℤ) else 0)
          = if k = k₀ then 1 else 0 := by
      intro k
      by_cases hmem : P ∈ triangleSet ⟨fanApex u, u k, u (k + 1)⟩
      · rw [if_pos hmem,
          if_pos (fan_unique hr hm3 hpl hstrict hs hcar hσ hmem hk₀)]
      · rw [if_neg hmem, if_neg (fun hkk => hmem (by rw [hkk]; exact hk₀))]
    rw [Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun k _ => hiff k),
      Finset.sum_ite_eq' Finset.univ k₀ (fun _ => (1 : ℤ))]
    simp
  · rw [if_neg hP]
    rw [Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun k _ => if_neg
      (fun hmem => hP (fan_subset hr hm3 hpl hstrict hs.toRefShape k hmem)))]
    exact Finset.sum_const_zero

name: emit_count
statement:
theorem emit_count {g : Frag} [NeZero g.poly.size]
    (hr : 3 ≤ r) (hm3 : 3 ≤ g.poly.size)
    (hpl : OnPlane nt ct w) (hstrict : StrictConv nt w)
    (hs : RefShapeOrd w (fragCycle g))
    {P : Point} (hcar : dotQ nt P = ct)
    (hσ : ∀ k : Fin g.poly.size,
      areaForm nt (fanApex (fragCycle g)) (fragCycle g k) P ≠ 0) :
    ((emitFrag g).toList.map
        (fun τ => if P ∈ triangleSet τ then (1 : ℤ) else 0)).sum
      = if P ∈ vpoly w then 1 else 0
proof:
:= by
  have hp0 : 0 < g.poly.size := by omega
  have hp1 : 1 < g.poly.size := by omega
  have hp2 : 2 < g.poly.size := by omega
  by_cases h3 : g.poly.size = 3
  · 
    have e0 : g.poly.getD 0 default = g.poly[(⟨0, hp0⟩ : Fin g.poly.size)] :=
      getD_eq_getElem _ hp0 _
    have e1 : g.poly.getD 1 default = g.poly[(⟨1, hp1⟩ : Fin g.poly.size)] :=
      getD_eq_getElem _ hp1 _
    have e2 : g.poly.getD 2 default = g.poly[(⟨2, hp2⟩ : Fin g.poly.size)] :=
      getD_eq_getElem _ hp2 _
    have h1m : (1 : ℕ) % g.poly.size = 1 := Nat.mod_eq_of_lt (by omega)
    have hsucc0 : (⟨0, hp0⟩ : Fin g.poly.size) + 1 = ⟨1, hp1⟩ := by
      apply Fin.ext
      rw [Fin.val_add, Fin.val_one', h1m]
      show (0 + 1) % g.poly.size = 1
      rw [h3]
    have hsucc1 : (⟨1, hp1⟩ : Fin g.poly.size) + 1 = ⟨2, hp2⟩ := by
      apply Fin.ext
      rw [Fin.val_add, Fin.val_one', h1m]
      show (1 + 1) % g.poly.size = 2
      rw [h3]
    have hsucc2 : (⟨2, hp2⟩ : Fin g.poly.size) + 1 = ⟨0, hp0⟩ := by
      apply Fin.ext
      rw [Fin.val_add, Fin.val_one', h1m]
      show (2 + 1) % g.poly.size = 0
      rw [h3]
    have hne01 : fragCycle g ⟨0, hp0⟩ ≠ fragCycle g ⟨1, hp1⟩ := by
      have := hs.toRefShape.consec_ne hr hstrict ⟨0, hp0⟩
      rwa [hsucc0] at this
    have hne12 : fragCycle g ⟨1, hp1⟩ ≠ fragCycle g ⟨2, hp2⟩ := by
      have := hs.toRefShape.consec_ne hr hstrict ⟨1, hp1⟩
      rwa [hsucc1] at this
    have hne20 : fragCycle g ⟨2, hp2⟩ ≠ fragCycle g ⟨0, hp0⟩ := by
      have := hs.toRefShape.consec_ne hr hstrict ⟨2, hp2⟩
      rwa [hsucc2] at this
    have hemit := emitFrag_eq_triangle h3
      (by rw [e0, e1]; exact hne01)
      (by rw [e1, e2]; exact hne12)
      (by rw [e2, e0]; exact hne20)
    rw [hemit]
    show (if P ∈ triangleSet ⟨P3.toPoint (g.poly.getD 0 default).p,
        P3.toPoint (g.poly.getD 1 default).p,
        P3.toPoint (g.poly.getD 2 default).p⟩ then (1 : ℤ) else 0) + 0
      = if P ∈ vpoly w then 1 else 0
    rw [add_zero]
    
    have hseteq : triangleSet ⟨P3.toPoint (g.poly.getD 0 default).p,
        P3.toPoint (g.poly.getD 1 default).p,
        P3.toPoint (g.poly.getD 2 default).p⟩ = vpoly w := by
      rw [triangleSet_eq_vpoly, ← hs.toRefShape.vpoly_eq]
      show convexHull ℚ _ = convexHull ℚ _
      congr 1
      ext x
      constructor
      · rintro ⟨j, rfl⟩
        fin_cases j
        · exact ⟨⟨0, hp0⟩, by rw [e0]; rfl⟩
        · exact ⟨⟨1, hp1⟩, by rw [e1]; rfl⟩
        · exact ⟨⟨2, hp2⟩, by rw [e2]; rfl⟩
      · rintro ⟨j, rfl⟩
        rcases j with ⟨jv, hjv⟩
        have hj3 : jv < 3 := by omega
        interval_cases jv
        · exact ⟨0, by rw [show fragCycle g ⟨0, hp0⟩
            = P3.toPoint (g.poly.getD 0 default).p from by rw [e0]; rfl]; rfl⟩
        · exact ⟨1, by rw [show fragCycle g ⟨1, hp1⟩
            = P3.toPoint (g.poly.getD 1 default).p from by rw [e1]; rfl]; rfl⟩
        · exact ⟨2, by rw [show fragCycle g ⟨2, hp2⟩
            = P3.toPoint (g.poly.getD 2 default).p from by rw [e2]; rfl]; rfl⟩
    rw [hseteq]
  · 
    have hemit := emitFrag_eq_fan h3 hm3
      (fun k => hs.toRefShape.apex_ne hr hm3 hpl hstrict k)
      (fun k => hs.toRefShape.consec_ne hr hstrict k)
    rw [hemit, List.map_ofFn, List.sum_ofFn]
    exact fan_count hr hm3 hpl hstrict hs hcar hσ

name: injective_of_linear_injective
statement:
theorem injective_of_linear_injective (iota : Plane2 →ᵃ[ℚ] Point)
    (hLin : Function.Injective iota.linear) : Function.Injective iota
proof:
:=
  (AffineMap.linear_injective_iff iota).mp hLin

name: finrank_vectorSpan_image
statement:
theorem finrank_vectorSpan_image (iota : Plane2 →ᵃ[ℚ] Point)
    (hLin : Function.Injective iota.linear) (S : Set Plane2) :
    Module.finrank ℚ (vectorSpan ℚ (iota '' S)) = Module.finrank ℚ (vectorSpan ℚ S)
proof:
:= by
  
  rw [← AffineMap.vectorSpan_image_eq_submodule_map]
  
  exact ((Submodule.equivMapOfInjective iota.linear hLin (vectorSpan ℚ S)).finrank_eq).symm

name: image_convexHull
statement:
theorem image_convexHull (iota : Plane2 →ᵃ[ℚ] Point) (S : Set Plane2) :
    iota '' (convexHull ℚ S) = convexHull ℚ (iota '' S)
proof:
:=
  AffineMap.image_convexHull iota S

name: affineIndependent_image_iff
statement:
theorem affineIndependent_image_iff {ι : Type*} (iota : Plane2 →ᵃ[ℚ] Point)
    (hLin : Function.Injective iota.linear) (p : ι → Plane2) :
    AffineIndependent ℚ (fun i => iota (p i)) ↔ AffineIndependent ℚ p
proof:
:=
  iota.affineIndependent_iff (injective_of_linear_injective iota hLin)

name: plane_iso
statement:
theorem plane_iso
    {m : ℕ} (g : Fin m → (Point →ᵃ[ℚ] ℚ)) (P : Set Point)
    (hP : P = ⋂ i, {x | 0 ≤ g i x})
    (hdim : Module.finrank ℚ (vectorSpan ℚ P) = 2) :
    ∃ (iota : Plane2 →ᵃ[ℚ] Point) (iotaInv : Point →ᵃ[ℚ] Plane2)
       (g' : Fin m → (Plane2 →ᵃ[ℚ] ℚ)) (Pq : Set Plane2),
      Function.Injective iota.linear
      ∧ Set.range iota = (affineSpan ℚ P : Set Point)
      ∧ (∀ y : Plane2, iotaInv (iota y) = y)
      ∧ Pq = ⋂ i, {y | 0 ≤ g' i y}
      ∧ (∀ i, g' i = (g i).comp iota)
      ∧ iota '' Pq = P
      ∧ Module.finrank ℚ (vectorSpan ℚ Pq) = 2
proof:
:= by
  
  
  
  
  
  
  
  
  
  
  
  
  
  
  
  
  
  
  
  
  
  
  
  have hPne : P.Nonempty := by
    by_contra h
    rw [Set.not_nonempty_iff_eq_empty] at h
    subst h
    rw [vectorSpan_def, show ((∅ : Set Point) -ᵥ (∅ : Set Point)) = (∅ : Set Point) by simp,
        Submodule.span_empty] at hdim
    simp at hdim
  obtain ⟨o, hoP⟩ := hPne
  
  set D : Submodule ℚ Point := vectorSpan ℚ P with hD
  have hfin : Module.finrank ℚ ↥D = 2 := hdim
  let bD : Basis (Fin 2) ℚ ↥D := Module.finBasisOfFinrankEq ℚ ↥D hfin
  let e : (Fin 2 → ℚ) ≃ₗ[ℚ] ↥D := bD.equivFun.symm
  
  let L : Plane2 →ₗ[ℚ] Point := D.subtype ∘ₗ (e : (Fin 2 → ℚ) →ₗ[ℚ] ↥D)
  have hLinj : Function.Injective L := by
    have : (L : Plane2 → Point) = D.subtype ∘ e := by ext y; simp [L]
    rw [this]; exact D.injective_subtype.comp e.injective
  have hLrange : LinearMap.range L = D := by
    show LinearMap.range (D.subtype ∘ₗ (e : (Fin 2 → ℚ) →ₗ[ℚ] ↥D)) = D
    rw [LinearMap.range_comp, LinearEquiv.range, Submodule.map_subtype_top]
  
  let iota : Plane2 →ᵃ[ℚ] Point :=
    AffineMap.mk' (fun y => L y +ᵥ o) L (0 : Plane2) (by intro y; simp)
  have hiotalin : iota.linear = L := AffineMap.mk'_linear _ _ _ _
  have hiotaapp : ∀ y, iota y = L y +ᵥ o := fun _ => rfl
  have hiota0 : iota 0 = o := by rw [hiotaapp]; simp
  have hiotainj : Function.Injective iota.linear := by rw [hiotalin]; exact hLinj
  
  have hrange : Set.range iota = (affineSpan ℚ P : Set Point) := by
    have hcoe : Set.range iota = (↑(AffineSubspace.map iota ⊤) : Set Point) := by
      rw [AffineSubspace.coe_map, AffineSubspace.top_coe, Set.image_univ]
    rw [hcoe]
    apply congrArg (SetLike.coe)
    have hmemP : o ∈ affineSpan ℚ P := subset_affineSpan ℚ P hoP
    have hmemMap : o ∈ AffineSubspace.map iota ⊤ := by
      rw [AffineSubspace.mem_map]; exact ⟨0, AffineSubspace.mem_top _ _ _, hiota0⟩
    rw [AffineSubspace.eq_iff_direction_eq_of_mem hmemMap hmemP,
        AffineSubspace.map_direction, AffineSubspace.direction_top, hiotalin,
        direction_affineSpan, Submodule.map_top, hLrange]
  
  have hker : LinearMap.ker L = ⊥ := LinearMap.ker_eq_bot.mpr hLinj
  obtain ⟨M, hM⟩ := L.exists_leftInverse_of_injective hker
  let iotaInv : Point →ᵃ[ℚ] Plane2 :=
    AffineMap.mk' (fun x => M (x -ᵥ o)) M o (by intro x; simp)
  have hinv : ∀ y, iotaInv (iota y) = y := by
    intro y
    show M (iota y -ᵥ o) = y
    rw [hiotaapp]; simp only [vadd_vsub]
    have : M (L y) = (M ∘ₗ L) y := rfl
    rw [this, hM]; simp
  
  let g' : Fin m → (Plane2 →ᵃ[ℚ] ℚ) := fun i => (g i).comp iota
  let Pq : Set Plane2 := ⋂ i, {y | 0 ≤ g' i y}
  have hPqdef : Pq = ⋂ i, {y | 0 ≤ g' i y} := rfl
  have hg' : ∀ i, g' i = (g i).comp iota := fun _ => rfl
  
  have hmemequiv : ∀ y : Plane2, (iota y ∈ P ↔ y ∈ Pq) := by
    intro y
    rw [hP]
    show (iota y ∈ ⋂ i, {x | 0 ≤ g i x}) ↔ (y ∈ ⋂ i, {z | 0 ≤ g' i z})
    simp only [Set.mem_iInter, Set.mem_setOf_eq]
    constructor
    · intro h i; show 0 ≤ g' i y; simpa [g', AffineMap.comp_apply] using h i
    · intro h i; have := h i; simpa [g', AffineMap.comp_apply] using this
  have hPsub : P ⊆ Set.range iota := by rw [hrange]; exact subset_affineSpan ℚ P
  
  have hiotaPq : iota '' Pq = P := by
    ext x
    constructor
    · rintro ⟨y, hy, rfl⟩; exact (hmemequiv y).mpr hy
    · intro hx; obtain ⟨y, rfl⟩ := hPsub hx; exact ⟨y, (hmemequiv y).mp hx, rfl⟩
  
  have hdim' : Module.finrank ℚ (vectorSpan ℚ Pq) = 2 := by
    have hfr := finrank_vectorSpan_image iota hiotainj Pq
    rw [hiotaPq] at hfr
    rw [← hfr, hdim]
  exact ⟨iota, iotaInv, g', Pq, hiotainj, hrange, hinv, hPqdef, hg', hiotaPq, hdim'⟩

name: rmin_eq
statement: theorem rmin_eq (a b : Rat) : rmin a b = min a b
proof:
:= by
  unfold rmin; split
  · rw [min_eq_left ‹a ≤ b›]
  · rw [min_eq_right (le_of_not_le ‹¬ a ≤ b›)]

name: rmax_eq
statement: theorem rmax_eq (a b : Rat) : rmax a b = max a b
proof:
:= by
  unfold rmax; split
  · rw [max_eq_right ‹a ≤ b›]
  · rw [max_eq_left (le_of_not_le ‹¬ a ≤ b›)]

name: segment_coord_bound
statement:
theorem segment_coord_bound (a b p : Fin 3 → ℚ) (hp : p ∈ segment ℚ a b) (k : Fin 3) :
    min (a k) (b k) ≤ p k ∧ p k ≤ max (a k) (b k)
proof:
:= by
  rw [segment_eq_image] at hp
  obtain ⟨θ, hθ, rfl⟩ := hp
  simp only [Set.mem_Icc] at hθ
  obtain ⟨h0, h1⟩ := hθ
  simp only [Pi.add_apply, Pi.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul]
  refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
  · rcases le_total (a k) (b k) with h | h
    · rw [min_eq_left h]; nlinarith
    · rw [min_eq_right h]; nlinarith
  · rcases le_total (a k) (b k) with h | h
    · rw [max_eq_right h]; nlinarith
    · rw [max_eq_left h]; nlinarith

name: box_from_edge
statement:
theorem box_from_edge (lo hi a b p : ℚ)
    (hloab : lo ≤ min a b) (hhiab : max a b ≤ hi)
    (hlo : min a b ≤ p) (hhi : p ≤ max a b) : lo ≤ p ∧ p ≤ hi
proof:
:=
  ⟨le_trans hloab hlo, le_trans hhi hhiab⟩

name: edgeSet_subset_box
statement:
theorem edgeSet_subset_box (S : Triangle) (p : Point) (hp : p ∈ edgeSet S) :
    inBox (boxOfTri S) p
proof:
:= by
  unfold edgeSet at hp
  unfold boxOfTri bboxOf inBox ofPoint
  simp only [rmin_eq, rmax_eq]
  
  have hmin01 : ∀ k, min (S.v₀ k) (min (S.v₁ k) (S.v₂ k)) ≤ min (S.v₀ k) (S.v₁ k) := fun k =>
    min_le_min_left _ (min_le_left _ _)
  have hmin12 : ∀ k, min (S.v₀ k) (min (S.v₁ k) (S.v₂ k)) ≤ min (S.v₁ k) (S.v₂ k) := fun k =>
    min_le_right _ _
  have hmin20 : ∀ k, min (S.v₀ k) (min (S.v₁ k) (S.v₂ k)) ≤ min (S.v₂ k) (S.v₀ k) := fun k => by
    rw [min_comm (S.v₂ k) (S.v₀ k)]; exact min_le_min_left _ (min_le_right _ _)
  have hmax01 : ∀ k, max (S.v₀ k) (S.v₁ k) ≤ max (S.v₀ k) (max (S.v₁ k) (S.v₂ k)) := fun k =>
    max_le_max_left _ (le_max_left _ _)
  have hmax12 : ∀ k, max (S.v₁ k) (S.v₂ k) ≤ max (S.v₀ k) (max (S.v₁ k) (S.v₂ k)) := fun k =>
    le_max_right _ _
  have hmax20 : ∀ k, max (S.v₂ k) (S.v₀ k) ≤ max (S.v₀ k) (max (S.v₁ k) (S.v₂ k)) := fun k => by
    rw [max_comm (S.v₂ k) (S.v₀ k)]; exact max_le_max_left _ (le_max_right _ _)
  rcases hp with (hp | hp) | hp
  · 
    exact ⟨box_from_edge _ _ _ _ _ (hmin01 0) (hmax01 0) (segment_coord_bound _ _ p hp 0).1 (segment_coord_bound _ _ p hp 0).2,
           box_from_edge _ _ _ _ _ (hmin01 1) (hmax01 1) (segment_coord_bound _ _ p hp 1).1 (segment_coord_bound _ _ p hp 1).2,
           box_from_edge _ _ _ _ _ (hmin01 2) (hmax01 2) (segment_coord_bound _ _ p hp 2).1 (segment_coord_bound _ _ p hp 2).2⟩
  · 
    exact ⟨box_from_edge _ _ _ _ _ (hmin12 0) (hmax12 0) (segment_coord_bound _ _ p hp 0).1 (segment_coord_bound _ _ p hp 0).2,
           box_from_edge _ _ _ _ _ (hmin12 1) (hmax12 1) (segment_coord_bound _ _ p hp 1).1 (segment_coord_bound _ _ p hp 1).2,
           box_from_edge _ _ _ _ _ (hmin12 2) (hmax12 2) (segment_coord_bound _ _ p hp 2).1 (segment_coord_bound _ _ p hp 2).2⟩
  · 
    exact ⟨box_from_edge _ _ _ _ _ (hmin20 0) (hmax20 0) (segment_coord_bound _ _ p hp 0).1 (segment_coord_bound _ _ p hp 0).2,
           box_from_edge _ _ _ _ _ (hmin20 1) (hmax20 1) (segment_coord_bound _ _ p hp 1).1 (segment_coord_bound _ _ p hp 1).2,
           box_from_edge _ _ _ _ _ (hmin20 2) (hmax20 2) (segment_coord_bound _ _ p hp 2).1 (segment_coord_bound _ _ p hp 2).2⟩

name: not_boxesOverlap_disjoint
statement:
theorem not_boxesOverlap_disjoint (u v : Box3) (h : boxesOverlap u v = false) (p : Point)
    (hpu : inBox u p) (hpv : inBox v p) : False
proof:
:= by
  unfold boxesOverlap at h
  unfold inBox at hpu hpv
  simp only [Bool.and_eq_false_iff, decide_eq_false_iff_not, not_le] at h
  obtain ⟨⟨a0u, a0u'⟩, a1u, a1u'⟩ := hpu
  obtain ⟨⟨a0v, a0v'⟩, a1v, a1v'⟩ := hpv
  
  rcases h with (((((h | h) | h) | h) | h) | h)
  · linarith [a0u, a0v']   
  · linarith [a0v, a0u']
  · linarith [a1u.1, a1v.2]
  · linarith [a1v.1, a1u.2]
  · linarith [a1u'.1, a1v'.2]
  · linarith [a1v'.1, a1u'.2]

name: boxes_miss_edgeSet_disjoint
statement:
theorem boxes_miss_edgeSet_disjoint (S T : Triangle)
    (h : boxesOverlap (boxOfTri S) (boxOfTri T) = false) :
    edgeSet S ∩ edgeSet T = ∅
proof:
:= by
  rw [Set.eq_empty_iff_forall_not_mem]
  rintro p ⟨hpS, hpT⟩
  exact not_boxesOverlap_disjoint _ _ h p (edgeSet_subset_box S p hpS) (edgeSet_subset_box T p hpT)

name: copA_hull_off_of_no_jump
statement:
theorem copA_hull_off_of_no_jump (M₁ M₂ : Mesh) (h₁ : Legacy.WellFormedMesh M₁)
    {Q : Point} (hQ1 : ∀ i : Fin M₁.size, dotQ (carrierNormal M₁[i]) Q ≠ 0)
    {v : ℚ} (hpos : 0 < v)
    (hno1 : ∀ i : Fin M₁.size, ¬ Proof.MeshIntersectDelta.FaceJumps M₁[i] Q v)
    {fa : Frag}
    (hfa : fa ∈ (splitCoplanar (Proof.MeshIntersectNsi.fragsAOf M₁ M₂) (materialize M₂)).1) :
    v • Q ∉ Proof.MeshIntersectClip.vpoly (fragCycle fa)
proof:
:= by
  intro hmem
  obtain ⟨i, hi, hfaInv, hdi, hfapl, hfaclip⟩ := Proof.MeshIntersectNsi.copA_carrier h₁.2.2.2 hfa
  have hQi : dotQ (carrierNormal (M₁[i]'hi)) Q ≠ 0 := hQ1 ⟨i, hi⟩
  have hiMz : i < (materialize M₁).size := by rw [materialize_size]; exact hi
  have hgetD : (materialize M₁).getD i default = faceSOf (M₁[i]'hi) := by
    rw [Proof.MeshIntersectKeep.arr_getD _ _ _ hiMz, materialize_getElem M₁ i hi]
  have hbase : FragInv (carrierNormal (M₁[i]'hi)) (detOrigin (M₁[i]'hi))
      (fragOfFace ((materialize M₁).getD i default)) := by
    rw [hgetD]; exact Proof.MeshIntersectKeep.fragInv_base hdi
  have hsub : Proof.MeshIntersectClip.vpoly (fragCycle fa) ⊆ triangleSet (M₁[i]'hi) := by
    refine (Proof.MeshIntersectClipBridge.clipFaceScoped_vpoly_subset hbase _ hfaclip).trans ?_
    rw [hgetD, Proof.MeshIntersectKeep.vpoly_fragOfFace]
  have hPt : v • Q ∈ triangleSet (M₁[i]'hi) := hsub hmem
  have hlevel : dotQ (carrierNormal (M₁[i]'hi)) (v • Q) = detOrigin (M₁[i]'hi) :=
    Proof.MeshIntersectRay.triangleSet_subset_level
      (Proof.MeshIntersectRay.dotQ_carrierNormal_v₀ _)
      (Proof.MeshIntersectRay.dotQ_carrierNormal_v₁ _)
      (Proof.MeshIntersectRay.dotQ_carrierNormal_v₂ _) (v • Q) hPt
  have hmu : Proof.MeshIntersectDelta.muF (M₁[i]'hi) Q = v := by
    rw [Proof.MeshIntersectDelta.muF]
    rw [Proof.MeshIntersectRay.dotQ_smul_right] at hlevel
    field_simp at hlevel ⊢
    linarith [hlevel]
  apply hno1 ⟨i, hi⟩
  refine ⟨hmu, by rw [Fin.getElem_fin, hmu]; exact hpos, ?_⟩
  show Proof.MeshIntersectDelta.hitF (M₁[i]'hi) Q ∈ triangleSet (M₁[i]'hi)
  rw [Proof.MeshIntersectDelta.hitF, hmu]; exact hPt

name: keptFaceB_cover_ge_one
statement:
theorem keptFaceB_cover_ge_one (M₁ M₂ : Mesh)
    (h₁ : Legacy.WellFormedMesh M₁) (h₂ : Legacy.WellFormedMesh M₂)
    {Q : Point} (hG : Gen M₁ M₂ Q) (j : Fin M₂.size)
    (hcop : ¬ Proof.MeshIntersectCop.TrFace M₂ M₁ j.1 j.isLt)
    (hpos : 0 < Proof.MeshIntersectStep.faceParam M₂[j] Q)
    (hno1 : ∀ i : Fin M₁.size,
        ¬ Proof.MeshIntersectDelta.FaceJumps M₁[i] Q (Proof.MeshIntersectStep.faceParam M₂[j] Q))
    (hwind : winding (meshChain M₁) (Proof.MeshIntersectStep.faceHit M₂[j] Q) = 1)
    (hPS : Proof.MeshIntersectStep.faceHit M₂[j] Q ∈ triangleSet M₂[j]) :
    1 ≤ ((copDescB M₁ M₂ j.1).toList.map
        (fun f => if Proof.MeshIntersectStep.faceHit M₂[j] Q
            ∈ Proof.MeshIntersectClip.vpoly (fragCycle f) then (1 : ℤ) else 0)).sum
proof:
:= by
  classical
  set P := Proof.MeshIntersectStep.faceHit M₂[j] Q with hP
  have hdetB : detOrigin M₂[j] ≠ 0 := h₂.2.2.2 j
  have hQ2 : dotQ (carrierNormal M₂[j]) Q ≠ 0 := hG.2.1 j
  have hQ1 : ∀ i : Fin M₁.size, dotQ (carrierNormal M₁[i]) Q ≠ 0 := hG.1
  have hgetD : (materialize M₂).getD j.1 default = faceSOf M₂[j] := by
    rw [getD_eq_getElem (materialize M₂) (by rw [materialize_size]; exact j.isLt) default,
      materialize_getElem M₂ j.1 j.isLt]; rfl
  set base := fragOfFace ((materialize M₂).getD j.1 default) with hbase
  have hbaseInv : FragInv (carrierNormal M₂[j]) (detOrigin M₂[j]) base := by
    rw [hbase, hgetD]; exact Proof.MeshIntersectKeep.fragInv_base hdetB
  have hbaseT : Proof.MeshIntersectClip.vpoly (fragCycle base) = triangleSet M₂[j] := by
    rw [hbase, hgetD, Proof.MeshIntersectKeep.vpoly_fragOfFace]
  
  have hPbase : P ∈ Proof.MeshIntersectClip.vpoly (fragCycle base) := by rw [hbaseT]; exact hPS
  set L := planesForScoped ((materialize M₂).getD j.1 default).plane (materialize M₁)
    ((candP M₂ M₁).getD j.1 #[]) with hL
  
  obtain ⟨fb, hfbClip, hPfb⟩ := (clipFaceScoped_mem_vpoly_iff hbaseInv L P).mpr hPbase
  have hfbInv : FragInv (carrierNormal M₂[j]) (detOrigin M₂[j]) fb :=
    fragInv_clipFaceScoped hbaseInv _ hfbClip
  haveI := hfbInv.neZero
  have hfbpl : fb.plane = (faceSOf M₂[j]).plane := by
    have := Proof.MeshIntersectNsi.clipFaceScoped_plane base L hfbClip
    rw [hbase, hgetD, fragOfFace] at this; simpa using this
  
  set copA := (splitCoplanar (Proof.MeshIntersectNsi.fragsAOf M₁ M₂) (materialize M₂)).1 with hcopA
  have hcopA_eq : copA = (splitCoplanar
      ((Array.range (materialize M₁).size).flatMap (fun i =>
        clipFaceScoped (fragOfFace ((materialize M₁).getD i default))
          (planesForScoped ((materialize M₁).getD i default).plane (materialize M₂)
            ((candP M₁ M₂).getD i #[]))))
      (materialize M₂)).1 := by rw [hcopA, Proof.MeshIntersectNsi.fragsAOf]
  
  have hoppInv : ∀ fa ∈ copA, ∃ n' c', FragInv n' c' fa
      ∧ (coplanarPlane fb.plane fa.plane = true →
          ∃ ρ : ℚ, ρ ≠ 0 ∧ n' = ρ • carrierNormal M₂[j] ∧ c' = ρ * detOrigin M₂[j]) :=
    copA_hoppInv h₁.2.2.2 hdetB hfbpl
  
  have hPeqv : P = Proof.MeshIntersectStep.faceParam M₂[j] Q • Q := by rw [hP]; rfl
  have hxov : ∀ fa ∈ copA, P ∉ Proof.MeshIntersectClip.vpoly (fragCycle fa) := by
    intro fa hfa
    rw [hPeqv]
    exact copA_hull_off_of_no_jump M₁ M₂ h₁ hQ1 hpos hno1 hfa
  
  obtain ⟨p, hpPend, hPp⟩ := Proof.MeshIntersectResolve.resolveFragB_cover copA
    hfbInv hoppInv hPfb hxov
  
  haveI := (Proof.MeshIntersectResolve.resolveFragBPending_fragInv copA hfbInv p hpPend).neZero
  
  have hPrel : P ∈ Proof.MeshIntersectClip.vrelint (fragCycle p) :=
    cop_cell_relint_dichotomyB_pending M₁ M₂ h₁ h₂ hG j hfbClip hcopA_eq hpPend hPp
  
  have hfbClip' : fb ∈ clipFaceScoped (fragOfFace (faceSOf M₂[j])) L := by
    rwa [hbase, hgetD] at hfbClip
  have hfbcop : isCoplanarWith fb (materialize M₁) = true := by
    by_contra hc
    rw [Bool.not_eq_true,
      (Proof.MeshIntersectCop.isCoplanarWith_clipFace_iff (MB := M₁) 2 j.isLt hfbClip')] at hc
    exact hcop hc
  have hfbFilt : fb ∈ (clipFaceScoped base L).filter (fun f => isCoplanarWith f (materialize M₁)) :=
    Array.mem_filter.mpr ⟨hfbClip, hfbcop⟩
  
  have hPeqParam : P = (detOrigin M₂[j] / dotQ (carrierNormal M₂[j]) Q) • Q := by
    rw [hP]; simp only [Proof.MeshIntersectStep.faceHit, Proof.MeshIntersectStep.faceParam,
      Fin.getElem_fin]
  have hG1pj'0 := gen_Aprime_seg₂_pending hG j hQ2 hfbClip hcopA_eq hpPend
  have hG1pj' : ∀ (k : ℕ) (hk : k < M₁.size),
      coplanarPlane (faceSOf (M₁[k]'hk)).plane fb.plane = false →
      ∀ g ∈ Impl.Legacy.Sim.tetraHalves (M₁[k]'hk), g.eval P ≠ 0 := by
    rw [hPeqParam]; exact hG1pj'0
  
  have havoid : ∀ fa ∈ copA, coplanarPlane fb.plane fa.plane = true →
      Proof.MeshIntersectClip.vrelint (fragCycle p)
        ∩ Proof.MeshIntersectClip.vrelint (fragCycle fa) = ∅ := by
    intro fa hfa hcofa
    exact Proof.MeshIntersectResolve.resolveFragBPending_avoids copA hfbInv hoppInv hfa hcofa hpPend
  
  have hfbB : fb ∈ (splitCoplanar (Proof.MeshIntersectNsi.fragsBOf M₁ M₂) (materialize M₁)).1 := by
    rw [splitCoplanar]; simp only
    refine Array.mem_filter.mpr ⟨?_, by simpa using hfbcop⟩
    rw [Proof.MeshIntersectNsi.fragsBOf]
    refine mem_flatMap_arr.mpr ⟨j.1, ?_, ?_⟩
    · rw [Array.mem_def, Array.toList_range, List.mem_range, materialize_size]; exact j.isLt
    · rw [hbase] at hfbClip; exact hfbClip
  
  
  
  have hoff : Proof.MeshIntersectRadialTransport.OffBdy M₁ P := by
    intro k
    by_cases hCk : coplanarPlane (faceSOf M₁[k]).plane fb.plane = false
    · exact Or.inl (hG1pj' k.1 k.isLt hCk)
    · refine Or.inr ?_
      rw [Bool.not_eq_false] at hCk
      have hns := Bprime_seg_offSimplex_cop_pending h₁ h₂ hfbB (hcopA ▸ hpPend)
        (fun fa hfa hc => havoid fa (hcopA ▸ hfa) hc) hPrel hPrel k.1 k.isLt hCk 0
        (le_refl (0:ℚ)) zero_le_one
      have hseg0 : Proof.MeshIntersectCancel.seg P P (0:ℚ) = P :=
        Proof.MeshIntersectCancel.seg_zero P P
      rwa [hseg0] at hns
  
  have hkeep : keepFallback (faceBVH (prepare (materialize M₁))) (prepare (materialize M₁)) p
      = true := by
    have hiff := keep_iff_winding_of_AprimeB_pending M₁ M₂ h₁ h₂ hfbB
      (hcopA ▸ hpPend) (fun fa hfa hc => havoid fa (hcopA ▸ hfa) hc)
      hPrel hoff
    rw [hiff]; exact hwind
  
  have hpKept : p ∈ resolveCoplanar.resolveFragB (faceBVH (prepare (materialize M₁))) fb copA
      (prepare (materialize M₁)) :=
    Proof.MeshIntersectResolve.mem_resolveFragB_of_pending_keepFallback _ fb copA
      (prepare (materialize M₁)) hpPend hkeep
  have hpCop : p ∈ copDescB M₁ M₂ j.1 := by
    rw [copDescB_eq]
    refine mem_flatMap_arr.mpr ⟨fb, hfbFilt, ?_⟩
    rw [← hcopA_eq]; exact hpKept
  
  have hmemList : p ∈ (copDescB M₁ M₂ j.1).toList := Array.mem_toList.mpr hpCop
  have hone : (if P ∈ Proof.MeshIntersectClip.vpoly (fragCycle p) then (1 : ℤ) else 0) = 1 := by
    rw [if_pos hPp]
  refine le_trans ?_ (List.single_le_sum ?_ _ (List.mem_map_of_mem _ hmemList))
  · show (1 : ℤ) ≤ (if P ∈ Proof.MeshIntersectClip.vpoly (fragCycle p) then (1 : ℤ) else 0)
    rw [hone]
  · intro x hx
    rw [List.mem_map] at hx
    obtain ⟨g, _, rfl⟩ := hx
    by_cases hfp : P ∈ Proof.MeshIntersectClip.vpoly (fragCycle g) <;>
      simp only [hfp, if_true, if_false, le_refl, zero_le_one]

name: keptFaceB_pending_cell_winding
statement:
theorem keptFaceB_pending_cell_winding (M₁ M₂ : Mesh)
    (h₁ : Legacy.WellFormedMesh M₁) (h₂ : Legacy.WellFormedMesh M₂)
    {Q : Point} (hG : Gen M₁ M₂ Q) (j : Fin M₂.size)
    {fb : Frag}
    (hfbClip : fb ∈ clipFaceScoped (fragOfFace ((materialize M₂).getD j.1 default))
        (planesForScoped ((materialize M₂).getD j.1 default).plane (materialize M₁)
          ((candP M₂ M₁).getD j.1 #[])))
    (hfbpl : fb.plane = (faceSOf M₂[j]).plane)
    (hfbB : fb ∈ (splitCoplanar (Proof.MeshIntersectNsi.fragsBOf M₁ M₂) (materialize M₁)).1)
    {f : Frag} (hpPend : f ∈ Proof.MeshIntersectResolve.resolveFragBPending fb
        (splitCoplanar (Proof.MeshIntersectNsi.fragsAOf M₁ M₂) (materialize M₂)).1)
    {bvhW : Impl.BVH.BVH} (hbvhW : bvhW = faceBVH (prepare (materialize M₁)))
    (hkeepfT : keepFallback bvhW (prepare (materialize M₁)) f = true)
    (hPp : Proof.MeshIntersectStep.faceHit M₂[j] Q
        ∈ Proof.MeshIntersectClip.vpoly (fragCycle f)) :
    winding (meshChain M₁) (Proof.MeshIntersectStep.faceHit M₂[j] Q) = 1
proof:
:= by
  classical
  set P := Proof.MeshIntersectStep.faceHit M₂[j] Q with hP
  set copA := (splitCoplanar (Proof.MeshIntersectNsi.fragsAOf M₁ M₂) (materialize M₂)).1 with hcopA
  have hdetB : detOrigin M₂[j] ≠ 0 := h₂.2.2.2 j
  have hQ2 : dotQ (carrierNormal M₂[j]) Q ≠ 0 := hG.2.1 j
  have hcopA_eq : copA = (splitCoplanar
      ((Array.range (materialize M₁).size).flatMap (fun i =>
        clipFaceScoped (fragOfFace ((materialize M₁).getD i default))
          (planesForScoped ((materialize M₁).getD i default).plane (materialize M₂)
            ((candP M₁ M₂).getD i #[]))))
      (materialize M₂)).1 := by rw [hcopA, Proof.MeshIntersectNsi.fragsAOf]
  have hfbInv : FragInv (carrierNormal M₂[j]) (detOrigin M₂[j]) fb := by
    have hgetD : (materialize M₂).getD j.1 default = faceSOf M₂[j] := by
      rw [getD_eq_getElem (materialize M₂) (by rw [materialize_size]; exact j.isLt) default,
        materialize_getElem M₂ j.1 j.isLt]; rfl
    have hbaseInv : FragInv (carrierNormal M₂[j]) (detOrigin M₂[j])
        (fragOfFace ((materialize M₂).getD j.1 default)) := by
      rw [hgetD]; exact Proof.MeshIntersectKeep.fragInv_base hdetB
    exact fragInv_clipFaceScoped hbaseInv _ hfbClip
  have hoppInv : ∀ fa ∈ copA, ∃ n' c', FragInv n' c' fa
      ∧ (coplanarPlane fb.plane fa.plane = true →
          ∃ ρ : ℚ, ρ ≠ 0 ∧ n' = ρ • carrierNormal M₂[j] ∧ c' = ρ * detOrigin M₂[j]) :=
    copA_hoppInv h₁.2.2.2 hdetB hfbpl
  have hPrel : P ∈ Proof.MeshIntersectClip.vrelint (fragCycle f) :=
    cop_cell_relint_dichotomyB_pending M₁ M₂ h₁ h₂ hG j hfbClip hcopA_eq hpPend hPp
  have hPeqParam : P = (detOrigin M₂[j] / dotQ (carrierNormal M₂[j]) Q) • Q := by
    rw [hP]; simp only [Proof.MeshIntersectStep.faceHit, Proof.MeshIntersectStep.faceParam,
      Fin.getElem_fin]
  have hG1pj'0 := gen_Aprime_seg₂_pending hG j hQ2 hfbClip hcopA_eq hpPend
  have hG1pj' : ∀ (k : ℕ) (hk : k < M₁.size),
      coplanarPlane (faceSOf (M₁[k]'hk)).plane fb.plane = false →
      ∀ g ∈ Impl.Legacy.Sim.tetraHalves (M₁[k]'hk), g.eval P ≠ 0 := by
    rw [hPeqParam]; exact hG1pj'0
  have havoid : ∀ fa ∈ copA, coplanarPlane fb.plane fa.plane = true →
      Proof.MeshIntersectClip.vrelint (fragCycle f)
        ∩ Proof.MeshIntersectClip.vrelint (fragCycle fa) = ∅ := by
    intro fa hfa hcofa
    exact Proof.MeshIntersectResolve.resolveFragBPending_avoids copA hfbInv hoppInv hfa hcofa hpPend
  
  have hoff : Proof.MeshIntersectRadialTransport.OffBdy M₁ P := by
    intro k
    by_cases hCk : coplanarPlane (faceSOf M₁[k]).plane fb.plane = false
    · exact Or.inl (hG1pj' k.1 k.isLt hCk)
    · refine Or.inr ?_
      rw [Bool.not_eq_false] at hCk
      have hns := Bprime_seg_offSimplex_cop_pending h₁ h₂ hfbB (hcopA ▸ hpPend)
        (fun fa hfa hc => havoid fa (hcopA ▸ hfa) hc) hPrel hPrel k.1 k.isLt hCk 0
        (le_refl (0:ℚ)) zero_le_one
      have hseg0 : Proof.MeshIntersectCancel.seg P P (0:ℚ) = P :=
        Proof.MeshIntersectCancel.seg_zero P P
      rwa [hseg0] at hns
  rw [hbvhW] at hkeepfT
  have hiff := keep_iff_winding_of_AprimeB_pending M₁ M₂ h₁ h₂ hfbB (hcopA ▸ hpPend)
    (fun fa hfa hc => havoid fa (hcopA ▸ hfa) hc) hPrel hoff
  exact hiff.mp hkeepfT

name: keptFaceB_cop_pierce_winding
statement:
theorem keptFaceB_cop_pierce_winding (M₁ M₂ : Mesh)
    (h₁ : Legacy.WellFormedMesh M₁) (h₂ : Legacy.WellFormedMesh M₂)
    {Q : Point} (hG : Gen M₁ M₂ Q) (j : Fin M₂.size)
    {f : Frag} (hf : f ∈ copDescB M₁ M₂ j.1)
    (hPp : Proof.MeshIntersectStep.faceHit M₂[j] Q
        ∈ Proof.MeshIntersectClip.vpoly (fragCycle f)) :
    winding (meshChain M₁) (Proof.MeshIntersectStep.faceHit M₂[j] Q) = 1
proof:
:= by
  classical
  obtain ⟨fb, hfbB, hfbpl, hfbClipD, hfmem⟩ := mem_copDescB_parent M₁ M₂ j.1 j.isLt hf
  have hpPend : f ∈ Proof.MeshIntersectResolve.resolveFragBPending fb
      (splitCoplanar (Proof.MeshIntersectNsi.fragsAOf M₁ M₂) (materialize M₂)).1 :=
    Proof.MeshIntersectResolve.mem_resolveFragBPending_of_resolveFragB _ fb _ _ hfmem
  have hkeepf : keepFallback (faceBVH (prepare (materialize M₁))) (prepare (materialize M₁)) f
      = true :=
    Proof.MeshIntersectResolve.resolveFragB_kept_fallback _ fb _ _ hfmem
  exact keptFaceB_pending_cell_winding M₁ M₂ h₁ h₂ hG j hfbClipD hfbpl hfbB hpPend rfl hkeepf hPp

name: copDescB_indicator_eq_w2
statement:
theorem copDescB_indicator_eq_w2 (M₁ M₂ : Mesh)
    (h₁ : Legacy.WellFormedMesh M₁) (h₂ : Legacy.WellFormedMesh M₂)
    {Q : Point} (hG : Gen M₁ M₂ Q) (j : Fin M₂.size)
    (hcop : ¬ Proof.MeshIntersectCop.TrFace M₂ M₁ j.1 j.isLt)
    (hpos : 0 < Proof.MeshIntersectStep.faceParam M₂[j] Q)
    (hno1 : ∀ i : Fin M₁.size,
        ¬ Proof.MeshIntersectDelta.FaceJumps M₁[i] Q (Proof.MeshIntersectStep.faceParam M₂[j] Q)) :
    ((copDescB M₁ M₂ j.1).toList.map
        (fun f => if Proof.MeshIntersectStep.faceHit M₂[j] Q
            ∈ Proof.MeshIntersectClip.vpoly (fragCycle f) then (1 : ℤ) else 0)).sum
      = (if Proof.MeshIntersectStep.faceHit M₂[j] Q ∈ triangleSet M₂[j] then 1 else 0)
        * winding (meshChain M₁) (Proof.MeshIntersectStep.faceHit M₂[j] Q)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  set P := Proof.MeshIntersectStep.faceHit M₂[j] Q with hP
  have hnpo₂ : NoPlaneThroughOrigin M₂ := h₂.2.2.2
  have hQ1 : ∀ i : Fin M₁.size, dotQ (carrierNormal M₁[i]) Q ≠ 0 := hG.1
  have hPeqv : P = Proof.MeshIntersectStep.faceParam M₂[j] Q • Q := by rw [hP]; rfl
  by_cases hPS : P ∈ triangleSet M₂[j]
  · rw [if_pos hPS, one_mul]
    have hwind01 : winding (meshChain M₁) P = 0 ∨ winding (meshChain M₁) P = 1 := by
      rw [hPeqv]
      exact winding_in_01_of_radial_gap M₁ h₁.2.2.2 h₁.2.1 hQ1 (gen_Q_off_NA_planes hG) hpos hno1
    rcases hwind01 with hw0 | hw1
    · rw [hw0]
      refine List.sum_eq_zero ?_
      intro x hx
      rw [List.mem_map] at hx; obtain ⟨f, hf, rfl⟩ := hx
      by_cases hfp : P ∈ Proof.MeshIntersectClip.vpoly (fragCycle f)
      · exfalso
        have := keptFaceB_cop_pierce_winding M₁ M₂ h₁ h₂ hG j (Array.mem_toList.mp hf) hfp
        rw [hw0] at this; exact absurd this (by norm_num)
      · rw [if_neg hfp]
    · rw [hw1]
      have hge1 : (1 : ℤ) ≤ ((copDescB M₁ M₂ j.1).toList.map
          (fun f => if P ∈ Proof.MeshIntersectClip.vpoly (fragCycle f) then (1 : ℤ) else 0)).sum :=
        keptFaceB_cover_ge_one M₁ M₂ h₁ h₂ hG j hcop hpos hno1 hw1 hPS
      have hle1 : ((copDescB M₁ M₂ j.1).toList.map
          (fun f => if P ∈ Proof.MeshIntersectClip.vpoly (fragCycle f) then (1 : ℤ) else 0)).sum ≤ 1 :=
        keptRegion_indicator_le_one (copDescB M₁ M₂ j.1).toList
          (copDescB_pairwise_relDisj M₁ M₂ hnpo₂ j)
          (fun f hf hfp => copDescB_pierce_relint M₁ M₂ h₁ h₂ hG j (Array.mem_toList.mp hf) hfp)
      omega
  · rw [if_neg hPS, zero_mul]
    have hdet : detOrigin M₂[j] ≠ 0 := hnpo₂ j
    have hgetD : (materialize M₂).getD j.1 default = faceSOf (M₂[j.1]'j.isLt) := by
      have hjB : j.1 < (materialize M₂).size := by rw [materialize_size]; exact j.isLt
      rw [Proof.MeshIntersectKeep.arr_getD _ _ _ hjB, materialize_getElem M₂ j.1 j.isLt]
    have hbase : FragInv (carrierNormal M₂[j]) (detOrigin M₂[j])
        (fragOfFace ((materialize M₂).getD j.1 default)) := by
      rw [hgetD]; exact Proof.MeshIntersectKeep.fragInv_base hdet
    have hbaseT : Proof.MeshIntersectClip.vpoly
        (fragCycle (fragOfFace ((materialize M₂).getD j.1 default)))
          ⊆ triangleSet (M₂[j.1]'j.isLt) := by
      rw [hgetD, Proof.MeshIntersectKeep.vpoly_fragOfFace]
    exact indicator_sum_eq_zero_of_hull_off (copDescB M₁ M₂ j.1) P (triangleSet M₂[j])
      (fun f hf => (copDescB_vpoly_subset_base M₁ M₂ j.1 hbase hf).trans hbaseT) hPS

name: keptFaceB_indicator_coplanar
statement:
theorem keptFaceB_indicator_coplanar (M₁ M₂ : Mesh)
    (h₁ : Legacy.WellFormedMesh M₁) (h₂ : Legacy.WellFormedMesh M₂)
    {Q : Point} (hG : Gen M₁ M₂ Q) (j : Fin M₂.size)
    (hcop : ¬ Proof.MeshIntersectCop.TrFace M₂ M₁ j.1 j.isLt)
    (hpos : 0 < Proof.MeshIntersectStep.faceParam M₂[j] Q)
    (hno1 : ∀ i : Fin M₁.size,
        ¬ Proof.MeshIntersectDelta.FaceJumps M₁[i] Q (Proof.MeshIntersectStep.faceParam M₂[j] Q)) :
    ((keptFaceB M₁ M₂ j.1).toList.map
        (fun f => if Proof.MeshIntersectStep.faceHit M₂[j] Q
            ∈ Proof.MeshIntersectClip.vpoly (fragCycle f) then (1 : ℤ) else 0)).sum
      = (if Proof.MeshIntersectStep.faceHit M₂[j] Q ∈ triangleSet M₂[j] then 1 else 0)
        * winding (meshChain M₁) (Proof.MeshIntersectStep.faceHit M₂[j] Q)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  rw [show keptFaceB M₁ M₂ j.1 = keptNcFaceB M₁ M₂ j.1 ++ copDescB M₁ M₂ j.1 from rfl,
    Array.toList_append, List.map_append, List.sum_append,
    keptNcFaceB_toList_eq_nil_of_not_TrFace M₁ M₂ j.isLt hcop]
  simp only [List.map_nil, List.sum_nil, zero_add]
  exact copDescB_indicator_eq_w2 M₁ M₂ h₁ h₂ hG j hcop hpos hno1

name: forall2_filter_pos
statement:
theorem forall2_filter_pos {α} (R : α → α → Prop) (p q : α → Bool) (S : α → Prop)
    (hpq : ∀ a b, R a b → S a → p a = q b) :
    ∀ {l l' : List α}, List.Forall₂ R l l' → (∀ a ∈ l, S a) →
      List.Forall₂ R (l.filter p) (l'.filter q)
  | _, _, List.Forall₂.nil, _ => List.Forall₂.nil
  | _, _, List.Forall₂.cons (a := a) (b := b) hab htl, hS => by
      have hSa : S a
proof:
:= hS a (List.mem_cons_self _ _)
      have htl' := forall2_filter_pos R p q S hpq htl
        (fun x hx => hS x (List.mem_cons_of_mem _ hx))
      simp only [List.filter_cons, ← hpq a b hab hSa]
      cases hp : p a
      · simpa [hp] using htl'
      · simpa [hp] using List.Forall₂.cons hab htl'

statement:
theorem keepFragB_seam (o : P3) {bvh bvh' : Impl.BVH.BVH} (W : Array PFace) (f f' : Frag)

name: classify_seam
statement:
theorem classify_seam (o : P3) (frags frags' : Array Frag) (W : Array PFace)
    (hff : List.Forall₂ (FragSeam o) frags.toList frags'.toList)
    (hpos : ∀ f ∈ frags.toList, 0 < f.poly.size ∧ FragFaithful f) (hW : Faithful W) :

      (classify frags W).toList (classify frags' (W.map (trPFace o))).toList
proof:

    (keepFragB (faceBVH (W.map (trPFace o))) (W.map (trPFace o)))
    (fun f => 0 < f.poly.size ∧ FragFaithful f)
    (fun a b hs hSa => (keepFragB_seam o W a b hs hSa.1 hSa.2 (faceBVH_QSh o W) hW).symm)
    hff hpos

name: clear_identity
statement:
theorem clear_identity (w : ℤ) (x : ℚ) (hdvd : (x.den : ℤ) ∣ w) :
    (w:ℚ) * x = (((w / x.den) * x.num : ℤ) : ℚ)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨k, hk⟩ := hdvd; subst hk
  have hden0 : (x.den : ℤ) ≠ 0 := by exact_mod_cast x.den_nz
  rw [Int.mul_ediv_cancel_left _ hden0]; push_cast
  have key : x * (x.den : ℚ) = (x.num : ℚ) := Rat.mul_den_eq_num x
  linear_combination (k:ℚ) * key

proof:
:= by
  rw [clear_identity w x hdvd, Rat.num_intCast]

name: homogenize_w_pos

proof:

  have hd : ∀ p : P3, dlcm p ≠ 0 := by
    intro p; unfold dlcm
    exact Nat.lcm_ne_zero (Nat.lcm_ne_zero p.x.den_nz p.y.den_nz) p.z.den_nz
  have : 0 < homW a b c := by
    apply Nat.pos_of_ne_zero
    unfold homW
    exact Nat.lcm_ne_zero (Nat.lcm_ne_zero (hd a) (hd b)) (hd c)
  exact_mod_cast this

name: intSign_eq_of_pos_mul
statement:
theorem intSign_eq_of_pos_mul {m₁ m₂ : Int} {κ₁ κ₂ G : ℚ} (h₁ : 0 < κ₁) (h₂ : 0 < κ₂)
    (e₁ : (m₁ : ℚ) = κ₁ * G) (e₂ : (m₂ : ℚ) = κ₂ * G) : Int.sign m₁ = Int.sign m₂
proof:
:= by
  rcases lt_trichotomy G 0 with hG | hG | hG
  · have p1 : (m₁ : ℚ) < 0 := by rw [e₁]; exact mul_neg_of_pos_of_neg h₁ hG
    have p2 : (m₂ : ℚ) < 0 := by rw [e₂]; exact mul_neg_of_pos_of_neg h₂ hG
    rw [Int.sign_eq_neg_one_iff_neg.mpr (by exact_mod_cast p1),
        Int.sign_eq_neg_one_iff_neg.mpr (by exact_mod_cast p2)]
  · have z1 : (m₁ : ℚ) = 0 := by rw [e₁, hG, mul_zero]
    have z2 : (m₂ : ℚ) = 0 := by rw [e₂, hG, mul_zero]
    rw [(by exact_mod_cast z1 : m₁ = 0), (by exact_mod_cast z2 : m₂ = 0)]
  · have p1 : (0 : ℚ) < m₁ := by rw [e₁]; exact mul_pos h₁ hG
    have p2 : (0 : ℚ) < m₂ := by rw [e₂]; exact mul_pos h₂ hG
    rw [Int.sign_eq_one_iff_pos.mpr (by exact_mod_cast p1),
        Int.sign_eq_one_iff_pos.mpr (by exact_mod_cast p2)]

name: dotS_smulS

proof:
:= by
  simp only [dotS, smulS]; ring

name: shiftScale_geom
statement:
theorem shiftScale_geom (o n n' : P3) (c c' μ : Rat) (p : P3)
    (hn' : n' = smulS μ n) (hc' : c' = μ * (c - dotS n o)) :
    dotS n' (psubS p o) - c' = μ * (dotS n p - c)
proof:
:= by
  rw [hn', hc', dotS_smulS, dotS_psubS]; ring

name: evalI_clearPlane_toH4
statement:

    ((evalI (clearPlane n c) (toH4 p) : Int) : ℚ)
    = ((toH4W p : ℚ) * (clearPlaneW n c : ℚ)) * (dotS n p - c)
proof:
:= by
  rw [evalI_decode, gAff_clearPlane]; ring

name: signI_shiftScale
statement:
theorem signI_shiftScale (o n n' : P3) (c c' μ : Rat) (p : P3)
    (hμ : 0 < μ) (hn' : n' = smulS μ n) (hc' : c' = μ * (c - dotS n o)) :
    signI (clearPlane n' c') (toH4 (psubS p o)) = signI (clearPlane n c) (toH4 p)
proof:
:= by
  simp only [signI]
  apply intSign_eq_of_pos_mul
      (κ₁ := (toH4W (psubS p o) : ℚ) * (clearPlaneW n' c' : ℚ) * μ)
      (κ₂ := (toH4W p : ℚ) * (clearPlaneW n c : ℚ)) (G := dotS n p - c)
  · exact mul_pos (mul_pos (by exact_mod_cast toH4W_pos _) (by exact_mod_cast clearPlaneW_pos _ _)) hμ
  · exact mul_pos (by exact_mod_cast toH4W_pos _) (by exact_mod_cast clearPlaneW_pos _ _)
  · rw [evalI_clearPlane_toH4, shiftScale_geom o n n' c c' μ p hn' hc']; ring
  · rw [evalI_clearPlane_toH4]

name: cutVtx_shiftScale
statement:
theorem cutVtx_shiftScale (o n n' : P3) (c c' μ : Rat) (A B : Vtx)
    (hμ : 0 < μ) (hn' : n' = smulS μ n) (hc' : c' = μ * (c - dotS n o))
    (hA : A.h = toH4 A.p) (hB : B.h = toH4 B.p) :
    cutVtx (clearPlane n' c') (trVtx o A) (trVtx o B)
    = trVtx o (cutVtx (clearPlane n c) A B)
proof:
:= by
  have hA' : (trVtx o A).h = toH4 (trVtx o A).p := rfl
  have hB' : (trVtx o B).h = toH4 (trVtx o B).p := rfl
  have hpA : (trVtx o A).p = psubS A.p o := rfl
  have hpB : (trVtx o B).p = psubS B.p o := rfl
  
  have htU := cutVtx_t_val n c A B hA hB
  have htT := cutVtx_t_val n' c' (trVtx o A) (trVtx o B) hA' hB'
  rw [hpA, hpB] at htT
  
  have gA : dotS n' (psubS A.p o) - c' = μ * (dotS n A.p - c) :=
    shiftScale_geom o n n' c c' μ A.p hn' hc'
  have gB : dotS n' (psubS B.p o) - c' = μ * (dotS n B.p - c) :=
    shiftScale_geom o n n' c c' μ B.p hn' hc'
  rw [gA, gB] at htT
  have hden : (μ * (dotS n A.p - c)) - (μ * (dotS n B.p - c))
            = μ * ((dotS n A.p - c) - (dotS n B.p - c)) := by ring
  rw [hden] at htT
  have hμne : μ ≠ 0 := ne_of_gt hμ
  rw [mul_div_mul_left _ _ hμne] at htT
  
  have hteq :
      (((evalI (clearPlane n' c') (trVtx o A).h * (trVtx o B).h.w : Int) : ℚ))
        / (((evalI (clearPlane n' c') (trVtx o A).h * (trVtx o B).h.w
             - evalI (clearPlane n' c') (trVtx o B).h * (trVtx o A).h.w : Int) : ℚ))
      = (((evalI (clearPlane n c) A.h * B.h.w : Int) : ℚ))
        / (((evalI (clearPlane n c) A.h * B.h.w
             - evalI (clearPlane n c) B.h * A.h.w : Int) : ℚ)) := by
    rw [htT, htU]
  simp only [cutVtx, hpA, hpB]
  rw [hteq, trVtx_mkVtx, lerp_psubS]

name: sum_split
statement:
private theorem sum_split {α : Type*} (l : List α)
    (F G : α → Multiset (Point × Point))
    (h : ∀ x ∈ l, ∃ S, F x = G x + S ∧ Bal S) :
    ∃ S, (l.map F).sum = (l.map G).sum + S ∧ Bal S
proof:
:= by
  induction l with
  | nil => exact ⟨0, by simp, bal_zero⟩
  | cons a t ih =>
    obtain ⟨Sa, ha, hba⟩ := h a (List.mem_cons_self a t)
    obtain ⟨St, hts, hbt⟩ := ih fun x hx => h x (List.mem_cons_of_mem _ hx)
    refine ⟨Sa + St, ?_, bal_add hba hbt⟩
    rw [List.map_cons, List.map_cons, List.sum_cons, List.sum_cons, ha, hts]
    abel

name: edgeMultiset_out_gen
statement:
theorem edgeMultiset_out_gen (M₁ M₂ : Mesh)
    (h₁ : NoPlaneThroughOrigin M₁) (h₂ : NoPlaneThroughOrigin M₂)
    (hg₁ : Proof.MeshIntersectNpo.GenWF M₁) (hg₂ : Proof.MeshIntersectNpo.GenWF M₂) :
    ∃ S, edgeMultiset (meshIntersect M₁ M₂) = outBoundaryGen M₁ M₂ + S
      ∧ Bal S
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have hsplit := sum_split (keptGen M₁ M₂).toList
      (fun f => edgeMultiset (emitFrag (atomizeFrag (vsGen M₁ M₂) f)))
      (fun f => fragBoundary (atomizeFrag (vsGen M₁ M₂) f)) ?_
  · obtain ⟨S, hS, hbS⟩ := hsplit
    refine ⟨S, ?_, hbS⟩
    rw [meshIntersect_eq M₁ M₂ hg₁ hg₂, edgeMultiset_flatMap, Array.toList_map, List.map_map]
    exact hS
  · intro f hf
    have hf' : f ∈ keptGen M₁ M₂ := Array.mem_def.mpr hf
    obtain ⟨_M, _i, _hi, -, _hdet, hinv₀⟩ := kept_fragInv h₁ h₂ hf'
    haveI hz : NeZero f.poly.size := hinv₀.neZero
    haveI hzm : NeZero (atomizeFrag (vsGen M₁ M₂) f).poly.size :=
      ⟨by have := keptGen_atomize_size3 h₁ h₂ hf'; omega⟩
    obtain ⟨M, i, hi, hdet, hinv, hm, hshape⟩ := keptGen_refShape h₁ h₂ hf'
    exact emit_edgeMultiset hm
      (fun k => hshape.toRefShape.apex_ne hinv.size3 hm hinv.onPlane
        hinv.strictConv k)
      (fun k => hshape.toRefShape.consec_ne hinv.size3 hinv.strictConv k)

name: outBoundaryGen_saturated
statement:
theorem outBoundaryGen_saturated (M₁ M₂ : Mesh)
    (h₁ : NoPlaneThroughOrigin M₁) (h₂ : NoPlaneThroughOrigin M₂) :
    Saturated (outBoundaryGen M₁ M₂)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have hedge : ∀ e ∈ outBoundaryGen M₁ M₂, ∃ f ∈ keptGen M₁ M₂,
      3 ≤ (atomizeFrag (vsGen M₁ M₂) f).poly.size
      ∧ e ∈ fragBoundary (atomizeFrag (vsGen M₁ M₂) f) := by
    intro e he
    obtain ⟨X, hX, heX⟩ := mem_listSum he
    rw [List.mem_map] at hX
    obtain ⟨f, hf, rfl⟩ := hX
    have hf' : f ∈ keptGen M₁ M₂ := Array.mem_def.mpr hf
    exact ⟨f, hf', keptGen_atomize_size3 h₁ h₂ hf', heX⟩
  have hcore : ∀ e ∈ outBoundaryGen M₁ M₂,
      (∃ u ∈ (vsGen M₁ M₂).toList, P3.toPoint u.p = e.1)
        ∧ ∃ u ∈ (vsGen M₁ M₂).toList, P3.toPoint u.p = e.2 := by
    intro e he
    obtain ⟨f, hf', hm, heX⟩ := hedge e he
    haveI hzm : NeZero (atomizeFrag (vsGen M₁ M₂) f).poly.size :=
      ⟨fun hc => by rw [hc] at hm; exact absurd hm (by norm_num)⟩
    exact fragBoundary_endpoints hm
      (atomize_vertex_mem (vsGen M₁ M₂) f (fun x hx =>
        vertexUniverse_complete (keptGen M₁ M₂) hf' (Array.mem_def.mpr hx)))
      heX
  have hvert : ∀ v ∈ Proof.MeshIntersectCycle.verts (outBoundaryGen M₁ M₂),
      ∃ u ∈ (vsGen M₁ M₂).toList, P3.toPoint u.p = v := by
    intro v hv
    rw [Proof.MeshIntersectCycle.verts, Multiset.mem_add] at hv
    rcases hv with h | h
    · rw [Multiset.mem_map] at h
      obtain ⟨e, he, rfl⟩ := h
      exact (hcore e he).1
    · rw [Multiset.mem_map] at h
      obtain ⟨e, he, rfl⟩ := h
      exact (hcore e he).2
  intro e he v hv
  obtain ⟨f, hf', hm, heX⟩ := hedge e he
  haveI hzm : NeZero (atomizeFrag (vsGen M₁ M₂) f).poly.size :=
    ⟨fun hc => by rw [hc] at hm; exact absurd hm (by norm_num)⟩
  obtain ⟨k, rfl⟩ := mem_fragBoundary hm heX
  exact atomize_saturated_gen h₁ h₂ hf' (hvert v hv) k

name: outBoundaryGen_nondeg
statement:
theorem outBoundaryGen_nondeg (M₁ M₂ : Mesh)
    (h₁ : NoPlaneThroughOrigin M₁) (h₂ : NoPlaneThroughOrigin M₂) :

proof:
:= by

  obtain ⟨X, hX, heX⟩ := mem_listSum he

  obtain ⟨f, hf, rfl⟩ := hX
  have hf' : f ∈ keptGen M₁ M₂ := Array.mem_def.mpr hf
  obtain ⟨_M, _i, _hi, -, _hdet, hinv₀⟩ := kept_fragInv h₁ h₂ hf'
  haveI hzr : NeZero f.poly.size := hinv₀.neZero
  haveI hzm : NeZero (atomizeFrag (vsGen M₁ M₂) f).poly.size :=
    ⟨by have := keptGen_atomize_size3 h₁ h₂ hf'; omega⟩
  obtain ⟨M, i, hi, hdet, hinv, hm, hshape⟩ := keptGen_refShape h₁ h₂ hf'
  obtain ⟨k, rfl⟩ := mem_fragBoundary hm heX

name: mu_outBoundaryGen_eq
statement:
theorem mu_outBoundaryGen_eq (M₁ M₂ : Mesh)
    (h₁ : NoPlaneThroughOrigin M₁) (h₂ : NoPlaneThroughOrigin M₂)
    (hg₁ : Proof.MeshIntersectNpo.GenWF M₁) (hg₂ : Proof.MeshIntersectNpo.GenWF M₂)
    (x y : Point) :
    mu (edgeMultiset (meshIntersect M₁ M₂)) x y = mu (outBoundaryGen M₁ M₂) x y
proof:

  rw [heq]
