name: crossQ_add_right
statement:
theorem crossQ_add_right (a u v : Point) :
    crossQ a (u + v) = crossQ a u + crossQ a v
proof:
:= by
  funext i; fin_cases i <;>
    simp [crossQ, mkPoint, Pi.add_apply] <;> ring

name: crossQ_add_left
statement:
theorem crossQ_add_left (a u v : Point) :
    crossQ (u + v) a = crossQ u a + crossQ v a
proof:
:= by
  funext i; fin_cases i <;>
    simp [crossQ, mkPoint, Pi.add_apply] <;> ring

name: crossQ_smul_r
statement:
theorem crossQ_smul_r (t : ℚ) (a b : Point) :
    crossQ a (t • b) = t • crossQ a b
proof:
:= by
  funext i; fin_cases i <;>
    simp [crossQ, mkPoint, Pi.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul] <;> ring

name: crossQ_smul_l
statement:
theorem crossQ_smul_l (t : ℚ) (a b : Point) :
    crossQ (t • a) b = t • crossQ a b
proof:
:= by
  funext i; fin_cases i <;>
    simp [crossQ, mkPoint, Pi.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul] <;> ring

name: crossQ_self'
statement: theorem crossQ_self' (a : Point) : crossQ a a = 0
proof:
:= by
  funext i; fin_cases i <;> simp [crossQ, mkPoint] <;> ring

name: smul_pair_inj
statement:
theorem smul_pair_inj {a b : Point} (hab : crossQ a b ≠ 0) {p q p' q' : ℚ}
    (h : p • a + q • b = p' • a + q' • b) : p = p' ∧ q = q'
proof:
:= by
  have hq : q • crossQ a b = q' • crossQ a b := by
    have h2 := congrArg (crossQ a) h
    simp only [crossQ_add_right, crossQ_smul_r, crossQ_self', smul_zero,
      zero_add] at h2
    exact h2
  have hp : p • crossQ a b = p' • crossQ a b := by
    have h2 := congrArg (fun u => crossQ u b) h
    simp only [crossQ_add_left, crossQ_smul_l, crossQ_self', smul_zero,
      add_zero] at h2
    exact h2
  refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
  · have := sub_eq_zero.mpr hp
    rw [← sub_smul, smul_eq_zero] at this
    exact sub_eq_zero.mp (this.resolve_right hab)
  · have := sub_eq_zero.mpr hq
    rw [← sub_smul, smul_eq_zero] at this
    exact sub_eq_zero.mp (this.resolve_right hab)

name: coplanar_decomp
statement:
theorem coplanar_decomp {a b w₀ : Point} (hab : crossQ a b ≠ 0)
    (hperp : dotQ (crossQ a b) w₀ = 0) : ∃ c_a c_b : ℚ, w₀ = c_a • a + c_b • b
proof:
:= by
  have hdn : 0 < dotQ (crossQ a b) (crossQ a b) :=
    Proof.MeshIntersectRay.dotQ_self_pos hab
  have hne : dotQ (crossQ a b) (crossQ a b) ≠ 0 := ne_of_gt hdn
  refine ⟨dotQ (crossQ a b) (crossQ w₀ b) / dotQ (crossQ a b) (crossQ a b),
    (- dotQ (crossQ a b) (crossQ w₀ a)) / dotQ (crossQ a b) (crossQ a b), ?_⟩
  
  have hfull : dotQ (crossQ a b) (crossQ a b) • w₀
      = dotQ (crossQ a b) (crossQ w₀ b) • a - dotQ (crossQ a b) (crossQ w₀ a) • b
        + (dotQ (crossQ a b) w₀) • (crossQ a b) := by
    funext i
    fin_cases i <;>
      · simp [crossQ, dotQ, mkPoint, Pi.sub_apply, Pi.add_apply, Pi.smul_apply,
          smul_eq_mul]
        ring
  rw [hperp, zero_smul, add_zero] at hfull
  
  set D := dotQ (crossQ a b) (crossQ a b) with hD
  set X := dotQ (crossQ a b) (crossQ w₀ b) with hX
  set Y := dotQ (crossQ a b) (crossQ w₀ a) with hY
  have hcX : D * (X / D) = X := by
    rw [mul_comm, div_mul_cancel₀ X hne]
  have hcY : D * ((-Y) / D) = -Y := by
    rw [mul_comm, div_mul_cancel₀ (-Y) hne]
  refine smul_right_injective Point hne ?_
  show D • w₀ = D • ((X / D) • a + ((-Y) / D) • b)
  rw [smul_add, smul_smul, smul_smul, hcX, hcY, hfull, neg_smul]
  abel

name: mem_openSegment_iff_coords
statement:
theorem mem_openSegment_iff_coords {a b w₀ : Point} (hab : crossQ a b ≠ 0)
    {c_a c_b : ℚ} (hdec : w₀ = c_a • a + c_b • b) :
    w₀ ∈ openSegment ℚ a b ↔ (0 < c_a ∧ 0 < c_b ∧ c_a + c_b = 1)
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨p, q, hp, hq, hpq, heq⟩
    rw [hdec] at heq
    
    obtain ⟨ea, eb⟩ := smul_pair_inj hab heq
    exact ⟨ea ▸ hp, eb ▸ hq, ea ▸ eb ▸ hpq⟩
  · rintro ⟨hca, hcb, hsum⟩
    exact ⟨c_a, c_b, hca, hcb, hsum, hdec.symm⟩

name: cone_smul_threshold
statement:
theorem cone_smul_threshold {a b w₀ : Point} (hab : crossQ a b ≠ 0) (_hw₀ : w₀ ≠ 0) :
    ∃ σ : ℚ, 0 ≤ σ ∧ (∀ s : ℚ, 0 < s → (s • w₀ ∈ openCone2 a b ↔ s < σ))
      ∧ (σ = 1 ↔ w₀ ∈ openSegment ℚ a b)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  set n := crossQ a b with hn
  by_cases hperp : dotQ n w₀ = 0
  · 
    obtain ⟨c_a, c_b, hdec⟩ := coplanar_decomp hab hperp
    have hseg := mem_openSegment_iff_coords (w₀ := w₀) hab hdec
    by_cases hpos : 0 < c_a ∧ 0 < c_b
    · 
      obtain ⟨hca, hcb⟩ := hpos
      have hsum : 0 < c_a + c_b := by linarith
      refine ⟨1 / (c_a + c_b), by positivity, fun s hs => ?_, ?_⟩
      · constructor
        · rintro ⟨μ₀, μa, μb, hμ₀, hμa, hμb, hsm, heq⟩
          rw [hdec, smul_add, smul_smul, smul_smul] at heq
          obtain ⟨ea, eb⟩ := smul_pair_inj hab heq
          rw [lt_div_iff₀ hsum]
          nlinarith [ea, eb, hμ₀, hsm]
        · intro hlt
          rw [lt_div_iff₀ hsum] at hlt
          refine ⟨1 - s * c_a - s * c_b, s * c_a, s * c_b, by nlinarith [hlt],
            mul_pos hs hca, mul_pos hs hcb, by ring, ?_⟩
          rw [hdec, smul_add, smul_smul, smul_smul]
      · rw [hseg]
        constructor
        · intro h1
          have : c_a + c_b = 1 := by
            field_simp at h1; linarith [h1]
          exact ⟨hca, hcb, this⟩
        · rintro ⟨_, _, h1⟩; rw [h1]; norm_num
    · 
      refine ⟨0, le_refl 0, fun s hs => ?_, ?_⟩
      · constructor
        · rintro ⟨μ₀, μa, μb, hμ₀, hμa, hμb, hsm, heq⟩
          rw [hdec, smul_add, smul_smul, smul_smul] at heq
          obtain ⟨ea, eb⟩ := smul_pair_inj hab heq
          exfalso; apply hpos
          refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
          · have h2 : 0 < s * c_a := ea ▸ hμa; nlinarith [h2, hs]
          · have h2 : 0 < s * c_b := eb ▸ hμb; nlinarith [h2, hs]
        · intro hlt; exact absurd hlt (by linarith)
      · rw [hseg]
        constructor
        · intro h; exact absurd h (by norm_num)
        · rintro ⟨hca, hcb, _⟩; exact absurd ⟨hca, hcb⟩ hpos
  · 
    have hnseg : w₀ ∉ openSegment ℚ a b := by
      rintro ⟨p, q, hp, hq, hpq, heq⟩
      apply hperp
      rw [hn, ← heq, Proof.MeshIntersectRay.dotQ_add_right,
        Proof.MeshIntersectRay.dotQ_smul_right, Proof.MeshIntersectRay.dotQ_smul_right,
        dotQ_crossQ_left, dotQ_crossQ_right, mul_zero, mul_zero, add_zero]
    refine ⟨0, le_refl 0, fun s hs => ?_, ?_⟩
    · constructor
      · rintro ⟨μ₀, μa, μb, hμ₀, hμa, hμb, hsm, heq⟩
        exfalso
        have : dotQ n (s • w₀) = 0 := by
          rw [heq, Proof.MeshIntersectRay.dotQ_add_right,
            Proof.MeshIntersectRay.dotQ_smul_right,
            Proof.MeshIntersectRay.dotQ_smul_right, hn, dotQ_crossQ_left, dotQ_crossQ_right,
            mul_zero, mul_zero, add_zero]
        rw [Proof.MeshIntersectRay.dotQ_smul_right] at this
        exact hperp ((mul_eq_zero.mp this).resolve_left (ne_of_gt hs))
      · intro hlt; exact absurd hlt (by linarith)
    · constructor
      · intro h; exact absurd h (by norm_num)
      · intro h; exact absurd h hnseg

name: mem_openSegment_iff_segment_of_notVert
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · exact fun h => openSegment_subset_segment ℚ e.1 e.2 h
  · intro hseg
    have h1 : e.1 ≠ w := fun h => hw (h ▸ fst_mem_verts he)
    have h2 : e.2 ≠ w := fun h => hw (h ▸ snd_mem_verts he)
    exact mem_openSegment_of_ne_left_right h1 h2 hseg

name: cone_event_jump
statement:
theorem cone_event_jump {M : Mesh} {x y : Point}
    (hnpo : NoPlaneThroughOrigin M)
    (hG1 : ∀ (i : Fin M.size), ∀ g ∈ tetraHalves M[i],
      g.eval x ≠ 0 ∧ g.eval y ≠ 0)
    (hG2 : ∀ (i : Fin M.size), ∀ g ∈ tetraHalves M[i],
      ∀ g' ∈ tetraHalves M[i], g ≠ g' → ∀ τ : ℚ, 0 < τ → τ < 1 →
        ¬ (g.eval (seg x y τ) = 0 ∧ g'.eval (seg x y τ) = 0))
    {τ δ : ℚ} (hτ0 : 0 < τ) (hτ1 : τ < 1) (hδ : 0 < δ)
    (hnoface : ∀ i : Fin M.size, seg x y τ ∉ triangleSet M[i])
    (hstabw : ∀ (i : Fin M.size), ∀ g ∈ tetraHalves M[i],
      g.eval (seg x y τ) ≠ 0 →
      ((0 < g.eval (seg x y (τ + δ)) ↔ 0 < g.eval (seg x y τ)) ∧
       (0 < g.eval (seg x y (τ - δ)) ↔ 0 < g.eval (seg x y τ)) ∧
       g.eval (seg x y (τ + δ)) ≠ 0 ∧ g.eval (seg x y (τ - δ)) ≠ 0)) :
    winding (meshChain M) (seg x y (τ + δ))
      - winding (meshChain M) (seg x y (τ - δ))
      = ((edgeMultiset M).map (jump (seg x y τ) (psub y x))).sum
proof:
:= by
  classical
  set v := psub y x with hv
  set z := seg x y τ with hzdef
  set pP := seg x y (τ + δ) with hpP
  set pM := seg x y (τ - δ) with hpM
  
  have hact : ∀ (i : Fin M.size), ∀ g ∈ tetraHalves M[i], g.eval z = 0 →
      (dotQ g.n v ≠ 0 ∧ (0 < g.eval pP ↔ 0 < dotQ g.n v)
        ∧ (0 < g.eval pM ↔ dotQ g.n v < 0) ∧ g.eval pP ≠ 0 ∧ g.eval pM ≠ 0) := by
    intro i g hg hgz
    have hlz : g.eval x + τ * dotQ g.n v = 0 := by rw [← eval_seg]; exact hgz
    have hD : dotQ g.n v ≠ 0 := by
      intro hD0; rw [hD0, mul_zero, add_zero] at hlz; exact (hG1 i g hg).1 hlz
    have hPv : g.eval pP = δ * dotQ g.n v := by
      rw [hpP, eval_seg, ← hv]; linear_combination hlz
    have hMv : g.eval pM = - δ * dotQ g.n v := by
      rw [hpM, eval_seg, ← hv]; linear_combination hlz
    refine ⟨hD, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
    · rw [hPv]
      constructor
      · intro h; by_contra hc; push_neg at hc; nlinarith
      · intro h; exact mul_pos hδ h
    · rw [hMv]
      constructor
      · intro h; by_contra hc; push_neg at hc; nlinarith
      · intro h; nlinarith
    · rw [hPv]; exact mul_ne_zero (ne_of_gt hδ) hD
    · rw [hMv]; exact mul_ne_zero (by linarith) hD
  
  have hidx : ∀ i : Fin M.size,
      orientSign M[i] * ((if pP ∈ simplex M[i] then (1:ℤ) else 0)
          - (if pM ∈ simplex M[i] then (1:ℤ) else 0))
        = ((faceEdges M[i]).map (jump z v)).sum := by
    intro i
    have hsingle : ∀ g ∈ tetraHalves M[i], ∀ g' ∈ tetraHalves M[i],
        g.eval z = 0 → g'.eval z = 0 → g = g' := by
      intro g hg g' hg' hgz hgz'
      by_contra hne
      exact hG2 i g hg g' hg' hne τ hτ0 hτ1 ⟨hgz, hgz'⟩
    exact face_jump (hnpo i) (hnoface i) hsingle
      (fun g hg => hstabw i g hg) (fun g hg => hact i g hg)
  
  have hflat : ∑ i : Fin M.size, ((faceEdges M[i]).map (jump z v)).sum
      = ((edgeMultiset M).map (jump z v)).sum := by
    rw [← sum_map_toList M (fun t => ((faceEdges t).map (jump z v)).sum),
      list_sum_flat, edgeMultiset, Multiset.map_coe, Multiset.sum_coe]
  rw [winding_meshChain_eq, winding_meshChain_eq, list_sum_map_sub, sum_map_toList]
  have hsum : ∑ i : Fin M.size,
      (orientSign M[i] * (if pP ∈ simplex M[i] then (1:ℤ) else 0)
        - orientSign M[i] * (if pM ∈ simplex M[i] then (1:ℤ) else 0))
      = ∑ i : Fin M.size, ((faceEdges M[i]).map (jump z v)).sum := by
    refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun i _ => ?_
    rw [← mul_sub]; exact hidx i
  rw [hsum, hflat]

name: cone_jump
statement:
theorem cone_jump {M : Mesh} {x y : Point}
    (hnpo : NoPlaneThroughOrigin M)
    {τs : ℚ} (hτ0 : 0 < τs) (hτ1 : τs < 1)
    (hnoface : ∀ (i : Fin M.size) (τ : ℚ), 0 < τ → τ < 1 →
      seg x y τ ∉ triangleSet M[i])
    (hsingle : ∀ (i : Fin M.size), ∀ g ∈ tetraHalves M[i], ∀ τ : ℚ, 0 < τ → τ < 1 →
      g.eval (seg x y τ) = 0 → τ = τs)
    (hG1 : ∀ (i : Fin M.size), ∀ g ∈ tetraHalves M[i],
      g.eval x ≠ 0 ∧ g.eval y ≠ 0)
    (hG2 : ∀ (i : Fin M.size), ∀ g ∈ tetraHalves M[i],
      ∀ g' ∈ tetraHalves M[i], g ≠ g' → ∀ τ : ℚ, 0 < τ → τ < 1 →
        ¬ (g.eval (seg x y τ) = 0 ∧ g'.eval (seg x y τ) = 0)) :
    winding (meshChain M) y - winding (meshChain M) x
      = ((edgeMultiset M).map (jump (seg x y τs) (psub y x))).sum
proof:
:= by
  classical
  obtain ⟨δ₀, hδ₀, hwin⟩ := window_list (meshHalves M) x y τs
  set δ := min (min (τs / 2) ((1 - τs) / 2)) δ₀ with hδdef
  have hδpos : 0 < δ := lt_min (lt_min (by linarith) (by linarith)) hδ₀
  have hδτ : δ ≤ τs / 2 := le_trans (min_le_left _ _) (min_le_left _ _)
  have hδ1 : δ ≤ (1 - τs) / 2 := le_trans (min_le_left _ _) (min_le_right _ _)
  have hδδ0 : δ ≤ δ₀ := min_le_right _ _
  have hstabw : ∀ (i : Fin M.size), ∀ g ∈ tetraHalves M[i],
      g.eval (seg x y τs) ≠ 0 →
      ((0 < g.eval (seg x y (τs + δ)) ↔ 0 < g.eval (seg x y τs)) ∧
       (0 < g.eval (seg x y (τs - δ)) ↔ 0 < g.eval (seg x y τs)) ∧
       g.eval (seg x y (τs + δ)) ≠ 0 ∧ g.eval (seg x y (τs - δ)) ≠ 0) := by
    intro i g hg hne
    exact hwin g (mem_meshHalves.mpr ⟨i, hg⟩) hne δ hδpos hδδ0
  have hleft : winding (meshChain M) (seg x y 0)
      = winding (meshChain M) (seg x y (τs - δ)) := by
    apply const_piece hnpo (by linarith : (0 : ℚ) ≤ τs - δ)
    intro i g hg τ' hτ'0 hτ'le
    rcases eq_or_lt_of_le hτ'0 with rfl | hτ'pos
    · rw [seg_zero]; exact (hG1 i g hg).1
    · intro hzero
      have heq := hsingle i g hg τ' hτ'pos (by linarith) hzero
      linarith
  have hright : winding (meshChain M) (seg x y (τs + δ))
      = winding (meshChain M) (seg x y 1) := by
    apply const_piece hnpo (by linarith : τs + δ ≤ 1)
    intro i g hg τ' hτ'ge hτ'1
    rcases eq_or_lt_of_le hτ'1 with rfl | hτ'lt
    · rw [seg_one]; exact (hG1 i g hg).2
    · intro hzero
      have heq := hsingle i g hg τ' (by linarith) hτ'lt hzero
      linarith
  have hev := cone_event_jump hnpo hG1 hG2 hτ0 hτ1 hδpos
    (fun i => hnoface i τs hτ0 hτ1) hstabw
  rw [seg_zero] at hleft
  rw [seg_one] at hright
  rw [hleft, ← hright]
  exact hev

name: multiset_sum_map_sub
statement:
theorem multiset_sum_map_sub {α : Type*} (D : Multiset α) (f g : α → ℤ) :
    (D.map f).sum - (D.map g).sum = (D.map (fun e => f e - g e)).sum
proof:
:= by
  induction D using Multiset.induction_on with
  | empty => simp
  | cons a D ih =>
    rw [Multiset.map_cons, Multiset.sum_cons, Multiset.map_cons, Multiset.sum_cons,
      Multiset.map_cons, Multiset.sum_cons, ← ih]
    ring

name: sum_map_ite_zero
statement:
theorem sum_map_ite_zero {α : Type*} (D : Multiset α) (P : α → Prop) [DecidablePred P]
    (f : α → ℤ) :
    (D.map (fun e => if P e then f e else 0)).sum
      = ((D.filter P).map f).sum
proof:
:= by
  induction D using Multiset.induction_on with
  | empty => simp
  | cons a D ih =>
    rw [Multiset.map_cons, Multiset.sum_cons, ih]
    by_cases h : P a
    · rw [Multiset.filter_cons_of_pos _ h, Multiset.map_cons, Multiset.sum_cons, if_pos h]
    · rw [Multiset.filter_cons_of_neg _ h, if_neg h, zero_add]

name: edge_flip
statement:
theorem edge_flip {a b w₀ : Point} (hab : crossQ a b ≠ 0) (hw₀ : w₀ ≠ 0) (v : Point) :
    ∃ ρ : ℚ, 0 < ρ ∧ ∀ η : ℚ, 0 < η → η ≤ ρ →
      jump ((1 - η) • w₀) v (a, b) - jump ((1 + η) • w₀) v (a, b)
        = if w₀ ∈ openSegment ℚ a b then qsign (dotQ (crossQ a b) v) else 0
proof:
:= by
  classical
  obtain ⟨σ, hσ0, hσ, hσ1⟩ := cone_smul_threshold hab hw₀
  by_cases heq1 : σ = 1
  · 
    have hmem : w₀ ∈ openSegment ℚ a b := hσ1.mp heq1
    refine ⟨1 / 2, by norm_num, fun η hη hηρ => ?_⟩
    have h1 : (0 : ℚ) < 1 - η := by linarith
    have h2 : (0 : ℚ) < 1 + η := by linarith
    have hin : ((1 - η) • w₀ ∈ openCone2 a b) := by
      rw [hσ (1 - η) h1, heq1]; linarith
    have hout : ¬ ((1 + η) • w₀ ∈ openCone2 a b) := by
      rw [hσ (1 + η) h2, heq1]; linarith
    simp only [jump, if_pos hin, if_neg hout, if_pos hmem, sub_zero]
  · 
    have hnmem : w₀ ∉ openSegment ℚ a b := fun h => heq1 (hσ1.mpr h)
    rcases lt_or_gt_of_ne heq1 with hlt | hgt
    · 
      refine ⟨min ((1 - σ) / 2) (1 / 2), by
        have : 0 < 1 - σ := by linarith
        positivity, fun η hη hηρ => ?_⟩
      have hη1 : η ≤ (1 - σ) / 2 := le_trans hηρ (min_le_left _ _)
      have hη2 : η ≤ 1 / 2 := le_trans hηρ (min_le_right _ _)
      have h1 : (0 : ℚ) < 1 - η := by linarith
      have h2 : (0 : ℚ) < 1 + η := by linarith
      have hin : ¬ ((1 - η) • w₀ ∈ openCone2 a b) := by
        rw [hσ (1 - η) h1]; linarith
      have hout : ¬ ((1 + η) • w₀ ∈ openCone2 a b) := by
        rw [hσ (1 + η) h2]; linarith
      simp only [jump, if_neg hin, if_neg hout, if_neg hnmem, sub_zero]
    · 
      refine ⟨min ((σ - 1) / 2) (1 / 2), by
        have : 0 < σ - 1 := by linarith
        positivity, fun η hη hηρ => ?_⟩
      have hη1 : η ≤ (σ - 1) / 2 := le_trans hηρ (min_le_left _ _)
      have hη2 : η ≤ 1 / 2 := le_trans hηρ (min_le_right _ _)
      have h1 : (0 : ℚ) < 1 - η := by linarith
      have h2 : (0 : ℚ) < 1 + η := by linarith
      have hin : ((1 - η) • w₀ ∈ openCone2 a b) := by
        rw [hσ (1 - η) h1]; linarith
      have hout : ((1 + η) • w₀ ∈ openCone2 a b) := by
        rw [hσ (1 + η) h2]; linarith
      simp only [jump, if_pos hin, if_pos hout, if_neg hnmem, sub_self]

name: sum_flip_eventually
statement:
theorem sum_flip_eventually (D : Multiset (Point × Point)) {w₀ : Point}
    (hw₀ : w₀ ≠ 0) (v : Point) (hcr : ∀ e ∈ D, crossQ e.1 e.2 ≠ 0) :
    ∃ η₀ : ℚ, 0 < η₀ ∧ ∀ η : ℚ, 0 < η → η ≤ η₀ →
      (D.map (fun e => jump ((1 - η) • w₀) v e - jump ((1 + η) • w₀) v e)).sum
        = (D.map (fun e => if w₀ ∈ openSegment ℚ e.1 e.2
            then qsign (dotQ (crossQ e.1 e.2) v) else 0)).sum
proof:
:= by
  classical
  induction D using Multiset.induction_on with
  | empty => exact ⟨1, one_pos, fun η _ _ => by simp⟩
  | cons e D ih =>
    obtain ⟨ρ, hρ, hflip⟩ := edge_flip (a := e.1) (b := e.2) (hcr e (Multiset.mem_cons_self e D)) hw₀ v
    obtain ⟨η₀', hη₀', hsum⟩ := ih (fun e' he' => hcr e' (Multiset.mem_cons_of_mem he'))
    refine ⟨min ρ η₀', lt_min hρ hη₀', fun η hη hηle => ?_⟩
    have hηρ : η ≤ ρ := le_trans hηle (min_le_left _ _)
    have hηη₀ : η ≤ η₀' := le_trans hηle (min_le_right _ _)
    rw [Multiset.map_cons, Multiset.sum_cons, Multiset.map_cons, Multiset.sum_cons,
      hsum η hη hηη₀]
    have := hflip η hη hηρ
    rw [show (e.1, e.2) = e from Prod.ext rfl rfl] at this
    rw [this]

name: edge_mu
proof:
:= by
  classical
  obtain ⟨η₀, hη₀, hsum⟩ := sum_flip_eventually D hw₀ v hcr
  refine ⟨η₀, hη₀, fun η hη hηle => ?_⟩
  
  rw [multiset_sum_map_sub, hsum η hη hηle]
  
  have hindeq : (D.map (fun e => if w₀ ∈ openSegment ℚ e.1 e.2
        then qsign (dotQ (crossQ e.1 e.2) v) else 0)).sum
      = (D.map (fun e => if w₀ ∈ segment ℚ e.1 e.2
        then qsign (dotQ (crossQ e.1 e.2) v) else 0)).sum := by
    refine congrArg Multiset.sum (Multiset.map_congr rfl fun e he => ?_)
    rw [mem_openSegment_iff_segment_of_notVert hnd hgen.2.1 he]
  rw [hindeq]
  
  have hfilter : (D.map (fun e => if w₀ ∈ segment ℚ e.1 e.2
        then qsign (dotQ (crossQ e.1 e.2) v) else 0)).sum
      = ((D.filter (fun e => w₀ ∈ segment ℚ e.1 e.2)).map
          (fun e => qsign (dotQ (crossQ e.1 e.2) v))).sum :=
    sum_map_ite_zero D _ _
  rw [hfilter, cover_eq_carrier hsat hnd hcar hgen, Multiset.map_add,
    Multiset.sum_add, Multiset.map_replicate, Multiset.map_replicate,
    Multiset.sum_replicate, Multiset.sum_replicate]
  
  have hyx : qsign (dotQ (crossQ y x) v) = - qsign (dotQ (crossQ x y) v) := by
    rw [dotQ_crossQ_swap y x v, qsign_neg]
  simp only [hyx, mu]
  push_cast [nsmul_eq_mul]
  ring

name: cone_sum_bal_zero
statement:
theorem cone_sum_bal_zero {S : Multiset (Point × Point)} (hS : Bal S)

name: qsign_pos_mul'
statement:
theorem qsign_pos_mul' {c : ℚ} (hc : 0 < c) (q : ℚ) :
    qsign (c * q) = qsign q
proof:
:= by
  rcases lt_trichotomy q 0 with h | rfl | h
  · rw [qsign_of_neg h, qsign_of_neg (mul_neg_of_pos_of_neg hc h)]
  · rw [mul_zero]
  · rw [qsign_of_pos h, qsign_of_pos (mul_pos hc h)]

name: jump_smul_pos
statement:
theorem jump_smul_pos {c : ℚ} (hc : 0 < c) (z v : Point) (e : Point × Point) :
    jump z (c • v) e = jump z v e
proof:
:= by
  unfold jump
  by_cases h : z ∈ openCone2 e.1 e.2
  · rw [if_pos h, if_pos h, Proof.MeshIntersectRay.dotQ_smul_right,
      qsign_pos_mul' hc]
  · rw [if_neg h, if_neg h]

name: emitFrag_eq
statement:
theorem emitFrag_eq (f : Frag) :
    emitFrag f =
      (if f.poly.size == 3 then
        (if beqS (f.poly.getD 0 default).p (f.poly.getD 1 default).p
            || beqS (f.poly.getD 1 default).p (f.poly.getD 2 default).p
            || beqS (f.poly.getD 2 default).p (f.poly.getD 0 default).p then #[]
         else #[⟨(f.poly.getD 0 default).p.toPoint, (f.poly.getD 1 default).p.toPoint,
                 (f.poly.getD 2 default).p.toPoint⟩])
      else
        (Array.range f.poly.size).foldl
          (estep f.poly (smulS (1 / (f.poly.size : Rat))
            (f.poly.foldl (fun acc v => paddS acc v.p) ⟨0, 0, 0⟩)) f.poly.size) #[])
proof: := rfl

name: emit_apex_tr
statement:
theorem emit_apex_tr (o : P3) (f : Frag) (hpos : 0 < f.poly.size) :
    smulS (1 / (f.poly.size : Rat))
        (Array.foldl (fun acc v => paddS acc v.p) (⟨0, 0, 0⟩ : P3) (f.poly.map (trVtx o)) 0
          f.poly.size)
    = psubS (smulS (1 / (f.poly.size : Rat))
        (f.poly.foldl (fun acc v => paddS acc v.p) ⟨0, 0, 0⟩)) o
proof:
:= by
  have key : Array.foldl (fun acc v => paddS acc v.p) (⟨0, 0, 0⟩ : P3) (f.poly.map (trVtx o)) 0
        f.poly.size = (f.poly.map (trVtx o)).foldl (fun acc v => paddS acc v.p) ⟨0, 0, 0⟩ := by
    congr 1; exact (Array.size_map _ _).symm
  rw [key]
  have h := fragCentroid_tr o f hpos
  simpa only [fragCentroid, trFrag_poly, Array.size_map] using h

name: estep_map
statement:
theorem estep_map (O : Point) (poly : Array Vtx) (apex : P3) (r : Nat)
    (acc : Array Triangle) (i : Nat) (hi : i < poly.size) (hi1 : (i + 1) % r < poly.size) :
    estep (poly.map (trVtx (ofPoint O))) (psubS apex (ofPoint O)) r
        (acc.map (trTri O)) i
    = (estep poly apex r acc i).map (trTri O)
proof:
:= by
  have haGet : ((poly.map (trVtx (ofPoint O))).getD i default).p
             = psubS poly[i].p (ofPoint O) := by
    rw [map_getD_lt _ _ _ hi _ default, getD_getElem _ _ hi]; rfl
  have hbGet : ((poly.map (trVtx (ofPoint O))).getD ((i + 1) % r) default).p
             = psubS poly[(i + 1) % r].p (ofPoint O) := by
    rw [map_getD_lt _ _ _ hi1 _ default, getD_getElem _ _ hi1]; rfl
  simp only [estep, haGet, hbGet, getD_getElem poly i hi, getD_getElem poly ((i + 1) % r) hi1,
    beqS_psubS]
  split_ifs with hc
  · rfl
  · rw [Array.map_push, trTri_triangle]

name: emitFrag_tr
statement:
theorem emitFrag_tr (O : Point) (f : Frag) :
    emitFrag (trFrag (ofPoint O) f) = (emitFrag f).map (trTri O)
proof:
:= by
  rw [emitFrag_eq, emitFrag_eq]
  simp only [trFrag_poly, Array.size_map]
  by_cases h3 : f.poly.size == 3
  · 
    simp only [h3, if_true]
    have hsz : f.poly.size = 3 := by simpa using h3
    have g0 : ((f.poly.map (trVtx (ofPoint O))).getD 0 default).p
            = psubS (f.poly.getD 0 default).p (ofPoint O) := by
      rw [map_getD_lt _ _ _ (by omega) _ default]; rfl
    have g1 : ((f.poly.map (trVtx (ofPoint O))).getD 1 default).p
            = psubS (f.poly.getD 1 default).p (ofPoint O) := by
      rw [map_getD_lt _ _ _ (by omega) _ default]; rfl
    have g2 : ((f.poly.map (trVtx (ofPoint O))).getD 2 default).p
            = psubS (f.poly.getD 2 default).p (ofPoint O) := by
      rw [map_getD_lt _ _ _ (by omega) _ default]; rfl
    rw [g0, g1, g2, beqS_psubS, beqS_psubS, beqS_psubS]
    apply Array.ext'
    split_ifs with hc <;>
      simp [Array.toList_map, trTri_triangle]
  · 
    rw [if_neg h3, if_neg h3]
    by_cases hz : f.poly.size = 0
    · rw [hz, ← Array.foldl_toList, ← Array.foldl_toList, Array.toList_range, List.range_zero,
        List.foldl_nil]; simp
    · have hpos : 0 < f.poly.size := Nat.pos_of_ne_zero hz
      rw [emit_apex_tr (ofPoint O) f hpos]
      set apex := smulS (1 / (f.poly.size : Rat))
        (f.poly.foldl (fun acc v => paddS acc v.p) ⟨0, 0, 0⟩)
      rw [← Array.foldl_toList, ← Array.foldl_toList]
      have hg : (#[] : Array Triangle).map (trTri O) = #[] := by simp
      rw [← hg]
      refine foldl_shift (Array.map (trTri O))
        (estep f.poly apex f.poly.size)
        (estep (f.poly.map (trVtx (ofPoint O))) (psubS apex (ofPoint O)) f.poly.size) _ ?_ _
      intro acc k hk
      rw [Array.toList_range, List.mem_range] at hk
      exact estep_map O f.poly apex f.poly.size acc k hk (Nat.mod_lt _ hpos)

statement:
theorem inFacePlane_rescaled_v₀_iff (S T : Triangle) :

    have := faceHOf_w_pos T; have := faceHOf_w_pos S; positivity
  refine inFacePlane_iff_mem_affineSpan_scaled _ _
    ((faceHOf T).w * (faceHOf S).w : ℤ) (by exact_mod_cast hΛ) S.v₀ T.v₀ T.v₁ T.v₂ ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_
  · rw [decI_rescale_faceHOf_v₀]
  · rw [decI_rescale_faceHOf_v₀]; push_cast; rw [mul_comm]
  · rw [decI_rescale_faceHOf_v₁]; push_cast; rw [mul_comm]
  · rw [decI_rescale_faceHOf_v₂]; push_cast; rw [mul_comm]

name: raycount_eq_winding_cop
statement:
theorem raycount_eq_winding_cop {MB : Mesh}
    (hcyc : IsClosedOrientedSurface MB) (hnpo : NoPlaneThroughOrigin MB) (hns : NoFaceInteriorContact MB)
    {Cop : Fin MB.size → Prop} {P d' : Point}
    (hPoff : ∀ u : Fin MB.size, P ∉ triangleSet MB[u])
    (hCopSimplex : ∀ k : Fin MB.size, Cop k → P ∉ simplex MB[k])
    (hTrClean : ∀ k : Fin MB.size, ¬ Cop k → ∀ g ∈ Impl.Legacy.Sim.tetraHalves MB[k], g.eval P ≠ 0)
    (hd : d' ≠ 0)
    (hdN : ∀ u : Fin MB.size, dotQ (Proof.MeshIntersectJump.faceNormal MB[u]) d' ≠ 0)
    (hdA : ∀ (j : Fin MB.size) (k : Fin 4), dotQ (slot MB[j] k).n d' ≠ 0)
    (hG2line : ∀ (j : Fin MB.size), ∀ g ∈ Impl.Legacy.Sim.tetraHalves MB[j],
      ∀ g' ∈ Impl.Legacy.Sim.tetraHalves MB[j], g ≠ g' → ∀ t : ℚ,
      ¬ (g.eval (lineAt P d' t) = 0 ∧ g'.eval (lineAt P d' t) = 0))
    (hnoedge : ∀ (u : Fin MB.size) (t : ℚ), t ≠ 0 → lineAt P d' t ∉ edgeSet MB[u]) :
    winding (meshChain MB) P = Proof.MeshIntersectRayClassify.RayCount MB P d'
proof:
:= by
  classical
  
  set root : Fin MB.size → ℚ :=
    fun u => (detOrigin MB[u] - dotQ (Proof.MeshIntersectJump.faceNormal MB[u]) P) / dotQ (Proof.MeshIntersectJump.faceNormal MB[u]) d'
    with hrootdef
  
  have hcar : ∀ (u : Fin MB.size) (t : ℚ), lineAt P d' t ∈ triangleSet MB[u] → t = root u := by
    intro u t hmem
    have h1 := Proof.MeshIntersectRayClassify.triangleSet_on_carrier hmem
    rw [Proof.WellFormedCheckNormal.dotQ_lineAt] at h1
    have hroot : root u
        = (detOrigin MB[u] - dotQ (Proof.MeshIntersectJump.faceNormal MB[u]) P) / dotQ (Proof.MeshIntersectJump.faceNormal MB[u]) d' := by
      simp only [hrootdef]
    rw [hroot, eq_div_iff (hdN u)]; linarith
  
  set RL : List ℚ := ((List.finRange MB.size).product (List.finRange 4)).map
    (fun jk => -(slot MB[jk.1] jk.2).eval P / dotQ (slot MB[jk.1] jk.2).n d') with hRLdef
  
  set δ3 : ℚ :=
    ((List.finRange MB.size).map (fun u => if 0 < root u then root u else 1)).foldr min 1 with hδ3def
  have hδ3pos : 0 < δ3 := by
    rw [hδ3def]
    refine foldr_min_pos (fun a ha => ?_) one_pos
    rw [List.mem_map] at ha; obtain ⟨u, _, rfl⟩ := ha
    split_ifs with h
    · exact h
    · exact one_pos
  have hδ3le : ∀ u : Fin MB.size, 0 < root u → δ3 ≤ root u := by
    intro u hu
    have hm : (if 0 < root u then root u else 1) ∈
        (List.finRange MB.size).map (fun u => if 0 < root u then root u else 1) :=
      List.mem_map.mpr ⟨u, List.mem_finRange u, rfl⟩
    have hb := foldr_min_le hm 1
    rw [← hδ3def] at hb
    rwa [if_pos hu] at hb
  
  set δ4 : ℚ := (((List.finRange MB.size).product (List.finRange 4)).map
    (fun kl => if (slot MB[kl.1] kl.2).eval P < 0 ∧ 0 < dotQ (slot MB[kl.1] kl.2).n d'
               then -(slot MB[kl.1] kl.2).eval P / dotQ (slot MB[kl.1] kl.2).n d'
               else 1)).foldr min 1 with hδ4def
  have hδ4pos : 0 < δ4 := by
    rw [hδ4def]
    refine foldr_min_pos (fun a ha => ?_) one_pos
    rw [List.mem_map] at ha; obtain ⟨kl, _, rfl⟩ := ha
    split_ifs with h
    · exact div_pos (by linarith [h.1]) h.2
    · exact one_pos
  have hδ4le : ∀ (k : Fin MB.size) (l0 : Fin 4),
      (slot MB[k] l0).eval P < 0 → 0 < dotQ (slot MB[k] l0).n d' →
      δ4 ≤ -(slot MB[k] l0).eval P / dotQ (slot MB[k] l0).n d' := by
    intro k l0 hneg hpos
    have hm : (-(slot MB[k] l0).eval P / dotQ (slot MB[k] l0).n d') ∈
        (((List.finRange MB.size).product (List.finRange 4)).map
          (fun kl => if (slot MB[kl.1] kl.2).eval P < 0 ∧ 0 < dotQ (slot MB[kl.1] kl.2).n d'
                     then -(slot MB[kl.1] kl.2).eval P / dotQ (slot MB[kl.1] kl.2).n d'
                     else 1)) := by
      apply List.mem_map.mpr
      refine ⟨(k, l0), List.pair_mem_product.mpr ⟨List.mem_finRange k, List.mem_finRange l0⟩, ?_⟩
      show (if (slot MB[k] l0).eval P < 0 ∧ 0 < dotQ (slot MB[k] l0).n d'
            then -(slot MB[k] l0).eval P / dotQ (slot MB[k] l0).n d' else 1)
          = -(slot MB[k] l0).eval P / dotQ (slot MB[k] l0).n d'
      rw [if_pos ⟨hneg, hpos⟩]
    have hb := foldr_min_le hm 1
    rw [← hδ4def] at hb
    exact hb
  
  obtain ⟨ε, hε0, hεδ, hεRL⟩ := exists_between_avoiding (lt_min hδ3pos hδ4pos) RL
  have hεδ3 : ε < δ3 := lt_of_lt_of_le hεδ (min_le_left _ _)
  have hεδ4 : ε < δ4 := lt_of_lt_of_le hεδ (min_le_right _ _)
  set Pε : Point := lineAt P d' ε with hPεdef
  
  have hCLEAN : ∀ (j : Fin MB.size), ∀ g ∈ Impl.Legacy.Sim.tetraHalves MB[j], g.eval Pε ≠ 0 := by
    intro j g hg
    obtain ⟨k, rfl⟩ := mem_tetraHalves_iff.mp hg
    rw [hPεdef, eval_lineAt]
    intro hz
    have hval : ε = -(slot MB[j] k).eval P / dotQ (slot MB[j] k).n d' := by
      rw [eq_div_iff (hdA j k)]; linarith [hz]
    refine (hεRL _ ?_) hval
    rw [hRLdef]
    exact List.mem_map.mpr
      ⟨(j, k), List.pair_mem_product.mpr ⟨List.mem_finRange j, List.mem_finRange k⟩, rfl⟩
  
  have hSEGOFF : ∀ s : ℚ, 0 ≤ s → s ≤ ε → ∀ u : Fin MB.size,
      lineAt P d' s ∉ triangleSet MB[u] := by
    intro s hs0 hsε u hmem
    rcases eq_or_lt_of_le hs0 with h0 | h0
    · apply hPoff u
      have hL : lineAt P d' s = P := by rw [← h0]; funext c; simp only [lineAt]; ring
      rwa [hL] at hmem
    · have hsr : s = root u := hcar u s hmem
      have hru : 0 < root u := hsr ▸ h0
      have hlt : ε < s := by
        calc ε < δ3 := hεδ3
          _ ≤ root u := hδ3le u hru
          _ = s := hsr.symm
      linarith
  
  have hcomp : ∀ (r s : ℚ), lineAt (lineAt P d' r) d' s = lineAt P d' (r + s) := by
    intro r s; funext c; simp only [lineAt]; ring
  
  have hStep2 : winding (meshChain MB) Pε = Proof.MeshIntersectRayClassify.RayCount MB Pε d' := by
    apply raycount_eq_winding hcyc hnpo hns
    · intro j g hg; exact hCLEAN j g hg
    · exact hd
    · exact hdN
    · exact hdA
    · intro j g hg g' hg' hne t
      rw [hPεdef, hcomp]
      exact hG2line j g hg g' hg' hne (ε + t)
    · intro u t ht
      rw [hPεdef, hcomp]
      by_cases hεt : ε + t = 0
      · rw [hεt]
        have hL : lineAt P d' 0 = P := by funext c; simp only [lineAt]; ring
        rw [hL]
        exact fun hc => hPoff u (edgeSet_subset_triangleSet MB[u] hc)
      · exact hnoedge u (ε + t) hεt
  
  have hStep3 : Proof.MeshIntersectRayClassify.RayCount MB Pε d'
      = Proof.MeshIntersectRayClassify.RayCount MB P d' := by
    apply rayCount_local_const hnpo
    · intro θ hθ0 hθ1 u
      have hpt : (fun i => Pε i + θ * (P i - Pε i)) = lineAt P d' ((1 - θ) * ε) := by
        rw [hPεdef]; funext c; simp only [lineAt]; ring
      rw [hpt]
      exact hSEGOFF ((1 - θ) * ε) (mul_nonneg (by linarith) hε0.le)
        (by nlinarith [mul_nonneg hθ0 hε0.le]) u
    · intro θ hθ0 hθ1 u s hs
      have hpt : (fun i => Pε i + θ * (P i - Pε i)) = lineAt P d' ((1 - θ) * ε) := by
        rw [hPεdef]; funext c; simp only [lineAt]; ring
      rw [hpt, hcomp]
      have hpos : (0 : ℚ) < (1 - θ) * ε + s := by
        nlinarith [mul_nonneg (by linarith : (0:ℚ) ≤ 1 - θ) hε0.le, hs]
      exact hnoedge u ((1 - θ) * ε + s) hpos.ne'
  
  have hStep1 : winding (meshChain MB) P = winding (meshChain MB) Pε := by
    apply winding_const_of_avoiding_offTri_cop MB hcyc hnpo P Pε (Cop := Cop)
    · 
      intro i τ h0 h1
      have hpt : (fun k => P k + τ * (Pε k - P k)) = lineAt P d' (τ * ε) := by
        rw [hPεdef]; funext c; simp only [lineAt]; ring
      rw [hpt]
      exact hSEGOFF (τ * ε) (mul_nonneg h0.le hε0.le)
        (by nlinarith [mul_nonneg (by linarith : (0:ℚ) ≤ 1 - τ) hε0.le]) i
    · 
      intro k hCk τ h0 h1
      have hPsimp : P ∉ simplex MB[k] := hCopSimplex k hCk
      have hdet3 : det3 MB[k].v₀ MB[k].v₁ MB[k].v₂ ≠ 0 := by rw [det3_eq_detOrigin]; exact hnpo k
      have hex : ∃ l : Fin 4, (slot MB[k] l).eval P < 0 := by
        by_contra hcon; push_neg at hcon
        exact hPsimp ((mem_simplex_iff_slots hdet3 P).mpr hcon)
      obtain ⟨l0, hl0⟩ := hex
      have hpt : seg P Pε τ = lineAt P d' (τ * ε) := by
        rw [hPεdef]; funext c; simp only [seg, lineAt]; ring
      rw [hpt]
      have hslotlt : (slot MB[k] l0).eval (lineAt P d' (τ * ε)) < 0 := by
        rw [eval_lineAt]
        rcases lt_or_gt_of_ne (hdA k l0) with hneg | hpos
        · have hle : (τ * ε) * dotQ (slot MB[k] l0).n d' ≤ 0 :=
            mul_nonpos_iff.mpr (Or.inl ⟨mul_nonneg h0 hε0.le, hneg.le⟩)
          linarith [hl0]
        · have hprod : ε * dotQ (slot MB[k] l0).n d' < -(slot MB[k] l0).eval P := by
            have hb : ε < -(slot MB[k] l0).eval P / dotQ (slot MB[k] l0).n d' :=
              lt_of_lt_of_le hεδ4 (hδ4le k l0 hl0 hpos)
            exact (lt_div_iff₀ hpos).mp hb
          have hτε : (τ * ε) * dotQ (slot MB[k] l0).n d' ≤ ε * dotQ (slot MB[k] l0).n d' :=
            mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right
              (by nlinarith [mul_nonneg (by linarith : (0:ℚ) ≤ 1 - τ) hε0.le]) hpos.le
          linarith [hl0, hprod, hτε]
      intro hmem
      have := (mem_simplex_iff_slots hdet3 (lineAt P d' (τ * ε))).mp hmem l0
      linarith
    · 
      intro k hCk g hg
      exact ⟨hTrClean k hCk g hg, hCLEAN k g hg⟩
    · 
      intro k hCk a b _ _ hab τ h0 h1 hboth
      have hpt : (fun kk => P kk + τ * (Pε kk - P kk)) = lineAt P d' (τ * ε) := by
        rw [hPεdef]; funext c; simp only [lineAt]; ring
      rw [hpt] at hboth
      have hne : slot MB[k] a ≠ slot MB[k] b := by
        intro heq
        exact (crossQ_slot_ne (hnpo k) hab) (by rw [heq]; exact CSG.Proof.MeshIntersectClip.crossQ_self _)
      exact hG2line k (slot MB[k] a) (slot_mem _ _) (slot MB[k] b) (slot_mem _ _) hne (τ * ε) hboth
  
  rw [hStep1, hStep2, hStep3]

name: intersect_eq
statement:
theorem intersect_eq (w₁ w₂ : Chain) :
    Impl.Legacy.ChainIntersectionAlgorithm.intersect w₁ w₂
      = Proof.ProductChainGen.productChainOf CSG.Impl.Legacy.Sim.simImpl w₁ w₂
proof:
:= by
  have h1 : Impl.Legacy.ChainIntersectionAlgorithm.intersect w₁ w₂
      = Proof.ProductChainGen.productChainOf CSG.Impl.Legacy.Sim.simImplFast w₁ w₂ := rfl
  rw [h1]
  have hf : CSG.Impl.Legacy.Sim.simImplFast = CSG.Impl.Legacy.Sim.simImpl :=
    funext fun s => funext fun t => Proof.SimImplScale.simImplFast_eq_simImpl s t
  rw [hf]

name: intersect_spec
statement:
theorem intersect_spec (w₁ w₂ : Chain) (h₁ : Legacy.Normal w₁) (h₂ : Legacy.Normal w₂) :
    Legacy.Normal (Impl.Legacy.ChainIntersectionAlgorithm.intersect w₁ w₂) ∧
      EqOffPlanes (Legacy.solid (Impl.Legacy.ChainIntersectionAlgorithm.intersect w₁ w₂))
        (Legacy.solid w₁ ∩ Legacy.solid w₂)
proof:
:= by
  rw [intersect_eq]
  exact ⟨ Proof.ProductChainGen.normal_of_productOf
            CSG.Impl.Legacy.Sim.simImpl Proof.SimImplWinding.simImpl_windingSpec w₁ w₂ h₁ h₂,
          Proof.ProductChainGen.eqOffPlanes_of_productOf
            CSG.Impl.Legacy.Sim.simImpl Proof.SimImplWinding.simImpl_windingSpec w₁ w₂ ⟩

name: dotQ_faceNormal_carrier
statement:
theorem dotQ_faceNormal_carrier (t : Triangle) (w : Point) :
    dotQ (Proof.MeshIntersectJump.faceNormal t) w = dotQ (carrierNormal t) w
proof:
:= by
  simp only [Proof.MeshIntersectJump.faceNormal, carrierNormal, dotQ, crossQ, psub,
    Proof.SimImplCover.mkPoint_zero, Proof.SimImplCover.mkPoint_one,
    Proof.SimImplCover.mkPoint_two, Pi.sub_apply]

name: slot3_cases
statement:
theorem slot3_cases (t : Triangle) :
    slot t 3 = ⟨crossQ (psub t.v₁ t.v₀) (psub t.v₂ t.v₀), detOrigin t⟩
    ∨ slot t 3
      = ⟨psub (mkPoint 0 0 0) (crossQ (psub t.v₁ t.v₀) (psub t.v₂ t.v₀)),
          -(detOrigin t)⟩
proof:
:= by
  have hb := faceNormal_offset t
  rw [Proof.MeshIntersectJump.faceNormal] at hb
  have hslot : slot t 3
      = (if dotQ (crossQ (psub t.v₁ t.v₀) (psub t.v₂ t.v₀)) t.v₀ ≤ 0
         then (⟨crossQ (psub t.v₁ t.v₀) (psub t.v₂ t.v₀),
               dotQ (crossQ (psub t.v₁ t.v₀) (psub t.v₂ t.v₀)) t.v₀⟩ : Half)
         else Half.neg ⟨crossQ (psub t.v₁ t.v₀) (psub t.v₂ t.v₀),
               dotQ (crossQ (psub t.v₁ t.v₀) (psub t.v₂ t.v₀)) t.v₀⟩) := rfl
  rw [hslot]
  split_ifs
  · left
    rw [hb]
  · right
    rw [Half.neg, hb]

name: slot3_eval
statement:
theorem slot3_eval (t : Triangle) (p : Point) :
    (slot t 3).eval p = dotQ (carrierNormal t) p - detOrigin t
    ∨ (slot t 3).eval p = -(dotQ (carrierNormal t) p - detOrigin t)
proof:
:= by
  have hfc : dotQ (crossQ (psub t.v₁ t.v₀) (psub t.v₂ t.v₀)) p
      = dotQ (carrierNormal t) p := dotQ_faceNormal_carrier t p
  rcases slot3_cases t with h | h <;> rw [h, Half.eval]
  · left
    rw [hfc]
  · right
    show dotQ (psub (mkPoint 0 0 0) _) p - _ = _
    rw [dotQ_neg_normal, hfc]
    ring

name: slot3_eval_zero_iff
statement:
theorem slot3_eval_zero_iff (t : Triangle) (p : Point) :
    (slot t 3).eval p = 0 ↔ dotQ (carrierNormal t) p = detOrigin t
proof:
:= by
  rcases slot3_eval t p with h | h <;> rw [h]
  · exact sub_eq_zero
  · rw [neg_eq_zero]
    exact sub_eq_zero

name: isOpen_boxO
statement: theorem isOpen_boxO (Q : Point) (r : ℚ) : IsOpen (BoxO Q r)
proof:
:= by
  have hrw : BoxO Q r
      = ⋂ k : Fin 3, (fun P : Point => P k) ⁻¹' (Set.Ioo (Q k - r) (Q k + r)) := by
    ext P
    rw [mem_BoxO]
    simp only [Set.mem_iInter, Set.mem_preimage, Set.mem_Ioo, abs_lt]
    constructor
    · intro h k; obtain ⟨h1, h2⟩ := h k; constructor <;> linarith
    · intro h k; obtain ⟨h1, h2⟩ := h k; constructor <;> linarith
  rw [hrw]
  exact isOpen_iInter_of_finite (fun k => isOpen_Ioo.preimage (continuous_apply k))

name: self_mem_boxO
statement: theorem self_mem_boxO (Q : Point) {r : ℚ} (hr : 0 < r) : Q ∈ BoxO Q r
proof:
:= by
  rw [mem_BoxO]; intro i; simpa using hr

name: exists_boxO_subset_of_mem_nhds
statement:
theorem exists_boxO_subset_of_mem_nhds {Q : Point} {V : Set Point} (hV : V ∈ nhds Q) :
    ∃ r : ℚ, 0 < r ∧ BoxO Q r ⊆ V
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨δ, hδ, hball⟩ := Metric.mem_nhds_iff.mp hV
  obtain ⟨r, hr0, hrδ⟩ := exists_rat_btwn hδ
  have hr0' : (0 : ℚ) < r := by exact_mod_cast hr0
  refine ⟨r, hr0', fun P hP => hball ?_⟩
  rw [Metric.mem_ball]
  have hd : dist P Q < (r : ℝ) := by
    rw [dist_pi_lt_iff hr0]
    intro k
    rw [Rat.dist_eq]
    have h : ((|P k - Q k| : ℚ) : ℝ) < ((r : ℚ) : ℝ) := by
      exact_mod_cast (mem_BoxO.mp hP) k
    push_cast at h
    exact h
  linarith

name: mem_closure_of_boxO_meets
statement:
theorem mem_closure_of_boxO_meets {S : Set Point} {Q : Point}
    (h : ∀ r : ℚ, 0 < r → ∃ P, P ∈ BoxO Q r ∧ P ∈ S) : Q ∈ closure S
proof:
:= by
  rw [mem_closure_iff]
  intro U hU hQU
  obtain ⟨r, hr, hsub⟩ := exists_boxO_subset_of_mem_nhds (hU.mem_nhds hQU)
  obtain ⟨P, hPbox, hPS⟩ := h r hr
  exact ⟨P, hsub hPbox, hPS⟩

name: continuous_affine
statement: theorem continuous_affine (g : Point →ᵃ[ℚ] ℚ) : Continuous g
proof:
:= by
  have hlin : Continuous (g.linear : Point →ₗ[ℚ] ℚ) := LinearMap.continuous_on_pi _
  simpa using (hlin.add continuous_const).congr (fun P => by
    have h := g.map_vadd (0 : Point) P
    simp only [vadd_eq_add, add_zero] at h
    simpa using h.symm)

name: isOpen_signPos
statement: theorem isOpen_signPos (g : Point →ᵃ[ℚ] ℚ) (s : ℚ) : IsOpen {P : Point | 0 < s * g P}
proof:
:=
  isOpen_lt continuous_const (continuous_const.mul (continuous_affine g))

name: isClosed_triangleSet
statement:
theorem isClosed_triangleSet {t : Triangle} (hn : faceNormal t ≠ 0) :
    IsClosed (triangleSet t)
proof:
:= by
  rw [← isOpen_compl_iff, isOpen_iff_mem_nhds]
  intro Q hQ
  obtain ⟨r, hr, hspec⟩ := exists_separating_box hn hQ
  refine Filter.mem_of_superset ((isOpen_boxO Q r).mem_nhds (self_mem_boxO Q hr)) ?_
  exact fun P hP => hspec P (BoxO_subset_Box Q r hP)

name: isClosed_surface
statement:
theorem isClosed_surface {X : Mesh} (hndf : NoDegenerateFaces X) :
    IsClosed (Proof.surface X)
proof:
:= by
  rw [Proof.surface]
  exact isClosed_iUnion_of_finite (fun i => isClosed_triangleSet (hndf i))

name: mem_cell
statement:
theorem mem_cell {X : Mesh} {d₀ Q P : Point} :
    P ∈ cell X d₀ Q ↔ ∀ (u : Fin X.size) (j : Fin 4),
      0 < (SurfaceBridge.wfam X[u] d₀ Q j).2 * ((SurfaceBridge.wfam X[u] d₀ Q j).1 P)
proof:
:=
  Iff.rfl

name: isOpen_cell
statement: theorem isOpen_cell (X : Mesh) (d₀ Q : Point) : IsOpen (cell X d₀ Q)
proof:
:= by
  have hrw : cell X d₀ Q = ⋂ u : Fin X.size, ⋂ j : Fin 4,
      {P : Point | 0 < (SurfaceBridge.wfam X[u] d₀ Q j).2 *
        ((SurfaceBridge.wfam X[u] d₀ Q j).1 P)} := by
    ext P
    rw [mem_cell]
    simp only [Set.mem_iInter, Set.mem_setOf_eq]
  rw [hrw]
  exact isOpen_iInter_of_finite
    (fun u => isOpen_iInter_of_finite (fun j => isOpen_signPos _ _))

name: self_mem_cell
statement:
theorem self_mem_cell {X : Mesh} {Q d₀ : Point} (hQ : Q ∉ Proof.surface X)
    (hadm₀ : AdmissibleRay X Q d₀) : Q ∈ cell X d₀ Q
proof:
:= by
  rw [mem_cell]
  intro u j
  exact SurfaceBridge.wfam_strict
    (fun hmem => hQ (Set.mem_iUnion.mpr ⟨u, hmem⟩)) (fun s hs => hadm₀.2 u s hs) j

name: solid_iff_of_mem_cell
statement:
theorem solid_iff_of_mem_cell {X : Mesh}
    (hcyc : IsClosedOrientedSurface X) (hns : NoFaceInteriorContact X)
    (hndf : NoDegenerateFaces X)
    {O : Point} (hnpo : NoPlaneThroughOrigin (trMesh O X))
    {Q d₀ : Point} (hQ : Q ∉ Proof.surface X) (hadm₀ : AdmissibleRay X Q d₀)
    {P : Point} (hPcell : P ∈ cell X d₀ Q) (hP : P ∉ Proof.surface X) :
    P ∈ solid X ↔ Q ∈ solid X
proof:
:= by
  classical
  obtain ⟨d', hadm'⟩ := Proof.MeshIntersectM2Kit.exists_admissible X P
  have hN : Negligible
      (Proof.surface X ∪ {R | ¬ AdmissibleRay X R d₀} ∪ {R | ¬ AdmissibleRay X R d'}) :=
    Proof.Negligible.negligible_union
      (Proof.Negligible.negligible_union (surface_negligible hndf)
        (SurfaceBridge.negligible_not_admissible hadm₀.1))
      (SurfaceBridge.negligible_not_admissible hadm'.1)
  obtain ⟨R, hRcount, hRcell, hRN⟩ :=
    exists_count_eq_cell_off_negligible hP hadm'
      (fun p : Fin X.size × Fin 4 => (SurfaceBridge.wfam X[p.1] d₀ Q p.2).1)
      (fun p : Fin X.size × Fin 4 => (SurfaceBridge.wfam X[p.1] d₀ Q p.2).2)
      (fun _ => SurfaceBridge.wfam_sign _ _ _ _)
      (fun p => (mem_cell.mp hPcell) p.1 p.2) hN
  simp only [Set.mem_union, Set.mem_setOf_eq, not_or, not_not] at hRN
  obtain ⟨⟨hRsurf, hRadm₀⟩, hRadm'⟩ := hRN
  
  have hRQ : crossingCount X R d₀ = crossingCount X Q d₀ := by
    rw [SurfaceBridge.crossingCount_eq_sum, SurfaceBridge.crossingCount_eq_sum]
    exact Finset.sum_congr rfl
      (fun u _ => SurfaceBridge.wfam_forces (fun j => hRcell (u, j)))
  
  have hRdd : crossingCount X R d' = crossingCount X R d₀ :=
    crossingCount_eq_of_offSurface hcyc hns hnpo hRsurf hRadm' hRadm₀
  have hPQ : crossingCount X P d' = crossingCount X Q d₀ := by
    rw [← hRcount, hRdd, hRQ]
  rw [solid_iff_count_of_offSurface hcyc hns hnpo hP hadm',
    solid_iff_count_of_offSurface hcyc hns hnpo hQ hadm₀, hPQ]

name: exists_solid_in_boxO
statement:
theorem exists_solid_in_boxO {X : Mesh}
    (hcyc : IsClosedOrientedSurface X) (hwzo : WindingZeroOrOne X)
    (hns : NoFaceInteriorContact X) (hndf : NoDegenerateFaces X)
    {O : Point} (hnpo : NoPlaneThroughOrigin (trMesh O X))
    {Q : Point} (hQ : Q ∈ Proof.surface X) {r : ℚ} (hr : 0 < r) :
    ∃ P, P ∈ BoxO Q r ∧ P ∈ solid X
proof:
:= by
  classical
  rw [Proof.surface, Set.mem_iUnion] at hQ
  obtain ⟨i, hQi⟩ := hQ
  obtain ⟨x, hxmem, hxedge, hxbox⟩ :=
    exists_relint_in_box (hndf i) hQi (r := r / 4) (by linarith)
  have hiso : ∀ u : Fin X.size, u ≠ i → x ∉ triangleSet X[u] :=
    fun u hu => relint_isolated hns hxmem hxedge hu
  obtain ⟨-, P₁, d, -, hP₁box, hP₁count, hP₁adm, hP₁surf⟩ :=
    exists_jump_probe hwzo hndf hxmem hxedge hiso (R := r / 4) (by linarith)
  refine ⟨P₁, ?_, ?_⟩
  · rw [mem_BoxO]
    intro k
    have h1 : |x k - Q k| ≤ r / 4 := hxbox k
    have h2 : |P₁ k - x k| ≤ r / 4 := hP₁box k
    have h3 : |P₁ k - Q k| ≤ |P₁ k - x k| + |x k - Q k| := abs_sub_le _ _ _
    linarith
  · rw [solid_iff_count_of_offSurface hcyc hns hnpo hP₁surf hP₁adm, hP₁count]
    norm_num

name: surface_eq_frontier
statement:
theorem surface_eq_frontier {M : Mesh} (hwf : WellFormedMesh M) :
    Proof.surface M = frontier (solid M)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  obtain ⟨hcyc, hwzo, hns, hndf⟩ := hwf
  obtain ⟨O, hnpo⟩ := Proof.MeshIntersectM2Kit.good_origin_of_nonDegenerate hndf
  apply Set.eq_of_subset_of_subset
  · 
    intro Q hQ
    refine ⟨mem_closure_of_boxO_meets (fun r hr => ?_), fun hint => ?_⟩
    · obtain ⟨P, hPbox, hPsolid⟩ := exists_solid_in_boxO hcyc hwzo hns hndf hnpo hQ hr
      exact ⟨P, hPbox, hPsolid⟩
    · exact surface_disjoint_solid hcyc hns hwzo hndf hnpo hQ (interior_subset hint)
  · 
    intro Q hQfr
    by_contra hQ
    obtain ⟨hcl, hint⟩ := hQfr
    obtain ⟨d₀, hadm₀⟩ := Proof.MeshIntersectM2Kit.exists_admissible M Q
    set U : Set Point := cell M d₀ Q ∩ (Proof.surface M)ᶜ with hU
    have hUopen : IsOpen U :=
      (isOpen_cell M d₀ Q).inter (isClosed_surface hndf).isOpen_compl
    have hQU : Q ∈ U := ⟨self_mem_cell hQ hadm₀, hQ⟩
    have hkey : ∀ P ∈ U, (P ∈ solid M ↔ Q ∈ solid M) :=
      fun P hP => solid_iff_of_mem_cell hcyc hns hndf hnpo hQ hadm₀ hP.1 hP.2
    by_cases hQs : Q ∈ solid M
    · exact hint (mem_interior.mpr ⟨U, fun P hP => (hkey P hP).mpr hQs, hUopen, hQU⟩)
    · obtain ⟨P, hPU, hPs⟩ := mem_closure_iff.mp hcl U hUopen hQU
      exact hQs ((hkey P hPU).mp hPs)

name: surface_eq_frontier_solid
statement:
theorem surface_eq_frontier_solid (M : Mesh) (h : WellFormedMesh M) :
    (⋃ i : Fin M.size, triangleSet M[i]) = frontier (solid M)
proof:
:= by
  show Proof.surface M = frontier (solid M)
  exact surface_eq_frontier h

name: surface_eq_of_solid_eq
statement:
theorem surface_eq_of_solid_eq (M₁ M₂ : Mesh)
    (h₁ : WellFormedMesh M₁) (h₂ : WellFormedMesh M₂)
    (hs : solid M₁ = solid M₂) :
    (⋃ i : Fin M₁.size, triangleSet M₁[i])
      = ⋃ i : Fin M₂.size, triangleSet M₂[i]
proof:
:= by
  rw [surface_eq_frontier_solid M₁ h₁, surface_eq_frontier_solid M₂ h₂, hs]

name: beqIPlane_iff
statement: theorem beqIPlane_iff {g h : IPlane} : beqIPlane g h = true ↔ g = h
proof:
:=
  Proof.MeshIntersectPrim.beqIPlane_eq_true_iff

name: iplaneLe_iff
statement:
theorem iplaneLe_iff {g h : IPlane} : iplaneLe g h = true ↔
    g.a < h.a ∨ (g.a = h.a ∧ (g.b < h.b ∨ (g.b = h.b ∧
      (g.c < h.c ∨ (g.c = h.c ∧ g.d ≤ h.d)))))
proof:
:= by
  unfold iplaneLe
  by_cases ha : g.a = h.a
  · simp only [ha, bne_self_eq_false, Bool.false_eq_true, if_false, true_and,
      lt_irrefl, false_or]
    by_cases hb : g.b = h.b
    · simp only [hb, bne_self_eq_false, Bool.false_eq_true, if_false, true_and,
        lt_irrefl, false_or]
      by_cases hc : g.c = h.c
      · simp only [hc, bne_self_eq_false, Bool.false_eq_true, if_false, true_and,
          lt_irrefl, false_or, decide_eq_true_eq]
      · simp only [bne_iff_ne.mpr hc, if_true, decide_eq_true_eq]
        constructor
        · intro h'; exact Or.inl h'
        · rintro (h' | ⟨h', -⟩); exact h'; exact absurd h' hc
    · simp only [bne_iff_ne.mpr hb, if_true, decide_eq_true_eq]
      constructor
      · intro h'; exact Or.inl h'
      · rintro (h' | ⟨h', -⟩); exact h'; exact absurd h' hb
  · simp only [bne_iff_ne.mpr ha, if_true, decide_eq_true_eq]
    constructor
    · intro h'; exact Or.inl h'
    · rintro (h' | ⟨h', -⟩); exact h'; exact absurd h' ha

name: iplaneLe_refl
statement: theorem iplaneLe_refl (g : IPlane) : iplaneLe g g = true
proof:
:= by
  rw [iplaneLe_iff]; right; exact ⟨rfl, by right; exact ⟨rfl, by right; exact ⟨rfl, le_refl _⟩⟩⟩

name: iplaneLe_total
statement: theorem iplaneLe_total (g h : IPlane) : iplaneLe g h = true ∨ iplaneLe h g = true
proof:
:= by
  rw [iplaneLe_iff, iplaneLe_iff]
  by_cases ha : g.a = h.a
  · by_cases hb : g.b = h.b
    · by_cases hc : g.c = h.c
      · rcases le_total g.d h.d with h' | h'
        · exact Or.inl (Or.inr ⟨ha, Or.inr ⟨hb, Or.inr ⟨hc, h'⟩⟩⟩)
        · exact Or.inr (Or.inr ⟨ha.symm, Or.inr ⟨hb.symm, Or.inr ⟨hc.symm, h'⟩⟩⟩)
      · rcases lt_or_gt_of_ne hc with h' | h'
        · exact Or.inl (Or.inr ⟨ha, Or.inr ⟨hb, Or.inl h'⟩⟩)
        · exact Or.inr (Or.inr ⟨ha.symm, Or.inr ⟨hb.symm, Or.inl h'⟩⟩)
    · rcases lt_or_gt_of_ne hb with h' | h'
      · exact Or.inl (Or.inr ⟨ha, Or.inl h'⟩)
      · exact Or.inr (Or.inr ⟨ha.symm, Or.inl h'⟩)
  · rcases lt_or_gt_of_ne ha with h' | h'
    · exact Or.inl (Or.inl h')
    · exact Or.inr (Or.inl h')

name: iplaneLe_trans
statement:
theorem iplaneLe_trans {g h k : IPlane}
    (h₁ : iplaneLe g h = true) (h₂ : iplaneLe h k = true) : iplaneLe g k = true
proof:
:= by
  rw [iplaneLe_iff] at h₁ h₂ ⊢
  rcases h₁ with ha1 | ⟨ha1, h₁⟩
  · rcases h₂ with ha2 | ⟨ha2, -⟩
    · exact Or.inl (lt_trans ha1 ha2)
    · exact Or.inl (ha2 ▸ ha1)
  · rcases h₂ with ha2 | ⟨ha2, h₂⟩
    · exact Or.inl (ha1 ▸ ha2)
    · refine Or.inr ⟨ha1.trans ha2, ?_⟩
      rcases h₁ with hb1 | ⟨hb1, h₁⟩
      · rcases h₂ with hb2 | ⟨hb2, -⟩
        · exact Or.inl (lt_trans hb1 hb2)
        · exact Or.inl (hb2 ▸ hb1)
      · rcases h₂ with hb2 | ⟨hb2, h₂⟩
        · exact Or.inl (hb1 ▸ hb2)
        · refine Or.inr ⟨hb1.trans hb2, ?_⟩
          rcases h₁ with hc1 | ⟨hc1, h₁⟩
          · rcases h₂ with hc2 | ⟨hc2, -⟩
            · exact Or.inl (lt_trans hc1 hc2)
            · exact Or.inl (hc2 ▸ hc1)
          · rcases h₂ with hc2 | ⟨hc2, h₂⟩
            · exact Or.inl (hc1 ▸ hc2)
            · exact Or.inr ⟨hc1.trans hc2, le_trans h₁ h₂⟩

name: iplaneLe_antisymm
statement:
theorem iplaneLe_antisymm {g h : IPlane}
    (h₁ : iplaneLe g h = true) (h₂ : iplaneLe h g = true) : g = h
proof:
:= by
  rw [iplaneLe_iff] at h₁ h₂
  have ha : g.a = h.a := by
    rcases h₁ with h' | ⟨h', -⟩
    · rcases h₂ with h'' | ⟨h'', -⟩ <;> omega
    · exact h'
  have hb : g.b = h.b := by
    rcases h₁ with h' | ⟨-, h₁⟩
    · omega
    rcases h₂ with h'' | ⟨-, h₂⟩
    · omega
    rcases h₁ with h' | ⟨h', -⟩
    · rcases h₂ with h'' | ⟨h'', -⟩ <;> omega
    · exact h'
  have hc : g.c = h.c := by
    rcases h₁ with h' | ⟨-, h₁⟩
    · omega
    rcases h₂ with h'' | ⟨-, h₂⟩
    · omega
    rcases h₁ with h' | ⟨-, h₁⟩
    · omega
    rcases h₂ with h'' | ⟨-, h₂⟩
    · omega
    rcases h₁ with h' | ⟨h', -⟩
    · rcases h₂ with h'' | ⟨h'', -⟩ <;> omega
    · exact h'
  have hd : g.d = h.d := by
    rcases h₁ with h' | ⟨-, h₁⟩
    · omega
    rcases h₁ with h' | ⟨-, h₁⟩
    · omega
    rcases h₁ with h' | ⟨-, h₁⟩
    · omega
    rcases h₂ with h'' | ⟨-, h₂⟩
    · omega
    rcases h₂ with h'' | ⟨-, h₂⟩
    · omega
    rcases h₂ with h'' | ⟨-, h₂⟩
    · omega
    omega
  cases g; cases h; simp_all

name: iplaneLe_antisymm_beq
statement:
theorem iplaneLe_antisymm_beq {g h : IPlane}
    (h₁ : iplaneLe g h = true) (h₂ : iplaneLe h g = true) : beqIPlane g h = true
proof:
:=
  beqIPlane_iff.mpr (iplaneLe_antisymm h₁ h₂)

name: primKeys_eq
statement:
theorem primKeys_eq (B : Array FaceS) :
    primKeys B
      = ((B.map (fun u => IPlane.prim u.plane)).toList.mergeSort iplaneLe).toArray.foldl
          kstep #[]
proof: := rfl

name: back
statement:
theorem back?_eq_getLast? {α : Type*} (a : Array α) :
    a.back? = a.toList.getLast?
proof:
:= by
  rcases a with ⟨l⟩
  simp [Array.back?, List.getLast?_eq_getElem?]

name: iplaneLt_of_le_of_ne
statement:
theorem iplaneLt_of_le_of_ne {g h : IPlane} (hle : iplaneLe g h = true)
    (hne : beqIPlane g h = false) : iplaneLt g h = true
proof:
:= by
  unfold iplaneLt; rw [hle, hne]; rfl

name: iplaneLe_of_lt
statement: theorem iplaneLe_of_lt {g h : IPlane} (h₁ : iplaneLt g h = true) : iplaneLe g h = true
proof:
:= by
  unfold iplaneLt at h₁; exact (Bool.and_eq_true_iff.mp h₁).1

name: iplaneLt_irrefl
statement: theorem iplaneLt_irrefl {g h : IPlane} (h₁ : iplaneLt g h = true) : beqIPlane g h = false
proof:
:= by
  unfold iplaneLt at h₁
  have := (Bool.and_eq_true_iff.mp h₁).2
  simpa using this

name: iplaneLt_trans
statement:
theorem iplaneLt_trans {g h k : IPlane}
    (h₁ : iplaneLt g h = true) (h₂ : iplaneLt h k = true) : iplaneLt g k = true
proof:
:= by
  have hgh := iplaneLe_of_lt h₁
  have hhk := iplaneLe_of_lt h₂
  have hgk := iplaneLe_trans hgh hhk
  refine iplaneLt_of_le_of_ne hgk ?_
  by_contra hc
  rw [Bool.not_eq_false] at hc
  have hgeq : g = k := beqIPlane_iff.mp hc
  subst hgeq
  
  have : beqIPlane g h = true := iplaneLe_antisymm_beq hgh hhk
  rw [iplaneLt_irrefl h₁] at this
  exact absurd this (by simp)

name: iplaneLt_of_lt_of_le
statement:
theorem iplaneLt_of_lt_of_le {g h k : IPlane}
    (h₁ : iplaneLt g h = true) (h₂ : iplaneLe h k = true) : iplaneLt g k = true
proof:
:= by
  by_cases he : beqIPlane h k = true
  · have : h = k := beqIPlane_iff.mp he
    subst this; exact h₁
  · rw [Bool.not_eq_true] at he
    exact iplaneLt_trans h₁ (iplaneLt_of_le_of_ne h₂ he)

name: pairwise_lt_getLast
statement:
theorem pairwise_lt_getLast {l : List IPlane}
    (hl : l.Pairwise (fun a b => iplaneLt a b = true))
    {u a : IPlane} (hu : l.getLast? = some u) (ha : a ∈ l) (hne : a ≠ u) :
    iplaneLt a u = true
proof:
:= by
  have hlne : l ≠ [] := by rintro rfl; simp at hu
  rw [List.getLast?_eq_getElem?, List.getElem?_eq_some_iff] at hu
  obtain ⟨hlast_lt, hu'⟩ := hu
  obtain ⟨i, hi, hai⟩ := List.getElem_of_mem ha
  have hine : i ≠ l.length - 1 := by
    intro hc; subst hc; exact hne (hai.symm.trans hu')
  have hilt : i < l.length - 1 := by omega
  have := List.pairwise_iff_getElem.mp hl i (l.length - 1) hi (by omega) hilt
  subst hai; subst hu'; exact this

name: kstep_fold_invariant
statement:
theorem kstep_fold_invariant :
    ∀ (l : List IPlane) (acc : Array IPlane),
      acc.toList.Pairwise (fun a b => iplaneLt a b = true) →
      (∀ a ∈ acc.toList, ∀ g ∈ l, iplaneLe a g = true) →
      l.Pairwise (fun a b => iplaneLe a b = true) →
      (l.foldl kstep acc).toList.Pairwise (fun a b => iplaneLt a b = true)
        ∧ ∀ a ∈ (l.foldl kstep acc).toList, a ∈ acc.toList ∨ a ∈ l
proof:
:= by
  intro l
  induction l with
  | nil =>
    intro acc hacc _ _
    exact ⟨hacc, fun a ha => Or.inl ha⟩
  | cons v rest ih =>
    intro acc hacc hbound hsorted
    rw [List.foldl_cons]
    have hrest_sorted : rest.Pairwise (fun a b => iplaneLe a b = true) :=
      (List.pairwise_cons.mp hsorted).2
    have hv_le_rest : ∀ x ∈ rest, iplaneLe v x = true :=
      (List.pairwise_cons.mp hsorted).1
    have hpush : (acc.push v).toList = acc.toList ++ [v] := by simp
    have hkey : (∀ a ∈ acc.toList, iplaneLt a v = true) →
        (List.foldl kstep (acc.push v) rest).toList.Pairwise
            (fun a b => iplaneLt a b = true)
          ∧ ∀ a ∈ (List.foldl kstep (acc.push v) rest).toList,
              a ∈ acc.toList ∨ a ∈ v :: rest := by
      intro hstrict
      obtain ⟨hp, hm⟩ := ih (acc.push v)
        (by
          rw [hpush, List.pairwise_append]
          exact ⟨hacc, by simp, by
            intro a ha b hb'
            simp only [List.mem_singleton] at hb'
            exact hb' ▸ hstrict a ha⟩)
        (by
          intro a ha x hx
          rw [hpush] at ha
          rcases List.mem_append.mp ha with h | h
          · exact hbound a h x (List.mem_cons_of_mem _ hx)
          · simp only [List.mem_singleton] at h
            exact h ▸ hv_le_rest x hx)
        hrest_sorted
      refine ⟨hp, fun a ha => ?_⟩
      rcases hm a ha with h | h
      · rw [hpush] at h
        rcases List.mem_append.mp h with h' | h'
        · exact Or.inl h'
        · simp only [List.mem_singleton] at h'
          exact Or.inr (h' ▸ List.mem_cons_self ..)
      · exact Or.inr (List.mem_cons_of_mem _ h)
    rcases hb : acc.back? with - | u
    · have hae : acc.toList = [] := by
        rw [back?_eq_getLast?] at hb
        exact List.getLast?_eq_none_iff.mp hb
      have h1 : (kstep acc v) = acc.push v := by unfold kstep; rw [hb]
      rw [h1]
      exact hkey (by rw [hae]; simp)
    · have hu_mem : u ∈ acc.toList := by
        rw [back?_eq_getLast?] at hb
        exact List.mem_of_mem_getLast? hb
      by_cases heq : beqIPlane u v = true
      · have h1 : kstep acc v = acc := by unfold kstep; rw [hb]; simp [heq]
        rw [h1]
        obtain ⟨hp, hm⟩ := ih acc hacc
          (fun a ha x hx => hbound a ha x (List.mem_cons_of_mem _ hx))
          hrest_sorted
        exact ⟨hp, fun a ha => (hm a ha).imp id (List.mem_cons_of_mem _)⟩
      · have h1 : kstep acc v = acc.push v := by unfold kstep; rw [hb]; simp [heq]
        rw [h1]
        have hupv : beqIPlane u v = false := by simpa using heq
        apply hkey
        intro a ha
        have hle : iplaneLe a v = true := hbound a ha v (List.mem_cons_self ..)
        by_cases hau : a = u
        · subst hau; exact iplaneLt_of_le_of_ne hle hupv
        · have hau_lt : iplaneLt a u = true := pairwise_lt_getLast hacc
            (by rw [← back?_eq_getLast?, hb]) ha hau
          exact iplaneLt_of_lt_of_le hau_lt
            (hbound u hu_mem v (List.mem_cons_self ..))

name: kstep_fold_mono
statement:
theorem kstep_fold_mono :
    ∀ (l : List IPlane) (acc : Array IPlane) (a : IPlane), a ∈ acc.toList →
      a ∈ (l.foldl kstep acc).toList
proof:
:= by
  intro l
  induction l with
  | nil => exact fun acc a ha => ha
  | cons v rest ih =>
    intro acc a ha
    rw [List.foldl_cons]
    apply ih
    rcases hb : acc.back? with - | u
    · have h1 : kstep acc v = acc.push v := by unfold kstep; rw [hb]
      rw [h1]; simpa using Or.inl ha
    · by_cases heq : beqIPlane u v = true
      · have h1 : kstep acc v = acc := by unfold kstep; rw [hb]; simp [heq]
        rw [h1]; exact ha
      · have h1 : kstep acc v = acc.push v := by unfold kstep; rw [hb]; simp [heq]
        rw [h1]; simpa using Or.inl ha

name: kstep_fold_complete
statement:
theorem kstep_fold_complete :
    ∀ (l : List IPlane) (acc : Array IPlane) (v : IPlane), v ∈ l →
      ∃ u ∈ (l.foldl kstep acc).toList, beqIPlane u v = true
proof:
:= by
  intro l
  induction l with
  | nil =>
    intro acc v hv
    exact absurd hv (List.not_mem_nil v)
  | cons w rest ih =>
    intro acc v hv
    rw [List.foldl_cons]
    rcases List.mem_cons.mp hv with rfl | hv'
    · rcases hb : acc.back? with - | u
      · have h1 : kstep acc v = acc.push v := by unfold kstep; rw [hb]
        refine ⟨v, ?_, beqIPlane_iff.mpr rfl⟩
        rw [h1]; exact kstep_fold_mono rest _ v (by simp)
      · by_cases heq : beqIPlane u v = true
        · have h1 : kstep acc v = acc := by unfold kstep; rw [hb]; simp [heq]
          have hb' : acc.toList.getLast? = some u := by
            rw [← back?_eq_getLast?]; exact hb
          refine ⟨u, ?_, heq⟩
          rw [h1]; exact kstep_fold_mono rest acc u (List.mem_of_mem_getLast? hb')
        · have h1 : kstep acc v = acc.push v := by unfold kstep; rw [hb]; simp [heq]
          refine ⟨v, ?_, beqIPlane_iff.mpr rfl⟩
          rw [h1]; exact kstep_fold_mono rest _ v (by simp)
    · exact ih (kstep acc w) v hv'

name: preKeys_sorted
statement:
theorem preKeys_sorted (B : Array FaceS) :
    (preKeys B).Pairwise (fun a b => iplaneLe a b = true)
proof:
:=
  List.sorted_mergeSort
    (le := iplaneLe)
    (fun _ _ _ => iplaneLe_trans)
    (fun a b => by rcases iplaneLe_total a b with h | h <;> simp [h]) _

name: mem_preKeys_iff
statement:
theorem mem_preKeys_iff (B : Array FaceS) {g : IPlane} :
    g ∈ preKeys B ↔ ∃ u ∈ B, IPlane.prim u.plane = g
proof:
:= by
  unfold preKeys
  rw [(List.mergeSort_perm _ _).mem_iff, Array.mem_toList, Array.mem_map]

name: primKeys_eq_foldl
statement:
theorem primKeys_eq_foldl (B : Array FaceS) :
    primKeys B = (preKeys B).foldl kstep #[]
proof:
:= by
  rw [primKeys_eq]
  exact List.foldl_toArray kstep #[] (preKeys B)

name: primKeys_toList_eq
statement:
theorem primKeys_toList_eq (B : Array FaceS) :
    (primKeys B).toList = ((preKeys B).foldl kstep #[]).toList
proof:
:= by
  rw [primKeys_eq_foldl]

name: mem_primKeys_iff
statement:
theorem mem_primKeys_iff (B : Array FaceS) {g : IPlane} :
    g ∈ (primKeys B).toList ↔ ∃ u ∈ B, IPlane.prim u.plane = g
proof:
:= by
  rw [primKeys_toList_eq, ← mem_preKeys_iff B]
  constructor
  · intro hg
    have := (kstep_fold_invariant (preKeys B) #[] (by simp) (by simp)
      (preKeys_sorted B)).2 g hg
    rcases this with h | h
    · simp at h
    · exact h
  · intro hmem
    obtain ⟨u, hu, heq⟩ := kstep_fold_complete (preKeys B) #[] g hmem
    have hueq : u = g := beqIPlane_iff.mp heq
    subst hueq
    exact hu

name: primKeys_pairwise_lt
statement:
theorem primKeys_pairwise_lt (B : Array FaceS) :
    (primKeys B).toList.Pairwise (fun a b => iplaneLt a b = true)
proof:
:= by
  rw [primKeys_toList_eq]
  exact (kstep_fold_invariant (preKeys B) #[] (by simp) (by simp)
    (preKeys_sorted B)).1

name: primKeys_mono
statement:
theorem primKeys_mono (B : Array FaceS) :
    ∀ (i j : Nat) (hi : i < (primKeys B).size) (hj : j < (primKeys B).size), i ≤ j →
      iplaneLe ((primKeys B)[i]) ((primKeys B)[j]) = true
proof:
:= by
  intro i j hi hj hij
  rcases Nat.eq_or_lt_of_le hij with rfl | hlt
  · exact iplaneLe_refl _
  · have hpw := primKeys_pairwise_lt B
    have h := List.pairwise_iff_getElem.mp hpw i j (by simpa using hi) (by simpa using hj) hlt
    simp only [Array.getElem_toList] at h
    exact iplaneLe_of_lt h

name: memPrim_go_sound
statement:
theorem memPrim_go_sound (keys : Array IPlane) (k : IPlane) :
    ∀ (fuel lo hi : Nat), hi ≤ keys.size →
      memPrim.go keys k lo hi fuel = true →
      ∃ idx, lo ≤ idx ∧ idx < hi ∧ beqIPlane (keys.getD idx default) k = true
proof:
:= by
  intro fuel
  induction fuel with
  | zero => intro lo hi _ h; simp [memPrim.go] at h
  | succ n ih =>
    intro lo hi hhi h
    rw [memPrim.go] at h
    by_cases hlohi : lo < hi
    · rw [if_pos hlohi] at h
      set mid := (lo + hi) / 2 with hmid
      have hmidlt : mid < hi := by omega
      have hmidge : lo ≤ mid := by omega
      by_cases hbeq : beqIPlane (keys.getD mid default) k = true
      · exact ⟨mid, hmidge, hmidlt, hbeq⟩
      · rw [if_neg hbeq] at h
        by_cases hle : iplaneLe (keys.getD mid default) k = true
        · rw [if_pos hle] at h
          obtain ⟨idx, hidxlo, hidxhi, hidxbeq⟩ := ih (mid + 1) hi hhi h
          exact ⟨idx, by omega, hidxhi, hidxbeq⟩
        · rw [if_neg hle] at h
          obtain ⟨idx, hidxlo, hidxhi, hidxbeq⟩ := ih lo mid (by omega) h
          exact ⟨idx, hidxlo, by omega, hidxbeq⟩
    · rw [if_neg hlohi] at h; exact absurd h (by simp)

name: memPrim_go_complete
statement:
theorem memPrim_go_complete (keys : Array IPlane) (k : IPlane)
    (hsorted : ∀ (i j : Nat) (hi : i < keys.size) (hj : j < keys.size), i ≤ j →
      iplaneLe (keys[i]) (keys[j]) = true) :
    ∀ (fuel lo hi idx : Nat), hi ≤ keys.size → lo ≤ idx → idx < hi →
      hi - lo ≤ fuel →
      beqIPlane (keys.getD idx default) k = true →
      memPrim.go keys k lo hi fuel = true
proof:
:= by
  intro fuel
  induction fuel with
  | zero =>
    intro lo hi idx _ hlo hidxhi hfuel _
    omega
  | succ n ih =>
    intro lo hi idx hhi hlo hidxhi hfuel hbeqidx
    have hlohi : lo < hi := by omega
    rw [memPrim.go, if_pos hlohi]
    set mid := (lo + hi) / 2 with hmid
    have hmidlt : mid < hi := by omega
    have hmidge : lo ≤ mid := by omega
    have hmidsz : mid < keys.size := by omega
    have hidxsz : idx < keys.size := by omega
    have hgetmid : keys.getD mid default = keys[mid] := by
      simp [Array.getD, hmidsz]
    have hgetidx : keys.getD idx default = keys[idx] := by
      simp [Array.getD, hidxsz]
    by_cases hbeq : beqIPlane (keys.getD mid default) k = true
    · rw [if_pos hbeq]
    · rw [if_neg hbeq]
      
      have hidxk : keys[idx] = k := by rw [← hgetidx]; exact beqIPlane_iff.mp hbeqidx
      by_cases hle : iplaneLe (keys.getD mid default) k = true
      · rw [if_pos hle]
        
        have hmidlt_idx : mid < idx := by
          by_contra hc
          push_neg at hc  
          have hmono := hsorted idx mid hidxsz hmidsz hc
          rw [hidxk] at hmono
          
          have hbeq' : beqIPlane (keys[mid]) k = true :=
            iplaneLe_antisymm_beq (by rw [hgetmid] at hle; exact hle) hmono
          rw [hgetmid] at hbeq
          exact hbeq hbeq'
        apply ih (mid + 1) hi idx hhi (by omega) hidxhi (by omega) hbeqidx
      · rw [if_neg hle]
        
        have hkmid : iplaneLe k (keys.getD mid default) = true := by
          rcases iplaneLe_total (keys.getD mid default) k with h | h
          · exact absurd h hle
          · exact h
        
        have hidx_lt_mid : idx < mid := by
          by_contra hc
          push_neg at hc  
          have hmono := hsorted mid idx hmidsz hidxsz hc
          rw [hidxk] at hmono
          
          have hbeq' : beqIPlane (keys[mid]) k = true :=
            iplaneLe_antisymm_beq hmono (by rw [hgetmid] at hkmid; exact hkmid)
          rw [hgetmid] at hbeq
          exact hbeq hbeq'
        apply ih lo mid idx (by omega) hlo hidx_lt_mid (by omega) hbeqidx

name: memPrim_iff
statement:
theorem memPrim_iff (B : Array FaceS) (g : IPlane) :
    memPrim (primKeys B) g = true
      ↔ ∃ idx, idx < (primKeys B).size
          ∧ beqIPlane ((primKeys B).getD idx default) (IPlane.prim g) = true
proof:
:= by
  unfold memPrim
  set keys := primKeys B with hkeys
  set k := IPlane.prim g with hk
  constructor
  · intro h
    obtain ⟨idx, _, hidxhi, hidxbeq⟩ :=
      memPrim_go_sound keys k (keys.size + 1) 0 keys.size (le_refl _) h
    exact ⟨idx, hidxhi, hidxbeq⟩
  · rintro ⟨idx, hidxsz, hidxbeq⟩
    refine memPrim_go_complete keys k ?_ (keys.size + 1) 0 keys.size idx
      (le_refl _) (Nat.zero_le _) hidxsz (by omega) hidxbeq
    rw [hkeys]; exact primKeys_mono B

name: isCoplanarWith_eq_any
statement:
theorem isCoplanarWith_eq_any (f : Frag) (B : Array FaceS) :
    isCoplanarWith f B = B.any (fun u => coplanarPlane f.plane u.plane)
proof:
:= by
  unfold isCoplanarWith
  rw [Bool.eq_iff_iff, memPrim_iff B f.plane, Array.any_eq_true]
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨idx, hidxsz, hidxbeq⟩
    have hget : (primKeys B).getD idx default = (primKeys B)[idx] := by
      simp [Array.getD, hidxsz]
    rw [hget] at hidxbeq
    have hmem : (primKeys B)[idx] ∈ (primKeys B).toList := by
      rw [Array.mem_toList]; exact Array.getElem_mem hidxsz
    have hk : (primKeys B)[idx] = IPlane.prim f.plane := beqIPlane_iff.mp hidxbeq
    rw [hk] at hmem
    obtain ⟨u, hu, hueq⟩ := (mem_primKeys_iff B).mp hmem
    obtain ⟨i, hi, rfl⟩ := Array.getElem_of_mem hu
    refine ⟨⟨i, hi⟩, ?_⟩
    show coplanarPlane f.plane B[i].plane = true
    unfold coplanarPlane
    rw [hueq]
    exact beqIPlane_iff.mpr rfl
  · rintro ⟨i, hcop⟩
    have hcop' : coplanarPlane f.plane B[i].plane = true := hcop
    unfold coplanarPlane at hcop'
    have hueq : IPlane.prim f.plane = IPlane.prim B[i].plane := beqIPlane_iff.mp hcop'
    have hmem : IPlane.prim f.plane ∈ (primKeys B).toList :=
      (mem_primKeys_iff B).mpr ⟨B[i], Array.getElem_mem i.isLt, hueq.symm⟩
    obtain ⟨idx, hidxsz, hgeteq⟩ := Array.getElem_of_mem (Array.mem_toList.mp hmem)
    refine ⟨idx, hidxsz, ?_⟩
    have hget : (primKeys B).getD idx default = (primKeys B)[idx] := by
      simp [Array.getD, hidxsz]
    rw [hget, hgeteq]
    exact beqIPlane_iff.mpr rfl

name: copDescA_toList_eq_nil_of_TrFace
statement:
theorem copDescA_toList_eq_nil_of_TrFace (M₁ M₂ : Mesh) {i : ℕ} (hi : i < M₁.size)
    (htr : Proof.MeshIntersectCop.TrFace M₁ M₂ i hi) :
    (copDescA M₁ M₂ i).toList = []
proof:
:= by
  rw [copDescA_eq]
  
  have hfilt : ((clipFaceScoped (fragOfFace ((materialize M₁).getD i default))
        (planesForScoped ((materialize M₁).getD i default).plane (materialize M₂)
          ((candP M₁ M₂).getD i #[]))).filter
      (fun f => isCoplanarWith f (materialize M₂))).toList = [] := by
    have hgetD : (materialize M₁).getD i default = faceSOf M₁[i] := by
      have hiA : i < (materialize M₁).size := by rw [materialize_size]; exact hi
      rw [Proof.MeshIntersectKeep.arr_getD _ _ _ hiA, materialize_getElem M₁ i hi]
    rw [hgetD, Array.toList_filter]
    refine List.filter_eq_nil_iff.mpr ?_
    intro f hf
    rw [Array.mem_toList] at hf
    rw [Bool.not_eq_true,
      (Proof.MeshIntersectCop.isCoplanarWith_clipFace_iff (MB := M₂) 1 hi hf)]
    exact htr
  rw [Proof.MeshIntersectClipBridge.toList_flatMap_arr, hfilt, List.flatMap_nil]

name: copDescB_toList_eq_nil_of_TrFace
statement:
theorem copDescB_toList_eq_nil_of_TrFace (M₁ M₂ : Mesh) {j : ℕ} (hj : j < M₂.size)
    (htr : Proof.MeshIntersectCop.TrFace M₂ M₁ j hj) :
    (copDescB M₁ M₂ j).toList = []
proof:
:= by
  rw [copDescB_eq]
  have hfilt : ((clipFaceScoped (fragOfFace ((materialize M₂).getD j default))
        (planesForScoped ((materialize M₂).getD j default).plane (materialize M₁)
          ((candP M₂ M₁).getD j #[]))).filter
      (fun f => isCoplanarWith f (materialize M₁))).toList = [] := by
    have hgetD : (materialize M₂).getD j default = faceSOf M₂[j] := by
      have hjA : j < (materialize M₂).size := by rw [materialize_size]; exact hj
      rw [Proof.MeshIntersectKeep.arr_getD _ _ _ hjA, materialize_getElem M₂ j hj]
    rw [hgetD, Array.toList_filter]
    refine List.filter_eq_nil_iff.mpr ?_
    intro f hf
    rw [Array.mem_toList] at hf
    rw [Bool.not_eq_true,
      (Proof.MeshIntersectCop.isCoplanarWith_clipFace_iff (MB := M₁) 2 hj hf)]
    exact htr
  rw [Proof.MeshIntersectClipBridge.toList_flatMap_arr, hfilt, List.flatMap_nil]

name: keptFaceA_indicator_transverse
statement:
theorem keptFaceA_indicator_transverse (M₁ M₂ : Mesh)
    (h₁ : Legacy.WellFormedMesh M₁) (h₂ : Legacy.WellFormedMesh M₂)
    {Q : Point} (hG : Gen M₁ M₂ Q) (i : Fin M₁.size)
    (htr : Proof.MeshIntersectCop.TrFace M₁ M₂ i.1 i.isLt) :
    ((keptFaceA M₁ M₂ i.1).toList.map
        (fun f => if Proof.MeshIntersectStep.faceHit M₁[i] Q
            ∈ Proof.MeshIntersectClip.vpoly (fragCycle f) then (1 : ℤ) else 0)).sum
      = (if Proof.MeshIntersectStep.faceHit M₁[i] Q ∈ triangleSet M₁[i] then 1 else 0)
        * winding (meshChain M₂) (Proof.MeshIntersectStep.faceHit M₁[i] Q)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have hdetA : detOrigin M₁[i] ≠ 0 := h₁.2.2.2 i
  
  have hPeq : Proof.MeshIntersectStep.faceHit M₁[i] Q
      = (detOrigin (M₁[i.1]'i.isLt) / dotQ (carrierNormal (M₁[i.1]'i.isLt)) Q) • Q := by
    simp only [Proof.MeshIntersectStep.faceHit, Proof.MeshIntersectStep.faceParam,
      Fin.getElem_fin]
  set P := Proof.MeshIntersectStep.faceHit M₁[i] Q with hP
  have hgetD : (materialize M₁).getD i.1 default = faceSOf (M₁[i.1]'i.isLt) := by
    have hiA : i.1 < (materialize M₁).size := by rw [materialize_size]; exact i.isLt
    rw [Proof.MeshIntersectKeep.arr_getD _ _ _ hiA, materialize_getElem M₁ i.1 i.isLt]
  
  obtain ⟨-, hav, hE1, -⟩ := hG.2.2.2.1 i htr
  rw [← hPeq] at hav hE1
  
  rw [show keptFaceA M₁ M₂ i.1 = keptNcFaceA M₁ M₂ i.1 ++ copDescA M₁ M₂ i.1 from rfl,
    Array.toList_append, List.map_append, List.sum_append,
    copDescA_toList_eq_nil_of_TrFace M₁ M₂ i.isLt htr]
  simp only [List.map_nil, List.sum_nil, add_zero]
  
  have hfilt : ((clipFaceScoped (fragOfFace ((materialize M₁).getD i.1 default))
        (planesForScoped ((materialize M₁).getD i.1 default).plane (materialize M₂)
          ((candP M₁ M₂).getD i.1 #[]))).filter
        (fun f => !(isCoplanarWith f (materialize M₂)))).toList
      = (clipFaceScoped (fragOfFace (faceSOf (M₁[i.1]'i.isLt)))
          (planesForScoped ((materialize M₁).getD i.1 default).plane (materialize M₂)
            ((candP M₁ M₂).getD i.1 #[]))).toList := by
    rw [hgetD]
    exact Proof.MeshIntersectCop.filter_clipFace_of_TrFace 1 i.isLt htr
  rw [keptNcFaceA,
    Proof.MeshIntersectCop.classify_toList_congr (prepare (materialize M₂)) hfilt]
  
  
  
  
  have hkey := Proof.MeshIntersectPfi.tile_keep_sum_transverse (MA := M₁) (MB := M₂)
    1 i.isLt hdetA h₂ htr (P := P) hav (fun j => hE1 j)
  
  rw [← hgetD]
  exact hkey

name: keptFaceB_indicator_transverse
statement:
theorem keptFaceB_indicator_transverse (M₁ M₂ : Mesh)
    (h₁ : Legacy.WellFormedMesh M₁) (h₂ : Legacy.WellFormedMesh M₂)
    {Q : Point} (hG : Gen M₁ M₂ Q) (j : Fin M₂.size)
    (htr : Proof.MeshIntersectCop.TrFace M₂ M₁ j.1 j.isLt) :
    ((keptFaceB M₁ M₂ j.1).toList.map
        (fun f => if Proof.MeshIntersectStep.faceHit M₂[j] Q
            ∈ Proof.MeshIntersectClip.vpoly (fragCycle f) then (1 : ℤ) else 0)).sum
      = (if Proof.MeshIntersectStep.faceHit M₂[j] Q ∈ triangleSet M₂[j] then 1 else 0)
        * winding (meshChain M₁) (Proof.MeshIntersectStep.faceHit M₂[j] Q)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have hdetB : detOrigin M₂[j] ≠ 0 := h₂.2.2.2 j
  
  have hPeq : Proof.MeshIntersectStep.faceHit M₂[j] Q
      = (detOrigin (M₂[j.1]'j.isLt) / dotQ (carrierNormal (M₂[j.1]'j.isLt)) Q) • Q := by
    simp only [Proof.MeshIntersectStep.faceHit, Proof.MeshIntersectStep.faceParam,
      Fin.getElem_fin]
  set P := Proof.MeshIntersectStep.faceHit M₂[j] Q with hP
  have hgetD : (materialize M₂).getD j.1 default = faceSOf (M₂[j.1]'j.isLt) := by
    have hjB : j.1 < (materialize M₂).size := by rw [materialize_size]; exact j.isLt
    rw [Proof.MeshIntersectKeep.arr_getD _ _ _ hjB, materialize_getElem M₂ j.1 j.isLt]
  
  obtain ⟨-, hav, hE1, -⟩ := hG.2.2.2.2.1 j htr
  rw [← hPeq] at hav hE1
  
  rw [show keptFaceB M₁ M₂ j.1 = keptNcFaceB M₁ M₂ j.1 ++ copDescB M₁ M₂ j.1 from rfl,
    Array.toList_append, List.map_append, List.sum_append,
    copDescB_toList_eq_nil_of_TrFace M₁ M₂ j.isLt htr]
  simp only [List.map_nil, List.sum_nil, add_zero]
  
  have hfilt : ((clipFaceScoped (fragOfFace ((materialize M₂).getD j.1 default))
        (planesForScoped ((materialize M₂).getD j.1 default).plane (materialize M₁)
          ((candP M₂ M₁).getD j.1 #[]))).filter
        (fun f => !(isCoplanarWith f (materialize M₁)))).toList
      = (clipFaceScoped (fragOfFace (faceSOf (M₂[j.1]'j.isLt)))
          (planesForScoped ((materialize M₂).getD j.1 default).plane (materialize M₁)
            ((candP M₂ M₁).getD j.1 #[]))).toList := by
    rw [hgetD]
    exact Proof.MeshIntersectCop.filter_clipFace_of_TrFace 2 j.isLt htr
  rw [keptNcFaceB,
    Proof.MeshIntersectCop.classify_toList_congr (prepare (materialize M₁)) hfilt]
  
  
  
  
  have hkey := Proof.MeshIntersectPfi.tile_keep_sum_transverse (MA := M₂) (MB := M₁)
    2 j.isLt hdetB h₁ htr (P := P) hav (fun i => hE1 i)
  
  rw [← hgetD]
  exact hkey

name: keptCopA_geom
statement:
theorem keptCopA_geom (M₁ M₂ : Mesh) (h₁ : Legacy.WellFormedMesh M₁) (h₂ : Legacy.WellFormedMesh M₂)
    {fa : Frag} (hfaA : fa ∈ (splitCoplanar (fragsAOf M₁ M₂) (materialize M₂)).1)
    {f : Frag}
    (hInvDesc : ∀ {n c : _}, FragInv n c fa → FragInv n c f)
    (hVpDesc : Proof.MeshIntersectClip.vpoly (fragCycle f)
      ⊆ Proof.MeshIntersectClip.vpoly (fragCycle fa))
    (havoid : ∀ fb ∈ (splitCoplanar (fragsBOf M₁ M₂) (materialize M₁)).1,
      coplanarPlane fa.plane fb.plane = true →
        Proof.MeshIntersectClip.vrelint (fragCycle f)
          ∩ Proof.MeshIntersectClip.vrelint (fragCycle fb) = ∅)
    {i' : ℕ} (hi' : i' < M₁.size) (hfapl' : fa.plane = (faceSOf (M₁[i']'hi')).plane) :
    (∀ j : Fin M₂.size,
        Proof.MeshIntersectClip.vrelint (fragCycle f) ∩ triangleSet M₂[j] = ∅) ∧
    (∀ j : Fin M₂.size,
        coplanarPlane (faceSOf M₂[j]).plane (faceSOf (M₁[i']'hi')).plane = true →
        ∀ Q : Point, Q ∈ Proof.MeshIntersectClip.vrelint (fragCycle f) → Q ∉ simplex M₂[j])
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨fun j => ?_, fun j hCj Q hQ => ?_⟩
  · by_cases hc : coplanarPlane (faceSOf M₂[j]).plane fa.plane = true
    · exact Proof.MeshIntersectCop.Aprime_cell_disjoint_coplanar_opponent h₁.2.2.2 h₂.2.2.2
        hfaA hInvDesc havoid j.isLt hc
    · rw [Bool.not_eq_true] at hc
      exact Proof.MeshIntersectCop.Aprime_cell_disjoint_transverse_opponent h₁.2.2.2 h₂.2.2.2
        hfaA hInvDesc hVpDesc j.isLt hc
  · have hcfa : coplanarPlane (faceSOf M₂[j]).plane fa.plane = true := by rw [hfapl']; exact hCj
    have hns := Proof.MeshIntersectCop.Aprime_seg_offSimplex_cop_core h₁ h₂ hfaA hInvDesc havoid
      hQ hQ j.1 j.isLt hcfa 0 (le_refl 0) zero_le_one
    have hseg : Proof.MeshIntersectCancel.seg Q Q 0 = Q := by
      funext c; simp only [Proof.MeshIntersectCancel.seg]; ring
    rw [hseg] at hns; exact hns

name: keptCopB_geom
statement:
theorem keptCopB_geom (M₁ M₂ : Mesh) (h₁ : Legacy.WellFormedMesh M₁) (h₂ : Legacy.WellFormedMesh M₂)
    {fb : Frag} (hfbB : fb ∈ (splitCoplanar (fragsBOf M₁ M₂) (materialize M₁)).1)
    {f : Frag}
    (hInvDesc : ∀ {n c : _}, FragInv n c fb → FragInv n c f)
    (hVpDesc : Proof.MeshIntersectClip.vpoly (fragCycle f)
      ⊆ Proof.MeshIntersectClip.vpoly (fragCycle fb))
    (havoid : ∀ fa ∈ (splitCoplanar (fragsAOf M₁ M₂) (materialize M₂)).1,
      coplanarPlane fb.plane fa.plane = true →
        Proof.MeshIntersectClip.vrelint (fragCycle f)
          ∩ Proof.MeshIntersectClip.vrelint (fragCycle fa) = ∅)
    {j' : ℕ} (hj' : j' < M₂.size) (hfbpl' : fb.plane = (faceSOf (M₂[j']'hj')).plane) :
    (∀ i : Fin M₁.size,
        Proof.MeshIntersectClip.vrelint (fragCycle f) ∩ triangleSet M₁[i] = ∅) ∧
    (∀ i : Fin M₁.size,
        coplanarPlane (faceSOf M₁[i]).plane (faceSOf (M₂[j']'hj')).plane = true →
        ∀ Q : Point, Q ∈ Proof.MeshIntersectClip.vrelint (fragCycle f) → Q ∉ simplex M₁[i])
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨fun i => ?_, fun i hCi Q hQ => ?_⟩
  · by_cases hc : coplanarPlane (faceSOf M₁[i]).plane fb.plane = true
    · exact Proof.MeshIntersectCop.Bprime_cell_disjoint_coplanar_opponent h₁.2.2.2 h₂.2.2.2
        hfbB hInvDesc havoid i.isLt hc
    · rw [Bool.not_eq_true] at hc
      exact Proof.MeshIntersectCop.Bprime_cell_disjoint_transverse_opponent h₁.2.2.2 h₂.2.2.2
        hfbB hInvDesc hVpDesc i.isLt hc
  · have hcfb : coplanarPlane (faceSOf M₁[i]).plane fb.plane = true := by rw [hfbpl']; exact hCi
    have hns := Proof.MeshIntersectCop.Bprime_seg_offSimplex_cop_core h₁ h₂ hfbB hInvDesc havoid
      hQ hQ i.1 i.isLt hcfb 0 (le_refl 0) zero_le_one
    have hseg : Proof.MeshIntersectCancel.seg Q Q 0 = Q := by
      funext c; simp only [Proof.MeshIntersectCancel.seg]; ring
    rw [hseg] at hns; exact hns

name: keep_iff_winding_core
statement:
theorem keep_iff_winding_core {MB : Mesh} {tA : Triangle}
    (hwfB : Legacy.WellFormedMesh MB) (hdetA : detOrigin tA ≠ 0)
    {f : Frag} (hfInv : FragInv (carrierNormal tA) (detOrigin tA) f)
    (hoffT : ∀ j : Fin MB.size,
      Proof.MeshIntersectClip.vrelint (fragCycle f) ∩ triangleSet MB[j] = ∅)
    (hrelintCop : ∀ j : Fin MB.size,
      coplanarPlane (faceSOf MB[j]).plane (faceSOf tA).plane = true →
      ∀ Q : Point, Q ∈ Proof.MeshIntersectClip.vrelint (fragCycle f) → Q ∉ simplex MB[j])
    {p : Point} (hPrel : p ∈ Proof.MeshIntersectClip.vrelint (fragCycle f))
    (hoff : Proof.MeshIntersectRadialTransport.OffBdy MB p) :
    keepFallback (faceBVH (prepare (materialize MB))) (prepare (materialize MB)) f = true
      ↔ winding (meshChain MB) p = 1
proof:
:= by
  classical
  haveI := hfInv.neZero
  have hcarrierNe : carrierNormal tA ≠ 0 := carrierNormal_ne_zero hdetA
  
  obtain ⟨P_cell, -, -, hTrClean, hPmem, hbridge⟩ :=
    Proof.MeshIntersectRayClassifyCopKeep.keepFallback_iff_winding
      (MB := MB) (wOpp := prepare (materialize MB)) (fa := f)
      (r := f.poly.size) (w := fragCycle f)
      (fc := ∑ i, ((f.poly.size : ℚ))⁻¹ • fragCycle f i)
      (n := carrierNormal tA) (c := detOrigin tA)
      (Cop := fun k => coplanarPlane (faceSOf MB[k]).plane (faceSOf tA).plane = true)
      hwfB rfl hfInv.size3 hfInv.onPlane hfInv.strictConv
      (Proof.MeshIntersectRayClassifyF6Supply.fragCentroid_eq_ofPoint_bary f)
      (by have := hfInv.size3; omega)
      (Proof.MeshIntersectRayClassifyF6Supply.fragInv_fragMirrors hfInv) rfl
      (fun u x hx hmem => (Set.eq_empty_iff_forall_not_mem.mp (hoffT u)) x ⟨hx, hmem⟩)
      hrelintCop
      (Proof.MeshIntersectRayClassifyF6Supply.facet_feasible_cop hdetA hwfB.2.2.2
        (Cop := fun k => coplanarPlane (faceSOf MB[k]).plane (faceSOf tA).plane = true)
        (fun j hnc => by simp only [Bool.not_eq_true] at hnc; exact hnc))
      (fun u k => Proof.MeshIntersectRayClassifyF6Supply.exists_edge_moment hwfB.2.2.2 hcarrierNe
        (detOrigin tA) u k)
  
  rw [hbridge, decide_eq_true_eq]
  
  
  clear hbridge
  
  have htrans : winding (meshChain MB) p = winding (meshChain MB) P_cell :=
    Proof.MeshIntersectRadialTransport.fragConst_cop (tA := tA) hdetA hwfB
      (Cop := fun k => coplanarPlane (faceSOf MB[k]).plane (faceSOf tA).plane = true)
      hfInv hoffT hrelintCop hPmem hTrClean hPrel hoff
  rw [← htrans]
