name: copDescA_pairwise_relDisj
statement:
theorem copDescA_pairwise_relDisj (M₁ M₂ : Mesh) (hnpo₁ : NoPlaneThroughOrigin M₁)
    (i : Fin M₁.size) :
    (copDescA M₁ M₂ i.1).toList.Pairwise RelDisj
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have hdet : detOrigin M₁[i] ≠ 0 := hnpo₁ i
  have hbase : FragInv (carrierNormal M₁[i]) (detOrigin M₁[i])
      (fragOfFace ((materialize M₁).getD i.1 default)) := by
    rw [show (materialize M₁).getD i.1 default = faceSOf M₁[i] from by
      rw [getD_eq_getElem (materialize M₁) (by rw [materialize_size]; exact i.isLt) default,
        materialize_getElem M₁ i.1 i.isLt]; rfl]
    exact Proof.MeshIntersectKeep.fragInv_base hdet
  
  rw [copDescA_eq, Proof.MeshIntersectClipBridge.toList_flatMap_arr, List.pairwise_flatMap]
  set base := fragOfFace ((materialize M₁).getD i.1 default) with hbaseDef
  set L := planesForScoped ((materialize M₁).getD i.1 default).plane (materialize M₂)
    ((candP M₁ M₂).getD i.1 #[]) with hLDef
  set copB := (splitCoplanar
      ((Array.range (materialize M₂).size).flatMap (fun j =>
        clipFaceScoped (fragOfFace ((materialize M₂).getD j default))
          (planesForScoped ((materialize M₂).getD j default).plane (materialize M₁)
            ((candP M₂ M₁).getD j #[]))))
      (materialize M₁)).1 with hcopB
  set WB := prepare (materialize M₂) with hWB
  
  have hpieceInv : ∀ fa ∈ ((clipFaceScoped base L).filter
        (fun f => isCoplanarWith f (materialize M₂))).toList,
      FragInv (carrierNormal M₁[i]) (detOrigin M₁[i]) fa := by
    intro fa hfa
    rw [Array.mem_toList, Array.mem_filter] at hfa
    exact fragInv_clipFaceScoped hbase _ hfa.1
  refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
  · 
    intro fa hfa
    exact Proof.MeshIntersectResolve.resolveFrag_kept_pairwise _ copB WB (hpieceInv fa hfa)
  · 
    have hclipPw : ((clipFaceScoped base L).filter
        (fun f => isCoplanarWith f (materialize M₂))).toList.Pairwise RelDisj := by
      rw [Array.toList_filter]
      exact (clipFaceScoped_pairwise hbase L).sublist (List.filter_sublist _)
    refine hclipPw.imp_of_mem ?_
    intro fa fa' hfa hfa' hdisj p hp p' hp'
    have hfaInv := hpieceInv fa hfa
    have hfa'Inv := hpieceInv fa' hfa'
    rw [RelDisj, Set.eq_empty_iff_forall_not_mem]
    rintro x ⟨hxp, hxp'⟩
    rw [RelDisj, Set.eq_empty_iff_forall_not_mem] at hdisj
    refine hdisj x ⟨?_, ?_⟩
    · exact Proof.MeshIntersectNsi.vrelint_descent_of_vpoly_subset hfaInv
        (Proof.MeshIntersectResolve.resolveFrag_kept_fromFa _ copB WB hfaInv (Array.mem_def.mpr hp))
        (Proof.MeshIntersectResolve.resolveFrag_kept_vpoly_subset_fa _ copB WB hfaInv (Array.mem_def.mpr hp)) hxp
    · exact Proof.MeshIntersectNsi.vrelint_descent_of_vpoly_subset hfa'Inv
        (Proof.MeshIntersectResolve.resolveFrag_kept_fromFa _ copB WB hfa'Inv (Array.mem_def.mpr hp'))
        (Proof.MeshIntersectResolve.resolveFrag_kept_vpoly_subset_fa _ copB WB hfa'Inv (Array.mem_def.mpr hp')) hxp'

    refine hclipPw.imp_of_mem ?_
    intro fb fb' hfb hfb' hdisj p hp p' hp'

    have hfb'Inv := hpieceInv fb' hfb'
    rw [RelDisj, Set.eq_empty_iff_forall_not_mem]
    rintro x ⟨hxp, hxp'⟩

    refine hdisj x ⟨?_, ?_⟩
    · exact Proof.MeshIntersectNsi.vrelint_descent_of_vpoly_subset hfbInv
        (Proof.MeshIntersectResolve.resolveFragB_kept_fromFb _ copA WA hfbInv (Array.mem_def.mpr hp))
        (Proof.MeshIntersectResolve.resolveFragB_kept_vpoly_subset_fb _ copA WA hfbInv (Array.mem_def.mpr hp)) hxp
    · exact Proof.MeshIntersectNsi.vrelint_descent_of_vpoly_subset hfb'Inv

name: stepSum_sub_window
statement:
theorem stepSum_sub_window {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι] (S : ι → ℚ × ℤ) {v μ : ℚ} (hvμ : v < μ) :
    Proof.MeshIntersectStep.stepSum S v - Proof.MeshIntersectStep.stepSum S μ
      = ∑ k ∈ Finset.univ.filter (fun k => v ≤ (S k).1 ∧ (S k).1 < μ), (S k).2
proof:
:= by
  classical
  rw [Proof.MeshIntersectStep.stepSum, Proof.MeshIntersectStep.stepSum,
    ← Finset.sum_sub_distrib, Finset.sum_filter]
  refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun k _ => ?_)
  rw [Proof.MeshIntersectStep.stepIndicator, Proof.MeshIntersectStep.stepIndicator]
  by_cases h1 : v ≤ (S k).1
  · by_cases h2 : μ ≤ (S k).1
    · 
      rw [if_pos h1, if_pos h2, if_neg (by push_neg; exact fun _ => h2)]; ring
    · 
      rw [if_pos h1, if_neg h2, if_pos ⟨h1, lt_of_not_le h2⟩]; ring
  · 
    have h2 : ¬ μ ≤ (S k).1 := fun h => h1 (le_trans (le_of_lt hvμ) h)
    rw [if_neg h1, if_neg h2, if_neg (by push_neg; intro hc; exact absurd hc h1)]; ring

name: stepSum_sub_window_eq_sum_jumps
statement:
theorem stepSum_sub_window_eq_sum_jumps {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι] (S : ι → ℚ × ℤ)
    {v μ : ℚ} (hvμ : v < μ) :
    Proof.MeshIntersectStep.stepSum S v - Proof.MeshIntersectStep.stepSum S μ
      = ∑ w ∈ (Finset.univ.filter (fun k => v ≤ (S k).1 ∧ (S k).1 < μ)).image
            (fun k => (S k).1),
          stepJumpAt S w
proof:
:= by
  classical
  rw [stepSum_sub_window S hvμ]
  set s : Finset ι := Finset.univ.filter (fun k => v ≤ (S k).1 ∧ (S k).1 < μ) with hs
  
  rw [← Finset.sum_fiberwise_of_maps_to
        (t := s.image (fun k => (S k).1)) (g := fun k => (S k).1)
        (fun i hi => Finset.mem_image_of_mem _ hi) (fun k => (S k).2)]
  refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun w hw => ?_)
  rw [stepJumpAt]
  
  obtain ⟨k₀, hk₀s, hk₀w⟩ := Finset.mem_image.mp hw
  have hwin : v ≤ w ∧ w < μ := by
    have := (Finset.mem_filter.mp hk₀s).2
    rw [hk₀w] at this; exact this
  apply Finset.sum_congr ?_ (fun _ _ => rfl)
  ext k
  simp only [hs, Finset.mem_filter, Finset.mem_univ, true_and]
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨_, hkw⟩; exact hkw
  · intro hkw; exact ⟨by rw [hkw]; exact hwin, hkw⟩

name: stepSum_sub_window_eq_of_jumps
statement:
theorem stepSum_sub_window_eq_of_jumps {ι₁ ι₂ : Type*} [Fintype ι₁] [Fintype ι₂]
    (A : ι₁ → ℚ × ℤ) (B : ι₂ → ℚ × ℤ) {v μ : ℚ} (hvμ : v < μ)
    (hjump : ∀ w : ℚ, v ≤ w → stepJumpAt A w = stepJumpAt B w) :
    Proof.MeshIntersectStep.stepSum A v - Proof.MeshIntersectStep.stepSum A μ
      = Proof.MeshIntersectStep.stepSum B v - Proof.MeshIntersectStep.stepSum B μ
proof:
:= by
  classical
  rw [stepSum_sub_window_eq_sum_jumps A hvμ, stepSum_sub_window_eq_sum_jumps B hvμ]
  set IA : Finset ℚ :=
    (Finset.univ.filter (fun k => v ≤ (A k).1 ∧ (A k).1 < μ)).image (fun k => (A k).1)
    with hIA
  set IB : Finset ℚ :=
    (Finset.univ.filter (fun k => v ≤ (B k).1 ∧ (B k).1 < μ)).image (fun k => (B k).1)
    with hIB
  
  
  have hboundsB : ∀ w ∈ IB, v ≤ w ∧ w < μ := by
    intro w hw
    obtain ⟨k, hk, hkw⟩ := Finset.mem_image.mp hw
    rw [← hkw]; exact (Finset.mem_filter.mp hk).2
  have hboundsA : ∀ w ∈ IA, v ≤ w ∧ w < μ := by
    intro w hw
    obtain ⟨k, hk, hkw⟩ := Finset.mem_image.mp hw
    rw [← hkw]; exact (Finset.mem_filter.mp hk).2
  
  
  have hAext : ∑ w ∈ IA, stepJumpAt A w = ∑ w ∈ IA ∪ IB, stepJumpAt A w := by
    refine Finset.sum_subset Finset.subset_union_left ?_
    intro w hwU hwIA
    
    have hwB : w ∈ IB := (Finset.mem_union.mp hwU).resolve_left hwIA
    obtain ⟨hvw, hwμ⟩ := hboundsB w hwB
    apply stepJumpAt_eq_zero_of_not_mem
    intro hwimg
    
    obtain ⟨k, _, hkw⟩ := Finset.mem_image.mp hwimg
    refine hwIA ?_
    rw [hIA]
    refine Finset.mem_image.mpr ⟨k, Finset.mem_filter.mpr ⟨Finset.mem_univ k, ?_⟩, hkw⟩
    rw [hkw]; exact ⟨hvw, hwμ⟩
  have hBext : ∑ w ∈ IB, stepJumpAt B w = ∑ w ∈ IA ∪ IB, stepJumpAt B w := by
    refine Finset.sum_subset Finset.subset_union_right ?_
    intro w hwU hwIB
    have hwA : w ∈ IA := (Finset.mem_union.mp hwU).resolve_right hwIB
    obtain ⟨hvw, hwμ⟩ := hboundsA w hwA
    apply stepJumpAt_eq_zero_of_not_mem
    intro hwimg
    obtain ⟨k, _, hkw⟩ := Finset.mem_image.mp hwimg
    refine hwIB ?_
    rw [hIB]
    refine Finset.mem_image.mpr ⟨k, Finset.mem_filter.mpr ⟨Finset.mem_univ k, ?_⟩, hkw⟩
    rw [hkw]; exact ⟨hvw, hwμ⟩
  rw [hAext, hBext]
  refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun w hw => ?_)
  have hvw : v ≤ w := by
    rcases Finset.mem_union.mp hw with h | h
    · exact (hboundsA w h).1
    · exact (hboundsB w h).1
  exact hjump w hvw

theorem indicator_sum_eq_zero_of_hull_off (arr : Array Frag) (p : Point) (S : Set Point)
    (hsub : ∀ f ∈ arr, Proof.MeshIntersectClip.vpoly (fragCycle f) ⊆ S) (hp : p ∉ S) :
    (arr.toList.map (fun f => if p ∈ Proof.MeshIntersectClip.vpoly (fragCycle f)
        then (1 : ℤ) else 0)).sum = 0
proof:
:= by
  refine List.sum_eq_zero (fun x hx => ?_)
  obtain ⟨f, hf, rfl⟩ := List.mem_map.mp hx
  rw [if_neg (fun hin => hp (hsub f (Array.mem_def.mpr hf) hin))]

name: keptFaceA_indicator_off_tri
statement:
theorem keptFaceA_indicator_off_tri (M₁ M₂ : Mesh) (hnpo₁ : NoPlaneThroughOrigin M₁)
    (i : Fin M₁.size) {Q : Point}
    (hoff : Proof.MeshIntersectStep.faceHit M₁[i] Q ∉ triangleSet M₁[i]) :
    ((keptFaceA M₁ M₂ i.1).toList.map
        (fun f => if Proof.MeshIntersectStep.faceHit M₁[i] Q
            ∈ Proof.MeshIntersectClip.vpoly (fragCycle f) then (1 : ℤ) else 0)).sum = 0
proof:
:= by
  
  have hdet : detOrigin M₁[i] ≠ 0 := hnpo₁ i
  have hgetD : (materialize M₁).getD i.1 default = faceSOf (M₁[i.1]'i.isLt) := by
    have hiA : i.1 < (materialize M₁).size := by rw [materialize_size]; exact i.isLt
    rw [Proof.MeshIntersectKeep.arr_getD _ _ _ hiA, materialize_getElem M₁ i.1 i.isLt]
  have hbase : FragInv (carrierNormal M₁[i]) (detOrigin M₁[i])
      (fragOfFace ((materialize M₁).getD i.1 default)) := by
    rw [hgetD]; exact Proof.MeshIntersectKeep.fragInv_base hdet
  have hbaseT : Proof.MeshIntersectClip.vpoly
      (fragCycle (fragOfFace ((materialize M₁).getD i.1 default)))
        ⊆ triangleSet (M₁[i.1]'i.isLt) := by
    rw [hgetD, Proof.MeshIntersectKeep.vpoly_fragOfFace]
  rw [show keptFaceA M₁ M₂ i.1 = keptNcFaceA M₁ M₂ i.1 ++ copDescA M₁ M₂ i.1 from rfl,
    Array.toList_append, List.map_append, List.sum_append,
    indicator_sum_eq_zero_of_hull_off (keptNcFaceA M₁ M₂ i.1) _ (triangleSet M₁[i])
      (fun f hf => (keptNcFaceA_vpoly_subset_base M₁ M₂ i.1 hbase hf).trans hbaseT) hoff,
    indicator_sum_eq_zero_of_hull_off (copDescA M₁ M₂ i.1) _ (triangleSet M₁[i])
      (fun f hf => (copDescA_vpoly_subset_base M₁ M₂ i.1 hbase hf).trans hbaseT) hoff,
    add_zero]

name: keptFaceB_indicator_off_tri
statement:
theorem keptFaceB_indicator_off_tri (M₁ M₂ : Mesh) (hnpo₂ : NoPlaneThroughOrigin M₂)
    (j : Fin M₂.size) {Q : Point}
    (hoff : Proof.MeshIntersectStep.faceHit M₂[j] Q ∉ triangleSet M₂[j]) :
    ((keptFaceB M₁ M₂ j.1).toList.map
        (fun f => if Proof.MeshIntersectStep.faceHit M₂[j] Q
            ∈ Proof.MeshIntersectClip.vpoly (fragCycle f) then (1 : ℤ) else 0)).sum = 0
proof:
:= by
  have hdet : detOrigin M₂[j] ≠ 0 := hnpo₂ j
  have hgetD : (materialize M₂).getD j.1 default = faceSOf (M₂[j.1]'j.isLt) := by
    have hjA : j.1 < (materialize M₂).size := by rw [materialize_size]; exact j.isLt
    rw [Proof.MeshIntersectKeep.arr_getD _ _ _ hjA, materialize_getElem M₂ j.1 j.isLt]
  have hbase : FragInv (carrierNormal M₂[j]) (detOrigin M₂[j])
      (fragOfFace ((materialize M₂).getD j.1 default)) := by
    rw [hgetD]; exact Proof.MeshIntersectKeep.fragInv_base hdet
  have hbaseT : Proof.MeshIntersectClip.vpoly
      (fragCycle (fragOfFace ((materialize M₂).getD j.1 default)))
        ⊆ triangleSet (M₂[j.1]'j.isLt) := by
    rw [hgetD, Proof.MeshIntersectKeep.vpoly_fragOfFace]
  rw [show keptFaceB M₁ M₂ j.1 = keptNcFaceB M₁ M₂ j.1 ++ copDescB M₁ M₂ j.1 from rfl,
    Array.toList_append, List.map_append, List.sum_append,
    indicator_sum_eq_zero_of_hull_off (keptNcFaceB M₁ M₂ j.1) _ (triangleSet M₂[j])
      (fun f hf => (keptNcFaceB_vpoly_subset_base M₁ M₂ j.1 hbase hf).trans hbaseT) hoff,
    indicator_sum_eq_zero_of_hull_off (copDescB M₁ M₂ j.1) _ (triangleSet M₂[j])
      (fun f hf => (copDescB_vpoly_subset_base M₁ M₂ j.1 hbase hf).trans hbaseT) hoff,
    add_zero]

name: winding_const_of_no_jump
statement:
theorem winding_const_of_no_jump (M : Mesh) (hM : NoPlaneThroughOrigin M) {Q : Point}
    (hQ : ∀ k : Fin M.size, dotQ (carrierNormal M[k]) Q ≠ 0) {w : ℚ} (hw0 : 0 < w)
    (hno : ∀ k : Fin M.size, ¬ Proof.MeshIntersectDelta.FaceJumps M[k] Q w) :
    winding (meshChain M) (w • Q) = Proof.MeshIntersectStep.stepLeft (meshSteps M Q) w
    ∧ Proof.MeshIntersectStep.stepLeft (meshSteps M Q) w
        = Proof.MeshIntersectStep.stepRight (meshSteps M Q) w
proof:
:= by
  
  have hsj0 : stepJumpAt (meshSteps M Q) w = 0 := by
    rw [stepJumpAt, Finset.sum_filter]
    refine Finset.sum_eq_zero (fun k _ => ?_)
    by_cases hpar : (meshSteps M Q k).1 = w
    · rw [if_pos hpar]
      show faceJump M[k] Q = 0
      rw [show faceJump M[k] Q = orientSign M[k]
          * (if Proof.MeshIntersectStep.faceHit M[k] Q ∈ triangleSet M[k] then (1:ℤ) else 0)
          from rfl]
      by_cases hhit : Proof.MeshIntersectStep.faceHit M[k] Q ∈ triangleSet M[k]
      · exfalso
        apply hno k
        refine ⟨hpar, ?_, hhit⟩
        show 0 < Proof.MeshIntersectDelta.muF M[k] Q
        rw [show Proof.MeshIntersectDelta.muF M[k] Q
          = Proof.MeshIntersectStep.faceParam M[k] Q from rfl,
          show Proof.MeshIntersectStep.faceParam M[k] Q = (meshSteps M Q k).1 from rfl, hpar]
        exact hw0
      · rw [if_neg hhit]; ring
    · rw [if_neg hpar]
  refine ⟨(stepLeft_meshSteps_eq_winding M hM hQ hw0).symm, ?_⟩
  
  have hsj := stepJumpAt_eq_left_sub_right (meshSteps M Q) w
  rw [hsj0] at hsj
  linarith [hsj]

name: winding_in_01_of_radial_gap
statement:
theorem winding_in_01_of_radial_gap (M : Mesh) (hnpo : NoPlaneThroughOrigin M)
    (hnorm : Legacy.Normal (meshChain M)) {Q : Point}
    (hQ : ∀ k : Fin M.size, dotQ (carrierNormal M[k]) Q ≠ 0)
    (he : ∀ m : Fin (nbData M).1, dotQ ((nbData M).2.1 m) Q ≠ 0)
    {v : ℚ} (hv : 0 < v)
    (hno : ∀ k : Fin M.size, ¬ Proof.MeshIntersectDelta.FaceJumps M[k] Q v) :
    winding (meshChain M) (v • Q) = 0 ∨ winding (meshChain M) (v • Q) = 1
proof:
:= by
  
  obtain ⟨hwL, hLR⟩ := winding_const_of_no_jump M hnpo hQ hv hno
  
  obtain ⟨μg, hvμg, hgapg⟩ := gap_above_exists (meshSteps M Q) v
  
  obtain ⟨μp, hvμp, hμpμg, hμpoff⟩ :=
    gap_point_off_negligible ((nbData M).2.1) ((nbData M).2.2) Q he hvμg
  
  have hgapp : ∀ k, v < (meshSteps M Q k).1 → μp ≤ (meshSteps M Q k).1 :=
    fun k hk => le_trans (le_of_lt hμpμg) (hgapg k hk)
  
  have hR : Proof.MeshIntersectStep.stepRight (meshSteps M Q) v
      = winding (meshChain M) (μp • Q) :=
    stepRight_meshSteps_eq_winding M hnpo hQ hv hvμp hgapp
  
  have hcov := nbData_covers hnorm (X := μp • Q) hμpoff
  
  rw [hwL, hLR, hR]
  exact hcov

name: copB_hull_off_of_no_jump
statement:
theorem copB_hull_off_of_no_jump (M₁ M₂ : Mesh) (h₂ : Legacy.WellFormedMesh M₂)
    {Q : Point} (hQ2 : ∀ j : Fin M₂.size, dotQ (carrierNormal M₂[j]) Q ≠ 0)
    {v : ℚ} (hpos : 0 < v)
    (hno2 : ∀ j : Fin M₂.size, ¬ Proof.MeshIntersectDelta.FaceJumps M₂[j] Q v)
    {fb : Frag}
    (hfb : fb ∈ (splitCoplanar (Proof.MeshIntersectNsi.fragsBOf M₁ M₂) (materialize M₁)).1) :
    v • Q ∉ Proof.MeshIntersectClip.vpoly (fragCycle fb)
proof:
:= by
  intro hmem
  obtain ⟨j, hj, hfbInv, hdj, hfbpl, hfbclip⟩ := Proof.MeshIntersectNsi.copB_carrier h₂.2.2.2 hfb
  
  have hjMz : j < (materialize M₂).size := by rw [materialize_size]; exact hj
  have hgetD : (materialize M₂).getD j default = faceSOf (M₂[j]'hj) := by
    rw [Proof.MeshIntersectKeep.arr_getD _ _ _ hjMz, materialize_getElem M₂ j hj]
  have hbase : FragInv (carrierNormal (M₂[j]'hj)) (detOrigin (M₂[j]'hj))
      (fragOfFace ((materialize M₂).getD j default)) := by
    rw [hgetD]; exact Proof.MeshIntersectKeep.fragInv_base hdj
  have hsub : Proof.MeshIntersectClip.vpoly (fragCycle fb) ⊆ triangleSet (M₂[j]'hj) := by
    refine (Proof.MeshIntersectClipBridge.clipFaceScoped_vpoly_subset hbase _ hfbclip).trans ?_
    rw [hgetD, Proof.MeshIntersectKeep.vpoly_fragOfFace]
  have hPt : v • Q ∈ triangleSet (M₂[j]'hj) := hsub hmem
  
  have hQj : dotQ (carrierNormal (M₂[j]'hj)) Q ≠ 0 := hQ2 ⟨j, hj⟩
  have hlevel : dotQ (carrierNormal (M₂[j]'hj)) (v • Q) = detOrigin (M₂[j]'hj) :=
    Proof.MeshIntersectRay.triangleSet_subset_level
      (Proof.MeshIntersectRay.dotQ_carrierNormal_v₀ _)
      (Proof.MeshIntersectRay.dotQ_carrierNormal_v₁ _)
      (Proof.MeshIntersectRay.dotQ_carrierNormal_v₂ _) (v • Q) hPt
  have hmu : Proof.MeshIntersectDelta.muF (M₂[j]'hj) Q = v := by
    rw [Proof.MeshIntersectDelta.muF]
    rw [Proof.MeshIntersectRay.dotQ_smul_right] at hlevel
    field_simp at hlevel ⊢
    linarith [hlevel]
  
  apply hno2 ⟨j, hj⟩
  refine ⟨hmu, by rw [Fin.getElem_fin, hmu]; exact hpos, ?_⟩
  show Proof.MeshIntersectDelta.hitF (M₂[j]'hj) Q ∈ triangleSet (M₂[j]'hj)
  rw [Proof.MeshIntersectDelta.hitF, hmu]; exact hPt

name: finrank_point
statement: theorem finrank_point : Module.finrank ℚ Point = 3
proof:
:= by
  simp [Point, Module.finrank_pi]

name: mem_activeSet
statement:
theorem mem_activeSet {G : Fin m → Half} {s : Fin m → ℚ} {x : Point} {j : Fin m} :
    j ∈ activeSet G s x ↔ s j * gOf (G j) x = 0
proof:
:= by
  simp [activeSet]

name: active_iff_dotQ
proof:
:= by
  have hsj0 : s j ≠ 0 := by rcases hsj with h | h <;> simp [h]
  rw [mul_eq_zero]
  constructor
  · rintro (h | h)
    · exact absurd h hsj0
    · 
      have : (G j).eval x = 0 := by simpa [gOf_apply] using h
      have : dotQ (G j).n x - (G j).c = 0 := by simpa [Half.eval] using this
      linarith
  · intro h
    right
    have : (G j).eval x = 0 := by simp [Half.eval, h]
    simpa [gOf_apply] using this

name: mem_Wperp_iff
statement:
theorem mem_Wperp_iff {G : Fin m → Half} {s : Fin m → ℚ} {x : Point} {v : Point} :
    v ∈ Wperp G s x ↔ ∀ j ∈ activeSet G s x, dotQ (G j).n v = 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [Wperp, Submodule.mem_iInf]
  constructor
  · intro h j hj
    have := (Submodule.mem_iInf _).mp (h j) hj
    rw [LinearMap.mem_ker] at this
    rw [dotQ_eq_sum]
    simpa [linOf_apply] using this
  · intro h j
    rw [Submodule.mem_iInf]
    intro hj
    rw [LinearMap.mem_ker, linOf_apply]
    have := h j hj
    rw [dotQ_eq_sum] at this
    simpa using this

name: affine_line_eval
statement:
theorem affine_line_eval (g : Point →ᵃ[ℚ] ℚ) (p v : Point) (r : ℚ) :
    g (fun i => p i + r * v i) = g p + r * (g.linear v)
proof:
:= by
  have hpt : (fun i => p i + r * v i) = r • v +ᵥ p := by
    funext i; simp [vadd_eq_add]; ring
  rw [hpt, AffineMap.map_vadd]; simp [map_smul, add_comm]

name: slope_zero_on_active
proof:
:= by
  rw [affine_line_eval]
  have hslope : (gOf (G j)).linear v = 0 := by
    rw [gOf_linear, linOf_apply]
    have := (mem_Wperp_iff.mp hv) j hj
    rw [dotQ_eq_sum] at this
    simpa using this
  rw [hslope, mul_zero, add_zero]

name: muMap_apply
statement:
@[simp] theorem muMap_apply (G : Fin m → Half) (s : Fin m → ℚ) (x : Point)
    (v : Point) (j : ActiveIdx G s x) : muMap G s x v j = linOf (G j.val).n v
proof: := rfl

name: ker_muMap
statement:
theorem ker_muMap (G : Fin m → Half) (s : Fin m → ℚ) (x : Point) :
    LinearMap.ker (muMap G s x) = Wperp G s x
proof:
:= by
  ext v
  rw [LinearMap.mem_ker, mem_Wperp_iff]
  constructor
  · intro h j hj
    have : muMap G s x v ⟨j, hj⟩ = 0 := by rw [h]; rfl
    rw [muMap_apply, linOf_apply] at this
    rw [dotQ_eq_sum]; simpa using this
  · intro h
    funext j
    rw [muMap_apply, linOf_apply]
    have := h j.val j.property
    rw [dotQ_eq_sum] at this
    simpa using this

name: muMap_eq_mulVecLin
statement:
theorem muMap_eq_mulVecLin (G : Fin m → Half) (s : Fin m → ℚ) (x : Point) :
    muMap G s x = (activeMatrix G s x).mulVecLin
proof:
:= by
  apply LinearMap.ext
  intro v
  funext j
  rw [muMap_apply, Matrix.mulVecLin_apply, linOf_apply]
  simp only [Matrix.mulVec, dotProduct, activeMatrix]

name: Wspan_eq_span_range
statement:
theorem Wspan_eq_span_range (G : Fin m → Half) (s : Fin m → ℚ) (x : Point) :
    Wspan G s x = Submodule.span ℚ (Set.range (activeMatrix G s x))
proof:
:= by
  rw [Wspan]
  congr 1
  
  ext p
  simp only [Set.mem_image, Finset.mem_coe, Set.mem_range]
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨j, hj, rfl⟩
    exact ⟨⟨j, hj⟩, rfl⟩
  · rintro ⟨j, rfl⟩
    exact ⟨j.val, j.property, rfl⟩

name: Wperp_finrank_ge
statement:
theorem Wperp_finrank_ge (G : Fin m → Half) (s : Fin m → ℚ) (x : Point) :
    Module.finrank ℚ (Wspan G s x) + Module.finrank ℚ (Wperp G s x) = 3
proof:
:= by
  
  have hrn := LinearMap.finrank_range_add_finrank_ker (muMap G s x)
  
  have hrange : Module.finrank ℚ (LinearMap.range (muMap G s x))
      = (activeMatrix G s x).rank := by
    rw [Matrix.rank, muMap_eq_mulVecLin]
  
  have hwspan : Module.finrank ℚ (Wspan G s x) = (activeMatrix G s x).rank := by
    rw [Wspan_eq_span_range, ← Matrix.rank_eq_finrank_span_row]
  
  have hker : Module.finrank ℚ (LinearMap.ker (muMap G s x))
      = Module.finrank ℚ (Wperp G s x) := by rw [ker_muMap]
  rw [hrange] at hrn
  rw [hker] at hrn
  rw [hwspan]
  rw [hrn]
  exact finrank_point

name: Wperp_ne_bot_of_lt
statement:
theorem Wperp_ne_bot_of_lt {G : Fin m → Half} {s : Fin m → ℚ} {x : Point}
    (h : Module.finrank ℚ (Wspan G s x) ≤ 2) : Wperp G s x ≠ ⊥
proof:
:= by
  have hsum := Wperp_finrank_ge G s x
  have hpos : 0 < Module.finrank ℚ (Wperp G s x) := by omega
  rw [Module.finrank_pos_iff_exists_ne_zero] at hpos
  rw [Submodule.ne_bot_iff]
  obtain ⟨v, hv⟩ := hpos
  exact ⟨v.val, v.property, by simpa using fun h => hv (Subtype.ext h)⟩

name: exists_decreasing_inactive
statement:
theorem exists_decreasing_inactive {G : Fin m → Half} {s : Fin m → ℚ} {x : Point}
    (hrec : ∀ v : Point, (∀ j, 0 ≤ s j * (gOf (G j)).linear v) → v = 0)
    (_hx : x ∈ Pset G s) {v : Point} (hv0 : v ≠ 0) :
    ∃ j, s j * (gOf (G j)).linear v < 0
proof:
:= by
  by_contra h
  push_neg at h
  exact hv0 (hrec v h)

name: exists_decreasing_inactive_signed
statement:
theorem exists_decreasing_inactive_signed {G : Fin m → Half} {s : Fin m → ℚ} {x : Point}
    (hrec : ∀ v : Point, (∀ j, 0 ≤ s j * (gOf (G j)).linear v) → v = 0)
    (hx : x ∈ Pset G s) {v : Point} (hv0 : v ≠ 0) :
    (∃ j, s j * (gOf (G j)).linear v < 0) ∨
    (∃ j, s j * (gOf (G j)).linear (-v) < 0)
proof:
:=
  Or.inl (exists_decreasing_inactive hrec hx hv0)

name: normal_mem_Wspan
statement:
theorem normal_mem_Wspan {G : Fin m → Half} {s : Fin m → ℚ} {x : Point} {j : Fin m}
    (hj : j ∈ activeSet G s x) : (G j).n ∈ Wspan G s x
proof:
:= by
  apply Submodule.subset_span
  exact ⟨j, hj, rfl⟩

name: Wspan_mono
statement:
theorem Wspan_mono {G : Fin m → Half} {s : Fin m → ℚ} {x x' : Point}
    (h : activeSet G s x ⊆ activeSet G s x') : Wspan G s x ≤ Wspan G s x'
proof:
:= by
  apply Submodule.span_mono
  apply Set.image_subset
  exact_mod_cast h

name: Wspan_lt_of_new_active
proof:
:= by
  have hle : Wspan G s x ≤ Wspan G s x' := Wspan_mono hsub
  have hlt : Wspan G s x < Wspan G s x' := by
    rw [SetLike.lt_iff_le_and_exists]
    refine ⟨hle, (G jstar).n, ?_, hnotin⟩
    exact normal_mem_Wspan hjstar
  exact Submodule.finrank_lt_finrank_of_lt hlt

name: decreasing_not_active
proof:
:= by
  intro hj
  have hslope : (gOf (G j)).linear v = 0 := by
    rw [gOf_linear, linOf_apply]
    have := (mem_Wperp_iff.mp hvW) j hj
    rw [dotQ_eq_sum] at this
    simpa using this
  rw [hslope, mul_zero] at hdec
  exact lt_irrefl 0 hdec

name: stepA'_increment
statement:
theorem stepA'_increment {G : Fin m → Half} {s : Fin m → ℚ} {x : Point}
    (_hn : ∀ j, (G j).n ≠ 0) (_hs : ∀ j, s j = 1 ∨ s j = -1)
    (_hrec : ∀ v : Point, (∀ j, 0 ≤ s j * (gOf (G j)).linear v) → v = 0)
    (hx : x ∈ Pset G s) {v : Point} (_hv0 : v ≠ 0) (hvW : v ∈ Wperp G s x)
    (hdec : ∃ j, s j * (gOf (G j)).linear v < 0) :
    ∃ (r : ℚ) (jstar : Fin m), 0 < r ∧
      (fun i => x i + r * v i) ∈ Pset G s ∧
      s jstar * gOf (G jstar) (fun i => x i + r * v i) = 0 ∧
      jstar ∉ activeSet G s x ∧
      activeSet G s x ⊆ activeSet G s (fun i => x i + r * v i) ∧
      jstar ∈ activeSet G s (fun i => x i + r * v i) ∧
      (G jstar).n ∉ Wspan G s x
proof:
:= by
  classical
  
  set Dec : Finset (Fin m) :=
    Finset.univ.filter (fun j => s j * (gOf (G j)).linear v < 0) with hDecdef
  have hmemDec : ∀ j, j ∈ Dec ↔ s j * (gOf (G j)).linear v < 0 := by
    intro j; rw [hDecdef]; simp
  
  have hne : Dec.Nonempty := by
    obtain ⟨j, hj⟩ := hdec
    exact ⟨j, (hmemDec j).mpr hj⟩
  
  have hpos : ∀ j ∈ Dec, 0 < s j * gOf (G j) x := by
    intro j hj
    have hjdec : s j * (gOf (G j)).linear v < 0 := (hmemDec j).mp hj
    have hjinact : j ∉ activeSet G s x := decreasing_not_active hvW hjdec
    have hge : 0 ≤ s j * gOf (G j) x := hx j
    rcases lt_or_eq_of_le hge with hlt | heq
    · exact hlt
    · exact absurd (mem_activeSet.mpr heq.symm) hjinact
  
  set step : Fin m → ℚ := fun j => (s j * gOf (G j) x) / (-(s j * (gOf (G j)).linear v))
    with hstepdef
  have hsteppos : ∀ j ∈ Dec, 0 < step j := by
    intro j hj
    rw [hstepdef]
    apply div_pos (hpos j hj)
    have := (hmemDec j).mp hj
    linarith
  
  obtain ⟨jstar, hjstarDec, hjstarmin⟩ := Finset.exists_min_image Dec step hne
  set r : ℚ := step jstar with hrdef
  have hrpos : 0 < r := hsteppos jstar hjstarDec
  
  have hjstarzero : s jstar * gOf (G jstar) (fun i => x i + r * v i) = 0 := by
    have heval : gOf (G jstar) (fun i => x i + r * v i)
        = gOf (G jstar) x + r * (gOf (G jstar)).linear v := affine_line_eval _ _ _ _
    have hvaleq : s jstar * gOf (G jstar) (fun i => x i + r * v i)
        = s jstar * gOf (G jstar) x + r * (s jstar * (gOf (G jstar)).linear v) := by
      rw [heval]; ring
    rw [hvaleq]
    have hjstarslope : s jstar * (gOf (G jstar)).linear v < 0 := (hmemDec jstar).mp hjstarDec
    have hBpos : 0 < -(s jstar * (gOf (G jstar)).linear v) := by linarith
    
    have hrval : r = (s jstar * gOf (G jstar) x) / (-(s jstar * (gOf (G jstar)).linear v)) := by
      rw [hrdef, hstepdef]
    have hBne : -(s jstar * (gOf (G jstar)).linear v) ≠ 0 := ne_of_gt hBpos
    have hrB : r * (-(s jstar * (gOf (G jstar)).linear v)) = s jstar * gOf (G jstar) x := by
      rw [hrval, div_mul_cancel₀ _ hBne]
    nlinarith [hrB]
  refine ⟨r, jstar, hrpos, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · 
    intro j
    have heval : gOf (G j) (fun i => x i + r * v i)
        = gOf (G j) x + r * (gOf (G j)).linear v := affine_line_eval _ _ _ _
    
    have hvaleq : s j * gOf (G j) (fun i => x i + r * v i)
        = s j * gOf (G j) x + r * (s j * (gOf (G j)).linear v) := by
      rw [heval]; ring
    have hge : 0 ≤ s j * gOf (G j) x := hx j
    rw [hvaleq]
    by_cases hjslope : s j * (gOf (G j)).linear v < 0
    · 
      have hjmemDec : j ∈ Dec := (hmemDec j).mpr hjslope
      have hrle : r ≤ step j := hjstarmin j hjmemDec
      
      have hBpos : 0 < -(s j * (gOf (G j)).linear v) := by linarith
      have hstepj : step j = (s j * gOf (G j) x) / (-(s j * (gOf (G j)).linear v)) := by
        rw [hstepdef]
      rw [hstepj] at hrle
      have hrB : r * (-(s j * (gOf (G j)).linear v)) ≤ s j * gOf (G j) x := by
        rw [← le_div_iff₀ hBpos]; exact hrle
      nlinarith [hrB]
    · 
      push_neg at hjslope
      have : 0 ≤ r * (s j * (gOf (G j)).linear v) :=
        mul_nonneg (le_of_lt hrpos) hjslope
      linarith
  · 
    exact hjstarzero
  · 
    exact decreasing_not_active hvW ((hmemDec jstar).mp hjstarDec)
  · 
    intro j hj
    rw [mem_activeSet]
    have hfrozen : gOf (G j) (fun i => x i + r * v i) = gOf (G j) x :=
      slope_zero_on_active hvW hj r
    rw [hfrozen]
    exact mem_activeSet.mp hj
  · 
    rw [mem_activeSet]
    exact hjstarzero
  · 
    intro hin
    
    have hann : ∀ p ∈ Wspan G s x, linOfMap p v = 0 := by
      intro p hp
      refine Submodule.span_induction ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_ hp
      · rintro q ⟨j, hj, rfl⟩
        have := (mem_Wperp_iff.mp hvW) j hj
        rw [dotQ_eq_sum] at this
        rw [linOfMap_apply, linOf_apply]; simpa using this
      · simp
      · intro a b _ _ ha hb
        rw [map_add]; simp only [LinearMap.add_apply]; rw [ha, hb, add_zero]
      · intro c a _ ha
        rw [map_smul]; simp only [LinearMap.smul_apply]; rw [ha, smul_zero]
    have hzero : linOf (G jstar).n v = 0 := by
      have := hann _ hin; rwa [linOfMap_apply] at this
    have hjstarslope : s jstar * (gOf (G jstar)).linear v < 0 := (hmemDec jstar).mp hjstarDec
    rw [gOf_linear, hzero, mul_zero] at hjstarslope
    exact lt_irrefl 0 hjstarslope

name: Wspan_finrank_le
statement:
theorem Wspan_finrank_le (G : Fin m → Half) (s : Fin m → ℚ) (x : Point) :
    Module.finrank ℚ (Wspan G s x) ≤ 3
proof:
:= by
  have := Submodule.finrank_le (Wspan G s x)
  rwa [finrank_point] at this

name: stepA_to_rank3
statement:
theorem stepA_to_rank3 {G : Fin m → Half} {s : Fin m → ℚ}
    (hn : ∀ j, (G j).n ≠ 0) (hs : ∀ j, s j = 1 ∨ s j = -1)
    (hrec : ∀ v : Point, (∀ j, 0 ≤ s j * (gOf (G j)).linear v) → v = 0)
    {x₀ : Point} (hx : x₀ ∈ Pset G s) :
    ∃ x ∈ Pset G s, Module.finrank ℚ (Wspan G s x) = 3 ∧
      activeSet G s x₀ ⊆ activeSet G s x
proof:
:= by
  classical
  
  suffices H : ∀ n : ℕ, ∀ x : Point, x ∈ Pset G s →
      3 - Module.finrank ℚ (Wspan G s x) = n →
      ∃ y ∈ Pset G s, Module.finrank ℚ (Wspan G s y) = 3 ∧
        activeSet G s x ⊆ activeSet G s y by
    obtain ⟨y, hy, hyr, hsub⟩ := H _ x₀ hx rfl
    exact ⟨y, hy, hyr, hsub⟩
  intro n
  induction n using Nat.strong_induction_on with
  | _ n ih =>
    intro x hxP hμ
    by_cases hrank3 : Module.finrank ℚ (Wspan G s x) = 3
    · exact ⟨x, hxP, hrank3, Finset.Subset.refl _⟩
    · 
      have hle3 : Module.finrank ℚ (Wspan G s x) ≤ 3 := Wspan_finrank_le G s x
      have hle2 : Module.finrank ℚ (Wspan G s x) ≤ 2 := by omega
      have hperp : Wperp G s x ≠ ⊥ := Wperp_ne_bot_of_lt hle2
      obtain ⟨v, hvmem, hv0⟩ := Submodule.exists_mem_ne_zero_of_ne_bot hperp
      
      rcases exists_decreasing_inactive_signed hrec hxP hv0 with hdec | hdec
      · 
        obtain ⟨r, jstar, hrpos, hx'P, _hval, _hjnew, hsub, hjstarnew, hjnotin⟩ :=
          stepA'_increment hn hs hrec hxP hv0 hvmem hdec
        set x' : Point := (fun i => x i + r * v i) with hx'def
        have hgrow : Module.finrank ℚ (Wspan G s x) < Module.finrank ℚ (Wspan G s x') :=
          Wspan_lt_of_new_active hsub hjstarnew hjnotin
        have hμ' : 3 - Module.finrank ℚ (Wspan G s x') < n := by
          have := Wspan_finrank_le G s x'
          omega
        obtain ⟨y, hy, hyr, hysub⟩ := ih _ hμ' x' hx'P rfl
        exact ⟨y, hy, hyr, Finset.Subset.trans hsub hysub⟩
      · 
        have hnvmem : (-v) ∈ Wperp G s x := Submodule.neg_mem _ hvmem
        have hnv0 : (-v) ≠ 0 := by simpa using hv0
        obtain ⟨r, jstar, hrpos, hx'P, _hval, _hjnew, hsub, hjstarnew, hjnotin⟩ :=
          stepA'_increment hn hs hrec hxP hnv0 hnvmem hdec
        set x' : Point := (fun i => x i + r * (-v) i) with hx'def
        have hgrow : Module.finrank ℚ (Wspan G s x) < Module.finrank ℚ (Wspan G s x') :=
          Wspan_lt_of_new_active hsub hjstarnew hjnotin
        have hμ' : 3 - Module.finrank ℚ (Wspan G s x') < n := by
          have := Wspan_finrank_le G s x'
          omega
        obtain ⟨y, hy, hyr, hysub⟩ := ih _ hμ' x' hx'P rfl
        exact ⟨y, hy, hyr, Finset.Subset.trans hsub hysub⟩

name: exists_three_indep_active
statement:
theorem exists_three_indep_active {G : Fin m → Half} {s : Fin m → ℚ} {x : Point}
    (hrank : Module.finrank ℚ (Wspan G s x) = 3) :
    ∃ j₁ j₂ j₃ : Fin m,
      j₁ ∈ activeSet G s x ∧ j₂ ∈ activeSet G s x ∧ j₃ ∈ activeSet G s x ∧
      LinearIndependent ℚ ![(G j₁).n, (G j₂).n, (G j₃).n]
proof:
:= by
  classical
  
  have htop : Wspan G s x = ⊤ := by
    apply Submodule.eq_top_of_finrank_eq
    rw [hrank, finrank_point]
  
  set t : Set Point := (fun j => (G j).n) '' ↑(activeSet G s x) with htdef
  have hspant : Submodule.span ℚ t = ⊤ := by rw [← Wspan, htop]
  
  have htfin : t.Finite := Set.Finite.image _ (Finset.finite_toSet _)
  
  obtain ⟨b, hbsub, hbspan, hbli⟩ := exists_linearIndependent ℚ t
  have hbspantop : Submodule.span ℚ b = ⊤ := by rw [hbspan, hspant]
  have hbfin : b.Finite := htfin.subset hbsub
  haveI : Fintype b := hbfin.fintype
  
  have hcard : b.toFinset.card = 3 := by
    have := finrank_span_set_eq_card (R := ℚ) (s := b) hbli
    rw [hbspantop, finrank_top, finrank_point] at this
    exact this.symm
  
  rw [Finset.card_eq_three] at hcard
  obtain ⟨p₁, p₂, p₃, h12, h13, h23, hbeq⟩ := hcard
  have hp1mem : p₁ ∈ b := by
    have : p₁ ∈ b.toFinset := by rw [hbeq]; simp
    simpa using this
  have hp2mem : p₂ ∈ b := by
    have : p₂ ∈ b.toFinset := by rw [hbeq]; simp
    simpa using this
  have hp3mem : p₃ ∈ b := by
    have : p₃ ∈ b.toFinset := by rw [hbeq]; simp
    simpa using this
  
  obtain ⟨j₁, hj1act, hj1n⟩ := hbsub hp1mem
  obtain ⟨j₂, hj2act, hj2n⟩ := hbsub hp2mem
  obtain ⟨j₃, hj3act, hj3n⟩ := hbsub hp3mem
  simp only [] at hj1n hj2n hj3n
  
  refine ⟨j₁, j₂, j₃, hj1act, hj2act, hj3act, ?_⟩
  rw [hj1n, hj2n, hj3n]
  
  set f : Fin 3 → b := ![⟨p₁, hp1mem⟩, ⟨p₂, hp2mem⟩, ⟨p₃, hp3mem⟩] with hfdef
  have hvalf : ((↑) : b → Point) ∘ f = ![p₁, p₂, p₃] := by
    funext i; fin_cases i <;> rfl
  
  have hpinj : Function.Injective (![p₁, p₂, p₃] : Fin 3 → Point) := by
    intro a c hac
    fin_cases a <;> fin_cases c <;>
      simp only [Matrix.cons_val_zero, Matrix.cons_val_one, Matrix.head_cons,
        Matrix.cons_val_two, Matrix.tail_cons] at hac ⊢ <;>
      first
        | rfl
        | exact absurd hac h12 | exact absurd hac.symm h12
        | exact absurd hac h13 | exact absurd hac.symm h13
        | exact absurd hac h23 | exact absurd hac.symm h23
  
  have hfinj : Function.Injective f := by
    intro a c hac
    apply hpinj
    have : (((↑) : b → Point) ∘ f) a = (((↑) : b → Point) ∘ f) c := by
      simp only [Function.comp_apply, hac]
    rwa [hvalf] at this
  have hcomp := hbli.comp f hfinj
  rw [hvalf] at hcomp
  exact hcomp

name: three_active_in_arrVerts
statement:
theorem three_active_in_arrVerts {G : Array Half} {u v w : Nat}
    (hu : u < G.size) (hv : v < G.size) (hw : w < G.size)
    (huv : u ≠ v) (huw : u ≠ w) (hvw : v ≠ w)
    (hdet : det3 G[u].n G[v].n G[w].n ≠ 0)
    {p : Point} (hpu : dotQ G[u].n p = G[u].c) (hpv : dotQ G[v].n p = G[v].c)
    (hpw : dotQ G[w].n p = G[w].c) :
    p ∈ arrVerts G
proof:
:= by
  have key : ∀ a b c : Nat, (ha : a < G.size) → (hb : b < G.size) → (hc : c < G.size) →
      a < b → b < c →
      det3 (G[a]'ha).n (G[b]'hb).n (G[c]'hc).n ≠ 0 →
      dotQ (G[a]'ha).n p = (G[a]'ha).c → dotQ (G[b]'hb).n p = (G[b]'hb).c →
      dotQ (G[c]'hc).n p = (G[c]'hc).c → p ∈ arrVerts G := by
    intro a b c ha hb hc hab hbc hd hpa hpb hpc
    rw [mem_arrVerts]
    exact ⟨a, b, c, hab, hbc, hc, tripleVertex_of_active ha hb hc hd hpa hpb hpc⟩
  obtain ⟨h1, h2, h3, h4, h5⟩ := det3_ne_zero_perm hdet
  rcases lt_trichotomy u v with huvlt | huveq | huvgt
  · rcases lt_trichotomy v w with hvwlt | hvweq | hvwgt
    · exact key u v w hu hv hw huvlt hvwlt hdet hpu hpv hpw
    · exact absurd hvweq hvw
    · rcases lt_trichotomy u w with huwlt | huweq | huwgt
      · exact key u w v hu hw hv huwlt hvwgt h2 hpu hpw hpv
      · exact absurd huweq huw
      · exact key w u v hw hu hv huwgt huvlt h5 hpw hpu hpv
  · exact absurd huveq huv
  · rcases lt_trichotomy v w with hvwlt | hvweq | hvwgt
    · rcases lt_trichotomy u w with huwlt | huweq | huwgt
      · exact key v u w hv hu hw huvgt huwlt h1 hpv hpu hpw
      · exact absurd huweq huw
      · exact key v w u hv hw hu hvwlt huwgt h4 hpv hpw hpu
    · exact absurd hvweq hvw
    · exact key w v u hw hv hu hvwgt huvgt h3 hpw hpv hpu

name: rank3_in_arrVerts
proof:
:= by
  classical
  set G : Fin (planes w).size → Half := fun j => (planes w)[j] with hGdef
  
  obtain ⟨j₁, j₂, j₃, hj1act, hj2act, hj3act, hli⟩ := exists_three_indep_active (G := G) (s := s) hrank
  
  have hdet : det3 (G j₁).n (G j₂).n (G j₃).n ≠ 0 :=
    (det3_ne_zero_iff_linearIndependent _ _ _).mpr hli
  
  have hpa : ∀ {j : Fin (planes w).size}, j ∈ activeSet G s x → dotQ (G j).n x = (G j).c := by
    intro j hj
    exact (active_iff_dotQ (hs j)).mp (mem_activeSet.mp hj)
  have hd1 : dotQ (G j₁).n x = (G j₁).c := hpa hj1act
  have hd2 : dotQ (G j₂).n x = (G j₂).c := hpa hj2act
  have hd3 : dotQ (G j₃).n x = (G j₃).c := hpa hj3act
  
  have hinj := hli.injective
  have hn12 : (G j₁).n ≠ (G j₂).n := by
    intro h
    have : (0 : Fin 3) = 1 := hinj (by simpa using h)
    exact absurd this (by decide)
  have hn13 : (G j₁).n ≠ (G j₃).n := by
    intro h
    have : (0 : Fin 3) = 2 := hinj (by simpa using h)
    exact absurd this (by decide)
  have hn23 : (G j₂).n ≠ (G j₃).n := by
    intro h
    have : (1 : Fin 3) = 2 := hinj (by simpa using h)
    exact absurd this (by decide)
  
  have h12 : j₁.val ≠ j₂.val := fun h => hn12 (by rw [Fin.ext h])
  have h13 : j₁.val ≠ j₃.val := fun h => hn13 (by rw [Fin.ext h])
  have h23 : j₂.val ≠ j₃.val := fun h => hn23 (by rw [Fin.ext h])
  
  have hsize1 : j₁.val < (planes w).size := j₁.isLt
  have hsize2 : j₂.val < (planes w).size := j₂.isLt
  have hsize3 : j₃.val < (planes w).size := j₃.isLt
  have hget1 : (planes w)[j₁.val]'hsize1 = G j₁ := rfl
  have hget2 : (planes w)[j₂.val]'hsize2 = G j₂ := rfl
  have hget3 : (planes w)[j₃.val]'hsize3 = G j₃ := rfl
  apply three_active_in_arrVerts hsize1 hsize2 hsize3 h12 h13 h23
  · rw [hget1, hget2, hget3]; exact hdet
  · rw [hget1]; exact hd1
  · rw [hget2]; exact hd2
  · rw [hget3]; exact hd3

name: stepA
statement:
theorem stepA {w : Chain} {s : Fin (planes w).size → ℚ}
    (hn : ∀ j : Fin (planes w).size, ((planes w)[j]).n ≠ 0)
    (hs : ∀ j, s j = 1 ∨ s j = -1)
    (hrec : ∀ v : Point, (∀ j : Fin (planes w).size,
      0 ≤ s j * (gOf ((planes w)[j])).linear v) → v = 0)
    {x₀ : Point} (hx : x₀ ∈ Pset (fun j => (planes w)[j]) s) :
    ∃ u, u ∈ arrVerts (planes w) ∧ u ∈ Pset (fun j => (planes w)[j]) s ∧
      activeSet (fun j => (planes w)[j]) s x₀ ⊆ activeSet (fun j => (planes w)[j]) s u
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨u, huP, hurank, husub⟩ := stepA_to_rank3 hn hs hrec hx
  exact ⟨u, rank3_in_arrVerts hs huP hurank, huP, husub⟩

name: exists_separating_functional
statement:
theorem exists_separating_functional (F : AffineSubspace ℚ Point)
    (_hk : Module.finrank ℚ F.direction ≤ 2) {c u₀ : Point}
    (hu₀ : u₀ ∈ F) (hcF : c ∉ F) :
    ∃ φ : Point →ₗ[ℚ] ℚ,
      (∀ d ∈ F.direction, φ d = 0) ∧ φ c ≠ φ u₀ ∧
      Module.finrank ℚ (LinearMap.ker φ) = 2
proof:
:= by
  classical
  
  have hcu : (c -ᵥ u₀ : Point) ∉ F.direction := by
    rw [AffineSubspace.vsub_right_mem_direction_iff_mem hu₀]
    exact hcF
  
  obtain ⟨φ, hφne, hφmap⟩ :=
    Submodule.exists_dual_map_eq_bot_of_nmem hcu (inferInstance : Module.Free ℚ (Point ⧸ F.direction))
  
  have hle : F.direction ≤ LinearMap.ker φ := (LinearMap.le_ker_iff_map).mpr hφmap
  
  have hvanish : ∀ d ∈ F.direction, φ d = 0 := by
    intro d hd
    exact (LinearMap.mem_ker).mp (hle hd)
  
  have hsep : φ c ≠ φ u₀ := by
    intro hcontra
    apply hφne
    rw [vsub_eq_sub, map_sub, hcontra, sub_self]
  
  have hφnz : φ ≠ 0 := by
    intro h
    apply hφne
    rw [h]; rfl
  
  have hrank : Module.finrank ℚ (LinearMap.ker φ) = 2 := by
    have := Module.Dual.finrank_ker_add_one_of_ne_zero (f := φ) hφnz
    rw [finrank_point] at this
    omega
  exact ⟨φ, hvanish, hsep, hrank⟩

name: Wperp_inf_ker
statement:
theorem Wperp_inf_kerφ_ne_bot {G : Fin m → Half} {s : Fin m → ℚ} {x : Point}
    {φ : Point →ₗ[ℚ] ℚ} (hφker : Module.finrank ℚ (LinearMap.ker φ) = 2)
    (hWle : Module.finrank ℚ (Wspan G s x) ≤ 1) :
    Wperp G s x ⊓ LinearMap.ker φ ≠ ⊥
proof:
:= by
  
  have hsum := Wperp_finrank_ge G s x
  
  have hie := Submodule.finrank_sup_add_finrank_inf_eq (Wperp G s x) (LinearMap.ker φ)
  
  have hsuple : Module.finrank ℚ ↑(Wperp G s x ⊔ LinearMap.ker φ) ≤ 3 := by
    have := Submodule.finrank_le (Wperp G s x ⊔ LinearMap.ker φ)
    rwa [finrank_point] at this
  
  have hpos : 0 < Module.finrank ℚ ↑(Wperp G s x ⊓ LinearMap.ker φ) := by omega
  rw [Module.finrank_pos_iff_exists_ne_zero] at hpos
  rw [Submodule.ne_bot_iff]
  obtain ⟨v, hv⟩ := hpos
  exact ⟨v.val, v.property, by simpa using fun h => hv (Subtype.ext h)⟩

name: incr_eq_add_smul
statement:
theorem incr_eq_add_smul (x v : Point) (r : ℚ) :
    (fun i => x i + r * v i) = x + r • v
proof:
:= by
  funext i; simp [Pi.add_apply, Pi.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul]

name: stepA'_in_ker
statement:
theorem stepA'_in_kerφ_preserves {G : Fin m → Half} {s : Fin m → ℚ} {x : Point}
    (hn : ∀ j, (G j).n ≠ 0) (hs : ∀ j, s j = 1 ∨ s j = -1)
    (hrec : ∀ v : Point, (∀ j, 0 ≤ s j * (gOf (G j)).linear v) → v = 0)
    (hx : x ∈ Pset G s) {φ : Point →ₗ[ℚ] ℚ} {v : Point} (hv0 : v ≠ 0)
    (hvWk : v ∈ Wperp G s x ⊓ LinearMap.ker φ)
    (hdec : ∃ j, s j * (gOf (G j)).linear v < 0) :
    ∃ (r : ℚ) (jstar : Fin m), 0 < r ∧
      (fun i => x i + r * v i) ∈ Pset G s ∧
      s jstar * gOf (G jstar) (fun i => x i + r * v i) = 0 ∧
      jstar ∉ activeSet G s x ∧
      activeSet G s x ⊆ activeSet G s (fun i => x i + r * v i) ∧
      jstar ∈ activeSet G s (fun i => x i + r * v i) ∧
      (G jstar).n ∉ Wspan G s x ∧
      φ (fun i => x i + r * v i) = φ x
proof:
:= by
  have hvW : v ∈ Wperp G s x := (Submodule.mem_inf.mp hvWk).1
  have hvk : v ∈ LinearMap.ker φ := (Submodule.mem_inf.mp hvWk).2
  obtain ⟨r, jstar, hrpos, hx'P, hval, hjnew, hsub, hjstarnew, hjnotin⟩ :=
    stepA'_increment hn hs hrec hx hv0 hvW hdec
  refine ⟨r, jstar, hrpos, hx'P, hval, hjnew, hsub, hjstarnew, hjnotin, ?_⟩
  
  rw [incr_eq_add_smul, map_add, map_smul]
  have : φ v = 0 := (LinearMap.mem_ker).mp hvk
  rw [this, smul_zero, add_zero]

name: stepA_ker
statement:
theorem stepA_kerφ_to_rank_ge2 {G : Fin m → Half} {s : Fin m → ℚ}
    (hn : ∀ j, (G j).n ≠ 0) (hs : ∀ j, s j = 1 ∨ s j = -1)
    (hrec : ∀ v : Point, (∀ j, 0 ≤ s j * (gOf (G j)).linear v) → v = 0)
    {φ : Point →ₗ[ℚ] ℚ} (hφker : Module.finrank ℚ (LinearMap.ker φ) = 2)
    {x₀ : Point} (hx : x₀ ∈ Pset G s) :
    ∃ x₂ ∈ Pset G s, 2 ≤ Module.finrank ℚ (Wspan G s x₂) ∧ φ x₂ = φ x₀ ∧
      activeSet G s x₀ ⊆ activeSet G s x₂
proof:
:= by
  classical
  suffices H : ∀ n : ℕ, ∀ x : Point, x ∈ Pset G s →
      3 - Module.finrank ℚ (Wspan G s x) = n →
      ∃ y ∈ Pset G s, 2 ≤ Module.finrank ℚ (Wspan G s y) ∧ φ y = φ x ∧
        activeSet G s x ⊆ activeSet G s y by
    obtain ⟨y, hy, hyr, hyphi, hsub⟩ := H _ x₀ hx rfl
    exact ⟨y, hy, hyr, hyphi, hsub⟩
  intro n
  induction n using Nat.strong_induction_on with
  | _ n ih =>
    intro x hxP hμ
    by_cases hge2 : 2 ≤ Module.finrank ℚ (Wspan G s x)
    · exact ⟨x, hxP, hge2, rfl, Finset.Subset.refl _⟩
    · 
      have hle1 : Module.finrank ℚ (Wspan G s x) ≤ 1 := by omega
      have hne : Wperp G s x ⊓ LinearMap.ker φ ≠ ⊥ := Wperp_inf_kerφ_ne_bot hφker hle1
      obtain ⟨v, hvmem, hv0⟩ := Submodule.exists_mem_ne_zero_of_ne_bot hne
      
      rcases exists_decreasing_inactive_signed hrec hxP hv0 with hdec | hdec
      · 
        obtain ⟨r, jstar, hrpos, hx'P, _hval, _hjnew, hsub, hjstarnew, hjnotin, hphi⟩ :=
          stepA'_in_kerφ_preserves hn hs hrec hxP hv0 hvmem hdec
        set x' : Point := (fun i => x i + r * v i) with hx'def
        have hgrow : Module.finrank ℚ (Wspan G s x) < Module.finrank ℚ (Wspan G s x') :=
          Wspan_lt_of_new_active hsub hjstarnew hjnotin
        have hμ' : 3 - Module.finrank ℚ (Wspan G s x') < n := by
          have := Wspan_finrank_le G s x'
          omega
        obtain ⟨y, hy, hyr, hyphi, hysub⟩ := ih _ hμ' x' hx'P rfl
        exact ⟨y, hy, hyr, by rw [hyphi, hphi], Finset.Subset.trans hsub hysub⟩
      · 
        have hnvmem : (-v) ∈ Wperp G s x ⊓ LinearMap.ker φ := Submodule.neg_mem _ hvmem
        have hnv0 : (-v) ≠ 0 := by simpa using hv0
        obtain ⟨r, jstar, hrpos, hx'P, _hval, _hjnew, hsub, hjstarnew, hjnotin, hphi⟩ :=
          stepA'_in_kerφ_preserves hn hs hrec hxP hnv0 hnvmem hdec
        set x' : Point := (fun i => x i + r * (-v) i) with hx'def
        have hgrow : Module.finrank ℚ (Wspan G s x) < Module.finrank ℚ (Wspan G s x') :=
          Wspan_lt_of_new_active hsub hjstarnew hjnotin
        have hμ' : 3 - Module.finrank ℚ (Wspan G s x') < n := by
          have := Wspan_finrank_le G s x'
          omega
        obtain ⟨y, hy, hyr, hyphi, hysub⟩ := ih _ hμ' x' hx'P rfl
        exact ⟨y, hy, hyr, by rw [hyphi, hphi], Finset.Subset.trans hsub hysub⟩

name: Cset_subset_Pset
statement:
theorem Cset_subset_Pset {G : Fin m → Half} {s : Fin m → ℚ} :
    Cset G s ⊆ Pset G s
proof:
:= by
  intro x hx j
  exact le_of_lt (hx j)

name: vertex_off_flat_by_constrained_purification
statement:
theorem vertex_off_flat_by_constrained_purification {w : Chain}
    {s : Fin (planes w).size → ℚ}
    (hn : ∀ j : Fin (planes w).size, ((planes w)[j]).n ≠ 0)
    (hs : ∀ j, s j = 1 ∨ s j = -1)
    (hrec : ∀ v : Point, (∀ j : Fin (planes w).size,
      0 ≤ s j * (gOf ((planes w)[j])).linear v) → v = 0)
    (F : AffineSubspace ℚ Point) (hk : Module.finrank ℚ F.direction ≤ 2)
    {c : Point} (hc : c ∈ Cset (fun j => (planes w)[j]) s)
    (u₀ : Point) (hu₀ : u₀ ∈ F) (hcF : c ∉ F) :
    ∃ u, u ∈ arrVerts (planes w) ∧ u ∈ Pset (fun j => (planes w)[j]) s ∧ u ∉ F
proof:
:= by
  classical
  set G : Fin (planes w).size → Half := fun j => (planes w)[j] with hGdef
  
  obtain ⟨φ, hvanish, hsep, hφker⟩ := exists_separating_functional F hk hu₀ hcF
  
  have off_flat : ∀ y : Point, φ y ≠ φ u₀ → y ∉ F := by
    intro y hy hyF
    apply hy
    have hdir : (y -ᵥ u₀ : Point) ∈ F.direction :=
      (AffineSubspace.vsub_right_mem_direction_iff_mem hu₀ y).mpr hyF
    have : φ (y -ᵥ u₀) = 0 := hvanish _ hdir
    rw [vsub_eq_sub, map_sub, sub_eq_zero] at this
    exact this
  
  have hcP : c ∈ Pset G s := Cset_subset_Pset hc
  have hcτ : φ c ≠ φ u₀ := hsep
  
  obtain ⟨x₂, hx₂P, hx₂ge2, hx₂phi, _hx₂sub⟩ :=
    stepA_kerφ_to_rank_ge2 hn hs hrec hφker hcP
  rw [← hGdef] at hx₂ge2
  have hx₂phiτ : φ x₂ ≠ φ u₀ := by rw [hx₂phi]; exact hcτ
  have hx₂le3 : Module.finrank ℚ (Wspan G s x₂) ≤ 3 := Wspan_finrank_le G s x₂
  
  rcases Nat.lt_or_ge (Module.finrank ℚ (Wspan G s x₂)) 3 with hlt3 | hge3
  · 
    have heq2 : Module.finrank ℚ (Wspan G s x₂) = 2 := by omega
    have hle2 : Module.finrank ℚ (Wspan G s x₂) ≤ 2 := by omega
    have hWperp : Wperp G s x₂ ≠ ⊥ := Wperp_ne_bot_of_lt hle2
    obtain ⟨v₂, hv₂mem, hv₂0⟩ := Submodule.exists_mem_ne_zero_of_ne_bot hWperp
    by_cases hφv₂ : φ v₂ = 0
    · 
      have hv₂k : v₂ ∈ Wperp G s x₂ ⊓ LinearMap.ker φ :=
        Submodule.mem_inf.mpr ⟨hv₂mem, (LinearMap.mem_ker).mpr hφv₂⟩
      rcases exists_decreasing_inactive_signed hrec hx₂P hv₂0 with hdec | hdec
      · obtain ⟨r, jstar, hrpos, hx₃P, _hval, _hjnew, hsub, hjstarnew, hjnotin, hphi⟩ :=
          stepA'_in_kerφ_preserves hn hs hrec hx₂P hv₂0 hv₂k hdec
        set x₃ : Point := (fun i => x₂ i + r * v₂ i) with hx₃def
        have hgrow : Module.finrank ℚ (Wspan G s x₂) < Module.finrank ℚ (Wspan G s x₃) :=
          Wspan_lt_of_new_active hsub hjstarnew hjnotin
        have hx₃le3 : Module.finrank ℚ (Wspan G s x₃) ≤ 3 := Wspan_finrank_le G s x₃
        have hx₃rank : Module.finrank ℚ (Wspan G s x₃) = 3 := by omega
        refine ⟨x₃, rank3_in_arrVerts hs hx₃P hx₃rank, hx₃P, ?_⟩
        apply off_flat
        rw [hphi]; exact hx₂phiτ
      · have hnv₂k : (-v₂) ∈ Wperp G s x₂ ⊓ LinearMap.ker φ := Submodule.neg_mem _ hv₂k
        have hnv₂0 : (-v₂) ≠ 0 := by simpa using hv₂0
        obtain ⟨r, jstar, hrpos, hx₃P, _hval, _hjnew, hsub, hjstarnew, hjnotin, hphi⟩ :=
          stepA'_in_kerφ_preserves hn hs hrec hx₂P hnv₂0 hnv₂k hdec
        set x₃ : Point := (fun i => x₂ i + r * (-v₂) i) with hx₃def
        have hgrow : Module.finrank ℚ (Wspan G s x₂) < Module.finrank ℚ (Wspan G s x₃) :=
          Wspan_lt_of_new_active hsub hjstarnew hjnotin
        have hx₃le3 : Module.finrank ℚ (Wspan G s x₃) ≤ 3 := Wspan_finrank_le G s x₃
        have hx₃rank : Module.finrank ℚ (Wspan G s x₃) = 3 := by omega
        refine ⟨x₃, rank3_in_arrVerts hs hx₃P hx₃rank, hx₃P, ?_⟩
        apply off_flat
        rw [hphi]; exact hx₂phiτ
    · 
      have hnv₂0 : (-v₂) ≠ 0 := by simpa using hv₂0
      have hnv₂mem : (-v₂) ∈ Wperp G s x₂ := Submodule.neg_mem _ hv₂mem
      
      have hdecP : ∃ j, s j * (gOf (G j)).linear v₂ < 0 :=
        exists_decreasing_inactive hrec hx₂P hv₂0
      have hdecM : ∃ j, s j * (gOf (G j)).linear (-v₂) < 0 :=
        exists_decreasing_inactive hrec hx₂P hnv₂0
      
      obtain ⟨rP, jP, hrPpos, huPP, _valP, _newP, hsubP, hjnP, hnotinP⟩ :=
        stepA'_increment hn hs hrec hx₂P hv₂0 hv₂mem hdecP
      set uP : Point := (fun i => x₂ i + rP * v₂ i) with huPdef
      have hgrowP : Module.finrank ℚ (Wspan G s x₂) < Module.finrank ℚ (Wspan G s uP) :=
        Wspan_lt_of_new_active hsubP hjnP hnotinP
      have huPle3 : Module.finrank ℚ (Wspan G s uP) ≤ 3 := Wspan_finrank_le G s uP
      have huPrank : Module.finrank ℚ (Wspan G s uP) = 3 := by omega
      have huPvert : uP ∈ arrVerts (planes w) := rank3_in_arrVerts hs huPP huPrank
      
      obtain ⟨rM, jM, hrMpos, huMP, _valM, _newM, hsubM, hjnM, hnotinM⟩ :=
        stepA'_increment hn hs hrec hx₂P hnv₂0 hnv₂mem hdecM
      set uM : Point := (fun i => x₂ i + rM * (-v₂) i) with huMdef
      have hgrowM : Module.finrank ℚ (Wspan G s x₂) < Module.finrank ℚ (Wspan G s uM) :=
        Wspan_lt_of_new_active hsubM hjnM hnotinM
      have huMle3 : Module.finrank ℚ (Wspan G s uM) ≤ 3 := Wspan_finrank_le G s uM
      have huMrank : Module.finrank ℚ (Wspan G s uM) = 3 := by omega
      have huMvert : uM ∈ arrVerts (planes w) := rank3_in_arrVerts hs huMP huMrank
      
      have hφuP : φ uP = φ x₂ + rP * φ v₂ := by
        rw [huPdef, incr_eq_add_smul, map_add, map_smul, smul_eq_mul]
      have hφuM : φ uM = φ x₂ - rM * φ v₂ := by
        rw [huMdef, incr_eq_add_smul, map_add, map_smul, smul_eq_mul, map_neg]; ring
      
      have hdiff : φ uP ≠ φ uM := by
        rw [hφuP, hφuM]
        intro h
        have hz : (rP + rM) * φ v₂ = 0 := by linarith
        rcases mul_eq_zero.mp hz with hsum | hv
        · have hpos : 0 < rP + rM := by linarith
          rw [hsum] at hpos; exact lt_irrefl 0 hpos
        · exact hφv₂ hv
      
      by_cases hPoff : φ uP = φ u₀
      · 
        have hMoff : φ uM ≠ φ u₀ := by
          intro h; exact hdiff (by rw [hPoff, h])
        exact ⟨uM, huMvert, huMP, off_flat uM hMoff⟩
      · exact ⟨uP, huPvert, huPP, off_flat uP hPoff⟩
  · 
    have hx₂rank : Module.finrank ℚ (Wspan G s x₂) = 3 := by omega
    exact ⟨x₂, rank3_in_arrVerts hs hx₂P hx₂rank, hx₂P, off_flat x₂ hx₂phiτ⟩

name: aiSnoc
statement:
theorem aiSnoc {n : ℕ} {u : Fin (n + 1) → Point} (hu : AffineIndependent ℚ u)
    {x : Point} (hx : x ∉ affineSpan ℚ (Set.range u)) :
    AffineIndependent ℚ (Fin.snoc u x)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  
  have hsc : ∀ i : Fin (n + 1),
      (Fin.snoc u x : Fin (n + 2) → Point) (Fin.castSucc i) = u i := fun i => by
    have := congrFun (Fin.snoc_comp_castSucc (a := x) (f := u)) i
    simp only [Function.comp_apply] at this
    exact this
  apply AffineIndependent.affineIndependent_of_not_mem_span (i := Fin.last (n + 1))
  · 
    refine (affineIndependent_equiv (finSuccAboveEquiv (Fin.last (n + 1)))).mp ?_
    have hcomp : (fun y : {z : Fin (n + 2) // z ≠ Fin.last (n + 1)} =>
          (Fin.snoc u x : Fin (n + 2) → Point) y.val)
        ∘ (finSuccAboveEquiv (Fin.last (n + 1))) = u := by
      funext i
      simp only [Function.comp_apply, finSuccAboveEquiv_apply, Fin.succAbove_last]
      exact hsc i
    rw [hcomp]
    exact hu
  · 
    rw [Fin.snoc_last]
    have himg : Fin.snoc u x '' {z : Fin (n + 2) | z ≠ Fin.last (n + 1)} = Set.range u := by
      ext p
      simp only [Set.mem_image, Set.mem_setOf_eq, Set.mem_range]
      constructor
      · rintro ⟨z, hz, rfl⟩
        obtain ⟨i, rfl⟩ := Fin.exists_castSucc_eq.mpr hz
        exact ⟨i, (hsc i).symm⟩
      · rintro ⟨i, rfl⟩
        exact ⟨Fin.castSucc i, (Fin.castSucc_lt_last i).ne, hsc i⟩
    rw [himg]
    exact hx

name: exists_open_cell_off_flat
statement:
theorem exists_open_cell_off_flat {G : Fin m → Half} {s : Fin m → ℚ}
    {p₀ : Point} (hp₀ : ∀ j, 0 < s j * gOf (G j) p₀)
    (F : AffineSubspace ℚ Point) (hk : Module.finrank ℚ F.direction ≤ 2) :
    ∃ c ∈ Cset G s, c ∉ F
proof:
:= by
  by_contra hcon
  push_neg at hcon
  
  have hsub : Cset G s ⊆ (F : Set Point) := fun c hc => hcon c hc
  
  have hvle : vectorSpan ℚ (Cset G s) ≤ F.direction := by
    have hle : affineSpan ℚ (Cset G s) ≤ F := affineSpan_le.mpr hsub
    have hdir : (affineSpan ℚ (Cset G s)).direction ≤ F.direction :=
      AffineSubspace.direction_le hle
    rwa [direction_affineSpan] at hdir
  
  have h3 : Module.finrank ℚ (vectorSpan ℚ (Cset G s)) = 3 :=
    openCell_finrank_three (fun j => gOf (G j)) s hp₀
  have hmono : Module.finrank ℚ (vectorSpan ℚ (Cset G s)) ≤ Module.finrank ℚ F.direction :=
    Submodule.finrank_mono hvle
  omega

name: boundedFullDimCell_has_aff_indep_4_arrVerts
statement:
theorem boundedFullDimCell_has_aff_indep_4_arrVerts {w : Chain}
    {s : Fin (planes w).size → ℚ}
    (hn : ∀ j : Fin (planes w).size, ((planes w)[j]).n ≠ 0)
    (hs : ∀ j, s j = 1 ∨ s j = -1)
    {p₀ : Point} (hp₀ : ∀ j, 0 < s j * gOf ((planes w)[j]) p₀)
    {K : Set Point} {R : ℚ} (hKbound : ∀ x ∈ K, ∀ i, |x i| ≤ R)
    (hCsub : Cset (fun j => (planes w)[j]) s ⊆ K) :
    ∃ u : Fin 4 → Point,
      AffineIndependent ℚ u ∧
      (∀ k, u k ∈ arrVerts (planes w)) ∧
      (∀ k, u k ∈ Pset (fun j => (planes w)[j]) s)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  set G : Fin (planes w).size → Half := fun j => (planes w)[j] with hGdef
  
  have hrec : ∀ v : Point,
      (∀ j : Fin (planes w).size, 0 ≤ s j * (gOf (G j)).linear v) → v = 0 :=
    closedCell_recessionCone_trivial (fun j => gOf (G j)) s hp₀ hKbound hCsub
  
  have hp₀P : p₀ ∈ Pset G s := fun j => le_of_lt (hp₀ j)
  
  obtain ⟨u₀, hu₀vert, hu₀P, _hu₀sub⟩ := stepA hn hs hrec hp₀P
  
  
  have step : ∀ (k : ℕ), k ≤ 2 → ∀ (fk : Fin (k + 1) → Point),
      AffineIndependent ℚ fk → (∀ i, fk i ∈ arrVerts (planes w)) →
      (∀ i, fk i ∈ Pset G s) → u₀ ∈ affineSpan ℚ (Set.range fk) →
      ∃ fk' : Fin (k + 2) → Point, AffineIndependent ℚ fk' ∧
        (∀ i, fk' i ∈ arrVerts (planes w)) ∧ (∀ i, fk' i ∈ Pset G s) ∧
        u₀ ∈ affineSpan ℚ (Set.range fk') := by
    intro k hk2 fk hAIk hvertk hPk hu0k
    
    set Fk : AffineSubspace ℚ Point := affineSpan ℚ (Set.range fk) with hFkdef
    have hcard : Fintype.card (Fin (k + 1)) = k + 1 := Fintype.card_fin _
    have hdimk : Module.finrank ℚ Fk.direction = k := by
      rw [hFkdef, direction_affineSpan]
      exact hAIk.finrank_vectorSpan hcard
    have hk2' : Module.finrank ℚ Fk.direction ≤ 2 := by rw [hdimk]; exact hk2
    
    obtain ⟨ck, hckC, hckF⟩ := exists_open_cell_off_flat hp₀ Fk hk2'
    
    obtain ⟨u', hu'vert, hu'P, hu'F⟩ :=
      vertex_off_flat_by_constrained_purification hn hs hrec Fk hk2' hckC u₀ hu0k hckF
    
    have hu'span : u' ∉ affineSpan ℚ (Set.range fk) := by rw [← hFkdef]; exact hu'F
    
    refine ⟨Fin.snoc fk u', aiSnoc hAIk hu'span, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
    · 
      intro i
      refine Fin.lastCases ?_ ?_ i
      · rw [Fin.snoc_last]; exact hu'vert
      · intro j; rw [Fin.snoc_castSucc]; exact hvertk j
    · 
      intro i
      refine Fin.lastCases ?_ ?_ i
      · rw [Fin.snoc_last]; exact hu'P
      · intro j; rw [Fin.snoc_castSucc]; exact hPk j
    · 
      have hsub : Set.range fk ⊆ Set.range (Fin.snoc fk u' : Fin (k + 2) → Point) := by
        rintro y ⟨i, rfl⟩
        exact ⟨Fin.castSucc i, by rw [Fin.snoc_castSucc]⟩
      exact (affineSpan_mono ℚ hsub) hu0k
  
  have hAI1 : AffineIndependent ℚ (![u₀] : Fin 1 → Point) :=
    affineIndependent_of_subsingleton ℚ _
  have hvert1 : ∀ i, (![u₀] : Fin 1 → Point) i ∈ arrVerts (planes w) := by
    intro i; fin_cases i; exact hu₀vert
  have hP1 : ∀ i, (![u₀] : Fin 1 → Point) i ∈ Pset G s := by
    intro i; fin_cases i; exact hu₀P
  have hu01 : u₀ ∈ affineSpan ℚ (Set.range (![u₀] : Fin 1 → Point)) := by
    apply mem_affineSpan
    exact ⟨0, rfl⟩
  obtain ⟨f2, hAI2, hvert2, hP2, hu02⟩ := step 0 (by norm_num) _ hAI1 hvert1 hP1 hu01
  obtain ⟨f3, hAI3, hvert3, hP3, hu03⟩ := step 1 (by norm_num) _ hAI2 hvert2 hP2 hu02
  obtain ⟨f4, hAI4, hvert4, hP4, _hu04⟩ := step 2 (by norm_num) _ hAI3 hvert3 hP3 hu03
  exact ⟨f4, hAI4, hvert4, hP4⟩

name: cramer_key
statement:
private theorem cramer_key (P Q W : Plane2) :
    ∀ j : Fin 2, W j * cross P Q = (cross W Q) * P j + (cross P W) * Q j
proof:
:= by
  intro j
  fin_cases j <;> simp only [cross, Fin.isValue, Fin.mk_zero, Fin.mk_one] <;> ring

name: cramer
statement:
theorem cramer (P Q W : Plane2) (hdet : cross P Q ≠ 0) :
    W = (cross W Q / cross P Q) • P + (cross P W / cross P Q) • Q
proof:
:= by
  funext i
  rw [Pi.add_apply, Pi.smul_apply, Pi.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul, smul_eq_mul,
      div_mul_eq_mul_div, div_mul_eq_mul_div, div_add_div_same, eq_div_iff hdet]
  exact cramer_key P Q W i

name: chord_id
proof:
:= by
  have e : cross (q-p) (w-p) = cross (p-c) (q-c) + cross (q-c) (w-c) - cross (p-c) (w-c) := by
    simp only [cross, Pi.sub_apply]; ring
  rw [e, hw]
  simp only [cross, Pi.add_apply, Pi.sub_apply, Pi.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul]; ring

name: t1_id
statement: private theorem t1_id (p q c : Plane2) : cross (q-p) (c-p) = cross (p-c) (q-c)
proof:
:= by
  simp only [cross, Pi.sub_apply]; ring

name: f_affine
statement:
private theorem f_affine (p q a b : Plane2) (s : ℚ) :
    cross (q-p) (((1-s)•a + s•b) - p) = (1-s)*cross (q-p) (a-p) + s*cross (q-p) (b-p)
proof:
:= by
  simp only [cross, Pi.sub_apply, Pi.add_apply, Pi.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul]; ring

name: ne_of_cross_pos_left
statement: private theorem ne_of_cross_pos_left {p q c : Plane2} (h : 0 < cross (p-c) (q-c)) : p ≠ c
proof:
:= by
  intro he; rw [he] at h; simp only [sub_self] at h
  rw [show cross (0 : Plane2) (q - c) = 0 by simp [cross]] at h; exact lt_irrefl 0 h

name: ne_of_cross_pos_right
statement: private theorem ne_of_cross_pos_right {p q c : Plane2} (h : 0 < cross (p-c) (q-c)) : q ≠ c
proof:
:= by
  intro he; rw [he] at h; simp only [sub_self] at h
  rw [show cross (p - c) (0 : Plane2) = 0 by simp [cross]] at h; exact lt_irrefl 0 h

name: ne_pq_of_cross_pos
statement: private theorem ne_pq_of_cross_pos {p q c : Plane2} (h : 0 < cross (p-c) (q-c)) : p ≠ q
proof:
:= by
  intro he; rw [he] at h
  rw [show cross (q - c) (q - c) = 0 by simp only [cross]; ring] at h
  exact lt_irrefl 0 h

name: line_param
statement:
private theorem line_param (p q c m : Plane2) (t : ℚ)
    (h : m - c = (1-t)•(p-c) + t•(q-c)) : m = (1-t)•p + t•q
proof:
:= by
  funext i
  have := congrFun h i
  simp only [Pi.sub_apply, Pi.add_apply, Pi.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul] at this ⊢
  linarith

name: mem_openSegment_mk
proof: := ⟨a, b, ha, hb, hab, he⟩

name: cross_ne_zero_of_affineIndependent
proof:
:= by
  
  
  intro hzero
  
  have hinj : Function.Injective (![a, b, cc] : Fin 3 → Plane2) := h.injective
  have hba0 : b - a ≠ 0 := by
    rw [sub_ne_zero]; intro he
    have : (![a, b, cc] : Fin 3 → Plane2) 1 = (![a, b, cc] : Fin 3 → Plane2) 0 := by
      simp [he]
    exact absurd (hinj this) (by decide)
  have hca0 : cc - a ≠ 0 := by
    rw [sub_ne_zero]; intro he
    have : (![a, b, cc] : Fin 3 → Plane2) 2 = (![a, b, cc] : Fin 3 → Plane2) 0 := by
      simp [he]
    exact absurd (hinj this) (by decide)
  rw [affineIndependent_iff_not_collinear_set] at h
  apply h
  rw [Proof.CrossProduct.cross_eq_zero_iff_not_linearIndependent hba0 hca0,
    LinearIndependent.pair_iff] at hzero
  push_neg at hzero
  obtain ⟨s, t, hst, hnot⟩ := hzero
  
  rw [collinear_iff_of_mem (show a ∈ ({a, b, cc} : Set Plane2) by simp)]
  rcases eq_or_ne s 0 with hs | hs
  · 
    have ht : t ≠ 0 := fun ht => hnot hs ht
    rw [hs, zero_smul, zero_add] at hst
    have hca : cc = a := by
      have hcc0 : cc - a = 0 := by
        rcases smul_eq_zero.mp hst with h | h; exact absurd h ht; exact h
      rw [sub_eq_zero] at hcc0; exact hcc0
    refine ⟨b - a, fun p hp => ?_⟩
    simp only [Set.mem_insert_iff, Set.mem_singleton_iff] at hp
    rcases hp with rfl | rfl | rfl
    · exact ⟨0, by simp⟩
    · exact ⟨1, by simp [vadd_eq_add]⟩
    · exact ⟨0, by rw [hca]; simp⟩
  · 
    have hba : b - a = (-t / s) • (cc - a) := by
      have hsb : s • (b - a) = (-t) • (cc - a) := by
        have h2 : s • (b - a) + t • (cc - a) - t • (cc - a) = -(t • (cc - a)) := by
          rw [hst]; abel
        rw [add_sub_cancel_right] at h2
        rw [h2, neg_smul]
      have hbe : (b - a) = s⁻¹ • (s • (b - a)) := by
        rw [smul_smul, inv_mul_cancel₀ hs, one_smul]
      rw [hbe, hsb, smul_smul]; congr 1; field_simp
    refine ⟨cc - a, fun p hp => ?_⟩
    simp only [Set.mem_insert_iff, Set.mem_singleton_iff] at hp
    rcases hp with rfl | rfl | rfl
    · exact ⟨0, by simp⟩
    · exact ⟨-t / s, by rw [vadd_eq_add, ← hba]; abel⟩
    · exact ⟨1, by simp [vadd_eq_add]⟩

name: cross_dir_one_root
proof:
:= by
  simp only [cross, Pi.sub_apply, Matrix.cons_val_zero, Matrix.cons_val_one, Matrix.head_cons,
    mul_one] at h1 h2
  have hd0 : v 0 - w 0 ≠ 0 := by
    intro hz; apply hvw
    rw [hz, zero_mul, zero_sub, neg_eq_zero, sub_eq_zero] at h1
    funext i; fin_cases i
    · simpa [sub_eq_zero] using hz
    · exact h1
  have e1 : (v 0 - w 0) * (k1 : ℚ) = (v 1 - w 1) := by linarith [h1]
  have e2 : (v 0 - w 0) * (k2 : ℚ) = (v 1 - w 1) := by linarith [h2]
  have heq : (v 0 - w 0) * (k1 : ℚ) = (v 0 - w 0) * (k2 : ℚ) := by rw [e1, e2]
  exact_mod_cast mul_left_cancel₀ hd0 heq

name: exists_transverse_dir
statement:
private theorem exists_transverse_dir (V : Finset Plane2) :
    ∃ n : ℕ, ∀ v ∈ V, ∀ w ∈ V, v ≠ w → cross (v - w) ![1, (n : ℚ)] ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  classical
  set BadN : Finset ℕ := (V ×ˢ V).biUnion
    (fun p => if h : ∃ k : ℕ, cross (p.1 - p.2) ![1, (k : ℚ)] = 0
              then {Classical.choose h} else ∅) with hBadN
  obtain ⟨n, hn⟩ := Finset.exists_not_mem BadN
  refine ⟨n, fun v hv w hw hvw hzero => hn ?_⟩
  rw [hBadN, Finset.mem_biUnion]
  refine ⟨(v, w), Finset.mem_product.mpr ⟨hv, hw⟩, ?_⟩
  have hex : ∃ k : ℕ, cross ((v, w).1 - (v, w).2) ![1, (k : ℚ)] = 0 := ⟨n, hzero⟩
  rw [dif_pos hex, Finset.mem_singleton]
  exact cross_dir_one_root hvw hzero (Classical.choose_spec hex)

name: exists_strict_feasible
statement:
theorem exists_strict_feasible {m : ℕ} (g : Fin m → (Plane2 →ᵃ[ℚ] ℚ))
    (P' : Set Plane2) (hP' : P' = ⋂ i, {y | 0 ≤ g i y})
    (V : Finset Plane2) (hVP : (↑V : Set Plane2) ⊆ P')
    (hcard : 3 ≤ V.card)
    (hcoll : ∀ a ∈ V, ∀ b ∈ V, ∀ c0 ∈ V, a ≠ b → a ≠ c0 → b ≠ c0 →
      AffineIndependent ℚ ![a, b, c0])
    (_hdim : Module.finrank ℚ (vectorSpan ℚ P') = 2) :
    ∃ c : Plane2,
      (∀ i, Proof.HpolytopeVertex.NonVacuous (g i) → 0 < g i c)
      ∧ (∀ v ∈ V, ∀ w ∈ V, v ≠ w → cross (v - c) (w - c) ≠ 0)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  
  
  
  obtain ⟨v0, v1, v2, hv0, hv1, hv2, h01, h02, h12⟩ :
      ∃ a b c, a ∈ V ∧ b ∈ V ∧ c ∈ V ∧ a ≠ b ∧ a ≠ c ∧ b ≠ c := by
    obtain ⟨s, hsV, hs3⟩ := Finset.exists_subset_card_eq hcard
    obtain ⟨a, b, c, hab, hac, hbc, hs⟩ := Finset.card_eq_three.mp hs3
    refine ⟨a, b, c, hsV ?_, hsV ?_, hsV ?_, hab, hac, hbc⟩ <;> rw [hs] <;> simp
  set c0 : Plane2 := (3⁻¹ : ℚ) • (v0 + v1 + v2) with hc0
  
  have hAI : AffineIndependent ℚ ![v0, v1, v2] := hcoll v0 hv0 v1 hv1 v2 hv2 h01 h02 h12
  
  have hcentroid : ∀ (h : Plane2 →ᵃ[ℚ] ℚ), 3 * h c0 = h v0 + h v1 + h v2 := by
    intro h
    have e0 : h.linear (v1 - v0) = h v1 - h v0 :=
      Proof.HpolytopeVertex.affine_linear_sub h v1 v0
    have e1 : h.linear (v2 - v0) = h v2 - h v0 :=
      Proof.HpolytopeVertex.affine_linear_sub h v2 v0
    have ec : h.linear (c0 - v0) = h c0 - h v0 :=
      Proof.HpolytopeVertex.affine_linear_sub h c0 v0
    have hcv : c0 - v0 = (3⁻¹ : ℚ) • ((v1 - v0) + (v2 - v0)) := by
      rw [hc0]; funext i
      simp only [Pi.sub_apply, Pi.add_apply, Pi.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul]; ring
    rw [hcv, map_smul, map_add, e0, e1, smul_eq_mul] at ec
    linarith [ec]
  
  
  
  have hc0feas : ∀ i, Proof.HpolytopeVertex.NonVacuous (g i) → 0 < g i c0 := by
    intro i hnv
    
    have hge : ∀ v ∈ V, 0 ≤ g i v := by
      intro v hv
      have hvP' : v ∈ P' := hVP hv
      rw [hP'] at hvP'; simpa using Set.mem_iInter.mp hvP' i
    have h0 := hge v0 hv0; have h1 := hge v1 hv1; have h2 := hge v2 hv2
    
    have hnotallzero : ¬ (g i v0 = 0 ∧ g i v1 = 0 ∧ g i v2 = 0) := by
      rintro ⟨z0, z1, z2⟩
      apply hnv
      
      
      have l1 : (g i).linear (v1 - v0) = 0 := by
        rw [Proof.HpolytopeVertex.affine_linear_sub, z0, z1]; ring
      have l2 : (g i).linear (v2 - v0) = 0 := by
        rw [Proof.HpolytopeVertex.affine_linear_sub, z0, z2]; ring
      have hdet : cross (v1 - v0) (v2 - v0) ≠ 0 :=
        cross_ne_zero_of_affineIndependent hAI
      
      apply LinearMap.ext
      intro W
      rw [LinearMap.zero_apply, cramer (v1 - v0) (v2 - v0) W hdet, map_add, map_smul,
        map_smul, l1, l2, smul_zero, smul_zero, add_zero]
    
    have hsumpos : 0 < g i v0 + g i v1 + g i v2 := by
      rcases (by tauto : g i v0 ≠ 0 ∨ g i v1 ≠ 0 ∨ g i v2 ≠ 0) with h | h | h
      · have : 0 < g i v0 := lt_of_le_of_ne h0 (Ne.symm h); linarith
      · have : 0 < g i v1 := lt_of_le_of_ne h1 (Ne.symm h); linarith
      · have : 0 < g i v2 := lt_of_le_of_ne h2 (Ne.symm h); linarith
    have h3 := hcentroid (g i)
    linarith [hsumpos, h3]
  
  
  
  
  
  
  
  classical
  
  obtain ⟨n, hn⟩ := exists_transverse_dir V
  set e : Plane2 := ![1, (n : ℚ)] with he
  have hslope : ∀ v ∈ V, ∀ w ∈ V, v ≠ w → cross (v - w) e ≠ 0 := hn
  
  have hfeas_id : ∀ (i : Fin m) (δ : ℚ), g i (c0 + δ • e) = g i c0 + δ * (g i).linear e := by
    intro i δ
    have key : (g i).linear ((c0 + δ • e) - c0) = g i (c0 + δ • e) - g i c0 :=
      Proof.HpolytopeVertex.affine_linear_sub (g i) (c0 + δ • e) c0
    have hsub : (c0 + δ • e) - c0 = δ • e := by abel
    rw [hsub, map_smul, smul_eq_mul] at key
    linarith [key]
  
  have hcross_id : ∀ (v w : Plane2) (δ : ℚ),
      cross (v - (c0 + δ • e)) (w - (c0 + δ • e))
        = cross (v - c0) (w - c0) - δ * cross (v - w) e := by
    intro v w δ
    simp only [cross, Pi.sub_apply, Pi.add_apply, Pi.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul]; ring
  
  set B : Finset (Fin m) := Finset.univ.filter (fun i => Proof.HpolytopeVertex.NonVacuous (g i))
    with hB
  set δi : Fin m → ℚ := fun i => g i c0 / (1 + |(g i).linear e|) with hδi
  set δfeas : ℚ := if h : B.Nonempty then B.inf' h δi else 1 with hδfeas
  have hδfeas_pos : 0 < δfeas := by
    rw [hδfeas]; split
    · next h =>
      rw [Finset.lt_inf'_iff]; intro i hi
      rw [hB, Finset.mem_filter] at hi
      have := hc0feas i hi.2; positivity
    · exact one_pos
  have hδfeas_le : ∀ i ∈ B, δfeas ≤ δi i := by
    intro i hi; rw [hδfeas, dif_pos ⟨i, hi⟩]; exact Finset.inf'_le δi hi
  
  set Forbidden : Finset ℚ := (V ×ˢ V).image
    (fun p => cross (p.1 - c0) (p.2 - c0) / cross (p.1 - p.2) e) with hForb
  
  set cand : ℕ → ℚ := fun k => δfeas / ((k : ℚ) + 2) with hcand
  have hcand_inj : Function.Injective cand := by
    intro a b hab
    rw [hcand] at hab; simp only at hab
    have ha2 : ((a : ℚ) + 2) ≠ 0 := by positivity
    have hb2 : ((b : ℚ) + 2) ≠ 0 := by positivity
    rw [div_eq_div_iff ha2 hb2] at hab
    have hac : ((a : ℚ) + 2) = ((b : ℚ) + 2) :=
      mul_left_cancel₀ (ne_of_gt hδfeas_pos) (by linarith [hab])
    have : (a : ℚ) = (b : ℚ) := by linarith
    exact_mod_cast this
  obtain ⟨k, hk⟩ := Finset.exists_not_mem (Forbidden.preimage cand hcand_inj.injOn)
  have hkForb : cand k ∉ Forbidden := fun h => hk (Finset.mem_preimage.mpr h)
  set δ : ℚ := cand k with hδ
  have hδpos : 0 < δ := by rw [hδ, hcand]; positivity
  have hδlt : δ < δfeas := by
    rw [hδ, hcand, div_lt_iff₀ (by positivity : (0 : ℚ) < (k : ℚ) + 2)]
    nlinarith [hδfeas_pos, Nat.cast_nonneg (α := ℚ) k]
  refine ⟨c0 + δ • e, ?_, ?_⟩
  · 
    intro i hnv
    rw [hfeas_id]
    have hiB : i ∈ B := Finset.mem_filter.mpr ⟨Finset.mem_univ i, hnv⟩
    have hlt : δ < δi i := lt_of_lt_of_le hδlt (hδfeas_le i hiB)
    have hgc0 : 0 < g i c0 := hc0feas i hnv
    have hden : (0 : ℚ) < 1 + |(g i).linear e| := by positivity
    rw [hδi, lt_div_iff₀ hden] at hlt
    have h1 : δ * |(g i).linear e| ≤ δ * (1 + |(g i).linear e|) :=
      mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (by linarith [abs_nonneg ((g i).linear e)]) (le_of_lt hδpos)
    have h3 : -(δ * |(g i).linear e|) ≤ δ * (g i).linear e := by
      nlinarith [neg_abs_le ((g i).linear e), abs_nonneg ((g i).linear e),
        le_abs_self ((g i).linear e), hδpos]
    linarith [h1, h3, hlt]
  · 
    intro v hv w hw hvw
    rw [hcross_id]
    have hslope_ne : cross (v - w) e ≠ 0 := hslope v hv w hw hvw
    intro hzero
    apply hkForb
    rw [hForb, Finset.mem_image]
    refine ⟨(v, w), Finset.mem_product.mpr ⟨hv, hw⟩, ?_⟩
    rw [hδ]; field_simp; linarith [hzero]

name: cmp_same_half
statement:
theorem cmp_same_half (c v w : Plane2)
    (h : upperHalf c v ↔ upperHalf c w) :
    cmp c v w = decide (0 ≤ cross (v - c) (w - c))
proof:
:= by
  classical
  unfold cmp
  by_cases huv : upperHalf c v
  · have huw : upperHalf c w := h.mp huv
    simp [huv, huw]
  · have huw : ¬ upperHalf c w := fun hw => huv (h.mpr hw)
    simp [huv, huw]

name: cmp_up_low
statement:
theorem cmp_up_low (c v w : Plane2)
    (hv : upperHalf c v) (hw : ¬ upperHalf c w) : cmp c v w = true
proof:
:= by
  classical
  unfold cmp; simp [hv, hw]

name: trans_half_strict
statement:
private theorem trans_half_strict {a b d : Plane2}
    (hb : b ≠ 0) (ha1 : 0 ≤ a 1) (hb1 : 0 ≤ b 1) (hd1 : 0 ≤ d 1)
    (had_ne : cross a d ≠ 0)
    (hab : 0 < cross a b) (hbd : 0 < cross b d) :
    0 < cross a d
proof:
:= by
  have hotimes := Proof.CrossProduct.cross_otimes a b d
  rcases lt_or_eq_of_le hb1 with hb1pos | hb1zero
  · 
    have hsum_nonneg : 0 ≤ cross a d * b 1 := by
      rw [hotimes]
      have t1 : 0 ≤ cross a b * d 1 := mul_nonneg (le_of_lt hab) hd1
      have t2 : 0 ≤ cross b d * a 1 := mul_nonneg (le_of_lt hbd) ha1
      linarith
    have had_nonneg : 0 ≤ cross a d := by
      by_contra h; push_neg at h
      have : cross a d * b 1 < 0 := mul_neg_of_neg_of_pos h hb1pos
      linarith
    exact lt_of_le_of_ne had_nonneg (Ne.symm had_ne)
  · 
    exfalso
    have hb1z : b 1 = 0 := hb1zero.symm
    rcases lt_trichotomy (b 0) 0 with hb0 | hb0 | hb0
    · 
      have : cross b d = b 0 * d 1 := by simp only [cross, hb1z]; ring
      rw [this] at hbd
      linarith [mul_nonpos_of_nonpos_of_nonneg (le_of_lt hb0) hd1]
    · 
      apply hb; funext i; fin_cases i
      · simpa using hb0
      · simpa using hb1z
    · 
      have : cross a b = - (a 1 * b 0) := by simp only [cross, hb1z]; ring
      rw [this] at hab
      linarith [mul_nonneg ha1 (le_of_lt hb0)]

name: upperHalf_nonneg
statement: private theorem upperHalf_nonneg {c v : Plane2} (h : upperHalf c v) : 0 ≤ (v - c) 1
proof:
:= by
  rcases h with h | ⟨h, _⟩
  · exact le_of_lt h
  · exact le_of_eq h.symm

name: lower_nonpos
statement: private theorem lower_nonpos {c v : Plane2} (h : ¬ upperHalf c v) : (v - c) 1 ≤ 0
proof:
:= by
  unfold upperHalf at h; push_neg at h
  exact h.1

name: cross_neg_neg
statement: private theorem cross_neg_neg (x y : Plane2) : cross (-x) (-y) = cross x y
proof:
:= by
  simp only [cross, Pi.neg_apply]; ring

name: sep_threeterm
statement:
private theorem sep_threeterm {a0 a1 a2 : ℚ} {l0 l1 l2 : ℚ}
    (hl0 : 0 < l0) (hl1 : 0 < l1) (hl2 : 0 < l2)
    (hsum : l0 * a0 + l1 * a1 + l2 * a2 = 0)
    (hnz : ¬ (a0 = 0 ∧ a1 = 0 ∧ a2 = 0)) :
    (0 < a0 ∨ 0 < a1 ∨ 0 < a2) ∧ (a0 < 0 ∨ a1 < 0 ∨ a2 < 0)
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · by_contra h; push_neg at h
    obtain ⟨h0, h1, h2⟩ := h
    have t0 : l0 * a0 ≤ 0 := mul_nonpos_of_nonneg_of_nonpos (le_of_lt hl0) h0
    have t1 : l1 * a1 ≤ 0 := mul_nonpos_of_nonneg_of_nonpos (le_of_lt hl1) h1
    have t2 : l2 * a2 ≤ 0 := mul_nonpos_of_nonneg_of_nonpos (le_of_lt hl2) h2
    have e0 : l0 * a0 = 0 := le_antisymm t0 (by linarith)
    have e1 : l1 * a1 = 0 := le_antisymm t1 (by linarith)
    have e2 : l2 * a2 = 0 := le_antisymm t2 (by linarith)
    exact hnz ⟨(mul_eq_zero.mp e0).resolve_left (ne_of_gt hl0),
      (mul_eq_zero.mp e1).resolve_left (ne_of_gt hl1),
      (mul_eq_zero.mp e2).resolve_left (ne_of_gt hl2)⟩
  · by_contra h; push_neg at h
    obtain ⟨h0, h1, h2⟩ := h
    have t0 : 0 ≤ l0 * a0 := mul_nonneg (le_of_lt hl0) h0
    have t1 : 0 ≤ l1 * a1 := mul_nonneg (le_of_lt hl1) h1
    have t2 : 0 ≤ l2 * a2 := mul_nonneg (le_of_lt hl2) h2
    have e0 : l0 * a0 = 0 := le_antisymm (by linarith) t0
    have e1 : l1 * a1 = 0 := le_antisymm (by linarith) t1
    have e2 : l2 * a2 = 0 := le_antisymm (by linarith) t2
    exact hnz ⟨(mul_eq_zero.mp e0).resolve_left (ne_of_gt hl0),
      (mul_eq_zero.mp e1).resolve_left (ne_of_gt hl1),
      (mul_eq_zero.mp e2).resolve_left (ne_of_gt hl2)⟩

name: sep_cross
proof:
:= by
  
  
  set a0 := cross q (T.v0 - c) with ha0
  set a1 := cross q (T.v1 - c) with ha1
  set a2 := cross q (T.v2 - c) with ha2
  have hweighted : T.l0 * a0 + T.l1 * a1 + T.l2 * a2 = 0 := by
    have hcc : cross q (c - c) = 0 := by rw [sub_self]; simp [cross]
    have hcomb := T.comb
    have hsum1 := T.sum1
    
    have key : T.l0 * a0 + T.l1 * a1 + T.l2 * a2 = cross q (c - c) := by
      rw [ha0, ha1, ha2]
      have e : c - c = T.l0 • (T.v0 - c) + T.l1 • (T.v1 - c) + T.l2 • (T.v2 - c) := by
        funext i
        have hci := congrFun hcomb i
        simp only [Pi.add_apply, Pi.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul] at hci
        have hs : T.l0 * c i + T.l1 * c i + T.l2 * c i = c i := by
          have : (T.l0 + T.l1 + T.l2) * c i = 1 * c i := by rw [hsum1]
          linear_combination this
        simp only [Pi.sub_apply, Pi.add_apply, Pi.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul]
        rw [mul_sub, mul_sub, mul_sub]; rw [hci] at *; linarith [hs]
      rw [e]
      simp only [cross, Pi.add_apply, Pi.sub_apply, Pi.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul]; ring
    rw [key, hcc]
  
  have hnz : ¬ (a0 = 0 ∧ a1 = 0 ∧ a2 = 0) := by
    rintro ⟨z0, z1, z2⟩
    
    have d1 : cross q (T.v1 - T.v0) = 0 := by
      have : cross q (T.v1 - T.v0) = a1 - a0 := by
        rw [ha0, ha1]; simp only [cross, Pi.sub_apply]; ring
      rw [this, z0, z1]; ring
    have d2 : cross q (T.v2 - T.v0) = 0 := by
      have : cross q (T.v2 - T.v0) = a2 - a0 := by
        rw [ha0, ha2]; simp only [cross, Pi.sub_apply]; ring
      rw [this, z0, z2]; ring
    
    have hdet : cross (T.v1 - T.v0) (T.v2 - T.v0) ≠ 0 :=
      cross_ne_zero_of_affineIndependent T.ai
    apply hq
    
    have hqall : ∀ w : Plane2, cross q w = 0 := by
      intro w
      rw [cramer (T.v1 - T.v0) (T.v2 - T.v0) w hdet]
      rw [Proof.CrossProduct.cross_add_right, Proof.CrossProduct.cross_smul_right,
          Proof.CrossProduct.cross_smul_right, d1, d2]
      ring
    
    have hq0 : q 0 = 0 := by
      have := hqall ![0, 1]
      simp only [cross, Matrix.cons_val_zero, Matrix.cons_val_one, Matrix.head_cons,
        mul_one, mul_zero, sub_zero] at this
      exact this
    have hq1 : q 1 = 0 := by
      have := hqall ![1, 0]
      simp only [cross, Matrix.cons_val_zero, Matrix.cons_val_one, Matrix.head_cons,
        mul_one, mul_zero, zero_sub, neg_eq_zero] at this
      exact this
    funext i; fin_cases i
    · simpa using hq0
    · simpa using hq1
  obtain ⟨hpos, hneg⟩ := sep_threeterm T.pos0 T.pos1 T.pos2 hweighted hnz
  constructor
  · rcases hpos with h | h | h
    · exact ⟨T.v0, T.mem0, h⟩
    · exact ⟨T.v1, T.mem1, h⟩
    · exact ⟨T.v2, T.mem2, h⟩
  · rcases hneg with h | h | h
    · exact ⟨T.v0, T.mem0, h⟩
    · exact ⟨T.v1, T.mem1, h⟩
    · exact ⟨T.v2, T.mem2, h⟩

name: straddle_core
statement:
private theorem straddle_core {P Q U : Plane2}
    (hQ1 : 0 ≤ Q 1) (hQ4 : Q 1 = 0 → 0 < Q 0)
    (hU1 : 0 ≤ U 1) (hU4 : U 1 = 0 → 0 < U 0)
    (hP1 : P 1 ≤ 0) (hQPne : cross Q P ≠ 0)
    (hPU : 0 < cross P U) (hQU : 0 ≤ cross Q U) :
    0 < cross P Q
proof:
:= by
  
  have hUP : cross U P < 0 := by
    have := Proof.CrossProduct.cross_antisymm P U; linarith [hPU, this]
  rcases lt_or_eq_of_le hU1 with hU1pos | hU1zero
  · 
    
    have hotimes := Proof.CrossProduct.cross_otimes Q U P
    
    have t1 : cross Q U * P 1 ≤ 0 := mul_nonpos_of_nonneg_of_nonpos hQU hP1
    have t2 : cross U P * Q 1 ≤ 0 := mul_nonpos_of_nonpos_of_nonneg (le_of_lt hUP) hQ1
    have hle : cross Q P * U 1 ≤ 0 := by rw [hotimes]; linarith
    have hQPle : cross Q P ≤ 0 := by
      by_contra h; push_neg at h
      have : 0 < cross Q P * U 1 := mul_pos h hU1pos
      linarith
    
    have hQPlt : cross Q P < 0 := lt_of_le_of_ne hQPle hQPne
    have := Proof.CrossProduct.cross_antisymm Q P; linarith
  · 
    have hU1z : U 1 = 0 := hU1zero.symm
    have hU0 : 0 < U 0 := hU4 hU1z
    
    have hUPval : cross U P = U 0 * P 1 := by simp only [cross, hU1z]; ring
    have hP1neg : P 1 < 0 := by
      rw [hUPval] at hUP
      by_contra h; push_neg at h
      have : 0 ≤ U 0 * P 1 := mul_nonneg (le_of_lt hU0) h
      linarith
    
    have hQUval : cross Q U = - (Q 1 * U 0) := by simp only [cross, hU1z]; ring
    have hQ1z : Q 1 = 0 := by
      rw [hQUval] at hQU
      have : Q 1 * U 0 ≤ 0 := by linarith
      have hQ1le : Q 1 ≤ 0 := by
        by_contra h; push_neg at h
        have : 0 < Q 1 * U 0 := mul_pos h hU0
        linarith
      linarith [hQ1, hQ1le]
    have hQ0 : 0 < Q 0 := hQ4 hQ1z
    
    have : cross P Q = - (P 1 * Q 0) := by simp only [cross, hQ1z]; ring
    rw [this]
    have : P 1 * Q 0 < 0 := mul_neg_of_neg_of_pos hP1neg hQ0
    linarith

name: straddle_sign
statement:
private theorem straddle_sign {Q P : Plane2}
    (dirs : Plane2 → Prop) (upper : Plane2 → Prop)
    
    (hclass : ∀ x, dirs x → (upper x ∧ 0 ≤ x 1 ∧ (x 1 = 0 → 0 < x 0))
                        ∨ (¬ upper x ∧ x 1 ≤ 0 ∧ (x 1 = 0 → x 0 < 0)))
    (hQdir : dirs Q) (hPdir : dirs P)
    (hQup : upper Q) (hPlo : ¬ upper P)
    (hQPne : cross Q P ≠ 0)
    
    (hQmin : ∀ x, dirs x → upper x → x ≠ Q → 0 < cross Q x)
    
    (hPmax : ∀ x, dirs x → ¬ upper x → x ≠ P → cross P x < 0)
    
    (hsepP : ∃ z, dirs z ∧ 0 < cross P z) :
    0 < cross P Q
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨U, hUdir, hPU⟩ := hsepP
  
  
  have hUup : upper U := by
    by_contra hUlo
    by_cases hUP : U = P
    · rw [hUP, Proof.CrossProduct.cross_self] at hPU; exact lt_irrefl 0 hPU
    · exact absurd (hPmax U hUdir hUlo hUP) (not_lt.mpr (le_of_lt hPU))
  
  rcases hclass Q hQdir with ⟨_, hQ1, hQ4⟩ | ⟨hcon, _, _⟩
  swap; · exact absurd hQup hcon
  rcases hclass U hUdir with ⟨_, hU1, hU4⟩ | ⟨hcon, _, _⟩
  swap; · exact absurd hUup hcon
  rcases hclass P hPdir with ⟨hcon, _, _⟩ | ⟨_, hP1, _⟩
  · exact absurd hcon hPlo
  
  by_cases hUQ : U = Q
  · rw [hUQ] at hPU; exact hPU
  · 
    have hQU : 0 ≤ cross Q U := le_of_lt (hQmin U hUdir hUup hUQ)
    exact straddle_core hQ1 hQ4 hU1 hU4 hP1 hQPne hPU hQU

name: wedge_cross_half_imposs
statement:
private theorem wedge_cross_half_imposs {a d x : Plane2}
    (ha1 : 0 ≤ a 1) (_ha4 : a 1 = 0 → 0 < a 0)
    (hd1 : 0 ≤ d 1) (_hd4 : d 1 = 0 → 0 < d 0)
    (hx1 : x 1 ≤ 0)
    (had : 0 < cross a d)
    (hax : 0 < cross a x) (hxd : 0 < cross x d) : False
proof:
:= by
  
  have hotimes := Proof.CrossProduct.cross_otimes a x d
  
  have hrhs : 0 ≤ cross a x * d 1 + cross x d * a 1 :=
    add_nonneg (mul_nonneg (le_of_lt hax) hd1) (mul_nonneg (le_of_lt hxd) ha1)
  have hlhs : cross a d * x 1 ≤ 0 := mul_nonpos_of_nonneg_of_nonpos (le_of_lt had) hx1
  have hzero : cross a d * x 1 = 0 := le_antisymm hlhs (by rw [hotimes]; exact hrhs)
  
  have hx1z : x 1 = 0 := by
    rcases mul_eq_zero.mp hzero with h | h
    · exact absurd h (ne_of_gt had)
    · exact h
  
  have hrhs0 : cross a x * d 1 + cross x d * a 1 = 0 := by rw [← hotimes, hzero]
  have hd1z : d 1 = 0 := by
    have t1 : 0 ≤ cross a x * d 1 := mul_nonneg (le_of_lt hax) hd1
    have t2 : 0 ≤ cross x d * a 1 := mul_nonneg (le_of_lt hxd) ha1
    have : cross a x * d 1 = 0 := by linarith
    rcases mul_eq_zero.mp this with h | h
    · exact absurd h (ne_of_gt hax)
    · exact h
  have ha1z : a 1 = 0 := by
    have t1 : 0 ≤ cross a x * d 1 := mul_nonneg (le_of_lt hax) hd1
    have t2 : 0 ≤ cross x d * a 1 := mul_nonneg (le_of_lt hxd) ha1
    have : cross x d * a 1 = 0 := by linarith
    rcases mul_eq_zero.mp this with h | h
    · exact absurd h (ne_of_gt hxd)
    · exact h
  
  have : cross a d = 0 := by simp only [cross, ha1z, hd1z]; ring
  exact absurd this (ne_of_gt had)

name: parallel_scalar
statement:
private theorem parallel_scalar {X Y : Plane2} (hX : X ≠ 0) (hc : cross X Y = 0) :
    ∃ lam : ℚ, Y = lam • X
proof:
:= by
  have hcross : X 0 * Y 1 - X 1 * Y 0 = 0 := by unfold cross at hc; linarith
  by_cases hX0 : X 0 = 0
