  · have hX1 : X 1 ≠ 0 := by
      intro h1; apply hX; funext i; fin_cases i <;> simp_all
    have hY0 : Y 0 = 0 := by
      have : X 1 * Y 0 = 0 := by rw [hX0] at hcross; linarith
      rcases mul_eq_zero.mp this with h | h
      · exact absurd h hX1
      · exact h
    refine ⟨Y 1 / X 1, ?_⟩
    funext i; fin_cases i
    · show Y 0 = Y 1 / X 1 * X 0
      rw [hX0, mul_zero]; exact hY0
    · show Y 1 = Y 1 / X 1 * X 1
      field_simp
  · refine ⟨Y 0 / X 0, ?_⟩
    funext i; fin_cases i
    · show Y 0 = Y 0 / X 0 * X 0
      field_simp
    · show Y 1 = Y 0 / X 0 * X 1
      have hh : X 0 * Y 1 = X 1 * Y 0 := by linarith
      field_simp
      linarith [hh]

name: nearer_not_extreme
statement:
private theorem nearer_not_extreme {V : Finset Plane2} {P' : Set Plane2}
    (hext : ∀ x ∈ V, x ∈ Set.extremePoints ℚ P')
    (hVsub : (↑V : Set Plane2) ⊆ P')
    {c : Plane2} (hcP' : c ∈ P')
    {a b : Plane2} (haV : a ∈ V) (hbV : b ∈ V) (hab : a ≠ b)
    (μ : ℚ) (hμ : 1 < μ) (hpar : a - c = μ • (b - c)) :
    False
proof:
:= by
  have hμ0 : (0:ℚ) < μ := by linarith
  set s := 1/μ with hs
  have hs0 : 0 < s := by rw [hs]; positivity
  have hbc : b - c = s • (a - c) := by
    rw [hpar, smul_smul, hs, one_div, inv_mul_cancel₀ (ne_of_gt hμ0), one_smul]
  have hbeq : (1 - s) • c + s • a = b := by
    funext i
    have hi := congrFun hbc i
    simp only [Pi.sub_apply, Pi.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul] at hi ⊢
    simp only [Pi.add_apply, Pi.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul]
    linarith
  have hs1 : s < 1 := by rw [hs, div_lt_one hμ0]; exact hμ
  have hb_seg : b ∈ openSegment ℚ c a :=
    mem_openSegment_mk (1 - s) s (by linarith) hs0 (by ring) hbeq
  have haP' : a ∈ P' := hVsub haV
  have hbext := hext b hbV
  rw [mem_extremePoints] at hbext
  exact hab (hbext.2 c hcP' a haP' hb_seg).2

name: straddle_ne
statement:
private theorem straddle_ne {Q P : Plane2}
    (dirs : Plane2 → Prop) (upper : Plane2 → Prop)
    (hclass : ∀ x, dirs x → (upper x ∧ 0 ≤ x 1 ∧ (x 1 = 0 → 0 < x 0))
                        ∨ (¬ upper x ∧ x 1 ≤ 0 ∧ (x 1 = 0 → x 0 < 0)))
    (hQdir : dirs Q) (hPdir : dirs P)
    (hQup : upper Q) (hPlo : ¬ upper P)
    (hQne : Q ≠ 0) (hPne : P ≠ 0)
    (hQmin : ∀ x, dirs x → upper x → x ≠ Q → 0 < cross Q x)
    (hPmax : ∀ x, dirs x → ¬ upper x → x ≠ P → cross P x < 0)
    (hsepQ : ∃ z, dirs z ∧ cross Q z < 0) :
    cross Q P ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  intro hQP0
  obtain ⟨z, hzdir, hzneg⟩ := hsepQ
  rcases hclass Q hQdir with ⟨_, hQ1, hQ4⟩ | ⟨hcon, _, _⟩
  swap; · exact absurd hQup hcon
  rcases hclass P hPdir with ⟨hcon, _, _⟩ | ⟨_, hP1, hP4⟩
  · exact absurd hcon hPlo
  obtain ⟨lam, hlam⟩ := parallel_scalar hQne hQP0
  have hlamneg : lam < 0 := by
    have hP1eq : P 1 = lam * Q 1 := by rw [hlam]; simp [Pi.smul_apply]
    rcases lt_or_eq_of_le hQ1 with hQ1pos | hQ1zero
    · have hle : lam ≤ 0 := by
        by_contra h; push_neg at h
        have : 0 < P 1 := by rw [hP1eq]; exact mul_pos h hQ1pos
        linarith
      rcases lt_or_eq_of_le hle with h | h
      · exact h
      · exfalso; apply hPne; rw [hlam, h, zero_smul]
    · have hQ1z : Q 1 = 0 := hQ1zero.symm
      have hQ0pos : 0 < Q 0 := hQ4 hQ1z
      have hP1z : P 1 = 0 := by rw [hP1eq, hQ1z, mul_zero]
      have hP0neg : P 0 < 0 := hP4 hP1z
      have hP0eq : P 0 = lam * Q 0 := by rw [hlam]; simp [Pi.smul_apply]
      by_contra h; push_neg at h
      have : 0 ≤ P 0 := by rw [hP0eq]; exact mul_nonneg h (le_of_lt hQ0pos)
      linarith
  have hPz : cross P z = lam * cross Q z := by
    rw [hlam, Proof.CrossProduct.cross_smul_left]
  have hPzpos : 0 < cross P z := by rw [hPz]; exact mul_pos_of_neg_of_neg hlamneg hzneg
  have hzlo : ¬ upper z := by
    intro hzup
    have hzQ : z ≠ Q := by
      rintro rfl; rw [Proof.CrossProduct.cross_self] at hzneg; exact lt_irrefl 0 hzneg
    have := hQmin z hzdir hzup hzQ
    linarith
  by_cases hzP : z = P
  · rw [hzP, Proof.CrossProduct.cross_self] at hPzpos; exact lt_irrefl 0 hPzpos
  · have := hPmax z hzdir hzlo hzP; linarith

name: cross_zero_of_mem_segment
statement:
private theorem cross_zero_of_mem_segment {c a b : Plane2}
    (h : c ∈ convexHull ℚ ({a, b} : Set Plane2)) : cross (a - c) (b - c) = 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [convexHull_pair, segment_eq_image] at h
  simp only [Set.mem_image, Set.mem_Icc] at h
  obtain ⟨t, ⟨_, _⟩, hc⟩ := h
  rw [← hc]
  simp only [cross, Pi.sub_apply, Pi.add_apply, Pi.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul]; ring

name: tri_of_mem
statement:
private theorem tri_of_mem {c : Plane2} {V : Finset Plane2}
    (hcmem : c ∈ convexHull ℚ (↑V : Set Plane2))
    (hcard : 3 ≤ V.card)
    (hcoll : ∀ a ∈ V, ∀ b ∈ V, ∀ c0 ∈ V, a ≠ b → a ≠ c0 → b ≠ c0 →
      AffineIndependent ℚ ![a, b, c0])
    (hnc : ∀ v ∈ V, ∀ w ∈ V, v ≠ w → cross (v - c) (w - c) ≠ 0) :
    Nonempty (Tri c V)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  
  rw [convexHull_eq_union] at hcmem
  simp only [Set.mem_iUnion] at hcmem
  obtain ⟨T, hTS, hTai, hcT⟩ := hcmem
  have hcard3 : T.card ≤ 3 := by
    have hb := hTai.card_le_finrank_succ
    have key : Fintype.card {x // x ∈ (↑T : Set Plane2)} ≤ Module.finrank ℚ Plane2 + 1 :=
      le_trans hb (by gcongr; exact Submodule.finrank_le _)
    rw [show Module.finrank ℚ Plane2 = 2 from Module.finrank_fin_fun ℚ,
        show Fintype.card {x // x ∈ (↑T : Set Plane2)} = T.card from by
          simp [Fintype.card_coe]] at key
    omega
  
  have hTV : ∀ x ∈ T, x ∈ V := fun x hx => hTS hx
  have hcard_ge : 3 ≤ T.card := by
    by_contra hlt; push_neg at hlt
    interval_cases h : T.card
    · 
      rw [Finset.card_eq_zero] at h; subst h
      simp only [Finset.coe_empty, convexHull_empty, Set.mem_empty_iff_false] at hcT
    · 
      rw [Finset.card_eq_one] at h
      obtain ⟨v, hv⟩ := h
      rw [hv] at hcT hTV
      simp only [Finset.coe_singleton, convexHull_singleton, Set.mem_singleton_iff] at hcT
      have hvV : v ∈ V := hTV v (Finset.mem_singleton_self v)
      
      obtain ⟨w, hwV, hwv⟩ : ∃ w ∈ V, w ≠ v := by
        by_contra hcon; push_neg at hcon
        have hsub : V ⊆ {v} := fun x hx => Finset.mem_singleton.mpr (hcon x hx)
        have := Finset.card_le_card hsub
        simp only [Finset.card_singleton] at this; omega
      exact hnc v hvV w hwV (Ne.symm hwv) (by rw [← hcT, sub_self]; simp [cross])
    · 
      rw [Finset.card_eq_two] at h
      obtain ⟨a, b, hab, hT2⟩ := h
      rw [hT2] at hcT hTV
      have haV : a ∈ V := hTV a (by simp)
      have hbV : b ∈ V := hTV b (by simp)
      rw [Finset.coe_insert, Finset.coe_singleton] at hcT
      exact hnc a haV b hbV hab (cross_zero_of_mem_segment hcT)
  have hcard_eq : T.card = 3 := le_antisymm hcard3 hcard_ge
  
  obtain ⟨v0, v1, v2, h01, h02, h12, hTeq⟩ := Finset.card_eq_three.mp hcard_eq
  have hv0 : v0 ∈ V := hTV v0 (by rw [hTeq]; simp)
  have hv1 : v1 ∈ V := hTV v1 (by rw [hTeq]; simp)
  have hv2 : v2 ∈ V := hTV v2 (by rw [hTeq]; simp)
  
  rw [hTeq, Finset.convexHull_eq] at hcT
  simp only [Set.mem_setOf_eq] at hcT
  obtain ⟨w, hw0, hw1, hwcm⟩ := hcT
  
  set l0 := w v0; set l1 := w v1; set l2 := w v2
  have hl0nn : 0 ≤ l0 := hw0 v0 (by simp)
  have hl1nn : 0 ≤ l1 := hw0 v1 (by simp)
  have hl2nn : 0 ≤ l2 := hw0 v2 (by simp)
  have hsum : l0 + l1 + l2 = 1 := by
    rw [← hw1]; rw [Finset.sum_insert (by simp [h01, h02]),
      Finset.sum_insert (by simp [h12]), Finset.sum_singleton]; ring
  
  have hcomb : c = l0 • v0 + l1 • v1 + l2 • v2 := by
    rw [← hwcm, Finset.centerMass]
    have hden : (∑ y ∈ ({v0, v1, v2} : Finset Plane2), w y) = 1 := hw1
    have hnum : (∑ x ∈ ({v0, v1, v2} : Finset Plane2), w x • id x)
        = l0 • v0 + l1 • v1 + l2 • v2 := by
      rw [Finset.sum_insert (by simp [h01, h02]), Finset.sum_insert (by simp [h12]),
          Finset.sum_singleton]
      simp only [id_eq, add_assoc]
    rw [hden, hnum, inv_one, one_smul]
  
  
  
  have hcross_two : ∀ {a b : Plane2} (la lb : ℚ), a ∈ V → b ∈ V → a ≠ b →
      0 ≤ la → 0 ≤ lb → la + lb = 1 → c = la • a + lb • b → False := by
    intro a b la lb haV hbV hab hla hlb hlab hccomb
    apply hnc a haV b hbV hab
    
    apply cross_zero_of_mem_segment (a := a) (b := b)
    rw [convexHull_pair, segment_eq_image]
    refine ⟨lb, ⟨hlb, by linarith⟩, ?_⟩
    rw [hccomb]; funext i
    simp only [Pi.add_apply, Pi.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul]
    have hla' : la = 1 - lb := by linarith
    rw [hla']
  have hpos0 : 0 < l0 := by
    rcases lt_or_eq_of_le hl0nn with h | h; · exact h
    exfalso; apply hcross_two l1 l2 hv1 hv2 h12 hl1nn hl2nn (by linarith [hsum, h.symm])
    rw [hcomb, ← h]; simp [zero_smul]
  have hpos1 : 0 < l1 := by
    rcases lt_or_eq_of_le hl1nn with h | h; · exact h
    exfalso; apply hcross_two l0 l2 hv0 hv2 h02 hl0nn hl2nn (by linarith [hsum, h.symm])
    rw [hcomb, ← h]; simp only [zero_smul, add_zero]
  have hpos2 : 0 < l2 := by
    rcases lt_or_eq_of_le hl2nn with h | h; · exact h
    exfalso; apply hcross_two l0 l1 hv0 hv1 h01 hl0nn hl1nn (by linarith [hsum, h.symm])
    rw [hcomb, ← h]; simp [zero_smul]
  exact ⟨⟨v0, v1, v2, hv0, hv1, hv2, l0, l1, l2,
    hpos0, hpos1, hpos2, hcomb, hsum,
    hcoll v0 hv0 v1 hv1 v2 hv2 h01 h02 h12⟩⟩

name: cmp_trans
statement:
private theorem cmp_trans {c : Plane2} {V : Finset Plane2}
    (hnc : ∀ v ∈ V, ∀ w ∈ V, v ≠ w → cross (v - c) (w - c) ≠ 0)
    (a b d : Plane2) (haV : a ∈ V) (hbV : b ∈ V) (hdV : d ∈ V)
    (hab : cmp c a b) (hbd : cmp c b d) : cmp c a d
proof:
:= by
  classical
  
  have hcr : ∀ x ∈ V, ∀ y ∈ V, x ≠ y → cross (x - c) (y - c) ≠ 0 := hnc
  
  by_cases hab' : a = b
  · subst hab'; exact hbd
  by_cases hbd' : b = d
  · subst hbd'; exact hab
  by_cases had' : a = d
  · subst had'
    
    rw [cmp_same_half c a a (Iff.rfl)]
    simp [Proof.CrossProduct.cross_self]
  
  
  by_cases ha : upperHalf c a <;> by_cases hb : upperHalf c b <;> by_cases hd : upperHalf c d
  · 
    have hAB : 0 < cross (a - c) (b - c) := by
      have := hab; rw [cmp_same_half c a b ⟨fun _ => hb, fun _ => ha⟩, decide_eq_true_eq] at this
      exact lt_of_le_of_ne this (Ne.symm (hcr a haV b hbV hab'))
    have hBD : 0 < cross (b - c) (d - c) := by
      have := hbd; rw [cmp_same_half c b d ⟨fun _ => hd, fun _ => hb⟩, decide_eq_true_eq] at this
      exact lt_of_le_of_ne this (Ne.symm (hcr b hbV d hdV hbd'))
    have hbn : b - c ≠ 0 := by
      intro he; rw [he] at hBD
      rw [show cross (0 : Plane2) (d - c) = 0 by simp [cross]] at hBD; exact lt_irrefl 0 hBD
    have hAD : 0 < cross (a - c) (d - c) :=
      trans_half_strict (b := b - c) hbn
        (upperHalf_nonneg ha) (upperHalf_nonneg hb) (upperHalf_nonneg hd)
        (hcr a haV d hdV had') hAB hBD
    rw [cmp_same_half c a d ⟨fun _ => hd, fun _ => ha⟩]; exact decide_eq_true (le_of_lt hAD)
  · 
    rw [cmp_up_low c a d ha hd]
  · 
    
    exfalso
    have : cmp c b d = false := by unfold cmp; simp [hb, hd]
    rw [this] at hbd; exact absurd hbd (by simp)
  · 
    rw [cmp_up_low c a d ha hd]
  · 
    exfalso
    have : cmp c a b = false := by unfold cmp; simp [ha, hb]
    rw [this] at hab; exact absurd hab (by simp)
  · 
    exfalso
    have : cmp c a b = false := by unfold cmp; simp [ha, hb]
    rw [this] at hab; exact absurd hab (by simp)
  · 
    exfalso
    have : cmp c b d = false := by unfold cmp; simp [hb, hd]
    rw [this] at hbd; exact absurd hbd (by simp)
  · 
    have hAB : 0 < cross (a - c) (b - c) := by
      have := hab; rw [cmp_same_half c a b ⟨fun h => absurd h ha, fun h => absurd h hb⟩,
        decide_eq_true_eq] at this
      exact lt_of_le_of_ne this (Ne.symm (hcr a haV b hbV hab'))
    have hBD : 0 < cross (b - c) (d - c) := by
      have := hbd; rw [cmp_same_half c b d ⟨fun h => absurd h hb, fun h => absurd h hd⟩,
        decide_eq_true_eq] at this
      exact lt_of_le_of_ne this (Ne.symm (hcr b hbV d hdV hbd'))
    
    have hAD0 : cross (-(a - c)) (-(d - c)) ≠ 0 := by
      rw [cross_neg_neg]; exact hcr a haV d hdV had'
    have hABn : 0 < cross (-(a - c)) (-(b - c)) := by rw [cross_neg_neg]; exact hAB
    have hBDn : 0 < cross (-(b - c)) (-(d - c)) := by rw [cross_neg_neg]; exact hBD
    have hbn : -(b - c) ≠ 0 := by
      rw [neg_ne_zero]; intro he
      rw [he] at hBD
      rw [show cross (0 : Plane2) (d - c) = 0 by simp [cross]] at hBD; exact lt_irrefl 0 hBD
    have hAD : 0 < cross (-(a - c)) (-(d - c)) :=
      trans_half_strict (b := -(b - c)) hbn
        (by simp only [Pi.neg_apply]; linarith [lower_nonpos ha])
        (by simp only [Pi.neg_apply]; linarith [lower_nonpos hb])
        (by simp only [Pi.neg_apply]; linarith [lower_nonpos hd])
        hAD0 hABn hBDn
    rw [cross_neg_neg] at hAD
    rw [cmp_same_half c a d ⟨fun h => absurd h ha, fun h => absurd h hd⟩]
    exact decide_eq_true (le_of_lt hAD)

name: cmp_trans_half
statement:
theorem cmp_trans_half {c : Plane2} {V : Finset Plane2}
    (hnc_half : ∀ v ∈ V, ∀ w ∈ V, v ≠ w → (upperHalf c v ↔ upperHalf c w) →
      cross (v - c) (w - c) ≠ 0)
    (a b d : Plane2) (haV : a ∈ V) (hbV : b ∈ V) (hdV : d ∈ V)
    (hab : cmp c a b) (hbd : cmp c b d) : cmp c a d
proof:
:= by
  classical
  by_cases hab' : a = b
  · subst hab'; exact hbd
  by_cases hbd' : b = d
  · subst hbd'; exact hab
  by_cases had' : a = d
  · subst had'
    rw [cmp_same_half c a a (Iff.rfl)]
    simp [Proof.CrossProduct.cross_self]
  by_cases ha : upperHalf c a <;> by_cases hb : upperHalf c b <;> by_cases hd : upperHalf c d
  · 
    have hAB : 0 < cross (a - c) (b - c) := by
      have := hab; rw [cmp_same_half c a b ⟨fun _ => hb, fun _ => ha⟩, decide_eq_true_eq] at this
      exact lt_of_le_of_ne this (Ne.symm (hnc_half a haV b hbV hab' ⟨fun _ => hb, fun _ => ha⟩))
    have hBD : 0 < cross (b - c) (d - c) := by
      have := hbd; rw [cmp_same_half c b d ⟨fun _ => hd, fun _ => hb⟩, decide_eq_true_eq] at this
      exact lt_of_le_of_ne this (Ne.symm (hnc_half b hbV d hdV hbd' ⟨fun _ => hd, fun _ => hb⟩))
    have hbn : b - c ≠ 0 := by
      intro he; rw [he] at hBD
      rw [show cross (0 : Plane2) (d - c) = 0 by simp [cross]] at hBD; exact lt_irrefl 0 hBD
    have hAD : 0 < cross (a - c) (d - c) :=
      trans_half_strict (b := b - c) hbn
        (upperHalf_nonneg ha) (upperHalf_nonneg hb) (upperHalf_nonneg hd)
        (hnc_half a haV d hdV had' ⟨fun _ => hd, fun _ => ha⟩) hAB hBD
    rw [cmp_same_half c a d ⟨fun _ => hd, fun _ => ha⟩]; exact decide_eq_true (le_of_lt hAD)
  · rw [cmp_up_low c a d ha hd]
  · exfalso
    have : cmp c b d = false := by unfold cmp; simp [hb, hd]
    rw [this] at hbd; exact absurd hbd (by simp)
  · rw [cmp_up_low c a d ha hd]
  · exfalso
    have : cmp c a b = false := by unfold cmp; simp [ha, hb]
    rw [this] at hab; exact absurd hab (by simp)
  · exfalso
    have : cmp c a b = false := by unfold cmp; simp [ha, hb]
    rw [this] at hab; exact absurd hab (by simp)
  · exfalso
    have : cmp c b d = false := by unfold cmp; simp [hb, hd]
    rw [this] at hbd; exact absurd hbd (by simp)
  · 
    have hAB : 0 < cross (a - c) (b - c) := by
      have := hab; rw [cmp_same_half c a b ⟨fun h => absurd h ha, fun h => absurd h hb⟩,
        decide_eq_true_eq] at this
      exact lt_of_le_of_ne this (Ne.symm (hnc_half a haV b hbV hab'
        ⟨fun h => absurd h ha, fun h => absurd h hb⟩))
    have hBD : 0 < cross (b - c) (d - c) := by
      have := hbd; rw [cmp_same_half c b d ⟨fun h => absurd h hb, fun h => absurd h hd⟩,
        decide_eq_true_eq] at this
      exact lt_of_le_of_ne this (Ne.symm (hnc_half b hbV d hdV hbd'
        ⟨fun h => absurd h hb, fun h => absurd h hd⟩))
    have hAD0 : cross (-(a - c)) (-(d - c)) ≠ 0 := by
      rw [cross_neg_neg]; exact hnc_half a haV d hdV had' ⟨fun h => absurd h ha, fun h => absurd h hd⟩
    have hABn : 0 < cross (-(a - c)) (-(b - c)) := by rw [cross_neg_neg]; exact hAB
    have hBDn : 0 < cross (-(b - c)) (-(d - c)) := by rw [cross_neg_neg]; exact hBD
    have hbn : -(b - c) ≠ 0 := by
      rw [neg_ne_zero]; intro he
      rw [he] at hBD
      rw [show cross (0 : Plane2) (d - c) = 0 by simp [cross]] at hBD; exact lt_irrefl 0 hBD
    have hAD : 0 < cross (-(a - c)) (-(d - c)) :=
      trans_half_strict (b := -(b - c)) hbn
        (by simp only [Pi.neg_apply]; linarith [lower_nonpos ha])
        (by simp only [Pi.neg_apply]; linarith [lower_nonpos hb])
        (by simp only [Pi.neg_apply]; linarith [lower_nonpos hd])
        hAD0 hABn hBDn
    rw [cross_neg_neg] at hAD
    rw [cmp_same_half c a d ⟨fun h => absurd h ha, fun h => absurd h hd⟩]
    exact decide_eq_true (le_of_lt hAD)

name: cmp_total
statement: theorem cmp_total (c v w : Plane2) : cmp c v w || cmp c w v
proof:
:= by
  classical
  by_cases huv : upperHalf c v <;> by_cases huw : upperHalf c w
  · 
    rw [cmp_same_half c v w ⟨fun _ => huw, fun _ => huv⟩,
        cmp_same_half c w v ⟨fun _ => huv, fun _ => huw⟩, Bool.or_eq_true,
        decide_eq_true_eq, decide_eq_true_eq]
    rcases le_total (0 : ℚ) (cross (v - c) (w - c)) with h | h
    · exact Or.inl h
    · refine Or.inr ?_
      have : cross (w - c) (v - c) = - cross (v - c) (w - c) :=
        Proof.CrossProduct.cross_antisymm _ _
      rw [this]; linarith
  · 
    rw [cmp_up_low c v w huv huw]; simp
  · 
    rw [cmp_up_low c w v huw huv]; simp
  · 
    rw [cmp_same_half c v w ⟨fun h => absurd h huv, fun h => absurd h huw⟩,
        cmp_same_half c w v ⟨fun h => absurd h huw, fun h => absurd h huv⟩, Bool.or_eq_true,
        decide_eq_true_eq, decide_eq_true_eq]
    rcases le_total (0 : ℚ) (cross (v - c) (w - c)) with h | h
    · exact Or.inl h
    · refine Or.inr ?_
      have : cross (w - c) (v - c) = - cross (v - c) (w - c) :=
        Proof.CrossProduct.cross_antisymm _ _
      rw [this]; linarith

name: exists_cyclic_order
statement:
theorem exists_cyclic_order {m : ℕ} (g : Fin m → (Plane2 →ᵃ[ℚ] ℚ))
    (P' : Set Plane2) (hP' : P' = ⋂ i, {y | 0 ≤ g i y})
    (V : Finset Plane2)
    (hVeq : P' = convexHull ℚ (↑V : Set Plane2))
    (_hVP : (↑V : Set Plane2) ⊆ P')
    (hcard : 3 ≤ V.card)
    (hcoll : ∀ a ∈ V, ∀ b ∈ V, ∀ c0 ∈ V, a ≠ b → a ≠ c0 → b ≠ c0 →
      AffineIndependent ℚ ![a, b, c0])
    (_hdim : Module.finrank ℚ (vectorSpan ℚ P') = 2)
    {c : Plane2}
    (hc : (∀ i, Proof.HpolytopeVertex.NonVacuous (g i) → 0 < g i c)
      ∧ (∀ v ∈ V, ∀ w ∈ V, v ≠ w → cross (v - c) (w - c) ≠ 0)) :
    ∃ (r : ℕ) (u : ℕ → Plane2), r = V.card
      ∧ (∀ j, j < r → u j ∈ V)
      ∧ (∀ i j, i < r → j < r → i ≠ j → u i ≠ u j)
      ∧ (∀ v ∈ V, ∃ j, j < r ∧ u j = v)
      ∧ (∀ i, i < r → 0 < cross (u i - c) (u ((i + 1) % r) - c))
      ∧ (∀ i, i < r → ∀ w ∈ V, w ≠ u i → w ≠ u ((i + 1) % r) →
           ¬ (0 < cross (u i - c) (w - c) ∧ 0 < cross (w - c) (u ((i + 1) % r) - c)))
proof:
:= by
  classical
  obtain ⟨hcfeas, hnc⟩ := hc
  
  
  
  set le : {x // x ∈ V} → {x // x ∈ V} → Bool := fun a b => cmp c ↑a ↑b with hle
  set Vl : List {x // x ∈ V} := V.attach.toList with hVl
  set L : List {x // x ∈ V} := List.mergeSort Vl le with hL
  
  set M : List Plane2 := L.map Subtype.val with hM
  
  set u : ℕ → Plane2 := fun i => M.getD i 0 with hu
  
  have hLlen : L.length = V.card := by
    rw [hL, List.length_mergeSort, hVl, Finset.length_toList, Finset.card_attach]
  have hMlen : M.length = V.card := by rw [hM, List.length_map, hLlen]
  set r : ℕ := V.card with hr
  
  have hLperm : L.Perm Vl := by rw [hL]; exact List.mergeSort_perm Vl le
  have hVlnodup : Vl.Nodup := by rw [hVl]; exact V.attach.nodup_toList
  have hLnodup : L.Nodup := hLperm.nodup_iff.mpr hVlnodup
  
  have hLmem : ∀ a : {x // x ∈ V}, a ∈ L := by
    intro a
    rw [hL, List.mem_mergeSort, hVl, Finset.mem_toList]
    exact Finset.mem_attach V a
  
  have hMnodup : M.Nodup := by
    rw [hM]; exact hLnodup.map (fun a b h => Subtype.ext h)
  have hMmem : ∀ x : Plane2, x ∈ M ↔ x ∈ V := by
    intro x
    rw [hM, List.mem_map]
    constructor
    · rintro ⟨a, _, rfl⟩; exact a.2
    · intro hx; exact ⟨⟨x, hx⟩, hLmem ⟨x, hx⟩, rfl⟩
  
  have hugetD : ∀ j (hj : j < r), u j = M.get ⟨j, by rw [hMlen]; exact hj⟩ := by
    intro j hj
    rw [hu]; simp only
    rw [List.getD_eq_getElem M 0 (by rw [hMlen]; exact hj)]; rfl
  have humem : ∀ j, j < r → u j ∈ V := by
    intro j hj
    rw [hugetD j hj]; rw [← hMmem]; exact List.get_mem M _
  
  have htrans : ∀ (a b d : {x // x ∈ V}), le a b → le b d → le a d := by
    intro a b d hab hbd
    exact cmp_trans hnc a.1 b.1 d.1 a.2 b.2 d.2 hab hbd
  have htotal : ∀ (a b : {x // x ∈ V}), le a b || le b a := by
    intro a b; exact cmp_total c a.1 b.1
  have hsorted : List.Pairwise (fun a b => le a b = true) L := by
    rw [hL]; exact List.sorted_mergeSort htrans htotal Vl
  
  
  have hrel : ∀ (i j : Fin L.length), i < j → cmp c ↑(L.get i) ↑(L.get j) := by
    intro i j hij
    exact List.Sorted.rel_get_of_lt hsorted hij
  
  have hLr : L.length = r := by rw [hLlen]
  have huL : ∀ i (hi : i < r), u i = ↑(L.get ⟨i, by rw [hLr]; exact hi⟩) := by
    intro i hi
    rw [hugetD i hi]
    have hiL : i < L.length := by rw [hLr]; exact hi
    
    have hcast : M.get ⟨i, by rw [hMlen]; exact hi⟩
        = Subtype.val (L.get ⟨i, hiL⟩) := by
      simp only [hM, List.get_eq_getElem, List.getElem_map]
    rw [hcast]
  
  have hrelu : ∀ i j, i < j → j < r → cmp c (u i) (u j) := by
    intro i j hij hjr
    have hir : i < r := lt_trans hij hjr
    rw [huL i hir, huL j hjr]
    exact hrel ⟨i, by rw [hLr]; exact hir⟩ ⟨j, by rw [hLr]; exact hjr⟩ (by simpa using hij)
  
  have hcmemV : c ∈ convexHull ℚ (↑V : Set Plane2) := by
    rw [← hVeq, hP']
    simp only [Set.mem_iInter, Set.mem_setOf_eq]
    intro i
    by_cases hv : Proof.HpolytopeVertex.NonVacuous (g i)
    · exact le_of_lt (hcfeas i hv)
    · 
      obtain ⟨v0, hv0V⟩ : ∃ v0, v0 ∈ V := by
        have : V.Nonempty := Finset.card_pos.mp (by omega)
        exact this
      unfold Proof.HpolytopeVertex.NonVacuous at hv; push_neg at hv
      have hv0P' : v0 ∈ P' := by rw [hVeq]; exact subset_convexHull ℚ _ hv0V
      have hgv0 : 0 ≤ g i v0 := by rw [hP'] at hv0P'; simpa using Set.mem_iInter.mp hv0P' i
      have heq : g i c = g i v0 := by
        have hconst : g i c - g i v0 = (g i).linear (c - v0) := by
          have := AffineMap.linearMap_vsub (g i) c v0; simpa using this.symm
        rw [hv] at hconst; simp only [LinearMap.zero_apply] at hconst; linarith [hconst]
      rw [heq]; exact hgv0
  
  obtain ⟨tri⟩ := tri_of_mem hcmemV hcard hcoll hnc
  
  have hnodupu : ∀ i j, i < r → j < r → i ≠ j → u i ≠ u j := by
    intro i j hi hj hij
    rw [hugetD i hi, hugetD j hj]
    intro he
    apply hij
    have := (List.Nodup.get_inj_iff hMnodup).mp he
    simpa using this
  
  have hncu : ∀ i j, i < r → j < r → i ≠ j → cross (u i - c) (u j - c) ≠ 0 := by
    intro i j hi hj hij
    exact hnc (u i) (humem i hi) (u j) (humem j hj) (hnodupu i j hi hj hij)
  
  
  have hsamehalf_pos : ∀ i j, i < r → j < r → i ≠ j →
      (upperHalf c (u i) ↔ upperHalf c (u j)) →
      cmp c (u i) (u j) → 0 < cross (u i - c) (u j - c) := by
    intro i j hi hj hij hiff hcmpij
    rw [cmp_same_half c (u i) (u j) hiff, decide_eq_true_eq] at hcmpij
    exact lt_of_le_of_ne hcmpij (Ne.symm (hncu i j hi hj hij))
  
  have hno_low_up : ∀ i j, i < j → j < r → ¬ upperHalf c (u i) → upperHalf c (u j) → False := by
    intro i j hij hjr hlo hup
    have hcmpij : cmp c (u i) (u j) := hrelu i j hij hjr
    
    have : cmp c (u i) (u j) = false := by unfold cmp; simp [hlo, hup]
    rw [this] at hcmpij; exact absurd hcmpij (by simp)
  
  set m : ℕ := (Finset.range r).filter (fun i => upperHalf c (u i)) |>.card with hm_def
  
  have hpart : ∀ i, i < r → (upperHalf c (u i) ↔ i < m) := by
    
    have hprefix : (Finset.range r).filter (fun i => upperHalf c (u i))
        = Finset.range m := by
      
      have hdc : ∀ i j, i < j → j < r → upperHalf c (u j) → upperHalf c (u i) := by
        intro i j hij hjr hupj
        by_contra hlo
        exact hno_low_up i j hij hjr hlo hupj
      
      apply Finset.eq_of_subset_of_card_le
      · intro i hi
        rw [Finset.mem_filter, Finset.mem_range] at hi
        rw [Finset.mem_range]
        
        
        by_contra hge; push_neg at hge
        have hsub : Finset.range (i + 1) ⊆
            (Finset.range r).filter (fun k => upperHalf c (u k)) := by
          intro k hk
          rw [Finset.mem_range] at hk
          rw [Finset.mem_filter, Finset.mem_range]
          refine ⟨by omega, ?_⟩
          rcases Nat.lt_or_ge k i with hki | hki
          · exact hdc k i hki hi.1 hi.2
          · have : k = i := by omega
            rw [this]; exact hi.2
        have hcard_le := Finset.card_le_card hsub
        rw [Finset.card_range] at hcard_le
        omega
      · rw [Finset.card_range]
    rw [hprefix] at hm_def
    intro i hi
    constructor
    · intro hup
      have : i ∈ (Finset.range r).filter (fun k => upperHalf c (u k)) :=
        Finset.mem_filter.mpr ⟨Finset.mem_range.mpr hi, hup⟩
      rw [hprefix, Finset.mem_range] at this; exact this
    · intro hlt
      have : i ∈ Finset.range m := Finset.mem_range.mpr hlt
      rw [← hprefix, Finset.mem_filter] at this; exact this.2
  
  have hmr : m ≤ r := by
    rw [hm_def]; exact le_trans (Finset.card_filter_le _ _) (by rw [Finset.card_range])
  
  have hcross10 : ∀ x : Plane2, cross ![1, 0] x = x 1 := by
    intro x; simp only [cross, Matrix.cons_val_zero, Matrix.cons_val_one, Matrix.head_cons]; ring
  
  have hq10 : (![1, 0] : Plane2) ≠ 0 := by
    intro he; have := congrFun he 0; simp at this
  obtain ⟨⟨vp, hvpV, hvp⟩, ⟨vm, hvmV, hvm⟩⟩ := sep_cross tri hq10
  rw [hcross10] at hvp hvm
  
  have hvp_up : upperHalf c vp := Or.inl hvp
  have hvm_lo : ¬ upperHalf c vm := by
    unfold upperHalf; push_neg; refine ⟨by linarith, ?_⟩; intro h0; linarith
  
  have henumu : ∀ v ∈ V, ∃ k, k < r ∧ u k = v := by
    intro v hv
    have hvM : v ∈ M := (hMmem v).mpr hv
    obtain ⟨k, hk⟩ := List.get_of_mem hvM
    have hkr : (k : ℕ) < r := by have hk2 : (k : ℕ) < M.length := k.2; omega
    exact ⟨k, hkr, by rw [hugetD k hkr]; simpa using hk⟩
  obtain ⟨ip, hipr, hipeq⟩ := henumu vp hvpV
  obtain ⟨im, himr, himeq⟩ := henumu vm hvmV
  have hm_pos : 0 < m := by
    have : upperHalf c (u ip) := by rw [hipeq]; exact hvp_up
    have := (hpart ip hipr).mp this; omega
  have hm_lt : m < r := by
    have hlo : ¬ upperHalf c (u im) := by rw [himeq]; exact hvm_lo
    by_contra hge; push_neg at hge
    have : im < m := by omega
    exact hlo ((hpart im himr).mpr this)
  
  have hukc : ∀ k, k < r → u k ≠ c := by
    intro k hk he
    
    obtain ⟨k', hk'r, hk'ne⟩ : ∃ k', k' < r ∧ k' ≠ k := by
      rcases eq_or_ne k 0 with h0 | h0
      · exact ⟨1, by omega, by omega⟩
      · exact ⟨0, by omega, by omega⟩
    have hne : u k' ≠ u k := hnodupu k' k hk'r hk (by omega)
    apply hncu k k' hk hk'r (by omega)
    rw [he, sub_self]; simp [cross]
  
  have hclassu : ∀ k, k < r →
      (upperHalf c (u k) ∧ 0 ≤ (u k - c) 1 ∧ ((u k - c) 1 = 0 → 0 < (u k - c) 0))
      ∨ (¬ upperHalf c (u k) ∧ (u k - c) 1 ≤ 0 ∧ ((u k - c) 1 = 0 → (u k - c) 0 < 0)) := by
    intro k hk
    by_cases hup : upperHalf c (u k)
    · refine Or.inl ⟨hup, upperHalf_nonneg hup, ?_⟩
      intro h1
      rcases hup with h | ⟨_, h⟩
      · rw [h1] at h; exact absurd h (lt_irrefl 0)
      · exact h
    · refine Or.inr ⟨hup, lower_nonpos hup, ?_⟩
      intro h1
      
      unfold upperHalf at hup; push_neg at hup
      have hle0 : (u k - c) 0 ≤ 0 := hup.2 h1
      rcases lt_or_eq_of_le hle0 with hlt | heq0
      · exact hlt
      · 
        exfalso; apply hukc k hk
        have hz : u k - c = 0 := by
          funext i; fin_cases i
          · simpa using heq0
          · simpa using h1
        rwa [sub_eq_zero] at hz
  
  set dirs : Plane2 → Prop := fun x => ∃ k, k < r ∧ x = u k - c with hdirs_def
  set upperD : Plane2 → Prop := fun x => ∃ k, k < r ∧ x = u k - c ∧ upperHalf c (u k)
    with hupperD_def
  
  have hclassD : ∀ x, dirs x →
      (upperD x ∧ 0 ≤ x 1 ∧ (x 1 = 0 → 0 < x 0))
      ∨ (¬ upperD x ∧ x 1 ≤ 0 ∧ (x 1 = 0 → x 0 < 0)) := by
    intro x hx
    obtain ⟨k, hk, hxeq⟩ := hx
    subst hxeq
    rcases hclassu k hk with ⟨hup, h1, h4⟩ | ⟨hlo, h1, h4⟩
    · exact Or.inl ⟨⟨k, hk, rfl, hup⟩, h1, h4⟩
    · refine Or.inr ⟨?_, h1, h4⟩
      rintro ⟨k', hk', hk'eq, hup'⟩
      
      have : u k = u k' := by
        have := hk'eq; rwa [sub_left_inj] at this
      have hkk' : k = k' := by
        by_contra hne
        exact hnodupu k k' hk hk' hne this
      subst hkk'; exact hlo hup'
  
  have hwrap : 0 < cross (u (r - 1) - c) (u 0 - c) := by
    set Pw : Plane2 := u (r - 1) - c with hPw
    set Qw : Plane2 := u 0 - c with hQw
    have hr1 : r - 1 < r := by omega
    
    have hQ_up : upperHalf c (u 0) := (hpart 0 (by omega)).mpr hm_pos
    have hP_lo : ¬ upperHalf c (u (r - 1)) := by
      intro hup; have := (hpart (r - 1) hr1).mp hup; omega
    apply straddle_sign dirs upperD hclassD
    · exact ⟨0, by omega, rfl⟩          
    · exact ⟨r - 1, hr1, rfl⟩          
    · exact ⟨0, by omega, rfl, hQ_up⟩   
    · 
      rintro ⟨k, hk, hkeq, hup⟩
      have hek : u (r - 1) = u k := by rw [hPw, sub_left_inj] at hkeq; exact hkeq
      have : r - 1 = k := by
        by_contra hne; exact hnodupu (r - 1) k hr1 hk hne hek
      subst this; exact hP_lo hup
    · 
      exact hncu 0 (r - 1) (by omega) hr1 (by omega)
    · 
      rintro x ⟨k, hk, hxeq⟩ ⟨k', hk', hxeq', hupx'⟩ hxQ
      subst hxeq
      
      have hkk' : k = k' := by
        have : u k = u k' := by rw [sub_left_inj] at hxeq'; exact hxeq'
        by_contra hne; exact hnodupu k k' hk hk' hne this
      subst hkk'
      have hupx : upperHalf c (u k) := hupx'
      have hk0 : k ≠ 0 := by
        rintro rfl; exact hxQ rfl
      have hkm : k < m := (hpart k hk).mp hupx
      
      have hiff : upperHalf c (u 0) ↔ upperHalf c (u k) := ⟨fun _ => hupx, fun _ => hQ_up⟩
      exact hsamehalf_pos 0 k (by omega) hk (by omega) hiff (hrelu 0 k (by omega) hk)
    · 
      rintro x ⟨k, hk, hxeq⟩ hlox hxP
      subst hxeq
      have hkr1 : k ≠ r - 1 := by rintro rfl; exact hxP rfl
      
      have hlo_uk : ¬ upperHalf c (u k) := by
        intro hupk
        exact hlox ⟨k, hk, rfl, hupk⟩
      have hkge : m ≤ k := by
        by_contra hlt; push_neg at hlt
        exact hlo_uk ((hpart k hk).mpr hlt)
      have hklt : k < r - 1 := by omega
      have hiff : upperHalf c (u k) ↔ upperHalf c (u (r - 1)) :=
        ⟨fun h => absurd h hlo_uk, fun h => absurd h hP_lo⟩
      
      
      have hpos := hsamehalf_pos k (r - 1) hk hr1 (by omega) hiff (hrelu k (r - 1) hklt hr1)
      have := Proof.CrossProduct.cross_antisymm (u k - c) (u (r - 1) - c)
      rw [hPw]; linarith
    · 
      obtain ⟨z, hzV, hz⟩ : ∃ z ∈ V, 0 < cross Pw (z - c) := by
        have hPwne : Pw ≠ 0 := by
          rw [hPw, sub_ne_zero]; exact hukc (r - 1) hr1

      obtain ⟨kz, hkzr, hkzeq⟩ := henumu z hzV
      exact ⟨z - c, ⟨kz, hkzr, by rw [hkzeq]⟩, hz⟩
  
  
  
  set dirsN : Plane2 → Prop := fun x => ∃ k, k < r ∧ x = -(u k - c) with hdirsN_def

      · simp only [Pi.neg_apply]; linarith

  have hmid : 0 < cross (u (m - 1) - c) (u m - c) := by

      · exact ⟨m, hmr', rfl⟩            
      · exact ⟨m - 1, hm1, rfl⟩         
      · exact ⟨m, hmr', rfl, hM'_lo⟩    
      · 
        rintro ⟨k, hk, hkeq, hlo⟩
        have hek : u (m - 1) = u k := by rw [neg_inj, sub_left_inj] at hkeq; exact hkeq

      ·

      · 
        rintro x ⟨k, hk, hxeq⟩ ⟨k', hk', hk'eq, hlo'⟩ hxQ
        subst hxeq

          have : u k = u k' := by rw [neg_inj, sub_left_inj] at hk'eq; exact hk'eq

      ·

  have hMcall : ∀ i, i < r → 0 < cross (u i - c) (u ((i + 1) % r) - c) := by
    intro i hi
    
    by_cases hwrapi : i = r - 1

      have hmod : (r - 1 + 1) % r = 0 := by

          have hli1 : ¬ upperHalf c (u (i + 1)) := fun h => by
            have := (hpart (i + 1) (by omega)).mp h; omega

            ⟨fun h => absurd h hli, fun h => absurd h hli1⟩
          exact hsamehalf_pos i (i + 1) hi (by omega) (by omega) hiff

  · 
    intro i j hi hj hij

    intro he

    simpa using this

    refine ⟨k, hkr, ?_⟩
    rw [hugetD k hkr]
    simp only [Fin.eta] at hk ⊢; exact hk
  · 
    
    
    
    
    
    
    
    
    
    
    
    
    
    
    
    exact hMcall
  · 
    
    
    intro i hi w hwV hwi hwi1
    rintro ⟨hwedge1, hwedge2⟩
    
    obtain ⟨k, hkr, hkeq⟩ := henumu w hwV

    by_cases hwrapi : i = r - 1
    · 
      subst hwrapi

          have hiff : upperHalf c (u m) ↔ upperHalf c (u k) :=
            ⟨fun h => absurd h hM'_lo, fun h => absurd h hwup⟩
          have hpos := hcmp_lt m k hkgt hkr hiff
          have := Proof.CrossProduct.cross_antisymm (u m - c) (u k - c)

      · 
        
        
        rcases Nat.lt_or_ge i (m - 1) with hlt | hge

          have hui : upperHalf c (u i) := (hpart i hi).mpr (by omega)

name: centroid_within_half_ne
statement:
theorem centroid_within_half_ne {m r : ℕ} (g : Fin m → (Plane2 →ᵃ[ℚ] ℚ))
    (P' : Set Plane2) (hP' : P' = ⋂ i, {y | 0 ≤ g i y})
    (V : Finset Plane2) (hVeq : P' = convexHull ℚ (↑V : Set Plane2))
    (hVP : (↑V : Set Plane2) ⊆ P')
    (hext : ∀ v ∈ V, v ∈ Set.extremePoints ℚ P')
    (hr : 3 ≤ r) (u : ℕ → Plane2)
    (hmem : ∀ i, i < r → u i ∈ V)
    (hnodup : ∀ i j, i < r → j < r → i ≠ j → u i ≠ u j)
    {c : Plane2}
    (hcent : (r : ℚ) • c = ∑ j ∈ Finset.range r, u j)
    (hcfeas : ∀ i, Proof.HpolytopeVertex.NonVacuous (g i) → 0 < g i c) :
    ∀ i j, i < r → j < r → i ≠ j →
      (upperHalf c (u i) ↔ upperHalf c (u j)) → cross (u i - c) (u j - c) ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have hr0 : 0 < r := by omega
  have hconvP' : Convex ℚ P' := by rw [hVeq]; exact convex_convexHull ℚ _
  have hvP' : ∀ i, i < r → u i ∈ P' := by
    intro i hi; rw [hVeq]; exact subset_convexHull ℚ _ (hmem i hi)
  have hcP' : c ∈ P' := by
    rw [hP']; simp only [Set.mem_iInter, Set.mem_setOf_eq]
    intro i
    by_cases hv : Proof.HpolytopeVertex.NonVacuous (g i)
    · exact le_of_lt (hcfeas i hv)
    · obtain ⟨v0, hv0V⟩ : ∃ v0, v0 ∈ V := ⟨u 0, hmem 0 hr0⟩
      unfold Proof.HpolytopeVertex.NonVacuous at hv; push_neg at hv
      have hv0P' : v0 ∈ P' := by rw [hVeq]; exact subset_convexHull ℚ _ hv0V
      have hgv0 : 0 ≤ g i v0 := by rw [hP'] at hv0P'; simpa using Set.mem_iInter.mp hv0P' i
      have heq : g i c = g i v0 := by
        have hconst : g i c - g i v0 = (g i).linear (c - v0) := by
          have := AffineMap.linearMap_vsub (g i) c v0; simpa using this.symm
        rw [hv] at hconst; simp only [LinearMap.zero_apply] at hconst; linarith [hconst]
      rw [heq]; exact hgv0
  have hukc : ∀ k, k < r → u k ≠ c := by
    have hrQ : (0:ℚ) < r := by exact_mod_cast hr0
    have hr1 : (0:ℚ) < (r:ℚ) - 1 := by
      have h3 : (3:ℚ) ≤ (r:ℚ) := by exact_mod_cast hr
      linarith
    have key : ∀ i0, i0 < r → c ∈ Set.extremePoints ℚ P' → u i0 = c := by
      intro i0 hi0 hcext
      set S := (Finset.range r).erase i0 with hS
      have hScard : S.card = r - 1 := by
        rw [hS, Finset.card_erase_of_mem (Finset.mem_range.mpr hi0), Finset.card_range]
      set p := ((r:ℚ) - 1)⁻¹ • (∑ j ∈ S, u j) with hp
      have hcardQ : ((r - 1 : ℕ) : ℚ) = (r:ℚ) - 1 := by
        have : (1:ℕ) ≤ r := by omega
        push_cast [Nat.cast_sub this]; ring
      have hpcm : p = S.centerMass (fun _ => ((r:ℚ)-1)⁻¹) u := by
        rw [Finset.centerMass, Finset.sum_const, hScard, nsmul_eq_mul, hcardQ,
          mul_inv_cancel₀ (ne_of_gt hr1), inv_one, one_smul, hp, Finset.smul_sum]
      have hpP' : p ∈ P' := by
        rw [hVeq, hpcm]
        apply Finset.centerMass_mem_convexHull
        · intro j hj; positivity
        · rw [Finset.sum_const, hScard, nsmul_eq_mul, hcardQ,
            mul_inv_cancel₀ (ne_of_gt hr1)]; norm_num
        · intro j hj
          rw [hS, Finset.mem_erase, Finset.mem_range] at hj
          exact hmem j hj.2
      have hsplit : ∑ j ∈ Finset.range r, u j = u i0 + ∑ j ∈ S, u j := by
        rw [hS, Finset.add_sum_erase _ _ (Finset.mem_range.mpr hi0)]
      have hccomb : c = ((r:ℚ)⁻¹) • u i0 + (((r:ℚ)-1)/(r:ℚ)) • p := by
        have h1 : c = ((r:ℚ)⁻¹) • (∑ j ∈ Finset.range r, u j) := by
          rw [← hcent, smul_smul, inv_mul_cancel₀ (ne_of_gt hrQ), one_smul]
        rw [h1, hsplit, smul_add, hp, smul_smul]
        have hcoef : ((r:ℚ)-1)/(r:ℚ) * ((r:ℚ)-1)⁻¹ = (r:ℚ)⁻¹ := by
          rw [div_eq_mul_inv, mul_right_comm, mul_inv_cancel₀ (ne_of_gt hr1), one_mul]
        rw [hcoef]
      have hw0 : (0:ℚ) < (r:ℚ)⁻¹ := by positivity
      have hw1 : (0:ℚ) < ((r:ℚ)-1)/(r:ℚ) := by positivity
      have hwsum : (r:ℚ)⁻¹ + ((r:ℚ)-1)/(r:ℚ) = 1 := by field_simp
      have hcseg : c ∈ openSegment ℚ (u i0) p :=
        ⟨(r:ℚ)⁻¹, ((r:ℚ)-1)/(r:ℚ), hw0, hw1, hwsum, hccomb.symm⟩
      rw [mem_extremePoints] at hcext
      exact (hcext.2 (u i0) (hvP' i0 hi0) p hpP' hcseg).1
    intro k hk hukc
    have hcV : c ∈ V := hukc ▸ hmem k hk
    have hcext : c ∈ Set.extremePoints ℚ P' := hext c hcV
    have e0 : u 0 = c := key 0 (by omega) hcext
    have e1 : u 1 = c := key 1 (by omega) hcext
    exact hnodup 0 1 (by omega) (by omega) (by omega) (e0.trans e1.symm)
  intro i j hi hj hij hiff hcz
  have hac : u i ≠ c := hukc i hi
  have hbc : u j ≠ c := hukc j hj
  have hXne : u i - c ≠ 0 := by rw [sub_ne_zero]; exact hac
  have hYne : u j - c ≠ 0 := by rw [sub_ne_zero]; exact hbc
  have hab : u i ≠ u j := hnodup i j hi hj hij
  by_cases hup : upperHalf c (u i)
  · have hupj : upperHalf c (u j) := hiff.mp hup
    obtain ⟨lam, hlam⟩ := parallel_scalar hXne hcz
    have ha1 : 0 ≤ (u i - c) 1 := upperHalf_nonneg hup
    have hb1 : 0 ≤ (u j - c) 1 := upperHalf_nonneg hupj
    have ha4 : (u i - c) 1 = 0 → 0 < (u i - c) 0 := by
      intro h1; rcases hup with h | ⟨_, h⟩
      · rw [h1] at h; exact absurd h (lt_irrefl 0)
      · exact h
    have hb4 : (u j - c) 1 = 0 → 0 < (u j - c) 0 := by
      intro h1; rcases hupj with h | ⟨_, h⟩
      · rw [h1] at h; exact absurd h (lt_irrefl 0)
      · exact h
    have hlampos : 0 < lam := by
      rcases lt_trichotomy lam 0 with hneg | hzero | hpos
      · exfalso
        have hb1eq : (u j - c) 1 = lam * (u i - c) 1 := by rw [hlam]; simp [Pi.smul_apply]
        have ha1z : (u i - c) 1 = 0 := by
          by_contra h
          have hpp : 0 < (u i - c) 1 := lt_of_le_of_ne ha1 (Ne.symm h)
          have : (u j - c) 1 < 0 := by rw [hb1eq]; exact mul_neg_of_neg_of_pos hneg hpp
          linarith
        have hb1z : (u j - c) 1 = 0 := by rw [hb1eq, ha1z, mul_zero]
        have ha0p : 0 < (u i - c) 0 := ha4 ha1z
        have hb0p : 0 < (u j - c) 0 := hb4 hb1z
        have hb0eq : (u j - c) 0 = lam * (u i - c) 0 := by rw [hlam]; simp [Pi.smul_apply]
        have : (u j - c) 0 < 0 := by rw [hb0eq]; exact mul_neg_of_neg_of_pos hneg ha0p
        linarith
      · exfalso; apply hYne; rw [hlam, hzero, zero_smul]
      · exact hpos
    rcases lt_trichotomy lam 1 with hlt | heq | hgt
    · refine nearer_not_extreme hext hVP hcP' (a := u i) (b := u j)
        (hmem i hi) (hmem j hj) hab (1/lam) ?_ ?_
      · rw [lt_div_iff₀ hlampos]; linarith
      · rw [hlam, smul_smul, one_div, inv_mul_cancel₀ (ne_of_gt hlampos), one_smul]
    · exfalso; apply hab
      have heqv : u j - c = u i - c := by rw [hlam, heq, one_smul]
      funext t; have := congrFun heqv t; simp only [Pi.sub_apply] at this; linarith
    · exact nearer_not_extreme hext hVP hcP' (a := u j) (b := u i)
        (hmem j hj) (hmem i hi) (Ne.symm hab) lam hgt hlam
  · have hloj : ¬ upperHalf c (u j) := fun h => hup (hiff.mpr h)
    have hczN : cross (-(u i - c)) (-(u j - c)) = 0 := by rw [cross_neg_neg]; exact hcz
    have hXnN : -(u i - c) ≠ 0 := by rw [neg_ne_zero]; exact hXne
    have hYnN : -(u j - c) ≠ 0 := by rw [neg_ne_zero]; exact hYne
    obtain ⟨lam, hlam⟩ := parallel_scalar hXnN hczN
    have hlow4 : ∀ k, k < r → ¬ upperHalf c (u k) →
        (u k - c) 1 = 0 → (u k - c) 0 < 0 := by
      intro k hk hlo h1
      unfold upperHalf at hlo; push_neg at hlo
      have hle0 : (u k - c) 0 ≤ 0 := hlo.2 h1
      rcases lt_or_eq_of_le hle0 with hlt | heq0
      · exact hlt
      · exfalso; apply hukc k hk
        have hz : u k - c = 0 := by
          funext t; fin_cases t
          · simpa using heq0
          · simpa using h1
        rwa [sub_eq_zero] at hz
    have ha1 : 0 ≤ (-(u i - c)) 1 := by simp only [Pi.neg_apply]; linarith [lower_nonpos hup]
    have hb1 : 0 ≤ (-(u j - c)) 1 := by simp only [Pi.neg_apply]; linarith [lower_nonpos hloj]
    have ha4 : (-(u i - c)) 1 = 0 → 0 < (-(u i - c)) 0 := by
      intro h1; simp only [Pi.neg_apply, neg_eq_zero] at h1 ⊢
      linarith [hlow4 i hi hup h1]
    have hb4 : (-(u j - c)) 1 = 0 → 0 < (-(u j - c)) 0 := by
      intro h1; simp only [Pi.neg_apply, neg_eq_zero] at h1 ⊢
      linarith [hlow4 j hj hloj h1]
    have hlampos : 0 < lam := by
      rcases lt_trichotomy lam 0 with hneg | hzero | hpos
      · exfalso
        have hb1eq : (-(u j - c)) 1 = lam * (-(u i - c)) 1 := by rw [hlam]; simp [Pi.smul_apply]
        have ha1z : (-(u i - c)) 1 = 0 := by
          by_contra h
          have hpp : 0 < (-(u i - c)) 1 := lt_of_le_of_ne ha1 (Ne.symm h)
          have : (-(u j - c)) 1 < 0 := by rw [hb1eq]; exact mul_neg_of_neg_of_pos hneg hpp
          linarith
        have hb1z : (-(u j - c)) 1 = 0 := by rw [hb1eq, ha1z, mul_zero]
        have ha0p : 0 < (-(u i - c)) 0 := ha4 ha1z
        have hb0p : 0 < (-(u j - c)) 0 := hb4 hb1z
        have hb0eq : (-(u j - c)) 0 = lam * (-(u i - c)) 0 := by rw [hlam]; simp [Pi.smul_apply]
        have : (-(u j - c)) 0 < 0 := by rw [hb0eq]; exact mul_neg_of_neg_of_pos hneg ha0p
        linarith
      · exfalso; apply hYnN; rw [hlam, hzero, zero_smul]
      · exact hpos
    have hlam' : u j - c = lam • (u i - c) := by
      have : -(u j - c) = lam • -(u i - c) := hlam
      rw [smul_neg] at this
      have h2 : u j - c = lam • (u i - c) := by
        have := congrArg (fun z => -z) this
        simpa using this
      exact h2
    have hab : u i ≠ u j := hnodup i j hi hj hij
    rcases lt_trichotomy lam 1 with hlt | heq | hgt
    · refine nearer_not_extreme hext hVP hcP' (a := u i) (b := u j)
        (hmem i hi) (hmem j hj) hab (1/lam) ?_ ?_
      · rw [lt_div_iff₀ hlampos]; linarith
      · rw [hlam', smul_smul, one_div, inv_mul_cancel₀ (ne_of_gt hlampos), one_smul]
    · exfalso; apply hab
      have heqv : u j - c = u i - c := by rw [hlam', heq, one_smul]
      funext t; have := congrFun heqv t; simp only [Pi.sub_apply] at this; linarith
    · exact nearer_not_extreme hext hVP hcP' (a := u j) (b := u i)
        (hmem j hj) (hmem i hi) (Ne.symm hab) lam hgt hlam'

name: centroid_order_signs
statement:
theorem centroid_order_signs {m r : ℕ} (g : Fin m → (Plane2 →ᵃ[ℚ] ℚ))
    (P' : Set Plane2) (hP' : P' = ⋂ i, {y | 0 ≤ g i y})
    (V : Finset Plane2) (hVeq : P' = convexHull ℚ (↑V : Set Plane2))
    (hVP : (↑V : Set Plane2) ⊆ P')
    (hext : ∀ v ∈ V, v ∈ Set.extremePoints ℚ P')
    (hcoll : ∀ a ∈ V, ∀ b ∈ V, ∀ cc ∈ V, a ≠ b → a ≠ cc → b ≠ cc →
      AffineIndependent ℚ ![a, b, cc])
    (hr : 3 ≤ r) (u : ℕ → Plane2)
    (hmem : ∀ i, i < r → u i ∈ V) (henum : ∀ v ∈ V, ∃ j, j < r ∧ u j = v)
    (hnodup : ∀ i j, i < r → j < r → i ≠ j → u i ≠ u j)
    {c : Plane2}
    (hcent : (r : ℚ) • c = ∑ j ∈ Finset.range r, u j)
    (hcfeas : ∀ i, Proof.HpolytopeVertex.NonVacuous (g i) → 0 < g i c)
    (hsorted : ∀ i j, i < j → j < r → cmp c (u i) (u j)) :
    (∀ i, i < r → 0 < cross (u i - c) (u ((i + 1) % r) - c))
    ∧ (∀ i, i < r → ∀ w ∈ V, w ≠ u i → w ≠ u ((i + 1) % r) →
        ¬ (0 < cross (u i - c) (w - c) ∧ 0 < cross (w - c) (u ((i + 1) % r) - c)))
proof:
:= by
  classical
  
  have hrelu := hsorted
  have humem := hmem
  have hnodupu := hnodup
  have henumu := henum
  have hr0 : 0 < r := by omega
  
  have hconvP' : Convex ℚ P' := by rw [hVeq]; exact convex_convexHull ℚ _
  have hvP' : ∀ i, i < r → u i ∈ P' := by
    intro i hi; rw [hVeq]; exact subset_convexHull ℚ _ (hmem i hi)
  
  have hcP' : c ∈ P' := by
    rw [hP']; simp only [Set.mem_iInter, Set.mem_setOf_eq]
    intro i
    by_cases hv : Proof.HpolytopeVertex.NonVacuous (g i)
    · exact le_of_lt (hcfeas i hv)
    · obtain ⟨v0, hv0V⟩ : ∃ v0, v0 ∈ V := ⟨u 0, hmem 0 hr0⟩
      unfold Proof.HpolytopeVertex.NonVacuous at hv; push_neg at hv
      have hv0P' : v0 ∈ P' := by rw [hVeq]; exact subset_convexHull ℚ _ hv0V
      have hgv0 : 0 ≤ g i v0 := by rw [hP'] at hv0P'; simpa using Set.mem_iInter.mp hv0P' i
      have heq : g i c = g i v0 := by
        have hconst : g i c - g i v0 = (g i).linear (c - v0) := by
          have := AffineMap.linearMap_vsub (g i) c v0; simpa using this.symm
        rw [hv] at hconst; simp only [LinearMap.zero_apply] at hconst; linarith [hconst]
      rw [heq]; exact hgv0
  
  have hsep : ∀ q : Plane2, q ≠ 0 →
      (∃ k, k < r ∧ 0 < cross q (u k - c)) ∧ (∃ k, k < r ∧ cross q (u k - c) < 0) := by
    intro q hq
    set a : ℕ → ℚ := fun k => cross q (u k - c) with ha_def
    have hsum0 : ∑ k ∈ Finset.range r, a k = 0 := by
      have hdist : ∑ k ∈ Finset.range r, a k
          = cross q (∑ k ∈ Finset.range r, (u k - c)) := by
        rw [ha_def]; simp only
        induction (Finset.range r) using Finset.induction with
        | empty => simp [cross]
        | insert hx ih =>
          rw [Finset.sum_insert hx, Finset.sum_insert hx, ih,
              Proof.CrossProduct.cross_add_right]
      rw [hdist]
      have hvec : (∑ k ∈ Finset.range r, (u k - c)) = 0 := by
        rw [Finset.sum_sub_distrib, Finset.sum_const, Finset.card_range]
        rw [← hcent, Nat.cast_smul_eq_nsmul]; abel
      rw [hvec]; simp [cross]
    have hnz : ¬ (∀ k, k < r → a k = 0) := by
      intro hall
      have h0 : (0:ℕ) < r := by omega
      have h1 : (1:ℕ) < r := by omega
      have h2 : (2:ℕ) < r := by omega
      have hai : AffineIndependent ℚ ![u 0, u 1, u 2] :=
        hcoll _ (hmem 0 h0) _ (hmem 1 h1) _ (hmem 2 h2)
          (hnodup 0 1 h0 h1 (by omega)) (hnodup 0 2 h0 h2 (by omega))
          (hnodup 1 2 h1 h2 (by omega))
      have hdet : cross (u 1 - u 0) (u 2 - u 0) ≠ 0 :=
        cross_ne_zero_of_affineIndependent hai
      have hdiff : ∀ j k, cross q (u j - u k) = a j - a k := by
        intro j k
        rw [ha_def]; simp only
        have : u j - u k = (u j - c) - (u k - c) := by abel
        rw [this, Proof.CrossProduct.cross_sub_right]
      have d1 : cross q (u 1 - u 0) = 0 := by rw [hdiff, hall 1 h1, hall 0 h0]; ring
      have d2 : cross q (u 2 - u 0) = 0 := by rw [hdiff, hall 2 h2, hall 0 h0]; ring
      apply hq
      have hqall : ∀ w : Plane2, cross q w = 0 := by
        intro w
        rw [cramer (u 1 - u 0) (u 2 - u 0) w hdet]
        rw [Proof.CrossProduct.cross_add_right, Proof.CrossProduct.cross_smul_right,
            Proof.CrossProduct.cross_smul_right, d1, d2]; ring
      have hq0 : q 0 = 0 := by
        have := hqall ![0, 1]
        simp only [cross, Matrix.cons_val_zero, Matrix.cons_val_one, Matrix.head_cons,
          mul_one, mul_zero, sub_zero] at this
        exact this
      have hq1 : q 1 = 0 := by
        have := hqall ![1, 0]
        simp only [cross, Matrix.cons_val_zero, Matrix.cons_val_one, Matrix.head_cons,
          mul_one, mul_zero, zero_sub, neg_eq_zero] at this
        exact this
      funext i; fin_cases i
      · simpa using hq0
      · simpa using hq1
    push_neg at hnz
    obtain ⟨k0, hk0r, hk0ne⟩ := hnz
    refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
    · by_contra hcon; push_neg at hcon
      have hnonpos : ∀ k ∈ Finset.range r, a k ≤ 0 := fun k hk => hcon k (Finset.mem_range.mp hk)
      exact hk0ne ((Finset.sum_eq_zero_iff_of_nonpos hnonpos).mp hsum0 k0
        (Finset.mem_range.mpr hk0r))
    · by_contra hcon; push_neg at hcon
      have hnonneg : ∀ k ∈ Finset.range r, 0 ≤ a k := fun k hk => hcon k (Finset.mem_range.mp hk)
      exact hk0ne ((Finset.sum_eq_zero_iff_of_nonneg hnonneg).mp hsum0 k0
        (Finset.mem_range.mpr hk0r))
  
  have hukc : ∀ k, k < r → u k ≠ c := by
    have hrQ : (0:ℚ) < r := by exact_mod_cast hr0
    have hr1 : (0:ℚ) < (r:ℚ) - 1 := by
      have h3 : (3:ℚ) ≤ (r:ℚ) := by exact_mod_cast hr
      linarith
    have key : ∀ i0, i0 < r → c ∈ Set.extremePoints ℚ P' → u i0 = c := by
      intro i0 hi0 hcext
      set S := (Finset.range r).erase i0 with hS
      have hScard : S.card = r - 1 := by
        rw [hS, Finset.card_erase_of_mem (Finset.mem_range.mpr hi0), Finset.card_range]
      set p := ((r:ℚ) - 1)⁻¹ • (∑ j ∈ S, u j) with hp
      have hcardQ : ((r - 1 : ℕ) : ℚ) = (r:ℚ) - 1 := by
        have : (1:ℕ) ≤ r := by omega
        push_cast [Nat.cast_sub this]; ring
      have hpcm : p = S.centerMass (fun _ => ((r:ℚ)-1)⁻¹) u := by
        rw [Finset.centerMass, Finset.sum_const, hScard, nsmul_eq_mul, hcardQ,
          mul_inv_cancel₀ (ne_of_gt hr1), inv_one, one_smul, hp, Finset.smul_sum]
      have hpP' : p ∈ P' := by
        rw [hVeq, hpcm]
        apply Finset.centerMass_mem_convexHull
        · intro j hj; positivity
        · rw [Finset.sum_const, hScard, nsmul_eq_mul, hcardQ,
            mul_inv_cancel₀ (ne_of_gt hr1)]; norm_num
        · intro j hj
          rw [hS, Finset.mem_erase, Finset.mem_range] at hj
          exact hmem j hj.2
      have hsplit : ∑ j ∈ Finset.range r, u j = u i0 + ∑ j ∈ S, u j := by
        rw [hS, Finset.add_sum_erase _ _ (Finset.mem_range.mpr hi0)]
      have hccomb : c = ((r:ℚ)⁻¹) • u i0 + (((r:ℚ)-1)/(r:ℚ)) • p := by
        have h1 : c = ((r:ℚ)⁻¹) • (∑ j ∈ Finset.range r, u j) := by
          rw [← hcent, smul_smul, inv_mul_cancel₀ (ne_of_gt hrQ), one_smul]
        rw [h1, hsplit, smul_add, hp, smul_smul]
        have hcoef : ((r:ℚ)-1)/(r:ℚ) * ((r:ℚ)-1)⁻¹ = (r:ℚ)⁻¹ := by
          rw [div_eq_mul_inv, mul_right_comm, mul_inv_cancel₀ (ne_of_gt hr1), one_mul]
        rw [hcoef]
      have hw0 : (0:ℚ) < (r:ℚ)⁻¹ := by positivity
      have hw1 : (0:ℚ) < ((r:ℚ)-1)/(r:ℚ) := by positivity
      have hwsum : (r:ℚ)⁻¹ + ((r:ℚ)-1)/(r:ℚ) = 1 := by field_simp
      have hcseg : c ∈ openSegment ℚ (u i0) p :=
        ⟨(r:ℚ)⁻¹, ((r:ℚ)-1)/(r:ℚ), hw0, hw1, hwsum, hccomb.symm⟩
      rw [mem_extremePoints] at hcext
      exact (hcext.2 (u i0) (hvP' i0 hi0) p hpP' hcseg).1
    intro k hk hukc
    have hcV : c ∈ V := hukc ▸ hmem k hk
    have hcext : c ∈ Set.extremePoints ℚ P' := hext c hcV
    have e0 : u 0 = c := key 0 (by omega) hcext
    have e1 : u 1 = c := key 1 (by omega) hcext
    exact hnodup 0 1 (by omega) (by omega) (by omega) (e0.trans e1.symm)
  
  have hncu_half : ∀ i j, i < r → j < r → i ≠ j →
      (upperHalf c (u i) ↔ upperHalf c (u j)) → cross (u i - c) (u j - c) ≠ 0 := by
    intro i j hi hj hij hiff hcz
    have hac : u i ≠ c := hukc i hi
    have hbc : u j ≠ c := hukc j hj
    have hXne : u i - c ≠ 0 := by rw [sub_ne_zero]; exact hac
    have hYne : u j - c ≠ 0 := by rw [sub_ne_zero]; exact hbc
    have hab : u i ≠ u j := hnodup i j hi hj hij
    
    by_cases hup : upperHalf c (u i)
    · 
      have hupj : upperHalf c (u j) := hiff.mp hup
      obtain ⟨lam, hlam⟩ := parallel_scalar hXne hcz
      have ha1 : 0 ≤ (u i - c) 1 := upperHalf_nonneg hup
      have hb1 : 0 ≤ (u j - c) 1 := upperHalf_nonneg hupj
      have ha4 : (u i - c) 1 = 0 → 0 < (u i - c) 0 := by
        intro h1; rcases hup with h | ⟨_, h⟩
        · rw [h1] at h; exact absurd h (lt_irrefl 0)
        · exact h
      have hb4 : (u j - c) 1 = 0 → 0 < (u j - c) 0 := by
        intro h1; rcases hupj with h | ⟨_, h⟩
        · rw [h1] at h; exact absurd h (lt_irrefl 0)
        · exact h
      
      have hlampos : 0 < lam := by
        rcases lt_trichotomy lam 0 with hneg | hzero | hpos
        · exfalso
          have hb1eq : (u j - c) 1 = lam * (u i - c) 1 := by rw [hlam]; simp [Pi.smul_apply]
          have ha1z : (u i - c) 1 = 0 := by
            by_contra h
            have hpp : 0 < (u i - c) 1 := lt_of_le_of_ne ha1 (Ne.symm h)
            have : (u j - c) 1 < 0 := by rw [hb1eq]; exact mul_neg_of_neg_of_pos hneg hpp
            linarith
          have hb1z : (u j - c) 1 = 0 := by rw [hb1eq, ha1z, mul_zero]
          have ha0p : 0 < (u i - c) 0 := ha4 ha1z
          have hb0p : 0 < (u j - c) 0 := hb4 hb1z
          have hb0eq : (u j - c) 0 = lam * (u i - c) 0 := by rw [hlam]; simp [Pi.smul_apply]
          have : (u j - c) 0 < 0 := by rw [hb0eq]; exact mul_neg_of_neg_of_pos hneg ha0p
          linarith
        · exfalso; apply hYne; rw [hlam, hzero, zero_smul]
        · exact hpos
      
      rcases lt_trichotomy lam 1 with hlt | heq | hgt
      · 
        refine nearer_not_extreme hext hVP hcP' (a := u i) (b := u j)
          (hmem i hi) (hmem j hj) hab (1/lam) ?_ ?_
        · rw [lt_div_iff₀ hlampos]; linarith
        · rw [hlam, smul_smul, one_div, inv_mul_cancel₀ (ne_of_gt hlampos), one_smul]
      · exfalso; apply hab
        have heqv : u j - c = u i - c := by rw [hlam, heq, one_smul]
        funext t; have := congrFun heqv t; simp only [Pi.sub_apply] at this; linarith
      · 
        exact nearer_not_extreme hext hVP hcP' (a := u j) (b := u i)
          (hmem j hj) (hmem i hi) (Ne.symm hab) lam hgt hlam
    · 
      have hloj : ¬ upperHalf c (u j) := fun h => hup (hiff.mpr h)
      have hczN : cross (-(u i - c)) (-(u j - c)) = 0 := by rw [cross_neg_neg]; exact hcz
      have hXnN : -(u i - c) ≠ 0 := by rw [neg_ne_zero]; exact hXne
      have hYnN : -(u j - c) ≠ 0 := by rw [neg_ne_zero]; exact hYne
      obtain ⟨lam, hlam⟩ := parallel_scalar hXnN hczN
      
      have hlow4 : ∀ k, k < r → ¬ upperHalf c (u k) →
          (u k - c) 1 = 0 → (u k - c) 0 < 0 := by
        intro k hk hlo h1
        unfold upperHalf at hlo; push_neg at hlo
        have hle0 : (u k - c) 0 ≤ 0 := hlo.2 h1
        rcases lt_or_eq_of_le hle0 with hlt | heq0
        · exact hlt
        · exfalso; apply hukc k hk
          have hz : u k - c = 0 := by
            funext t; fin_cases t
            · simpa using heq0
            · simpa using h1
          rwa [sub_eq_zero] at hz
      have ha1 : 0 ≤ (-(u i - c)) 1 := by simp only [Pi.neg_apply]; linarith [lower_nonpos hup]
      have hb1 : 0 ≤ (-(u j - c)) 1 := by simp only [Pi.neg_apply]; linarith [lower_nonpos hloj]
      have ha4 : (-(u i - c)) 1 = 0 → 0 < (-(u i - c)) 0 := by
        intro h1; simp only [Pi.neg_apply, neg_eq_zero] at h1 ⊢
        linarith [hlow4 i hi hup h1]
      have hb4 : (-(u j - c)) 1 = 0 → 0 < (-(u j - c)) 0 := by
        intro h1; simp only [Pi.neg_apply, neg_eq_zero] at h1 ⊢
        linarith [hlow4 j hj hloj h1]
      have hlampos : 0 < lam := by
        rcases lt_trichotomy lam 0 with hneg | hzero | hpos
        · exfalso
          have hb1eq : (-(u j - c)) 1 = lam * (-(u i - c)) 1 := by rw [hlam]; simp [Pi.smul_apply]
          have ha1z : (-(u i - c)) 1 = 0 := by
            by_contra h
            have hpp : 0 < (-(u i - c)) 1 := lt_of_le_of_ne ha1 (Ne.symm h)
            have : (-(u j - c)) 1 < 0 := by rw [hb1eq]; exact mul_neg_of_neg_of_pos hneg hpp
