      · have hui : upperHalf c (u i) := (hpart i hi).mpr (by omega)
        have hui1 : upperHalf c (u (i + 1)) := (hpart (i + 1) (by omega)).mpr (by omega)
        by_cases hwup : upperHalf c (u k)
        · rcases Nat.lt_trichotomy k i with hki | hki | hki
          · have hiff : upperHalf c (u k) ↔ upperHalf c (u i) := ⟨fun _ => hui, fun _ => hwup⟩
            have hpos := hcmp_lt k i hki hi hiff
            have := Proof.CrossProduct.cross_antisymm (u k - c) (u i - c)
            linarith [hwedge1]
          · exact hk_ne_i hki
          · have hki1 : i + 1 < k := by omega
            have hiff : upperHalf c (u (i + 1)) ↔ upperHalf c (u k) :=
              ⟨fun _ => hwup, fun _ => hui1⟩
            have hpos := hcmp_lt (i + 1) k hki1 hkr hiff
            have := Proof.CrossProduct.cross_antisymm (u (i + 1) - c) (u k - c)
            linarith [hwedge2]
        · exfalso
          rcases hclassu i hi with ⟨_, ha1, ha4⟩ | ⟨hcon, _, _⟩
          swap; · exact hcon hui
          rcases hclassu (i + 1) (by omega) with ⟨_, hd1, hd4⟩ | ⟨hcon, _, _⟩
          swap; · exact hcon hui1
          have hx1 : (u k - c) 1 ≤ 0 := lower_nonpos hwup
          exact wedge_cross_half_imposs ha1 ha4 hd1 hd4 hx1
            (hcmp_lt i (i + 1) (by omega) (by omega) ⟨fun _ => hui1, fun _ => hui⟩)
            hwedge1 hwedge2
      · have hli : ¬ upperHalf c (u i) := fun h => by have := (hpart i hi).mp h; omega
        have hli1 : ¬ upperHalf c (u (i + 1)) := fun h => by
          have := (hpart (i + 1) (by omega)).mp h; omega
        by_cases hwup : upperHalf c (u k)
        · exfalso
          rcases hclassu i hi with ⟨hcon, _, _⟩ | ⟨_, ha1, ha4⟩
          · exact hli hcon
          rcases hclassu (i + 1) (by omega) with ⟨hcon, _, _⟩ | ⟨_, hd1, hd4⟩
          · exact hli1 hcon
          have ha1' : 0 ≤ (-(u i - c)) 1 := by simp only [Pi.neg_apply]; linarith
          have ha4' : (-(u i - c)) 1 = 0 → 0 < (-(u i - c)) 0 := by
            intro hz; simp only [Pi.neg_apply, neg_eq_zero] at hz ⊢; linarith [ha4 hz]
          have hd1' : 0 ≤ (-(u (i + 1) - c)) 1 := by simp only [Pi.neg_apply]; linarith
          have hd4' : (-(u (i + 1) - c)) 1 = 0 → 0 < (-(u (i + 1) - c)) 0 := by
            intro hz; simp only [Pi.neg_apply, neg_eq_zero] at hz ⊢; linarith [hd4 hz]
          have hx1' : (-(u k - c)) 1 ≤ 0 := by
            simp only [Pi.neg_apply]; linarith [upperHalf_nonneg hwup]
          have had' : 0 < cross (-(u i - c)) (-(u (i + 1) - c)) := by
            rw [cross_neg_neg]
            exact hcmp_lt i (i + 1) (by omega) (by omega)
              ⟨fun h => absurd h hli, fun h => absurd h hli1⟩
          have hax' : 0 < cross (-(u i - c)) (-(u k - c)) := by rw [cross_neg_neg]; exact hwedge1
          have hxd' : 0 < cross (-(u k - c)) (-(u (i + 1) - c)) := by
            rw [cross_neg_neg]; exact hwedge2
          exact wedge_cross_half_imposs ha1' ha4' hd1' hd4' hx1' had' hax' hxd'
        · rcases Nat.lt_trichotomy k i with hki | hki | hki
          · have hiff : upperHalf c (u k) ↔ upperHalf c (u i) :=
              ⟨fun h => absurd h hwup, fun h => absurd h hli⟩
            have hpos := hcmp_lt k i hki hi hiff
            have := Proof.CrossProduct.cross_antisymm (u k - c) (u i - c)
            linarith [hwedge1]
          · exact hk_ne_i hki
          · have hki1 : i + 1 < k := by omega
            have hiff : upperHalf c (u (i + 1)) ↔ upperHalf c (u k) :=
              ⟨fun h => absurd h hli1, fun h => absurd h hwup⟩
            have hpos := hcmp_lt (i + 1) k hki1 hkr hiff
            have := Proof.CrossProduct.cross_antisymm (u (i + 1) - c) (u k - c)
            linarith [hwedge2]

name: edge_support
statement:
theorem edge_support {m : ℕ} (g : Fin m → (Plane2 →ᵃ[ℚ] ℚ))
    (P' : Set Plane2) (hP' : P' = ⋂ i, {y | 0 ≤ g i y})
    (V : Finset Plane2) (hVeq : P' = convexHull ℚ (↑V : Set Plane2))
    (hext : ∀ v ∈ V, v ∈ Set.extremePoints ℚ P')
    (_hcoll : ∀ a ∈ V, ∀ b ∈ V, ∀ c0 ∈ V, a ≠ b → a ≠ c0 → b ≠ c0 →
      AffineIndependent ℚ ![a, b, c0])
    {c : Plane2}
    (hcfeas : ∀ i, Proof.HpolytopeVertex.NonVacuous (g i) → 0 < g i c)
    {p q : Plane2} (hp : p ∈ V) (hq : q ∈ V)
    (hfacta : 0 < cross (p - c) (q - c))
    (hconsec : ∀ w ∈ V, w ≠ p → w ≠ q →
      ¬ (0 < cross (p - c) (w - c) ∧ 0 < cross (w - c) (q - c))) :
    ∀ w ∈ V, 0 ≤ cross (q - p) (w - p)
proof:
:= by
  
  
  have hcP' : c ∈ P' := by
    rw [hP']; simp only [Set.mem_iInter, Set.mem_setOf_eq]
    intro i
    by_cases hv : Proof.HpolytopeVertex.NonVacuous (g i)
    · exact le_of_lt (hcfeas i hv)
    · unfold Proof.HpolytopeVertex.NonVacuous at hv
      push_neg at hv
      have hpP' : p ∈ P' := by rw [hVeq]; exact subset_convexHull ℚ _ hp
      have hgp : 0 ≤ g i p := by rw [hP'] at hpP'; simpa using Set.mem_iInter.mp hpP' i
      have : g i c = g i p := by
        have hconst : g i c - g i p = (g i).linear (c - p) := by
          have := AffineMap.linearMap_vsub (g i) c p; simpa using this.symm
        rw [hv] at hconst; simp only [LinearMap.zero_apply] at hconst; linarith [hconst]
      rw [this]; exact hgp
  
  intro w hw
  by_contra hneg
  push_neg at hneg
  have hpc : p ≠ c := ne_of_cross_pos_left hfacta
  have hqc : q ≠ c := ne_of_cross_pos_right hfacta
  have hpq : p ≠ q := ne_pq_of_cross_pos hfacta
  set det := cross (p-c) (q-c) with hdet_def
  have hdet : 0 < det := hfacta
  have hdetne : det ≠ 0 := ne_of_gt hdet
  have hwc : w ≠ c := by
    intro he; rw [he] at hneg; rw [t1_id] at hneg
    exact absurd hneg (not_lt.mpr (le_of_lt hdet))
  have hwp : w ≠ p := by
    intro he; rw [he] at hneg
    rw [show cross (q - p) (p - p) = 0 by simp only [cross, sub_self, Pi.zero_apply]; ring] at hneg
    exact lt_irrefl 0 hneg
  have hwq : w ≠ q := by
    intro he; rw [he] at hneg
    rw [show cross (q - p) (q - p) = 0 by simp only [cross]; ring] at hneg
    exact lt_irrefl 0 hneg
  have hfc : cross (q-p) (c-p) = det := t1_id p q c
  set fc := cross (q-p) (c-p) with hfc_def
  set fw := cross (q-p) (w-p) with hfw_def
  have hfcpos : 0 < fc := by rw [hfc]; exact hdet
  have hfwneg : fw < 0 := hneg
  
  set s := fc / (fc - fw) with hs_def
  have hden : 0 < fc - fw := by linarith
  have hs0 : 0 < s := by rw [hs_def]; exact div_pos hfcpos hden
  have hs1 : s < 1 := by rw [hs_def, div_lt_one hden]; linarith
  set mm := (1-s)•c + s•w with hmm_def
  
  have hfm : cross (q-p) (mm - p) = 0 := by
    have hne : fc - fw ≠ 0 := ne_of_gt hden
    rw [hmm_def, f_affine p q c w s, ← hfc_def, ← hfw_def, hs_def]
    field_simp
    ring
  have hmm_seg_cw : mm ∈ openSegment ℚ c w := by
    refine mem_openSegment_mk (1-s) s (by linarith) hs0 (by ring) ?_
    rw [hmm_def]
  have hwP' : w ∈ P' := by rw [hVeq]; exact subset_convexHull ℚ _ hw
  have hconvP' : Convex ℚ P' := by rw [hVeq]; exact convex_convexHull ℚ _
  have hmmP' : mm ∈ P' := hconvP'.openSegment_subset hcP' hwP' hmm_seg_cw
  
  set P := p - c with hP_def
  set Q := q - c with hQ_def
  set t := cross P (mm - c) / det with ht_def
  set lam := cross (mm - c) Q / det with hlam_def
  have hdecomp : mm - c = lam • P + t • Q := by
    have := cramer P Q (mm - c) hdetne
    rw [← hdet_def] at this; rw [ht_def, hlam_def]; exact this
  have hchord : cross (q-p) (mm-p) = det * (1 - lam - t) := by
    rw [hdet_def]; exact chord_id p q c mm lam t hdecomp
  have hlamt : lam + t = 1 := by
    have : det * (1 - lam - t) = 0 := by rw [← hchord]; exact hfm
    have := (mul_eq_zero.mp this).resolve_left hdetne
    linarith
  have hmm_pq : mm = (1-t) • p + t • q := by
    apply line_param p q c mm t
    rw [hdecomp]; congr 1; congr 1; rw [show (1:ℚ) - t = lam by linarith]
  have hext_p := hext p hp
  have hext_q := hext q hq
  rw [mem_extremePoints] at hext_p hext_q
  have hmmc : mm - c = s • (w - c) := by
    rw [hmm_def]; funext i
    simp only [Pi.sub_apply, Pi.add_apply, Pi.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul]; ring
  
  have ht_pos : 0 < t := by
    by_contra htle; push_neg at htle
    rcases lt_or_eq_of_le htle with htlt | hteq
    · set θ := 1 / (1 - t) with hθ_def
      have h1t : 0 < 1 - t := by linarith
      have hθ0 : 0 < θ := by rw [hθ_def]; exact div_pos one_pos h1t
      have hθ1 : θ < 1 := by rw [hθ_def, div_lt_one h1t]; linarith
      have hp_seg : p ∈ openSegment ℚ q mm := by
        refine mem_openSegment_mk (1-θ) θ (by linarith) hθ0 (by ring) ?_
        rw [hmm_pq]
        have : (1 - θ) • q + θ • ((1-t) • p + t • q)
             = (θ * (1-t)) • p + ((1-θ) + θ * t) • q := by
          rw [smul_add, smul_smul, smul_smul, add_smul]; abel
        rw [this]
        have hc1 : θ * (1 - t) = 1 := by rw [hθ_def]; field_simp
        have hc2 : (1 - θ) + θ * t = 0 := by linear_combination -hc1
        rw [hc1, hc2, one_smul, zero_smul, add_zero]
      have hqP' : q ∈ P' := by rw [hVeq]; exact subset_convexHull ℚ _ hq
      have := (hext_p.2 q hqP' mm hmmP' hp_seg).1
      exact hpq this.symm
    · have hmm_eq_p : mm = p := by rw [hmm_pq, hteq]; simp
      rw [hmm_eq_p] at hmm_seg_cw
      have := (hext_p.2 c hcP' w hwP' hmm_seg_cw).1
      exact hpc this.symm
  
  have ht_lt : t < 1 := by
    by_contra htge; push_neg at htge
    rcases lt_or_eq_of_le htge with htlt | hteq
    · set θ := 1 / t with hθ_def
      have ht0 : 0 < t := by linarith
      have hθ0 : 0 < θ := by rw [hθ_def]; exact div_pos one_pos ht0
      have hθ1 : θ < 1 := by rw [hθ_def, div_lt_one ht0]; linarith
      have hq_seg : q ∈ openSegment ℚ p mm := by
        refine mem_openSegment_mk (1-θ) θ (by linarith) hθ0 (by ring) ?_
        rw [hmm_pq]
        have : (1 - θ) • p + θ • ((1-t) • p + t • q)
             = ((1-θ) + θ * (1-t)) • p + (θ * t) • q := by
          rw [smul_add, smul_smul, smul_smul, add_smul]; abel
        rw [this]
        have hc2 : θ * t = 1 := by rw [hθ_def]; field_simp
        have hc1 : (1 - θ) + θ * (1 - t) = 0 := by linear_combination -hc2
        rw [hc1, hc2, one_smul, zero_smul, zero_add]
      have hpP' : p ∈ P' := by rw [hVeq]; exact subset_convexHull ℚ _ hp
      have := (hext_q.2 p hpP' mm hmmP' hq_seg).1
      exact hpq this
    · have hmm_eq_q : mm = q := by
        rw [hmm_pq, ← hteq]; simp only [sub_self, zero_smul, one_smul, zero_add]
      rw [hmm_eq_q] at hmm_seg_cw
      have := (hext_q.2 c hcP' w hwP' hmm_seg_cw).1
      exact hqc this.symm
  
  have hWdecomp : w - c = ((1-t)/s) • P + (t/s) • Q := by
    have h1 : s • (w - c) = (1-t) • P + t • Q := by
      rw [← hmmc, hdecomp, show lam = 1 - t by linarith]
    have hsne : s ≠ 0 := ne_of_gt hs0
    funext i
    have hc := congrFun h1 i
    simp only [Pi.add_apply, Pi.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul] at hc ⊢
    rw [div_mul_eq_mul_div, div_mul_eq_mul_div, div_add_div_same, eq_div_iff hsne]
    linarith [hc]
  have hPW : cross P (w - c) = (t/s) * det := by
    rw [hWdecomp]
    rw [show cross P (((1-t)/s) • P + (t/s) • Q)
          = ((1-t)/s) * cross P P + (t/s) * cross P Q by
        simp only [cross, Pi.add_apply, Pi.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul]; ring]
    rw [show cross P P = 0 by simp only [cross]; ring, hdet_def]; ring
  have hWQ : cross (w - c) Q = ((1-t)/s) * det := by
    rw [hWdecomp]
    rw [show cross (((1-t)/s) • P + (t/s) • Q) Q
          = ((1-t)/s) * cross P Q + (t/s) * cross Q Q by
        simp only [cross, Pi.add_apply, Pi.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul]; ring]
    rw [show cross Q Q = 0 by simp only [cross]; ring, hdet_def]; ring
  have hstar1 : 0 < cross (p-c) (w-c) := by
    rw [← hP_def, hPW]; positivity
  have hstar2 : 0 < cross (w-c) (q-c) := by
    rw [← hQ_def, hWQ]
    have : 0 < (1 - t)/s := div_pos (by linarith) hs0
    positivity
  exact hconsec w hw hwp hwq ⟨hstar1, hstar2⟩

name: ori_id
statement:
private theorem ori_id (a b cc : Plane2) :
    cross (b - a) (cc - a) = cross (cc - b) (a - b)
proof:
:= by
  simp only [cross, Pi.sub_apply]; ring

name: edge_support_at
statement:
private theorem edge_support_at {m r : ℕ} (g : Fin m → (Plane2 →ᵃ[ℚ] ℚ))
    (P' : Set Plane2) (hP' : P' = ⋂ i, {y | 0 ≤ g i y})
    (V : Finset Plane2) (hVeq : P' = convexHull ℚ (↑V : Set Plane2))
    (hext : ∀ v ∈ V, v ∈ Set.extremePoints ℚ P')
    (hcoll : ∀ a ∈ V, ∀ b ∈ V, ∀ cc ∈ V, a ≠ b → a ≠ cc → b ≠ cc →
      AffineIndependent ℚ ![a, b, cc])
    (u : ℕ → Plane2) (hmem : ∀ i, i < r → u i ∈ V)
    {c : Plane2}
    (hcfeas : ∀ i, Proof.HpolytopeVertex.NonVacuous (g i) → 0 < g i c)
    (hMc : ∀ i, i < r → 0 < cross (u i - c) (u ((i + 1) % r) - c))
    (hconsec : ∀ i, i < r → ∀ w ∈ V, w ≠ u i → w ≠ u ((i + 1) % r) →
      ¬ (0 < cross (u i - c) (w - c) ∧ 0 < cross (w - c) (u ((i + 1) % r) - c)))
    (i : ℕ) (hi : i < r) :
    ∀ w ∈ V, 0 ≤ cross (u ((i + 1) % r) - u i) (w - u i)
proof:
:=
  edge_support g P' hP' V hVeq hext hcoll hcfeas
    (hmem i hi) (hmem ((i + 1) % r) (Nat.mod_lt _ (by omega)))
    (hMc i hi) (hconsec i hi)

name: d_ne_zero
proof:
:= by
  intro he
  have : u j = u 0 := sub_eq_zero.mp he
  exact hnodup j 0 hj (by omega) hj0 this

name: sweep
statement:
private theorem sweep {m r : ℕ} (g : Fin m → (Plane2 →ᵃ[ℚ] ℚ))
    (P' : Set Plane2) (hP' : P' = ⋂ i, {y | 0 ≤ g i y})
    (V : Finset Plane2) (hVeq : P' = convexHull ℚ (↑V : Set Plane2))
    (hext : ∀ v ∈ V, v ∈ Set.extremePoints ℚ P')
    (hcoll : ∀ a ∈ V, ∀ b ∈ V, ∀ cc ∈ V, a ≠ b → a ≠ cc → b ≠ cc →
      AffineIndependent ℚ ![a, b, cc])
    (hr : 3 ≤ r) (u : ℕ → Plane2)
    (hmem : ∀ i, i < r → u i ∈ V)
    (hnodup : ∀ i j, i < r → j < r → i ≠ j → u i ≠ u j)
    {c : Plane2}
    (hcfeas : ∀ i, Proof.HpolytopeVertex.NonVacuous (g i) → 0 < g i c)
    (hMc : ∀ i, i < r → 0 < cross (u i - c) (u ((i + 1) % r) - c))
    (hconsec : ∀ i, i < r → ∀ w ∈ V, w ≠ u i → w ≠ u ((i + 1) % r) →
      ¬ (0 < cross (u i - c) (w - c) ∧ 0 < cross (w - c) (u ((i + 1) % r) - c))) :
    ∀ a b, 1 ≤ a → a < b → b < r →
      0 < cross (u a - u 0) (u b - u 0)
proof:
:= by
  
  set d : ℕ → Plane2 := fun j => u j - u 0 with hd
  
  have hES := edge_support_at g P' hP' V hVeq hext hcoll u hmem hcfeas hMc hconsec
  
  have hAI : ∀ a b cc : ℕ, a < r → b < r → cc < r → a ≠ b → a ≠ cc → b ≠ cc →
      AffineIndependent ℚ ![u a, u b, u cc] := fun a b cc ha hb hcc hab hacc hbcc =>
    hcoll _ (hmem a ha) _ (hmem b hb) _ (hmem cc hcc)
      (hnodup a b ha hb hab) (hnodup a cc ha hcc hacc) (hnodup b cc hb hcc hbcc)
  
  have hcross_ne : ∀ a b : ℕ, a < r → b < r → a ≠ 0 → b ≠ 0 → a ≠ b →
      cross (u a - u 0) (u b - u 0) ≠ 0 := fun a b ha hb ha0 hb0 hab =>
    cross_ne_zero_of_affineIndependent
      (hAI 0 a b (by omega) ha hb (Ne.symm ha0) (Ne.symm hb0) hab)
  
  have hdne : ∀ j, j < r → j ≠ 0 → d j ≠ 0 := fun j hj hj0 =>
    d_ne_zero u hnodup hj hj0
  
  have hconsecSign : ∀ i, 1 ≤ i → i + 1 < r →
      0 < cross (d i) (d (i + 1)) := by
    intro i hi1 hi
    
    have hori : cross (d i) (d (i + 1)) = cross (u (i + 1) - u i) (u 0 - u i) := by
      simp only [hd]; exact ori_id (u 0) (u i) (u (i + 1))
    
    have hii1 : (i + 1) % r = i + 1 := Nat.mod_eq_of_lt hi
    have hb0 : 0 ≤ cross (u (i + 1) - u i) (u 0 - u i) := by
      have := hES i (by omega) (u 0) (hmem 0 (by omega))
      rw [hii1] at this; exact this
    have hge : 0 ≤ cross (d i) (d (i + 1)) := by rw [hori]; exact hb0
    
    have hne : cross (d i) (d (i + 1)) ≠ 0 :=
      hcross_ne i (i + 1) (by omega) (by omega) (by omega) (by omega) (by omega)
    exact lt_of_le_of_ne hge (Ne.symm hne)
  
  have h01 : (0 + 1) % r = 1 := Nat.mod_eq_of_lt (by omega)
  have hSPOKE : ∀ j, j < r → 0 ≤ cross (d 1) (d j) := by
    intro j hj
    have := hES 0 (by omega) (u j) (hmem j hj)
    rw [h01] at this
    
    simpa only [hd] using this
  
  have hr1 : ((r - 1) + 1) % r = 0 := by
    have : (r - 1) + 1 = r := by omega
    rw [this]; exact Nat.mod_self r
  have hMIRROR : ∀ j, j < r → 0 ≤ cross (d j) (d (r - 1)) := by
    intro j hj
    have hes := hES (r - 1) (by omega) (u j) (hmem j hj)
    rw [hr1] at hes
    
    
    have hori : cross (u 0 - u (r - 1)) (u j - u (r - 1))
        = cross (d j) (d (r - 1)) := by
      simp only [hd]; exact ori_id (u (r - 1)) (u 0) (u j)
    rw [hori] at hes; exact hes
  
  have hd1r1 : 0 < cross (d 1) (d (r - 1)) := by
    have hge := hSPOKE (r - 1) (by omega)
    have hne := hcross_ne 1 (r - 1) (by omega) (by omega) (by omega) (by omega) (by omega)
    exact lt_of_le_of_ne hge (Ne.symm hne)
  
  set ν : Plane2 := perp (d 1 - d (r - 1)) with hν_def
  have hcone : ∀ j, j < r → j ≠ 0 → 0 < ∑ i, (d j) i * ν i := by
    intro j hj hj0
    
    have hinner : (∑ i, (d j) i * ν i) = cross (d 1) (d j) + cross (d j) (d (r - 1)) := by
      rw [hν_def, Proof.CrossProduct.inner_perp]
      rw [Proof.CrossProduct.cross_sub_left]
      rw [Proof.CrossProduct.cross_antisymm (d (r - 1)) (d j)]
      ring
    rw [hinner]
    have h1 := hSPOKE j hj
    have h2 := hMIRROR j hj
    
    rcases eq_or_lt_of_le h1 with he1 | hlt1
    · 
      rcases eq_or_lt_of_le h2 with he2 | hlt2
      · 
        exfalso
        have hp1 : cross (d 1) (d j) = 0 := he1.symm
        have hp2 : cross (d j) (d (r - 1)) = 0 := he2.symm
        
        have hdj := hdne j hj hj0
        
        have : cross (d 1) (d (r - 1)) = 0 := by
          
          
          
          have hk := cramer_key (d 1) (d (r - 1)) (d j)
          
          
          have hk0 := hk 0
          have hk1 := hk 1
          rw [hp1, hp2] at hk0 hk1
          simp only [zero_mul, add_zero, zero_add] at hk0 hk1
          
          by_contra hcr
          have hcr' : cross (d 1) (d (r - 1)) ≠ 0 := hcr
          have hj0' : (d j) 0 = 0 := by
            rcases mul_eq_zero.mp hk0 with h | h; exact h; exact absurd h hcr'
          have hj1' : (d j) 1 = 0 := by
            rcases mul_eq_zero.mp hk1 with h | h; exact h; exact absurd h hcr'
          apply hdj
          funext i
          fin_cases i
          · simpa using hj0'
          · simpa using hj1'
        exact absurd this (ne_of_gt hd1r1)
      · rw [← he1]; linarith
    · linarith
  
  have hνne : ν ≠ 0 := by
    intro hν0
    apply ne_of_gt hd1r1
    
    have h0 := congrFun hν0 (0 : Fin 2)
    have h1 := congrFun hν0 (1 : Fin 2)
    simp only [hν_def, perp, Matrix.cons_val_zero, Matrix.cons_val_one,
      Matrix.head_cons, Pi.zero_apply, neg_eq_zero] at h0 h1
    
    have hsub : d 1 = d (r - 1) := by
      funext i
      fin_cases i
      · have := h1; simp only [Pi.sub_apply, sub_eq_zero] at this; exact this
      · have := h0; simp only [Pi.sub_apply, sub_eq_zero] at this; exact this
    rw [hsub, Proof.CrossProduct.cross_self]
  
  
  have hpair : ∀ n a, 1 ≤ a → a + (n + 1) < r →
      0 < cross (d a) (d (a + n + 1)) := by
    intro n
    induction n with
    | zero =>
      intro a ha1 ha
      have := hconsecSign a ha1 (by omega)
      simpa using this
    | succ n ih =>
      intro a ha1 ha
      
      have hstep1 : 0 < cross (d a) (d (a + n + 1)) := ih a ha1 (by omega)
      have hstep2 : 0 < cross (d (a + n + 1)) (d (a + n + 2)) := by
        have := hconsecSign (a + n + 1) (by omega) (by omega)
        simpa using this
      
      have hres : 0 < cross (d a) (d (a + n + 2)) :=
        Proof.CrossProduct.half_plane_transitive (ν := ν) hνne
          (hdne a (by omega) (by omega))
          (hdne (a + n + 1) (by omega) (by omega))
          (hdne (a + n + 2) (by omega) (by omega))
          (hcone a (by omega) (by omega))
          (hcone (a + n + 1) (by omega) (by omega))
          (hcone (a + n + 2) (by omega) (by omega))
          hstep1 hstep2
      have : a + n + 2 = a + (n + 1) + 1 := by ring
      rw [this] at hres; exact hres
  
  intro a b ha1 hab hb
  have := hpair (b - a - 1) a ha1 (by omega)
  have heq : a + (b - a - 1) + 1 = b := by omega
  rw [heq] at this; exact this

name: order_A
statement:
theorem order_A {m r : ℕ} (g : Fin m → (Plane2 →ᵃ[ℚ] ℚ))
    (P' : Set Plane2) (hP' : P' = ⋂ i, {y | 0 ≤ g i y})
    (V : Finset Plane2) (hVeq : P' = convexHull ℚ (↑V : Set Plane2))
    (_hVP : (↑V : Set Plane2) ⊆ P')
    (hext : ∀ v ∈ V, v ∈ Set.extremePoints ℚ P')
    (hcoll : ∀ a ∈ V, ∀ b ∈ V, ∀ cc ∈ V, a ≠ b → a ≠ cc → b ≠ cc →
      AffineIndependent ℚ ![a, b, cc])
    (hr : 3 ≤ r) (u : ℕ → Plane2)
    (hmem : ∀ i, i < r → u i ∈ V) (_henum : ∀ v ∈ V, ∃ j, j < r ∧ u j = v)
    (hnodup : ∀ i j, i < r → j < r → i ≠ j → u i ≠ u j)
    {c : Plane2}
    (hcfeas : ∀ i, Proof.HpolytopeVertex.NonVacuous (g i) → 0 < g i c)
    (hMc : ∀ i, i < r → 0 < cross (u i - c) (u ((i + 1) % r) - c))
    (hconsec : ∀ i, i < r → ∀ w ∈ V, w ≠ u i → w ≠ u ((i + 1) % r) →
      ¬ (0 < cross (u i - c) (w - c) ∧ 0 < cross (w - c) (u ((i + 1) % r) - c)))
    {k : ℕ} (hk : k < r - 2) :
    0 < cross (u (k + 1) - u 0) (u (k + 2) - u 0)
proof:
:= by
  
  
  
  
  
  
  
  
  have h := sweep g P' hP' V hVeq hext hcoll hr u hmem hnodup hcfeas hMc hconsec
    (k + 1) (k + 2) (by omega) (by omega) (by omega)
  exact h

name: order_B
statement:
theorem order_B {m r : ℕ} (g : Fin m → (Plane2 →ᵃ[ℚ] ℚ))
    (P' : Set Plane2) (hP' : P' = ⋂ i, {y | 0 ≤ g i y})
    (V : Finset Plane2) (hVeq : P' = convexHull ℚ (↑V : Set Plane2))
    (_hVP : (↑V : Set Plane2) ⊆ P')
    (hext : ∀ v ∈ V, v ∈ Set.extremePoints ℚ P')
    (hcoll : ∀ a ∈ V, ∀ b ∈ V, ∀ cc ∈ V, a ≠ b → a ≠ cc → b ≠ cc →
      AffineIndependent ℚ ![a, b, cc])
    (hr : 3 ≤ r) (u : ℕ → Plane2)
    (hmem : ∀ i, i < r → u i ∈ V) (_henum : ∀ v ∈ V, ∃ j, j < r ∧ u j = v)
    (hnodup : ∀ i j, i < r → j < r → i ≠ j → u i ≠ u j)
    {c : Plane2}
    (hcfeas : ∀ i, Proof.HpolytopeVertex.NonVacuous (g i) → 0 < g i c)
    (hMc : ∀ i, i < r → 0 < cross (u i - c) (u ((i + 1) % r) - c))
    (hconsec : ∀ i, i < r → ∀ w ∈ V, w ≠ u i → w ≠ u ((i + 1) % r) →
      ¬ (0 < cross (u i - c) (w - c) ∧ 0 < cross (w - c) (u ((i + 1) % r) - c)))
    {k k' j : ℕ} (_hk : k < r - 2) (hk' : k' < r - 2) (hkk' : k < k')
    (hj : j = 1 ∨ j = 2) :
    0 ≤ cross (u (k + 2) - u 0) (u (k' + j) - u 0)
proof:
:= by
  
  
  
  have hjpos : 1 ≤ j := by rcases hj with h | h <;> omega
  have hble : k + 2 ≤ k' + j := by omega
  have hbr : k' + j < r := by rcases hj with h | h <;> omega
  rcases eq_or_lt_of_le hble with heq | hlt
  · 
    rw [heq, Proof.CrossProduct.cross_self]
  · 
    have h := sweep g P' hP' V hVeq hext hcoll hr u hmem hnodup hcfeas hMc hconsec
      (k + 2) (k' + j) (by omega) hlt hbr
    exact le_of_lt h

name: exists_ordered_vertices
statement:
theorem exists_ordered_vertices {m : ℕ} (g : Fin m → (Plane2 →ᵃ[ℚ] ℚ))
    (P' : Set Plane2) (hP' : P' = ⋂ i, {y | 0 ≤ g i y})
    (V : Finset Plane2)
    (hVeq : P' = convexHull ℚ (↑V : Set Plane2))
    (hVP : (↑V : Set Plane2) ⊆ P')
    (hcard : 3 ≤ V.card)
    (hcoll : ∀ a ∈ V, ∀ b ∈ V, ∀ c0 ∈ V, a ≠ b → a ≠ c0 → b ≠ c0 →
      AffineIndependent ℚ ![a, b, c0])
    (hext : ∀ v ∈ V, v ∈ Set.extremePoints ℚ P')
    (hdim : Module.finrank ℚ (vectorSpan ℚ P') = 2) :
    ∃ (r : ℕ) (u : ℕ → Plane2), r = V.card ∧ 3 ≤ r
      ∧ (∀ j, j < r → u j ∈ V)
      ∧ (∀ v ∈ V, ∃ j, j < r ∧ u j = v)
      ∧ (∀ a b cc : ℕ, a < r → b < r → cc < r → a ≠ b → a ≠ cc → b ≠ cc →
          AffineIndependent ℚ ![u a, u b, u cc])
      ∧ (∀ k, k < r - 2 → 0 < cross (u (k + 1) - u 0) (u (k + 2) - u 0))
      ∧ (∀ k k' j : ℕ, k < r - 2 → k' < r - 2 → k < k' → (j = 1 ∨ j = 2) →
          0 ≤ cross (u (k + 2) - u 0) (u (k' + j) - u 0))
      ∧ ∃ c : Plane2,
          (∀ i, Proof.HpolytopeVertex.NonVacuous (g i) → 0 < g i c)
        ∧ (∀ i, i < r → 0 < cross (u i - c) (u ((i + 1) % r) - c))
        ∧ (∀ i, i < r → ∀ w ∈ V, w ≠ u i → w ≠ u ((i + 1) % r) →
             ¬ (0 < cross (u i - c) (w - c) ∧ 0 < cross (w - c) (u ((i + 1) % r) - c)))
proof:
:= by
  
  
  
  
  
  
  obtain ⟨c, hcfeas, hcnc⟩ :=
    exists_strict_feasible g P' hP' V hVP hcard hcoll hdim
  obtain ⟨r, u, hrcard, hmem, hnodup, henum, hMc, hconsec⟩ :=
    exists_cyclic_order g P' hP' V hVeq hVP hcard hcoll hdim ⟨hcfeas, hcnc⟩
  have hr3 : 3 ≤ r := hrcard ▸ hcard
  
  have hucoll : ∀ a b cc : ℕ, a < r → b < r → cc < r → a ≠ b → a ≠ cc → b ≠ cc →
      AffineIndependent ℚ ![u a, u b, u cc] := by
    intro a b cc ha hb hcc hab hacc hbcc
    exact hcoll _ (hmem a ha) _ (hmem b hb) _ (hmem cc hcc)
      (hnodup a b ha hb hab) (hnodup a cc ha hcc hacc) (hnodup b cc hb hcc hbcc)
  refine ⟨r, u, hrcard, hr3, hmem, henum, hucoll, ?_, ?_, c, hcfeas, hMc, hconsec⟩
  · 
    intro k hk
    exact order_A g P' hP' V hVeq hVP hext hcoll hr3 u hmem henum hnodup hcfeas hMc hconsec hk
  · 
    intro k k' j hk hk' hkk' hj
    exact order_B g P' hP' V hVeq hVP hext hcoll hr3 u hmem henum hnodup hcfeas hMc hconsec
      hk hk' hkk' hj

name: emit_winding_frag_univ
statement:
theorem emit_winding_frag_univ {nt : Point} {ct : ℚ} {f : Frag}
    (vs : Array Vtx)
    (hvs : ∀ v ∈ vs.toList, repr4 v.h (P3.toPoint v.p))
    (hnd : vs.toList.Pairwise (fun u v => u.p ≠ v.p))
    {tA : Triangle} (hcN : nt = carrierNormal tA) (hcD : ct = detOrigin tA)
    (hdetA : ct ≠ 0)
    (hinv : FragInv nt ct f)
    {Q : Point} (hQ : dotQ nt Q ≠ 0)
    (hσ : ∀ k : Fin (atomizeFrag vs f).poly.size,
      areaForm nt
        (fanApex (fragCycle (atomizeFrag vs f)))
        (fragCycle (atomizeFrag vs f) k)
        ((ct / dotQ nt Q) • Q) ≠ 0) :
    winding (meshChain (emitFrag (atomizeFrag vs f))) Q
      = (orientSign tA
          * (if 1 ≤ ct / dotQ nt Q then 1 else 0))
        * (if (ct / dotQ nt Q) • Q ∈ vpoly (fragCycle f) then 1 else 0)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  subst hcN hcD
  obtain ⟨hm, hshape⟩ := atomize_refShape hinv vs hvs hnd
  haveI instr : NeZero f.poly.size := hinv.neZero
  haveI instm : NeZero (atomizeFrag vs f).poly.size := ⟨by omega⟩
  have hcarP : dotQ (carrierNormal tA)
      ((detOrigin tA / dotQ (carrierNormal tA) Q) • Q) = detOrigin tA := by
    rw [Proof.MeshIntersectRay.dotQ_smul_right]
    field_simp
  rw [winding_meshChain_map]
  have hterm : ∀ τ ∈ (emitFrag (atomizeFrag vs f)).toList,
      orientSign τ * (if Q ∈ simplex τ then (1 : ℤ) else 0)
        = (orientSign tA
            * (if 1 ≤ detOrigin tA / dotQ (carrierNormal tA) Q then 1 else 0))
          * (if (detOrigin tA / dotQ (carrierNormal tA) Q) • Q
                ∈ triangleSet τ then 1 else 0) := by
    intro τ hτ
    obtain ⟨h0, h1, h2, hccw⟩ := emit_facts_gen hinv.size3 hm hinv.onPlane
      hinv.strictConv hshape.toRefShape (Array.mem_def.mpr hτ)
    have hsgn := orientSign_inherit hdetA h0 h1 h2 hccw
    rw [hsgn.2]
    simp only [mem_simplex_iff_radial h0 h1 h2 hdetA hQ]
    rw [ite_and_mul]
    ring
  rw [List.map_congr_left hterm, List.sum_map_mul_left,
    emit_count hinv.size3 hm hinv.onPlane hinv.strictConv hshape hcarP hσ]

name: dotAffine_apply
statement: @[simp] theorem dotAffine_apply (n w : Point) : dotAffine n w = dotQ n w
proof: := rfl

name: dotQ_crossQ_ne_zero_of_orth
statement:
theorem dotQ_crossQ_ne_zero_of_orth {n x y : Point} (hn : n ≠ 0)
    (hx : dotQ n x = 0) (hy : dotQ n y = 0) (hxy : crossQ x y ≠ 0) :
    dotQ n (crossQ x y) ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  intro hc
  have hpar := CSG.Proof.MeshIntersectClip.crossQ_parallel_of_orth hx hy
  rw [hc, zero_smul] at hpar
  
  have hnn : 0 < dotQ n n := Proof.MeshIntersectRay.dotQ_self_pos hn
  have hz : crossQ x y = 0 :=
    (smul_eq_zero.mp hpar).resolve_left (ne_of_gt hnn)
  exact hxy hz

name: eq_smul_crossQ_of_orth
statement:
theorem eq_smul_crossQ_of_orth {n x y : Point} (hn : n ≠ 0)
    (hx : dotQ n x = 0) (hy : dotQ n y = 0) (hxy : crossQ x y ≠ 0) :
    ∃ α : ℚ, α ≠ 0 ∧ n = α • crossQ x y
proof:
:= by
  have hpar := CSG.Proof.MeshIntersectClip.crossQ_parallel_of_orth hx hy
  
  have hk := dotQ_crossQ_ne_zero_of_orth hn hx hy hxy
  have hnn : 0 < dotQ n n := Proof.MeshIntersectRay.dotQ_self_pos hn
  refine ⟨dotQ n n / dotQ n (crossQ x y), div_ne_zero (ne_of_gt hnn) hk, ?_⟩
  
  have hgoal : (dotQ n n / dotQ n (crossQ x y)) • crossQ x y = n := by
    rw [div_eq_inv_mul, mul_smul, hpar, smul_smul, inv_mul_cancel₀ hk, one_smul]
  exact hgoal.symm

name: mem_slotNormalList
statement:
theorem mem_slotNormalList {M : Mesh} (i : Fin M.size) (k : Fin 4) (hk : k ≠ 3) :
    dotAffine (slot M[i] k).n ∈ slotNormalList M
proof:
:= by
  rw [slotNormalList, List.mem_flatMap]
  refine ⟨i, List.mem_finRange i, ?_⟩
  fin_cases k
  · exact List.mem_cons_self _ _
  · exact List.mem_cons_of_mem _ (List.mem_cons_self _ _)
  · exact List.mem_cons_of_mem _ (List.mem_cons_of_mem _ (List.mem_cons_self _ _))
  · exact absurd rfl hk

name: hguard_of_zpick
statement:
theorem hguard_of_zpick {M : Mesh} {x y w₀ : Point}
    (hz : ∀ φ ∈ slotNormalList M, (φ x ≠ 0 ∨ φ y ≠ 0) → φ w₀ ≠ 0)
    (i : Fin M.size) (k : Fin 4) (hk : k ≠ 3) :
    dotQ (slot M[i] k).n w₀ ≠ 0 ∨
      (dotQ (slot M[i] k).n x = 0 ∧ dotQ (slot M[i] k).n y = 0)
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hxy : dotQ (slot M[i] k).n x = 0 ∧ dotQ (slot M[i] k).n y = 0
  · exact Or.inr hxy
  · left
    push_neg at hxy
    have hor : dotAffine (slot M[i] k).n x ≠ 0 ∨ dotAffine (slot M[i] k).n y ≠ 0 := by
      by_cases hx0 : dotQ (slot M[i] k).n x = 0
      · exact Or.inr (by simp only [dotAffine_apply]; exact hxy hx0)
      · exact Or.inl (by simp only [dotAffine_apply]; exact hx0)
    have := hz _ (mem_slotNormalList i k hk) hor
    simpa only [dotAffine_apply] using this

name: seg_AB
statement:
theorem seg_AB (z v : Point) (ε τ : ℚ) :
    seg (z - ε • v) (z + ε • v) τ = z + ((2 * τ - 1) * ε) • v
proof:
:= by
  funext k
  simp only [seg, Pi.add_apply, Pi.sub_apply, Pi.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul]
  ring

name: seg_AB_half
statement:
theorem seg_AB_half (z v : Point) (ε : ℚ) :
    seg (z - ε • v) (z + ε • v) (1/2) = z
proof:
:= by
  rw [seg_AB]; simp

name: psub_AB
statement:
theorem psub_AB (z v : Point) (ε : ℚ) :
    psub (z + ε • v) (z - ε • v) = (2 * ε) • v
proof:
:= by
  funext k
  simp only [psub, Pi.add_apply, Pi.sub_apply, Pi.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul]
  ring

name: slot_eval_seg_AB
statement:
theorem slot_eval_seg_AB (g : Half) (z v : Point) (ε τ : ℚ) :
    g.eval (seg (z - ε • v) (z + ε • v) τ)
      = g.eval z + ((2 * τ - 1) * ε) * dotQ g.n v
proof:
:= by
  rw [seg_AB, Proof.MeshIntersectLoop.half_eval_add_smul]

name: crossQ_ne_zero_of_offplane
statement:
theorem crossQ_ne_zero_of_offplane {n x y : Point} {c : ℚ} (hc : c ≠ 0)
    (hx : dotQ n x = c) (hy : dotQ n y = c) (hxy : x ≠ y) : crossQ x y ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  intro h
  have hy0 : y ≠ 0 := by
    intro hy0; rw [hy0, CSG.Proof.MeshIntersectClip.dotQ_zero_right] at hy
    exact hc hy.symm
  obtain ⟨t, ht⟩ := CSG.Proof.MeshIntersectClip.exists_smul_of_crossQ_eq_zero hy0 h
  
  have hcx : t * c = c := by
    have hx' := hx
    rw [ht, Proof.MeshIntersectRay.dotQ_smul_right, hy] at hx'
    exact hx'
  have ht1 : t = 1 := by
    have hfac : (t - 1) * c = 0 := by ring_nf; nlinarith [hcx]
    rcases mul_eq_zero.mp hfac with h' | h'
    · linarith [sub_eq_zero.mp h']
    · exact absurd h' hc
  exact hxy (by rw [ht, ht1, one_smul])

name: outBoundaryGen_crossQ_ne_zero
statement:
theorem outBoundaryGen_crossQ_ne_zero {M₁ M₂ : Mesh}
    (h₁ : NoPlaneThroughOrigin M₁) (h₂ : NoPlaneThroughOrigin M₂)
    {x y : Point} (hxy : (x, y) ∈ outBoundaryGen M₁ M₂) :
    crossQ x y ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  classical
  
  obtain ⟨X, hX, heX⟩ := CSG.Proof.MeshIntersectSeam.mem_listSum hxy
  rw [List.mem_map] at hX
  obtain ⟨f, hf, rfl⟩ := hX
  have hf' : f ∈ keptGen M₁ M₂ := Array.mem_def.mpr hf
  obtain ⟨_M, _i, _hi, -, _hdet, hinv₀⟩ := kept_fragInv h₁ h₂ hf'
  haveI hzr : NeZero f.poly.size := hinv₀.neZero
  haveI hzm : NeZero (atomizeFrag (vsGen M₁ M₂) f).poly.size :=
    ⟨by have := keptGen_atomize_size3 h₁ h₂ hf'; omega⟩
  obtain ⟨M, i, hi, hdet, hinv, hm, hshape⟩ := keptGen_refShape h₁ h₂ hf'
  
  have hpl := CSG.Proof.MeshIntersectAtomize.RefShape.onPlane hinv.onPlane
    hshape.toRefShape
  
  obtain ⟨k, hk⟩ := CSG.Proof.MeshIntersectSeam.mem_fragBoundary hm heX
  rw [Prod.mk.injEq] at hk
  obtain ⟨hk1, hk2⟩ := hk
  have hx : dotQ (Proof.MeshIntersectRay.carrierNormal (M[i]'hi)) x
      = detOrigin (M[i]'hi) := by
    rw [hk1]; exact hpl k
  have hy : dotQ (Proof.MeshIntersectRay.carrierNormal (M[i]'hi)) y
      = detOrigin (M[i]'hi) := by
    rw [hk2]; exact hpl (k + 1)
  have hxyne : x ≠ y := by
    rw [hk1, hk2]
    exact hshape.toRefShape.consec_ne hinv.size3 hinv.strictConv k
  exact crossQ_ne_zero_of_offplane hdet hx hy hxyne

name: good_segment
statement:
theorem good_segment {M : Mesh} {z v : Point}
    (hnpo : NoPlaneThroughOrigin M)
    (hGtri : ∀ i : Fin M.size, z ∉ triangleSet M[i])
    (hGline : ∀ (i : Fin M.size), ∀ g ∈ tetraHalves M[i],
      g.eval z = 0 → dotQ g.n v ≠ 0)
    (hGonezero : ∀ (i : Fin M.size), ∀ g ∈ tetraHalves M[i],
      ∀ g' ∈ tetraHalves M[i], g ≠ g' →
      ¬ (g.eval z = 0 ∧ g'.eval z = 0)) :
    ∃ ε₀ : ℚ, 0 < ε₀ ∧ ∀ ε : ℚ, 0 < ε → ε ≤ ε₀ →
      (∀ (i : Fin M.size) (τ : ℚ), 0 < τ → τ < 1 →
        seg (z - ε • v) (z + ε • v) τ ∉ triangleSet M[i])
      ∧ (∀ (i : Fin M.size), ∀ g ∈ tetraHalves M[i], ∀ τ : ℚ, 0 < τ → τ < 1 →
        g.eval (seg (z - ε • v) (z + ε • v) τ) = 0 → τ = 1/2)
      ∧ (∀ (i : Fin M.size), ∀ g ∈ tetraHalves M[i],
        g.eval (z - ε • v) ≠ 0 ∧ g.eval (z + ε • v) ≠ 0)
      ∧ (∀ (i : Fin M.size), ∀ g ∈ tetraHalves M[i],
        ∀ g' ∈ tetraHalves M[i], g ≠ g' → ∀ τ : ℚ, 0 < τ → τ < 1 →
        ¬ (g.eval (seg (z - ε • v) (z + ε • v) τ) = 0
          ∧ g'.eval (seg (z - ε • v) (z + ε • v) τ) = 0))
proof:
:= by
  classical
  
  obtain ⟨δ₁, hδ₁, hpkg⟩ :=
    Proof.MeshIntersectLoop.exists_delta_mesh M z v 0 (le_refl (0 : ℚ))
  refine ⟨δ₁, hδ₁, fun ε hε0 hε => ⟨?_, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩⟩
  · 
    intro i τ hτ0 hτ1
    have hbox : Proof.MeshIntersectLoop.InBox v 0 0 ((2 * τ - 1) • v) :=
      ⟨2 * τ - 1, 0, by rw [abs_le]; constructor <;> linarith,
        by simp, by simp⟩
    have hp := hpkg ε hε0 hε ((2 * τ - 1) • v) hbox i
    have hseg : seg (z - ε • v) (z + ε • v) τ = z + ε • ((2 * τ - 1) • v) := by
      rw [seg_AB, smul_smul]; congr 1; ring_nf
    rw [hseg]
    exact Proof.MeshIntersectLoop.box_off_face (hnpo i) (hGtri i) hp.2.2
      (fun k => hp.2.1 k)
  · 
    intro i g hg τ hτ0 hτ1 hzero
    by_cases hgz : g.eval z = 0
    · 
      have hav : dotQ g.n v ≠ 0 := hGline i g hg hgz
      rw [slot_eval_seg_AB, hgz, zero_add] at hzero
      have : (2 * τ - 1) * ε = 0 := by
        rcases mul_eq_zero.mp hzero with h | h
        · exact h
        · exact absurd h hav
      rcases mul_eq_zero.mp this with h | h
      · linarith
      · exact absurd h (ne_of_gt hε0)
    · 
      exfalso
      have hbox : Proof.MeshIntersectLoop.InBox v 0 0 ((2 * τ - 1) • v) :=
        ⟨2 * τ - 1, 0, by rw [abs_le]; constructor <;> linarith,
          by simp, by simp⟩
      have hp := hpkg ε hε0 hε ((2 * τ - 1) • v) hbox i
      have hseg : seg (z - ε • v) (z + ε • v) τ = z + ε • ((2 * τ - 1) • v) := by
        rw [seg_AB, smul_smul]; congr 1; ring_nf
      rw [hseg] at hzero
      exact hp.1 g hg hgz hzero
  · 
    intro i g hg
    constructor
    · by_cases hgz : g.eval z = 0
      · have hav : dotQ g.n v ≠ 0 := hGline i g hg hgz
        rw [show z - ε • v = seg (z - ε • v) (z + ε • v) 0 from by
          rw [seg_zero], slot_eval_seg_AB, hgz, zero_add]
        intro hc
        have : (2 * 0 - 1) * ε = 0 := by
          rcases mul_eq_zero.mp hc with h | h
          · exact h
          · exact absurd h hav
        rcases mul_eq_zero.mp this with h | h
        · norm_num at h
        · exact absurd h (ne_of_gt hε0)
      · have hbox : Proof.MeshIntersectLoop.InBox v 0 0 ((2 * (0:ℚ) - 1) • v) :=
          ⟨2 * 0 - 1, 0, by norm_num, by simp, by simp⟩
        have hp := hpkg ε hε0 hε ((2 * (0:ℚ) - 1) • v) hbox i
        have hseg : z - ε • v = z + ε • ((2 * (0:ℚ) - 1) • v) := by
          rw [show ((2 * (0:ℚ) - 1) : ℚ) = -1 from by norm_num, smul_smul]
          funext k; simp only [Pi.add_apply, Pi.sub_apply, Pi.smul_apply,
            smul_eq_mul]; ring
        rw [hseg]
        exact hp.1 g hg hgz
    · by_cases hgz : g.eval z = 0
      · have hav : dotQ g.n v ≠ 0 := hGline i g hg hgz
        rw [show z + ε • v = seg (z - ε • v) (z + ε • v) 1 from by
          rw [seg_one], slot_eval_seg_AB, hgz, zero_add]
        intro hc
        have : (2 * 1 - 1) * ε = 0 := by
          rcases mul_eq_zero.mp hc with h | h
          · exact h
          · exact absurd h hav
        rcases mul_eq_zero.mp this with h | h
        · norm_num at h
        · exact absurd h (ne_of_gt hε0)
      · have hbox : Proof.MeshIntersectLoop.InBox v 0 0 ((2 * (1:ℚ) - 1) • v) :=
          ⟨2 * 1 - 1, 0, by norm_num, by simp, by simp⟩
        have hp := hpkg ε hε0 hε ((2 * (1:ℚ) - 1) • v) hbox i
        have hseg : z + ε • v = z + ε • ((2 * (1:ℚ) - 1) • v) := by
          rw [show ((2 * (1:ℚ) - 1) : ℚ) = 1 from by norm_num, smul_smul]
          funext k; simp only [Pi.add_apply, Pi.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul]; ring
        rw [hseg]
        exact hp.1 g hg hgz
  · 
    intro i g hg g' hg' hne τ hτ0 hτ1 ⟨hz1, hz2⟩
    
    have hregimeP : ∀ h : Half, h ∈ tetraHalves M[i] →
        h.eval (seg (z - ε • v) (z + ε • v) τ) = 0 → h.eval z = 0 := by
      intro h hh hhz
      by_contra hnz
      have hbox : Proof.MeshIntersectLoop.InBox v 0 0 ((2 * τ - 1) • v) :=
        ⟨2 * τ - 1, 0, by rw [abs_le]; constructor <;> linarith,
          by simp, by simp⟩
      have hp := hpkg ε hε0 hε ((2 * τ - 1) • v) hbox i
      have hseg : seg (z - ε • v) (z + ε • v) τ
          = z + ε • ((2 * τ - 1) • v) := by
        rw [seg_AB, smul_smul]; congr 1; ring_nf
      rw [hseg] at hhz
      exact hp.1 h hh hnz hhz
    exact hGonezero i g hg g' hg' hne ⟨hregimeP g hg hz1, hregimeP g' hg' hz2⟩

name: input_winding_const
statement:
theorem input_winding_const {M : Mesh} {z v : Point}
    (hcyc : IsClosedOrientedSurface M) (hnpo : NoPlaneThroughOrigin M)
    (hGtri : ∀ i : Fin M.size, z ∉ triangleSet M[i])
    (hGline : ∀ (i : Fin M.size), ∀ g ∈ tetraHalves M[i],
      g.eval z = 0 → dotQ g.n v ≠ 0)
    (hGonezero : ∀ (i : Fin M.size), ∀ g ∈ tetraHalves M[i],
      ∀ g' ∈ tetraHalves M[i], g ≠ g' →
      ¬ (g.eval z = 0 ∧ g'.eval z = 0)) :
    ∃ ε₀ : ℚ, 0 < ε₀ ∧ ∀ ε : ℚ, 0 < ε → ε ≤ ε₀ →
      winding (meshChain M) (z - ε • v) = winding (meshChain M) (z + ε • v)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  obtain ⟨ε₀, hε₀, hgood⟩ := good_segment hnpo hGtri hGline hGonezero
  refine ⟨ε₀, hε₀, fun ε hε0 hε => ?_⟩
  obtain ⟨hnoface, _hsingle, hG1, hG2⟩ := hgood ε hε0 hε
  
  set A := z - ε • v with hA
  set B := z + ε • v with hB
  have hG1' : ∀ (i : Fin M.size), ∀ g ∈ tetraHalves M[i],
      g.eval A ≠ 0 ∧ g.eval B ≠ 0 := hG1
  have hα : ∀ (i : Fin M.size), ∀ g ∈ tetraHalves M[i], g.eval (seg A B 0) ≠ 0 := by
    intro i g hg; rw [seg_zero]; exact (hG1 i g hg).1
  have hβ : ∀ (i : Fin M.size), ∀ g ∈ tetraHalves M[i], g.eval (seg A B 1) ≠ 0 := by
    intro i g hg; rw [seg_one]; exact (hG1 i g hg).2
  have hnoface' : ∀ (i : Fin M.size) (τ : ℚ), (0:ℚ) < τ → τ < 1 →
      seg A B τ ∉ triangleSet M[i] := hnoface
  have hsweep := sweep hcyc hnpo hG1' hG2
    (((rootsOf M A B).filter (fun τ => (0:ℚ) < τ ∧ τ < 1)).card)
    0 1 (le_refl _) (by norm_num) (le_refl _) hnoface' hα hβ (le_refl _)
  rw [seg_zero, seg_one] at hsweep
  exact hsweep

name: avoid_plane_eventually
statement:
theorem avoid_plane_eventually (n : Point) (c : ℚ) {z v : Point}
    (hgood : dotQ n z = c → dotQ n v ≠ 0) :
    ∃ ε₀ : ℚ, 0 < ε₀ ∧ ∀ ε : ℚ, 0 < ε → ε ≤ ε₀ →
      dotQ n (z - ε • v) ≠ c ∧ dotQ n (z + ε • v) ≠ c
proof:
:= by
  have hval : ∀ ε : ℚ, dotQ n (z - ε • v) = dotQ n z - ε * dotQ n v
      ∧ dotQ n (z + ε • v) = dotQ n z + ε * dotQ n v := by
    intro ε
    refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩ <;>
      · simp only [dotQ, Pi.add_apply, Pi.sub_apply, Pi.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul]
        ring
  by_cases hz : dotQ n z = c
  · 
    have hv := hgood hz
    refine ⟨1, one_pos, fun ε hε0 _ => ⟨?_, ?_⟩⟩
    · rw [(hval ε).1, hz]
      intro hc; apply hv
      have : ε * dotQ n v = 0 := by linarith
      exact (mul_eq_zero.mp this).resolve_left (ne_of_gt hε0)
    · rw [(hval ε).2, hz]
      intro hc; apply hv
      have : ε * dotQ n v = 0 := by linarith
      exact (mul_eq_zero.mp this).resolve_left (ne_of_gt hε0)
  · 
    refine ⟨|dotQ n z - c| / (1 + |dotQ n v|), by
      apply div_pos (abs_pos.mpr (sub_ne_zero.mpr hz)); positivity,
      fun ε hε0 hε => ⟨?_, ?_⟩⟩
    · rw [(hval ε).1]
      intro hc
      have heq : ε * dotQ n v = dotQ n z - c := by linarith
      have hub : ε * (1 + |dotQ n v|) ≤ |dotQ n z - c| := by
        rw [← le_div_iff₀ (by positivity)]; exact hε
      have : |ε * dotQ n v| < |dotQ n z - c| := by
        rw [abs_mul, abs_of_pos hε0]
        nlinarith [abs_nonneg (dotQ n v)]
      rw [heq] at this; exact (lt_irrefl _) this
    · rw [(hval ε).2]
      intro hc
      have heq : ε * dotQ n v = -(dotQ n z - c) := by linarith
      have hub : ε * (1 + |dotQ n v|) ≤ |dotQ n z - c| := by
        rw [← le_div_iff₀ (by positivity)]; exact hε
      have : |ε * dotQ n v| < |dotQ n z - c| := by
        rw [abs_mul, abs_of_pos hε0]
        nlinarith [abs_nonneg (dotQ n v)]
      rw [heq, abs_neg] at this; exact (lt_irrefl _) this

name: dotQ_eq_sum
statement: theorem dotQ_eq_sum (n x : Point) : dotQ n x = ∑ i, n i * x i
proof:
:= by
  simp only [dotQ, Fin.sum_univ_three]

name: negligible_planes
proof:
:= by
  classical
  obtain ⟨k, H, hHplane, hNsub⟩ := hN
  refine ⟨k, fun i => (hHplane i).choose, fun i => (hHplane i).choose_spec.choose,
    fun i => (hHplane i).choose_spec.choose_spec.1, ?_⟩
  refine hNsub.trans (Set.iUnion_mono fun i => ?_)
  have h := (hHplane i).choose_spec.choose_spec.2
  intro x hx; rw [h] at hx; exact hx

name: avoid_negligible_eventually
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have hper : ∀ i : Fin k, ∃ ε₀ : ℚ, 0 < ε₀ ∧ ∀ ε : ℚ, 0 < ε → ε ≤ ε₀ →
      dotQ (nf i) (z - ε • v) ≠ cf i ∧ dotQ (nf i) (z + ε • v) ≠ cf i :=
    fun i => avoid_plane_eventually (nf i) (cf i) (hgood i)
  obtain ⟨ε₀, hε₀, hP⟩ := Proof.MeshIntersectLoop.exists_delta_forall_fin _ hper
  refine ⟨ε₀, hε₀, fun ε hε0 hε => ⟨fun hmem => ?_, fun hmem => ?_⟩⟩
  · obtain ⟨i, hxS⟩ := Set.mem_iUnion.mp (hNsub hmem)
    exact (hP ε hε0 hε i).1 (by rw [dotQ_eq_sum]; exact hxS)
  · obtain ⟨i, hxS⟩ := Set.mem_iUnion.mp (hNsub hmem)
    exact (hP ε hε0 hε i).2 (by rw [dotQ_eq_sum]; exact hxS)

name: out_winding_const
statement:
theorem out_winding_const {M₁ M₂ : Mesh} (h₁ : Legacy.WellFormedMesh M₁)
    (h₂ : Legacy.WellFormedMesh M₂) {z v : Point}
    {k : ℕ} {nf : Fin k → Point} {cf : Fin k → ℚ}
    (hNsub : Nstar M₁ M₂ h₁.2.2.2 h₂.2.2.2
      ⊆ ⋃ i, {x | (∑ j, nf i j * x j) = cf i})
    (hNtrans : ∀ i : Fin k, dotQ (nf i) z = cf i → dotQ (nf i) v ≠ 0)
    
    (hin1 : ∃ ε₀ : ℚ, 0 < ε₀ ∧ ∀ ε : ℚ, 0 < ε → ε ≤ ε₀ →
      winding (meshChain M₁) (z - ε • v) = winding (meshChain M₁) (z + ε • v))
    (hin2 : ∃ ε₀ : ℚ, 0 < ε₀ ∧ ∀ ε : ℚ, 0 < ε → ε ≤ ε₀ →
      winding (meshChain M₂) (z - ε • v) = winding (meshChain M₂) (z + ε • v)) :
    ∃ ε₀ : ℚ, 0 < ε₀ ∧ ∀ ε : ℚ, 0 < ε → ε ≤ ε₀ →
      winding (meshChain (meshIntersect M₁ M₂)) (z - ε • v)
        = winding (meshChain (meshIntersect M₁ M₂)) (z + ε • v)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  obtain ⟨εN, hεN, hN⟩ := avoid_negligible_eventually hNsub hNtrans
  obtain ⟨ε1, hε1, hw1⟩ := hin1
  obtain ⟨ε2, hε2, hw2⟩ := hin2
  refine ⟨min εN (min ε1 ε2), lt_min hεN (lt_min hε1 hε2), fun ε hε0 hε => ?_⟩
  have hεN' : ε ≤ εN := le_trans hε (min_le_left _ _)
  have hε1' : ε ≤ ε1 := le_trans hε (le_trans (min_le_right _ _) (min_le_left _ _))
  have hε2' : ε ≤ ε2 := le_trans hε (le_trans (min_le_right _ _) (min_le_right _ _))
  obtain ⟨hAN, hBN⟩ := hN ε hε0 hεN'
  
  have hmA := master_gen_of_gen M₁ M₂ h₁ h₂
    (gen_of_not_mem_Nstar M₁ M₂ h₁.2.2.2 h₂.2.2.2 hAN)
  have hmB := master_gen_of_gen M₁ M₂ h₁ h₂
    (gen_of_not_mem_Nstar M₁ M₂ h₁.2.2.2 h₂.2.2.2 hBN)
  rw [hmA, hmB, hw1 ε hε0 hε1', hw2 ε hε0 hε2']

name: cone_sum_zero_at
statement:
theorem cone_sum_zero_at {M₁ M₂ : Mesh} (h₁ : Legacy.WellFormedMesh M₁)
    (h₂ : Legacy.WellFormedMesh M₂) {z v : Point}
    
    (hGtri : ∀ i : Fin (meshIntersect M₁ M₂).size,
      z ∉ triangleSet (meshIntersect M₁ M₂)[i])
    (hGline : ∀ (i : Fin (meshIntersect M₁ M₂).size),
      ∀ g ∈ tetraHalves (meshIntersect M₁ M₂)[i],
      g.eval z = 0 → dotQ g.n v ≠ 0)
    (hGonezero : ∀ (i : Fin (meshIntersect M₁ M₂).size),
      ∀ g ∈ tetraHalves (meshIntersect M₁ M₂)[i],
      ∀ g' ∈ tetraHalves (meshIntersect M₁ M₂)[i], g ≠ g' →
      ¬ (g.eval z = 0 ∧ g'.eval z = 0))
    
    (hWconst : ∃ ε₀ : ℚ, 0 < ε₀ ∧ ∀ ε : ℚ, 0 < ε → ε ≤ ε₀ →
      winding (meshChain (meshIntersect M₁ M₂)) (z - ε • v)
        = winding (meshChain (meshIntersect M₁ M₂)) (z + ε • v)) :
    ((outBoundaryGen M₁ M₂).map (jump z v)).sum = 0
proof:
:= by
  classical
  set out := meshIntersect M₁ M₂ with hout
  have hnpo : NoPlaneThroughOrigin out :=
    meshIntersect_noPlaneThroughOrigin M₁ M₂ h₁ h₂
  obtain ⟨εg, hεg, hgood⟩ := good_segment hnpo hGtri hGline hGonezero
  obtain ⟨εW, hεW, hW⟩ := hWconst
  set ε := min εg εW with hεdef
  have hεpos : 0 < ε := lt_min hεg hεW
  have hεg' : ε ≤ εg := min_le_left _ _
  have hεW' : ε ≤ εW := min_le_right _ _
  obtain ⟨hnoface, hsingle, hG1, hG2⟩ := hgood ε hεpos hεg'
  
  have hcj := cone_jump (M := out) (x := z - ε • v) (y := z + ε • v) hnpo
    (τs := 1/2) (by norm_num) (by norm_num) hnoface hsingle hG1 hG2
  
  rw [seg_AB_half, psub_AB] at hcj
  have hjump : ((edgeMultiset out).map (jump z ((2 * ε) • v))).sum
      = ((edgeMultiset out).map (jump z v)).sum := by
    apply congrArg Multiset.sum
    apply Multiset.map_congr rfl
    intro e _
    exact Proof.MeshIntersectCone.jump_smul_pos (by linarith : (0:ℚ) < 2 * ε) z v e
  rw [hjump] at hcj
  
  have hWdiff : winding (meshChain out) (z + ε • v)
      - winding (meshChain out) (z - ε • v) = 0 := by
    rw [hW ε hεpos hεW']; ring
  rw [hWdiff] at hcj
  
  obtain ⟨S, hS, hbS⟩ := edgeMultiset_out_gen M₁ M₂ h₁.2.2.2 h₂.2.2.2
    (Proof.MeshIntersectNpo.GenWF.of_legacy h₁) (Proof.MeshIntersectNpo.GenWF.of_legacy h₂)
  have htrans : ((edgeMultiset out).map (jump z v)).sum
      = ((outBoundaryGen M₁ M₂).map (jump z v)).sum := by
    rw [hS, Multiset.map_add, Multiset.sum_add,
      Proof.MeshIntersectCone.cone_sum_bal_zero hbS z v, add_zero]
  rw [htrans] at hcj
  exact hcj.symm

name: radRoot_avoid
statement:
theorem radRoot_avoid {n w₀ : Point} {target c : ℚ} (htarget : target ≠ 0)
    (hc : c ∉ radRoot n w₀ target) : c * dotQ n w₀ ≠ target
proof:
:= by
  unfold radRoot at hc
  by_cases h : dotQ n w₀ = 0
  · rw [h, mul_zero]; exact (Ne.symm htarget)
  · rw [dif_neg h, Finset.mem_singleton] at hc
    intro hcon
    apply hc
    field_simp
    linarith [hcon]

name: mesh_good_radial
statement:
theorem mesh_good_radial {M : Mesh} {w₀ x y : Point}
    (hnpo : NoPlaneThroughOrigin M) (_hw₀ : w₀ ≠ 0) (hxy : crossQ x y ≠ 0)
    (hguard : ∀ (i : Fin M.size) (k : Fin 4), k ≠ 3 →
      dotQ (slot M[i] k).n w₀ ≠ 0 ∨
        (dotQ (slot M[i] k).n x = 0 ∧ dotQ (slot M[i] k).n y = 0)) :
    ∃ B : Finset ℚ, ∀ c : ℚ, 0 < c → c ∉ B →
      (∀ i : Fin M.size, (c • w₀) ∉ triangleSet M[i])
      ∧ (∀ (i : Fin M.size), ∀ g ∈ tetraHalves M[i],
        g.eval (c • w₀) = 0 → dotQ g.n (crossQ x y) ≠ 0)
      ∧ (∀ (i : Fin M.size), ∀ g ∈ tetraHalves M[i],
        ∀ g' ∈ tetraHalves M[i], g ≠ g' →
        ¬ (g.eval (c • w₀) = 0 ∧ g'.eval (c • w₀) = 0))
proof:
:= by
  classical
  refine ⟨Finset.univ.biUnion (fun i : Fin M.size =>
    radRoot (Proof.MeshIntersectRay.carrierNormal M[i]) w₀ (detOrigin M[i])), fun c hc hcB => ?_⟩
  
  have hcar : ∀ i : Fin M.size, c * dotQ (Proof.MeshIntersectRay.carrierNormal M[i]) w₀ ≠ detOrigin M[i] := by
    intro i
    apply radRoot_avoid (hnpo i)
    intro hmem
    exact hcB (Finset.mem_biUnion.mpr ⟨i, Finset.mem_univ i, hmem⟩)
  
  have hslotval : ∀ (i : Fin M.size) (k : Fin 4),
      (slot M[i] k).eval (c • w₀) = c * dotQ (slot M[i] k).n w₀ - (slot M[i] k).c := by
    intro i k
    rw [Half.eval, Proof.MeshIntersectRay.dotQ_smul_right]
  
  have hbase : ∀ i : Fin M.size, (slot M[i] 3).eval (c • w₀) ≠ 0 := by
    intro i hc0
    rw [Proof.MeshIntersectLoop.slot3_eval_zero_iff,
      Proof.MeshIntersectRay.dotQ_smul_right] at hc0
    exact hcar i hc0
  
  have hvanish : ∀ (i : Fin M.size) (k : Fin 4), (slot M[i] k).eval (c • w₀) = 0 →
      k ≠ 3 ∧ dotQ (slot M[i] k).n w₀ = 0 := by
    intro i k hk0
    have hk3 : k ≠ 3 := by
      intro h; rw [h] at hk0; exact hbase i hk0
    refine ⟨hk3, ?_⟩
    rw [hslotval, Proof.MeshIntersectLoop.slot_lat_c _ k hk3, sub_zero] at hk0
    exact (mul_eq_zero.mp hk0).resolve_left (ne_of_gt hc)
  refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · 
    intro i hmem
    exact hcar i (by
      rw [← Proof.MeshIntersectRay.dotQ_smul_right]
      exact Proof.MeshIntersectEval.mem_triangleSet_onPlane (hnpo i) hmem)
  · 
    intro i g hg hg0
    obtain ⟨k, rfl⟩ := mem_tetraHalves_iff.mp hg
    obtain ⟨hk3, hw0⟩ := hvanish i k hg0
    
    rcases hguard i k hk3 with h | ⟨hgx, hgy⟩
    · exact absurd hw0 h
    · exact dotQ_crossQ_ne_zero_of_orth
        (Proof.MeshIntersectLoop.tetraHalves_n_ne_zero (hnpo i) (slot_mem _ k))
        hgx hgy hxy
  · 
    intro i g hg g' hg' hne ⟨hg0, hg0'⟩
    obtain ⟨k, rfl⟩ := mem_tetraHalves_iff.mp hg
    obtain ⟨k', rfl⟩ := mem_tetraHalves_iff.mp hg'
    obtain ⟨hk3, hw0⟩ := hvanish i k hg0
    obtain ⟨hk3', hw0'⟩ := hvanish i k' hg0'
    
    rcases hguard i k hk3 with h | ⟨hgx, hgy⟩
    · exact absurd hw0 h
    rcases hguard i k' hk3' with h | ⟨hg'x, hg'y⟩
    · exact absurd hw0' h
    
    have hnk := Proof.MeshIntersectLoop.tetraHalves_n_ne_zero (hnpo i) (slot_mem _ k)
    have hnk' := Proof.MeshIntersectLoop.tetraHalves_n_ne_zero (hnpo i) (slot_mem _ k')
    obtain ⟨α, hα, hαeq⟩ := eq_smul_crossQ_of_orth hnk hgx hgy hxy
    obtain ⟨β, hβ, hβeq⟩ := eq_smul_crossQ_of_orth hnk' hg'x hg'y hxy
    obtain ⟨p, hgp, hg'p⟩ :=
      Proof.MeshIntersectLoop.facet_pair_vertex (hnpo i) (slot_mem _ k)
        (slot_mem _ k') hne
    
    have hlatk : (slot M[i] k).c = 0 := Proof.MeshIntersectLoop.slot_lat_c _ k hk3
    have hlatk' : (slot M[i] k').c = 0 := Proof.MeshIntersectLoop.slot_lat_c _ k' hk3'
    have hg'pn : dotQ (slot M[i] k').n p = 0 := by
      have := hg'p; rw [Half.eval, hlatk', sub_zero] at this; exact this
    have hcrossp : dotQ (crossQ x y) p = 0 := by
      rw [hβeq, Proof.SimImplCover.dotQ_smul_left] at hg'pn
      exact (mul_eq_zero.mp hg'pn).resolve_left hβ
    apply hgp
    rw [Half.eval, hlatk, sub_zero, hαeq, Proof.SimImplCover.dotQ_smul_left,
      hcrossp, mul_zero]

name: cone_sum_zero_of_good_z
statement:
theorem cone_sum_zero_of_good_z {M₁ M₂ : Mesh} (h₁ : Legacy.WellFormedMesh M₁)
    (h₂ : Legacy.WellFormedMesh M₂) {z : Point} {x y : Point}
    {k : ℕ} {nf : Fin k → Point} {cf : Fin k → ℚ}
    (hNsub : Nstar M₁ M₂ h₁.2.2.2 h₂.2.2.2
      ⊆ ⋃ i, {p | (∑ j, nf i j * p j) = cf i})
    (hNtrans : ∀ i : Fin k, dotQ (nf i) z = cf i → dotQ (nf i) (crossQ x y) ≠ 0)
    
    (hOtri : ∀ i : Fin (meshIntersect M₁ M₂).size,
      z ∉ triangleSet (meshIntersect M₁ M₂)[i])
    (hOline : ∀ (i : Fin (meshIntersect M₁ M₂).size),
      ∀ g ∈ tetraHalves (meshIntersect M₁ M₂)[i],
      g.eval z = 0 → dotQ g.n (crossQ x y) ≠ 0)
    (hOone : ∀ (i : Fin (meshIntersect M₁ M₂).size),
      ∀ g ∈ tetraHalves (meshIntersect M₁ M₂)[i],
      ∀ g' ∈ tetraHalves (meshIntersect M₁ M₂)[i], g ≠ g' →
      ¬ (g.eval z = 0 ∧ g'.eval z = 0))
    
    (h1tri : ∀ i : Fin M₁.size, z ∉ triangleSet M₁[i])
    (h1line : ∀ (i : Fin M₁.size), ∀ g ∈ tetraHalves M₁[i],
      g.eval z = 0 → dotQ g.n (crossQ x y) ≠ 0)
    (h1one : ∀ (i : Fin M₁.size), ∀ g ∈ tetraHalves M₁[i],
      ∀ g' ∈ tetraHalves M₁[i], g ≠ g' → ¬ (g.eval z = 0 ∧ g'.eval z = 0))
    
    (h2tri : ∀ i : Fin M₂.size, z ∉ triangleSet M₂[i])
    (h2line : ∀ (i : Fin M₂.size), ∀ g ∈ tetraHalves M₂[i],
      g.eval z = 0 → dotQ g.n (crossQ x y) ≠ 0)
    (h2one : ∀ (i : Fin M₂.size), ∀ g ∈ tetraHalves M₂[i],
      ∀ g' ∈ tetraHalves M₂[i], g ≠ g' → ¬ (g.eval z = 0 ∧ g'.eval z = 0)) :
    ((outBoundaryGen M₁ M₂).map (jump z (crossQ x y))).sum = 0
proof:
:= by
  have hin1 := input_winding_const (v := crossQ x y) h₁.1 h₁.2.2.2 h1tri h1line h1one
  have hin2 := input_winding_const (v := crossQ x y) h₂.1 h₂.2.2.2 h2tri h2line h2one
  have hWconst := out_winding_const (v := crossQ x y) h₁ h₂ hNsub hNtrans hin1 hin2
  exact cone_sum_zero_at h₁ h₂ hOtri hOline hOone hWconst

name: mem_planeNormalList
statement:
theorem mem_planeNormalList {k : ℕ} (nf : Fin k → Point) (i : Fin k) :
    dotAffine (nf i) ∈ planeNormalList nf
proof:
:= by
  rw [planeNormalList, List.mem_map]
  exact ⟨i, List.mem_finRange i, rfl⟩

name: nstar_trans_radial
statement:
theorem nstar_trans_radial {k : ℕ} {nf : Fin k → Point} {cf : Fin k → ℚ}
    {w₀ x y : Point} (hxy : crossQ x y ≠ 0) (hnf : ∀ i, nf i ≠ 0)
    (hz : ∀ φ ∈ planeNormalList nf, (φ x ≠ 0 ∨ φ y ≠ 0) → φ w₀ ≠ 0) :
    ∃ B : Finset ℚ, ∀ c : ℚ, 0 < c → c ∉ B →
      ∀ i : Fin k, dotQ (nf i) (c • w₀) = cf i → dotQ (nf i) (crossQ x y) ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  classical
  refine ⟨Finset.univ.biUnion (fun i : Fin k =>
    if dotQ (nf i) w₀ = 0 then ∅ else {cf i / dotQ (nf i) w₀}), fun c hc hcB i hci => ?_⟩
  rw [Proof.MeshIntersectRay.dotQ_smul_right] at hci
  by_cases hv : dotQ (nf i) (crossQ x y) = 0
  · exfalso
    
    by_cases hw0 : dotQ (nf i) w₀ = 0
    · 
      rw [hw0, mul_zero] at hci   
      
      by_cases hxy0 : dotQ (nf i) x = 0 ∧ dotQ (nf i) y = 0
      · exact (dotQ_crossQ_ne_zero_of_orth (hnf i) hxy0.1 hxy0.2 hxy) hv
      · push_neg at hxy0
        have hor : dotAffine (nf i) x ≠ 0 ∨ dotAffine (nf i) y ≠ 0 := by
          by_cases hx0 : dotQ (nf i) x = 0
          · exact Or.inr (by simp only [dotAffine_apply]; exact hxy0 hx0)
          · exact Or.inl (by simp only [dotAffine_apply]; exact hx0)
        exact (hz _ (mem_planeNormalList nf i) hor) (by simpa using hw0)
    · 
      apply hcB
      refine Finset.mem_biUnion.mpr ⟨i, Finset.mem_univ i, ?_⟩
      rw [if_neg hw0, Finset.mem_singleton]
      field_simp
      linarith [hci]
  · exact hv

name: exists_lt_all_pos
statement:
theorem exists_lt_all_pos (S : Finset ℚ) :
    ∃ η₀ : ℚ, 0 < η₀ ∧ ∀ η : ℚ, 0 < η → η ≤ η₀ → η ∉ S
proof:
:= by
  classical
  set P := S.filter (fun s => 0 < s) with hP
  by_cases hPe : P.Nonempty
  · set m := P.min' hPe with hmdef
    have hmpos : 0 < m := (Finset.mem_filter.mp (Finset.min'_mem P hPe)).2
    refine ⟨m / 2, by positivity, fun η hη0 hη hmem => ?_⟩
    have hηP : η ∈ P := Finset.mem_filter.mpr ⟨hmem, hη0⟩
    have hge : m ≤ η := Finset.min'_le P η hηP
    linarith
  · refine ⟨1, one_pos, fun η hη0 _ hmem => ?_⟩
    exact hPe ⟨η, Finset.mem_filter.mpr ⟨hmem, hη0⟩⟩

name: straddle_jumps_zero
statement:
theorem straddle_jumps_zero {M₁ M₂ : Mesh}
    (h₁ : Legacy.WellFormedMesh M₁) (h₂ : Legacy.WellFormedMesh M₂)
    {x y : Point} (hxy : x ≠ y)
    (hcar : (x, y) ∈ outBoundaryGen M₁ M₂ ∨ (y, x) ∈ outBoundaryGen M₁ M₂) :
    ∃ (w₀ v : Point), GenericPt (outBoundaryGen M₁ M₂) x y w₀ ∧ w₀ ≠ 0
      ∧ dotQ (crossQ x y) v ≠ 0
      ∧ ∃ η₀ : ℚ, 0 < η₀ ∧ ∀ η : ℚ, 0 < η → η ≤ η₀ →
        ((outBoundaryGen M₁ M₂).map (jump ((1 - η) • w₀) v)).sum = 0
        ∧ ((outBoundaryGen M₁ M₂).map (jump ((1 + η) • w₀) v)).sum = 0
proof:
:= by
  classical
  
  have hcxy : crossQ x y ≠ 0 := by
    rcases hcar with h | h
    · exact outBoundaryGen_crossQ_ne_zero h₁.2.2.2 h₂.2.2.2 h
    · have hyx : crossQ y x ≠ 0 := outBoundaryGen_crossQ_ne_zero h₁.2.2.2 h₂.2.2.2 h
      rw [CSG.Proof.MeshIntersectClip.crossQ_anticomm] at hyx
      exact fun hc => hyx (by rw [hc, neg_zero])
  
  obtain ⟨k, nf, cf, hnf, hNsub⟩ :=
    negligible_planes (negligible_Nstar M₁ M₂ h₁.2.2.2 h₂.2.2.2)
  
  set out := meshIntersect M₁ M₂ with hout
  set G : List (Point →ᵃ[ℚ] ℚ) :=
    slotNormalList out ++ slotNormalList M₁ ++ slotNormalList M₂ ++ planeNormalList nf
    with hGdef
  
  obtain ⟨w₀, hgen, hbavoid, hzG⟩ := exists_zpick (outBoundaryGen M₁ M₂) hxy [0] G
  have hw₀ : w₀ ≠ 0 := hbavoid 0 (List.mem_singleton.mpr rfl)
  have hdot : dotQ (crossQ x y) (crossQ x y) ≠ 0 :=
    ne_of_gt (Proof.MeshIntersectRay.dotQ_self_pos hcxy)
  refine ⟨w₀, crossQ x y, hgen, hw₀, hdot, ?_⟩
  
  have hzG' : ∀ φ ∈ G, (φ x ≠ 0 ∨ φ y ≠ 0) → φ w₀ ≠ 0 := hzG
  have hzOut : ∀ φ ∈ slotNormalList out, (φ x ≠ 0 ∨ φ y ≠ 0) → φ w₀ ≠ 0 := fun φ hφ =>
    hzG' φ (by rw [hGdef]; exact List.mem_append_left _ (List.mem_append_left _
      (List.mem_append_left _ hφ)))
  have hz1 : ∀ φ ∈ slotNormalList M₁, (φ x ≠ 0 ∨ φ y ≠ 0) → φ w₀ ≠ 0 := fun φ hφ =>
    hzG' φ (by rw [hGdef]; exact List.mem_append_left _ (List.mem_append_left _
      (List.mem_append_right _ hφ)))
  have hz2 : ∀ φ ∈ slotNormalList M₂, (φ x ≠ 0 ∨ φ y ≠ 0) → φ w₀ ≠ 0 := fun φ hφ =>
    hzG' φ (by rw [hGdef]; exact List.mem_append_left _ (List.mem_append_right _ hφ))
  have hzN : ∀ φ ∈ planeNormalList nf, (φ x ≠ 0 ∨ φ y ≠ 0) → φ w₀ ≠ 0 := fun φ hφ =>
    hzG' φ (by rw [hGdef]; exact List.mem_append_right _ hφ)
  
  have hgOut := mesh_good_radial (M := out)
    (meshIntersect_noPlaneThroughOrigin M₁ M₂ h₁ h₂) hw₀ hcxy
    (hguard_of_zpick hzOut)
  have hg1 := mesh_good_radial (M := M₁) h₁.2.2.2 hw₀ hcxy (hguard_of_zpick hz1)
  have hg2 := mesh_good_radial (M := M₂) h₂.2.2.2 hw₀ hcxy (hguard_of_zpick hz2)
  have hgN := nstar_trans_radial (cf := cf) hcxy hnf hzN
  obtain ⟨BO, hBO⟩ := hgOut
  obtain ⟨B1, hB1⟩ := hg1
  obtain ⟨B2, hB2⟩ := hg2
  obtain ⟨BN, hBN⟩ := hgN
  
  set Ball : Finset ℚ := BO ∪ B1 ∪ B2 ∪ BN with hBall
  set badEta : Finset ℚ :=
    (Ball.image (fun b => 1 - b)) ∪ (Ball.image (fun b => b - 1)) with hbadEta
  obtain ⟨η₁, hη₁, hη₁avoid⟩ := exists_lt_all_pos badEta
  refine ⟨min η₁ (1/2), lt_min hη₁ (by norm_num), fun η hη0 hη => ?_⟩
  have hηη₁ : η ≤ η₁ := le_trans hη (min_le_left _ _)
  have hηhalf : η ≤ 1/2 := le_trans hη (min_le_right _ _)
  have hηbad : η ∉ badEta := hη₁avoid η hη0 hηη₁
  
  have hcgood : ∀ c : ℚ, 0 < c → c ∉ Ball →
      ((outBoundaryGen M₁ M₂).map (jump (c • w₀) (crossQ x y))).sum = 0 := by
    intro c hcpos hcBall
    have hcBO : c ∉ BO := fun h => hcBall (by
      rw [hBall]; exact Finset.mem_union_left _ (Finset.mem_union_left _
        (Finset.mem_union_left _ h)))
    have hcB1 : c ∉ B1 := fun h => hcBall (by
      rw [hBall]; exact Finset.mem_union_left _ (Finset.mem_union_left _
        (Finset.mem_union_right _ h)))
    have hcB2 : c ∉ B2 := fun h => hcBall (by
      rw [hBall]; exact Finset.mem_union_left _ (Finset.mem_union_right _ h))
    have hcBN : c ∉ BN := fun h => hcBall (by rw [hBall]; exact Finset.mem_union_right _ h)
    obtain ⟨hOtri, hOline, hOone⟩ := hBO c hcpos hcBO
    obtain ⟨h1tri, h1line, h1one⟩ := hB1 c hcpos hcB1
    obtain ⟨h2tri, h2line, h2one⟩ := hB2 c hcpos hcB2
    have hNtr := hBN c hcpos hcBN
    exact cone_sum_zero_of_good_z (x := x) (y := y) h₁ h₂ hNsub hNtr
      hOtri hOline hOone h1tri h1line h1one h2tri h2line h2one
  
  have hin_pos : (0:ℚ) < 1 - η := by linarith
  have hout_pos : (0:ℚ) < 1 + η := by linarith
  have hin_ball : (1 - η) ∉ Ball := by
    intro hmem
    apply hηbad
    rw [hbadEta]; refine Finset.mem_union_left _ ?_
    rw [Finset.mem_image]; exact ⟨1 - η, hmem, by ring⟩
  have hout_ball : (1 + η) ∉ Ball := by
    intro hmem
    apply hηbad
    rw [hbadEta]; refine Finset.mem_union_right _ ?_
    rw [Finset.mem_image]; exact ⟨1 + η, hmem, by ring⟩
  exact ⟨hcgood (1 - η) hin_pos hin_ball, hcgood (1 + η) hout_pos hout_ball⟩

name: mu_outBoundaryGen_zero
proof:
:= by
  classical
  by_cases hcar : (x, y) ∈ outBoundaryGen M₁ M₂ ∨ (y, x) ∈ outBoundaryGen M₁ M₂
  · 
    have hnd := outBoundaryGen_nondeg M₁ M₂ h₁.2.2.2 h₂.2.2.2
    have hsat := outBoundaryGen_saturated M₁ M₂ h₁.2.2.2 h₂.2.2.2
    have hxy : x ≠ y := by
      rcases hcar with h | h
      · exact hnd _ h
      · exact (hnd _ h).symm
    obtain ⟨w₀, v, hgen, hw₀, hv, η₀, hη₀, hjz⟩ :=
      straddle_jumps_zero h₁ h₂ hxy hcar
    
    have hcr : ∀ e ∈ outBoundaryGen M₁ M₂, crossQ e.1 e.2 ≠ 0 := by
      intro e he
      exact outBoundaryGen_crossQ_ne_zero h₁.2.2.2 h₂.2.2.2
        (show (e.1, e.2) ∈ outBoundaryGen M₁ M₂ from by rw [Prod.mk.eta]; exact he)
    
    obtain ⟨η₁, hη₁, hmu⟩ :=
      edge_mu (v := v) hsat hnd hxy hcar hgen hw₀ hcr
    set η := min η₀ η₁ with hηdef
    have hηpos : 0 < η := lt_min hη₀ hη₁
    have hjz' := hjz η hηpos (min_le_left _ _)
    have hmu' := hmu η hηpos (min_le_right _ _)
    rw [hjz'.1, hjz'.2, sub_zero] at hmu'
    
    have hq : qsign (dotQ (crossQ x y) v) ≠ 0 := by
      rcases lt_trichotomy (dotQ (crossQ x y) v) 0 with h | h | h
      · rw [qsign_of_neg h]; exact neg_ne_zero.mpr one_ne_zero
      · exact absurd h hv
      · rw [qsign_of_pos h]; exact one_ne_zero
    exact (mul_eq_zero.mp hmu'.symm).resolve_right hq
  · 
    push_neg at hcar
    simp [mu, Multiset.count_eq_zero_of_not_mem hcar.1,
      Multiset.count_eq_zero_of_not_mem hcar.2]

name: meshIntersect_isCycle
statement:
theorem meshIntersect_isCycle (M₁ M₂ : Mesh)
    (h₁ : Legacy.WellFormedMesh M₁) (h₂ : Legacy.WellFormedMesh M₂) :
    IsClosedOrientedSurface (meshIntersect M₁ M₂)
proof:
:= by
  rw [isCycle_iff_bal, bal_iff_mu]
  intro x y
  rw [mu_outBoundaryGen_eq M₁ M₂ h₁.2.2.2 h₂.2.2.2
    (Proof.MeshIntersectNpo.GenWF.of_legacy h₁) (Proof.MeshIntersectNpo.GenWF.of_legacy h₂) x y]
  exact mu_outBoundaryGen_zero h₁ h₂ x y

name: const_one_ne_zero
statement: theorem const_one_ne_zero : (fun _ => (1 : ℚ)) ≠ (0 : Point)
proof:
:= by
  intro h
  have := congrFun h 0
  simp at this

name: resN_ne
statement:
theorem resN_ne {M : Mesh} (hnpo : NoPlaneThroughOrigin M) {P₁ : Point}
    (h1 : G1Clean M P₁) (α : RIdx M) : resN M P₁ α ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [resN]
  split
  · exact const_one_ne_zero
  · rename_i hkk
    exact resultant_ne (hnpo α.1) hkk
      (h1 α.1 _ (mem_tetraHalves_iff.mpr ⟨α.2.1, rfl⟩))
      (h1 α.1 _ (mem_tetraHalves_iff.mpr ⟨α.2.2, rfl⟩))

name: eval_seg
statement:
theorem eval_seg (g : Half) (P₁ P₂ : Point) (τ : ℚ) :
    g.eval (fun k => P₁ k + τ * (P₂ k - P₁ k))
      = (1 - τ) * g.eval P₁ + τ * g.eval P₂
proof:
:= by
  simp only [Half.eval, dotQ]
  ring

name: dotQ_resultant
statement:
theorem dotQ_resultant (a a' : ℚ) (u v w : Point) :
    dotQ (a • v - a' • u) w = a * dotQ v w - a' * dotQ u w
proof:
:= by
  simp only [dotQ, Pi.sub_apply, Pi.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul]
  ring

name: hG2_of_avoid
statement:
theorem hG2_of_avoid {M : Mesh} {P₁ P₂ : Point}
    (havoid : ∀ α : RIdx M, dotQ (resN M P₁ α) P₂ ≠ resD M P₁ α) :
    ∀ (i : Fin M.size), ∀ g ∈ tetraHalves M[i], ∀ g' ∈ tetraHalves M[i], g ≠ g' →
      ∀ τ : ℚ, 0 < τ → τ < 1 →
      ¬ (g.eval (fun k => P₁ k + τ * (P₂ k - P₁ k)) = 0
          ∧ g'.eval (fun k => P₁ k + τ * (P₂ k - P₁ k)) = 0)
proof:
:= by
  rintro i g hg g' hg' hne τ hτ0 hτ1 ⟨hgz, hg'z⟩
  obtain ⟨k, rfl⟩ := mem_tetraHalves_iff.mp hg
  obtain ⟨k', rfl⟩ := mem_tetraHalves_iff.mp hg'
  have hkk : k ≠ k' := by rintro rfl; exact hne rfl
  rw [eval_seg] at hgz hg'z
  set a := (slot M[i] k).eval P₁ with ha
  set b := (slot M[i] k).eval P₂ with hb
  set a' := (slot M[i] k').eval P₁ with ha'
  set b' := (slot M[i] k').eval P₂ with hb'
  
  have hres : a * b' - a' * b = 0 := by
    have h : τ * (a * b' - a' * b) = a * ((1 - τ) * a' + τ * b') - a' * ((1 - τ) * a + τ * b) := by
      ring
    rw [hgz, hg'z, mul_zero, mul_zero, sub_zero] at h
    exact (mul_eq_zero.mp h).resolve_left (ne_of_gt hτ0)
  refine havoid ⟨i, k, k'⟩ ?_
  simp only [resN, resD, if_neg hkk]
  rw [dotQ_resultant]
  simp only [← ha, ← ha']
  have hbv : dotQ (slot M[i] k').n P₂ = b' + (slot M[i] k').c := by
    rw [hb']; simp only [Half.eval]; ring
  have hbu : dotQ (slot M[i] k).n P₂ = b + (slot M[i] k).c := by
    rw [hb]; simp only [Half.eval]; ring
  rw [hbv, hbu]
  nlinarith [hres]

name: nudge_wa
statement:
theorem nudge_wa {M : Mesh} (hcyc : IsClosedOrientedSurface M)
    (hnpo : NoPlaneThroughOrigin M) (hns : NoFaceInteriorContact M)
    {Wa : Point → ℤ} (hclean : CleanDirs M Wa)
    {Q : Point} (hQoff : ∀ u : Fin M.size, Q ∉ triangleSet M[u])
    {ρ : ℚ} (hρ : 0 < ρ)
    {ι : Type} [Fintype ι] (Nx : ι → Point) (dx : ι → ℚ) (hNx : ∀ α, Nx α ≠ 0) :
    ∃ P : Point, G1Clean M P ∧ (∀ k, |P k - Q k| ≤ ρ) ∧
      (∀ α, dotQ (Nx α) P ≠ dx α) ∧ Wa Q = winding (meshChain M) P
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨d, hd, hdc, hWa⟩ := hclean Q
  obtain ⟨P, hP, hball, havoid, hw⟩ := nudge hcyc hnpo hns hQoff hd hdc ρ hρ Nx dx hNx
  exact ⟨P, hP, hball, havoid, by rw [hWa, hw]⟩

name: wa_eq_of_fat_segment
statement:
theorem wa_eq_of_fat_segment {M : Mesh} (hcyc : IsClosedOrientedSurface M)
    (hnpo : NoPlaneThroughOrigin M) (hns : NoFaceInteriorContact M)
    {Wa : Point → ℤ} (hclean : CleanDirs M Wa)
    {Q₁ Q₂ : Point} {ρ : ℚ} (hρ : 0 < ρ)
    (hfat : ∀ τ : ℚ, 0 ≤ τ → τ ≤ 1 → ∀ z : Point,
      (∀ k, |z k - (Q₁ k + τ * (Q₂ k - Q₁ k))| ≤ ρ) →
      ∀ u : Fin M.size, z ∉ triangleSet M[u]) :
    Wa Q₁ = Wa Q₂
proof:
:= by
  
  have hQ₁off : ∀ u : Fin M.size, Q₁ ∉ triangleSet M[u] := by
    refine hfat 0 le_rfl zero_le_one Q₁ (fun k => ?_)
    simp only [zero_mul, add_zero, sub_self, abs_zero]
    exact le_of_lt hρ
  have hQ₂off : ∀ u : Fin M.size, Q₂ ∉ triangleSet M[u] := by
    refine hfat 1 zero_le_one le_rfl Q₂ (fun k => ?_)
    have : Q₂ k - (Q₁ k + 1 * (Q₂ k - Q₁ k)) = 0 := by ring
    rw [this, abs_zero]
    exact le_of_lt hρ
  
  obtain ⟨P₁, hP₁, hball₁, -, hw₁⟩ :=
    nudge_wa hcyc hnpo hns hclean hQ₁off hρ (ι := Empty) (fun α => α.elim)
      (fun α => α.elim) (fun α => α.elim)
  
  obtain ⟨P₂, hP₂, hball₂, havoid, hw₂⟩ :=
    nudge_wa hcyc hnpo hns hclean hQ₂off hρ (resN M P₁) (resD M P₁) (resN_ne hnpo hP₁)
  rw [hw₁, hw₂]
  refine winding_const_of_avoiding M hcyc hnpo P₁ P₂ ?_ ?_ (hG2_of_avoid havoid)
  · 
    intro u τ hτ0 hτ1
    refine hfat τ (le_of_lt hτ0) (le_of_lt hτ1) _ (fun k => ?_) u
    have hkey : P₁ k + τ * (P₂ k - P₁ k) - (Q₁ k + τ * (Q₂ k - Q₁ k))
        = (1 - τ) * (P₁ k - Q₁ k) + τ * (P₂ k - Q₂ k) := by ring
    rw [hkey]
    have h1 : |(1 - τ) * (P₁ k - Q₁ k)| ≤ (1 - τ) * ρ := by
      rw [abs_mul, abs_of_nonneg (by linarith : (0:ℚ) ≤ 1 - τ)]
      exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (hball₁ k) (by linarith)
    have h2 : |τ * (P₂ k - Q₂ k)| ≤ τ * ρ := by
      rw [abs_mul, abs_of_nonneg (le_of_lt hτ0)]
      exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (hball₂ k) (le_of_lt hτ0)
    calc |(1 - τ) * (P₁ k - Q₁ k) + τ * (P₂ k - Q₂ k)|
        ≤ |(1 - τ) * (P₁ k - Q₁ k)| + |τ * (P₂ k - Q₂ k)| := abs_add _ _
      _ ≤ (1 - τ) * ρ + τ * ρ := by linarith
      _ = ρ := by ring
  · exact fun i g hg => ⟨hP₁ i g hg, hP₂ i g hg⟩

name: list_any_congr
statement:
theorem list_any_congr {α} : ∀ (l : List α) (p q : α → Bool),
    (∀ a ∈ l, p a = q a) → l.any p = l.any q
  | [], _, _, _ => rfl
  | a :: l, p, q, h => by
      simp only [List.any_cons, h a (List.mem_cons_self _ _),
        list_any_congr l p q (fun x hx => h x (List.mem_cons_of_mem _ hx))]

/
predicates. -/

name: forall2_filter
statement:
theorem forall2_filter {α} (R : α → α → Prop) (p q : α → Bool)
    (hpq : ∀ a b, R a b → p a = q b) :
    ∀ {l l' : List α}, List.Forall₂ R l l' →
      List.Forall₂ R (l.filter p) (l'.filter q)
  | _, _, List.Forall₂.nil => List.Forall₂.nil
  | _, _, List.Forall₂.cons (a := a) (b := b) hab htl => by
      simp only [List.filter_cons, ← hpq a b hab]
      cases hp : p a
      · simpa [hp] using forall2_filter R p q hpq htl
      · simpa [hp] using List.Forall₂.cons hab (forall2_filter R p q hpq htl)

/-! ## 1. The split verdict is seam-invariant -/

/
carriers against a materialized (own-`iFacePlaneP`) opponent mesh and its translate. -/

name: memPrim_primKeys_seam
statement:
theorem memPrim_primKeys_seam (o : P3) (g g' : IPlane) (B : Array FaceS)
    (hpl : PlaneSeam o g g')
    (hB : ∀ u ∈ B, u.plane = iFacePlaneP u.v₀.p u.v₁.p u.v₂.p) :
    memPrim (primKeys (B.map (trFaceS o))) g' = memPrim (primKeys B) g
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨a, b, c, hg, hg'⟩ := hpl
  have e1 : memPrim (primKeys (B.map (trFaceS o))) g'
      = (B.map (trFaceS o)).any (fun u => coplanarPlane g' u.plane) :=
    isCoplanarWith_eq_any { plane := g', poly := #[] }
      (B.map (trFaceS o))
  have e2 : memPrim (primKeys B) g = B.any (fun u => coplanarPlane g u.plane) :=
    isCoplanarWith_eq_any { plane := g, poly := #[] } B
  rw [e1, e2, ← Array.any_toList, ← Array.any_toList, Array.toList_map]
  rw [List.any_map]
  apply list_any_congr
  intro u hu
  have hup : u.plane = iFacePlaneP u.v₀.p u.v₁.p u.v₂.p := hB u (Array.mem_toList.mp hu)
  show coplanarPlane g' (trFaceS o u).plane = coplanarPlane g u.plane
  rw [hg, hg', hup]
  show coplanarPlane (iFacePlaneP (psubS a o) (psubS b o) (psubS c o))
        (iFacePlaneP (psubS u.v₀.p o) (psubS u.v₁.p o) (psubS u.v₂.p o))
     = coplanarPlane (iFacePlaneP a b c) (iFacePlaneP u.v₀.p u.v₁.p u.v₂.p)
  exact coplanarPlane_iFacePlaneP_tr o a b c u.v₀.p u.v₁.p u.v₂.p

name: splitCoplanar_seam
statement:
theorem splitCoplanar_seam (o : P3) (frags frags' : Array Frag) (B : Array FaceS)
    (hff : List.Forall₂ (FragSeam o) frags.toList frags'.toList)
    (hB : ∀ u ∈ B, u.plane = iFacePlaneP u.v₀.p u.v₁.p u.v₂.p) :
    List.Forall₂ (FragSeam o)
        (splitCoplanar frags B).1.toList (splitCoplanar frags' (B.map (trFaceS o))).1.toList
      ∧ List.Forall₂ (FragSeam o)
        (splitCoplanar frags B).2.toList (splitCoplanar frags' (B.map (trFaceS o))).2.toList
proof:
:= by
  have hpred : ∀ f f', FragSeam o f f' →
      memPrim (primKeys (B.map (trFaceS o))) f'.plane = memPrim (primKeys B) f.plane := by
    intro f f' hs
    exact memPrim_primKeys_seam o f.plane f'.plane B hs.2 hB
  simp only [splitCoplanar, Array.toList_filter]
  refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
  · exact forall2_filter (FragSeam o) (fun f => memPrim (primKeys B) f.plane)
      (fun f => memPrim (primKeys (B.map (trFaceS o))) f.plane)
      (fun a b h => (hpred a b h).symm) hff
  · exact forall2_filter (FragSeam o) (fun f => !memPrim (primKeys B) f.plane)
      (fun f => !memPrim (primKeys (B.map (trFaceS o))) f.plane)
      (fun a b h => congrArg Bool.not (hpred a b h).symm) hff

name: tetra_facet_pos_smul
statement:
theorem tetra_facet_pos_smul (t : Triangle)
    (h : AffineIndependent ℚ ![(0 : Point), t.v₀, t.v₁, t.v₂])
    (b : AffineBasis (Fin 4) ℚ (Fin 3 → ℚ))
    (hbcoe : ⇑b = ![(0 : Point), t.v₀, t.v₁, t.v₂]) :
    (∀ g ∈ tetraHalves t, ∃ (j : Fin 4) (lam : ℚ), 0 < lam ∧ gOf g = lam • b.coord j)
      ∧ (∀ j : Fin 4, ∃ g ∈ tetraHalves t, ∃ lam : ℚ, 0 < lam ∧ gOf g = lam • b.coord j)
proof:
:= by
  have hsz4 : (tetraHalves t).size = 4 := rfl
  set f0 : Half := (tetraHalves t)[0]'(by rw [hsz4]; omega) with hf0d
  set f1 : Half := (tetraHalves t)[1]'(by rw [hsz4]; omega) with hf1d
  set f2 : Half := (tetraHalves t)[2]'(by rw [hsz4]; omega) with hf2d
  set f3 : Half := (tetraHalves t)[3]'(by rw [hsz4]; omega) with hf3d
  have hmem0 : f0 ∈ tetraHalves t := by rw [hf0d]; exact Array.getElem_mem _
  have hmem1 : f1 ∈ tetraHalves t := by rw [hf1d]; exact Array.getElem_mem _
  have hmem2 : f2 ∈ tetraHalves t := by rw [hf2d]; exact Array.getElem_mem _
  have hmem3 : f3 ∈ tetraHalves t := by rw [hf3d]; exact Array.getElem_mem _
  have hall : ∀ g ∈ tetraHalves t, g = f0 ∨ g = f1 ∨ g = f2 ∨ g = f3 := by
    intro g hg
    obtain ⟨n, hn, rfl⟩ := Array.mem_iff_getElem.mp hg
    rw [hsz4] at hn
    interval_cases n
    · left; rfl
    · right; left; rfl
    · right; right; left; rfl
    · right; right; right; rfl
  have hb0 : b 0 = (0 : Point) := by rw [hbcoe]; rfl
  have hb1 : b 1 = t.v₀ := by rw [hbcoe]; rfl
  have hb2 : b 2 = t.v₁ := by rw [hbcoe]; rfl
  have hb3 : b 3 = t.v₂ := by rw [hbcoe]; rfl
  have hdet : det3 t.v₀ t.v₁ t.v₂ ≠ 0 := by
    rw [det3_ne_zero_iff_linearIndependent]
    rw [affineIndependent_iff] at h
    rw [Fintype.linearIndependent_iff]
    intro ss hst i0
    set w : Fin 4 → ℚ := ![-(ss 0 + ss 1 + ss 2), ss 0, ss 1, ss 2] with hw
    have hwsum : ∑ i, w i = 0 := by
      simp only [hw, Fin.sum_univ_four, Matrix.cons_val_zero, Matrix.cons_val_one,
        Matrix.head_cons, Matrix.cons_val_two, Matrix.cons_val_three, Matrix.tail_cons]; ring
    have hwcomb : ∑ i, w i • (![(0 : Point), t.v₀, t.v₁, t.v₂] i) = 0 := by
      have hst' : ss 0 • t.v₀ + ss 1 • t.v₁ + ss 2 • t.v₂ = 0 := by
        have := hst; rw [Fin.sum_univ_three] at this
        simpa [Matrix.cons_val_zero, Matrix.cons_val_one, Matrix.head_cons,
          Matrix.cons_val_two, Matrix.tail_cons] using this
      simp only [hw, Fin.sum_univ_four, Matrix.cons_val_zero, Matrix.cons_val_one,
        Matrix.head_cons, Matrix.cons_val_two, Matrix.cons_val_three, Matrix.tail_cons]
      rw [smul_zero, zero_add]; linear_combination (norm := module) hst'
    have hz := h Finset.univ w hwsum hwcomb
    fin_cases i0
    · exact hz 1 (Finset.mem_univ _)
    · exact hz 2 (Finset.mem_univ _)
    · exact hz 3 (Finset.mem_univ _)
  
  have hfacet0 : ∃ lam : ℚ, 0 < lam ∧ gOf f0 = lam • b.coord 1 := by
    set n0 := crossQ t.v₁ t.v₂ with hn0
    have hg0 : f0
        = (if 0 ≤ dotQ n0 t.v₀ then (⟨n0, 0⟩ : Half) else Half.neg ⟨n0, 0⟩) := by rw [hf0d]; rfl
    have hvk : dotQ n0 t.v₀ ≠ 0 := by rw [hn0, dotQ_crossQ_det]; exact hdet
    obtain ⟨hz0, hpos, hvanish, _⟩ := origin_facet_eval n0 t.v₀ hvk _ hg0
    refine ⟨gOf f0 t.v₀, hpos, ?_⟩
    apply gOf_eq_smul_coord (b := b) _ 1 _ (by rw [hb1])
    intro i hi
    fin_cases i
    · simp only [Fin.zero_eta, Fin.mk_one, Fin.reduceFinMk]; rw [hb0]; exact hz0
    · exact absurd rfl hi
    · simp only [Fin.zero_eta, Fin.mk_one, Fin.reduceFinMk]; rw [hb2]; exact hvanish t.v₁ (by rw [hn0]; exact dotQ_crossQ_left t.v₁ t.v₂)
    · simp only [Fin.zero_eta, Fin.mk_one, Fin.reduceFinMk]; rw [hb3]; exact hvanish t.v₂ (by rw [hn0]; exact dotQ_crossQ_right t.v₁ t.v₂)
  
  have hfacet1 : ∃ lam : ℚ, 0 < lam ∧ gOf f1 = lam • b.coord 2 := by
    set n1 := crossQ t.v₀ t.v₂ with hn1
    have hg1 : f1
        = (if 0 ≤ dotQ n1 t.v₁ then (⟨n1, 0⟩ : Half) else Half.neg ⟨n1, 0⟩) := by rw [hf1d]; rfl
    have hvk : dotQ n1 t.v₁ ≠ 0 := by
      rw [hn1, dotQ_crossQ_det]
      intro hc; apply hdet
      have : det3 t.v₁ t.v₀ t.v₂ = - det3 t.v₀ t.v₁ t.v₂ := by
        simp only [det3_expand]; ring
      rw [this] at hc; linarith
    obtain ⟨hz0, hpos, hvanish, _⟩ := origin_facet_eval n1 t.v₁ hvk _ hg1
    refine ⟨gOf f1 t.v₁, hpos, ?_⟩
    apply gOf_eq_smul_coord (b := b) _ 2 _ (by rw [hb2])
    intro i hi
    fin_cases i
    · simp only [Fin.zero_eta, Fin.mk_one, Fin.reduceFinMk]; rw [hb0]; exact hz0
    · simp only [Fin.zero_eta, Fin.mk_one, Fin.reduceFinMk]; rw [hb1]; exact hvanish t.v₀ (by rw [hn1]; exact dotQ_crossQ_left t.v₀ t.v₂)
    · exact absurd rfl hi
    · simp only [Fin.zero_eta, Fin.mk_one, Fin.reduceFinMk]; rw [hb3]; exact hvanish t.v₂ (by rw [hn1]; exact dotQ_crossQ_right t.v₀ t.v₂)
  
  have hfacet2 : ∃ lam : ℚ, 0 < lam ∧ gOf f2 = lam • b.coord 3 := by
    set n2 := crossQ t.v₀ t.v₁ with hn2
    have hg2 : f2
        = (if 0 ≤ dotQ n2 t.v₂ then (⟨n2, 0⟩ : Half) else Half.neg ⟨n2, 0⟩) := by rw [hf2d]; rfl
    have hvk : dotQ n2 t.v₂ ≠ 0 := by
      rw [hn2, dotQ_crossQ_det]
      intro hc; apply hdet
      have : det3 t.v₂ t.v₀ t.v₁ = det3 t.v₀ t.v₁ t.v₂ := by
        simp only [det3_expand]; ring
      rw [this] at hc; exact hc
    obtain ⟨hz0, hpos, hvanish, _⟩ := origin_facet_eval n2 t.v₂ hvk _ hg2
    refine ⟨gOf f2 t.v₂, hpos, ?_⟩
    apply gOf_eq_smul_coord (b := b) _ 3 _ (by rw [hb3])
    intro i hi
    fin_cases i
    · simp only [Fin.zero_eta, Fin.mk_one, Fin.reduceFinMk]; rw [hb0]; exact hz0
    · simp only [Fin.zero_eta, Fin.mk_one, Fin.reduceFinMk]; rw [hb1]; exact hvanish t.v₀ (by rw [hn2]; exact dotQ_crossQ_left t.v₀ t.v₁)
    · simp only [Fin.zero_eta, Fin.mk_one, Fin.reduceFinMk]; rw [hb2]; exact hvanish t.v₁ (by rw [hn2]; exact dotQ_crossQ_right t.v₀ t.v₁)
    · exact absurd rfl hi
  
  have hfacet3 : ∃ lam : ℚ, 0 < lam ∧ gOf f3 = lam • b.coord 0 := by
    set n3 := crossQ (psub t.v₁ t.v₀) (psub t.v₂ t.v₀) with hn3
    set c3 := dotQ n3 t.v₀ with hc3
    have hg3 : f3
        = (if c3 ≤ 0 then (⟨n3, c3⟩ : Half) else Half.neg ⟨n3, c3⟩) := by rw [hf3d]; rfl
    have hc3ne : c3 ≠ 0 := by
      rw [hc3, hn3]
      rw [dotQ_crossQ_det]
      intro hc; apply hdet
      have : det3 t.v₀ (psub t.v₁ t.v₀) (psub t.v₂ t.v₀) = det3 t.v₀ t.v₁ t.v₂ := by
        simp only [det3_expand, psub]; ring
      rw [this] at hc; exact hc
    obtain ⟨hzv0, hzv1, hzv2, hpos, _⟩ := base_facet_eval t.v₀ t.v₁ t.v₂ n3 hn3 c3 hc3 hc3ne _ hg3
    refine ⟨gOf f3 0, hpos, ?_⟩
    apply gOf_eq_smul_coord (b := b) _ 0 _ (by rw [hb0])
    intro i hi
    fin_cases i
    · exact absurd rfl hi
    · simp only [Fin.zero_eta, Fin.mk_one, Fin.reduceFinMk]; rw [hb1]; exact hzv0
    · simp only [Fin.zero_eta, Fin.mk_one, Fin.reduceFinMk]; rw [hb2]; exact hzv1
    · simp only [Fin.zero_eta, Fin.mk_one, Fin.reduceFinMk]; rw [hb3]; exact hzv2
  obtain ⟨l0, hl0, he0⟩ := hfacet0
  obtain ⟨l1, hl1, he1⟩ := hfacet1
  obtain ⟨l2, hl2, he2⟩ := hfacet2
  obtain ⟨l3, hl3, he3⟩ := hfacet3
  refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
  · 
    intro g hg
    rcases hall g hg with rfl | rfl | rfl | rfl
    · exact ⟨1, l0, hl0, he0⟩
    · exact ⟨2, l1, hl1, he1⟩
    · exact ⟨3, l2, hl2, he2⟩
    · exact ⟨0, l3, hl3, he3⟩
  · 
    intro j
    fin_cases j
    · exact ⟨f3, hmem3, l3, hl3, he3⟩
    · exact ⟨f0, hmem0, l0, hl0, he0⟩
    · exact ⟨f1, hmem1, l1, hl1, he1⟩
    · exact ⟨f2, hmem2, l2, hl2, he2⟩

name: smul_affine_linear_ne_zero
statement:
theorem smul_affine_linear_ne_zero {f : Point →ᵃ[ℚ] ℚ} {lam : ℚ}
    (hlam : lam ≠ 0) (hf : f.linear ≠ 0) : (lam • f).linear ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [AffineMap.smul_linear]
  exact smul_ne_zero hlam hf

name: range_loop_eq
statement:
theorem range_loop_eq {β : Type} (n : Nat) (F : Nat → β → Id (ForInStep β))
    (f : Nat → β → β) (hF : ∀ i b, F i b = ForInStep.yield (f i b)) :
    ∀ (k i : Nat) (hl : 0 ≤ i) (b : β), i + k = n →
      Std.Range.forIn'.loop 0 n 1 (fun i _ b => F i b) k i hl b
        = (List.range' i k).foldl (fun b j => f j b) b
proof:
:= by
  intro k
  induction k with
  | zero =>
    intro i hl b h
    rw [Std.Range.forIn'.loop]
    simp [Nat.not_lt.mpr (Nat.le_of_eq h.symm)]
  | succ k ih =>
    intro i hl b h
    have hi : i < n := by omega
    rw [Std.Range.forIn'.loop]
    simp only [dif_pos hi]
    show (match (F i b) with
      | ForInStep.done b => pure b
      | ForInStep.yield b =>
          Std.Range.forIn'.loop 0 n 1 (fun i _ b => F i b) k (i + 1) (by omega) b) = _
    rw [hF i b]
    show Std.Range.forIn'.loop 0 n 1 (fun i _ b => F i b) k (i + 1) (by omega) (f i b) = _
    rw [ih (i + 1) (Nat.zero_le _) (f i b) (by omega), List.range'_succ]
    rfl

name: forIn_range_eq
statement:
theorem forIn_range_eq {β : Type} (n : Nat) (init : β) (F : Nat → β → Id (ForInStep β))
    (f : Nat → β → β) (hF : ∀ i b, F i b = ForInStep.yield (f i b)) :
    forIn (m := Id) (⟨0, n, 1⟩ : Std.Range) init F
      = (List.range n).foldl (fun b i => f i b) init
proof:
:= by
  show Std.Range.forIn'.loop 0 n 1 (fun i _ b => F i b) n 0 (Nat.zero_le _) init = _
  rw [range_loop_eq n F f hF n 0 (Nat.zero_le _) init (by omega), List.range_eq_range']

name: arr_getD
statement:
theorem arr_getD {α : Type} (a : Array α) (i : Nat) (d : α) (hi : i < a.size) :
    a.getD i d = a[i]
proof:
:= by
