name: array_mem_flatMap
statement:
theorem array_mem_flatMap {α β : Type} (f : α → Array β) (as : Array α) {x : β}
    (h : x ∈ as.flatMap f) : ∃ a ∈ as, x ∈ f a
proof:
:= by
  have hre : as = as.toList.toArray := by simp
  rw [hre, Array.flatMap_toArray, Array.mem_def, Array.toList_toArray,
    List.mem_flatMap] at h
  obtain ⟨a, ha, hx⟩ := h
  exact ⟨a, by rw [hre]; simpa using ha, Array.mem_def.mpr (by simpa using hx)⟩

name: clipFrag_plane
statement:
theorem clipFrag_plane (g : IPlane) (f : Frag) {f' : Frag}
    (hf' : f' ∈ clipFrag g f) : f'.plane = f.plane
proof:
:= by
  simp only [clipFrag] at hf'
  split at hf'
  · rw [Array.mem_def] at hf'
    simp only [Array.toList_toArray, List.mem_singleton] at hf'
    subst hf'; rfl
  · rw [Array.mem_def] at hf'
    simp only [Array.toList_toArray, List.mem_cons, List.mem_singleton,
      List.not_mem_nil, or_false] at hf'
    rcases hf' with h | h <;> (subst h; rfl)

name: clipFragScoped_plane
statement:
theorem clipFragScoped_plane (g : IPlane) (scope : Box3) (fb : Frag × Box3)
    {f' : Frag × Box3} (hf' : f' ∈ clipFragScoped g scope fb) :
    f'.1.plane = fb.1.plane
proof:
:= by
  simp only [clipFragScoped] at hf'
  split at hf'
  · rw [Array.mem_def, Array.toList_map, List.mem_map] at hf'
    obtain ⟨p, hp, rfl⟩ := hf'
    exact clipFrag_plane g fb.1 (Array.mem_def.mpr hp)
  · rw [Array.mem_def] at hf'
    simp only [Array.toList_toArray, List.mem_singleton] at hf'
    subst hf'; rfl

name: clipFaceScoped_plane
statement:
theorem clipFaceScoped_plane (f₀ : Frag) (L : Array (IPlane × Box3)) {f' : Frag}
    (hf' : f' ∈ clipFaceScoped f₀ L) : f'.plane = f₀.plane
proof:
:= by
  simp only [clipFaceScoped] at hf'
  rw [Array.mem_def, Array.toList_map, List.mem_map] at hf'
  obtain ⟨p, hp, rfl⟩ := hf'
  
  have key : ∀ (Ls : List (IPlane × Box3)) (fs : Array (Frag × Box3)),
      (∀ q ∈ fs, q.1.plane = f₀.plane) →
      ∀ q ∈ Ls.foldl (fun fs t => fs.flatMap (clipFragScoped t.1 t.2)) fs,
        q.1.plane = f₀.plane := by
    intro Ls
    induction Ls with
    | nil => intro fs hfs q hq; exact hfs q hq
    | cons t Ls ih =>
      intro fs hfs q hq
      refine ih _ ?_ q hq
      intro r hr
      obtain ⟨s, hs, hrs⟩ := array_mem_flatMap _ _ hr
      rw [clipFragScoped_plane t.1 t.2 s hrs]
      exact hfs s hs
  have hfold : (L.foldl (fun fs t => fs.flatMap (clipFragScoped t.1 t.2))
      #[(f₀, fragPolyBox f₀)])
      = L.toList.foldl (fun fs t => fs.flatMap (clipFragScoped t.1 t.2))
        #[(f₀, fragPolyBox f₀)] := by
    rw [← Array.foldl_toList]
  rw [hfold] at hp
  exact key L.toList #[(f₀, fragPolyBox f₀)]
    (by intro q hq
        rw [Array.mem_def] at hq
        simp only [Array.toList_toArray, List.mem_singleton] at hq
        subst hq; rfl) p (Array.mem_def.mpr hp)

name: planesForScoped_empty
statement:
theorem planesForScoped_empty (P : IPlane) (B : Array FaceS) :
    planesForScoped P B #[] = #[]
proof: := rfl

name: clipFaceScoped_nil
statement: theorem clipFaceScoped_nil (f₀ : Frag) : clipFaceScoped f₀ #[] = #[f₀]
proof: := rfl

name: foldl_refStep
statement:
theorem foldl_refStep (blk : Nat → List α) (p : Nat → Bool) (q : α → Bool)
    (keep : α → Bool) (hq : ∀ i, ∀ x ∈ blk i, q x = p i) :
    ∀ (l : List Nat) (c k : List α),
      l.foldl (fun st i => refStep blk p keep i st) (c, k)
        = (c ++ (l.flatMap blk).filter q,
           k ++ ((l.flatMap blk).filter (fun x => !q x)).filter keep)
proof:
:= by
  intro l
  induction l with
  | nil => intro c k; simp [refStep]
  | cons i l ih =>
    intro c k
    have hblk : ∀ x ∈ blk i, q x = p i := hq i
    by_cases hp : p i = true
    · have h1 : (blk i).filter q = blk i := by
        rw [List.filter_eq_self]
        intro x hx; rw [hblk x hx]; exact hp
      have h2 : ((blk i).filter (fun x => !q x)) = [] := by
        rw [List.filter_eq_nil_iff]
        intro x hx
        simp only [Bool.not_eq_true', hblk x hx, hp]
        simp
      have hstep : refStep blk p keep i (c, k) = (c ++ blk i, k) := by
        simp only [refStep, if_pos hp]
      rw [List.foldl_cons, hstep, ih]
      simp only [List.flatMap_cons, List.filter_append, h1, h2, List.nil_append,
        List.append_assoc]
    · have hp' : p i = false := by simpa using hp
      have h1 : (blk i).filter q = [] := by
        rw [List.filter_eq_nil_iff]
        intro x hx; rw [hblk x hx, hp']; simp
      have h2 : ((blk i).filter (fun x => !q x)) = blk i := by
        rw [List.filter_eq_self]
        intro x hx
        simp only [Bool.not_eq_true', hblk x hx, hp']
      have hstep : refStep blk p keep i (c, k) = (c, k ++ (blk i).filter keep) := by
        simp only [refStep, if_neg hp]
      rw [List.foldl_cons, hstep, ih]
      simp only [List.flatMap_cons, List.filter_append, h1, h2, List.nil_append,
        List.append_assoc, List.filter_append]

name: foldl_pair_toList
statement:
theorem foldl_pair_toList
    (g : Nat → MProd (Array α) (Array α) → MProd (Array α) (Array α))
    (h : Nat → (List α × List α) → (List α × List α)) :
    ∀ (l : List Nat), (∀ i ∈ l, ∀ st : MProd (Array α) (Array α),
        ((g i st).1.toList, (g i st).2.toList) = h i (st.1.toList, st.2.toList)) →
      ∀ st : MProd (Array α) (Array α),
        (((l.foldl (fun st i => g i st) st).1.toList),
         ((l.foldl (fun st i => g i st) st).2.toList))
          = l.foldl (fun st i => h i st) (st.1.toList, st.2.toList)
proof:
:= by
  intro l
  induction l with
  | nil => intro _ st; rfl
  | cons i l ih =>
    intro hc st
    rw [List.foldl_cons, List.foldl_cons,
      ih (fun j hj => hc j (List.mem_cons_of_mem _ hj)) (g i st),
      hc i (List.mem_cons_self _ _) st]

name: clipFacesA_eq_flatMap
statement:
theorem clipFacesA_eq_flatMap (A B : Array FaceS) (candA : Array (Array Nat)) :
    clipFacesA A B candA = (Array.range A.size).flatMap (blkA A B candA)
proof: := rfl

name: clipFacesB_eq_flatMap
statement:

name: fusedA_eq_forIn
statement:
theorem fusedA_eq_forIn (A B : Array FaceS) (candA : Array (Array Nat)) (freeA : Array Bool)
    (labelA : Array Nat) (keepRootA : Std.HashMap Nat Bool) (keysB : Array IPlane)
    (bvh : Impl.BVH.BVH) (WB : Array PFace) :
    fusedA A B candA freeA labelA keepRootA keysB bvh WB
      = (fun r : FSt => (r.1, r.2))
          (forIn (m := Id) (⟨0, A.size, 1⟩ : Std.Range) (⟨#[], #[]⟩ : FSt)
            (bodyA A B candA freeA labelA keepRootA keysB bvh WB))
proof: := rfl

name: fusedA_eq_foldl
statement:
theorem fusedA_eq_foldl (A B : Array FaceS) (candA : Array (Array Nat)) (freeA : Array Bool)
    (labelA : Array Nat) (keepRootA : Std.HashMap Nat Bool) (keysB : Array IPlane)
    (bvh : Impl.BVH.BVH) (WB : Array PFace) :
    fusedA A B candA freeA labelA keepRootA keysB bvh WB
      = (fun r : FSt => (r.1, r.2)) ((List.range A.size).foldl
          (fun st i => stepA A B candA freeA labelA keepRootA keysB bvh WB i st) ⟨#[], #[]⟩)
proof:
:= by
  rw [fusedA_eq_forIn, forIn_range_eq _ _ _
    (fun i st => stepA A B candA freeA labelA keepRootA keysB bvh WB i st) ?_]
  intro i b
  obtain ⟨c, k⟩ := b
  simp only [bodyA, stepA, blkA]
  split
  · rfl
  · split
    · split <;> rfl
    · rfl

name: toList_range_flatMap
statement:
theorem toList_range_flatMap {β : Type} (n : Nat) (g : Nat → Array β) :
    ((Array.range n).flatMap g).toList = (List.range n).flatMap (fun i => (g i).toList)
proof:
:= by
  have hr : Array.range n = (List.range n).toArray := by
    apply Array.ext'; simp
  rw [hr, Array.flatMap_toArray, Array.toList_toArray]

name: blkA_plane
statement:
theorem blkA_plane (A B : Array FaceS) (candA : Array (Array Nat)) (i : Nat)
    {x : Frag} (hx : x ∈ blkA A B candA i) : x.plane = (A.getD i default).plane
proof:
:=
  clipFaceScoped_plane _ _ hx

name: blkA_free
statement:
theorem blkA_free (A B : Array FaceS) (candA : Array (Array Nat)) (i : Nat)
    (h : candA.getD i #[] = #[]) :
    blkA A B candA i = #[fragOfFace (A.getD i default)]
proof:
:= by
  simp only [blkA, h, planesForScoped_empty, clipFaceScoped_nil]

name: fusedA_eq_ref
statement:
theorem fusedA_eq_ref (A B : Array FaceS) (candA : Array (Array Nat)) (freeA : Array Bool)
    (labelA : Array Nat) (keepRootA : Std.HashMap Nat Bool) (keysB : Array IPlane)
    (bvh : Impl.BVH.BVH) (WB : Array PFace)
    (hfree : ∀ i, i < A.size → freeA.getD i false = true → candA.getD i #[] = #[])
    (hkeep : ∀ i, i < A.size → freeA.getD i false = true →
      keepRootA.getD (labelA.getD i i) false
        = keepFragB bvh WB (fragOfFace (A.getD i default))) :
    fusedA A B candA freeA labelA keepRootA keysB bvh WB
      = ((clipFacesA A B candA).filter (fun f => memPrim keysB f.plane),
         ((clipFacesA A B candA).filter (fun f => !memPrim keysB f.plane)).filter
           (keepFragB bvh WB))
proof:
:= by
  
  have hqp : ∀ i, ∀ x ∈ (fun i => (blkA A B candA i).toList) i,
      (fun f : Frag => memPrim keysB f.plane) x
        = (fun i => memPrim keysB (A.getD i default).plane) i := by
    intro i x hx
    exact congrArg (memPrim keysB) (blkA_plane A B candA i (Array.mem_def.mpr hx))
  
  have hcompat : ∀ i ∈ List.range A.size, ∀ st : FSt,
      (((stepA A B candA freeA labelA keepRootA keysB bvh WB i st).1.toList),
       ((stepA A B candA freeA labelA keepRootA keysB bvh WB i st).2.toList))
        = refStep (fun i => (blkA A B candA i).toList)
            (fun i => memPrim keysB (A.getD i default).plane) (keepFragB bvh WB) i
            (st.1.toList, st.2.toList) := by
    intro i hi st
    have hilt : i < A.size := List.mem_range.mp hi
    simp only [stepA, refStep]
    by_cases hc : memPrim keysB (A.getD i default).plane = true
    · rw [if_pos hc, if_pos hc]
      simp
    · rw [if_neg hc, if_neg hc]
      by_cases hf : freeA.getD i false = true
      · rw [if_pos hf]
        have hsingle : (blkA A B candA i).toList = [fragOfFace (A.getD i default)] := by
          rw [blkA_free A B candA i (hfree i hilt hf)]
        have hfilter : (blkA A B candA i).toList.filter (keepFragB bvh WB)
            = if keepRootA.getD (labelA.getD i i) false then (blkA A B candA i).toList else [] := by
          rw [hsingle]
          simp only [List.filter_cons, List.filter_nil]
          rw [hkeep i hilt hf]
        by_cases hk : keepRootA.getD (labelA.getD i i) false = true
        · rw [if_pos hk, hfilter, if_pos hk]
          simp
        · rw [if_neg hk, hfilter, if_neg hk]
          simp
      · rw [if_neg hf]
        simp
  
  rw [fusedA_eq_foldl]
  have hfold := foldl_pair_toList
    (fun i st => stepA A B candA freeA labelA keepRootA keysB bvh WB i st)
    (fun i st => refStep (fun i => (blkA A B candA i).toList)
      (fun i => memPrim keysB (A.getD i default).plane) (keepFragB bvh WB) i st)
    (List.range A.size) hcompat ⟨#[], #[]⟩
  rw [foldl_refStep (fun i => (blkA A B candA i).toList)
      (fun i => memPrim keysB (A.getD i default).plane) (fun f => memPrim keysB f.plane)
      (keepFragB bvh WB) hqp (List.range A.size) [] []] at hfold
  have hflat : ((List.range A.size).flatMap (fun i => (blkA A B candA i).toList))
      = (clipFacesA A B candA).toList := by
    rw [clipFacesA_eq_flatMap, toList_range_flatMap]
  rw [hflat] at hfold
  simp only [List.nil_append] at hfold
  have e1 : ((List.range A.size).foldl
        (fun st i => stepA A B candA freeA labelA keepRootA keysB bvh WB i st)
        (⟨#[], #[]⟩ : FSt)).1.toList
      = (clipFacesA A B candA).toList.filter (fun f => memPrim keysB f.plane) :=
    congrArg (fun z : List Frag × List Frag => z.1) hfold
  have e2 : ((List.range A.size).foldl
        (fun st i => stepA A B candA freeA labelA keepRootA keysB bvh WB i st)
        (⟨#[], #[]⟩ : FSt)).2.toList
      = ((clipFacesA A B candA).toList.filter (fun f => !memPrim keysB f.plane)).filter
          (keepFragB bvh WB) :=
    congrArg (fun z : List Frag × List Frag => z.2) hfold
  have E1 : ((List.range A.size).foldl
        (fun st i => stepA A B candA freeA labelA keepRootA keysB bvh WB i st)
        (⟨#[], #[]⟩ : FSt)).1
      = (clipFacesA A B candA).filter (fun f => memPrim keysB f.plane) :=
    Array.ext' (by rw [Array.toList_filter]; exact e1)
  have E2 : ((List.range A.size).foldl
        (fun st i => stepA A B candA freeA labelA keepRootA keysB bvh WB i st)
        (⟨#[], #[]⟩ : FSt)).2
      = ((clipFacesA A B candA).filter (fun f => !memPrim keysB f.plane)).filter
          (keepFragB bvh WB) :=
    Array.ext' (by rw [Array.toList_filter, Array.toList_filter]; exact e2)
  have hpair : (((List.range A.size).foldl
        (fun st i => stepA A B candA freeA labelA keepRootA keysB bvh WB i st)
        (⟨#[], #[]⟩ : FSt)).1,
      ((List.range A.size).foldl
        (fun st i => stepA A B candA freeA labelA keepRootA keysB bvh WB i st)
        (⟨#[], #[]⟩ : FSt)).2)
      = ((clipFacesA A B candA).filter (fun f => memPrim keysB f.plane),
         ((clipFacesA A B candA).filter (fun f => !memPrim keysB f.plane)).filter
           (keepFragB bvh WB)) := by rw [E1, E2]
  exact hpair

name: meshIntersectPre_decomp
statement:
theorem meshIntersectPre_decomp (pa pb : Prep) :
    meshIntersectPre pa pb =
      pipelineTail pa pb
        (fusedA pa.A pb.A (candOf pa.A pb.A pb.bvh) (freeOf (candOf pa.A pb.A pb.bvh))
          (clusterFree pa.A (freeOf (candOf pa.A pb.A pb.bvh)))
          (keepRootOf pa.A (freeOf (candOf pa.A pb.A pb.bvh))
            (clusterFree pa.A (freeOf (candOf pa.A pb.A pb.bvh))) pb.bvh pb.W)
          (primKeys pb.A) pb.bvh pb.W).1
        (fusedA pa.A pb.A (candOf pa.A pb.A pb.bvh) (freeOf (candOf pa.A pb.A pb.bvh))
          (clusterFree pa.A (freeOf (candOf pa.A pb.A pb.bvh)))
          (keepRootOf pa.A (freeOf (candOf pa.A pb.A pb.bvh))
            (clusterFree pa.A (freeOf (candOf pa.A pb.A pb.bvh))) pb.bvh pb.W)
          (primKeys pb.A) pb.bvh pb.W).2
        (fusedA pb.A pa.A (candOf pb.A pa.A pa.bvh) (freeOf (candOf pb.A pa.A pa.bvh))
          (clusterFree pb.A (freeOf (candOf pb.A pa.A pa.bvh)))
          (keepRootOf pb.A (freeOf (candOf pb.A pa.A pa.bvh))
            (clusterFree pb.A (freeOf (candOf pb.A pa.A pa.bvh))) pa.bvh pa.W)
          (primKeys pa.A) pa.bvh pa.W).1
        (fusedA pb.A pa.A (candOf pb.A pa.A pa.bvh) (freeOf (candOf pb.A pa.A pa.bvh))
          (clusterFree pb.A (freeOf (candOf pb.A pa.A pa.bvh)))
          (keepRootOf pb.A (freeOf (candOf pb.A pa.A pa.bvh))
            (clusterFree pb.A (freeOf (candOf pb.A pa.A pa.bvh))) pa.bvh pa.W)
          (primKeys pa.A) pa.bvh pa.W).2
proof: := rfl

name: meshIntersectPre_eq_ref
statement:
theorem meshIntersectPre_eq_ref (pa pb : Prep)
    (hkeepA : ∀ i, i < pa.A.size → (freeOf (candOf pa.A pb.A pb.bvh)).getD i false = true →
      (keepRootOf pa.A (freeOf (candOf pa.A pb.A pb.bvh))
        (clusterFree pa.A (freeOf (candOf pa.A pb.A pb.bvh))) pb.bvh pb.W).getD
          ((clusterFree pa.A (freeOf (candOf pa.A pb.A pb.bvh))).getD i i) false
        = keepFragB pb.bvh pb.W (fragOfFace (pa.A.getD i default)))
    (hkeepB : ∀ i, i < pb.A.size → (freeOf (candOf pb.A pa.A pa.bvh)).getD i false = true →
      (keepRootOf pb.A (freeOf (candOf pb.A pa.A pa.bvh))
        (clusterFree pb.A (freeOf (candOf pb.A pa.A pa.bvh))) pa.bvh pa.W).getD
          ((clusterFree pb.A (freeOf (candOf pb.A pa.A pa.bvh))).getD i i) false
        = keepFragB pa.bvh pa.W (fragOfFace (pb.A.getD i default))) :
    meshIntersectPre pa pb = meshIntersectRef pa pb
proof:
:= by
  have hfree : ∀ (A B : Array FaceS) (bvh : Impl.BVH.BVH) (i : Nat), i < A.size →
      (freeOf (candOf A B bvh)).getD i false = true → (candOf A B bvh).getD i #[] = #[] := by
    intro A B bvh i hi h
    have hsz : (candOf A B bvh).size = A.size := Array.size_map ..
    have hi' : i < (candOf A B bvh).size := by rw [hsz]; exact hi
    have hfg : (freeOf (candOf A B bvh)).getD i false = ((candOf A B bvh).getD i #[]).isEmpty := by
      unfold freeOf
      rw [arr_getD _ _ _ (by rw [Array.size_map]; exact hi'), arr_getD _ _ _ hi',
        Array.getElem_map]
    rw [hfg] at h
    exact Array.ext' (List.isEmpty_iff.mp (by rw [Array.isEmpty_toList]; exact h))
  rw [meshIntersectPre_decomp,
    fusedA_eq_ref pa.A pb.A _ _ _ _ _ _ _ (hfree pa.A pb.A pb.bvh) hkeepA,
    fusedA_eq_ref pb.A pa.A _ _ _ _ _ _ _ (hfree pb.A pa.A pa.bvh) hkeepB]
  rfl

name: keepRootOf_eq_foldl
statement:
theorem keepRootOf_eq_foldl (A : Array FaceS) (free : Array Bool) (label : Array Nat)
    (bvh : Impl.BVH.BVH) (W : Array PFace) :
    keepRootOf A free label bvh W
      = (List.range A.size).foldl
          (fun mp i => krStep A free label bvh W i mp) ∅
proof:
:= by
  show forIn (m := Id) (⟨0, A.size, 1⟩ : Std.Range) (∅ : Std.HashMap Nat Bool) _ = _
  rw [forIn_range_eq _ _ _ (fun i mp => krStep A free label bvh W i mp) ?_]
  intro i b
  simp only [krStep]
  split <;> rfl

name: foldl_krStep_getD
statement:
theorem foldl_krStep_getD (A : Array FaceS) (free : Array Bool) (label : Array Nat)
    (bvh : Impl.BVH.BVH) (W : Array PFace) {r : Nat}
    (hr : free.getD r false && label.getD r r == r) :
    ∀ (l : List Nat) (mp : Std.HashMap Nat Bool),
      (r ∈ l ∨ mp.getD r false = keepFragB bvh W (fragOfFace (A.getD r default))) →
      ((l.foldl (fun mp i => krStep A free label bvh W i mp) mp).getD r false
        = keepFragB bvh W (fragOfFace (A.getD r default)))
proof:
:= by
  intro l
  induction l with
  | nil =>
    intro mp h
    rcases h with h | h
    · exact absurd h (List.not_mem_nil r)
    · exact h
  | cons i l ih =>
    intro mp h
    rw [List.foldl_cons]
    refine ih _ ?_
    by_cases hmem : r ∈ l
    · exact Or.inl hmem
    refine Or.inr ?_
    by_cases hri : i = r
    · subst hri
      simp only [krStep, if_pos hr, Std.HashMap.getD_insert_self]
    · have hprev : mp.getD r false = keepFragB bvh W (fragOfFace (A.getD r default)) := by
        rcases h with h | h
        · rcases List.mem_cons.mp h with h' | h'
          · exact absurd h'.symm hri
          · exact absurd h' hmem
        · exact h
      simp only [krStep]
      split
      · rw [Std.HashMap.getD_insert]
        rw [if_neg (by simpa using hri)]
        exact hprev
      · exact hprev

name: keepRootOf_getD
statement:
theorem keepRootOf_getD (A : Array FaceS) (free : Array Bool) (label : Array Nat)
    (bvh : Impl.BVH.BVH) (W : Array PFace) {r : Nat} (hlt : r < A.size)
    (hfree : free.getD r false = true) (hroot : label.getD r r = r) :
    (keepRootOf A free label bvh W).getD r false
      = keepFragB bvh W (fragOfFace (A.getD r default))
proof:
:= by
  rw [keepRootOf_eq_foldl]
  refine foldl_krStep_getD A free label bvh W ?_ (List.range A.size) ∅
    (Or.inl (List.mem_range.mpr hlt))
  rw [hfree, hroot]
  simp

name: guarded_sum_single'
statement:
private theorem guarded_sum_single' {l : List Frag} {P : Point}
    (p : Frag → Bool) (kstar : Fin l.length)
    (huni : ∀ b : Fin l.length, P ∈ vpoly (fragCycle l[b]) → b = kstar)
    (hmem : P ∈ vpoly (fragCycle l[kstar])) :
    (l.map (fun f => if p f = true
        then (if P ∈ vpoly (fragCycle f) then (1 : ℤ) else 0) else 0)).sum
      = if p l[kstar] = true then 1 else 0
proof:
:= by
  classical
  rw [sum_map_eq_finSum, Finset.sum_eq_single kstar]
  · rw [if_pos hmem]
  · intro b hbmem hbne
    have hnot : P ∉ vpoly (fragCycle l[b]) := fun hm => hbne (huni b hm)
    rw [if_neg hnot, ite_self]
  · intro habs
    exact absurd (Finset.mem_univ _) habs

name: tile_keep_sum_transverse
statement:
theorem tile_keep_sum_transverse {MA MB : Mesh} (meshId : Nat) {i : ℕ}
    (hi : i < MA.size) (hdetA : detOrigin (MA[i]'hi) ≠ 0)
    (hwfB : Legacy.WellFormedMesh MB)
    (htr : ∀ j : Fin MB.size,
      coplanarPlane (faceSOf MB[j]).plane (faceSOf (MA[i]'hi)).plane = false)
    {P : Point}
    (hav : AvoidsLines (carrierNormal (MA[i]'hi)) (detOrigin (MA[i]'hi))
      (fragCycle (fragOfFace ((materialize MA).getD i default)))
      ((planesForScoped ((materialize MA).getD i default).plane (materialize MB)
        ((candP MA MB).getD i #[])).toList.map
          (fun t => t.1)) P)
    (hE1 : ∀ j : Fin MB.size, ∀ g ∈ tetraHalves (MB[j]), g.eval P ≠ 0) :
    ((classify (clipFaceScoped
          (fragOfFace ((materialize MA).getD i default))
          (planesForScoped ((materialize MA).getD i default).plane (materialize MB)
            ((candP MA MB).getD i #[])))
        (prepare (materialize MB))).toList.map
        (fun f => if P ∈ vpoly (fragCycle f) then (1 : ℤ) else 0)).sum
      = (if P ∈ triangleSet (MA[i]'hi) then 1 else 0)
        * winding (meshChain MB) P
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have hnpoB : NoPlaneThroughOrigin MB := hwfB.2.2.2
  have hiA : i < (materialize MA).size := by simpa [materialize] using hi
  have hgetD : (materialize MA).getD i default = faceSOf (MA[i]'hi) := by
    rw [arr_getD _ _ _ hiA, materialize_getElem MA i hi]
  have hinv₀ : FragInv (carrierNormal (MA[i]'hi)) (detOrigin (MA[i]'hi))
      (fragOfFace ((materialize MA).getD i default)) := by
    rw [hgetD]; exact fragInv_base hdetA
  haveI := hinv₀.neZero
  have hpoly₀ : vpoly (fragCycle
      (fragOfFace ((materialize MA).getD i default)))
      = triangleSet (MA[i]'hi) := by
    rw [hgetD]; exact vpoly_fragOfFace (MA[i]'hi)
  rw [classify, Array.toList_filter, sum_filter_map]
  by_cases hPt : P ∈ triangleSet (MA[i]'hi)
  · rw [if_pos hPt, one_mul]
    have hPmem₀ : P ∈ vpoly (fragCycle
        (fragOfFace ((materialize MA).getD i default))) := by
      rw [hpoly₀]; exact hPt
    obtain ⟨f', hf'arr, hf'rel⟩ := clipFaceScoped_tile_relint hinv₀
      (planesForScoped ((materialize MA).getD i default).plane (materialize MB)
        ((candP MA MB).getD i #[]))
      hav hPmem₀
    have hf'list := Array.mem_def.mp hf'arr
    rw [List.mem_iff_getElem] at hf'list
    obtain ⟨istar, histar, hf'eq⟩ := hf'list
    have histar' : istar < (clipFaceScoped
        (fragOfFace ((materialize MA).getD i default))
        (planesForScoped ((materialize MA).getD i default).plane (materialize MB)
          ((candP MA MB).getD i #[]))).size := by
      rw [← Array.length_toList]; exact histar
    have hf'eqArr : (clipFaceScoped
        (fragOfFace ((materialize MA).getD i default))
        (planesForScoped ((materialize MA).getD i default).plane (materialize MB)
          ((candP MA MB).getD i #[])))[istar]'histar'
        = f' := by
      rw [← hf'eq]; exact (Array.getElem_toList histar).symm
    have hmemArr : P ∈ vpoly (fragCycle ((clipFaceScoped
        (fragOfFace ((materialize MA).getD i default))
        (planesForScoped ((materialize MA).getD i default).plane (materialize MB)
          ((candP MA MB).getD i #[])))[istar]'histar')) := by
      rw [hf'eqArr]; exact vrelint_subset_vpoly _ hf'rel
    have hmemFin : P ∈ vpoly (fragCycle ((clipFaceScoped
        (fragOfFace ((materialize MA).getD i default))
        (planesForScoped ((materialize MA).getD i default).plane (materialize MB)
          ((candP MA MB).getD i #[]))).toList[
        (⟨istar, histar⟩ : Fin (clipFaceScoped
          (fragOfFace ((materialize MA).getD i default))
          (planesForScoped ((materialize MA).getD i default).plane (materialize MB)
            ((candP MA MB).getD i #[]))).toList.length)])) :=
      hmemArr
    have huni : ∀ b : Fin (clipFaceScoped
        (fragOfFace ((materialize MA).getD i default))
        (planesForScoped ((materialize MA).getD i default).plane (materialize MB)
          ((candP MA MB).getD i #[]))).toList.length,
        P ∈ vpoly (fragCycle ((clipFaceScoped
          (fragOfFace ((materialize MA).getD i default))
          (planesForScoped ((materialize MA).getD i default).plane (materialize MB)
            ((candP MA MB).getD i #[]))).toList[b.val]'b.isLt)) →
        b = (⟨istar, histar⟩ : Fin _) := by
      intro b hm
      have hb : b.val < (clipFaceScoped
          (fragOfFace ((materialize MA).getD i default))
          (planesForScoped ((materialize MA).getD i default).plane (materialize MB)
            ((candP MA MB).getD i #[]))).size := by
        rw [← Array.length_toList]; exact b.isLt
      have hm' : P ∈ vpoly (fragCycle ((clipFaceScoped
          (fragOfFace ((materialize MA).getD i default))
          (planesForScoped ((materialize MA).getD i default).plane (materialize MB)
            ((candP MA MB).getD i #[])))[b.val]'hb)) :=
        hm
      exact Fin.ext (clipFaceScoped_tile_unique hinv₀ _ hav hb histar' hm' hmemArr)
    rw [guarded_sum_single' _ (⟨istar, histar⟩ : Fin _) huni hmemFin]
    rw [show (clipFaceScoped
        (fragOfFace ((materialize MA).getD i default))
        (planesForScoped ((materialize MA).getD i default).plane (materialize MB)
          ((candP MA MB).getD i #[]))).toList[
        (⟨istar, histar⟩ : Fin (clipFaceScoped
          (fragOfFace ((materialize MA).getD i default))
          (planesForScoped ((materialize MA).getD i default).plane (materialize MB)
            ((candP MA MB).getD i #[]))).toList.length)]
      = f' from hf'eqArr]
    have hinv' : FragInv (carrierNormal (MA[i]'hi)) (detOrigin (MA[i]'hi))
        f' := fragInv_clipFaceScoped hinv₀ _ hf'arr
    have hoffT : ∀ j : Fin MB.size,
        vrelint (fragCycle f') ∩ triangleSet (MB[j.val]'j.isLt) = ∅ := fun j =>
      cs_off_side_transverse meshId hi hdetA hf'arr j.isLt (hnpoB j) (htr j)
    haveI := hinv'.neZero
    
    have hoff_surf : ∀ (u : Fin MB.size), ∀ x ∈ vrelint (fragCycle f'),
        x ∉ triangleSet (MB[u.val]'u.isLt) := fun u x hx hxtri =>
      (Set.eq_empty_iff_forall_not_mem.mp (hoffT u)) x ⟨hx, hxtri⟩
    
    obtain ⟨P_cell, hP_cellG1, hP_cellMem, hkiff⟩ :=
      CSG.Proof.MeshIntersectRayClassifyKeep.keepFragB_iff_winding
        (f := f') hwfB rfl hinv'.size3 hinv'.onPlane hinv'.strictConv
        (CSG.Proof.MeshIntersectRayClassifyF6Supply.fragCentroid_eq_ofPoint_bary f')
        (by have := hinv'.size3; omega)
        (CSG.Proof.MeshIntersectRayClassifyF6Supply.fragInv_fragMirrors hinv')
        rfl hoff_surf
        (CSG.Proof.MeshIntersectRayClassifyF6Supply.facet_feasible_transverse
          hdetA hnpoB htr)
        (fun u k => CSG.Proof.MeshIntersectRayClassifyF6Supply.exists_edge_moment
          hnpoB (carrierNormal_ne_zero hdetA) (detOrigin (MA[i]'hi)) u k)
    
    have hval := winding_zero_or_one_facets hnpoB hwfB.2.1 hP_cellG1
    
    have htrans : winding (meshChain MB) P = winding (meshChain MB) P_cell :=
      CSG.Proof.MeshIntersectRadialTransport.fragConst_cop hdetA hwfB
        (Cop := fun _ => False) hinv' hoffT (fun _ hCj => hCj.elim)
        hP_cellMem (fun j _ g hg => hP_cellG1 j g hg) hf'rel
        (fun i => Or.inl (hE1 i))
    rw [htrans]
    rw [show keepFragB (faceBVH (prepare (materialize MB))) (prepare (materialize MB)) f'
        = decide (winding (meshChain MB) P_cell = 1) from hkiff]
    rcases hval with h0 | h1
    · rw [h0]; decide
    · rw [h1]; decide
  · rw [if_neg hPt, zero_mul]
    apply List.sum_eq_zero
    intro x hx
    obtain ⟨f, hf, rfl⟩ := List.mem_map.mp hx
    have hsub := clipFaceScoped_vpoly_subset hinv₀
      (planesForScoped ((materialize MA).getD i default).plane (materialize MB)
        ((candP MA MB).getD i #[]))
      (Array.mem_def.mpr hf)
    have hnot : P ∉ vpoly (fragCycle f) := by
      intro hmem; exact hPt (hpoly₀ ▸ hsub hmem)
    rw [if_neg hnot]
    split <;> rfl

name: winding_atomize_emit_sum
statement:
theorem winding_atomize_emit_sum (K : Array Frag) (vs : Array Vtx) (Q : Point) :
    winding (meshChain ((K.map (atomizeFrag vs)).flatMap emitFrag)) Q
      = (K.toList.map
          (fun f => winding (meshChain (emitFrag (atomizeFrag vs f))) Q)).sum
proof:
:= by
  rw [winding_meshChain_flatMap, Array.toList_map, List.map_map]
  rfl

name: apex_mem_relint
statement: theorem apex_mem_relint (F : FanPoly) : F.apex ∈ relint F
proof:
:=
  F.apex_relint

name: one_ne_zero'
statement: theorem one_ne_zero' (m : ℕ) : (1 : ZMod (m + 3)) ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  intro h
  rw [show (1 : ZMod (m + 3)) = ((1 : ℕ) : ZMod (m + 3)) by norm_cast,
    ZMod.natCast_zmod_eq_zero_iff_dvd] at h
  exact absurd (Nat.le_of_dvd one_pos h) (by omega)

name: two_ne_zero'
statement: theorem two_ne_zero' (m : ℕ) : (2 : ZMod (m + 3)) ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  intro h
  rw [show (2 : ZMod (m + 3)) = ((2 : ℕ) : ZMod (m + 3)) by norm_cast,
    ZMod.natCast_zmod_eq_zero_iff_dvd] at h
  exact absurd (Nat.le_of_dvd two_pos h) (by omega)

name: q_ne
statement: theorem q_ne (F : FanPoly) (k : ZMod (F.m + 3)) : F.q k ≠ F.q (k + 1)
proof:
:= by
  intro h
  have hk := F.inj h
  have h1 : (1 : ZMod (F.m + 3)) = 0 := by
    calc (1 : ZMod (F.m + 3)) = (k + 1) - k := by ring
    _ = k - k := by rw [← hk]
    _ = 0 := sub_self k
  exact one_ne_zero' F.m h1

name: segment_weight_vector
statement:
theorem segment_weight_vector (F : FanPoly) {k : ZMod (F.m + 3)} {y : Point}
    (hy : y ∈ segment ℚ (F.q k) (F.q (k + 1))) :
    ∃ w : ZMod (F.m + 3) → ℚ,
      (∀ j, 0 ≤ w j) ∧ ∑ j, w j = 1 ∧ ∑ j, w j • F.q j = y
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨c, d, hc, hd, hcd, rfl⟩ := hy
  refine ⟨fun j => (if j = k then c else 0) + (if j = k + 1 then d else 0),
    fun j => ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · have h1 : (0 : ℚ) ≤ if j = k then c else 0 := by split <;> simp [hc]
    have h2 : (0 : ℚ) ≤ if j = k + 1 then d else 0 := by split <;> simp [hd]
    dsimp only
    linarith
  · rw [Finset.sum_add_distrib, Finset.sum_ite_eq' Finset.univ k fun _ => c,
      Finset.sum_ite_eq' Finset.univ (k + 1) fun _ => d]
    simpa using hcd
  · have h1 : ∀ j, ((if j = k then c else 0) + if j = k + 1 then d else 0) • F.q j
        = (if j = k then c • F.q j else 0) + (if j = k + 1 then d • F.q j else 0) := by
      intro j
      rw [add_smul]
      congr 1 <;> (split <;> simp)
    simp only [h1]
    rw [Finset.sum_add_distrib,
      Finset.sum_ite_eq' Finset.univ k fun j => c • F.q j,
      Finset.sum_ite_eq' Finset.univ (k + 1) fun j => d • F.q j]
    simp

name: absorb
statement:
theorem absorb (F : FanPoly) {x y : Point} (hx : x ∈ relint F)
    (hy : ∃ w : ZMod (F.m + 3) → ℚ,
      (∀ j, 0 ≤ w j) ∧ ∑ j, w j = 1 ∧ ∑ j, w j • F.q j = y)
    {θ : ℚ} (h0 : 0 < θ) (h1 : θ ≤ 1) :
    θ • x + (1 - θ) • y ∈ relint F
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨v, hv0, hv1, rfl⟩ := hx
  obtain ⟨w, hw0, hw1, rfl⟩ := hy
  refine ⟨fun j => θ * v j + (1 - θ) * w j, fun j => ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · have hA := mul_pos h0 (hv0 j)
    have hB := mul_nonneg (by linarith : (0 : ℚ) ≤ 1 - θ) (hw0 j)
    dsimp only
    linarith
  · rw [Finset.sum_add_distrib, ← Finset.mul_sum, ← Finset.mul_sum, hv1, hw1]
    ring
  · rw [Finset.smul_sum, Finset.smul_sum, ← Finset.sum_add_distrib]
    exact Finset.sum_congr rfl fun j _ => by rw [smul_smul, smul_smul, ← add_smul]

name: eta_pos_of_relint
statement:
theorem eta_pos_of_relint (F : FanPoly) (k : ZMod (F.m + 3)) {x : Point}
    (hx : x ∈ relint F) : 0 < F.eta k x
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨w, hw0, hw1, rfl⟩ := hx
  rw [← Finset.affineCombination_eq_linear_combination Finset.univ F.q w hw1,
    Finset.map_affineCombination Finset.univ F.q w hw1 (F.eta k),
    Finset.affineCombination_eq_linear_combination Finset.univ _ w hw1]
  obtain ⟨j0, hj0⟩ := F.eta_pos k
  refine Finset.sum_pos' (fun j _ => ?_) ⟨j0, Finset.mem_univ _, ?_⟩
  · simpa [smul_eq_mul] using mul_nonneg (hw0 j).le (F.eta_nonneg k j)
  · simpa [smul_eq_mul] using mul_pos (hw0 j0) hj0

name: eta_zero_on_edge
statement:
theorem eta_zero_on_edge (F : FanPoly) (k : ZMod (F.m + 3)) {y : Point}
    (hy : y ∈ segment ℚ (F.q k) (F.q (k + 1))) : F.eta k y = 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [segment_eq_image_lineMap] at hy
  obtain ⟨t, -, rfl⟩ := hy
  rw [AffineMap.apply_lineMap, F.eta_self_left k, F.eta_self_right k]
  simp

name: eta_eq_zero_endpoints
proof:
:= by
  rw [openSegment_eq_image_lineMap] at hy
  obtain ⟨t, ht, rfl⟩ := hy
  obtain ⟨ht0, ht1⟩ := ht
  rw [AffineMap.apply_lineMap] at h0
  set c := F.eta l (F.q k) with hc_def
  set d := F.eta l (F.q (k + 1)) with hd_def
  have hc : 0 ≤ c := F.eta_nonneg l k
  have hd : 0 ≤ d := F.eta_nonneg l (k + 1)
  have h0' : t * d + (1 - t) * c = 0 := by
    have h0'' : (1 - t) * c + t * d = 0 := by
      simpa [AffineMap.lineMap_apply_module] using h0
    linarith
  have hA : 0 ≤ t * d := mul_nonneg ht0.le hd
  have hB : 0 ≤ (1 - t) * c := mul_nonneg (by linarith) hc
  have hAz : t * d = 0 := by linarith
  have hBz : (1 - t) * c = 0 := by linarith
  constructor
  · rcases mul_eq_zero.mp hBz with h | h
    · exact absurd h (by intro h'; linarith)
    · exact h
  · rcases mul_eq_zero.mp hAz with h | h
    · exact absurd h (by intro h'; linarith)
    · exact h

name: mem_fanTri_iff
statement:
theorem mem_fanTri_iff (F : FanPoly) (k : ZMod (F.m + 3)) {x : Point} :
    x ∈ triangleSet (fanTri F k) ↔
      ∃ y ∈ segment ℚ (F.q k) (F.q (k + 1)), x ∈ segment ℚ F.apex y
proof:
:= by
  show x ∈ convexHull ℚ {F.apex, F.q k, F.q (k + 1)} ↔ _
  rw [show ({F.apex, F.q k, F.q (k + 1)} : Set Point)
      = insert F.apex {F.q k, F.q (k + 1)} from rfl,
    convexHull_insert (Set.insert_nonempty _ _), mem_convexJoin]
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨a, ha, y, hy, hx⟩
    rw [Set.mem_singleton_iff] at ha
    subst ha
    rw [convexHull_pair] at hy
    exact ⟨y, hy, hx⟩
  · rintro ⟨y, hy, hx⟩
    exact ⟨F.apex, rfl, y, by rwa [convexHull_pair], hx⟩

name: fanBd
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨y, hy, hxy⟩ := (mem_fanTri_iff F k).mp hx
  obtain ⟨c, d, hc, hd, hcd, hx'⟩ := hxy
  rcases eq_or_lt_of_le hc with hc0 | hc0
  · 
    have hd1 : d = 1 := by linarith
    rw [← hc0, hd1, zero_smul, zero_add, one_smul] at hx'
    rwa [← hx']
  · 
    exfalso
    apply hnx
    have hd' : d = 1 - c := by linarith
    rw [← hx', hd']
    exact absorb F (apex_mem_relint F) (segment_weight_vector F hy) hc0
      (by linarith)

name: fanBd_disjoint
proof:
:= by
  rintro x ⟨hxT, hxS⟩
  have hnx : x ∉ relint F := fun hx =>
    Set.eq_empty_iff_forall_not_mem.mp hS x ⟨hx, hxS⟩
  exact Or.inl (Or.inr (fanBd F k hxT hnx))

name: ray_eq
statement:
theorem ray_eq (F : FanPoly) {k l : ZMod (F.m + 3)} {y₁ y₂ : Point}
    {s₁ s₂ : ℚ}
    (hy₁ : y₁ ∈ segment ℚ (F.q k) (F.q (k + 1)))
    (hy₂ : y₂ ∈ segment ℚ (F.q l) (F.q (l + 1)))
    (hs₁ : 0 < s₁) (hs₂ : 0 < s₂) (hle : s₂ ≤ s₁)
    (heq : (1 - s₁) • F.apex + s₁ • y₁ = (1 - s₂) • F.apex + s₂ • y₂) :
    y₁ = y₂
proof:
:= by
  have hkey : y₁ = (1 - s₂ / s₁) • F.apex + (s₂ / s₁) • y₂ := by
    funext i
    have hi := congrFun heq i
    simp only [Pi.add_apply, Pi.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul] at hi ⊢
    have hns : s₁ ≠ 0 := ne_of_gt hs₁
    field_simp
    linear_combination hi
  rcases eq_or_lt_of_le hle with hss | hss
  · 
    have h1 : s₂ / s₁ = 1 := by rw [hss]; field_simp
    rw [hkey, h1]
    simp
  · 
    exfalso
    have hθ0 : 0 < 1 - s₂ / s₁ := by
      have : s₂ / s₁ < 1 := (div_lt_one hs₁).mpr hss
      linarith
    have hθ1 : 1 - s₂ / s₁ ≤ 1 := by
      have : 0 < s₂ / s₁ := div_pos hs₂ hs₁
      linarith
    have hmem : y₁ ∈ relint F := by
      have := absorb F (apex_mem_relint F) (segment_weight_vector F hy₂) hθ0 hθ1
      rwa [show (1 : ℚ) - (1 - s₂ / s₁) = s₂ / s₁ by ring, ← hkey] at this
    exact absurd (eta_zero_on_edge F k hy₁)
      (ne_of_gt (eta_pos_of_relint F k hmem))

name: endpoint_cases
statement:
theorem endpoint_cases (F : FanPoly) {k l : ZMod (F.m + 3)} (hkl : k ≠ l)
    {y : Point}
    (hyk : y ∈ segment ℚ (F.q k) (F.q (k + 1)))
    (hyl : y ∈ segment ℚ (F.q l) (F.q (l + 1))) :
    y = F.q k ∨ y = F.q (k + 1)
proof:
:= by
  by_contra h
  push_neg at h
  obtain ⟨hk1, hk2⟩ := h
  have hok : y ∈ openSegment ℚ (F.q k) (F.q (k + 1)) :=
    mem_openSegment_of_ne_left_right (Ne.symm hk1) (Ne.symm hk2) hyk
  
  have hl1 : y ≠ F.q l := fun hy => F.sat k l (hy ▸ hok)
  have hl2 : y ≠ F.q (l + 1) := fun hy => F.sat k (l + 1) (hy ▸ hok)
  have hol : y ∈ openSegment ℚ (F.q l) (F.q (l + 1)) :=
    mem_openSegment_of_ne_left_right (Ne.symm hl1) (Ne.symm hl2) hyl
  
  
  obtain ⟨hek, hek1⟩ :=
    eta_eq_zero_endpoints F hok (eta_zero_on_edge F l hyl)
  have hcol := F.coll k l hek hek1
  
  rcases Proof.MeshIntersectCycle.collinear_overlap_dichotomy
      (q_ne F k) (q_ne F l) hcol ⟨y, hok, hol⟩
      (F.sat k l) (F.sat k (l + 1)) (F.sat l k) (F.sat l (k + 1)) with
    ⟨h1, _⟩ | ⟨h1, h2⟩
  · exact hkl (F.inj h1).symm
  · 
    have e1 : l = k + 1 := F.inj h1
    have e2 : l + 1 = k := F.inj h2
    rw [e1] at e2
    have h2z : (2 : ZMod (F.m + 3)) = 0 := by
      calc (2 : ZMod (F.m + 3)) = (k + 1 + 1) - k := by ring
      _ = k - k := by rw [e2]
      _ = 0 := sub_self k
    exact two_ne_zero' F.m h2z

name: mem_edgeSet_of_endpoint
proof:
:= by
  rcases hy with rfl | rfl
  · exact Or.inl (Or.inl hx)
  · exact Or.inr (by rwa [segment_symm] at hx)

name: fanSep
statement:
theorem fanSep (F : FanPoly) {k l : ZMod (F.m + 3)} (hkl : k ≠ l) :
    triangleSet (fanTri F k) ∩ triangleSet (fanTri F l) ⊆
      edgeSet (fanTri F k) ∩ edgeSet (fanTri F l)
proof:
:= by
  rintro x ⟨hxk, hxl⟩
  by_cases hxa : x = F.apex
  · subst hxa
    exact ⟨Or.inl (Or.inl (left_mem_segment ℚ _ _)),
      Or.inl (Or.inl (left_mem_segment ℚ _ _))⟩
  obtain ⟨y₁, hy₁, hx1⟩ := (mem_fanTri_iff F k).mp hxk
  obtain ⟨y₂, hy₂, hx2⟩ := (mem_fanTri_iff F l).mp hxl
  obtain ⟨c₁, d₁, hc₁, hd₁, hcd₁, he₁⟩ := hx1
  obtain ⟨c₂, d₂, hc₂, hd₂, hcd₂, he₂⟩ := hx2
  
  have hd₁0 : 0 < d₁ := by
    rcases eq_or_lt_of_le hd₁ with h | h
    · exfalso
      apply hxa
      have hc1 : c₁ = 1 := by linarith
      rw [← he₁, ← h, hc1, zero_smul, add_zero, one_smul]
    · exact h
  have hd₂0 : 0 < d₂ := by
    rcases eq_or_lt_of_le hd₂ with h | h
    · exfalso
      apply hxa
      have hc1 : c₂ = 1 := by linarith
      rw [← he₂, ← h, hc1, zero_smul, add_zero, one_smul]
    · exact h
  have hc₁' : c₁ = 1 - d₁ := by linarith
  have hc₂' : c₂ = 1 - d₂ := by linarith
  have heq : (1 - d₁) • F.apex + d₁ • y₁ = (1 - d₂) • F.apex + d₂ • y₂ := by
    rw [← hc₁', ← hc₂']
    exact he₁.trans he₂.symm
  
  have hy12 : y₁ = y₂ := by
    rcases le_total d₂ d₁ with hle | hle
    · exact ray_eq F hy₁ hy₂ hd₁0 hd₂0 hle heq
    · exact (ray_eq F hy₂ hy₁ hd₂0 hd₁0 hle heq.symm).symm
  subst hy12
  
  have hek := endpoint_cases F hkl hy₁ hy₂
  have hel := endpoint_cases F (Ne.symm hkl) hy₂ hy₁
  have hxseg : x ∈ segment ℚ F.apex y₁ := ⟨c₁, d₁, hc₁, hd₁, hcd₁, he₁⟩
  exact ⟨mem_edgeSet_of_endpoint F k hek hxseg,
    mem_edgeSet_of_endpoint F l hel hxseg⟩

name: relint_subset_poly
statement: theorem relint_subset_poly (F : FanPoly) : relint F ⊆ poly F
proof:
:= by
  rintro x ⟨w, hw0, hw1, rfl⟩
  have h := affineCombination_mem_convexHull
    (s := Finset.univ) (w := w) (v := F.q) (fun i _ => (hw0 i).le) hw1
  rwa [Finset.affineCombination_eq_linear_combination Finset.univ F.q w hw1]
    at h

name: fanTri_subset_poly
statement:
theorem fanTri_subset_poly (F : FanPoly) (k : ZMod (F.m + 3)) :
    triangleSet (fanTri F k) ⊆ poly F
proof:
:= by
  show convexHull ℚ {F.apex, F.q k, F.q (k + 1)} ⊆ poly F
  refine convexHull_min ?_ (convex_convexHull ℚ _)
  rintro z (rfl | rfl | rfl)
  · exact relint_subset_poly F (apex_mem_relint F)
  · exact subset_convexHull ℚ _ ⟨k, rfl⟩
  · exact subset_convexHull ℚ _ ⟨k + 1, rfl⟩

name: mem_tri_iff
statement:
theorem mem_tri_iff (a b c : Point) {x : Point} :
    x ∈ triangleSet ⟨a, b, c⟩ ↔ ∃ y ∈ segment ℚ b c, x ∈ segment ℚ a y
proof:
:= by
  show x ∈ convexHull ℚ {a, b, c} ↔ _
  rw [show ({a, b, c} : Set Point) = insert a {b, c} from rfl,
    convexHull_insert (Set.insert_nonempty _ _), mem_convexJoin]
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨p, hp, y, hy, hx⟩
    rw [Set.mem_singleton_iff] at hp
    subst hp
    rw [convexHull_pair] at hy
    exact ⟨y, hy, hx⟩
  · rintro ⟨y, hy, hx⟩
    exact ⟨a, rfl, y, by rwa [convexHull_pair], hx⟩

name: wholeTri_subset_poly
statement:
theorem wholeTri_subset_poly (F : FanPoly) :
    triangleSet (wholeTri F) ⊆ poly F
proof:
:= by
  show convexHull ℚ {F.q 0, F.q 1, F.q 2} ⊆ poly F
  refine convexHull_min ?_ (convex_convexHull ℚ _)
  rintro z (rfl | rfl | rfl)
  · exact subset_convexHull ℚ _ ⟨0, rfl⟩
  · exact subset_convexHull ℚ _ ⟨1, rfl⟩
  · exact subset_convexHull ℚ _ ⟨2, rfl⟩

name: zmod_three_cases
statement:
theorem zmod_three_cases {F : FanPoly} (hm : F.m = 0) (k : ZMod (F.m + 3)) :
    k = 0 ∨ k = 1 ∨ k = 2
proof:
:= by
  have hv := ZMod.val_lt k
  have hk : ((k.val : ℕ) : ZMod (F.m + 3)) = k := ZMod.natCast_rightInverse k
  have h3 : k.val = 0 ∨ k.val = 1 ∨ k.val = 2 := by omega
  rcases h3 with h | h | h
  · left; rw [← hk, h]; exact Nat.cast_zero
  · right; left; rw [← hk, h]; exact Nat.cast_one
  · right; right; rw [← hk, h]; exact Nat.cast_two

name: one_ne_two'
statement: private theorem one_ne_two' (m : ℕ) : (1 : ZMod (m + 3)) ≠ 2
proof:
:= by
  intro h
  apply one_ne_zero' m
  calc (1 : ZMod (m + 3)) = 2 - 1 := by ring
  _ = 1 - 1 := by rw [← h]
  _ = 0 := by ring

name: triBd
proof:
:= by
  classical
  obtain ⟨y, hy, hxy⟩ := (mem_tri_iff (F.q 0) (F.q 1) (F.q 2)).mp hx
  obtain ⟨c, d, hc, hd, hcd, hyeq⟩ := hy
  obtain ⟨c₀, d₀, hc₀, hd₀, hcd₀, hxeq⟩ := hxy
  show x ∈ segment ℚ (F.q 0) (F.q 1) ∪ segment ℚ (F.q 1) (F.q 2)
    ∪ segment ℚ (F.q 2) (F.q 0)
  rcases eq_or_lt_of_le hd₀ with hd₀0 | hd₀pos
  · 
    have hc₀1 : c₀ = 1 := by linarith
    have hxq : x = F.q 0 := by
      rw [← hxeq, ← hd₀0, hc₀1, zero_smul, add_zero, one_smul]
    rw [hxq]
    exact Or.inr (right_mem_segment ℚ _ _)
  rcases eq_or_lt_of_le hc₀ with hc₀0 | hc₀pos
  · 
    have hd₀1 : d₀ = 1 := by linarith
    have hxq : x = y := by
      rw [← hxeq, ← hc₀0, hd₀1, zero_smul, zero_add, one_smul]
    exact Or.inl (Or.inr (hxq ▸ ⟨c, d, hc, hd, hcd, hyeq⟩))
  rcases eq_or_lt_of_le hc with hc0 | hcpos
  · 
    have hd1 : d = 1 := by linarith
    have hyq : y = F.q 2 := by
      rw [← hyeq, ← hc0, hd1, zero_smul, zero_add, one_smul]
    refine Or.inr ?_
    rw [segment_symm]
    exact ⟨c₀, d₀, hc₀, hd₀, hcd₀, by rw [← hyq]; exact hxeq⟩
  rcases eq_or_lt_of_le hd with hd0 | hdpos
  · 
    have hc1 : c = 1 := by linarith
    have hyq : y = F.q 1 := by
      rw [← hyeq, ← hd0, hc1, zero_smul, add_zero, one_smul]
    exact Or.inl (Or.inl ⟨c₀, d₀, hc₀, hd₀, hcd₀, by rw [← hyq]; exact hxeq⟩)
  · 
    exfalso
    apply hnx
    have h10 : (1 : ZMod (F.m + 3)) ≠ 0 := one_ne_zero' F.m
    have h20 : (2 : ZMod (F.m + 3)) ≠ 0 := two_ne_zero' F.m
    have h21 : (2 : ZMod (F.m + 3)) ≠ 1 := (one_ne_two' F.m).symm
    have huniv : (Finset.univ : Finset (ZMod (F.m + 3))) = {0, 1, 2} := by
      symm
      apply Finset.eq_univ_iff_forall.mpr
      intro k
      rcases zmod_three_cases hm k with rfl | rfl | rfl <;> simp
    have hmem0 : (0 : ZMod (F.m + 3)) ∉ ({1, 2} : Finset (ZMod (F.m + 3))) := by
      simp [Ne.symm h10, Ne.symm h20]
    have hmem1 : (1 : ZMod (F.m + 3)) ∉ ({2} : Finset (ZMod (F.m + 3))) := by
      simp [one_ne_two' F.m]
    set w : ZMod (F.m + 3) → ℚ :=
      fun k => if k = 0 then c₀ else if k = 1 then d₀ * c else d₀ * d with hw
    have hw0 : w 0 = c₀ := by
      show (if (0 : ZMod (F.m + 3)) = 0 then c₀
        else if (0 : ZMod (F.m + 3)) = 1 then d₀ * c else d₀ * d) = c₀
      exact if_pos rfl
    have hw1 : w 1 = d₀ * c := by
      show (if (1 : ZMod (F.m + 3)) = 0 then c₀
        else if (1 : ZMod (F.m + 3)) = 1 then d₀ * c else d₀ * d) = d₀ * c
      rw [if_neg h10]
      exact if_pos rfl
    have hw2 : w 2 = d₀ * d := by
      show (if (2 : ZMod (F.m + 3)) = 0 then c₀
        else if (2 : ZMod (F.m + 3)) = 1 then d₀ * c else d₀ * d) = d₀ * d
      rw [if_neg h20, if_neg h21]
    refine ⟨w, fun k => ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
    · rcases zmod_three_cases hm k with rfl | rfl | rfl
      · rw [hw0]; exact hc₀pos
      · rw [hw1]; exact mul_pos hd₀pos hcpos
      · rw [hw2]; exact mul_pos hd₀pos hdpos
    · rw [huniv, Finset.sum_insert hmem0, Finset.sum_insert hmem1,
        Finset.sum_singleton, hw0, hw1, hw2]
      nlinarith [hcd, hcd₀]
    · rw [huniv, Finset.sum_insert hmem0, Finset.sum_insert hmem1,
        Finset.sum_singleton, hw0, hw1, hw2]
      calc c₀ • F.q 0 + ((d₀ * c) • F.q 1 + (d₀ * d) • F.q 2)
          = c₀ • F.q 0 + d₀ • (c • F.q 1 + d • F.q 2) := by module
      _ = x := by rw [hyeq]; exact hxeq

name: triBd_disjoint
proof:
:= by
  rintro x ⟨hxT, hxS⟩
  have hnx : x ∉ relint F := fun hx =>
    Set.eq_empty_iff_forall_not_mem.mp hS x ⟨hx, hxS⟩
  exact triBd F hm hxT hnx

name: exists_perp_ne
statement: theorem exists_perp_ne {v : Point} (hv : v ≠ 0) : ∃ m : Point, m ≠ 0 ∧ dotQ m v = 0
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hc1 : (mkPoint (v 1) (-(v 0)) 0 : Point) = 0
  · have hv1 : v 1 = 0 := by have := congrFun hc1 0; simpa [mkPoint_zero] using this
    have hv0 : v 0 = 0 := by
      have := congrFun hc1 1
      simp only [mkPoint_one, Pi.zero_apply, neg_eq_zero] at this; exact this
    have hv2 : v 2 ≠ 0 := by
      intro h2; apply hv; funext k; fin_cases k <;> simp [mkPoint, hv0, hv1, h2]
    refine ⟨mkPoint 0 (v 2) (-(v 1)), ?_, ?_⟩
    · intro h; have := congrFun h 1
      simp only [mkPoint_one, Pi.zero_apply] at this; exact hv2 this
    · simp only [dotQ, mkPoint_zero, mkPoint_one, mkPoint_two]; ring
  · exact ⟨mkPoint (v 1) (-(v 0)) 0, hc1, by
      simp only [dotQ, mkPoint_zero, mkPoint_one, mkPoint_two]; ring⟩

name: crossQ_zero_of_combo
statement:
theorem crossQ_zero_of_combo {e1 e2 : Point} {α β : ℚ} (hnt : α ≠ 0 ∨ β ≠ 0)
    (h : α • e1 + β • e2 = 0) : crossQ e1 e2 = 0
proof:
:= by
  rcases hnt with ha | hb
  · have hz : crossQ (α • e1 + β • e2) e2 = crossQ (0 : Point) e2 := by rw [h]
    rw [Proof.MeshIntersectCone.crossQ_add_left, Proof.MeshIntersectClip.crossQ_smul_left,
      Proof.MeshIntersectClip.crossQ_smul_left, Proof.MeshIntersectClip.crossQ_self, smul_zero,
      add_zero, Proof.MeshIntersectRayClassifyGen.crossQ_zero_left] at hz
    exact (smul_eq_zero.mp hz).resolve_left ha
  · have hz : crossQ e1 (α • e1 + β • e2) = crossQ e1 (0 : Point) := by rw [h]
    rw [Proof.MeshIntersectCone.crossQ_add_right, Proof.MeshIntersectClip.crossQ_smul_right,
      Proof.MeshIntersectClip.crossQ_smul_right, Proof.MeshIntersectClip.crossQ_self, smul_zero,
      zero_add, Proof.MeshIntersectClip.crossQ_zero_right] at hz
    exact (smul_eq_zero.mp hz).resolve_left hb

name: lateral_contra_local
statement:
theorem lateral_contra_local {tA : Triangle} (hdetA : detOrigin tA ≠ 0)
    {N : Point} (hN : N ≠ 0) (h₀ : dotQ N tA.v₀ = 0) (h₁ : dotQ N tA.v₁ = 0)
    (h₂ : dotQ N tA.v₂ = 0) : False
proof:
:= by
  have hu1 : dotQ N (tA.v₁ - tA.v₀) = 0 := by
    rw [Proof.MeshIntersectRay.dotQ_sub_right, h₀, h₁]; ring
  have hu2 : dotQ N (tA.v₂ - tA.v₀) = 0 := by
    rw [Proof.MeshIntersectRay.dotQ_sub_right, h₀, h₂]; ring
  have hkey := Proof.MeshIntersectClip.crossQ_parallel_of_orth (n := N) hu1 hu2
  have hcn : crossQ (tA.v₁ - tA.v₀) (tA.v₂ - tA.v₀) = carrierNormal tA := rfl
  rw [hcn] at hkey
  have hpair := congrArg (fun z => dotQ z tA.v₀) hkey
  simp only [Proof.SimImplCover.dotQ_smul_left] at hpair
  rw [dotQ_carrierNormal_v₀, h₀, mul_zero] at hpair
  have hNN : 0 < dotQ N N := Proof.MeshIntersectRay.dotQ_self_pos hN
  rcases mul_eq_zero.mp hpair with h | h
  · exact hNN.ne' h
  · exact hdetA h

name: smulS_toPoint

name: paddS_toPoint'

name: foldl_padd_toPoint
proof:
:= by
  induction l generalizing acc with
  | nil => simp
  | cons hd tl ih =>
    rw [List.foldl_cons, ih, paddS_toPoint', List.map_cons, List.sum_cons]
    abel

name: poly_map_eq_ofFn
statement:
private theorem poly_map_eq_ofFn (f : Frag) :
    f.poly.toList.map (fun v => P3.toPoint v.p) = List.ofFn (fragCycle f)
proof:
:= by
  apply List.ext_getElem
  · simp
  · intro k h1 h2
    simp only [List.getElem_map, List.getElem_ofFn, Array.getElem_toList]
    rfl

name: sampleB_toPoint
statement:
theorem sampleB_toPoint (f : Frag) [NeZero f.poly.size] :
    P3.toPoint (smulS (1 / ((f.poly.size : ℕ) : ℚ))
        (f.poly.foldl (fun acc v => paddS acc v.p) ⟨0, 0, 0⟩))
      = ∑ i, ((f.poly.size : ℚ))⁻¹ • fragCycle f i
proof:
:= by
  rw [show f.poly.foldl (fun acc v => paddS acc v.p) ⟨0, 0, 0⟩
      = f.poly.toList.foldl (fun acc v => paddS acc v.p) ⟨0, 0, 0⟩ from
      (Array.foldl_toList ..).symm]
  rw [smulS_toPoint, foldl_padd_toPoint, toPoint_zeroP3, zero_add,
    poly_map_eq_ofFn, List.sum_ofFn, Finset.smul_sum]
  refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun i _ => ?_
  rw [one_div]

name: fragCentroid_eq_ofPoint_bary
statement:
theorem fragCentroid_eq_ofPoint_bary (f : Frag) [NeZero f.poly.size] :
    fragCentroid f = ofPoint (∑ i, ((f.poly.size : ℚ))⁻¹ • fragCycle f i)
proof:
:= by

  rfl

name: h4Repr_of_repr4
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨hw, hQ⟩ := h
  have hwq : ((q.w : ℚ)) ≠ 0 := by exact_mod_cast hw.ne'
  have hx : p.x = (q.x : ℚ) / (q.w : ℚ) := by
    have := congrFun hQ 0; simpa [P3.toPoint, mkPoint_zero] using this
  have hy : p.y = (q.y : ℚ) / (q.w : ℚ) := by
    have := congrFun hQ 1; simpa [P3.toPoint, mkPoint_one] using this
  have hz : p.z = (q.z : ℚ) / (q.w : ℚ) := by
    have := congrFun hQ 2; simpa [P3.toPoint, mkPoint_two] using this
  exact ⟨hw, by rw [hx]; field_simp, by rw [hy]; field_simp, by rw [hz]; field_simp⟩

name: fragInv_fragMirrors
statement:
theorem fragInv_fragMirrors {nt : Point} {ct : ℚ} {f : Frag} (hinv : FragInv nt ct f) :
    MeshIntersectWedge.FragMirrors f
proof:
:= by
  intro v hv
  obtain ⟨i, hi, hval⟩ := List.mem_iff_getElem.mp hv
  have hi' : i < f.poly.size := by simpa using hi
  have hveq : f.poly[i] = v := by rw [← hval, Array.getElem_toList]
  exact h4Repr_of_repr4 (hveq ▸ hinv.vrepr ⟨i, hi'⟩)

name: exists_edge_moment
statement:
theorem exists_edge_moment {M : Mesh} (hnpo : NoPlaneThroughOrigin M)
    {n : Point} (hn : n ≠ 0) (c : ℚ) (u : Fin M.size) (k : Fin 3) :
    ∃ m : Point, dotQ m (psub (edgeHead M[u] k) (edgeTail M[u] k)) = 0 ∧
      ∃ y, dotQ n y = c ∧ dotQ m (psub y (edgeTail M[u] k)) ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  set e := psub (edgeHead M[u] k) (edgeTail M[u] k) with he
  set a := edgeTail M[u] k with ha
  have he0 : e ≠ 0 := edge_vec_ne_zero hnpo u k
  obtain ⟨m, hm0, hme, hmn⟩ : ∃ m : Point, m ≠ 0 ∧ dotQ m e = 0 ∧ dotQ m n = 0 := by
    by_cases hcr : crossQ e n = 0
    · obtain ⟨s, hs⟩ := Proof.MeshIntersectClip.exists_smul_of_crossQ_eq_zero hn hcr
      obtain ⟨m, hm0, hmn⟩ := exists_perp_ne hn
      refine ⟨m, hm0, ?_, hmn⟩
      rw [hs, Proof.MeshIntersectRay.dotQ_smul_right, hmn, mul_zero]
    · exact ⟨crossQ e n, hcr, Proof.SimImplCover.dotQ_crossQ_left e n,
        Proof.SimImplCover.dotQ_crossQ_right e n⟩
  have hnn : dotQ n n ≠ 0 := (Proof.MeshIntersectRay.dotQ_self_pos hn).ne'
  set y0 := (c / dotQ n n) • n with hy0
  have hy0c : dotQ n y0 = c := by
    rw [hy0, Proof.MeshIntersectRay.dotQ_smul_right, div_mul_cancel₀ _ hnn]
  have hnm : dotQ n m = 0 := by rw [Proof.MeshIntersectClip.dotQ_comm]; exact hmn
  have hymc : dotQ n (y0 + m) = c := by
    rw [Proof.MeshIntersectRay.dotQ_add_right, hy0c, hnm, add_zero]
  have hmm : dotQ m m ≠ 0 := (Proof.MeshIntersectRay.dotQ_self_pos hm0).ne'
  by_cases hz : dotQ m (psub y0 a) = 0
  · refine ⟨m, hme, y0 + m, hymc, ?_⟩
    rw [dotQ_psub_right] at hz ⊢
    rw [Proof.MeshIntersectRay.dotQ_add_right]
    intro hcontra
    exact hmm (by linarith)
  · exact ⟨m, hme, y0, hy0c, hz⟩

name: baryPt_mem_triangleSet
statement: theorem baryPt_mem_triangleSet (t : Triangle) : baryPt t ∈ triangleSet t
proof:
:= by
  have heq : baryPt t = (1 / 3 : ℚ) • t.v₀ + (1 / 3 : ℚ) • t.v₁ + (1 / 3 : ℚ) • t.v₂ := by
    funext j; simp only [baryPt, Pi.add_apply, Pi.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul]; ring
  rw [heq]
  have hmem := Proof.WellFormedCheckNSI.mem_triangleSet_of_bary t (fun _ => (1 / 3 : ℚ))
    (fun _ => by norm_num) (by rw [Fin.sum_univ_three]; norm_num)
  simpa using hmem

name: centroid_off_edge
statement: theorem centroid_off_edge {t : Triangle} (hfn : Proof.MeshIntersectJump.faceNormal t ≠ 0) : baryPt t ∉ edgeSet t
proof:
:= by
  intro hmem
  have hbc : baryPt t = (1 / 3 : ℚ) • t.v₀ + (1 / 3 : ℚ) • t.v₁ + (1 / 3 : ℚ) • t.v₂ := by
    funext j; simp only [baryPt, Pi.add_apply, Pi.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul]; ring
  have hcn : crossQ (t.v₁ - t.v₀) (t.v₂ - t.v₀) = 0 := by
    simp only [edgeSet, Set.mem_union] at hmem
    rcases hmem with (hseg | hseg) | hseg
    · obtain ⟨x, y, _, _, hxy, heq⟩ := hseg
      refine crossQ_zero_of_combo (α := y - 1 / 3) (β := -1 / 3) (Or.inr (by norm_num)) ?_
      have hdep : (y - 1 / 3 : ℚ) • (t.v₁ - t.v₀) + (-1 / 3 : ℚ) • (t.v₂ - t.v₀)
          = (x • t.v₀ + y • t.v₁)
            - ((1 / 3 : ℚ) • t.v₀ + (1 / 3 : ℚ) • t.v₁ + (1 / 3 : ℚ) • t.v₂) := by
        match_scalars <;> linarith [hxy]
      rw [heq, hbc, sub_self] at hdep; exact hdep
    · obtain ⟨x, y, _, _, hxy, heq⟩ := hseg
      refine crossQ_zero_of_combo (α := x - 1 / 3) (β := y - 1 / 3) ?_ ?_
      · by_contra hcon; push_neg at hcon; obtain ⟨e1z, e2z⟩ := hcon; linarith [hxy]
      · have hdep : (x - 1 / 3 : ℚ) • (t.v₁ - t.v₀) + (y - 1 / 3 : ℚ) • (t.v₂ - t.v₀)
            = (x • t.v₁ + y • t.v₂)
              - ((1 / 3 : ℚ) • t.v₀ + (1 / 3 : ℚ) • t.v₁ + (1 / 3 : ℚ) • t.v₂) := by
          match_scalars <;> linarith [hxy]
        rw [heq, hbc, sub_self] at hdep; exact hdep
    · obtain ⟨x, y, _, _, hxy, heq⟩ := hseg
      refine crossQ_zero_of_combo (α := -1 / 3) (β := x - 1 / 3) (Or.inl (by norm_num)) ?_
      have hdep : (-1 / 3 : ℚ) • (t.v₁ - t.v₀) + (x - 1 / 3 : ℚ) • (t.v₂ - t.v₀)
          = (x • t.v₂ + y • t.v₀)
            - ((1 / 3 : ℚ) • t.v₀ + (1 / 3 : ℚ) • t.v₁ + (1 / 3 : ℚ) • t.v₂) := by
        match_scalars <;> linarith [hxy]
      rw [heq, hbc, sub_self] at hdep; exact hdep
  apply hfn
  rw [Proof.MeshIntersectJump.faceNormal, Proof.MeshIntersectRay.psub_eq_sub, Proof.MeshIntersectRay.psub_eq_sub]
  exact hcn

name: baryPt_off_other_faces
statement:
theorem baryPt_off_other_faces {M : Mesh} (hns : NoFaceInteriorContact M)
    (hnpo : NoPlaneThroughOrigin M) :
    ∀ (i : ℕ) (hi : i < M.size) (u : Fin M.size), u.val ≠ i →
      baryPt (M[i]'hi) ∉ triangleSet M[u]
proof:
:= by
  intro i hi u hui hmemU
  have hne : (⟨i, hi⟩ : Fin M.size) ≠ u := by simp only [ne_eq, Fin.ext_iff]; omega
  have hmemI : baryPt (M[i]'hi) ∈ triangleSet (M[i]'hi) := baryPt_mem_triangleSet _
  have hsub := hns ⟨i, hi⟩ u hne
  have hedge := hsub ⟨hmemI, hmemU⟩
  exact centroid_off_edge (Proof.MeshIntersectRayClassify.faceNormal_ne_zero (hnpo ⟨i, hi⟩)) hedge

theorem slot_c_lateral (u : Triangle) (k : Fin 4) (hk : (k : ℕ) < 3) :

  fin_cases k
  · rw [show (⟨0, by omega⟩ : Fin 4) = 0 from rfl, slotH_0]
    split
    · rfl
    · show -(0 : ℚ) = 0
      ring

name: slot_n_lateral_ne
statement:
theorem slot_n_lateral_ne {u : Triangle} (hdet : detOrigin u ≠ 0)
    (k : Fin 4) (hk : (k : ℕ) < 3) : (slot u k).n ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  have hbase : ∀ N : Point, ∀ x : Point, dotQ N x ≠ 0 → N ≠ 0 := by
    intro N x hNx hN0
    apply hNx
    rw [hN0]
    simp [dotQ]
  have hnegbase : ∀ N : Point, ∀ x : Point, dotQ N x ≠ 0 →
      (Half.neg ⟨N, (0 : ℚ)⟩).n ≠ 0 := by
    intro N x hNx h0
    rw [half_neg_n, neg_eq_zero] at h0
    exact hbase N x hNx h0
  fin_cases k
  · rw [show (⟨0, by omega⟩ : Fin 4) = 0 from rfl, slotH_0]
    have hp : dotQ (crossQ u.v₁ u.v₂) u.v₀ ≠ 0 := by
      rw [Proof.SimImplCover.dotQ_crossQ_det, det3_eq_detOrigin]
      exact hdet
    split
    · exact hbase _ _ hp
    · exact hnegbase _ _ hp
  · rw [show (⟨1, by omega⟩ : Fin 4) = 1 from rfl, slotH_1]
    have hp : dotQ (crossQ u.v₀ u.v₂) u.v₁ ≠ 0 := by
      rw [Proof.SimImplCover.dotQ_crossQ_det]
      intro h
      apply hdet
      rw [← det3_eq_detOrigin]
      rw [Proof.SimImplCover.det3_expand] at h ⊢
      linarith [h]
    split
    · exact hbase _ _ hp
    · exact hnegbase _ _ hp
  · rw [show (⟨2, by omega⟩ : Fin 4) = 2 from rfl, slotH_2]
    have hp : dotQ (crossQ u.v₀ u.v₁) u.v₂ ≠ 0 := by
      rw [Proof.SimImplCover.dotQ_crossQ_det]
      intro h
      apply hdet
      rw [← det3_eq_detOrigin]
      rw [Proof.SimImplCover.det3_expand] at h ⊢
      linarith [h]
    split
    · exact hbase _ _ hp
    · exact hnegbase _ _ hp
  · simp at hk

name: slot3_vanish
proof:
:= by
  have hpsub : crossQ (psub u.v₁ u.v₀) (psub u.v₂ u.v₀) = carrierNormal u := by
    rw [Proof.SimImplCover.psub_eq_sub, Proof.SimImplCover.psub_eq_sub]
    rfl
  have hc3 : dotQ (crossQ (psub u.v₁ u.v₀) (psub u.v₂ u.v₀)) u.v₀
      = detOrigin u := by
    rw [hpsub]
    exact dotQ_carrierNormal_v₀ u
  rw [slotH_3] at h
  split at h
  · have h' : dotQ (crossQ (psub u.v₁ u.v₀) (psub u.v₂ u.v₀)) x
        - dotQ (crossQ (psub u.v₁ u.v₀) (psub u.v₂ u.v₀)) u.v₀ = 0 := h
    rw [hpsub, dotQ_carrierNormal_v₀] at h'
    linarith
  · have h' : dotQ (psub (mkPoint 0 0 0)
        (crossQ (psub u.v₁ u.v₀) (psub u.v₂ u.v₀))) x
        - -(dotQ (crossQ (psub u.v₁ u.v₀) (psub u.v₂ u.v₀)) u.v₀) = 0 := h
    rw [dotQ_neg_normal, hpsub, dotQ_carrierNormal_v₀] at h'
    linarith

name: ce_iplane_of_mul
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨m, hm, ha, hb, hc, hd⟩ := h
  refine ⟨m, hm, fun x => ?_⟩
  simp only [ce, iplaneN, iplaneD, dotQ, mkPoint_zero, mkPoint_one,
    mkPoint_two, ha, hb, hc, hd]
  ring

name: smul_of_ann_ker
statement:
theorem smul_of_ann_ker {n m : Point} (hn : n ≠ 0)
    (hker : ∀ v : Point, dotQ n v = 0 → dotQ m v = 0) :
    m = (dotQ m n / dotQ n n) • n
proof:
:= by
  have hnn : 0 < dotQ n n := dotQ_self_pos hn
  set ρ : ℚ := dotQ m n / dotQ n n with hρ
  set v : Point := m - ρ • n with hv
  have hnv : dotQ n v = 0 := by
    rw [hv, dotQ_sub_right, Proof.SimImplCover.dotQ_smul_right, hρ,
      Proof.MeshIntersectClip.dotQ_comm m n,
      div_mul_cancel₀ _ (ne_of_gt hnn), sub_self]
  have hmv : dotQ m v = 0 := hker v hnv
  have hvv : dotQ v v = 0 := by
    have hexp : dotQ v v = dotQ m v - ρ * dotQ n v := by
      rw [hv, Proof.MeshIntersectClip.dotQ_comm (m - ρ • n) v, dotQ_sub_right,
        Proof.SimImplCover.dotQ_smul_right, Proof.MeshIntersectClip.dotQ_comm v m,
        Proof.MeshIntersectClip.dotQ_comm v n]
    rw [hexp, hmv, hnv]; ring
  have hv0 : v = 0 := by
    by_contra hc
    exact (ne_of_gt (dotQ_self_pos hc)) hvv
  rw [hv, sub_eq_zero] at hv0
  exact hv0

name: ratProp_of_common_multiple
statement:
theorem ratProp_of_common_multiple {g p : IPlane} {nt : Point} {ct ρ m : ℚ}
    (hρ : ρ ≠ 0) (hm : m ≠ 0)
    (hga : (g.a : ℚ) = ρ * nt 0) (hgb : (g.b : ℚ) = ρ * nt 1)
    (hgc : (g.c : ℚ) = ρ * nt 2) (hgd : (g.d : ℚ) = ρ * ct)
    (hpa : (p.a : ℚ) = m * nt 0) (hpb : (p.b : ℚ) = m * nt 1)
    (hpc : (p.c : ℚ) = m * nt 2) (hpd : (p.d : ℚ) = m * ct) :
    RatProp g p
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨m / ρ, div_ne_zero hm hρ, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · rw [hpa, hga]; field_simp; ring
  · rw [hpb, hgb]; field_simp; ring
  · rw [hpc, hgc]; field_simp; ring
  · rw [hpd, hgd]; field_simp; ring

name: transverse_witness
statement:
theorem transverse_witness {g : IPlane} {nt : Point} {ct : ℚ} (hnt : nt ≠ 0)
    {p : IPlane} (hmul : IsMulOf p nt ct) (hgN : iplaneN g ≠ 0)
    (hcop : coplanarPlane g p = false) :
    ∃ y, dotQ nt y = ct ∧ ce (iplaneN g) (iplaneD g) y ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  by_contra hcon
  push_neg at hcon
  have hvanish : ∀ y, dotQ nt y = ct → ce (iplaneN g) (iplaneD g) y = 0 := hcon
  have hnn : 0 < dotQ nt nt := dotQ_self_pos hnt
  set y0 : Point := (ct / dotQ nt nt) • nt with hy0
  have hy0c : dotQ nt y0 = ct := by
    rw [hy0, Proof.SimImplCover.dotQ_smul_right, div_mul_cancel₀ _ (ne_of_gt hnn)]
  have hker : ∀ v : Point, dotQ nt v = 0 → dotQ (iplaneN g) v = 0 := by
    intro v hv
    have hin : dotQ nt (y0 + v) = ct := by
      rw [dotQ_add_right, hy0c, hv, add_zero]
    have e1 := hvanish y0 hy0c
    have e2 := hvanish (y0 + v) hin
    simp only [ce, dotQ_add_right] at e1 e2
    linarith
  obtain hsm := smul_of_ann_ker hnt hker
  set ρ : ℚ := dotQ (iplaneN g) nt / dotQ nt nt with hρdef
  have hρ : ρ ≠ 0 := by
    intro h0
    apply hgN
    rw [hsm, h0, zero_smul]
  have hga : (g.a : ℚ) = ρ * nt 0 := by
    have := congrFun hsm 0
    simpa [iplaneN, mkPoint_zero, Pi.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul] using this
  have hgb : (g.b : ℚ) = ρ * nt 1 := by
    have := congrFun hsm 1
    simpa [iplaneN, mkPoint_one, Pi.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul] using this
  have hgc : (g.c : ℚ) = ρ * nt 2 := by
    have := congrFun hsm 2
    simpa [iplaneN, mkPoint_two, Pi.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul] using this
  have hgd : (g.d : ℚ) = ρ * ct := by
    have e1 := hvanish y0 hy0c
    simp only [ce] at e1
    have hgny0 : dotQ (iplaneN g) y0 = ρ * ct := by
      rw [hsm, Proof.SimImplCover.dotQ_smul_left, hy0c]
    rw [hgny0] at e1
    have : (iplaneD g) = ρ * ct := by linarith
    rw [iplaneD] at this; exact this
  obtain ⟨m, hm, hpa, hpb, hpc, hpd⟩ := hmul
  have hratp : RatProp g p :=
    ratProp_of_common_multiple hρ (ne_of_gt hm) hga hgb hgc hgd hpa hpb hpc hpd
  have : coplanarPlane g p = true :=
    coplanarPlane_eq_true_iff.mpr (prim_eq_of_ratMul hratp)
  rw [this] at hcop
  exact Bool.noConfusion hcop

name: iplaneN_eq_smul
statement:
theorem iplaneN_eq_smul {g : IPlane} {N : Point} {c : ℚ} (h : IsMulOf g N c) :
    ∃ m : ℚ, 0 < m ∧ iplaneN g = m • N
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨m, hm, ha, hb, hc, _⟩ := h
  refine ⟨m, hm, ?_⟩
  funext i
  fin_cases i <;>
    simp only [iplaneN, mkPoint_zero, mkPoint_one, mkPoint_two, Pi.smul_apply,
      smul_eq_mul]
  · exact ha
  · exact hb
  · exact hc

name: isMulOf_faceSOf_plane
statement:
theorem isMulOf_faceSOf_plane (u : Triangle) :
    IsMulOf (faceSOf u).plane (carrierNormal u) (detOrigin u)
proof:
:= by
  
  
  
  exact CSG.Proof.MeshIntersectPlaneH.isMulOf_iFacePlaneH_carrier u

name: carrier_not_subset_of_noncoplanar
statement:
theorem carrier_not_subset_of_noncoplanar {tA u : Triangle}
    (hdetA : detOrigin tA ≠ 0) (hdetU : detOrigin u ≠ 0)
    (hcop : coplanarPlane (faceSOf u).plane (faceSOf tA).plane = false) :
    ∃ y, dotQ (carrierNormal tA) y = detOrigin tA
      ∧ dotQ (carrierNormal u) y ≠ detOrigin u
proof:
:= by
  have hmulA : IsMulOf (faceSOf tA).plane (carrierNormal tA) (detOrigin tA) :=
    isMulOf_faceSOf_plane tA
  have hmulU : IsMulOf (faceSOf u).plane (carrierNormal u) (detOrigin u) :=
    isMulOf_faceSOf_plane u
  have hntA : carrierNormal tA ≠ 0 := carrierNormal_ne_zero hdetA
  have hntU : carrierNormal u ≠ 0 := carrierNormal_ne_zero hdetU
  have hgN : iplaneN (faceSOf u).plane ≠ 0 := by
    obtain ⟨m, hm, hsm⟩ := iplaneN_eq_smul hmulU
    rw [hsm]
    exact smul_ne_zero (ne_of_gt hm) hntU
  obtain ⟨y, hyA, hyU⟩ :=
    transverse_witness (g := (faceSOf u).plane) hntA hmulA hgN hcop
  refine ⟨y, hyA, ?_⟩
  obtain ⟨m, hm, hce⟩ := ce_iplane_of_mul hmulU
  rw [hce] at hyU
  have hyU' : ce (carrierNormal u) (detOrigin u) y ≠ 0 := by
    intro h0
    exact hyU (by rw [h0, mul_zero])
  intro heq
  apply hyU'
  simp only [ce, heq, sub_self]

name: facet_feasible_slot
statement:
theorem facet_feasible_slot {tA u : Triangle} (hdetA : detOrigin tA ≠ 0)
    (hdetU : detOrigin u ≠ 0) (k : Fin 4)
    (hbase : (k : ℕ) = 3 → coplanarPlane (faceSOf u).plane (faceSOf tA).plane = false) :
    ∃ y, dotQ (carrierNormal tA) y = detOrigin tA ∧ (slot u k).eval y ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hk3 : (k : ℕ) < 3
  · by_contra hcon
    push_neg at hcon
    have h₀ := hcon tA.v₀ (dotQ_carrierNormal_v₀ tA)
    have h₁ := hcon tA.v₁ (dotQ_carrierNormal_v₁ tA)
    have h₂ := hcon tA.v₂ (dotQ_carrierNormal_v₂ tA)
    have hc0 : (slot u k).c = 0 := slot_c_lateral u k hk3
    have hNne : (slot u k).n ≠ 0 := slot_n_lateral_ne hdetU k hk3
    have hdot : ∀ x : Point, (slot u k).eval x = 0 → dotQ (slot u k).n x = 0 := by
      intro x hx; rw [Half.eval, hc0, sub_zero] at hx; exact hx
    exact lateral_contra_local hdetA hNne (hdot _ h₀) (hdot _ h₁) (hdot _ h₂)
  · have hk : k = 3 := Fin.ext (by omega)
    subst hk
    obtain ⟨y, hyA, hyU⟩ :=
      carrier_not_subset_of_noncoplanar hdetA hdetU (hbase rfl)
    exact ⟨y, hyA, fun h0 => hyU (slot3_vanish h0)⟩

name: facet_feasible_transverse
statement:
theorem facet_feasible_transverse {tA : Triangle} (hdetA : detOrigin tA ≠ 0) {MB : Mesh}
    (hnpoB : NoPlaneThroughOrigin MB)
    (htr : ∀ j : Fin MB.size, coplanarPlane (faceSOf MB[j]).plane (faceSOf tA).plane = false) :
    ∀ (j : Fin MB.size) (g : Half), g ∈ tetraHalves MB[j] →
      ∃ y, dotQ (carrierNormal tA) y = detOrigin tA ∧ g.eval y ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  intro j g hg
  obtain ⟨k, rfl⟩ := mem_tetraHalves_iff.mp hg
  exact facet_feasible_slot hdetA (hnpoB j) k (fun _ => htr j)

name: facet_feasible_cop
proof:
:= by
  intro j k hcon
  apply facet_feasible_slot hdetA (hnpoB j) k
  intro hk3
  apply htr j
  intro hcop
  exact hcon ⟨hcop, Fin.ext (by simpa using hk3)⟩

name: stepJumpAt_meshSteps_list
statement:
theorem stepJumpAt_meshSteps_list (M : Mesh) (Q : Point) (v : ℚ) :
    stepJumpAt (meshSteps M Q) v
      = (M.toList.map (fun f =>
          if Proof.MeshIntersectStep.faceParam f Q = v
          then Proof.MeshIntersectStep.faceJump f Q else 0)).sum
proof:
:= by
  classical
  rw [stepJumpAt, Finset.sum_filter,
    Proof.MeshIntersectAbel.sum_map_eq_finSum M.toList
      (fun f => if Proof.MeshIntersectStep.faceParam f Q = v
        then Proof.MeshIntersectStep.faceJump f Q else 0)]
  rw [show (fun k : Fin M.size => if (meshSteps M Q k).1 = v then (meshSteps M Q k).2 else 0)
        = (fun k : Fin M.size =>
            if Proof.MeshIntersectStep.faceParam M[k] Q = v
            then Proof.MeshIntersectStep.faceJump M[k] Q else 0) from rfl,
    ← Fin.sum_congr'
      (fun k : Fin M.size =>
        if Proof.MeshIntersectStep.faceParam M[k] Q = v
        then Proof.MeshIntersectStep.faceJump M[k] Q else 0)
      (by rw [Array.length_toList] : M.toList.length = M.size)]
  refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun k _ => ?_)
  congr 2

name: meshIntersect_toList_eq
statement:
theorem meshIntersect_toList_eq (M₁ M₂ : Mesh) (hg₁ : Proof.MeshIntersectNpo.GenWF M₁) (hg₂ : Proof.MeshIntersectNpo.GenWF M₂) :
    (meshIntersect M₁ M₂).toList
      = (outNc M₁ M₂).toList ++ (outCop M₁ M₂).toList
proof:
:= by
  rw [Proof.MeshIntersectNpo.meshIntersect_eq M₁ M₂ hg₁ hg₂, keptGen_eq_buckets, outNc, outCop]
  rw [Proof.MeshIntersectClipBridge.toList_flatMap_arr,
    Proof.MeshIntersectClipBridge.toList_flatMap_arr,
    Proof.MeshIntersectClipBridge.toList_flatMap_arr,
    Array.toList_map, Array.toList_map, Array.toList_map,
    Array.toList_append, List.map_append, List.flatMap_append]

name: outCop_outNc_jump_eq_out
statement:
theorem outCop_outNc_jump_eq_out (M₁ M₂ : Mesh) (hg₁ : Proof.MeshIntersectNpo.GenWF M₁) (hg₂ : Proof.MeshIntersectNpo.GenWF M₂)
    (Q : Point) (v : ℚ) :
    stepJumpAt (meshSteps (outCop M₁ M₂) Q) v
        + stepJumpAt (meshSteps (outNc M₁ M₂) Q) v
      = stepJumpAt (meshSteps (meshIntersect M₁ M₂) Q) v
proof:
:= by
  rw [stepJumpAt_meshSteps_list, stepJumpAt_meshSteps_list, stepJumpAt_meshSteps_list,
    meshIntersect_toList_eq M₁ M₂ hg₁ hg₂, List.map_append, List.sum_append]
  ring

name: stepLeft_eq_stepSum
statement:
theorem stepLeft_eq_stepSum {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι]
    (S : ι → ℚ × ℤ) (v : ℚ) :
    Proof.MeshIntersectStep.stepLeft S v = Proof.MeshIntersectStep.stepSum S v
proof:
:= by
  classical
  rw [Proof.MeshIntersectStep.stepLeft, Proof.MeshIntersectStep.stepSum,
    Finset.sum_filter]
  refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun k _ => ?_)
  rw [Proof.MeshIntersectStep.stepIndicator]
  by_cases h : v ≤ (S k).1 <;> simp [h]

name: gap_above_exists
statement:
theorem gap_above_exists {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι] (S : ι → ℚ × ℤ) (v : ℚ) :
    ∃ μ : ℚ, v < μ ∧ ∀ k, v < (S k).1 → μ ≤ (S k).1
proof:
:= by
  classical
  set T : Finset ι := Finset.univ.filter (fun k => v < (S k).1) with hT
  rcases T.eq_empty_or_nonempty with he | hne
  · refine ⟨v + 1, by linarith, fun k hk => ?_⟩
    exact absurd (Finset.mem_filter.mpr ⟨Finset.mem_univ k, hk⟩) (by rw [← hT, he]; simp)
  · 
    obtain ⟨k₀, hk₀mem, hk₀min⟩ := T.exists_min_image (fun k => (S k).1) hne
    have hk₀v : v < (S k₀).1 := (Finset.mem_filter.mp hk₀mem).2
    refine ⟨(v + (S k₀).1) / 2, by linarith, fun k hk => ?_⟩
    have hkmem : k ∈ T := Finset.mem_filter.mpr ⟨Finset.mem_univ k, hk⟩
    have := hk₀min k hkmem
    linarith

name: stepRight_eq_stepSum_gap
proof:
:= by
  classical
  rw [Proof.MeshIntersectStep.stepRight, Proof.MeshIntersectStep.stepSum,
    Finset.sum_filter]
  refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun k _ => ?_)
  rw [Proof.MeshIntersectStep.stepIndicator]
  by_cases h : v < (S k).1
  · rw [if_pos h, if_pos (hgap k h), mul_one]
  · rw [if_neg h]
    rw [if_neg (by push_neg at h ⊢; linarith), mul_zero]

name: gap_below_exists
statement:
theorem gap_below_exists {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι] (S : ι → ℚ × ℤ) (v : ℚ) :
    ∃ μ : ℚ, μ < v ∧ ∀ k, (S k).1 < v → (S k).1 < μ
proof:
:= by
  classical
  set T : Finset ι := Finset.univ.filter (fun k => (S k).1 < v) with hT
  rcases T.eq_empty_or_nonempty with he | hne
  · refine ⟨v - 1, by linarith, fun k hk => ?_⟩
    exact absurd (Finset.mem_filter.mpr ⟨Finset.mem_univ k, hk⟩) (by rw [← hT, he]; simp)
  · 
    obtain ⟨k₀, hk₀mem, hk₀max⟩ := T.exists_max_image (fun k => (S k).1) hne
    have hk₀v : (S k₀).1 < v := (Finset.mem_filter.mp hk₀mem).2
    refine ⟨((S k₀).1 + v) / 2, by linarith, fun k hk => ?_⟩
    have hkmem : k ∈ T := Finset.mem_filter.mpr ⟨Finset.mem_univ k, hk⟩
    have := hk₀max k hkmem
    linarith

name: stepSum_below_gap
proof:
:= by
  classical
  rw [Proof.MeshIntersectStep.stepSum, Proof.MeshIntersectStep.stepSum]
  refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun k _ => ?_)
  rw [Proof.MeshIntersectStep.stepIndicator, Proof.MeshIntersectStep.stepIndicator]
  by_cases h : v ≤ (S k).1
  · rw [if_pos h, if_pos (by linarith)]
  · push_neg at h
    rw [if_neg (by push_neg; exact h),
      if_neg (by push_neg; exact hgap k h)]

name: stepJumpAt_meshSteps_eq_winding_diff
statement:
theorem stepJumpAt_meshSteps_eq_winding_diff (M : Mesh) {Q : Point}
    (hM : NoPlaneThroughOrigin M)
    (hQ : ∀ j : Fin M.size, dotQ (carrierNormal M[j]) Q ≠ 0)
    {v μ : ℚ} (hv : 0 < v) (hμ : v < μ)
    (hgap : ∀ k, v < (meshSteps M Q k).1 → μ ≤ (meshSteps M Q k).1) :
    stepJumpAt (meshSteps M Q) v
      = winding (meshChain M) (v • Q) - winding (meshChain M) (μ • Q)
proof:
:= by
  rw [stepJumpAt_eq_left_sub_right, stepLeft_eq_stepSum,
    stepRight_eq_stepSum_gap (meshSteps M Q) hμ hgap,
    winding_radial_step M hM hQ hv, winding_radial_step M hM hQ (lt_trans hv hμ)]

name: list_sum_map_sub
statement:
theorem list_sum_map_sub {α G : Type*} [AddCommGroup G] (l : List α) (f g : α → G) :
    (l.map f).sum - (l.map g).sum = (l.map (fun a => f a - g a)).sum
proof:
:= by
  induction l with
  | nil => simp
  | cons a l ih => simp only [List.map_cons, List.sum_cons]; rw [← ih]; abel

name: frag_winding_diff_eq_jump
statement:
theorem frag_winding_diff_eq_jump (M₁ M₂ : Mesh) {s : Triangle} {f : Frag}
    (hdetA : detOrigin s ≠ 0)
    (hinv : FragInv (carrierNormal s) (detOrigin s) f)
    {Q : Point} (hQ : dotQ (carrierNormal s) Q ≠ 0)
    {v μ : ℚ} (hv : 0 < v) (hvμ : v < μ)
    (hgap : v < Proof.MeshIntersectStep.faceParam s Q
      → μ ≤ Proof.MeshIntersectStep.faceParam s Q)
    (hvs : ∀ w ∈ (Proof.MeshIntersectNpo.vsGen M₁ M₂).toList,
      Proof.MeshIntersectBridge.repr4 w.h (P3.toPoint w.p))
    (hnd : (Proof.MeshIntersectNpo.vsGen M₁ M₂).toList.Pairwise (fun u v => u.p ≠ v.p))
    (hσ : ∀ k : Fin (atomizeFrag (Proof.MeshIntersectNpo.vsGen M₁ M₂) f).poly.size,
      Proof.MeshIntersectClip.areaForm (carrierNormal s)
        (fanApex (fragCycle (atomizeFrag (Proof.MeshIntersectNpo.vsGen M₁ M₂) f)))
        (fragCycle (atomizeFrag (Proof.MeshIntersectNpo.vsGen M₁ M₂) f) k)
        (Proof.MeshIntersectStep.faceHit s Q) ≠ 0) :
    winding (meshChain (emitFrag (atomizeFrag (Proof.MeshIntersectNpo.vsGen M₁ M₂) f))) (v • Q)
        - winding (meshChain (emitFrag (atomizeFrag (Proof.MeshIntersectNpo.vsGen M₁ M₂) f))) (μ • Q)
      = fragJumpAt s f Q v
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have hμ0 : 0 < μ := lt_trans hv hvμ
  rw [Proof.MeshIntersectCopDelta.cop_emit_jump_scaled _ hvs hnd hdetA hinv hQ hv hσ,
    Proof.MeshIntersectCopDelta.cop_emit_jump_scaled _ hvs hnd hdetA hinv hQ hμ0 hσ,
    fragJumpAt]
  
  set ι : ℤ := if Proof.MeshIntersectStep.faceHit s Q
      ∈ Proof.MeshIntersectClip.vpoly (fragCycle f) then 1 else 0
    with hι
  set μs : ℚ := Proof.MeshIntersectStep.faceParam s Q with hμs
  have hstep : (orientSign s * (if v ≤ μs then 1 else 0)) * ι
        - (orientSign s * (if μ ≤ μs then 1 else 0)) * ι
      = (orientSign s * (if μs = v then 1 else 0)) * ι := by
    by_cases hvle : v ≤ μs
    · by_cases hμle : μ ≤ μs
      · 
        rw [if_pos hvle, if_pos hμle, if_neg (by intro h; rw [h] at hμle; linarith)]
        ring
      · 
        
        have hμseqv : μs = v := by
          rcases lt_or_eq_of_le hvle with hlt | heq
          · exact absurd (hgap hlt) hμle
          · exact heq.symm
        rw [if_pos hvle, if_neg hμle, if_pos hμseqv]; ring
    · 
      have hμltv : μs < v := lt_of_not_le hvle
      rw [if_neg hvle, if_neg (by intro h; linarith), if_neg (by intro h; rw [h] at hμltv; linarith)]
      ring
  rw [hstep]

name: oppCarrier_copB
statement:
private theorem oppCarrier_copB {M₁ M₂ : Mesh} (h₂ : NoPlaneThroughOrigin M₂)
    {nt : Point} {ct : ℚ} {fa : Frag} {i : ℕ} (hi : i < M₁.size)
    (hdetA : detOrigin (M₁[i]'hi) ≠ 0)
    (_hInv : FragInv (carrierNormal (M₁[i]'hi)) (detOrigin (M₁[i]'hi)) fa)
    (hpl : fa.plane = (faceSOf (M₁[i]'hi)).plane)
    (hntct : nt = carrierNormal (M₁[i]'hi) ∧ ct = detOrigin (M₁[i]'hi)) :
    Proof.MeshIntersectResolveNear.OppCarrier nt ct fa.plane
      (splitCoplanar (Proof.MeshIntersectNsi.fragsBOf M₁ M₂) (materialize M₁)).1
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨hnt, hct⟩ := hntct; subst hnt; subst hct
  intro fb hfb
  obtain ⟨j, hj, hfbInv, hdetB, hfbpl, -⟩ := Proof.MeshIntersectNsi.copB_carrier h₂ hfb
  refine ⟨carrierNormal (M₂[j]'hj), detOrigin (M₂[j]'hj), hfbInv, fun hcop => ?_⟩
  rw [hpl, hfbpl] at hcop
  obtain ⟨ρ, hρ, hnρ, hcρ⟩ :=
    Proof.MeshIntersectNsi.coplanar_carrier_prop hdetA hdetB hcop
  exact ⟨ρ, hρ, hnρ, hcρ⟩

name: keptCop_eq
statement:
theorem keptCop_eq (M₁ M₂ : Mesh) (h₁ : NoPlaneThroughOrigin M₁) (h₂ : NoPlaneThroughOrigin M₂) :
    keptCop M₁ M₂ = keptCopA M₁ M₂ ++ keptCopB M₁ M₂
proof:
:= by
  rw [keptCop, keptCopA, keptCopB,
    Proof.MeshIntersectResolveNear.resolveCoplanar_eq_full]
  · 
    intro fa hfa
    obtain ⟨i, hi, hfaInv, hdetA, hfapl, -⟩ := Proof.MeshIntersectNsi.copA_carrier h₁ hfa
    exact ⟨carrierNormal (M₁[i]'hi), detOrigin (M₁[i]'hi), hfaInv,
      oppCarrier_copB h₂ hi hdetA hfaInv hfapl ⟨rfl, rfl⟩⟩
  · 
    intro fb hfb
    obtain ⟨j, hj, hfbInv, hdetB, hfbpl, -⟩ := Proof.MeshIntersectNsi.copB_carrier h₂ hfb
    exact ⟨carrierNormal (M₂[j]'hj), detOrigin (M₂[j]'hj), hfbInv,
      oppCarrier_copA h₁ hj hdetB hfbInv hfbpl ⟨rfl, rfl⟩⟩

name: sum_keptNcA_per_face
statement:
theorem sum_keptNcA_per_face (M₁ M₂ : Mesh) (F : Frag → ℤ) :
    ((keptNcA M₁ M₂).toList.map F).sum
      = ((List.range (materialize M₁).size).map (fun i =>
          ((keptNcFaceA M₁ M₂ i).toList.map F).sum)).sum
proof:
:= by
  simp only [keptNcFaceA]
  rw [keptNcA, show (classify ((splitCoplanar
        ((Array.range (materialize M₁).size).flatMap (fun i =>
          clipFaceScoped (fragOfFace ((materialize M₁).getD i default))
            (planesForScoped ((materialize M₁).getD i default).plane (materialize M₂)
              ((candP M₁ M₂).getD i #[]))))
        (materialize M₂)).2)
      (prepare (materialize M₂)))
      = (((Array.range (materialize M₁).size).flatMap (fun i =>
          clipFaceScoped (fragOfFace ((materialize M₁).getD i default))
            (planesForScoped ((materialize M₁).getD i default).plane (materialize M₂)
              ((candP M₁ M₂).getD i #[])))).filter
        (fun a => keepFragB (faceBVH (prepare (materialize M₂))) (prepare (materialize M₂)) a
          && (fun f => !(isCoplanarWith f (materialize M₂))) a)) from by
    rw [classify, splitCoplanar, Array.filter_filter]; rfl]
  rw [Proof.MeshIntersectGerm.sum_classify_flatMap]
  refine congrArg List.sum (List.map_congr_left ?_)
  intro i _
  rw [classify, Array.filter_filter]

proof:

  rw [keptNcB, show (classify ((splitCoplanar
        ((Array.range (materialize M₂).size).flatMap (fun j =>
          clipFaceScoped (fragOfFace ((materialize M₂).getD j default))
            (planesForScoped ((materialize M₂).getD j default).plane (materialize M₁)
              ((candP M₂ M₁).getD j #[]))))
        (materialize M₁)).2)
      (prepare (materialize M₁)))
      = (((Array.range (materialize M₂).size).flatMap (fun j =>
          clipFaceScoped (fragOfFace ((materialize M₂).getD j default))
            (planesForScoped ((materialize M₂).getD j default).plane (materialize M₁)
              ((candP M₂ M₁).getD j #[])))).filter
        (fun a => keepFragB (faceBVH (prepare (materialize M₁))) (prepare (materialize M₁)) a
          && (fun f => !(isCoplanarWith f (materialize M₁))) a)) from by
    rw [classify, splitCoplanar, Array.filter_filter]; rfl]
  rw [Proof.MeshIntersectGerm.sum_classify_flatMap]
  refine congrArg List.sum (List.map_congr_left ?_)
  intro j _

name: sum_keptCopA_per_face
statement:

      = ((List.range (materialize M₁).size).map (fun i =>
          ((copDescA M₁ M₂ i).toList.map F).sum)).sum
proof:
:= by
  simp only [copDescA]
  rw [keptCopA]
  
  rw [show (splitCoplanar
        ((Array.range (materialize M₁).size).flatMap (fun i =>
          clipFaceScoped (fragOfFace ((materialize M₁).getD i default))
            (planesForScoped ((materialize M₁).getD i default).plane (materialize M₂)

          (clipFaceScoped (fragOfFace ((materialize M₁).getD i default))
            (planesForScoped ((materialize M₁).getD i default).plane (materialize M₂)
              ((candP M₁ M₂).getD i #[]))).filter
            (fun f => isCoplanarWith f (materialize M₂)))) from by

              ((candP M₂ M₁).getD j #[]))))
        (materialize M₁)).1
      = ((Array.range (materialize M₂).size).flatMap (fun j =>
          (clipFaceScoped (fragOfFace ((materialize M₂).getD j default))
            (planesForScoped ((materialize M₂).getD j default).plane (materialize M₁)

name: sum_keptGen_per_parent
statement:
theorem sum_keptGen_per_parent (M₁ M₂ : Mesh) (h₁ : NoPlaneThroughOrigin M₁)
    (h₂ : NoPlaneThroughOrigin M₂) (F : Frag → ℤ) :
    ((Proof.MeshIntersectNpo.keptGen M₁ M₂).toList.map F).sum
      = ((List.range M₁.size).map (fun i => ((keptFaceA M₁ M₂ i).toList.map F).sum)).sum
        + ((List.range M₂.size).map (fun j => ((keptFaceB M₁ M₂ j).toList.map F).sum)).sum
proof:
:= by
  classical
  rw [keptGen_eq_buckets, Array.toList_append, Array.toList_append,
    List.map_append, List.map_append, List.sum_append, List.sum_append]
  rw [show (keptCop M₁ M₂).toList = (keptCopA M₁ M₂ ++ keptCopB M₁ M₂).toList from by
    rw [keptCop_eq M₁ M₂ h₁ h₂],
    Array.toList_append, List.map_append, List.sum_append]
  
  rw [sum_keptNcA_per_face, sum_keptNcB_per_face, sum_keptCopA_per_face, sum_keptCopB_per_face]
  simp only [materialize_size]
  
  have hA : ((List.range M₁.size).map (fun i => ((keptFaceA M₁ M₂ i).toList.map F).sum)).sum
      = ((List.range M₁.size).map (fun i => ((keptNcFaceA M₁ M₂ i).toList.map F).sum)).sum
        + ((List.range M₁.size).map (fun i => ((copDescA M₁ M₂ i).toList.map F).sum)).sum := by
    rw [← list_sum_map_add]
    refine congrArg List.sum (List.map_congr_left ?_)
    intro i _
    rw [keptFaceA, keptNcFaceA, Array.toList_append, List.map_append, List.sum_append]
  have hB : ((List.range M₂.size).map (fun j => ((keptFaceB M₁ M₂ j).toList.map F).sum)).sum
      = ((List.range M₂.size).map (fun j => ((keptNcFaceB M₁ M₂ j).toList.map F).sum)).sum
        + ((List.range M₂.size).map (fun j => ((copDescB M₁ M₂ j).toList.map F).sum)).sum := by
    rw [← list_sum_map_add]
    refine congrArg List.sum (List.map_congr_left ?_)
    intro j _
    rw [keptFaceB, keptNcFaceB, Array.toList_append, List.map_append, List.sum_append]
  rw [hA, hB]
  
  generalize ((List.range M₁.size).map (fun i => ((keptNcFaceA M₁ M₂ i).toList.map F).sum)).sum = a
  generalize ((List.range M₂.size).map (fun j => ((keptNcFaceB M₁ M₂ j).toList.map F).sum)).sum = b
  generalize ((List.range M₁.size).map (fun i => ((copDescA M₁ M₂ i).toList.map F).sum)).sum = c
  generalize ((List.range M₂.size).map (fun j => ((copDescB M₁ M₂ j).toList.map F).sum)).sum = d
  abel
