name: block_jump_collapse
statement:
theorem block_jump_collapse (M₁ M₂ : Mesh) {s : Triangle} (block : Array Frag) {Q : Point}
    (hdet : detOrigin s ≠ 0) (hQ : dotQ (carrierNormal s) Q ≠ 0)
    {v μ : ℚ} (hv : 0 < v) (hvμ : v < μ)
    (hgap : v < Proof.MeshIntersectStep.faceParam s Q
      → μ ≤ Proof.MeshIntersectStep.faceParam s Q)
    (hvs : ∀ w ∈ (Proof.MeshIntersectNpo.vsGen M₁ M₂).toList,
      Proof.MeshIntersectBridge.repr4 w.h (P3.toPoint w.p))
    (hnd : (Proof.MeshIntersectNpo.vsGen M₁ M₂).toList.Pairwise (fun u v => u.p ≠ v.p))
    (hinv : ∀ f ∈ block, FragInv (carrierNormal s) (detOrigin s) f)
    (hσ : ∀ f ∈ block, ∀ k : Fin (atomizeFrag (Proof.MeshIntersectNpo.vsGen M₁ M₂) f).poly.size,
      Proof.MeshIntersectClip.areaForm (carrierNormal s)
        (fanApex (fragCycle (atomizeFrag (Proof.MeshIntersectNpo.vsGen M₁ M₂) f)))
        (fragCycle (atomizeFrag (Proof.MeshIntersectNpo.vsGen M₁ M₂) f) k)
        (Proof.MeshIntersectStep.faceHit s Q) ≠ 0) :
    (block.toList.map (fragDiff M₁ M₂ Q v μ)).sum = faceCopNcJump s block Q v
proof:
:= by
  classical
  
  have hmap : (block.toList.map (fragDiff M₁ M₂ Q v μ)).sum
      = (block.toList.map (fun f => fragJumpAt s f Q v)).sum := by
    refine congrArg List.sum (List.map_congr_left ?_)
    intro f hf
    have hfmem : f ∈ block := Array.mem_def.mpr hf
    rw [fragDiff]
    exact frag_winding_diff_eq_jump M₁ M₂ hdet (hinv f hfmem) hQ hv hvμ hgap hvs hnd
      (hσ f hfmem)
  rw [hmap, faceCopNcJump]
  
  rw [← list_sum_map_const_mul]
  refine congrArg List.sum (List.map_congr_left ?_)
  intro f _
  rw [fragJumpAt]

name: list_range_sum_eq_fin_sum
statement:
theorem list_range_sum_eq_fin_sum {n : ℕ} (G : ℕ → ℤ) (H : Fin n → ℤ)
    (hGH : ∀ i : Fin n, G i.1 = H i) :
    ((List.range n).map G).sum = ∑ i : Fin n, H i
proof:
:= by
  rw [Proof.MeshIntersectAbel.sum_map_eq_finSum (List.range n) G]
  rw [← Fin.sum_congr' (fun k : Fin n => H k) (List.length_range (n := n))]
  refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun k _ => ?_)
  have := hGH (Fin.cast (List.length_range (n := n)) k)
  simpa using this

name: out_stepJump_eq_winding_diff
statement:
theorem out_stepJump_eq_winding_diff (M₁ M₂ : Mesh)
    (h₁ : Legacy.WellFormedMesh M₁) (h₂ : Legacy.WellFormedMesh M₂)
    {Q : Point} (hG : Gen M₁ M₂ Q) {v μ : ℚ} (hv : 0 < v) (hμ : v < μ)
    (hgap : ∀ k, v < (meshSteps (meshIntersect M₁ M₂) Q k).1
      → μ ≤ (meshSteps (meshIntersect M₁ M₂) Q k).1) :
    stepJumpAt (meshSteps (meshIntersect M₁ M₂) Q) v
      = winding (meshChain (meshIntersect M₁ M₂)) (v • Q)
        - winding (meshChain (meshIntersect M₁ M₂)) (μ • Q)
proof:
:= by
  apply stepJumpAt_meshSteps_eq_winding_diff (meshIntersect M₁ M₂)
    (Proof.MeshIntersectNpo.meshIntersect_noPlaneThroughOrigin M₁ M₂ h₁ h₂)
    ?_ hv hμ hgap
  intro j
  apply out_carrier_ne_of_mem M₁ M₂ h₁.2.2.2 h₂.2.2.2
    (Proof.MeshIntersectNpo.GenWF.of_legacy h₁) (Proof.MeshIntersectNpo.GenWF.of_legacy h₂) hG
  exact Array.getElem_mem j.isLt

name: gap_above_exists
statement:
theorem gap_above_exists₃ {ι₀ ι₁ ι₂ : Type*} [Fintype ι₀] [Fintype ι₁] [Fintype ι₂]
    (S₀ : ι₀ → ℚ × ℤ) (S₁ : ι₁ → ℚ × ℤ) (S₂ : ι₂ → ℚ × ℤ) (v : ℚ) :
    ∃ μ : ℚ, v < μ
      ∧ (∀ k, v < (S₀ k).1 → μ ≤ (S₀ k).1)
      ∧ (∀ k, v < (S₁ k).1 → μ ≤ (S₁ k).1)
      ∧ (∀ k, v < (S₂ k).1 → μ ≤ (S₂ k).1)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨μ₀, hμ₀, hg₀⟩ := gap_above_exists S₀ v
  obtain ⟨μ₁, hμ₁, hg₁⟩ := gap_above_exists S₁ v
  obtain ⟨μ₂, hμ₂, hg₂⟩ := gap_above_exists S₂ v
  refine ⟨min μ₀ (min μ₁ μ₂), by simp only [lt_min_iff]; exact ⟨hμ₀, hμ₁, hμ₂⟩, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · exact fun k hk => le_trans (min_le_left _ _) (hg₀ k hk)
  · exact fun k hk => le_trans (le_trans (min_le_right _ _) (min_le_left _ _)) (hg₁ k hk)
  · exact fun k hk => le_trans (le_trans (min_le_right _ _) (min_le_right _ _)) (hg₂ k hk)

name: keptFaceA_jump_collapse
statement:
theorem keptFaceA_jump_collapse (M₁ M₂ : Mesh)
    (h₁ : Legacy.WellFormedMesh M₁) (_h₂ : Legacy.WellFormedMesh M₂)
    {Q : Point} (hG : Gen M₁ M₂ Q) {v μ : ℚ} (hv : 0 < v) (hvμ : v < μ)
    (hgap : ∀ i : Fin M₁.size, v < Proof.MeshIntersectStep.faceParam M₁[i] Q
      → μ ≤ Proof.MeshIntersectStep.faceParam M₁[i] Q)
    (hvs : ∀ w ∈ (Proof.MeshIntersectNpo.vsGen M₁ M₂).toList,
      Proof.MeshIntersectBridge.repr4 w.h (P3.toPoint w.p))
    (hnd : (Proof.MeshIntersectNpo.vsGen M₁ M₂).toList.Pairwise (fun u v => u.p ≠ v.p))
    (i : Fin M₁.size) :
    ((keptFaceA M₁ M₂ i.1).toList.map (fragDiff M₁ M₂ Q v μ)).sum
      = faceCopNcJump M₁[i] (keptFaceA M₁ M₂ i.1) Q v
proof:
:= by
  have hdet : detOrigin M₁[i] ≠ 0 := h₁.2.2.2 i
  have hQ : dotQ (carrierNormal M₁[i]) Q ≠ 0 := hG.1 i
  have hbase : FragInv (carrierNormal M₁[i]) (detOrigin M₁[i])
      (fragOfFace ((materialize M₁).getD i.1 default)) := by
    rw [show (materialize M₁).getD i.1 default = faceSOf M₁[i] from by
      rw [getD_eq_getElem (materialize M₁) (by rw [materialize_size]; exact i.isLt) default,
        materialize_getElem M₁ i.1 i.isLt]; rfl]
    exact Proof.MeshIntersectKeep.fragInv_base hdet
  
  have hhit : Proof.MeshIntersectStep.faceHit M₁[i] Q
      = (detOrigin M₁[i] / dotQ (carrierNormal M₁[i]) Q) • Q := rfl
  
  have hinvNc : ∀ f ∈ keptNcFaceA M₁ M₂ i.1,
      FragInv (carrierNormal M₁[i]) (detOrigin M₁[i]) f :=
    fun f hf => fragInv_clipFaceScoped hbase _ (keptNcFaceA_mem_clipFace M₁ M₂ i.1 hf)
  
  have hinvCop : ∀ f ∈ copDescA M₁ M₂ i.1,
      FragInv (carrierNormal M₁[i]) (detOrigin M₁[i]) f :=
    fun f hf => copDescA_fragInv M₁ M₂ i.1 hbase hf
  
  have hσNc : ∀ f ∈ keptNcFaceA M₁ M₂ i.1,
      ∀ k : Fin (atomizeFrag (Proof.MeshIntersectNpo.vsGen M₁ M₂) f).poly.size,
        Proof.MeshIntersectClip.areaForm (carrierNormal M₁[i])
          (fanApex (fragCycle (atomizeFrag (Proof.MeshIntersectNpo.vsGen M₁ M₂) f)))
          (fragCycle (atomizeFrag (Proof.MeshIntersectNpo.vsGen M₁ M₂) f) k)
          (Proof.MeshIntersectStep.faceHit M₁[i] Q) ≠ 0 := by
    intro f hf
    rw [hhit]
    exact hG.2.2.2.2.2.1 i hQ f (keptNcFaceA_mem_clipFace M₁ M₂ i.1 hf)
  
  have hσCop : ∀ f ∈ copDescA M₁ M₂ i.1,
      ∀ k : Fin (atomizeFrag (Proof.MeshIntersectNpo.vsGen M₁ M₂) f).poly.size,
        Proof.MeshIntersectClip.areaForm (carrierNormal M₁[i])
          (fanApex (fragCycle (atomizeFrag (Proof.MeshIntersectNpo.vsGen M₁ M₂) f)))
          (fragCycle (atomizeFrag (Proof.MeshIntersectNpo.vsGen M₁ M₂) f) k)
          (Proof.MeshIntersectStep.faceHit M₁[i] Q) ≠ 0 := by
    rw [hhit]
    exact gen_kept_hsigma₁ hG i hQ
  
  rw [show keptFaceA M₁ M₂ i.1 = keptNcFaceA M₁ M₂ i.1 ++ copDescA M₁ M₂ i.1 from rfl]
  exact block_jump_collapse M₁ M₂ (keptNcFaceA M₁ M₂ i.1 ++ copDescA M₁ M₂ i.1)
    hdet hQ hv hvμ (hgap i) hvs hnd
    (forall_mem_append_arr hinvNc hinvCop)
    (forall_mem_append_arr hσNc hσCop)

name: keptFaceB_jump_collapse
statement:
theorem keptFaceB_jump_collapse (M₁ M₂ : Mesh)
    (_h₁ : Legacy.WellFormedMesh M₁) (h₂ : Legacy.WellFormedMesh M₂)
    {Q : Point} (hG : Gen M₁ M₂ Q) {v μ : ℚ} (hv : 0 < v) (hvμ : v < μ)
    (hgap : ∀ j : Fin M₂.size, v < Proof.MeshIntersectStep.faceParam M₂[j] Q
      → μ ≤ Proof.MeshIntersectStep.faceParam M₂[j] Q)
    (hvs : ∀ w ∈ (Proof.MeshIntersectNpo.vsGen M₁ M₂).toList,
      Proof.MeshIntersectBridge.repr4 w.h (P3.toPoint w.p))
    (hnd : (Proof.MeshIntersectNpo.vsGen M₁ M₂).toList.Pairwise (fun u v => u.p ≠ v.p))
    (j : Fin M₂.size) :
    ((keptFaceB M₁ M₂ j.1).toList.map (fragDiff M₁ M₂ Q v μ)).sum
      = faceCopNcJump M₂[j] (keptFaceB M₁ M₂ j.1) Q v
proof:
:= by
  have hdet : detOrigin M₂[j] ≠ 0 := h₂.2.2.2 j
  have hQ : dotQ (carrierNormal M₂[j]) Q ≠ 0 := hG.2.1 j
  have hbase : FragInv (carrierNormal M₂[j]) (detOrigin M₂[j])
      (fragOfFace ((materialize M₂).getD j.1 default)) := by
    rw [show (materialize M₂).getD j.1 default = faceSOf M₂[j] from by
      rw [getD_eq_getElem (materialize M₂) (by rw [materialize_size]; exact j.isLt) default,
        materialize_getElem M₂ j.1 j.isLt]; rfl]
    exact Proof.MeshIntersectKeep.fragInv_base hdet
  have hhit : Proof.MeshIntersectStep.faceHit M₂[j] Q
      = (detOrigin M₂[j] / dotQ (carrierNormal M₂[j]) Q) • Q := rfl
  have hinvNc : ∀ f ∈ keptNcFaceB M₁ M₂ j.1,
      FragInv (carrierNormal M₂[j]) (detOrigin M₂[j]) f :=
    fun f hf => fragInv_clipFaceScoped hbase _ (keptNcFaceB_mem_clipFace M₁ M₂ j.1 hf)
  have hinvCop : ∀ f ∈ copDescB M₁ M₂ j.1,
      FragInv (carrierNormal M₂[j]) (detOrigin M₂[j]) f :=
    fun f hf => copDescB_fragInv M₁ M₂ j.1 hbase hf
  have hσNc : ∀ f ∈ keptNcFaceB M₁ M₂ j.1,
      ∀ k : Fin (atomizeFrag (Proof.MeshIntersectNpo.vsGen M₁ M₂) f).poly.size,
        Proof.MeshIntersectClip.areaForm (carrierNormal M₂[j])
          (fanApex (fragCycle (atomizeFrag (Proof.MeshIntersectNpo.vsGen M₁ M₂) f)))
          (fragCycle (atomizeFrag (Proof.MeshIntersectNpo.vsGen M₁ M₂) f) k)
          (Proof.MeshIntersectStep.faceHit M₂[j] Q) ≠ 0 := by
    intro f hf
    rw [hhit]
    exact hG.2.2.2.2.2.2.1 j hQ f (keptNcFaceB_mem_clipFace M₁ M₂ j.1 hf)
  have hσCop : ∀ f ∈ copDescB M₁ M₂ j.1,
      ∀ k : Fin (atomizeFrag (Proof.MeshIntersectNpo.vsGen M₁ M₂) f).poly.size,
        Proof.MeshIntersectClip.areaForm (carrierNormal M₂[j])
          (fanApex (fragCycle (atomizeFrag (Proof.MeshIntersectNpo.vsGen M₁ M₂) f)))
          (fragCycle (atomizeFrag (Proof.MeshIntersectNpo.vsGen M₁ M₂) f) k)
          (Proof.MeshIntersectStep.faceHit M₂[j] Q) ≠ 0 := by
    rw [hhit]
    exact gen_kept_hsigma₂ hG j hQ
  rw [show keptFaceB M₁ M₂ j.1 = keptNcFaceB M₁ M₂ j.1 ++ copDescB M₁ M₂ j.1 from rfl]
  exact block_jump_collapse M₁ M₂ (keptNcFaceB M₁ M₂ j.1 ++ copDescB M₁ M₂ j.1)
    hdet hQ hv hvμ (hgap j) hvs hnd
    (forall_mem_append_arr hinvNc hinvCop)
    (forall_mem_append_arr hσNc hσCop)

name: out_jump_regroup_by_parent
statement:
theorem out_jump_regroup_by_parent (M₁ M₂ : Mesh)
    (h₁ : Legacy.WellFormedMesh M₁) (h₂ : Legacy.WellFormedMesh M₂)
    {Q : Point} (hG : Gen M₁ M₂ Q) {v : ℚ} (hv : 0 < v) :
    stepJumpAt (meshSteps (meshIntersect M₁ M₂) Q) v
      = (∑ i : Fin M₁.size, faceCopNcJump M₁[i] (keptFaceA M₁ M₂ i.1) Q v)
        + (∑ j : Fin M₂.size, faceCopNcJump M₂[j] (keptFaceB M₁ M₂ j.1) Q v)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have h1npo : NoPlaneThroughOrigin M₁ := h₁.2.2.2
  have h2npo : NoPlaneThroughOrigin M₂ := h₂.2.2.2
  obtain ⟨hvs, hnd⟩ := Proof.MeshIntersectNpo.vsGen_facts h1npo h2npo
  
  obtain ⟨μ, hvμ, hgapOut, hgap1, hgap2⟩ := gap_above_exists₃
    (meshSteps (meshIntersect M₁ M₂) Q) (meshSteps M₁ Q) (meshSteps M₂ Q) v
  
  have hgapFace1 : ∀ i : Fin M₁.size, v < Proof.MeshIntersectStep.faceParam M₁[i] Q
      → μ ≤ Proof.MeshIntersectStep.faceParam M₁[i] Q := fun i => hgap1 i
  have hgapFace2 : ∀ j : Fin M₂.size, v < Proof.MeshIntersectStep.faceParam M₂[j] Q
      → μ ≤ Proof.MeshIntersectStep.faceParam M₂[j] Q := fun j => hgap2 j
  
  rw [out_stepJump_eq_winding_diff M₁ M₂ h₁ h₂ hG hv hvμ hgapOut,
    winding_gen_eq_bucket M₁ M₂ (Proof.MeshIntersectNpo.GenWF.of_legacy h₁)
      (Proof.MeshIntersectNpo.GenWF.of_legacy h₂),
    winding_gen_eq_bucket M₁ M₂ (Proof.MeshIntersectNpo.GenWF.of_legacy h₁)
      (Proof.MeshIntersectNpo.GenWF.of_legacy h₂), bucketWinding, bucketWinding,
    list_sum_map_sub]
  rw [show (fun f => winding (meshChain (emitFrag (atomizeFrag
            (Proof.MeshIntersectNpo.vsGen M₁ M₂) f))) (v • Q)
          - winding (meshChain (emitFrag (atomizeFrag
            (Proof.MeshIntersectNpo.vsGen M₁ M₂) f))) (μ • Q))
        = fragDiff M₁ M₂ Q v μ from rfl]
  rw [sum_keptGen_per_parent M₁ M₂ h1npo h2npo (fragDiff M₁ M₂ Q v μ)]
  
  congr 1
  · exact list_range_sum_eq_fin_sum
      (fun i => ((keptFaceA M₁ M₂ i).toList.map (fragDiff M₁ M₂ Q v μ)).sum)
      (fun i => faceCopNcJump M₁[i] (keptFaceA M₁ M₂ i.1) Q v)
      (fun i => keptFaceA_jump_collapse M₁ M₂ h₁ h₂ hG hv hvμ hgapFace1 hvs hnd i)
  · exact list_range_sum_eq_fin_sum
      (fun j => ((keptFaceB M₁ M₂ j).toList.map (fragDiff M₁ M₂ Q v μ)).sum)
      (fun j => faceCopNcJump M₂[j] (keptFaceB M₁ M₂ j.1) Q v)
      (fun j => keptFaceB_jump_collapse M₁ M₂ h₁ h₂ hG hv hvμ hgapFace2 hvs hnd j)

name: qsign_neg
statement: theorem qsign_neg (q : ℚ) : qsign (-q) = - qsign q
proof:
:= by
  unfold qsign
  rcases lt_trichotomy q 0 with h | h | h
  · rw [if_pos (show (0:ℚ) < -q by linarith), if_neg (show ¬ (0:ℚ) < q by linarith),
        if_pos h]
    norm_num
  · subst h; norm_num
  · rw [if_neg (show ¬ (0:ℚ) < -q by linarith), if_pos (show -q < (0:ℚ) by linarith),
        if_pos h]

name: qsign_of_pos
statement: theorem qsign_of_pos {q : ℚ} (h : 0 < q) : qsign q = 1
proof: := if_pos h

name: qsign_of_neg
statement: theorem qsign_of_neg {q : ℚ} (h : q < 0) : qsign q = -1
proof:
:= by
  unfold qsign; rw [if_neg (by linarith), if_pos h]

name: sign_stable
statement:
theorem sign_stable {c d : ℚ} (hc : c ≠ 0) (hlt : |d| < |c|) :
    ((0 < c + d ↔ 0 < c) ∧ c + d ≠ 0)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨h1, h2⟩ := abs_lt.mp hlt
  rcases hc.lt_or_lt with h | h
  · rw [abs_of_neg h] at h1 h2
    constructor
    · constructor <;> intro hh <;> linarith
    · intro hh; linarith
  · rw [abs_of_pos h] at h1 h2
    constructor
    · constructor <;> intro hh <;> linarith
    · intro hh; linarith

name: seg_zero
statement: theorem seg_zero (x y : Point) : seg x y 0 = x

name: seg_one

name: eval_seg
statement:
theorem eval_seg (g : Half) (x y : Point) (τ : ℚ) :

name: det3_eq_detOrigin
statement: theorem det3_eq_detOrigin (t : Triangle) : det3 t.v₀ t.v₁ t.v₂ = detOrigin t
proof:
:= by
  simp only [det3, dotQ, crossQ, mkPoint_zero, mkPoint_one, mkPoint_two, detOrigin]

name: orientSign_cases
statement:
theorem orientSign_cases {t : Triangle} (h : detOrigin t ≠ 0) :
    orientSign t = 1 ∨ orientSign t = -1
proof:
:= by
  unfold orientSign
  rcases h.lt_or_lt with hlt | hgt
  · right; rw [if_neg (by linarith), if_pos hlt]
  · left; rw [if_pos hgt]

name: dotQ_crossQ_swap
statement:
theorem dotQ_crossQ_swap (a b u : Point) :
    dotQ (crossQ a b) u = - dotQ (crossQ b a) u
proof:
:= by
  simp only [dotQ, crossQ, mkPoint_zero, mkPoint_one, mkPoint_two]
  ring

name: odd_sum_swap_invariant
proof:
:= by
  have h1 : (S.map J).sum = ((S.map Prod.swap).map J).sum := by
    conv_lhs => rw [hS]
  rw [Multiset.map_map] at h1
  have h2 : (S.map (J ∘ Prod.swap)).sum = (S.map (fun e => - J e)).sum := by
    apply congrArg
    apply Multiset.map_congr rfl
    intro e _
    exact hodd e
  have h3 : (S.map (fun e => - J e)).sum = - (S.map J).sum := by
    rw [← Multiset.sum_map_neg', Multiset.map_map]
    rfl
  have h4 : (S.map J).sum = - (S.map J).sum := h1.trans (h2.trans h3)
  omega

name: tetraHalves_size
statement: theorem tetraHalves_size (t : Triangle) : (tetraHalves t).size = 4
proof: := rfl

name: slot_mem
statement: theorem slot_mem (t : Triangle) (k : Fin 4) : slot t k ∈ tetraHalves t
proof:
:=
  Array.getElem_mem _

name: mem_tetraHalves_iff
statement:
theorem mem_tetraHalves_iff {t : Triangle} {g : Half} :
    g ∈ tetraHalves t ↔ ∃ k : Fin 4, g = slot t k
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro hg
    obtain ⟨n, hn, heq⟩ := Array.mem_iff_getElem.mp hg
    rw [tetraHalves_size] at hn
    exact ⟨⟨n, hn⟩, heq.symm⟩
  · rintro ⟨k, rfl⟩
    exact slot_mem t k

name: slotIdx_injective
statement: theorem slotIdx_injective : Function.Injective slotIdx

name: dotQ_neg_normal
statement:
theorem dotQ_neg_normal (n u : Point) :
    dotQ (psub (mkPoint 0 0 0) n) u = - dotQ n u
proof:
:= by
  simp only [dotQ, psub, mkPoint_zero, mkPoint_one, mkPoint_two]
  ring

name: slot0_lat
statement:
theorem slot0_lat {t : Triangle} (hdet : detOrigin t ≠ 0) (u : Point) :
    dotQ (slot t 0).n u = (orientSign t : ℚ) * dotQ (crossQ t.v₁ t.v₂) u
proof:
:= by
  have hb : dotQ (crossQ t.v₁ t.v₂) t.v₀ = detOrigin t := by
    rw [dotQ_crossQ_det, det3_eq_detOrigin]
  have hslot : slot t 0
      = (if 0 ≤ dotQ (crossQ t.v₁ t.v₂) t.v₀ then (⟨crossQ t.v₁ t.v₂, 0⟩ : Half)
         else Half.neg ⟨crossQ t.v₁ t.v₂, 0⟩) := rfl
  unfold orientSign
  rcases hdet.lt_or_lt with hlt | hgt
  · rw [hslot, if_neg (by rw [hb]; linarith), if_neg (by linarith), if_pos hlt]
    show dotQ (psub (mkPoint 0 0 0) (crossQ t.v₁ t.v₂)) u = _
    rw [dotQ_neg_normal]; push_cast; ring
  · rw [hslot, if_pos (by rw [hb]; linarith), if_pos hgt]
    push_cast; ring

name: slot1_lat
statement:
theorem slot1_lat {t : Triangle} (hdet : detOrigin t ≠ 0) (u : Point) :
    dotQ (slot t 1).n u = (orientSign t : ℚ) * dotQ (crossQ t.v₂ t.v₀) u
proof:
:= by
  have hb : dotQ (crossQ t.v₀ t.v₂) t.v₁ = - detOrigin t := by
    rw [dotQ_crossQ_det, ← det3_eq_detOrigin]
    simp only [det3_expand]; ring
  have hslot : slot t 1
      = (if 0 ≤ dotQ (crossQ t.v₀ t.v₂) t.v₁ then (⟨crossQ t.v₀ t.v₂, 0⟩ : Half)
         else Half.neg ⟨crossQ t.v₀ t.v₂, 0⟩) := rfl
  have hsw : dotQ (crossQ t.v₀ t.v₂) u = - dotQ (crossQ t.v₂ t.v₀) u :=
    dotQ_crossQ_swap _ _ _
  unfold orientSign
  rcases hdet.lt_or_lt with hlt | hgt
  · rw [hslot, if_pos (by rw [hb]; linarith), if_neg (by linarith), if_pos hlt]
    show dotQ (crossQ t.v₀ t.v₂) u = _
    rw [hsw]; push_cast; ring
  · rw [hslot, if_neg (by rw [hb]; linarith), if_pos hgt]
    show dotQ (psub (mkPoint 0 0 0) (crossQ t.v₀ t.v₂)) u = _
    rw [dotQ_neg_normal, hsw]; push_cast; ring

name: slot2_lat
statement:
theorem slot2_lat {t : Triangle} (hdet : detOrigin t ≠ 0) (u : Point) :
    dotQ (slot t 2).n u = (orientSign t : ℚ) * dotQ (crossQ t.v₀ t.v₁) u
proof:
:= by
  have hb : dotQ (crossQ t.v₀ t.v₁) t.v₂ = detOrigin t := by
    rw [dotQ_crossQ_det, ← det3_eq_detOrigin]
    simp only [det3_expand]; ring
  have hslot : slot t 2
      = (if 0 ≤ dotQ (crossQ t.v₀ t.v₁) t.v₂ then (⟨crossQ t.v₀ t.v₁, 0⟩ : Half)
         else Half.neg ⟨crossQ t.v₀ t.v₁, 0⟩) := rfl
  unfold orientSign
  rcases hdet.lt_or_lt with hlt | hgt
  · rw [hslot, if_neg (by rw [hb]; linarith), if_neg (by linarith), if_pos hlt]
    show dotQ (psub (mkPoint 0 0 0) (crossQ t.v₀ t.v₁)) u = _
    rw [dotQ_neg_normal]; push_cast; ring
  · rw [hslot, if_pos (by rw [hb]; linarith), if_pos hgt]
    push_cast; ring

name: slot_coord
statement:
theorem slot_coord {t : Triangle} (hdet : det3 t.v₀ t.v₁ t.v₂ ≠ 0)
    (b : AffineBasis (Fin 4) ℚ (Fin 3 → ℚ))
    (hbcoe : ⇑b = ![(0 : Point), t.v₀, t.v₁, t.v₂]) :
    ∀ k : Fin 4, ∃ lam : ℚ, 0 < lam ∧ gOf (slot t k) = lam • b.coord (slotIdx k)
proof:
:= by
  have hb0 : b 0 = (0 : Point) := by rw [hbcoe]; rfl
  have hb1 : b 1 = t.v₀ := by rw [hbcoe]; rfl
  have hb2 : b 2 = t.v₁ := by rw [hbcoe]; rfl
  have hb3 : b 3 = t.v₂ := by rw [hbcoe]; rfl
  intro k
  fin_cases k
  · 
    set n0 := crossQ t.v₁ t.v₂ with hn0
    have hg0 : slot t 0
        = (if 0 ≤ dotQ n0 t.v₀ then (⟨n0, 0⟩ : Half) else Half.neg ⟨n0, 0⟩) := rfl
    have hvk : dotQ n0 t.v₀ ≠ 0 := by rw [hn0, dotQ_crossQ_det]; exact hdet
    obtain ⟨hz0, hpos, hvanish, _⟩ := origin_facet_eval n0 t.v₀ hvk _ hg0
    refine ⟨gOf (slot t 0) t.v₀, hpos, ?_⟩
    apply gOf_eq_smul_coord (b := b) _ 1 _ (by rw [hb1]; rfl)
    intro i hi
    fin_cases i
    · rw [show b ⟨0, by omega⟩ = b 0 from rfl, hb0]; exact hz0
    · exact absurd rfl hi
    · rw [show b ⟨2, by omega⟩ = b 2 from rfl, hb2]
      exact hvanish t.v₁ (by rw [hn0]; exact dotQ_crossQ_left t.v₁ t.v₂)
    · rw [show b ⟨3, by omega⟩ = b 3 from rfl, hb3]
      exact hvanish t.v₂ (by rw [hn0]; exact dotQ_crossQ_right t.v₁ t.v₂)
  · 
    set n1 := crossQ t.v₀ t.v₂ with hn1
    have hg1 : slot t 1
        = (if 0 ≤ dotQ n1 t.v₁ then (⟨n1, 0⟩ : Half) else Half.neg ⟨n1, 0⟩) := rfl
    have hvk : dotQ n1 t.v₁ ≠ 0 := by
      rw [hn1, dotQ_crossQ_det]
      intro hc; apply hdet
      have : det3 t.v₁ t.v₀ t.v₂ = - det3 t.v₀ t.v₁ t.v₂ := by
        simp only [det3_expand]; ring
      rw [this] at hc; linarith
    obtain ⟨hz0, hpos, hvanish, _⟩ := origin_facet_eval n1 t.v₁ hvk _ hg1
    refine ⟨gOf (slot t 1) t.v₁, hpos, ?_⟩
    apply gOf_eq_smul_coord (b := b) _ 2 _ (by rw [hb2]; rfl)
    intro i hi
    fin_cases i
    · rw [show b ⟨0, by omega⟩ = b 0 from rfl, hb0]; exact hz0
    · rw [show b ⟨1, by omega⟩ = b 1 from rfl, hb1]
      exact hvanish t.v₀ (by rw [hn1]; exact dotQ_crossQ_left t.v₀ t.v₂)
    · exact absurd rfl hi
    · rw [show b ⟨3, by omega⟩ = b 3 from rfl, hb3]
      exact hvanish t.v₂ (by rw [hn1]; exact dotQ_crossQ_right t.v₀ t.v₂)
  · 
    set n2 := crossQ t.v₀ t.v₁ with hn2
    have hg2 : slot t 2
        = (if 0 ≤ dotQ n2 t.v₂ then (⟨n2, 0⟩ : Half) else Half.neg ⟨n2, 0⟩) := rfl
    have hvk : dotQ n2 t.v₂ ≠ 0 := by
      rw [hn2, dotQ_crossQ_det]
      intro hc; apply hdet
      have : det3 t.v₂ t.v₀ t.v₁ = det3 t.v₀ t.v₁ t.v₂ := by
        simp only [det3_expand]; ring
      rw [this] at hc; exact hc
    obtain ⟨hz0, hpos, hvanish, _⟩ := origin_facet_eval n2 t.v₂ hvk _ hg2
    refine ⟨gOf (slot t 2) t.v₂, hpos, ?_⟩
    apply gOf_eq_smul_coord (b := b) _ 3 _ (by rw [hb3]; rfl)
    intro i hi
    fin_cases i
    · rw [show b ⟨0, by omega⟩ = b 0 from rfl, hb0]; exact hz0
    · rw [show b ⟨1, by omega⟩ = b 1 from rfl, hb1]
      exact hvanish t.v₀ (by rw [hn2]; exact dotQ_crossQ_left t.v₀ t.v₁)
    · rw [show b ⟨2, by omega⟩ = b 2 from rfl, hb2]
      exact hvanish t.v₁ (by rw [hn2]; exact dotQ_crossQ_right t.v₀ t.v₁)
    · exact absurd rfl hi
  · 
    set n3 := crossQ (psub t.v₁ t.v₀) (psub t.v₂ t.v₀) with hn3
    set c3 := dotQ n3 t.v₀ with hc3
    have hg3 : slot t 3
        = (if c3 ≤ 0 then (⟨n3, c3⟩ : Half) else Half.neg ⟨n3, c3⟩) := rfl
    have hc3ne : c3 ≠ 0 := by
      rw [hc3, hn3]
      intro hc; apply hdet
      have : dotQ (crossQ (psub t.v₁ t.v₀) (psub t.v₂ t.v₀)) t.v₀
          = det3 t.v₀ t.v₁ t.v₂ := by
        simp only [dotQ, crossQ, psub, mkPoint_zero, mkPoint_one, mkPoint_two, det3]
        ring
      rw [this] at hc; exact hc
    obtain ⟨hv0, hv1, hv2, hpos, _⟩ := base_facet_eval t.v₀ t.v₁ t.v₂ n3 hn3 c3 hc3 hc3ne _ hg3
    refine ⟨gOf (slot t 3) 0, hpos, ?_⟩
    apply gOf_eq_smul_coord (b := b) _ 0 _ (by rw [hb0]; rfl)
    intro i hi
    fin_cases i
    · exact absurd rfl hi
    · rw [show b ⟨1, by omega⟩ = b 1 from rfl, hb1]; exact hv0
    · rw [show b ⟨2, by omega⟩ = b 2 from rfl, hb2]; exact hv1
    · rw [show b ⟨3, by omega⟩ = b 3 from rfl, hb3]; exact hv2

name: slot_injective
statement:
theorem slot_injective {t : Triangle} (hdet : det3 t.v₀ t.v₁ t.v₂ ≠ 0)
    (b : AffineBasis (Fin 4) ℚ (Fin 3 → ℚ))
    (hbcoe : ⇑b = ![(0 : Point), t.v₀, t.v₁, t.v₂]) :
    ∀ k l : Fin 4, slot t k = slot t l → k = l
proof:
:= by
  intro k l heq
  by_contra hkl
  obtain ⟨lamk, hlamk, hk⟩ := slot_coord hdet b hbcoe k
  obtain ⟨laml, hlaml, hl⟩ := slot_coord hdet b hbcoe l
  have hgOf : gOf (slot t k) = gOf (slot t l) := by rw [heq]
  rw [hk, hl] at hgOf
  have happ := DFunLike.congr_fun hgOf (b (slotIdx k))
  have hkk : (lamk • b.coord (slotIdx k)) (b (slotIdx k)) = lamk * 1 := by
    show lamk * (b.coord (slotIdx k) (b (slotIdx k))) = lamk * 1
    rw [b.coord_apply_eq]
  have hll : (laml • b.coord (slotIdx l)) (b (slotIdx k)) = laml * 0 := by
    show laml * (b.coord (slotIdx l) (b (slotIdx k))) = laml * 0
    rw [b.coord_apply_ne]
    exact fun hc => hkl (slotIdx_injective hc.symm)
  rw [hkk, hll] at happ
  simp only [mul_one, mul_zero] at happ
  exact (ne_of_gt hlamk) happ

name: mem_simplex_iff_slots
statement:
theorem mem_simplex_iff_slots {t : Triangle} (hdet : det3 t.v₀ t.v₁ t.v₂ ≠ 0)
    (u : Point) :
    u ∈ simplex t ↔ ∀ k : Fin 4, 0 ≤ (slot t k).eval u
proof:
:= by
  rw [← feasible_iff_mem_simplex hdet, Proof.SimImplCover.feasible_iff]
  constructor
  · intro h k
    have := h (slot t k) (slot_mem t k)
    simpa [gOf_apply] using this
  · intro h g hg
    obtain ⟨k, rfl⟩ := mem_tetraHalves_iff.mp hg
    simpa [gOf_apply] using h k

name: openCone2_comm
statement: theorem openCone2_comm (a b : Point) : openCone2 a b = openCone2 b a
proof:
:= by
  ext u
  constructor <;> rintro ⟨μ₀, μa, μb, h0, ha, hb, hsum, rfl⟩ <;>
    exact ⟨μ₀, μb, μa, h0, hb, ha, by linarith, by rw [add_comm]⟩

name: jump_swap
statement:
theorem jump_swap (z v : Point) (e : Point × Point) :
    jump z v e.swap = - jump z v e
proof:
:= by
  rcases e with ⟨a, b⟩
  unfold jump
  simp only [Prod.swap_prod_mk]
  rw [openCone2_comm b a]
  by_cases h : z ∈ openCone2 a b
  · rw [if_pos h, if_pos h, dotQ_crossQ_swap b a v]
    rw [show - dotQ (crossQ a b) v = -(dotQ (crossQ a b) v) from rfl, qsign_neg]
  · rw [if_neg h, if_neg h]; ring

name: cone_coord_12
statement:
theorem cone_coord_12 {b : AffineBasis (Fin 4) ℚ (Fin 3 → ℚ)}
    (hb0 : b 0 = 0) (z : Point) :
    z ∈ openCone2 (b 1) (b 2) ↔
      (0 < b.coord 0 z ∧ 0 < b.coord 1 z ∧ 0 < b.coord 2 z ∧ b.coord 3 z = 0)
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨μ₀, μa, μb, h0, ha, hb, hsum, hz⟩
    set w : Fin 4 → ℚ := ![μ₀, μa, μb, 0] with hw
    have hwsum : ∑ j, w j = 1 := by
      simp only [hw, Fin.sum_univ_four, Matrix.cons_val_zero, Matrix.cons_val_one,
        Matrix.head_cons, Matrix.cons_val_two, Matrix.tail_cons, Matrix.cons_val_three]
      linarith
    have hcomb : Finset.univ.affineCombination ℚ ⇑b w = z := by
      rw [Finset.affineCombination_eq_linear_combination Finset.univ ⇑b w hwsum,
        Fin.sum_univ_four]
      simp only [hw, Matrix.cons_val_zero, Matrix.cons_val_one, Matrix.head_cons,
        Matrix.cons_val_two, Matrix.tail_cons, Matrix.cons_val_three]
      rw [hb0, smul_zero, zero_add, zero_smul, add_zero]
      exact hz.symm
    have hcoord : ∀ j, b.coord j z = w j := fun j => by
      rw [← hcomb]
      exact b.coord_apply_combination_of_mem (Finset.mem_univ j) hwsum
    refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩ <;> rw [hcoord] <;>
      simp only [hw, Matrix.cons_val_zero, Matrix.cons_val_one, Matrix.head_cons,
        Matrix.cons_val_two, Matrix.tail_cons, Matrix.cons_val_three]
    · exact h0
    · exact ha
    · exact hb
  · rintro ⟨h0, h1, h2, h3⟩
    refine ⟨b.coord 0 z, b.coord 1 z, b.coord 2 z, h0, h1, h2, ?_, ?_⟩
    · have hs := b.sum_coord_apply_eq_one z
      rw [Fin.sum_univ_four] at hs
      linarith
    · have hz := b.affineCombination_coord_eq_self z
      rw [Finset.affineCombination_eq_linear_combination Finset.univ ⇑b _
        (b.sum_coord_apply_eq_one z), Fin.sum_univ_four] at hz
      rw [hb0, smul_zero, zero_add, h3, zero_smul, add_zero] at hz
      exact hz.symm

name: cone_coord_23
statement:
theorem cone_coord_23 {b : AffineBasis (Fin 4) ℚ (Fin 3 → ℚ)}
    (hb0 : b 0 = 0) (z : Point) :

      (0 < b.coord 0 z ∧ 0 < b.coord 2 z ∧ 0 < b.coord 3 z ∧ b.coord 1 z = 0)
proof:

  · rintro ⟨μ₀, μa, μb, h0, ha, hb, hsum, hz⟩
    set w : Fin 4 → ℚ := ![μ₀, 0, μa, μb] with hw
    have hwsum : ∑ j, w j = 1 := by
      simp only [hw, Fin.sum_univ_four, Matrix.cons_val_zero, Matrix.cons_val_one,
        Matrix.head_cons, Matrix.cons_val_two, Matrix.tail_cons, Matrix.cons_val_three]
      linarith
    have hcomb : Finset.univ.affineCombination ℚ ⇑b w = z := by
      rw [Finset.affineCombination_eq_linear_combination Finset.univ ⇑b w hwsum,
        Fin.sum_univ_four]
      simp only [hw, Matrix.cons_val_zero, Matrix.cons_val_one, Matrix.head_cons,
        Matrix.cons_val_two, Matrix.tail_cons, Matrix.cons_val_three]
      rw [hb0, smul_zero, zero_add, zero_smul, zero_add]
      exact hz.symm
    have hcoord : ∀ j, b.coord j z = w j := fun j => by
      rw [← hcomb]
      exact b.coord_apply_combination_of_mem (Finset.mem_univ j) hwsum
    refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩ <;> rw [hcoord] <;>
      simp only [hw, Matrix.cons_val_zero, Matrix.cons_val_one, Matrix.head_cons,
        Matrix.cons_val_two, Matrix.tail_cons, Matrix.cons_val_three]
    · exact h0
    · exact ha
    · exact hb
  · rintro ⟨h0, h2, h3, h1⟩
    refine ⟨b.coord 0 z, b.coord 2 z, b.coord 3 z, h0, h2, h3, ?_, ?_⟩
    · have hs := b.sum_coord_apply_eq_one z

        (b.sum_coord_apply_eq_one z), Fin.sum_univ_four] at hz
      rw [hb0, smul_zero, zero_add, h1, zero_smul, zero_add] at hz

name: cone_coord_31
statement:
theorem cone_coord_31 {b : AffineBasis (Fin 4) ℚ (Fin 3 → ℚ)}
    (hb0 : b 0 = 0) (z : Point) :
    z ∈ openCone2 (b 3) (b 1) ↔
      (0 < b.coord 0 z ∧ 0 < b.coord 3 z ∧ 0 < b.coord 1 z ∧ b.coord 2 z = 0)
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨μ₀, μa, μb, h0, ha, hb, hsum, hz⟩
    set w : Fin 4 → ℚ := ![μ₀, μb, 0, μa] with hw
    have hwsum : ∑ j, w j = 1 := by
      simp only [hw, Fin.sum_univ_four, Matrix.cons_val_zero, Matrix.cons_val_one,
        Matrix.head_cons, Matrix.cons_val_two, Matrix.tail_cons, Matrix.cons_val_three]
      linarith
    have hcomb : Finset.univ.affineCombination ℚ ⇑b w = z := by
      rw [Finset.affineCombination_eq_linear_combination Finset.univ ⇑b w hwsum,
        Fin.sum_univ_four]
      simp only [hw, Matrix.cons_val_zero, Matrix.cons_val_one, Matrix.head_cons,
        Matrix.cons_val_two, Matrix.tail_cons, Matrix.cons_val_three]
      rw [hb0, smul_zero, zero_add, zero_smul, add_zero, add_comm]
      exact hz.symm
    have hcoord : ∀ j, b.coord j z = w j := fun j => by
      rw [← hcomb]
      exact b.coord_apply_combination_of_mem (Finset.mem_univ j) hwsum

      simp only [hw, Matrix.cons_val_zero, Matrix.cons_val_one, Matrix.head_cons,
        Matrix.cons_val_two, Matrix.tail_cons, Matrix.cons_val_three]
    · exact h0
    · exact ha
    · exact hb
  · rintro ⟨h0, h3, h1, h2⟩
    refine ⟨b.coord 0 z, b.coord 3 z, b.coord 1 z, h0, h3, h1, ?_, ?_⟩
    · have hs := b.sum_coord_apply_eq_one z
      rw [Fin.sum_univ_four] at hs
      linarith
    · have hz := b.affineCombination_coord_eq_self z

        (b.sum_coord_apply_eq_one z), Fin.sum_univ_four] at hz

name: mem_triangleSet_of_coords
statement:
theorem mem_triangleSet_of_coords {t : Triangle} {z : Point} {μ1 μ2 μ3 : ℚ}
    (h1 : 0 ≤ μ1) (h2 : 0 ≤ μ2) (h3 : 0 ≤ μ3) (hsum : μ1 + μ2 + μ3 = 1)
    (hz : z = μ1 • t.v₀ + μ2 • t.v₁ + μ3 • t.v₂) :
    z ∈ triangleSet t
proof:
:= by
  unfold triangleSet
  have hmem : (Finset.univ : Finset (Fin 3)).centerMass ![μ1, μ2, μ3] ![t.v₀, t.v₁, t.v₂]
      ∈ convexHull ℚ ({t.v₀, t.v₁, t.v₂} : Set Point) := by
    apply Finset.centerMass_mem_convexHull
    · intro i _
      fin_cases i <;> simpa
    · rw [Fin.sum_univ_three]
      simp only [Matrix.cons_val_zero, Matrix.cons_val_one, Matrix.head_cons,
        Matrix.cons_val_two, Matrix.tail_cons]
      rw [hsum]; norm_num
    · intro i _
      fin_cases i <;> simp
  have hcm : (Finset.univ : Finset (Fin 3)).centerMass ![μ1, μ2, μ3] ![t.v₀, t.v₁, t.v₂] = z := by
    rw [Finset.centerMass]
    rw [Fin.sum_univ_three, Fin.sum_univ_three]
    simp only [Matrix.cons_val_zero, Matrix.cons_val_one, Matrix.head_cons,
      Matrix.cons_val_two, Matrix.tail_cons]
    rw [hsum, hz]
    norm_num
  rw [← hcm]
  exact hmem

name: neg_slot_of_base_vanish_off_triangle
statement:
theorem neg_slot_of_base_vanish_off_triangle {t : Triangle} (hdet : detOrigin t ≠ 0)
    {z : Point} (hH1 : z ∉ triangleSet t) (hz3 : (slot t 3).eval z = 0) :
    ∃ l : Fin 4, (slot t l).eval z < 0
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have hdet3 : det3 t.v₀ t.v₁ t.v₂ ≠ 0 := by rw [det3_eq_detOrigin]; exact hdet
  have hAI := (det3_ne_zero_iff_originApex_affineIndependent t).mp hdet3
  obtain ⟨b, a₀, hbcoe, _hbset, _⟩ := Proof.AffineBasisSimplex.simplexAffineBasis t hAI
  have hb0 : b 0 = (0 : Point) := by rw [hbcoe]; rfl
  have hb1 : b 1 = t.v₀ := by rw [hbcoe]; rfl
  have hb2 : b 2 = t.v₁ := by rw [hbcoe]; rfl
  have hb3 : b 3 = t.v₂ := by rw [hbcoe]; rfl
  set μ : Fin 4 → ℚ := fun j => b.coord j z with hμdef
  have hkey : ∀ k : Fin 4, ∃ lam : ℚ, 0 < lam ∧
      ∀ u, (slot t k).eval u = lam * b.coord (slotIdx k) u := by
    intro k
    obtain ⟨lam, hlam, heq⟩ := slot_coord hdet3 b hbcoe k
    refine ⟨lam, hlam, fun u => ?_⟩
    exact DFunLike.congr_fun heq u
  choose lam hlam hev using hkey
  
  have hμ0 : μ 0 = 0 := by
    have := hev 3 z
    rw [hz3] at this
    have : (0 : ℚ) = lam 3 * b.coord (slotIdx 3) z := this
    have hsi : slotIdx 3 = 0 := rfl
    rw [hsi] at this
    exact (mul_eq_zero.mp this.symm).resolve_left (ne_of_gt (hlam 3))
  
  by_contra hcon
  push_neg at hcon
  
  have hμnn : ∀ j : Fin 4, 0 ≤ μ j := by
    intro j
    
    have hsurj : ∃ k : Fin 4, slotIdx k = j := by
      revert j; decide
    obtain ⟨k, hk⟩ := hsurj
    have hge : 0 ≤ (slot t k).eval z := hcon k
    rw [hev k z] at hge
    have hge' : 0 ≤ lam k * b.coord (slotIdx k) z := hge
    have hb : 0 ≤ b.coord (slotIdx k) z := by nlinarith [hlam k, hge']
    rw [hk] at hb
    exact hb
  have hμ1 : 0 ≤ μ 1 := hμnn 1
  have hμ2 : 0 ≤ μ 2 := hμnn 2
  have hμ3 : 0 ≤ μ 3 := hμnn 3
  have hsum : μ 1 + μ 2 + μ 3 = 1 := by
    have hs := b.sum_coord_apply_eq_one z
    rw [Fin.sum_univ_four] at hs
    have : μ 0 + μ 1 + μ 2 + μ 3 = 1 := hs
    rw [hμ0] at this; linarith
  have hz := b.affineCombination_coord_eq_self z
  rw [Finset.affineCombination_eq_linear_combination Finset.univ (⇑b) _
    (b.sum_coord_apply_eq_one z), Fin.sum_univ_four] at hz
  rw [hb0, hb1, hb2, hb3] at hz
  have hz' : z = μ 1 • t.v₀ + μ 2 • t.v₁ + μ 3 • t.v₂ := by
    rw [← hz, show μ 0 • (0:Point) = 0 from by rw [hμ0]; simp]
    module
  exact hH1 (mem_triangleSet_of_coords hμ1 hμ2 hμ3 hsum hz')

name: t4_arith
statement:
private theorem t4_arith {s : ℤ} (hs : s = 1 ∨ s = -1) {E D : ℚ}
    (hDE : D = (s : ℚ) * E) (hD : D ≠ 0)
    {mP mM : Prop} [Decidable mP] [Decidable mM]
    (hmP : mP ↔ 0 < D) (hmM : mM ↔ D < 0) :
    s * ((if mP then (1:ℤ) else 0) - (if mM then (1:ℤ) else 0)) = qsign E
proof:
:= by
  rcases hD.lt_or_lt with hneg | hpos
  · rw [if_neg (fun hc => absurd (hmP.mp hc) (by linarith)), if_pos (hmM.mpr hneg)]
    rcases hs with rfl | rfl
    · push_cast at hDE
      rw [qsign_of_neg (show E < 0 by nlinarith)]
      norm_num
    · push_cast at hDE
      rw [qsign_of_pos (show 0 < E by nlinarith)]
      norm_num
  · rw [if_pos (hmP.mpr hpos), if_neg (fun hc => absurd (hmM.mp hc) (by linarith))]
    rcases hs with rfl | rfl
    · push_cast at hDE
      rw [qsign_of_pos (show 0 < E by nlinarith)]
      norm_num
    · push_cast at hDE
      rw [qsign_of_neg (show E < 0 by nlinarith)]
      norm_num

name: face_jump
statement:
theorem face_jump {t : Triangle} (hdet : detOrigin t ≠ 0)
    {z pP pM v : Point}
    (hH1 : z ∉ triangleSet t)
    (hsingle : ∀ g ∈ tetraHalves t, ∀ g' ∈ tetraHalves t,
      g.eval z = 0 → g'.eval z = 0 → g = g')
    (hstab : ∀ g ∈ tetraHalves t, g.eval z ≠ 0 →
      ((0 < g.eval pP ↔ 0 < g.eval z) ∧ (0 < g.eval pM ↔ 0 < g.eval z)
        ∧ g.eval pP ≠ 0 ∧ g.eval pM ≠ 0))
    (hact : ∀ g ∈ tetraHalves t, g.eval z = 0 →
      (dotQ g.n v ≠ 0 ∧ (0 < g.eval pP ↔ 0 < dotQ g.n v)
        ∧ (0 < g.eval pM ↔ dotQ g.n v < 0) ∧ g.eval pP ≠ 0 ∧ g.eval pM ≠ 0)) :
    (orientSign t) * ((if pP ∈ simplex t then (1:ℤ) else 0)
        - (if pM ∈ simplex t then (1:ℤ) else 0))
      = ((faceEdges t).map (jump z v)).sum
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have hdet3 : det3 t.v₀ t.v₁ t.v₂ ≠ 0 := by rw [det3_eq_detOrigin]; exact hdet
  have hAI := (det3_ne_zero_iff_originApex_affineIndependent t).mp hdet3
  obtain ⟨b, a₀, hbcoe, _hbset, _⟩ := Proof.AffineBasisSimplex.simplexAffineBasis t hAI
  have hb0 : b 0 = (0 : Point) := by rw [hbcoe]; rfl
  have hb1 : b 1 = t.v₀ := by rw [hbcoe]; rfl
  have hb2 : b 2 = t.v₁ := by rw [hbcoe]; rfl
  have hb3 : b 3 = t.v₂ := by rw [hbcoe]; rfl
  set μ : Fin 4 → ℚ := fun j => b.coord j z with hμdef
  
  have hkey : ∀ k : Fin 4, ∃ lam : ℚ, 0 < lam ∧
      ∀ u, (slot t k).eval u = lam * b.coord (slotIdx k) u := by
    intro k
    obtain ⟨lam, hlam, heq⟩ := slot_coord hdet3 b hbcoe k
    refine ⟨lam, hlam, fun u => ?_⟩
    exact DFunLike.congr_fun heq u
  choose lam hlam hev using hkey
  
  have hpos_iff : ∀ k : Fin 4, (0 < (slot t k).eval z ↔ 0 < μ (slotIdx k)) := by
    intro k
    rw [hev k z]
    constructor
    · intro h
      by_contra hc
      push_neg at hc
      nlinarith [hlam k]
    · intro h
      exact mul_pos (hlam k) h
  have hzero_iff : ∀ k : Fin 4, ((slot t k).eval z = 0 ↔ μ (slotIdx k) = 0) := by
    intro k
    rw [hev k z]
    constructor
    · intro h
      rcases mul_eq_zero.mp h with h | h
      · exact absurd h (ne_of_gt (hlam k))
      · exact h
    · intro h
      rw [show b.coord (slotIdx k) z = μ (slotIdx k) from rfl, h, mul_zero]
  have hμsum : μ 0 + μ 1 + μ 2 + μ 3 = 1 := by
    have hs := b.sum_coord_apply_eq_one z
    rw [Fin.sum_univ_four] at hs
    exact hs
  
  have hjump_eq : ∀ (a c : Point), jump z v (a, c)
      = if z ∈ openCone2 a c then qsign (dotQ (crossQ a c) v) else 0 := fun a c => rfl
  
  have hcone01 : z ∈ openCone2 t.v₀ t.v₁ ↔ (0 < μ 0 ∧ 0 < μ 1 ∧ 0 < μ 2 ∧ μ 3 = 0) := by
    rw [← hb1, ← hb2]; exact cone_coord_12 hb0 z
  have hcone12 : z ∈ openCone2 t.v₁ t.v₂ ↔ (0 < μ 0 ∧ 0 < μ 2 ∧ 0 < μ 3 ∧ μ 1 = 0) := by
    rw [← hb2, ← hb3]; exact cone_coord_23 hb0 z
  have hcone20 : z ∈ openCone2 t.v₂ t.v₀ ↔ (0 < μ 0 ∧ 0 < μ 3 ∧ 0 < μ 1 ∧ μ 2 = 0) := by
    rw [← hb3, ← hb1]; exact cone_coord_31 hb0 z
  
  have hsum_edges : ((faceEdges t).map (jump z v)).sum
      = jump z v (t.v₀, t.v₁) + jump z v (t.v₁, t.v₂) + jump z v (t.v₂, t.v₀) := by
    simp only [faceEdges, List.map_cons, List.map_nil, List.sum_cons, List.sum_nil]
    ring
  by_cases hz0 : ∃ k : Fin 4, (slot t k).eval z = 0
  · 
    obtain ⟨k₀, hk₀⟩ := hz0
    have huniq : ∀ k : Fin 4, (slot t k).eval z = 0 → k = k₀ := fun k hk =>
      slot_injective hdet3 b hbcoe k k₀
        (hsingle _ (slot_mem t k) _ (slot_mem t k₀) hk hk₀)
    by_cases hneg : ∃ l : Fin 4, (slot t l).eval z < 0
    · 
      obtain ⟨l, hl⟩ := hneg
      have hPf : pP ∉ simplex t := by
        rw [mem_simplex_iff_slots hdet3]
        intro h
        have hst := hstab _ (slot_mem t l) (ne_of_lt hl)
        have hnotpos : ¬ (0 < (slot t l).eval pP) := fun hc =>
          absurd (hst.1.mp hc) (by linarith)
        have : (slot t l).eval pP < 0 := lt_of_le_of_ne (not_lt.mp hnotpos) hst.2.2.1
        linarith [h l]
      have hMf : pM ∉ simplex t := by
        rw [mem_simplex_iff_slots hdet3]
        intro h
        have hst := hstab _ (slot_mem t l) (ne_of_lt hl)
        have hnotpos : ¬ (0 < (slot t l).eval pM) := fun hc =>
          absurd (hst.2.1.mp hc) (by linarith)
        have : (slot t l).eval pM < 0 := lt_of_le_of_ne (not_lt.mp hnotpos) hst.2.2.2
        linarith [h l]
      have hμl : μ (slotIdx l) < 0 := by
        have := hev l z
        rcases lt_trichotomy (μ (slotIdx l)) 0 with h | h | h
        · exact h
        · exact absurd ((hzero_iff l).mpr h) (ne_of_lt hl)
        · exact absurd ((hpos_iff l).mpr h) (by linarith)
      have hallcone : ∀ (a c : Point),
          (z ∈ openCone2 a c ↔ (0 < μ 0 ∧ 0 < μ 1 ∧ 0 < μ 2 ∧ μ 3 = 0)) ∨
          (z ∈ openCone2 a c ↔ (0 < μ 0 ∧ 0 < μ 2 ∧ 0 < μ 3 ∧ μ 1 = 0)) ∨
          (z ∈ openCone2 a c ↔ (0 < μ 0 ∧ 0 < μ 3 ∧ 0 < μ 1 ∧ μ 2 = 0)) →
          z ∉ openCone2 a c := by
        intro a c hch hc
        have hall : ∀ j : Fin 4, 0 ≤ μ j := by
          rcases hch with h | h | h
          · obtain ⟨c0, c1, c2, c3⟩ := h.mp hc
            intro j; fin_cases j
            · exact le_of_lt c0
            · exact le_of_lt c1
            · exact le_of_lt c2
            · exact le_of_eq c3.symm
          · obtain ⟨c0, c2, c3, c1⟩ := h.mp hc
            intro j; fin_cases j
            · exact le_of_lt c0
            · exact le_of_eq c1.symm
            · exact le_of_lt c2
            · exact le_of_lt c3
          · obtain ⟨c0, c3, c1, c2⟩ := h.mp hc
            intro j; fin_cases j
            · exact le_of_lt c0
            · exact le_of_lt c1
            · exact le_of_eq c2.symm
            · exact le_of_lt c3
        linarith [hall (slotIdx l)]
      rw [if_neg hPf, if_neg hMf, hsum_edges, hjump_eq, hjump_eq, hjump_eq,
        if_neg (hallcone _ _ (Or.inl hcone01)),
        if_neg (hallcone _ _ (Or.inr (Or.inl hcone12))),
        if_neg (hallcone _ _ (Or.inr (Or.inr hcone20)))]
      ring
    · 
      push_neg at hneg
      have hposall : ∀ l : Fin 4, l ≠ k₀ → 0 < (slot t l).eval z := by
        intro l hlk
        rcases lt_or_eq_of_le (hneg l) with h | h
        · exact h
        · exact absurd (huniq l h.symm) hlk
      
      have hμk0 : μ (slotIdx k₀) = 0 := (hzero_iff k₀).mp hk₀
      have hμpos : ∀ l : Fin 4, l ≠ k₀ → 0 < μ (slotIdx l) := fun l hlk =>
        (hpos_iff l).mp (hposall l hlk)
      
      have hactive := hact _ (slot_mem t k₀) hk₀
      have hP4 : (pP ∈ simplex t) ↔ 0 < dotQ (slot t k₀).n v := by
        rw [mem_simplex_iff_slots hdet3]
        constructor
        · intro h
          exact hactive.2.1.mp (lt_of_le_of_ne (h k₀) (Ne.symm hactive.2.2.2.1))
        · intro hD k
          by_cases hk : k = k₀
          · subst hk
            exact le_of_lt (hactive.2.1.mpr hD)
          · have hst := hstab _ (slot_mem t k) (ne_of_gt (hposall k hk))
            exact le_of_lt (hst.1.mpr (hposall k hk))
      have hM4 : (pM ∈ simplex t) ↔ dotQ (slot t k₀).n v < 0 := by
        rw [mem_simplex_iff_slots hdet3]
        constructor
        · intro h
          exact hactive.2.2.1.mp (lt_of_le_of_ne (h k₀) (Ne.symm hactive.2.2.2.2))
        · intro hD k
          by_cases hk : k = k₀
          · subst hk
            exact le_of_lt (hactive.2.2.1.mpr hD)
          · have hst := hstab _ (slot_mem t k) (ne_of_gt (hposall k hk))
            exact le_of_lt (hst.2.1.mpr (hposall k hk))
      
      fin_cases k₀
      · 
        have hin : z ∈ openCone2 t.v₁ t.v₂ := by
          rw [hcone12]
          exact ⟨(hμpos 3 (by decide)), (hμpos 1 (by decide)), (hμpos 2 (by decide)), hμk0⟩
        have hout01 : z ∉ openCone2 t.v₀ t.v₁ := by
          rw [hcone01]
          intro hc
          have := hc.2.1
          have h0 : μ 1 = 0 := hμk0
          linarith
        have hout20 : z ∉ openCone2 t.v₂ t.v₀ := by
          rw [hcone20]
          intro hc
          have := hc.2.2.1
          have h0 : μ 1 = 0 := hμk0
          linarith
        rw [hsum_edges, hjump_eq, hjump_eq, hjump_eq, if_neg hout01, if_pos hin,
          if_neg hout20]
        have hDE : dotQ (slot t 0).n v = (orientSign t : ℚ) * dotQ (crossQ t.v₁ t.v₂) v :=
          slot0_lat hdet v
        have := t4_arith (orientSign_cases hdet) hDE hactive.1 hP4 hM4
        omega
      · 
        have hin : z ∈ openCone2 t.v₂ t.v₀ := by
          rw [hcone20]
          exact ⟨(hμpos 3 (by decide)), (hμpos 2 (by decide)), (hμpos 0 (by decide)), hμk0⟩
        have hout01 : z ∉ openCone2 t.v₀ t.v₁ := by
          rw [hcone01]
          intro hc
          have := hc.2.2.1
          have h0 : μ 2 = 0 := hμk0
          linarith
        have hout12 : z ∉ openCone2 t.v₁ t.v₂ := by
          rw [hcone12]
          intro hc
          have := hc.2.1
          have h0 : μ 2 = 0 := hμk0
          linarith
        rw [hsum_edges, hjump_eq, hjump_eq, hjump_eq, if_neg hout01, if_neg hout12,
          if_pos hin]
        have hDE : dotQ (slot t 1).n v = (orientSign t : ℚ) * dotQ (crossQ t.v₂ t.v₀) v :=
          slot1_lat hdet v
        have := t4_arith (orientSign_cases hdet) hDE hactive.1 hP4 hM4
        omega
      · 
        have hin : z ∈ openCone2 t.v₀ t.v₁ := by
          rw [hcone01]
          exact ⟨(hμpos 3 (by decide)), (hμpos 0 (by decide)), (hμpos 1 (by decide)), hμk0⟩
        have hout12 : z ∉ openCone2 t.v₁ t.v₂ := by
          rw [hcone12]
          intro hc
          have := hc.2.2.1
          have h0 : μ 3 = 0 := hμk0
          linarith
        have hout20 : z ∉ openCone2 t.v₂ t.v₀ := by
          rw [hcone20]
          intro hc
          have := hc.2.1
          have h0 : μ 3 = 0 := hμk0
          linarith
        rw [hsum_edges, hjump_eq, hjump_eq, hjump_eq, if_pos hin, if_neg hout12,
          if_neg hout20]
        have hDE : dotQ (slot t 2).n v = (orientSign t : ℚ) * dotQ (crossQ t.v₀ t.v₁) v :=
          slot2_lat hdet v
        have := t4_arith (orientSign_cases hdet) hDE hactive.1 hP4 hM4
        omega
      · 
        exfalso
        apply hH1
        
        have hμ0 : μ 0 = 0 := hμk0
        have hμ1 : 0 < μ 1 := hμpos 0 (by decide)
        have hμ2 : 0 < μ 2 := hμpos 1 (by decide)
        have hμ3 : 0 < μ 3 := hμpos 2 (by decide)
        have hz := b.affineCombination_coord_eq_self z
        rw [Finset.affineCombination_eq_linear_combination Finset.univ (⇑b) _
          (b.sum_coord_apply_eq_one z), Fin.sum_univ_four] at hz
        rw [hb0, hb1, hb2, hb3] at hz
        have hz' : z = μ 1 • t.v₀ + μ 2 • t.v₁ + μ 3 • t.v₂ := by
          rw [← hz, show μ 0 • (0:Point) = 0 from smul_zero _]
          module
        exact mem_triangleSet_of_coords (le_of_lt hμ1) (le_of_lt hμ2) (le_of_lt hμ3)
          (by linarith) hz'
  · 
    push_neg at hz0
    have hP : (pP ∈ simplex t) ↔ (∀ k : Fin 4, 0 < (slot t k).eval z) := by
      rw [mem_simplex_iff_slots hdet3]
      constructor
      · intro h k
        have hst := hstab _ (slot_mem t k) (hz0 k)
        exact hst.1.mp (lt_of_le_of_ne (h k) (Ne.symm hst.2.2.1))
      · intro h k
        have hst := hstab _ (slot_mem t k) (hz0 k)
        exact le_of_lt (hst.1.mpr (h k))
    have hM : (pM ∈ simplex t) ↔ (∀ k : Fin 4, 0 < (slot t k).eval z) := by
      rw [mem_simplex_iff_slots hdet3]
      constructor
      · intro h k
        have hst := hstab _ (slot_mem t k) (hz0 k)
        exact hst.2.1.mp (lt_of_le_of_ne (h k) (Ne.symm hst.2.2.2))
      · intro h k
        have hst := hstab _ (slot_mem t k) (hz0 k)
        exact le_of_lt (hst.2.1.mpr (h k))
    have hifs : (if pP ∈ simplex t then (1:ℤ) else 0)
        = (if pM ∈ simplex t then (1:ℤ) else 0) := by
      by_cases h : ∀ k : Fin 4, 0 < (slot t k).eval z
      · rw [if_pos (hP.mpr h), if_pos (hM.mpr h)]
      · rw [if_neg (fun hh => h (hP.mp hh)), if_neg (fun hh => h (hM.mp hh))]
    have hjz : ∀ (a c : Point) (k : Fin 4),
        (z ∈ openCone2 a c → μ (slotIdx k) = 0) → jump z v (a, c) = 0 := by
      intro a c k himp
      rw [hjump_eq, if_neg]
      intro hc
      exact hz0 k ((hzero_iff k).mpr (himp hc))
    rw [hifs, hsum_edges]
    rw [hjz t.v₀ t.v₁ 2 (fun hc => (hcone01.mp hc).2.2.2),
      hjz t.v₁ t.v₂ 0 (fun hc => (hcone12.mp hc).2.2.2),
      hjz t.v₂ t.v₀ 1 (fun hc => (hcone20.mp hc).2.2.2)]
    ring

name: face_jump_T2
statement:
theorem face_jump_T2 {t : Triangle} (hdet : detOrigin t ≠ 0)
    {z pP pM v : Point}
    (_hH1 : z ∉ triangleSet t)
    (hneg : ∃ l : Fin 4, (slot t l).eval z < 0)
    (hstab : ∀ g ∈ tetraHalves t, g.eval z ≠ 0 →
      ((0 < g.eval pP ↔ 0 < g.eval z) ∧ (0 < g.eval pM ↔ 0 < g.eval z)
        ∧ g.eval pP ≠ 0 ∧ g.eval pM ≠ 0)) :
    (orientSign t) * ((if pP ∈ simplex t then (1:ℤ) else 0)
        - (if pM ∈ simplex t then (1:ℤ) else 0))
      = ((faceEdges t).map (jump z v)).sum
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have hdet3 : det3 t.v₀ t.v₁ t.v₂ ≠ 0 := by rw [det3_eq_detOrigin]; exact hdet
  have hAI := (det3_ne_zero_iff_originApex_affineIndependent t).mp hdet3
  obtain ⟨b, a₀, hbcoe, _hbset, _⟩ := Proof.AffineBasisSimplex.simplexAffineBasis t hAI
  have hb0 : b 0 = (0 : Point) := by rw [hbcoe]; rfl
  have hb1 : b 1 = t.v₀ := by rw [hbcoe]; rfl
  have hb2 : b 2 = t.v₁ := by rw [hbcoe]; rfl
  have hb3 : b 3 = t.v₂ := by rw [hbcoe]; rfl
  set μ : Fin 4 → ℚ := fun j => b.coord j z with hμdef
  
  have hkey : ∀ k : Fin 4, ∃ lam : ℚ, 0 < lam ∧
      ∀ u, (slot t k).eval u = lam * b.coord (slotIdx k) u := by
    intro k
    obtain ⟨lam, hlam, heq⟩ := slot_coord hdet3 b hbcoe k
    refine ⟨lam, hlam, fun u => ?_⟩
    exact DFunLike.congr_fun heq u
  choose lam hlam hev using hkey
  
  have hpos_iff : ∀ k : Fin 4, (0 < (slot t k).eval z ↔ 0 < μ (slotIdx k)) := by
    intro k
    rw [hev k z]
    constructor
    · intro h
      by_contra hc
      push_neg at hc
      nlinarith [hlam k]
    · intro h
      exact mul_pos (hlam k) h
  have hzero_iff : ∀ k : Fin 4, ((slot t k).eval z = 0 ↔ μ (slotIdx k) = 0) := by
    intro k
    rw [hev k z]
    constructor
    · intro h
      rcases mul_eq_zero.mp h with h | h
      · exact absurd h (ne_of_gt (hlam k))
      · exact h
    · intro h
      rw [show b.coord (slotIdx k) z = μ (slotIdx k) from rfl, h, mul_zero]
  
  have hjump_eq : ∀ (a c : Point), jump z v (a, c)
      = if z ∈ openCone2 a c then qsign (dotQ (crossQ a c) v) else 0 := fun a c => rfl
  
  have hcone01 : z ∈ openCone2 t.v₀ t.v₁ ↔ (0 < μ 0 ∧ 0 < μ 1 ∧ 0 < μ 2 ∧ μ 3 = 0) := by
    rw [← hb1, ← hb2]; exact cone_coord_12 hb0 z
  have hcone12 : z ∈ openCone2 t.v₁ t.v₂ ↔ (0 < μ 0 ∧ 0 < μ 2 ∧ 0 < μ 3 ∧ μ 1 = 0) := by
    rw [← hb2, ← hb3]; exact cone_coord_23 hb0 z
  have hcone20 : z ∈ openCone2 t.v₂ t.v₀ ↔ (0 < μ 0 ∧ 0 < μ 3 ∧ 0 < μ 1 ∧ μ 2 = 0) := by
    rw [← hb3, ← hb1]; exact cone_coord_31 hb0 z
  
  have hsum_edges : ((faceEdges t).map (jump z v)).sum
      = jump z v (t.v₀, t.v₁) + jump z v (t.v₁, t.v₂) + jump z v (t.v₂, t.v₀) := by
    simp only [faceEdges, List.map_cons, List.map_nil, List.sum_cons, List.sum_nil]
    ring
  obtain ⟨l, hl⟩ := hneg
  have hPf : pP ∉ simplex t := by
    rw [mem_simplex_iff_slots hdet3]
    intro h
    have hst := hstab _ (slot_mem t l) (ne_of_lt hl)
    have hnotpos : ¬ (0 < (slot t l).eval pP) := fun hc =>
      absurd (hst.1.mp hc) (by linarith)
    have : (slot t l).eval pP < 0 := lt_of_le_of_ne (not_lt.mp hnotpos) hst.2.2.1
    linarith [h l]
  have hMf : pM ∉ simplex t := by
    rw [mem_simplex_iff_slots hdet3]
    intro h
    have hst := hstab _ (slot_mem t l) (ne_of_lt hl)
    have hnotpos : ¬ (0 < (slot t l).eval pM) := fun hc =>
      absurd (hst.2.1.mp hc) (by linarith)
    have : (slot t l).eval pM < 0 := lt_of_le_of_ne (not_lt.mp hnotpos) hst.2.2.2
    linarith [h l]
  have hμl : μ (slotIdx l) < 0 := by
    have := hev l z
    rcases lt_trichotomy (μ (slotIdx l)) 0 with h | h | h
    · exact h
    · exact absurd ((hzero_iff l).mpr h) (ne_of_lt hl)
    · exact absurd ((hpos_iff l).mpr h) (by linarith)
  have hallcone : ∀ (a c : Point),
      (z ∈ openCone2 a c ↔ (0 < μ 0 ∧ 0 < μ 1 ∧ 0 < μ 2 ∧ μ 3 = 0)) ∨
      (z ∈ openCone2 a c ↔ (0 < μ 0 ∧ 0 < μ 2 ∧ 0 < μ 3 ∧ μ 1 = 0)) ∨
      (z ∈ openCone2 a c ↔ (0 < μ 0 ∧ 0 < μ 3 ∧ 0 < μ 1 ∧ μ 2 = 0)) →
      z ∉ openCone2 a c := by
    intro a c hch hc
    have hall : ∀ j : Fin 4, 0 ≤ μ j := by
      rcases hch with h | h | h
      · obtain ⟨c0, c1, c2, c3⟩ := h.mp hc
        intro j; fin_cases j
        · exact le_of_lt c0
        · exact le_of_lt c1
        · exact le_of_lt c2
        · exact le_of_eq c3.symm
      · obtain ⟨c0, c2, c3, c1⟩ := h.mp hc
        intro j; fin_cases j
        · exact le_of_lt c0
        · exact le_of_eq c1.symm
        · exact le_of_lt c2
        · exact le_of_lt c3
      · obtain ⟨c0, c3, c1, c2⟩ := h.mp hc
        intro j; fin_cases j
        · exact le_of_lt c0
        · exact le_of_lt c1
        · exact le_of_eq c2.symm
        · exact le_of_lt c3
    linarith [hall (slotIdx l)]
  rw [if_neg hPf, if_neg hMf, hsum_edges, hjump_eq, hjump_eq, hjump_eq,
    if_neg (hallcone _ _ (Or.inl hcone01)),
    if_neg (hallcone _ _ (Or.inr (Or.inl hcone12))),
    if_neg (hallcone _ _ (Or.inr (Or.inr hcone20)))]
  ring

name: face_jump_noG2
statement:
theorem face_jump_noG2 {t : Triangle} (hdet : detOrigin t ≠ 0)
    {z pP pM v : Point}
    (hH1 : z ∉ triangleSet t)
    (hLL : ∀ k k' : Fin 4, (k : ℕ) < 3 → (k' : ℕ) < 3 → k ≠ k' →
      ¬ ((slot t k).eval z = 0 ∧ (slot t k').eval z = 0))
    (hstab : ∀ g ∈ tetraHalves t, g.eval z ≠ 0 →
      ((0 < g.eval pP ↔ 0 < g.eval z) ∧ (0 < g.eval pM ↔ 0 < g.eval z)
        ∧ g.eval pP ≠ 0 ∧ g.eval pM ≠ 0))
    (hact : ∀ g ∈ tetraHalves t, g.eval z = 0 →
      (dotQ g.n v ≠ 0 ∧ (0 < g.eval pP ↔ 0 < dotQ g.n v)
        ∧ (0 < g.eval pM ↔ dotQ g.n v < 0) ∧ g.eval pP ≠ 0 ∧ g.eval pM ≠ 0)) :

        - (if pM ∈ simplex t then (1:ℤ) else 0))

proof:
:= by

  have hAI := (det3_ne_zero_iff_originApex_affineIndependent t).mp hdet3
  obtain ⟨b, a₀, hbcoe, _hbset, _⟩ := Proof.AffineBasisSimplex.simplexAffineBasis t hAI
  have hb0 : b 0 = (0 : Point) := by rw [hbcoe]; rfl
  have hb1 : b 1 = t.v₀ := by rw [hbcoe]; rfl
  have hb2 : b 2 = t.v₁ := by rw [hbcoe]; rfl
  have hb3 : b 3 = t.v₂ := by rw [hbcoe]; rfl
  set μ : Fin 4 → ℚ := fun j => b.coord j z with hμdef
  
  have hkey : ∀ k : Fin 4, ∃ lam : ℚ, 0 < lam ∧
      ∀ u, (slot t k).eval u = lam * b.coord (slotIdx k) u := by
    intro k
    obtain ⟨lam, hlam, heq⟩ := slot_coord hdet3 b hbcoe k
    refine ⟨lam, hlam, fun u => ?_⟩
    exact DFunLike.congr_fun heq u
  choose lam hlam hev using hkey
  
  have hpos_iff : ∀ k : Fin 4, (0 < (slot t k).eval z ↔ 0 < μ (slotIdx k)) := by
    intro k
    rw [hev k z]
    constructor
    · intro h
      by_contra hc
      push_neg at hc
      nlinarith [hlam k]
    · intro h
      exact mul_pos (hlam k) h
  have hzero_iff : ∀ k : Fin 4, ((slot t k).eval z = 0 ↔ μ (slotIdx k) = 0) := by
    intro k
    rw [hev k z]
    constructor
    · intro h
      rcases mul_eq_zero.mp h with h | h
      · exact absurd h (ne_of_gt (hlam k))
      · exact h
    · intro h
      rw [show b.coord (slotIdx k) z = μ (slotIdx k) from rfl, h, mul_zero]
  have hμsum : μ 0 + μ 1 + μ 2 + μ 3 = 1 := by
    have hs := b.sum_coord_apply_eq_one z
    rw [Fin.sum_univ_four] at hs
    exact hs
  
  have hjump_eq : ∀ (a c : Point), jump z v (a, c)
      = if z ∈ openCone2 a c then qsign (dotQ (crossQ a c) v) else 0 := fun a c => rfl
  
  have hcone01 : z ∈ openCone2 t.v₀ t.v₁ ↔ (0 < μ 0 ∧ 0 < μ 1 ∧ 0 < μ 2 ∧ μ 3 = 0) := by
    rw [← hb1, ← hb2]; exact cone_coord_12 hb0 z
  have hcone12 : z ∈ openCone2 t.v₁ t.v₂ ↔ (0 < μ 0 ∧ 0 < μ 2 ∧ 0 < μ 3 ∧ μ 1 = 0) := by
    rw [← hb2, ← hb3]; exact cone_coord_23 hb0 z
  have hcone20 : z ∈ openCone2 t.v₂ t.v₀ ↔ (0 < μ 0 ∧ 0 < μ 3 ∧ 0 < μ 1 ∧ μ 2 = 0) := by
    rw [← hb3, ← hb1]; exact cone_coord_31 hb0 z
  
  have hsum_edges : ((faceEdges t).map (jump z v)).sum
      = jump z v (t.v₀, t.v₁) + jump z v (t.v₁, t.v₂) + jump z v (t.v₂, t.v₀) := by
    simp only [faceEdges, List.map_cons, List.map_nil, List.sum_cons, List.sum_nil]
    ring
  by_cases hz0 : ∃ k : Fin 4, (slot t k).eval z = 0
  · 
    obtain ⟨k₀, hk₀⟩ := hz0
    by_cases hneg : ∃ l : Fin 4, (slot t l).eval z < 0
    · 
      exact face_jump_T2 hdet hH1 hneg hstab
    · 
      push_neg at hneg
      
      
      
      have hk_lat : ∀ k : Fin 4, (slot t k).eval z = 0 → (k : ℕ) < 3 := by
        intro k hk
        by_contra hk3
        have hk3' : k = 3 := by apply Fin.ext; omega
        rw [hk3'] at hk
        obtain ⟨l, hl⟩ := neg_slot_of_base_vanish_off_triangle hdet hH1 hk
        exact absurd (hneg l) (by linarith)
      have huniq : ∀ k : Fin 4, (slot t k).eval z = 0 → k = k₀ := by
        intro k hk
        by_contra hkk
        exact hLL k k₀ (hk_lat k hk) (hk_lat k₀ hk₀) hkk ⟨hk, hk₀⟩
      have hposall : ∀ l : Fin 4, l ≠ k₀ → 0 < (slot t l).eval z := by
        intro l hlk
        rcases lt_or_eq_of_le (hneg l) with h | h
        · exact h
        · exact absurd (huniq l h.symm) hlk
      
      have hμk0 : μ (slotIdx k₀) = 0 := (hzero_iff k₀).mp hk₀
      have hμpos : ∀ l : Fin 4, l ≠ k₀ → 0 < μ (slotIdx l) := fun l hlk =>
        (hpos_iff l).mp (hposall l hlk)
      
      have hactive := hact _ (slot_mem t k₀) hk₀
      have hP4 : (pP ∈ simplex t) ↔ 0 < dotQ (slot t k₀).n v := by
        rw [mem_simplex_iff_slots hdet3]
        constructor
        · intro h
          exact hactive.2.1.mp (lt_of_le_of_ne (h k₀) (Ne.symm hactive.2.2.2.1))
        · intro hD k
          by_cases hk : k = k₀
          · subst hk
            exact le_of_lt (hactive.2.1.mpr hD)
          · have hst := hstab _ (slot_mem t k) (ne_of_gt (hposall k hk))
            exact le_of_lt (hst.1.mpr (hposall k hk))
      have hM4 : (pM ∈ simplex t) ↔ dotQ (slot t k₀).n v < 0 := by
        rw [mem_simplex_iff_slots hdet3]
        constructor
        · intro h
          exact hactive.2.2.1.mp (lt_of_le_of_ne (h k₀) (Ne.symm hactive.2.2.2.2))
        · intro hD k
          by_cases hk : k = k₀
          · subst hk
            exact le_of_lt (hactive.2.2.1.mpr hD)
          · have hst := hstab _ (slot_mem t k) (ne_of_gt (hposall k hk))
            exact le_of_lt (hst.2.1.mpr (hposall k hk))
      
      fin_cases k₀
      · 
        have hin : z ∈ openCone2 t.v₁ t.v₂ := by
          rw [hcone12]
          exact ⟨(hμpos 3 (by decide)), (hμpos 1 (by decide)), (hμpos 2 (by decide)), hμk0⟩
        have hout01 : z ∉ openCone2 t.v₀ t.v₁ := by
          rw [hcone01]
          intro hc
          have := hc.2.1
          have h0 : μ 1 = 0 := hμk0
          linarith
        have hout20 : z ∉ openCone2 t.v₂ t.v₀ := by
          rw [hcone20]
          intro hc
          have := hc.2.2.1
          have h0 : μ 1 = 0 := hμk0
          linarith
        rw [hsum_edges, hjump_eq, hjump_eq, hjump_eq, if_neg hout01, if_pos hin,
          if_neg hout20]
        have hDE : dotQ (slot t 0).n v = (orientSign t : ℚ) * dotQ (crossQ t.v₁ t.v₂) v :=
          slot0_lat hdet v
        have := t4_arith (orientSign_cases hdet) hDE hactive.1 hP4 hM4
        omega
      · 
        have hin : z ∈ openCone2 t.v₂ t.v₀ := by
          rw [hcone20]
          exact ⟨(hμpos 3 (by decide)), (hμpos 2 (by decide)), (hμpos 0 (by decide)), hμk0⟩
        have hout01 : z ∉ openCone2 t.v₀ t.v₁ := by
          rw [hcone01]
          intro hc
          have := hc.2.2.1
          have h0 : μ 2 = 0 := hμk0
          linarith
        have hout12 : z ∉ openCone2 t.v₁ t.v₂ := by
          rw [hcone12]
          intro hc
          have := hc.2.1
          have h0 : μ 2 = 0 := hμk0
          linarith
        rw [hsum_edges, hjump_eq, hjump_eq, hjump_eq, if_neg hout01, if_neg hout12,
          if_pos hin]
        have hDE : dotQ (slot t 1).n v = (orientSign t : ℚ) * dotQ (crossQ t.v₂ t.v₀) v :=
          slot1_lat hdet v
        have := t4_arith (orientSign_cases hdet) hDE hactive.1 hP4 hM4
        omega
      · 
        have hin : z ∈ openCone2 t.v₀ t.v₁ := by
          rw [hcone01]
          exact ⟨(hμpos 3 (by decide)), (hμpos 0 (by decide)), (hμpos 1 (by decide)), hμk0⟩
        have hout12 : z ∉ openCone2 t.v₁ t.v₂ := by
          rw [hcone12]
          intro hc
          have := hc.2.2.1
          have h0 : μ 3 = 0 := hμk0
          linarith
        have hout20 : z ∉ openCone2 t.v₂ t.v₀ := by
          rw [hcone20]
          intro hc
          have := hc.2.1
          have h0 : μ 3 = 0 := hμk0
          linarith
        rw [hsum_edges, hjump_eq, hjump_eq, hjump_eq, if_pos hin, if_neg hout12,
          if_neg hout20]
        have hDE : dotQ (slot t 2).n v = (orientSign t : ℚ) * dotQ (crossQ t.v₀ t.v₁) v :=
          slot2_lat hdet v
        have := t4_arith (orientSign_cases hdet) hDE hactive.1 hP4 hM4
        omega
      · 
        
        
        exfalso
        apply hH1
        have hμ0 : μ 0 = 0 := hμk0
        have hμ1 : 0 < μ 1 := hμpos 0 (by decide)
        have hμ2 : 0 < μ 2 := hμpos 1 (by decide)
        have hμ3 : 0 < μ 3 := hμpos 2 (by decide)
        have hz := b.affineCombination_coord_eq_self z
        rw [Finset.affineCombination_eq_linear_combination Finset.univ (⇑b) _
          (b.sum_coord_apply_eq_one z), Fin.sum_univ_four] at hz
        rw [hb0, hb1, hb2, hb3] at hz
        have hz' : z = μ 1 • t.v₀ + μ 2 • t.v₁ + μ 3 • t.v₂ := by
          rw [← hz, show μ 0 • (0:Point) = 0 from smul_zero _]
          module
        exact mem_triangleSet_of_coords (le_of_lt hμ1) (le_of_lt hμ2) (le_of_lt hμ3)
          (by linarith) hz'
  · 
    push_neg at hz0
    have hP : (pP ∈ simplex t) ↔ (∀ k : Fin 4, 0 < (slot t k).eval z) := by
      rw [mem_simplex_iff_slots hdet3]
      constructor
      · intro h k
        have hst := hstab _ (slot_mem t k) (hz0 k)
        exact hst.1.mp (lt_of_le_of_ne (h k) (Ne.symm hst.2.2.1))
      · intro h k
        have hst := hstab _ (slot_mem t k) (hz0 k)
        exact le_of_lt (hst.1.mpr (h k))
    have hM : (pM ∈ simplex t) ↔ (∀ k : Fin 4, 0 < (slot t k).eval z) := by
      rw [mem_simplex_iff_slots hdet3]
      constructor
      · intro h k
        have hst := hstab _ (slot_mem t k) (hz0 k)
        exact hst.2.1.mp (lt_of_le_of_ne (h k) (Ne.symm hst.2.2.2))
      · intro h k
        have hst := hstab _ (slot_mem t k) (hz0 k)
        exact le_of_lt (hst.2.1.mpr (h k))
    have hifs : (if pP ∈ simplex t then (1:ℤ) else 0)
        = (if pM ∈ simplex t then (1:ℤ) else 0) := by
      by_cases h : ∀ k : Fin 4, 0 < (slot t k).eval z
      · rw [if_pos (hP.mpr h), if_pos (hM.mpr h)]
      · rw [if_neg (fun hh => h (hP.mp hh)), if_neg (fun hh => h (hM.mp hh))]
    have hjz : ∀ (a c : Point) (k : Fin 4),
        (z ∈ openCone2 a c → μ (slotIdx k) = 0) → jump z v (a, c) = 0 := by
      intro a c k himp
      rw [hjump_eq, if_neg]
      intro hc
      exact hz0 k ((hzero_iff k).mpr (himp hc))
    rw [hifs, hsum_edges]
    rw [hjz t.v₀ t.v₁ 2 (fun hc => (hcone01.mp hc).2.2.2),
      hjz t.v₁ t.v₂ 0 (fun hc => (hcone12.mp hc).2.2.2),
      hjz t.v₂ t.v₀ 1 (fun hc => (hcone20.mp hc).2.2.2)]
    ring

name: mem_toList_iff
statement:
theorem mem_toList_iff {M : Mesh} {t : Triangle} :
    t ∈ M.toList ↔ ∃ i : Fin M.size, M[i] = t
proof:
:= by
  rw [← Array.mem_def, Array.mem_iff_getElem]
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨i, hi, heq⟩
    exact ⟨⟨i, hi⟩, heq⟩
  · rintro ⟨i, heq⟩
    exact ⟨i.1, i.2, heq⟩

name: winding_meshChain_eq
statement:
theorem winding_meshChain_eq (M : Mesh) (Q : Point) :
    winding (meshChain M) Q
      = (M.toList.map (fun t => orientSign t * (if Q ∈ simplex t then (1:ℤ) else 0))).sum
proof:
:= by
  rw [winding_eq_indicatorSum, meshChain, Array.toList_map, List.map_map]
  rfl

name: mem_planes_imp
statement:
theorem mem_planes_imp {M : Mesh} {g : Half} (hg : g ∈ planes (meshChain M)) :
    ∃ i : Fin M.size, g ∈ tetraHalves M[i]
proof:
:= by
  rw [planes, ← Array.foldl_toList] at hg
  have key : ∀ (l : List (Int × Triangle)) (acc : Array Half),
      g ∈ l.foldl (fun acc e => if isDegen e.2 then acc else acc ++ tetraHalves e.2) acc →
      g ∈ acc ∨ ∃ e ∈ l, g ∈ tetraHalves e.2 := by
    intro l
    induction l with
    | nil =>
      intro acc h
      exact Or.inl h
    | cons e tl ih =>
      intro acc h
      simp only [List.foldl_cons] at h
      rcases ih _ h with hacc | ⟨e', he', hg'⟩
      · by_cases hd : isDegen e.2
        · rw [if_pos hd] at hacc
          exact Or.inl hacc
        · rw [if_neg hd] at hacc
          rcases Array.mem_append.mp hacc with h1 | h1
          · exact Or.inl h1
          · exact Or.inr ⟨e, List.mem_cons_self e tl, h1⟩
      · exact Or.inr ⟨e', List.mem_cons_of_mem e he', hg'⟩
  rcases key _ #[] hg with hacc | ⟨e, he, hge⟩
  · simp at hacc
  · rw [meshChain, Array.toList_map, List.mem_map] at he
    obtain ⟨t, ht, rfl⟩ := he
    obtain ⟨i, hi⟩ := mem_toList_iff.mp ht
    exact ⟨i, by rw [hi]; exact hge⟩

name: meshChain_nondegen
statement:
theorem meshChain_nondegen {M : Mesh} (hnpo : NoPlaneThroughOrigin M) :
    ∀ e ∈ (meshChain M).toList, isDegen e.2 = false
proof:
:= by
  intro e he
  rw [meshChain, Array.toList_map, List.mem_map] at he
  obtain ⟨t, ht, rfl⟩ := he
  obtain ⟨i, hi⟩ := mem_toList_iff.mp ht
  have hd : det3 t.v₀ t.v₁ t.v₂ ≠ 0 := by
    rw [det3_eq_detOrigin, ← hi]
    exact hnpo i
  show (det3 t.v₀ t.v₁ t.v₂ == 0) = false
  rw [beq_eq_false_iff_ne]
  exact hd

name: no_sign_change
proof:
:= by
  have hD : D ≠ 0 := by
    intro h
    subst h
    simp only [mul_zero, add_zero] at hα hβ
    linarith
  rcases hD.lt_or_lt with hDneg | hDpos
  · 
    set r := -A / D with hr
    have hroot : A + r * D = 0 := by
      rw [hr]
      field_simp
    have hαr : α < r := by
      by_contra hcon
      push_neg at hcon
      nlinarith [mul_nonneg (sub_nonneg.mpr hcon) (neg_nonneg.mpr (le_of_lt hDneg))]
    have hrβ : r < β := by
      by_contra hcon
      push_neg at hcon
      nlinarith [mul_nonneg (sub_nonneg.mpr hcon) (neg_nonneg.mpr (le_of_lt hDneg))]
    exact hnz r (le_of_lt hαr) (le_of_lt hrβ) hroot
  · 
    nlinarith [mul_nonneg (sub_nonneg.mpr hαβ) (le_of_lt hDpos)]

name: sign_const_of_no_root
statement:
theorem sign_const_of_no_root {A D α β : ℚ} (hαβ : α ≤ β)
    (hnz : ∀ τ : ℚ, α ≤ τ → τ ≤ β → A + τ * D ≠ 0) :
    (0 < A + α * D ↔ 0 < A + β * D)
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro hα
    by_contra hβ
    exact no_sign_change hαβ hnz hα
      (lt_of_le_of_ne (not_lt.mp hβ) (hnz β hαβ le_rfl))
  · intro hβ
    by_contra hα
    have hα' : A + α * D < 0 :=
      lt_of_le_of_ne (not_lt.mp hα) (hnz α le_rfl hαβ)
    apply no_sign_change (A := -A) (D := -D) hαβ
    · intro τ h1 h2 hc
      exact hnz τ h1 h2 (by linarith)
    · linarith
    · linarith

name: const_piece
statement:
theorem const_piece {M : Mesh} (hnpo : NoPlaneThroughOrigin M) {x y : Point}
    {α β : ℚ} (hαβ : α ≤ β)
    (hnz : ∀ (i : Fin M.size), ∀ g ∈ tetraHalves M[i], ∀ τ : ℚ, α ≤ τ → τ ≤ β →
      g.eval (seg x y τ) ≠ 0) :
    winding (meshChain M) (seg x y α) = winding (meshChain M) (seg x y β)
proof:
:= by
  apply winding_const_on_cell
  · intro g hgp
    obtain ⟨i, hgi⟩ := mem_planes_imp hgp
    exact hnz i g hgi α le_rfl hαβ
  · intro e he hd
    rw [meshChain_nondegen hnpo e he] at hd
    exact absurd hd Bool.false_ne_true
  · intro g hgp
    obtain ⟨i, hgi⟩ := mem_planes_imp hgp
    exact hnz i g hgi β hαβ le_rfl
  · intro e he hd
    rw [meshChain_nondegen hnpo e he] at hd
    exact absurd hd Bool.false_ne_true
  · intro g hgp
    obtain ⟨i, hgi⟩ := mem_planes_imp hgp
    rw [eval_seg, eval_seg]
    apply sign_const_of_no_root hαβ
    intro τ h1 h2
    rw [← eval_seg]
    exact hnz i g hgi τ h1 h2

name: meshChain_entry_face
statement:
theorem meshChain_entry_face {M : Mesh} {e : Int × Triangle}
    (he : e ∈ (meshChain M).toList) : ∃ i : Fin M.size, M[i] = e.2
proof:
:= by
  rw [meshChain, Array.toList_map, List.mem_map] at he
  obtain ⟨t, ht, rfl⟩ := he
  exact mem_toList_iff.mp ht

name: const_piece_cop
proof:
:= by
  classical
  
  set Cop' : Int × Triangle → Prop := fun e => ∃ i : Fin M.size, M[i] = e.2 ∧ Cop i
    with hCop'
  
  
  have gate : ∀ g : Half, (∃ e ∈ (meshChain M).toList, ¬ Cop' e ∧ g ∈ tetraHalves e.2) →
      ∃ i : Fin M.size, ¬ Cop i ∧ g ∈ tetraHalves M[i] := by
    rintro g ⟨e, he, hne, hgte⟩
    obtain ⟨i, hi⟩ := meshChain_entry_face he
    refine ⟨i, ?_, ?_⟩
    · intro hCi; exact hne ⟨i, hi, hCi⟩
    · rw [hi]; exact hgte
  apply winding_const_on_cell_cop (Cop := Cop')
  · 
    intro g _hgp hwit
    obtain ⟨i, hCi, hgi⟩ := gate g hwit
    exact hnz i hCi g hgi α le_rfl hαβ
  · 
    intro g _hgp hwit
    obtain ⟨i, hCi, hgi⟩ := gate g hwit
    exact hnz i hCi g hgi β hαβ le_rfl
  · 
    intro g _hgp hwit
    obtain ⟨i, hCi, hgi⟩ := gate g hwit
    rw [eval_seg, eval_seg]
    apply sign_const_of_no_root hαβ
    intro τ h1 h2
    rw [← eval_seg]
    exact hnz i hCi g hgi τ h1 h2
  · 
    rintro e he ⟨i, hi, hCi⟩
    refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
    · rw [← hi]; exact hcop i hCi α le_rfl hαβ
    · rw [← hi]; exact hcop i hCi β hαβ le_rfl
  · 
    intro e he hd
    rw [meshChain_nondegen hnpo e he] at hd
    exact absurd hd Bool.false_ne_true
  · 
    intro e he hd
    rw [meshChain_nondegen hnpo e he] at hd
    exact absurd hd Bool.false_ne_true

name: list_sum_map_sub
statement:
theorem list_sum_map_sub {α : Type*} (l : List α) (f g : α → ℤ) :
    (l.map f).sum - (l.map g).sum = (l.map (fun a => f a - g a)).sum
proof:
:= by
  induction l with
  | nil => simp
  | cons a l ih =>
    simp only [List.map_cons, List.sum_cons]
    omega

name: list_sum_flat
statement:
theorem list_sum_flat {α β : Type*} (l : List α) (F : α → List β) (J : β → ℤ) :
    (l.map (fun a => ((F a).map J).sum)).sum = ((l.flatMap F).map J).sum
proof:
:= by
  induction l with
  | nil => simp
  | cons a l ih =>
    simp only [List.map_cons, List.sum_cons, List.flatMap_cons, List.map_append,
      List.sum_append, ih]

name: event_jump
statement:
theorem event_jump {M : Mesh} {x y : Point}
    (hcyc : IsClosedOrientedSurface M) (hnpo : NoPlaneThroughOrigin M)
    (hG1 : ∀ (i : Fin M.size), ∀ g ∈ tetraHalves M[i], g.eval x ≠ 0 ∧ g.eval y ≠ 0)
    (hG2 : ∀ (i : Fin M.size), ∀ g ∈ tetraHalves M[i], ∀ g' ∈ tetraHalves M[i],
      g ≠ g' → ∀ τ : ℚ, 0 < τ → τ < 1 →
        ¬ (g.eval (seg x y τ) = 0 ∧ g'.eval (seg x y τ) = 0))
    {τ δ : ℚ} (hτ0 : 0 < τ) (hτ1 : τ < 1) (hδ : 0 < δ)
    (hH1z : ∀ i : Fin M.size, seg x y τ ∉ triangleSet M[i])
    (hstabw : ∀ (i : Fin M.size), ∀ g ∈ tetraHalves M[i], g.eval (seg x y τ) ≠ 0 →
      ((0 < g.eval (seg x y (τ + δ)) ↔ 0 < g.eval (seg x y τ)) ∧
       (0 < g.eval (seg x y (τ - δ)) ↔ 0 < g.eval (seg x y τ)) ∧
       g.eval (seg x y (τ + δ)) ≠ 0 ∧ g.eval (seg x y (τ - δ)) ≠ 0)) :
    winding (meshChain M) (seg x y (τ - δ)) = winding (meshChain M) (seg x y (τ + δ))
proof:
:= by
  classical
  set v := psub y x with hv
  set z := seg x y τ with hzdef
  set pP := seg x y (τ + δ) with hpP
  set pM := seg x y (τ - δ) with hpM
  
  have hface : ∀ t ∈ M.toList,
      orientSign t * ((if pP ∈ simplex t then (1:ℤ) else 0)
          - (if pM ∈ simplex t then (1:ℤ) else 0))
        = ((faceEdges t).map (jump z v)).sum := by
    intro t ht
    obtain ⟨i, hi⟩ := mem_toList_iff.mp ht
    have hdet : detOrigin t ≠ 0 := by rw [← hi]; exact hnpo i
    have hH1z' : z ∉ triangleSet t := by
      rw [← hi]
      exact hH1z i
    have hsingle : ∀ g ∈ tetraHalves t, ∀ g' ∈ tetraHalves t,
        g.eval z = 0 → g'.eval z = 0 → g = g' := by
      intro g hg g' hg' hgz hgz'
      by_contra hne
      rw [← hi] at hg hg'
      exact hG2 i g hg g' hg' hne τ hτ0 hτ1 ⟨hgz, hgz'⟩
    have hstab : ∀ g ∈ tetraHalves t, g.eval z ≠ 0 →
        ((0 < g.eval pP ↔ 0 < g.eval z) ∧ (0 < g.eval pM ↔ 0 < g.eval z)
          ∧ g.eval pP ≠ 0 ∧ g.eval pM ≠ 0) := by
      intro g hg hgz
      rw [← hi] at hg
      exact hstabw i g hg hgz
    have hact : ∀ g ∈ tetraHalves t, g.eval z = 0 →
        (dotQ g.n v ≠ 0 ∧ (0 < g.eval pP ↔ 0 < dotQ g.n v)
          ∧ (0 < g.eval pM ↔ dotQ g.n v < 0) ∧ g.eval pP ≠ 0 ∧ g.eval pM ≠ 0) := by
      intro g hg hgz
      have hlz : g.eval x + τ * dotQ g.n v = 0 := by
        rw [← eval_seg]
        exact hgz
      have hD : dotQ g.n v ≠ 0 := by
        intro hD0
        rw [hD0, mul_zero, add_zero] at hlz
        rw [← hi] at hg
        exact (hG1 i g hg).1 hlz
      have hPv : g.eval pP = δ * dotQ g.n v := by
        rw [hpP, eval_seg, ← hv]
        linear_combination hlz
      have hMv : g.eval pM = - δ * dotQ g.n v := by
        rw [hpM, eval_seg, ← hv]
        linear_combination hlz
      refine ⟨hD, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
      · rw [hPv]
        constructor
        · intro h
          by_contra hc
          push_neg at hc
          nlinarith
        · intro h
          exact mul_pos hδ h
      · rw [hMv]
        constructor
        · intro h
          by_contra hc
          push_neg at hc
          nlinarith
        · intro h
          nlinarith
      · rw [hPv]
        exact mul_ne_zero (ne_of_gt hδ) hD
      · rw [hMv]
        exact mul_ne_zero (by linarith) hD
    exact face_jump hdet hH1z' hsingle hstab hact
  
  have hzero : ((M.toList.flatMap faceEdges).map (jump z v)).sum = 0 := by
    have hodd := odd_sum_swap_invariant (S := edgeMultiset M) hcyc (jump_swap z v)
    rw [edgeMultiset] at hodd
    rw [Multiset.map_coe, Multiset.sum_coe] at hodd
    exact hodd
  
  have hdiff : winding (meshChain M) pP - winding (meshChain M) pM = 0 := by
    rw [winding_meshChain_eq, winding_meshChain_eq, list_sum_map_sub]
    have hcongr : (M.toList.map (fun t =>
        orientSign t * (if pP ∈ simplex t then (1:ℤ) else 0)
          - orientSign t * (if pM ∈ simplex t then (1:ℤ) else 0))).sum
        = (M.toList.map (fun t => ((faceEdges t).map (jump z v)).sum)).sum := by
      apply congrArg List.sum
      apply List.map_congr_left
      intro t ht
      rw [← mul_sub]
      exact hface t ht
    rw [hcongr, list_sum_flat]
    exact hzero
  omega

name: event_jump_noG2_cop
statement:
theorem event_jump_noG2_cop {M : Mesh} {x y : Point}
    (hcyc : IsClosedOrientedSurface M) (hnpo : NoPlaneThroughOrigin M) {Cop : Fin M.size → Prop}
    (hG1tr : ∀ i, ¬ Cop i → ∀ g ∈ tetraHalves M[i], g.eval x ≠ 0 ∧ g.eval y ≠ 0)
    (hLLtr : ∀ i, ¬ Cop i → ∀ k k' : Fin 4, (k : ℕ) < 3 → (k' : ℕ) < 3 →
      k ≠ k' → ∀ τ : ℚ, 0 < τ → τ < 1 →
        ¬ ((slot M[i] k).eval (seg x y τ) = 0 ∧ (slot M[i] k').eval (seg x y τ) = 0))
    {τ δ : ℚ} (hτ0 : 0 < τ) (hτ1 : τ < 1) (hδ : 0 < δ)
    (hH1z : ∀ i : Fin M.size, seg x y τ ∉ triangleSet M[i])
    (hCopOffτ : ∀ i, Cop i → seg x y τ ∉ simplex M[i])
    (hstabw : ∀ (i : Fin M.size), ∀ g ∈ tetraHalves M[i], g.eval (seg x y τ) ≠ 0 →
      ((0 < g.eval (seg x y (τ + δ)) ↔ 0 < g.eval (seg x y τ)) ∧
       (0 < g.eval (seg x y (τ - δ)) ↔ 0 < g.eval (seg x y τ)) ∧
       g.eval (seg x y (τ + δ)) ≠ 0 ∧ g.eval (seg x y (τ - δ)) ≠ 0)) :
    winding (meshChain M) (seg x y (τ - δ)) = winding (meshChain M) (seg x y (τ + δ))
proof:
:= by
  classical
  set v := psub y x with hv
  set z := seg x y τ with hzdef
  set pP := seg x y (τ + δ) with hpP
  set pM := seg x y (τ - δ) with hpM
  
  have hface : ∀ t ∈ M.toList,
      orientSign t * ((if pP ∈ simplex t then (1:ℤ) else 0)
          - (if pM ∈ simplex t then (1:ℤ) else 0))
        = ((faceEdges t).map (jump z v)).sum := by
    intro t ht
    obtain ⟨i, hi⟩ := mem_toList_iff.mp ht
    have hdet : detOrigin t ≠ 0 := by rw [← hi]; exact hnpo i
    have hdet3 : det3 t.v₀ t.v₁ t.v₂ ≠ 0 := by rw [det3_eq_detOrigin]; exact hdet
    have hH1z' : z ∉ triangleSet t := by
      rw [← hi]; exact hH1z i
    have hstab : ∀ g ∈ tetraHalves t, g.eval z ≠ 0 →
        ((0 < g.eval pP ↔ 0 < g.eval z) ∧ (0 < g.eval pM ↔ 0 < g.eval z)
          ∧ g.eval pP ≠ 0 ∧ g.eval pM ≠ 0) := by
      intro g hg hgz
      rw [← hi] at hg
      exact hstabw i g hg hgz
    by_cases hCi : Cop i
    · 
      have hsimp : z ∉ simplex t := by
        rw [← hi]; exact hCopOffτ i hCi
      have hneg : ∃ l : Fin 4, (slot t l).eval z < 0 := by
        by_contra hcon
        push_neg at hcon
        exact hsimp ((mem_simplex_iff_slots hdet3 z).mpr hcon)
      exact face_jump_T2 hdet hH1z' hneg hstab
    · 
      have hLL' : ∀ k k' : Fin 4, (k : ℕ) < 3 → (k' : ℕ) < 3 → k ≠ k' →
          ¬ ((slot t k).eval z = 0 ∧ (slot t k').eval z = 0) := by
        intro k k' hk hk' hkk hboth
        rw [← hi] at hboth
        exact hLLtr i hCi k k' hk hk' hkk τ hτ0 hτ1 hboth
      have hact : ∀ g ∈ tetraHalves t, g.eval z = 0 →
          (dotQ g.n v ≠ 0 ∧ (0 < g.eval pP ↔ 0 < dotQ g.n v)
            ∧ (0 < g.eval pM ↔ dotQ g.n v < 0) ∧ g.eval pP ≠ 0 ∧ g.eval pM ≠ 0) := by
        intro g hg hgz
        have hlz : g.eval x + τ * dotQ g.n v = 0 := by
          rw [← eval_seg]; exact hgz
        have hD : dotQ g.n v ≠ 0 := by
          intro hD0
          rw [hD0, mul_zero, add_zero] at hlz
          rw [← hi] at hg
          exact (hG1tr i hCi g hg).1 hlz
        have hPv : g.eval pP = δ * dotQ g.n v := by
          rw [hpP, eval_seg, ← hv]
          linear_combination hlz
        have hMv : g.eval pM = - δ * dotQ g.n v := by
          rw [hpM, eval_seg, ← hv]
          linear_combination hlz
        refine ⟨hD, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
        · rw [hPv]
          constructor
          · intro h
            by_contra hc
            push_neg at hc
            nlinarith
          · intro h
            exact mul_pos hδ h
        · rw [hMv]
          constructor
          · intro h
            by_contra hc
            push_neg at hc
            nlinarith
          · intro h
            nlinarith
        · rw [hPv]
          exact mul_ne_zero (ne_of_gt hδ) hD
        · rw [hMv]
          exact mul_ne_zero (by linarith) hD
      exact face_jump_noG2 hdet hH1z' hLL' hstab hact
  
  have hzero : ((M.toList.flatMap faceEdges).map (jump z v)).sum = 0 := by
    have hodd := odd_sum_swap_invariant (S := edgeMultiset M) hcyc (jump_swap z v)
    rw [edgeMultiset] at hodd
    rw [Multiset.map_coe, Multiset.sum_coe] at hodd
    exact hodd
  
  have hdiff : winding (meshChain M) pP - winding (meshChain M) pM = 0 := by
    rw [winding_meshChain_eq, winding_meshChain_eq, list_sum_map_sub]
    have hcongr : (M.toList.map (fun t =>
        orientSign t * (if pP ∈ simplex t then (1:ℤ) else 0)
          - orientSign t * (if pM ∈ simplex t then (1:ℤ) else 0))).sum
        = (M.toList.map (fun t => ((faceEdges t).map (jump z v)).sum)).sum := by
      apply congrArg List.sum
      apply List.map_congr_left
      intro t ht
      rw [← mul_sub]
      exact hface t ht
    rw [hcongr, list_sum_flat]
    exact hzero
  omega

name: mem_meshHalves
statement:
theorem mem_meshHalves {M : Mesh} {g : Half} :
    g ∈ meshHalves M ↔ ∃ i : Fin M.size, g ∈ tetraHalves M[i]
proof:
:= by
  unfold meshHalves
  rw [List.mem_flatMap]
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨i, _, hgi⟩
    exact ⟨i, Array.mem_def.mpr hgi⟩
  · rintro ⟨i, hgi⟩
    exact ⟨i, List.mem_finRange i, Array.mem_def.mp hgi⟩

name: root_mem_rootsOf
proof:
:= by
  have hlz : g.eval x + τ * dotQ g.n (psub y x) = 0 := by
    rw [← eval_seg]
    exact hzero
  have hD : dotQ g.n (psub y x) ≠ 0 := by
    intro h0
    rw [h0, mul_zero, add_zero] at hlz
    exact (hG1 i g hg).1 hlz
  have hτ : τ = - g.eval x / dotQ g.n (psub y x) := by
    field_simp
    linarith
  rw [rootsOf, List.mem_toFinset, List.mem_filterMap]
  refine ⟨g, mem_meshHalves.mpr ⟨i, hg⟩, ?_⟩
  rw [if_neg hD, hτ]

name: window_list
statement:
theorem window_list (l : List Half) (x y : Point) (τ : ℚ) :
    ∃ δ : ℚ, 0 < δ ∧ ∀ g ∈ l, g.eval (seg x y τ) ≠ 0 → ∀ δ' : ℚ, 0 < δ' → δ' ≤ δ →
      ((0 < g.eval (seg x y (τ + δ')) ↔ 0 < g.eval (seg x y τ)) ∧
       (0 < g.eval (seg x y (τ - δ')) ↔ 0 < g.eval (seg x y τ)) ∧
       g.eval (seg x y (τ + δ')) ≠ 0 ∧ g.eval (seg x y (τ - δ')) ≠ 0)
proof:
:= by
  induction l with
  | nil => exact ⟨1, one_pos, by simp⟩
  | cons g l ih =>
    obtain ⟨δ₀, hδ₀, hl⟩ := ih
    by_cases hg : g.eval (seg x y τ) = 0
    · refine ⟨δ₀, hδ₀, ?_⟩
      intro g' hg' hne δ' h1 h2
      rcases List.mem_cons.mp hg' with rfl | hmem
      · exact absurd hg hne
      · exact hl g' hmem hne δ' h1 h2
    · have hδgpos : 0 < |g.eval (seg x y τ)| / (1 + |dotQ g.n (psub y x)|) := by
        apply div_pos (abs_pos.mpr hg)
        positivity
      refine ⟨min δ₀ (|g.eval (seg x y τ)| / (1 + |dotQ g.n (psub y x)|)),
        lt_min hδ₀ hδgpos, ?_⟩
      intro g' hg' hne δ' h1 h2
      rcases List.mem_cons.mp hg' with heq | hmem
      · 
        rw [heq] at hne ⊢
        have h2' : δ' ≤ |g.eval (seg x y τ)| / (1 + |dotQ g.n (psub y x)|) :=
          le_trans h2 (min_le_right _ _)
        have hub : δ' * (1 + |dotQ g.n (psub y x)|) ≤ |g.eval (seg x y τ)| := by
          rw [← le_div_iff₀ (by positivity)]
          exact h2'
        have hboundP : |δ' * dotQ g.n (psub y x)| < |g.eval (seg x y τ)| := by
          rw [abs_mul, abs_of_pos h1]
          nlinarith [abs_nonneg (dotQ g.n (psub y x))]
        have hboundM : |(-δ') * dotQ g.n (psub y x)| < |g.eval (seg x y τ)| := by
          rw [abs_mul, abs_neg, abs_of_pos h1]
          nlinarith [abs_nonneg (dotQ g.n (psub y x))]
        have heP : g.eval (seg x y (τ + δ'))
            = g.eval (seg x y τ) + δ' * dotQ g.n (psub y x) := by
          rw [eval_seg, eval_seg]
          ring
        have heM : g.eval (seg x y (τ - δ'))
            = g.eval (seg x y τ) + (-δ') * dotQ g.n (psub y x) := by
          rw [eval_seg, eval_seg]
          ring
        have hsP := sign_stable hne hboundP
        have hsM := sign_stable hne hboundM
        refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
        · rw [heP]; exact hsP.1
        · rw [heM]; exact hsM.1
        · rw [heP]; exact hsP.2
        · rw [heM]; exact hsM.2
      · exact hl g' hmem hne δ' h1 (le_trans h2 (min_le_left _ _))

name: sweep
statement:
theorem sweep {M : Mesh} {x y : Point}
    (hcyc : IsClosedOrientedSurface M) (hnpo : NoPlaneThroughOrigin M)
    (hG1 : ∀ (i : Fin M.size), ∀ g ∈ tetraHalves M[i], g.eval x ≠ 0 ∧ g.eval y ≠ 0)
    (hG2 : ∀ (i : Fin M.size), ∀ g ∈ tetraHalves M[i], ∀ g' ∈ tetraHalves M[i],
      g ≠ g' → ∀ τ : ℚ, 0 < τ → τ < 1 →
        ¬ (g.eval (seg x y τ) = 0 ∧ g'.eval (seg x y τ) = 0)) :
    ∀ (n : ℕ) (α β : ℚ), 0 ≤ α → α < β → β ≤ 1 →
      (∀ (i : Fin M.size) (τ : ℚ), α < τ → τ < β → seg x y τ ∉ triangleSet M[i]) →
      (∀ (i : Fin M.size), ∀ g ∈ tetraHalves M[i], g.eval (seg x y α) ≠ 0) →
      (∀ (i : Fin M.size), ∀ g ∈ tetraHalves M[i], g.eval (seg x y β) ≠ 0) →
      ((rootsOf M x y).filter (fun τ => α < τ ∧ τ < β)).card ≤ n →
      winding (meshChain M) (seg x y α) = winding (meshChain M) (seg x y β)
proof:
:= by
  intro n
  induction n with
  | zero =>
    intro α β h0 hαβ h1 _hH1 hα hβ hcard
    apply const_piece hnpo (le_of_lt hαβ)
    intro i g hg τ hτ1 hτ2 hzero
    have hτα : τ ≠ α := fun h => hα i g hg (h ▸ hzero)
