    have hτβ : τ ≠ β := fun h => hβ i g hg (h ▸ hzero)
    have hmem : τ ∈ (rootsOf M x y).filter (fun τ => α < τ ∧ τ < β) := by
      rw [Finset.mem_filter]
      exact ⟨root_mem_rootsOf hG1 hg hzero,
        lt_of_le_of_ne hτ1 (Ne.symm hτα), lt_of_le_of_ne hτ2 hτβ⟩
    have := Finset.card_pos.mpr ⟨τ, hmem⟩
    omega
  | succ n ih =>
    intro α β h0 hαβ h1 hH1 hα hβ hcard
    set S := (rootsOf M x y).filter (fun τ => α < τ ∧ τ < β) with hS
    by_cases hSe : S = ∅
    · apply ih α β h0 hαβ h1 hH1 hα hβ
      rw [← hS, hSe]
      simp
    · obtain ⟨τ, hτS⟩ := Finset.nonempty_iff_ne_empty.mpr hSe
      have hτS' := hτS
      rw [hS, Finset.mem_filter] at hτS'
      obtain ⟨hτroot, hτα, hτβ⟩ := hτS'
      have hτ0 : 0 < τ := lt_of_le_of_lt h0 hτα
      have hτlt1 : τ < 1 := lt_of_lt_of_le hτβ h1
      obtain ⟨δ₀, hδ₀, hwin⟩ := window_list (meshHalves M) x y τ
      set δ := min (min ((τ - α)/2) ((β - τ)/2)) δ₀ with hδdef
      have hδpos : 0 < δ := by
        rw [hδdef]
        exact lt_min (lt_min (by linarith) (by linarith)) hδ₀
      have hδα : α < τ - δ := by
        have hle : δ ≤ (τ - α)/2 := le_trans (min_le_left _ _) (min_le_left _ _)
        linarith
      have hδβ : τ + δ < β := by
        have hle : δ ≤ (β - τ)/2 := le_trans (min_le_left _ _) (min_le_right _ _)
        linarith
      have hδ' : δ ≤ δ₀ := min_le_right _ _
      have hstabw : ∀ (i : Fin M.size), ∀ g ∈ tetraHalves M[i],
          g.eval (seg x y τ) ≠ 0 →
          ((0 < g.eval (seg x y (τ + δ)) ↔ 0 < g.eval (seg x y τ)) ∧
           (0 < g.eval (seg x y (τ - δ)) ↔ 0 < g.eval (seg x y τ)) ∧
           g.eval (seg x y (τ + δ)) ≠ 0 ∧ g.eval (seg x y (τ - δ)) ≠ 0) := by
        intro i g hg hne
        exact hwin g (mem_meshHalves.mpr ⟨i, hg⟩) hne δ hδpos hδ'
      have hend : ∀ (i : Fin M.size), ∀ g ∈ tetraHalves M[i],
          g.eval (seg x y (τ - δ)) ≠ 0 ∧ g.eval (seg x y (τ + δ)) ≠ 0 := by
        intro i g hg
        by_cases hne : g.eval (seg x y τ) = 0
        · have hlz : g.eval x + τ * dotQ g.n (psub y x) = 0 := by
            rw [← eval_seg]
            exact hne
          have hD : dotQ g.n (psub y x) ≠ 0 := by
            intro h0
            rw [h0, mul_zero, add_zero] at hlz
            exact (hG1 i g hg).1 hlz
          constructor
          · rw [eval_seg]
            intro hc
            apply hD
            have hδD : δ * dotQ g.n (psub y x) = 0 := by
              linear_combination hlz - hc
            exact (mul_eq_zero.mp hδD).resolve_left (ne_of_gt hδpos)
          · rw [eval_seg]
            intro hc
            apply hD
            have hδD : δ * dotQ g.n (psub y x) = 0 := by
              linear_combination hc - hlz
            exact (mul_eq_zero.mp hδD).resolve_left (ne_of_gt hδpos)
        · have hw := hwin g (mem_meshHalves.mpr ⟨i, hg⟩) hne δ hδpos hδ'
          exact ⟨hw.2.2.2, hw.2.2.1⟩
      have hτmem : τ ∈ S := hτS
      have hstep1 : winding (meshChain M) (seg x y α)
          = winding (meshChain M) (seg x y (τ - δ)) := by
        apply ih α (τ - δ) h0 hδα (by linarith)
          (fun i τ' h1' h2' => hH1 i τ' h1' (by linarith))
          hα (fun i g hg => (hend i g hg).1)
        have hsub : (rootsOf M x y).filter (fun τ' => α < τ' ∧ τ' < τ - δ)
            ⊆ S.erase τ := by
          intro τ' hτ'
          rw [Finset.mem_filter] at hτ'
          rw [Finset.mem_erase, hS, Finset.mem_filter]
          refine ⟨ne_of_lt (by linarith [hτ'.2.2]), hτ'.1, hτ'.2.1, by linarith [hτ'.2.2]⟩
        calc ((rootsOf M x y).filter (fun τ' => α < τ' ∧ τ' < τ - δ)).card
            ≤ (S.erase τ).card := Finset.card_le_card hsub
          _ = S.card - 1 := Finset.card_erase_of_mem hτmem
          _ ≤ n := by omega
      have hstep2 : winding (meshChain M) (seg x y (τ - δ))
          = winding (meshChain M) (seg x y (τ + δ)) :=
        event_jump hcyc hnpo hG1 hG2 hτ0 hτlt1 hδpos
          (fun i => hH1 i τ hτα hτβ) hstabw
      have hstep3 : winding (meshChain M) (seg x y (τ + δ))
          = winding (meshChain M) (seg x y β) := by
        apply ih (τ + δ) β (by linarith) hδβ h1
          (fun i τ' h1' h2' => hH1 i τ' (by linarith) h2')
          (fun i g hg => (hend i g hg).2) hβ
        have hsub : (rootsOf M x y).filter (fun τ' => τ + δ < τ' ∧ τ' < β)
            ⊆ S.erase τ := by
          intro τ' hτ'
          rw [Finset.mem_filter] at hτ'
          rw [Finset.mem_erase, hS, Finset.mem_filter]
          refine ⟨ne_of_gt (by linarith [hτ'.2.1]), hτ'.1, by linarith [hτ'.2.1], hτ'.2.2⟩
        calc ((rootsOf M x y).filter (fun τ' => τ + δ < τ' ∧ τ' < β)).card
            ≤ (S.erase τ).card := Finset.card_le_card hsub
          _ = S.card - 1 := Finset.card_erase_of_mem hτmem
          _ ≤ n := by omega
      exact hstep1.trans (hstep2.trans hstep3)

name: sweep_noG2_cop
statement:
theorem sweep_noG2_cop {M : Mesh} {x y : Point}
    (hcyc : IsClosedOrientedSurface M) (hnpo : NoPlaneThroughOrigin M) {Cop : Fin M.size → Prop}
    (hG1tr : ∀ i, ¬ Cop i → ∀ g ∈ tetraHalves M[i], g.eval x ≠ 0 ∧ g.eval y ≠ 0)
    (hLLtr : ∀ i, ¬ Cop i → ∀ k k' : Fin 4, (k : ℕ) < 3 → (k' : ℕ) < 3 →
      k ≠ k' → ∀ τ : ℚ, 0 < τ → τ < 1 →
        ¬ ((slot M[i] k).eval (seg x y τ) = 0 ∧ (slot M[i] k').eval (seg x y τ) = 0))
    (hcoppar : ∀ i, Cop i → ∀ τ : ℚ, 0 ≤ τ → τ ≤ 1 → (seg x y τ) ∉ simplex M[i]) :
    ∀ (n : ℕ) (α β : ℚ), 0 ≤ α → α < β → β ≤ 1 →
      (∀ (i : Fin M.size) (τ : ℚ), α < τ → τ < β → seg x y τ ∉ triangleSet M[i]) →
      (∀ i, ¬ Cop i → ∀ g ∈ tetraHalves M[i], g.eval (seg x y α) ≠ 0) →
      (∀ i, ¬ Cop i → ∀ g ∈ tetraHalves M[i], g.eval (seg x y β) ≠ 0) →
      ((rootsOf M x y).filter (fun τ => α < τ ∧ τ < β)).card ≤ n →
      winding (meshChain M) (seg x y α) = winding (meshChain M) (seg x y β)
proof:
:= by
  intro n
  induction n with
  | zero =>
    intro α β h0 hαβ h1 _hH1 hα hβ hcard
    apply const_piece_cop hnpo (le_of_lt hαβ) (Cop := Cop)
    · 
      intro i hCi g hg τ hτ1 hτ2 hzero
      have hτα : τ ≠ α := fun h => hα i hCi g hg (h ▸ hzero)
      have hτβ : τ ≠ β := fun h => hβ i hCi g hg (h ▸ hzero)
      
      have hroot : τ ∈ rootsOf M x y := by
        have hlz : g.eval x + τ * dotQ g.n (psub y x) = 0 := by
          rw [← eval_seg]; exact hzero
        have hD : dotQ g.n (psub y x) ≠ 0 := by
          intro h0'
          rw [h0', mul_zero, add_zero] at hlz
          exact (hG1tr i hCi g hg).1 hlz
        have hτ : τ = - g.eval x / dotQ g.n (psub y x) := by
          field_simp; linarith
        rw [rootsOf, List.mem_toFinset, List.mem_filterMap]
        exact ⟨g, mem_meshHalves.mpr ⟨i, hg⟩, by rw [if_neg hD, hτ]⟩
      have hmem : τ ∈ (rootsOf M x y).filter (fun τ => α < τ ∧ τ < β) := by
        rw [Finset.mem_filter]
        exact ⟨hroot, lt_of_le_of_ne hτ1 (Ne.symm hτα), lt_of_le_of_ne hτ2 hτβ⟩
      have := Finset.card_pos.mpr ⟨τ, hmem⟩
      omega
    · 
      intro i hCi τ hτ1 hτ2
      exact hcoppar i hCi τ (le_trans h0 hτ1) (le_trans hτ2 h1)
  | succ n ih =>
    intro α β h0 hαβ h1 hH1 hα hβ hcard
    set S := (rootsOf M x y).filter (fun τ => α < τ ∧ τ < β) with hS
    by_cases hSe : S = ∅
    · apply ih α β h0 hαβ h1 hH1 hα hβ
      rw [← hS, hSe]
      simp
    · obtain ⟨τ, hτS⟩ := Finset.nonempty_iff_ne_empty.mpr hSe
      have hτS' := hτS
      rw [hS, Finset.mem_filter] at hτS'
      obtain ⟨hτroot, hτα, hτβ⟩ := hτS'
      have hτ0 : 0 < τ := lt_of_le_of_lt h0 hτα
      have hτlt1 : τ < 1 := lt_of_lt_of_le hτβ h1
      obtain ⟨δ₀, hδ₀, hwin⟩ := window_list (meshHalves M) x y τ
      set δ := min (min ((τ - α)/2) ((β - τ)/2)) δ₀ with hδdef
      have hδpos : 0 < δ := by
        rw [hδdef]
        exact lt_min (lt_min (by linarith) (by linarith)) hδ₀
      have hδα : α < τ - δ := by
        have hle : δ ≤ (τ - α)/2 := le_trans (min_le_left _ _) (min_le_left _ _)
        linarith
      have hδβ : τ + δ < β := by
        have hle : δ ≤ (β - τ)/2 := le_trans (min_le_left _ _) (min_le_right _ _)
        linarith
      have hδ' : δ ≤ δ₀ := min_le_right _ _
      have hstabw : ∀ (i : Fin M.size), ∀ g ∈ tetraHalves M[i],
          g.eval (seg x y τ) ≠ 0 →
          ((0 < g.eval (seg x y (τ + δ)) ↔ 0 < g.eval (seg x y τ)) ∧
           (0 < g.eval (seg x y (τ - δ)) ↔ 0 < g.eval (seg x y τ)) ∧
           g.eval (seg x y (τ + δ)) ≠ 0 ∧ g.eval (seg x y (τ - δ)) ≠ 0) := by
        intro i g hg hne
        exact hwin g (mem_meshHalves.mpr ⟨i, hg⟩) hne δ hδpos hδ'
      
      have hend_cop : ∀ i, ¬ Cop i → ∀ g ∈ tetraHalves M[i],
          g.eval (seg x y (τ - δ)) ≠ 0 ∧ g.eval (seg x y (τ + δ)) ≠ 0 := by
        intro i hCi g hg
        by_cases hne : g.eval (seg x y τ) = 0
        · have hlz : g.eval x + τ * dotQ g.n (psub y x) = 0 := by
            rw [← eval_seg]
            exact hne
          have hD : dotQ g.n (psub y x) ≠ 0 := by
            intro h0'
            rw [h0', mul_zero, add_zero] at hlz
            exact (hG1tr i hCi g hg).1 hlz
          constructor
          · rw [eval_seg]
            intro hc
            apply hD
            have hδD : δ * dotQ g.n (psub y x) = 0 := by
              linear_combination hlz - hc
            exact (mul_eq_zero.mp hδD).resolve_left (ne_of_gt hδpos)
          · rw [eval_seg]
            intro hc
            apply hD
            have hδD : δ * dotQ g.n (psub y x) = 0 := by
              linear_combination hc - hlz
            exact (mul_eq_zero.mp hδD).resolve_left (ne_of_gt hδpos)
        · have hw := hwin g (mem_meshHalves.mpr ⟨i, hg⟩) hne δ hδpos hδ'
          exact ⟨hw.2.2.2, hw.2.2.1⟩
      have hτmem : τ ∈ S := hτS
      have hstep1 : winding (meshChain M) (seg x y α)
          = winding (meshChain M) (seg x y (τ - δ)) := by
        apply ih α (τ - δ) h0 hδα (by linarith)
          (fun i τ' h1' h2' => hH1 i τ' h1' (by linarith))
          hα (fun i hCi g hg => (hend_cop i hCi g hg).1)
        have hsub : (rootsOf M x y).filter (fun τ' => α < τ' ∧ τ' < τ - δ)
            ⊆ S.erase τ := by
          intro τ' hτ'
          rw [Finset.mem_filter] at hτ'
          rw [Finset.mem_erase, hS, Finset.mem_filter]
          refine ⟨ne_of_lt (by linarith [hτ'.2.2]), hτ'.1, hτ'.2.1, by linarith [hτ'.2.2]⟩
        calc ((rootsOf M x y).filter (fun τ' => α < τ' ∧ τ' < τ - δ)).card
            ≤ (S.erase τ).card := Finset.card_le_card hsub
          _ = S.card - 1 := Finset.card_erase_of_mem hτmem
          _ ≤ n := by omega
      have hstep2 : winding (meshChain M) (seg x y (τ - δ))
          = winding (meshChain M) (seg x y (τ + δ)) :=
        event_jump_noG2_cop hcyc hnpo hG1tr hLLtr hτ0 hτlt1 hδpos
          (fun i => hH1 i τ hτα hτβ)
          (fun i hCi => hcoppar i hCi τ (le_of_lt hτ0) (le_of_lt hτlt1)) hstabw
      have hstep3 : winding (meshChain M) (seg x y (τ + δ))
          = winding (meshChain M) (seg x y β) := by
        apply ih (τ + δ) β (by linarith) hδβ h1
          (fun i τ' h1' h2' => hH1 i τ' (by linarith) h2')
          (fun i hCi g hg => (hend_cop i hCi g hg).2) hβ
        have hsub : (rootsOf M x y).filter (fun τ' => τ + δ < τ' ∧ τ' < β)
            ⊆ S.erase τ := by
          intro τ' hτ'
          rw [Finset.mem_filter] at hτ'
          rw [Finset.mem_erase, hS, Finset.mem_filter]
          refine ⟨ne_of_gt (by linarith [hτ'.2.1]), hτ'.1, by linarith [hτ'.2.1], hτ'.2.2⟩
        calc ((rootsOf M x y).filter (fun τ' => τ + δ < τ' ∧ τ' < β)).card
            ≤ (S.erase τ).card := Finset.card_le_card hsub
          _ = S.card - 1 := Finset.card_erase_of_mem hτmem
          _ ≤ n := by omega
      exact hstep1.trans (hstep2.trans hstep3)

name: winding_const_of_avoiding
statement:
theorem winding_const_of_avoiding (M : Mesh)
    (hcyc : IsClosedOrientedSurface M) (hnpo : NoPlaneThroughOrigin M) (x y : Point)
    (hH1 : ∀ (i : Fin M.size) (τ : ℚ), 0 < τ → τ < 1 →
      (fun k => x k + τ * (y k - x k)) ∉ triangleSet M[i])
    (hG1 : ∀ (i : Fin M.size), ∀ g ∈ Impl.Legacy.Sim.tetraHalves M[i],
      g.eval x ≠ 0 ∧ g.eval y ≠ 0)
    (hG2 : ∀ (i : Fin M.size), ∀ g ∈ Impl.Legacy.Sim.tetraHalves M[i],
      ∀ g' ∈ Impl.Legacy.Sim.tetraHalves M[i], g ≠ g' → ∀ τ : ℚ, 0 < τ → τ < 1 →
      ¬ (g.eval (fun k => x k + τ * (y k - x k)) = 0
          ∧ g'.eval (fun k => x k + τ * (y k - x k)) = 0)) :
    winding (meshChain M) x = winding (meshChain M) y
proof:
:= by
  have hend0 : ∀ (i : Fin M.size), ∀ g ∈ tetraHalves M[i],
      g.eval (seg x y 0) ≠ 0 := by
    intro i g hg
    rw [seg_zero]
    exact (hG1 i g hg).1
  have hend1 : ∀ (i : Fin M.size), ∀ g ∈ tetraHalves M[i],
      g.eval (seg x y 1) ≠ 0 := by
    intro i g hg
    rw [seg_one]
    exact (hG1 i g hg).2
  have h := sweep hcyc hnpo hG1 hG2
    (((rootsOf M x y).filter (fun τ => (0:ℚ) < τ ∧ τ < 1)).card)
    0 1 le_rfl one_pos le_rfl hH1 hend0 hend1 le_rfl
  rw [seg_zero, seg_one] at h
  exact h

name: winding_const_of_avoiding_offTri_cop
statement:
theorem winding_const_of_avoiding_offTri_cop (M : Mesh)
    (hcyc : IsClosedOrientedSurface M) (hnpo : NoPlaneThroughOrigin M) (x y : Point)
    {Cop : Fin M.size → Prop}
    (hH1 : ∀ (i : Fin M.size) (τ : ℚ), 0 < τ → τ < 1 →
      (fun k => x k + τ * (y k - x k)) ∉ triangleSet M[i])
    (hCopOff : ∀ (k : Fin M.size), Cop k →
      ∀ τ : ℚ, 0 ≤ τ → τ ≤ 1 → (seg x y τ) ∉ simplex M[k])
    (hG1tr : ∀ (k : Fin M.size), ¬ Cop k → ∀ g ∈ Impl.Legacy.Sim.tetraHalves M[k],
      g.eval x ≠ 0 ∧ g.eval y ≠ 0)
    (hLLtr : ∀ (k : Fin M.size), ¬ Cop k → ∀ a b : Fin 4, (a : ℕ) < 3 → (b : ℕ) < 3 →
      a ≠ b → ∀ τ : ℚ, 0 < τ → τ < 1 →
      ¬ ((slot M[k] a).eval (fun k => x k + τ * (y k - x k)) = 0
          ∧ (slot M[k] b).eval (fun k => x k + τ * (y k - x k)) = 0)) :
    winding (meshChain M) x = winding (meshChain M) y
proof:
:= by
  have hend0 : ∀ i, ¬ Cop i → ∀ g ∈ tetraHalves M[i],
      g.eval (seg x y 0) ≠ 0 := by
    intro i hCi g hg
    rw [seg_zero]
    exact (hG1tr i hCi g hg).1
  have hend1 : ∀ i, ¬ Cop i → ∀ g ∈ tetraHalves M[i],
      g.eval (seg x y 1) ≠ 0 := by
    intro i hCi g hg
    rw [seg_one]
    exact (hG1tr i hCi g hg).2
  have hLLtr' : ∀ i, ¬ Cop i → ∀ k k' : Fin 4, (k : ℕ) < 3 → (k' : ℕ) < 3 →
      k ≠ k' → ∀ τ : ℚ, 0 < τ → τ < 1 →
      ¬ ((slot M[i] k).eval (seg x y τ) = 0 ∧ (slot M[i] k').eval (seg x y τ) = 0) :=
    hLLtr
  have h := sweep_noG2_cop hcyc hnpo hG1tr hLLtr' hCopOff
    (((rootsOf M x y).filter (fun τ => (0:ℚ) < τ ∧ τ < 1)).card)
    0 1 le_rfl one_pos le_rfl hH1 hend0 hend1 le_rfl
  rw [seg_zero, seg_one] at h
  exact h

name: fracVal_fracNorm
statement:
theorem fracVal_fracNorm (num den : Int) (hden : den ≠ 0) :
    fracVal (fracNorm num den) = (num : ℚ) / (den : ℚ)
proof:
:= by
  unfold fracNorm fracVal
  by_cases hd : den < 0
  · simp only [hd, if_true]
    push_cast
    rw [div_eq_div_iff (by simp; omega) (by exact_mod_cast hden)]
    ring
  · simp only [hd, if_false]

name: mix_pos_of_not_share
statement:
theorem mix_pos_of_not_share (a b : Fin 3 → ℚ) (lam : ℚ)
    (ha : ∀ j, 0 ≤ a j) (hb : ∀ j, 0 ≤ b j)
    (hl0 : 0 < lam) (hl1 : lam < 1)
    (hnz : ∀ j, ¬ (a j = 0 ∧ b j = 0)) :
    ∀ j, 0 < (1 - lam) * a j + lam * b j
proof:
:= by
  intro j
  rcases lt_or_eq_of_le (ha j) with h | h
  · have : 0 < (1-lam) * a j := mul_pos (by linarith) h
    nlinarith [mul_nonneg (le_of_lt hl0) (hb j)]
  · have hb0 : b j ≠ 0 := fun hbj => hnz j ⟨h.symm, hbj⟩
    have hbpos : 0 < b j := lt_of_le_of_ne (hb j) (Ne.symm hb0)
    have : 0 < lam * b j := mul_pos hl0 hbpos
    nlinarith [mul_nonneg (by linarith : (0:ℚ) ≤ 1 - lam) (ha j)]

name: mix_param_of_between
statement:
theorem mix_param_of_between (plo phi q : ℚ) (hne : plo ≠ phi)
    (hbet : (plo < q ∧ q < phi) ∨ (phi < q ∧ q < plo)) :
    ∃ lam : ℚ, 0 < lam ∧ lam < 1 ∧ (1 - lam) * plo + lam * phi = q
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨(q - plo)/(phi - plo), ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · rcases hbet with ⟨h1,h2⟩ | ⟨h1,h2⟩
    · apply div_pos <;> linarith
    · apply div_pos_of_neg_of_neg <;> linarith
  · rw [div_lt_one_iff]
    rcases hbet with ⟨h1,h2⟩ | ⟨h1,h2⟩
    · left; constructor <;> linarith
    · right; right; constructor <;> linarith
  · have hd : phi - plo ≠ 0 := by intro h; apply hne; linarith [sub_eq_zero.mp h]
    field_simp; ring

name: vertexHit_fracVal
statement:
theorem vertexHit_fracVal (m : Nat) (hm : m < 3) (v : I3) :
    fracVal (coordAt m v, (1 : Int)) = decI v ⟨m, hm⟩
proof:
:= by
  unfold fracVal
  simp only []
  rw [show ((1 : Int) : ℚ) = 1 by norm_num, div_one, coordAt_cast m v hm]

name: edgeHit_fracVal
statement:
theorem edgeHit_fracVal (m : Nat) (hm : m < 3) (a b : I3) (ea eb : Int)
    (hden : ea - eb ≠ 0) :
    fracVal (fracNorm (coordAt m a * (ea - eb) + ea * (coordAt m b - coordAt m a)) (ea - eb))
      = ((ea : ℚ) * (decI b ⟨m, hm⟩) - (eb : ℚ) * (decI a ⟨m, hm⟩)) / ((ea : ℚ) - (eb : ℚ))
proof:
:= by
  rw [fracVal_fracNorm _ _ hden]
  push_cast
  rw [coordAt_cast m a hm, coordAt_cast m b hm]
  set ca := decI a ⟨m, hm⟩
  set cb := decI b ⟨m, hm⟩
  have hd' : (ea : ℚ) - eb ≠ 0 := by exact_mod_cast hden
  rw [div_eq_div_iff hd' hd']; ring

name: collectParams_mem_vertex
statement:
theorem collectParams_mem_vertex (m : Nat) (vs : Array I3) (signs : Array Int)
    (nO q : I3) (j : Nat) (hj : j < 3) (hsj : signs.getD j 0 = 0) :
    (coordAt m (vs.getD j default), (1 : Int)) ∈ collectParams m vs signs nO q
proof:
:= by
  unfold collectParams
  simp only
  rw [Array.mem_append]
  left
  rw [Array.mem_filterMap]
  refine ⟨j, ?_, ?_⟩
  · rw [Array.mem_def, Array.toList_range, List.mem_range]; exact hj
  · rw [hsj]; simp

name: collectParams_mem_edge
statement:
theorem collectParams_mem_edge (m : Nat) (vs : Array I3) (signs : Array Int)
    (nO q : I3) (k : Nat) (hk : k < 3)
    (hguard : (signs.getD k 0 < 0 ∧ 0 < signs.getD ((k+1)%3) 0) ∨
              (0 < signs.getD k 0 ∧ signs.getD ((k+1)%3) 0 < 0)) :
    (let a := vs.getD k default; let b := vs.getD ((k+1)%3) default
     let ea := dotI nO (subI a q); let eb := dotI nO (subI b q)
     let aDom := coordAt m a; let bDom := coordAt m b; let den := ea - eb
     fracNorm (aDom * den + ea * (bDom - aDom)) den)
      ∈ collectParams m vs signs nO q
proof:
:= by
  unfold collectParams
  simp only
  rw [Array.mem_append]
  right
  rw [Array.mem_filterMap]
  refine ⟨k, ?_, ?_⟩
  · rw [Array.mem_def, Array.toList_range, List.mem_range]; exact hk
  · have hg : ((decide (signs.getD k 0 < 0) && decide (0 < signs.getD ((k+1)%3) 0)) ||
        (decide (0 < signs.getD k 0) && decide (signs.getD ((k+1)%3) 0 < 0))) = true := by
      rcases hguard with ⟨h1, h2⟩ | ⟨h1, h2⟩
      · rw [Bool.or_eq_true]; left
        rw [Bool.and_eq_true]; exact ⟨decide_eq_true h1, decide_eq_true h2⟩
      · rw [Bool.or_eq_true]; right
        rw [Bool.and_eq_true]; exact ⟨decide_eq_true h1, decide_eq_true h2⟩
    rw [if_pos hg]

name: collectParams_mem_cases
statement:
theorem collectParams_mem_cases (m : Nat) (vs : Array I3) (signs : Array Int)
    (nO q : I3) (p : Int × Int) (hp : p ∈ collectParams m vs signs nO q) :
    (∃ j, j < 3 ∧ signs.getD j 0 = 0 ∧ p = (coordAt m (vs.getD j default), (1 : Int))) ∨
    (∃ k, k < 3 ∧ ((signs.getD k 0 < 0 ∧ 0 < signs.getD ((k+1)%3) 0) ∨
                   (0 < signs.getD k 0 ∧ signs.getD ((k+1)%3) 0 < 0)) ∧
      p = (let a := vs.getD k default; let b := vs.getD ((k+1)%3) default
           let ea := dotI nO (subI a q); let eb := dotI nO (subI b q)
           let aDom := coordAt m a; let bDom := coordAt m b; let den := ea - eb
           fracNorm (aDom * den + ea * (bDom - aDom)) den))
proof:
:= by
  unfold collectParams at hp
  simp only at hp
  rw [Array.mem_append] at hp
  rcases hp with hv | he
  · left
    rw [Array.mem_filterMap] at hv
    obtain ⟨k, hkr, hk⟩ := hv
    have hk3 : k < 3 := by
      rw [Array.mem_def, Array.toList_range, List.mem_range] at hkr; exact hkr
    refine ⟨k, hk3, ?_, ?_⟩
    · by_cases hc : signs.getD k 0 == 0
      · simpa using hc
      · rw [if_neg (by simpa using hc)] at hk; exact absurd hk (by simp)
    · split at hk
      · rw [Option.some.injEq] at hk; exact hk.symm
      · exact absurd hk (by simp)
  · right
    rw [Array.mem_filterMap] at he
    obtain ⟨k, hkr, hk⟩ := he
    have hk3 : k < 3 := by
      rw [Array.mem_def, Array.toList_range, List.mem_range] at hkr; exact hkr
    refine ⟨k, hk3, ?_, ?_⟩
    · split at hk
      · rename_i hguard
        rcases (Bool.or_eq_true _ _).mp hguard with hg | hg
        · rw [Bool.and_eq_true] at hg; left
          exact ⟨by simpa using hg.1, by simpa using hg.2⟩
        · rw [Bool.and_eq_true] at hg; right
          exact ⟨by simpa using hg.1, by simpa using hg.2⟩
      · exact absurd hk (by simp)
    · split at hk
      · rw [Option.some.injEq] at hk; exact hk.symm
      · exact absurd hk (by simp)

name: collectParams_empty_signs
statement:
theorem collectParams_empty_signs (m : Nat) (vs : Array I3) (signs : Array Int)
    (nO q : I3) (hempty : collectParams m vs signs nO q = #[]) :
    (∀ j, j < 3 → signs.getD j 0 ≠ 0) ∧
    (∀ k, k < 3 → ¬ ((signs.getD k 0 < 0 ∧ 0 < signs.getD ((k+1)%3) 0) ∨
                     (0 < signs.getD k 0 ∧ signs.getD ((k+1)%3) 0 < 0)))
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro j hj hsj
    have hmem := collectParams_mem_vertex m vs signs nO q j hj hsj
    rw [hempty] at hmem
    simp at hmem
  · intro k hk hguard
    have hmem := collectParams_mem_edge m vs signs nO q k hk hguard
    rw [hempty] at hmem
    simp at hmem

name: hasEdgeOnLine_iff
statement:
theorem hasEdgeOnLine_iff (signs : Array Int) :
    hasEdgeOnLine signs = true ↔
      ∃ i j, i < 3 ∧ j < 3 ∧ i ≠ j ∧ signs.getD i 0 = 0 ∧ signs.getD j 0 = 0
proof:
:= by
  
  have hsize : ((Array.range 3).filter (fun k => signs.getD k 0 == 0)).size
      = (if signs.getD 0 0 = 0 then 1 else 0) + (if signs.getD 1 0 = 0 then 1 else 0)
        + (if signs.getD 2 0 = 0 then 1 else 0) := by
    rw [show Array.range 3 = #[0,1,2] from rfl]
    simp only [Array.filter]
    by_cases h0 : signs.getD 0 0 = 0 <;> by_cases h1 : signs.getD 1 0 = 0 <;>
      by_cases h2 : signs.getD 2 0 = 0 <;> simp_all [Array.foldl] <;> rfl
  unfold hasEdgeOnLine
  rw [hsize, decide_eq_true_eq]
  
  by_cases h0 : signs.getD 0 0 = 0 <;> by_cases h1 : signs.getD 1 0 = 0 <;>
    by_cases h2 : signs.getD 2 0 = 0 <;>
    simp only [h0, h1, h2, if_true, if_false] <;>
    first
    | (constructor
       · intro _
         first
         | exact ⟨0, 1, by decide, by decide, by decide, h0, h1⟩
         | exact ⟨0, 2, by decide, by decide, by decide, h0, h2⟩
         | exact ⟨1, 2, by decide, by decide, by decide, h1, h2⟩
       · intro _; norm_num)
    | (constructor
       · intro hge; norm_num at hge
       · rintro ⟨i, j, hi, hj, hij, hsi, hsj⟩
         interval_cases i <;> interval_cases j <;> simp_all)

name: FragSeam.eq_setPlane
statement:
theorem FragSeam.eq_setPlane {o : P3} {f f' : Frag} (h : FragSeam o f f') :
    f' = setPlane f'.plane (trFrag o f)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨hpoly, _⟩ := h
  have hrec : setPlane f'.plane (trFrag o f)
       = { plane := f'.plane, poly := f.poly.map (trVtx o) } := rfl
  rw [hrec]
  rcases f' with ⟨pl', poly'⟩
  simp only [Frag.mk.injEq, true_and]
  exact hpoly

name: cstep_map_ss
statement:
theorem cstep_map_ss (o : P3) (g g' : IPlane) (poly : Array Vtx)
    (signs : Array Int) (r : Nat) (hr : r = poly.size)
    (hfaith : ∀ v ∈ poly, VtxFaithful v)
    (hcut : ∀ A B : Vtx, VtxFaithful A → VtxFaithful B →
      cutVtx g' (trVtx o A) (trVtx o B) = trVtx o (cutVtx g A B))
    (st : Array Vtx × Array Vtx) (i : Nat) (hi : i < r) :
    cstep g' (poly.map (trVtx o)) signs r (mapSt o st) i
    = mapSt o (cstep g poly signs r st i)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨pV, nV⟩ := st
  have hisz : i < poly.size := hr ▸ hi
  have hrpos : 0 < r := Nat.lt_of_le_of_lt (Nat.zero_le i) hi
  have hi1sz : (i + 1) % r < poly.size := hr ▸ Nat.mod_lt _ hrpos
  have hAf : VtxFaithful (poly.getD i default) := hfaith _ (getD_mem poly i hisz default)
  have hBf : VtxFaithful (poly.getD ((i + 1) % r) default) :=
    hfaith _ (getD_mem poly _ hi1sz default)
  have haGet : (poly.map (trVtx o)).getD i default = trVtx o (poly.getD i default) :=
    map_getD_lt _ _ _ hisz _ _
  have hbGet : (poly.map (trVtx o)).getD ((i + 1) % r) default
             = trVtx o (poly.getD ((i + 1) % r) default) := map_getD_lt _ _ _ hi1sz _ _
  have hcut' : cutVtx g' (trVtx o (poly.getD i default))
                (trVtx o (poly.getD ((i + 1) % r) default))
            = trVtx o (cutVtx g (poly.getD i default)
                (poly.getD ((i + 1) % r) default)) := hcut _ _ hAf hBf
  simp only [cstep, mapSt, haGet, hbGet, hcut']
  split_ifs <;> simp [Array.map_push]

name: clip_signs_ss
statement:
theorem clip_signs_ss (o : P3) (g g' : IPlane) (f : Frag) (hf : FragFaithful f)
    (hsign : ∀ v : Vtx, VtxFaithful v → signI g' (trVtx o v).h = signI g v.h) :
    (f.poly.map (trVtx o)).map (fun v => signI g' v.h)
      = f.poly.map (fun v => signI g v.h)
proof:
:= by
  rw [Array.map_map]
  apply Array.ext'
  rw [Array.toList_map, Array.toList_map]
  apply List.map_congr_left
  intro v hv
  show signI g' (trVtx o v).h = signI g v.h
  exact hsign v (hf v (Array.mem_toList.mp hv))

name: cwalkP_ss
statement:
theorem cwalkP_ss (o : P3) (g g' : IPlane) (poly : Array Vtx)
    (signs : Array Int) (hf : ∀ v ∈ poly, VtxFaithful v)
    (hcut : ∀ A B : Vtx, VtxFaithful A → VtxFaithful B →
      cutVtx g' (trVtx o A) (trVtx o B) = trVtx o (cutVtx g A B)) :
    cwalkP g' (poly.map (trVtx o)) signs = mapSt o (cwalkP g poly signs)
proof:
:= by
  simp only [cwalkP, Array.size_map]
  have hinit : mapSt o ((#[], #[]) :
      Array Vtx × Array Vtx) = (#[], #[]) := by
    simp [mapSt]
  rw [← Array.foldl_toList, ← Array.foldl_toList]
  conv_lhs => rw [← hinit]
  refine foldl_shift (mapSt o) _ _ _ ?_ _
  intro stt k hk
  have hk' : k < poly.size := by rw [Array.toList_range, List.mem_range] at hk; exact hk
  exact cstep_map_ss o g g' poly signs poly.size rfl hf hcut stt k hk'

name: cwalk_ss
statement:
theorem cwalk_ss (o : P3) (g g' : IPlane) (f : Frag) (hf : FragFaithful f)
    (hsign : ∀ v : Vtx, VtxFaithful v → signI g' (trVtx o v).h = signI g v.h)
    (hcut : ∀ A B : Vtx, VtxFaithful A → VtxFaithful B →
      cutVtx g' (trVtx o A) (trVtx o B) = trVtx o (cutVtx g A B)) :
    cwalk g' (trFrag o f) = mapSt o (cwalk g f)
proof:
:= by
  rw [cwalk_cwalkP, cwalk_cwalkP, trFrag_poly, clip_signs_ss o g g' f hf hsign]
  exact cwalkP_ss o g g' f.poly _ hf hcut

name: clipFrag_ss
statement:
theorem clipFrag_ss (o : P3) (g g' : IPlane) (f : Frag) (hf : FragFaithful f)
    (hsign : ∀ v : Vtx, VtxFaithful v → signI g' (trVtx o v).h = signI g v.h)
    (hcut : ∀ A B : Vtx, VtxFaithful A → VtxFaithful B →
      cutVtx g' (trVtx o A) (trVtx o B) = trVtx o (cutVtx g A B)) :
    clipFrag g' (trFrag o f) = (clipFrag g f).map (trFrag o)
proof:
:= by
  rw [clipFrag_eq, clipFrag_eq]
  simp only [trFrag_poly, Array.size_map]
  rw [clip_signs_ss o g g' f hf hsign, cwalk_ss o g g' f hf hsign hcut]
  split_ifs with h <;> apply Array.ext' <;> simp [Array.toList_map, mapSt, trFrag]

name: clearHalf_n0
statement: theorem clearHalf_n0 (g : Half) : (clearHalfSimple g).n 0 = mscal g * g.n 0
proof:
:= by
  simp [clearHalfSimple, mscal, mkPoint_zero]

name: clearHalf_n1
statement: theorem clearHalf_n1 (g : Half) : (clearHalfSimple g).n 1 = mscal g * g.n 1
proof:
:= by
  simp [clearHalfSimple, mscal, mkPoint_one]

name: clearHalf_n2
statement: theorem clearHalf_n2 (g : Half) : (clearHalfSimple g).n 2 = mscal g * g.n 2
proof:
:= by
  simp [clearHalfSimple, mscal, mkPoint_two]

name: clearHalf_c
statement: theorem clearHalf_c (g : Half) : (clearHalfSimple g).c = mscal g * g.c
proof:
:= by
  simp [clearHalfSimple, mscal]

name: mscal_pos
statement: theorem mscal_pos (g : Half) : 0 < mscal g
proof:
:= by
  unfold mscal
  have h0 : (g.n 0).den ≠ 0 := (g.n 0).den_pos.ne'
  have h1 : (g.n 1).den ≠ 0 := (g.n 1).den_pos.ne'
  have h2 : (g.n 2).den ≠ 0 := (g.n 2).den_pos.ne'
  have h3 : g.c.den ≠ 0 := g.c.den_pos.ne'
  have hL : (Nat.lcm (Nat.lcm (Nat.lcm (g.n 0).den (g.n 1).den) (g.n 2).den) g.c.den) ≠ 0 :=
    Nat.lcm_ne_zero (Nat.lcm_ne_zero (Nat.lcm_ne_zero h0 h1) h2) h3
  exact_mod_cast Nat.pos_of_ne_zero hL

name: mscal_ne
statement: theorem mscal_ne (g : Half) : mscal g ≠ 0
proof: := (mscal_pos g).ne'

name: dotQ_clear
statement:
theorem dotQ_clear (g : Half) (v : Point) :
    dotQ (clearHalfSimple g).n v = mscal g * dotQ g.n v
proof:
:= by
  rw [dotQ, dotQ, clearHalf_n0, clearHalf_n1, clearHalf_n2]
  ring

name: det3_clear
statement:
theorem det3_clear (gi gj gk : Half) :
    det3 (clearHalfSimple gi).n (clearHalfSimple gj).n (clearHalfSimple gk).n
      = (mscal gi * mscal gj * mscal gk) * det3 gi.n gj.n gk.n
proof:
:= by
  rw [det3_expand, det3_expand]
  rw [clearHalf_n0 gi, clearHalf_n1 gi, clearHalf_n2 gi,
      clearHalf_n0 gj, clearHalf_n1 gj, clearHalf_n2 gj,
      clearHalf_n0 gk, clearHalf_n1 gk, clearHalf_n2 gk]
  ring

name: tripleVertex_clear
statement:
theorem tripleVertex_clear (G : Array Half) (i j k : Nat) :
    tripleVertexFast (G.map clearHalfSimple) i j k = tripleVertex G i j k
proof:
:= by
  unfold tripleVertexFast tripleVertex
  simp only [Array.getElem?_map]
  rcases hi : G[i]? with _ | gi <;> rcases hj : G[j]? with _ | gj <;> rcases hk : G[k]? with _ | gk <;>
    simp only [Option.map_none', Option.map_some']
  
  
  set gi' := clearHalfSimple gi with hgi'
  set gj' := clearHalfSimple gj with hgj'
  set gk' := clearHalfSimple gk with hgk'
  
  have hdet : det3 gi'.n gj'.n gk'.n = (mscal gi * mscal gj * mscal gk) * det3 gi.n gj.n gk.n :=
    det3_clear gi gj gk
  set m3 := mscal gi * mscal gj * mscal gk with hm3
  have hm3ne : m3 ≠ 0 := by
    rw [hm3]; exact mul_ne_zero (mul_ne_zero (mscal_ne gi) (mscal_ne gj)) (mscal_ne gk)
  
  have hguard : (det3 gi'.n gj'.n gk'.n == 0) = (det3 gi.n gj.n gk.n == 0) := by
    show decide (det3 gi'.n gj'.n gk'.n = 0) = decide (det3 gi.n gj.n gk.n = 0)
    apply decide_eq_decide.mpr
    rw [hdet, mul_eq_zero]
    exact or_iff_right hm3ne
  rw [hguard]
  by_cases hg : det3 gi.n gj.n gk.n == 0
  · simp only [hg, if_true]
  · simp only [hg, if_false]
    
    have hd : det3 gi.n gj.n gk.n ≠ 0 := by
      intro h; rw [h] at hg; simp at hg
    have hd' : det3 gi'.n gj'.n gk'.n ≠ 0 := by
      rw [hdet]; exact mul_ne_zero hm3ne hd
    
    
    set x' : Point := cramer3 gi'.n gj'.n gk'.n (mkPoint gi'.c gj'.c gk'.c) with hx'
    
    have e0 : dotQ gi.n x' = gi.c := by
      have hcr : dotQ gi'.n x' = (mkPoint gi'.c gj'.c gk'.c) 0 := cramer3_dotQ_zero hd'
      rw [mkPoint_zero] at hcr
      rw [dotQ_clear gi x', clearHalf_c gi] at hcr
      exact mul_left_cancel₀ (mscal_ne gi) hcr
    have e1 : dotQ gj.n x' = gj.c := by
      have hcr : dotQ gj'.n x' = (mkPoint gi'.c gj'.c gk'.c) 1 := cramer3_dotQ_one hd'
      rw [mkPoint_one] at hcr
      rw [dotQ_clear gj x', clearHalf_c gj] at hcr
      exact mul_left_cancel₀ (mscal_ne gj) hcr
    have e2 : dotQ gk.n x' = gk.c := by
      have hcr : dotQ gk'.n x' = (mkPoint gi'.c gj'.c gk'.c) 2 := cramer3_dotQ_two hd'
      rw [mkPoint_two] at hcr
      rw [dotQ_clear gk x', clearHalf_c gk] at hcr
      exact mul_left_cancel₀ (mscal_ne gk) hcr
    have hx'eq : x' = cramer3 gi.n gj.n gk.n (mkPoint gi.c gj.c gk.c) :=
      cramer3_unique hd e0 e1 e2
    
    show some (cramer3' gi'.n gj'.n gk'.n (mkPoint gi'.c gj'.c gk'.c) (det3 gi'.n gj'.n gk'.n))
        = some (cramer3 gi.n gj.n gk.n (mkPoint gi.c gj.c gk.c))
    rw [show cramer3' gi'.n gj'.n gk'.n (mkPoint gi'.c gj'.c gk'.c) (det3 gi'.n gj'.n gk'.n)
          = x' from rfl, hx'eq]

name: vertsScaled_eq_verts
statement: theorem vertsScaled_eq_verts (G : Array Half) : vertsScaled G = verts G
proof:
:= by
  show dedup pointBEq
      (((planeTriples G.size).filterMap
        (fun ijk => tripleVertexFast (G.map clearHalfSimple) ijk.1 ijk.2.1 ijk.2.2)).filter
          (feasible G))
    = dedup pointBEq
      (((planeTriples G.size).filterMap
        (fun ijk => tripleVertex G ijk.1 ijk.2.1 ijk.2.2)).filter (feasible G))
  have hcb : (fun ijk : Nat × Nat × Nat =>
                tripleVertexFast (G.map clearHalfSimple) ijk.1 ijk.2.1 ijk.2.2)
           = (fun ijk : Nat × Nat × Nat => tripleVertex G ijk.1 ijk.2.1 ijk.2.2) :=
    funext fun ijk => tripleVertex_clear G ijk.1 ijk.2.1 ijk.2.2
  rw [hcb]

name: chainOfFast_eq_chainOf
statement: theorem chainOfFast_eq_chainOf (G : Array Half) : chainOfFast G = chainOf G
proof:
:= by
  show (let V := vertsScaled G
        let facetV : Nat → Array Point := fun i => V.filter (onPlane G i)
        let isOuter : Nat → Bool := fun i =>
          match G[i]? with
          | some g => decide (0 < g.eval (mkPoint 0 0 0)) && affRank3 (facetV i)
          | none => false
        let leaders : Array Nat := keepFirstPerClass G ((allIdxs G).filter isOuter)
        let fans : Nat → Array Triangle := fun i =>
          let fv := facetV i
          let fr := frame_c G i
          let e1 := fr.1; let e2 := fr.2
          let qs := fv.map (piProj e1 e2)
          let ctr := centroid2 qs
          let cmp := fun p q => angBefore (psub2 (piProj e1 e2 p) ctr) (psub2 (piProj e1 e2 q) ctr)
          let U := (fv.toList.mergeSort cmp).toArray
          let r := U.size
          (Array.range (r - 2)).map (fun k =>
            ⟨U.getD 0 (mkPoint 0 0 0), U.getD (k + 1) (mkPoint 0 0 0), U.getD (k + 2) (mkPoint 0 0 0)⟩)
        (leaders.toList.flatMap (fun i =>
            (fans i).toList.map (fun τ => ((1 : Int), τ)))).toArray) = chainOf G
  rw [vertsScaled_eq_verts]
  rfl

name: simImplFast_eq_simImpl
statement: theorem simImplFast_eq_simImpl (s t : Triangle) : simImplFast s t = simImpl s t
proof:
:= by
  unfold simImplFast simImpl
  by_cases hg : (det3 s.v₀ s.v₁ s.v₂ != 0 && det3 t.v₀ t.v₁ t.v₂ != 0) = true
  · rw [if_pos hg, if_pos hg]
    exact chainOfFast_eq_chainOf _
  · rw [if_neg hg, if_neg hg]

name: gapBox_pos
statement: theorem gapBox_pos {u v : Box3} (h : boxesOverlap u v = false) : 0 < gapBox u v
proof:
:= by
  simp only [boxesOverlap, Bool.and_eq_false_iff, decide_eq_false_iff_not, not_le] at h
  unfold gapBox
  rcases h with ((((h | h) | h) | h) | h) | h
  · exact lt_of_lt_of_le (by linarith) (le_trans (le_trans (le_max_left _ _)
      (le_max_left _ _)) (le_max_left _ _))
  · exact lt_of_lt_of_le (by linarith) (le_trans (le_trans (le_max_right _ _)
      (le_max_left _ _)) (le_max_left _ _))
  · exact lt_of_lt_of_le (by linarith) (le_trans (le_trans (le_max_left _ _)
      (le_max_right _ _)) (le_max_left _ _))
  · exact lt_of_lt_of_le (by linarith) (le_trans (le_trans (le_max_right _ _)
      (le_max_right _ _)) (le_max_left _ _))
  · exact lt_of_lt_of_le (by linarith) (le_trans (le_max_left _ _) (le_max_right _ _))
  · exact lt_of_lt_of_le (by linarith) (le_trans (le_max_right _ _) (le_max_right _ _))

name: gapBox_le_abs
statement:
theorem gapBox_le_abs {u v : Box3} {y z : Point} (hy : InBox u y) (hz : InBox v z) :
    gapBox u v ≤ max |z 0 - y 0| (max |z 1 - y 1| |z 2 - y 2|)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨⟨a1, a2⟩, ⟨a3, a4⟩, a5, a6⟩ := hy
  obtain ⟨⟨c1, c2⟩, ⟨c3, c4⟩, c5, c6⟩ := hz
  have habs : ∀ k : Fin 3, y k - z k ≤ |z k - y k| := by
    intro k; rw [abs_sub_comm]; exact le_abs_self _
  have habs' : ∀ k : Fin 3, z k - y k ≤ |z k - y k| := fun k => le_abs_self _
  refine max_le (max_le (max_le ?_ ?_) (max_le ?_ ?_)) (max_le ?_ ?_)
  · exact le_trans (by linarith [habs 0]) (le_max_left _ _)
  · exact le_trans (by linarith [habs' 0]) (le_max_left _ _)
  · exact le_trans (by linarith [habs 1]) (le_trans (le_max_left _ _) (le_max_right _ _))
  · exact le_trans (by linarith [habs' 1]) (le_trans (le_max_left _ _) (le_max_right _ _))
  · exact le_trans (by linarith [habs 2]) (le_trans (le_max_right _ _) (le_max_right _ _))
  · exact le_trans (by linarith [habs' 2]) (le_trans (le_max_right _ _) (le_max_right _ _))

name: not_inBox_of_close
statement:
theorem not_inBox_of_close {u v : Box3} {y z : Point} (hy : InBox u y)
    (hlt : ∀ k : Fin 3, |z k - y k| < gapBox u v) : ¬ InBox v z
proof:
:= by
  intro hz
  have := gapBox_le_abs hy hz
  have h0 := hlt 0
  have h1 := hlt 1
  have h2 := hlt 2
  rcases max_cases |z 0 - y 0| (max |z 1 - y 1| |z 2 - y 2|) with ⟨he, _⟩ | ⟨he, _⟩ <;>
    rw [he] at this
  · linarith
  · rcases max_cases |z 1 - y 1| |z 2 - y 2| with ⟨he', _⟩ | ⟨he', _⟩ <;> rw [he'] at this
    · linarith
    · linarith

name: foldl_min_le_init
statement:
theorem foldl_min_le_init (f : ℕ → ℚ) :
    ∀ (l : List ℕ) (a : ℚ), l.foldl (fun acc j => min acc (f j)) a ≤ a
proof:
:= by
  intro l
  induction l with
  | nil => intro a; exact le_refl a
  | cons x l ih => intro a; exact le_trans (ih (min a (f x))) (min_le_left _ _)

name: foldl_min_le
statement:
theorem foldl_min_le (f : ℕ → ℚ) :
    ∀ (l : List ℕ) (j : ℕ), j ∈ l → ∀ (a : ℚ),
      l.foldl (fun acc j => min acc (f j)) a ≤ f j
proof:
:= by
  intro l
  induction l with
  | nil => intro j hj; exact absurd hj (List.not_mem_nil j)
  | cons x l ih =>
    intro j hj a
    rw [List.foldl_cons]
    rcases List.mem_cons.mp hj with rfl | hj'
    · exact le_trans (foldl_min_le_init f l _) (min_le_right _ _)
    · exact ih j hj' _

name: foldl_min_pos
statement:
theorem foldl_min_pos (f : ℕ → ℚ) :
    ∀ (l : List ℕ), (∀ j ∈ l, 0 < f j) → ∀ (a : ℚ), 0 < a →
      0 < l.foldl (fun acc j => min acc (f j)) a
proof:
:= by
  intro l
  induction l with
  | nil => intro _ a ha; exact ha
  | cons x l ih =>
    intro hl a ha
    rw [List.foldl_cons]
    exact ih (fun j hj => hl j (List.mem_cons_of_mem _ hj)) _
      (lt_min ha (hl x (List.mem_cons_self _ _)))

name: sepRadius_le
statement:
theorem sepRadius_le {bA : Box3} {B : Array FaceS} {j : ℕ} (hj : j < B.size) :
    sepRadius bA B ≤ gapBox bA (bboxOfFace (B.getD j default)) / 2
proof:
:=
  foldl_min_le _ _ j (List.mem_range.mpr hj) 1

name: sepRadius_pos
proof:
:=
  foldl_min_pos _ _ (fun j hj => by
    have := gapBox_pos (h j (List.mem_range.mp hj)); linarith) 1 one_pos

name: size_materialize
statement: theorem size_materialize (M : Mesh) : (materialize M).size = M.size
proof: := Array.size_map ..

name: materialize_getD
statement:
theorem materialize_getD {M : Mesh} {i : ℕ} (hi : i < M.size) :
    (materialize M).getD i default = faceSOf (M[i]'hi)
proof:
:= by
  rw [arr_getD _ _ _ (by rw [size_materialize]; exact hi)]
  exact materialize_getElem M i hi

name: inBox_of_mem_triangleSet
proof:
:= by
  rw [materialize_getD hi]
  exact triangleSet_subset_bbox _ hx

name: off_triangleSet_of_close
statement:
theorem off_triangleSet_of_close {M₁ M₂ : Mesh} {i : ℕ} (hi : i < M₁.size)
    (hfree : ∀ j, j < (materialize M₂).size →
      boxesOverlap (bboxOfFace ((materialize M₁).getD i default))
        (bboxOfFace ((materialize M₂).getD j default)) = false)
    {y z : Point} (hy : y ∈ triangleSet (M₁[i]'hi))
    (hclose : ∀ k : Fin 3, |z k - y k| ≤
      sepRadius (bboxOfFace ((materialize M₁).getD i default)) (materialize M₂))
    (u : Fin M₂.size) : z ∉ triangleSet M₂[u]
proof:
:= by
  intro hz
  have hu : (u : ℕ) < (materialize M₂).size := by
    rw [size_materialize]; exact u.isLt
  have hgap : 0 < gapBox (bboxOfFace ((materialize M₁).getD i default))
      (bboxOfFace ((materialize M₂).getD (u : ℕ) default)) :=
    gapBox_pos (hfree (u : ℕ) hu)
  have hle := sepRadius_le (bA := bboxOfFace ((materialize M₁).getD i default))
    (B := materialize M₂) hu
  refine not_inBox_of_close (inBox_of_mem_triangleSet hi hy) (fun k => ?_)
    (inBox_of_mem_triangleSet u.isLt (by simpa using hz))
  exact lt_of_le_of_lt (le_trans (hclose k) hle) (by linarith)

name: barycenter_tr
statement:
theorem barycenter_tr (o a b c : P3) :
    smulS (1 / 3) (paddS (psubS a o) (paddS (psubS b o) (psubS c o)))
    = psubS (smulS (1 / 3) (paddS a (paddS b c))) o
proof:
:= by
  simp only [smulS, paddS, psubS, P3.mk.injEq]; refine ⟨by ring, by ring, by ring⟩

name: ofPoint_P3toPoint
statement: private theorem ofPoint_P3toPoint (p : P3) : ofPoint (P3.toPoint p) = p
proof:
:= by
  cases p with
  | mk x y z => simp [ofPoint, P3.toPoint, mkPoint]

name: faithful_mirrors
statement:
theorem faithful_mirrors {f : PFace} (h : PFaceFaithful f) :
    f.h0 = toH4 f.v0 ∧ f.h1 = toH4 f.v1 ∧ f.h2 = toH4 f.v2
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨-, -, -, hh0, hh1, hh2, -, -, -, -, -⟩ := h
  rw [show (⟨f.v0.toPoint, f.v1.toPoint, f.v2.toPoint⟩ : Triangle).v₀ = f.v0.toPoint from rfl,
    ofPoint_P3toPoint] at hh0
  rw [show (⟨f.v0.toPoint, f.v1.toPoint, f.v2.toPoint⟩ : Triangle).v₁ = f.v1.toPoint from rfl,
    ofPoint_P3toPoint] at hh1
  rw [show (⟨f.v0.toPoint, f.v1.toPoint, f.v2.toPoint⟩ : Triangle).v₂ = f.v2.toPoint from rfl,
    ofPoint_P3toPoint] at hh2
  exact ⟨hh0, hh1, hh2⟩

name: baryH_repr_faithful
statement:
theorem baryH_repr_faithful {f : PFace} (hf : PFaceFaithful f) :
    H4Repr
      ⟨f.h0.x * (((f.h0.w.natAbs.lcm f.h1.w.natAbs).lcm f.h2.w.natAbs : ℕ) / f.h0.w)
        + f.h1.x * (((f.h0.w.natAbs.lcm f.h1.w.natAbs).lcm f.h2.w.natAbs : ℕ) / f.h1.w)
        + f.h2.x * (((f.h0.w.natAbs.lcm f.h1.w.natAbs).lcm f.h2.w.natAbs : ℕ) / f.h2.w),
       f.h0.y * (((f.h0.w.natAbs.lcm f.h1.w.natAbs).lcm f.h2.w.natAbs : ℕ) / f.h0.w)
        + f.h1.y * (((f.h0.w.natAbs.lcm f.h1.w.natAbs).lcm f.h2.w.natAbs : ℕ) / f.h1.w)
        + f.h2.y * (((f.h0.w.natAbs.lcm f.h1.w.natAbs).lcm f.h2.w.natAbs : ℕ) / f.h2.w),
       f.h0.z * (((f.h0.w.natAbs.lcm f.h1.w.natAbs).lcm f.h2.w.natAbs : ℕ) / f.h0.w)
        + f.h1.z * (((f.h0.w.natAbs.lcm f.h1.w.natAbs).lcm f.h2.w.natAbs : ℕ) / f.h1.w)
        + f.h2.z * (((f.h0.w.natAbs.lcm f.h1.w.natAbs).lcm f.h2.w.natAbs : ℕ) / f.h2.w),
       3 * (((f.h0.w.natAbs.lcm f.h1.w.natAbs).lcm f.h2.w.natAbs : ℕ) : ℤ)⟩
      (smulS (1 / 3) (paddS f.v0 (paddS f.v1 f.v2)))
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨h0, h1, h2⟩ := faithful_mirrors hf
  exact baryH_repr (h0 ▸ toH4_H4Repr f.v0) (h1 ▸ toH4_H4Repr f.v1) (h2 ▸ toH4_H4Repr f.v2) rfl

name: dI3_hsub_toH4
statement:
private theorem dI3_hsub_toH4 (a b : P3) :
    dI3 (hsub (toH4 b) (toH4 a)) = ((toH4W a : ℚ) * (toH4W b : ℚ)) • (dP3 b - dP3 a)
proof:
:= by
  rw [dI3_hsub, dH4_toH4, dH4_toH4, toH4_w, toH4_w]
  funext i
  fin_cases i <;>
    · simp only [Pi.sub_apply, Pi.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul, dP3]
      ring

name: ScM_hsub_toH4_tr
statement:
private theorem ScM_hsub_toH4_tr (o a b : P3) :
    ScM (((toH4W (psubS a o) : ℚ) * (toH4W (psubS b o) : ℚ))
          / ((toH4W a : ℚ) * (toH4W b : ℚ)))
      (hsub (toH4 b) (toH4 a)) (hsub (toH4 (psubS b o)) (toH4 (psubS a o)))
proof:
:= by
  have hapos : (0 : ℚ) < (toH4W a : ℚ) := by exact_mod_cast toH4W_pos a
  have hbpos : (0 : ℚ) < (toH4W b : ℚ) := by exact_mod_cast toH4W_pos b
  have hane : (toH4W a : ℚ) ≠ 0 := ne_of_gt hapos
  have hbne : (toH4W b : ℚ) ≠ 0 := ne_of_gt hbpos
  have hd : dP3 (psubS b o) - dP3 (psubS a o) = dP3 b - dP3 a := by
    rw [dP3_psubS, dP3_psubS]; abel
  unfold ScM
  rw [dI3_hsub_toH4, dI3_hsub_toH4, hd, smul_smul]
  congr 1
  field_simp

name: ScM_hsub_toH4_tr_pos
proof:
:= by
  have h1 : (0 : ℚ) < (toH4W (psubS a o) : ℚ) := by exact_mod_cast toH4W_pos _
  have h2 : (0 : ℚ) < (toH4W (psubS b o) : ℚ) := by exact_mod_cast toH4W_pos _
  have h3 : (0 : ℚ) < (toH4W a : ℚ) := by exact_mod_cast toH4W_pos a
  have h4 : (0 : ℚ) < (toH4W b : ℚ) := by exact_mod_cast toH4W_pos b
  positivity

name: dotI_nrmI_tr
statement:
theorem dotI_nrmI_tr (o : P3) {f : PFace} (hf : PFaceFaithful f) (di : I3) :
    ∃ c : ℚ, 0 < c ∧
      ((dotI (trPFace o f).nrmI di : ℤ) : ℚ) = c * ((dotI f.nrmI di : ℤ) : ℚ)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨hh0, hh1, hh2⟩ := faithful_mirrors hf
  obtain ⟨-, -, -, -, -, -, hnrm, -, -, -, -⟩ := hf
  have hn : f.nrmI = crossI (hsub (toH4 f.v1) (toH4 f.v0)) (hsub (toH4 f.v2) (toH4 f.v0)) := by
    rw [hnrm, hh0, hh1, hh2]
  have hn' : (trPFace o f).nrmI
      = crossI (hsub (toH4 (psubS f.v1 o)) (toH4 (psubS f.v0 o)))
          (hsub (toH4 (psubS f.v2 o)) (toH4 (psubS f.v0 o))) := rfl
  refine ⟨_, mul_pos (mul_pos (ScM_hsub_toH4_tr_pos o f.v0 f.v1)
    (ScM_hsub_toH4_tr_pos o f.v0 f.v2)) one_pos, ?_⟩
  rw [hn, hn']
  exact ScM_dot (ScM_cross (ScM_hsub_toH4_tr o f.v0 f.v1) (ScM_hsub_toH4_tr o f.v0 f.v2))
    (show ScM 1 di di by unfold ScM; rw [one_smul])

name: faceSideWindings_tr
statement:
theorem faceSideWindings_tr (o : P3) {bvh bvh' : Impl.BVH.BVH} (W : Array PFace)
    (i : Nat) (hi : i < W.size)
    (hq : QSh o bvh bvh') (hW : Faithful W) :
    Impl.WellFormedCheck.faceSideWindings bvh' (W.map (trPFace o)) i
    = Impl.WellFormedCheck.faceSideWindings bvh W i
proof:
:= by
  have hi' : i < (W.map (trPFace o)).size := by rwa [Array.size_map]
  have hgetD : W.getD i default = W[i] := arr_getD_lt _ _ _ hi
  have hgetD' : (W.map (trPFace o)).getD i default = trPFace o W[i] := by
    rw [arr_getD_lt _ _ _ hi', Array.getElem_map]
  have hfaith : PFaceFaithful W[i] := hW _ (Array.getElem_mem hi)
  have hrep := baryH_repr_faithful hfaith
  have hrep' := baryH_repr_faithful (f := trPFace o W[i]) (faithful_trPFace o W[i])
  rw [show (trPFace o W[i]).v0 = psubS W[i].v0 o from rfl,
    show (trPFace o W[i]).v1 = psubS W[i].v1 o from rfl,
    show (trPFace o W[i]).v2 = psubS W[i].v2 o from rfl, barycenter_tr] at hrep'
  simp only [Impl.WellFormedCheck.faceSideWindings, hgetD, hgetD', Array.size_map]
  congr 1
  funext j
  obtain ⟨c, hc, hsc⟩ := dotI_nrmI_tr o hfaith
    (⟨(rayDirAt j).x.num, (rayDirAt j).y.num, (rayDirAt j).z.num⟩ : I3)
  have hp : (0 < dotI (trPFace o W[i]).nrmI
        ⟨(rayDirAt j).x.num, (rayDirAt j).y.num, (rayDirAt j).z.num⟩)
      = (0 < dotI W[i].nrmI ⟨(rayDirAt j).x.num, (rayDirAt j).y.num, (rayDirAt j).z.num⟩) :=
    propext (sc_0lt hc hsc)
  have hn : (dotI (trPFace o W[i]).nrmI
        ⟨(rayDirAt j).x.num, (rayDirAt j).y.num, (rayDirAt j).z.num⟩ < 0)
      = (dotI W[i].nrmI ⟨(rayDirAt j).x.num, (rayDirAt j).y.num, (rayDirAt j).z.num⟩ < 0) :=
    propext (sc_lt0 hc hsc)
  rw [windingRayDirH_tr o W hrep hrep' (rayDirAt j) hq hW
    (CSG.Proof.MeshIntersectRayClassify.p3Int_rayDirAt j)]
  simp only [hp, hn]

name: checkNormalCond_equivariant
statement:
theorem checkNormalCond_equivariant (O : Point) (M : Mesh) :
    Impl.WellFormedCheck.checkNormalCond (trMesh O M) =
    Impl.WellFormedCheck.checkNormalCond M
proof:
:= by
  simp only [Impl.WellFormedCheck.checkNormalCond, Impl.WellFormedCheck.checkNormalCondPre]
  rw [prepare_materialize_tr, materialize_tr, Array.size_map]
  apply all_congr'
  intro i hi
  have hi' : i < (prepare (materialize M)).size := by
    rw [Array.mem_def, Array.toList_range, List.mem_range] at hi
    simpa only [prepare, Array.size_map] using hi
  rw [faceSideWindings_tr (ofPoint O) (prepare (materialize M)) i hi'
    (faceBVH_QSh (ofPoint O) (prepare (materialize M))) (faithful_prepare_materialize M)]

name: dotQ_self_pos
statement: theorem dotQ_self_pos {v : Point} (hv : v ≠ 0) : 0 < dotQ v v
proof:
:= by
  have h0 : 0 ≤ dotQ v v := by
    simp only [dotQ]
    nlinarith [mul_self_nonneg (v 0), mul_self_nonneg (v 1), mul_self_nonneg (v 2)]
  rcases h0.lt_or_eq with h | h
  · exact h
  · exfalso
    apply hv
    simp only [dotQ] at h
    have h₀ : v 0 = 0 := mul_self_eq_zero.mp (by
      nlinarith [mul_self_nonneg (v 1), mul_self_nonneg (v 2)])
    have h₁ : v 1 = 0 := mul_self_eq_zero.mp (by
      nlinarith [mul_self_nonneg (v 0), mul_self_nonneg (v 2)])
    have h₂ : v 2 = 0 := mul_self_eq_zero.mp (by
      nlinarith [mul_self_nonneg (v 0), mul_self_nonneg (v 1)])
    funext i
    fin_cases i
    · exact h₀
    · exact h₁
    · exact h₂

name: sum_classify_flatMap
statement:
theorem sum_classify_flatMap {n : ℕ} (C : ℕ → Array Frag) (p : Frag → Bool)
    (F : Frag → ℤ) :
    ((((Array.range n).flatMap C).filter p).toList.map F).sum
      = ((List.range n).map (fun i =>
          (((C i).filter p).toList.map F).sum)).sum
proof:
:= by
  rw [Array.toList_filter, toList_flatMap_arr, Array.toList_range,
    Proof.MeshIntersectAbel.filter_flatMap, List.map_flatMap,
    List.flatMap_def, List.sum_flatten, List.map_map]
  congr 1
  apply List.map_congr_left
  intro i _
  rw [Function.comp_apply, Array.toList_filter]

name: checkNonDegenerate_spec
statement:
theorem checkNonDegenerate_spec (M : Mesh) :
    Impl.WellFormedCheck.checkNonDegenerate M = true ↔ NoDegenerateFaces M
proof:
:= by
  unfold Impl.WellFormedCheck.checkNonDegenerate
  rw [Array.all_eq_true, NoDegenerateFaces]
  refine forall_congr' (fun i => ?_)
  
  show (!Impl.MeshIntersect.isZeroS
      (Impl.MeshIntersect.crossS
        (Impl.MeshIntersect.psubS (Impl.MeshIntersect.ofPoint M[i].v₁)
          (Impl.MeshIntersect.ofPoint M[i].v₀))
        (Impl.MeshIntersect.psubS (Impl.MeshIntersect.ofPoint M[i].v₂)
          (Impl.MeshIntersect.ofPoint M[i].v₀)))) = true
      ↔ faceNormal M[i] ≠ 0
  set N := Impl.MeshIntersect.crossS
      (Impl.MeshIntersect.psubS (Impl.MeshIntersect.ofPoint M[i].v₁)
        (Impl.MeshIntersect.ofPoint M[i].v₀))
      (Impl.MeshIntersect.psubS (Impl.MeshIntersect.ofPoint M[i].v₂)
        (Impl.MeshIntersect.ofPoint M[i].v₀)) with hN
  
  
  have hx : faceNormal M[i] 0 = N.x := by rw [hN]; rfl
  have hy : faceNormal M[i] 1 = N.y := by rw [hN]; rfl
  have hz : faceNormal M[i] 2 = N.z := by rw [hN]; rfl
  
  have key : Impl.MeshIntersect.isZeroS N = true ↔ faceNormal M[i] = 0 := by
    simp only [Impl.MeshIntersect.isZeroS, Bool.and_eq_true, beq_iff_eq]
    constructor
    · rintro ⟨⟨hx0, hy0⟩, hz0⟩
      funext j
      fin_cases j
      · exact hx.trans hx0
      · exact hy.trans hy0
      · exact hz.trans hz0
    · intro h
      exact ⟨⟨hx ▸ congrFun h 0, hy ▸ congrFun h 1⟩, hz ▸ congrFun h 2⟩
  constructor
  · intro h hfn
    rw [key.mpr hfn] at h
    simp at h
  · intro hfn
    cases hb : Impl.MeshIntersect.isZeroS N with
    | true => exact absurd (key.mp hb) hfn
    | false => rfl

name: coords_of_mem_triangleSet
statement:
theorem coords_of_mem_triangleSet {t : Triangle}
    (b : AffineBasis (Fin 4) ℚ Point) (hbcoe : ⇑b = ![0, t.v₀, t.v₁, t.v₂])
    {z : Point} (hz : z ∈ triangleSet t) :
    b.coord 0 z = 0 ∧ 0 ≤ b.coord 1 z ∧ 0 ≤ b.coord 2 z ∧ 0 ≤ b.coord 3 z
proof:
:= by
  have hb1 : b 1 = t.v₀ := by rw [hbcoe]; rfl
  have hb2 : b 2 = t.v₁ := by rw [hbcoe]; rfl
  have hb3 : b 3 = t.v₂ := by rw [hbcoe]; rfl
  have key : ∀ (j : Fin 4) (s : Set ℚ), Convex ℚ s →
      b.coord j (b 1) ∈ s → b.coord j (b 2) ∈ s → b.coord j (b 3) ∈ s →
      b.coord j z ∈ s := by
    intro j s hs hm1 hm2 hm3
    refine convexHull_min ?_ (hs.affine_preimage (b.coord j)) hz
    rintro y (rfl | rfl | rfl)
    · rw [← hb1]; exact hm1
    · rw [← hb2]; exact hm2
    · rw [← hb3]; exact hm3
  refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · refine key 0 {0} (convex_singleton 0) ?_ ?_ ?_ <;>
      · rw [AffineBasis.coord_apply]
        simp
  · refine key 1 (Set.Ici 0) (convex_Ici 0) ?_ ?_ ?_ <;>
      · rw [AffineBasis.coord_apply]
        split <;> norm_num
  · refine key 2 (Set.Ici 0) (convex_Ici 0) ?_ ?_ ?_ <;>
      · rw [AffineBasis.coord_apply]
        split <;> norm_num
  · refine key 3 (Set.Ici 0) (convex_Ici 0) ?_ ?_ ?_ <;>
      · rw [AffineBasis.coord_apply]
        split <;> norm_num

name: mem_edgeSet_of_coord_zero
statement:
theorem mem_edgeSet_of_coord_zero {t : Triangle}
    (b : AffineBasis (Fin 4) ℚ Point) (hbcoe : ⇑b = ![0, t.v₀, t.v₁, t.v₂])
    {z : Point} (hz : z ∈ triangleSet t)
    (hj : b.coord 1 z = 0 ∨ b.coord 2 z = 0 ∨ b.coord 3 z = 0) :
    z ∈ edgeSet t
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨h0, h1, h2, h3⟩ := coords_of_mem_triangleSet b hbcoe hz
  have hb0 : b 0 = (0 : Point) := by rw [hbcoe]; rfl
  have hb1 : b 1 = t.v₀ := by rw [hbcoe]; rfl
  have hb2 : b 2 = t.v₁ := by rw [hbcoe]; rfl
  have hb3 : b 3 = t.v₂ := by rw [hbcoe]; rfl
  have hsum : b.coord 0 z + b.coord 1 z + b.coord 2 z + b.coord 3 z = 1 := by
    have hs := b.sum_coord_apply_eq_one z
    rw [Fin.sum_univ_four] at hs
    exact hs
  have hrep : z = b.coord 0 z • b 0 + b.coord 1 z • b 1
      + b.coord 2 z • b 2 + b.coord 3 z • b 3 := by
    have h := b.affineCombination_coord_eq_self z
    rw [Finset.affineCombination_eq_linear_combination _ _ _
      (b.sum_coord_apply_eq_one z), Fin.sum_univ_four] at h
    exact h.symm
  rw [hb0, hb1, hb2, hb3, h0, zero_smul, zero_add] at hrep
  show z ∈ segment ℚ t.v₀ t.v₁ ∪ segment ℚ t.v₁ t.v₂ ∪ segment ℚ t.v₂ t.v₀
  rcases hj with h | h | h
  · 
    refine Or.inl (Or.inr ⟨b.coord 2 z, b.coord 3 z, h2, h3, by linarith, ?_⟩)
    rw [h, zero_smul, zero_add] at hrep
    exact hrep.symm
  · 
    refine Or.inr ⟨b.coord 3 z, b.coord 1 z, h3, h1, by linarith, ?_⟩
    rw [h, zero_smul, add_zero] at hrep
    conv_rhs => rw [hrep]
    abel
  · 
    refine Or.inl (Or.inl ⟨b.coord 1 z, b.coord 2 z, h1, h2, by linarith, ?_⟩)
    rw [h, zero_smul, add_zero] at hrep
    exact hrep.symm

name: face_jump_base
statement:
theorem face_jump_base {t : Triangle} (hdet : detOrigin t ≠ 0)
    {z pP pM v : Point}
    (hmem : z ∈ triangleSet t) (hedge : z ∉ edgeSet t)
    (hstab : ∀ g ∈ tetraHalves t, g.eval z ≠ 0 →
      ((0 < g.eval pP ↔ 0 < g.eval z) ∧ (0 < g.eval pM ↔ 0 < g.eval z)
        ∧ g.eval pP ≠ 0 ∧ g.eval pM ≠ 0))
    (hact : ∀ g ∈ tetraHalves t, g.eval z = 0 →
      (dotQ g.n v ≠ 0 ∧ (0 < g.eval pP ↔ 0 < dotQ g.n v)
        ∧ (0 < g.eval pM ↔ dotQ g.n v < 0) ∧ g.eval pP ≠ 0 ∧ g.eval pM ≠ 0)) :
    ((if pP ∈ simplex t then (1:ℤ) else 0)
        - (if pM ∈ simplex t then (1:ℤ) else 0)
      = qsign (dotQ (slot t 3).n v))
    ∧ ((faceEdges t).map (jump z v)).sum = 0
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have hdet3 : det3 t.v₀ t.v₁ t.v₂ ≠ 0 := by
    rw [det3_eq_detOrigin]
    exact hdet
  have hAI := (det3_ne_zero_iff_originApex_affineIndependent t).mp hdet3
  obtain ⟨b, a₀, hbcoe, _hbset, _⟩ :=
    Proof.AffineBasisSimplex.simplexAffineBasis t hAI
  have hb0 : b 0 = (0 : Point) := by rw [hbcoe]; rfl
  have hb1 : b 1 = t.v₀ := by rw [hbcoe]; rfl
  have hb2 : b 2 = t.v₁ := by rw [hbcoe]; rfl
  have hb3 : b 3 = t.v₂ := by rw [hbcoe]; rfl
  set μ : Fin 4 → ℚ := fun j => b.coord j z with hμdef
  
  obtain ⟨hμ0, hμ1n, hμ2n, hμ3n⟩ := coords_of_mem_triangleSet b hbcoe hmem
  have hμ1 : 0 < μ 1 := lt_of_le_of_ne hμ1n fun h =>
    hedge (mem_edgeSet_of_coord_zero b hbcoe hmem (Or.inl h.symm))
  have hμ2 : 0 < μ 2 := lt_of_le_of_ne hμ2n fun h =>
    hedge (mem_edgeSet_of_coord_zero b hbcoe hmem (Or.inr (Or.inl h.symm)))
  have hμ3 : 0 < μ 3 := lt_of_le_of_ne hμ3n fun h =>
    hedge (mem_edgeSet_of_coord_zero b hbcoe hmem (Or.inr (Or.inr h.symm)))
  
  have hkey : ∀ k : Fin 4, ∃ lam : ℚ, 0 < lam ∧
      ∀ u, (slot t k).eval u = lam * b.coord (slotIdx k) u := by
    intro k
    obtain ⟨lam, hlam, heq⟩ := slot_coord hdet3 b hbcoe k
    exact ⟨lam, hlam, fun u => DFunLike.congr_fun heq u⟩
  choose lam hlam hev using hkey
  
  have hbase0 : (slot t 3).eval z = 0 := by
    rw [hev 3 z, show slotIdx 3 = 0 from rfl]
    have hμ0' : μ 0 = 0 := hμ0
    show lam 3 * μ 0 = 0
    rw [hμ0', mul_zero]
  have hlatpos : ∀ k : Fin 4, k ≠ 3 → 0 < (slot t k).eval z := by
    intro k hk
    rw [hev k z]
    apply mul_pos (hlam k)
    fin_cases k
    · exact hμ1
    · exact hμ2
    · exact hμ3
    · exact absurd rfl hk
  constructor
  · 
    obtain ⟨hD, hPiff, hMiff, hPne, hMne⟩ := hact (slot t 3) (slot_mem t 3) hbase0
    have hlatP : ∀ k : Fin 4, k ≠ 3 →
        0 < (slot t k).eval pP ∧ 0 < (slot t k).eval pM := by
      intro k hk
      have hzpos := hlatpos k hk
      obtain ⟨h1, h2, -, -⟩ := hstab (slot t k) (slot_mem t k) (ne_of_gt hzpos)
      exact ⟨h1.mpr hzpos, h2.mpr hzpos⟩
    rcases lt_or_gt_of_ne hD with hDn | hDp
    · 
      have hPout : pP ∉ simplex t := by
        rw [mem_simplex_iff_slots hdet3]
        push_neg
        refine ⟨3, ?_⟩
        have hnot : ¬ 0 < (slot t 3).eval pP := fun h => by
          have := hPiff.mp h
          linarith
        rcases lt_or_gt_of_ne hPne with h | h
        · exact h
        · exact absurd h hnot
      have hMin : pM ∈ simplex t := by
        rw [mem_simplex_iff_slots hdet3]
        intro k
        by_cases hk : k = 3
        · subst hk
          exact (hMiff.mpr hDn).le
        · exact (hlatP k hk).2.le
      rw [if_neg hPout, if_pos hMin, qsign_of_neg hDn]
      norm_num
    · 
      have hPin : pP ∈ simplex t := by
        rw [mem_simplex_iff_slots hdet3]
        intro k
        by_cases hk : k = 3
        · subst hk
          exact (hPiff.mpr hDp).le
        · exact (hlatP k hk).1.le
      have hMout : pM ∉ simplex t := by
        rw [mem_simplex_iff_slots hdet3]
        push_neg
        refine ⟨3, ?_⟩
        have hnot : ¬ 0 < (slot t 3).eval pM := fun h => by
          have := hMiff.mp h
          linarith
        rcases lt_or_gt_of_ne hMne with h | h
        · exact h
        · exact absurd h hnot
      rw [if_pos hPin, if_neg hMout, qsign_of_pos hDp]
      norm_num
  · 
    have hcone01 : z ∈ openCone2 t.v₀ t.v₁
        ↔ (0 < μ 0 ∧ 0 < μ 1 ∧ 0 < μ 2 ∧ μ 3 = 0) := by
      rw [← hb1, ← hb2]
      exact cone_coord_12 hb0 z
    have hcone12 : z ∈ openCone2 t.v₁ t.v₂
        ↔ (0 < μ 0 ∧ 0 < μ 2 ∧ 0 < μ 3 ∧ μ 1 = 0) := by
      rw [← hb2, ← hb3]
      exact cone_coord_23 hb0 z
    have hcone20 : z ∈ openCone2 t.v₂ t.v₀
        ↔ (0 < μ 0 ∧ 0 < μ 3 ∧ 0 < μ 1 ∧ μ 2 = 0) := by
      rw [← hb3, ← hb1]
      exact cone_coord_31 hb0 z
    have hj01 : jump z v (t.v₀, t.v₁) = 0 := by
      rw [show jump z v (t.v₀, t.v₁) = if z ∈ openCone2 t.v₀ t.v₁ then
        qsign (dotQ (crossQ t.v₀ t.v₁) v) else 0 from rfl, if_neg]
      intro hc
      have hμ0' : μ 0 = 0 := hμ0
      have := (hcone01.mp hc).1
      rw [hμ0'] at this
      exact lt_irrefl 0 this
    have hj12 : jump z v (t.v₁, t.v₂) = 0 := by
      rw [show jump z v (t.v₁, t.v₂) = if z ∈ openCone2 t.v₁ t.v₂ then
        qsign (dotQ (crossQ t.v₁ t.v₂) v) else 0 from rfl, if_neg]
      intro hc
      have hμ0' : μ 0 = 0 := hμ0
      have := (hcone12.mp hc).1
      rw [hμ0'] at this
      exact lt_irrefl 0 this
    have hj20 : jump z v (t.v₂, t.v₀) = 0 := by
      rw [show jump z v (t.v₂, t.v₀) = if z ∈ openCone2 t.v₂ t.v₀ then
        qsign (dotQ (crossQ t.v₂ t.v₀) v) else 0 from rfl, if_neg]
      intro hc
      have hμ0' : μ 0 = 0 := hμ0
      have := (hcone20.mp hc).1
      rw [hμ0'] at this
      exact lt_irrefl 0 this
    simp only [faceEdges, List.map_cons, List.map_nil, List.sum_cons,
      List.sum_nil, hj01, hj12, hj20]
    ring

name: sum_map_toList
statement:
theorem sum_map_toList {α : Type} (a : Array α) (F : α → ℤ) :
    (a.toList.map F).sum = ∑ i : Fin a.size, F (a[i])
proof:
:= by
  conv_lhs => rw [← List.ofFn_getElem (a.toList.map F)]
  rw [List.sum_ofFn]
  refine Fintype.sum_equiv
    (finCongr (by rw [List.length_map, Array.length_toList])) _ _ (fun k => ?_)
  rw [List.getElem_map]
  congr 1

name: event_jump_base
statement:
theorem event_jump_base {M : Mesh} {x y : Point}
    (hcyc : IsClosedOrientedSurface M) (hnpo : NoPlaneThroughOrigin M)
    (hns : NoFaceInteriorContact M)
    (hG1 : ∀ (i : Fin M.size), ∀ g ∈ tetraHalves M[i],
      g.eval x ≠ 0 ∧ g.eval y ≠ 0)
    (hG2 : ∀ (i : Fin M.size), ∀ g ∈ tetraHalves M[i],
      ∀ g' ∈ tetraHalves M[i], g ≠ g' → ∀ τ : ℚ, 0 < τ → τ < 1 →
        ¬ (g.eval (seg x y τ) = 0 ∧ g'.eval (seg x y τ) = 0))
    {τ δ : ℚ} (hτ0 : 0 < τ) (hτ1 : τ < 1) (hδ : 0 < δ)
    (istar : Fin M.size)
    (hmem : seg x y τ ∈ triangleSet M[istar])
    (hedge : seg x y τ ∉ edgeSet M[istar])
    (hstabw : ∀ (i : Fin M.size), ∀ g ∈ tetraHalves M[i],
      g.eval (seg x y τ) ≠ 0 →
      ((0 < g.eval (seg x y (τ + δ)) ↔ 0 < g.eval (seg x y τ)) ∧
       (0 < g.eval (seg x y (τ - δ)) ↔ 0 < g.eval (seg x y τ)) ∧
       g.eval (seg x y (τ + δ)) ≠ 0 ∧ g.eval (seg x y (τ - δ)) ≠ 0)) :
    winding (meshChain M) (seg x y (τ + δ))
      - winding (meshChain M) (seg x y (τ - δ))
      = orientSign M[istar] * qsign (dotQ (slot M[istar] 3).n (psub y x))
proof:
:= by
  classical
  set v := psub y x with hv
  set z := seg x y τ with hzdef
  set pP := seg x y (τ + δ) with hpP
  set pM := seg x y (τ - δ) with hpM
  set J : ℤ := orientSign M[istar] * qsign (dotQ (slot M[istar] 3).n v)
    with hJ
  
  have hact : ∀ (i : Fin M.size), ∀ g ∈ tetraHalves M[i], g.eval z = 0 →
      (dotQ g.n v ≠ 0 ∧ (0 < g.eval pP ↔ 0 < dotQ g.n v)
        ∧ (0 < g.eval pM ↔ dotQ g.n v < 0) ∧ g.eval pP ≠ 0 ∧ g.eval pM ≠ 0) := by
    intro i g hg hgz
    have hlz : g.eval x + τ * dotQ g.n v = 0 := by
      rw [← eval_seg]
      exact hgz
    have hD : dotQ g.n v ≠ 0 := by
      intro hD0
      rw [hD0, mul_zero, add_zero] at hlz
      exact (hG1 i g hg).1 hlz
    have hPv : g.eval pP = δ * dotQ g.n v := by
      rw [hpP, eval_seg, ← hv]
      linear_combination hlz
    have hMv : g.eval pM = - δ * dotQ g.n v := by
      rw [hpM, eval_seg, ← hv]
      linear_combination hlz
    refine ⟨hD, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
    · rw [hPv]
      constructor
      · intro h
        by_contra hc
        push_neg at hc
        nlinarith
      · intro h
        exact mul_pos hδ h
    · rw [hMv]
      constructor
      · intro h
        by_contra hc
        push_neg at hc
        nlinarith
      · intro h
        nlinarith
    · rw [hPv]
      exact mul_ne_zero (ne_of_gt hδ) hD
    · rw [hMv]
      exact mul_ne_zero (by linarith) hD
  
  have hidx : ∀ i : Fin M.size,
      orientSign M[i] * ((if pP ∈ simplex M[i] then (1:ℤ) else 0)
          - (if pM ∈ simplex M[i] then (1:ℤ) else 0))
        = (if i = istar then J else 0)
          + ((faceEdges M[i]).map (jump z v)).sum := by
    intro i
    by_cases hi : i = istar
    · subst hi
      obtain ⟨hb, hz0⟩ := face_jump_base (hnpo i) hmem hedge
        (fun g hg => hstabw i g hg) (fun g hg => hact i g hg)
      rw [if_pos rfl, hz0, add_zero]
      rw [hb]
    · rw [if_neg hi, zero_add]
      have hH1z : z ∉ triangleSet M[i] := by
        intro hzin
        exact hedge (hns istar i (fun hc => hi hc.symm) ⟨hmem, hzin⟩)
      have hsingle : ∀ g ∈ tetraHalves M[i], ∀ g' ∈ tetraHalves M[i],
          g.eval z = 0 → g'.eval z = 0 → g = g' := by
        intro g hg g' hg' hgz hgz'
        by_contra hne
        exact hG2 i g hg g' hg' hne τ hτ0 hτ1 ⟨hgz, hgz'⟩
      exact face_jump (hnpo i) hH1z hsingle
        (fun g hg => hstabw i g hg) (fun g hg => hact i g hg)
  
  rw [winding_meshChain_eq, winding_meshChain_eq, list_sum_map_sub,
    sum_map_toList]
  have hsum : ∑ i : Fin M.size,
      (orientSign M[i] * (if pP ∈ simplex M[i] then (1:ℤ) else 0)
        - orientSign M[i] * (if pM ∈ simplex M[i] then (1:ℤ) else 0))
      = ∑ i : Fin M.size, ((if i = istar then J else 0)
          + ((faceEdges M[i]).map (jump z v)).sum) := by
    refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun i _ => ?_
    rw [← mul_sub]
    exact hidx i
  rw [hsum, Finset.sum_add_distrib, Finset.sum_ite_eq' Finset.univ istar
    (fun _ => J)]
  have hzero : ∑ i : Fin M.size, ((faceEdges M[i]).map (jump z v)).sum = 0 := by
    rw [← sum_map_toList M (fun t => ((faceEdges t).map (jump z v)).sum),
      list_sum_flat]
    have hodd := odd_sum_swap_invariant (S := edgeMultiset M) hcyc (jump_swap z v)
    rw [edgeMultiset, Multiset.map_coe, Multiset.sum_coe] at hodd
    exact hodd
  rw [hzero, add_zero, if_pos (Finset.mem_univ istar)]

name: winding_jump_single
statement:
theorem winding_jump_single {M : Mesh} {x y : Point}
    (hcyc : IsClosedOrientedSurface M) (hnpo : NoPlaneThroughOrigin M)
    (hns : NoFaceInteriorContact M)
    (istar : Fin M.size) {τs : ℚ} (hτ0 : 0 < τs) (hτ1 : τs < 1)
    (hmem : seg x y τs ∈ triangleSet M[istar])
    (hedge : seg x y τs ∉ edgeSet M[istar])
    (hH1 : ∀ (i : Fin M.size) (τ : ℚ), 0 < τ → τ < 1 → τ ≠ τs →
      seg x y τ ∉ triangleSet M[i])
    (hG1 : ∀ (i : Fin M.size), ∀ g ∈ tetraHalves M[i],
      g.eval x ≠ 0 ∧ g.eval y ≠ 0)
    (hG2 : ∀ (i : Fin M.size), ∀ g ∈ tetraHalves M[i],
      ∀ g' ∈ tetraHalves M[i], g ≠ g' → ∀ τ : ℚ, 0 < τ → τ < 1 →
        ¬ (g.eval (seg x y τ) = 0 ∧ g'.eval (seg x y τ) = 0)) :
    winding (meshChain M) y - winding (meshChain M) x
      = orientSign M[istar] * qsign (dotQ (slot M[istar] 3).n (psub y x))
proof:
:= by
  classical
  obtain ⟨δ₀, hδ₀, hwin⟩ := window_list (meshHalves M) x y τs
  set δ := min (min (τs/2) ((1 - τs)/2)) δ₀ with hδdef
  have hδpos : 0 < δ := lt_min (lt_min (by linarith) (by linarith)) hδ₀
  have hδτ : δ ≤ τs/2 := le_trans (min_le_left _ _) (min_le_left _ _)
  have hδ1 : δ ≤ (1 - τs)/2 := le_trans (min_le_left _ _) (min_le_right _ _)
  have hδδ0 : δ ≤ δ₀ := min_le_right _ _
  
  have hend : ∀ (i : Fin M.size), ∀ g ∈ tetraHalves M[i],
      g.eval (seg x y (τs - δ)) ≠ 0 ∧ g.eval (seg x y (τs + δ)) ≠ 0 := by
    intro i g hg
    by_cases hne : g.eval (seg x y τs) = 0
    · have hlz : g.eval x + τs * dotQ g.n (psub y x) = 0 := by
        rw [← eval_seg]
        exact hne
      have hD : dotQ g.n (psub y x) ≠ 0 := by
        intro h0
        rw [h0, mul_zero, add_zero] at hlz
        exact (hG1 i g hg).1 hlz
      constructor
      · rw [eval_seg]
        intro hc
        apply hD
        have hδD : δ * dotQ g.n (psub y x) = 0 := by
          linear_combination hlz - hc
        exact (mul_eq_zero.mp hδD).resolve_left (ne_of_gt hδpos)
      · rw [eval_seg]
        intro hc
        apply hD
        have hδD : δ * dotQ g.n (psub y x) = 0 := by
          linear_combination hc - hlz
        exact (mul_eq_zero.mp hδD).resolve_left (ne_of_gt hδpos)
    · have hw := hwin g (mem_meshHalves.mpr ⟨i, hg⟩) hne δ hδpos hδδ0
      exact ⟨hw.2.2.2, hw.2.2.1⟩
  
  have hstabw : ∀ (i : Fin M.size), ∀ g ∈ tetraHalves M[i],
      g.eval (seg x y τs) ≠ 0 →
      ((0 < g.eval (seg x y (τs + δ)) ↔ 0 < g.eval (seg x y τs)) ∧
       (0 < g.eval (seg x y (τs - δ)) ↔ 0 < g.eval (seg x y τs)) ∧
       g.eval (seg x y (τs + δ)) ≠ 0 ∧ g.eval (seg x y (τs - δ)) ≠ 0) := by
    intro i g hg hne
    exact hwin g (mem_meshHalves.mpr ⟨i, hg⟩) hne δ hδpos hδδ0
  
  have hend0 : ∀ (i : Fin M.size), ∀ g ∈ tetraHalves M[i],
      g.eval (seg x y 0) ≠ 0 := by
    intro i g hg
    rw [seg_zero]
    exact (hG1 i g hg).1
  have hend1 : ∀ (i : Fin M.size), ∀ g ∈ tetraHalves M[i],
      g.eval (seg x y 1) ≠ 0 := by
    intro i g hg
    rw [seg_one]
    exact (hG1 i g hg).2
  
  have h1 : winding (meshChain M) (seg x y 0)
      = winding (meshChain M) (seg x y (τs - δ)) := by
    apply sweep hcyc hnpo hG1 hG2
      (((rootsOf M x y).filter (fun τ' => (0:ℚ) < τ' ∧ τ' < τs - δ)).card)
      0 (τs - δ) le_rfl (by linarith) (by linarith)
      (fun i τ' ht0 ht1 => hH1 i τ' ht0 (by linarith) (by linarith))
      hend0 (fun i g hg => (hend i g hg).1) le_rfl
  
  have h2 : winding (meshChain M) (seg x y (τs + δ))
      = winding (meshChain M) (seg x y 1) := by
    apply sweep hcyc hnpo hG1 hG2
      (((rootsOf M x y).filter (fun τ' => τs + δ < τ' ∧ τ' < 1)).card)
      (τs + δ) 1 (by linarith) (by linarith) le_rfl
      (fun i τ' ht0 ht1 => hH1 i τ' (by linarith) ht1 (by linarith))
      (fun i g hg => (hend i g hg).2) hend1 le_rfl
  
  have h3 := event_jump_base hcyc hnpo hns hG1 hG2 hτ0 hτ1 hδpos istar
    hmem hedge hstabw
  rw [seg_zero] at h1
  rw [seg_one] at h2
  rw [← h2, h1]
  exact h3

name: faceNormal_offset
statement:
theorem faceNormal_offset (t : Triangle) :
    dotQ (faceNormal t) t.v₀ = detOrigin t
proof:
:= by
  rw [faceNormal, dotQ_crossQ_det, ← det3_eq_detOrigin]
  simp only [det3_expand, psub]
  ring

name: slot3_n_sign
statement:
theorem slot3_n_sign {t : Triangle} (hdet : detOrigin t ≠ 0) (u : Point) :
    dotQ (slot t 3).n u = -(orientSign t : ℚ) * dotQ (faceNormal t) u
proof:
:= by
  have hb : dotQ (crossQ (psub t.v₁ t.v₀) (psub t.v₂ t.v₀)) t.v₀ = detOrigin t :=
    faceNormal_offset t
  have hslot : slot t 3
      = (if dotQ (crossQ (psub t.v₁ t.v₀) (psub t.v₂ t.v₀)) t.v₀ ≤ 0
         then (⟨crossQ (psub t.v₁ t.v₀) (psub t.v₂ t.v₀),
               dotQ (crossQ (psub t.v₁ t.v₀) (psub t.v₂ t.v₀)) t.v₀⟩ : Half)
         else Half.neg ⟨crossQ (psub t.v₁ t.v₀) (psub t.v₂ t.v₀),
               dotQ (crossQ (psub t.v₁ t.v₀) (psub t.v₂ t.v₀)) t.v₀⟩) := rfl
  unfold orientSign
  rcases hdet.lt_or_lt with hlt | hgt
  · rw [hslot, if_pos (by rw [hb]; linarith), if_neg (by linarith), if_pos hlt]
    show dotQ (crossQ (psub t.v₁ t.v₀) (psub t.v₂ t.v₀)) u = _
    rw [faceNormal]
    push_cast
    ring
  · rw [hslot, if_neg (by rw [hb]; linarith), if_pos hgt]
    show dotQ (psub (mkPoint 0 0 0)
      (crossQ (psub t.v₁ t.v₀) (psub t.v₂ t.v₀))) u = _
    rw [dotQ_neg_normal, faceNormal]
    push_cast
    ring

name: orientSign_mul_qsign_slot3
statement:
theorem orientSign_mul_qsign_slot3 {t : Triangle} (hdet : detOrigin t ≠ 0)
    (v : Point) :
    orientSign t * qsign (dotQ (slot t 3).n v)
      = - qsign (dotQ (faceNormal t) v)
proof:
:= by
  rw [slot3_n_sign hdet v]
  rcases orientSign_cases hdet with h | h <;> rw [h]
  · rw [show -(((1 : ℤ) : ℚ)) * dotQ (faceNormal t) v
        = -(dotQ (faceNormal t) v) by push_cast; ring, qsign_neg]
    ring
  · rw [show -(((-1 : ℤ) : ℚ)) * dotQ (faceNormal t) v
        = dotQ (faceNormal t) v by push_cast; ring]
    ring

name: jump_normal_form
statement:
theorem jump_normal_form {M : Mesh} {x y : Point}
    (hcyc : IsClosedOrientedSurface M) (hnpo : NoPlaneThroughOrigin M)
    (hns : NoFaceInteriorContact M)
    (istar : Fin M.size) {τs : ℚ} (hτ0 : 0 < τs) (hτ1 : τs < 1)
    (hmem : seg x y τs ∈ triangleSet M[istar])
    (hedge : seg x y τs ∉ edgeSet M[istar])
    (hH1 : ∀ (i : Fin M.size) (τ : ℚ), 0 < τ → τ < 1 → τ ≠ τs →
      seg x y τ ∉ triangleSet M[i])
    (hG1 : ∀ (i : Fin M.size), ∀ g ∈ tetraHalves M[i],
      g.eval x ≠ 0 ∧ g.eval y ≠ 0)
    (hG2 : ∀ (i : Fin M.size), ∀ g ∈ tetraHalves M[i],
      ∀ g' ∈ tetraHalves M[i], g ≠ g' → ∀ τ : ℚ, 0 < τ → τ < 1 →
        ¬ (g.eval (seg x y τ) = 0 ∧ g'.eval (seg x y τ) = 0)) :
    winding (meshChain M) y - winding (meshChain M) x
      = - qsign (dotQ (faceNormal M[istar]) (psub y x))
proof:
:= by
  rw [winding_jump_single hcyc hnpo hns istar hτ0 hτ1 hmem hedge hH1 hG1 hG2]
  exact orientSign_mul_qsign_slot3 (hnpo istar) (psub y x)

name: p3_ext
statement:
theorem p3_ext {u v : P3} (hx : u.x = v.x) (hy : u.y = v.y) (hz : u.z = v.z) :
    u = v
proof:
:= by
  cases u; cases v; cases hx; cases hy; cases hz; rfl

name: beqS_iff
statement: theorem beqS_iff {u v : P3} : beqS u v = true ↔ u = v
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro h
    simp only [beqS, Bool.and_eq_true, beq_iff_eq] at h
    exact p3_ext h.1.1 h.1.2 h.2
  · rintro rfl
    simp [beqS]

name: toPoint_inj
statement: theorem toPoint_inj {u v : P3} (h : P3.toPoint u = P3.toPoint v) : u = v
proof:
:= by
  have := congrArg ofPoint h
  rwa [toPoint_ofPoint, toPoint_ofPoint] at this

name: p3Lt_iff
statement:
theorem p3Lt_iff {u v : P3} : p3Lt u v = true
    ↔ u.x < v.x ∨ (u.x = v.x ∧ (u.y < v.y ∨ (u.y = v.y ∧ u.z < v.z)))
proof:
:= by
  rw [p3Lt]
  by_cases hx : u.x = v.x
  · by_cases hy : u.y = v.y
    · simp [hx, hy]
    · simp [hx, hy, lt_irrefl]
  · simp [hx, fun h : u.x < v.x => ne_of_lt h]

name: p3Lt_irrefl
statement: theorem p3Lt_irrefl (u : P3) : p3Lt u u = false
proof:
:= by
  rw [Bool.eq_false_iff, Ne, p3Lt_iff]
  rintro (h | ⟨-, h | ⟨-, h⟩⟩) <;> exact lt_irrefl _ h

name: p3Lt_trichotomy
statement:
theorem p3Lt_trichotomy (u v : P3) :
    p3Lt u v = true ∨ p3Lt v u = true ∨ u = v
proof:
:= by
  rcases lt_trichotomy u.x v.x with h | hx | h
  · exact Or.inl (p3Lt_iff.mpr (Or.inl h))
  · rcases lt_trichotomy u.y v.y with h | hy | h
    · exact Or.inl (p3Lt_iff.mpr (Or.inr ⟨hx, Or.inl h⟩))
    · rcases lt_trichotomy u.z v.z with h | hz | h
      · exact Or.inl (p3Lt_iff.mpr (Or.inr ⟨hx, Or.inr ⟨hy, h⟩⟩))
      · exact Or.inr (Or.inr (p3_ext hx hy hz))
      · exact Or.inr (Or.inl (p3Lt_iff.mpr (Or.inr ⟨hx.symm, Or.inr ⟨hy.symm, h⟩⟩)))
    · exact Or.inr (Or.inl (p3Lt_iff.mpr (Or.inr ⟨hx.symm, Or.inl h⟩)))
  · exact Or.inr (Or.inl (p3Lt_iff.mpr (Or.inl h)))

name: p3Lt_asymm
statement: theorem p3Lt_asymm {u v : P3} (h : p3Lt u v = true) : p3Lt v u = false
proof:
:= by
  rw [Bool.eq_false_iff, Ne, p3Lt_iff]
  rw [p3Lt_iff] at h
  rcases h with h | ⟨hx, h | ⟨hy, h⟩⟩ <;>
    rintro (h' | ⟨hx', h' | ⟨hy', h'⟩⟩) <;> first
      | exact lt_irrefl _ (lt_trans h h')
      | (exact absurd (hx ▸ h') (lt_irrefl _))
      | (exact absurd (hx' ▸ h) (lt_irrefl _))
      | (exact absurd (hy ▸ h') (lt_irrefl _))
      | (exact absurd (hy' ▸ h) (lt_irrefl _))

name: p3Lt_trans
statement:
theorem p3Lt_trans {u v w : P3} (h₁ : p3Lt u v = true) (h₂ : p3Lt v w = true) :
    p3Lt u w = true
proof:
:= by
  rw [p3Lt_iff] at h₁ h₂ ⊢
  rcases h₁ with h | ⟨hx, h₁⟩
  · rcases h₂ with h' | ⟨hx', -⟩
    · exact Or.inl (lt_trans h h')
    · exact Or.inl (hx' ▸ h)
  · rcases h₂ with h' | ⟨hx', h₂⟩
    · exact Or.inl (hx ▸ h')
    · refine Or.inr ⟨hx.trans hx', ?_⟩
      rcases h₁ with h | ⟨hy, h₁⟩
      · rcases h₂ with h' | ⟨hy', -⟩
        · exact Or.inl (lt_trans h h')
        · exact Or.inl (hy' ▸ h)
      · rcases h₂ with h' | ⟨hy', h₂⟩
        · exact Or.inl (hy ▸ h')
        · exact Or.inr ⟨hy.trans hy', lt_trans h₁ h₂⟩

name: p3Lt_of_p3Le_of_ne
statement:
theorem p3Lt_of_p3Le_of_ne {u v : P3} (h : p3Le u v = true) (hne : u ≠ v) :
    p3Lt u v = true
proof:
:= by
  rcases p3Lt_trichotomy u v with h1 | h1 | h1
  · exact h1
  · rw [p3Le, h1] at h
    simp at h
  · exact absurd h1 hne

name: p3Le_of_p3Lt
statement: theorem p3Le_of_p3Lt {u v : P3} (h : p3Lt u v = true) : p3Le u v = true
proof:
:= by
  rw [p3Le, p3Lt_asymm h]
  rfl

name: p3Le_refl
statement: theorem p3Le_refl (u : P3) : p3Le u u = true
proof:
:= by
  rw [p3Le, p3Lt_irrefl]
  rfl

name: p3Le_total
statement: theorem p3Le_total (u v : P3) : p3Le u v = true ∨ p3Le v u = true
proof:
:= by
  rcases p3Lt_trichotomy u v with h | h | h
  · exact Or.inl (p3Le_of_p3Lt h)
  · exact Or.inr (p3Le_of_p3Lt h)
  · exact h ▸ Or.inl (p3Le_refl u)

name: p3Le_trans
statement:
theorem p3Le_trans {u v w : P3} (h₁ : p3Le u v = true) (h₂ : p3Le v w = true) :
    p3Le u w = true
proof:
:= by
  by_cases huv : u = v
  · exact huv ▸ h₂
  by_cases hvw : v = w
  · exact hvw ▸ h₁
  exact p3Le_of_p3Lt
    (p3Lt_trans (p3Lt_of_p3Le_of_ne h₁ huv) (p3Lt_of_p3Le_of_ne h₂ hvw))

name: p3Lt_of_p3Lt_of_p3Le
statement:
theorem p3Lt_of_p3Lt_of_p3Le {u v w : P3} (h₁ : p3Lt u v = true)
    (h₂ : p3Le v w = true) : p3Lt u w = true
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hvw : v = w
  · exact hvw ▸ h₁
  exact p3Lt_trans h₁ (p3Lt_of_p3Le_of_ne h₂ hvw)

name: vertexUniverse_eq
statement:
private theorem vertexUniverse_eq (K : Array Frag) :
    vertexUniverse K
      = ((K.flatMap (fun f => f.poly)).toList.mergeSort
          (fun a b => p3Le a.p b.p)).toArray.foldl dstep #[]
proof: := rfl

name: back
statement:
private theorem back?_eq_getLast? {α : Type*} (a : Array α) :
    a.back? = a.toList.getLast?
proof:
:= by
  rcases a with ⟨l⟩
  simp [Array.back?, List.getLast?_eq_getElem?]

name: pairwise_lt_getLast
statement:
private theorem pairwise_lt_getLast {l : List Vtx}
    (hl : l.Pairwise (fun a b => p3Lt a.p b.p = true))
    {u a : Vtx} (hu : l.getLast? = some u) (ha : a ∈ l) (hne : a ≠ u) :
    p3Lt a.p u.p = true
proof:
:= by
  have hlne : l ≠ [] := by
    rintro rfl
    simp at hu
  have hlen : 0 < l.length := List.length_pos.mpr hlne
  rw [List.getLast?_eq_getElem?, List.getElem?_eq_some_iff] at hu
  obtain ⟨hlast_lt, hu'⟩ := hu
  obtain ⟨i, hi, hai⟩ := List.getElem_of_mem ha
  have hine : i ≠ l.length - 1 := by
    intro hc
    subst hc
    exact hne (hai.symm.trans hu')
  have hilt : i < l.length - 1 := by omega
  have := List.pairwise_iff_getElem.mp hl i (l.length - 1) hi (by omega) hilt
  subst hai
  subst hu'
  exact this

name: dstep_fold_invariant
statement:
private theorem dstep_fold_invariant :
    ∀ (l : List Vtx) (acc : Array Vtx),
      acc.toList.Pairwise (fun a b => p3Lt a.p b.p = true) →
      (∀ a ∈ acc.toList, ∀ v ∈ l, p3Le a.p v.p = true) →
      l.Pairwise (fun a b => p3Le a.p b.p = true) →
      (l.foldl dstep acc).toList.Pairwise (fun a b => p3Lt a.p b.p = true)
        ∧ ∀ a ∈ (l.foldl dstep acc).toList, a ∈ acc.toList ∨ a ∈ l
proof:
:= by
  intro l
  induction l with
  | nil =>
    intro acc hacc _ _
    exact ⟨hacc, fun a ha => Or.inl ha⟩
  | cons v rest ih =>
    intro acc hacc hbound hsorted
    rw [List.foldl_cons]
    have hrest_sorted : rest.Pairwise (fun a b => p3Le a.p b.p = true) :=
      (List.pairwise_cons.mp hsorted).2
    have hv_le_rest : ∀ x ∈ rest, p3Le v.p x.p = true :=
      (List.pairwise_cons.mp hsorted).1
    have hpush : (acc.push v).toList = acc.toList ++ [v] := by simp
    
    have hkey : (∀ a ∈ acc.toList, p3Lt a.p v.p = true) →
        (List.foldl dstep (acc.push v) rest).toList.Pairwise
            (fun a b => p3Lt a.p b.p = true)
          ∧ ∀ a ∈ (List.foldl dstep (acc.push v) rest).toList,
              a ∈ acc.toList ∨ a ∈ v :: rest := by
      intro hstrict
      obtain ⟨hp, hm⟩ := ih (acc.push v)
        (by
          rw [hpush, List.pairwise_append]
          exact ⟨hacc, by simp, by
            intro a ha b hb'
            simp only [List.mem_singleton] at hb'
            exact hb' ▸ hstrict a ha⟩)
        (by
          intro a ha x hx
          rw [hpush] at ha
          rcases List.mem_append.mp ha with h | h
          · exact hbound a h x (List.mem_cons_of_mem _ hx)
          · simp only [List.mem_singleton] at h
            exact h ▸ hv_le_rest x hx)
        hrest_sorted
      refine ⟨hp, fun a ha => ?_⟩
      rcases hm a ha with h | h
      · rw [hpush] at h
        rcases List.mem_append.mp h with h' | h'
        · exact Or.inl h'
        · simp only [List.mem_singleton] at h'
          exact Or.inr (h' ▸ List.mem_cons_self _ _)
      · exact Or.inr (List.mem_cons_of_mem _ h)
    rcases hb : acc.back? with - | u
    · 
      have hae : acc.toList = [] := by
        rw [back?_eq_getLast?] at hb
        exact List.getLast?_eq_none_iff.mp hb
      have h1 : (dstep acc v) = acc.push v := by
        unfold dstep
        rw [hb]
      rw [h1]
      exact hkey (by rw [hae]; simp)
    · 
      have hu_mem : u ∈ acc.toList := by
        rw [back?_eq_getLast?] at hb
        exact List.mem_of_mem_getLast? hb
      by_cases heq : beqS u.p v.p = true
      · 
        have h1 : dstep acc v = acc := by
          unfold dstep
          rw [hb]
          simp [heq]
        rw [h1]
        obtain ⟨hp, hm⟩ := ih acc hacc
          (fun a ha x hx => hbound a ha x (List.mem_cons_of_mem _ hx))
          hrest_sorted
        exact ⟨hp, fun a ha => (hm a ha).imp id (List.mem_cons_of_mem _)⟩
      · 
        have h1 : dstep acc v = acc.push v := by
          unfold dstep
          rw [hb]
          simp [heq]
        rw [h1]
        have hupv : u.p ≠ v.p := fun hc => heq (beqS_iff.mpr hc)
        apply hkey
        intro a ha
        have hle : p3Le a.p v.p = true :=
          hbound a ha v (List.mem_cons_self _ _)
        by_cases hau : a = u
        · exact p3Lt_of_p3Le_of_ne hle (hau ▸ hupv)
        · have hau_lt : p3Lt a.p u.p = true := pairwise_lt_getLast hacc
            (by rw [← back?_eq_getLast?, hb]) ha hau
          exact p3Lt_of_p3Lt_of_p3Le hau_lt
            (hbound u hu_mem v (List.mem_cons_self _ _))

name: vertexUniverse_pairwise
statement:
theorem vertexUniverse_pairwise (K : Array Frag) :
    (vertexUniverse K).toList.Pairwise (fun a b => p3Lt a.p b.p = true)
proof:
:= by
  rw [vertexUniverse_eq]
  set l := (K.flatMap (fun f => f.poly)).toList.mergeSort
    (fun a b => p3Le a.p b.p) with hl
  have hsorted : l.Pairwise (fun a b => p3Le a.p b.p = true) :=
    List.sorted_mergeSort
      (le := fun (a b : Vtx) => p3Le a.p b.p)
      (fun _ _ _ => p3Le_trans)
      (fun a b => by rcases p3Le_total a.p b.p with h | h <;> simp [h]) _
  have := dstep_fold_invariant l #[] (by simp) (by simp) hsorted
  rw [← Array.foldl_toList]
  simpa using this.1

name: mem_vertexUniverse
proof:
:= by
  rw [vertexUniverse_eq] at hv
  set l := (K.flatMap (fun f => f.poly)).toList.mergeSort
    (fun a b => p3Le a.p b.p) with hl
  have hsorted : l.Pairwise (fun a b => p3Le a.p b.p = true) :=
    List.sorted_mergeSort
      (le := fun (a b : Vtx) => p3Le a.p b.p)
      (fun _ _ _ => p3Le_trans)
      (fun a b => by rcases p3Le_total a.p b.p with h | h <;> simp [h]) _
  rw [← Array.foldl_toList] at hv
  have := (dstep_fold_invariant l #[] (by simp) (by simp) hsorted).2 v
    (by simpa using hv)
  rcases this with h | h
  · simp at h
  · have hperm : l.Perm (K.flatMap (fun f => f.poly)).toList :=
      List.mergeSort_perm _ _
    have hmem : v ∈ (K.flatMap (fun f => f.poly)).toList := hperm.mem_iff.mp h
    rw [toList_flatMap_arr, List.mem_flatMap] at hmem
    obtain ⟨f, hf, hvf⟩ := hmem
    exact ⟨f, Array.mem_def.mpr hf, Array.mem_def.mpr hvf⟩

name: dstep_fold_mono
proof:
:= by
  intro l
  induction l with
  | nil => exact fun acc a ha => ha
  | cons v rest ih =>
    intro acc a ha
