    rw [List.foldl_cons]
    apply ih
    rcases hb : acc.back? with - | u
    · have h1 : dstep acc v = acc.push v := by
        unfold dstep
        rw [hb]
      rw [h1]
      simpa using Or.inl ha
    · by_cases heq : beqS u.p v.p = true
      · have h1 : dstep acc v = acc := by
          unfold dstep
          rw [hb]
          simp [heq]
        rw [h1]
        exact ha
      · have h1 : dstep acc v = acc.push v := by
          unfold dstep
          rw [hb]
          simp [heq]
        rw [h1]
        simpa using Or.inl ha

name: dstep_fold_complete
proof:
:= by
  intro l
  induction l with
  | nil =>
    intro acc v hv
    exact absurd hv (List.not_mem_nil v)
  | cons w rest ih =>
    intro acc v hv
    rw [List.foldl_cons]
    rcases List.mem_cons.mp hv with rfl | hv'
    · 
      rcases hb : acc.back? with - | u
      · have h1 : dstep acc v = acc.push v := by
          unfold dstep
          rw [hb]
        refine ⟨v, ?_, rfl⟩
        rw [h1]
        exact dstep_fold_mono rest _ v (by simp)
      · by_cases heq : beqS u.p v.p = true
        · have h1 : dstep acc v = acc := by
            unfold dstep
            rw [hb]
            simp [heq]
          have hb' : acc.toList.getLast? = some u := by
            rw [← back?_eq_getLast?]
            exact hb
          refine ⟨u, ?_, beqS_iff.mp heq⟩
          rw [h1]
          exact dstep_fold_mono rest acc u (List.mem_of_mem_getLast? hb')
        · have h1 : dstep acc v = acc.push v := by
            unfold dstep
            rw [hb]
            simp [heq]
          refine ⟨v, ?_, rfl⟩
          rw [h1]
          exact dstep_fold_mono rest _ v (by simp)
    · exact ih (dstep acc w) v hv'

name: vertexUniverse_complete
statement:
theorem vertexUniverse_complete (K : Array Frag) {f : Frag} (hf : f ∈ K)
    {v : Vtx} (hv : v ∈ f.poly) :
    ∃ u ∈ (vertexUniverse K).toList, u.p = v.p
proof:
:= by
  rw [vertexUniverse_eq, ← Array.foldl_toList, Array.toList_toArray]
  apply dstep_fold_complete
  apply (List.mergeSort_perm _ _).mem_iff.mpr
  rw [toList_flatMap_arr, List.mem_flatMap]
  exact ⟨f, Array.mem_def.mp hf, Array.mem_def.mp hv⟩

name: vertexUniverse_xmono
statement:
theorem vertexUniverse_xmono (K : Array Frag) :
    ∀ (i j : Nat) (hi : i < (vertexUniverse K).size)
      (hj : j < (vertexUniverse K).size), i ≤ j →
      ((vertexUniverse K)[i]).p.x ≤ ((vertexUniverse K)[j]).p.x
proof:
:= by
  intro i j hi hj hij
  rcases Nat.eq_or_lt_of_le hij with rfl | hlt
  · exact le_refl _
  · have hpw := vertexUniverse_pairwise K
    have h := List.pairwise_iff_getElem.mp hpw i j (by simpa using hi)
      (by simpa using hj) hlt
    rw [p3Lt_iff] at h
    simp only [Array.getElem_toList] at h
    rcases h with h | ⟨h, -⟩
    · exact le_of_lt h
    · exact le_of_eq h

name: isZeroI_iff
statement: theorem isZeroI_iff {u : I3} : isZeroI u = true ↔ i3Q u = 0
proof:
:= by
  simp only [isZeroI, Bool.and_eq_true, beq_iff_eq]
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨⟨hx, hy⟩, hz⟩
    funext i
    fin_cases i <;> simp [i3Q, mkPoint, hx, hy, hz]
  · intro h
    have hx := congrFun h 0
    have hy := congrFun h 1
    have hz := congrFun h 2
    simp only [i3Q, mkPoint_zero, mkPoint_one, mkPoint_two, Pi.zero_apply,
      Int.cast_eq_zero] at hx hy hz
    exact ⟨⟨hx, hy⟩, hz⟩

name: test_sound
statement:
private theorem test_sound {a b v : Vtx}
    (ha : repr4 a.h (P3.toPoint a.p)) (hb : repr4 b.h (P3.toPoint b.p))
    (hv : repr4 v.h (P3.toPoint v.p))
    (hab : P3.toPoint a.p ≠ P3.toPoint b.p)
    (hcoll : isZeroI (crossI (hsub v.h a.h) (hsub b.h a.h)) = true)
    (hpos : 0 < dotI (hsub b.h a.h) (hsub v.h a.h))
    (hlt : b.h.w * dotI (hsub b.h a.h) (hsub v.h a.h)
      < v.h.w * dotI (hsub b.h a.h) (hsub b.h a.h)) :
    P3.toPoint v.p = P3.toPoint a.p
        + edgeParam (P3.toPoint a.p) (P3.toPoint b.p) (P3.toPoint v.p)
          • (P3.toPoint b.p - P3.toPoint a.p)
      ∧ 0 < edgeParam (P3.toPoint a.p) (P3.toPoint b.p) (P3.toPoint v.p)
      ∧ edgeParam (P3.toPoint a.p) (P3.toPoint b.p) (P3.toPoint v.p) < 1
proof:
:= by
  set A := P3.toPoint a.p
  set B := P3.toPoint b.p
  set V := P3.toPoint v.p
  set u : Point := B - A with hu
  have hune : u ≠ 0 := fun hc => hab (by
    have := congrArg (· + A) hc
    simpa [hu, sub_add_cancel] using this.symm)
  have huu : 0 < dotQ u u := dotQ_self_pos hune
  have haw := ha.1
  have hbw := hb.1
  have hvw := hv.1
  set α : ℚ := ((b.h.w * a.h.w : ℤ) : ℚ) with hα
  set γ : ℚ := ((v.h.w * a.h.w : ℤ) : ℚ) with hγ
  have hα0 : 0 < α := by
    rw [hα]
    exact_mod_cast mul_pos hbw haw
  have hγ0 : 0 < γ := by
    rw [hγ]
    exact_mod_cast mul_pos hvw haw
  have huh : i3Q (hsub b.h a.h) = α • u := i3Q_hsub ha hb
  have hwh : i3Q (hsub v.h a.h) = γ • (V - A) := i3Q_hsub ha hv
  
  have hcross : crossQ (V - A) u = 0 := by
    have h0 := isZeroI_iff.mp hcoll
    rw [i3Q_crossI, huh, hwh, crossQ_smul_left, crossQ_smul_right] at h0
    have := smul_eq_zero.mp h0
    rcases this with h | h
    · exact absurd h (by positivity)
    · rcases smul_eq_zero.mp h with h' | h'
      · exact absurd h' (by positivity)
      · exact h'
  obtain ⟨s, hs⟩ := exists_smul_of_crossQ_eq_zero hune hcross
  set W := dotQ u u with hW
  have hsmul_l : ∀ (c : ℚ) (x y : Point), dotQ (c • x) y = c * dotQ x y := by
    intro c x y
    rw [dotQ_comm, Proof.MeshIntersectRay.dotQ_smul_right, dotQ_comm]
  
  have hdot1 : ((dotI (hsub b.h a.h) (hsub v.h a.h) : ℤ) : ℚ)
      = α * γ * (s * W) := by
    rw [dotI_i3Q, huh, hwh, hs, Proof.MeshIntersectRay.dotQ_smul_right,
      hsmul_l, Proof.MeshIntersectRay.dotQ_smul_right, hW]
    ring
  have hdot2 : ((dotI (hsub b.h a.h) (hsub b.h a.h) : ℤ) : ℚ)
      = α * α * W := by
    rw [dotI_i3Q, huh, Proof.MeshIntersectRay.dotQ_smul_right, hsmul_l, hW]
    ring
  
  have hpos' : 0 < s := by
    have h1 : (0 : ℚ) < ((dotI (hsub b.h a.h) (hsub v.h a.h) : ℤ) : ℚ) := by
      exact_mod_cast hpos
    rw [hdot1] at h1
    nlinarith [mul_pos (mul_pos hα0 hγ0) huu]
  have hlt' : s < 1 := by
    have h1 : ((b.h.w : ℤ) : ℚ) * ((dotI (hsub b.h a.h) (hsub v.h a.h) : ℤ) : ℚ)
        < ((v.h.w : ℤ) : ℚ) * ((dotI (hsub b.h a.h) (hsub b.h a.h) : ℤ) : ℚ) := by
      exact_mod_cast hlt
    rw [hdot1, hdot2] at h1
    have hbwq : (0 : ℚ) < ((b.h.w : ℤ) : ℚ) := by exact_mod_cast hbw
    have hvwq : (0 : ℚ) < ((v.h.w : ℤ) : ℚ) := by exact_mod_cast hvw
    have hawq : (0 : ℚ) < ((a.h.w : ℤ) : ℚ) := by exact_mod_cast haw
    set C : ℚ := ((v.h.w : ℤ) : ℚ) * (((b.h.w : ℤ) : ℚ) * ((b.h.w : ℤ) : ℚ))
      * (((a.h.w : ℤ) : ℚ) * ((a.h.w : ℤ) : ℚ)) * W with hC
    have hC0 : 0 < C := by
      rw [hC]
      positivity
    have h2 : C * s < C * 1 := by
      have e1 : ((b.h.w : ℤ) : ℚ) * (α * γ * (s * W)) = C * s := by
        rw [hC, hα, hγ]
        push_cast
        ring
      have e2 : ((v.h.w : ℤ) : ℚ) * (α * α * W) = C * 1 := by
        rw [hC, hα]
        push_cast
        ring
      rw [← e1, ← e2]
      exact h1
    exact lt_of_mul_lt_mul_left (by linarith) hC0.le
  
  have hparam : edgeParam A B V = s := by
    rw [edgeParam, ← hu, hs, Proof.MeshIntersectRay.dotQ_smul_right, ← hW]
    field_simp
  refine ⟨?_, hparam ▸ hpos', hparam ▸ hlt'⟩
  rw [hparam, ← hs]
  abel

name: hitsOn_eq
statement:
private theorem hitsOn_eq (vs : Array Vtx) (a b : Vtx) :
    hitsOn vs a b
      = if isZeroI (hsub b.h a.h) = true then #[]
        else ((hCands vs a b).toList.mergeSort
            (fun v w => decide (dotS (psubS b.p a.p) (psubS v.p a.p)
              ≤ dotS (psubS b.p a.p) (psubS w.p a.p)))).toArray
proof: := rfl

name: dedupAdjN_eq
statement:
private theorem dedupAdjN_eq (arr : Array Nat) :
    dedupAdjN arr = arr.toList.foldl dstepN #[]
proof:
:= by
  rw [dedupAdjN, ← Array.foldl_toList]; rfl

name: dstepN_none
statement:
private theorem dstepN_none {acc : Array Nat} {i : Nat} (h : acc.back? = none) :
    dstepN acc i = acc.push i
proof: := by unfold dstepN; rw [h]

name: dstepN_some_eq
statement:
private theorem dstepN_some_eq {acc : Array Nat} {i u : Nat} (h : acc.back? = some u)
    (he : u == i) : dstepN acc i = acc
proof: := by unfold dstepN; rw [h]; simp [he]

name: dstepN_some_ne
statement:
private theorem dstepN_some_ne {acc : Array Nat} {i u : Nat} (h : acc.back? = some u)
    (he : ¬ (u == i)) : dstepN acc i = acc.push i
proof: := by unfold dstepN; rw [h]; simp [he]

name: dstepN_fold_mono
proof:
:= by
  intro l
  induction l with
  | nil => exact fun acc i hi => hi
  | cons j rest ih =>
    intro acc i hi
    rw [List.foldl_cons]
    apply ih
    rcases hb : acc.back? with - | u
    · rw [dstepN_none hb]; simpa using Or.inl hi
    · by_cases he : u == j
      · rw [dstepN_some_eq hb he]; exact hi
      · rw [dstepN_some_ne hb he]; simpa using Or.inl hi

name: pairwise_lt_getLast_nat
proof:
:= by
  have hlne : l ≠ [] := by rintro rfl; simp at hu
  rw [List.getLast?_eq_getElem?, List.getElem?_eq_some_iff] at hu
  obtain ⟨hlast_lt, hu'⟩ := hu
  obtain ⟨i, hi, hai⟩ := List.getElem_of_mem ha
  have hine : i ≠ l.length - 1 := by
    intro hc; subst hc; exact hne (hai.symm.trans hu')
  have hilt : i < l.length - 1 := by omega
  have := List.pairwise_iff_getElem.mp hl i (l.length - 1) hi (by omega) hilt
  subst hai; subst hu'; exact this

name: dstepN_fold_invariant
statement:
private theorem dstepN_fold_invariant :
    ∀ (l : List Nat) (acc : Array Nat),
      acc.toList.Pairwise (· < ·) →
      (∀ x ∈ acc.toList, ∀ y ∈ l, x < y ∨ x = y) →
      l.Pairwise (· ≤ ·) →
      (l.foldl dstepN acc).toList.Pairwise (· < ·)
        ∧ ∀ i ∈ (l.foldl dstepN acc).toList, i ∈ acc.toList ∨ i ∈ l
proof:
:= by
  intro l
  induction l with
  | nil => intro acc hacc _ _; exact ⟨by simpa using hacc, fun i hi => Or.inl hi⟩
  | cons j rest ih =>
    intro acc hacc hbnd hsorted
    rw [List.foldl_cons]
    have hrest_sorted : rest.Pairwise (· ≤ ·) := (List.pairwise_cons.mp hsorted).2
    have hj_le : ∀ y ∈ rest, j ≤ y := (List.pairwise_cons.mp hsorted).1
    have hpush : (acc.push j).toList = acc.toList ++ [j] := by simp
    
    have hkey : (∀ x ∈ acc.toList, x < j) →
        (List.foldl dstepN (acc.push j) rest).toList.Pairwise (· < ·)
          ∧ ∀ i ∈ (List.foldl dstepN (acc.push j) rest).toList,
              i ∈ acc.toList ∨ i ∈ j :: rest := by
      intro hstrict
      obtain ⟨hp, hm⟩ := ih (acc.push j)
        (by rw [hpush, List.pairwise_append]
            exact ⟨hacc, by simp, by
              intro x hx y hy; rw [List.mem_singleton] at hy; subst hy; exact hstrict x hx⟩)
        (by intro x hx y hy
            rw [hpush, List.mem_append] at hx
            rcases hx with hx | hx
            · rcases hbnd x hx y (List.mem_cons_of_mem _ hy) with h | h
              · exact Or.inl h
              · exact Or.inr h
            · rw [List.mem_singleton] at hx; subst hx
              rcases lt_or_eq_of_le (hj_le y hy) with h | h
              · exact Or.inl h
              · exact Or.inr h)
        hrest_sorted
      refine ⟨hp, fun i hi => ?_⟩
      rcases hm i hi with h | h
      · rw [hpush, List.mem_append] at h
        rcases h with h | h
        · exact Or.inl h
        · rw [List.mem_singleton] at h; exact Or.inr (h ▸ List.mem_cons_self _ _)
      · exact Or.inr (List.mem_cons_of_mem _ h)
    rcases hb : acc.back? with - | u
    · 
      have hae : acc.toList = [] := by
        rw [back?_eq_getLast?] at hb; exact List.getLast?_eq_none_iff.mp hb
      rw [dstepN_none hb]
      exact hkey (by rw [hae]; simp)
    · have hu_last : acc.toList.getLast? = some u := by rw [← back?_eq_getLast?]; exact hb
      have hu_mem : u ∈ acc.toList := List.mem_of_mem_getLast? hu_last
      by_cases he : u == j
      · 
        rw [dstepN_some_eq hb he]
        obtain ⟨hp, hm⟩ := ih acc hacc
          (fun x hx y hy => hbnd x hx y (List.mem_cons_of_mem _ hy)) hrest_sorted
        exact ⟨hp, fun i hi => (hm i hi).imp id (List.mem_cons_of_mem _)⟩
      · 
        rw [dstepN_some_ne hb he]
        have hu_lt_j : u < j := by
          rcases hbnd u hu_mem j (List.mem_cons_self _ _) with h | h
          · exact h
          · exact absurd (by simp [h]) he
        
        apply hkey
        intro x hx
        by_cases hxu : x = u
        · exact hxu ▸ hu_lt_j
        · exact lt_trans (pairwise_lt_getLast_nat hacc hu_last hx hxu) hu_lt_j

name: dstepN_fold_complete
proof:
:= by
  intro l
  induction l with
  | nil => intro acc i hi; exact absurd hi (List.not_mem_nil i)
  | cons j rest ih =>
    intro acc i hi
    rw [List.foldl_cons]
    rcases List.mem_cons.mp hi with rfl | hi'
    · 
      rcases hb : acc.back? with - | u
      · rw [dstepN_none hb]; exact dstepN_fold_mono rest _ i (by simp)
      · by_cases he : u == i
        · rw [dstepN_some_eq hb he]
          have huu : u = i := by simpa using he
          have hu_mem : u ∈ acc.toList := by
            rw [back?_eq_getLast?] at hb; exact List.mem_of_mem_getLast? hb
          rw [← huu]
          exact dstepN_fold_mono rest acc u hu_mem
        · rw [dstepN_some_ne hb he]; exact dstepN_fold_mono rest _ i (by simp)
    · exact ih (dstepN acc j) i hi'

name: vs_p_inj_idx
statement:
private theorem vs_p_inj_idx {vs : Array Vtx}
    (hnd : vs.toList.Pairwise (fun u v => u.p ≠ v.p))
    {i j : Nat} (hi : i < vs.size) (hj : j < vs.size) (hij : i ≠ j) :
    vs[i].p ≠ vs[j].p
proof:
:= by
  have hi' : i < vs.toList.length := by simpa using hi
  have hj' : j < vs.toList.length := by simpa using hj
  rw [← Array.getElem_toList (h := hi), ← Array.getElem_toList (h := hj)]
  rcases lt_or_gt_of_ne hij with hlt | hgt
  · exact List.pairwise_iff_getElem.mp hnd i j hi' hj' hlt
  · exact Ne.symm (List.pairwise_iff_getElem.mp hnd j i hj' hi' hgt)

name: hIdx_nodup
statement:
private theorem hIdx_nodup (vs : Array Vtx) (a b : Vtx) :
    (hIdx vs a b).toList.Nodup
proof:
:=
  Proof.BVH.boxQueryM_nodup (univBoxes vs) (edgeBox a b)

name: hCands_mem_univ
statement:
private theorem hCands_mem_univ {vs : Array Vtx} {a b v : Vtx}
    (hv : v ∈ (hCands vs a b).toList) : v ∈ vs.toList
proof:
:= by
  rw [Array.mem_toList, hCands, Array.mem_filterMap] at hv
  obtain ⟨i, _, hf⟩ := hv
  by_cases hi : i < vs.size
  · rw [dif_pos hi] at hf
    by_cases ht : hTest a b vs[i] = true
    · rw [if_pos ht] at hf
      have : v = vs[i] := (Option.some_inj.mp hf).symm
      rw [this, Array.mem_toList]; exact Array.getElem_mem hi
    · rw [if_neg ht] at hf; exact absurd hf (by simp)
  · rw [dif_neg hi] at hf; exact absurd hf (by simp)

name: hCands_test
statement:
private theorem hCands_test {vs : Array Vtx} {a b v : Vtx}
    (hv : v ∈ (hCands vs a b).toList) : hTest a b v = true
proof:
:= by
  rw [Array.mem_toList, hCands, Array.mem_filterMap] at hv
  obtain ⟨i, _, hf⟩ := hv
  by_cases hi : i < vs.size
  · rw [dif_pos hi] at hf
    by_cases ht : hTest a b vs[i] = true
    · rw [if_pos ht] at hf
      have : v = vs[i] := (Option.some_inj.mp hf).symm
      rw [this]; exact ht
    · rw [if_neg ht] at hf; exact absurd hf (by simp)
  · rw [dif_neg hi] at hf; exact absurd hf (by simp)

name: hCands_pairwise
proof:
:= by
  rw [hCands, Array.toList_filterMap]
  rw [List.pairwise_filterMap]
  have hidxnd : (hIdx vs a b).toList.Pairwise (fun i j => i ≠ j) := hIdx_nodup vs a b
  refine hidxnd.imp_of_mem ?_
  intro i j hi hj hij u hu u' hu'
  
  by_cases hisz : i < vs.size
  · rw [dif_pos hisz] at hu
    by_cases hjsz : j < vs.size
    · rw [dif_pos hjsz] at hu'
      by_cases hti : hTest a b vs[i] = true
      · rw [if_pos hti] at hu
        by_cases htj : hTest a b vs[j] = true
        · rw [if_pos htj] at hu'
          have heu : u = vs[i] := (Option.some_inj.mp hu).symm
          have heu' : u' = vs[j] := (Option.some_inj.mp hu').symm
          rw [heu, heu']
          exact vs_p_inj_idx hnd hisz hjsz hij
        · rw [if_neg htj] at hu'; exact absurd hu' (by simp)
      · rw [if_neg hti] at hu; exact absurd hu (by simp)
    · rw [dif_neg hjsz] at hu'; exact absurd hu' (by simp)
  · rw [dif_neg hisz] at hu; exact absurd hu (by simp)

name: hCands_complete
statement:
private theorem hCands_complete {vs : Array Vtx} {a b v : Vtx}
    (hvmem : v ∈ vs.toList) (htest : hTest a b v = true)
    (hov : Impl.BVH.overlap (edgeBox a b) (vtxBox v) = true) :
    v ∈ (hCands vs a b).toList
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨idx, hidx, hveq⟩ := List.mem_iff_getElem.mp ((Array.mem_toList).mpr
    ((Array.mem_toList).mp hvmem))
  rw [Array.length_toList] at hidx
  have hveq' : vs[idx] = v := by simpa using hveq
  have hsz : idx < (univBoxes vs).size := by rw [univBoxes, Array.size_map]; exact hidx
  have hbox : Impl.BVH.overlap (edgeBox a b) ((univBoxes vs).getD idx default) = true := by
    rw [Proof.MeshIntersectKeep.arr_getD _ _ _ hsz]
    show Impl.BVH.overlap (edgeBox a b) (vs.map vtxBox)[idx] = true
    rw [Array.getElem_map, hveq']
    exact hov
  
  have hidxq : idx ∈ Impl.BVH.boxQuery (univBVH vs) (edgeBox a b) := by
    rw [univBVH]
    exact CSG.Proof.BVH.boxQueryM_sound (univBoxes vs) (edgeBox a b) idx hsz hbox
  have hidxd : idx ∈ (hIdx vs a b).toList := (Array.mem_toList).mpr hidxq
  rw [Array.mem_toList, hCands, Array.mem_filterMap]
  exact ⟨idx, (Array.mem_toList).mp hidxd, by rw [dif_pos hidx, hveq', if_pos htest]⟩

name: hitsOn_shape
statement:
theorem hitsOn_shape (vs : Array Vtx) {a b : Vtx}
    (ha : repr4 a.h (P3.toPoint a.p)) (hb : repr4 b.h (P3.toPoint b.p))
    (hvs : ∀ v ∈ vs.toList, repr4 v.h (P3.toPoint v.p))
    (hnd : vs.toList.Pairwise (fun u v => u.p ≠ v.p))
    (hab : P3.toPoint a.p ≠ P3.toPoint b.p) :
    ∃ s : List ℚ,
      (hitsOn vs a b).toList.map (fun v => P3.toPoint v.p)
          = s.map (fun t => P3.toPoint a.p
              + t • (P3.toPoint b.p - P3.toPoint a.p))
        ∧ s.Chain' (· < ·) ∧ ∀ t ∈ s, 0 < t ∧ t < 1
proof:
:= by
  classical
  set A := P3.toPoint a.p with hA
  set B := P3.toPoint b.p with hB
  
  have huhne : isZeroI (hsub b.h a.h) = false := by
    rw [Bool.eq_false_iff, Ne, isZeroI_iff, i3Q_hsub ha hb]
    intro hc
    rcases smul_eq_zero.mp hc with h | h
    · have : (0 : ℚ) < ((b.h.w * a.h.w : ℤ) : ℚ) := by
        exact_mod_cast mul_pos hb.1 ha.1
      exact absurd h (by positivity)
    · exact hab (by
        have := congrArg (· + A) h
        simpa [sub_add_cancel] using this.symm)
  rw [hitsOn_eq, if_neg (by rw [huhne]; exact Bool.false_ne_true)]
  
  set l : List Vtx := (hCands vs a b).toList with hl
  rw [Array.toList_toArray]
  
  have hl_mem : ∀ v ∈ l, v ∈ vs.toList := fun v hv => hCands_mem_univ (hl ▸ hv)
  have htest : ∀ v ∈ l, hTest a b v = true := fun v hv => hCands_test (hl ▸ hv)
  have hl_nd : l.Pairwise (fun u v => u.p ≠ v.p) := by
    rw [hl]; exact hCands_pairwise a b hnd
  
  have hdecode : ∀ v ∈ l,
      P3.toPoint v.p = A + edgeParam A B (P3.toPoint v.p) • (B - A)
        ∧ 0 < edgeParam A B (P3.toPoint v.p)
        ∧ edgeParam A B (P3.toPoint v.p) < 1 := by
    intro v hv
    have ht := htest v hv
    rw [hTest] at ht
    simp only [Bool.and_eq_true, decide_eq_true_eq] at ht
    exact test_sound ha hb (hvs v (hl_mem v hv)) hab ht.2.1 ht.2.2.1 ht.2.2.2
  
  set key : Vtx → ℚ := fun v =>
    dotS (psubS b.p a.p) (psubS v.p a.p) with hkey
  have hkey_eq : ∀ v ∈ l,
      key v = edgeParam A B (P3.toPoint v.p) * dotQ (B - A) (B - A) := by
    intro v hv
    have hrep := (hdecode v hv).1
    rw [hkey]
    show dotS (psubS b.p a.p) (psubS v.p a.p) = _
    rw [dotS_toPoint, psubS_toPoint, psubS_toPoint]
    show dotQ (B - A) (P3.toPoint v.p - A) = _
    conv_lhs => rw [hrep]
    rw [show A + edgeParam A B (P3.toPoint v.p) • (B - A) - A
        = edgeParam A B (P3.toPoint v.p) • (B - A) from by abel,
      Proof.MeshIntersectRay.dotQ_smul_right]
  have hBA : (0 : ℚ) < dotQ (B - A) (B - A) :=
    dotQ_self_pos (fun hc => hab (by
      have := congrArg (· + A) hc
      simpa [sub_add_cancel] using this.symm))
  
  set le : Vtx → Vtx → Bool := fun v w => decide (key v ≤ key w) with hle
  have hms_perm : (l.mergeSort le).Perm l := List.mergeSort_perm l le
  have hms_sorted : (l.mergeSort le).Pairwise (fun v w => le v w = true) :=
    List.sorted_mergeSort
      (fun x y z hxy hyz => by
        rw [hle] at hxy hyz ⊢
        simp only [decide_eq_true_eq] at hxy hyz ⊢
        exact le_trans hxy hyz)
      (fun x y => by
        rw [hle]
        rcases le_total (key x) (key y) with h | h <;> simp [h]) l
  have hms_mem : ∀ v ∈ l.mergeSort le, v ∈ l :=
    fun v hv => hms_perm.subset hv
  have hms_nd : (l.mergeSort le).Pairwise (fun u v => u.p ≠ v.p) :=
    (hms_perm.pairwise_iff (fun h => h.symm)).mpr hl_nd
  
  refine ⟨(l.mergeSort le).map (fun v => edgeParam A B (P3.toPoint v.p)),
    ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · rw [List.map_map]
    apply List.map_congr_left
    intro v hv
    exact (hdecode v (hms_mem v hv)).1
  · 
    have hpw : (l.mergeSort le).Pairwise (fun v w =>
        edgeParam A B (P3.toPoint v.p) < edgeParam A B (P3.toPoint w.p)) := by
      have hcomb := hms_sorted.and hms_nd
      apply List.Pairwise.imp_of_mem ?_ hcomb
      intro v w hv hw hvw
      obtain ⟨hkle, hpne⟩ := hvw
      rw [hle] at hkle
      simp only [decide_eq_true_eq] at hkle
      rw [hkey_eq v (hms_mem v hv), hkey_eq w (hms_mem w hw)] at hkle
      have hle' : edgeParam A B (P3.toPoint v.p)
          ≤ edgeParam A B (P3.toPoint w.p) :=
        le_of_mul_le_mul_right hkle hBA
      rcases lt_or_eq_of_le hle' with h | h
      · exact h
      · exfalso
        apply hpne
        apply toPoint_inj
        rw [(hdecode v (hms_mem v hv)).1, (hdecode w (hms_mem w hw)).1, h]
    exact (List.chain'_map _).mpr (hpw.chain')
  · intro t ht
    rw [List.mem_map] at ht
    obtain ⟨v, hv, rfl⟩ := ht
    exact ⟨(hdecode v (hms_mem v hv)).2.1, (hdecode v (hms_mem v hv)).2.2⟩

name: between_coord
statement:
private theorem between_coord {x y c τ : ℚ} (h0 : 0 ≤ τ) (h1 : τ ≤ 1)
    (hc : c = x + τ * (y - x)) : min x y ≤ c ∧ c ≤ max x y
proof:
:= by
  rcases le_total x y with h | h
  · rw [min_eq_left h, max_eq_right h]
    constructor <;> nlinarith
  · rw [min_eq_right h, max_eq_left h]
    constructor <;> nlinarith

name: overlap_edgeBox_vtxBox
statement:
private theorem overlap_edgeBox_vtxBox {a b v : Vtx} {τ : ℚ}
    (h0 : 0 < τ) (h1 : τ < 1)
    (hx : v.p.x = a.p.x + τ * (b.p.x - a.p.x))
    (hy : v.p.y = a.p.y + τ * (b.p.y - a.p.y))
    (hz : v.p.z = a.p.z + τ * (b.p.z - a.p.z)) :
    Impl.BVH.overlap (edgeBox a b) (vtxBox v) = true
proof:
:= by
  have hbx := between_coord h0.le h1.le hx
  have hby := between_coord h0.le h1.le hy
  have hbz := between_coord h0.le h1.le hz
  rw [Impl.BVH.overlap, edgeBox, vtxBox]
  simp only [Bool.and_eq_true, decide_eq_true_eq]
  refine ⟨⟨⟨⟨⟨?_, ?_⟩, ?_⟩, ?_⟩, ?_⟩, ?_⟩
  · rw [rmin_eq]; exact hbx.1
  · rw [rmax_eq]; exact hbx.2
  · rw [rmin_eq]; exact hby.1
  · rw [rmax_eq]; exact hby.2
  · rw [rmin_eq]; exact hbz.1
  · rw [rmax_eq]; exact hbz.2

name: test_complete
statement:
private theorem test_complete {a b v : Vtx}
    (ha : repr4 a.h (P3.toPoint a.p)) (hb : repr4 b.h (P3.toPoint b.p))
    (hv : repr4 v.h (P3.toPoint v.p))
    (hab : P3.toPoint a.p ≠ P3.toPoint b.p) {τ : ℚ} (h0 : 0 < τ) (h1 : τ < 1)
    (hrep : P3.toPoint v.p
      = P3.toPoint a.p + τ • (P3.toPoint b.p - P3.toPoint a.p)) :
    hTest a b v = true
proof:
:= by
  set u : Point := P3.toPoint b.p - P3.toPoint a.p with hu
  have hune : u ≠ 0 := fun hc => hab (by
    have := congrArg (· + P3.toPoint a.p) hc
    simpa [hu, sub_add_cancel] using this.symm)
  have huu : 0 < dotQ u u := dotQ_self_pos hune
  
  have hcoord : ∀ j : Fin 3, P3.toPoint v.p j
      = P3.toPoint a.p j + τ * (P3.toPoint b.p j - P3.toPoint a.p j) := by
    intro j
    rw [hrep]
    simp [hu, Pi.add_apply, Pi.smul_apply, Pi.sub_apply, smul_eq_mul]
  have hy : v.p.y = a.p.y + τ * (b.p.y - a.p.y) := hcoord 1
  have hz : v.p.z = a.p.z + τ * (b.p.z - a.p.z) := hcoord 2
  have hby := between_coord h0.le h1.le hy
  have hbz := between_coord h0.le h1.le hz
  
  have haw := ha.1
  have hbw := hb.1
  have hvw := hv.1
  have hawq : (0 : ℚ) < ((a.h.w : ℤ) : ℚ) := by exact_mod_cast haw
  have hbwq : (0 : ℚ) < ((b.h.w : ℤ) : ℚ) := by exact_mod_cast hbw
  have hvwq : (0 : ℚ) < ((v.h.w : ℤ) : ℚ) := by exact_mod_cast hvw
  set α : ℚ := ((b.h.w * a.h.w : ℤ) : ℚ) with hα
  set γ : ℚ := ((v.h.w * a.h.w : ℤ) : ℚ) with hγ
  have hα0 : 0 < α := by
    rw [hα]
    exact_mod_cast mul_pos hbw haw
  have hγ0 : 0 < γ := by
    rw [hγ]
    exact_mod_cast mul_pos hvw haw
  have huh : i3Q (hsub b.h a.h) = α • u := i3Q_hsub ha hb
  have hwh : i3Q (hsub v.h a.h)
      = γ • (P3.toPoint v.p - P3.toPoint a.p) := i3Q_hsub ha hv
  have hVA : P3.toPoint v.p - P3.toPoint a.p = τ • u := by
    rw [hrep]
    abel
  have hsmul_l : ∀ (c : ℚ) (x y : Point), dotQ (c • x) y = c * dotQ x y := by
    intro c x y
    rw [dotQ_comm, Proof.MeshIntersectRay.dotQ_smul_right, dotQ_comm]
  
  have hcross : isZeroI (crossI (hsub v.h a.h) (hsub b.h a.h)) = true := by
    rw [isZeroI_iff, i3Q_crossI, hwh, hVA, huh, smul_smul, crossQ_smul_left,
      crossQ_smul_right, crossQ_self, smul_zero, smul_zero]
  
  have hdot1 : ((dotI (hsub b.h a.h) (hsub v.h a.h) : ℤ) : ℚ)
      = α * γ * τ * dotQ u u := by
    rw [dotI_i3Q, huh, hwh, hVA, smul_smul,
      Proof.MeshIntersectRay.dotQ_smul_right, hsmul_l]
    ring
  have hdot2 : ((dotI (hsub b.h a.h) (hsub b.h a.h) : ℤ) : ℚ)
      = α * α * dotQ u u := by
    rw [dotI_i3Q, huh, Proof.MeshIntersectRay.dotQ_smul_right, hsmul_l]
    ring
  have hpos : (0 : ℤ) < dotI (hsub b.h a.h) (hsub v.h a.h) := by
    have h : (0 : ℚ) < ((dotI (hsub b.h a.h) (hsub v.h a.h) : ℤ) : ℚ) := by
      rw [hdot1]
      have := mul_pos (mul_pos (mul_pos hα0 hγ0) h0) huu
      linarith
    exact_mod_cast h
  have hlt : b.h.w * dotI (hsub b.h a.h) (hsub v.h a.h)
      < v.h.w * dotI (hsub b.h a.h) (hsub b.h a.h) := by
    have hq : ((b.h.w : ℤ) : ℚ) * ((dotI (hsub b.h a.h) (hsub v.h a.h) : ℤ) : ℚ)
        < ((v.h.w : ℤ) : ℚ) * ((dotI (hsub b.h a.h) (hsub b.h a.h) : ℤ) : ℚ) := by
      rw [hdot1, hdot2, hα, hγ]
      push_cast
      have hD : (0 : ℚ) < ((b.h.w : ℤ) : ℚ) * ((b.h.w : ℤ) : ℚ)
          * (((a.h.w : ℤ) : ℚ) * ((a.h.w : ℤ) : ℚ)) * ((v.h.w : ℤ) : ℚ)
          * dotQ u u :=
        mul_pos (mul_pos (mul_pos (mul_pos hbwq hbwq)
          (mul_pos hawq hawq)) hvwq) huu
      nlinarith [mul_pos hD (show (0 : ℚ) < 1 - τ by linarith)]
    exact_mod_cast hq
  
  rw [hTest]
  simp only [Bool.and_eq_true, decide_eq_true_eq]
  refine ⟨⟨⟨⟨?_, ?_⟩, ?_⟩, ?_⟩, hcross, ?_, ?_⟩
  · rw [rmin_eq]
    exact hby.1
  · rw [rmax_eq]
    exact hby.2
  · rw [rmin_eq]
    exact hbz.1
  · rw [rmax_eq]
    exact hbz.2
  · exact hpos
  · exact hlt

name: hitsOn_complete
statement:
theorem hitsOn_complete (vs : Array Vtx) {a b v : Vtx}
    (ha : repr4 a.h (P3.toPoint a.p)) (hb : repr4 b.h (P3.toPoint b.p))
    (hv : repr4 v.h (P3.toPoint v.p))
    (_hmono : ∀ (i j : Nat) (hi : i < vs.size) (hj : j < vs.size),
      i ≤ j → (vs[i]).p.x ≤ (vs[j]).p.x)
    (hab : P3.toPoint a.p ≠ P3.toPoint b.p)
    (hvmem : v ∈ vs.toList) {τ : ℚ} (h0 : 0 < τ) (h1 : τ < 1)
    (hrep : P3.toPoint v.p
      = P3.toPoint a.p + τ • (P3.toPoint b.p - P3.toPoint a.p)) :
    v ∈ (hitsOn vs a b).toList
proof:
:= by
  
  have huhne : isZeroI (hsub b.h a.h) = false := by
    rw [Bool.eq_false_iff, Ne, isZeroI_iff, i3Q_hsub ha hb]
    intro hc
    rcases smul_eq_zero.mp hc with h | h
    · have : (0 : ℚ) < ((b.h.w * a.h.w : ℤ) : ℚ) := by
        exact_mod_cast mul_pos hb.1 ha.1
      exact absurd h (by positivity)
    · exact hab (by
        have := congrArg (· + P3.toPoint a.p) h
        simpa [sub_add_cancel] using this.symm)
  rw [hitsOn_eq, if_neg (by rw [huhne]; exact Bool.false_ne_true),
    Array.toList_toArray]
  apply (List.mergeSort_perm _ _).mem_iff.mpr
  
  have hx : v.p.x = a.p.x + τ * (b.p.x - a.p.x) := by
    have := congrFun hrep 0
    simpa [Pi.add_apply, Pi.smul_apply, Pi.sub_apply, smul_eq_mul] using this
  have hy : v.p.y = a.p.y + τ * (b.p.y - a.p.y) := by
    have := congrFun hrep 1
    simpa [Pi.add_apply, Pi.smul_apply, Pi.sub_apply, smul_eq_mul] using this
  have hz : v.p.z = a.p.z + τ * (b.p.z - a.p.z) := by
    have := congrFun hrep 2
    simpa [Pi.add_apply, Pi.smul_apply, Pi.sub_apply, smul_eq_mul] using this
  
  have htest : hTest a b v = true := test_complete ha hb hv hab h0 h1 hrep
  have hov : Impl.BVH.overlap (edgeBox a b) (vtxBox v) = true :=
    overlap_edgeBox_vtxBox h0 h1 hx hy hz
  exact hCands_complete hvmem htest hov

name: hitsOn_mem_univ
statement:
theorem hitsOn_mem_univ (vs : Array Vtx) (a b : Vtx) {v : Vtx}
    (hv : v ∈ (hitsOn vs a b).toList) : v ∈ vs.toList
proof:
:= by
  rw [hitsOn_eq] at hv
  split at hv
  · simp at hv
  · rw [Array.toList_toArray] at hv
    exact hCands_mem_univ ((List.mergeSort_perm _ _).mem_iff.mp hv)

name: foldl_push_list
proof:
:= by
  intro l
  induction l with
  | nil => intro init; simp
  | cons a t ih =>
    intro init
    rw [List.foldl_cons, ih]
    exact Array.ext' (by simp)

name: foldl_push_eq_append
statement:
private theorem foldl_push_eq_append (arr init : Array Vtx) :
    arr.foldl (fun acc h => acc.push h) init = init ++ arr
proof:
:= by
  rw [← Array.foldl_toList, foldl_push_list]

name: foldl_fun_congr
proof:
:= by
  intro l
  induction l with
  | nil => intro init; rfl
  | cons a t ih =>
    intro init
    rw [List.foldl_cons, List.foldl_cons, h, ih]

name: foldl_chain_toList
statement:
private theorem foldl_chain_toList (a : ℕ → Vtx) (hits : ℕ → Array Vtx) :
    ∀ (l : List ℕ) (init : Array Vtx),
      (l.foldl (fun pv i => (pv.push (a i)) ++ hits i) init).toList
        = init.toList ++ l.flatMap (fun i => a i :: (hits i).toList)
proof:
:= by
  intro l
  induction l with
  | nil => intro init; simp
  | cons i t ih =>
    intro init
    rw [List.foldl_cons, ih, List.flatMap_cons]
    simp

name: atomizeFrag_poly
statement:
theorem atomizeFrag_poly (vs : Array Vtx) (f : Frag) :
    (atomizeFrag vs f).poly.toList
      = (List.range f.poly.size).flatMap (fun i =>
          f.poly.getD i default ::
            (hitsOn vs (f.poly.getD i default)
              (f.poly.getD ((i + 1) % f.poly.size) default)).toList)
proof:
:= by
  have step1 : (atomizeFrag vs f).poly
      = ((Array.range f.poly.size).foldl
        (fun pv i =>
          (hitsOn vs (f.poly.getD i default)
              (f.poly.getD ((i + 1) % f.poly.size) default)).foldl
            (fun pv h => pv.push h) (pv.push (f.poly.getD i default)))
        (#[] : Array Vtx)) := rfl
  rw [step1, ← Array.foldl_toList, Array.toList_range]
  rw [foldl_fun_congr (fun pv i => foldl_push_eq_append _ _)]
  exact foldl_chain_toList _ _ _ #[]

name: chartBlock_ne
statement:
theorem chartBlock_ne (sl : Fin r → List ℚ) (i : Fin r) :
    chartBlock sl i ≠ []
proof: := by simp [chartBlock]

name: chartBlock_fst
statement:
theorem chartBlock_fst {sl : Fin r → List ℚ} {i : Fin r} {p : Fin r × ℚ}
    (hp : p ∈ chartBlock sl i) : p.1 = i
proof:
:= by
  rcases List.mem_cons.mp hp with rfl | hp
  · rfl
  · rw [List.mem_map] at hp
    obtain ⟨t, -, rfl⟩ := hp
    rfl

name: chartList_mem_bounds
proof:
:= by
  rw [chartList, List.mem_flatMap] at hp
  obtain ⟨i, -, hp⟩ := hp
  rcases List.mem_cons.mp hp with rfl | hp
  · exact ⟨le_refl 0, one_pos⟩
  · rw [List.mem_map] at hp
    obtain ⟨t, ht, rfl⟩ := hp
    exact ⟨(hb i t ht).1.le, (hb i t ht).2⟩

name: chartList_mem_head
statement:
theorem chartList_mem_head (sl : Fin r → List ℚ) (i : Fin r) :
    (i, (0 : ℚ)) ∈ chartList sl
proof:
:= by
  rw [chartList, List.mem_flatMap]
  exact ⟨i, List.mem_finRange i, List.mem_cons_self _ _⟩

name: chartList_length
statement:
theorem chartList_length (sl : Fin r → List ℚ) :
    r ≤ (chartList sl).length
proof:
:= by
  rw [chartList]
  have key : ∀ (l : List (Fin r)),
      l.length ≤ (l.flatMap (chartBlock sl)).length := by
    intro l
    induction l with
    | nil => simp
    | cons a t ih =>
      rw [List.flatMap_cons, List.length_append]
      have : 1 ≤ (chartBlock sl a).length := by
        rw [chartBlock]
        simp
      simp only [List.length_cons]
      omega
  simpa using key (List.finRange r)

name: chain'_flatMap
statement:
private theorem chain'_flatMap {ι X : Type*} {Rl : X → X → Prop}
    {B : ι → List X} (hne : ∀ i, B i ≠ []) (hwithin : ∀ i, (B i).Chain' Rl) :
    ∀ {l : List ι},
      l.Chain' (fun i j => Rl ((B i).getLast (hne i)) ((B j).head (hne j))) →
      (l.flatMap B).Chain' Rl
proof:
:= by
  intro l
  induction l with
  | nil => intro _; simp
  | cons i t ih =>
    intro hch
    rw [List.flatMap_cons, List.chain'_append]
    refine ⟨hwithin i, ih (List.Chain'.tail hch), ?_⟩
    intro x hx y hy
    rcases t with - | ⟨j, t'⟩
    · simp at hy
    · rw [List.flatMap_cons] at hy
      rw [Option.mem_def, List.getLast?_eq_getLast _ (hne i),
        Option.some_inj] at hx
      rw [Option.mem_def, List.head?_append, List.head?_eq_head (hne j),
        Option.some_or, Option.some_inj] at hy
      have hRl := (List.chain'_cons.mp hch).1
      rw [← hx, ← hy]
      exact hRl

name: getLast
statement:
private theorem getLast?_flatMap {ι X : Type*} {B : ι → List X}
    (hne : ∀ i, B i ≠ []) :
    ∀ (l : List ι) (i : ι), l.getLast? = some i →
      (l.flatMap B).getLast? = (B i).getLast?
proof:
:= by
  intro l
  induction l with
  | nil =>
    intro i hi
    simp at hi
  | cons a t ih =>
    intro i hi
    rcases t with - | ⟨j, t'⟩
    · rw [List.getLast?_singleton, Option.some_inj] at hi
      subst hi
      simp
    · rw [List.getLast?_cons_cons] at hi
      rw [List.flatMap_cons, List.getLast?_append, ih i hi]
      rcases hopt : (B i).getLast? with - | x
      · exact absurd (List.getLast?_eq_none_iff.mp hopt) (hne _)
      · rw [Option.some_or]

name: head
proof:
:= by
  rcases l with - | ⟨a, t⟩
  · simp at hl
  · rw [List.head?_cons, Option.some_inj] at hl
    rw [List.flatMap_cons, List.head?_append, List.head?_eq_head (hne a),
      Option.some_or, hl]
    exact (List.head?_eq_head (hne i)).symm

name: getElem_idx_congr
proof:
:= by
  subst h
  rfl

name: cyclic_consec
statement:
private theorem cyclic_consec {X : Type*} {Rl : X → X → Prop} {L : List X}
    (hch : L.Chain' Rl)
    (hwrap : ∀ x ∈ L.getLast?, ∀ y ∈ L.head?, Rl x y)
    (k : ℕ) (hk : k < L.length) :
    Rl (L[k]'hk)
      (L[(k + 1) % L.length]'(Nat.mod_lt _ (Nat.zero_lt_of_lt hk)))
proof:
:= by
  have hne : L ≠ [] := by
    intro hc
    rw [hc] at hk
    simp at hk
  by_cases h : k + 1 < L.length
  · rw [getElem_idx_congr L (Nat.mod_eq_of_lt h)]
    have := List.chain'_iff_get.mp hch k (by omega)
    simpa using this
  · have hk1 : k = L.length - 1 := by omega
    subst hk1
    have hmod : (L.length - 1 + 1) % L.length = 0 := by
      rw [Nat.sub_add_cancel (by omega), Nat.mod_self]
    rw [getElem_idx_congr L hmod]
    apply hwrap
    · rw [Option.mem_def, List.getLast?_eq_getElem?,
        List.getElem?_eq_getElem (by omega)]
    · rw [Option.mem_def, List.head?_eq_head hne, Option.some_inj,
        List.head_eq_getElem]

name: chartList_cyclic
statement:
theorem chartList_cyclic {sl : Fin r → List ℚ}
    (hc : ∀ i, (sl i).Chain' (· < ·))
    (hb : ∀ i, ∀ t ∈ sl i, 0 < t ∧ t < 1)
    (k : ℕ) (hk : k < (chartList sl).length) :
    crel ((chartList sl)[k]'hk)
      ((chartList sl)[(k + 1) % (chartList sl).length]'
        (Nat.mod_lt _ (Nat.zero_lt_of_lt hk)))
proof:
:= by
  have hr1 : 1 ≤ r := Nat.one_le_iff_ne_zero.mpr (NeZero.ne r)
  have hwithin : ∀ i, (chartBlock sl i).Chain' crel := by
    intro i
    rw [chartBlock]
    apply List.chain'_cons'.mpr
    constructor
    · intro p hp
      rw [Option.mem_def] at hp
      rcases hsl : sl i with - | ⟨t0, ts⟩
      · rw [hsl] at hp
        simp at hp
      · rw [hsl, List.map_cons, List.head?_cons, Option.some_inj] at hp
        rw [← hp]
        exact Or.inl ⟨rfl, (hb i t0 (by rw [hsl]; exact List.mem_cons_self _ _)).1⟩
    · rw [List.chain'_map]
      exact (hc i).imp (fun {t t'} h => Or.inl ⟨rfl, h⟩)
  have hlink : (List.finRange r).Chain'
      (fun i j => crel ((chartBlock sl i).getLast (chartBlock_ne sl i))
        ((chartBlock sl j).head (chartBlock_ne sl j))) := by
    apply List.chain'_iff_get.mpr
    intro n hn
    rw [List.length_finRange] at hn
    have hget : ∀ (a : ℕ) (ha : a < r),
        (List.finRange r).get ⟨a, by rw [List.length_finRange]; exact ha⟩
          = ⟨a, ha⟩ := by
      intro a ha
      rw [List.get_eq_getElem, List.getElem_finRange]
      rfl
    rw [hget n (by omega), hget (n + 1) (by omega)]
    have hsucc : (⟨n + 1, by omega⟩ : Fin r) = ⟨n, by omega⟩ + 1 := by
      apply Fin.ext
      rw [Fin.val_add, Fin.val_one']
      have h1r : 1 % r = 1 := Nat.mod_eq_of_lt (by omega)
      rw [h1r]
      exact (Nat.mod_eq_of_lt (by omega)).symm
    rw [hsucc]
    right
    refine ⟨?_, rfl⟩
    exact (congrArg (· + 1)
      (chartBlock_fst (List.getLast_mem (chartBlock_ne sl ⟨n, by omega⟩)))).symm
  have hch : (chartList sl).Chain' crel := by
    rw [chartList]
    exact chain'_flatMap (chartBlock_ne sl) hwithin hlink
  have hwrap : ∀ x ∈ (chartList sl).getLast?, ∀ y ∈ (chartList sl).head?,
      crel x y := by
    intro x hx y hy
    have hfr_len : (List.finRange r).length = r := List.length_finRange r
    have hfne : (List.finRange r) ≠ [] := by
      rw [← List.length_pos_iff_ne_nil, hfr_len]
      omega
    have hlast_fin : (List.finRange r).getLast? = some (⟨r - 1, by omega⟩ : Fin r) := by
      rw [List.getLast?_eq_getElem?, List.getElem?_eq_getElem (by rw [hfr_len]; omega)]
      rw [Option.some_inj, List.getElem_finRange]
      apply Fin.ext
      simp [hfr_len]
    have hhead_fin : (List.finRange r).head? = some (⟨0, by omega⟩ : Fin r) := by
      rw [List.head?_eq_head hfne, Option.some_inj, List.head_eq_getElem,
        List.getElem_finRange]
      rfl
    rw [Option.mem_def, chartList,
      getLast?_flatMap (chartBlock_ne sl) _ _ hlast_fin] at hx
    rw [Option.mem_def, chartList,
      head?_flatMap (chartBlock_ne sl) _ _ hhead_fin] at hy
    
    have hy' : y = ((⟨0, by omega⟩ : Fin r), (0 : ℚ)) := by
      rw [show (chartBlock sl (⟨0, by omega⟩ : Fin r)).head?
          = some ((⟨0, by omega⟩ : Fin r), (0 : ℚ)) from rfl,
        Option.some_inj] at hy
      exact hy.symm
    
    have hx' : x ∈ chartBlock sl (⟨r - 1, by omega⟩ : Fin r) :=
      List.mem_of_mem_getLast? (Option.mem_def.mpr hx)
    have hxfst : x.1 = (⟨r - 1, by omega⟩ : Fin r) := chartBlock_fst hx'
    right
    constructor
    · rw [hy', hxfst]
      apply Fin.ext
      rw [Fin.val_add, Fin.val_one']
      rcases Nat.lt_or_ge 1 r with h2 | h2
      · have h1r : 1 % r = 1 := Nat.mod_eq_of_lt h2
        rw [h1r]
        show 0 = (r - 1 + 1) % r
        rw [Nat.sub_add_cancel hr1, Nat.mod_self]
      · have hr_eq : r = 1 := by omega
        subst hr_eq
        rfl
    · rw [hy']
  exact cyclic_consec hch hwrap k hk

name: chartBlock_snd
proof:
:= by
  rcases List.mem_cons.mp hp with rfl | hp
  · exact ⟨le_refl 0, one_pos⟩
  · rw [List.mem_map] at hp
    obtain ⟨t, ht, rfl⟩ := hp
    exact ⟨(hb i t ht).1.le, (hb i t ht).2⟩

name: chartList_gparam_pairwise
statement:
theorem chartList_gparam_pairwise {sl : Fin r → List ℚ}
    (hc : ∀ i, (sl i).Chain' (· < ·))
    (hb : ∀ i, ∀ t ∈ sl i, 0 < t ∧ t < 1) :
    (chartList sl).Pairwise (fun p q => gparam p < gparam q)
proof:
:= by
  have hchain : (chartList sl).Chain' (fun p q => gparam p < gparam q) := by
    rw [chartList]
    apply chain'_flatMap (chartBlock_ne sl)
    · 
      intro i
      rw [chartBlock]
      apply List.chain'_cons'.mpr
      refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
      · intro p hp
        rw [Option.mem_def] at hp
        rcases hsl : sl i with - | ⟨t0, ts⟩
        · rw [hsl] at hp
          simp at hp
        · rw [hsl, List.map_cons, List.head?_cons, Option.some_inj] at hp
          rw [← hp]
          have ht0 := (hb i t0 (by rw [hsl]; exact List.mem_cons_self _ _)).1
          show gparam (i, (0 : ℚ)) < gparam (i, t0)
          simp only [gparam]
          linarith
      · rw [List.chain'_map]
        refine (hc i).imp fun {t t'} h => ?_
        show gparam (i, t) < gparam (i, t')
        simp only [gparam]
        linarith
    · 
      apply List.chain'_iff_get.mpr
      intro n hn
      rw [List.length_finRange] at hn
      have hget : ∀ (a : ℕ) (ha : a < r),
          (List.finRange r).get ⟨a, by rw [List.length_finRange]; exact ha⟩
            = ⟨a, ha⟩ := by
        intro a ha
        rw [List.get_eq_getElem, List.getElem_finRange]
        rfl
      rw [hget n (by omega), hget (n + 1) (by omega)]
      set p := (chartBlock sl ⟨n, by omega⟩).getLast
        (chartBlock_ne sl ⟨n, by omega⟩) with hpdef
      have hpmem : p ∈ chartBlock sl ⟨n, by omega⟩ := List.getLast_mem _
      have hpfst : p.1 = ⟨n, by omega⟩ := chartBlock_fst hpmem
      have hpsnd := (chartBlock_snd hb hpmem).2
      have hhead : (chartBlock sl ⟨n + 1, by omega⟩).head
          (chartBlock_ne sl ⟨n + 1, by omega⟩)
            = ((⟨n + 1, by omega⟩ : Fin r), (0 : ℚ)) := rfl
      rw [hhead]
      show gparam p < gparam ((⟨n + 1, by omega⟩ : Fin r), (0 : ℚ))
      simp only [gparam, hpfst]
      push_cast
      linarith
  haveI : IsTrans (Fin r × ℚ) (fun p q => gparam p < gparam q) :=
    ⟨fun _ _ _ h1 h2 => h1.trans h2⟩
  exact List.chain'_iff_pairwise.mp hchain

name: chartList_getElem_zero
statement:
theorem chartList_getElem_zero {sl : Fin r → List ℚ} (hr1 : 1 ≤ r)
    (h0 : 0 < (chartList sl).length) :
    (chartList sl)[0]'h0 = ((⟨0, by omega⟩ : Fin r), (0 : ℚ))
proof:
:= by
  have hfr_len : (List.finRange r).length = r := List.length_finRange r
  have hfne : (List.finRange r) ≠ [] := by
    rw [← List.length_pos_iff_ne_nil, hfr_len]
    omega
  have hhead_fin : (List.finRange r).head? = some (⟨0, by omega⟩ : Fin r) := by
    rw [List.head?_eq_head hfne, Option.some_inj, List.head_eq_getElem,
      List.getElem_finRange]
    rfl
  have hy : (chartList sl).head? = some ((⟨0, by omega⟩ : Fin r), (0 : ℚ)) := by
    rw [chartList, head?_flatMap (chartBlock_ne sl) _ _ hhead_fin]
    rfl
  have hne : chartList sl ≠ [] := List.length_pos_iff_ne_nil.mp h0
  rw [List.head?_eq_head hne, Option.some_inj] at hy
  rw [← hy, List.head_eq_getElem]

name: chartList_interval
statement:
theorem chartList_interval {sl : Fin r → List ℚ} (hr3 : 3 ≤ r)
    (hc : ∀ i, (sl i).Chain' (· < ·))
    (hb : ∀ i, ∀ t ∈ sl i, 0 < t ∧ t < 1) :
    ∃ d : ℕ → Fin r × ℚ × ℚ,
      (∀ k, ∀ hk : k < (chartList sl).length,
        (d k).1 = ((chartList sl)[k]'hk).1
        ∧ (d k).2.1 = ((chartList sl)[k]'hk).2
        ∧ (d k).2.1 < (d k).2.2 ∧ (d k).2.2 ≤ 1
        ∧ ∀ (w : Fin r → Point),
            chartPt w ((chartList sl)[(k + 1) % (chartList sl).length]'
                (Nat.mod_lt _ (Nat.zero_lt_of_lt hk)))
              = chartPt w ((d k).1, (d k).2.2))
      ∧ (∀ k l, k < (chartList sl).length → l < (chartList sl).length →
          k ≠ l →
          ((d k).1.val : ℚ) + (d k).2.2 ≤ ((d l).1.val : ℚ) + (d l).2.1
          ∨ ((d l).1.val : ℚ) + (d l).2.2 ≤ ((d k).1.val : ℚ) + (d k).2.1)
      ∧ ∀ (i : Fin r) (s : ℚ), 0 ≤ s → s < 1 →
          ∃ k, ∃ _hk : k < (chartList sl).length,
            (d k).1 = i ∧ (d k).2.1 ≤ s ∧ s < (d k).2.2
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have hr1 : 1 ≤ r := by omega
  have hlen0 : 0 < (chartList sl).length :=
    lt_of_lt_of_le (by omega) (chartList_length sl)
  have h1r : 1 % r = 1 := Nat.mod_eq_of_lt (by omega)
  have hpw' := chartList_gparam_pairwise hc hb
  rw [List.pairwise_iff_getElem] at hpw'
  
  set ent : ℕ → Fin r × ℚ := fun k =>
    (chartList sl).getD k ((⟨0, by omega⟩ : Fin r), 0) with hent
  have hentEq : ∀ k (hk : k < (chartList sl).length),
      ent k = (chartList sl)[k]'hk := by
    intro k hk
    simp only [hent]
    exact List.getD_eq_getElem _ _ hk
  
  have hpw : ∀ k l, k < l → l < (chartList sl).length →
      gparam (ent k) < gparam (ent l) := by
    intro k l hkl hl
    have hk : k < (chartList sl).length := by omega
    rw [hentEq k hk, hentEq l hl]
    exact hpw' k l hk hl hkl
  have hbnd : ∀ k, k < (chartList sl).length →
      0 ≤ (ent k).2 ∧ (ent k).2 < 1 := by
    intro k hk
    rw [hentEq k hk]
    exact chartList_mem_bounds hb (List.getElem_mem hk)
  have hcyc : ∀ k, k < (chartList sl).length →
      crel (ent k) (ent ((k + 1) % (chartList sl).length)) := by
    intro k hk
    rw [hentEq k hk, hentEq _ (Nat.mod_lt _ hlen0)]
    exact chartList_cyclic hc hb k hk
  have hent0 : ent 0 = ((⟨0, by omega⟩ : Fin r), (0 : ℚ)) := by
    rw [hentEq 0 hlen0]
    exact chartList_getElem_zero hr1 hlen0
  
  set β : ℕ → ℚ := fun k =>
    if (ent ((k + 1) % (chartList sl).length)).1 = (ent k).1
      then (ent ((k + 1) % (chartList sl).length)).2
      else 1 with hβdef
  
  have hβbounds : ∀ k, k < (chartList sl).length →
      (ent k).2 < β k ∧ β k ≤ 1 := by
    intro k hk
    have hmodlt : (k + 1) % (chartList sl).length < (chartList sl).length :=
      Nat.mod_lt _ hlen0
    simp only [hβdef]
    rcases hcyc k hk with ⟨hsame, hlt⟩ | ⟨hnext, -⟩
    · rw [if_pos hsame]
      exact ⟨hlt, (hbnd _ hmodlt).2.le⟩
    · rw [if_neg (by rw [hnext]; exact fin_add_one_ne hr3 _)]
      exact ⟨(hbnd k hk).2, le_refl 1⟩
  
  have hβpt : ∀ k, k < (chartList sl).length → ∀ (w : Fin r → Point),
      chartPt w (ent ((k + 1) % (chartList sl).length))
        = chartPt w ((ent k).1, β k) := by
    intro k hk w
    simp only [hβdef]
    rcases hcyc k hk with ⟨hsame, -⟩ | ⟨hnext, hzero⟩
    · rw [if_pos hsame]
      simp only [chartPt, hsame]
    · rw [if_neg (by rw [hnext]; exact fin_add_one_ne hr3 _)]
      simp only [chartPt, hnext, hzero]
      rw [zero_smul, one_smul, add_zero]
      abel
  
  have hβends : ∀ k, k + 1 < (chartList sl).length →
      ((ent k).1.val : ℚ) + β k = gparam (ent (k + 1)) := by
    intro k hk1
    have hk : k < (chartList sl).length := by omega
    have hmod : (k + 1) % (chartList sl).length = k + 1 :=
      Nat.mod_eq_of_lt hk1
    have hcrel := hcyc k hk
    rw [hmod] at hcrel
    simp only [hβdef, hmod]
    rcases hcrel with ⟨hsame, -⟩ | ⟨hnext, hzero⟩
    · rw [if_pos hsame]
      simp only [gparam, hsame]
    · rw [if_neg (by rw [hnext]; exact fin_add_one_ne hr3 _)]
      have hmono := hpw k (k + 1) (by omega) hk1
      have hv : ((ent k).1 + 1).val = ((ent k).1.val + 1) % r := by
        rw [Fin.val_add, Fin.val_one', h1r]
      rcases Nat.lt_or_ge ((ent k).1.val + 1) r with hlt2 | hge
      · simp only [gparam, hnext, hzero, hv, Nat.mod_eq_of_lt hlt2]
        push_cast
        ring
      · exfalso
        have hvr : (ent k).1.val + 1 = r := by
          have := ((ent k).1).isLt
          omega
        have hz : ((ent k).1 + 1).val = 0 := by
          rw [hv, hvr, Nat.mod_self]
        have hq0 : gparam (ent (k + 1)) = 0 := by
          simp only [gparam, hnext, hzero, hz]
          norm_num
        have hge0 : (0 : ℚ) ≤ gparam (ent k) := by
          simp only [gparam]
          have h2 := (hbnd k hk).1
          positivity
        rw [hq0] at hmono
        linarith
  
  have hβlast : ∀ k, k + 1 = (chartList sl).length →
      ((ent k).1.val : ℚ) + β k = (r : ℚ) := by
    intro k hk1
    have hk : k < (chartList sl).length := by omega
    have hmod : (k + 1) % (chartList sl).length = 0 := by
      rw [hk1, Nat.mod_self]
    have hcrel := hcyc k hk
    rw [hmod, hent0] at hcrel
    simp only [hβdef, hmod, hent0]
    rcases hcrel with ⟨-, hlt⟩ | ⟨hnext, -⟩
    · exact absurd hlt (not_lt.mpr (hbnd k hk).1)
    · have hne : ¬ ((⟨0, by omega⟩ : Fin r) = (ent k).1) := by
        intro hcond
        rw [hcond] at hnext
        exact fin_add_one_ne hr3 _ hnext.symm
      rw [if_neg hne]
      have hv : ((ent k).1 + 1).val = ((ent k).1.val + 1) % r := by
        rw [Fin.val_add, Fin.val_one', h1r]
      have hz0 : ((ent k).1 + 1).val = 0 := by
        rw [← hnext]
      have hvr : (ent k).1.val + 1 = r := by
        rw [hv] at hz0
        have hlt2 := ((ent k).1).isLt
        rcases Nat.lt_or_ge ((ent k).1.val + 1) r with h2 | h2
        · rw [Nat.mod_eq_of_lt h2] at hz0
          omega
        · omega
      exact_mod_cast congrArg (Nat.cast (R := ℚ)) hvr
  
  refine ⟨fun k => ((ent k).1, (ent k).2, β k), ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · 
    intro k hk
    refine ⟨?_, ?_, (hβbounds k hk).1, (hβbounds k hk).2, ?_⟩
    · show (ent k).1 = ((chartList sl)[k]'hk).1
      rw [hentEq k hk]
    · show (ent k).2 = ((chartList sl)[k]'hk).2
      rw [hentEq k hk]
    · intro w
      have := hβpt k hk w
      rw [hentEq _ (Nat.mod_lt _ hlen0)] at this
      exact this
  · 
    have key : ∀ k l, k < (chartList sl).length →
        l < (chartList sl).length → k < l →
        ((ent k).1.val : ℚ) + β k ≤ ((ent l).1.val : ℚ) + (ent l).2 := by
      intro k l hk hl hkl
      have hk1 : k + 1 < (chartList sl).length := by omega
      have hend := hβends k hk1
      rcases Nat.lt_or_ge (k + 1) l with h2 | h2
      · have := hpw (k + 1) l h2 hl
        simp only [gparam] at hend this
        linarith
      · have hkl1 : k + 1 = l := by omega
        rw [hkl1] at hend
        simp only [gparam] at hend
        linarith
    intro k l hk hl hne
    rcases Nat.lt_or_gt_of_ne hne with h | h
    · left
      exact key k l hk hl h
    · right
      exact key l k hl hk h
  · 
    intro i s hs0 hs1
    set g : ℚ := (i.val : ℚ) + s with hgdef
    have hg0 : (0 : ℚ) ≤ g := by
      rw [hgdef]
      positivity
    set S : Finset ℕ := (Finset.range (chartList sl).length).filter
      (fun k => gparam (ent k) ≤ g) with hSdef
    have h0S : 0 ∈ S := by
      refine Finset.mem_filter.mpr ⟨Finset.mem_range.mpr hlen0, ?_⟩
      rw [hent0]
      show ((0 : ℕ) : ℚ) + (0 : ℚ) ≤ g
      simpa using hg0
    have hSne : S.Nonempty := ⟨0, h0S⟩
    set k₀ := S.max' hSne with hk₀def
    have hk₀S : k₀ ∈ S := S.max'_mem hSne
    have hk₀S' := Finset.mem_filter.mp hk₀S
    have hk₀len : k₀ < (chartList sl).length := Finset.mem_range.mp hk₀S'.1
    have hk₀le : gparam (ent k₀) ≤ g := hk₀S'.2
    refine ⟨k₀, hk₀len, ?_⟩
    
    have hupper : g < ((ent k₀).1.val : ℚ) + β k₀ := by
      rcases Nat.lt_or_ge (k₀ + 1) (chartList sl).length with hk1 | hk1
      · have hnot2 : ¬ gparam (ent (k₀ + 1)) ≤ g := by
          intro hle
          have hmem : k₀ + 1 ∈ S :=
            Finset.mem_filter.mpr ⟨Finset.mem_range.mpr hk1, hle⟩
          have := S.le_max' _ hmem
          omega
        have hend := hβends k₀ hk1
        have hgt := not_le.mp hnot2
        simp only [gparam] at hend hgt
        linarith
      · have hk1' : k₀ + 1 = (chartList sl).length := by omega
        have hend := hβlast k₀ hk1'
        have hir : (i.val : ℚ) + 1 ≤ (r : ℚ) := by
          exact_mod_cast Nat.succ_le_of_lt i.isLt
        rw [hgdef]
        linarith
    
    have hlower : ((ent k₀).1.val : ℚ) + (ent k₀).2 ≤ g := hk₀le
    
    have hα0 := (hbnd k₀ hk₀len).1
    have hβ1 := (hβbounds k₀ hk₀len).2
    have hivals : (ent k₀).1.val = i.val := by
      have h1 : (((ent k₀).1.val : ℚ)) < (i.val : ℚ) + 1 := by
        rw [hgdef] at hlower
        linarith
      have h2 : ((i.val : ℚ)) < ((ent k₀).1.val : ℚ) + 1 := by
        rw [hgdef] at hupper
        have := (hβbounds k₀ hk₀len).2
        linarith
      have h1' : (ent k₀).1.val < i.val + 1 := by
        exact_mod_cast h1
      have h2' : i.val < (ent k₀).1.val + 1 := by
        exact_mod_cast h2
      omega
    have hcast : (((ent k₀).1.val : ℚ)) = (i.val : ℚ) := by
      exact_mod_cast congrArg (Nat.cast (R := ℚ)) hivals
    refine ⟨Fin.ext hivals, ?_, ?_⟩
    · rw [hgdef] at hlower
      show (ent k₀).2 ≤ s
      linarith
    · rw [hgdef] at hupper
      show s < β k₀
      linarith

name: atomize_refShape
statement:
theorem atomize_refShape {nt : Point} {ct : ℚ} {f : Frag}
    (hf : FragInv nt ct f) (vs : Array Vtx)
    (hvs : ∀ v ∈ vs.toList, repr4 v.h (P3.toPoint v.p))
    (hnd : vs.toList.Pairwise (fun u v => u.p ≠ v.p)) :
    ∃ hm : 3 ≤ (atomizeFrag vs f).poly.size,
      @RefShapeOrd f.poly.size (atomizeFrag vs f).poly.size hf.neZero
        ⟨by omega⟩ (fragCycle f) (fragCycle (atomizeFrag vs f))
proof:
:= by
  classical
  haveI := hf.neZero
  have hr : 3 ≤ f.poly.size := hf.size3
  
  have hedge : ∀ i : Fin f.poly.size,
      ∃ s : List ℚ,
        (hitsOn vs f.poly[i] f.poly[i + 1]).toList.map
            (fun v => P3.toPoint v.p)
          = s.map (fun t => fragCycle f i
              + t • (fragCycle f (i + 1) - fragCycle f i))
        ∧ s.Chain' (· < ·) ∧ ∀ t ∈ s, 0 < t ∧ t < 1 := by
    intro i
    exact hitsOn_shape vs (hf.vrepr i) (hf.vrepr (i + 1)) hvs hnd
      (consec_ne hr hf.strictConv i)
  choose sl hsl_map hsl_chain hsl_bounds using hedge
  
  have hmap : (atomizeFrag vs f).poly.toList.map (fun v => P3.toPoint v.p)
      = (chartList sl).map (chartPt (fragCycle f)) := by
    rw [atomizeFrag_poly, List.map_flatMap, chartList, List.map_flatMap]
    rw [← finRange_map_val f.poly.size, List.flatMap_map]
    congr 1
    funext i
    rw [chartBlock, List.map_cons, List.map_cons, List.map_map]
    congr 1
    · show P3.toPoint (f.poly.getD i.val default).p = chartPt (fragCycle f) (i, 0)
      rw [poly_getD f i, chartPt]
      show fragCycle f i = _
      simp
    · show (hitsOn vs (f.poly.getD i.val default)
          (f.poly.getD ((i.val + 1) % f.poly.size) default)).toList.map
          (fun v => P3.toPoint v.p)
        = (sl i).map (chartPt (fragCycle f) ∘ fun t => (i, t))
      rw [poly_getD f i, poly_getD_succ hr i, hsl_map i]
      rfl
  
  have hlen : (atomizeFrag vs f).poly.size = (chartList sl).length := by
    have := congrArg List.length hmap
    rwa [List.length_map, List.length_map, Array.length_toList] at this
  have hm : 3 ≤ (atomizeFrag vs f).poly.size := by
    rw [hlen]
    have := chartList_length sl
    omega
  refine ⟨hm, ?_⟩
  haveI : NeZero (atomizeFrag vs f).poly.size := ⟨by omega⟩
  
  have hread : ∀ k : Fin (atomizeFrag vs f).poly.size,
      fragCycle (atomizeFrag vs f) k
        = chartPt (fragCycle f)
            ((chartList sl)[k.val]'(Nat.lt_of_lt_of_eq k.isLt hlen)) := by
    intro k
    have hk' : k.val < ((chartList sl).map (chartPt (fragCycle f))).length := by
      rw [List.length_map, ← hlen]
      exact k.isLt
    have h := toPoint_get_of_map_eq hmap k hk'
    rw [List.get_eq_getElem, List.getElem_map] at h
    exact h
  refine ⟨⟨?_, ?_, ?_⟩, ?_⟩
  · 
    intro i
    have hmem : (i, (0 : ℚ)) ∈ chartList sl := chartList_mem_head sl i
    rw [List.mem_iff_getElem] at hmem
    obtain ⟨n, hn, hval⟩ := hmem
    refine ⟨⟨n, Nat.lt_of_lt_of_eq hn hlen.symm⟩, ?_⟩
    refine (hread ⟨n, Nat.lt_of_lt_of_eq hn hlen.symm⟩).trans ?_
    refine (congrArg (chartPt (fragCycle f)) hval).trans ?_
    rw [chartPt]
    show fragCycle f i + (0 : ℚ) • _ = fragCycle f i
    rw [zero_smul, add_zero]
  · 
    intro k
    have hk : k.val < (chartList sl).length := by
      rw [← hlen]
      exact k.isLt
    have hmem : (chartList sl)[k.val]'hk ∈ chartList sl := List.getElem_mem hk
    obtain ⟨h0, h1⟩ := chartList_mem_bounds hsl_bounds hmem
    exact ⟨_, _, h0, h1, hread k⟩
  · 
    intro k
    have hk : k.val < (chartList sl).length := by
      rw [← hlen]
      exact k.isLt
    have hkk : (k + 1).val = (k.val + 1) % (chartList sl).length := by
      rw [← hlen, Fin.val_add, Fin.val_one']
      congr 1
      have h1m : 1 % (atomizeFrag vs f).poly.size = 1 :=
        Nat.mod_eq_of_lt (by omega)
      rw [h1m]
    have hcyc := chartList_cyclic hsl_chain hsl_bounds k.val hk
    have hreadk := hread k
    have hreadk1 : fragCycle (atomizeFrag vs f) (k + 1)
        = chartPt (fragCycle f)
            ((chartList sl)[(k.val + 1) % (chartList sl).length]'
              (Nat.mod_lt _ (Nat.zero_lt_of_lt hk))) :=
      (hread (k + 1)).trans
        (congrArg (chartPt (fragCycle f)) (getElem_idx_congr _ hkk _))
    have hpbnd := chartList_mem_bounds hsl_bounds
      (List.getElem_mem (l := chartList sl) (n := k.val) hk)
    rcases hcyc with ⟨hsame, hlt⟩ | ⟨hnext, hzero⟩
    · 
      have hqbnd := chartList_mem_bounds hsl_bounds
        (List.getElem_mem (l := chartList sl)
          (n := (k.val + 1) % (chartList sl).length)
          (Nat.mod_lt _ (Nat.zero_lt_of_lt hk)))
      refine ⟨((chartList sl)[k.val]'hk).1, ((chartList sl)[k.val]'hk).2,
        ((chartList sl)[(k.val + 1) % (chartList sl).length]'
          (Nat.mod_lt _ (Nat.zero_lt_of_lt hk))).2,
        hpbnd.1, hlt, hqbnd.2.le, hreadk, ?_⟩
      rw [hreadk1, chartPt, hsame]
    · 
      refine ⟨((chartList sl)[k.val]'hk).1, ((chartList sl)[k.val]'hk).2, 1,
        hpbnd.1, hpbnd.2, le_refl 1, hreadk, ?_⟩
      rw [hreadk1, chartPt, hnext, hzero, one_smul]
      show fragCycle f _ + (0 : ℚ) • _ = _
      rw [zero_smul, add_zero]
      abel
  · 
    obtain ⟨d, hper, hdisj, hcover⟩ :=
      chartList_interval hr hsl_chain hsl_bounds
    refine ⟨fun k => d k.val, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
    · intro k
      have hk : k.val < (chartList sl).length :=
        Nat.lt_of_lt_of_eq k.isLt hlen
      obtain ⟨h1, h2, h3, h4, h5⟩ := hper k.val hk
      have hkk : (k + 1).val = (k.val + 1) % (chartList sl).length := by
        rw [← hlen, Fin.val_add, Fin.val_one']
        congr 1
        have h1m : 1 % (atomizeFrag vs f).poly.size = 1 :=
          Nat.mod_eq_of_lt (by omega)
        rw [h1m]
      have hb0 : 0 ≤ (d k.val).2.1 := by
        rw [h2]
        exact (chartList_mem_bounds hsl_bounds (List.getElem_mem hk)).1
      refine ⟨hb0, h3, h4, ?_, ?_⟩
      · exact (hread k).trans (by rw [h1, h2]; rfl)
      · have hreadk1 : fragCycle (atomizeFrag vs f) (k + 1)
            = chartPt (fragCycle f)
                ((chartList sl)[(k.val + 1) % (chartList sl).length]'
                  (Nat.mod_lt _ (Nat.zero_lt_of_lt hk))) :=
          (hread (k + 1)).trans
            (congrArg (chartPt (fragCycle f)) (getElem_idx_congr _ hkk _))
        exact hreadk1.trans (h5 (fragCycle f))
    · intro k l hne
      exact hdisj k.val l.val (Nat.lt_of_lt_of_eq k.isLt hlen)
        (Nat.lt_of_lt_of_eq l.isLt hlen) (fun h => hne (Fin.ext h))
    · intro i s h0 h1
      obtain ⟨k, hk, hki, hα, hβ⟩ := hcover i s h0 h1
      exact ⟨⟨k, Nat.lt_of_lt_of_eq hk hlen.symm⟩, hki, hα, hβ⟩

name: two_comb
statement:
private theorem two_comb (w : Fin r → Point) (i : Fin r) {t : ℚ}
    (h0 : 0 ≤ t) (h1 : t ≤ 1) :
    ∃ c : Fin r → ℚ, (∀ j, 0 ≤ c j) ∧ (∑ j, c j) = 1
      ∧ w i + t • (w (i + 1) - w i) = ∑ j, c j • w j
proof:
:= by
  classical
  refine ⟨fun j => (if j = i then 1 - t else 0) + (if j = i + 1 then t else 0),
    fun j => add_nonneg (by split_ifs <;> linarith) (by split_ifs <;> linarith),
    ?_, ?_⟩
  · rw [Finset.sum_add_distrib, Finset.sum_ite_eq' Finset.univ i,
      Finset.sum_ite_eq' Finset.univ (i + 1)]
    simp
  · have hsum : ∑ j, ((if j = i then 1 - t else 0)
        + (if j = i + 1 then t else 0)) • w j
        = ∑ j, ((if j = i then (1 - t) • w j else 0)
          + (if j = i + 1 then t • w j else 0)) := by
      refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun j _ => ?_
      rw [add_smul]
      congr 1 <;> · split_ifs <;> simp
    rw [hsum, Finset.sum_add_distrib, Finset.sum_ite_eq' Finset.univ i,
      Finset.sum_ite_eq' Finset.univ (i + 1)]
    simp only [Finset.mem_univ, if_pos]
    rw [smul_sub, sub_smul, one_smul]
    abel

name: RefShape.comb'
statement:
theorem RefShape.comb' (hs : RefShape w u) (k : Fin m) :
    ∃ c : Fin r → ℚ, (∀ i, 0 ≤ c i) ∧ (∑ i, c i) = 1
      ∧ u k = ∑ i, c i • w i
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨i, t, h0, h1, hrep⟩ := hs.comb k
  obtain ⟨c, hc0, hc1, hcr⟩ := two_comb w i h0 h1.le
  exact ⟨c, hc0, hc1, hrep.trans hcr⟩

name: RefShape.vpoly_eq
statement: theorem RefShape.vpoly_eq (hs : RefShape w u) : vpoly u = vpoly w
proof:
:=
  vpoly_refines hs.orig hs.comb'

name: RefShape.vrelint_eq
statement:
theorem RefShape.vrelint_eq (hr : 3 ≤ r) (hstrict : StrictConv nt w)
    (hs : RefShape w u) : vrelint u = vrelint w
proof:
:=
  vrelint_refines (strictConv_injective hr hstrict) hs.orig hs.comb'

name: RefShape.onPlane
statement:
theorem RefShape.onPlane (hpl : OnPlane nt ct w) (hs : RefShape w u) :
    OnPlane nt ct u
proof:
:= by
  intro k
  obtain ⟨i, t, -, -, hrep⟩ := hs.comb k
  rw [hrep, dotQ_add_right, Proof.MeshIntersectRay.dotQ_smul_right,
    dotQ_sub_right, hpl i, hpl (i + 1)]
  ring

name: RefShape.apex_mem
statement:
theorem RefShape.apex_mem (hr : 3 ≤ r) (hm3 : 3 ≤ m)
    (hstrict : StrictConv nt w) (hs : RefShape w u) :
    (∑ k, (m : ℚ)⁻¹ • u k) ∈ vrelint w
proof:
:=
  refined_barycenter_mem_vrelint hr hm3 hstrict hs.orig hs.comb'

name: RefShape.eta_vanish
statement:
theorem RefShape.eta_vanish (hs : RefShape w u) (k : Fin m) :
    ∃ i : Fin r, eta nt w i (u k) = 0
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨i, t, -, -, hrep⟩ := hs.comb k
  refine ⟨i, ?_⟩
  have hu : u k = (1 - t) • w i + t • w (i + 1) := by
    rw [hrep, smul_sub, sub_smul, one_smul]
    abel
  rw [hu, eta_affine_comb nt w i (by ring : (1 - t) + t = 1), eta_self,
    eta_succ]
  ring

name: RefShape.consec_ne
statement:
theorem RefShape.consec_ne (hr : 3 ≤ r) (hstrict : StrictConv nt w)
    (hs : RefShape w u) (k : Fin m) : u k ≠ u (k + 1)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨i, α, β, -, hαβ, -, hk, hk1⟩ := hs.consec k
  intro hc
  rw [hk, hk1, add_right_inj] at hc
  have hz : (β - α) • (w (i + 1) - w i) = 0 := by
    rw [sub_smul, hc]
    abel
  rcases smul_eq_zero.mp hz with h | h
  · linarith [hαβ, h]
  · exact Proof.MeshIntersectClip.consec_ne hr hstrict i
      (sub_eq_zero.mp h).symm

name: RefShape.apex_ne
statement:
theorem RefShape.apex_ne (hr : 3 ≤ r) (hm3 : 3 ≤ m)
    (hpl : OnPlane nt ct w) (hstrict : StrictConv nt w) (hs : RefShape w u)
    (k : Fin m) : (∑ j, (m : ℚ)⁻¹ • u j) ≠ u k
proof:
:= by
  intro hc
  have hmem := hs.apex_mem hr hm3 hstrict
  rw [Proof.MeshIntersectClip.vrelint_eq hr hpl hstrict] at hmem
  obtain ⟨-, hpos⟩ := hmem
  obtain ⟨i, hi⟩ := hs.eta_vanish (nt := nt) k
  have hp := hpos i
  rw [hc, hi] at hp
  exact lt_irrefl 0 hp

name: chart_inj
statement:
theorem chart_inj (hr : 3 ≤ r) (hstrict : StrictConv nt w)
    {i j : Fin r} {s t : ℚ} (hs0 : 0 ≤ s) (hs1 : s < 1)
    (ht0 : 0 ≤ t) (ht1 : t < 1)
    (heq : w i + s • (w (i + 1) - w i) = w j + t • (w (j + 1) - w j)) :
    i = j ∧ s = t
proof:
:= by
  
  have key : ∀ (i j : Fin r) (s t : ℚ), 0 ≤ t → t < 1 → i ≠ j →
      w i + s • (w (i + 1) - w i) = w j + t • (w (j + 1) - w j) →
      j = i + 1 := by
    intro i j s t ht0 ht1 hij heq
    have hPi : eta nt w i (w i + s • (w (i + 1) - w i)) = 0 := by
      have hx : w i + s • (w (i + 1) - w i) = (1 - s) • w i + s • w (i + 1) := by
        rw [smul_sub, sub_smul, one_smul]
        abel
      rw [hx, eta_affine_comb nt w i (by ring : (1 - s) + s = 1), eta_self,
        eta_succ]
      ring
    have hPj : eta nt w i (w j + t • (w (j + 1) - w j))
        = (1 - t) * eta nt w i (w j) + t * eta nt w i (w (j + 1)) := by
      have hx : w j + t • (w (j + 1) - w j) = (1 - t) • w j + t • w (j + 1) := by
        rw [smul_sub, sub_smul, one_smul]
        abel
      rw [hx, eta_affine_comb nt w i (by ring : (1 - t) + t = 1)]
    have hzero : (1 - t) * eta nt w i (w j) + t * eta nt w i (w (j + 1)) = 0 := by
      rw [← hPj, ← heq, hPi]
    have hA : 0 ≤ eta nt w i (w j) := convPos_of_strict hstrict i j
    have hB : 0 ≤ eta nt w i (w (j + 1)) := convPos_of_strict hstrict i (j + 1)
    have h1 : (1 - t) * eta nt w i (w j) = 0 := by
      have hge : 0 ≤ (1 - t) * eta nt w i (w j) := mul_nonneg (by linarith) hA
      have hge2 : 0 ≤ t * eta nt w i (w (j + 1)) := mul_nonneg ht0 hB
      linarith
    have hAz : eta nt w i (w j) = 0 := by
      rcases mul_eq_zero.mp h1 with h | h
      · exact absurd h (by intro hc; linarith)
      · exact h
    by_contra hj1
    exact absurd hAz (ne_of_gt (hstrict i j (Ne.symm hij) hj1))
  by_cases hij : i = j
  · subst hij
    refine ⟨rfl, ?_⟩
    have h := heq
    rw [add_right_inj] at h
    have hz : (s - t) • (w (i + 1) - w i) = 0 := by
      rw [sub_smul, h]
      abel
    rcases smul_eq_zero.mp hz with h' | h'
    · exact sub_eq_zero.mp h'
    · exact absurd (sub_eq_zero.mp h').symm (consec_ne hr hstrict i)
  · exfalso
    have hj1 := key i j s t ht0 ht1 hij heq
    have hi1 := key j i t s hs0 hs1 (Ne.symm hij) heq.symm
    rw [hj1] at hi1
    exact fin_add_two_ne hr i hi1.symm

name: RefShapeOrd.inj
statement:
theorem RefShapeOrd.inj (hr : 3 ≤ r) (hstrict : StrictConv nt w)
    (hs : RefShapeOrd w u) : Function.Injective u
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨d, hper, hdisj, -⟩ := hs.chart
  intro k l hkl
  by_contra hne
  obtain ⟨hk0, hk1, hk2, hk3, -⟩ := hper k
  obtain ⟨hl0, hl1, hl2, hl3, -⟩ := hper l
  obtain ⟨hd, hlo⟩ := chart_inj hr hstrict hk0 (lt_of_lt_of_le hk1 hk2)
    hl0 (lt_of_lt_of_le hl1 hl2) (by rw [← hk3, ← hl3]; exact hkl)
  have hdval : (((d k).1.val : ℚ)) = ((d l).1.val : ℚ) := by rw [hd]
  rcases hdisj k l hne with h | h
  · linarith
  · linarith

name: beqS_false_of_toPoint_ne
statement:
theorem beqS_false_of_toPoint_ne {a b : P3}
    (h : P3.toPoint a ≠ P3.toPoint b) : beqS a b = false
proof:
:= by
  rw [Bool.eq_false_iff, Ne, beqS_iff]
  intro hc
  exact h (by rw [hc])

name: emitFrag_unfold
statement:
private theorem emitFrag_unfold (g : Frag) :
    emitFrag g
      = if g.poly.size == 3 then
          (if beqS (g.poly.getD 0 default).p (g.poly.getD 1 default).p
              || beqS (g.poly.getD 1 default).p (g.poly.getD 2 default).p
              || beqS (g.poly.getD 2 default).p (g.poly.getD 0 default).p
            then #[]
            else #[⟨P3.toPoint (g.poly.getD 0 default).p,
              P3.toPoint (g.poly.getD 1 default).p,
              P3.toPoint (g.poly.getD 2 default).p⟩])
        else
          (Array.range g.poly.size).foldl (fun acc i =>
            if beqS (smulS (1 / ((g.poly.size : ℕ) : ℚ))
                  (g.poly.foldl (fun acc v => paddS acc v.p) ⟨0, 0, 0⟩))
                (g.poly.getD i default).p
              || beqS (smulS (1 / ((g.poly.size : ℕ) : ℚ))
                  (g.poly.foldl (fun acc v => paddS acc v.p) ⟨0, 0, 0⟩))
                (g.poly.getD ((i + 1) % g.poly.size) default).p
              || beqS (g.poly.getD i default).p
                (g.poly.getD ((i + 1) % g.poly.size) default).p
            then acc
            else acc.push ⟨P3.toPoint (smulS (1 / ((g.poly.size : ℕ) : ℚ))
                (g.poly.foldl (fun acc v => paddS acc v.p) ⟨0, 0, 0⟩)),
              P3.toPoint (g.poly.getD i default).p,
              P3.toPoint (g.poly.getD ((i + 1) % g.poly.size) default).p⟩)
            #[]
proof: := rfl

name: emitFrag_eq_triangle
statement:
theorem emitFrag_eq_triangle {g : Frag} (h3 : g.poly.size = 3)
    (hne01 : P3.toPoint (g.poly.getD 0 default).p
      ≠ P3.toPoint (g.poly.getD 1 default).p)
    (hne12 : P3.toPoint (g.poly.getD 1 default).p
      ≠ P3.toPoint (g.poly.getD 2 default).p)
    (hne20 : P3.toPoint (g.poly.getD 2 default).p
      ≠ P3.toPoint (g.poly.getD 0 default).p) :
    emitFrag g = #[⟨P3.toPoint (g.poly.getD 0 default).p,
      P3.toPoint (g.poly.getD 1 default).p,
      P3.toPoint (g.poly.getD 2 default).p⟩]
proof:
:= by
  rw [emitFrag_unfold, if_pos (by rw [h3]; rfl : (g.poly.size == 3) = true),
    if_neg (by
      rw [beqS_false_of_toPoint_ne hne01, beqS_false_of_toPoint_ne hne12,
        beqS_false_of_toPoint_ne hne20]
      simp)]

name: foldl_push_map
statement:
private theorem foldl_push_map {α β : Type} (l : List α) (cond : α → Bool)
    (F : α → β) (h : ∀ x ∈ l, cond x = false) :
    ∀ init : Array β,
      (l.foldl (fun acc x => if cond x then acc else acc.push (F x))
        init).toList = init.toList ++ l.map F
proof:
:= by
  induction l with
  | nil => intro init; simp
  | cons a t ih =>
    intro init
    rw [List.foldl_cons, if_neg (by rw [h a (List.mem_cons_self _ _)]; simp)]
    rw [ih (fun x hx => h x (List.mem_cons_of_mem _ hx)), List.map_cons]
    simp

name: emitFrag_eq_fan
statement:
theorem emitFrag_eq_fan {g : Frag} [NeZero g.poly.size]
    (h4 : g.poly.size ≠ 3) (hm3 : 3 ≤ g.poly.size)
    (hapex : ∀ k : Fin g.poly.size, apexQ g ≠ fragCycle g k)
    (hcons : ∀ k : Fin g.poly.size, fragCycle g k ≠ fragCycle g (k + 1)) :
    (emitFrag g).toList
      = List.ofFn (fun k : Fin g.poly.size =>
          (⟨apexQ g, fragCycle g k, fragCycle g (k + 1)⟩ : Triangle))
proof:
:= by
  
  have hapexQ : P3.toPoint (smulS (1 / ((g.poly.size : ℕ) : ℚ))
      (g.poly.foldl (fun acc v => paddS acc v.p) ⟨0, 0, 0⟩)) = apexQ g :=
    CSG.Proof.MeshIntersectSample.sampleB_toPoint g
  rw [emitFrag_unfold, if_neg (by simpa using h4)]
  rw [← Array.foldl_toList, Array.toList_range]
  rw [foldl_push_map _ _ _ ?hfalse #[]]
  case hfalse =>
    intro i hi
    rw [List.mem_range] at hi
    have hgd1 : g.poly.getD i default = g.poly[(⟨i, hi⟩ : Fin g.poly.size)] :=
      poly_getD g ⟨i, hi⟩
    have hgd2 : g.poly.getD ((i + 1) % g.poly.size) default
        = g.poly[(⟨i, hi⟩ : Fin g.poly.size) + 1] :=
      poly_getD_succ hm3 ⟨i, hi⟩
    have h1 : P3.toPoint (smulS (1 / ((g.poly.size : ℕ) : ℚ))
        (g.poly.foldl (fun acc v => paddS acc v.p) ⟨0, 0, 0⟩))
        ≠ P3.toPoint (g.poly.getD i default).p := by
      rw [hapexQ, hgd1]
      exact hapex ⟨i, hi⟩
    have h2 : P3.toPoint (smulS (1 / ((g.poly.size : ℕ) : ℚ))
        (g.poly.foldl (fun acc v => paddS acc v.p) ⟨0, 0, 0⟩))
        ≠ P3.toPoint (g.poly.getD ((i + 1) % g.poly.size) default).p := by
      rw [hapexQ, hgd2]
      exact hapex (⟨i, hi⟩ + 1)
    have h3 : P3.toPoint (g.poly.getD i default).p
        ≠ P3.toPoint (g.poly.getD ((i + 1) % g.poly.size) default).p := by
      rw [hgd1, hgd2]
      exact hcons ⟨i, hi⟩
    rw [beqS_false_of_toPoint_ne h1, beqS_false_of_toPoint_ne h2,
      beqS_false_of_toPoint_ne h3]
    rfl
  · rw [show (#[] : Array Triangle).toList = [] from rfl, List.nil_append]
    apply List.ext_getElem
    · simp
    · intro n h1 h2
      have h1' : n < g.poly.size := by simpa using h1
      rw [List.getElem_map, List.getElem_range, List.getElem_ofFn]
      have hgd1 : g.poly.getD n default = g.poly[(⟨n, h1'⟩ : Fin g.poly.size)] :=
        poly_getD g ⟨n, h1'⟩
      have hgd2 : g.poly.getD ((n + 1) % g.poly.size) default
          = g.poly[(⟨n, h1'⟩ : Fin g.poly.size) + 1] :=
        poly_getD_succ hm3 ⟨n, h1'⟩
      rw [hgd1, hgd2, hapexQ]
      rfl

name: eta_zero_convex
statement:
private theorem eta_zero_convex (nt : Point) (w : Fin r → Point) (i : Fin r) :
    Convex ℚ {x : Point | eta nt w i x = 0}
proof:
:= by
  intro x hx y hy a b ha hb hab
  simp only [Set.mem_setOf_eq] at hx hy ⊢
  rw [eta_affine_comb nt w i hab, hx, hy]
  ring

name: RefShape.tri_ccw
statement:
theorem RefShape.tri_ccw (hr : 3 ≤ r) (hm : m = 3)
    (hpl : OnPlane nt ct w) (hstrict : StrictConv nt w) (hs : RefShape w u) :
    0 < areaForm nt (u ⟨0, by omega⟩) (u ⟨1, by omega⟩) (u ⟨2, by omega⟩)
proof:
:= by
  subst hm
  obtain ⟨i, α, β, h0α, hαβ, hβ1, hu0, hu1⟩ := hs.consec ⟨0, by omega⟩
  have hone : (⟨0, by omega⟩ : Fin 3) + 1 = ⟨1, by omega⟩ := rfl
  rw [hone] at hu1
  have hsub : ∀ x, areaForm nt (u ⟨0, by omega⟩) (u ⟨1, by omega⟩) x
      = (β - α) * eta nt w i x := by
    intro x
    rw [hu0, hu1, areaForm_sub_edge]
    rfl
  rw [hsub]
  apply mul_pos (by linarith)
  
  rcases lt_or_le 0 (eta nt w i (u ⟨2, by omega⟩)) with hpos | hle
  · exact hpos
  exfalso
  have hnonneg : 0 ≤ eta nt w i (u ⟨2, by omega⟩) := by
    have hmem : u ⟨2, by omega⟩ ∈ vpoly w := by
      rw [← hs.vpoly_eq]
      exact subset_convexHull ℚ _ (Set.mem_range_self _)
    rw [Proof.MeshIntersectClip.vpoly_eq hr hpl hstrict] at hmem
    exact hmem.2 i
  have hz2 : eta nt w i (u ⟨2, by omega⟩) = 0 := le_antisymm hle hnonneg
  have hz0 : eta nt w i (u ⟨0, by omega⟩) = 0 := by
    have hu0' : u ⟨0, by omega⟩ = (1 - α) • w i + α • w (i + 1) := by
      rw [hu0, smul_sub, sub_smul, one_smul]
      abel
    rw [hu0', eta_affine_comb nt w i (by ring : (1 - α) + α = 1), eta_self,
      eta_succ]
    ring
  have hz1 : eta nt w i (u ⟨1, by omega⟩) = 0 := by
    have hu1' : u ⟨1, by omega⟩ = (1 - β) • w i + β • w (i + 1) := by
      rw [hu1, smul_sub, sub_smul, one_smul]
      abel
    rw [hu1', eta_affine_comb nt w i (by ring : (1 - β) + β = 1), eta_self,
      eta_succ]
    ring
  
  have hall : vpoly u ⊆ {x : Point | eta nt w i x = 0} := by
    apply convexHull_min ?_ (eta_zero_convex nt w i)
    rintro x ⟨k, rfl⟩
    rcases k with ⟨kv, hkv⟩
    interval_cases kv
    · exact hz0
    · exact hz1
    · exact hz2
  have hwj : w (i + 1 + 1) ∈ vpoly u := by
    rw [hs.vpoly_eq]
    exact subset_convexHull ℚ _ (Set.mem_range_self _)
  have := hall hwj
  rw [Set.mem_setOf_eq] at this
  exact absurd this
    (ne_of_gt (hstrict i (i + 1 + 1) (fin_add_two_ne hr i)
      (fin_add_one_ne hr (i + 1))))

name: RefShape.fan_ccw
statement:
theorem RefShape.fan_ccw (hr : 3 ≤ r) (hm3 : 3 ≤ m)
    (hpl : OnPlane nt ct w) (hstrict : StrictConv nt w) (hs : RefShape w u)
    (k : Fin m) :
    0 < areaForm nt (∑ j, (m : ℚ)⁻¹ • u j) (u k) (u (k + 1))
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨i, α, β, -, hαβ, -, hk, hk1⟩ := hs.consec k
  rw [hk, hk1]
  exact fan_triangle_ccw hr hpl hstrict (hs.apex_mem hr hm3 hstrict) i hαβ

name: winding_meshChain_flatMap
statement:
theorem winding_meshChain_flatMap {α : Type} (X : Array α) (F : α → Mesh)
    (Q : Point) :
    winding (meshChain (X.flatMap F)) Q
      = (X.toList.map (fun x => winding (meshChain (F x)) Q)).sum
proof:
:= by
  unfold winding meshChain
  rw [Array.toList_map, toList_flatMap_arr, List.map_flatMap, List.map_flatMap,
    List.flatMap_def, List.sum_flatten, List.map_map]
  congr 1
  apply List.map_congr_left
  intro x _
  simp only [Function.comp_apply]
  rw [Array.toList_map]

name: mem_classify
statement:
theorem mem_classify {frags : Array Frag} {W : Array PFace} {f : Frag} :
    f ∈ classify frags W
      ↔ f ∈ frags ∧
          keepFragB (faceBVH W) W f = true
proof:
:= by

name: materialize_size
statement: theorem materialize_size (M : Mesh) : (materialize M).size = M.size
proof:
:= by
