name: Negligible_mono_local
statement:
private theorem Negligible_mono_local {N M : Set Point} (h : N ⊆ M)
    (hM : Negligible M) : Negligible N
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨k, H, hH, hMsub⟩ := hM
  exact ⟨k, H, hH, Set.Subset.trans h hMsub⟩

name: degenBarrier_mem_degenPlanes
proof:
:= by
  rw [degenPlanes, ← Array.foldl_toList]
  have key : ∀ (l : List (Int × Triangle)) (acc : Array Half),
      ((⟨degenBarrierNormal e.2, 0⟩ : Half) ∈ acc ∨ (e ∈ l ∧ isDegen e.2 = true)) →
      (⟨degenBarrierNormal e.2, 0⟩ : Half) ∈
        l.foldl (fun acc e' => if isDegen e'.2 then acc.push ⟨degenBarrierNormal e'.2, 0⟩
          else acc) acc := by
    intro l
    induction l with
    | nil =>
      intro acc h
      rcases h with h | ⟨h, _⟩
      · exact h
      · exact absurd h (List.not_mem_nil e)
    | cons hd' tl ih =>
      intro acc h
      simp only [List.foldl_cons]
      apply ih
      rcases h with hacc | ⟨hmem, hdg⟩
      · left
        by_cases hdh : isDegen hd'.2
        · rw [if_pos hdh]; exact Array.mem_push.mpr (Or.inl hacc)
        · rw [if_neg hdh]; exact hacc
      · rw [List.mem_cons] at hmem
        rcases hmem with rfl | htl
        · left; rw [if_pos hdg]; exact Array.mem_push.mpr (Or.inr rfl)
        · right; exact ⟨htl, hdg⟩
  exact key w.toList #[] (Or.inr ⟨he, hd⟩)

name: signWeight_mem
statement:
private theorem signWeight_mem (g : Half) (Q : Point) :
    signWeight g Q = 1 ∨ signWeight g Q = -1
proof:
:= by
  unfold signWeight; split <;> simp

name: signWeight_mul_pos
statement:
private theorem signWeight_mul_pos {g : Half} {Q : Point} (hQ : g.eval Q ≠ 0) :
    0 < signWeight g Q * g.eval Q
proof:
:= by
  unfold signWeight
  rcases lt_or_gt_of_ne hQ with hneg | hpos
  · rw [if_neg (not_lt.mpr (le_of_lt hneg))]; linarith
  · rw [if_pos hpos]; linarith

name: same_sign_of_signWeight
statement:
private theorem same_sign_of_signWeight {t x y : ℚ} (ht : t = 1 ∨ t = -1)
    (hx : 0 < t * x) (hy : 0 < t * y) : (0 < x ↔ 0 < y) ∧ y ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  rcases ht with h | h <;> subst h <;> simp only [one_mul, neg_mul, neg_pos] at hx hy
  · exact ⟨⟨fun _ => hy, fun _ => hx⟩, ne_of_gt hy⟩
  · exact ⟨⟨fun hh => absurd hh (by linarith), fun hh => absurd hh (by linarith)⟩,
      by intro hh; rw [hh] at hy; linarith⟩

name: bad_sample_forces_full_dim_bad_cell
proof:
:= by
  classical
  
  
  
  have hoff : ∀ g ∈ samplePlanes w, g.eval Q ≠ 0 := by
    rw [samples, Array.mem_map] at hQ
    obtain ⟨p, _hp, hQeq⟩ := hQ
    intro g hg
    rw [← hQeq]; exact sample_off_samplePlanes w p g hg
  clear hQ
  
  set G : Array Half := samplePlanes w with hGdef
  
  set s : Fin G.size → ℚ := fun a => signWeight (G[a]) Q with hs
  have hsmem : ∀ a, s a = 1 ∨ s a = -1 := fun a => signWeight_mem _ _
  
  set g : Fin G.size → (Point →ᵃ[ℚ] ℚ) := fun a => gOf (G[a]) with hg
  
  have hQcell : ∀ a, 0 < s a * g a Q := by
    intro a
    rw [hs, hg, gOf_apply]
    exact signWeight_mul_pos (hoff _ (Array.getElem_mem a.isLt))
  
  set C : Set Point := {Q' : Point | ∀ a, 0 < s a * g a Q'} with hC
  
  
  have hsync : ∀ Q' ∈ C, ∀ h ∈ G,
      (0 < h.eval Q ↔ 0 < h.eval Q') ∧ h.eval Q' ≠ 0 := by
    intro Q' hQ'C h hh
    rw [Array.mem_iff_getElem] at hh
    obtain ⟨a, ha, rfl⟩ := hh
    have haQ : 0 < s ⟨a, ha⟩ * G[a].eval Q := by
      have := hQcell ⟨a, ha⟩; rw [hg, gOf_apply] at this; exact this
    have haQ' : 0 < s ⟨a, ha⟩ * G[a].eval Q' := by
      have := hQ'C ⟨a, ha⟩; rw [hg, gOf_apply] at this; exact this
    exact same_sign_of_signWeight (hsmem ⟨a, ha⟩) haQ haQ'
  
  have hpl_sub : ∀ h ∈ planes w, h ∈ G := by
    intro h hh; rw [hGdef, samplePlanes, Array.mem_append]; exact Or.inl hh
  have hbar_in : ∀ e ∈ w.toList, isDegen e.2 = true →
      (⟨degenBarrierNormal e.2, 0⟩ : Half) ∈ G := by
    intro e he hd
    rw [hGdef, samplePlanes, Array.mem_append]; right
    exact degenBarrier_mem_degenPlanes he hd
  
  have hi_of : ∀ Q' ∈ C, ∀ h ∈ planes w, h.eval Q' ≠ 0 :=
    fun Q' hQ'C h hh => (hsync Q' hQ'C h (hpl_sub h hh)).2
  have hbar_of : ∀ Q' ∈ C, ∀ e ∈ w.toList, isDegen e.2 = true →
      dotQ (degenBarrierNormal e.2) Q' ≠ 0 := by
    intro Q' hQ'C e he hd
    have := (hsync Q' hQ'C ⟨degenBarrierNormal e.2, 0⟩ (hbar_in e he hd)).2
    simpa [Half.eval] using this
  have hii_of : ∀ Q' ∈ C, ∀ e ∈ w.toList, isDegen e.2 = true → Q' ∉ simplex e.2 :=
    fun Q' hQ'C => degenerate_off_barrier (hbar_of Q' hQ'C)
  
  have hQC : Q ∈ C := hQcell
  
  have hQwind : winding w Q ≠ 0 ∧ winding w Q ≠ 1 := by
    have hi : ∀ h ∈ planes w, h.eval Q ≠ 0 := fun h hh => hoff h (hpl_sub h hh)
    have heq : windingAt w Q = winding w Q :=
      windingAt_eq_winding_sample hi (hii_of Q hQC)
    rw [← heq]; exact hbad
  
  have hsub : C ⊆ {Q' : Point | winding w Q' ≠ 0 ∧ winding w Q' ≠ 1} := by
    intro Q' hQ'C
    have hiQ : ∀ h ∈ planes w, h.eval Q ≠ 0 := fun h hh => hoff h (hpl_sub h hh)
    have hsign : ∀ h ∈ planes w, (0 < h.eval Q ↔ 0 < h.eval Q') :=
      fun h hh => (hsync Q' hQ'C h (hpl_sub h hh)).1
    have hwQQ' : winding w Q = winding w Q' :=
      winding_const_on_cell hiQ (hii_of Q hQC) (hi_of Q' hQ'C)
        (hii_of Q' hQ'C) hsign
    rw [Set.mem_setOf_eq, ← hwQQ']; exact hQwind
  
  have hC_not_neg : ¬ Negligible C := by
    have := fullDimCell_not_negligible g s hsmem hQcell
    rw [hC]; exact this
  intro hBneg
  exact hC_not_neg (Negligible_mono_local hsub hBneg)

name: foldl_mono
proof:
:= by
  intro l
  induction l with
  | nil => intro a hx; simpa using hx
  | cons hd tl ih => intro a hx; rw [List.foldl_cons]; exact ih _ (extensive a hd x hx)

name: mem_foldl_list
statement:
private theorem mem_foldl_list {α β : Type*} (g : Array β → α → Array β)
    (extensive : ∀ (a : Array β) (i : α) (y : β), y ∈ a → y ∈ g a i) (x : β) :
    ∀ (l : List α) (init : Array β),
      (∃ i ∈ l, ∀ a : Array β, x ∈ g a i) → x ∈ l.foldl g init
proof:
:= by
  intro l
  induction l with
  | nil => intro init ⟨i, hi, _⟩; exact absurd hi (List.not_mem_nil i)
  | cons hd tl ih =>
    intro init ⟨i, hi, hx⟩
    rw [List.foldl_cons]
    rw [List.mem_cons] at hi
    rcases hi with rfl | htl
    · exact foldl_mono g extensive x tl (g init i) (hx init)
    · exact ih (g init hd) ⟨i, htl, hx⟩

name: afoldl_mono
proof:
:= by
  rw [← Array.foldl_toList]; exact foldl_mono g extensive x l.toList a hx

name: mem_afoldl_range
statement:
private theorem mem_afoldl_range {β : Type*} (g : Array β → Nat → Array β)
    (extensive : ∀ (a : Array β) (i : Nat) (y : β), y ∈ a → y ∈ g a i)
    (x : β) (n : Nat) (init : Array β)
    (i₀ : Nat) (hi₀ : i₀ < n) (hhit : ∀ a : Array β, x ∈ g a i₀) :
    x ∈ (Array.range n).foldl g init
proof:
:= by
  rw [← Array.foldl_toList, Array.toList_range]
  exact mem_foldl_list g extensive x (List.range n) init ⟨i₀, List.mem_range.mpr hi₀, hhit⟩

name: mem_s4
proof:
:= by
  set n := vs.size with hn
  set X : Array Point := #[vs[i]!, vs[j]!, vs[k]!, vs[l]!] with hX
  have hi : i < n := lt_trans hij (lt_trans hjk (lt_trans hkl hln))
  have hj : j < n := lt_trans hjk (lt_trans hkl hln)
  have hk : k < n := lt_trans hkl hln
  unfold subsetsUpTo4
  simp only []
  rw [Array.mem_append]; right
  have ext_l : ∀ (i' j' k' : Nat), ∀ (a : Array (Array Point)) (l' : Nat) (y : Array Point),
      y ∈ a → y ∈ (if i' < j' && j' < k' && k' < l' then
        a.push #[vs[i']!, vs[j']!, vs[k']!, vs[l']!] else a) := by
    intro i' j' k' a l' y hy
    split
    · exact Array.mem_push.mpr (Or.inl hy)
    · exact hy
  have ext_k : ∀ (i' j' : Nat), ∀ (a : Array (Array Point)) (k' : Nat) (y : Array Point),
      y ∈ a → y ∈ (Array.range n).foldl (fun a l' =>
        if i' < j' && j' < k' && k' < l' then
          a.push #[vs[i']!, vs[j']!, vs[k']!, vs[l']!] else a) a :=
    fun i' j' a k' y hy => afoldl_mono _ (ext_l i' j' k') y _ a hy
  have ext_j : ∀ (i' : Nat), ∀ (a : Array (Array Point)) (j' : Nat) (y : Array Point),
      y ∈ a → y ∈ (Array.range n).foldl (fun a k' => (Array.range n).foldl (fun a l' =>
        if i' < j' && j' < k' && k' < l' then
          a.push #[vs[i']!, vs[j']!, vs[k']!, vs[l']!] else a) a) a :=
    fun i' a j' y hy => afoldl_mono _ (ext_k i' j') y _ a hy
  have ext_i : ∀ (a : Array (Array Point)) (i' : Nat) (y : Array Point),
      y ∈ a → y ∈ (Array.range n).foldl (fun a j' => (Array.range n).foldl (fun a k' =>
        (Array.range n).foldl (fun a l' =>
          if i' < j' && j' < k' && k' < l' then
            a.push #[vs[i']!, vs[j']!, vs[k']!, vs[l']!] else a) a) a) a :=
    fun a i' y hy => afoldl_mono _ (ext_j i') y _ a hy
  apply mem_afoldl_range _ ext_i X n _ i hi
  intro a
  apply mem_afoldl_range _ (ext_j i) X n _ j hj
  intro a'
  apply mem_afoldl_range _ (ext_k i j) X n _ k hk
  intro a''
  apply mem_afoldl_range _ (ext_l i j k) X n _ l hln
  intro a'''
  rw [if_pos (by simp [hij, hjk, hkl])]
  exact Array.mem_push.mpr (Or.inr rfl)

name: bary_four_eq
statement:
private theorem bary_four_eq (a b c d : Point) :
    bary #[a, b, c, d] = (fun i => (a i + b i + c i + d i) / 4)
proof:
:= by
  funext i; simp [bary, mkPoint]

name: bary_in_open_cell
statement:
private theorem bary_in_open_cell {m : ℕ} (G : Fin m → Half) (s : Fin m → ℚ)
    (hn : ∀ j, (G j).n ≠ 0) (hs : ∀ j, s j = 1 ∨ s j = -1)
    {u : Fin 4 → Point} (hAI : AffineIndependent ℚ u)
    (hP : ∀ k j, 0 ≤ s j * (gOf (G j)) (u k)) :
    ∀ j, 0 < s j * (gOf (G j)) (bary #[u 0, u 1, u 2, u 3])
proof:
:= by
  intro j
  have hsj : s j ≠ 0 := by rcases hs j with h | h <;> rw [h] <;> norm_num
  have hbary : s j * (gOf (G j)) (bary #[u 0, u 1, u 2, u 3])
      = (s j * (gOf (G j)) (u 0) + s j * (gOf (G j)) (u 1)
          + s j * (gOf (G j)) (u 2) + s j * (gOf (G j)) (u 3)) / 4 := by
    rw [gOf_apply, Half_eval_eq, bary_four_eq]
    simp only [gOf_apply, Half_eval_eq]
    have hsum : ∀ x : Point, (∑ i, (G j).n i * x i)
        = (G j).n 0 * x 0 + (G j).n 1 * x 1 + (G j).n 2 * x 2 := by
      intro x; rw [Fin.sum_univ_three]
    rw [hsum]
    simp only [hsum]
    field_simp
    ring
  rw [hbary]
  have h0 := hP 0 j; have h1 := hP 1 j; have h2 := hP 2 j; have h3 := hP 3 j
  refine lt_of_le_of_ne (by positivity) ?_
  intro hcontra
  have e0 : s j * (gOf (G j)) (u 0) = 0 := by linarith
  have e1 : s j * (gOf (G j)) (u 1) = 0 := by linarith
  have e2 : s j * (gOf (G j)) (u 2) = 0 := by linarith
  have e3 : s j * (gOf (G j)) (u 3) = 0 := by linarith
  have hplane : ∀ k : Fin 4, (∑ i, (G j).n i * (u k) i) = (G j).c := by
    intro k
    have hk : s j * (gOf (G j)) (u k) = 0 := by fin_cases k <;> assumption
    have hgz : (gOf (G j)) (u k) = 0 := by
      rcases mul_eq_zero.mp hk with h | h
      · exact absurd h hsj
      · exact h
    rw [gOf_apply, Half_eval_eq] at hgz
    linarith
  exact not_affineIndependent_four_of_mem_plane (hn j) (G j).c ⟨u, hAI, hplane⟩

name: sorted_indices_of_four
statement:
private theorem sorted_indices_of_four (vs : Array Point) (u : Fin 4 → Point)
    (hinj : Function.Injective u) (hmem : ∀ k, u k ∈ vs) :
    ∃ i j k l : Nat, i < j ∧ j < k ∧ k < l ∧ l < vs.size ∧
      bary #[vs[i]!, vs[j]!, vs[k]!, vs[l]!] = bary #[u 0, u 1, u 2, u 3]
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have hidx : ∀ k, ∃ p : Fin vs.size, vs[p] = u k := by
    intro k
    have := hmem k
    rw [Array.mem_iff_getElem] at this
    obtain ⟨p, hp, hpe⟩ := this
    exact ⟨⟨p, hp⟩, hpe⟩
  choose idx hidxe using hidx
  have hidxinj : Function.Injective idx :=
    fun a b hab => hinj (by rw [← hidxe a, ← hidxe b, hab])
  set S : Finset (Fin vs.size) := Finset.image idx Finset.univ with hS
  have hScard : S.card = 4 := by
    rw [hS, Finset.card_image_of_injective _ hidxinj, Finset.card_univ, Fintype.card_fin]
  set e : Fin 4 → (Fin vs.size) := ⇑(S.orderEmbOfFin hScard) with he
  have hmono : StrictMono e := (S.orderEmbOfFin hScard).strictMono
  have heinj : Function.Injective e := hmono.injective
  have hrange : Set.range e = ↑S := by rw [he]; exact Finset.range_orderEmbOfFin S hScard
  have hSimE : Finset.image e Finset.univ = S := by
    apply Finset.coe_injective
    rw [Finset.coe_image, Finset.coe_univ, Set.image_univ, hrange]
  have hget : ∀ m, vs[(e m : Nat)]! = vs[e m] := fun m => by
    rw [getElem!_pos vs (e m : Nat) (e m).isLt]
    rfl
  refine ⟨(e 0 : Nat), (e 1 : Nat), (e 2 : Nat), (e 3 : Nat),
    hmono (by decide), hmono (by decide), hmono (by decide), (e 3).isLt, ?_⟩
  rw [bary_four_eq, bary_four_eq]
  funext i
  rw [hget 0, hget 1, hget 2, hget 3]
  have hsumE : vs[e 0] i + vs[e 1] i + vs[e 2] i + vs[e 3] i = ∑ m : Fin 4, vs[e m] i := by
    rw [Fin.sum_univ_four]
  have hsumU : u 0 i + u 1 i + u 2 i + u 3 i = ∑ m : Fin 4, u m i := by
    rw [Fin.sum_univ_four]
  rw [hsumE, hsumU]
  congr 1
  have hUeq : ∀ m, u m i = vs[idx m] i := fun m => by rw [hidxe m]
  simp_rw [hUeq]
  have h1 : ∑ m : Fin 4, vs[idx m] i = ∑ x ∈ S, vs[x] i := by
    rw [hS, Finset.sum_image (by intro a _ b _ hab; exact hidxinj hab)]
  have h2 : ∑ m : Fin 4, vs[e m] i = ∑ x ∈ S, vs[x] i := by
    rw [← hSimE, Finset.sum_image (by intro a _ b _ hab; exact heinj hab)]
  rw [h1, h2]

name: sign_transport
statement:
private theorem sign_transport {s x y : ℚ} (hs : s = 1 ∨ s = -1)
    (hsx : 0 < s * x) (hiff : 0 < x ↔ 0 < y) (hy : y ≠ 0) : 0 < s * y
proof:
:= by
  rcases hs with h | h <;> subst h
  · simp only [one_mul] at hsx ⊢; exact hiff.mp hsx
  · simp only [neg_mul, one_mul, neg_pos] at hsx ⊢
    rcases lt_or_gt_of_ne hy with hyneg | hypos
    · exact hyneg
    · exact absurd (hiff.mpr hypos) (by linarith)

name: cell_has_sample
statement:
theorem cell_has_sample {w : Chain} {s : Fin (planes w).size → ℚ}
    (hn : ∀ j : Fin (planes w).size, ((planes w)[j]).n ≠ 0)
    (hs : ∀ j, s j = 1 ∨ s j = -1)
    {p₀ : Point} (hp₀ : ∀ j, 0 < s j * gOf ((planes w)[j]) p₀)
    {K : Set Point} {R : ℚ} (hKbound : ∀ x ∈ K, ∀ i, |x i| ≤ R)
    (hCsub : Cset (fun j => (planes w)[j]) s ⊆ K) :
    ∃ Q ∈ samples w,
      (∀ j, 0 < s j * gOf ((planes w)[j]) Q) ∧
      (∀ e ∈ w.toList, isDegen e.2 = true → Q ∉ simplex e.2)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  set G : Fin (planes w).size → Half := fun j => (planes w)[j] with hGdef
  
  obtain ⟨u, hAI, hvert, hPset⟩ :=
    boundedFullDimCell_has_aff_indep_4_arrVerts hn hs hp₀ hKbound hCsub
  
  have hPmem : ∀ k j, 0 ≤ s j * (gOf (G j)) (u k) := fun k j => hPset k j
  have hbaryC : ∀ j, 0 < s j * gOf (G j) (bary #[u 0, u 1, u 2, u 3]) :=
    bary_in_open_cell G s hn hs hAI hPmem
  
  have huinj : Function.Injective u := hAI.injective
  have huvs : ∀ k, u k ∈ arrVerts (planes w) := hvert
  obtain ⟨i, j, k, l, hij, hjk, hkl, hln, hbaryeq⟩ :=
    sorted_indices_of_four (arrVerts (planes w)) u huinj huvs
  set vs := arrVerts (planes w) with hvs
  set p := bary #[u 0, u 1, u 2, u 3] with hp
  have hSmem : #[vs[i]!, vs[j]!, vs[k]!, vs[l]!] ∈ subsetsUpTo4 vs :=
    mem_s4 vs hij hjk hkl hln
  have hanchor : p ∈ anchors vs := by
    rw [anchors, Array.mem_map]
    exact ⟨#[vs[i]!, vs[j]!, vs[k]!, vs[l]!], hSmem, hbaryeq⟩
  
  set q := sampleAt (samplePlanes w) (dir w) p with hq
  have hqmem : q ∈ samples w := by
    rw [samples, Array.mem_map]
    exact ⟨p, hanchor, rfl⟩
  refine ⟨q, hqmem, ?_, ?_⟩
  · 
    intro jj
    
    have hpsign : 0 < s jj * (G jj).eval p := by
      have := hbaryC jj; rwa [gOf_apply] at this
    have hpoff : (G jj).eval p ≠ 0 := by
      intro h0; rw [h0, mul_zero] at hpsign; exact lt_irrefl 0 hpsign
    
    have hGmem : (G jj) ∈ samplePlanes w := by
      rw [samplePlanes, Array.mem_append]; left
      rw [hGdef]; exact Array.getElem_mem jj.isLt
    
    have hpres : (0 < (G jj).eval p ↔ 0 < (G jj).eval q) :=
      sample_sign_preserved w p (G jj) hGmem hpoff
    
    have hqoff : (G jj).eval q ≠ 0 := sample_off_samplePlanes w p (G jj) hGmem
    rw [gOf_apply]
    exact sign_transport (hs jj) hpsign hpres hqoff
  · 
    apply degenerate_off_barrier
    intro e he hd
    
    have hbar_in : (⟨degenBarrierNormal e.2, 0⟩ : Half) ∈ samplePlanes w := by
      rw [samplePlanes, Array.mem_append]; right
      exact degenBarrier_mem_degenPlanes he hd
    have := sample_off_samplePlanes w p ⟨degenBarrierNormal e.2, 0⟩ hbar_in
    simpa [Half.eval] using this

name: mem_planes_n_ne_zero
statement:
private theorem mem_planes_n_ne_zero {w : Chain} {g : Half}
    (hg : g ∈ planes w) : g.n ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [planes, ← Array.foldl_toList] at hg
  have key : ∀ (l : List (Int × Triangle)) (acc : Array Half),
      g ∈ l.foldl (fun acc e => if isDegen e.2 then acc else acc ++ tetraHalves e.2) acc →
      g ∈ acc ∨ ∃ e ∈ l, isDegen e.2 = false ∧ g ∈ tetraHalves e.2 := by
    intro l
    induction l with
    | nil => intro acc h; exact Or.inl (by simpa using h)
    | cons e tl ih =>
      intro acc h
      simp only [List.foldl_cons] at h
      rcases ih _ h with hacc | ⟨e', he'mem, he'd, he'g⟩
      · by_cases hde : isDegen e.2
        · rw [if_pos hde] at hacc; exact Or.inl hacc
        · rw [if_neg hde] at hacc
          rcases Array.mem_append.mp hacc with h1 | h2
          · exact Or.inl h1
          · exact Or.inr ⟨e, List.mem_cons_self _ _, by simp [hde], h2⟩
      · exact Or.inr ⟨e', List.mem_cons_of_mem _ he'mem, he'd, he'g⟩
  rcases key w.toList #[] hg with hempty | ⟨e, _hemem, hed, heg⟩
  · simp at hempty
  · have hdet : det3 e.2.v₀ e.2.v₁ e.2.v₂ ≠ 0 := by
      intro h0; rw [isDegen] at hed; simp [h0] at hed
    exact tetraHalf_n_ne_zero hdet g heg

name: mem_degenPlanes_n_ne_zero
statement:
private theorem mem_degenPlanes_n_ne_zero {w : Chain} {g : Half}
    (hg : g ∈ degenPlanes w) : g.n ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [degenPlanes, ← Array.foldl_toList] at hg
  have key : ∀ (l : List (Int × Triangle)) (acc : Array Half),
      g ∈ l.foldl (fun acc e =>
            if isDegen e.2 then acc.push (⟨degenBarrierNormal e.2, 0⟩ : Half) else acc) acc →
      g ∈ acc ∨ ∃ e ∈ l, isDegen e.2 = true ∧ g = (⟨degenBarrierNormal e.2, 0⟩ : Half) := by
    intro l
    induction l with
    | nil => intro acc h; exact Or.inl (by simpa using h)
    | cons e tl ih =>
      intro acc h
      simp only [List.foldl_cons] at h
      rcases ih _ h with hacc | ⟨e', he'mem, he'd, he'g⟩
      · by_cases hde : isDegen e.2
        · rw [if_pos hde] at hacc
          rcases Array.mem_push.mp hacc with h1 | h2
          · exact Or.inl h1
          · exact Or.inr ⟨e, List.mem_cons_self _ _, hde, h2⟩
        · rw [if_neg hde] at hacc; exact Or.inl hacc
      · exact Or.inr ⟨e', List.mem_cons_of_mem _ he'mem, he'd, he'g⟩
  rcases key w.toList #[] hg with hempty | ⟨e, _hemem, hed, heg⟩
  · simp at hempty
  · have hdet : det3 e.2.v₀ e.2.v₁ e.2.v₂ = 0 := by
      rw [isDegen] at hed; simpa using hed
    rw [heg]; exact (degenBarrierNormal_spec hdet).1

name: mem_samplePlanes_n_ne_zero
statement:
private theorem mem_samplePlanes_n_ne_zero {w : Chain} {g : Half}
    (hg : g ∈ samplePlanes w) : g.n ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [samplePlanes, Array.mem_append] at hg
  rcases hg with h | h
  · exact mem_planes_n_ne_zero h
  · exact mem_degenPlanes_n_ne_zero h

name: isPlane_eval_zero
statement:
private theorem isPlane_eval_zero {g : Half} (hn : g.n ≠ 0) :
    IsPlane {x : Point | g.eval x = 0}
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨g.n, g.c, hn, ?_⟩
  ext x
  rw [Set.mem_setOf_eq, Set.mem_setOf_eq, Half_eval_eq]
  constructor
  · intro h; linarith
  · intro h; linarith

name: negligible_of_isPlane_local
statement:
private theorem negligible_of_isPlane_local {H : Set Point} (h : IsPlane H) :
    Negligible H
proof:
:=
  ⟨1, fun _ => H, fun _ => h, fun _ hx => Set.mem_iUnion.mpr ⟨0, hx⟩⟩

name: cmax_bound
statement: private theorem cmax_bound (v : Point) (i : Fin 3) : |v i| ≤ cmax v
proof:
:= by
  unfold cmax
  fin_cases i
  · exact le_max_left _ _
  · exact le_trans (le_max_left _ _) (le_max_right _ _)
  · exact le_trans (le_max_right _ _) (le_max_right _ _)

name: cmax_nonneg
statement: private theorem cmax_nonneg (v : Point) : 0 ≤ cmax v
proof:
:=
  le_trans (abs_nonneg _) (cmax_bound v 0)

name: simplex_box_bound
statement:
private theorem simplex_box_bound (t : Triangle) :
    ∃ R : ℚ, ∀ x ∈ simplex t, ∀ i, |x i| ≤ R
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨max (cmax t.v₀) (max (cmax t.v₁) (cmax t.v₂)), ?_⟩
  set R := max (cmax t.v₀) (max (cmax t.v₁) (cmax t.v₂)) with hRdef
  have hR0 : 0 ≤ R := le_trans (cmax_nonneg _) (le_max_left _ _)
  have hbox_conv : Convex ℚ {x : Point | ∀ i, |x i| ≤ R} := by
    intro x hx y hy a b ha hb hab i
    simp only [Set.mem_setOf_eq] at hx hy
    have hco : (a • x + b • y) i = a * x i + b * y i := by
      simp [Pi.add_apply, Pi.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul]
    rw [hco]
    calc |a * x i + b * y i| ≤ |a * x i| + |b * y i| := abs_add _ _
      _ = a * |x i| + b * |y i| := by rw [abs_mul, abs_mul, abs_of_nonneg ha, abs_of_nonneg hb]
      _ ≤ a * R + b * R := add_le_add (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (hx i) ha)
          (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (hy i) hb)
      _ = R := by rw [← add_mul, hab, one_mul]
  have hgen : {(0 : Point), t.v₀, t.v₁, t.v₂} ⊆ {x : Point | ∀ i, |x i| ≤ R} := by
    intro z hz i
    simp only [Set.mem_insert_iff, Set.mem_singleton_iff] at hz
    rcases hz with rfl | rfl | rfl | rfl
    · simpa using hR0
    · exact le_trans (cmax_bound t.v₀ i) (le_max_left _ _)
    · exact le_trans (cmax_bound t.v₁ i) (le_trans (le_max_left _ _) (le_max_right _ _))
    · exact le_trans (cmax_bound t.v₂ i) (le_trans (le_max_right _ _) (le_max_right _ _))
  intro x hx
  exact convexHull_min hgen hbox_conv (by rw [simplex] at hx; exact hx)

name: Nw_negligible
statement: private theorem Nw_negligible (w : Chain) : Negligible (Nw w)
proof:
:= by
  apply Proof.Negligible.negligible_iUnion_fintype
  intro i
  exact negligible_of_isPlane_local
    (isPlane_eval_zero (mem_samplePlanes_n_ne_zero (Array.getElem_mem i.isLt)))

name: off_Nw_samplePlanes
statement:
private theorem off_Nw_samplePlanes {w : Chain} {Q : Point} (hQNw : Q ∉ Nw w) :
    ∀ g ∈ samplePlanes w, g.eval Q ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  intro g hg hge
  apply hQNw
  rw [Nw, Set.mem_iUnion]
  rw [Array.mem_iff_getElem] at hg
  obtain ⟨i, hi, rfl⟩ := hg
  exact ⟨⟨i, hi⟩, hge⟩

name: forward_pointwise
proof:
:= by
  classical
  
  have hoffS : ∀ g ∈ samplePlanes w, g.eval Q ≠ 0 := off_Nw_samplePlanes hQNw
  
  have hi : ∀ g ∈ planes w, g.eval Q ≠ 0 := by
    intro g hg
    exact hoffS g (by rw [samplePlanes, Array.mem_append]; exact Or.inl hg)
  
  have hbarQ : ∀ e ∈ w.toList, isDegen e.2 = true →
      dotQ (degenBarrierNormal e.2) Q ≠ 0 := by
    intro e he hd
    have hbin : (⟨degenBarrierNormal e.2, 0⟩ : Half) ∈ samplePlanes w := by
      rw [samplePlanes, Array.mem_append]; right
      exact degenBarrier_mem_degenPlanes he hd
    have := hoffS _ hbin
    simpa [Half.eval] using this
  have hii : ∀ e ∈ w.toList, isDegen e.2 = true → Q ∉ simplex e.2 :=
    degenerate_off_barrier hbarQ
  
  by_cases hw0 : winding w Q = 0
  · exact Or.inl hw0
  · 
    obtain ⟨e0, _he0, _hnd0, _hQe0, hcell⟩ :=
      cell_subset_nondegenerate_simplex hi hii hw0
    
    set s : Fin (planes w).size → ℚ := fun j => signWeight ((planes w)[j]) Q with hsdef
    have hs : ∀ j, s j = 1 ∨ s j = -1 := fun j => signWeight_mem _ _
    have hn : ∀ j : Fin (planes w).size, ((planes w)[j]).n ≠ 0 :=
      fun j => mem_planes_n_ne_zero (Array.getElem_mem j.isLt)
    
    have hp₀ : ∀ j, 0 < s j * gOf ((planes w)[j]) Q := by
      intro j
      rw [hsdef, gOf_apply]
      exact signWeight_mul_pos (hi _ (Array.getElem_mem j.isLt))
    
    obtain ⟨R, hR⟩ := simplex_box_bound e0.2
    
    have hCsub : Cset (fun j => (planes w)[j]) s ⊆ simplex e0.2 := by
      intro x hx
      apply hcell x
      intro g hg
      
      rw [Array.mem_iff_getElem] at hg
      obtain ⟨j, hj, rfl⟩ := hg
      have hxj : 0 < s ⟨j, hj⟩ * gOf ((planes w)[j]) x := hx ⟨j, hj⟩
      have hQj : 0 < s ⟨j, hj⟩ * gOf ((planes w)[j]) Q := hp₀ ⟨j, hj⟩
      rw [gOf_apply] at hxj hQj
      obtain ⟨hiff, _⟩ := same_sign_of_signWeight (hs ⟨j, hj⟩) hQj hxj
      refine ⟨hiff, ?_⟩
      
      have hQne : ((planes w)[j]).eval Q ≠ 0 := hi _ (Array.getElem_mem hj)
      have hxne : ((planes w)[j]).eval x ≠ 0 := by
        intro h0; rw [h0, mul_zero] at hxj; exact lt_irrefl 0 hxj
      constructor
      · intro hQlt
        rcases lt_trichotomy (((planes w)[j]).eval x) 0 with hxlt | hxe | hxgt
        · exact hxlt
        · exact absurd hxe hxne
        · exact absurd (hiff.mpr hxgt) (by linarith)
      · intro hxlt
        rcases lt_trichotomy (((planes w)[j]).eval Q) 0 with hQlt | hQe | hQgt
        · exact hQlt
        · exact absurd hQe hQne
        · exact absurd (hiff.mp hQgt) (by linarith)
    
    obtain ⟨Qs, hQsmem, hQscell, hQsdeg⟩ :=
      cell_has_sample hn hs hp₀ hR hCsub
    
    have hiQs : ∀ g ∈ planes w, g.eval Qs ≠ 0 := by
      intro g hg
      rw [Array.mem_iff_getElem] at hg
      obtain ⟨j, hj, hgeq⟩ := hg
      have hc := hQscell ⟨j, hj⟩
      rw [gOf_apply] at hc
      simp only [Fin.getElem_fin] at hc
      rw [← hgeq]
      intro h0; rw [h0, mul_zero] at hc; exact lt_irrefl 0 hc
    
    have hwQs : windingAt w Qs = winding w Qs :=
      windingAt_eq_winding_sample hiQs hQsdeg
    have hQsval : winding w Qs = 0 ∨ winding w Qs = 1 := by
      rw [← hwQs]; exact hF Qs hQsmem
    
    have hsign : ∀ g ∈ planes w, (0 < g.eval Q ↔ 0 < g.eval Qs) := by
      intro g hg
      rw [Array.mem_iff_getElem] at hg
      obtain ⟨j, hj, hgeq⟩ := hg
      have hQj : 0 < s ⟨j, hj⟩ * gOf ((planes w)[j]) Q := hp₀ ⟨j, hj⟩
      have hQsj : 0 < s ⟨j, hj⟩ * gOf ((planes w)[j]) Qs := hQscell ⟨j, hj⟩
      rw [gOf_apply] at hQj hQsj
      rw [← hgeq]
      exact (same_sign_of_signWeight (hs ⟨j, hj⟩) hQj hQsj).1
    have hwQQs : winding w Q = winding w Qs :=
      winding_const_on_cell hi hii hiQs hQsdeg hsign
    rw [hwQQs]; exact hQsval

name: isNormal_true_imp_normal
statement:
theorem isNormal_true_imp_normal {w : Chain}
    (hN : Impl.Legacy.NormalCheck.isNormal w = true) : Legacy.Normal w
proof:
:= by
  classical
  
  have hF : ∀ Q ∈ samples w, windingAt w Q = 0 ∨ windingAt w Q = 1 := by
    rw [isNormal, Array.all_eq_true_iff_forall_mem] at hN
    intro Q hQ
    have := hN Q hQ
    simp only [Bool.or_eq_true, beq_iff_eq] at this
    exact this
  exact ⟨Nw w, Nw_negligible w, fun Q hQNw => forward_pointwise hF hQNw⟩

name: not_normal_of_isNormal_false
statement:
theorem not_normal_of_isNormal_false {w : Chain}
    (hN : Impl.Legacy.NormalCheck.isNormal w = false) : ¬ Legacy.Normal w
proof:
:= by
  classical
  
  have hbadex : ∃ Q ∈ samples w, windingAt w Q ≠ 0 ∧ windingAt w Q ≠ 1 := by
    by_contra hc
    push_neg at hc
    have hall : Impl.Legacy.NormalCheck.isNormal w = true := by
      rw [isNormal, Array.all_eq_true_iff_forall_mem]
      intro Q hQ
      simp only [Bool.or_eq_true, beq_iff_eq]
      by_cases h0 : windingAt w Q = 0
      · exact Or.inl h0
      · exact Or.inr (hc Q hQ h0)
    rw [hall] at hN; exact absurd hN (by simp)
  obtain ⟨Q, hQmem, hbad⟩ := hbadex
  
  have hBnotneg : ¬ Negligible {Q' : Point | winding w Q' ≠ 0 ∧ winding w Q' ≠ 1} :=
    bad_sample_forces_full_dim_bad_cell hQmem hbad
  
  rintro ⟨N, hNneg, hN'⟩
  apply hBnotneg
  apply Negligible_mono_local _ hNneg
  intro Q' hQ'
  rw [Set.mem_setOf_eq] at hQ'
  by_contra hQ'N
  rcases hN' Q' hQ'N with h0 | h1
  · exact hQ'.1 h0
  · exact hQ'.2 h1

name: univAll_tr
statement:
theorem univAll_tr (o : P3) (K : Array Frag) :
    (K.map (trFrag o)).flatMap (fun f => f.poly)
    = (K.flatMap (fun f => f.poly)).map (trVtx o)
proof:

name: foldl_map_fusion
statement:
theorem foldl_map_fusion {α α' β : Type*} (g : α → α') (mapf : β → β)
    (F : β → α → β) (F' : β → α' → β)
    (h : ∀ acc a, F' (mapf acc) (g a) = mapf (F acc a)) :
    ∀ (l : List α) (init : β), (l.map g).foldl F' (mapf init) = mapf (l.foldl F init)
  | [], init => rfl
  | a :: l, init => by
      simp only [List.map_cons, List.foldl_cons]
      rw [h init a]
      exact foldl_map_fusion g mapf F F' h l (F init a)

/-! ## 3. `vertexUniverse` commutes with `trFrag` -/

/
def dedupStep (acc : Array Vtx) (v : Vtx) : Array Vtx
proof:
:=
  match acc.back? with
  | some u => if beqS u.p v.p then acc else acc.push v
  | none => acc.push v

name: vertexUniverse_dedupStep
statement:
theorem vertexUniverse_dedupStep (K : Array Frag) :
    vertexUniverse K
    = ((K.flatMap (fun f => f.poly)).toList.mergeSort (fun a b => p3Le a.p b.p)).toArray.foldl
        dedupStep #[]
proof: := rfl

name: back
statement:
theorem back?_map {α β} (g : α → β) (arr : Array α) :
    (arr.map g).back? = arr.back?.map g
proof:
:= by
  simp only [Array.back?, Array.size_map, Array.getElem?_map]

name: dedupStep_map
statement:
theorem dedupStep_map (o : P3) (acc : Array Vtx) (v : Vtx) :
    dedupStep (acc.map (trVtx o)) (trVtx o v) = (dedupStep acc v).map (trVtx o)
proof:
:= by
  have hbeq : ∀ u : Vtx, beqS (trVtx o u).p (trVtx o v).p = beqS u.p v.p := by
    intro u; rw [trVtx_p, trVtx_p]; exact beqS_psubS u.p v.p o
  simp only [dedupStep, back?_map]
  cases hb : acc.back? with
  | none => simp [Array.map_push]
  | some u =>
      cases h : beqS u.p v.p <;> simp [Option.map_some, hbeq, h, Array.map_push]

name: vertexUniverse_tr
statement:
theorem vertexUniverse_tr (o : P3) (K : Array Frag) :
    vertexUniverse (K.map (trFrag o)) = (vertexUniverse K).map (trVtx o)
proof:
:= by
  rw [vertexUniverse_dedupStep, vertexUniverse_dedupStep, univAll_tr]
  set all := K.flatMap (fun f => f.poly) with hall
  
  have hsort : ((all.map (trVtx o)).toList.mergeSort (fun a b => p3Le a.p b.p)).toArray
      = (((all.toList.mergeSort (fun a b => p3Le a.p b.p))).toArray).map (trVtx o) := by
    rw [Array.toList_map, List.map_toArray,
        List.map_mergeSort (r := fun a b => p3Le a.p b.p) (s := fun a b => p3Le a.p b.p)
          (f := trVtx o) (l := all.toList) (fun a _ b _ => (p3Le_psubS a.p b.p o).symm)]
  rw [hsort, ← Array.foldl_toList, ← Array.foldl_toList, Array.toList_map]
  have key := foldl_map_fusion (trVtx o) (Array.map (trVtx o)) dedupStep dedupStep
    (dedupStep_map o) ((all.toList.mergeSort (fun a b => p3Le a.p b.p)).toArray).toList #[]
  rw [Array.map_empty] at key
  exact key

name: linePoint_eq
statement:
private theorem linePoint_eq (p v : Point) (r : ℚ) :

name: affine_line_eval
statement:
private theorem affine_line_eval (g : Point →ᵃ[ℚ] ℚ) (p v : Point) (r : ℚ) :
    g (fun i => p i + r * v i) = g p + r * (g.linear v)
proof:
:= by
  rw [linePoint_eq, AffineMap.map_vadd]; simp [map_smul, add_comm]

name: genericDir_exists
statement:
private theorem genericDir_exists {k : ℕ} (n : Fin k → Point) (hn : ∀ i, n i ≠ 0) :
    ∃ r₀ : ℕ, ∀ i, dotQ (n i) (momentDir r₀) ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  set N := 2 * k + 1 with hN
  set bad := (Finset.Icc 1 N).filter
    (fun r => ∃ i, dotQ (n i) (momentDir r) = 0) with hbad
  have hsub : bad ⊆ (Finset.univ : Finset (Fin k)).biUnion
      (fun i => (Finset.Icc 1 N).filter (fun r => dotQ (n i) (momentDir r) = 0)) := by
    intro r hr
    rw [hbad, Finset.mem_filter] at hr
    obtain ⟨i, hi⟩ := hr.2
    rw [Finset.mem_biUnion]
    exact ⟨i, Finset.mem_univ i, Finset.mem_filter.mpr ⟨hr.1, hi⟩⟩
  have hcardbad : bad.card ≤ 2 * k := by
    refine le_trans (Finset.card_le_card hsub) ?_
    refine le_trans (Finset.card_biUnion_le) ?_
    calc ∑ i : Fin k,
            ((Finset.Icc 1 N).filter (fun r => dotQ (n i) (momentDir r) = 0)).card
          ≤ ∑ _i : Fin k, 2 :=
            Finset.sum_le_sum (fun i _ => momentDir_roots_le_two (hn i) N)
      _ = 2 * k := by rw [Finset.sum_const, Finset.card_univ, Fintype.card_fin]; ring
  have hIcc : (Finset.Icc 1 N).card = N := by rw [Nat.card_Icc]; omega
  have hgood : ∃ r ∈ Finset.Icc 1 N, ¬ ∃ i, dotQ (n i) (momentDir r) = 0 := by
    by_contra hc; push_neg at hc
    have hbadeq : bad = Finset.Icc 1 N := by
      rw [hbad]; apply Finset.filter_true_of_mem; intro r hr; exact hc r hr
    rw [hbadeq, hIcc, hN] at hcardbad; omega
  obtain ⟨r, _, hrgood⟩ := hgood
  push_neg at hrgood
  exact ⟨r, hrgood⟩

name: segment_in_cell_core
statement:
private theorem segment_in_cell_core {a b r δ₀ : ℚ}
    (_ha : 0 < a) (hr0 : 0 ≤ r) (hrδ : r ≤ δ₀)
    (hδpos : 0 < δ₀) (hδle : δ₀ ≤ a / (1 + |b|)) :
    0 < a + r * b
proof:
:= by
  have hden : 0 < 1 + |b| := by positivity
  have hδmul : δ₀ * (1 + |b|) ≤ a := by
    rw [div_eq_mul_inv] at hδle
    have := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hδle (le_of_lt hden)
    rwa [mul_assoc, inv_mul_cancel₀ (ne_of_gt hden), mul_one] at this
  have hrb_lt : r * |b| < a := by
    have h1 : r * |b| ≤ δ₀ * |b| := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hrδ (abs_nonneg b)
    have h2 : δ₀ * |b| < δ₀ * (1 + |b|) := by
      apply mul_lt_mul_of_pos_left _ hδpos; linarith [abs_nonneg b]
    linarith
  have habs : |r * b| < a := by rw [abs_mul, abs_of_nonneg hr0]; exact hrb_lt
  exact lt_of_lt_of_le (by linarith [(abs_lt.mp habs).1]) (le_refl _)

name: fullDimCell_not_negligible
proof:
:= by
  rintro ⟨k, H, hH, hCsub⟩
  
  choose n c hn hHeq using hH
  
  obtain ⟨r₀, hr₀⟩ := genericDir_exists n hn
  set v : Point := momentDir r₀ with hv
  have hv0 : v 0 = 1 := by rw [hv]; simp [momentDir, mkPoint]
  have hnv : ∀ i, dotQ (n i) v ≠ 0 := hr₀
  
  set a : Fin m → ℚ := fun j => s j * g j p₀ with ha
  set b : Fin m → ℚ := fun j => s j * (g j).linear v with hb
  have hapos : ∀ j, 0 < a j := hp₀
  
  obtain ⟨δ₀, hδpos, hδle⟩ :
      ∃ δ₀ : ℚ, 0 < δ₀ ∧ ∀ j, δ₀ ≤ a j / (1 + |b j|) := by
    rcases Nat.eq_zero_or_pos m with hm0 | hmpos
    · 
      subst hm0
      exact ⟨1, one_pos, fun j => j.elim0⟩
    · haveI : Nonempty (Fin m) := ⟨⟨0, hmpos⟩⟩
      refine ⟨Finset.univ.inf' Finset.univ_nonempty (fun j => a j / (1 + |b j|)), ?_, ?_⟩
      · 
        rw [Finset.lt_inf'_iff]
        intro j _
        have hden : 0 < 1 + |b j| := by positivity
        exact div_pos (hapos j) hden
      · intro j; exact Finset.inf'_le _ (Finset.mem_univ j)
  
  have hseg : ∀ r : ℚ, 0 ≤ r → r ≤ δ₀ →
      (fun i => p₀ i + r * v i) ∈ {Q : Point | ∀ j, 0 < s j * g j Q} := by
    intro r hr0 hrδ
    simp only [Set.mem_setOf_eq]
    intro j
    
    have hval : s j * g j (fun i => p₀ i + r * v i) = a j + r * b j := by
      rw [affine_line_eval]; rw [ha, hb]; ring
    rw [hval]
    exact segment_in_cell_core (hapos j) hr0 hrδ hδpos (hδle j)
  
  set rr : Fin (k + 1) → ℚ := fun t => δ₀ / ((t : ℚ) + 2) with hrr
  set P : Fin (k + 1) → Point := fun t => (fun i => p₀ i + rr t * v i) with hP
  
  have hrr_pos : ∀ t, 0 < rr t := by
    intro t
    rw [hrr]
    have hpos : (0:ℚ) < (t : ℚ) + 2 := by positivity
    positivity
  have hrr_le : ∀ t, rr t ≤ δ₀ := by
    intro t; rw [hrr]
    have hpos : (0:ℚ) < (t : ℚ) + 2 := by positivity
    rw [div_le_iff₀ hpos]; nlinarith
  
  have hP_mem : ∀ t, P t ∈ {Q : Point | ∀ j, 0 < s j * g j Q} := by
    intro t; exact hseg (rr t) (le_of_lt (hrr_pos t)) (hrr_le t)
  
  have hP_distinct : ∀ t t' : Fin (k + 1), t ≠ t' → P t ≠ P t' := by
    intro t t' htt' hPeq
    
    have h0 := congrFun hPeq 0
    rw [hP] at h0
    simp only [hv0, mul_one] at h0
    have hrreq : rr t = rr t' := by linarith
    
    rw [hrr] at hrreq
    have hpos : (0:ℚ) < (t : ℚ) + 2 := by positivity
    have hpos' : (0:ℚ) < (t' : ℚ) + 2 := by positivity
    rw [div_eq_div_iff (ne_of_gt hpos) (ne_of_gt hpos')] at hrreq
    have heq : (t' : ℚ) + 2 = (t : ℚ) + 2 := mul_left_cancel₀ (ne_of_gt hδpos) hrreq
    have : (t : ℚ) = (t' : ℚ) := by linarith
    have : (t : ℕ) = (t' : ℕ) := by exact_mod_cast this
    exact htt' (Fin.ext this)
  
  have hP_cover : ∀ t, P t ∈ ⋃ i, H i := fun t => hCsub (hP_mem t)
  
  rcases Nat.eq_zero_or_pos k with hk0 | hkpos
  · subst hk0
    have := hP_cover 0
    rw [Set.mem_iUnion] at this
    obtain ⟨i, _⟩ := this
    exact i.elim0
  
  have hP_idx : ∀ t, ∃ i, P t ∈ H i := fun t => Set.mem_iUnion.mp (hP_cover t)
  choose f hf using hP_idx
  
  have hcard : Fintype.card (Fin k) < Fintype.card (Fin (k + 1)) := by simp
  obtain ⟨t, t', htt', hftt'⟩ := Fintype.exists_ne_map_eq_of_card_lt f hcard
  
  have hmemt : P t ∈ H (f t) := hf t
  have hmemt' : P t' ∈ H (f t) := by rw [hftt']; exact hf t'
  
  set i := f t with hi
  
  have hPt : ∀ t : Fin (k + 1), P t = (fun j => p₀ j + rr t * v j) := fun t => rfl
  have htoeq : ∀ r : ℚ,
      (fun j => p₀ j + r * v j) ∈ H i → dotQ (n i) (fun j => p₀ j + r * v j) = c i := by
    intro r hr
    rw [hHeq i] at hr
    simp only [Set.mem_setOf_eq] at hr
    rw [dotQ_eq_sum]; exact hr
  have heqt : dotQ (n i) (fun j => p₀ j + rr t * v j) = c i :=
    htoeq (rr t) (by rw [← hPt t]; exact hmemt)
  have heqt' : dotQ (n i) (fun j => p₀ j + rr t' * v j) = c i :=
    htoeq (rr t') (by rw [← hPt t']; exact hmemt')
  
  obtain ⟨r_uniq, _, huniq⟩ := plane_meets_line_le_one (n := n i) (p₀ := p₀) (v := v)
    (c := c i) (hnv i)
  have hrt : rr t = r_uniq := huniq (rr t) heqt
  have hrt' : rr t' = r_uniq := huniq (rr t') heqt'
  
  have hrreq : rr t = rr t' := by rw [hrt, hrt']
  have hPeq : P t = P t' := by rw [hPt t, hPt t', hrreq]
  exact hP_distinct t t' htt' hPeq

name: dot_comm'
statement: theorem dot_comm' (a b : Point) : dot a b = dot b a
proof:
:= by
  simp only [dot, Fin.sum_univ_three]; ring

name: dot_crossQ_left
statement: theorem dot_crossQ_left (n v : Point) : dot (crossQ n v) n = 0
proof:
:= by
  simp only [dot, crossQ, Fin.sum_univ_three, mkPoint_zero,
    mkPoint_one, mkPoint_two]; ring

name: dot_crossQ_right
statement: theorem dot_crossQ_right (n v : Point) : dot (crossQ n v) v = 0
proof:
:= by
  simp only [dot, crossQ, Fin.sum_univ_three, mkPoint_zero,
    mkPoint_one, mkPoint_two]; ring

name: exists_perp_ne_zero
statement:
theorem exists_perp_ne_zero {d : Point} (hd : d ≠ 0) :
    ∃ n : Point, n ≠ 0 ∧ dot n d = 0
proof:
:= by
  
  by_cases h01 : crossQ d e0 ≠ 0
  · exact ⟨crossQ d e0, h01, dot_crossQ_left d e0⟩
  · by_cases h02 : crossQ d e1 ≠ 0
    · exact ⟨crossQ d e1, h02, dot_crossQ_left d e1⟩
    · refine ⟨crossQ d e2, ?_, dot_crossQ_left d e2⟩
      push_neg at h01 h02
      intro h2
      apply hd
      
      have hd2 : d 2 = 0 := by
        have := congrFun h01 1
        simpa [crossQ, e0, mkPoint_one, Matrix.cons_val_zero, Matrix.cons_val_one,
          Matrix.head_cons, Matrix.cons_val_two, Matrix.tail_cons] using this
      have hd1 : d 1 = 0 := by
        have := congrFun h01 2
        simp only [crossQ, e0, mkPoint_two, Matrix.cons_val_zero, Matrix.cons_val_one,
          Matrix.head_cons, Matrix.cons_val_two, Matrix.tail_cons, Pi.zero_apply] at this
        linarith
      have hd0 : d 0 = 0 := by
        have := congrFun h02 2
        simpa [crossQ, e1, mkPoint_two, Matrix.cons_val_zero, Matrix.cons_val_one,
          Matrix.head_cons, Matrix.cons_val_two, Matrix.tail_cons] using this
      funext i; fin_cases i <;> simp only [Pi.zero_apply] <;> assumption

name: shadow_subset_plane
statement:
theorem shadow_subset_plane {a b d : Point} (hd : d ≠ 0) :
    ∃ H : Set Point, IsPlane H ∧ shadow a b d ⊆ H
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hpar : crossQ d (b - a) = 0
  · 
    obtain ⟨n, hn, hnd⟩ := exists_perp_ne_zero hd
    
    obtain ⟨r, hr⟩ := CSG.Proof.MeshIntersectClip.exists_smul_of_crossQ_eq_zero hd
      (by rw [CSG.Proof.MeshIntersectClip.crossQ_anticomm, hpar, neg_zero])
    refine ⟨{x | (∑ i, n i * x i) = dot n a}, ⟨n, dot n a, hn, rfl⟩, ?_⟩
    rintro P ⟨s, hs, hmem⟩
    obtain ⟨p, q, hp, hq, hpq, heq⟩ := hmem
    
    have hPeq : P = a + (q * r - s) • d := by
      funext i
      have hbi : (b - a) i = r * d i := by
        have := congrFun hr i; simpa [Pi.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul, Pi.sub_apply] using this
      have hbi' : b i = a i + r * d i := by
        have := hbi; simp only [Pi.sub_apply] at this; linarith
      have hki := congrFun heq i
      simp only [Pi.add_apply, Pi.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul] at hki ⊢
      have hpi : p = 1 - q := by linarith
      rw [hpi, hbi'] at hki
      linarith
    show (∑ i, n i * P i) = dot n a
    rw [show (∑ i, n i * P i) = dot n P from rfl, hPeq, dot_add_right, dot_smul_right, hnd,
      mul_zero, add_zero]
  · 
    refine ⟨{x | (∑ i, (crossQ d (b - a)) i * x i) = dot (crossQ d (b - a)) a},
      ⟨crossQ d (b - a), dot (crossQ d (b - a)) a, hpar, rfl⟩, ?_⟩
    rintro P ⟨s, hs, hmem⟩
    obtain ⟨p, q, hp, hq, hpq, heq⟩ := hmem
    set n := crossQ d (b - a) with hndef
    have hnd : dot n d = 0 := by rw [hndef]; exact dot_crossQ_left d (b - a)
    have hnba : dot n (b - a) = 0 := by rw [hndef]; exact dot_crossQ_right d (b - a)
    
    have hPeq : P = p • a + q • b - s • d := by
      funext i
      have hki := congrFun heq i
      simp only [Pi.add_apply, Pi.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul] at hki ⊢
      simp only [Pi.sub_apply, Pi.add_apply, Pi.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul]
      linarith
    show (∑ i, n i * P i) = dot n a
    rw [show (∑ i, n i * P i) = dot n P from rfl, hPeq]
    rw [dot_sub_right, dot_add_right, dot_smul_right, dot_smul_right, dot_smul_right, hnd, mul_zero,
      sub_zero]
    
    have hnb : dot n b = dot n a := by
      have : dot n (b - a) = dot n b - dot n a := dot_sub_right n b a
      linarith [hnba, this]
    rw [hnb, ← add_mul, hpq, one_mul]

name: mem_edgeSet_iff
statement:
theorem mem_edgeSet_iff {t : Triangle} {x : Point} :
    x ∈ edgeSet t ↔ ∃ k : Fin 3, x ∈ segment ℚ (edgeSeg t k).1 (edgeSeg t k).2
proof:
:= by
  simp only [edgeSet, Set.mem_union, edgeSeg]
  constructor
  · rintro ((h | h) | h)
    · exact ⟨0, by simpa using h⟩
    · exact ⟨1, by simpa using h⟩
    · exact ⟨2, by simpa using h⟩
  · rintro ⟨k, hk⟩
    fin_cases k
    · exact Or.inl (Or.inl (by simpa using hk))
    · exact Or.inl (Or.inr (by simpa using hk))
    · exact Or.inr (by simpa using hk)

name: negligible_shadow
statement:
theorem negligible_shadow {a b d : Point} (hd : d ≠ 0) :
    Negligible (shadow a b d)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨H, hplane, hsub⟩ := shadow_subset_plane (a := a) (b := b) hd
  refine ⟨1, fun _ => H, fun _ => hplane, ?_⟩
  intro x hx
  exact Set.mem_iUnion.mpr ⟨0, hsub hx⟩

name: negligible_not_admissible
statement:
theorem negligible_not_admissible {M : Mesh} {d : Point} (hd : d ≠ 0) :
    Negligible {P | ¬ AdmissibleRay M P d}
proof:
:= by
  
  refine Proof.Negligible.negligible_mono
    (M := ⋃ uk : Fin M.size × Fin 3,
      shadow (edgeSeg M[uk.1] uk.2).1 (edgeSeg M[uk.1] uk.2).2 d) ?_ ?_
  · intro P hP
    simp only [Set.mem_setOf_eq, AdmissibleRay, not_and] at hP
    have hP' := hP hd
    push_neg at hP'
    obtain ⟨u, s, hs, hmem⟩ := hP'
    rw [mem_edgeSet_iff] at hmem
    obtain ⟨k, hk⟩ := hmem
    exact Set.mem_iUnion.mpr ⟨(u, k), s, hs, hk⟩
  · exact Proof.Negligible.negligible_iUnion_fintype
      (fun uk => negligible_shadow hd)

name: hitMin_pos
statement:
theorem hitMin_pos {M : Mesh} {Q d : Point} (hne : (hitFinset M Q d).Nonempty) :
    0 < ((hitFinset M Q d).image (fun u => sStar M[u] d Q)).min'
      (Finset.image_nonempty.mpr hne)
proof:
:= by
  set I := (hitFinset M Q d).image (fun u => sStar M[u] d Q) with hI
  obtain ⟨v, hv, hval⟩ := Finset.mem_image.mp (Finset.min'_mem I (Finset.image_nonempty.mpr hne))
  rw [← hval]
  obtain ⟨_, hnd', hhit'⟩ := Finset.mem_filter.mp hv
  exact ((rayHits_iff hnd' Q).mp hhit').1

name: eps0_pos
statement: theorem eps0_pos (M : Mesh) (Q d : Point) : 0 < eps0 M Q d
proof:
:= by
  unfold eps0
  split_ifs with h
  · have := hitMin_pos h; positivity
  · norm_num

name: eps0_lt_sStar
proof:
:= by
  have hmem : u ∈ hitFinset M Q d :=
    Finset.mem_filter.mpr ⟨Finset.mem_univ u, hnd, hhit⟩
  have hne : (hitFinset M Q d).Nonempty := ⟨u, hmem⟩
  unfold eps0
  rw [dif_pos hne]
  have hmin_le : ((hitFinset M Q d).image (fun u => sStar M[u] d Q)).min'
      (Finset.image_nonempty.mpr hne) ≤ sStar M[u] d Q :=
    Finset.min'_le _ _ (Finset.mem_image.mpr ⟨u, hmem, rfl⟩)
  have hmin_pos := hitMin_pos hne
  linarith

name: sStar_slide
statement:
theorem sStar_slide {t : Triangle} {d : Point} (hnd : dot (faceNormal t) d ≠ 0)
    (Q : Point) (ε : ℚ) : sStar t d (Q + ε • d) = sStar t d Q - ε
proof:
:= by
  rw [sStar, sStar, dot_line]
  field_simp
  ring

name: hitPt_slide
statement:
theorem hitPt_slide {t : Triangle} {d : Point} (hnd : dot (faceNormal t) d ≠ 0)
    (Q : Point) (ε : ℚ) : hitPt t d (Q + ε • d) = hitPt t d Q
proof:
:= by
  rw [hitPt, hitPt, sStar_slide hnd]
  funext i
  simp only [Pi.add_apply, Pi.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul, sub_mul]
  ring

name: rayHits_slide
proof:
:= by
  rw [rayHits_iff hnd, rayHits_iff hnd, sStar_slide hnd, hitPt_slide hnd]
  by_cases hhit : RayHits Q d M[u]
  · obtain ⟨hpos, hmem⟩ := (rayHits_iff hnd Q).mp hhit
    have hlt : ε < sStar M[u] d Q := lt_of_le_of_lt hε0 (eps0_lt_sStar hnd hhit)
    simp only [hmem, and_true]
    constructor <;> intro _ <;> [linarith; linarith]
  · rw [rayHits_iff hnd] at hhit
    push_neg at hhit
    constructor
    · rintro ⟨hpos, hmem⟩
      exact absurd hmem (hhit (by linarith))
    · rintro ⟨hpos, hmem⟩
      exact absurd hmem (hhit hpos)

name: crossingCount_slide
proof:
:= by
  rw [crossingCount_eq_sum, crossingCount_eq_sum]
  refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun u _ => ?_)
  unfold crossSummand
  by_cases hnd : dot (faceNormal M[u]) d = 0
  · rw [hnd]; simp
  · rw [rayHits_slide hnd hε hε0]

name: admissible_slide
statement:
theorem admissible_slide {M : Mesh} {Q d : Point} (hadm : AdmissibleRay M Q d)
    {ε : ℚ} (hε : 0 < ε) : AdmissibleRay M (Q + ε • d) d
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨hd, hedge⟩ := hadm
  refine ⟨hd, fun u s hs => ?_⟩
  have hrw : (Q + ε • d) + s • d = Q + (ε + s) • d := by
    funext i; simp only [Pi.add_apply, Pi.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul, add_mul]; ring
  rw [hrw]
  exact hedge u (ε + s) (by linarith)

name: ee0_slide
statement:
theorem ee0_slide (t : Triangle) (Q d : Point) (s : ℚ) :
    Proof.MeshIntersectRayClassify.ee0 t (Q + s • d)
      = Proof.MeshIntersectRayClassify.ee0 t Q + s * delta0 t d
proof:
:= by
  simp only [Proof.MeshIntersectRayClassify.ee0, delta0, det3,
    dotQ, crossQ, psub, Proof.MeshIntersectJump.faceNormal, mkPoint_zero, mkPoint_one, mkPoint_two,
    Pi.add_apply, Pi.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul]; ring

statement:
theorem ee1_slide (t : Triangle) (Q d : Point) (s : ℚ) :

name: ee2_slide
statement:
theorem ee2_slide (t : Triangle) (Q d : Point) (s : ℚ) :

name: parallel_ray_on_carrier
proof:
:= by

name: triangleSet_coord_bounded
statement:
theorem triangleSet_coord_bounded {t : Triangle} {x : Point} (hx : x ∈ triangleSet t)
    (j : Fin 3) :
    x j ≤ max (t.v₀ j) (max (t.v₁ j) (t.v₂ j))
proof:
:= by
  
  set B := max (t.v₀ j) (max (t.v₁ j) (t.v₂ j)) with hB
  have hconv : Convex ℚ {y : Point | y j ≤ B} := by
    intro a ha b hb p q hp hq hpq
    simp only [Set.mem_setOf_eq, Pi.add_apply, Pi.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul] at ha hb ⊢
    calc p * a j + q * b j
        ≤ p * B + q * B := by
          apply add_le_add
          · exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left ha hp
          · exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hb hq
      _ = B := by rw [← add_mul, hpq, one_mul]

  have hsub : ({t.v₀, t.v₁, t.v₂} : Set Point) ⊆ {y : Point | y j ≤ B} := by
    intro y hy; simp only [Set.mem_insert_iff, Set.mem_singleton_iff] at hy
    simp only [Set.mem_setOf_eq, hB]
    rcases hy with rfl | rfl | rfl
    · exact le_max_left _ _
    · exact le_trans (le_max_left _ _) (le_max_right _ _)
    · exact le_trans (le_max_right _ _) (le_max_right _ _)
  exact convexHull_min hsub hconv hx

name: triangleSet_coord_bounded_lo
statement:
theorem triangleSet_coord_bounded_lo {t : Triangle} {x : Point} (hx : x ∈ triangleSet t)
    (j : Fin 3) :
    min (t.v₀ j) (min (t.v₁ j) (t.v₂ j)) ≤ x j
proof:
:= by
  set B := min (t.v₀ j) (min (t.v₁ j) (t.v₂ j)) with hB
  have hconv : Convex ℚ {y : Point | B ≤ y j} := by
    intro a ha b hb p q hp hq hpq
    simp only [Set.mem_setOf_eq, Pi.add_apply, Pi.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul] at ha hb ⊢
    calc B = p * B + q * B := by rw [← add_mul, hpq, one_mul]
      _ ≤ p * a j + q * b j := by
          apply add_le_add
          · exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left ha hp
          · exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hb hq
  have hsub : ({t.v₀, t.v₁, t.v₂} : Set Point) ⊆ {y : Point | B ≤ y j} := by
    intro y hy; simp only [Set.mem_insert_iff, Set.mem_singleton_iff] at hy
    simp only [Set.mem_setOf_eq, hB]
    rcases hy with rfl | rfl | rfl
    · exact min_le_left _ _
    · exact le_trans (min_le_right _ _) (min_le_left _ _)
    · exact le_trans (min_le_right _ _) (min_le_right _ _)
  exact convexHull_min hsub hconv hx

name: binding_offset
statement:
theorem binding_offset (c δ : Fin 3 → ℚ) (hc : ∀ k, 0 ≤ c k)
    (hneg : ∃ k, δ k < 0) :
    ∃ β' : ℚ, 0 ≤ β' ∧ (∀ k, 0 ≤ c k + β' * δ k) ∧ (∃ k, c k + β' * δ k = 0)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  
  set K := (Finset.univ.filter (fun k => δ k < 0)) with hKdef
  have hKne : K.Nonempty := by
    obtain ⟨k, hk⟩ := hneg
    exact ⟨k, Finset.mem_filter.mpr ⟨Finset.mem_univ k, hk⟩⟩
  set cand : Fin 3 → ℚ := fun k => c k / (- δ k) with hcanddef
  set β' := (K.image cand).min' (Finset.image_nonempty.mpr hKne) with hβ'
  have hβ'mem := Finset.min'_mem (K.image cand) (Finset.image_nonempty.mpr hKne)
  rw [← hβ'] at hβ'mem
  obtain ⟨k₀, hk₀K, hk₀val⟩ := Finset.mem_image.mp hβ'mem
  have hk₀neg : δ k₀ < 0 := (Finset.mem_filter.mp hk₀K).2
  have hcandval : ∀ k, cand k = c k / (- δ k) := fun k => rfl
  have hβ'nonneg : 0 ≤ β' := by
    rw [← hk₀val, hcandval]
    exact div_nonneg (hc k₀) (by linarith)
  refine ⟨β', hβ'nonneg, ?_, ⟨k₀, ?_⟩⟩
  · intro k
    by_cases hk : δ k < 0
    · 
      have hle : β' ≤ cand k :=
        Finset.min'_le _ _ (Finset.mem_image.mpr
          ⟨k, Finset.mem_filter.mpr ⟨Finset.mem_univ k, hk⟩, rfl⟩)
      rw [hcandval, le_div_iff₀ (by linarith : (0:ℚ) < - δ k)] at hle
      nlinarith [hle]
    · push_neg at hk
      have : 0 ≤ β' * δ k := mul_nonneg hβ'nonneg hk
      linarith [hc k]
  · 
    have hval : β' = c k₀ / (- δ k₀) := by rw [← hk₀val, hcandval]
    have hne : - δ k₀ ≠ 0 := by linarith
    rw [hval, div_mul_eq_mul_div, mul_div_assoc,
      show δ k₀ / (- δ k₀) = -1 from by
        rw [div_neg, div_self (by linarith : δ k₀ ≠ 0)], mul_neg_one]
    ring

name: ee_slide_vec
statement:
theorem ee_slide_vec (t : Triangle) (Q d : Point) (s : ℚ) (k : Fin 3) :
    eeVec t (Q + s • d) k = eeVec t Q k + s * deltaVec t d k
proof:
:= by
  fin_cases k
  · simp only [eeVec, deltaVec, Matrix.cons_val_zero]; exact ee0_slide t Q d s
  · simp only [eeVec, deltaVec, Matrix.cons_val_one, Matrix.head_cons]; exact ee1_slide t Q d s
  · simp only [eeVec, deltaVec, Matrix.cons_val_two, Matrix.tail_cons, Matrix.head_cons]
    exact ee2_slide t Q d s

name: mem_triangleSet_iff_eeVec
statement:
theorem mem_triangleSet_iff_eeVec {t : Triangle} {P : Point} (hn : faceNormal t ≠ 0)
    (hcar : dot (faceNormal t) P = cOf t) :
    P ∈ triangleSet t ↔ ∀ k, 0 ≤ eeVec t P k
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro hmem k
    obtain ⟨h0, h1, h2⟩ := ee_nonneg_of_mem hmem
    fin_cases k
    · simpa [eeVec] using h0
    · simpa [eeVec] using h1
    · simpa [eeVec] using h2
  · intro h
    exact mem_triangleSet_of_carrier' hn hcar
      (by simpa [eeVec] using h 0) (by simpa [eeVec] using h 1) (by simpa [eeVec] using h 2)

name: inplane_not_mem
statement:
theorem inplane_not_mem {M : Mesh} {Q d : Point} {u : Fin M.size}
    (hd : d ≠ 0) (hnd : dot (faceNormal M[u]) d = 0) (hn : faceNormal M[u] ≠ 0)
    (hcar : dot (faceNormal M[u]) Q = cOf M[u])
    (hadm : ∀ s : ℚ, 0 < s → Q + s • d ∉ edgeSet M[u])
    {ε : ℚ} (hε : 0 < ε) : Q + ε • d ∉ triangleSet M[u]
proof:
:= by
  set t := M[u] with ht
  intro hmem
  
  have hcarε : dot (faceNormal t) (Q + ε • d) = cOf t := parallel_ray_on_carrier hnd hcar ε
  have hcε : ∀ k, 0 ≤ eeVec t (Q + ε • d) k :=
    (mem_triangleSet_iff_eeVec hn hcarε).mp hmem
  
  have hneg : ∃ k, deltaVec t d k < 0 := by
    by_contra hall
    push_neg at hall  
    
    obtain ⟨j₀, hj₀⟩ : ∃ j, d j ≠ 0 := by
      by_contra hc; push_neg at hc; exact hd (funext fun j => hc j)
    
    set B := max (t.v₀ j₀) (max (t.v₁ j₀) (t.v₂ j₀)) with hBdef
    
    rcases lt_or_gt_of_ne hj₀ with hdneg | hdpos
    · 
      
      set Blo := min (t.v₀ j₀) (min (t.v₁ j₀) (t.v₂ j₀)) with hBlodef
      
      have hpos : 0 < - d j₀ := by linarith
      have hexists : ∃ s : ℚ, ε ≤ s ∧ Q j₀ + s * d j₀ < Blo := by
        refine ⟨max ε ((Q j₀ - Blo + 1) / (- d j₀)), le_max_left _ _, ?_⟩
        have hs2 : (Q j₀ - Blo + 1) / (- d j₀) ≤ max ε ((Q j₀ - Blo + 1) / (- d j₀)) :=
          le_max_right _ _
        rw [div_le_iff₀ hpos] at hs2
        nlinarith [hs2]
      obtain ⟨s, hsε, hslt⟩ := hexists
      have hins : Q + s • d ∈ triangleSet t := by
        rw [mem_triangleSet_iff_eeVec hn (parallel_ray_on_carrier hnd hcar s)]
        intro k
        rw [ee_slide_vec]
        have hεk := hcε k
        rw [ee_slide_vec] at hεk
        nlinarith [hεk, hall k, mul_nonneg (by linarith : (0:ℚ) ≤ s - ε) (hall k)]
      have hlow := triangleSet_coord_bounded_lo hins j₀
      rw [← hBlodef] at hlow
      simp only [Pi.add_apply, Pi.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul] at hlow
      linarith [hlow, hslt]
    · 
      have hexists : ∃ s : ℚ, ε ≤ s ∧ B < Q j₀ + s * d j₀ := by
        refine ⟨max ε ((B - Q j₀ + 1) / d j₀), le_max_left _ _, ?_⟩
        have hs2 : (B - Q j₀ + 1) / d j₀ ≤ max ε ((B - Q j₀ + 1) / d j₀) := le_max_right _ _
        rw [div_le_iff₀ hdpos] at hs2
        nlinarith [hs2]
      obtain ⟨s, hsε, hgt⟩ := hexists
      have hins : Q + s • d ∈ triangleSet t := by
        rw [mem_triangleSet_iff_eeVec hn (parallel_ray_on_carrier hnd hcar s)]
        intro k
        rw [ee_slide_vec]
        have hεk := hcε k
        rw [ee_slide_vec] at hεk
        nlinarith [hεk, hall k, mul_nonneg (by linarith : (0:ℚ) ≤ s - ε) (hall k)]
      have hbnd := triangleSet_coord_bounded hins j₀
      simp only [Pi.add_apply, Pi.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul] at hbnd
      rw [← hBdef] at hbnd
      linarith [hbnd, hgt]
  
  obtain ⟨β', hβ'0, hβ'nn, k₀, hk₀⟩ := binding_offset (eeVec t (Q + ε • d)) (deltaVec t d) hcε hneg
  set β := ε + β' with hβdef
  have hβpos : 0 < β := by rw [hβdef]; linarith
  
  have heeβ : ∀ k, eeVec t (Q + β • d) k = eeVec t (Q + ε • d) k + β' * deltaVec t d k := by
    intro k
    have h1 : Q + β • d = (Q + ε • d) + β' • d := by
      funext i; simp only [Pi.add_apply, Pi.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul, hβdef, add_mul]; ring
    rw [h1, ee_slide_vec]
  have hall_nn : ∀ k, 0 ≤ eeVec t (Q + β • d) k := by intro k; rw [heeβ]; exact hβ'nn k
  have hzero : eeVec t (Q + β • d) k₀ = 0 := by rw [heeβ]; exact hk₀
  
  have hedgeβ : Q + β • d ∈ edgeSet t :=
    mem_edgeSet_of_carrier' hn (parallel_ray_on_carrier hnd hcar β)
      (by have := hall_nn 0; simpa [eeVec] using this)
      (by have := hall_nn 1; simpa [eeVec] using this)
      (by have := hall_nn 2; simpa [eeVec] using this)
      (by
        fin_cases k₀
        · left; have := hzero; simpa [eeVec] using this
        · right; left; have := hzero; simpa [eeVec] using this
        · right; right; have := hzero; simpa [eeVec] using this)
  exact hadm β hβpos hedgeβ

name: slid_off_surface
statement:
theorem slid_off_surface {M : Mesh} {Q d : Point} (hadm : AdmissibleRay M Q d)
    {ε : ℚ} (hε : 0 < ε) (hε0 : ε ≤ eps0 M Q d) :
    Q + ε • d ∉ surface M
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨hd, hedge⟩ := hadm
  rw [surface, Set.mem_iUnion, not_exists]
  intro u hmem
  by_cases hnd : dot (faceNormal M[u]) d = 0
  · 
    by_cases hdeg : faceNormal M[u] = 0
    · 
      exact hedge u ε hε (triangleSet_subset_edgeSet_of_degen hdeg hmem)
    · 
      by_cases hcar : dot (faceNormal M[u]) Q = cOf M[u]
      · 
        exact inplane_not_mem hd hnd hdeg hcar (fun s hs => hedge u s hs) hε hmem
      · 
        apply hcar
        have hcarε : dot (faceNormal M[u]) (Q + ε • d) = cOf M[u] := triangleSet_carrier hmem
        rw [dot_line, hnd, mul_zero, add_zero] at hcarε
        exact hcarε
  · 
    have hcarε : dot (faceNormal M[u]) (Q + ε • d) = cOf M[u] := triangleSet_carrier hmem
    have hsε0 : sStar M[u] d (Q + ε • d) = 0 := by
      rw [sStar, hcarε, sub_self, zero_div]
    have hsQ : sStar M[u] d Q = ε := by
      have := sStar_slide hnd Q ε; rw [hsε0] at this; linarith
    by_cases hhit : RayHits Q d M[u]
    · exact absurd (hsQ ▸ eps0_lt_sStar hnd hhit) (by linarith)
    · 
      apply hhit
      rw [rayHits_iff hnd]
      refine ⟨by rw [hsQ]; exact hε, ?_⟩
      have hh : hitPt M[u] d Q = Q + ε • d := by rw [hitPt, hsQ]
      rw [hh]; exact hmem

name: R4_backward
statement:
theorem R4_backward {M : Mesh}
    (h : Proof.Negligible.WindingZeroOrOneOffPlanes M) : WindingZeroOrOne M
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨N, hN, hNval⟩ := h
  intro Q d hadm
  
  set ε := eps0 M Q d with hεdef
  have hεpos : 0 < ε := eps0_pos M Q d
  set Q' := Q + ε • d with hQ'def
  have hQ'off : Q' ∉ surface M := slid_off_surface hadm hεpos le_rfl
  have hQ'adm : AdmissibleRay M Q' d := admissible_slide hadm hεpos
  have hcountQ' : crossingCount M Q' d = crossingCount M Q d :=
    crossingCount_slide hεpos le_rfl
  
  have hNunion : Negligible (N ∪ {P | ¬ AdmissibleRay M P d}) :=
    Proof.Negligible.negligible_union hN (negligible_not_admissible hadm.1)
  obtain ⟨P, hPcount, hPN⟩ :=
    exists_count_eq_off_negligible hQ'off hQ'adm hNunion
  have hPnotN : P ∉ N := fun hc => hPN (Or.inl hc)
  have hPadm : AdmissibleRay M P d := by
    by_contra hc; exact hPN (Or.inr hc)
  
  have hval := hNval P hPnotN d hPadm
  rw [hPcount, hcountQ'] at hval
  exact hval

name: iFacePlane_eq_clearPlane
statement:
theorem iFacePlane_eq_clearPlane (a b c : P3) :
    iFacePlane a b c
    = clearPlane (crossS (psubS b a) (psubS c a))
        (dotS (crossS (psubS b a) (psubS c a)) a)
proof: := rfl

name: iFacePlane_shift
statement:
theorem iFacePlane_shift (a b c o : P3) :
    iFacePlane (psubS a o) (psubS b o) (psubS c o)
    = clearPlane (crossS (psubS b a) (psubS c a))
        (dotS (crossS (psubS b a) (psubS c a)) a
          - dotS (crossS (psubS b a) (psubS c a)) o)
proof:
:= by
  rw [iFacePlane_eq_clearPlane, crossNormal_translate, dotS_psubS]

name: clearPlane_eq_zero_of_gamma
statement:
theorem clearPlane_eq_zero_of_gamma (n : P3) (c : ℚ) (hγ : gamma (clearPlane n c) = 0) :
    clearPlane n c = ⟨0, 0, 0, 0⟩
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨ha, hb, hc, hd⟩ := (gamma_eq_zero_iff _).mp hγ
  calc clearPlane n c
      = ⟨(clearPlane n c).a, (clearPlane n c).b, (clearPlane n c).c, (clearPlane n c).d⟩ := rfl
    _ = ⟨0, 0, 0, 0⟩ := by rw [ha, hb, hc, hd]

name: prim_clearPlane_eq_iff
statement:
theorem prim_clearPlane_eq_iff (n₁ : P3) (c₁ : ℚ) (n₂ : P3) (c₂ : ℚ) :
    IPlane.prim (clearPlane n₁ c₁) = IPlane.prim (clearPlane n₂ c₂)
    ↔ RatProp4 n₁.x n₁.y n₁.z c₁ n₂.x n₂.y n₂.z c₂
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨hM1, hPa, hPb, hPc, hPd⟩ := clearPlane_eq_smul n₁ c₁
  obtain ⟨hM2, hQa, hQb, hQc, hQd⟩ := clearPlane_eq_smul n₂ c₂
  have hM1' : (clearMul n₁ c₁ : ℚ) ≠ 0 := by exact_mod_cast ne_of_gt hM1
  have hM2' : (clearMul n₂ c₂ : ℚ) ≠ 0 := by exact_mod_cast ne_of_gt hM2
  rw [← ratProp_iff_ratProp4_of_decomp hM1' hM2' hPa hPb hPc hPd hQa hQb hQc hQd]
  constructor
  · intro heq
    by_cases hγ1 : gamma (clearPlane n₁ c₁) = 0
    · have hPz := clearPlane_eq_zero_of_gamma n₁ c₁ hγ1
      rw [hPz, prim_zero] at heq
      have hγ2 : gamma (clearPlane n₂ c₂) = 0 := by
        by_contra hγ2
        exact prim_ne_zero_of_gamma_ne hγ2 heq.symm
      rw [hPz, clearPlane_eq_zero_of_gamma n₂ c₂ hγ2]
      exact ⟨1, one_ne_zero, by simp, by simp, by simp, by simp⟩
    · by_cases hγ2 : gamma (clearPlane n₂ c₂) = 0
      · exfalso
        rw [clearPlane_eq_zero_of_gamma n₂ c₂ hγ2, prim_zero] at heq
        exact prim_ne_zero_of_gamma_ne hγ1 heq
      · exact ratMul_of_prim_eq hγ1 hγ2 heq
  · exact prim_eq_of_ratMul

name: ratProp4_dot_shift
statement:
theorem ratProp4_dot_shift (N₁ N₂ : P3) (D₁ D₂ : ℚ) (o : P3) :
    RatProp4 N₁.x N₁.y N₁.z D₁ N₂.x N₂.y N₂.z D₂
    ↔ RatProp4 N₁.x N₁.y N₁.z (D₁ - dotS N₁ o) N₂.x N₂.y N₂.z (D₂ - dotS N₂ o)
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨ρ, hρ, hx, hy, hz, hd⟩
    have hE : dotS N₂ o = ρ * dotS N₁ o := by simp only [dotS]; rw [hx, hy, hz]; ring
    exact ⟨ρ, hρ, hx, hy, hz, by linear_combination hd - hE⟩
  · rintro ⟨ρ, hρ, hx, hy, hz, hd⟩
    have hE : dotS N₂ o = ρ * dotS N₁ o := by simp only [dotS]; rw [hx, hy, hz]; ring
    exact ⟨ρ, hρ, hx, hy, hz, by linear_combination hd + hE⟩

name: coplanarPlane_iFacePlane_tr
statement:
theorem coplanarPlane_iFacePlane_tr (o a₁ b₁ c₁ a₂ b₂ c₂ : P3) :
    coplanarPlane (iFacePlane (psubS a₁ o) (psubS b₁ o) (psubS c₁ o))
                  (iFacePlane (psubS a₂ o) (psubS b₂ o) (psubS c₂ o))
    = coplanarPlane (iFacePlane a₁ b₁ c₁) (iFacePlane a₂ b₂ c₂)
proof:
:= by
  rw [iFacePlane_shift a₁ b₁ c₁ o, iFacePlane_shift a₂ b₂ c₂ o,
      iFacePlane_eq_clearPlane a₁ b₁ c₁, iFacePlane_eq_clearPlane a₂ b₂ c₂,
      Bool.eq_iff_iff, coplanarPlane_eq_true_iff, coplanarPlane_eq_true_iff,
      prim_clearPlane_eq_iff, prim_clearPlane_eq_iff]
  exact (ratProp4_dot_shift _ _ _ _ o).symm

name: gamma_clearPlane_eq_zero_iff
statement:
theorem gamma_clearPlane_eq_zero_iff (n : P3) (c : ℚ) :
    gamma (clearPlane n c) = 0 ↔ n.x = 0 ∧ n.y = 0 ∧ n.z = 0 ∧ c = 0
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨hM, hPa, hPb, hPc, hPd⟩ := clearPlane_eq_smul n c
  have hM' : (clearMul n c : ℚ) ≠ 0 := by exact_mod_cast ne_of_gt hM
  rw [gamma_eq_zero_iff]
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨ha, hb, hc, hd⟩
    refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
    · have : (clearMul n c : ℚ) * n.x = 0 := by rw [← hPa]; exact_mod_cast ha
      exact (mul_eq_zero.mp this).resolve_left hM'
    · have : (clearMul n c : ℚ) * n.y = 0 := by rw [← hPb]; exact_mod_cast hb
      exact (mul_eq_zero.mp this).resolve_left hM'
    · have : (clearMul n c : ℚ) * n.z = 0 := by rw [← hPc]; exact_mod_cast hc
      exact (mul_eq_zero.mp this).resolve_left hM'
    · have : (clearMul n c : ℚ) * c = 0 := by rw [← hPd]; exact_mod_cast hd
      exact (mul_eq_zero.mp this).resolve_left hM'
  · rintro ⟨hx, hy, hz, hc⟩
    refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
    · have : ((clearPlane n c).a : ℚ) = 0 := by rw [hPa, hx, mul_zero]
      exact_mod_cast this
    · have : ((clearPlane n c).b : ℚ) = 0 := by rw [hPb, hy, mul_zero]
      exact_mod_cast this
    · have : ((clearPlane n c).c : ℚ) = 0 := by rw [hPc, hz, mul_zero]
      exact_mod_cast this
    · have : ((clearPlane n c).d : ℚ) = 0 := by rw [hPd, hc, mul_zero]
      exact_mod_cast this

name: sameOrient_clearPlane_iff
statement:
theorem sameOrient_clearPlane_iff (n₁ : P3) (c₁ : ℚ) (n₂ : P3) (c₂ : ℚ) :
    sameOrient (clearPlane n₁ c₁) (clearPlane n₂ c₂) = true
    ↔ ∃ ρ : ℚ, 0 < ρ ∧ n₂.x = ρ * n₁.x ∧ n₂.y = ρ * n₁.y ∧ n₂.z = ρ * n₁.z ∧ c₂ = ρ * c₁
proof:
:= by
  unfold sameOrient
  rw [beqIPlane_eq_true_iff]
  obtain ⟨hM1, hPa, hPb, hPc, hPd⟩ := clearPlane_eq_smul n₁ c₁
  obtain ⟨hM2, hQa, hQb, hQc, hQd⟩ := clearPlane_eq_smul n₂ c₂
  have hM1' : (clearMul n₁ c₁ : ℚ) ≠ 0 := by exact_mod_cast ne_of_gt hM1
  have hM2' : (clearMul n₂ c₂ : ℚ) ≠ 0 := by exact_mod_cast ne_of_gt hM2
  constructor
  · intro heq
    by_cases hγ1 : gamma (clearPlane n₁ c₁) = 0
    · obtain ⟨z1x, z1y, z1z, z1c⟩ := (gamma_clearPlane_eq_zero_iff n₁ c₁).mp hγ1
      have hpd1 : IPlane.primDir (clearPlane n₁ c₁) = ⟨0, 0, 0, 0⟩ := by
        rw [clearPlane_eq_zero_of_gamma n₁ c₁ hγ1, primDir_zero]
      have hγ2 : gamma (clearPlane n₂ c₂) = 0 := by
        by_contra hγ2
        exact primDir_ne_zero_of_gamma_ne hγ2 (hpd1 ▸ heq).symm
      obtain ⟨z2x, z2y, z2z, z2c⟩ := (gamma_clearPlane_eq_zero_iff n₂ c₂).mp hγ2
      exact ⟨1, one_pos, by rw [z1x, z2x]; ring, by rw [z1y, z2y]; ring,
        by rw [z1z, z2z]; ring, by rw [z1c, z2c]; ring⟩
    · by_cases hγ2 : gamma (clearPlane n₂ c₂) = 0
      · exfalso
        have hpd2 : IPlane.primDir (clearPlane n₂ c₂) = ⟨0, 0, 0, 0⟩ := by
          rw [clearPlane_eq_zero_of_gamma n₂ c₂ hγ2, primDir_zero]
        exact primDir_ne_zero_of_gamma_ne hγ1 (hpd2 ▸ heq)
      · obtain ⟨ρ, hρ, pa, pb, pc, pd⟩ := ratProp_pos_of_primDir_eq hγ1 hγ2 heq
        refine ⟨ρ * clearMul n₁ c₁ / clearMul n₂ c₂,
          by positivity, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
        · have h : (clearMul n₂ c₂ : ℚ) * n₂.x = ρ * (clearMul n₁ c₁ : ℚ) * n₁.x := by
            rw [← hQa, pa, hPa]; ring
          rw [div_mul_eq_mul_div, eq_div_iff hM2']; linear_combination h
        · have h : (clearMul n₂ c₂ : ℚ) * n₂.y = ρ * (clearMul n₁ c₁ : ℚ) * n₁.y := by
            rw [← hQb, pb, hPb]; ring
          rw [div_mul_eq_mul_div, eq_div_iff hM2']; linear_combination h
        · have h : (clearMul n₂ c₂ : ℚ) * n₂.z = ρ * (clearMul n₁ c₁ : ℚ) * n₁.z := by
            rw [← hQc, pc, hPc]; ring
          rw [div_mul_eq_mul_div, eq_div_iff hM2']; linear_combination h
        · have h : (clearMul n₂ c₂ : ℚ) * c₂ = ρ * (clearMul n₁ c₁ : ℚ) * c₁ := by
            rw [← hQd, pd, hPd]; ring
          rw [div_mul_eq_mul_div, eq_div_iff hM2']; linear_combination h
  · rintro ⟨ρ, hρ, hx, hy, hz, hc⟩
    set ρ' : ℚ := clearMul n₂ c₂ * ρ / clearMul n₁ c₁ with hρ'def
    have hρ' : 0 < ρ' := by rw [hρ'def]; positivity
    have pa : ((clearPlane n₂ c₂).a : ℚ) = ρ' * (clearPlane n₁ c₁).a := by
      rw [hQa, hx, hPa, hρ'def, div_mul_eq_mul_div, eq_div_iff hM1']; ring
    have pb : ((clearPlane n₂ c₂).b : ℚ) = ρ' * (clearPlane n₁ c₁).b := by
      rw [hQb, hy, hPb, hρ'def, div_mul_eq_mul_div, eq_div_iff hM1']; ring
    have pc : ((clearPlane n₂ c₂).c : ℚ) = ρ' * (clearPlane n₁ c₁).c := by
      rw [hQc, hz, hPc, hρ'def, div_mul_eq_mul_div, eq_div_iff hM1']; ring
    have pd : ((clearPlane n₂ c₂).d : ℚ) = ρ' * (clearPlane n₁ c₁).d := by
      rw [hQd, hPd, hρ'def, div_mul_eq_mul_div, eq_div_iff hM1']
      linear_combination (clearMul n₂ c₂ : ℚ) * (clearMul n₁ c₁ : ℚ) * hc
    exact CSG.Proof.MeshIntersectPlaneKey.primDir_eq_of_posMul ⟨ρ', hρ', pa, pb, pc, pd⟩

name: ratProp4pos_dot_shift
statement:
theorem ratProp4pos_dot_shift (N₁ N₂ : P3) (D₁ D₂ : ℚ) (o : P3) :
    (∃ ρ : ℚ, 0 < ρ ∧ N₂.x = ρ * N₁.x ∧ N₂.y = ρ * N₁.y ∧ N₂.z = ρ * N₁.z ∧ D₂ = ρ * D₁)
    ↔ (∃ ρ : ℚ, 0 < ρ ∧ N₂.x = ρ * N₁.x ∧ N₂.y = ρ * N₁.y ∧ N₂.z = ρ * N₁.z
        ∧ D₂ - dotS N₂ o = ρ * (D₁ - dotS N₁ o))
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨ρ, hρ, hx, hy, hz, hd⟩
    have hE : dotS N₂ o = ρ * dotS N₁ o := by simp only [dotS]; rw [hx, hy, hz]; ring
    exact ⟨ρ, hρ, hx, hy, hz, by linear_combination hd - hE⟩
  · rintro ⟨ρ, hρ, hx, hy, hz, hd⟩
    have hE : dotS N₂ o = ρ * dotS N₁ o := by simp only [dotS]; rw [hx, hy, hz]; ring
    exact ⟨ρ, hρ, hx, hy, hz, by linear_combination hd + hE⟩

name: sameOrient_iFacePlane_tr
statement:
theorem sameOrient_iFacePlane_tr (o a₁ b₁ c₁ a₂ b₂ c₂ : P3) :
    sameOrient (iFacePlane (psubS a₁ o) (psubS b₁ o) (psubS c₁ o))
               (iFacePlane (psubS a₂ o) (psubS b₂ o) (psubS c₂ o))
    = sameOrient (iFacePlane a₁ b₁ c₁) (iFacePlane a₂ b₂ c₂)
proof:
:= by
  rw [iFacePlane_shift a₁ b₁ c₁ o, iFacePlane_shift a₂ b₂ c₂ o,
      iFacePlane_eq_clearPlane a₁ b₁ c₁, iFacePlane_eq_clearPlane a₂ b₂ c₂,
      Bool.eq_iff_iff, sameOrient_clearPlane_iff, sameOrient_clearPlane_iff]
  exact (ratProp4pos_dot_shift _ _ _ _ o).symm

name: coplanarPlane_iFacePlaneP
statement:
theorem coplanarPlane_iFacePlaneP (a b c a' b' c' : P3) :
    coplanarPlane (iFacePlaneP a b c) (iFacePlaneP a' b' c')
    = coplanarPlane (iFacePlane a b c) (iFacePlane a' b' c')
proof:
:= by
  simp only [coplanarPlane, iFacePlaneP, prim_iFacePlaneH_eq]

name: sameOrient_iFacePlaneP
statement:
theorem sameOrient_iFacePlaneP (a b c a' b' c' : P3) :
    sameOrient (iFacePlaneP a b c) (iFacePlaneP a' b' c')
    = sameOrient (iFacePlane a b c) (iFacePlane a' b' c')
proof:
:= by
  simp only [sameOrient, iFacePlaneP, primDir_iFacePlaneH_eq]

name: coplanarPlane_iFacePlaneP_tr
statement:
theorem coplanarPlane_iFacePlaneP_tr (o a₁ b₁ c₁ a₂ b₂ c₂ : P3) :
    coplanarPlane (iFacePlaneP (psubS a₁ o) (psubS b₁ o) (psubS c₁ o))
                  (iFacePlaneP (psubS a₂ o) (psubS b₂ o) (psubS c₂ o))
    = coplanarPlane (iFacePlaneP a₁ b₁ c₁) (iFacePlaneP a₂ b₂ c₂)
proof:
:= by
  rw [coplanarPlane_iFacePlaneP, coplanarPlane_iFacePlaneP]
  exact coplanarPlane_iFacePlane_tr o a₁ b₁ c₁ a₂ b₂ c₂

name: sameOrient_iFacePlaneP_tr
statement:
theorem sameOrient_iFacePlaneP_tr (o a₁ b₁ c₁ a₂ b₂ c₂ : P3) :
    sameOrient (iFacePlaneP (psubS a₁ o) (psubS b₁ o) (psubS c₁ o))
               (iFacePlaneP (psubS a₂ o) (psubS b₂ o) (psubS c₂ o))
    = sameOrient (iFacePlaneP a₁ b₁ c₁) (iFacePlaneP a₂ b₂ c₂)
proof:
:= by
  rw [sameOrient_iFacePlaneP, sameOrient_iFacePlaneP]
  exact sameOrient_iFacePlane_tr o a₁ b₁ c₁ a₂ b₂ c₂

name: Excludes.mono
statement:
theorem Excludes.mono {F G : Point → Prop} (h : Excludes F)
    (himp : ∀ Q, F Q → G Q) : Excludes G
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨N, hN, hF⟩ := h
  exact ⟨N, hN, fun Q hQ => himp Q (hF Q hQ)⟩

name: Excludes.trivial
statement: theorem Excludes.trivial {F : Point → Prop} (h : ∀ Q, F Q) : Excludes F
proof:
:=
  ⟨∅, negligible_empty, fun Q _ => h Q⟩

name: Excludes.and
statement:
theorem Excludes.and {F G : Point → Prop} (hF : Excludes F)
    (hG : Excludes G) : Excludes (fun Q => F Q ∧ G Q)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨N₁, hN₁, h₁⟩ := hF
  obtain ⟨N₂, hN₂, h₂⟩ := hG
  exact ⟨N₁ ∪ N₂, negligible_union hN₁ hN₂,
    fun Q hQ => ⟨h₁ Q (fun h => hQ (Or.inl h)), h₂ Q (fun h => hQ (Or.inr h))⟩⟩

name: Excludes.forall_fintype
statement:
theorem Excludes.forall_fintype {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι]
    {F : ι → Point → Prop} (h : ∀ i, Excludes (F i)) :
    Excludes (fun Q => ∀ i, F i Q)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  choose N hneg hF using h
  exact ⟨⋃ i, N i, negligible_iUnion_fintype hneg,
    fun Q hQ i => hF i Q (fun hmem => hQ (Set.mem_iUnion.mpr ⟨i, hmem⟩))⟩

name: Excludes.forall_mem_list
proof:
:= by
  have h' : ∀ i : Fin l.length, Excludes (F l[i]) :=
    fun i => h _ (l.getElem_mem i.isLt)
  refine (Excludes.forall_fintype h').mono ?_
  intro Q hQ x hx
  obtain ⟨i, hi, rfl⟩ := List.mem_iff_getElem.mp hx
  exact hQ ⟨i, hi⟩

name: Excludes.forall_mem_array
proof:
:= by
  have h' := Excludes.forall_mem_list (l := a.toList) (F := F)
    (fun x hx => h x (Array.mem_def.mpr hx))
  exact h'.mono (fun Q hQ x hx => hQ x (Array.mem_def.mp hx))

name: dotQ_eq_sum
statement: theorem dotQ_eq_sum (n x : Point) : dotQ n x = ∑ i, n i * x i
proof:
:= by
  rw [Fin.sum_univ_three]
  rfl

name: isPlane_dotQ
statement:
theorem isPlane_dotQ {n : Point} (hn : n ≠ 0) (c : ℚ) :
    IsPlane {x | dotQ n x = c}
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨n, c, hn, ?_⟩
  ext x
  simp only [Set.mem_setOf_eq, dotQ_eq_sum]

name: negligible_of_isPlane
statement:
theorem negligible_of_isPlane {H : Set Point} (h : IsPlane H) :
    Negligible H
proof:
:=
  ⟨1, fun _ => H, fun _ => h, fun _ hx => Set.mem_iUnion.mpr ⟨0, hx⟩⟩

name: excludes_dotQ_ne
statement:
theorem excludes_dotQ_ne {n : Point} (hn : n ≠ 0) (c : ℚ) :
    Excludes (fun Q => dotQ n Q ≠ c)
proof:
:=
  ⟨{x | dotQ n x = c}, negligible_of_isPlane (isPlane_dotQ hn c),
    fun _ hQ => hQ⟩

name: dotQ_smul_sub_left
statement:
theorem dotQ_smul_sub_left (s t : ℚ) (u v w : Point) :
    dotQ (s • u - t • v) w = s * dotQ u w - t * dotQ v w
proof:
:= by
  simp only [dotQ, Pi.sub_apply, Pi.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul]
  ring

name: dotQ_pull
statement:
theorem dotQ_pull (a nt Q : Point) (b ct : ℚ) (hQ : dotQ nt Q ≠ 0) :
    dotQ a ((ct / dotQ nt Q) • Q) - b
      = dotQ (ct • a - b • nt) Q / dotQ nt Q
proof:
:= by
  rw [eq_div_iff hQ, Proof.MeshIntersectRay.dotQ_smul_right,
    dotQ_smul_sub_left]
  field_simp
  ring

name: pull_aff
statement:
theorem pull_aff {a nt : Point} {b ct : ℚ} (hcert : ct • a - b • nt ≠ 0) :
    Excludes (fun Q => dotQ nt Q ≠ 0 →
      dotQ a ((ct / dotQ nt Q) • Q) ≠ b)
proof:
:= by
  refine (excludes_dotQ_ne hcert 0).mono ?_
  intro Q hQ hntQ heq
  apply hQ
  have hp := dotQ_pull a nt Q b ct hntQ
  rw [heq, sub_self] at hp
  exact (div_eq_zero_iff.mp hp.symm).resolve_right hntQ

name: cert_lat
statement:
theorem cert_lat {a nt : Point} {ct : ℚ} (hct : ct ≠ 0) (ha : a ≠ 0) :
    ct • a - (0 : ℚ) • nt ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [zero_smul, sub_zero]
  exact smul_ne_zero hct ha

name: dotQ_comm
statement: theorem dotQ_comm (u v : Point) : dotQ u v = dotQ v u
proof:
:= by
  simp only [dotQ]
  ring

name: areaForm_affine_data
statement:
theorem areaForm_affine_data (nt u v x : Point) :
    areaForm nt u v x
      = dotQ (crossQ nt (v - u)) x - dotQ (crossQ nt (v - u)) u
proof:
:= by
  show dotQ nt (crossQ (v - u) (x - u)) = _
  rw [dotQ_crossQ_cyclic, dotQ_comm, dotQ_sub_right]

name: cert_area
statement:
theorem cert_area {nt u v : Point} {ct : ℚ} (hnt : nt ≠ 0) (hct : ct ≠ 0)
    (hu : dotQ nt u = ct) (hv : dotQ nt v = ct) (huv : u ≠ v) :
    ct • crossQ nt (v - u) - dotQ (crossQ nt (v - u)) u • nt ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  intro hzero
  
  have hperp : dotQ (crossQ nt (v - u)) nt = 0 :=
    Proof.SimImplCover.dotQ_crossQ_left nt (v - u)
  
  have hdot : ct * dotQ (crossQ nt (v - u)) nt
      - dotQ (crossQ nt (v - u)) u * dotQ nt nt = 0 := by
    rw [← dotQ_smul_sub_left, hzero]
    simp [dotQ]
  rw [hperp, mul_zero] at hdot
  have hb : dotQ (crossQ nt (v - u)) u = 0 := by
    rcases mul_eq_zero.mp (by linarith :
        dotQ (crossQ nt (v - u)) u * dotQ nt nt = 0) with h | h
    · exact h
    · exact absurd h (ne_of_gt (dotQ_self_pos hnt))
  
  rw [hb, zero_smul, sub_zero] at hzero
  have hcross : crossQ (v - u) nt = 0 := by
    rw [crossQ_anticomm, (smul_eq_zero.mp hzero).resolve_left hct, neg_zero]
  obtain ⟨t, ht⟩ := exists_smul_of_crossQ_eq_zero hnt hcross
  
  have horth : dotQ nt (v - u) = 0 := by
    rw [dotQ_sub_right, hu, hv, sub_self]
  rw [ht, Proof.MeshIntersectRay.dotQ_smul_right] at horth
  rcases mul_eq_zero.mp horth with h | h
  · rw [h, zero_smul] at ht
    exact (sub_ne_zero.mpr (Ne.symm huv)) ht
  · exact (ne_of_gt (dotQ_self_pos hnt)) h

name: pull_area
statement:
theorem pull_area {nt u v : Point} {ct : ℚ} (hnt : nt ≠ 0) (hct : ct ≠ 0)
    (hu : dotQ nt u = ct) (hv : dotQ nt v = ct) (huv : u ≠ v) :
    Excludes (fun Q => dotQ nt Q ≠ 0 →
      areaForm nt u v ((ct / dotQ nt Q) • Q) ≠ 0)
proof:
:= by
  refine (pull_aff (cert_area hnt hct hu hv huv)).mono ?_
  intro Q h hQ hzero
  apply h hQ
  rw [areaForm_affine_data] at hzero
  linarith [hzero]

name: mem_candidates_lt
statement:
theorem mem_candidates_lt {A B : Array FaceS} {i : ℕ} {j : Nat}
    (hj : j ∈ (candidates A B).getD i #[]) : j < B.size
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hi : i < (candidates A B).size
  · rw [arr_getD _ _ _ hi] at hj
    have hi' : i < A.size := by
      have : (candidates A B).size = A.size := Array.size_map ..
      omega
    unfold candidates at hj
    rw [Array.getElem_map] at hj
    have := Proof.BVH.boxQuery_mem_lt (B.map (fun g => boxToBVH (bboxOfFace g)))
      (boxToBVH (bboxOfFace (A[i]'hi'))) j hj
    rwa [Array.size_map] at this
  · simp only [Array.getD, dif_neg hi] at hj
    simp at hj

name: mem_planesForScoped_inv
proof:
:= by

  simp only at h
  split at h
  · rename_i box _

  · exact absurd h (by simp)

name: winding_meshChain_fin
statement:
theorem winding_meshChain_fin (m : Mesh) (Q : Point) :
    winding (meshChain m) Q
      = ∑ j : Fin m.size,
          orientSign (m[j]) * (if Q ∈ simplex (m[j]) then 1 else 0)
proof:
:= by
  rw [winding_meshChain_map, sum_map_eq_finSum,
    ← Fin.sum_congr' (fun j : Fin m.size =>
        orientSign (m[j]) * (if Q ∈ simplex (m[j]) then (1 : ℤ) else 0))
      (by rw [Array.length_toList] : m.toList.length = m.size)]
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro k _
  congr 1

name: carrier_not_subset_of_noncoplanar
statement:
theorem carrier_not_subset_of_noncoplanar {tA u : Triangle}
    (hdetA : detOrigin tA ≠ 0) (hdetU : detOrigin u ≠ 0)
    (hcop : coplanarPlane (faceSOf u).plane (faceSOf tA).plane = false) :
    ∃ y, dotQ (carrierNormal tA) y = detOrigin tA
      ∧ dotQ (carrierNormal u) y ≠ detOrigin u
proof:
:= by
  have hmulA : IsMulOf (faceSOf tA).plane (carrierNormal tA) (detOrigin tA) :=
    isMulOf_faceSOf_plane tA
  have hmulU : IsMulOf (faceSOf u).plane (carrierNormal u) (detOrigin u) :=
    isMulOf_faceSOf_plane u
  have hntA : carrierNormal tA ≠ 0 := carrierNormal_ne_zero hdetA
  have hntU : carrierNormal u ≠ 0 := carrierNormal_ne_zero hdetU
  have hgN : iplaneN (faceSOf u).plane ≠ 0 := by
    obtain ⟨m, hm, hsm⟩ :=
      Proof.MeshIntersectRayClassifyF6Supply.iplaneN_eq_smul hmulU
    rw [hsm]
    exact smul_ne_zero (ne_of_gt hm) hntU
  
  obtain ⟨y, hyA, hyU⟩ :=
    Proof.MeshIntersectRayClassifyF6Supply.transverse_witness
      (g := (faceSOf u).plane) hntA hmulA hgN hcop
  refine ⟨y, hyA, ?_⟩
  
  obtain ⟨m, hm, hce⟩ := ce_iplane_of_mul hmulU
  rw [hce] at hyU
  have hyU' : ce (carrierNormal u) (detOrigin u) y ≠ 0 := by
    intro h0
    exact hyU (by rw [h0, mul_zero])
  intro heq
  apply hyU'
  simp only [ce, heq, sub_self]

name: cs_off_side_transverse
statement:
theorem cs_off_side_transverse {MA MB : Mesh} (_meshId : Nat) {i : ℕ}
    (hi : i < MA.size) (hdetA : detOrigin (MA[i]'hi) ≠ 0)
    {f : Frag}
    (hmem : f ∈ clipFaceScoped (fragOfFace ((materialize MA).getD i default))
      (planesForScoped ((materialize MA).getD i default).plane (materialize MB)
        ((candP MA MB).getD i #[])))
    {j : ℕ} (hj : j < MB.size) (hdetB : detOrigin (MB[j]'hj) ≠ 0)
    (htr : coplanarPlane (faceSOf (MB[j]'hj)).plane (faceSOf (MA[i]'hi)).plane
        = false) :
    vrelint (fragCycle f) ∩ triangleSet (MB[j]'hj) = ∅
proof:
:= by
  have hiA : i < (materialize MA).size := by simpa [materialize] using hi
  rw [arr_getD _ _ _ hiA, materialize_getElem MA i hi] at hmem
  have hf₀ := fragInv_base hdetA
  haveI := hf₀.neZero
  refine clipFaceScoped_vrelint_off_triangle hf₀ hmem
    (dotQ_carrierNormal_v₀ _) (dotQ_carrierNormal_v₁ _)
    (dotQ_carrierNormal_v₂ _) ?_ ?_
  · 
    by_cases hmeet : (triangleSet (MA[i]'hi) ∩ triangleSet (MB[j]'hj)).Nonempty
    · left
      obtain ⟨pg, hpg, hmul, hbox⟩ := Proof.MeshIntersectPrep.planesForScoped_of_meet_P hi hj hmeet
      rw [arr_getD _ _ _ hiA, materialize_getElem MA i hi] at hpg
      exact ⟨pg, hpg, hmul, hbox⟩
    · right
      rw [vpoly_fragOfFace]
      rw [Set.not_nonempty_iff_eq_empty] at hmeet
      exact hmeet
  · 
    by_contra hcon
    push_neg at hcon
    obtain ⟨y, hyA, hyU⟩ :=
      carrier_not_subset_of_noncoplanar hdetA hdetB htr
    apply hyU
    exact carrier_subset_of_cycle_on_plane hf₀.size3 hf₀.onPlane hf₀.strictConv
      (m := carrierNormal (MB[j]'hj)) (d := detOrigin (MB[j]'hj)) hcon hyA

name: nsiBoxes_getD
statement:
theorem nsiBoxes_getD (A : Array (FaceH × Box3)) (j : Nat) (hj : j < A.size) :

proof:

name: prepOf_bvh_eq
statement:
theorem prepOf_bvh_eq (M : Mesh) :
    (Impl.MeshIntersect.prepOf M).bvh
      = Impl.BVH.buildBVHM ((materialize M).map (fun fb => box3ToBVH fb.2))
proof:
:= by

      (Impl.MeshIntersect.prepare (Impl.MeshIntersect.materialize M))) = _

    Array.map_map]
