name: checkPre_iff
statement:
theorem checkPre_iff (A : Array (FaceH × Box3)) :
    checkNoSelfIntersectionPre (Impl.BVH.buildBVHM (A.map (fun fb => box3ToBVH fb.2))) A = true
      ↔ NsiP A
proof:
:= by
  simp only [checkNoSelfIntersectionPre]
  constructor
  · intro hall a b hab hb hovl
    rw [Array.all_eq_true_iff_forall_mem] at hall
    have ha : a ∈ Array.range A.size := by
      simp only [Array.mem_def, Array.toList_range, List.mem_range]; exact hab.trans hb
    have h1 := hall a ha
    rw [Array.all_eq_true_iff_forall_mem] at h1
    have hbq : b ∈ Impl.BVH.boxQuery (Impl.BVH.buildBVHM (A.map (fun fb => box3ToBVH fb.2)))
        (box3ToBVH (A.getD a default).2) := by
      apply CSG.Proof.BVH.boxQueryM_sound
      · rw [nsiBoxes_size]; exact hb
      · rw [nsiBoxes_getD A b hb, overlap_box3ToBVH]; exact hovl
    have h2 := h1 b hbq
    rw [show (decide (a < b) && boxesOverlap (A.getD a default).2 (A.getD b default).2) = true from
      by rw [hovl, Bool.and_true, decide_eq_true_eq]; exact hab] at h2
    simpa using h2
  · intro hP
    rw [Array.all_eq_true_iff_forall_mem]
    intro i _
    rw [Array.all_eq_true_iff_forall_mem]
    intro j hj
    by_cases hg : (decide (i < j) && boxesOverlap (A.getD i default).2 (A.getD j default).2) = true
    · rw [hg]
      simp only [Bool.not_true, Bool.false_or]
      rw [Bool.and_eq_true, decide_eq_true_eq] at hg
      have hjlt : j < A.size := by
        have h := CSG.Proof.BVH.boxQueryM_mem_lt _ _ _ hj
        rwa [nsiBoxes_size] at h
      exact hP i j hg.1 hjlt hg.2
    · rw [Bool.not_eq_true] at hg
      rw [hg]
      rfl

name: nsiCandidates_mem_overlap
statement:
theorem nsiCandidates_mem_overlap (A : Array (FaceH × Box3)) (a b : Nat)
    (hmem : (a, b) ∈ nsiCandidates A) :
    boxesOverlap (A.getD a default).2 (A.getD b default).2 = true
proof:
:= by
  unfold nsiCandidates at hmem
  rw [show Array.range A.size = (List.range A.size).toArray from by apply Array.ext'; simp]
    at hmem
  rw [Array.flatMap_toArray, Array.mem_def] at hmem
  simp only [Array.toList_toArray, List.mem_flatMap, List.mem_range, Array.toList_map,
    List.mem_map, Array.toList_filter, List.mem_filter] at hmem
  obtain ⟨i, _hi, j, ⟨⟨_hjmem, hcond⟩, heq⟩⟩ := hmem
  rw [Prod.mk.injEq] at heq
  obtain ⟨hia, hjb⟩ := heq
  subst hia; subst hjb
  rw [Bool.and_eq_true] at hcond
  simpa only [Array.getD_eq_get?] using hcond.2

name: checkOld_iff
statement:
theorem checkOld_iff (M : Mesh) :
    checkNoSelfIntersection M = true ↔ NsiP (materialize M)
proof:
:= by
  simp only [checkNoSelfIntersection]
  constructor
  · intro hall a b hab hb hovl
    rw [Array.all_eq_true_iff_forall_mem] at hall
    exact hall (a, b) (mem_nsiCandidates (materialize M) a b hab hb hovl)
  · intro hP
    rw [Array.all_eq_true_iff_forall_mem]
    intro ij hij
    obtain ⟨a, b⟩ := ij
    obtain ⟨hab, hb⟩ := nsiCandidates_mem_bound _ a b hij
    exact hP a b hab hb (nsiCandidates_mem_overlap _ a b hij)

name: paddS_psubS_left

proof:
:= by
  simp only [paddS, psubS, P3.mk.injEq]; refine ⟨by ring, by ring, by ring⟩

name: foldl_paddS_offset
statement:
theorem foldl_paddS_offset :
    ∀ (L : List Vtx) (x y : P3),
      L.foldl (fun acc v => paddS acc v.p) (psubS x y)
      = psubS (L.foldl (fun acc v => paddS acc v.p) x) y
  | [], x, y => rfl
  | v :: L, x, y => by
      show L.foldl (fun acc v => paddS acc v.p) (paddS (psubS x y) v.p)
        = psubS (L.foldl (fun acc v => paddS acc v.p) (paddS x v.p)) y
      rw [paddS_psubS_comm]
      exact foldl_paddS_offset L (paddS x v.p) y

/

name: foldl_paddS_map_trVtx
statement:
theorem foldl_paddS_map_trVtx (o : P3) :
    ∀ (L : List Vtx) (s : P3),
      (L.map (trVtx o)).foldl (fun acc v => paddS acc v.p) s
      = psubS (L.foldl (fun acc v => paddS acc v.p) s) (smulS (L.length : Rat) o)
  | [], s => by simp only [List.map_nil, List.foldl_nil, List.length_nil, Nat.cast_zero,
      smulS_zero, psubS_zero]
  | v :: L, s => by
      show (L.map (trVtx o)).foldl (fun acc v => paddS acc v.p) (paddS s (psubS v.p o)) = _
      rw [foldl_paddS_map_trVtx o L (paddS s (psubS v.p o)), paddS_psubS_left,
          foldl_paddS_offset L (paddS s v.p) o]
      simp only [List.foldl_cons, List.length_cons, psubS, smulS, P3.mk.injEq]
      push_cast
      refine ⟨by ring, by ring, by ring⟩

/

name: fragCentroid_tr
statement:
theorem fragCentroid_tr (o : P3) (f : Frag) (hpos : 0 < f.poly.size) :
    fragCentroid (trFrag o f) = psubS (fragCentroid f) o
proof:
:= by
  have hsum : (f.poly.map (trVtx o)).foldl (fun acc v => paddS acc v.p) ⟨0, 0, 0⟩
      = psubS (f.poly.foldl (fun acc v => paddS acc v.p) ⟨0, 0, 0⟩)
              (smulS (f.poly.size : Rat) o) := by
    rw [← Array.foldl_toList, Array.toList_map, foldl_paddS_map_trVtx, Array.foldl_toList]
  simp only [fragCentroid, trFrag_poly]
  rw [hsum, Array.size_map]
  set S : P3 := f.poly.foldl (fun acc v => paddS acc v.p) ⟨0, 0, 0⟩ with hS
  have hne : (f.poly.size : Rat) ≠ 0 := by positivity
  simp only [smulS, psubS, P3.mk.injEq]
  refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_⟩ <;> field_simp

name: fragCentroidH_repr_tr
statement:
theorem fragCentroidH_repr_tr (o : P3) (f : Frag) (hpos : 0 < f.poly.size)
    (hf : FragFaithful f) :
    MeshIntersectWedge.H4Repr (fragCentroidH f) (fragCentroid f) ∧
    MeshIntersectWedge.H4Repr (fragCentroidH (trFrag o f)) (psubS (fragCentroid f) o)
proof:
:= by
  have hne : f.poly.size ≠ 0 := Nat.pos_iff_ne_zero.mp hpos
  have hne' : (trFrag o f).poly.size ≠ 0 := by
    rw [trFrag_poly, Array.size_map]; exact hne
  refine ⟨MeshIntersectWedge.fragCentroidH_repr hne (fragMirrors_of_faithful hf), ?_⟩
  have h := MeshIntersectWedge.fragCentroidH_repr hne' (fragMirrors_trFrag o f)

name: list_filter_map_congr
statement:
theorem list_filter_map_congr {α β} (g : α → β) (p : α → Bool) (q : β → Bool) :
    ∀ (l : List α), (∀ x ∈ l, q (g x) = p x) →
    (l.map g).filter q = (l.filter p).map g
  | [], _ => rfl
  | a :: as, h => by
      have ha : q (g a) = p a
proof:
:= h a (List.mem_cons_self a as)
      have has := list_filter_map_congr g p q as (fun x hx => h x (List.mem_cons_of_mem a hx))
      simp only [List.map_cons, List.filter_cons, ha]
      cases hp : p a <;> simp [has]

name: filter_map_congr
statement:
theorem filter_map_congr {α β} (g : α → β) (p : α → Bool) (q : β → Bool) (l : Array α)
    (h : ∀ x ∈ l, q (g x) = p x) :
    (l.map g).filter q = (l.filter p).map g
proof:
:= by
  apply Array.ext'
  rw [Array.toList_filter, Array.toList_map, Array.toList_map, Array.toList_filter]
  apply list_filter_map_congr
  intro x hx
  exact h x (Array.mem_toList.mp hx)

name: admissible_perturb
statement:
theorem admissible_perturb {W : Mesh} (hnpo : Legacy.NoPlaneThroughOrigin W)
    {Q d : Point} (hQ : G1Clean W Q) (hadm : AdmissibleRay W Q d) :
    ∃ d' : Point,
      d' ≠ 0 ∧
      (∀ u : Fin W.size, dotQ (Proof.MeshIntersectJump.faceNormal W[u]) d' ≠ 0) ∧
      (∀ (j : Fin W.size) (k : Fin 4), dotQ (slot W[j] k).n d' ≠ 0) ∧
      (∀ (j : Fin W.size), ∀ g ∈ tetraHalves W[j], ∀ g' ∈ tetraHalves W[j],
        g ≠ g' → ∀ t : ℚ, ¬ (g.eval (lineAt Q d' t) = 0 ∧ g'.eval (lineAt Q d' t) = 0)) ∧
      (∀ (u : Fin W.size) (t : ℚ), t ≠ 0 → lineAt Q d' t ∉ edgeSet W[u]) ∧
      (∀ θ : ℚ, 0 ≤ θ → θ ≤ 1 → (fun i => (1 - θ) * d i + θ * d' i) ≠ 0) ∧
      (∀ θ : ℚ, 0 ≤ θ → θ ≤ 1 → ∀ u : Fin W.size, ∀ s : ℚ, 0 < s →
        lineAt Q (fun i => (1 - θ) * d i + θ * d' i) s ∉ edgeSet W[u])
proof:
:= by
  classical
  obtain ⟨hd_ne, hd_clean⟩ := hadm
  have hdd : 0 < dotQ d d := Proof.MeshIntersectRay.dotQ_self_pos hd_ne
  have hP_he_ne : ∀ (u : Fin W.size) (k : Fin 3),
      crossQ (psub (edgeTail W[u] k) Q) (psub (edgeHead W[u] k) Q) ≠ 0 :=
    fun u k => he_ne_of_G1Clean hnpo hQ u k
  have hG1 : ∀ (j : Fin W.size) (k : Fin 4), (slot W[j] k).eval Q ≠ 0 :=
    fun j k => hQ j (slot W[j] k) (slot_mem _ _)
  
  obtain ⟨d', hdall⟩ := side_dense_dir' d
    (Sum.elim (fun u : Fin W.size => Proof.MeshIntersectJump.faceNormal W[u])
      (Sum.elim (fun jk : Fin W.size × Fin 4 => (slot W[jk.1] jk.2).n)
        (Sum.elim (fun t : Fin W.size × Fin 4 × Fin 4 =>
            if t.2.1 = t.2.2 then d
            else (slot W[t.1] t.2.1).eval Q • (slot W[t.1] t.2.2).n
              - (slot W[t.1] t.2.2).eval Q • (slot W[t.1] t.2.1).n)
          (Sum.elim
            (fun uk : Fin W.size × Fin 3 =>
              crossQ (psub (edgeTail W[uk.1] uk.2) Q) (psub (edgeHead W[uk.1] uk.2) Q))
            (fun _ : Unit => d)))))
    (by
      rintro (u | ⟨j, k⟩ | ⟨j, k, k'⟩ | ⟨u, k⟩ | _)
      · simp only [Sum.elim_inl]; exact faceNormal_ne_zero (hnpo u)
      · simp only [Sum.elim_inl, Sum.elim_inr]; exact facet_n_ne_zero (hnpo j) _ (slot_mem _ _)
      · simp only [Sum.elim_inl, Sum.elim_inr]
        split_ifs with hkk
        · exact hd_ne
        · exact resultant_ne (hnpo j) hkk (hG1 j k) (hG1 j k')
      · simp only [Sum.elim_inl, Sum.elim_inr]; exact hP_he_ne u k
      · simp only [Sum.elim_inr]; exact hd_ne)
  
  have hφ := hdall (Sum.inr (Sum.inr (Sum.inr (Sum.inr ()))))
  simp only [Sum.elim_inr] at hφ
  have hdd' : 0 < dotQ d d' := by
    have hmul := hφ.2 (ne_of_gt hdd)
    by_contra h; push_neg at h
    exact absurd hmul (not_lt.mpr (mul_nonpos_of_nonneg_of_nonpos hdd.le h))
  have hd'ne : d' ≠ 0 := by
    intro h; apply hφ.1; rw [h]; exact Proof.MeshIntersectClip.dotQ_zero_right d
  
  refine ⟨d', hd'ne,
    fun u => by have := (hdall (Sum.inl u)).1; simpa only [Sum.elim_inl] using this,
    fun j k => by
      have := (hdall (Sum.inr (Sum.inl (j, k)))).1
      simpa only [Sum.elim_inl, Sum.elim_inr] using this,
    ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · 
    intro j g hg g' hg' hne t ht
    obtain ⟨k, rfl⟩ := mem_tetraHalves_iff.mp hg
    obtain ⟨k', rfl⟩ := mem_tetraHalves_iff.mp hg'
    have hkk : k ≠ k' := fun h => hne (by rw [h])
    obtain ⟨he1, he2⟩ := ht
    have hres := (hdall (Sum.inr (Sum.inr (Sum.inl (j, k, k'))))).1
    simp only [Sum.elim_inl, Sum.elim_inr, if_neg hkk] at hres
    rw [eval_lineAt] at he1 he2
    apply hres
    rw [dotQ_resultant]
    linear_combination (dotQ (slot W[j] k').n d') * he1 - (dotQ (slot W[j] k).n d') * he2
  · 
    intro u t ht hmem
    rw [edgeSet_eq_iUnion] at hmem
    simp only [Set.mem_iUnion] at hmem
    obtain ⟨k, hk⟩ := hmem
    have hhe := (hdall (Sum.inr (Sum.inr (Sum.inr (Sum.inl (u, k)))))).1
    simp only [Sum.elim_inl, Sum.elim_inr] at hhe
    exact no_graze_from_P ht hhe hk
  · 
    intro θ hθ0 hθ1 h
    have hdotθ : dotQ d (fun i => (1 - θ) * d i + θ * d' i)
        = (1 - θ) * dotQ d d + θ * dotQ d d' := by simp only [dotQ]; ring
    have hpos : 0 < dotQ d (fun i => (1 - θ) * d i + θ * d' i) := by
      rw [hdotθ]; exact interp_pos hdd hdd' hθ0 hθ1
    rw [h, Proof.MeshIntersectClip.dotQ_zero_right] at hpos
    exact lt_irrefl 0 hpos
  · 
    intro θ hθ0 hθ1 u s hs hmem
    rcases eq_or_lt_of_le hθ0 with hθ | hθ
    · 
      have hdθ0 : (fun i => (1 - θ) * d i + θ * d' i) = d := by
        rw [← hθ]; funext i; ring
      rw [hdθ0] at hmem
      exact hd_clean u s hs (by rw [lineAt_eq]; exact hmem)
    · rw [edgeSet_eq_iUnion] at hmem
      simp only [Set.mem_iUnion] at hmem
      obtain ⟨k, hk⟩ := hmem
      refine no_graze_from_P hs.ne' ?_ hk
      have hheP := hdall (Sum.inr (Sum.inr (Sum.inr (Sum.inl (u, k)))))
      simp only [Sum.elim_inl, Sum.elim_inr] at hheP
      have hlin : dotQ (crossQ (psub (edgeTail W[u] k) Q) (psub (edgeHead W[u] k) Q))
            (fun i => (1 - θ) * d i + θ * d' i)
          = (1 - θ) * dotQ (crossQ (psub (edgeTail W[u] k) Q) (psub (edgeHead W[u] k) Q)) d
            + θ * dotQ (crossQ (psub (edgeTail W[u] k) Q) (psub (edgeHead W[u] k) Q)) d' := by
        simp only [dotQ]; ring
      rw [hlin]
      by_cases hd0 : dotQ (crossQ (psub (edgeTail W[u] k) Q) (psub (edgeHead W[u] k) Q)) d = 0
      · rw [hd0]; simp only [mul_zero, zero_add]
        exact mul_ne_zero hθ.ne' hheP.1
      · exact interp_ne (hheP.2 hd0) hθ0 hθ1

name: crossingCount_eq_winding_core
statement:
theorem crossingCount_eq_winding_core {W : Mesh} (hcyc : IsClosedOrientedSurface W)
    (hnpo : Legacy.NoPlaneThroughOrigin W) (hns : NoFaceInteriorContact W)
    {Q : Point} (hQ : G1Clean W Q) {d : Point} (hadm : AdmissibleRay W Q d) :
    crossingCount W Q d = Chains.winding (Legacy.meshChain W) Q
proof:
:= by
  
  rw [Proof.MeshIntersectM2Kit.crossingCount_eq_rayCount]
  
  have hedge_d : ∀ (u : Fin W.size) (t : ℚ), 0 < t → lineAt Q d t ∉ edgeSet W[u] := by
    intro u t ht
    have := hadm.2 u t ht
    rwa [lineAt_eq] at this
  rw [Proof.MeshIntersectM2Kit.rayCount_eq_RayCount' W Q d hedge_d]
  
  obtain ⟨d', hd'ne, hdN, hdA, hG2line, hnoedge, hdθ, hedge_arc⟩ :=
    admissible_perturb hnpo hQ hadm
  
  have hoffc : ∀ u : Fin W.size,
      dotQ (Proof.MeshIntersectJump.faceNormal W[u]) Q ≠ Legacy.detOrigin W[u] :=
    fun u => sub_ne_zero.mp (clean_off_carrier hnpo hQ u)
  rw [rayCount_local_const_dir hnpo hoffc hdθ hedge_arc]
  
  exact (raycount_eq_winding hcyc hnpo hns hQ hd'ne hdN hdA hG2line hnoedge).symm

name: crossingCount_eq_winding
statement:
theorem crossingCount_eq_winding {M : Mesh} (hcyc : IsClosedOrientedSurface M) (hns : NoFaceInteriorContact M)
    {O : Point} (hO : Legacy.NoPlaneThroughOrigin (trMesh O M))
    {Q : Point} (hQ : G1Clean (trMesh O M) (trPoint O Q))
    {d : Point} (hadm : AdmissibleRay M Q d) :
    crossingCount M Q d = Chains.winding (Legacy.meshChain (trMesh O M)) (trPoint O Q)
proof:
:= by
  have hcyc' : IsClosedOrientedSurface (trMesh O M) := (isCycle_trMesh_iff O M).mpr hcyc
  have hns' : NoFaceInteriorContact (trMesh O M) := (noSelfIntersection_trMesh_iff O M).mpr hns
  have hadm' : AdmissibleRay (trMesh O M) (trPoint O Q) d := (admissible_trMesh_iff O M Q d).mpr hadm
  rw [← crossingCount_trMesh O M Q d]
  exact crossingCount_eq_winding_core hcyc' hO hns' hQ hadm'

name: trPoint_trPoint_neg
statement: theorem trPoint_trPoint_neg (O y : Point) : trPoint O (trPoint (-O) y) = y
proof:
:= by
  funext i; simp only [trPoint, Pi.neg_apply]; ring

name: eqOffPlanes_solid_core
statement:
theorem eqOffPlanes_solid_core {W : Mesh} (hcyc : IsClosedOrientedSurface W)
    (hnpo : Legacy.NoPlaneThroughOrigin W) (hns : NoFaceInteriorContact W) :
    EqOffPlanes (solid W) (Chains.solid (Legacy.meshChain W))
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨{x | ¬ G1Clean W x}, negligible_unclean W hnpo, ?_⟩
  intro Q hQ
  by_contra hcon
  simp only [Set.mem_setOf_eq, not_not] at hcon
  obtain ⟨d₀, hadm₀⟩ := exists_admissible W Q
  have hequiv : Q ∈ solid W ↔ Q ∈ Chains.solid (Legacy.meshChain W) := by
    constructor
    · intro hsol
      have hcc := hsol d₀ hadm₀
      rw [crossingCount_eq_winding_core hcyc hnpo hns hcon hadm₀] at hcc
      exact hcc
    · intro hsol d hadm
      rw [crossingCount_eq_winding_core hcyc hnpo hns hcon hadm]
      exact hsol
  rcases hQ with ⟨h1, h2⟩ | ⟨h1, h2⟩
  · exact h2 (hequiv.mp h1)
  · exact h2 (hequiv.mpr h1)

name: mem_solid_trMesh
statement:
theorem mem_solid_trMesh (O : Point) (M : Mesh) (Q : Point) :
    trPoint O Q ∈ solid (trMesh O M) ↔ Q ∈ solid M
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro hy d hadm
    have hadm' : AdmissibleRay (trMesh O M) (trPoint O Q) d := (admissible_trMesh_iff O M Q d).mpr hadm
    have := hy d hadm'
    rwa [crossingCount_trMesh] at this
  · intro hy d hadm
    rw [crossingCount_trMesh]
    exact hy d ((admissible_trMesh_iff O M Q d).mp hadm)

name: solid_trMesh
statement: theorem solid_trMesh (O : Point) (M : Mesh) : solid (trMesh O M) = trPoint O '' solid M
proof:
:= by
  ext y
  simp only [Set.mem_image]
  constructor
  · intro hy
    exact ⟨trPoint (-O) y, (mem_solid_trMesh O M (trPoint (-O) y)).mp
      (by rwa [trPoint_trPoint_neg]), trPoint_trPoint_neg O y⟩
  · rintro ⟨Q, hQ, rfl⟩
    exact (mem_solid_trMesh O M Q).mpr hQ

name: T_solid
statement:
theorem T_solid {M : Mesh} (hcyc : IsClosedOrientedSurface M) (hns : NoFaceInteriorContact M)
    {O : Point} (hO : Legacy.NoPlaneThroughOrigin (trMesh O M)) :
    EqOffPlanes (solid M) (trPoint (-O) '' Chains.solid (Legacy.meshChain (trMesh O M)))
proof:
:= by
  have hcore := eqOffPlanes_solid_core (isCycle_trMesh_iff O M |>.mpr hcyc) hO
    (noSelfIntersection_trMesh_iff O M |>.mpr hns)
  rw [solid_trMesh] at hcore
  have h := eqOffPlanes_image (-O) hcore
  rwa [trPoint_image_image] at h

name: normal_iff_core_offPlanes
statement:
theorem normal_iff_core_offPlanes {W : Mesh} (hcyc : IsClosedOrientedSurface W)
    (hnpo : Legacy.NoPlaneThroughOrigin W) (hns : NoFaceInteriorContact W) :
    Proof.Negligible.WindingZeroOrOneOffPlanes W ↔ Chains.Normal (Legacy.meshChain W)
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨N, hNneg, hN⟩
    refine ⟨N ∪ {x | ¬ G1Clean W x},
      Proof.Negligible.negligible_union hNneg (negligible_unclean W hnpo), ?_⟩
    intro Q hQ
    simp only [Set.mem_union, not_or, Set.mem_setOf_eq, not_not] at hQ
    obtain ⟨hQN, hQclean⟩ := hQ
    obtain ⟨d₀, hadm₀⟩ := exists_admissible W Q
    have := hN Q hQN d₀ hadm₀
    rwa [crossingCount_eq_winding_core hcyc hnpo hns hQclean hadm₀] at this
  · rintro ⟨N, hNneg, hN⟩
    refine ⟨N ∪ {x | ¬ G1Clean W x},
      Proof.Negligible.negligible_union hNneg (negligible_unclean W hnpo), ?_⟩
    intro Q hQ d hadm
    simp only [Set.mem_union, not_or, Set.mem_setOf_eq, not_not] at hQ
    obtain ⟨hQN, hQclean⟩ := hQ
    rw [crossingCount_eq_winding_core hcyc hnpo hns hQclean hadm]
    exact hN Q hQN

name: normal_trMesh_iff_offPlanes
statement:
theorem normal_trMesh_iff_offPlanes (O : Point) (M : Mesh) :
    Proof.Negligible.WindingZeroOrOneOffPlanes (trMesh O M)
      ↔ Proof.Negligible.WindingZeroOrOneOffPlanes M
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨N, hNneg, hN⟩
    refine ⟨trPoint (-O) '' N, negligible_image (-O) hNneg, ?_⟩
    intro Q hQ d hadm
    have hyN : trPoint O Q ∉ N := fun hmem =>
      hQ ⟨trPoint O Q, hmem, trPoint_neg_trPoint O Q⟩
    have := hN (trPoint O Q) hyN d ((admissible_trMesh_iff O M Q d).mpr hadm)
    rwa [crossingCount_trMesh] at this
  · rintro ⟨N, hNneg, hN⟩
    refine ⟨trPoint O '' N, negligible_image O hNneg, ?_⟩
    intro y hy d hadm
    have hQN : trPoint (-O) y ∉ N := fun hmem =>
      hy ⟨trPoint (-O) y, hmem, trPoint_trPoint_neg O y⟩
    have hyeq : y = trPoint O (trPoint (-O) y) := (trPoint_trPoint_neg O y).symm
    have hadmM : AdmissibleRay M (trPoint (-O) y) d := by
      apply (admissible_trMesh_iff O M (trPoint (-O) y) d).mp
      rw [← hyeq]; exact hadm
    have := hN (trPoint (-O) y) hQN d hadmM
    rw [← crossingCount_trMesh O M (trPoint (-O) y) d, ← hyeq] at this
    exact this

name: T_normal_offPlanes
statement:
theorem T_normal_offPlanes {M : Mesh} (hcyc : IsClosedOrientedSurface M) (hns : NoFaceInteriorContact M)
    {O : Point} (hO : Legacy.NoPlaneThroughOrigin (trMesh O M)) :
    Proof.Negligible.WindingZeroOrOneOffPlanes M ↔ Chains.Normal (Legacy.meshChain (trMesh O M))
proof:
:= by
  rw [← normal_trMesh_iff_offPlanes O M]
  exact normal_iff_core_offPlanes (isCycle_trMesh_iff O M |>.mpr hcyc) hO
    (noSelfIntersection_trMesh_iff O M |>.mpr hns)

name: affOf_apply
statement:
@[simp] theorem affOf_apply (m : Point) (b : ℚ) (P : Point) :
    affOf m b P = dot m P + b
proof: := rfl

name: dot_add_right
statement: theorem dot_add_right (a x y : Point) : dot a (x + y) = dot a x + dot a y
proof:
:= by
  simp only [dot, Fin.sum_univ_three, Pi.add_apply]; ring

name: dot_smul_right
statement:
theorem dot_smul_right (a : Point) (s : ℚ) (x : Point) :
    dot a (s • x) = s * dot a x
proof:
:= by
  simp only [dot, Fin.sum_univ_three, Pi.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul]; ring

name: dot_sub_right
statement: theorem dot_sub_right (a x y : Point) : dot a (x - y) = dot a x - dot a y
proof:
:= by
  simp only [dot, Fin.sum_univ_three, Pi.sub_apply]; ring

name: dot_line
statement:
theorem dot_line (n Q d : Point) (s : ℚ) :
    dot n (Q + s • d) = dot n Q + s * dot n d
proof:
:= by
  rw [dot_add_right, dot_smul_right]

name: cOf_eq_detOrigin
statement: theorem cOf_eq_detOrigin (t : Triangle) : cOf t = CSG.Legacy.detOrigin t
proof:
:= by
  rw [cOf, dot_eq_dotQ, faceNormal_eq, Proof.MeshIntersectJump.faceNormal_offset]

name: carrier_v0
statement: theorem carrier_v0 (t : Triangle) : dot (faceNormal t) t.v₀ = cOf t
proof: := rfl

name: carrier_v1
statement: theorem carrier_v1 (t : Triangle) : dot (faceNormal t) t.v₁ = cOf t
proof:
:= by
  rw [cOf, dot_eq_dotQ, dot_eq_dotQ, faceNormal_eq,
    Proof.MeshIntersectRayClassify.dotQ_faceNormal_v1,
    Proof.MeshIntersectJump.faceNormal_offset]

name: carrier_v2
statement: theorem carrier_v2 (t : Triangle) : dot (faceNormal t) t.v₂ = cOf t
proof:
:= by
  rw [cOf, dot_eq_dotQ, dot_eq_dotQ, faceNormal_eq,
    Proof.MeshIntersectRayClassify.dotQ_faceNormal_v2,
    Proof.MeshIntersectJump.faceNormal_offset]

name: triangleSet_carrier
statement:
theorem triangleSet_carrier {t : Triangle} {x : Point} (hx : x ∈ triangleSet t) :
    dot (faceNormal t) x = cOf t
proof:
:= by
  rw [dot_eq_dotQ, faceNormal_eq, cOf_eq_detOrigin]
  exact Proof.MeshIntersectRayClassify.triangleSet_on_carrier hx

name: dot_line_eq_iff
statement:
theorem dot_line_eq_iff {t : Triangle} {d : Point} (hnd : dot (faceNormal t) d ≠ 0)
    (P : Point) (s : ℚ) :
    dot (faceNormal t) (P + s • d) = cOf t ↔ s = sStar t d P
proof:
:= by
  rw [dot_line, sStar]
  constructor
  · intro h
    field_simp
    linarith
  · intro h; rw [h]; field_simp

name: hitPt_on_carrier
statement:
theorem hitPt_on_carrier {t : Triangle} {d : Point} (hnd : dot (faceNormal t) d ≠ 0)
    (P : Point) : dot (faceNormal t) (hitPt t d P) = cOf t
proof:
:=
  (dot_line_eq_iff hnd P (sStar t d P)).mpr rfl

name: rayHits_iff
statement:
theorem rayHits_iff {t : Triangle} {d : Point} (hnd : dot (faceNormal t) d ≠ 0)
    (P : Point) :
    RayHits P d t ↔ 0 < sStar t d P ∧ hitPt t d P ∈ triangleSet t
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨s, hs, hmem⟩
    have hcar : dot (faceNormal t) (P + s • d) = cOf t := triangleSet_carrier hmem
    have hseq : s = sStar t d P := (dot_line_eq_iff hnd P s).mp hcar
    subst hseq
    exact ⟨hs, hmem⟩
  · rintro ⟨hpos, hmem⟩
    exact ⟨sStar t d P, hpos, hmem⟩

name: Nt_pos
statement: theorem Nt_pos {t : Triangle} (hn : faceNormal t ≠ 0) : 0 < Nt t
proof:
:= by
  rw [Nt, dot_eq_dotQ]; exact Proof.MeshIntersectRay.dotQ_self_pos hn

name: Nt_eq
statement:
theorem Nt_eq (t : Triangle) :
    Nt t = dotQ (Proof.MeshIntersectJump.faceNormal t)
      (Proof.MeshIntersectJump.faceNormal t)
proof:
:= by
  rw [Nt, dot_eq_dotQ, faceNormal_eq]

name: carrier_repr'
statement:
theorem carrier_repr' {t : Triangle} {P : Point} (hn : faceNormal t ≠ 0)
    (hP : dot (faceNormal t) P = cOf t) :
    P = (ee1 t P / Nt t) • t.v₀ + (ee2 t P / Nt t) • t.v₁
      + (ee0 t P / Nt t) • t.v₂
proof:
:= by
  rw [Nt_eq]
  set N := dotQ (Proof.MeshIntersectJump.faceNormal t)
    (Proof.MeshIntersectJump.faceNormal t) with hNdef
  have hNne : N ≠ 0 := by rw [hNdef, ← Nt_eq]; exact (Nt_pos hn).ne'
  have hoff : dotQ (Proof.MeshIntersectJump.faceNormal t)
      (psub P t.v₀) = 0 := by
    rw [dotQ_faceNormal_sub_v0]
    rw [← faceNormal_eq, ← dot_eq_dotQ, hP, cOf_eq_detOrigin]; ring
  have hkey := e_decomp t P
  rw [hoff, zero_smul, add_zero] at hkey
  have he : ∀ e : ℚ, N * (e / N) = e := fun e => by
    rw [← mul_div_assoc, mul_comm, mul_div_assoc, div_self hNne, mul_one]
  apply smul_right_injective (Fin 3 → ℚ) hNne
  show N • P = N • ((ee1 t P / N) • t.v₀ + (ee2 t P / N) • t.v₁ + (ee0 t P / N) • t.v₂)
  rw [hkey, smul_add, smul_add, smul_smul, smul_smul, smul_smul, he, he, he]

name: ee_nonneg_of_mem
statement:
theorem ee_nonneg_of_mem {t : Triangle} {P : Point} (hP : P ∈ triangleSet t) :
    0 ≤ ee0 t P ∧ 0 ≤ ee1 t P ∧ 0 ≤ ee2 t P
proof:
:=
  ee_nonneg_of_mem_triangleSet hP

name: mem_triangleSet_of_carrier'
statement:
theorem mem_triangleSet_of_carrier' {t : Triangle} {P : Point} (hn : faceNormal t ≠ 0)
    (hP : dot (faceNormal t) P = cOf t)
    (h0 : 0 ≤ ee0 t P) (h1 : 0 ≤ ee1 t P) (h2 : 0 ≤ ee2 t P) :
    P ∈ triangleSet t
proof:
:= by
  have hNpos : 0 < Nt t := Nt_pos hn
  have hrepr := carrier_repr' hn hP
  rw [hrepr]
  refine mem_convexHull_triple (div_nonneg h1 hNpos.le) (div_nonneg h2 hNpos.le)
    (div_nonneg h0 hNpos.le) ?_ t.v₀ t.v₁ t.v₂
  rw [div_add_div_same, div_add_div_same,
    show ee1 t P + ee2 t P + ee0 t P = Nt t from by
      rw [Nt_eq]; linarith [e_sum t P]]
  exact div_self hNpos.ne'

name: mem_edgeSet_of_carrier'
statement:
theorem mem_edgeSet_of_carrier' {t : Triangle} {P : Point} (hn : faceNormal t ≠ 0)
    (hP : dot (faceNormal t) P = cOf t)
    (h0 : 0 ≤ ee0 t P) (h1 : 0 ≤ ee1 t P) (h2 : 0 ≤ ee2 t P)
    (hz : ee0 t P = 0 ∨ ee1 t P = 0 ∨ ee2 t P = 0) :
    P ∈ edgeSet t
proof:
:= by
  have hNpos : 0 < Nt t := Nt_pos hn
  have hrepr := carrier_repr' hn hP
  have hsum : ee0 t P + ee1 t P + ee2 t P = Nt t := by rw [Nt_eq]; exact e_sum t P
  set N := Nt t with hN
  simp only [edgeSet, Set.mem_union, segment, Set.mem_setOf_eq]
  rcases hz with hz0 | hz1 | hz2
  · rw [hz0, zero_div, zero_smul, add_zero] at hrepr
    refine Or.inl (Or.inl ⟨ee1 t P / N, ee2 t P / N, div_nonneg h1 hNpos.le,
      div_nonneg h2 hNpos.le, ?_, hrepr.symm⟩)
    rw [div_add_div_same, show ee1 t P + ee2 t P = N from by linarith]
    exact div_self hNpos.ne'
  · rw [hz1, zero_div, zero_smul, zero_add] at hrepr
    refine Or.inl (Or.inr ⟨ee2 t P / N, ee0 t P / N, div_nonneg h2 hNpos.le,
      div_nonneg h0 hNpos.le, ?_, hrepr.symm⟩)
    rw [div_add_div_same, show ee2 t P + ee0 t P = N from by linarith]
    exact div_self hNpos.ne'
  · rw [hz2, zero_div, zero_smul, add_zero] at hrepr
    refine Or.inr ⟨ee0 t P / N, ee1 t P / N, div_nonneg h0 hNpos.le,
      div_nonneg h1 hNpos.le, ?_, ?_⟩
    · rw [div_add_div_same, show ee0 t P + ee1 t P = N from by linarith]
      exact div_self hNpos.ne'
    · rw [add_comm]; exact hrepr.symm

name: mem_triangleSet_not_edge_of_carrier'
statement:
theorem mem_triangleSet_not_edge_of_carrier' {t : Triangle} {P : Point}
    (hn : faceNormal t ≠ 0) (hP : dot (faceNormal t) P = cOf t)
    (h0 : 0 < ee0 t P) (h1 : 0 < ee1 t P) (h2 : 0 < ee2 t P) :
    P ∈ triangleSet t ∧ P ∉ edgeSet t
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨mem_triangleSet_of_carrier' hn hP h0.le h1.le h2.le, ?_⟩
  intro hedge
  rcases ee_zero_of_mem_edgeSet hedge with hz | hz | hz
  · exact absurd hz h0.ne'
  · exact absurd hz h1.ne'
  · exact absurd hz h2.ne'

name: ee_pos_of_mem_not_edge
statement:
theorem ee_pos_of_mem_not_edge {t : Triangle} {P : Point} (hn : faceNormal t ≠ 0)
    (hmem : P ∈ triangleSet t) (hne : P ∉ edgeSet t) :
    0 < ee0 t P ∧ 0 < ee1 t P ∧ 0 < ee2 t P
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨h0, h1, h2⟩ := ee_nonneg_of_mem hmem
  have hcar : dot (faceNormal t) P = cOf t := triangleSet_carrier hmem
  refine ⟨h0.lt_of_ne ?_, h1.lt_of_ne ?_, h2.lt_of_ne ?_⟩ <;>
    (intro hz; exact hne
      (mem_edgeSet_of_carrier' hn hcar h0 h1 h2 (by tauto)))

name: convexHull_insert_mem
statement:
theorem convexHull_insert_mem {s : Set Point} {x : Point} (hx : x ∈ convexHull ℚ s) :
    convexHull ℚ (insert x s) = convexHull ℚ s
proof:
:= by
  apply subset_antisymm
  · apply convexHull_min _ (convex_convexHull ℚ s)
    intro y hy
    rcases hy with rfl | hy
    · exact hx
    · exact subset_convexHull ℚ s hy
  · exact convexHull_mono (Set.subset_insert x s)

name: triangleSet_subset_seg_of_between
proof:
:= by

  rw [convexHull_insert_mem (by rw [convexHull_pair]; exact hbetween), convexHull_pair]

name: seg_v_subset_edgeSet
statement:
theorem seg_v_subset_edgeSet (t : Triangle) :
    segment ℚ t.v₀ t.v₁ ⊆ edgeSet t ∧ segment ℚ t.v₁ t.v₀ ⊆ edgeSet t ∧
    segment ℚ t.v₁ t.v₂ ⊆ edgeSet t ∧ segment ℚ t.v₂ t.v₁ ⊆ edgeSet t ∧
    segment ℚ t.v₂ t.v₀ ⊆ edgeSet t ∧ segment ℚ t.v₀ t.v₂ ⊆ edgeSet t
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨fun x hx => Or.inl (Or.inl hx), fun x hx => Or.inl (Or.inl ?_),
    fun x hx => Or.inl (Or.inr hx), fun x hx => Or.inl (Or.inr ?_),
    fun x hx => Or.inr hx, fun x hx => Or.inr ?_⟩
  · rwa [segment_symm]
  · rwa [segment_symm]
  · rwa [segment_symm]

name: triangleSet_subset_edgeSet_of_degen
statement:
theorem triangleSet_subset_edgeSet_of_degen {t : Triangle} (hdeg : faceNormal t = 0) :
    triangleSet t ⊆ edgeSet t
proof:
:= by
  have hcross : crossQ (psub t.v₁ t.v₀) (psub t.v₂ t.v₀) = 0 := by
    rw [← faceNormal_eq_cross]; exact hdeg
  obtain ⟨h01, h10, h12, h21, h20, h02⟩ := seg_v_subset_edgeSet t
  by_cases hv : psub t.v₂ t.v₀ = 0
  · 
    have hv2 : t.v₂ = t.v₀ := by
      funext i; have := congrFun hv i; simp only [psub, Pi.zero_apply] at this; linarith
    have hset : ({t.v₀, t.v₁, t.v₀} : Set Point) = ({t.v₀, t.v₁} : Set Point) := by
      ext y; simp only [Set.mem_insert_iff, Set.mem_singleton_iff]; tauto
    rw [triangleSet, hv2, hset, convexHull_pair]
    exact h01
  · obtain ⟨r, hr⟩ := exists_smul_of_crossQ_eq_zero hv hcross
    have hv1 : t.v₁ = (1 - r) • t.v₀ + r • t.v₂ := by
      funext i
      have := congrFun hr i
      simp only [psub, Pi.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul, Pi.sub_apply] at this
      simp only [Pi.add_apply, Pi.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul]
      linarith
    rcases lt_trichotomy r 0 with hrneg | hr0 | hrpos
    · 
      have h1r : 0 < 1 - r := by linarith
      have hmem0 : t.v₀ ∈ segment ℚ t.v₁ t.v₂ := by
        refine ⟨1 / (1 - r), (-r) / (1 - r), div_nonneg (by norm_num) h1r.le,
          div_nonneg (by linarith) h1r.le, ?_, ?_⟩
        · rw [div_add_div_same]; rw [div_eq_one_iff_eq h1r.ne']; ring
        · rw [hv1]; funext i
          simp only [Pi.add_apply, Pi.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul]
          field_simp
      have hset : ({t.v₀, t.v₁, t.v₂} : Set Point) = ({t.v₁, t.v₀, t.v₂} : Set Point) := by
        ext y; simp only [Set.mem_insert_iff]; tauto
      rw [triangleSet, hset]
      exact (triangleSet_subset_seg_of_between (a := t.v₁) (b := t.v₀) (c := t.v₂) hmem0).trans h12
    · 
      have hv1' : t.v₁ = t.v₀ := by rw [hv1, hr0]; simp
      have hset : ({t.v₀, t.v₀, t.v₂} : Set Point) = ({t.v₀, t.v₂} : Set Point) := by
        ext y; simp only [Set.mem_insert_iff, Set.mem_singleton_iff]; tauto
      rw [triangleSet, hv1', hset, convexHull_pair]
      exact h02
    · rcases le_or_lt r 1 with hle1 | hgt1
      · 
        have hmem1 : t.v₁ ∈ segment ℚ t.v₀ t.v₂ :=
          ⟨1 - r, r, by linarith, hrpos.le, by ring, by rw [hv1]⟩
        rw [triangleSet]
        exact (triangleSet_subset_seg_of_between (a := t.v₀) (b := t.v₁) (c := t.v₂) hmem1).trans h02
      · 
        have hmem2 : t.v₂ ∈ segment ℚ t.v₀ t.v₁ := by
          refine ⟨1 - 1 / r, 1 / r, ?_, by positivity, by ring, ?_⟩
          · have : 1 / r ≤ 1 := by rw [div_le_one hrpos]; linarith
            linarith
          · rw [hv1]; funext i
            simp only [Pi.add_apply, Pi.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul]
            field_simp; ring
        have hset : ({t.v₀, t.v₁, t.v₂} : Set Point) = ({t.v₀, t.v₂, t.v₁} : Set Point) := by
          ext y; simp only [Set.mem_insert_iff, Set.mem_singleton_iff]; tauto
        rw [triangleSet, hset]
        exact (triangleSet_subset_seg_of_between (a := t.v₀) (b := t.v₂) (c := t.v₁) hmem2).trans h01

name: seg_scalar_oneway
statement:
private theorem seg_scalar_oneway {n : ℕ} (a b : Fin n → ℚ)
    (NB : ∀ θ : ℚ, 0 ≤ θ → θ ≤ 1 →
      (∀ i, 0 ≤ (1 - θ) * a i + θ * b i) → (∀ i, 0 < (1 - θ) * a i + θ * b i))
    (ha : ∀ i, 0 < a i) : ∀ i, 0 < b i
proof:
:= by
  by_contra hcon
  push_neg at hcon
  obtain ⟨j₀, hj₀⟩ := hcon
  set J : Finset (Fin n) := Finset.univ.filter (fun i => b i ≤ 0) with hJdef
  have hj₀J : j₀ ∈ J := by rw [hJdef]; simp [hj₀]
  have hJne : J.Nonempty := ⟨j₀, hj₀J⟩
  set c : Fin n → ℚ := fun i => a i / (a i - b i) with hcdef
  have hdenpos : ∀ i ∈ J, 0 < a i - b i := by
    intro i hi
    rw [hJdef, Finset.mem_filter] at hi
    have := ha i; linarith [hi.2]
  have hczero : ∀ i ∈ J, (1 - c i) * a i + c i * b i = 0 := by
    intro i hi
    have hd := hdenpos i hi
    simp only [hcdef]
    field_simp
    ring
  have hcpos : ∀ i ∈ J, 0 < c i := by
    intro i hi
    exact div_pos (ha i) (hdenpos i hi)
  have hcle1 : ∀ i ∈ J, c i ≤ 1 := by
    intro i hi
    have hd := hdenpos i hi
    rw [hJdef, Finset.mem_filter] at hi
    rw [hcdef, div_le_one hd]; linarith [hi.2]
  obtain ⟨i₁, hi₁J, hmin⟩ := J.exists_min_image c hJne
  set θc : ℚ := c i₁ with hθcdef
  have hθc0 : 0 < θc := hcpos i₁ hi₁J
  have hθc1 : θc ≤ 1 := hcle1 i₁ hi₁J
  have hallnn : ∀ i, 0 ≤ (1 - θc) * a i + θc * b i := by
    intro i
    by_cases hi : i ∈ J
    · have hd := hdenpos i hi
      have hle : θc ≤ c i := hmin i hi
      have hcieq : c i * (a i - b i) = a i := by rw [hcdef]; field_simp
      have hle' : θc * (a i - b i) ≤ a i := by
        calc θc * (a i - b i) ≤ c i * (a i - b i) := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hle hd.le
          _ = a i := hcieq
      nlinarith [hle']
    · rw [hJdef, Finset.mem_filter] at hi
      push_neg at hi
      have hbpos : 0 < b i := hi (Finset.mem_univ i)
      have h1 : 0 ≤ 1 - θc := by linarith
      nlinarith [ha i, hbpos, h1, hθc0]
  have hstrict := NB θc hθc0.le hθc1 hallnn
  have hzero : (1 - θc) * a i₁ + θc * b i₁ = 0 := hczero i₁ hi₁J
  exact absurd (hstrict i₁) (by rw [hzero]; exact lt_irrefl 0)

name: seg_scalar_pos_iff
statement:
theorem seg_scalar_pos_iff {n : ℕ} (a b : Fin n → ℚ)
    (NB : ∀ θ : ℚ, 0 ≤ θ → θ ≤ 1 →
      (∀ i, 0 ≤ (1 - θ) * a i + θ * b i) → (∀ i, 0 < (1 - θ) * a i + θ * b i)) :
    (∀ i, 0 < a i) ↔ (∀ i, 0 < b i)
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · exact seg_scalar_oneway a b NB
  · have NB' : ∀ θ : ℚ, 0 ≤ θ → θ ≤ 1 →
        (∀ i, 0 ≤ (1 - θ) * b i + θ * a i) → (∀ i, 0 < (1 - θ) * b i + θ * a i) := by
      intro θ hθ0 hθ1 hnn
      have h := NB (1 - θ) (by linarith) (by linarith)
        (by intro i; have := hnn i; nlinarith [this])
      intro i; have := h i; nlinarith [this]
    exact seg_scalar_oneway b a NB'

name: qsign_self_pos
statement: theorem qsign_self_pos {q : ℚ} (h : q ≠ 0) : 0 < (qsign q : ℚ) * q
proof:
:= by
  rw [qsign_of_ne h]
  by_cases hq : q < 0
  · rw [if_pos hq]; push_cast; nlinarith
  · rw [if_neg hq]; push_neg at hq
    have hqp : 0 < q := lt_of_le_of_ne hq (Ne.symm h)
    push_cast; nlinarith

name: same_sign_iff
statement: theorem same_sign_iff {a b : ℚ} (h : 0 < a * b) : (0 < a ↔ 0 < b)
proof:
:= by
  rcases mul_pos_iff.mp h with ⟨ha, hb⟩ | ⟨ha, hb⟩
  · exact ⟨fun _ => hb, fun _ => ha⟩
  · exact ⟨fun h' => absurd h' (not_lt.mpr ha.le), fun h' => absurd h' (not_lt.mpr hb.le)⟩

name: qsign_eq_of_same_sign
statement:
theorem qsign_eq_of_same_sign {A den : ℚ} (hA : A ≠ 0) (h : 0 < (qsign A : ℚ) * den) :
    qsign den = qsign A
proof:
:= by
  rcases qsign_ne_zero hA with h1 | h1 <;> rw [h1] at h ⊢
  · have hd : 0 < den := by push_cast at h; linarith
    rw [qsign_of_ne hd.ne', if_neg (not_lt.mpr hd.le)]
  · have hd : den < 0 := by push_cast at h; linarith
    rw [qsign_of_ne hd.ne, if_pos hd]

name: cramer3
statement:
theorem cramer3 (a b c w : Point) :
    det3 a b c • w = det3 w b c • a + det3 a w c • b + det3 a b w • c
proof:
:= by
  funext k
  fin_cases k
  · show det3 a b c * w 0 = det3 w b c * a 0 + det3 a w c * b 0 + det3 a b w * c 0
    simp only [det3, dotQ, crossQ, mkPoint_zero, mkPoint_one, mkPoint_two]; ring
  · show det3 a b c * w 1 = det3 w b c * a 1 + det3 a w c * b 1 + det3 a b w * c 1
    simp only [det3, dotQ, crossQ, mkPoint_zero, mkPoint_one, mkPoint_two]; ring
  · show det3 a b c * w 2 = det3 w b c * a 2 + det3 a w c * b 2 + det3 a b w * c 2
    simp only [det3, dotQ, crossQ, mkPoint_zero, mkPoint_one, mkPoint_two]; ring

name: det3_e01_faceNormal
statement:
theorem det3_e01_faceNormal (t : Triangle) :
    det3 (psub t.v₁ t.v₀) (psub t.v₂ t.v₀) (Proof.MeshIntersectJump.faceNormal t) = dotQ (Proof.MeshIntersectJump.faceNormal t) (Proof.MeshIntersectJump.faceNormal t)
proof:
:= by
  simp only [det3, dotQ, crossQ, psub, Proof.MeshIntersectJump.faceNormal, mkPoint_zero, mkPoint_one, mkPoint_two]; ring

name: dir_deg_zero
statement:
theorem dir_deg_zero {t : Triangle} (hdet : detOrigin t ≠ 0) {w : Point}
    (h1 : dotQ (Proof.MeshIntersectJump.faceNormal t) w = 0)
    (h2 : det3 (psub t.v₁ t.v₀) w (Proof.MeshIntersectJump.faceNormal t) = 0)
    (h3 : det3 (psub t.v₂ t.v₀) w (Proof.MeshIntersectJump.faceNormal t) = 0) :
    w = 0
proof:
:= by
  have hN : 0 < dotQ (Proof.MeshIntersectJump.faceNormal t) (Proof.MeshIntersectJump.faceNormal t) := N_pos hdet
  have hcoef : det3 (psub t.v₁ t.v₀) (psub t.v₂ t.v₀) (Proof.MeshIntersectJump.faceNormal t) ≠ 0 := by
    rw [det3_e01_faceNormal]; exact ne_of_gt hN
  have hkey := cramer3 (psub t.v₁ t.v₀) (psub t.v₂ t.v₀) (Proof.MeshIntersectJump.faceNormal t) w
  have c1 : det3 w (psub t.v₂ t.v₀) (Proof.MeshIntersectJump.faceNormal t) = 0 := by
    have e : det3 w (psub t.v₂ t.v₀) (Proof.MeshIntersectJump.faceNormal t)
        = - det3 (psub t.v₂ t.v₀) w (Proof.MeshIntersectJump.faceNormal t) := by
      simp only [det3, dotQ, crossQ, psub, mkPoint_zero, mkPoint_one, mkPoint_two]; ring
    rw [e, h3, neg_zero]
  have c3 : det3 (psub t.v₁ t.v₀) (psub t.v₂ t.v₀) w = 0 := by
    have e : det3 (psub t.v₁ t.v₀) (psub t.v₂ t.v₀) w = dotQ (Proof.MeshIntersectJump.faceNormal t) w := by
      simp only [det3, dotQ, crossQ, psub, Proof.MeshIntersectJump.faceNormal, mkPoint_zero, mkPoint_one, mkPoint_two]; ring
    rw [e, h1]
  simp only [c1, h2, c3, zero_smul, add_zero] at hkey
  rcases smul_eq_zero.mp hkey with h | h
  · exact absurd h hcoef
  · exact h

name: hit_on_carrier
proof:
:= by
  rw [Proof.MeshIntersectRayClassify.dotQ_lineAt]
  unfold faceRoot

name: meetsRelint_iff_pos
statement:
theorem meetsRelint_iff_pos {MB : Mesh} {P dir : Point} {u : Fin MB.size}
    (hdet : detOrigin MB[u] ≠ 0) (hden : dotQ (Proof.MeshIntersectJump.faceNormal MB[u]) dir ≠ 0) :
    MeetsRelint MB P dir u ↔
      (0 < faceRoot MB P dir u ∧ 0 < ee0 MB[u] (lineAt P dir (faceRoot MB P dir u))
        ∧ 0 < ee1 MB[u] (lineAt P dir (faceRoot MB P dir u))
        ∧ 0 < ee2 MB[u] (lineAt P dir (faceRoot MB P dir u)))
proof:
:= by
  have hitc : dotQ (Proof.MeshIntersectJump.faceNormal MB[u]) (lineAt P dir (faceRoot MB P dir u)) = detOrigin MB[u] :=
    hit_on_carrier hden
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨s, hs, hmem, hnotedge⟩
    have hroot : s = faceRoot MB P dir u := hit_at_root hden hmem
    rw [hroot] at hs hmem hnotedge
    obtain ⟨h0, h1, h2⟩ := ee_nonneg_of_mem_triangleSet hmem
    refine ⟨hs, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
    · rcases eq_or_lt_of_le h0 with h | h
      · exact absurd (mem_edgeSet_of_carrier hdet hitc h0 h1 h2 (Or.inl h.symm)) hnotedge
      · exact h
    · rcases eq_or_lt_of_le h1 with h | h
      · exact absurd (mem_edgeSet_of_carrier hdet hitc h0 h1 h2 (Or.inr (Or.inl h.symm))) hnotedge
      · exact h
    · rcases eq_or_lt_of_le h2 with h | h
      · exact absurd (mem_edgeSet_of_carrier hdet hitc h0 h1 h2 (Or.inr (Or.inr h.symm))) hnotedge
      · exact h
  · rintro ⟨hr, h0, h1, h2⟩
    refine ⟨faceRoot MB P dir u, hr,
      mem_triangleSet_of_carrier hdet hitc h0.le h1.le h2.le, ?_⟩
    intro hedgemem
    rcases ee_zero_of_mem_edgeSet hedgemem with h | h | h
    · exact absurd h h0.ne'
    · exact absurd h h1.ne'
    · exact absurd h h2.ne'

name: meetsRelint_iff_of_segment
statement:
theorem meetsRelint_iff_of_segment {MB : Mesh} {Q Q' d : Point} {u : Fin MB.size}
    (hdet : detOrigin MB[u] ≠ 0) (hden : dotQ (Proof.MeshIntersectJump.faceNormal MB[u]) d ≠ 0)
    (hoff : ∀ θ : ℚ, 0 ≤ θ → θ ≤ 1 →
      (fun i => Q i + θ * (Q' i - Q i)) ∉ triangleSet MB[u])
    (hedge : ∀ θ : ℚ, 0 ≤ θ → θ ≤ 1 → ∀ s : ℚ, 0 < s →
      lineAt (fun i => Q i + θ * (Q' i - Q i)) d s ∉ edgeSet MB[u]) :
    MeetsRelint MB Q d u ↔ MeetsRelint MB Q' d u
proof:
:= by
  have hcarr : ∀ P : Point,
      dotQ (Proof.MeshIntersectJump.faceNormal MB[u]) (lineAt P d (faceRoot MB P d u)) = detOrigin MB[u] :=
    fun P => hit_on_carrier hden
  have hseg : ∀ θ : ℚ, (fun i => Q i + θ * (Q' i - Q i)) = seg Q Q' θ := by
    intro θ; funext i; simp [seg]
  have hchar : ∀ P : Point, MeetsRelint MB P d u ↔
      (0 < faceRoot MB P d u ∧ 0 < ee0 MB[u] (lineAt P d (faceRoot MB P d u))
        ∧ 0 < ee1 MB[u] (lineAt P d (faceRoot MB P d u))
        ∧ 0 < ee2 MB[u] (lineAt P d (faceRoot MB P d u))) :=
    fun P => meetsRelint_iff_pos hdet hden
  
  set a : Fin 4 → ℚ := ![faceRoot MB Q d u, ee0 MB[u] (lineAt Q d (faceRoot MB Q d u)),
    ee1 MB[u] (lineAt Q d (faceRoot MB Q d u)), ee2 MB[u] (lineAt Q d (faceRoot MB Q d u))]
    with hadef
  set b : Fin 4 → ℚ := ![faceRoot MB Q' d u, ee0 MB[u] (lineAt Q' d (faceRoot MB Q' d u)),
    ee1 MB[u] (lineAt Q' d (faceRoot MB Q' d u)), ee2 MB[u] (lineAt Q' d (faceRoot MB Q' d u))]
    with hbdef
  have hrseg : ∀ θ : ℚ, faceRoot MB (seg Q Q' θ) d u
      = (1 - θ) * faceRoot MB Q d u + θ * faceRoot MB Q' d u := by
    intro θ; unfold faceRoot; rw [dotQ_seg]; field_simp; ring
  have hhitseg : ∀ θ : ℚ, lineAt (seg Q Q' θ) d (faceRoot MB (seg Q Q' θ) d u)
      = seg (lineAt Q d (faceRoot MB Q d u)) (lineAt Q' d (faceRoot MB Q' d u)) θ := by
    intro θ; funext k; rw [hrseg θ]; simp only [lineAt, seg]; ring
  have hf0 : ∀ θ : ℚ, (1 - θ) * a 0 + θ * b 0 = faceRoot MB (seg Q Q' θ) d u := by
    intro θ; simp only [hadef, hbdef, Matrix.cons_val_zero]; rw [hrseg θ]
  have hf1 : ∀ θ : ℚ, (1 - θ) * a 1 + θ * b 1
      = ee0 MB[u] (lineAt (seg Q Q' θ) d (faceRoot MB (seg Q Q' θ) d u)) := by
    intro θ; simp only [hadef, hbdef, Matrix.cons_val_one, Matrix.head_cons]
    rw [hhitseg θ, ee0_seg]
  have hf2 : ∀ θ : ℚ, (1 - θ) * a 2 + θ * b 2
      = ee1 MB[u] (lineAt (seg Q Q' θ) d (faceRoot MB (seg Q Q' θ) d u)) := by
    intro θ; simp only [hadef, hbdef, Matrix.cons_val_two, Matrix.tail_cons, Matrix.head_cons]
    rw [hhitseg θ, ee1_seg]
  have hf3 : ∀ θ : ℚ, (1 - θ) * a 3 + θ * b 3
      = ee2 MB[u] (lineAt (seg Q Q' θ) d (faceRoot MB (seg Q Q' θ) d u)) := by
    intro θ; simp only [hadef, hbdef, Matrix.cons_val_three, Matrix.tail_cons, Matrix.head_cons]
    rw [hhitseg θ, ee2_seg]
  
  have NB : ∀ θ : ℚ, 0 ≤ θ → θ ≤ 1 →
      (∀ i, 0 ≤ (1 - θ) * a i + θ * b i) → (∀ i, 0 < (1 - θ) * a i + θ * b i) := by
    intro θ hθ0 hθ1 hnn
    have hnn0 : 0 ≤ faceRoot MB (seg Q Q' θ) d u := by have := hnn 0; rwa [hf0 θ] at this
    have hnn1 : 0 ≤ ee0 MB[u] (lineAt (seg Q Q' θ) d (faceRoot MB (seg Q Q' θ) d u)) := by
      have := hnn 1; rwa [hf1 θ] at this
    have hnn2 : 0 ≤ ee1 MB[u] (lineAt (seg Q Q' θ) d (faceRoot MB (seg Q Q' θ) d u)) := by
      have := hnn 2; rwa [hf2 θ] at this
    have hnn3 : 0 ≤ ee2 MB[u] (lineAt (seg Q Q' θ) d (faceRoot MB (seg Q Q' θ) d u)) := by
      have := hnn 3; rwa [hf3 θ] at this
    have hitc : dotQ (Proof.MeshIntersectJump.faceNormal MB[u])
        (lineAt (seg Q Q' θ) d (faceRoot MB (seg Q Q' θ) d u)) = detOrigin MB[u] :=
      hcarr (seg Q Q' θ)
    have hr : 0 < faceRoot MB (seg Q Q' θ) d u := by
      rcases eq_or_lt_of_le hnn0 with h | h
      · exfalso
        have hit0 : lineAt (seg Q Q' θ) d (faceRoot MB (seg Q Q' θ) d u) = seg Q Q' θ := by
          rw [← h]; exact lineAt_zero (seg Q Q' θ) d
        have hPc : dotQ (Proof.MeshIntersectJump.faceNormal MB[u]) (seg Q Q' θ) = detOrigin MB[u] := by rw [← hit0]; exact hitc
        rw [hit0] at hnn1 hnn2 hnn3
        have hPtri : seg Q Q' θ ∈ triangleSet MB[u] :=
          mem_triangleSet_of_carrier hdet hPc hnn1 hnn2 hnn3
        exact (hoff θ hθ0 hθ1) (by rw [hseg θ]; exact hPtri)
      · exact h
    have hcln : lineAt (seg Q Q' θ) d (faceRoot MB (seg Q Q' θ) d u) ∉ edgeSet MB[u] := by
      have := hedge θ hθ0 hθ1 (faceRoot MB (seg Q Q' θ) d u) hr
      rwa [hseg θ] at this
    have he0 : 0 < ee0 MB[u] (lineAt (seg Q Q' θ) d (faceRoot MB (seg Q Q' θ) d u)) := by
      rcases eq_or_lt_of_le hnn1 with h | h
      · exact absurd (mem_edgeSet_of_carrier hdet hitc hnn1 hnn2 hnn3 (Or.inl h.symm)) hcln
      · exact h
    have he1 : 0 < ee1 MB[u] (lineAt (seg Q Q' θ) d (faceRoot MB (seg Q Q' θ) d u)) := by
      rcases eq_or_lt_of_le hnn2 with h | h
      · exact absurd (mem_edgeSet_of_carrier hdet hitc hnn1 hnn2 hnn3 (Or.inr (Or.inl h.symm))) hcln
      · exact h
    have he2 : 0 < ee2 MB[u] (lineAt (seg Q Q' θ) d (faceRoot MB (seg Q Q' θ) d u)) := by
      rcases eq_or_lt_of_le hnn3 with h | h
      · exact absurd (mem_edgeSet_of_carrier hdet hitc hnn1 hnn2 hnn3 (Or.inr (Or.inr h.symm))) hcln
      · exact h
    refine forall_fin4.mpr ⟨?_, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
    · rw [hf0 θ]; exact hr
    · rw [hf1 θ]; exact he0
    · rw [hf2 θ]; exact he1
    · rw [hf3 θ]; exact he2
  
  have hAFF := seg_scalar_pos_iff a b NB
  have hcharQ : MeetsRelint MB Q d u ↔ (∀ i, 0 < a i) := by
    rw [hchar Q, forall_fin4]
    simp only [hadef, Matrix.cons_val_zero, Matrix.cons_val_one, Matrix.head_cons,
      Matrix.cons_val_two, Matrix.tail_cons, Matrix.cons_val_three]
  have hcharQ' : MeetsRelint MB Q' d u ↔ (∀ i, 0 < b i) := by
    rw [hchar Q', forall_fin4]
    simp only [hbdef, Matrix.cons_val_zero, Matrix.cons_val_one, Matrix.head_cons,
      Matrix.cons_val_two, Matrix.tail_cons, Matrix.cons_val_three]
  rw [hcharQ, hcharQ', hAFF]

name: rayCount_local_const
statement:
theorem rayCount_local_const {MB : Mesh} (hnpo : NoPlaneThroughOrigin MB) {Q Q' d : Point}
    (hoff : ∀ θ : ℚ, 0 ≤ θ → θ ≤ 1 → ∀ u : Fin MB.size,
      (fun i => Q i + θ * (Q' i - Q i)) ∉ triangleSet MB[u])
    (hedge : ∀ θ : ℚ, 0 ≤ θ → θ ≤ 1 → ∀ u : Fin MB.size, ∀ s : ℚ, 0 < s →
      lineAt (fun i => Q i + θ * (Q' i - Q i)) d s ∉ edgeSet MB[u]) :
    RayCount MB Q d = RayCount MB Q' d
proof:
:= by
  unfold RayCount
  refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun u _ => ?_)
  by_cases hden : dotQ (Proof.MeshIntersectJump.faceNormal MB[u]) d = 0
  · have hq : qsign (dotQ (Proof.MeshIntersectJump.faceNormal MB[u]) d) = 0 := by rw [hden]; rfl
    rw [hq]; simp only [ite_self]
  · have hiff := meetsRelint_iff_of_segment (hnpo u) hden
      (fun θ h0 h1 => hoff θ h0 h1 u) (fun θ h0 h1 s hs => hedge θ h0 h1 u s hs)
    exact if_congr hiff rfl rfl

name: summand_dir_eq
statement:
theorem summand_dir_eq {MB : Mesh} {P : Point} {u : Fin MB.size} (dir : Point)
    (hdet : detOrigin MB[u] ≠ 0) {A : ℚ}
    (hAeq : A = detOrigin MB[u] - dotQ (Proof.MeshIntersectJump.faceNormal MB[u]) P) (hA : A ≠ 0) :
    (if MeetsRelint MB P dir u then qsign (dotQ (Proof.MeshIntersectJump.faceNormal MB[u]) dir) else (0 : ℤ))
      = (if (0 < (qsign A : ℚ) * dotQ (Proof.MeshIntersectJump.faceNormal MB[u]) dir
            ∧ 0 < (qsign A : ℚ) * (dotQ (Proof.MeshIntersectJump.faceNormal MB[u]) dir * ee0 MB[u] P
                  + A * det3 (psub MB[u].v₁ MB[u].v₀) dir (Proof.MeshIntersectJump.faceNormal MB[u]))
            ∧ 0 < (qsign A : ℚ) * (dotQ (Proof.MeshIntersectJump.faceNormal MB[u]) dir * ee1 MB[u] P
                  + A * det3 (psub MB[u].v₂ MB[u].v₁) dir (Proof.MeshIntersectJump.faceNormal MB[u]))
            ∧ 0 < (qsign A : ℚ) * (dotQ (Proof.MeshIntersectJump.faceNormal MB[u]) dir * ee2 MB[u] P
                  + A * det3 (psub MB[u].v₀ MB[u].v₂) dir (Proof.MeshIntersectJump.faceNormal MB[u])))
          then qsign A else 0)
proof:
:= by
  have hsA : 0 < (qsign A : ℚ) * A := qsign_self_pos hA
  by_cases hden : dotQ (Proof.MeshIntersectJump.faceNormal MB[u]) dir = 0
  · have hq0 : qsign (dotQ (Proof.MeshIntersectJump.faceNormal MB[u]) dir) = 0 := by rw [hden]; rfl
    have hc1 : ¬ (0 < (qsign A : ℚ) * dotQ (Proof.MeshIntersectJump.faceNormal MB[u]) dir) := by
      rw [hden, mul_zero]; exact lt_irrefl 0
    rw [hq0, if_neg (mt And.left hc1), ite_self]
  · 
    have hfrden : faceRoot MB P dir u * dotQ (Proof.MeshIntersectJump.faceNormal MB[u]) dir = A := by
      unfold faceRoot; rw [div_mul_cancel₀ _ hden, hAeq]
    have hitc : dotQ (Proof.MeshIntersectJump.faceNormal MB[u]) (lineAt P dir (faceRoot MB P dir u)) = detOrigin MB[u] :=
      hit_on_carrier hden
    have hchar := meetsRelint_iff_pos (P := P) (dir := dir) (u := u) hdet hden
    have hek0 : ee0 MB[u] (lineAt P dir (faceRoot MB P dir u)) * dotQ (Proof.MeshIntersectJump.faceNormal MB[u]) dir
        = dotQ (Proof.MeshIntersectJump.faceNormal MB[u]) dir * ee0 MB[u] P
          + A * det3 (psub MB[u].v₁ MB[u].v₀) dir (Proof.MeshIntersectJump.faceNormal MB[u]) := by
      rw [ee0_lineAt]
      linear_combination (det3 (psub MB[u].v₁ MB[u].v₀) dir (Proof.MeshIntersectJump.faceNormal MB[u])) * hfrden
    have hek1 : ee1 MB[u] (lineAt P dir (faceRoot MB P dir u)) * dotQ (Proof.MeshIntersectJump.faceNormal MB[u]) dir
        = dotQ (Proof.MeshIntersectJump.faceNormal MB[u]) dir * ee1 MB[u] P
          + A * det3 (psub MB[u].v₂ MB[u].v₁) dir (Proof.MeshIntersectJump.faceNormal MB[u]) := by
      rw [ee1_lineAt]
      linear_combination (det3 (psub MB[u].v₂ MB[u].v₁) dir (Proof.MeshIntersectJump.faceNormal MB[u])) * hfrden
    have hek2 : ee2 MB[u] (lineAt P dir (faceRoot MB P dir u)) * dotQ (Proof.MeshIntersectJump.faceNormal MB[u]) dir
        = dotQ (Proof.MeshIntersectJump.faceNormal MB[u]) dir * ee2 MB[u] P
          + A * det3 (psub MB[u].v₀ MB[u].v₂) dir (Proof.MeshIntersectJump.faceNormal MB[u]) := by
      rw [ee2_lineAt]
      linear_combination (det3 (psub MB[u].v₀ MB[u].v₂) dir (Proof.MeshIntersectJump.faceNormal MB[u])) * hfrden
    have hprod0 : faceRoot MB P dir u * ((qsign A : ℚ) * dotQ (Proof.MeshIntersectJump.faceNormal MB[u]) dir)
        = (qsign A : ℚ) * A := by
      linear_combination (qsign A : ℚ) * hfrden
    have hprodk0 : ee0 MB[u] (lineAt P dir (faceRoot MB P dir u))
          * ((qsign A : ℚ) * dotQ (Proof.MeshIntersectJump.faceNormal MB[u]) dir)
        = (qsign A : ℚ) * (dotQ (Proof.MeshIntersectJump.faceNormal MB[u]) dir * ee0 MB[u] P
              + A * det3 (psub MB[u].v₁ MB[u].v₀) dir (Proof.MeshIntersectJump.faceNormal MB[u])) := by
      linear_combination (qsign A : ℚ) * hek0
    have hprodk1 : ee1 MB[u] (lineAt P dir (faceRoot MB P dir u))
          * ((qsign A : ℚ) * dotQ (Proof.MeshIntersectJump.faceNormal MB[u]) dir)
        = (qsign A : ℚ) * (dotQ (Proof.MeshIntersectJump.faceNormal MB[u]) dir * ee1 MB[u] P
              + A * det3 (psub MB[u].v₂ MB[u].v₁) dir (Proof.MeshIntersectJump.faceNormal MB[u])) := by
      linear_combination (qsign A : ℚ) * hek1
    have hprodk2 : ee2 MB[u] (lineAt P dir (faceRoot MB P dir u))
          * ((qsign A : ℚ) * dotQ (Proof.MeshIntersectJump.faceNormal MB[u]) dir)
        = (qsign A : ℚ) * (dotQ (Proof.MeshIntersectJump.faceNormal MB[u]) dir * ee2 MB[u] P
              + A * det3 (psub MB[u].v₀ MB[u].v₂) dir (Proof.MeshIntersectJump.faceNormal MB[u])) := by
      linear_combination (qsign A : ℚ) * hek2
    by_cases hcond : 0 < (qsign A : ℚ) * dotQ (Proof.MeshIntersectJump.faceNormal MB[u]) dir
        ∧ 0 < (qsign A : ℚ) * (dotQ (Proof.MeshIntersectJump.faceNormal MB[u]) dir * ee0 MB[u] P
              + A * det3 (psub MB[u].v₁ MB[u].v₀) dir (Proof.MeshIntersectJump.faceNormal MB[u]))
        ∧ 0 < (qsign A : ℚ) * (dotQ (Proof.MeshIntersectJump.faceNormal MB[u]) dir * ee1 MB[u] P
              + A * det3 (psub MB[u].v₂ MB[u].v₁) dir (Proof.MeshIntersectJump.faceNormal MB[u]))
        ∧ 0 < (qsign A : ℚ) * (dotQ (Proof.MeshIntersectJump.faceNormal MB[u]) dir * ee2 MB[u] P
              + A * det3 (psub MB[u].v₀ MB[u].v₂) dir (Proof.MeshIntersectJump.faceNormal MB[u]))
    · obtain ⟨hH0, hH1, hH2, hH3⟩ := hcond
      have hfrpos : 0 < faceRoot MB P dir u := (same_sign_iff (by rw [hprod0]; exact hsA)).mpr hH0
      have he0pos : 0 < ee0 MB[u] (lineAt P dir (faceRoot MB P dir u)) :=
        (same_sign_iff (by rw [hprodk0]; exact hH1)).mpr hH0
      have he1pos : 0 < ee1 MB[u] (lineAt P dir (faceRoot MB P dir u)) :=
        (same_sign_iff (by rw [hprodk1]; exact hH2)).mpr hH0
      have he2pos : 0 < ee2 MB[u] (lineAt P dir (faceRoot MB P dir u)) :=
        (same_sign_iff (by rw [hprodk2]; exact hH3)).mpr hH0
      have hMR : MeetsRelint MB P dir u := hchar.mpr ⟨hfrpos, he0pos, he1pos, he2pos⟩
      have hqden : qsign (dotQ (Proof.MeshIntersectJump.faceNormal MB[u]) dir) = qsign A := qsign_eq_of_same_sign hA hH0
      rw [if_pos hMR, if_pos ⟨hH0, hH1, hH2, hH3⟩, hqden]
    · rw [if_neg hcond]
      have hnMR : ¬ MeetsRelint MB P dir u := by
        intro hMR
        obtain ⟨hfrpos, he0, he1, he2⟩ := hchar.mp hMR
        have hH0 : 0 < (qsign A : ℚ) * dotQ (Proof.MeshIntersectJump.faceNormal MB[u]) dir :=
          (same_sign_iff (by rw [hprod0]; exact hsA)).mp hfrpos
        refine hcond ⟨hH0, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
        · rw [← hprodk0]; exact mul_pos he0 hH0
        · rw [← hprodk1]; exact mul_pos he1 hH0
        · rw [← hprodk2]; exact mul_pos he2 hH0
      rw [if_neg hnMR]

name: H_pos_of_nonneg
statement:
theorem H_pos_of_nonneg {MB : Mesh} {P dir : Point} {u : Fin MB.size}
    (hdet : detOrigin MB[u] ≠ 0) {A : ℚ}
    (hAeq : A = detOrigin MB[u] - dotQ (Proof.MeshIntersectJump.faceNormal MB[u]) P) (hA : A ≠ 0)
    (hdir : dir ≠ 0)
    (hedge1 : ∀ s : ℚ, 0 < s → lineAt P dir s ∉ edgeSet MB[u])
    (hnn0 : 0 ≤ (qsign A : ℚ) * dotQ (Proof.MeshIntersectJump.faceNormal MB[u]) dir)
    (hnn1 : 0 ≤ (qsign A : ℚ) * (dotQ (Proof.MeshIntersectJump.faceNormal MB[u]) dir * ee0 MB[u] P
              + A * det3 (psub MB[u].v₁ MB[u].v₀) dir (Proof.MeshIntersectJump.faceNormal MB[u])))
    (hnn2 : 0 ≤ (qsign A : ℚ) * (dotQ (Proof.MeshIntersectJump.faceNormal MB[u]) dir * ee1 MB[u] P
              + A * det3 (psub MB[u].v₂ MB[u].v₁) dir (Proof.MeshIntersectJump.faceNormal MB[u])))
    (hnn3 : 0 ≤ (qsign A : ℚ) * (dotQ (Proof.MeshIntersectJump.faceNormal MB[u]) dir * ee2 MB[u] P
              + A * det3 (psub MB[u].v₀ MB[u].v₂) dir (Proof.MeshIntersectJump.faceNormal MB[u]))) :
    0 < (qsign A : ℚ) * dotQ (Proof.MeshIntersectJump.faceNormal MB[u]) dir
    ∧ 0 < (qsign A : ℚ) * (dotQ (Proof.MeshIntersectJump.faceNormal MB[u]) dir * ee0 MB[u] P
          + A * det3 (psub MB[u].v₁ MB[u].v₀) dir (Proof.MeshIntersectJump.faceNormal MB[u]))
    ∧ 0 < (qsign A : ℚ) * (dotQ (Proof.MeshIntersectJump.faceNormal MB[u]) dir * ee1 MB[u] P
          + A * det3 (psub MB[u].v₂ MB[u].v₁) dir (Proof.MeshIntersectJump.faceNormal MB[u]))
    ∧ 0 < (qsign A : ℚ) * (dotQ (Proof.MeshIntersectJump.faceNormal MB[u]) dir * ee2 MB[u] P
          + A * det3 (psub MB[u].v₀ MB[u].v₂) dir (Proof.MeshIntersectJump.faceNormal MB[u]))
proof:
:= by
  have hsA : 0 < (qsign A : ℚ) * A := qsign_self_pos hA
  have hqAne : (qsign A : ℚ) ≠ 0 := by
    rcases qsign_ne_zero hA with h | h <;> rw [h] <;> norm_num
  by_cases hden : dotQ (Proof.MeshIntersectJump.faceNormal MB[u]) dir = 0
  · exfalso
    have hg0 : 0 ≤ det3 (psub MB[u].v₁ MB[u].v₀) dir (Proof.MeshIntersectJump.faceNormal MB[u]) := by
      have h := hnn1; rw [hden] at h
      have h2 : 0 ≤ ((qsign A : ℚ) * A) * det3 (psub MB[u].v₁ MB[u].v₀) dir (Proof.MeshIntersectJump.faceNormal MB[u]) := by
        nlinarith [h]
      exact (mul_nonneg_iff_of_pos_left hsA).mp h2
    have hg1 : 0 ≤ det3 (psub MB[u].v₂ MB[u].v₁) dir (Proof.MeshIntersectJump.faceNormal MB[u]) := by
      have h := hnn2; rw [hden] at h
      have h2 : 0 ≤ ((qsign A : ℚ) * A) * det3 (psub MB[u].v₂ MB[u].v₁) dir (Proof.MeshIntersectJump.faceNormal MB[u]) := by
        nlinarith [h]
      exact (mul_nonneg_iff_of_pos_left hsA).mp h2
    have hg2 : 0 ≤ det3 (psub MB[u].v₀ MB[u].v₂) dir (Proof.MeshIntersectJump.faceNormal MB[u]) := by
      have h := hnn3; rw [hden] at h
      have h2 : 0 ≤ ((qsign A : ℚ) * A) * det3 (psub MB[u].v₀ MB[u].v₂) dir (Proof.MeshIntersectJump.faceNormal MB[u]) := by
        nlinarith [h]
      exact (mul_nonneg_iff_of_pos_left hsA).mp h2
    have hsum := det3_edge_sum MB[u] dir
    have hz0 : det3 (psub MB[u].v₁ MB[u].v₀) dir (Proof.MeshIntersectJump.faceNormal MB[u]) = 0 := by linarith
    have hz1 : det3 (psub MB[u].v₂ MB[u].v₁) dir (Proof.MeshIntersectJump.faceNormal MB[u]) = 0 := by linarith
    have hz3 : det3 (psub MB[u].v₂ MB[u].v₀) dir (Proof.MeshIntersectJump.faceNormal MB[u]) = 0 := by
      rw [det3_v2v0_split]; linarith
    exact hdir (dir_deg_zero hdet hden hz0 hz3)
  · 
    have hfrden : faceRoot MB P dir u * dotQ (Proof.MeshIntersectJump.faceNormal MB[u]) dir = A := by
      unfold faceRoot; rw [div_mul_cancel₀ _ hden, hAeq]
    have hitc : dotQ (Proof.MeshIntersectJump.faceNormal MB[u]) (lineAt P dir (faceRoot MB P dir u)) = detOrigin MB[u] :=
      hit_on_carrier hden
    have hek0 : ee0 MB[u] (lineAt P dir (faceRoot MB P dir u)) * dotQ (Proof.MeshIntersectJump.faceNormal MB[u]) dir
        = dotQ (Proof.MeshIntersectJump.faceNormal MB[u]) dir * ee0 MB[u] P
          + A * det3 (psub MB[u].v₁ MB[u].v₀) dir (Proof.MeshIntersectJump.faceNormal MB[u]) := by
      rw [ee0_lineAt]
      linear_combination (det3 (psub MB[u].v₁ MB[u].v₀) dir (Proof.MeshIntersectJump.faceNormal MB[u])) * hfrden
    have hek1 : ee1 MB[u] (lineAt P dir (faceRoot MB P dir u)) * dotQ (Proof.MeshIntersectJump.faceNormal MB[u]) dir
        = dotQ (Proof.MeshIntersectJump.faceNormal MB[u]) dir * ee1 MB[u] P
          + A * det3 (psub MB[u].v₂ MB[u].v₁) dir (Proof.MeshIntersectJump.faceNormal MB[u]) := by
      rw [ee1_lineAt]
      linear_combination (det3 (psub MB[u].v₂ MB[u].v₁) dir (Proof.MeshIntersectJump.faceNormal MB[u])) * hfrden
    have hek2 : ee2 MB[u] (lineAt P dir (faceRoot MB P dir u)) * dotQ (Proof.MeshIntersectJump.faceNormal MB[u]) dir
        = dotQ (Proof.MeshIntersectJump.faceNormal MB[u]) dir * ee2 MB[u] P
          + A * det3 (psub MB[u].v₀ MB[u].v₂) dir (Proof.MeshIntersectJump.faceNormal MB[u]) := by
      rw [ee2_lineAt]
      linear_combination (det3 (psub MB[u].v₀ MB[u].v₂) dir (Proof.MeshIntersectJump.faceNormal MB[u])) * hfrden
    have hprod0 : faceRoot MB P dir u * ((qsign A : ℚ) * dotQ (Proof.MeshIntersectJump.faceNormal MB[u]) dir)
        = (qsign A : ℚ) * A := by
      linear_combination (qsign A : ℚ) * hfrden
    have hprodk0 : ee0 MB[u] (lineAt P dir (faceRoot MB P dir u))
          * ((qsign A : ℚ) * dotQ (Proof.MeshIntersectJump.faceNormal MB[u]) dir)
        = (qsign A : ℚ) * (dotQ (Proof.MeshIntersectJump.faceNormal MB[u]) dir * ee0 MB[u] P
              + A * det3 (psub MB[u].v₁ MB[u].v₀) dir (Proof.MeshIntersectJump.faceNormal MB[u])) := by
      linear_combination (qsign A : ℚ) * hek0
    have hprodk1 : ee1 MB[u] (lineAt P dir (faceRoot MB P dir u))
          * ((qsign A : ℚ) * dotQ (Proof.MeshIntersectJump.faceNormal MB[u]) dir)
        = (qsign A : ℚ) * (dotQ (Proof.MeshIntersectJump.faceNormal MB[u]) dir * ee1 MB[u] P
              + A * det3 (psub MB[u].v₂ MB[u].v₁) dir (Proof.MeshIntersectJump.faceNormal MB[u])) := by
      linear_combination (qsign A : ℚ) * hek1
    have hprodk2 : ee2 MB[u] (lineAt P dir (faceRoot MB P dir u))
          * ((qsign A : ℚ) * dotQ (Proof.MeshIntersectJump.faceNormal MB[u]) dir)
        = (qsign A : ℚ) * (dotQ (Proof.MeshIntersectJump.faceNormal MB[u]) dir * ee2 MB[u] P
              + A * det3 (psub MB[u].v₀ MB[u].v₂) dir (Proof.MeshIntersectJump.faceNormal MB[u])) := by
      linear_combination (qsign A : ℚ) * hek2
    have hH0 : 0 < (qsign A : ℚ) * dotQ (Proof.MeshIntersectJump.faceNormal MB[u]) dir :=
      lt_of_le_of_ne hnn0 (Ne.symm (mul_ne_zero hqAne hden))
    have hfrpos : 0 < faceRoot MB P dir u := (same_sign_iff (by rw [hprod0]; exact hsA)).mpr hH0
    have he0nn : 0 ≤ ee0 MB[u] (lineAt P dir (faceRoot MB P dir u)) :=
      (mul_nonneg_iff_of_pos_right hH0).mp (by rw [hprodk0]; exact hnn1)
    have he1nn : 0 ≤ ee1 MB[u] (lineAt P dir (faceRoot MB P dir u)) :=
      (mul_nonneg_iff_of_pos_right hH0).mp (by rw [hprodk1]; exact hnn2)
    have he2nn : 0 ≤ ee2 MB[u] (lineAt P dir (faceRoot MB P dir u)) :=
      (mul_nonneg_iff_of_pos_right hH0).mp (by rw [hprodk2]; exact hnn3)
    have hcln : lineAt P dir (faceRoot MB P dir u) ∉ edgeSet MB[u] := hedge1 _ hfrpos
    refine ⟨hH0, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
    · rcases lt_or_eq_of_le hnn1 with h | h
      · exact h
      · exfalso
        have hee : ee0 MB[u] (lineAt P dir (faceRoot MB P dir u)) = 0 := by
          have hz : ee0 MB[u] (lineAt P dir (faceRoot MB P dir u))
              * ((qsign A : ℚ) * dotQ (Proof.MeshIntersectJump.faceNormal MB[u]) dir) = 0 := by rw [hprodk0]; exact h.symm
          exact (mul_eq_zero.mp hz).resolve_right hH0.ne'
        exact hcln (mem_edgeSet_of_carrier hdet hitc he0nn he1nn he2nn (Or.inl hee))
    · rcases lt_or_eq_of_le hnn2 with h | h
      · exact h
      · exfalso
        have hee : ee1 MB[u] (lineAt P dir (faceRoot MB P dir u)) = 0 := by
          have hz : ee1 MB[u] (lineAt P dir (faceRoot MB P dir u))
              * ((qsign A : ℚ) * dotQ (Proof.MeshIntersectJump.faceNormal MB[u]) dir) = 0 := by rw [hprodk1]; exact h.symm
          exact (mul_eq_zero.mp hz).resolve_right hH0.ne'
        exact hcln (mem_edgeSet_of_carrier hdet hitc he0nn he1nn he2nn (Or.inr (Or.inl hee)))
    · rcases lt_or_eq_of_le hnn3 with h | h
      · exact h
      · exfalso
        have hee : ee2 MB[u] (lineAt P dir (faceRoot MB P dir u)) = 0 := by
          have hz : ee2 MB[u] (lineAt P dir (faceRoot MB P dir u))
              * ((qsign A : ℚ) * dotQ (Proof.MeshIntersectJump.faceNormal MB[u]) dir) = 0 := by rw [hprodk2]; exact h.symm
          exact (mul_eq_zero.mp hz).resolve_right hH0.ne'
        exact hcln (mem_edgeSet_of_carrier hdet hitc he0nn he1nn he2nn (Or.inr (Or.inr hee)))

name: four_cond_const
proof:
:= by
  have key := seg_scalar_pos_iff ![a0, a1, a2, a3] ![b0, b1, b2, b3] (by
    intro θ hθ0 hθ1 hnn
    rw [forall_fin4] at hnn
    simp only [Matrix.cons_val_zero, Matrix.cons_val_one, Matrix.head_cons,
      Matrix.cons_val_two, Matrix.tail_cons, Matrix.cons_val_three] at hnn
    refine forall_fin4.mpr ?_
    simp only [Matrix.cons_val_zero, Matrix.cons_val_one, Matrix.head_cons,
      Matrix.cons_val_two, Matrix.tail_cons, Matrix.cons_val_three]
    exact NB θ hθ0 hθ1 hnn)
  rw [forall_fin4, forall_fin4] at key
  simpa using key

name: rayCount_local_const_dir
statement:
theorem rayCount_local_const_dir {MB : Mesh} (hnpo : NoPlaneThroughOrigin MB) {P d d' : Point}
    (hoffc : ∀ u : Fin MB.size, dotQ (Proof.MeshIntersectJump.faceNormal MB[u]) P ≠ detOrigin MB[u])
    (hdθ : ∀ θ : ℚ, 0 ≤ θ → θ ≤ 1 → (fun i => (1 - θ) * d i + θ * d' i) ≠ 0)
    (hedge : ∀ θ : ℚ, 0 ≤ θ → θ ≤ 1 → ∀ u : Fin MB.size, ∀ s : ℚ, 0 < s →
      lineAt P (fun i => (1 - θ) * d i + θ * d' i) s ∉ edgeSet MB[u]) :
    RayCount MB P d = RayCount MB P d'
proof:
:= by
  unfold RayCount
  refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun u _ => ?_)
  have hdet := hnpo u
  set A : ℚ := detOrigin MB[u] - dotQ (Proof.MeshIntersectJump.faceNormal MB[u]) P with hAeq
  have hA : A ≠ 0 := by rw [hAeq, sub_ne_zero]; exact fun h => hoffc u h.symm
  have hdseg : ∀ θ : ℚ, (fun i => (1 - θ) * d i + θ * d' i) = seg d d' θ := by
    intro θ; funext i; simp only [seg]; ring
  rw [summand_dir_eq (P := P) (u := u) d hdet hAeq hA,
      summand_dir_eq (P := P) (u := u) d' hdet hAeq hA]
  refine if_congr ?_ rfl rfl
  refine four_cond_const _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ ?_
  intro θ hθ0 hθ1 hnn
  have hdir_ne : seg d d' θ ≠ 0 := by rw [← hdseg θ]; exact hdθ θ hθ0 hθ1
  have hedge1 : ∀ s : ℚ, 0 < s → lineAt P (seg d d' θ) s ∉ edgeSet MB[u] := by
    intro s hs; rw [← hdseg θ]; exact hedge θ hθ0 hθ1 u s hs
  
  have hI0 : (1 - θ) * ((qsign A : ℚ) * dotQ (Proof.MeshIntersectJump.faceNormal MB[u]) d)
        + θ * ((qsign A : ℚ) * dotQ (Proof.MeshIntersectJump.faceNormal MB[u]) d')
      = (qsign A : ℚ) * dotQ (Proof.MeshIntersectJump.faceNormal MB[u]) (seg d d' θ) := by
    rw [dotQ_seg]; ring
  have hI1 : (1 - θ) * ((qsign A : ℚ) * (dotQ (Proof.MeshIntersectJump.faceNormal MB[u]) d * ee0 MB[u] P
          + A * det3 (psub MB[u].v₁ MB[u].v₀) d (Proof.MeshIntersectJump.faceNormal MB[u])))
        + θ * ((qsign A : ℚ) * (dotQ (Proof.MeshIntersectJump.faceNormal MB[u]) d' * ee0 MB[u] P
          + A * det3 (psub MB[u].v₁ MB[u].v₀) d' (Proof.MeshIntersectJump.faceNormal MB[u])))
      = (qsign A : ℚ) * (dotQ (Proof.MeshIntersectJump.faceNormal MB[u]) (seg d d' θ) * ee0 MB[u] P
          + A * det3 (psub MB[u].v₁ MB[u].v₀) (seg d d' θ) (Proof.MeshIntersectJump.faceNormal MB[u])) := by
    rw [dotQ_seg, det3_seg_mid]; ring
  have hI2 : (1 - θ) * ((qsign A : ℚ) * (dotQ (Proof.MeshIntersectJump.faceNormal MB[u]) d * ee1 MB[u] P
          + A * det3 (psub MB[u].v₂ MB[u].v₁) d (Proof.MeshIntersectJump.faceNormal MB[u])))
        + θ * ((qsign A : ℚ) * (dotQ (Proof.MeshIntersectJump.faceNormal MB[u]) d' * ee1 MB[u] P
          + A * det3 (psub MB[u].v₂ MB[u].v₁) d' (Proof.MeshIntersectJump.faceNormal MB[u])))
      = (qsign A : ℚ) * (dotQ (Proof.MeshIntersectJump.faceNormal MB[u]) (seg d d' θ) * ee1 MB[u] P
          + A * det3 (psub MB[u].v₂ MB[u].v₁) (seg d d' θ) (Proof.MeshIntersectJump.faceNormal MB[u])) := by
    rw [dotQ_seg, det3_seg_mid]; ring
  have hI3 : (1 - θ) * ((qsign A : ℚ) * (dotQ (Proof.MeshIntersectJump.faceNormal MB[u]) d * ee2 MB[u] P
          + A * det3 (psub MB[u].v₀ MB[u].v₂) d (Proof.MeshIntersectJump.faceNormal MB[u])))
        + θ * ((qsign A : ℚ) * (dotQ (Proof.MeshIntersectJump.faceNormal MB[u]) d' * ee2 MB[u] P
          + A * det3 (psub MB[u].v₀ MB[u].v₂) d' (Proof.MeshIntersectJump.faceNormal MB[u])))
      = (qsign A : ℚ) * (dotQ (Proof.MeshIntersectJump.faceNormal MB[u]) (seg d d' θ) * ee2 MB[u] P
          + A * det3 (psub MB[u].v₀ MB[u].v₂) (seg d d' θ) (Proof.MeshIntersectJump.faceNormal MB[u])) := by
    rw [dotQ_seg, det3_seg_mid]; ring
  obtain ⟨hnn0, hnn1, hnn2, hnn3⟩ := hnn
  rw [hI0] at hnn0; rw [hI1] at hnn1; rw [hI2] at hnn2; rw [hI3] at hnn3
  have hpos := H_pos_of_nonneg hdet hAeq hA hdir_ne hedge1 hnn0 hnn1 hnn2 hnn3
  obtain ⟨hp0, hp1, hp2, hp3⟩ := hpos
  refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · rw [hI0]; exact hp0
  · rw [hI1]; exact hp1
  · rw [hI2]; exact hp2
  · rw [hI3]; exact hp3

name: det3I_eq_cross_dot
statement: theorem det3I_eq_cross_dot (u v w : I3) : det3I u v w = dotI (crossI u v) w
proof:
:= by
  simp only [det3I, dotI, crossI]; ring

name: det3I_cyc
statement: theorem det3I_cyc (u v w : I3) : det3I u v w = det3I w u v
proof:
:= by
  simp only [det3I, dotI, crossI]; ring

name: det3I_swap23
statement: theorem det3I_swap23 (u v w : I3) : det3I u v w = - det3I u w v
proof:
:= by
  simp only [det3I, dotI, crossI]; ring

name: dotI_self_mul_det3I
statement:
theorem dotI_self_mul_det3I (n a e d : I3) :
    dotI n n * det3I a e d
      = dotI n a * det3I n e d + dotI n e * det3I n d a + dotI n d * det3I n a e
proof:
:= by
  simp only [det3I, dotI, crossI]; ring

name: dotI_crossI_left
statement: theorem dotI_crossI_left (u v : I3) : dotI (crossI u v) u = 0
proof:
:= by
  simp only [dotI, crossI]; ring

name: dotI_crossI_right
statement: theorem dotI_crossI_right (u v : I3) : dotI (crossI u v) v = 0
proof:
:= by
  simp only [dotI, crossI]; ring

name: dotI_hsub_symm
statement: theorem dotI_hsub_symm (n : I3) (u v : H4) : dotI n (hsub u v) = - dotI n (hsub v u)
proof:
:= by
  simp only [dotI, hsub]; ring

name: dotI_hsub_shift
statement:
theorem dotI_hsub_shift (n : I3) (hk h0 qh : H4) :
    h0.w * dotI n (hsub hk qh)
      = hk.w * dotI n (hsub h0 qh) + qh.w * dotI n (hsub hk h0)
proof:
:= by
  simp only [dotI, hsub]; ring

name: dotI_self_pos
statement: theorem dotI_self_pos {n : I3} (h : ¬ (n.x = 0 ∧ n.y = 0 ∧ n.z = 0)) : 0 < dotI n n
proof:
:= by
  simp only [dotI]
  rcases (by tauto : n.x ≠ 0 ∨ n.y ≠ 0 ∨ n.z ≠ 0) with h' | h' | h' <;>
    nlinarith [mul_self_nonneg n.x, mul_self_nonneg n.y, mul_self_nonneg n.z,
      mul_self_pos.mpr h']

name: dotI_self_pos_of_dot_ne
statement: theorem dotI_self_pos_of_dot_ne {n d : I3} (h : dotI n d ≠ 0) : 0 < dotI n n
proof:
:= by
  apply dotI_self_pos
  rintro ⟨hx, hy, hz⟩
  exact h (by simp [dotI, hx, hy, hz])

name: pfacePrep_default
statement: theorem pfacePrep_default : PFacePrep (default : PFace)
proof:
:=
  ⟨rfl, rfl, rfl, rfl, rfl⟩

name: nrmI_default
statement: theorem nrmI_default : (default : PFace).nrmI = ⟨0, 0, 0⟩
proof: := rfl

name: prep_dotI_e01
statement: theorem prep_dotI_e01 {f : PFace} (hp : PFacePrep f) : dotI f.nrmI f.e01 = 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [hp.e01, hp.nrm]; exact dotI_crossI_left _ _

name: prep_dotI_e20
statement: theorem prep_dotI_e20 {f : PFace} (hp : PFacePrep f) : dotI f.nrmI f.e20 = 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [hp.e20, dotI_hsub_symm, hp.nrm, dotI_crossI_right]; ring

name: prep_dotI_h2h0
statement:
theorem prep_dotI_h2h0 {f : PFace} (hp : PFacePrep f) :
    dotI f.nrmI (hsub f.h2 f.h0) = 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [hp.nrm]; exact dotI_crossI_right _ _

name: prep_dotI_h1h0
statement:
theorem prep_dotI_h1h0 {f : PFace} (hp : PFacePrep f) :
    dotI f.nrmI (hsub f.h1 f.h0) = 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [hp.nrm]; exact dotI_crossI_left _ _

name: hsub_h2h1_shift
statement:
theorem hsub_h2h1_shift (n : I3) (h0 h1 h2 : H4) :
    h0.w * dotI n (hsub h2 h1)
      = h1.w * dotI n (hsub h2 h0) - h2.w * dotI n (hsub h1 h0)
proof:
:= by
  simp only [dotI, hsub]; ring

name: prep_dotI_e12
statement:
theorem prep_dotI_e12 {f : PFace} (hp : PFacePrep f) (hw : f.h0.w ≠ 0) :
    dotI f.nrmI f.e12 = 0
proof:
:= by
  have h := hsub_h2h1_shift f.nrmI f.h0 f.h1 f.h2
  rw [prep_dotI_h2h0 hp, prep_dotI_h1h0 hp] at h
  rw [hp.e12]
  exact mul_eq_zero.mp (by simpa using h) |>.resolve_left hw

name: wedgeOf_eq_det3I
statement:
theorem wedgeOf_eq_det3I (hk : H4) (E : I3) (qh : H4) (di : I3) :
    wedgeOf hk E qh di = det3I (hsub hk qh) E di
proof:
:=
  (det3I_eq_cross_dot _ _ _).symm

name: edgeDet_split
statement:
theorem edgeDet_split (E n di : I3) (hk qh : H4) (N dw : ℤ) :
    dotI E (crossI (hsub ⟨dw * qh.x + N * di.x, dw * qh.y + N * di.y,
                          dw * qh.z + N * di.z, dw * qh.w⟩ hk) n)
      = N * hk.w * det3I E di n - dw * det3I E (hsub hk qh) n
proof:
:= by
  simp only [det3I, dotI, crossI, hsub]; ring

name: edgeDet_eq_wedge
statement:
theorem edgeDet_eq_wedge {f : PFace} (hp : PFacePrep f) (hw : f.h0.w ≠ 0)
    {N Dn : ℤ} {qh : H4} {di : I3}
    (hN : N = qh.w * f.nd0 - f.h0.w * dotI f.nrmI ⟨qh.x, qh.y, qh.z⟩)
    (hDn : Dn = dotI f.nrmI di)
    (hk : H4) (E : I3)
    (hE : dotI f.nrmI E = 0)
    (hkp : dotI f.nrmI (hsub hk f.h0) = 0) :
    dotI E (crossI (hsub ⟨Dn * f.h0.w * qh.x + N * di.x, Dn * f.h0.w * qh.y + N * di.y,
                          Dn * f.h0.w * qh.z + N * di.z, Dn * f.h0.w * qh.w⟩ hk) f.nrmI)
      = f.h0.w * dotI f.nrmI f.nrmI * wedgeOf hk E qh di
proof:
:= by
  
  have hNeq : N = dotI f.nrmI (hsub f.h0 qh) := by
    rw [hN, hp.nd0]; simp only [dotI, hsub]; ring
  
  have hshift : f.h0.w * dotI f.nrmI (hsub hk qh) = hk.w * N := by
    have h := dotI_hsub_shift f.nrmI hk f.h0 qh
    rw [hkp, ← hNeq] at h
    simpa using h
  
  have hsplit := edgeDet_split E f.nrmI di hk qh N (Dn * f.h0.w)
  
  have hlag := dotI_self_mul_det3I f.nrmI (hsub hk qh) E di
  rw [hE, zero_mul, add_zero] at hlag
  
  have hc1 : det3I E di f.nrmI = det3I f.nrmI E di := det3I_cyc _ _ _
  have hc2 : det3I E (hsub hk qh) f.nrmI = - det3I f.nrmI (hsub hk qh) E := by
    rw [det3I_cyc E (hsub hk qh) f.nrmI, det3I_swap23]
  
  refine mul_left_cancel₀ hw ?_
  rw [hsplit, wedgeOf_eq_det3I, hc1, hc2]
  linear_combination (-(f.h0.w * det3I f.nrmI E di)) * hshift
    + (f.h0.w * f.h0.w * det3I f.nrmI (hsub hk qh) E) * hDn
    + (-(f.h0.w * f.h0.w)) * hlag

name: edgeDetsI_eq_wedges
statement:
theorem edgeDetsI_eq_wedges {f : PFace} (hp : PFacePrep f) (hw : f.h0.w ≠ 0)
    {N Dn : ℤ} {qh : H4} {di : I3}
    (hN : N = qh.w * f.nd0 - f.h0.w * dotI f.nrmI ⟨qh.x, qh.y, qh.z⟩)
    (hDn : Dn = dotI f.nrmI di) :
    edgeDetsI f f.nrmI N Dn qh di
      = (f.h0.w * dotI f.nrmI f.nrmI * wedgeOf f.h0 f.e01 qh di,
         f.h0.w * dotI f.nrmI f.nrmI * wedgeOf f.h1 f.e12 qh di,
         f.h0.w * dotI f.nrmI f.nrmI * wedgeOf f.h2 f.e20 qh di)
proof:
:= by
  have h0 : dotI f.nrmI (hsub f.h0 f.h0) = 0 := by simp only [dotI, hsub]; ring
  have h1 : dotI f.nrmI (hsub f.h1 f.h0) = 0 := prep_dotI_h1h0 hp
  have h2 : dotI f.nrmI (hsub f.h2 f.h0) = 0 := prep_dotI_h2h0 hp
  simp only [edgeDetsI, Prod.mk.injEq]
  refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · exact edgeDet_eq_wedge hp hw hN hDn f.h0 f.e01 (prep_dotI_e01 hp) h0
  · exact edgeDet_eq_wedge hp hw hN hDn f.h1 f.e12 (prep_dotI_e12 hp hw) h1
  · exact edgeDet_eq_wedge hp hw hN hDn f.h2 f.e20 (prep_dotI_e20 hp) h2

name: scale_signs
statement:
theorem scale_signs {c W : ℤ} (hc : 0 < c) :
    (0 < c * W ↔ 0 < W) ∧ (c * W < 0 ↔ W < 0) ∧
    (0 ≤ c * W ↔ 0 ≤ W) ∧ (c * W ≤ 0 ↔ W ≤ 0) ∧ (c * W = 0 ↔ W = 0)
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨⟨fun h => ?_, fun h => ?_⟩, ⟨fun h => ?_, fun h => ?_⟩,
    ⟨fun h => ?_, fun h => ?_⟩, ⟨fun h => ?_, fun h => ?_⟩,
    ⟨fun h => ?_, fun h => by simp [h]⟩⟩ <;> nlinarith

name: edgeDet_factor_pos
statement:
theorem edgeDet_factor_pos {f : PFace} (hw : 0 < f.h0.w) {di : I3}
    (hDn : dotI f.nrmI di ≠ 0) : 0 < f.h0.w * dotI f.nrmI f.nrmI
proof:
:=
  mul_pos hw (dotI_self_pos_of_dot_ne hDn)

name: edgeDetsI_eq_scaled_wedges
statement:
theorem edgeDetsI_eq_scaled_wedges {f : PFace} (hp : PFacePrep f) (hw : 0 < f.h0.w)
    (qh : H4) (di : I3) :
    edgeDetsI f f.nrmI (qh.w * f.nd0 - f.h0.w * dotI f.nrmI ⟨qh.x, qh.y, qh.z⟩)
        (dotI f.nrmI di) qh di
      = (f.h0.w * dotI f.nrmI f.nrmI * wedgeOf f.h0 f.e01 qh di,
         f.h0.w * dotI f.nrmI f.nrmI * wedgeOf f.h1 f.e12 qh di,
         f.h0.w * dotI f.nrmI f.nrmI * wedgeOf f.h2 f.e20 qh di)
proof:
:=
  edgeDetsI_eq_wedges hp (ne_of_gt hw) rfl rfl

name: wedge_eq_zero_iff
proof:
:=
  (scale_signs (edgeDet_factor_pos hw hDn)).2.2.2.2

name: wedge_sign
statement:
theorem wedge_sign {f : PFace} (hw : 0 < f.h0.w) {di : I3}
    (hDn : dotI f.nrmI di ≠ 0) (W : ℤ) :
    (0 < f.h0.w * dotI f.nrmI f.nrmI * W ↔ 0 < W) ∧
    (f.h0.w * dotI f.nrmI f.nrmI * W < 0 ↔ W < 0)
proof:
:=
  ⟨(scale_signs (edgeDet_factor_pos hw hDn)).1, (scale_signs (edgeDet_factor_pos hw hDn)).2.1⟩

name: rayFaceCrossW_eq
statement:
theorem rayFaceCrossW_eq {f : PFace} (hp : PFacePrep f) (hw : 0 < f.h0.w) (qh : H4) (di : I3) :
    rayFaceCrossW f qh di = rayFaceCross f qh di
proof:
:= by
  simp only [rayFaceCrossW, rayFaceCross]
  by_cases hz : (dotI f.nrmI di == 0) = true
  · rw [if_pos hz, if_pos hz]
  · rw [if_neg hz, if_neg hz]
    by_cases hf : (if 0 < dotI f.nrmI di then decide
        (qh.w * f.nd0 - f.h0.w * dotI f.nrmI ⟨qh.x, qh.y, qh.z⟩ ≤ 0)
      else decide (0 ≤ qh.w * f.nd0 - f.h0.w * dotI f.nrmI ⟨qh.x, qh.y, qh.z⟩)) = true
    · rw [if_pos hf, if_pos hf]
    · rw [if_neg hf, if_neg hf]
      have hDn : dotI f.nrmI di ≠ 0 := by simpa using hz
      have hc : 0 < f.h0.w * dotI f.nrmI f.nrmI := edgeDet_factor_pos hw hDn
      rw [edgeDetsI_eq_scaled_wedges hp hw qh di]
      simp only [wedgeOf]
      set c := f.h0.w * dotI f.nrmI f.nrmI with hcdef
      set W0 := dotI (crossI (hsub f.h0 qh) f.e01) di with hW0
      set W1 := dotI (crossI (hsub f.h1 qh) f.e12) di with hW1
      set W2 := dotI (crossI (hsub f.h2 qh) f.e20) di with hW2
      have s0 := scale_signs (c := c) (W := W0) hc
      have s1 := scale_signs (c := c) (W := W1) hc
      have s2 := scale_signs (c := c) (W := W2) hc
      by_cases hzero : (W0 == 0 || W1 == 0 || W2 == 0) = true
      · rw [if_pos hzero]
      · rw [if_neg hzero]
        simp only [Bool.or_eq_true, beq_iff_eq, not_or] at hzero
        obtain ⟨⟨hn0, hn1⟩, hn2⟩ := hzero
        by_cases hDpos : 0 < dotI f.nrmI di
        · rw [if_pos hDpos]
          simp only [Bool.and_eq_true, Bool.or_eq_true, decide_eq_true_eq,
            s0.1, s0.2.1, s0.2.2.1, s0.2.2.2, s1.1, s1.2.1, s1.2.2.1, s1.2.2.2,
            s2.1, s2.2.1, s2.2.2.1, s2.2.2.2]
          split_ifs <;> first | rfl | (exfalso; omega)
        · rw [if_neg hDpos]
          simp only [Bool.and_eq_true, Bool.or_eq_true, decide_eq_true_eq,
            s0.1, s0.2.1, s0.2.2.1, s0.2.2.2, s1.1, s1.2.1, s1.2.2.1, s1.2.2.2,
            s2.1, s2.2.1, s2.2.2.1, s2.2.2.2]
          split_ifs <;> first | rfl | (exfalso; omega)

name: rayFaceCrossW_eq_of_nrmI_zero
statement:
theorem rayFaceCrossW_eq_of_nrmI_zero {f : PFace} (h : f.nrmI = ⟨0, 0, 0⟩)
    (qh : H4) (di : I3) : rayFaceCrossW f qh di = rayFaceCross f qh di
proof:
:= by
  have hz : (dotI f.nrmI di == 0) = true := by simp [h, dotI]
  simp only [rayFaceCrossW, rayFaceCross]
  rw [if_pos hz, if_pos hz]

name: rayFaceCrossW1_eq
statement:
theorem rayFaceCrossW1_eq (f : PFace) (qh : H4) :
    rayFaceCrossW1 f qh = rayFaceCrossW f qh ⟨1, 0, 0⟩
proof:
:= by
  simp only [rayFaceCrossW1, rayFaceCrossW, dotI, crossI, hsub,
    mul_one, mul_zero, add_zero, zero_add]

name: H4Repr.cross
statement:
theorem H4Repr.cross {q q' : H4} {p : P3} (h : H4Repr q p) (h' : H4Repr q' p) :
    q.x * q'.w = q'.x * q.w ∧ q.y * q'.w = q'.y * q.w ∧ q.z * q'.w = q'.z * q.w
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨-, hx, hy, hz⟩ := h
  obtain ⟨-, hx', hy', hz'⟩ := h'
  refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · have e : ((q.x * q'.w : ℤ) : ℚ) = ((q'.x * q.w : ℤ) : ℚ) := by
      push_cast; rw [hx, hx']; ring
    exact_mod_cast e
  · have e : ((q.y * q'.w : ℤ) : ℚ) = ((q'.y * q.w : ℤ) : ℚ) := by
      push_cast; rw [hy, hy']; ring
    exact_mod_cast e
  · have e : ((q.z * q'.w : ℤ) : ℚ) = ((q'.z * q.w : ℤ) : ℚ) := by
      push_cast; rw [hz, hz']; ring
    exact_mod_cast e

name: sign_transfer
statement:
theorem sign_transfer {a b w w' : ℤ} (hw : 0 < w) (hw' : 0 < w') (h : a * w = b * w') :
    (0 < a ↔ 0 < b) ∧ (a < 0 ↔ b < 0) ∧ (0 ≤ a ↔ 0 ≤ b) ∧ (a ≤ 0 ↔ b ≤ 0) ∧
      (a = 0 ↔ b = 0)
proof:
:= by
  have e1 : ∀ x y : ℤ, 0 < y → (0 < x * y ↔ 0 < x) := by
    intro x y hy; rw [mul_pos_iff]; omega
  have e2 : ∀ x y : ℤ, 0 < y → (x * y < 0 ↔ x < 0) := by
    intro x y hy; rw [mul_neg_iff]; omega
  have e3 : ∀ x y : ℤ, 0 < y → (0 ≤ x * y ↔ 0 ≤ x) := by
    intro x y hy; rw [mul_nonneg_iff]; omega
  have e4 : ∀ x y : ℤ, 0 < y → (x * y ≤ 0 ↔ x ≤ 0) := by
    intro x y hy; rw [mul_nonpos_iff]; omega
  have e5 : ∀ x y : ℤ, 0 < y → (x * y = 0 ↔ x = 0) := by
    intro x y hy; rw [mul_eq_zero]; omega
  refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · rw [← e1 a w hw, h, e1 b w' hw']
  · rw [← e2 a w hw, h, e2 b w' hw']
  · rw [← e3 a w hw, h, e3 b w' hw']
  · rw [← e4 a w hw, h, e4 b w' hw']
  · rw [← e5 a w hw, h, e5 b w' hw']

name: N_scale
statement:
theorem N_scale (f : PFace) {qh qh' : H4}
    (hx : qh.x * qh'.w = qh'.x * qh.w) (hy : qh.y * qh'.w = qh'.y * qh.w)
    (hz : qh.z * qh'.w = qh'.z * qh.w) :
    (qh.w * f.nd0 - f.h0.w * dotI f.nrmI ⟨qh.x, qh.y, qh.z⟩) * qh'.w
      = (qh'.w * f.nd0 - f.h0.w * dotI f.nrmI ⟨qh'.x, qh'.y, qh'.z⟩) * qh.w
proof:
:= by
  simp only [dotI]
  linear_combination (-(f.h0.w * f.nrmI.x)) * hx + (-(f.h0.w * f.nrmI.y)) * hy
    + (-(f.h0.w * f.nrmI.z)) * hz

name: dotI_hsub_scale
statement:
theorem dotI_hsub_scale (hk : H4) (m : I3) {qh qh' : H4}
    (hx : qh.x * qh'.w = qh'.x * qh.w) (hy : qh.y * qh'.w = qh'.y * qh.w)
    (hz : qh.z * qh'.w = qh'.z * qh.w) :
    dotI m (hsub hk qh) * qh'.w = dotI m (hsub hk qh') * qh.w
proof:
:= by
  simp only [dotI, hsub]
  linear_combination (-(m.x * hk.w)) * hx + (-(m.y * hk.w)) * hy + (-(m.z * hk.w)) * hz

name: edgeDet_scale
statement:
theorem edgeDet_scale (E n di : I3) (hk : H4) {qh qh' : H4} {N N' dw : ℤ}
    (hN : N * qh'.w = N' * qh.w)
    (hx : qh.x * qh'.w = qh'.x * qh.w) (hy : qh.y * qh'.w = qh'.y * qh.w)
    (hz : qh.z * qh'.w = qh'.z * qh.w) :
    dotI E (crossI (hsub ⟨dw * qh.x + N * di.x, dw * qh.y + N * di.y,
                          dw * qh.z + N * di.z, dw * qh.w⟩ hk) n) * qh'.w
      = dotI E (crossI (hsub ⟨dw * qh'.x + N' * di.x, dw * qh'.y + N' * di.y,
                          dw * qh'.z + N' * di.z, dw * qh'.w⟩ hk) n) * qh.w
proof:
:= by
  rw [edgeDet_split, edgeDet_split]
  have hA : ∀ q : H4, det3I E (hsub hk q) n = dotI (crossI n E) (hsub hk q) := by
    intro q; simp only [det3I, dotI, crossI, hsub]; ring
  rw [hA, hA]
  have hs := dotI_hsub_scale hk (crossI n E) hx hy hz
  linear_combination (hk.w * det3I E di n) * hN + (-dw) * hs

name: rayFaceCross_congr
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨hx, hy, hz⟩ := h.cross h'
  have hw : 0 < qh.w := h.1
  have hw' : 0 < qh'.w := h'.1
  simp only [rayFaceCross]
  set Dn := dotI f.nrmI di with hDndef
  set N := qh.w * f.nd0 - f.h0.w * dotI f.nrmI ⟨qh.x, qh.y, qh.z⟩ with hNdef
  set N' := qh'.w * f.nd0 - f.h0.w * dotI f.nrmI ⟨qh'.x, qh'.y, qh'.z⟩ with hN'def
  have hNs : N * qh'.w = N' * qh.w := N_scale f hx hy hz
  obtain ⟨sN1, sN2, sN3, sN4, sN5⟩ := sign_transfer hw' hw hNs
  obtain ⟨e0, e1, e2, he⟩ : ∃ a b c : ℤ, edgeDetsI f f.nrmI N Dn qh di = (a, b, c) :=
    ⟨_, _, _, rfl⟩
  obtain ⟨e0', e1', e2', he'⟩ : ∃ a b c : ℤ, edgeDetsI f f.nrmI N' Dn qh' di = (a, b, c) :=
    ⟨_, _, _, rfl⟩
  have hscale : e0 * qh'.w = e0' * qh.w ∧ e1 * qh'.w = e1' * qh.w ∧
      e2 * qh'.w = e2' * qh.w := by
    have h1 := edgeDet_scale f.e01 f.nrmI di f.h0 (dw := Dn * f.h0.w) hNs hx hy hz
