    have h2 := edgeDet_scale f.e12 f.nrmI di f.h1 (dw := Dn * f.h0.w) hNs hx hy hz
    have h3 := edgeDet_scale f.e20 f.nrmI di f.h2 (dw := Dn * f.h0.w) hNs hx hy hz
    simp only [edgeDetsI, Prod.mk.injEq] at he he'
    exact ⟨by rw [← he.1, ← he'.1]; exact h1,
           by rw [← he.2.1, ← he'.2.1]; exact h2,
           by rw [← he.2.2, ← he'.2.2]; exact h3⟩
  obtain ⟨sc0, sc1, sc2⟩ := hscale
  obtain ⟨t01, t02, t03, t04, t05⟩ := sign_transfer hw' hw sc0
  obtain ⟨t11, t12, t13, t14, t15⟩ := sign_transfer hw' hw sc1
  obtain ⟨t21, t22, t23, t24, t25⟩ := sign_transfer hw' hw sc2
  clear_value Dn N N'
  rw [he, he']
  by_cases hz0 : (Dn == 0) = true
  · rw [if_pos hz0, if_pos hz0]
    simp only [beq_iff_eq, sN5]
  · rw [if_neg hz0, if_neg hz0]
    have hfwd : ((if 0 < Dn then decide (N ≤ 0) else decide (0 ≤ N)) = true)
        ↔ ((if 0 < Dn then decide (N' ≤ 0) else decide (0 ≤ N')) = true) := by
      by_cases hDpos : 0 < Dn
      · simp only [if_pos hDpos, decide_eq_true_eq, sN4]
      · simp only [if_neg hDpos, decide_eq_true_eq, sN3]
    by_cases hf : (if 0 < Dn then decide (N ≤ 0) else decide (0 ≤ N)) = true
    · rw [if_pos hf, if_pos (hfwd.mp hf)]
    · rw [if_neg hf, if_neg (fun hc => hf (hfwd.mpr hc))]
      simp only [Bool.and_eq_true, Bool.or_eq_true, decide_eq_true_eq,
        t01, t02, t03, t04, t11, t12, t13, t14, t21, t22, t23, t24]

name: num_cast_eq
statement:
private theorem num_cast_eq {q : ℚ} {L : ℕ} (hd : q.den ∣ L) :
    ((((Int.ofNat L : ℤ) : ℚ) * q).num : ℚ) = (L : ℚ) * q
proof:
:= by
  have hcast : ((Int.ofNat L : ℤ) : ℚ) = (L : ℚ) := by norm_cast
  rw [hcast]
  obtain ⟨k, hk⟩ := hd
  have hden : q * (q.den : ℚ) = (q.num : ℚ) := by
    have hd0 : ((q.den : ℕ) : ℚ) ≠ 0 := by exact_mod_cast q.den_ne_zero
    have h := Rat.num_div_den q
    rw [div_eq_iff hd0] at h
    exact h.symm
  have heq : (L : ℚ) * q = ((q.num * k : ℤ) : ℚ) := by
    rw [hk]; push_cast; linear_combination (k : ℚ) * hden
  rw [heq, Rat.num_intCast]

name: toH4_H4Repr
statement: theorem toH4_H4Repr (p : P3) : H4Repr (toH4 p) p
proof:
:= by
  have hLne : (p.x.den.lcm p.y.den).lcm p.z.den ≠ 0 :=
    Nat.lcm_ne_zero (Nat.lcm_ne_zero (Rat.den_ne_zero _) (Rat.den_ne_zero _))
      (Rat.den_ne_zero _)
  refine ⟨Int.ofNat_pos.mpr (Nat.pos_of_ne_zero hLne), ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · rw [show (toH4 p).w = Int.ofNat ((p.x.den.lcm p.y.den).lcm p.z.den) from rfl,
      show (toH4 p).x = ((Int.ofNat ((p.x.den.lcm p.y.den).lcm p.z.den) : ℚ) * p.x).num from rfl]
    rw [num_cast_eq (dvd_trans (Nat.dvd_lcm_left _ _) (Nat.dvd_lcm_left _ _))]
    norm_cast
  · rw [show (toH4 p).w = Int.ofNat ((p.x.den.lcm p.y.den).lcm p.z.den) from rfl,
      show (toH4 p).y = ((Int.ofNat ((p.x.den.lcm p.y.den).lcm p.z.den) : ℚ) * p.y).num from rfl]
    rw [num_cast_eq (dvd_trans (Nat.dvd_lcm_right _ _) (Nat.dvd_lcm_left _ _))]
    norm_cast
  · rw [show (toH4 p).w = Int.ofNat ((p.x.den.lcm p.y.den).lcm p.z.den) from rfl,
      show (toH4 p).z = ((Int.ofNat ((p.x.den.lcm p.y.den).lcm p.z.den) : ℚ) * p.z).num from rfl]
    rw [num_cast_eq (Nat.dvd_lcm_right _ _)]
    norm_cast

name: floor_int_div
statement: theorem floor_int_div {a b : ℤ} (hb : 0 < b) : ⌊(a : ℚ) / (b : ℚ)⌋ = a / b
proof:
:= by
  lift b to ℕ using hb.le
  exact_mod_cast Rat.floor_intCast_div_natCast a b

name: dyFloor_eq_floor
statement:
theorem dyFloor_eq_floor {n d : ℤ} (hd : 0 < d) (e : ℤ) :
    Impl.BVH.dyFloor n d e = ⌊(n : ℚ) / (d : ℚ) / (2 : ℚ) ^ e⌋
proof:
:= by
  rcases le_or_lt 0 e with he | he
  · obtain ⟨m, rfl⟩ := Int.eq_ofNat_of_zero_le he
    have hdm : (0:ℤ) < d * 2 ^ m := by positivity
    have hval : (n : ℚ) / (d : ℚ) / (2:ℚ) ^ ((m : ℤ)) = (n : ℚ) / ((d * 2 ^ m : ℤ) : ℚ) := by
      push_cast
      rw [zpow_natCast, div_div]
    simp only [Impl.BVH.dyFloor, if_pos he, Int.toNat_natCast]
    rw [Int.fdiv_eq_ediv _ hdm.le, hval, floor_int_div hdm]
  · obtain ⟨k, rfl⟩ : ∃ k : ℕ, e = -(k:ℤ) := ⟨(-e).toNat, by omega⟩
    have hif : ¬ ((0:ℤ) ≤ -(k:ℤ)) := by omega
    have hd0 : (d : ℚ) ≠ 0 := by exact_mod_cast hd.ne'
    have hval : (n : ℚ) / (d : ℚ) / (2:ℚ) ^ (-(k:ℤ)) = ((n * 2 ^ k : ℤ) : ℚ) / (d : ℚ) := by
      push_cast
      rw [zpow_neg, zpow_natCast]
      field_simp
    simp only [Impl.BVH.dyFloor, if_neg hif, neg_neg, Int.toNat_natCast]
    rw [Int.fdiv_eq_ediv _ hd.le, hval, floor_int_div hd]

name: dyFloor_congr
statement:
theorem dyFloor_congr {n d n' d' : ℤ} (hd : 0 < d) (hd' : 0 < d')
    (h : (n : ℚ) / (d : ℚ) = (n' : ℚ) / (d' : ℚ)) (e : ℤ) :
    Impl.BVH.dyFloor n d e = Impl.BVH.dyFloor n' d' e
proof:
:= by
  rw [dyFloor_eq_floor hd, dyFloor_eq_floor hd', h]

name: dyCeil_congr
statement:
theorem dyCeil_congr {n d n' d' : ℤ} (hd : 0 < d) (hd' : 0 < d')
    (h : (n : ℚ) / (d : ℚ) = (n' : ℚ) / (d' : ℚ)) (e : ℤ) :
    Impl.BVH.dyCeil n d e = Impl.BVH.dyCeil n' d' e
proof:
:= by
  simp only [Impl.BVH.dyCeil]
  congr 1
  refine dyFloor_congr hd hd' ?_ e
  push_cast
  rw [neg_div, neg_div, h]

name: dyFloor_scale
statement:
theorem dyFloor_scale {n d k : ℤ} (hd : 0 < d) (hk : 0 < k) (e : ℤ) :
    Impl.BVH.dyFloor (k * n) (k * d) e = Impl.BVH.dyFloor n d e
proof:
:= by
  refine dyFloor_congr (by positivity) hd ?_ e
  have hk0 : (k : ℚ) ≠ 0 := by exact_mod_cast hk.ne'
  have hd0 : (d : ℚ) ≠ 0 := by exact_mod_cast hd.ne'
  push_cast
  field_simp
  ring

name: offset_ratio
statement:
theorem offset_ratio {xn xd : ℤ} (hxd : 0 < xd) (a : ℚ) :
    ((xn * (a.den:ℤ) - a.num * xd : ℤ) : ℚ) / (((a.den:ℤ) * xd : ℤ) : ℚ)
      = (xn : ℚ) / (xd : ℚ) - a
proof:
:= by
  have hd0 : ((a.den : ℕ) : ℚ) ≠ 0 := by
    have := a.den_ne_zero; exact_mod_cast this
  have hx0 : ((xd : ℤ) : ℚ) ≠ 0 := by exact_mod_cast hxd.ne'
  have ha : (a.num : ℚ) = a * (a.den : ℚ) := (div_eq_iff hd0).mp (Rat.num_div_den a)
  push_cast
  rw [ha]
  field_simp
  linear_combination (-((xd : ℚ)) ^ 2) * ha

name: daxisParamND_eq
statement:
theorem daxisParamND_eq (dα : ℚ) {xn xd : ℤ} (hxd : 0 < xd) (a : ℚ) (e : ℤ) :
    Impl.BVH.daxisParamND dα xn xd a e
      = Impl.BVH.daxisParam dα ((xn : ℚ) / (xd : ℚ)) a e
proof:
:= by
  set X : ℚ := (xn : ℚ) / (xd : ℚ) with hX
  have hdenpos : (0:ℤ) < (X.den : ℤ) := by exact_mod_cast X.pos
  have hd1 : (0:ℤ) < (a.den : ℤ) * xd := by
    have : (0:ℤ) < (a.den : ℤ) := by exact_mod_cast a.pos
    positivity
  have hd2 : (0:ℤ) < (a.den : ℤ) * (X.den : ℤ) := by
    have : (0:ℤ) < (a.den : ℤ) := by exact_mod_cast a.pos
    positivity
  have hratio : ((xn * (a.den:ℤ) - a.num * xd : ℤ) : ℚ) / (((a.den:ℤ) * xd : ℤ) : ℚ)
      = ((X.num * (a.den:ℤ) - a.num * (X.den:ℤ) : ℤ) : ℚ)
        / (((a.den:ℤ) * (X.den:ℤ) : ℤ) : ℚ) := by
    rw [offset_ratio hxd a, offset_ratio hdenpos a, ← hX]
    congr 1
    exact_mod_cast (Rat.num_div_den X).symm
  simp only [Impl.BVH.daxisParamND, Impl.BVH.daxisParam,
    dyFloor_congr hd1 hd2 hratio e,
    dyCeil_congr hd1 hd2 hratio e]

name: rayQueryFwdND_eq
statement:
theorem rayQueryFwdND_eq (h : Impl.BVH.BVH) {xn yn zn xw : ℤ} (hw : 0 < xw)
    (d : Impl.BVH.Pt) :
    Impl.BVH.rayQueryFwdND h xn yn zn xw d
      = Impl.BVH.rayQueryFwd h ⟨(xn:ℚ)/(xw:ℚ), (yn:ℚ)/(xw:ℚ), (zn:ℚ)/(xw:ℚ)⟩ d
proof:
:= by
  simp only [Impl.BVH.rayQueryFwdND, Impl.BVH.rayQueryFwd,
    daxisParamND_eq _ hw]
  
  
  
  rfl

name: rayFaceCrossW_eq'
statement:
theorem rayFaceCrossW_eq' {f : PFace} (h : WedgeOK f) (qh : H4) (di : I3) :
    rayFaceCrossW f qh di = rayFaceCross f qh di
proof:
:= by
  rcases h with ⟨hp, hw⟩ | h0
  · exact rayFaceCrossW_eq hp hw qh di
  · exact rayFaceCrossW_eq_of_nrmI_zero h0 qh di

name: rayFaceCrossW1_eq'
statement:
theorem rayFaceCrossW1_eq' {f : PFace} (h : WedgeOK f) (qh : H4) :
    rayFaceCrossW1 f qh = rayFaceCross f qh ⟨1, 0, 0⟩
proof:
:=
  (rayFaceCrossW1_eq f qh).trans (rayFaceCrossW_eq' h qh ⟨1, 0, 0⟩)

name: rayFaceCrossW_congr
proof:
:= by
  rw [rayFaceCrossW_eq' hf, rayFaceCrossW_eq' hf, rayFaceCross_congr f h h' di]

name: rayFaceCrossW1_congr
proof:
:= by
  rw [rayFaceCrossW1_eq' hf, rayFaceCrossW1_eq' hf, rayFaceCross_congr f h h' ⟨1, 0, 0⟩]

name: foldl_congr
statement:
theorem foldl_congr {α β : Type} (F G : β → α → β) (h : ∀ b a, F b a = G b a)
    (init : β) (as : Array α) : as.foldl F init = as.foldl G init
proof:
:= by
  have hfg : F = G := funext fun b => funext fun a => h b a
  rw [hfg]

name: windingRayDir_eq_old
statement:
theorem windingRayDir_eq_old (bvh : Impl.BVH.BVH) (W : Array PFace)
    (hW : ∀ i : ℕ, WedgeOK (W.getD i default)) (Q d : P3) :
    windingRayDir bvh W Q d = windingRayDirOld bvh W Q d
proof:
:= by
  simp only [windingRayDir, windingRayDirOld]
  by_cases hd : (d.x == 1 && d.y == 0 && d.z == 0) = true
  · rw [if_pos hd]
    simp only [Bool.and_eq_true, beq_iff_eq] at hd
    obtain ⟨⟨hx1, hy0⟩, hz0⟩ := hd
    refine foldl_congr _ _ (fun acc i => ?_) _ _
    cases acc with
    | none => rfl
    | some s =>
      rw [rayFaceCrossW1_eq' (hW i)]
      congr 2
      simp [hx1, hy0, hz0]
  · rw [if_neg hd]
    refine foldl_congr _ _ (fun acc i => ?_) _ _
    cases acc with
    | none => rfl
    | some s => simp only [rayFaceCrossW_eq' (hW i)]; rfl

name: windingRayDirH_eq_old
statement:
theorem windingRayDirH_eq_old (bvh : Impl.BVH.BVH) (W : Array PFace)
    (hW : ∀ i : ℕ, WedgeOK (W.getD i default)) {qh : H4} {Q : P3} (hq : H4Repr qh Q)
    (d : P3) : windingRayDirH bvh W qh d = windingRayDirOld bvh W Q d
proof:
:= by
  have hw0 : (qh.w : ℚ) ≠ 0 := by
    have := hq.1; exact_mod_cast this.ne'
  have hcx : (qh.x : ℚ) / (qh.w : ℚ) = Q.x := by rw [hq.2.1]; field_simp
  have hcy : (qh.y : ℚ) / (qh.w : ℚ) = Q.y := by rw [hq.2.2.1]; field_simp
  have hcz : (qh.z : ℚ) / (qh.w : ℚ) = Q.z := by rw [hq.2.2.2]; field_simp
  have hhits : Impl.BVH.rayQueryFwdND bvh qh.x qh.y qh.z qh.w ⟨d.x, d.y, d.z⟩
      = Impl.BVH.rayQueryFwd bvh ⟨Q.x, Q.y, Q.z⟩ ⟨d.x, d.y, d.z⟩ := by
    rw [rayQueryFwdND_eq bvh hq.1, hcx, hcy, hcz]
  have hcongr : ∀ (f : PFace) (di : I3),
      rayFaceCross f qh di = rayFaceCross f (toH4 Q) di :=
    fun f di => rayFaceCross_congr f hq (toH4_H4Repr Q) di
  simp only [windingRayDirH, windingRayDirOld, hhits]
  by_cases hd : (d.x == 1 && d.y == 0 && d.z == 0) = true
  · rw [if_pos hd]
    simp only [Bool.and_eq_true, beq_iff_eq] at hd
    obtain ⟨⟨hx1, hy0⟩, hz0⟩ := hd
    refine foldl_congr _ _ (fun acc i => ?_) _ _
    cases acc with
    | none => rfl
    | some s =>
      rw [rayFaceCrossW1_eq' (hW i), hcongr]
      congr 2
      simp [hx1, hy0, hz0]
  · rw [if_neg hd]
    refine foldl_congr _ _ (fun acc i => ?_) _ _
    cases acc with
    | none => rfl
    | some s => simp only [rayFaceCrossW_eq' (hW i), hcongr]; rfl

name: windingRayDirH_eq
statement:
theorem windingRayDirH_eq (bvh : Impl.BVH.BVH) (W : Array PFace)
    (hW : ∀ i : ℕ, WedgeOK (W.getD i default)) {qh : H4} {Q : P3} (hq : H4Repr qh Q)
    (d : P3) : windingRayDirH bvh W qh d = windingRayDir bvh W Q d
proof:
:=
  (windingRayDirH_eq_old bvh W hW hq d).trans (windingRayDir_eq_old bvh W hW Q d).symm

name: windingAtH_eq
statement:
theorem windingAtH_eq (bvh : Impl.BVH.BVH) (W : Array PFace)
    (hW : ∀ i : ℕ, WedgeOK (W.getD i default)) {qh : H4} {Q : P3} (hq : H4Repr qh Q) :
    windingAtH bvh W qh = windingAt bvh W Q
proof:
:= by
  simp only [windingAtH, windingAt]
  congr 2
  funext j
  exact windingRayDirH_eq bvh W hW hq (rayDirAt j)

name: searchFirst_offset
statement:
theorem searchFirst_offset {α : Type} (attempt : ℕ → Option α) {x : α} :
    ∀ (i s : ℕ), (∀ j, j < i → attempt (s + j) = none) → attempt (s + i) = some x →
      ∀ fuel, i < fuel → searchFirst attempt s fuel = some x
proof:
:= by
  intro i
  induction i with
  | zero =>
    intro s _ hi fuel hf
    obtain ⟨n, rfl⟩ : ∃ n, fuel = n + 1 := ⟨fuel - 1, by omega⟩
    simp only [searchFirst, show attempt s = some x by simpa using hi]
  | succ m ih =>
    intro s hbefore hi fuel hf
    obtain ⟨n, rfl⟩ : ∃ n, fuel = n + 1 := ⟨fuel - 1, by omega⟩
    have h0 : attempt s = none := by simpa using hbefore 0 (by omega)
    simp only [searchFirst, h0]
    refine ih (s + 1) (fun j hj => ?_) ?_ n (by omega)
    · rw [show s + 1 + j = s + (j + 1) by omega]
      exact hbefore (j + 1) (by omega)
    · rw [show s + 1 + m = s + (m + 1) by omega]
      exact hi

name: searchFirst_fuel_mono
statement:
theorem searchFirst_fuel_mono {α : Type} {attempt : ℕ → Option α} {x : α} :
    ∀ {f₁ f₂ s : ℕ}, f₁ ≤ f₂ → searchFirst attempt s f₁ = some x →
      searchFirst attempt s f₂ = some x
proof:
:= by
  intro f₁
  induction f₁ with
  | zero => intro f₂ s _ h; rw [searchFirst] at h; exact absurd h (by simp)
  | succ n ih =>
    intro f₂ s hle h
    obtain ⟨m, rfl⟩ : ∃ m, f₂ = m + 1 := ⟨f₂ - 1, by omega⟩
    rcases ha : attempt s with _ | y
    · simp only [searchFirst, ha] at h ⊢
      exact ih (by omega) h
    · simp only [searchFirst, ha] at h ⊢
      exact h

name: scaled_num
statement:
theorem scaled_num {x w w' : ℤ} (hw : w ≠ 0) (hdvd : w ∣ w') :
    ((x * (w' / w) : ℤ) : ℚ) = (w' : ℚ) * ((x : ℚ) / (w : ℚ))
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨c, rfl⟩ := hdvd
  rw [Int.mul_ediv_cancel_left _ hw]
  have hw0 : (w : ℚ) ≠ 0 := by exact_mod_cast hw
  push_cast
  field_simp
  ring

name: H4Repr.div
statement:
theorem H4Repr.div {q : H4} {p : P3} (h : H4Repr q p) :
    (q.x : ℚ) / (q.w : ℚ) = p.x ∧ (q.y : ℚ) / (q.w : ℚ) = p.y ∧
      (q.z : ℚ) / (q.w : ℚ) = p.z
proof:
:= by
  have hw0 : (q.w : ℚ) ≠ 0 := by have := h.1; exact_mod_cast this.ne'
  exact ⟨by rw [h.2.1]; field_simp, by rw [h.2.2.1]; field_simp,
    by rw [h.2.2.2]; field_simp⟩

name: dvd_of_natAbs_dvd
statement:
theorem dvd_of_natAbs_dvd {w : ℤ} {m : ℕ} (hw : 0 < w) (h : w.natAbs ∣ m) :
    w ∣ (m : ℤ)
proof:
:= by
  have h1 : ((w.natAbs : ℤ)) ∣ ((m : ℤ)) := Int.natCast_dvd_natCast.mpr h
  rwa [Int.natAbs_of_nonneg hw.le] at h1

name: baryH_repr
statement:
theorem baryH_repr {h0 h1 h2 : H4} {p0 p1 p2 : P3} {w' : ℤ}
    (r0 : H4Repr h0 p0) (r1 : H4Repr h1 p1) (r2 : H4Repr h2 p2)
    (hw' : w' = (((h0.w.natAbs.lcm h1.w.natAbs).lcm h2.w.natAbs : ℕ) : ℤ)) :
    H4Repr ⟨h0.x * (w' / h0.w) + h1.x * (w' / h1.w) + h2.x * (w' / h2.w),
            h0.y * (w' / h0.w) + h1.y * (w' / h1.w) + h2.y * (w' / h2.w),
            h0.z * (w' / h0.w) + h1.z * (w' / h1.w) + h2.z * (w' / h2.w), 3 * w'⟩
      (smulS (1 / 3) (paddS p0 (paddS p1 p2)))
proof:
:= by
  have hL : (0:ℕ) < (h0.w.natAbs.lcm h1.w.natAbs).lcm h2.w.natAbs := by
    refine Nat.pos_of_ne_zero (Nat.lcm_ne_zero (Nat.lcm_ne_zero ?_ ?_) ?_) <;>
      simp only [ne_eq, Int.natAbs_eq_zero]
    · exact (r0.1).ne'
    · exact (r1.1).ne'
    · exact (r2.1).ne'
  have hw'pos : 0 < w' := by rw [hw']; exact_mod_cast hL
  have hd0 : h0.w ∣ w' := by
    rw [hw']
    exact dvd_of_natAbs_dvd r0.1 (dvd_trans (Nat.dvd_lcm_left _ _) (Nat.dvd_lcm_left _ _))
  have hd1 : h1.w ∣ w' := by
    rw [hw']
    exact dvd_of_natAbs_dvd r1.1 (dvd_trans (Nat.dvd_lcm_right _ _) (Nat.dvd_lcm_left _ _))
  have hd2 : h2.w ∣ w' := by
    rw [hw']
    exact dvd_of_natAbs_dvd r2.1 (Nat.dvd_lcm_right _ _)
  refine ⟨by positivity, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · simp only [smulS, paddS, Int.cast_add]
    rw [scaled_num r0.1.ne' hd0, scaled_num r1.1.ne' hd1, scaled_num r2.1.ne' hd2,
      r0.div.1, r1.div.1, r2.div.1]
    push_cast
    ring
  · simp only [smulS, paddS, Int.cast_add]
    rw [scaled_num r0.1.ne' hd0, scaled_num r1.1.ne' hd1, scaled_num r2.1.ne' hd2,
      r0.div.2.1, r1.div.2.1, r2.div.2.1]
    push_cast
    ring
  · simp only [smulS, paddS, Int.cast_add]
    rw [scaled_num r0.1.ne' hd0, scaled_num r1.1.ne' hd1, scaled_num r2.1.ne' hd2,
      r0.div.2.2, r1.div.2.2, r2.div.2.2]
    push_cast
    ring

name: lcm_fold_dvd_init
statement:
private theorem lcm_fold_dvd_init : ∀ (l : List Vtx) (a : ℕ),
    a ∣ l.foldl (fun acc v => Nat.lcm acc v.h.w.natAbs) a
proof:
:= by
  intro l
  induction l with
  | nil => intro a; simp
  | cons v l ih =>
    intro a
    exact dvd_trans (Nat.dvd_lcm_left a v.h.w.natAbs) (ih _)

name: lcm_fold_dvd
statement:
private theorem lcm_fold_dvd : ∀ (l : List Vtx) (a : ℕ) (v : Vtx), v ∈ l →
    v.h.w.natAbs ∣ l.foldl (fun acc v => Nat.lcm acc v.h.w.natAbs) a
proof:
:= by
  intro l
  induction l with
  | nil => intro a v hv; exact absurd hv (by simp)
  | cons u l ih =>
    intro a v hv
    rcases List.mem_cons.mp hv with rfl | hv'
    · exact dvd_trans (Nat.dvd_lcm_right a v.h.w.natAbs) (lcm_fold_dvd_init l _)
    · exact ih _ v hv'

name: lcm_fold_ne_zero
statement:
private theorem lcm_fold_ne_zero : ∀ (l : List Vtx) (a : ℕ), a ≠ 0 →
    (∀ v ∈ l, v.h.w ≠ 0) → l.foldl (fun acc v => Nat.lcm acc v.h.w.natAbs) a ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  intro l
  induction l with
  | nil => intro a ha _; simpa using ha
  | cons u l ih =>
    intro a ha h
    refine ih _ (Nat.lcm_ne_zero ha ?_) (fun v hv => h v (List.mem_cons_of_mem _ hv))
    simpa using h u (List.mem_cons_self _ _)

name: paddS_fold
statement:
private theorem paddS_fold : ∀ (l : List Vtx) (a : P3),
    (l.foldl (fun acc v => paddS acc v.p) a).x = a.x + (l.map (fun v => v.p.x)).sum ∧
    (l.foldl (fun acc v => paddS acc v.p) a).y = a.y + (l.map (fun v => v.p.y)).sum ∧
    (l.foldl (fun acc v => paddS acc v.p) a).z = a.z + (l.map (fun v => v.p.z)).sum
proof:
:= by
  intro l
  induction l with
  | nil => intro a; simp
  | cons v l ih =>
    intro a
    obtain ⟨h1, h2, h3⟩ := ih (paddS a v.p)
    refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_⟩ <;> rw [List.foldl_cons] <;>
      [rw [h1]; rw [h2]; rw [h3]] <;> simp only [paddS, List.map_cons, List.sum_cons] <;> ring

name: centroid_fold
statement:
private theorem centroid_fold {w' : ℤ} : ∀ (l : List Vtx),
    (∀ v ∈ l, H4Repr v.h v.p) → (∀ v ∈ l, v.h.w ∣ w') → ∀ a : ℤ × ℤ × ℤ,
    (((l.foldl (fun (acc : ℤ × ℤ × ℤ) v =>
        (acc.1 + v.h.x * (w' / v.h.w), acc.2.1 + v.h.y * (w' / v.h.w),
         acc.2.2 + v.h.z * (w' / v.h.w))) a).1 : ℚ)
      = (a.1 : ℚ) + (w' : ℚ) * (l.map (fun v => v.p.x)).sum) ∧
    (((l.foldl (fun (acc : ℤ × ℤ × ℤ) v =>
        (acc.1 + v.h.x * (w' / v.h.w), acc.2.1 + v.h.y * (w' / v.h.w),
         acc.2.2 + v.h.z * (w' / v.h.w))) a).2.1 : ℚ)
      = (a.2.1 : ℚ) + (w' : ℚ) * (l.map (fun v => v.p.y)).sum) ∧
    (((l.foldl (fun (acc : ℤ × ℤ × ℤ) v =>
        (acc.1 + v.h.x * (w' / v.h.w), acc.2.1 + v.h.y * (w' / v.h.w),
         acc.2.2 + v.h.z * (w' / v.h.w))) a).2.2 : ℚ)
      = (a.2.2 : ℚ) + (w' : ℚ) * (l.map (fun v => v.p.z)).sum)
proof:
:= by
  intro l
  induction l with
  | nil => intro _ _ a; simp
  | cons v l ih =>
    intro hr hd a
    have hrv := hr v (List.mem_cons_self _ _)
    have hdv := hd v (List.mem_cons_self _ _)
    obtain ⟨h1, h2, h3⟩ := ih (fun u hu => hr u (List.mem_cons_of_mem _ hu))
      (fun u hu => hd u (List.mem_cons_of_mem _ hu))
      (a.1 + v.h.x * (w' / v.h.w), a.2.1 + v.h.y * (w' / v.h.w),
       a.2.2 + v.h.z * (w' / v.h.w))
    refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_⟩
    · rw [List.foldl_cons, h1]
      simp only [List.map_cons, List.sum_cons, Int.cast_add]
      rw [scaled_num hrv.1.ne' hdv, hrv.div.1]
      ring
    · rw [List.foldl_cons, h2]
      simp only [List.map_cons, List.sum_cons, Int.cast_add]
      rw [scaled_num hrv.1.ne' hdv, hrv.div.2.1]
      ring
    · rw [List.foldl_cons, h3]
      simp only [List.map_cons, List.sum_cons, Int.cast_add]
      rw [scaled_num hrv.1.ne' hdv, hrv.div.2.2]
      ring

name: fragCentroidH_repr
statement:
theorem fragCentroidH_repr {f : Frag} (hne : f.poly.size ≠ 0) (hm : FragMirrors f) :
    H4Repr (fragCentroidH f) (fragCentroid f)
proof:
:= by
  set l := f.poly.toList with hl
  have hlen : l.length = f.poly.size := by rw [hl, Array.length_toList]
  set w' : ℤ := ((f.poly.foldl (fun acc v => Nat.lcm acc v.h.w.natAbs) 1 : ℕ) : ℤ) with hw'
  have hfold : (f.poly.foldl (fun acc v => Nat.lcm acc v.h.w.natAbs) 1 : ℕ)
      = l.foldl (fun acc v => Nat.lcm acc v.h.w.natAbs) 1 := by
    rw [hl, Array.foldl_toList]
  have hne0 : (f.poly.foldl (fun acc v => Nat.lcm acc v.h.w.natAbs) 1 : ℕ) ≠ 0 := by
    rw [hfold]
    exact lcm_fold_ne_zero l 1 one_ne_zero (fun v hv => (hm v hv).1.ne')
  have hw'pos : 0 < w' := by
    rw [hw']; exact_mod_cast Nat.pos_of_ne_zero hne0
  have hdvd : ∀ v ∈ l, v.h.w ∣ w' := by
    intro v hv
    rw [hw', hfold]
    exact dvd_of_natAbs_dvd (hm v hv).1 (lcm_fold_dvd l 1 v hv)
  have hrpos : (0:ℚ) < (f.poly.size : ℚ) := by
    have : 0 < f.poly.size := Nat.pos_of_ne_zero hne
    exact_mod_cast this
  obtain ⟨hs1, hs2, hs3⟩ := centroid_fold (w' := w') l
    (fun v hv => hm v hv) hdvd (0, 0, 0)
  obtain ⟨hp1, hp2, hp3⟩ := paddS_fold l ⟨0, 0, 0⟩
  have hcx : (fragCentroidH f).x
      = (l.foldl (fun (acc : ℤ × ℤ × ℤ) v =>
          (acc.1 + v.h.x * (w' / v.h.w), acc.2.1 + v.h.y * (w' / v.h.w),
           acc.2.2 + v.h.z * (w' / v.h.w))) (0, 0, 0)).1 := by
    rw [hl, Array.foldl_toList]; rfl
  have hcy : (fragCentroidH f).y
      = (l.foldl (fun (acc : ℤ × ℤ × ℤ) v =>
          (acc.1 + v.h.x * (w' / v.h.w), acc.2.1 + v.h.y * (w' / v.h.w),
           acc.2.2 + v.h.z * (w' / v.h.w))) (0, 0, 0)).2.1 := by
    rw [hl, Array.foldl_toList]; rfl
  have hcz : (fragCentroidH f).z
      = (l.foldl (fun (acc : ℤ × ℤ × ℤ) v =>
          (acc.1 + v.h.x * (w' / v.h.w), acc.2.1 + v.h.y * (w' / v.h.w),
           acc.2.2 + v.h.z * (w' / v.h.w))) (0, 0, 0)).2.2 := by
    rw [hl, Array.foldl_toList]; rfl
  have hcw : (fragCentroidH f).w = (f.poly.size : ℤ) * w' := rfl
  have harr : f.poly.foldl (fun acc v => paddS acc v.p) ⟨0, 0, 0⟩
      = l.foldl (fun acc v => paddS acc v.p) ⟨0, 0, 0⟩ := by
    rw [hl, Array.foldl_toList]
  have hgx : (fragCentroid f).x = (1 / (f.poly.size : ℚ)) * (l.map (fun v => v.p.x)).sum := by
    rw [show (fragCentroid f).x = (1 / (f.poly.size : ℚ))
        * (f.poly.foldl (fun acc v => paddS acc v.p) ⟨0, 0, 0⟩).x from rfl, harr, hp1]
    simp
  have hgy : (fragCentroid f).y = (1 / (f.poly.size : ℚ)) * (l.map (fun v => v.p.y)).sum := by
    rw [show (fragCentroid f).y = (1 / (f.poly.size : ℚ))
        * (f.poly.foldl (fun acc v => paddS acc v.p) ⟨0, 0, 0⟩).y from rfl, harr, hp2]
    simp
  have hgz : (fragCentroid f).z = (1 / (f.poly.size : ℚ)) * (l.map (fun v => v.p.z)).sum := by
    rw [show (fragCentroid f).z = (1 / (f.poly.size : ℚ))
        * (f.poly.foldl (fun acc v => paddS acc v.p) ⟨0, 0, 0⟩).z from rfl, harr, hp3]
    simp
  refine ⟨by rw [hcw]; positivity, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · rw [hcx, hcw, hgx, hs1]; push_cast; field_simp; ring
  · rw [hcy, hcw, hgy, hs2]; push_cast; field_simp; ring
  · rw [hcz, hcw, hgz, hs3]; push_cast; field_simp; ring

name: arr_getD_lt
statement:
theorem arr_getD_lt {α : Type} (a : Array α) (i : ℕ) (d : α) (hi : i < a.size) :
    a.getD i d = a[i]
proof:
:= by
  rw [Array.getD]; simp [hi]

name: arr_getD_ge
statement:
theorem arr_getD_ge {α : Type} (a : Array α) (i : ℕ) (d : α) (hi : ¬ i < a.size) :
    a.getD i d = d
proof:
:= by
  rw [Array.getD]; simp [hi]

name: prepare_getD_wedgeOK
statement:
theorem prepare_getD_wedgeOK (A : Array FaceS)
    (hA : ∀ (i : ℕ) (hi : i < A.size), 0 < (A[i]'hi).v₀.h.w) (i : ℕ) :
    WedgeOK ((prepare A).getD i default)
proof:
:= by
  have hsz : (prepare A).size = A.size := by simp [prepare]
  by_cases hi : i < A.size
  · rw [arr_getD_lt _ _ _ (by rw [hsz]; exact hi)]
    refine Or.inl ⟨?_, ?_⟩
    · simp only [prepare, Array.getElem_map]
      exact ⟨rfl, rfl, rfl, rfl, rfl⟩
    · simp only [prepare, Array.getElem_map]
      exact hA i hi
  · rw [arr_getD_ge _ _ _ (by rw [hsz]; exact hi)]
    exact Or.inr nrmI_default

name: materialize_wedgeOK
statement:
theorem materialize_wedgeOK (M : Mesh) (i : ℕ) :
    WedgeOK ((prepare (materialize M)).getD i default)
proof:
:= by
  refine prepare_getD_wedgeOK _ (fun j hj => ?_) i
  have hj' : j < M.size := by simpa [materialize] using hj
  rw [show (materialize M)[j] = (materialize M)[j]'hj from rfl]
  simp only [materialize, Array.getElem_map]
  exact (toH4_H4Repr _).1

name: keepFragB_eq
statement:
theorem keepFragB_eq (bvh : Impl.BVH.BVH) (W : Array PFace)
    (hW : ∀ i : ℕ, WedgeOK (W.getD i default)) {f : Frag}
    (hne : f.poly.size ≠ 0) (hm : FragMirrors f) :
    keepFragB bvh W f = (windingAt bvh W (fragCentroid f) == 1)
proof:
:= by
  simp only [keepFragB, windingAtH_eq bvh W hW (fragCentroidH_repr hne hm)]

name: keepFallback_eq
statement:
theorem keepFallback_eq (bvh : Impl.BVH.BVH) (wOpp : Array PFace)
    (hW : ∀ i : ℕ, WedgeOK (wOpp.getD i default)) {fa : Frag}
    (hne : fa.poly.size ≠ 0) (hm : FragMirrors fa) :
    keepFallback bvh wOpp fa = (windingAt bvh wOpp (fragCentroid fa) == 1)
proof:
:= by
  simp only [keepFallback, windingAtH_eq bvh wOpp hW (fragCentroidH_repr hne hm)]

name: not_TrFace_of_coincident_C
statement:
theorem not_TrFace_of_coincident_C (M₁ M₂ : Mesh)
    (h₁ : Legacy.WellFormedMesh M₁) (h₂ : Legacy.WellFormedMesh M₂)
    {Q : Point} (hG : Gen M₁ M₂ Q) (i₀ : Fin M₁.size) (j₀ : Fin M₂.size)
    (hcross : dotQ (detOrigin M₂[j₀] • carrierNormal M₁[i₀]
        - detOrigin M₁[i₀] • carrierNormal M₂[j₀]) Q = 0) :
    coplanarPlane (faceSOf M₂[j₀]).plane (faceSOf M₁[i₀]).plane = true
proof:
:= by
  by_contra hcopF
  rw [Bool.not_eq_true] at hcopF
  
  have hcopF' : coplanarPlane (faceSOf M₁[i₀]).plane (faceSOf M₂[j₀]).plane = false := by
    rwa [Proof.MeshIntersectNsi.coplanarPlane_symm] at hcopF
  have hnp : ¬ Proof.MeshIntersectPrim.RatPropCarrier (carrierNormal M₁[i₀]) (detOrigin M₁[i₀])
      (carrierNormal M₂[j₀]) (detOrigin M₂[j₀]) :=
    Proof.MeshIntersectNsi.not_ratPropCarrier_of_coplanarPlane_false hcopF'
  have htieNZ : detOrigin M₂[j₀] • carrierNormal M₁[i₀]
      - detOrigin M₁[i₀] • carrierNormal M₂[j₀] ≠ 0 :=
    Proof.MeshIntersectPrim.tie_of_transverse (h₁.2.2.2 i₀) (h₂.2.2.2 j₀) hnp
  
  exact (hG.2.2.1 i₀ j₀ htieNZ) hcross

name: copDescA_off_hit_at_C_overlap
statement:
theorem copDescA_off_hit_at_C_overlap (M₁ M₂ : Mesh)
    (h₁ : Legacy.WellFormedMesh M₁) (h₂ : Legacy.WellFormedMesh M₂)
    {Q : Point} (hG : Gen M₁ M₂ Q) {w : ℚ} (hw0 : 0 < w)
    (i₀ : Fin M₁.size) (j₀ : Fin M₂.size)
    (hi₀ : Proof.MeshIntersectDelta.FaceJumps M₁[i₀] Q w)
    (hj₀ : Proof.MeshIntersectDelta.FaceJumps M₂[j₀] Q w)
    (huniq2 : ∀ j j' : Fin M₂.size, Proof.MeshIntersectDelta.FaceJumps M₂[j] Q w →
      Proof.MeshIntersectDelta.FaceJumps M₂[j'] Q w → j = j')
    (hsoF : sameOrient (faceSOf M₁[i₀]).plane (faceSOf M₂[j₀]).plane = false)
    {fa : Frag}
    (hfaClip : fa ∈ clipFaceScoped (fragOfFace ((materialize M₁).getD i₀.1 default))
        (planesForScoped ((materialize M₁).getD i₀.1 default).plane (materialize M₂)
          ((candP M₁ M₂).getD i₀.1 #[])))
    (hfapl : fa.plane = (faceSOf M₁[i₀]).plane)
    {opp : Array Frag}
    (hopp : opp = (splitCoplanar (Proof.MeshIntersectNsi.fragsBOf M₁ M₂) (materialize M₁)).1)
    {f : Frag} (hkeptArm : f ∈ Proof.MeshIntersectResolve.resolveFragKept fa opp) :
    Proof.MeshIntersectStep.faceHit M₁[i₀] Q ∉ Proof.MeshIntersectClip.vpoly (fragCycle f)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  intro hPvf
  have hdetA : detOrigin M₁[i₀] ≠ 0 := h₁.2.2.2 i₀
  have hQ1 : dotQ (carrierNormal M₁[i₀]) Q ≠ 0 := hG.1 i₀
  have hgetDA : (materialize M₁).getD i₀.1 default = faceSOf M₁[i₀] := by
    rw [getD_eq_getElem (materialize M₁) (by rw [materialize_size]; exact i₀.isLt) default,
      materialize_getElem M₁ i₀.1 i₀.isLt]; rfl
  have hbaseInvi : FragInv (carrierNormal M₁[i₀]) (detOrigin M₁[i₀])
      (fragOfFace ((materialize M₁).getD i₀.1 default)) := by
    rw [hgetDA]; exact Proof.MeshIntersectKeep.fragInv_base hdetA
  have hfaInv : FragInv (carrierNormal M₁[i₀]) (detOrigin M₁[i₀]) fa :=
    fragInv_clipFaceScoped hbaseInvi _ hfaClip
  haveI := hfaInv.neZero
  
  
  
  set copB := (splitCoplanar (Proof.MeshIntersectNsi.fragsBOf M₁ M₂) (materialize M₁)).1 with hcopB
  subst opp
  have hoppInv : ∀ fb ∈ copB, ∃ n' c', FragInv n' c' fb
      ∧ (coplanarPlane fa.plane fb.plane = true →
          ∃ ρ : ℚ, ρ ≠ 0 ∧ n' = ρ • carrierNormal M₁[i₀] ∧ c' = ρ * detOrigin M₁[i₀]) :=
    copB_hoppInv h₂.2.2.2 hdetA hfapl
  obtain ⟨fb, hfbmem, hsofb, hsubfb⟩ :=
    Proof.MeshIntersectResolve.SameOrientOppSubset copB hfaInv hoppInv hkeptArm
  obtain ⟨j, hj, hfbInv, hdj, hfbpl, hfbclip⟩ := Proof.MeshIntersectNsi.copB_carrier h₂.2.2.2 hfbmem
  have hjMz : j < (materialize M₂).size := by rw [materialize_size]; exact hj
  have hgetDj : (materialize M₂).getD j default = faceSOf (M₂[j]'hj) := by
    rw [Proof.MeshIntersectKeep.arr_getD _ _ _ hjMz, materialize_getElem M₂ j hj]
  have hbasej : FragInv (carrierNormal (M₂[j]'hj)) (detOrigin (M₂[j]'hj))
      (fragOfFace ((materialize M₂).getD j default)) := by
    rw [hgetDj]; exact Proof.MeshIntersectKeep.fragInv_base hdj
  have hsubT : Proof.MeshIntersectClip.vpoly (fragCycle fb) ⊆ triangleSet (M₂[j]'hj) := by
    refine (Proof.MeshIntersectClipBridge.clipFaceScoped_vpoly_subset hbasej _ hfbclip).trans ?_
    rw [hgetDj, Proof.MeshIntersectKeep.vpoly_fragOfFace]
  have hPtj : Proof.MeshIntersectStep.faceHit M₁[i₀] Q ∈ triangleSet (M₂[j]'hj) :=
    hsubT (hsubfb hPvf)
  have hQj : dotQ (carrierNormal (M₂[j]'hj)) Q ≠ 0 := hG.2.1 ⟨j, hj⟩
  have hcopij : coplanarPlane (faceSOf M₁[i₀]).plane (faceSOf (M₂[j]'hj)).plane = true := by
    rw [← hfapl, ← hfbpl]
    exact Proof.MeshIntersectResolve.coplanarPlane_of_sameOrient hsofb
  have hmuj : Proof.MeshIntersectDelta.muF (M₂[j]'hj) Q = Proof.MeshIntersectDelta.muF M₁[i₀] Q :=
    Proof.MeshIntersectCopDelta.muF_eq_of_coplanar_carrier hdj hdetA hQj hQ1 hcopij
  have hmujw : Proof.MeshIntersectDelta.muF (M₂[j]'hj) Q = w := by rw [hmuj]; exact hi₀.1
  have hjumpj : Proof.MeshIntersectDelta.FaceJumps (M₂[j]'hj) Q w := by
    refine ⟨hmujw, by rw [hmujw]; exact hw0, ?_⟩
    show Proof.MeshIntersectDelta.hitF (M₂[j]'hj) Q ∈ triangleSet (M₂[j]'hj)
    rw [Proof.MeshIntersectDelta.hitF, hmujw]
    have hwq : (w : ℚ) • Q = Proof.MeshIntersectStep.faceHit M₁[i₀] Q := by
      show w • Q = Proof.MeshIntersectDelta.hitF M₁[i₀] Q
      rw [Proof.MeshIntersectDelta.hitF, show Proof.MeshIntersectDelta.muF M₁[i₀] Q = w from hi₀.1]
    rw [hwq]; exact hPtj
  have hjeq : (⟨j, hj⟩ : Fin M₂.size) = j₀ := huniq2 ⟨j, hj⟩ j₀ hjumpj hj₀
  have hsoTrue : sameOrient (faceSOf M₁[i₀]).plane (faceSOf M₂[j₀]).plane = true := by
    have hfbpl₀ : fb.plane = (faceSOf M₂[j₀]).plane := by
      have hMeq : (M₂[j]'hj) = M₂[j₀] :=
        congrArg (fun (k : Fin M₂.size) => M₂[k]) hjeq
      rw [hfbpl, hMeq]
    have hh : sameOrient fa.plane fb.plane = true := hsofb
    rw [hfapl, hfbpl₀] at hh; exact hh
  rw [hsoF] at hsoTrue; exact Bool.false_ne_true hsoTrue

name: copDescA_off_hit_at_C_pending
statement:
theorem copDescA_off_hit_at_C_pending (M₁ M₂ : Mesh)
    (h₁ : Legacy.WellFormedMesh M₁) (h₂ : Legacy.WellFormedMesh M₂)
    {Q : Point} (hG : Gen M₁ M₂ Q) (i₀ : Fin M₁.size) (j₀ : Fin M₂.size)
    (hcopBA : coplanarPlane (faceSOf M₂[j₀]).plane (faceSOf M₁[i₀]).plane = true)
    (hPS2 : Proof.MeshIntersectStep.faceHit M₁[i₀] Q ∈ triangleSet M₂[j₀])
    {fa : Frag}
    (hfaA : fa ∈ (splitCoplanar (Proof.MeshIntersectNsi.fragsAOf M₁ M₂) (materialize M₂)).1)
    (hfaClip : fa ∈ clipFaceScoped (fragOfFace ((materialize M₁).getD i₀.1 default))
        (planesForScoped ((materialize M₁).getD i₀.1 default).plane (materialize M₂)
          ((candP M₁ M₂).getD i₀.1 #[])))
    (hfapl : fa.plane = (faceSOf M₁[i₀]).plane)
    {opp : Array Frag}
    (hopp : opp = (splitCoplanar (Proof.MeshIntersectNsi.fragsBOf M₁ M₂) (materialize M₁)).1)
    {f : Frag} (hpPend : f ∈ Proof.MeshIntersectResolve.resolveFragPending fa opp)
    {bvhW : Impl.BVH.BVH} (_hbvhW : bvhW = faceBVH (prepare (materialize M₂)))
    (hkeepf : keepFallback bvhW (prepare (materialize M₂)) f = true) :
    Proof.MeshIntersectStep.faceHit M₁[i₀] Q ∉ Proof.MeshIntersectClip.vpoly (fragCycle f)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  intro hPvf
  
  
  
  have hPrelf : Proof.MeshIntersectStep.faceHit M₁[i₀] Q
      ∈ Proof.MeshIntersectClip.vrelint (fragCycle f) :=
    cop_cell_relint_dichotomy_pending M₁ M₂ h₁ h₂ hG i₀ hfaClip hopp hpPend hPvf
  have hdetA : detOrigin M₁[i₀] ≠ 0 := h₁.2.2.2 i₀
  have hgetDA : (materialize M₁).getD i₀.1 default = faceSOf M₁[i₀] := by
    rw [getD_eq_getElem (materialize M₁) (by rw [materialize_size]; exact i₀.isLt) default,
      materialize_getElem M₁ i₀.1 i₀.isLt]; rfl
  have hbaseInvi : FragInv (carrierNormal M₁[i₀]) (detOrigin M₁[i₀])
      (fragOfFace ((materialize M₁).getD i₀.1 default)) := by
    rw [hgetDA]; exact Proof.MeshIntersectKeep.fragInv_base hdetA
  have hfaInv : FragInv (carrierNormal M₁[i₀]) (detOrigin M₁[i₀]) fa :=
    fragInv_clipFaceScoped hbaseInvi _ hfaClip
  haveI := hfaInv.neZero
  
  
  
  
  
  
  
  set copB := (splitCoplanar (Proof.MeshIntersectNsi.fragsBOf M₁ M₂) (materialize M₁)).1 with hcopB
  subst opp
  clear_value copB
  
  
  
  
  have hoppInv : ∀ fb ∈ copB, ∃ n' c', FragInv n' c' fb
      ∧ (coplanarPlane fa.plane fb.plane = true →
          ∃ ρ : ℚ, ρ ≠ 0 ∧ n' = ρ • carrierNormal M₁[i₀] ∧ c' = ρ * detOrigin M₁[i₀]) := by
    rw [hcopB]; exact copB_hoppInv h₂.2.2.2 hdetA hfapl
  have hf_res : f ∈ resolveFrag bvhW fa copB (prepare (materialize M₂)) :=
    Proof.MeshIntersectResolve.mem_resolveFrag_of_pending_keepFallback bvhW fa copB
      (prepare (materialize M₂)) hpPend hkeepf
  have hInvDesc : ∀ {n c : _}, FragInv n c fa → FragInv n c f := by
    intro n c hb
    exact Proof.MeshIntersectResolve.resolveFrag_kept_fromFa bvhW copB (prepare (materialize M₂)) hb hf_res
  have havoid : ∀ fb ∈ copB, coplanarPlane fa.plane fb.plane = true →
      Proof.MeshIntersectClip.vrelint (fragCycle f) ∩ Proof.MeshIntersectClip.vrelint (fragCycle fb) = ∅ := by
    intro fb hfbmem hcopfb
    exact Proof.MeshIntersectResolve.resolveFrag_pending_avoids copB hfaInv hoppInv
      hfbmem hcopfb hpPend
  have hcop' : coplanarPlane (faceSOf M₂[j₀]).plane fa.plane = true := by rw [hfapl]; exact hcopBA
  have havoid' : ∀ fb ∈ (splitCoplanar (Proof.MeshIntersectNsi.fragsBOf M₁ M₂) (materialize M₁)).1,
      coplanarPlane fa.plane fb.plane = true →
      Proof.MeshIntersectClip.vrelint (fragCycle f) ∩ Proof.MeshIntersectClip.vrelint (fragCycle fb) = ∅ := by
    rw [← hcopB]; exact havoid
  have hdisj : Proof.MeshIntersectClip.vrelint (fragCycle f) ∩ triangleSet M₂[j₀] = ∅ :=
    Proof.MeshIntersectCop.Aprime_cell_disjoint_coplanar_opponent h₁.2.2.2 h₂.2.2.2
      hfaA hInvDesc havoid' (j := j₀.1) j₀.isLt hcop'
  have hmem : Proof.MeshIntersectStep.faceHit M₁[i₀] Q
      ∈ Proof.MeshIntersectClip.vrelint (fragCycle f) ∩ triangleSet M₂[j₀] := ⟨hPrelf, hPS2⟩
  rw [hdisj] at hmem; exact hmem

name: copDescA_off_hit_at_C_oppOrient
statement:
theorem copDescA_off_hit_at_C_oppOrient (M₁ M₂ : Mesh)
    (h₁ : Legacy.WellFormedMesh M₁) (h₂ : Legacy.WellFormedMesh M₂)
    {Q : Point} (hG : Gen M₁ M₂ Q) {w : ℚ} (hw0 : 0 < w)
    (i₀ : Fin M₁.size) (j₀ : Fin M₂.size)
    (hi₀ : Proof.MeshIntersectDelta.FaceJumps M₁[i₀] Q w)
    (hj₀ : Proof.MeshIntersectDelta.FaceJumps M₂[j₀] Q w)
    (huniq2 : ∀ j j' : Fin M₂.size, Proof.MeshIntersectDelta.FaceJumps M₂[j] Q w →
      Proof.MeshIntersectDelta.FaceJumps M₂[j'] Q w → j = j')
    (hcopBA : coplanarPlane (faceSOf M₂[j₀]).plane (faceSOf M₁[i₀]).plane = true)
    (hPS2 : Proof.MeshIntersectStep.faceHit M₁[i₀] Q ∈ triangleSet M₂[j₀])
    (hsoF : sameOrient (faceSOf M₁[i₀]).plane (faceSOf M₂[j₀]).plane = false) :
    ∀ f ∈ copDescA M₁ M₂ i₀.1,
      Proof.MeshIntersectStep.faceHit M₁[i₀] Q ∉ Proof.MeshIntersectClip.vpoly (fragCycle f)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  intro f hf
  obtain ⟨fa, hfaA, hfapl, hfaClipD, hfmem⟩ := mem_copDescA_parent M₁ M₂ i₀.1 i₀.isLt hf
  rcases Proof.MeshIntersectResolve.mem_resolveFragKept_or_pending _ fa _ _ hfmem with
    hkeptArm | hpendArm
  · exact copDescA_off_hit_at_C_overlap M₁ M₂ h₁ h₂ hG hw0 i₀ j₀ hi₀ hj₀ huniq2 hsoF
      hfaClipD hfapl rfl hkeptArm
  · obtain ⟨hpPend, hkeepf⟩ := Array.mem_filter.mp hpendArm
    exact copDescA_off_hit_at_C_pending M₁ M₂ h₁ h₂ hG i₀ j₀ hcopBA hPS2 hfaA
      hfaClipD hfapl rfl hpPend rfl (by simpa using hkeepf)

name: keptFaceA_collapse_at_C
statement:
theorem keptFaceA_collapse_at_C (M₁ M₂ : Mesh)
    (h₁ : Legacy.WellFormedMesh M₁) (h₂ : Legacy.WellFormedMesh M₂)
    {Q : Point} (hG : Gen M₁ M₂ Q) {w : ℚ} (hw0 : 0 < w)
    (i₀ : Fin M₁.size) (j₀ : Fin M₂.size)
    (hi₀ : Proof.MeshIntersectDelta.FaceJumps M₁[i₀] Q w)
    (hj₀ : Proof.MeshIntersectDelta.FaceJumps M₂[j₀] Q w)
    (huniq2 : ∀ j j' : Fin M₂.size, Proof.MeshIntersectDelta.FaceJumps M₂[j] Q w →
      Proof.MeshIntersectDelta.FaceJumps M₂[j'] Q w → j = j')
    (hcross : dotQ (detOrigin M₂[j₀] • carrierNormal M₁[i₀]
        - detOrigin M₁[i₀] • carrierNormal M₂[j₀]) Q = 0) :
    ((keptFaceA M₁ M₂ i₀.1).toList.map
        (fun f => if Proof.MeshIntersectStep.faceHit M₁[i₀] Q
            ∈ Proof.MeshIntersectClip.vpoly (fragCycle f) then (1 : ℤ) else 0)).sum
      = (if sameOrient (faceSOf M₁[i₀]).plane (faceSOf M₂[j₀]).plane then 1 else 0)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  set P := Proof.MeshIntersectStep.faceHit M₁[i₀] Q with hP
  have hdetA : detOrigin M₁[i₀] ≠ 0 := h₁.2.2.2 i₀
  have hdetB : detOrigin M₂[j₀] ≠ 0 := h₂.2.2.2 j₀
  have hQ1 : dotQ (carrierNormal M₁[i₀]) Q ≠ 0 := hG.1 i₀
  have hQ2 : dotQ (carrierNormal M₂[j₀]) Q ≠ 0 := hG.2.1 j₀
  
  have hcopBA : coplanarPlane (faceSOf M₂[j₀]).plane (faceSOf M₁[i₀]).plane = true :=
    not_TrFace_of_coincident_C M₁ M₂ h₁ h₂ hG i₀ j₀ hcross
  have hcop : ¬ Proof.MeshIntersectCop.TrFace M₁ M₂ i₀.1 i₀.isLt := by
    intro htr
    have hf : coplanarPlane (faceSOf M₂[j₀]).plane (faceSOf M₁[i₀]).plane = false := htr j₀
    rw [hf] at hcopBA; exact Bool.false_ne_true hcopBA
  
  have hmuEq : Proof.MeshIntersectDelta.muF M₁[i₀] Q = Proof.MeshIntersectDelta.muF M₂[j₀] Q :=
    Proof.MeshIntersectCopDelta.muF_eq_of_coplanar_carrier hdetA hdetB hQ1 hQ2 hcopBA
  have hHitEq : Proof.MeshIntersectStep.faceHit M₂[j₀] Q = P := by
    have h1 : Proof.MeshIntersectStep.faceHit M₂[j₀] Q
        = Proof.MeshIntersectDelta.muF M₂[j₀] Q • Q := rfl
    have h2 : Proof.MeshIntersectStep.faceHit M₁[i₀] Q
        = Proof.MeshIntersectDelta.muF M₁[i₀] Q • Q := rfl
    rw [hP, h1, ← hmuEq, ← h2]
  
  have hPS1 : P ∈ triangleSet M₁[i₀] := by
    have h : Proof.MeshIntersectStep.faceHit M₁[i₀] Q ∈ triangleSet M₁[i₀] := hi₀.2.2
    rw [← hP] at h; exact h
  have hPS2 : P ∈ triangleSet M₂[j₀] := by
    have h : Proof.MeshIntersectStep.faceHit M₂[j₀] Q ∈ triangleSet M₂[j₀] := hj₀.2.2
    rw [hHitEq] at h; exact h
  
  have hgetDA : (materialize M₁).getD i₀.1 default = faceSOf M₁[i₀] := by
    rw [getD_eq_getElem (materialize M₁) (by rw [materialize_size]; exact i₀.isLt) default,
      materialize_getElem M₁ i₀.1 i₀.isLt]; rfl
  set baseA := fragOfFace ((materialize M₁).getD i₀.1 default) with hbaseA
  have hbaseAInv : FragInv (carrierNormal M₁[i₀]) (detOrigin M₁[i₀]) baseA := by
    rw [hbaseA, hgetDA]; exact Proof.MeshIntersectKeep.fragInv_base hdetA
  have hbaseAT : Proof.MeshIntersectClip.vpoly (fragCycle baseA) = triangleSet M₁[i₀] := by
    rw [hbaseA, hgetDA, Proof.MeshIntersectKeep.vpoly_fragOfFace]
  have hPbaseA : P ∈ Proof.MeshIntersectClip.vpoly (fragCycle baseA) := by rw [hbaseAT]; exact hPS1
  set LA := planesForScoped ((materialize M₁).getD i₀.1 default).plane (materialize M₂)
    ((candP M₁ M₂).getD i₀.1 #[]) with hLA
  obtain ⟨fa, hfaClip, hPfa⟩ := (clipFaceScoped_mem_vpoly_iff hbaseAInv LA P).mpr hPbaseA
  have hfaInv : FragInv (carrierNormal M₁[i₀]) (detOrigin M₁[i₀]) fa :=
    fragInv_clipFaceScoped hbaseAInv _ hfaClip
  haveI := hfaInv.neZero
  have hfapl : fa.plane = (faceSOf M₁[i₀]).plane := by
    have := Proof.MeshIntersectNsi.clipFaceScoped_plane baseA LA hfaClip
    rw [hbaseA, hgetDA, fragOfFace] at this; simpa using this
  
  have hfaClip' : fa ∈ clipFaceScoped (fragOfFace (faceSOf M₁[i₀])) LA := by
    rwa [hbaseA, hgetDA] at hfaClip
  have hfacop : isCoplanarWith fa (materialize M₂) = true := by
    by_contra hc
    rw [Bool.not_eq_true] at hc
    exact hcop ((Proof.MeshIntersectCop.isCoplanarWith_clipFace_iff (MB := M₂) 1 i₀.isLt
      hfaClip').mp hc)
  
  have hgetDB : (materialize M₂).getD j₀.1 default = faceSOf M₂[j₀] := by
    rw [getD_eq_getElem (materialize M₂) (by rw [materialize_size]; exact j₀.isLt) default,
      materialize_getElem M₂ j₀.1 j₀.isLt]; rfl
  set baseB := fragOfFace ((materialize M₂).getD j₀.1 default) with hbaseB
  have hbaseBInv : FragInv (carrierNormal M₂[j₀]) (detOrigin M₂[j₀]) baseB := by
    rw [hbaseB, hgetDB]; exact Proof.MeshIntersectKeep.fragInv_base hdetB
  have hbaseBT : Proof.MeshIntersectClip.vpoly (fragCycle baseB) = triangleSet M₂[j₀] := by
    rw [hbaseB, hgetDB, Proof.MeshIntersectKeep.vpoly_fragOfFace]
  have hPbaseB : P ∈ Proof.MeshIntersectClip.vpoly (fragCycle baseB) := by rw [hbaseBT]; exact hPS2
  set LB := planesForScoped ((materialize M₂).getD j₀.1 default).plane (materialize M₁)
    ((candP M₂ M₁).getD j₀.1 #[]) with hLB
  obtain ⟨fb₀, hfb₀Clip, hPfb₀⟩ := (clipFaceScoped_mem_vpoly_iff hbaseBInv LB P).mpr hPbaseB
  have hfb₀Inv : FragInv (carrierNormal M₂[j₀]) (detOrigin M₂[j₀]) fb₀ :=
    fragInv_clipFaceScoped hbaseBInv _ hfb₀Clip
  haveI := hfb₀Inv.neZero
  have hfb₀pl : fb₀.plane = (faceSOf M₂[j₀]).plane := by
    have := Proof.MeshIntersectNsi.clipFaceScoped_plane baseB LB hfb₀Clip
    rw [hbaseB, hgetDB, fragOfFace] at this; simpa using this
  
  have hfb₀Clip' : fb₀ ∈ clipFaceScoped (fragOfFace (faceSOf M₂[j₀])) LB := by
    rwa [hbaseB, hgetDB] at hfb₀Clip
  have hcopBj : ¬ Proof.MeshIntersectCop.TrFace M₂ M₁ j₀.1 j₀.isLt := by
    intro htr
    have : coplanarPlane (faceSOf M₁[i₀]).plane (faceSOf M₂[j₀]).plane = false := htr i₀
    rw [Proof.MeshIntersectNsi.coplanarPlane_symm] at this
    exact absurd hcopBA (by rw [this]; exact Bool.false_ne_true)
  have hfb₀cop : isCoplanarWith fb₀ (materialize M₁) = true := by
    by_contra hc
    rw [Bool.not_eq_true] at hc
    exact hcopBj ((Proof.MeshIntersectCop.isCoplanarWith_clipFace_iff (MB := M₁) 2 j₀.isLt
      hfb₀Clip').mp hc)
  have hfb₀mem : fb₀ ∈ (splitCoplanar (Proof.MeshIntersectNsi.fragsBOf M₁ M₂) (materialize M₁)).1 := by
    rw [splitCoplanar]; simp only
    refine Array.mem_filter.mpr ⟨?_, hfb₀cop⟩
    rw [Proof.MeshIntersectNsi.fragsBOf]
    refine mem_flatMap_arr.mpr ⟨j₀.1, ?_, ?_⟩
    · rw [Array.mem_def, Array.toList_range, List.mem_range]
      rw [materialize_size]; exact j₀.isLt
    · rwa [hbaseB] at hfb₀Clip
  
  have hPrel : P ∈ Proof.MeshIntersectClip.vrelint (fragCycle fb₀) := by
    have hprov : FragProv (carrierNormal M₂[j₀]) (fragCycle fb₀)
        (Proof.MeshIntersectFaceLedger.copEdgePlanesB M₁ M₂ j₀.1) fb₀ :=
      Proof.MeshIntersectNpo.fragProv_self (carrierNormal M₂[j₀])
    have havoidP : AvoidsLines (carrierNormal M₂[j₀]) (detOrigin M₂[j₀]) (fragCycle fb₀)
        (Proof.MeshIntersectFaceLedger.copEdgePlanesB M₁ M₂ j₀.1)
        (Proof.MeshIntersectStep.faceHit M₂[j₀] Q) := by
      have h := gen_cop_avoidsLinesB hG j₀ hQ2 hfb₀Clip
      have hhit : Proof.MeshIntersectStep.faceHit M₂[j₀] Q
          = (detOrigin M₂[j₀] / dotQ (carrierNormal M₂[j₀]) Q) • Q := rfl
      rwa [hhit]
    rcases Proof.MeshIntersectClipBridge.vrelint_or_not_vpoly_of_avoids hfb₀Inv hprov havoidP with
      hrel | hnv
    · rwa [hHitEq] at hrel
    · exact absurd (by rw [hHitEq]; exact hPfb₀ : Proof.MeshIntersectStep.faceHit M₂[j₀] Q
        ∈ Proof.MeshIntersectClip.vpoly (fragCycle fb₀)) hnv
  
  have hxdrop : sameOrient (faceSOf M₁[i₀]).plane (faceSOf M₂[j₀]).plane = true →
      ∀ fb ∈ (splitCoplanar (Proof.MeshIntersectNsi.fragsBOf M₁ M₂) (materialize M₁)).1,
        coplanarPlane fa.plane fb.plane = true → sameOrient fa.plane fb.plane = false →
        P ∉ Proof.MeshIntersectClip.vpoly (fragCycle fb) := by
    intro hso fb hfbmem _hcopfb hsofb
    
    
    have hso₀ : sameOrient fa.plane fb₀.plane = true := by
      rw [hfapl, hfb₀pl]; exact hso
    have hne : fb₀ ≠ fb := by
      intro h; rw [← h, hso₀] at hsofb; exact Bool.noConfusion hsofb
    
    have hpw := Proof.MeshIntersectNsi.fragsBOf_pairwise (M₁ := M₁) (M₂ := M₂) h₂.2.2.2 h₂.2.2.1
    have hsub : (splitCoplanar (Proof.MeshIntersectNsi.fragsBOf M₁ M₂) (materialize M₁)).1.toList.Sublist
        (Proof.MeshIntersectNsi.fragsBOf M₁ M₂).toList := by
      rw [splitCoplanar]; simp only; rw [Array.toList_filter]; exact List.filter_sublist _
    have hpwC := hpw.sublist hsub
    have hmem₀ : fb₀ ∈ (splitCoplanar (Proof.MeshIntersectNsi.fragsBOf M₁ M₂) (materialize M₁)).1.toList :=
      Array.mem_toList.mpr hfb₀mem
    have hmemfb : fb ∈ (splitCoplanar (Proof.MeshIntersectNsi.fragsBOf M₁ M₂) (materialize M₁)).1.toList :=
      Array.mem_toList.mpr hfbmem
    
    have hsym : Symmetric Proof.MeshIntersectNoSelfAsm.CrossSep := fun a b h => ⟨h.2, h.1⟩
    have hcs := hpwC.forall hsym hmem₀ hmemfb hne
    intro hPvfb
    have hmem : P ∈ Proof.MeshIntersectClip.vrelint (fragCycle fb₀) ∩ Proof.MeshIntersectClip.vpoly (fragCycle fb) :=
      ⟨hPrel, hPvfb⟩
    rw [hcs.1] at hmem
    exact hmem
  
  have hno_opp : sameOrient (faceSOf M₁[i₀]).plane (faceSOf M₂[j₀]).plane = false →
      ∀ f ∈ copDescA M₁ M₂ i₀.1, P ∉ Proof.MeshIntersectClip.vpoly (fragCycle f) := by
    intro hsoF
    have := copDescA_off_hit_at_C_oppOrient M₁ M₂ h₁ h₂ hG hw0 i₀ j₀ hi₀ hj₀ huniq2 hcopBA hPS2 hsoF
    rwa [← hP] at this
  
  exact overlap_cell_pierced_once_at_C M₁ M₂ h₁ h₂ hG i₀ j₀ hcop hfaClip hfacop hfapl hPfa
    hfb₀mem hfb₀pl hPrel hxdrop hno_opp

name: copDescB_off_hit_at_C_pending
statement:
theorem copDescB_off_hit_at_C_pending (M₁ M₂ : Mesh)
    (h₁ : Legacy.WellFormedMesh M₁) (h₂ : Legacy.WellFormedMesh M₂)
    {Q : Point} (hG : Gen M₁ M₂ Q) (i₀ : Fin M₁.size) (j₀ : Fin M₂.size)
    (hcopAB : coplanarPlane (faceSOf M₁[i₀]).plane (faceSOf M₂[j₀]).plane = true)
    (hPS1 : Proof.MeshIntersectStep.faceHit M₂[j₀] Q ∈ triangleSet M₁[i₀])
    {fb : Frag}
    (hfbB : fb ∈ (splitCoplanar (Proof.MeshIntersectNsi.fragsBOf M₁ M₂) (materialize M₁)).1)
    (hfbClip : fb ∈ clipFaceScoped (fragOfFace ((materialize M₂).getD j₀.1 default))
        (planesForScoped ((materialize M₂).getD j₀.1 default).plane (materialize M₁)
          ((candP M₂ M₁).getD j₀.1 #[])))
    (hfbpl : fb.plane = (faceSOf M₂[j₀]).plane)
    {copA : Array Frag}
    (hcopA : copA = (splitCoplanar (Proof.MeshIntersectNsi.fragsAOf M₁ M₂) (materialize M₂)).1)
    {f : Frag} (hpPend : f ∈ Proof.MeshIntersectResolve.resolveFragBPending fb copA)
    {bvhW : Impl.BVH.BVH}
    (hf_res : f ∈ resolveCoplanar.resolveFragB bvhW fb copA (prepare (materialize M₁))) :
    Proof.MeshIntersectStep.faceHit M₂[j₀] Q ∉ Proof.MeshIntersectClip.vpoly (fragCycle f)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  intro hPvf
  have hdetB : detOrigin M₂[j₀] ≠ 0 := h₂.2.2.2 j₀
  have hfbInv : FragInv (carrierNormal M₂[j₀]) (detOrigin M₂[j₀]) fb := by
    have hgetD : (materialize M₂).getD j₀.1 default = faceSOf M₂[j₀] := by
      rw [getD_eq_getElem (materialize M₂) (by rw [materialize_size]; exact j₀.isLt) default,
        materialize_getElem M₂ j₀.1 j₀.isLt]; rfl
    have hbaseInv : FragInv (carrierNormal M₂[j₀]) (detOrigin M₂[j₀])
        (fragOfFace ((materialize M₂).getD j₀.1 default)) := by
      rw [hgetD]; exact Proof.MeshIntersectKeep.fragInv_base hdetB
    exact fragInv_clipFaceScoped hbaseInv _ hfbClip
  haveI := hfbInv.neZero
  
  
  
  
  
  
  
  set copA₀ := (splitCoplanar (Proof.MeshIntersectNsi.fragsAOf M₁ M₂) (materialize M₂)).1 with hcopA₀
  subst copA
  clear_value copA₀
  
  
  have hPrelf : Proof.MeshIntersectStep.faceHit M₂[j₀] Q
      ∈ Proof.MeshIntersectClip.vrelint (fragCycle f) :=
    cop_cell_relint_dichotomyB_pending M₁ M₂ h₁ h₂ hG j₀ hfbClip hcopA₀ hpPend hPvf
  
  
  
  
  have hoppInv : ∀ fa ∈ copA₀, ∃ n' c', FragInv n' c' fa
      ∧ (coplanarPlane fb.plane fa.plane = true →
          ∃ ρ : ℚ, ρ ≠ 0 ∧ n' = ρ • carrierNormal M₂[j₀] ∧ c' = ρ * detOrigin M₂[j₀]) := by
    rw [hcopA₀]; exact copA_hoppInv h₁.2.2.2 hdetB hfbpl
  
  have hInvDesc : ∀ {n c : _}, FragInv n c fb → FragInv n c f := by
    intro n c hb
    exact Proof.MeshIntersectResolve.resolveFragB_kept_fromFb bvhW copA₀ _ hb hf_res
  
  have havoid : ∀ fa ∈ copA₀, coplanarPlane fb.plane fa.plane = true →
      Proof.MeshIntersectClip.vrelint (fragCycle f)
        ∩ Proof.MeshIntersectClip.vrelint (fragCycle fa) = ∅ := by
    intro fa hfa hcofa
    exact Proof.MeshIntersectResolve.resolveFragBPending_avoids copA₀ hfbInv hoppInv hfa hcofa hpPend
  
  have hcop' : coplanarPlane (faceSOf M₁[i₀]).plane fb.plane = true := by rw [hfbpl]; exact hcopAB
  have havoid' : ∀ fa ∈ (splitCoplanar (Proof.MeshIntersectNsi.fragsAOf M₁ M₂) (materialize M₂)).1,
      coplanarPlane fb.plane fa.plane = true →
      Proof.MeshIntersectClip.vrelint (fragCycle f)
        ∩ Proof.MeshIntersectClip.vrelint (fragCycle fa) = ∅ := by
    rw [← hcopA₀]; exact havoid
  
  have hdisj : Proof.MeshIntersectClip.vrelint (fragCycle f) ∩ triangleSet M₁[i₀] = ∅ :=
    Proof.MeshIntersectCop.Bprime_cell_disjoint_coplanar_opponent h₁.2.2.2 h₂.2.2.2
      hfbB hInvDesc havoid' (i := i₀.1) i₀.isLt hcop'
  
  have hmem : Proof.MeshIntersectStep.faceHit M₂[j₀] Q
      ∈ Proof.MeshIntersectClip.vrelint (fragCycle f) ∩ triangleSet M₁[i₀] := ⟨hPrelf, hPS1⟩
  rw [hdisj] at hmem; exact hmem

name: copDescB_off_hit_at_C
statement:
theorem copDescB_off_hit_at_C (M₁ M₂ : Mesh)
    (h₁ : Legacy.WellFormedMesh M₁) (h₂ : Legacy.WellFormedMesh M₂)
    {Q : Point} (hG : Gen M₁ M₂ Q) (i₀ : Fin M₁.size) (j₀ : Fin M₂.size)
    (hcopAB : coplanarPlane (faceSOf M₁[i₀]).plane (faceSOf M₂[j₀]).plane = true)
    (hPS1 : Proof.MeshIntersectStep.faceHit M₂[j₀] Q ∈ triangleSet M₁[i₀])
    {f : Frag} (hf : f ∈ copDescB M₁ M₂ j₀.1) :
    Proof.MeshIntersectStep.faceHit M₂[j₀] Q ∉ Proof.MeshIntersectClip.vpoly (fragCycle f)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  obtain ⟨fb, hfbB, hfbpl, hfbClip, hfmem⟩ := mem_copDescB_parent M₁ M₂ j₀.1 j₀.isLt hf
  
  
  clear hf
  
  have hpPend : f ∈ Proof.MeshIntersectResolve.resolveFragBPending fb
      (splitCoplanar (Proof.MeshIntersectNsi.fragsAOf M₁ M₂) (materialize M₂)).1 :=
    Proof.MeshIntersectResolve.mem_resolveFragBPending_of_resolveFragB _ fb _ _ hfmem
  exact copDescB_off_hit_at_C_pending M₁ M₂ h₁ h₂ hG i₀ j₀ hcopAB hPS1 hfbB hfbClip hfbpl rfl
    hpPend hfmem

name: keptFaceB_collapse_zero_at_C
statement:
theorem keptFaceB_collapse_zero_at_C (M₁ M₂ : Mesh)
    (h₁ : Legacy.WellFormedMesh M₁) (h₂ : Legacy.WellFormedMesh M₂)
    {Q : Point} (hG : Gen M₁ M₂ Q) {w : ℚ} (_hw0 : 0 < w)
    (i₀ : Fin M₁.size) (j₀ : Fin M₂.size)
    (hi₀ : Proof.MeshIntersectDelta.FaceJumps M₁[i₀] Q w)
    (_hj₀ : Proof.MeshIntersectDelta.FaceJumps M₂[j₀] Q w)
    (_huniq1 : ∀ i i' : Fin M₁.size, Proof.MeshIntersectDelta.FaceJumps M₁[i] Q w →
      Proof.MeshIntersectDelta.FaceJumps M₁[i'] Q w → i = i')
    (hcross : dotQ (detOrigin M₂[j₀] • carrierNormal M₁[i₀]
        - detOrigin M₁[i₀] • carrierNormal M₂[j₀]) Q = 0) :
    ((keptFaceB M₁ M₂ j₀.1).toList.map
        (fun f => if Proof.MeshIntersectStep.faceHit M₂[j₀] Q
            ∈ Proof.MeshIntersectClip.vpoly (fragCycle f) then (1 : ℤ) else 0)).sum = 0
proof:
:= by
  classical
  set P := Proof.MeshIntersectStep.faceHit M₂[j₀] Q with hP
  have hdetA : detOrigin M₁[i₀] ≠ 0 := h₁.2.2.2 i₀
  have hdetB : detOrigin M₂[j₀] ≠ 0 := h₂.2.2.2 j₀
  have hQ1 : dotQ (carrierNormal M₁[i₀]) Q ≠ 0 := hG.1 i₀
  have hQ2 : dotQ (carrierNormal M₂[j₀]) Q ≠ 0 := hG.2.1 j₀
  
  have hcopBA : coplanarPlane (faceSOf M₂[j₀]).plane (faceSOf M₁[i₀]).plane = true :=
    not_TrFace_of_coincident_C M₁ M₂ h₁ h₂ hG i₀ j₀ hcross
  have hcopAB : coplanarPlane (faceSOf M₁[i₀]).plane (faceSOf M₂[j₀]).plane = true := by
    rwa [Proof.MeshIntersectNsi.coplanarPlane_symm] at hcopBA
  have hcopBj : ¬ Proof.MeshIntersectCop.TrFace M₂ M₁ j₀.1 j₀.isLt := by
    intro htr
    have : coplanarPlane (faceSOf M₁[i₀]).plane (faceSOf M₂[j₀]).plane = false := htr i₀
    rw [this] at hcopAB; exact Bool.false_ne_true hcopAB
  
  have hmuEq : Proof.MeshIntersectDelta.muF M₁[i₀] Q = Proof.MeshIntersectDelta.muF M₂[j₀] Q :=
    Proof.MeshIntersectCopDelta.muF_eq_of_coplanar_carrier hdetA hdetB hQ1 hQ2 hcopBA
  have hHitEq : Proof.MeshIntersectStep.faceHit M₁[i₀] Q = P := by
    have h1 : Proof.MeshIntersectStep.faceHit M₁[i₀] Q
        = Proof.MeshIntersectDelta.muF M₁[i₀] Q • Q := rfl
    have h2 : Proof.MeshIntersectStep.faceHit M₂[j₀] Q
        = Proof.MeshIntersectDelta.muF M₂[j₀] Q • Q := rfl
    rw [h1, hmuEq, ← h2]
  
  have hPS1 : P ∈ triangleSet M₁[i₀] := by
    have h : Proof.MeshIntersectStep.faceHit M₁[i₀] Q ∈ triangleSet M₁[i₀] := hi₀.2.2
    rwa [hHitEq] at h
  
  rw [show keptFaceB M₁ M₂ j₀.1 = keptNcFaceB M₁ M₂ j₀.1 ++ copDescB M₁ M₂ j₀.1 from rfl,
    Array.toList_append, List.map_append, List.sum_append,
    keptNcFaceB_toList_eq_nil_of_not_TrFace M₁ M₂ j₀.isLt hcopBj]
  simp only [List.map_nil, List.sum_nil, zero_add]
  
  refine List.sum_eq_zero ?_
  intro x hx
  rw [List.mem_map] at hx
  obtain ⟨f, hf, rfl⟩ := hx
  rw [if_neg (copDescB_off_hit_at_C M₁ M₂ h₁ h₂ hG i₀ j₀ hcopAB hPS1 (Array.mem_toList.mp hf))]

name: oneSided_windings_in_01_radial
statement:
theorem oneSided_windings_in_01_radial (M : Mesh) (hnpo : NoPlaneThroughOrigin M)
    (hnorm : Legacy.Normal (meshChain M)) {Q : Point}
    (hQ : ∀ k : Fin M.size, dotQ (carrierNormal M[k]) Q ≠ 0)
    (he : ∀ m : Fin (nbData M).1, dotQ ((nbData M).2.1 m) Q ≠ 0)
    {w : ℚ} (hw0 : 0 < w) :
    (Proof.MeshIntersectStep.stepLeft (meshSteps M Q) w = 0
        ∨ Proof.MeshIntersectStep.stepLeft (meshSteps M Q) w = 1)
      ∧ (Proof.MeshIntersectStep.stepRight (meshSteps M Q) w = 0
        ∨ Proof.MeshIntersectStep.stepRight (meshSteps M Q) w = 1)
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
  · 
    
    obtain ⟨μb, hμbw, hgapb⟩ := gap_below_exists (meshSteps M Q) w
    
    
    set v0 : ℚ := max 0 μb with hv0
    have hv0w : v0 < w := by
      rw [hv0]; exact max_lt hw0 hμbw
    obtain ⟨μm, hv0μm, hμmw, hμmoff⟩ :=
      gap_point_off_negligible ((nbData M).2.1) ((nbData M).2.2) Q he hv0w
    have hμm0 : 0 < μm := lt_of_le_of_lt (le_max_left 0 μb) hv0μm
    have hμmb : μb < μm := lt_of_le_of_lt (le_max_right 0 μb) hv0μm
    
    have hgapm : ∀ k, (meshSteps M Q k).1 < w → (meshSteps M Q k).1 < μm :=
      fun k hk => lt_trans (hgapb k hk) hμmb
    
    have hchain : Proof.MeshIntersectStep.stepLeft (meshSteps M Q) w
        = winding (meshChain M) (μm • Q) := by
      rw [stepLeft_eq_stepSum, stepSum_below_gap (meshSteps M Q) hμmw hgapm,
        ← stepLeft_eq_stepSum, stepLeft_meshSteps_eq_winding M hnpo hQ hμm0]
    rw [hchain]
    exact nbData_covers hnorm (X := μm • Q) hμmoff
  · 
    obtain ⟨μg, hwμg, hgapg⟩ := gap_above_exists (meshSteps M Q) w
    obtain ⟨μp, hwμp, hμpμg, hμpoff⟩ :=
      gap_point_off_negligible ((nbData M).2.1) ((nbData M).2.2) Q he hwμg
    have hgapp : ∀ k, w < (meshSteps M Q k).1 → μp ≤ (meshSteps M Q k).1 :=
      fun k hk => le_trans (le_of_lt hμpμg) (hgapg k hk)
    rw [stepRight_meshSteps_eq_winding M hnpo hQ hw0 hwμp hgapp]
    exact nbData_covers hnorm (X := μp • Q) hμpoff

name: gap_windings_in_01_at_C
statement:
theorem gap_windings_in_01_at_C (M₁ M₂ : Mesh)
    (h₁ : Legacy.WellFormedMesh M₁) (h₂ : Legacy.WellFormedMesh M₂)
    {Q : Point} (hG : Gen M₁ M₂ Q) {w : ℚ} (hw0 : 0 < w)
    (i₀ : Fin M₁.size) (j₀ : Fin M₂.size)
    (_hi₀ : Proof.MeshIntersectDelta.FaceJumps M₁[i₀] Q w)
    (_hj₀ : Proof.MeshIntersectDelta.FaceJumps M₂[j₀] Q w) :
    0 ≤ Proof.MeshIntersectStep.stepLeft (meshSteps M₁ Q) w
      ∧ Proof.MeshIntersectStep.stepLeft (meshSteps M₁ Q) w ≤ 1
      ∧ 0 ≤ Proof.MeshIntersectStep.stepRight (meshSteps M₁ Q) w
      ∧ Proof.MeshIntersectStep.stepRight (meshSteps M₁ Q) w ≤ 1
      ∧ 0 ≤ Proof.MeshIntersectStep.stepLeft (meshSteps M₂ Q) w
      ∧ Proof.MeshIntersectStep.stepLeft (meshSteps M₂ Q) w ≤ 1
      ∧ 0 ≤ Proof.MeshIntersectStep.stepRight (meshSteps M₂ Q) w
      ∧ Proof.MeshIntersectStep.stepRight (meshSteps M₂ Q) w ≤ 1
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨h1L, h1R⟩ := oneSided_windings_in_01_radial M₁ h₁.2.2.2 h₁.2.1 hG.1
    (gen_Q_off_NA_planes hG) hw0
  obtain ⟨h2L, h2R⟩ := oneSided_windings_in_01_radial M₂ h₂.2.2.2 h₂.2.1 hG.2.1
    (gen_Q_off_NB_planes hG) hw0
  rcases h1L with h1L | h1L <;> rcases h1R with h1R | h1R <;>
    rcases h2L with h2L | h2L <;> rcases h2R with h2R | h2R <;>
      refine ⟨by omega, by omega, by omega, by omega, by omega, by omega, by omega, by omega⟩

name: complementarity_of_normal
statement:
theorem complementarity_of_normal (M₁ M₂ : Mesh)
    (h₁ : Legacy.WellFormedMesh M₁) (h₂ : Legacy.WellFormedMesh M₂)
    {Q : Point} (hG : Gen M₁ M₂ Q) {w : ℚ}
    (i₀ : Fin M₁.size) (j₀ : Fin M₂.size)
    (hi₀ : Proof.MeshIntersectDelta.FaceJumps M₁[i₀] Q w)
    (hj₀ : Proof.MeshIntersectDelta.FaceJumps M₂[j₀] Q w)
    (hΔ1 : Proof.MeshIntersectStep.stepLeft (meshSteps M₁ Q) w
        - Proof.MeshIntersectStep.stepRight (meshSteps M₁ Q) w = orientSign M₁[i₀])
    (hΔ2 : Proof.MeshIntersectStep.stepLeft (meshSteps M₂ Q) w
        - Proof.MeshIntersectStep.stepRight (meshSteps M₂ Q) w = orientSign M₂[j₀]) :
    (sameOrient (faceSOf M₁[i₀]).plane (faceSOf M₂[j₀]).plane = true →
        Proof.MeshIntersectStep.stepLeft (meshSteps M₁ Q) w
          + Proof.MeshIntersectStep.stepRight (meshSteps M₂ Q) w = 1)
      ∧ (sameOrient (faceSOf M₁[i₀]).plane (faceSOf M₂[j₀]).plane = false →
        Proof.MeshIntersectStep.stepLeft (meshSteps M₁ Q) w
          = Proof.MeshIntersectStep.stepRight (meshSteps M₂ Q) w)
proof:
:= by
  have hdetA : detOrigin M₁[i₀] ≠ 0 := h₁.2.2.2 i₀
  have hdetB : detOrigin M₂[j₀] ≠ 0 := h₂.2.2.2 j₀
  have hw0 : (0 : ℚ) < w := hi₀.1 ▸ hi₀.2.1
  
  obtain ⟨hb1, hb2, hb3, hb4, hb5, hb6, hb7, hb8⟩ :=
    gap_windings_in_01_at_C M₁ M₂ h₁ h₂ hG hw0 i₀ j₀ hi₀ hj₀
  
  have hσA := Proof.MeshIntersectCancel.orientSign_cases hdetA
  have hσB := Proof.MeshIntersectCancel.orientSign_cases hdetB
  refine ⟨fun hso => ?_, fun hsoF => ?_⟩
  · 
    have hσeq : orientSign M₁[i₀] = orientSign M₂[j₀] :=
      orientSign_eq_of_sameOrient hdetA hdetB hso
    omega
  · 
    
    
    have htie0 : dotQ (detOrigin M₂[j₀] • carrierNormal M₁[i₀]
        - detOrigin M₁[i₀] • carrierNormal M₂[j₀]) Q = 0 := by
      by_contra htieNZ
      exact Proof.MeshIntersectDelta.jump_transverse_distinct (hG.1 i₀) (hG.2.1 j₀)
        htieNZ hi₀ hj₀
    have hcop : coplanarPlane (faceSOf M₂[j₀]).plane (faceSOf M₁[i₀]).plane = true :=
      not_TrFace_of_coincident_C M₁ M₂ h₁ h₂ hG i₀ j₀ htie0
    have hcopAB : coplanarPlane (faceSOf M₁[i₀]).plane (faceSOf M₂[j₀]).plane = true := by
      rwa [Proof.MeshIntersectNsi.coplanarPlane_symm] at hcop
    have hσeq : orientSign M₂[j₀] = - orientSign M₁[i₀] :=
      Proof.MeshIntersectCopDelta.orientSign_eq_of_oppOrient hdetA hdetB hcopAB hsoF
    omega

name: out_crossing_C_close
statement:
theorem out_crossing_C_close (M₁ M₂ : Mesh)
    (h₁ : Legacy.WellFormedMesh M₁) (h₂ : Legacy.WellFormedMesh M₂)
    {Q : Point} (hG : Gen M₁ M₂ Q) {w : ℚ} (hw0 : 0 < w)
    (i₀ : Fin M₁.size) (j₀ : Fin M₂.size)
    (hi₀ : Proof.MeshIntersectDelta.FaceJumps M₁[i₀] Q w)
    (hj₀ : Proof.MeshIntersectDelta.FaceJumps M₂[j₀] Q w)
    (huniq1 : ∀ i i' : Fin M₁.size, Proof.MeshIntersectDelta.FaceJumps M₁[i] Q w →
      Proof.MeshIntersectDelta.FaceJumps M₁[i'] Q w → i = i')
    (huniq2 : ∀ j j' : Fin M₂.size, Proof.MeshIntersectDelta.FaceJumps M₂[j] Q w →
      Proof.MeshIntersectDelta.FaceJumps M₂[j'] Q w → j = j')
    (hcrossij : dotQ (detOrigin M₂[j₀] • carrierNormal M₁[i₀]
        - detOrigin M₁[i₀] • carrierNormal M₂[j₀]) Q = 0) :
    (∑ i : Fin M₁.size, faceCopNcJump M₁[i] (keptFaceA M₁ M₂ i.1) Q w)
        + (∑ j : Fin M₂.size, faceCopNcJump M₂[j] (keptFaceB M₁ M₂ j.1) Q w)
      = Proof.MeshIntersectStep.stepLeft (meshSteps M₁ Q) w
          * Proof.MeshIntersectStep.stepLeft (meshSteps M₂ Q) w
        - Proof.MeshIntersectStep.stepRight (meshSteps M₁ Q) w
          * Proof.MeshIntersectStep.stepRight (meshSteps M₂ Q) w
proof:
:= by
  classical
  set w1m := Proof.MeshIntersectStep.stepLeft (meshSteps M₁ Q) w with hw1m
  set w1p := Proof.MeshIntersectStep.stepRight (meshSteps M₁ Q) w with hw1p
  set w2m := Proof.MeshIntersectStep.stepLeft (meshSteps M₂ Q) w with hw2m
  set w2p := Proof.MeshIntersectStep.stepRight (meshSteps M₂ Q) w with hw2p
  have hSJ1 : stepJumpAt (meshSteps M₁ Q) w = w1m - w1p :=
    stepJumpAt_eq_left_sub_right (meshSteps M₁ Q) w
  have hSJ2 : stepJumpAt (meshSteps M₂ Q) w = w2m - w2p :=
    stepJumpAt_eq_left_sub_right (meshSteps M₂ Q) w
  have keptFace_off_tri_A : ∀ (i : Fin M₁.size),
      Proof.MeshIntersectStep.faceHit M₁[i] Q ∉ triangleSet M₁[i] →
      ((keptFaceA M₁ M₂ i.1).toList.map
          (fun f => if Proof.MeshIntersectStep.faceHit M₁[i] Q
              ∈ Proof.MeshIntersectClip.vpoly (fragCycle f) then (1 : ℤ) else 0)).sum = 0 :=
    fun i hoff => keptFaceA_indicator_off_tri M₁ M₂ h₁.2.2.2 i hoff
  have keptFace_off_tri_B : ∀ (j : Fin M₂.size),
      Proof.MeshIntersectStep.faceHit M₂[j] Q ∉ triangleSet M₂[j] →
      ((keptFaceB M₁ M₂ j.1).toList.map
          (fun f => if Proof.MeshIntersectStep.faceHit M₂[j] Q
              ∈ Proof.MeshIntersectClip.vpoly (fragCycle f) then (1 : ℤ) else 0)).sum = 0 :=
    fun j hoff => keptFaceB_indicator_off_tri M₁ M₂ h₂.2.2.2 j hoff
  have hcopBA : coplanarPlane (faceSOf M₂[j₀]).plane (faceSOf M₁[i₀]).plane = true :=
    not_TrFace_of_coincident_C M₁ M₂ h₁ h₂ hG i₀ j₀ hcrossij
  
  have hN1 := keptFaceA_collapse_at_C M₁ M₂ h₁ h₂ hG hw0 i₀ j₀ hi₀ hj₀ huniq2 hcrossij
  have hN2 := keptFaceB_collapse_zero_at_C M₁ M₂ h₁ h₂ hG hw0 i₀ j₀ hi₀ hj₀ huniq1 hcrossij
  
  
  
  
  have hzeroA : ∀ i ∈ (Finset.univ : Finset (Fin M₁.size)), i ≠ i₀ →
      faceCopNcJump M₁[i] (keptFaceA M₁ M₂ i.1) Q w = 0 := by
    intro i _ hne
    rw [faceCopNcJump]
    by_cases hpar : Proof.MeshIntersectStep.faceParam M₁[i] Q = w
    · by_cases hofftri : Proof.MeshIntersectStep.faceHit M₁[i] Q ∈ triangleSet M₁[i]
      · exfalso
        apply hne
        refine huniq1 i i₀ ⟨hpar, ?_, hofftri⟩ hi₀
        show 0 < Proof.MeshIntersectDelta.muF M₁[i] Q
        rw [show Proof.MeshIntersectDelta.muF M₁[i] Q
          = Proof.MeshIntersectStep.faceParam M₁[i] Q from rfl, hpar]; exact hw0
      · rw [keptFace_off_tri_A i hofftri]; ring
    · rw [if_neg hpar]; ring
  have hcollA : (∑ i : Fin M₁.size, faceCopNcJump M₁[i] (keptFaceA M₁ M₂ i.1) Q w)
      = orientSign M₁[i₀]
        * ((keptFaceA M₁ M₂ i₀.1).toList.map
            (fun f => if Proof.MeshIntersectStep.faceHit M₁[i₀] Q
                ∈ Proof.MeshIntersectClip.vpoly (fragCycle f) then (1 : ℤ) else 0)).sum := by
    rw [Finset.sum_eq_single_of_mem i₀ (Finset.mem_univ i₀) hzeroA,
      faceCopNcJump,
      if_pos (show Proof.MeshIntersectStep.faceParam M₁[i₀] Q = w from hi₀.1)]; ring
  
  have hzeroB : ∀ j ∈ (Finset.univ : Finset (Fin M₂.size)), j ≠ j₀ →
      faceCopNcJump M₂[j] (keptFaceB M₁ M₂ j.1) Q w = 0 := by
    intro j _ hne
    rw [faceCopNcJump]
    by_cases hpar : Proof.MeshIntersectStep.faceParam M₂[j] Q = w
    · by_cases hofftri : Proof.MeshIntersectStep.faceHit M₂[j] Q ∈ triangleSet M₂[j]
      · exfalso
        apply hne
        refine huniq2 j j₀ ⟨hpar, ?_, hofftri⟩ hj₀
        show 0 < Proof.MeshIntersectDelta.muF M₂[j] Q
        rw [show Proof.MeshIntersectDelta.muF M₂[j] Q
          = Proof.MeshIntersectStep.faceParam M₂[j] Q from rfl, hpar]; exact hw0
      · rw [keptFace_off_tri_B j hofftri]; ring
    · rw [if_neg hpar]; ring
  have hcollB : (∑ j : Fin M₂.size, faceCopNcJump M₂[j] (keptFaceB M₁ M₂ j.1) Q w)
      = orientSign M₂[j₀]
        * ((keptFaceB M₁ M₂ j₀.1).toList.map
            (fun f => if Proof.MeshIntersectStep.faceHit M₂[j₀] Q
                ∈ Proof.MeshIntersectClip.vpoly (fragCycle f) then (1 : ℤ) else 0)).sum := by
    rw [Finset.sum_eq_single_of_mem j₀ (Finset.mem_univ j₀) hzeroB,
      faceCopNcJump,
      if_pos (show Proof.MeshIntersectStep.faceParam M₂[j₀] Q = w from hj₀.1)]; ring
  
  have hsjA : stepJumpAt (meshSteps M₁ Q) w = orientSign M₁[i₀] := by
    rw [stepJumpAt, Finset.sum_filter, Finset.sum_eq_single i₀]
    · rw [if_pos (show (meshSteps M₁ Q i₀).1 = w from hi₀.1)]
      show faceJump M₁[i₀] Q = orientSign M₁[i₀]
      rw [show faceJump M₁[i₀] Q = orientSign M₁[i₀]
          * (if Proof.MeshIntersectStep.faceHit M₁[i₀] Q ∈ triangleSet M₁[i₀] then (1:ℤ) else 0)
          from rfl,
        if_pos (show Proof.MeshIntersectStep.faceHit M₁[i₀] Q ∈ triangleSet M₁[i₀] from hi₀.2.2)]
      ring
    · intro i _ hne
      by_cases hpar : (meshSteps M₁ Q i).1 = w
      · rw [if_pos hpar]
        show faceJump M₁[i] Q = 0
        rw [show faceJump M₁[i] Q = orientSign M₁[i]
            * (if Proof.MeshIntersectStep.faceHit M₁[i] Q ∈ triangleSet M₁[i] then (1:ℤ) else 0)
            from rfl]
        by_cases hhit : Proof.MeshIntersectStep.faceHit M₁[i] Q ∈ triangleSet M₁[i]
        · exfalso; apply hne
          refine huniq1 i i₀ ⟨hpar, ?_, hhit⟩ hi₀
          show 0 < Proof.MeshIntersectDelta.muF M₁[i] Q
          rw [show Proof.MeshIntersectDelta.muF M₁[i] Q
            = (meshSteps M₁ Q i).1 from rfl, hpar]; exact hw0
        · rw [if_neg hhit]; ring
      · rw [if_neg hpar]
    · intro hni; exact absurd (Finset.mem_univ i₀) hni
  have hsjB : stepJumpAt (meshSteps M₂ Q) w = orientSign M₂[j₀] := by
    rw [stepJumpAt, Finset.sum_filter, Finset.sum_eq_single j₀]
    · rw [if_pos (show (meshSteps M₂ Q j₀).1 = w from hj₀.1)]
      show faceJump M₂[j₀] Q = orientSign M₂[j₀]
      rw [show faceJump M₂[j₀] Q = orientSign M₂[j₀]
          * (if Proof.MeshIntersectStep.faceHit M₂[j₀] Q ∈ triangleSet M₂[j₀] then (1:ℤ) else 0)
          from rfl,
        if_pos (show Proof.MeshIntersectStep.faceHit M₂[j₀] Q ∈ triangleSet M₂[j₀] from hj₀.2.2)]
      ring
    · intro j _ hne
      by_cases hpar : (meshSteps M₂ Q j).1 = w
      · rw [if_pos hpar]
        show faceJump M₂[j] Q = 0
        rw [show faceJump M₂[j] Q = orientSign M₂[j]
            * (if Proof.MeshIntersectStep.faceHit M₂[j] Q ∈ triangleSet M₂[j] then (1:ℤ) else 0)
            from rfl]
        by_cases hhit : Proof.MeshIntersectStep.faceHit M₂[j] Q ∈ triangleSet M₂[j]
        · exfalso; apply hne
          refine huniq2 j j₀ ⟨hpar, ?_, hhit⟩ hj₀
          show 0 < Proof.MeshIntersectDelta.muF M₂[j] Q
          rw [show Proof.MeshIntersectDelta.muF M₂[j] Q
            = (meshSteps M₂ Q j).1 from rfl, hpar]; exact hw0
        · rw [if_neg hhit]; ring
      · rw [if_neg hpar]
    · intro hnj; exact absurd (Finset.mem_univ j₀) hnj
  have hΔ1 : w1m - w1p = orientSign M₁[i₀] := by rw [hw1m, hw1p, ← hSJ1]; exact hsjA
  have hΔ2 : w2m - w2p = orientSign M₂[j₀] := by rw [hw2m, hw2p, ← hSJ2]; exact hsjB
  have hbd := gap_windings_in_01_at_C M₁ M₂ h₁ h₂ hG hw0 i₀ j₀ hi₀ hj₀
  have hcomplPair := complementarity_of_normal M₁ M₂ h₁ h₂ hG i₀ j₀ hi₀ hj₀ hΔ1 hΔ2
  rw [hcollA, hcollB, hN1, hN2]
  by_cases hso : sameOrient (faceSOf M₁[i₀]).plane (faceSOf M₂[j₀]).plane
  · rw [if_pos hso]
    have hσeq : orientSign M₂[j₀] = orientSign M₁[i₀] :=
      (orientSign_eq_of_sameOrient (h₁.2.2.2 i₀) (h₂.2.2.2 j₀) hso).symm
    have hcompl : w1m + w2p = 1 := hcomplPair.1 hso
    have hΔ2' : w2m - w2p = orientSign M₁[i₀] := by rw [hΔ2, hσeq]
    rw [show orientSign M₁[i₀] * (1 : ℤ) + orientSign M₂[j₀] * 0 = orientSign M₁[i₀] by ring]
    exact (Proof.MeshIntersectDelta.coincident_delta_same_product hΔ1 hΔ2' hcompl).symm
  · rw [if_neg hso]
    have hsoF : sameOrient (faceSOf M₁[i₀]).plane (faceSOf M₂[j₀]).plane = false := by
      simpa using hso
    have hw : w1m = w2p := hcomplPair.2 hsoF
    have hΔ : w1m - w1p = -(w2m - w2p) := by
      rw [hΔ1, hΔ2]
      have hcopAB : coplanarPlane (faceSOf M₁[i₀]).plane (faceSOf M₂[j₀]).plane = true := by
        rwa [Proof.MeshIntersectNsi.coplanarPlane_symm] at hcopBA
      rw [Proof.MeshIntersectCopDelta.orientSign_eq_of_oppOrient
        (h₁.2.2.2 i₀) (h₂.2.2.2 j₀) hcopAB hsoF, neg_neg]
    rw [show orientSign M₁[i₀] * (0 : ℤ) + orientSign M₂[j₀] * 0 = 0 by ring]
    exact (Proof.MeshIntersectDelta.coincident_delta_opp_product hΔ hw).symm

name: out_crossing_jump_match
statement:
theorem out_crossing_jump_match (M₁ M₂ : Mesh)
    (h₁ : Legacy.WellFormedMesh M₁) (h₂ : Legacy.WellFormedMesh M₂)
    {Q : Point} (hG : Gen M₁ M₂ Q) (w : ℚ) (hw : 1 ≤ w) :
    stepJumpAt (meshSteps (meshIntersect M₁ M₂) Q) w
      = stepJumpAt (prodSteps (meshSteps M₁ Q) (meshSteps M₂ Q)) w
proof:
:= by
  classical
  
  
  
  have hnpo₁ : NoPlaneThroughOrigin M₁ := h₁.2.2.2
  have hnpo₂ : NoPlaneThroughOrigin M₂ := h₂.2.2.2
  have hQ1 : ∀ i : Fin M₁.size, dotQ (carrierNormal M₁[i]) Q ≠ 0 := hG.1
  have hQ2 : ∀ j : Fin M₂.size, dotQ (carrierNormal M₂[j]) Q ≠ 0 := hG.2.1
  have hw0 : (0 : ℚ) < w := lt_of_lt_of_le (by norm_num) hw
  
  
  
  
  
  
  
  
  
  
  
  
  have keptRegion_eq_keep_w2_A :
      ∀ (i : Fin M₁.size),
        0 < Proof.MeshIntersectStep.faceParam M₁[i] Q →
        (∀ j : Fin M₂.size, ¬ Proof.MeshIntersectDelta.FaceJumps M₂[j] Q
          (Proof.MeshIntersectStep.faceParam M₁[i] Q)) →
        ((keptFaceA M₁ M₂ i.1).toList.map
            (fun f => if Proof.MeshIntersectStep.faceHit M₁[i] Q
                ∈ Proof.MeshIntersectClip.vpoly (fragCycle f) then (1 : ℤ) else 0)).sum
          = (if Proof.MeshIntersectStep.faceHit M₁[i] Q ∈ triangleSet M₁[i] then 1 else 0)
            * winding (meshChain M₂) (Proof.MeshIntersectStep.faceHit M₁[i] Q) := by
    intro i hposi hno2i
    by_cases htr : Proof.MeshIntersectCop.TrFace M₁ M₂ i.1 i.isLt
    · exact keptFaceA_indicator_transverse M₁ M₂ h₁ h₂ hG i htr
    · exact keptFaceA_indicator_coplanar M₁ M₂ h₁ h₂ hG i htr hposi hno2i
  
  
  
  have keptRegion_eq_keep_w2_B :
      ∀ (j : Fin M₂.size),
        0 < Proof.MeshIntersectStep.faceParam M₂[j] Q →
        (∀ i : Fin M₁.size, ¬ Proof.MeshIntersectDelta.FaceJumps M₁[i] Q
          (Proof.MeshIntersectStep.faceParam M₂[j] Q)) →
        ((keptFaceB M₁ M₂ j.1).toList.map
            (fun f => if Proof.MeshIntersectStep.faceHit M₂[j] Q
                ∈ Proof.MeshIntersectClip.vpoly (fragCycle f) then (1 : ℤ) else 0)).sum
          = (if Proof.MeshIntersectStep.faceHit M₂[j] Q ∈ triangleSet M₂[j] then 1 else 0)
            * winding (meshChain M₁) (Proof.MeshIntersectStep.faceHit M₂[j] Q) := by
    intro j hposj hno1j
    by_cases htr : Proof.MeshIntersectCop.TrFace M₂ M₁ j.1 j.isLt
    · exact keptFaceB_indicator_transverse M₁ M₂ h₁ h₂ hG j htr
    · exact keptFaceB_indicator_coplanar M₁ M₂ h₁ h₂ hG j htr hposj hno1j
  
  
  
  
  
  have keptFace_off_tri_A :
      ∀ (i : Fin M₁.size),
        Proof.MeshIntersectStep.faceHit M₁[i] Q ∉ triangleSet M₁[i] →
        ((keptFaceA M₁ M₂ i.1).toList.map
            (fun f => if Proof.MeshIntersectStep.faceHit M₁[i] Q
                ∈ Proof.MeshIntersectClip.vpoly (fragCycle f) then (1 : ℤ) else 0)).sum = 0 :=
    fun i hoff => keptFaceA_indicator_off_tri M₁ M₂ hnpo₁ i hoff
  have keptFace_off_tri_B :
      ∀ (j : Fin M₂.size),
        Proof.MeshIntersectStep.faceHit M₂[j] Q ∉ triangleSet M₂[j] →
        ((keptFaceB M₁ M₂ j.1).toList.map
            (fun f => if Proof.MeshIntersectStep.faceHit M₂[j] Q
                ∈ Proof.MeshIntersectClip.vpoly (fragCycle f) then (1 : ℤ) else 0)).sum = 0 :=
    fun j hoff => keptFaceB_indicator_off_tri M₁ M₂ hnpo₂ j hoff
  
  
  
  have winding_in_01_A :
      (∀ j : Fin M₂.size, ¬ Proof.MeshIntersectDelta.FaceJumps M₂[j] Q w) →
        winding (meshChain M₂) (w • Q) = Proof.MeshIntersectStep.stepLeft (meshSteps M₂ Q) w
        ∧ Proof.MeshIntersectStep.stepLeft (meshSteps M₂ Q) w
            = Proof.MeshIntersectStep.stepRight (meshSteps M₂ Q) w :=
    fun hno => winding_const_of_no_jump M₂ hnpo₂ hQ2 hw0 hno
  have winding_in_01_B :
      (∀ i : Fin M₁.size, ¬ Proof.MeshIntersectDelta.FaceJumps M₁[i] Q w) →
        winding (meshChain M₁) (w • Q) = Proof.MeshIntersectStep.stepLeft (meshSteps M₁ Q) w
        ∧ Proof.MeshIntersectStep.stepLeft (meshSteps M₁ Q) w
            = Proof.MeshIntersectStep.stepRight (meshSteps M₁ Q) w :=
    fun hno => winding_const_of_no_jump M₁ hnpo₁ hQ1 hw0 hno
  
  rw [stepJumpAt_prodSteps]
  
  rw [out_jump_regroup_by_parent M₁ M₂ h₁ h₂ hG hw0]
  
  have hclass := Proof.MeshIntersectDelta.isolated_crossing
    (M₁ := M₁) (M₂ := M₂) h₁.2.2.1 h₂.2.2.1 (Q := Q) (μk := w)
    (fun i _ => gen_relint₁ hG i) (fun j _ => gen_relint₂ hG j)
    (fun i j htieNZ hboth =>
      Proof.MeshIntersectDelta.jump_transverse_distinct (hQ1 i) (hQ2 j) htieNZ
        hboth.1 hboth.2)
  obtain ⟨huniq1, huniq2, hcross⟩ := hclass
  
  set w1m := Proof.MeshIntersectStep.stepLeft (meshSteps M₁ Q) w with hw1m
  set w1p := Proof.MeshIntersectStep.stepRight (meshSteps M₁ Q) w with hw1p
  set w2m := Proof.MeshIntersectStep.stepLeft (meshSteps M₂ Q) w with hw2m
  set w2p := Proof.MeshIntersectStep.stepRight (meshSteps M₂ Q) w with hw2p
  
  
  have houtA : (∀ j : Fin M₂.size, ¬ Proof.MeshIntersectDelta.FaceJumps M₂[j] Q w) →
      (∑ i : Fin M₁.size, faceCopNcJump M₁[i] (keptFaceA M₁ M₂ i.1) Q w)
        = winding (meshChain M₂) (w • Q) * stepJumpAt (meshSteps M₁ Q) w := by
    intro hno2
    rw [stepJumpAt, Finset.sum_filter, Finset.mul_sum]
    refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun i _ => ?_)
    rw [faceCopNcJump]
    by_cases hpar : Proof.MeshIntersectStep.faceParam M₁[i] Q = w
    · 
      have hpos : 0 < Proof.MeshIntersectStep.faceParam M₁[i] Q := by rw [hpar]; exact hw0
      have hno2' : ∀ j : Fin M₂.size, ¬ Proof.MeshIntersectDelta.FaceJumps M₂[j] Q
          (Proof.MeshIntersectStep.faceParam M₁[i] Q) := by rw [hpar]; exact hno2
      rw [keptRegion_eq_keep_w2_A i hpos hno2']
      
      have hhit : Proof.MeshIntersectStep.faceHit M₁[i] Q = w • Q := by
        show Proof.MeshIntersectDelta.hitF M₁[i] Q = w • Q
        rw [Proof.MeshIntersectDelta.hitF, show Proof.MeshIntersectDelta.muF M₁[i] Q
          = Proof.MeshIntersectStep.faceParam M₁[i] Q from rfl, hpar]
      have hpar' : (meshSteps M₁ Q i).1 = w := hpar
      rw [if_pos hpar, if_pos hpar', hhit]
      show orientSign M₁[i] * 1 * ((if w • Q ∈ triangleSet M₁[i] then (1:ℤ) else 0)
          * winding (meshChain M₂) (w • Q))
        = winding (meshChain M₂) (w • Q) * (meshSteps M₁ Q i).2
      rw [show (meshSteps M₁ Q i).2 = faceJump M₁[i] Q from rfl,
        show faceJump M₁[i] Q = orientSign M₁[i]
          * (if Proof.MeshIntersectStep.faceHit M₁[i] Q ∈ triangleSet M₁[i] then (1:ℤ) else 0)
          from rfl, hhit]
      ring
    · have hpar' : ¬ (meshSteps M₁ Q i).1 = w := hpar
      rw [if_neg hpar, if_neg hpar']
      ring
  
  have houtB : (∀ i : Fin M₁.size, ¬ Proof.MeshIntersectDelta.FaceJumps M₁[i] Q w) →
      (∑ j : Fin M₂.size, faceCopNcJump M₂[j] (keptFaceB M₁ M₂ j.1) Q w)
        = winding (meshChain M₁) (w • Q) * stepJumpAt (meshSteps M₂ Q) w := by
    intro hno1
    rw [stepJumpAt, Finset.sum_filter, Finset.mul_sum]
    refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun j _ => ?_)
    rw [faceCopNcJump]
    by_cases hpar : Proof.MeshIntersectStep.faceParam M₂[j] Q = w
    · 
      have hpos : 0 < Proof.MeshIntersectStep.faceParam M₂[j] Q := by rw [hpar]; exact hw0
      have hno1' : ∀ i : Fin M₁.size, ¬ Proof.MeshIntersectDelta.FaceJumps M₁[i] Q
          (Proof.MeshIntersectStep.faceParam M₂[j] Q) := by rw [hpar]; exact hno1
      rw [keptRegion_eq_keep_w2_B j hpos hno1']
      have hhit : Proof.MeshIntersectStep.faceHit M₂[j] Q = w • Q := by
        show Proof.MeshIntersectDelta.hitF M₂[j] Q = w • Q
        rw [Proof.MeshIntersectDelta.hitF, show Proof.MeshIntersectDelta.muF M₂[j] Q
          = Proof.MeshIntersectStep.faceParam M₂[j] Q from rfl, hpar]
      have hpar' : (meshSteps M₂ Q j).1 = w := hpar
      rw [if_pos hpar, if_pos hpar', hhit]
      show orientSign M₂[j] * 1 * ((if w • Q ∈ triangleSet M₂[j] then (1:ℤ) else 0)
          * winding (meshChain M₁) (w • Q))
        = winding (meshChain M₁) (w • Q) * (meshSteps M₂ Q j).2
      rw [show (meshSteps M₂ Q j).2 = faceJump M₂[j] Q from rfl,
        show faceJump M₂[j] Q = orientSign M₂[j]
          * (if Proof.MeshIntersectStep.faceHit M₂[j] Q ∈ triangleSet M₂[j] then (1:ℤ) else 0)
          from rfl, hhit]
      ring
    · have hpar' : ¬ (meshSteps M₂ Q j).1 = w := hpar
      rw [if_neg hpar, if_neg hpar']
      ring
  
  have hzeroOutB : (∀ j : Fin M₂.size, ¬ Proof.MeshIntersectDelta.FaceJumps M₂[j] Q w) →
      (∑ j : Fin M₂.size, faceCopNcJump M₂[j] (keptFaceB M₁ M₂ j.1) Q w) = 0 := by
    intro hno2
    refine Finset.sum_eq_zero (fun j _ => ?_)
    rw [faceCopNcJump]
    by_cases hpar : Proof.MeshIntersectStep.faceParam M₂[j] Q = w
    · 
      have hofftri : Proof.MeshIntersectStep.faceHit M₂[j] Q ∉ triangleSet M₂[j] := by
        intro hin
        apply hno2 j
        refine ⟨hpar, ?_, hin⟩
        show 0 < Proof.MeshIntersectDelta.muF M₂[j] Q
        rw [show Proof.MeshIntersectDelta.muF M₂[j] Q
          = Proof.MeshIntersectStep.faceParam M₂[j] Q from rfl, hpar]; exact hw0
      rw [keptFace_off_tri_B j hofftri]; ring
    · rw [if_neg hpar]; ring
  have hzeroOutA : (∀ i : Fin M₁.size, ¬ Proof.MeshIntersectDelta.FaceJumps M₁[i] Q w) →
      (∑ i : Fin M₁.size, faceCopNcJump M₁[i] (keptFaceA M₁ M₂ i.1) Q w) = 0 := by
    intro hno1
    refine Finset.sum_eq_zero (fun i _ => ?_)
    rw [faceCopNcJump]
    by_cases hpar : Proof.MeshIntersectStep.faceParam M₁[i] Q = w
    · have hofftri : Proof.MeshIntersectStep.faceHit M₁[i] Q ∉ triangleSet M₁[i] := by
        intro hin
        apply hno1 i
        refine ⟨hpar, ?_, hin⟩
        show 0 < Proof.MeshIntersectDelta.muF M₁[i] Q
        rw [show Proof.MeshIntersectDelta.muF M₁[i] Q
          = Proof.MeshIntersectStep.faceParam M₁[i] Q from rfl, hpar]; exact hw0
      rw [keptFace_off_tri_A i hofftri]; ring
    · rw [if_neg hpar]; ring
  
  have hjA0 : (∀ i : Fin M₁.size, ¬ Proof.MeshIntersectDelta.FaceJumps M₁[i] Q w) →
      stepJumpAt (meshSteps M₁ Q) w = 0 := by
    intro hno1
    rw [stepJumpAt, Finset.sum_filter]
    refine Finset.sum_eq_zero (fun i _ => ?_)
    by_cases hpar : (meshSteps M₁ Q i).1 = w
    · rw [if_pos hpar]
      show faceJump M₁[i] Q = 0
      rw [show faceJump M₁[i] Q = orientSign M₁[i]
          * (if Proof.MeshIntersectStep.faceHit M₁[i] Q ∈ triangleSet M₁[i] then (1:ℤ) else 0)
          from rfl]
      by_cases hhit : Proof.MeshIntersectStep.faceHit M₁[i] Q ∈ triangleSet M₁[i]
      · exfalso
        apply hno1 i
        refine ⟨hpar, ?_, hhit⟩
        show 0 < Proof.MeshIntersectDelta.muF M₁[i] Q
        rw [show Proof.MeshIntersectDelta.muF M₁[i] Q
          = Proof.MeshIntersectStep.faceParam M₁[i] Q from rfl,
          show Proof.MeshIntersectStep.faceParam M₁[i] Q = (meshSteps M₁ Q i).1 from rfl, hpar]
        exact hw0
      · rw [if_neg hhit]; ring
    · rw [if_neg hpar]
  have hjB0 : (∀ j : Fin M₂.size, ¬ Proof.MeshIntersectDelta.FaceJumps M₂[j] Q w) →
      stepJumpAt (meshSteps M₂ Q) w = 0 := by
    intro hno2
    rw [stepJumpAt, Finset.sum_filter]
    refine Finset.sum_eq_zero (fun j _ => ?_)
    by_cases hpar : (meshSteps M₂ Q j).1 = w
    · rw [if_pos hpar]
      show faceJump M₂[j] Q = 0
      rw [show faceJump M₂[j] Q = orientSign M₂[j]
          * (if Proof.MeshIntersectStep.faceHit M₂[j] Q ∈ triangleSet M₂[j] then (1:ℤ) else 0)
          from rfl]
      by_cases hhit : Proof.MeshIntersectStep.faceHit M₂[j] Q ∈ triangleSet M₂[j]
      · exfalso
        apply hno2 j
        refine ⟨hpar, ?_, hhit⟩
        show 0 < Proof.MeshIntersectDelta.muF M₂[j] Q
        rw [show Proof.MeshIntersectDelta.muF M₂[j] Q
          = Proof.MeshIntersectStep.faceParam M₂[j] Q from rfl,
          show Proof.MeshIntersectStep.faceParam M₂[j] Q = (meshSteps M₂ Q j).1 from rfl, hpar]
        exact hw0
      · rw [if_neg hhit]; ring
    · rw [if_neg hpar]
  
  have hSJ1 : stepJumpAt (meshSteps M₁ Q) w = w1m - w1p :=
    stepJumpAt_eq_left_sub_right (meshSteps M₁ Q) w
  have hSJ2 : stepJumpAt (meshSteps M₂ Q) w = w2m - w2p :=
    stepJumpAt_eq_left_sub_right (meshSteps M₂ Q) w
  
  by_cases hJ1 : ∃ i : Fin M₁.size, Proof.MeshIntersectDelta.FaceJumps M₁[i] Q w
  · by_cases hJ2 : ∃ j : Fin M₂.size, Proof.MeshIntersectDelta.FaceJumps M₂[j] Q w
    · 
      
      obtain ⟨i₀, hi₀⟩ := hJ1
      obtain ⟨j₀, hj₀⟩ := hJ2
      exact out_crossing_C_close M₁ M₂ h₁ h₂ hG hw0 i₀ j₀ hi₀ hj₀ huniq1 huniq2
        (hcross i₀ j₀ hi₀ hj₀)
    · 
      push_neg at hJ2
      have hwinB := winding_in_01_A hJ2
      have h2const : w2m = w2p := hwinB.2
      rw [houtA hJ2, hzeroOutB hJ2, add_zero, hSJ1]
      
      rw [hwinB.1]
      linear_combination (-w1p) * h2const
  · push_neg at hJ1
    by_cases hJ2 : ∃ j : Fin M₂.size, Proof.MeshIntersectDelta.FaceJumps M₂[j] Q w
    ·
