      have hwinA := winding_in_01_B hJ1
      have h1const : w1m = w1p := hwinA.2
      rw [houtB hJ1, hzeroOutA hJ1, zero_add, hSJ2]
      rw [hwinA.1]
      linear_combination (-w2p) * h1const
    · 
      push_neg at hJ2
      have hwinA := winding_in_01_B hJ1
      have hwinB := winding_in_01_A hJ2
      rw [hzeroOutA hJ1, hzeroOutB hJ2, add_zero]
      rw [hwinA.2, hwinB.2]; ring

name: out_winding_eq_stepSum_pt
statement:
theorem out_winding_eq_stepSum_pt (M₁ M₂ : Mesh)
    (h₁ : Legacy.WellFormedMesh M₁) (h₂ : Legacy.WellFormedMesh M₂)
    {Q : Point} (hG : Gen M₁ M₂ Q) {t : ℚ} (ht : 0 < t) :
    winding (meshChain (meshIntersect M₁ M₂)) (t • Q)
      = Proof.MeshIntersectStep.stepSum (meshSteps (meshIntersect M₁ M₂) Q) t
proof:
:= by
  apply winding_radial_step (meshIntersect M₁ M₂)
    (Proof.MeshIntersectNpo.meshIntersect_noPlaneThroughOrigin M₁ M₂ h₁ h₂)
    ?_ ht
  intro j
  apply out_carrier_ne_of_mem M₁ M₂ h₁.2.2.2 h₂.2.2.2
    (Proof.MeshIntersectNpo.GenWF.of_legacy h₁) (Proof.MeshIntersectNpo.GenWF.of_legacy h₂) hG
  exact Array.getElem_mem j.isLt

name: out_winding_diff_eq_stepSum
statement:
theorem out_winding_diff_eq_stepSum (M₁ M₂ : Mesh)
    (h₁ : Legacy.WellFormedMesh M₁) (h₂ : Legacy.WellFormedMesh M₂)
    {Q : Point} (hG : Gen M₁ M₂ Q) {v μ : ℚ} (hv0 : 0 < v) (hμ0 : 0 < μ) :
    winding (meshChain (meshIntersect M₁ M₂)) (v • Q)
        - winding (meshChain (meshIntersect M₁ M₂)) (μ • Q)
      = Proof.MeshIntersectStep.stepSum (meshSteps (meshIntersect M₁ M₂) Q) v
        - Proof.MeshIntersectStep.stepSum (meshSteps (meshIntersect M₁ M₂) Q) μ
proof:
:= by
  rw [out_winding_eq_stepSum_pt M₁ M₂ h₁ h₂ hG hv0,
    out_winding_eq_stepSum_pt M₁ M₂ h₁ h₂ hG hμ0]

name: prod_winding_diff_eq_stepSum
statement:
theorem prod_winding_diff_eq_stepSum (M₁ M₂ : Mesh)
    (h₁ : Legacy.WellFormedMesh M₁) (h₂ : Legacy.WellFormedMesh M₂)
    {Q : Point} (hG : Gen M₁ M₂ Q) {v μ : ℚ} (hv0 : 0 < v) (hμ0 : 0 < μ) :
    winding (meshChain M₁) (v • Q) * winding (meshChain M₂) (v • Q)
        - winding (meshChain M₁) (μ • Q) * winding (meshChain M₂) (μ • Q)
      = Proof.MeshIntersectStep.stepSum
            (prodSteps (meshSteps M₁ Q) (meshSteps M₂ Q)) v
        - Proof.MeshIntersectStep.stepSum
            (prodSteps (meshSteps M₁ Q) (meshSteps M₂ Q)) μ
proof:
:= by
  rw [winding_radial_step M₁ h₁.2.2.2 hG.1 hv0, winding_radial_step M₂ h₂.2.2.2 hG.2.1 hv0,
    winding_radial_step M₁ h₁.2.2.2 hG.1 hμ0, winding_radial_step M₂ h₂.2.2.2 hG.2.1 hμ0,
    Proof.MeshIntersectStep.stepSum_mul, Proof.MeshIntersectStep.stepSum_mul]

name: out_minus_prod_winding_diff
statement:
theorem out_minus_prod_winding_diff (M₁ M₂ : Mesh)
    (h₁ : Legacy.WellFormedMesh M₁) (h₂ : Legacy.WellFormedMesh M₂)
    {Q : Point} (hG : Gen M₁ M₂ Q) {v μ : ℚ} (hv : 1 ≤ v) (hμ : v < μ) :
    winding (meshChain (meshIntersect M₁ M₂)) (v • Q)
        - winding (meshChain (meshIntersect M₁ M₂)) (μ • Q)
      = (winding (meshChain M₁) (v • Q) * winding (meshChain M₂) (v • Q))
        - (winding (meshChain M₁) (μ • Q) * winding (meshChain M₂) (μ • Q))
proof:
:= by
  have hv0 : (0 : ℚ) < v := lt_of_lt_of_le (by norm_num) hv
  have hμ0 : (0 : ℚ) < μ := lt_trans hv0 hμ
  rw [out_winding_diff_eq_stepSum M₁ M₂ h₁ h₂ hG hv0 hμ0,
    prod_winding_diff_eq_stepSum M₁ M₂ h₁ h₂ hG hv0 hμ0]
  
  refine stepSum_sub_window_eq_of_jumps _ _ hμ (fun w hvw => ?_)
  exact out_crossing_jump_match M₁ M₂ h₁ h₂ hG w (le_trans hv hvw)

name: out_jump_eq_prod_jump
statement:
theorem out_jump_eq_prod_jump (M₁ M₂ : Mesh)
    (h₁ : Legacy.WellFormedMesh M₁) (h₂ : Legacy.WellFormedMesh M₂)
    {Q : Point} (hG : Gen M₁ M₂ Q) (v : ℚ) (hv : 1 ≤ v) :
    stepJumpAt (meshSteps (meshIntersect M₁ M₂) Q) v
      = stepJumpAt (prodSteps (meshSteps M₁ Q) (meshSteps M₂ Q)) v
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have hnpo₁ : NoPlaneThroughOrigin M₁ := h₁.2.2.2
  have hnpo₂ : NoPlaneThroughOrigin M₂ := h₂.2.2.2
  have hQ1 : ∀ j : Fin M₁.size, dotQ (carrierNormal M₁[j]) Q ≠ 0 := hG.1
  have hQ2 : ∀ j : Fin M₂.size, dotQ (carrierNormal M₂[j]) Q ≠ 0 := hG.2.1
  have hv0 : (0 : ℚ) < v := lt_of_lt_of_le (by norm_num) hv
  
  obtain ⟨μ, hμv, hgOut, hg1, hg2⟩ := gap_above_exists₃
    (meshSteps (meshIntersect M₁ M₂) Q) (meshSteps M₁ Q) (meshSteps M₂ Q) v
  
  rw [out_stepJump_eq_winding_diff M₁ M₂ h₁ h₂ hG hv0 hμv hgOut]
  
  rw [stepJumpAt_prodSteps,
    stepLeft_meshSteps_eq_winding M₁ hnpo₁ hQ1 hv0,
    stepLeft_meshSteps_eq_winding M₂ hnpo₂ hQ2 hv0,
    stepRight_meshSteps_eq_winding M₁ hnpo₁ hQ1 hv0 hμv hg1,
    stepRight_meshSteps_eq_winding M₂ hnpo₂ hQ2 hv0 hμv hg2]
  exact out_minus_prod_winding_diff M₁ M₂ h₁ h₂ hG hv hμv

name: cop_nc_out_jump_bilinear
statement:
theorem cop_nc_out_jump_bilinear (M₁ M₂ : Mesh)
    (h₁ : Legacy.WellFormedMesh M₁) (h₂ : Legacy.WellFormedMesh M₂)
    {Q : Point} (hG : Gen M₁ M₂ Q) (v : ℚ) (hv : 1 ≤ v) :
    stepJumpAt (meshSteps (outCop M₁ M₂) Q) v
        + stepJumpAt (meshSteps (outNc M₁ M₂) Q) v
      = stepLeft (meshSteps M₁ Q) v * stepLeft (meshSteps M₂ Q) v
        - stepRight (meshSteps M₁ Q) v * stepRight (meshSteps M₂ Q) v
proof:
:= by
  
  
  rw [outCop_outNc_jump_eq_out M₁ M₂ (Proof.MeshIntersectNpo.GenWF.of_legacy h₁)
      (Proof.MeshIntersectNpo.GenWF.of_legacy h₂),
    show stepLeft (meshSteps M₁ Q) v * stepLeft (meshSteps M₂ Q) v
        - stepRight (meshSteps M₁ Q) v * stepRight (meshSteps M₂ Q) v
      = stepJumpAt (prodSteps (meshSteps M₁ Q) (meshSteps M₂ Q)) v from
        (stepJumpAt_prodSteps (meshSteps M₁ Q) (meshSteps M₂ Q) v).symm]
  exact out_jump_eq_prod_jump M₁ M₂ h₁ h₂ hG v hv

name: cop_per_crossing_jump_match
statement:
theorem cop_per_crossing_jump_match (M₁ M₂ : Mesh)
    (h₁ : Legacy.WellFormedMesh M₁) (h₂ : Legacy.WellFormedMesh M₂)
    {Q : Point} (hG : Gen M₁ M₂ Q) (v : ℚ) (hv : 1 ≤ v) :
    stepJumpAt (meshSteps (outCop M₁ M₂) Q) v
        + stepJumpAt (meshSteps (outNc M₁ M₂) Q) v
      = stepJumpAt (prodSteps (meshSteps M₁ Q) (meshSteps M₂ Q)) v
proof:
:= by
  rw [stepJumpAt_prodSteps]
  exact cop_nc_out_jump_bilinear M₁ M₂ h₁ h₂ hG v hv

name: cop_residual_step_leaf
statement:
theorem cop_residual_step_leaf (M₁ M₂ : Mesh)
    (h₁ : Legacy.WellFormedMesh M₁) (h₂ : Legacy.WellFormedMesh M₂)
    {Q : Point} (hG : Gen M₁ M₂ Q) :
    stepSum (meshSteps (outCop M₁ M₂) Q) 1
      = stepSum (prodSteps (meshSteps M₁ Q) (meshSteps M₂ Q)) 1
        - stepSum (meshSteps (outNc M₁ M₂) Q) 1
proof:
:= by
  
  
  refine stepSum_one_eq_sub_of_jumps
    (meshSteps (outCop M₁ M₂) Q)
    (prodSteps (meshSteps M₁ Q) (meshSteps M₂ Q))
    (meshSteps (outNc M₁ M₂) Q)
    (fun v hv => ?_)
  exact cop_per_crossing_jump_match M₁ M₂ h₁ h₂ hG v hv

name: cop_master_pointwise
statement:
theorem cop_master_pointwise (M₁ M₂ : Mesh)
    (h₁ : Legacy.WellFormedMesh M₁) (h₂ : Legacy.WellFormedMesh M₂)
    {Q : Point} (hG : Gen M₁ M₂ Q) :
    winding (meshChain (meshIntersect M₁ M₂)) Q
      = winding (meshChain M₁) Q * winding (meshChain M₂) Q
proof:
:= by
  classical
  
  have hsplit := winding_gen_split M₁ M₂ (Proof.MeshIntersectNpo.GenWF.of_legacy h₁)
    (Proof.MeshIntersectNpo.GenWF.of_legacy h₂) Q
  rw [← Tncop] at hsplit
  
  rw [cop_bucket_radial_step M₁ M₂ h₁ h₂ hG] at hsplit
  
  rw [cop_residual_step_leaf M₁ M₂ h₁ h₂ hG] at hsplit
  
  rw [Tncop_radial_step M₁ M₂ h₁ h₂ hG] at hsplit
  
  have hprod : winding (meshChain M₁) Q * winding (meshChain M₂) Q
      = stepSum (prodSteps (meshSteps M₁ Q) (meshSteps M₂ Q)) 1 := by
    rw [winding_eq_stepSum_one M₁ h₁.2.2.2 hG.1,
      winding_eq_stepSum_one M₂ h₂.2.2.2 hG.2.1, stepSum_mul]
  rw [hprod]
  
  rw [hsplit]; ring

name: master_winding_eq
statement:
theorem master_winding_eq (M₁ M₂ : Mesh)
    (h₁ : Legacy.WellFormedMesh M₁) (h₂ : Legacy.WellFormedMesh M₂)
    {Q : Point} (hG : Gen M₁ M₂ Q) :
    winding (meshChain (meshIntersect M₁ M₂)) Q
      = winding (meshChain M₁) Q * winding (meshChain M₂) Q
proof:
:=
  cop_master_pointwise M₁ M₂ h₁ h₂ hG

name: master_gen_of_gen
statement:
theorem master_gen_of_gen (M₁ M₂ : Mesh)
    (h₁ : Legacy.WellFormedMesh M₁) (h₂ : Legacy.WellFormedMesh M₂)
    {Q : Point} (hG : Gen M₁ M₂ Q) :
    winding (meshChain (meshIntersect M₁ M₂)) Q
      = winding (meshChain M₁) Q * winding (meshChain M₂) Q
proof:
:=
  master_winding_eq M₁ M₂ h₁ h₂ hG

name: master_gen
statement:
theorem master_gen (M₁ M₂ : Mesh)
    (h₁ : Legacy.WellFormedMesh M₁) (h₂ : Legacy.WellFormedMesh M₂) :
    ∃ N : Set Point, Negligible N ∧ ∀ Q ∉ N,
      winding (meshChain (meshIntersect M₁ M₂)) Q
        = winding (meshChain M₁) Q * winding (meshChain M₂) Q
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨Nstar M₁ M₂ h₁.2.2.2 h₂.2.2.2,
    negligible_Nstar M₁ M₂ h₁.2.2.2 h₂.2.2.2, ?_⟩
  intro Q hQ
  exact master_gen_of_gen M₁ M₂ h₁ h₂
    (gen_of_not_mem_Nstar M₁ M₂ h₁.2.2.2 h₂.2.2.2 hQ)

name: meshIntersect_spec
statement:
theorem meshIntersect_spec (M₁ M₂ : Mesh)
    (h₁ : Legacy.WellFormedMesh M₁) (h₂ : Legacy.WellFormedMesh M₂) :
    EqOffPlanes (Legacy.solid (meshChain (meshIntersect M₁ M₂)))
      (Legacy.solid (meshChain M₁) ∩ Legacy.solid (meshChain M₂))
proof:
:= by
  classical
  obtain ⟨N, hNneg, hN⟩ := master_gen M₁ M₂ h₁ h₂
  refine ⟨N, hNneg, ?_⟩
  intro Q hQ
  by_contra hc
  have hfact := hN Q hc
  have hmem : Q ∈ Legacy.solid (meshChain (meshIntersect M₁ M₂))
      ↔ Q ∈ Legacy.solid (meshChain M₁) ∩ Legacy.solid (meshChain M₂) := by
    unfold Legacy.solid
    simp only [Set.mem_inter_iff, Set.mem_setOf_eq]
    rw [hfact, mul_ne_zero_iff]
  rcases hQ with hQ | hQ
  · exact (Set.not_mem_of_mem_diff hQ) (hmem.1 (Set.mem_of_mem_diff hQ))
  · exact (Set.not_mem_of_mem_diff hQ) (hmem.2 (Set.mem_of_mem_diff hQ))

name: affine_smul_eval
statement:
private theorem affine_smul_eval (g : Point →ᵃ[ℚ] ℚ) (Q : Point) (μ : ℚ) :
    g (μ • Q) = g 0 + μ * g.linear Q
proof:
:= by
  have h : g (μ • Q) = g.linear (μ • Q) + g 0 := by
    rw [AffineMap.decomp g]; simp
  rw [h, map_smul, smul_eq_mul]; ring

name: radial_exit_aux
statement:
private theorem radial_exit_aux {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι] (g : ι → (Point →ᵃ[ℚ] ℚ))
    (K : Set Point) (hK : K = ⋂ ℓ, {x : Point | 0 ≤ g ℓ x})
    (hg0 : ∀ ℓ, 0 ≤ g ℓ 0)
    (hbind : ∀ {Q : Point}, Q ≠ 0 → ∃ ℓ, (g ℓ).linear Q < 0)
    {Q : Point} (hQ : Q ≠ 0) :
    ∃ ρ : ℚ, 0 ≤ ρ ∧ {μ : ℚ | 0 ≤ μ ∧ μ • Q ∈ K} = Set.Icc 0 ρ
      ∧ ∃ ℓ, (g ℓ).linear Q < 0 ∧ g ℓ 0 / (-(g ℓ).linear Q) = ρ
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have hscale := fun ℓ μ => affine_smul_eval (g ℓ) Q μ
  
  set B : Finset ι := Finset.univ.filter (fun ℓ => (g ℓ).linear Q < 0) with hB
  obtain ⟨ℓ₀, hℓ₀⟩ := hbind hQ
  have hBne : B.Nonempty := ⟨ℓ₀, by simp [hB, hℓ₀]⟩
  
  set f : ι → ℚ := fun ℓ => g ℓ 0 / (-(g ℓ).linear Q) with hf
  set ρ : ℚ := (B.image f).min' (hBne.image f) with hρ
  have hρnn : 0 ≤ ρ := by
    rw [hρ]; apply Finset.le_min'; intro y hy
    rw [Finset.mem_image] at hy; obtain ⟨ℓ, hℓB, rfl⟩ := hy
    rw [hB, Finset.mem_filter] at hℓB
    apply div_nonneg (hg0 ℓ); linarith [hℓB.2]
  
  have hmem : ρ ∈ B.image f := by rw [hρ]; exact Finset.min'_mem _ _
  rw [Finset.mem_image] at hmem
  obtain ⟨ℓs, hℓsB, hℓseq⟩ := hmem
  rw [hB, Finset.mem_filter] at hℓsB
  refine ⟨ρ, hρnn, ?_, ℓs, hℓsB.2, hℓseq⟩
  ext μ
  simp only [Set.mem_setOf_eq, Set.mem_Icc]
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨hμ0, hμK⟩
    refine ⟨hμ0, ?_⟩
    
    rw [hρ]; apply Finset.le_min'; intro y hy
    rw [Finset.mem_image] at hy; obtain ⟨ℓ, hℓB, rfl⟩ := hy
    rw [hB, Finset.mem_filter] at hℓB
    have hLneg : (g ℓ).linear Q < 0 := hℓB.2
    rw [hK] at hμK
    have hge : 0 ≤ g ℓ (μ • Q) := by simpa using Set.mem_iInter.mp hμK ℓ
    rw [hscale] at hge
    rw [hf, le_div_iff₀ (by linarith : (0:ℚ) < -(g ℓ).linear Q)]
    nlinarith
  · rintro ⟨hμ0, hμρ⟩
    refine ⟨hμ0, ?_⟩
    rw [hK, Set.mem_iInter]; intro ℓ
    simp only [Set.mem_setOf_eq]; rw [hscale]
    by_cases hLsign : (g ℓ).linear Q < 0
    · 
      have hℓB : ℓ ∈ B := by simp [hB, hLsign]
      have hρf : ρ ≤ f ℓ := by
        rw [hρ]; exact Finset.min'_le _ _ (Finset.mem_image_of_mem f hℓB)
      have hμf : μ ≤ f ℓ := le_trans hμρ hρf
      rw [hf, le_div_iff₀ (by linarith : (0:ℚ) < -(g ℓ).linear Q)] at hμf
      nlinarith [hg0 ℓ]
    · 
      push_neg at hLsign
      have : 0 ≤ μ * (g ℓ).linear Q := mul_nonneg hμ0 hLsign
      linarith [hg0 ℓ]

name: radial_exit
statement:
theorem radial_exit {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι] (g : ι → (Point →ᵃ[ℚ] ℚ))
    (K : Set Point) (hK : K = ⋂ ℓ, {x : Point | 0 ≤ g ℓ x})
    (hg0 : ∀ ℓ, 0 ≤ g ℓ 0)
    (hbind : ∀ {Q : Point}, Q ≠ 0 → ∃ ℓ, (g ℓ).linear Q < 0)
    {Q : Point} (hQ : Q ≠ 0) :
    ∃ ρ : ℚ, 0 ≤ ρ ∧ {μ : ℚ | 0 ≤ μ ∧ μ • Q ∈ K} = Set.Icc 0 ρ
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨ρ, hρnn, hρeq, _⟩ := radial_exit_aux g K hK hg0 hbind hQ
  exact ⟨ρ, hρnn, hρeq⟩

name: radial_exit_pos_outer
statement:
theorem radial_exit_pos_outer {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι] (g : ι → (Point →ᵃ[ℚ] ℚ))
    (K : Set Point) (hK : K = ⋂ ℓ, {x : Point | 0 ≤ g ℓ x})
    (hg0 : ∀ ℓ, 0 ≤ g ℓ 0)
    (hbind : ∀ {Q : Point}, Q ≠ 0 → ∃ ℓ, (g ℓ).linear Q < 0)
    {Q : Point} (hQ : Q ≠ 0) (hQK : Q ∈ K) (ρ : ℚ)
    (hρ : {μ : ℚ | 0 ≤ μ ∧ μ • Q ∈ K} = Set.Icc 0 ρ)
    (hP₀ : ∀ ℓ, g ℓ 0 = 0 → 0 < (g ℓ).linear Q) :
    1 ≤ ρ ∧ ∃ ℓ, 0 < g ℓ 0 ∧ (g ℓ).linear Q < 0
      ∧ g ℓ 0 / (-(g ℓ).linear Q) = ρ ∧ g ℓ (ρ • Q) = 0
proof:
:= by
  classical
  
  have h1feas : (1 : ℚ) ∈ {μ : ℚ | 0 ≤ μ ∧ μ • Q ∈ K} := by
    refine ⟨zero_le_one, ?_⟩; rw [one_smul]; exact hQK
  rw [hρ] at h1feas
  have h1ρ : (1 : ℚ) ≤ ρ := h1feas.2
  refine ⟨h1ρ, ?_⟩
  
  obtain ⟨ρm, hρmnn, hρmeq, ℓs, hℓsneg, hℓseq⟩ :=
    radial_exit_aux g K hK hg0 hbind hQ
  have hρeq : ρm = ρ := by
    rw [hρ] at hρmeq  
    have hr : 0 ≤ ρ := le_trans zero_le_one h1ρ
    have h1 : ρm ∈ Set.Icc (0:ℚ) ρ := by rw [hρmeq]; exact Set.right_mem_Icc.mpr hρmnn
    have h2 : ρ ∈ Set.Icc (0:ℚ) ρm := by rw [← hρmeq]; exact Set.right_mem_Icc.mpr hr
    exact le_antisymm h1.2 h2.2
  refine ⟨ℓs, ?_, hℓsneg, ?_, ?_⟩
  · 
    
    rcases lt_or_eq_of_le (hg0 ℓs) with h | h
    · exact h
    · exact absurd (hP₀ ℓs h.symm) (by linarith)
  · rw [hℓseq, hρeq]
  · 
    rw [affine_smul_eval, ← hρeq, ← hℓseq]
    have hLne : -(g ℓs).linear Q ≠ 0 := by linarith [hℓsneg]
    field_simp

name: clipFrag_plane_mem
statement:
theorem clipFrag_plane_mem (g : IPlane) (f : Frag) :
    ∀ f' ∈ clipFrag g f, f'.plane = f.plane
proof:
:= by
  intro f' hf'
  rw [clipFrag_eq] at hf'
  split at hf'
  · rw [Array.mem_singleton] at hf'; rw [hf']
  · rw [Array.mem_def] at hf'
    fin_cases hf' <;> rfl

name: list_forall2_flatMap
statement:
theorem list_forall2_flatMap {α β γ} (R : β → γ → Prop) (l : List α)
    (g : α → List β) (f : α → List γ) (h : ∀ a ∈ l, List.Forall₂ R (g a) (f a)) :
    List.Forall₂ R (l.flatMap g) (l.flatMap f)
proof:
:= by
  induction l with
  | nil => exact List.Forall₂.nil
  | cons a l ih =>
      simp only [List.flatMap_cons]
      exact List.rel_append (h a (List.mem_cons_self _ _))
        (ih (fun x hx => h x (List.mem_cons_of_mem _ hx)))

name: block_forall2
statement:
theorem block_forall2 (o : P3) (a b c : P3) (K : Array Frag)
    (hpl : ∀ f ∈ K, f.plane = iFacePlaneP a b c) :
    List.Forall₂ (FragSeam o) K.toList
      (((K.map (trFrag o)).map
        (setPlane (iFacePlaneP (psubS a o) (psubS b o) (psubS c o)))).toList)
proof:
:= by
  rw [Array.map_map]
  rw [Array.toList_map]
  rw [List.forall₂_map_right_iff]
  rw [List.forall₂_same]
  intro k hk
  refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
  · simp only [Function.comp, setPlane_poly, trFrag_poly]
  · refine ⟨a, b, c, hpl k (Array.mem_toList.mp hk), ?_⟩
    simp only [Function.comp, setPlane_plane]

name: fragOfFace_faithful

    (h : VtxFaithful f.v₀ ∧ VtxFaithful f.v₁ ∧ VtxFaithful f.v₂) :

  rw [Array.mem_def] at hv
  fin_cases hv
  · exact h.1
  · exact h.2.1
  · exact h.2.2

name: member_fracVal_cases
statement:
theorem member_fracVal_cases (m : Fin 3) (vs : Array I3) (signs : Array Int)
    (nO qO : I3) (p : Int × Int)
    (hsm : ∀ k, k < 3 → signs.getD k 0
      = Int.sign (dotI nO (subI (vs.getD k default) qO)))
    (hp : p ∈ collectParams (m : ℕ) vs signs nO qO) :
    (∃ j, j < 3 ∧ signs.getD j 0 = 0 ∧ fracVal p = Cval m vs j) ∨
    (∃ k, k < 3 ∧
        ((signs.getD k 0 < 0 ∧ 0 < signs.getD ((k+1)%3) 0) ∨
         (0 < signs.getD k 0 ∧ signs.getD ((k+1)%3) 0 < 0)) ∧
        Eval nO qO vs k - Eval nO qO vs ((k+1)%3) ≠ 0 ∧
        fracVal p = (Eval nO qO vs k * Cval m vs ((k+1)%3)
            - Eval nO qO vs ((k+1)%3) * Cval m vs k)
          / (Eval nO qO vs k - Eval nO qO vs ((k+1)%3)))
proof:
:= by
  rcases collectParams_mem_cases (m : ℕ) vs signs nO qO p hp with
    ⟨j, hj3, hsj, hpeq⟩ | ⟨k, hk3, hguard, hpeq⟩
  · left
    refine ⟨j, hj3, hsj, ?_⟩
    rw [hpeq, vertexHit_fracVal (m : ℕ) m.2 _]
    rfl
  · 
    right
    have hk1 : (k+1)%3 < 3 := Nat.mod_lt _ (by norm_num)
    have hsa := hsm k hk3
    have hsb := hsm ((k+1)%3) hk1
    have hdenI : dotI nO (subI (vs.getD k default) qO)
        - dotI nO (subI (vs.getD ((k+1)%3) default) qO) ≠ 0 := by
      rw [hsa, hsb] at hguard
      rcases hguard with ⟨h1, h2⟩ | ⟨h1, h2⟩
      · have ha : dotI nO (subI (vs.getD k default) qO) < 0 := int_neg_of_sign_neg (by simpa using h1)
        have hb : 0 < dotI nO (subI (vs.getD ((k+1)%3) default) qO) := int_pos_of_sign_pos (by simpa using h2)
        omega
      · have ha : 0 < dotI nO (subI (vs.getD k default) qO) := int_pos_of_sign_pos (by simpa using h1)
        have hb : dotI nO (subI (vs.getD ((k+1)%3) default) qO) < 0 := int_neg_of_sign_neg (by simpa using h2)
        omega
    have hden : Eval nO qO vs k - Eval nO qO vs ((k+1)%3) ≠ 0 := by
      simp only [Eval]; rw [← Int.cast_sub, Int.cast_ne_zero]; exact hdenI
    refine ⟨k, hk3, hguard, hden, ?_⟩
    rw [hpeq]
    simp only []
    rw [edgeHit_fracVal (m : ℕ) m.2 _ _ _ _ hdenI]
    simp only [Eval, Cval]

name: mem_vertex_of_eval_zero
statement:
theorem mem_vertex_of_eval_zero (m : Fin 3) (vs : Array I3) (signs : Array Int)
    (nO qO : I3) (j : Nat) (hj : j < 3)
    (hsm : signs.getD j 0 = Int.sign (dotI nO (subI (vs.getD j default) qO)))
    (hz : Eval nO qO vs j = 0) :
    (coordAt (m : ℕ) (vs.getD j default), (1 : Int)) ∈ collectParams (m : ℕ) vs signs nO qO
proof:
:= by
  apply collectParams_mem_vertex
  · exact hj
  · rw [hsm]
    have : dotI nO (subI (vs.getD j default) qO) = 0 := by
      have : ((dotI nO (subI (vs.getD j default) qO) : Int) : ℚ) = 0 := hz
      exact_mod_cast this
    rw [this]; simp

name: mem_edge_of_eval_opp
statement:
theorem mem_edge_of_eval_opp (m : Fin 3) (vs : Array I3) (signs : Array Int)
    (nO qO : I3) (k : Nat) (hk : k < 3)
    (hsa : signs.getD k 0 = Int.sign (dotI nO (subI (vs.getD k default) qO)))
    (hsb : signs.getD ((k+1)%3) 0 = Int.sign (dotI nO (subI (vs.getD ((k+1)%3) default) qO)))
    (hopp : (Eval nO qO vs k < 0 ∧ 0 < Eval nO qO vs ((k+1)%3)) ∨
            (0 < Eval nO qO vs k ∧ Eval nO qO vs ((k+1)%3) < 0)) :
    (let a := vs.getD k default; let b := vs.getD ((k+1)%3) default
     let ea := dotI nO (subI a qO); let eb := dotI nO (subI b qO)
     let aDom := coordAt (m : ℕ) a; let bDom := coordAt (m : ℕ) b; let den := ea - eb
     fracNorm (aDom * den + ea * (bDom - aDom)) den)
      ∈ collectParams (m : ℕ) vs signs nO qO
proof:
:= by
  apply collectParams_mem_edge
  · exact hk
  · rw [hsa, hsb]
    rcases hopp with ⟨h1, h2⟩ | ⟨h1, h2⟩
    · left
      have ea : dotI nO (subI (vs.getD k default) qO) < 0 := by
        have : ((dotI nO (subI (vs.getD k default) qO) : Int) : ℚ) < 0 := h1
        exact_mod_cast this
      have eb : 0 < dotI nO (subI (vs.getD ((k+1)%3) default) qO) := by
        have : (0:ℚ) < ((dotI nO (subI (vs.getD ((k+1)%3) default) qO) : Int) : ℚ) := h2
        exact_mod_cast this
      exact ⟨by rw [Int.sign_eq_neg_one_iff_neg.mpr ea]; norm_num,
             by rw [Int.sign_eq_one_iff_pos.mpr eb]; norm_num⟩
    · right
      have ea : 0 < dotI nO (subI (vs.getD k default) qO) := by
        have : (0:ℚ) < ((dotI nO (subI (vs.getD k default) qO) : Int) : ℚ) := h1
        exact_mod_cast this
      have eb : dotI nO (subI (vs.getD ((k+1)%3) default) qO) < 0 := by
        have : ((dotI nO (subI (vs.getD ((k+1)%3) default) qO) : Int) : ℚ) < 0 := h2
        exact_mod_cast this
      exact ⟨by rw [Int.sign_eq_one_iff_pos.mpr ea]; norm_num,
             by rw [Int.sign_eq_neg_one_iff_neg.mpr eb]; norm_num⟩

name: edge_cut_fracVal
statement:
theorem edge_cut_fracVal (m : Fin 3) (vs : Array I3) (nO qO : I3) (k : Nat)
    (hden : Eval nO qO vs k - Eval nO qO vs ((k+1)%3) ≠ 0) :
    fracVal (let a := vs.getD k default; let b := vs.getD ((k+1)%3) default
       let ea := dotI nO (subI a qO); let eb := dotI nO (subI b qO)
       let aDom := coordAt (m : ℕ) a; let bDom := coordAt (m : ℕ) b; let den := ea - eb
       fracNorm (aDom * den + ea * (bDom - aDom)) den)
      = (Eval nO qO vs k * Cval m vs ((k+1)%3) - Eval nO qO vs ((k+1)%3) * Cval m vs k)
          / (Eval nO qO vs k - Eval nO qO vs ((k+1)%3))
proof:
:= by
  have hdenI : dotI nO (subI (vs.getD k default) qO)
      - dotI nO (subI (vs.getD ((k+1)%3) default) qO) ≠ 0 := by
    simp only [Eval] at hden
    rw [← Int.cast_sub, Int.cast_ne_zero] at hden
    exact hden
  simp only []
  rw [edgeHit_fracVal (m : ℕ) m.2 _ _ _ _ hdenI]
  simp only [Eval, Cval]

name: eval_sign_iff
statement:
theorem eval_sign_iff (vs : Array I3) (signs : Array Int) (nO qO : I3) (j : Nat)
    (hsm : signs.getD j 0 = Int.sign (dotI nO (subI (vs.getD j default) qO))) :
    (signs.getD j 0 = 0 ↔ Eval nO qO vs j = 0) ∧
    (signs.getD j 0 < 0 ↔ Eval nO qO vs j < 0) ∧
    (0 < signs.getD j 0 ↔ 0 < Eval nO qO vs j)
proof:
:= by
  simp only [Eval]
  set d := dotI nO (subI (vs.getD j default) qO) with hd
  refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · rw [hsm]
    constructor
    · intro h; have : d = 0 := by
        rcases lt_trichotomy d 0 with h' | h' | h'
        · rw [Int.sign_eq_neg_one_iff_neg.mpr h'] at h; omega
        · exact h'
        · rw [Int.sign_eq_one_iff_pos.mpr h'] at h; omega
      rw [this]; norm_num
    · intro h; have hd0 : d = 0 := by exact_mod_cast h
      rw [hd0]; simp
  · rw [hsm]
    constructor
    · intro h; have : d < 0 := int_neg_of_sign_neg h; exact_mod_cast this
    · intro h; have : d < 0 := by exact_mod_cast h
      rw [Int.sign_eq_neg_one_iff_neg.mpr this]; norm_num
  · rw [hsm]
    constructor
    · intro h; have : 0 < d := int_pos_of_sign_pos h; exact_mod_cast this
    · intro h; have : 0 < d := by exact_mod_cast h
      rw [Int.sign_eq_one_iff_pos.mpr this]; norm_num

name: ub_one_zero_same
statement:
theorem ub_one_zero_same (e1 e2 c0 c1 c2 μ0 μ1 μ2 ub : ℚ)
    (hsame : (0 < e1 ∧ 0 < e2) ∨ (e1 < 0 ∧ e2 < 0))
    (hm0 : 0 ≤ μ0) (hm1 : 0 ≤ μ1) (hm2 : 0 ≤ μ2) (hsum : μ0 + μ1 + μ2 = 1)
    (hfeas : μ1 * e1 + μ2 * e2 = 0) (hv : c0 ≤ ub) :
    μ0 * c0 + μ1 * c1 + μ2 * c2 ≤ ub
proof:
:= by
  have hcol : μ0 * c0 + μ1 * c1 + μ2 * c2 = c0 := by
    rcases hsame with ⟨h1, h2⟩ | ⟨h1, h2⟩
    · exact feasible_one_zero_same_sign e1 e2 c0 c1 c2 μ0 μ1 μ2 h1 h2 hm0 hm1 hm2 hsum hfeas
    · have := feasible_one_zero_same_sign (-e1) (-e2) c0 c1 c2 μ0 μ1 μ2
        (by linarith) (by linarith) hm0 hm1 hm2 hsum (by linarith)
      linarith [this]
  rw [hcol]; exact hv

name: same_sign_absurd
statement:
theorem same_sign_absurd (e0 e1 e2 μ0 μ1 μ2 : ℚ)
    (hm0 : 0 ≤ μ0) (hm1 : 0 ≤ μ1) (hm2 : 0 ≤ μ2) (hsum : μ0 + μ1 + μ2 = 1)
    (hfeas : μ0 * e0 + μ1 * e1 + μ2 * e2 = 0)
    (hsign : (e0 < 0 ∧ e1 < 0 ∧ e2 < 0) ∨ (0 < e0 ∧ 0 < e1 ∧ 0 < e2)) : False
proof:
:= by
  rcases hsign with ⟨h0, h1, h2⟩ | ⟨h0, h1, h2⟩
  · have p0 : μ0 = 0 := by
      by_contra h; have hp : 0 < μ0 := lt_of_le_of_ne hm0 (Ne.symm h)
      linarith [mul_nonneg hm1 (neg_nonneg.mpr h1.le), mul_nonneg hm2 (neg_nonneg.mpr h2.le),
        mul_pos hp (neg_pos.mpr h0)]
    have p1 : μ1 = 0 := by
      by_contra h; have hp : 0 < μ1 := lt_of_le_of_ne hm1 (Ne.symm h)
      linarith [mul_nonneg hm0 (neg_nonneg.mpr h0.le), mul_nonneg hm2 (neg_nonneg.mpr h2.le),
        mul_pos hp (neg_pos.mpr h1)]
    have p2 : μ2 = 0 := by
      by_contra h; have hp : 0 < μ2 := lt_of_le_of_ne hm2 (Ne.symm h)
      linarith [mul_nonneg hm0 (neg_nonneg.mpr h0.le), mul_nonneg hm1 (neg_nonneg.mpr h1.le),
        mul_pos hp (neg_pos.mpr h2)]
    rw [p0, p1, p2] at hsum; norm_num at hsum
  · have p0 : μ0 = 0 := by
      by_contra h; have hp : 0 < μ0 := lt_of_le_of_ne hm0 (Ne.symm h)
      linarith [mul_nonneg hm1 h1.le, mul_nonneg hm2 h2.le, mul_pos hp h0]
    have p1 : μ1 = 0 := by
      by_contra h; have hp : 0 < μ1 := lt_of_le_of_ne hm1 (Ne.symm h)
      linarith [mul_nonneg hm0 h0.le, mul_nonneg hm2 h2.le, mul_pos hp h1]
    have p2 : μ2 = 0 := by
      by_contra h; have hp : 0 < μ2 := lt_of_le_of_ne hm2 (Ne.symm h)
      linarith [mul_nonneg hm0 h0.le, mul_nonneg hm1 h1.le, mul_pos hp h2]
    rw [p0, p1, p2] at hsum; norm_num at hsum

name: weight_eq_zero
statement: theorem weight_eq_zero (μ e : ℚ) (he : e ≠ 0) (h : μ * e = 0) : μ = 0
proof:
:= by
  rcases mul_eq_zero.mp h with h | h
  · exact h
  · exact absurd h he

name: orbit_upper
proof:
:= by
  rcases lt_trichotomy e0 0 with h0 | h0 | h0 <;>
    rcases lt_trichotomy e1 0 with h1 | h1 | h1 <;>
      rcases lt_trichotomy e2 0 with h2 | h2 | h2
  
  · exact absurd hfeas (by intro hf; exact same_sign_absurd e0 e1 e2 μ0 μ1 μ2 hm0 hm1 hm2 hsum hf (Or.inl ⟨h0, h1, h2⟩))
  
  · exact le_of_eq_of_le (by ring) (ub_one_zero_same e0 e1 c2 c0 c1 μ2 μ0 μ1 ub (Or.inr ⟨h0, h1⟩) hm2 hm0 hm1 (by linarith) (by have hf := hfeas; rw [h2] at hf; linarith [hf]) (v2 h2))
  
  · exact le_of_eq_of_le (by ring) (bound_two_cuts (-e0) (-e1) (-e2) c0 c1 c2 μ0 μ1 μ2 _ _ ub (by linarith) hm0 hm1 hm2 (by linarith) (by linarith) rfl rfl (by linarith [K21 h2 h1]) (by linarith [K20 h2 h0]) (by linarith) (by linarith))
  
  · exact le_of_eq_of_le (by ring) (ub_one_zero_same e0 e2 c1 c0 c2 μ1 μ0 μ2 ub (Or.inr ⟨h0, h2⟩) hm1 hm0 hm2 (by linarith) (by have hf := hfeas; rw [h1] at hf; linarith [hf]) (v1 h1))
  
  · have hmo0 : μ0 = 0 := weight_eq_zero μ0 e0 h0.ne (by have hf := hfeas; rw [h1, h2] at hf; linarith [hf])
    subst hmo0
    have key : μ1 * ub + μ2 * ub = ub := by linear_combination ub * hsum
    linarith [mul_nonneg hm1 (sub_nonneg.mpr (v1 h1)), mul_nonneg hm2 (sub_nonneg.mpr (v2 h2)), key]
  
  · exact le_of_eq_of_le (by ring) (bound_vertex_cut e2 e0 c1 c2 c0 μ1 μ2 μ0 _ ub h2 h0 hm1 hm2 hm0 (by linarith) (by have hf := hfeas; rw [h1] at hf; linarith [hf]) rfl (v1 h1) (K20 h2 h0) (by linarith))
  
  · exact le_of_eq_of_le (by ring) (bound_two_cuts (-e0) (-e2) (-e1) c0 c2 c1 μ0 μ2 μ1 _ _ ub (by linarith) hm0 hm2 hm1 (by linarith) (by linarith) rfl rfl (by linarith [K12 h1 h2]) (by linarith [K10 h1 h0]) (by linarith) (by linarith))
  
  · exact le_of_eq_of_le (by ring) (bound_vertex_cut e1 e0 c2 c1 c0 μ2 μ1 μ0 _ ub h1 h0 hm2 hm1 hm0 (by linarith) (by have hf := hfeas; rw [h2] at hf; linarith [hf]) rfl (v2 h2) (K10 h1 h0) (by linarith))
  
  · exact le_of_eq_of_le (by ring) (bound_two_cuts e1 e2 e0 c1 c2 c0 μ1 μ2 μ0 _ _ ub h0 hm1 hm2 hm0 (by linarith) (by linarith) rfl rfl (K20 h2 h0) (K10 h1 h0) (by linarith) (by linarith))
  
  · exact le_of_eq_of_le (by ring) (ub_one_zero_same e1 e2 c0 c1 c2 μ0 μ1 μ2 ub (Or.inr ⟨h1, h2⟩) hm0 hm1 hm2 (by linarith) (by have hf := hfeas; rw [h0] at hf; linarith [hf]) (v0 h0))
  
  · have hmo0 : μ1 = 0 := weight_eq_zero μ1 e1 h1.ne (by have hf := hfeas; rw [h0, h2] at hf; linarith [hf])
    subst hmo0
    have key : μ0 * ub + μ2 * ub = ub := by linear_combination ub * hsum
    linarith [mul_nonneg hm0 (sub_nonneg.mpr (v0 h0)), mul_nonneg hm2 (sub_nonneg.mpr (v2 h2)), key]
  
  · exact le_of_eq_of_le (by ring) (bound_vertex_cut e2 e1 c0 c2 c1 μ0 μ2 μ1 _ ub h2 h1 hm0 hm2 hm1 (by linarith) (by have hf := hfeas; rw [h0] at hf; linarith [hf]) rfl (v0 h0) (K21 h2 h1) (by linarith))
  
  · have hmo0 : μ2 = 0 := weight_eq_zero μ2 e2 h2.ne (by have hf := hfeas; rw [h0, h1] at hf; linarith [hf])
    subst hmo0
    have key : μ0 * ub + μ1 * ub = ub := by linear_combination ub * hsum
    linarith [mul_nonneg hm0 (sub_nonneg.mpr (v0 h0)), mul_nonneg hm1 (sub_nonneg.mpr (v1 h1)), key]
  
  · have key : μ0 * ub + μ1 * ub + μ2 * ub = ub := by linear_combination ub * hsum
    linarith [mul_nonneg hm0 (sub_nonneg.mpr (v0 h0)), mul_nonneg hm1 (sub_nonneg.mpr (v1 h1)),
      mul_nonneg hm2 (sub_nonneg.mpr (v2 h2)), key]
  
  · have hmo0 : μ2 = 0 := weight_eq_zero μ2 e2 h2.ne' (by have hf := hfeas; rw [h0, h1] at hf; linarith [hf])
    subst hmo0
    have key : μ0 * ub + μ1 * ub = ub := by linear_combination ub * hsum
    linarith [mul_nonneg hm0 (sub_nonneg.mpr (v0 h0)), mul_nonneg hm1 (sub_nonneg.mpr (v1 h1)), key]
  
  · exact le_of_eq_of_le (by ring) (bound_vertex_cut e1 e2 c0 c1 c2 μ0 μ1 μ2 _ ub h1 h2 hm0 hm1 hm2 (by linarith) (by have hf := hfeas; rw [h0] at hf; linarith [hf]) rfl (v0 h0) (K12 h1 h2) (by linarith))
  
  · have hmo0 : μ1 = 0 := weight_eq_zero μ1 e1 h1.ne' (by have hf := hfeas; rw [h0, h2] at hf; linarith [hf])
    subst hmo0
    have key : μ0 * ub + μ2 * ub = ub := by linear_combination ub * hsum
    linarith [mul_nonneg hm0 (sub_nonneg.mpr (v0 h0)), mul_nonneg hm2 (sub_nonneg.mpr (v2 h2)), key]
  
  · exact le_of_eq_of_le (by ring) (ub_one_zero_same e1 e2 c0 c1 c2 μ0 μ1 μ2 ub (Or.inl ⟨h1, h2⟩) hm0 hm1 hm2 (by linarith) (by have hf := hfeas; rw [h0] at hf; linarith [hf]) (v0 h0))
  
  · exact le_of_eq_of_le (by ring) (bound_two_cuts (-e1) (-e2) (-e0) c1 c2 c0 μ1 μ2 μ0 _ _ ub (by linarith) hm1 hm2 hm0 (by linarith) (by linarith) rfl rfl (by linarith [K02 h0 h2]) (by linarith [K01 h0 h1]) (by linarith) (by linarith))
  
  · exact le_of_eq_of_le (by ring) (bound_vertex_cut e0 e1 c2 c0 c1 μ2 μ0 μ1 _ ub h0 h1 hm2 hm0 hm1 (by linarith) (by have hf := hfeas; rw [h2] at hf; linarith [hf]) rfl (v2 h2) (K01 h0 h1) (by linarith))
  
  · exact le_of_eq_of_le (by ring) (bound_two_cuts e0 e2 e1 c0 c2 c1 μ0 μ2 μ1 _ _ ub h1 hm0 hm2 hm1 (by linarith) (by linarith) rfl rfl (K21 h2 h1) (K01 h0 h1) (by linarith) (by linarith))
  
  · exact le_of_eq_of_le (by ring) (bound_vertex_cut e0 e2 c1 c0 c2 μ1 μ0 μ2 _ ub h0 h2 hm1 hm0 hm2 (by linarith) (by have hf := hfeas; rw [h1] at hf; linarith [hf]) rfl (v1 h1) (K02 h0 h2) (by linarith))
  
  · have hmo0 : μ0 = 0 := weight_eq_zero μ0 e0 h0.ne' (by have hf := hfeas; rw [h1, h2] at hf; linarith [hf])
    subst hmo0
    have key : μ1 * ub + μ2 * ub = ub := by linear_combination ub * hsum
    linarith [mul_nonneg hm1 (sub_nonneg.mpr (v1 h1)), mul_nonneg hm2 (sub_nonneg.mpr (v2 h2)), key]
  
  · exact le_of_eq_of_le (by ring) (ub_one_zero_same e0 e2 c1 c0 c2 μ1 μ0 μ2 ub (Or.inl ⟨h0, h2⟩) hm1 hm0 hm2 (by linarith) (by have hf := hfeas; rw [h1] at hf; linarith [hf]) (v1 h1))
  
  · exact le_of_eq_of_le (by ring) (bound_two_cuts e0 e1 e2 c0 c1 c2 μ0 μ1 μ2 _ _ ub h2 hm0 hm1 hm2 (by linarith) (by linarith) rfl rfl (K12 h1 h2) (K02 h0 h2) (by linarith) (by linarith))
  
  · exact le_of_eq_of_le (by ring) (ub_one_zero_same e0 e1 c2 c0 c1 μ2 μ0 μ1 ub (Or.inl ⟨h0, h1⟩) hm2 hm0 hm1 (by linarith) (by have hf := hfeas; rw [h2] at hf; linarith [hf]) (v2 h2))
  
  · exact absurd hfeas (by intro hf; exact same_sign_absurd e0 e1 e2 μ0 μ1 μ2 hm0 hm1 hm2 hsum hf (Or.inr ⟨h0, h1, h2⟩))

name: proj_le_ub
statement:
theorem proj_le_ub (m : Fin 3) (vs : Array I3) (signs : Array Int) (nO qO : I3)
    (μ0 μ1 μ2 ub : ℚ)
    (hsm : ∀ k, k < 3 → signs.getD k 0 = Int.sign (dotI nO (subI (vs.getD k default) qO)))
    (hm0 : 0 ≤ μ0) (hm1 : 0 ≤ μ1) (hm2 : 0 ≤ μ2) (hsum : μ0 + μ1 + μ2 = 1)
    (hfeas : μ0 * Eval nO qO vs 0 + μ1 * Eval nO qO vs 1 + μ2 * Eval nO qO vs 2 = 0)
    (hub : ∀ p ∈ collectParams (m : ℕ) vs signs nO qO, fracVal p ≤ ub) :
    μ0 * Cval m vs 0 + μ1 * Cval m vs 1 + μ2 * Cval m vs 2 ≤ ub
proof:
:= by
  set e0 := Eval nO qO vs 0 with he0
  set e1 := Eval nO qO vs 1 with he1
  set e2 := Eval nO qO vs 2 with he2
  set c0 := Cval m vs 0 with hc0
  set c1 := Cval m vs 1 with hc1
  set c2 := Cval m vs 2 with hc2
  
  have hvtx : ∀ j : Nat, j < 3 → Eval nO qO vs j = 0 → Cval m vs j ≤ ub := by
    intro j hj hz
    have hmem := mem_vertex_of_eval_zero m vs signs nO qO j hj (hsm j hj) hz
    have := hub _ hmem
    rwa [vertexHit_fracVal (m : ℕ) m.2, ← Cval] at this
  
  have hcut : ∀ k : Nat, k < 3 →
      ((Eval nO qO vs k < 0 ∧ 0 < Eval nO qO vs ((k+1)%3)) ∨
       (0 < Eval nO qO vs k ∧ Eval nO qO vs ((k+1)%3) < 0)) →
      (Eval nO qO vs k * Cval m vs ((k+1)%3) - Eval nO qO vs ((k+1)%3) * Cval m vs k)
          / (Eval nO qO vs k - Eval nO qO vs ((k+1)%3)) ≤ ub := by
    intro k hk hopp
    have hk1 : (k+1)%3 < 3 := Nat.mod_lt _ (by norm_num)
    have hmem := mem_edge_of_eval_opp m vs signs nO qO k hk (hsm k hk) (hsm ((k+1)%3) hk1) hopp
    have hbnd := hub _ hmem
    have hden : Eval nO qO vs k - Eval nO qO vs ((k+1)%3) ≠ 0 := by
      rcases hopp with ⟨h1, h2⟩ | ⟨h1, h2⟩ <;> (intro hc; linarith)
    rwa [edge_cut_fracVal m vs nO qO k hden] at hbnd
  
  have v0 : e0 = 0 → c0 ≤ ub := fun h => by have := hvtx 0 (by norm_num) h; rwa [← hc0] at this
  have v1 : e1 = 0 → c1 ≤ ub := fun h => by have := hvtx 1 (by norm_num) h; rwa [← hc1] at this
  have v2 : e2 = 0 → c2 ≤ ub := fun h => by have := hvtx 2 (by norm_num) h; rwa [← hc2] at this
  
  have cut01 : (e0 < 0 ∧ 0 < e1) ∨ (0 < e0 ∧ e1 < 0) →
      (e0 * c1 - e1 * c0) / (e0 - e1) ≤ ub := by
    intro hopp
    have h := hcut 0 (by norm_num)
      (by simpa only [show ((0:ℕ)+1)%3 = 1 from rfl, ← he0, ← he1] using hopp)
    simpa only [show ((0:ℕ)+1)%3 = 1 from rfl, ← he0, ← he1, ← hc0, ← hc1] using h
  have cut12 : (e1 < 0 ∧ 0 < e2) ∨ (0 < e1 ∧ e2 < 0) →
      (e1 * c2 - e2 * c1) / (e1 - e2) ≤ ub := by
    intro hopp
    have h := hcut 1 (by norm_num)
      (by simpa only [show ((1:ℕ)+1)%3 = 2 from rfl, ← he1, ← he2] using hopp)
    simpa only [show ((1:ℕ)+1)%3 = 2 from rfl, ← he1, ← he2, ← hc1, ← hc2] using h
  have cut20 : (e2 < 0 ∧ 0 < e0) ∨ (0 < e2 ∧ e0 < 0) →
      (e2 * c0 - e0 * c2) / (e2 - e0) ≤ ub := by
    intro hopp
    have h := hcut 2 (by norm_num)
      (by simpa only [show ((2:ℕ)+1)%3 = 0 from rfl, ← he2, ← he0] using hopp)
    simpa only [show ((2:ℕ)+1)%3 = 0 from rfl, ← he2, ← he0, ← hc2, ← hc0] using h
  
  have clearK : ∀ ea eb ca cb : ℚ, 0 < ea - eb →
      (ea * cb - eb * ca) / (ea - eb) ≤ ub → ea * cb - eb * ca ≤ ub * (ea - eb) := by
    intro ea eb ca cb hd hle; rw [div_le_iff₀ hd] at hle; linarith
  
  have flipDiv : ∀ ea eb ca cb : ℚ, ea ≠ eb →
      (ea * cb - eb * ca) / (ea - eb) = (eb * ca - ea * cb) / (eb - ea) := by
    intro ea eb ca cb hne
    rw [div_eq_div_iff (sub_ne_zero.mpr hne) (sub_ne_zero.mpr (Ne.symm hne))]; ring
  
  
  have K01 : 0 < e0 → e1 < 0 → e0 * c1 - e1 * c0 ≤ ub * (e0 - e1) :=
    fun a b => clearK e0 e1 c0 c1 (by linarith) (cut01 (Or.inr ⟨a, b⟩))
  have K10 : 0 < e1 → e0 < 0 → e1 * c0 - e0 * c1 ≤ ub * (e1 - e0) := by
    intro a b
    have := cut01 (Or.inl ⟨b, a⟩)
    rw [flipDiv e0 e1 c0 c1 (by intro h; linarith)] at this
    exact clearK e1 e0 c1 c0 (by linarith) this
  
  have K12 : 0 < e1 → e2 < 0 → e1 * c2 - e2 * c1 ≤ ub * (e1 - e2) :=
    fun a b => clearK e1 e2 c1 c2 (by linarith) (cut12 (Or.inr ⟨a, b⟩))
  have K21 : 0 < e2 → e1 < 0 → e2 * c1 - e1 * c2 ≤ ub * (e2 - e1) := by
    intro a b
    have := cut12 (Or.inl ⟨b, a⟩)
    rw [flipDiv e1 e2 c1 c2 (by intro h; linarith)] at this
    exact clearK e2 e1 c2 c1 (by linarith) this
  
  have K20 : 0 < e2 → e0 < 0 → e2 * c0 - e0 * c2 ≤ ub * (e2 - e0) :=
    fun a b => clearK e2 e0 c2 c0 (by linarith) (cut20 (Or.inr ⟨a, b⟩))
  have K02 : 0 < e0 → e2 < 0 → e0 * c2 - e2 * c0 ≤ ub * (e0 - e2) := by
    intro a b
    have := cut20 (Or.inl ⟨b, a⟩)
    rw [flipDiv e2 e0 c2 c0 (by intro h; linarith)] at this
    exact clearK e0 e2 c0 c2 (by linarith) this
  
  exact orbit_upper e0 e1 e2 c0 c1 c2 μ0 μ1 μ2 ub hm0 hm1 hm2 hsum hfeas v0 v1 v2 K01 K10 K12 K21 K20 K02

name: proj_ge_lb
statement:
theorem proj_ge_lb (m : Fin 3) (vs : Array I3) (signs : Array Int) (nO qO : I3)
    (μ0 μ1 μ2 lb : ℚ)
    (hsm : ∀ k, k < 3 → signs.getD k 0 = Int.sign (dotI nO (subI (vs.getD k default) qO)))
    (hm0 : 0 ≤ μ0) (hm1 : 0 ≤ μ1) (hm2 : 0 ≤ μ2) (hsum : μ0 + μ1 + μ2 = 1)
    (hfeas : μ0 * Eval nO qO vs 0 + μ1 * Eval nO qO vs 1 + μ2 * Eval nO qO vs 2 = 0)
    (hlb : ∀ p ∈ collectParams (m : ℕ) vs signs nO qO, lb ≤ fracVal p) :
    lb ≤ μ0 * Cval m vs 0 + μ1 * Cval m vs 1 + μ2 * Cval m vs 2
proof:
:= by
  set e0 := Eval nO qO vs 0 with he0
  set e1 := Eval nO qO vs 1 with he1
  set e2 := Eval nO qO vs 2 with he2
  set c0 := Cval m vs 0 with hc0
  set c1 := Cval m vs 1 with hc1
  set c2 := Cval m vs 2 with hc2
  have hvtx : ∀ j : Nat, j < 3 → Eval nO qO vs j = 0 → lb ≤ Cval m vs j := by
    intro j hj hz
    have hmem := mem_vertex_of_eval_zero m vs signs nO qO j hj (hsm j hj) hz
    have := hlb _ hmem
    rwa [vertexHit_fracVal (m : ℕ) m.2, ← Cval] at this
  have v0 : e0 = 0 → lb ≤ c0 := fun h => by rw [hc0]; exact hvtx 0 (by norm_num) (by rw [← he0]; exact h)
  have v1 : e1 = 0 → lb ≤ c1 := fun h => by rw [hc1]; exact hvtx 1 (by norm_num) (by rw [← he1]; exact h)
  have v2 : e2 = 0 → lb ≤ c2 := fun h => by rw [hc2]; exact hvtx 2 (by norm_num) (by rw [← he2]; exact h)
  have hcut : ∀ k : Nat, k < 3 →
      ((Eval nO qO vs k < 0 ∧ 0 < Eval nO qO vs ((k+1)%3)) ∨
       (0 < Eval nO qO vs k ∧ Eval nO qO vs ((k+1)%3) < 0)) →
      lb ≤ (Eval nO qO vs k * Cval m vs ((k+1)%3) - Eval nO qO vs ((k+1)%3) * Cval m vs k)
          / (Eval nO qO vs k - Eval nO qO vs ((k+1)%3)) := by
    intro k hk hopp
    have hk1 : (k+1)%3 < 3 := Nat.mod_lt _ (by norm_num)
    have hmem := mem_edge_of_eval_opp m vs signs nO qO k hk (hsm k hk) (hsm ((k+1)%3) hk1) hopp
    have hbnd := hlb _ hmem
    have hden : Eval nO qO vs k - Eval nO qO vs ((k+1)%3) ≠ 0 := by
      rcases hopp with ⟨h1, h2⟩ | ⟨h1, h2⟩ <;> (intro hc; linarith)
    rwa [edge_cut_fracVal m vs nO qO k hden] at hbnd
  have cut01 : (e0 < 0 ∧ 0 < e1) ∨ (0 < e0 ∧ e1 < 0) → lb ≤ (e0 * c1 - e1 * c0) / (e0 - e1) := by
    intro hopp
    have h := hcut 0 (by norm_num) (by simpa only [show ((0:ℕ)+1)%3 = 1 from rfl, ← he0, ← he1] using hopp)
    simpa only [show ((0:ℕ)+1)%3 = 1 from rfl, ← he0, ← he1, ← hc0, ← hc1] using h
  have cut12 : (e1 < 0 ∧ 0 < e2) ∨ (0 < e1 ∧ e2 < 0) → lb ≤ (e1 * c2 - e2 * c1) / (e1 - e2) := by
    intro hopp
    have h := hcut 1 (by norm_num) (by simpa only [show ((1:ℕ)+1)%3 = 2 from rfl, ← he1, ← he2] using hopp)
    simpa only [show ((1:ℕ)+1)%3 = 2 from rfl, ← he1, ← he2, ← hc1, ← hc2] using h
  have cut20 : (e2 < 0 ∧ 0 < e0) ∨ (0 < e2 ∧ e0 < 0) → lb ≤ (e2 * c0 - e0 * c2) / (e2 - e0) := by
    intro hopp
    have h := hcut 2 (by norm_num) (by simpa only [show ((2:ℕ)+1)%3 = 0 from rfl, ← he2, ← he0] using hopp)
    simpa only [show ((2:ℕ)+1)%3 = 0 from rfl, ← he2, ← he0, ← hc2, ← hc0] using h
  
  have flipD : ∀ ea eb ca cb : ℚ, ea ≠ eb →
      (ea * cb - eb * ca) / (ea - eb) = (eb * ca - ea * cb) / (eb - ea) := by
    intro ea eb ca cb hne
    rw [div_eq_div_iff (sub_ne_zero.mpr hne) (sub_ne_zero.mpr (Ne.symm hne))]; ring
  have L01 : 0 < e0 → e1 < 0 → e0 * (-c1) - e1 * (-c0) ≤ (-lb) * (e0 - e1) := by
    intro a b; have h := cut01 (Or.inr ⟨a, b⟩); rw [le_div_iff₀ (by linarith)] at h; linarith [h]
  have L10 : 0 < e1 → e0 < 0 → e1 * (-c0) - e0 * (-c1) ≤ (-lb) * (e1 - e0) := by
    intro a b; have h := cut01 (Or.inl ⟨b, a⟩)
    rw [flipD e0 e1 c0 c1 (by intro hh; linarith), le_div_iff₀ (by linarith)] at h; linarith [h]
  have L12 : 0 < e1 → e2 < 0 → e1 * (-c2) - e2 * (-c1) ≤ (-lb) * (e1 - e2) := by
    intro a b; have h := cut12 (Or.inr ⟨a, b⟩); rw [le_div_iff₀ (by linarith)] at h; linarith [h]
  have L21 : 0 < e2 → e1 < 0 → e2 * (-c1) - e1 * (-c2) ≤ (-lb) * (e2 - e1) := by
    intro a b; have h := cut12 (Or.inl ⟨b, a⟩)
    rw [flipD e1 e2 c1 c2 (by intro hh; linarith), le_div_iff₀ (by linarith)] at h; linarith [h]
  have L20 : 0 < e2 → e0 < 0 → e2 * (-c0) - e0 * (-c2) ≤ (-lb) * (e2 - e0) := by
    intro a b; have h := cut20 (Or.inr ⟨a, b⟩); rw [le_div_iff₀ (by linarith)] at h; linarith [h]
  have L02 : 0 < e0 → e2 < 0 → e0 * (-c2) - e2 * (-c0) ≤ (-lb) * (e0 - e2) := by
    intro a b; have h := cut20 (Or.inl ⟨b, a⟩)
    rw [flipD e2 e0 c2 c0 (by intro hh; linarith), le_div_iff₀ (by linarith)] at h; linarith [h]
  have key := orbit_upper e0 e1 e2 (-c0) (-c1) (-c2) μ0 μ1 μ2 (-lb) hm0 hm1 hm2 hsum
    (by rw [he0, he1, he2]; exact hfeas)
    (fun h => by have := v0 h; linarith) (fun h => by have := v1 h; linarith)
    (fun h => by have := v2 h; linarith) L01 L10 L12 L21 L20 L02
  linarith [key]

name: of_not_false
statement: private theorem of_not_false {b : Bool} (h : ¬ b = false) : b = true
proof:
:= by
  cases b
  · exact absurd rfl h
  · rfl

name: normalStage_iff
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨O, hO⟩ := Proof.MeshIntersectM2Kit.good_origin_of_nonDegenerate hnd
  
  have hequiv : Impl.WellFormedCheck.checkNormalCond M
      = Impl.WellFormedCheck.checkNormalCond (Proof.MeshIntersectM2Kit.trMesh O M) :=
    (Proof.MeshIntersectM2Equiv.checkNormalCond_equivariant O M).symm
  rw [hequiv,
    Proof.WellFormedCheckNormal.checkNormalCond_correct (Proof.MeshIntersectM2Kit.trMesh O M)
      ((Proof.MeshIntersectM2Kit.isCycle_trMesh_iff O M).mpr hcyc) hO
      ((Proof.MeshIntersectM2Kit.noSelfIntersection_trMesh_iff O M).mpr hns)]
  
  exact (Proof.MeshIntersectM2Core.T_normal_offPlanes hcyc hns hO).symm.trans
    (Proof.SurfaceBridge.windingZeroOrOne_iff_offPlanes M).symm

name: eqOffPlanes_symm
statement:
private theorem eqOffPlanes_symm {P R : Set Point} (h : EqOffPlanes P R) :
    EqOffPlanes R P
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨N, hN, hsub⟩ := h
  exact ⟨N, hN, by rw [Set.union_comm]; exact hsub⟩

name: eqOffPlanes_trans
statement:
private theorem eqOffPlanes_trans {P R S : Set Point}
    (h₁ : EqOffPlanes P R) (h₂ : EqOffPlanes R S) : EqOffPlanes P S
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨N₁, hN₁, hsub₁⟩ := h₁
  obtain ⟨N₂, hN₂, hsub₂⟩ := h₂
  refine ⟨N₁ ∪ N₂, Proof.Negligible.negligible_union hN₁ hN₂, ?_⟩
  rintro x (⟨hxP, hxS⟩ | ⟨hxS, hxP⟩) <;> by_cases hR : x ∈ R
  · exact Or.inr (hsub₂ (Or.inl ⟨hR, hxS⟩))
  · exact Or.inl (hsub₁ (Or.inl ⟨hxP, hR⟩))
  · exact Or.inl (hsub₁ (Or.inr ⟨hR, hxP⟩))
  · exact Or.inr (hsub₂ (Or.inr ⟨hxS, hR⟩))

name: eqOffPlanes_inter
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨N₁, hN₁, hsub₁⟩ := h₁
  obtain ⟨N₂, hN₂, hsub₂⟩ := h₂
  refine ⟨N₁ ∪ N₂, Proof.Negligible.negligible_union hN₁ hN₂, ?_⟩
  rintro x (⟨⟨hxP1, hxP2⟩, hxR⟩ | ⟨⟨hxR1, hxR2⟩, hxP⟩)
  · by_cases hR1 : x ∈ R₁
    · by_cases hR2 : x ∈ R₂
      · exact absurd ⟨hR1, hR2⟩ hxR
      · exact Or.inr (hsub₂ (Or.inl ⟨hxP2, hR2⟩))
    · exact Or.inl (hsub₁ (Or.inl ⟨hxP1, hR1⟩))
  · by_cases hP1 : x ∈ P₁
    · by_cases hP2 : x ∈ P₂
      · exact absurd ⟨hP1, hP2⟩ hxP
      · exact Or.inr (hsub₂ (Or.inr ⟨hxR2, hP2⟩))
    · exact Or.inl (hsub₁ (Or.inr ⟨hxR1, hP1⟩))

name: legacyWF_trMesh
proof:
:=
  ⟨(Proof.MeshIntersectM2Kit.isCycle_trMesh_iff O M).mpr hcyc,
    (Proof.MeshIntersectM2Core.T_normal_offPlanes hcyc hnsi hO).mp
      ((Proof.SurfaceBridge.windingZeroOrOne_iff_offPlanes M).mp hnrm),
    (Proof.MeshIntersectM2Kit.noSelfIntersection_trMesh_iff O M).mpr hnsi,
    hO⟩

name: meshIntersect_spec_offPlanes
statement:
theorem meshIntersect_spec_offPlanes (M₁ M₂ : Mesh)
    (h₁ : WellFormedMesh M₁) (h₂ : WellFormedMesh M₂) :
    EqOffPlanes (solid (Impl.MeshIntersect.meshIntersect M₁ M₂))
      (solid M₁ ∩ solid M₂)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨hcyc1, hnrm1, hnsi1, hnd1⟩ := h₁
  obtain ⟨hcyc2, hnrm2, hnsi2, hnd2⟩ := h₂
  
  obtain ⟨O, hO1, hO2, -⟩ :=
    Proof.MeshIntersectM2Kit.good_origin₂ hnd1 hnd2 (ι := Empty) Empty.elim Empty.elim
      (fun e => e.elim)
  
  have hwf1 := legacyWF_trMesh hcyc1 hnrm1 hnsi1 hO1
  have hwf2 := legacyWF_trMesh hcyc2 hnrm2 hnsi2 hO2
  
  have hequiv : Impl.MeshIntersect.meshIntersect
      (Proof.MeshIntersectM2Kit.trMesh O M₁) (Proof.MeshIntersectM2Kit.trMesh O M₂)
      = Proof.MeshIntersectM2Kit.trMesh O (Impl.MeshIntersect.meshIntersect M₁ M₂) :=
    Proof.MeshIntersectM2Equiv.meshIntersect_equivariant O M₁ M₂
  
  have hcorpus := Proof.MeshIntersect.meshIntersect_spec _ _ hwf1 hwf2
  rw [hequiv] at hcorpus
  
  
  have hwfOut := Proof.MeshIntersect.meshIntersect_wellFormed _ _ hwf1 hwf2
  rw [hequiv] at hwfOut
  obtain ⟨hcycOut', -, hnsiOut', hnpoOut'⟩ := hwfOut
  have hcycOut := (Proof.MeshIntersectM2Kit.isCycle_trMesh_iff O _).mp hcycOut'
  have hnsiOut := (Proof.MeshIntersectM2Kit.noSelfIntersection_trMesh_iff O _).mp hnsiOut'
  
  have himg := Proof.MeshIntersectM2Kit.eqOffPlanes_image (-O) hcorpus
  rw [Proof.MeshIntersectM2Kit.trPoint_image_inter] at himg
  
  refine eqOffPlanes_trans (Proof.MeshIntersectM2Core.T_solid hcycOut hnsiOut hnpoOut')
    (eqOffPlanes_trans himg
      (eqOffPlanes_inter
        (eqOffPlanes_symm (Proof.MeshIntersectM2Core.T_solid hcyc1 hnsi1 hO1))
        (eqOffPlanes_symm (Proof.MeshIntersectM2Core.T_solid hcyc2 hnsi2 hO2))))

name: eqOffPlanes_mem_iff
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro hxP
    by_contra hxR
    exact hx (hsub (Or.inl ⟨hxP, hxR⟩))
  · intro hxR
    by_contra hxP
    exact hx (hsub (Or.inr ⟨hxR, hxP⟩))

name: mem_solid_out_iff
statement:
private theorem mem_solid_out_iff {out M₁ M₂ : Mesh} {O : Point}
    (hcycO : IsClosedOrientedSurface out) (hnsO : NoFaceInteriorContact out)
    (hcyc1 : IsClosedOrientedSurface M₁) (hns1 : NoFaceInteriorContact M₁)
    (hcyc2 : IsClosedOrientedSurface M₂) (hns2 : NoFaceInteriorContact M₂)
    (hnpoO : Legacy.NoPlaneThroughOrigin (Proof.MeshIntersectM2Kit.trMesh O out))
    (hnpo1 : Legacy.NoPlaneThroughOrigin (Proof.MeshIntersectM2Kit.trMesh O M₁))
    (hnpo2 : Legacy.NoPlaneThroughOrigin (Proof.MeshIntersectM2Kit.trMesh O M₂))
    (heq : EqOffPlanes (solid out) (solid M₁ ∩ solid M₂))
    (hcont : surface out ⊆ surface M₁ ∪ surface M₂)
    {Q : Point} (hQ : Q ∉ surface M₁ ∪ surface M₂) :
    Q ∈ solid out ↔ Q ∈ solid M₁ ∧ Q ∈ solid M₂
proof:
:= by
  classical
  
  have hQ1 : Q ∉ surface M₁ := fun h => hQ (Or.inl h)
  have hQ2 : Q ∉ surface M₂ := fun h => hQ (Or.inr h)
  have hQout : Q ∉ surface out := fun h => hQ (hcont h)
  
  obtain ⟨d₀, hadmO, hadm1, hadm2⟩ := Proof.SurfaceSolid.exists_admissible₃ out M₁ M₂ Q
  
  obtain ⟨N₀, hN₀neg, hN₀sub⟩ := heq
  
  set Ms : Fin 3 → Mesh := ![out, M₁, M₂] with hMs
  set ds : Fin 3 → Point := fun _ => d₀ with hds
  have hQ' : ∀ i, Q ∉ surface (Ms i) := by
    intro i; fin_cases i <;> simpa [hMs] using ‹_›
  have hadm' : ∀ i, AdmissibleRay (Ms i) Q (ds i) := by
    intro i; fin_cases i <;> simpa [hMs, hds] using ‹_›
  
  
  set Nadm : Set Point :=
    ({P | ¬ AdmissibleRay out P d₀} ∪ {P | ¬ AdmissibleRay M₁ P d₀})
      ∪ {P | ¬ AdmissibleRay M₂ P d₀} with hNadm
  set Ncln : Set Point :=
    ({P | ¬ Proof.WellFormedCheckNormal.G1Clean (Proof.MeshIntersectM2Kit.trMesh O out)
        (Proof.MeshIntersectM2Kit.trPoint O P)}
      ∪ {P | ¬ Proof.WellFormedCheckNormal.G1Clean (Proof.MeshIntersectM2Kit.trMesh O M₁)
        (Proof.MeshIntersectM2Kit.trPoint O P)})
      ∪ {P | ¬ Proof.WellFormedCheckNormal.G1Clean (Proof.MeshIntersectM2Kit.trMesh O M₂)
        (Proof.MeshIntersectM2Kit.trPoint O P)} with hNcln
  have hNadmNeg : Negligible Nadm :=
    Proof.Negligible.negligible_union
      (Proof.Negligible.negligible_union
        (Proof.SurfaceBridge.negligible_not_admissible hadmO.1)
        (Proof.SurfaceBridge.negligible_not_admissible hadm1.1))
      (Proof.SurfaceBridge.negligible_not_admissible hadm2.1)
  have hNclnNeg : Negligible Ncln :=
    Proof.Negligible.negligible_union
      (Proof.Negligible.negligible_union
        (Proof.SurfaceSolid.negligible_unclean_pb hnpoO)
        (Proof.SurfaceSolid.negligible_unclean_pb hnpo1))
      (Proof.SurfaceSolid.negligible_unclean_pb hnpo2)
  have hNneg : Negligible ((N₀ ∪ Nadm) ∪ Ncln) :=
    Proof.Negligible.negligible_union
      (Proof.Negligible.negligible_union hN₀neg hNadmNeg) hNclnNeg
  
  obtain ⟨P, hPcount, hPN⟩ :=
    Proof.SurfaceSolid.exists_multi_count_eq_off_negligible Ms ds Q hQ' hadm' hNneg
  
  simp only [hNadm, hNcln, Set.mem_union, not_or] at hPN
  obtain ⟨⟨hPN₀, ⟨hPadmO, hPadm1⟩, hPadm2⟩, ⟨hPclnO, hPcln1⟩, hPcln2⟩ := hPN
  simp only [Set.mem_setOf_eq, not_not] at hPadmO hPadm1 hPadm2 hPclnO hPcln1 hPcln2
  
  have hcO : crossingCount out P d₀ = crossingCount out Q d₀ := by
    have := hPcount 0; simpa [hMs, hds] using this
  have hc1 : crossingCount M₁ P d₀ = crossingCount M₁ Q d₀ := by
    have := hPcount 1; simpa [hMs, hds] using this
  have hc2 : crossingCount M₂ P d₀ = crossingCount M₂ Q d₀ := by
    have := hPcount 2; simpa [hMs, hds] using this
  
  have hstepO : Q ∈ solid out ↔ P ∈ solid out := by
    rw [Proof.SurfaceSolid.solid_iff_count_of_offSurface hcycO hnsO hnpoO hQout hadmO,
      Proof.SurfaceSolid.solid_iff_windOf hcycO hnsO hnpoO hPclnO,
      ← Proof.SurfaceSolid.crossingCount_eq_windOf hcycO hnsO hnpoO hPclnO hPadmO, hcO]
  have hstep1 : Q ∈ solid M₁ ↔ P ∈ solid M₁ := by
    rw [Proof.SurfaceSolid.solid_iff_count_of_offSurface hcyc1 hns1 hnpo1 hQ1 hadm1,
      Proof.SurfaceSolid.solid_iff_windOf hcyc1 hns1 hnpo1 hPcln1,
      ← Proof.SurfaceSolid.crossingCount_eq_windOf hcyc1 hns1 hnpo1 hPcln1 hPadm1, hc1]
  have hstep2 : Q ∈ solid M₂ ↔ P ∈ solid M₂ := by
    rw [Proof.SurfaceSolid.solid_iff_count_of_offSurface hcyc2 hns2 hnpo2 hQ2 hadm2,
      Proof.SurfaceSolid.solid_iff_windOf hcyc2 hns2 hnpo2 hPcln2,
      ← Proof.SurfaceSolid.crossingCount_eq_windOf hcyc2 hns2 hnpo2 hPcln2 hPadm2, hc2]
  
  have hPagree : P ∈ solid out ↔ P ∈ solid M₁ ∩ solid M₂ :=
    eqOffPlanes_mem_iff hN₀sub hPN₀
  rw [hstepO, hstep1, hstep2, hPagree, Set.mem_inter_iff]

name: meshIntersect_spec_offSurfaces
statement:
theorem meshIntersect_spec_offSurfaces (M₁ M₂ : Mesh)
    (h₁ : WellFormedMesh M₁) (h₂ : WellFormedMesh M₂) :
    solid (Impl.MeshIntersect.meshIntersect M₁ M₂) \ (surface M₁ ∪ surface M₂)
      = (solid M₁ ∩ solid M₂) \ (surface M₁ ∪ surface M₂)
proof:
:= by
  
  obtain ⟨hcyc1, hnrm1, hnsi1, hnd1⟩ := h₁
  obtain ⟨hcyc2, hnrm2, hnsi2, hnd2⟩ := h₂
  
  have heq := meshIntersect_spec_offPlanes M₁ M₂ ⟨hcyc1, hnrm1, hnsi1, hnd1⟩ ⟨hcyc2, hnrm2, hnsi2, hnd2⟩
  have hcont := Proof.SurfaceContain.surface_meshIntersect_subset M₁ M₂
    ⟨hcyc1, hnrm1, hnsi1, hnd1⟩ ⟨hcyc2, hnrm2, hnsi2, hnd2⟩
  
  
  
  
  obtain ⟨O, hO1, hO2, -⟩ :=
    Proof.MeshIntersectM2Kit.good_origin₂ hnd1 hnd2 (ι := Empty) Empty.elim Empty.elim
      (fun e => e.elim)
  have hwf1 := legacyWF_trMesh hcyc1 hnrm1 hnsi1 hO1
  have hwf2 := legacyWF_trMesh hcyc2 hnrm2 hnsi2 hO2
  have hequiv : Impl.MeshIntersect.meshIntersect
      (Proof.MeshIntersectM2Kit.trMesh O M₁) (Proof.MeshIntersectM2Kit.trMesh O M₂)
      = Proof.MeshIntersectM2Kit.trMesh O (Impl.MeshIntersect.meshIntersect M₁ M₂) :=
    Proof.MeshIntersectM2Equiv.meshIntersect_equivariant O M₁ M₂
  have hwfOut := Proof.MeshIntersect.meshIntersect_wellFormed _ _ hwf1 hwf2
  rw [hequiv] at hwfOut
  obtain ⟨hcycOut', -, hnsiOut', hnpoO⟩ := hwfOut
  have hcycO := (Proof.MeshIntersectM2Kit.isCycle_trMesh_iff O _).mp hcycOut'
  have hnsiO := (Proof.MeshIntersectM2Kit.noSelfIntersection_trMesh_iff O _).mp hnsiOut'
  
  set out := Impl.MeshIntersect.meshIntersect M₁ M₂ with hout
  
  ext Q
  simp only [Set.mem_diff]
  by_cases hQ : Q ∈ surface M₁ ∪ surface M₂
  · simp only [hQ, not_true, and_false]
  · simp only [hQ, not_false_iff, and_true]
    exact mem_solid_out_iff hcycO hnsiO hcyc1 hnsi1 hcyc2 hnsi2 hnpoO hO1 hO2 heq hcont hQ

name: meshIntersect_wellFormed
statement:
theorem meshIntersect_wellFormed (M₁ M₂ : Mesh)
    (h₁ : WellFormedMesh M₁) (h₂ : WellFormedMesh M₂) :
    WellFormedMesh (Impl.MeshIntersect.meshIntersect M₁ M₂)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨hcyc1, hnrm1, hnsi1, hnd1⟩ := h₁
  obtain ⟨hcyc2, hnrm2, hnsi2, hnd2⟩ := h₂
  obtain ⟨O, hO1, hO2, -⟩ :=
    Proof.MeshIntersectM2Kit.good_origin₂ hnd1 hnd2 (ι := Empty) Empty.elim Empty.elim
      (fun e => e.elim)
  have hwf1 := legacyWF_trMesh hcyc1 hnrm1 hnsi1 hO1
  have hwf2 := legacyWF_trMesh hcyc2 hnrm2 hnsi2 hO2
  have hequiv : Impl.MeshIntersect.meshIntersect
      (Proof.MeshIntersectM2Kit.trMesh O M₁) (Proof.MeshIntersectM2Kit.trMesh O M₂)
      = Proof.MeshIntersectM2Kit.trMesh O (Impl.MeshIntersect.meshIntersect M₁ M₂) :=
    Proof.MeshIntersectM2Equiv.meshIntersect_equivariant O M₁ M₂
  have hwfOut := Proof.MeshIntersect.meshIntersect_wellFormed _ _ hwf1 hwf2
  rw [hequiv] at hwfOut
  obtain ⟨hcycOut', hnrmOut', hnsiOut', hnpoOut'⟩ := hwfOut
  have hcycOut := (Proof.MeshIntersectM2Kit.isCycle_trMesh_iff O _).mp hcycOut'
  have hnsiOut := (Proof.MeshIntersectM2Kit.noSelfIntersection_trMesh_iff O _).mp hnsiOut'
  refine ⟨hcycOut, ?_, hnsiOut, ?_⟩
  · 
    exact (Proof.SurfaceBridge.windingZeroOrOne_iff_offPlanes _).mpr
      ((Proof.MeshIntersectM2Core.T_normal_offPlanes hcycOut hnsiOut hnpoOut').mpr hnrmOut')
  · 
    intro i hdeg
    exact Proof.MeshIntersectM2Kit.not_noPlaneThroughOrigin_of_degenerate i hdeg O hnpoOut'

name: meshIntersect_spec
statement:
theorem meshIntersect_spec (M₁ M₂ : Mesh)
    (h₁ : WellFormedMesh M₁) (h₂ : WellFormedMesh M₂) :
    solid (Impl.MeshIntersect.meshIntersect M₁ M₂) = solid M₁ ∩ solid M₂
proof:
:=
  
  
  
  
  Proof.SurfaceExact.mem_solid_out_iff_exact
    (meshIntersect_wellFormed M₁ M₂ h₁ h₂) h₁ h₂
    (meshIntersect_spec_offSurfaces M₁ M₂ h₁ h₂)

name: checkWellFormed_spec
statement:
theorem checkWellFormed_spec (M : Mesh) :
    Impl.WellFormedCheck.checkWellFormed M = true ↔ WellFormedMesh M
proof:
:= by
  unfold Impl.WellFormedCheck.checkWellFormed WellFormedMesh
  simp only [Bool.and_eq_true]
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨⟨⟨hcyc, hnd⟩, hnsi⟩, hnrm⟩
    have hcyc' := (Proof.WellFormedCheckCycle.checkIsCycle_spec M).mp hcyc
    have hnd' := (Proof.WellFormedCheck.checkNonDegenerate_spec M).mp hnd
    have hnsi' := (Proof.WellFormedCheckNSI.L_nsi M hcyc' hnd').mp hnsi
    have hnrm' := (normalStage_iff M hcyc' hnd' hnsi').mp hnrm
    exact ⟨hcyc', hnrm', hnsi', hnd'⟩
  · rintro ⟨hcyc', hnrm', hnsi', hnd'⟩
    refine ⟨⟨⟨?_, ?_⟩, ?_⟩, ?_⟩
    · exact (Proof.WellFormedCheckCycle.checkIsCycle_spec M).mpr hcyc'
    · exact (Proof.WellFormedCheck.checkNonDegenerate_spec M).mpr hnd'
    · exact (Proof.WellFormedCheckNSI.L_nsi M hcyc' hnd').mpr hnsi'
    · exact (normalStage_iff M hcyc' hnd' hnsi').mpr hnrm'

name: checkMeshWF_none_iff
proof:
:= by
  simp only [Impl.WellFormedCheck.checkMeshWF, Impl.WellFormedCheck.checkWellFormed,
    Bool.and_eq_true]
  cases Impl.WellFormedCheck.checkIsCycle M <;>
    cases Impl.WellFormedCheck.checkNonDegenerate M <;>
      cases Impl.WellFormedCheck.checkNoSelfIntersection M <;>
        cases Impl.WellFormedCheck.checkNormalCond M <;> simp

name: checkMeshWF_none_iff_wf
statement:
theorem checkMeshWF_none_iff_wf (mc mo ms mn : String) (M : Mesh) :
    Impl.WellFormedCheck.checkMeshWF mc mo ms mn M = none ↔ WellFormedMesh M
proof:
:=
  (checkMeshWF_none_iff mc mo ms mn M).trans (checkWellFormed_spec M)

name: checkMeshWF_some_sound
statement:
theorem checkMeshWF_some_sound (mc mo ms mn : String) (M : Mesh) (e : String)
    (h : Impl.WellFormedCheck.checkMeshWF mc mo ms mn M = some e) :
    (e = mc ∧ ¬ IsClosedOrientedSurface M) ∨ (e = mo ∧ ¬ NoDegenerateFaces M) ∨
    (e = ms ∧ ¬ NoFaceInteriorContact M) ∨ (e = mn ∧ ¬ WindingZeroOrOne M)
proof:
:= by
  unfold Impl.WellFormedCheck.checkMeshWF at h
  by_cases hc : Impl.WellFormedCheck.checkIsCycle M = false
  · rw [if_pos hc, Option.some.injEq] at h
    exact Or.inl ⟨h.symm, fun hp =>
      absurd ((Proof.WellFormedCheckCycle.checkIsCycle_spec M).mpr hp) (by rw [hc]; decide)⟩
  · rw [if_neg hc] at h
    have hcyc : IsClosedOrientedSurface M :=
      (Proof.WellFormedCheckCycle.checkIsCycle_spec M).mp (of_not_false hc)
    by_cases hno : Impl.WellFormedCheck.checkNonDegenerate M = false
    · rw [if_pos hno, Option.some.injEq] at h
      exact Or.inr (Or.inl ⟨h.symm, fun hp =>
        absurd ((Proof.WellFormedCheck.checkNonDegenerate_spec M).mpr hp) (by rw [hno]; decide)⟩)
    · rw [if_neg hno] at h
      have hnd : NoDegenerateFaces M :=
        (Proof.WellFormedCheck.checkNonDegenerate_spec M).mp (of_not_false hno)
      by_cases hns : Impl.WellFormedCheck.checkNoSelfIntersection M = false
      · rw [if_pos hns, Option.some.injEq] at h
        exact Or.inr (Or.inr (Or.inl ⟨h.symm, fun hp =>
          absurd ((Proof.WellFormedCheckNSI.L_nsi M hcyc hnd).mpr hp)
            (by rw [hns]; decide)⟩))
      · rw [if_neg hns] at h
        have hnsi : NoFaceInteriorContact M :=
          (Proof.WellFormedCheckNSI.L_nsi M hcyc hnd).mp (of_not_false hns)
        by_cases hnr : Impl.WellFormedCheck.checkNormalCond M = false
        · rw [if_pos hnr, Option.some.injEq] at h
          exact Or.inr (Or.inr (Or.inr ⟨h.symm, fun hp =>
            absurd ((normalStage_iff M hcyc hnd hnsi).mpr hp)
              (by rw [hnr]; decide)⟩))
        · rw [if_neg hnr] at h
          simp at h

name: run_eq_ok_iff
statement:
private theorem run_eq_ok_iff
    (mCycle mOrigin mSelf mNormal : String)
    (M₁ M₂ M : Mesh) :
    Impl.MeshIntersectWithPreconditionCheck.run mCycle mOrigin mSelf mNormal M₁ M₂
        = Except.ok M ↔
      WellFormedMesh M₁ ∧ WellFormedMesh M₂ ∧
        M = Impl.MeshIntersect.meshIntersect M₁ M₂
proof:
:= by
  unfold Impl.MeshIntersectWithPreconditionCheck.run
  
  
  
  simp only [Proof.WellFormedCheckPre.checkMeshWFPre_eq,
    show Impl.MeshIntersect.meshIntersectPre (Impl.MeshIntersect.prepOf M₁)
        (Impl.MeshIntersect.prepOf M₂) = Impl.MeshIntersect.meshIntersect M₁ M₂ from rfl]
  cases hw1 : Impl.WellFormedCheck.checkMeshWF mCycle mOrigin mSelf mNormal M₁ with
  | some e =>
    constructor
    · intro hh; simp at hh
    · rintro ⟨hwf1, -, -⟩
      exact absurd ((checkMeshWF_none_iff_wf mCycle mOrigin mSelf mNormal M₁).mpr hwf1)
        (by rw [hw1]; simp)
  | none =>
    cases hw2 : Impl.WellFormedCheck.checkMeshWF mCycle mOrigin mSelf mNormal M₂ with
    | some e =>
      constructor
      · intro hh; simp at hh
      · rintro ⟨-, hwf2, -⟩
        exact absurd ((checkMeshWF_none_iff_wf mCycle mOrigin mSelf mNormal M₂).mpr hwf2)
          (by rw [hw2]; simp)
    | none =>
      have hwf1 : WellFormedMesh M₁ :=
        (checkMeshWF_none_iff_wf mCycle mOrigin mSelf mNormal M₁).mp hw1
      have hwf2 : WellFormedMesh M₂ :=
        (checkMeshWF_none_iff_wf mCycle mOrigin mSelf mNormal M₂).mp hw2
      constructor
      · intro hh
        rw [Except.ok.injEq] at hh
        exact ⟨hwf1, hwf2, hh.symm⟩
      · rintro ⟨-, -, hM⟩
        rw [hM]

name: run_ok_spec
statement:
theorem run_ok_spec
    (mCycle mOrigin mSelf mNormal : String)
    (M₁ M₂ M : Mesh)
    (h : Impl.MeshIntersectWithPreconditionCheck.run mCycle mOrigin mSelf mNormal M₁ M₂
      = Except.ok M) :
    solid M = solid M₁ ∩ solid M₂ ∧ WellFormedMesh M
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨hwf1, hwf2, hM⟩ := (run_eq_ok_iff mCycle mOrigin mSelf mNormal M₁ M₂ M).mp h
  rw [hM]
  exact ⟨meshIntersect_spec M₁ M₂ hwf1 hwf2, meshIntersect_wellFormed M₁ M₂ hwf1 hwf2⟩

name: run_ok_of_wellFormed
statement:
theorem run_ok_of_wellFormed
    (mCycle mOrigin mSelf mNormal : String)
    (M₁ M₂ : Mesh)
    (h₁ : WellFormedMesh M₁) (h₂ : WellFormedMesh M₂) :
    Impl.MeshIntersectWithPreconditionCheck.run mCycle mOrigin mSelf mNormal M₁ M₂
      = Except.ok (Impl.MeshIntersect.meshIntersect M₁ M₂)
proof:
:=
  (run_eq_ok_iff mCycle mOrigin mSelf mNormal M₁ M₂
    (Impl.MeshIntersect.meshIntersect M₁ M₂)).mpr ⟨h₁, h₂, rfl⟩

name: run_error_sound
statement:
theorem run_error_sound
    (mCycle mOrigin mSelf mNormal : String)
    (M₁ M₂ : Mesh) (msg : String)
    (h : Impl.MeshIntersectWithPreconditionCheck.run mCycle mOrigin mSelf mNormal M₁ M₂
      = Except.error msg) :
    (msg = mCycle ∧ (¬ IsClosedOrientedSurface M₁ ∨ ¬ IsClosedOrientedSurface M₂)) ∨
    (msg = mOrigin ∧ (¬ NoDegenerateFaces M₁ ∨ ¬ NoDegenerateFaces M₂)) ∨
    (msg = mSelf ∧ (¬ NoFaceInteriorContact M₁ ∨ ¬ NoFaceInteriorContact M₂)) ∨
    (msg = mNormal ∧ (¬ WindingZeroOrOne M₁ ∨ ¬ WindingZeroOrOne M₂))
proof:
:= by
  unfold Impl.MeshIntersectWithPreconditionCheck.run at h
  
  simp only [Proof.WellFormedCheckPre.checkMeshWFPre_eq] at h
  cases hw1 : Impl.WellFormedCheck.checkMeshWF mCycle mOrigin mSelf mNormal M₁ with
  | some e =>
    simp only [hw1, Except.error.injEq] at h
    rcases checkMeshWF_some_sound mCycle mOrigin mSelf mNormal M₁ e hw1 with
        ⟨he, hp⟩ | ⟨he, hp⟩ | ⟨he, hp⟩ | ⟨he, hp⟩
    · rw [h] at he; exact Or.inl ⟨he, Or.inl hp⟩
    · rw [h] at he; exact Or.inr (Or.inl ⟨he, Or.inl hp⟩)
    · rw [h] at he; exact Or.inr (Or.inr (Or.inl ⟨he, Or.inl hp⟩))
    · rw [h] at he; exact Or.inr (Or.inr (Or.inr ⟨he, Or.inl hp⟩))
  | none =>
    simp only [hw1] at h
    cases hw2 : Impl.WellFormedCheck.checkMeshWF mCycle mOrigin mSelf mNormal M₂ with
    | some e =>
      simp only [hw2, Except.error.injEq] at h
      rcases checkMeshWF_some_sound mCycle mOrigin mSelf mNormal M₂ e hw2 with
          ⟨he, hp⟩ | ⟨he, hp⟩ | ⟨he, hp⟩ | ⟨he, hp⟩
      · rw [h] at he; exact Or.inl ⟨he, Or.inr hp⟩
      · rw [h] at he; exact Or.inr (Or.inl ⟨he, Or.inr hp⟩)
      · rw [h] at he; exact Or.inr (Or.inr (Or.inl ⟨he, Or.inr hp⟩))
      · rw [h] at he; exact Or.inr (Or.inr (Or.inr ⟨he, Or.inr hp⟩))
    | none =>
      simp [hw2] at h

name: run_error_of_not_wellFormed
statement:
theorem run_error_of_not_wellFormed
    (mCycle mOrigin mSelf mNormal : String)
    (M₁ M₂ : Mesh)
    (h : ¬ WellFormedMesh M₁ ∨ ¬ WellFormedMesh M₂) :
    ∃ msg, Impl.MeshIntersectWithPreconditionCheck.run mCycle mOrigin mSelf mNormal M₁ M₂
      = Except.error msg
proof:
:= by
  generalize hR : Impl.MeshIntersectWithPreconditionCheck.run mCycle mOrigin mSelf mNormal M₁ M₂ = r
  cases r with
  | error msg => exact ⟨msg, rfl⟩
  | ok M =>
    obtain ⟨hwf1, hwf2, -⟩ :=
      (run_eq_ok_iff mCycle mOrigin mSelf mNormal M₁ M₂ M).mp hR
    rcases h with h | h
    · exact absurd hwf1 h
    · exact absurd hwf2 h

name: negligible_mono
statement:
theorem negligible_mono {N M : Set Point} (h : N ⊆ M) (hM : Negligible M) :
    Negligible N
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨k, H, hplane, hsub⟩ := hM
  exact ⟨k, H, hplane, h.trans hsub⟩

name: negligible_union
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨k₁, H₁, hplane₁, hsub₁⟩ := h₁
  obtain ⟨k₂, H₂, hplane₂, hsub₂⟩ := h₂
  refine ⟨k₁ + k₂, fun i => Sum.elim H₁ H₂ (finSumFinEquiv.symm i), ?_, ?_⟩
  · intro i
    rcases hj : finSumFinEquiv.symm i with j | j
    · simpa [hj] using hplane₁ j
    · simpa [hj] using hplane₂ j
  · 
    intro x hx
    rcases hx with hx | hx
    · obtain ⟨j, hxS⟩ := Set.mem_iUnion.mp (hsub₁ hx)
      refine Set.mem_iUnion.mpr ⟨finSumFinEquiv (Sum.inl j), ?_⟩
      simpa using hxS
    · obtain ⟨j, hxS⟩ := Set.mem_iUnion.mp (hsub₂ hx)
      refine Set.mem_iUnion.mpr ⟨finSumFinEquiv (Sum.inr j), ?_⟩
      simpa using hxS

name: negligible_empty
statement: theorem negligible_empty : Negligible (∅ : Set Point)
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨1, fun _ => {x | (∑ i, (1 : Point) i * x i) = 0}, ?_, by simp⟩
  intro _
  refine ⟨(1 : Point), 0, ?_, rfl⟩
  intro hcon
  have := congrFun hcon 0
  simp at this

name: negligible_iUnion_fintype
proof:
:= by
  classical
  
  
  have key : ∀ (s : Finset ι), Negligible (⋃ i ∈ s, N i) := by
    intro s
    refine Finset.induction_on s ?_ ?_
    · simpa using negligible_empty
    · intro a s _ ih
      have hrw : (⋃ i ∈ insert a s, N i) = N a ∪ ⋃ i ∈ s, N i := by
        ext x; simp [Finset.mem_insert, or_and_right, exists_or]
      rw [hrw]
      exact negligible_union (h a) ih
  have heq : (⋃ i, N i) = ⋃ i ∈ (Finset.univ : Finset ι), N i := by
    ext x; simp
  rw [heq]
  exact key Finset.univ

name: sc_eq0
statement: theorem sc_eq0 (hc : 0 < c) {a a' : ℤ} (h : (a' : ℚ) = c * a) : a' = 0 ↔ a = 0
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro ha'
    have : c * (a : ℚ) = 0 := by rw [← h]; exact_mod_cast ha'
    rcases mul_eq_zero.1 this with h1 | h1
    · exact absurd h1 (ne_of_gt hc)
    · exact_mod_cast h1
  · intro ha; subst ha; simp at h; exact_mod_cast h

name: sc_lt0
statement: theorem sc_lt0 (hc : 0 < c) {a a' : ℤ} (h : (a' : ℚ) = c * a) : a' < 0 ↔ a < 0
proof:
:= by
  have key : (a':ℚ) < 0 ↔ (a:ℚ) < 0 := by
    rw [h]; constructor
    · intro hx; by_contra hcon; push_neg at hcon
      exact absurd hx (not_lt.2 (mul_nonneg hc.le hcon))
    · intro hx; exact mul_neg_of_pos_of_neg hc hx
  exact_mod_cast key

name: sc_0lt
statement: theorem sc_0lt (hc : 0 < c) {a a' : ℤ} (h : (a' : ℚ) = c * a) : 0 < a' ↔ 0 < a
proof:
:= by
  have key : (0:ℚ) < (a':ℚ) ↔ (0:ℚ) < (a:ℚ) := by
    rw [h]; constructor
    · intro hx; by_contra hcon; push_neg at hcon
      have : c * (a:ℚ) ≤ c * 0 := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hcon hc.le
      simp only [mul_zero] at this; exact absurd hx (not_lt.2 this)
    · intro hx; exact mul_pos hc hx
  exact_mod_cast key

name: sc_sign
statement: theorem sc_sign (hc : 0 < c) {a a' : ℤ} (h : (a' : ℚ) = c * a) : Int.sign a' = Int.sign a
proof:
:= by
  rcases lt_trichotomy a 0 with ha | ha | ha
  · have : a' < 0 := (sc_lt0 hc h).2 ha
    rw [Int.sign_eq_neg_one_of_neg this, Int.sign_eq_neg_one_of_neg ha]
  · subst ha; have : a' = 0 := (sc_eq0 hc h).2 rfl; rw [this]
  · have : 0 < a' := (sc_0lt hc h).2 ha
    rw [Int.sign_eq_one_of_pos this, Int.sign_eq_one_of_pos ha]

name: list_filterMap_forall
statement:
theorem list_filterMap_forall₂ {α β : Type*} {R : β → β → Prop} {f f' : α → Option β}
    (l : List α) (h : ∀ k ∈ l, (f k = none ∧ f' k = none) ∨
        (∃ x x', f k = some x ∧ f' k = some x' ∧ R x x')) :
    List.Forall₂ R (l.filterMap f) (l.filterMap f')
proof:
:= by
  induction l with
  | nil => simp
  | cons a as ih =>
    have hhead := h a (List.mem_cons_self a as)
    have htail := ih (fun k hk => h k (List.mem_cons_of_mem a hk))
    rcases hhead with ⟨hn, hn'⟩ | ⟨x, x', hs, hs', hR⟩
    · rw [List.filterMap_cons_none hn, List.filterMap_cons_none hn']; exact htail
    · rw [List.filterMap_cons_some hs, List.filterMap_cons_some hs']
      exact List.Forall₂.cons hR htail

name: arr_filterMap_toList
statement:
theorem arr_filterMap_toList {α β} (f : α → Option β) (as : Array α) :
    (as.filterMap f).toList = as.toList.filterMap f
proof: := by simp

name: all_congr'
statement:
theorem all_congr' {α} (as : Array α) {P Q : α → Bool} (h : ∀ x ∈ as, P x = Q x) :
    as.all P = as.all Q
proof:
:= by
  rw [Bool.eq_iff_iff, Array.all_eq_true, Array.all_eq_true]
  constructor
  · intro hh i; rw [← h as[i] (Array.getElem_mem i.isLt)]; exact hh i
  · intro hh i; rw [h as[i] (Array.getElem_mem i.isLt)]; exact hh i

name: isMulOf_edgePlane
statement:
theorem isMulOf_edgePlane (nPi a b : P3) :
    IsMulOf (edgePlane nPi a b) (P3.toPoint (edgeNormal nPi a b))
      (edgeOffset nPi a b)
proof:
:= by
  unfold edgePlane edgeNormal edgeOffset
  exact isMulOf_clearPlane _ _

name: ce_edgePlane_eq_neg_areaForm
statement:
theorem ce_edgePlane_eq_neg_areaForm (nPi a b : P3) (x : Point) :
    ce (P3.toPoint (edgeNormal nPi a b)) (edgeOffset nPi a b) x
      = - areaForm (P3.toPoint nPi) (P3.toPoint a) (P3.toPoint b) x
proof:
:= by
  unfold ce edgeOffset
  rw [dotS_toPoint]
  simp only [edgeNormal, smulS, crossS, psubS, P3.toPoint, dotS, areaForm, dotQ,
    crossQ, mkPoint_zero, mkPoint_one, mkPoint_two, Pi.sub_apply]
  ring

name: firstStrict_foldl_some
statement:
theorem firstStrict_foldl_some (l : List Int) (s : Int) :
    l.foldl (fun acc t => match acc with
      | some _ => acc
      | none => if t != 0 then some t else none) (some s) = some s
proof:
:= by
  induction l with
  | nil => rfl
  | cons a l ih => simpa using ih

name: firstStrict_nonpos
statement:
theorem firstStrict_nonpos (l : List Int) (h : ∀ s ∈ l, s ≤ 0) :
    firstStrict l = none ∨ ∃ s, firstStrict l = some s ∧ s < 0
proof:
:= by
  unfold firstStrict
  induction l with
  | nil => exact Or.inl rfl
  | cons a l ih =>
    simp only [List.foldl_cons]
    by_cases ha : a != 0
    · have ha0 : a ≠ 0 := by simpa using ha
      have hapos : a ≤ 0 := h a (by simp)
      have haneg : a < 0 := lt_of_le_of_ne hapos ha0
      rw [if_pos ha, firstStrict_foldl_some]
      exact Or.inr ⟨a, rfl, haneg⟩
    · rw [if_neg ha]
      exact ih (fun s hs => h s (by simp [hs]))

name: firstStrict_pos
statement:
theorem firstStrict_pos (l : List Int) (h : ∀ s ∈ l, 0 ≤ s)
    (hex : ∃ s ∈ l, 0 < s) :
    ∃ s, firstStrict l = some s ∧ 0 < s
proof:
:= by
  unfold firstStrict
  induction l with
  | nil => obtain ⟨s, hs, _⟩ := hex; simp at hs
  | cons a l ih =>
    simp only [List.foldl_cons]
    by_cases ha : a != 0
    · have ha0 : a ≠ 0 := by simpa using ha
      have hann : 0 ≤ a := h a (by simp)
      have hapos : 0 < a := lt_of_le_of_ne hann (Ne.symm ha0)
      rw [if_pos ha, firstStrict_foldl_some]
      exact ⟨a, rfl, hapos⟩
    · have ha0 : a = 0 := by simpa using ha
      rw [if_neg ha]
      apply ih (fun s hs => h s (by simp [hs]))
      obtain ⟨s, hs, hspos⟩ := hex
      rcases List.mem_cons.mp hs with rfl | hsl
      · exact absurd ha0 (by omega)
      · exact ⟨s, hsl, hspos⟩

name: sideOf_eq
statement:
theorem sideOf_eq (g : IPlane) (f : Frag) :
    sideOf g f =
      (match firstStrict (f.poly.toList.map (fun v => signI g v.h)) with
        | some s => decide (s < 0)
        | none => true)
proof:
:= by
  conv_lhs => simp only [sideOf, ← Array.foldl_toList, Array.toList_map]
  rfl

name: edgePlane_interior_nonpos
statement:
theorem edgePlane_interior_nonpos (nPi a b : P3) (x : Point) :
    ce (P3.toPoint (edgeNormal nPi a b)) (edgeOffset nPi a b) x ≤ 0
      ↔ 0 ≤ areaForm (P3.toPoint nPi) (P3.toPoint a) (P3.toPoint b) x
proof:
:= by
  rw [ce_edgePlane_eq_neg_areaForm]
  constructor <;> intro h <;> linarith

name: mem_signs_iff
statement:
theorem mem_signs_iff (g : IPlane) (f : Frag) (s : Int) :
    s ∈ f.poly.toList.map (fun v => signI g v.h)
      ↔ ∃ v ∈ f.poly.toList, signI g v.h = s
proof:
:= by
  rw [List.mem_map]

name: sideOf_iff_interior
statement:
theorem sideOf_iff_interior {g : IPlane} {N : Point} {d : ℚ} {f : Frag}
    (hg : IsMulOf g N d)
    (hrep : ∀ v ∈ f.poly.toList, repr4 v.h (P3.toPoint v.p))
    (hone : (∀ v ∈ f.poly.toList, 0 ≤ ce N d (P3.toPoint v.p))
      ∨ (∀ v ∈ f.poly.toList, ce N d (P3.toPoint v.p) ≤ 0)) :
    sideOf g f = true ↔ ∀ v ∈ f.poly.toList, ce N d (P3.toPoint v.p) ≤ 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [sideOf_eq]
  set L := f.poly.toList.map (fun v => signI g v.h) with hL
  
  have hsign : ∀ v ∈ f.poly.toList,
      (signI g v.h ≤ 0 ↔ ce N d (P3.toPoint v.p) ≤ 0) ∧
      (0 ≤ signI g v.h ↔ 0 ≤ ce N d (P3.toPoint v.p)) ∧
      (0 < signI g v.h ↔ 0 < ce N d (P3.toPoint v.p)) := by
    intro v hv
    obtain ⟨hp, hn, hnn, hz⟩ := signI_iff_of_mul hg (hrep v hv)
    refine ⟨?_, hnn, hp⟩
    constructor
    · intro h
      rcases lt_or_eq_of_le h with h' | h'
      · exact (hn.mp h').le
      · exact le_of_eq (hz.mp h')
    · intro h
      rcases lt_or_eq_of_le h with h' | h'
      · exact (hn.mpr h').le
      · exact le_of_eq (hz.mpr h')
  constructor
  · 
    intro hside v hv
    rcases hone with hpos | hneg
    · 
      
      by_contra hcon
      push_neg at hcon
      
      have hvpos : 0 < ce N d (P3.toPoint v.p) := hcon
      have hexpos : ∃ s ∈ L, 0 < s := by
        refine ⟨signI g v.h, ?_, ?_⟩
        · rw [hL, mem_signs_iff]; exact ⟨v, hv, rfl⟩
        · exact ((hsign v hv).2.2).mpr hvpos
      have hallnn : ∀ s ∈ L, 0 ≤ s := by
        intro s hs
        rw [hL, mem_signs_iff] at hs
        obtain ⟨w, hw, rfl⟩ := hs
        exact ((hsign w hw).2.1).mpr (hpos w hw)
      obtain ⟨s, hfs, hspos⟩ := firstStrict_pos L hallnn hexpos
      rw [hfs] at hside
      simp only [decide_eq_true_eq] at hside
      omega
    · exact hneg v hv
  · 
    intro hint
    have hallnp : ∀ s ∈ L, s ≤ 0 := by
      intro s hs
      rw [hL, mem_signs_iff] at hs
      obtain ⟨w, hw, rfl⟩ := hs
      exact ((hsign w hw).1).mpr (hint w hw)
    rcases firstStrict_nonpos L hallnp with hnone | ⟨s, hfs, hsneg⟩
    · rw [hnone]
    · rw [hfs]; simp [hsneg]

name: clipBySide_mem_aux
statement:
theorem clipBySide_mem_aux (g : IPlane) (l : List Frag) :
    ∀ (acc : Array Frag × Array Frag),
    (∀ p, p ∈ (l.foldl (sideSplit g) acc).1
        ↔ p ∈ acc.1 ∨ (p ∈ l ∧ sideOf g p = true)) ∧
    (∀ p, p ∈ (l.foldl (sideSplit g) acc).2
        ↔ p ∈ acc.2 ∨ (p ∈ l ∧ sideOf g p = false))
proof:
:= by
  induction l with
  | nil => intro acc; simp
  | cons a l ih =>
    intro acc
    simp only [List.foldl_cons]
    cases hsa : sideOf g a with
    | true =>
      have hstep : sideSplit g acc a = (acc.1.push a, acc.2) := by
        simp [sideSplit, hsa]
      rw [hstep]
      obtain ⟨ih1, ih2⟩ := ih (acc.1.push a, acc.2)
      refine ⟨fun p => ?_, fun p => ?_⟩
      · rw [ih1]; simp only [Array.mem_push, List.mem_cons]
        constructor
        · rintro ((h | rfl) | ⟨hl, hs⟩)
          · exact Or.inl h
          · exact Or.inr ⟨Or.inl rfl, hsa⟩
          · exact Or.inr ⟨Or.inr hl, hs⟩
        · rintro (h | ⟨(rfl | hl), hs⟩)
          · exact Or.inl (Or.inl h)
          · exact Or.inl (Or.inr rfl)
          · exact Or.inr ⟨hl, hs⟩
      · rw [ih2]; simp only [List.mem_cons]
        constructor
        · rintro (h | ⟨hl, hs⟩)
          · exact Or.inl h
          · exact Or.inr ⟨Or.inr hl, hs⟩
        · rintro (h | ⟨(rfl | hl), hs⟩)
          · exact Or.inl h
          · rw [hsa] at hs; exact absurd hs (by simp)
          · exact Or.inr ⟨hl, hs⟩
    | false =>
      have hstep : sideSplit g acc a = (acc.1, acc.2.push a) := by
        simp [sideSplit, hsa]
      rw [hstep]
      obtain ⟨ih1, ih2⟩ := ih (acc.1, acc.2.push a)
      refine ⟨fun p => ?_, fun p => ?_⟩
      · rw [ih1]; simp only [List.mem_cons]
        constructor
        · rintro (h | ⟨hl, hs⟩)
          · exact Or.inl h
          · exact Or.inr ⟨Or.inr hl, hs⟩
        · rintro (h | ⟨(rfl | hl), hs⟩)
          · exact Or.inl h
          · rw [hsa] at hs; exact absurd hs (by simp)
          · exact Or.inr ⟨hl, hs⟩
      · rw [ih2]; simp only [Array.mem_push, List.mem_cons]
        constructor
        · rintro ((h | rfl) | ⟨hl, hs⟩)
          · exact Or.inl h
          · exact Or.inr ⟨Or.inl rfl, hsa⟩
          · exact Or.inr ⟨Or.inr hl, hs⟩
        · rintro (h | ⟨(rfl | hl), hs⟩)
          · exact Or.inl (Or.inl h)
          · exact Or.inl (Or.inr rfl)
          · exact Or.inr ⟨hl, hs⟩

name: clipBySide_eq_foldl
statement:
theorem clipBySide_eq_foldl (g : IPlane) (f : Frag) :
    clipBySide g f = (clipFrag g f).toList.foldl (sideSplit g) (#[], #[])
proof:
:= by
  unfold clipBySide
  rw [← Array.foldl_toList]
  rfl

name: mem_clipBySide_fst
statement:
theorem mem_clipBySide_fst (g : IPlane) (f : Frag) (p : Frag) :
    p ∈ (clipBySide g f).1 ↔ p ∈ clipFrag g f ∧ sideOf g p = true
proof:
:= by
  rw [clipBySide_eq_foldl, (clipBySide_mem_aux g (clipFrag g f).toList (#[], #[])).1 p]
  simp only [show ∀ q : Frag, (q ∈ (#[] : Array Frag)) = False from fun q => by simp,
    false_or, Array.mem_toList]

name: mem_clipBySide_snd
statement:
theorem mem_clipBySide_snd (g : IPlane) (f : Frag) (p : Frag) :
    p ∈ (clipBySide g f).2 ↔ p ∈ clipFrag g f ∧ sideOf g p = false
proof:
:= by
  rw [clipBySide_eq_foldl, (clipBySide_mem_aux g (clipFrag g f).toList (#[], #[])).2 p]
  simp only [show ∀ q : Frag, (q ∈ (#[] : Array Frag)) = False from fun q => by simp,
    false_or, Array.mem_toList]

name: fragInv_vrepr_toList
statement:
theorem fragInv_vrepr_toList {nt : Point} {ct : ℚ} {p : Frag} (hp : FragInv nt ct p) :
    ∀ v ∈ p.poly.toList, repr4 v.h (P3.toPoint v.p)
proof:
:= by
  intro v hv
  rw [List.mem_iff_get] at hv
  obtain ⟨k, rfl⟩ := hv
  have := hp.vrepr ⟨k.val, by simp⟩
  simpa [fragCycle] using this

name: oneSided_toList
statement:
theorem oneSided_toList {g : IPlane} {N : Point} {d : ℚ} {nt : Point} {ct : ℚ}
    {f : Frag} (hg : IsMulOf g N d) (hf : FragInv nt ct f)
    {p : Frag} (hmem : p ∈ clipFrag g f) :
    (∀ v ∈ p.poly.toList, 0 ≤ ce N d (P3.toPoint v.p))
      ∨ (∀ v ∈ p.poly.toList, ce N d (P3.toPoint v.p) ≤ 0)
proof:
:= by
  rcases clipFrag_oneSided hg hf hmem with hpos | hneg
  · left; intro v hv
    rw [List.mem_iff_get] at hv
    obtain ⟨k, rfl⟩ := hv
    have := hpos ⟨k.val, by simp⟩
    simpa [fragCycle] using this
  · right; intro v hv
    rw [List.mem_iff_get] at hv
    obtain ⟨k, rfl⟩ := hv
    have := hneg ⟨k.val, by simp⟩
    simpa [fragCycle] using this

name: clipBySide_fst_hull_nonpos
proof:
:= by
  rw [mem_clipBySide_fst] at hp
  obtain ⟨hmem, hside⟩ := hp
  have hp' : FragInv nt ct p := fragInv_clipFrag g hf hmem
  haveI := hp'.neZero
  have hrep := fragInv_vrepr_toList hp'
  have hone' := oneSided_toList hg hf hmem
  have hint := (sideOf_iff_interior hg hrep hone').mp hside
  
  apply vpoly_subset_ce_nonpos
  intro k
  have : (fragCycle p) k = P3.toPoint (p.poly[k]).p := rfl
  rw [this]
  refine hint (p.poly[k]) ?_
  exact List.get_mem _ _

name: innerFold_mem_aux
statement:
theorem innerFold_mem_aux (g : IPlane) (l : List Frag) :
    ∀ (acc : Array Frag × Array Frag),
    (∀ p, p ∈ (l.foldl (innerStep g) acc).1
        ↔ p ∈ acc.1 ∨ ∃ q ∈ l, p ∈ (clipBySide g q).1) ∧
    (∀ p, p ∈ (l.foldl (innerStep g) acc).2
        ↔ p ∈ acc.2 ∨ ∃ q ∈ l, p ∈ (clipBySide g q).2)
proof:
:= by
  induction l with
  | nil => intro acc; simp
  | cons a l ih =>
    intro acc
    simp only [List.foldl_cons]
    obtain ⟨ih1, ih2⟩ := ih (innerStep g acc a)
    refine ⟨fun p => ?_, fun p => ?_⟩
    · rw [ih1]
      simp only [innerStep, Array.mem_append, List.mem_cons]
      constructor
      · rintro ((h | h) | ⟨q, hq, hp⟩)
        · exact Or.inl h
        · exact Or.inr ⟨a, Or.inl rfl, h⟩
        · exact Or.inr ⟨q, Or.inr hq, hp⟩
      · rintro (h | ⟨q, (rfl | hq), hp⟩)
        · exact Or.inl (Or.inl h)
        · exact Or.inl (Or.inr hp)
        · exact Or.inr ⟨q, hq, hp⟩
    · rw [ih2]
      simp only [innerStep, Array.mem_append, List.mem_cons]
      constructor
      · rintro ((h | h) | ⟨q, hq, hp⟩)
        · exact Or.inl h
        · exact Or.inr ⟨a, Or.inl rfl, h⟩
        · exact Or.inr ⟨q, Or.inr hq, hp⟩
      · rintro (h | ⟨q, (rfl | hq), hp⟩)
        · exact Or.inl (Or.inl h)
        · exact Or.inl (Or.inr hp)
        · exact Or.inr ⟨q, hq, hp⟩

name: innerFold_eq
statement:
theorem innerFold_eq (g : IPlane) (inside : Array Frag) :
    inside.foldl (fun st piece =>
      let (ins, outs) := st
      let (i2, o2) := clipBySide g piece
      (ins ++ i2, outs ++ o2)) (#[], #[]) = innerFold g inside
proof:
:= by
  rw [innerFold, ← Array.foldl_toList]
  rfl

name: mem_innerFold_fst
statement:
theorem mem_innerFold_fst (g : IPlane) (inside : Array Frag) (p : Frag) :
    p ∈ (innerFold g inside).1 ↔ ∃ q ∈ inside, p ∈ (clipBySide g q).1
proof:
:= by
  rw [innerFold, (innerFold_mem_aux g inside.toList (#[], #[])).1 p]
  simp only [show ∀ q : Frag, (q ∈ (#[] : Array Frag)) = False from fun q => by simp,
    false_or, Array.mem_toList]

name: mem_innerFold_snd
statement:
theorem mem_innerFold_snd (g : IPlane) (inside : Array Frag) (p : Frag) :
    p ∈ (innerFold g inside).2 ↔ ∃ q ∈ inside, p ∈ (clipBySide g q).2
proof:
:= by
  rw [innerFold, (innerFold_mem_aux g inside.toList (#[], #[])).2 p]
  simp only [show ∀ q : Frag, (q ∈ (#[] : Array Frag)) = False from fun q => by simp,
    false_or, Array.mem_toList]

name: coplanarClip_eq_foldl
statement:
theorem coplanarClip_eq_foldl (fa fb : Frag) :
    coplanarClip fa fb = (edgePlanesOf fb).toList.foldl outerStep (#[fa], #[])
proof:
:= by
  unfold coplanarClip
  rw [← Array.foldl_toList]
  congr 1
  funext acc g
  obtain ⟨inside, comp⟩ := acc
  simp only [outerStep, ← innerFold_eq]

name: mem_edgePlanesOf
statement:
theorem mem_edgePlanesOf {fb : Frag} {g : IPlane} (hg : g ∈ edgePlanesOf fb) :
    ∃ i : ℕ, i < fb.poly.size ∧
      g = edgePlane (carrierNormalP fb)
        (fb.poly.getD i default).p (fb.poly.getD ((i + 1) % fb.poly.size) default).p
proof:
:= by
  unfold edgePlanesOf at hg
  rw [Array.mem_map] at hg
  obtain ⟨i, hi, rfl⟩ := hg
  have hi' : i < fb.poly.size := by
    rw [← Array.mem_toList, Array.toList_range, List.mem_range] at hi; exact hi
  exact ⟨i, hi', rfl⟩

name: dotQ_smul_left
statement: theorem dotQ_smul_left (m : ℚ) (n x : Point) : dotQ (m • n) x = m * dotQ n x
proof:
:= by
  simp only [dotQ, Pi.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul]; ring

name: areaForm_smul_left
statement:
theorem areaForm_smul_left (m : ℚ) (n x u v : Point) :
    areaForm (m • n) x u v = m * areaForm n x u v
proof:
:= by
  rw [areaForm, areaForm, dotQ_smul_left]

name: eta_smul_left
statement:
theorem eta_smul_left {r : ℕ} [NeZero r] (m : ℚ) (n : Point) (w : Fin r → Point)
