    (i : Fin r) (x : Point) : eta (m • n) w i x = m * eta n w i x
proof:
:= by
  rw [eta, eta, areaForm_smul_left]

name: onPlane_smul
statement:
theorem onPlane_smul {r : ℕ} {m : ℚ} {n : Point} {c : ℚ} {w : Fin r → Point}
    (h : OnPlane n c w) : OnPlane (m • n) (m * c) w
proof:
:= by
  intro i; rw [dotQ_smul_left, h i]

name: strictConv_smul
statement:
theorem strictConv_smul {r : ℕ} [NeZero r] {m : ℚ} (hm : 0 < m) {n : Point}
    {w : Fin r → Point} (h : StrictConv n w) : StrictConv (m • n) w
proof:
:= by
  intro i j hj1 hj2
  rw [eta_smul_left]
  exact mul_pos hm (h i j hj1 hj2)

name: carrierNormalPt_eq_smul
statement:
theorem carrierNormalPt_eq_smul {nt : Point} {ct : ℚ} {fb : Frag}
    (hfb : FragInv nt ct fb) :
    ∃ m : ℚ, 0 < m ∧ carrierNormalPt fb = m • nt ∧
      dotQ (carrierNormalPt fb) (fragCycle fb ⟨0, by have := hfb.size3; omega⟩) = m * ct
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨m, hm, ha, hb, hc, _⟩ := hfb.mul
  refine ⟨m, hm, ?_, ?_⟩
  · funext k
    fin_cases k <;>
      simp only [carrierNormalPt, carrierNormalP, P3.toPoint, mkPoint_zero,
        mkPoint_one, mkPoint_two, Pi.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul]
    · exact ha
    · exact hb
    · exact hc
  · have honp := hfb.onPlane ⟨0, by have := hfb.size3; omega⟩
    have : carrierNormalPt fb = m • nt := by
      funext k
      fin_cases k <;>
        simp only [carrierNormalPt, carrierNormalP, P3.toPoint, mkPoint_zero,
          mkPoint_one, mkPoint_two, Pi.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul]
      · exact ha
      · exact hb
      · exact hc
    rw [this, dotQ_smul_left, honp]

name: fragCycle_getD
statement:
theorem fragCycle_getD {fb : Frag} {i : ℕ} (hi : i < fb.poly.size) :
    fragCycle fb ⟨i, hi⟩ = P3.toPoint (fb.poly.getD i default).p
proof:
:= by
  rw [fragCycle, getD_eq_getElem _ hi default]
  rfl

name: fragCycle_succ_getD
statement:
theorem fragCycle_succ_getD {fb : Frag} {i : ℕ} (hi : i < fb.poly.size)
    [NeZero fb.poly.size] :
    fragCycle fb (⟨i, hi⟩ + 1)
      = P3.toPoint (fb.poly.getD ((i + 1) % fb.poly.size) default).p
proof:
:= by
  have hlt : (i + 1) % fb.poly.size < fb.poly.size :=
    Nat.mod_lt _ (NeZero.pos _)
  rw [fragCycle, getD_eq_getElem _ hlt default]
  rw [Fin.add_def]
  simp [Fin.val_one']

name: edgePlane_nonpos_eq_eta
statement:
theorem edgePlane_nonpos_eq_eta {fb : Frag} {i : ℕ} (hi : i < fb.poly.size)
    [NeZero fb.poly.size] (x : Point) :
    ce (P3.toPoint (edgeNormal (carrierNormalP fb)
        (fb.poly.getD i default).p (fb.poly.getD ((i + 1) % fb.poly.size) default).p))
      (edgeOffset (carrierNormalP fb)
        (fb.poly.getD i default).p (fb.poly.getD ((i + 1) % fb.poly.size) default).p) x ≤ 0
      ↔ 0 ≤ eta (carrierNormalPt fb) (fragCycle fb) ⟨i, hi⟩ x
proof:
:= by
  rw [edgePlane_interior_nonpos]
  rw [eta, ← fragCycle_getD hi, ← fragCycle_succ_getD hi]
  show 0 ≤ areaForm (carrierNormalPt fb) _ _ x ↔ _
  rfl

name: outerFold_inside_invariant
statement:
theorem outerFold_inside_invariant {nt : Point} {ct : ℚ}
    (gs : List IPlane) :
    ∀ (init : Array Frag × Array Frag),
    (∀ q ∈ init.1, FragInv nt ct q) →
    ∀ p ∈ (gs.foldl outerStep init).1,
      FragInv nt ct p
      ∧ (∃ q ∈ init.1, vpoly (fragCycle p) ⊆ vpoly (fragCycle q))
      ∧ (∀ g ∈ gs, ∀ N d, IsMulOf g N d →
          vpoly (fragCycle p) ⊆ {x | ce N d x ≤ 0})
proof:
:= by
  induction gs with
  | nil =>
    intro init hinit p hp
    exact ⟨hinit p hp, ⟨p, hp, le_refl _⟩, by intro g hg; simp at hg⟩
  | cons g gs ih =>
    intro init hinit p hp
    simp only [List.foldl_cons] at hp
    
    have hstep1 : (outerStep init g).1 = (innerFold g init.1).1 := rfl
    
    have hnewinv : ∀ p' ∈ (outerStep init g).1,
        FragInv nt ct p'
        ∧ (∃ q ∈ init.1, vpoly (fragCycle p') ⊆ vpoly (fragCycle q))
        ∧ (∀ N d, IsMulOf g N d → vpoly (fragCycle p') ⊆ {x | ce N d x ≤ 0}) := by
      intro p' hp'
      rw [hstep1, mem_innerFold_fst] at hp'
      obtain ⟨q, hq, hpq⟩ := hp'
      have hqinv := hinit q hq
      rw [mem_clipBySide_fst] at hpq
      obtain ⟨hmem, hside⟩ := hpq
      refine ⟨fragInv_clipFrag g hqinv hmem, ⟨q, hq, ?_⟩, ?_⟩
      · exact clipFrag_vpoly_subset g hqinv hmem
      · intro N d hg
        have := clipBySide_fst_hull_nonpos hg hqinv
          (p := p') (by rw [mem_clipBySide_fst]; exact ⟨hmem, hside⟩)
        exact this
    
    have hnewfrag : ∀ q ∈ (outerStep init g).1, FragInv nt ct q :=
      fun q hq => (hnewinv q hq).1
    obtain ⟨hpinv, ⟨q', hq', hsubq'⟩, hnp⟩ := ih (outerStep init g) hnewfrag p hp
    refine ⟨hpinv, ?_, ?_⟩
    · 
      obtain ⟨q'', hq'', hsubq''⟩ := (hnewinv q' hq').2.1
      exact ⟨q'', hq'', hsubq'.trans hsubq''⟩
    · 
      intro g0 hg0 N d hgmul
      rcases List.mem_cons.mp hg0 with rfl | hg0'
      · 
        have hq'nonpos := (hnewinv q' hq').2.2 N d hgmul
        exact hsubq'.trans hq'nonpos
      · 
        exact hnp g0 hg0' N d hgmul

name: vpoly_fb_eq
statement:
theorem vpoly_fb_eq {nt : Point} {ct : ℚ} {fb : Frag} [NeZero fb.poly.size]
    (hfb : FragInv nt ct fb) :
    ∃ (m : ℚ), 0 < m ∧ carrierNormalPt fb = m • nt ∧
      vpoly (fragCycle fb)
        = {x | dotQ (carrierNormalPt fb) x = m * ct
            ∧ ∀ i, 0 ≤ eta (carrierNormalPt fb) (fragCycle fb) i x}
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨m, hm, hcar, _⟩ := carrierNormalPt_eq_smul hfb
  refine ⟨m, hm, hcar, ?_⟩
  have honp : OnPlane (carrierNormalPt fb) (m * ct) (fragCycle fb) := by
    rw [hcar]; exact onPlane_smul hfb.onPlane
  have hstr : StrictConv (carrierNormalPt fb) (fragCycle fb) := by
    rw [hcar]; exact strictConv_smul hm hfb.strictConv
  exact vpoly_eq hfb.size3 honp hstr

name: coplanarClip_inside_vpoly_subset_fb_free
proof:
:= by
  haveI := hfa.neZero
  haveI := hfb.neZero
  rw [coplanarClip_eq_foldl] at hp
  have hinit : ∀ q ∈ (#[fa], (#[] : Array Frag)).1, FragInv nt ct q := by
    intro q hq
    have : q = fa := by simpa using hq
    rw [this]; exact hfa
  obtain ⟨hpinv, ⟨q, hq, hsubfa⟩, hnonpos⟩ :=
    outerFold_inside_invariant (edgePlanesOf fb).toList (#[fa], #[]) hinit p hp
  have hqfa : q = fa := by simpa using hq
  rw [hqfa] at hsubfa
  
  obtain ⟨m', hm', hcar', hvfb⟩ := vpoly_fb_eq hfb
  intro x hx
  rw [hvfb]
  refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
  · 
    have hxfa : x ∈ vpoly (fragCycle fa) := hsubfa hx
    have hfa_plane : vpoly (fragCycle fa)
        ⊆ {y | dotQ (carrierNormalPt fb) y = m' * ct'} := by
      apply convexHull_min
      · rintro y ⟨j, rfl⟩
        show dotQ (carrierNormalPt fb) (fragCycle fa j) = m' * ct'
        rw [hcar', dotQ_smul_left, hplfa j]
      · intro u hu v hv a b _ _ hab
        simp only [Set.mem_setOf_eq] at hu hv ⊢
        rw [dotQ] at hu hv ⊢
        simp only [Pi.add_apply, Pi.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul]
        have : carrierNormalPt fb 0 * (a * u 0 + b * v 0)
            + carrierNormalPt fb 1 * (a * u 1 + b * v 1)
            + carrierNormalPt fb 2 * (a * u 2 + b * v 2)
            = a * (carrierNormalPt fb 0 * u 0 + carrierNormalPt fb 1 * u 1
                + carrierNormalPt fb 2 * u 2)
              + b * (carrierNormalPt fb 0 * v 0 + carrierNormalPt fb 1 * v 1
                + carrierNormalPt fb 2 * v 2) := by ring
        rw [this, hu, hv, ← add_mul, hab, one_mul]
    exact hfa_plane hxfa
  · 
    intro i
    have hi : (i : ℕ) < fb.poly.size := i.isLt
    set gi := edgePlane (carrierNormalP fb)
      (fb.poly.getD (i : ℕ) default).p
      (fb.poly.getD (((i : ℕ) + 1) % fb.poly.size) default).p with hgidef
    have hgi_mem : gi ∈ edgePlanesOf fb := by
      unfold edgePlanesOf
      rw [Array.mem_map]
      refine ⟨(i : ℕ), ?_, ?_⟩
      · rw [← Array.mem_toList, Array.toList_range, List.mem_range]; exact hi
      · rfl
    have hgi_mul : IsMulOf gi
        (P3.toPoint (edgeNormal (carrierNormalP fb)
          (fb.poly.getD (i : ℕ) default).p
          (fb.poly.getD (((i : ℕ) + 1) % fb.poly.size) default).p))
        (edgeOffset (carrierNormalP fb)
          (fb.poly.getD (i : ℕ) default).p
          (fb.poly.getD (((i : ℕ) + 1) % fb.poly.size) default).p) := by
      rw [hgidef]; exact isMulOf_edgePlane _ _ _
    have hnp := hnonpos gi (by rw [← Array.mem_toList] at hgi_mem; exact hgi_mem)
      _ _ hgi_mul hx
    simp only [Set.mem_setOf_eq] at hnp
    have := (edgePlane_nonpos_eq_eta hi x).mp hnp
    rwa [show (⟨(i : ℕ), hi⟩ : Fin fb.poly.size) = i from by ext; rfl] at this

name: clipBySide_cover
statement:
theorem clipBySide_cover {nt : Point} {ct : ℚ} {g : IPlane} {f : Frag}
    (hf : FragInv nt ct f) (x : Point) :
    ((∃ p ∈ (clipBySide g f).1, x ∈ vpoly (fragCycle p))
      ∨ (∃ p ∈ (clipBySide g f).2, x ∈ vpoly (fragCycle p)))
      ↔ x ∈ vpoly (fragCycle f)
proof:
:= by
  rw [← clipFrag_mem_vpoly_iff g hf x]
  constructor
  · rintro (⟨p, hp, hx⟩ | ⟨p, hp, hx⟩)
    · rw [mem_clipBySide_fst] at hp; exact ⟨p, hp.1, hx⟩
    · rw [mem_clipBySide_snd] at hp; exact ⟨p, hp.1, hx⟩
  · rintro ⟨p, hp, hx⟩
    cases hs : sideOf g p with
    | true => exact Or.inl ⟨p, (mem_clipBySide_fst g f p).mpr ⟨hp, hs⟩, hx⟩
    | false => exact Or.inr ⟨p, (mem_clipBySide_snd g f p).mpr ⟨hp, hs⟩, hx⟩

name: outerFold_cover_invariant
statement:
theorem outerFold_cover_invariant {nt : Point} {ct : ℚ} (gs : List IPlane)
    (x : Point) :
    ∀ (init : Array Frag × Array Frag),
    (∀ q ∈ init.1, FragInv nt ct q) →
    (((∃ p ∈ (gs.foldl outerStep init).1, x ∈ vpoly (fragCycle p))
        ∨ (∃ p ∈ (gs.foldl outerStep init).2, x ∈ vpoly (fragCycle p)))
      ↔ ((∃ p ∈ init.1, x ∈ vpoly (fragCycle p))
        ∨ (∃ p ∈ init.2, x ∈ vpoly (fragCycle p))))
proof:
:= by
  induction gs with
  | nil => intro init _; simp
  | cons g gs ih =>
    intro init hinit
    simp only [List.foldl_cons]
    
    have hnewfrag : ∀ q ∈ (outerStep init g).1, FragInv nt ct q := by
      intro q hq
      have : q ∈ (innerFold g init.1).1 := hq
      rw [mem_innerFold_fst] at this
      obtain ⟨r, hr, hqr⟩ := this
      rw [mem_clipBySide_fst] at hqr
      exact fragInv_clipFrag g (hinit r hr) hqr.1
    rw [ih (outerStep init g) hnewfrag]
    
    
    constructor
    · rintro (⟨p, hp, hx⟩ | ⟨p, hp, hx⟩)
      · 
        have : p ∈ (innerFold g init.1).1 := hp
        rw [mem_innerFold_fst] at this
        obtain ⟨r, hr, hpr⟩ := this
        have hcov : x ∈ vpoly (fragCycle r) := by
          have := clipFrag_vpoly_subset g (hinit r hr)
            ((mem_clipBySide_fst g r p).mp hpr).1
          exact this hx
        exact Or.inl ⟨r, hr, hcov⟩
      · 
        have hp' : p ∈ init.2 ∨ p ∈ (innerFold g init.1).2 := by
          have : p ∈ init.2 ++ (innerFold g init.1).2 := hp
          rwa [Array.mem_append] at this
        rcases hp' with hpinit | hpinner
        · exact Or.inr ⟨p, hpinit, hx⟩
        · rw [mem_innerFold_snd] at hpinner
          obtain ⟨r, hr, hpr⟩ := hpinner
          have hcov : x ∈ vpoly (fragCycle r) := by
            have := clipFrag_vpoly_subset g (hinit r hr)
              ((mem_clipBySide_snd g r p).mp hpr).1
            exact this hx
          exact Or.inl ⟨r, hr, hcov⟩
    · rintro (⟨r, hr, hx⟩ | ⟨p, hp, hx⟩)
      · 
        have := (clipBySide_cover (g := g) (hinit r hr) x).mpr hx
        rcases this with ⟨p, hp, hxp⟩ | ⟨p, hp, hxp⟩
        · refine Or.inl ⟨p, ?_, hxp⟩
          show p ∈ (innerFold g init.1).1
          rw [mem_innerFold_fst]; exact ⟨r, hr, hp⟩
        · refine Or.inr ⟨p, ?_, hxp⟩
          show p ∈ init.2 ++ (innerFold g init.1).2
          rw [Array.mem_append]; right
          rw [mem_innerFold_snd]; exact ⟨r, hr, hp⟩
      · 
        refine Or.inr ⟨p, ?_, hx⟩
        show p ∈ init.2 ++ (innerFold g init.1).2
        rw [Array.mem_append]; exact Or.inl hp

name: coplanarClip_cover
statement:
theorem coplanarClip_cover {nt : Point} {ct : ℚ} {fa fb : Frag}
    (hfa : FragInv nt ct fa) (x : Point) :
    ((∃ p ∈ (coplanarClip fa fb).1, x ∈ vpoly (fragCycle p))
      ∨ (∃ p ∈ (coplanarClip fa fb).2, x ∈ vpoly (fragCycle p)))
      ↔ x ∈ vpoly (fragCycle fa)
proof:
:= by
  rw [coplanarClip_eq_foldl]
  have hinit : ∀ q ∈ (#[fa], (#[] : Array Frag)).1, FragInv nt ct q := by
    intro q hq
    have : q = fa := by simpa using hq
    rw [this]; exact hfa
  rw [outerFold_cover_invariant (edgePlanesOf fb).toList x (#[fa], #[]) hinit]
  constructor
  · rintro (⟨p, hp, hx⟩ | ⟨p, hp, hx⟩)
    · obtain rfl : p = fa := by simpa using hp
      exact hx
    · simp at hp
  · intro hx
    exact Or.inl ⟨fa, by simp, hx⟩

name: outerFold_comp_dropped
statement:
theorem outerFold_comp_dropped {nt : Point} {ct : ℚ} (gs : List IPlane) :
    ∀ (init : Array Frag × Array Frag),
    (∀ q ∈ init.1, FragInv nt ct q) →
    ∀ p ∈ (gs.foldl outerStep init).2,
      p ∈ init.2 ∨ ∃ g ∈ gs, ∃ r, FragInv nt ct r ∧ p ∈ (clipBySide g r).2
proof:
:= by
  induction gs with
  | nil => intro init _ p hp; exact Or.inl hp
  | cons g gs ih =>
    intro init hinit p hp
    simp only [List.foldl_cons] at hp
    have hnewfrag : ∀ q ∈ (outerStep init g).1, FragInv nt ct q := by
      intro q hq
      have : q ∈ (innerFold g init.1).1 := hq
      rw [mem_innerFold_fst] at this
      obtain ⟨r, hr, hqr⟩ := this
      rw [mem_clipBySide_fst] at hqr
      exact fragInv_clipFrag g (hinit r hr) hqr.1
    rcases ih (outerStep init g) hnewfrag p hp with hp2 | ⟨g', hg', r, hr, hpr⟩
    · 
      have : p ∈ init.2 ++ (innerFold g init.1).2 := hp2
      rw [Array.mem_append] at this
      rcases this with hpinit | hpinner
      · exact Or.inl hpinit
      · rw [mem_innerFold_snd] at hpinner
        obtain ⟨r, hr, hpr⟩ := hpinner
        exact Or.inr ⟨g, List.mem_cons_self g gs, r, hinit r hr, hpr⟩
    · exact Or.inr ⟨g', List.mem_cons_of_mem g hg', r, hr, hpr⟩

name: clipBySide_snd_vrelint_pos
proof:
:= by
  rw [mem_clipBySide_snd] at hp
  obtain ⟨hmem, hside⟩ := hp
  have hp' : FragInv nt ct p := fragInv_clipFrag g hf hmem
  haveI := hp'.neZero
  
  
  have hrep := fragInv_vrepr_toList hp'
  have hone' := oneSided_toList hg hf hmem
  
  have hnotallnp : ¬ (∀ v ∈ p.poly.toList, ce N d (P3.toPoint v.p) ≤ 0) := by
    intro hall
    have := (sideOf_iff_interior hg hrep hone').mpr hall
    rw [hside] at this; exact absurd this (by simp)
  
  have hallnn : ∀ v ∈ p.poly.toList, 0 ≤ ce N d (P3.toPoint v.p) := by
    rcases hone' with h | h
    · exact h
    · exact absurd h hnotallnp
  have hexpos : ∃ v ∈ p.poly.toList, 0 < ce N d (P3.toPoint v.p) := by
    by_contra hcon
    push_neg at hcon
    exact hnotallnp (fun v hv => hcon v hv)
  
  rintro x ⟨μ, hμpos, hμsum, rfl⟩
  simp only [Set.mem_setOf_eq]
  rw [ce_sum_comb N d hμsum]
  have hnn : ∀ j, 0 ≤ μ j * ce N d (fragCycle p j) := by
    intro j
    refine mul_nonneg (hμpos j).le ?_
    have : fragCycle p j = P3.toPoint (p.poly[j]).p := rfl
    rw [this]
    exact hallnn (p.poly[j]) (List.get_mem _ _)
  obtain ⟨v, hv, hvpos⟩ := hexpos
  rw [List.mem_iff_get] at hv
  obtain ⟨k, rfl⟩ := hv
  refine Finset.sum_pos' (fun j _ => hnn j)
    ⟨⟨k.val, by simp⟩, Finset.mem_univ _, ?_⟩
  refine mul_pos (hμpos _) ?_
  have : fragCycle p ⟨k.val, by simp⟩
      = P3.toPoint (p.poly.toList.get k).p := by
    rw [fragCycle]; congr 1
  rw [this]; exact hvpos

name: overlaps_iff_exists_size3
statement:
theorem overlaps_iff_exists_size3 (fa fb : Frag) :
    overlaps fa fb = true ↔ ∃ p ∈ (coplanarClip fa fb).1, 3 ≤ p.poly.size
proof:
:= by
  unfold overlaps
  rw [show (coplanarClip fa fb)
      = ((coplanarClip fa fb).1, (coplanarClip fa fb).2) from rfl]
  simp only [Array.any_eq_true, decide_eq_true_eq, ge_iff_le]
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨i, h⟩
    exact ⟨(coplanarClip fa fb).1[i], Array.getElem_mem i.isLt, h⟩
  · rintro ⟨p, hp, h⟩
    obtain ⟨i, hi, rfl⟩ := Array.mem_iff_getElem.mp hp
    exact ⟨⟨i, hi⟩, h⟩

name: coplanarClip_inside_size3
proof:
:= by
  rw [coplanarClip_eq_foldl] at hp
  have hinit : ∀ q ∈ (#[fa], (#[] : Array Frag)).1, FragInv nt ct q := by
    intro q hq
    obtain rfl : q = fa := by simpa using hq
    exact hfa
  obtain ⟨hpinv, _, _⟩ :=
    outerFold_inside_invariant (edgePlanesOf fb).toList (#[fa], #[]) hinit p hp
  exact hpinv.size3

name: Vert_zero
statement: @[simp] theorem Vert_zero (s : Triangle) : Vert s 0 = s.v₀
proof: := rfl

name: Vert_one
statement: @[simp] theorem Vert_one (s : Triangle) : Vert s 1 = s.v₁
proof: := rfl

name: Vert_two
statement: @[simp] theorem Vert_two (s : Triangle) : Vert s 2 = s.v₂
proof: := rfl

name: baryPt_plane
statement:
theorem baryPt_plane (s : Triangle) (n q : Point) (μ : Fin 3 → ℚ)
    (hμ : μ 0 + μ 1 + μ 2 = 1) :
    n ⬝ᵥ (baryPt s μ - q)
      = μ 0 * (n ⬝ᵥ ((s.v₀ : Point) - q)) + μ 1 * (n ⬝ᵥ ((s.v₁ : Point) - q))
        + μ 2 * (n ⬝ᵥ ((s.v₂ : Point) - q))
proof:
:= by
  have key : (baryPt s μ - q : Point)
      = μ 0 • ((s.v₀ : Point) - q) + μ 1 • ((s.v₁ : Point) - q) + μ 2 • ((s.v₂ : Point) - q) := by
    unfold baryPt; match_scalars <;> linarith [hμ]
  rw [key]; simp only [dotProduct_add, dotProduct_smul, smul_eq_mul]

name: baryPt_coord
statement:
theorem baryPt_coord (s : Triangle) (m : Fin 3) (μ : Fin 3 → ℚ) :
    (baryPt s μ) m = μ 0 * (s.v₀ : Point) m + μ 1 * (s.v₁ : Point) m + μ 2 * (s.v₂ : Point) m
proof:
:= by
  unfold baryPt; simp only [Pi.add_apply, Pi.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul]

name: mix_two
statement:
theorem mix_two (Λ Ea Eb Ca Cb ea eb ca cb : ℚ)
    (_hΛ3 : (0:ℚ) < Λ ^ 3)
    (hEa : Ea = Λ ^ 3 * ea) (hEb : Eb = Λ ^ 3 * eb)
    (hCa : Ca = Λ * ca) (hCb : Cb = Λ * cb)
    (hopp : (Ea < 0 ∧ 0 < Eb) ∨ (0 < Ea ∧ Eb < 0)) :
    0 < -Eb / (Ea - Eb) ∧ 0 < Ea / (Ea - Eb) ∧
    (-Eb / (Ea - Eb)) + (Ea / (Ea - Eb)) = 1 ∧
    (-Eb / (Ea - Eb)) * ea + (Ea / (Ea - Eb)) * eb = 0 ∧
    Λ * ((-Eb / (Ea - Eb)) * ca + (Ea / (Ea - Eb)) * cb)
      = (Ea * Cb - Eb * Ca) / (Ea - Eb)
proof:
:= by
  have hd : Ea - Eb ≠ 0 := by rcases hopp with ⟨h1,h2⟩ | ⟨h1,h2⟩ <;> intro h <;> nlinarith
  have hμa : 0 < -Eb / (Ea - Eb) := by
    rcases hopp with ⟨h1, h2⟩ | ⟨h1, h2⟩
    · exact div_pos_of_neg_of_neg (by linarith) (by linarith)
    · exact div_pos (by linarith) (by linarith)
  have hμb : 0 < Ea / (Ea - Eb) := by
    rcases hopp with ⟨h1, h2⟩ | ⟨h1, h2⟩
    · exact div_pos_of_neg_of_neg (by linarith) (by linarith)
    · exact div_pos (by linarith) (by linarith)
  have hsum : (-Eb / (Ea - Eb)) + (Ea / (Ea - Eb)) = 1 := by
    rw [div_add_div_same, div_eq_one_iff_eq hd]; ring
  refine ⟨hμa, hμb, hsum, ?_, ?_⟩
  · 
    rw [div_mul_eq_mul_div, div_mul_eq_mul_div, div_add_div_same,
      div_eq_zero_iff]
    left; rw [hEa, hEb]; ring
  · 
    rw [hCa, hCb, div_mul_eq_mul_div, div_mul_eq_mul_div, div_add_div_same,
      mul_div_assoc']
    rw [div_eq_div_iff hd hd]; ring

name: member_incidence
statement:
theorem member_incidence (s : Triangle) (m : Fin 3) (n q : Point) (Λ : ℚ)
    (vs : Array I3) (signs : Array Int) (nO qO : I3)
    (hC : ∀ j : Fin 3, Cval m vs (j : ℕ) = Λ * (Vert s j) m)
    (hE : ∀ j : Fin 3, Eval nO qO vs (j : ℕ) = Λ ^ 3 * (n ⬝ᵥ ((Vert s j) - q)))
    (hΛ : 0 < Λ)
    (hsm : ∀ k, k < 3 → signs.getD k 0 = Int.sign (dotI nO (subI (vs.getD k default) qO)))
    (p : Int × Int) (hp : p ∈ collectParams (m : ℕ) vs signs nO qO) :
    ∃ μ : Fin 3 → ℚ, (∀ j, 0 ≤ μ j) ∧ μ 0 + μ 1 + μ 2 = 1 ∧
      ((∃ j : Fin 3, μ j = 1 ∧ ∀ i, i ≠ j → μ i = 0) ∨
        (∃ j : Fin 3, μ j = 0 ∧ ∀ i, i ≠ j → 0 < μ i)) ∧
      n ⬝ᵥ (baryPt s μ - q) = 0 ∧
      Λ * (baryPt s μ) m = fracVal p
proof:
:= by
  
  have hplane : ∀ μ : Fin 3 → ℚ, μ 0 + μ 1 + μ 2 = 1 →
      n ⬝ᵥ (baryPt s μ - q)
        = μ 0 * (n ⬝ᵥ ((s.v₀ : Point) - q)) + μ 1 * (n ⬝ᵥ ((s.v₁ : Point) - q))
          + μ 2 * (n ⬝ᵥ ((s.v₂ : Point) - q)) := by
    intro μ hμ
    have key : (baryPt s μ - q : Point)
        = μ 0 • ((s.v₀ : Point) - q) + μ 1 • ((s.v₁ : Point) - q) + μ 2 • ((s.v₂ : Point) - q) := by
      unfold baryPt; match_scalars <;> linarith [hμ]
    rw [key]; simp only [dotProduct_add, dotProduct_smul, smul_eq_mul]
  
  have hcoord : ∀ μ : Fin 3 → ℚ, (baryPt s μ) m
      = μ 0 * (s.v₀ : Point) m + μ 1 * (s.v₁ : Point) m + μ 2 * (s.v₂ : Point) m := by
    intro μ; unfold baryPt
    simp only [Pi.add_apply, Pi.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul]
  rcases member_fracVal_cases (m : Fin 3) vs signs nO qO p hsm hp with
    ⟨j, hj3, hsj, hpeq⟩ | ⟨k, hk3, hguard, hden, hpeq⟩
  · 
    
    have hEval : Eval nO qO vs j = 0 :=
      ((eval_sign_iff vs signs nO qO j (hsm j hj3)).1).mp hsj
    have hΛ3 : (Λ : ℚ) ^ 3 ≠ 0 := by positivity
    have hej : n ⬝ᵥ ((Vert s ⟨j, hj3⟩) - q) = 0 := by
      have := hE ⟨j, hj3⟩
      simp only [hEval] at this
      rcases mul_eq_zero.mp this.symm with h | h
      · exact absurd h hΛ3
      · exact h
    have hCj : Cval m vs j = Λ * (Vert s ⟨j, hj3⟩) m := hC ⟨j, hj3⟩
    interval_cases j
    · refine ⟨![1, 0, 0], by intro i; fin_cases i <;> simp, by norm_num,
        Or.inl ⟨0, by simp, fun i hi => by fin_cases i <;> first | exact absurd rfl hi | rfl⟩,
        ?_, ?_⟩
      · rw [hplane _ (by norm_num)]; simpa using hej
      · rw [hpeq, hcoord, hCj]; simp
    · refine ⟨![0, 1, 0], by intro i; fin_cases i <;> simp, by norm_num,
        Or.inl ⟨1, by simp, fun i hi => by fin_cases i <;> first | exact absurd rfl hi | rfl⟩,
        ?_, ?_⟩
      · rw [hplane _ (by norm_num)]; simpa using hej
      · rw [hpeq, hcoord, hCj]; simp
    · refine ⟨![0, 0, 1], by intro i; fin_cases i <;> simp, by norm_num,
        Or.inl ⟨2, by simp, fun i hi => by fin_cases i <;> first | exact absurd rfl hi | rfl⟩,
        ?_, ?_⟩
      · rw [hplane _ (by norm_num)]; simpa using hej
      · rw [hpeq, hcoord, hCj]; simp
  · 
    have hk1 : (k + 1) % 3 < 3 := Nat.mod_lt _ (by norm_num)
    have hsgnk := eval_sign_iff vs signs nO qO k (hsm k hk3)
    have hsgnk1 := eval_sign_iff vs signs nO qO ((k+1)%3) (hsm ((k+1)%3) hk1)
    have hopp : (Eval nO qO vs k < 0 ∧ 0 < Eval nO qO vs ((k+1)%3)) ∨
        (0 < Eval nO qO vs k ∧ Eval nO qO vs ((k+1)%3) < 0) := by
      rcases hguard with ⟨h1, h2⟩ | ⟨h1, h2⟩
      · exact Or.inl ⟨hsgnk.2.1.mp h1, hsgnk1.2.2.mp h2⟩
      · exact Or.inr ⟨hsgnk.2.2.mp h1, hsgnk1.2.1.mp h2⟩
    have hΛ3 : (0 : ℚ) < Λ ^ 3 := by positivity
    interval_cases k <;>
      simp only [show ((0:ℕ)+1)%3 = 1 from rfl, show ((1:ℕ)+1)%3 = 2 from rfl,
        show ((2:ℕ)+1)%3 = 0 from rfl] at hopp hpeq ⊢
    · 
      obtain ⟨hμa, hμb, hμsum, hpl, hpr⟩ := mix_two Λ
        (Eval nO qO vs 0) (Eval nO qO vs 1) (Cval m vs 0) (Cval m vs 1)
        (n ⬝ᵥ ((Vert s 0) - q)) (n ⬝ᵥ ((Vert s 1) - q)) ((Vert s 0) m) ((Vert s 1) m)
        hΛ3 (hE 0) (hE 1) (hC 0) (hC 1) hopp
      set μa := -Eval nO qO vs 1 / (Eval nO qO vs 0 - Eval nO qO vs 1) with hμadef
      set μb := Eval nO qO vs 0 / (Eval nO qO vs 0 - Eval nO qO vs 1) with hμbdef
      have hsum' : μa + μb + 0 = 1 := by rw [add_zero]; exact hμsum
      refine ⟨![μa, μb, 0], by intro i; fin_cases i <;> simp [hμa.le, hμb.le],
        by simpa using hsum',
        Or.inr ⟨2, by simp,
          fun i hi => by fin_cases i <;> first | exact absurd rfl hi | exact hμa | exact hμb⟩,
        ?_, ?_⟩
      · rw [hplane _ (by simpa using hsum')]
        simp only [Matrix.cons_val_zero, Matrix.cons_val_one, Matrix.head_cons,
          Matrix.cons_val_two, Matrix.tail_cons, Vert, zero_mul, add_zero]
        simpa only [Vert] using hpl
      · rw [hpeq, hcoord]
        simp only [Matrix.cons_val_zero, Matrix.cons_val_one, Matrix.head_cons,
          Matrix.cons_val_two, Matrix.tail_cons, Vert, zero_mul, add_zero]
        simpa only [Vert] using hpr
    · 
      obtain ⟨hμa, hμb, hμsum, hpl, hpr⟩ := mix_two Λ
        (Eval nO qO vs 1) (Eval nO qO vs 2) (Cval m vs 1) (Cval m vs 2)
        (n ⬝ᵥ ((Vert s 1) - q)) (n ⬝ᵥ ((Vert s 2) - q)) ((Vert s 1) m) ((Vert s 2) m)
        hΛ3 (hE 1) (hE 2) (hC 1) (hC 2) hopp
      set μa := -Eval nO qO vs 2 / (Eval nO qO vs 1 - Eval nO qO vs 2) with hμadef
      set μb := Eval nO qO vs 1 / (Eval nO qO vs 1 - Eval nO qO vs 2) with hμbdef
      have hsum' : (0:ℚ) + μa + μb = 1 := by rw [zero_add]; exact hμsum
      refine ⟨![0, μa, μb], by intro i; fin_cases i <;> simp [hμa.le, hμb.le],
        by simpa using hsum',
        Or.inr ⟨0, by simp,
          fun i hi => by fin_cases i <;> first | exact absurd rfl hi | exact hμa | exact hμb⟩,
        ?_, ?_⟩
      · rw [hplane _ (by simpa using hsum')]
        simp only [Matrix.cons_val_zero, Matrix.cons_val_one, Matrix.head_cons,
          Matrix.cons_val_two, Matrix.tail_cons, Vert, zero_mul, zero_add]
        simpa only [Vert] using hpl
      · rw [hpeq, hcoord]
        simp only [Matrix.cons_val_zero, Matrix.cons_val_one, Matrix.head_cons,
          Matrix.cons_val_two, Matrix.tail_cons, Vert, zero_mul, zero_add]
        simpa only [Vert] using hpr
    · 
      obtain ⟨hμa, hμb, hμsum, hpl, hpr⟩ := mix_two Λ
        (Eval nO qO vs 2) (Eval nO qO vs 0) (Cval m vs 2) (Cval m vs 0)
        (n ⬝ᵥ ((Vert s 2) - q)) (n ⬝ᵥ ((Vert s 0) - q)) ((Vert s 2) m) ((Vert s 0) m)
        hΛ3 (hE 2) (hE 0) (hC 2) (hC 0) hopp
      set μa := -Eval nO qO vs 0 / (Eval nO qO vs 2 - Eval nO qO vs 0) with hμadef
      set μb := Eval nO qO vs 2 / (Eval nO qO vs 2 - Eval nO qO vs 0) with hμbdef
      have hsum' : μb + 0 + μa = 1 := by rw [add_zero, add_comm]; exact hμsum
      refine ⟨![μb, 0, μa], by intro i; fin_cases i <;> simp [hμa.le, hμb.le],
        by simpa using hsum',
        Or.inr ⟨1, by simp,
          fun i hi => by fin_cases i <;> first | exact absurd rfl hi | exact hμa | exact hμb⟩,
        ?_, ?_⟩
      · rw [hplane _ (by simpa using hsum')]
        simp only [Matrix.cons_val_zero, Matrix.cons_val_one, Matrix.head_cons,
          Matrix.cons_val_two, Matrix.tail_cons, Vert, zero_mul, add_zero, mul_zero]
        simp only [Vert, Matrix.cons_val_zero, Matrix.cons_val_two, Matrix.tail_cons,
          Matrix.head_cons] at hpl
        linarith [hpl]
      · rw [hpeq, hcoord]
        simp only [Matrix.cons_val_zero, Matrix.cons_val_one, Matrix.head_cons,
          Matrix.cons_val_two, Matrix.tail_cons, Vert, zero_mul, add_zero, mul_zero]
        simp only [Vert, Matrix.cons_val_zero, Matrix.cons_val_two, Matrix.tail_cons,
          Matrix.head_cons] at hpr
        rw [mul_add]; linarith [hpr]

name: member_incidence'
statement:
theorem member_incidence' (s : Triangle) (m : Fin 3) (n q : Point) (Λ : ℚ)
    (vs : Array I3) (signs : Array Int) (nO qO : I3)
    (hC : ∀ j : Fin 3, Cval m vs (j : ℕ) = Λ * (Vert s j) m)
    (hE : ∀ j : Fin 3, Eval nO qO vs (j : ℕ) = Λ ^ 3 * (n ⬝ᵥ ((Vert s j) - q)))
    (hΛ : 0 < Λ)
    (hsm : ∀ k, k < 3 → signs.getD k 0 = Int.sign (dotI nO (subI (vs.getD k default) qO)))
    (p : Int × Int) (hp : p ∈ collectParams (m : ℕ) vs signs nO qO) :
    ∃ μ : Fin 3 → ℚ, (∀ j, 0 ≤ μ j) ∧ μ 0 + μ 1 + μ 2 = 1 ∧
      ((∃ j : Fin 3, (μ j = 1 ∧ ∀ i, i ≠ j → μ i = 0) ∧ signs.getD (j : ℕ) 0 = 0) ∨
        (∃ j : Fin 3, (μ j = 0 ∧ ∀ i, i ≠ j → 0 < μ i) ∧
          (∀ i, i ≠ j → signs.getD (i : ℕ) 0 ≠ 0) ∧
          (∀ ν : Fin 3 → ℚ, ν 0 + ν 1 + ν 2 = 1 → ν j = 0 →
            n ⬝ᵥ (baryPt s ν - q) = 0 → ν = μ))) ∧
      n ⬝ᵥ (baryPt s μ - q) = 0 ∧
      Λ * (baryPt s μ) m = fracVal p
proof:
:= by
  have hplane : ∀ μ : Fin 3 → ℚ, μ 0 + μ 1 + μ 2 = 1 →
      n ⬝ᵥ (baryPt s μ - q)
        = μ 0 * (n ⬝ᵥ ((s.v₀ : Point) - q)) + μ 1 * (n ⬝ᵥ ((s.v₁ : Point) - q))
          + μ 2 * (n ⬝ᵥ ((s.v₂ : Point) - q)) := fun μ hμ => baryPt_plane s n q μ hμ
  have hcoord : ∀ μ : Fin 3 → ℚ, (baryPt s μ) m
      = μ 0 * (s.v₀ : Point) m + μ 1 * (s.v₁ : Point) m + μ 2 * (s.v₂ : Point) m :=
    fun μ => baryPt_coord s m μ
  
  have hΛ3 : (0 : ℚ) < Λ ^ 3 := by positivity
  
  set e : Fin 3 → ℚ := fun j => n ⬝ᵥ ((Vert s j) - q) with he
  have hEe : ∀ j : Fin 3, Eval nO qO vs (j : ℕ) = Λ ^ 3 * e j := hE
  rcases member_fracVal_cases (m : Fin 3) vs signs nO qO p hsm hp with
    ⟨j, hj3, hsj, hpeq⟩ | ⟨k, hk3, hguard, hden, hpeq⟩
  · 
    have hEval : Eval nO qO vs j = 0 :=
      ((eval_sign_iff vs signs nO qO j (hsm j hj3)).1).mp hsj
    have hΛ3' : (Λ : ℚ) ^ 3 ≠ 0 := by positivity
    have hej : n ⬝ᵥ ((Vert s ⟨j, hj3⟩) - q) = 0 := by
      have := hE ⟨j, hj3⟩
      simp only [hEval] at this
      rcases mul_eq_zero.mp this.symm with h | h
      · exact absurd h hΛ3'
      · exact h
    have hCj : Cval m vs j = Λ * (Vert s ⟨j, hj3⟩) m := hC ⟨j, hj3⟩
    interval_cases j
    · refine ⟨![1, 0, 0], by intro i; fin_cases i <;> simp, by norm_num,
        Or.inl ⟨0, ⟨by simp, fun i hi => by fin_cases i <;> first | exact absurd rfl hi | rfl⟩, hsj⟩,
        ?_, ?_⟩
      · rw [hplane _ (by norm_num)]; simpa using hej
      · rw [hpeq, hcoord, hCj]; simp
    · refine ⟨![0, 1, 0], by intro i; fin_cases i <;> simp, by norm_num,
        Or.inl ⟨1, ⟨by simp, fun i hi => by fin_cases i <;> first | exact absurd rfl hi | rfl⟩, hsj⟩,
        ?_, ?_⟩
      · rw [hplane _ (by norm_num)]; simpa using hej
      · rw [hpeq, hcoord, hCj]; simp
    · refine ⟨![0, 0, 1], by intro i; fin_cases i <;> simp, by norm_num,
        Or.inl ⟨2, ⟨by simp, fun i hi => by fin_cases i <;> first | exact absurd rfl hi | rfl⟩, hsj⟩,
        ?_, ?_⟩
      · rw [hplane _ (by norm_num)]; simpa using hej
      · rw [hpeq, hcoord, hCj]; simp
  · 
    have hk1 : (k + 1) % 3 < 3 := Nat.mod_lt _ (by norm_num)
    have hsgnk := eval_sign_iff vs signs nO qO k (hsm k hk3)
    have hsgnk1 := eval_sign_iff vs signs nO qO ((k+1)%3) (hsm ((k+1)%3) hk1)
    have hopp : (Eval nO qO vs k < 0 ∧ 0 < Eval nO qO vs ((k+1)%3)) ∨
        (0 < Eval nO qO vs k ∧ Eval nO qO vs ((k+1)%3) < 0) := by
      rcases hguard with ⟨h1, h2⟩ | ⟨h1, h2⟩
      · exact Or.inl ⟨hsgnk.2.1.mp h1, hsgnk1.2.2.mp h2⟩
      · exact Or.inr ⟨hsgnk.2.2.mp h1, hsgnk1.2.1.mp h2⟩
    
    have hsk0 : signs.getD k 0 ≠ 0 := by
      rcases hguard with ⟨h1, _⟩ | ⟨h1, _⟩ <;> omega
    have hsk10 : signs.getD ((k+1)%3) 0 ≠ 0 := by
      rcases hguard with ⟨_, h2⟩ | ⟨_, h2⟩ <;> omega
    interval_cases k <;>
      simp only [show ((0:ℕ)+1)%3 = 1 from rfl, show ((1:ℕ)+1)%3 = 2 from rfl,
        show ((2:ℕ)+1)%3 = 0 from rfl] at hopp hpeq hsk0 hsk10 hden ⊢
    · 
      obtain ⟨hμa, hμb, hμsum, hpl, hpr⟩ := mix_two Λ
        (Eval nO qO vs 0) (Eval nO qO vs 1) (Cval m vs 0) (Cval m vs 1)
        (n ⬝ᵥ ((Vert s 0) - q)) (n ⬝ᵥ ((Vert s 1) - q)) ((Vert s 0) m) ((Vert s 1) m)
        hΛ3 (hE 0) (hE 1) (hC 0) (hC 1) hopp
      set μa := -Eval nO qO vs 1 / (Eval nO qO vs 0 - Eval nO qO vs 1) with hμadef
      set μb := Eval nO qO vs 0 / (Eval nO qO vs 0 - Eval nO qO vs 1) with hμbdef
      have hsum' : μa + μb + 0 = 1 := by rw [add_zero]; exact hμsum
      have hg0 : Eval nO qO vs 0 = Λ ^ 3 * (n ⬝ᵥ ((s.v₀ : Point) - q)) := hE 0
      have hg1 : Eval nO qO vs 1 = Λ ^ 3 * (n ⬝ᵥ ((s.v₁ : Point) - q)) := hE 1
      have hede : (n ⬝ᵥ ((s.v₀ : Point) - q)) - (n ⬝ᵥ ((s.v₁ : Point) - q)) ≠ 0 := by
        intro h; apply hden; rw [hg0, hg1, ← mul_sub, h, mul_zero]
      have hμaeq : μa = -(n ⬝ᵥ ((s.v₁ : Point) - q)) / ((n ⬝ᵥ ((s.v₀ : Point) - q)) - (n ⬝ᵥ ((s.v₁ : Point) - q))) := by
        rw [hμadef, hg0, hg1, ← mul_sub, ← mul_neg, mul_div_mul_left _ _ (by positivity : (Λ:ℚ)^3 ≠ 0)]
      refine ⟨![μa, μb, 0], by intro i; fin_cases i <;> simp [hμa.le, hμb.le],
        by simpa using hsum',
        Or.inr ⟨2, ⟨by simp,
          fun i hi => by fin_cases i <;> first | exact absurd rfl hi | exact hμa | exact hμb⟩,
          ?_, ?_⟩, ?_, ?_⟩
      · intro i hi; fin_cases i <;> first | exact absurd rfl hi | exact hsk0 | exact hsk10
      · 
        intro ν hνsum hν2 hνpl
        rw [hplane _ hνsum, hν2] at hνpl
        have hν1 : ν 1 = 1 - ν 0 := by rw [hν2] at hνsum; linarith
        have heq0 : ν 0 = μa := by
          rw [hμaeq, eq_div_iff hede]
          rw [hν1] at hνpl; nlinarith [hνpl]
        have heq1 : ν 1 = μb := by rw [hν1, heq0]; linarith
        funext i; fin_cases i
        · exact heq0
        · exact heq1
        · exact hν2
      · rw [hplane _ (by simpa using hsum')]
        simp only [Matrix.cons_val_zero, Matrix.cons_val_one, Matrix.head_cons,
          Matrix.cons_val_two, Matrix.tail_cons, Vert, zero_mul, add_zero]
        simpa only [Vert] using hpl
      · rw [hpeq, hcoord]
        simp only [Matrix.cons_val_zero, Matrix.cons_val_one, Matrix.head_cons,
          Matrix.cons_val_two, Matrix.tail_cons, Vert, zero_mul, add_zero]
        simpa only [Vert] using hpr
    · 
      obtain ⟨hμa, hμb, hμsum, hpl, hpr⟩ := mix_two Λ
        (Eval nO qO vs 1) (Eval nO qO vs 2) (Cval m vs 1) (Cval m vs 2)
        (n ⬝ᵥ ((Vert s 1) - q)) (n ⬝ᵥ ((Vert s 2) - q)) ((Vert s 1) m) ((Vert s 2) m)
        hΛ3 (hE 1) (hE 2) (hC 1) (hC 2) hopp
      set μa := -Eval nO qO vs 2 / (Eval nO qO vs 1 - Eval nO qO vs 2) with hμadef
      set μb := Eval nO qO vs 1 / (Eval nO qO vs 1 - Eval nO qO vs 2) with hμbdef
      have hsum' : (0:ℚ) + μa + μb = 1 := by rw [zero_add]; exact hμsum
      have hg1 : Eval nO qO vs 1 = Λ ^ 3 * (n ⬝ᵥ ((s.v₁ : Point) - q)) := hE 1
      have hg2 : Eval nO qO vs 2 = Λ ^ 3 * (n ⬝ᵥ ((s.v₂ : Point) - q)) := hE 2
      have hede : (n ⬝ᵥ ((s.v₁ : Point) - q)) - (n ⬝ᵥ ((s.v₂ : Point) - q)) ≠ 0 := by
        intro h; apply hden; rw [hg1, hg2, ← mul_sub, h, mul_zero]
      have hμaeq : μa = -(n ⬝ᵥ ((s.v₂ : Point) - q)) / ((n ⬝ᵥ ((s.v₁ : Point) - q)) - (n ⬝ᵥ ((s.v₂ : Point) - q))) := by
        rw [hμadef, hg1, hg2, ← mul_sub, ← mul_neg, mul_div_mul_left _ _ (by positivity : (Λ:ℚ)^3 ≠ 0)]
      refine ⟨![0, μa, μb], by intro i; fin_cases i <;> simp [hμa.le, hμb.le],
        by simpa using hsum',
        Or.inr ⟨0, ⟨by simp,
          fun i hi => by fin_cases i <;> first | exact absurd rfl hi | exact hμa | exact hμb⟩,
          ?_, ?_⟩, ?_, ?_⟩
      · intro i hi; fin_cases i <;> first | exact absurd rfl hi | exact hsk0 | exact hsk10
      · intro ν hνsum hν0 hνpl
        rw [hplane _ hνsum, hν0] at hνpl
        have hν2 : ν 2 = 1 - ν 1 := by rw [hν0] at hνsum; linarith
        have heq1 : ν 1 = μa := by
          rw [hμaeq, eq_div_iff hede]
          rw [hν2] at hνpl; nlinarith [hνpl]
        have heq2 : ν 2 = μb := by rw [hν2, heq1]; linarith
        funext i; fin_cases i
        · exact hν0
        · exact heq1
        · exact heq2
      · rw [hplane _ (by simpa using hsum')]
        simp only [Matrix.cons_val_zero, Matrix.cons_val_one, Matrix.head_cons,
          Matrix.cons_val_two, Matrix.tail_cons, Vert, zero_mul, zero_add]
        simpa only [Vert] using hpl
      · rw [hpeq, hcoord]
        simp only [Matrix.cons_val_zero, Matrix.cons_val_one, Matrix.head_cons,
          Matrix.cons_val_two, Matrix.tail_cons, Vert, zero_mul, zero_add]
        simpa only [Vert] using hpr
    · 
      obtain ⟨hμa, hμb, hμsum, hpl, hpr⟩ := mix_two Λ
        (Eval nO qO vs 2) (Eval nO qO vs 0) (Cval m vs 2) (Cval m vs 0)
        (n ⬝ᵥ ((Vert s 2) - q)) (n ⬝ᵥ ((Vert s 0) - q)) ((Vert s 2) m) ((Vert s 0) m)
        hΛ3 (hE 2) (hE 0) (hC 2) (hC 0) hopp
      set μa := -Eval nO qO vs 0 / (Eval nO qO vs 2 - Eval nO qO vs 0) with hμadef
      set μb := Eval nO qO vs 2 / (Eval nO qO vs 2 - Eval nO qO vs 0) with hμbdef
      have hsum' : μb + 0 + μa = 1 := by rw [add_zero, add_comm]; exact hμsum
      have hg2 : Eval nO qO vs 2 = Λ ^ 3 * (n ⬝ᵥ ((s.v₂ : Point) - q)) := hE 2
      have hg0 : Eval nO qO vs 0 = Λ ^ 3 * (n ⬝ᵥ ((s.v₀ : Point) - q)) := hE 0
      have hede : (n ⬝ᵥ ((s.v₂ : Point) - q)) - (n ⬝ᵥ ((s.v₀ : Point) - q)) ≠ 0 := by
        intro h; apply hden; rw [hg2, hg0, ← mul_sub, h, mul_zero]
      have hμaeq : μa = -(n ⬝ᵥ ((s.v₀ : Point) - q)) / ((n ⬝ᵥ ((s.v₂ : Point) - q)) - (n ⬝ᵥ ((s.v₀ : Point) - q))) := by
        rw [hμadef, hg2, hg0, ← mul_sub, ← mul_neg, mul_div_mul_left _ _ (by positivity : (Λ:ℚ)^3 ≠ 0)]
      refine ⟨![μb, 0, μa], by intro i; fin_cases i <;> simp [hμa.le, hμb.le],
        by simpa using hsum',
        Or.inr ⟨1, ⟨by simp,
          fun i hi => by fin_cases i <;> first | exact absurd rfl hi | exact hμb | exact hμa⟩,
          ?_, ?_⟩, ?_, ?_⟩
      · intro i hi; fin_cases i <;> first | exact absurd rfl hi | exact hsk10 | exact hsk0
      · intro ν hνsum hν1 hνpl
        rw [hplane _ hνsum, hν1] at hνpl
        have hν0 : ν 0 = 1 - ν 2 := by rw [hν1] at hνsum; linarith
        have heq2 : ν 2 = μa := by
          rw [hμaeq, eq_div_iff hede]
          rw [hν0] at hνpl; nlinarith [hνpl]
        have heq0 : ν 0 = μb := by rw [hν0, heq2]; linarith
        funext i; fin_cases i
        · exact heq0
        · exact hν1
        · exact heq2
      · rw [hplane _ (by simpa using hsum')]
        simp only [Matrix.cons_val_zero, Matrix.cons_val_one, Matrix.head_cons,
          Matrix.cons_val_two, Matrix.tail_cons, Vert, zero_mul, add_zero, mul_zero]
        simp only [Vert, Matrix.cons_val_zero, Matrix.cons_val_two, Matrix.tail_cons,
          Matrix.head_cons] at hpl
        linarith [hpl]
      · rw [hpeq, hcoord]
        simp only [Matrix.cons_val_zero, Matrix.cons_val_one, Matrix.head_cons,
          Matrix.cons_val_two, Matrix.tail_cons, Vert, zero_mul, add_zero, mul_zero]
        simp only [Vert, Matrix.cons_val_zero, Matrix.cons_val_two, Matrix.tail_cons,
          Matrix.head_cons] at hpr
        rw [mul_add]; linarith [hpr]

name: kind_some_zero
statement:
theorem kind_some_zero {μ : Fin 3 → ℚ}
    (hkind : (∃ j : Fin 3, μ j = 1 ∧ ∀ i, i ≠ j → μ i = 0) ∨
      (∃ j : Fin 3, μ j = 0 ∧ ∀ i, i ≠ j → 0 < μ i)) :
    μ 0 = 0 ∨ μ 1 = 0 ∨ μ 2 = 0
proof:
:= by
  rcases hkind with ⟨j, _, hoff⟩ | ⟨j, hj0, _⟩
  · 
    fin_cases j
    · exact Or.inr (Or.inl (hoff 1 (by decide)))
    · exact Or.inl (hoff 0 (by decide))
    · exact Or.inl (hoff 0 (by decide))
  · 
    fin_cases j
    · exact Or.inl hj0
    · exact Or.inr (Or.inl hj0)
    · exact Or.inr (Or.inr hj0)

name: bary_proj_bound
statement:
theorem bary_proj_bound (s : Triangle) (m : Fin 3) (n q : Point) (Λ : ℚ)
    (vs : Array I3) (signs : Array Int) (nO qO : I3) (lo hi : Int × Int)
    (hC : ∀ j : Fin 3, Cval m vs (j : ℕ) = Λ * (Vert s j) m)
    (hE : ∀ j : Fin 3, Eval nO qO vs (j : ℕ) = Λ ^ 3 * (n ⬝ᵥ ((Vert s j) - q)))
    (hΛ3 : (0:ℚ) < Λ ^ 3)
    (hsm : ∀ k, k < 3 → signs.getD k 0 = Int.sign (dotI nO (subI (vs.getD k default) qO)))
    (hpos : ∀ p ∈ collectParams (m : ℕ) vs signs nO qO, 0 < p.2)
    (hIown : fracInterval (collectParams (m : ℕ) vs signs nO qO) = some (lo, hi))
    (μ : Fin 3 → ℚ) (hnn : ∀ j, 0 ≤ μ j) (hsum : μ 0 + μ 1 + μ 2 = 1)
    (hplane : n ⬝ᵥ (baryPt s μ - q) = 0) :
    fracVal lo ≤ Λ * (baryPt s μ) m ∧ Λ * (baryPt s μ) m ≤ fracVal hi
proof:
:= by
  
  have hfeas : μ 0 * Eval nO qO vs 0 + μ 1 * Eval nO qO vs 1 + μ 2 * Eval nO qO vs 2 = 0 := by
    have hpl := baryPt_plane s n q μ hsum
    rw [hplane] at hpl
    have e0 := hE 0; have e1 := hE 1; have e2 := hE 2
    simp only [Vert, Fin.isValue, Fin.val_zero, Fin.val_one, Fin.val_two,
      Matrix.cons_val_zero, Matrix.cons_val_one, Matrix.head_cons,
      Matrix.cons_val_two, Matrix.tail_cons] at e0 e1 e2 hpl
    rw [e0, e1, e2]; nlinarith [hpl, hΛ3]
  
  have hproj : Λ * (baryPt s μ) m
      = μ 0 * Cval m vs 0 + μ 1 * Cval m vs 1 + μ 2 * Cval m vs 2 := by
    have hco := baryPt_coord s m μ
    have c0 := hC 0; have c1 := hC 1; have c2 := hC 2
    simp only [Vert, Fin.isValue, Fin.val_zero, Fin.val_one, Fin.val_two,
      Matrix.cons_val_zero, Matrix.cons_val_one, Matrix.head_cons,
      Matrix.cons_val_two, Matrix.tail_cons] at c0 c1 c2
    rw [hco, c0, c1, c2]; ring
  
  have hub : ∀ p ∈ collectParams (m : ℕ) vs signs nO qO, fracVal p ≤ fracVal hi :=
    fun p hp => (fracInterval_mem_bound _ hpos lo hi hIown p hp).2
  have hlb : ∀ p ∈ collectParams (m : ℕ) vs signs nO qO, fracVal lo ≤ fracVal p :=
    fun p hp => (fracInterval_mem_bound _ hpos lo hi hIown p hp).1
  constructor
  · rw [hproj]
    exact proj_ge_lb m vs signs nO qO (μ 0) (μ 1) (μ 2) (fracVal lo)
      hsm (hnn 0) (hnn 1) (hnn 2) hsum hfeas hlb
  · rw [hproj]
    exact proj_le_ub m vs signs nO qO (μ 0) (μ 1) (μ 2) (fracVal hi)
      hsm (hnn 0) (hnn 1) (hnn 2) hsum hfeas hub

name: axisSlab_complete
statement:
private theorem axisSlab_complete (dα xα loα hiα t pα : ℚ)
    (hp : pα = xα + t * dα) (hlo : loα ≤ pα) (hhi : pα ≤ hiα) :
    (Impl.BVH.axisSlab dα xα loα hiα).ok = true ∧
    0 < (Impl.BVH.axisSlab dα xα loα hiα).den ∧
    ((Impl.BVH.axisSlab dα xα loα hiα).bdd = true →
      (Impl.BVH.axisSlab dα xα loα hiα).loN ≤ t * (Impl.BVH.axisSlab dα xα loα hiα).den ∧
      t * (Impl.BVH.axisSlab dα xα loα hiα).den ≤ (Impl.BVH.axisSlab dα xα loα hiα).hiN)
proof:
:= by
  unfold Impl.BVH.axisSlab
  have hloHi : loα ≤ hiα := le_trans hlo hhi
  by_cases hd : dα = 0
  · subst hd
    simp only [if_pos rfl]
    refine ⟨?_, by norm_num, by simp⟩
    simp only [mul_zero, add_zero] at hp; subst hp; simp; exact ⟨hlo, hhi⟩
  · simp only [if_neg hd]
    by_cases hpos : 0 < dα
    · simp only [if_pos hpos, decide_eq_true_eq, one_mul]
      refine ⟨hloHi, by simpa using hpos, fun _ => ⟨?_, ?_⟩⟩
      · refine rmin_le_of (Or.inl ?_); nlinarith [hp, hlo]
      · refine le_rmax_of (Or.inr ?_); nlinarith [hp, hhi]
    · have hneg : dα < 0 := lt_of_le_of_ne (not_lt.mp hpos) hd
      have hdf : ¬ (decide (0 < dα) = true) := by simp [hpos]
      simp only [if_neg hdf, decide_eq_true_eq, if_neg hpos]
      refine ⟨hloHi, by nlinarith, fun _ => ⟨?_, ?_⟩⟩
      · refine rmin_le_of (Or.inr ?_); nlinarith [hp, hhi]
      · refine le_rmax_of (Or.inl ?_); nlinarith [hp, hlo]

name: rayLineMeetsBox_of_mem_line
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨hsxok, hsxd, hsxi⟩ := axisSlab_complete d.x x.x b.lox b.hix t px hpx hbx.1 hbx.2
  obtain ⟨hsyok, hsyd, hsyi⟩ := axisSlab_complete d.y x.y b.loy b.hiy t py hpy hby.1 hby.2
  obtain ⟨hszok, hszd, hszi⟩ := axisSlab_complete d.z x.z b.loz b.hiz t pz hpz hbz.1 hbz.2
  set sx := Impl.BVH.axisSlab d.x x.x b.lox b.hix with hsxdef
  set sy := Impl.BVH.axisSlab d.y x.y b.loy b.hiy with hsydef
  set sz := Impl.BVH.axisSlab d.z x.z b.loz b.hiz with hszdef
  have lehi : ∀ (s s' : Impl.BVH.AxisSlab),
      0 < s.den → 0 < s'.den →
      (s.bdd = true → s.loN ≤ t * s.den ∧ t * s.den ≤ s.hiN) →
      (s'.bdd = true → s'.loN ≤ t * s'.den ∧ t * s'.den ≤ s'.hiN) →
      Impl.BVH.slabLeHi s s' = true := by
    intro s s' hsd hs'd hsi hs'i
    unfold Impl.BVH.slabLeHi
    split
    · rename_i hbdd
      rw [Bool.and_eq_true] at hbdd
      refine decide_eq_true ?_
      have h1 := (hsi hbdd.1).1
      have h2 := (hs'i hbdd.2).2
      have e1 : s.loN * s'.den ≤ (t * s.den) * s'.den :=
        mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right h1 (le_of_lt hs'd)
      have e2 : (t * s'.den) * s.den ≤ s'.hiN * s.den :=
        mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right h2 (le_of_lt hsd)
      nlinarith [e1, e2]
    · rfl
  rw [Impl.BVH.rayLineMeetsBox]
  simp only [Bool.and_eq_true]
  refine ⟨⟨⟨⟨⟨⟨⟨⟨hsxok, hsyok⟩, hszok⟩, ?_⟩, ?_⟩, ?_⟩, ?_⟩, ?_⟩, ?_⟩ <;>
    first
    | exact lehi sx sy hsxd hsyd hsxi hsyi
    | exact lehi sx sz hsxd hszd hsxi hszi
    | exact lehi sy sx hsyd hsxd hsyi hsxi
    | exact lehi sy sz hsyd hszd hsyi hszi
    | exact lehi sz sx hszd hsxd hszi hsxi
    | exact lehi sz sy hszd hsyd hszi hsyi

name: rayLineMeetsBoxFwd_of_mem_ray
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨hsxok, hsxd, hsxi⟩ := axisSlab_complete d.x x.x b.lox b.hix t px hpx hbx.1 hbx.2
  obtain ⟨hsyok, hsyd, hsyi⟩ := axisSlab_complete d.y x.y b.loy b.hiy t py hpy hby.1 hby.2
  obtain ⟨hszok, hszd, hszi⟩ := axisSlab_complete d.z x.z b.loz b.hiz t pz hpz hbz.1 hbz.2
  set sx := Impl.BVH.axisSlab d.x x.x b.lox b.hix with hsxdef
  set sy := Impl.BVH.axisSlab d.y x.y b.loy b.hiy with hsydef
  set sz := Impl.BVH.axisSlab d.z x.z b.loz b.hiz with hszdef
  have lehi : ∀ (s s' : Impl.BVH.AxisSlab),
      0 < s.den → 0 < s'.den →
      (s.bdd = true → s.loN ≤ t * s.den ∧ t * s.den ≤ s.hiN) →
      (s'.bdd = true → s'.loN ≤ t * s'.den ∧ t * s'.den ≤ s'.hiN) →
      Impl.BVH.slabLeHi s s' = true := by
    intro s s' hsd hs'd hsi hs'i
    unfold Impl.BVH.slabLeHi
    split
    · rename_i hbdd
      rw [Bool.and_eq_true] at hbdd
      refine decide_eq_true ?_
      have h1 := (hsi hbdd.1).1
      have h2 := (hs'i hbdd.2).2
      have e1 : s.loN * s'.den ≤ (t * s.den) * s'.den :=
        mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right h1 (le_of_lt hs'd)
      have e2 : (t * s'.den) * s.den ≤ s'.hiN * s.den :=
        mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right h2 (le_of_lt hsd)
      nlinarith [e1, e2]
    · rfl
  have nonneg : ∀ (s : Impl.BVH.AxisSlab), 0 < s.den →
      (s.bdd = true → s.loN ≤ t * s.den ∧ t * s.den ≤ s.hiN) →
      Impl.BVH.slabNonneg s = true := by
    intro s hsd hsi
    unfold Impl.BVH.slabNonneg
    split
    · rename_i hbdd
      refine decide_eq_true ?_
      have h2 := (hsi hbdd).2
      have h0 : (0:ℚ) ≤ t * s.den := mul_nonneg ht (le_of_lt hsd)
      linarith [h2, h0]
    · rfl
  rw [Impl.BVH.rayLineMeetsBoxFwd]
  simp only [Bool.and_eq_true]
  refine ⟨⟨⟨⟨⟨⟨⟨⟨⟨⟨⟨hsxok, hsyok⟩, hszok⟩, ?_⟩, ?_⟩, ?_⟩, ?_⟩, ?_⟩, ?_⟩, ?_⟩, ?_⟩, ?_⟩ <;>
    first
    | exact lehi sx sy hsxd hsyd hsxi hsyi
    | exact lehi sx sz hsxd hszd hsxi hszi
    | exact lehi sy sx hsyd hsxd hsyi hsxi
    | exact lehi sy sz hsyd hszd hsyi hszi
    | exact lehi sz sx hszd hsxd hszi hsxi
    | exact lehi sz sy hszd hsyd hszi hsyi
    | exact nonneg sx hsxd hsxi
    | exact nonneg sy hsyd hsyi
    | exact nonneg sz hszd hszi

name: rayQuery_toList_props
statement:

name: rmin_le_left
statement: private theorem rmin_le_left (a b : ℚ) : Impl.MeshIntersect.rmin a b ≤ a
proof:
:= by
  unfold Impl.MeshIntersect.rmin; split <;> [skip; (rename_i h; linarith)]; rfl

name: rmin_le_right
statement: private theorem rmin_le_right (a b : ℚ) : Impl.MeshIntersect.rmin a b ≤ b
proof:
:= by
  unfold Impl.MeshIntersect.rmin; split <;> [(rename_i h; exact h); rfl]

name: left_le_rmax
statement: private theorem left_le_rmax (a b : ℚ) : a ≤ Impl.MeshIntersect.rmax a b
proof:
:= by

name: convex_coord_ge
statement: private theorem convex_coord_ge (k : Fin 3) (c : ℚ) : Convex ℚ {y : Point | c ≤ y k}
proof:
:= by
  intro x hx y hy a b ha hb hab
  simp only [Set.mem_setOf_eq] at hx hy ⊢
  have hk : (a • x + b • y) k = a * x k + b * y k := by
    simp [Pi.add_apply, Pi.smul_apply]
  rw [hk]
  have h1 : a * c ≤ a * x k := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hx ha
  have h2 : b * c ≤ b * y k := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hy hb
  have hc : a * c + b * c = c := by rw [← add_mul, hab, one_mul]
  linarith [h1, h2, hc]

name: convex_coord_le
statement: private theorem convex_coord_le (k : Fin 3) (c : ℚ) : Convex ℚ {y : Point | y k ≤ c}
proof:
:= by
  intro x hx y hy a b ha hb hab
  simp only [Set.mem_setOf_eq] at hx hy ⊢
  have hk : (a • x + b • y) k = a * x k + b * y k := by
    simp [Pi.add_apply, Pi.smul_apply]
  rw [hk]
  have h1 : a * x k ≤ a * c := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hx ha
  have h2 : b * y k ≤ b * c := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hy hb
  have hc : a * c + b * c = c := by rw [← add_mul, hab, one_mul]
  linarith [h1, h2, hc]

name: coord_mem_of_convexHull
statement:
private theorem coord_mem_of_convexHull (k : Fin 3) (a b c : Point) {x : Point}
    (hx : x ∈ convexHull ℚ ({a, b, c} : Set Point)) :
    Impl.MeshIntersect.rmin (a k) (Impl.MeshIntersect.rmin (b k) (c k)) ≤ x k ∧
    x k ≤ Impl.MeshIntersect.rmax (a k) (Impl.MeshIntersect.rmax (b k) (c k))
proof:
:= by
  set lo := Impl.MeshIntersect.rmin (a k) (Impl.MeshIntersect.rmin (b k) (c k)) with hlo
  set hi := Impl.MeshIntersect.rmax (a k) (Impl.MeshIntersect.rmax (b k) (c k)) with hhi
  have hla : lo ≤ a k := rmin_le_left _ _
  have hlb : lo ≤ b k := le_trans (rmin_le_right _ _) (rmin_le_left _ _)
  have hlc : lo ≤ c k := le_trans (rmin_le_right _ _) (rmin_le_right _ _)
  have hah : a k ≤ hi := left_le_rmax _ _
  have hbh : b k ≤ hi := le_trans (left_le_rmax _ _) (right_le_rmax _ _)
  have hch : c k ≤ hi := le_trans (right_le_rmax _ _) (right_le_rmax _ _)
  refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
  · have hsub : ({a, b, c} : Set Point) ⊆ {y : Point | lo ≤ y k} := by
      intro y hy
      simp only [Set.mem_insert_iff, Set.mem_singleton_iff] at hy
      rcases hy with rfl | rfl | rfl
      · exact hla
      · exact hlb
      · exact hlc
    exact convexHull_min hsub (convex_coord_ge k lo) hx
  · have hsub : ({a, b, c} : Set Point) ⊆ {y : Point | y k ≤ hi} := by
      intro y hy
      simp only [Set.mem_insert_iff, Set.mem_singleton_iff] at hy
      rcases hy with rfl | rfl | rfl
      · exact hah
      · exact hbh
      · exact hch
    exact convexHull_min hsub (convex_coord_le k hi) hx

name: tri_coord_mem_faceBox
statement:
theorem tri_coord_mem_faceBox {t : Triangle} {x : Point}
    (hx : x ∈ triangleSet t) :
    ((faceBoxOf (pfaceOf t)).lox ≤ x 0 ∧ x 0 ≤ (faceBoxOf (pfaceOf t)).hix) ∧
    ((faceBoxOf (pfaceOf t)).loy ≤ x 1 ∧ x 1 ≤ (faceBoxOf (pfaceOf t)).hiy) ∧
    ((faceBoxOf (pfaceOf t)).loz ≤ x 2 ∧ x 2 ≤ (faceBoxOf (pfaceOf t)).hiz)
proof:
:= by
  have hbox : faceBoxOf (pfaceOf t)
      = ⟨(pminS (ofPoint t.v₀) (pminS (ofPoint t.v₁) (ofPoint t.v₂))).x,
         (pminS (ofPoint t.v₀) (pminS (ofPoint t.v₁) (ofPoint t.v₂))).y,
         (pminS (ofPoint t.v₀) (pminS (ofPoint t.v₁) (ofPoint t.v₂))).z,
         (pmaxS (ofPoint t.v₀) (pmaxS (ofPoint t.v₁) (ofPoint t.v₂))).x,
         (pmaxS (ofPoint t.v₀) (pmaxS (ofPoint t.v₁) (ofPoint t.v₂))).y,
         (pmaxS (ofPoint t.v₀) (pmaxS (ofPoint t.v₁) (ofPoint t.v₂))).z⟩ := rfl
  rw [hbox]
  have hx' : x ∈ convexHull ℚ ({t.v₀, t.v₁, t.v₂} : Set Point) := hx
  have e0 : (ofPoint t.v₀).x = t.v₀ 0 := rfl
  have e1 : (ofPoint t.v₀).y = t.v₀ 1 := rfl
  have e2 : (ofPoint t.v₀).z = t.v₀ 2 := rfl
  refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · simpa only [pminS, pmaxS, ofPoint] using coord_mem_of_convexHull 0 t.v₀ t.v₁ t.v₂ hx'
  · simpa only [pminS, pmaxS, ofPoint] using coord_mem_of_convexHull 1 t.v₀ t.v₁ t.v₂ hx'
  · simpa only [pminS, pmaxS, ofPoint] using coord_mem_of_convexHull 2 t.v₀ t.v₁ t.v₂ hx'

name: prepare_getElem_eq
statement:
theorem prepare_getElem_eq (MB : Mesh) (u : Fin MB.size) :
    (prepare (materialize MB))[u.val]'(by rw [prepare_size]; exact u.isLt) = pfaceOf MB[u]
proof:
:= by
  simp only [prepare, materialize, pfaceOf, Array.getElem_map, mkVtx, Fin.getElem_fin]

name: faceBox_map_getElem
statement:
theorem faceBox_map_getElem (MB : Mesh) (u : Fin MB.size) :
    ((prepare (materialize MB)).map (fun f => faceBoxOf f))[u.val]'
        (by rw [Array.size_map, prepare_size]; exact u.isLt)
      = faceBoxOf (pfaceOf MB[u])
proof:
:= by
  rw [Array.getElem_map]
  congr 1
  exact prepare_getElem_eq MB u

name: tri_meets_box
statement:
theorem tri_meets_box {MB : Mesh} (_hnpo : NoPlaneThroughOrigin MB) (u : Fin MB.size)
    (Q d : Point) (s : ℚ) (hmem : lineAt Q d s ∈ triangleSet MB[u]) :
    Impl.BVH.rayLineMeetsBox ⟨(ofPoint Q).x, (ofPoint Q).y, (ofPoint Q).z⟩
      ⟨(ofPoint d).x, (ofPoint d).y, (ofPoint d).z⟩
      (((prepare (materialize MB)).map (fun f => faceBoxOf f))[u.val]'
        (by rw [Array.size_map, prepare_size]; exact u.isLt)) = true
proof:
:= by
  rw [faceBox_map_getElem]
  obtain ⟨hx, hy, hz⟩ := tri_coord_mem_faceBox hmem
  exact rayLineMeetsBox_of_mem_line (t := s)
    (px := lineAt Q d s 0) (py := lineAt Q d s 1) (pz := lineAt Q d s 2)
    (by simp [ofPoint, lineAt]) (by simp [ofPoint, lineAt]) (by simp [ofPoint, lineAt]) hx hy hz

name: tri_meets_box_fwd
statement:
theorem tri_meets_box_fwd {MB : Mesh} (u : Fin MB.size)
    (Q d : Point) (s : ℚ) (hs : 0 ≤ s) (hmem : lineAt Q d s ∈ triangleSet MB[u]) :
    Impl.BVH.rayLineMeetsBoxFwd ⟨(ofPoint Q).x, (ofPoint Q).y, (ofPoint Q).z⟩
      ⟨(ofPoint d).x, (ofPoint d).y, (ofPoint d).z⟩
      (((prepare (materialize MB)).map (fun f => faceBoxOf f))[u.val]'
        (by rw [Array.size_map, prepare_size]; exact u.isLt)) = true
proof:
:= by
  rw [faceBox_map_getElem]
  obtain ⟨hx, hy, hz⟩ := tri_coord_mem_faceBox hmem
  exact rayLineMeetsBoxFwd_of_mem_ray (t := s) hs
    (px := lineAt Q d s 0) (py := lineAt Q d s 1) (pz := lineAt Q d s 2)
    (by simp [ofPoint, lineAt]) (by simp [ofPoint, lineAt]) (by simp [ofPoint, lineAt]) hx hy hz

name: sign_beq_one
statement: theorem sign_beq_one (a : Int) : (Int.sign a == 1) = decide (0 < a)
proof:
:= by
  rcases lt_trichotomy a 0 with h | h | h
  · rw [Int.sign_eq_neg_one_of_neg h]; simp [asymm h]
  · subst h; simp
  · rw [Int.sign_eq_one_of_pos h]; simp [h]

name: sign_beq_neg_one
statement: theorem sign_beq_neg_one (a : Int) : (Int.sign a == -1) = decide (a < 0)
proof:
:= by
  rcases lt_trichotomy a 0 with h | h | h
  · rw [Int.sign_eq_neg_one_of_neg h]; simp [h]
  · subst h; simp
  · rw [Int.sign_eq_one_of_pos h]; simp [asymm h]

name: sign_beq_zero
statement: theorem sign_beq_zero (a : Int) : (Int.sign a == 0) = decide (a = 0)
proof:
:= by
  rcases lt_trichotomy a 0 with h | h | h
  · rw [Int.sign_eq_neg_one_of_neg h]; simp [h.ne]
  · subst h; simp
  · rw [Int.sign_eq_one_of_pos h]; simp [h.ne']

name: sign_neg_iff
statement: theorem sign_neg_iff (a : Int) : Int.sign a < 0 ↔ a < 0
proof:
:= by
  rcases lt_trichotomy a 0 with h | h | h
  · rw [Int.sign_eq_neg_one_of_neg h]; simp [h]
  · subst h; simp
  · rw [Int.sign_eq_one_of_pos h]; simp [asymm h]

name: sign_pos_iff
statement: theorem sign_pos_iff (a : Int) : 0 < Int.sign a ↔ 0 < a
proof:
:= by
  rcases lt_trichotomy a 0 with h | h | h
  · rw [Int.sign_eq_neg_one_of_neg h]; simp [asymm h]
  · subst h; simp
  · rw [Int.sign_eq_one_of_pos h]; simp [h]

name: sign_trisect
statement: theorem sign_trisect (a : Int) : Int.sign a = -1 ∨ Int.sign a = 0 ∨ Int.sign a = 1
proof:
:= by
  rcases lt_trichotomy a 0 with h | h | h
  · exact Or.inl (Int.sign_eq_neg_one_of_neg h)
  · exact Or.inr (Or.inl (by subst h; rfl))
  · exact Or.inr (Or.inr (Int.sign_eq_one_of_pos h))

name: range3
statement: theorem range3 : Array.range 3 = #[0, 1, 2]
proof: := by decide

name: sideVal_eq

name: allStrictOneSide_sign
statement:
theorem allStrictOneSide_sign (a b c : Int) :
    allStrictOneSide #[Int.sign a, Int.sign b, Int.sign c] = strictOneSide3 a b c
proof:

    List.length_singleton, Nat.reduceAdd, List.all_toArray', List.all_cons, List.all_nil,
    Bool.and_true, sign_beq_one, sign_beq_neg_one, Bool.and_assoc]
