name: fracLt_irrefl
statement: theorem fracLt_irrefl (p : Int × Int) : fracLt p p = false
proof:
:= by
  simp [fracLt]

name: fracLt_asymm
statement: theorem fracLt_asymm {p q : Int × Int} (h : fracLt p q = true) : fracLt q p = false
proof:
:= by
  simp only [fracLt, decide_eq_true_eq] at h
  simp only [fracLt, decide_eq_false_iff_not, not_lt]
  exact h.le

name: instanceOK3_none
statement:
theorem instanceOK3_none (sf : Array Int)
    (Iother : Option ((Int × Int) × (Int × Int))) : instanceOK3 sf none Iother = true
proof:
:= by
  unfold instanceOK3
  split <;> rfl

name: instanceOK3_diag
statement:
theorem instanceOK3_diag (sf : Array Int) (p : Int × Int)
    (Iother : Option ((Int × Int) × (Int × Int))) :
    instanceOK3 sf (some (p, p)) Iother = true
proof:
:= by
  unfold instanceOK3
  split
  · rfl
  · match Iother with
    | none => rfl
    | some (ao, bo) =>
      have hl : fracLt (if fracLt p ao = true then ao else p) p = false := by
        by_cases hlt : fracLt p ao = true
        · rw [if_pos hlt]; exact fracLt_asymm hlt
        · rw [if_neg hlt]; exact fracLt_irrefl p
      simp only [hl, Bool.false_and, Bool.not_false, ite_self]

name: instanceOK3_edge
statement:
theorem instanceOK3_edge (sf : Array Int) (If Iother : Option ((Int × Int) × (Int × Int)))
    (h : hasEdgeOnLine sf = true) : instanceOK3 sf If Iother = true
proof:
:= by
  unfold instanceOK3; rw [if_pos h]

name: fracInterval_nil
statement: theorem fracInterval_nil : fracInterval #[] = none
proof: := rfl

name: fracInterval_single
statement: theorem fracInterval_single (p : Int × Int) : fracInterval #[p] = some (p, p)
proof: := rfl

name: fracInterval_of_size_le_one
statement:
theorem fracInterval_of_size_le_one (ps : Array (Int × Int)) (h : ps.size ≤ 1) :
    fracInterval ps = none ∨ ∃ p, fracInterval ps = some (p, p)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨l⟩ := ps
  match l, h with
  | [], _ => exact Or.inl rfl
  | [p], _ => exact Or.inr ⟨p, rfl⟩
  | (_ :: _ :: _), h => simp [Array.size] at h

name: instanceOK3_of_size_le_one
statement:
theorem instanceOK3_of_size_le_one (sf : Array Int) (ps : Array (Int × Int))
    (h : ps.size ≤ 1) (Iother : Option ((Int × Int) × (Int × Int))) :
    instanceOK3 sf (fracInterval ps) Iother = true
proof:
:= by
  rcases fracInterval_of_size_le_one ps h with h1 | ⟨p, h1⟩
  · rw [h1]; exact instanceOK3_none _ _
  · rw [h1]; exact instanceOK3_diag _ _ _

name: instTrivial3_sign
statement:
theorem instTrivial3_sign (a b c : Int) :
    instTrivial3 a b c = instTrivial3 (Int.sign a) (Int.sign b) (Int.sign c)
proof:
:= by
  have hz : ∀ x : Int, (Int.sign x == 0) = (x == 0) := by
    intro x; rw [sign_beq_zero]; rfl
  have hx : ∀ x y : Int, strictCross (Int.sign x) (Int.sign y) = strictCross x y := by
    intro x y
    simp only [strictCross, decide_eq_decide, sign_neg_iff, sign_pos_iff]
  simp only [instTrivial3, hz, hx]

name: instTrivial3_instanceOK_gen
statement:
theorem instTrivial3_instanceOK_gen (axis : Nat) (vs : Array I3) (nO uO : I3)
    (s0 s1 s2 : Int)
    (h0 : s0 = -1 ∨ s0 = 0 ∨ s0 = 1) (h1 : s1 = -1 ∨ s1 = 0 ∨ s1 = 1)
    (h2 : s2 = -1 ∨ s2 = 0 ∨ s2 = 1)
    (h : instTrivial3 s0 s1 s2 = true)
    (Iother : Option ((Int × Int) × (Int × Int))) :
    instanceOK3 #[s0, s1, s2]
      (fracInterval (collectParams axis vs #[s0, s1, s2] nO uO)) Iother = true
proof:
:= by
  rcases h0 with h0 | h0 | h0 <;> rcases h1 with h1 | h1 | h1 <;> rcases h2 with h2 | h2 | h2 <;>
    subst h0 <;> subst h1 <;> subst h2 <;>
    first
      | exact absurd h (by decide)
      | exact instanceOK3_edge _ _ _ (by decide)
      | exact instanceOK3_of_size_le_one _ _ (by simp [collectParams, range3]) _

name: instTrivial3_instanceOK
statement:
theorem instTrivial3_instanceOK (axis : Nat) (vs : Array I3) (nO uO : I3) (a b c : Int)
    (h : instTrivial3 a b c = true) (Iother : Option ((Int × Int) × (Int × Int))) :
    instanceOK3 #[Int.sign a, Int.sign b, Int.sign c]
      (fracInterval (collectParams axis vs #[Int.sign a, Int.sign b, Int.sign c] nO uO))
      Iother = true
proof:
:=
  instTrivial3_instanceOK_gen axis vs nO uO _ _ _ (sign_trisect a) (sign_trisect b)
    (sign_trisect c) (by rwa [← instTrivial3_sign]) Iother

name: triPairOKN_eq
statement:
theorem triPairOKN_eq (s t : FaceH) :
    triPairOKN (faceNormal s) (faceNormal t) s t = triPairOK s t
proof:
:= by
  simp only [triPairOKN, triPairOK, sideSigns_vertsOf, allStrictOneSide_sign, allZero_sign]
  set ns := faceNormal s with hns
  set nt := faceNormal t with hnt
  set σ0 := sideVal ns s.v₀ t.v₀ with hσ0
  set σ1 := sideVal ns s.v₀ t.v₁ with hσ1
  set σ2 := sideVal ns s.v₀ t.v₂ with hσ2
  set τ0 := sideVal nt t.v₀ s.v₀ with hτ0
  set τ1 := sideVal nt t.v₀ s.v₁ with hτ1
  set τ2 := sideVal nt t.v₀ s.v₂ with hτ2
  by_cases h0 : (isZeroI ns || isZeroI nt) = true
  · rw [if_pos h0, if_pos h0]
  rw [if_neg h0, if_neg h0]
  by_cases h1 : strictOneSide3 σ0 σ1 σ2 = true
  · rw [if_pos h1,
      if_pos (show (strictOneSide3 σ0 σ1 σ2 || strictOneSide3 τ0 τ1 τ2) = true by rw [h1]; rfl)]
  rw [if_neg h1]
  by_cases h2 : strictOneSide3 τ0 τ1 τ2 = true
  · rw [if_pos h2,
      if_pos (show (strictOneSide3 σ0 σ1 σ2 || strictOneSide3 τ0 τ1 τ2) = true by rw [h2]; simp)]
  rw [if_neg h2,
    if_neg (show ¬ (strictOneSide3 σ0 σ1 σ2 || strictOneSide3 τ0 τ1 τ2) = true by
      rw [Bool.not_eq_true] at h1 h2; rw [h1, h2]; simp)]
  by_cases h3 : allZero3 σ0 σ1 σ2 = true
  · rw [if_pos h3, if_pos h3]
  rw [if_neg h3, if_neg h3]
  
  by_cases hG : (instTrivial3 τ0 τ1 τ2 && instTrivial3 σ0 σ1 σ2) = true
  · rw [if_pos hG]
    obtain ⟨hτ, hσ⟩ := Bool.and_eq_true .. |>.mp hG
    by_cases hd : isZeroI (crossI ns nt) = true
    · rw [if_pos hd]
    · rw [if_neg hd]
      rw [instTrivial3_instanceOK _ _ _ _ _ _ _ hτ,
          instTrivial3_instanceOK _ _ _ _ _ _ _ hσ]
      rfl
  · rw [if_neg hG]

name: I3.ext'
statement: theorem I3.ext' {a b : I3} (hx : a.x = b.x) (hy : a.y = b.y) (hz : a.z = b.z) : a = b
proof:
:= by
  cases a; cases b; simp_all

name: rescale_v
statement: theorem rescale_v₀ (k : Int) (f : FaceH) : (rescale k f).v₀ = iscale k f.v₀
proof: := rfl

name: rescale_v
statement: theorem rescale_v₁ (k : Int) (f : FaceH) : (rescale k f).v₁ = iscale k f.v₁
proof: := rfl

name: rescale_v
statement: theorem rescale_v₂ (k : Int) (f : FaceH) : (rescale k f).v₂ = iscale k f.v₂
proof: := rfl

name: vertsOf_rescale
statement:
theorem vertsOf_rescale (k : Int) (f : FaceH) :
    vertsOf (rescale k f) = (vertsOf f).map (iscale k)
proof: := rfl

name: I3_default
statement: theorem I3_default : (default : I3) = ⟨0, 0, 0⟩
proof: := rfl

name: iscale_default
statement: theorem iscale_default (k : Int) : iscale k (default : I3) = default
proof:
:= by
  rw [I3_default]; apply I3.ext' <;> simp [iscale]

name: subI_iscale
statement:
theorem subI_iscale (k : Int) (u v : I3) :
    subI (iscale k u) (iscale k v) = iscale k (subI u v)
proof:
:= by
  apply I3.ext' <;> simp [subI, iscale] <;> ring

name: crossI_iscale
statement:
theorem crossI_iscale (a b : Int) (u v : I3) :
    crossI (iscale a u) (iscale b v) = iscale (a * b) (crossI u v)
proof:
:= by
  apply I3.ext' <;> simp [crossI, iscale] <;> ring

name: dotI_iscale
statement:
theorem dotI_iscale (a b : Int) (u v : I3) :
    dotI (iscale a u) (iscale b v) = a * b * dotI u v
proof:
:= by
  simp [dotI, iscale]; ring

name: beq_zero_mul
statement: theorem beq_zero_mul {c : Int} (hc : c ≠ 0) (z : Int) : (c * z == 0) = (z == 0)
proof:
:= by
  rcases eq_or_ne z 0 with h | h
  · simp [h]
  · simp [h, mul_ne_zero hc h]

name: isZeroI_iscale
statement:
theorem isZeroI_iscale {c : Int} (hc : c ≠ 0) (u : I3) :
    isZeroI (iscale c u) = isZeroI u
proof:
:= by
  simp only [isZeroI, iscale, beq_zero_mul hc]

name: coordAt_iscale
statement:
theorem coordAt_iscale (axis : Nat) (k : Int) (v : I3) :
    coordAt axis (iscale k v) = k * coordAt axis v
proof:
:= by
  unfold coordAt; split <;> [skip; split] <;> rfl

name: sign_mul_of_pos
statement:
theorem sign_mul_of_pos {c : Int} (hc : 0 < c) (e : Int) :
    Int.sign (c * e) = Int.sign e
proof:
:= by
  rw [Int.sign_mul, Int.sign_eq_one_of_pos hc, one_mul]

name: faceNormal_rescale
statement:
theorem faceNormal_rescale (k : Int) (f : FaceH) :
    faceNormal (rescale k f) = iscale (k * k) (faceNormal f)
proof:
:= by
  rw [faceNormal, faceNormal, rescale_v₀, rescale_v₁, rescale_v₂, subI_iscale, subI_iscale,
    crossI_iscale]

name: map_iscale_getD
statement:
theorem map_iscale_getD (k : Int) (A : Array I3) (i : Nat) :
    (A.map (iscale k)).getD i default = iscale k (A.getD i default)
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hi : i < A.size
  · have hi' : i < (A.map (iscale k)).size := by simpa using hi
    rw [Array.getD_eq_get?, Array.getElem?_eq_getElem hi', Option.getD_some, Array.getElem_map,
      Array.getD_eq_get?, Array.getElem?_eq_getElem hi, Option.getD_some]
  · have hi' : ¬ i < (A.map (iscale k)).size := by simpa using hi
    rw [Array.getD, Array.getD, dif_neg hi, dif_neg hi', iscale_default]

name: sideVal_iscale
statement:
theorem sideVal_iscale (k : Int) (n u v : I3) :
    sideVal (iscale (k * k) n) (iscale k u) (iscale k v) = (k * k) * k * sideVal n u v
proof:
:= by
  rw [sideVal_eq, sideVal_eq, subI_iscale, dotI_iscale]

name: sideSigns_scale
statement:
theorem sideSigns_scale {k : Int} (hk : 0 < k) (n u : I3) (vs : Array I3) :
    sideSigns (iscale (k * k) n) (iscale k u) (vs.map (iscale k)) = sideSigns n u vs
proof:
:= by
  have hpos : 0 < (k * k) * k := by positivity
  simp only [sideSigns, Array.map_map]
  congr 1
  funext v
  simp only [Function.comp_apply]
  rw [subI_iscale, dotI_iscale, sign_mul_of_pos hpos]

name: coplanarSeparated_eq
statement:
theorem coplanarSeparated_eq (n : I3) (sv tv : Array I3) :
    coplanarSeparated n sv tv
      = ((Array.range 3).any (sepAt n sv tv) || (Array.range 3).any (sepAt n tv sv))
proof: := rfl

name: bne_scaled
statement: theorem bne_scaled {P : Int} (hP : P ≠ 0) (c : Int) : ((P * c) != 0) = (c != 0)
proof:
:= by
  show (!(_ == 0)) = (!(_ == 0)); rw [beq_zero_mul hP]

name: decide_scaled_nonpos
statement:
theorem decide_scaled_nonpos {P : Int} (hP : 0 < P) (c x : Int) :
    decide (P * c * (P * x) ≤ 0) = decide (c * x ≤ 0)
proof:
:= by
  refine decide_eq_decide.mpr ?_
  rw [show P * c * (P * x) = (P * P) * (c * x) from by ring]
  constructor <;> intro h <;> nlinarith [mul_pos hP hP]

name: sepAt_scale
statement:
theorem sepAt_scale {a k : Int} (ha : 0 < a) (hk : 0 < k) (n : I3)
    (own other : Array I3) (j : Nat) :
    sepAt (iscale a n) (own.map (iscale k)) (other.map (iscale k)) j = sepAt n own other j
proof:
:= by
  have hP : 0 < a * k * k := by positivity
  simp only [sepAt, map_iscale_getD, subI_iscale, crossI_iscale, dotI_iscale,
    bne_scaled hP.ne', decide_scaled_nonpos hP]

name: coplanarSeparated_scale
statement:
theorem coplanarSeparated_scale {a k : Int} (ha : 0 < a) (hk : 0 < k) (n : I3)
    (sv tv : Array I3) :
    coplanarSeparated (iscale a n) (sv.map (iscale k)) (tv.map (iscale k))
      = coplanarSeparated n sv tv
proof:
:= by
  rw [coplanarSeparated_eq, coplanarSeparated_eq]
  congr 1 <;> (congr 1; funext j; exact sepAt_scale ha hk _ _ _ j)

name: ble_decide
statement: theorem ble_decide (x y : Nat) : Nat.ble x y = decide (x ≤ y)
proof:
:= by
  rw [Bool.eq_iff_iff, Nat.ble_eq, decide_eq_true_eq]

name: dominantAxis_iscale
statement:
theorem dominantAxis_iscale {c : Int} (hc : 0 < c) (d : I3) :
    dominantAxis (iscale c d) = dominantAxis d
proof:
:= by
  have hn : 0 < c.natAbs := Int.natAbs_pos.mpr hc.ne'
  have hble : ∀ x y : Nat, Nat.ble (c.natAbs * x) (c.natAbs * y) = Nat.ble x y := by
    intro x y
    rw [ble_decide, ble_decide]
    exact decide_eq_decide.mpr (mul_le_mul_iff_of_pos_left hn)
  simp only [dominantAxis, iscale, Int.natAbs_mul, hble]

name: fracLt_scaled
statement:
theorem fracLt_scaled {k : Int} (hk : 0 < k) {p p' q q' : Int × Int}
    (hp : ScaledBy k p p') (hq : ScaledBy k q q') : fracLt p' q' = fracLt p q
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨mp, hmp, hp1, hp2⟩ := hp
  obtain ⟨mq, hmq, hq1, hq2⟩ := hq
  have hC : 0 < k * mp * mq := by positivity
  simp only [fracLt, hp1, hp2, hq1, hq2]
  refine decide_eq_decide.mpr ?_
  rw [show k * (mp * p.1) * (mq * q.2) = (k * mp * mq) * (p.1 * q.2) from by ring,
    show k * (mq * q.1) * (mp * p.2) = (k * mp * mq) * (q.1 * p.2) from by ring]
  exact mul_lt_mul_left hC

name: instanceOK3_scaled
statement:
theorem instanceOK3_scaled {k : Int} (hk : 0 < k) (sf : Array Int)
    {If If' Io Io' : Option ((Int × Int) × (Int × Int))}
    (hf : OptScaled k If If') (ho : OptScaled k Io Io') :
    instanceOK3 sf If' Io' = instanceOK3 sf If Io
proof:
:= by
  unfold instanceOK3
  by_cases hE : hasEdgeOnLine sf = true
  · rw [if_pos hE, if_pos hE]
  rw [if_neg hE, if_neg hE]
  rcases If with _ | ⟨af, bf⟩ <;> rcases If' with _ | ⟨af', bf'⟩ <;>
    rcases Io with _ | ⟨ao, bo⟩ <;> rcases Io' with _ | ⟨ao', bo'⟩ <;>
    simp only [OptScaled] at hf ho <;>
    first
      | exact hf.elim
      | exact ho.elim
      | rfl
      | skip
  obtain ⟨h1, h2⟩ := hf
  obtain ⟨h3, h4⟩ := ho
  have hl : ScaledBy k (if fracLt af ao = true then ao else af)
      (if fracLt af' ao' = true then ao' else af') := by
    rw [fracLt_scaled hk h1 h3]; split <;> assumption
  have hr : ScaledBy k (if fracLt bo bf = true then bo else bf)
      (if fracLt bo' bf' = true then bo' else bf') := by
    rw [fracLt_scaled hk h4 h2]; split <;> assumption
  simp only
  rw [fracLt_scaled hk hr hl, fracLt_scaled hk hl h2, fracLt_scaled hk h1 hr]

name: fracInterval_eq
statement:
theorem fracInterval_eq (ps : Array (Int × Int)) :
    fracInterval ps = ps.toList.foldl fracStep none
proof:
:= by
  rw [Array.foldl_toList]; rfl

name: fracStep_scaled
proof:
:= by
  rcases acc with _ | ⟨lo, hi⟩ <;> rcases acc' with _ | ⟨lo', hi'⟩ <;>
    simp only [OptScaled] at hacc
  · exact ⟨hp, hp⟩
  · obtain ⟨h1, h2⟩ := hacc
    refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
    · show ScaledBy k (if fracLt p lo = true then p else lo)
        (if fracLt p' lo' = true then p' else lo')
      rw [fracLt_scaled hk hp h1]; split <;> assumption
    · show ScaledBy k (if fracLt hi p = true then p else hi)
        (if fracLt hi' p' = true then p' else hi')
      rw [fracLt_scaled hk h2 hp]; split <;> assumption

name: foldl_scaled
statement:
theorem foldl_scaled {k : Int} (hk : 0 < k) :
    ∀ {l l' : List (Int × Int)}, List.Forall₂ (ScaledBy k) l l' →
      ∀ {acc acc' : Option ((Int × Int) × (Int × Int))}, OptScaled k acc acc' →
        OptScaled k (l.foldl fracStep acc) (l'.foldl fracStep acc')
proof:
:= by
  intro l
  induction l with
  | nil => intro l' h acc acc' hacc; cases h; simpa using hacc
  | cons p l ih =>
    intro l' h acc acc' hacc
    cases h with
    | cons hp htl =>
      simpa using ih htl (fracStep_scaled hk hacc hp)

name: fracInterval_scaled
proof:
:= by
  rw [fracInterval_eq, fracInterval_eq]
  exact foldl_scaled hk h trivial

name: forall
statement:
theorem forall₂_filterMap {α β γ : Type} {R : β → γ → Prop} (f : α → Option β) (g : α → Option γ)
    (h : ∀ a, (f a = none ∧ g a = none) ∨ (∃ b c, f a = some b ∧ g a = some c ∧ R b c))
    (l : List α) : List.Forall₂ R (l.filterMap f) (l.filterMap g)
proof:
:= by
  induction l with
  | nil => simp
  | cons a l ih =>
    rcases h a with ⟨h1, h2⟩ | ⟨b, c, h1, h2, hR⟩
    · rw [List.filterMap_cons_none h1, List.filterMap_cons_none h2]; exact ih
    · rw [List.filterMap_cons_some h1, List.filterMap_cons_some h2]
      exact List.Forall₂.cons hR ih

name: fracNorm_scaled
statement:
theorem fracNorm_scaled {k M : Int} (hM : 0 < M) (num den : Int) :
    ScaledBy k (fracNorm num den) (fracNorm (k * (M * num)) (M * den))
proof:
:= by
  have hd : (M * den < 0) ↔ (den < 0) := by
    constructor <;> intro h <;> nlinarith
  unfold fracNorm
  by_cases h : den < 0
  · rw [if_pos h, if_pos (hd.mpr h)]
    refine ⟨M, hM, ?_, ?_⟩
    · show -(k * (M * num)) = k * (M * -num); ring
    · show -(M * den) = M * -den; ring
  · rw [if_neg h, if_neg (fun hcon => h (hd.mp hcon))]
    exact ⟨M, hM, rfl, rfl⟩

name: edgeEntry_scaled
statement:
theorem edgeEntry_scaled {k : Int} (hk : 0 < k) (ea eb aDom bDom : Int) :
    ScaledBy k
      (fracNorm (aDom * (ea - eb) + ea * (bDom - aDom)) (ea - eb))
      (fracNorm (k * aDom * (k * k * k * ea - k * k * k * eb)
          + k * k * k * ea * (k * bDom - k * aDom))
        (k * k * k * ea - k * k * k * eb))
proof:
:= by
  have hM : (0:Int) < k * k * k := by positivity
  rw [show k * aDom * (k * k * k * ea - k * k * k * eb) + k * k * k * ea * (k * bDom - k * aDom)
      = k * ((k * k * k) * (aDom * (ea - eb) + ea * (bDom - aDom))) from by ring,
    show k * k * k * ea - k * k * k * eb = (k * k * k) * (ea - eb) from by ring]
  exact fracNorm_scaled hM _ _

name: collectParams_scaled
statement:
theorem collectParams_scaled {k : Int} (hk : 0 < k) (axis : Nat) (vs : Array I3)
    (signs : Array Int) (nO uO : I3) :
    List.Forall₂ (ScaledBy k) (collectParams axis vs signs nO uO).toList
      (collectParams axis (vs.map (iscale k)) signs (iscale (k * k) nO) (iscale k uO)).toList
proof:
:= by
  have hM : (0:Int) < k * k * k := by positivity
  simp only [collectParams, Array.toList_append, Array.toList_filterMap, Array.toList_range]
  refine List.rel_append ?_ ?_
  · refine forall₂_filterMap _ _ ?_ _
    intro i
    by_cases hc : (signs.getD i 0 == 0) = true
    · right
      refine ⟨(coordAt axis (vs.getD i default), 1),
        (coordAt axis ((vs.map (iscale k)).getD i default), 1), if_pos hc, if_pos hc, ?_⟩
      refine ⟨1, one_pos, ?_, ?_⟩
      · show coordAt axis ((vs.map (iscale k)).getD i default)
          = k * (1 * coordAt axis (vs.getD i default))
        rw [map_iscale_getD, coordAt_iscale]; ring
      · show (1:Int) = 1 * 1
        ring
    · exact Or.inl ⟨if_neg hc, if_neg hc⟩
  · refine forall₂_filterMap _ _ ?_ _
    intro i
    by_cases hc : (decide (signs.getD i 0 < 0) && decide (0 < signs.getD ((i + 1) % 3) 0) ||
        decide (0 < signs.getD i 0) && decide (signs.getD ((i + 1) % 3) 0 < 0)) = true
    · refine Or.inr ⟨_, _, if_pos hc, if_pos hc, ?_⟩
      simp only [map_iscale_getD, subI_iscale, dotI_iscale, coordAt_iscale]
      exact edgeEntry_scaled hk _ _ _ _
    · exact Or.inl ⟨if_neg hc, if_neg hc⟩

name: triPairOK_rescale
statement:
theorem triPairOK_rescale {k : Int} (hk : 0 < k) (s t : FaceH) :
    triPairOK (rescale k s) (rescale k t) = triPairOK s t
proof:
:= by
  have hkk : (0:Int) < k * k := by positivity
  have hd : (0:Int) < k * k * (k * k) := by positivity
  simp only [triPairOK, rescale_v₀, vertsOf_rescale, faceNormal_rescale,
    isZeroI_iscale hkk.ne', sideSigns_scale hk, coplanarSeparated_scale hkk hk,
    crossI_iscale, isZeroI_iscale hd.ne', dominantAxis_iscale hd]
  rw [instanceOK3_scaled hk _ (fracInterval_scaled hk (collectParams_scaled hk _ _ _ _ _))
        (fracInterval_scaled hk (collectParams_scaled hk _ _ _ _ _)),
    instanceOK3_scaled hk _ (fracInterval_scaled hk (collectParams_scaled hk _ _ _ _ _))
        (fracInterval_scaled hk (collectParams_scaled hk _ _ _ _ _))]

name: faceNormals_getD
statement:
theorem faceNormals_getD (A : Array (FaceH × Box3)) (i : Nat) :
    (faceNormals A).getD i default = faceNormal (A.getD i default).1
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hi : i < A.size
  · have hi' : i < (faceNormals A).size := by simpa [faceNormals] using hi
    rw [faceNormals, Array.getD_eq_get?, Array.getElem?_eq_getElem (by simpa using hi),
      Option.getD_some, Array.getElem_map, Array.getD_eq_get?,
      Array.getElem?_eq_getElem hi, Option.getD_some]
  · have hi' : ¬ i < (faceNormals A).size := by simpa [faceNormals] using hi
    rw [Array.getD, Array.getD, dif_neg hi, dif_neg hi']
    rfl

name: triPairOKAt_eq
statement:
theorem triPairOKAt_eq (A : Array (FaceH × Box3)) (i j : Nat)
    (hi : 0 < (A.getD i default).1.w) :
    triPairOKAt (faceNormals A) A i j
      = triPairOK (rescale (A.getD j default).1.w (A.getD i default).1)
          (rescale (A.getD i default).1.w (A.getD j default).1)
proof:
:= by
  unfold triPairOKAt
  by_cases hw : ((A.getD i default).1.w == (A.getD j default).1.w) = true
  · rw [if_pos hw, faceNormals_getD, faceNormals_getD, triPairOKN_eq]
    have hwe : (A.getD i default).1.w = (A.getD j default).1.w := by simpa using hw
    rw [← hwe]
    exact (triPairOK_rescale hi _ _).symm
  · rw [if_neg hw]

name: isCoplanarWith_clipFace_iff
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have hpl : f.plane = (faceSOf (MA[i]'hi)).plane := by
    have := clipFaceScoped_plane (fragOfFace (faceSOf (MA[i]'hi))) L hf
    simpa [fragOfFace] using this
  rw [Proof.MeshIntersectCoplanarKey.isCoplanarWith_eq_any]
  unfold TrFace
  rw [hpl]
  rw [Bool.eq_false_iff, Ne, Array.any_eq_true]
  push_neg
  constructor
  · intro hno j
    have hjm : j.1 < (materialize MB).size := by rw [materialize_size]; exact j.isLt
    have := hno ⟨j.1, hjm⟩
    rw [Fin.getElem_fin] at this
    rw [materialize_getElem MB j.1 j.isLt, coplanarPlane_symm] at this
    simpa using this
  · intro hyes u
    have hu' : u.1 < MB.size := by simpa [materialize] using u.isLt
    rw [Fin.getElem_fin]
    rw [materialize_getElem MB u.1 hu', coplanarPlane_symm]
    have := hyes ⟨u.1, hu'⟩
    rw [Fin.getElem_fin] at this
    simp [this]

name: filter_clipFace_of_TrFace
proof:
:= by
  rw [Array.toList_filter]
  refine List.filter_eq_self.mpr ?_
  intro f hf
  rw [Array.mem_toList] at hf
  rw [Bool.not_eq_true', (isCoplanarWith_clipFace_iff (MB := MB) meshId hi hf)]
  exact htr

name: filter_clipFace_of_not_TrFace
proof:
:= by
  rw [Array.toList_filter]
  refine List.filter_eq_nil_iff.mpr ?_
  intro f hf
  rw [Array.mem_toList] at hf
  
  simp only [Bool.not_eq_true', Bool.not_eq_false]
  
  by_contra hc
  rw [Bool.not_eq_true, (isCoplanarWith_clipFace_iff (MB := MB) meshId hi hf)] at hc
  exact htr hc

name: Aprime_cell_disjoint_coplanar_opponent
statement:
theorem Aprime_cell_disjoint_coplanar_opponent {M₁ M₂ : Mesh}
    (h₁ : NoPlaneThroughOrigin M₁) (h₂ : NoPlaneThroughOrigin M₂)
    {fa : Frag} (hfa : fa ∈ (splitCoplanar (fragsAOf M₁ M₂) (materialize M₂)).1)
    {faStar : Frag}
    (hInvDesc : ∀ {n c : _}, FragInv n c fa → FragInv n c faStar)
    (havoid : ∀ fb ∈ (splitCoplanar (fragsBOf M₁ M₂) (materialize M₁)).1,
      coplanarPlane fa.plane fb.plane = true →
        vrelint (fragCycle faStar) ∩ vrelint (fragCycle fb) = ∅)
    {j : ℕ} (hj : j < M₂.size)
    (hcop : coplanarPlane (faceSOf (M₂[j]'hj)).plane fa.plane = true) :
    vrelint (fragCycle faStar) ∩ triangleSet (M₂[j]'hj) = ∅
proof:
:= by
  classical
  set copB := (splitCoplanar (fragsBOf M₁ M₂) (materialize M₁)).1 with hcopB
  
  obtain ⟨i, hi, hfaInv, hdetA, hfapl, -⟩ := copA_carrier h₁ hfa
  haveI := hfaInv.neZero
  set n := carrierNormal (M₁[i]'hi) with hn
  set c := detOrigin (M₁[i]'hi) with hc
  
  have hfaStarInv : FragInv n c faStar := hInvDesc hfaInv
  haveI := hfaStarInv.neZero
  
  have hcopi : coplanarPlane (faceSOf (M₂[j]'hj)).plane (faceSOf (M₁[i]'hi)).plane = true := by
    rwa [hfapl] at hcop
  
  set base_j := fragOfFace (faceSOf (M₂[j]'hj)) with hbasej
  set L_j := planesForScoped ((materialize M₂).getD j default).plane (materialize M₁)
      ((candP M₂ M₁).getD j #[]) with hLj
  
  have hjMz : j < (materialize M₂).size := by rwa [materialize_size]
  have hbasej_eq :
      base_j = fragOfFace ((materialize M₂).getD j default) := by
    rw [hbasej, arr_getD _ _ _ hjMz, materialize_getElem M₂ j hj]
  
  have hdetB : detOrigin (M₂[j]'hj) ≠ 0 := h₂ ⟨j, hj⟩
  have hbaseInv : FragInv (carrierNormal (M₂[j]'hj)) (detOrigin (M₂[j]'hj)) base_j :=
    fragInv_base hdetB
  haveI := hbaseInv.neZero
  
  have hcover : vpoly (fragCycle base_j) = triangleSet (M₂[j]'hj) := by
    rw [hbasej]; exact vpoly_fragOfFace (M₂[j]'hj)
  
  have hpiece : ∀ fb ∈ clipFaceScoped base_j L_j,
      vrelint (fragCycle faStar) ∩ vpoly (fragCycle fb) = ∅ := by
    intro fb hfb
    
    have hfbmem_frags : fb ∈ fragsBOf M₁ M₂ := by
      rw [fragsBOf]
      refine mem_flatMap_arr.mpr ⟨j, ?_, ?_⟩
      · rw [Array.mem_def, Array.toList_range, List.mem_range]; exact hjMz
      · rw [← hbasej_eq]; exact hfb
    
    have hverdict : isCoplanarWith fb (materialize M₁) = true := by
      
      have hfb' : fb ∈ clipFaceScoped (fragOfFace ((materialize M₂).getD j default)) L_j := by
        rw [← hbasej_eq]; exact hfb
      
      have hnotTr : ¬ TrFace M₂ M₁ j hj := by
        intro htr
        have hfalse := htr ⟨i, hi⟩
        rw [Fin.getElem_fin] at hfalse
        rw [coplanarPlane_symm] at hfalse
        rw [hfalse] at hcopi; exact absurd hcopi (by simp)
      by_contra hc
      rw [Bool.not_eq_true] at hc
      have hbaseM₂ : (materialize M₂).getD j default = faceSOf (M₂[j]'hj) := by
        rw [arr_getD _ _ _ hjMz, materialize_getElem M₂ j hj]
      rw [hbaseM₂] at hfb'
      rw [(isCoplanarWith_clipFace_iff (MA := M₂) (MB := M₁) 2 hj hfb')] at hc
      exact hnotTr hc
    have hfbcopB : fb ∈ copB := by
      rw [hcopB, splitCoplanar]; simp only
      exact Array.mem_filter.mpr ⟨hfbmem_frags, by simpa using hverdict⟩
    
    
    have hfbpl_j : fb.plane = (faceSOf (M₂[j]'hj)).plane := by
      have := clipFaceScoped_plane base_j L_j hfb
      rw [hbasej, fragOfFace] at this; simpa using this
    
    obtain ⟨j', hj', hfbInv, hdetB', hfbpl, -⟩ := copB_carrier h₂ hfbcopB
    haveI := hfbInv.neZero
    
    have hcopfb : coplanarPlane fa.plane fb.plane = true := by
      rw [hfapl, hfbpl_j, coplanarPlane_symm]; exact hcopi
    
    have havoidfb : vrelint (fragCycle faStar) ∩ vrelint (fragCycle fb) = ∅ :=
      havoid fb hfbcopB hcopfb
    
    
    have hcopij' : coplanarPlane (faceSOf (M₁[i]'hi)).plane (faceSOf (M₂[j']'hj')).plane = true := by
      rw [← hfapl, ← hfbpl]; exact hcopfb
    obtain ⟨κ, hκ, hnκ, hcκ⟩ := coplanar_carrier_prop hdetA hdetB' hcopij'
    
    have hplfb : OnPlane n c (fragCycle fb) := by
      intro k
      have hk := hfbInv.onPlane k
      rw [hnκ, hcκ, Proof.MeshIntersectCoplanarClip.dotQ_smul_left] at hk
      exact mul_left_cancel₀ hκ hk
    exact vrelint_disjoint_vpoly_free hfaStarInv.size3 hfbInv.size3
      hfaStarInv.onPlane hfaStarInv.strictConv hplfb havoidfb
  
  rw [Set.eq_empty_iff_forall_not_mem]
  rintro x ⟨hxStar, hxbase⟩
  
  have hxhull : x ∈ vpoly (fragCycle base_j) := hcover ▸ hxbase
  obtain ⟨fb, hfb, hxfb⟩ := (clipFaceScoped_mem_vpoly_iff hbaseInv L_j x).mpr hxhull
  have := hpiece fb hfb
  rw [Set.eq_empty_iff_forall_not_mem] at this
  exact this x ⟨hxStar, hxfb⟩

name: Aprime_cell_seg_off_coplanar_opponent
statement:
theorem Aprime_cell_seg_off_coplanar_opponent {M₁ M₂ : Mesh}
    (h₁ : NoPlaneThroughOrigin M₁) (h₂ : NoPlaneThroughOrigin M₂)
    {fa : Frag} (hfa : fa ∈ (splitCoplanar (fragsAOf M₁ M₂) (materialize M₂)).1)
    {faStar : Frag}
    (hInvDesc : ∀ {n c : _}, FragInv n c fa → FragInv n c faStar)
    (havoid : ∀ fb ∈ (splitCoplanar (fragsBOf M₁ M₂) (materialize M₁)).1,
      coplanarPlane fa.plane fb.plane = true →
        vrelint (fragCycle faStar) ∩ vrelint (fragCycle fb) = ∅)
    {j : ℕ} (hj : j < M₂.size)
    (hcop : coplanarPlane (faceSOf (M₂[j]'hj)).plane fa.plane = true)
    {x y : Point} (hx : x ∈ vrelint (fragCycle faStar)) (hy : y ∈ vrelint (fragCycle faStar))
    {τ : ℚ} (hτ0 : 0 < τ) (hτ1 : τ ≤ 1) :
    (1 - τ) • x + τ • y ∉ triangleSet (M₂[j]'hj)
proof:
:= by
  
  have hseg : (1 - τ) • x + τ • y ∈ vrelint (fragCycle faStar) :=
    vrelint_absorb_free _ hy (vrelint_subset_vpoly _ hx) hτ0 hτ1
  
  have hdisj := Aprime_cell_disjoint_coplanar_opponent h₁ h₂ hfa hInvDesc havoid hj hcop
  rw [Set.eq_empty_iff_forall_not_mem] at hdisj
  intro hmem
  exact hdisj _ ⟨hseg, hmem⟩

name: Aprime_cell_disjoint_transverse_opponent
statement:
theorem Aprime_cell_disjoint_transverse_opponent {M₁ M₂ : Mesh}
    (h₁ : NoPlaneThroughOrigin M₁) (h₂ : NoPlaneThroughOrigin M₂)
    {fa : Frag} (hfa : fa ∈ (splitCoplanar (fragsAOf M₁ M₂) (materialize M₂)).1)
    {faStar : Frag}
    (hInvDesc : ∀ {n c : _}, FragInv n c fa → FragInv n c faStar)
    (hVpDesc : vpoly (fragCycle faStar) ⊆ vpoly (fragCycle fa))
    {k : ℕ} (hk : k < M₂.size)
    (htr : coplanarPlane (faceSOf (M₂[k]'hk)).plane fa.plane = false) :
    vrelint (fragCycle faStar) ∩ triangleSet (M₂[k]'hk) = ∅
proof:
:= by
  classical
  
  obtain ⟨i, hi, hfaInv, hdetA, hfapl, hfaclip⟩ := copA_carrier h₁ hfa
  haveI := hfaInv.neZero
  
  have hfaStarInv :
      FragInv (carrierNormal (M₁[i]'hi)) (detOrigin (M₁[i]'hi)) faStar :=
    hInvDesc hfaInv
  
  have htri : coplanarPlane (faceSOf (M₂[k]'hk)).plane (faceSOf (M₁[i]'hi)).plane = false := by
    rwa [hfapl] at htr
  have hspine : vrelint (fragCycle fa) ∩ triangleSet (M₂[k]'hk) = ∅ :=
    cs_off_side_transverse 1 hi hdetA hfaclip hk (h₂ ⟨k, hk⟩) htri
  
  have hvsub : vpoly (fragCycle faStar) ⊆ vpoly (fragCycle fa) := hVpDesc
  have hrsub : vrelint (fragCycle faStar) ⊆ vrelint (fragCycle fa) :=
    vrelint_descent_of_vpoly_subset hfaInv hfaStarInv hvsub
  
  rw [Set.eq_empty_iff_forall_not_mem]
  rintro z ⟨hzStar, hztri⟩
  rw [Set.eq_empty_iff_forall_not_mem] at hspine
  exact hspine z ⟨hrsub hzStar, hztri⟩

name: dotQ_eq_of_mem_vrelint
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨μ, _, hsum, rfl⟩ := hz
  exact dotQ_comb n (fragCycle fa) hsum hfa.onPlane

name: cop_Aprime_simplex_off'
statement:
theorem cop_Aprime_simplex_off' {M₁ M₂ : Mesh}
    (h₁ : NoPlaneThroughOrigin M₁) (h₂ : NoPlaneThroughOrigin M₂)
    {fa : Frag}
    (hfaA : fa ∈ (splitCoplanar (fragsAOf M₁ M₂) (materialize M₂)).1)
    {faStar : Frag}
    (hInvDesc : ∀ {n c : _}, FragInv n c fa → FragInv n c faStar)
    (havoid : ∀ fb ∈ (splitCoplanar (fragsBOf M₁ M₂) (materialize M₁)).1,
      coplanarPlane fa.plane fb.plane = true →
        vrelint (fragCycle faStar) ∩ vrelint (fragCycle fb) = ∅)
    {x y : Point} (hx : x ∈ vrelint (fragCycle faStar)) (hy : y ∈ vrelint (fragCycle faStar))
    {k : ℕ} (hk : k < M₂.size)
    (hcop : coplanarPlane (faceSOf (M₂[k]'hk)).plane fa.plane = true)
    {τ : ℚ} (h0 : 0 ≤ τ) (h1 : τ ≤ 1) :
    ∃ l : Fin 4, (slot (M₂[k]'hk) l).eval (seg x y τ) < 0
proof:
:= by
  
  obtain ⟨i, hi, hfaInv, hdetA, hfapl, -⟩ := copA_carrier h₁ hfaA
  have hfaStarInv :
      FragInv (carrierNormal (M₁[i]'hi)) (detOrigin (M₁[i]'hi)) faStar :=
    hInvDesc hfaInv
  
  have hsPi : dotQ (carrierNormal (M₁[i]'hi)) x = detOrigin (M₁[i]'hi) :=
    dotQ_eq_of_mem_vrelint hfaStarInv hx
  have hpPi : dotQ (carrierNormal (M₁[i]'hi)) y = detOrigin (M₁[i]'hi) :=
    dotQ_eq_of_mem_vrelint hfaStarInv hy
  have hzPi : dotQ (carrierNormal (M₁[i]'hi)) (seg x y τ) = detOrigin (M₁[i]'hi) := by
    have heq : seg x y τ = (1 - τ) • x + τ • y := by
      funext c; simp only [seg, Pi.add_apply, Pi.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul]; ring
    rw [heq, dotQ_affine_comb, hsPi, hpPi]; ring
  have hcopi : coplanarPlane (faceSOf (M₁[i]'hi)).plane (faceSOf (M₂[k]'hk)).plane = true := by
    rw [coplanarPlane_symm, hfapl] at hcop; exact hcop
  obtain ⟨κ, hκ, hnκ, hcκ⟩ :=
    coplanar_carrier_prop hdetA (h₂ ⟨k, hk⟩) hcopi
  simp only [Fin.getElem_fin] at hnκ hcκ
  have hbase : (slot (M₂[k]'hk) 3).eval (seg x y τ) = 0 := by
    rw [slot3_eval_zero_iff, hnκ, hcκ]
    rw [Proof.MeshIntersectCoplanarClip.dotQ_smul_left, hzPi]
  have hoff : (seg x y τ) ∉ triangleSet (M₂[k]'hk) := by
    rcases lt_or_eq_of_le h0 with h0' | h0'
    · have hh := Aprime_cell_seg_off_coplanar_opponent h₁ h₂ hfaA hInvDesc havoid hk
        hcop hx hy h0' h1
      have heq : ((1 - τ) • x + τ • y) = seg x y τ := by
        funext c; simp only [seg, Pi.add_apply, Pi.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul]; ring
      rwa [heq] at hh
    · have hdisj := Aprime_cell_disjoint_coplanar_opponent h₁ h₂ hfaA hInvDesc havoid hk hcop
      rw [Set.eq_empty_iff_forall_not_mem] at hdisj
      have hseg0 : seg x y τ = x := by
        rw [← h0']; funext c; simp only [seg]; ring
      rw [hseg0]; intro hmem; exact hdisj _ ⟨hx, hmem⟩
  exact neg_slot_of_base_vanish_off_triangle (h₂ ⟨k, hk⟩) hoff hbase

name: Aprime_seg_offSimplex_cop_core
statement:
theorem Aprime_seg_offSimplex_cop_core {M₁ M₂ : Mesh}
    (h₁ : Legacy.WellFormedMesh M₁) (h₂ : Legacy.WellFormedMesh M₂)
    {fa : Frag} (hfaA : fa ∈ (splitCoplanar (fragsAOf M₁ M₂) (materialize M₂)).1)
    {faStar : Frag}
    (hInvDesc : ∀ {n c : _}, FragInv n c fa → FragInv n c faStar)
    (havoid : ∀ fb ∈ (splitCoplanar (fragsBOf M₁ M₂) (materialize M₁)).1,
      coplanarPlane fa.plane fb.plane = true →
        vrelint (fragCycle faStar) ∩ vrelint (fragCycle fb) = ∅)
    {sStar p_i : Point}
    (hSrel : sStar ∈ vrelint (fragCycle faStar)) (hPrel : p_i ∈ vrelint (fragCycle faStar)) :
    ∀ (k : ℕ) (hk : k < M₂.size),
      coplanarPlane (faceSOf (M₂[k]'hk)).plane fa.plane = true →
      ∀ τ : ℚ, 0 ≤ τ → τ ≤ 1 → (seg sStar p_i τ) ∉ simplex (M₂[k]'hk)
proof:
:= by
  intro k hk hcop τ h0 h1
  
  obtain ⟨l, hl⟩ := cop_Aprime_simplex_off' h₁.2.2.2 h₂.2.2.2 hfaA hInvDesc havoid hSrel hPrel
    hk hcop h0 h1
  intro hmem
  have hdet3 : det3 (M₂[k]'hk).v₀ (M₂[k]'hk).v₁ (M₂[k]'hk).v₂ ≠ 0 := by
    rw [det3_eq_detOrigin]; exact h₂.2.2.2 ⟨k, hk⟩
  have := (mem_simplex_iff_slots hdet3 (seg sStar p_i τ)).mp hmem l
  linarith

name: Bprime_cell_disjoint_coplanar_opponent
statement:
theorem Bprime_cell_disjoint_coplanar_opponent {M₁ M₂ : Mesh}
    (h₁ : NoPlaneThroughOrigin M₁) (h₂ : NoPlaneThroughOrigin M₂)
    {fb : Frag} (hfb : fb ∈ (splitCoplanar (fragsBOf M₁ M₂) (materialize M₁)).1)
    {fbStar : Frag}
    (hInvDesc : ∀ {n c : _}, FragInv n c fb → FragInv n c fbStar)
    (havoid : ∀ fa ∈ (splitCoplanar (fragsAOf M₁ M₂) (materialize M₂)).1,
      coplanarPlane fb.plane fa.plane = true →
        vrelint (fragCycle fbStar) ∩ vrelint (fragCycle fa) = ∅)
    {i : ℕ} (hi : i < M₁.size)
    (hcop : coplanarPlane (faceSOf (M₁[i]'hi)).plane fb.plane = true) :
    vrelint (fragCycle fbStar) ∩ triangleSet (M₁[i]'hi) = ∅
proof:
:= by

  set copA := (splitCoplanar (fragsAOf M₁ M₂) (materialize M₂)).1 with hcopA
  
  obtain ⟨j, hj, hfbInv, hdetB, hfbpl, -⟩ := copB_carrier h₂ hfb
  haveI := hfbInv.neZero
  set n := carrierNormal (M₂[j]'hj) with hn
  set c := detOrigin (M₂[j]'hj) with hc
  
  have hfbStarInv : FragInv n c fbStar := hInvDesc hfbInv
  haveI := hfbStarInv.neZero
  
  have hcopj : coplanarPlane (faceSOf (M₁[i]'hi)).plane (faceSOf (M₂[j]'hj)).plane = true := by
    rwa [hfbpl] at hcop
  
  set base_i := fragOfFace (faceSOf (M₁[i]'hi)) with hbasei
  set L_i := planesForScoped ((materialize M₁).getD i default).plane (materialize M₂)
      ((candP M₁ M₂).getD i #[]) with hLi
  have hiMz : i < (materialize M₁).size := by rwa [materialize_size]
  have hbasei_eq :
      base_i = fragOfFace ((materialize M₁).getD i default) := by
    rw [hbasei, arr_getD _ _ _ hiMz, materialize_getElem M₁ i hi]
  have hdetA : detOrigin (M₁[i]'hi) ≠ 0 := h₁ ⟨i, hi⟩
  have hbaseInv : FragInv (carrierNormal (M₁[i]'hi)) (detOrigin (M₁[i]'hi)) base_i :=
    fragInv_base hdetA
  haveI := hbaseInv.neZero
  have hcover : vpoly (fragCycle base_i) = triangleSet (M₁[i]'hi) := by
    rw [hbasei]; exact vpoly_fragOfFace (M₁[i]'hi)
  
  have hpiece : ∀ fa ∈ clipFaceScoped base_i L_i,
      vrelint (fragCycle fbStar) ∩ vpoly (fragCycle fa) = ∅ := by
    intro fa hfa
    
    have hfamem_frags : fa ∈ fragsAOf M₁ M₂ := by
      rw [fragsAOf]
      refine mem_flatMap_arr.mpr ⟨i, ?_, ?_⟩
      · rw [Array.mem_def, Array.toList_range, List.mem_range]; exact hiMz
      · rw [← hbasei_eq]; exact hfa
    have hverdict : isCoplanarWith fa (materialize M₂) = true := by
      have hfa' : fa ∈ clipFaceScoped (fragOfFace ((materialize M₁).getD i default)) L_i := by
        rw [← hbasei_eq]; exact hfa
      have hnotTr : ¬ TrFace M₁ M₂ i hi := by
        intro htr
        have hfalse := htr ⟨j, hj⟩
        rw [Fin.getElem_fin] at hfalse
        rw [coplanarPlane_symm] at hfalse
        rw [hfalse] at hcopj; exact absurd hcopj (by simp)
      by_contra hcc
      rw [Bool.not_eq_true] at hcc
      have hbaseM₁ : (materialize M₁).getD i default = faceSOf (M₁[i]'hi) := by
        rw [arr_getD _ _ _ hiMz, materialize_getElem M₁ i hi]
      rw [hbaseM₁] at hfa'
      rw [(isCoplanarWith_clipFace_iff (MA := M₁) (MB := M₂) 1 hi hfa')] at hcc
      exact hnotTr hcc
    have hfacopA : fa ∈ copA := by

    have hfapl_i : fa.plane = (faceSOf (M₁[i]'hi)).plane := by
      have := clipFaceScoped_plane base_i L_i hfa
      rw [hbasei, fragOfFace] at this; simpa using this
    obtain ⟨i', hi', hfaInv, hdetA', hfapl, -⟩ := copA_carrier h₁ hfacopA
    haveI := hfaInv.neZero
    have hcopfa : coplanarPlane fb.plane fa.plane = true := by
      rw [hfbpl, hfapl_i, coplanarPlane_symm]; exact hcopj
    have havoidfa : vrelint (fragCycle fbStar) ∩ vrelint (fragCycle fa) = ∅ :=
      havoid fa hfacopA hcopfa
    
    have hcopji' : coplanarPlane (faceSOf (M₂[j]'hj)).plane (faceSOf (M₁[i']'hi')).plane = true := by
      rw [← hfbpl, ← hfapl]; exact hcopfa
    obtain ⟨κ, hκ, hnκ, hcκ⟩ := coplanar_carrier_prop hdetB hdetA' hcopji'
    have hplfa : OnPlane n c (fragCycle fa) := by

      hfbStarInv.onPlane hfbStarInv.strictConv hplfa havoidfa
  
  rw [Set.eq_empty_iff_forall_not_mem]
  rintro x ⟨hxStar, hxbase⟩
  have hxhull : x ∈ vpoly (fragCycle base_i) := hcover ▸ hxbase
  obtain ⟨fa, hfa, hxfa⟩ := (clipFaceScoped_mem_vpoly_iff hbaseInv L_i x).mpr hxhull
  have := hpiece fa hfa
  rw [Set.eq_empty_iff_forall_not_mem] at this
  exact this x ⟨hxStar, hxfa⟩

name: Bprime_cell_disjoint_transverse_opponent
statement:
theorem Bprime_cell_disjoint_transverse_opponent {M₁ M₂ : Mesh}
    (h₁ : NoPlaneThroughOrigin M₁) (h₂ : NoPlaneThroughOrigin M₂)
    {fb : Frag} (hfb : fb ∈ (splitCoplanar (fragsBOf M₁ M₂) (materialize M₁)).1)
    {fbStar : Frag}
    (hInvDesc : ∀ {n c : _}, FragInv n c fb → FragInv n c fbStar)
    (hVpDesc : vpoly (fragCycle fbStar) ⊆ vpoly (fragCycle fb))
    {i : ℕ} (hi : i < M₁.size)
    (htr : coplanarPlane (faceSOf (M₁[i]'hi)).plane fb.plane = false) :
    vrelint (fragCycle fbStar) ∩ triangleSet (M₁[i]'hi) = ∅
proof:
:= by
  classical
  obtain ⟨j, hj, hfbInv, hdetB, hfbpl, hfbclip⟩ := copB_carrier h₂ hfb
  haveI := hfbInv.neZero
  have hfbStarInv :
      FragInv (carrierNormal (M₂[j]'hj)) (detOrigin (M₂[j]'hj)) fbStar :=
    hInvDesc hfbInv
  have htri : coplanarPlane (faceSOf (M₁[i]'hi)).plane (faceSOf (M₂[j]'hj)).plane = false := by
    rwa [hfbpl] at htr
  have hspine : vrelint (fragCycle fb) ∩ triangleSet (M₁[i]'hi) = ∅ :=
    cs_off_side_transverse 2 hj hdetB hfbclip hi (h₁ ⟨i, hi⟩) htri
  have hvsub : vpoly (fragCycle fbStar) ⊆ vpoly (fragCycle fb) := hVpDesc
  have hrsub : vrelint (fragCycle fbStar) ⊆ vrelint (fragCycle fb) :=
    vrelint_descent_of_vpoly_subset hfbInv hfbStarInv hvsub
  rw [Set.eq_empty_iff_forall_not_mem]
  rintro z ⟨hzStar, hztri⟩
  rw [Set.eq_empty_iff_forall_not_mem] at hspine
  exact hspine z ⟨hrsub hzStar, hztri⟩

name: cop_Bprime_simplex_off'
statement:
theorem cop_Bprime_simplex_off' {M₁ M₂ : Mesh}
    (h₁ : NoPlaneThroughOrigin M₁) (h₂ : NoPlaneThroughOrigin M₂)
    {fb : Frag}
    (hfbB : fb ∈ (splitCoplanar (fragsBOf M₁ M₂) (materialize M₁)).1)
    {fbStar : Frag}
    (hInvDesc : ∀ {n c : _}, FragInv n c fb → FragInv n c fbStar)
    (havoid : ∀ fa ∈ (splitCoplanar (fragsAOf M₁ M₂) (materialize M₂)).1,
      coplanarPlane fb.plane fa.plane = true →
        vrelint (fragCycle fbStar) ∩ vrelint (fragCycle fa) = ∅)
    {x y : Point} (hx : x ∈ vrelint (fragCycle fbStar)) (hy : y ∈ vrelint (fragCycle fbStar))
    {i : ℕ} (hi : i < M₁.size)
    (hcop : coplanarPlane (faceSOf (M₁[i]'hi)).plane fb.plane = true)
    {τ : ℚ} (h0 : 0 ≤ τ) (h1 : τ ≤ 1) :
    ∃ l : Fin 4, (slot (M₁[i]'hi) l).eval (seg x y τ) < 0
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨j, hj, hfbInv, hdetB, hfbpl, -⟩ := copB_carrier h₂ hfbB
  have hfbStarInv :
      FragInv (carrierNormal (M₂[j]'hj)) (detOrigin (M₂[j]'hj)) fbStar :=
    hInvDesc hfbInv
  have hsPi : dotQ (carrierNormal (M₂[j]'hj)) x = detOrigin (M₂[j]'hj) :=
    dotQ_eq_of_mem_vrelint hfbStarInv hx
  have hpPi : dotQ (carrierNormal (M₂[j]'hj)) y = detOrigin (M₂[j]'hj) :=
    dotQ_eq_of_mem_vrelint hfbStarInv hy
  have hzPi : dotQ (carrierNormal (M₂[j]'hj)) (seg x y τ) = detOrigin (M₂[j]'hj) := by
    have heq : seg x y τ = (1 - τ) • x + τ • y := by
      funext cc; simp only [seg, Pi.add_apply, Pi.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul]; ring
    rw [heq, dotQ_affine_comb, hsPi, hpPi]; ring
  have hcopj : coplanarPlane (faceSOf (M₂[j]'hj)).plane (faceSOf (M₁[i]'hi)).plane = true := by
    rw [coplanarPlane_symm, hfbpl] at hcop; exact hcop
  obtain ⟨κ, hκ, hnκ, hcκ⟩ :=
    coplanar_carrier_prop hdetB (h₁ ⟨i, hi⟩) hcopj
  simp only [Fin.getElem_fin] at hnκ hcκ
  have hbase : (slot (M₁[i]'hi) 3).eval (seg x y τ) = 0 := by
    rw [slot3_eval_zero_iff, hnκ, hcκ]
    rw [Proof.MeshIntersectCoplanarClip.dotQ_smul_left, hzPi]
  have hoff : (seg x y τ) ∉ triangleSet (M₁[i]'hi) := by
    rcases lt_or_eq_of_le h0 with h0' | h0'
    · have hh := Bprime_cell_seg_off_coplanar_opponent h₁ h₂ hfbB hInvDesc havoid hi
        hcop hx hy h0' h1
      have heq : ((1 - τ) • x + τ • y) = seg x y τ := by
        funext cc; simp only [seg, Pi.add_apply, Pi.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul]; ring
      rwa [heq] at hh
    · have hdisj := Bprime_cell_disjoint_coplanar_opponent h₁ h₂ hfbB hInvDesc havoid hi hcop
      rw [Set.eq_empty_iff_forall_not_mem] at hdisj
      have hseg0 : seg x y τ = x := by
        rw [← h0']; funext cc; simp only [seg]; ring
      rw [hseg0]; intro hmem; exact hdisj _ ⟨hx, hmem⟩
  exact neg_slot_of_base_vanish_off_triangle (h₁ ⟨i, hi⟩) hoff hbase

name: Bprime_seg_offSimplex_cop_core
statement:
theorem Bprime_seg_offSimplex_cop_core {M₁ M₂ : Mesh}
    (h₁ : Legacy.WellFormedMesh M₁) (h₂ : Legacy.WellFormedMesh M₂)
    {fb : Frag} (hfbB : fb ∈ (splitCoplanar (fragsBOf M₁ M₂) (materialize M₁)).1)
    {fbStar : Frag}
    (hInvDesc : ∀ {n c : _}, FragInv n c fb → FragInv n c fbStar)
    (havoid : ∀ fa ∈ (splitCoplanar (fragsAOf M₁ M₂) (materialize M₂)).1,
      coplanarPlane fb.plane fa.plane = true →
        vrelint (fragCycle fbStar) ∩ vrelint (fragCycle fa) = ∅)
    {sStar p_i : Point}
    (hSrel : sStar ∈ vrelint (fragCycle fbStar)) (hPrel : p_i ∈ vrelint (fragCycle fbStar)) :
    ∀ (i : ℕ) (hi : i < M₁.size),
      coplanarPlane (faceSOf (M₁[i]'hi)).plane fb.plane = true →
      ∀ τ : ℚ, 0 ≤ τ → τ ≤ 1 → (seg sStar p_i τ) ∉ simplex (M₁[i]'hi)
proof:
:= by
  intro i hi hcop τ h0 h1
  obtain ⟨l, hl⟩ := cop_Bprime_simplex_off' h₁.2.2.2 h₂.2.2.2 hfbB hInvDesc havoid hSrel hPrel
    hi hcop h0 h1
  intro hmem
  have hdet3 : det3 (M₁[i]'hi).v₀ (M₁[i]'hi).v₁ (M₁[i]'hi).v₂ ≠ 0 := by
    rw [det3_eq_detOrigin]; exact h₁.2.2.2 ⟨i, hi⟩
  have := (mem_simplex_iff_slots hdet3 (seg sStar p_i τ)).mp hmem l
  linarith

name: excludes_ledger_bundle
statement:
theorem excludes_ledger_bundle (M₁ M₂ MA MB : Mesh)
    (h₁ : NoPlaneThroughOrigin M₁) (h₂ : NoPlaneThroughOrigin M₂)
    (meshId : Nat) (hMA : NoPlaneThroughOrigin MA) (hnpoB : NoPlaneThroughOrigin MB) :
    Excludes (fun Q => ∀ (i : Fin MA.size),
      TrFace MA MB i.1 i.isLt → LedgerBundle M₁ M₂ MA MB meshId i.1 i.isLt Q)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  refine Excludes.forall_fintype (fun i => ?_)
  by_cases htr : TrFace MA MB i.1 i.isLt
  · have hdetA : detOrigin (MA[i.1]'i.isLt) ≠ 0 := hMA i
    have hL := ledger_face_gen (M₁ := M₁) (M₂ := M₂) (MA := MA) (MB := MB)
      h₁ h₂ meshId i.isLt hdetA hnpoB htr
    exact hL.mono (fun Q hQ _ => hQ)
  · exact Excludes.trivial (fun _ hc => absurd hc htr)

name: stepSum_one_eq_sum_jumps
statement:
theorem stepSum_one_eq_sum_jumps {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι] (S : ι → ℚ × ℤ) :
    stepSum S 1
      = ∑ v ∈ (Finset.univ.filter (fun k => 1 ≤ (S k).1)).image (fun k => (S k).1),
          stepJumpAt S v
proof:
:= by
  classical
  rw [step_telescope]
  set s : Finset ι := Finset.univ.filter (fun k => 1 ≤ (S k).1) with hs
  
  rw [← Finset.sum_fiberwise_of_maps_to
        (t := s.image (fun k => (S k).1)) (g := fun k => (S k).1)
        (fun i hi => Finset.mem_image_of_mem _ hi) (fun k => (S k).2)]
  
  
  refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun v hv => ?_)
  rw [stepJumpAt]
  obtain ⟨k₀, hk₀s, hk₀v⟩ := Finset.mem_image.mp hv
  have hv1 : (1 : ℚ) ≤ v := by
    have := (Finset.mem_filter.mp hk₀s).2
    rw [hk₀v] at this; exact this
  apply Finset.sum_congr ?_ (fun _ _ => rfl)
  ext k
  simp only [hs, Finset.mem_filter, Finset.mem_univ, true_and]
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨_, hkv⟩; exact hkv
  · intro hkv; exact ⟨by rw [hkv]; exact hv1, hkv⟩

name: stepJumpAt_eq_zero_of_not_mem
statement:
theorem stepJumpAt_eq_zero_of_not_mem {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι] (S : ι → ℚ × ℤ) {v : ℚ}
    (hv : v ∉ Finset.univ.image (fun k => (S k).1)) : stepJumpAt S v = 0
proof:
:= by
  classical
  rw [stepJumpAt]
  apply Finset.sum_eq_zero
  intro k hk
  have hkv : (S k).1 = v := (Finset.mem_filter.mp hk).2
  exact absurd (hkv ▸ Finset.mem_image_of_mem (fun k => (S k).1) (Finset.mem_univ k)) hv

name: stepSum_one_eq_of_jumps
statement:
theorem stepSum_one_eq_of_jumps {ι₁ ι₂ : Type*} [Fintype ι₁] [Fintype ι₂]
    (A : ι₁ → ℚ × ℤ) (B : ι₂ → ℚ × ℤ)
    (hjump : ∀ v : ℚ, 1 ≤ v → stepJumpAt A v = stepJumpAt B v) :
    stepSum A 1 = stepSum B 1
proof:
:= by
  classical
  rw [stepSum_one_eq_sum_jumps A, stepSum_one_eq_sum_jumps B]
  set IA : Finset ℚ := (Finset.univ.filter (fun k => 1 ≤ (A k).1)).image (fun k => (A k).1)
    with hIA
  set IB : Finset ℚ := (Finset.univ.filter (fun k => 1 ≤ (B k).1)).image (fun k => (B k).1)
    with hIB
  
  have hmemA : ∀ v : ℚ, v ∈ IA ↔ (1 ≤ v ∧ v ∈ Finset.univ.image (fun k => (A k).1)) := by
    intro v
    rw [hIA, Finset.mem_image, Finset.mem_image]
    constructor
    · rintro ⟨k, hk, hkv⟩
      exact ⟨by rw [← hkv]; exact (Finset.mem_filter.mp hk).2, k, Finset.mem_univ k, hkv⟩
    · rintro ⟨hv, k, _, hkv⟩
      exact ⟨k, Finset.mem_filter.mpr ⟨Finset.mem_univ k, by rw [hkv]; exact hv⟩, hkv⟩
  have hmemB : ∀ v : ℚ, v ∈ IB ↔ (1 ≤ v ∧ v ∈ Finset.univ.image (fun k => (B k).1)) := by
    intro v
    rw [hIB, Finset.mem_image, Finset.mem_image]
    constructor
    · rintro ⟨k, hk, hkv⟩
      exact ⟨by rw [← hkv]; exact (Finset.mem_filter.mp hk).2, k, Finset.mem_univ k, hkv⟩
    · rintro ⟨hv, k, _, hkv⟩
      exact ⟨k, Finset.mem_filter.mpr ⟨Finset.mem_univ k, by rw [hkv]; exact hv⟩, hkv⟩
  
  have hAext : ∑ v ∈ IA, stepJumpAt A v = ∑ v ∈ IA ∪ IB, stepJumpAt A v := by
    refine Finset.sum_subset (f := fun v => stepJumpAt A v) Finset.subset_union_left ?_
    intro v hvU hvIA
    apply stepJumpAt_eq_zero_of_not_mem
    intro hvimg
    refine hvIA ((hmemA v).mpr ⟨?_, hvimg⟩)
    rcases Finset.mem_union.mp hvU with h | h
    · exact ((hmemA v).mp h).1
    · exact ((hmemB v).mp h).1
  have hBext : ∑ v ∈ IB, stepJumpAt B v = ∑ v ∈ IA ∪ IB, stepJumpAt B v := by
    refine Finset.sum_subset (f := fun v => stepJumpAt B v) Finset.subset_union_right ?_
    intro v hvU hvIB
    apply stepJumpAt_eq_zero_of_not_mem
    intro hvimg
    refine hvIB ((hmemB v).mpr ⟨?_, hvimg⟩)
    rcases Finset.mem_union.mp hvU with h | h
    · exact ((hmemA v).mp h).1
    · exact ((hmemB v).mp h).1
  rw [hAext, hBext]
  refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun v hv => ?_)
  
  have hv1 : 1 ≤ v := by
    rcases Finset.mem_union.mp hv with h | h
    · exact ((hmemA v).mp h).1
    · exact ((hmemB v).mp h).1
  exact hjump v hv1

name: stepSum_sumElim
statement:
theorem stepSum_sumElim {ι₁ ι₂ : Type*} [Fintype ι₁] [Fintype ι₂]
    (A : ι₁ → ℚ × ℤ) (C : ι₂ → ℚ × ℤ) (μ : ℚ) :
    stepSum (Sum.elim A C) μ = stepSum A μ + stepSum C μ
proof:
:= by
  classical
  rw [stepSum, stepSum, stepSum, Fintype.sum_sum_type]
  rfl

name: stepJumpAt_sumElim
statement:
theorem stepJumpAt_sumElim {ι₁ ι₂ : Type*} [Fintype ι₁] [Fintype ι₂]
    (A : ι₁ → ℚ × ℤ) (C : ι₂ → ℚ × ℤ) (v : ℚ) :
    stepJumpAt (Sum.elim A C) v = stepJumpAt A v + stepJumpAt C v
proof:
:= by
  classical
  rw [stepJumpAt, stepJumpAt, stepJumpAt]
  
  rw [Finset.sum_filter, Finset.sum_filter, Finset.sum_filter, Fintype.sum_sum_type]
  rfl

name: stepSum_one_eq_sub_of_jumps
statement:
theorem stepSum_one_eq_sub_of_jumps {ιA ιB ιC : Type*}
    [Fintype ιA] [Fintype ιB] [Fintype ιC]
    (A : ιA → ℚ × ℤ) (B : ιB → ℚ × ℤ) (C : ιC → ℚ × ℤ)
    (hjump : ∀ v : ℚ, 1 ≤ v → stepJumpAt A v + stepJumpAt C v = stepJumpAt B v) :
    stepSum A 1 = stepSum B 1 - stepSum C 1
proof:
:= by
  have hAC : stepSum (Sum.elim A C) 1 = stepSum B 1 :=
    stepSum_one_eq_of_jumps (Sum.elim A C) B (fun v hv => by
      rw [stepJumpAt_sumElim]; exact hjump v hv)
  rw [stepSum_sumElim] at hAC
  omega

name: stepLeft_prodSteps
statement:
theorem stepLeft_prodSteps {ι₁ ι₂ : Type*} [Fintype ι₁] [Fintype ι₂]
    (S₁ : ι₁ → ℚ × ℤ) (S₂ : ι₂ → ℚ × ℤ) (μ₀ : ℚ) :
    stepLeft (prodSteps S₁ S₂) μ₀ = stepLeft S₁ μ₀ * stepLeft S₂ μ₀
proof:
:= by
  classical
  rw [stepLeft, stepLeft, stepLeft, Finset.sum_mul_sum, ← Finset.sum_product']
  rw [show (Finset.univ.filter (fun k => μ₀ ≤ (S₁ k).1)
        ×ˢ Finset.univ.filter (fun k => μ₀ ≤ (S₂ k).1))
      = Finset.univ.filter (fun p => μ₀ ≤ (prodSteps S₁ S₂ p).1) from ?_]
  · rfl
  · ext p; simp [prodSteps, Finset.mem_product, le_min_iff]

name: stepRight_prodSteps
statement:
theorem stepRight_prodSteps {ι₁ ι₂ : Type*} [Fintype ι₁] [Fintype ι₂]
    (S₁ : ι₁ → ℚ × ℤ) (S₂ : ι₂ → ℚ × ℤ) (μ₀ : ℚ) :
    stepRight (prodSteps S₁ S₂) μ₀ = stepRight S₁ μ₀ * stepRight S₂ μ₀
proof:
:= by
  classical
  rw [stepRight, stepRight, stepRight, Finset.sum_mul_sum, ← Finset.sum_product']
  rw [show (Finset.univ.filter (fun k => μ₀ < (S₁ k).1)
        ×ˢ Finset.univ.filter (fun k => μ₀ < (S₂ k).1))
      = Finset.univ.filter (fun p => μ₀ < (prodSteps S₁ S₂ p).1) from ?_]
  · rfl
  · ext p; simp [prodSteps, Finset.mem_product, lt_min_iff]

name: stepJumpAt_eq_left_sub_right
statement:
theorem stepJumpAt_eq_left_sub_right {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι] (S : ι → ℚ × ℤ) (μ₀ : ℚ) :
    stepJumpAt S μ₀ = stepLeft S μ₀ - stepRight S μ₀
proof:
:= by
  rw [stepJumpAt, stepLeft_sub_stepRight]

name: stepJumpAt_prodSteps
statement:
theorem stepJumpAt_prodSteps {ι₁ ι₂ : Type*} [Fintype ι₁] [Fintype ι₂]
    (S₁ : ι₁ → ℚ × ℤ) (S₂ : ι₂ → ℚ × ℤ) (μ₀ : ℚ) :
    stepJumpAt (prodSteps S₁ S₂) μ₀
      = stepLeft S₁ μ₀ * stepLeft S₂ μ₀ - stepRight S₁ μ₀ * stepRight S₂ μ₀
proof:
:= by
  rw [stepJumpAt_eq_left_sub_right, stepLeft_prodSteps, stepRight_prodSteps]
